lines.content: 世界がそっと、ため息をつく――
lines.translated: The world lets out a quiet, quiet sigh --

lines.content: 胸に。
lines.translated: Into my chest.

lines.content: 瞳に。
lines.translated: Into my eyes.

lines.content: ……心の中に。
lines.translated: Into my heart.

lines.content: そんな言葉が舞い降りた。
lines.translated: Those words came drifting down.

lines.content: ひら、
lines.translated: Drifting,

lines.content: ひら、
lines.translated: Drifting,

lines.content: ひらり。
lines.translated: Softly down.

lines.content: トンネルを走る真っ暗な車窓。
lines.translated: A pitch-black window rushing through a tunnel.

lines.content: そのほんの少しの隙間から、どこからか小さな春色が舞い込んで――
lines.translated: Through that tiny gap, a small breath of spring came drifting in from somewhere --

lines.content: ……う、んん
lines.translated: mm, mmh...

lines.content: ――鼻先に花びらが、ひとつ。
lines.translated: -- A single petal, right at the tip of her nose.

lines.content: 隣に座るあの子の寝顔を彩った。
lines.translated: It settled softly over the sleeping face of the girl beside me.

lines.content: ……くしゅっ
lines.translated: achoo...

lines.content: 小さなくしゃみにもめげない[ひとひら|一片]を摘もうと、そっと伸ばした俺の手は。
lines.translated: I reached out gently to pluck the petal that refused to be deterred by her little sneeze -- but my hand was stopped.

lines.content: ……だい、じょうぶ
lines.translated: i'm... fine...

lines.content: 俺のその手は、あの子にそっと、握られた。
lines.translated: My hand was caught, softly, in hers.

lines.content: ……だいじょうぶだよ
lines.translated: i'm okay...

lines.content: ……眠たげな小さな口元から、ひらり、
lines.translated: from her drowsy little lips, fluttering,

lines.content: ……大丈夫。絶対、ぜったい。君をひとりぼっちになんて、させないよ
lines.translated: it's okay. i promise, i promise. i won't ever let you be alone.

lines.content: ……ひらりと、
lines.translated: fluttering,

lines.content: 絶対に、約束……だから
lines.translated: i promise... i really do...

lines.content: ……少しずつこぼれた言葉は、花びらみたいに風に流され、消えゆくばかり。
lines.translated: the words spilled out little by little, carried off by the wind like petals, fading away.

lines.content: 今までたくさん、つらいことも、悲しいことも、あったけど……
lines.translated: there have been so many hard things, so many sad things, up until now... but...

lines.content: これから、きっと……。これから、ずっと。君にはいいことばかりが、起こるんだよ。絶対に。ぜったい。……わたしが君に、約束するよ
lines.translated: from here on, i know it... from here on, forever. only good things are going to happen to you. i promise. i absolutely promise. ...i'm making you that promise.

lines.content: 眠たげなあの子が微笑んだ。
lines.translated: The drowsy girl smiled.

lines.content: そのまま俺たちは手を握り合う。
lines.translated: And just like that, we held each other's hands.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: ため息だ。
lines.translated: A sigh.

lines.content: ……俺たちは、世界と共にため息をつく。
lines.translated: together with the world, we sighed.

lines.content: トンネルが抜けたのだ。
lines.translated: The tunnel had ended.

lines.content: 車窓に光。眩しい、光。
lines.translated: Light in the window. Brilliant, blinding light.

lines.content: ……ほら、見て。すごいよ。とってもきれいだ
lines.translated: look. isn't it amazing. it's so beautiful.

lines.content: 君と、俺。
lines.translated: You, and I.

lines.content: 車窓から覗き込んだ世界は鮮やかで。
lines.translated: The world that peeked back at us through the window was vivid and alive.

lines.content: ひらひらの、
lines.translated: Fluttering,

lines.content: ふわふわの、
lines.translated: Drifting,

lines.content: 桜の木々で、満ちていて……。
lines.translated: Full of cherry blossom trees, overflowing with them...
Mm.

lines.content: あの子がおもむろに立ち上がり、車窓を勢いよく開け放つ。
lines.translated: She suddenly rose to her feet and threw the train window open wide.

lines.content: 桜だ。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 列車の中に春がたくさん、たくさん、流れ込んでくる。車内はあっという間に春の色。
lines.translated: Spring came pouring in -- so much of it, so much -- flooding the car until everything was the color of spring.

lines.content: あの子は、俺の大切な、友だちは……。
lines.translated: She, my precious, my dear friend...

lines.content: いっぱいの春が雪崩れ込む窓から身体を乗り出し、
lines.translated: She leaned her whole body out through the window as spring came avalanching in,

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.

lines.content: 何かを、叫んだ。
lines.translated: and screamed something.

lines.content: 大きな声で。
lines.translated: At the top of her lungs.

lines.content: 無口なあの子の口からは、一度も聞いたことのないような、大きな声で。
lines.translated: From the lips of that quiet girl -- a voice louder than anything I had ever heard from her before.

lines.content: その叫びはこの世界への宣戦布告。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: That cry was a declaration of war upon this world. It had to be.

lines.content: ……だから俺も真似して、何かを叫ぶ。
lines.translated: So I followed her lead and screamed something too.

lines.content: 物語だ。
lines.translated: A story.

lines.content: これからどんなことがあったとしても、ふたりは絶対離れないと、誓いあい――
lines.translated: No matter what lay ahead, we swore we would never be apart -- and with that oath between us --

lines.content: ……物語が、はじまる。
lines.translated: the story begins.

lines.content: 俺は“夢”を叶えることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to make my "dream" come true?

lines.content: 君は、笑顔のままでいてくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will you keep on smiling?

lines.content: この“心”に再び“夜”がやって来る、その前に。
lines.translated: Before the "night" comes again to this "heart" of mine.
Can I... kill myself?

lines.translated: From the lips of that quiet girl -- a voice louder than anything I had ever heard from her before.

lines.content: ……だから俺も真似して、何かを叫ぶ。
lines.translated: So I followed her lead and screamed something too.

lines.content: 物語だ。
lines.translated: A story.

lines.content: これからどんなことがあったとしても、ふたりは絶対離れないと、誓いあい――
lines.translated: No matter what lay ahead, we swore we would never be apart -- and with that oath between us --

lines.content: ……物語が、はじまる。
lines.translated: the story begins.

lines.content: 俺は“夢”を叶えることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to make my "dream" come true?

lines.content: 君は、笑顔のままでいてくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will you keep on smiling?

lines.content: この“心”に再び“夜”がやって来る、その前に。
lines.translated: Before the "night" comes again to this "heart" of mine.
Can I... kill myself?

lines.content: ようこそ。さくらの杜の“夜”の下へ
lines.translated: Welcome. To the "night" beneath the forest of cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 辿り着いた扉をふたりで開くと……、
lines.translated: Together, the two of us opened the door we had finally reached...

lines.content: 君たちとこうして出会えることを、私は、私たちは、ずっとずっと心待ちにしていたよ
lines.translated: I -- we -- have been waiting, so very long, to meet you like this.

lines.content: やさしい“夜”が、そして“魔法”が、俺たちの到着を待っていた。
lines.translated: A gentle "night" -- and "magic" -- had been waiting for our arrival.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 俺の心が、ため息をつく――
lines.translated: My heart lets out a sigh --

lines.content: どこで道を間違えたのか。
lines.translated: Where did I take the wrong road?

lines.content: どこで選択を誤ったのか。
lines.translated: Where did I make the wrong choice?
Where is the hero?

lines.content: この物語を救いたい。救わなければ。
lines.translated: I want to save this story. I have to save it.

lines.content: 心の中に熱く、さみしい、[叫び|銃声]を轟かせて……。
lines.translated: A hot, lonely cry -- like a gunshot -- thundering through my chest...

lines.content: たったひとりの君を救うため。
lines.translated: To save the one and only you.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]は、何度だって――……
lines.translated: I will, as many times as it takes --...

lines.content: あー。これで、今日から晴れて宿なしかぁ……
lines.translated: Ahh. So starting today, I'm officially homeless, huh...

lines.content: 『本棚を見ればその人物がどのような人生を送ってきたかわかる』――とは誰の言葉だっただろうか。
lines.translated: "You can tell what kind of life a person has lived by looking at their bookshelf" -- whose words were those, again?

lines.content: 肩から下げたたったひとつのスポーツバック。
lines.translated: A single sports bag, slung over my shoulder.

lines.content: そしてペンダントのように首から下げた古い鍵がひとつきり。
lines.translated: And one old key, hanging from my neck like a pendant.

lines.content: それがこの俺、[かなで|奏][たいが|大雅]の全財産。
lines.translated: That was the sum total of everything I owned -- me, Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 過去、現在、あるいは未来――
lines.translated: Past, present, or perhaps future --

lines.content: その縮図であるらしい本棚なんて、今は持ち合わせているはずもなく。
lines.translated: A bookshelf, supposedly a miniature of all that -- I had no such thing to speak of.

lines.content: 何ひとつとして所有できなかったこれまでの人生。きっと薄っぺらだと笑われるに違いない。
lines.translated: A life in which I had never been able to own a single thing. I'm sure people would laugh and call it pathetically thin.

lines.content: だが何もないということは幸運だ。
lines.translated: But having nothing is its own kind of luck.

lines.content: ……今の両手が空っぽであるのなら。
lines.translated: If my hands are empty right now,

lines.content: これから獲得出来うるすべてのものを、余さず、放さず、運んでいける――はずだから。
lines.translated: then everything I have yet to gain -- I can carry it all, every last bit of it, without letting a single thing go -- or so I tell myself.

lines.content: さあ、これからどうする
lines.translated: So then. What now?

lines.content: 見上げた空は、快晴。
lines.translated: I looked up. The sky was perfectly clear.

lines.content: 季節は春。
lines.translated: The season was spring.

lines.content: 心地よく。柔らかく。期待を煽る、始まりの季節。
lines.translated: Comfortable. Soft. A season of beginnings, stirring up expectation.

lines.content: 新たな門出にふさわしい。
lines.translated: Fitting for a new departure.

lines.content: これからはじまる[未来|時間]はきっと、この春色みたいに鮮やかだ――
lines.translated: The future stretching out ahead of me -- surely it would be as vivid as the colors of this spring --

lines.content: ……等と。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 強がってみたはいいけれど、
lines.translated: Not that the bravado lasted long.

lines.content: ……うう
lines.translated: Ugh.

lines.content: お腹を押さえる。
lines.translated: I pressed a hand to my stomach.

lines.content: 居候の腹の虫が“何でもいいから目一杯食わせろ”と暴れていた。“未来より、今だろ”と。
lines.translated: The freeloader living in my gut was throwing a fit -- "feed me something, anything, and make it a full meal." "Forget the future, what about right now?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。……そういえば、腹、減ったよなぁ
lines.translated: Yeah, yeah, fair enough. ...Come to think of it, I am pretty hungry.

lines.content: 考えてみたら朝食を食べ損ねてしまっていた。急いで準備を整えていたから……。
lines.translated: I'd missed breakfast, now that I thought about it. I'd been in such a rush getting ready...

lines.content: まったく。今日は一応、[・|特][・|別][・|な][・|日]だっていうのにな
lines.translated: Honestly. Today is supposed to be a special day, of all days.

lines.content: それなのに空腹だなんてちょっと切ない。
lines.translated: And yet here I am, starving. That's a little sad.

lines.content: 財布を取り出す。
lines.translated: I pulled out my wallet.

lines.content: 一円玉ばかりで三十二円。行きつけのラーメン屋の割引券が二、三枚。
lines.translated: Thirty-two yen, almost entirely in one-yen coins. Two or three discount coupons for a ramen place I used to go to.

lines.content: 三十二円じゃ駄菓子がふたつかみっつ買えるくらいじゃないか。そんなんじゃ腹の足しにもならないなあ
lines.translated: Thirty-two yen -- that might buy me two or three pieces of penny candy, maybe. Not exactly enough to fill a stomach.

lines.content: 我ながらわびしい。
lines.translated: Even by my own standards, that's pretty bleak.

lines.content: 独り言だって増えるというもの。
lines.translated: No wonder I'm talking to myself more and more.

lines.content: 本棚よりもまずは食費がほしい。
lines.translated: What I need right now isn't a bookshelf -- it's grocery money.

lines.content: どう足掻いてみても結構やばい――
lines.translated: No matter how I look at it, things are pretty dire --

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 少し、先の方。
lines.translated: A little ways ahead.

lines.content: 道ばたに何かが落ちているのに気づいた。
lines.translated: I noticed something lying on the side of the road.

lines.content: 近づいてみる。
lines.translated: I moved closer to get a look.

lines.content: 破られたメモ用紙のようなものが、一ページ。
lines.translated: A single torn page, like a scrap of memo paper.

lines.content: その上に何かが置かれていた。
lines.translated: Something had been placed on top of it.

lines.content: 拾い上げてみる。
lines.translated: I picked it up.

lines.content: チョコ？
lines.translated: Chocolate?

lines.content: カラフルな包み紙にくるまれたチョコレート。
lines.translated: A chocolate, wrapped in colorful foil.

lines.content: それもひとつだけではない。
lines.translated: And not just one.

lines.content: ふたつ、みっつ。
lines.translated: Two, three.

lines.content: 何で、こんなところに
lines.translated: Why would these be here, of all places...

lines.content: 首を傾げる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: そこでメモ用紙にこう書かれているのに気がついた。
lines.translated: That's when I noticed something written on the memo paper.

lines.content: あまいの
lines.translated: Sweet ones

lines.content: にがいの
lines.translated: Bitter ones

lines.content: ちょっと、にがいの
lines.translated: these are a little bitter

lines.content: どれでも、どうぞ
lines.translated: please, take any one you like

lines.content: はは
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: 微笑む。
lines.translated: I smiled.

lines.content: お世辞にも上手とは言えない字だ。
lines.translated: The handwriting was, to put it charitably, not exactly polished.

lines.content: みみずがのたくったような――と乱暴な感想を添えるほど意地悪にはなりきれない。その必要だってない。……この子には。
lines.translated: "Like a worm wriggling across the page" -- I couldn't quite bring myself to be that harsh about it. And there was no need to be. ...Not with this girl.

lines.content: ひらがなだけで書かれたメモを丁寧に折り畳む。
lines.translated: I carefully folded the note, written entirely in hiragana.

lines.content: 大事に、大事に、ポケットにしまう。
lines.translated: Gently, gently, I tucked it into my pocket.

lines.content: ……振り返る。
lines.translated: And looked back.

lines.content: きょろきょろとしながら、言う。
lines.translated: I glanced around and spoke.

lines.content: おかえり、クロ。今回はちょっと長かったね。……どこにいる？
lines.translated: "Welcome back, Kuro. You were gone a little longer this time. ...Where are you?"

lines.content: っ
施設の門柱。
lines.translated: The gatepost of the facility.

lines.content: そこから飛び出していたものが、びくっ、と飛び跳ねるように震えた。
lines.translated: Whatever had been poking out from behind the gatepost gave a startled little jump.

lines.content: なに、やってるの？　そんなところで
lines.translated: "What are you doing? Over there, of all places..."

lines.content: 苦笑い――
lines.translated: A wry smile--

lines.content: 近づくとだめだ。きっと、逃げられる。
lines.translated: If I get any closer, she'll bolt. I'm sure of it.

lines.content: そんな気がする。
lines.translated: That's just the feeling I get.

lines.content: だから振り返ったまま声をかけることにした。
lines.translated: So I decided to keep my back turned and call out to her that way.

lines.content: ありがとう。チョコレート、君の大好物なのに……。今回のお土産かな。よかったら一緒に食べようか
lines.translated: "Thank you. Chocolate is your favorite, and yet... Is this your souvenir from this time? Want to eat it together, if you'd like?"

lines.content: 返答はない。
lines.translated: No answer.

lines.content: 門柱から飛び出していたものが――
lines.translated: Whatever had been peeking out from behind the gatepost --

lines.content: 白い猫の耳としっぽの持ち主は、恐る恐るというふうにこちらを覗いていた。
lines.translated: The owner of those white cat ears and tail was peering over at me, cautious and hesitant.

lines.content: ただただ無口に。寡黙に。どこか、心配そうに。こちらを見つめているばかり。
lines.translated: Simply silent. Quietly reserved. Watching me with something that looked almost like worry. Just watching.

lines.content: いらないの？
lines.translated: You don't want any?
Mm.

lines.content: こっくりと、一度だけうなずいた。
lines.translated: She gave one small, deliberate nod.

lines.content: そっか。残念
lines.translated: "I see. That's a shame."

lines.content: 包みを取ってチョコをひとつ口に放り込む。
lines.translated: I unwrapped one of the chocolates and popped it into my mouth.

lines.content: ……あまい。
lines.translated: "...Sweet."

lines.content: 空腹にしみるなあ
lines.translated: "Really hits the spot when you're hungry."

lines.content: しみじみとしてしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but feel it deeply.
--Eh?

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 小さすぎて聞こえなかった。
lines.translated: It was too quiet to hear.

lines.content: なんて？
lines.translated: What was that?

lines.content: ……お、おいし……い？
lines.translated: "...I-is it... good...?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。とっても
lines.translated: "Yeah. Really good."
Mm.

lines.content: うれしそう。
lines.translated: She looked happy.

lines.content: しっぽがぶんぶんと勢いよく左右に振れる。
lines.translated: Her tail swung back and forth with great enthusiasm.

lines.content: なあ、クロ。本当に食べない？　まだあとふたつ残ってるけど……
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. You really don't want any? There are still two left..."

lines.content: そっか。相変わらず人見知りだな。そろそろ俺にくらい慣れてくれてもいいのになあとは思うけど
lines.translated: "I see. Still as shy as ever, huh. I keep thinking you'd have warmed up to me a little by now, at least..."

lines.content: ……いや。どうかな。
lines.translated: "...Well. I don't know."

lines.content: 昔は今ほど警戒されてはいなかったように思うのに。
lines.translated: I could have sworn she used to be less guarded around me than she is now.

lines.content: いやいや。
lines.translated: No, no.

lines.content: 昔は警戒なんてほどんとされていなかったように、思うのに。
lines.translated: I could have sworn she barely used to be guarded around me at all.

lines.content: どうしてこうまで距離を置かれてしまっているのか。
lines.translated: I wonder why she keeps her distance from me like this.

lines.content: 俺の身体が成長すればするだけ、なんだか君との距離が遠くなっていくように思えてしまう。
lines.translated: It feels like the more I grow, the further away you get.

lines.content: 俺、少しここで休憩していくけれど、もしも食べたかったら出ておいで
lines.translated: "I'm going to rest here for a bit -- if you want any, come on out."

lines.content: 少し意地悪だろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe that was a little mean of me.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながらも、俺は近くに立つさくらの木の下に腰掛ける。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I sat down beneath a nearby cherry tree.

lines.content: チョコレートを側に置く。さっきのメモ用紙を下に敷いて。
lines.translated: I set the chocolates down beside me, laying them on top of the note from earlier.

lines.content: もうすっかり春だな。……きれいだ。すごく
lines.translated: It's really spring now, isn't it? ...It's beautiful. Really beautiful.

lines.content: 桜並木。
lines.translated: The row of cherry trees.

lines.content: 町を囲む山々は桃色に染まっている。
lines.translated: The mountains surrounding the town were dyed a soft pink.

lines.content: ここからは町がよく見渡せた。
lines.translated: From up here, you could see the whole town clearly.

lines.content: ……風が吹く。
lines.translated: A breeze blew past.

lines.content: ざーっという木々のざわめき。
lines.translated: The rustling of the trees swept through the air.

lines.content: 桜吹雪だ。
lines.translated: A flurry of cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 甘い香りの桃色がたくさん、たくさん、町に降り注いでいく。
lines.translated: Countless sweet-scented pink petals rained down over the town.

lines.content: 俺は、目を細めた。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: 色々なことを思い出してしまう。
lines.translated: So many memories came flooding back.

lines.content: この町にやって来てからのことだ。
lines.translated: Memories from ever since I first came to this town.

lines.content: はじめての友だちができたこと。
lines.translated: Making my very first friends.

lines.content: はじめて、[・|あ][・|の][・|人][・|以][・|外][・|に]、家族だと思える人たちができたこと。
lines.translated: Finding people I could think of as family for the first time, besides her.

lines.content: さみしい悲しい時どきうれしい。
lines.translated: Lonely, sad, and every now and then, happy.

lines.content: そんな気持ちは、いつまでもなくならなかったこと。
lines.translated: How those feelings never truly went away.

lines.content: 今もまだ、時おり、“心”に“夜”がやって来ること。
lines.translated: How even now, every so often, "Night" still visits my heart.

lines.content: ……君と列車に乗ってこの町にやって来たあの日のこと。
lines.translated: And that day I rode the train with you and arrived in this town.

lines.content: 色々だ。
lines.translated: So many things.

lines.content: ふわ
lines.translated: Phew...

lines.content: あくびをひとつ、噛みしめて――
lines.translated: Stifling a yawn--

lines.content: このチョコレート、どうしたの
lines.translated: Where did you get this chocolate, anyway?

lines.content: そーっと。
lines.translated: Very quietly.

lines.content: 背後からチョコに伸ばされていた手があった。
lines.translated: A hand had been reaching out from behind me toward the chocolate.

lines.content: ……ちゃ、ちゃんと
lines.translated: I-I properly...

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……ちゃんと、買ったんだ
lines.translated: I bought it properly.

lines.content: ため息をつき――諦めたように、言った。
lines.translated: She let out a sigh--and said it as if giving up.

lines.content: だが、隣に座ってはくれなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, she wouldn't sit down next to me.

lines.content: さくらの木に手を添えて――俺の後ろに立つ。
lines.translated: Resting a hand against the trunk of the cherry tree--she stood right behind me.

lines.content: ふたりで町を眺めた。
lines.translated: Together, the two of us looked out over the town.

lines.content: 少しの間、沈黙。
lines.translated: Silence fell for a little while.

lines.content: 静かに時間が過ぎていく。
lines.translated: Time passed quietly by.

lines.content: あの子の呼吸する音さえも聞こえてくるかのようだった。
lines.translated: It felt as though I could even hear the sound of her breathing.

lines.content: また、風が吹く。
lines.translated: The wind blew again.

lines.content: 舞い上がった花びらに、鼻先をくすぐられたのだろうか――
lines.translated: Maybe a swirling petal had tickled the tip of her nose--

lines.content: ……くちゅ
lines.translated: Achoo.

lines.content: ――背後であの子がくしゃみをした。
lines.translated: --because she sneezed right behind me.

lines.content: はは
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: 思わず笑ってしまった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but laugh.

lines.content: 不満そうな気配を背後に感じながらも。
lines.translated: Even as I sensed her sulking presence behind me.

lines.content: ……さくら。きれいだ
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms. They're beautiful.

lines.content: ……そう、だね
lines.translated: Yeah, they are.

lines.content: 一年中春だったらいいのに。時どきそんなふうに思うよ
lines.translated: I wish it could be spring all year round. Sometimes I really think that.

lines.content: ……ぽかぽかだから
lines.translated: Because it's nice and warm.

lines.content: そうだね。ぽかぽかだから
lines.translated: Yeah. Because it's nice and warm.

lines.content: 微笑んで、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Smiling, I continued.

lines.content: この町に来たときも春だった。だからかな。俺、春が結構好きなんだ
lines.translated: It was spring when I first came to this town, too. Maybe that's why. I actually like spring quite a bit.
Even though it was inside the "Night."

lines.content: ああ、うん。そうだった
lines.translated: Ah, yeah. That's right.

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ……入り口は、いつも[・|夢]の中だよね
lines.translated: The entrance is always inside a dream, isn't it?

lines.content: ふたりで眺めるさくら色の町。
lines.translated: A cherry-blossom-colored town, viewed by the two of us.

lines.content: この風景には色々な思い出が詰まっている。
lines.translated: This scenery was packed with so many memories.

lines.content: ……クロは今、何を思うのだろう。
lines.translated: What was Kuro thinking about right now, I wondered?

lines.content: 俺と同じように昔を懐かしんでいるだろうか。
lines.translated: Was she looking back fondly on the past, just like I was?

lines.content: もしもそうなら少し、ほんの少し、うれしい。
lines.translated: If she was, that would make me a little--just a tiny bit--happy.

lines.content: ……チョコをもうひとつ、口に放り込んだ。
lines.translated: I popped another piece of chocolate into my mouth.

lines.content: 今度は少し苦い味。
lines.translated: This one had a slightly bitter taste.

lines.content: じんわりと溶ける。
lines.translated: It melted slowly on my tongue.

lines.content: そういえば猫はチョコレート食べちゃだめなんじゃなかったっけか。猫にとってこの苦みや甘みは猛毒なのだ。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, aren't cats supposed to stay away from chocolate? To a cat, this bitterness and sweetness would be deadly poison.

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 名を呼ばれ、振り向く。
lines.translated: Hearing my name called, I turned around.

lines.content: するとあの子が。
lines.translated: And there she was.

lines.content: クロと名付けた小さな子が。
lines.translated: The little girl I had named Kuro.

lines.content: ……目を細め、俺を見つめていた。
lines.translated: She was narrowing her eyes, gazing straight at me.

lines.content: そして細く、微かに震える声で言ったのだ。
lines.translated: And in a thin, faintly trembling voice, she spoke.

lines.content: 大雅。いまは、どう
lines.translated: Taiga. How are things, now?

lines.content: どう……？
lines.translated: How are things...?

lines.content: うん。……さみしくは、ない？
lines.translated: Yeah. ...Are you lonely?

lines.content: ひとりぼっちには、なってない？
lines.translated: You're not all alone, are you?

lines.content: ――やさしい誰かが側にいてくれる？
lines.translated: --Is there someone kind staying by your side?

lines.content: ……少し、心配だ
lines.translated: I'm a little worried.

lines.content: 小さな声で、ため息にも似た声色で、彼女は言った。
lines.translated: She spoke in a small voice that sounded almost like a sigh.

lines.content: ……わたしには、[・|う][・|そ][・|つ][・|き]な、わたしなんかには。こんなこと言える権利なんて、ないけど。心配なんだ。凄く、すごく
lines.translated: For me--for a liar like me, I don't have any right to say something like this, I know. But I'm worried. Really, really worried.

lines.content: 考える。
lines.translated: I thought about it.

lines.content: どうしたら君を安心させられるだろう。
lines.translated: How could I put her mind at ease?

lines.content: どうしたら君は、俺の言葉を信じてくれるだろう。
lines.translated: How could I get her to believe my words?

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: おかげさまでひとりじゃないよ。さみしくもない。心配はないよ
lines.translated: Thanks to you, I'm not alone. I'm not lonely, either. There's nothing to worry about.

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: ふわりと君が微笑んだ。
lines.translated: A soft smile bloomed on her face.

lines.content: 深く、ふかく、安心したのだというように。
lines.translated: As though she were deeply, truly relieved.

lines.content: 普段は無口で無表情。
lines.translated: Normally, she was quiet and expressionless.

lines.content: 俺以外の誰ともまともに話そうとしないからなのか――
lines.translated: Maybe it was because she never tried to have a proper conversation with anyone other than me--

lines.content: まるで長いながい間引きこもっていて、久しぶりに人と会話をするのだというふうに、舌先が暖まるまでは言葉を所々詰まらせたりもする。
lines.translated: Like someone who had been shut away for a long, long time and was finally talking to another person again, she would stumble over her words here and there until her tongue warmed up.

lines.content: 消極的な、というのが正しいのかわからないが、とにかくそんな性格が本来であるはずの彼女だけれど、俺の前では一生懸命、話をしようとしてくれる。
lines.translated: I didn't know if "passive" was the right word for it, but even though that was her true nature, she always tried her hardest to talk when she was in front of me.

lines.content: ……笑顔で、いてくれようとする。
lines.translated: She tried to keep smiling for me.

lines.content: そんな君を見ていると、どうしてかな、少し……。
lines.translated: Watching her do that, for some reason, made me feel a little...

lines.content: 少しだけ、俺はさみしい。
lines.translated: Just a little bit lonely.

lines.content: ……チョコは
lines.translated: About the chocolate.

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: どうして手に入れたのか、大雅。気にしていたけど……チョコはちゃんと買ったんだよ。盗んだりはしていない。悪いことはしてないよ。本当
lines.translated: You were wondering how I got it, right, Taiga? ...I bought the chocolate properly. I didn't steal it. I didn't do anything bad. Really.

lines.content: うん。わかってるよ
lines.translated: Yeah. I know.

lines.content: もちろんだ。
lines.translated: Of course I did.

lines.content: 君が誰かに迷惑かけたり、傷つけたり。そんな悪いことなんてするはずがない――でも。
lines.translated: There was no way she would ever cause trouble for someone, or hurt anyone, or do anything bad like that--even so.

lines.content: ……でも、さ。お金はどうしたのかな。他意はないけど少し気になる。大変だったんじゃないかなあって
lines.translated: Still, though. How did you get the money? I don't mean anything by it, I'm just a little curious. I figured it must've been tough.

lines.content: ……自動販売機の下とか。おつりとか。道の隅に落ちてるのとか。探して集めた
lines.translated: Underneath vending machines. Forgotten change. Coins dropped on the side of the road. I looked around and gathered them up.

lines.content: おお、意外とサバイバルな答えだ
lines.translated: Oh, that's a surprisingly survivalist answer.

lines.content: 時どき商店街のお店のおつかいもした。おつりをもらえるんだよ
lines.translated: Sometimes I ran errands for the shops in the shopping district, too. They let me keep the change.
In your cat form?

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: どこか得意そうに、言う。
lines.translated: She said it with a hint of pride.

lines.content: 猫の姿だと人と話さなくて済むから楽なのだ、とも。
lines.translated: Adding that being in her cat form was easier because she didn't have to talk to people.

lines.content: あと……お金、百円玉が三枚と、十円玉が五枚。五円玉も一枚。残ってる
lines.translated: Also... for money, I have three hundred-yen coins, and five ten-yen coins. And one five-yen coin, too. Left over.

lines.content: すごい。俺よりお金持ちだ
lines.translated: Amazing. You're richer than I am.

lines.content: そう……？
lines.translated: Really...?

lines.content: そうだよ。妬ましいやね
lines.translated: Really. Makes me jealous.

lines.content: くすりと笑った。
lines.translated: She giggled softly.

lines.content: 背後からそんな気配がする……気がした。
lines.translated: Or at least... I felt like I sensed her doing so behind me.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: うん、なに？
lines.translated: Yeah, what is it?

lines.content: ……わたしは、あまり頭がよくない。だって、猫だから
lines.translated: I'm not very smart. Because I'm a cat.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅とちゃんと、話せるように……本を読んだり、テレビを見たり。勉強は、たくさんしてるけど……字もまだひらがなしか書けない
lines.translated: So that I can talk with you properly, Taiga... I read books, and watch TV. I study a lot, but... I can still only write in hiragana.

lines.content: でも、これだけお金があったらね。チョコはまだ、いっぱい買える。それくらいはわかるんだ
lines.translated: Even so, with this much money, I know I can still buy a whole lot of chocolate. I understand that much, at least.

lines.content: ああ。そうだね。たくさん、たくさん、買えそうだ。甘いのも、少し苦いのも。たくさんだ
lines.translated: Yeah. That's true. You could buy lots and lots of it. Both the sweet kind and the slightly bitter kind. Plenty of it.

lines.content: うん。だからそれは、大雅。やっぱりきみが全部食べてほしいんだよ。……今日はとっても、[・|特][・|別][・|な][・|日][・|だ][・|か][・|ら]
lines.translated: Yeah. So, Taiga, I really want you to eat it all. ...Because today is a very special day.

lines.content: わかった。……そうだね。そういうことなら、ありがたくいただくよ
lines.translated: Got it. ...You're right. In that case, I'll gladly accept it.

lines.content: もう全部食べちゃったけどね、と笑う俺。
lines.translated: Though I already ate it all, I added with a laugh.

lines.content: そんな俺に、少しうれしそうな声で、安心したような声で……囁くようにクロが言った。
lines.translated: Hearing that, Kuro spoke in a whisper, her voice sounding a little happy and relieved.

lines.content: ……おめでとう。大雅
lines.translated: Happy birthday, Taiga.

lines.content: 大切に。慎重に。言葉を選ぶみたいにして。
lines.translated: Carefully. Cautiously. As if choosing each word with care.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: きみがこの世界に生まれてきてくれて、本当に、よかった
lines.translated: I'm truly glad that you were born into this world.

lines.content: 俺は、町を見つめてる。
lines.translated: I gazed out at the town.

lines.content: 君のくれた言葉にずきりと、胸が、心が痛んだけれど……。
lines.translated: The words she gave me sent a sharp ache through my chest, through my heart, and yet...

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: こちらこそ、ありがとう。
lines.translated: I'm the one who should be thanking you.

lines.content: 君のおかげで俺はまだこうして生きていられる――それは何の比喩表現でもなく、ただの事実なのだ。
lines.translated: It's thanks to you that I'm still able to live like this--that wasn't a figure of speech, just the simple truth.
You gave me courage. And helped me make up my mind.

lines.content: だけど、
lines.translated: Even so,

lines.content: ……なんだか
lines.translated: Somehow,

lines.content: ふと、微笑む。照れ笑いだ。
lines.translated: A sudden smile slipped out. A sheepish grin.

lines.content: なんだかちょっとだけ、恥ずかしいかも。面と向かって“おめでとう”とか、“ありがとう”って言われるのは
lines.translated: Somehow, it's a little embarrassing. Being told "happy birthday" and "thank you" face-to-face like this.

lines.content: ……次はチョコよりもいいプレゼントが、できますように
lines.translated: Next time, I hope I can give you a better present than chocolate.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: また来年も。無事に、大雅がこの日を迎えられますように
lines.translated: And next year, too. I hope you can safely welcome this day again, Taiga.

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: もうそこにあの子の姿はどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: She was already nowhere to be seen.

lines.content: でも……姿は見えないが、どこかで俺を見守っていてくれるはずだ。
lines.translated: Still... even if I couldn't see her, I knew she had to be watching over me from somewhere.

lines.content: 普段あの子は、あまり俺に近寄ってはくれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Normally, she didn't come very close to me...

lines.content: でも今日は特別な日。
lines.translated: But today was a special day.

lines.content: だからあの子も特別なことをしてくれたのだろう。
lines.translated: That was probably why she had done something special for me, too.

lines.content: ……さて。とりあえず、行こうか
lines.translated: All right. Guess I should get going for now.

lines.content: 立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood up.

lines.content: 鞄を肩に背負いなおす。
lines.translated: I slung my bag back over my shoulder.

lines.content: 十年の間過ごした施設を、今日、俺は出る。
lines.translated: Today, I was leaving the institution where I had spent the last ten years.

lines.content: 家族のいないこの俺にとって、ここは実家のようなものだった。
lines.translated: For someone without a family like me, this place had been like my childhood home.

lines.content: 今日までお世話になりました
lines.translated: Thank you for taking care of me up until today.

lines.content: 頭を下げる。深々と。
lines.translated: I bowed my head. Deeply.

lines.content: ここを出れば身寄りのない俺は正真正銘、天涯孤独となる。
lines.translated: Once I left this place, with no relatives to my name, I would truly be all alone in the world.

lines.content: 踵を返す。
lines.translated: I turned on my heel.

lines.content: 改めて、一番高いところから町を見下ろした。
lines.translated: Once again, I looked down over the town from the highest vantage point.

lines.content: 春先の、暖かく、あまやかな香りが鼻先をくすぐる。
lines.translated: The warm, sweet scent of early spring tickled the tip of my nose.

lines.content: 微笑みと共に両目を細めた。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes with a smile.

lines.content: すー……
lines.translated: *Inhale*...

lines.content: 息を大きく吸い込んだ。
lines.translated: I took a deep breath.

lines.content: いっぱいの春を胸に感じる。
lines.translated: Feeling my chest fill with the spring air.

lines.content: 花の匂い。太陽の香り。涼風の感触。
lines.translated: The scent of flowers. The smell of the sun. The touch of the cool breeze.

lines.content: はぁ……
lines.translated: *Exhale*...

lines.content: 深くふかく、胸に溜め込んだ息を吐き出す。
lines.translated: Deeply, slowly, I breathed out the air held in my chest.

lines.content: そして……、
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 腹が減った
lines.translated: I'm starving.

lines.content: ……つぶやく。
lines.translated: I muttered.

lines.content: ……住むところはない
lines.translated: I have nowhere to live.

lines.content: 金もない
lines.translated: I have no money, either.

lines.content: ああ、彼女だって……いねえよ。くそぅ
lines.translated: Oh, and a girlfriend... don't have one of those, either. Dammit.

lines.content: しょっぱいなぁ。
lines.translated: How pathetic.

lines.content: 口に出すと笑えるくらい、なにもない。
lines.translated: Saying it out loud, it was almost laughable how I had nothing at all.

lines.content: だが……たったひとつだけ手に入れたものがある。
lines.translated: However... there was just one single thing I had obtained.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 今の俺は何よりも価値あるものを手に入れた。
lines.translated: Right now, I had obtained something more valuable than anything else.

lines.content: 今日から俺は――
lines.translated: Starting today, I...

lines.content: 奏大雅という人間は――
lines.translated: The person known as Kanade Taiga...

lines.content: ――自由だぁぁあぁぁああああ！！！！
lines.translated: "...am freeeeeeeee!!!!"

lines.content: ……叫ぶ。
lines.translated: I shouted.

lines.content: 遠い昔のあの子みたいに。
lines.translated: Just like she did, so long ago.

lines.content: これは、宣戦布告である。
lines.translated: This was a declaration of war.

lines.content: 今を戦い。
lines.translated: To fight in the present.

lines.content: 過去には負けず。
lines.translated: To never lose to the past.

lines.content: 未来に、勝つのだ。
lines.translated: And to triumph over the future.
And to take her back.

lines.content: ……あの子の笑顔を、この手で、必ず。
lines.translated: I will bring back her smile with my own two hands, no matter what.

lines.content: それが俺、奏大雅の成すべきことだろうと強く信じる。
lines.translated: I firmly believed that was what I, Kanade Taiga, was meant to do.

lines.content: 地面を蹴り、振り返らず――坂道を駆け下りた。
lines.translated: Kicking off the ground without looking back, I sprinted down the slope.

lines.content: この空っぽの手のひらが、まず最初に手に入れたものをしっかりと握り締めたまま。
lines.translated: All while my empty palm tightly clutched the very first thing I had obtained.

lines.content: やさしい心の持ち主は、われにもあらず受難者となる
lines.translated: "Those with gentle hearts become martyrs in spite of themselves."

lines.content: そんな忘れ得ぬ言葉を、いつまでも、この心に秘めたまま――
lines.translated: Keeping those unforgettable words locked away inside my heart forevermore...

lines.content: よお、ロックンローラー。調子はどうだ？
lines.translated: "Yo, rock 'n' roller. How's it going?"

lines.content: バス停である。
lines.translated: I was at the bus stop.

lines.content: 桜並木の大通りを走りぬけ、やって来た。
lines.translated: I had arrived here after running all the way down the cherry tree-lined main street.

lines.content: 学園行きのバスを待つ生徒たちで溢れるその中に、見知った顔の男子生徒が俺を見つけ、気安い調子で手を上げ近寄ってきた。
lines.translated: Amidst the crowd of students waiting for the school bus, a familiar guy spotted me and approached with an easygoing wave of his hand.

lines.content: ああ、絶好調だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, couldn't be better."

lines.content: 俺も手を上げ、答える。
lines.translated: I raised a hand in return as I answered.

lines.content: そういうお前はどうなんだ
lines.translated: "What about you?"

lines.content: ちょー元気
lines.translated: "Super great."

lines.content: 白い歯を見せ笑う。
lines.translated: He grinned, flashing his white teeth.

lines.content: 今が夜なら、そこの十字路で悪魔に魂売ってもいいくらいかなって思えるくらい快調だ
lines.translated: "I'm doing so great that if it were nighttime, I'd probably be down to sell my soul to the devil at that crossroads over there."

lines.content: そうか。そいつはよかった
lines.translated: "I see. Good for you."

lines.content: 元気が一番だよな、と俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: Being in high spirits is what matters most, I thought with a nod.

lines.content: だけどほんとに売るなよ。魂。大事だろ
lines.translated: "Don't actually go selling it, though. Your soul, I mean. That's important, right?"

lines.content: 実際それでギターが上手くなるなら重畳だ。約束できないな
lines.translated: "If it actually makes me better at guitar, then I'm all for it. Can't make any promises."

lines.content: ギターより、長生きだろ
lines.translated: "Living a long life is way better than being good at guitar."

lines.content: そうかなあ
lines.translated: "You think so?"

lines.content: もしも寿命だとかが短くなっても、その短い間に人より多くハッピーなことがあるんならいいじゃないか。帳尻が合う。元がケチな人生だったならなお儲けもんだ
lines.translated: "Even if it shortens my lifespan or whatever, as long as I get to experience way more happiness than everyone else in that short time, I'm good with it. It balances out. And if my life was gonna be stingy to begin with, then I'm coming out ahead."

lines.content: 人生、太く短くだ
lines.translated: "Live fast, die young."

lines.content: 太く長くでもいいじゃないか
lines.translated: "Why not live fast and live long?"

lines.content: おー、欲張りだ。でもなあ、人生、そう都合よくいかねえって
lines.translated: "Ooh, greedy. Come on, man, life doesn't work out that conveniently."

lines.content: 背の高い男子生徒は笑った。
lines.translated: The tall boy laughed.

lines.content: 豪快ではないが爽快な笑顔だ。
lines.translated: It wasn't a boisterous laugh, but a refreshing smile.

lines.content: こちらもつられて微笑んでしまうくらい。
lines.translated: Enough to make me smile right along with him.

lines.content: それはそうと。大雅。今日から行くところないんだろ
lines.translated: "Anyway, Taiga. You don't have anywhere to go starting today, right?"

lines.content: 話題が急に変わったなあ
lines.translated: "Well, that was a sudden change of subject."

lines.content: 施設を出たんだろ？　そのバック、私物はそれで全部なのか？
lines.translated: "You left the institution, didn't you? Is everything you own in that bag?"

lines.content: ああ、まあな。部屋を順番待ちの誰かに譲ったからな。行く当ては微妙だし金もなければ青春の気配さえもない
lines.translated: "Yeah, pretty much. I gave up my room to someone on the waiting list. My prospects for a place to stay are iffy, I've got no money, and not even a hint of a springtime of youth."

lines.content: なぁ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 笑顔の口元を引き結ぶ男子生徒だ。
lines.translated: The smile faded as he pressed his lips together.

lines.content: なんだ？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 質問だ
lines.translated: "Got a question."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: あのな、大雅。……これからの予定は？
lines.translated: "Listen, Taiga... What are your plans from here on out?"

lines.content: ん？　予定？
lines.translated: "Hm? Plans?"

lines.content: 住むとこは？　腹へってないか？　……あめ玉あるけど、食うか？
lines.translated: "Where are you gonna live? Aren't you hungry? ...I've got some hard candy, want one?"

lines.content: そのバックで本当に荷物全部なのか？　何か困ってることとかないのか？　力になるぞ――あ、そういえば転校生が来るってよ
lines.translated: "Is that bag really all your luggage? Are you having trouble with anything? I'll help you out--oh, by the way, I heard we're getting a transfer student."

lines.content: はは。質問攻めだな
lines.translated: "Haha. Talk about twenty questions."

lines.content: あと、転校生……？
lines.translated: Also, a transfer student...?

lines.content: 最後のものに至っては質問でさえない。
lines.translated: That last bit wasn't even a question.

lines.content: 一番最初に答えたほうがいい質問は？
lines.translated: "Which question should I answer first?"

lines.content: んー……。そうだなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm... Let's see."

lines.content: 思案顔。
lines.translated: He put on a thoughtful look.

lines.content: 男子生徒は……。
lines.translated: This guy...

lines.content: 幼馴染みの[とあ|兎蛙][ともひと|智仁]は、首をかしげた。
lines.translated: My childhood friend, Toa Tomohito, tilted his head.

lines.content: ……兎蛙智仁。
lines.translated: Toa Tomohito.

lines.content: 名前に“と”が一杯あるから、渾名は“とと”。
lines.translated: Because his name has a bunch of "to"s in it, his nickname is "Toto."

lines.content: 今はもうあまりそう呼ぶこともなくなったが……奇抜といえばそうかもしれない。
lines.translated: I don't really call him that much anymore, though... I guess you could say it's an odd one.

lines.content: なんだそりゃ？　と首を傾げられても、さあ、なんだろうなあと、惚ける他にないのだ。
lines.translated: Even if someone tilted their head and asked "What's up with that?", all I could do was play dumb and say "Beats me."

lines.content: まぁ、子供時代の渾名付けのセンスにはよくあることだと思う。
lines.translated: Well, I think that's pretty common when it comes to the naming sense of kids.

lines.content: それが未だに払拭されず続いていたりいなかったり。
lines.translated: And somehow, it still hadn't completely faded away, sticking around on and off to this day.

lines.content: 子ども時代の渾名、か。
lines.translated: A childhood nickname, huh?

lines.content: もし今その名で呼べば、ふつうの感覚を持つ人間なら嫌な顔のひとつもするだろう。恥ずかしさかそれに類する感情のどちらかで。
lines.translated: If you called someone with normal sensibilities by a name like that now, they'd probably at least make a face. Out of embarrassment, or something along those lines.

lines.content: だがこいつに限ってはそうならない。
lines.translated: But that didn't apply to this guy.

lines.content: 何故ならこいつは。兎蛙智仁は……。
lines.translated: Because this guy--Toa Tomohito...

lines.content: 質問
lines.translated: "Question."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 大雅、[うち|家]、来るか？
lines.translated: "Taiga, wanna come stay at my place?"

lines.content: ……こいつは相当、いいヤツだからだ。
lines.translated: is a seriously good guy.

lines.content: 大丈夫。ありがとう。……だが、男の施しは受けん
lines.translated: "I'm fine. Thanks. ...Besides, I don't take handouts from guys."

lines.content: はは。なんだそれ
lines.translated: "Haha. What's that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: かわいい女の子に言われるならまだしも
lines.translated: "Now, if a cute girl were offering, that'd be a different story."

lines.content: ああ、うん。そりゃーそうだ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Well, obviously."

lines.content: ふたりで空を見上げた。漫然と。
lines.translated: The two of us gazed up at the sky. Aimlessly.

lines.content: 女っ気ねぇよな俺たち
lines.translated: "Zero luck with women, huh, us?"

lines.content: よせよ悲しくなるだろ
lines.translated: "Cut it out, you're gonna make me sad."

lines.content: ……まあ、幼馴染みたちは女の子だがな。それも、とってもかわいい
lines.translated: "...Well, our childhood friends are girls, though. And super cute ones, at that."

lines.content: 知ってるか？　智仁。幼馴染みってのはさ、恋人にはなれないんだぞ
lines.translated: "Did you know, Tomohito? Childhood friends can never become lovers."

lines.content: そうなのか？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Really? Why's that?"

lines.content: そういうものだからだ
lines.translated: "Because that's just how it goes."

lines.content: そういうものなのか。やるせないな
lines.translated: "So that's how it goes, huh? Man, that's depressing."

lines.content: とかなんとか。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: ……ひどく侘しい気分になった。
lines.translated: A terribly lonely feeling washed over me.

lines.content: 大雅。本当に大丈夫なのか？
lines.translated: "Taiga. Are you really gonna be okay?"

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 無理したり遠慮するのは格好悪いぞ。誰にも迷惑かけず自分ひとりで何でもやろうなんてのは傲慢だ――って姉ちゃんが言っていたしな。間違ってはないと思う
lines.translated: "Pushing yourself and holding back is uncool, you know. Trying to do everything all by yourself without bothering anyone is just arrogance--or so my sister says. And I don't think she's wrong."

lines.content: そうだな。俺もそう思うよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I think so too."

lines.content: 施設は学園を卒業するまでは暮らせる決まりだ。それなのにどうして……
lines.translated: "The rule at the institution is that you can live there until you graduate from the academy. So why did you..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: さっきもチラッとだけ言ったけどさ、どうやら新しい子が順番待ちをしてるみたいなんだ。職員が話してるのを聞いちゃったんだよ
lines.translated: "I mentioned it briefly earlier, but it looks like there's a new kid on the waiting list. I overheard the staff talking about it."

lines.content: 最近は身寄りのない子が多いみたいでどこも部屋が足りない。
lines.translated: Lately, it seemed there were a lot of kids with no relatives, and everywhere was short on rooms.

lines.content: 俺が早く出て行けば、その順番待ちをしている誰かはそれだけ早く、入所できる
lines.translated: "If I leave early, whoever's waiting in line can move in that much sooner."

lines.content: そうでなければ色々なところをたらい回しされながら、その子は過ごさなければならなくなるだろう。
lines.translated: Otherwise, that kid would probably have to spend their time getting passed around from place to place.

lines.content: ならば年長者であるこの俺が、かわいい後輩たちに居場所を譲ることに何ら不思議も抵抗もない。
lines.translated: That being the case, as the oldest one there, I had no qualms or hesitation whatsoever about giving up my spot to my cute juniors.

lines.content: だからって大雅……。それじゃあお前はこれからどうするんだ？
lines.translated: "Even so, Taiga... What are you gonna do now, then?"

lines.content: ……実は、行くところならなくはないんだよ
lines.translated: "...Actually, it's not like I have nowhere at all to go."

lines.content: そうなのか？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: ああ。そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 困ったことがあれば家に来なさいと、何度も誘われている場所がある。
lines.translated: There was a place where I'd been invited over and over again, told to come stay with them if I ever ran into trouble.

lines.content: ……だから、大丈夫。
lines.translated: So I'll be fine.

lines.content: 心配してくれてありがとう。
lines.translated: Thanks for worrying about me.

lines.content: そんな気持ちを込めて、俺は苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: With those feelings in mind, I gave him a wry smile.

lines.content: もう一度言うぞ？　困ったことがあったら言えよ大雅。なんでもな。遠慮するなよ。無理もダメだ
lines.translated: "I'll say it again, okay? If you're ever in a pinch, just tell me, Taiga. Anything at all. Don't hold back, and don't push yourself too hard."

lines.content: ああ。わかってるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know."

lines.content: 俺も学生だから、何でも力になれるほど余分に力はあまってないけど。まあ、がんばってはみるからな
lines.translated: "I'm a student too, so I don't have enough spare power to help you with everything. Well, I'll do my best, though."

lines.content: 学生は辛いな
lines.translated: "Being a student is rough, huh?"

lines.content: まったくだ
lines.translated: "Tell me about it."

lines.content: 何が楽しくて毎日毎日、勉強なんてさせられてるんだろうな。こんなことする暇があるなら、もっと、やるべき何かがあるんじゃないかって思うよな
lines.translated: "What's the point of making us study day in and day out? If we have time to do this stuff, you'd think there'd be something more important we should be doing instead, right?"

lines.content: “もっと、やるべき何か”。……それは？
lines.translated: "'Something more important we should be doing'... Like what?"

lines.content: それがわからないから、学生なんだろ
lines.translated: "We're students precisely because we don't know what that is, right?"

lines.content: はは。違いない
lines.translated: "Haha. No doubt about that."

lines.content: いつもいつでも、俺たちは無力さを痛感するばかりだ。
lines.translated: Time and time again, we're only ever reminded of just how powerless we are.

lines.content: それはそうと、智仁
lines.translated: "By the way, Tomohito."

lines.content: おう。なんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah? What's up?"

lines.content: 住むところは問題ないが、早速ひとつお願いがある
lines.translated: "A place to live isn't an issue, but I do have one favor to ask right off the bat."

lines.content: お、なんだ？　この頼れる幼馴染みに何でも言ってみればいい
lines.translated: "Oh, what is it? Ask your reliable childhood friend anything."

lines.content: あめ玉がほしい。朝飯も食べてなくて腹減ったんだ
lines.translated: "I want a piece of hard candy. I didn't eat breakfast, so I'm starving."

lines.content: チョコは食べたがあれだけではとても足りない。
lines.translated: I ate that chocolate earlier, but that alone wasn't nearly enough.

lines.content: ……さっき言ってたろ、あめ玉持ってるってさ
lines.translated: "...You mentioned earlier that you had some candy on you, right?"

lines.content: ああ、おーけーだ。無力な学生でも安心のお願いだな
lines.translated: "Yeah, sure thing. That's a safe request even a powerless student can handle."

lines.content: うれしそうに笑う。
lines.translated: He laughed happily.

lines.content: あれ？　なあ。男の施しは嫌なんじゃなかったっけ？
lines.translated: "Wait? Hey, didn't you say you don't take handouts from guys?"

lines.content: 別腹だ
lines.translated: "There's always room for sweets."

lines.content: んー？　それ、おかしくないですか？
lines.translated: "Hmm? Doesn't that sound a little weird?"

lines.content: 苦笑いで胸ポケットからあめ玉を取り出し、俺に手渡してくれた。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, he pulled a piece of candy from his breast pocket and handed it to me.

lines.content: 甘い。
lines.translated: Sweet.

lines.content: ミルク味だ。
lines.translated: It's milk-flavored.

lines.content: なぜミルク。
lines.translated: Why milk?

lines.content: なぜ……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: まあいいか。
lines.translated: Well, whatever.

lines.content: そういや転校生って？　知らなかったな
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, what's this about a transfer student? I hadn't heard anything."

lines.content: 偶然だけど噂を聞いたんだ。来るのは来週みたいだぞ
lines.translated: "I just happened to hear a rumor. Looks like they're coming next week."

lines.content: 相変わらず情報の早い奴だ
lines.translated: "Always quick on the uptake with info, as usual."

lines.content: 転校生。女の子だとさ
lines.translated: "The transfer student's a girl, apparently."

lines.content: たぎるな
lines.translated: "Now that gets the blood pumping."

lines.content: 華がある
lines.translated: "Adds a nice touch to the place."

lines.content: ぐっと親指を立てる智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a firm thumbs-up.

lines.content: しかし俺は口を『へ』の字にする。
lines.translated: However, my mouth curled into a frown.

lines.content: まあ。どうせお前が惚れられるいつものパターンだろうけどな。嫉ましいばかりだ
lines.translated: "Well, it's just gonna end up with her falling for you like usual anyway. Makes me sick with jealousy."

lines.content: 知ってるか。音楽が世界を救うんだぜ
lines.translated: "Did you know? Music will save the world."

lines.content: ……何言ってるんだこいつ
lines.translated: "...What is this guy talking about?"

lines.content: 大雅もバンドとかギターとかすればいい。モテモテになれる
lines.translated: "You should join a band or play guitar or something too, Taiga. You'll be swimming in girls."

lines.content: 滅びろイケメン
lines.translated: "Drop dead, pretty boy."

lines.content: 何が“俺たち女っ気ねえよな”だ。
lines.translated: So much for "Zero luck with women, huh, us?"

lines.content: 青春の裕福層め。
lines.translated: Damn the wealthy elite of youth.

lines.content: 貧困層をひがませて楽しいか。
lines.translated: Is it fun making the impoverished class jealous?

lines.content: 本当に。
lines.translated: Seriously.

lines.content: 何なんだ。
lines.translated: What the heck is his deal?

lines.content: ……好きな人だって、いるくせに。
lines.translated: Even though he already has someone he likes.

lines.content: ふと取り出したスマートフォンを智仁はいじっている。
lines.translated: Tomohito was fiddling with the smartphone he'd suddenly pulled out.

lines.content: その横顔はめずらしく笑顔ではない。
lines.translated: Unusually enough, there was no smile on his profile.

lines.content: そっとしておく。
lines.translated: I decided to leave him be.

lines.content: 無駄話もしばらくはなしだ。
lines.translated: No more idle chatter for a little while.

lines.content: まもなくバスがやって来る。
lines.translated: Before long, the bus arrived.

lines.content: ふたりで学園行きに乗り込んだ。
lines.translated: The two of us boarded the one bound for the academy.

lines.content: 俺たちが通うのは私立桜ヶ丘学園。
lines.translated: We attend the private Sakuragaoka Academy.

lines.content: その生徒たちで溢れる車内はざわざわと騒がしい。
lines.translated: Packed with its students, the inside of the bus was noisy with chatter.

lines.content: 車窓を流れる桜並木。
lines.translated: A row of cherry blossom trees flowed past the window.

lines.content: いっぱいの春の色。
lines.translated: Overflowing with the colors of spring.

lines.content: 楽しいことも。悲しいことも。何ひとつとして起こらない、平穏な世界。
lines.translated: A peaceful world where nothing at all happens--neither joyful things, nor sad things.
This was the very world that they had protected ten years ago.

lines.content: 停車。
lines.translated: The bus stopped.

lines.content: 次のバス停。
lines.translated: The next bus stop.

lines.content: 乗客の殆どが桜ヶ丘の生徒たち。
lines.translated: Most of the passengers boarding were Sakuragaoka students.

lines.content: その中に見知った顔を一名、発見。
lines.translated: Among them, I spotted one familiar face.

lines.content: おはよう後輩。今日もちっこいな
lines.translated: "Morning, kouhai. Looking tiny again today, huh?"

lines.content: おはようございます先輩
lines.translated: "Good morning, senpai."

lines.content: にっこりと笑う少し小さめなサイズの女の子……[あんどう|杏藤][ちわ|千和]。俺たちのひとつ後輩。この春に入学したばかりの一年生。
lines.translated: Smiling brightly was a slightly petite girl... Andou Chiwa. A year below us. A first-year who had just enrolled this spring.

lines.content: 知り合いの[ひいきめ|贔屓目]を除いても、まあ、可愛らしい。
lines.translated: Even setting aside my bias as an acquaintance, well, she's pretty cute.

lines.content: 車内の男子たちが少なからず彼女の乗車に目の色を変えるのもわからないではない。
lines.translated: It wasn't hard to understand why more than a few of the guys on the bus perked up the moment she got on.

lines.content: だが残念だ。非常に。
lines.translated: But it was a shame. A massive shame.

lines.content: その可愛らしい笑顔も挨拶も、すべてこの俺に――ではなく、俺の隣にだけ向けられていることが。
lines.translated: Because that cute smile and greeting were directed entirely at me--no, wait, solely at the guy next to me.

lines.content: 兎蛙先輩。今日もお昼はおにぎりですか？
lines.translated: "Toa-senpai. Are you having rice balls for lunch again today?"

lines.content: うん。そうだよ。数少ない大好物のひとつだからね。おにぎりばんざいだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. They're one of my few absolute favorites, after all. Hooray for rice balls."

lines.content: 笑う。そして指折り数えながら、智仁は言う。
lines.translated: He laughed. Then, counting on his fingers, Tomohito continued.

lines.content: ……ええっと。今日のおにぎりは梅干と昆布とおかかのみっつだ。完璧な装備だろ
lines.translated: "...Let's see. Today's rice balls are pickled plum, kelp, and bonito flakes. The perfect loadout, right?"

lines.content: 楽しいことのあまりない学園生活でこれだけが、おにぎり食べられる時間だけが、俺の救いなんだよ
lines.translated: "In an academy life with very little fun to be had, this alone--the time I get to eat rice balls--is my only salvation."

lines.content: 大げさに嘆いて見せていた。
lines.translated: He made a big show of sighing dramatically.

lines.content: むむむ。完璧……。そうですかね。私としては鮭がほしいところです
lines.translated: "Hmm. Perfect...? I wonder about that. Personally, I think it could use some salmon."

lines.content: そっかー。まずったかな。実はおかかと鮭、どちらにするか悩んだんだよ
lines.translated: "I see. Did I mess up? Actually, I was torn between bonito flakes and salmon."

lines.content: 大変だ。なんだか猛烈に鮭のおにぎりが食べたくなってきちゃったぞ。ううむ。選択ミスだったかもしれない
lines.translated: "Oh no. Now I've suddenly got a massive craving for a salmon rice ball. Hmmm. That might've been a tactical error."

lines.content: 大丈夫ですよ兎蛙先輩。私のお弁当、鮭のおにぎりあります。良かったらお昼に食べますか？
lines.translated: "It's okay, Toa-senpai. I have salmon rice balls in my lunchbox. Would you like to eat one at lunch?"

lines.content: え。いいの？
lines.translated: "Huh? Are you sure?"

lines.content: はい。もちろんです
lines.translated: "Yes, of course."

lines.content: おい……
あー、うぅん
lines.translated: "Ah, well..."

lines.content: どうかしましたか？
lines.translated: "Is something the matter?"

lines.content: いやあ。そういえば昨日もその前の日も、千和ちゃんにおにぎり貰っちゃってるよね俺。今みたいに具の選択にミスっちゃってさ
lines.translated: "No, well... Come to think of it, you gave me rice balls yesterday and the day before too, didn't you, Chiwa-chan? Because I messed up my filling choices just like right now."

lines.content: さすがに毎日貰うのは悪いよ。それに千和ちゃんのお昼なんじゃないのかな？
lines.translated: "I'd feel bad taking them from you every day. Besides, isn't that your lunch, Chiwa-chan?"

lines.content: いえいえ、気にしないでください。兎蛙先輩が食べるかなって、たくさんおにぎり、作って来てますので
lines.translated: "No, no, please don't worry about it. I figured you might eat some, Toa-senpai, so I made plenty of extras before coming here."

lines.content: もしもし……？
lines.translated: "Hello...?"

lines.content: そっかー。たくさんかあ。じゃあ今日も甘えちゃおうかなあ……よし。俄然やる気が出てきたぞ
lines.translated: "I see. Plenty of extras, huh? Then maybe I'll take you up on your offer again today... Alright, now I'm suddenly feeling super motivated."

lines.content: にっこりとする。
lines.translated: He grinned.

lines.content: 学校なんておにぎり食べに行ってるようなもんだからね。お昼の時間はひとつの不備もなく完璧に彩りたいんだ
lines.translated: "Going to school is basically just an excuse to eat rice balls, after all. I want my lunchtime to be colored with absolute perfection, without a single flaw."

lines.content: 兎蛙先輩は本当におにぎり好きですよね。美味しそうに食べてくれるから作りがいがあって私もうれしいです
lines.translated: "You really love rice balls, don't you, Toa-senpai? You always eat them with such gusto, so it makes them worth making, and that makes me happy too."

lines.content: ニッポンジンですからね。魂ですからね。うん
lines.translated: "I am Japanese, after all. It's my soul, you know? Yep."

lines.content: 魂ですか？
lines.translated: "Your soul?"

lines.content: そうるふーど。魂の食べ物。……あ、これ、なんとなくゴスペルっぽいかもしれないぞ
lines.translated: "Soul food. Food for the soul. ...Ah, come to think of it, that sounds kind of like gospel, doesn't it?"

lines.content: “ハレルヤ”。神にささげる感謝の歌だ。“いただきます”。神にささげる感謝の言葉だ。ほら、なんだか、似てる
lines.translated: "'Hallelujah' is a song of gratitude offered to God. 'Itadakimasu' is a phrase of gratitude offered to God. Look, they're kind of similar."

lines.content: えー。いただきますは食材にささげる言葉じゃないですか？　それと農家の人たちへの感謝です
lines.translated: "Huh? Isn't 'itadakimasu' offered to the ingredients? Along with gratitude to the farmers."

lines.content: あれ。そうだったっけ。あー。そんな気もするなあ
lines.translated: "Oh, wait. Was it? Ahh. Now that you mention it, I feel like that's right."

lines.content: くすくす笑い合うふたりである。
lines.translated: The two of them giggled together.

lines.content: 眩しいね。
lines.translated: So dazzling.

lines.content: うらやましいね。
lines.translated: I'm so jealous.

lines.content: 俺も入れて。
lines.translated: Let me in on this too.

lines.content: なあ、ちっこい後輩。もうひとりのイケてないほうの先輩も少しは敬えばいいとおもいませんか？
lines.translated: "Hey, tiny kouhai. Don't you think you should show a little respect to your other, less-cool senpai too?"

lines.content: はぁ
lines.translated: "Haah..."

lines.content: え？　ため息？　そんなに？　そんなになのか？
lines.translated: Huh? A sigh? That bad? Is it really that bad?

lines.content: おはようございます大嫌いなほうの先輩
lines.translated: "Good morning, senpai who I hate with a passion."

lines.content: こちらを振り向く。満面の笑顔だった。
lines.translated: She turned to face me, beaming with a huge smile.

lines.content: ちょっと話しかけないでほしいです
lines.translated: "I'd really appreciate it if you didn't talk to me right now."

lines.content: ……あんまりですねかわいい後輩
lines.translated: "...That's pretty harsh, my cute kouhai."

lines.content: 奏先輩は意地悪だから、嫌いです
lines.translated: "Kanade-senpai is mean, so I hate you."

lines.content: 頬を膨らませる後輩だった。
lines.translated: My kouhai puffed out her cheeks.

lines.content: だからさわやかな朝の時間くらいは静かにしていてください。お願いします
lines.translated: "So please just be quiet during the refreshing morning hours, at least. I'm begging you."

lines.content: なあ、ちっこい後輩。愛情の裏返しって知ってるか
lines.translated: "Hey, tiny kouhai. Ever heard of teasing someone because you like them?"

lines.content: ちっこい、ちっこい、うるさいです
lines.translated: "Tiny this, tiny that, you're so annoying."

lines.content: ジト目である。
lines.translated: She gave me a flat stare.

lines.content: 身体的特徴で人をからかうのは最低だと思います。そういうところも嫌いです
lines.translated: "Making fun of people for their physical traits is the absolute worst. I hate that about you, too."

lines.content: え？　でも、だけど……、じゃあ俺はどうしたらいいんだ
lines.translated: "Huh? Wait, hold on... Then what am I supposed to do?"

lines.content: どうしたら、って。そんなの簡単です。意地悪するのを止めてくれたらいいと思います
lines.translated: "What do you mean, what are you supposed to do? It's simple. Just stop being mean to me."

lines.content: ……どうしてそんなに不満そうな顔をするんですか
lines.translated: "...Why are you making such a dissatisfied face?"

lines.content: ……はぁ
lines.translated: "...Haah."

lines.content: 俺は小さく首を横に振る。やれやれという具合に。
lines.translated: I gave a small shake of my head, as if to say 'good grief.'

lines.content: わかった、わかりました。身体のことを言わなきゃいいんだな。了解した
lines.translated: "Got it, I understand. I just have to avoid mentioning your height, right? Understood."

lines.content: そして言う。笑顔で。
lines.translated: And then I said it, with a smile.

lines.content: “ちわっこい”
lines.translated: "'Chiwakkoi.'"

lines.content: 細めた両目を杏藤千和は更に細める。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa's already narrowed eyes narrowed even further.

lines.content: 名前で遊ばれるのはもっと嫌いです。やめてください。大切な名前なんです
lines.translated: "I hate it even more when you mess with my name. Please stop. My name is very important to me."

lines.content: 小ささを表すちっこいと、千和の名前を文字って、“ちわっこい”。
lines.translated: Combining "chikkoi," meaning tiny, with her name, Chiwa, to make "Chiwakkoi."

lines.content: それは渾名というか、小さな頃のからかい言葉である。
lines.translated: It was less of a nickname and more of a teasing word from when we were little.

lines.content: 子ども時代から周りに比べて小さな身体の彼女に対しての。
lines.translated: Aimed at a girl who had always been smaller than everyone else around her since childhood.

lines.content: それに結局身体のことじゃないですか……、先輩、嫌い。大嫌いです
lines.translated: "Besides, that's still about my height in the end, isn't it...? I hate you, senpai. I really hate you."

lines.content: 小さく舌を出す女の子……杏藤千和。
lines.translated: The girl who stuck the tip of her tongue out at me... Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: 兎蛙に続いて俺の幼馴染第二号。
lines.translated: Following Toa, she was my childhood friend number two.

lines.content: 彼女は律儀というか面倒見がいいとでも言うのか。
lines.translated: You could call her conscientious, or maybe just really attentive.

lines.content: どんなに凍えるほど詰まんないことを言ってもいつも律儀に反応してくれる――俺の一日はそんな彼女を弄り倒すことに終始する。
lines.translated: No matter how glacially unfunny my jokes are, she always dutifully reacts to them--and my entire day begins and ends with teasing her relentlessly.

lines.content: 嫌われないよう。泣かせたりしないよう。
lines.translated: Careful not to make her actually hate me. Careful not to make her cry.

lines.content: 幼馴染み同士にしかわからないライン上を、ふらふらと。
lines.translated: Teetering back and forth along a line that only childhood friends can understand.

lines.content: ねえ、先輩。教えてください。どうして奏先輩はいつも私にばかり意地悪するんですか。他の人にはやさしいのに。こんなの嫌です。おかしいです
lines.translated: "Hey, senpai. Tell me. Why are you always only mean to me, Kanade-senpai? Even though you're nice to everyone else. I hate this. It's weird."

lines.content: 千和は頬を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa was puffing out her cheeks.

lines.content: もっと私にもやさしくしてください。じゃないと嫌です。私はずっと先輩のことが大嫌いなままです
lines.translated: "Please be nicer to me, too. Otherwise, no way. I'll just keep hating you forever, senpai."

lines.content: だめだ
lines.translated: "No can do."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: かわいい子はいじめたくなるんだ
lines.translated: "When a girl is cute, it makes me want to tease her."

lines.content: はい？
lines.translated: "Excuse me?"

lines.content: なあ、千和
lines.translated: "Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: 俺は真剣な顔をする。
lines.translated: I put on a serious face.

lines.content: え、あ、は、はい……
lines.translated: "Huh? Ah, y-yes...?"

lines.content: なんですか、と。
lines.translated: "What is it?" her expression asked.

lines.content: 若干、おびえたようにする。
lines.translated: She looked slightlynervous.

lines.content: 俺はな
lines.translated: "You see..."

lines.content: はい……
ごめんな。千和の怒った顔が好きなんだ
lines.translated: "Sorry. I just really like your angry face, Chiwa."

lines.content: 口を尖らせる。ジト目で睨まれる。
lines.translated: She pouted and glared at me with flat, unamused eyes.

lines.content: ……先輩。きもいです、先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai. You're creeping me out, senpai."

lines.content: 一歩後退で距離を開けられた。
lines.translated: She took a step back to put some distance between us.

lines.content: 小さな身体を更にちぢこめるようにして。
lines.translated: Hunching her small frame to make herself look even smaller.

lines.content: どうして奏先輩は奏先輩なんですか
lines.translated: "Why is Kanade-senpai so... Kanade-senpai?"

lines.content: んん？　難しいことを言うな。俺も知りたい。どうしてなんだ？
lines.translated: "Hmm? That's a tough question. I'd like to know, too. Why is that?"

lines.content: 隣の智仁を見る。
lines.translated: I looked at Tomohito next to me.

lines.content: そんな俺の視線を受けて、
lines.translated: Catching my gaze,

lines.content: え。俺？　俺に聞いてるのか？　んー、そんなこと俺に言われてもなあ
lines.translated: "Huh? Me? Are you asking me? Hmmm, even if you ask me something like that..."

lines.content: 苦笑いの智仁である。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 確かに難しい。難問だ。どうしてかなあ
lines.translated: "That certainly is tough. A real conundrum. Why is that, I wonder?"

lines.content: 奏先輩も兎蛙先輩みたいにやさしい人ならよかったです
lines.translated: "I wish Kanade-senpai were a kind person like Toa-senpai."

lines.content: それって……やさしければ意地悪してもいいってことなのかな
lines.translated: "Does that mean... as long as I'm kind, it's okay to be mean to you?"

lines.content: どうしてそうなるんですか……。私の話、聞いてくれてますか？　それだから奏先輩は奏先輩なんですよ。嫌いです
lines.translated: "How did you come to that conclusion...? Are you even listening to me? That's the exact reason why Kanade-senpai is Kanade-senpai. I hate you."

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: やれやれとばかりに首を振る。
lines.translated: Shaking her head as if to say 'good grief.'

lines.content: ショートカットの柔らかそうな毛先が、小さな肩の上でふわりと揺れた。
lines.translated: The soft-looking tips of her short hair swayed gently above her small shoulders.

lines.content: 智仁
lines.translated: Tomohito

lines.content: なんだ。嫌われ者の幼馴染。抱きしめてほしいのか？
lines.translated: "What's this? The hated childhood friend. Want me to give you a hug?"

lines.content: 何言ってるんだお前と目を細めながら俺は言う。
lines.translated: Narrowing my eyes as if to ask what the hell he was talking about, I spoke.

lines.content: 嫌いと言われるのも中々オツなものがあるよな。気に入った。よし。もう一回言ってみてくれないか千和
lines.translated: "Being told you're hated has a certain charm to it, doesn't it? I like it. Alright. Could you say it for me one more time, Chiwa?"

lines.content: ものすごい嫌そうな顔をされた。
lines.translated: She gave me a look of utter disgust.

lines.content: でも、いいか。今度は言葉とは裏腹に愛情こめてな？　語尾にハートが見えるくらいがちょうどいい。心から嫌われたら立ち直れないかもしれない。俺はナイーブなんだ。こう見えて
lines.translated: "Hold on, listen up. This time, put some love into it to contrast with the words, okay? Just enough so I can see a little heart at the end of the sentence. If you genuinely hated me from the bottom of your heart, I might never recover. I'm actually pretty sensitive, despite how I look."

lines.content: 気持ち悪いです……
lines.translated: "That's disgusting..."

lines.content: ドン引きされた。
lines.translated: She was completely weirded out.

lines.content: どうして奏先輩はそう気持ち悪いんですか……
lines.translated: "Why are you so disgusting, Kanade-senpai...?"

lines.content: おい、智仁
lines.translated: "Hey, Tomohito."

lines.content: なんだ。気持ち悪い幼馴染。慰めてほしいのか？
lines.translated: "What is it, disgusting childhood friend? Want me to comfort you?"

lines.content: それは否定できないなと首を振りながら俺は言う。
lines.translated: Shaking my head since I couldn't really deny it, I spoke.

lines.content: ……どうしてかな。キモイよりも気持ち悪いのほうがダメージ大きいことが時どきあるよな
lines.translated: "...I wonder why. Sometimes being called 'disgusting' deals way more damage than just 'creepy,' doesn't it?"

lines.content: それはわからないでもないな。俺はキモイのほうがダメージでかいけど
lines.translated: "I can kinda see where you're coming from. Though personally, 'creepy' deals more damage to me."

lines.content: “気持ち悪い”はストレートすぎてむしろ俺にはご褒美だ……なんて。
lines.translated: "'Disgusting' is so blunt that it actually feels like a reward to me..."

lines.content: そんなよくわからないことをぶつぶつと、智仁はつぶやいている。
lines.translated: Tomohito muttered something incomprehensible like that under his breath.

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: そのとき。
lines.translated: Right at that moment.

lines.content: ――バスが急停止した。
lines.translated: --The bus screeched to a sudden halt.

lines.content: きゃ……っ
小さな悲鳴。
lines.translated: A small yelp.

lines.content: 同時に千和がその身体をふらつかせる。このままだとコケルな。
lines.translated: At the same time, Chiwa lost her balance. At this rate, she was going to wipe out.

lines.content: 俺はちっこい後輩がこけないように身体を寄せて、支えた。
lines.translated: I moved my body closer to support my tiny kouhai so she wouldn't fall.

lines.content: 手を差し伸べるのも何か嫌がられそうだと思ったので。
lines.translated: Figuring she'd probably hate it if I reached out to grab her with my hands.

lines.content: あ、ありがとうございます……
lines.translated: "Th-Thank you very much..."

lines.content: 千和は礼の言葉をくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa offered me words of gratitude.

lines.content: 俺の身体に小さな両手でしがみつき、目を驚きでぱちくりさせる。
lines.translated: She clung to me with both of her small hands, blinking her eyes in surprise.

lines.content: 危なかったです。奏先輩がいないとこけちゃうところでした
lines.translated: "That was close. If you hadn't been here, Kanade-senpai, I would have wiped out."

lines.content: 素直だ。
lines.translated: How honest.

lines.content: いつもこんな感じならすごくかわいいけど。
lines.translated: She'd be super cute if she were always like this.

lines.content: だが、どうしてなのか。
lines.translated: Even so, I wonder why.

lines.content: 彼女にはちょっかいを出したくなってしまう。
lines.translated: I always end up wanting to mess with her.

lines.content: 挨拶代わりに怒らせてみたくなる。
lines.translated: I get the urge to rile her up just as a way of saying hello.

lines.content: 一日の始まり。俺が千和をからかう。千和が怒って、俺をジト目で睨んで見上げる。
lines.translated: It's how the day begins. I tease Chiwa. Chiwa gets mad and glares up at me with half-lidded eyes.

lines.content: そして千和が、小さな身体で背伸びして、
lines.translated: Then she stretches her tiny frame up on her tiptoes,

lines.content: 『まったく奏先輩は仕方ないですね』
lines.translated: "'Good grief, there's just no helping you, Kanade-senpai.'"

lines.content: と言って唇を尖らせる。
lines.translated: And pouts her lips as she says it.

lines.content: ジト目のままで、
lines.translated: Keeping those half-lidded eyes fixed on me,

lines.content: 『先輩。嫌いです。大嫌い』
lines.translated: "'Senpai. I hate you. I really hate you.'"

lines.content: と言って、睨まれる。
lines.translated: She says, glaring at me.

lines.content: 俺の癒しだ。
lines.translated: It's so soothing to me.

lines.content: 清涼剤だ。
lines.translated: Like a breath of fresh air.

lines.content: 愛玩動物だ――と言うのは失礼だけれど。
lines.translated: Calling her a pet would be rude, of course,

lines.content: まあ、のりとしてはそんなところだ。
lines.translated: but the vibe is pretty much along those lines.

lines.content: 不満そうに唇を尖らせた彼女は、ついついその小さな頭を撫で回したくなる。
lines.translated: Seeing her pout her lips in dissatisfaction always makes me want to ruffle her little head.

lines.content: ……子ども時代。
lines.translated: Back when we were kids.

lines.content: 『お兄ちゃん、待ってよぉ……！』
lines.translated: "'Onii-chan, wait up...!'"

lines.content: 彼女がいつも俺の後に引っ付いてきていたからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe it's because she used to tag along behind me all the time.

lines.content: 『置いていかないで！　意地悪しないで！』
lines.translated: "'Don't leave me behind! Stop being so mean!'"

lines.content: いつでも俺は“あの頃はよかった”と回顧してしまう。
lines.translated: I always find myself looking back on those days and thinking how great they were.

lines.content: ふぅ……
lines.translated: "Phew..."

lines.content: 俺の身体にしがみつくような形のままで体勢を整える千和。
lines.translated: Still clinging to me, Chiwa regained her footing.

lines.content: 気持ちを落ち着かせるみたいに深呼吸をしている。
lines.translated: She took a deep breath as if to calm herself down.

lines.content: 大丈夫？
lines.translated: "Are you okay?"

lines.content: あ、はい……。大丈夫、です、けど……
lines.translated: "Ah, yes... I'm fine, though..."

lines.content: 俺に支えられたのが不服なのか、唇を尖らせたまま千和はうなずいた。
lines.translated: Perhaps dissatisfied that she'd had to rely on me, Chiwa nodded with her lips still pouted.

lines.content: 反面。すぐに離れようとしないところもまた、なんとも言えない気分にさせられる。
lines.translated: On the flip side, the fact that she didn't immediately pull away gave me an indescribable feeling.

lines.content: ……危ないな。何かあったのか？
lines.translated: "...That was dangerous. Did something happen?"

lines.content: 爪先立ちで車両の先頭を確認しようとした。
lines.translated: I stood on my tiptoes, trying to see the front of the bus.

lines.content: わからないな。
lines.translated: No idea.

lines.content: 人が多すぎて見えない。
lines.translated: There were too many people blocking the view.

lines.content: 子供が飛び出してきたみたいだな
lines.translated: "Looks like a kid darted out into the street."

lines.content: 高身長の智仁がそう言うと同時、バスは再び動き出した。
lines.translated: Right as the tall Tomohito said that, the bus started moving again.

lines.content: そして運転手の漏らす大きめな独り言がここまで聞こえてくる。
lines.translated: And then, the driver's loud muttering drifted all the way back to us.

lines.content: “なめやがって。ガキが。死にたいのか”
lines.translated: "Damn brat, looking down on me. Does he have a death wish?"

lines.content: “俺を失職させるつもりかよ。あてつけか？”
lines.translated: "Trying to get me fired or what? Doing it just to spite me?"

lines.content: “運転席には防犯カメラがついてるしよ……俺か？　俺が悪いのか？”
lines.translated: "There's a security camera in the driver's seat, too... Is it me? Am I the one at fault here?"

lines.content: ぶつぶつぶつぶつ。
lines.translated: Mutter, mutter, grumble, grumble.

lines.content: 不愉快な言葉だ。
lines.translated: What unpleasant words.

lines.content: こちらの気分も悪くなる。
lines.translated: Hearing them soured my mood, too.

lines.content: 車内の雰囲気も、言葉の色に汚染され重くなる。
lines.translated: The atmosphere inside the bus grew heavy, tainted by the ugliness of his words.

lines.content: そんな中、智仁がひそひそと言う。
lines.translated: Amidst all that, Tomohito whispered to me.

lines.content: 最近の大人は口が悪いな
lines.translated: "Adults these days sure have foul mouths."

lines.content: まったくだ
lines.translated: "Tell me about it."

lines.content: でもな。昔は“まったく、最近の子どもは――”ってよく言われてたらしいぞ
lines.translated: "Though, you know, apparently back in the old days, people used to say 'Good grief, kids these days--' all the time, too."

lines.content: へー。そうなの？
lines.translated: "Oh yeah? Is that so?"

lines.content: あ。それ、私も聞いたことがあります
lines.translated: "Ah. I've heard about that before, too."

lines.content: まるで仲間はずれを嫌うみたいに、千和が言葉を挟んだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa chimed in, almost as if she didn't want to be left out.

lines.content: どこかの国の古代の遺跡にも、石の壁や柱に落書きされるみたいにして、“まったく、最近の子どもは言葉遣いがなってない――”みたいなことが残されてたみたいですよ
lines.translated: "Apparently, even in ancient ruins in some country, there was graffiti carved into stone walls and pillars saying things like, 'Good grief, kids these days don't know how to speak properly--'"

lines.content: ふーん。いつの時代も、生意気な子どもは達観ぶりたい大人の目には余るんだな
lines.translated: "Huh. I guess in every era, cheeky kids are an eyesore to adults who want to act all wise and enlightened."

lines.content: そしてそのとき非難された子どもたちが大人になったら、次の世代の子供たちに“まったく、最近の子どもは――”と顔をしかめているのだろうか。
lines.translated: And when the kids who got criticized back then grew up, did they frown at the next generation and say, "Good grief, kids these days--," too?

lines.content: 時代は巡るなあ。……それはそうと。千和
lines.translated: "History really does repeat itself. ...Anyway, Chiwa."

lines.content: なんですか？
lines.translated: "What is it?"

lines.content: 不思議そうに俺を見上げる。
lines.translated: She looked up at me curiously.

lines.content: そんな千和に、疑問を投げかけた。
lines.translated: I tossed a question her way.

lines.content: いや。いつまでくっついてるのかなって
lines.translated: "Nothing, I was just wondering how long you plan on clinging to me."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 悪い気分じゃないけれど、周りの目が少し気になる
lines.translated: "Not that I mind, but people are starting to stare a little."

lines.content: ちらり、ちらりと。
lines.translated: Glance, glance.

lines.content: 密着し合う俺たちに送られる視線がむずがゆかった。
lines.translated: The looks being sent our way as we stood pressed against each other were making me feel a bit self-conscious.

lines.content: それにようやく千和は気付き、
lines.translated: Chiwa finally noticed,

lines.content: 飛びのくように、さっと、離れる。
lines.translated: and practically jumped backward, pulling away in a flash.

lines.content: 足元に落としていた鞄を拾う。
lines.translated: She picked up the bag she had dropped at her feet.

lines.content: そして澄まし顔で言う。
lines.translated: Then, putting on a prim and proper face, she spoke.

lines.content: 油断しました。不覚です
lines.translated: "I let my guard down. How careless of me."

lines.content: 咳払い。
lines.translated: She cleared her throat.

lines.content: スカートを叩く。
lines.translated: She dusted off her skirt.

lines.content: 前髪に触れる。
lines.translated: She touched her bangs.

lines.content: 身だしなみを整えるように。
lines.translated: Trying to straighten up her appearance.

lines.content: わ、わたしとしたことが。兎蛙先輩じゃなくて思わず奏先輩にしがみつくなんて――
lines.translated: "W-What was I thinking? Clinging to Kanade-senpai on reflex instead of Toa-senpai--"

lines.content: 大雅。いいこと教えようか
lines.translated: "Taiga. Want me to tell you something nice?"

lines.content: ん？　なんだ？
lines.translated: "Hmm? What is it?"

lines.content: いいこと？
lines.translated: Something nice?

lines.content: 千和ちゃんがいつもおにぎり作って来てくれるの、本当は俺にじゃなくて大雅になんだぞ
lines.translated: "You know those rice balls Chiwa-chan always makes and brings over? They're actually for you, Taiga, not me."

lines.content: ――ひゃいっ！？
lines.translated: "--Hyai!?"

lines.content: 千和が奇怪な声を上げた。
lines.translated: Chiwa let out a bizarre noise.

lines.content: いつも俺にくれる分に合わせて、“たくさん作って余ったから奏先輩にもあげてください”って言って、余分にくれるもんな
lines.translated: "Whenever she gives me mine, she always hands me extras and says, 'I made too many and have leftovers, so please give these to Kanade-senpai.'"

lines.content: なななな、なんですかそれ！　違います！　違うんです！　それは……そのっ
lines.translated: "Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What are you talking about?! That's not true! It's not like that! That's... umm!"

lines.content: あたふたとしている。
lines.translated: She was completely flustered.

lines.content: ちらちらと焦った視線を俺に送りながら。
lines.translated: Darting panicked glances my way.

lines.content: でもさ。大雅には絶対秘密にしてほしいって念を押されるんだよ。あくまでも俺からのおすそ分けって感じにしてほしいって
lines.translated: "Though, she always makes me promise to keep it an absolute secret from you. She wants me to make it look like I'm just sharing my own food with you."

lines.content: だったらばらしちゃだめじゃないか。
lines.translated: Then you shouldn't be spilling the beans like this, man.

lines.content: 千和を見る。
lines.translated: I looked at Chiwa.

lines.content: すると……、
lines.translated: And...

lines.content: ち、ちがっ、ちが、う、そんな、ちがくて……
lines.translated: "N-No, that's, not, how it is, at all..."

lines.content: 真っ赤になっていた。
lines.translated: Her face was bright red.

lines.content: かわいそうに。
lines.translated: Poor thing.

lines.content: 目が、ぐるぐる回っている。
lines.translated: Her eyes were practically spinning in circles.

lines.content: 大丈夫？　倒れないよな？
lines.translated: Are you okay? You're not gonna faint, are you?

lines.content: か、奏先輩は、施設で、暮らしてて……っ、あそこはご飯も少ないから、お腹、すいてるんじゃないかって……！　お、おにぎり……！　私っ、得意で……！　そうるふーどで……！
lines.translated: "K-Kanade-senpai lives in an institution... and they don't serve much food there, so I thought you might be hungry...! A-And rice balls...! I'm good at making them...! They're my soul food...!"

lines.content: あわあわしている。
lines.translated: She was in a total panic.

lines.content: ああもうかわいい。
lines.translated: Ugh, she's just so cute.

lines.content: 撫で回したくなる。
lines.translated: It makes me want to ruffle her hair all over.

lines.content: 同時。子ども時代を思い出す。
lines.translated: At the same time, it brought back memories of our childhood.

lines.content: 『お兄ちゃん。私と[・|あ][・|の][・|子]、どっちが好き……？』
lines.translated: "'Onii-chan. Who do you like better, me or *her*...?'"

lines.content: ふむ。
lines.translated: Hmm.

lines.content: 思い出とはかくも美しいものである。
lines.translated: Memories truly are a beautiful thing.

lines.content: 補正とも美化とも言うが。
lines.translated: Though some might call it rose-tinted glasses or romanticizing the past.

lines.content: だが昔は昔。今は今。心も世界もすべてが変わる。
lines.translated: But the past is the past, and now is now. Hearts, the world, everything changes.

lines.content: う、うう……っ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: 千和は智仁を恨みがましく睨む。涙目だ。どうしてばらしちゃうんですか、と言うように。
lines.translated: Chiwa shot Tomohito a resentful glare. She had tears in her eyes, as if silently asking him why he had to go and spill the beans.

lines.content: ごめん
lines.translated: "Sorry."

lines.content: 俺はがんばる女の子の味方でいたいんだ
lines.translated: "I just want to be on the side of girls doing their best."

lines.content: ……おかしいです。ぜんぜん味方してもらってる気がしないです
lines.translated: "...That's strange. I don't feel like you're on my side at all."

lines.content: あのさ、千和
lines.translated: "Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: 俺は、真剣な顔をする。
lines.translated: I put on a serious face.

lines.content: な、なんですか……
lines.translated: "Wh-What is it...?"

lines.content: ばつの悪そうにする千和である。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked terribly awkward.

lines.content: もじもじとしている。
lines.translated: She was fidgeting.

lines.content: あのな
lines.translated: "Listen."

lines.content: はい……
結婚しよう
lines.translated: "Let's get married."

lines.content: い、嫌ですっ
lines.translated: "N-No way!"

lines.content: “静かにしろ！”
