lines.content: 寄り道先の私のお店で、奏先輩に“お祝い”ができたらいいなって、そう、思っています
lines.translated: "We were hoping we could 'celebrate' with you at my shop on our detour, Kanade-senpai."

lines.content: お祝い――
lines.translated: Celebrate--

lines.content: 千和と姫織と智仁が、俺には内緒で用意してくれていたパーティー。
lines.translated: A party that Chiwa, Himeori, and Tomohito had prepared for me in secret.

lines.content: はっぴはっぴばーすでーなんです、奏大雅くん
lines.translated: "Happy, happy birthday to you, Kanade Taiga-kun."

lines.content: お、おう。ありがとう……
lines.translated: "O-Oh. Thanks..."

lines.content: 今日はこの俺、奏大雅の産まれた日。
lines.translated: Today was the day I, Kanade Taiga, was born.

lines.content: つまり誕生日だ。
lines.translated: In other words, my birthday.
The milestone year where I could finally win my freedom.

lines.content: 目の前にしたテーブルには、『おめでとう』の文字が乗せられたケーキがひとつ。
lines.translated: On the table in front of me sat a single cake with "Happy Birthday" written across it.

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: あんまりうれしそうじゃない……？
lines.translated: "You don't look very happy...?"

lines.content: いやそんなことはないよ。うれしい。とっても。……だけど
lines.translated: "No, that's not true at all. I'm happy. Really happy. ...It's just..."

lines.content: だけど？
lines.translated: "It's just?"

lines.content: ああ。えっと、この歳になって友人たちに誕生日を祝って貰えるだなんて……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Well, having my friends celebrate my birthday at this age..."

lines.content: それもこんな盛大に、とも言える形で。
lines.translated: And in such a grand way, at that.

lines.content: 本当にうれしい。
lines.translated: I really was happy.

lines.content: とても、とてもだ。
lines.translated: Truly, deeply happy.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: なんだかお兄さん、気恥ずかしい気持ちで一杯です
lines.translated: "I'm just completely overwhelmed with embarrassment here."

lines.content: 俺は顔を両手で覆って見せたりした。
lines.translated: I made a show of burying my face in my hands.

lines.content: 毎年誕生日は互いに祝ってるだろ？
lines.translated: "We celebrate each other's birthdays every year, don't we?"

lines.content: そうだな。四人で誰かの誕生日を祝い合うのは毎年のことだ
lines.translated: "True. The four of us getting together to celebrate someone's birthday is an annual tradition."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: そうだよ？
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: ……だけどさ。なんだかちょっと、今回はいつもより手が込んでやしないかな
lines.translated: "...Still, though. Don't you think you guys went a little more all-out than usual this time?"

lines.content: いつもは『おめでとう』の言葉と、簡単なプレゼントだったりを手渡す程度だ。
lines.translated: Normally, it was just a simple "Happy Birthday" and handing over a small present or something.

lines.content: それなのにケーキだなんて。
lines.translated: Yet here they were with a whole cake.

lines.content: しかもこんな豪華な。
lines.translated: And such a fancy one, too.

lines.content: 明らかにいつもより『特別』だった。
lines.translated: It was clearly more "special" than usual.

lines.content: ああ、今年は特別なんだ。……いや、大雅の今年の誕生日は特別だ、というのが正しいよな
lines.translated: "Yeah, this year is special. ...Or rather, it's more accurate to say that your birthday this year is special, Taiga."

lines.content: みんなそれをわかってる。だからこうしていつもとちょっとだけ違うお祝いをしたかったんだ
lines.translated: "We all know that. That's why we wanted to celebrate a little differently than usual."

lines.content: 今年はいつもと少し違う、か。
lines.translated: A little different than usual this year, huh.

lines.content: ……言わんとせんことはわかる。
lines.translated: I knew what he was getting at.

lines.content: わかるのだけれど、こんな形を取られてしまうとやはりそわそわとしてしまう。
lines.translated: I knew, of course, but having them make such a big deal out of it still made me feel restless.

lines.content: 人の誕生日を祝うのはいいけれど、自分が祝われる立場となると話が違う
lines.translated: "I'm fine with celebrating other people's birthdays, but it's a different story when I'm the one being celebrated."

lines.content: 毎年言ってるよなそれ
lines.translated: "You say that every year, man."

lines.content: しかも大雅はいつも自分のお誕生日を忘れてる
lines.translated: "Plus, Taiga always forgets his own birthday."

lines.content: いや……、忘れてるって訳じゃ
lines.translated: "No... It's not that I forget it."

lines.content: ただ実感が湧かないだけで。
lines.translated: It just never really sinks in.

lines.content: どこまでいっても他人事なのだ。
lines.translated: Ultimately, it always feels like it's happening to someone else.

lines.content: 今日だって三人がこそこそしているのを見て、なんとなくそうだろうなと思ってはいたけれど。
lines.translated: Even today, I'd seen the three of them sneaking around and had a vague hunch about what they were up to, though.

lines.content: 自分のお誕生日を忘れちゃう人は、なんだか自分に薄情な感じがしちゃいますよね
lines.translated: "People who forget their own birthdays seem a little cold toward themselves, don't you think?"

lines.content: ほう。面白いことを言うじゃないかひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Oh? That's an interesting thing to say, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: 頬を柔らかく抓ってみる。
lines.translated: I gave her cheek a gentle pinch.

lines.content: い、いひゃい、いひゃいよたいが……っ
lines.translated: "O-Owie, owie, Taigaaa...!"

lines.content: 解放する。
lines.translated: I let her go.

lines.content: ううっ、乱暴者めぇ……
lines.translated: "Ugh, you brute..."

lines.content: ジト目だ。
lines.translated: She glared at me with half-lidded eyes.

lines.content: 自分にも人にも薄情なのが大雅なんだね……
lines.translated: "You really are cold to yourself and everyone else, Taiga..."

lines.content: 頬をさすさすとしていた。
lines.translated: She rubbed her cheek tenderly.

lines.content: ふふん。その反面、ひよりちゃんはどうでしょう。自分のお誕生日をこれでもかってくらいお祝いして貰いたいので、こうして恩を売っておくのです
lines.translated: "Hehe. On the other hand, what about Hiyori-chan? I want my own birthday celebrated as grandly as humanly possible, so I'm buttering you up in advance!"

lines.content: さすが正直者
lines.translated: "Always appreciate the honesty."

lines.content: ひよちゃんのお腹はブラックホールだな。色々な意味で
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan's stomach is a black hole. In more ways than one."

lines.content: 苦笑い。くすくすと笑い合う。
lines.translated: We exchanged wry smiles and shared a quiet laugh.

lines.content: 先輩。ご注文は決まりましたか？
lines.translated: "Senpai, have you decided on your order yet?"

lines.content: 声がした。
lines.translated: A voice called out.

lines.content: 振り向く――
lines.translated: I turned around--

lines.content: ごめんなさい。もう少ししたら忙しくなりそうなので、早めに決めて貰えたらうれしいです
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, it's going to get busy in a little bit, so I'd really appreciate it if you could decide soon."

lines.content: ――[・|お][・|店]の制服を着ている千和がいた。
lines.translated: --and there stood Chiwa, wearing the cafe's uniform.

lines.content: ここは彼女の親御さんが経営しているお店。
lines.translated: This place was run by her parents.

lines.content: あらゆる種類のコーヒーが用意されていて――
lines.translated: They served all kinds of coffee--

lines.content: 更には、観光客用にと軽食などを提供している。
lines.translated: And on top of that, they offered light meals and snacks for the tourists.

lines.content: 板張りの床や壁。木目調の家具が目立つ。
lines.translated: With wooden floorboards, paneled walls, and prominent wood-grain furniture.

lines.content: 店内には聞こえるか聞こえないかといった大きさで、落ち着いた音色の音楽が常に流れていた。
lines.translated: Soothing music always played throughout the shop at a volume just barely loud enough to hear.

lines.content: そこかしこに和紙で作られた狐のお面やらが飾られてもいる。
lines.translated: Fox masks made of traditional Japanese paper and other ornaments were displayed here and there.

lines.content: 洋の中に和の雰囲気も混ざり合い――大正ロマンを絵に描いたような空間だ。
lines.translated: A Japanese atmosphere blended into the Western style--making it a picture-perfect Taisho Roman space.

lines.content: 彼女はいつも放課後はここでお手伝いをしている。
lines.translated: She always helped out here after school.

lines.content: 今日はあらかじめ先輩のお誕生会をするからと、お父さんには伝えておいたんですが……
lines.translated: "I did tell my dad in advance that we'd be holding your birthday party today, Senpai, but..."

lines.content: だからといって当然お店を貸し切るわけにもいかず。
lines.translated: Even so, it naturally wasn't like we could rent out the whole place.

lines.content: 店はそろそろかき入れ時となる。
lines.translated: The cafe would be hitting its peak hours soon.

lines.content: 俺たちのような帰宅部以外の生徒が部活を終えて押し寄せてくるのだ。
lines.translated: Students who weren't in the go-home club like us would finish up their club activities and come flooding in.

lines.content: 腹を空かせた野獣のような輩もなぜだかこんなこじゃれたお店に顔を出す。
lines.translated: For whatever reason, even rowdy guys hungry as wild beasts would show up at a stylish little place like this.

lines.content: それだけ食事が美味いと評判なのだ。
lines.translated: The food simply had that good of a reputation.

lines.content: 育ち盛りの生徒たち用にと価格もボリュームもそれなりだった。
lines.translated: To cater to growing students, both the prices and the portions were quite reasonable.

lines.content: ……注文。急ぐから、ちょっとだけ待ってな
lines.translated: "...Our order. I'll hurry, so just give me a second."

lines.content: メニューを開く。
lines.translated: I opened the menu.

lines.content: コーヒーやカプチーノなどと言った、俺にとっては小洒落ていて大人なメニュー。
lines.translated: It was full of things like coffee and cappuccinos--a menu that felt a bit fancy and grown-up to me.

lines.content: そして抹茶や白玉入りのお汁粉だとか。抹茶味のパフェだとか。
lines.translated: Then there was matcha, sweet red bean soup with shiratama dumplings, and matcha parfaits.

lines.content: 軽食はパスタやオムライスやカレーやハヤシライスなどメニューはバラエティに富んでいる。
lines.translated: For light meals, they had a wide variety of options like pasta, omurice, curry, and hayashi rice.

lines.content: ううむ、悩むな。何にしよう
lines.translated: "Hmm, tough call. What should I get?"

lines.content: 選択肢が多ければ多いほど俺は悩んでしまうタイプだ。
lines.translated: The more choices I have, the harder it is for me to make up my mind.

lines.content: 改めよう。
lines.translated: Let's take a step back.

lines.content: 今日はこの俺、奏大雅の誕生日――
lines.translated: Today is my--Kanade Taiga's--birthday.

lines.content: だからといって無邪気にはしゃいでしまえるほど子どもではもうないけれど。
lines.translated: Though I'm not a kid anymore, so it's not like I can just get innocently hyped up about it.

lines.content: 目の前にはケーキがある。
lines.translated: There was a cake right in front of me.

lines.content: それは『お誕生日おめでとう』というみんなの気持ちが形になったかのような甘いお菓子だ。
lines.translated: A sweet confection that felt like everyone's "Happy Birthday" wishes given physical form.

lines.content: このお店で一番値の張るメニューのひとつ。
lines.translated: It was one of the priciest items on the menu here.

lines.content: みんなこの日のためにお小遣いを少しずつ貯め買ってくれたのだ。
lines.translated: Everyone had saved up their allowance little by little to buy it for me for this day.

lines.content: うれしくないわけがない。
lines.translated: There was no way I wouldn't be happy.

lines.content: その気持ちに応えたいとも思ってしまう。
lines.translated: It made me want to return their feelings.

lines.content: だからメニュー選びにだって慎重に、なってしまう……。
lines.translated: Which was why I ended up being extra careful even when just picking from the menu...

lines.content: それに、きっと[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]もお夕飯を用意して待っていてくれるはず。
lines.translated: Besides, I was sure she would have dinner ready and waiting for me, too.

lines.content: ここで満腹になってしまうのは少し避けたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to avoid getting completely full here if I could.

lines.content: むむむむむ
lines.translated: "Hmmmmm."

lines.content: 開いたメニューとにらめっこ。
lines.translated: I had a staring contest with the open menu.

lines.content: そんな俺に千和はくすくす笑っていた。
lines.translated: Watching me, Chiwa giggled softly.

lines.content: なあ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 智仁が耳打ちしてくる。
lines.translated: Tomohito leaned in to whisper to me.

lines.content: おう。なんだろう
lines.translated: "Yeah? What's up?"

lines.content: ぺらり。メニューを捲りながら応える。
lines.translated: Flip. I answered while turning a page of the menu.

lines.content: 今日の千和ちゃんかわいくないか？
lines.translated: "Isn't Chiwa-chan looking cute today?"

lines.content: そうだな。お店の制服変わったみたいだな
lines.translated: "Yeah. Looks like the shop's uniform changed."

lines.content: なんだよ、気づいてたのかよ
lines.translated: "What the heck, so you did notice."

lines.content: 当たり前だろ。びっくりした。どきどきだ
lines.translated: "Of course I did. Caught me off guard. My heart's pounding."

lines.content: ……なあ、親友。そろそろ千和ちゃんに感想とかないのか？
lines.translated: "...Hey, best buddy. Aren't you gonna tell Chiwa-chan what you think already?"

lines.content: はは。なあ、親友よ。俺がさっきから頑なにメニューにばっかり視線を注いでいる理由がわかるかな
lines.translated: "Haha. Hey, best buddy. Can you guess why I've been stubbornly gluing my eyes to the menu this whole time?"

lines.content: とってもお腹すいてるとか？
lines.translated: "Because you're super hungry?"

lines.content: 俺のちわっこい後輩がかわいくて直視できないからに決まってるだろ
lines.translated: "Obviously it's because my pint-sized Chiwa of a kouhai is so cute I can't look directly at her."

lines.content: なるほどそうか！
lines.translated: "I see, so that's it!"

lines.content: なるほどそうだ。娘の成長にお父さんはうれしい気分だ
lines.translated: "Indeed it is. Seeing his daughter grow up makes Papa very happy."

lines.content: 後輩だったり娘だったり、千和ちゃんは大忙しだな……
lines.translated: "First she's your kouhai, now she's your daughter... Chiwa-chan sure has her hands full..."

lines.content: ああ。だけど本音を言うと、もっと違うところも成長していてくれたなら、お父さんはもっともっとうれしい。……見ろよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Though if I'm being honest, Papa would be even happier if she grew a little more in some other places, too. ...Just look."
I cast a quick glance at Chiwa. Even if I do prefer them small rather than big...

lines.content: 相変わらず色々とちわっこくてお父さんは寂しい気分だ……
lines.translated: "She's still as pint-sized as ever in all sorts of ways, and it makes Papa feel a little lonely..."

lines.content: 聞こえてますよ先輩
lines.translated: "I can hear you, Senpai."

lines.content: 千和。唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa was pouting.

lines.content: 自己主張の乏しい胸元を両手で隠すようにして、言う。
lines.translated: Crossing both arms over her modest chest to hide it, she spoke up.

lines.content: 褒められてるのか貶されてるのかわかりません。……セクハラって言葉を先輩は知ってますか？
lines.translated: "I can't tell if you're complimenting me or insulting me. ...Do you know the term 'sexual harassment,' Senpai?"

lines.content: ごめんごめんと苦笑いで改めて千和を見た。
lines.translated: "Sorry, sorry," I said with a wry smile, taking a proper look at Chiwa again.

lines.content: やっぱりかわいい制服だ。
lines.translated: It really was a cute uniform.

lines.content: いや。もちろん千和がかわいいから制服だってもっとかわいく感じられる。
lines.translated: No, of course, it was because Chiwa herself was cute that the uniform looked even cuter on her.

lines.content: それに……俺たちの会話に、千和はそっぽを向けた頬を少しだけ染めていた。
lines.translated: Plus... from our conversation, Chiwa had turned her head away with a faint blush tinting her cheeks.

lines.content: そんなところもまた俺はかわいいと感じてしまう。
lines.translated: That side of her made me think she was cute all over again.

lines.content: だがじゃれ合っている時間もあまりなさそうだ。
lines.translated: Still, it didn't look like we had much time to be messing around.

lines.content: 中々決まりそうにないので千和のお勧めを聞いてみた。
lines.translated: Since I was having trouble deciding, I asked Chiwa for her recommendation.

lines.content: お勧めですか。そうですね……
lines.translated: "My recommendation? Let's see..."

lines.content: 千和は人差し指を小さな顎先に添え、少し考えるような仕草だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa placed her index finger against the tip of her small chin, pausing to think for a moment.

lines.content: お父さんはエスプレッソが上手に挽けたと言っていました
lines.translated: "My dad said he managed to grind a really good batch of espresso today."

lines.content: お。コーヒーか
lines.translated: "Oh, coffee, huh?"

lines.content: 悪くないな、と智仁はうなずく。
lines.translated: "Not bad," Tomohito said with a nod.

lines.content: 甘いものは抹茶のパフェをおすすめしたいです。人気なんですよ？
lines.translated: "If you want something sweet, I'd recommend the matcha parfait. It's really popular, you know?"

lines.content: そっか。なるほど……
lines.translated: "Oh yeah? I see..."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき、更に悩んだ。
lines.translated: I nodded, mulling it over even more.

lines.content: ……抹茶パフェに、エスプレッソ
lines.translated: "...A matcha parfait, or an espresso."

lines.content: どちらも魅力的だけど。値段もそれなりだ
lines.translated: "They both sound tempting, though. The prices are up there, too."

lines.content: どちらもワンコインじゃあ楽しめない価格。
lines.translated: Neither of them was cheap enough to enjoy for a single five-hundred-yen coin.

lines.content: 学生の身分では手が出ないとはいかないまでも、躊躇くらいはしてしまう。
lines.translated: Not that they were completely out of reach on a student's budget, but it was enough to make me hesitate.
Ah...

lines.content: そもそも俺は今日文無しじゃないか。
lines.translated: Wait, aren't I completely broke today in the first place?

lines.content: 今さらそんな事実を思い出してしまった。
lines.translated: That fact suddenly occurred to me way too late.

lines.content: 奏先輩
lines.translated: "Kanade-senpai."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: 今日はなんでも好きなものを食べてください。ご馳走しますよ
lines.translated: "Please eat whatever you like today. It's my treat."

lines.content: え。なんでも……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Whatever I like...?"

lines.content: はい。そうです。なんでも、です
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. Anything at all."

lines.content: 深くうなずく。
lines.translated: She nodded deeply.

lines.content: そして微笑み……、
lines.translated: Then, with a smile...

lines.content: お腹いっぱい好きなものを食べたり飲んだりしてください。お値段は気にしなくてもいいです
lines.translated: "Please eat and drink whatever you like until you're full. You don't need to worry about the prices."

lines.content: あ、でも、時間は気にして貰わないといけないですけど。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "Ah, though I do have to ask you to keep an eye on the time. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 素直に頭を下げる千和だった。
lines.translated: Chiwa bowed her head earnestly.

lines.content: ……どうして？
つい、思っていたことが俺の口から滑り出た。
lines.translated: The thought on my mind slipped right out of my mouth.

lines.content: 千和は、ぱちくりとする。
lines.translated: Chiwa blinked in surprise.

lines.content: え？　“どうして”？
lines.translated: "Huh? 'Why'?"

lines.content: どうして、おごりなのかなって
lines.translated: "I mean, why are you treating me?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: ちょっとばつの悪そうに唇を尖らせて、千和は言う。
lines.translated: Pouting her lips a little bashfully, Chiwa spoke up.

lines.content: ……お祝い、だからです
lines.translated: "...Because we're celebrating."

lines.content: お祝い……
lines.translated: "Celebrating..."

lines.content: だけど既にケーキを買って貰っている。
lines.translated: Even though they already bought me a cake.

lines.content: このお店で一番値の張るケーキをワンホールもだ。
lines.translated: A whole one, too, and the most expensive one in this shop at that.

lines.content: これ以上はもうさすがに悪い。貰いすぎだよ
lines.translated: "I'd really feel bad accepting any more than this. You're giving me way too much."

lines.content: そんなことありません
lines.translated: "That's not true at all."

lines.content: 首を振る。きっぱりと。
lines.translated: She shook her head. Firmly.

lines.content: 奏先輩のこと嫌いですけど、意地悪なことばっかりする先輩は大っ嫌いですけれど。でも、それとこれとは別のお話なんです
lines.translated: "I don't like you, Kanade-senpai, and I really hate how you're always being mean to me. But that and this are two completely different things."

lines.content: う、そ、そっか
lines.translated: "Uh, I-I see."

lines.content: そうです。だからこれくらい、……これくらいの“おめでとう”くらい、あってもいいって思います。全然自然です。ふつうのことです
lines.translated: "That's right. So I think this much... this much of a 'happy birthday,' at least, is totally fine. It's completely natural. Just a normal thing to do."

lines.content: そうですよね？　と千和は少し必死な感じで、軽く詰め寄り、言う。
lines.translated: "Right?" Chiwa added, leaning in slightly with a somewhat desperate look on her face.

lines.content: それに今年の誕生日は特別なんです。去年までとは違います。だから……
lines.translated: "Besides, this year's birthday is special. It's different from all the ones up until last year. So..."

lines.content: とにかくお祝いです。おめでとうなんです。良いことがあった人にはもっと良いことあってほしいんです
lines.translated: "Anyway, it's a celebration. A 'happy birthday.' When something good happens to someone, I want even more good things to happen to them."

lines.content: ……私が勝手にしたいことなんです。先輩だから特別ってわけじゃありません
lines.translated: "...It's just something I want to do for my own sake. It's not like you're getting special treatment just because you're my senpai."

lines.content: だから、その……気にせずにご注文をどうぞ、なんです
lines.translated: "So, um... please go ahead and order without worrying about it."

lines.content: 夜月先輩も兎蛙先輩にもご馳走させてください、と千和は言う。
lines.translated: "Please let me treat you too, Yotsuki-senpai, Toa-senpai," Chiwa added.

lines.content: 姫織は歓喜し、智仁はありがとうと微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Himeori rejoiced, and Tomohito smiled with a "Thank you."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ……ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: これ以上の遠慮は逆に不遜だ。
lines.translated: Holding back any further would actually be rude at this point.

lines.content: そんなふうに自分を納得させて注文をすることにした。
lines.translated: Convincing myself of that, I decided to place my order.

lines.content: 千和のお勧めの抹茶パフェをお願いしようかな
lines.translated: "I think I'll go with the matcha parfait you recommended, Chiwa."

lines.content: しまった。注文してから気づいた。
lines.translated: Oops. I only realized it after I ordered.

lines.content: ……ケーキとパフェはちょっと重いな。
lines.translated: Having both cake and a parfait is going to be a little heavy.

lines.content: 千和も『大丈夫ですか？』と心配してくれた。
lines.translated: Even Chiwa looked worried, asking, "Are you sure you'll be okay?"

lines.content: だけどまあいい。
lines.translated: Well, whatever.

lines.content: ケーキは持ち帰らせて貰おう。
lines.translated: I'll just take the cake home with me.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]がきっと喜ぶだろうから。
lines.translated: Because I'm sure *that girl* will be thrilled.

lines.content: お待たせしました
lines.translated: "Here you go. Sorry to keep you waiting."

lines.content: 注文したものが運ばれてくる。
lines.translated: Our orders were brought to the table.

lines.content: とりあえず、みんな同じく抹茶のパフェを頼んでみた。
lines.translated: For the time being, we had all decided to order the same matcha parfait.

lines.content: おお～。白玉に抹茶のムースにチョコレートの飾りつけ。うん、美味しそうだ
lines.translated: "Whoa~ Shiratama, matcha mousse, and chocolate toppings. Yeah, this looks delicious."

lines.content: 手を合わる。
lines.translated: I clapped my hands together.

lines.content: それでは、遠慮なくいただきま――
lines.translated: "All right then, I won't hold back. Thanks for the food--"

lines.content: ごちそうさまです。美味しかったです
lines.translated: "Thanks for the treat. That was delicious."

lines.content: ――……え～、すごい。ひよちゃんもう食べ終わったのか。結構大きいのに。早いなあ
lines.translated: "--...Wait, seriously? You finished yours already, Hiyo-chan? It's pretty big, though. That was fast."

lines.content: パフェは飲み物
lines.translated: "Parfaits are a drink."

lines.content: うそだろ
lines.translated: "No way."

lines.content: 何杯でもいけます
lines.translated: "I could down as many glasses as you put in front of me."

lines.content: 得意げに、言う。
lines.translated: She said it proudly.

lines.content: ……ひよちゃん、さすがに太っちゃうぞ？　せめて良く噛んで食べなさい？
lines.translated: "...Hiyo-chan, you're seriously going to get fat, you know? At least chew your food properly, okay?"

lines.content: 早飯は兵士のたしなみ
lines.translated: "Eating fast is the mark of a good soldier."

lines.content: 兵士？　ふむ。そのココロは？
lines.translated: "A soldier? Hmm. And what do you mean by that?"

lines.content: 食事は戦い。負けられない、戦争
lines.translated: "Meals are a battle. A war you cannot afford to lose."

lines.content: 姫織は獲物を狙う目でこちらを見ている。
lines.translated: Himeori was staring this way with the eyes of a predator stalking its prey.

lines.content: 貴重な物資を飢えた輩に奪われてしまわぬようにしないといけない
lines.translated: "You have to make sure your precious supplies aren't stolen by starving scavengers."

lines.content: ダメだ……
lines.translated: "No way..."

lines.content: これは俺のだぞ。そんな目で見ても、やらない
lines.translated: "This one's mine. Even if you look at me like that, you're not getting any."

lines.content: けっち
lines.translated: "Stingy."

lines.content: イーッと、白い歯を見せた。
lines.translated: She bared her white teeth at me.

lines.content: ねえねえともちゃん。明日の寄り道はラーメンがいいかも
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Tomo-chan. Maybe we should stop for ramen on the way home tomorrow."

lines.content: 甘えたように言う。擦り寄る姿は子犬のようだ。
lines.translated: She said it in a wheedling tone. The way she cozied up to him made her look just like a puppy.

lines.content: ラーメン一杯、お腹いっぱい、食べたいのかも……
lines.translated: "I think I might want to eat a whole bowl of ramen until I'm completely stuffed..."

lines.content: んー、ラーメンか。そいつも悪くないかもなあ。お金、あればだけどね
lines.translated: "Hmm, ramen, huh? That might not be a bad idea. Assuming we have the money for it, though."

lines.content: ……あぁ、だけど、言われてみればお腹すいたなあ
lines.translated: "...Ah, although now that you mention it, I am kinda hungry."

lines.content: 今、パフェを食べてるじゃないか
lines.translated: "You're literally eating a parfait right now."

lines.content: 甘いものは別腹なのさ。今朝だったかな。大雅もおんなじようなこと言ってたろ？
lines.translated: "There's always a separate stomach for sweets. Wasn't it just this morning that you were saying the exact same thing, Taiga?"

lines.content: 意地悪そうに智仁の口元は緩む。
lines.translated: A teasing grin tugged at the corners of Tomohito's mouth.

lines.content: それに同調したように姫織は腕を組み、深くうなずいた。
lines.translated: As if chiming in, Himeori crossed her arms and nodded deeply.

lines.content: ええ、ひじょーに良くわかりますよ？
lines.translated: "Yes, I understand that veeery well, you know?"

lines.content: ひとつ目のお腹が満たされたから、ふたつ目のお腹がぐーぐー鳴るの
lines.translated: "Now that my first stomach is full, my second stomach is rumbling away."

lines.content: なるほど。別腹
lines.translated: "I see. A separate stomach."

lines.content: 今日のお夕飯が楽しみでなりませんよね
lines.translated: "I simply cannot wait for dinner tonight."

lines.content: 君のお腹は何個あるんだ
lines.translated: "Just how many stomachs do you have?"

lines.content: たーくさん
lines.translated: "Looots."

lines.content: 両手を広げる。
lines.translated: She spread both arms wide.

lines.content: たーくさんなんだよ、大雅
lines.translated: "I've got looots of them, Taiga."

lines.content: そっか。たくさんか
lines.translated: "I see. Lots, huh?"

lines.content: うん。大雅の分のご飯を残さずぜんぶ食べちゃいたいくらいにたくさんなのだー
lines.translated: "Yep. So many that I want to eat up all of your share of dinner too without leaving a single bite behind~"

lines.content: ……そいつは危険なのだー
lines.translated: "...Now that sounds dangerous~"

lines.content: ぎらつく姫織の視線から改めてパフェを隠した。
lines.translated: I made a point of hiding my parfait from Himeori's gleaming eyes all over again.

lines.content: だめですよ、夜月先輩
lines.translated: "You mustn't do that, Yotsuki-senpai."

lines.content: ――姫織の空になった食器を回収しに来た千和が諭す。
lines.translated: --Chiwa, who had come over to clear Himeori's empty glass, gently chided her.

lines.content: さすがの夜月先輩でも間食ばっかりしていたら太っちゃうだけじゃなくって、健康とかも危ないそうです。気をつけないと……
lines.translated: "Even for you, Yotsuki-senpai, if you do nothing but snack between meals, you won't just put on weight--they say it's bad for your health, too. You have to be careful..."

lines.content: でもでも……
lines.translated: "But, buuut..."

lines.content: いまにもほら、お腹の虫が飛び出してきそうなんだよ？　映画みたいに。ぎにゃーって。“俺に餌をやらないとは何事か、人類まるっと皆殺しだぞ”って
lines.translated: "Look, the monster in my belly is about to burst right out any second now, you know? Just like in the movies. Going 'Gyaaah!' Saying, 'How dare you not feed me, I'm gonna slaughter all of humanity!'"

lines.content: うおお、皆殺し。そいつは怖いなあ
lines.translated: "Whoa, slaughtering all of humanity. Now that's scary."

lines.content: 相変わらずぜんぜん怖そうではない間延びした対応だった。
lines.translated: As usual, his drawling response didn't sound scared in the slightest.

lines.content: ……お客さん。増えてきたな
lines.translated: "...Looks like more customers are coming in."

lines.content: 俺は店内を見渡した。
lines.translated: I looked around the shop.

lines.content: がやがやと騒がしくなりはじめていた。
lines.translated: It was starting to get noisy with chatter.

lines.content: 町の景観を目的とした観光客や、放課後の寄り道にやって来た生徒たち。
lines.translated: Tourists here to see the town's scenery, and students stopping by on their way home after school.

lines.content: 誕生日だのといって席を占領するのも悪い
lines.translated: "We shouldn't hog our seats using my birthday as an excuse."

lines.content: ん。ふたりともさっさと食べて、さっさと帰ろう
lines.translated: "Mm. Let's both finish up quickly and head on home."

lines.content: もっと食べたいと不満を口にするかと思いきや――意外にも素直に、姫織はうなずいていた。
lines.translated: Just when I thought she'd complain about wanting to eat more--surprisingly enough, Himeori nodded obediently.

lines.content: よし。完食
lines.translated: "Alright. All done."

lines.content: パフェを綺麗に平らげた。
lines.translated: I polished off my parfait cleanly.

lines.content: 同じく。……うん、美味しかった。時には甘いものもいい
lines.translated: "Same here. ...Yeah, that was good. Having something sweet every now and then isn't bad."

lines.content: 三人で『ごちそうさまでした』と手を合わせる。
lines.translated: The three of us put our hands together and said, "Thanks for the meal."

lines.content: 今日はここで解散することになった。
lines.translated: We decided to part ways here for today.

lines.content: ケーキを丁寧に箱へ納めてもらい、店を出た。
lines.translated: After having the cake carefully packed into a box, we left the shop.

lines.content: すみません。今日はここで失礼します。……また、明日です
lines.translated: "Excuse me. I'll be taking my leave here for today. ...See you tomorrow."

lines.content: 制服姿の千和が見送りに出てくれた。
lines.translated: Still in her work uniform, Chiwa came out to see us off.

lines.content: 通りを歩く人たちがその姿に視線を送っている。
lines.translated: Passersby walking down the street were casting glances her way.

lines.content: ちらり。ちらりと。
lines.translated: One glance after another.

lines.content: その視線に気づいた俺はなぜだかちょっと得意な気分。
lines.translated: Noticing their eyes on her made me feel a little proud for some reason.

lines.content: ……俺たちはちょうどお店の前に設置してあるバス停で、帰りの便を待つ。
lines.translated: We waited for our ride home at the bus stop set up right in front of the shop.

lines.content: 三人とも、改めて今日はありがとう。千和、抹茶のパフェ美味しかった
lines.translated: "Thanks again for today, you three. Chiwa, the matcha parfait was delicious."

lines.content: ケーキもすごくうれしかった。帰ってから大切に食べようと思う
lines.translated: "And the cake made me really happy, too. I'll savor every bite once I get home."

lines.content: 俺の言葉に三人は顔を見合わせ小さく笑った。
lines.translated: At my words, the three of them exchanged glances and shared a small laugh.

lines.content: 色々あったりなかったりしたけれど、おおむね成功だったよねと。
lines.translated: As if to say that despite a few hiccups here and there, it had been a success overall.

lines.content: そして千和が代表するようにして言う。はにかんで。
lines.translated: Then, speaking on behalf of the group, Chiwa spoke up shyly.

lines.content: 色々大変だったんですよ先輩。一時はどうなるかと思いました
lines.translated: "It was really a lot of trouble, Senpai. At one point, I didn't know how things would turn out."

lines.content: どうなるか？
lines.translated: "How things would turn out?"

lines.content: はい。奏先輩に秘密でお誕生日のお祝いを計画していたのに。バレちゃうかと心配でした。今日はずっとどきどきだったんです――結局は、やっぱり、バレちゃいましたけど
lines.translated: "Yes. We were planning a birthday celebration in secret for you, Kanade-senpai, and I was worried you'd find out. My heart was pounding all day today--though in the end, the secret got out anyway."

lines.content: お誕生日のお祝い。
lines.translated: A birthday celebration.

lines.content: もうそれほど俺たちは子どもでもない。
lines.translated: We aren't really kids anymore.

lines.content: 故に。あんまり盛大にやりすぎると逆に興醒め。
lines.translated: Because of that, making too big a deal out of it would actually kill the mood.

lines.content: だけど今年の誕生日は特別な意味を持つ。
lines.translated: Even so, this year's birthday held a special meaning.

lines.content: そのためにいつもとは違う“何か”が欲しかった。
lines.translated: That was why they wanted "something" different from usual.

lines.content: それが三人の気持ちだ。
lines.translated: That was how the three of them felt.

lines.content: 一人ひとりがプレゼントを用意するよりも、三人でケーキをひとつ用意するほうがいいかなって思ったんです
lines.translated: "Rather than each of us getting you an individual present, we thought it might be nicer for the three of us to get a single cake together."

lines.content: 千和の言葉に俺は自然と微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's words brought a natural smile to my face.

lines.content: 確かに。
lines.translated: That's true.

lines.content: これくらいのほうが後々あまり気兼ねせずに済むだろう。
lines.translated: Keeping it on this scale made it easier not to feel overly indebted afterward.

lines.content: 後はどうやって先輩に気づかれないまま、ケーキを用意している私のお店に誘導するかが問題でした
lines.translated: "After that, the problem was how to guide you to my shop where the cake was waiting without you catching on, Senpai."

lines.content: だけど……、聞いてくださいよ先輩
lines.translated: "Except... just listen to this, Senpai."

lines.content: 千和は頬を膨らませる。
lines.translated: Chiwa puffed out her cheeks.

lines.content: 夜月先輩。奏先輩を誘導する役は自分に任せてって、自信満々に言っていたのに……
lines.translated: "Yotsuki-senpai was so confident, telling us to leave the job of bringing you here to her, and yet..."

lines.content: 完、璧
lines.translated: "Per-fect."

lines.content: 姫織。目をきらりとさせる。
lines.translated: Himeori's eyes sparkled.

lines.content: 親指を、ぴしっと。
lines.translated: She gave a sharp thumbs-up.

lines.content: 得意げに胸も張る。
lines.translated: And puffed out her chest proudly.

lines.content: そして言った。
lines.translated: Then she said:

lines.content: ひよりちゃんだっていつまでもひよこじゃないの
lines.translated: "Even Hiyori-chan doesn't stay a little chick forever."

lines.content: ええ～。あれが完璧ですか？　ちょっと強引でしたよ……
lines.translated: "Ehh~? You call that perfect? It was a bit forceful..."

lines.content: 苦笑いで千和がそう答えていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa replied with a wry smile.

lines.content: そんなこんなで。
lines.translated: And so, through all of that.

lines.content: 三人は俺の誕生日を祝うため、色々と考えたり話し合ったりしていてくれたらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, the three of them had put a lot of thought and discussion into celebrating my birthday.

lines.content: 先輩。本当ならお店を貸し切りにできればよかったんですけど。今日はどうしても無理でした。この時間はいつもお客さんが多くって……
lines.translated: "Senpai, I really wished we could have reserved the whole shop just for us. But it was simply impossible today. We always get so many customers around this time..."

lines.content: 俺は頬を緩ませ首を振る。
lines.translated: My expression softened, and I shook my head.

lines.content: 充分だ。いや、充分以上だった。
lines.translated: This was enough. No, it was more than enough.

lines.content: ありがとう。この気持ちが言葉以上に伝わればいい。
lines.translated: Thank you. I hoped that feeling would reach them even more than my words could.

lines.content: そんなことを思う何回目かの誕生日だった。
lines.translated: It was the umpteenth birthday I'd found myself thinking that.

lines.content: 何はともあれおめでとうだ、大雅
lines.translated: "At any rate, congrats, Taiga."

lines.content: 智仁が言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito said.

lines.content: 一年繰り上げだけど。これでようやく自由だな
lines.translated: "It's a year early, sure. But with this, you're finally free."

lines.content: 智仁は、町を見下ろす山の中腹辺りを見上げていた。
lines.translated: Tomohito was looking up toward the mountainside overlooking the town.

lines.content: 今日俺が飛び出した“施設”がそこにはある。
lines.translated: That was where the "facility" I'd walked out of today stood.

lines.content: あの施設は窮屈だったよな。色々とさ
lines.translated: "That facility was stifling, wasn't it? In a lot of ways."

lines.content: おやさしいのさ。悪気があってのそれじゃない
lines.translated: "They're just overly kind. They don't mean any harm by it."

lines.content: そうだな。わかってる
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know."

lines.content: ……十年前の“戦争”中、“ゆめのねどこ”に出入りするために家出したとき、俺もちょっと厄介になったからな
lines.translated: "...Back during the 'War' ten years ago, when I ran away from home to hang around the 'Bed of Dreams,' they took care of me for a bit, too."

lines.content: 窮屈とは言ったけど、特別あの場所で何か嫌なことがあったわけでもないんだ
lines.translated: "I called it stifling, sure, but it's not like anything particularly bad ever happened to me there."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: どんなに事務的で。どんなにふつうで。
lines.translated: No matter how bureaucratic. No matter how ordinary.

lines.content: どんなに、平凡であること、それ以上でも以下でもない環境であろうとも。
lines.translated: No matter how thoroughly average that environment was--nothing more, nothing less.

lines.content: だからこそプログラム通り俺たちのことを丁寧に扱ってくれた。
lines.translated: Precisely because of that, they treated us with care, strictly by the book.
Even so, no one ever came to take me in.

lines.content: たったそれだけのことなのだ。
lines.translated: That was all there was to it.

lines.content: ま、なにはともあれめでたい日だ。……大雅が自由になれた特別な日だ
lines.translated: "Well, whatever the case, today's a day to celebrate. ...A special day where you gained your freedom, Taiga."

lines.content: だから今年は少しだけでもいつもと違うことがしたかった。大雅。ちゃんとその意図が叶っていればいいけれど
lines.translated: "So we wanted to do something at least a little different from usual this year. I hope that intention got across properly, Taiga."

lines.content: ありがとう。本当に充分だ
lines.translated: "Thanks. It really is plenty."

lines.content: このケーキは誕生日だってだけじゃなくて、さながら俺が自由になったお祝いってところなんだな
lines.translated: "So this cake isn't just for my birthday--it's practically a celebration of my freedom, huh?"

lines.content: うん。そうかも……？
lines.translated: "Yep. Maybe so...?"

lines.content: だけどなあ……、うん。確かに、だ。俺以外はすぐに[・|迎][・|え]が来たのに。俺はさっぱりだった。こんなのはどうかしてる。おかしいよな、まったく
lines.translated: "Still, man... Yeah, it really is true. Someone came to pick up everyone else right away. Yet I had no luck at all. That's just messed up. It's weird, seriously."

lines.content: ちょっとわざとらしくそんなことを言ってみた。
lines.translated: I said it with a slightly exaggerated air.

lines.content: それは、先輩の意地悪な感じが大人の人たちに伝わったんじゃないですか
lines.translated: "Isn't that because the adults picked up on your mean streak, Senpai?"

lines.content: 千和が得意そうに言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa said smugly.

lines.content: だから誰もが警戒したんですよ、きっと
lines.translated: "So everyone was on their guard around you, I bet."

lines.content: はは。違いない
lines.translated: "Haha. No doubt about that."

lines.content: 小さく笑う。
lines.translated: I let out a small laugh.

lines.content: そして俺も施設のある辺りを見上げてみた。
lines.translated: Then I looked up toward where the facility was, too.

lines.content: もうあそこには戻りたくはないな。繰り返すようだけど、別に何かものすごく嫌なことがあったわけじゃない。それでもやっぱり窮屈だった。俺は今が結構気に入ってるしな
lines.translated: "I don't ever want to go back there again. Not to repeat myself, but it's not like anything terribly bad happened. Even so, it really was stifling. Besides, I like how things are right now pretty well."

lines.content: あそこは別段強制的な拘束力を持つ収容施設とまでは言えない場所だ。
lines.translated: You couldn't really call that place a detention facility with any power to hold you by force.

lines.content: しかし経済的にも精神的にも自力で生きていくことのできない子どもにとっては、その場所以外に身を寄せる“何か”などあろうはずもなく。
lines.translated: However, for children incapable of surviving on their own financially or mentally, there was no other "something" they could possibly turn to for shelter.

lines.content: 強制性などなくともそれに依存する他に選択できる道はない。
lines.translated: Even without coercion, there was no path to choose other than depending on it.

lines.content: そして今日。
lines.translated: And today.

lines.content: ……この俺の誕生日。
lines.translated: On this birthday of mine.

lines.content: 経済的な自立を得られたわけではないのだが――半ば見切り発車のような形で、ひとり、生きていくための不自由な自由を得た。
lines.translated: It wasn't as if I had achieved financial independence--but by jumping the gun a bit, I had obtained an inconvenient freedom to live on my own.

lines.content: 更にもうひとつ。
lines.translated: And on top of that, there was one more thing.

lines.content: 俺は、手に入れられるものがある。
lines.translated: Something within my grasp.
I kept my promise.
Asahi-san.

lines.content: 今度はあなたが約束を守ってくれる番だ。
lines.translated: Now it's your turn to keep yours.

lines.content: バスがやって来る時間までもう少しだ。
lines.translated: It was almost time for the bus to arrive.

lines.content: あ～……それにしても、明日も変わらず学校かあ
lines.translated: "Ahh~... Still, we've got school again tomorrow as usual, huh?"

lines.content: ため息をつく。
lines.translated: He let out a sigh.

lines.content: 面倒だなあ行きたくねえなあ、明日学校爆発とかしないかなあ。はぁ、もう、帰りたいよなあ
lines.translated: "What a pain, I really don't wanna go. Can't the school just explode tomorrow or something? *Sigh*, man, I wanna go home already."

lines.content: 今、帰宅中じゃないか
lines.translated: "Aren't you on your way home right now?"

lines.content: 違う。明日の分を、もう、帰ってしまいたいんだ
lines.translated: "No. I want to get tomorrow's trip home over with right now."

lines.content: ははっ。意味わかんない
lines.translated: "Haha. That makes no sense."

lines.content: やれやれと首を振って見せた。
lines.translated: I shook my head in exasperation.

lines.content: んー。今夜、三人一緒に夢の中で会えたらすてきですね？
lines.translated: "Hmm. Wouldn't it be lovely if the three of us could meet up in a dream together tonight?"

lines.content: 突然乙女なことを言いますよね、ひよりさん
lines.translated: "Saying something so girly all of a sudden, Hiyori-san?"

lines.content: ちょっと聞いてるこっちが照れくさいなんて思っていたけど、
lines.translated: Just listening to it made me feel a bit bashful, or so I thought,

lines.content: 待って。
lines.translated: Wait.

lines.content: 三人？
lines.translated: "Three of us?"

lines.content: そしてね、三人力を合わせて学校爆発させる夢を見られれば完璧
lines.translated: "And then, if the three of us could join forces in the dream to blow up the school, it'd be absolute perfection."

lines.content: ほほう。俺たちの学舎を見事粉砕だな。明日は休みだ、天国だ。ひゃっほい
lines.translated: "Oh-ho. Utterly pulverizing our alma mater, huh? Tomorrow's a day off, pure heaven. Yahoo!"

lines.content: 夜見る世界と現実と。どっちが本物？
lines.translated: "The world we see at night, and reality. Which one is the real thing?"

lines.content: ……物騒なこと言わないでください
lines.translated: "...Please don't say such dangerous things."

lines.content: あ、あの……ひよちゃん、三人って……ねえ、誰が？　誰が仲間はずれなの？
lines.translated: "U-Um... Hiyo-chan, you said three of us... Hey, who is it? Who's the one being left out?"

lines.content: バスがやって来た。
lines.translated: The bus arrived.

lines.content: 姫織と智仁が乗り込む。
lines.translated: Himeori and Tomohito boarded it.

lines.content: それじゃ改めて、また明日だな
lines.translated: "Well then, once again, see you tomorrow."

lines.content: あれ？　大雅は乗らないの？
lines.translated: "Huh? You're not getting on, Taiga?"

lines.content: 俺はいいんだ
lines.translated: "I'm good."

lines.content: あ、そっか。仲間はずれだね？
lines.translated: "Ah, I see. So you're the one left out, huh?"

lines.content: ちがわい。……ちがうよね？
lines.translated: "Wait, no! ...That's not it, right?"

lines.content: ムッとしてみせたり、不安そうにしてみせたり。
lines.translated: I alternated between putting on a sulky face and looking anxious.

lines.content: うん、まあ、いいさ。ひよちゃんは智仁が迷子にならないようついてやっててくれ
lines.translated: "Yeah, well, whatever. Hiyo-chan, stick with Tomohito so he doesn't get lost, okay?"

lines.content: もちろんですともー
lines.translated: "Why, of course~"

lines.content: え？　俺が……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Me...?"

lines.content: バスの扉が閉まる。
lines.translated: The bus doors closed.

lines.content: ガラス越しにふたりが手を振るのに千和と応えた。
lines.translated: The two of them waved through the glass, and Chiwa and I waved back.

lines.content: ……先輩。ちょっと気になってることがあるんです
lines.translated: "...Senpai. There's something that's been on my mind a little."

lines.content: バスを見送りながら千和が言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa spoke as we watched the bus drive off.

lines.content: もし良かったら教えてもらってもいいですか？
lines.translated: "If you don't mind, could you tell me?"

lines.content: 気になってること？
lines.translated: "Something on your mind?"

lines.content: はい……
先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 先輩、奏先輩。質問があります
lines.translated: "Senpai, Kanade-senpai. I have a question."

lines.content: ああ、なんだろう
lines.translated: "Sure, what is it?"

lines.content: 今日は先輩の誕生日です。それってつまり、もうあの施設には戻らないってことですよね？
lines.translated: "Today is your birthday, Senpai. Does that mean you aren't going back to that facility anymore?"

lines.content: うん。そうなるな
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's how it works out."

lines.content: だったら先輩は今日、どこに帰るんですか？
lines.translated: "Then where are you going home to today, Senpai?"

lines.content: 俺を見つめる。
lines.translated: She stared right at me.

lines.content: 教えてください。先輩、行くところはちゃんとあるんですか？　ご飯とかは大丈夫ですか？
lines.translated: "Please tell me. Senpai, do you actually have somewhere to go? Are you okay for food and stuff?"

lines.content: 心配そうに。
lines.translated: She looked worried.

lines.content: 荷物はそれだけ？　鞄ひとつだけですか？　着替えは……？　寝るところは……？　お布団は……お金は……
lines.translated: "Is that all your luggage? Just that one bag? What about a change of clothes...? A place to sleep...? A futon... Money..."

lines.content: 不安そうに。
lines.translated: She sounded anxious.

lines.content: 先輩……ひとりで、さみしかったりは……そういうの、平気なんですか……？
lines.translated: "Senpai... Won't you get lonely all by yourself...? Are you really okay with all that...?"

lines.content: 小さな千和は、俺を見上げたまま言う。
lines.translated: Little Chiwa kept looking up at me as she spoke.

lines.content: 両手を胸の前で握りしめ。
lines.translated: Both of her hands were clasped tightly in front of her chest.

lines.content: たくさんの言葉を並べながら、少し、詰め寄って来さえする。
lines.translated: As she rattled off question after question, she even stepped a little closer to press me.

lines.content: 先輩。もしも、色々大変だったら……先輩……その……
lines.translated: "Senpai. If things are really tough... Senpai... um..."

lines.content: そこでうつむく。
lines.translated: There, she cast her eyes down.

lines.content: そして、視線を足元にさ迷わせ、尖らせた唇をもにょもにょとさせながら、
lines.translated: Then, letting her gaze wander around her feet and mumbling with pursed lips,

lines.content: あの……先輩が嫌じゃ、なかったら……家に、来て、くれても……なんて……なん、て……
lines.translated: "Um... If you wouldn't mind it, Senpai... you could come to my house... or something... just kidding, just... kidding..."

lines.content: ちょっとばつの悪そうに、小さくちいさく言っていた。
lines.translated: Looking a bit awkward, she said it in a tiny, tiny voice.

lines.content: はは
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: 君は俺のお母さんかってくらい気にかけてくれている。
lines.translated: She was fussing over me so much you'd think she was my mother.

lines.content: それに千和、おかしいな。君は俺のことが大っ嫌いなんじゃなかったっけ。
lines.translated: Besides, Chiwa, that's strange. Didn't you utterly despise me?

lines.content: ……うれしい。
lines.translated: I'm happy.

lines.content: そしてかわいい。
lines.translated: And she's cute.

lines.content: そう思う。とても、とても。
lines.translated: That's what I think. Very, very much so.

lines.content: ……大丈夫。ありがとう。ぜんぜん平気だ
lines.translated: "...I'm fine. Thank you. I'm totally okay."

lines.content: 笑って見せる。
lines.translated: I gave her a smile.

lines.content: 何も。何ひとつ。問題はない。すべてが順調なのだと言う代わりに。
lines.translated: Instead of saying that nothing, not a single thing was wrong, and everything was going smoothly,

lines.content: 大丈夫だ千和。行くところはあるんだ。だからそういった最低限は、千和が心配してくれてることは、まあ、とりあえず大丈夫だろうって思う
lines.translated: "It's fine, Chiwa. I have a place to go. So as far as the bare necessities go, the things you're worrying about for me... well, I think I'll manage for the time being."

lines.content: そうですか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: でも。行くところって……。それって、もしかして
lines.translated: "But a place to go... Could that possibly mean..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: たぶん、それに関しては千和が考えているもので正解だ
lines.translated: "What you're thinking of is probably right on the mark, Chiwa."

lines.content: 智仁も姫織もあまりその点について聞いてこなかったのは、ふたりもなんとなく察しがついていたからだろう。
lines.translated: The reason neither Tomohito nor Himeori pried too much into that was probably because they'd both more or less guessed it, too.

lines.content: 秘密にしていたのは……、ごめんな。お節介焼きでおやさしい幼馴染みたちを無駄に心配させたくなかったんだ
lines.translated: "As for keeping it a secret... sorry about that. I didn't want to make my meddlesome, sweet childhood friends worry for nothing."

lines.content: 誤解を招くようなせりふだった。
lines.translated: It was a line that invited misunderstanding.

lines.content: 気恥ずかしさから奇妙な言い方になってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: Out of embarrassment, I ended up phrasing it in a strange way.

lines.content: “心配させたくない”
lines.translated: "I didn't want to make them worry."

lines.content: それは事実。
lines.translated: That part was true.

lines.content: 正直に事情を話せば、智仁は家に来いと言うだろう。既に誘われたように。
lines.translated: If I explained my circumstances honestly, Tomohito would tell me to stay at his place. Just like he'd already invited me to do.

lines.content: 姫織は……何を言うかはわからないにせよ、きっと心配してくれる。
lines.translated: Himeori... I didn't know what she'd say, but she'd definitely worry about me.

lines.content: 場合によっては大切なご飯を分け与えてくれたりもするだろう。
lines.translated: Depending on the situation, she might even share her precious meals with me.

lines.content: 姫織はどうもわかりづらい性格をしてはいるが、本音のところではやさしい子なのだと俺は知ってる。
lines.translated: Himeori has a personality that's pretty hard to read, but I know that deep down, she's a kind girl.

lines.content: 千和だって。
lines.translated: Even Chiwa.

lines.content: 口や態度ではとてもとても迷惑がりながらも、俺の世話を焼こうとしてくれるはずだ。
lines.translated: While acting terribly, terribly put out in her words and attitude, she would surely try to take care of me.

lines.content: さっきも小さくちいさく、俺を気遣ってくれるような言葉を漏らしていたように。
lines.translated: Just like how she'd let slip those tiny, quiet words of concern for me a moment ago.

lines.content: ……そんなみんなの姿が目に浮かび、なんだかとてもうれしくもなる。
lines.translated: Picturing everyone like that in my mind made me feel awfully happy somehow.
When I think about what lies ahead, that kindness sometimes makes it hurt a little.

lines.content: 充分だ。
lines.translated: It's enough.

lines.content: 充分なのだ。
lines.translated: It really is enough.

lines.content: この俺なんかにはもったいないくらい。
lines.translated: More than someone like me ever deserves.

lines.content: どこまでも自分勝手なこの俺が、誰かの助力を期待するのはあんまりにも都合が良すぎる。
lines.translated: For someone as thoroughly selfish as me to expect help from others is just way too convenient.

lines.content: ……と、言うのが。
lines.translated: Or so the saying goes.

lines.content: 本来あるべき模範的な回答なのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think that would be the proper, model answer to give.

lines.content: だが実際のところは、どうだ。
lines.translated: But in reality, how is it?

lines.content: 俺は自身のライフラインを他者へと――[・|あ][・|の][・|場][・|所]へと依存することを期待してしまっている。
lines.translated: I'm sitting here hoping toฝาก my own lifeline onto others--to depend on that place.

lines.content: 故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: 幼馴染みたちへ投げかけた“大丈夫”の言葉も。
lines.translated: Even the "I'm fine" I tossed out to my childhood friends.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と][・|た][・|ち]に拒否されたなら、話はまた別ということになってしまうだろう。
lines.translated: If those people turn me away, it'll end up being a whole different story.

lines.content: だがそれはそれで構わない。
lines.translated: But if that happens, I don't mind.

lines.content: このまま行き場も何もなく、町をさまようことになったとしても……。
lines.translated: Even if I end up wandering the town with nowhere to go and nothing to my name...

lines.content: これから歩まねばならない道のりを思うなら。
lines.translated: When I think of the road I have to walk from here on out.

lines.content: やさしく、手厚く、大切に扱われてしまうより――最初から嫌われ者であるほうがよほどいいのだ。
lines.translated: Rather than being treated kindly, warmly, and preciously--it's far better if I'm hated right from the start.

lines.content: 先輩？
lines.translated: "Senpai?"

lines.content: ふと沈黙してしまっていた俺を、千和が少し心配そうな表情で呼んでいた。
lines.translated: Having suddenly fallen silent, I heard Chiwa calling out to me with a slightly worried look on her face.

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は小さく首を振る。
lines.translated: I gave a small shake of my head.

lines.content: そして頬を緩め、『ごめんぼーっとしてた』とそう伝え、続けて言った。
lines.translated: Then I relaxed my cheeks, told her, "Sorry, I was spacing out," and continued.

lines.content: ごめん。何の話だったっけ
lines.translated: "Sorry. What were we talking about again?"

lines.content: 何の話って……
lines.translated: "What were we talking about...?"

lines.content: 不満そう。
lines.translated: She looked dissatisfied.

lines.content: 先輩はこれからどうするんですかって話です
lines.translated: "We were talking about what you're going to do from now on, Senpai."

lines.content: ちょっと頬を膨らませたりして。
lines.translated: She puffed her cheeks out a little.

lines.content: でも、わかりました……。先輩は、大丈夫なんですね？
lines.translated: "Still, I understand... You're really going to be okay, right, Senpai?"

lines.content: ああ。少なくとも今日のところはなんとかなりそうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. At least for today, it looks like things will work out somehow."

lines.content: ……困ったことがあったら言ってくださいね。約束です
lines.translated: "...If you run into any trouble, please tell me, okay? It's a promise."

lines.content: うん、ありがとう。約束だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, thanks. It's a promise."

lines.content: 絶対に、ぜったいですよ？
lines.translated: "Definitely, okay? You really promise?"

lines.content: 指切りをしようというふうに小指を立てた千和だったけど……。
lines.translated: Chiwa held up her pinky as if to make a pinky promise, but...

lines.content: ……すみません。何でもないです
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Never mind."

lines.content: ……急に恥ずかしくなったのか手を下ろす。
lines.translated: Perhaps suddenly feeling embarrassed, she lowered her hand.

lines.content: 頬をうっすらと染めていた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks were tinged with a faint blush.

lines.content: ……私もそろそろ戻らないと。お店が大変そうです
lines.translated: "...I should get back soon, too. Things look pretty busy inside."

lines.content: 店の中から千和を呼ぶ声がしていた。
lines.translated: Voices were calling for Chiwa from inside the shop.

lines.content: 見るとお店にはお客がたくさんだ。
lines.translated: Looking over, I saw the place was packed with customers.

lines.content: ああ、改めて今日はありがとう。うれしかったし、楽しかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Thanks again for today. It made me really happy, and I had a great time."

lines.content: はい。先輩、私のお誕生日には今日のお返しを期待していますから
lines.translated: "You're welcome. Senpai, I'll be expecting you to return the favor on my birthday."

lines.content: そうだな。あんまり派手になりすぎないような感じで
lines.translated: "Right. I'll make sure it's nothing too flashy."

lines.content: そうですね。それくらいが丁度いいって思います。私たちには
lines.translated: "Yes, I think that's just right. For the two of us."

lines.content: 明るく笑う。
lines.translated: She smiled brightly.

lines.content: 千和はお店のほうへくるりと背を向け、歩き出す。
lines.translated: Chiwa turned her back to me and started walking toward the shop.

lines.content: 千和。あのさ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Hey."

lines.content: はい？
lines.translated: "Excuse me?"

lines.content: 立ち止まり、振り向く。
lines.translated: She stopped and looked back.

lines.content: 何ですか？
lines.translated: "What is it?"

lines.content: その新しいお店の制服。とってもよく似合ってるって思うよ
lines.translated: "That new shop uniform of yours. I think it suits you really well."

lines.content: えっ
lines.translated: "Eh?"

lines.content: 千和。驚いたようにつんのめるが、ぐっと持ちこたえていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa stumbled forward in surprise, though she quickly caught herself.

lines.content: すごくかわいいって思う。うそじゃない。今だけ冗談とかは抜きだ
lines.translated: "I think it's super cute. No lie. I'm not joking around right now."

lines.content: ……突然何なんですか
lines.translated: "...Where is this coming from all of a sudden?"

lines.content: その視線はジト目だった。
lines.translated: She fixed me with an unimpressed stare.

lines.content: いや。ちゃんと言っておかないとと思って
lines.translated: "Well, I just thought I should make sure to say it properly."

lines.content: ちゃんとって……
lines.translated: "Properly...?"

lines.content: 千和は気まずそうに視線をさまよわせていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's eyes wandered awkwardly.

lines.content: そして、いつもみたいに唇をちょっと尖らせ、
lines.translated: Then, pouting her lips slightly like she always did...

lines.content: 先輩は、あれですよね……
lines.translated: "Senpai, you're... well..."

lines.content: うつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: She looked down.

lines.content: もにょもにょとしながら、続けて言った。
lines.translated: Fidgeting and mumbling, she continued.

lines.content: 先輩。……先輩は、こんなふうにふたりだけになると、ちょっとだけですけど話しやすくなるような気がします。それって私の気のせいでしょうか
lines.translated: "Senpai. ...When it's just the two of us like this, I feel like you become a little bit easier to talk to. Is it just my imagination?"

lines.content: 俺の顔を覗き込むようにしてそう言った。
lines.translated: She said this while peering up into my face.

lines.content: だけど俺の返答を待たず、千和はふるふると小さく頭を振って、
lines.translated: However, without waiting for my reply, Chiwa gave a small shake of her head.

lines.content: ……ううん。違います。わかってます。騙されません。いつもの意地悪ですね。本当は馬子にも衣装とかそんな感じのこと思ってるんです
lines.translated: "...No, that's not it. I know. You won't fool me. You're just being mean like usual. You're probably thinking something like 'fine feathers make fine birds,' aren't you?"

lines.content: うーん。どうかな
lines.translated: "Hmm. Who knows?"

lines.content: ……そんなことはないけれど。
lines.translated: That wasn't true at all, though.

lines.content: ふんだ。先輩の考えることくらいちゃんとわかるんですっ
lines.translated: "Hmph. I know full well what goes on in your head, Senpai!"

lines.content: いーっと歯を見せる。
lines.translated: She bared her teeth in a playful grimace.

lines.content: そっぽを向いて、千和はお店へ戻っていった。
lines.translated: Turning her head away, Chiwa headed back into the shop.

lines.content: ……ひとりになる。
lines.translated: Now I was alone.

lines.content: ふと、さみしい気持ちにもなる。
lines.translated: A sudden wave of loneliness washed over me.

lines.content: おやすみも。さよならも。また明日も、言いそびれてしまったなあと。
lines.translated: I realized I'd missed my chance to say goodnight, goodbye, or see you tomorrow.

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 俺も行こう。
lines.translated: I should get going, too.

lines.content: 帰らなければ。
lines.translated: I have to go back.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]を助けるそのために……。
lines.translated: In order to save *her*...

lines.content: 約束を果たしてもらいに、俺はあそこへ、向かわなければ。
lines.translated: I have to head over there to make them fulfill their promise.

lines.content: 楽しかった時間も、平凡だった毎日も。
lines.translated: The fun times, the ordinary everyday life...

lines.content: 今日までですべて終わりだ。
lines.translated: It all ends today.

lines.content: 千和の店をひとり離れる。
lines.translated: I walked away from Chiwa's shop alone.

lines.content: バスには乗らない。
lines.translated: I didn't take the bus.

lines.content: 昨日までは山の上の施設に帰らなければならなかったが、今日からその必要はもうないからだ。
lines.translated: Up until yesterday, I had to go back to the facility up on the mountain, but starting today, there was no longer any need for that.

lines.content: 人が行き交う夕暮れの町。
lines.translated: The town at dusk, with people passing to and fro.

lines.content: “ねえねえ知ってる？　あなた知ってる？　知ってるかしら？”
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, do you know? Do you know? I wonder if you know?"

lines.content: ふと、足を止める。
lines.translated: I suddenly stopped in my tracks.

lines.content: “ちょっと小耳に挟んだ噂だけども……”
lines.translated: "It's just a little rumor I happened to overhear, though..."

lines.content: ひそひそ
lines.translated: Whisper, whisper.

lines.content: ひそひそ
lines.translated: Whisper, whisper.

lines.content: 誰ともしれない声がする――
lines.translated: Anonymous voices drifted through the air--

lines.content: “ほらほらあの子よ。見てごらん”
lines.translated: "Look, look, that's her. Take a look."

lines.content: “毎朝バスの前に飛び出そうとするあの子のことよ”
lines.translated: "That's the girl who tries to jump out in front of the bus every morning."

lines.content: 見ると、バス停に小さな小さな女の子が立っていた……。
lines.translated: Looking over, I saw a tiny, tiny little girl standing at the bus stop...

lines.content: “……あの子はとっても可哀想”
lines.translated: "...I feel so sorry for that girl."

lines.content: “ある日、突然、両親が家に帰ってこなくなったんだって”
lines.translated: "They say one day, out of nowhere, her parents just stopped coming home."

lines.content: “噂では何かの事件に巻き込まれちゃったとか”
lines.translated: "Rumor has it they got caught up in some kind of incident."

lines.content: “いいえ、いいえ、あの子が手の付けようもないくらいの悪い子だから捨てられちゃったって噂だわ”
lines.translated: "No, no, the rumor I heard is that she was such an uncontrollable, awful child that they abandoned her."

lines.content: “あの子。両親に自分を捨てたことを後悔させるために自殺未遂を繰り返してるって話だけれど……本当なのかしら”
lines.translated: "That girl... They say she keeps attempting suicide over and over to make her parents regret abandoning her... I wonder if it's true."

lines.content: ひそひそ話は夕焼け空に滲んで消えた。
lines.translated: The whispered rumors bled into the sunset sky and vanished.

lines.content: バス停に立っていた小さな子も、いつの間にか姿が見えなくなっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the little girl standing at the bus stop had disappeared as well.

lines.content: さみしそうに俯いていたその横顔が脳裏に焼き付き離れなかった。
lines.translated: Her profile, looking so lonely with her head bowed, was burned into my mind and wouldn't leave.

lines.content: ……おそらく。
lines.translated: Most likely.

lines.content: 今が十年前ならば、きっと、あの子は“魔法少女”が助けるべきなのだろう女の子。
lines.translated: If this were ten years ago, she would surely be the kind of girl a "magical girl" ought to save.

lines.content: 歩みを進め、路地裏へ。
lines.translated: I pressed on, stepping into a back alley.

lines.content: しばらくまっすぐ進んでいくと目的の場所が見えてくる。
lines.translated: After walking straight for a while, my destination came into view.

lines.content: そこは古い建物だった。
lines.translated: It was an old building.

lines.content: 静かだ。
lines.translated: Quiet.

lines.content: 窓や扉はすべてぴったりと閉ざされている。
lines.translated: The windows and doors were all shut tight.

lines.content: 窓から中を覗いてみても真っ暗だった。
lines.translated: Even when I peered through the window, it was pitch black inside.

lines.content: ぼろぼろの廃屋……とまでは言えないものの、人の気配をまるで感じさせない古い家屋だ。
lines.translated: While I wouldn't go so far as to call it a dilapidated ruin, it was an old house completely devoid of any sign of life.

lines.content: 俺は、首から提げてる“鍵”を取り出す。
lines.translated: I took out the "key" hanging from my neck.

lines.content: 金色の“鍵”だ。
lines.translated: It was a golden "key."

lines.content: 三日月と星々の瞬く夜空が、柄の部分には細かく彫刻してあるものだった。
lines.translated: A night sky with a crescent moon and twinkling stars was intricately carved into the handle.

lines.content: その鍵をじいっと見つめたまま、俺は少し考えていた。
lines.translated: Staring intently at the key, I thought for a moment.

lines.content: ……そういえば
lines.translated: "...Come to think of it."

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: クロは鍵、持ってるのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder if Kuro has a key."

lines.content: っ
振り向いた先に、びくっと震える影がひとつ。ゴミ捨て場の青いポリバケツの裏だ。
lines.translated: Where I turned around, a single shadow flinched. Right behind a blue plastic trash can at the garbage collection point.

lines.content: 確か[・|前][・|回]は俺の鍵を一緒に使ったように思うんだけど……
lines.translated: "If I remember right, we used my key together *last time*, didn't we...?"

lines.content: なあ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: もしも[・|あ][・|っ][・|ち]にもついて来てくれるなら、今回もこれ、一緒に使わない？
lines.translated: "If you're going to follow me *over there* too, want to use this together again?"

lines.content: これがないと[・|あ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]には入れないんだけど……
lines.translated: "You can't get to the *other side* without this..."

lines.content: ……使う
lines.translated: "...I'll use it."

lines.content: 小さく丸まるみたいにしゃがみ込んでいたあの子。
lines.translated: The girl who had been crouching down, curled into a tiny ball.

lines.content: ……一緒に、使う
lines.translated: "...We'll use it, together."

lines.content: 渋々という具合に、ポリバケツの裏から姿を見せた。
lines.translated: Looking somewhat reluctant, she emerged from behind the plastic trash can.

lines.content: 大雅と一緒に、わたしも、使う
lines.translated: "Together with Taiga, I'll use it too."

lines.content: ん。わかった。そうしよう
lines.translated: "Yeah. Got it. Let's do that."

lines.content: 隣に並んでくれたクロ。
lines.translated: Kuro came to stand beside me.

lines.content: たったそれだけのことだがなんだかうれしい。
lines.translated: It was such a small thing, yet it made me happy somehow.

lines.content: 久しぶりに会ったからだろうか……今日の君は少し素直だ。
lines.translated: Maybe it's because it's been a while since we last met... You're being a little more honest today.
*Almost like when we talk on the phone.*

lines.content: ……どうして
ん？　なに？
lines.translated: "Hm? What is it?"

lines.content: ……どうして、大雅。わたしがついて来てるってわかったのかな
lines.translated: "...Why, Taiga? How did you know I was following you?"

lines.content: 首をひねり、考える。
lines.translated: I tilted my head, thinking it over.

lines.content: ううむ。どうしてって言われてもなあ。なんとなくだよ
lines.translated: "Hmm. It's hard to say why when you ask like that. I just had a feeling."

lines.content: ……なんとなく？
lines.translated: "...Just a feeling?"

lines.content: うん、そうだよ。なんとなくだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Just a feeling."

lines.content: だがそこにあえて理由を探してみるのなら……。
lines.translated: Though if I were to go looking for a reason...

lines.content: クロ。ずっと側にいるって約束してくれたろ？　だからだよ
lines.translated: "Kuro. You promised you'd always stay by my side, right? That's why."

lines.content: クロは……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: クロは、しゅんとしていた……ように、見えた。
lines.translated: Kuro looked as if... she had wilted a little.

lines.content: 『……わたしは、うそつきだ』
lines.translated: *"...I'm a liar."*

lines.content: クロの今朝の言葉を思い出す。
lines.translated: I remembered what Kuro had said this morning.

lines.content: 『大雅。きみが一番つらいとき。わたしは側にいられなかった……』
lines.translated: *"Taiga. When things were at their absolute worst for you... I couldn't be by your side..."*

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 別にそんな顔をさせたくて言ったわけじゃなかったんだ。
lines.translated: I hadn't said that to make her pull a face like that.

lines.content: 君のことを信じてるんだ、だから必ず側にいてくれるだろうなと思えたんだ。
lines.translated: I just trust you, and that's why I felt sure you'd be right there with me.

lines.content: そう、言いたかっただけなのに……。
lines.translated: That was all I wanted to say...

lines.content: ……君はやっぱりうつむいたまま。
lines.translated: And yet, you kept looking down.

lines.content: 君に安心してほしかったのに。君に笑ってほしかったのに。
lines.translated: I wanted to put your mind at ease. I wanted to see you smile.

lines.content: それなのにどうしてこうなってしまうんだろう。
lines.translated: So why does it always end up turning out like this?

lines.content: 上手くいかない。本当に。
lines.translated: Nothing ever goes right. Really.

lines.content: なあ、クロ。今日は一日、どうしてた？
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. What were you up to all day today?"

lines.content: 問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: そして空気の色を塗り替えたい。そう思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to paint over the mood in the air. That's what I thought.

lines.content: そうしてこの子の表情を塗り替えたい。そう、思った。
lines.translated: And by doing so, I wanted to paint over the expression on her face. That's what I thought.

lines.content: 近くにいた
lines.translated: "I was nearby."

lines.content: ぽつりとクロはそう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro murmured quietly.

lines.content: ……大雅の、近くに
lines.translated: "...Near you, Taiga."

lines.content: ずっと？
lines.translated: "All the time?"

lines.content: ずっと、いた
lines.translated: "The whole time."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ……大雅の姿が見える場所に、ずっといた
lines.translated: "...Somewhere I could see you, the whole time."

lines.content: 学校でも？
lines.translated: "Even at school?"

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: むむ。どこにいたのか全然わからなかった。明日は見つけられるようがんばらないと
lines.translated: "Hrm. I had no idea where you were at all. I'll have to try harder to spot you tomorrow."

lines.content: ……明日も見つけられないよう、がんばらないと
lines.translated: "...I'll have to try harder not to be spotted tomorrow, too."

lines.content: そう言い、クロは顔を上げた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Kuro lifted her head.

lines.content: ああ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: その顔は小さく、ちいさく、笑ってくれていた。
lines.translated: There was a small, tiny smile on her face for me.

lines.content: ほんの少しの変化だ。よく見つめなければ気づけないほどの。
lines.translated: It was a very slight change. So slight that you wouldn't notice unless you were looking closely.

lines.content: ……ともすればその笑顔は俺の気のせいだったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: For all I knew, that smile might have just been my imagination.

lines.content: それでも俺は微笑みを返す。
lines.translated: Even so, I smiled back.

lines.content: そして、手を……。
lines.translated: And then, my hand...

lines.content: 手を、繋がなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't take her hand.

lines.content: 君の微笑みを確かめようと、その顔を見つめることも難しかった。
lines.translated: Even just looking at her face to make sure of her smile was difficult.

lines.content: ……どうしてだろう。どうしてなんだ。
lines.translated: Why is that? Why?

lines.content: 今はすぐ目の前に、隣に、いてくれるのに。
lines.translated: Even though right now, she's right in front of me, right beside me.

lines.content: 俺は、玄関口に手をかけた。
lines.translated: I placed my hand on the front door.

lines.content: 立て付けはかなり悪くなってはいたものの、施錠はされておらず簡単に開いた。
lines.translated: Though the frame had warped quite badly, it wasn't locked and slid open easily.

lines.content: 家の中はぼろぼろでぐずぐずだった。
lines.translated: The inside of the house was dilapidated and falling apart.

lines.content: 所々穴の開いてしまっている廊下には薄く埃の層ができ――
lines.translated: A thin layer of dust coated the hallway, which had holes gaping in places--

lines.content: 朽ちた壁や天井は崩れ落ち、奥のほうからは鼻をつく正体のわからない刺激臭が漂ってきていた。
lines.translated: Rotting walls and ceilings had crumbled down, and an unidentifiable, pungent stench wafted from deeper inside, stinging my nose.

lines.content: とても人の住める環境ではない。
lines.translated: It was hardly an environment fit for human habitation.

lines.content: 綺麗にリフォームし直す手間を考えれば、よっぽどの理由がない限り新しく立て替えたほうがきっと無難だ。
lines.translated: Considering the trouble it would take to renovate it nicely, unless there was a very good reason not to, tearing it down and rebuilding from scratch would surely be the safer bet.

lines.content: そんなどうでもいいようなことを考えながら、俺は一度、扉を閉めた。
lines.translated: Mulling over such pointless thoughts, I pulled the door shut again.

lines.content: 辺りをもう一度見回す。
lines.translated: I glanced around the area once more.

lines.content: そして鍵を握りしめる。
lines.translated: Then, I gripped the key tightly.

lines.content: その鍵の先端を、玄関扉の鍵穴へとゆっくり差し込んだ。
lines.translated: I slowly slid the tip of the key into the front door's keyhole.

lines.content: クロ。どこでもいいから、俺に掴まっていて
lines.translated: "Kuro. Hold on to me. Anywhere is fine."

lines.content: ……わかった
lines.translated: "...Okay."

lines.content: クロはうなずく。
lines.translated: Kuro nodded.

lines.content: そして俺に伸ばした手を少し、さ迷わせ……きゅっと。
lines.translated: She reached her hand out toward me, letting it waver slightly... before giving a gentle tug.

lines.content: クロは、俺の制服の裾を摘まむみたいにした。
lines.translated: Kuro lightly pinched the hem of my uniform.

lines.content: ゆっくり。ゆっくりと……俺は差し込んだ鍵を時計回りに回転させ――
lines.translated: Slowly. Slowly... I turned the inserted key clockwise--

lines.content: かちり。
lines.translated: *Click.*

lines.content: ――開錠の合図。
lines.translated: --The sound of the lock releasing.

lines.content: [・|接][・|続]はつつがなく完了したことを俺は知る。
lines.translated: I knew that the *connection* had been completed without a hitch.

lines.content: 扉を開く。
lines.translated: I opened the door.

lines.content: すると――
lines.translated: And when I did--

lines.content: 姿を表したのは。
lines.translated: What revealed itself was...

lines.content: ぼろぼろに老いてしまった廃屋や。
lines.translated: Not an old, crumbling ruin of a house,

lines.content: 粉塵舞い上がる灰色のその内部――
lines.translated: nor a gray interior thick with swirling dust--

lines.content: などでは、なく。
lines.translated: Nothing of the sort.

lines.content: ……おかえり
lines.translated: "...Welcome back."

lines.content: やわらかいその声が。
lines.translated: That soft voice.

lines.content: おかえり、大雅。待ってたぞ
lines.translated: "Welcome back, Taiga. I've been waiting for you."

lines.content: ふんわりとした、笑顔が。
lines.translated: That gentle, warm smile.

lines.content: お誕生日おめでとう
lines.translated: "Happy birthday."

lines.content: やさしいばかりの、その、言葉が。
lines.translated: Those purely tender words.

lines.content: 俺たちの帰りを待っていてくれていた。
lines.translated: They had been waiting for us to come home.

lines.content: あさひさん。約束を果たしてもらいに来ました
lines.translated: "Asahi-san. I've come to have you fulfill your promise."

lines.content: 俺は、俺を迎えてくれたやさしい声と柔らかい笑顔の持ち主にそう伝えた。
lines.translated: I spoke those words to the owner of the kind voice and soft smile who had welcomed me in.

lines.content: [ひむかい|陽向井]あさひ。この町の“魔法使い”にだ。
lines.translated: To Himukai Asahi. The "magician" of this town.

lines.content: ……あいさつも何も返すことなく。
lines.translated: Without even returning her greeting or anything.

lines.content: 不躾だとは思う。
lines.translated: I knew it was rude.

lines.content: 少し後悔もした。
lines.translated: I regretted it a little, too.

lines.content: だからこそ俺の言葉を受けた相手は――
lines.translated: Which was surely why the person on the receiving end of my words--

lines.content: この俺、奏大雅の命の恩人であるあさひさんは。
lines.translated: Asahi-san, the savior who had spared the life of me, Kanade Taiga...

lines.content: ちょっとだけ困ったような表情を浮かべ、開いていた本をぱたりと閉じてしまったのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: Let a slightly troubled expression cross her face and softly snapped shut the book she had open.

lines.content: 何を、読んでいたんですか？
lines.translated: "What were you reading?"

lines.content: 唐突すぎた自身の言動に少しばかり、後ろめたいものを感じてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I felt a little guilty about how overly abrupt I had just been.

lines.content: ……だからその気まずさに取り繕うような笑顔を浮かべる。
lines.translated: So I put on a smile to gloss over the awkwardness.

lines.content: そうして俺は、あさひさんの座る真向かいの席に腰を下ろし、問いかけた。
lines.translated: Taking a seat directly across from Asahi-san, I asked her the question.

lines.content: 小説だよ
lines.translated: "A novel."

lines.content: あさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san replied.

lines.content: そして腰を据えた丸い形のテーブルに、幾つも積まれた本を視線で指し示した。
lines.translated: Then, she gestured with her eyes toward the several stacks of books resting on the round table where she sat.

lines.content: 別に難しいものじゃない。ほら、見てみろ。童話に近いものだよ
lines.translated: "It's nothing particularly difficult. Here, take a look. It's practically a fairy tale."

lines.content: 一冊、受け取る。
lines.translated: I took one of the books from her.

lines.content: あさひさんがさっきまで読んでいたのであろうものだ。
lines.translated: It was likely the one Asahi-san had been reading just a moment ago.

lines.content: よく見ると俺でも知っている有名なものだった。
lines.translated: Looking closely, it was a famous title that even I recognized.

lines.content: 大雅が帰ってきてくれるまで暇つぶしのつもりで読んでいたんだよ。だけど、だめだな。悪い癖だよ。気づいたらついつい熱中してしまっていた
lines.translated: "I meant to just read it to pass the time until you came back to me, Taiga. But it's no good. It's a bad habit of mine. Before I knew it, I got completely absorbed in it."

lines.content: 俺は……。
“帰ってきてくれるまで”
lines.translated: "Until you came back to me."

lines.content: あさひさんのそんな言葉の選択に、うれしいような、気恥ずかしいような。
lines.translated: Asahi-san's choice of words made me feel both happy and a little bashful.

lines.content: とにかく照れ笑いのようなものを自然と浮かべてしまう。
lines.translated: At any rate, a sheepish smile naturally rose to my face.

lines.content: あさひさん。この人の本、好きですよね
lines.translated: "Asahi-san. You really like this author's books, don't you?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。大好きだよ。自分でも呆れちゃうくらいにね
lines.translated: "Yeah, I do. I love them. Enough to amaze even myself."

lines.content: 微笑んで、うなずく。
lines.translated: She smiled and nodded.

lines.content: あさひさんはさっきまで開いていた本の表紙を、慈しむように指先で撫でた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san fondly traced her fingertips over the cover of the book she had been reading just moments ago.

lines.content: もう繰り返し読んでいる。最初から最後まで通して読むのは何回目になるのかな。よく、わからない。それだけたくさん読んでいる。でも、不思議と飽きないんだ
lines.translated: "I've read it over and over again. I wonder how many times I've read it through from start to finish now. I'm not really sure. That's how much I've read it. Yet strangely enough, I never get tired of it."

lines.content: テーブルに積まれた本はすべて同じ作家の本である。
lines.translated: The books stacked on the table were all by the same author.

lines.content: 今、あさひさんの手の中にあるものは、その中でもおそらく一番有名な一冊だ。
lines.translated: The one currently in Asahi-san's hands was probably the most famous among them.

lines.content: ――瞬く星の海を渡る列車のお話。
lines.translated: --The story of a train crossing a sea of twinkling stars.

lines.content: 人の言葉を話す猫たちが背筋を伸ばし、きらきら光る不思議な世界を旅して生きる物語。
lines.translated: A tale of cats who speak human language, standing tall as they travel and live through a sparkling, wondrous world.

lines.content: 小説だけではなく絵本だったり映画だったりアニメだったり。
lines.translated: Not just as a novel, but as picture books, movies, and anime.

lines.content: 色々な舞台を与えられ続けている、現代に一番近いお伽噺だ。
lines.translated: A story continually given all kinds of stages, the closest thing to a modern-day fairy tale.

lines.content: ……さて、大雅。“約束”だったな
lines.translated: "...Now then, Taiga. About our 'promise.'"

lines.content: あさひさんは俺を見つめてそう言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gazed at me as she spoke.

lines.content: はい……
俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: 確かに私は、君と約束をした。だから今日……君の誕生日である今日、この日、私は君にひとつの“権限”を与えなければならない
lines.translated: "It's true that I made a promise with you. So today... on this day, your birthday, I have to grant you a certain 'authority.'"

lines.content: だけど……だけどな。正直なところ私はまだ君の考えには賛同しきれないでいるんだよ。……いや。うん。違う。それは少し、違うかな
lines.translated: "However... however, you see. To be honest, I still can't bring myself to fully agree with your way of thinking. ...No. Yeah. That's wrong. Maybe that's putting it a little wrong."

lines.content: あさひさんは目をつむる。そして首を振った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san closed her eyes and shook her head.

lines.content: 私たちはこれでも昨日、今日、出会ったような気安いばかりの関係ではないから……。素直に、そして率直に、言おうか
lines.translated: "It's not as if we have the kind of casual relationship where we just met yesterday or today... So let me say it honestly and frankly."

lines.content: 私は君との“約束”を果たすことを躊躇している。むしろ“約束”を破ってしまいたいとさえ思っているんだ
lines.translated: "I'm hesitating to fulfill my 'promise' with you. In fact, I'm even thinking that I want to break that 'promise' altogether."

lines.content: 大雅。なあ、大雅。押しつけがましいことをあえて言わせて貰えるなら――私は、君のことが心配なんだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. Hey, Taiga. If you'll allow me to say something a bit pushy--I'm worried about you."

lines.content: 私は君につらい想いをしてほしくない。できるだけ波風たたない平穏な、むしろ少し暇だなあって言ってふて腐れるくらいの平凡な人生を送ってほしい
lines.translated: "I don't want you to go through anything painful. I want you to live a peaceful life as free of trouble as possible--an ordinary life where you're so bored you actually sulk about having too much free time."

lines.content: 君たち人間の幸せはそういった何気ない日々の中にこそあるものだ――……と、君たちのご先祖は口を揃えてそう言っているじゃないか
lines.translated: "True happiness for you humans lies right within those casual, everyday moments--...isn't that what all your ancestors unanimously say?"

lines.content: だと、いうのに……
lines.translated: "And yet, despite that..."

lines.content: ……ため息。
lines.translated: A sigh.

lines.content: そして、苦笑いを浮かべるあさひさんだ。
lines.translated: And then, a wry smile surfaced on Asahi-san's face.

lines.content: だというのに、大雅。君はわざわざ歩きにくい道を選ぼうとしているようにしか思えなくなるときが私にはあるよ
lines.translated: "And yet, Taiga, there are times when I can't help but feel like you're going out of your way to choose a difficult path to walk."

lines.content: だから、とても、とても、心配なんだよ、大雅。私は、君が歩むこの先が……君の未来が、心配なんだ
lines.translated: "That's why I'm very, very worried, Taiga. I'm worried about the path ahead of you... about your future."

lines.content: 勇気と無謀は。
lines.translated: Courage and recklessness.

lines.content: 果敢さと蛮勇さとは。
lines.translated: Boldness and foolhardiness.

lines.content: どれも似ているようでまるで違うものなんだとあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san says they all might seem similar, yet are completely different things.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: な？　君もそう思うだろ？
lines.translated: "Right? You think so too, don't you?"

lines.content: ……そして、あさひさんは俺の背後に視線を投げた。
lines.translated: And then, Asahi-san cast her gaze behind me.

lines.content: 大雅の……奏大雅の可愛いかわいい小さな相棒。君だって大雅には平穏に、無事に、幸せに、生涯を終えて貰いたいだろ？
lines.translated: "Taiga's... Kanade Taiga's cute, adorable little partner. Even you want Taiga to live out his life peacefully, safely, and happily, don't you?"

lines.content: クロは俺の背中に隠れてしまう。
lines.translated: Kuro hid herself behind my back.

lines.content: ……小さな身体を更に小さく縮めて。
lines.translated: Shrinking her small body down even smaller.

lines.content: そして細めた目であさひさんを見ていた。警戒するように。
lines.translated: And she watched Asahi-san with narrowed eyes, as if on guard.

lines.content: うぅ～ん。相変わらず嫌われちゃってるなあ、私
lines.translated: "Hmm~. She still hates me as much as ever, huh."

lines.content: いや。別にクロはあさひさんのことを嫌ってるわけじゃ……ない、よな？
lines.translated: "No. It's not like Kuro particularly hates you, Asahi-san... right?"

lines.content: クロはますます俺の後ろに隠れてしまった。
lines.translated: Kuro hid herself even further behind me.

lines.content: 話さないのではなく、話せない。この子は極端な人見知りなのだ。
lines.translated: It isn't that she won't talk, it's that she can't. This girl is just extremely shy around strangers.

lines.content: 誰かのことを無闇に嫌ったり避けたりするような態度を好んで取るような子ではない――はずだ。
lines.translated: She isn't the kind of girl who likes to take an attitude of blindly hating or avoiding someone--at least, she shouldn't be.

lines.content: まあ、いいか。いつかは君とも仲良く笑って話せるようになればいいなあと願うけど……その辺は追々の課題という感じで。未来に期待だ
lines.translated: "Well, whatever. I do hope that someday we'll be able to get along, laugh, and talk together... but let's treat that as an issue for later. Here's hoping for the future."

lines.content: だけどもうずいぶんと長い間、そんな期待を未来に持ち越させてるような気もするけどね
lines.translated: "Though I feel like I've been carrying that hope over into the future for an awfully long time now."

lines.content: 苦笑い。肩をすくめる。そして、あさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: A wry smile. She shrugged her shoulders. And then, Asahi-san spoke.

lines.content: 今日からここで[・|四][・|人][・|一][・|緒]に暮らしていくんだ。そんな生活の中で、いつか君の声が聞けるのを楽しみにしてるよ
lines.translated: "Starting today, the *four of us will be living together* here. In the midst of that life, I'm looking forward to hearing your voice someday."

lines.content: 四人、一緒に……。
lines.translated: The four of us, together...

lines.content: クロは首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Kuro was tilting her head.

lines.content: ……少しの間ぱちくりと瞬きを繰り返す。
lines.translated: She blinked her eyes in surprise for a moment.

lines.content: そして、言葉の意味を理解したのか、
lines.translated: And then, perhaps having understood the meaning of those words,

lines.content: クロは『そんなの聞いてないっ』というように目を泳がせる。
lines.translated: Kuro's eyes darted around as if to say, "I never heard anything about that!"

lines.content: ぎゅっと、俺の制服の背中を握りしめていた。
lines.translated: She was tightly clutching the back of my uniform.

lines.content: 今日から俺は、俺たちは、ここで生活を共にすることになる。
lines.translated: Starting today, I--we--would be sharing a life here.

lines.content: ……ここは、“ゆめのねどこ”
lines.translated: This place is "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: この町をテリトリーとする“[・|夜][・|の][・|魔][・|法][・|使][・|い]”、陽向井あさひさんの根城であり。
lines.translated: It is the stronghold of Himukai Asahi-san, the "*Magician of the Night*" who claims this town as her territory.

lines.content: そんな彼女が操る不思議を形にするための工房でもあった。
