lines.translated: And it was also a workshop for giving form to the wonders she manipulates.

lines.content: 裏路地の廃屋。
lines.translated: An abandoned house in a back alley.

lines.content: その玄関から、この店の内部へ。
lines.translated: From that entranceway, into the interior of this shop.

lines.content: そんな、論ずるべくもないほどの不可能な接続を可能にしたのが、俺の握りしめた一本の鍵。
lines.translated: What made such an indisputably impossible connection possible was the single key clutched tightly in my hand.

lines.content: これを造ったのもまた、“魔法使い”たるこのひとだ。
lines.translated: And the one who made it was also this person, the "magician."

lines.content: この俺、奏大雅の[・|命][・|の][・|恩][・|人]でもあるこのひとなのだ。
lines.translated: This person, who is also the *savior* of my--Kanade Taiga's--life.

lines.content: 俺がここに出入りするようになって、早十年。
lines.translated: It has already been ten years since I started coming and going from this place.

lines.content: 色々なことがあった。
lines.translated: A lot has happened.

lines.content: この場所で“魔法使い”と過ごした日々は今も色あせることなく思い出せる。
lines.translated: Even now, I can recall the days I spent with the "magician" in this place without them fading.

lines.content: ……そして数人の“魔法少女”と過ごした、決して短くもない毎日を。
lines.translated: As well as the by no means short everyday life I spent with several "magical girls."

lines.content: 久しぶりに訪れたからだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it because I was visiting for the first time in a while?

lines.content: そしてこれからすべきことを想うからこそ、だろうか。
lines.translated: And was it precisely because I was thinking about what I had to do from here on out?

lines.content: 俺はつい、心ここにあらずといったふうに、店中に視線を泳がせてしまっている……。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was letting my gaze wander all around the shop, my mind completely elsewhere...

lines.content: ……大雅。そんな、難しい顔をしなくてもいいじゃないか。大丈夫。ちゃんと約束は守るよ。絶対だ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You don't have to make such a grim face, do you? It's okay. I'll properly keep my promise. Definitely."

lines.content: あさひさんのその言葉に、俺ははっとして顔を上げた。
lines.translated: At Asahi-san's words, I snapped back to my senses and raised my head.

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。実際のところ気が進まないというのが嘘のない本当の気持ちだし、このままはぐらかしてしまえるのなら是非とも私はそうしたい
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. In reality, my honest, unvarnished feeling is that I'm reluctant to do it, and if I could just dodge the issue like this, I would absolutely love to."

lines.content: だけど君に嘘つきだと思われるのもそれはそれでつらいものがある
lines.translated: "However, having you think of me as a liar would be painful in its own right."

lines.content: だから約束は守るよ。……君に渡そう。君に、任せよう。今日、君に……君にとって特別な今日という日にこそ、約束通りあの“権限”を与えようと思う
lines.translated: "So I'll keep my promise. ...I'll hand it over to you. I'll entrust it to you. Today, to you... on this day that is so special to you, I intend to grant you that 'authority' just as promised."

lines.content: ああ、いやいや。“権限”というよりは“役割”だな。うん。そう言ったほうがきっと正しい
lines.translated: "Ah, no, wait. Rather than 'authority,' it's a 'role,' isn't it? Yeah. Putting it that way is surely more accurate."

lines.content: 苦笑いだ。少し照れくさそうでもあった。
lines.translated: A wry smile. She looked a little bashful, too.

lines.content: 今日の日に私が君へと譲り渡す“役割”が、私から君への、誕生日プレゼントだということにしたい。そう、思ってる
lines.translated: "I want to make the 'role' I'm handing down to you today my birthday present to you. That's what I'm thinking."

lines.content: なぜか俺は、そこで素直にうなずくことができないでいた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't bring myself to simply nod right then.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は確かに、自分自身が望んだことであるはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though *that* was certainly supposed to be what I myself had wished for.

lines.content: 改めて聞きたい。問いかけたい。大雅の今年の誕生日プレゼントは、大雅……[・|君][・|に][・|あ][・|の]“[・|役][・|割]”を与える、というだけで本当にいいんだな？
lines.translated: "I want to ask you once more. To question you. For your birthday present this year, Taiga... is it really okay if it's just granting *you that 'role'*?"

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: まだ消せない僅かな戸惑いを抱えながらも。
lines.translated: Even while still holding onto a slight hesitation I couldn't quite erase.

lines.content: そうか。わかった。……もうなにも言わない。私の心配も、不安も、充分に伝えたから
lines.translated: "I see. Understood. ...I won't say anything more. Because I've already conveyed my worries and anxieties plenty enough."

lines.content: 君は賢い子だ。ちゃんと考え、ちゃん悩んで、ちゃんと意味のある[・|使][・|い][・|方]をするだろうと信じてる
lines.translated: "You're a smart kid. I believe you'll think it through, agonize over it properly, and put it to a truly meaningful *use*."

lines.content: にこりと笑う。
lines.translated: She beamed a warm smile.

lines.content: そしてあさひさんは俺に手を差し出した。
lines.translated: And then Asahi-san held her hand out to me.

lines.content: 大雅。君の利き腕は左手だったな
lines.translated: "Taiga. Your dominant arm is your left hand, right?"

lines.content: ……え？　はい、そうですけど
lines.translated: "...Huh? Yes, that's right, though."

lines.content: じゃあ、左手だ。……君のその左手に“力”を与えよう。そして君自身には“権限”を、“役割”を、与えよう。ほら、私の手を取って
lines.translated: "Then, your left hand it is. ...I'll grant the 'power' to that left hand of yours. And to you yourself, I'll grant the 'authority,' the 'role.' Come on, take my hand."

lines.content: どうして、手なんですか？
lines.translated: "Why my hand?"

lines.content: 俺は言われるまま差し出された手を握った。
lines.translated: I grasped her outstretched hand as I was told.

lines.content: どうして？　そんなの当然お約束だからだよ
lines.translated: "Why? Because that's obviously the classic trope, of course."

lines.content: ……ごめんなさいあさひさん。ちょっと言ってる意味がよくわからない、かも
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Asahi-san. I'm not sure I quite understand what you mean."

lines.content: 困惑する俺である。
lines.translated: I stood there, thoroughly bewildered.

lines.content: すると、途端――
lines.translated: Whereupon, the very next instant--

lines.content: ふっふん
lines.translated: "Heh heh."

lines.content: お姉さんは、得意そうにした。
lines.translated: The older girl put on a smug look.

lines.content: ほら。あれだよ。“力”を使用するときにはさ、“くっ、俺の王の力がっ”とか、“やめろっ、し、静まれっ、闇の炎よっ”とかさ、そんなふうに格好付けてみたいだろ、男の子
lines.translated: "Come on. It's that thing. When you use your 'power,' you want to try acting cool and saying stuff like, 'Guh, my King's power is--!' or 'Stop! Q-Quiet down, Dark Flame!' right, boy?"

lines.content: え、ええ～、ちょっと何言ってるのかわかんないですけど
lines.translated: "U-Uh, I really have no idea what you're talking about..."

lines.content: むう。相変わらずつっまんない男の子だな、君は
lines.translated: "Mmph. You're as boring a boy as ever, aren't you?"

lines.content: あさひさんは頬を膨らませた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san puffed out her cheeks.

lines.content: 特別な“力”を授かるのは腕か、目か、そのどちらかだって決まってる。そういうものなんだよ。青春時代の様式美ってやつだ。わかるだろ？
lines.translated: "When you're granted a special 'power,' it's a rule that it goes into either your arm or your eye. That's just how it works. It's the classic aesthetic of youth, you know? You get it, right?"

lines.content: 無邪気な笑顔を見せられた。
lines.translated: She flashed me an innocent smile.

lines.content: まるで幼い子どものようだ。
lines.translated: Just like a little kid.

lines.content: 対する俺は……、
lines.translated: As for me, on the other hand...

lines.content: う～ん……
困惑。
lines.translated: Bewilderment.

lines.content: 戸惑い。
lines.translated: Confusion.

lines.content: どちらも消せない。
lines.translated: I couldn't shake off either of them.

lines.content: ……だが。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: えっと。失礼なことを言いますけど、怒らないでくださいねあさひさん
lines.translated: "Um, I'm going to say something a little rude, so please don't get mad, okay, Asahi-san?"

lines.content: ん？　ああ、いいぞ。何でも言ってみるといい
lines.translated: "Hm? Oh, sure. Go ahead and say whatever's on your mind."

lines.content: 私は君の何十倍も長生きしてるお姉さんだから。この町に暮らす[・|猫]は長生きなんだ。多少のことなら我慢できるぞ
lines.translated: "I'm an older lady who's lived dozens of times longer than you, after all. The *cats* living in this town have long lifespans. I can put up with a little bit of teasing."

lines.content: そう言ってあさひさんは胸を張るような仕草を見せた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Asahi-san puffed out her chest with pride.

lines.content: だけど、いいか？　口さがなさ過ぎたらいかにお姉さんとは言っても傷ついちゃうくらいのことはあるかもしれない。そこら辺は考慮しつつ、よろしくな
lines.translated: "However, listen up, okay? If you're too sharp-tongued, even an older lady like me might get her feelings hurt a little. Keep that in mind, alright?"

lines.content: 俺はそんなあさひさんに笑いかけながら、言った。
lines.translated: Smiling at Asahi-san, I spoke.

lines.content: さすがは、あさひさん。“夜の魔法使い”です。厨二病をこじらせてるだけはある。なんだか聞いてるこっちが恥ずかしくなってきました
lines.translated: "Leave it to you, Asahi-san, the 'Magician of the Night.' You really have a terminal case of chuunibyou. Just listening to you is making me feel embarrassed on your behalf."

lines.content: ふん。なんだよ。厨二病、言うな。……一言多いな。イヤな奴だ。やっぱりちょっとだけ、傷ついちゃったぞ
lines.translated: "Hmph. What's your deal? Don't call it chuunibyou. ...You always have to say one thing too many. What a mean kid. See, you actually did hurt my feelings a little."

lines.content: つんとするあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san turned her nose up in a huff.

lines.content: だけどその横顔はむしろ得意そうなふうにも見えた。
lines.translated: And yet, from the side, her expression actually looked kind of proud.

lines.content: 陽向井あさひ。
lines.translated: Hinamukai Asahi.

lines.content: この町の魔法使い。
lines.translated: The magician of this town.
*The one who commands* "*magical girls*"...

lines.content: その“力”を、その“権限”を、“役割”を……。
lines.translated: That "power," that "authority," that "role"...

lines.content: 今日、俺は、このひとから譲り受ける。
lines.translated: Today, I am inheriting them from this person.
"'*Magic in the form of a girl*.' *Therefore*, a '*magical girl*.'"

lines.content: 君に彼女らの“力”を使う権限を与えよう――大雅。奏大雅。今日から君は、魔法使いならぬ、魔法少女『使い』だ
lines.translated: "I shall grant you the authority to wield their 'power'--Taiga. Kanade Taiga. Starting today, you are not a magician, but a Magical Girl 'Master.'"

lines.content: それがあさひさんから俺が受け取る、誕生日プレゼントだった。
lines.translated: That was the birthday present I received from Asahi-san.

lines.content: ……魔法少女。
lines.translated: Magical girls.

lines.content: やはり俺はその言葉をあまり好意的には受け取れない。
lines.translated: Even now, I can't bring myself to view that term very favorably.

lines.content: ああ。むしろ嫌悪しているとさえ言っていい。
lines.translated: Yeah. In fact, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say I loathe it.

lines.content: 嫌悪しているのは何もできない自分自身。
lines.translated: What I loathe is my own powerless self.

lines.content: そんな事実を思い出さされてしまうから。
lines.translated: Because those words force me to remember that very fact.

lines.content: しかしあさひさんが[・|彼][・|女][・|た][・|ち]に送ったその言葉は、人々が一般的に抱いているだろう共通認識のイメージとは、若干のずれがある。
lines.translated: However, the title Asahi-san bestowed upon *them* differs slightly from the common image people generally hold.

lines.content: 私たちの関係は“拳銃”と“弾丸”に良くよく似ている
lines.translated: "Our relationship closely resembles a 'handgun' and a 'bullet.'"

lines.content: あさひさんが静かに言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke quietly.

lines.content: [私|魔法使い]が、“弾丸”に秘められた能力を解き放つための“拳銃”で、[彼女|魔法少女]らが、強大な破壊力をその身に秘めた“弾丸”だ……
lines.translated: "I, the magician, am the 'handgun' that unleashes the power hidden within the 'bullet,' and they, the magical girls, are the 'bullets' carrying immense destructive force within themselves..."

lines.content: この世界の“魔法少女”とは、[それ|少女]そのものが、私たち“夜の魔法使い”の使役する“魔法”となる
lines.translated: "In this world, a 'magical girl' is a girl who herself becomes the 'magic' wielded by us 'Magicians of the Night.'"

lines.content: 故に。私の“役割”は、正確に言えば“魔法使い”ではない。少女の形をした魔法――つまり、魔法少女。その力を使役する存在。魔法使いならぬ、“魔法少女『使い』”といったところだ
lines.translated: "Therefore, strictly speaking, my 'role' is not that of a 'magician.' Magic in the form of a girl--in other words, a magical girl. I am an existence that commands that power. Not a magician, but rather a 'Magical Girl Master,' so to speak."

lines.content: そしてその“役割”の根源である“[・|夜]”を、今、君の左手に託した。大雅。君がずっと望んでいた通りにな
lines.translated: "And now, I have entrusted the '*Night*,' the very root of that 'role,' to your left hand. Taiga. Just as you've wished for all along."

lines.content: 俺は、自分の手を見つめている。
lines.translated: I stared down at my own hand.

lines.content: “拳銃”と“弾丸”。そして“[・|夜]”
lines.translated: A "handgun" and a "bullet." And the "*Night*."

lines.content: それらを付与され、託されたらしいこの左手を……見つめる。
lines.translated: I stared... at this left hand of mine, to which those things had apparently been granted and entrusted.

lines.content: 思い出すのは十年前の出来事だ。
lines.translated: What came to mind were the events of ten years ago.

lines.content: 誰もが深い眠りにつく夜の時間――人知れず、人類の存亡をかけた戦いがあった。
lines.translated: During the hours of the night when everyone falls into a deep sleep--unbeknownst to the world, there was a battle fought for the survival of humanity.

lines.content: それは幾人かの魔法少女たちと、かつてない最大の“[・|悪][・|夢]”、“夜の王”との戦争だった。
lines.translated: It was a war between several magical girls and the greatest "*Nightmare*" the world had ever seen, the "King of the Night."

lines.content: 『“魔法”によく似た不思議な力を使い戦う女の子をなんと呼ぶ？　魔法少女だ。それ以外に相応しい言葉などどこにもない。そう思うだろ？』
lines.translated: "'What do you call a girl who fights using a mysterious power much like "magic"? A magical girl. There's no other term more fitting anywhere. Don't you think so?'"

lines.content: 過去。在りし日のこと。あさひさんは集められた少女たちにそう言った。
lines.translated: In the past. In days gone by. Asahi-san had said those words to the girls who had been gathered together.
"*A story to shoot through the future of humanity's ruin*"--

lines.content: その結末を完全なる勝利で飾った少女たちは、一人ひとり、報酬を得た。
lines.translated: Having graced the conclusion of that story with a complete victory, the girls each received a reward, one by one.

lines.content: それは“特別な魔法”だった。
lines.translated: It was "special magic."

lines.content: 彼女ら専用の“最後の魔法”
lines.translated: The "final magic" meant exclusively for them.

lines.content: その“魔法”の効果は、彼女たち自身の“夢”を叶えるというものである。
lines.translated: The effect of that "magic" was to grant their own personal "dreams."

lines.content: 魔法少女は“夢”と“希望”を抱いて戦う存在であるべきで……。
lines.translated: Magical girls are meant to be beings who fight while holding onto "dreams" and "hope"...

lines.content: この町の彼女らもまた、人々の“夢”と“希望”を、“魔法少女”らしく命がけで護ったのだ。
lines.translated: And the girls of this town, too, risked their lives like true "magical girls" to protect the "dreams" and "hopes" of the people.

lines.content: そして、人類の破滅を阻止するための物語は終わり……エピローグ。
lines.translated: And so, the story to prevent the ruin of humanity came to an end... followed by the epilogue.

lines.content: 次は、大勢の人々のためではない、自分自身の願いを叶えるため――
lines.translated: Next, not for the sake of the masses, but to fulfill their own personal wishes--

lines.content: 今度は、少女たち個人個人の物語をハッピーエンドに導くそのために。
lines.translated: This time, to guide each individual girl's story to a happy ending.

lines.content: エピローグから先の時間は、存在していくはずだった。
lines.translated: The time beyond the epilogue was supposed to exist for that very purpose.

lines.content: “特別な魔法”
lines.translated: "Special magic."

lines.content: “最後の魔法”
lines.translated: "The final magic."

lines.content: しかし、その“魔法”は、未だ使用されることなく少女たちの中に在る。
lines.translated: Yet that "magic" still remains within the girls, unused to this day.

lines.content: [・|理][・|由][・|あ][・|っ][・|て]“特別な魔法”を使う機会を奪われたまま、十年……。
lines.translated: Robbed of the chance to use their "special magic" *for a certain reason*, ten years have passed...

lines.content: 少女たちは確かに最大の“悪夢”、“夜の王”との戦いには勝利したけれど。
lines.translated: The girls certainly won their battle against the greatest "Nightmare," the "King of the Night."

lines.content: だけど、少女たちは自らの人生に横たわる“[困難|悪夢]”とは、今もまだ戦い続けている。
lines.translated: And yet, even now, the girls are still fighting against the "nightmares"--the *hardships*--that lie across their own lives.
*Their fight, the war that began ten years ago, is still far from over.*

lines.content: 大雅。[・|私][・|は][・|君][・|を][・|選][・|ん][・|だ]。君が十年前の戦いにピリオドを打ってほしい
lines.translated: "Taiga. *I chose you.* I want you to put a period at the end of the battle from ten years ago."

lines.content: あさひさんは俺を見つめている。
lines.translated: Asahi-san looked straight at me.

lines.content: 彼女らに秘められた“最後の魔法”を使い、彼女らがその胸に閉じ込めた“夢”を叶える――そのための機会を、力を、私の代わりに彼女らに与えてあげてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "To use the 'final magic' hidden within them, and grant the 'dreams' they've locked away in their hearts--in my stead, I want you to give them the opportunity and the power to do that."

lines.content: 改めよう。君は力を解放するための“拳銃”で、少女たちは、困難ばかりの現実を撃ち抜くための“弾丸”だ……
lines.translated: "Let me rephrase it. You are the 'handgun' to unleash their power, and the girls are the 'bullets' meant to shoot through a reality filled with nothing but hardship..."

lines.content: “拳銃”と“弾丸”
lines.translated: A "handgun" and a "bullet."

lines.content: どちらが欠けても効果を発揮することはかなわない。
lines.translated: If either one is missing, they cannot fulfill their purpose.

lines.content: 少女たちは自分の意思だけでは“[魔法|自分]”を使うことができない。[・|あ][・|る][・|特][・|別][・|な][・|場][・|所][・|以][・|外][・|で][・|は]
lines.translated: "The girls cannot use their magic--use *themselves*--by their own will alone. *Except in a certain special place.*"

lines.content: ……だけど今日からは違う。奏大雅。“魔法少女『使い』”として君が許可を与えるだけで、彼女たちは自由に“魔法”を使うことが可能になる。その“権限”を、君は得たんだ
lines.translated: "...But starting today, things are different. Kanade Taiga. Simply by you granting permission as their 'Magical Girl Master,' they will be able to use their 'magic' freely. You have obtained that 'authority.'"

lines.content: あさひさんは握っていた俺の手を離し、言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san let go of my hand, which she had been holding, and spoke.
"I am different from all of you. *I am not human. That is why I cannot understand the human heart.* And because of that, I could not draw out their power completely..."

lines.content: 大雅。お願いだ
lines.translated: "Taiga. Please."

lines.content: 彼女らが心に秘めた“最後の魔法”を上手に使い、彼女らの人生を、最高のハッピーエンドに導いてあげて欲しいんだ
lines.translated: "I want you to skillfully guide the 'final magic' hidden in their hearts, and lead their lives to the absolute best happy ending."

lines.content: ……改めて、言う。私にはその“役割”を上手に果たすことができないから
lines.translated: "...I'll say it again. Because I cannot fulfill that 'role' well myself."
"As for the method to do so... *it is just as I thoroughly explained to all of you ten years ago, on that night of the full moon.*"
"*It comes down to 'magic,' 'compensation,' and 'relationships.'* There is nothing more I need to teach you at this point."

lines.content: だけど……わかってるよな、大雅
lines.translated: "However... you understand, don't you, Taiga?"

lines.content: 今日。その手に“夜”を付与されたからと言って、今の君ではまだ少女たちの“魔法”を引き出せない。[・|準][・|備][・|が][・|足][・|り][・|な][・|い]
lines.translated: "Just because the 'Night' was granted to your hand today doesn't mean the current you can draw out the girls' 'magic' yet. *You aren't sufficiently prepared.*"

lines.content: それを可能とするために、君にはこれからたくさんの困難があるかもしれない。それを思うと……やっぱり、私は君にすべてを背負わせることが不安でならないんだ
lines.translated: "In order to make that possible, you may face many hardships from here on out. When I think about that... I really can't help feeling anxious about making you shoulder everything."

lines.content: 苦笑いのあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 俺は沈黙を返すしかできないでいる。
lines.translated: All I could do was return her words with silence.

lines.content: 君に“[・|夜][・|の][・|力]”を渡すのは気が進まない。どころか、なんだか不安で、心配で、気が気でないっていうのが正直なところだよ
lines.translated: "I'm reluctant to hand the '*Power of the Night*' over to you. In fact, to be completely honest, I feel so anxious and worried that I'm beside myself."

lines.content: ……それは君のことを信頼していないというわけではなくて。なんて、言うのかな。ほら、年上の女っていうのはさ、いつもこうしてかわいい子のことを心配していたいだけのことなんだ
lines.translated: "...It's not that I don't trust you. How should I put it? Come on, an older woman just always wants to fuss and worry over a cute kid like this, that's all."

lines.content: そうは言っても、結果的には君にこの“役割”を担って貰えるようにとお願いしなければならないのも、また、私は自分が情けなくも思えてしまうのだけど……
lines.translated: "Even so, the fact that I ultimately have to ask you to take on this 'role' makes me feel pretty pathetic about myself, too..."

lines.content: あさひさんはひとつだけため息をついた後、にこりと笑った。
lines.translated: After letting out a single sigh, Asahi-san offered a warm smile.

lines.content: まあ、その交換条件、というのもおかしな話かもしれないが……それでもとにかく、大雅もここで一緒に暮らしてくれることになったんだよな。君に“力”を渡す代わりの条件だよ
lines.translated: "Well, calling it a condition in exchange might sound a bit strange, though... Regardless, it's been decided that you'll be living here together with us too, Taiga. That's the condition in exchange for handing the 'power' over to you."

lines.content: 俺は少し目を伏せてしまう。あさひさんの笑顔を前に。
lines.translated: Faced with Asahi-san's smile, I lowered my gaze slightly.

lines.content: そして俺は、自分の左手を見つめようとした。
lines.translated: And then, I turned my eyes toward my own left hand.

lines.content: “魔法”と“代償”、そして“関係性”
lines.translated: "Magic," "compensation," and "relationships."

lines.content: そういった不思議が宿された左手を。
lines.translated: The left hand in which such mysteries now dwelled.

lines.content: 今、この手のひらには、かつて“魔法少女”たちが思い描いた“夢”を叶える――そのための“権限”が、“[・|夜]”が、付与されているのだ。
lines.translated: Right now, in the palm of this hand, the "authority"--the "*Night*"--to grant the "dreams" once envisioned by the "magical girls" had been bestowed.

lines.content: 彼女らが強く望んだ“最後の魔法”
lines.translated: The "final magic" they had wished for so strongly.

lines.content: 彼女らの“夢”は何なのか。そこにあったはずの“希望”とはなんだったのか。
lines.translated: What were their "dreams"? And what was the "hope" that was supposed to be there?

lines.content: 幼馴染みだからといって。
lines.translated: Just because we're childhood friends.

lines.content: 親友、だからといって……。
lines.translated: Just because we're best friends...

lines.content: 当然。彼女らの抱える問題をすべて知っていられるわけではない。
lines.translated: Naturally, that doesn't mean I know all the problems they're carrying.
*It comes down to "relationships."*

lines.content: それこそが“魔法”を使うための“鍵”となる。
lines.translated: That is the very "key" to using their "magic."
*I have to be the one to open up their hearts.*

lines.content: あさひさんにできなかったことを成さねばならない。
lines.translated: I have to accomplish what Asahi-san could not.

lines.content: （十年前。俺は、何の役にも立てなかった。むしろ足を引っ張るような存在でしかなった。……護られてばかりだった）
lines.translated: (Ten years ago, I couldn't be of any use at all. In fact, I was nothing more than dead weight... I was always the one being protected.)

lines.content: だけどこれからは、少しだけでもいい。みんなの役に立てたなら。
lines.translated: But from now on, even if it's just a little bit... If I can be of use to everyone.

lines.content: （世界を救ったみんなを、今度は、俺が少しでも助けられたなら……）
lines.translated: (If I can help everyone who saved the world, even just a little, this time around...)

lines.content: ――その果てにこそ、
lines.translated: --Only at the very end of that path,

lines.content: ――俺の“夢”は、
lines.translated: --will my "dream"...

lines.content: 『“人はみんな[・|誰][・|か]になりたい”――ねえ、君はいったい、どんな[・|誰][・|か]になりたいと願う？』
lines.translated: "'Everyone wants to become *someone*'--hey, what kind of *someone* do you wish to become?"

lines.content: 心でそっと、ため息をつき……、
lines.translated: Letting out a quiet sigh in my heart...

lines.content: （どこだ。ヒーローは、どこにいる……）
lines.translated: (Where is he? Where is the hero...?)

lines.content: ふらりとした。
lines.translated: I swayed slightly.

lines.content: めまいだ。
lines.translated: A wave of dizziness.

lines.content: そんな重いばかりの頭を抱えようとしたけれど、
lines.translated: I tried to cradle my painfully heavy head, but...

lines.content: ……クロがそっと、俺の手を握ってくれていた。
lines.translated: Kuro was gently holding my hand.

lines.content: いつの間に……。
lines.translated: Since when...?

lines.content: 気づかなかった。
lines.translated: I hadn't noticed.

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: 名前を呼んでもふいっとそっぽを向いて、こっちを見てはくれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even when I called her name, she abruptly looked away and wouldn't meet my eyes...

lines.content: だけど、いつの間にか繋がれた手を、クロは離そうとしなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, Kuro didn't try to let go of the hand she had somehow intertwined with mine.

lines.content: 気づけばめまいもなくなっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the dizziness had vanished, too.

lines.content: 君がこうして側にいてくれるから、俺は……。
lines.translated: Because you stay by my side like this, I...

lines.content: 俺は、小さな手を握り返す。
lines.translated: I squeezed her small hand back.

lines.content: 伝えられないたくさんの言葉を心に隠した。
lines.translated: I hid all the countless words I couldn't convey deep inside my heart.

lines.content: （手と手を繋げば、心も一緒に繋がれば良いのに……）
lines.translated: (I wish our hearts could connect together just by holding hands like this...)

lines.content: ふとため息を落とすように、そんなことを思った。
lines.translated: The thought crossed my mind like a sudden sigh.

lines.content: 沈黙があった。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: ほんの僅かな沈黙だ。
lines.translated: It was a very brief silence.

lines.content: クロは俺と手を繋いだまま、うつむいて。
lines.translated: Still holding my hand, Kuro looked down.

lines.content: あさひさんはラムネの瓶に浮かんだ水滴を、指先でぬぐうように撫でいる。
lines.translated: Asahi-san was tracing her fingertips over the condensation on her ramune bottle, wiping the droplets away.

lines.content: 俺は、忘れられないいつかの日の誓いを思い……。
lines.translated: And I remembered the unforgettable vow from that distant day...

lines.content: 僅かであったはずのその静けさが、少しずつ重さを持ち始めたところで――
lines.translated: Just as that supposedly brief quietude began to grow heavy, little by little--

lines.content: う～……お姉ちゃん、どこ？　そこにいる？　私お腹すいちゃったよ……
lines.translated: "Uuu... Big Sis, where are you? Are you in there? I'm getting hungry..."

lines.content: ――扉を開く音と、かわいい小さな声がした。
lines.translated: --I heard the sound of a door opening, accompanied by a cute little voice.

lines.content: ちょっと、驚く。
lines.translated: It startled me a bit.

lines.content: パッと弾かれたように、俺はクロと手を離してしまう。
lines.translated: As if repelled by a spring, I reflexively let go of Kuro's hand.

lines.content: そして振り返る。
lines.translated: And then I turned around.

lines.content: そこにいたのは小さな黒髪の女の子。
lines.translated: Standing there was a small girl with black hair.

lines.content: お店のフロアと、生活空間である奥座敷とを繋ぐ扉。
lines.translated: The door connecting the shop floor to the back parlor, which served as their living space.

lines.content: それを開いて顔を出していた。
lines.translated: She had opened it and was peeking her face out.

lines.content: ……お昼寝でもしていたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had she been taking an afternoon nap?

lines.content: こしこしと[まぶた|瞼]を擦っている。
lines.translated: She was rubbing her eyelids sleepily.

lines.content: ねえねえお姉ちゃん、お菓子、食べてもいい？　お夕飯残さないから……
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Big Sis, can I eat some sweets? I promise I'll finish all my dinner..."

lines.content: んん～。そうだなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm~ Let's see."

lines.content: どうしようか、とあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: "What should we do about that?" Asahi-san mused.

lines.content: [とおや|十夜]。この前も同じようなこと言って、ご飯残しちゃってたからなあ
lines.translated: "Toya. You said the exact same thing the other day and ended up leaving food on your plate, didn't you?"

lines.content: そ、そう、だったっけ……
lines.translated: "D-Did I really...?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ。忘れたのか？　お菓子食べすぎてお腹いっぱいだって言ってさ。どうしても入らないってぐずってたじゃないか
lines.translated: "Yeah, you did. Did you forget? You said you ate too many sweets and your stomach was full. You were fussing about how you couldn't eat another bite, remember?"

lines.content: うー……
あの日のお姉ちゃん、とっても悲しかったんだぞ。せっかくかわいい妹のためにと思ってさ、がんばって美味しいの作ったのに
lines.translated: "Big Sis was super sad that day, you know. And after I worked so hard to make something delicious just for my cute little sister, too."

lines.content: あのときは……
lines.translated: "Back then..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせ、もにょもにょとしながらそう言った。
lines.translated: She pouted her lips and mumbled her apology.

lines.content: あの日の私は。あのときの、妹は……ちょっとだけ悪い子だったかも、だけど……だ、だけどね？　今日は大丈夫。大丈夫、なんだよ……？
lines.translated: "The me on that day... your little sister back then... might have been a little bit of a bad girl, maybe... B-But you know? Today will be fine. I'll really be fine, okay...?"

lines.content: 十夜と呼ばれた女の子は『ほんとにほんとに、大丈夫だよ？』と、あさひさんを上目で見つめながら言っていた。
lines.translated: The girl called Toya looked up at Asahi-san with pleading eyes, adding, "Really, truly, I'll be fine, okay?"

lines.content: 寝起きだからなのか、あそこからこちらが見えていないからなのか――
lines.translated: Whether it was because she was still half-asleep, or because she couldn't see us from over there--

lines.content: たぶん、あの子は俺たちのことに気づいていないんじゃないだろうか。
lines.translated: That girl probably hadn't noticed us yet.

lines.content: そう思ったから――
lines.translated: Thinking that--

lines.content: うう～、ほんとにお腹すいたんだよお姉ちゃん。ねえねえ、だったら今日は？　今日のお夕飯ってどんな――
lines.translated: "Uuu~, I'm really, truly hungry, Big Sis. Hey, hey, what about today, then? What's for dinner toni--"

lines.content: やあ。こんにちは
lines.translated: "Hey there. Hello."

lines.content: ――そこで俺は手を上げる。
lines.translated: --I raised my hand right then.

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: ぴたりと、停止。
lines.translated: She froze completely in place.

lines.content: おはよう。眠そうだな十夜。お昼寝してたのかな。ああ～、うん。なんだか俺もお腹すいてきたなあ
lines.translated: "Good morning. You look sleepy, Toya. Were you taking a nap? Ahh~, yeah. Somehow I'm starting to get hungry, too."

lines.content: ぱちぱちと[まぶた|瞼]をしばたいて、固まる。
lines.translated: She blinked her eyes rapidly and stiffened.

lines.content: 十夜？
lines.translated: "Toya?"

lines.content: どうした？　と、俺は首をかしげるけれど。
lines.translated: "What's wrong?" I tilted my head, wondering.

lines.content: 少女はみるみる顔を青くして――
lines.translated: The girl's face turned pale right before my eyes--

lines.content: ひうっ
lines.translated: "Eek!"

lines.content: ――飛び上がる。
lines.translated: --And she jumped in the air.

lines.content: そして、やって来た奥の部屋に飛び込んでしまった。転がり込むようにして。
lines.translated: Then, she dove straight back into the inner room she had just come out of, practically tumbling inside.

lines.content: その様子に隣のクロも驚き、飛び上がっていた。
lines.translated: Startled by her reaction, Kuro jumped right beside me as well.

lines.content: 更にぴったりとクロは俺に身体を寄せてくる。
lines.translated: She pressed herself even closer against my side.

lines.content: ど、どうして、大雅がいるの……っ
lines.translated: "W-Why is Taiga here...?!"

lines.content: バタンと閉じられた扉の向こうから声がする。
lines.translated: Her voice echoed from behind the door she had just slammed shut.

lines.content: お、お姉ちゃぁん、約束が違うよ……っ
lines.translated: "B-Big Siiis, this isn't what you promised...!"

lines.content: ん？　約束……、って、なんだったっけ
lines.translated: "Hm? Promised...? Wait, what was that again?"

lines.content: もうっ、大雅が来るならちゃんと教えておいてって言ってたのに……っ
lines.translated: "Geez! I told you to make sure to warn me beforehand if Taiga was coming over...!"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: どうしよぅ……やだよぉ……髪、ぼさぼさだし、あくびも見られたかもだし……、お腹鳴ったの、聞こえたかも……、うぅ、格好悪いよぅ……っ
lines.translated: "What do I dooo... Nooo... My hair is a complete mess, and he might've seen me yawning... and maybe he even heard my stomach growling... Uuu, this is so embarrassing...!"

lines.content: ぶつぶつとそんな声が聞こえてきていた。
lines.translated: We could hear her muttering all of that from the other side.

lines.content: 俺、来なかった方が……
lines.translated: "Maybe I shouldn't have come..."

lines.content: 何を言ってるんだ。そんなわけない
lines.translated: "What are you talking about? Of course not."

lines.content: あさひさんは首を振る。
lines.translated: Asahi-san shook her head.

lines.content: この頃あの子は、私のかわいい妹は、ちょっと……ほら、あれだよ。お年頃ってやつなんだよ
lines.translated: "Lately, that girl--my cute little sister--has been a bit... well, you know. She's at that age."

lines.content: 特に大雅には隙を見せたりしたくないんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "I bet she especially doesn't want to let her guard down around you, Taiga."

lines.content: 俺に？　隙を？　どうして……？
lines.translated: "Around me? Let her guard down? Why...?"

lines.content: さあ、どうしてかなあ。きっと格好付けたいのさ。お年頃っていうのはそういうことだろう？
lines.translated: "Who knows why? She probably just wants to look cool in front of you. Isn't that what being at that age is all about?"

lines.content: そう、なんですかね……？
lines.translated: "Is... that how it works...?"

lines.content: よくわからないが、とりあえずうなずいておいた。
lines.translated: I didn't really get it, but I nodded for the time being.

lines.content: ああ。あの子、最近なんだか外の世界から色々なことを覚えて帰ってくるんだよ。十夜がどんどんおませな子になっていっててさ。姉としてはそれなりに気を遣って大変なんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Lately, she's been picking up all sorts of things from the outside world and bringing them home with her. Toya is growing more and more precocious by the day. As her older sister, having to walk on eggshells around her takes quite a bit of effort, you know."

lines.content: 苦笑いであさひさんは肩をすくめる。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a wry smile and shrugged her shoulders.

lines.content: 十夜。そろそろそこを開けてくれないかな。そのままじゃ台所へ行けないよ。これからお夕飯を作らないといけないし
lines.translated: "Toya. Could you open the door for me soon? I can't get to the kitchen like that. And I need to start making dinner now."

lines.content: 扉が薄らと開いた。
lines.translated: The door cracked open ever so slightly.

lines.content: ううー……
そこから渋々といったふうに顔を出す。
lines.translated: She reluctantly poked her face out from the crack.

lines.content: こんにちは、十夜
lines.translated: "Hello, Toya."

lines.content: 驚かせないよう、できる限りやさしく言ったつもりだった。
lines.translated: I tried to say it as gently as possible so I wouldn't startle her.

lines.content: しかし、十夜は駆け足であさひさんの背中に隠れてしまった。
lines.translated: However, Toya scurried over and hid behind Asahi-san's back.

lines.content: うーん。
lines.translated: Hmm.

lines.content: おかしいな。
lines.translated: That's strange.

lines.content: この前会ったときは、もっと懐いてくれていたはずなのになあ。
lines.translated: She was much more warmed up to me the last time we met.

lines.content: やっぱり俺、来ない方がよかっただろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe I really shouldn't have come after all.

lines.content: そんなことを思っていたが――
lines.translated: Just as I was thinking that--

lines.content: 十夜が恐る恐るという具合に、あさひさんの背中から顔を半分だけ出して、
lines.translated: Toya timidly peeked half of her face out from behind Asahi-san's back.

lines.content: ……こんにちは
lines.translated: "...Hello."

lines.content: 俺に小さくちいさくそれだけ言うと、
lines.translated: After murmuring just that in a tiny, quiet voice,

lines.content: っ
また、あさひさんの背中に隠れてしまった。
lines.translated: she hid right back behind Asahi-san again.

lines.content: ああ、こんにちは。十夜。急に来て、ごめんね
lines.translated: "Yeah, hello, Toya. Sorry for dropping by so suddenly."

lines.content: んんん～っ、そ、そうじゃなくてぇ……
lines.translated: "Nnnn~, th-that's not it..."

lines.content: 首を横に振る。
lines.translated: She shook her head.

lines.content: あさひさんの背中にごしごしと、顔を押し付けるようにして。
lines.translated: She rubbed her face against Asahi-san's back, pressing herself into it.

lines.content: 違うよ。大雅。ご、誤解しないで？　お願い。別に、大雅がいやなんじゃ、なくて……
lines.translated: "That's not it, Taiga. D-Don't get the wrong idea, okay? Please. It's not that I don't want you here, Taiga..."

lines.content: そう？
lines.translated: "Yeah?"

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 恥ずかしいとこ、見られたのが……恥ずかしくって……うう……死にそうだよお……お姉ちゃん……
lines.translated: "It's just... you saw me at an embarrassing moment, and I'm so mortified... Uuu... I feel like I'm gonna die... Big Sis..."

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: 違うのか。
lines.translated: So that wasn't it.

lines.content: 嫌われたのかなあと思ってた。
lines.translated: Here I thought she had come to dislike me.

lines.content: それはともすれば仕方のないことだけど……。
lines.translated: Which might have been unavoidable in a way, I suppose...
Even knowing that things are bound to turn out that way someday...

lines.content: だけどやっぱり悲しいことだから。
lines.translated: It would still be sad, after all.

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: 違うとわかって、安心した。
lines.translated: So I was relieved to know I had it wrong.

lines.content: ……少し人見知りの女の子。[ふゆつき|冬月][とおや|十夜]。
lines.translated: A slightly shy girl. Fuyutsuki Toya.

lines.content: 名字は違うがあさひさんとは姉妹だ。
lines.translated: Though their last names are different, she and Asahi-san are sisters.

lines.content: 十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: 男の子っぽい名前にほんの少し、コンプレックス。
lines.translated: She has a tiny bit of a complex about her boyish-sounding name.

lines.content: もっとかわいい名前がよかったと。
lines.translated: She wishes she had a cuter one.

lines.content: まさにお年頃というやつなのだ。
lines.translated: She really is right at that age.

lines.content: ……そんな、ちょっとだけ背伸びを覚え始めた少女は言う。
lines.translated: Having just started trying to act a little more grown-up, the girl spoke.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんの背中に顔を押しつけて。
lines.translated: Her face still pressed against her sister's back.

lines.content: お姉ちゃん……大雅、今日は、どうして来てくれたの？　お姉ちゃんと私と、遊びに……？
lines.translated: "Big Sis... Why did Taiga come over today? To hang out with you and me...?"

lines.content: え？　あー、うん。十夜。もしかして忘れてたのか？
lines.translated: "Huh? Ah, yeah. Toya, don't tell me you forgot?"

lines.content: 忘れ……？
lines.translated: "Forgot...?"

lines.content: ああ。今日は大雅の誕生日だぞ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. Today's Taiga's birthday, remember?"

lines.content: だからさ、三人でお祝いしようってずいぶん前にそう決めてたろ？
lines.translated: "We decided a long time ago that the three of us would celebrate it together, didn't we?"

lines.content: え、っと……えと、今日は……
lines.translated: "U-Umm... Let's see, today is..."

lines.content: 小さな両手の指を折りたたんだりしながら、真剣な表情で数えている。
lines.translated: With a serious expression, she began counting by folding down the fingers on her small hands.

lines.content: ハッとして、十夜はあさひさんを見上げた。
lines.translated: Gasping in realization, Toya looked up at Asahi-san.

lines.content: 大雅の、お誕生日……？
lines.translated: "It's Taiga's... birthday...?"

lines.content: 小首をかしげてそう言った。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly as she asked.

lines.content: ああ、そうだって言ったろ？　まさか数を数え間違えてたな？
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's what I just said, isn't it? Don't tell me you miscounted the days?"

lines.content: う、うううう～、そう、かも……
lines.translated: "U-Uuuuu~... I might have..."

lines.content: また、あさひさんの背後で小さく縮んだ。
lines.translated: She shrank back behind Asahi-san once again.

lines.content: だって、仕方ないよ。算数苦手なんだもん……
lines.translated: "I-I can't help it! I'm bad at math..."

lines.content: ……今度は真っ赤になって、もにょもにょとしていた。
lines.translated: This time she turned bright red, squirming and mumbling to herself.

lines.content: 恥ずかしい、とか。
lines.translated: Muttering about how embarrassing it was.

lines.content: 格好悪い、とか。
lines.translated: How uncool she looked.

lines.content: 明日だと思ってた、とか。
lines.translated: How she thought it was tomorrow.

lines.content: ……どうしよう。どうしようお姉ちゃん。大雅のプレゼント、私、まだ何も用意してないよ
lines.translated: "...What do I do? What do I do, Big Sis? I haven't gotten a present ready for Taiga yet..."

lines.content: そんなことを十夜が小さくもらすと……。
lines.translated: Just as Toya let that slip in a tiny voice...

lines.content: そのとき、奥間の方から音がした。
lines.translated: A sound echoed from the inner room.

lines.content: 柱時計の音だった。
lines.translated: It was the chime of the wall clock.

lines.content: ぼーん、ぼーんと、数回ほど。
lines.translated: Bong, bong, it tolled several times.

lines.content: その少々重苦しくもある音が鳴り終わらない内に、『ああ、そろそろか』とあさひさんが言った。
lines.translated: Before that somewhat heavy, somber sound had even finished ringing out, Asahi-san murmured, "Ah, it's just about time."

lines.content: そろそろ“夜”だ。私たちの時間だな
lines.translated: "'Night' is almost here. It's our time."

lines.content: そのせりふは特段、何かの合図だとか、“朝”と“夜”とを入れ替えるためのスイッチだとか。
lines.translated: Those words weren't meant to be any kind of special signal, nor a switch to swap "morning" and "night."

lines.content: そんなふうにして特別に設えられたものではもちろんなかった。
lines.translated: Of course, nothing of the sort had been specially set up.

lines.content: だが、あさひさんのその声を境に、室内が一気に暗くなったのだ。
lines.translated: Yet, right on the cue of Asahi-san's voice, the room plunged into darkness all at once.

lines.content: ……窓の外が夕焼け色に傾いていく。
lines.translated: Outside the window, the sky began to deepen into the colors of sunset.

lines.content: ……十夜。今夜もいつもみたいに、“夜”の町を見回ってきてくれるかな
lines.translated: "...Toya. Could you go patrol the 'Night' town tonight like usual?"

lines.content: ええええええ。今日もなの……？
lines.translated: "Ehhhhh? Today too...?"

lines.content: ああ、ごめんな。今夜もなんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, sorry. Tonight too."

lines.content: 何か異常がないか見回ってくれるだけいいんだよ。その間にお姉ちゃんはお夕飯の準備をしておくから
lines.translated: "You just need to look around and make sure nothing's out of the ordinary. Your big sister will get dinner ready while you're out."

lines.content: でも……でも……、外は嫌だよ。夜は……“[・|夜][・|の][・|国]”が始まる前は、少し怖いんだよ、お姉ちゃん……
lines.translated: "But... but... I don't wanna go outside. The night... right before the 'Night Realm' begins, it's a little scary, Big Sis..."

lines.content: もにょもにょとしていた。
lines.translated: She squirmed and fidgeted.

lines.content: ちらりちらりと、窓の外を見ている。
lines.translated: She kept stealing nervous glances out the window.

lines.content: “[・|迷][・|子]”がいたら大変だ。彼や彼女は誰かが見つけてあげないとお家に帰れない。そんな迷子を夜の外に連れ出すのがお姉ちゃん達の役割だ。そうだろ、十夜
lines.translated: "It'll be bad if there are any 'lost children' out there. If someone doesn't find them, those boys and girls won't be able to go home. Leading those lost children out of the night is our job. Right, Toya?"

lines.content: それは、そうかもだけど……
lines.translated: "Well, maybe, but..."

lines.content: でも、お姉ちゃん。いつも言ってるけど“夜”が始まる前は怖いんだよ。お化けみたいなのもいっぱいいて、変な人たちもいっぱいで。とっても怖いんだよ、お姉ちゃん……
lines.translated: "Still, Big Sis, like I always say, it's scary before the 'Night' starts. There are lots of ghost-like things out there, and lots of weird people. It's really scary, Big Sis..."

lines.content: ごめんな。いつも無理なお願いしてるのはわかってる
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I know I'm always asking too much of you."

lines.content: でもお姉ちゃん、お夕飯をつくらないといけないから……。
lines.translated: "But I have to make dinner..."

lines.content: 何度もあさひさんはごめんなと付け加える。
lines.translated: Asahi-san apologized again and again.

lines.content: 妹にばかり大変な思いを押しつけてごめんな。お姉ちゃんがもっと頼りになるお姉ちゃんだったらよかったんだけど
lines.translated: "I'm sorry for always pushing the hard stuff onto my little sister. I wish I could be a more reliable big sister for you."

lines.content: ううううう～
lines.translated: "Uuuuuu~"

lines.content: 十夜は涙目になっていた。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in Toya's eyes.

lines.content: 唇を強く結んでもいた。
lines.translated: She pressed her lips tightly together.

lines.content: 大丈夫
lines.translated: "It's okay."

lines.content: え？　大丈夫？
lines.translated: "Huh? It's okay?"

lines.content: ああ。今夜は俺も一緒に行くよ。ひとりじゃない。だからさ、たぶん、いつもよりは怖くないだろ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'll go with you tonight. You won't be alone. So it probably won't be as scary as usual, right?"

lines.content: 十夜は何も言わず目をぱちくりとさせていた。
lines.translated: Toya just blinked in surprise without saying a word.

lines.content: ……嫌がられるかなと覚悟はしていた。
lines.translated: I had braced myself for the possibility that she wouldn't want me to.

lines.content: 何せお年頃な女の子だ。
lines.translated: After all, she's a girl at that delicate age.

lines.content: 気むずかしくて、当然。
lines.translated: It's only natural for her to be difficult to please.

lines.content: そう思っていた。
lines.translated: Or so I thought.

lines.content: だけど、十夜は。
lines.translated: However, Toya replied.

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 意外にも、というのか。
lines.translated: Surprisingly enough, I suppose.

lines.content: わかった……。わかったよ
lines.translated: "Okay... I got it."

lines.content: 渋々という具合に、うなずいた。
lines.translated: She gave a reluctant little nod.

lines.content: 大雅が一緒なら……だったら、いいよ。ひとりじゃないなら、ふたりなら、今夜も見回り……行けるかも
lines.translated: "If you're with me, Taiga... then okay. If I'm not alone, and it's the two of us... I think I can go on patrol tonight."

lines.content: その答えにちょっとだけ驚いた。
lines.translated: Her answer caught me slightly off guard.

lines.content: 驚いたけど。
lines.translated: Still, despite my surprise,

lines.content: 俺は十夜に笑顔を見せて、言った。
lines.translated: I gave Toya a smile and spoke.

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。ふたり一緒なら、ひとりだとちょっと怖いことでも全然平気だよな
lines.translated: "Yeah, you're right. As long as the two of us are together, even things that are a little scary alone won't be a problem at all."

lines.content: 俺の言葉に『うん、そうなんだよ』と言ってうなずく十夜。
lines.translated: At my words, Toya nodded and said, "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちじゃできないことでも、ふたりなら……全然平気、なんだよね？
lines.translated: "Even things I can't do all by myself... if it's the two of us, it'll be totally fine, right?"

lines.content: 微笑んで小首をかしげるような仕草。
lines.translated: She smiled and tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: ……よかった。
lines.translated: Thank goodness.

lines.content: 俺は内心ため息をつく。
lines.translated: I breathed an inward sigh of relief.

lines.content: 人見知りなこの妹は大変だ。
lines.translated: Dealing with this shy little sister is no easy task.

lines.content: 少し会わない時間が続くと、すぐにまたもじもじとした態度に戻ってしまう。
lines.translated: Whenever we go a little while without seeing each other, she goes right back to fidgeting nervously around me.

lines.content: まるで三日留守にしたくらいで飼い主の顔を忘れてしまい、びくびくと物陰に隠れてしまう飼い猫のようだ。
lines.translated: She's just like a house cat that forgets its owner's face after they've been away for three days, timidly hiding behind furniture.

lines.content: でも俺は人見知りと話すのには慣れている。
lines.translated: Still, I'm used to talking to shy girls.

lines.content: クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: 十夜と話している俺の隣で、とっても不満そうな顔をしていた。
lines.translated: Standing beside me while I talked with Toya, she had a very dissatisfied look on her face.

lines.content: 無表情だが……目を少し細めているその雰囲気は、今の彼女はちょっと不機嫌なのだと俺にはわかるのだ。
lines.translated: Her face was expressionless, yet... from the way her eyes were slightly narrowed, I could tell she was in a bit of a bad mood right now.

lines.content: よければクロも一緒に
lines.translated: "You can come with us too if you'd like, Kuro."

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: そっぽを向かれた。
lines.translated: She turned her head away.

lines.content: やっぱり何か不機嫌そうだった。
lines.translated: Yep, definitely in a bad mood about something.

lines.content: やはり“夜”には俺と十夜のふたりで行くしかないようだ。
lines.translated: Looks like Toya and I will have to go into the "Night" with just the two of us after all.

lines.content: ……だからこそ十夜に関しては、とにかく、よかった。
lines.translated: Which is all the more reason I'm glad things went smoothly with Toya.

lines.content: 今回はいつもよりも早く打ち解けられたような気がする。
lines.translated: I feel like we warmed up to each other faster than usual this time.

lines.content: 代わりにクロのご機嫌を少し傾かせてしまったような気もしないでもないが……。
lines.translated: Though I can't shake the feeling that it came at the cost of souring Kuro's mood a little...

lines.content: 悪いな大雅。私たちの仕事をいつも手伝ってくれて……。手間をかけさせてしまって、ごめん
lines.translated: "Sorry about this, Taiga. You're always helping us out with our work... I feel bad for putting you through the trouble."

lines.content: いや。これくらい、別に手間でも何でもないですよ
lines.translated: "No, not at all. Something like this is no trouble to me."

lines.content: ちゃんとアルバイト代は出すからな。そこのところは心配するな。まあ、あまり期待されても困っちゃうけど
lines.translated: "I'll make sure to pay you properly for the part-time work, so don't worry about that. Well, though I'd be in a bind if you got your hopes up too high."

lines.content: ええー。大雅ばっかりずるいよお姉ちゃん。私だって、お小遣いほしい……
lines.translated: "Ehhhh? No fair, Taiga gets all the good stuff, Big Sis. I want an allowance too..."

lines.content: うん。そうだな。今月のお小遣いには色を付けておこうか。楽しみにしておくように
lines.translated: "Yeah, good point. Maybe I'll throw in a little extra for your allowance this month. Look forward to it."

lines.content: 姉と妹は指切りをして微笑み合っていた。
lines.translated: The two sisters linked pinkies in a promise and smiled at each other.

lines.content: よし。それじゃあ頼んだぞふたりとも。……帰ったらすぐにお夕飯、食べれるように準備しておくよ。ご褒美のおやつも待っているからな
lines.translated: "Alright. Counting on you two, then. ...I'll have dinner ready to eat as soon as you get back. And there's a special treat waiting for you as a reward, too."

lines.content: ……え？　ご褒美？　おやつ？
lines.translated: "...Huh? A reward? A treat?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: いつもお姉ちゃんのお願いを聞いてくれるいい子な妹にご褒美と思って。冷蔵庫に――
lines.translated: "I figured my good little sister who always listens to my requests deserved a reward. In the fridge--"

lines.content: っ
そこでぱたぱたと台所へ走っていく十夜。
lines.translated: Right then, Toya pattered off toward the kitchen at a run.

lines.content: あ、あっ、ああああ～っ
lines.translated: "Ah, ahh, ahhhhh~!"

lines.content: 声がする。
lines.translated: Her voice rang out.

lines.content: すごいっ、プリンだぁ……っ
lines.translated: "Amazing, it's pudding...!"

lines.content: 小さなカップを持って戻ってきた。
lines.translated: She came back holding a small cup.

lines.content: 見てみて大雅、ほら、プリンだよ！　これ、すごい美味しいやつっ
lines.translated: "Look, look, Taiga! See, it's pudding! This is the super delicious kind!"

lines.content: 大切な宝物を自慢するみたいに、両手で頭高くに掲げていた。
lines.translated: She held it high above her head with both hands, like she was showing off a precious treasure.

lines.content: うわぁ～い！　お姉ちゃんありがとう！　これだから妹はお姉ちゃんのことが大好きなんだよ！
lines.translated: "Yaay! Thank you, Big Sis! This is why your little sister loves you so much!"

lines.content: はしゃぐ。
lines.translated: She frolicked around.

lines.content: 元気一杯に。
lines.translated: Bursting with energy.

lines.content: その様子に頬が緩んだ。
lines.translated: Watching her made my cheeks relax into a smile.

lines.content: かわいいなあと思う。
lines.translated: She's so cute, I thought.

lines.content: 十夜は甘いものが……とりわけプリンが大好物だ。
lines.translated: Toya loves sweets... and pudding most of all.

lines.content: 思い出す。
lines.translated: Then I remembered.

lines.content: そういえば。
lines.translated: Come to think of it.

lines.content: 俺も、ケーキのお土産があったんだった
lines.translated: "I brought cake as a souvenir, too."

lines.content: えっ、ケーキっ！？
lines.translated: "Huh, cake!?"

lines.content: 目を輝かせる。
lines.translated: Her eyes sparkled.

lines.content: 俺の足下に飛びついて、
lines.translated: She practically threw herself at my feet, and...

lines.content: 大雅っ、ようこそおいでくださいましたっ
lines.translated: "Taiga, welcome to our humble abode!"

lines.content: 元気いっぱいにそう言った。
lines.translated: She declared with all the energy in the world.

lines.content: すごいよ、大雅、お姉ちゃん……っ、大雅のお誕生日は甘くて美味しい、すてきな日だねっ！
lines.translated: "This is amazing, Taiga, Big Sis...! Taiga's birthday is such a sweet, delicious, wonderful day!"

lines.content: さっきまでのおどおどした様子は、もうすっかりどこかへ行ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Her timid demeanor from just a moment ago had completely vanished into thin air.

lines.content: さて、十夜。さっそくだけど出かけようか。準備、できてる？
lines.translated: "Alright, Toya. Not to rush you, but shall we head out? Are you ready?"

lines.content: 大切な宝物を扱うみたいに、プリンとケーキを冷蔵庫に収めていた十夜。
lines.translated: Toya had been putting the pudding and cake away in the fridge, handling them like priceless treasures.

lines.content: 俺の呼びかけでぱたぱたと駆け寄ってきた。
lines.translated: At my call, she pattered back over to me.

lines.content: うん。おっけーだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. I'm good to go."

lines.content: リュックサックを背負っていた。
lines.translated: She was wearing a backpack.

lines.content: 小さな身体にはちょっと大きめの。
lines.translated: It was a little big for her small frame.

lines.content: 夜回りに必要な小道具が詰められている。
lines.translated: Inside, it was packed with all the little tools needed for the night patrol.

lines.content: 重くない？　と問いかけると、大丈夫と十夜は応える。
lines.translated: When I asked if it was heavy, Toya replied that she was fine.

lines.content: 大雅がいないときはいっつもひとりでやってることだもん。もう慣れてるよ
lines.translated: "I always do this by myself when you're not here, Taiga. I'm used to it by now."

lines.content: ちょっと足元をふらりとさせながらも、リュックをしっかり背負い直す――そして十夜は、ほらね平気でしょと言いたげに、鼻先をつんとしてみせる。
lines.translated: Even as she wobbled slightly on her feet, she hoisted the straps firmly back onto her shoulders--and then stuck her nose up in the air, as if to say, "See? Told you I'm fine."

lines.content: そっか。さすがだな。でも、手だけは繋いでおこうか
lines.translated: "I see. Impressive as always. Still, let's at least hold hands."

lines.content: 俺が差し出した手を十夜はそっと握った。
lines.translated: Toya gently took the hand I held out to her.

lines.content: 面倒なことはさっさと済ませておくのが一番だ。宿題とかと一緒だな。そしたら残りはたのしいことばっかりだよ
lines.translated: "It's best to get the tedious stuff out of the way quickly. Just like homework. That way, only the fun stuff is left for later."

lines.content: うん……。帰ったら一緒にご褒美食べようね大雅。それがきっと、大変な後に残った楽しいことだよね
lines.translated: "Yeah... Let's eat our rewards together when we get back, Taiga. That's definitely the fun stuff waiting for us after the hard work, right?"

lines.content: 玄関先にふたり並んで立った。
lines.translated: The two of us stood side by side at the front door.

lines.content: 十夜が首から提げたチェーンを胸元から取り出す。
lines.translated: Toya pulled out the chain hanging around her neck from beneath her collar.

lines.content: そこには銀色の鍵がぶら下がっている。
lines.translated: Dangling from it was a silver key.

lines.content: 受け取る。
lines.translated: I took it from her.

lines.content: それは、星々や月といった夜が彫刻してある骨董品だ。
lines.translated: It was an antique piece, engraved with motifs of the night like the moon and stars.

lines.content: 俺は鍵穴へとそれを差し込む。
lines.translated: I slipped it into the keyhole.

lines.content: かちゃりと小気味のいい音と共に、開錠。
lines.translated: With a satisfying click, the lock turned.
"Midnight Patrol."
"Collecting Nightmares."
"Searching for Lost Children."

lines.content: その目的を果たすそのため――
lines.translated: In order to fulfill those objectives--

lines.content: 俺は、ドアノブに手をかけた。
lines.translated: I placed my hand on the doorknob.

lines.content: 君は私と一緒にお留守番だな
lines.translated: "Looks like you'll be staying home with me."

lines.content: どうしようか迷っていたクロにあさひさんが言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke to Kuro, who had been hesitating over what to do.

lines.content: 君は鍵を持ってないだろう？　あれがなければ、あちら側とこちら側、自由に出入りすることができないんだ
lines.translated: "You don't have a key, right? Without that, you can't freely pass back and forth between that side and this one."

lines.content: もしも何かがあってはぐれてしまったりしたら大変だ。“夜”に閉じ込められてしまう
lines.translated: "If something happened and you got separated from them, it'd be bad. You'd end up trapped in the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 君の“鍵”はまた今度、作っておくからなとあさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: "I'll make a 'key' for you next time, okay?" Asahi-san added.

lines.content: クロは目を伏せしゅんとしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Kuro lowered her gaze, visibly deflating.

lines.content: ……俺以外の誰かにもわかるほどの反応で。
lines.translated: It was a reaction obvious enough that even someone other than me could tell how she felt.

lines.content: あ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Oh, right."

lines.content: そこで十夜は、思い出したようにあさひさんを振り返った。
lines.translated: Just then, Toya looked back at Asahi-san as if she'd suddenly remembered something.

lines.content: お姉ちゃん。冷蔵庫のプリン食べちゃ嫌だよ？　ちゃんと取っておいてね？
lines.translated: "Big Sis. Don't eat the pudding in the fridge, okay? Make sure you save it for me, okay?"

lines.content: む。わかってるよ。私が十夜にってお土産で買って帰ってきたものだぞ。私が食べちゃったら意味がない。ちゃんと取っておくさ
lines.translated: "Mmh. I know, I know. I bought that as a souvenir for you in the first place, Toya. There'd be no point if I ate it myself. I'll make sure to save it."

lines.content: ……あのね。お姉ちゃんは忘れっぽいから妹はとっても心配
lines.translated: "...Um, you see. Big Sis is really forgetful, so her little sister is super worried."

lines.content: あさひさんにではなく俺に向かって十夜はそう言っていた。
lines.translated: Toya directed that comment at me rather than Asahi-san.

lines.content: 本当に不安そうな顔つきで。
lines.translated: Wearing a genuinely anxious expression.

lines.content: さくっと済ませて帰ってこよう。プリンがなくなっちゃうその前に
lines.translated: "Let's wrap this up quick and get back. Before the pudding disappears."

lines.content: おー
lines.translated: "Yeah!"

lines.content: まったく。まあ、別にいいけどさ……
lines.translated: "Honestly. Well, whatever..."

lines.content: やれやれと首を振るあさひさんだったが、
lines.translated: Asahi-san shook her head in exasperation, but then...

lines.content: いいか、大雅。[・|何][・|が][・|あ][・|っ][・|て][・|も]無理だけはするなよ
lines.translated: "Listen to me, Taiga. No matter what happens, don't push yourself too hard."

lines.content: 俺の目をじっと見て、あさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: Looking straight into my eyes, Asahi-san spoke.

lines.content: 約束してほしい。“どんなことがあっても無茶はしない”“できるだけ無傷で帰ってくる”――大雅はすぐ、突っ走っては怪我をして帰ってくるから、心配なんだよ。とっても
lines.translated: "I want you to promise me. 'No matter what happens, I won't do anything reckless,' and 'I'll come back as unharmed as possible'--you always rush headlong into things and come back hurt, Taiga, so it worries me. A whole lot."

lines.content: 無理をしない。何があっても。
lines.translated: Don't push myself too hard. No matter what happens.

lines.content: 俺は頭の中でその注意を噛み締めるように何度か繰り返し、少し大げさなくらい深くうなずいて見せた。
lines.translated: I repeated her warning over and over in my head to let it sink in, then gave a slightly exaggerated, deep nod.

lines.content: わかりました。無理も、無茶も、絶対にしません
lines.translated: "I understand. I definitely won't push myself too hard, or do anything reckless."

lines.content: 約束だぞ？
lines.translated: "It's a promise, okay?"

lines.content: はい。約束、ですね
lines.translated: "Yes. A promise."

lines.content: あさひさんが顔の前に小指を立てて見せた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san held up her pinky finger in front of her face.

lines.content: 俺たちも真似する。
lines.translated: The two of us copied her.

lines.content: 直接指切りをすることはないけれど、しっかりと誓い合う。
lines.translated: We didn't actually link fingers, but we firmly exchanged our vow all the same.

lines.content: 決して無理はしない。
lines.translated: Never push ourselves too hard.

lines.content: だけどやれることは全力でこなしていこう。
lines.translated: Still, we'd give our all to everything we could do.

lines.content: では、ふたりとも。気をつけて行ってこい。帰ったらすぐにお夕飯、食べられるようにしておくよ
lines.translated: "Well then, you two. Be careful out there. I'll have dinner ready to eat as soon as you get back."

lines.content: わかりましたと俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded to show I understood.

lines.content: 十夜も、俺を真似するようにうなずいた。
lines.translated: Toya nodded too, mimicking me.

lines.content: そしてクロに『行ってくる』と声をかける。
lines.translated: Then I called out to Kuro, telling her we were heading out.
Mm.

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ……気をつけて
lines.translated: "...Be careful."

lines.content: ありがとう。早めに帰ってくるよ
lines.translated: "Thanks. We'll be back early."

lines.content: 俺はもう一度、ドアノブに手をかける。
lines.translated: Once again, I placed my hand on the doorknob.

lines.content: 時計回りに回転。
lines.translated: Turning it clockwise.

lines.content: がちゃり。
lines.translated: Click.

lines.content: 開かれる扉。
lines.translated: The door swung open.

lines.content: そこには。
lines.translated: And there...

lines.content: 開かれた、扉の向こうには。
lines.translated: Beyond the open door...

lines.content: もうすぐ真夜中が、やって来る
lines.translated: "Midnight is coming soon."

lines.content: うん。とてもとっても、怖い場所
lines.translated: "Yeah. A really, really scary place."
--Even so, it's a place where every wish comes true.
No. A place where every desire takes form.

lines.content: ……俺たちの“魔法”は、誰にも負けない“想像力”だ
lines.translated: Our "magic" is an "imagination" that yields to no one.

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: その言葉を、怖い物から自分を護るお守りのように……、
lines.translated: As if they were a charm to protect us from frightening things...

lines.content: 小さくちいさく握りしめ。
lines.translated: Clutching them tightly, ever so tightly in our hearts.

lines.content: 俺たちは手を繋ぎ、ふたりでその場所へと足を踏み入れた。
lines.translated: Hand in hand, the two of us stepped into that place together.

lines.content: あさひさんの“ゆめのねどこ”から外へと踏み出す。
lines.translated: We stepped outside from Asahi-san's "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 夕暮れ。
lines.translated: Dusk.

lines.content: 少し大げさなくらいに腫れぼったく膨らんだ夕日が、空をじんわり染めていた。
lines.translated: The setting sun, swollen to an almost exaggerated size, was slowly dyeing the sky.

lines.content: ふと、足元を見る。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I looked down at my feet.

lines.content: 視界の隅を何か動くものが掠めたような気がして。
lines.translated: I felt like something moving had just flickered at the edge of my vision.

lines.content: ……影、だった。
lines.translated: It was shadows.

lines.content: ひとり。ふたり。さんにん。よにん。
lines.translated: One. Two. Three. Four.

lines.content: もっとだろうか……。
lines.translated: Maybe even more...

lines.content: 少し先の道を人影だけが列をなしている。
lines.translated: A little ways down the road, human-shaped shadows were forming a line all on their own.

lines.content: 誰もいないのに影だけが一列に並び……。
lines.translated: Nobody was there, yet the shadows alone were lined up in single file...

lines.content: おそらくはランドセルだろう何かを背負った小さな影は、縦笛を吹きつつみんな仲良く進行していく。
lines.translated: The small shadows, carrying what were likely school backpacks, marched along cheerfully together while playing recorders.

lines.content: どこか陽気なメロディと共に。
lines.translated: Accompanied by a somewhat upbeat melody.

lines.content: 元気よく両足を振り上げて。
lines.translated: Energetically kicking their legs up high as they walked.

lines.content: かえろう
lines.translated: Let's go home.

lines.content: かえろう
lines.translated: Let's go home.

lines.content: お家にかえろう
lines.translated: Let's go back to our house.

lines.content: だけど彼らがそこへ帰り着くことは永遠にないのだと俺は知っている。
lines.translated: Yet I knew they would never, ever make it back there.

lines.content: この場所で影になるということは、そういうことだ。
lines.translated: That was what it meant to become a shadow in this place.

lines.content: この子たちはもう“迷子”でさえない。
lines.translated: These kids weren't even "lost children" anymore.

lines.content: ……行こうか十夜
lines.translated: "...Let's go, Toya."

lines.content: うん、わかった。急いで……、だけど気をつけて、行こうね
lines.translated: "Yeah, okay. Let's hurry... and be careful as we go."

lines.content: ふたりで進む川沿いの道。
lines.translated: Together, we walked down the riverside path.

lines.content: 大きな魚影がゆらりと水面を揺らしてゆく。
lines.translated: The large shadow of a fish glided by, sending ripples across the surface of the water.

lines.content: 夕に染まる厚ぼったい空の色。
lines.translated: The heavy, thick color of the sky dyed in evening hues.

lines.content: ……夕焼け小焼けでまた明日……
lines.translated: As the sunset fades away, see you tomorrow...

lines.content: 電信柱の放送マイクから帰宅を知らせるメロディが流れ始める。
lines.translated: From the loudspeaker on a utility pole, the melody telling children to head home began to play.

lines.content: どこかさみしげな空気が満ちた。
lines.translated: A somewhat lonely atmosphere filled the air.

lines.content: ……次第次第。
lines.translated: Little by little.

lines.content: 辺りが暗く、なっていく。
lines.translated: Our surroundings grew darker.

lines.content: “夜”が来るのだ。
lines.translated: The "Night" was coming.
The bright and dazzling "Land of Night."
Before that special time begins--a frightening time comes first.

lines.content: 立ち止まり、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: We stopped and looked up at the sky.
The sky...

lines.content: ふたりで見上げた夕暮れ色が、少しずつ、変わっていく。
lines.translated: The twilight hues the two of us gazed up at were changing, bit by bit.

lines.content: そして、帰宅を促すメロディが終わる頃。
lines.translated: And by the time the melody urging everyone home came to an end...

lines.content: 空はすっかり星々の時間に染め変わる。
lines.translated: The sky had completely shifted into the colors of starry night.

lines.content: 太陽の代わりに満月が。小さくきらめく星の瞬き。
lines.translated: A full moon in place of the sun. The faint twinkling of tiny stars.

lines.content: 夜の参禅町。
lines.translated: Sanzen Town at night.

lines.content: しんと静まり返る。
lines.translated: Dead silent.

lines.content: たったひとかけらの物音もない。
lines.translated: There wasn't even the slightest trace of a sound.

lines.content: 町に覆い被さるような夜気が、ねっとりと肌に粘り着いてくるような気がし――
lines.translated: The night airblanketing the town felt like it was clinging thickly to my skin--

lines.content: 立ち止まって、ごめん。急ごうか。[・|も][・|う][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ][・|の]“[・|夜]”が始まる前に仕事を終えないと
lines.translated: "Sorry for stopping. Let's hurry. We need to finish our job before the other 'Night' begins."

lines.content: ――落ち着かない気分を振り払うように、先を急いだ。
lines.translated: --As if to shake off my restless unease, I hurried ahead.

lines.content: 夜の色に包まれた町は静かだった。
lines.translated: Wrapped in the colors of night, the town was quiet.

lines.content: ……不自然なほどに。
lines.translated: Unnaturally so.

lines.content: 俺たち以外に誰もいないのだ。
lines.translated: There was no one else here besides us.

lines.content: あまりにも、静か。
lines.translated: Far too quiet.

lines.content: 夜色の帳は濃紺であるばかり。
lines.translated: The curtain of night was nothing but deep navy blue.

lines.content: 十夜がリュックから取り出した懐中電灯。
lines.translated: Toya pulled a flashlight out of her backpack.

lines.content: その明かりは、ほんの一メートルくらい先を照らすのがやっとだ。
lines.translated: Its beam could barely illuminate a meter ahead of us.

lines.content: 時間が経てば経つほどに闇はその濃度を増していく。
lines.translated: The more time passed, the denser the darkness grew.

lines.content: 町は姿を変えず、ただ夜の中に在るというだけだ。
lines.translated: The town hadn't changed its shape; it simply existed within the night.

lines.content: それなのに、その姿はまったく別物であるように見えた。
lines.translated: Even so, it looked like something completely different.

lines.content: ……闇の中に潜む、俺たちをじぃっと見つめる視線。
lines.translated: A gaze lurking in the darkness, staring intently at us.

lines.content: そんなもの、あるはずもない。
lines.translated: There was no way anything like that was actually there.

lines.content: しかしそんなあるはずもない何かを、俺の中に生まれた細やかな恐怖心が感じ取ろうとする。
lines.translated: Yet the faint sense of fear sprouting inside me kept trying to pick up on something that couldn't possibly exist.

lines.content: 十夜が俺の手を強く握った。
lines.translated: Toya squeezed my hand tightly.

lines.content: この静けさが十夜は苦手だ。怖いとも言っていた。
lines.translated: Toya didn't do well with this silence. She'd even told me it scared her.

lines.content: その気持ちが俺にも良くよくわかるから、
lines.translated: And because I understood that feeling all too well...

lines.content: なんだ。あの車は……怪しいぞ
lines.translated: "What's that? That car... looks suspicious."

lines.content: 大通りの先の先に駐車されている乗用車。それを十夜に指さして見せた。
lines.translated: A passenger car was parked way down the main street. I pointed it out to Toya.

lines.content: え？　怪しいって……何かいたの？
lines.translated: "Huh? Suspicious... Was there something there?"

lines.content: 十夜は俺に身体を寄せてきた。
lines.translated: Toya pressed herself closer to me.

lines.content: 怖い何かが、いたのかな……
lines.translated: "Was there something scary...?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずき、俺は――
lines.translated: I nodded, and--

lines.content: スパイだ
lines.translated: "It's a spy."

lines.content: ……俺は、人差し指と親指とで拳銃の形を作る。
lines.translated: I made the shape of a handgun with my index finger and thumb.

lines.content: 腰をかがめる。
lines.translated: Then I crouched down low.

lines.content: 大げさに辺りを警戒するふりをしてみせたりもする。
lines.translated: I even put on an exaggerated show of scanning our surroundings on high alert.

lines.content: もしかすると俺たちのことを監視している……すっごい美人な女スパイとかの愛車なのかもしれないぞ。大変だ。下手に近づいたら何かおかしな仕掛けとかで怪我するかもしれない
lines.translated: "For all we know, they might be staking us out... That could be the prized ride of some super gorgeous female spy. This is bad. If we get too close without thinking, we might get hurt by some weird booby trap."

lines.content: え～、なに、それ？
lines.translated: "Ehh, what is that?"

lines.content: うむ。ここは危険だぞ十夜。急いで離れなければ
lines.translated: "Indeed. It's dangerous here, Toya. We must leave at once."

lines.content: きょろきょろと辺りを見回す仕草を見せる。
lines.translated: I made a show of darting my eyes around.

lines.content: そして唇の前に人差し指を立て、静かに、静かに、音を立てずに、とゼスチャーで十夜へ伝えた。
lines.translated: Then I held my index finger to my lips, gesturing to Toya to stay quiet and not make a sound.

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: 十夜は首をかしげて……、
lines.translated: Toya tilted her head...

lines.content: ごっこ遊び？
lines.translated: "Are we playing pretend?"

lines.content: かもね
lines.translated: "Maybe."

lines.content: 冷静な言葉に少し恥ずかしく……。
lines.translated: Her calm response made me feel a little embarrassed...

lines.content: 片手で作った拳銃もポケットにしまった。
lines.translated: I slipped my finger-gun back into my pocket.

lines.content: 怖がる十夜を、そして自分自身とを勇気づけるために、ちょっとふざけてみたのだけれど。
lines.translated: I'd only been goofing around a little to cheer up the frightened Toya, as well as myself.

lines.content: なんだか、大雅。お姉ちゃんみたいだね
lines.translated: "You're kind of like my big sister, Taiga."

lines.content: 十夜はくすくすと笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: Toya giggled for me.

lines.content: 俺は、首をかしげる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんみたいって？
lines.translated: "Like your big sister?"

lines.content: えと……お姉ちゃんとも時どきごっこ遊びしてるよ
lines.translated: "Um... I play pretend with my sister sometimes, too."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: 格好いい映画がお姉ちゃんは好きなんだけど……。一緒に映画見たらね、お姉ちゃん。いつも映画の人たちの真似をしようって言うんだよ。おもちゃの鉄砲で
lines.translated: "She really likes cool movies... Whenever we watch one together, she always says we should copy the people in the movie. With toy guns."

lines.content: へ～
lines.translated: "Huh~"

lines.content: お店の中で撃ち合いっこするの。昨日もお姉ちゃんに付き合わされちゃったもん。終わったらお菓子くれるからって
lines.translated: "We have shootouts inside the shop. She made me play along with her yesterday, too, promising she'd give me sweets when we were done."

lines.content: 十夜はやれやれと小さな肩をすくめていた。
lines.translated: Toya gave an exasperated shrug of her small shoulders.

lines.content: かわいいお姉ちゃんを持った妹はとても大変なんだよ
lines.translated: "Having such a cute big sister is really hard on a little sister, you know."

lines.content: お、おお……
俺は、どんな反応をしていいものか……。
lines.translated: I wasn't quite sure how to react to that...

lines.content: 俺の前じゃ、あさひさん。そんな様子は殆ど見せないのに。いつも頼りになる年上のお姉さんって感じだ。それなのに……
lines.translated: "Asahi-san hardly ever shows that side of herself around me. She always feels like a reliable older sister. And yet..."

lines.content: ごっこ遊びかあ、と俺は苦笑いを浮かべてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Playing pretend, huh? I couldn't help a wry smile.

lines.content: お姉ちゃん。格好付けたいお年頃なんだよ、きっと
lines.translated: "She's just at that age where she wants to act cool, I bet."

lines.content: おおぅ。言いますね十夜ちゃん
lines.translated: "Ooh, listen to you, Toya-chan."

lines.content: 得意そうな顔になり、十夜は更に言った。
lines.translated: Looking rather proud of herself, Toya went on.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんはかわいいんだよ
lines.translated: "My big sister is really cute."

lines.content: うん、そうだね。そう思うよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, she is. I think so too."

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ……少し歩いたところで、小さな声で十夜が言った。
lines.translated: After we'd walked a little ways, Toya spoke up in a small voice.

lines.content: ……今の話、お姉ちゃんには内緒だよ？
lines.translated: "...Keep what I just told you a secret from my sister, okay?"

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: だって……
lines.translated: "Because..."

lines.content: 十夜は、思わず口が滑っちゃった、というような不安そうな顔で俺を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Toya looked up at me with an uneasy expression, as if realizing she'd let it slip by mistake.

lines.content: お姉ちゃん。きっと恥ずかしくなってお部屋から出てこなくなっちゃうから
lines.translated: "She'll definitely get so embarrassed she won't come out of her room."

lines.content: それは大変だ
lines.translated: "That would be bad."

lines.content: うん。特に大雅に知られたってわかったらね、もしかしたら泣いちゃうかもだよ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. Especially if she found out you knew, Taiga. She might even cry, you know?"

lines.content: ……どうして、俺に？
lines.translated: "...Why me in particular?"

lines.content: 格好付けたいお姉ちゃんなの
lines.translated: "Because she's a big sister who wants to look cool."

lines.content: ああ、そっか。なるほど
lines.translated: "Ah, I see. Got it."

lines.content: 俺たちは細かな会話を重ねながらどんどん歩く。
lines.translated: We kept walking, trading little bits of conversation as we went.

lines.content: ……夜の静けさになんか負けないように。
lines.translated: Refusing to let the silence of the night get the better of us.

lines.content: できるだけ、笑顔で。
lines.translated: Smiling as much as we could.

lines.content: 夜の街を進む。誰もいない。誰ともすれ違わない。そんな不自然な夜の中を。
lines.translated: We made our way through the nighttime streets. No one was around. We didn't pass a single soul in this unnatural night.

lines.content: 今は[・|ま][・|だ]、静かな時間。
lines.translated: Right now, it was still the quiet hours.
The stagnant hour of the night.

lines.content: 明かりは夜空の星と満月と。
lines.translated: The only lights came from the stars and the full moon in the night sky,

lines.content: 等間隔に設置された、丸みを帯びたデザインの街灯と……。
lines.translated: the rounded streetlights spaced out at regular intervals...

lines.content: ぽつり
lines.translated: And, dotting the darkness one by one,

lines.content: ぽつり
lines.translated: And, dotting the darkness one by one,

lines.content: 大通りに面したたくさんの民家に灯りはじめた光だけ。
lines.translated: the lights beginning to flicker on inside the many houses lining the main street.

lines.content: ……俺たちは夜を見回る。
lines.translated: We patrolled the night.

lines.content: 探しているものにはまだ遭遇していない。
lines.translated: We still hadn't run into what we were looking for.

lines.content: 明かりの灯った民家の前を通りかかった。
lines.translated: We passed in front of a house with its lights on.

lines.content: ぼそぼそ、ぼそぼそ――
lines.translated: Murmur, murmur--

lines.content: 小さなちいさな話し声がした。
lines.translated: I heard faint, quiet voices talking.

lines.content: 思わず立ち止まる。
lines.translated: I stopped in my tracks without thinking.

lines.content: はじめての人の気配。
lines.translated: The first sign of people.

lines.content: 否応なく、というのもおかしなものだが――カーテンの開かれた窓から、中の様子をちらりと覗き込んでしまう。
lines.translated: It feels strange to say I couldn't help myself, and yet--through the open curtains of the window, I stole a glance inside.

lines.content: 小さな家族の団らんがそこにはあった。
lines.translated: There, a small family was gathered together.

lines.content: 黒電話。ブラウン管テレビ。背の低い木製の丸テーブル。蓄音機に繋がれたわざとらしいくらい大きなラジオ機。
lines.translated: A black rotary phone. A CRT television. A low wooden round table. An almost comically large radio hooked up to a phonograph.

lines.content: 昭和時代を思わせる家内設備。
lines.translated: Household furnishings reminiscent of the Showa era.

lines.content: 軍歌だろうか。今や奇っ怪にしか思えないメロディがラジオから流れていた。
lines.translated: Was that a military song? A melody that sounded nothing short of bizarre nowadays was playing from the radio.

lines.content: よく見ると丸テーブルを[・|何][・|者][・|か]が囲んでいる。
lines.translated: Looking closely, figures were gathered around the round table.

lines.content: ぼそぼそ、ぼそぼそ――
lines.translated: Murmur, murmur--

lines.content: ……何者かは理解できない言葉で囁くように話し合っていた。
lines.translated: Those figures were whispering to one another in words I couldn't understand.

lines.content: “何者か”とは言ったが、しかしそれは人のようで人ではない。
lines.translated: I call them "figures," because while they looked human, they weren't.

lines.content: 影である。
lines.translated: They were shadows.

lines.content: 深いふかい黒色をした人型の影が、四つ。
lines.translated: Four humanoid shadows of a deep, pitch black.

lines.content: くっきりと空間に浮かび上がるようにしてそこに在る。
lines.translated: They were right there, standing out starkly in the room.

lines.content: 四人、と数えるべきなのか。誰が男で。誰が女で。誰が、子どもで……。
lines.translated: Should I count them as four people? Who was the man, who was the woman, who were the children...?

lines.content: そういったものがなんとかわかる程度の輪郭が、ゆらゆら、ぶら下がった裸電球の光に照らされ揺れていた。
lines.translated: Their outlines, just distinct enough to make out those details, flickered and swayed under the light of a dangling bare bulb.

lines.content: 食事中、なのだろうか。
lines.translated: Were they in the middle of a meal?

lines.content: テーブルに並べられた皿には調理済みの料理が盛りつけられている。
lines.translated: The plates lined up on the table were heaped with cooked food.

lines.content: 人影たちはしきりに箸（を持っているように見える）を伸ばしていた。
lines.translated: The shadowy figures kept reaching out with chopsticks (or at least, they looked like they were holding them).

lines.content: 影たちが何を話しているのか、どんな表情で空間を共にしているのか。
lines.translated: What the shadows were talking about, what sort of expressions they wore as they shared that space...

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: それでも楽しげな雰囲気だけは見て取れた。
lines.translated: Even so, I could clearly sense the cheerful atmosphere.

lines.content: これは [・|記][・|憶]だ。
lines.translated: This was a memory.
Something that had happened in this town in the distant past was being played back here over, and over, and over again.

lines.content: そんな幸せだったのだろう誰かの人生を、誰かの瞬間を、覗いていたら……。
lines.translated: Peeking in on someone's life, on someone's moment that must have been so happy...

lines.content: なぜか……。
lines.translated: For some reason...

lines.content: なぜか俺は、その様子を食い入るように見ていた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I found myself staring transfixed at the scene.

lines.content: 窓はぴったりと閉ざされている。はずなのに――
lines.translated: The window was shut tight. It should have been, and yet--

lines.content: 異様なほど甘い香りに馥郁とされた空気が漏れ出してくる。
lines.translated: Air thick with an unnaturally sweet fragrance came seeping out.

lines.content: ふらり、ふらりと。
lines.translated: Slowly, waveringly.

lines.content: その団欒の中に加わりたい気分にさせられてしまう。
lines.translated: It made me feel like I wanted to join that happy family circle.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...
This was a time where the night had stagnated. Forever. For all eternity.

lines.content: あの影と同じように自分もなれれば……。
lines.translated: If only I could become just like those shadows...

lines.content: ……なんだかもう。
lines.translated: Somehow, I just...

lines.content: 全部がどうでもよくなった――とまでは言わないし、言えもしないが。
lines.translated: I wouldn't go so far as to say nothing mattered anymore--I couldn't say that, either, but...

lines.content: ちょっとくらい休んでみてもいいんじゃないかなあ。
lines.translated: Maybe it wouldn't hurt to rest for just a little while.

lines.content: ……だめだよ
lines.translated: "...You mustn't."

lines.content: 十夜にきゅっと手を握られ我に返る。
lines.translated: Toya squeezed my hand tightly, snapping me back to my senses.

lines.content: 大雅。あんまり見てたら取り込まれちゃうかも。“迷子”に、なっちゃうかも……。そしたら帰って来れなくなっちゃうよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. If you stare too long, you might get pulled in. You might become a 'Lost One'... And then you won't be able to come back."

lines.content: ……あ、ああ。そうだね。ありがとう
lines.translated: "...Ah, yeah. You're right. Thanks."

lines.content: ふるふると首を振り、微笑んで、言った。
lines.translated: I gave my head a little shake, smiled, and spoke.

lines.content: ミイラ取りがミイラになっちゃ笑い種にもなれないしね
lines.translated: "If the rescuer ends up needing rescuing, it wouldn't even be funny. Like a mummy hunter becoming a mummy."

lines.content: ……ミイラ
lines.translated: "...A mummy."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 大雅はすぐ怖いことを言う
lines.translated: "You always say scary things right away, Taiga."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: She pouted.

lines.content: 気を取り直し、俺たちはまた進む。
lines.translated: Pulling ourselves together, we pressed on once more.

lines.content: 一軒の古民家の前を通る。
lines.translated: We passed in front of an old traditional house.

lines.content: また、ちょうど明かりが灯った。
lines.translated: Just then, another light came on.

lines.content: 木枠の格子がはめ込まれた窓から淡い光が漏れている。
lines.translated: A pale glow leaked through a window fitted with a wooden lattice.

lines.content: 歩きながら……まただ。
lines.translated: As I walked... there I went again.

lines.content: ふと、窓から中を見てしまう。
lines.translated: Without thinking, I found myself peeking inside through the window.

lines.content: 微かな音楽が耳に付き、気になってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: A faint melody had caught my ear, piquing my curiosity.

lines.content: そこは民家ではなくお店のようだった。
lines.translated: It seemed to be a shop rather than a private home.

lines.content: 楽器屋だろうか。蝶ネクタイと背広できちんと正装をした初老の男性がチェロを弾いていた。
lines.translated: A music store, perhaps? An elderly man dressed neatly in a suit and bow tie was playing the cello.

lines.content: 今度は影ではなく人間で……。
lines.translated: This time, it wasn't a shadow, but a human...

lines.content: 穏やか表情で。
lines.translated: Wearing a serene expression.

lines.content: 身体中から響かせる旋律に[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて――たおやかに。
lines.translated: With his eyelids closed, giving himself over to the melody resonating through his entire body--gracefully.

lines.content: ……重厚な音色の弦楽器ただひとつ。
lines.translated: Just a single stringed instrument with a rich, deep tone.

lines.content: 奏でる旋律は、きっと遙か昔にさみしい誰かが、愛する誰かを想い作られたもの。
lines.translated: The melody he played must have been composed long, long ago by someone lonely, thinking of someone they loved.

lines.content: ふと、男の隣に女の人の姿が見えた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I noticed the figure of a woman beside the man.

lines.content: 半透明で――
lines.translated: Translucent--

lines.content: チェロを弾く男性に、そっと寄り添い――
lines.translated: Gently nestling close to the man playing the cello--

lines.content: それは壁に飾られた写真の中で微笑む人とよく似た顔をしていた。
lines.translated: Her face looked remarkably like the person smiling in a photograph framed on the wall.

lines.content: この男性は“迷子”でなければ“影”でもない。ましてや“[・|悪][・|夢]”とも違う。
lines.translated: This man was neither a "Lost One" nor a "shadow." And he certainly wasn't a "Nightmare," either.
He was someone who had come to meet a person precious to him, within his heart, within a dream.

lines.content: 太陽が目覚めれば自然と真昼の世界へ戻るだろう。
lines.translated: Once the sun woke, he would surely return naturally to the midday world.

lines.content: ……だめだ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: 急がないと。
lines.translated: We have to hurry.

lines.content: 停滞した夜の刻が終わり始めてる。
lines.translated: The stagnant hour of the night is beginning to end.

lines.content: そして、もうひとつの夜が……。
lines.translated: And another night is...
The "Country of the Night" is about to begin.
Our job is to clean the stage before that happens.

lines.content: ぽつり
lines.translated: And, dotting the darkness one by one,

lines.content: ぽつり
lines.translated: And, dotting the darkness one by one,

lines.content: 灯る明かりが増えていく。
lines.translated: More and more lights were coming on.

lines.content: あの家も、この家も。
lines.translated: In that house, and this one, too.

lines.content: そこにある光景はそれぞれ違っていようとも……。
lines.translated: Even if the scenes inside were all different from one another...

lines.content: おそらく、誰かにとって何より理想的な風景が映し出されているに違いなかった。
lines.translated: Surely, each one was projecting the most ideal scenery imaginable for someone.

lines.content: 十夜が小さな声を上げる。そして道の先を指さす。
