lines.content: 隣には智仁。
lines.translated: Next to me was Tomohito.

lines.content: つり革にぐったり体重をかけるよう掴まり、大きなあくびをかみ殺している。
lines.translated: He was clinging to a strap, leaning his weight sluggishly against it and stifling a massive yawn.

lines.content: 昨日はあれから迷子にならず帰れたか
lines.translated: "Did you make it home without getting lost after we split up yesterday?"

lines.content: だとか。
lines.translated: Things like that.

lines.content: そりゃあ、まあ。でも、ひよちゃんのお腹すいた攻撃が大変だったんだぞ。危うく齧り付かれるところだった
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. Though Hiyo-chan's 'I'm hungry' attack was rough. She practically bit a chunk out of me."

lines.content: で、あるとか。
lines.translated: And things like that.

lines.content: 挨拶代わりに取り留めもないことを話す朝の時間。
lines.translated: Morning time spent chatting about nothing in particular by way of greeting.

lines.content: 今朝もあめ玉を貰う。
lines.translated: I got a piece of hard candy from him this morning, too.

lines.content: 遠慮なく受け取るがちょっと不思議な味だった。
lines.translated: I took it without hesitation, though it had a slightly strange flavor.

lines.content: 何味だと問う。当ててみろと返される。正解したら何かあるのかと言う。俺のハグをくれてやると微笑まれる。……もういい。きもちわるい。
lines.translated: I asked what flavor it was. He told me to guess. I asked if I got anything if I was right. He smiled and said he'd give me a hug. ...Never mind. Gross.

lines.content: ちらりと隣に立つ智仁を見る。
lines.translated: I glanced over at Tomohito standing beside me.

lines.content: ……[・|昨][・|晩]のことを思い出さずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help remembering last night.

lines.content: そんな俺の内面に気づいたわけでもなく、
lines.translated: Completely oblivious to what was going on inside my head,

lines.content: はぁぁぁぁ
lines.translated: "Haaaaah..."

lines.content: 智仁は、ため息。大きなおおきな。
lines.translated: Tomohito let out a sigh. A huge, massive one.

lines.content: どうした。すごいため息だ
lines.translated: "What's wrong? That was quite a sigh."

lines.content: 幸せが逃げるぞ。と、適当なことを俺は言う。
lines.translated: Your happiness will slip away, I added offhandedly.

lines.content: 学校ってなんのためにあるのかなあ大雅
lines.translated: "What does school even exist for, Taiga?"

lines.content: そんなのは知らない。……まあ、うん。たぶん、大人が嫉まないようにだろ
lines.translated: "Beats me. ...Well, yeah. Probably so adults don't get jealous."

lines.content: なんだぁそれ
lines.translated: "What the heck is that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: 自分が汗水垂らして働いてるのに、同じ時間、のんびりゲームして馬鹿話してごろごろ寝てるやつがいると考えてみろよ
lines.translated: "Just imagine sweating bullets at work while knowing there are people out there taking it easy, playing games, talking nonsense, and lounging around asleep at the exact same time."

lines.content: ……おいまさか。自分たちが働いてるのに、俺たちが遊んでると悔しいからか？
lines.translated: "...Hey, no way. You mean it's because they're bitter about us having fun while they're working?"

lines.content: かもな
lines.translated: "Maybe."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: だから、腹いせに、俺たちには将来使うかどうかもわからない無駄に難しい勉強ばっかりさせるんだ
lines.translated: "So out of spite, they force us to study pointlessly difficult stuff we don't even know if we'll ever use in the future."

lines.content: はああ。歪んでやがる
lines.translated: "Haaah. That's so twisted."

lines.content: そして、学校サボったら烈火のごとく怒るんだよ。将来困っても知らないぞって言葉の裏には、いつだって“ぼくもわたしも遊びたいのにずるいだろ！”とかいう本心が渦巻いている――
lines.translated: "And then if you skip school, they get furiously mad. Behind the words 'don't blame me if you struggle in the future,' their true feelings of 'it's not fair when I want to play too!' are always swirling around--"

lines.content: ――ように、かわいげのかけらもない俺は思ってしまうわけだ
lines.translated: "--or so someone without a single cute bone in his body like me ends up thinking."

lines.content: なるほど、なるほど。施設でもらい手がなかったのも納得だな
lines.translated: "I see, I see. Makes total sense why nobody ever adopted you at the orphanage."

lines.content: だろ
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: 智仁のちょっとからかうようなせりふに、俺は得意げな顔を返してみせた。
lines.translated: In response to Tomohito's slightly teasing remark, I shot him a smug look.

lines.content: あとは、まあ、集団行動学ぶためとかじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Other than that, well, maybe it's to learn how to act in a group?"

lines.content: 急に無難な話になったな
lines.translated: "That suddenly turned into a really safe answer."

lines.content: 社会とは車輪だ、っていうだろ
lines.translated: "They say society is like a wheel, right?"

lines.content: ときには心だって、そうだ。
lines.translated: And sometimes, the heart is like that, too.

lines.content: 世の中。ひとりじゃできないことが多いだろ
lines.translated: "In this world, there's a lot you can't do all by yourself, right?"

lines.content: そうか？　音楽はひとりでもできるんだよ
lines.translated: "Is there? You can make music all by yourself, you know."

lines.content: だからもう帰りたいと智仁。
lines.translated: Which is why I want to go home already, Tomohito added.

lines.content: ……それと、あとは、将来の選択肢を増やすためだとも大人は言うな
lines.translated: "...And besides that, adults also say it's to increase your options for the future."

lines.content: なぜその選択肢に、“今日はもう疲れたから帰る”というものは認めてもらえていないのかなあ
lines.translated: "Why is it that 'I'm tired today so I'm going home' isn't recognized as one of those options, I wonder?"

lines.content: 帰りたい帰りたいなあと、ぶつぶつと。
lines.translated: I wanna go home, I wanna go home, he grumbled under his breath.

lines.content: そんなに嫌なら行かなきゃいいじゃないか。別にお前がいなくてもお前以外の誰も困らない
lines.translated: "If you hate it that much, why don't you just not go? It's not like anyone other than you will be troubled if you're not there."

lines.content: いや。そんなわけにもいかないな
lines.translated: "Nah. Can't really do that."

lines.content: なぜ
lines.translated: "Why not?"

lines.content: 俺は、幸せを回収しに学校に行ってるんだよ
lines.translated: "I'm going to school to retrieve my happiness."

lines.content: 何を得意げに意味不明なこと言っているんだ
lines.translated: "What are you talking so smugly about? That makes zero sense."

lines.content: 意味はある。いつだって、どこにだってある。いいか。ため息をついたら幸せが逃げていくんだろ？　そいつらはいったいどこへ行くんだ
lines.translated: "It does make sense. Always, and everywhere. Listen. When you sigh, your happiness runs away, right? Where on earth do you think it goes?"

lines.content: ……さあ
lines.translated: "...Who knows?"

lines.content: 昨日“帰りたい”とついたため息と一緒に、校舎の中に落っことしたまま閉じこめられてしまっているかもしれない俺の幸せだよ
lines.translated: "It's my happiness that might still be dropped and trapped inside the school building along with the sighs I let out yesterday wishing I could go home."

lines.content: あいつらのことを俺以外のいったい誰が、助け出してやれるっていうんだよ
lines.translated: "Who on earth other than me is going to rescue them?"

lines.content: そんなの俺しかいないじゃないか――
lines.translated: I'm the only one who can do it, aren't I?--

lines.content: そんなふうにひとり勝手に納得している。
lines.translated: And just like that, he nodded to himself, entirely satisfied with his own logic.

lines.content: そしてまた、隣で気怠げにぶつぶつ言い始めた智仁。
lines.translated: And then, right beside me, Tomohito started listlessly muttering under his breath again.

lines.content: 俺はあめ玉を囓って砕く。
lines.translated: I bit down on my piece of hard candy, crunching it into pieces.

lines.content: しゅわしゅわしたものが中から出てきて、朝からちょっと口の中が甘ったるい。
lines.translated: Fizzy powder spilled out from the center, leaving my mouth feeling a little overly sweet this early in the morning.

lines.content: レモン味のサイダー……？
lines.translated: "Lemon-flavored cider...?"

lines.content: はずれだ。でも、抱きしめてはやろう
lines.translated: "Wrong. Though I will give you a hug anyway."

lines.content: いらん。よるな
lines.translated: "Pass. Stay away from me."

lines.content: ……次の停留所。
lines.translated: At the next bus stop.

lines.content: 千和が乗り込んでくる。
lines.translated: Chiwa boarded the bus.

lines.content: や
lines.translated: "Yo."

lines.content: うっす
lines.translated: "Mornin'."

lines.content: ふたり揃って片手をあげ朝の挨拶。
lines.translated: The two of us raised a hand in unison to greet her.

lines.content: 昨日のように邪険な態度を期待――……覚悟、していたのだけれど。
lines.translated: I was expecting--...or rather, bracing myself for the same brusque attitude she'd given me yesterday, but...

lines.content: 顔を上げた千和は『あ……』と小さな声を上げる。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked up and let out a tiny, "Ah..."

lines.content: そしてすっと俺の前に立つ。
lines.translated: Then she walked straight over and stood right in front of me.

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: 先輩。制服のボタン、ひとつ掛け違ってますよ？
lines.translated: "Senpai. Your uniform is buttoned wrong by one, you know?"

lines.content: ん？　そう？
lines.translated: "Hm? It is?"

lines.content: はい。ちぐはぐな感じです。今朝は急いでたんですか？
lines.translated: "Yes. It looks all mismatched. Were you in a rush this morning?"

lines.content: あー、えっと……
lines.translated: "Ah, um..."

lines.content: 制服のボタン。
lines.translated: My uniform buttons.

lines.content: 今朝のことを思い出す。
lines.translated: I thought back to earlier this morning.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”を出る前――
lines.translated: Right before leaving the "Bed of Dreams"--

lines.content: 十夜が寝ぼけた俺の着替えを手伝いたいと言うので、俺はあくびしながら『いいよ』とうなずき、十夜の好きにさせたのだ。
lines.translated: Toya had said she wanted to help my half-asleep self get dressed, so I'd yawned, nodded with an "Okay," and let her do whatever she wanted.

lines.content: ……十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: 満足そうに、
lines.translated: Looking thoroughly satisfied,

lines.content: 『できたっ、私、すっごい！』
lines.translated: "'All done! I'm amazing!'"

lines.content: とか、言うから。
lines.translated: she had declared.

lines.content: だから俺はろくに確かめもせず、『ありがとう』と頭を撫でて……。
lines.translated: So without really bothering to check, I'd just patted her head with a "Thanks"...

lines.content: すると十夜は、
lines.translated: To which Toya had replied,

lines.content: 『ふふん。お礼はあの店の美味しいプリンでいいんだよ？』
lines.translated: "'Hehe. You can thank me with a delicious pudding from that shop, okay?'"

lines.content: と得意そうにして。
lines.translated: looking all proud of herself.

lines.content: 結果。その笑顔でこちらも満足。
lines.translated: In the end, seeing that smile was enough to leave me satisfied, too.

lines.content: そしてそのまま出てきたのだ。
lines.translated: And so I'd headed out just like that.

lines.content: ああ、言われてみれば。確かにちょっとだらしない感じだな
lines.translated: "Oh, now that you mention it, yeah. It definitely looks a little sloppy."

lines.content: 智仁がまじまじと俺の喉元を見る。
lines.translated: Tomohito stared intently at my collar.

lines.content: そして、『俺が直そうか』と智仁は何でもないように言うのだけれど、
lines.translated: He casually offered, "Want me to fix it?" as if it were nothing,

lines.content: ダメです
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: 千和がさっと、俺の胸元に手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: Chiwa quickly reached her hands up toward my chest.

lines.content: そんなことしてるから夜月先輩に疑われるんですよ。先輩たちはちょっと自覚が足りないと思います
lines.translated: "Doing things like that is the exact reason Yotsuki-senpai gets suspicious of you two. I think you both lack a little self-awareness."

lines.content: 疑われる……？
lines.translated: "Suspicious...?"

lines.content: なにを？　と首をかしげる智仁。
lines.translated: Of what? Tomohito tilted his head.

lines.content: それは、その……
lines.translated: "Well, um..."

lines.content: 口を尖らせ、もにょもにょとする。
lines.translated: She pouted, mumbling indistinctly under her breath.

lines.content: と、とにかく、そういうことですから私が直します
lines.translated: "A-Anyway, that's how it is, so I'll fix it."

lines.content: 言って千和は、俺の制服のボタンを外す。
lines.translated: Saying that, Chiwa began undoing the buttons of my uniform.

lines.content: 首元のほうは、身長差にちょっとだけ苦戦しながら――
lines.translated: Up near the collar, she struggled just a tiny bit with the height difference--

lines.content: えっと……、ここが、こうなってて……
lines.translated: "Um... this part goes like this..."

lines.content: 一生懸命、直してくれる。
lines.translated: She worked earnestly to fix it for me.

lines.content: そういえば
lines.translated: "Come to think of it,"

lines.content: ふと。智仁が言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito suddenly spoke up.

lines.content: 改めて聞くのもどうかなって感じだが……[・|今][・|日][・|は][・|あ][・|そ][・|こ][・|か][・|ら]登校したのか？
lines.translated: "It feels a little weird asking this now, but... did you commute to school from there today?"
"Yeah, I did. From there."

lines.content: 膝を曲げ、中腰。
lines.translated: I bent my knees into a half-crouch.

lines.content: 千和にボタンのついでに、身だしなみ締め直してもらいながら、俺は智仁の問いかけにうなずく。
lines.translated: While letting Chiwa tidy up the rest of my uniform along with the buttons, I nodded at Tomohito's question.

lines.content: 智仁の言うとおり、今日はあそこから……“ゆめのねどこ”から登校だ。しばらくはそうなるかな
lines.translated: "Just like you said, Tomohito, I'm commuting from there... from the 'Bed of Dreams' today. Probably will be for a while."

lines.content: そっか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: なあ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: なんだ？　と振り向く。
lines.translated: What's up? I turned my head to look at him.

lines.content: あ、もうっ、動かないでくださいよ先輩っ
lines.translated: "Ah, geez, please don't move, Senpai!"

lines.content: と千和が声を上げるのを間近に聞きながら、
lines.translated: Listening to Chiwa raise her voice from right up close,

lines.content: どうかしたか？
lines.translated: "Is something the matter?"

lines.content: 中腰のまま智仁に俺は問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked Tomohito while still holding my half-crouch.

lines.content: いや、あのふたりは……あさひさんと十夜は元気なのかなあって。そう思ってさ
lines.translated: "Nah, I was just wondering... if those two--Asahi-san and Toya--are doing well. That's all."

lines.content: ああ、元気だ。相変わらずだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, they're doing great. Same as always."

lines.content: 昨日あったことを軽く話した。
lines.translated: I gave him a brief rundown of what happened yesterday.

lines.content: 寝ぼけた十夜がお姉ちゃんに甘えていたこと。
lines.translated: How a half-asleep Toya had been acting all spoiled with her big sister.

lines.content: そんな様子を俺に見られて恥ずかしがっていたこと。
lines.translated: How embarrassed she'd gotten when she realized I was watching her act like that.

lines.content: お土産にしたケーキをふたりとも喜んでくれたこと。
lines.translated: And how happy the two of them had been with the cake I brought back as a souvenir.

lines.content: 昨日のケーキ。みんなで一緒に食べたんだ。……改めて、ありがとう。すごく美味しかった
lines.translated: "We all ate the cake from yesterday together. ...Thanks again. It was really delicious."

lines.content: “夜”の中で“悪夢”を回収したことは伏せておいた。
lines.translated: I kept quiet about how we'd collected a "Nightmare" inside the "Night."

lines.content: そして、もうひとつ。新しくやって来た[・|客]についても。
lines.translated: And about one more thing: the new guest who had arrived.

lines.content: ……そっか。懐かしいな
lines.translated: "...I see. Man, that brings back memories."

lines.content: 智仁は目を細め、言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito narrowed his eyes and spoke.

lines.content: もう俺たちはあそこには出入りできなくなっちゃったからなあ……。それに記憶ももう曖昧だ。少し、さみしい
lines.translated: "Since the rest of us can't go in and out of there anymore... And my memories of it are getting fuzzy now, too. It's a little lonely."

lines.content: 智仁も。千和も。そして姫織も。
lines.translated: Tomohito. Chiwa. And Himeori, too.

lines.content: 今はもう“ゆめのねどこ”に立ち入ることができない。
lines.translated: None of them could set foot inside the "Bed of Dreams" anymore.

lines.content: 鍵をなくしてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: Because they had lost their keys.

lines.content: だからあの場所へ自由に出入りすることはできなくなった。
lines.translated: And so, they could no longer freely come and go from that place.

lines.content: いや。なくした、というより、消えてしまったと言うほうがいいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: No. Rather than saying they lost them, it might be more accurate to say the keys simply vanished.

lines.content: それは“心”が子どもから大人に近づいている証拠なのだ。
lines.translated: It was proof that their "hearts" were growing closer to adulthood from childhood.

lines.content: あの場所は大人になれば自然と卒業しなければならない場所。
lines.translated: That place was somewhere you naturally had to graduate from once you grew up.

lines.content: 俺は、千和やひよちゃんや智仁よりもガキだからな。精神年齢赤ちゃんだ。だからまだ、出入りできる。ふたりより昔の記憶もきっと鮮明だ
lines.translated: "I'm more of a brat than you, Chiwa, and Hiyo-chan, after all. Mentally, I'm a total baby. That's why I can still go in and out. My memories of the old days are probably way clearer than yours, too."

lines.content: おどけたように言ってみせる。
lines.translated: I said it jokingly.

lines.content: しかしそんな俺にしてもいつ鍵をなくしてしまうかわからない。
lines.translated: Yet even someone like me had no way of knowing when I might lose my key, too.

lines.content: 子どもから、大人へ。
lines.translated: From a child to an adult.

lines.content: その明確な判断基準は存在しない。
lines.translated: There is no clear-cut standard for when that happens.

lines.content: 心の成長速度が人それぞれであることが当然である以上……。
lines.translated: Since it's only natural that everyone's heart grows at its own pace...

lines.content: あさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san.

lines.content: 十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: もしかしたら、クロにまで……。
lines.translated: And maybe even Kuro...

lines.content: 俺はいつ、会えなくなってしまうかわからないのだ。
lines.translated: There was no telling when I might suddenly become unable to see them anymore.

lines.content: 智仁が小さく歌を口ずさむ。
lines.translated: Tomohito softly hummed a tune under his breath.

lines.content: “幼い頃には神さまがいて……”
lines.translated: "When I was little, there was a god..."

lines.content: どこかで聞いたことのある歌だった。
lines.translated: It was a song I'd heard somewhere before.

lines.content: ちょっとかわいい“魔法”を身近に感じることも。
lines.translated: Feeling a little bit of cute "magic" close by.

lines.content: 隣の森に住む大きなおおきな毛むくじゃらのお話も。
lines.translated: And stories of a great, big furry creature living in the forest next door.

lines.content: みな、子どもの頃にだけ出会える特権だ。
lines.translated: Those are all privileges you only get to encounter when you're a child.

lines.content: 大人に近づけば彼らとはすれ違うことが多くなり。
lines.translated: As you grow closer to adulthood, you start passing them by without noticing more and more.

lines.content: いつか大人になれば、綺麗さっぱり忘れてしまう。
lines.translated: And once you finally become an adult, you forget about them completely.

lines.content: 不思議な物事はいつだって、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う]にできている……。
lines.translated: Mysterious things are always made to work that way...

lines.content: ……人生とは忘れることだ。つらいことも。悲しいことも。すべて忘れて眠ってしまおう
lines.translated: "...Life is about forgetting. The painful things. The sad things, too. Let's forget it all and go to sleep."

lines.content: ひら……
lines.translated: Fluttering...

lines.content: ひら…
lines.translated: Drifting...

lines.content: ひらり
lines.translated: Fluttering down.

lines.content: 花びらのような、言葉がひとつ。
lines.translated: A single word, like a flower petal.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 世界がそっと、ため息をつく。
lines.translated: The world lets out a soft sigh.

lines.content: 俺が大人になる前に。
lines.translated: Before I become an adult.

lines.content: 俺がすべて忘れてしまう、その前に――
lines.translated: Before I forget everything--

lines.content: （……俺は、大切な人を、何よりも大切にしたい人たちのことを、俺は……助けることができるだろうか）
lines.translated: (...Will I be able to save the people who are precious to me, the ones I want to cherish more than anything?)

lines.content: ……ぽつり。
lines.translated: Drip.

lines.content: 心に小さな“夜”がやって来た。
lines.translated: A tiny "Night" visited my heart.

lines.content: お。大雅。見てみろ
lines.translated: "Oh. Taiga. Look at that."

lines.content: 智仁の声で我に返る。
lines.translated: Tomohito's voice brought me back to my senses.

lines.content: なんだ？　何があった
lines.translated: "What? What happened?"

lines.content: ちょっと身構えてしまう。
lines.translated: I tensed up a little.

lines.content: 何か事件か
lines.translated: "Did something happen?"

lines.content: ああ。とんでもない大事件だぞ
lines.translated: "Yeah. A massive, unbelievable incident."

lines.content: ……なんだ。何があったんだ
lines.translated: "...What is it? What happened?"

lines.content: ほら、あそこだあそこ
lines.translated: "Look, right over there."

lines.content: 窓の外を智仁は指さしている。
lines.translated: Tomohito was pointing outside the window.

lines.content: そうして続けられた智仁の明るい声に、心に生まれた小さな“夜”は姿を消した。
lines.translated: And as Tomohito continued in a cheerful voice, the tiny "Night" born in my heart vanished.

lines.content: 見ろよ大雅。かわいい子、発見
lines.translated: "Look, Taiga. Cute girl spotted."

lines.content: えっ、どこどこ――
lines.translated: "Huh, where, where--"

lines.content: きゅ
lines.translated: Tug.

lines.content: ふぐっ
lines.translated: "Fugh!"

lines.content: ちょっと強めに襟を詰められ、うめく。
lines.translated: My collar was pulled tight a bit too roughly, making me groan.

lines.content: うん。完璧ですね
lines.translated: "Yup. Perfect."

lines.content: 千和。満足げ。
lines.translated: Chiwa. Looking satisfied.

lines.content: 慣れた手つきだった。
lines.translated: She did it with practiced hands.

lines.content: ダメですよ先輩。身だしなみはちゃんとしなくちゃ
lines.translated: "You can't go around like that, Senpai. You have to keep yourself looking neat and tidy."

lines.content: 人差し指を立てる。
lines.translated: She held up her index finger.

lines.content: 兎蛙先輩もです
lines.translated: "That goes for you too, Toa-senpai."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: かわいい女の子って……。そんな節操ない感じじゃ女の子に嫌われますよ。知ってますか？　色々だらしのない男の子はポイント低いんですから
lines.translated: "Looking for cute girls... If you act that shameless, girls are going to hate you. Did you know? Boys who are sloppy about all sorts of things score really low points."

lines.content: むむ。そうなのか。そいつは大変だなあ。女の子に嫌われる人生なんて生きる意味がまるでない
lines.translated: "Mmh. Is that so? That's a real problem. A life where girls hate me isn't worth living at all."

lines.content: とは言いつつも、やっぱりちっとも大変そうでない笑顔だった。
lines.translated: Despite saying that, his smile didn't look troubled in the slightest.

lines.content: ……俺たちを乗せバスは学園へと向かう。
lines.translated: Carrying us inside, the bus headed toward the academy.

lines.content: さくらの花。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 粉雪のように。
lines.translated: Like powdery snow.

lines.content: 小雨のように。
lines.translated: Like a light rain.

lines.content: 車窓に触れては流れる桃色で、鮮やかに騒がしい町の風景。
lines.translated: A vividly bustling townscape, painted in pink petals that brushed against the bus window before flowing past.

lines.content: ……そして隣でささやかな笑みと共に会話を重ねる幼馴染みのふたり。
lines.translated: And beside me, my two childhood friends chatting away with small smiles on their faces.

lines.content: それらを眺めながら、俺は、考えている。
lines.translated: As I watched all of this, I was lost in thought.

lines.content: 『……私を魔法少女に戻してください』
lines.translated: "'...Please turn me back into a magical girl.'"

lines.content: ……昨日。
lines.translated: Yesterday.

lines.content: “夜の国”から帰ってきた俺と十夜を迎えたその言葉について。
lines.translated: About those words that greeted Toya and me when we returned from the "Land of Night."
About that girl, another childhood friend of mine who had come back.

lines.content: ……彼女が連れてきた幾つかの願いに、ついて。
lines.translated: About the several wishes she had brought with her.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my eyes.

lines.content: そして頬を小さく緩め――
lines.translated: And letting a small smile relax my cheeks--

lines.content: 俺は、昨晩あったことを思い出してみることにした。
lines.translated: I decided to look back on what had happened last night.

lines.content: その胸の中はどきどきなのか、それともわくわくなのか。
lines.translated: Was this feeling in my chest nervousness, or excitement?

lines.content: 今はまだ正体のわからない微かな高鳴りに満ちていた。
lines.translated: It was filled with a faint throbbing whose true nature I still didn't understand.

lines.content: 昨日――
lines.translated: Yesterday--

lines.content: お願いします。どうか私を、魔法少女に戻してください
lines.translated: "Please. I beg you, please turn me back into a magical girl."

lines.content: “夜の国”から帰宅してきた俺たちを迎えたその言葉。
lines.translated: Those words greeted us when we came home from the "Land of Night."

lines.content: ……もう一度だけ、私に魔法を使わせてください
lines.translated: "...Just one more time, please let me use magic."
The unfamiliar girl said this as if praying.

lines.content: そして俺は……。
lines.translated: And I...

lines.content: 俺は。
動けずにいた。
lines.translated: Couldn't move.

lines.content: お店の扉を開けて、“ただいま”と言いかけた口を少し、開いたまま。
lines.translated: With the shop door open, my mouth stayed slightly parted, frozen in the middle of saying "I'm home."

lines.content: 女の子がはっとした表情をして、こちらを振り向いた。
lines.translated: The girl gasped and turned to look at us.

lines.content: 驚いた顔。
lines.translated: A surprised face.

lines.content: 少しの沈黙。
lines.translated: A brief silence.

lines.content: 両目をぱちぱちとさせ、
lines.translated: She blinked her eyes several times,

lines.content: もしかして……
lines.translated: "Could you be..."

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 間違ってたら、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry if I'm mistaken."
Wait.

lines.content: 少女は恐る恐る、手探りでもするかのような様子で、次の言葉に繋いだ。
lines.translated: Timidly, as if feeling her way in the dark, the girl continued to her next words.

lines.content: あなたは、大雅、くん……？
lines.translated: "Are you... Taiga-kun...?"

lines.content: 首をかしげ。
lines.translated: She tilted her head.

lines.content: そしてもう一度、少女は俺のその名を呼んだのだ。
lines.translated: And once more, the girl called my name.

lines.content: もしかして奏大雅くん、なの……？
lines.translated: "Could you be Kanade Taiga-kun...?"

lines.content: どきりとした。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: どうして、俺の名前を……。
lines.translated: How does she know my name...?

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 正直なところ“まさか”、という気持ちはあった。
lines.translated: To be honest, a part of me thought, "No way."

lines.content: “魔法少女”
lines.translated: "Magical girl."

lines.content: 千和や姫織以外に、その言葉を貰った子は、後[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]しか俺は知らない……。
lines.translated: Aside from Chiwa and Himeori, I only knew two other girls who had been given that title...

lines.content: 『……ねえ、大雅くん。あの子にばっかりやさしくして……。私、なんだかちょっとさみしいよ』
lines.translated: "'...Hey, Taiga-kun. You're only ever nice to her... It makes me feel a little lonely.'"

lines.content: またしても“まさかな”と思う。
lines.translated: Once again, I thought, "No way."

lines.content: もしもこの少女が、記憶の中の少女であるのなら……。
lines.translated: If this girl really was the girl from my memories...

lines.content: その横顔。
lines.translated: Her profile.

lines.content: その身体つき。
lines.translated: Her build.

lines.content: その、空気感。
lines.translated: Her entire aura.

lines.content: すべてがまるで別人。
lines.translated: Everything about her was like a completely different person.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|頃]のことを思い出せば思い出すだけ、あまりにも変わってしまった外見の印象に驚いてしまう。
lines.translated: The more I remembered back then, the more astonished I was by how drastically her appearance had changed.

lines.content: だが、どんなに驚いてしまおうと。
lines.translated: However, no matter how surprised I might be.

lines.content: 認めがたい事実だと混乱、してしまおうと。
lines.translated: No matter how confused I was by a fact so hard to accept.

lines.content: [・|ふ][・|た][・|り]の内ひとりしか、もう、こうして再会できる可能性のある子はいない。
lines.translated: Of those two, there was only one girl left whom I could possibly reunite with like this.

lines.content: だからきっと、この子は――
lines.translated: So surely, this girl was--

lines.content: ねえ、どうしたの大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, what's wrong, Taiga?"

lines.content: 焦れたような声が背後から。
lines.translated: An impatient voice came from behind me.

lines.content: そんなところで立ち止まってちゃ入れないよ
lines.translated: "If you stop right there, I can't get in."

lines.content: ぐいっと――
lines.translated: Squeezing through--

lines.content: 俺の右腋から小さな頭をねじ込む様にして、十夜が顔を出す。
lines.translated: Toya poked her face out, wedging her small head under my right arm.

lines.content: そして少女の姿を見つけた十夜。
lines.translated: And then Toya spotted the girl.

lines.content: きょとんとする――
lines.translated: She looked dumbfounded--

lines.content: あ、ああ……！
lines.translated: "Ah, aah...!"

lines.content: ――のも、一瞬だった。
lines.translated: --Though only for an instant.

lines.content: 少女の姿を見つけるなり、すぐさま大きな声を上げると、
lines.translated: The moment she saw the girl, she immediately let out a loud voice,

lines.content: すごい！　ハルちゃんだ……！
lines.translated: "Amazing! It's Haru-chan...!"

lines.content: 人見知りなはずの小さな子が目を輝かせた。
lines.translated: The little girl, who was supposed to be shy around strangers, had her eyes sparkling.

lines.content: そして少女の下へと駆け寄っていった。
lines.translated: And then she ran right up to the girl.

lines.content: ハルと呼ばれた女の子は首を傾げるも、
lines.translated: The girl called Haru tilted her head,

lines.content: 十夜……？
lines.translated: "Toya...?"

lines.content: すぐに、顔を綻ばせる。
lines.translated: Her face immediately broke into a smile.

lines.content: 足下に飛びついてきた十夜を軽く抱き留めた。
lines.translated: She gently caught Toya, who had tackled her around the legs.

lines.content: ねえねえ本当？　本当にハルちゃんなの？　どうしたの？　いつ？　いつ帰ってきたの？
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, really? Is it really Haru-chan? What happened? When? When did you come back?"

lines.content: 十夜は足元にじゃれ付く子猫のようだ。
lines.translated: Toya was like a kitten playfully pawing at her feet.

lines.content: 珍しい。
lines.translated: What a rare sight.

lines.content: 人見知りの代名詞というか、その見本だったり模範だったりする十夜が、何の躊躇いもなくじゃれついている。
lines.translated: Toya, who was practically the poster child--the very textbook example--of shyness around strangers, was clinging to her without a shred of hesitation.

lines.content: うん……、えっと、今日帰ってきたの。ついさっきだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... um, I came back today. Just a little while ago."

lines.content: 照れくさそうに少女は言う。
lines.translated: The girl spoke bashfully.

lines.content: だけどすぐに不思議そうな表情に変わり、
lines.translated: However, her expression quickly turned curious,

lines.content: ちょっと事情があって……昔住んでた施設に戻らなきゃならなくなったの
lines.translated: "Some things came up... and I had to return to the facility I used to live in."

lines.content: 引っ越しの作業とか施設に入り直すための手続きだとか……そういうの全部終わらしたら、ここに来なきゃって……思って
lines.translated: "Once I finished unpacking and going through all the procedures to move back in... I felt like I just had to come here."

lines.content: そう言う少女の手には“鍵”が一本、握られていた。
lines.translated: As she said this, the girl held a single "key" tightly in her hand.

lines.content: ……なんだかすごく懐かしくなって……昔みたいにここの、“ゆめのねどこ”の扉に鍵を差し込んでみたんだけど……私、まだまだここにやって来れるみたいだね。驚いちゃった
lines.translated: "...A wave of nostalgia washed over me... so I tried putting my key into the door to the 'Dream Bed,' just like in the old days... It looks like I'm still able to come here. It really surprised me."

lines.content: 複雑そうに少女は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: The girl gave a complicated smile.

lines.content: 今日の日までなくさず持ち続けていた鍵をぎゅっと握りしめたまま。
lines.translated: All the while, she clutched the key she had kept safe until today.

lines.content: そうだな。……私も、ビックリしたよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...It surprised me, too."

lines.content: あさひさんが言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke up.

lines.content: 俺を迎えてくれたときと同じように、テーブルに座り、本を読んでいたようだ。
lines.translated: Just like when she first welcomed me, she seemed to have been sitting at the table reading a book.

lines.content: しかしその顔は困惑の色。
lines.translated: However, her face was tinged with perplexity.

lines.content: この少女とついさっきまで、何か込み入った話をしていたのだろうと想像はできる。
lines.translated: It wasn't hard to imagine that she and this girl had been in the middle of a complicated conversation until just a moment ago.

lines.content: そしてあのせりふ――
lines.translated: And then there were those words--

lines.content: “私を魔法少女に戻してください”
lines.translated: "Please turn me back into a magical girl."

lines.content: そして帰ってきた俺を振り向いたときに少女が見せた――違和感。
lines.translated: Not to mention the sense of unease the girl had shown when she turned to look at me as I came back.

lines.content: 何か……。
lines.translated: Something was off...

lines.content: 和気藹々と会話を楽しめるような空気ではなかった。それだけは想像できる。
lines.translated: It clearly wasn't the kind of atmosphere where we could just enjoy a lighthearted chat. That much I could tell.

lines.content: だけど足元の十夜の頭を撫でながら、女の子は――
lines.translated: Even so, while stroking Toya's head at her feet, the girl--

lines.content: ハルと呼ばれた女の子は、そのまま俺に視線を向けた。
lines.translated: The girl called Haru turned her gaze straight toward me.

lines.content: あ、ええっと……
lines.translated: "Ah, umm..."

lines.content: 照れ笑いのような、気まずげな顔をする。
lines.translated: She gave an awkward, bashful smile.

lines.content: ただいま、大雅くん。久しぶりだね
lines.translated: "I'm back, Taiga-kun. It's been a long time."

lines.content: 千和ちゃんや姫織ちゃんたちは元気？
lines.translated: "How are Chiwa-chan, Himeori-chan, and the others doing?"

lines.content: 少女は首を傾げていた。
lines.translated: The girl tilted her head.

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は少しの戸惑いと共に、うなずく。
lines.translated: Though a little bewildered, I nodded.

lines.content: みんな元気だ。相変わらずだ。……きっと、このことを話せばみんな喜ぶ
lines.translated: "Everyone's doing well. Same as always. ...I'm sure they'll be thrilled when I tell them about this."

lines.content: 随分と変わってしまった女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who had changed so much.
Even if I couldn't help but sense a slight hesitation in my own words...

lines.content: だが、彼女の浮かべるその笑顔だけは、変わっていなかった。
lines.translated: Still, the smile on her face hadn't changed one bit.

lines.content: だからこそ安心し……。
lines.translated: That alone brought me relief...

lines.content: だからこそ、俺は遠い昔のことをどうしたって思い出さずにはいられない。
lines.translated: And because of that, I couldn't stop myself from remembering the distant past.

lines.content: 十年ぶりの再会となる幼馴染みの女の子。
lines.translated: A childhood friend I was reuniting with for the first time in ten years.

lines.content: かつて杏藤千和や、夜月姫織と同じように、特別な少女だった、[ひいらぎ|柊]ハルという名の彼女のことを……。
lines.translated: Her name was Hiiragi Haru--a girl who, just like Andou Chiwa and Yotsuki Himeori, used to be someone special...

lines.content: およそ十年前。
lines.translated: Roughly ten years ago.

lines.content: かつて“魔法少女”と名付けられた女の子たちは人知れず世界を救った。
lines.translated: The girls once christened "magical girls" had secretly saved the world.

lines.content: 誰も知らない真夜中の世界で“戦争”があったのだ。
lines.translated: A "war" had been fought in the midnight world, unbeknownst to anyone.
Just four magical girls.

lines.content: 力を合わせ、“夜の国”で人々の心を食い荒らそうとしていた、過去最大にして最凶最悪の“悪夢”を退けて――
lines.translated: Joining forces, they drove back the largest, most wicked, and most horrific "Nightmare" in history, which had been trying to devour people's hearts in the "Land of Night"--

lines.content: 結果。
lines.translated: As a result.

lines.content: 少女たちの手には勝利が握られた。
lines.translated: The girls grasped victory in their hands.

lines.content: 彼女らが関わることを余儀なくされた“[・|人][・|類][・|滅][・|亡][・|を][・|阻][・|止][・|す][・|る][・|た][・|め][・|の][・|物][・|語]”は、事実上ハッピーエンドということになったのだ。
lines.translated: The "story to prevent the extinction of humanity" that they had been forced to take part in had, for all intents and purposes, reached a happy ending.

lines.content: 少女たちの戦いはそこで終わる。
lines.translated: The girls' battle ended there.

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれの日常へと帰還する――はずだった。
lines.translated: Each of them was supposed to return to her own everyday life.

lines.content: ……結果。
lines.translated: As a result.

lines.content: 理不尽な話だけれど。
lines.translated: Unfair as it was.

lines.content: どうしようもなく、酷い話だけれど。
lines.translated: As hopelessly cruel as it was.

lines.content: 人類の未来は救われたが、少女たちの未来が救われることはなかった……。
lines.translated: Humanity's future had been saved, yet the girls' own futures were not...

lines.content: 『……どうしよう。こんなはずじゃ、なかったのに』
lines.translated: "'...What do I do? It wasn't supposed to be like this.'"

lines.content: 本来バラバラの場所に産まれ、それぞれの人生を生きていた少女たち。
lines.translated: The girls had originally been born in completely different places, each living her own separate life.

lines.content: 『……どうして。いっぱいがんばった。がんばったんだよ』
lines.translated: "'...Why? I tried so hard. I really did my best.'"

lines.content: 少女らは願いを叶えることができなかったようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed the girls' wishes had not been granted.

lines.content: 『……ねえ、誰か教えて。私は本当に世界を、救えたの？』
lines.translated: "'...Hey, someone tell me. Did I really save the world?'"

lines.content: 少女らは、自分たちの置かれた状況や境遇に悲観するばかりの日々。
lines.translated: They spent their days doing nothing but despairing over their circumstances and the situations they had been placed in.

lines.content: 漠然とした不安ばかりが膨れていく。
lines.translated: Nothing but vague anxiety continued to swell inside them.

lines.content: ただただ、呆然とするばかりの毎日だった。
lines.translated: Every single day was spent in a hollow daze.

lines.content: 少女らの心に仄暗い“夜”が忍び寄る。
lines.translated: A dim, dark "night" began creeping into the girls' hearts.

lines.content: そんな少女たちの中心に立ったのが、あの子だった。
lines.translated: The one who stood at the center of those girls was her.

lines.content: 『ねえ。なんだかおかしいよ。みんな揃って、不幸になる練習ばかりしてるみたいだよ』
lines.translated: "'Hey. Something's weird about this. It's like we're all getting together just to practice being miserable.'"

lines.content: あの子は微笑み、そう言った。
lines.translated: She smiled and said those words.
"'Come on, let's start a treasure hunt. Let's go look for fun things.'"

lines.content: 今思えば、そのたった一言が、きっとあの頃の俺たちの世界を変えたのだ。
lines.translated: Looking back now, that single phrase must have been what changed our world back then.

lines.content: 『みんなこれからもずっと、ずっと、泣いてばかりで暮らしていくの？　嫌だな。私はそんなの、絶対、嫌だよ』
lines.translated: "'Are we all just going to keep crying forever and ever from now on? No way. I'd hate that--I'd absolutely hate it.'"

lines.content: 『きっと、私たちの“楽しいこと”は、今はちょっと迷子になってるだけなんだよ。世界のどこかに隠れちゃったんだよ。だったらこっちから迎えに行ってあげなくちゃ』
lines.translated: "'I'm sure all our "fun things" have just gotten a little lost right now. They're hiding somewhere out there in the world. So we just have to go and pick them up ourselves.'"

lines.content: それらの言葉をきっかけにして……。
lines.translated: Sparked by those words...

lines.content: 彼女が俺たちの中心に立った日から、日々はめまぐるしく過ぎていった。
lines.translated: From the day she stood at our center, the days flew by in a dizzying blur.

lines.content: 彼女と共に在った幼い頃は毎日が冒険の日々だった。
lines.translated: Back when we were young and she was with us, every single day was an adventure.

lines.content: 怖い大人たちを無意味に困らせるためだけの悪戯をしてみたり。
lines.translated: We played pointless pranks just to give the scary adults a hard time.

lines.content: 施設の門限などと言った可愛い規則をみんなで揃って破ってみたりした。
lines.translated: And we all banded together to break cute little rules like the facility's curfew.

lines.content: ……それらの些細な“遊び”は、取るに足らないものであったからこそ楽しくて。
lines.translated: Those trivial "games" were fun precisely because they were so insignificant.

lines.content: きっと、幼い日々に見つけた“宝物”だった。
lines.translated: Surely, they were the "treasures" we found in our childhood days.

lines.content: 暗澹として重苦しい世界は瞬く間に“楽しいこと”で色づいていった。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, our bleak, oppressive world was colored with "fun things."

lines.content: ……彼女がこの町を去ってしまう、その瞬間までは。
lines.translated: Right up until the moment she left this town.

lines.content: 別れの理由はとても現実的で、シンプルなものだったけれど。
lines.translated: The reason for our parting was very realistic, and very simple.

lines.content: とにかく彼女はひとり、この町を去ることになった。
lines.translated: Regardless, she ended up leaving this town all by herself.

lines.content: それがおよそ十年前の出来事だ。
lines.translated: That happened roughly ten years ago.

lines.content: 彼女がくれた繋がりだったり言葉だったり、笑顔だったりは――
lines.translated: The bonds she gave us, her words, her smile--

lines.content: あえて口に出すことはなくとも、今も俺たちの中に消えずに残り続けていた。
lines.translated: Even if we never said it out loud, they remained within us to this very day, never fading away.

lines.content: ……なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: こんなにもわざとらしい言葉を、こんなにも、気恥ずかしいばかりのせりふを。
lines.translated: Such contrived words, such utterly embarrassing lines.

lines.content: 柄にもなくつらつら並べてしまえるほど、彼女の存在は俺や、俺たちにとって特別な意味を持っていたのだ。
lines.translated: The fact that I could string them together so uncharacteristically just went to show how special her existence was to me, and to all of us.

lines.content: そんな彼女が。
lines.translated: And now, that very girl.

lines.content: もう、この[物語|世界]にとって特別な存在ではなくなってしまったはずの“元、魔法少女”が……。
lines.translated: A "former magical girl" who was no longer supposed to be a special existence to this world...

lines.content: ――だけど、俺たちにとっては確かに特別であり続けたはずの、彼女が。
lines.translated: --Yet who had undoubtedly remained special to us all along.

lines.content: ……お願いします。あさひさん、私にもう一度だけ魔法を、使わせてください
lines.translated: "...Please. Asahi-san, please let me use magic just one more time."

lines.content: こうして、今、俺の目の前にいる。
lines.translated: Was standing right here, right in front of my eyes.

lines.content: さて、今夜はシチューだ。たくさん作ったから、いっぱい食べてくれたらうれしいな
lines.translated: "Now then, we're having stew tonight. I made plenty, so I'd be happy if you all ate your fill."

lines.content: 台所からエプロンを外しながらあさひさんがやって来た。
lines.translated: Asahi-san walked over from the kitchen, taking off her apron.

lines.content: 揚げたての鶏の唐揚げ。
lines.translated: Freshly fried chicken karaage.

lines.content: 新鮮な野菜をちぎって盛りつけた彩り鮮やかなサラダ。
lines.translated: A vibrant, colorful salad of freshly torn vegetables.

lines.content: あさひさん手作りのチーズまで並ぶテーブルは、賑やかだ。
lines.translated: The table was a lively spread, even featuring Asahi-san's homemade cheese.

lines.content: 味の方も上手にできたと思うんだ……。口に合えば良いけれど
lines.translated: "I think the seasoning turned out pretty well, too... I hope it suits your tastes."

lines.content: 俺の向かいに座りあさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said as she sat down across from me.

lines.content: それじゃ、うん……。いただこうか
lines.translated: "Well then, yeah... Let's dig in."

lines.content: いただきま～すっ
lines.translated: "Thanks for the food~!"

lines.content: みんな揃って合掌をする。
lines.translated: We all put our hands together.

lines.content: 込み入った話はお夕飯を食べながら――
lines.translated: For now, we had decided to save the complicated talk for while we ate dinner--

lines.content: とりあえずそういう運びとなった、ハルを一緒に加えての食事である。
lines.translated: Which meant Haru was joining us at the table as well.

lines.content: ……[クロ|あの子]は、いない。
lines.translated: That girl--Kuro--wasn't here.

lines.content: あさひさんが用意してくれた二階の部屋に引きこもったままなのだという。
lines.translated: Apparently, she was still holed up in the second-floor room Asahi-san had prepared for her.

lines.content: 呼びかけても返事はない。
lines.translated: Even when called, there was no answer.

lines.content: クロの食事は後から俺が部屋に持って行くことになった。
lines.translated: It was decided that I would bring Kuro's meal up to her room later.

lines.content: どうやらあさひさんは既に俺とクロがこの家に住み込むことを想定し、準備していたらしい。
lines.translated: It seemed Asahi-san had already anticipated that Kuro and I would be moving into this house and had made preparations accordingly.

lines.content: （二階の部屋、か）
lines.translated: (A room on the second floor, huh.)

lines.content: 俺は天井をふと見上げた。
lines.translated: I suddenly glanced up at the ceiling.

lines.content: こうして俺たちがわいわい食事するその声が届かないわけもないだろう。
lines.translated: There was no way the lively sounds of us eating together wouldn't reach her up there.

lines.content: ひとりでさみしい思いはしていないだろうか。
lines.translated: I wondered if she was feeling lonely all by herself.

lines.content: 少し、心配だった。
lines.translated: I was a little worried.

lines.content: すごい。美味しそう
lines.translated: "Wow. Everything looks delicious."

lines.content: ハルはどこか懐かしそうに目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Haru narrowed her eyes with a somewhat nostalgic look on her face.

lines.content: 誰かの手料理食べるのも久しぶりだから、えっと、なんだかとても……うれしいです
lines.translated: "It's been a long time since I've had someone's home-cooked meal, so, um, I'm really... happy."

lines.content: 昔はここに集まってくる子たちみんなでご飯を食べたよなあ。千和に教えてもらったもんじゃ焼きの味は未だに忘れられないくらいだ
lines.translated: "Back in the day, all the kids who gathered here used to eat together, didn't they? Even now, I still can't forget the taste of the monjayaki Chiwa taught me how to make."

lines.content: あさひさんもしみじみとそう言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said wistfully.

lines.content: 最近は、大雅もあまり頻繁にはここへ来てくれていなかったから。ご飯も造りがいがなくて困ってたんだ
lines.translated: "Lately, Taiga hasn't been coming by all that often, either. It was a real problem, since it didn't feel worth the effort to cook."

lines.content: 意地悪げな視線を向けられる。
lines.translated: She shot me a teasing look.

lines.content: 俺は言葉もなく苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: Left speechless, all I could do was give a wry smile.

lines.content: だから、ハル。またこうして会えて、とてもうれしい
lines.translated: "So, Haru. I'm really happy we could meet again like this."

lines.content: また昔みたいにここへ遊びに来てくれたらと思う。十夜も喜ぶし
lines.translated: "I hope you'll come hang out here again just like old times. It'll make Toya happy, too."

lines.content: はい……
ハルは笑顔を返した。
lines.translated: Haru returned her smile.

lines.content: その笑顔に違和感はない。
lines.translated: Nothing seemed out of place about that smile.

lines.content: どこにも、ない――
lines.translated: Nothing at all--

lines.content: （……ように、見えるけど）
lines.translated: (...At least, that's how it looks.)

lines.content: ――俺は、俺しか知らない[・|彼][・|女][・|の][・|秘][・|密]について思う。
lines.translated: --I thought about her secret, the one only I knew.

lines.content: そして、遠い思い出の中の彼女を思う。
lines.translated: And I thought of her as she was in my distant memories.
"'...Hey, Taiga-kun. Did I do a good job today?'"

lines.content: 誰にも見せず。
lines.translated: Shown to no one.

lines.content: 誰にも知られず。
lines.translated: Known by no one.
Her secret, which had been kept safe all that time.

lines.content: いつもみんなの中心に咲いていた彼女の笑顔のその裏側に。
lines.translated: Behind that smile of hers that had always bloomed at the center of everyone.

lines.content: 彼女は、彼女だけの[物語|問題]を抱え込んでいた――なんて言うのは大げさな言い方かもしれない。
lines.translated: She had been carrying a problem--a story--all her own, though maybe putting it like that is a bit of an exaggeration.

lines.content: だけどかつての彼女は、自分の[・|秘][・|密]を俺だけに教えてくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, back then, she had shared her secret with me and me alone.

lines.content: まだあの秘密は変わらず彼女の中に、柊ハルの中に在るのだろうか。
lines.translated: Did that secret still remain unchanged within her--within Hiiragi Haru?

lines.content: なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: あさひさんの問いかけ。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke up with a question.

lines.content: こちらへは帰ってきたばかりだというようなことを言っていたけれど。何か、特別な理由でもあったのかな
lines.translated: "You mentioned something about having just come back here. Was there some kind of special reason for it?"

lines.content: ……はい
ハルはうなずき、ぽつりぽつりと、答える。
lines.translated: Haru nodded and answered haltingly, word by word.

lines.content: 特別な事情、というか……
lines.translated: "Well, I wouldn't call it special circumstances, exactly..."

lines.content: ただ、ちょっと。私を引き取ってくれた新しいお父さんとお母さん……[ふたり|里親]のお家を出ることになったので、ここに、戻ってくることにしました
lines.translated: "It's just that, well... It was decided that I'd be leaving the house of the new mom and dad who took me in... my foster parents' house, so I decided to come back here."

lines.content: 煮え切らない返答にどこか座りの悪いものを覚えてしまう。
lines.translated: Her vague answer left me with an unsettled feeling in the pit of my stomach.

lines.content: あさひさんは何も言わず、冷たいお茶の満たされたコップに口を付けた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said nothing, simply bringing a glass filled with cold tea to her lips.

lines.content: その横顔はそれ以上、ハルの“事情”を追求すべきか否か考えているようにも見えた。
lines.translated: From her profile, she seemed to be contemplating whether or not she should press any further into Haru's "circumstances."

lines.content: 十年前。“夜の王”との戦いを終えた俺たちは……。
lines.translated: Ten years ago. After finishing our battle with the "King of the Night," we...

lines.content: 日中は特に用もないのに、この“ゆめのねどこ”に集まっては時間を潰し――
lines.translated: Would gather at this "Bed of Dreams" during the day to kill time even when we had nothing in particular to do--

lines.content: 夜は山の上の施設で身を寄せ合って暮らしていた。
lines.translated: And at night, we lived huddled together at the facility up on the mountain.

lines.content: 柊ハルがこの町を去ったのは[・|迎][・|え]が来たからだ。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru left this town because someone came for her.

lines.content: 彼女のことを愛してくれるやさしい人たちに手をひかれ……。
lines.translated: Taken by the hand by kind people who loved her...

lines.content: そうして整えられた彼女の新しい生活は、この町の中には存在し得なかったからである。
lines.translated: Because the new life that had been arranged for her simply could not exist within this town.

lines.content: そのため惜しまれつつも――そうだ、充分に惜しまれつつ、柊ハルはこの町を、俺たちの元を去ったのだ。
lines.translated: And so, though we were sad to see her go--yes, dearly missed by everyone, Hiiragi Haru left this town and left us behind.

lines.content: “またいつか絶対みんなで会おう”
lines.translated: "Let's definitely all meet again someday."

lines.content: “そのときが来ることを信じてる”
lines.translated: "I believe that day will come."

lines.content: ごくごく当たり前でしかない約束を幾つか交わして。
lines.translated: Having exchanged a few utterly ordinary promises like that.

lines.content: そうか。ならまた、あの山の上の施設でハルは暮らすことになるのかな
lines.translated: "I see. Then I suppose you'll be living at that facility up on the mountain again, Haru?"

lines.content: この日のあさひさんは、ハルの事情について“そうか”の一言を投げかけるだけで済ませることにしたようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed that today, Asahi-san had decided to leave the matter of Haru's circumstances at a simple "I see."

lines.content: 新しい両親の元をどうして離れる決意をしたのか――
lines.translated: Why had she decided to leave her new parents?

lines.content: ふつうなら当然抱いてしまうだろう疑問には触れようとしなかった。
lines.translated: Asahi-san made no attempt to touch upon the question anyone would naturally have.

lines.content: あさひさんはいつだって俺たちにとって見習うべき“大人”の姿だった。
lines.translated: To us, Asahi-san had always been the model of an "adult" we should look up to.

lines.content: 少し子どもっぽいところがあっても、それもまた、好意的に思えてしまう。
lines.translated: Even if she had a slightly childish side, we couldn't help but view that fondly as well.

lines.content: ……そんなあさひさんの、質問というよりは事実確認といったほうがいいだろう言葉に、ハルは『そうなります』とうなずいた。
lines.translated: In response to Asahi-san's words, which were more of a confirmation of the facts than a question, Haru nodded and said, "That's right."

lines.content: 施設には今日の夕方付けで引っ越すつもりでいました
lines.translated: "I was planning on moving into the facility as of this evening."

lines.content: ……なるほど。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: 本日施設を出た俺。
lines.translated: I had left the facility today.

lines.content: そして本日、施設へと戻ってきたハル。
lines.translated: And today, Haru had returned to the facility.

lines.content: 入れ違いだ。ものの見事に。
lines.translated: We had traded places. Completely and utterly.

lines.content: なんにせよ。また少しは賑やかになるのなら、それはいいことだよな
lines.translated: "In any case. If things get a little livelier around here again, that's a good thing."

lines.content: これから改めてよろしく、柊ハル。君さえよければ歓迎するよ
lines.translated: "Once again, it's good to have you back, Hiiragi Haru. As long as you're okay with it, you're more than welcome here."

lines.content: 私たちの日常へようこそ、とあさひさんはにこりと笑った。
lines.translated: "Welcome to our everyday life," Asahi-san said with a warm smile.

lines.content: 君も大雅と一緒にここに住む……というわけには、いかないのかな？
lines.translated: "Don't suppose you could come live here together with Taiga, too?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ハルはきょとんとする。
lines.translated: Haru blinked in surprise.

lines.content: 大雅くんと、一緒に？
lines.translated: "Together with... Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: もう施設に手続きを済ませてしまっているのなら、中々すぐにはそうできないだろうけど……でも、ハル。君がその気になったなら、いつでも……
lines.translated: "If you've already finished the paperwork with the facility, it probably won't be easy to do right away... But, Haru. If you ever feel like it, you're welcome anytime..."

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと……ちょっと待って、お姉ちゃんっ
lines.translated: "W-Wait... wait a second, Onee-chan!"

lines.content: そこで十夜が声を挟んだ。
lines.translated: Toyachimed in right then.

lines.content: 少し慌てたように、フォークを置く。
lines.translated: Looking a little flustered, she set down her fork.

lines.content: 大雅……、今日から？　住むの？　ここに……？
lines.translated: "Taiga... starting today? You're living? Here...?"

lines.content: 十夜はそろりと俺を見上げる。
lines.translated: Toya slowly looked up at me.

lines.content: うん。そうだよ。お姉ちゃんと大雅との約束だったんだよ。そしてお姉ちゃんの夢でもあった
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. It was a promise between me and Taiga. And it was also my dream."

lines.content: え？　夢、ですか……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Your dream...?"

lines.content: 意外な言葉に俺は少し驚く。
lines.translated: I was a little surprised by the unexpected word.

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: だってこれはずっとずっと、考えていたことなんだ。後悔、していたんだ
lines.translated: "Because it's something I've been thinking about for a really, really long time. Something I've regretted."

lines.content: 本当は、大雅。ハル
lines.translated: "The truth is, Taiga. Haru."

lines.content: 君たちを施設になんて……、身寄りのない子が住むための場所にだなんて、しかもこんなにも長く、住まわせていたくなかったんだよ
lines.translated: "I never wanted to make the two of you live in a facility... in a place meant for children with no relatives, especially not for this long."

lines.content: ……十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: 少女たちの“戦争”が終わってすぐの当時。
lines.translated: Right after the girls' "war" had come to an end.

lines.content: [・|役][・|割]を終えた少女たちと、“人類の未来を守る”といった大きな物語の中で、何の役にも立てなかったこの俺は行き場をなくす。
lines.translated: The girls who had fulfilled their roles, and I, who hadn't been able to do a single useful thing in the grand story of "protecting the future of humanity," lost our place to belong.

lines.content: 社会的に正当な手続き上の流れ、とでもいうのか。
lines.translated: You could call it the socially proper, procedural course of events.

lines.content: 身寄りのなかった俺とハルは、別段やさしくもなく大きなお世話を焼くでもない、ごくごくふつうの大人たちに手を引かれ、山の上の施設に収容されたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Having no relatives, Haru and I were taken by the hand by utterly ordinary adults--who were neither particularly kind nor overly meddlesome--and placed in the facility up on the mountain...

lines.content: それでいいと俺たちは思っていたし、むしろそれがいいのだとさえ考えていた。
lines.translated: We thought that was fine, and in fact, we even thought it was for the best.

lines.content: ひとりきりになる時間が俺たちには必要だった。
lines.translated: We needed time to be alone.

lines.content: 静かに、可能な限り深く、自分たちの今後について考えるだけの、時間が。
lines.translated: Time to quietly, and as deeply as possible, think about our futures.

lines.content: それ故に、むしろ俺たちは進んで施設に収容されたのだと言っても語弊はないだろう。
lines.translated: Because of that, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say we willingly went into the facility.

lines.content: だけどあさひさんは[・|そ][・|れ]を後悔しているのだとそう言った。
lines.translated: Yet Asahi-san said she regretted *that*.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでいると決めてしまった人間の心には、いつだって、深く冷たい[闇色|夜]が忍び寄る――
lines.translated: "Deep, cold darkness--the Night--always creeps into the hearts of those who have decided to be all alone--"

lines.content: それを知らない私ではないはずだと、そんな、“想像”の足りない私でいてはいけないはず、だったのに……
lines.translated: "I knew that better than anyone, and I never should have been so lacking in 'imagination,' and yet..."

lines.content: あのときどうして、俺とハルのふたりを強く引き留めなかったのか――
lines.translated: Why hadn't she insisted harder on keeping Haru and me back then--?

lines.content: ちょっと乱暴にでも引き留めて、俺たちふたりをここに住まわせてしまわなかったのか――
lines.translated: Why hadn't she held us back, even if she had to be a little rough about it, and made the two of us live here--?

lines.content: そうして[・|君]がひとりぼっちになってしまっても尚、強くその手を引き、連れてくることができなかったのか――
lines.translated: And even after *you* ended up all alone, why couldn't she have pulled you strongly by the hand and brought you here--?

lines.content: それをきっと私は後悔してる。今でも、ずっとだ
lines.translated: "I'm sure I regret that. Even now, I always have."

lines.content: ……そして今、ようやく私の“夢”が叶う
lines.translated: "...And now, my 'dream' is finally coming true."

lines.content: ふと微笑むあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san suddenly smiled.

lines.content: まあ、うん
lines.translated: "Well, yeah."

lines.content: ここで一緒に暮らしたからと言って、嫌なことが何もなくなるとは言えないし、その保証なんてもちろんできやしないけど
lines.translated: "Just because we live together here doesn't mean all the bad things will go away, and of course I can't guarantee anything like that."

lines.content: でも、ハル。もしも可能なら、今度こそハルも大雅と一緒に、ここで――
lines.translated: "Even so, Haru. If it's possible, this time I want you to live here together with Taiga, too--"

lines.content: ちょっと、ちょっと待ってってば、お姉ちゃん……っ
lines.translated: "W-Wait a second, I said wait, Onee-chan...!"

lines.content: 十夜がおろおろとしていた。
lines.translated: Toya was all flustered.

lines.content: 未だに状況を把握し切れていないようだった。
lines.translated: It seemed she still hadn't fully grasped the situation.

lines.content: ね、ねえねえ、お話、整理していい？
lines.translated: "H-Hey, wait, can I get things straight here?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。ごめん。お夕飯の席なのについ長話になっちゃった。話が長いのはお姉ちゃんの悪い癖だな
lines.translated: "Ah, right. Sorry. We're in the middle of dinner, and I ended up rambling. Talking too long is your big sister's bad habit."

lines.content: つまり。あの……それって、これからずっとずっと、大雅、お家に住むの……？
lines.translated: "So, in other words. Um... does that mean Taiga is going to live in our house forever and ever starting now...?"

lines.content: うん。お姉ちゃんはそうして欲しいと願ってる。ずっとじゃなくて、[・|可][・|能][・|な][・|限][・|り][・|ね]。あとは大雅次第かな。ほら、直接聞いてみようか
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's what I'm hoping for. Well, maybe not forever, *just for as long as possible*. The rest is up to Taiga, I guess. Go on, why don't you ask him directly?"

lines.content: 十夜は俺を振り向く。あさひさんもだ。
lines.translated: Toya turned to look at me. Asahi-san did, too.

lines.content: ……本気？
lines.translated: "...Are you serious?"

lines.content: 首を少しかしげる。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: 大雅、ここに住んじゃうの？　今日から一緒？
lines.translated: "Taiga, are you really moving in here? Together with us starting today?"

lines.content: えっと……
考える。
lines.translated: I thought about it.

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: どう、答えればいいだろう――
lines.translated: How should I answer her--?

lines.content: だ、なんてことを考えるのも今更だし、ちょっとわざとらしすぎるだろう。
lines.translated: Or rather, it was a bit late to be wondering about that now, and playing coy would just seem way too forced.

lines.content: だからもう俺は素直に伝えることにした。
lines.translated: So I decided to just tell her honestly.

lines.content: うん。そうしようかなって思ってる。あさひさんの言うとおり、そういう約束だったからね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's what I'm thinking of doing. Like Asahi-san said, that was our promise."

lines.content: ……もしも十夜が許してくれるなら、だけど
lines.translated: "...As long as you're okay with it, Toya."

lines.content: う、そ、そう、なんだ……
lines.translated: "O-Oh, I-I see..."

lines.content: 十夜はおどおどとしていた。
lines.translated: Toya looked flustered and hesitant.

lines.content: その横顔は、真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: Her profile was bright red.

lines.content: 鼻先まで赤く染まってしまっている。
lines.translated: She was blushing all the way to the tip of her nose.

lines.content: だけどそのまま食事を再開させた。
lines.translated: Even so, she went right back to eating.

lines.content: 少しずつ、少しずつ、お行儀良くフォークを口元に運んでいる。
lines.translated: Little by little, bit by bit, she politely brought the fork to her mouth.

lines.content: ……意外だった。
lines.translated: That was unexpected.

lines.content: 驚きもした。
lines.translated: It surprised me, too.

lines.content: 正直なところ、声を上げて『そんなの絶対反対だよ！』とか言って嫌がられるだろうと思っていたのだ。
lines.translated: To be honest, I'd thought she would raise her voice, say something like, "I'm totally against that!" and hate the idea.

lines.content: むしろ『私の気持ちが置いてきぼりだよお姉ちゃん！』と、あさひさんと揃って怒られるだろうとさえ思っていたのに――
lines.translated: In fact, I'd even expected her to get mad at both Asahi-san and me, saying, "You're completely ignoring my feelings, Onee-chan!" And yet--

lines.content: ……えへへ
lines.translated: "...Ehehe."

lines.content: へにゃりと。
lines.translated: Her expression melted into a soft smile.

lines.content: 十夜は静かに笑った。
lines.translated: Toya laughed quietly.

lines.content: 口に運んでいたスプーンを咥えて、うれしそうに……。
lines.translated: With the spoon still in her mouth, she looked so happy...

lines.content: ぴこり
lines.translated: *Twitch.*

lines.content: 十夜の[・|気][・|持][・|ち]も、飛び出していた。
lines.translated: Toya's *feelings* had popped right out, too.

lines.content: なあ、十夜
lines.translated: "Hey, Toya."

lines.content: な、なあに
lines.translated: "Wh-What is it?"

lines.content: 焦る。
lines.translated: She panicked.

lines.content: ぷいっとそっぽを向いて、
lines.translated: Turning her head away in a huff, she spoke.

lines.content: ……違うよ？　別に、大雅がここに住むからって、うれしいとか、楽しそうかもとか、そんなこと思ってなんか
lines.translated: "...You're wrong, okay? It's not like I'm happy just because you're living here, Taiga, or thinking it might be fun, or anything like that."

lines.content: 違う違う
lines.translated: "No, no, not that."

lines.content: ……じゃあ、なに？
lines.translated: "...Then what?"

lines.content: 出てる
lines.translated: "They're out."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: きょとんとする。
lines.translated: She blinked in confusion.

lines.content: なにが？
lines.translated: "What is?"

lines.content: 耳。出てるよ
lines.translated: "Your ears. They're sticking out."

lines.content: えっ、う、うう……っ
lines.translated: "Eh? U-Uuu...!"

lines.content: 十夜は頭を押さえ、うつむく。
lines.translated: Toya pressed her hands against her head and looked down.

lines.content: しばらくなにも言わずそのままだったけど、
lines.translated: She stayed like that without saying a word for a little while, until...

lines.content: 変、だった？
lines.translated: "Did it... look weird?"

lines.content: また顔を真っ赤にして、そろりとこちらを見上げていた。
lines.translated: Her face bright red again, she slowly peeked up at me.

lines.content: ……まだ、私、お姉ちゃんみたいに上手にできないの。だから、外ではあんまり驚いたりしないようにって、がんばってるけど
lines.translated: "...I still can't do it as well as Onee-chan. So I try really hard not to get too surprised when I'm outside, though..."

lines.content: もにょもにょと言ったあと、改めて十夜は『変じゃなかった？』と聞いてきた。
lines.translated: After mumbling to herself, Toya asked me again, "Did it look weird?"

lines.content: うん、大丈夫
lines.translated: "No, it's fine."

lines.content: ほんと？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: ああ。変じゃない。むしろかわいかった。……そうだよね？
lines.translated: "Yeah. It wasn't weird at all. In fact, it was cute. ...Right?"

lines.content: ハルに同意を求めた。
lines.translated: I looked to Haru for agreement.

lines.content: えっ、うん。うんうん。もちろんだよ
lines.translated: "Eh? Yeah. Mhm, of course."

lines.content: 何度もうなずく。そして言う。
lines.translated: She nodded repeatedly. And then she said:

lines.content: 十夜かわいい。とても、とっても
lines.translated: "Toya is cute. Very, very cute."

lines.content: あ、う、うん……、ハルちゃんありがとう
lines.translated: "Ah, u-um... thank you, Haru-chan."

lines.content: 照れくさそう。
lines.translated: She looked embarrassed.

lines.content: もじもじしている。
lines.translated: She was fidgeting shyly.

lines.content: 頭を両手でなでつけている。
lines.translated: She smoothed down her hair with both hands.

lines.content: 腕を下ろすとそこにもう猫の耳はなくなっていた。
lines.translated: When she lowered her arms, the cat ears were already gone.

lines.content: あさひさん。十夜。ふたりは人間社会に紛れ込み生活している――日本的な言い方をあえて選べば――いわば化け猫だ。
lines.translated: Asahi-san. Toya. The two of them lived blended into human society--if I were to deliberately choose a traditional Japanese term for it--as bakeneko, so to speak.

lines.content: [・|町][・|か][・|ら][・|姿][・|を][・|消][・|し][・|た][・|猫][・|た][・|ち][・|は]、“夜の国”の力で人の姿となり、夜の中でのんびりと生きている。
lines.translated: *The cats that disappeared from the town* took on human forms through the power of the "Night Realm," living carefree lives within the night.

lines.content: 改めて聞いても良いかな、十夜
lines.translated: "Can I ask you again properly, Toya?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 俺さ。しばらくの間だけ、ここで寝起きさせて貰ってもいいかな
lines.translated: "Would it be okay if I lived here with you guys, just for a little while?"

lines.content: 十夜は何も言わず、だけどしっかりうなうずいてくれた。
lines.translated: Toya didn't say anything, but she gave me a firm nod.

lines.content: “いいよ”
lines.translated: "Sure."

lines.content: そんな声を確かに聞いた気になれる表情だった。
lines.translated: The look on her face made me feel like I had definitely heard her say those words.

lines.content: ありがとう。……本当は十夜にもっともっと嫌がられるかなって思って、どきどきしてたんだ。許してくれてよかった
lines.translated: "Thanks. ...Honestly, I was really nervous because I thought you'd hate the idea a lot more, Toya. I'm glad you're letting me stay."

lines.content: ……だって
lines.translated: "...Well, that's because..."

lines.content: 唇をとがらせ、十夜は言った。
lines.translated: Pouting her lips, Toya spoke.

lines.content: お友だち、いないから
lines.translated: "I don't have any friends."

lines.content: 友だち……？
lines.translated: "Friends...?"

lines.content: ……大雅、意地悪だけど。時どきちょっと、気持ち悪いけど
lines.translated: "...Taiga, you're mean. And sometimes you're a little gross."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: でも、でもね、大雅……いっぱい、遊んでくれるし
lines.translated: "But, you know, Taiga... you play with me a lot."

lines.content: じっと俺を見て……。
lines.translated: She stared straight at me...

lines.content: ……えへへ
lines.translated: "...Ehehe."

lines.content: へにゃっとし、笑った。
lines.translated: And her face softened into a gentle smile.

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: やっぱり……十夜はかわいい。
lines.translated: Toya really is... cute.

lines.content: 気持ち悪いって思われてたのはちょっと、いや、かなりショックだったけど。
lines.translated: Though finding out she thought I was gross was a little--no, a pretty huge shock.

lines.content: ハルも考えておいてほしい。気が向いたらいつでも歓迎したいから
lines.translated: "I want you to think about it too, Haru. If you ever feel like it, we'd love to welcome you anytime."

lines.content: はい……。ありがとうございます。考えておきます
lines.translated: "Yes... Thank you very much. I'll keep it in mind."

lines.content: 食事を終える。
lines.translated: We finished our meal.

lines.content: 後片付けは全員で。
lines.translated: Everyone pitched in to clean up afterward.

lines.content: 小さな台所に、十夜とハルとあさひさん、そして俺の四人で並ぶ。
lines.translated: Toya, Haru, Asahi-san, and I--all four of us lined up in the small kitchen.

lines.content: 洗剤で食器を洗う。布巾で拭く。棚に収める。
lines.translated: Washing the dishes with soap. Wiping them with dish towels. Putting them away in the cupboards.

lines.content: それらの作業を、ちょっと狭いねと笑いながらこなしていった。
lines.translated: We went through the chores together, laughing about how cramped it was.

lines.content: 片付けの後は俺のケーキと十夜のプリンを四人でわけて一緒に食べた。
lines.translated: After cleaning up, the four of us shared my cake and Toya's pudding together.

lines.content: 美味しかった。それに、楽しかった。
lines.translated: It was delicious. And it was fun.

lines.content: まるで四人家族みたいだと……そんな恥ずかしげもないことを思ってしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking something shameless... that we were just like a family of four.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: すっかりハルのお願い――“もう一度魔法を”“魔法少女に戻して欲しい”――それらを言及するような雰囲気ではなくなってしまった。
lines.translated: The mood had completely shifted away from bringing up Haru's requests--"let me use magic once more" and "turn me back into a magical girl."

lines.content: どうしたものかと思ってしまっているのは俺だけなのだろう。
lines.translated: I was probably the only one wondering what we should do about it.

lines.content: はっきりとしない場の空気に苛つく、とまではいかなくとも、焦れてしまう気持ちは多少あったのだった。
lines.translated: While I wouldn't go so far as to say the vague atmosphere irritated me, I did feel a little bit impatient.

lines.content: 太陽が眠りにつき。
lines.translated: The sun went to sleep.

lines.content: 満月が微笑むその時刻……。
lines.translated: At that hour when the full moon smiled down...

lines.content: この町の裏側に訪れる、もうひとつの夜――“夜の国”
lines.translated: Another night visited the hidden side of this town--the "Night Realm."

lines.content: ここは十年前、少女たちにとっての戦場であり、護るべき鮮やかな光だった。
lines.translated: Ten years ago, this place had been a battlefield for the girls, and a vivid light that needed to be protected.

lines.content: その特別な“夜”にハルを連れ出し、少しの間だけ散歩をすることになった。
lines.translated: We decided to take Haru out into that special "Night" for a short walk.

lines.content: かつてここで過ごしたたくさんの日々。
lines.translated: All those many days we once spent here.

lines.content: その一つひとつの想い出を懐かしむようにして、ハルと十夜、そして俺の三人で、“夜”を歩いた。
lines.translated: As if reminiscing on each and every one of those memories, the three of us--Haru, Toya, and I--walked through the "Night."

lines.content: 夜が更けていくにつれ、“夜の国”は刻々と姿を変える。
lines.translated: As the night deepened, the "Night Realm" changed its appearance moment by moment.
*However, there were hardly any scary things left anymore.* Toya and I had cleaned up as much as we possibly could.

lines.content: 今はもう、ついさっき、十夜とふたりで“悪夢”のかけらを探し歩いていたときとは様子が違う。
lines.translated: Things looked completely different now compared to just a little while ago, when Toya and I were walking around searching for fragments of "nightmares."

lines.content: まず、どこか明るい雰囲気だった。
lines.translated: First of all, the atmosphere was somehow brighter.

lines.content: 月の光だけでなく、町全体がぼんやりとした暖かく、柔らかな光に包まれている。
lines.translated: It wasn't just the moonlight; the entire town was wrapped in a faint, warm, and gentle glow.

lines.content: もう懐中電灯は必要ない。
lines.translated: We didn't need a flashlight anymore.

lines.content: 真っ暗な“夜”を怖がる心細さも不要だった。
lines.translated: Nor did we need to feel that helpless fear of the pitch-black "Night."

lines.content: 静かだった先ほどとは違い、今はざわざわと煌びやかに賑わっていた。
lines.translated: Unlike how quiet it had been earlier, it was now bustling with a dazzling lively murmur.

lines.content: たくさんのお店が扉を開いている。
lines.translated: Many shops had their doors open.

lines.content: その明かりが大通りに漏れ出し、“夜”を照らし出していた。
lines.translated: Their light spilled out onto the main street, illuminating the "Night."

lines.content: 行き交う[・|様][・|々]なお客が、転々と店内を覗き込んでは歩いている様子が見えた。
lines.translated: I could see *all sorts* of customers coming and going, peeking into shops here and there as they walked along.
They were *cats*.

lines.content: 客を呼び込む店主たちは人ではなくて――二本足で歩く猫たちだった。
lines.translated: The shopkeepers calling out to customers weren't human--they were cats walking on two legs.

lines.content: 活気よく人語を話し。
lines.translated: Speaking human language with lively energy.

lines.content: 趣味の良い洋服で、あるいは和装で身を固め。
lines.translated: Dressed in tasteful Western clothes or traditional Japanese attire.

lines.content: 少し意地悪そうな笑顔を貼り付けた彼らが売るのは……夢のカケラだ。
lines.translated: Wearing slightly mischievous smiles pasted on their faces, what they sold were... fragments of dreams.
*This place, the "Night Realm," is a place for the people of this town to dream at night. It is their stage.*

lines.content: 大通りを行き交うお客は、今夜見る夢を探して店から店へと、冷やかして回る。
lines.translated: The customers coming and going on the main street browsed from shop to shop in search of the dream they would see tonight.
*Customers are able to dream of whatever is symbolized by the items they purchase at the shops of the "Night."*

lines.content: 駄菓子屋であめ玉を購入すれば、甘いお菓子をお腹いっぱい食べられる夢を見る。
lines.translated: If you buy a piece of hard candy at a penny candy store, you'll dream of eating your fill of sweet treats.

lines.content: 写真屋で大好きなあの人との思い出を現像すると、ただただ[・|そ][・|の][・|人][・|に]やさしくしてもらえるだけの苦い夢。
lines.translated: If you develop a memory with that special someone you love at a photo studio, you'll have a bittersweet dream where *that person* simply treats you with kindness.

lines.content: そして時計屋で黄金の懐中時計を購入し、この世のすべてを思い通りに掌握する豪快な夢を見る。
lines.translated: And if you purchase a golden pocket watch at a clock shop, you'll have a grand dream of holding the entire world in the palm of your hand just as you wish.

lines.content: 客とは、参禅町で眠りについた人々の[魂|心]である。
lines.translated: The customers are the souls of the people who have fallen asleep in Sanzen Town.

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれの寝床で[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて、そうしていつか、夢の中……。
lines.translated: Each of them closes their eyelids in their own bed, and before long, they find themselves in a dream...

lines.content: [命|心]は特別な夜――“夜の国”と繋がれる。
lines.translated: Their hearts are connected to the special night--the "Night Realm."

lines.content: “夜”の中で目覚めた彼らは、今夜見るための夢を探して、鮮やかな“夜”の中を彷徨った。
lines.translated: Awakening within the "Night," they wandered through its vivid scenery in search of the dreams they would see tonight.

lines.content: こんなふうに人々が“夜”で目覚めるその前に、“悪夢”のかけらを十夜と俺は捕まえたのだ。
lines.translated: Before people woke up in the "Night" like this, Toya and I had caught the fragments of "nightmares."

lines.content: 宿主をなくした“悪夢”のかけらが、無防備な人の心にするりと滑り込んでしまわぬように。
lines.translated: So that those fragments of "nightmares" that had lost their hosts wouldn't slip smoothly into the defenseless hearts of people.

lines.content: 彼らが苦しくて悲しくて、とてもさみしい悪い夢にうなされてしまわぬように。
lines.translated: So that they wouldn't be plagued by painful, sad, and terribly lonely bad dreams.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...
*To sleep is to live in the world of the dead.*

lines.content: “夜”の役割は、夢を見るための舞台であるだけでは、なくて……。
lines.translated: The role of the "Night" wasn't merely to serve as a stage for dreaming...

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: 迷子にならないようにと繋いだ手を、十夜が小さく引っ張っていた。
lines.translated: Toya gave a small tug on my hand, which I was holding so she wouldn't get lost.

lines.content: なに、十夜
lines.translated: "What is it, Toya?"

lines.content: 俺はハルの姿も見失わないようにしながら答えた。
lines.translated: I answered her while making sure not to lose sight of Haru either.

lines.content: 大雅。あのね。今日から一緒……なんだよね？
lines.translated: "Taiga. Um, you know. We're going to be together... starting today, right?"

lines.content: うん。そうだよ。よろしくね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. Looking forward to it."

lines.content: そっか……。じゃあ、あのね
lines.translated: "I see... Well, um, you know..."

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: 寝る前にトランプ、しようね？　今日だけじゃないよ？　毎日だよ？
lines.translated: "Let's play cards before bed, okay? Not just today, okay? Every day, okay?"

lines.content: トランプ？
lines.translated: "Cards?"

lines.content: うん、そう。お姉ちゃんは弱すぎるから詰まんないんだもん
lines.translated: "Mhm, yeah. Onee-chan is way too weak at them, so it's boring."

lines.content: そうなんだ。あさひさん、トランプ弱いんだ
lines.translated: "Is that so? Asahi-san is bad at card games, huh?"

lines.content: ちょっと意外だ。
lines.translated: That was a little surprising.

lines.content: うん。お姉ちゃんね、……“私だって練習してるんだぞ、十夜の遊び相手になれるように。それに負けるのだって嫌だからな”、っていうけど、いつまで経っても弱いままなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Onee-chan says... 'I'm practicing too, you know, so I can be a good playmate for you, Toya. Besides, I hate losing too,' but no matter how much time passes, she stays weak."

lines.content: へぇ、そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Huh, is that right?"

lines.content: トランプでマジックばかり練習してて、トランプゲームのほうはルールもあまり覚える気がないんだよお姉ちゃんは
lines.translated: "She just practices magic tricks with the cards all the time, and she doesn't really have any intention of learning the rules for actual card games."

lines.content: 十夜は唇を尖らせ不満顔。
lines.translated: Toya pouted her lips with a dissatisfied look on her face.

lines.content: 俺は苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: I gave a wry smile.

lines.content: ……十夜と話していると、あさひさんの知らない顔ばかりが見えてきて、なんだかちょっと罪悪感に似た気持ちを抱いてしまう。
lines.translated: Whenever I talk with Toya, I keep seeing sides of Asahi-san I never knew existed, which makes me feel something akin to a little bit of guilt.

lines.content: ああ、わかった。いいよ、いっぱい遊ぼう。毎晩だってどんとこいだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, got it. Sure, let's play a lot. Every night? Bring it on."

lines.content: 俺は笑いながらそう答えた。
lines.translated: I answered with a laugh.

lines.content: うれしそうににっこりする十夜だけれど……。
lines.translated: Toya gave a happy smile, though...

lines.content: だけどな十夜。俺は、強いぞ
lines.translated: "However, Toya. Just so you know, I'm strong."

lines.content: あさひさんはもしかしたら、十夜が楽しいようにって、わざと負けてくれてるのかもしれない。あのひとは“大人”だから
lines.translated: "Maybe Asahi-san is losing on purpose so that you can have fun, Toya. Because she's an 'adult.'"

lines.content: でも、十夜。[おとなげ|大人気]だなんてものにまるで興味のない俺は、さて、どうしようかな
lines.translated: "But, Toya. As someone who has zero interest in acting like a mature adult, well now, I wonder what I'll do."

lines.content: ……え、ええ？　時どき勝たせてくれなきゃいやなんだよ？
lines.translated: "...Eh, eeeh? I won't like it if you don't let me win sometimes, you know?"

lines.content: 恐る恐る俺を見上げる十夜。
lines.translated: Toya looked up at me timidly.

lines.content: 繋いだ手にちょっとだけ力がこもっている。
lines.translated: Her grip on my hand tightened just a little bit.

lines.content: うん。まあ、考えとくだけは考えとくよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Well, I'll at least think about it."

lines.content: そして俺は、寝る前にトランプするだけでいいの？　と聞いてみた。
lines.translated: Then I asked her if just playing cards before bed was really enough.

lines.content: 他に何か一緒にしてほしいことはない？
lines.translated: "Is there anything else you want us to do together?"

lines.content: 後は……えっと、テレビも一緒に見るんだよ？
lines.translated: "Also... um, we're going to watch TV together too, okay?"

lines.content: テレビかー
lines.translated: "TV, huh..."

lines.content: そう。でもご飯食べるときはだめなの。お姉ちゃんが怒るから
lines.translated: "Right. But not while we're eating meals. Because Onee-chan will get mad."

lines.content: そっか。なるほど、覚えておくよ
lines.translated: "I see. Gotcha, I'll keep that in mind."

lines.content: あとあと、お風呂も……毎日一緒がいいのかも……？
lines.translated: "And, and, baths too... maybe it'd be nice to take them together every day...?"

lines.content: ああ。十夜がいいなら
lines.translated: "Sure. If you're okay with that, Toya."

lines.content: うん……。えへへ
lines.translated: "Mhm... Ehehe."

lines.content: また笑う。
lines.translated: She smiled again.

lines.content: 笑って、くれる。
lines.translated: She smiled for me.

lines.content: そして猫の耳が飛び出さないよう、軽く頭を両手で押さえていた。
lines.translated: And then she lightly pressed both hands against her head so her cat ears wouldn't pop out.

lines.content: ……よかった。
lines.translated: Thank goodness.

lines.content: 改めて安堵する。
lines.translated: I felt relieved all over again.

lines.content: 全力で拒否されることくらいは覚悟していた者としては、尚更だ。
lines.translated: Especially as someone who had been prepared to be flat-out rejected with everything she had.

lines.content: しばらく歩いて、ふと、気づいた。
lines.translated: After walking for a while, I suddenly realized something.

lines.content: ハル……。
lines.translated: Haru...

lines.content: 十夜とばかり話していた。
lines.translated: I had been talking only with Toya the whole time.

lines.content: 何も言わず隣を歩いていてくれるのは、視界に捕らえてはいたけれど。
lines.translated: Even though I had kept her in the corner of my eye as she walked beside me without saying a word.

lines.content: 言い訳がましくなるのは本意ではないが……。
lines.translated: I didn't want to sound like I was making excuses, though...

lines.content: 何か適切な言葉はないかと探し、振り返る。
lines.translated: Searching for the right words to say, I looked back.

lines.content: 『まだ転校する日は先だけど、この制服。かわいくてつい着て来ちゃった』
lines.translated: "The day I transfer schools is still a ways off, but this uniform... It was so cute I just couldn't help wearing it here."

lines.content: さっきまでそう言って、笑っていたハルだけど……。
lines.translated: Haru had been saying that with a smile just a little while ago, and yet...

lines.content: ハルは“夜”が一番はなやぐ時間を見つめていた。
lines.translated: Haru was gazing out at the time when the "Night" was at its most brilliant.

lines.content: 人が行き交いざわめく道を……。
lines.translated: At the street bustling with people coming and going...

lines.content: 静かに。
lines.translated: Quietly.

lines.content: ゆっくり。
lines.translated: Slowly.

lines.content: 俺の隣を歩いてる。
lines.translated: She was walking right beside me.

lines.content: 眩しそうにその目を細め……。
lines.translated: Squinting her eyes as if dazzled by the light...

lines.content: 震える瞳に、少し不思議な“夜”の風景を映し出している。
lines.translated: Reflecting the slightly wondrous scenery of the "Night" in her trembling eyes.

lines.content: その頬は少し赤いようにも見えた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks looked a little flushed, too.

lines.content: 俺は……。
言葉を、飲み込む。
lines.translated: I swallowed my words.

lines.content: 幼馴染み。
lines.translated: My childhood friend.

lines.content: およそ十年ぶりの、再会。
lines.translated: A reunion after roughly ten years.

lines.content: 昔と比べずいぶん高くなった身長が、俺たちの知らない時間が積み重なっていることの証明のように思えてしまう。
lines.translated: How much taller she had grown compared to the old days felt like proof of all the time that had piled up without us knowing.

lines.content: そして――
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 『お願いします。私にもう一度、魔法を使わせてください』
lines.translated: "Please. Let me use magic one more time."

lines.content: ハルが連れてきたあの言葉を、その理由を、俺はどうしても気にしないではいられなかった。
lines.translated: I just couldn't help but wonder about those words Haru had brought with her, and the reason behind them.

lines.content: 『大雅……。今こそ君の出番だ』
lines.translated: "Taiga... Now is your time to shine."

lines.content: ハルたちと“ゆめのねどこ”を出ようとした俺に、あさひさんはそっと耳打ちするように言ったのだ。
lines.translated: As I was about to leave the "Dream Bed" with Haru and the others, Asahi-san had whispered that into my ear.

lines.content: 『ここからは君の仕事だぞ。よくよく考え、慎重に、“力”を使えよ』
lines.translated: "It's your job from here on out. Think it through carefully, be cautious, and use your 'power.'"

lines.content: あさひさんはにっこりと笑った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a beaming smile.

lines.content: 対する俺は、目を細めてしまう。
lines.translated: In contrast, I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: 『出番？』
lines.translated: "My time to shine?"

lines.content: 『おいおい、何をぽかんとしてるんだよ。とぼけたこと言っちゃってるんだよ』
lines.translated: "Hey now, why are you spacing out like that? Don't play dumb with me."

lines.content: 『……奏大雅。この町で唯一の“魔法少女『使い』”の男の子。自分の“役割”を忘れちゃったとは言わせないぞ？』
lines.translated: "...Kanade Taiga. The only male 'Magical Girl User' in this town. Don't tell me you've forgotten your own 'role'?"

lines.content: 『まさか……本当に忘れちゃったわけじゃあないよな？　誕生日プレゼントだ。私から君へ贈った“力”。その、“役割”だよ。今こそそれを使うとき。そういう話をしているんだけどな』
lines.translated: "Don't tell me... you didn't actually forget, right? It was your birthday present. The 'power' I gifted to you. And the 'role' that comes with it. Now is the time to use it. That's what I'm talking about here."

lines.content: 私の言うこと、ちゃんとわかってるかな？
lines.translated: Do you really understand what I'm saying?

lines.content: そう言ったあさひさんは、ハルの後ろ姿を見つめていた……。
lines.translated: Saying that, Asahi-san stared at Haru's back...

lines.content: 『彼女の物語に、その、“人生の課題”に……“最後の魔法”が本当に必要であるのか否か。それを、君が、私の代わりに判断してほしいんだよ』
lines.translated: "Whether or not the 'last magic' is truly necessary for her story, for that 'life challenge' of hers... I want you to be the one to judge that in my place."

lines.content: ん？　どうした大雅
lines.translated: "Hm? What's up, Taiga?"

lines.content: 思考が。心が。[登校中|現在]に戻る。
lines.translated: My thoughts. My mind. They returned to the present--on my way to school.

lines.content: なんだよ。そんなにじーっと見つめて。俺の顔に何かついてるか？
lines.translated: "What is it? Staring at me so intently like that. Have I got something on my face?"

lines.content: 悪く言えば脳天気な。まあ、よく言えば、男女問わず惹きつけられる魅力的な笑顔がそこにはあった。
