lines.translated: Put badly, it was a carefree smile. Well, put nicely, it was a charming smile that drew people in regardless of gender.

lines.content: あんまり見つめられると照れるだろ。なんだよ。何か言いたいことでもあるのか？
lines.translated: "You're gonna make me blush if you stare that much. What's the matter? Got something you wanna say?"

lines.content: 照れるってなんだよ。顔を赤くするな。気持ち悪い。
lines.translated: What do you mean, "blush"? Don't go turning red. It's creepy.

lines.content: そんな意思表示をしかめた顔に存分に乗せ、俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: Putting that sentiment on full display with a scowl, I shook my head.

lines.content: いや……。言いたいこと、というか
lines.translated: "No... Not something I want to say, exactly."

lines.content: 昨晩。俺は“夜”の中で出会ったハルに問いかけたのだ。そのことを俺は思っている。
lines.translated: Last night, I had asked Haru a question when we met in the "Night." That was what I was thinking about.

lines.content: “魔法少女に戻りたい”
lines.translated: "I want to become a magical girl again."

lines.content: “最後の魔法を使いたい”
lines.translated: "I want to use my last magic."

lines.content: 俺が“ゆめのねどこ”に戻ってきた瞬間、聞いてしまったハルの言葉。
lines.translated: The words I had overheard from Haru the moment I returned to the "Dream Bed."

lines.content: あれはいったい、どういう意味だったのかな。
lines.translated: Just what on earth did she mean by that?

lines.content: ハルにそう問いかけていた。
lines.translated: That was what I had asked Haru.

lines.content: 『それは……』
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: きらきら光る“夜”の中。
lines.translated: In the glittering "Night."

lines.content: 隣を歩いていたハルが顔を伏せ、
lines.translated: Walking beside me, Haru lowered her gaze,
"No matter what, no matter what... There is a 'dream' that I *must fulfill*."

lines.content: ハルは、そう言った。
lines.translated: That was what Haru said.

lines.content: 『そのために私は“魔法”を使いたい。“魔法少女”に戻りたい』
lines.translated: "That's why I want to use 'magic.' I want to become a 'magical girl' again."

lines.content: 昨晩のハルはそれ以上には何も教えてはくれなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: Last night, Haru wouldn't tell me anything more than that, though...

lines.content: 悪いな親友
lines.translated: "Sorry, best friend."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 今からちょっと俺は卑屈になる
lines.translated: "I'm about to get a little self-deprecating here."

lines.content: ええ。なんだよそれ
lines.translated: "Huh? What's that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: ほら、あれだよ。運動会とかの開催式で、生徒代表が手を上げてやるやつだ。あれと同じだよ
lines.translated: "You know, that thing. The thing where the student representative raises their hand at the opening ceremony of a sports festival or whatever. It's just like that."

lines.content: 選手宣誓？
lines.translated: "The athlete's oath?"

lines.content: そう、それだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's the one."

lines.content: 俺はピシッと手を上げる。
lines.translated: I snapped my hand up sharply.

lines.content: 卑屈宣誓
lines.translated: "The Oath of Self-Deprecation."

lines.content: お、おう……？
もしも俺がお前みたいなイケメンだったなら、女の子の秘密のひとつやふたつ、簡単に聞き出せたのかなあと思うと……。ああ、まったく。我が顔面の出来が嘆かわしくもなる
lines.translated: "When I think about how, if only I were a handsome guy like you, I could've easily coaxed out a secret or two from a girl... Man, seriously. It makes me lament the craftsmanship of my own face."

lines.content: 悪いな親友。お前の言うこと、よくわかんないぞ
lines.translated: "Sorry, best friend. I really don't get what you're talking about."

lines.content: 言ったろ。卑屈になるって
lines.translated: "I told you, didn't I? That I was gonna get self-deprecating."

lines.content: まあ、確かに
lines.translated: "Well, true."

lines.content: “イケメンが微笑めば葬儀屋が儲かる”
lines.translated: "'When a handsome guy smiles, the undertaker profits.'"

lines.content: ……何言ってるんだ大雅
lines.translated: "...What are you talking about, Taiga?"

lines.content: いいか、いいかイケメン、よく聞けよ
lines.translated: "Listen, listen here, handsome, listen closely."

lines.content: お前みたいな一部のイケメンが何の努力もなくかわいい女の子たちの気持ちを笑顔ひとつで一網打尽にするから……
lines.translated: "Because a select few handsome guys like you sweep up all the cute girls' hearts with a single smile and zero effort..."

lines.content: だから、だからっ、俺みたいなイケてない輩があぶれてしまい世を憂い、ちょっと早めに孤独死しては、葬儀屋が揃いも揃ってほっこり笑顔になるんだよ
lines.translated: "Because of that--because of that!--uncool guys like me get left out in the cold, lament the world, and die lonely deaths a little ahead of schedule, bringing warm, fuzzy smiles to the faces of every last undertaker out there."

lines.content: 俺。大雅の言うこと。よくわからない
lines.translated: "I. Really don't get. What you're saying, Taiga."

lines.content: ……まあ、気にしないでくれ。ただのひがみだ。やっかみだ。世界のすべてはもてない奴らの卑屈さとかでできてるんだよ
lines.translated: "...Well, don't mind me. It's just sour grapes. Just jealousy. Everything in this world is made out of the self-deprecation of unpopular guys."

lines.content: もっとモテたい。もっと好かれたい。俺だって私だって人並みに愛されてみたい――そんな想いが色々とすごい発明だとか、貴重な発見だとかをする原動力になってるんだ。きっと
lines.translated: "'I want to be more popular. I want to be liked more. I want to be loved just like anyone else, too'--feelings like that are the driving force behind all sorts of amazing inventions and precious discoveries. Probably."

lines.content: すごいな。最強じゃないか
lines.translated: "Amazing. Doesn't that make you the strongest?"

lines.content: だろ
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: お前が無敵なら俺は、俺たちは、最強だ。だから舐めんな。モテない奴、舐めんな
lines.translated: "If you're invincible, then I--then we--are the strongest. So don't underestimate me. Don't underestimate unpopular guys."

lines.content: 胸を張り、言った。
lines.translated: I puffed out my chest and said that.

lines.content: 昨晩の出来事は……。
lines.translated: As for what happened last night...

lines.content: その再会については、まだみんなには秘密にしておきたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to keep that reunion a secret from everyone else for a little while longer.

lines.content: 何か特別なことができないか。そんなふうに、思っていたから。
lines.translated: Because I was wondering if we could do something special for her.

lines.content: 授業中である。
lines.translated: In the middle of class.

lines.content: あっという間に時間は過ぎて、もう午前が終わろうかとしていた。
lines.translated: Time had flown by in the blink of an eye, and the morning was already coming to an end.

lines.content: 四時限目。これが終わればお昼の時間――という具合。
lines.translated: Fourth period. Once this was over, it would be lunchtime--that sort of thing.

lines.content: あくびをひとつ。
lines.translated: I let out a yawn.

lines.content: ぽかぽか陽気に眠気が差し込む。
lines.translated: Drowsiness crept in with the warm, sunny weather.

lines.content: 風。
lines.translated: The wind.

lines.content: 春の風。
lines.translated: The spring breeze.

lines.content: 開け放たれた窓から流れ込んでくる花の香り。
lines.translated: The scent of flowers drifted in through the wide-open window.

lines.content: ふわりと古いカーテンを揺らしている。
lines.translated: Gently swaying the old curtains.

lines.content: 頬を。額を。鼻先を。暖かな風が撫でていく。
lines.translated: Across my cheeks. My forehead. The tip of my nose. The warm breeze caressed me.

lines.content: その風が目に滲みたというわけではないだろうが、俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を細めた。
lines.translated: It probably wasn't because the wind stung my eyes, but I narrowed my eyelids.

lines.content: 頬杖をつき窓の向こうを――遠くを、見つめる。
lines.translated: Resting my chin in my hand, I gazed out beyond the window--into the distance.

lines.content: 山の上の施設。
lines.translated: At the facility atop the mountain.

lines.content: 昨日俺が後にした場所である。
lines.translated: The place I had left behind yesterday.

lines.content: ハルは今、あそこにいるのだろうか。
lines.translated: I wondered if Haru was over there right now.

lines.content: 昨晩のことを思うと更に意識は散漫となる。
lines.translated: Thinking about last night made my focus drift even further.

lines.content: 授業どころでは、学園生活どころでは、なくなる。
lines.translated: Forget paying attention to class, my mind wasn't even on school life anymore.

lines.content: 『それじゃあ、今日のところは、今夜のところはもう帰るね』
lines.translated: "Well then, I'll be heading back for today--for tonight."

lines.content: “夜”の散歩を終え“ゆめのねどこ”に戻るとハルはそう言った。
lines.translated: After finishing our walk through the "Night" and returning to the "Dream Bed," Haru had said that.

lines.content: 『またね。十夜、大雅くん。今夜は楽しかったよ。昔のことを色々と思い出せて……すごく、楽しかった。だからきっと、また来るね』
lines.translated: "See you later. Toya, Taiga-kun. Tonight was fun. Being able to remember so many things from the old days... it was really fun. So I'll definitely come again."

lines.content: 別れ際のハルは笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: Haru showed us a smile as we parted ways.

lines.content: それはぎこちなくも見える微笑みだった。
lines.translated: It was a smile that also looked a bit awkward.
"Promise...?"

lines.content: 十夜がさみしそうに首をかしげ、
lines.translated: Toya tilted her head, looking lonely.

lines.content: 『うん。約束ね』
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's a promise."

lines.content: ハルはもちろんだよと微笑んで、
lines.translated: Haru smiled as if to say "Of course,"

lines.content: 『みんなにも……千和ちゃんや姫織ちゃん、智仁くんにも、よければよろしくって言っておいてくれたらうれしいな』
lines.translated: "And to everyone else... Chiwa-chan, Himeori-chan, and Tomohito-kun too, I'd be happy if you could tell them I said hi, if you don't mind."

lines.content: そんな言葉を残し、“ゆめのねどこ”の扉を閉めて――“夜”から夜へと戻っていった。
lines.translated: Leaving those words behind, she closed the door to the "Dream Bed"--and returned from the "Night" back into the night.

lines.content: 改めて思う。
lines.translated: I thought about it once again.

lines.content: 今、ハルは何をしているのだろう。
lines.translated: What was Haru doing right now?

lines.content: 昨晩のことは覚えていてくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would she remember what happened last night?

lines.content: “夜”の中に“鍵”を使用し、這入ってこれたということは、すなわち[肉体|身体]を[・|持][・|ち][・|込][・|め][・|た]ということだ。
lines.translated: The fact that she was able to use a "Key" to enter the "Night" meant that she had *brought her physical body in* with her.

lines.content: それ故にきっと昨晩のことをハルはちゃんと覚えていることだろう。
lines.translated: Therefore, Haru surely remembers what happened last night.

lines.content: だから“また来るね”という約束もまた、きっと覚えていてくれることだろうと思う。
lines.translated: Which means I'm sure she'll also remember her promise to come again.

lines.content: 時計を確認する。
lines.translated: I checked the clock.

lines.content: この授業が終わればお昼の時間だ。
lines.translated: Once this class ends, it'll be lunchtime.

lines.content: ハルは今、ここから見えるあの場所で、食事の準備をしているのかもしれないし。
lines.translated: Right now, in that place I can see from here, Haru might be getting ready for a meal.

lines.content: 新しい人間関係を構築するため目を回している最中かもしれない。
lines.translated: Or maybe her head is spinning as she tries to build new relationships.

lines.content: 大丈夫だろうか。
lines.translated: Is she doing okay?

lines.content: うまく、やれているだろうか。
lines.translated: Is she managing to get along well?

lines.content: [・|昔][・|の][・|彼][・|女]を知る俺は気になってしかたがない。
lines.translated: Knowing *the girl she used to be*, I couldn't help but worry.

lines.content: それとも俺の心配など杞憂も杞憂で……。
lines.translated: Or maybe my worries are completely unfounded...

lines.content: 全部を器用に、短い時間ですっぱりとこなしてしまい。
lines.translated: Maybe she handled everything deftly and cleanly in no time at all.

lines.content: 今はもうひと安心と、ぽかぽか陽気の日差しの中を、ひなたぼっこでもしながら過ごしているだろうか。
lines.translated: And right now, relieved that it's all settled, she's spending her time basking in the warm, sunny weather.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: それはむしろ、あさひさんや十夜にこそぴったりなイメージか……。
lines.translated: Though that image actually suits Asahi-san or Toya much better...

lines.content: また、あくびが。
lines.translated: Another yawn escaped me.

lines.content: うららかな日差しが眠気を増幅させる。
lines.translated: The glorious sunlight only amplified my drowsiness.

lines.content: 授業も残り時間あと数分なのだ。
lines.translated: There were only a few minutes of class left.

lines.content: これくらいなんとか我慢しようと堪えているその隣の席で……。
lines.translated: As I tried to hold out and endure it for just a little longer, in the seat next to mine...

lines.content: うう～ん
lines.translated: "Mmmn~"

lines.content: ……ずっと居眠りしてる女の子。夜月姫織。
lines.translated: was a girl who had been fast asleep this whole time. Yotsuki Himeori.

lines.content: むにゃむにゃ
lines.translated: "Mnya, mnya..."

lines.content: 堂々としたものだ。
lines.translated: She was certainly bold about it.

lines.content: こちらなんてずっと必死に眠気と戦っているというのに……。
lines.translated: And here I was, fighting off my drowsiness for dear life...

lines.content: だらっと机に突っ伏して、口元をもにゅもにゅさせている。
lines.translated: She was slumped limp over her desk, her mouth chewing on nothing.

lines.content: うむむむ……、じゅるり
lines.translated: "Mmmm... *slurp*."

lines.content: 夢の中で美味しいものでも食べたのだろうか。幸せそうだ。
lines.translated: Maybe she was eating something delicious in her dream. She looked so happy.

lines.content: でへへ……
lines.translated: "Dehehe..."

lines.content: へんにゃり。
lines.translated: Her face melted into a goofy grin.

lines.content: だらしない顔だ。
lines.translated: What a sloppy expression.

lines.content: 幸せそうな、顔だ。
lines.translated: What a blissful expression.

lines.content: うわぁ。どーしよー。食べても食べても減らないよぅ……、ぢゅふふ
lines.translated: "Uwaa. What do I do? No matter how much I eat, the pile never gets any smaller... *chuckle*."

lines.content: うーん。ベタベタな夢だなあ。
lines.translated: Man. Talk about a cliche dream.

lines.content: でも微笑ましく思う。
lines.translated: Still, it made me smile.

lines.content: [智仁|お人好し]じゃなくても帰り道に美味しいものをご馳走したくなる。
lines.translated: Even if you weren't a pushover like Tomohito, seeing this would make you want to treat her to something delicious on the way home.

lines.content: ふぅー、ふぅーっ
lines.translated: "Phew, phew!"

lines.content: 口をすぼめて必死に息を吹いている。
lines.translated: She puckered her lips and blew out air with all her might.

lines.content: 熱いものでも夢の中でさましてるのかな。
lines.translated: I guess she's cooling down something hot in her dream.

lines.content: （……寝てるんだよな？）
lines.translated: (...She *is* asleep, right?)

lines.content: そっと指先を伸ばし、頬をつついてみた。
lines.translated: I gently reached out a fingertip and poked her cheek.

lines.content: う、ああううう～
lines.translated: "Uu, aauuu~"

lines.content: 眉根を寄せる。
lines.translated: Her brows furrowed.

lines.content: だけど起きない。
lines.translated: But she didn't wake up.

lines.content: （すごいな。こんな、寝ぼけてるのかどうかよくわからない状態の人間は、はじめて見た）
lines.translated: (Amazing. This is the first time I've ever seen someone where I honestly can't tell if they're just half-asleep or what.)

lines.content: 面白い。
lines.translated: It was funny.

lines.content: 楽しい。
lines.translated: It was fun.

lines.content: ずっと見てたい。いじっていたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to keep watching her forever. Keep messing with her.

lines.content: だけどそろそろ起こしたほうがいいだろう。
lines.translated: Still, I should probably wake her up soon.

lines.content: ちょっとだけ意地悪らしい[教師|彼]に見つかってしまうと大変だ。
lines.translated: It'll be bad news if the teacher, who seems a little mean, catches her.
Though the one in trouble... *wouldn't be Himeori*.
*It'd be me*.

lines.content: 出された大量の課題を姫織にごねられ手伝わされる未来が容易に想像できてしまう。俺だって勉強は好きなほうじゃない。御免被りたい。
lines.translated: I could easily picture a future where she gets slapped with a mountain of extra homework and whines until I help her with it. It's not like I'm a fan of studying either. No thank you.

lines.content: でも、なあ。
lines.translated: Even so, man...

lines.content: （授業時間もあとほんの少し。このまま寝かせていてあげたい気も……）
lines.translated: (There's only a tiny bit of class left. Part of me wants to just let her sleep...)

lines.content: 悩む。
lines.translated: I agonized over it.

lines.content: 悩む。
lines.translated: I agonized over it.

lines.content: ……悩む。
lines.translated: And agonized some more.

lines.content: （ああ、もう）
lines.translated: (Ah, jeez.)

lines.content: 仕方がない。
lines.translated: It can't be helped.

lines.content: このまま寝かせておこう。
lines.translated: I'll just let her sleep.

lines.content: 俺は甘いだろうか。
lines.translated: Am I being too soft on her?

lines.content: それともただただどっちつかずで、その場しのぎで、無責任なだけなのか。
lines.translated: Or am I just being indecisive, shortsighted, and irresponsible?

lines.content: （まあ、うん、あれだ。怒られるときは一緒に怒られようなひよちゃん。隣の席なのに起こさなかった俺にも責任ありという感じでさ）
lines.translated: (Well, yeah, you know. If you get scolded, we'll get scolded together, Hiyo-chan. Like, since I sit right next to you and didn't wake you up, I'm partly responsible too.)

lines.content: 課題も半分くらいなら手伝おう。
lines.translated: I'll even help her with about half the extra work.

lines.content: 俺はもう一度、あくびを噛み殺しながら……窓の外を見る。
lines.translated: Stifling another yawn... I looked out the window once more.

lines.content: そこから見える山は一面桃色。
lines.translated: The mountain visible from here was entirely pink.

lines.content: まるでさくらの森のよう。
lines.translated: Just like a forest of cherry blossoms.

lines.content: その中にぽつんと顔を見せる背の低い施設の姿。
lines.translated: Poking out alone amidst it all was the low-slung building of the facility.

lines.content: 更にあくびを噛むと、昨晩のことがまたしても立ち上がってくる。
lines.translated: As I stifled yet another yawn, thoughts of last night rose to the surface once again.

lines.content: ……ハル。
lines.translated: Haru.

lines.content: 柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: “元魔法少女”という奇妙な経歴を持つ彼女には誰にも言えない秘密があった。
lines.translated: With her bizarre background as a "former magical girl," she held a secret she couldn't tell anyone.

lines.content: それは、かつて“夜の魔法使い”から彼女が受け取ったのだろう“最後の魔法”や、それに準ずる俺の知らない“動機”などだけでは、ない……。
lines.translated: And it wasn't just the "Last Magic" she must have received from the "Magician of the Night," or the "motive" behind it that I still didn't know about...

lines.content: ただひとり俺だけが知らされている彼女の秘密がある。
lines.translated: There was a secret of hers that only I had been told.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を知ってしまっている俺だからこそ、思う。思ってしまう。
lines.translated: Precisely because I knew *that*, I couldn't help but think about her.

lines.content: （ハル。大丈夫か。ちゃんと上手に、できてるか）
lines.translated: (Haru. Are you okay? Are you managing to do it right?)

lines.content: 俺は余計な心配ばかりを繰り返すのだった。
lines.translated: I just kept worrying needlessly over and over.

lines.content: うううう～ん
lines.translated: "Uuuuun~"

lines.content: うなり声。
lines.translated: A groan.

lines.content: 振り向く。
lines.translated: I turned my head back.

lines.content: お腹、すいたよぉ……
lines.translated: "I'm... so hungry..."

lines.content: べたな寝言だ。
lines.translated: More cliche sleep-talking.

lines.content: でもその表情は先ほどとは一変。苦しそう。
lines.translated: But her expression had completely changed from earlier. She looked like she was in pain.

lines.content: （静かにしてないとバレちゃうぞ？）
lines.translated: (If you don't keep quiet, you're gonna get caught, you know?)

lines.content: ……窓の外には“心配”が。
lines.translated: Outside the window lay my "worries."

lines.content: ……振り向けばそこにも“不安”が。
lines.translated: And when I turned around, right there lay my "anxieties."

lines.content: なんだか我ながら忙しいやつだなあと思う。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking what a busy guy I was.

lines.content: やめて……
lines.translated: "Stop..."

lines.content: そんな俺の“不安”も余所に――姫織は苦しそうに手をバタつかせ始めていた。
lines.translated: Oblivious to my "anxieties"--Himeori was starting to flail her hands around painfully.

lines.content: やめてよぉ
lines.translated: "Stop it..."

lines.content: 切なげな声。涙声。
lines.translated: A pitiful voice. A tearful voice.

lines.content: お腹の空く時間だ。
lines.translated: It was the time of day when stomachs started growling.

lines.content: 幸せな夢からお腹にさみしい夢に変わってしまったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Her happy dream might have turned into one that left her stomach feeling lonely.

lines.content: 夜月姫織は食いしん坊。
lines.translated: Yotsuki Himeori was a glutton.

lines.content: 彼女にとってお腹が空くのは、ひとりぼっちで真夜中を歩くのと同じくらいさみしいことだ。
lines.translated: To her, being hungry was just as lonely as walking all by herself at midnight.

lines.content: それもまた、彼女にとって、夜月姫織にとって――
lines.translated: And to her, to Yotsuki Himeori--

lines.content: ハルがその胸に抱く秘密と同様。
lines.translated: Just like the secret Haru held in her heart.

lines.content: ――世界が終わるにも等しい、ごくごくふつうで、平凡な、大問題なのだろうけれど。
lines.translated: --It was probably a completely ordinary, mundane, yet massive problem, on par with the end of the world.

lines.content: やっぱりそろそろ起こさないとまずい。
lines.translated: Yeah, I really need to wake her up soon or this is going to get bad.

lines.content: このまま騒ぎ始めると[彼|教師]に居眠りがバレてしまいそうだ。
lines.translated: If she starts making a racket like this, the teacher is going to catch her sleeping.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: うう、やめてよ大雅ぁ……
lines.translated: "Uu, stop it, Taigaaa..."

lines.content: なぜ。俺の名を。呼ぶ
lines.translated: Why. Are you calling. My name.

lines.content: 焦る。驚く。面食らう。
lines.translated: I panicked. I was shocked. I was completely thrown for a loop.

lines.content: う～、やだやだやめてよ、私のご飯、とらないでよぉっ
lines.translated: "Uuu~, no, no, stop it, don't take my food..."

lines.content: どろぼー、だとか。
lines.translated: Calling me a thief, and stuff like that.

lines.content: いじわるー、だとか。
lines.translated: Calling me a meanie, and stuff like that.

lines.content: 大雅なんて大嫌いー
lines.translated: "I hate you, Taigaaa!"

lines.content: だとか。
lines.translated: Things like that.

lines.content: 騒ぎ始める。
lines.translated: She started making a racket.

lines.content: 大雅……大雅ぁ……嫌い、きらい、大嫌い……ぐす……
lines.translated: "Taiga... Taigaaa... I hate you, hate you, I really hate you... *sniffle*..."

lines.content: だからどうして俺を呼ぶのか。
lines.translated: Seriously, why is she calling my name?

lines.content: うう……大雅……へっぷち
lines.translated: "Uu... Taiga... *achoo!*"

lines.content: くしゃみした。
lines.translated: She sneezed.

lines.content: 慌ててその口をふさごうとする。
lines.translated: I frantically tried to cover her mouth.

lines.content: だけど、もう遅い。
lines.translated: But it was already too late.

lines.content: くすくすと教室内に含み笑いが。
lines.translated: Stifled giggles rippled through the classroom.

lines.content: 教師がこちらを振り返っていた。
lines.translated: The teacher had turned around to look at us.

lines.content: 難しい表情だ。
lines.translated: With a grim expression.

lines.content: 明らかにご立腹。
lines.translated: Clearly furious.

lines.content: （……違う。騒いでたの、俺じゃないですよ）
lines.translated: (...No, wait. It wasn't me making all that noise.)

lines.content: 声には出さず首を左右に何度も振って必死にアピール。
lines.translated: Without making a sound, I shook my head back and forth repeatedly in a desperate appeal.

lines.content: ……権力とはいつだって無情だ。
lines.translated: Authority is always ruthless.

lines.content: 放課後に職員室へ来なさいとお達し。
lines.translated: I received a royal decree to report to the faculty room after school.

lines.content: 不真面目な君には追加で課題を出さなければいけません。とかなんとか。
lines.translated: Something about having to assign extra homework to an unserious student like me.

lines.content: ……ひどい。俺じゃないのに
lines.translated: "...That's awful. It wasn't even me."

lines.content: 俺は眠らないようにとがんばっていたのに。
lines.translated: And here I was trying so hard not to fall asleep.

lines.content: むしろ褒められてもいいんじゃ……。
lines.translated: If anything, I deserve to be praised...

lines.content: 悲しくなった。
lines.translated: I felt sad.

lines.content: 切なくもなった。
lines.translated: It was heartbreaking, too.

lines.content: ……お歳故に耳がはっきりしないのかな。
lines.translated: Maybe his hearing is going bad because of his age.

lines.content: だから俺の名前だけが聞こえていて、誰の声だか判断できず、という具合……？
lines.translated: So he only caught my name, couldn't tell whose voice it was, and jumped to conclusions...?

lines.content: ならば責めてもしかたない。
lines.translated: If that's the case, I can't really blame him.

lines.content: うう……変だよどうしておかしいよ……ねえ、大雅……食べても食べてもお腹一杯にならないんだよぉ……
lines.translated: "Uu... That's weird, why, it makes no sense... Hey, Taiga... No matter how much I eat, I can't get full..."

lines.content: ……[姫織|こちら]を責めてもしかたない。気がする。
lines.translated: I feel like I can't really blame her, either.

lines.content: 残り時間十分程度。
lines.translated: There were only about ten minutes left of class.

lines.content: 眠る子を無理矢理起こすのはあまり気分が良くない。
lines.translated: Forcing a sleeping girl awake wouldn't feel very good.

lines.content: 居眠りはそのままにしておいた。
lines.translated: So I just let her keep napping.

lines.content: お昼の時間。
lines.translated: Lunchtime.

lines.content: お弁当を持ってやって来た千和を交えてお昼をいただく。
lines.translated: Chiwa came over with her bento, and we all ate lunch together.

lines.content: 驚いたぞ大雅。まさかひよちゃんの代わりに怒られるだなんて。格好良いじゃないか
lines.translated: "Color me surprised, Taiga. I never thought you'd take the fall for Hiyo-chan like that. Pretty cool of you."

lines.content: ……ほんとに意外です。先輩にそんなやさしさがあったなんて。未だに信じられない気分です
lines.translated: "...It really is unexpected. To think you had that kind of kindness in you, Senpai. I still can't quite believe it."

lines.content: 別に、やさしさとか。そういうのじゃないよ。なんとなくそんな流れになっただけだ
lines.translated: "It wasn't really about kindness or anything like that. Things just sort of flowed that way."

lines.content: ……ごめんね大雅
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 怒ってない？
lines.translated: "Are you mad?"

lines.content: うん。まあ、ちょっとだけね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Well, just a little bit."

lines.content: 少し意地悪な顔をして見せた。
lines.translated: I put on a slightly teasing face.

lines.content: だけどひよちゃんが反省してるみたいなので不問としましょう
lines.translated: "Since Hiyo-chan seems to be reflecting on what she did, though, I'll let you off the hook."

lines.content: ……みんなで食べるお弁当。
lines.translated: Eating lunch with everyone.

lines.content: 俺はあさひさんが作ってくれたお弁当に箸をつけている。
lines.translated: I dug into the bento Asahi-san had made for me with my chopsticks.

lines.content: そして、また少し、昨晩のことを俺は思った。
lines.translated: And then, my thoughts drifted back to last night for a moment.

lines.content: ハルのことをいつみんなに言おうか。
lines.translated: When should I tell everyone about Haru?

lines.content: ハルは“みんなによろしく伝えておいて”とそう言っていた。
lines.translated: Haru had told me to "say hi to everyone" for her.

lines.content: だから別にここで“実は聞いて驚けよ”としたり顔で暴露してしまっても、まあ、どこに問題が発生することもないだろう。
lines.translated: So even if I were to smugly drop the bombshell right here and say, "Listen to this and prepare to be amazed," it probably wouldn't cause any problems.

lines.content: （……うん。だけど、そうだな）
lines.translated: (...Yeah. Still, though.)

lines.content: ひどく勝手な判断なのだけど――
lines.translated: It was a terribly selfish decision on my part, but--

lines.content: やはりまだ、みんなには内緒にしておこう。
lines.translated: I decided to keep it a secret from everyone for just a little longer.

lines.content: そう思った[・|動][・|機]はきっとハルに相談すれば理解してくれるのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: I was sure that if I talked to Haru about my *motive* for thinking that way, she would understand.

lines.content: ……せっかくの滅多にないイベントなのだ。
lines.translated: After all, a rare event like this doesn't come around often.

lines.content: もっと特別な何かを用意したい。
lines.translated: I wanted to prepare something much more special.

lines.content: それが動機だ。
lines.translated: That was my motive.

lines.content: もっともっと、みんなが驚くような何かを用意できないか……。
lines.translated: Could I set up something that would surprise everyone even more...?

lines.content: そんな悪戯心にも似た思いが芽生え始めていた。
lines.translated: A feeling akin to a mischievous impulse was beginning to bud inside me.

lines.content: 本日の学園生活。
lines.translated: Today's school life.

lines.content: その成果は昨日と変わらず平凡なもの。
lines.translated: The results were just as unremarkable as yesterday's.

lines.content: 特筆すべき事件などそうそう起きない。
lines.translated: Noteworthy incidents don't just happen every day.

lines.content: 時間は伸びやかに過ぎ放課後となった。
lines.translated: Time stretched on leisurely until after school arrived.

lines.content: 帰宅の準備を整え幼馴染み三人と廊下を歩く。
lines.translated: Having packed up to go home, I walked down the hallway with my three childhood friends.

lines.content: そっか。大雅、今日は一緒に帰れないのか
lines.translated: "I see. So you can't walk home with us today, Taiga?"

lines.content: 智仁の低い声が放課後の静かな廊下に響いていた。
lines.translated: Tomohito's low voice echoed through the quiet after-school hallway.

lines.content: ああ。これから職員室へ行かなきゃならないんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I have to head to the faculty room now."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: そうだね。超絶だるだるだ
lines.translated: "Yep. It's a massive pain."

lines.content: 先生からの呼び出しですか？
lines.translated: "Did the teacher call you in?"

lines.content: まあ、そんなところかな
lines.translated: "Well, something like that."

lines.content: 姫織と千和に順番に答えた。
lines.translated: I answered Himeori and Chiwa in turn.

lines.content: 授業妨害のペナルティはいかほどだろうか。
lines.translated: Just how heavy would the penalty for disrupting class be?

lines.content: あまり厳しいものでなければいいけれど。
lines.translated: Hopefully nothing too harsh.

lines.content: だから今日は先に帰ってくれ。また明日、一緒に帰ろう
lines.translated: "So you guys go on ahead today. Let's walk home together again tomorrow."

lines.content: でも、先輩。終わるの待ってますよ？　どれくらいかかるものなんでしょうか
lines.translated: "But Senpai, we can wait until you're done, you know? How long do you think it'll take?"

lines.content: うん、ありがとう。素直にうれしい
lines.translated: "Yeah, thanks. That honestly makes me happy."

lines.content: 千和がやさしさをくれたので笑顔を返すことにしよう。意地悪はなしだ。
lines.translated: Since Chiwa had shown me some kindness, I decided to return it with a smile. No teasing this time.

lines.content: だけど、そうだな。正直なところいつお説教が終わるかわからないんだ
lines.translated: "Still, let's see. To be honest, I have no idea when the lecture is going to end."

lines.content: 少し厳しい老年の教師は小言も多く、お説教はくどくど長いのだとも聞いたことがある。
lines.translated: I'd heard that the somewhat strict elderly teacher tended to nitpick a lot, and that his lectures dragged on forever.

lines.content: 終了時間を推測することもできないので、待って貰っているわけにはいかない。
lines.translated: Since I couldn't even guess when it would wrap up, I couldn't just make them wait around for me.

lines.content: そして何より――俺の勝手な都合だけれど――今日は可能な限り早めに帰宅したかった。
lines.translated: And above all--though this was purely for my own selfish reasons--I wanted to get home as early as possible today.

lines.content: 昨日みたいにみんなと放課後を過ごすのもいい。それはきっと、“楽しい”と意識することもないくらいとても楽しい。
lines.translated: Spending time after school with everyone like yesterday was nice, too. It was always so much fun that I didn't even have to consciously think about how fun it was.

lines.content: だが、今日はお説教が終わり次第“ゆめのねどこ”へ直行したいのだ。
lines.translated: However, today I wanted to head straight to the "Bed of Dreams" the moment my lecture was over.

lines.content: そこに昨日再会したばかりの新しい笑顔があればいいと、そう願っているからだ。
lines.translated: Because I was hoping that the new smiling face I'd just reunited with yesterday would be waiting for me there.

lines.content: そんなわけで。行ってきます。……どうか無事帰還できるよう祈っておいてくれ
lines.translated: "So anyway, I'm off. ...Please pray that I make it back alive."

lines.content: 敬礼。
lines.translated: I gave a salute.

lines.content: せめて致命傷にはならないようにと願っていてほしい。お勉強嫌い。大嫌い。奴は青春時代にとっての猛毒だ
lines.translated: "At the very least, wish for me to avoid any fatal wounds. I hate studying. Despise it. That stuff is deadly poison to one's youth."

lines.content: うむ。出される課題ができるだけ少ないようにって祈っとく
lines.translated: "Right. I'll pray they give you as little extra homework as possible."

lines.content: 智仁と敬礼しあう。
lines.translated: Tomohito and I exchanged salutes.

lines.content: そして笑う。
lines.translated: And then we laughed.

lines.content: んー。さよならの前に、もうひとつ。明日の放課後は駄菓子屋にでも寄り道して帰らないか
lines.translated: "Hmm. Before we say goodbye, one more thing. Tomorrow after school, why don't we stop by the penny candy shop on the way home?"

lines.content: 楽しみがあれば乗り越えられそうだからと俺は言う。
lines.translated: I suggested it, figuring I could push through this if I had something to look forward to.

lines.content: 買い食いの資金はひとり三百円までだ。三百円以内で誰が一番上手に買い物できるか。もしくは誰がもっともセンスあるチョイスをするか勝負しようぜ
lines.translated: "The snack budget is up to three hundred yen per person. Let's have a contest to see who can shop the smartest within three hundred yen. Or rather, who has the best taste in snacks."

lines.content: そして買ったお菓子を持ってお花見とかしてもいいかな。ちょうどさくらが見頃だからね
lines.translated: "And then maybe we can take the snacks we bought and do some cherry blossom viewing. The sakura are right at their peak, after all."

lines.content: おっけーおっけー。駄菓子で、お花見かあ。うん。駄菓子なんて久しぶりだな。飴玉以外はふだんお菓子食わないし。面白そうだ。勝者の特権は何にする？
lines.translated: "Okay, okay. Cherry blossom viewing with penny candy, huh? Yeah, it's been ages since I had penny candy. I don't usually eat sweets besides hard candy, anyway. Sounds fun. What should the winner's privilege be?"

lines.content: 特権？
lines.translated: "Privilege?"

lines.content: 勝者にも敗者にも何かないと勝負に張りが生まれない。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "There's no real tension in a match unless there's something at stake for both the winner and the losers. Right?"

lines.content: あ、だったら、こうしませんか
lines.translated: "Ah, in that case, how about we do this?"

lines.content: 千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa piped up.

lines.content: 勝った人は、負けた人たちからひとつずつ一番美味しいお菓子をもらえるのはどうでしょう
lines.translated: "How about the winner gets to take the single most delicious snack from each of the losers?"

lines.content: まあ残酷っ
lines.translated: "My, how cruel!"

lines.content: 俺は目を丸くする。
lines.translated: My eyes went wide.

lines.content: この子かわいい顔して容赦がないわっ
lines.translated: "Such a cute face, yet so utterly merciless!"

lines.content: どうしていきなり女子化するんだ
lines.translated: "Why are you suddenly talking like a lady?"

lines.content: ……きもいです先輩。とっても
lines.translated: "...That's really gross, Senpai. Seriously."

lines.content: ふ、ふふん。まあ、あれだ。ひよちゃんが歓喜しそうなルールだな。一番美味しいお菓子どころか、買ったお菓子全部をぺろっといかれちゃいそうだ
lines.translated: "H-Hmph. Well, you know. That sounds like a rule Hiyo-chan would be thrilled about. Forget just the most delicious snack, she'd probably gobble up everything we bought in a single bite."

lines.content: みんな姫織を振り向いた。
lines.translated: Everyone turned to look at Himeori.

lines.content: けれど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 姫織はうつむいていた。
lines.translated: Himeori was looking down at the floor.

lines.content: 何かを言いたそうに口元をもにょもにょとさせている。
lines.translated: Her lips were fidgeting, as if she wanted to say something.

lines.content: あれ？　どうしたのひよちゃん。元気ないな
lines.translated: "Huh? What's wrong, Hiyo-chan? You seem down."

lines.content: らしくないぞと、そんな身勝手な印象を押しつけるようなことを言って、うつむいたその顔をのぞき込もうとする。
lines.translated: Telling her it wasn't like her--imposing my own selfish impression of her like that--I leaned down to peer at her downturned face.

lines.content: すると姫織は言った。
lines.translated: Then, Himeori spoke up.

lines.content: ねえ大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ぽつりと俺の名前を呼んだ姫織に、うなずく。
lines.translated: She murmured my name quietly, and I nodded in response.

lines.content: なんだいひよちゃん
lines.translated: "What is it, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 言いたいことがあるのなら言ってみるといい、と少しおちゃらけたふうにして言ってみた。
lines.translated: I kept my tone a little playful, encouraging her to speak her mind.

lines.content: 大雅。あのね。やっぱり……怒ってる？
lines.translated: "Taiga. Um, well. Are you... mad at me after all?"

lines.content: 恐る恐ると言った具合に姫織は答えた。
lines.translated: Himeori asked timidly.

lines.content: やっぱり？
lines.translated: "After all?"

lines.content: 私のせいで先生に怒られるんだよね？　だから、大雅、やっぱり怒ってるかなって。私のこと、嫌いになった……？
lines.translated: "You're going to get scolded by the teacher because of me, right? So I was wondering if you were actually mad at me. Do you... hate me now?"

lines.content: 俺をちらりと見上げて、そう言った。
lines.translated: She glanced up at me fleetingly as she said it.

lines.content: 課題。手伝わないけど。でも応援はするよ？　がんばれ大雅、負けるな大雅
lines.translated: "With the extra homework. I won't help you with it, though. But I'll cheer you on, okay? Go for it, Taiga! Don't give up, Taiga!"

lines.content: うおー、という具合に両手を振り上げる。
lines.translated: She pumped both her arms in the air with a little "rah!" motion.

lines.content: だからね？　怒っちゃ嫌だよ？　嫌いになっちゃ、嫌なんだよ……？
lines.translated: "So, okay? Don't be mad, alright? I don't want you to hate me..."

lines.content: 手伝わないのかよー
lines.translated: "Wait, you're not gonna help him?!"

lines.content: 俺の代わりに智仁が突っ込む。
lines.translated: Tomohito chimed in on my behalf.

lines.content: 俺は『はは』と、笑う。
lines.translated: "Haha," I laughed.

lines.content: そして姫織の小さな頭に手を乗せて、
lines.translated: Then, placing a hand on Himeori's small head, I said,

lines.content: 言ったろひよちゃん。珍しくひよちゃんが反省してるっぽいので怒らないって。だからさ。むろん嫌いになんてならないよ
lines.translated: "I already told you, Hiyo-chan. Since you actually seem to be reflecting on it for once, I'm not mad. And of course, I could never hate you."

lines.content: そのまま頭を強引にぐりぐりと、撫でる。
lines.translated: Leaving my hand there, I playfully ruffled her hair.

lines.content: だから元気を出しなさい。そんな顔してたらご飯が美味しくなくなっちゃうぞ。そんなのイヤだろ、大変だろ？　世界が終わるくらいの大問題だ
lines.translated: "So cheer up. If you keep making a face like that, your food won't taste good anymore. You wouldn't want that, right? That'd be a disaster. A crisis big enough to end the world."

lines.content: ふわわわわわっ。目がっ、目が回るよぉ
lines.translated: "Fwawawawawa! I'm getting, I'm getting dizzyyy!"

lines.content: だけど今回だけだぞー。次は大切なお昼ご飯を半分いただいちゃうかもしれない。そして課題はちょっと手伝ってくれたらうれしいな
lines.translated: "Just this once, though. Next time, I might have to confiscate half of your precious lunch. Oh, and I'd really appreciate it if you helped me out a little with the extra homework."

lines.content: 職員室に到着。
lines.translated: We arrived at the faculty room.

lines.content: ここで別れることにする。
lines.translated: We decided to part ways here.

lines.content: ……与えられた罰則は思いの外重く、お説教は小言の山が降り積もり、想像以上に長引いてしまった。
lines.translated: The penalty I received was heavier than expected, and the lecture turned into a mountain of nitpicking that dragged on far longer than I'd imagined.

lines.content: ……すっかり夜じゃないですか
lines.translated: "...It's completely dark out already."

lines.content: まさかお説教がここまで長くなろうとは。
lines.translated: I never thought the lecture would take this long.

lines.content: みんなには先に帰ってもらっていて大正解だった。
lines.translated: Telling everyone to go home ahead of me had been the absolute right call.

lines.content: 先生。
lines.translated: Man, that teacher.

lines.content: まさか家庭で相手にされず気に入らない生徒を使ってその憂さを晴らしてるんじゃないだろうな。
lines.translated: Don't tell me his family ignores him at home, so he takes out his frustrations on students he doesn't like.

lines.content: 家族に居場所がない。
lines.translated: Having no place to belong in your own family.

lines.content: 仕事に生きる男にはよくあることだと想像するけど――そんな無駄な想像力が勝手に働いてしまうほど疲労した。げんなりと、した。
lines.translated: I imagine that's pretty common for men who live only for their work--though the fact that my mind was wandering to such pointless places showed just how exhausted I was. I felt completely drained.

lines.content: 俺は、鍵を取り出す。
lines.translated: I took out the key.

lines.content: あさひさんや十夜に会いに行くための鍵だ。
lines.translated: The key to go see Asahi-san and Toya.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”へと戻る……その前に。
lines.translated: Before returning to the "Bed of Dreams," however...

lines.content: 辺りを、見回す。
lines.translated: I looked around.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]の姿を探している。
lines.translated: Searching for *her*.

lines.content: [・|携][・|帯]を使えばすぐに繋がることはできるだろう。
lines.translated: If I used my *cell phone*, I could probably reach her right away.

lines.content: もし近くにいれば呼び出し音で居場所もわかるかもしれない。
lines.translated: If she was nearby, the ringtone might even give away her location.

lines.content: だけどそうしない。あの子は自力で見つけ出したいと思ってしまう。
lines.translated: Even so, I didn't do that. I found myself wanting to track her down on my own.

lines.content: ん～……そうだな。今日はどこに隠れてるのか
lines.translated: "Hmm... Let's see. Where is she hiding today?"

lines.content: ひとりでぶつぶつ言いながら、見回す。
lines.translated: Muttering to myself, I scanned the area.

lines.content: 夜の色が差し込み始めた校舎はしんと静かだ。
lines.translated: The school building was dead silent as the colors of night began to seep in.

lines.content: ここは一階の廊下。
lines.translated: This was the first-floor hallway.

lines.content: 隠れられるような場所はあまりないように思えるけれど……。
lines.translated: There didn't seem to be many places to hide around here, though...

lines.content: ふと、窓の向こうを見る。
lines.translated: Just then, I looked out the window.

lines.content: そこには花壇がある。たくさんの春の花が、その鮮やかさを色とりどりにほころばせていた。
lines.translated: There was a flowerbed outside. Countless spring flowers were blooming in a vibrant array of colors.

lines.content: そんな花たちの中から――猫の耳としっぽが、見えている。
lines.translated: And poking out from among those flowers--were a pair of cat ears and a tail.

lines.content: みーっけ
lines.translated: "Found you."

lines.content: とかなんとか言いながら、窓を開けた。
lines.translated: Saying that, I slid the window open.

lines.content: はは。頭かくしてなんとやらだ。……クロ。やっぱり隠れるの下手だよな
lines.translated: "Haha. 'A bird hiding its head in the sand,' and all that. ...Kuro. You really are bad at hiding, aren't you?"

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: どうかした？　と俺は首をかしげる。
lines.translated: "What's wrong?" I asked, tilting my head.

lines.content: ……いない？
lines.translated: "...Gone?"

lines.content: ん？　なに？
lines.translated: "Hm? What is it?"

lines.content: 小さなちいさな声なので聞き取れなかった。
lines.translated: Her voice was so tiny I couldn't quite catch it.

lines.content: すると、言葉を詰まらせながらも、こう返ってきた。
lines.translated: Then, stumbling over her words a bit, she asked again.

lines.content: ……もう、誰もいないかな
lines.translated: "...Is everyone gone now?"

lines.content: ああ、いないよ。俺だけだ。みんな先に帰ったし、たぶん他の生徒も誰もいないよ。もうこんな時間だしね
lines.translated: "Yeah, nobody's here. Just me. My friends went on ahead, and I doubt there are any other students left, either. Look how late it is."
Mm.

lines.content: 立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood up.

lines.content: ガサガサと花の中から姿を見せる――はらはらと花びらを舞わせながら。
lines.translated: With a rustle, she emerged from the flowers--sending petals fluttering into the air around her.

lines.content: うおお、花びらまみれじゃないか。それに泥だらけだ。ああ、頬に花粉までくっつけちゃって。あんまり汚れて帰ったらあさひさんに怒られちゃうぞ。お風呂入りなさいって
lines.translated: "Whoa, you're covered in petals. And caked in mud, too. Ah, you've even got pollen stuck to your cheeks. If you go home this dirty, Asahi-san's going to scold you and tell you to go take a bath."

lines.content: クロ。お風呂苦手だろ？　と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "You don't like baths, right, Kuro?" I added.

lines.content: 髪の毛に絡みついている花びらを一枚、いちまい、取っていく。
lines.translated: I plucked the petals tangled in her hair out, one by one.

lines.content: 頬を、鼻先を、うっすらと黄色くしている花粉は、ぱたぱたとはたいてやった。
lines.translated: Then I gently brushed away the pollen dusting her cheeks and the tip of her nose in pale yellow.

lines.content: ――くちゅ
lines.translated: "--Achoo."

lines.content: くしゃみをした。
lines.translated: She sneezed.

lines.content: うう……。じゅる
lines.translated: "Ugh... *sniffle*."

lines.content: 鼻を啜る――ハッと、目が合った。
lines.translated: She sniffled--and then, with a start, our eyes met.

lines.content: 慌ててつんとし、そっぽを向いた。
lines.translated: Flustered, she acted aloof and turned her head away.

lines.content: 恥ずかしかったのかもしれない。頬が少し赤かった。
lines.translated: Maybe she was embarrassed. Her cheeks were a little red.

lines.content: 俺は小さく笑う。
lines.translated: I let out a small chuckle.

lines.content: クロは、決まり悪そうに唇をとがらせ……うつむいた。
lines.translated: Looking awkward, Kuro pouted... and cast her eyes down.

lines.content: 顔を上げない。
lines.translated: She wouldn't look up.

lines.content: そんなに恥ずかしかったのだろうか……。
lines.translated: Was she really that embarrassed...?

lines.content: どこかもじもじともしていた。
lines.translated: She was fidgeting a bit, too.

lines.content: クロ？　どうした？
lines.translated: "Kuro? What's the matter?"

lines.content: ……った
え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……しまった
lines.translated: "...Oh no."

lines.content: そこでふと、なぜか顔を両手で覆いながら、クロは言った。
lines.translated: Suddenly covering her face with both hands for some reason, Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……見つかって、しまった
lines.translated: "...You found me."

lines.content: おかしい、な。上手にかくれてたはずのに
lines.translated: "That's weird. I thought I was hiding really well."

lines.content: はは。ああ、うん。見つけちゃったぞ、クロ
lines.translated: "Haha. Yeah, well. I sure did find you, Kuro."

lines.content: わたしは……
顔を上げる。俺を見上げる。小首を、かしげる。
lines.translated: She lifted her face. Looking up at me, she tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: ……わたしは、大雅。隠れるのが下手、かな
lines.translated: "...Taiga, am I... bad at hiding?"

lines.content: うん。ちょっとだけね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Just a little bit."

lines.content: そっか……。だったら明日は、もっと、ずっと、上手に隠れていないと、だ……
lines.translated: "I see... Then tomorrow, I'll have to hide much, much better..."

lines.content: じゃあ俺だって。もっと、ずっと、上手に見つけないとだ
lines.translated: "Then I'll just have to get much, much better at finding you, too."

lines.content: 小さく笑いかけて見せ、負けないぞー、だとか、そんなことを言ってみた。
lines.translated: I gave her a small smile, playfully adding that I wasn't going to lose.

lines.content: だけど……、
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: だけどクロはまたついっと、そっぽを向いた。
lines.translated: However, Kuro briskly turned her head away again.

lines.content: わたしだって
lines.translated: "Me too..."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ……わたしだって、負けない
lines.translated: "...I'm not going to lose, either."

lines.content: 顔を背けたままクロは小さな、とても小さな声でそう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro said this in a tiny, barely audible voice, her face still turned away.

lines.content: その表情にはどんな心の色が滲んでいるのか見えないけれど……。
lines.translated: I couldn't see her expression to tell what colors were bleeding into her heart, but...

lines.content: 俺はまた少し、笑顔になれた。
lines.translated: It brought another small smile to my face.

lines.content: さて。今日も俺はあさひさんたちに会いにあちら側へ行くけど
lines.translated: "Well then. I'm heading over to the other side to see Asahi-san and the others again today."

lines.content: というか、いまやあそこが俺の家だけれど。
lines.translated: Or rather, that place is practically my home now.

lines.content: クロ、君はどうする？　一緒に来てくれるかな
lines.translated: "What about you, Kuro? Will you come with me?"

lines.content: そっぽを向いたままである。
lines.translated: She kept looking away.

lines.content: だけど俺の目の前から逃げ出すようなことはない。
lines.translated: Yet she made no move to run away from me.

lines.content: そんな彼女に俺は手を差し伸べて、
lines.translated: So I held out my hand to her.

lines.content: また一緒に来てくれるなら、ほら、そんなところにいないで。……手、貸して
lines.translated: "If you're coming with me again, come on, don't just stand over there. ...Give me your hand."

lines.content: クロはちらりと俺を見た。
lines.translated: Kuro glanced at me.

lines.content: 差し出した手には捕まらず……俺をじっと、見上げている。
lines.translated: Instead of taking my offered hand... she just stared intently up at me.

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。
lines.translated: What's going on with her?

lines.content: 俺は首を傾げた。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: そしてクロは俺の手は借りず、[・|す][・|る][・|り]と校舎に這入った。
lines.translated: Then, without taking my hand, Kuro smoothly slipped into the school building.

lines.content: 手、貸さなくてよかったの？
lines.translated: "Are you sure you didn't need a hand?"

lines.content: 問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: はぁ、はぁ、と呼吸も荒く、疲労してしまっている彼女に。
lines.translated: She was panting heavily, completely worn out.

lines.content: [・|す][・|る][・|り]と――というのは、あくまで彼女の理想だ。
lines.translated: Slipping in "smoothly"--that was purely how it went in her head.

lines.content: 実際は……。
lines.translated: In reality...

lines.content: う、ん、んんん～……っ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh, nnnngh...!"

lines.content: 小さな背では中々、少し背の高くなってる花壇の塀を越えられず。
lines.translated: With her small stature, she had a hard time getting over the slightly raised wall of the flowerbed.

lines.content: ぐ～っと背伸びしてみたり、
lines.translated: She stretched herself up as tall as she could,

lines.content: ぴょんとはねたり、
lines.translated: hopped up and down,

lines.content: 一生懸命、格闘していた。
lines.translated: and struggled with all her might.

lines.content: いや。背の高さだけが原因ではない。
lines.translated: No, her height wasn't the only issue here.

lines.content: この子は運動神経に少々問題ありなのだ。猫なのに。
lines.translated: This girl had some serious problems with her motor skills. Even though she's a cat.

lines.content: そうしてなんとか塀を乗り越えたクロ。
lines.translated: Eventually, Kuro managed to clamber over the wall.

lines.content: ……問題ない
lines.translated: "...No problem."

lines.content: 息を切らせながらうなずいた。
lines.translated: She nodded, still catching her breath.

lines.content: これくらいなら、平気。大丈夫。ひとりで登れる……。ひとりで、登れた
lines.translated: "Something like this is nothing. I'm fine. I can climb it by myself... I climbed it by myself."

lines.content: 問題ないようには、平気なようには、とても見えなかったけどなあ
lines.translated: "It really didn't look like 'nothing' or 'no problem' to me, though."

lines.content: 不服そう――
lines.translated: She looked dissatisfied--

lines.content: 唇をとがらせ。目を、細め。ついっとクロはそっぽを向くのだ。
lines.translated: Pouting her lips and narrowing her eyes, Kuro briskly turned her head away.

lines.content: ……わたしは、子どもじゃない。だから何でもひとりでできる。心配ない。大雅は気にしすぎだ
lines.translated: "...I'm not a child. I can do anything by myself. No need to worry. You worry too much, Taiga."

lines.content: 人見知りな舌足らずが少しずつスムーズになってきた声でクロはそう言う。俺以外と話さないクロ。いつも最初は舌足らずだ。
lines.translated: The shy lisp in Kuro's voice gradually smoothed out as she spoke. She never talked to anyone besides me, so she always stumbled over her words at first.

lines.content: そう？　本当に？
lines.translated: "Oh yeah? Really?"

lines.content: 大丈夫だって、平気だって、言ってるのに……
lines.translated: "I keep telling you I'm fine, that it's nothing..."

lines.content: ん～。だけど、あれだよな。不思議だ。あさひさんも十夜も運動神経、とてもいいのに。どうしてクロだけ
lines.translated: "Hmm. Still, you know, it's strange. Asahi-san and Toya both have great reflexes. Why is it just you, Kuro?"

lines.content: クロは更に不満そうな顔をした。
lines.translated: Kuro looked even more displeased.

lines.content: そしてぷいっと、そっぽを向く。
lines.translated: With a huff, she turned away again.

lines.content: 大雅は、意地悪だ
lines.translated: "You're mean, Taiga."

lines.content: 校舎にだって、こうしてちゃんとひとりで、這入れたんだから……それでいいのに
lines.translated: "I managed to get into the school building all by myself just fine... That should be good enough."

lines.content: 頬を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks were puffed out.

lines.content: そしてため息をつく。
lines.translated: Then she let out a sigh.

lines.content: ……一緒に、いく
lines.translated: "...I'll go with you."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”の……あさひのお店。大雅と一緒に、わたしも、いくよ
lines.translated: "To the 'Night Magician's'... to Asahi's shop. I'll go with you too, Taiga."

lines.content: ……うん。ありがとう。そしてごめんね。色々と
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Thanks. And I'm sorry. About a lot of things."

lines.content: 微笑む。……苦笑いを、浮かべる。
lines.translated: I smiled... a wry smile rising to my face.

lines.content: そして鍵を手にする。
lines.translated: Then I took the key in my hand.

lines.content: 改めて職員室の扉にその“魔法”を使おうとしたところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was about to use that "magic" on the staff room door again,

lines.content: 俺はその手を止めた。
lines.translated: I stopped my hand.

lines.content: 隣のクロを見る。じっと、見る。
lines.translated: I looked at Kuro beside me. Staring intently at her.

lines.content: クロは小首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Kuro tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: どうしたの？　行かないの？　……何か、あったの？
lines.translated: What's wrong? Aren't we going? ...Did something happen?

lines.content: そんな表情だ。不安そうな、視線だ。
lines.translated: That was what her expression said. Her gaze was filled with unease.

lines.content: いや……、うん
lines.translated: "No... yeah."

lines.content: 頭を掻く。
lines.translated: I scratched my head.

lines.content: 少し言いにくいが――
lines.translated: It was a little hard to say, though--

lines.content: いやかなり恥ずかしいが、言ってしまおう。
lines.translated: No, it was pretty embarrassing, actually, but I decided to just say it.

lines.content: なあ、クロ。もうひとつお願いというか。確認と、いうのかな。とにかくクロに聞きたいことがあるんだけど……
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. I have one more favor to ask, or maybe something to check. Anyway, there's something I want to ask you..."

lines.content: なに……？
lines.translated: "What...?"

lines.content: 目をぱちぱちとしながらクロは俺に応えた。
lines.translated: Kuro blinked a few times as she answered me.

lines.content: 大雅はわたしに、何を聞きたい？
lines.translated: "What do you want to ask me, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 俺は隣のクロを見て、言った。
lines.translated: I looked at Kuro beside me and spoke.

lines.content: “眠れない夜は一緒に星を数えよう”
lines.translated: "'On sleepless nights, let's count the stars together.'"

lines.content: 今日は……、俺の今日という日には、クロ。色々と楽しいこと、うれしいことがたくさん、たくさん、あったんだよ
lines.translated: "Today... during my day today, Kuro, a whole lot of fun things and happy things happened to me. So, so many of them."

lines.content: だからさ……
lines.translated: "That's why..."

lines.content: そんな今日の日にあった楽しいことを……きらきらだった色々を、眠る前に、久しぶりに君と話ができるかなって。そうできればいいなって。そう思ったんだ
lines.translated: "I was wondering if I could tell you about the fun things that happened today... all those sparkling moments, right before going to sleep, for the first time in a while. I thought it'd be nice if we could do that."

lines.content: クロは目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Kuro narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: ほ、ほら。昨日はちょっとバタバタしてたから……
lines.translated: "Y-You know, things were a little hectic yesterday, so..."

lines.content: だから今夜はどうだろう。
lines.translated: So how about tonight?

lines.content: また小さなあの頃のように、夜を……眠る前の短い時間を、君と一緒に過ごせるだろうか。
lines.translated: Just like back when we were little, could I spend the night... that short time right before falling asleep, together with you?

lines.content: そんなあんまりにも稚気にあふれた本音をぶつけようとしている自分のことが……何よりも。
lines.translated: More than anything, the fact that I was trying to lay bare such an utterly childish wish...

lines.content: 俺は何よりも恥ずかしいもののように、思えてしまう。
lines.translated: It felt more embarrassing to me than anything else in the world.

lines.content: 顔が一瞬で真っ赤になったのも自分でもわかる。
lines.translated: I could feel my face turning bright red in an instant.

lines.content: 今夜……
lines.translated: "Tonight..."

lines.content: 隣で俺の顔をじっと見つめて、クロは言った。
lines.translated: Staring intently at my face from beside me, Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……今夜。大雅がもし、眠れないなら
lines.translated: "...Tonight. If you can't sleep, Taiga..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……考えて、おく
lines.translated: "...I'll think about it."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: だから[・|電][・|話]のスイッチ、切らないでおいて
lines.translated: "So don't turn your phone off."

lines.content: ……うん。わかった
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Got it."

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.
Just that alone was enough to put my mind at ease.

lines.content: 言いようのないほど大きな安堵を、覚えてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: I felt an indescribably huge wave of relief wash over me.

lines.content: ポケットの中の鍵を握りしめる。
lines.translated: I squeezed the key inside my pocket.

lines.content: ……そうして町をふたりで並んで歩き、“ゆめのねどこ”へと帰宅した。
lines.translated: And so, the two of us walked side by side through the town and returned home to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: おかえり
lines.translated: "Welcome back."

lines.content: 迎えられたその声に安心し。
lines.translated: Hearing that welcoming voice put me at ease.

lines.content: 今日も一日お疲れだったな
lines.translated: "Good work out there today."

lines.content: その言葉に、なぜか、疲労も小さくなっていき――
lines.translated: For some reason, those words made my exhaustion melt away a little--

lines.content: あ、おかえりなさい大雅くん。今日はね、コロッケなんだって。一緒に作ろう？
lines.translated: "Ah, welcome back, Taiga-kun. Apparently we're having croquettes today. Want to make them together?"

lines.content: うれしい先客の微笑みに、思わず笑みがこぼれた。
lines.translated: Seeing the smile of a welcome guest already here, a grin naturally slipped onto my face.

lines.content: ハル。来てたんだ
lines.translated: "Haru. You're here."

lines.content: 後ろ手に扉を閉め……振り返る。
lines.translated: Closing the door behind me... I turned around.

lines.content: だけどそこにクロはいなかった。
lines.translated: However, Kuro wasn't there.

lines.content: ハルに。十夜に。あさひさん。
lines.translated: Haru, Toya, and Asahi-san.

lines.content: 思っていたより賑わいでいた“ゆめのねどこ”だ。
lines.translated: The "Bed of Dreams" was livelier than I had expected.

lines.content: クロは素早く二階の部屋へと上がっていったようだった。
lines.translated: It seemed Kuro had quickly slipped upstairs to her room on the second floor.

lines.content: あさひさんはその様子を見ていたのだろう。やれやれとばかりに首をすくめ、俺に苦笑いを送っていた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san must have seen that happen. She shrugged as if to say "oh dear" and gave me a wry smile.

lines.content: ……クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: 俺の前では一生懸命話をしてくれようとするけれど……。
lines.translated: She tries her hardest to talk when she's in front of me, and yet...

lines.content: 俺以外とは殆ど話をしようとしない。目も合わせようとしない。それは昔から変わらずそうだった。
lines.translated: She barely tries to speak with anyone else. She won't even meet their eyes. It's always been that way since long ago.

lines.content: え、えっと……
ハルが気まずげな笑顔を見せていた。
lines.translated: Haru wore an awkward smile.

lines.content: そんなハルに、俺は言う――店内のテーブルに広げられた材料やらを見渡しながら。できるだけ、軽い調子で。
lines.translated: Looking over the ingredients spread out across the shop's table, I spoke to her in as light a tone as I could manage.

lines.content: 今日は……、コロッケ？
lines.translated: "So... croquettes today?"

lines.content: あ、うん。そうみたいだよ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Looks like it."

lines.content: ハルは、微笑む。
lines.translated: Haru smiled.

lines.content: 十夜と一緒にお手伝いしてたんだけど……美味しいの、いっぱい作っちゃうよ。しっかりこねて。綺麗に丸めて。食べ盛りな男の子のお腹もいっぱいにできるようにって
lines.translated: "I've been helping out with Toya... We're gonna make lots of delicious ones! Kneading them well and rolling them up nice and neat, so they can fill up a growing boy's stomach."

lines.content: パン粉や小麦粉で真っ白になった両手をにぎにぎとさせ……笑う。
lines.translated: She clenched and unclenched her hands, which were pure white with breadcrumbs and flour... and laughed.

lines.content: 俺もつられて笑顔を作る。
lines.translated: Drawn in by her, I broke into a smile too.

lines.content: 今夜もご馳走になっちゃうだけじゃ悪いから……。だからせめてお手伝いくらいはしたいと思って
lines.translated: "I'd feel bad just freeloading again tonight... so I figured I should at least help out a little."

lines.content: なるほど……。ところで、ハル。料理とかできたんだ
lines.translated: "I see... By the way, Haru, I didn't know you could cook."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: いや、俺さ。ハルは料理は苦手なんじゃないのかなって勝手に思い込んでたよ。たとえば
lines.translated: "I mean, for some reason I just assumed you were bad at cooking. Like, for example..."

lines.content: たとえばって……？
lines.translated: "For example...?"

lines.content: うん。たとえばさ、破壊的な味覚のセンスで料理が猛毒に変化したり――だけでなく。調理中の鍋が破裂したりするようなタイプだと勝手に思ってた
lines.translated: "Yeah. Like, I just assumed you were the type whose destructive sense of taste would turn food into deadly poison--and not just that, you'd make the pot explode while cooking."

lines.content: そんなこと……
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: “ないよ”、と言って怒られるかと思った。
lines.translated: I thought she'd get mad and say "not true!"

lines.content: だが、ハルは決まり悪そうに視線を泳がせ、言った。
lines.translated: However, Haru's eyes darted around awkwardly before she spoke.

lines.content: ……ない、とは言えないかも。だね
lines.translated: "...I can't exactly say that's *not* true, I guess."

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり？
lines.translated: "Aha, I knew it."

lines.content: えー、やっぱりってなに？
lines.translated: "Hey, what do you mean 'I knew it'?"

lines.content: 唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: She pouted.

lines.content: 大雅くん。君は、あれだね。昔にずいぶん身体が比べて大きくなったけど、意地悪な心も一緒に大きくなっちゃったんだね。なんだか千和ちゃんが可哀想だよ
lines.translated: "You know what, Taiga-kun? Your body has grown a whole lot bigger compared to back then, and it looks like your mean streak grew right along with it. I kinda feel sorry for Chiwa-chan."

lines.content: ぷりぷりとしながらハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru huffed indignantly as she spoke.

lines.content: お鍋を爆発させちゃったのも。食べた人を失神させちゃったりとかも。そんな失敗は、もう、何度も何度も繰り返してきたから……。だから今はもう人並みにはできるんだよ
lines.translated: "Blowing up pots, making people who ate my food pass out... I've already made mistakes like that over and over again... So now I can cook about as well as anyone else!"

lines.content: ……なるほど。この数年。君も色々、大変だったんだな
lines.translated: "...I see. Sounds like you've been through a lot over these past few years too."

lines.content: しみじみとした。
lines.translated: It really hit home for me.

lines.content: 当然だが俺の年月に色々なことがあったのだから、ハルの過ごした年月にもまた、色々なことがあったに違いないのだ。
lines.translated: Naturally, since all sorts of things had happened during my years, all sorts of things must have happened during the years Haru spent away, too.

lines.content: 改めて。ただいま帰りました、あさひさん。少し遅くなってしまいました
lines.translated: "Once again, I'm home, Asahi-san. Sorry I'm a little late."

lines.content: うん。おかえり。何かあったのかなって心配してたんだぞ
lines.translated: "Yeah, welcome back. I was worried something might have happened."

lines.content: あさひさんは微笑んでくれる。十夜と一緒にコロッケを丸めながら。
lines.translated: Asahi-san smiled at me while rolling croquettes alongside Toya.

lines.content: 学園でちょっと色々ありまして。今日はいつもより課題がマシマシです
lines.translated: "A few things came up at the academy. I've got a bigger pile of assignments than usual today."

lines.content: そっか。それならしっかり食べて力をつけなきゃだ
lines.translated: "I see. Then you'll have to eat plenty and keep your strength up."

lines.content: 美味しくなるようがんばらなきゃ。責任重大ですね
lines.translated: "We have to do our best to make them delicious. That's a big responsibility."

lines.content: うん。自分でこねこねしたコロッケ、美味しいよね。すごく
lines.translated: "Yeah. Croquettes you knead yourself are delicious, right? Super delicious."

lines.content: 十夜が真剣な顔でコロッケを丸めていた。
lines.translated: Toya was rolling a croquette with a serious expression on her face.

lines.content: ああ。自分たちで作ったコロッケは不思議なくらい美味しいぞ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Croquettes you make yourself taste almost magically delicious."

lines.content: 餃子とかも同じだな。一個一個、自分の手で丁寧にお肉を包んで作っていくんだ。お店のものより断然不格好なのに、どうしてか、断然、美味しくできちゃうんだ
lines.translated: "It's the same with gyoza, too. You carefully wrap the meat one by one with your own hands. Even though they turn out way uglier than store-bought ones, for some reason, they end up tasting way better."

lines.content: そういった不思議を今日はみんなで作ろうかとあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san suggested that we all create that kind of magic together today.

lines.content: わかりました。一番いいのを作ってあさひさんにご馳走しますよ
lines.translated: "Got it. I'll make the best one of the bunch and treat you to it, Asahi-san."

lines.content: 俺は腕まくりをする。
lines.translated: I rolled up my sleeves.

lines.content: さて。まずは何をしましょうかあさひさん。タマネギ切ったりとかですか？　ええ、何でもやりますよ。俺、知っての通り、料理とかからっきしですけども
lines.translated: "Alright, what should I start with, Asahi-san? Chopping onions or something? Yeah, I'll do whatever. Though as you well know, I'm completely hopeless at cooking."

lines.content: そんな得意そうに言われてもな。反応に困るよ
lines.translated: "When you say that so proudly, I don't even know how to respond."

lines.content: 苦笑いであさひさんが言い――その隣で“ぱんっ”と、音がした。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said with a wry smile--and right next to her, there was a loud *pop*.

lines.content: なんだ？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 振り返ると……、
lines.translated: When I turned around...

lines.content: ……うう～。お姉ちゃん、どうしよう、大変になっちゃった
lines.translated: "...Uuu~ Onee-chan, what do I do? Something terrible happened."

lines.content: ど、どうしたんだ十夜、その頭
lines.translated: "W-What happened to your head, Toya?!"

lines.content: 真っ白だった。
lines.translated: It was pure white.

lines.content: 十夜はけほけほと咳をする。
lines.translated: Toya coughed a few times.

lines.content: ……小麦粉の袋。バンってなっちゃった
lines.translated: "...The bag of flour. It went boom."

lines.content: どうやら小麦粉の袋を開けようとして、力が入りすぎてしまったのか、破裂してしまったらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, she had put too much strength into trying to open the bag of flour, causing it to burst.

lines.content: ごめんねお姉ちゃん。もったいないことしちゃった……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Onee-chan. What a waste..."

lines.content: それはいいよ、気にするな。がんばってくれたんだもんな。それよりも
lines.translated: "That's fine, don't worry about it. You were doing your best, after all. More importantly..."

lines.content: あさひさんは十夜の手を取る。そしてその指先や手のひらを見る。
lines.translated: Asahi-san took Toya's hands and checked her fingertips and palms.

lines.content: 怪我とかはしてないか？　真っ白けになっただけ？
lines.translated: "Are you hurt anywhere? Or did you just get turned pure white?"

lines.content: うん……。大丈夫。平気だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... I'm okay. I'm fine."

lines.content: そうか。平気か。それならよかった。安心だ
lines.translated: "I see. You're fine, huh? That's good, then. What a relief."

lines.content: 息をつき――
lines.translated: She breathed a sigh of relief--

lines.content: だけどあさひさんは、小さく吹き出す。
lines.translated: But then Asahi-san let out a small snicker.

lines.content: はは、十夜。コロッケの代わりに十夜を揚げて食べちゃおうか。きっと美味しいぞ
lines.translated: "Haha, Toya. Maybe we should fry you up and eat you instead of the croquettes. I bet you'd be delicious."

lines.content: むぅ。今日のお姉ちゃんは意地悪だよ
lines.translated: "Muu. You're being mean today, Onee-chan."

lines.content: ムクレっ面をする十夜だった。
lines.translated: Toya pouted.

lines.content: 十夜。料理の前に一緒にお風呂入ろうか。あさひさん、いいですか？
lines.translated: "Toya, let's go take a bath together before we cook. Is that okay, Asahi-san?"

lines.content: うん。お願いしてもいいかな。コロッケ作りはそれからにしよう
lines.translated: "Yeah. Could I leave that to you? Let's hold off on making the croquettes until after that."

lines.content: 十夜の手を引き背を向けたハルだったけど、
lines.translated: Haru took Toya's hand and turned her back,

lines.content: こちらを振り返り、俺を見ている。
lines.translated: only to glance back over her shoulder and stare at me.

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 覗いちゃだめだよ。絶対、だめだよ
lines.translated: "No peeking, okay? Absolutely no peeking."

lines.content: 覗かないよ
lines.translated: "I'm not gonna peek."

lines.content: 本当に？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: 本当に
lines.translated: "Really."

lines.content: 深くうなずく。
lines.translated: She nodded deeply.

lines.content: 俺、子どもの裸には興味ないんだ。だから安全
lines.translated: "I have no interest in seeing kids naked. So you're safe."

lines.content: ……それってどういうことかな
lines.translated: "...And what exactly do you mean by that?"

lines.content: 目を細めた。
lines.translated: She narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: 私だってもう昔みたいに子どもじゃないんだよ？　だから……
lines.translated: "I'm not a kid like I used to be, you know? So..."

lines.content: いや、えっと。ハルのことじゃなくて、十夜のことで
lines.translated: "No, um. I didn't mean you, Haru, I meant Toya."

lines.content: えー、私だって子どもじゃないもん
lines.translated: "Hey, I'm not a kid either!"

lines.content: 失礼だよねまったくだよねとふたりはぷんすかしながらお風呂場へ。
lines.translated: Huffing and puffing to each other about how rude I was, the two of them marched off to the bathroom.

lines.content: ……いったいなんだったんだ
lines.translated: "...What on earth was that about?"

lines.content: 首をかしげるばかりの俺だった。
lines.translated: All I could do was tilt my head in confusion.

lines.content: はは
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: あさひさんが笑う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san laughed.

lines.content: やっぱりハルがいるといつもより、ほんの少しだけ、大雅は様子が違うよな
lines.translated: "You really do act just a tiny bit different than usual when Haru's around, Taiga."

lines.content: ……そうですか？
うん。ちょっとはしゃいでるっていうのかな。そんな感じがするよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. How should I put it... like you're in high spirits? That's the impression I get."

lines.content: うーん
lines.translated: "Hmm."

lines.content: どうだろうか。
lines.translated: Was that true?

lines.content: そんな自覚はまるでないけど……。
lines.translated: I wasn't aware of it at all, though...

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: はい？
lines.translated: "Excuse me?"

lines.content: 君が最初にここに来たときは大変だった。ああ、一筋縄じゃいかなそうな子が来たなあって思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "It was rough when you first came here. I remember thinking, 'Oh boy, looks like we've got a kid who's going to be a real handful.'"

lines.content: え？　そうなんですか？　初耳ですけど
lines.translated: "Huh? Really? That's the first I've heard of it."

lines.content: そりゃあそうさ。今、はじめて言うんだからね
lines.translated: "Well, of course it is. This is the first time I'm telling you."

lines.content: にこりとし、あさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san smiled warmly and continued.

lines.content: ……ハルと話してる君を見ていると、どうしてかな。あの頃のことをなんとなく思い出してしまったんだ。まるで共通点なんてないのに
lines.translated: "...I wonder why, watching you talk with Haru somehow reminded me of back then. Even though the two situations have nothing in common at all."

lines.content: ああ、うん。君は、そうだな。今だから正直に言えることではあるけれど――控えめに言っても変わってた
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Back then, well... I can only say this honestly now that so much time has passed, but--to put it mildly, you were unusual."

lines.content: あさひさんはしみじみとしていた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san looked reflective.

lines.content: それまでここで出会った子たちとは少し、いいや、かなり違ったんだ
lines.translated: "You were a little--no, quite different from the other kids I'd met here before."
"The wish you carried with you was far too heavy for a child to bear so young. So I actually agonized quite a bit over what the right way to treat you was."

lines.content: そうなんですか？　と首をかしげる俺に、あさひさんは、ああ、そうだよ。実はね、とうなずいた。
lines.translated: When I tilted my head and asked, "Is that so?", Asahi-san nodded and replied, "Yeah, it really is."

lines.content: まあ、何が言いたいのかというと……大雅。君が元気になれて良かった
lines.translated: "Well, what I'm trying to say is... Taiga, I'm glad you've gotten better."

lines.content: そして、無事、こんなに大きな男の子に育ってくれた。それもまた、うれしい
lines.translated: "And you've safely grown into such a big boy. That makes me happy, too."

lines.content: ……ほら、見てみろ。もう私より背が高い。はじめて会ったときは十夜と同じくらい小さかったのに。まったく生意気だよな
lines.translated: "...Come on, look at this. You're already taller than me. When we first met, you were as tiny as Toya. Seriously, how cheeky of you."

lines.content: あさひさんはぴたりと俺に肩をつけて立つ。そしてくすくすと、笑う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san stood right next to me, pressing her shoulder against mine. Then she giggled softly.

lines.content: がんばってつま先立ちしてみても、君の首もとくらいにしか私はもう届かない
lines.translated: "Even if I try my best to stand on my tiptoes, I can barely reach your neck anymore."

lines.content: こんなふうに言われてしまうと。
lines.translated: When she says things like that to me...

lines.content: こんなふうに、笑顔を向けられてしまうと。
lines.translated: When she turns a smile like that toward me...

lines.content: （……あさひさんとはじめて会ったとき、か）
lines.translated: (...When I first met Asahi-san, huh.)

lines.content: 俺も昔のことを思い出さずにはいられなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but remember the old days, too.

lines.content: 数年前。
lines.translated: Several years ago.

lines.content: 少女たちの戦争が始まる少し前。
lines.translated: Just before the girls' war began.

lines.content: ……はじめて“ゆめのねどこ”の扉を開いた、あの頃。
lines.translated: Back when I first opened the door to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: あの頃の俺は。
lines.translated: Back then, I...

lines.content: 何もかもが小さく無力だった、この俺は。
lines.translated: Everything about me was small and powerless. I...

lines.content: どうしても。
lines.translated: No matter what.

lines.content: どう、しても……。
lines.translated: No matter what...

lines.content: 自分のことが嫌いで。
lines.translated: I hated myself.

lines.content: 憎くて。
lines.translated: I despised myself.

lines.content: 許せなくて。
lines.translated: I couldn't forgive myself.

lines.content: すぐにでも死んで、しまいたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to die right then and there.

lines.content: ――今すぐ死ねる方法を教えてください。
lines.translated: --Please tell me a way I can die right now.

lines.content: それが一番最初に、あさひさんへと投げかけた言葉だったように思う。
lines.translated: I think those were the very first words I ever threw at Asahi-san.

lines.content: 十年前のことだ。
lines.translated: That was ten years ago.

lines.content: [・|予][・|言]によって出現が示されたという“夜の王”
lines.translated: The "King of the Night," whose appearance was foretold by prophecy.

lines.content: 人類の心を蝕む最大の“悪夢”
lines.translated: The greatest "Nightmare" eating away at the hearts of humanity.

lines.content: そして人類の未来を守るための“夜”の戦争。
lines.translated: And the war of the "Night" fought to protect humanity's future.

lines.content: 少女らと共に力を合わせ、無事、闘争に勝利できた後のことだ。
lines.translated: It happened after I joined forces with the girls and we safely won that struggle.

lines.content: 結局は何の役にも立てず、少女たちに護られてばかりいたこの俺は……。
lines.translated: Even though I ended up being completely useless and did nothing but get protected by the girls...

lines.content: それでも、最前線で戦い続けた少女らと同様に、[夢|願い]を叶えるための“魔法”を得る権利を与えられたのだった。
lines.translated: Just like the girls who kept fighting on the front lines, I was still given the right to obtain "magic" to grant my wish--my dream.

lines.content: 今日から一緒に考えよう。君の悲しみに、[・|そ][・|の]“[・|魔][・|法]”は本当に必要なのかな
lines.translated: "Let's think about it together starting today. Does your sorrow really need that 'magic'?"

lines.content: あさひさんは一人ひとり順番に部屋へと招き入れ、それぞれにそう問いかけたのだという。
lines.translated: Asahi-san invited each of us into her room one by one in turn, and asked us all that same question.

lines.content: ……一人ひとり、その胸が抱える悲しみの内容については、詳しく問いかけることなく。
lines.translated: Without prying into the details of the sorrow each of us carried in our hearts.

lines.content: 戦争の報酬として与えられた“最後の魔法”――その奇跡さえあればそれぞれの人生に立ちふさがる困難を一瞬でかき消すことができるはず。
lines.translated: The "Last Magic" given as a reward for the war--with that miracle alone, we should have been able to wipe away the hardships blocking our respective lives in an instant.

lines.content: だけどその奇跡は君らにとって本当に必要なモノなのか否か。
lines.translated: However, was that miracle truly something we needed, or not?

lines.content: それを確かめなければ、“夜”の外へ“魔法”を持ち出す許可をあさひさんは出せなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: Without confirming that, Asahi-san probably couldn't give us permission to take our "magic" outside of the "Night."

lines.content: そんなあさひさんへの返答が、その一言だった。
lines.translated: My reply to Asahi-san was that single sentence.

lines.content: ……今すぐ死ねる方法を教えてほしい。
lines.translated: I want you to tell me a way I can die right now.

lines.content: 言葉の選択はどこか細かく違っていたかもしれない。
lines.translated: My exact choice of words might have been slightly different.

lines.content: だが俺は、意味としてはそう遠くはないだろうはずのことを口にしたはずだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I'm certain I said something that wasn't far off in meaning.

lines.content: さあ、教えてほしい。君の願いはなんだろう。どうして君は、“魔法”を必要とするのかな
lines.translated: "Now, tell me. What is your wish? Why is it that you need 'magic'?"

lines.content: という、あさひさんの問いかけに対して返したのだと記憶している。
lines.translated: I remember saying it in response to that question from Asahi-san.

lines.content: ――できるだけ苦しんで死にたい。
lines.translated: --I want to suffer as much as possible and die.

lines.content: ――その方法はないでしょうか。そのための“魔法”は、ないでしょうか。
lines.translated: --Is there a way to do that? Is there "magic" for that?

lines.content: ――教えてください。何でもします。できることなら、なんだって。
lines.translated: --Please tell me. I'll do anything. Whatever I possibly can.

lines.content: それが、あのときの俺の答えだった。
lines.translated: That was my answer back then.

lines.content: ――ぼくは苦しんで死にたい。できるだけ最悪な死に方を選びたい。
lines.translated: --I want to suffer and die. I want to choose the absolute worst way to die possible.

lines.content: ――あなたは。この町の“魔法使い”は。この願いを“夜の王”との戦いの果てに……こんな簡単な願い事くらい、叶えられるんですよね？
lines.translated: --You... The "Mage" of this town... At the end of the battle with the "King of the Night"... You can grant a simple wish like this, right?

lines.content: 俺の命は存在そのものが死に神のようなもの。
lines.translated: My very existence, my life itself, was like a reaper.

lines.content: もはやこの世界のどこにも居場所はない。あってはならない。
lines.translated: There was no longer a place for me anywhere in this world. There shouldn't be.

lines.content: 自分という命は消えてなくなって初めて、ようやく“何か”の役に立てるのだ……。
lines.translated: Only when this life of mine vanished into nothing would I finally be of some use...

lines.content: 細いため息をつき、あさひさんは椅子の背もたれに深く身体を預けた。
lines.translated: Letting out a thin sigh, Asahi-san leaned deeply back against her chair.

lines.content: ……なあ、少年。死にたがりの男の子。私から、君へ。問いかけたい。まずは教えてほしいんだ。“どうして君はそんなにも死にたいと願うのか”――
lines.translated: "...Hey, kid. You boy who wants to die. I have a question for you. First, I want you to tell me this. 'Why do you wish so badly to die?'--"

lines.content: この問いに、この私を、“特権”と“役割”を担う“魔法使い”であるこの私のことを、充分以上に納得させられるくらい説得力のある返答をして見せてほしい
lines.translated: "I want you to give me an answer to this question persuasive enough to more than satisfy me--the 'Mage' who bears this 'privilege' and 'role.'"

lines.content: ――あなたを説得できれば願いを叶えてもらえる。かも、しれない？
lines.translated: --If I can convince you, you'll grant my wish. Maybe?

lines.content: ああ。かも、しれないな
lines.translated: "Yeah. Maybe."

lines.content: まずは、そこからだよ。[・|そ][・|れ]がかなわなければお話にならない。それこそが、まず最初に、君がここで乗り越えるべき障害だ。よくよく考えてから答えてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "First, we start there. If you can't manage that, it's out of the question. That is the very first obstacle you must overcome here. I want you to think it through carefully before you answer."

lines.content: しかしその問いにあの頃の俺は即答した。
lines.translated: However, back then, I answered that question immediately.

lines.content: ――この命そのものが疫病神だ。
lines.translated: --This life itself is a curse.

lines.content: その答えをひねり出すのにほんの少しの悩みもなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't hesitate for even a fraction of a second to come up with that answer.

lines.content: ――周りの人たちを。
lines.translated: --The people around me.

lines.content: ――何よりも大切だと想うすべての人たちを。
lines.translated: --All the people I hold dearer than anything else.

lines.content: ――ぼくは手当たり次第に不幸にしてしまう。
lines.translated: --I indiscriminately bring misfortune to them all.

lines.content: ――この命は、この存在は、そういうふうにできてしまっている。
lines.translated: --This life, this existence, is simply built that way.

lines.content: ――だから死にたい。最大最悪の罰を受けてから、死んでしまいたい。
lines.translated: --That's why I want to die. I want to receive the greatest, worst punishment possible, and then die.

lines.content: この町にたどり着いてからというもの……。
lines.translated: Ever since I arrived in this town...

lines.content: ずっとだ。ずっとずっと、眠れない夜が続いてた。
lines.translated: The whole time. For the longest time, the sleepless nights had continued.

lines.content: ――嫌だ。もう、嫌だ。限界なんだ。
lines.translated: --I hate it. I can't take it anymore. I'm at my limit.

lines.content: ――死にたい。殺してほしい。身体も全部。心も、全部。
lines.translated: --I want to die. I want you to kill me. All of my body. All of my heart, too.

lines.content: いつも側にいてくれたはずの[クロ|あの子]も、戦争が終わった後、よくどこかへ出かけたまま帰ってこないことが多くなった。
lines.translated: Even that girl--Kuro--who was supposed to always be by my side, often went out somewhere and didn't come back for long stretches after the war ended.

lines.content: するとたちまち脆弱な俺の心には後ろ向きな言葉が溢れてしまう。
lines.translated: Whenever that happened, negative words would immediately overflow from my fragile heart.

lines.content: あの子が心配するようなことを……クロが側にいると口にできない身勝手な言葉を、俺は、魔法使いを相手に吐き散らし続けた。
lines.translated: Things that would make her worry... Selfish words I couldn't say when Kuro was by my side, I kept spewing out at the Mage.

lines.content: 答えは[のー|却下]だな。君の答えは曖昧すぎる。とても“夜”の中から“魔法”を……“奇跡”を持ち出すことは許可できない
lines.translated: "The answer is 'No'--rejected. Your answer is far too vague. There's no way I can give you permission to take 'magic'... to take a 'miracle' out of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: それから俺たちは顔をつきあわせ、たくさんの言葉を交わした。
lines.translated: After that, we met face-to-face and exchanged countless words.

lines.content: 長いながい時間が過ぎた。
lines.translated: A long, long time passed.

lines.content: 長いながい、言葉を分け合った。
lines.translated: We shared long, long conversations.

lines.content: しかしどれだけ月日が流れても、俺の“魔法”に許可は下りなかった。
lines.translated: Yet no matter how many months and days flowed by, permission for my "magic" was never granted.

lines.content: 君は“魔法”を扱うには“心”があまりに足りない
lines.translated: "You lack far too much 'heart' to handle 'magic.'"

lines.content: いつだったか、あさひさんは本をぱたりと閉じて、そう言った。
lines.translated: At some point, Asahi-san snapped her book shut and said that.

lines.content: 君のすべてがあんまりに危なっかしいんだよ
lines.translated: "Everything about you is just way too precarious."

lines.content: ――だからぼくの“魔法”に許可は出せない？
lines.translated: --Is that why you can't give permission for my "magic"?

lines.content: ……ああ。そんなところだよ。何せ君は自身をもっとも最悪な方法で殺してくれる“魔法”を想像してる。そんなのは危なっかしいどころの話じゃない
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Something like that. After all, you're imagining a 'magic' that will kill you in the absolute worst way possible. Calling that precarious is an understatement."

lines.content: いいかい？　忘れないでほしい。君らの“魔法”は誰にも負けない“想像力”だ。
lines.translated: "Listen, okay? I don't want you to forget this. Your 'magic' is an 'imagination' second to none."

lines.content: そう囁くように言ったあさひさんの手には小説が。映画のＤＶＤが。漫画本のシリーズが。穏やかでときに激しい音楽のレコードが。
lines.translated: Whispering those words, Asahi-san held novels in her hands. Movie DVDs. Manga series. Records of music both gentle and at times intense.

lines.content: 溢れんばかりのそれらを次々と渡された。
lines.translated: She handed them over to me one after another, an overflowing mountain of them.

lines.content: ここにあるたくさんの物語と、たくさんの登場人物たちの言葉を見つめて“心”を磨けよ、さみしがり屋の男の子。[・|ヒ][・|ー][・|ロ][・|ー][・|は][・|き][・|っ][・|と]、[・|こ][・|こ][・|に][・|い][・|る]
lines.translated: "Gaze at the many stories here, and the words of the many characters within them, and polish your 'heart,' you lonely boy. A hero is surely right here."

lines.content: “夢”も“希望”も……“魔法”も全部、これらの中に詰まってる
lines.translated: "'Dreams,' 'hope'... and 'magic' are all packed inside these."

lines.content: そしてまた、一冊の本を差し出された。
lines.translated: And then, she held out another book to me.

lines.content: ぱらぱらとめくった。
lines.translated: I flipped through the pages.

lines.content: 異世界に迷い込んだ少年が願いを叶えるために冒険し、いくつもの困難を乗り越え成長していく物語。
lines.translated: It was a story about a boy who wandered into another world, went on an adventure to grant his wish, and grew as he overcame numerous hardships.

lines.content: その少年は自分と正反対のように思えて。
lines.translated: That boy felt like the exact opposite of me.

lines.content: その“心”は、あまりにも眩しく見えて。
lines.translated: His "heart" looked far too dazzling.

lines.content: 彼の迎えたエンディングにはとうてい納得できようはずもなく。
lines.translated: There was no way I could ever accept the ending he reached.

lines.content: 目を、逸らした。
lines.translated: I looked away.

lines.content: この世界は[魔法|宝物]で溢れかえってる
lines.translated: "This world is overflowing with treasures--with magic."

lines.content: あさひさんはつらく悲しい物語こそ愛おしそうに扱った――
lines.translated: Asahi-san treated the painful, sad stories most lovingly of all--

lines.content: ここにある言葉たちはすべて、過去から現在へと届けられる[エール|応援]なんだよ
lines.translated: "All the words here are cheers sent from the past to the present."

lines.content: その声に耳を傾けるように本を読み。共に心を締め付けるように映画を見。時に涙をこらえながら漫画を開き。いつか一緒に穏やかな音楽に心たゆたい――面白おかしく笑っていよう
