lines.translated: "Read books as if listening closely to those voices. Watch movies as if letting them squeeze our hearts together. Open manga while holding back tears at times. And someday, let's let our hearts drift along to gentle music together--and laugh in amusement."

lines.content: だけど、どうしようもなく悲しいことがあったなら時には泣いてもいいし、落ち込んだってかまわない。そうできる“心”にだけ、“魔法”が宿る
lines.translated: "However, if something overwhelmingly sad happens, it's okay to cry sometimes, and it doesn't matter if you get depressed. 'Magic' only dwells within a 'heart' capable of doing that."

lines.content: そうして自分の人生の意味を“想像”するんだ、とあさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: That is how you "imagine" the meaning of your own life, Asahi-san said.

lines.content: ……忘れないで。[・|私][・|た][・|ち]はいつだって、がんばってる君を応援しているよ
lines.translated: "...Don't forget. We are always cheering for you as you do your best."

lines.content: 人生の意味――
lines.translated: The meaning of life--

lines.content: 死を望んでばかりいる人間に対して何を言っているんだ。“夢”も“希望”も眩しすぎてめまいがするんだ。
lines.translated: What is she saying to someone who only ever wishes for death? Both "dreams" and "hope" are so blindingly bright they make me dizzy.

lines.content: そう、思いながらも……。
lines.translated: Yet even as I thought that...

lines.content: あの頃の俺はどこにも居場所なんてなかった。
lines.translated: Back then, I didn't have a place to belong anywhere.

lines.content: やはり毎夜のようにここを訪れては、“魔法使い”の言うことに倣うほか、すべきことなど思いつけなかった。
lines.translated: In the end, I couldn't think of anything else to do besides visiting here nearly every night and doing as the "Mage" said.

lines.content: 死にたいばかりの“心”は意味もなく生き延びた。
lines.translated: My "heart," which only wanted to die, survived without any meaning.

lines.content: “魔法使い”とふたりで本を読み。映画を見。“夜”の町の劇場で、猫たちの演じる[ショー|お芝居]を見上げ。音楽にたゆたい。漫画を開く。
lines.translated: The "Mage" and I read books together. We watched movies. At the theater in the town of the "Night," we looked up at the shows performed by the cats. We drifted along to music. We opened manga.

lines.content: いつしか自分と同じくらいの歳に見える女の子も加わった。
lines.translated: Before long, a girl who looked about the same age as me joined us.

lines.content: 私の妹だと“魔法使い”は紹介した。微笑んで。
lines.translated: With a smile, the "Mage" introduced her as her younger sister.

lines.content: 名前は十夜だ。冬月十夜。わけあって名字は違うがれっきとした私の妹だ。[・|今]はちょうど君と同じくらいだな。仲良くしてくれたらうれしいよ
lines.translated: "Her name is Toya. Fuyutsuki Toya. Our last names are different for certain reasons, but she's my proper little sister. Right now, she's just about the same age as you. I'd be happy if you two got along."

lines.content: “魔法使い”の妹はなんだかひどく人見知りで、いつも姉の背中に隠れていた。
lines.translated: The "Mage's" little sister was terribly shy for some reason, always hiding behind her older sister's back.

lines.content: だけど、『かわいい名前だね。お耳もとってもかわいいよ』とそう言うと、照れたように、そしてうれしそうに笑ってくれるようになった。
lines.translated: However, when I told her, "That's a cute name. Your ears are really cute, too," she started smiling bashfully and happily for me.

lines.content: 三人で色々なことをしたように思う。
lines.translated: I feel like the three of us did all sorts of things together.

lines.content: 色々な場所に出かけたように、思う。
lines.translated: I feel like we went out to all sorts of places.

lines.content: 夢の世界は。そして[・|死][・|者][・|の][・|世][・|界]は……“夜の国”は、どこまでも広大で。
lines.translated: The world of dreams. And the world of the dead... The "Realm of the Night" was boundlessly vast.

lines.content: そこに住む猫たちの不思議な町は、星空よりもきらきら光って。
lines.translated: The mysterious town of the cats who lived there sparkled even brighter than the starry sky.

lines.content: “[ここ|夜]”はどんなに冒険しても飽きることはなかった。
lines.translated: No matter how much we adventured through the "Night" here, I never grew tired of it.

lines.content: 楽しい。
lines.translated: It was fun.

lines.content: そう思ってしまったことも一度や二度ではないだろう。
lines.translated: I'm sure it wasn't just once or twice that I caught myself thinking that.

lines.content: うれしい。
lines.translated: I'm happy.

lines.content: そんな気持ちを拾ったのも、ひとつやふたつではなかったはずだ。
lines.translated: It couldn't have been just once or twice that I picked up feelings like that, either.

lines.content: だからもう少し。
lines.translated: So just a little longer.

lines.content: あとほんの、少しだけ。
lines.translated: Just a tiny bit longer.

lines.content: ……生きているのも、悪くはないかも。
lines.translated: Maybe being alive isn't so bad.

lines.content: そんなふうに願ったことも、きっとあったことだろう。
lines.translated: I'm sure there were times when I wished for that, too.

lines.content: そんな資格。
lines.translated: That kind of qualification.

lines.content: ……そんな、権利。
lines.translated: That kind of right.

lines.content: こんな自分になどあり得てはいけないのに。
lines.translated: Someone like me should never be allowed to have them.

lines.content: だけどそんな罪悪感にも似た感情は、ほんの少しでも抱いた端から、“魔法使い”の作る温かなご飯によってうやむやにされてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Yet the moment I harbored even the slightest hint of that guilt-like emotion, it would be swept away by the warm meals the "Mage" made.

lines.content: 今夜もたくさん遊んだな。“夜”の町で買い物してきた材料で、さて、今日は何を作ろうか
lines.translated: "We played a lot tonight, too. Now then, what should I make today with the ingredients we bought in the town of the 'Night'?"

lines.content: 三人で思い切り遊んだ夜は、最後にいつも“魔法使い”が美味しいご飯を作ってくれた。
lines.translated: At the end of a night where the three of us played to our hearts' content, the "Mage" always cooked a delicious meal for us.

lines.content: 三人揃って『いただきます』と手を合わせて微笑み合った。
lines.translated: All three of us clapped our hands together, said "Thank you for the food," and smiled at one another.

lines.content: 魔法使いが作ってくれる美味しいご飯は、お腹だけではない、“心”までをも満たしてくれる。そんな気がしていた。
lines.translated: The delicious meals the Mage made didn't just fill my stomach; I felt like they filled my "heart" as well.

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.
I must not think things like that.

lines.content: だから俺は、いつも『ごちそうさま』の代わりにこう言った。
lines.translated: So instead of saying "Thank you for the meal," I always said this:

lines.content: ――いつ死に方を教えてくれるの。この世で一番、凄惨で、苦しい死に方を。
lines.translated: --When will you teach me how to die? The most gruesome, painful way to die in this world.

lines.content: そう問いかけるのも、いつからか挨拶のようなものに成り下がってしまっていたけれど。
lines.translated: Even though asking that had degenerated into something like a mere greeting at some point.

lines.content: ……そうだな。君がその願いを忘れてしまったそのときが丁度いいかな。“死に方”を知るなんて。それくらいがちょうどいいよ
lines.translated: "...Let's see. Right around the time you forget all about that wish would be best, I think. Learning 'how to die'... That'll be just the right time for it."

lines.content: そして“苦しみ”だなんて。もう、お腹一杯だって、その頃には、これ以上ないほど充分だって、そう思えてるはずだよ
lines.translated: "And as for 'suffering'... By then, you'll surely feel like you've had your fill of it, more than enough."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は食器を片づけながらそう言った。
lines.translated: The "Mage" said that as she cleared away the dishes.

lines.content: ――それは、いつくらいになるのかな。
lines.translated: --When will that be?

lines.content: さあね。きっと、ずっと先だ。君がおじいちゃんになるくらいずっとずっと先の話じゃないかな
lines.translated: "Who knows? Surely a long way off. Probably way, way into the future, when you've become an old man."

lines.content: ――おじいちゃんに。
lines.translated: --An old man.

lines.content: ああ。そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: そして“魔法使い”は歌うように、言う。
lines.translated: And then the "Mage" spoke as if singing.

lines.content: 食べる量もほんの少しでよくなって――
lines.translated: "When you only need to eat a tiny bit of food--"

lines.content: 一日の大半を睡眠にあてるようになり――
lines.translated: "When you start spending most of the day sleeping--"

lines.content: 細くなった身体も、ああ、中々動かしづらくなってしまって……
lines.translated: "When your thinned-out body, ah, becomes quite difficult to move..."

lines.content: ふと、自然に、柔らかな布団の中で、よく生きたな、そろそろかな、って、そう思えたとある夜のことじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Wouldn't it be on some night when, lying in a soft futon, it naturally crosses your mind: 'I've lived well, maybe it's about time'?"

lines.content: ――それは、寿命って言うんだよ。
lines.translated: --That's what you call dying of old age.

lines.content: ああ。そうだよ。……よかったな。生きて。生きて。飽きるほど、生きて。ようやく死ねたな
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. ...Good for you. You lived. You lived. You lived until you were sick of it. And you were finally able to die."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: The "Mage" smiled.

lines.content: 人間誰しもいつかは死ぬんだ。そう急ぐこともないじゃないか、と。
lines.translated: Every human dies someday. There's no need to be in such a rush, she said.

lines.content: その日がやって来るまではやりたいことだけ選んで生きよう。思い切り楽しめばいいじゃないか。思い切り、泣いたり悲しんだり、すればいい。それが君らの特権だよ
lines.translated: "Until that day comes, let's live choosing only the things we want to do. Why not enjoy it to your heart's content? Why not cry and grieve to your heart's content? That is your privilege."

lines.content: ……その笑顔はあまりにも自然なものに思えた。
lines.translated: That smile seemed far too natural.

lines.content: だからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe that was why.

lines.content: 俺もつい、つられて、笑ってしまった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help being drawn in and smiling, too.

lines.content: そんな俺に“魔法使い”はとてもうれしそうな顔をしてくれた。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, the "Mage" gave me an overjoyed look.

lines.content: 偉そうなことを言わせてもらうけど……なあ、生き急ぐ少年。しぶとく生きろよ。勇敢に、生き抜けよ。人はきっと図々しく生きるくらいでちょうどいい
lines.translated: "Forgive me for sounding preachy, but... hey, boy in a hurry to die. Live tenaciously. Survive bravely. Living a little shamelessly is surely just right for humans."

lines.content: 他人に好かれようと自分を殺してしまうより。大勢に嫌われてしまうくらいで、ちょうどいいんだ
lines.translated: "Rather than killing yourself to be liked by others, being hated by a crowd is just about right."

lines.content: ……だから、ほら。もう一度笑って見せてよ。君くらいの子はさ、もうちょっとだけでも無邪気で、生意気なくらいがかわいいぞ
lines.translated: "...So, come on. Show me a smile one more time. A kid your age is cutest when they're just a little more innocent and cheeky."

lines.content: そして俺は。
lines.translated: And as for me...

lines.content: あの頃の、ぼくは。
lines.translated: Back then, I...

lines.content: “魔法使い”が望んでくれたように、[・|目][・|論][・|見][・|通][・|り]に……、微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Just as the "Mage" hoped for, right according to her plan... I smiled.

lines.content: 朝日が来るとあさひさんは決まって俺の頭をやさしく撫でた。
lines.translated: Whenever the morning sun came, Asahi-san would without fail gently stroke my head.

lines.content: つらく悲しいことがあった日は、ほんの少しだけ早く眠ろう。そして私たちと話をしようか。……君の“心”が。ちょっとだけでも軽くなれるようにと祈ってる
lines.translated: "On days when painful and sad things happen, let's go to sleep just a little bit early. And let's have a chat together, okay? ...I'm praying that your 'heart' can become even just a little bit lighter."

lines.content: ……気づいたときにはもう遅かった。
lines.translated: By the time I realized it, it was already too late.

lines.content: 手遅れだった。
lines.translated: Way too late.

lines.content: 俺の“心”は死について考えることもあまりなくなってしまっていた。
lines.translated: My "heart" had mostly stopped thinking about death.

lines.content: ……そんなふうに導くことこそ、“夜の魔法使い”の本当の役割だとは考えもしていなかった。
lines.translated: It had never even occurred to me that guiding me like that was the true role of the "Mage of the Night."

lines.content: 俺のような子どもをひとりにさせないことこそが、彼女の本当の[目的|役割]だったのだ。
lines.translated: Keeping children like me from being alone was her true role all along.

lines.content: それからもあさひさんと十夜とは色々な時間を共に過ごした。
lines.translated: After that, I spent all kinds of time together with Asahi-san and Toya.
Together with the little god who made a steam locomotive her stronghold, we wandered across the Realm of the Night, the world of dreams and life.

lines.content: 喧嘩もしたし口汚く罵ったこともあったかもしれない……。
lines.translated: We fought, and I might have hurled foul-mouthed insults at her at times...

lines.content: だが結果としてこの俺、奏大雅は、“夜の魔法使い”こと陽向井あさひに[心|命]を救われた。
lines.translated: But as a result, I, Kanade Taiga, had my life--my heart--saved by the "Mage of the Night," Himukai Asahi.

lines.content: しかしその反面、俺は“願い”を失った。
lines.translated: Yet on the other hand, I lost my "wish."

lines.content: ……苦しんで苦しんで死んでしまいたい。
lines.translated: I want to suffer and suffer and die.

lines.content: そんな“[・|夢]”を失ってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: I had lost that "dream."

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: そのための覚悟が、緩んでしまった。
lines.translated: My resolve for it had slackened.

lines.content: 叶えるべきものは忘れず、失うことなく、[ここ|胸]にあり続けてる。
lines.translated: What I must fulfill remains right here in my chest, neither forgotten nor lost.

lines.content: だけどそのための方法がわからなくなった。
lines.translated: However, I no longer knew the method to achieve it.

lines.content: まるで迷子だ。
lines.translated: Just like a lost child.

lines.content: 俺は何を望むのか。
lines.translated: What is it that I wish for?

lines.content: 進むべき道がわからなくなった。
lines.translated: I no longer knew the path I should take.

lines.content: 少女たちは世界を救った。
lines.translated: The girls saved the world.

lines.content: 世界を揺るがす大きなおおきな物語はハッピーエンド。
lines.translated: The grand, overarching story that shook the world reached a happy ending.

lines.content: しかし、俺の小さなちいさな[物語|世界]は終わりを求め、[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き][・|は][・|ま][・|だ]、さまよい続けていた。
lines.translated: However, my own tiny, little world sought an ending, and back then, I was still wandering aimlessly.

lines.content: 道は多義に渡り広大で。
lines.translated: The paths were vast and manifold.

lines.content: 世界は相変わらず底意地悪く……。
lines.translated: The world remained as spiteful as ever...

lines.content: しかし痛烈なさみしさだけは取り除かれた。
lines.translated: Yet that piercing loneliness alone had been taken away.

lines.content: それ以来ずっと、俺はこのひとたちの側を離れられずにいる。
lines.translated: Ever since then, I haven't been able to leave these people's side.

lines.content: （……そして今の俺は、願いを聞いてもらう立場ではない）
lines.translated: (...And right now, I'm not in a position to have my wish heard.)

lines.content: 今度は俺が、この俺が、誰かの想いを聞き届け――“いえす”か、“のー”か。
lines.translated: This time, I--this very self of mine-- had to listen to someone's feelings, and say "Yes" or "No."

lines.content: その“願い”は叶えられるべきものなのか……。
lines.translated: Is that "wish" something that ought to be granted...?

lines.content: 彼女らの想いに答えを出さなければならなかった。
lines.translated: I had to give an answer to their feelings.

lines.content: ……そんな俺はあさひさんと本を読んで過ごしている。
lines.translated: And so, I'm spending my time reading books with Asahi-san.

lines.content: ハルと十夜がお風呂から出てくるのを、文字を静かに追いながら、お店のフロアで待っていた。
lines.translated: Quietly following the letters with my eyes, I waited on the shop floor for Haru and Toya to come out of the bath.

lines.content: ぺらり。ぺらり。
lines.translated: Flip. Flip.

lines.content: ページをめくる音だけがする。
lines.translated: The only sound is the turning of pages.

lines.content: その度に過去を生きた誰かの想いが――“[魔法|想像力]”が、頭の中に流れ込んでくる。
lines.translated: Each time, the feelings of someone who lived in the past--their "magic," their "imagination"--flows into my head.
A hero was certainly right here.
The day will surely come when I will have to borrow their power.

lines.content: その日のためにこうして絶えず“[魔法|想像力]”を飲み込んでいる。
lines.translated: It's for the sake of that day that I'm constantly swallowing up "magic"--"imagination"--like this.

lines.content: なあ、大雅。ちょっといいかな
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. Got a minute?"

lines.content: あさひさんが何か、思い出したようにぱたりと本を閉じた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san snapped her book shut as if she had just remembered something.

lines.content: はい。なんでしょうか
lines.translated: "Yes. What is it?"

lines.content: 俺も本を閉じた。
lines.translated: I closed my book as well.

lines.content: そしてあさひさんを見る。
lines.translated: And then I looked at Asahi-san.

lines.content: 何か、あったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had something happened?

lines.content: ああ、うん。実は大雅に見せたいものがあるんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, well. Actually, there's something I want to show you, Taiga."

lines.content: そう言うあさひさんは周りをきょろきょろと見ていた。
lines.translated: As she said that, Asahi-san was glancing around restlessly.

lines.content: ……なんだろう。
lines.translated: What could it be?

lines.content: そんなに警戒するなんて。誰かに見られたら困るものですか？
lines.translated: "Why are you being so cautious? Is it something you'd be in trouble if someone saw?"

lines.content: いや。うん……。そうだとも言えるし、そうじゃないとも言えなくもないし……
lines.translated: "No. Well... You could say it is, and you couldn't exactly say it isn't, either..."

lines.content: どうしたんですか？　珍しく煮え切らない感じですね
lines.translated: "What's wrong? It's rare for you to be this indecisive."

lines.content: まあ、うん。そう言うときもあるさ。私だって当然完璧じゃないし、そう単純でもないんだ
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. Even I have times like that. Naturally, I'm not perfect, and I'm not all that simple, either."

lines.content: 複雑なんですね
lines.translated: "So you're complicated, then."

lines.content: そして、なるほど。単純でもない。
lines.translated: And, I see. She isn't simple, either.

lines.content: いや、えっと。まあ、その……。そんなやっかいなことでもないんだけど。えっと。ただ、これを大雅とふたりで見たいなと思っただけなんだよ
lines.translated: "No, um. Well, uh... It's not anything that troublesome, really. Um. I just thought I'd like to watch this together with you, just the two of us, Taiga."

lines.content: あさひさんは胸に何か長方形の箱のようなものを抱えていた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san was hugging something like a rectangular box to her chest.

lines.content: なんだろうと良くよく見ると、それは……、
lines.translated: Wondering what it could be, I took a closer look and saw that it was...

lines.content: アニメのＤＶＤ、ですか？
lines.translated: "An anime DVD?"

lines.content: パッケージにはかわいい笑顔の女の子たちの微笑むイラストが。
lines.translated: On the package was an illustration of cute girls smiling brightly.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。アニメだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. It's an anime."

lines.content: あさひさんは笑顔だ。
lines.translated: Asahi-san was all smiles.

lines.content: パッケージの女の子にも負けないくらい。
lines.translated: Enough to rival the girls on the package.

lines.content: 新作アニメのＤＶＤだ。テレビ放送では第一話を見逃してしまってたんだよ
lines.translated: "It's the DVD for a new anime. I ended up missing the first episode when it aired on TV."

lines.content: 二話から見るのもなんだか違うなあって感じで……当時はそのまま最後まで一度も見ずに終わってしまったんだ
lines.translated: "Starting from the second episode felt kind of wrong, so... back then, it ended without me ever watching a single episode all the way to the finale."

lines.content: だからさ。こうしてＤＶＤの一巻が発売になるまで我慢して待ってたんだよ。ちゃんと一話から通して見るために。ほら。これでやっと見れる
lines.translated: "So, you see. I patiently waited like this until the first DVD volume went on sale, just so I could watch it properly from episode one. Look. Now I can finally watch it."

lines.content: 今一番の話題作だぞ――とあさひさんは、はにかむのだ。
lines.translated: "It's the hottest topic right now, you know," Asahi-san said bashfully.

lines.content: これを、俺とふたりで？
lines.translated: "You want to watch this with just the two of us?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: それは……別に良いですけど。でもどうして、ちょっと人目を気にしていたというか、こそこそしていたんですか？
lines.translated: "I mean... I don't really mind, but why were you worrying about people seeing you, or rather, acting so sneaky about it?"

lines.content: 別にアニメなら俺だけではなくて、ハルや十夜とも一緒に見ればいいかと……
lines.translated: "If it's just an anime, instead of just me, couldn't you watch it together with Haru and Toya too...?"

lines.content: このアニメはちょっとえっちだ
lines.translated: "This anime is a little naughty."

lines.content: ぽかんとする。
lines.translated: We stared at him blankly.

lines.content: 十夜にはまだまだ早いし、ハルは、そうだなあ。こういうものを受け入れられる子なのかどうかわからない
lines.translated: "It's still way too early for Toya, and as for Haru, well... I don't know if she's the kind of girl who can accept this sort of thing."

lines.content: だから、大雅。君が付き合ってくれたらなって思うんだよ
lines.translated: "So, Taiga. I was hoping you'd keep me company."

lines.content: ……なるほど。事情はなんとなくわかりました
lines.translated: "...I see. I more or less understand the situation."

lines.content: しかし俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: However, I shook my head.

lines.content: あさひさん。ねえ、あさひさん。俺、男の子なんですよ？
lines.translated: "Asahi-san. Hey, Asahi-san. I'm a boy, you know?"

lines.content: うん、知ってるよ？
lines.translated: "Yeah, I know?"

lines.content: あさひさんは首を傾げる。
lines.translated: Asahi-san tilted her head.

lines.content: 大雅はりっぱな男の子だ。言われなくてもちゃんとわかってる
lines.translated: "Taiga is a fine young man. I know that perfectly well without being told."

lines.content: なら、どうして。ちょっとえっちなアニメらしいこのＤＶＤを、俺は、あさひさんと一緒に見なけりゃならないんですか
lines.translated: "Then why? Why do I have to watch this DVD of what seems to be a slightly naughty anime together with you, Asahi-san?"

lines.content: 拷問ですか。罰ゲームですか。嫌がらせですか。……あさひさん。俺のこと実は嫌いなんですか
lines.translated: "Is this torture? A punishment game? Harassment? ...Asahi-san, do you actually hate me?"

lines.content: そんなわけない。大好きだよ
lines.translated: "Of course not. I love you."

lines.content: きっぱりと言われる。
lines.translated: She declared it flatly.

lines.content: 少しどきりとしてしまう。
lines.translated: It made my heart skip a little beat.

lines.content: う……だ、だったらどうして。余計に、どうして……
lines.translated: "Ugh... T-Then why? That just makes me wonder even more, why..."

lines.content: 恥ずかしいですよわかってくださいよと俺は言う。
lines.translated: "It's embarrassing, please understand," I told her.

lines.content: だって……、それはさ
lines.translated: "Because... well, you see."

lines.content: あさひさんは唇を尖らせた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san pouted her lips.

lines.content: ……これ、楽しみにしていたアニメなんだよ。ひとりで観るのもいいけれど、今の気分はそれだとちょっとさみしいっていうか
lines.translated: "...This is an anime I was really looking forward to. Watching it alone is fine and all, but with the mood I'm in right now, that feels a little lonely, I guess."

lines.content: もにょもにょとしながらあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san mumbled hesitantly.

lines.content: ……ほら。名作の予感がするものは一緒にここはこうだ、あそこはどうだって話しながら観たい。そんな気分になることってないかな？　今の私はちょうどそんな心境なんだよ
lines.translated: "...Come on. When you have a feeling something's going to be a masterpiece, you want to watch it together while talking about how this part is like this, and that part is like that. Don't you ever get in that kind of mood? That's the exact state of mind I'm in right now."

lines.content: あさひさんの好きな小説の話ならいくらでも付き合いますよ
lines.translated: "If it's talking about the novels you like, Asahi-san, I'll keep you company as much as you want."

lines.content: 知ってるだろう大雅。私は決して読書家というわけではないんだよ。どうしようもなく好きな作家がひとりいるにすぎなくて……
lines.translated: "You know how it is, Taiga. I'm by no means a bookworm. There's just one author I happen to like hopelessly much..."

lines.content: どちらかといえばアニメや映画で“想像力”を養うのが性分に合っている。受動的なインプットが好物なんだよ
lines.translated: "If anything, cultivating my 'imagination' through anime and movies suits my nature better. Passive input is my favorite."

lines.content: だからと言って、どうして俺が一緒にアニメを。しかも、えっちなのを。
lines.translated: Even so, why do I have to watch anime together with her? And a naughty one, at that.

lines.content: 俺にしてみれば、どうしたってそれは、母親とふたりで[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う]ものを観ようと迫られている感覚になってしまうわけで……。
lines.translated: From my perspective, no matter how you slice it, it ends up feeling like I'm being pressured into watching *that* kind of thing alone with my own mother...

lines.content: ……ねえ、あさひさん
lines.translated: "...Hey, Asahi-san."

lines.content: ――俺は、ふるふると首を振る。
lines.translated: --I gave my head a little shake.

lines.content: アニメの話もいいですけど……。もっともっと話さなきゃならないことがある気がします
lines.translated: "Talking about anime is fine and all, but... I feel like there are much more important things we need to talk about."

lines.content: というと？
lines.translated: "Meaning?"

lines.content: “魔法使い”としてです。あさひさんは他に気にしなきゃならないこととかあるんじゃないでしょうか
lines.translated: "As a 'Mage.' Don't you have other things you should be worrying about, Asahi-san?"

lines.content: ……他に気にしなきゃならないこと。しかも“魔法使い”として――それは、なんだろう
lines.translated: "...Other things I should be worrying about. And as a 'Mage' at that--what could that be?"

lines.content: とぼけたふうではない。真剣にわからないという顔だった。
lines.translated: She didn't seem to be playing dumb. Her face showed she genuinely had no idea.

lines.content: ……俺に譲ってくれた“魔法使い”としての“役割”ですよ
lines.translated: "...The 'role' as a 'Mage' that you passed on to me."

lines.content: ああ、なんだ。そのことか
lines.translated: "Oh, what. That?"

lines.content: 言って――あさひさんはバッと片手で顔を隠した。
lines.translated: Saying that--Asahi-san dramatically covered her face with one hand.

lines.content: 片目を押さえるような、中二病の代名詞のようなポーズ。
lines.translated: A pose holding down one eye, the very epitome of chuunibyou.

lines.content: ぼくの王の力が
lines.translated: "My King's power..."

lines.content: ぼくの闇の炎が
lines.translated: "My dark flames..."

lines.content: つい反射的に付き合ってしまう。
lines.translated: I reflexively played along without thinking.

lines.content: するとあさひさんは満足そうに微笑んだ。
lines.translated: At that, Asahi-san smiled with satisfaction.

lines.content: い、今はハルの“[夢|願い]”について、俺はどう判断していいか悩んでいる最中です。よかったら助言をください
lines.translated: "R-Right now, I'm in the middle of agonizing over how I should judge Haru's 'wish'--her 'dream.' If you don't mind, please give me some advice."

lines.content: ……その進行状況というか。気にならないんですか
lines.translated: "...Aren't you curious about how that's progressing, or anything?"

lines.content: うん。全然
lines.translated: "Nope. Not at all."

lines.content: あっけらかんとそう言った。
lines.translated: She said it nonchalantly.

lines.content: 全然まったく気にならないよ
lines.translated: "I'm not worried about it in the slightest."

lines.content: 全然、まったく、って……
lines.translated: "Not in the slightest...?"

lines.content: 私は君のことを信頼しているから
lines.translated: "Because I trust you."

lines.content: 何のてらいもなく――いきなり真っ直ぐな言葉を返された。
lines.translated: Without a hint of pretension--she suddenly came back at me with completely straightforward words.

lines.content: 私は、君になすりつけた仕事に関しては、手出しも口出しもしないって決めてるんだ
lines.translated: "When it comes to the job I pushed onto you, I've decided not to interfere or butt in at all."

lines.content: 信頼。
lines.translated: Trust.

lines.content: そう言われてしまうとこちらも何も口出しできなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: When she puts it like that, I can't say anything back, either.

lines.content: それとも何か問題があったのかな？　でも素直になれずそんな態度とか？　本当は今すぐ私に、このお姉さんの胸元に、甘えたように泣きついてしまいたい？
lines.translated: "Or did you run into some kind of problem? And you're acting like that because you can't be honest with yourself? Do you actually want to cling to my chest right now and cry like a spoiled child?"

lines.content: いえ。そんなことは決して
lines.translated: "No. Nothing of the sort."

lines.content: きっぱりと俺は首を振った。
lines.translated: I flatly shook my head.

lines.content: なんだよ。つまんないな。私は今すぐ君のことを抱きしめたいのに
lines.translated: "What? How boring. And here I want to hug you right this second."

lines.content: あさひさんは頬を膨らませていたけれど、
lines.translated: Asahi-san puffed out her cheeks, but then...

lines.content: それなら……ただただ無責任に、この言葉を君に贈ろう――
lines.translated: "In that case... completely irresponsibly, I'll offer you these words--"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ――がんばれよ、男の子。“魔法少女『使い』”の男の子。君ならできるって信じてる
lines.translated: "--Do your best, boy. The 'Magical Girl "User"' boy. I believe you can do it."

lines.content: あさひさんは微笑みながら言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said with a smile.

lines.content: だけどどうしても、どうしても無理だと感じたときには言いなさい
lines.translated: "However, when you feel like it's truly, absolutely impossible, tell me."

lines.content: 男の子が泣いて縋ってくるのを“大丈夫だよ平気だよ私がついてるよ”と言って慰めてやるのが大好きなんだ。私はさ
lines.translated: "When a boy comes crying and clinging to me, I just love comforting him and saying, 'It's okay, everything's fine, I'm right here with you.' That's just how I am."

lines.content: 甘やかして甘やかして、心も身体も栄養満点にぷっくりと太らせてやる。それが私の趣味だからだ。そんな趣味を持っているから、こんなお店を構えているんだ
lines.translated: "I'll spoil you rotten and fatten up both your heart and body until they're plump and full of nutrition. Because that's my hobby. And it's because I have a hobby like that that I'm running a shop like this."

lines.content: 心に、そしてその人生に、一筋縄ではいかない問題を抱えた少年少女たち。
lines.translated: Boys and girls who carry complicated problems in their hearts, and in their lives.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]は彼ら彼女らを迎え入れ、心も身体も“魔法使い”がやさしく包むための場所――かつての[・|ぼ][・|く]が、そうされたように。
lines.translated: *Here* is a place to welcome them in, for the "Mage" to gently wrap up both their hearts and bodies--just as was done for *me* in the past.

lines.content: 幼い頃に食べたあさひさんのご飯。その暖かな味を思い出す。
lines.translated: The meals Asahi-san made that I ate when I was little. I remember their warm taste.

lines.content: 今も変わらず美味しいそれは……。
lines.translated: Even now, it's just as delicious as ever...

lines.content: 確かに。
lines.translated: That's true.

lines.content: 捻くれてばかりいたあの頃の俺の心を、充分に、甘やかしてくれたように思う。
lines.translated: Looking back, I think it did more than enough to spoil my twisted little heart back then.

lines.content: 君はまだまだ子どもだ。失敗したとしても大人の私がいくらでもフォローしてやれる。だから今は自分で考え、自分で悩み……安心して、失敗してきなさい
lines.translated: "You're still just a kid. Even if you mess up, I'm an adult, so I can cover for you as much as you need. Right now, just think for yourself, agonize for yourself... and rest easy knowing it's okay to fail."

lines.content: 今の私が、今の君に言えるのは、まあせいぜいそれくらいだよ
lines.translated: "Right now, that's really the most I can say to you."

lines.content: ……“魔法少女『使い』”奏大雅。君がどんな答えを出し。君が、どんなふうに彼女らを導いていくのか。私はそれが楽しみでならない。そんな気持ちも私の中に確かにあるから
lines.translated: "...'Magical Girl "User"' Kanade Taiga. What kind of answer you'll find, and how you'll guide those girls... I can't wait to see it. Because that feeling is definitely inside me, too."

lines.content: だから
……はい
だから、大雅。今は一緒にこのアニメを観よう
lines.translated: "So, Taiga. Let's watch this anime together for now."

lines.content: ＤＶＤのパッケージをぐいっと俺に押しつける。
lines.translated: She firmly shoved the DVD case against me.

lines.content: そしてちょっとえっちな雰囲気になって、ふたりで一緒に気まずくなろう。そんな流れもきっと楽しいはずだから
lines.translated: "And then the mood will get a little risqué, and the two of us can get all awkward together. I'm sure things playing out like that will be plenty of fun, too."

lines.content: いやです
lines.translated: "No thank you."

lines.content: ええ、どうして……？
lines.translated: "Whaaat, why...?"

lines.content: どうしてって。
lines.translated: What do you mean, "why"?

lines.content: あさひさん……ちょっと、ほんのちょっとだけ感動というか、そんな気持ちになりかけていた俺の心を返してほしい。だからいやです。絶対、観ない
lines.translated: "Asahi-san... I was just starting to feel a tiny, teeny-tiny bit moved here, and I'd like those feelings back, please. So no. I'm definitely not watching it."

lines.content: 大丈夫。平気だ。きっと萌えがその傷心をいやしてくれる。間違いない
lines.translated: "It's okay. You'll be fine. I'm sure the moe will heal that broken heart of yours. No doubt about it."

lines.content: 知ってるか大雅、萌えはどんな強力な薬より心に効くんだ。
lines.translated: "Did you know, Taiga? Moe is better for the heart than the strongest medicine."

lines.content: 真剣な顔でそんなことを言い、ＤＶＤを押しつけてくるあさひさん。それを押し返す俺。
lines.translated: Saying that with a deadpan face, Asahi-san pushed the DVD toward me. I pushed it right back.

lines.content: 一話だけでいいから一緒に観よう
lines.translated: "Just one episode is fine, so let's watch it together."

lines.content: いやです
lines.translated: "No thank you."

lines.content: 今が嫌なら今夜こっそりふたりっきりで
lines.translated: "If you don't want to do it now, we can watch it in secret tonight, just the two of us."

lines.content: いやですってば
lines.translated: "I told you, no."

lines.content: いいじゃないか
lines.translated: "Oh, come on, what's the harm?"

lines.content: どうしてそんなに拘るんですか
lines.translated: "Why are you so fixated on this?"

lines.content: 大雅をこのアニメで姉萌えにする作戦なんだ
lines.translated: "It's my grand strategy to give you an older-sister fetish using this anime."

lines.content: そんなこと言われてじゃあ観ますかなんて言えるはずがない……などと。
lines.translated: How could I possibly say "Alright, let's watch it then" after being told something like that...?

lines.content: ふたりでＤＶＤを押しつけあっていると、
lines.translated: As the two of us were shoving the DVD back and forth at each other...

lines.content: がらり。
lines.translated: *Clatter.*

lines.content: お店の扉が開かれる音がした。
lines.translated: The sound of the shop's door sliding open rang out.

lines.content: 奥間の扉ではない。玄関の扉だ。
lines.translated: Not the door to the back room. The front entrance.

lines.content: ここは元々簡単な料理を出してくれるお食事処であり、民宿のようなこともしているお店だ。
lines.translated: This place is originally an eatery that serves simple dishes, and it also operates somewhat like a bed-and-breakfast.

lines.content: 食事にやって来るのは主に猫たち。
lines.translated: The ones who come here to eat are mainly cats.

lines.content: お客だろうか。
lines.translated: Could it be a customer?

lines.content: あさひさんと俺は揃って振り向いた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san and I both turned around at the same time.

lines.content: ちょいと報告したいことがある
lines.translated: "I've got a little something to report."

lines.content: するとそこに立っていたのは予想通り猫だった。二足歩行でオシャレな洋服を着込んだまだら猫。
lines.translated: Standing there, just as expected, was a cat. A mottled cat walking on two legs and dressed in stylish clothes.

lines.content: “魔法使い”とその弟子よ。大変だ
lines.translated: "Hear ye, 'Mage' and her apprentice. We've got trouble."

lines.content: 人の言葉を操る猫はちっとも大変そうではなく、むしろ何か面白可笑しいことでも見てきたかのような態度で、言った。
lines.translated: The cat capable of human speech didn't look troubled in the slightest; rather, he spoke with the attitude of someone who had just witnessed something hilarious.

lines.content: どうやら“迷子”が出たみたいだぞ。君らの出番だ
lines.translated: "Looks like a 'Lost Child' has shown up. You two are up."
A "Lost Child."

lines.content: そして、君らの出番。
lines.translated: And, "You two are up."

lines.content: やって来た二足歩行の猫はそう言った。
lines.translated: That's what the bipedal cat who had just arrived said.

lines.content: 君らとはもちろん、あさひさんと俺のことだ。
lines.translated: By "you two," he naturally meant Asahi-san and me.

lines.content: どうなってるんだ、“魔法使い”
lines.translated: "What's going on here, 'Mage'?"

lines.content: やって来た猫はあまりに人間っぽい仕草で肩を竦めて見せた。
lines.translated: The cat gave a shrug in an all-too-human gesture.

lines.content: 町は噂でもちきりだ。“魔法使い”のところの下っ端が“迷子”を逃がしちまったってね。ほら、そこの子どもだよ
lines.translated: "The town is buzzing with rumors. Word is the underling at the 'Mage's' place let a 'Lost Child' get away. Look, that kid right there."

lines.content: 鋭い爪で俺を指す。
lines.translated: He pointed a sharp claw at me.

lines.content: お前が飼ってるその人間の雄だ。昨晩そいつが“迷子”を逃がしてしまったところを見ていた奴がいるんだよ
lines.translated: "That human male you're keeping as a pet. Someone saw him let a 'Lost Child' slip away last night."

lines.content: “迷子”がそこらで暴れては移動を繰り返してる。町の猫どもが“迷子”の行方を総出で捜索中だ
lines.translated: "The 'Lost Child' has been rampaging all over the place and moving from spot to spot. All the cats in town are out in full force searching for its whereabouts."

lines.content: まったく。その子どものせいで余計な手間が増えてしまったじゃないかとも言われてる
lines.translated: "Good grief. People are saying we've got all this extra work on our paws now because of that kid."

lines.content: ……そうか。申し訳なかった。そうなってしまうのは想定よりもずっと早かったな
lines.translated: "...I see. I'm sorry about that. Things escalated much faster than I anticipated."

lines.content: あさひさんはため息をつく。
lines.translated: Asahi-san let out a sigh.

lines.content: 昨晩のことは大雅から報告は受けてる。お夕飯を食べてから昨晩逃がしてしまったらしい“迷子”の探索に出てもらおうと思っていたんだが……
lines.translated: "I already received a report from Taiga about last night. I was planning to have him go out and search for the 'Lost Child' he apparently let get away after we finished dinner, but..."

lines.content: 暢気なことをしていて申し訳なかった。完全に私の読み間違いだ、とあさひさんはそう言った。
lines.translated: "I apologize for taking things so easy. It was a complete misjudgment on my part," Asahi-san said.

lines.content: 昨晩、俺が取り逃がしてしまった少女の形をした“迷子”……。
lines.translated: The girl-shaped "Lost Child" that I had let slip through my fingers last night...

lines.content: それはこの町に暮らす[・|誰][・|か]の心だ。
lines.translated: That is the heart of *someone* living in this town.

lines.content: つらい、悲しい、そしてさみしい。自分ひとりではもう抱えきれない。そんな気持ちの持ち主が眠りにつくと……。
lines.translated: Painful, sad, and lonely. Too much to bear all on one's own anymore. When the person harboring those feelings falls asleep...

lines.content: その気持ちが、心が、感情が、ここで……。
lines.translated: Those feelings, that heart, those emotions manifest here...

lines.content: そして“夜”を暴れ回っては、次第次第に、自身の心までをも摩耗させていく。
lines.translated: And as it rampages through the "Night," it gradually wears down even their own heart.

lines.content: この場所でそんな“迷子”を消し去るということは、この町で暮らす“迷子”の持ち主である“誰か”の心を、ほんの少し、軽くするということだ。
lines.translated: Erasing such a "Lost Child" in this place means making the heart of that "someone"--the owner of the "Lost Child" living in this town--just a little bit lighter.

lines.content: 昨晩。俺は十夜と迷える誰かの“迷子”と出会った。本来ならあそこで捕獲し、浄化するため“ゆめのねどこ”へと連れ帰るはずだった。
lines.translated: Last night, Toya and I encountered someone's stray "Lost Child." Normally, we were supposed to capture it right then and there and bring it back to the "Bed of Dreams" to be purified.

lines.content: “迷子”が“夜”を徘徊するとつらい気持ちが大きく膨らむ。際限もなく。
lines.translated: When a "Lost Child" wanders through the "Night," its painful feelings swell up. Endlessly.

lines.content: すると迷う心はいつしか“悪夢”に変わってしまう。そうなればもう手遅れだ。
lines.translated: And before long, that straying heart turns into a "Nightmare." Once that happens, it's already too late.

lines.content: その“[悪夢|迷子]”の持ち主は、そう遠くない未来、自身の命を手放すことになるだろう。抱え込んだつらい気持ちに耐えきれず。
lines.translated: In the not-so-distant future, the owner of that "Nightmare"--that "Lost Child"--will likely let go of their own life, unable to endure the painful feelings they've bottled up inside.

lines.content: だというのに俺は“迷子”を取り逃してしまった。
lines.translated: And yet, I let the "Lost Child" get away.

lines.content: もちろんそのことはあさひさんに報告をした。
lines.translated: Of course, I reported what happened to Asahi-san.

lines.content: 怒られると思った。こんなふうに後あとから問題になるだろうこと思ったから。
lines.translated: I thought she would be angry with me. Because I knew it would turn into a problem later on, just like this.

lines.content: しかし叱られたのは俺が少し無茶をして、深追いしたことについてだけだった。
lines.translated: However, the only thing she scolded me for was pushing myself a bit too hard and chasing it too far.

lines.content: もちろん、今もこの町のどこかで苦しんでるのだろう“迷子”の持ち主のことを考えると、何を暢気なこと言ってるんだよと呆れられることもあるだろうし、それが正論だとも思う
lines.translated: "Of course, when you think about the owner of the 'Lost Child' who must be suffering somewhere in this town right now, people might be exasperated with me for acting so carefree, and I think they'd have every right to be."

lines.content: だけど、人間は神ではないんだ。だから間違いもときには犯す。失敗だってする。むろん、私たちだってそうだ。そこを責める気はないよ
lines.translated: "However, humans aren't gods. We make mistakes sometimes. We fail, too. Naturally, the same goes for us. I have no intention of blaming him for that."

lines.content: そう言って俺の不手際だったりを簡単に許してしまうあさひさん。
lines.translated: Saying that, Asahi-san easily forgave my blunder.

lines.content: それに、まだ“迷子”が“悪夢”に変わることはないだろうから、そう慌てなくてもいいよと私は大雅に言ったんだよ。こんなふうに町を暴れるだろう段階にもまだないだろうってね
lines.translated: "Besides, I told Taiga he didn't need to panic so much because the 'Lost Child' probably wouldn't turn into a 'Nightmare' just yet. I figured it wouldn't be at the stage where it would go rampaging through town like this, either."

lines.content: すべては私の判断ミスだよ。だから責められるのは大雅じゃなくて私のほうだ
lines.translated: "It's entirely my error in judgment. So if anyone is to blame, it's me, not Taiga."

lines.content: そんなあさひさんの言葉に、やって来た猫はやれやれと首を振る。
lines.translated: At Asahi-san's words, the cat shook his head as if to say, "Good grief."

lines.content: 相変わらず甘いな。激甘だ
lines.translated: "Soft as always, aren't you? Way too soft."

lines.content: ため息交じりに猫は俺を見た。
lines.translated: With a sigh mixed into his voice, the cat looked at me.

lines.content: 悪いことをしたのだからそれをちゃんと解らせなきゃならない。こっぴどく折檻してやればいい。子どもの扱いなんて、泣いて喚いてごめんなさいと謝り出すくらいがちょうどいい
lines.translated: "He messed up, so you've got to make sure he understands that properly. You should give him a harsh punishment. When it comes to handling kids, making them cry and bawl and beg for forgiveness is just about right."

lines.content: ふん。相変わらず乱暴だな。わざとやったことではないのなら怒る気はさらさらないんだ。私と、君とでは、ちょっとだけ教育方針が違うんだよ
lines.translated: "Hmph. Rough as always, I see. As long as he didn't do it on purpose, I have zero intention of getting mad. You and I just have slightly different educational policies, that's all."

lines.content: あさひさんは俺をぐいっと抱き寄せた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san pulled me into a tight hug.

lines.content: 胸元に頭を抱えるような形で。
lines.translated: Cradling my head right against her chest.

lines.content: あんまり家の子を苛めないでやってくれないかな。そんな調子なら、君の店には今後一切、“悪夢”を取り引きしてやらないぞ
lines.translated: "Could you please not bully my kid too much? If you keep that up, I won't trade a single 'Nightmare' with your shop ever again."

lines.content: ……“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Land of Night."

lines.content: ここは、この町の人々が夜に夢見るための場所であり。
lines.translated: This is a place for the people of this town to dream at night.

lines.content: そして、化け猫たちが営む大きな大きな遊園地、あるいは劇場――[・|と][・|い][・|う][・|側][・|面][・|も][・|あ][・|る]。
lines.translated: And at the same time, *it also has another side to it*--as a massive, sprawling amusement park, or perhaps a theater, run by bakeneko.

lines.content: 開園時間は夜の間のみと決まっていた。
lines.translated: Its opening hours were strictly limited to the nighttime.

lines.content: そして眠りに落ちた人間たちの“[意識|心]”を、猫たちは客としてもてなす。
lines.translated: And the cats entertain the "minds"--the "hearts"--of the humans who have fallen asleep as their guests.

lines.content: 無駄に苦労ばかりが多い現実世界を生きる人間たちに、面白おかしい[・|夢]を売る。
lines.translated: To the humans living in a real world filled with so much pointless hardship, they sell *dreams* full of fun and amusement.

lines.content: 昨晩、俺と十夜は“夜の国”開演前の短い時間の中で“悪夢”のかけらを回収して回った。
lines.translated: Last night, Toya and I went around collecting fragments of "Nightmares" during the short window before the "Land of Night" opened for business.

lines.content: 眠りに落ちた人間たちが落としていった、あるいは“夜の中”に捨てていった“悪夢”のかけらをだ。
lines.translated: Fragments of "Nightmares" that sleeping humans had dropped, or perhaps thrown away, "into the Night."

lines.content: まるで、ショーが始まる前の静かな劇場で、客席や舞台に、前日の騒ぎから散らかったままのゴミを拾い、きれいに掃除するみたいに。
lines.translated: Just like picking up trash left scattered across the seats and stage from the previous day's excitement and cleaning up a quiet theater before the show begins.

lines.content: そうして集めた“悪夢”のかけらを材料にして、猫たちは人間たちが夜に見る夢を編むのだ。甘い夢を見るためのあめ玉だったり。大冒険する夢を見るための剣だったり。
lines.translated: Using the "Nightmare" fragments gathered that way as raw materials, the cats weave the dreams that humans see at night. Like hard candies for having sweet dreams. Or swords for dreaming of grand adventures.

lines.content: 販売する[商品|夢]の対価として猫たちが受け取るもの。
lines.translated: And what the cats receive as payment for the "dreams"--the merchandise--they sell...

lines.content: それは、現実世界でため込んだ“不安”だったり“心配”だったり、漠然としすぎた“恐怖”だったり。
lines.translated: Are the "anxieties," "worries," and all-too-vague "fears" saved up in the real world.

lines.content: それは死にたくなるくらいつらければつらいだけ、いい。
lines.translated: The more agonizing those feelings are--to the point of making someone want to die--the better.

lines.content: 一部の猫たちは人間の心に重くぶら下がる後ろ向きなそれらの感情が大好物なのだ。
lines.translated: For some of the cats, those negative emotions hanging heavily from human hearts are their absolute favorite treat.

lines.content: 金貨の代わりにほんの少しだけその“心”を受け取って、それを猫たちは甘く美味しいお菓子に変えてお腹一杯食べるのだった。
lines.translated: Receiving just a tiny bit of that "heart" in place of gold coins, the cats turn it into sweet, delicious snacks and eat until their bellies are full.

lines.content: まあ、何はともあれ“迷子”の話だ
lines.translated: "Well, whatever the case, I'm here about the 'Lost Child.'"

lines.content: やれやれとばかりに化け猫は言った。
lines.translated: The bakeneko spoke with a "good grief" tone.

lines.content: [じぶんち|自分家]の子をどんなふうに甘やかそうと、それはそちらの勝手だからね。好きにすればいい。こちらに迷惑が掛からない限りの範囲でね
lines.translated: "How you choose to spoil the kid of your own house is your business. Do whatever you like. As long as it doesn't cause trouble for us, that is."

lines.content: ああそうだとも。家は家。よそはよそさ。こちらはチョコレートの食べ過ぎで鼻血が出るくらい甘くしつけるのが方針なのさ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Our house is our house, and yours is yours. My policy here is to spoil him so sweet he'll get a nosebleed from eating too much chocolate."

lines.content: 抱きしめられたまま頭を撫でられる。
lines.translated: Still holding me tight, she stroked my head.

lines.content: ……あの、もう、勘弁してください。さすがにちょっと恥ずかしいです
lines.translated: "...Um, please let me go already. This is honestly a little embarrassing."

lines.content: 恥ずかしい――だけでなく、呼吸も少し苦しい。
lines.translated: Not only is it embarrassing--it's also a little hard to breathe.

lines.content: 無理矢理離れた。
lines.translated: I pried myself away from her.

lines.content: ……“魔法使い”。そんなことはどうでもいいんだ。とにかく“迷子”なんだよ
lines.translated: "...'Magician.' None of that matters. The issue here is the 'Lost Child.'"

lines.content: 早々に何とかしてもらわないと、他の客たちが怯えてしまって、あげく、自分の家に引きこもったまま出てこなくなってしまう。誰も夢を見なくなってまうんだ
lines.translated: "If you don't do something about it soon, the other customers will get spooked, and before you know it, they'll shut themselves up in their houses and refuse to come out. No one will dream anymore."

lines.content: ここは現実世界と同じように怖い場所であってはならない。そう言って猫は続ける。
lines.translated: This place must not be as frightening as the real world. Saying that, the cat continued.

lines.content: 買い手がなければどんなに上等な洋服を仕立てたところで、そこにどんなにすばらしい夢見を織り込んだところで、全部が全部、無駄になってしまうんだ
lines.translated: "Without buyers, no matter how fine the clothes I tailor, or how wonderful the dreams I weave into them, every last bit of it goes to waste."

lines.content: この猫は“夜の国”で洋服の仕立屋を営んでいる。
lines.translated: This cat runs a tailor shop in the "Land of Night."

lines.content: 俺たちが回収した“悪夢”のかけらを、この猫はきれいな洋服に作り替えていた。
lines.translated: He takes the fragments of "Nightmares" we collect and remakes them into pretty clothes.

lines.content: 彼の仕立てる洋服はとりわけ人気が高い。
lines.translated: The clothes he tailors are especially popular.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を着ればどんな理想的な自分にだってなれる――そういう夢を、見させてくれる。
lines.translated: *Put them on*, and you can become whatever ideal version of yourself you want--that is the kind of dream they let you have.

lines.content: “迷子”はせっかく仕立てた商品を片っ端から食い散らかしたり盗んでいったりもする
lines.translated: "The 'Lost Child' is devouring and stealing the merchandise I worked so hard to tailor, one piece after another."

lines.content: おまけに“夜”の町を残らず破壊しかねない。だからさっさと処分して貰わんとかなわないんだ
lines.translated: "On top of that, it might very well destroy every last bit of the town of 'Night.' So I need you to dispose of it quickly, or I won't be able to stand it."

lines.content: そちらはそちらの仕事をちゃんとこなしてほしい。ただそう願いに来ただけだよ。……“魔法使い”。それぞれに定めた“役割”をこなそう。ただそう言いたいだけなんだよ。こちらはね
lines.translated: "I want you to do your job properly on your end. I only came here to ask that of you. ...'Magician.' Let's each fulfill our designated 'roles.' That's all I want to say, from my side of things."

lines.content: ……そうだな。“迷子”を迎えに行かなきゃならないな。一刻も早くだ
lines.translated: "...Right. We have to go pick up the 'Lost Child.' As soon as possible."

lines.content: あさひさんはうなずき、そして俺を見た。
lines.translated: Asahi-san nodded, and then looked at me.

lines.content: わかりました。行ってきます。“迷子”を探し、ここへ迎えられるように。……今度こそ、期待に応えられるように
lines.translated: "Understood. I'll get going. I'll find the 'Lost Child' and bring them back here. ...So I can live up to your expectations this time."

lines.content: ああ、うん。がんばれよ大雅
lines.translated: "Yeah, right. Do your best, Taiga."

lines.content: だけどまあ、そんなふうに肩肘張らなくてもいいさ。君も、“迷子”も。無事であってくれればそれでいい
lines.translated: "Still, you don't need to be so tense about it. As long as both you and the 'Lost Child' come back safe, that's enough for me."

lines.content: ちょっと乱暴ごとになってしまうのは避けられないかもしれませんが。その点は……
lines.translated: "It might be unavoidable that things get a little rough, though. So on that point..."

lines.content: 仕方がない、とはあまり言いたくないな。うーん。どうしようか
lines.translated: "I don't really want to say 'it can't be helped.' Hmm. What should we do?"

lines.content: 腕を組み[まぶた|瞼]を閉じたあさひさんが、ふらふらと首を振らした。
lines.translated: Crossing her arms and closing her eyelids, Asahi-san swayed her head back and forth.

lines.content: そこで……。
lines.translated: Just then...

lines.content: お待たせしました。お風呂、いただきました
lines.translated: "Sorry to keep you waiting. We're all done with our bath."

lines.content: ハルと十夜が手を繋ぎ、戻ってきた。
lines.translated: Haru and Toya came back, holding hands.

lines.content: なんだ。また人間の子を増やしたのか！
lines.translated: "What's this? You took in another human kid?!"

lines.content: 化け猫は呆れたふうにそう言って、
lines.translated: The bakeneko said in an exasperated tone.

lines.content: ハルが、そんな[猫|仕立屋]のことを驚いた顔でまじまじと見ていた。
lines.translated: Haru stared intently at the tailor cat with a surprised look on her face.

lines.content: ……しゃべる猫は[夜の国|ここ]では珍しくない。
lines.translated: Talking cats aren't rare here in the Land of Night.

lines.content: いや。昔は猫だけではなく、様々な種類のイキモノが“夜”を占拠していたけれど……。
lines.translated: No. Long ago, it wasn't just cats--all sorts of different creatures occupied the "Night," though...

lines.content: なんだかすごくおしゃれな猫さんだね。とってもかわいい
lines.translated: "He's such a stylish cat, isn't he? So cute."

lines.content: ハルは俺にそう耳打ちをした。
lines.translated: Haru whispered that into my ear.

lines.content: どうやらしゃべる猫に驚いているのではなく、その姿そのものに感心しているようだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, she wasn't surprised that the cat could talk, but was simply admiring his appearance itself.

lines.content: じゃあ、十夜。急いでお夕飯の準備すませちゃおうか
lines.translated: "All right, Toya. Let's hurry and finish getting dinner ready, okay?"

lines.content: うん。コロッケきれいに丸められるように、私もいっぱいがんばるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'll try really hard so I can roll the croquettes into nice, neat shapes."

lines.content: ふたりの様子にあさひさんは『うん。そうだな』と独り言を口にし、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Watching the two of them, Asahi-san murmured, "Yeah. That's it," to herself and nodded.

lines.content: そして小さな妹を呼び止める。
lines.translated: Then, she called out to stop my little sister.

lines.content: ……十夜
lines.translated: "...Toya."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ひとつお願いがあるんだけど、いいかな？
lines.translated: "I have a favor to ask. Do you mind?"

lines.content: 物干し竿などが設置してあるベランダから、手すりを踏み台にして屋根へとよじ登る。
lines.translated: From the veranda where the laundry poles were set up, I used the railing as a foothold to scramble up onto the roof.

lines.content: 足下、少し滑るから気をつけて
lines.translated: "It's a little slippery underfoot, so be careful."

lines.content: ついてきたハルの手をしっかりと握る。
lines.translated: I firmly grasped Haru's hand as she followed behind me.

lines.content: 屋根のてっぺんまでやって来た。
lines.translated: We made it all the way to the top of the roof.

lines.content: ……そこから今夜の“夜”を広く見渡す。
lines.translated: From there, we looked out over the wide expanse of tonight's "Night."

lines.content: 夜景がきらきら光る星空のよう。
lines.translated: The night view looked like a sparkling, starry sky.
*Off in the distance, a giant stuffed bear was walking around.*

lines.content: どしん
lines.translated: Thoom.

lines.content: どしん
lines.translated: Thoom.

lines.content: ぬいぐるみが踏みしめたものはすべて甘そうなお菓子に変わった。
lines.translated: Everything the stuffed bear stepped on turned into sweet-looking candy.

lines.content: 今夜の[プログラム|夢]は騒々しい。甘い匂いがここまでかすかに届いてきている。わーきゃーと聞こえる声は悲鳴ではなく歓声だろうか。
lines.translated: Tonight's dream program is a noisy one. A faint, sweet scent is drifting all the way over here. The shrieks and squeals I hear probably aren't screams of terror, but cheers of delight.

lines.content: “夜の国”は夢の舞台だ。
lines.translated: The "Land of Night" is a stage for dreams.

lines.content: [・|生][・|者]にとっては“夢”を見るための劇場なのだ。
lines.translated: For *the living*, it is a theater for seeing "dreams."

lines.content: 毎夜猫たちが大きな“夢”の演目を用意している。
lines.translated: Every night, the cats prepare a grand "dream" attraction.

lines.content: 個別で“商品”を購入し、寝床に戻り、夢見るだけでなく……。
lines.translated: People don't just buy individual "merchandise" to take back to their beds and dream...

lines.content: 少し高めの料金設定の金色のチケットを買うことでショーに参加することができる。
lines.translated: By purchasing a slightly pricier golden ticket, they can participate in a show.

lines.content: 町の人々が一斉に共有できる“夢”である。
lines.translated: It's a "dream" that the people of the town can all share at once.

lines.content: ここから町を見渡し“迷子”を探す。
lines.translated: From up here, I look out over the town to search for the "Lost Child."

lines.content: 捜索には特に不思議な[・|魔][・|法]を使うわけでもない。
lines.translated: I don't use any mysterious *magic* for the search.

lines.content: 高い場所から双眼鏡をのぞき込む。それだけ。
lines.translated: I just peer through a pair of binoculars from a high place. That's all.

lines.content: 今夜は町が騒がしい。
lines.translated: The town is noisy tonight.

lines.content: だがそれは巨大なぬいぐるみが歩いてるせいだけではなかった。
lines.translated: However, that wasn't just because a giant stuffed bear was walking around.

lines.content: 猫たちが慌てて店じまいを始めている。
lines.translated: The cats are hurriedly starting to close up their shops.

lines.content: 原因を探る。町を見渡す。
lines.translated: I search for the cause. I scan the town.

lines.content: この中にきっと“迷子”がいるはずだ。
lines.translated: The "Lost Child" has to be in there somewhere.

lines.content: はぁ
lines.translated: "Haah..."

lines.content: ため息が聞こえた。
lines.translated: I heard a sigh.

lines.content: 俺は双眼鏡をのぞき込んだまま、隣に立つハルの横顔を見た。
lines.translated: Still peering through the binoculars, I shifted my gaze to Haru's profile as she stood next to me.

lines.content: ピントを合わせる。
lines.translated: I adjusted the focus.

lines.content: むっつりしていた。
lines.translated: She was sulking.

lines.content: ……ハル。なんだか不機嫌そうだね
lines.translated: "...Haru. You look like you're in a bad mood."

lines.content: 双眼鏡を覗き込んだまま、俺は言った。
lines.translated: I said, still peering through the binoculars.

lines.content: う、うん。そうだよ。少しだけ……ご機嫌は斜めかも
lines.translated: Y-yeah. That's right. Just a little... she might be in a bit of a mood.

lines.content: ハルは頬を膨らませ、
lines.translated: Haru puffed out her cheeks.

lines.content: あの調子なら、大雅くん。[・|十][・|夜][・|と][・|の][・|ち][・|ゅ][・|ー]は特別なことじゃなくて、いつもやってることなんだね
lines.translated: Going by that, Taiga-kun -- what you do with Toya isn't something special, is it? It's just something you always do.

lines.content: いや、ちゅーだなんて、そんな誤解を招くような言い方……
lines.translated: No, calling it a "kiss" like that is just going to cause a misunderstanding...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 誤解、なのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it really a misunderstanding, though?

lines.content: 客観的に見れば、確かに結果は同じようなものだった。
lines.translated: Objectively speaking, the end result was, in fact, pretty much the same thing.

lines.content: ……数分前。
lines.translated: A few minutes ago.

lines.content: 十夜。ひとつお願いがあるんだけど……いいかな？
lines.translated: Toya, I have a favor to ask... is that okay?

lines.content: お風呂から戻ってきた十夜にあさひさんは言う――これから[俺|大雅]が“夜”の中へと“迷子”を探しに出かけなければならない。
lines.translated: Asahi-san says to Toya, who has just come back from the bath -- that I'm going to have to head into the "night" to search for a "lost child."

lines.content: そのために十夜の“力”を俺に貸してあげてほしいのだ、と。
lines.translated: And so she asks Toya to lend me her "power" for that purpose.

lines.content: 今夜は少し危険なことになる予感がある。だから十夜はお留守番。俺だけが“夜”へと向かう。だから……。
lines.translated: I have a feeling tonight is going to get a little dangerous. So Toya stays home. Only I head into the "night." And so...

lines.content: ……いつもより長めにお願いできたらうれしいな。どうかな、十夜。平気かな
lines.translated: I'd be happy if you could make it a little longer than usual. What do you think, Toya? Would that be okay?

lines.content: う、うん。それは、いいけど……
lines.translated: Y-yeah. That's... fine, but...

lines.content: 頬が赤いのはお風呂上がりで火照っているというだけではないだろう。
lines.translated: The flush on her cheeks wasn't just from the warmth of the bath.

lines.content: 小さな身体をもじもじと揺すりながら、十夜は言う。
lines.translated: Squirming and swaying her small body, Toya speaks.

lines.content: いっぱい見られてる中で、その……ちゅ、ちゅーするの……恥ずかしいよ。お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: With everyone watching like this, doing that... a k-kiss... it's embarrassing. Onee-chan.

lines.content: ちゅ……
lines.translated: "Mwah..."

lines.content: ハルは絶句していた。顔が真っ青。……俺は、それを見ないふり。
lines.translated: Haru was speechless. Her face had gone completely pale. ...I pretended not to notice.

lines.content: どうしても……ねえ、大雅。お姉ちゃん。どうしてもしなきゃだめ？
lines.translated: Does it really have to... hey, Taiga. Onee-chan. Does it really have to happen?

lines.content: もちろん十夜がいやなら絶対にとは頼めないよ。だけど、念のためにお願いできたら俺もうれしい。あさひさんの言うように、少し長めに
lines.translated: Of course, if Toya doesn't want to, I'd never insist. But if you could do it just to be safe, I'd be grateful too. Like Asahi-san said -- just a little longer than usual.

lines.content: う、うう～……っ
lines.translated: U, uuu~...!

lines.content: 真っ赤になる。小さく地団駄も踏む。
lines.translated: She turns bright red. She even stamps her feet a little.

lines.content: ごめんな十夜。あまり時間がないかもしれないんだ。だから、少し急いでもらえればうれしい……かもしれない
lines.translated: Sorry, Toya. We might not have much time. So I'd be happy if you could hurry just a little... maybe.

lines.content: 十夜の小さな背にあわせて膝を折ろうとしたところで――
lines.translated: I was about to bend my knees to match Toya's small frame when --

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと待って。あの、十夜とちゅーって……ど、どういうことなの？
lines.translated: W-wait a moment. Um, a kiss with Toya... wh-what does that mean?

lines.content: その理由を知らないハルが、あるいは忘れてしまっているのかもしれないハルが、慌てたふうに目を白黒させていた。
lines.translated: Haru, who didn't know the reason -- or perhaps had forgotten it -- was blinking in flustered confusion.

lines.content: ちょっとわけありで
lines.translated: It's a bit of a long story.

lines.content: そ、そのわけが知りたいんだけど……だめなのかな？
lines.translated: I-I want to know that long story... is that not okay?

lines.content: 悪いが今は説明している時間もあまりなさそうだ
lines.translated: Sorry, but I don't really have time to explain right now.

lines.content: ちらりと見る。何でもいいから早く行け。仕立屋の猫が鋭い視線でそう訴えかけてきている。
lines.translated: I glance over. The prim cat in the bow tie is shooting me a sharp look that says: I don't care what you do, just hurry up and go.

lines.content: ごめんハル。帰ったらちゃんと説明するよ
lines.translated: Sorry, Haru. I'll explain properly when I get back.

lines.content: う、うん……。帰ったら、だね。約束だよ？
lines.translated: Y-yeah... when you get back, right. Promise?

lines.content: ……ごめんねハルちゃん。私だって恥ずかしいんだよ。だから、あんまり見ないでね
lines.translated: Sorry, Haru-chan. I'm embarrassed too, you know. So please don't stare too much.

lines.content: 十夜はもじもじとしながらも……おでこにキスをしてくれた。
lines.translated: Still squirming, Toya... gave me a kiss on the forehead.

lines.content: 長めに。
lines.translated: A long one.
About ten seconds, give or take.

lines.content: ありがとう、十夜
lines.translated: Thank you, Toya.

lines.content: 小さな頭を撫でる。そしてもう一度、ありがとうと言った。
lines.translated: I patted her small head. And then said thank you once more.

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: 十夜は俺に頭を撫でられながら、うつむく。
lines.translated: Toya looked down as I stroked her head.

lines.content: まだ恥ずかしさが抜けないのか――その頬はほんのりと赤かった。
lines.translated: The embarrassment still hadn't faded -- her cheeks were faintly, softly red.

lines.content: がんばってね大雅。無茶はだめだよ。美味しいコロッケ作って、待ってるね
lines.translated: Do your best, Taiga. No reckless stuff, okay? I'll make some delicious croquettes and wait for you.

lines.content: ああ、ありがとう。楽しみにしてる
lines.translated: Yeah, thanks. I'm looking forward to it.

lines.content: にっこりと笑いあって見た。
lines.translated: We smiled at each other.

lines.content: そんな俺と十夜を前に、あさひさんがやれやれと首を振るのだ。
lines.translated: Watching me and Toya like that, Asahi-san shook her head with a "good grief."

lines.content: 情けない
lines.translated: "Pathetic."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 情けないよ大雅。もっとすごいことすればもっともっと長めに[・|効][・|果]があるのに。文字通りに、いや、名の通りに、[・|十][・|夜][・|分]。いつまでも意気地がないよな君は
lines.translated: You're hopeless, Taiga. If you did something more, the effect would last so much longer. Literally -- or rather, true to her name -- ten whole nights' worth. You really have no nerve, do you.

lines.content: ……それが姉の言うことですか
lines.translated: Is that something a sister should be saying?

lines.content: 俺は唖然としながらにこにこ笑うあさひさんを見つめた。
lines.translated: I stared at Asahi-san, dumbfounded, as she smiled her cheerful smile.

lines.content: ……ともあれ。
lines.translated: Anyway.

lines.content: 準備は万端とまでは言えないが、まるっきり不足しているというわけでもない。
lines.translated: I wouldn't say preparations were perfect, but they weren't entirely lacking either.

lines.content: 十夜に力を借りた。
lines.translated: I had borrowed Toya's power.

lines.content: 覚悟もできている。
lines.translated: And my resolve was set.

lines.content: あとは“想像力”を充分に発揮して――
lines.translated: All that's left is to put my "imagination" to full use --

lines.content: さあ。
lines.translated: Come on.

lines.content: 行こうか。
lines.translated: Let's go.

lines.content: ……“魔法使い”の時間だ。
lines.translated: It's time for the "sorcerer."

lines.content: 俺たちの“夜”をはじめよう。
lines.translated: Let our "night" begin.

lines.content: 覚悟を決めて。勇気を出して。踏み出そうとしたのだけれど……、
lines.translated: I steeled my resolve. I summoned my courage. I was about to take that first step -- but...

lines.content: う、ううう……ぐず
lines.translated: Ugh... uu... sniff...

lines.content: ……ハルが泣いていた。
lines.translated: Haru was crying.

lines.content: え。え……っ、どうして……？
lines.translated: Wh -- what... why...?

lines.content: ぐす。私も、行きたいよ
lines.translated: Sniff. I want to go too.

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: わ、私も……大雅くんと一緒に。役に、立ちたい……から。だから、その……うう。十夜とちゅーなんて……
lines.translated: I-I want to... go with Taiga-kun. I want to be... useful. That's why... um... wuu. Kissing Toya like that...

lines.content: ハルは滲んでいた涙をごしごし拭っていた。
lines.translated: Haru was scrubbing at the tears welling in her eyes.

lines.content: それも……あ、あんなに、慣れたふうで……十夜と、大雅くん……ああいうこととか……
lines.translated: And... th-that... she looked so... so used to it... Toya and Taiga-kun... doing things like that...

lines.content: もっと、すごいこと、とか……うう……いつも、大雅くんはこんな小さな子と、ちゅー……してるの？
lines.translated: Even more... incredible things... wuu... does Taiga-kun always go around kissing... such little girls...?

lines.content: い、いや。なんだか微妙に誤解を受けそうな感じだな
lines.translated: N-no. Somehow I feel like this is heading toward a pretty serious misunderstanding.

lines.content: 俺はあさひさんを振り返る。
lines.translated: I turn to look at Asahi-san.

lines.content: あさひさんは『仕方がないな』というふうに肩を竦めた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san shrugged her shoulders with a "can't be helped" sort of look.

lines.content: ……説得するだけの時間ももったいない。また、釈明している時間もだ。
lines.translated: We don't have time to spare on convincing her. Or on clearing things up, for that matter.
Besides, Haru had every bit as much potential to be useful as Toya.

lines.content: 十夜の代わりにハルを今夜の相棒とすることにした。
lines.translated: So I decided to make Haru my partner for tonight, in Toya's place.

lines.content: まあ、そもそも。
lines.translated: Well, when you think about it.

lines.content: ……俺が今からすることは、元々ハルの――“魔法少女”たちの仕事の一部、だったのだけれど。
lines.translated: What I'm about to do was originally part of Haru's -- the "magical girls'" -- job, anyway.

lines.content: “迷子”は、見つかった？
lines.translated: "Has the lost one been found?"

lines.content: ハルが隣で目を細め、町を見ていた。
lines.translated: Haru was standing beside me, eyes narrowed, gazing out over the town.

lines.content: 双眼鏡を覗き込んだままの俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: I kept my eyes pressed to the binoculars and shook my head.

lines.content: いや。まだだ
lines.translated: No. Not yet.

lines.content: なんだか町中が騒がしい感じがするけど……大丈夫なのかな
lines.translated: The whole town feels kind of restless... I wonder if everything's okay.

lines.content: ああ。その騒ぎの中心を探っていけば、すぐ見つかるだろうとは思うけど
lines.translated: Yeah. If we track down the center of that commotion, I think we'll find them soon enough.

lines.content: 双眼鏡で覗き込んだ町の風景。
lines.translated: The townscape as seen through the binoculars.

lines.content: 逃げまどう猫たち。それぞれの家に戻っていく人ではない[何か|影]や、夢見るためにやって来た[命|心]たち。
lines.translated: Cats fleeing in all directions. Shadows -- things that weren't people -- drifting back to their respective homes, and souls that had come here to dream.

lines.content: “迷子”になっちゃった誰かの心。現実の世界で……ううん。“夜の国”のほうも現実のひとつだったよね
lines.translated: The heart of someone who got "lost." In the real world... no, wait. The "Night Country" was one kind of real too, wasn't it.

lines.content: とにかく“夜”じゃないほう。“太陽の時間”の中で、いったい何があって[・|そ][・|う]なったのかは、わからないけど……
lines.translated: Anyway -- the one that isn't the "night." Whatever happened in the "sun's hours" to cause this... I don't know, but...

lines.content: 大丈夫だよね？　とハルが言う。
lines.translated: "It'll be okay, right?" Haru says.

lines.content: 私たちみたいに、あさひさんがきっと、元気にしてくれるよね？
lines.translated: Asahi-san will definitely cheer them up, just like she did for us, right?

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだね。きっと
lines.translated: Yeah. I'm sure she will.

lines.content: 太陽の時間の中で背負い込んだつらい思いから逃げ出すように“迷子”となってしまった誰かの心。
lines.translated: Someone's heart -- fleeing from the weight of pain they'd carried through the hours of sunlight -- had gone "lost."

lines.content: その行方を見つけ、あさひさんの待つ“ゆめのねどこ”へと導く。
lines.translated: Find where it had wandered, and guide it to the "dream bed" where Asahi-san was waiting.

lines.content: そしてあさひさんが、彼や彼女の抱えた心の問題を少しでも軽くするために手を尽くす。
lines.translated: And then Asahi-san would do everything in her power to ease whatever burden that heart was carrying, even just a little.

lines.content: ……この俺が十年前、そうされたように。
lines.translated: Just as she had done for me, ten years ago.

lines.content: あのひとが、“夜の魔法使い”であるあさひさんが、この胸に抱いた願いを叶えるための手助けをしてくれる。
lines.translated: That person -- Asahi-san, the "sorcerer of the night" -- would help make the wish I held in my chest come true.

lines.content: だからきっと、俺も、ハルも、本来ならば――“迷子”と同じだ。
lines.translated: So surely, both I and Haru were, at our core -- no different from the "lost ones" ourselves.

lines.content: ……見つけた
lines.translated: Found one.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: “迷子”だ
lines.translated: "It's the 'Lost Child.'"

lines.content: 昨日、遭遇した[・|あ][・|の][・|子]だった。
lines.translated: It was that child I had encountered yesterday.

lines.content: どこ？
lines.translated: "Where?"

lines.content: ほら、あそこ。あの山だ。町を見た渡す展望台のような広場だよ。あそこに“何か”がうずくまってる。……どうしてあんなところに。すぐに行かないと
lines.translated: Look -- over there. That hill. The open plaza that looks out over the whole town like a viewing platform. Something is huddled up over there. ...Why all the way out there. We have to go now.

lines.content: 見れば“迷子”はすでに“悪夢”に変化しつつあるように見えた。黒く。黒く。昨晩見たよりもずっと……黒く。
lines.translated: Even from here I could see that the "lost one" was already in the process of transforming into a "nightmare." Black. Blacker. So much darker than last night...

lines.content: でも、大雅くん。ここからあそこは遠いよ。凄くすごく、遠い。私たちがあそこにたどり着くまで“迷子”はちゃんとそこにいるのかな
lines.translated: But, Taiga-kun. That place is far from here. Really, really far. Will the "lost one" still be there by the time we make it?

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 双眼鏡を降ろす。
lines.translated: I lower the binoculars.

lines.content: ハル。そのために君も一緒に着いてきてもらったんだ
lines.translated: Haru -- that's exactly why I asked you to come along.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 手を、繋ごう
lines.translated: Let's hold hands.

lines.content: 俺はハルへと手を差し伸べる。
lines.translated: I reach my hand out toward Haru.

lines.content: ……どうか俺に君の“[魔法|想像力]”を使わせてほしい。……昔々の“夜”の中。あさひさんがそうしていたみたいに
lines.translated: Please, let me use your "magic" -- your "imagination." ...Like Asahi-san used to do, in the nights of long ago.

lines.content: かつて“特別”だった少女。柊ハル。
lines.translated: The girl who was once "special." Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 彼女の力を“夜”の中で引き出して、それを自由自在に操作していたのは陽向井あさひ――この町の“夜の魔法使い”だ。
lines.translated: The one who had drawn out her power within the "Night" and wielded it freely was Hinai Asahi -- the "sorcerer of the night" of this town.

lines.content: そうすることであさひさんは人類の敵……“夜の王”と戦った。
lines.translated: Through that power, Asahi-san had fought humanity's enemy... the "King of Night."

lines.content: その役割を、その能力を、引き継いだのだ――差し出した手のひらに込められた事情を、俺はハルに語った。
lines.translated: That role, that ability -- had been passed on. I told Haru the circumstances behind the hand I had extended to her.

lines.content: それじゃあ、今は……大雅くんが私たちの心を“夜”の中で使う人……“魔法少女『使い』”？
lines.translated: So that means... right now, you're the one who uses our hearts within the "Night"... a "magical girl handler"?

lines.content: あ、ああ……。そういうことになる、かな
lines.translated: Ah, yeah... I guess that's one way to put it.

lines.content: だけど、と俺は付け加える。
lines.translated: But, I added.

lines.content: “魔法少女『使い』”……その呼び方は遠慮してもらえると、うれしい。すごく恥ずかしいので
lines.translated: "Magical girl handler"... I'd really appreciate it if you didn't call me that. It's incredibly embarrassing.

lines.content: そう呼ばれて喜ぶのはあさひさんくらいだよ。苦笑いで俺はそう言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san's basically the only one who'd be happy being called something like that. I said it with a wry smile.

lines.content: 柊ハル。かつて“夜の国”で“魔法少女”と呼ばれた女の子。人類の未来を脅かしていた最大の悪夢、“夜の王”を退けたその力を借り受けたいんだ
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru. The girl who was once called a "magical girl" in the "Night Country." I want to borrow the power that drove back the greatest nightmare that ever threatened humanity's future -- the "King of Night."

lines.content: ……私で、いいの？
lines.translated: Me? Is it... okay if it's me?

lines.content: ハルは首をかしげた。そして不安そうにする。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head. Then her expression grew uneasy.

lines.content: 千和ちゃんや、姫織ちゃんたちじゃなくて、私で……いいのかな？
lines.translated: Not Chiwa-chan, or Himeori-chan... is it really okay if it's me?

lines.content: ああ、うん……。そうだよ
lines.translated: Yeah, it is. It's you.

lines.content: 柊ハル。かつて“魔法少女”と呼ばれた女の子。人類の未来を脅かしていた“夜の王”を退けたその力を今夜、俺は借りたいんだ
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru. The girl who was once called a "magical girl." Tonight, I want to borrow the power that drove back the "King of Night" -- the one who threatened humanity's future.

lines.content: ハルは、うなずく。
lines.translated: Haru nodded.

lines.content: そして恐る恐る、差し出した俺の手を握ってくれた。
lines.translated: And then, hesitantly, she took hold of the hand I had extended.

lines.content: ……俺たちの“魔法”は、誰にも負けない“想像力”だ
lines.translated: Our "magic" is an "imagination" that yields to no one.

lines.content: ここは思い描くすべてが叶えられてしまう“[夢|魔法]の世界”――“夜の国”
lines.translated: This is the "world of magic" -- the "Night Country" -- where everything you can dream of comes true.

lines.content: 俺は、命じる。
lines.translated: I give the command.

lines.content: 繋いだ手。少女の形をした魔法。魔法少女。[・|俺][・|の][・|魔][・|法]……柊ハルへ。
lines.translated: Joined hands. Magic in the shape of a girl. A magical girl. My magic... to Hiiragi Haru.
From here -- to there.

lines.content: 遠いとおい距離を一気に縮めるにはどんな“魔法”が最適なのか”――心を、想像を重ねるようにと、俺は命じた。
lines.translated: What "magic" would be best suited to close a vast, vast distance all at once -- I commanded her to layer her heart, her imagination, with mine.

lines.content: ……繋いだ手からハルの心が、その想像が流れ込んできた。
lines.translated: Through our joined hands, Haru's heart -- her imagination -- came flowing into me.

lines.content: 閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の裏側に広がる光景。それがハルの“[想像力|魔法]”だ。
lines.translated: The scene that spread across the back of my closed eyelids. That was Haru's "magic."

lines.content: ああ、そうだね。
lines.translated: Ah, yes.

lines.content: それがきっと今に最も相応しい魔法だろう。
lines.translated: That was surely the most fitting magic for this moment.

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。
lines.translated: I opened my eyelids.

lines.content: ハル。しっかり掴まっててほしい。振り落とされないように
lines.translated: Haru. Hold on tight. Don't let yourself get thrown off.

lines.content: う、うん。わかった。掴まってる
lines.translated: O-okay. Got it. I'm holding on.

lines.content: ぎゅっと。
lines.translated: Tightly.

lines.content: ハルが力強く俺の手を握り返した。
lines.translated: Haru squeezed my hand back with surprising strength.

lines.content: 絶対、ぜったい、離さないよ……
lines.translated: I absolutely, absolutely won't let go...

lines.content: どこか不安そうに俺を見上げた。
lines.translated: She looked up at me, a trace of anxiety in her eyes.

lines.content: 今から何をするのか。どんな[想像|心]を具現化させようというのか。互いにそれはもう理解できてる。通じ合えている。
lines.translated: What we were about to do. What imagination -- what heart -- we were about to make real. We both already understood. We were in sync.

lines.content: だからそんなハルに……俺の“魔法”に、微笑みかけて――
lines.translated: So to that Haru... to my "magic," I smiled --
And then let go of Haru's hand.

lines.content: え？　どうして――わわっ
lines.translated: Eh? Why -- wh-whoa!

lines.content: ハルの身体を抱き上げた。
lines.translated: I scooped Haru up into my arms.

lines.content: そのまま俺はもう一度、強く[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: And just like that, I shut my eyelids again, tightly.

lines.content: [・|未][・|完][・|成][・|な][・|こ][・|の][・|心]ではうまく“想像”できない。故に。“思い出す”のだ。
lines.translated: With this unfinished heart of mine, I can't "imagine" it properly. So instead -- I "remember."

lines.content: 幼い頃からあさひさんと触れたたくさんの物語。その中で生きている彼や彼女のことを。
lines.translated: All the stories I had touched alongside Asahi-san since childhood. The people -- him and her -- who lived within those stories.

lines.content: そして重ねる。俺の魔法、柊ハルが心で思い描いた[魔法|映像]と、俺の中にある想像を。
lines.translated: And I layer them. My magic, the image Hiiragi Haru had pictured in her heart, and the imagination within me.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: （……ヒーローは、[・|こ][・|こ]だ。ここにいる）
lines.translated: (...The hero is here. Right here.)

lines.content: 心でつぶやく。呪文のように。
lines.translated: I murmur it in my heart. Like an incantation.

lines.content: ……頭の中に展開させた[理想像|ヒーロー]と自分とを、しっかり、重ね合わせて――……
lines.translated: The ideal -- the hero -- I had conjured in my mind, overlaid firmly, precisely, with myself --

lines.content: 突風。
lines.translated: A gust of wind.

lines.content: 轟音。
lines.translated: A roaring sound.

lines.content: ――わっ、わわわわわ
lines.translated: -- Wh-whoaaa, whoa whoa whoa whoa!

lines.content: ハルの、声。
lines.translated: Haru's voice.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I open my eyelids.

lines.content: すると、そこは――
lines.translated: And there --

lines.content: そこは、空の上だった。
lines.translated: There, we were above the sky.

lines.content: 分厚い雲を突き抜けて……。
lines.translated: Having burst straight through the thick clouds...

lines.content: 真夜中の、大きなおおきな満月が目の前に迫るほど。
lines.translated: The great, enormous full moon of midnight loomed close enough to fill our entire view.

lines.content: すごい……っ
lines.translated: Amazing...

lines.content: 腕の中でハルが息を呑む音を聴いた気がした。
lines.translated: I thought I heard Haru catch her breath in my arms.

lines.content: すごい。すごいよ大雅くん、ほら、見て。町が、あんなに小さく……
lines.translated: Amazing. This is amazing, Taiga-kun -- look, look. The town, it's so tiny down there...

lines.content: 足下。遙か下を見る。
lines.translated: I look down. Far, far below.

lines.content: 分厚い雲の切れ間に町の灯りが見えていた。
lines.translated: Through the gaps in the thick clouds, the lights of the town were visible.

lines.content: ……ちょっと、高すぎたかもしれない
lines.translated: That might have been a little too high.

lines.content: ……俺は“魔法少女”の力を使う者。
lines.translated: I am one who wields the power of a "magical girl."

lines.content: あさひさん曰く、“魔法使い”ならぬ“魔法少女『使い』”
lines.translated: As Asahi-san put it -- not a "magic-user," but a "magical girl user."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]は、思い描けるすべてが叶う“夜”の中で、ハルの“想像力”を借り、俺の“魔法”とした結果だ。
lines.translated: This is the result of borrowing Haru's "imagination" within the "night" where anything one can picture comes true, and making it my own "magic."

lines.content: 少女の形をした“魔法”……故に、“魔法少女”
lines.translated: "Magic" that takes the form of a girl -- hence, a "magical girl."

lines.content: 彼女らの力を顕現化させるのが、あさひさんから譲り受けた俺の“役割”だ。
lines.translated: Manifesting their power is the "role" I inherited from Asahi-san.

lines.content: それなのに俺は、その力を制御し切れていなかった。
lines.translated: And yet I still couldn't fully control that power.

lines.content: ここまで高く飛び上がるほどの跳躍を、ハルに求めてはいなかったはずなのに……。
lines.translated: I hadn't meant to ask Haru for a leap powerful enough to send us soaring this high...
As I thought -- my heart is still incomplete.

lines.content: まだ上手に“[ハル|魔法]”を使いこなせない。
lines.translated: I still can't wield Haru's "magic" with any real skill.

lines.content: 満月がすぐそこに迫って見えるほど、高く、飛び上がってしまってる。
lines.translated: We've jumped so high that the full moon looks close enough to touch.

lines.content: ハルはぎゅっと目を閉じた。
lines.translated: Haru squeezed her eyes shut.

lines.content: 足下にあった分厚い雲に飲み込まれる。
lines.translated: We were swallowed up by the thick clouds that had been below our feet.

lines.content: 頬に。額に。身体、全体に。
lines.translated: Against my cheeks. Against my forehead. Against my entire body.

lines.content: ……鋭い大気がひゅうひゅうと擦過していく。
lines.translated: Sharp air rushed past us with a thin, whistling shriek.

lines.content: わあ……
lines.translated: "Whoa..."

lines.content: 感嘆の声。
lines.translated: A voice of wonder.

lines.content: すごく、綺麗
lines.translated: It's so... beautiful.

lines.content: ハルは満月に手を伸ばす。俺の腕の中で。
lines.translated: Haru reached out toward the full moon. There in my arms.

lines.content: ……お月様。満天の星。見たことのない星空だ。
lines.translated: The moon. A sky full of stars. A starscape I had never seen before.

lines.content: 流れ星がひとつ。
lines.translated: One shooting star.

lines.content: また、ひとつ。
lines.translated: Then another.

lines.content: ふたつ。みっつ。
lines.translated: Two. Three.

lines.content: 瞬く間に流星群となる。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, it became a meteor shower.

lines.content: その一つひとつが夜空に光の尾を引いた。
lines.translated: Each and every one of them trailed a tail of light across the night sky.

lines.content: まるで開きっぱなしのフィルムに焼き付けられた星の足跡。
lines.translated: Like the footprints of stars burned into a strip of film left open to the light.

lines.content: ……降下。
lines.translated: Descent.

lines.content: 適当な民家の屋根を踏み台にし、もう一度、上空へ。
lines.translated: Using the roof of some random house as a stepping stone, I launched us skyward once more.

lines.content: 目の前の広場……、もうすぐそこだよ。すごいよ大雅くん。あっという間だね
lines.translated: The plaza ahead... we're almost there. This is incredible, Taiga-kun. That was so fast.

lines.content: ごめん、ハル。
lines.translated: Sorry, Haru.

lines.content: 今はあまり話しているだけの余裕もなかった。
lines.translated: Right now I didn't have much room to spare for conversation.

lines.content: 頭の中のイメージを、そして集中力を途切れさせてしまえば瞬く間に墜落してしまう。
lines.translated: If I let the image in my head slip -- if my concentration broke -- we'd plummet in an instant.

lines.content: 夜空を駆ける。
lines.translated: Racing through the night sky.

lines.content: 高く、大きく、ジャンプするだけ。
lines.translated: Just jumping. High and wide.

lines.content: たったそれだけの“魔法”――と呼べるのかも微妙なところでしかないこの[跳躍|方法]。
lines.translated: This method of leaping -- if you could even call it "magic" was debatable at best.

lines.content: 手を繋いだハルに、俺が“夜空を飛ぶ”という“[魔法|想像]”を命じた結果だが……。
lines.translated: It was the result of commanding Haru, whose hand I held, to "imagine" that I was "flying through the night sky"...

lines.content: あまりにもありふれたシチュエーションだ。
lines.translated: An utterly commonplace scenario, when you think about it.

lines.content: ハル。千和。そして姫織。
lines.translated: Haru. Chiwa. And Himeori.

lines.content: かつての君たちだったなら、今、どんな“魔法”を選んだだろう。“想像”、していたことだろう。
lines.translated: If it had been the you of back then -- what "magic" would you have chosen right now? What would you have "imagined"?

lines.content: ぽんとひとつ踏み切るだけで、夜空をすぃっと滑空して見せただろうか。
lines.translated: Would you have shown me how to glide smoothly through the night sky with just a single light kick off the ground?

lines.content: おとぎ話の魔法使いや魔女みたいに、杖や箒で夜空をかけていっただろうか。
lines.translated: Would you have ridden through the night sky on a wand or a broomstick, like a fairy-tale wizard or witch?

lines.content: どれだけ素敵でかわいいシチュエーションを生み出したのだろう。
lines.translated: How many wonderful, enchanting scenarios would you have conjured up?

lines.content: ……この俺になど文字通り想像もできやしない方法を、幾つも、いくつも、思い浮かべていたはずだ。
lines.translated: You would surely have thought of countless methods -- methods that someone like me literally couldn't even imagine.

lines.content: 敵わない。
lines.translated: I'm no match for her.

lines.content: どんなに心を磨こうと、どんなにたくさん本を読み、他人の想像力を詰め込もうと……。
lines.translated: No matter how much I polish my heart, no matter how many books I read and fill myself with other people's imagination...

lines.content: きっと俺は、かつての君らのようにはなれないだろう。
lines.translated: I could never become what you once were, I'm sure of it.

lines.content: だからこそ、ただただ大きくジャンプするだけにとどめておいた。
lines.translated: That's precisely why I settled for nothing more than one great big jump.

lines.content: 杖や箒で空を翔るのは安直過ぎて、少しばかり恥ずかしい――というのも正直なところあったりもするのだけれど。
lines.translated: Though if I'm being honest, riding through the sky on a wand or a broomstick felt a little too on-the-nose -- a touch embarrassing, even.

lines.content: もう少しだ……
lines.translated: Just a little further...

lines.content: 目的地が近づいていた。
lines.translated: Our destination was getting closer.

lines.content: 町を見渡せる山の広場だ。
lines.translated: It's an open plaza on the mountain overlooking the town.

lines.content: その中心に“迷子”の姿が見えている。
lines.translated: Right in the center of it, I can see the figure of the "Lost Child."

lines.content: ……あの子。何をしてるんだろうか。ずっと同じ場所にいるみたいだけど
lines.translated: "...What is that kid doing? It looks like they've been staying in the exact same spot this whole time."

lines.content: 不思議に思った。
lines.translated: I found it strange.

lines.content: だけど今大切なのは無事にあそこまで行き着くことだ。
lines.translated: Right now, though, the important thing is getting over there safely.

lines.content: 改めて遙か上空から着地するポイントを見定めた。
lines.translated: From high up in the sky, I once again fixed my eyes on a spot to land.

lines.content: あそこくらいが適当、なのかな
lines.translated: "Right around there should do it, I guess."

lines.content: “迷子”のすぐ目の前に降り立つことを決める。
lines.translated: I decided to touch down right in front of the "Lost Child."

lines.content: 重力にふたり分の重さを掴ませるイメージ。
lines.translated: I pictured letting gravity take hold of the weight of the two of us.

lines.content: 地面が、迫った。
lines.translated: The ground rushed up to meet us.

lines.content: ものすごい勢いで落下していく。
