lines.translated: We were plummeting at a tremendous speed.

lines.content: ……流石に少し怖くなる。
lines.translated: Even I was getting a little scared.

lines.content: 落下しながら短く息を吐き出す。簡単な深呼吸。
lines.translated: As we fell, I let out a short breath. A quick, deep breath.

lines.content: （大丈夫。問題ない）
lines.translated: (It's fine. No problem.)

lines.content: 数秒先の未来を俺は思い描いた。
lines.translated: I pictured the future a few seconds ahead.

lines.content: 無事にハルを抱きかかえたまま、足先から軽やかに着地する自分のイメージを――
lines.translated: The image of myself landing lightly on the tips of my toes, still carrying Haru safely in my arms--

lines.content: ――ぎゅっと、ハルが抱きついてきた。
lines.translated: --Haru clung to me tightly.

lines.content: こ、こわいっ
lines.translated: "I-I'm scared!"

lines.content: 俺の首に回した両腕に力を込めて、身体を、ぴったりと――……まずい。
lines.translated: Putting all her strength into the arms wrapped around my neck, she pressed her body right up against--...Uh-oh.

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっとこれ……大丈夫？　こわいよ、大雅くんっ
lines.translated: "H-Hold on... is this really okay? I'm scared, Taiga-kun!"

lines.content: 集中力が、乱れた。
lines.translated: My concentration wavered.

lines.content: （ちょっとスピード、出過ぎじゃないか、これ）
lines.translated: (Aren't we going a little too fast here?)

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり俺はどこまでいっても未完成。一瞬だけ、着地のイメージが途切れてしまった。
lines.translated: Man, no matter how far I go, I'm still nowhere near ready. For just an instant, my mental image of the landing broke off.

lines.content: う、ううううっ、大雅くん……っ
lines.translated: "U-Uuuuugh, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: 更に強く抱きついてくる。
lines.translated: She clung to me even harder.

lines.content: は、ハル、あんまりくっつかないで……っ
lines.translated: "H-Haru, don't press up against me so much...!"

lines.content: い、いやっ、怖いよっ
lines.translated: "N-No! I'm scared!"

lines.content: ぎゅう。
lines.translated: Squeeze.

lines.content: しっかり捕まってろって言ったのは大雅くんだよ……っ
lines.translated: "You're the one who told me to hold on tight, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: 集中力が乱れたのはハルに抱きつかれたからだ。その……柔らかいものが、あれで……それで。
lines.translated: The reason my concentration broke was because Haru had thrown her arms around me. Her... soft things were doing that... and all that.

lines.content: う、うう……っ！
lines.translated: "U-Uugh...!"

lines.content: これくらいのことで集中力が乱れるなんてまるで笑い種にもなりゃしない。
lines.translated: Losing my focus over something like this wasn't even funny.

lines.content: このことがもしも知れたらあさひさんに笑われてしまう。からかわれてしまう――
lines.translated: If Asahi-san ever found out about this, she'd laugh at me. She'd tease me to no end--

lines.content: （なんてことを考えてる場合じゃ、ないっ）
lines.translated: (Now is NOT the time to be thinking about that!)

lines.content: みるみる地上が近づいてきていた。
lines.translated: The ground was rushing up to meet us fast.

lines.content: このまま地面にたたきつけられれば無論……結果は死だ。
lines.translated: Needless to say, if we slammed into the ground like this... the result would be death.

lines.content: ここがいくら“夢の国”であろうとも、肉体を持ち込んでいる俺たちは簡単に死に至る。現実世界と変わることなく。
lines.translated: No matter how much of a "Dreamland" this place might be, since we brought our physical bodies here, we could easily die. Just like in the real world.

lines.content: 必死に着地のイメージを整えようとする。
lines.translated: I frantically tried to reconstruct the image of our landing.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 一度乱れた心は制御不能に。
lines.translated: Once my mind was thrown into disarray, there was no getting it back under control.

lines.content: 脳裏に着地失敗の映像が……。
lines.translated: Visions of a botched landing flashed through my head...

lines.content: ゾッとする。全身に悪寒が走った。
lines.translated: My blood ran cold. A chill shot through my entire body.

lines.content: 俺は着地の衝撃に備え、全身に力を込めた――
lines.translated: Bracing for the impact of landing, I tensed every muscle in my body--

lines.content: 稲妻だ。
lines.translated: Lightning.

lines.content: まるで稲妻に撃たれてしまったような衝撃が全身に奔った。
lines.translated: A shockwave coursed through my entire body, as if I'd been struck by a bolt of lightning.

lines.content: 歯を、食いしばる。
lines.translated: I gritted my teeth.

lines.content: ぐ、おおおおおおお
lines.translated: "Guh, ooooooooh!"

lines.content: 全身を震わせた。痛みに。痺れに。必死に耐える。
lines.translated: My whole body trembled. From the pain. From the numbness. I desperately endured it.

lines.content: だ、大丈夫……？
lines.translated: "A-Are you okay...?"

lines.content: すぐ近くからハルの声。
lines.translated: Haru's voice came from right beside me.

lines.content: すごい音、したけど……
lines.translated: "That made a huge noise..."

lines.content: あ、ああ、大丈夫
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah, I'm fine."

lines.content: 強がりながらもそう応え、俺は、堅く閉じていた[まぶた|瞼]をうっすらと開いた――
lines.translated: Putting on a tough front as I answered, I cracked open my tightly shut eyelids--

lines.content: ぜんっ、ぜん、平気
lines.translated: "Toootally fine."

lines.content: 笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: I flashed a smile.

lines.content: きっとひきつった笑顔だ。
lines.translated: A cramped, twitching smile, no doubt.

lines.content: ほ、ほんとに？　着地のとき、どしんって、すごく痛そうな音してたんだよ……？
lines.translated: "R-Really? When we landed, there was this huge thud that sounded super painful...?"

lines.content: これくらい、な、なんてことないって
lines.translated: "Something like that is n-nothing at all, really."

lines.content: 腕の中のハルにできるだけ自然に笑いかけ、もう一度大丈夫と伝えた。
lines.translated: Giving Haru in my arms the most natural smile I could muster, I told her once more that I was fine.

lines.content: だが、実際のところ――
lines.translated: In reality, though--

lines.content: （い、ってええええええええええっ）
lines.translated: (Owwwwwwwwwwwww!)

lines.content: ――心中、涙目だった。
lines.translated: --on the inside, I was on the verge of tears.

lines.content: （足、骨折――はしてないまでも、捻挫くらいは、したかも……っ）
lines.translated: (My legs aren't broken--at least I don't think so, though I might have sprained something...!)

lines.content: 着地は成功であり失敗だった。
lines.translated: The landing was both a success and a failure.

lines.content: 落下の最中、なんとかイメージを修正できた。
lines.translated: Mid-fall, I had managed to adjust my mental image.
However.

lines.content: とっさに修正したイメージが最適とはいえないものだった。
lines.translated: The image I'd scrambled to picture on the fly was far from ideal.

lines.content: “主人公の少年がコンクリートの地面の上に少女を抱えたまま飛び降りる”というとあるアニメのワンシーンを、俺は、つい思い浮かべてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I had inadvertently pictured a scene from a certain anime where "the boy protagonist jumps down onto a concrete ground while carrying a girl in his arms."

lines.content: ここは想像力こそが武器となる“夜の国”
lines.translated: This was the "Night Realm," where imagination itself was a weapon.

lines.content: （……こともあろうに、こんなところであんなシーンを思い描かなくてもいいだろうに）
lines.translated: (...Of all the things to picture, why did I have to go and imagine a scene like that in a place like this?)

lines.content: 律儀にも全身びりびりと、痛い。
lines.translated: True to form, my whole body was throbbing and tingling with pain.

lines.content: あの、大雅くん……
lines.translated: "Um, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 怪我がなくてよかった。ありがとう。……あの、もう、降ろしてくれても大丈夫かなって……
lines.translated: "I'm glad you're not hurt. Thank you. ...Um, I think you can put me down now..."

lines.content: 何も言わずうなずいて、抱き抱えたままのハルをおろした。
lines.translated: Nodding wordlessly, I set Haru down from where I was still holding her in my arms.

lines.content: ごめんね、重かったよね。私、ダイエットしなきゃ……かも……お菓子ばっかり食べてたら、だめだよね……
lines.translated: "Sorry, I was heavy, wasn't I? Maybe... I need to go on a diet... Eating nothing but sweets is no good after all, huh..."

lines.content: いや。ううん、大丈夫。そんなことない。軽かった。羽みたいに
lines.translated: "No. Uh-uh, it's fine. Not at all. You were light. Like a feather."

lines.content: 笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: I said it with a smile.

lines.content: きっと油汗まみれの青い顔で、だ。
lines.translated: Though my face was surely pale and drenched in cold sweat.

lines.content: 憧れの[ヒーロー|あの人]ならば、もっと気の利いたことを言うのかな。
lines.translated: If it were that hero I admired, I wonder if she would have said something much smoother.

lines.content: ついそんなことを思ってしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking things like that.

lines.content: ……深呼吸。
lines.translated: Deep breath.

lines.content: 目の前を、見つめる。
lines.translated: I stared straight ahead.
--There was a stuffed animal.

lines.content: くまのぬいぐるみだ。俺たちの着地したすぐ目の前に座っている。
lines.translated: A stuffed bear. Sitting right in front of where we had landed.

lines.content: ちょっと高級で、毛並みもふわふわなぬいぐるみ。
lines.translated: A somewhat high-end plushie with soft, fluffy fur.

lines.content: 抱きしめたら心地良さそうなふわふわな毛並み。
lines.translated: Fluffy fur that looked like it would feel wonderful to hug.

lines.content: しかし……片目に眼帯をつけ、両手足にぐるぐると真っ白な包帯を巻き付けたその姿には、どこか不気味なものを感じさせられてしまう。
lines.translated: However... with an eyepatch over one eye and pure white bandages wrapped tightly around its arms and legs, there was something undeniably eerie about its appearance.
It was the "Lost Child."

lines.content: いいや。昨晩に見た、そして先ほど双眼鏡からのぞき見た姿とはだいぶ違ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: No. Its appearance had changed drastically from what I saw last night, and even from what I'd glimpsed through the binoculars just a little while ago.

lines.content: もう既に“悪夢”に変わり始めている“迷子”の姿だ。
lines.translated: It was the form of a "Lost Child" that had already begun turning into a "Nightmare."

lines.content: 広場に降り立った俺たちの目の前に[・|そ][・|れ]はいたのだった。
lines.translated: Right before our eyes as we stood in the plaza, *it* was there.

lines.content: “う、うううううう”
lines.translated: "U-Uuuuuuuugh..."

lines.content: ――包帯だらけのテディベアが、立ち上がった。ゆっくりと。
lines.translated: --The bandage-wrapped teddy bear stood up. Slowly.

lines.content: “死に、たい”
lines.translated: "I want... to die."

lines.content: 声がした。
lines.translated: A voice called out.

lines.content: “死ね、ない”
lines.translated: "I can't... die."

lines.content: うなるような声だった。
lines.translated: Its voice sounded like a groan.

lines.content: “死にたく、ない……”
lines.translated: "I don't want... to die..."

lines.content: 泣き出しそうな、声だった。
lines.translated: Its voice sounded like it was about to burst into tears.

lines.content: “どうか、教えて。私はどこへ、帰れば……”
lines.translated: "Please, tell me. Where am I supposed to go home to...?"

lines.content: 大丈夫。……平気だ。何も心配しなくていい。俺たちと一緒に帰ろう。俺は、俺たちは、君のことを助けにきたんだ
lines.translated: "It's okay. ...You're alright. You don't have to worry about a thing. Let's go home together. I--we came here to save you."

lines.content: 手を差し伸べる。
lines.translated: I held out my hand.

lines.content: よければ話を聞かせてくれないか。なあ、君の名前は？　いったい何があったんだ？
lines.translated: "If you don't mind, will you tell me your story? Hey, what's your name? What on earth happened to you?"

lines.content: 語りかける。
lines.translated: I spoke to it.

lines.content: できるだけ、やさしく。
lines.translated: As gently as I possibly could.

lines.content: 何がつらい。何が、悲しい。何がそんなに、[・|痛][・|い]んだ？
lines.translated: "What's hurting you so much? What's making you so sad? What is it that *aches* so badly?"

lines.content: 俺たちならきっと君の力になれる。だから、ほら。こんなところで、ひとりでいないで……俺たちと帰ろう
lines.translated: "I'm sure we can help you. So come on. Don't stay in a place like this all by yourself... Let's go home together."

lines.content: ぬいぐるみは何も言わない。応えない。
lines.translated: The stuffed bear said nothing. It didn't answer.

lines.content: ただその小さな身体を重そうに、気怠げに、[・|右][・|半][・|身][・|を][・|傾][・|け][・|る][・|よ][・|う][・|に][・|し][・|て]――立ち尽くしているばかりだ。
lines.translated: It simply stood there motionless, its small body looking heavy and listless, *leaning its entire right side at a tilt*--.

lines.content: ぽつり
lines.translated: And, dotting the darkness one by one,

lines.content: ぽつり
lines.translated: And, dotting the darkness one by one,

lines.content: 雨が、降り始めた。
lines.translated: Rain began to fall.

lines.content: ……瞬く間に土砂降りとなる。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, it turned into a downpour.

lines.content: あ、あああああああっ
lines.translated: "A-Aaaaaaaaah!"

lines.content: 突然、ハルが頭を抱え……叫んだ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Haru clutched her head... and screamed.

lines.content: な、なああ、なにっ、なにこれ……っ、いや、いたいっ、いた、いっ、う、うううっ
lines.translated: "W-Whaaat, what, what is this...?! No, it hurts, it hurts! U-Uuuugh!"

lines.content: お、おい、どうしたんだハル
lines.translated: "H-Hey, what's wrong, Haru?!"

lines.content: 苦しむハルを振り返り、気づいた。
lines.translated: Turning back toward the agonized Haru, I realized it.

lines.content: これは……
lines.translated: "This is..."

lines.content: 俺は、空を仰いだ。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky.
*It wasn't rain.*

lines.content: 降り注ぐものは、 [・|文][・|字][・|だ]。
lines.translated: What was pouring down on us was *writing*.

lines.content: ……空から。
lines.translated: From the sky.

lines.content: どんよりと曇った“夜”の空から。
lines.translated: From the gloomy, overcast sky of the "Night."

lines.content: たくさん、たくさん、
lines.translated: So many, so many,

lines.content: いっぱい、いっぱい、
lines.translated: Endless, endless,

lines.content: 言葉がまるで嵐のように、その雨粒の一つひとつが遙か上空からつらつらと線を引き、降ってくる――まるで小説の一文、一行のそれのように。
lines.translated: Words came pouring down like a storm, each individual raindrop drawing a continuous line from high above--just like a single sentence, a single line from a novel.

lines.content: “私はいらない”
lines.translated: "I'm not needed."

lines.content: “私は、悪魔だ”
lines.translated: "I am a demon."

lines.content: “私は[私|あの子]を苦しめる……”
lines.translated: "I'm making *her* suffer..."

lines.content: それは“迷子”の声だ。あるいは叫びだ。
lines.translated: It was the voice of the "Lost Child." Or rather, its scream.

lines.content: それらが俺やハルをめがけ、“夜”の空から落ちてきて――肌にべったりと文字が張り付くと、
lines.translated: Aimed straight at Haru and me, they fell from the sky of the "Night"--and as the letters stuck thickly to our skin,

lines.content: いやっ、あ、ああっ、お願い、やだっ、大雅くん……っ、お願い、助けてっ、この声、胸が、心が、なんだか痛いよ……っ
lines.translated: "No, a-aaah, please, stop it, Taiga-kun...! Please, help me! This voice, my chest, my heart, it hurts so much...!"

lines.content: 俺たちの“心”を汚染しようと、いや、俺たちに助けを求めようと、すがりついてくる。
lines.translated: Trying to contaminate our "hearts"--no, begging us for help, they clung to us desperately.

lines.content: “どうして。どうして”
lines.translated: "Why. Why."

lines.content: “どうして私は、生まれたの……”
lines.translated: "Why was I ever born...?"

lines.content: “どうして。どうして私は、大切にしたいものを、傷つけて、ばかりなの……”
lines.translated: "Why. Why do I do nothing but hurt the things I want to treasure...?"

lines.content: 知らない誰かの声が心に響く。
lines.translated: The voice of a stranger echoed within my mind.

lines.content: 気づけば俺にも降り注ぐ言葉が張り付いている。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the pouring words were sticking to me as well.

lines.content: 頭が。心が。割れそうに、痛い。
lines.translated: My head. My heart. They hurt so much they felt like they would split open.

lines.content: や、やめてくれ……っ、俺たちは敵じゃあない、君の、味方になれればと……っ
lines.translated: "S-Stop it...! We aren't your enemies, we just want to be on your side...!"

lines.content: “要らない……っ”
lines.translated: "I don't want that...!"

lines.content: 叫ぶ。
lines.translated: It screamed.

lines.content: “敵も、味方も、必要ないっ”
lines.translated: "I don't need enemies, and I don't need allies!"

lines.content: 拒絶の声だ。
lines.translated: A voice of pure rejection.

lines.content: “誰か、誰か私を、殺してほしい……ただ、それだけっ”
lines.translated: "Someone, I just want someone to kill me... That's all I want!"

lines.content: [心|文字]の雨がふっと止んだ。
lines.translated: The rain of words--of hearts--suddenly stopped.

lines.content: 頭の中でがんがんと鳴り響いていた声も止む。
lines.translated: The voice pounding relentlessly inside my head ceased as well.

lines.content: 俺は空を見上げた。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: なぜか。
lines.translated: For some reason.

lines.content: ……なぜか、嫌な感じがしたのだ。
lines.translated: For some reason, I had a terrible feeling about this.

lines.content: 見上げた両目を鋭くすがめた。
lines.translated: Looking up, I narrowed my eyes sharply.

lines.content: ……おい、おいおい、まさか、冗談だろ
lines.translated: "...Hey, hey, hey, no way. You've got to be kidding me."

lines.content: 夜空に、きらりと無数に光るものを見つけた。
lines.translated: In the night sky, I spotted countless things glinting brightly.

lines.content: 雲間に覗く夜空の星々。なんかでは、ない。
lines.translated: Stars peeking through the clouds in the night sky? Not a chance.

lines.content: 言葉の代わりに降ってきたモノは……。
lines.translated: What came pouring down in place of the words were...

lines.content: ハサミ。
lines.translated: Scissors.

lines.content: カッターナイフ。
lines.translated: Box cutters.

lines.content: コンパス。
lines.translated: Compasses.

lines.content: 尖った鉛筆。
lines.translated: Sharpened pencils.

lines.content: 雨粒は鋭利な凶器に姿を変えて、豪雨のように降り注いできていた。
lines.translated: The raindrops had transformed into sharp, deadly weapons, pouring down on us in a torrential downpour.

lines.content: ここはもう既に“迷子”の心の領域内――この子の“[魔法|想像力]”だ。
lines.translated: We were already inside the domain of the "Lost Child's" heart--this was her "imagination," her magic.

lines.content: ハル……っ
lines.translated: "Haru...!"

lines.content: とっさにハルを抱き寄せ、かばった。その背中に激痛が。
lines.translated: I instantly pulled Haru close, shielding her with my body. Searing pain tore through my back.

lines.content: 降り注いだ凶器のいくつかが突き刺さる。
lines.translated: Several of the raining weapons pierced into me.

lines.content: 運良くどれも急所は避けられたが、とても、とても痛かった。
lines.translated: Thankfully, none of them hit any vital spots, but it hurt. It hurt so, so much.

lines.content: ……ごめん、ごめんなさい、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ふるえる声がした。
lines.translated: Her voice was trembling.

lines.content: ど、どうしよう。ごめんなさい……私の、せいで……
lines.translated: "W-What do we do? I'm so sorry... It's all my fault..."

lines.content: 大丈夫。これくらい平気だよ
lines.translated: "It's okay. Something like this is nothing."

lines.content: なんとか笑顔を見せ、夜空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Managing to force a smile, I looked back up at the night sky.

lines.content: ――また、雨が凶器に変わり始める。きらり、きらりと鋭い光が瞬いていた。
lines.translated: --Once again, the rain was beginning to turn into weapons. Sharp glints of light were twinkling one after another.

lines.content: もうやめてくれともう一度、願った。
lines.translated: I wished once more for it to just stop already.

lines.content: だが鋭い雨は止まないし、“迷子”もそれを止める気はないようだ。
lines.translated: But the razor-sharp rain wouldn't stop, and it didn't look like the "Lost Child" had any intention of stopping it either.

lines.content: 仕方がない。
lines.translated: It can't be helped.

lines.content: 乱暴なことはできるだけ避けたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to avoid resorting to violence as much as possible.

lines.content: いつだってそうだ。
lines.translated: That was always how I felt.

lines.content: しかしそれもまた、時と場合によってしまう。
lines.translated: However, even that depended on the time and place.

lines.content: 俺はハルから離れ、“迷子”と向き合う。
lines.translated: I stepped away from Haru and faced the "Lost Child."

lines.content: ……ごめん。少し、ほんの、少しだけ……苦しい思いをさせてしまうかもしれない
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. This might... make you suffer just a little, a tiny bit."

lines.content: 深く[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids tightly.

lines.content: ……俺たちの“魔法”は、誰にも負けない“想像力”だ
lines.translated: Our "magic" is an "imagination" that yields to no one.

lines.content: いつものせりふを呪文や合い言葉のようにつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured my usual line like an incantation or a password.

lines.content: そして[まぶた|瞼]の裏で意識を集中し――“想像”を開始する。
lines.translated: And behind my closed eyelids, I focused my mind--and began to "imagine."

lines.content: ……手のひら。
lines.translated: My palm.

lines.content: 左の手のひらだ。
lines.translated: The palm of my left hand.

lines.content: ……ヒーローだ
lines.translated: "...A hero."

lines.content: 俺はつぶやく。
lines.translated: I murmured.

lines.content: ヒーローは、どこにいる
lines.translated: "Where is the hero?"

lines.content: 立ちふさがる問題を、華麗に解決して見せてくれるヒーローだ。俺たちの、味方だ。
lines.translated: A hero who would brilliantly solve the problems standing in our way. An ally to us.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た]なら、今、この状況をどんなふうにして、切り抜けるのか……。
lines.translated: If it were *you*, how would you break through this situation right now...?

lines.content: 思い浮かべたのは“拳銃”だ。
lines.translated: What I pictured in my mind was a "handgun."

lines.content: 昨晩、この手のひらの中に出現させたのと同じもの。
lines.translated: The exact same one I had materialized in the palm of my hand last night.

lines.content: 俺は引き金を絞った。
lines.translated: I squeezed the trigger.

lines.content: 銃口が一瞬光る。炸裂音。
lines.translated: The muzzle flashed for an instant. A deafening bang.

lines.content: ぬいぐるみを動けなくすればそれでいい。そして俺たちへの攻撃をやめさせたい。
lines.translated: All I needed to do was immobilize the stuffed bear. And make it stop attacking us.

lines.content: 左足を狙った弾丸は[・|想][・|像][・|通][・|り]命中した。
lines.translated: The bullet aimed at its left leg hit its mark *just as I imagined*.

lines.content: 撃たれた衝撃で吹き飛ぶぬいぐるみ。ころころ転がる。穴の開いた足からふわふわの白い綿が舞い散った。
lines.translated: The impact of the shot sent the stuffed bear flying. It tumbled head over heels across the ground. Fluffy white cotton scattered into the air from the hole in its leg.

lines.content: ごめん……。
lines.translated: I'm sorry...

lines.content: ……ごめんな
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: でもこれで終わりだ。
lines.translated: But this ends it.

lines.content: あとはぬいぐるみの中の“心”を取り出し、あさひさんのところへ戻れば俺の役割はそこで終了。
lines.translated: Now I just had to retrieve the "heart" from inside the plushie, bring it back to Asahi-san, and my role here would be finished.

lines.content: 拳銃を手のひらから消した。
lines.translated: I made the handgun vanish from my palm.

lines.content: 同時――
lines.translated: At that exact same moment--

lines.content: っ
左足に激痛がはしった。
lines.translated: A searing pain shot through my left leg.

lines.content: 思わず片膝をつく。
lines.translated: I involuntarily dropped to one knee.

lines.content: 見れば足から血が噴き出している。弾痕だった。
lines.translated: Looking down, I saw blood spurting from my leg. A bullet wound.

lines.content: たった今ぬいぐるみの足を撃ち抜いたのと、まったく同じ場所にその傷はできていたのだ……。
lines.translated: The wound had opened up in the exact same spot where I had just shot through the stuffed bear's leg...

lines.content: な、なん、だ……これは……っ
lines.translated: "W-What... is this...?!"

lines.content: 激痛にあえぎながら俺はうめいた。
lines.translated: Gasping in agony, I let out a groan.

lines.content: ……まさか。
lines.translated: No way.

lines.content: ま、まさか、ダメージをそっくりそのまま、返された……？
lines.translated: "N-No way... The damage was reflected right back at me...?!"

lines.content: むくりと起き上がるぬいぐるみ。
lines.translated: The stuffed bear slowly picked itself up.

lines.content: ナイフだ。
lines.translated: A knife.

lines.content: カッターナイフをぬいぐるみは手にしていた。いつの間にか。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the stuffed bear was holding a box cutter in its hand.

lines.content: かち、かち、かち、かち
lines.translated: Click, click, click, click.

lines.content: 刃を押し出している。
lines.translated: It was pushing out the blade.

lines.content: かち、かち、かちかちかち
lines.translated: Click, click, click-click-click.

lines.content: 静かに、無言で、長くながく、押し出している。
lines.translated: Quietly, wordlessly, pushing it out further and further.

lines.content: 襲いかかってくると思った。
lines.translated: I thought it was going to lunge at me.

lines.content: 関節などどこにもない柔らかい手で、どうやって握りしめているのかわからないそのナイフを振りかざし――
lines.translated: Brandishing that knife, which it was somehow gripping tightly in a soft paw devoid of any joints--

lines.content: まるで殺人鬼の怨霊が乗り移った[人形|おもちゃ]のように。
lines.translated: Like a toy possessed by the vengeful spirit of a serial killer.

lines.content: あるいは思春期の女の子が無自覚で動かす[人形|お友達]のように。
lines.translated: Or perhaps like a doll--a "friend"--unconsciously manipulated by an adolescent girl.

lines.content: 俺は再び手のひらに拳銃を出力させた。
lines.translated: Once again, I materialized the handgun in the palm of my hand.

lines.content: 身構える
lines.translated: I braced myself.

lines.content: その銃口をもう一度ぬいぐるみへと合わせた。
lines.translated: I aimed the muzzle at the stuffed bear once more.

lines.content: この状況を打開できるだけの案もなにも思いつかないままに。
lines.translated: Without a single idea of how to actually break through this situation.

lines.content: だが、“ぬいぐるみ”は手にしたカッターの刃先を俺には向けず……。
lines.translated: However, the "stuffed bear" didn't point the tip of the box cutter's blade at me...

lines.content: “ごめんなさい”
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: ……自分の手首に、押し当てた。
lines.translated: Instead, it pressed it against its own wrist.

lines.content: “ごめんなさい、許してください。そんなつもりじゃ、なかったの……”
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, please forgive me. I didn't mean for this to happen..."

lines.content: ぬいぐるみは刃を引いた。
lines.translated: The stuffed bear drew the blade across.

lines.content: ふわりと切り口から飛び出す真っ白な綿。
lines.translated: Pure white cotton floated softly out from the cut.

lines.content: “ああ、やっぱり。やっぱりだ。全部、ぜんぶ、私が、悪いの……”
lines.translated: "Ah, I knew it. I knew it. Everything, all of it, is my fault..."

lines.content: 自身を傷つけようと、何度も、何度も……。
lines.translated: Over and over again, it tried to hurt itself...

lines.content: “私が、私程度が、この世界に、[・|あ][・|の][・|子][・|の][・|心][・|に]、生まれてきたばっかりに……”
lines.translated: "Just because someone like me, a mere thing like me, was born into this world, *into that girl's heart*..."

lines.content: その鈍い切れ味の刃を手首に押し当て、前後に引いた。
lines.translated: It pressed the dull blade against its wrist and sawed it back and forth.

lines.content: “うう。どうして……。どうして”
lines.translated: "Ugh. Why...? Why..."

lines.content: だがその身体は傷つかない。
lines.translated: Yet its body took no real damage.

lines.content: “どうしてどうして、どうしてなんで、死ねないの……”
lines.translated: "Why, why, why, why can't I die...?"

lines.content: 取り出したカッターナイフがあまりにもなまくらだった――
lines.translated: The box cutter it had pulled out was just far too dull--

lines.content: わけでは、なく。
lines.translated: No, that wasn't it.

lines.content: 俺の手首がぱっくりと、裂けていた。
lines.translated: My own wrist had split wide open.

lines.content: 血が吹き出す。
lines.translated: Blood spurted out.

lines.content: “死ねない”
lines.translated: "I can't die."

lines.content: “死ねない”
lines.translated: "I can't die."

lines.content: “死ねないよお”
lines.translated: "I can't die..."

lines.content: ぬいぐるみが懸命にカッターナイフを引く度。
lines.translated: Every time the stuffed bear frantically dragged the box cutter across its wrist...

lines.content: じわり
lines.translated: Slowly...

lines.content: じわり
lines.translated: Slowly...

lines.content: 少しずつ傷口が広がっていく。
lines.translated: Little by little, the wound on my arm spread wider.

lines.content: どう、なってるんだっ……これはっ
lines.translated: "W-What is going on... with this?!"

lines.content: 脇の下の動脈を圧迫し出血を押さえようとする。
lines.translated: I pressed down on the artery under my arm, trying to staunch the bleeding.

lines.content: ああ、くそ……[たち|性質]が悪いっ
lines.translated: "Ah, damn it... What a nasty trick!"

lines.content: どうやら――
lines.translated: Apparently--

lines.content: “攻撃のダメージは、攻撃した者に跳ね返る”
lines.translated: "Damage from an attack is reflected back onto the attacker."

lines.content: 更に。
lines.translated: And what's more.

lines.content: “ぬいぐるみが自分を傷つけたダメージも、そのまま[・|敵]への攻撃と変わってしまう”らしい。
lines.translated: It seemed that "any damage the stuffed bear inflicts upon itself is also turned directly into an attack against its *enemy*."

lines.content: 足止めのしようが、まるでない。
lines.translated: There was no way to pin it down at all.

lines.content: だめだ。気絶でもさせてその隙に連れ帰ろうかと思っていたが……。
lines.translated: It's no use. I had been thinking of knocking it out and carrying it back while it was unconscious, but...

lines.content: 手が出せない。出しようがない。
lines.translated: I can't lay a hand on it. There's no way I can.

lines.content: 情けない話だが――
lines.translated: As pathetic as it is to admit--

lines.content: まるで格好もつかない話なのだが。
lines.translated: And as utterly uncool as it makes me look.

lines.content: 俺はすっかり混乱してしまっていた。
lines.translated: I was completely thrown into confusion.

lines.content: 少し想定外の問題にぶち当たるとすぐに冷静さを欠いてしまう。
lines.translated: The moment I run into a slightly unexpected problem, I immediately lose my composure.

lines.content: “想像力”は安定せず、出力させた拳銃はたちまち錆び付いていく。
lines.translated: My "imagination" wavered, and the handgun I had materialized quickly began to rust away.

lines.content: 憧れたヒーローにだなんてほど遠い。
lines.translated: I'm nowhere near being the hero I admired.

lines.content: ……十年前の少女たちの代わりにこの町を守ろうだなんて、とても、とても。
lines.translated: Protecting this town in place of those girls from ten years ago is completely, utterly beyond me.

lines.content: ここは逃走すべきだろうか。
lines.translated: Should I just run away for now?
If I escape from the "Lost Child's" territory *and return to the "Bed of Dreams," I can have Asahi-san heal these wounds*.

lines.content: 今はいったん退くしかないか。
lines.translated: Do I have no choice but to retreat for the moment?

lines.content: じわりと一歩、後退したところで……。
lines.translated: Just as I slowly took a single step back...

lines.content: 雨だ。
lines.translated: Rain.

lines.content: また雨が降り始めた。
lines.translated: It started raining again.

lines.content: “迷子”の“心”
lines.translated: The "heart" of the "Lost Child."

lines.content: つらつらつらりと、文字が降る。
lines.translated: Words came pouring down in a steady stream.

lines.content: この場所だけではない。
lines.translated: And not just in this spot.

lines.content: 町全体に――“夜の国”全体に降り注ぎ始める。
lines.translated: It was beginning to pour down over the entire town--over the entire "Land of Night."

lines.content: “迷子”の“魔法効果範囲”が広がり始めていた。
lines.translated: The "Lost Child's" "magical area of effect" was starting to expand.

lines.content: 広い。あまりにも広大だ。
lines.translated: It's wide. Far too vast.

lines.content: その“心”は“夜”に堕とされ――もう完全に、立派に、人の心を食い潰す悪い夢……“悪夢”と化していた。
lines.translated: That "heart" had fallen into the "Night"--and had now completely, thoroughly turned into a bad dream that devours people's hearts... a "Nightmare."

lines.content: このまま逃走すれば“[悪夢|迷子]”の降らせる雨に当てられ、“夜”の町が崩壊してしまうかもしれない。
lines.translated: If I run away now, the town of the "Night" might collapse under the rain brought down by this "Nightmare."

lines.content: もう退くに退けなくなってしまった。今ここで俺がこの暴走を止めるしかない。
lines.translated: I can no longer afford to retreat. I have no choice but to stop this rampage right here, right now.

lines.content: ……深呼吸。
lines.translated: Deep breath.

lines.content: 覚悟を決めろ。
lines.translated: Steel yourself.

lines.content: 逃走の選択はもうない。
lines.translated: Running away is no longer an option.

lines.content: 弱点を探せ。
lines.translated: Find a weakness.

lines.content: 何か。何かあるはずだ。
lines.translated: Something. There has to be something.

lines.content: よくよく相手を観察しろ。
lines.translated: Observe the enemy closely.

lines.content: “無敵”なように見えても、そんなもの、そうそうあり得ていいはずがないのだから……。
lines.translated: Even if it looks "invincible," there's no way something like that could actually exist so easily...

lines.content: ぬいぐるみが一歩、こちらへ踏み出した。
lines.translated: The stuffed bear took a step toward me.

lines.content: “ねえ、どうして”
lines.translated: "Hey, why..."

lines.content: よろよろと、右足を引きずるように……。
lines.translated: Tottering unsteadily, dragging its right leg...
"Do you know? *Who am I*...?"

lines.content: 俺は、出血の止まらない手首を押さえたまま、後退するしかないのだが……。
lines.translated: Clutching my wrist to stop the endless bleeding, all I could do was back away, and yet...

lines.content: よろよろと歩く、そんな“ぬいぐるみ”の姿を見て、ふと、冷静さが戻って来た。
lines.translated: Watching the "stuffed bear" totter forward like that, my composure suddenly returned.

lines.content: ……そうか。よくよく観察してみると
lines.translated: "...I see. Now that I look closely..."

lines.content: 弱点が、わかった。
lines.translated: I figured out its weakness.

lines.content: いや……。
lines.translated: No...

lines.content: 今はまだ予測にしかすぎないが……。
lines.translated: Right now, it's still nothing more than a guess, though...

lines.content: 試してみる価値くらいは、あるか
lines.translated: "It's at least worth a shot, huh?"

lines.content: 手のひらの拳銃をカッターナイフへと俺は変化させた。
lines.translated: I transformed the handgun in my palm into a box cutter.

lines.content: ぬいぐるみが持っているものとまったく同じ。
lines.translated: An exact replica of the one the stuffed bear was holding.

lines.content: そうして出現させた刃を、俺は、自分の首に添えた。
lines.translated: Then, I brought the materialized blade up to my own neck.

lines.content: なにやってるの大雅くん！
lines.translated: "What are you doing, Taiga-kun?!"

lines.content: 背後でハルが叫ぶ。
lines.translated: Haru screamed from behind me.

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: 振り返らず、言った。
lines.translated: Without looking back, I spoke.

lines.content: ……もしも俺に何かあったら、予想が外れて、失敗、してしまったら
lines.translated: "...If something happens to me--if my guess is wrong, and I fail..."

lines.content: 失敗？　失敗って……どういうことなの？
lines.translated: "Fail? What do you mean... by fail?"

lines.content: こっちを向いてちゃんと話して、と不安そうなハルの声。
lines.translated: Haru's anxious voice pleaded with me to turn around and explain properly.

lines.content: ごめんなハル。もしも何かあったら、俺のことは構わなくていい。ハルは急いであさひさんのところへ戻るんだ。そして助けを呼んできてほしい
lines.translated: "Sorry, Haru. If anything happens, don't worry about me. I need you to hurry back to Asahi-san's place. And I want you to call for help."

lines.content: そ、そんな……っ、何かあったらってっ。大雅くんを置いてなんかっ
lines.translated: "N-No way...! What do you mean, 'if anything happens'?! I could never leave you behind, Taiga-kun!"

lines.content: いいから
lines.translated: "Just do it."

lines.content: でも……
頼むよ
lines.translated: "I'm counting on you."

lines.content: ハル。お願いだ
lines.translated: "Haru. Please."

lines.content: ……う、うん
lines.translated: "...O-Okay."

lines.content: ハルには無理矢理うなずいてもらい、俺は――
lines.translated: Having practically forced Haru to nod, I--

lines.content: ……気分、最悪だ
lines.translated: "...This feels awful."

lines.content: ――右足を不自由そうに引きずっているぬいぐるみを見据え、俺は……、
lines.translated: --Fixing my gaze on the stuffed bear awkwardly dragging its right leg, I...

lines.content: たぶん――
lines.translated: "Maybe--"

lines.content: ……俺は。

lines.translated: "*That right leg of yours is my pain, isn't it? Right?*"

lines.content: 自分の首を、切り裂いた。
lines.translated: I slashed my own throat.

lines.content: “あ、あああああああああっ”
lines.translated: "A-Aaaaaaaaaaaah?!"

lines.content: 叫んだのは“迷子”のほうだ。
lines.translated: The one who screamed was the "Lost Child."

lines.content: “血、血がっ、いたいっ、いたい……っ”
lines.translated: "B-Blood, it hurts, it hurts...!"

lines.content: “迷子”は、“悪夢”は――泣き崩れるように膝を突く。
lines.translated: The "Lost Child"--the "Nightmare"--dropped to its knees as if collapsing in tears.

lines.content: ごめんな。俺、着地を失敗しちゃったんだ
lines.translated: "Sorry about that. I messed up my landing earlier."

lines.content: 俺は更に深く刃を首に突き立てる。
lines.translated: I drove the blade even deeper into my neck.

lines.content: 右足――痛いよな。まともに歩けないくらい。足を、引きずってしまうくらい
lines.translated: "Your right leg--hurts, doesn't it? Enough that you can't even walk properly. Enough to make you drag it along."

lines.content: “あ、あ、ああ……”
lines.translated: "Ah, aah, aaaah..."

lines.content: 弱々しくなる声。
lines.translated: Its voice grew weaker and weaker.

lines.content: トドメとばかりに、俺はナイフを勢いよく引いた。
lines.translated: As a finishing blow, I yanked the knife across with full force.

lines.content: するとぬいぐるみの[綿|中身]が、ぽふんと、破裂するみたいに弾んで散った。
lines.translated: With a soft pop, the stuffed bear's stuffing burst apart and scattered into the air.

lines.content: その中心に光るものがある。蛍のような小さな光。
lines.translated: At the center of it all, something was glowing. A tiny light, like a firefly.

lines.content: “心”だ。
lines.translated: A "Heart."

lines.content: 痛烈な真昼の世界が耐えられず“迷子”となり。
lines.translated: A tiny "Heart" that couldn't bear the harsh world of midday and became a "Lost Child."

lines.content: 夢見るようなやさしい真夜中の世界で“悪夢”となった、小さな“心”
lines.translated: And in the dreamy, gentle world of midnight, it turned into a "Nightmare."

lines.content: 十夜に持たせてもらった鞄から、“悪夢”回収用の鳥かごを取り出そうとした。
lines.translated: I reached into the bag Toya had given me to pull out the birdcage meant for collecting "Nightmares."

lines.content: あ、あれ……？
……くらりと、した。
lines.translated: A wave of dizziness washed over me.

lines.content: なんだ？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: まだ、終わっていない？　まだ何か……起こるのか？
lines.translated: Is it not over yet? Is something else... about to happen?

lines.content: 心の中で嘆息する。
lines.translated: I sighed inwardly.

lines.content: だがそうではない。ただの出血多量。
lines.translated: No, that wasn't it. It was just severe blood loss.

lines.content: 足からの出血だ。
lines.translated: Bleeding from my leg.

lines.content: 視界が揺れる。
lines.translated: My vision swayed.

lines.content: 夢の世界と繋がっている“夜”の中で、肉体的な問題に振り回されるだなんて笑えもしない冗談だ……。
lines.translated: Being at the mercy of physical limitations inside the "Night," which is connected to the world of dreams, was a joke I couldn't even laugh at...

lines.content: まあ、身体を持ち込んでるんだから、それもまた、当然、か……
lines.translated: "Well, since I brought my real body in here, I guess... it's only natural..."

lines.content: 視界がとぎれる。
lines.translated: My vision began to cut out.

lines.content: ここで死ぬのかなあ、なんてそう思う。
lines.translated: I found myself wondering if I was going to die right here.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: そっか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: これが、俺の願い――？
lines.translated: Is this my wish--?

lines.content: 思いつける限りの、最も凄惨な、残酷な、死に方……だろうか。
lines.translated: Is this the most gruesome, cruelest way to die... that I could possibly think of?

lines.content: うーん。違うなあ。まだ、まだまだ、足りない。足りないなあ。
lines.translated: Hmm. No, that's not it. It's still, still not enough. Not nearly enough.
*Yeah, that's right.*
*Just when I finally became free... Just when I finally managed to make up my mind.*
*There's no way I can afford to die like this... Not yet, not by a long shot...*

lines.content: なんてことを、思っていると……。
lines.translated: Just as those thoughts crossed my mind...

lines.content: 誰かの声が。
lines.translated: Someone's voice.

lines.content: 誰かの泣き顔が。
lines.translated: Someone's tear-stained face.

lines.content: 薄らと……。
lines.translated: Faintly...

lines.content: 見えた気が、したのだった。
lines.translated: I felt like I could see them.
"...*Ten seconds*."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I open my eyelids.
*The "stuffed bear" was tottering and stumbling its way toward me.*

lines.content: ……なるほど。
lines.translated: I see.
*My prediction was spot on.*
*So doing this is the right answer, huh?*
*I pressed the blade against my own neck.*
"*What are you doing, Taiga-kun?!*"
*Haru screamed.*
*It was the exact same future scene I had previewed behind my eyelids.*

lines.content: 攻撃してもだめだ。そのダメージが跳ね返される
lines.translated: "Attacking it won't work. The damage just gets reflected back."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……だけど、逆だ。この子は他人の痛みを自分のものにしてしまうみたいなんだ。それが弱点といえば、弱点だ
lines.translated: "...Actually, it's the opposite. It seems this kid takes on other people's pain as its own. If it has a weakness, that's it."

lines.content: 他人の痛みを？
lines.translated: "Other people's pain?"

lines.content: ああ。……きっと、本当はとてもやさしい子だったんだよ。きっとね
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...I bet they were actually a really kind kid. I'm sure of it."

lines.content: 着地で痛めた捻挫のダメージが、いつの間にかなくなってしまっている。
lines.translated: The damage from the sprain I got when I messed up my landing had vanished before I knew it.

lines.content: 代わりに“迷子”が足を、右足を引きずりながら歩いていた。
lines.translated: In exchange, the "Lost Child" had started dragging its right leg as it walked.

lines.content: それを見て“もしや”と感じた。
lines.translated: Seeing that made me think, "Could it be?"

lines.content: “無敵”などこの世に存在するはずがない。弱点は必ずあるはず。
lines.translated: There's no such thing as "invincible" in this world. There always has to be a weakness.

lines.content: その視点で見ると、この“悪夢”は他人の痛みを自分のものにしてしまう、そんな“心の悪癖”――あえて悪癖と呼ぼう――が、あったのではないか。
lines.translated: Looking at it from that angle, didn't this "Nightmare" have a "bad habit of the heart"--and I'll dare to call it a bad habit--of taking on other people's pain as its own?

lines.content: その癖が自分を苦しめ、苦しめ抜いて、“夜”に堕ち――“悪夢”と化してしまったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe that habit tormented them, pushed them to the brink, caused them to fall into the "Night"--and turned them into a "Nightmare."

lines.content: そう思い至った。
lines.translated: That was the conclusion I came to.

lines.content: だがすべては予測でしかない。
lines.translated: Even so, it was all nothing more than a guess.

lines.content: だからまずは、“十夜から借りた力”を使い、自分の予想を確かめてみることにした。
lines.translated: So first, I decided to use the "power I borrowed from Toya" to test out my theory.

lines.content: ……十秒よりもだいぶ長かったかもしれないな。十夜。そんなに長くキスしてくれたっけ
lines.translated: "...That might've been way longer than ten seconds, huh? Toya. Did you really kiss me for that long?"

lines.content: え……？　キス？　十秒？
lines.translated: "Eh...? A kiss? Ten seconds?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。……大丈夫。これで問題ないんだ。いや。こうすることが、正解なんだ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. ...It's fine. There's no problem with this. No, doing this is the right answer."

lines.content: 大雅くん？　何を、言ってるの……？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun? What are you talking about...?"

lines.content: ……さすがに自傷行為はリスクが高い。そこまで無謀にはなりきれない
lines.translated: "...Cutting myself is obviously a huge risk. Even I can't bring myself to be quite that reckless."

lines.content: 俺にはまだやるべきことがある――俺には、助け出したいひと達が、いる。
lines.translated: I still have things I need to do--there are still people I want to save.

lines.content: だからほんの少しだけ、未来を盗み見た
lines.translated: "So I took a tiny peek into the future."

lines.content: ……もう過去の自分ほどは死にたがりではない。
lines.translated: I'm not as eager to die as I used to be.

lines.content: 十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 前回は回避に。
lines.translated: Last time, it was for evasion.

lines.content: 今回は、予測のために。
lines.translated: This time, it was for prediction.

lines.content: 俺は十夜から借りた力を使った。
lines.translated: I used the power I borrowed from Toya.

lines.content: 大雅くん。ちゃんと説明して欲しいよ。何が、なんだか……わからないよ
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. I want you to explain this properly. I don't... understand what's going on at all."

lines.content: この問題を突破する方法を見つけたぞって話だよ
lines.translated: "I'm saying I found a way to break through this situation."

lines.content: だけど、ハル。俺、出血多量でさ、そろそろ気を失っちゃうみたいだから……ごめん。後は、頼んだ
lines.translated: "However, Haru. I've lost a lot of blood, and it looks like I'm about to pass out soon... Sorry. I'm leaving the rest to you."

lines.content: 振り返ったハルに苦笑いでそう伝え、“悪夢”と向き合う。
lines.translated: Glancing back, I gave Haru a wry smile as I told her that, then turned to face the "Nightmare."

lines.content: ……さあ、行くぞ
lines.translated: "...Alright, here we go."

lines.content: 大丈夫。未来は知ってる。
lines.translated: It's okay. I know the future.

lines.content: 覚悟を、決めろ。
lines.translated: Steel yourself.

lines.content: 深呼吸――
lines.translated: Take a deep breath--

lines.content: 俺は、刃を握った手に力を込めて、
lines.translated: I gripped the blade tightly,

lines.content: 自分の喉を、切り裂いた――
lines.translated: and slashed my own throat--

lines.content: そうして[まぶた|瞼]の裏の未来を確定させる。
lines.translated: Locking in the future I had seen behind my eyelids.

lines.content: 暗闇の中。誰かの声がする。
lines.translated: In the darkness, I heard someone's voice.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]の裏で見た未来と同じ。
lines.translated: Just like the future I saw behind my eyelids.

lines.content: 誰の声だろう。
lines.translated: Whose voice is that?

lines.content: いや。誰の声、だなんて。
lines.translated: No. Why am I even asking whose voice it is?

lines.content: ちゃんとわかっていた。
lines.translated: I knew full well who it was.

lines.content: だから今度はしっかり聞こうと思った。
lines.translated: So this time, I decided to listen closely.

lines.content: 大雅……、大雅っ
lines.translated: "Taiga... Taiga!"

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: いやだよ大雅っ、大雅、どうしてこんなっ、無茶ばかり……っ
lines.translated: "No, Taiga! Taiga, why do you always do... such reckless things...?!"

lines.content: クロが、叫んでいた。
lines.translated: Kuro was crying out.

lines.content: いつもつんとそっぽを向くばかりの君なのに。
lines.translated: Even though you're always pouting and looking away from me.

lines.content: 倒れた俺のことを抱きしめてくれながら。
lines.translated: You were holding my collapsed body tightly in your arms.

lines.content: きみが、いなくなってしまったら、わたしは……わたしっ、どうしたら……いいのっ
lines.translated: "If you were to disappear, what... what am I supposed to do...?!"

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: こんなところにまで、駆けつけてくれてたのか。
lines.translated: You came rushing all the way out to a place like this for me?

lines.content: 俺のピンチを敏感に察知して……。
lines.translated: Sensing that I was in danger...

lines.content: 帰りの“鍵”も持たずに。
lines.translated: Without even bringing a "Key" to get back.

lines.content: “夜”の中に閉じこめられて、帰れなくなってしまうかも、しれないのに……。
lines.translated: Even though you might get trapped inside the "Night" and never be able to return...

lines.content: こんな、ところにまで……。
lines.translated: All the way out to a place like this...

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: いつでも、どこにでも、君は、駆けつけてきてくれる。見守っていてくれる。
lines.translated: Anytime, anywhere, you always come running for me. You're always watching over me.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 大雅……大雅……血が、いっぱいだ……
lines.translated: "Taiga... Taiga... There's so much blood..."

lines.content: 君は泣いていた。
lines.translated: You were crying.

lines.content: 涙が、ぽろぽろ。
lines.translated: Tears fell, drop by drop.

lines.content: 冷たい。
lines.translated: Cold.

lines.content: そう、思った。
lines.translated: That was what I thought.

lines.content: 痛いとも、思った。
lines.translated: I also thought it hurt.

lines.content: 心が。見えない“何か”が……。
lines.translated: My heart. Some unseen "something"...

lines.content: ずきずき、ずきずき。
lines.translated: Throbbing, throbbing.

lines.content: とても、とても、痛いのだ。
lines.translated: It hurt so, so much.

lines.content: だめだ。いやだ。
lines.translated: No. I hate this.

lines.content: ……泣かないで
lines.translated: "...Don't cry."

lines.content: こんな未来は、知らなかったんだ。
lines.translated: I didn't know about a future like this.

lines.content: ……こんなことなら
lines.translated: "...If I had known it would turn out like this..."

lines.content: 君が、泣いてしまうのなら。
lines.translated: If I had known it would make you cry...

lines.content: ……こんな未来、なら、選ばなかったのに
lines.translated: "...I never... would have chosen a future like this."

lines.content: 俺の“心”は世界から切り離された。
lines.translated: My "heart" was severed from the world.

lines.content: その“魔法”は本当に、君らに必要なものなのかな
lines.translated: "Is that 'magic' truly something you all need?"

lines.content: 春に華やぐ“夜”の町。“参禅町”
lines.translated: The town of "Night," blooming in the spring. "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: そこに降り立つ俺たちを待っていた“夜の魔法使い”は穏やかな声でそう言った。
lines.translated: Waiting for us as we set foot there, the "Magician of the Night" spoke to us in a gentle voice.

lines.content: 隣に寄り添うクロの手を俺は握った。
lines.translated: I took Kuro's hand as she stayed close beside me.

lines.content: “夜”の魔法使い。陽向井あさひ。その根城。
lines.translated: The Magician of the "Night." Hinamukai Asahi. Her stronghold.

lines.content: それこそが俺たちの旅の終着地。
lines.translated: That was the final destination of our journey.

lines.content: ……俺たちはここに、呼び寄せられた。それぞれの“願い”を叶えるそのために。
lines.translated: We had been summoned here. In order to grant our respective "wishes."

lines.content: ……君らに問いたいことは山とある。[・|共][・|に][・|学][・|び][・|た][・|い][・|こ][・|と][・|も][・|だ]。そして、君らが、私に、語り聞かせてほしいことも
lines.translated: "...There is a mountain of things I wish to ask you all. And things I wish to learn together with you. As well as things you likely want me to tell you."

lines.content: だがその前に、おそらくは何も知らないだろう君たちに、この時間のことを……
lines.translated: "Before that, however, since you probably know nothing at all, I want to tell you about this time..."

lines.content: この“[世界|夜の国]”についてのことを、私から、君たちへ、伝えておきたいと思う
lines.translated: "I would like to tell you all about this 'world'--this 'Land of the Night.'"
Yes. "You all."

lines.content: 夢を見るためのこの[場所|寝床]には、俺やクロの他にも多くの子ども達がいた。
lines.translated: In this place--this "bed" for dreaming--there were many other children besides Kuro and me.

lines.content: 柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 杏藤千和。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: 夜月姫織。
lines.translated: Yotsuki Himeori.

lines.content: 兎蛙智仁。
lines.translated: Toa Tomohito.
And, one more person.

lines.content: 誰もがいくつもの“夜”を通り抜け……、
lines.translated: Every one of us had passed through countless "Nights"...

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれの道を経て。
lines.translated: Each of us having walked our own path.

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれの道を求めて。
lines.translated: Each of us seeking our own path.

lines.content: この場所に、“魔法使い”の手によって[・|召][・|喚]されていた。
lines.translated: We had been summoned to this place by the hand of the "Magician."

lines.content: まずはようこそと言っておこうか……ようこそ、子ども達。我が町の、[・|我][・|が][・|刻][・|の]、漆黒の裏側へ
lines.translated: "First, allow me to welcome you... Welcome, children. To the pitch-black underside of my town, of my time."

lines.content: ……そして、ありがとう。いい子たち。私の呼びかけに応えてくれて
lines.translated: "...And thank you, good children. For answering my call."

lines.content: どうか君たちの未来に、幸せな“魔法”がありますようにと祈ってる
lines.translated: "I pray that there will be happy 'magic' in your futures."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: The "Mage" smiled.

lines.content: 俺たちが集められたのは古めかしい民宿のような施設、その談話室――いわゆる居間だ。奥座敷。
lines.translated: We were gathered in the lounge of an old-fashioned, inn-like facility--what you'd call a living room. The back parlor.

lines.content: 万年床ならぬ万年ごたつを囲んで座った子ども達を前に、“魔法使い”は――“夜”の管理者は、にこりと微笑む。
lines.translated: Standing before the children seated around an ever-present kotatsu, the "Magician"--the Administrator of the "Night"--offered a warm smile.

lines.content: と、まあ。気恥ずかしいようなご挨拶はここまでかな。時間も引き延ばされて無限にあるかのように見え、[・|こ][・|こ][・|で][・|も]、[・|外][・|で][・|も]、有限だ
lines.translated: "Well, then. That's enough of the embarrassing greetings. Even though time is stretched out and seems infinite, both here and outside, it is finite."

lines.content: まるで、教卓を前に[べん|鞭]を振るう教師のように、そのひとは語り始めた。
lines.translated: Like a teacher brandishing a pointer before a lectern, she began to speak.

lines.content: 私は、この町に横たわる“夜”の管理者のひとりにして、“夜の魔法使い”、陽向井あさひだ
lines.translated: "I am one of the Administrators of the 'Night' that lies across this town, and the 'Magician of the Night,' Hinamukai Asahi."

lines.content: 選ばれし君たちに特別な時間を与える者であり……同時に、その資格が君らに果たしてあるのかどうか。それを審判する者でもある
lines.translated: "I am the one who grants special time to you, the chosen ones... and at the same time, the one who judges whether or not you truly possess the qualifications for it."

lines.content: そのために、まずは君らは充分に学ばなければならない。その項目がここにはずらりと用意されている
lines.translated: "To that end, you must first learn a great deal. The subjects you need to study are all lined up right here."

lines.content: “魔法使い”はそう言って、悪戯っぽく笑っていた――“選ばれし君たち”“特別な力を与えし者”
lines.translated: Saying that, the "Magician" laughed mischievously--"you, the chosen ones," "the one who grants special power."

lines.content: あの頃の俺たちはまだ、このひとが、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]こじらせてしまっているひとなのだと知らなかった。
lines.translated: Back then, we didn't yet know that she was the kind of person who had developed a bit of a melodramatic streak like that.

lines.content: だから真剣に、ともすれば浮き足立つようなその高説に耳を傾けていた。
lines.translated: So we listened earnestly to her lofty speech, practically on the edges of our seats.

lines.content: ここは、“夜の国”。すべての願いが叶えられる国
lines.translated: "This is the 'Land of the Night.' A land where all wishes can be granted."

lines.content: 君らの時間でも太陽が傾けば夜が来る。そうだな？　太陽が沈み、月が目覚める――瞬く間に静かな闇が辺りを染める
lines.translated: "In your time as well, when the sun dips low, night falls. Right? The sun sets, and the moon awakens--in the blink of an eye, a quiet darkness dyes the surroundings."

lines.content: そうすればここも、もうひとつの“夜”も、君らの町の裏側に……同時に目覚める
lines.translated: "When that happens, this place, this other 'Night,' awakens on the underside of your town... at the exact same time."
It is--

lines.content: その“特別”な時間は、
lines.translated: That "special" time is--

lines.content: この町で眠るすべての人々の心に、いつも隣り合わせで繋がっており……。
lines.translated: Always connected, side by side, to the hearts of everyone sleeping in this town...
And it is also a place where you can freely purchase the dreams you will see tonight.

lines.content: そして“夜の国”の一番の特徴はというと……。
lines.translated: And as for the greatest defining feature of the "Land of the Night"...
"Within this other 'Night,' limited only to those who have managed to bring their physical bodies inside--"

lines.content: 頭で、心で、思い描いたすべての[・|光][・|景]が形となって現れる。そういう性質を持つ刻の中に、“[ここ|ゆめのねどこ]”はある
lines.translated: "Every scene you envision in your mind and in your heart will take shape and manifest. 'This place'--the 'Bed of Dreams'--exists within a time that possesses that sort of nature."

lines.content: ここはすべてが叶う不思議の国だ。
lines.translated: This is a wonderland where anything can come true.

lines.content: 銀河を駆ける流れ星のように、夜空を一足飛びで駆け抜けてみたり。
lines.translated: You could leap across the night sky in a single bound, like a shooting star racing through the galaxy.

lines.content: 炎を操り。大気を凍らせ。鋭い光の槍を大地深く突き刺し落とす――そのようなある種、幼稚とも言える安易な[・|も][・|の]も可能に出来る。
lines.translated: Manipulating flames. Freezing the atmosphere. Driving sharp spears of light deep into the earth--even things that could be called somewhat childish and simplistic are made possible here.

lines.content: ここでは好きな自分になれるのだ。今を好きな時間に、できるのだ。
lines.translated: Here, you can become whoever you want to be. You can make the present into whatever time you like.

lines.content: 自在に夢の中を飛び回る感覚だ。
lines.translated: It feels like flying freely through a dream.

lines.content: それはまるで、明晰夢。
lines.translated: Just like a lucid dream.

lines.content: 毎夜見る夢の光景を自在に、思うまま、操作できてしまえる感覚に良くよく似ている。
lines.translated: It closely resembles the sensation of being able to freely manipulate the scenes of the dreams you have every night, entirely at will.

lines.content: 想像力だ
lines.translated: "It is imagination."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: The "Magician" said.

lines.content: 君らの“魔法”は、誰にも負けない“想像力”だ
lines.translated: "Your 'magic' is an 'imagination' second to none."

lines.content: “夜”の中で思い描けるその“想像力”の強さこそが“魔法”の強さに比例する。
lines.translated: The strength of the "imagination" one can envision within the "Night" is directly proportional to the strength of their "magic."

lines.content: そして……、
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: そのような“夜”の中で。
lines.translated: Within such a "Night."

lines.content: そのような“力”を利用し。
lines.translated: Utilizing such "power."

lines.content: ……君らにはいずれ、この“夜”の中に訪れるであろう最大の“悪夢”と……
lines.translated: "...Eventually, you will have to face the greatest 'Nightmare' that will visit this 'Night'..."

lines.content: 私たちが“夜の王”と名付けた巨大な“悪夢”と、戦ってもらわなければならない。……私と、一緒に。文字通り力を合わせて
lines.translated: "You will have to fight the colossal 'Nightmare' that we have named the 'King of the Night.' ...Together with me. Literally joining our strength together."

lines.content: その[・|戦][・|争]を無事に乗り切ることが叶ったなら……。
lines.translated: And if we managed to safely survive that war...

lines.content: 思うがままの、思い描くがままの“魔法”を……たったひとつだけだ。君らが“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”の下に持ち帰ることを許可しよう
lines.translated: "I shall permit you to bring back... just one 'magic' of your choosing, whatever you envision, beneath the 'Time of the Sun'--the real world."

lines.content: それが選ばれし者である君たちに手渡せる交換条件だと“魔法使い”は言う――
lines.translated: The "Magician" told us that was the condition of the trade she could offer to us, the chosen ones--
The condition of the trade.

lines.content: それこそを求めて、この“夜”の中に俺たちはやって来た。
lines.translated: Seeking that very thing, we had come into this "Night."

lines.content: そうだ。ここに集められた俺たちはみんな、望んで戦争に参加したけれど……、
lines.translated: That's right. All of us gathered here had willingly joined the war, and yet...

lines.content: 誰もが進んで、その戦いそのものに手を挙げたいわけでは、なかった。
lines.translated: None of us had actually wanted to volunteer for the fighting itself.

lines.content: いずれ現れる“夜の王”は、この“夜”を通じて人々の夢を、心を、食い荒らしてしまうと言われてる
lines.translated: "It is said that the 'King of the Night' who will eventually appear will devour people's dreams and hearts through this 'Night.'"

lines.content: そして知らず知らずの間に壊されてしまった心は、静かに、人類全体の傷となり広がっていき――そう遠くもない未来。君たち人類は
lines.translated: "And the hearts destroyed without anyone realizing will quietly spread as a wound across all of humanity--and in a future not so far away, humanity will..."
Perish.

lines.content: 枯れ落ちる花びらのように。
lines.translated: Like withering, falling petals.

lines.content: 腐り落ちる果実のように。
lines.translated: Like rotting, falling fruit.

lines.content: ……跡形もなく。
lines.translated: Without a trace.

lines.content: 心をなくしてしまったが最後、君たちは遅かれ早かれ自滅してしまうんだよ――君たち人間の尊厳はその心ひとつにあると言ってしまっても構わないだろうからね
lines.translated: "Once you lose your hearts, sooner or later, you will destroy yourselves--after all, it wouldn't be an exaggeration to say that human dignity lies entirely within the heart."

lines.content: そんな[未来|最後]を私は回避させたい。そう祈る
lines.translated: "I want to avert such a future--such an end. That is my prayer."

lines.content: “夜の王”は滅びのはじまりなのだ。
lines.translated: The "King of the Night" is the beginning of ruin.

lines.content: この町の“夜”の中にこそ、滅びのはじまりが潜んでる――……だが、問題なのは。重要なのは。
lines.translated: Right inside the "Night" of this town, the beginning of ruin lies dormant--...However, the problem is. What's important is.

lines.content: そんな“[夜の王|悪夢]”と直接戦うことが私にはできない。“想像力”を武器とできない[・|私][・|の][・|よ][・|う][・|な][・|イ][・|キ][・|モ][・|ノ]には。それは君ら人間でなければできないことなんだ
lines.translated: "I cannot fight that 'Nightmare'--the 'King of the Night'--directly. Not for a creature like me, who cannot wield 'imagination' as a weapon. That is something only you humans can do."

lines.content: 悔しいが。情けない限りだが。君ら人間の子どもたちだけなんだよ――“夜”の中で“悪夢”と戦えるのは。繰り返すが私や[・|私][・|た][・|ち]にはそうできない
lines.translated: "As frustrating as it is. As utterly pathetic as it is. Only you human children--can fight 'Nightmares' within the 'Night.' I repeat, neither I nor the rest of us can do so."

lines.content: だから君らの力を借り受けて、共に戦う……そういう手段しか私には取れない。“夜”の魔法使いは苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: "Therefore, borrowing your strength and fighting together... is the only measure I can take." The Magician of the "Night" gave a bitter smile.

lines.content: ……“[魔法|想像力]”だよ
lines.translated: "...It is 'imagination'--'magic.'"

lines.content: “悪夢”と対抗できる方法は君らの“想像”の力に頼るほかない――
lines.translated: "The only way to stand against a 'Nightmare' is to rely on the power of your 'imagination'--"

lines.content: それは“夜の王”だけじゃない。人の心を惑わせるどんな小さな“悪夢”とだって、それと対抗できるのは……君ら人間にだけ許された唯一の“魔法”。それだけなんだよ
lines.translated: "And that doesn't just apply to the 'King of the Night.' Even against the smallest 'Nightmare' that leads a person's heart astray, the only thing that can counter it... is the sole 'magic' granted only to you humans. Nothing else."

lines.content: ……そしてこの“夜”の時間にこうして出入りできるのは、君ら人間が子どもの時だけだ。故に。私たちは幼い君らに希望を託すしかないんだよ
lines.translated: "...And it is only while you humans are children that you can come and go from this 'Night' time like this. Therefore, we have no choice but to entrust our hopes to you while you are young."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。君らに未来を託したい。“夜の魔法使い”はそう言った。
lines.translated: Yes, that's right. I want to entrust the future to you all. That was what the "Magician of the Night" said.

lines.content: いずれこの町の“夜”に現れるのだろう最大の“悪夢”……“夜の王”を君らにどうか打倒してほしい
lines.translated: "I want you all to defeat the greatest 'Nightmare' that will eventually appear in the 'Night' of this town... the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: 私の愛する人類の……君たちの未来に、平和を送り届けてあげてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "I want you to deliver peace to the future of my beloved humanity... to your own future."

lines.content: ……そうして私の願いを叶えてくれた君たちに、“夜の王”を退けてくれるだろう未来の君たちにこそ、私は、“魔法”を贈りたい
lines.translated: "...And to you who grant my wish, to the future you who will surely drive back the 'King of the Night,' I want to bestow 'magic.'"

lines.content: そのときまでに君たちは、それぞれに、きっと叶えがたい“夢”や困難を抱えているはずの、君たちは……
lines.translated: "By that time, each of you, who surely carry hard-to-grant 'dreams' and hardships of your own..."

lines.content: そんな自分自身を救い出すための、自分だけの“魔法”を、“想像”しておいてほしい
lines.translated: "I want you to have 'imagined' your very own 'magic' in order to save yourselves."

lines.content: そして……、と、“魔法使い”は言って微笑んだ。
lines.translated: "And..." the "Magician" said, smiling.

lines.content: そして君たちの“悲しみ”には、本当に、その“魔法”が必要なのか――“夜”から持ち出せる“魔法”はひとつきり。ゆっくりと、慎重に、考えておいてほしい
lines.translated: "You should also think long and carefully about whether your 'sorrow' truly requires that 'magic'--for there is only one 'magic' you can bring out from the 'Night.'"

lines.content: それが、今回の……一番はじめの“[・|夜][・|会]”で、私から君らへ贈る、最初の“[・|課][・|題]”だ
lines.translated: "That is the first 'assignment' I give to you all at this... very first 'Soiree' of ours."

lines.content: 俺たちの一番最初の邂逅はそうして終わる。
lines.translated: Our very first encounter ended just like that.

lines.content: また次の“夜”に……。“ゆめのねどこ”で、待っているよ。いい子たち。君たちの[・|答][・|え]を、いつでも私は、待っているからね
lines.translated: "Until the next 'Night'... I'll be waiting for you at the 'Bed of Dreams.' Good children. I'll always be waiting for your answers."

lines.content: そうして“魔法使い”との最初の“夜”は幕を閉じ……。
lines.translated: And so, the curtain fell on our first "Night" with the "Magician"...

lines.content: そうして、[・|そ][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|の][・|戦][・|い]に俺たちはどうしようもなく身を投じることになる――人類のためなんかじゃない。
lines.translated: And so, we found ourselves hopelessly throwing our lives into the battle for that sake--not for the sake of humanity or anything like that.

lines.content: 自分自身のどうしようもない人生を救うため。この心の中で暴れ回る“悪夢”を殺す。
lines.translated: To save our own helpless lives. To kill the "Nightmares" rampaging inside our hearts.

lines.content: その“魔法”を手に入れる。
lines.translated: To obtain that "magic."

lines.content: そしてそれぞれがそれぞれの“夢”を叶えるそのために……。
lines.translated: And so that each of us could grant our own respective "dreams"...

lines.content: そのためだけにこそ、俺たちは手を取り合って“想像”してみた。
lines.translated: For that reason alone, we joined hands and tried to "imagine."

lines.content: 自分たちを追い詰める困難は、悲しみは、その“悪夢”は。
lines.translated: The hardships cornering us, the sorrows, those "Nightmares"...

lines.content: いったいどんな“[希望|魔法]”があったなら、乗り越えていけるものなのだろうか、と。
lines.translated: Just what kind of "magic" would we need to be able to overcome them?

lines.content: 俺は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I close my eyelids.

lines.content: そして、何度だって“想像”してみる――“魔法”だ。俺には助けたいひとがいる。
lines.translated: And I try to "imagine" it over and over again--it's "magic." There is someone I want to save.

lines.content: その人の笑顔を[まぶた|瞼]の裏に探し続けた。
lines.translated: I kept searching for that person's smiling face behind my eyelids.

lines.content: その光景こそが俺の“希望”
lines.translated: That very sight is my "hope."

lines.content: その未来こそが俺の“夢”
lines.translated: That very future is my "dream."

lines.content: そんな“夢”を現実の舞台に引き寄せるには――いったいどんな“魔法”が必要なのかと、俺は何度も何度も自分自身に問いかけ続けた。
lines.translated: To pull such a "dream" onto the stage of reality--just what kind of "magic" would I need? I kept asking myself that question over and over again.

lines.content: そんな俺の手を、君が、
lines.translated: And my hand, as I did so,

lines.content: いつも側にいてくれる小さな君が、握っていてくれた。
lines.translated: was held by you, the little you who is always by my side.

lines.content: 十夜が無茶はだめだよって言ってたけど……。そのとおりだよ。大雅くんは無茶しすぎだって思う
lines.translated: "Toya told you not to do anything reckless, didn't she...? She's right. I think you push yourself way too hard, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 帰宅するなりハルから軽くお叱りを受けていた。
lines.translated: As soon as we got back, I received a light scolding from Haru.

lines.content: あのままだったら、私ひとりだったら、気を失った大雅くんを連れて帰れなかったかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "If things had kept going like that, and I'd been all by myself, I might not have been able to carry you back after you passed out, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 面目ない……
lines.translated: "I have no excuse..."

lines.content: 俺は辺りを見回した。
lines.translated: I looked around.

lines.content: “魔法使い”の工房。あさひさんの部屋。
lines.translated: The workshop of the "Magician." Asahi-san's room.

lines.content: 治療をするためここへ運び込まれていた。
lines.translated: I had been carried here to receive treatment.

lines.content: だが、クロの姿が見当たらない。
lines.translated: However, Kuro was nowhere to be seen.

lines.content: 意識が途切れる前に見たクロの泣き顔。
lines.translated: The tearful face of Kuro that I saw right before losing consciousness.

lines.content: ……ずきり。
lines.translated: Throb.

lines.content: 胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: My chest ached.

lines.content: とにかくだめだよ大雅くん。もうあんなこと二度としたらだめだよ。ちゃんと反省するんだよ。いい？
lines.translated: "Anyway, that's no good, Taiga-kun. You must never do anything like that ever again. Make sure you reflect on what you did. Okay?"

lines.content: 気を失った俺をクロと一緒に“ゆめのねどこ”まで運んでくれたらしい。服はどろどろだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, she had carried my unconscious body all the way to the "Bed of Dreams" together with Kuro. My clothes were covered in mud.

lines.content: ハル。治療とかは私がやっておくよ。お風呂と着替えを済ませて来るといい。着替えの場所は十夜に聞いてほしい
lines.translated: "Haru. I'll take care of his treatment and everything. You should go take a bath and change your clothes. Ask Toya where the spare clothes are."

lines.content: はい。わかりました。……お願いします
lines.translated: "Yes, understood. ...Please take care of him."

lines.content: 今日はお風呂入ってばっかりですね、苦笑いでそういうハル。
lines.translated: "I feel like all I've been doing today is taking baths," Haru said with a wry smile.

lines.content: 心配そうに一度、俺の顔を見て部屋から出て行った。
lines.translated: Casting one last worried glance at my face, she left the room.

lines.content: 扉が閉まる。
lines.translated: The door closes.

lines.content: 沈黙。
lines.translated: Silence.

lines.content: うう。
lines.translated: Ugh.

lines.content: 少し、気まずい……。
lines.translated: It's a little awkward...

lines.content: ……はぁ
lines.translated: "...Haah."

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: 更に、気まずさが。
lines.translated: And the awkwardness only grows.

lines.content: ……あさひさん？
lines.translated: "...Asahi-san?"

lines.content: 恐る恐る、名前を呼んでみた。
lines.translated: Timidly, I tried calling her name.

lines.content: またこんな無茶をして。約束したじゃないか。無茶なことはしないって。それなのにどうして大雅はこうも簡単なことさえ聞き分けられない悪い子なんだ
lines.translated: "Doing something so reckless again. You promised, didn't you? That you wouldn't do anything reckless. So why are you such a bad boy who can't even understand something so simple, Taiga?"

lines.content: クロとハルに抱き抱えられ、運ばれた俺。
lines.translated: I had been carried here in the arms of Kuro and Haru.

lines.content: その道中でなんとか目を覚まし、“ゆめのねどこ”の扉を開いた俺だったのだけど……、
lines.translated: I'd managed to wake up along the way and opened the door to the "Bed of Dreams" myself, though...

lines.content: いくら魔法使いとはいってもな……いいか、大雅。傷を治すのだって楽じゃないだぞ。それなりに精神力とか体力とか消費するんだ
lines.translated: "Magician or not... listen to me, Taiga. Healing wounds isn't easy, you know. It takes a fair bit of mental and physical stamina."

lines.content: なあ、そこのところ、ちゃんとわかってくれてるのか
lines.translated: "Hey, do you actually understand that?"

lines.content: いたっ
lines.translated: "Ow!"

lines.content: ぺしっと頬を叩かれた。
lines.translated: She slapped a bandage onto my cheek.

lines.content: どうやらハルが張ってくれていた絆創膏が剥がれかけていたらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, the bandage Haru had put on me earlier was starting to peel off.

lines.content: それに、大雅。いったい何のために十夜から借りた力があると思ってるんだよ。危険を察知したならすぐに逃げろっていつも言ってるだろ
lines.translated: "Besides, Taiga. Just what do you think you have the power you borrowed from Toya for? I'm always telling you to run away immediately if you sense danger, aren't I?"

lines.content: ぷりぷりとするあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san was fuming.

lines.content: ……絆創膏を貼られた額。運ばれる最中に擦りむいたらしい。
lines.translated: There was a bandage stuck to my forehead. Apparently, I'd scraped it while being carried here.

lines.content: だが、そこに痛みはもう殆ど感じない。
lines.translated: However, I could barely feel any pain there anymore.

lines.content: 包帯がぐるぐると巻き付けられた手首や足の傷もだ。
lines.translated: The same went for the wounds on my wrists and legs, which were wrapped tightly in bandages.

lines.content: 私の力にも……、君ら人間の人生をサポートすることが存在証明のようなところのある私たちの力にも、限界はある。何でも可能だってわけじゃあないんだ
lines.translated: "Even my power... even the power of us whose very reason for existing is to support the lives of you humans, has its limits. It's not like we can do just anything."

lines.content: だから君らのほうが少しでも慎重であってもらわなければ、困るんだよ……
lines.translated: "So I really need you kids to be at least a little more careful, or else it puts me in a bind..."

lines.content: この町で暮らす、“心”を持った猫たちは特殊な力を持っている。
lines.translated: The cats with "hearts" who live in this town possess special powers.

lines.content: その力は、遠い昔の時代から、相棒として共に歩んできた人間たちをサポートするためにあるものだった。
lines.translated: Those powers existed to support the humans they had walked alongside as partners since ancient times.

lines.content: 我々人間には、人類という大きな括りの中にも様々な種族が存在している。
lines.translated: Among us humans, even within the broad category of humanity, various races exist.

lines.content: まず分かり易い区分けとして――黒人。白人。黄色人種。
lines.translated: First, as an easy-to-understand classification--Black people. White people. Asian people.

lines.content: 肌の色だけではない。
lines.translated: And it isn't just about skin color.

lines.content: 産まれた土地や血筋にまで特別なつながりを見いだして、部族としてひとつの文化を作り上げている。
lines.translated: People find special connections even in the lands of their birth and their bloodlines, forming tribes and building unique cultures.

lines.content: 長いながい時間をかけて様々な価値を、肉体的に、精神的に、もっともっと俯瞰的な価値基準を手にした集まり――つまり民族。
lines.translated: Groups that have spent a long, long time acquiring various values--physically, spiritually, and from an even broader perspective--in other words, ethnic groups.

lines.content: [猫たち|彼女ら]も同じだ。
lines.translated: It is the same for them--the cats.

lines.content: 『[私たち|猫たち]にもざっくりとわけて九つの種族があるんだよ』
lines.translated: "'Broadly speaking, there are nine tribes among us cats, too.'"

lines.content: ずっと昔にあさひさんが教えてくれたことを思い出してしまう。
lines.translated: I find myself remembering what Asahi-san taught me a long time ago.

lines.content: 『その九つの種族にはひとつずつ、[人間|相棒]の人生をサポートするための特殊な力が受け継がれているんだ』
lines.translated: "'Each of those nine tribes has inherited a single special power meant to support the lives of their human partners.'"

lines.content: ひとつ。[人間|主人]に未来予知をさせる能力。
lines.translated: One: the ability to grant their human master foresight of the future.

lines.content: ひとつ。[人間|主人]の負傷を治癒する能力。
lines.translated: One: the ability to heal their human master's injuries.

lines.content: 等々。
lines.translated: And so on.

lines.content: 『九つの種族に宿るすべての力は覚えていない。忘れてしまった』
lines.translated: "'I don't remember all the powers that dwell within the nine tribes. I've forgotten them.'"

lines.content: 『……ええっと、確か、“主人を助けるために数多ある異世界を渡る”、という力を持った一族がいたような、いなかったような……覚えているのはその程度だよ』
lines.translated: "'...Let's see, if I recall correctly, there might have been a clan with the power to "cross numerous other worlds in order to save their master," or maybe there wasn't... That's about as much as I remember.'"

lines.content: 『君らの言葉を借りるなら――私たちは猫であるからね。愛すべき主人以外のことはたとえ同族のことであっても興味なんてないんだよ。これっぽっちもね』
lines.translated: "'To borrow your words--we are cats, after all. We don't have the slightest bit of interest in anything other than our beloved masters, even when it comes to our own kind. Not even a little bit.'"

lines.content: 当然――というのか、同一族の猫にも、その力をどの程度扱えるか個体差がある。
lines.translated: Naturally--or perhaps obviously, even among cats of the same clan, there are individual differences in how well they can wield that power.

lines.content: 『私は包帯や絆創膏などで治療した傷を、通常の何十倍といった速度で治癒へ向かわせることができる。そんな力をその血に受け継ぐ種族の出身だ』
lines.translated: "'I can make wounds treated with bandages or plasters heal at dozens of times the normal speed. I come from a tribe that inherits that kind of power in its blood.'"

lines.content: その能力は“この町の魔法使い”としての力とはまったく別のものだ、とあさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san had said that this ability was something completely separate from her power as the "Magician of this town."

lines.content: 『まあ、うん。私の力は、正確には傷を治しているというわけじゃないんだ。[・|結][・|果][・|的][・|に][・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|な][・|る]というだけで……。ともあれ、そういうことだよ。それが私の力の使い道なんだ』
lines.translated: "'Well, yeah. Strictly speaking, my power doesn't actually heal wounds. It's just that it ends up turning out that way as a result... Anyway, that's how it is. That's how my power is used.'"

lines.content: ……[猫|彼女]らの“力”に関しての歴史や、そこにあっただろう物語やらを紐解くには、きっと長いながい言葉や時間が必要になるのだろう。
lines.translated: Unraveling the history behind the "powers" of those cats, and the stories that must have existed there, would surely require a long, long time and many words.

lines.content: だがそれは、人間と猫とのそういった関係は、もうずいぶんと昔に衰退してしまったものなのだ。
lines.translated: However, that sort of relationship between humans and cats had already faded away a very long time ago.

lines.content: きっと後生に語り継がれることはないだろうものだし、誰もそのことを知らないままに消えていく――
lines.translated: It is something that will surely never be passed down to future generations, vanishing without anyone ever knowing about it--

lines.content: ――十年前、“[特別な女の子|魔法少女]”たちが“夜”の中で最大最悪の“悪夢”と戦い、人類を救った事実と同様に。
lines.translated: --Just like the fact that ten years ago, "magical girls" fought the greatest and worst "Nightmare" within the "Night" and saved humanity.

lines.content: 残念だけど今回の件でこれ以上私たちにできることはないかな
lines.translated: "It's unfortunate, but I don't think there's anything more we can do regarding this case."

lines.content: あさひさんは[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san closed her eyelids.

lines.content: ……大雅。ハル。いつかの君たちみたいな子なら、このお店に引き留めて、長々と話をしたり一緒に食事をしたりするのもひとつの方法だろうけど……
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Haru. If it were kids like the two of you once were, keeping them here in this shop to have a long chat or share a meal together would be one way of handling it, though..."

lines.content: そうすることで“夜の国”を彷徨う“心”が“悪夢”に堕ちるのを防ぐ。
lines.translated: Doing so prevents a "heart" wandering through the "Land of Night" from falling and becoming a "Nightmare."

lines.content: それが“夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひの仕事のひとつだが……。
lines.translated: That is one of the jobs of Asahi Hinamukai, the "Magician of the Night," however...

lines.content: “夜”に心を飲み込まれ、既に“悪夢”と化してしまったものには、もう、そんなことをしても無駄なんだ
lines.translated: "For something whose heart has already been swallowed by the 'Night' and turned into a 'Nightmare,' doing that is already pointless."

lines.content: しかもそれが“心”そのものではなく、“[・|心]”[・|の][・|一][・|部]となると……だめだ。もはや手遅れだとしか言いようがない
lines.translated: "And when it isn't even the 'heart' itself, but only a 'part of a heart'... it's no good. All I can say is that it's already too late."

lines.content: そこまで言ってあさひさんは立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Having said that much, Asahi-san stands up.

lines.content: そして“鍵”をひとつ、取り出した――無論、それはごくふつうの扉を解錠するためのごくごくふつうの“鍵”ではない。
lines.translated: And then she took out a single "key"--of course, it wasn't an ordinary "key" meant for unlocking an ordinary door.

lines.content: あさひさん、どこへ……？
lines.translated: "Asahi-san, where are you...?"

lines.content: ああ、君が連れ帰ってくれた“[心|迷子]”を受け渡さなければいけない。この町の……いいや、“夜の国”の小さなちいさな神さまに
lines.translated: "Ah, I have to hand over the 'lost child' you brought back. To the tiny, tiny god of this town... no, of the 'Land of Night.'"

lines.content: あさひさんが取り出した“鍵”
lines.translated: The "key" Asahi-san had taken out.

lines.content: それは俺たちが“ゆめのねどこ”の扉を開くためのものとはデザインが少し違う。
lines.translated: Its design was slightly different from the ones we used to open the door to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: だけど、問題がひとつだけある
lines.translated: "However, there is just one problem."

lines.content: あの小さな神さまは、なぜだろな。大雅、君としかまともには話そうとしてくれない。だからまた、この仕事も君にお願いしなければならないんだ
lines.translated: "For some reason, that little god won't try to have a proper conversation with anyone but you, Taiga. So once again, I'm going to have to ask you to handle this job."

lines.content: ……あ、ああ。うん。よく考えればさ、そこのところは大雅の相棒のあの子と……クロと、同じかもな
lines.translated: "...A-Ah. Yeah. Come to think of it, she's probably just like that partner of yours in that regard... just like Kuro."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべるあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san offered a wry smile.

lines.content: 俺も苦笑いを返した。
lines.translated: I returned one of my own.

lines.content: だからさ。大雅。ごめんな、本当は怪我人に無理をさせるような真似はしたくないけど……
lines.translated: "So, yeah. Sorry, Taiga. I really don't want to push an injured person too hard, but..."

lines.content: いいえ、あさひさん。俺、行きますよ。大丈夫です
lines.translated: "No, Asahi-san. I'll go. I'm fine."

lines.content: 部屋のテーブルを見る。
lines.translated: I look over at the table in the room.

lines.content: そこには先ほど回収してきた“ぬいぐるみ”が置いてある。
lines.translated: Sitting there is the "stuffed animal" we just recovered.

lines.content: その首には赤色のチョーカーが巻かれていた。
lines.translated: A red choker was wrapped around its neck.

lines.content: それは“悪夢”を回収するときに十夜が使っていた鋼鉄の鳥かごと同じ効果を持つ。
lines.translated: It has the same effect as the steel birdcage Toya used when collecting "Nightmares."

lines.content: あさひさんの手作りのチョーカーだ。
lines.translated: It's a choker handmade by Asahi-san.

lines.content: つまり今は“悪夢”の動きを一時的に封じているような状態だった。
lines.translated: In other words, it was currently sealing the "Nightmare's" movements temporarily.

lines.content: チョーカーの効果は一晩もつかどうかである。
lines.translated: It's questionable whether the choker's effect will even last the night.
I'll take that child to the god.

lines.content: “悪夢”がまた暴れ出すその前に。
lines.translated: Before the "Nightmare" starts rampaging again.

lines.content: 朝が来て、“悪夢”が持ち主の[心|元]に帰ってしまう、その前に。
lines.translated: Before morning comes and the "Nightmare" returns to its owner's heart.

lines.content: 無茶をするなと叱った口先で、今度はすぐにでも仕事を頼まれてくれと平気で言ってる。そんな私は……どうしようもないほど矛盾だとかの塊なんだろうな。きっと
lines.translated: "Right after scolding you not to be reckless, I'm turning around and calmly asking you to take on a job right away. I must be... a hopeless mass of contradictions, huh? Surely."

lines.content: 今回は私が大雅に無茶をさせてしまった。ひとりで暴走する“悪夢”と向かい合わせてしまった。さっきはつい、君のことを叱ってしまったけれど……
lines.translated: "This time, I was the one who forced you to be reckless, Taiga. I made you face a rampaging 'Nightmare' all alone. I ended up scolding you earlier, too, even though..."

lines.content: ごめん、大雅。叱られるべきは私のほうだ――でも、大人は失敗しても、誰も中々叱ってくれない。ちょっと不便だ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Taiga. I'm the one who deserves to be scolded--but when adults mess up, nobody really scolds them. It's a little inconvenient."

lines.content: あさひさんは苦笑いを浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: 俺は言葉を詰まらせてしまう。
lines.translated: I find myself at a loss for words.

lines.content: こういう場合、年下というものも不便だ。
lines.translated: In situations like this, being younger is inconvenient, too.

lines.content: どのように声をかけていいのかわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know what to say to her.

lines.content: 偉そうに励ますのも違うような気がするし……。
lines.translated: Trying to act high and mighty to cheer her up feels wrong, too...

lines.content: だからせめて、努めて明るく振る舞うことにした。
lines.translated: So at the very least, I decided to try and act cheerful.

lines.content: 神さまに。……[・|ナ][・|ナ][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん]に、言っておきますよ
lines.translated: "I'll tell the god. ...I'll let Nana-chan know."

lines.content: ……え？　何を？
lines.translated: "...Huh? Tell her what?"

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: あんまり無愛想な態度ばっかり取ってたら、お節介焼きな家の姉がいつか泣いちゃうかもしれないぞ。だからもう少し、俺以外にも話をしてくれたらうれしいなって
lines.translated: "That if she keeps acting so unfriendly all the time, my meddlesome older sister at home might end up crying someday. So I'd be happy if she talked to people other than me a little more."

lines.content: ……なんだよ、それ
lines.translated: "...What's up with that?"

lines.content: いつから私は大雅の姉になったんだよ
lines.translated: "Since when did I become your older sister, Taiga?"

lines.content: あさひさんは唇をとがらせ――少し、ほんの少しだけ、いつものやさしい笑顔を見せてくれた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san pouted--and then showed me a little, just a tiny bit, of her usual gentle smile.

lines.content: あさひさんから受け取った“鍵”
lines.translated: The "key" I received from Asahi-san.

lines.content: それは柄の部分に星空を走る[・|鉄][・|道]が彫刻してあるものだった。
lines.translated: Its grip was carved with a railway running through a starry sky.

lines.content: 満月の刻まれた、俺たちが渡されているものとは別のもの。
lines.translated: It was different from the ones engraved with a full moon that had been given to us.

lines.content: そして俺はあさひさんから“鞄”を借りた。
lines.translated: I also borrowed a "bag" from Asahi-san.

lines.content: 肩にかけるタイプの革製の鞄だ。
lines.translated: A leather shoulder bag.

lines.content: 十夜のリュックサック同様、鞄の口に通せる大きさものなら何でも入るし、いくらでも持ち運べる。あさひさん特製の鞄だ。
lines.translated: Just like Toya's backpack, anything small enough to fit through the opening can go inside, and you can carry as much as you want. It's one of Asahi-san's special bags.

lines.content: その中に必要になるかもしれないものを詰め込む。
lines.translated: I stuff things I might need into it.

lines.content: 小さなちいさな神さまへのお土産だ。
lines.translated: Souvenirs for the tiny, tiny god.

lines.content: 大雅。[・|ナ][・|ナ][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん][・|に]“そんなものばかり食べてたら身体に毒だぞ”って伝えておいてほしいかな
lines.translated: "Taiga. Could you tell Nana-chan, 'If you keep eating nothing but that stuff, it'll ruin your health'?"

lines.content: 苦笑いで――いいや、ちょっとあきれたふうな表情であさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: With a wry smile--no, with a slightly exasperated expression, Asahi-san spoke.

lines.content: それと、気が向いたらいつでも美味しいもの作ってあげられるからなって
lines.translated: "Also, tell her that if she ever feels like it, I can whip up something delicious for her anytime."

lines.content: わかりました。伝えておきます
lines.translated: "Understood. I'll pass that along."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき――受け取った“鍵”を、あさひさんの“工房”の扉、そこにある鍵穴へと差し込んだ。
lines.translated: I nodded--and inserted the "key" I had received into the keyhole on the door to Asahi-san's "workshop."

lines.content: 気をつけて
lines.translated: "Be careful."

lines.content: あさひさんが言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke up.

lines.content: あまり長居するようなら、連絡をくれたらうれしいかな
lines.translated: "If you're going to stay long, I'd appreciate it if you contacted me."
