lines.content: 了解です。クロとハルにはちょっと出かけてくると伝えてください。あと……
lines.translated: "Got it. Please tell Kuro and Haru that I'm stepping out for a bit. Also..."

lines.content: あと？
lines.translated: "Also?"

lines.content: はい。ふたりには“ありがとう”とも伝えてもらえればうれしいです
lines.translated: "Yes. I'd be happy if you could tell the two of them 'thank you' for me, too."

lines.content: ハルが一緒にいてくれたから。
lines.translated: Because Haru stayed with me.

lines.content: クロが駆けつけてくれたから。
lines.translated: Because Kuro came running for me.

lines.content: ふたりがいたから、こうして無事でいられます。だから、ありがとうと……
lines.translated: "It's because the two of them were there that I'm safe like this. So, please tell them thank you..."

lines.content: そんなの自分で言えばいいじゃないか。ふたりだってきっとそのほうがうれしいと思うけどな
lines.translated: "Why don't you just tell them yourself? I'm sure they'd be much happier hearing it from you."

lines.content: ……もちろん。帰ったらそうしますし、“ゆめのねどこ”への帰り道で何度か伝えたような気がします
lines.translated: "...Of course. I'll do that when I get back, and I feel like I told them a few times on the way back to the 'Bed of Dreams,' too."

lines.content: 気がする？
lines.translated: "You feel like you did?"

lines.content: そのときは目が覚めたばっかりだったので、ちょっと意識が曖昧で。しっかり伝えられているかどうか自信がなくて……とにかく一言だけ、お願いします
lines.translated: "I had just woken up back then, so my head was a bit fuzzy. I'm not confident whether I managed to get it across properly... Anyway, just a quick word for now, please."

lines.content: “悪夢”がチョーカーの拘束から目覚め、また再び暴れ出してしまう前に終わらせたい。
lines.translated: I want to finish this before the "Nightmare" wakes from the choker's restraints and starts rampaging all over again.

lines.content: 故に、時間が惜しくて……。
lines.translated: Because of that, time is precious...

lines.content: ふたりに“出かけてくるよ”と挨拶をする時間もあまりない。
lines.translated: I don't even really have time to go tell the two of them that I'm heading out.

lines.content: わかった。伝えておくよ。……だけど何も言わず行ってしまったらふたりは怒るかもしれないぞ？
lines.translated: "Got it. I'll pass it on. ...Though the two of them might get mad if you leave without saying anything, you know?"

lines.content: 確かにそうかもと俺は苦笑いを浮かべながらも――
lines.translated: Thinking she might have a point, I gave a wry smile while--

lines.content: “鍵”を、使った。
lines.translated: I used the "key."

lines.content: 開いた扉のその向こう。
lines.translated: Beyond the opened door.
It was connected to a moving train car.

lines.content: がたん、
lines.translated: Clack-clack.

lines.content: がたん、
lines.translated: Clack-clack.

lines.content: 鋼鉄の車輪が線路を走る滑走音。
lines.translated: The sound of steel wheels gliding along the tracks.

lines.content: 耳をつんざくような汽笛が響いた。
lines.translated: A deafening whistle echoed out.

lines.content: 改めて……小さなあの子に、あまのじゃくな神さまによろしくな
lines.translated: "Once again... give my regards to that little girl, to that contrarian god."

lines.content: あさひさんが耳を押さえながら、少し声を大きくして、言った。
lines.translated: Covering her ears, Asahi-san raised her voice a little and spoke.

lines.content: わかりましたと笑顔で答え――
lines.translated: I answered "Understood" with a smile--

lines.content: それじゃあ、行ってきます。お夕飯までには帰れるように気をつけます
lines.translated: "Well then, I'm off. I'll make sure to be back by dinner."

lines.content: 俺は扉を閉めた。
lines.translated: I closed the door.

lines.content: しばらく列車に揺られ、終着駅で俺は下車した。
lines.translated: After swaying on the train for a while, I got off at the terminal station.

lines.content: “夜”になると廃線状態であるはずの市電が動き出す。代わりにバスの姿は殆ど見ない。
lines.translated: When "Night" falls, the streetcars that are supposed to be out of service start moving. In exchange, you barely see any buses.

lines.content: 町中に張り巡らされた線路には、市電だけではなく小型の[ＳＬ|汽車]なども走ってる。そのひとつに切符代わりのあの“鍵”で乗車し、[・|こ][・|こ]まで運んで貰った。
lines.translated: Along the tracks stretched throughout the town, not only streetcars, but also small steam locomotives and the like are running. Using that "key" in place of a ticket, I boarded one of them and had it carry me all the way here.

lines.content: 見上げれば幾つもの石段。そのてっぺんにはほんわりと“夜”を照らす光が見える。夜月神社。姫織の家だ。
lines.translated: Looking up, I see numerous stone steps. At the very top, a soft light illuminating the "Night" is visible. Yotsuki Shrine. Himeori's home.

lines.content: しかし用があるのは姫織にではない。
lines.translated: However, my business isn't with Himeori.

lines.content: 俺は一段、一段、石造りの階段を上がっていく。
lines.translated: Step by step, I climb the stone stairs.

lines.content: そして不思議なほどに、静か。虫の声さえどこか遠い。
lines.translated: And it is strangely quiet. Even the chirping of insects sounds somewhat distant.

lines.content: 今宵の“夜”は終わりが近い。太陽の気配が町を滲ませていた。
lines.translated: Tonight's "Night" is nearing its end. The presence of the sun was beginning to seep into the town.

lines.content: しかし、辺りはとても暗かった。夜明け前がもっとも“夜”は暗くなる。
lines.translated: Even so, the surroundings were pitch-black. The "Night" is at its darkest just before dawn.

lines.content: 鞄から懐中電灯を取り出し、スイッチを入れた。
lines.translated: I took a flashlight out of the bag and switched it on.

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: つい、っと何かが横を通り過ぎた。
lines.translated: Something darted right past me.

lines.content: なんだ？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 懐中電灯の光をそちらに向ける。
lines.translated: I point the beam of the flashlight in that direction.
Wait.

lines.content: 驚いた。
lines.translated: I was stunned.
A fish was swimming there.

lines.content: 宙を浮かぶように泳ぐ魚が、ぎょろりとした目でこちらを睨んだ――ような気がした。
lines.translated: Swimming as if floating in midair, the fish glared at me with bulging eyes--or so it felt.

lines.content: まっしろな魚はこぽりとひとつ、気泡を吐き出し逃げていく。
lines.translated: The pure white fish let out a single bloop of a bubble and fled.

lines.content: そしてまた、ぬらりと――
lines.translated: And then again, slithering smoothly--

lines.content: まるでリュウグウノツカイのように大きく長い身体をした魚が背後から現れ、俺のすぐ横を泳いでいき、真っ暗闇の中にその姿を消した。
lines.translated: A fish with a large, long body just like an oarfish appeared from behind me, swam right past my side, and vanished into the pitch-black darkness.

lines.content: よく見ればあちこちに魚がゆらりゆらゆらと泳いでいた。
lines.translated: Looking closely, fish were swimming lazily here and there all around me.

lines.content: ……重く静かな“夜”の中。
lines.translated: Within the heavy, silent "Night."

lines.content: ここはまるで、深く冷たい深海のようだった。
lines.translated: This place was just like the deep, freezing ocean floor.

lines.content: ふと風が吹く。
lines.translated: Suddenly, a breeze blows.

lines.content: 小さな魚の群が、ざざざざざーっと猛スピードで俺を包み、通り過ぎていった。
lines.translated: A school of small fish swarmed around me at breakneck speed with a rushing whoosh and passed right on by.

lines.content: どうやら大きな魚から逃げていく途中だったらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, they were in the middle of fleeing from a larger fish.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]はかけらだ。夢のかけら。
lines.translated: Those are fragments. Fragments of dreams.

lines.content: 昨晩、俺と十夜が“夜”の中を回収して歩いたのと、同じもの。
lines.translated: The exact same things Toya and I walked around collecting in the "Night" last night.

lines.content: ……放置しておけばいつしかそれは“悪夢”となって、眠りについた誰かの“心”に滑り込む。
lines.translated: If left alone, they will eventually turn into "Nightmares" and slip into the "heart" of someone who has fallen asleep.

lines.content: 定期的に掃除しなければ、これらは際限などないかのようにどんどん増える。
lines.translated: If we don't clean them up regularly, they will multiply endlessly, as if they know no bounds.

lines.content: そうしていつか“夜”の世界はパンクする。
lines.translated: And then someday, the world of "Night" will burst at the seams.

lines.content: すると、人々は“悪夢”ばかりを見るようになってしまう。
lines.translated: When that happens, people will end up having nothing but "Nightmares."

lines.content: ……ここも、十夜と一緒に掃除しにこなけりゃいけないかな
lines.translated: "...Maybe I'll have to come clean up around here with Toya, too."

lines.content: また少し歩く。石段を登る。
lines.translated: I walk a little further and climb the stone steps.

lines.content: 真ん中辺りまで登ったところで、目の前に糸のようなものが垂れているのに気づいた。
lines.translated: About halfway up, I noticed something like a thread dangling right in front of my eyes.

lines.content: 遙か上空からすらーっと長く。
lines.translated: It stretched straight down in a long line from far up in the sky.

lines.content: 良く見てみると糸の先には釣り針が結ばれていた。その針につけられている餌は……なんだろう。小さな光だ。
lines.translated: Looking closely, a fishhook was tied to the end of the line. And the bait attached to the hook was... what is that? A tiny light.

lines.content: その光に吸い寄せられた魚が食らいつく。
lines.translated: Drawn in by that light, a fish snapped at it.

lines.content: すると、魚はそのまま空高く引き上げられていった。
lines.translated: Immediately, the fish was reeled straight up high into the sky.

lines.content: 懐中電灯の光を、見上げた夜空に向けてみた。
lines.translated: I looked up and pointed the beam of my flashlight toward the night sky.

lines.content: 光の柱が真夜中に吸い込まれていく――
lines.translated: The pillar of light was sucked into the dead of night--

lines.content: 満点の星空が、ゆらゆら、ばしゃばしゃと、揺れていた。
lines.translated: The sky full of stars was swaying and splashing about.

lines.content: まるで釣り上げた魚が暴れ、水面に波紋が広がるみたいに。
lines.translated: Just like ripples spreading across the water's surface from a hooked fish thrashing around.

lines.content: きらきら光るあの空は、深い海の底から見上げる海面のようだった。
lines.translated: That sparkling sky looked just like the surface of the ocean seen from the deep sea floor.

lines.content: また釣り糸がするりと垂れてきた。
lines.translated: Another fishing line dropped smoothly down.

lines.content: その針先にはほんわりと淡い光を放つ星が付けられていた。
lines.translated: Attached to the tip of its hook was a star giving off a soft, faint glow.

lines.content: 飴玉だ。甘いあまい味の飴玉を餌に“悪夢の魚”を釣り上げる。
lines.translated: A piece of hard candy. Reeling in "Nightmare fish" using sweet, sugary candy as bait.

lines.content: よく見るとそれはひとつではない。
lines.translated: Looking closely, there wasn't just one.

lines.content: 辺りにいくつも糸が落とされていた。
lines.translated: Numerous lines had been dropped all around the area.

lines.content: もしあの星に触れ、間違って釣り上げられたらどこへ行くのだろう。
lines.translated: If I touched one of those stars and got reeled up by mistake, where would I end up?

lines.content: 空の上には何がある？
lines.translated: What lies above the sky?

lines.content: 俺や十夜みたいな“悪夢”の回収者が小さなボートに乗って、月明かりに照らされながら釣りをしているのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe "Nightmare" collectors like Toya and me are riding in a little boat, fishing under the moonlight.

lines.content: 夜空から垂らされた糸を避けながら、更に石段を登っていく。
lines.translated: Dodging the lines dangling from the night sky, I climb further up the stone steps.

lines.content: 階段を登り切った。すると広がる境内の光景。
lines.translated: I reached the top of the stairs. Before me spread the view of the shrine grounds.

lines.content: そこもやはり“夜”の中。いつもの風景とは違ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Naturally, this place was inside the "Night" as well. It had changed from its usual scenery.

lines.content: ぼんぼりに灯された淡い光は“夜”の闇を照らし出し……[ＳＬ|機関車]だ。
lines.translated: The faint light lit within the paper lanterns illuminated the darkness of the "Night" to reveal... a steam locomotive.

lines.content: その先頭車両と客室車両がひとつずつ、連結されたものが境内には停められていた。
lines.translated: Parked on the shrine grounds were its lead engine and a single passenger car coupled together.

lines.content: いつもなら市電の客車部分を社務所に改装したものが置かれている場所にそれはある。
lines.translated: It sat in the spot normally occupied by a streetcar passenger cabin that had been remodeled into the shrine office.

lines.content: 操縦室をのぞき込む。
lines.translated: I peer into the cab.

lines.content: だが、誰もいない。
lines.translated: However, no one is there.

lines.content: 客室車両にも明かりはなく、人の気配はなかったが……。
lines.translated: There were no lights on in the passenger car either, and no sign of anyone inside, but...

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ……車両の屋根の上。
lines.translated: Up on the roof of the train car.

lines.content: ぼんやりとした光が見えた。
lines.translated: I saw a dim light.

lines.content: ……こんなところにいたんだ
lines.translated: "...So this is where you were."

lines.content: 見上げた屋根に女の子が、ひとり。
lines.translated: Looking up, there was a single girl on the roof.

lines.content: 足をぶらぶらさせるような格好で、座っていた。
lines.translated: She was sitting there, dangling her legs over the edge.

lines.content: 光はそんな女の子の隣に置かれたランタンだった。
lines.translated: The light came from a lantern placed next to her.

lines.content: 大きめの車掌服と、その帽子。
lines.translated: An oversized conductor's uniform, and a matching hat.

lines.content: そして伸び放題の長い髪を三つ編みに結い――
lines.translated: With her long, overgrown hair tied into braids--

lines.content: 客車の屋根に腰を下ろし、空をじっと見上げていた。
lines.translated: She sat on the roof of the passenger car, gazing fixedly up at the sky.

lines.content: こんなところで、何やってるのかな
lines.translated: "What are you doing in a place like this?"

lines.content: また、問いかける。
lines.translated: I call out to her again.

lines.content: そんなところにいたら風邪ひいちゃうかもしれないよ。でも、まあ、君が風邪とか引くのかどうか。わからないけど
lines.translated: "You might catch a cold if you stay up there. Well, though I don't really know if you can even catch a cold or not."

lines.content: 少女は何も答えず夜空を見ていた。
lines.translated: The girl didn't answer at all, just watching the night sky.

lines.content: 俺もつられて空を見上げてみる。
lines.translated: Following her lead, I look up at the sky too.

lines.content: 満点の星の空。
lines.translated: A sky full of stars.

lines.content: 大きなおおきな満月が、さみしく冷たい“夜”の時間をオレンジ色に照らし出す。
lines.translated: A huge, massive full moon illuminates the lonely, freezing time of "Night" in an orange glow.

lines.content: 流れ星。
lines.translated: Shooting stars.

lines.content: ひとつ、ふたつ。
lines.translated: One, two.

lines.content: みっつ、よっつ……。
lines.translated: Three, four...

lines.content: あの星座はなんだったっけ。
lines.translated: What constellation was that again?

lines.content: ぼんやりと見知らぬ夜空を見上げながらそう思っていた。
lines.translated: I wondered to myself, blankly gazing up at the unfamiliar night sky.

lines.content: ……星を、見ていた
lines.translated: "...I was looking at the stars."

lines.content: ぽつり、と――
lines.translated: Quietly, she spoke--

lines.content: 少女のつぶやきが、沈黙に小さな穴を開けたのだ。
lines.translated: The girl's murmur poked a tiny hole in the silence.

lines.content: だから俺も、夜空を見上げたままそっと返した。
lines.translated: So, still looking up at the night sky, I gently replied.

lines.content: 星？
lines.translated: "The stars?"

lines.content: そう。星
lines.translated: "Yes. The stars."

lines.content: 少女は人差し指を星空に向けた。
lines.translated: The girl pointed her index finger at the starry sky.

lines.content: 今度は誰を、どの星に連れて行かなきゃならないのか……。想像してみてた
lines.translated: "Who I'll have to take next, and to which star... I was trying to imagine it."

lines.content: 奏大雅。あなたが、わざわざここに来るってことは……[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と][・|で][・|し][・|ょ][・|う]？
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga. For you to come all the way out here... that's what it means, right?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 俺は、うなずき――
lines.translated: I nodded--

lines.content: やっぱり君は……[・|ナ][・|ナ]ちゃんは、すごいな
lines.translated: "You really are amazing... Nana-chan."

lines.content: ――苦笑いを浮かべて見せた。
lines.translated: --and gave a wry smile.

lines.content: さすがは“夜”の[・|神][・|さ][・|ま][・|だ]。何でも全部お見通しなんだね。隠し事なんて、君にはできない
lines.translated: "Just what I'd expect from the God of the 'Night.' You see right through everything, don't you? I can't keep any secrets from you."

lines.content: ……違う
lines.translated: "...Wrong."

lines.content: 神さまなんかじゃない。と小さな女の子は言う。
lines.translated: I'm no god, the little girl says.

lines.content: ……私は、何者でもない
lines.translated: "...I am nobody."

lines.content: 自分が何者なのか知りたいだけの、ただ、ここにいるだけの、“何か”でしかない
lines.translated: "I'm nothing more than a 'something' that is simply here, only wanting to know what I am."

lines.content: だから神さまなんて呼ばないで
lines.translated: "So don't call me a god."

lines.content: うーん
lines.translated: "Hmm."

lines.content: 嫌だやめてといわれることを意地悪く続けるのも、それはもちろん、本意ではないけれど……。
lines.translated: Of course, it's not my intention to be mean and keep doing something she tells me she hates and wants me to stop, but...

lines.content: どうしてもだめかな、ナナちゃん。君のこと神さまって呼ぶと、なんでだか安心するっていうのかな……
lines.translated: "Can I really not, Nana-chan? When I call you God, how should I put it, it somehow makes me feel relieved..."

lines.content: ……だめ
女の子は目を細め、屋根の上から俺を見下ろす。
lines.translated: The girl narrows her eyes and looks down at me from atop the roof.

lines.content: その、ナナちゃんというのもやめてほしい。神さまと呼ばれるのと同じくらい……いや
lines.translated: "Um, I want you to stop calling me Nana-chan, too. Just as much as being called God... I hate it."

lines.content: そう？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Really? Why?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: いやだから、いや。[・|安][・|直]すぎるから
lines.translated: "Because I hate it, that's why. It's way too simplistic."

lines.content: そうかな。かわいいって思うけどなあ、俺
lines.translated: "You think so? I think it's cute, though."

lines.content: かわいい……
lines.translated: "Cute..."

lines.content: 顔を伏せた。
lines.translated: She cast her eyes down.

lines.content: ……頬がほんのりと赤い。
lines.translated: Her cheeks are faintly flushed.

lines.content: 照れている。
lines.translated: She's embarrassed.

lines.content: 屈、辱
lines.translated: "Hu-miliating."

lines.content: ……のかと思えば、違った。それは憤怒の表情だった。
lines.translated: Or so I thought, but I was wrong. It was an expression of sheer fury.

lines.content: その言葉、きらい
lines.translated: "I hate that word."

lines.content: ど、どうして？
lines.translated: "W-Why?"

lines.content: ……あなたの周りの女の子、みんな、私を“かわいい”と言っておもちゃにする。もみくちゃに、する。トラウマが
lines.translated: "...All the girls around you call me 'cute' and treat me like a toy. They Rumple and squish me. It's traumatic."

lines.content: ……まだまだ俺たちが小さかった頃のこと。
lines.translated: That was back when we were all still very young.

lines.content: 俺たちはよくここへ遊びに来ていた。あるいはナナちゃんの力を借りるため、度々ここへ訪れた。
lines.translated: We used to come here to play a lot. Or rather, we visited here frequently to borrow Nana-chan's power.

lines.content: “夜”の魔法使いの“ゆめのねどこ”が、もし俺たちの学校のようなものだとすれば……。
lines.translated: If the "Dream Bed" of the Magician of the "Night" was something like a school to us...

lines.content: ここはまるで託児所のようだった。
lines.translated: Then this place was just like a daycare.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは当時の俺たちよりもちっこくて。
lines.translated: Back then, Nana-chan was even tinier than we were.

lines.content: 抱きしめられたり。
lines.translated: Getting hugged tightly.

lines.content: 頬ずりされたり。
lines.translated: Getting her cheeks nuzzled.

lines.content: 挙げ句、望まぬあだ名まで付けられて――ちっこくてかわいいからとされたい放題されていた。
lines.translated: And to top it all off, even being given an unwanted nickname--because she was tiny and cute, everyone did whatever they wanted with her.

lines.content: それこそまるで“ぬいぐるみ”のような扱いだったのだ。
lines.translated: She really was treated just like a stuffed animal.

lines.content: それも、これも……。
lines.translated: All of this, and all of that...

lines.content: みんな、みんな。あなたが、奏大雅が、私を“ナナちゃん”だとか呼ぶようになったから。……“ナナちゃん”だなんて、何それ。名前なんていらないのに。屈辱だ
lines.translated: "Every single bit of it. It's because you, Kanade Taiga, started calling me 'Nana-chan.' ...'Nana-chan,' what is that supposed to be? I don't even need a name. It's humiliating."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはぎりぎりと歯ぎしりするようにしていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan looked like she was grinding her teeth in frustration.

lines.content: その様子とかわいい顔が、なんだかとても相反していて……むしろ楽しい。
lines.translated: Her behavior and her cute face contrasted so much that... it was actually kind of amusing.

lines.content: そんなナナちゃんは辺りをきょろきょろ見回して、
lines.translated: Looking around restlessly, Nana-chan said,

lines.content: ……大雅。今日はあなた以外には誰も来ていないよね
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Nobody else came with you today, right?"

lines.content: 警戒に目を細めていた。
lines.translated: She narrowed her eyes warily.

lines.content: 来てないよ。俺だけだ
lines.translated: "Nobody else came. It's just me."

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: まだ安心できないのか、きょろきょろとし続けていた。
lines.translated: Still not completely reassured, she kept glancing around restlessly.

lines.content: 抱きしめられるのも頬ずりされるのも……乱暴に振り回されてもみくちゃにされるのも、もう、たくさん。泣きたくなる
lines.translated: "Getting hugged, having my cheeks nuzzled... being swung around roughly and rumpled up, I've had enough of it all. It makes me want to cry."

lines.content: 大丈夫だよ。みんな子どもじゃないから、もうそんなことはないって思うけどな
lines.translated: "You'll be fine. None of us are little kids anymore, so I don't think that'll happen again."

lines.content: ふん
lines.translated: "Hmph."

lines.content: ぷいっとそっぽを向いた。
lines.translated: She turned her head away in a huff.

lines.content: ……いいから。さっさと用事を済ませてしまおう。私は眠いの。すごく眠い
lines.translated: "...Whatever. Let's just get your business over with quickly. I'm sleepy. Very sleepy."

lines.content: そうして帽子を目深に被った女の子……。
lines.translated: And so, this girl with her hat pulled down low over her eyes...

lines.content: 俺たちは彼女のことを“神さま”と呼んでいる。もしくは“ナナちゃん”と。
lines.translated: We call her "God." Or "Nana-chan."

lines.content: 出会った当初、何者でもない私には名前がないと言っていたそんな彼女に、確かに俺が、そう名付けたのだ。
lines.translated: When we first met, she told me that since she was nobody, she had no name. And it's true that I was the one who gave her that name.

lines.content: 彼女の住処であり相棒でもあるこのＳＬに振られた番号が七番だからだ。
lines.translated: That's because the number assigned to this steam locomotive, which is both her home and her partner, is number seven.

lines.content: 確かにそうだ。ナナちゃんの言うとおりあまりに安直だけど……。
lines.translated: It certainly is true. Just as Nana-chan says, it's way too simplistic, but...

lines.content: 幼い頃からずっとそう呼び続けている。故に。もう彼女のことを、“ナナちゃん”か“神さま”以外の名で呼ぶのも、もはや違和感しか残らない。
lines.translated: I've been calling her that ever since I was little. Because of that, calling her by any name other than "Nana-chan" or "God" now would just feel completely unnatural.

lines.content: そんな彼女は――ナナちゃんは、ナナちゃん自身が言うとおり、何者でもないのだろう。
lines.translated: She--Nana-chan, just as she says herself, is probably nobody at all.

lines.content: 人間ではない。動物ではない。植物ではない。むろん、鉱物ではあり得ない。
lines.translated: She isn't human. She isn't an animal. She isn't a plant. And of course, she couldn't possibly be a mineral.

lines.content: そんな彼女は――いつ、どこで、何のために産まれたのか……。
lines.translated: When, where, and for what purpose was she born...?

lines.content: 彼女自身でさえそれを知らない。それを知りたいといつも思ってる。
lines.translated: Even she herself doesn't know. And she always wants to find out.

lines.content: 天使や精霊、それこそ神さまとしか呼びようのない“何か”であろうと俺は感じてしまうから――だから何の奇をてらうこともなく、彼女のことを“神さま”とも呼んでいる。
lines.translated: Because I can't help feeling that she's an angel, a spirit, or "something" that can only be called a god--without trying to be clever about it, I also call her "God."

lines.content: 『気づいたらここにいた』
lines.translated: "'Before I knew it, I was here.'"

lines.content: ――出会ったばかりのナナちゃんは俺にそう言ったのだった。
lines.translated: --That was what Nana-chan told me when we had just met.

lines.content: 『……気づいたら私は、この列車と一緒にここにいて』
lines.translated: "'...Before I knew it, I was here together with this train.'"

lines.content: 『ここから、この、列車の中から一歩も外へ出られない、そんな私は……“夜”の世界を生きるすべての人たちの“心”を、渡り歩いて、生きてきた』
lines.translated: "'Unable to take even a single step outside of this place, outside of this train... I have lived on by wandering from heart to heart of all the people living in the world of the "Night."'"

lines.content: [クロ|あの子]と俺。
lines.translated: Kuro and I.

lines.content: ずっと昔、俺たちはこの蒸気機関車に乗ってたくさん、たくさんの“夜”の世界を越えて、このさくらの町へとやって来た。
lines.translated: A long time ago, we rode this steam locomotive across many, many worlds of the "Night" and arrived at this town of cherry blossoms.

lines.content: だから俺は、この“夜”の世界で、彼女がどんな“役割”を担っているのかを知っている。
lines.translated: That's why I know what kind of "role" she plays in this world of the "Night."

lines.content: ……だから。
lines.translated: And so.

lines.content: だからこそ俺は、この“ぬいぐるみ”を。
lines.translated: That is precisely why I brought this "stuffed animal."

lines.content: ……“悪夢”と化した誰かの“心”を。
lines.translated: Someone's "heart" that had turned into a "nightmare."

lines.content: ここに。
lines.translated: Here.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの元に、連れてきたのだ――
lines.translated: I brought it to Nana-chan--

lines.content: ……この子はとても、やさしい子
lines.translated: "...This child is a very kind child."

lines.content: 俺が手渡した“ぬいぐるみ”を、そっとナナちゃんは抱き寄せた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan gently hugged the "stuffed animal" I handed to her.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは語る。
lines.translated: Nana-chan begins to speak.

lines.content: だけど少しばかりやさしすぎたのだ、と。
lines.translated: But she was just a little too kind, she says.

lines.content: 抱きしめた“誰か”の心にあった想いを、言葉に変えて――語り始める。
lines.translated: Turning the feelings inside the heart of the "someone" she was holding into words--she begins to tell the story.

lines.content: 誰もが彼女に甘えた。学校の先生も。近所の人も。……両親さえも
lines.translated: "Everyone took advantage of her kindness. Her teachers at school. The neighbors. ...Even her parents."

lines.content: だけど何があってもこの子は、[・|女][・|の][・|子]は、笑ってた。
lines.translated: But no matter what happened, this child, this *girl*, kept smiling.

lines.content: だから、“この子には何をしても許される”……。言葉はなくとも、どうしてだろう、自然とそういう役回りになってしまう子だった
lines.translated: "So, 'No matter what you do to this child, she'll forgive you'... Even without words, I wonder why, she naturally ended up in that kind of role."

lines.content: 何をしても、何をしなくても、笑顔で許してくれる彼女に、いつしか誰も“ごめんなさい”も“ありがとう”も言わなくなった。そう、感じることもなくなった。
lines.translated: No matter what anyone did, or didn't do, she would forgive them with a smile, so before long, nobody said "I'm sorry" or "Thank you" to her anymore. Nor did they even feel that way.

lines.content: ……だから女の子は、お父さんに、お母さんに……大切だった、ふたりに。何の説明もなく捨てられてしまっても、笑顔のままだった
lines.translated: "...So even when the girl was abandoned without any explanation by her father, and her mother... by the two people so precious to her, she kept smiling."

lines.content: まずお父さんが家に帰ってこなくなった。
lines.translated: First, her father stopped coming home.

lines.content: “お父さんには私たち以外に別の家族があって、そちらのほうが大切になってしまったの”――
lines.translated: "'Your father has another family besides us, and they've become more important to him'--"

lines.content: あの子のお母さんはそう言って泣いていた。
lines.translated: That child's mother cried as she said that.

lines.content: ……女の子も。まるで自分のことのように涙を流して悲しんだ
lines.translated: "...The girl, too, shed tears and grieved as if it were happening to her own self."

lines.content: これからはふたり一緒に力を合わせて生きていこう……。
lines.translated: From now on, the two of them would work together and live on...

lines.content: そう、思っていたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though that was what she had thought...

lines.content: お母さんも別の家族を見つけて、女の子の待つ家に帰ってこなくなってしまった
lines.translated: "Her mother also found another family, and stopped coming back to the home where the girl was waiting."

lines.content: 真冬のことだ。
lines.translated: It was in the dead of winter.

lines.content: 電気も水も停められて……。
lines.translated: The electricity and water were shut off...

lines.content: 女の子は肌を突き刺す空気の寒さと、心を突き刺すさみしさと、どうしようもない空腹で、今にも消えてなくなってしまいそう
lines.translated: "With the freezing air piercing her skin, the loneliness piercing her heart, and a helpless hunger, the girl feels as though she might fade away at any moment."

lines.content: だけど女の子は決して、両親を責めるようなことはしなかった。むしろ自分が悪いのだと思っていた。
lines.translated: Yet the girl never once blamed her parents. Instead, she thought it was her own fault.

lines.content: ……お父さん。お母さん。ふたりが帰ってきてくれないのは、私が、誕生日に買ってもらったくまのぬいぐるみをなくしてしまった悪い子だからだ
lines.translated: "...Dad. Mom. The reason the two of you won't come home is because I'm a bad girl who lost the teddy bear you bought me for my birthday."

lines.content: そんなふうに、思ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: That was what she had ended up believing.

lines.content: ……それは両親の教育の結果なのかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Perhaps that was the result of how her parents raised her."

lines.content: “人の痛みを自分の痛みのように思いなさい”――
lines.translated: "Think of others' pain as your own"--

lines.content: あなたがつらいとき、周りの人はもっともっと、あなたよりももっと、つらいのだから……
lines.translated: "When you are hurting, the people around you are hurting much, much more than you are..."

lines.content: だからいつでも笑顔でいなさい。
lines.translated: So always keep a smile on your face.

lines.content: どんなことをされたとしても、相手を笑顔で、許してあげなさい
lines.translated: "No matter what is done to you, forgive the other person with a smile."

lines.content: 決して相手を恨んだり、責めるようなことをしてはだめ。
lines.translated: You must never resent or blame the other person.

lines.content: ……たとえば、あなたを殴りつけた誰かは、もっともっと、心も身体も、あなたよりもずっと、痛い想いをしているのだから――
lines.translated: "...For instance, someone who hits you is feeling much, much more pain in their heart and body than you ever are--"

lines.content: それが両親からうけた教育だった。
lines.translated: That was the upbringing she received from her parents.

lines.content: ――“相手の痛みのわかる大人になりなさい。そうでなければ、みんなあなたを愛せない”
lines.translated: "--'Grow up to be an adult who understands the pain of others. Otherwise, nobody will be able to love you.'"

lines.content: ……バカみたいな教えだ。
lines.translated: What a ridiculous teaching.

lines.content: どうして“バカみたい”と言えるのか――それを論じることさえもバカみたい。
lines.translated: Even arguing about why it can be called "ridiculous" is ridiculous in itself.

lines.content: 女の子の心を都合よく操るための暴論でしかない――きっとそれを唱えた本人等もそのことに気づいていないくらいの暴論だ。
lines.translated: It's nothing more than an absurd argument meant to conveniently manipulate the girl's heart--so absurd that the very people who preached it probably didn't even realize it themselves.

lines.content: ……女の子は、お母さんが新しい家族と暮らしている家を一度だけ見に行った
lines.translated: "...Just once, the girl went to see the house where her mother was living with her new family."

lines.content: 寒いさむい冬の中。
lines.translated: In the cold, freezing winter.

lines.content: ちらちらと雪が舞う。
lines.translated: Snowflakes fluttered down.

lines.content: たくさんの笑顔が似合うクリスマス……。
lines.translated: Christmas, a time meant for so many smiles...

lines.content: 暖かそうな明かりの洩れている窓を覗いた。
lines.translated: She peeked through the window where a warm-looking light was spilling out.

lines.content: お母さんは知らない女の子にやさしく微笑みかけていた。
lines.translated: Her mother was smiling gently at an unfamiliar girl.

lines.content: 女の子の大好きだったその手で、知らない女の子の頭を撫でていた
lines.translated: "With that hand the girl had loved so much, she was stroking the unfamiliar girl's head."

lines.content: 美味しそうな料理。
lines.translated: Delicious-looking food.

lines.content: 暖かそうな部屋。
lines.translated: A warm-looking room.

lines.content: お母さんが笑ってる。
lines.translated: Her mother is smiling.

lines.content: 幸せそう。
lines.translated: She looks happy.

lines.content: 女の子は安心だった。
lines.translated: The girl felt relieved.

lines.content: “よかったねお母さん。本当に”
lines.translated: "'I'm so glad for you, Mom. Really.'"

lines.content: このごろずっと、お母さん、つらそうだったから……。
lines.translated: Because lately, Mom had looked like she was in so much pain...

lines.content: 笑えているのなら、よかった。
lines.translated: If she's able to smile, then I'm glad.

lines.content: “……でも、どうしてかな、お母さん。心が痛いよ。とても、とても……”
lines.translated: "'...But I wonder why, Mom. My heart hurts. So, so much...'"

lines.content: 早く行かなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to go soon.

lines.content: もう、行かなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to leave now.

lines.content: でも、ずっと、ずっと、その場を離れられず、立ち尽くしていた。
lines.translated: But for a long, long time, she couldn't leave that spot, standing there frozen.

lines.content: 窓が開いた。見つかった
lines.translated: "The window opened. She was found."

lines.content: お母さんの顔が凍り付く――
lines.translated: Her mother's face freezes--

lines.content: ……お母さん。だめだよ。そんな顔、見たくない
lines.translated: "...Mom. Don't. I don't want to see you make a face like that."

lines.content: 女の子は泣きたくなった。
lines.translated: The girl wanted to cry.

lines.content: お母さんの隣には、“この子、だあれ？”と首を傾げる女の子。その手には、ぬいぐるみ……
lines.translated: "Next to her mother was the girl tilting her head and asking, 'Who's this?' And in her hand was a stuffed animal..."

lines.content: なくしてしまったと思っていた、お誕生日のプレゼント。
lines.translated: The birthday present she thought she had lost.

lines.content: “相手の痛みのわかる大人になりなさい。そうでなければ、みんなあなたを愛せない”――どこかからそんな声が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: "Grow up to be an adult who understands the pain of others. Otherwise, nobody will be able to love you"--she heard that voice coming from somewhere.

lines.content: だから女の子は大丈夫だよと笑って見せた。
lines.translated: So the girl smiled and told her that she was okay.

lines.content: 私も、お母さん、私も……新しい家族を見つけたの
lines.translated: "Me too, Mom, I... I found a new family, too."

lines.content: 笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: I said it with a smile.

lines.content: だからお母さん、大丈夫だから、私、平気だから……
lines.translated: "So Mom, it's okay, I'm completely fine..."

lines.content: だからお母さん、そんな、悲しそうな顔、しないで――
lines.translated: So Mom, please don't make such a sad face--

lines.content: 駆けだした。
lines.translated: She broke into a run.

lines.content: 転んでしまう。
lines.translated: She trips and falls.

lines.content: 膝小僧を擦りむいた。
lines.translated: She scraped her knee.

lines.content: いたい……
lines.translated: "It hurts..."

lines.content: ……振り返る。
lines.translated: And looked back.

lines.content: でも、誰も、追いかけてきてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: But nobody came chasing after her.

lines.content: 本当に“大丈夫”だと思われた。本当に“平気”だと、安心された。……“私には何をしても許される”。不思議とみんなそう思ってしまう。どうしてか自分はそういう役回り
lines.translated: "She really believed I was 'okay.' She was relieved, thinking I was truly 'fine.' ...'Anything done to me will be forgiven.' Strangely enough, everyone ends up thinking that way. For some reason, that's the role I'm always stuck playing."

lines.content: そんなことないのに。
lines.translated: Even though that wasn't true at all.

lines.content: 大丈夫なはず、ないのに。
lines.translated: Even though there was no way she could be okay.

lines.content: 本当に、本当に、捨てられてしまった
lines.translated: "I had truly, truly been abandoned."

lines.content: お母さん。お父さん。ふたりの幸せには私は邪魔だと女の子は気づいた。
lines.translated: Mom. Dad. The girl realized that she was in the way of their happiness.

lines.content: ……このまま小さくちいさくなって、消えてしまえば、死んで、しまえれば……私……ねえ、お母さん
lines.translated: "'...If I just shrank down smaller and smaller like this, and disappeared, and died... I... Hey, Mom.'"

lines.content: 私。少しは、お母さんに心配してもらえるのかな。
lines.translated: Would Mom worry about me, even just a little?

lines.content: 少しの間、笑顔を忘れて泣いてしまった
lines.translated: "For a little while, she forgot how to smile and cried."

lines.content: そんな自分がいやだった。
lines.translated: She hated herself for being like that.

lines.content: ……お父さんのほうが。お母さんのほうが。私なんかよりずっと悲しくてつらいはずなのに
lines.translated: "'...Dad and Mom must be feeling so much sadder and in so much more pain than someone like me.'"

lines.content: こんなことでは愛されない。
lines.translated: Nobody will love me if I act like this.

lines.content: だけど笑顔でなんかいられなくて……。
lines.translated: Even so, she couldn't bring herself to smile...

lines.content: もう二度と、誰もこの部屋には帰ってきてくれない。
lines.translated: Nobody would ever come back to this room again.

lines.content: ……このままだと、私はずっと、ひとりきり
lines.translated: "'...At this rate, I'll be all alone forever.'"

lines.content: 私はこれからどうすればいいのだろう。
lines.translated: What am I supposed to do from now on?

lines.content: 不安だった。
lines.translated: She was anxious.

lines.content: 心配だった。
lines.translated: She was worried.

lines.content: つらい。
lines.translated: It's painful.

lines.content: 悲しい。
lines.translated: It's sad.

lines.content: さみしい。
lines.translated: I'm lonely.

lines.content: いたい。
lines.translated: It hurts.

lines.content: そんな気持ちが、女の子の“心”の中で大きくなって……
lines.translated: "Those feelings grew bigger and bigger inside the girl's 'heart'..."

lines.content: あの子の“心”に、“悪夢”が産まれた。
lines.translated: And in that girl's "heart," a "Nightmare" was born.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの話を静かに聞いていた。
lines.translated: I listened quietly to Nana-chan's story.
That girl is me.

lines.content: 俺、そっくりだ……。
lines.translated: She's just like me...

lines.content: いいや。誰も側にいてくれなかっただけ、ぼくよりも、[・|ひ][・|ど][・|い]。
lines.translated: No. In the sense that nobody was there by her side, she had it even worse than me.

lines.content: そう思わずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking that.

lines.content: 過去。あるいは、未来。
lines.translated: The past. Or perhaps, the future.

lines.content: 様々なことを思い出さずにはいられないのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't stop myself from remembering all sorts of things.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。今日まで悲しいばかりの、さみしいばかりの人生だったね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Up until today, your life has been nothing but sadness and loneliness, hasn't it?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんは抱きしめた“ぬいぐるみ”をやさしく撫でていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan gently stroked the "stuffed animal" she was hugging.

lines.content: “夜の国”はこの町の人々が夢見るための特別な場所。
lines.translated: The "Country of Night" is a special place for the people of this town to dream.

lines.content: 現実世界で拾い集めた“悲しい”、“つらい”、“さみしい”、そして“不安”や“心配”、そんな気持ちを少しずつ捨てていける――“夢”と“心”の廃棄場でもある。
lines.translated: It is also a dumping ground for "dreams" and "hearts"--a place where you can gradually cast away the "sadness," "pain," "loneliness," as well as the "anxiety" and "worry" picked up in the real world.

lines.content: ……だけど、自分の中の暗い“心”を上手に捨てられない人もいる
lines.translated: "...However, there are some people who aren't good at casting away the dark 'feelings' inside themselves."

lines.content: “ぬいぐるみ”を抱きしめたままナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan spoke while still hugging the "stuffed animal."

lines.content: そんな人は……生きることに不器用な、誰かは、夢から覚めてもつらいまま
lines.translated: "People like that... someone who is clumsy at living, remains in pain even after waking from their dream."

lines.content: ……そうして捨てられない暗い心が大きくおおきく膨らんで
lines.translated: "...And so, the dark feelings they can't throw away swell bigger and bigger..."

lines.content: ――いつしかその人自身を殺す“悪夢”と変わる。
lines.translated: --Until eventually, they turn into a "Nightmare" that kills the person themselves.

lines.content: “心”の中で“悪夢”が巨大に育ってしまった人の“夜”は明けない。
lines.translated: For someone whose "Nightmare" has grown massive inside their "heart," the "Night" never ends.

lines.content: 自分を嫌い。
lines.translated: They hate themselves.

lines.content: 自殺を考え。
lines.translated: They contemplate suicide.

lines.content: ……実際に実行に移したり。
lines.translated: And sometimes, they actually go through with it.

lines.content: もうこの先、自分には二度とうれしいことも楽しいことも訪れることはない――
lines.translated: Believing that nothing happy or fun will ever happen to them again for the rest of their lives--

lines.content: そう、思え。
lines.translated: That's how it feels.

lines.content: 太陽が昇っても、明けない“夜”が心を染めて。
lines.translated: Even when the sun rises, an unending "Night" stains their heart.

lines.content: ただの一度も、笑えなくなる……。
lines.translated: And they become unable to smile, not even once...

lines.content: 十年前は、奏大雅。あなたの幼馴染みの女の子たちが、“悪夢”となって大きくおおきく膨らんでしまった“心”と“夜”の中で戦い……
lines.translated: "Ten years ago, Kanade Taiga. Your childhood friends fought in the 'Night' against the 'hearts' that had swollen bigger and bigger into 'Nightmares'..."

lines.content: そうして“心”の中から“悪夢”に堕ちた部分だけを切り取り、鎮めて、私のところに連れてきた
lines.translated: "And then, they cut out only the part of the 'heart' that had fallen into a 'Nightmare,' quelled it, and brought it here to me."

lines.content: そして大きく育ちすぎてしまった誰かの“悪夢”を、ナナちゃんが相棒の機関車でしか行けない[・|と][・|あ][・|る][・|場][・|所]にまで連れて行く。
lines.translated: Then, Nana-chan takes that someone's overgrown "Nightmare" to a certain place that can only be reached by her partner, the steam locomotive.

lines.content: そうすることで“悪夢”の持ち主だった人物は少し、ほんの少しだけ、明るい気分で目覚めることができる。
lines.translated: By doing so, the person who possessed the "Nightmare" is able to wake up feeling a little--just a tiny bit--brighter.
However, that also means killing a part of that person...

lines.content: ……俺は、上手くやれてるかな。ナナちゃん
lines.translated: "...Am I doing a good job, Nana-chan?"

lines.content: 思わずそう問いかけてしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help asking her that.

lines.content: 今は俺ひとりが、あの頃のみんなの代わりをしてるけど……
lines.translated: "Right now, I'm filling in for everyone from back then all by myself, though..."

lines.content: ……十年前。あなた達は最大の“悪夢”と戦った。そしてそれに勝利した。そこであの子たちの役割は終わってしまった
lines.translated: "...Ten years ago, you all fought the greatest 'Nightmare.' And you triumphed over it. That was where those girls' roles ended."

lines.content: そうだね。だから今、俺はひとりでがんばってるんだよ。あの子たちがこなしていた仕事を引き継げればと思ってた
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's why I'm doing my best on my own now. I was hoping I could take over the job those girls used to do."

lines.content: でもね、ナナちゃん。自分で言うのもなんだけど……俺なんかがひとりでどこまでできるのか。なんだかとても心許なく思えることもあるんだ
lines.translated: "But you know, Nana-chan. It might sound weird coming from me... but sometimes I feel really insecure about how much someone like me can actually accomplish alone."

lines.content: 今回の“[この子|ぬいぐるみ]”に関してもそうだ。あの頃のみんなだったら、もっと上手に、ほんの少しも苦しめず……、この“[悪夢|ぬいぐるみ]”をここに連れてこれたんじゃないかと思う
lines.translated: "It's the same with this 'stuffed animal' this time. If it were everyone from back then, I feel like they could have brought this 'Nightmare' here much more skillfully, without making it suffer even the slightest bit..."

lines.content: 一度そう感じてしまうと自分自身が情けなく思えてならなかった。
lines.translated: Once I started feeling that way, I couldn't help finding myself utterly pathetic.

lines.content: 十夜の言うとおり、またみんなに助けを求めるほうがいいのではないかとそう感じてさえもしてしまう。
lines.translated: It even made me feel like it might be better to ask everyone for help again, just like Toya said.

lines.content: ……別に
lines.translated: "...Not really."

lines.content: しかしナナちゃんは言う。ふるふると首を振り。
lines.translated: However, Nana-chan spoke up, shaking her head slightly.

lines.content: あなたが“悪夢”と戦うのが上手なのか下手なのか、そんなのはわからない……
lines.translated: "Whether you're good or bad at fighting 'Nightmares,' I don't know about that..."

lines.content: けど、私はあなたひとりでいいと思ってる。“下手であること”が必ずしも“悪いこと”であるとも思わないから
lines.translated: "Still, I think just having you alone is fine. Because I don't think 'being clumsy at it' is necessarily a 'bad thing.'"

lines.content: そう？
lines.translated: "Yeah?"

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: こっくりと、うなずく。
lines.translated: She gave a firm nod.

lines.content: あなたはひとりでも充分に“役割”を果たしてると私は思う。その証拠に、“[この子|ぬいぐるみ]”みたいな子を、もう何度も私のところへ連れてきている……君、ひとりの力で
lines.translated: "I think you're fulfilling your 'role' plenty well enough on your own. As proof, you've already brought ones like this 'stuffed animal' to me many times... all by your own power."

lines.content: いや。俺の力だけでは決してない。十夜やあさひさんの助力や助言があってこそだ。俺ひとりではかつての少女たちのように万全な仕事はやり切れないだろう。
lines.translated: No. It's definitely not by my power alone. It's only possible thanks to Toya's and Asahi-san's help and advice. On my own, I'd never be able to pull off a flawless job like the girls used to do.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: それは、ナナちゃん
lines.translated: "Wait, Nana-chan..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: あれだね。ここにこうして来るのが俺ひとりだと、べたべた触られなくて済むから？
lines.translated: "Is it that? Because if I'm the only one coming here like this, you don't have to deal with people fawning all over you?"

lines.content: まあ、そう。理由なんてそれしかない。だけどそれで充分。特に夜月姫織と柊ハルは、ひどかった
lines.translated: "Well, yes. That's the only reason. But that's plenty enough. Yozuki Himeori and Hiiragi Haru were especially terrible."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは顔をしかめた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan grimaced.

lines.content: 姫織は私の大切な帽子を奪おうとするし、ハルはいつまでも私を抱いて離さない
lines.translated: "Himeori always tried to steal my precious hat, and Haru would hug me and refuse to let go forever."

lines.content: ぎゅーっと深く帽子をかぶって、ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: Pulling her hat down tight over her head, Nana-chan continued.

lines.content: だから、ここへ来るのは奏大雅ひとりでいい。あなた以外と話すと疲れる。とっても
lines.translated: "So having just Kanade Taiga come here is fine. Talking to anyone other than you is exhausting. Very much so."

lines.content: そっか……。なんか、喜んでいいのかどうかって感じだね
lines.translated: "I see... I'm kind of not sure whether I should be happy about that or not."

lines.content: つい俺は苦笑いを浮かべてしまうのだった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help cracking a wry smile.

lines.content: ……ああ、そういえば。ナナちゃんに伝えたいことがあったんだった
lines.translated: "...Oh, speaking of which. There was something I wanted to tell you, Nana-chan."

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: うん。柊ハルだよ。ついこの前のことだけど、帰って来たんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's about Hiiragi Haru. Just the other day, she came back."

lines.content: 転校していったあの子が……？
lines.translated: "That girl who transferred away...?"

lines.content: そうだよ。ずっとずっと大人になってた。見違えるくらいきれいにもなってたよ
lines.translated: "That's right. She's grown up so, so much. And she's gotten so pretty you'd barely recognize her."

lines.content: でも、千和や姫織とは違って、まだ“夜”の中に出入りはできるみたいなんだ……俺みたいにね
lines.translated: "Still, unlike Chiwa and Himeori, it looks like she can still go in and out of the 'Night'... just like me."

lines.content: まだハルの中には“少女”が消えずに残っているのかもしれない。何気なく俺はそう言った。
lines.translated: Maybe the "girl" inside Haru still remains without having faded away. I said that casually.

lines.content: そして俺はナナちゃんになら大丈夫だろうと思い、[・|そ][・|れ]を伝えた――彼女が再び“魔法”を必要としているのだということを。
lines.translated: And figuring it would be fine to tell Nana-chan, I passed it along to her--the fact that Haru was in need of "magic" once again.

lines.content: 彼女がいったいどんな“魔法”をその心に秘めているのか。
lines.translated: Just what kind of "magic" is she hiding inside her heart?

lines.content: それは一切、不明なままだが……。
lines.translated: That remains a complete mystery, though...

lines.content: 今俺が把握していることをナナちゃんに伝えた。
lines.translated: I told Nana-chan everything I currently understood.

lines.content: 何か助言をもらえると期待したのかもしれないし、ただ秘密にしていることが何となく居心地が悪かったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe I was hoping to get some advice from her, or maybe I just felt vaguely uncomfortable keeping it a secret.

lines.content: だけどナナちゃんはじっと黙ってしまった。
lines.translated: However, Nana-chan fell completely silent.

lines.content: そして再び夜空を見上げた。
lines.translated: And then, she looked up at the night sky once again.

lines.content: ただ小さくちいさく、『……そう』とだけ言っていたように俺には聞こえた……。
lines.translated: In a tiny, quiet voice, it sounded to me like she only said, "...I see..."

lines.content: ……ああ。そういえば、あともうひとつ
lines.translated: "...Oh, right. There's one more thing."

lines.content: 俺は肩に提げた鞄を開く。
lines.translated: I opened the bag slung over my shoulder.

lines.content: そしてお土産があるんだと、俺が言うが早いか……、
lines.translated: And no sooner had I mentioned that I brought a souvenir than...

lines.content: カップ麺……？
lines.translated: "Cup noodles...?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんが首をかしげた。その目は無表情のように見え、どこか期待の色も見えていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan tilted her head. Her eyes looked expressionless, yet there was a hint of anticipation in them.

lines.content: うん。そう。大正解。鞄に入るだけ……たくさん、持ってきたよ
lines.translated: "Yep, that's right. Spot on. I brought a whole bunch... as many as I could fit in my bag."

lines.content: お、おおおお、たくさん……っ
lines.translated: "Oh, ooooh, a whole bunch...!"

lines.content: 目がきらめいていた。今度は一目瞭然とわかるくらいに。
lines.translated: Her eyes were sparkling. This time, it was obvious at a single glance.

lines.content: そのよろこびように俺は苦笑いを浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: Seeing how overjoyed she was, I gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: ねえ、ナナちゃん。いつも思うんだけどさ
lines.translated: "Hey, Nana-chan. I always find myself wondering about this, though."

lines.content: うん？　何を？
lines.translated: "Hmm? About what?"

lines.content: 早くちょうだいとばかりに屋根から身を乗り出すナナちゃんに、『危ないよ。落ち着いて』と俺はたしなめる。
lines.translated: As Nana-chan leaned out from the roof as if begging me to hand them over right away, I gently chided her, telling her, "That's dangerous. Calm down."

lines.content: いつも何か仕事を頼むときは報酬にカップ麺……。本当にそれだけでいいのかな。もっと違うものをお願いされてもいいって思うんだけど……
lines.translated: "Whenever I ask you to do a job for me, the reward is always cup noodles... Are you really sure that's enough? I feel like you could ask for something a bit different..."

lines.content: たとえばあさひさんの手料理だとか。
lines.translated: Like Asahi-san's home cooking, for instance.

lines.content: いいの。それがいい。カップ麺最高。添加物とか諸々身体に悪ければ悪いだろうものほど痺れるほどにちょー美味しいの
lines.translated: "It's fine. This is what I want. Cup noodles are the best. The worse something is for your body with all the additives and stuff, the more mind-numbingly, super-duper delicious it is."

lines.content: だからそれ以上は不要。カップ麺は人類最大にして唯一の善良なる大発明だよ
lines.translated: "So I don't need anything more than this. Cup noodles are humanity's greatest and sole benevolent grand invention."

lines.content: すっごい高評価だな、カップ麺
lines.translated: "That's some seriously high praise for cup noodles."

lines.content: だから早く。前回もらったものはとっくに切らしちゃったから……早くちょうだい。食べさせて
lines.translated: "So hurry up. I ran out of the ones you gave me last time ages ago... Hurry and give them to me. Let me eat."

lines.content: チープな味付けと添加物と保存料がとっても恋しい。醤油味のやつは持ってきてくれた？
lines.translated: "I've missed the cheap flavoring, additives, and preservatives so much. Did you bring the soy sauce flavored ones?"

lines.content: うん。あるよ。ナナちゃんはその味が好きだって知ってるから……。でも、まずはお湯を沸かさないと
lines.translated: "Yeah, I've got them. Since I know you love that flavor, Nana-chan... But first, we need to boil some water."

lines.content: 大丈夫。平気
lines.translated: "It's fine. No problem."

lines.content: ふふんと得意げ。
lines.translated: She gave a proud little hum.

lines.content: そろそろ大雅がカップ麺持って来てくれるって予感があった。だからね、お湯を沸かして待ってたよ
lines.translated: "I had a feeling you'd be bringing me cup noodles soon, Taiga. So I boiled some water and waited for you."

lines.content: ランタンの光だと思っていたものは、ランプでお湯を沸かしていたようだった。
lines.translated: What I had thought was the light of a lantern was actually a stove lamp boiling water.

lines.content: ほら。早く。大雅もこっちに
lines.translated: "Come on, hurry. Get over here too, Taiga."

lines.content: ぽんぽんと、ナナちゃんは自分の座っている隣を叩いた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan patted the spot right next to where she was sitting.

lines.content: 俺は列車の屋根によじ登る。
lines.translated: I clambered up onto the roof of the train.

lines.content: そしてふたり並んで座り、カップ麺にお湯を注いだ。
lines.translated: Sitting side by side, the two of us poured hot water into the cup noodles.

lines.content: まだかなまだかな。うふふ。こんな幸せな時間を作り出すなんて……まったく人間は罪深い
lines.translated: "Is it ready yet? Is it ready yet? Ufufu. Creating such a blissful moment... humans really are sinful creatures."

lines.content: 小さな身体をふらふらと揺すりながら、ナナちゃんは世界一長い三分間に幸せな想像を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Swaying her small body back and forth, Nana-chan let her happy imagination run wild during the longest three minutes in the world.

lines.content: この町の“夜”に住む神さまは、カップラーメンが大好物だ
lines.translated: "The god who lives in the 'Night' of this town loves cup ramen more than anything."

lines.content: 何気なく俺はそうつぶやいてみた。
lines.translated: I murmured that casually.

lines.content: すると、隣に座る小さな神さまは唇を尖らせる。
lines.translated: At that, the little god sitting next to me pouted her lips.

lines.content: ……大雅もしつこい。何度も言った。私はただここに居続けるだけの“何か”。神さまなんかじゃないんだよって
lines.translated: "...You're so persistent, Taiga. I've told you so many times. I'm just 'something' that stays here. I'm not a god or anything like that."

lines.content: うん。そうだね。……美味しそうにカップ麺ばっかり食べてる神さまなんて、見たことも聞いたこともないかもしれないね
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's true. ...Come to think of it, I don't think I've ever seen or heard of a god who happily eats nothing but cup noodles."

lines.content: だけど……、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Even so..." I said.

lines.content: だけど、そんなナナちゃんが俺は好きだよ
lines.translated: "Even so, I like you just the way you are, Nana-chan."

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: 満点の星がきらめく夜空の下で、小さな神さまと一緒にカップ麺を食べた。
lines.translated: Beneath a night sky glittering with countless stars, I ate cup noodles together with the little god.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの所から“ゆめのねどこ”に帰宅した。
lines.translated: I returned from Nana-chan's place to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: するとハルは既に帰宅してしまった後だった。
lines.translated: By the time I got back, Haru had already gone home.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの所に長居しすぎたようだ――奥座敷のテーブルには俺の食事が用意されていた。
lines.translated: It seemed I had stayed at Nana-chan's for too long--my dinner was laid out on the table in the back parlor.

lines.content: コロッケの盛られたお皿が、ラップをかけて置いてあった。
lines.translated: A plate piled with croquettes had been left there, covered in plastic wrap.

lines.content: ハルに悪いことをしてしまったかも。……明日、謝らないと
lines.translated: "I might've done something bad to Haru. ...I'll have to apologize tomorrow."

lines.content: さっきナナちゃんとカップ麺を食べたばかりだ。
lines.translated: I had just eaten cup noodles with Nana-chan a little while ago.

lines.content: それでも、ハルと十夜が作ってくれた大小形がばらばらのコロッケは、とても、とても美味しくて……。
lines.translated: Even so, the croquettes of all different shapes and sizes that Haru and Toya had made for me were so, so delicious...

lines.content: あさひさんが温め直してくれた豚汁とポテトサラダまで残さず全部食べてしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up eating every last bite, including the pork miso soup and potato salad that Asahi-san reheated for me.

lines.content: 今夜は七時間くらいかな。大雅にはがんばってもらったし……。少しくらい[・|ズ][・|ル]をしても許されるはずだよな。悪いけど、大雅。後で“夜”の時間を調整しておいてほしい
lines.translated: "About seven hours tonight, I suppose. You worked hard out there, Taiga... I'm sure we can be forgiven for cheating just a little bit. Sorry to ask, Taiga, but could you adjust the 'Night's' time later?"

lines.content: 食器を片付けてくれるあさひさんにそう言われ、俺は『わかりました。そうします』とうなずいた。
lines.translated: When Asahi-san said that to me as she cleared away the dishes, I nodded and replied, "Understood. I'll do that."

lines.content: 十夜とあさひさんの後に風呂に入った。
lines.translated: I took a bath after Toya and Asahi-san.

lines.content: 寝間着に着替え、バスタオルで濡れた頭を拭きながら寝床のある自室へと。
lines.translated: Changing into my sleepwear, I dried my wet hair with a bath towel as I headed to my room where my bed was.

lines.content: 暗く小さな部屋だ。
lines.translated: It was a dark, small room.

lines.content: ぱちりとスイッチを押す。
lines.translated: With a click, I flipped the switch.

lines.content: すると明かりが灯り、露わになる。
lines.translated: The light turned on, revealing the room's contents.

lines.content: 時計だ。
lines.translated: Clocks.

lines.content: 小さな部屋にはたくさんの時計が飾られ並ぶ。
lines.translated: Countless clocks were displayed and lined up throughout the small room.

lines.content: ――かち、かち、かち。
lines.translated: --Tick, tock, tick.

lines.content: 時計の秒針が進む音で満たされていた。
lines.translated: The room was filled with the sound of advancing second hands.

lines.content: 壁面にはたくさんの時計がかけられている。
lines.translated: Many clocks hung on the walls.

lines.content: 壁掛けの時計だけではない。柱時計や懐中時計なども壁にぶら下げられていた。
lines.translated: And not just wall clocks. Grandfather clocks and pocket watches were suspended from the walls as well.

lines.content: 中にはアンティークな腕時計などもある。
lines.translated: Among them were even antique wristwatches and the like.

lines.content: ……様々なデザインの時計があった。
lines.translated: There were clocks of all different designs.

lines.content: 無駄を極力省いた（数字までをも省かれた）シンプルなもの。
lines.translated: Simple ones stripped of all excess--even down to the numbers.

lines.content: 宝石を散りばめられた豪華絢爛といった具合のもの。
lines.translated: Gorgeous, extravagant ones studded with jewels.

lines.content: とある自称天才画家が好んだようなぐにゃぐにゃと歪んだものなどたくさんだ。
lines.translated: And plenty of warped, melting ones, the kind a certain self-proclaimed genius painter was fond of.

lines.content: 俺は数ある時計のそのひとつを手に取る。
lines.translated: I picked up one of the many timepieces.

lines.content: 小さな金色の懐中時計だ。
lines.translated: It was a small gold pocket watch.

lines.content: 今から少しばかり[・|ズ][・|ル]をする。
lines.translated: I was about to cheat just a little bit.

lines.content: 手にした時計の針を回転させた。
lines.translated: I turned the hands of the watch in my grasp.
In the direction that turns back time.

lines.content: 針を戻した数だけ、この部屋の……いいや、このお店の時間は[・|殆][・|ど]停まる。
lines.translated: By the exact amount I turned back the hands, the time in this room... no, the time in this entire shop would come to a near standstill.

lines.content: ちょうど七時間後に時は動きだし――そして[・|ベ][・|ル]が鳴るよう設定した。
lines.translated: Time would begin moving again in exactly seven hours--and I set the bell to ring when it did.

lines.content: 目覚ましだ。
lines.translated: An alarm.

lines.content: 七時間後、部屋にある時計が一斉に――まるで嵐が到来したかのようになき喚くだろう。
lines.translated: In seven hours, every clock in the room would cry out and wail all at once--as though a storm had arrived.

lines.content: 懐中時計のボタンをカチリと押す。そして時は止まるのだ。
lines.translated: I pressed the button on the pocket watch with a click. And with that, time stopped.

lines.content: ……停止するのは時間だけ。命あるものの時間は止まらず流れる。
lines.translated: Only time itself came to a halt. The time of living things did not stop, continuing to flow onward.

lines.content: あさひさんの造った“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: It was a "magic" created by Asahi-san.

lines.content: 今夜は少し疲れた。“悪夢”と向き合い、小さな“夜”の神さまとも会いに行った。
lines.translated: I was a little tired tonight. I had faced a "Nightmare" and gone to see the little god of the "Night."

lines.content: 気づけばもう深夜をとっくに過ぎている。朝が近いのだ。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, it was already well past midnight. Morning was fast approaching.

lines.content: まともに眠ればもう殆ど睡眠を取ることができない時間けれど……。
lines.translated: It was an hour where I would barely get any sleep at all if I went to bed normally, yet...

lines.content: 肉体を夢の中に持ち込んでいる俺たちは、ときにこうして時間の調整をしていたりする。
lines.translated: Because we bring our physical bodies into the dream, we sometimes adjust time like this.

lines.content: “夜”の魔法使いが作り上げたこの特異点。
lines.translated: This singularity crafted by the magician of the "Night."

lines.content: 朝と“夜”の出入り口――“ゆめのねどこ”
lines.translated: The doorway between morning and "Night"--the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: ここは時の流れに[・|ほ][・|ん][・|の][・|少][・|し][・|だ][・|け]手を加えることができる。あくまでも、ほんの少しだけ。
lines.translated: Here, one could tamper with the flow of time just a tiny bit. Strictly, only a tiny bit.

lines.content: しかしそれは自然に逆らうような行為だ。故に。“魔法使い”たるあさひさんはこの調整をズルだと言って、あまり良いとはしていない。
lines.translated: However, it was an act that defied nature. Therefore, as a "magician," Asahi-san called this adjustment cheating and didn't entirely approve of it.

lines.content: 操作し終えた懐中時計を、元の位置に戻す。
lines.translated: Having finished adjusting the pocket watch, I returned it to its original place.

lines.content: 俺は部屋の電気を最小に落とした。
lines.translated: I dimmed the room's lights to their lowest setting.

lines.content: 豆電球のオレンジ色の光だけとなる。
lines.translated: Only the orange glow of the nightlight bulb remained.

lines.content: そして寝床に横になった。
lines.translated: Then, I lay down on my bed.

lines.content: 携帯電話を取り出し、ディスプレイを見る。
lines.translated: I took out a cell phone and looked at the display.

lines.content: ふたつ折りの古い端末。いわゆるガラケー。
lines.translated: An old clamshell device. A so-called flip phone.

lines.content: 普段使いしているスマホとはまた違うもの。
lines.translated: It was different from the smartphone I used on a daily basis.

lines.content: この端末の番号を登録された端末は、たとえどんなに遠く離れた場所に在ったとしても、必ず繋がる――これはそういう“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: Any device registered with this phone's number would unfailingly connect, no matter how far away it might be--that was the kind of "magic" this was.

lines.content: ……ぽちぽちと操作する。
lines.translated: I pressed the buttons with soft clicks.

lines.content: 電話帳には三名だけしか登録されていない。
lines.translated: Only three people were registered in the contacts list.

lines.content: 陽向井あさひ。冬月十夜。そして、クロだ。
lines.translated: Hinamukai Asahi. Fuyutsuki Toya. And Kuro.

lines.content: うう～ん……
クロの番号をディスプレイに表示させた。
lines.translated: I pulled up Kuro's number on the display.

lines.content: あとは通話のボタンを押すだけで発信できてしまう――のだけど。
lines.translated: All I had to do now was press the call button to dial--and yet.

lines.content: ……少し、ためらう。
lines.translated: I hesitated for a moment.

lines.content: 不安なのだ。
lines.translated: I felt anxious.

lines.content: 繋がらなかったらどうしよう。
lines.translated: What if it didn't go through?

lines.content: 無視されてしまったら、どうしよう。
lines.translated: What if she ignored me?

lines.content: ……まあ、うん
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah."

lines.content: 苦笑い――
lines.translated: A wry smile--

lines.content: 今までそんなこと、ただの一度もなかったんだけど
lines.translated: "That's never happened even once until now, though."
Except for when she has gone off somewhere far away.

lines.content: 通話ボタンを押した。
lines.translated: I pressed the call button.

lines.content: すると呼び出し音が鳴り始める――
lines.translated: Immediately, the ringing tone began to play--

lines.content: ぷるるるる、ぷるるるる、というお決まりの電子音。
lines.translated: Brrrring, brrrring, went the familiar electronic sound.

lines.content: この音が途切れるのを今かいまかと待っている。
lines.translated: I waited with bated breath for the sound to cut off at any moment.

lines.content: カップ麺ができあがる三分間が幸せなものならば、この待ち時間はきっとその真逆だろうと思えてしまう。
lines.translated: If the three minutes spent waiting for cup noodles to cook are pure bliss, then this wait felt like the exact opposite.

lines.content: やがて呼び出し音はぷつりと止まる。
lines.translated: Before long, the ringing abruptly clicked off.

lines.content: [・|相][・|手]が通話ボタンを押したのだ。
lines.translated: The person on the other end had pressed the answer button.

lines.content: もしもし？
lines.translated: "Hello?"

lines.content: 呼びかける。
lines.translated: I called out.

lines.content: 聞こえる？　今話せるかな。大丈夫、かな
lines.translated: "Can you hear me? Are you free to talk right now? Is this an okay time?"

lines.content: 返事はない。
lines.translated: There was no reply.

lines.content: だけど気配だけは確かに感じた。
lines.translated: Even so, I could distinctly feel her presence.

lines.content: だから構わずこのまま話しかける。
lines.translated: So I didn't let it bother me and kept talking.

lines.content: クロ。今、どこにいる？
lines.translated: "Kuro. Where are you right now?"

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: まさか
lines.translated: "Wait..."

lines.content: 沈黙に少し不安を覚えた。
lines.translated: The silence made me feel a little uneasy.

lines.content: まさか、クロ
lines.translated: "Don't tell me, Kuro..."

lines.content: ひとりで……、どこか危ないところにいたりは、しないよね？
lines.translated: "You're not off somewhere dangerous... all by yourself, are you?"

lines.content: ……クロ？
lines.translated: "...Kuro?"

lines.content: 何度目かの呼びかけだ。
lines.translated: I had lost count of how many times I'd called her name.

lines.content: しかし返答はない。変わらず、ない。
lines.translated: Yet there was still no answer. None at all.

lines.content: 心の中にただただ静けさだけが満たされていく。
lines.translated: Only sheer silence continued to fill my heart.

lines.content: 俺も、沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: I fell silent, too.

lines.content: ふと心配になった。不安にもなった。
lines.translated: Suddenly, worry washed over me. Anxiety crept in as well.

lines.content: ……クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: 俺の大切な一番の友だちは……時どき行き先も告げないままにふらりと姿を消してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Because my precious best friend... had a habit of wandering off and disappearing from time to time without telling me where she was going.

lines.content: そして、『もう二度と会えなくなってしまうんじゃ……』なんて、俺が心配で心配で、不安で、不安で……たまらなくなってしまったとき。
lines.translated: And right when I'd get so worried and anxious that I couldn't stand it anymore, terrified that I might never see her again...

lines.content: ひょっこり、何事もなかったふうに戻って来てくれる。
lines.translated: She would pop right back up out of nowhere, acting as if nothing had ever happened.

lines.content: この沈黙はまた君がどこかへ出かけてしまうことの前触れなのではないのか……。
lines.translated: Wasn't this silence a sign that she was about to go off somewhere again...?

lines.content: そしていつか。いつの日か。本当に、二度と会えなくなってしまう日がやって来るんじゃ……。
lines.translated: And someday. One of these days. What if the day comes when I really never get to see her again...?

lines.content: 俺のそんな怖さを君の声で打ち消してほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted the sound of her voice to dispel that fear of mine.

lines.content: だから俺は君を呼ぶのだ。繰り返し、呼ぶのだ。
lines.translated: That is why I call out to her. Why I call out to her again and again.

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: でも、やっぱりクロは何も話してくれない。
lines.translated: Even so, Kuro still wouldn't say a word to me.

lines.content: また、沈黙だ――……
lines.translated: Silence once again--...

lines.content: と、思ったが、
lines.translated: Or so I thought, until--

lines.content: ……危ないのは
lines.translated: "...The one in danger..."

lines.content: ぽつり、と。
lines.translated: A quiet murmur.

lines.content: 危ないのは、大雅。きみのほうだよ
lines.translated: "The one in danger is you, Taiga."

lines.content: 小さなちいさなその声が、頭の中にじんわり響いた。
lines.translated: That tiny, faint voice echoed softly inside my head.

lines.content: どういうつもりで、あんなこと
lines.translated: "What were you thinking, doing something like that?"

lines.content: あんなこと？
lines.translated: "Something like that?"

lines.content: ……言わなくても、わかってるはずだよ、大雅
lines.translated: "...You should know what I mean without me having to say it, Taiga."

lines.content: ため息交じりに君は言う。
lines.translated: She spoke, her voice heavy with a sigh.

lines.content: またあんな無茶をして。そういう話をしているんだけど……
lines.translated: "Doing something so reckless again. That's what I'm talking about..."

lines.content: ……それはちょっと怒ったような声だった。
lines.translated: She sounded a little angry.

lines.content: 大雅、苦しそうだった
lines.translated: "You looked like you were in so much pain, Taiga."

lines.content: 血が、いっぱいだった
lines.translated: "There was so much blood."

lines.content: “夜”の中でも気をつけないときみは死ぬんだ。それなのに……
lines.translated: "Even in the 'Night,' you'll die if you aren't careful. And yet..."

lines.content: どうして、と君が言う。
lines.translated: Why? she asked.

lines.content: ……それなのにどうして。大雅。どうしてきみは、無茶なことばかりをするの。[・|ま][・|る][・|で][・|死][・|に][・|た][・|が][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|る][・|み][・|た][・|い]だよ
lines.translated: "...And yet why, Taiga? Why do you keep doing such reckless things? It's almost like you're trying to get yourself killed."

lines.content: まるで昔の君を見ているみたいだった、とクロが言う。
lines.translated: It was just like watching the old you, Kuro said.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅。ちゃんと聞いてる？
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga. Are you listening to me?"

lines.content: 今度はあの子が繰り返し、俺を呼ぶ。
lines.translated: This time, she was the one calling my name over and over.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: うん。聞いてる。……聞いてるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm listening. ...I hear you."

lines.content: 大雅。あのね
lines.translated: "Listen, Taiga."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 大雅はもう[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]はしない子になったと思ってたんだよ。わたしが勝手に、期待していただけだって、そう言われてしまったら……それまでだけど
lines.translated: "I thought you had grown out of doing things like that, Taiga. Though if you tell me that was just wishful thinking on my part... I suppose there's nothing I can say."

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 素直に謝罪の言葉をつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured an honest apology.

lines.content: 十夜に借りた力で未来は知っていたのだ……。
lines.translated: Thanks to the power I borrowed from Toya, I already knew what would happen in the future...

lines.content: 冬月十夜。彼女の“特別な猫”としての力は、唇をあわせた時間だけ、その人物に自身の未来を見せることである。
lines.translated: Fuyutsuki Toya. Her power as a "special cat" allows her to show a person their own future for the exact duration their lips are pressed together.

lines.content: だから君の言う[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]を目的とした行為ではなかったのだが……それでも、謝る。謝罪する。
lines.translated: So my actions weren't aimed at doing "things like that" the way she meant... Nevertheless, I apologized. I offered my regrets.

lines.content: ごめん。ごめんね、クロ。君に心配させるつもりじゃ、なかったんだ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm really sorry, Kuro. I didn't mean to make you worry."

lines.content: ただただ必死だったんだ。
lines.translated: I had simply been desperate.

lines.content: 追い詰められたあの状況を打破するために……ただそれだけしか頭の中にはなかった。
lines.translated: Breaking through that cornered situation... was the only thing on my mind.

lines.content: ……心配なんて
lines.translated: "...Worried?"

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: 大雅のこと、心配なんて……そんなこと
lines.translated: "Worried about you, Taiga...? I wasn't..."

lines.content: もにょもにょと唇を尖らせている。
lines.translated: She mumbled, pouting her lips.

lines.content: きっと電話の向こうでクロはそんな表情を見せている――ように思えた。
lines.translated: It really felt like Kuro was making that exact face on the other end of the line.

lines.content: いったいどこでこの電話を繋いでくれているのかはわからないけど……。
lines.translated: I had no idea where she was taking this call from, though...

lines.content: きっとそんなに遠い場所にはいないはずなのだ。案外とすぐ近くにいてくれるかもしれない――[・|今][・|は][・|ま][・|だ]。
lines.translated: She surely couldn't be all that far away. For all I knew, she might be right nearby--for now, at least.

lines.content: そんな君に。
lines.translated: To her.
To the girl who always became just a little more honest with me when we talked over the phone.

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: なあ、クロ。お願いだ。できれば直接謝りたいよ。ごめんねを言いたい。……電話じゃなくて
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. Please. I'd really like to apologize to you in person if I can. I want to say I'm sorry face-to-face. ...Not over the phone."

lines.content: 君と電話で話すとき、少し甘えてしまいそうになるこの俺は、『会いたい。クロに会いたい。今、どこにいる？』と、もう一度だけ問いかけようと思ったけれど、
lines.translated: Talking to her on the phone always makes me want to lean on her a little, and I was about to ask just one more time--"I want to see you. I want to see you, Kuro. Where are you right now?"--when...

lines.content: ……だめ
拒絶の一言が俺の胸を、痛みばかりに敏感な心の内側を、ちくりと刺すのだ。
lines.translated: A single word of rejection pricked sharply at my chest, right at the tender core of my heart that was all too sensitive to pain.

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: だめ、か
lines.translated: "No good, huh?"

lines.content: ……だって
lines.translated: "...Well, that's because..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: だって、わたし……わたしは、泣いちゃうし
lines.translated: "Because I... I'll just end up crying."

lines.content: もにょもにょとした声に、俺は問い返す。
lines.translated: Hearing her mumbled voice, I asked back.

lines.content: 泣いちゃう……？
lines.translated: "End up crying...?"

lines.content: ……クロ？
lines.translated: "...Kuro?"

lines.content: わたし。大雅の前で、たくさん、たくさん……泣いちゃった……し
lines.translated: "Because I... I already cried so, so much... right in front of you, Taiga."

lines.content: ぐすりと鼻を啜る――微かな気配を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: A soft sniffle--I thought I heard the faint sound of her catching her breath.

lines.content: 見られた
lines.translated: "You saw me."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅に、見られた
lines.translated: "You saw me, Taiga."

lines.content: 泣いてるところ……見られた
lines.translated: "You saw me... crying."

lines.content: だから、だめ
lines.translated: "So, no."

lines.content: 電話じゃないと話せない。大雅と会えない。会いたくない
lines.translated: "I can only talk to you over the phone. I can't see you, Taiga. I don't want to see you."

lines.content: ……とっても。すっごく。恥ずかしい、から
lines.translated: "...Because it's really, super embarrassing."

lines.content: 記憶が途切れる前に見たクロの泣き顔。
lines.translated: Kuro's tear-stained face, which I had seen right before my consciousness faded.

lines.content: それを思い出しながら、俺は言うのだ。
lines.translated: Remembering it, I spoke up.

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: ……なに？
lines.translated: "...What is it?"

lines.content: うん。……あのさ。クロはさ、こうして電話で話すときだけ……
lines.translated: "Nothing. ...Well, just that whenever we talk on the phone like this, Kuro..."

lines.content: “少し、素直になるよね”
lines.translated: "You get a little more honest with me, don't you?"

lines.content: 改めてそう言いたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to say that to her outright.

lines.content: “こうして話をするときは口数が多くなるよね”、と。
lines.translated: "You get a lot more talkative when we chat like this," I wanted to tell her.

lines.content: “それがすごくうれしいよ”
lines.translated: "And that makes me really happy."

lines.content: “だからさ。俺、そんなクロと、もっともっと、いっぱい話をしていたいんだ”
lines.translated: "That's why I want to keep talking with you like this, more and more."

lines.content: そんなふうに続く言葉ごと、俺はふわふわ燻る心を削った。
lines.translated: Along with the words that would have followed, I pared back the warm, smoldering feelings in my heart.

lines.content: ……こんな本音をもし安易に伝えてしまったら、今夜はもうクロが電話を続けてくれないかもしれない……そう、思ったからだ。
lines.translated: Because I figured that if I carelessly let those true feelings slip, Kuro might not stay on the phone with me any longer tonight.

lines.content: 電話になると、なに……？
lines.translated: "When we're on the phone, I what...?"

lines.content: 電話の向こうでクロが小首をかしげている――その仕草が手に取るように思い描けた。
lines.translated: I could vividly picture Kuro tilting her head in confusion on the other end of the line.

lines.content: わたしは大雅と電話で話すとき……どうなるの？
lines.translated: "How do I get... when I talk to you on the phone, Taiga?"

lines.content: ううん。何でもない。気にしないで
lines.translated: "Nah, it's nothing. Don't worry about it."

lines.content: ……なんだか
lines.translated: Somehow,

lines.content: クロが電話の向こうで目を細めた……気がする。
lines.translated: I had a feeling... that Kuro was narrowing her eyes at me on the other end of the phone.

lines.content: ……なんだか。大雅に恥ずかしいこと、考えられてるような気がするよ
lines.translated: "...Somehow, I have a feeling you're thinking something embarrassing about me, Taiga."

lines.content: そしてクロは頬を膨らませている……そんなクロの姿を俺は思い描いた。
lines.translated: And she was puffing out her cheeks... That was the image of Kuro I pictured in my mind.

lines.content: ああ、うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. You're right."

lines.content: そうかもしれないねと笑い、俺はごろりと寝返りを打つ。
lines.translated: Laughing and admitting that might be the case, I rolled over in bed.

lines.content: なぜかな。
lines.translated: Why is it?

lines.content: どうしてかな。
lines.translated: How come?

lines.content: うまく、眠れなかった。
lines.translated: I just couldn't fall asleep.

lines.content: 今夜はそれなりに忙しい日だった。
lines.translated: Tonight had been a reasonably busy day.

lines.content: 命の危険を経験することが“それなり”なのかとは思うものの……。
lines.translated: Though I wasn't sure if experiencing a brush with death really counted as "reasonably" busy...

lines.content: とにかく身体も心も疲れているはずだった。眠ることに苦労する理由はどこを探しても見当たらない。そのような一日であるはずだったのだ。
lines.translated: Regardless, both my mind and body should have been exhausted. I couldn't find a single reason why I'd have trouble falling asleep. It was supposed to have been that kind of day.

lines.content: それなのに、眠れない。時間ばかりがじりじりと過ぎては消えてゆく。
lines.translated: Even so, sleep eluded me. Time simply crept by, agonizingly slow, before slipping away.

lines.content: このままでは調整した七時間、ずっと睡魔の足音に耳を澄ませながら過ごさなければならない……焦れば焦るほど眠りの時間は遠ざかっていくようだった。
lines.translated: At this rate, I'd have to spend all seven of the hours I'd set aside just straining my ears for the footsteps of the sandman... The more impatient I grew, the further away sleep seemed to drift.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: ふと、君が俺の名前を呼んだ。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, you called my name.

lines.content: 君は『眠れないの？』と俺に問う。
lines.translated: "Can't sleep?" you asked me.

lines.content: 俺は『そうだね』と、君に応える。
lines.translated: "Yeah," I answered you.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……どうしても、気になることがあるんだ
lines.translated: "...There's just something I can't get off my mind."

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 今日の俺は、ベストを尽くせたのかな
lines.translated: "I keep wondering if I really did my best today."

lines.content: べすと……それは、どういうこと？
lines.translated: "B-e-s-t... What does that mean?"

lines.content: うん。あのさ
lines.translated: "Well, you know..."

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: ……今日は色々なことがあった日だけど、もっと上手に色々なことをこなせたんじゃないのかな、って
lines.translated: "...A lot happened today, and I can't help thinking I could've handled things much better."

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 俺はもっと、もっと上手に、色々とこなす必要があったんじゃ、ないのかな
lines.translated: "That I needed to handle everything much, much better than I did."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|人]ならきっとそうできたはずなのだ――ここにいるのが俺ではなく、[・|あ][・|の][・|人]ならば。誰もが憧れるヒーローならば。
lines.translated: *He* surely could have done it--if it were *him* here instead of me. If I were the hero everyone admired.

lines.content: ああ。何を馬鹿なことを考えているのか。
lines.translated: Ah. What kind of stupid thoughts am I having?

lines.content: 俺は心でため息をつく。
lines.translated: I sighed inwardly.

lines.content: こんなことばかりを考えてしまっているから眠れなくなってしまうのだ――それはちゃんと、わかっている。わかっている、はずなのに。
lines.translated: Dwelling on things like this is the exact reason I can't fall asleep--I know that full well. I'm supposed to know that, and yet...

lines.content: 止まらない。ぐるぐるぐるぐる。“夜”色の思考は止めどない。
lines.translated: It won't stop. Round and round and round. These "Night"-colored thoughts spin endlessly.

lines.content: 俺……思うんだ
lines.translated: "You know... I've been thinking."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 深く。静かに。うなずいてくれる君の声。
lines.translated: Deeply. Quietly. I heard you nod in agreement over the line.

lines.content: 大雅はなにを、思うの？
lines.translated: "Thinking about what, Taiga?"

lines.content: ああ。……きっと“睡魔”は、後ろ向きな奴が大嫌いなんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Well... I bet the 'sandman' really hates pessimists."

lines.content: 心地いい眠りを連れてくる“睡魔”は、“夢”の中で一緒に遊びたい盛りの小さな女の子なんだよ
lines.translated: "The 'sandman' who brings pleasant sleep is actually a little girl at that age where she just wants to play together in our 'dreams.'"

lines.content: だから暗いことばかり考えてるとそっぽを向かれてしまうんだ。……きっと、きっとね
lines.translated: "So if you only think about dark,gloomy things, she'll turn her back on you. ...I'm sure of it."

lines.content: そしてますます眠れなくなってしまうんだ。
lines.translated: And then it becomes even harder to fall asleep.

lines.content: やんちゃ盛りな[睡魔|女の子]に好いて貰うには、きっと、楽しいことだけ考えてないとだめなんだ……。
lines.translated: To get a playful little girl like that to like you, you probably have to think only about fun things...

lines.content: クロはほんの少しの沈黙を挟んだ後に、
lines.translated: After a brief moment of silence, Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: そうかもしれないね、と囁くように言う。
lines.translated: "Maybe you're right," she whispered.

lines.content: 大雅の“睡魔”についての話は、よくわからないけど……、人の心は[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う]にできている……みたい、だから
lines.translated: "I don't really understand your story about the 'sandman'... but it seems like the human heart is *made that way*."

lines.content: そういうふうに？
lines.translated: "Made that way?"

lines.content: うん。そう、だよ……。ベッドの中で難しいことばかりを考えるから、どうしても、どうしても……眠れなくなってしまう。そういうイキモノ。それが、人間
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right... When they lie in bed and only think about complicated things, they just can't... can't fall asleep no matter what. That's the kind of creature they are. That's what humans are."

lines.content: ……まあ、そうかもね
lines.translated: "...Well, maybe so."

lines.content: わたしは、おばかだから……だから、上手にいえないかも、だけど
lines.translated: "I'm kind of dumb... so I might not be able to say this very well, but..."

lines.content: 少しの沈黙のあと、クロは言う。
lines.translated: After another short pause, Kuro continued.

lines.content: 人の心は複雑だし、難解だし、厄介だし、繊細なんだよ。……大雅。きみはたぶん、誰よりもずっと
lines.translated: "The human heart is complicated, hard to understand, troublesome, and delicate. ...Taiga. Yours probably is, far more than anyone else's."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はきっと、[・|や][・|さ][・|し][・|い][・|大][・|雅]だけの、キラキラの宝物だって、わたしはね、思うけど……
lines.translated: "I think *that* is a sparkling treasure that belongs only to *kind, gentle Taiga*, you know...?"

lines.content: だけどそれはとても、とっても、重たくて……時どきトゲトゲしていて、痛いんだ。だからきみは、[・|き][・|っ][・|と][・|誰][・|よ][・|り][・|大][・|変][・|な][・|ん][・|だ][・|ね]
lines.translated: "But it's very, very heavy... and sometimes it's spiky, and it hurts. That's why *it must be harder for you than for anyone else*."

lines.content: やっぱりどこかつたない口調で、クロは俺にそう言ってくれる。
lines.translated: In that somewhat halting, awkward way of hers, Kuro told me that.

lines.content: だから、楽しいことだけを数えよう。今日あったこと……、明日、あるかもしれないこと
lines.translated: "So let's only count the fun things. Things that happened today... and things that might happen tomorrow."

lines.content: 昔みたいに？
lines.translated: "Like we used to?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: ふたりで、一緒に……？
lines.translated: "The two of us, together...?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうだよ。一緒に
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right. Together."

lines.content: 夜空の星を、見上げるみたいに――と、少し照れくさそうな声で君が言ってくれた。
lines.translated: "Just like looking up at the stars in the night sky--" you added, your voice sounding a little shy.

lines.content: だから俺は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: So I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: みんなと、約束をしたんだ
lines.translated: "I made a promise with everyone."

lines.content: どんな約束？
lines.translated: "What kind of promise?"

lines.content: ……明日みんなで集まって、お菓子を買って、お花見をしようって
lines.translated: "...To get together tomorrow, buy some snacks, and go cherry blossom viewing."

lines.content: そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: ああ、そうなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, really."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: お菓子は三百円まで。誰が一番、上手にお買い物できるか勝負もするんだ
lines.translated: "The limit for snacks is three hundred yen. We're even going to have a contest to see who can do the best shopping."

lines.content: それは……とても、すごく、楽しそうだね
lines.translated: "That... sounds really, super fun."

lines.content: ふと、君が微笑んでくれたように思えた。
lines.translated: For a moment, I felt as though you were smiling.

lines.content: でも、きっと、ひよちゃんは……姫織は花より駄菓子なんだろうなあって思う。油断してたら俺のぶんのお菓子も全部食べられちゃったりするんだろうなあって
lines.translated: "Still, I bet Hiyo-chan... I mean, Himeori, cares more about the cheap sweets than the flowers. If I let my guard down, she'll probably eat all of my snacks, too."

lines.content: ……そんな明日のことを想像すると。
lines.translated: When I imagined a tomorrow like that.

lines.content: どうしてだろう。自然と頬が緩んだ。
lines.translated: I wonder why. My cheeks naturally relaxed into a smile.

lines.content: 遠いとおい未来のことより、顔を上げればすぐそこに在る時間を想像することのほうが、なぜか、ずっとずっと難しいときもあるけれど――
lines.translated: Sometimes, for whatever reason, imagining the time waiting right in front of you if you just lift your head is much, much harder than imagining a far-off, distant future--

lines.content: クロ
lines.translated: Kuro

lines.content: なに？
