lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: クロも一緒に、みんなと、一緒に……お花見できればいい
lines.translated: "I wish you could come cherry blossom viewing with us too, Kuro... together with everyone."

lines.content: そんな未来をひとつだけ、俺は思い浮かべていたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to hold on to just that one vision of the future.

lines.content: そんな未来がいつか、いつの日か、やって来ればいいと……思ってる
lines.translated: "I hope a future like that comes someday... one of these days."

lines.content: そんな身勝手な未来を[まぶた|瞼]の向こうに“想像”してしまう。
lines.translated: Behind my closed eyelids, I "imagined" that selfish future.

lines.content: そこにはもう闇はなかった。
lines.translated: There was no darkness there anymore.

lines.content: ……夢なのか。幻なのか。
lines.translated: Was it a dream? Or an illusion?
*What was there was your profile.*

lines.content: 春だ。
lines.translated: It was spring.

lines.content: 甘い香りの春の花が辺り一面に咲き綻ぶ。
lines.translated: Sweetly fragrant spring flowers bloomed in profusion all around us.

lines.content: はらはら、はらり。
lines.translated: Fluttering, drifting down.

lines.content: さくらの花びらが降り注ぐ中、ふたり一緒に身体を寄せた。
lines.translated: Amidst the falling cherry blossom petals, the two of us nestled close together.

lines.content: 小さな君は、また、かわいいその鼻先に花びらを乗せ――
lines.translated: Tiny as you are, you had a petal resting on the tip of your cute little nose again--

lines.content: 淡く微笑むかのような眼差しで、満開の春色を静かに見上げ――
lines.translated: Gazing quietly up at the full-bloom colors of spring, a faint smile in your eyes--

lines.content: お酒の入った大人向けのチョコレートを、おっかなびっくり、ちびちびと舐めているから……。
lines.translated: Timidly nibbling away at a grown-up chocolate filled with liquor...

lines.content: 小さく冷たいその頬は、降り止まない花びらみたいに薄紅色で……。
lines.translated: Your small, cool cheeks were a pale pink, just like the endlessly falling petals...

lines.content: 笑い声がする。
lines.translated: I could hear laughter.

lines.content: 笑顔が溢れる。
lines.translated: Smiles were everywhere.

lines.content: 君も、みんなと一緒に笑い合えるような時間がどこかにないかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if there's a time somewhere out there where you, too, can laugh together with everyone.

lines.content: そしてそんな君が、俺の名前をそっと呼んでくれたりしないかな。
lines.translated: And I wonder if that version of you might softly call my name.
"...Taiga."

lines.content: ぴったり俺の隣に座ったまま……君が、俺の手をそっと握ってくれたりしないかな。
lines.translated: Sitting right next to me... I wonder if you might gently take my hand.

lines.content: 『……ねえ、大雅』
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 鼻にかわいいピンク色の[ひとひら|一片]を乗せたまま、俺を見上げて、笑顔で、また何度も俺の名前を呼んでくれたりは、しないかな。
lines.translated: With a cute pink petal resting on your nose, looking up at me with a smile, I wonder if you might call my name over and over again.

lines.content: ……突然の風が吹き抜け、さくらの花びらが舞い上がる。
lines.translated: A sudden breeze blows through, sending the cherry blossom petals dancing into the air.

lines.content: そして俺は、ぼくたちは、繋いだ手と手にぎゅっと力を込めるのだ。
lines.translated: And I--both of us--squeeze our joined hands tightly.

lines.content: そんな様子をみんなに見られて、あたふたしたり、照れて笑って見せたりもして……。
lines.translated: Everyone sees us like that, and we get all flustered, laughing shyly...

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: お願いだ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: ……そんな明日が、くればいい
lines.translated: "...I hope a tomorrow like that comes."

lines.content: ……クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: 大切な、大切な、俺の友だち。
lines.translated: My precious, precious friend.

lines.content: 君とふたり一緒に思い描いた明日は、きらきらで、まぶしくて……。
lines.translated: The tomorrow I pictured together with you was sparkling and dazzlingly bright...

lines.content: うつら、うつらと、“睡魔”の足音が近づいてきた。
lines.translated: Drowsily, driftingly, the footsteps of the "sandman" drew near.

lines.content: 眠れない夜の終わりがやってきた。
lines.translated: The end of my sleepless night had arrived.

lines.content: クロと電話で話ながら、ふと意識が落ちていく――その感覚はとても心地のいいものだった。
lines.translated: While talking on the phone with Kuro, my consciousness began to fade--and the sensation was a deeply comforting one.

lines.content: このまま意識をゆだねていたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to just surrender my consciousness to it like this.

lines.content: だから最後にひとつだけ、お祈りを、しよう。
lines.translated: So let me say just one last prayer.

lines.content: お願いだ、“夜の神さま”
lines.translated: "Please, 'God of the Night.'"

lines.content: はっきりしっかり思い描けたこの光景が……“夜”の中で、静かに、そっと、芽吹きますように
lines.translated: "May this vision I've pictured so clearly and Vividly... quietly, gently sprout within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 俺は祈った。
lines.translated: I prayed.
*Even though I knew full well that such a thing must never come to pass.*

lines.content: それでも祈った。
lines.translated: Even so, I prayed.

lines.content: 祈り続けた。
lines.translated: I kept on praying.

lines.content: せめて夢の中だけでも、幸せな心でありたいと願いながら……。
lines.translated: Wishing that at least in my dreams, my heart could be happy...

lines.content: 通話が途切れた。
lines.translated: The call disconnected.

lines.content: 耳元につー、つー、という音が繰り返し響いている。
lines.translated: A steady *beep, beep* echoed repeatedly in my ear.

lines.content: わたしは暗い場所にひとり、うずくまっていた。
lines.translated: I was crouching all alone in a dark place.

lines.content: 真っ黒な電話の受話器を静かにわたしは降ろす。
lines.translated: Quietly, I lowered the pitch-black receiver of the telephone.

lines.content: かちゃり
lines.translated: *Click.*

lines.content: 君とわたしが切り離される音がして――少し、ほんの少し、胸がずきりとしてしまう。
lines.translated: At the sound of you and me being severed from one another--my chest gave a little, just a tiny little twinge.

lines.content: この“痛み”の正体は、まだわたしにはわからない。……わからない、ふりをする。
lines.translated: I still don't know what this "pain" really is. ...Or rather, I pretend not to know.

lines.content: 次から次へと色々な想いが溢れてくる“心”という“何か”は、わたしの胸の内側で、ただただいつでも騒がしい。
lines.translated: This "something" called a "heart," overflowing with all sorts of feelings one after another, is always just so noisy inside my chest.

lines.content: 数えるだけで日が暮れそうなほど、たくさん、たくさんの想いはすべて無視できますようにと、首を振り……。
lines.translated: I shook my head, praying that I could ignore all of these countless, endless feelings--so many it would take all day just to count them...

lines.content: わたしは扉を薄く、開けてみた。
lines.translated: I cracked the door open just a sliver.

lines.content: 大雅の部屋だ。
lines.translated: It was Taiga's room.

lines.content: そっと覗いた先の寝床には、眠る大雅が静かな寝息を立てている。
lines.translated: Peeking softly inside, I saw Taiga fast asleep in bed, breathing quietly.

lines.content: 電話で大雅と話していたのは、この扉を挟んですぐそこの廊下だった。
lines.translated: I had been talking to him on the phone from the hallway right on the other side of this door.

lines.content: 両膝を抱きかかえるような形で座り、時には扉に背中をぴったりつけて……大雅と話しをしていた。
lines.translated: Sitting with my arms wrapped around my knees, sometimes pressing my back flat against the door... I had been talking with Taiga.

lines.content: それなのにどうして、いや……だからこそ、『……今、どこにいる？』と大雅に問いかけられても、『すぐ側にいる』と、わたしは応えられなかった。
lines.translated: And yet why--no, *because* of that, even when Taiga asked me, "...Where are you right now?", I couldn't answer, "I'm right beside you."

lines.content: そんなふうに答えてしまったら、わたしは今すぐにでもこの扉を開いて……。
lines.translated: Because if I had answered like that, I would have opened this door right then and there, and...

lines.content: ふるふると首を振った。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: ふと芽生えたこんな気持ちにも、わたしは見えないふりをする。
lines.translated: I pretend not to see these feelings that suddenly sprouted inside me, too.

lines.content: そんなわたしは、少し……眠る大雅の側で、その寝顔をほんの少しだけ見つめることにした。
lines.translated: Instead, I decided to stay beside the sleeping Taiga for a bit... and just gaze at his sleeping face for a little while.

lines.content: それくらいなら大丈夫。平気。許してもらえる、はずだよね……。
lines.translated: Just that much should be fine. It's okay. I'll be forgiven for this much, right...?

lines.content: 恐る恐る、ゆっくり、ゆっくり。
lines.translated: Timidly, slowly, ever so slowly.

lines.content: 私は眠る大雅の傍に近寄った。
lines.translated: I crept closer to the sleeping Taiga's side.

lines.content: よかった……。
lines.translated: Thank goodness...

lines.content: わたしは心でため息をつく。
lines.translated: I breathed a sigh of relief in my heart.

lines.content: いつも大雅の横顔は苦しそうだった。
lines.translated: Taiga's profile always looked so pained.

lines.content: 眉間にぐっと皺を寄せ――何か、遠い日の何かに苦しめられているような――激しい“悪夢”に襲われているような、そんな表情を浮かべていることが、多いけど。
lines.translated: His brow would be tightly furrowed--as if he were being tormented by something from a distant day--as if he were being assaulted by a violent "nightmare." He wore an expression like that so often, and yet.

lines.content: 今日は少し……少しだけ、大雅。きみの寝顔が、やさしいね
lines.translated: "Today, just a little... just a little bit, Taiga. Your sleeping face looks so peaceful."

lines.content: 眠る大雅の頭をそっと撫でてみた。
lines.translated: I gently stroked the sleeping Taiga's head.

lines.content: 指先が大雅の白くてすべすべしている額を何度も掠める。
lines.translated: My fingertips brushed across his pale, smooth forehead again and again.

lines.content: その度に大雅のことを起こしてしまわないようにと……そっと、そっと、気をつけて。
lines.translated: Being careful each time... softly, gently, so as not to wake him up.

lines.content: でも。でもね。
lines.translated: But. You know what?

lines.content: ……大雅、ずるいよ
lines.translated: "...Taiga, it's not fair."

lines.content: わたしはつい、頬を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was puffing out my cheeks.

lines.content: 人間は、大雅は、こんなに大きくなれるのに……わたしはずっと、いつまでもずっと、小さいままだ
lines.translated: "Humans--you, Taiga--can grow up this big... while I stay small forever, and ever, and ever."

lines.content: ……まだまだきみが小さかったいつかの日は、わたしがこうして撫で撫でしてあげなきゃ、君は、いつまでも眠れない子どもだったのにな……
lines.translated: "...Back on those days when you were still so little, you were a kid who could never fall asleep unless I patted your head just like this..."

lines.content: そう、つぶやくと……。
lines.translated: As I murmured that...

lines.content: わたしの胸はまたひとつ、ずきりと軋んだ。
lines.translated: My chest gave another sharp, creaking twinge.

lines.content: 痛いばかりの胸の音で、大雅が目を覚ましてしまわないかと心配になるけれど……。
lines.translated: I worried that the agonizingly loud sound of my aching heart might wake Taiga up, and yet...

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: わたしは、わたしの今日はね、大雅。うれしいことをひとつ、見つけられた日だったよ
lines.translated: "As for me, my day today, Taiga... was a day where I found one happy thing."

lines.content: 思い出すだけで頬が緩んでしまうけど……別にいいよね。
lines.translated: Just remembering it makes my cheeks relax into a smile... well, I guess that's okay.

lines.content: これくらいなら平気だよね。大丈夫、だよね。君を起こしたりはしないよね。
lines.translated: Just this much is fine, right? It's okay, right? It won't wake you up, right?

lines.content: 大雅は姫織の代わりに、先生に怒られていたね
lines.translated: "You let the teacher scold you in Himeori's place, didn't you, Taiga?"

lines.content: 押しつけられた課題とか、色々面倒なことも、ひとつも文句を言わずに引き受けていたよね
lines.translated: "The assignments pushed onto her, and all sorts of other troublesome things... you took them all on without a single complaint."

lines.content: それは、大雅にとって特に何でもないことで、別にふつうのことだったのかもしれないけれど……わたしはすごいって、思ったんだよ。
lines.translated: Maybe to you, Taiga, it wasn't any big deal, just a normal thing to do... but I thought it was amazing.

lines.content: ……大雅。格好良かった。男の子だなあって思ったよ。わたし、なんだかとっても、うれしい気持ちになれちゃったんだ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You were so cool. It made me think, 'He really is a boy.' Somehow, it made me feel so, so happy."

lines.content: そんなきみを見つけられたわたしの今日は、とってもきらきらな日だったなあって、思うんだ
lines.translated: "Being able to see that side of you made my day today feel so sparkling and bright."

lines.content: 充分だと、そう思う。
lines.translated: That's enough for me, I think.

lines.content: 遠くできみのことを見つめられているだけで……。
lines.translated: Just being able to watch over you from afar...

lines.content: それだけで、わたしは充分。
lines.translated: That alone is enough for me.

lines.content: とても。すごく。……たぶん、幸せ。
lines.translated: Very. So very much. ...Probably, I'm happy.

lines.content: あとは……明日も、明後日も、ずっとずっと、きみが今日みたいにやさしい顔で、眠りにつければ……
lines.translated: "Now, if only... tomorrow, and the day after tomorrow, and forever and ever, you can fall asleep with a peaceful face like today..."

lines.content: それ以上わたしが望むものはない。何もない。
lines.translated: There is nothing more I could wish for. Nothing at all.

lines.content: わたしはきみが幸せでいられればそれでいいんだ。
lines.translated: As long as you can be happy, that's all I need.

lines.content: たとえ世界中を敵に回してしまったとしても、わたしはきみの笑顔があればそれでいい。
lines.translated: Even if I were to make an enemy of the entire world, as long as I have your smile, that's enough for me.
*Because that is the one and only reason I am here.*

lines.content: 大雅の手をそっと握った。
lines.translated: I gently took Taiga's hand.

lines.content: その手のひらを少しの間、じっと見つめたり、にぎにぎしてみたりして……わたしは、
lines.translated: Gazing intently at his palm for a little while, giving his hand little squeezes... I...

lines.content: ……さよなら
lines.translated: "...Goodbye."

lines.content: わたしは、つぶやく。
lines.translated: I murmured.

lines.content: さよなら……バイバイ。元気でね
lines.translated: "Goodbye... bye-bye. Take care."

lines.content: いつもきみの隣に、幸せな魔法がありますように……
lines.translated: "May there always be happy magic right beside you..."

lines.content: きみの未来にたくさん、たくさん、きらきらの星が降ることを……わたしはそれだけを、いつも、思い描くよ
lines.translated: "May countless, endless sparkling stars rain down upon your future... That is the only thing I will always picture."

lines.content: ……くらりとした。
lines.translated: A wave of dizziness washed over me.

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 悪戯好きの睡魔に[まぶた|瞼]を重く、掴まれた。
lines.translated: A mischievous sandman grabbed hold of my eyelids, making them heavy.

lines.content: だけど……、平気。
lines.translated: But... I'm fine.

lines.content: まだ、がまんできるよ。
lines.translated: I can still hold out.

lines.content: 今度はたぶん、もう少しだけ長く、きみの側にいられる。
lines.translated: This time, I can probably stay by your side just a little bit longer.

lines.content: そう、思った。
lines.translated: That was what I thought.

lines.content: 君たちは私の“魔法”だ。その関係は拳銃と弾丸に良くよく似ている――
lines.translated: "You all are my 'magic.' Our relationship is very, very much like that of a gun and its bullets--"

lines.content: ……満月の夜。
lines.translated: A night of the full moon.

lines.content: 静かに開かれた二度目の夜会で、“魔法使い”がそう言った。
lines.translated: At the quietly held second night party, the "Magician" spoke those words.

lines.content: まずは今夜も引き続き、君らにはもう少しだけこの“[世界|夜の国]”について……
lines.translated: "First, continuing on from last time, tonight I'd like to tell you a little more about this 'Land of Night'..."

lines.content: そしていずれ姿を現すだろう“夜の王”や“悪夢”と対抗するための方法について伝えておこうと思う
lines.translated: "As well as how to stand against the 'King of the Night' and the 'Nightmares' that will eventually show themselves."

lines.content: 奥座敷である。またここに集められた俺たちを前に、“夜の魔法使い”は[べん|鞭]を取る。
lines.translated: We were in the inner parlor. In front of us, gathered here once again, the "Magician of the Night" took up her pointer.

lines.content: もう薄々感づいてはいるだろうけど――私はこう見えて、人間ではない。正体は猫だ。“夜”の力を借り受けて、こうして人の形を取っている。[・|私][・|た][・|ち]はそういうイキモノだ
lines.translated: "You've probably vaguely caught on by now, but--despite how I look, I'm not human. My true form is a cat. I'm borrowing the power of the 'Night' to take on a human shape like this. That is the kind of creature *we* are."

lines.content: 古くから君ら人間の側に寄り添い……なぜだか無条件に、君らの未来に幸せがありますようにと祈り続ける存在だ
lines.translated: "Beings who have stayed close beside you humans since ancient times... and who, for whatever reason, unconditionally keep praying for happiness in your futures."

lines.content: 神さまみたいな“何か”が私たちをそう設計したんだろうさ。まったく、やれやれ。迷惑な話だ
lines.translated: "Some 'something' like a god probably designed us that way. Good grief, honestly. What a nuisance."

lines.content: とにかく私たちはそういうイキモノ。よろしくな。“魔法使い”は繰り返しそう言った。
lines.translated: "Anyway, that's the kind of creature we are. Nice to meet you." The "Magician" repeated those words.

lines.content: そんな私たちは君らよりもずっと長生きで、不死ではないが、不老なるイキモノだ。ずっとずっと若いまま。ずっと、ずっと、幼いままだ
lines.translated: "We live much longer than you all. We aren't immortal, but we are ageless creatures. Forever and ever young. Forever, and ever, childlike."

lines.content: ……その反面。刹那を生きる君ら人間のようなうつくしい“想像力”を、その命の使い道を選択する一瞬の勇気を、私たちは持ち得ない
lines.translated: "...On the flip side, we cannot possess the beautiful 'imagination' of you humans who live in the fleeting moment, nor the momentary courage to choose how to use your lives."

lines.content: いつだって“想像力”こそが“魔法”なんだと“魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: It is always "imagination" that is true "magic," the "Magician" said.

lines.content: “夜”の中でも。“太陽”の下ででも。
lines.translated: Both within the "Night," and beneath the "Sun."

lines.content: “涙のうちに種蒔く者は、喜びの内に刈り取る”
lines.translated: "'They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.'"

lines.content: “魔法使い”はぽつりとそう言い、微笑む。少し照れたように。
lines.translated: The "Magician" murmured the quote and smiled, looking a little shy.

lines.content: ……これはね、君らの祖先が、詩人という名の“魔法使い”が、[・|君][・|ら][・|宛][・|に]残した言葉だけれど……
lines.translated: "...These are words left behind *addressed to you all* by your ancestors--by 'magicians' known as poets..."

lines.content: 私は詩を編む人こそが本当の“魔法使い”だと思うんだ、と“夜の魔法使い”はそう言った。
lines.translated: "I believe that those who weave poetry are the true 'magicians,'" the "Magician of the Night" said.

lines.content: 詩人はね、きっと時を超えた言葉の配達人なんだよ
lines.translated: "Poets, you see, are surely couriers of words that transcend time."

lines.content: 遠いとおい過去の時間から、[今|現在]を悲しみの中で生きる君らへと、応援のメッセージを送り続けてくれているんだよ、と。……そのように説いた人間がいた。私もそう、信じてる
lines.translated: "From a distant, faraway past, they continue to send messages of encouragement to you who live in sorrow in the present. ...There was once a human who preached that. And I believe it, too."

lines.content: 遠いとおい過去の時間。
lines.translated: A distant, faraway past.

lines.content: 様々な悲しみの中、色々な苦しみの中、それでも負けず――
lines.translated: Amidst all kinds of sorrow, amidst all sorts of suffering, refusing to give in--

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: たとえ負けてしまったとしてももう一度立ち上がり、傷つきながら、泣きながら、最後まで生き抜いた強くうつくしい心の持ち主。
lines.translated: And even if they were defeated, standing back up once more, hurting, crying, yet surviving all the way to the end--people with strong, beautiful hearts.

lines.content: そんな“誰か”の心の中から産まれた言葉は、きっと、受け取る誰をも勇気づける“魔法”となるはず……。
lines.translated: Words born from the heart of "someone" like that are sure to become "magic" that gives courage to anyone who receives them...

lines.content: ……そんな心のこもった言葉は、がんばれって、負けるなって、そんなふうにしか伝えられない私には、とうてい、作り上げることのできない“魔法”なんだよ
lines.translated: "...Words filled with that much heart are a 'magic' I could never possibly create--not when all I know how to say is 'do your best' or 'don't give up.'"

lines.content: 君ら人間がその“想像力”で作り出したもの――それは[詩|言葉]だけではない。
lines.translated: What you humans create with your "imagination"--it isn't limited to just poetry and words.

lines.content: 絵画や音楽や物語や……そういった作品世界に込められた想いに、私たちはいつもいつでも、心を掴まれ、憧れ、魅了され止まないのだと、“魔法使い”は微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: The feelings poured into worlds of art, music, stories... We are always, endlessly captivated, filled with longing, and enchanted by them, the "Magician" said with a smile.

lines.content: ……そのような“想像力”こそが、ここでは……この“夜”の中では、何者にも代えがたい“魔法”となるんだよ、と。
lines.translated: And it is precisely that kind of "imagination" that becomes an irreplaceable "magic" here... within this "Night."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。そのようなうつくしい心を持たない私には“魔法”が使えない――だから厳密に言えば“魔法使い”ではない
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. Lacking a heart as beautiful as that, I cannot use 'magic'--so strictly speaking, I am not a 'magician.'"

lines.content: まあ、“夜”の中に散らばり落ちてる“夢のかけら”を編んで、魔法のような力を発揮する道具を作ることはできうるが――
lines.translated: "Well, I *can* weave together the 'fragments of dreams' scattered throughout the 'Night' to craft tools that exhibit magical powers, but--"

lines.content: 今こうして議題にあげているのはそういった即席の魔法についてではない。
lines.translated: What she was bringing up for discussion right now wasn't that kind of makeshift magic.

lines.content: [今|現在]を生きる俺たちが、悲しい出来事に負けないようにと願えるものだ。
lines.translated: It was something we, who live in the present, could wish for so that we wouldn't be defeated by tragic events.

lines.content: そして“夜”の中にうごめく悪意と対抗するためのものなのだ。
lines.translated: And it was something to stand against the malice squirming within the "Night."

lines.content: そのための“魔法”は、俺たちの心の中にこそある“想像力”なのだと、改めて“魔法使い”はそう言った。
lines.translated: The "magic" needed for that, the "Magician" reiterated, was the "imagination" dwelling right inside our own hearts.

lines.content: だから、どうか……お願いだ。君らに私の“魔法”に、なってほしいんだ
lines.translated: "So, please... I'm begging you. I want you all to become my 'magic.'"

lines.content: ――私たちが、“魔法”になる？
lines.translated: --Become her "magic"?

lines.content: 誰かがそっと手を上げそう言った。
lines.translated: Someone timidly raised a hand and asked that.

lines.content: ――それっていったい、どういうことなの？
lines.translated: --What on earth does that mean?

lines.content: 不安そうなその声は誰のものだっただろう。
lines.translated: Whose anxious voice was that, I wonder?

lines.content: ハルだろうか。千和だろうか。姫織だろうか。それとも……クロだっただろうか。
lines.translated: Was it Haru? Was it Chiwa? Was it Himeori? Or... could it have been Kuro?

lines.content: そのか細い声に“魔法使い”は微笑み、応える。
lines.translated: The "Magician" smiled at that faint voice and answered.

lines.content: ああ。君ら自身が未来を造る――そのための“魔法”なんだよ
lines.translated: "Yes. You all will build the future yourselves--it is the 'magic' for that purpose."

lines.content: ……君たちの“魔法”は誰にも負けない“想像力”だ。しかし君らは、君ら自身の心の力を思い通りには操れないだろう
lines.translated: "...Your 'magic' is an 'imagination' second to none. However, you probably can't control the power of your own hearts at will."

lines.content: 今の君らが、“夜”の中で“[想像力|魔法]”を使おうとしてみても、その思考は君らの意思など関係なく、めちゃくちゃに暴れ出してしまうはずだ
lines.translated: "Even if you tried to use your 'magic' of imagination within the 'Night' as you are now, your thoughts would surely run wild and out of control, regardless of your will."

lines.content: 人間の心は強い力を秘めているが故、いつでもじゃじゃ馬のように制御できない。
lines.translated: Because the human heart hides such immense power, it is always like an untamed horse, impossible to control.

lines.content: 持ち主の思うとおりになど殆どならないのだ。
lines.translated: It almost never does what its owner wants it to do.

lines.content: ……考えたくはない不安にばかりとらわれる。
lines.translated: It gets caught up only in anxieties we don't want to think about.

lines.content: ……信じたくはない恐怖にばかり責め立てられる。
lines.translated: It is hounded only by fears we don't want to believe in.

lines.content: 想像すべきはいつだって光りある未来であるべきはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though what we ought to imagine should always be a bright, shining future.

lines.content: だから“魔法”を使えない私が君らの力を使うんだ。この“夜”のフィールドの中で、私は、君たちの[力|想像]を借り受ける
lines.translated: "That's why I, who cannot use 'magic' myself, will wield your power. Within the field of this 'Night,' I will borrow your strength--your imagination."

lines.content: 私が命じるままに、君らは君らにしか持ち得ない“想像力”を発揮して、“夜”を自在に駆けていく――……
lines.translated: "Following my commands, you will unleash the 'imagination' only you can possess, running freely through the 'Night'--..."

lines.content: そして“魔法使い”は一番近くにいた女の子――柊ハルの手を取った。
lines.translated: Then, the "Magician" took the hand of the girl closest to her--Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: ……ほら、わかるだろう？　今、私は何を考えている？
lines.translated: "...See, you can tell, right? What am I thinking right now?"

lines.content: 微笑んで、言った。
lines.translated: Smiling, she spoke.

lines.content: さあ、“魔法使い”の時間のはじまりだ。おとぎ話の続きをはじめよう
lines.translated: "Now, the time of the 'Magician' begins. Let's start the continuation of our fairy tale."

lines.content: 途端。
lines.translated: In that very instant.

lines.content: ……はらりと。
lines.translated: Fluttering softly.

lines.content: 柊ハルの頭上にひとひらの花びらが舞い降りた。
lines.translated: A single flower petal drifted down onto Hiiragi Haru's head.

lines.content: いったいどこから入り込んできたのだろう。
lines.translated: Where on earth had it slipped in from?

lines.content: ふと、何気なく見上げる。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I casually looked up.

lines.content: するとそこには……満開のさくらがあった。
lines.translated: And right there... were cherry blossoms in full bloom.

lines.content: さっきまであったはずの古い板張りの天井はどこにもない。
lines.translated: The old wood-paneled ceiling that had been there just moments ago was nowhere to be seen.

lines.content: あるのは満開の春色だ。ざわざわと、風に枝を揺らすさくらの天井。
lines.translated: All that was there were the colors of spring in full bloom. A ceiling of cherry blossoms, their branches rustling and swaying in the wind.
"I see. *So this is the kind of 'magic' you are.*"

lines.content: 微笑む“魔法使い”――君はこういう“想像”が得意なんだな、と。
lines.translated: The smiling "Magician" mused--so you're good at this kind of "imagination," huh?

lines.content: 思っていた以上だ。私が命じたのは、ほら、そこの戸棚の上に置いてある花瓶だよ。そこに一輪だけ花を出現させようかとしただけだったんだけど……
lines.translated: "This is more than I expected. What I commanded was, look, that vase sitting on top of the cupboard over there. I only tried to make a single flower appear in it, and yet..."

lines.content: これはすごいなと“魔法使い”は言い、花びら吹雪く天井を見上げ、ため息をついていた。
lines.translated: "This is amazing," the "Magician" said, looking up at the ceiling snowing flower petals and letting out a sigh of admiration.

lines.content: ……しかし花は天井だけではとどまらなかった。
lines.translated: However, the flowers did not stop at just the ceiling.

lines.content: 俺たちの腰を下ろした床が隆起する。
lines.translated: The floor we were sitting on heaved upward.

lines.content: 地面と変わった床をさくらの木の根が突き破り姿を現す。
lines.translated: Cherry tree roots burst through the floor, which had turned into earth, revealing themselves.

lines.content: 頭上のさくらは散れども消えることなく花は増え続け……。
lines.translated: Though the cherry blossoms overhead scattered, they didn't vanish; instead, the flowers kept multiplying...

lines.content: 部屋をいっぱいに埋め始めていた。
lines.translated: They were beginning to fill the entire room.

lines.content: ……ここまでかな。これ以上は危ないか。まだまだ私も君を制御しきれない
lines.translated: "...That's enough for now, I think. Any further might be dangerous. I still can't fully control you yet, either."

lines.content: 繋いだ手を離す。
lines.translated: She let go of her joined hand.

lines.content: すると、パッと音もなく、辺りは元に戻ってしまった。
lines.translated: Instantly, without a sound, our surroundings snapped back to normal.

lines.content: 古い室内。万年こたつの敷かれた“ゆめのねどこ”だ。
lines.translated: The old room. The "Dream Bedchamber" with its year-round kotatsu laid out.

lines.content: カチカチカチと、柱時計の進む音が聞こえていた。
lines.translated: Tick, tock, tick, tock--the sound of the wall clock ticking away echoed.

lines.content: 拳銃と弾丸だ
lines.translated: "A handgun and its bullets."

lines.content: “魔法使い”がそう言った。
lines.translated: The "Magician" said.

lines.content: ……私が心で撃鉄を下ろし、君らの心が現実を撃ち砕く
lines.translated: "...I pull back the hammer with my heart, and your hearts shatter reality."

lines.content: 言い方を変えれば君ら自身が私の“魔法”なんだよ
lines.translated: "To put it another way, you yourselves are my 'magic.'"

lines.content: この“夜”の時間の中で、君らの心から引き出した想像という名の“魔法”を使い、私は、君らの未来に害をなす“夜の王”と戦おうと考えている――
lines.translated: "Within the time of this 'Night,' using the 'magic' called imagination drawn out from your hearts, I intend to fight the 'King of the Night' who seeks to harm your futures--"

lines.content: そこまでの説明や戦争への前準備、そして“夜”の成り立ちを伝え聞かされた俺たちは……。
lines.translated: Having been told all that explanation, the preparations for war, and the very nature of the "Night," we...

lines.content: まだ知り合って二日も経っていない、およそ十年前の幼いばかりの俺たちは、顔を見合わせ、困惑と少しの恐怖とを共有し、分け合っていた。
lines.translated: Roughly ten years ago, when we were just young children who had known each other for barely two days, we looked at one another, sharing and dividing up our confusion and a little bit of fear.

lines.content: “想像”にはもちろん得意分野があるだろう。それぞれがそれぞれに思い描きやすいビジョンだよ。柊ハルちゃん。君が命を操ることが得意なようにね。それが[魔法|君ら]の属性となる
lines.translated: "Naturally, everyone has their own specialty when it comes to 'imagination.' A vision that is easiest for each individual to picture. Hiiragi Haru-chan, just like how you excel at manipulating life. That becomes your magical affinity."

lines.content: そういった君らの個性を把握しておきたい私は、こうして、満月の夜に夜会を開き、君らと言葉を重ねてる
lines.translated: "Because I want to grasp those unique traits of yours, I hold night parties on nights of the full moon like this, exchanging words with you all."

lines.content: そう言う“魔法使い”は更に続ける。
lines.translated: Having said that, the "Magician" continued further.

lines.content: そして、“夜”の中で君たちの[力|想像]をより強力に引き出し、使うには……使う側の私と、使われる側の君らとの“関係性”が重要になってくる
lines.translated: "And in order to draw out and wield your power of imagination even more potently within the 'Night'... the 'relationship' between me, the wielder, and you, the ones being wielded, becomes crucial."

lines.content: 信頼関係こそが魔法を使う“鍵”となるんだと“魔法使い”は言い――
lines.translated: A relationship of trust is the very "key" to using magic, the "Magician" said--

lines.content: どうか、許されるなら……、君らの心を、その言葉を、私に語り聞かせてはくれないだろうか
lines.translated: "Please, if you will allow it... won't you tell me about your hearts, in your own words?"

lines.content: 私も……必要と思ってもらえるのなら、君らに私の心をありのまま、伝えていこうと思ってる
lines.translated: "And if... if you feel it's necessary, I intend to convey my own heart to you all, just as it is."

lines.content: ――少し気恥ずかしそうにはにかむ“魔法使い”は言ったのだ。
lines.translated: --The "Magician" spoke with a slightly bashful, shy smile.

lines.content: 私は君たちこそを自分の“魔法”としたいと思ってる。“夜の王”と戦うために。そのために、心をできるだけ寄り添い合わせて生きていきたいと、願ってる
lines.translated: "I want to make you all my 'magic.' In order to fight the 'King of the Night.' For that sake, I wish to live with our hearts nestled as closely together as possible."

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: だけど、それだけじゃない。
lines.translated: However, that wasn't all.

lines.content: ここでこうして君らと話をする動機は、それだけではないのだ。
lines.translated: Her motive for talking with us here like this wasn't limited to just that.

lines.content: 私は君らとよりよく、今より深く、仲良くなりたいと祈ってる。それは戦争に勝つためだけじゃない。純粋に君らの友人となりたいんだよ
lines.translated: "I pray that I can get along with you better, and much more deeply, than I do now. That isn't just to win the war. I purely want to become your friend."

lines.content: ああ、友人だ。友だちだ。いつか親友にさえならたらいい。互いが互いの人生を応援し合える、そんな、得がたい[・|関][・|係]に……私は、なりたい
lines.translated: "Yes, a friend. A pal. If we could even become best friends someday, that would be wonderful. An irreplaceable *relationship* where we can cheer each other on in our respective lives... That is what I want us to become."

lines.content: なぜなら私は、私たちは、君たち人間のことを無条件に大切にしたいと願ってしまう……そういうふうに生まれついてしまったイキモノだから
lines.translated: "Because I--because we--are creatures born with an unconditional desire to cherish you humans..."

lines.content: 少々後ろ向きだとも思える言葉で表現された“魔法使い”のその言葉。
lines.translated: Those words of the "Magician" were expressed in a way that could seem a little self-deprecating.

lines.content: だからこそあの頃の――幼いながらもどこか捻くれていただろう、俺たちは――自然と“魔法使い”の言葉を受け入れられたのではないかと思う。
lines.translated: And I think that's precisely why back then--even though we were young, we were all probably a bit twisted in our own ways--we were able to naturally accept the "Magician's" words.

lines.content: ……さあ、今夜も聞かせて欲しいんだ。私の大切な“魔法”の卵たち
lines.translated: "...Now, let me hear your stories tonight as well, my precious fledgling 'magics.'"

lines.content: 君たちの“悲しみ”に、本当に、その“魔法”は必要なのか――それを一緒に、考えていこう
lines.translated: "Do you truly need that 'magic' for your 'sorrow'? --Let's think about that together."

lines.content: 夜会のあとはいつも美味しいご飯が待っていた。
lines.translated: After the night party, delicious food was always waiting for us.

lines.content: “魔法使い”はとても料理が上手だった。
lines.translated: The "Magician" was a wonderful cook.

lines.content: 長くながく生きているその中で、俺たち人間の喜ぶ味を、彼女は、俺たちなんかよりもずっと深く理解しているようだった。
lines.translated: Over the course of her long, long life, she seemed to have come to understand the flavors that delight us humans far more deeply than we ever could ourselves.

lines.content: どうかな。口に合うかな
lines.translated: "How is it? Does it suit your tastes?"

lines.content: “魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: The "Magician" said.

lines.content: 美味しいです。とても
lines.translated: "It's delicious. Really delicious."

lines.content: 俺は言った。
lines.translated: I said.

lines.content: 君はいつも俺の隣を離れなかった。
lines.translated: You never once left my side.

lines.content: これから先の未来、大切な幼馴染みとなる予定の柊ハルや、杏藤千和や、夜月姫織や、兎蛙智仁、そして[・|も][・|う][・|ひ][・|と][・|り]も……。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru, Andou Chiwa, Yotsuki Himeori, Toga Tomohito--who were all destined to become my precious childhood friends in the future to come--and *one other person*, too...

lines.content: いつの間にか笑顔でいることが多くなっていたように思う。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I think we were all smiling much more often.

lines.content: 食事の後、それぞれが“鍵”をひとつ、“魔法使い”から渡された。
lines.translated: After the meal, each of us was handed a single "key" by the "Magician."

lines.content: その“鍵”があれば好きなとき、ここへ、“ゆめのねどこ”へやって来ることができる――
lines.translated: With that "key," we could come here, to the "Dream Bedchamber," whenever we liked--

lines.content: つらいことがあったらいつでもおいで。暖かいご飯を山盛りで用意して待ってるよ
lines.translated: "Whenever you're going through a painful time, come visit anytime. I'll be waiting with a mountain of warm food ready for you."
The "Magician" smiled--this is *the girls' story*.

lines.content: 言葉を重ね。心を重ね。時間も重ねて……。
lines.translated: Layering words. Layering hearts. Layering time...

lines.content: そうして“魔法使い”は無事に[・|少][・|女][・|た][・|ち]を自身の“魔法”として使えるようになり――“夜の王”との戦争に望めるまでになる。
lines.translated: And so, the "Magician" became able to safely wield *the girls* as her own "magic"--reaching the point where she could face the war against the "King of the Night."

lines.content: だが、それだけだった。
lines.translated: However, that was all.

lines.content: “[友人|関係性]”ではだめだった。
lines.translated: A "relationship" as mere "friends" wasn't enough.

lines.content: ……足りなかった。
lines.translated: It fell short.

lines.content: 俺たちが本当に欲しかった“魔法”を、“夜”の外で、“太陽”の下で使えるようになるまでには――“夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひには、不可能だったのだ。
lines.translated: Reaching the point where we could use the "magic" we truly wanted outside the "Night," beneath the "Sun"--that was something impossible for the "Magician of the Night," Hinamukai Asahi.

lines.content: 俺には親友と呼べる仲間が数多くいる。
lines.translated: I have many companions I can call my best friends.

lines.content: 柊ハル。杏藤千和。夜月姫織。兎蛙智仁。そして、今は遠いところにいるもうひとり。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru. Andou Chiwa. Yotsuki Himeori. Toga Tomohito. And one other person, who is in a faraway place right now.

lines.content: 五人いれば充分だ。
lines.translated: Having five of them is more than enough.

lines.content: 長い人生の中で“親友”と呼べる誰かと出会える確率は、実はそんなに多くない。
lines.translated: In this long life, the odds of meeting someone you can call a "best friend" aren't actually all that high.

lines.content: 数字にすると二十四億分の一。で、あるらしい。
lines.translated: Put into numbers, it's apparently one in 2.4 billion.

lines.content: 途方もない。途轍もない。恐怖さえ覚える数字だ。
lines.translated: It's mind-boggling. Absurd. A number so vast it's almost terrifying.

lines.content: だというのに、五人も。
lines.translated: And yet, I have five of them.

lines.content: 最愛の人と出会える確率を唱えると更にその数字は実に七十二億分の一にまで跳ね上がるのだが――
lines.translated: If we're talking about the odds of meeting the love of your life, that figure jumps all the way to one in 7.2 billion--

lines.content: 今は、友人、とりわけ親友の話だ。
lines.translated: But right now, we're talking about friends, and best friends in particular.

lines.content: 二十四億分の五。
lines.translated: Five in 2.4 billion.

lines.content: そんな奇跡的な出会いを果たした大切な親友――と恥ずかしげもなく呼べる人間が、五人もいるのだ。
lines.translated: I have five whole people resulting from such miraculous encounters whom I can unashamedly call my precious best friends.

lines.content: そのうちの誰かがもしも、何か……何か大変なピンチを迎えたそのときは、全力で力になりたい。
lines.translated: If any one of them ever faces some kind of... some kind of terrible crisis, I want to do everything in my power to help them.

lines.content: そう誓う。そう願う。そう、祈る。
lines.translated: That is my vow. My wish. My prayer.

lines.content: ……だけど。
lines.translated: Even so.

lines.content: どうかな。
lines.translated: I wonder.

lines.content: 時どきふとさみしさにも似た“もしも”が脳裏を過ぎるのだ。
lines.translated: Every now and then, a "what if" akin to loneliness crosses my mind.

lines.content: なあ、親友。
lines.translated: Hey, my best friends.

lines.content: 君らは何か、解決しがたい問題に直面したそのときは――
lines.translated: If you ever come face to face with a problem too difficult to solve--

lines.content: ……俺に相談したり、頼ったり、してくれるのかな
lines.translated: "...Would you talk to me about it, and lean on me?"

lines.content: ヒーローなんかではないこの俺に、助けを求めてくれたりするのだろうか。
lines.translated: Would they ask for help from someone like me, who is no hero at all?

lines.content: そればかりがいつも心配だった。
lines.translated: That was the one thing I always worried about.

lines.content: 優勝はひよちゃんだな。よっ、さすが食いしん坊、半端ないっす
lines.translated: "The winner is Hiyo-chan. Man, you really are a glutton. Seriously next-level."

lines.content: ――下校時間。
lines.translated: --It was time to head home from school.

lines.content: 俺たちは昨日交わした約束通り、駄菓子屋で購入したお菓子を食べながら帰るのだった。
lines.translated: Just as we had promised yesterday, we were walking back while eating the snacks we bought at the candy shop.

lines.content: はらはら、はらりと舞い散る、さくらの花の並木道。
lines.translated: A tree-lined street of cherry blossoms, their petals fluttering gently down through the air.

lines.content: 智仁や姫織や千和の笑顔や明るい言葉が綻んでいる。
lines.translated: The smiles and cheerful voices of Tomohito, Himeori, and Chiwa were blooming all around.

lines.content: ……でも。だけど。
lines.translated: However. Even so.

lines.content: 俺の隣に、君がいない。
lines.translated: You aren't here beside me.

lines.content: きらきらひかる春色を、薄ら染まった冷たい頬で小さく笑う――そんな君を見てみたいと願った、昨日の“夜”だったけど。
lines.translated: Last "Night," I had wished to see you like that--smiling faintly with cold, lightly flushed cheeks amid the sparkling colors of spring.

lines.content: “魔法の時間”に思い描いた君の笑顔はどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: Yet the smile I had pictured during the "hour of magic" was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 思い描いたふうに都合よく、世界はその色を変えてはくれない。
lines.translated: The world doesn't change its colors just to conveniently match what we picture in our minds.

lines.content: いやあ。ひよちゃんのお腹の中の怪獣は最強無敵でめちゃめちゃつよいな
lines.translated: "Man. The monster inside Hiyo-chan's stomach is seriously invincible and crazy strong."

lines.content: 智仁が笑う。
lines.translated: Tomohito laughed.

lines.content: てんてけてーん
lines.translated: "Ta-da-da-daaa!"

lines.content: 姫織が、ばんざい。超うれしそう。
lines.translated: Himeori threw her hands up in victory. She looked super happy.

lines.content: さすがひよりちゃん。お菓子のことでは負けなしだー。パないっすよね
lines.translated: "That's Hiyori-chan for you. Undefeated when it comes to sweets! Totally next-level, right?"

lines.content: 約束通り――とは、ちょっとした勝負のことだ。
lines.translated: What I meant by "just as we had promised" was a little contest of ours.

lines.content: ひとり三百円までで誰が一番上手に買い物できるのか。
lines.translated: With a budget of up to three hundred yen per person, who could do the best job shopping?

lines.content: そんな氷上の“芸術点”のように主観的でしかない勝負の行方は、姫織の優勝で終わったのだが……。
lines.translated: The outcome of a contest as purely subjective as the "artistic impression" score in figure skating had ended with Himeori taking first place, however...

lines.content: 異議あり！
lines.translated: "Objection!"

lines.content: ……俺はビシッと手を上げた。
lines.translated: I shot my hand straight up into the air.

lines.content: ほんの少しの寂しさを吹き飛ばすように。
lines.translated: As if to blow away that tiny hint of loneliness.

lines.content: 裁判長っ、このジャッジには不正が見られますっ、もう一度審議をっ、再審を願います！
lines.translated: "Your Honor, there is foul play in this ruling! I demand another deliberation! I request a retrial!"

lines.content: え？　なにそれ。裁判長ってなんだよ
lines.translated: "Huh? What's that supposed to be? Who's 'Your Honor'?"

lines.content: もー、なんでもいいからー、誰か聞いてくれよー
lines.translated: "Come on, whatever, just somebody listen to meee!"

lines.content: 呆れ顔の智仁にめそめそと、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I whined tearfully at an exasperated-looking Tomohito.

lines.content: ひよちゃんったら酷いんだぜ。俺が買ったお菓子、食べちゃったんだぜ
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan was so mean to me! She ate the snacks I bought!"

lines.content: 残ったのは十円チョコがみっつだけ……。
lines.translated: All I had left were three ten-yen chocolates...

lines.content: 俺。俺さ。めっちゃ上手に買い物できたのに、おすすめの駄菓子はこれだぜって、みんなに自慢したいくらいの、優勝間違いなしの、最強ラインナップだったのに
lines.translated: "I... Listen, I did such a great job shopping! It was the ultimate lineup, a guaranteed winner that I wanted to brag about to everyone and say, 'These are the snacks I recommend!'"

lines.content: それなのに。
lines.translated: And yet.

lines.content: それなのにっ。ひよちゃんのお腹の中の恐竜に、ぜんぶ美味しくおいしくいただかれちゃったんだよ。このチョコ以外、全部
lines.translated: "And yet! The dinosaur inside Hiyo-chan's stomach happily gobbled them all up! Every single one except these chocolates!"

lines.content: こんなの勝負にならない、やり直し、やり直しだいっ、と大人げなく男らしくもまるでなく駄々を踏み踏みする俺だった。
lines.translated: "How is this a fair match? A do-over! I demand a do-over!" I threw a tantrum, acting completely childish and utterly unmanly.

lines.content: でも先輩……。私、見てましたけど、奏先輩が夜月先輩に進んでお菓子、あげてたような……
lines.translated: "But Senpai... I was watching, and it looked to me like you were willingly giving your snacks to Yotsuki-senpai..."

lines.content: うん、そうね。大雅がいっぱい餌付けしてくれるから……。ぺろっと美味しくいただきました。お腹がもうね、ぱんぱんで、ぱんちくりんなの
lines.translated: "Yep, that's right. Because Taiga kept feeding me so much... I polished them right off, and they were delicious. My tummy is completely stuffed and super duper full now."

lines.content: 餌付けって。それ、自分で言うんだ
lines.translated: "'Feeding you'? You're really gonna describe it like that yourself?"

lines.content: 苦笑いの智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a wry smile.

lines.content: そして――俺、涙目。
lines.translated: And as for me--I had tears in my eyes.

lines.content: ううっ、だって……、だって……っ
lines.translated: "Ugh, b-because... because...!"

lines.content: ひよちゃんにお菓子あげるの好きなんだっ、めっちゃ幸せそうに、美味しそうに、食べてくれるから……っ
lines.translated: "I like giving Hiyo-chan snacks! Because she looks so happy and eats them like they're the most delicious thing ever...!"

lines.content: え。だったら、なんて言うのか、自業自得みたいなもんじゃないのかそれ
lines.translated: "Huh? Then, how do I put this... didn't you kind of bring this on yourself?"

lines.content: ちがわいひよちゃんが無限にお菓子を貢いでしまいたくなるくらいの魔性の女な感じだから悪いんだい
lines.translated: "No I didn't! It's Hiyo-chan's fault for having the vibes of a femme fatale who makes you want to offer her an infinite tribute of snacks!"

lines.content: ましょーの、おんな……っ
lines.translated: "A femme... fatale...!"

lines.content: 両手を振り上げ、言った。
lines.translated: She threw both hands up in the air as she said it.

lines.content: なにそれすてきかっくいい……っ
lines.translated: "What is that, it sounds so wonderful and cool...!"

lines.content: 目をきらきらさせていた。
lines.translated: Her eyes were sparkling.

lines.content: とにかくだめだ、納得いかねえっ、再戦だっ、明日改めて戦いを申し込む……っ
lines.translated: "Anyway, no way, I won't accept this! It's a rematch! Tomorrow, I'm challenging you all over again...!"

lines.content: お花見も明日だ！　だって俺、お菓子チョコしか残ってないし……！
lines.translated: "We're doing the flower viewing tomorrow, too! Because all I have left for snacks are these chocolates...!"

lines.content: ジタジタしながら俺は言う。
lines.translated: I stamped my feet in frustration as I spoke.

lines.content: ……だから
lines.translated: "...And so."

lines.content: え？　だから？
lines.translated: "Huh? And so?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。だからさ、残った十円チョコだけは奪わないで。お願い。……後生だから
lines.translated: "Yeah, well. So, please, just don't take my remaining ten-yen chocolates. Please. ...I'm begging you."

lines.content: 急にしおらしくなったぞ
lines.translated: "Well, he got meek all of a sudden."

lines.content: あ、そうでしたよね。優勝した人は負けた人たちから、買い物した中で一番美味しそうなお菓子をもらえるっていうルールでした
lines.translated: "Ah, that's right. The rule was that the winner gets to take the most delicious-looking snack from what the losers bought."

lines.content: ああ、そうだったそうだった。じゃあ、もうそのチョコしか残ってない大雅は……
lines.translated: "Oh yeah, that was it. Which means Taiga, who only has those chocolates left..."

lines.content: おやつ抜きですね。先輩、かわいそう
lines.translated: "Gets no snacks at all. Poor Senpai."

lines.content: と言いつつも、意地悪そうな笑みの千和だった。
lines.translated: Despite her words, Chiwa had a mischievous grin on her face.

lines.content: くっ。残酷すぎるっ。かわいい顔した誰かが決めた残酷すぎるルールだっ
lines.translated: "Guh. Too cruel! This is an overly cruel rule decided by someone with a cute face!"

lines.content: 唇を尖らせ思い切りうざい感じで言う俺に――姫織が、言った。
lines.translated: As I pouted and laid it on as obnoxiously thick as possible--Himeori spoke up.

lines.content: 別にいいよ。明日、またしょーぶだよ大雅。お花見もまた明日でも、私はいいよ
lines.translated: "I don't mind. Let's have another match tomorrow, Taiga. I'm fine with saving the flower viewing for tomorrow, too."

lines.content: ほんと？　いいの？　りありー？
lines.translated: "For real? Is that okay? Really?"

lines.content: うん。りあ、りー……？
lines.translated: "Yep. 'Rea... lly'...?"

lines.content: ぱちくりと、小首を傾げる姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori blinked and tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: 賞品もそのときまでお預けで問題なし
lines.translated: "I have no problem putting the prize on hold until then, either."

lines.content: さすがひよちゃんっ
lines.translated: "That's our Hiyo-chan!"

lines.content: 魔性の女っ
lines.translated: "What a femme fatale!"

lines.content: いい女っ
lines.translated: "What a woman!"

lines.content: おとな！
lines.translated: "So mature!"

lines.content: あだるちぃ！
lines.translated: "So adulty!"

lines.content: ふっふん
lines.translated: "Heh heh."

lines.content: 得意げ。もっと褒めてと言わんばかり。
lines.translated: She looked proud of herself. Practically begging us to praise her some more.

lines.content: だけどね、大雅。その代わり……明日の勝負はね、お花見はね、私のお家でやりましょう？
lines.translated: "However, Taiga. In exchange... for tomorrow's match, and the flower viewing, let's do it at my house, okay?"

lines.content: ひよちゃんの？
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan's place?"

lines.content: そう。私の神社で
lines.translated: "Yes. At my shrine."

lines.content: 姫織は山のほうを見た。
lines.translated: Himeori looked toward the mountain.

lines.content: そこの中腹辺りに神社が見える。
lines.translated: About halfway up the slope, a shrine was visible.

lines.content: 大きな大きな作りの建物だ。
lines.translated: It was a very, very large building.

lines.content: 私のお家。神社だけど、駄菓子もちゃんと売ってるよ。近所のちびっこたちのちびっこな懐を狙い打つ感じ
lines.translated: "My house. It's a shrine, but we properly sell penny candy, too. Kind of sniping right at the tiny wallets of the neighborhood kiddos."

lines.content: 金儲けの狙いどころがえげつないぞ
lines.translated: "That's a brutally ruthless target market for making a profit."

lines.content: もちろん当たりの駄菓子は事前に全部回収済みなのだ
lines.translated: "Of course, all the winning prize candies have already been collected in advance!"

lines.content: ……さらっとやなこと聞いた気がする。坊主丸儲けってやつなのか
lines.translated: "...I feel like I just casually heard something awful. Is this what they mean by priests raking it all in?"

lines.content: それにね。あのね。見せたいものも、あるし。だからどうかなあって
lines.translated: "Besides... um, you know. There's something I want to show you, too. So I was wondering what you'd think."

lines.content: 見せたいもの……。
lines.translated: Something she wants to show us...

lines.content: うん、俺はいいよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, I'm down."

lines.content: 俺も俺もー
lines.translated: "Me too, me too!"

lines.content: 私もいいです。久しぶりに夜月先輩のお家、行ってみたいですし
lines.translated: "I'm fine with that too. It's been a while since I visited Yozuki-senpai's house, so I'd love to go."

lines.content: お花見も明日するなら雨降らなければいいですね、と千和は空を見ていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked up at the sky, saying that she hoped it wouldn't rain if we were going flower viewing tomorrow.

lines.content: ひよちゃんの神社かあ。あそこは眺めがいいから……うん。お花見するのには丁度いいな
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan's shrine, huh? The view is great up there, so... yeah. It's the perfect spot for flower viewing."

lines.content: ああ、うん。確かにそうだ。ひよちゃんの神社はさくらの木がいっぱいだったから……きっときれいだ
lines.translated: "Oh, yeah. That's true. Hiyo-chan's shrine has lots of cherry trees, so... I'm sure it'll be beautiful."

lines.content: ふわふわきれいなさくらの中で、今日みたいにみんなで食べたらね、お菓子もきっと、もっともっと、美味しいよっ
lines.translated: "If we all eat together like we did today under the fluffy, pretty cherry blossoms, I bet our snacks will taste even more delicious!"

lines.content: お、花より団子かあー？　この食いしん坊ちゃんめえ
lines.translated: "Oh, dumplings over flowers, huh? You little glutton, you."

lines.content: えっへへ～
lines.translated: "Ehehe~"

lines.content: それじゃあ明日、学校が終わったら姫織の家でお花見をしようと話がまとまった。
lines.translated: And so it was decided that we'd have our flower viewing at Himeori's house after school tomorrow.

lines.content: いや～、明日は楽しみなイベント目白押しだなあ。次の日に“楽しみなこと”があるっていうのはすてきなことだよな
lines.translated: "Man~, tomorrow is just packed with exciting events. Having something fun to look forward to the next day is really a wonderful thing."

lines.content: 智仁が深くうなずいていた。姫織が首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Tomohito nodded deeply. Himeori tilted her head.

lines.content: 楽しみなこと、目白押し？
lines.translated: "Packed with exciting things?"

lines.content: うん、そうだよ。明日はきっとお祭り騒ぎだ
lines.translated: "Yep, that's right. Tomorrow's bound to be a real festival."

lines.content: 何か……、お花見の他に、何かあったっけか
lines.translated: "Wait... was there something else going on besides the flower viewing?"

lines.content: 転校生が来る
lines.translated: "A transfer student is coming."

lines.content: きりっとして、智仁は言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito said with a sharp, serious look.

lines.content: しかも噂によれば女の子だって話だ
lines.translated: "And according to the rumors, it's a girl."

lines.content: 転校生。
lines.translated: A transfer student.

lines.content: それってたぶんハルのことだな、と思いながらも、
lines.translated: That's probably Haru, I thought to myself, while saying out loud,

lines.content: おおっ、それってすっげえっ、一大イベントじゃないかっ
lines.translated: "Whoa, that's amazing! Isn't that a huge event?!"

lines.content: わざとらしく俺は驚いて見せた。
lines.translated: I put on a deliberately exaggerated show of surprise.

lines.content: ……ちょっと無理にテンションあげすぎたかもしれないが。
lines.translated: Though I might have forced my enthusiasm a little too much.

lines.content: うむっ
lines.translated: "Indeed!"

lines.content: 智仁。眉を引き締める。
lines.translated: Tomohito furrowed his brow.

lines.content: かわいかったらいいな！
lines.translated: "I hope she's cute!"

lines.content: うむうむ！
lines.translated: "Indeed, indeed!"

lines.content: 巨乳だったら、いいな！
lines.translated: "I hope she's got huge boobs!"

lines.content: うぅむ……っ
lines.translated: "Hmph..."

lines.content: その点はあまり強く同意しかねる。
lines.translated: I couldn't quite bring myself to strongly agree on that point.

lines.content: 俺はどちらかといえばちっこいほうが……いや。何でもない。何でもないよ？
lines.translated: If I had to choose, I prefer them on the smaller side... No. Never mind. It's nothing, okay?

lines.content: 誰にともいわず脳内で言い訳をするあたり、なんとも。
lines.translated: The fact that I was making excuses to no one in particular inside my own head really said it all.

lines.content: そんな俺の内心うずまく[・|や][・|ま][・|し][・|さ]に勘付いたのかどうか、
lines.translated: Whether they sensed the guilty conscience swirling inside me or not,

lines.content: 男ってやーね
lines.translated: "Boys are just the worst."

lines.content: まったくですね
lines.translated: "They really are."

lines.content: 姫織。千和。軽蔑の眼差しだ。
lines.translated: Himeori. Chiwa. Their gazes were full of contempt.

lines.content: いや。ぺったんこ組の敵意だ。
lines.translated: No, that was the hostility of the flat-chested brigade.

lines.content: ……組、とはいっても、いまのところふたりしか女の子はいないわけだが。
lines.translated: Though I call them a brigade, there were only two girls here at the moment.

lines.content: いやあ。転校生。巨乳で、むっちりで、かわいかったらいいなあ
lines.translated: "Man. A transfer student. I really hope she's busty, curvy, and cute."

lines.content: 智仁は構わずしみじみとしていた。
lines.translated: Unbothered, Tomohito spoke with heartfelt longing.

lines.content: おい
lines.translated: "Hey."

lines.content: そんな智仁に、言う。
lines.translated: I called out to Tomohito.

lines.content: まさか浮気か
lines.translated: "Don't tell me you're cheating."

lines.content: なぜそうなる
lines.translated: "How did you jump to that conclusion?"

lines.content: なぜ？
lines.translated: "How?"

lines.content: なぜってお前。
lines.translated: What do you mean, "how"?

lines.content: お前には好きな人がいるだろうに……。
lines.translated: You already have someone you like, don't you...?

lines.content: とは言えず、口ごもる。
lines.translated: Unable to say that out loud, I hesitated.

lines.content: 不自然な沈黙を生んでしまう。
lines.translated: It created an awkward silence.

lines.content: その様子が誤解を呼んだ。
lines.translated: And that reaction invited a misunderstanding.

lines.content: わー……
lines.translated: "Whoa..."

lines.content: 姫織が目をきらめかせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori's eyes were sparkling.
"Oh my~..."

lines.content: 千和が口元をそっと押さえて目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa gently covered her mouth and narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 聞きましたか夜月先輩、“浮気”ですって
lines.translated: "Did you hear that, Yozuki-senpai? He said 'cheating.'"

lines.content: 見ました？　見ました？　たいがーの切なそうなあの眼差しと沈黙を
lines.translated: "Did you see that? Did you see that? That wistful look in Taiga's eyes and his silence."

lines.content: ……違う
lines.translated: "...Wrong."

lines.content: はい。見ました。そして察しましたよ夜月先輩。あれは、ガチですね
lines.translated: "Yes. I saw it. And I've connected the dots, Yozuki-senpai. That's the real deal."

lines.content: うん。ほもほもしている
lines.translated: "Yep. Things are getting super gay."

lines.content: 違うってば
lines.translated: "You've got it all wrong!"

lines.content: くちゅくちゅってしてる
lines.translated: "They're getting all lovey-dovey."

lines.content: ……なんだそれ
lines.translated: "...What does that even mean?"

lines.content: ちゅ、ちゅー、するんですか……？
lines.translated: "A-Are you going to k-kiss...?"

lines.content: しねえってば
lines.translated: "Like hell we are!"

lines.content: はは。なら抱きしめてやる。全裸でな
lines.translated: "Haha. Then I'll give you a hug. Stark naked."

lines.content: やめろ！
lines.translated: "Stop that!"

lines.content: まったく我がままなやつだ
lines.translated: "Jeez, what a needy guy."

lines.content: 寄るな！
lines.translated: "Stay away from me!"

lines.content: じゃあ、下半身だけ
lines.translated: "Alright, just the lower half then."

lines.content: おい！　脱ぐんじゃあねえ！
lines.translated: "Hey! Don't take your clothes off!"

lines.content: ぎゃーぎゃーと、騒ぐ。
lines.translated: We made a huge racket.

lines.content: 間もなくバス停だ。
lines.translated: Soon, we reached the bus stop.

lines.content: 千和と姫織、そして智仁が乗車組。
lines.translated: Chiwa, Himeori, and Tomohito were the ones taking the bus.

lines.content: 俺はこのまま“ゆめのねどこ”へと歩いて帰る。
lines.translated: I would walk the rest of the way back to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: ……それじゃあまた明日と言って、俺たちは別れた。
lines.translated: Saying "See you tomorrow," we parted ways.

lines.content: ……さて。俺も帰ろうか
lines.translated: "...Alright. Guess I'll head home too."

lines.content: 帰ろう帰ろうお家に帰ろう暖かなシチューが待ってる、だなんてひとり鼻歌。
lines.translated: Let's go home, let's go home, let's go back home, a warm stew is waiting for me--I hummed a little tune to myself.

lines.content: ちょっとご機嫌。
lines.translated: I was in a pretty good mood.

lines.content: みんなと実のない話をしながらの帰り道――実がないからこそ楽しかったのだとそう思う。
lines.translated: Walking home while chatting about nothing in particular with everyone--I think it was precisely because it was about nothing that it was so much fun.

lines.content: お花見かあ。明日も楽しみだなー
lines.translated: "Flower viewing, huh? I'm looking forward to tomorrow, too."

lines.content: とか。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: あさひさんにバイト料もらっていて、よかった。じゃないと駄菓子も買えなかったから
lines.translated: "Good thing I got my paycheck from Asahi-san. Otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to buy any penny candy."

lines.content: だとか。
lines.translated: Things like that.

lines.content: ……うん。それに、チョコだって買えなかったし
lines.translated: "...Yeah. And I wouldn't have been able to buy these chocolates, either."

lines.content: ぶつぶつと、独り言。
lines.translated: I muttered to myself.

lines.content: このチョコレート。安いものだけど、クロにあげたら喜んでくれるかな。うん。きっと美味しそうに食べてくれる。
lines.translated: These chocolates. They're cheap, but I wonder if Kuro will be happy if I give them to her. Yeah. I'm sure she'll eat them right up with a big smile.

lines.content: そんな光景を思い描きながらてくてく歩く。
lines.translated: Picturing that scene in my head, I strolled along.

lines.content: ――ねえねえ、聞いた？
lines.translated: --Hey, hey, did you hear?

lines.content: ふと、声がした。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I heard a voice.

lines.content: ――バス停に立ってたあの子の話。あなたは聞いた？
lines.translated: --About that girl who was standing at the bus stop. Did you hear?

lines.content: 通り過ぎる数人の主婦たちがひそひそと話している。
lines.translated: A few housewives passing by were whispering to each other.

lines.content: ――あの子ね、両親に置いて行かれちゃってたみたいなの。
lines.translated: --Apparently, that girl was left behind by her parents.

lines.content: 市の職員であるらしい主婦のひとりが、両親に何度も連絡をしようとしたが繋がらず……いわゆる育児放棄だ。
lines.translated: One of the housewives, who seemed to be a city hall employee, said they tried contacting the parents multiple times, but couldn't get through... It was a case of so-called child abandonment.

lines.content: 両親には当然、何らかの[ペナルティ|罰則]があるだろう。そして女の子は山の上の施設に送られる。
lines.translated: Naturally, the parents would face some kind of penalty. And the girl would be sent to the facility up on the mountain.

lines.content: ――あの子、自分が死んだら両親が少しでも悲しんでくれるかもしれないと思ってたみたい。
lines.translated: --It seems she thought her parents might feel at least a little sad if she died.

lines.content: そんなことを考える自分はとても悪い子。だからやっぱり、こんな自分は早く死んでしまったほうがいい。あの子の中の“悪夢”があの子の心に何度もそう囁いて……。
lines.translated: Thinking things like that made her a very bad girl. So she figured someone like her really would be better off dying as soon as possible. The "Nightmare" inside her had whispered that to her heart over and over again...

lines.content: だから何度も、あの子は自分を殺そうとしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: That was why she had tried to kill herself so many times.

lines.content: あの子が轢かれようと飛び出したバスは週末――まだ家族が仲良しだった頃――家族揃ってお出かけするときに必ず利用していたバスなのだという。
lines.translated: They said the bus she had jumped out in front of was the exact one her family always used to take on weekend outings--back when they all still got along.

lines.content: そしてその運転手は女の子の父親自身……。
lines.translated: And the driver of that bus had been the girl's own father...

lines.content: ――私、あの子と何度か、施設に来るよう説得するため話したことがあるの。
lines.translated: --I talked to her a few times to try and persuade her to come to the facility.

lines.content: ――ずっと強情だった。絶対、家を離れたくないって。
lines.translated: --She was stubborn the whole time. She said she绝对 refused to leave her house.

lines.content: ――泣いたり叫んだりするわけじゃないけれど……。絶対に玄関の扉を明けてくれなかった。いつもインターフォン越しにちょっと話すだけ。
lines.translated: --It wasn't like she cried or screamed, though... She just flat-out refused to open the front door. We'd always just talk a little through the intercom.

lines.content: ご飯はちゃんと食べてるの？　不便なことは何もない？　お願い。おばさんね、あなたの力になりたいの。
lines.translated: Are you eating properly? Are you having any trouble getting by? Please. I want to help you, sweetie.

lines.content: だからここを開けて。少しでいいからお話ししよう？
lines.translated: So open the door. Let's just talk for a little bit, okay?

lines.content: どんなに門柱のマイク越しに声を掛けても、沈黙ばかりしか帰ってこない。そんな日々。
lines.translated: No matter how much she called out through the gatepost microphone, only silence ever came back. Day after day, it was like that.

lines.content: ――でも、不思議なの。
lines.translated: --But you know, it's strange.

lines.content: ――今日もダメ元であの子と話に行ったら、まるで別人みたいに落ち着いててね。玄関をすぐに開けてくれた。
lines.translated: --Today, I went to talk to her again thinking it'd be no use, and she was so calm, like a completely different person. She opened the front door right away.

lines.content: あなたのことが心配なの。お願い。一緒に行こう？
lines.translated: I'm worried about you, sweetie. Please. Won't you come with me?

lines.content: ――そう言うと、わかりましたって。ありがとうございます、って……。素直に付いて来てくれたのよ。
lines.translated: --When I said that, she said, "Okay. Thank you..." And she came along without a fuss.

lines.content: なんだかとってもすっきりした顔つきだったのだという。
lines.translated: Apparently, she had a very refreshed look on her face.

lines.content: ときおり町で見かけるあの子は、いつも思い詰めたように顔をきつくしかめていた。
lines.translated: Whenever people saw that girl around town, she always had a tight, brooding frown on her face.

lines.content: それなのに今日のあの子は、時どき笑顔を見せてくれたし、手を繋いで施設まで一緒に歩いてお話もしてくれた。
lines.translated: Yet today, she smiled from time to time, held the woman's hand as they walked together to the facility, and even chatted with her.

lines.content: ――なんだかとても、とってもね、かわいい子だったわ。
lines.translated: --She really, truly was such a sweet girl.

lines.content: あの子には絶対に幸せになってほしい。
lines.translated: I really want her to find happiness.

lines.content: 施設の新しい環境に早く慣れればいいけれど……。
lines.translated: I just hope she gets used to her new environment at the facility soon...

lines.content: そう話す人たちの声が通り過ぎていく。
lines.translated: The voices of the women talking passed me by.

lines.content: 俺は昨晩のできごとを思い出している。
lines.translated: I thought back to what happened last night.

lines.content: 俺たちの役割は、あくまでも誰かの心に芽生えた“悪夢”を処理することだけだ。
lines.translated: Our role is strictly limited to dealing with the "Nightmares" that sprout in someone's heart.

lines.content: つらい、悲しい、そんな現実世界で芽生えた“心”を“悪夢”と呼んで、“夜”の中でその“心”から切り離す――[・|分][・|離][・|さ][・|せ][・|る]。そして現実世界で少しでも生きやすくなればいい。
lines.translated: Calling those painful, sorrowful feelings that sprout in the real world "Nightmares," and severing them from the "heart" within the "Night"--separating them. Hoping that it makes living in the real world just a little bit easier.

lines.content: そう思っての[・|戦][・|い]だった。
lines.translated: That was the reason behind our battles.

lines.content: だが時どき思う。思ってしまう。
lines.translated: But sometimes I wonder. I can't help wondering.

lines.content: 夢の中ではなく現実の世界の中でこそ俺は、あの子に、何かをすべきなのではないのか。
lines.translated: Shouldn't I be doing something for that girl in the real world, rather than inside a dream?

lines.content: たとえば。
lines.translated: For instance...

lines.content: あの子を身勝手に捨てた両親に、あの子のさみしい心を、思い知らせてやることだとか……。
lines.translated: Making the parents who selfishly abandoned her realize just how lonely her heart was, or something like that...

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: だが、だめだ。
lines.translated: No, I can't.

lines.content: そんなことをする権利なんてこの俺になどありはしない。
lines.translated: Someone like me has no right to do something like that.

lines.content: あの子は俺だ。俺と同じだ。
lines.translated: That girl is me. She's the same as me.
I'd just end up repeating it all over again.

lines.content: 昨晩、ナナちゃんに語り聞かせてもらったものは、寂しいさみしい小さなあの子のお話だ。
lines.translated: What Nana-chan told me last night was the story of that lonely, oh-so-lonely little girl.

lines.content: その物語にとってこの俺は、本来覗き見ることさえ叶わない脇役以下のモブなのだ。
lines.translated: To that story, I'm less than a supporting character--just a nameless face in the crowd who shouldn't even be allowed a peek inside.

lines.content: そんな俺がこれ以上、彼女の物語に関わろうなど……それは出しゃばりだという他にない。ここから先は、あの子の手を引き歩いてくれるやさしい誰かに任せよう。
lines.translated: For someone like me to try getting any more involved in her story... would be nothing short of meddling. From here on out, I should leave things to someone kind who will take her by the hand and walk alongside her.

lines.content: たくさんの人たちを無差別に救い出せるヒーローなんかじゃ俺はない。そんな俺が誰かの物語の結末を、身勝手に塗り替えようだなんて。
lines.translated: I'm no hero who can indiscriminately save tons of people. Who am I to selfishly try and rewrite the ending of someone else's story?

lines.content: ……それに俺は、他人の[物語|世界]を前にして立ち止まっていられないのだ。[・|自][・|分][・|自][・|身][・|が][・|は][・|じ][・|め][・|た][・|物][・|語]に、責任を持たなければならないのだから。
lines.translated: Besides, I can't afford to stand still in front of someone else's world. Because I have to take responsibility for the story I started myself.

lines.content: ……あとは、任せよう
lines.translated: "...I'll leave the rest to them."

lines.content: やさしい誰かと、小さなちいさな神さまに……。
lines.translated: To someone kind, and to a tiny, tiny god...

lines.content: ナナちゃんに、任せよう
lines.translated: "I'll leave it to Nana-chan."

lines.content: きっと俺なんかよりも上手に、あの子のさみしい“心”を慰めてくれるだろうから。
lines.translated: Because I'm sure she'll comfort that girl's lonely "heart" much better than someone like me ever could.

lines.content: 俺は立ち止まり、辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: I stopped in my tracks and looked around.

lines.content: 自分自身の物語のありかを探す。
lines.translated: Searching for where my own story was.

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: 今日はどこに隠れているんだろう。
lines.translated: Where could she be hiding today?

lines.content: 今日も俺の一日をどこから見守っていてくれたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Where had she been watching over my day from this time?

lines.content: 恥ずかしがり屋な（あるいは人見知りな）あの子を見つけるのは俺の役目だ――なんて勝手にそう決めていた。
lines.translated: Finding that bashful (or maybe just shy around strangers) girl is my job--at least, I'd decided that on my own.

lines.content: 他の誰かに見つけられてしまうその前に見つけたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to find her before anyone else did.

lines.content: なにせあの子は隠れるのが下手だ。
lines.translated: After all, she's terrible at hiding.

lines.content: 耳が尻尾がいつもふりふりと物陰から見えている。
lines.translated: Her ears and tail are always twitching in plain sight from behind cover.

lines.content: むしろ見つけてほしいとばかりにわかりやすい。
lines.translated: In fact, it's so obvious that it's like she wants me to find her.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: あれ？
lines.translated: "Oh?"

lines.content: ……女の人の声がした。
lines.translated: I heard a woman's voice.

lines.content: 求めていたものとは違う声。
lines.translated: A different voice from the one I was looking for.

lines.content: ……もしかして、大雅くん？
lines.translated: "...Could that be you, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 振り向く。
lines.translated: I turned my head back.

lines.content: 驚いた顔の女の子が立っていた。
lines.translated: A girl was standing there with a surprised look on her face.

lines.content: わー、すごい偶然ですね。まさか最後に大雅くんに会えるなんて。とっても驚いてしまいました
lines.translated: "Wow, what a coincidence! To think I'd get to see you right at the very end, Taiga-kun. You really surprised me."

lines.content: この町の学園とは違う制服に身を包んだ女の子。
lines.translated: A girl dressed in a different school uniform from the academy in this town.

lines.content: 軽い足取りでぴったりと俺の隣に並んだ。
lines.translated: With light steps, she came right up and stood next to me.

lines.content: 今回は誰とも会えないまま帰宅かなあ、って思ってましたけど……
lines.translated: "Here I was thinking I'd have to head back home without running into anyone this time..."

lines.content: まさかまさか。帰りのバスを待ってたら大雅くんと出会えるだなんて。想像もしていませんでした
lines.translated: "Who would've thought! Running into you while waiting for my bus home, Taiga-kun. I never even imagined it."

lines.content: にこにこ笑う。
lines.translated: She beamed.

lines.content: 胸の中で膨らんだ期待感に直接触れられたかのような笑顔だ――それはなんだかとても身近に感じてしまう表情でもあった。
lines.translated: It was a smile that felt like a direct expression of the anticipation swelling in her chest--and somehow, it was an expression that felt very familiar to me.

lines.content: ……あれ？　ひょっとしてですけれど……大雅くん。おねーちゃんのことを見送りに来てくれたりしたのでしょうか。だから、こんなところに……？
lines.translated: "...Huh? Don't tell me... Taiga-kun, did you happen to come here to see your big sis off? Is that why you're in a place like this...?"

lines.content: 女の子は首をかしげてそう言った。
lines.translated: The girl tilted her head as she said that.

lines.content: もちろんですよ。[あずさ|あず咲]先輩を見送りにきました――と、言いたいところですが
lines.translated: "Of course. I came to see you off, Azusaki-senpai--is what I'd like to say, anyway."

lines.content: 俺は苦笑いを作る。
lines.translated: I gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 残念ながら偶然です
lines.translated: "Unfortunately, it's just a coincidence."

lines.content: 今日、先輩が帰ってくるのは知りませんでしたし
lines.translated: "I didn't even know you were visiting today, Senpai."

lines.content: ですよねえ。それは、確かに確かに。残念ながらって感じですよね
lines.translated: "Right, right. That's very true. A real shame, isn't it?"

lines.content: あ、でもでも、偶然こうして会えるほうがなんだかすごいですよね。運命的だなあとか、そんなふうに年甲斐もなく乙女のようなことを考えちゃいそうです
lines.translated: "Oh, but running into each other by chance like this is kind of amazing in its own way, isn't it? It almost makes me want to think girlish thoughts about it being fate, even at my age."

lines.content: 年甲斐もなく、って
lines.translated: "'At your age,' you say..."

lines.content: 先輩、実際まだまだ乙女じゃないですか。俺と一歳しか違わない。老け込むには無理がありますよ
lines.translated: "Senpai, you're still plenty young, aren't you? You're only a year older than me. It's way too early for you to act old."

lines.content: そうですかね……
lines.translated: "Do you think so...?"

lines.content: そうですよ
lines.translated: "I do."

lines.content: 自信。持ってみてもいいですか？　色々と
lines.translated: "Confidence. Is it okay if I try having some? About a lot of things."

lines.content: いいと思いますよ。色々と
lines.translated: "I think you should. About a lot of things."

lines.content: 帰りのバスを待っているという女の子と、俺は並んでバス停のベンチに腰掛けた。
lines.translated: I sat down on the bus stop bench alongside the girl who said she was waiting for her bus home.

lines.content: もう少しでやって来るらしいバスを一緒に待つことにした。
lines.translated: I decided to wait with her for the bus, which was apparently coming soon.

lines.content: だけど、大雅くん。私は、おねーちゃんはね、時どきちょっと不安になるのです
lines.translated: "Still, Taiga-kun. I--your big sis here--gets a little anxious sometimes."

lines.content: 不安？　どうしてですか？
lines.translated: "Anxious? Why is that?"

lines.content: みっつあるチョコレートをひとつ差し出す。
lines.translated: I held out one of my three chocolates to her.

lines.content: あ、チョコレート
lines.translated: "Oh, chocolate."

lines.content: 女の子はチョコを受け取ってくれた。笑顔で。そして、続けて言った。
lines.translated: The girl accepted the chocolate with a smile. Then, she continued.

lines.content: マンガです
lines.translated: "Because of manga."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: マンガ？
lines.translated: Manga?

lines.content: かわいい女の子たちが集まってわいわいする四コママンガとか。よくありますよね
lines.translated: "You know those four-panel manga where cute girls get together and have fun? There are a lot of those, right?"

lines.content: ですね。よくありますね
lines.translated: "Yeah, they're pretty common."

lines.content: そういったマンガの中に、ほら、よく“婚期を逃した行き遅れの担任教師”っているでしょう？
lines.translated: "In manga like that, you know how there's often that 'spinster homeroom teacher who missed her chance to get married'?"

lines.content: あー、はい。いますね。結婚したいのにどうしてもできない女の先生
lines.translated: "Ah, yes. There is. The female teacher who really wants to get married, but just can't seem to manage it."

lines.content: 四コママンガとかだけじゃなくて、小説とかアニメとかでもよく見かけるような気がします。定番なんですかね
lines.translated: "I feel like you see them a lot not just in four-panel manga, but in novels and anime, too. I guess it's a staple trope."

lines.content: たいていみんな“結婚できない自分”にいじけていたり、“年齢ばかり重なっていく現実”に慌てふためいていたり……。
lines.translated: Usually, they're sulking about "not being able to get married," or panicking over "the reality of getting older and older"...

lines.content: それら複合的な精神的ダメージにより、深くなった闇が（たぶん嫉妬とかが）彼女らを暴走させたりさせなかったり。
lines.translated: And due to that compound mental damage, the deepened darkness inside them (probably jealousy and the like) either sends them on a rampage or it doesn't.

lines.content: 結構あの手のキャラクターは嫌いじゃないです。なんだか愛おしいような気分になってしまいます。……それがどうかしたんですか？
lines.translated: "I actually don't dislike that kind of character. They make me feel kind of fond of them. ...What about them, though?"

lines.content: 頬を少し赤くした女の子だけれど、
lines.translated: The girl's cheeks flushed slightly,

lines.content: 先輩？
lines.translated: "Senpai?"

lines.content: 俺が首をかしげると、ふるふると小さく震え、
lines.translated: and when I tilted my head, she trembled a little.

lines.content: きっとね、おねーちゃんはあんなふうになってしまいます
lines.translated: "I'm sure your big sis is going to end up just like that."

lines.content: くすんと鼻をすすった。
lines.translated: She sniffled.

lines.content: だってだって、聞いてくださいよ大雅くん。おねーちゃんの不安を聞いてあげてください
lines.translated: "Because, I mean, listen to me, Taiga-kun! Please listen to your big sis's worries!"

lines.content: ……おねーちゃん。この歳になるまで男性と一度もおつきあいしたことがありません
lines.translated: "...Your big sis has made it to this age without ever once going out with a guy."

lines.content: 恥ずかしそうに、もじもじと。
lines.translated: She fidgeted bashfully.

lines.content: おつきあいどころか手だってつないだことがないんです。このままじゃ、大雅くんたちが結婚したりしても、おねーちゃんはひとりなままで……
lines.translated: "Forget dating, I've never even held hands with one! At this rate, even after you and the others get married, Taiga-kun, your big sis will still be all alone..."

lines.content: 青くなり、言った。
lines.translated: Turning pale, she went on.

lines.content: このままじゃ、おねーちゃんは一生孤独です。孤独死です
lines.translated: "At this rate, your big sis is going to be alone for the rest of her life! I'll die alone!"

lines.content: がたがたしていた。涙目だ。何を言い出してるんだこの人は……と思ったが、どうやらマジらしい。
lines.translated: She was shaking like a leaf, tears in her eyes. What on earth is this person talking about...? I thought, but apparently she was dead serious.

lines.content: 最近の子たちは彼氏がいない子とはお友だちにもならないそうですし……
lines.translated: "And I hear kids these days won't even be friends with girls who don't have boyfriends..."

lines.content: 伴侶もいなければ友人さえも側にいない。さみしい……さみしい晩年。今から老後が心配すぎるおねーちゃんなんです
lines.translated: "No partner, and not even a single friend by my side. A lonely... lonely twilight of life. Your big sis is already way too worried about her old age."

lines.content: 老後って……。
lines.translated: Her old age...?

lines.content: だから、ほら。行き遅れてしまってさみしいばかりのマンガの中の先生みたいに、おねーちゃん、大雅くんたちにも置いて行かれてひとりぼっちで……
lines.translated: "So, you see, just like those lonely spinster teachers in manga, you and the others are going to leave your big sis behind, all by myself..."

lines.content: うう、さみしい、つらい、悲しいよお……ぐすん
lines.translated: "Ugh, it's so lonely, so painful, so sad... *sniffle*."

lines.content: めそめそとしている女の子。
lines.translated: The girl was sniffling and whimpering.

lines.content: 自分の言葉で不安を更に大きくしてしまったようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed she had only made her anxieties even worse with her own words.

lines.content: やれやれ。どうなってるんだろう――俺は苦笑いを浮かべてしまう。
lines.translated: Good grief. What's going on with her...? I couldn't help but give a wry smile.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|い][・|つ]と姉弟だとは思えないネガティブさだ。
lines.translated: With negativity like this, it was hard to believe she was his older sister.

lines.content: 先輩。ねえ、先輩。泣かないでくださいよ……ほら、鼻水、たれてますよ
lines.translated: "Senpai. Hey, Senpai. Please don't cry... Look, your nose is running."

lines.content: ちり紙を差し出す。あさひさんに毎朝欠かさず渡されているものだ。
lines.translated: I held out a tissue. It was one of the ones Asahi-san handed me every single morning without fail.

lines.content: ごめんなさいありがとうございますと受け取ったそれで、女の子は思い切り鼻をかんでいた。
lines.translated: Taking it with a hurried "I'm sorry, thank you," the girl blew her nose with all her might.

lines.content: 鼻先が真っ赤になっている。
lines.translated: The tip of her nose turned bright red.

lines.content: そんな女の子に俺は笑いかけ、言った。
lines.translated: I smiled at her and spoke up.

lines.content: 先輩。大丈夫です。俺が先輩をひとりになんてさせませんよ
lines.translated: "Senpai, it's okay. I won't let you end up all alone."

lines.content: この先もしも先輩が独り身でさみしい思いをするようなことがあったそのときは――俺が先輩のことを[さら|攫]いに行きます
lines.translated: "If there ever comes a time in the future when you're single and feeling lonely--I'll come and sweep you off your feet."

lines.content: 何気ないふうにそう言った。いや。ちょっと格好つけてそんなことを言ってみた。
lines.translated: I said it casually. No, actually, I was trying to sound a little cool when I said it.

lines.content: 女の子は目をぱちくりとさせる。
lines.translated: The girl blinked in surprise.

lines.content: だから、先輩。あず咲先輩。先輩はいやでもひとりぼっちにはなれないと思いますよ
lines.translated: "So, Senpai. Azusaki-senpai. Whether you like it or not, I don't think you'll ever be able to end up all alone."

lines.content: もし先輩が少しでもさみしい思いをしていたら、すぐにでも俺が[さら|攫]って世界中色々連れ回します。今から騒がしいばかりの老後を覚悟しておくといいですよ
lines.translated: "If you ever feel even the slightest bit lonely, I'll sweep you away right then and there and take you all around the world. You'd better prepare yourself now for a noisy, lively old age."

lines.content: 得意げに胸を張りそう言った――女の子はきょとんとしていたけれど、すぐに小さく微笑みを作ってくれた。
lines.translated: I puffed out my chest proudly as I said it--and though the girl looked stunned at first, she quickly gave me a small smile.

lines.content: その笑顔の性質というか、毛色というのか。
lines.translated: The nature of that smile, or rather, the feel of it...

lines.content: とにかく彼女のそれと同じものを俺は知っている。
lines.translated: Anyway, I knew someone else with that exact same smile.

lines.content: 彼女の名前は[とあ|兎蛙][あずさ|あず咲]。
lines.translated: Her name was Toa Azusaki.

lines.content: ひとつ先輩であり智仁の姉である。
lines.translated: She was a year ahead of me, and Tomohito's older sister.

lines.content: 彼女はこことは違う、遠い別のところに住んでいる。
lines.translated: She lived in a distant, different place far away from here.

lines.content: 故にあまり顔を合わすような機会もないのが本来なのだろうが……。
lines.translated: Because of that, we normally didn't have many chances to see each other face-to-face, and yet...

lines.content: そんな彼女も。
lines.translated: Even so, she...

lines.content: “遠いところにいる人”であるあず咲先輩も、同じだ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai, someone who lived "far away," was the same.

lines.content: ハル。千和。姫織。彼女らと、同じ。
lines.translated: Haru. Chiwa. Himeori. She was the same as them.

lines.content: 十年前に繰り広げられた“人類の未来を護る”という大きな物語の中心人物。そのひとり。
lines.translated: One of the central figures in the grand tale of "protecting humanity's future" that had unfolded ten years ago.

lines.content: 要するに……魔法少女。
lines.translated: In short... a magical girl.

lines.content: いや、“元”魔法少女だ――
lines.translated: No, a "former" magical girl--

lines.content: 先輩、今日はどうして、この町へ？
lines.translated: "Senpai, what brought you to town today?"

lines.content: 何かあったんですかと思い問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: Wondering if something had happened, I decided to ask.

lines.content: いえいえ。いつもと同じですよ。ちょっと時間が空いたので家族の様子でも見てこようかなあって思ったんです。だけど……
lines.translated: "Oh, nothing special. Just the usual. I had a little free time, so I thought I'd drop by and see how my family was doing. However..."

lines.content: だけど？
lines.translated: "It's just?"

lines.content: はい。だけどちょっとタイミングが悪かったみたいです。まだ誰も帰宅していませんでした
lines.translated: "Yes, it seems my timing was a little off. Nobody was home yet."

lines.content: そうですか。智仁とも会えなかったんですね
lines.translated: "I see. So you didn't get to see Tomohito, either."

lines.content: あいつとはさっき別れたばっかりだ。
lines.translated: I had just parted ways with him a little while ago.

lines.content: まさにすれ違いだった。
lines.translated: They must have just missed each other.

lines.content: はい、そうなんです。ともくんにも会えませんでした。おねーちゃん、余計にさみしい気持ちです
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. I couldn't see Tomo-kun, either. It makes your big sis feel even lonelier."

lines.content: 苦笑いであず咲先輩は言った。思えばもうずいぶんとともくんとは話してませんね、と。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai gave a wry smile, adding that now that she thought about it, she hadn't spoken to Tomo-kun in quite a long time.

lines.content: 次のバスがもう最後なので、誰か帰ってくるのを待ってるわけにもいきませんし。だから書き置きだけは残してきましたけど……
lines.translated: "The next bus is the last one for the night, so I can't really wait around for someone to come home. I did leave a note behind, though..."

lines.content: 気づいてくれたらいいなあって思いますと言って、女の子は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: "I hope they notice it," the girl said with a smile.

lines.content: それは周りの空気まで不思議と柔らかくしてしまうような笑顔だった。
lines.translated: It was the kind of smile that mysteriously softened the very air around her.

lines.content: 何かと後ろ向きな発言だったり思考だったりをしている女の子、兎蛙あず咲。
lines.translated: Toa Azusaki, a girl who was always making pessimistic remarks and thinking negative thoughts.

lines.content: いつも脳天気と言ってもまあそれほど間違ってもいないだろう弟とは正反対の性格だけれど……。
lines.translated: Her personality was the complete opposite of her younger brother, whom you wouldn't be far off in calling eternally carefree...

lines.content: その笑顔だけは良くよく似ていた。
lines.translated: Yet their smiles were remarkably alike.

lines.content: 不思議と誰をも味方に付けてしまう人なつっこい笑顔――彼を、彼女を、悪く言おうと思う人間は誰もいない。
lines.translated: An endearing, friendly smile that mysteriously won over everyone--there wasn't a person alive who could think ill of him, or of her.

lines.content: その人生に敵はいないのだ。
lines.translated: They had no enemies in life.

lines.content: つまり無敵。
lines.translated: Which meant they were invincible.

lines.content: そんな笑顔だ。
lines.translated: That was the kind of smile it was.

lines.content: ……だけど先輩はまた顔をくしゃっとさせて、
lines.translated: Even so, Senpai's face crumpled again.

lines.content: 大雅くんと別れたらまたひとりぼっちな時間に戻らなきゃいけません……うう……
lines.translated: "Once we part ways, Taiga-kun, I'll have to go back to being all alone again... Ugh..."

lines.content: くすんと鼻を啜る先輩だった。
lines.translated: Senpai sniffled.

lines.content: 後ろ向きな発言が多い先輩だ。最強無敵な武器ともなろう笑顔より、めそめそ泣くほうが多いのだ。
lines.translated: She really did say a lot of negative things. Rather than flashing that smile that could serve as the ultimate, invincible weapon, she spent far more time sniffling and crying.

lines.content: それでも俺はこのお姉さんと話すのが好きだった。なんだか落ち着くからだ。めそめそするこの人を大丈夫ですよと励ます自分のことが好きなのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Still, I liked talking to her. It calmed me down somehow. Or maybe I just liked the version of myself who could comfort this whimpering girl and tell her that everything would be okay.

lines.content: だからもう少し、あと少しだけ話していたいと、いつも思うのだが……。
lines.translated: That was why I always wished I could talk to her for just a little bit longer, but...

lines.content: あ、もう時間です。バスが来ちゃいました
lines.translated: "Ah, it's time. The bus is here."

lines.content: ……道の向こうからやって来るその姿を見つけてしまう。
lines.translated: I spotted it coming down the road from the distance.

lines.content: 残念です。もうちょっと大雅くんとお話していたかったのに
lines.translated: "That's too bad. I really wanted to talk with you a little longer, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: そうですね。本当に残念です。……本当に
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really is a shame. ...Really."

lines.content: わ、わぁ……今日の大雅くんは、あれですね
lines.translated: "W-Whoa... Taiga-kun, today you're really..."

lines.content: あれ？
lines.translated: "Oh?"
