lines.content: はい。あれなんです。……さみしいおねーちゃんを[さら|攫]いに来てくれると約束してくれるし、それにそんな、別れ際にさみしそうな顔をしてくれるし……えへへ
lines.translated: "Yes, you really are... Promising to come sweep your lonely big sis off her feet, and making such a sad face when it's time to say goodbye... Ehehe."

lines.content: 照れたような笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: She gave me a bashful smile.

lines.content: どうしよう。おねーちゃん、うれしくて泣いてしまいそうですよ……？
lines.translated: "What am I going to do? Your big sis is so happy she might just cry, you know...?"

lines.content: それじゃ、大雅くん。おねーちゃんは帰りますね
lines.translated: "Well then, Taiga-kun. Your big sis is heading home now."

lines.content: バスが停まる。
lines.translated: The bus came to a stop.

lines.content: 少しレトロなデザインのバスである。
lines.translated: It had a slightly retro design.

lines.content: ビーッと警告のブザーを鳴らしながら扉を開く。
lines.translated: With the beep of a warning buzzer, the doors opened.

lines.content: ……とうっ
ぴょんと小さくジャンプして乗り込んだ。
lines.translated: She gave a little hop and boarded the bus.

lines.content: ……スカートがふわりと膨らむ。
lines.translated: Her skirt billowed softly.

lines.content: どこからか風に流されてきたさくらの花びらを踊らせながら、先輩はこちらをくるりと振り返る。
lines.translated: Sending cherry blossom petals that had drifted in on the wind from somewhere dancing through the air, Senpai spun around to face me.

lines.content: チョコレート、ありがとうございます。とっても甘くて美味しかったです。まるでやさしい大雅くんみたいに甘かったですよ
lines.translated: "Thank you for the chocolate. It was so sweet and delicious. Just as sweet as you and your kindness, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 元気づけてくれてありがとうってことです。ちょっと勇気が出ました。おねーちゃんは今夜はひとりぼっちでも平気そうです
lines.translated: "What I mean is, thank you for cheering me up. I feel a little braver now. I think your big sis will be just fine on her own tonight."

lines.content: でわでわ。また来ます。また会えたら、すてきです
lines.translated: "Well then, bye-bye! I'll come visit again. It would be wonderful if we could meet again."

lines.content: そうですね。また会えたらとてもすてきですね
lines.translated: "Yeah. It really would be wonderful to see you again."

lines.content: ……はい
そのときは、大雅くん。もっともっと私とお話してくれたら、うれしいな……。それと、ともくんにもよろしくね
lines.translated: "When we do, Taiga-kun, it would make me really happy if you talked with me lots and lots more... Also, tell Tomo-kun I said hi, okay?"

lines.content: 扉が閉まる。
lines.translated: The door closes.

lines.content: 扉越しに手を振り合う。
lines.translated: We waved to each other through the closing doors.

lines.content: 俺はバスの姿が見えなくなるまで見送った。
lines.translated: I watched the bus until it was completely out of sight.

lines.content: 先輩。
lines.translated: Senpai.

lines.content: ……あず咲先輩。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: もっと、もっと、話したいことがあった。
lines.translated: There was so, so much more I wanted to talk to her about.

lines.content: たとえばハルが帰ってきたこととか……。
lines.translated: Like how Haru had come back...

lines.content: どうにかして、またみんな揃って話ができる時間を作れないかどうか、とか。
lines.translated: Or if there was some way we could make time for all of us to get together and talk again.

lines.content: “遠いところに住んでいる人”
lines.translated: "Someone who lives far away."

lines.content: 兎蛙あず咲。
lines.translated: Toa Azusaki.

lines.content: 次はいつ会えるだろう。
lines.translated: I wondered when I would be able to see her next.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら――つぶやく。
lines.translated: Turning those thoughts over in my mind--I murmured to myself.

lines.content: ……なあ智仁
lines.translated: "...Hey, Tomohito."

lines.content: なあ、親友。
lines.translated: Hey, my best friends.

lines.content: ……お前が抱えてる問題とか、悩みとか、いつか俺にも話してくれるよな
lines.translated: "...Someday, you'll tell me about the problems and worries you're carrying around, right?"

lines.content: 親友と出会える確率は二十四億分の一……、か。
lines.translated: The odds of meeting a best friend are one in 2.4 billion... huh?

lines.content: “鍵”を取り出す。
lines.translated: I took out the "key."

lines.content: 俺は改めて辺りを見回すのだ。
lines.translated: Then, I took another look around the area.

lines.content: すると……。
lines.translated: And when I did...

lines.content: はは。みーつけた
lines.translated: "Haha. Found you."

lines.content: 誰かが側にいると姿を見せない恥ずかしがり屋の耳と尻尾が、電柱の裏側から見えていた。
lines.translated: Poking out from behind a utility pole were the ears and tail of a shy girl who never showed herself when someone else was around.

lines.content: クロと一緒に“ゆめのねどこ”に帰宅した。
lines.translated: Together with Kuro, I returned home to the "Dream Bed."

lines.content: クロは相変わらず俺の背中に隠れたままで……、
lines.translated: Kuro was still hiding behind my back as usual...

lines.content: おかえり。ふたりとも
lines.translated: "Welcome home, you two."

lines.content: っ
びくりとし、耳が飛び出す。
lines.translated: She flinched, and her ears popped out.

lines.content: そして俺の背中にしがみつくようにして、隠れた。
lines.translated: Then she clung tightly to my back to hide herself.

lines.content: そんな様子にあさひさんは苦笑いを浮かべ、改めて『おかえり』の言葉と共に、こう言った。
lines.translated: Watching this, Asahi-san gave a wry smile, and along with another "Welcome home," she said this:

lines.content: おかえり大雅。遅かったな。……“夜の国”の小さな神さまが。ナナちゃんが、待ってるぞ
lines.translated: "Welcome back, Taiga. You're late. ...The little goddess of the 'Night Country'--Nana-chan--is waiting for you."

lines.content: ……ナナちゃんが呼んでいる。
lines.translated: Nana-chan is calling for me.

lines.content: しかも俺だけではなくハルも一緒に、ということらしかった。
lines.translated: What's more, it sounded like she wanted Haru to come along with me, too.

lines.content: 意外だった。
lines.translated: That was unexpected.

lines.content: 昨晩は、ナナちゃんに会いにやって来るのは俺だけでいいと言っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Last night, she'd said that I was the only one who needed to come see her, and yet...

lines.content: 今夜はふたりに私の仕事を手伝ってもらいたい
lines.translated: "Tonight, I'd like the two of you to help me with my work."

lines.content: 呼ばれるままやってきた[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]に、ナナちゃんは平然とそう言うのだった。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said this nonchalantly to *us* once we arrived as summoned.

lines.content: いや。ふたりじゃなくて、三人、だね。とにかくあなた達に手伝ってもらいたい仕事があるんだよ
lines.translated: "No. Not two of you--three, I suppose. Anyway, I have a job I'd like your help with."

lines.content: ナナちゃんの言葉にうなずく俺の隣には、ナナちゃんの要望通りハル、そして十夜がいる。
lines.translated: As I nodded at Nana-chan's words, standing next to me were Haru, just as Nana-chan had requested, and Toya.

lines.content: 『どこに行くの？　私も、行きたいなあ……』
lines.translated: "Where are you going? I want to go, too..."

lines.content: ふたりして出かけようとしていた俺とハルを、もじもじしながら見送る十夜はそう言った。
lines.translated: Toya had said that, fidgeting as she watched Haru and me getting ready to head out together.

lines.content: 別段断る理由も俺たちにはなく連れてきた十夜に、しかし、ナナちゃんはいやな顔をするかもしれない――ここに到着してからようやく想像できたこの俺だったが、
lines.translated: Having no particular reason to refuse, we brought Toya along. It only occurred to me after we arrived that Nana-chan might not be happy about it, but...

lines.content: 『……あめ玉。食べる？』
lines.translated: "...Here's a piece of candy. Want one?"

lines.content: と、ナナちゃんは少しだけ照れたようにお菓子を差し出し、十夜を歓迎して見せてくれていた。
lines.translated: Looking a little shy, Nana-chan held out a treat to show that Toya was welcome.

lines.content: おかえり、ハル。大雅の言うとおり、見違えるくらい大きくなったね
lines.translated: "Welcome back, Haru. Just like Taiga said, you've grown so much I almost didn't recognize you."

lines.content: 久しぶりに会ったハルにもナナちゃんはお菓子を差し出す。十夜に渡したのと同じあめ玉だった。
lines.translated: Nana-chan held out a treat to Haru as well, whom she was seeing for the first time in a long while. It was the same kind of hard candy she had given Toya.

lines.content: ……うん。ありがとう。ナナちゃんは変わらないね。ちっちゃくてかわいいままだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Thank you. You haven't changed at all, Nana-chan. You're still as tiny and cute as ever."

lines.content: あめ玉を受け取り、にこりと微笑むハルに、ナナちゃんも小さく笑った。
lines.translated: Haru took the candy and beamed, and Nana-chan gave a small smile in return.

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: 三人のやり取りを――いいや、ハルとナナちゃんのやり取りを側で見ていた俺は安堵する。
lines.translated: Watching the three of them interact from the side--or rather, watching the exchange between Haru and Nana-chan--I breathed a sigh of relief.

lines.content: いったいナナちゃんの心境にどのような変化が、たった半日程度の時間の中であったのかはわからないのだが……。
lines.translated: I had no idea what kind of change of heart Nana-chan had gone through in the span of just half a day, though...

lines.content: ナナちゃんにだって当然のことだが何か考えがあるはずだ。
lines.translated: Naturally, Nana-chan must have her own thoughts on the matter.

lines.content: とにかく今は彼女の話を聞くことにする。
lines.translated: For now, I decided to just listen to what she had to say.

lines.content: 俺たちはいったいどのような仕事を手伝えばいいのだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of work did she want us to help her with, anyway?

lines.content: 昨日。大雅が私のところに連れてきた[・|こ][・|の][・|子]を次の場所に連れて行かなきゃならない
lines.translated: "Yesterday, Taiga brought *this little one* to me, and now I have to take her to the next place."

lines.content: そう言うナナちゃんの胸元には“ぬいぐるみ”が――昨晩、“夜の国”で暴れていたあの“悪夢”がいた。
lines.translated: Held against Nana-chan's chest as she spoke was a "stuffed animal"--the "Nightmare" that had been rampaging through the "Night Country" last night.

lines.content: 俺は、学園からの帰り道で耳にしたことをナナちゃんに報告した。
lines.translated: I reported to Nana-chan what I had overheard on my way home from the academy.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|子]の持ち主は元気みたいだよ。やさしい人とも出会えたみたいだ
lines.translated: "It seems like *her* owner is doing well. Looks like she met someone kind, too."

lines.content: きっともう、自ら命を投げ出すような真似はしないだろう。
lines.translated: I was sure she wouldn't try to throw her own life away anymore.

lines.content: “……やっぱり”
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: ふと、声がした。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I heard a voice.

lines.content: “……私はやっぱり、いないほうがよかったんだよね”
lines.translated: "...It really is better that I'm not around, isn't it?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんが抱きしめた“ぬいぐるみ”の声だ。
lines.translated: It was the voice of the "stuffed animal" Nana-chan was hugging.

lines.content: “大切なあの子を……大切にしなきゃならない[あの子自身|私自身]のことを……私はずっと、傷つけていた。私がいなければあの子は笑顔……なんだよね”
lines.translated: "That precious girl... the girl I'm supposed to treasure, myself... I've been hurting her this whole time. Without me, she can smile... right?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんはぎゅっとぬいぐるみを抱きしめた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan hugged the stuffed animal tightly.

lines.content: 人の心に産まれた恐怖や不安やさみしさが“夜の国”で形を得たもの――それが“悪夢”だ。
lines.translated: Fear, anxiety, and loneliness born in a person's heart that take form in the "Night Country"--that is what a "Nightmare" is.

lines.content: そこにはいつしか自律した[自我|感情]さえも芽生えてしまう。
lines.translated: Before long, even an autonomous ego--real emotions--sprouts within them.

lines.content: そして[・|本][・|人]の意志とは無関係に“悪夢”は持ち主の心を責め立てはじめる――負の感情はただそこにあるだけで持ち主の暗闇となってしまうのだ。
lines.translated: And regardless of *their* own will, the "Nightmare" begins to torment its owner's heart--negative emotions become darkness for the owner simply by existing there.

lines.content: 一日かけて[・|こ][・|の][・|子]と色々話をしてみた
lines.translated: "I spent the whole day talking about all sorts of things with *this little one*."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan spoke.

lines.content: つらい。悲しい。そして、さみしい。お父さんとお母さんはもう帰ってこない。どうして自分ばかりがこんな目に……。
lines.translated: It's painful. It's sad. And I'm so lonely. Mom and Dad are never coming back. Why do these things always happen to me...?

lines.content: 神さまは。この世界は。きっと私のことが大嫌いなんだ――そんな少女の心が生み出した“悪夢”という存在。
lines.translated: God... and this world... must really hate me--the being called a "Nightmare" was born from the heart of a girl who felt that way.

lines.content: “夜”の中で鎮めることで、少女の“心”から“悪夢”だけを切り離した。
lines.translated: By quelling it within the "Night," we severed only the "Nightmare" from the girl's "heart."

lines.content: 持ち主の“心”にはもう戻れない。
lines.translated: It can never return to its owner's "heart" again.

lines.content: もしも戻れたとしても、自分を生み出した少女を、今度こそ、殺してしまいかねない。
lines.translated: And even if it could return, next time, it really might end up killing the girl who created it.

lines.content: ……すべての“[想像力|心]”が形を持つ“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Night Country," where all "imagination" and "hearts" take form.

lines.content: そこで自立した自我を持ってしまった“悪夢”は考える。
lines.translated: Having gained an independent ego there, the "Nightmare" thinks to itself:

lines.content: [・|自][・|分]という存在は[少女|あの子]にとって暗闇以外の何者でもない。
lines.translated: *My* existence is nothing more than darkness to that girl.

lines.content: だけどその[悪夢|暗闇]が自ら消滅を望むのなら。
lines.translated: But if that Nightmare--that darkness--wishes for its own destruction...

lines.content: あの子の中から、一時的なものとは言え、重く苦しい感情は消えてなくなる。
lines.translated: Even if it's only temporary, the heavy, painful emotions will vanish from inside that girl.

lines.content: “悪夢”を生み出した心の[少女|持ち主]は、きっと、また別の“悪夢”が芽生えるまでのほんの少しの間かもしれないけれど――笑顔で生きていくことができるだろう。
lines.translated: The girl--the owner of the heart that birthed the "Nightmare"--will surely be able to live with a smile on her face, even if it's only for a brief while until another "Nightmare" takes root.

lines.content: それはある種のハッピーエンドであるはずだ。
lines.translated: In a way, that should be a happy ending.

lines.content: それなのに、どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: And yet, why is it?

lines.content: 俺はこうして“悪夢”と向き合う度に、手放しでは喜べない複雑な気持ちになってしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Every time I face a "Nightmare" like this, I'm left with complicated feelings that keep me from celebrating wholeheartedly.

lines.content: ……何もあなただけが消えてなくなる必要はない
lines.translated: "...There's no need for you to be the only one to disappear."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそう言ってぬいぐるみの頭を撫でた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said this, gently stroking the stuffed animal's head.

lines.content: このまま、私とここで……この列車の中で一緒に暮らすことだってできる
lines.translated: "You could stay right here with me... We could live together on this train."

lines.content: 理由はどうあれこうして産まれてきたんだ。この子だって一度くらい、楽しいことを経験してみる権利はある。でも……
lines.translated: "Whatever the reason, you were born into this world. Even she has the right to experience something fun at least once. But..."

lines.content: でもね。この子は次へ行くことを強く望んだ
lines.translated: "But, you see, she strongly wished to move on to the next place."
"The next place."

lines.content: “悪夢”は自ら消滅を望むということだ。
lines.translated: That meant the "Nightmare" wished for its own destruction.

lines.content: もしも自分が何かの間違いで、また、持ち主の心に戻ったのなら――
lines.translated: If by some mistake it were to ever return to its owner's heart again--

lines.content: [少女|持ち主]はきっと、そのときこそ自ら命を絶ってしまいかねない。
lines.translated: Next time, the girl--its owner--really might take her own life.

lines.content: だから“悪夢”は自ら消えてなくなることにした。
lines.translated: That was why the "Nightmare" had chosen to disappear on its own.

lines.content: ……“[この子|悪夢]”を私は見送りたい。たったひとりで行くのはあまりにさみしいことだから
lines.translated: "...I want to see this 'Nightmare'--this little one--off. Because going all alone is just too lonely."
*At the end of life, there is a place that everyone visits without fail.*

lines.content: そこに“悪夢”を無事に送り届ける。それがナナちゃんの仕事のひとつである。
lines.translated: Safely delivering the "Nightmare" there. That is one of Nana-chan's jobs.

lines.content: そして俺たちが手伝うべきナナちゃんの仕事というのは――
lines.translated: And the job of Nana-chan's that we were supposed to help with was--

lines.content: 大雅。ハル。それに十夜。三人には私の……言ってみれば通常業務を手伝ってもらいたいんだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. Haru. And Toya. I'd like the three of you to help me with my... well, you could call it my regular duties."

lines.content: ナナちゃんの通常業務？
lines.translated: "Your regular duties, Nana-chan?"

lines.content: そう。私は毎晩、“夜の国”に散らばっている願いを回収して回ってる。そして今夜“[この子|悪夢]”を送り届ける場所に運んでいるんだけど……
lines.translated: "Yes. Every night, I go around collecting the wishes scattered across the 'Night Country.' And tonight, I'll be carrying them to the same place I'm delivering this 'Nightmare,' this little one, to, so..."

lines.content: その願いの回収を、今回は三人にお願いできたらいいなって思ってるんだよ
lines.translated: "I was hoping I could ask the three of you to handle collecting those wishes this time."

lines.content: ……“参禅町”にはいくつかの噂話があった。
lines.translated: There were a few rumors floating around "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: そのひとつに、こんなものがある。
lines.translated: One of them went like this:

lines.content: 眠る前、枕の下に“願い”を書いた手紙を忍ばせて夢を見ると――その願いは、夢の中に住む神さまに叶えてもらえるというものだ。
lines.translated: If you slip a letter with a "wish" written on it under your pillow before going to sleep and have a dream--that wish will be granted by a god who lives inside dreams.

lines.content: 子どもだましの都市伝説、あるいはどこにでもある七不思議のような噂話だ。
lines.translated: It sounded like a childish urban legend, or one of those "seven mysteries" you can find anywhere.

lines.content: だが全国津々浦々に存在しているそれらとまったく違う点は、言うまでもなく、その噂は真実であるということだ。
lines.translated: However, the one thing that made it completely different from similar stories found all across the country was, needless to say, the fact that the rumor was true.

lines.content: 願いの書かれた手紙はそれぞれの夢の中のどこかにある。“夜”を通じて、夢と夢とを渡り歩いて……それを探して、回収してもらいたい
lines.translated: "The letters with the wishes written on them are located somewhere inside each person's dream. I want you to travel from dream to dream through the 'Night'... find them, and collect them for me."

lines.content: 今夜は“[ぬいぐるみ|悪夢]”を送り届ける道中にその仕事を行うのだという――“[ぬいぐるみ|悪夢]”も、“願い”も、行き着く先はどちらも同じ。
lines.translated: She said we would be doing this job on our way to deliver the "stuffed animal"--the "Nightmare." Both the "stuffed animal" and the "wishes" shared the exact same final destination.

lines.content: この列車はね、この町で眠る人たちの心と心をつないで渡る。そうして願いを回収してそれを叶える場所にまで私が運ぶ
lines.translated: "You see, this train connects and crosses between the hearts of the people sleeping in this town. That's how I collect the wishes and carry them to the place where they are granted."

lines.content: それなりに大仕事になる場合もあるから私ひとりじゃとうてい間に合わないんだ
lines.translated: "Sometimes it turns into quite a big job, so there's no way I can manage it all by myself in time."

lines.content: “悪夢”との戦いも。“願い”の回収も。十年前は……かつて“魔法少女”だったあなた達の仕事のひとつだった。だから今更あえて説明をする必要もなかったかもしれないけれど……
lines.translated: "Both fighting 'Nightmares' and collecting 'wishes.' Ten years ago... those were part of your jobs when you were 'magical girls.' So I probably didn't even need to go out of my way to explain it now, but..."

lines.content: とにかくよろしくお願いしたいんだよとナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: "In any case, I'm counting on you," Nana-chan said.

lines.content: うん。わかったよナナちゃん。今の私がどこまでできるのかわからないけど……。一生懸命、がんばるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Got it, Nana-chan. I don't know how much I'll be able to do as I am now, though... I'll try my absolute best."

lines.content: しっかりと両手を胸の前で握りしめ、ハルは何度か深くうなずいていた。
lines.translated: Clasping both hands tightly in front of her chest, Haru nodded deeply several times.

lines.content: そんなハルの様子にナナちゃんは微笑みを浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: Watching Haru act like that, a smile graced Nana-chan's lips, and she spoke.

lines.content: ……ハルは、大人になったよね
lines.translated: "...You've really grown up, haven't you, Haru?"

lines.content: え？　私が……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Me...?"

lines.content: うん。まだハルは“夜の国”にこうして肉体を持ち込めるみたいだけど……それはまだ、心に少女な部分が残ってるって証拠だけれど……でもね、あなたは十分、大きくなったよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It looks like you can still bring your physical body into the 'Night Country' like this... which is proof that a part of your heart is still a young girl's... But even so, you've grown up plenty."

lines.content: そうかな
lines.translated: "You think so?"

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはうなずく。そして、微笑む。
lines.translated: Nana-chan nodded. And then, she smiled.

lines.content: だって、ほら。私を昔みたいにめちゃめちゃにしたりしないしね。これって驚くべき成長だよ
lines.translated: "I mean, look. You're not roughing me up like you used to. That's astonishing growth."

lines.content: めちゃめちゃ？
lines.translated: "Roughing you up?"

lines.content: 抱きついたりなで回したり。……あのときは大変だった。だけど今の大きくなったハルなら、大雅と一緒にまた会いに来てくれても――
lines.translated: "Clinging to me and petting me all over. ...It was really rough back then. But now that you've grown up, Haru, even if you come visit me with Taiga again--"

lines.content: ハル？
lines.translated: "Haru?"

lines.content: ……ごめんねナナちゃん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Nana-chan."

lines.content: え？　ごめんって……どうして？
lines.translated: "Huh? Sorry... Why?"

lines.content: きょとんとするナナちゃんに、ハルは気まずげに言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan blinked in surprise, and Haru spoke awkwardly.

lines.content: 私……やっぱりまだまだ子どもみたい。結構ね。うん。あのね。我慢してたりするんだよ……本当はね
lines.translated: "I... guess I'm still a kid after all. Pretty much, yeah. Um, you see... I'm actually holding myself back right now... to tell the truth."

lines.content: 両手をわきわきとさせるハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru was flexing her fingers eagerly in the air.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは変わらないよね。変わらずすっごいかわいいよね。あのときと変わらずぎゅ～ってしたくなっちゃうよね
lines.translated: "You haven't changed at all, Nana-chan. You're still super cute as ever. Just like back then, it makes me wanna give you a biiig squeeze."

lines.content: ――ナナちゃんは半眼で一歩、二歩、と距離を取る。そしてちらりと俺を見た。
lines.translated: --With half-lidded eyes, Nana-chan took one step back, then two, putting some distance between them. Then she shot a quick glance at me.

lines.content: ああ、そうか。なるほど。
lines.translated: Ah, I see. That makes sense.

lines.content: 俺はその一瞬で、なんとなくだがナナちゃんの考えていることがわかった。どうしてハルを連れて来るようにと言ったのか。その理由をだ。
lines.translated: In that brief instant, I somehow understood what Nana-chan was thinking. Why she had told me to bring Haru along. The reason behind it.

lines.content: そんなナナちゃんの警戒心を滲ませた態度に、ハルは慌てたように言う。
lines.translated: Seeing the wariness seeping into Nana-chan's demeanor, Haru spoke up in a fluster.

lines.content: ……う、うん。でもやらないよ。ぎゅってしない。本当は撫で撫でしたいし抱きしめたい気持ちになって大変だけど……昔みたいにはしないよ。うん。絶対
lines.translated: "...Y-Yeah. But I won't do it. No squeezing. Honestly, it's super hard holding back the urge to pet you and hug you, but... I won't act like I used to. Yep. Definitely."

lines.content: ……絶対？
lines.translated: "...Definitely?"

lines.content: 絶対だよ。好きな子に嫌われちゃうほどいっぱい愛情表現してたらさ、そんなのただの頭とか心が大変な人だもんね。だからね、うん、絶対にね……したいよ……？
lines.translated: "Definitely. If you shower someone you like with so much affection that they end up hating you, that just makes you a total basket case in the head and heart, right? So yeah, definitely... I wanna do it...?"

lines.content: ……したい？
lines.translated: "...You want to?"

lines.content: う、ううんっ、違う！　違ったよ、間違えちゃった……絶対、ぜったい、しないよ！
lines.translated: "N-No, wait! That's not it, I messed up... I definitely, *definitely* won't do it!"

lines.content: 手をわきわきとさせながらそんなことを言うハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru said all that while still flexing her fingers eagerly in the air.

lines.content: ジト目のナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan stared at her with flat, unamused eyes.

lines.content: しかしすぐに、何かを諦めたようにひとつ、ため息をつき、
lines.translated: However, she quickly let out a single sigh as if giving up on something.

lines.content: ……まあ、何はともあれまた会えてよかった。ハル。それだけは確かだと思うんだよ
lines.translated: "...Well, whatever the case, I'm glad I got to see you again, Haru. I think that much is certain."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは小さく微笑み――言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan offered a small smile--and spoke.

lines.content: さあ、準備はできてる？　出かけようか。この世の美しいもののすべてが行き着く先へ……[・|刻][・|の][・|終][・|着][・|駅]に、出発だ
lines.translated: "Now then, is everyone ready? Let's get going. Toward the place where all the beautiful things in this world end up... Departing for the *Terminal Station of Time*."

lines.content: 列車は進む。
lines.translated: The train moved forward.

lines.content: 目指すは終点。[・|刻][・|の][・|終][・|わ][・|り]。今はその道中――夜空がきれいな海の上。
lines.translated: Our destination was the end of the line. The *End of Time*. Right now, we were on our way there--traveling atop an ocean beneath a beautiful night sky.

lines.content: 波ひとつない静かな海面に線路が延びている。
lines.translated: The tracks stretched out across the calm, waveless surface of the sea.

lines.content: ここは夢だ。誰かの見ている夢の中――列車は“夜の国”を通じて、夢と夢を渡るのだ。
lines.translated: This was a dream. Inside a dream someone was having--the train crossed from dream to dream through the "Night Country."

lines.content: ここで願いの込められた手紙を探す。
lines.translated: Here, we would search for the letters filled with wishes.

lines.content: [手紙|願い]の[ありか|在処]はこの列車が探してくれる。まずは[この子|列車]にまかせておけばいいよ
lines.translated: "This train will find the whereabouts of the letters--the wishes--for us. For now, we can just leave it to this little one."

lines.content: 運転席から出てきたナナちゃんがそう言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said this as she stepped out of the driver's cab.

lines.content: そして俺たちの座る四人掛けの客席に腰掛ける。
lines.translated: Then, she took a seat in the four-person booth where the rest of us were sitting.

lines.content: かたんかたんと心地よく揺れる車体にその身を任せ――車窓を流れる夢の国の光景を、俺たちと一緒に眺めた。
lines.translated: Letting her body sway with the comfortable clack-clack of the train car--she gazed out the window with us at the scenery of the dream world flowing by.

lines.content: 運転はいいのかな
lines.translated: "Is it okay to leave the driving unattended?"

lines.content: 大丈夫。[この子|列車]は賢いから
lines.translated: "It's fine. This train--this little one--is very smart."

lines.content: 俺の疑問にナナちゃんは短い言葉で答えてくれた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan answered my question in a few short words.

lines.content: 私があれこれ言ったりするよりも任せておいたほうがずっといい仕事をしてくれる。この子の運転に限らず、そういう場合はたくさんあるよね
lines.translated: "She does a much better job when I leave things to her rather than fussing over every little detail. And that's true for a lot of things, not just her driving, right?"

lines.content: ああ……、そうかも
lines.translated: "Yeah... Maybe so."

lines.content: まるで列車に心があるみたいだね
lines.translated: "It's almost like the train has a heart of its own."

lines.content: ハルは客室車両をぐるりと見渡した。俺たち四人以外には誰もいないこの場所を。
lines.translated: Haru looked around the passenger car. At this space where there was no one else besides the four of us.

lines.content: そんなハルにナナちゃんはうなずいて、言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan nodded at Haru and spoke.

lines.content: 何にだって心はあるよ。見えないだけでどこにでもある
lines.translated: "Everything has a heart. You just can't see them,套餐but they're everywhere."

lines.content: ……そうなの？
lines.translated: "...Really?"

lines.content: 十夜が恐る恐るという具合に、隣に座ったナナちゃんを見上げていた。
lines.translated: Toya looked up at Nana-chan sitting next to her, sounding somewhat timid.

lines.content: そしてナナちゃんは『そうだよ』と言って、うなずく。
lines.translated: "That's right," Nana-chan said, nodding.

lines.content: もちろんどんな猫にだって心はあるし……何者でもないはずの私にも、ほら、なぜだか心のようなものがある
lines.translated: "Of course every cat has a heart... and look, even someone like me, who isn't supposed to be anyone at all, somehow has something like a heart."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべるナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: A wry smile floated onto Nana-chan's face.

lines.content: 目に見えなくとも、いつでも、どこにでも、それは確かにあるんだよ……人の心も直接目には見えないけれど、言葉と気持ちが触れあえるから、“そこにある”って思えるんだよ
lines.translated: "Even if it's invisible to the eye, it's always there, everywhere, without fail... You can't see a person's heart directly either, but because our words and feelings can touch one another, we can believe that 'it's right there.'"

lines.content: じゃあね……あのね……これにも心はあるのかな
lines.translated: "Then... um... does this have a heart, too?"

lines.content: 十夜はごそごそとリュックサックを探り出す。
lines.translated: Toya began rummaging around in her backpack.

lines.content: たくさんの道具を詰め込めるあさひさん特製のリュックサックだ。そこから十夜が取り出したのは、
lines.translated: It was Asahi-san's specially made backpack, capable of holding all sorts of tools. What Toya pulled out of it was...

lines.content: トランプ……？
lines.translated: "Playing cards...?"

lines.content: うん。いつか暇があったら大雅とやろうと思って、ずっと前からリュックに入れてたの。その“いつか”が今かなあって
lines.translated: "Yeah. I put them in my backpack a long time ago, thinking I'd play with Taiga someday when we had free time. I figured maybe that 'someday' is right now."

lines.content: 十夜はトランプとかオセロとかが好きなんだよな
lines.translated: "You really like playing cards and Othello and stuff like that, don't you, Toya?"

lines.content: うん。大好き
lines.translated: "Yeah. I love them."

lines.content: にへら、と笑う。
lines.translated: She grinned happily.

lines.content: ひとりでやるのも好きだけど、ふたり用のも好きだよ。……でもね、もっといっぱいなら、トランプもオセロもね、もっともっと好きなんだよ
lines.translated: "I like playing by myself, and I like games for two people, too. ...But you know, when there are even more people, I love cards and Othello even more."

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき、ちょっと意地悪な顔をする。
lines.translated: I nodded, putting on a slightly teasing grin.

lines.content: 弱いのにな
lines.translated: "Even though you're terrible at them."

lines.content: よ、弱くないもん……っ
lines.translated: "I-I'm not terrible...!"

lines.content: 違うよー、と両手を振り上げる。
lines.translated: "That's not true!" she protested, throwing both hands up in the air.

lines.content: 違うもん。弱くない……まだ本気出してないだけだもん
lines.translated: "It's not true. I'm not terrible... I just haven't gotten serious yet."

lines.content: オセロもトランプも、毎晩一緒に遊んでるけど……十夜。まともに俺に勝てたことないだろうに
lines.translated: "We play Othello and cards together every night, Toya... and you haven't beaten me fair and square a single time, have you?"

lines.content: オセロは角を最初に取らせてあげたところからスタートするとか、トランプも同様に色々とハンデつき――にも関わらず、十夜は俺に一勝もできていないのだった。
lines.translated: In Othello, we'd start after I let her take the corners first, and in card games, I'd give her all sorts of similar handicaps--yet despite all that, Toya hadn't managed to score a single win against me.

lines.content: ……むかつく
lines.translated: "...So annoying."

lines.content: ぽつりと十夜は言うのだ。唇を尖らせ、頬を膨らませ――そっぽを向いて。
lines.translated: Toya muttered under her breath. She pouted her lips, puffed out her cheeks--and looked away.

lines.content: ……私が弱いんじゃないもん。大雅が意地悪なだけだもん。もうちょっとで勝てるかなあって思っても一気に逆転されちゃうし
lines.translated: "...It's not because I'm weak. Taiga is just a meanie. Every time I think I'm finally about to win, you turn the tables on me all at once."

lines.content: そうしたときの俺の勝ち誇ったような顔が大嫌いだよと、十夜はぷりぷりと両手を振り上げていた。
lines.translated: Saying she hated the triumphant look on my face whenever I did that, Toya angrily waved both hands in the air.

lines.content: 大雅くん……
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 呆れたような視線であった。
lines.translated: Haru gave me an exasperated look.

lines.content: 一回くらい勝たせてあげればいいのに。十夜がせっかく大好きなトランプとかが大嫌いになっちゃったらどうするの？　……あ、まさかとは思うけど
lines.translated: "You could let her win at least once, you know. What are you going to do if Toya ends up hating the card games she loves so much? ...Ah, I doubt it, but..."

lines.content: ん？　まさかとは？
lines.translated: "Hm? Doubt what?"

lines.content: まさか、大雅くん。十夜相手にいつも本気でやってたりしないよね
lines.translated: "Don't tell me, Taiga-kun. You're not actually going all out against Toya every single time, are you?"

lines.content: もちろん。俺は本気だ。当然だろう
lines.translated: "Of course I am. I'm dead serious. That's only natural, isn't it?"

lines.content: うわ～……それはちょっとひどいよ。大人げないんじゃないかな大雅くん
lines.translated: "Wow~... That's pretty harsh. Don't you think that's a little childish of you, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 大人げ……？　それって何？
lines.translated: "Childish...? Why wouldn't I be?"

lines.content: え？　何って……
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you mean..."

lines.content: 俺たちはまだ学生だ。大人とは言えない。だろ？　それなのに……
lines.translated: "We're still students. You can't call us adults yet. Right? And yet..."

lines.content: “まだ大人じゃないのに大人げなんてものあるわけがない”……とかそんなこと言い出すつもりじゃないよね？
lines.translated: "You're not about to say something like, 'How could I act like an adult when I'm not even an adult yet?' are you?"

lines.content: ……言い出すつもりでした
lines.translated: "...I was totally about to say that."

lines.content: なぜ、わかった……。
lines.translated: How did she know...?

lines.content: 屁理屈って知ってるかな大雅くん。大雅くんの[・|そ][・|れ]は屁理屈にもなっていないと思うけど
lines.translated: "Do you know what a lame excuse is, Taiga-kun? Though I don't think *that* even qualifies as a lame excuse."

lines.content: 呆れきったような目で見られてしまう。
lines.translated: She looked at me with utter exasperation in her eyes.

lines.content: な、なんだよ。別に十夜に意地悪しようっていう動機があったわけじゃないんだ。俺は俺なりの信念というか。十夜に誠実な対応をしていたつもりなんだよ
lines.translated: "W-What's with that look? It's not like I had some ulterior motive to be mean to Toya. It's more like my own personal conviction. I meant to treat Toya with complete sincerity."

lines.content: ……せいじつな、たいおー……って、何？
lines.translated: "...Twee-ting with sin-sew-ity... What's that?"

lines.content: きょとんと首を傾げた十夜に、
lines.translated: When Toya tilted her head in blank confusion,

lines.content: う
lines.translated: "Urk."

lines.content: 俺はちょっとたじろぐ。
lines.translated: I faltered a little.

lines.content: だが、めげずに続けた。
lines.translated: Still, I pressed on undeterred.

lines.content: だって、そうだろ。何であれ勝負なんだ。手を抜いて挑むほうが逆に失礼じゃないか
lines.translated: "I mean, think about it. A match is a match, no matter what it is. Holding back against your opponent is actually way more disrespectful, isn't it?"

lines.content: だから……だからっ、俺はたとえ相手がちょっとおバカな幼女さまだろうと常に本気で立ち向かうんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why... that's why I always go all out, even if my opponent happens to be a slightly silly little lady!"

lines.content: 手なんて抜かない、絶対だ――半ば開き直ってそう言う俺に、十夜は頬を膨らませる。
lines.translated: I'll never hold back, not ever--as I said that, halfway doubling down in defiance, Toya puffed out her cheeks.

lines.content: おバカって……、ひどいよ大雅
lines.translated: "Silly...? That's mean, Taiga."

lines.content: ご、ごめん。えっと、かわいい幼女さまを相手にしても手を抜かない。勝負っていうのはそれくらい神聖なものなんだ。きっと
lines.translated: "S-Sorry. Um, I don't hold back even against a cute little lady. That's just how sacred a match is. Probably."

lines.content: ……ほらね。大雅は意地悪なんだよ。だから嫌い。遊んでくれる大雅は好きだけど……やさしくない大雅は大嫌い
lines.translated: "...See? Taiga is a meanie. That's why I hate you. I like the Taiga who plays with me... but I hate the Taiga who isn't nice."

lines.content: いいよー、わかった。それじゃあ悪者を一緒にやっつけちゃおうか
lines.translated: "Alrighty, I got it. In that case, let's team up and take down the bad guy together!"

lines.content: ハルはトランプを器用にくると四人分、均等に配った。
lines.translated: Haru deftly shuffled the cards and dealt them out evenly for the four of us.

lines.content: ……私も？
lines.translated: "...Me too?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんは目をぱちくりとした。
lines.translated: Nana-chan blinked in surprise.

lines.content: うん。一緒に
lines.translated: "Yep. Together."

lines.content: ハルはナナちゃんに微笑みかける。
lines.translated: Haru smiled warmly at Nana-chan.

lines.content: そんなふたりに俺は問うのだ。
lines.translated: Watching the two of them, I asked a question.

lines.content: 何をする？　ババ抜きとか？　俺は悪いが負ける気がまったくしないな――何しろ俺は遊びに関しては、いいや、勝負事に関しては手を抜かない男だからだ
lines.translated: "What are we playing? Old Maid or something? Hate to break it to you, but I don't feel like I'm gonna lose at all--because when it comes to games, no, when it comes to competition, I'm a man who never holds back."

lines.content: 余裕ぶったその発言は文字通り余裕だったからだ。
lines.translated: That cocky statement came from the fact that I literally had plenty of room to be confident.

lines.content: 十夜は手札が丸わかりといっていい。顔色が読みやすいのだ。まさに幼女という具合。幼気なのだ。……おかしいな。俺より何年も何十年も長生きしているはずなのに。
lines.translated: Toya's hand was practically an open book. Her expressions were just that easy to read. Exactly what you'd expect from a little girl. Completely innocent. ...Which is weird, considering she's supposed to have lived years, even decades longer than me.

lines.content: それはハルも同じだろうと想像する。嘘が上手そうには（あくまでも個人的な感想だが）思えない。
lines.translated: I imagined Haru would be the same way. She didn't strike me as someone who was good at lying (though that was strictly my personal impression).

lines.content: 故に問題はナナちゃんだが――
lines.translated: Therefore, the only wild card was Nana-chan, but--

lines.content: ……私、ルールとかよくわからないんだけど
lines.translated: "...I don't really know the rules or anything, though."

lines.content: ――まったくの初心者なようだ。
lines.translated: --It seemed she was a complete beginner.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは自分のカードを難しそうな表情で見ている。
lines.translated: Nana-chan was staring at her cards with a troubled expression.

lines.content: じゃあ最初は一緒にやろうよ。私がナナちゃんに教えてあげるね。……だからほら、こっちに来て。隣にどうぞだよ
lines.translated: "Then let's play together for the first round. I'll teach you how to play, Nana-chan. ...So come on, over here. Have a seat right next to me."

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: うなずきながらも――しかしナナちゃんはハルに近づくのを警戒しているふうだった。
lines.translated: Even as she nodded--Nana-chan still seemed wary of getting too close to Haru.

lines.content: だ、大丈夫だよ何もしないよ本当だよ……ナナちゃんのいやがることは絶対しないよ。約束だったよね？　だからね、ほら、隣に座ってよ
lines.translated: "I-It's okay, I won't do anything, I promise... I'll never do anything you don't like, Nana-chan. We promised, right? So come on, sit next to me."

lines.content: 半眼でハルを見つめるナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan stared at Haru with half-lidded eyes.

lines.content: 近寄っていいものか。ハルの言うことを信じてもいいのだろうか。そんな視線だった。
lines.translated: Is it really safe to go near her? Can I actually trust what Haru is saying? That was the kind of look she was giving her.

lines.content: う、うう～、どうしよう大雅くん。私ナナちゃんに信じてもらえてないよ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh~, what do I do, Taiga-kun? Nana-chan doesn't trust me at all."

lines.content: そんなにひどいこと小さな頃の私はしてたのかなあとハルは涙目だった。
lines.translated: Haru got teary-eyed, wondering aloud if she had really done such terrible things to her when she was little.

lines.content: ちょっと必死な感じが見えて逆に怖いんじゃないかな。ナナちゃんは
lines.translated: "I think you might be coming across as a little too desperate, and that's what's scaring Nana-chan off."

lines.content: ともあれ列車が目的のものをみつけるまでだ。それまではトランプでもして時間を潰そうという流れになったのだが……、
lines.translated: Regardless, this was just until the train found what we were looking for. We had decided to kill time by playing cards until then, however...

lines.content: ゲームは大富豪にしよう
lines.translated: "Let's play Daifugo."

lines.content: ……と、ハルは言った。
lines.translated: So said Haru.

lines.content: え……っ
ババ抜きになるだろうと勝手に思いこんでいたが……大富豪、だと。
lines.translated: I had just assumed we'd be playing Old Maid... Daifugo, she says?

lines.content: 顔色を読んだところであまり効果のなさそうなゲームだった。
lines.translated: That was a game where reading your opponent's expressions wouldn't do much good.

lines.content: ハル。ど、どうしてだ。どうして大富豪なんだ
lines.translated: "Haru. W-Why? Why Daifugo?"

lines.content: どうして……？
だって、そうだろう。旅の途中でみんなと遊ぶのはたいていの場合ババ抜きだって決まってるじゃないか……
lines.translated: "I mean, come on. It's practically an unwritten rule that when everyone plays cards on a trip, you play Old Maid..."

lines.content: え？　そうかなあ
lines.translated: "Huh? Is it really?"

lines.content: 首を傾げるハルだ。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head.

lines.content: そうだよ。そうなんだよ。それなのに大富豪だなんて……どうしてなのかな
lines.translated: "It is. It really is. And yet you're picking Daifugo... Why would you do that?"

lines.content: うーん……
別に私はババ抜きでもいいよ？
lines.translated: "I don't really mind playing Old Maid, you know?"

lines.content: 目をぱちくりとする十夜だ。
lines.translated: Toya blinked in surprise.

lines.content: 私も何でもいい。どちらもやったことがないし、そもそもルールだってわからない。だからどちらがいいとも言えない
lines.translated: "Anything is fine with me, too. I haven't played either of them, and I don't even know the rules to begin with. So I can't say which one is better."

lines.content: ほ、ほら。ふたりもこう言ってることだし……
lines.translated: "S-See? Even those two are saying so..."

lines.content: じーっと、ハルは俺のことを見つめ――
lines.translated: Haru stared intently at me--
"W-What...?"

lines.content: たじろいだこの俺に、くすりと、ハルは笑った。
lines.translated: Seeing me falter, Haru let out a little giggle.

lines.content: 大雅くん。そんなに負けるのいやなんだね。だから今でも“夜の国”を自由に出入りできるのかな
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. You really hate losing that much, huh? Maybe that's why you're still able to come and go freely from the 'Country of Night.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ううん。やっぱり大富豪にしようそうしよう。十夜もナナちゃんもそれでいい？
lines.translated: "Mhm. Let's definitely play Daifugo after all. Is that okay with you two, Toya, Nana-chan?"

lines.content: ……うん？　別にいいよ？
lines.translated: "...Yeah? I don't mind."

lines.content: みんなとトランプできればそれでいいらしい十夜は簡単に同意し、
lines.translated: Toya, who seemed happy as long as she got to play cards with everyone, easily agreed.

lines.content: 私もそれでいい。どちらの遊びもよく知らないけれど……この子と楽しいことができれば、何でも
lines.translated: "I'm fine with that too. I don't really know either game, so... as long as I can do something fun with this little one, anything goes."

lines.content: “ぬいぐるみ”を抱きしめながら、ナナちゃんもうなずいてしまう。
lines.translated: Hugging the "stuffed animal" tightly, Nana-chan ended up nodding as well.

lines.content: い、いや。やっぱりよくない。大富豪なんて……
lines.translated: "N-No. On second thought, it's not fine. Playing a game like Daifugo is..."

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: ……だ、だってさ、貧富の差で勝者と敗者のレッテルを一方的に押しつけるようなゲームは教育に悪い
lines.translated: "...I-I mean, think about it, a game that unilaterally slaps labels of winner and loser on people based on wealth disparity is terrible for education!"

lines.content: 教育
lines.translated: "Education."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは目を細めた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: 大雅。それ、まさか私に言ってるのか？
lines.translated: "Taiga. Don't tell me you're saying that for my sake?"

lines.content: い、いや……とにかく！　だめだ、大富豪はだめだよ
lines.translated: "N-No... Anyway! No can do, Daifugo is out of the question."

lines.content: こんな差別を助長するかのような遊びの何が楽しいっていうんだ。たかだかカードゲームじゃないか
lines.translated: "What's supposed to be fun about a game that practically promotes discrimination? It's just a card game, isn't it?"

lines.content: それなのに、勝敗が決する度に貧民だとか大貧民だとか言われる人のことを考えたことがあるのかよ
lines.translated: "And yet, have you ever stopped to consider the feelings of the people who get called 'beggar' or 'ultra-beggar' every time a match is decided?"

lines.content: 配られた手持ちのカードを見ながら俺は言うのだ。
lines.translated: I made my case while looking down at the hand I'd been dealt.

lines.content: なあ、みんな。もっと人の気持ちを考えようぜ。十夜。それにあえてナナちゃんもだ。君たちにはもっと世界のうつくしい部分だけを俺は見てすくすく育っていってほしいと――
lines.translated: "Come on, everyone. Let's be a little more considerate of people's feelings. Toya. And yes, I'll even include you, Nana-chan. I want you girls to grow up healthy and strong, seeing only the beautiful parts of this world--"

lines.content: 大雅くんにはババ抜きじゃないと都合の悪い理由があるんだね
lines.translated: "You have a reason why it's inconvenient for you if we don't play Old Maid, don't you, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 大雅くん。君は……だめだよ。ばればれだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. You're... hopeless, you know that? It's completely obvious."

lines.content: にこりとするハルだ。
lines.translated: Haru smiled sweetly.

lines.content: 大雅くん。君はあれだね。嘘がつけない人だね
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. You're one of those people, aren't you? Someone who can't tell a lie."

lines.content: そ、そんなことは……
lines.translated: "T-That's not..."

lines.content: ない。そんなはずは、ないのだ。
lines.translated: True. There's no way that's true.

lines.content: それにね、大雅くんは自分が強いと思いこんでるタイプの人だって思うな。でもね、知ってる？　大雅くん
lines.translated: "Besides, I think you're the type of person who just assumes he's really good at games, Taiga-kun. But hey, did you know, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 知ってるって……何を？
lines.translated: "Know... what?"

lines.content: 君はすっごくわかりやすいよ？　大雅くんは知らなかったみたいだけど、考えてることが顔に全部でちゃってるよ？
lines.translated: "You're super easy to read, you know? You didn't seem to realize it yourself, Taiga-kun, but everything you're thinking is written all over your face."

lines.content: うっそマジかよ
lines.translated: "No way, are you serious?"

lines.content: 手札がババ抜きに向いていたから必死になってるんだよね――それくらい私じゃなくても誰でもわかるよ
lines.translated: "You're getting desperate because your hand is really good for Old Maid, right?--Anyone could figure that out, not just me."

lines.content: え、そ、そう……なの？
lines.translated: "Huh? I-Is that... true?"

lines.content: 十夜とナナちゃんの顔を見る。ふたりは深くうなずいた。マジかよ。
lines.translated: I looked at Toya and Nana-chan's faces. The two of them nodded deeply. Are you serious?

lines.content: まあ、カードを配る前にゲームを決めなかった私も悪いけど……ごめんね
lines.translated: "Well, it's partly my fault for not deciding on the game before dealing the cards, though... Sorry about that."

lines.content: え？　ごめん……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Sorry...?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ハルは苦笑いを浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: Haru gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: そんなに必死になられたら、私、大雅くんに意地悪しちゃいたくなるな
lines.translated: "When you get that desperate, it makes me want to be a little mean to you, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 意地悪……
lines.translated: "Mean..."

lines.content: 配り直しもなしでこのまま大富豪で決定だよ――この意見に賛成の人～
lines.translated: "No redealing, we're officially playing Daifugo just like this--All in favor~?"

lines.content: は～い
lines.translated: "Aye~!"

lines.content: 十夜がぴしっと手を挙げて、
lines.translated: Toya shot her hand straight up into the air.

lines.content: 私も大富豪やりたーい
lines.translated: "I want to play Daifugo too~."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが珍しく……本当に珍しく、茶目っ気にあふれた顔で手を挙げていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan raised her hand with a rare... a truly rare, mischievous look on her face.

lines.content: ふふ……
lines.translated: "Hehe..."

lines.content: しかもにやにやしてらっしゃる。
lines.translated: And what's more, the little lady was grinning from ear to ear.

lines.content: どうやら俺が追いつめられている姿が楽しいらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, she was getting a kick out of watching me get cornered.

lines.content: うん。決定だね
lines.translated: "Yep. It's decided, then."

lines.content: ハルはにっこりする。
lines.translated: Haru beamed.

lines.content: この国は民主主義だから。いつだって数が多いほうが正義だってことになってるから――仕方ないよね。うん
lines.translated: "This country is a democracy, after all. The majority is always in the right--so there's no helping it. Yep."

lines.content: 何が民主だ。ただの数の暴力だ。
lines.translated: What democracy? This is just tyranny of the majority.

lines.content: こんなものがもしも万が一正義であったとしても、平和も愛も幸せも遙か後方へ置き去りにした中身空っぽなだけのシステムじゃあないか。
lines.translated: Even if by some remote chance this could be called justice, isn't it just a hollow system that leaves peace, love, and happiness far behind in the dust?

lines.content: そんなふうに全力抗議しようかと思ったが、
lines.translated: I was just about to launch a full-scale protest along those lines, when,

lines.content: あはは大雅かっこわるーい
lines.translated: "Ahaha, Taiga is so uncool~!"

lines.content: 十夜に指をさされて笑われた。
lines.translated: Toya pointed a finger at me and laughed.

lines.content: 笑ったり、焦ったり。顔がくしゃくしゃで格好悪くてすっごく楽しいよ……っ
lines.translated: "Smiling one second, panicking the next. Your face is all scrunched up and uncool, it's super hilarious...!"

lines.content: 小生意気な幼女さまはお腹を抱えて大爆笑である。
lines.translated: The cheeky little lady was holding her stomach and roaring with laughter.

lines.content: ……ポーカーフェイスができていないのは十夜だけじゃない。どうやらこの俺も同じであるらしかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't just Toya who couldn't keep a poker face. Apparently, the exact same went for me.

lines.content: 俺たちを乗せた列車のライトは闇を照らして――先へさきへと進んでいく。
lines.translated: The headlights of the train carrying us illuminated the darkness--pressing ever onward down the tracks.

lines.content: 俺たち四人は、十夜が持ってきていたトランプで時間を潰しながら[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]を待つ。
lines.translated: The four of us waited for *that time* to come, killing time with the playing cards Toya had brought along.

lines.content: ……くそう。またどべか
lines.translated: "...Dammit. Dead last again?"

lines.content: 十回ほど勝負して一度も勝てないとかこんなことあり得るのか……。
lines.translated: How is it even possible to play around ten rounds and not win a single time...?

lines.content: なぜだ。なぜ勝てない
lines.translated: "Why? Why can't I win?"

lines.content: カードを配るのはどべのペナルティのひとつだ。
lines.translated: Dealing the cards is one of the penalties for coming in dead last.

lines.content: 俺は一枚いちまいと丁寧にカードを配りながら首を傾げる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head in confusion as I carefully dealt the cards out one by one.

lines.content: だから言ったでしょう？　大雅くんはとってもわかりやすいんだよ
lines.translated: "Didn't I tell you? You're just way too easy to read, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ほらほら早くー
lines.translated: "Come on, hurry up~."

lines.content: 十夜が小さな手を差し出してくる。
lines.translated: Toya held out her tiny hand to me.

lines.content: 差し出された小さな手のひらを、首を傾げて俺は見つめた。
lines.translated: I tilted my head and stared at her outstretched little palm.

lines.content: 何かな
lines.translated: "May I help you?"

lines.content: 何かな、じゃなくって、大雅の一番強いカードだよ。大雅はそれを“せれぶ”な私に納めなきゃだめなんだよ？
lines.translated: "Don't 'May I help you' me! Your strongest cards, Taiga. You have to pay them as tribute to a 'celeb' like me, remember?"

lines.content: 大富豪のルールだ。
lines.translated: Those are the rules of Daifugo.

lines.content: プレイ人数が四人の場合、一番最初にあがった者から大富豪。富豪。貧民。大貧民。と格付けされ……。
lines.translated: When there are four players, starting from the first person to clear their hand, everyone is ranked as Tycoon, Rich, Poor, and Beggar...

lines.content: 次回のゲームの開始前には、平民と貧民は配られたカードの中から一番強いカードを富豪たちに巻き上げられてしまう。
lines.translated: Before the start of the next round, the lower ranks are forced to hand over the strongest cards in their dealt hands to the rich players.

lines.content: 今回一番にあがった十夜は大富豪。最下位の貧民から強いカードを二枚もゲットできる。そう。二枚もだ。
lines.translated: Toya, who finished first this round, is the Tycoon. She gets to take two whole strong cards from the lowest-ranked Beggar. Yes. Two whole cards.

lines.content: 今夜の十夜はなぜだろう。とっても強い。いつもと違って。
lines.translated: For some reason, Toya is really strong tonight. Unlike usual.

lines.content: ……俺の知ってるルールだと搾り取られるカードは一枚だったんだけどな
lines.translated: "...In the rules I know, you only get squeezed for one card, though."

lines.content: ぶつくさ言いながら十夜に二枚手渡す――ジョーカーだ。
lines.translated: Grumbling under my breath, I handed two cards over to Toya--the Jokers.

lines.content: ものの見事に二枚あるジョーカーがすべて俺の手札に収まっていた。問答無用で十夜に搾取されてしまう。
lines.translated: Both of the Jokers in the deck had ended up right in my hand. Without any room for argument, they were exploited by Toya.

lines.content: うう。社会の縮図だ。金持ちはますます富んで貧するものはますます窮する。……誰の言葉だったっけ
lines.translated: "Ugh. It's a microcosm of society. The rich get richer and the poor get poorer. ...Whose words were those again?"

lines.content: 世界で一番のベストセラーの元ネタになった男だよ。本が売れてもその恩恵にあやかれない悲しい男だ
lines.translated: "The man who inspired the biggest bestseller in the world. A tragic guy who never got to enjoy the royalties no matter how many copies it sold."

lines.content: 神さまが神さまを哀れむとは
lines.translated: "To think a god would pity another god."

lines.content: ……大雅も、しつこい。何度も言ってる。私は神さまなんかじゃないんだよって
lines.translated: "...You're really persistent, Taiga. I've told you over and over. I'm not a god or anything like that."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせるナナちゃんは、配られた自分の手札を見――
lines.translated: Pouting, Nana-chan looked down at the hand she had been dealt--

lines.content: ……むむむむむ
lines.translated: "...Mmmmmmm."
--and.

lines.content: 眉根をぎゅっと寄せるのだった。どうやら[・|い][・|い][・|カ][・|ー][・|ド]が来たらしい。
lines.translated: She furrowed her brows tightly. Apparently, she had gotten a *good card*.

lines.content: だが今回ナナちゃんは貧民だ。故に。そのカードは富豪であるハルに渡さなければならない――
lines.translated: However, Nana-chan was the Poor this round. Therefore, she had to hand that card over to Haru, the Rich--

lines.content: そのようなカード事情がナナちゃんの顔色を見ていればはっきりとわかった。
lines.translated: That whole card situation was plain as day just from looking at the expression on Nana-chan's face.

lines.content: ここには嘘が上手い人間はいないのか。
lines.translated: Is there not a single person here who's actually good at lying?

lines.content: そんなことを思っていると……がたん。
lines.translated: Just as I was thinking that... clunk.

lines.content: 列車が停車。
lines.translated: The train came to a stop.

lines.content: ……あ。ついたかな
lines.translated: "...Ah. Looks like we're here."

lines.content: 手札のカードを放棄するナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan abandoned her hand of cards.

lines.content: ゲームテーブルの代わりにしていた窓枠にそっと戻す。
lines.translated: She gently set them back down on the window frame we had been using as a game table.

lines.content: その顔はどこかほっとしているような笑顔でもあった――それほどに悩ましい手札だったのだろうか。
lines.translated: The smile on her face looked somewhat relieved--had her hand really been that much of a dilemma?

lines.content: ……ここだ。ここにこの夢の持ち主の“[手紙|願い]”はあるらしいよ
lines.translated: "...This is it. It seems the 'wish' of this dream's owner is right here."

lines.content: ……そういうことなら仕方がない。
lines.translated: If that's the case, it can't be helped.

lines.content: とりあえず勝負はおいておこう。続きはまたいつか、ということにしておこうか。本来の目的を果たさなければならない。
lines.translated: Let's put the match on hold for now. We can save the rest for another time. We have to fulfill our original purpose.

lines.content: ナナちゃんが指をさすのは車窓の外だ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan was pointing outside the train window.

lines.content: しかし見渡してもなにもない。
lines.translated: Yet when I looked out, there was nothing there.

lines.content: あるのは深いふかい“夜”の暗闇。
lines.translated: All that existed was the deep, profound darkness of the "Night."

lines.content: そこに瞬くたくさんの星空――俺たちの見知らぬ星の空が広がっている。
lines.translated: And a sky full of countless twinkling stars--an unfamiliar starry sky stretching out before us.

lines.content: そして静かな海原である。波ひとつなければどこにも島のひとつもありはしない。
lines.translated: Below lay a tranquil expanse of ocean. There wasn't a single wave, nor an island anywhere in sight.

lines.content: そんな真夜中の海の上で汽車は停止している。
lines.translated: The train had stopped right atop that midnight sea.

lines.content: ……暗闇と、星々と、暗い海それ以外になにもない、こんな場所のどこに、俺たちの探しているものがあるというのだろう。
lines.translated: In a place with nothing but darkness, stars, and a dark ocean, where on earth could the thing we're looking for possibly be?

lines.content: ほら、そこだよ。きっとそこに“[手紙|願い]”はあるよ
lines.translated: "Look, right there. I'm sure the 'wish' is down there."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが指をさすのはすぐ近くの海面だった。
lines.translated: Nana-chan was pointing at the surface of the sea right nearby.

lines.content: ……なんだ？
lines.translated: "...What's that?"

lines.content: 俺たちは揃って車窓の外をのぞき込む。
lines.translated: Together, we all leaned forward to peer out the window.

lines.content: ナナちゃんが指をさす海面が光っていたのだ。
lines.translated: The patch of sea Nana-chan pointed at was glowing.

lines.content: 海底から一筋の丸い光が延びてきているのだろうとわかる。
lines.translated: I could tell a single round beam of light was stretching up from the ocean floor.

lines.content: ……あ。海の底
lines.translated: "...Ah. At the bottom of the sea."

lines.content: ハルが[・|そ][・|れ]をいち早く見つけた。
lines.translated: Haru was the first to spot *it*.

lines.content: ……真っ赤なポストがあるよ？
lines.translated: "...There's a bright red mailbox?"

lines.content: ハルに続いて[・|そ][・|れ]を見つけた十夜がそう言った。
lines.translated: Following Haru's lead, Toya spotted *it* too and spoke up.

lines.content: 確かに海の底の底に真っ赤なポストが沈んでいるのが見えた。
lines.translated: Sure enough, I could see a bright red mailbox sunken at the very bottom of the sea.

lines.content: 照明を
lines.translated: "Lights."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが小さくつぶやく。
lines.translated: Nana-chan murmured softly.

lines.content: すると、列車の側面に取り付けられている小さなライトがひとつ、点灯し――海底のポストを、そして海の底のその周辺を更に広く照らし出す。
lines.translated: Immediately, a small light mounted on the side of the train flicked on--illuminating the mailbox on the seabed and casting a wider glow over the surrounding ocean floor.

lines.content: すると浮かび上がってくるものは、
lines.translated: And what emerged from the darkness was,

lines.content: 町だ
lines.translated: "A town."

lines.content: 海の底に古い町が沈んでる。
lines.translated: An old town was sunken at the bottom of the sea.

lines.content: 月の光や列車のライトに照らされて――真っ赤なポストは、そして海中の世界はきらきらと瞬いていた。
lines.translated: Illuminated by the moonlight and the train's lamp--the bright red mailbox and the underwater world sparkled and glimmered.

lines.content: 海の底に沈んだ町には古代都市のような豪奢な建造物の姿も見える。
lines.translated: In the town sunken on the seabed, I could even make out the shapes of luxurious structures like an ancient city.

lines.content: かつては整然と整備されていたのかもしれない石畳の街路。
lines.translated: Cobblestone streets that might have once been neatly maintained.

lines.content: たくさんの人たちで賑わっていたのかもしれない町の風景。
lines.translated: A townscape that might have once bustled with crowds of people.

lines.content: そこには小さな海草のかけらだったり、広大な海を根城にするプランクトンだったりが、まるで真夜中に人知れず降り出した粉雪みたいに、きらきらと……ふわふわと。
lines.translated: Down there, tiny fragments of seaweed and plankton that made the vast ocean their home drifted about, glittering... and floating softly, just like powder snow falling unnoticed in the dead of night.

lines.content: 深く、静かに眠りについた町に、降り積もる――そんな光景が広がっていた。
lines.translated: Piling up over a town that had fallen into a deep, quiet sleep--such was the scene that spread out before us.

lines.content: それらは、この夢を見ている誰かの心だ。
lines.translated: All of those things were the heart of whoever was dreaming this dream.

lines.content: その深いふかいところに根付いた風景だったりは。
lines.translated: The scenery rooted in the deepest, most profound parts of them.

lines.content: 夢見る誰かの記憶そのものだったり――あるいはさみしい心、だったり。色々だ。色々、なのだろう。
lines.translated: They were the very memories of the dreamer--or perhaps, their lonely heart. All sorts of things. It must be all sorts of things.

lines.content: そんな底の底の底に“[手紙|願い]”は眠っていて――
lines.translated: And sleeping at the very, very bottom of it all was the "wish"--

lines.content: あのポストから手紙を回収してきてほしいんだ。……さあ、覚悟を決めて、ざぶんと行こうよ
lines.translated: "I need you to retrieve the letter from that mailbox. ...Come on, brace yourselves and dive right in."

lines.content: ――ナナちゃんが窓を開け放ち、言った。
lines.translated: --Nana-chan threw the window wide open and spoke.

lines.content: 夜の潮風が流れ込む。ひやり。頬を撫でる。
lines.translated: The night sea breeze flowed in. Chilly. It brushed against my cheeks.

lines.content: そして、はい。これはポストの鍵だよ。手紙を取り出すときに必要だから
lines.translated: "And here. This is the key to the mailbox. You'll need it to take the letter out."

lines.content: 小さな鍵をナナちゃんから受け取る。
lines.translated: I took the small key from Nana-chan.

lines.content: それはあさひさんから受け取っている“魔法の鍵”とは違い、小さな、本当に小さな鍵だった。
lines.translated: Unlike the "magic key" I had received from Asahi-san, it was a small, truly tiny key.

lines.content: 真っ暗な海底にあるポストから“[手紙|願い]”を回収する。
lines.translated: Retrieving a "wish" from a mailbox at the pitch-black bottom of the sea.

lines.content: そのために俺たちは呼ばれたのだと充分に理解できている。覚悟だってしてきたつもりだ。
lines.translated: I understood full well that this was why we had been called here. I thought I had prepared myself for it, too.

lines.content: だがまさか……知らない誰かの夢の中でダイビングしなきゃならないとは思っていなかった。
lines.translated: But I never expected... that we'd have to go diving inside some stranger's dream.

lines.content: 故に。少しだけ気持ちを落ち着かせ、
lines.translated: Therefore, I calmed my nerves just a little,

lines.content: 深呼吸をして、
lines.translated: took a deep breath,

lines.content: 心の準備を整えたなら……、
lines.translated: and once I had mentally prepared myself...,

lines.content: 私も一緒に行けないかな、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Could I come with you too, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 今、たぶんだけど、ひとりで行こうとしてなかったかな
lines.translated: "Just now, maybe it's just a guess, but weren't you about to go all by yourself?"

lines.content: まあ、うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ……こういう場合はさ、男の子の出番かなあって。なんとなくだけど
lines.translated: "...In times like this, I figured it's a boy's turn to step up. Just a feeling, though."

lines.content: で、でもね、女の子も色々、がんばれるよ？
lines.translated: "B-But you know, girls can work hard at all sorts of things too!"

lines.content: ああ、知ってるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, I know."

lines.content: ましてや十年前は誰より“特別”だった女の子だ。
lines.translated: Especially a girl who, ten years ago, was more "special" than anyone else.

lines.content: “夜”の中で俺より上手にこなせることは多いだろうとそう思う。
lines.translated: I'm sure there are plenty of things she can handle much better than me inside the "Night."

lines.content: だけど女の子にばかり大変なことを押しつけてきたこの俺としては、せめてこういう雑用くらいは引き受けたいところなのだけど……、
lines.translated: Still, as someone who has done nothing but push the hard burdens onto girls, I wanted to at least take on odd jobs like this by myself, yet...,

lines.content: ひとりは、だめだよ。また何か危ないことがあるかもしれないよ？
lines.translated: "Going alone is no good. What if something dangerous happens again?"

lines.content: そうだよ大雅。また無茶なことしたらお姉ちゃんに怒られちゃうんだよ？
lines.translated: "That's right, Taiga. If you do something reckless again, Big Sis is gonna get mad at you, you know?"

lines.content: う、うん。それは……気をつけるつもりだけど
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Well... I intend to be careful, though."

lines.content: 大雅くん。私も一緒に行って、いいかな……？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. Is it okay if I come with you too...?"

lines.content: ハルが俺の目を見つめながら、言った。
lines.translated: Haru spoke while looking straight into my eyes.

lines.content: 何の役にも立てなかったらどうしようって思うけど……、せめて邪魔にならないようにはするから。だから一緒に連れて行ってもらえたらなあって……
lines.translated: "I worry about what I'll do if I can't be of any use at all... but I promise I'll at least try not to get in the way. So I was hoping you'd take me along with you..."

lines.content: そこまで言われてしまえば拒否できない。
lines.translated: When she puts it like that, there's no way I can refuse.

lines.content: わかった。一緒に行こうか。だけどお互いに充分、気をつけて
lines.translated: "Got it. Let's go together, then. Just make sure we're both plenty careful."

lines.content: うん、そうだよね。充分に気をつけて……たくさん、がんばろうね
lines.translated: "Yep, you're right. Let's be super careful... and do our very best."

lines.content: ハルは開け放たれた窓から首を出す。
lines.translated: Haru poked her head out the wide-open window.

lines.content: 改めて海中のポストを見ていた。
lines.translated: She looked down at the underwater mailbox once more.

lines.content: どれくらいの深さがあるのか確かめているようだった。
lines.translated: It seemed like she was trying to gauge just how deep it was.

lines.content: う、うう
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: ひきつった笑顔でこちらを振り向く。
lines.translated: She turned back toward me with a cramped smile.

lines.content: ど、どうしよう。大雅くん。ちょっと……ちょっとだけ、怖いかも
lines.translated: "W-What should I do, Taiga-kun? I might be a little... just a little bit scared."

lines.content: ああ、確かに。俺もひとりだとちょっと怖い。だからふたりで行けて、実は少し安心だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, for sure. Honestly, it's a bit scary for me to go alone too. So being able to go together is actually a little reassuring."

lines.content: 俺はハルの手を取った。
lines.translated: I took Haru's hand.

lines.content: 深呼吸――
lines.translated: Take a deep breath--

lines.content: ……えっと。うんと。人の夢の中で泳ぐには……どんなふうに“想像”すれば、いいんだったかな
lines.translated: "...Um. Let's see. To swim inside someone's dream... how was I supposed to 'imagine' it again?"

lines.content: 難しそうな表情で首を傾げるハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head with a troubled expression.

lines.content: ……よし。まあ、大丈夫かな。たぶんだけど
lines.translated: "...Okay. Well, I think I'll be fine. Probably."

lines.content: 俺も自分なりの方法で“想像”を完了させた。
lines.translated: I completed the "imagination" in my own way as well.

lines.content: あさひさんの[書斎|工房]で頭の中に詰め込んだ数々の物語を思い浮かべる――そこに描かれた主人公たちが、その人生をうつくしくきらめかせる一瞬一瞬を、思い返すのだ。
lines.translated: I called to mind the countless stories I had crammed into my head in Asahi-san's workshop--looking back on each and every moment where the protagonists depicted in them made their lives shine beautifully.

lines.content: “驚異的な潜水能力を持ちながら心に大きなおおきな喪失感を抱え愛するイルカだけが心のより所になっている孤高の青年”
lines.translated: "A solitary young man blessed with extraordinary diving abilities, carrying an immense sense of loss in his heart, whose only emotional anchor is a beloved dolphin."

lines.content: 彼の物語を思い描き……[まぶた|瞼]を、開く。
lines.translated: Picturing his story in my mind... I open my eyelids.

lines.content: ……俺も、大丈夫だ。なんとかいけそうな気がする
lines.translated: "...I'm good to go, too. I feel like I can pull this off somehow."

lines.content: 偉大な誰かの[想像力|物語]から力を借りて――
lines.translated: Borrowing strength from the story of someone great's imagination--

lines.content: さあ、“夜”が一番深くふかく、心を満たすそのときこそが――“魔法使い”の時間の始まりだ。
lines.translated: Now, the moment when the "Night" fills the heart most deeply, ever so deeply--that is when the time of the "magicians" begins.

lines.content: 俺とハルは海の中へと飛び込もうとした。
lines.translated: Haru and I moved to dive into the sea.

lines.content: ああ。ちょっと待って。念のために命綱を付けておこう
lines.translated: "Ah, hold on a second. Let's attach lifelines just in case."

lines.content: そう言ってナナちゃんは俺とハルの腰の辺りに[・|釣][・|り][・|針]をひっかけた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Nana-chan hooked fishing hooks around Haru's and my waists.

lines.content: 俺は腰のベルトに、ハルはスカートの腰回り。
lines.translated: Mine onto the belt at my waist, and Haru's onto the waistband of her skirt.

lines.content: そこに返しのついた釣り針をしっかりと食い込ませ――
lines.translated: Making sure the barbed hooks bit firmly into the fabric--

lines.content: はい。あなたはこれを持っていて
lines.translated: "Here. You hold onto this."

lines.content: ――十夜には釣り竿を持たせた。
lines.translated: --she handed a fishing rod to Toya.

lines.content: それは十夜のリュックから取り出した道具だった。
lines.translated: It was a tool she had pulled out of Toya's backpack.

lines.content: 釣り糸は二股にわかれている。片方にハル。もう片方に俺だ。
lines.translated: The fishing line split into two. Haru was on one end, and I was on the other.

lines.content: しっかり握って離さないようにね。ふたりの命がひっかかってるんだ。頼んだよ
lines.translated: "Grip it tight and don't let go, okay? Both of their lives are hooked onto this. I'm counting on you."

lines.content: う、うん。離さない。絶対だよ？　しっかり持ってる
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I won't let go. Never, okay? I've got a firm grip on it."

lines.content: 十夜は責任重大といった顔で、ぎゅっと、釣り竿を握りしめる――糸の先には言わずもがなだが、俺とハルが釣れている。
lines.translated: With a look of grave responsibility on her face, Toya squeezed the fishing rod tightly--needless to say, at the end of the line, Haru and I were the ones on the hook.

lines.content: 万が一の保険だよ。海の中ではぐれたりしないように
lines.translated: "It's insurance just in case. So you two don't get separated in the sea."

lines.content: それに帰り道にも便利だね。上昇したいときは糸にとんとんと三回触れる。もしも何か問題が起きたときには素早く四回。それが合図だよ
lines.translated: "Plus, it'll be handy for the trip back. When you want to ascend, tap the line three times. If any trouble comes up, tap it four times quickly. That'll be the signal."

lines.content: ……なんだか複雑な気分だ
lines.translated: "...I have kind of mixed feelings about this."

lines.content: あはは。十夜に釣り上げられたりしないよう無事に、自力で、戻って来ないとだね
lines.translated: "Ahaha. We'll have to make sure we come back safely under our own power so Toya doesn't end up reeling us in."

lines.content: ふたりで苦笑いを交換し合い――改めて、俺たちは海の中へと飛び込む。
lines.translated: Exchanging wry smiles with each other--once again, we dived into the sea.

lines.content: そこに躊躇はない。ほとんどない。
lines.translated: There was no hesitation. Almost none at all.

lines.content: 今更ちょっと怖いねというだけでうじうじと躊躇してばかりはいられないのだ。
lines.translated: At this point, we couldn't afford to keep wavering and hesitating just because it was a little scary.

lines.content: 十年前は“魔法少女”として。
lines.translated: Ten years ago, she did this as a "magical girl."

lines.content: そして俺は、そのサポートとして。
lines.translated: And I did it as her support.

lines.content: これくらいのことは日常茶飯事としてこなし続けていたのだから――……しかし。
lines.translated: Because we used to handle things like this as an everyday occurrence--...However.

lines.content: 俺は、上手に潜れなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't dive very well.

lines.content: 頭の中で自分自身に投影した物語の主人公。
lines.translated: The protagonist of the story I had projected onto myself in my head.

lines.content: その想像は十全と完了できたはずなのに――難しい。
lines.translated: I should have completed that imagination thoroughly, and yet--it was difficult.

lines.content: あの物語のあの主人公みたいに、ずば抜けた潜水の才能を発揮することができなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't demonstrate the extraordinary diving talent that protagonist had in that story.

lines.content: 俺は潜る、というより沈んでいった。
lines.translated: Rather than diving, I was sinking.

lines.content: ただただ海底に吸い込まれていくように。
lines.translated: As if I were simply being sucked down toward the ocean floor.

lines.content: ……不格好にばたばたと両手足をばたつかせながら。
lines.translated: Awkwardly flailing my arms and legs around all the while.

lines.content: もしかするとこの夢を見ている“誰か”の、何かしらの心情が（たとえば他人を受け付けないといった感性が）そうさせているのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps the feelings of the "someone" dreaming this dream (for instance, a mindset that rejects others) were causing this to happen.

lines.content: 他人のことをそう簡単に受け入れられない――
lines.translated: An inability to accept others so easily--

lines.content: そういった拒否感が、通常の[想像|技術]では潜水できないような難易度の高さとして現れているのだとしても不思議ではない。
lines.translated: It wouldn't be strange if that sense of rejection was manifesting as a high level of difficulty that prevented diving through ordinary techniques of imagination.

lines.content: ……そっと、俺の手をハルが握った。
lines.translated: Gently, Haru took my hand.

lines.content: そして唇の前に人差し指を立てる。
lines.translated: Then she raised her index finger to her lips.

lines.content: （落ち着いて……）
lines.translated: (Calm down...)

lines.content: そんな声が頭の中に聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: I heard that voice inside my head.

lines.content: ハルは俺とは違い平静だった。
lines.translated: Unlike me, Haru was composed.

lines.content: 自由に泳ぐことができないのであれば――下へ、下へ、沈んでいくのに任せている。
lines.translated: Since we couldn't swim freely--she was simply letting herself sink further and further down.

lines.content: ちょっと恥ずかしそうにスカートを押さえながら。
lines.translated: While holding down her skirt, looking a little embarrassed.

lines.content: （み、見ちゃだめだよ）
lines.translated: (D-Don't look, okay?)

lines.content: 頬を染めた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks flushed red.

lines.content: （……今日はかわいいの、はいてなかったと思うし）
lines.translated: (...I don't think I wore cute ones today, either.)

lines.content: ……さすが、と言うべきなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Should I say "as expected of her"?

lines.content: ブランクが十年あろうとさすがは“夜”に認められた“元”魔法少女だ。その心には。その、頭の中には。計り知れない“想像力”の素質が詰まってる。
lines.translated: Even with a ten-year gap, she really is a "former" magical girl acknowledged by the "Night." Inside her heart. Inside her head. She is packed with an immeasurable aptitude for "imagination."

lines.content: この俺なんかでは及びもつかない。
lines.translated: Someone like me couldn't possibly compare.

lines.content: たとえ偉大な誰かの想像を借り受けようと――いくらそんな小手先なことをしようとも、ハルの冷静さには近づけもしない。
lines.translated: Even if I borrow the imagination of someone great--no matter how many superficial tricks like that I try to use, I can't even come close to Haru's composure.

lines.content: 情けないとは思う。恥ずかしいとも思うけど……。
lines.translated: I think it's pathetic. And I think it's embarrassing, too, but...

lines.content: 俺は、差し伸べてくれたハルの手を握り返し――うなずく。
lines.translated: I squeezed back the hand Haru had reached out to me--and nodded.

lines.content: そして、静かに。
lines.translated: And then, quietly.

lines.content: 俺たちは、降り積もる雪の結晶みたいな海の埃とかプランクトンだとか――月明かりにきらきら光るそれらと一緒に、海底に沈んだ町へと降り立つ。
lines.translated: Together with the marine snow and plankton falling like snowflakes--all of it glittering in the moonlight, we touched down in the town sunken at the bottom of the sea.

lines.content: 無呼吸は長くて一分からどんなにがんばっても二分である。
lines.translated: Holding our breath would last a minute at long, or two minutes no matter how hard we pushed it.

lines.content: 夢の中なのだからそのような現実的な事情は無視してしまえばいい。
lines.translated: Since we're inside a dream, we should just ignore realistic circumstances like that.

lines.content: だが、俺たちは、他人や自分の夢の中を自在に行動できるように肉体を持ち込んでいる。
lines.translated: However, we had brought our physical bodies in so that we could act freely within our own dreams and the dreams of others.

lines.content: どうしたって現実的な事情が脳裏を掠め――その不安や心配までもが想像となり、“夜の国”の影響下に含まれてしまう。
lines.translated: No matter what, realistic concerns crossed my mind--and even those anxieties and worries turned into imagination, falling under the influence of the "Night Country."

lines.content: それ故に、どうしたって、現実的な不自由さからは逃げきれないのだ。
lines.translated: Because of that, there was simply no escaping these realistic limitations.

lines.content: だから、一分だ。長くて二分。
lines.translated: So, one minute. Two minutes at the longest.

lines.content: 海底にたどり着くまでに所要時間の三分の一は消費してしまっただろうと思う。
lines.translated: I figured we had probably used up a third of our available time just reaching the ocean floor.

lines.content: 少し……ほんの少しだけ呼吸の苦しさを感じ始めている。
lines.translated: A little... I was starting to feel just a tiny bit short of breath.

lines.content: 急いで“願い”を回収しなければならない。
lines.translated: We had to hurry and retrieve the "wish."

lines.content: 目的は円柱型の古い真っ赤なポストである。
lines.translated: Our target was an old, bright red cylindrical mailbox.

lines.content: 降り積もる海の雪や海底の白い砂が、ポストを包むようにうっすらと積もっている。
lines.translated: Falling marine snow and white sand from the seabed had piled up thinly around the mailbox, as if wrapping it up.

lines.content: それらを手で払う。
lines.translated: I brushed it away with my hand.

lines.content: もわもわと煙りながら散っていき――ポストの手紙などの取り出し口が姿を見せた。
lines.translated: It scattered like billowing smoke--revealing the retrieval door for the letters inside the mailbox.

lines.content: ナナちゃんから渡された鍵でそれを開く。
lines.translated: I unlocked it with the key Nana-chan had given me.

lines.content: すると、一通。
lines.translated: Inside, there was one letter.

lines.content: たった一通だけそこには手紙が投函されていた。
lines.translated: Just a single letter had been mailed in there.

lines.content: 真っ白な封筒。宛名も書かれていない。
lines.translated: A pure white envelope. No address was written on it, either.

lines.content: ハルが人差し指と親指で丸を作って、俺に向かってうなずいた――オーケーのサインだろう。
lines.translated: Haru made a circle with her index finger and thumb, nodding toward me--an "okay" sign, no doubt.

lines.content: 会話はどうやらできるみたいなのに、つい、そうしてしまう。ジェスチャーで意志を伝えようとしてしまう。
lines.translated: Even though it seemed we could converse just fine, she ended up doing that out of habit. Trying to convey her intentions through gestures.

lines.content: その気持ちもわからないではなかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't like I couldn't understand how she felt.

lines.content: 俺もハルにうなずいて応える。
lines.translated: I nodded back to Haru in response.

lines.content: そして取り出した手紙を（時間も限られているとわかっていたが、つい）その場で開いてみることにした。
lines.translated: And then (even knowing our time was limited, on impulse) I decided to open the letter I had taken out right then and there.

lines.content: 本当にこの手紙が目的のものであるのか、それを確かめたいという動機もあったし……。
lines.translated: Part of my motive was wanting to make sure this letter really was what we were looking for, and...

lines.content: こんな暗い、真っ暗い、海の底の底に隠された“願い”とはいったいどんなものなのだろう……。
lines.translated: Just what kind of "wish" could be hidden away at the very, very bottom of such a dark, pitch-black sea...?

lines.content: そんな、野次馬的で、不純な好奇心がそうさせてしまったのだろう――ごめん。ごめんな。ちゃんと君の“願い”は神さまに届けるから。
lines.translated: That kind of nosy, impure curiosity must have been what made me do it--I'm sorry. I'm really sorry. I promise I'll deliver your "wish" to God properly.

lines.content: そんな言い訳を思い浮かべるこの俺は……。
lines.translated: Coming up with excuses like that in my head, I...

lines.content: その手紙を、開く。
lines.translated: Opened the letter.

lines.content: すると、驚いた。
lines.translated: And then, I was astonished.

lines.content: 開いた手紙の文字が、しゅるしゅると海中に広がって――
lines.translated: The words written on the opened letter unraveled and spread out into the sea--

lines.content: “神さま”
lines.translated: "Dear God."

lines.content: 願いが。
lines.translated: The wish.

lines.content: “……神さま”
lines.translated: "...Dear God."

lines.content: 手紙に込められた、言葉が。
lines.translated: The words poured into the letter.

lines.content: “お願いします”
lines.translated: "Please."

lines.content: その切実な[映像|光景]が。
lines.translated: That earnest sight.

lines.content: “どうか……お願い”
lines.translated: "Please... I beg you."

lines.content: 俺たちの心に、届く。
lines.translated: Reached our hearts.

lines.content: “どうか。神さま……お願いします”
lines.translated: "Please. Dear God... I beg you."

lines.content: “どうか明日の、お歌の発表会……上手に歌えますように”
lines.translated: "Please let me sing well... at tomorrow's singing recital."

lines.content: 俺たちは、顔を見合わせた。
lines.translated: We looked at each other.

lines.content: “ずっとずっと、練習してきたけれど……”
lines.translated: "I've been practicing for so, so long, but..."

lines.content: “もしも歌を失敗して……上手に歌えなくて……意地悪な子に笑われて……”
lines.translated: "What if I mess up the song... and I can't sing it well... and the mean kids laugh at me..."

lines.content: “大好きな男の子にも、笑われちゃったら……すごく、悲しいよ……神さま”
lines.translated: "If the boy I really like laughs at me too... I'll be so, so sad... God."

lines.content: だから上手に歌えますように。
lines.translated: So please let me sing well.

lines.content: 下手だけどがんばって練習したんだよ……。
lines.translated: Even though I'm not very good, I practiced as hard as I could...

lines.content: そして大好きなあの子に、いつか、この気持ちを……大好きを伝える勇気もほしいよ。
lines.translated: And someday, I want the courage to tell that boy I really like how I feel... to tell him that I love him.

lines.content: そんな“[気持ち|願い]”がいっぱい、いっぱい、手紙の中にはあふれていた。
lines.translated: The letter was overflowing to the brim with those "wishes" and feelings.

lines.content: （……かわいい）
lines.translated: (...How cute.)

lines.content: ハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru said.

lines.content: （……すごくかわいいお願いだね）
lines.translated: (...That's such a cute wish.)

lines.content: さあ。戻ろう。
lines.translated: Alright. Let's head back.

lines.content: 時間はないが浮上するのには充分すぎる時間が残されている。
lines.translated: We didn't have much time, but there was more than enough left to make it back to the surface.

lines.content: ハルともう一度、手をつなぐ。
lines.translated: I held hands with Haru once again.

lines.content: そして海面を見上げた。
lines.translated: And then I looked up at the surface of the sea.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの列車が海底を照らしているライトが、海面にまあるい光りの形をみせていた。
lines.translated: The light from Nana-chan's train illuminating the ocean floor cast a round, glowing shape across the water's surface.

lines.content: （まるでお月さまみたいだね）
lines.translated: (It looks just like the moon, doesn't it?)

lines.content: ハルのつぶやきに、確かにそうだなと思う。ゆらゆら揺れる光りは大きなおおきな満月だ。
lines.translated: Hearing Haru's murmur, I thought she was right. The gently swaying light looked like a huge, giant full moon.

lines.content: あの光りに向かって海底を蹴る。
lines.translated: I kicked off the seabed toward that light.

lines.content: そして命綱代わりの釣り糸に、とんとんと、三回触れた。上昇をお願いする合図である。
lines.translated: Then, I tapped the fishing line serving as our lifeline three times. It was the signal asking them to pull us up.

lines.content: するとゆっくり糸が巻かれ始めた。
lines.translated: Slowly, the line began to reel in.

lines.content: このまま身を委ねておけば海上に出られる。
lines.translated: If we just let ourselves be pulled along like this, we'd make it back out onto the sea.

lines.content: （やっぱり……なんだか釣り上げられる魚みたいな気分で、複雑だ）
lines.translated: (Still... I feel kind of like a fish being reeled in. I have mixed feelings about this.)

lines.content: 苦笑いでそう言う俺に、ハルもそうだねとうなずいてくれたとき――
lines.translated: Just as Haru nodded in agreement at my wry remark--

lines.content: ゆらり。
lines.translated: Swoosh.

lines.content: 何かが俺たちの頭上を横切った。
lines.translated: Something passed right over our heads.
(What was...?)

lines.content: 見上げる。
lines.translated: We looked up.

lines.content: するとそこには大きな魚影が現れていた。
lines.translated: Right there, the massive silhouette of a fish had appeared.

lines.content: テレビだとかで見たことがある。
lines.translated: I had seen one on TV or somewhere before.

lines.content: あれは……。
lines.translated: That was...

lines.content: （ジンベイザメ……？）
lines.translated: (A whale shark...?)

lines.content: 間近で見るとそれはとんでもない迫力だった。
lines.translated: Seeing it up close, it was overwhelmingly massive.

lines.content: 夢の中のことだとは言え――いいやだからこそなのか、悠然と泳ぐその姿には圧倒させられる。
lines.translated: Even though this was inside a dream--no, perhaps precisely because it was--the sight of it swimming so leisurely was breathtaking.

lines.content: きっとこの夢の主である“誰か”も、あの巨大なジンベイザメに対する恐怖心がどこかにあるのだろう。
lines.translated: Surely the "someone" who owned this dream held a lingering fear of that giant whale shark somewhere inside them.

lines.content: だからこそのこの圧迫感である。
lines.translated: That must have been where this crushing sense of pressure came from.

lines.content: [・|彼]は大きな口を開け、海中のきらきら光るプランクトンだとかを一気に吸い込んでいく。
lines.translated: He opened his huge mouth, sucking in all the glittering plankton and everything else in the water at once.

lines.content: だが、そこで、気づいた――海底に降り積もる[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]は、夢の主の思い出のかけらだったようである。
lines.translated: However, that was when I realized--those things drifting down to pile up on the ocean floor seemed to be fragments of the dreamer's memories.

lines.content: 現れた巨大なサメに吸い込まれ消えていく最後に、[・|そ][・|れ]は、まるで最後のロウソクの炎のように膨れ上がり――先ほどの手紙みたいに俺たちの中で姿を見せた。
lines.translated: Right at the very end, just before being sucked into the giant shark that had appeared and vanishing, they flared up like the last flicker of a candle--revealing themselves inside us just like the letter from earlier.

lines.content: ……いくつもいくつも通り過ぎては消えていく、幼い誰かの思い出を、俺たちは海の底から見上げている。
lines.translated: From the bottom of the sea, we looked up at the memories of some young child as countless numbers of them drifted past and vanished.

lines.content: [・|人][・|は][・|忘][・|れ][・|て][・|い][・|く][・|生][・|き][・|物][・|だ]。つらいことも。悲しいことも。さみしいことも。[・|彼]が飲み込み、すべて消えゆく。
lines.translated: Humans are creatures that forget. Painful things. Sad things. Lonely things. He swallowed them up, and everything faded away.

lines.content: 忘れたいものだけでなく、忘れたくはないだろうものまで一緒に……。
lines.translated: Not just the things they wanted to forget, but even the things they probably didn't want to forget, all together...

lines.content: 海に沈んだ町に散らばっていたらしい思い出もすべて残さず吸い込んでいく。
lines.translated: It sucked in every last one of the memories that seemed to be scattered across the town sunken beneath the sea.

lines.content: そうしたサメの捕食行為に、海中の流れは激しく荒れて、
lines.translated: Because of the shark's feeding, the underwater currents grew violently turbulent, and--

lines.content: （あ……っ、手紙がっ）
lines.translated: (Ah...! The letter!)

lines.content: ハルの手の中にあった手紙がするりと離れてしまった。
lines.translated: The letter in Haru's hand slipped right out of her grasp.

lines.content: サメの口に吸い寄せられる。
lines.translated: It was being drawn toward the shark's mouth.

lines.content: あいつに食われたら“願い”は消える。
lines.translated: If that thing ate it, the "wish" would disappear.

lines.content: もしかしたら“大好きを伝えたい……”、そんな想いや願いまでもが消えていってしまうのかもしれない。そういうふうに想像するのはあまりに簡単だった。
