lines.translated: Perhaps even those feelings and wishes of "wanting to tell him I love him..." would vanish along with it. It was all too easy to imagine that happening.

lines.content: （ハル。先に上がっていてくれ……っ）
lines.translated: (Haru. Go on up ahead of me...!)

lines.content: 俺は腰の釣り針を外す。
lines.translated: I unhooked the fishing hook from my waist.

lines.content: （で、でも……っ）
危ないよ、とハルは言う。
lines.translated: It's dangerous, Haru told me.

lines.content: （大雅くんが食べられちゃったら……どうするのっ）
lines.translated: (What will we do... if you get eaten, Taiga-kun?!)

lines.content: だから私が行くよ、とハルは言うのだ。
lines.translated: So I'll go instead, Haru said.

lines.content: 確かに俺よりハルのほうが泳ぎが上手いだろう。だから効率を重視した判断をしたならばそれもいい。いや。それがいいのだろう。
lines.translated: It was true that Haru was probably a better swimmer than me. So if I were making a decision based purely on efficiency, that would be fine. No, that would probably be for the best.

lines.content: だが、だめだ。
lines.translated: No, I can't.

lines.content: 既に考えるよりも早く針を外してしまったし、それに、
lines.translated: But I had already unhooked myself faster than I could think, and besides...

lines.content: 『俺は先に戻ってるから、ハル、泳ぎの上手い君が手紙を追いかけてくれ』
lines.translated: "I'll head back first, so Haru, since you're a good swimmer, you go chase after the letter."

lines.content: ……だ、なんて。
lines.translated: As if.

lines.content: そんなこと、言えるはずがない。
lines.translated: There was no way I could ever say something like that.

lines.content: だから俺は、
lines.translated: So instead, I...

lines.content: （……ごめんな、ハル。また無茶をしてしまうかもしれない）
lines.translated: (...I'm sorry, Haru. I might end up doing something reckless again.)

lines.content: と、それだけ言って。
lines.translated: Saying only that...

lines.content: ハルの糸を素早く四度はじいて、合図を送る――緊急事態。急上昇だ。何かの拍子にハルがサメに飲み込まれてしまうことがあってはならない。
lines.translated: I quickly flicked Haru's line four times to send the signal--an emergency. A rapid ascent. Under no circumstances could I let Haru get swallowed up by the shark by some fluke.

lines.content: ハルの声。叫び声。
lines.translated: Haru's voice. A scream.

lines.content: だがその声が何を言っているのか――俺の耳には届かない。
lines.translated: But what that voice was saying--it didn't reach my ears.

lines.content: もう既に背中を向けていたからだ。
lines.translated: Because I had already turned my back to her.

lines.content: そして手紙に手を差し伸べている。
lines.translated: And I was reaching my hand out toward the letter.

lines.content: 巨大なサメの口に今にも吸い込まれようとしているあの願いにだ。
lines.translated: Toward that wish, which was about to be sucked into the giant shark's mouth at any moment.

lines.content: もしもあの手紙をここで紛失してしまうようなら……。
lines.translated: If I were to lose that letter right here...

lines.content: そんなことをしてしまうようでは、俺は、[ヒーロー|主人公]に笑われてしまう。
lines.translated: If I did something like that, I'd be laughed at by the heroes.

lines.content: 頭の中にたくさん、たくさん詰め込んだ彼や彼女ら、そして――[・|あ][・|の][・|人][・|に]。
lines.translated: By all the heroes and heroines crammed inside my head, and--by that person.

lines.content: だから踏ん張れ。
lines.translated: So hold your ground.

lines.content: ヒーローに近づこう。
lines.translated: Get closer to being a hero.

lines.content: 決して諦めることもなく――この手を、伸ばせっ。
lines.translated: Without ever giving up--reach out this hand!

lines.content: [・|私]はひとり、海面から顔を出す――
lines.translated: All alone, I poked my head out from the surface of the sea--

lines.content: あれ？　大雅は？
lines.translated: "Huh? Where's Taiga?"

lines.content: 列車の客席で十夜が首を傾げてた。
lines.translated: From the passenger seats of the train, Toya tilted her head.

lines.content: 釣り竿を握りしめたまま、海面をきょろきょろと見ている。
lines.translated: Still gripping the fishing rod tightly, she looked around across the surface of the water.

lines.content: 大変だよ大雅くんが……！
lines.translated: "It's terrible, Taiga-kun is...!"

lines.content: 大雅がどうしたの？
lines.translated: "What happened to Taiga?"

lines.content: 何かあったのと十夜は言う。海面は変わらず静かだった。
lines.translated: Did something happen, Toya asked. The surface of the sea remained as calm as ever.

lines.content: 海中で何か良からぬトラブルがあったとは思いもよらない。それほどの静けさ。
lines.translated: You would never have guessed that some terrible trouble had occurred underwater. It was that quiet.

lines.content: だから緊急事態発生を伝える[・|四][・|度][・|の][・|信][・|号]を受け取っても尚。
lines.translated: So even after receiving the four-tap signal communicating an emergency...

lines.content: 緊急を要するだろうこの状況を、一瞬で把握できない小さな十夜は首を傾げるばかりで……。
lines.translated: Little Toya, unable to instantly grasp this urgent situation, could only tilt her head...

lines.content: サメが……っ、手紙を、それで、追いかけて……っ
lines.translated: "A shark...! The letter, and then, he chased after it...!"

lines.content: 私は慌てるあまり、言葉を詰まらせてしまう。
lines.translated: In my panic, I stumbled over my words.

lines.content: とにかくっ、とにかく急がないと大変なんだよ……っ
lines.translated: "Anyway! Anyway, if we don't hurry, it's going to be awful...!"

lines.content: 急がないと、大変――それはわかる。
lines.translated: If we didn't hurry, it would be awful--I knew that.

lines.content: わかるけど。
lines.translated: I knew that, and yet.

lines.content: でも、何をどのように急げばいいのか。
lines.translated: What should we do, and how should we hurry?

lines.content: その手段を何も思い浮かべられないからこそ、余計に焦る。
lines.translated: Because I couldn't think of a single way to help, I grew even more frantic.

lines.content: この状況をいち早く察したのは、十夜よりも小さなナナちゃんだった。
lines.translated: The first one to grasp the situation was Nana-chan, who was even smaller than Toya.

lines.content: ……貸して
lines.translated: "...Give me that."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは十夜から釣り竿を受け取る。
lines.translated: Nana-chan took the fishing rod from Toya.

lines.content: ……命知らずなあの子のことだから。ううん。自分の命にどこか薄情なところのある、あの子のことだから……こういうこともあっても不思議じゃない
lines.translated: "...Knowing that daredevil of a boy. No, knowing how somewhat callous he can be when it comes to his own life... it's no wonder something like this happened."

lines.content: そう言って私のスカートから針を取り外す。
lines.translated: Saying that, she removed the hook from my skirt.

lines.content: そしてもう一度、海面に糸を投げ入れた。海面に浮かび上がったばかりの私は、その様子をぷかぷか浮いたまま見つめてた。
lines.translated: Then, once again, she cast the line into the sea. Having just surfaced, I watched her do so while bobbing in the water.

lines.content: どうするの？
lines.translated: "What are you going to do?"

lines.content: 不安そうにしている十夜にナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan answered the anxious-looking Toya.

lines.content: こんなこともあろうかと……っていうようなせりふは嫌いなんだけど、とにかく、こういう場合に備えてたよ。この針は大雅の心と引き合うように“魔法”をかけてる
lines.translated: "I hate lines like 'I thought something like this might happen'... but anyway, I came prepared for a situation like this. I cast 'magic' on this hook so that it would be drawn to Taiga's heart."

lines.content: うん。そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. That's right."

lines.content: これでも私は“夜の国”の住人だから。想像することに関しては、“考える生き物”であるあなた達人間にはずいぶんと劣るけれど、これくらいのことならできる
lines.translated: "I am a resident of the 'Night Country,' after all. When it comes to imagination, I'm far inferior to you humans, who are 'thinking creatures,' but I can manage at least this much."

lines.content: ……だからこうして糸を垂らしておけば、必ず、大雅を捕まえてくれるはず……
lines.translated: "...So as long as I leave the line dangling like this, it'll definitely catch Taiga..."

lines.content: そこで急に竿がしなった。ナナちゃんは目を丸くする。
lines.translated: Just then, the rod suddenly bent. Nana-chan's eyes went wide.

lines.content: 竿はぎりぎりと軋み、今にも折れそうなほどだ。
lines.translated: The rod creaked under the strain, looking as if it might snap at any moment.

lines.content: ……ハルっ
lines.translated: "...Haru!"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 早く……乗って……早くっ
lines.translated: "Hurry... get in... Hurry!"

lines.content: う、うん……っ
lines.translated: "O-Okay...!"

lines.content: 私は十夜の手を借りて、窓から車内へよじのぼった。
lines.translated: Borrowing Toya's hand, I scrambled up through the window and into the train.

lines.content: ふたりともお願い、一緒に竿を握ってて……っ
lines.translated: "Both of you, please, hold onto the rod with me...!"

lines.content: ナナちゃんの小さな手から、今にも釣り竿がすっぽ抜けてしまいそうだった。
lines.translated: The fishing rod looked ready to slip right out of Nana-chan's tiny hands at any second.

lines.content: ハル……っ、お願い
lines.translated: "Haru...! Please."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan spoke.

lines.content: 絶対、ぜったい、ぜったいに離さないんだぞっていう気持ちで……握りしめていてほしい
lines.translated: "I want you to hold onto it tightly... with the determination that you'll never, ever, ever let go."

lines.content: あなたの“想像力”が頼りだとナナちゃんは言う――人間の“想像力”は“奇跡”や“魔法”に等しいものなのだ、と。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said she was counting on my "imagination"--that a human's "imagination" is equal to a "miracle" or "magic."

lines.content: うん……っ、離さない。絶対。ぜったいだよ
lines.translated: "Okay...! I won't let go. Never. I promise."

lines.content: だけど、ハル。[・|こ][・|の][・|針][・|の][・|先][・|に][・|引][・|っ][・|か][・|か][・|っ][・|て][・|る][・|も][・|の]を一気に釣り上げてしまわないよう注意してほしいんだ
lines.translated: "However, Haru. Be careful not to reel in *whatever is hooked on the end of this line* all at once."

lines.content: じゃないと暴れる巨大な[・|そ][・|れ]が列車を破壊しかねない。そんなことになればみんな揃って海の底だとナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: Otherwise, *that* thrashing giant might destroy the train. If that happened, Nana-chan said, we'd all end up at the bottom of the sea together.

lines.content: ……たぶん、想定外のものが今、針には食らいついている。
lines.translated: Most likely, something completely unexpected was biting on the hook right now.

lines.content: ……私たちの“魔法”は誰にも負けない“想像力”だ
lines.translated: "...Our 'magic' is an 'imagination' second to none."

lines.content: 釣り竿を握った私は、つぶやく。
lines.translated: Gripping the fishing rod, I murmured the words.

lines.content: それは“夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひの口癖であり――同時に“魔法少女”たち共通の呪文のような文言になっている。
lines.translated: That was the catchphrase of "the Magician of the Night," Hinamukai Asahi--and at the same time, it served as a shared incantation for all us "magical girls."

lines.content: その一言で頭に、心に、“想像力”のスイッチを入れるのだ。
lines.translated: Those few words flipped the switch for "imagination" in my head and in my heart.

lines.content: ……ここは、“夜の国”
lines.translated: This was the "Night Country."

lines.content: 想像できるすべてを叶えられる夢の舞台だ。
lines.translated: A dream stage where anything you could imagine could be made real.

lines.content: 思い描く力が強ければ強いほど夢の中で自在に動ける。暴れる“悪夢”にだって打ち勝てる。
lines.translated: The stronger your power to visualize, the more freely you could move within the dream. You could even overcome a rampaging "nightmare."

lines.content: だけどそれは、言葉にするほど簡単なことじゃない。
lines.translated: However, doing so wasn't as easy as putting it into words.

lines.content: 他人の夢の中に入り込み、そしてその人物の想像力と戦うことは……それはやっぱり、どうしたって容易なことではないから。
lines.translated: Because stepping into someone else's dream and fighting against that person's imagination... was, after all, no easy feat no matter how you looked at it.

lines.content: そうだ。ここは“夜”であって、他人の夢の中でもある。
lines.translated: That's right. This was the "Night," and it was also inside someone else's dream.

lines.content: まったくの他人のフィールドで[・|そ][・|れ][・|以][・|上]を顕現させねばならないのだから、難しいという言葉だけでは不十分だろうと思うけど……。
lines.translated: Since I had to manifest *even more than that* on a complete stranger's turf, calling it "difficult" was probably an understatement, but...

lines.content: 絶対に、離さないし……大雅くん、絶対、助けるよ……っ
lines.translated: "I'll never let go, and... I'll definitely save you, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: ハルはぎゅっと両手で強く釣り竿を握りしめる――と、ほぼ、同時だった。
lines.translated: Haru gripped the fishing rod tightly with both hands--and it happened at almost the exact same moment.

lines.content: わ、わわわわわ……っ
lines.translated: "W-W-W-W-Whoa...!"

lines.content: 十夜が涙目で私にしがみつく。車体が傾いたのだ。
lines.translated: Toya clung to me with teary eyes. The train car had tilted.

lines.content: 何か、大きな力に引っ張られ――
lines.translated: Pulled by some massive force--

lines.content: 倒れちゃう……っ、列車が、倒れちゃうよっ
lines.translated: "It's gonna fall...! The train is gonna fall over!"

lines.content: 片輪を数十センチほども浮かせる体勢だ。まるで片足立ちのよう。めきめきと車体が音を立ててもいる。
lines.translated: The wheels on one side were lifted puluhan centimeters into the air. It was as if the train were standing on one foot. The car body was groaning loudly under the strain.

lines.content: ど、どうしようナナちゃん、このままじゃみんな揃って海の底だよ……っ、引きずり込まれちゃうっ
lines.translated: "W-What do we do, Nana-chan?! At this rate, we're all going to the bottom of the sea together...! It's going to drag us in!"

lines.content: 前進だ……っ
lines.translated: "Full speed ahead...!"

lines.content: ナナちゃんが咄嗟に合図を送る。
lines.translated: Nana-chan instantly gave the signal.

lines.content: それに呼応し汽笛を鳴らし――列車はぎゃりぎゃりと車輪を回転させる。火花が散るほど力強く。
lines.translated: Answering her call, the steam whistle blew--and the train's wheels screeched as they spun. So powerfully that sparks flew.

lines.content: 傾いた車体が少しずつ体勢を持ち直す。
lines.translated: Little by little, the tilted train car began to right itself.

lines.content: がたんっ、と大きな衝撃が走った。
lines.translated: A heavy *clunk* sent a massive jolt through the car.

lines.content: 車両の体勢が戻った。車輪が線路を捕まえたのだ。
lines.translated: The train was upright again. Its wheels had caught the tracks.

lines.content: そして列車はまたひとつ汽笛を鳴らすと――前へ。前へ。進んでいく。
lines.translated: Then, letting out one more blast of its whistle--the train pushed forward. Forward. Continuing on its way.

lines.content: 釣り竿は大きくしなる。
lines.translated: The fishing rod bent sharply.

lines.content: 離さないよう三人で強く握った。
lines.translated: The three of us gripped it tightly so we wouldn't let go.

lines.content: 列車は更に前へ進む――が、
lines.translated: The train pressed even further ahead--but,

lines.content: スピードが、落ちてる
lines.translated: "We're losing... speed."

lines.content: 次第、次第に、前に進む力が落ちていく。
lines.translated: Gradually, bit by bit, its forward momentum began to fade.

lines.content: そして……、
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: う、うそ……
lines.translated: "N-No way..."

lines.content: 私は思わず、息をのむ。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but gasp.

lines.content: 今度は車体が前方からぐぐぐぐぐと反り上がってきていたから。
lines.translated: Because this time, the front of the train was steadily rearing up into the air.

lines.content: “この竿は絶対ぜったい離さない”――三人分のその気持ちが“夜”の中で重なっている。
lines.translated: *"We will never, ever let go of this rod"*--the feelings of all three of us overlapped within the "Night."

lines.content: だから竿は折れず、糸は切れない。
lines.translated: That was why the rod didn't snap, and the line didn't break.

lines.content: 三人が握りしめた竿も、その手からするりと抜けてはいかないけれど……。
lines.translated: Nor did the rod slip out of the hands of the three of us gripping it so tightly, and yet...

lines.content: ね、ねえ、これ……大丈夫？　平気なのっ？
lines.translated: "H-Hey, is this... okay? Are we gonna be alright?!"

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|状][・|況]は今まで誰も経験したこがない。
lines.translated: No one had ever experienced *a situation like this* before.

lines.content: だから現状を上手に打破する“想像”もまた上手く思い描けない。
lines.translated: Because of that, we couldn't properly visualize the "imagination" needed to break through our current predicament.

lines.content: 竿は更にしなり。車体は更に持ち上がっていく。
lines.translated: The rod bent even further. The train car was lifted even higher.

lines.content: 大雅くん……早く、早く帰ってきて……お願いっ
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun... hurry, hurry and come back... please!"

lines.content: 私は竿をぎゅっと、握る。
lines.translated: I squeezed the rod with all my might.

lines.content: そして叫ぶと同時に、力強く糸を巻こうとしたところで……。
lines.translated: And just as I cried out and tried to forcefully reel in the line...

lines.content: ふと、竿のしなりが消えた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, the tension in the rod vanished.

lines.content: そして浮き上がっていた車体が、がたんっ、と大きな音を立て元に戻った。
lines.translated: And the lifted train car slammed back down into place with a loud *crash*.

lines.content: まさか、糸が切れた……？
lines.translated: "Don't tell me the line snapped...?"

lines.content: ううん。違うみたい。もう引っ張られてはいないけど……竿はまだ重いよ
lines.translated: "Uh-uh. I don't think so. It's not pulling anymore, but... the rod is still heavy."

lines.content: 早く糸を巻かないと
lines.translated: "We have to reel it in, quick."

lines.content: 私は、ナナちゃんにうなずくけれど……、
lines.translated: I nodded to Nana-chan, but...

lines.content: そこで、[・|そ][・|れ]を見つけた。
lines.translated: Just then, I spotted *it*.

lines.content: 遠くで……。
lines.translated: Off in the distance...

lines.content: 大きなサメが、しぶきをあげて、大きく大きく海面から飛び出して、飛び上がっていた。
lines.translated: A massive shark sent up a spray of water, leaping high, high out of the sea and into the air.

lines.content: 満月の光りでその姿をきらきらと煌めかせ――
lines.translated: Its form glittered and sparkled in the light of the full moon--

lines.content: 巻き上げたしぶきが、まるで星の雨のように降り注ぎ――
lines.translated: The spray it kicked up rained down like a shower of stars--

lines.content: ざぶん、と。
lines.translated: *Splash.*

lines.content: 更に大きなしぶきと共に、海面を叩いて着水した。
lines.translated: With an even bigger spray of water, it smacked against the surface of the sea and landed.

lines.content: ナナちゃんが急いで窓を閉めた。糸は繋がったままだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan hurriedly shut the window. The fishing line was still intact.

lines.content: 波だ……波が来る
lines.translated: "A wave... A wave is coming."

lines.content: ナナちゃんがそうつぶいた数秒後。
lines.translated: A few seconds after Nana-chan murmured that.

lines.content: 静かだった海原は大きくウネった。
lines.translated: The once-calm expanse of the sea swelled violently.

lines.content: 車体も上下左右に激しく揺れては、翻弄されて――私たちは身体を抱き合い嵐が過ぎるのを待つしかない。
lines.translated: The train car was tossed about, shaking fiercely up, down, left, and right--leaving us no choice but to hold onto each other and wait for the storm to pass.

lines.content: ……海面はウネり続ける。
lines.translated: The surface of the sea continued to heave.

lines.content: 実際はあっという間の出来事であったかもしれない。
lines.translated: In reality, it might have all happened in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: だけど、数秒。数分。もっともっと長く感じられた揺れが、収まって、
lines.translated: Even so, a few seconds. A few minutes. When the shaking that felt so, so much longer finally subsided...

lines.content: ……あれ
窓の外をそっと覗いた十夜が指をさす。
lines.translated: Peeking timidly out the window, Toya pointed a finger.

lines.content: ねえ見て
lines.translated: "Hey, look."

lines.content: 十夜の指さす先を見てみると――すぐそばの海面にぷかりと浮く背中があった。
lines.translated: Looking toward where Toya was pointing--there was a back bobbing up to the surface of the water right nearby.

lines.content: ナナちゃんが窓を開ける。私は急いで、糸を巻く。
lines.translated: Nana-chan opened the window. I hurriedly reeled in the line.

lines.content: 腰のベルトに食い込んでいた針が、その背中をしっかりと釣り上げた。
lines.translated: The hook, dug firmly into his waist belt, hauled him securely up by his back.

lines.content: 重さはなかった。不思議だけれど。
lines.translated: There was no weight to him. Strange as it was.

lines.content: 反応がなかった。
lines.translated: There was no response.

lines.content: ぶらぶらと釣り上げられたまま、ぐったりとしてしまっている。
lines.translated: Dangling from the line as we fished him out, he had gone completely limp.

lines.content: ……大雅くん？
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ハルが恐る恐る名前を呼ぶと、
lines.translated: When Haru timidly called his name...

lines.content: ……う、げほっ
lines.translated: "...Ugh, *cough*!"

lines.content: びくり、と身体がはねて、せき込んだ。
lines.translated: His body jolted, and he broke into a coughing fit.

lines.content: ごほごほ……うええ。死ぬかと、思った
lines.translated: "*Cough, cough*... Blegh. I thought... I was gonna die."

lines.content: だけど生きていた。
lines.translated: Still, he was alive.

lines.content: まったくの無事――であるかはわからないけれど、とりあえず、取り戻せた。
lines.translated: Whether he was completely unharmed--I couldn't say for sure, but for now, we had gotten him back.

lines.content: 三人でたぐり寄せたその結果が安堵となって、少し、空気が緩むようだった。
lines.translated: The result that the three of us had reeled in together brought a wave of relief, and the tense air seemed to loosen up a little.

lines.content: ……うえ～
lines.translated: "...Bleeergh~"

lines.content: 大雅くんは釣り上げられたまま、鼻から口から、だらだらと――飲み込んだ海水だけではない色々を吐き出しながら、
lines.translated: Still dangling from the line, Taiga-kun spewed a steady stream of not just swallowed seawater, but all sorts of things from his nose and mouth, while...

lines.content: ……格好付けようと思って、げほ、飛び出したんだ、けど
lines.translated: "...I jumped out thinking I'd look cool, *cough*, doing it, but..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 首を傾げる私に、大雅くんは言う。
lines.translated: As I tilted my head, Taiga-kun spoke.

lines.content: ……全然、まったく、格好……つかねえ～。ぐじゅっ
lines.translated: "...I didn't look cool... at all, not one bit~. *Sniffle*."

lines.content: ぶらぶらと釣り上げられた格好のまま、大雅くんはばつの悪そうな照れ笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Still dangling helplessly from the fishing line, Taiga-kun gave an awkward, sheepish smile.

lines.content: そして『ありがとう』とつぶやいて。
lines.translated: Then, he murmured a quiet "thank you."

lines.content: 照れたように、『三人のおかげで、助かった』と、笑顔を見せて――
lines.translated: Looking embarrassed, he smiled and added, "You three saved me"--

lines.content: だけど、手紙は。……ほら、ちゃんと無事に回収、してきたよ
lines.translated: "Still, as for the letter... Look, I managed to retrieve it safely."

lines.content: ――片手にしっかりと握りしめた便せんを、そっと、掲げるのだった。
lines.translated: --And gently held up the sheet of stationery clutched tightly in one hand.

lines.content: 列車は更に先へと進んでいく。
lines.translated: The train continued onward.

lines.content: この町で夢見る人々の数だけ、広大に増幅し続ける“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: Through the "Night" that expanded endlessly, growing vast to match the number of people dreaming in this town...

lines.content: 俺たちはいくつもの夢を渡り、いくつもの“[手紙|願い]”を回収していった。
lines.translated: We crossed through countless dreams and collected countless "wishes" in the form of letters.

lines.content: 危険なこともたくさんあった。
lines.translated: There were plenty of dangerous moments.

lines.content: 同じくらい楽しいこともあったのだ。
lines.translated: And just as many fun ones, too.

lines.content: そしてなんだかちょっと、さみしいことも。
lines.translated: Along with a few that were somehow a little lonely.

lines.content: そのすべてをナナちゃんの抱きしめた“ぬいぐるみ”と一緒に通り抜けていく。
lines.translated: We passed through all of them together with the "stuffed animal" Nana-chan held tight in her arms.

lines.content: そして、少し疲れた俺たちに、ナナちゃんはちょっとだけ休憩しようかと列車を停めた。
lines.translated: Eventually, seeing that we were getting a bit tired, Nana-chan stopped the train to suggest we take a short break.

lines.content: 見上げた夜空には大きな機械式の都市が広がっていた。
lines.translated: Looking up, a massive mechanical city sprawled across the night sky.

lines.content: そして地上には、心を宿した真っ白な野獣たちの住む熱帯雨林が広がっている。
lines.translated: And down on the ground stretched a tropical rainforest inhabited by pure white beasts who possessed hearts of their own.

lines.content: どちらが上で、どちらが下なのか……。
lines.translated: It was hard to tell which was up and which was down...

lines.content: [・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]から見上げる夜空の瞬きはすべて都市の光だ。
lines.translated: The twinkling lights in the night sky we looked up at from *this side* were all the lights of the city.

lines.content: そんな空と地上の景色を、停車した列車の屋根にみんなでよじ登って、眺めた。
lines.translated: All of us clambered up onto the roof of the parked train to gaze out at the scenery of both the sky and the ground.

lines.content: ……車のライトとかなのかな。星が動いてるみたいに見えるね。ちょっとだけ変な感じ
lines.translated: "...I wonder if those are car headlights or something. It looks like the stars are moving. It feels a little strange."

lines.content: ハルが指さした夜空には……もっともっと、大きな、おおきな、満月のような光りがある。
lines.translated: In the night sky where Haru pointed... there was an even bigger, massive light resembling a full moon.

lines.content: そこには手に明かりを持った人々が集まり、何か賑わっている様子がかろうじて見えた。
lines.translated: We could just barely make out people gathering there with lights in their hands, looking lively and bustling.

lines.content: お祭りみたいなことしてるのかなあ。……あっ、何かおいしそうなもの食べてるよ
lines.translated: "Maybe they're having a festival or something. ...Oh, they're eating something that looks really good."

lines.content: 目がいいなあ十夜。夜目が利くってやつなのかな
lines.translated: "You've got great eyes, Toya. Guess you have good night vision."

lines.content: ……えへへ。ちょっとだけお腹すいたかも
lines.translated: "...Ehehe. That might've made me a little hungry."

lines.content: みんなで騒がしいそれらの光りを仰ぎ見て……一緒にナナちゃんの大好物を食べたりもした。カップ麺だ。
lines.translated: Gazing up together at those lively lights... we also shared Nana-chan's favorite food. Cup noodles.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは俺たちと同じような[・|生][・|き][・|物]ではない。
lines.translated: Nana-chan isn't a *living creature* in the same way we are.

lines.content: だから別段、何も食べずに過ごすことを強要されたとしても、ナナちゃんは空腹どころか死の足音に怯える必要もないけれど……。
lines.translated: So even if she were forced to go without eating anything at all, she wouldn't have to fear the approaching footsteps of death, let alone hunger...

lines.content: それでも小さな神さまはこの粗雑な食事を愛している。
lines.translated: Even so, the little goddess loves this simple, humble meal.

lines.content: いつだったか俺が[現実世界|真昼の世界]からのお土産として持ってきて渡して以来のことだ。
lines.translated: It started ever since I brought some back as a souvenir from the midday world--the real world--some time ago.

lines.content: それからはナナちゃんに会うときはできるだけお土産として持って来ることにしている。買えるだけ、たくさんだ。
lines.translated: Since then, whenever I go to see Nana-chan, I make sure to bring some as a gift whenever I can. As many as I can buy.

lines.content: いつかハンバーガーとかも食べてみたい。フライドポテトも山盛りで
lines.translated: "I want to try eating a hamburger someday, too. With a huge mountain of french fries."

lines.content: [・|二][・|杯][・|目]のカップにお湯を注ぎながら、『きっと美味しいんだろうなあ』と夢見がちにナナちゃんは言うのだ。
lines.translated: Pouring hot water into her *second* cup, Nana-chan murmured dreamily, "I bet it's super delicious."

lines.content: 小さな組み立て式の湯沸かし器にかけられたヤカンには、あと数杯分のお湯が沸いていそうだった。
lines.translated: The kettle sitting on the small, collapsible water heater looked like it still had enough boiling water left for a few more cups.

lines.content: ……でも。ハンバーガーも、フライドポテトも。何度もお願いするのに大雅は持ってきてくれない。だからまだ食べたことない
lines.translated: "...But whether it's hamburgers or french fries, Taiga never brings me any, no matter how many times I ask. So I still haven't tried them."

lines.content: 頬を膨らませるナナちゃんに、俺は応える。
lines.translated: Nana-chan puffed out her cheeks in a pout, and I answered her.

lines.content: 神さまにお供えするのにハンバーガーっていうのも気が引けて……
lines.translated: "I just feel a little weird about offering a hamburger to a god..."

lines.content: カップラーメンはいいの？
lines.translated: "And cup ramen is fine?"

lines.content: いや、ハル。ハンバーガーは長持ちしないだろう？　お供えものは痛みづらいもののほうがいいかなって
lines.translated: "Well, Haru, hamburgers don't last very long, right? I figured offerings should be things that don't spoil easily."

lines.content: 長持ち？　……どうして？
lines.translated: "Last very long? ...Why?"

lines.content: 首を傾げたハルに俺は答える。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head, and I explained.

lines.content: ……だって、ほら。お地蔵様とかにお供えされたお饅頭がカビちゃってるのとか見たことない？
lines.translated: "...Well, think about it. Have you ever seen buns left as offerings at Jizo statues get all moldy?"

lines.content: あれってさ、お供えする気持ちはちゃんと汲んでくれるだろうけれど……心のどこかでお地蔵様は迷惑してたりしないかなって心配になるんだよ
lines.translated: "When that happens, I'm sure the Jizo appreciates the sentiment behind the offering... but part of me worries that deep down, it might actually be a nuisance to them."

lines.content: だから神さまにお供えするものはできるだけ保存が利くもののほうがいいと思うんだ。結果。俺たちの“夜”を護ってくれてる小さな神さまにはカップ麺が最善かなって
lines.translated: "So I think offerings to gods should have as long a shelf life as possible. Which means cup noodles are the absolute best choice for the little goddess protecting our 'Night.'"

lines.content: 私は神さまじゃないんだってば……それに、[・|護][・|る]とか。そんな大層なことはしてないよ
lines.translated: "I keep telling you, I'm not a goddess... Besides, *protecting* it? I'm not doing anything that grand."

lines.content: まったく何度言ってもわかんないやつだなあ、とナナちゃんは呆れ顔を浮かべるけれど、
lines.translated: Nana-chan gave an exasperated look, as if to say I never listen no matter how many times she tells me, before adding:

lines.content: だけど、まあ。もしも[・|そ][・|う]だとしたら、きっと私はジャンクフードの神さまなんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Still, well... if I *were* one, I'm pretty sure I'd be the goddess of junk food."

lines.content: そんなことを言い合いながら、瞬く“夜”の光景の中で小腹を満たす。
lines.translated: Chatting back and forth like that, we satisfied our light hunger amidst the twinkling scenery of the "Night."

lines.content: 四人で食べたインスタント麺はいつもよりほんの少しだけ美味しく感じられ――
lines.translated: Eating instant noodles together with the four of us made them taste just a little bit better than usual--

lines.content: ここにクロもいてくれたなら、もっともっと美味しく感じただろうか。俺は飽くこともなくそんなこと思う。
lines.translated: If Kuro were here with us too, would they taste even better? I never grew tired of thinking about things like that.

lines.content: でも、あの子が……世界中の人見知りな感情をポケットに拾い集めているかのような小さな子が、“みんなで、一緒に……”だ、なんて。
lines.translated: But for that girl... a tiny girl who seemed to go around gathering all the shyness in the world into her pockets, to actually be "together with everyone..."

lines.content: そんな光景が叶うのは、まさしく――文字通り夢のようなものなのかもしれなかった。
lines.translated: Having a sight like that come true might really--quite literally--be like a dream.

lines.content: それでも、願う。願ってしまう。
lines.translated: Even so, I wish for it. I can't help but wish for it.

lines.content: いつかそんなあり得ないとも思える光景が叶えばいい。
lines.translated: I hope that someday, a sight that seems so impossible will come true.

lines.content: その願いを手紙にして、いつの日か、枕の下に忍ばせてみようか。
lines.translated: Maybe someday I'll write that wish down in a letter and slip it under my pillow.

lines.content: そんな手紙を“夜の国”で受け取ったナナちゃんはなんて言うだろう。
lines.translated: If Nana-chan received a letter like that in the "Land of Night," what would she say?
Would she take me around through the "Night" on her train like this again? *Pushing herself just a little bit, just like she did this time.*

lines.content: そんな[・|い][・|つ][・|か]をふと想像し――さあ、進もうか。
lines.translated: Letting my mind wander to that *someday* for a moment--all right, let's get moving.

lines.content: 目的の場所は後ほんの、もう少し。
lines.translated: Our destination was just a little bit further.

lines.content: そうして再び走らせた列車に揺られ、俺たちはたどり着くのだ。
lines.translated: And so, swaying aboard the train as it set off once more, we finally arrived.

lines.content: すべての[・|終][・|わ][・|り]が集まってくる、その場所に。
lines.translated: At the place where all *endings* gather.

lines.content: 列車が駅に到着した。
lines.translated: The train pulled into the station.

lines.content: 夢から夢へと渡り歩き……“夜”に戻って来た。
lines.translated: After wandering from dream to dream... we had returned to the "Night."

lines.content: ここは“夜”の“参禅町”の中心に建つ[・|特][・|別][・|な][・|駅]である。
lines.translated: This was a *special station* standing at the very center of "Sanzen Town" in the "Night."

lines.content: その構内にナナちゃんの列車は滑り込む。俺とハルと十夜とナナちゃん、そして“ぬいぐるみ”は駅に降り立つ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's train slid into the terminal. Haru, Toya, Nana-chan, the "stuffed animal," and I stepped out onto the platform.

lines.content: 私は“[この子|ぬいぐるみ]”の切符を買って来るよ。だから――
lines.translated: "I'm going to go buy a ticket for this stuffed animal. So--"

lines.content: ちょうど汽笛が鳴った。ナナちゃんの声を聞き取ることができず、俺は聞き返してしまう。
lines.translated: Just then, a steam whistle blew. Unable to catch Nana-chan's voice over the noise, I had to ask her to repeat herself.

lines.content: え？　何？
lines.translated: "Huh? What was that?"

lines.content: だからね――今からこの子の切符を買って来るから。だからあなた達には手紙のほうをお願いしたいんだよ
lines.translated: "I said--I'm going to go buy a ticket for this little guy now! So I want you guys to take care of the letters for me!"

lines.content: ナナちゃんはちょっと声を大きくした。
lines.translated: Nana-chan raised her voice a little.

lines.content: けれどその声もあまりはっきりとは俺の耳に届かない。
lines.translated: Even so, her words didn't reach my ears very clearly.

lines.content: 駅の発着場は雑踏にあふれていた。
lines.translated: The station platforms were packed with a bustling crowd.

lines.content: ざわざわ。がやがや。騒がしい――……だけではない。
lines.translated: Murmuring. Chattering. It wasn't just noisy--there was more to it than that.

lines.content: ここにやって来るのはナナちゃんの列車だけではないのだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's train wasn't the only one that came here.

lines.content: 列車を迎え入れるためのレーンは何十、もしかすると何百と備えられており、そこにはひっきりなしに色々な列車が到着し、また、去っていく。
lines.translated: There were dozens, perhaps even hundreds of tracks laid out to receive trains, with all sorts of different ones constantly arriving and departing without pause.

lines.content: もちろんと言うのが正しいのか――そうしてやって来た列車からは、乗客たちがぞろぞろと降りてくる。更にまた、同じくらいの乗客たちがその列車に乗り込む。
lines.translated: And naturally--if that's the right word for it--passengers poured out of the arriving trains in droves. At the same time, just as many passengers boarded them.

lines.content: じりじりと発車時刻を知らせるベルの音。
lines.translated: The shrill ringing of bells announcing departure times.

lines.content: 列車によってはぎゅうぎゅう詰めの車内に駆け込む雑踏の音。
lines.translated: The commotion of crowds rushing into packed cars on certain trains.

lines.content: 安全確認の笛の音。
lines.translated: The sharp tweets of whistles confirming safety checks.

lines.content: ドアを開け閉めする蒸気の音。
lines.translated: The hiss of steam as doors opened and closed.

lines.content: そして汽笛が叫び――車輪が、軋む。
lines.translated: And the shriek of steam whistles--the grinding screech of wheels.

lines.content: そのような騒音が、だけど不愉快では決してない生活音が、ここには止めどなくあふれている。
lines.translated: An endless flood of such clamor--the sounds of everyday life, noisy yet by no means unpleasant--filled the air here.

lines.content: だから耳が慣れるまでは会話もままならないのだ。
lines.translated: Because of that, it was hard to even hold a conversation until your ears got used to it.

lines.content: だけどもナナちゃんの言うことはなんとなく理解できた。
lines.translated: Still, I more or less understood what Nana-chan was saying.

lines.content: 俺もここへはそんなに少なくもない回数、ナナちゃんとやって来ているのだから。
lines.translated: After all, I had come here with Nana-chan quite a few times myself.

lines.content: わかった。それじゃあ、十分後くらいにここに集合って感じでいいかな
lines.translated: "Got it. Let's meet back here in about ten minutes, then!"

lines.content: 俺が身振り手振りを交えそう伝えると、
lines.translated: When I conveyed that using hand gestures to help get it across...

lines.content: ん
lines.translated: "Mm."

lines.content: ぴっ、と。
lines.translated: With a sharp little motion.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは敬礼のゼスチャーだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan gave a crisp salute.

lines.content: 声が届きづらいための了解の合図。
lines.translated: A gesture of acknowledgment since our voices could barely reach each other.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの服装とそのポーズが、あまりにも似合っていたというか、様になっていたので、俺の頬はなんとなく緩んでしまった。
lines.translated: Because that pose suited Nana-chan's outfit so well--she looked completely the part--I couldn't help but crack a small smile.

lines.content: そして俺たちに背を向けて、ナナちゃんは雑踏の中へと姿を消した。“ぬいぐるみ”を両手に抱きしめたまま。
lines.translated: Then, turning her back to us, Nana-chan vanished into the bustling crowd, still hugging the "stuffed animal" tightly in both arms.

lines.content: 俺はそんな彼女の小さな背中を少しの間、見送る。
lines.translated: I watched her small back go for a little while.

lines.content: 俺たちの町の“夜”の中で、俺たちのことを見守っていてくれる小さな神さま――彼女はふだん、列車の外に出ることができない。
lines.translated: The little goddess who watches over us inside our town's "Night"--normally, she can't step outside of her train.

lines.content: “夜”の夜月神社の境内で……あの列車の中で、ナナちゃんはいつも生活している。
lines.translated: On the grounds of Yotsuki Shrine in the "Night"... Nana-chan always lives inside that train.

lines.content: だがこの駅では別だ。
lines.translated: But this station was an exception.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは自由に構内を歩き回れた。
lines.translated: Here, Nana-chan could walk around the terminal freely.
*This is where dreams meet their end.*

lines.content: あらゆるすべての非常識を常識に変えてしまうための場所。
lines.translated: A place meant to turn every kind of absurdity into common sense.

lines.content: だから非現実的な彼女という存在は、曖昧なこの場所では仮初めの自由を得るのだ。
lines.translated: That was why an unreal existence like her could gain a fleeting freedom within this ambiguous place.

lines.content: 外を自由に行き来できるだけではない。望めば“買い物”だってできるだろう。
lines.translated: She could do more than just come and go freely outside. If she wanted to, she could probably even go "shopping."

lines.content: だが彼女の大好きなカップ麺をはじめとしたジャンクフードは、残念ながら、ここには売っていないけれど。
lines.translated: Though unfortunately, they didn't sell cup noodles or any of the other junk food she loved so much here.

lines.content: よし。それじゃあ俺たちも行こうか
lines.translated: "Alright. Shall we get going too, then?"

lines.content: 俺はそう言い――耳がだいぶ慣れてきたことを自覚する。
lines.translated: As I said that--I realized my ears had gotten much more used to the noise.

lines.content: 声を不自然に大きくしなくとも言葉を交換できるようになっていた。
lines.translated: We were now able to talk to each other without having to raise our voices unnaturally.

lines.content: あ、手紙はどこにやったっけ。誰が持ってたんだったかな……俺？
lines.translated: "Oh, where did we put the letters? Who was holding onto them again... Was it me?"

lines.content: ううん。ここにあるよ
lines.translated: "Nope. I have them right here."

lines.content: 手紙はうなずく十夜が持っていた。
lines.translated: Toya nodded, holding the letters.

lines.content: 色々な夢の中から回収してきた[願い|手紙]である。
lines.translated: They were the letters--the wishes--we had collected from inside all the different dreams.

lines.content: そしてリュックサックから取り出したそれを、また、大切そうに中に納めた。
lines.translated: After pulling them out of her backpack to show me, she carefully tucked them back inside.

lines.content: そのリュック、すごいね。何でも入ってるんだね
lines.translated: "That backpack is amazing. It can fit anything, huh?"

lines.content: すごいなあ、と感心するハルである。
lines.translated: "So cool," Haru murmured in admiration.

lines.content: ううん。何でもじゃないよ。でもね、リュックの口を通る大きさのものなら何でも、いっぱい、無限に、持ち運べるんだよ
lines.translated: "Nope, not just anything. But as long as it's small enough to fit through the opening, I can carry lots and lots of stuff in it--an infinite amount!"

lines.content: すごいでしょ、と得意そうにする十夜だ。お姉ちゃんお手製の魔法だよ、と。
lines.translated: "Pretty amazing, right?" Toya puffed up with pride, adding that it was magic handmade by her big sister.

lines.content: “無限”という難しい言葉もちゃんと知ってるんだよ――と、また、得意げだった。
lines.translated: She also looked quite proud of herself for knowing a big, difficult word like "infinite."

lines.content: 俺はふたりに手を差し出した。
lines.translated: I held my hands out to the two of them.

lines.content: はぐれないよう手をつなごう。ほら、十夜はこっちの手。ハルはこっちだ
lines.translated: "Let's hold hands so we don't get separated. Here, Toya, take this hand. Haru, you take this one."

lines.content: は～い
lines.translated: "Aye~!"

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: と、うなずくけれど。
lines.translated: Toya nodded right away, but...

lines.content: ハルはちょっと戸惑っているようだった。俺は言う。
lines.translated: Haru seemed a little hesitant. Seeing that, I spoke up.

lines.content: ……汚くないよ？
lines.translated: "...My hand isn't dirty, you know?"

lines.content: そっ、そんなっ、違うよっ、そんなひどいこと、思ってないよ……っ
lines.translated: "Th-That's not it! No! I wasn't thinking anything awful like that...!"

lines.content: ハルがまず“ぎゅっ”としたのは両方の目だ。
lines.translated: The first thing Haru squeezed shut was both of her eyes.

lines.content: そして、俺の手を恐る恐る取り――ぎゅっと、握りしめた。
lines.translated: Then, she timidly reached out for my hand--and squeezed it tight.

lines.content: すると……、
lines.translated: And...

lines.content: え、えへへ
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe."

lines.content: ……へにゃっと、笑う。
lines.translated: She gave a soft, melting smile.

lines.content: 俺もそれにつられてしまい、ぎこちなく笑った。
lines.translated: Caught up in it, I smiled back awkwardly.

lines.content: この前の“夜”には抱きかかえられちゃったから……あの、ちょっと……えへへ、そのときのこと思い出しちゃって……
lines.translated: "You carried me in your arms during the last 'Night,' so... um, I just... ehehe, remembered what happened back then..."

lines.content: この前？
lines.translated: "Last time?"

lines.content: 何のこと？　と首を傾げる十夜だ。
lines.translated: "What do you mean?" Toya tilted her head.

lines.content: 俺はううん何でもないよとそう答え――ハルの、そして十夜の手を握り返した。
lines.translated: "Oh, it's nothing," I replied--and gave both Haru's and Toya's hands a gentle squeeze back.

lines.content: そうして俺たちは騒がしい駅を進む。
lines.translated: And so, we made our way through the bustling station.

lines.content: 列車の発着場を抜けると、商店の並ぶエリアとなる。
lines.translated: Passing through the train platforms brought us into an area lined with shops.

lines.content: レストランや本屋。雑貨屋に花屋。色々なお店が姿を見せた。
lines.translated: Restaurants and bookstores. General stores and florists. All sorts of different shops came into view.

lines.content: そして通路の隅には猫の扮する楽団がいる。
lines.translated: And in the corner of the walkway, there was an orchestra of dressed-up cats.

lines.content: チェロやバイオリンなどの弦楽器をメインに、たおやかな音楽を――出しゃばるでもないＢＧＭを流している。
lines.translated: Featuring mostly string instruments like cellos and violins, they were playing gentle, graceful music--providing unobtrusive background music for the concourse.

lines.content: ふと見上げるとここは[・|一][・|階]なのだとわかる。
lines.translated: Looking up, I realized that we were on the *first floor*.

lines.content: 先ほどの発着場はホール状になっていたが、ここはまるで巨大なショッピングモールのように、階層が上に上に連なっているのだった。
lines.translated: While the platform area earlier had been shaped like a grand hall, this section had floors stacking higher and higher above us, just like a massive shopping mall.

lines.content: 二階は居住エリアであるようだ。
lines.translated: The second floor seemed to be a residential area.

lines.content: 子供たちが落下防止の鉄柵の前を走り回っている。通路を挟んで反対側に渡された縄には洗濯物がひっかけてある。それらの縄がいくつも渡されていた。
lines.translated: Children were running around in front of the iron safety railings. Across the walkway, laundry hung from ropes stretched from one side to the other. Countless lines just like it crisscrossed the air.

lines.content: 三階が娯楽エリア。四階が夜の（文字通りの）店のエリア。五階が飲食エリア。
lines.translated: The third floor was an entertainment district. The fourth floor was a nightlife district (in the literal sense). The fifth floor was a dining area.

lines.content: 更にまだまだ続いている。
lines.translated: And it kept going even higher than that.

lines.content: だがここからではよく見渡せず、五階から上がどうなっているのか、詳しくはわからない。
lines.translated: From down here, though, I couldn't get a good view, so I couldn't really tell what was going on above the fifth floor.
*It was a single structure that felt as though it were a colossal metropolis all on its own.*

lines.content: ここで生活するのは、二本足で立つ知能ある猫たちだけではない。
lines.translated: And the intelligent, bipedal cats weren't the only ones living here.

lines.content: それぞれの町、それぞれの[・|時][・|間]の中で終わりを迎えた命が、乗車する予定の列車が到着するまでの時間を過ごしているのだ。
lines.translated: Lives that had reached their end in their respective towns and *times* spent their days here waiting for their scheduled trains to arrive.

lines.content: 商店の建ち並ぶ大通りは夜にも関わらず――いや、この場合は“夜”だからこそ、だろうか――先ほどの発着場ほどではないが賑わっていた。
lines.translated: Despite it being night--or rather, in this case, precisely *because* it was the "Night"--the main street lined with shops was bustling with activity, even if not quite as much as the platforms earlier.

lines.content: [・|金][・|貨]や[・|銀][・|貨]を手に買い物をしたり、ふと立ち止まって楽団の奏でる音楽に耳を傾けていたりしている。
lines.translated: People were shopping with *gold coins* and *silver coins* in hand, or pausing to listen to the music played by the orchestra.

lines.content: あ。アイスクリーム屋さんがあるよ？　美味しそう……
lines.translated: "Ah. Look, there's an ice cream shop! It looks so good..."

lines.content: 指をくわえる十夜に、『さっきカップ麺をみんなで食べたじゃないか』と笑いながら俺は言った。
lines.translated: Seeing Toya suck on her finger wistfully, I laughed and reminded her, "Didn't we all just eat cup noodles a little while ago?"

lines.content: あれはここの人たちのものだから。だから俺たちは我慢しなくちゃだ。帰ってあさひさんにおねだりして、おやつでも出してもらおう
lines.translated: "That's for the people who belong here. So we have to hold back. Let's beg Asahi-san to make us some snacks once we get home."

lines.content: [・|彼]や[・|彼][・|女]らは、ここで“次”に持ち込むための何かを探し求めているのだ。
lines.translated: The *men* and *women* here were searching for something to bring with them into their "next" life.

lines.content: 彼らの選べる“次”は様々ある。
lines.translated: There were all sorts of "nexts" they could choose from.

lines.content: よく言われる天国だの地獄だの。
lines.translated: Places people often talked about, like heaven or hell.

lines.content: ……生まれ変わり先の新たな人生だとか。
lines.translated: Or a brand-new life through reincarnation.

lines.content: それはもちろん人間だけでなく、花や虫や動物や、一瞬だけ瞬く太陽の光りである場合だってある。
lines.translated: Of course, that didn't just mean being reborn as a human; sometimes it meant becoming a flower, a bug, an animal, or even a ray of sunlight that glimmers for only a fleeting instant.

lines.content: ……更には。
lines.translated: And beyond even that.

lines.content: 作家と呼ばれる人間の頭の中の物語、その登場人物として、生を受けるとか。
lines.translated: One could be born as a character inside a story within the mind of a human called an author.

lines.content: その場合でも敵だの味方だの主人公だのモブだのと多岐に渡るし――生きることに疲れた者は、その魂が眠りにつくための倉庫へ収まることだってできる。
lines.translated: Even in those cases, the roles varied wildly from villains and allies to protagonists and background extras--and those who had grown weary of living could even choose to have their souls tucked away into a storehouse to sleep.

lines.content: 彼や彼女はそういった行き先に応じた列車に乗るのだ。
lines.translated: These men and women would board the train corresponding to their chosen destination.

lines.content: だが行き先を完全に自由に選べるかと言えばそうでもない。
lines.translated: However, that didn't mean they had complete freedom to choose where they went.

lines.content: 切符を買わねばならないからだ。
lines.translated: Because they had to buy a ticket first.

lines.content: 行き先に応じて[・|値]が違う。
lines.translated: And the *price* varied depending on the destination.

lines.content: もちろんというべきなのかはさておくが――その人物がもっとも[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|り][・|た][・|い]と渇望する行き先こそが巨額であるのだ。
lines.translated: Whether or not it went without saying--the destination a person *yearned for* the most always cost a fortune.

lines.content: ここの通貨は魂に刻まれた[・|経][・|験]である。
lines.translated: The currency used here was the *experiences* etched into one's soul.

lines.content: そこここに設置してある小さな換金所で[・|そ][・|れ]を金貨や銀貨に変えるのだ。
lines.translated: At the small exchange booths set up here and there, people traded *those* in for gold and silver coins.

lines.content: 楽しかった思い出は金貨に変わる。
lines.translated: Happy memories turned into gold coins.

lines.content: つらかった思い出は銀貨に変わる。
lines.translated: Painful memories turned into silver coins.

lines.content: 今回の人生をどう生きたかによって、選べる“次”が多くなる。
lines.translated: Depending on how you lived this life, the number of "nexts" you could choose from grew.

lines.content: 切符は高価だ。
lines.translated: Tickets were expensive.

lines.content: 一枚や二枚の金貨では好きな行き先には行き着けない。経験豊富なモノほど遠くへいける――
lines.translated: One or two gold coins wouldn't get you to the destination of your choice. The more richly experienced a soul was, the further they could go--

lines.content: だが、もちろん、それは一般的な人間社会における経験（早くに結婚をしただの子どもを持っただのいい会社に就職しただのという人間的な尺度）とは、また、違うのだが。
lines.translated: Though of course, "experience" here was something quite different from how human society usually measured it (things like getting married early, having kids, or landing a job at a good company).

lines.content: 更にここで買えるものは切符だけではなかった。
lines.translated: Furthermore, tickets weren't the only things you could buy here.

lines.content: 次の人生などに持ち込める“才能”や“感性”や“性格”などといった精神的（あるいは肉体的）優位性を購入できる。
lines.translated: You could also purchase mental (or physical) advantages to bring into your next life, such as "talent," "sensibility," or "personality."

lines.content: たとえば次の人生では野球の上手い男の子になりたいと願うのなら、そこの運動用品販売店で野球の才能を買えばいい。
lines.translated: For instance, if you wished to become a boy who was good at baseball in your next life, you just had to buy baseball talent at that sporting goods store over there.

lines.content: 打者に憧れるのならバットを。
lines.translated: If you dreamed of being a batter, you bought a bat.

lines.content: 投手に憧れるのならボールを。
lines.translated: If you dreamed of being a pitcher, you bought a ball.

lines.content: 守備も上手になりたいのならグローブも。
lines.translated: And if you wanted to be good at fielding too, you bought a glove.

lines.content: もちろんそれらの道具には、高価なものもあればそうでもないものもある。高いものを買えばそれだけ高水準の才能を魂に添えることができるのだ。
lines.translated: Naturally, some of that equipment was expensive, while some of it wasn't. The pricier the item you bought, the higher the level of talent you could attach to your soul.

lines.content: なんて言うか……。
lines.translated: How should I put it...

lines.content: こう言っちゃあ台無し感があるけれど、
lines.translated: Saying it like this kind of ruins the mood, but...

lines.content: まるで“強くてニューゲーム”って感じだよな……。いや。いやいや。それとはちょっと、違うのかな
lines.translated: "It really feels like a 'New Game Plus,' doesn't it... No. Wait, no. Maybe it's a little different from that."

lines.content: え？　強くて……にゅう？
lines.translated: "Huh? A plus... mew?"

lines.content: 首を傾げた十夜に、何でもない、ごめん、ただの独り言だよと苦笑いを俺は浮かべる――
lines.translated: When Toya tilted her head at my misheard words, I gave a wry smile and told her, "It's nothing, sorry, just talking to myself"--

lines.content: え？　何？　にゅう……？　あっ。……えっちな話？
lines.translated: "Huh? What? Boobs...? Ah. ...Are we talking about something dirty?"

lines.content: はっとしたように口元を手で押さえ、目を丸くするハルには、違うよ……何でそうなるんだよ、と俺は目を細めてしまった――ともあれ。
lines.translated: Haru gasped, covering her mouth with a hand as her eyes went wide, making me squint at her and say, "No... How did your mind even jump to that?"--Anyway.

lines.content: 絵が上手くなりたければ絵の才能を。
lines.translated: If you wanted to be good at drawing, you bought artistic talent.

lines.content: 歌がうまくなりたければ歌の才能を。
lines.translated: If you wanted to be good at singing, you bought vocal talent.

lines.content: 病気知らずの身体が欲しければ、健康を。
lines.translated: If you wanted a body that never got sick, you bought health.

lines.content: 誰より心やさしい人になりたければ、その、心を。
lines.translated: And if you wanted to become someone kinder than anyone else, you bought that very heart.

lines.content: それらはずらりと並んだ店々に取り扱われている。
lines.translated: All of those things were sold in the shops lined up in rows along the street.

lines.content: だから[切符|行き先]だけにすべての資金を消費してしまうわけにもまたいかない。
lines.translated: Which meant you couldn't just blow all your funds on a ticket--your destination--alone.

lines.content: だが、店の店主は猫たちがほとんどだ。
lines.translated: However, most of the shopkeepers here were cats.

lines.content: 彼らは金貨よりも銀貨を好む。
lines.translated: And they preferred silver coins over gold ones.

lines.content: つまり猫たちは人間のつらい気持ちを好むのだ。
lines.translated: In other words, the cats favored the painful feelings of humans.

lines.content: 彼らの間で銀貨は甘くて美味しいデザートとして取り引きされる。またたびよりも彼らをとろけさせてやまないデザートに。
lines.translated: Among the cats, silver coins were traded as sweet, delicious desserts. Desserts that made them melt with bliss even more than silvervine ever could.

lines.content: そうしてすべての銀貨を消費することで、次の人生に悲観的な感情や記憶を、その残滓さえ余すことなく消費して――踏み出すこともできるのだ。
lines.translated: And by spending all of one's silver coins that way, a person could consume every last trace of pessimistic emotion and memory, leaving not even the slightest lingering regret behind--before stepping forward into their next life.

lines.content: 金貨では切符を。
lines.translated: Gold coins for tickets.

lines.content: 銀貨では才能などを。
lines.translated: And silver coins for talents and the like.

lines.content: 多くの場合がそのような形で取引している。
lines.translated: In most cases, that was how transactions worked here.

lines.content: ここで上手に買い物することが、次の人生の有意義さを決めるとさえ言っていいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: You could even say that shopping wisely in this place determined just how meaningful your next life would be.

lines.content: しばらく色々な店先を眺めながら歩いていると、目的の場所――換金所のひとつを見つけた。
lines.translated: After walking for a while and browsing the various storefronts, we found one of our destinations--an exchange booth.

lines.content: それは電話ボックスみたいに小さな長方形の箱だ。
lines.translated: It was a small, rectangular box, much like a telephone booth.

lines.content: 真ん中辺りに小窓と、その前に差し出したいものを置くための、ちょっとした台が取り付けられている。
lines.translated: Right around the middle was a small window with a little counter attached in front of it, meant for placing whatever you wanted to hand over.

lines.content: そしてその真後ろには、二本足で歩く猫が出入りできるだろうくらいの大きさのドアが取り付けられている――ともあれまるっきり飾り気のない箱であった。
lines.translated: And directly on the back was a door just big enough for a bipedal cat to slip in and out of--all in all, it was a completely unadorned box.

lines.content: これは駅のそこらに設置されている。
lines.translated: These were set up all over the station.

lines.content: 十夜。手紙を用意してくれないかな
lines.translated: "Toya. Could you get the letters ready for me?"

lines.content: はい、これ
lines.translated: "Here you go."

lines.content: 十夜から受け取った手紙の束を、小窓の前の台に置く。
lines.translated: I took the bundle of letters from Toya and placed it on the counter in front of the small window.

lines.content: すると猫の手がにゅっと伸びてきて（茶トラ系の毛並みをした前足だった）、その手紙を受け取った。
lines.translated: A cat's paw promptly slid out (a foreleg with orange tabby fur) and took the letters inside.

lines.content: 換金可能な[心|経験]は、命が終わってしまった者たちだけではない。こうして今現在を思い悩んでいる人たちの心もその対象なのだ。
lines.translated: The experiences--the hearts--that could be cashed in here didn't belong solely to those whose lives had ended. The hearts of people currently struggling with their worries in the present were also eligible.

lines.content: 切符じゃなくて才能を買いたいんだ。だから全部、銀貨でお願いしたいんだけど……
lines.translated: "We want to buy talents, not tickets. So could we get it all in silver coins, please...?"

lines.content: そう言うと、がしゃん、と――小窓にシャッターのような鉄の敷居が降りてきた。
lines.translated: As soon as I said that--*clang*--an iron shutter-like partition dropped down over the small window.

lines.content: そこには“鑑定中。しばらくお待ちくだちい”と書いてある。
lines.translated: Written on it were the words: "Appraising. Pwease wait a moment."

lines.content: “さい”ではなく、“ちい”である。
lines.translated: Not "please," but "pwease."

lines.content: まだ言葉が不自由だった頃になんとか作ったものなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had they managed to cobble this sign together back when they still struggled with human language?

lines.content: 今はもうこの誤字に気づいているのかいないのか――気づいていたとしても面倒くさがりな猫たちである。別にいいやとそのままにしてしまっているのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: I couldn't tell if they were aware of the typo by now or not--though even if they had noticed, knowing how lazy cats were, they probably just figured "whatever" and left it as is.

lines.content: そんなどうでもいいことを考えながら、ちょっとの間だけ、待つ。
lines.translated: Mulling over such trivial things, I waited for a brief moment.

lines.content: がしゃり。どたん。がたがた。……ばたんっ。
lines.translated: *Clink. Thud. Rattle, rattle. ...Bang!*

lines.content: 箱の中から音がする。
lines.translated: Noises echoed from inside the box.

lines.content: 中でどんなことが行われているのかはよくわからないが……一分もしないで、小窓は開いた。
lines.translated: I had no idea what was going on in there, but... in less than a minute, the small window slid open.

lines.content: そして猫などの小動物用の餌皿が出てきた。そこには銀貨が並々と盛られていた。
lines.translated: Out came a food bowl meant for cats or other small animals. It was piled high to the brim with silver coins.

lines.content: 全部で銀貨五十八枚――、か
lines.translated: "Fifty-eight silver coins in total, huh..."

lines.content: 三人で数を数え終わると、がしゃり。また小窓にシャッターが降りてきた。
lines.translated: Once the three of us finished counting them up--*clack*. The shutter dropped over the small window once more.

lines.content: そこにはこう書いてあった――“文句は言っちゃあいやだよ”
lines.translated: This time, it read: "No complaining allowed!"

lines.content: 返品返金お断りということだろう。
lines.translated: Which probably meant no returns or refunds.

lines.content: 俺は換金された銀貨を見つめた。
lines.translated: I stared down at the silver coins we had exchanged the letters for.

lines.content: これだけあれば、それなりに高純度の“才能”が買えることだろう。
lines.translated: With this much, we could probably buy some fairly high-purity "talents."

lines.content: この場所に肉体を持ち込める俺たちは、ほしい才能や心や感情や感性といったものを購入して、現実世界に戻ることもできてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Because the three of us could bring our physical bodies into this place, we were even capable of purchasing whatever talents, hearts, emotions, or sensibilities we wanted and bringing them right back to the real world.

lines.content: 俺は……。
たとえば、ここで自由に欲しい“才能”だったりを好きなだけ購入して帰ることができるとしたら――俺は。
lines.translated: For example, if I could freely buy as much of whatever "talent" I wanted here and take it home with me--what would I do?
*Just what kind of person would I try to become?*

lines.content: そんなのは悩むべくもなくわかっている。
lines.translated: I didn't even need to stop and think to know the answer to that.
However, *it wasn't enough*.

lines.content: ここでそれを求めるには、あまりにも、足りなさすぎて……。
lines.translated: To seek that out here, this was far, far too little...

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: どうしたの？　と首を傾げる十夜。
lines.translated: Toya tilted her head, asking what was wrong.

lines.content: 何かあったの……？
lines.translated: "Is something the matter...?"

lines.content: 大丈夫？　と不安げなハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru looked up at me anxiously, asking if I was okay.

lines.content: いや、ごめん。何でもないよ――ただ
lines.translated: "No, sorry. It's nothing--it's just..."

lines.content: ただ？
lines.translated: "Just?"

lines.content: うん。……ただ、これだけあれば、カードゲームとかに絶対負けない運とか才能とかも買えちゃうのかなって、そんなこと思ってたんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...I was just wondering if this much would be enough to buy the luck or talent to never lose at card games. Stuff like that."

lines.content: ハルにそう答えると、十夜が唇をとがらせて、
lines.translated: When I gave Haru that answer, Toya pouted and said,

lines.content: だめだよ。絶対。……大雅。私に負けちゃったのが悔しいのはとってもわかるけどね
lines.translated: "No way. Absolutely not. ...Taiga, I totally get how frustrated you are that you lost to me, though."

lines.content: 十夜は得意そうに胸を張った。ようやく俺に勝てたのがそれほどうれしかったのか。
lines.translated: Toya puffed her chest out proudly. Was she really that happy about finally managing to beat me?

lines.content: うん。そうだね。……わかってる。わかってるよ？　わかってるともさ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. ...I know. I know, okay? Of course I know."

lines.content: ちょっとした誤魔化しのようなつもりのせりふだったのだが……。
lines.translated: I'd only meant to say it as a little deflection to brush things off, but...

lines.content: なんだかちょっと、本当にちょっとだけ、次は絶対に負けないぞという気になってしまった。
lines.translated: For some reason, a tiny part of me--really, just a tiny part--actually started feeling determined not to lose next time.

lines.content: まあ、それはそれとして。
lines.translated: Well, setting that aside.

lines.content: 俺が、俺のなりたい自分になるのはまたいつかの機会だ――そのようなときが本当に訪れるのかどうかは、とりあえず、考えないようにしよう。
lines.translated: Becoming the person I wanted to be was an opportunity for another day--and for now, I decided not to think about whether that day would ever truly come.

lines.content: だから、今は……。
lines.translated: So right now...

lines.content: 今夜の“夢”の中で回収してきた願いを叶えることが、優先だよな
lines.translated: "Our top priority is granting the wishes we collected in tonight's 'dreams,' right?"

lines.content: 明日の歌の発表会で歌が上手に歌えますように。
lines.translated: *I wish I can sing well at tomorrow's singing recital.*

lines.content: 手紙に込められたその想いを銀貨に変えた。その銀貨で歌の才能を買うのだ。
lines.translated: We had turned that feeling poured into a letter into silver coins. Now, we would use those silver coins to buy vocal talent.

lines.content: そしてこれを願った少女の眠る夢に戻す。
lines.translated: And then we would return it to the sleeping dream of the girl who had made the wish.

lines.content: だが、もちろん、そうしたからと言って、一朝一夕で歌が上手になるわけではない。
lines.translated: Of course, doing so didn't mean she would magically become a great singer overnight.

lines.content: いくら歌の“才能”を買って戻ったところで、その才能を最大限に煌めかせるには、やはり本人のたゆまぬ努力が必要にもなる。
lines.translated: No matter how much vocal "talent" we bought and brought back for her, making that talent shine to its fullest still required her own tireless effort.

lines.content: それに歌の才能を得られたからと言ってそれがその人物に最適と定着するかもわからないのだ。
lines.translated: Besides, just because someone acquired vocal talent didn't guarantee it would take root as the best fit for them.

lines.content: それにはやはり、また努力という面倒な（非常に非常に面倒な）要素が不可欠でもあるし……。
lines.translated: For that to happen, the troublesome (extremely, overwhelmingly troublesome) element of hard work was still indispensable...

lines.content: ……その才能を賢明に努力してまで芽吹かせようと思うまで、“歌が好き”だと感じるかもまた、それはそれ、別の話となってしまう。
lines.translated: And whether she even loved singing enough to put in the dedicated effort to make that talent blossom was, again, a whole other story.

lines.content: 色々な要素が理由で適用できなかった才能はいつか消えゆく。その人の中でしぼんでしまう。
lines.translated: Talents that failed to take hold due to various factors would eventually fade away. They would simply wither up inside that person.

lines.content: それは悲しむことでもなければ後悔するようなことでもないだろう。
lines.translated: That wasn't something to mourn, nor was it anything to regret.

lines.content: ただただ単純に、その人にとっては不要だったと言うだけのことだ――ただ、ただ、その人にとって[・|明][・|日]のちょっとした問題を乗り越えるだけの勇気になれば、それでよかったのだ。
lines.translated: It simply meant that the talent had been unnecessary for them--and as long as it served as just enough courage to help them overcome a small hurdle *tomorrow*, that alone was enough.

lines.content: 役割は充分以上に果たされたと言えよう。
lines.translated: You could say it had more than fulfilled its role.

lines.content: そんな“魔法”（と言って差し支えないと思う）を組み上げた猫たちも、文句はただのひとつだってないだろう。
lines.translated: Even the cats who had woven together this system of "magic" (which seemed like a fair enough word for it) wouldn't have a single complaint.

lines.content: そうしたささやかな経験もまた、猫たちの好物である心に育つかもしれないのだから。
lines.translated: Because those modest little experiences might very well grow into the kinds of hearts the cats loved to eat so much.

lines.content: ……よし。それじゃあまずは歌の才能からだな。楽器屋さんってどこにあったっけ？
lines.translated: "...Alright. Let's start with the vocal talent, then. Where was the music store again?"

lines.content: 急ごう。
lines.translated: We needed to hurry.

lines.content: 帰り道にまた一つひとつ、[才能|買ったもの]を夢の中に置いてくる作業も残されている。
lines.translated: We still had the task of dropping our purchases--those talents--back into each dream one by one on our way home.

lines.content: お歌の才能は楽器屋さんじゃなくて、レコード屋さんなんじゃないかなあ。楽しい歌が録音されてるレコードを買うの。たぶんだけど
lines.translated: "I don't think vocal talent would be at a music store, actually. Wouldn't it be at a record shop? You buy a record with a fun song recorded on it. Probably, anyway."

lines.content: う～ん……、どうかなあ。ちょっと難しいかもだね。慎重に選ばないといけないのかな
lines.translated: "Hmm... I wonder. That might be a little tricky. Maybe we need to choose carefully."

lines.content: だけどまあ、こう言うと怒られちゃうかもしれないけど、明日の発表会だけ乗り切れればいいんだ。それほど仰々しいものじゃなくてもいいんじゃあないかな
lines.translated: "Well, people might get mad at me for saying it like this, but she just needs to get through tomorrow's recital. It probably doesn't have to be anything too extravagant."

lines.content: 俺たちは“歌の才能”だけではなく、それ以外の手紙の内容にあった色々なものを、換金所で手に入れた銀貨で購入して回った。
lines.translated: Using the silver coins we'd gotten at the exchange booth, we went around buying not only the "vocal talent," but all sorts of other things matching the contents of the remaining letters.

lines.content: 銀貨はすべてきれいに使い切れた。
lines.translated: We managed to spend every last silver coin cleanly.

lines.content: 回収した手紙に込められていたささやかな願いは、これできっと、叶うだろう――あとはすべて本人次第ということにもなるのだが。
lines.translated: With this, the modest wishes poured into the letters we'd collected would surely come true--though everything after that would be up to the wishers themselves.

lines.content: ……まさか、うう、まさかこんなところで算数のお勉強、させられるなんて思ってなかったよ
lines.translated: "...I never, ugh, I never thought I'd be forced to do math homework in a place like this."

lines.content: ぶつぶつと言う十夜である。
lines.translated: Toya grumbled to herself.

lines.content: お釣りの計算とか難しいよ。両手の指の数よりたくさんなんだもん
lines.translated: "Calculating change is way too hard. It's more than the number of fingers on both hands."

lines.content: いやいや。三人一緒に計算しただろ？
lines.translated: "Come on, now. All three of us did the math together, didn't we?"

lines.content: 何も十夜ひとりに計算を押しつけたわけではないのだが……。
lines.translated: It wasn't like we had pushed all the calculations onto Toya alone...

lines.content: そんなことないもん。考えすぎて頭がずきずきしちゃうよ
lines.translated: "Nu-uh, it was still hard. I thought so much my head is throbbing."

lines.content: そろりと十夜は上目遣いで俺を見る。
lines.translated: Toya slowly peeked up at me with upturned eyes.

lines.content: 疲れちゃった頭にはね、甘いものがいいんだって。おねえちゃん、言ってた
lines.translated: "Big Sis told me that sweet things are good for a tired brain, you know."

lines.content: うん？　そうなんだ……？
lines.translated: "Hmm? Is that so...?"

lines.content: そう……。だから、だからね、大雅……あのね。アイスクリームとか……買ってくれないかなあって……
lines.translated: "Yeah... So, so, um, Taiga... Listen. I was wondering if maybe you could buy me... some ice cream or something..."

lines.content: ん。いいだろう。それくらいの願いならおやすいご用だ
lines.translated: "Mm. Sure thing. A wish like that is easy enough to grant."

lines.content: 本当……っ
lines.translated: "Really...?!"

lines.content: ああ。ふたつでもみっつでも買ってあげよう。今夜は十夜に色々と助けられたしな。ただし、“夜”の外でね？
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'll buy you two, or even three of them. You helped me out in a lot of ways tonight, after all. Outside of the 'Night,' though, okay?"

lines.content: この命までをも救われてしまったのだ――まあ、これくらいのお礼をしても、あまり十夜に間食させない主義のあさひさんだって許してくれるだろう。
lines.translated: She had even saved my life--so surely Asahi-san, who usually had a strict policy against letting Toya snack too much, would forgive me for giving her a thank-you gift like this.

lines.content: うわ～……いっ
lines.translated: "Yaay...!"

lines.content: やった！　やったよ！　と飛び跳ねるのだ。猫の耳がぴょんと飛び出している。
lines.translated: "Hooray! Hooray!" she cheered, jumping up and down. Her cat ears popped right out.

lines.content: そんな十夜の姿を見て……俺はちょっと心配にもなってくるのだ。
lines.translated: Watching Toya act like that... honestly made me a little worried.

lines.content: お嬢ちゃんあめ玉あげようかアイスクリーム舐めさせてあげようかちょっとこっちに来てごらんおじさんのお家に来てごらんよ怖くないからやさしくするから大丈夫だよ平気だよ――
lines.translated: *Hey there, little girl, want a piece of candy? Want a lick of this ice cream? Come on over here for a second, come visit my house, there's nothing to be scared of, I'll be nice to you, it's okay, everything's fine--*

lines.content: だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 人間にはおかしな人たちがたくさんいるのだ。
lines.translated: There were plenty of creeps out there in the human world.

lines.content: そんなおかしな人に甘いもの欲しさに簡単について行ったりしないだろうか。
lines.translated: What if she easily followed some weirdo like that just because she wanted something sweet?

lines.content: 十夜。俺は不安だよ
lines.translated: "Toya. I'm worried."

lines.content: きょとんとする。
lines.translated: She blinked in confusion.

lines.content: 不安？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Worried? Why?"

lines.content: 純真そのものといった瞳であった。
lines.translated: Her eyes were the very picture of pure innocence.

lines.content: ……なあ。ハルだってそう思うだろ。この子。危なっかしいったらないんだ
lines.translated: "...Hey. You think so too, right, Haru? This girl is way too easy a target."

lines.content: う、うん。よくわからないけど……そうかもだね。大雅くんの不安、わからないでもないかも……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I'm not really sure, but... maybe. I think I can understand why you're worried, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 苦笑いのハルである。
lines.translated: Haru gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 私がちょっと変な男の子だったら、我慢できずに色々と悪戯してるかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "If I were a slightly weird boy, I might not be able to hold back from playing all sorts of pranks on her."

lines.content: いいか、十夜
lines.translated: "Listen up, Toya."

lines.content: うん。なあに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: 知らない人には絶対ついていっちゃいけないぞ？　ほら、もしもハルがちょっと変な男の子だったら十夜は今頃……ああ、大変だ。とっても大変なことになってるかもしれないんだぞ
lines.translated: "You must never follow strangers, got it? Look, if Haru were a slightly weird boy, by now you might be... Oh, it'd be terrible. You might be in some really terrible trouble right now."

lines.content: た、大変なことって……っ
lines.translated: "T-Terrible trouble...?"

lines.content: 十夜は目をぱちぱちとさせ、首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Toya blinked her eyes and tilted her head.

lines.content: でも、大丈夫だよ。きっと平気だって思うな
lines.translated: "But it's okay. I think I'll definitely be fine."

lines.content: ほう。なぜ、そう思うんだい？
lines.translated: "Oh? And why do you think that?"

lines.content: だって、大雅はちょっと変な男の子だよ？　でも、私、まだ大変なことになっていないよ？　だからきっと平気なんだよ
lines.translated: "Because you're a slightly weird boy, Taiga. And I haven't gotten into any terrible trouble yet, right? So I'm sure I'll be fine."

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。そうだな。基本的には人見知りな子だもんな、十夜。俺に対してはこんなにこんなに、小生意気なのになあ
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. I guess so. You're basically shy around strangers, after all, Toya. Even though you're this cheeky with me."

lines.content: 鼻を指で摘んでみた。
lines.translated: I pinched her nose between my fingers.

lines.content: う、ううう～……っ、なに、するのぉ～……っ
lines.translated: "U-Uuuu... Wh-What are you doing...?"

lines.content: 涙目だ。猫の耳もしゅんとする。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in her eyes, and her cat ears drooped.

lines.content: 俺には元気いっぱいな姿を見せてくれるので、つい、忘れがちになってしまうけれど……そうだ。この子は警戒心の強い子だ。
lines.translated: Since she always showed me her energetic side, I tended to forget... right. This girl was actually very wary of others.

lines.content: だから大丈夫だろう。きっと。そう思うことにする。
lines.translated: So she would probably be fine. Surely. I decided to leave it at that.

lines.content: 戻ろうか。ナナちゃんが待ってる
lines.translated: "Let's head back. Nana-chan is waiting."

lines.content: 十分後に集合なんて言ってしまったが、思ったより時間がかかってしまった。
lines.translated: I had told her we'd meet back in ten minutes, but it ended up taking longer than expected.

lines.content: 俺たちの汽車に戻る。
lines.translated: We returned to our train.

lines.content: するとナナちゃんの抱いていた“ぬいぐるみ”が、“次”へと続く別の列車にちょうど乗り込んだところだった。
lines.translated: Just as we got back, the "stuffed animal" Nana-chan had been holding had just boarded a different train leading to the "Next."

lines.content: あの子が選んだ“次”は魂の倉庫だよ
lines.translated: "The 'Next' that child chose is the Warehouse of Souls."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはぽつりと言った――魂の倉庫。そこで深いふかい眠りにつくことをあの子は選んだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan murmured quietly--the Warehouse of Souls. That child had chosen to fall into a deep, deep sleep there.

lines.content: いや。選んだ、というのは少し違うのかもしれない。
lines.translated: No. Perhaps "chose" wasn't quite the right word.

lines.content: あの子は、人の心の中に芽生えた“悪い夢”だから。命は、ないんだ
lines.translated: "Because that child is a 'bad dream' that sprouted inside someone's heart. It doesn't have a life."

lines.content: だからあの子の全部を捧げても、魂の倉庫だなんて……静かで、さみしい……そんな場所にたどり着くための切符しか買うことができなかった
lines.translated: "So even after offering up everything it had, it could only afford a ticket to a place like the Warehouse of Souls... somewhere quiet, and lonely..."

lines.content: それでも。こうして自分が消えれば、自分を産んだ自分の持ち主が、ほんの少しでも笑顔になれるならいいと……
lines.translated: "Even so. It said that if disappearing like this could help its owner--the one who gave birth to it--smile even just a little bit more, then it was fine with that..."

lines.content: ――じりじりと発車が近いことを知らせるベルと、列車の扉が閉じられた音によって、ナナちゃんのその声はかき消されてしまう。
lines.translated: --The shrill ringing of the bell signaling the imminent departure, along with the sound of the train doors closing, drowned out Nana-chan's voice.

lines.content: ……そうだ。[悪夢|ぬいぐるみ]は命ではないのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. That stuffed animal--that nightmare--wasn't a living thing.

lines.content: それは誰かの命の中に芽吹いた[感情|心]でしかない――だがそんな“心”はときに、“夜の国”の中で独立した（かのような）自我を持つ。不安という名の命だ。
lines.translated: It was nothing more than an emotion, a heart, that had sprouted within someone else's life--yet inside the "Country of Night," such a "heart" sometimes gained an independent (or seemingly independent) ego. A life by the name of anxiety.

lines.content: その命は持ち主自身の心を攻撃してしまう。
lines.translated: And that life ended up attacking its owner's own heart.

lines.content: ただそこに[・|在][・|る]というだけで、持ち主のことを殺してしまいかねない――持ち主は苦しみに耐えかねて自死、してしまいかねない。
lines.translated: Simply by *existing* there, it could end up killing its owner--driving them to take their own life, unable to bear the suffering.

lines.content: そうなる前に自我を持った“暗黒の[悪夢|心]”を取り除くのが“魔法少女”の仕事であった。
lines.translated: Removing those self-aware "dark nightmares"--those dark hearts--before that happened was the job of a "magical girl."

lines.content: 他の町でも同じような活動を“夜”の中で行っている者たちがいると噂には聞く。
lines.translated: I had heard rumors that there were others in different towns carrying out similar activities within the "Night."

lines.content: 他の町で活動している者たちは“魔法少女”と呼ばれていないだろう。
lines.translated: Though those working in other towns probably weren't called "magical girls."

lines.content: それは“参禅町”の“夜”を根城にする“魔法使い”であるあさひさんが、勝手にみんなに名付けたものにすぎないからだ。
lines.translated: Because that was just a name Asahi-san, the "magician" who made the "Night" of Sanzen Town her home base, had arbitrarily given to everyone.

lines.content: それはまあ、ともかく。
lines.translated: Well, setting that aside.

lines.content: この町以外の少女たちは、害になる感情はその人の心の中で消滅させてしまう。無力化するのではなく、その場で完膚なきまでに殺してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: The girls in other towns completely eradicated harmful emotions right inside the person's heart. Rather than neutralizing them, they killed them on the spot, utterly and completely.

lines.content: そうして自我を持った“暗闇の[悪夢|心]”の持ち主の命を護る――それについての善悪を論議したりするつもりは毛頭ない。
lines.translated: That was how they protected the lives of those hosting a self-aware "dark nightmare"--and I had no intention whatsoever of debating the morality of it.

lines.content: ひどいからやめろだの、弱いものいじめはよくないだのと、知ったふうなことを得意げに、満足げに、語るような下品な真似はごめん被りたい。
lines.translated: I wanted no part in something as vulgar as smugly and self-righteously preaching to them to stop because it's cruel, or saying that bullying the weak is wrong, acting as if I knew everything.

lines.content: それぞれにそれぞれのやり方や生き方があるのだ。抱え込んだ事情だってあることだろう。
lines.translated: Everyone had their own ways of doing things, their own ways of living. They surely had their own circumstances to deal with, too.

lines.content: だから俺たちは俺たちのやり方と生き方を尊重するからこそ、ここにそうして、取り除かれた“悪夢”を消滅させることなく連れてくる。
lines.translated: That was why, out of respect for our own methods and way of life, we brought the removed "nightmares" here without destroying them.

lines.content: ……ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: As Nana-chan says.

lines.content: “悪夢”はその持ち主の心配や不安や恐怖心を一身に受け、ずっとずっと、たったひとり、真っ暗闇な心の中でつらい思いをしてきた。
lines.translated: A "nightmare" takes on all of its owner's worries, anxieties, and fears, suffering all alone in a pitch-black heart for so, so long.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: そんな彼や彼女ひとりを悪だとして断ずるのは、とても悲しいことだし、とてもさみしいことだ。
lines.translated: To condemn them alone as evil is a terribly sad, terribly lonely thing.

lines.content: だからせめて……、せめて最後の夜は、つらいことばかりだった“悪夢”にも、楽しいことが少しだけでも多くありますように。
lines.translated: So at the very least... on their very last night, may these "nightmares" who have known nothing but pain experience just a little bit more joy.

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそう願い、“悪夢”をこの駅に運ぶとき……列車で“夜”の中を旅して回る。
lines.translated: Wishing for that, whenever Nana-chan transports a "nightmare" to this station... she travels around through the "Night" by train.

lines.content: つらいことばかりしか知らない“悪夢”に、こんな世界の中にでも探せば楽しいことはあるのだと知ってほしいと、いつだったか、ナナちゃんは言っていた。
lines.translated: Sometime in the past, Nana-chan had told me she wanted the "nightmares" who knew only pain to learn that even in a world like this, you can find fun things if you look for them.

lines.content: そんな彼女の気持ちに俺は共感したいとそう願う。
lines.translated: I wished to sympathize with those feelings of hers.

lines.content: 願うからこそだ。俺はこうして、できうる限り彼女の仕事を手伝っている。
lines.translated: And it was precisely because of that wish that I was helping her with her work as much as I possibly could.

lines.content: もう一度、ベルの音。
lines.translated: The bell rang once more.

lines.content: 窓の向こうに“ぬいぐるみ”の姿を探す。
lines.translated: I searched for the "stuffed animal" beyond the train windows.

lines.content: 覗き込んだ車内には、抱えた鞄を頭上の棚に預けたり（この駅で購入した才能だとかだろう）、探し出せた空席に腰を落ち着ける人影の姿ばかりしか覗えない。
lines.translated: Peering inside the car, all I could see were the silhouettes of passengers stowing their bags on the overhead racks (probably containing the talents and such they'd bought at this station) or settling into empty seats they'd found.

lines.content: ……発車してしまう。
lines.translated: It was going to depart.

lines.content: このままではあの子にお別れを伝えられない――
lines.translated: At this rate, we wouldn't be able to say goodbye to that child--

lines.content: 俺たちは特別な感情をあの“ぬいぐるみ”に対して抱くような理由はないはずだ。
lines.translated: We shouldn't have had any reason to hold special feelings for that "stuffed animal."

lines.content: それでも“さようなら”くらいは伝えたいと思っても悪くはないはずだった。
lines.translated: Even so, there was surely nothing wrong with wanting to at least say "goodbye."

lines.content: ――あ、あそこ
lines.translated: "--Ah, over there."

lines.content: ハルが俺の手を引く。
lines.translated: Haru tugged on my hand.

lines.content: 少し離れた窓の向こうに、見つけた。
lines.translated: Beyond a window a short distance away, I spotted it.

lines.content: まるで窓に張り付くみたいにして立っている“くまのぬいぐるみ”
lines.translated: The "stuffed bear" was standing there, practically pressed up against the glass.

lines.content: こちらに向かって手を振っている。
lines.translated: It was waving at us.

lines.content: その姿はなんだかアニメの中の出来事みたいで――まさに夢の中の出来事、みたいで。
lines.translated: The sight looked like something straight out of a cartoon--truly like something out of a dream.

lines.content: もう一度。最後のベルが鳴り響く。
lines.translated: Once again, the final bell echoed out.

lines.content: そして濃霧のような蒸気を吐き出して、発車しはじめる黒塗りの蒸気機関車。
lines.translated: And spewing steam as thick as dense fog, the black-painted steam locomotive began to pull away.

lines.content: ばいばい、またね
lines.translated: "Bye-bye, see you."

lines.content: 十夜は“ぬいぐるみ”に手を振った。
lines.translated: Toya waved back at the "stuffed animal."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは何も言わず、ただ、見送る。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said nothing, simply watching it go.

lines.content: ハルも同じだ。
lines.translated: Haru did the same.

lines.content: 機関車の姿が遠く見えなくなるまで静かに見送り、言った。
lines.translated: She quietly saw the locomotive off until it disappeared into the distance, then spoke.

lines.content: あの子、笑ってたよね？　きっと
lines.translated: "That child was smiling, right? I'm sure of it."

lines.content: ぬいぐるみだから表情は読めない。
lines.translated: Since it was a stuffed animal, there was no way to read its expression.

lines.content: だけどそうであればいいと、俺も、思った。
lines.translated: Even so, I hoped that was true, too.
*No.*
*Did I really?*

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: えっ
lines.translated: "Eh?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんに名を呼ばれ、びくりとしてしまう――つい、声が、うわずる。
lines.translated: When Nana-chan called my name, I flinched--and my voice accidentally cracked in response.

lines.content: だがナナちゃんはそんな俺には構わずに、もしくは気づくことなく、言った。
lines.translated: But either not minding my reaction or not noticing it at all, Nana-chan spoke.

lines.content: ……あの子から手紙をもらったよ
lines.translated: "...I got a letter from that child."

lines.content: 手紙……？
lines.translated: "A letter...?"

lines.content: “真夜中”を走る列車の中で書いたのだというそれを、俺たちが戻ってくる前に“ぬいぐるみ”から渡されたらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, the "stuffed animal" had written it aboard the train running through "Midnight" and handed it to her before we got back.

lines.content: “夜”の中で[手紙|願い]を探して回る俺たちを見て、“ぬいぐるみ”も俺たちに手紙を書こうと思ったとのことだった。
lines.translated: Having watched us search for letters--for wishes--throughout the "Night," the "stuffed animal" had apparently decided to write a letter to us as well.

lines.content: そこにはこう、書いてあった――
lines.translated: This is what was written inside--

lines.content: “私はつらくて痛い気持ちしか生み出さない悪い夢”
lines.translated: "I am a bad dream that only creates painful, hurting feelings."

lines.content: “だから私は、消えてなくなるのがいい”
lines.translated: "So it's best that I disappear and cease to be."

lines.content: “私が死んでも、[持ち主|あの子]がお父さんとお母さんに捨てられてしまったっていう事実は変わらないけれど……”
lines.translated: "Even if I die, it won't change the fact that she--my owner--was abandoned by her mom and dad..."

lines.content: “それでも、私が死んで、私の持ち主が少しでも笑顔になれる瞬間が増えるのなら……”
lines.translated: "Even so, if my dying means my owner will have even a few more moments where she can smile..."

lines.content: “ごめんね。色々と乱暴なことをしてしまって、ごめんなさい。こんな私は、やっぱり、消えてなくなってしまったほうがいいんだね”
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm so sorry for doing all those violent things. It really is better for someone like me to just disappear and be gone."

lines.content: “でも”
“でもね、神さま”
lines.translated: "You know what, God?"

lines.content: “短い間だけど、こんな私なんかと一緒にいてくれて、うれしかった”
lines.translated: "It was only for a short time, but I was so happy that you stayed with someone like me."

lines.content: “神さまと。あなた達と一緒に列車で走った世界は、いっぱい、たくさん、きらきらで、まぶしかった”
lines.translated: "The world I rode through on the train with you, God, and with all of you, was so, so full of sparkling, dazzling things."

lines.content: “ありがとう。小さな神さま……私の、神さま”
lines.translated: "Thank you. Little God... my God."

lines.content: “上手く言えないのがすごく、すごく、悔しいけれど……”
lines.translated: "It's really, really frustrating that I can't put it into words very well, but..."

lines.content: “こんな、悪者な私に、やさしくしてくれてありがとう。あなたのおかげで、きっと、これからどこへ行ったとしても、悪くない夢が見れるような気がするよ”
lines.translated: "Thank you for being so kind to a bad guy like me. Thanks to you, I feel like no matter where I go from here, I'll be able to have a not-so-bad dream."

lines.content: ……と、そう、書いてある。
lines.translated: That was what it said.

lines.content: “……神さま。今夜私は、産まれてはじめて楽しいって、思えたよ”
lines.translated: "...God. Tonight, for the very first time since I was born, I felt like I had fun."

lines.content: これは、喜んでいいの？
lines.translated: "Is this something I should be happy about?"

lines.content: どんなふうな表情を作っていいのかわからないらしい――ナナちゃんは複雑な顔で、俺を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Seeming unsure of what kind of face she was supposed to make--Nana-chan looked up at me with a complicated expression.

lines.content: 俺は何も言わずナナちゃんの頭を撫でた。
lines.translated: Without saying a word, I stroked Nana-chan's head.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは帽子がずれ落ちないよう、両手でしっかり押さえるだけで、何も抵抗することなく俺に撫でられていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan simply held her hat down firmly with both hands so it wouldn't slip off, letting me pat her without putting up any resistance.

lines.content: ……帰ろう。まだ俺たちには仕事が残ってる。そうだよね？
lines.translated: "...Let's head back. We still have work left to do. Right?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 少し元気のないナナちゃんの手を俺は引いた。
lines.translated: I took Nana-chan's hand, as she was looking a little down.

lines.content: 俺たちは列車に乗り込む。
lines.translated: We boarded the train.
