lines.content: そして巨大な駅を……終わってしまった命や心が最後に行き着くこの駅を、世界中のうつくしいものが集まってくる“刻の終着駅”を、後にする。
lines.translated: And we left the massive station behind... the final destination for lives and hearts that had come to an end, the "Terminal of Time" where all the beautiful things in the world gathered.

lines.content: 遠くなっていく巨大なその姿を俺は車窓から見つめた。
lines.translated: Through the train window, I watched its colossal form recede into the distance.

lines.content: ……少しでいいんだ。
lines.translated: Just a little is fine.

lines.content: やさしい心が俺はほしい。
lines.translated: I want a kind heart.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら――車窓のシャッターを、俺は降ろした。
lines.translated: Thinking that--I pulled down the shutter over the window.

lines.content: ……もうすぐ朝がやって来る。
lines.translated: Morning would be here soon.

lines.content: “夜”に浮かぶ満月が[・|水][・|平][・|線]の向こうに沈みかけていた。
lines.translated: The full moon floating in the "Night" was beginning to sink beyond the *horizon*.

lines.content: 夜明け前。
lines.translated: Just before dawn.

lines.content: “夜”が一番深くなる時間帯でもある。
lines.translated: It was also the hour when the "Night" grew deepest.

lines.content: 今夜回収した“[願い|手紙]”は合計八つ。“刻の終着駅”で買い物したのものも同じく八つだ。
lines.translated: We had collected a total of eight "letters"--eight wishes--tonight. And we had bought eight items at the "Terminal of Time" to match.

lines.content: 俺たちは購入した“才能”などをそれぞれの夢の中に配り終えた。
lines.translated: We finished delivering the "talents" and other things we had purchased into their respective dreams.

lines.content: そして最後はあの“願い”だ――歌の発表会でうまく歌いたいと願う女の子。
lines.translated: Which left the final "wish"--the girl who wished to sing well at her vocal recital.

lines.content: 彼女の夢の中には“刻の終着駅”で購入してきた“[・|勇][・|気]”を運んだ。
lines.translated: Into her dream, we carried the "*courage*" we had purchased at the "Terminal of Time."

lines.content: 彼女に必要なのは歌の才能ではなく“勇気”なのではないか。
lines.translated: Maybe what she needed wasn't a talent for singing, but "courage."

lines.content: ハルと、十夜と、三人で話し合って決めたのだ。
lines.translated: Haru, Toya, and I had talked it over and decided on that together.

lines.content: [夢の主|彼女]の明日に立ちはだかるちょっと小さな大問題。
lines.translated: It was for the slightly small, yet huge problem standing in the way of the dreamer's tomorrow.

lines.content: そして歌の発表会を乗り越えたあと、大好きな人に思いを伝えるため……その一歩を踏み出せるように。
lines.translated: And so that after she made it through the vocal recital, she would be able to take that first step... toward conveying her feelings to the person she loved.

lines.content: 夢の海上に停車した列車の上だ。
lines.translated: We were on top of the train, parked upon the sea of dreams.

lines.content: そこにハルとふたりでよじ登り、彼女の夢の中に……夜空の月に向かって[・|紙][・|飛][・|行][・|機]を飛ばした。それが“勇気”だ。
lines.translated: Haru and I had climbed up there together, and into the girl's dream... toward the moon in the night sky, we launched a *paper airplane*. That was her "courage."

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”で購入した、たった一枚の金色の折り紙で折った紙飛行機だった。
lines.translated: It was a paper airplane folded from a single sheet of gold origami paper we had bought at the "Terminal of Time."

lines.content: ゆっくりと夜空を飛んでいくその姿を見つめながら、ハルは言うのだ。
lines.translated: Watching it slowly glide through the night sky, Haru spoke.

lines.content: ……もう、“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”は目的の場所にたどり着けたのかな
lines.translated: "...Do you think 'that child'--the stuffed animal--has reached its destination by now?"

lines.content: どうかな
lines.translated: "I wonder."

lines.content: 首を振り、俺は応える。
lines.translated: Shaking my head, I replied.

lines.content: “[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”が向かった先は、魂の安息所だとナナちゃんは言っていたけれど……俺もそこへは行ったことがないから
lines.translated: "Nana-chan said the place 'that child' was heading to is a resting place for souls... but I've never been there myself."

lines.content: だから[・|そ][・|こ]が[・|あ][・|の][・|駅]からどれだけ離れてるのかは……よく、わからない
lines.translated: "So I don't really know... just how far *that place* is from *that station*."

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: 囁くようにそう言ったハル。
lines.translated: Haru had spoken almost in a whisper.

lines.content: そして少しの間、唇を結んだまま、夜の空を見つめていた。
lines.translated: Then, for a short while, she kept her lips pressed together, gazing up at the night sky.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: “[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”はどうして産まれてきたのかな
lines.translated: "Why do you think 'that child' was born?"

lines.content: ハルは自分の胸元をそっと押さえる。
lines.translated: Haru gently pressed a hand against her chest.

lines.content: 私の中にも、“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”みたいな心が育ってるのかもしれない……のかな
lines.translated: "I wonder if... a heart like 'that child' might be growing inside me, too..."

lines.content: ……どうしようもない私が、[・|見][・|栄][・|っ][・|張][・|り]な、私が……格好付けちゃうその度にどきどき胸が痛いのも
lines.translated: "...Whenever the hopeless, *vain* side of me... tries to put on a brave front, my heart pounds and aches so much."

lines.content: 私の中の“誰か”が、“夜”の中で、どきどき痛い気持ちを肩代わりしてくれてたりするのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder if 'someone' inside me is out there in the 'Night,' taking on those pounding, painful feelings in my place."

lines.content: つらい思いをするために産まれてくる存在。そんなのはあまりにつらい。
lines.translated: An existence born only to suffer. Something like that was far too cruel.

lines.content: たとえそれが命なきただの心の一部であったとしても。
lines.translated: Even if it was nothing more than a lifeless fragment of a heart.

lines.content: “[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”は……
lines.translated: "'That child'..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: “[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”は、いいや、“[悪夢|ぬいぐるみ]”の持ち主は、両親にやさしくてもらえない、受け入れてもらえない、愛してもらえない……そんな自分が大嫌いだと思った
lines.translated: "'That child'--no, the owner of that 'nightmare,' hated herself... because her parents wouldn't treat her kindly, wouldn't accept her, wouldn't love her."

lines.content: そんな自分でいることがつらいと思った。
lines.translated: She felt it was too painful to go on being herself.

lines.content: だから大嫌いな自分とこの先ずっとつきあっていくことは無理だと、思った。それならいっそのこと死んでしまったほうがずっとましだ、と――
lines.translated: "So she thought it was impossible to keep living with the self she hated so much from here on out. She thought she'd be much better off just dying instead--"

lines.content: ――そう思ったから、“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”が産まれた？　だから、“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”の持ち主は自殺してしまいたいと、思った？
lines.translated: "--And because she thought that, 'that child' was born? Is that why the owner of 'that child' wanted to commit suicide?"

lines.content: そう、だね
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 父親の運転するバスに飛び出したりして。
lines.translated: Like by jumping out in front of the bus her father was driving.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は、思い描くすべてが形となってしまう“夜の国”で命を得て……さらに自分自身を痛烈に苦しめ始めてしまう
lines.translated: "*It* was given life in the 'Land of Night,' where everything you envision takes form... and it began to torment her even more fiercely."

lines.content: ……だから。[・|そ][・|の][・|人]がその苦しみに耐えきれず自殺してしまわないよう、私たちは、小さかったあの頃の私たちは、“夜”の中で戦っていた？
lines.translated: "...So that's why. To keep *that person* from being unable to bear the suffering and taking their own life, we--our younger selves back then--were fighting in the 'Night'?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。……“魔法少女”の出番だ。いつかの小さな君たちは、心にどうしようもなく嫌な自分を、“悪夢”を両手いっぱいに抱えた人を救うため、“夜”の中を駆け抜けたんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, right. ...That's where the 'magical girls' came in. Back then, when you were little, you girls ran through the 'Night' to save people whose hearts were filled with an unbearably hateful version of themselves--people carrying armfuls of 'nightmares.'"

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ハルはうなずいた。
lines.translated: Haru nodded.

lines.content: 私たちは何も知らずに“魔法少女”をしてたんだね
lines.translated: "We were being 'magical girls' without knowing anything about it, weren't we?"

lines.content: それともただ、今はもう思い出せなくなってしまってるだけかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Or maybe we've just become unable to remember it now...

lines.content: そう言うハルに、俺は苦笑いを浮かべて見せた。
lines.translated: When Haru added that, I gave her a wry smile.

lines.content: まあ……そもそも“魔法少女”っていうのは、俺たちの“魔法使い”が、あさひさんが勝手にそう呼び始めただけだけどね
lines.translated: "Well... in the first place, 'magical girls' was just what our 'magician,' Asahi-san, decided to start calling you on her own."

lines.content: うん。そうだったね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's true."

lines.content: ハルは微笑む。
lines.translated: Haru smiled.

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: どうか、したのかな
lines.translated: "Is something the matter?"

lines.content: 少し、元気がないというか。ハルの様子が変に感じたから
lines.translated: "You seem a little down, or... I just felt like you were acting a bit strange, Haru."

lines.content: え、えっと……
少し戸惑った様子。
lines.translated: She looked slightly hesitant.

lines.content: だけど小さくうなずき、ハルは言った。
lines.translated: But Haru gave a small nod and spoke.

lines.content: ……私、[・|み][・|ん][・|な]と会うのが少し怖い。そんな自分が確かにいるの。心の中に
lines.translated: "...I'm a little scared to see *everyone*. There's definitely a part of me that feels that way. Inside my heart."

lines.content: ハルは明日、俺たちの通う学園に転校してくる予定となっている。
lines.translated: Haru was scheduled to transfer into our academy tomorrow.

lines.content: しかも智仁の得た情報ではなんと俺たちと同じクラスだ。
lines.translated: And according to the information Tomohito had gotten, she was even going to be in the exact same class as us.

lines.content: 千和ちゃんや姫織ちゃんや、それに、智仁くん。みんな私のこと覚えててくれるかな。昔みたいに仲良くしてくれるかな
lines.translated: "Chiwa-chan, Himeori-chan, and Tomohito-kun, too. I wonder if everyone will remember me. I wonder if we'll be able to get along like we used to."

lines.content: ……私はちゃんと、みんなに嫌われないような私で、いられるのかな
lines.translated: "...Will I really be able to be the kind of person everyone won't hate?"

lines.content: そうした思いが日毎に大きく大きく育っていって――ちくり、ちくりと、心のやわらかい部分を刺し続けている。
lines.translated: Thoughts like those grew bigger and bigger with each passing day--pricking, again and again, at the soft parts of her heart.

lines.content: ……こんなのは“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”に比べたらほんの些細なものだよね。悩み――と呼んでしまうのもおこがましいのかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Compared to 'that child,' something like this is completely trivial, isn't it? It might even be presumptuous to call it a worry."

lines.content: だけど明日のことを考えると、だめなんだよ。胸がどきどきして、痛いよ。今すぐどこかに逃げ出してしまいたい
lines.translated: "But when I think about tomorrow, I just can't help it. My heart pounds so hard, and it hurts. It makes me want to run away somewhere right this second."

lines.content: それが今、私の中にある問題なのかもしれない――みんなと、私。その関係の中にある“悩み”なのかもしれない
lines.translated: "Maybe that's the problem inside me right now--everyone, and me. Maybe it's a 'worry' sitting right in the middle of our relationship."

lines.content: ……十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: 柊ハルは俺たちの中心人物だった。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru had been the center of our group.

lines.content: いつも笑顔でみんなのことを前へ前へと引っ張った。
lines.translated: She had always pulled everyone forward, again and again, with a smile on her face.
*But none of that had been the real her.*

lines.content: 本当の彼女は、誰より恥ずかしがり屋で人見知り――だけどみんなの前では格好つけずにはいられない。
lines.translated: The real Haru was shyer and more timid around people than anyone else--yet in front of everyone, she couldn't stop herself from putting on a brave front.

lines.content: 見栄っ張りなのだ。だから彼女はいつでも無理して笑っていた。
lines.translated: She was vain like that. And because of it, she was always forcing herself to smile.

lines.content: そしてなぜだか今も、昔も、こうして俺の前でだけ素直な自分を見せていてくれていた。
lines.translated: Yet for some reason, both now and back then, I was the only one she ever showed her true, honest self to like this.

lines.content: どうしても内側へと沈み込んでしまう胸の内を、俺にだけ、なぜかこうして告白してくれる。
lines.translated: The feelings deep in her chest that inevitably sank inward--for some reason, she confessed them only to me.

lines.content: 変わっていない。
lines.translated: She hadn't changed.

lines.content: 身体は大きくなって。昔以上にかわいくなって。
lines.translated: She had grown taller. She had become even cuter than she used to be.

lines.content: 色々と変わってしまったハルだけど……。
lines.translated: So many things about Haru had changed, and yet...

lines.content: 心は変わらず、ちょっとかわいい見栄っ張りな女の子のままだった。
lines.translated: Her heart hadn't changed at all; she was still the same slightly cute, vain girl trying to put on a brave front.

lines.content: 彼女の胸の内はいつもどきどき痛くて、不安で、心配で……震えているのだ。
lines.translated: Deep inside her chest, her heart was always pounding and aching, anxious and worried... trembling.

lines.content: もしかすると彼女の本当の笑顔を、俺は、俺たちは、まだ一度も見つめたことがないのかもしれない。それがハルの[・|も][・|う][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ][・|の][・|秘][・|密]だった。
lines.translated: Maybe I--maybe all of us--had never once seen her true smile. That was Haru's *other secret*.

lines.content: 私は……その……大雅くんは知っててくれると、思うけど……ばかみたいに、鬱陶しいくらいに、本当は恥ずかしがり屋で人見知り、だから
lines.translated: "I'm... um... I think you already know this, Taiga-kun, but... the truth is, I'm ridiculously, annoyingly shy and timid around people, so..."

lines.content: 顔を伏せ、
lines.translated: Lowering her gaze,

lines.content: 目をぎゅっと閉じ、
lines.translated: squeezing her eyes shut,

lines.content: 両手をぐっと、握りしめ……ハルは言う。
lines.translated: and clenching both hands tightly... Haru spoke.

lines.content: 明日のことを思うと胸が痛いよ……どきどきして、ずきずきして……本当に逃げ出してしまいたい
lines.translated: "When I think about tomorrow, my chest hurts... It's pounding, and throbbing... I really just want to run away."

lines.content: 初めての場所に行くときはいつもそうなの。明日なんてこなければいいって思うんだよ
lines.translated: "It's always like this when I have to go somewhere for the first time. I find myself wishing tomorrow would just never come."

lines.content: ……これは、この痛みは、私の中で私を苦しめる別の私がいるからなのかな。“夜の国”がイヤな私を形にしてるって、ことなのかな
lines.translated: "...Is this--is this pain because there's another me inside me who's tormenting me? Does it mean the 'Land of Night' is giving form to the side of me I hate?"

lines.content: あの“ぬいぐるみ”の子みたいにと、ハルは苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Like that "stuffed animal" child, Haru added with a wry smile.

lines.content: ……もう、俺たちの町には“魔法少女”はいなくなってしまった
lines.translated: "...There are no 'magical girls' left in our town anymore."

lines.content: だから今はナナちゃんがひとりで、その代わりをしてくれてる
lines.translated: "So right now, Nana-chan is filling in for them all by herself."

lines.content: そして時おり俺がナナちゃんを手伝っている。
lines.translated: And every now and then, I help Nana-chan out.

lines.content: いつも不安で、心配で……そんなイヤな自分に悩まされ、ちょっと勇気が出ない子を見つけると、ナナちゃんは“夜”の中に連れ出して一緒に旅をするんだ。今夜したみたいにね
lines.translated: "Whenever she finds a kid who's always anxious and worried... troubled by a side of themselves they hate, and unable to muster up a little courage, Nana-chan takes them out into the 'Night' to travel together. Just like we did tonight."

lines.content: 苦しい思いをしている人には楽しい夢をたくさん見せて……少しでも元気になれるようにと、ナナちゃんは祈ってるんだと思う
lines.translated: "She shows lots of fun dreams to people who are hurting... praying that it'll help them cheer up, even if only a little. At least, that's what I think."

lines.content: ――“参禅町”に住む人々は、子どもに限らず、大人に限らず、夢の中で一度はナナちゃんの列車に乗ったことがあるはずだ。
lines.translated: --Everyone living in "Sanzen Town," whether child or adult, must have ridden on Nana-chan's train at least once in their dreams.

lines.content: だが、誰もそんな夢の中での出来事などかけらも覚えていないだろう。
lines.translated: Though no one would remember even a single fragment of what happened inside those dreams.

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそれでいいのだと言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan says that's completely fine.

lines.content: 太陽の時間の中で背負い込んだ“イヤなこと”は全部、真っ暗な“夜”の中に捨てていけばいいのだと。
lines.translated: She says you can just throw away all the "bad things" you burdened yourself with during the time of the sun into the pitch-black "Night."

lines.content: どうしようもなくイヤなことがあった日も、いつもより早く眠ってしまえばなぜだか心がすっきりしているときがある――
lines.translated: Even on days when something hopelessly awful happens, there are times when going to sleep a little earlier than usual somehow leaves your heart feeling refreshed--

lines.content: そういうときはたいていの場合、ナナちゃんが列車を走らせて、きらきらまぶしい“夜”の旅に連れ出してくれている。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: Most of the time when that happens, it must be because Nana-chan is running her train and taking you out on a journey through the sparkling, dazzling "Night."

lines.content: だけど、まあ、本人はそんなことないって言うだろうけどね
lines.translated: "Though, well, she'd probably deny it if you asked her directly."

lines.content: ――俺たちの町の小さな神さまは、恥ずかしがり屋というか、ひねくれ者というのか。とにかく扱いづらいのだ。素直ではないのだ。
lines.translated: --Our town's little goddess is shy, or maybe just contrary. Either way, she's a handful. She's never honest with her feelings.

lines.content: そんな素直じゃない俺たちの神さまは、今回、“[ぬいぐるみ|悪夢]”を“夜”の中に連れ出した。
lines.translated: And this time, that dishonest little goddess of ours brought the "stuffed animal"--that nightmare--out into the "Night."
*That was one of her goals for tonight.*

lines.content: ただ“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”を“刻の終着駅”に運ぶだけならすぐに済むことだ。
lines.translated: If it were just a matter of carrying "that child" to the "Terminal Station of Time," it would have been over in no time.

lines.content: 今夜、“夜”の旅に俺たちを連れ出したのは……。
lines.translated: The reason she took us out on a journey through the "Night" tonight...

lines.content: もうひとり、ナナちゃんは“夜”に招待したい人物がいたからだろう。
lines.translated: Was probably because there was one other person Nana-chan wanted to invite into the "Night."

lines.content: ……ハル
lines.translated: "...Haru."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ナナちゃんが連れ出したかったのは“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”だけじゃない。君も一緒に連れて行きたかったんだよ。きっと
lines.translated: "That 'stuffed animal' child wasn't the only one Nana-chan wanted to take out tonight. I'm sure she wanted to bring you along, too."

lines.content: え？　私も、一緒に……？
lines.translated: "Eh? Me, too...?"

lines.content: ああ。……ハル
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Haru."

lines.content: 君は明日がすごい怖いと言っていたけれど……その言葉も、その気持ちも、ぜんぶナナちゃんはわかってるんじゃないのかな。はっきりとまでは言わないけれど……なんとなくね
lines.translated: "You said you were really scared of tomorrow... and I think Nana-chan understands all of those words and feelings of yours. Maybe not down to the exact details, but... in a general way."

lines.content: ……だから“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”と一緒に“夜”の中に連れ出して……色々な夢の中を旅したりして、ハルにも勇気をあげたかったんじゃあないかなって、俺は勝手に想像してるんだ
lines.translated: "...So I can't help imagining that she brought you out into the 'Night' alongside 'that child'... to travel through all kinds of dreams and give you some courage, too."

lines.content: ナナちゃんだって人見知りだ。それをちょっと無理をして、珍しく一緒にトランプをしてくれたりもしたのだろう。
lines.translated: Nana-chan is shy around people herself. She probably pushed herself a little to do something as rare as playing cards with us.

lines.content: きっとハルの中にある、“明日がうまくいきますように”っていうどきどきを、今夜の中に捨てて行けばいい、とか
lines.translated: "She probably figured you could toss that pounding anxiety inside you--that wish for tomorrow to go well--out into tonight."

lines.content: そうでなくても、ちょっとだけでも元気になってくれたらいいな、とか。あの神さまはそんなふうに思ってるんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Or even if not that, she probably hoped it would cheer you up at least a little. I think that's how that goddess feels."

lines.content: ただ俺が“そうだったらいいなあ”と、勝手に思ってるだけだけど。
lines.translated: Though that's just me selfishly thinking, "It sure would be nice if that were true."

lines.content: ハルは目をぱちくりとしていた。
lines.translated: Haru blinked in surprise.

lines.content: そしてまた胸元にそっと、触れる。
lines.translated: Then, she gently touched her chest again.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 今はこうして大雅くんが側にいてくれるけど……。でも、明日は転校生として、私ひとりで色々がんばらなきゃならない
lines.translated: "Right now, you're here by my side like this... But tomorrow, I'll have to do my best at all sorts of things all by myself as a transfer student."

lines.content: そうだね。応援してるけど、直接何かできるわけでもない。ハルが自分でがんばらないとだ
lines.translated: "True. I'm rooting for you, but it's not like I can do anything directly. You'll have to do your best on your own, Haru."

lines.content: ……うん。どうかな。私、明日はちゃんと……上手く、できるかな
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I wonder. Will I really be able to... do well tomorrow?"

lines.content: どうだろう……いや。無責任なことを言ってしまうけど、大丈夫だよ
lines.translated: "Who knows... No. This might sound irresponsible of me to say, but you'll be fine."

lines.content: そう、かな
lines.translated: "You... think so?"

lines.content: ああ。絶対だ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Definitely."

lines.content: 絶対？　絶対なの……？
lines.translated: "Definitely? Really, definitely...?"

lines.content: ああ。絶対の絶対だ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Definitely, positively."

lines.content: 俺は笑う。
lines.translated: I smiled.

lines.content: だって君には、君にやさしくしたいと願ってる神さまがついてるし……それに
lines.translated: "Because you have a goddess on your side who wants to be kind to you... and besides..."

lines.content: それに？
lines.translated: "And besides?"

lines.content: ……ああ、それにさ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, besides..."

lines.content: あんなにかわいい神さまが助けてあげたいと願った……のかもしれない女の子のことを
lines.translated: "When there's a girl whom such a cute goddess wished to help out... or maybe wished to help out..."

lines.content: “まあがんばれよー”だとか、そんな軽々しいことだけ言って見捨てられるわけがない。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "There's no way I could just brush her off with a flippant 'Well, good luck!' and abandon her. Right?"

lines.content: だから、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "So," I said.

lines.content: だからさ、ハル。明日は一緒にがんばろう
lines.translated: "So, Haru. Let's do our best together tomorrow."

lines.content: ……一緒に？
lines.translated: "...Together?"

lines.content: ああ、一緒に
lines.translated: "Yeah, together."

lines.content: 明日、転校生としてみんなの前に現れる柊ハルが、十年前と変わらない笑顔でいられるよう。みんなの前でうまく振る舞えるように、ふたりで一緒に、がんばろう
lines.translated: "So that the Hiiragi Haru who appears in front of everyone as a transfer student tomorrow can wear the same smile she did ten years ago. Let's do our best together, the two of us, so you can act natural in front of everyone."

lines.content: ……たとえば、どんなふうに？
lines.translated: "...Like how, for example?"

lines.content: 首を傾げるハルに俺は言う。うう～ん、そうだなあ、と腕を組みながら。
lines.translated: As Haru tilted her head, I crossed my arms and went, "Hmm, let's see..."

lines.content: もしもひとりが不安なら……俺も一緒に転校生になるとか？
lines.translated: "If you're anxious about doing it alone... how about I become a transfer student with you?"

lines.content: ええ～、そんなの無理だよ。……たぶん
lines.translated: "Ehh~, there's no way you can do that. ...Probably."

lines.content: じゃあ、そうだなあ
lines.translated: "Then, let's see..."

lines.content: ハルが教室に来るまでに俺が何か問題起こしてさ、転校生どころじゃない雰囲気にしてしまうのはどうかな
lines.translated: "What if I cause some kind of trouble before you get to the classroom, creating an atmosphere where no one even cares about a transfer student?"

lines.content: ……どんな騒ぎなの？
lines.translated: "...What kind of commotion?"

lines.content: “俺はちゃんと女の子が好きなんだよ智仁とはそんな変な関係じゃないんだ”ってひよちゃんに詰め寄るとか。そんな感じで
lines.translated: "Like cornering Hiyo-chan and insisting, 'I properly like girls, okay?! Me and Tomohito don't have a weird relationship like that!' Something along those lines."

lines.content: なにそれ。どういうことなの
lines.translated: "What is that? What does that even mean?"

lines.content: あきれたような顔をして笑うハルだけれど、そこで何かに気づいたみたいに目を丸くする。
lines.translated: Haru laughed with an exasperated look on her face, but then her eyes went wide as if she had just realized something.

lines.content: え？　もしかして……大雅くん
lines.translated: "Eh? Could it be... Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: ……もしかして、私と大雅くんは同じクラスなの？
lines.translated: "...Could it be that you and I are in the same class, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: みたいだね。そう聞いてるよ
lines.translated: "Looks like it. That's what I heard."

lines.content: 明日、ハル以外の転校生がやって来るとか、そんな偶然がもしもあるのならちょっとよくわからなくなってはくるけれど
lines.translated: "Though if there's some crazy coincidence where another transfer student besides you shows up tomorrow, then I wouldn't really know for sure."

lines.content: そっか。そう、なんだ。大雅くんと同じクラスなんだ
lines.translated: "I see. So that's how it is. I'm in the same class as you, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: そうつぶやくとハルはうつむいた。
lines.translated: Muttering that, Haru looked down.

lines.content: さっきまで笑顔だった口元を引き締めている。
lines.translated: Her lips, which had been smiling just a moment ago, pressed together tightly.

lines.content: ハル？
lines.translated: "Haru?"

lines.content: 名前を呼んでみた。
lines.translated: I tried calling her name.

lines.content: だけど反応はない。
lines.translated: But there was no response.

lines.content: ……ちょっとだけ不安になる。
lines.translated: It made me a little anxious.

lines.content: もう一度、ハルの名前を呼ぼうかとしたところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was about to call Haru's name again...

lines.content: ……おかしい
lines.translated: "...That's strange."

lines.content: ぽつりと、ハルは言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Haru murmured softly.

lines.content: ……なんだか変だね
lines.translated: "...It feels kind of weird."

lines.content: なんだか、私……明日のことが、ううん、明日からのことが少しだけ、楽しみになってきたかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "Somehow, I... I think I might actually be looking forward to tomorrow--no, to everything starting tomorrow, just a little bit."

lines.content: 顔を上げ、笑う――照れ笑いのような笑顔だった。
lines.translated: She raised her head and smiled--a bashful, sheepish sort of smile.

lines.content: 私って簡単な子だよね。……ううん。[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|思][・|え][・|る][・|の][・|も]、もしかしたらナナちゃんが元気をくれたおかげなのかな
lines.translated: "I'm such a simple girl, aren't I? ...No. Maybe *the reason I can feel this way* is because Nana-chan cheered me up."

lines.content: そして色々と複雑な内面を取り繕おうとしているかのように、ハルは続けて、言うのだった。
lines.translated: And then, as if trying to smooth over the complicated feelings inside her, Haru continued speaking.

lines.content: 今夜は色々なことがあったよね
lines.translated: "A lot sure happened tonight, huh?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really did."

lines.content: 四人でトランプしてみたり
lines.translated: "Like the four of us playing cards."

lines.content: たくさんの夢の中を、“[願い|手紙]”を探して回ったり
lines.translated: "And going around through all those dreams, searching for 'letters' full of wishes."

lines.content: 大雅くんが大きなサメに食べられちゃいそうになったり
lines.translated: "And you almost getting eaten by a giant shark, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……そのことはどうか忘れてやってくれないかな
lines.translated: "...Could you please do me a favor and forget about that part?"

lines.content: あはは、ううん。忘れないよ。絶対
lines.translated: "Ahaha, nope. I won't forget. Never ever."

lines.content: ええ
lines.translated: "Aw, come on."

lines.content: ひどいなあと唇を尖らせた俺に、ハルは笑顔でこう言った。
lines.translated: As I pouted and thought about how mean she was being, Haru gave me a bright smile and said:

lines.content: 今夜……大雅くんと、十夜と、そしてナナちゃんや“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”と一緒に冒険したことを忘れず覚えていられたら……きっと、きっとね
lines.translated: "If I can just hold onto the memories of our adventure tonight... with you, Toya, Nana-chan, and 'that child,' without forgetting... then I'm sure, I'm really sure..."

lines.content: うん。明日はきっと、なんだかいい日になりそう。そんな気がするんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm sure tomorrow will turn out to be a really good day. I just have that feeling."

lines.content: そして、ハルは『えへへ』とはにかみ、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: With a bashful "Ehehe," Haru stood up.

lines.content: ん～……とう！
lines.translated: "Nnn~... Hah!"
Wait.

lines.content: 大きく片手を振りかぶり、何かを夜空に向かって投げたのだった。
lines.translated: Winding her arm way back, she threw something toward the night sky.

lines.content: しかしそこには何もなかった。
lines.translated: However, there was nothing there.

lines.content: ただきらきら光る夜の空が、どこまでも広くあるだけだ。
lines.translated: Only the sparkling night sky, stretching out endlessly.

lines.content: えっと、弱気な自分を投げちゃうイメージで……？
lines.translated: "Um, I was picturing myself throwing away my timid side...?"

lines.content: 首を傾げている俺に、ハルは苦笑いを浮かべて振り向いた。
lines.translated: As I tilted my head in confusion, Haru turned back to me with a wry smile.

lines.content: 俺は、夜空を見た。
lines.translated: I looked up at the night sky.

lines.content: 目に見えないハルの弱気はどこへ行くのか。
lines.translated: Wondering where Haru's invisible timidity would go.

lines.content: ……そんなことを思ったのかどうかは、自分でもよくわからない。
lines.translated: Even I didn't really know if that was what was going through my head.

lines.content: だが、とにかく夜空を見たのだ。
lines.translated: Regardless, I looked up at the night sky.

lines.content: あ……っ
――ハルが小さな声をあげた。
lines.translated: --Haru let out a small gasp.

lines.content: 遠い海の向こうで何かが飛びあがった。
lines.translated: Far across the distant sea, something leaped into the air.

lines.content: 波飛沫を巻き上げ空へ飛び出したのは、大きなサメだった。
lines.translated: Kicking up a spray of waves as it burst into the sky was a giant shark.

lines.content: 夢の中で忘れたい思い出を食べていた、そして俺のことまで食べようとした、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]だ。
lines.translated: *That thing*--the one that ate memories people wanted to forget in their dreams, and had even tried to eat me.

lines.content: サメは高く、大きく、“夜”の空を飛びあがり――
lines.translated: The shark leaped high and grand into the sky of the "Night"--

lines.content: そしてゆっくりと、弧を描き――
lines.translated: Slowly tracing an arc--

lines.content: 暗闇にぽっかり淡い光りを浮かべる満月に、その巨体をシルエットのようにして映し――
lines.translated: Casting its massive body as a silhouette against the full moon floating with a pale light in the darkness--

lines.content: ざぶん、と。
lines.translated: *Splash.*

lines.content: 派手に飛沫を広げて、着水。
lines.translated: It hit the water, sending up a massive spray.

lines.content: 海の中に戻っていった。
lines.translated: Then it disappeared back into the sea.

lines.content: その様子を俺たちは眺めた。
lines.translated: The two of us stood there, watching it go.

lines.content: そしてハルは指をさし、『もしかして』と言った。
lines.translated: Then Haru pointed out at the water and murmured, "Do you think..."

lines.content: もしかして、私の弱気、食べてくれたのかな……？
lines.translated: "Do you think maybe it ate my timid side for me...?"

lines.content: そうかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe it did.

lines.content: そういうことがあっても悪くはない。
lines.translated: Having something like that happen wouldn't be so bad.

lines.content: そう思えたことに俺は、[・|俺][・|自][・|身][・|に]、どこか安心してしまっていた。
lines.translated: Being able to think that way made me feel strangely relieved about *myself*.

lines.content: ――ぽつり。ぽつり。
lines.translated: --Pitter. Patter.

lines.content: 雨が、降る。
lines.translated: Rain began to fall.

lines.content: そしてそれは瞬く間に大振りになる――
lines.translated: And in the blink of an eye, it turned into heavy drops--

lines.content: て、おいおいっ
lines.translated: "W-Whoa, hey!"

lines.content: ――大振りどころか土砂降りになってしまった。
lines.translated: --More than just heavy drops, it had turned into a complete downpour.

lines.content: う、うわぁ～……っ、びしゃびしゃだよっ
lines.translated: "U-Uwaaah~...! We're getting soaked!"

lines.content: 列車の屋根によじ登っていた俺たちだ。
lines.translated: We were still up on the roof of the train, where we had climbed earlier.

lines.content: 急いで車内に戻ろうとした。
lines.translated: We hurried to get back inside the car.

lines.content: ふたりとも、早く戻って
lines.translated: "Both of you, hurry back inside."

lines.content: すぐ真下の窓が開かれ、そこから顔を出したナナちゃんが言った。
lines.translated: A window right below us slid open, and Nana-chan poked her head out and called to us.

lines.content: また、波が来るよ。急いで帰ろう。飲み込まれたりしたら大変だ
lines.translated: "Another wave is coming. Let's hurry and head back. It'll be terrible if we get swallowed up."

lines.content: どうやらこの雨は、サメが巻き上げた飛沫が降り注いできていたものらしかった。こんなところまで届くだなんて……。さすがは“夜”だ。夢の中だ。
lines.translated: Apparently, this rain was actually the spray kicked up by the shark falling back down on us. To think it would reach all the way over here... What else would you expect from the "Night"? From inside a dream?

lines.content: 急いで列車に戻る。
lines.translated: We scrambled back into the train.

lines.content: 俺たちが席についたとほぼ同時に、列車は走り始めた――それぞれの夜明けに向かって。それぞれが夢見るための寝床に向かって。
lines.translated: Almost the exact moment we took our seats, the train began to run--heading toward each of our dawns. Toward the beds where each of us would dream.

lines.content: がたん、ごとん、と。
lines.translated: Clickety-clack, clickety-clack.

lines.content: まるで心地よい揺りかごの中みたいな列車の中。
lines.translated: Inside the train, it felt just like being rocked in a comfortable cradle.

lines.content: ……ハルがナナちゃんに、
lines.translated: Haru turned to Nana-chan.

lines.content: 今夜はありがとう。すごく、すっごく、楽しかったよ
lines.translated: "Thank you for tonight. It was really, truly so much fun."

lines.content: と、そう伝え、
lines.translated: She told her that, and...

lines.content: ……別に
lines.translated: "...Not really."

lines.content: ハルからお礼を言われることなんて、何もない
lines.translated: "There's nothing for you to thank me for, Haru."
Wait.

lines.content: まるで俺のかわいい小さな友だちみたいなことをナナちゃんは言いながら、そっぽを向く――そんなふたりのことを、見届けて。
lines.translated: Saying something that sounded just like my own cute little friend, Nana-chan looked away--and I watched the two of them interact like that.

lines.content: 私もお手紙書いて枕の下に置いて眠ったら、ねえ、ナナちゃん。私のお願いも叶えてくれるのかな
lines.translated: "Hey, Nana-chan... If I write a letter and put it under my pillow before going to sleep, will you grant my wish too?"

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。場合によっては、そういうこともあるかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. Depending on the situation, something like that might happen."

lines.content: ふたりがちょっと楽しそうに話してるその声を、聞きながら。
lines.translated: Listening to the sound of their voices as they chatted somewhat happily...

lines.content: 俺は少しの間だけ眠ろうと、ひとり、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じるのだった。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids by myself, trying to get just a little bit of sleep.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”へ戻った。
lines.translated: We returned to the "Dream Bed."

lines.content: 今夜は“夜”の中でたくさんの時間を過ごしすぎた。
lines.translated: Tonight, we had spent way too much time inside the "Night."

lines.content: 誰もが疲労を隠せない。
lines.translated: None of us could hide our exhaustion.

lines.content: 遊びたがりの十夜も、帰宅するなり、
lines.translated: Even Toya, who normally always wanted to play, said as soon as we got home:

lines.content: ……ふたりとも、おやすみなさい
lines.translated: "...Goodnight, you two."

lines.content: ぺこりと小さな頭を下げて……、
lines.translated: She gave a little bow with her small head...

lines.content: 眠たくっても、疲れちゃってても……歯みがき忘れちゃ、だめなんだよ……？　これはね、いい子のお約束なんだよ
lines.translated: "Even if you're sleepy, or all tired out... you mustn't forget to brush your teeth, okay...? That's a promise for good kids."

lines.content: 眠たい頭をふらふらさせながらそう言うと、お姉ちゃんと一緒の寝室に向かって行った。
lines.translated: Saying that as her sleepy head swayed back and forth, she headed toward the bedroom she shared with her big sister.

lines.content: 俺とハルは苦笑いで顔を見合わせ、
lines.translated: Haru and I exchanged wry smiles.

lines.content: ハル。もう歯は磨いた？
lines.translated: "Haru. Did you brush your teeth yet?"

lines.content: うん。あさひさんが新しい歯ブラシをくれたから
lines.translated: "Yep. Asahi-san gave me a new toothbrush."

lines.content: 白い歯を見せにっこりしていた。
lines.translated: She grinned, showing off her white teeth.

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: うん。そうなんだよ。寝る準備はばっちりなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yep, that's right. I'm completely ready for bed."

lines.content: ハルはうなずき、
lines.translated: Haru nodded.

lines.content: 今夜は私も一緒にお泊まりなんだね。施設には外出届も出してるし、そこら辺はばっちりだよ。だけど……なんだかちょっとだけ、不思議な気分
lines.translated: "I'm staying over here with everyone tonight, huh? I already submitted an overnight request to the facility, so all of that is totally fine. Still... it feels just a little bit strange."

lines.content: はにかむように笑ったかと思えば、もじもじとする。
lines.translated: One moment she was smiling bashfully, and the next she was fidgeting.

lines.content: おやすみ、ハル。また明日
lines.translated: "Goodnight, Haru. See you tomorrow."

lines.content: うん。こちらこそおやすみだよ、大雅くん。また明日だね。……いい夢見れたら、すてきだね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Goodnight to you too, Taiga-kun. See you tomorrow. ...It'd be wonderful if we could have sweet dreams, huh?"

lines.content: ついさっきまで夢みたいな夢を、夢の中で、見てきたばかりだけどね
lines.translated: "Even though we were just having a dreamlike dream inside a dream until a little while ago."

lines.content: あはは。なあにそれ。眠たい頭の中がこんがらがってふわふわしちゃいそうだよ
lines.translated: "Ahaha. What does that even mean? My sleepy head is going to get all tangled up and floaty."

lines.content: そんな程度のあいさつで、手を振り、ハルと別れる――
lines.translated: With a brief exchange like that, we waved to each other and parted ways--

lines.content: これからも改めてよろしくね、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Here's to getting along from now on, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 明日からは転校生として、同級生として、また仲良しな幼馴染みとして……色々たくさん、上手くいくように祈っていてくれたらうれしいな
lines.translated: "Starting tomorrow, as a transfer student, as a classmate, and as close childhood friends again... I'd be really happy if you prayed for lots and lots of things to go well for me."

lines.content: ――別れ際にそれだけ残し、そしてもう一度『おやすみなさい大雅くん』と笑顔で付け加え、ハルはあさひさんと十夜が眠る部屋に入っていった。
lines.translated: --Leaving just those words behind as we parted, she added one more "Goodnight, Taiga-kun" with a smile, and walked into the room where Asahi-san and Toya were sleeping.

lines.content: そんなハルの背中を見つめて思うのだ。
lines.translated: Staring at Haru's back, a thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: 今夜は三人一緒に眠るのか。
lines.translated: So the three of them are sleeping together tonight.

lines.content: ……俺は、ひとりか。
lines.translated: And I'm by myself, huh.

lines.content: ……なんて
lines.translated: "...Yeah, right."

lines.content: さみしがりにも程があろうというものだ。
lines.translated: There's a limit to how lonely a guy can get.

lines.content: やれやれと首を振り、俺も自室へと。
lines.translated: Shaking my head at myself, I headed back to my own room.

lines.content: 照明の落とされた部屋は薄暗い。
lines.translated: With the lights turned down, the room was dim.

lines.content: かち、かち、かち。
lines.translated: Tick, tick, tick.

lines.content: 時計の秒針が進むいくつもの音で満たされている。
lines.translated: It was filled with the overlapping sounds of advancing second hands.

lines.content: 今夜も夜の国で長く過ごした。通常ならば三時間も眠れない。
lines.translated: Tonight, too, I had spent a long time in the Country of Night. Normally, I wouldn't even be able to get three hours of sleep.

lines.content: だから今夜も時間を調整した。
lines.translated: So tonight, once again, I adjusted the time.

lines.content: 壁に掛けられた金色の懐中時計の秒針を四時間ほど戻してある。
lines.translated: I had wound the second hand of the golden pocket watch hanging on the wall back by about four hours.

lines.content: そうすることでこの“ゆめのねどこ”には、ぽっかりと、四時間の空白ができあがってしまう――外の世界とくらべて時間の経過が遅くなる。
lines.translated: By doing so, a gaping four-hour blank space was created inside this "Dream Bed"--making time pass slower here compared to the outside world.

lines.content: あるいはきっぱりと時間停止と言い切ってしまってもいい。
lines.translated: Or rather, you could flat-out call it stopping time.

lines.content: よって、作り上げた空白の四時間と、本来の三時間を合わせて、七時間ほどの睡眠時間を確保することができる。
lines.translated: Therefore, by combining the four-hour blank I created with the original three hours left, I could secure about seven hours of sleep.

lines.content: ……今夜はハルも“ゆめのねどこ”に泊まることになった。
lines.translated: Tonight, Haru had ended up staying over at the "Dream Bed" too.

lines.content: 明日は転校初日である。柊ハルにとって、どきどきの重大イベントである……らしい。
lines.translated: Tomorrow was her first day as a transfer student. For Hiiragi Haru, it was a heart-pounding, monumental event... apparently.

lines.content: 寝不足気味で立ち向かえるほど、実は過剰なまでの人見知りな彼女にとって、生やさしいイベントではないだろう。
lines.translated: For a girl as excessively shy around strangers as she actually was, it wouldn't be an easy event to face while running on a lack of sleep.

lines.content: そんな課題があろうとなかろうと――今夜は、あまりに“夜”で長い時間を過ごしすぎてしまったのも、事実。
lines.translated: Whether she had a challenge like that waiting for her or not--it was also a fact that we had spent way too much time in the "Night" tonight.

lines.content: どちらにせよ疲れを明日に残さないよう、睡眠時間を延ばさなければならなかった。
lines.translated: Either way, so we wouldn't carry our exhaustion over into tomorrow, I had to extend our sleeping hours.

lines.content: ……今夜はハルと同じ家で眠るのか
lines.translated: "...So I'm sleeping under the same roof as Haru tonight, huh?"

lines.content: 等と。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 口に出すとなんだかどきどきなイベント開始の合図のように思えなくもないけれど。
lines.translated: Saying it out loud made it sound kind of like the starting signal for some thrilling event, I suppose.

lines.content: だけど既に、何度も言っているように今夜はあまりに“夜の国”で過ごしすぎ……。
lines.translated: However, like I've already said so many times, we spent way too long in the "Country of Night" tonight...

lines.content: 時間も、体力も、言ってしまえば精神力でさえ、すり減らしにすり減らした一晩だったのだ。
lines.translated: It had been a night that whittled away our time, our stamina, and frankly, even our mental energy to the absolute bone.

lines.content: 何もどきどきするようなことは起こらない。
lines.translated: Nothing thrilling was going to happen.

lines.content: このまま静かに朝が来るのを待つだけだ。
lines.translated: I would just quietly wait for morning to come like this.

lines.content: それでいいし、それが、いいのだ。
lines.translated: That was fine, and that was how it should be.

lines.content: ごろりと俺は寝返りを打つ。
lines.translated: I rolled over in bed.

lines.content: 布団は昼間あさひさんが干してくれていたのだろう。
lines.translated: Asahi-san must have aired out the futon during the day.

lines.content: 柔らかく、ふわふわで……太陽の香りがした。
lines.translated: It was soft, fluffy... and smelled like the sun.

lines.content: 疲労は充分。ぽかぽか身体は暖かい。
lines.translated: I was plenty tired. My body was nice and warm.

lines.content: 本当なら、これだけで緩やかな眠りに誘われるには充分なのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Normally, this alone would be more than enough to lull me into a gentle sleep, and yet...

lines.content: ぞわり。
lines.translated: A cold shiver ran through me.

lines.content: 心の中に何かが芽吹いた。
lines.translated: Something sprouted inside my heart.

lines.content: 俺は、ため息をつく。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.
(...Again, huh?)

lines.content: 眠れない夜。
lines.translated: A sleepless night.

lines.content: 寝苦しい夜。
lines.translated: A restless night.

lines.content: いつもの夜。
lines.translated: A night just like always.

lines.content: 身体も心も酷使した一日だった。故に疲労していないはずがない。
lines.translated: It had been a day where I pushed both my body and mind to the limit. There was no way I wasn't exhausted.

lines.content: （……それでも今夜の俺が、眠れないその理由）
lines.translated: (...And yet, the reason I can't fall asleep tonight--)

lines.content: それはわかっていた。
lines.translated: I knew what it was.

lines.content: 思い巡らすまでもなくはっきりとしていた。
lines.translated: It was painfully obvious without me even having to mull it over.

lines.content: 俺は思い出しているのだ――今夜のことを。
lines.translated: I was remembering--remembering what happened tonight.

lines.content: 俺は、自分に問いかけているのだ――今夜の“さよなら”についてのことを。
lines.translated: I was questioning myself--about tonight's "goodbye."

lines.content: そのようにして眠れぬ時間が、ちく、たく、ちく、たく、折り重なっていくその度に。
lines.translated: And every time the sleepless hours piled up like that, tick, tock, tick, tock...
(...I feel like...)

lines.content: 自分のことが、
lines.translated: I am someone,

lines.content: 更に、
lines.translated: even more,

lines.content: もっと、
lines.translated: much more,

lines.content: ……もっと、
lines.translated: so much more,

lines.content: 憎悪すべき者であるように、思えて――
lines.translated: worthy of my own hatred--

lines.content: ――ベルが鳴る。
lines.translated: --A bell rang.

lines.content: ハッとした。
lines.translated: I gasped.

lines.content: 鳴り続ける呼び出し音。
lines.translated: The ringtone kept chiming.

lines.content: その音に驚くほどきれいに、簡単に、さっぱりと……夜色の思考が切り離されてしまった。
lines.translated: That sound severed my night-colored thoughts with surprising, simple, refreshing ease.

lines.content: 俺は枕元に置いていた端末を急いで掴む。
lines.translated: I hurriedly grabbed the phone sitting by my pillow.

lines.content: 肌身離さず持っている端末だ。
lines.translated: It was a device I kept with me at all times.

lines.content: 夢の中にいようが。真昼の下であくびをしていようが。
lines.translated: Whether I was in the middle of a dream, or yawning under the midday sun.

lines.content: ……自分自身に嫌悪し眠れずにいようが。
lines.translated: Or lying awake, loathing myself.

lines.content: 決して。これだけは決して、なくさぬように……握りしめている。
lines.translated: Never. I clutched it tightly... determined never to lose this one thing.

lines.content: 俺はその通話ボタンを押した。
lines.translated: I pressed the call button.

lines.content: ……もしもし？
lines.translated: "...Hello?"

lines.content: 問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: 君の名前を、心の中で……囁く。
lines.translated: I whispered your name... inside my heart.

lines.content: 俺は瞳を閉じている。
lines.translated: My eyes were closed.

lines.content: そして、[まぶた|瞼]の裏に君の顔を思い浮かべようとした。
lines.translated: And I tried to picture your face behind my eyelids.

lines.content: 闇色にふわり浮かび上がるのは君の横顔。
lines.translated: Floating softly against the dark was your profile.

lines.content: 君は両手の指を、腰の辺りでもじもじと絡ませながら、
lines.translated: With the fingers of both hands fidgeting and intertwining around your waist...

lines.content: ……びっくりした
lines.translated: "...You surprised me."

lines.content: ぽつりと、君の声が唇から零れて落ちる。
lines.translated: Your voice quietly spilled from your lips.

lines.content: どうして？　と俺は問いかけたように思う。
lines.translated: "Why?" I think I asked.

lines.content: ……すぐに繋がったから、驚いた
lines.translated: "...It connected right away, so I was surprised."

lines.content: そうつぶやきながら、君が目をぱちぱちとさせているところまで、俺は鮮明に思い浮かべられていた。
lines.translated: I could vividly picture you blinking in surprise as you murmured that.

lines.content: ……あ、ああ
lines.translated: "...Ah, yeah."

lines.content: えっと
ちょうど電話をポケットから出そうかなってしていたときだったから……
lines.translated: "I was just about to take my phone out of my pocket, so..."

lines.content: そんな不要な嘘が咄嗟に零れた。
lines.translated: An unnecessary lie slipped out on the spot.

lines.content: つとめて、笑顔で。
lines.translated: Putting on a forced smile.

lines.content: ……クロには見えるはずもないのに。
lines.translated: Even though there was no way Kuro could see it.

lines.content: 沈黙。
lines.translated: Silence.

lines.content: 言いたいことがあるけれど、中々どうして、言い出せない――クロはもじもじと絡めた指を所在なさげに見つめている。
lines.translated: Wanting to say something, yet somehow unable to get the words out--Kuro was staring awkwardly at her fidgeting, intertwined fingers.

lines.content: そんなクロの姿を、俺は身勝手に想像してしまっていた。
lines.translated: I was selfishly imagining her looking like that.

lines.content: どうしたの？
lines.translated: "What's wrong?"

lines.content: 俺は改めて問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked again.

lines.content: ……何か、あったの？
lines.translated: "...Did something happen?"

lines.content: においがした
lines.translated: "I smelled a scent."

lines.content: え？　におい？
lines.translated: "Huh? A scent?"

lines.content: 眠れない子の、においがしたから……
lines.translated: "I smelled the scent of a kid who couldn't sleep..."

lines.content: だから電話を、かけてみた。それだけ
lines.translated: "So I tried calling. That's all."

lines.content: ……それだけ、だよ？
lines.translated: "...That's really all, okay?"

lines.content: そっか。それだけ、か
lines.translated: "I see. That's all, huh?"

lines.content: 思わず口元が緩んでしまった。
lines.translated: A smile inadvertently tugged at the corners of my mouth.

lines.content: ……別に
lines.translated: "...Not really."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 別に、大雅のことが心配だとか。そんなことを思っていたわけじゃ、なくて……
lines.translated: "It's not like I was worried about you, Taiga. I wasn't thinking anything like that..."

lines.content: 眠れないのはつらいから。楽しい夢を見つけられないのは、悲しいから。大雅じゃなくても、誰でもみんな、大変だから。だから……わたしは……
lines.translated: "It's just hard not being able to sleep. And it's sad not being able to find a happy dream. Even if it wasn't you, Taiga, it's tough on anyone. So... I..."

lines.content: はは
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: 苦笑い――
lines.translated: A wry smile--

lines.content: 『まるでツンデレのお約束みたいなせりふだ』
lines.translated: "That sounds like a textbook tsundere line."

lines.content: とか。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 『そういうの。なんだか久しぶりに聞いた気がするなあ』
lines.translated: "Feels like it's been a while since I heard something like that."

lines.content: だとか。
lines.translated: Things like that.

lines.content: 『この頃はフィクションでも滅多にお目にかかれないのに』
lines.translated: "You rarely even see it in fiction these days."

lines.content: ――そんな軽口を笑顔で、明るく、言ってしまいたかった。
lines.translated: --I wanted to toss out playful banter like that, brightly and with a smile.

lines.content: だけど俺は。
lines.translated: However, I...

lines.content: 実際の、俺は。
lines.translated: The real me...

lines.content: 沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: Fell silent.

lines.content: 俺は君の言葉になんと言って返したらいいのだろう。
lines.translated: What was I supposed to say in response to your words?

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: どんな言葉を君に返したいと、俺は思っているのだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of words did I even want to give back to you?

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: わからなくなってしまった。何も。何ひとつ。
lines.translated: I didn't know anymore. Nothing. Not a single thing.

lines.content: この世界にはわからないことばかりが溢れている。自分の心といわず。世界に散らばる言葉といわず。
lines.translated: This world is overflowing with things I don't understand. Not just my own heart, and not just the words scattered across the world.

lines.content: そんな俺に、今度は君が、
lines.translated: And to me, in that state, you were the one who...

lines.content: ……大雅。何か、あったの？
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Did something happen?"

lines.content: と、そう囁いた。
lines.translated: whispered that.

lines.content: 今夜、大雅は列車で“夜の向こう”に出かけていった
lines.translated: "Tonight, you took the train out 'beyond the night,' Taiga."

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 俺は今夜、どんなことがあったのかを簡単に、クロに語った。
lines.translated: I briefly told Kuro about what had happened tonight.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの列車で子どもたちの“[手紙|願い]”を回収した。
lines.translated: How we collected the children's "wishes" on Nana-chan's train.

lines.content: 昨晩誰かの心の中から切り取った“[悪夢|ぬいぐるみ]”と一緒に、たくさんの夜の中を渡り歩いて……“刻の終着駅”を目指し、そこでさよならをした。
lines.translated: How we walked across many nights with the "stuffed animal" cut from someone's heart last night... heading for the "Terminal of Time," and said our goodbyes there.

lines.content: その帰り道にはハルとふたりで話したことも俺はクロに報告した。
lines.translated: I also reported to Kuro about the talk Haru and I had on the way back.

lines.content: ……迷惑、だった？
lines.translated: "...Was I a bother?"

lines.content: え？　迷惑……？
lines.translated: "Huh? A bother...?"

lines.content: なぜそのような話に？
lines.translated: Where did that come from?

lines.content: ……大雅、少し元気ない。だからお電話……今夜は、しないほうがよかったのかな
lines.translated: "...You sound a little down, Taiga. So maybe... I shouldn't have called tonight."

lines.content: いつもの素っ気ないふうな声だった。
lines.translated: It was her usual curt-sounding voice.

lines.content: だけど、その声には確かな不安がぽつりと落とされていて……驚く。驚いてしまう。
lines.translated: However, there was a distinct drop of anxiety in that voice... and it surprised me. It really surprised me.

lines.content: 電話越しの君はいつもとは違う。ほんの少しだけ、素直になってくれる。
lines.translated: Over the phone, you're different from usual. You become just a little bit more honest with me.

lines.content: その理由はわからない。いつの間にかそういうふうになっていた。……いや。明確な[わけ|理由]なんてないのかもしれない。
lines.translated: I don't know the reason why. Before I knew it, things had just turned out that way. ...No, maybe there isn't any clear reason at all.

lines.content: ただ面と向かって人と話すのが苦手だという、苦手になってしまったのだという、小さな彼女の中の人見知りをこじらせてしまった結果であるのかも、しれない。
lines.translated: Maybe it's just the result of the shyness inside her little self getting the better of her, since she's bad--or rather, has become bad--at talking to people face-to-face.

lines.content: それでも俺の中には『……小さなころはいろいろ話してくれたのになあ』とか、『つんとそっぽを向くよりも、そっと微笑みかけてくれることも、多かったんだけど……』とか。
lines.translated: Even so, thoughts like, "...You used to talk to me about all sorts of things when we were little," or, "You used to smile gently at me much more often than turning away in a huff..."

lines.content: そんな思いが変わらず残ってはいるけれど……、
lines.translated: Feelings like that still remain unchanged inside me, though...

lines.content: なあ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: 俺は、君の名を呼ぶ。
lines.translated: I called your name.

lines.content: うん。なに、大雅
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: 君も俺の名を呼び返す。
lines.translated: You called my name back.

lines.content: もう、こんな夜も遅い時間だけれど……少しだけでいい。話を、聞いてもらってもいいかな
lines.translated: "I know it's already so late at night, but... just for a little bit is fine. Would you mind listening to me talk?"

lines.content: 話？
lines.translated: "Talk?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: どんな話？
lines.translated: "About what?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: それは懺悔みたいなものだと俺は伝えた。
lines.translated: I told her it was something like a confession of sins.

lines.content: 眠れないのはきっと、心の中に言葉がいっぱい込み合っていて、ずっしり重くなってしまっているからだと思うから、と。
lines.translated: That the reason I couldn't sleep was probably because my heart was so crowded with words that it had grown heavy and weighed down.

lines.content: 別に……、構わない。話を聞くくらいなら
lines.translated: "I don't... really mind. If it's just listening to you talk."

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: どうしたの、と君の声。
lines.translated: "What's wrong?" your voice seemed to ask.

lines.content: 話があるんじゃ、なかったの……かな
lines.translated: "Didn't you... have something to tell me?"

lines.content: ああ。クロ……今夜の俺はさ、君に、ひどく面倒なことを聞かせてしまうかもしれない
lines.translated: "Yeah. Kuro... tonight, I might end up making you listen to something terribly tiresome."

lines.content: それでも、構わない？
lines.translated: "Is that still okay?"

lines.content: 構わない
lines.translated: "I don't mind."

lines.content: きっぱりとクロは言った。
lines.translated: Kuro said flatly.

lines.content: わたしはそのために電話をかけてる。だから、平気。構わない
lines.translated: "That's why I'm calling you. So it's fine. I don't mind."

lines.content: だから、さあ、話してみるといい。とクロは言う。
lines.translated: "So go ahead and tell me," Kuro said.

lines.content: どんなにひどい話なのか、どんなにか面倒な話を聞かされてしまうのかは、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: She didn't know how awful a story it might be, or how tiresome a tale she was about to be forced to listen to, and yet...

lines.content: それで今夜の大雅が、少しでも眠れるようになるのなら……わたしは、構わないんだ
lines.translated: "If it helps you get even a little bit of sleep tonight, Taiga... then I don't mind."

lines.content: 俺はベッドの中で少し身体の位置を変えてみた。
lines.translated: I shifted my position slightly in bed.

lines.content: 春先だから毛布一枚で事足りる。冷たくもないし暖かくもない。
lines.translated: Since it was early spring, a single blanket was enough. It was neither cold nor warm.

lines.content: そんな現実的な感触の寝床に、すっぽりと顔を沈めて……、深呼吸。
lines.translated: Sinking my face completely into a bed that felt so grounded in reality... I took a deep breath.

lines.content: ……俺は、最悪だった
lines.translated: "...I was the worst."

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: どうして、そんなことを思うのかな
lines.translated: "Why do you think that?"

lines.content: 闇の中に小さく響いたその声を頼りに、もう一度、君の顔を思い浮かべ――俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: Relying on that voice echoing faintly in the darkness, I pictured your face once more--and nodded.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 今夜はあの子を……“ぬいぐるみ”のあの子のことを、“刻の終着駅”にまで送り届けた
lines.translated: "Tonight, we saw that girl... that 'stuffed animal' girl, all the way to the 'Terminal of Time.'"

lines.content: ハルも。十夜も。ナナちゃんも。きっと、あさひさんもだ。皆みんな“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”を哀れんだ。かわいそうな子の幸せを願っていた
lines.translated: "Haru. Toya. Nana-chan. And surely Asahi-san, too. Every single one of them pitied 'that stuffed animal.' They all wished for that poor girl's happiness."

lines.content: だが、俺は……。
lines.translated: But I...

lines.content: ……俺は、そう、できなかった
lines.translated: "...I couldn't do that."

lines.content: つぶやいた途端――胸が、心が、冷たくなった。
lines.translated: The moment I muttered it--my chest, my heart, grew cold.

lines.content: 吐き出した自分の言葉が氷のようだと、思った。
lines.translated: The words I spat out felt just like ice.

lines.content: あの子に対して……
lines.translated: "Toward that girl..."

lines.content: さみしそうな、悲しそうな、つらそうな……そんな“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”に対して、何ひとつ、心動かされなかったんだよ、俺は
lines.translated: "Toward 'that stuffed animal' who looked so lonely, so sad, and in so much pain... my heart wasn't moved a single bit."

lines.content: みんなが遠ざかっていく列車に挙って手を振っていたあの光景……。
lines.translated: That sight of everyone waving their hands together at the departing train...
Some part of me was completely detached.
That girl and I are all too alike.

lines.content: そう思えば、余計にだ。
lines.translated: Thinking that only made it worse.

lines.content: ……ひとつ、言い訳をしたい
lines.translated: "...I want to make one excuse."

lines.content: 誰に？
lines.translated: To whom?

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: とにかく取り繕わせてもらいたい――そのための、一言だ。
lines.translated: I just wanted to gloss things over somehow--these words were for that sake alone.

lines.content: ……人は誰しも心の中に“夜”がある
lines.translated: "...Everyone has 'night' inside their hearts."

lines.content: あの“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”の持ち主だってそうだった
lines.translated: "It was the same for the owner of 'that stuffed animal.'"

lines.content: ……両親に捨てられた
lines.translated: "...Abandoned by her parents."

lines.content: 愛されなかった
lines.translated: "Unloved."

lines.content: 欲しくて欲しくてたまらない[もの|愛]を簡単に手に入れてしまう誰かのことが妬ましかった
lines.translated: "Envious of someone who so easily obtained the love she wanted so desperately."

lines.content: ……そこは私の場所だったのにとひとりで泣いた
lines.translated: "...Crying all alone, thinking that was supposed to be her place."

lines.content: その度にあの子の“夜”は大きく育った。
lines.translated: Each time, that girl's "night" grew larger.

lines.content: いくら泣いても。叫んでも。私はここだと祈っても。
lines.translated: No matter how much she cried. No matter how much she screamed. No matter how much she prayed, saying, "I'm right here."

lines.content: ……無駄なのだ。
lines.translated: It was all useless.

lines.content: 誰も『大丈夫だよ』と言って頭に、頬に、ずきずき痛むお腹に、やさしく触れようとはしてくれない。
lines.translated: No one would tell her "It's okay" and gently try to touch her head, her cheek, or her throbbing stomach.

lines.content: 苦しかった。悲しかった。さみしかった。……死んで、しまいたかった
lines.translated: "It was painful. It was sad. It was lonely. ...She wanted to die."

lines.content: ……そんな“夜”が渦巻く誰かの心の中に、ぽつりと生まれた、小さな悪夢……“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”だ
lines.translated: "...Inside someone's heart where such a 'night' swirled, a tiny nightmare was quietly born... and that was 'that stuffed animal.'"

lines.content: “[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”は“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”の持ち主である女の子の、つらい気持ちを全部、ひとつのこらず肩代わりするために生み落とされ――“夜”の中でひとりさみしくボロボロに朽ちていた。
lines.translated: "That stuffed animal" was born to take on every single last bit of the painful feelings belonging to the girl who owned her--and was rotting away in tatters, all alone in the "night."

lines.content: そしてそのまま[さよならする|姿を消す]ことを決めたのだ。
lines.translated: And so, she decided to say goodbye and disappear just like that.

lines.content: 誰もが“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”のために涙を見せた――あるいは、“[悪夢|ぬいぐるみ]”を生み出すほどに苦しんだ少女のために。
lines.translated: Everyone showed tears for "that stuffed animal"--or perhaps, for the girl who suffered enough to give birth to a "nightmare."

lines.content: 普段は俺たちのことなど興味ないとばかりの態度を取るナナちゃんでさえ、本当は誰よりやさしい、意地っ張りな神さまでさえ。
lines.translated: Even Nana-chan, who usually acts as though she couldn't care less about us; even that stubborn god, who is sebenarnya kinder than anyone.

lines.content: だけど、俺は。
lines.translated: But I...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 俺は……俺の心は、みんなと違って、まったくの赤の他人のために悲しくなんてなれない
lines.translated: "I... Unlike everyone else, my heart can't feel sad for a complete and utter stranger."

lines.content: つい先日出会ってしまったばかりの“誰か”のために、どうしても……神妙にはなりきれないのだ。
lines.translated: For "someone" I only just met the other day, I simply... cannot bring myself to feel genuinely solemn.

lines.content: ましてや相手は“知らない誰か”の心の中に生じた心のかけらなのだ。
lines.translated: Much less when the other party is a fragment of a heart born inside the mind of "someone I don't even know."

lines.content: 通りすがりの赤の他人よりも更に“縁”は希薄だ。
lines.translated: My "connection" to her is even thinner than that of a stranger passing by on the street.

lines.content: 俺の心は歯車がひとつ、あるいはふたつ、みっつ、足りていない。
lines.translated: My heart is missing a gear, or two, or three.

lines.content: 足りていないからこそ俺は未だに“夜の国”の中で“魔法”を十全と扱うことができない。
lines.translated: It is precisely because they are missing that I still cannot fully wield "magic" within the "Land of Night."

lines.content: なぜなら俺たちが使える“魔法”は“想像力”であるからだ――“想像力”とは心の力だ。心の色だ。心の模様だ。
lines.translated: Because the "magic" we can use is "imagination"--and "imagination" is the power of the heart. The color of the heart. The pattern of the heart.

lines.content: それらが欠落してしまっている歴然とした証拠が、自身の未熟さとしていつも、いつでも、俺の目の前に立ちはだかっている。
lines.translated: The undeniable proof that those things are missing stands before my eyes always, at every moment, in the form of my own inadequacy.

lines.content: 本当は、クロ。俺はさ……海底のポストから“[手紙|願い]”を回収したときも
lines.translated: "The truth is, Kuro... even when we collected the 'wishes' from the mailbox at the bottom of the sea..."

lines.content: その手紙からふわりとこぼれた“誰か”の願いに、心で触れた、あのときも
lines.translated: "Even when my heart touched 'someone's' wish that softly spilled out from those letters..."

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: ……みんなが、“[あの子|ぬいぐるみ]”を見送ったそのときも
lines.translated: "...And even when everyone saw 'that stuffed animal' off..."

lines.content: 悲しんだり神妙なそぶりをして見せてはいたけれど……その実。
lines.translated: I put on an act of being sad and solemn... but in reality...

lines.content: 俺は、泣けなかったどころじゃない。たぶんほんの少しも、[・|し][・|ん][・|み][・|り]ともできなかった
lines.translated: "Not only could I not cry, I probably couldn't even feel the slightest bit solemn."

lines.content: そんなヘドロのような心の持ち主で、あるからこそ。
lines.translated: It's precisely because I possess a heart like sludge.

lines.content: 俺は……、
lines.translated: That I...

lines.content: ……俺はあなたを。
lines.translated: That toward you.
Toward all of you.

lines.content: 唇を噛みしめる。
lines.translated: I bit my lip.

lines.content: ……俺はいつも、自分のことばっかりだ
lines.translated: "...I'm always only thinking about myself."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|自][・|分]がつくづく嫌いだと感じてしまう。嫌いだから。憎いから。だからそんな[自分|ヤツ]の前からは逃げ出してしまいたいけど……。無論。そんなことは不可能だ。
lines.translated: I feel so thoroughly disgusted with this side of myself. Because I hate it. Because I despise it. That's why I want to run away from a guy like myself, and yet... Of course, something like that is impossible.

lines.content: ならばもう、この命を自ら手放すくらいしか、問題解決の方法はどこにもないのではないか……。
lines.translated: In that case, isn't letting go of this life with my own hands the only way left anywhere to solve the problem...?

lines.content: これ以上は何も言えない。
lines.translated: I couldn't say anything more than this.

lines.content: 今は、言えない。
lines.translated: Right now, I couldn't say it.

lines.content: 少しの沈黙。ちくたく、ちくたく、時計の音ばかりが耳に痛い。普段はまったく気にならない微かな音なのに。
lines.translated: A brief silence. Tick-tock, tick-tock--only the sound of the clock grated painfully on my ears. Even though it was a faint sound I normally wouldn't notice at all.

lines.content: でも
ふと、クロが言う。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……でも、大雅。知らない子のことを心から心配できないと、きみは、言うけど
lines.translated: "...But, Taiga. You say you can't truly worry about a girl you don't know..."

lines.content: 自分のことばかりを心配している自分のことが、きみは嫌いだと、そう言うけれど
lines.translated: "And you say you hate yourself for only ever worrying about yourself..."

lines.content: ……でも、大雅
lines.translated: "...Even so, Taiga."

lines.content: きみはハルのことを、本気で気にかけていたように……わたしには思えたよ
lines.translated: "To me... it seemed like you genuinely cared about Haru."

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”からの帰り道。
lines.translated: On the way back from the "Terminal of Time."

lines.content: ハルとふたりで夜空を見つめながら心について少しだけ、言葉を交換し合った。
lines.translated: While gazing up at the night sky together, Haru and I had exchanged just a few words about the heart.

lines.content: そのときのことを実際に見ていられたわたしじゃ、ないけれど……でも
lines.translated: "It's not as though I was actually there to see it happen... but still."

lines.content: 明日を怖がるハルに大丈夫だよって、大雅はそう言ったんだよね？　明日のハルが笑顔でいられたらいいなって、大雅はそう、思ったんだよね……？
lines.translated: "When Haru was afraid of tomorrow, you told her it would be okay, didn't you, Taiga? You wished that Haru would be able to smile tomorrow, didn't you...?"

lines.content: 知らない誰かのために本気で悩めなくても。大切な……大切だと思いたい友だちのためなら、一緒に、一生懸命、悩むことができる
lines.translated: "Even if you can't genuinely agonize over someone you don't know... for the sake of a precious friend--a friend you want to hold dear--you can agonize right alongside them with everything you have."

lines.content: ……今はそれで充分だって、わたしは思うよ
lines.translated: "...I think that's plenty for now."

lines.content: 今は……
lines.translated: "For now..."

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: 今はそれで、充分。むしろ上出来だってわたしは大雅にそう言いたい
lines.translated: "It's plenty for now. In fact, I want to tell you that you did more than well enough, Taiga."

lines.content: 俺は、沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: I fell silent.

lines.content: 驚いているのだ。とても、とても。
lines.translated: I was surprised. Truly, deeply surprised.

lines.content: いつもこうして電話で話すときは、少しだけ素直になってくれるクロだけれど……。
lines.translated: Whenever we talk on the phone like this, Kuro always becomes just a little bit more honest with me, and yet...

lines.content: それにしても今夜の君は饒舌だと感じてしまう。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't help feeling that you were unusually talkative tonight.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: クロとこうして話せるのは素直にうれしい。言いようのない安心感がある。
lines.translated: Being able to talk with Kuro like this made me genuinely happy. It gave me an indescribable sense of relief.

lines.content: それは、幼い頃のことを、小さな君よりももっとずっと小さかった頃のことを……。
lines.translated: Because it made me remember when we were little--when I was much, much smaller even than the tiny you are now...

lines.content: 列車にガタンゴトンと揺られながら、君に膝枕をしてもらい……心地よくうたた寝をしていたことを、思い出してしまうから。
lines.translated: Resting my head in your lap as the train clattered and swayed along... comfortably dozing off.

lines.content: ふと、君の言葉が途切れていたことに、気付く。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I realized your words had cut off.

lines.content: ……クロ？
lines.translated: "...Kuro?"

lines.content: 名前を呼ぶと、『ううう』、と小さな唸り声。
lines.translated: When I called her name, I heard a tiny groan: "Uuu..."

lines.content: クロ？　どうしたの？
lines.translated: "Kuro? What's wrong?"

lines.content: 何か、あったの……と、俺は焦りを覚える。
lines.translated: Did something happen...? A sense of panic washed over me.

lines.content: しかしクロは呼びかけに答えない――うううという唸り声。
lines.translated: However, Kuro didn't answer my call--only letting out another "Uuu..." groan.

lines.content: そして耳を澄ませば聞こえてくるのは、
lines.translated: And when I strained my ears, what I heard was...

lines.content: ……どうしよう
lines.translated: "...What do I do?"

lines.content: という、小さな、とても小さく微かな、クロのつぶやきだった。
lines.translated: It was a small, a very small and faint mutter from Kuro.

lines.content: ……大変
lines.translated: "...This is bad."

lines.content: ――ぽつりと一言、クロの声。
lines.translated: --A single murmured word in Kuro's voice.

lines.content: なぜだかどきりと、俺の心は小さく爆ぜる。
lines.translated: For some reason, my heart gave a sudden, tiny jolt.

lines.content: きょ、今日は、ちょっと……
lines.translated: "T-Today, I just..."

lines.content: 思いもよらずおどおどとした声が返ってくる。
lines.translated: Unexpectedly, a timid, flustered voice came back.

lines.content: ちょっと……その、……ううっ……色々
lines.translated: "Just... um... uuu... a lot of things."

lines.content: 色々？
lines.translated: "A lot of things?"

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: 色々、と……調子に乗って……話しすぎてしまった……かも
lines.translated: "A lot of things, like... getting carried away... and maybe talking a little too much..."

lines.content: もにょもにょと萎んでいく声だった。
lines.translated: Her voice trailed off into an embarrassed mumble, shrinking away.

lines.content: 息をのむ気配が伝わってきた。
lines.translated: I could hear her catch her breath.

lines.content: うー、とか。あ、ああ……とか。うっ、あっ、ああああ……っ、だとか。
lines.translated: Sounds like "Uuu..." and "A-Aaah..." and "Ugh, ah, aaaah..."

lines.content: 電話越しに聞こえてくるその声には。
lines.translated: Hearing her voice over the phone like that...

lines.content: ――頬を真っ赤に、
lines.translated: --Her cheeks bright red,

lines.content: ――両目は涙で潤み、
lines.translated: --Her eyes brimming with tears,

lines.content: ――小さな頭を抱えて悶えては、
lines.translated: --Clutching her little head in agony,

lines.content: ――ごろごろごろごろ、転げまわっている……。
lines.translated: --And rolling around and around on the floor...

lines.content: そんなクロの姿を思い浮かべ、俺は……、
lines.translated: Picturing Kuro acting like that, I...

lines.content: ……う、くっ
lines.translated: "...Pfft, kh."

lines.content: ……俺は思わず、笑う。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but laugh.

lines.content: 笑ってしまう。
lines.translated: It just slipped out.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]の裏に思い浮かべたクロの姿は、その様子は、本当の君とどれほど被っているのかはわからないけれど。
lines.translated: I didn't know how closely the image of Kuro behind my eyelids matched the real you, though.

lines.content: まるで的外れな妄想を、俺が勝手に思い浮かべてはニマニマしているだかだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: For all I knew, I was just grinning to myself over some completely off-the-mark delusion I'd conjured up...

lines.content: それでも俺は、頬がどうしようもなく緩むのを止められなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't stop my cheeks from breaking into a helpless smile.

lines.content: ……むぅ
目を細めたかのようなクロの声だ。
lines.translated: Kuro's voice sounded like she was narrowing her eyes at me.

lines.content: かわいい唸り声もぴたりと止まる。
lines.translated: Her cute little groans stopped dead in their tracks, too.

lines.content: ……今、笑ってる？
lines.translated: "...Are you laughing right now?"

lines.content: 何かを察したようにクロが言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Kuro asked, as if she had sensed something.

lines.content: 大雅。今、わたしのこと……笑った？
lines.translated: "Taiga. Did you just... laugh at me?"

lines.content: う、ううん。そんなこと、ないよ
lines.translated: "N-No. Not at all."

lines.content: ……うそ
lines.translated: "...Liar."

lines.content: ……大雅は、うそばっかりだ
lines.translated: "...You're always such a liar, Taiga."

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: 意地悪な大雅は、嫌いだな。眠れず弱気になってる大雅のほうが……少しだけ、かわいいくらい
lines.translated: "I don't like it when you're being mean, Taiga. You're... a little bit cuter when you can't sleep and get all timid."

lines.content: ごめん。ごめんね。もう笑わないよ
lines.translated: "Sorry. I'm sorry. I won't laugh anymore."

lines.content: 笑いをぐっと堪えてそう言うと――クロはもう一度、ため息。
lines.translated: When I stifled my laughter and said that--Kuro let out another sigh.

lines.content: ……まったく
lines.translated: "...Honestly."

lines.content: これじゃあ、今夜……わたしのほうが眠れなくなってしまいそう。……てれてれしちゃって
lines.translated: "At this rate... I feel like I'm the one who won't be able to sleep tonight. ...Because I'm all bashful-washful now."

lines.content: てれ……？
lines.translated: "Bashful-washful...?"

lines.content: 恥ずかしいって、意味
lines.translated: "It means I'm embarrassed."

lines.content: う……また、笑った
lines.translated: "Ugh... You laughed again."

lines.content: ど、どうして、わかるんだろう
lines.translated: "H-How can you tell?"

lines.content: まるで近くで見ているみたいだと冗談めかして言ってみる。
lines.translated: I said it jokingly, as if she were watching me from somewhere nearby.

lines.content: そ、そんなこと……ない。ない
lines.translated: "I-I'm not... doing that. I'm not."

lines.content: しどろもどろだった。少しだけ。
lines.translated: She stumbled over her words. Just a little.

lines.content: 案外本当に近くにいてくれるのかも。そんなことを思う。
lines.translated: Maybe she really was somewhere close by after all. The thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: すると……不思議だ。
lines.translated: And when it did... it was strange.

lines.content: 今夜、俺はひとりじゃないかも。そう錯覚できた。
lines.translated: It gave me the illusion that maybe I wasn't alone tonight.

lines.content: ふわりと心が[・|ぼ][・|や][・|け][・|た]気がした。
lines.translated: I felt my mind gently blur and soften.

lines.content: ……粘つく“夜”色が解けた、気がした。
lines.translated: I felt as though the sticky color of the "night" had melted away.

lines.content: それは睡魔の足音だ。
lines.translated: Those were the approaching footsteps of sleep.

lines.content: 胸に、心に、頭の中に、今もこびり付いてる[・|問][・|題]は、解決できていないどころか――答えめいたものさえも、まるで捻り出せていないというのに。
lines.translated: Even though the problem still clinging to my chest, my heart, and my head wasn't anywhere near solved--in fact, I hadn't even managed to squeeze out anything resembling an answer.

lines.content: だからこそ今夜の俺は、さっきまでの、この俺は、眠れずうんうん唸ってばかりいたはずなのに。
lines.translated: And even though that was the exact reason I couldn't sleep tonight, groaning and agonizing over it until just a moment ago.

lines.content: それなのにクロと少し笑いあえた、それだけで……、
lines.translated: Despite all that, just sharing a little laugh with Kuro was enough to...

lines.content: ……ふわ
lines.translated: "...Fwah."

lines.content: あくびが漏れる。
lines.translated: A yawn escaped me.

lines.content: ……そんな俺を、やっぱり近くで見ていてくれてるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was she really watching over me from somewhere close by right now?

lines.content: ふっと微笑むかのような、声で、
lines.translated: In a voice that sounded like she was smiling softly,

lines.content: ……おやすみ大雅
lines.translated: "...Goodnight, Taiga."

lines.content: クロが言う。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……さみしいことがいっぱいの夜は、楽しいことだけいっぱい、たくさん、考えていればいいんだよ
lines.translated: "...On nights filled with lonely things, all you have to do is think about lots and lots of fun things instead."

lines.content: 悲しいことは知らないふりをするみたいにね。
lines.translated: Just like pretending not to know about the sad things.

lines.content: 見上げた夜空のきらきら星を、ふたりで一緒に、数えるみたいにね。
lines.translated: Just like the two of us counting the twinkling stars in the night sky together.

lines.content: ……そうすれば、ほら。
lines.translated: Do that, and see?

lines.content: ……大雅の夢は、大雅の未来は……いっぱいのきらきらで、色づくよ
lines.translated: "...Your dreams, Taiga, and your future... will be colored with lots and lots of sparkles."

lines.content: クロは、君は笑った。
lines.translated: Kuro--you--smiled.

lines.content: 気がした。
lines.translated: Or so it felt.

lines.content: だから俺も、笑った。
lines.translated: So I smiled, too.

lines.content: そして……、
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……そして俺は、つくづく、君とこうして話すのが好きなんだなあと、思うから――
lines.translated: And because I realized all over again just how much I loved talking with you like this--

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: 君と一緒に、すばらしい明日という時間について“想像”してみようと……心でそっと、深呼吸。
lines.translated: I decided to try "imagining" that wonderful time called tomorrow together with you... and quietly took a deep breath in my heart.

lines.content: ……俺の明日は
lines.translated: "...My tomorrow..."

lines.content: きっと、君がどこかで見守っていてくれる、俺の、明日という時間は。
lines.translated: That time called tomorrow, which you would surely be watching over from somewhere.

lines.content: きっと――……きっと
lines.translated: "Surely--...surely."

lines.content: ……こんな感じになるだろうと、思うのだ。
lines.translated: I thought to myself that it would probably go something like this.

lines.content: ひらり……、と。
lines.translated: Fluttering... softly.

lines.content: 真っ暗闇の中に、ひとひら。
lines.translated: A single petal in the pitch-black darkness.

lines.content: 薄桃色の花びらが、ふわふわ、はらりと舞ったのだ。
lines.translated: A pale pink petal danced and drifted gently down.

lines.content: その、たったひとつの春色が。
lines.translated: And when that single touch of spring color...

lines.content: 暗闇のスクリーンに波紋を落とすように、弾けて、消えると――
lines.translated: Burst and vanished, casting ripples across the dark screen--

lines.content: 『……大雅くん。私、やっぱり怖い。かも』
lines.translated: "'...Taiga-kun. I think I'm scared after all. Maybe.'"

lines.content: ……声がした。
lines.translated: I heard a voice.

lines.content: 『どうしよう。大雅くん……』
lines.translated: "'What do I do, Taiga-kun...?'"

lines.content: 『私。胸がどきどき、どきどき、大変だよ……』
lines.translated: "'My heart is pounding and pounding so hard, it's awful...'"

lines.content: ぽつり、ぽつりと落とされたその声で。
lines.translated: With those words, dropped one by one...

lines.content: ほんわりと、じんわりと……少しずつ。
lines.translated: Gently, warmly... little by little.

lines.content: 真っ暗闇でしかなかったはずの背景が……光景が、ほんの些細な“魔法”で、色づいていく――
lines.translated: The background, the scenery that had been nothing but pitch-black darkness... began to take on color through a tiny little bit of "magic"--

lines.content: 満開のさくらと、吹雪く花びらに包まれて……。
lines.translated: Enveloped by cherry blossoms in full bloom, and a swirling blizzard of petals...

lines.content: さくらの森へと続く長い、長い、階段をふたりでのぼるその途中。
lines.translated: Halfway up the long, long staircase leading to the cherry blossom forest, as the two of us climbed together.

lines.content: 『……こわい』
lines.translated: "'...I'm scared.'"

lines.content: うつむいた彼女は、ぎゅっと[まぶた|瞼]を閉じていた。
lines.translated: Looking down, she squeezed her eyelids shut.

lines.content: 『怖いよ、大雅くん』
lines.translated: "'I'm scared, Taiga-kun.'"

lines.content: 何が怖いのかと問いかけてみる。
lines.translated: I asked her what she was afraid of.

lines.content: すると立ち止まってしまっていた彼女は、ふるふると首を振り、
lines.translated: Having stopped in her tracks, she gave a trembling shake of her head,

lines.content: 『みんなに忘れられてたらどうしよう』
lines.translated: "'What if everyone has forgotten about me?'"

lines.content: 『ちゃんとお話しできなかったら、どうしよう』
lines.translated: "'What if I can't talk to them properly?'"

lines.content: 『そう、思うと……やっぱりすごく、とても、とても……怖いんだよ』
lines.translated: "'When I think about that... it really is super, very, very... scary.'"

lines.content: 明日の俺は、きっとあの子の手を引き、この階段をのぼるだろう。
lines.translated: Tomorrow, I would surely take her hand and climb these stairs.

lines.content: 積み重なる一段、一段が続いていくその先を、俺は、あの子と一緒に――少し怖がりな女の子、柊ハルと一緒に仰ぎ見る。
lines.translated: Together with her--together with that slightly timid girl, Hiiragi Haru--I would look up at what lay beyond the steps piling up one after another.

lines.content: 『大丈夫』
lines.translated: "'It'll be okay.'"

lines.content: 俺はハルを振り向いて――笑いかけてみる。
lines.translated: I turned back toward Haru--and offered her a smile.

lines.content: 『……絶対、ぜったい。平気だよ』
lines.translated: "'...Everything will definitely, definitely be fine.'"

lines.content: そう言う俺に、ハルは不器用に笑うのだ。
lines.translated: At my words, Haru gave an awkward smile.

lines.content: 不安そうに。心配そうに。口元だけで、微笑む。
lines.translated: Anxiously. Worriedly. Smiling only with the corners of her mouth.

lines.content: ……その笑顔を[・|本][・|当]にするにはどうしたらいいだろう。
lines.translated: What could I do to make that smile real?

lines.content: 柊ハル。彼女は引っ込み思案な女の子。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru. She was a shy, reserved girl.

lines.content: いつも笑顔であろうとがんばってはいるけれど……その実。
lines.translated: She always tried her hardest to keep a smile on her face... but in truth...

lines.content: いつも、いつも。
lines.translated: Always, all the time...

lines.content: その胸の中はどきどき、どきどき、痛いくらいに高鳴っていて……。
lines.translated: The heart inside her chest was pounding, pounding so hard it almost hurt...

lines.content: だけど彼女はちょっとかわいい意地っ張り。
lines.translated: Even so, she had a cute, stubborn streak.

lines.content: 自分の不安やどきどきを、絶対ぜったい悟られまいと、悟られては格好悪いと……恥ずかしいからと、また、笑顔。
lines.translated: Determined never, ever to let anyone notice her anxiety or her racing heart--thinking it would be uncool and embarrassing if they did--she put on a smile once again.

lines.content: その明るさの下にあるもうひとつの柊ハルを、その心を、彼女はなぜだか俺にだけ、垣間見せてくれるから、
lines.translated: For some reason, I was the only one she allowed to catch a glimpse of that other Hiiragi Haru, the heart hidden beneath her cheerful exterior.

lines.content: 『大丈夫。平気だ。心配しなくていい。……そばに、いるから』
lines.translated: "'It's okay. You'll be fine. You don't have to worry. ...Because I'm right here with you.'"

lines.content: 俺はそんな言葉で勇気づけたいと、願うのだ。
lines.translated: And so, I wished to encourage her with those words.

lines.content: 『大丈夫だ』
lines.translated: "'It'll be okay.'"

lines.content: 『たとえ、“魔法”が使えなくなってしまっても……』
lines.translated: "'Even if we can't use "magic" anymore...'"

lines.content: 『いつの間にか特別なんかじゃ、なくなってしまったとしても』
lines.translated: "'Even if, before we know it, we stop being special at all.'"

lines.content: 『少女時代が終わり、特別な日々の記憶も少しずつ薄くなっていき……』
lines.translated: "'Even if girlhood comes to an end, and the memories of our special days fade away little by little...'"

lines.content: 『代わりに、不安や心配やさみしさばかりが横たわる――そんな大人の世界に、手招きされても』
lines.translated: "'And in their place, an adult world filled with nothing but anxiety, worry, and loneliness beckons to us.'"

lines.content: 『……世界中の誰もがみんな、君たちのことを、君たちの“魔法”のことを忘れてしまったとしても』
lines.translated: "'...Even if everyone in the whole world forgets about all of you, and about your "magic."'"

lines.content: 『俺は、忘れない。覚えてる』
lines.translated: "'I won't forget. I'll remember.'"

lines.content: 『かつて君たちが誰より、何より、勇気のある女の子たちだったんだって』
lines.translated: "'That once upon a time, you were all girls with more courage than anyone or anything else.'"

lines.content: だから、できる。
lines.translated: That's why you can do it.

lines.content: 君にならできる。君たちになら、何でもできる。
lines.translated: You can do it. All of you can do anything.

lines.content: つらくて大変な日々を乗り越えて、今日まで生きてきたんじゃないか。
lines.translated: After all, haven't you overcome such painful, difficult days to live up until today?

lines.content: そういうふうに俺は、彼女を……彼女たちを、応援し続けていたいから……。
lines.translated: Because in that way, I want to keep cheering her--cheering all of them--on...

lines.content: 『さあ、行こうか。みんなハルを、待ってるよ』
lines.translated: "'Come on, let's go. Everyone is waiting for you, Haru.'"

lines.content: そうして俺は彼女の手を引き。
lines.translated: With that, I took her hand.

lines.content: ひとつ、ふたつ、しっかりと石の階段をのぼり。
lines.translated: One step, two steps, we climbed firmly up the stone stairs.

lines.content: ……たどり着く。
lines.translated: And finally arrived.

lines.content: “おかえりなさい”
lines.translated: "Welcome back."

lines.content: そんなみんなの声を、期待しながら。
lines.translated: Hoping to hear everyone's voices saying just that.

lines.content: 『あ……。春が来た』
lines.translated: "'Ah... Spring has come.'"

lines.content: まずそう言ったのは姫織だった。
lines.translated: The first to say so was Himeori.

lines.content: それが合図だったみたいにたくさん、たくさんの花びらが、吹き抜けた風に乗り舞いあがる。
lines.translated: As if that were the signal, countless, countless petals rode the blowing wind and danced up into the air.

lines.content: 一瞬だけ目を閉じて、恐る恐る、開く。
lines.translated: Closing my eyes for just an instant, I timidly opened them again.

lines.content: 『わわわ……っ、お弁当に埃が入っちゃいますっ』
lines.translated: "'Wawawa...! Dust is gonna get in the bento!'"

lines.content: 『うおおっ、大変だっ、あさひさんが作ってくれたおむすびに花びらがっ』
