lines.translated: "'Whoa, this is bad! Petals are getting on the rice balls Asahi-san made for us!'"

lines.content: 『ふわぁ……すごい。ひらひらで、ぽかぽかで、ふわふわだよ、お姉ちゃん』
lines.translated: "'Fwaah... amazing. It's all fluttery, warm, and fluffy, Onee-chan.'"

lines.content: 『そうだなあ。うん。お昼寝がまんして来てよかったなあ』
lines.translated: "'It sure is. Yeah. I'm glad I held off on my afternoon nap to come here.'"

lines.content: そこにみんな、揃っていた。
lines.translated: Everyone was gathered there.

lines.content: 珍しく十夜やあさひさんまで。
lines.translated: Unusually enough, even Toya and Asahi-san were present.

lines.content: たどり着いたのは姫織の神社だ。
lines.translated: The place we had arrived at was Himeori's shrine.

lines.content: 明日の放課後。あるいは学校を抜け出して集まったお昼の時間。
lines.translated: Tomorrow after school. Or perhaps during lunch break, having snuck out of school to gather together.

lines.content: さくらの木々に包まれた石畳の境内は、春が満開に咲き乱れ……。
lines.translated: The stone-paved shrine grounds, surrounded by cherry trees, were bursting in full spring bloom...

lines.content: みんなが持ち寄ったお弁当や、色とりどりの駄菓子が溢れ。
lines.translated: Overflowing with the boxed lunches everyone had brought and colorful, cheap sweets.

lines.content: 約束通りのお花見会が催されているその場所に、
lines.translated: In that place where the promised flower-viewing party was being held,

lines.content: 『あ、ああ、あの……っ、た、ただいま……っ』
lines.translated: "'U-U-Um...! I-I'm home...!'"

lines.content: ハルの緊張しっぱなしの声が、響いた。
lines.translated: Haru's thoroughly nervous voice rang out.

lines.content: 『た、たた、ただいま、かえりま、しゅた……っ』
lines.translated: "'I-I-I'm h-home, everyone...!'"

lines.content: 『今日から、ど、どうか……また……っ、よろしくお願い、します……っ』
lines.translated: "'Starting today, p-please... once again... take good care of me...!'"

lines.content: 噛みながらも小さく叫ぶようにして言い、ハルは勢いよく頭を下げた。
lines.translated: Stumbling over her words as she practically shouted in a small voice, Haru bowed her head vigorously.

lines.content: ……そんなハルにみんなは顔を見合わせ、そして、微笑む。
lines.translated: Seeing Haru like that, everyone exchanged glances and smiled.

lines.content: 誰かが“おかえりなさい”と、そっとやさしい言葉をくれた。
lines.translated: Someone gently offered the kind words, "Welcome back."

lines.content: だから俺も。……柊ハル。彼女のことを振り返り、
lines.translated: So I did, too. ...Looking back at her, at Hiiragi Haru,

lines.content: 『おかえり。……ハル』
lines.translated: "'Welcome back. ...Haru.'"

lines.content: 『恥ずかしいことを言うようだけど……今日だけは特別だ。ハル。こんな日が来るのをずっと、ずっと、待ってたよ』
lines.translated: "'This might sound embarrassing to say, but... today is special. Haru. I've been waiting and waiting for a day like this to come.'"

lines.content: 思えば今日まで言いそびれていた“おかえり”の言葉を、俺もなんとかここで手渡せた。みんなと同じ笑顔と共に。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, I managed to finally hand over the "welcome back" I had missed the chance to say until today, right here. Along with the same smile as everyone else.

lines.content: ……そうして、ハルは。
lines.translated: And then, Haru.

lines.content: そんな俺にちょっと驚いたような顔をしたけれど、
lines.translated: She looked a little surprised at me for a moment,

lines.content: 『うん。……ただいま、帰りました』
lines.translated: "'Yeah. ...I'm home.'"

lines.content: 穏やかさを取り戻し、ふと――桜色のその頬を緩める。
lines.translated: Regaining her composure, her cherry-blossom-pink cheeks suddenly relaxed into a smile.

lines.content: 暖かな季節が寝転ぶこの町に、またひとつ、新しい春がやって来て……。
lines.translated: To this town where the warm season lay sprawled out, another new spring had arrived...

lines.content: クロもさくらの木からちらちらと顔を出している。
lines.translated: Kuro was also peeking her face out from behind a cherry tree.

lines.content: そんな様子に思わず吹き出す。
lines.translated: Seeing her like that, I couldn't help but burst into laughter.

lines.content: 手招きする。
lines.translated: I beckoned to her.

lines.content: すると、ぴったり。
lines.translated: And then, right away.

lines.content: クロは俺の背中に隠れるみたいにして、小さな身体を寄せたのだ。
lines.translated: Kuro pressed her small body close, as if hiding behind my back.

lines.content: 『……チョコ、ほしい』
lines.translated: "'...I want chocolate.'"

lines.content: 柊ハルよりも重度の人見知りが、ぼそぼそと、言った。俺にしか聞こえないように。
lines.translated: Someone with an even more severe case of shyness than Hiiragi Haru murmured softly, so that only I could hear.

lines.content: 『……今日はね、いつもより、とびきり甘い……チョコがいい』
lines.translated: "'...Today, you know, I want chocolate... that's much, much sweeter than usual.'"

lines.content: あ～ん、と開けられた小さな口に、ひとかけら。
lines.translated: Into the small mouth opened wide with an "aah," I popped a single piece.

lines.content: 『……美味しい』
lines.translated: "'...It's delicious.'"

lines.content: 幸せそうに、笑う。
lines.translated: She smiled happily.

lines.content: 『……すごく、甘いよ。大雅』
lines.translated: "'...It's super sweet, Taiga.'"

lines.content: 俺も笑って、クロを見つめる――ニヤニヤと纏わりつくたくさんの視線には、気付かないふりをして。
lines.translated: I smiled too and gazed at Kuro--pretending not to notice the many grinning stares clinging to us.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 悪くない。
lines.translated: Not bad.

lines.content: こんな時間も悪くはないはず。
lines.translated: A time like this wouldn't be bad at all.

lines.content: きっと、幸せだった。
lines.translated: Surely, it was happiness.

lines.content: “想像”すること。
lines.translated: To "imagine."

lines.content: 望む未来を闇色の心のスクリーンに映し出すこと。
lines.translated: To project the future I wished for onto the dark-colored screen of my heart.

lines.content: そうすれば世界はきっと変わっていくはずだった。
lines.translated: If I did that, the world would surely change.

lines.content: 望んだように。
lines.translated: Just as I wished.

lines.content: 望む、以上に。
lines.translated: Even more than I wished.

lines.content: ……それは“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: That was "magic."

lines.content: 誰もが使える“夜”の魔法。
lines.translated: The magic of the "Night" that anyone could use.

lines.content: だから、たぶん。
lines.translated: So, maybe.

lines.content: 明日の光景を盗み見たかのように、今夜俺が思い描いこの光景は。
lines.translated: This scene I envisioned tonight, as if stealing a glimpse of tomorrow's scenery.

lines.content: まあ、たぶん、半分くらいは本当に叶ってくれるのでは、ないだろうか――
lines.translated: Well, maybe about half of it would actually come true, wouldn't it--?
Goodbye...

lines.content: ――だから。
lines.translated: --That's why.

lines.content: ……さよなら、バイバイ。幸せにね
lines.translated: Goodbye, bye-bye. Be happy, okay?

lines.content: きみの未来にたくさん、たくさん、きらきらの星が降ることを……わたしはそれだけを、いつも、思い描いているからね
lines.translated: That lots and lots of sparkling stars will fall upon your future... that's the only thing I'm always picturing in my mind, after all.

lines.content: ――ああ。
lines.translated: --Ah.

lines.content: 俺の“夜の魔法”はいつか、君の口癖みたいな“さよなら”までをも、叶えてしまうのでは、ないか。
lines.translated: Wouldn't my "magic of the Night" someday grant even that "goodbye" of yours, which you say like a habit?

lines.content: そう思えて、ならなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but think so.

lines.content: ――俺、奏大雅の“魔法”の決定権は、あの子に、クロに一任された。
lines.translated: --The right to decide on my--Kanade Taiga's--"magic" was entrusted entirely to that girl, to Kuro.

lines.content: あの頃の俺の願いは、“夢”や“希望”と呼ぶにはあまりに息苦しくて……。
lines.translated: Back then, my wish was far too suffocating to be called a "dream" or a "hope"...

lines.content: むしろ“悪夢”と呼ぶほうがより正確なものであったからだろう。
lines.translated: It was probably because calling it a "nightmare" would have been much more accurate.

lines.content: [・|君]なら……小さな黒猫の君だよ。大雅の相棒だ。大雅の友人だ。大雅の、家族だ
lines.translated: If it's you... the little black cat, I mean. You're Taiga's partner. Taiga's friend. Taiga's family.

lines.content: きっと君なら、大雅の人生にとって、最悪になるような願いを受理することは絶対に、ぜったいにだ。あり得ないだろうと思えるからね。私なんかよりよっぽどか信頼に足る
lines.translated: I feel like if it's you, you would never, ever accept a wish that would turn out to be the absolute worst for Taiga's life. It's unthinkable. You're far more trustworthy than someone like me.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 俺は、大げさに言えば――自分自身の人生を[たす|助]くための方法を、自分自身の手で選定することを許されない立場に配置されてしまった。
lines.translated: To put it dramatically--I was placed in a position where I wasn't allowed to choose the method to save my own life with my own hands.

lines.content: “……できうるかり最低で最悪な死に方をしたい”
lines.translated: "...I want to die in the lowest, absolute worst way possible."

lines.content: そのような“夢”を、文字通り、自暴するように叶えてしまわぬようにと。
lines.translated: So that I wouldn't literally, in sheer desperation, make such a "dream" come true.

lines.content: 君たちの悲しい出来事に、その“魔法”は本当に必要なものなのか。ふたりで良くよく考えてみてほしい
lines.translated: Is that "magic" truly necessary for the sad events you've been through? I want the two of you to think it over very, very carefully.

lines.content: そうしてふたりなりの答えを出してみてほしい……。
lines.translated: And I want you to come up with your own answer together...

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”はそう言うと――その日の温かなご飯を作るため、台所へと立った。
lines.translated: Having said that, the "Magician of the Night"--went into the kitchen to make a warm meal for the day.

lines.content: “……君たちの悲しみに、その“魔法”は本当に必要なものなのか”
lines.translated: "...Is that 'magic' truly necessary for your sadness?"

lines.content: おそらくは俺たち以外の子らにも、同じような言葉を“夜の魔法使い”は贈っているはずだ。
lines.translated: In all likelihood, the "Magician of the Night" had given similar words to the other children besides us, too.

lines.content: そのような“夜の魔法使い”の言葉には、自分の人生は自分自身で責任を持てという意図が、明確に含まれているように感じられた。
lines.translated: In those words of the "Magician of the Night," I felt a clear intent telling us to take responsibility for our own lives.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: その決定権を与奪されてしまったこの俺は、自分自身の人生や、運命などといったものにも責任を負わせてもらえないほど――まだ、まだまだ、子どもだったということだろうと思う。
lines.translated: Stripped of that right to decide, I wasn't even allowed to bear responsibility for my own life or fate--which probably meant I was still, very much, just a child.

lines.content: そしてその頃の俺は、やはり子どもらしくそのような判断に、不満ばかりを募らせていた。
lines.translated: And back then, just like a child, I only let my frustration grow over that judgment.

lines.content: ……きみの“魔法”を“想像”しよう
lines.translated: "...Let's 'imagine' your 'magic.'"

lines.content: 君がそう言い、俺の手を取った。
lines.translated: Saying that, you took my hand.

lines.content: いつも寄り添うようにそばにいてくれる小さな君が――そのときは俺よりもほんの僅かに大きかった、子猫な君が。
lines.translated: The small you who always stayed close by my side--the kitten you, who was only ever so slightly bigger than me back then.

lines.content: ……これから、一緒に……きみには、きみの人生には、いったいどんな“奇跡”が必要なのか。どんな未来を、思い描くのか……一緒に、ふたりで一緒に、考えていこう
lines.translated: "...From now on, together... what kind of 'miracle' do you, does your life, truly need? What kind of future will you picture...? Together, the two of us together, let's think it through."

lines.content: 俺の心にはいつも不安ばかりがある。
lines.translated: My heart was always filled with nothing but anxiety.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|の][・|目][・|的]を無事達成できるのか。
lines.translated: Would I be able to safely achieve this goal?

lines.content: それらの不安や心配を、無事、振り払えるほどの“奇跡”とは……。
lines.translated: A "miracle" great enough to safely shake off all those anxieties and worries...

lines.content: 望むべきものは明確であるはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though what I should wish for ought to have been clear.

lines.content: 切り取りたい悲しみは、何より確かであるはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though the sadness I wanted to cut away ought to have been more certain than anything.

lines.content: しかし俺には、あの頃の奏大雅には、人並みの“想像力”が備えられていたとは言い難く……。
lines.translated: Yet for me, for the Kanade Taiga of back then, it was hard to say I possessed an ordinary amount of "imagination"...

lines.content: ……まだ、俺には、いったい自分がどんな“奇跡”を求めているのか――……
lines.translated: "...Still, I don't know what kind of 'miracle' I'm even looking for--..."

lines.content: まるで、全然、予想だにもできていない。
lines.translated: I couldn't predict it at all, not in the slightest.

lines.content: ……うん。だからふたりで、考えるんだよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's why the two of us will think about it together."

lines.content: 君はいつでも、小さな俺の手を握ってくれていた。
lines.translated: You were always holding my small hand.

lines.content: ……ひとりで無理なら、いつでも、ふたり一緒に
lines.translated: "...If it's impossible alone, then always, the two of us together."

lines.content: 小さく、ちいさく、君が微笑みかけてくれる。
lines.translated: Faintly, so very faintly, you smiled at me.

lines.content: そんな時間の中にひとつ、予感があったのだ。
lines.translated: Amidst that time, I had a single premonition.

lines.content: ……俺の“夢”は、けして叶えられることはない。
lines.translated: My "dream" would never be granted.

lines.content: 求めたものは何ひとつ与えられないだろう。
lines.translated: Not a single thing I wished for would be given to me.

lines.content: だけど俺は、きっと、最も豊かに祝福される者のひとりになれる――……その、はずだった。
lines.translated: Even so, I would surely become one of the most richly blessed people--...or so it was supposed to be.

lines.content: 目を覚ます。
lines.translated: I woke up.

lines.content: かち、かち、かち――
lines.translated: Tick, tock, tick--

lines.content: 規則正しい時計の音がいくつも重なる部屋で朝を迎えた。
lines.translated: I greeted the morning in a room where the regular ticking of several clocks overlapped.

lines.content: ……おはよう
lines.translated: "...Good morning."

lines.content: あくびを噛み殺し、そうつぶやく。
lines.translated: Stifling a yawn, I murmured to myself.

lines.content: だけどそこに返事をしてくれる者は誰もいない。部屋には俺ひとりだけ。
lines.translated: But there was no one there to answer me. I was all alone in the room.

lines.content: ……けれど。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: [・|誰][・|か]の耳には届くのではないかとそう思い、もう一度、俺は小さく『おはよう』と言う。そしてぐっと伸びをし、寝床から這い出した。
lines.translated: Thinking that it might just reach someone's ears, I quietly said "Good morning" once more. Then I gave a big stretch and crawled out of bed.

lines.content: よく眠れた。清々しい朝だ。
lines.translated: I slept well. It was a refreshing morning.

lines.content: 見た夢も覚えていないほどよく眠れたとそう思う。
lines.translated: I felt like I had slept so well that I couldn't even remember the dreams I had.

lines.content: おまけに本日は学校がない。休日らしく遊びの予定もある。
lines.translated: On top of that, there was no school today. Like a proper holiday, I even had plans to go out and have fun.
Our meeting time was ten-thirty.

lines.content: 俺は手早く着替えを済ませ一階へ。
lines.translated: I quickly finished changing my clothes and headed to the first floor.

lines.content: 襖を真横にスライドさせると、居間に立ち込めていたいい匂いが鼻先をくすぐった。
lines.translated: When I slid the fusuma door straight to the side, a delicious smell wafting through the living room tickled the tip of my nose.

lines.content: おはよう、大雅。今日は日曜日なのに早起きなんだな
lines.translated: "Good morning, Taiga. You're up early even though it's Sunday."

lines.content: 台所からあさひさんの声がした。
lines.translated: Asahi-san's voice came from the kitchen.

lines.content: ちょうどよかった。今から十夜に起こしに行ってもらおうか考えていたんだ
lines.translated: "Just in time. I was just thinking about having Toya go wake you up."

lines.content: とんとんとんと、小気味のいい音は、まな板を包丁が叩く音。
lines.translated: Tap, tap, tap--that pleasant rhythm was the sound of a kitchen knife hitting a cutting board.

lines.content: ぐつぐつと空っぽなお腹を刺激するのは、きっと、お味噌汁が煮え立つ音だ。
lines.translated: And the bubbling sound stimulating my empty stomach was surely the miso soup coming to a boil.

lines.content: 今朝は目玉焼きだぞ、大雅。簡単で悪いけど……えっと、大雅は卵、何個がいい？
lines.translated: "We're having fried eggs this morning, Taiga. Sorry it's so simple, but... let's see, how many eggs would you like, Taiga?"

lines.content: ひとつとふたつ。どっちがいい？　とあさひさん。
lines.translated: One or two. Which would you like? asked Asahi-san.

lines.content: ひとつ――、と。
lines.translated: One--

lines.content: 今更すぎる遠慮心がそう答えようとしたけれど、
lines.translated: My reservation, which was way too late in the game by now, tried to make me answer like that, but...

lines.content: ……あ、ふたつで、お願いします
lines.translated: "...Ah, two, please."

lines.content: そんなふうにちょっと図々しくお願いしてみたりした。
lines.translated: I tried asking a bit shamelessly like that instead.

lines.content: するとあさひさんは、『うん。おっけー、了解』と弾んだ声を返してくれた。
lines.translated: In response, Asahi-san called back in a lively voice, "Yep. Okay, got it!"

lines.content: 男の子だもんな。朝も、昼も、夜だって、たくさん食べなきゃだ
lines.translated: "You're a boy, after all. Morning, noon, and night, you've got to eat plenty."

lines.content: ご機嫌そうな声が聞こえてきて――少しだけほっとする。
lines.translated: Hearing her cheerful voice--I felt a little relieved.

lines.content: ねえ大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ん？　おはよう、十夜。なに？
lines.translated: "Hm? Good morning, Toya. What's up?"

lines.content: お皿並べるの、大雅も手伝ってくれる……？
lines.translated: "Will you help me set the plates too, Taiga...?"

lines.content: うん。もちろん
lines.translated: "Yeah. Of course."

lines.content: 十夜が爪先立ちで、戸棚からお茶碗をみっつ取り出して俺に渡した。
lines.translated: Standing on her tiptoes, Toya took three rice bowls out of the cupboard and handed them to me.

lines.content: そこに俺は、炊きあがったご飯がいっぱいの炊飯器から、しゃもじでご飯をよそって、丸い木のテーブルに並べていった。
lines.translated: Using a rice paddle, I scooped freshly cooked rice from the full rice cooker into the bowls and lined them up on the round wooden table.

lines.content: お、ふたりともお手伝いありがとう。お姉ちゃんはとっても助かるなあ
lines.translated: "Oh, thank you both for helping out. That's a big help to your big sister."

lines.content: 台所からあさひさんがやって来た。
lines.translated: Asahi-san came over from the kitchen.

lines.content: その手のおぼんには、出来上がった朝食の盛られたお皿が乗っている。
lines.translated: On the tray in her hands sat plates loaded with the finished breakfast.

lines.content: あさひさんはテーブルの前に両膝を付いてお皿を並べた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san dropped to her knees in front of the table and set the plates down.

lines.content: 今朝のメニュー。
lines.translated: This morning's menu.

lines.content: ほかほかの炊きたてご飯に、熱々のお味噌汁。
lines.translated: Steaming hot freshly cooked rice, and piping hot miso soup.

lines.content: カリカリのベーコンの上に目玉焼き。食べやすく千切られたレタスと、薄くカットした大根と、トマトで飾った野菜のサラダ。
lines.translated: Fried eggs atop crispy bacon. A vegetable salad garnished with lettuce torn into bite-sized pieces, thinly sliced daikon radish, and tomatoes.

lines.content: ドレッシングは青じそであさひさんが作ったものだ。
lines.translated: The dressing was green shiso, homemade by Asahi-san.

lines.content: そして刻み葱とパックの納豆がひとつずつ。
lines.translated: Then there were chopped green onions and one pack of natto each.

lines.content: キュウリの[ぬかづ|糠漬]けもある。
lines.translated: There were also nukazuke pickled cucumbers.

lines.content: 俺からすると充分すぎるメニューなのに。
lines.translated: From my perspective, this menu was more than enough.

lines.content: どころか朝からちょっと食べすぎちゃうかもしれない……と思ってしまってもいるのに。
lines.translated: In fact, I was even thinking that I might end up eating a little too much first thing in the morning...

lines.content: あさひさんは少し申し訳なさそうに首をひねっていた。
lines.translated: Yet Asahi-san tilted her head, looking slightly apologetic.

lines.content: ごめんな、ふたりとも。今朝はちょっと手抜きだなあ。……ううん
lines.translated: "Sorry, you two. I cut a few corners this morning. ...Hmm."

lines.content: 仕方がない。あまり味が濃いのに慣れてほしくはないんだけれど……ふりかけを使うことを許可しようか
lines.translated: "It can't be helped. I don't really want you getting used to overly strong flavors, but... I suppose I'll permit the use of furikake."

lines.content: えっ、ほんとっ、いいのっ、やったあ……っ
lines.translated: "Eh, really?! Is it okay?! Yay...!"

lines.content: 十夜。ばんざいして、飛び跳ねる。
lines.translated: Toya threw her hands up in the air and jumped for joy.

lines.content: そして戸棚に駆けていき、長方形のアルミの缶を取り出し戻って来た。
lines.translated: Then she ran over to the cupboard, took out a rectangular aluminum tin, and came back.

lines.content: うれしそうにその缶の蓋を十夜が外す。
lines.translated: Happily, Toya took the lid off the tin.

lines.content: すると中には色々な種類のふりかけが、小さな袋に分けられてたくさん詰められていた。味もメーカーも様々だ。
lines.translated: Inside, various kinds of furikake divided into small packets were packed tightly together. They came in all sorts of flavors and brands.

lines.content: 私はねー、ん～……何にしようかなあ
lines.translated: "For me, let's see, hmm~... What should I pick?"

lines.content: うれしそうに頭をふらふらさせながら、色とりどりのふりかけを眺め、
lines.translated: Swaying her head happily from side to side, she gazed at the colorful packets of furikake.

lines.content: のりたまにする！　今朝の私はそんな気分だよ
lines.translated: "I'll go with Noritama! That's the mood I'm in this morning!"

lines.content: 大事そうに小さな黄色い袋を手に取った。
lines.translated: She carefully picked up a small yellow packet.

lines.content: ねえねえ知ってる大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Taiga, did you know?"

lines.content: うんうん、何をかな？
lines.translated: "Yeah, yeah, know what?"

lines.content: あのね。のりたまにはね、こしあんが入ってるんだよ
lines.translated: "Well, you see. Noritama actually has smooth red bean paste in it."

lines.content: え？　そうなの？　お菓子とかに使うやつ？
lines.translated: "Eh? Really? The kind they use in sweets and stuff?"

lines.content: ううん。お菓子に使ってるのとは違うやつだよ。甘くないあんこを使ってるんだって
lines.translated: "Unh-unh. It's different from the kind they use in sweets. They say it uses unsweetened red bean paste."

lines.content: へ～、そうなんだ。知らなかった
lines.translated: "Huh~, is that so? I didn't know that."

lines.content: うん。そうなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. It's true!"

lines.content: ふふんと得意そうにする。ねえねええらい？　すごい？　物知りでしょう？　と、顔がとっても褒めてほしそうにしていた。
lines.translated: She puffed out her chest proudly. Hey, hey, aren't I great? Aren't I amazing? Don't I know a lot? --her face looked like she really, really wanted to be praised.

lines.content: だからね、ご飯食べてるのに、お菓子食べてるみたいな気がしてね、のりたまって大好きなんだあ
lines.translated: "So, you see, even though I'm eating rice, it feels like I'm eating sweets, and that's why I love Noritama so much!"

lines.content: なるほどね。少しだけわからないでもないかな、その気持ち。ふりかけってご飯だけどお菓子って感じもするよね
lines.translated: "I see. I think I can kind of understand that feeling. Furikake goes on rice, but it does feel a bit like a snack, doesn't it?"

lines.content: 偉いえらいと十夜の小さな頭を撫でなでする。
lines.translated: Saying "Good girl, good girl," I patted Toya's small head.

lines.content: すると十夜はうれしそうに顔をくしゃりとして笑った――うれしいとつい出てくるらしい猫の耳が飛び出さなかったのは、成長の証だろうか。そんなことを思ったりする。
lines.translated: At that, Toya scrunched up her face happily and laughed--the fact that her cat ears, which apparently tended to pop out whenever she was happy, didn't spring out right now was probably a sign of how much she'd grown. That's the sort of thing I found myself thinking.

lines.content: 大雅はどれにする？　何でも好きなの選んじゃってもいいんだよ
lines.translated: "Which one are you going to pick, Taiga? You can choose whichever one you like, you know."

lines.content: 十夜に缶を渡された。
lines.translated: Toya handed the tin to me.

lines.content: えっと、そうだなあ
lines.translated: "Let's see, well..."

lines.content: 俺は特別ふりかけが欲しいわけではないけれど……。
lines.translated: It wasn't like I particularly wanted any furikake, though...

lines.content: せっかくだからと、俺は[・|ゆ][・|か][・|り]を選んだ。
lines.translated: Since she was offering, I chose Yukari red shiso.

lines.content: あさひさんに缶を回す。
lines.translated: I passed the tin over to Asahi-san.

lines.content: だけどあさひさんは何も選ばなかった――その代わり、
lines.translated: However, Asahi-san didn't pick anything--instead...

lines.content: よし、覚悟はいいかな可愛いかわいい妹くん。運命のじゃんけんタイムだぞ
lines.translated: "Alright, are you ready, my cute, adorable little sister? It's time for a fateful game of rock-paper-scissors."

lines.content: にやりと十夜に笑いかけていた。
lines.translated: She flashed a smug grin at Toya.

lines.content: うん、いいよー、負けないよ。今日こそいっぱいふりかけちゃうよお姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "Yep, bring it on! I won't lose! Today for sure, I'm going to use lots of furikake, Onee-chan!"

lines.content: ふたりは“最初はぐー”と勝負をはじめる。
lines.translated: With a chant of "Rock, paper, scissors," the two of them began their match.

lines.content: 十夜はふりかけが好きすぎて、放っておくとたくさんたくさん使ってしまうらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, Toya loved furikake so much that if left to her own devices, she would end up using way too much of it.

lines.content: だから三回勝負のじゃんけんで、ふりかけていい量を決めるのだという。
lines.translated: So they decided how much she was allowed to sprinkle on with a three-round game of rock-paper-scissors.

lines.content: う～……今日も一回しか勝てなかったよ……お姉ちゃんじゃんけん強すぎなんだもん。“魔法”でズルしてるみたい
lines.translated: "Ugh~... I only won once today too... You're way too good at rock-paper-scissors, Onee-chan. It's like you're cheating with 'magic.'"

lines.content: ぶつぶつと言いながら、十夜は[・|二][・|回]、ご飯にのりたまを振りかけた。
lines.translated: Grumbling to herself, Toya sprinkled Noritama onto her rice *twice*.

lines.content: 三回中全敗しても一回。一勝できればそこにプラスして、もう一回。そういう具合だ。
lines.translated: Even if she lost all three rounds, she got one shake. For each win, she got an extra shake on top of that. That was how the system worked.

lines.content: ……十夜は最初にグーしか出さないんだ。次はチョキだな。そしてその次はもちろんパーだ。秘密の“魔法”だ。覚えておくといいぞ
lines.translated: "...Toya always throws rock first. Next is scissors. And after that, of course, is paper. That's my secret 'magic.' You'd do well to remember it."

lines.content: あさひさんにひそひそと耳打ちされて、
lines.translated: Asahi-san whispered that into my ear.

lines.content: え？　なあに？
lines.translated: "Eh? What is it?"

lines.content: 私のこと、何か言ってる？　と小首をかしげる十夜だ。
lines.translated: Are you saying something about me? Toya tilted her head curiously.

lines.content: 俺は『何でもないよ』と苦笑いで箸を取り――三人一緒に“いただきます”と、両手を合わせた。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, I told her "It's nothing" and picked up my chopsticks--then all three of us put our hands together and said, "Thank you for the food."

lines.content: 目玉焼きは俺がふたつ。あさひさんと十夜がひとつずつ。
lines.translated: I had two fried eggs, while Asahi-san and Toya had one each.

lines.content: 鶏を飼ってるお隣さんから産み立てを貰ってきたんだ。しかも烏骨鶏だぞ。きっと、美味しい卵だ
lines.translated: "Our neighbor who raises chickens gave us some freshly laid ones. And they're from silky fowls, too. I'm sure they're delicious eggs."

lines.content: 新鮮な卵を使った出来立ての目玉焼き。その黄身の部分に俺は箸を突き立てた。
lines.translated: Freshly fried eggs made from fresh eggs. I poked the tip of my chopsticks right into the yolk.

lines.content: すると、とろり。
lines.translated: Slowly, it oozed out.

lines.content: 半熟の黄身が零れ出す。美味しそうだ。さすがに絶妙の焼き具合である。
lines.translated: The soft-cooked yolk spilled forth. It looked delicious. As expected, they were cooked to absolute perfection.

lines.content: ごめん、十夜。お醤油取ってくれないかな
lines.translated: "Sorry, Toya. Could you pass me the soy sauce?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: きょとんとした十夜に、俺もきょとんと小首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Toya stared at me blankly, so I tilted my head in confusion right back at her.

lines.content: あ、お醤油切れてたのかな。どうしよう……近くの商店で買ってこようか
lines.translated: "Ah, are we out of soy sauce? What should we do... Should I run to the nearby shop and buy some?"

lines.content: ううん
lines.translated: "Unh-unh."

lines.content: ふるふると首を振る十夜。
lines.translated: Toya shook her head back and forth.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: はいはい、何かな
lines.translated: "Yes, yes, what is it?"

lines.content: まさか……大雅はお醤油なの？　目玉焼きに、お醤油？
lines.translated: "No way... Taiga, are you a soy sauce person? Soy sauce on fried eggs?"

lines.content: え？　う、うん。そうだけど……。何か変かな
lines.translated: "Eh? Y-Yeah, I am, though... Is that weird?"

lines.content: 変だよ、とっても
lines.translated: "It's weird. Very weird."

lines.content: ジト目だった。
lines.translated: She glared at me with half-lidded eyes.

lines.content: 十夜はふくれっ面でサラダをもくもくと咀嚼していた。
lines.translated: Pouting, Toya silently munched on her salad.

lines.content: む。じゃあ、十夜。君は目玉焼きに醤油以外の何をかけようというのかな
lines.translated: "Hmph. Well then, Toya. What else besides soy sauce could you possibly suggest putting on fried eggs?"

lines.content: ソース以外で食べちゃったら卵がかわいそうだよ大雅
lines.translated: "If you eat them with anything other than sauce, I feel sorry for the eggs, Taiga."

lines.content: ソース……？
lines.translated: Sauce...?

lines.content: ほんとはひよこになるはずだった卵なのに、いい具合のトロトロに焼き上げられちゃって……
lines.translated: "Those eggs were supposed to become little chicks, and yet they got fried up all nice and runny..."

lines.content: そのうえお醤油まみれにされちゃうだなんて……ねえ、大雅。大雅はひよこになれなかった卵の気持ちを考えたことがあるの？
lines.translated: "And on top of that, to go and drench them in soy sauce... Hey, Taiga. Have you ever stopped to think about the feelings of the eggs that couldn't become chicks?"

lines.content: 何を言っているんだ君は
lines.translated: "What on earth are you talking about?"

lines.content: えっと……うす……うう、なんだっけお姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "Um... Wus... Ugh, what was it called again, Onee-chan?"

lines.content: ウスターソースかな
lines.translated: "Worcestershire sauce, maybe?"

lines.content: うんそれ。うすたーそーす。目玉焼きにはうすたーそーすだよ、大雅
lines.translated: "Yep, that's it. Wooster-sher sauce. Fried eggs are meant for Wooster-sher sauce, Taiga."

lines.content: あり得んっ
lines.translated: "Unthinkable!"

lines.content: 我慢できず俺は目を見開く。
lines.translated: Unable to hold back, my eyes flew wide open.

lines.content: はっ、何がウスターだ。この幼女はスカしたことを言ってからに
lines.translated: "Hah! What's all this 'Worcestershire' nonsense? Listen to this little girl trying to sound all high and mighty."

lines.content: ウスターでソースだと！？
lines.translated: Worcestershire sauce, she says?!

lines.content: ふん。
lines.translated: Hmph.

lines.content: ……ごめん。それって、なに？
lines.translated: "...Sorry. What actually is that?"

lines.content: え？　大雅うすたーそーす知らないの？
lines.translated: "Eh? Taiga, you don't know what Wooster-sher sauce is?"

lines.content: と、とにかく君はいつから欧米人になったんだ十夜。横文字なんか並べちゃってさ。日本人の心はどこへやったというんだ。俺は、お兄ちゃんはとっても悲しいぞ
lines.translated: "A-Anyway, since when did you become a Westerner, Toya? Throwing around foreign words like that. Where has your Japanese spirit gone? That makes me--makes your big brother very sad."

lines.content: ……違うもん。人じゃないもん。猫だもん
lines.translated: "...I'm not. I'm not even human. I'm a cat."

lines.content: ぴこんと頭に猫の耳。
lines.translated: *Boing.* Cat ears popped out on her head.

lines.content: うれしいわけではないだろうが飛び出した耳だ。今回は我慢できなかったらしい。
lines.translated: She probably wasn't happy right now, yet out they sprang. It seemed she couldn't hold them back this time.

lines.content: 毛づくろいをするみたいにその耳を両手で撫でつけていた。
lines.translated: She smoothed the ears down with both hands as if grooming herself.

lines.content: ええい、まったく。話にならん子猫ちゃんだな君は
lines.translated: "Why, you... Good grief. There's just no reasoning with you, little kitten."

lines.content: ぷりぷりとして見せる。
lines.translated: I put on an indignant huff.

lines.content: そして俺は賛同を得ようとあさひさんを振り向いた――
lines.translated: Then I turned to Asahi-san, looking for backup--

lines.content: うむ
lines.translated: "Mm."

lines.content: ――あさひさんは塩コショウを目玉焼きに振りかけていた。当然だという顔で。
lines.translated: --Asahi-san was sprinkling salt and pepper onto her fried egg. With a look on her face as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

lines.content: ……マジですか
lines.translated: "...Are you serious?"

lines.content: 私は塩コショウ派だ
lines.translated: "I'm on team salt and pepper."

lines.content: 改めるようにして、あさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san stated it almost formally.

lines.content: ひよこさんになれなかった美味しい卵に敬意と感謝の気持ちを込めて、お塩とコショウのみという極めてシンプルな味付けなんだ
lines.translated: "Out of respect and gratitude for the delicious eggs that couldn't become little chicks, I use an extremely simple seasoning of only salt and pepper."

lines.content: そんなふうにして卵のそのままの味をちゃんと、しっかり、味わってあげないといけない。お姉ちゃんはそう思うな
lines.translated: "That way, you can properly and thoroughly savor the natural flavor of the egg itself. That's what your big sister thinks."

lines.content: ……君たちは何もわかっていないな。本当に
lines.translated: "...Neither of you understands a thing. Truly."

lines.content: と、いうか。
lines.translated: Or rather...

lines.content: これだけ長い付き合いなのに、ふたりの味覚に対する趣向を初めて知った。
lines.translated: Even though we'd known each other for so long, this was the first time I'd learned about their culinary preferences.

lines.content: 親しき仲にも日々、発見の連続だなあ、と。
lines.translated: Even among close friends, every day really is a series of new discoveries, huh?

lines.content: ちょっと的から色々外れすぎていることを思いながら……。
lines.translated: While thinking about something that was a bit beside the point...

lines.content: 俺は、醤油の瓶に手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: I reached out for the bottle of soy sauce.

lines.content: 瓶はテーブルの真ん中にちゃんとあった。
lines.translated: The bottle was sitting right there in the middle of the table.

lines.content: 俺はね、ふたりとも――あさひさん、十夜。別に目玉焼きには醤油だソースだ塩コショウだと、あまりにもベタすぎる争論の話題提供をしたいわけじゃあないんだ
lines.translated: "Listen, you two--Asahi-san, Toya. It's not like I'm trying to kick off some cliche debate over whether soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, or salt and pepper belongs on fried eggs."

lines.content: そんなのは団らんの席だからと言っても下らなさ過ぎる――とまで言い切ってしまうのは、いささか引け目のようなものも感じてしまうけど。
lines.translated: Even at a cozy family meal, arguing over something like that is way too silly--though saying that outright made me feel slightly self-conscious, too.

lines.content: ともかく。
lines.translated: Regardless.

lines.content: 俺は目玉焼きというか、目玉焼きが食卓に並んだ朝食をより美味しくいただくことを可能にしてくれるアイテムこそがお醤油であると、そう説きたいわけなんだ
lines.translated: "What I want to preach here is that soy sauce is the ultimate item that makes it possible to enjoy a breakfast featuring fried eggs on the table even more deliciously."

lines.content: うええ。何かはじまっちゃったよお姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "Blegh. He's starting something weird, Onee-chan."

lines.content: ああ、うん。なんだか面倒っちいスイッチが入っちゃったみたいだな
lines.translated: "Yeah, uh-huh. Looks like some tiresome switch of his got flipped."

lines.content: うむ。こうして目玉焼きにお醤油を少し多めにかけてだね。そして、白身の部分や、他のおかずを先に平らげたなら……
lines.translated: "Indeed. First, you pour a slightly generous amount of soy sauce over the fried eggs like this. Then, once you've polished off the egg whites and the other side dishes first..."

lines.content: 俺はお皿の上でとろりと広がる黄身と、垂らしたお醤油とを箸先でぐちゃぐちゃ混ぜて、
lines.translated: Using the tips of my chopsticks, I messily mixed the runny yolk spreading across the plate with the soy sauce I'd drizzled on.

lines.content: これを熱々のご飯の上にかけてやる。そして、掻っ込む。それだけ。すごく美味しい。試してみて。ぜひ
lines.translated: "You pour this right on top of piping hot rice. And then you shovel it in. That's it. It's super delicious. Give it a try. Definitely."

lines.content: ……それ。ただの卵かけご飯だよ大雅
lines.translated: "...That's just raw egg over rice, Taiga."

lines.content: 違うよ、違う
lines.translated: "No it's not, it's totally different."

lines.content: とろとろになってる黄身と、少し固まっている部分の黄身とお醤油とがいい具合に[・|混][・|ざ][・|り][・|合][・|わ][・|な][・|く][・|て]……卵かけご飯ほどご飯と絡み切らない感じがたまらないんだ
lines.translated: "The way the runny yolk, the slightly firm parts of the yolk, and the soy sauce *don't* quite mix together evenly... The fact that it doesn't coat the rice as thoroughly as raw egg over rice is what makes it irresistible."

lines.content: 炊飯器で炊いてるご飯のおこげの味も時どき混じっていたりするし、そういった雑味がたまらないんだよ
lines.translated: "Plus, the flavor of the scorched rice from the rice cooker mixes in every now and then, and those little imperfections in the taste are just to die for."

lines.content: 俺は必死に一度試してみようよふたりともと言うけれど……、
lines.translated: I desperately tried to convince the two of them to give it a shot just once, but...

lines.content: や。きちゃない
lines.translated: "No way. It's messy."

lines.content: ……食べ物で遊ぶなよな、大雅。お姉ちゃんは悲しいぞ
lines.translated: "...Don't play with your food, Taiga. You're making your big sister sad."

lines.content: ……不評だった。すごく。
lines.translated: It went over poorly. Very poorly.

lines.content: ……食べず嫌いだよふたりとも。お醤油派は誰もがきっと、一度はやっているはずなんだ。俺だけじゃなくて。たぶん。きっと
lines.translated: "...You're both just being picky without even trying it. I'm sure everyone on team soy sauce has done this at least once. Not just me. Probably. Definitely."

lines.content: ごめんねひよこさん
lines.translated: "I'm so sorry, little chicks."

lines.content: 大雅が悪い子で、ごめんなさい。怒ってあげないでね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry Taiga is being a bad boy. Please don't be mad at him, okay?"

lines.content: 別にいいんだ。
lines.translated: It didn't matter to me.

lines.content: 俺は俺の信じた道を進むんだ。
lines.translated: I would walk the path I believed in.

lines.content: まあ、食べず嫌いという点においては私もちょっと賛成かな
lines.translated: "Well, when it comes to disliking something without even trying it, I have to agree with you a little there."

lines.content: あさひさんはそう言ってキュウリの[ぬかづ|糠漬]けを摘まんだ。
lines.translated: Saying that, Asahi-san picked up a piece of nukazuke pickled cucumber.

lines.content: ぽりぽりと美味しそうな音を立て、あさひさんは真っ白なご飯のおかずに[・|そ][・|れ]を噛みしめていた。
lines.translated: Making a delicious-sounding *crunch, crunch* noise, Asahi-san savored *it* as a side dish to her pure white rice.

lines.content: あさひさんが台所で漬けているキュウリである。自家製のお漬物なのである。
lines.translated: They were cucumbers that Asahi-san pickled herself in the kitchen. Homemade pickles.

lines.content: お漬物って、自分で、しかもお家で、作れるの……？　と、ものを知らないこの俺は、はじめ見たときはとても驚いたものだった。
lines.translated: You can make pickles yourself, and at home, no less...? Being as ignorant as I was, I'd been completely amazed the first time I saw them.

lines.content: そしてそれはとても美味しいことをいまの俺は知ってる。
lines.translated: And now I knew just how delicious they were.

lines.content: あさひさんはどこまでもママ[りょく|力]が高いのだ。美味しいものは何でも自分で作ってしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Asahi-san's "mom power" knew no bounds. If something was delicious, she would just make it herself from scratch.

lines.content: 俺も一切れ貰う。
lines.translated: I took a slice for myself, too.

lines.content: うん。やっぱり美味しい。上手に漬かっている。市販のものとは違う絶妙な味なのだ。
lines.translated: Yep. Delicious as always. They were pickled so well. They had an exquisite flavor completely different from store-bought ones.

lines.content: 高級な料亭で出されても納得の出来である――なんて。そういったお店には行ったことないけれど。
lines.translated: Honestly, I wouldn't be surprised if they served these at a high-end traditional restaurant--not that I'd ever actually been to a place like that.

lines.content: （いつかふたりを連れて旅行がてらそういうお店にご飯を食べに行くのもありかもしれない）
lines.translated: (Maybe it wouldn't be a bad idea to take the two of them on a trip someday and eat at a place like that.)

lines.content: そんなことを俺は思うのだけど、
lines.translated: As I was thinking that to myself,

lines.content: 十夜はつんとそっぽを向いていた。私なにも知らないよというみたいに。
lines.translated: Toya turned her head away in a huff, acting as if she didn't know a thing about it.

lines.content: 十夜は糠漬けが得意ではないようだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, Toya wasn't very fond of nukazuke pickles.

lines.content: だって臭いがするんだもん。糠の臭い。苦手なの。お鼻の奥がね、つんとするんだよ。……だからね、これはきっとね、私が食べちゃダメなやつ
lines.translated: "Because they smell funny. Like rice bran. I don't like it. It stings the back of my nose. ...So I'm pretty sure these are something I'm not supposed to eat."

lines.content: まったくひどいだろ大雅。一度も食べてくれていないのに、臭いだけで苦手だって決めつけてるんだ。私は悲しんでもいいよな、きっと
lines.translated: "Isn't that just awful, Taiga? She hasn't even tried a single bite, yet she's decided she hates them based on the smell alone. I have every right to be sad about this, don't I?"

lines.content: 苦笑いのあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a wry smile.

lines.content: だから大雅が来てくれてよかった。糠漬けも美味しそうに食べてくれるから。ちょっと、ううん、とっても嬉しいよ
lines.translated: "That's why I'm so glad you came over, Taiga. You eat my nukazuke with such gusto. It makes me a little--no, really happy."

lines.content: ニコニコ顔のあさひさんだ――
lines.translated: Asahi-san was beaming from ear to ear--

lines.content: でも。さっきの目玉焼きの食べ方だけは許してあげられそうにないけどな
lines.translated: "Though I still don't think I can forgive you for the way you ate those fried eggs earlier."

lines.content: うう。理解者だ。理解者がほしい。
lines.translated: Ugh. Someone who gets it. I want someone who understands me.

lines.content: あとほんの少しの触れ合いも。
lines.translated: And just a little bit of physical affection, too.

lines.content: そんなことを思った。
lines.translated: Those were the thoughts running through my head.

lines.content: ほら、これ。約束していたお弁当だぞ
lines.translated: "Here you go. The boxed lunch I promised you."

lines.content: 朝食後。
lines.translated: After breakfast.

lines.content: ごちそうさまでした美味しかったですと合掌していた俺に、あさひさんが、青色の布巾に包まれたお弁当箱を差し出してくれた。
lines.translated: Just as I was pressing my hands together and thanking her for the delicious meal, Asahi-san held out a lunchbox wrapped in a blue cloth.

lines.content: あっ、ありがとうございます。助かります
lines.translated: "Oh, thank you so much. You're a lifesaver."

lines.content: 受け取る。
lines.translated: I took it from her.

lines.content: なんだか[・|そ][・|れ]はとてもずっしりしていて、大きなお弁当だったけど――まずは、いきなりお願いしてごめんなさいと俺は言う。
lines.translated: For some reason, *it* felt really heavy, and it was a pretty huge lunchbox--but first, I apologized for asking her to make it so suddenly.

lines.content: だけどあさひさんは、これくらい何でもないよと笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: However, Asahi-san just smiled and told me that something like this was no trouble at all.

lines.content: このお弁当に力入れすぎちゃってさ、だから今朝は目玉焼きになっちゃったんだ。お弁当。ちょっとでも楽しみにしてくれたらうれしいかなって思うぞ
lines.translated: "I put a little too much effort into this lunchbox, which is why we ended up just having fried eggs this morning. Your lunch. I'd be really happy if you looked forward to it, even just a little."

lines.content: メニューは……
lines.translated: "What's on the menu...?"

lines.content: もちろん秘密だ。お昼の時間を楽しみにしててほしいかな
lines.translated: "That's a secret, of course. I want you to look forward to lunchtime."

lines.content: にこにことしてあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said with a bright smile.

lines.content: いいか？　お昼まで中を見ちゃだめだぞ、絶対だぞ
lines.translated: "Got it? You mustn't peek inside until noon, no matter what."

lines.content: えっと……。何かのフリみたいに聞こえて少し怖いんですけど
lines.translated: "Um... When you say it like that, it sounds like a setup for a prank, which is a little scary."

lines.content: でも、わかりましたと苦笑いで俺は答え、カバンの中にお弁当をしまった。
lines.translated: Even so, I replied "Understood" with a wry smile and tucked the lunchbox away inside my bag.

lines.content: 今日はみんなと……ハルや姫織や千和たちと一緒に、外でお昼を食べるんだよな？
lines.translated: "Today you're eating lunch outside with everyone... with Haru, Himeori, Chiwa, and the others, right?"

lines.content: はい。その予定です
lines.translated: "Yes. That's the plan."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そして時間を確認する。
lines.translated: With that, I checked the time.

lines.content: 居間に掛けられた時計は外の時間と同一だ――九時五十分。待ち合わせは十時半。そろそろ出たほうがいいだろうか。
lines.translated: The clock hanging in the living room matched the time outside--nine-fifty. We were meeting up at ten-thirty. It was probably about time I headed out.

lines.content: みんなでお弁当を持ち寄って……町のどこかで食べようってことになってます
lines.translated: "Everyone's bringing their own lunches... and the plan is to eat them somewhere around town."

lines.content: 町のどこかで？
lines.translated: "Somewhere around town?"

lines.content: はい。町の、どこかで、です。“どこか”はまだ決まってないんですけど
lines.translated: "Yes. Somewhere around town. Though we haven't actually decided on the 'somewhere' part yet."

lines.content: ピクニックに行くの？　それともお花見？
lines.translated: "Are you going on a picnic? Or cherry blossom viewing?"

lines.content: ん～、まあ、そんなところかなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm, well, something like that, I guess."
"*Though we already did the cherry blossom viewing yesterday.*"

lines.content: ……うん。昨日のハルちゃん。とってもうれしそうだったね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Haru-chan looked so happy yesterday, didn't she?"

lines.content: ああ。あの様子なら、安心だ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Seeing her like that is a huge relief."

lines.content: 十夜とあさひさんをうなずき合う。
lines.translated: Toya and Asahi-san nodded to each other.

lines.content: 私たちは写真を見せてもらっただけだけど……確かにうれしそうだった。ずっとあんなふうに笑顔でいてくれたら、私たちは安心だよな
lines.translated: "We only got to see the photos, though... She really did look happy. If she can keep smiling like that forever, we can rest easy."

lines.content: ふたりの言う[・|昨][・|日]とは。
lines.translated: What the two of them meant by *yesterday*...

lines.content: それは、ハルが転校生としてみんなの前に現れた日のことだ。
lines.translated: Was the day Haru appeared before everyone as a transfer student.

lines.content: 柊ハルが転校生としてのイベントをつつがなく、問題なんて何もなく、無事に終わらせられた日の終わりのことだ
lines.translated: Specifically, the end of the day after Hiiragi Haru had safely gotten through the whole transfer student event without a hitch or a single problem.

lines.content: 緊張を隠せないハルの手を引き、神社に続く石段をふたりでのぼった。
lines.translated: Taking Haru's hand as she struggled to hide her nerves, the two of us had climbed the stone steps leading up to the shrine.

lines.content: 広い境内にはみんなが揃っていた。そして、
lines.translated: Everyone was gathered in the spacious shrine grounds. And then,

lines.content: 『あ、春が来た』
lines.translated: "'Oh, spring has come.'"

lines.content: という、姫織の何気ないふうな、一言。
lines.translated: Himeori had murmured that one casual remark.

lines.content: そこで、風が吹く。
lines.translated: Right then, a breeze blew through.

lines.content: まるで魔法の中みたいに、たくさんの花が舞い――
lines.translated: Countless petals danced through the air, as if we were inside a spell--

lines.content: ハルの『ただいま』の言葉。
lines.translated: Followed by Haru's "I'm home."

lines.content: そしてみんなの、『おかえりなさい』の、その笑顔。
lines.translated: And everyone's smiling faces as they replied, "Welcome back."
*It was almost entirely just as I had imagined.*

lines.content: つまり俺が寝床の中で――いいや、魔法の時間のその中で……。
lines.translated: In other words, what I had envisioned in bed--no, during that magical time...

lines.content: “夜”の中で思い描いたことの、そのほとんどは叶えられたということだ。
lines.translated: Almost everything I had pictured within the "Night" had come true.

lines.content: “夜の国”に出入りできなくなった子たちとはもう会えない――
lines.translated: Except for the fact that you can no longer meet the kids who can no longer enter and leave the "Night Realm"--

lines.content: そんな“夜の規則”の中で生きているあさひさんや、十夜が、その場にいなかったことを除いたら。
lines.translated: Meaning Asahi-san and Toya, who lived under those "rules of the Night," hadn't been there.

lines.content: そして……クロ。
lines.translated: And... Kuro.

lines.content: あの子も姿を見せてくれなかったことを、除いたら。
lines.translated: Except for the fact that she hadn't shown herself, either.

lines.content: （俺たちの使える“魔法”は、誰にも負けない“想像力”だ――）
lines.translated: (The "magic" we can use is an "imagination" second to none--)

lines.content: もう一度“魔法”を信じてみてもいい。そんなふうに思わせてもくれた一日だった。
lines.translated: It was a day that made me feel like it was okay to try believing in "magic" one more time.

lines.content: いいなあいいなあお弁当。大雅ばっかりずるいなあ
lines.translated: "I'm so jealous, so jealous of your lunchbox. It's not fair that only Taiga gets one."

lines.content: 十夜のお弁当も作っておいたよ
lines.translated: "I made a lunchbox for you too, Toya."

lines.content: えっ、ほんとうっ……！？
lines.translated: "Huh? Really...?!"

lines.content: ああ、本当だよ。大雅のお弁当と同じくらいがんばって作ったんだぞ。十夜も、今日はお友だちと一緒に遊ぶんだったよな？
lines.translated: "Yeah, really. I worked just as hard on yours as I did on Taiga's. You're going to play with your friend today too, right, Toya?"

lines.content: うんっ――やった！　ありがとうお姉ちゃんっ
lines.translated: "Yep--yay! Thank you, Onee-chan!"

lines.content: あさひさんに飛びつくようにして抱きついた十夜だ。
lines.translated: Toya practically tackling Asahi-san in a hug.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんの胸やお腹に頬を擦りつけながら喜んでいた――いいなあ。俺も。俺も、いいでしょうか。その胸で、喜びの表現を、いいでしょうか。
lines.translated: She rejoiced, rubbing her cheeks against her big sister's chest and stomach--man, I'm jealous. Me too. May I join in, too? May I express my joy against that chest as well?

lines.content: そんな思いを衝動を……ぐっと抑え込む俺は、ふと、思うのだ。
lines.translated: Holding back those thoughts and impulses... a sudden thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: あれ？　十夜、お友だちとかいたんだね
lines.translated: "Huh? Toya, you had friends?"

lines.content: それは別に嫌味を言いたいわけではない。
lines.translated: I didn't mean it as a jab or anything.

lines.content: 十夜自身が、お友だちがいないから毎日面白くないと、以前に言っていたからだ。故に引っ掛かりを覚えてしまう。
lines.translated: It was just that Toya herself had mentioned before that every day was boring because she didn't have any friends. That was why it caught my attention.

lines.content: うん。最近[・|ま][・|た]お友だち、できたんだよ。大雅にも負けないくらいの仲良しなお友だち
lines.translated: "Yep. I made a friend *again* recently. A really close friend, just as close as you, Taiga."

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."
*Again*, huh?

lines.content: それはいいな。うらやましい
lines.translated: "That's great. I'm jealous."

lines.content: 十夜にはそう返しながらも。
lines.translated: Even as I replied to Toya like that,

lines.content: ふたりは“夜の国”に出入りできなくなった子どもたちとはもう会えない――そんなルールを思わずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but think of the rule that the two of them could no longer meet the children who had lost their ability to enter and leave the "Night Realm."

lines.content: 待ち合わせの場所は千和のお店だ。
lines.translated: Our meeting place was Chiwa's shop.

lines.content: 週末。日曜日。天気は晴れ。心地よい春風が町を撫で行く……麗らかな日。
lines.translated: It was the weekend. Sunday. The weather was clear. A pleasant spring breeze caressed the town... a gorgeous, balmy day.

lines.content: ハルと千和、姫織、そして智仁。
lines.translated: Haru, Chiwa, Himeori, and Tomohito.

lines.content: 久々に幼馴染みが集まり過ごそうかという休日である。
lines.translated: It was a day off where us childhood friends were getting together to hang out for the first time in a while.

lines.content: 俺はまず、あさひさんに見送られ、十夜とふたりで家を出た。
lines.translated: First, with Asahi-san seeing us off, Toya and I left the house together.

lines.content: お友だちが待っているのだという近所の公園にまで十夜を送り届ける。
lines.translated: I walked Toya all the way to the neighborhood park where her friend was supposedly waiting.

lines.content: 車に気を付けて遊ぶんだぞ？　怪我とかしないようにな？
lines.translated: "Watch out for cars while you're playing, okay? Make sure you don't get hurt, alright?"

lines.content: 公園の出入り口で、俺は念を押す。
lines.translated: At the entrance to the park, I made sure to drive the point home.

lines.content: いいか？　十夜。無茶しちゃだめだぞ？　怪我したら、痛いんだぞ？　血だって出ちゃうし。痣になっちゃうかもしれない。それに……
lines.translated: "Got it, Toya? Don't do anything reckless, okay? If you get hurt, it's gonna sting, you know? You'll bleed, and it might leave a bruise. Plus..."

lines.content: もー。ちゃんとわかってるよ。大雅うるさい
lines.translated: "Jeez. I know already. You're so nagging, Taiga."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせる十夜だ。ほんとにほんとにうるさいなあもうっ、という具合。
lines.translated: Toya pouted. Her whole demeanor screamed, *You're seriously, seriously so annoying, jeez!*

lines.content: それでも俺はめげたりしない。
lines.translated: Even so, I wasn't about to be deterred.

lines.content: かわいい子には旅をさせよというけれど――あれは嘘だ。大嘘だ。
lines.translated: There's a saying that if you love your child, you should send them out into the world to face hardships--but that's a lie. A total lie.

lines.content: かわいい子は過保護なくらいがんじがらめにしてやるくらいがちょうどいいのだ。なぜ？　そうすれば、ほら――
lines.translated: When a kid is cute, tying them down with borderline overprotective care is just about right. Why? Because if you do that, look--

lines.content: 今朝の大雅、嫌い。子ども扱いばっかりして、大嫌いだよ。私のほうが大雅よりずっとずっと長生きなのに
lines.translated: "I hate you this morning, Taiga. You keep treating me like a little kid, and I hate it. Even though I've lived way, way longer than you."

lines.content: ――こうして次第に芽生える小さなちいさな反抗心から、自然と自立心とかそういうのが育っていくものだから。
lines.translated: --Because from that tiny, minuscule spark of rebellion that gradually sprouts like this, a sense of independence and all that will naturally grow.

lines.content: 愛され過ぎてむしろ居心地の悪い場所からは、何も無理やり旅をさせようとせずとも自ら飛び出していくものだ。
lines.translated: When a place becomes stifling from being loved *too* much, they'll fly out into the world on their own without you having to force them to take a journey at all.

lines.content: 故に。俺は更に続ける。
lines.translated: Therefore, I pressed on even further.

lines.content: 行ってきますをする前に……最後にもうひとつだ、十夜
lines.translated: "Before we say our goodbyes... just one last thing, Toya."

lines.content: え～……まだ何かあるのぉ？　お友だち、待ってるのに
lines.translated: "Ehh~... Is there still more? My friend is waiting for me."

lines.content: その場で小さくぴょんぴょんと飛び跳ねて、イライラを表現して見せる十夜だった。
lines.translated: Toya hopped up and down on the spot to show just how irritated she was.

lines.content: うん、ごめんな。……いいか、十夜。ちゃんと聞いて
lines.translated: "Yeah, sorry. ...Listen, Toya. Hear me out."

lines.content: うん……。聞いてる。さっきからちゃんと聞いてるよ
lines.translated: "Fine... I'm listening. I've been listening this whole time."

lines.content: ああ。そうだな。十夜なら大丈夫だって……平気だって、信じてるけれど……これだけは聞いてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Right. True. I believe you'll be fine, Toya... that you'll be okay, buuut... I really need you to listen to just this one thing."

lines.content: う、うん……なに？
lines.translated: "O-Okay... what is it?"

lines.content: あのな、十夜。いいか、十夜
lines.translated: "Listen to me, Toya. Got it, Toya?"

lines.content: 視線を同じ高さにして、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Dropping down to meet her at eye level, I spoke to her.

lines.content: お転婆なのはいい。時どき怪我することも別にいいってことにする。それはさ、きっと元気な証拠だから
lines.translated: "It's fine to be a tomboy. I'll even let it slide if you get hurt from time to time. After all, that's just proof you're full of energy."

lines.content: ……いや。ほんとはやっぱり痛い思いをしてほしくはないんだけれど……それは仕方がないことなんだって、思うことにする
lines.translated: "...No, actually, I really don't want you getting hurt at all... but I'll just tell myself it can't be helped."

lines.content: でもな、と俺は真剣な表情を作るのだ。
lines.translated: "Even so," I continued, putting on a serious expression.

lines.content: でも、十夜。それがどんなにいい人そうに見えても、知らない人に……いいや、変なおじさんとかにはついて行っちゃ、だめだぞ？
lines.translated: "Even so, Toya. No matter how nice they might seem, you must never follow a stranger... no, a weird old man or anything like that, okay?"

lines.content: 十夜はどこか危なっかしい。そんな印象がある。
lines.translated: There's something precarious about Toya. That's the impression she gives off.

lines.content: それにこんなにも、かわいい。絶対変な人に目をつけられる。そんな気がする。
lines.translated: Plus, she's this cute. Weirdos are definitely going to set their sights on her. I just have a feeling they will.

lines.content: だから俺は不安が尽きないのだ。
lines.translated: That's why there's no end to my anxiety.

lines.content: お菓子あげるとか。飴玉あげるとか。何でも好きなの買ってあげるとか。そんな甘いことを言われても、だめだ。絶対だめだぞ
lines.translated: "Even if they say they'll give you sweets, or hard candy, or buy you whatever you want. Even if they tempt you with sweet talk like that, don't do it. Absolutely not, okay?"

lines.content: それだけが俺は心配なんだと、十夜に言った。真剣に。
lines.translated: I told Toya earnestly that this was the only thing I was truly worried about.

lines.content: え？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why?"

lines.content: え、って。どうして、って
lines.translated: "'Huh'? What do you mean, 'why'?"

lines.content: 俺は十夜の反応に面食らってしまう――
lines.translated: I was completely thrown off by Toya's reaction--

lines.content: なんだかんだと口うるさくは言いつつも、『そんなのわかってるよ大雅うるさいほんとうるさい』、とまた怒られちゃうくらい余計な心配だろうと思いながらの注意だったのに――
lines.translated: Even though I'd been nagging her about all sorts of things, I'd given her this warning fully expecting it to be so unnecessary she'd just get mad at me again and say, *I know that already, Taiga, you're so annoying, seriously so annoying!* And yet--

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]ってどうしてだめなの？
lines.translated: "Why is *that* bad?"

lines.content: ――おや？　様子がおかしいぞ。
lines.translated: --Oh? Something's off here.

lines.content: あ、あの。まさか……十夜。ううん、十夜さん？　まさかまさか、変なおじさんについていったことがある……みたいな？　はは。まさか、だよね
lines.translated: "U-Um. Don't tell me... Toya. No, Toya-san? You haven't actually followed a weird old man before... or anything like that, right? Haha. Of course not, right?"

lines.content: そっぽを向いた。
lines.translated: She looked away.

lines.content: おい……。いや、あの……十夜、ちゃん？
lines.translated: "Hey... No, um... Toya-chan?"

lines.content: 変なおじさんと、変じゃないおじさん。どう見分けたらいいの？
lines.translated: "A weird old man and a normal old man. How am I supposed to tell them apart?"

lines.content: ぽつりと言った。俺と顔を合わせないまま。
lines.translated: She murmured the question, still refusing to meet my eyes.

lines.content: え。それは……
lines.translated: "Huh? Well, that's..."

lines.content: ……ふむ。
lines.translated: Hmm.

lines.content: どうすれば……いいのかな
lines.translated: "How *do* you... tell them apart, I wonder?"

lines.content: 少し間、真剣に考え込んでしまった。
lines.translated: For a brief moment, I actually fell into deep thought.

lines.content: でも、十夜がそこでふと言った。
lines.translated: But then, Toya suddenly spoke up.

lines.content: おじさんって、かわいそうだよね
lines.translated: "You kinda feel bad for old men, don't you?"

lines.content: え？　かわいそう……なぜ？
lines.translated: "Huh? Feel bad for them... why?"

lines.content: だって。だってさ。おじさんはただおじさんってだけで、“この人変かもしれないぞ念のため気を付けよう近寄らないでおこう”って思われちゃうんだよ？
lines.translated: "Because. Because, I mean... just for being old men, people automatically think, 'This guy might be a weirdo, better be careful just in case and stay away from him,' right?"

lines.content: 小さな子とか女の人だとかは、あまりそういうこともないのに
lines.translated: "Even though people don't really think that way about little kids or women."

lines.content: しみじみとしたふうな十夜だった。
lines.translated: Toya sounded genuinely heartfelt about it.

lines.content: お、おう？　どうした十夜。大丈夫か、十夜
lines.translated: "O-Oh, yeah? What's gotten into you, Toya? Are you feeling okay, Toya?"

lines.content: 急におかしなことを言い出すちびっこに、俺は変わらず面食らっている。
lines.translated: I remained completely baffled by this pint-sized kid suddenly spouting such bizarre things.

lines.content: 大雅だっていつかはおじさんになるんだよ。私はおばさんになれないけれど……大雅はなるの、おじさんに
lines.translated: "Even you're going to become an old man someday, Taiga. I can't become an old lady, though... You're going to become one. An old man."

lines.content: おう……、そうかな。俺も、おじさんになれるのかな
lines.translated: "Right... I wonder. Can I really become an old man, too?"

lines.content: なれたらいいなあ、などとそんなことを言う。
lines.translated: *It'd be nice if I could,* I said, letting out a remark like that.

lines.content: 何言ってるの。なれるとかなれないとかじゃないんだよ。大雅はなるの。嫌でもなるの。おじさんに。人間はみんなそうなの。そういうものなの
lines.translated: "What are you talking about? It's not a matter of whether you can or can't. You're going to become one, Taiga. Whether you like it or not, you will. An old man. All humans do. That's just how it works."

lines.content: だから、大雅
lines.translated: "So, Taiga."

lines.content: いつかおじさんになる大雅は、今のうちからおじさんにやさしくしておいたほうがいいって私は、このかしこい妹はね、思うんだ
lines.translated: "Since you're going to be an old man someday, Taiga, I--your clever little sister--think you should start being nice to old men while you still can."

lines.content: そ、そうか。思っちゃうんだ
lines.translated: "I-I see. So that's what you think, huh?"

lines.content: ええそうですとも。人間は誰でもせいちょーするものだからね
lines.translated: "Yes, indeed I do. Because every human grows up, after all."

lines.content: ふふんと鼻を高くする。
lines.translated: She puffed out her chest proudly with a little *hmph*.

lines.content: しかしまあこの幼女。得意げである。
lines.translated: Boy, look at this little girl. She's so full of herself.

lines.content: それにね。変じゃないおじさんだって飴玉くれるかもしれないよ？　美味しい飴玉をたくさん、いっぱい
lines.translated: "Besides, you know, a normal old man might give you hard candy too, right? Lots and lots of delicious hard candy."

lines.content: えー……ううん。そう、かなあ
lines.translated: "Ehh... Hmm. I wonder about that..."

lines.content: そこでなぜか智仁のことを考えてしまった。
lines.translated: For some reason, that made me think of Tomohito.

lines.content: いつもポケットからミルク味の飴玉を差し出して来る変なお兄さんだ。
lines.translated: That weird older brother who's always pulling milk-flavored hard candies out of his pocket to hand out.

lines.content: ねえねえ大雅。もういい？　行っていい？　お話、終わり？
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Taiga. Are we done yet? Can I go now? Is your lecture over?"

lines.content: 十夜はとっても鬱陶しそうな顔だ。
lines.translated: Toya looked thoroughly fed up.

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: 車に気を付けて。変なおじさんにも気を付けて。怪我は少しくらいなら大丈夫。そんな具合で元気いっぱい、遊ぶんだよね
lines.translated: "Watch out for cars. Watch out for weird old men, too. Getting a little hurt is fine. And just have a blast playing with lots of energy, right?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだね。そんな感じ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. Something like that."

lines.content: 大雅も気を付けて遊ぶんだよ
lines.translated: "You be careful while you're hanging out too, Taiga."

lines.content: 気を付ける
lines.translated: "I will."

lines.content: さみしそうなおじさんを見かけたら、大雅。やさしくしてあげるんだよ
lines.translated: "And Taiga, if you see a lonely-looking old man, be nice to him, okay?"

lines.content: お、おう
lines.translated: "R-Right."

lines.content: そしたらきっと、大雅もおじさんになったとき、誰かにちょっとだけやさしくされるよ
lines.translated: "If you do, then when you become an old man, I'm sure someone will be a little bit nice to you, too."

lines.content: ……そうかな
lines.translated: "...You think so?"

lines.content: そうですとも
lines.translated: "Indeed I do."

lines.content: またも生意気盛りの幼女さまは得意げだった。
lines.translated: Once again, Her Sassy Little Highness looked terribly proud of herself.

lines.content: などと。
lines.translated: And so on and so forth.

lines.content: 我ながらよくわからないことを十夜と言い合い、手を振り別れて……十時半。
lines.translated: After trading a bunch of remarks with Toya that even I didn't quite understand, we waved goodbye and parted ways... at 10:30.

lines.content: 千和のお店だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa's shop.

lines.content: 予定通りに到着できた。
lines.translated: I had arrived right on schedule.

lines.content: はずなのに。
lines.translated: Or so I thought.

lines.content: もう、遅いよ大雅。何してたの？　まさかお寝坊さんなの？　みんな待ちくたびれちゃってたんだよ
lines.translated: "Jeez, you're late, Taiga. What were you doing? Don't tell me you overslept? Everyone's tired of waiting for you."

lines.content: 姫織がぷりぷりとしながら、テーブルにベターっと突っ伏している。
lines.translated: Himeori was pouting in a huff, slumped completely flat across the table.

lines.content: あ、ああ。ごめんごめん。早いな、みんな……って、あれ？　集合時間を間違えたのかな俺。約束は十時半、だったよね？　違ったかな
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Sorry, sorry. You guys are early... wait, huh? Did I get the meeting time wrong? We promised to meet at 10:30, right? Or was I mistaken?"

lines.content: もしかして俺の時計が狂いでもしたのかも。
lines.translated: Maybe my watch had gone haywire or something.

lines.content: 店内に飾られた時計を見る。
lines.translated: I looked at the clock displayed inside the shop.

lines.content: 美術館から持ち出してきたかのような古く大きな柱時計だ。
lines.translated: It was a large, antique grandfather clock that looked like it had been hauled straight out of an art museum.

lines.content: それが指し示す時刻は――
lines.translated: And the time its hands pointed to was--

lines.content: いいえ、大丈夫ですよ先輩。約束は十時半です。そして今がちょうどその時間ですね
lines.translated: "No, you're fine, Senpai. We promised to meet at 10:30, and it is right on the dot."

lines.content: だから気にしなくても平気ですよ、と苦笑いを浮かべるのは、お店の制服姿の千和である。
lines.translated: "So you don't need to worry about it," Chiwa added with a wry smile, dressed in her shop uniform.

lines.content: そっか、よかった。だったら安心だ
lines.translated: "I see, thank goodness. That's a relief."

lines.content: 他の人たちが早かったんです。約束よりも三十分も早く、です。驚きました
lines.translated: "Everyone else was just early. A whole thirty minutes earlier than promised, in fact. I was surprised."

lines.content: へぇ。三十分も
lines.translated: "Whoa. A whole thirty minutes?"

lines.content: はい。開店前だったので、お店を開けるの手伝ってもらっちゃいましたけど……
lines.translated: "Yes. Since it was before opening hours, I ended up having them help me open up the shop, though..."

lines.content: そっか。……むぅ
lines.translated: "I see. ...Man."

lines.content: 眉根を寄せる。
lines.translated: Her brows furrowed.

lines.content: 先輩？
lines.translated: "Senpai?"

lines.content: 俺もそこにいたかったなあって。また待ち合わせとかすることがあれば、今度はもう少し早めに来ることにしよう、うん、そうしよう
lines.translated: "I wish I could've been here for that, too. Next time we meet up like this, I'll make sure to come a little earlier. Yeah, I'll do that."

lines.content: ……うう。でもね大雅。聞いてよ、大雅
lines.translated: "...Ugh. But listen, Taiga. Hear me out, Taiga."

lines.content: うん、うん、何かなひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Yep, yep, what is it, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 私は大雅が遅いから、お腹が空きました
lines.translated: "Because you were late, Taiga, I'm hungry now."

lines.content: 姫織。ぷっくりと頬を膨らませている。
lines.translated: Himeori puffed her cheeks out round.

lines.content: 大雅が遅いとね、私のお腹はね、空っぽになっちゃうんだよ……知ってた？
lines.translated: "When you're late, Taiga, my tummy goes completely empty, you know... Did you know that?"

lines.content: お、おう。そうなの？　知らなかったなあ。ごめんねひよちゃん。お腹からっぽにしちゃって、ごめんね
lines.translated: "O-Oh, really? Is that so? I had no idea. Sorry about that, Hiyo-chan. Sorry for making your tummy go empty."

lines.content: ううん……いいの。でも、あのね。アイス、食べてもいいかしら
lines.translated: "No... it's okay. But, um, listen. May I have some ice, perhaps?"

lines.content: 上目遣いだ。ちらちらと。もじもじと。
lines.translated: She looked up at me through her lashes. Stealing little glances. Fidgeting shyly.

lines.content: アイス？
lines.translated: "Ice?"

lines.content: クリーム？
lines.translated: "Cream?"

lines.content: それでお腹いっぱいになるのかな？
lines.translated: "Is that really going to fill your tummy up?"

lines.content: ……なるよ
lines.translated: "...It will."

lines.content: ぽっと、頬を染めている。
lines.translated: Her cheeks flushed a soft pink.

lines.content: アイスクリーム。とっても大好き。ちょーあいしてる
lines.translated: "Ice cream. I really love it. I suuuper adore it."

lines.content: ほう。愛しているのかい。……そいつは嫉妬しちゃいますね
lines.translated: "Oh-ho. You adore it, huh? ...Now that makes me a little jealous."

lines.content: えっとね……私のお腹の中の、くいしんぼーなかいじゅーもね、とりあえずそれで許してやらんこともないって……、言ってるよ？
lines.translated: "Um, well... the greedy little monster inside my tummy is saying that... it might be willing to forgive you for now if it gets some, you know?"

lines.content: むう。それで人類が救われるのなら……仕方のない子だ。今日だけだぞ？
lines.translated: "Hmm. If it means saving humanity... what a hopeless girl you are. Just for today, got it?"

lines.content: わっほい！　ほんとう！？
lines.translated: "Woohoo! Really?!"

lines.content: うむ。ほんとうだとも
lines.translated: "Indeed. Really and truly."

lines.content: ふわ～、大雅……好き
lines.translated: "Fwah~ Taiga... I love you."

lines.content: え？　ほんとうかい？
lines.translated: "Huh? Really?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: こっくり。深くうなずく。
lines.translated: Nod. She gave a deep nod.

lines.content: 今日だけ、大好き
lines.translated: "I love you, just for today."

lines.content: く。今日だけ
lines.translated: "Guh. Just for today, huh."

lines.content: ことと次第によれば……明日も、好き……かも？
lines.translated: "Depending on how things go... maybe I'll love you tomorrow, too...?"

lines.content: ふむ。ご馳走するメニュー次第でってこと？
lines.translated: "Hmm. So it depends on what's on the menu I treat you to?"

lines.content: チョコのがいいなあー、ちらちら
lines.translated: "I'd really like a chocolate one~ Peek, peek."

lines.content: ……あまり高いのにしないでね？
lines.translated: "...Don't pick anything too expensive, okay?"

lines.content: あさひさんにもらったばかりのお小遣いを早くも使い切りたくはない。
lines.translated: I didn't want to burn through the allowance Asahi-san had just given me so soon.

lines.content: まったくもう……奏先輩は夜月先輩にばかり甘いんですから
lines.translated: "Honest to goodness... Kanade-senpai, you always spoil Yotsuki-senpai."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせる千和である。
lines.translated: Chiwa pouted, sticking her lips out.

lines.content: え。甘い？　そう、かな
lines.translated: "Huh? Spoil her? Do you think so?"

lines.content: そうですよ。甘々です
lines.translated: "Yes, I do. You're super sweet to her."

lines.content: 甘々……
lines.translated: "Super sweet..."

lines.content: ぎらり。
lines.translated: Glint.

lines.content: ……ひ、ひよちゃん。俺は、美味しくないよ？　甘くもないよ？
lines.translated: "...H-Hiyo-chan. I don't taste good, you know? I'm not sweet, either."

lines.content: だからそんな見ないで。獲物を狙うみたいな感じで。怖いから。
lines.translated: So don't look at me like that. Like a predator sizing up its prey. It's scary.

lines.content: ……また、そうやって。夜月先輩にばっかりやさしい
lines.translated: "...There you go again. Always being nice only to Yotsuki-senpai."

lines.content: 千和がつぶやく。唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa muttered, her lips still pursed into a pout.

lines.content: 私にはそんなふうにやさしくしてくれないのに。先輩は、いっつも私に意地悪ばっかりで――……
lines.translated: "You're never that nice to me. All you ever do is tease me, Senpai--..."

lines.content: そっかなるほど！　千和は大雅にいっぱいやさしくされたいお年頃なんだね！
lines.translated: "I see, got it! You're at that age where you want Taiga to be super nice to you, aren't you, Chiwa?!"

lines.content: う、ううっ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh!"

lines.content: そこで、千和。ハッとしたような顔。
lines.translated: At that, Chiwa gasped in sudden realization.

lines.content: そのちわっこい顔が、もれなく真っ赤に。
lines.translated: Her petite, Chiwa-ish face turned bright red from ear to ear.

lines.content: ち、ち違います！　どうして私が先輩にやさしくしてもらいたいとか……そんなこと思うんですか！
lines.translated: "T-T-That's not true! Why would I ever think about wanting Senpai to be nice to me?!"

lines.content: ぎゅっと目を閉じ、そんなことを小さく叫んだ。
lines.translated: Squeezeing her eyes shut, she let out a little shout.

lines.content: え？　違うの？
lines.translated: "Huh? It's not true?"

lines.content: と、智仁。
lines.translated: Said Tomohito.

lines.content: ち、違いますよっ
lines.translated: "I-It's not!"

lines.content: と、千和。
lines.translated: Said Chiwa.

lines.content: あははっ、うっそだあ
lines.translated: "Ahaha, no way, you're lying~"

lines.content: と、姫織。
lines.translated: Said Himeori.

lines.content: うっ、うう嘘じゃないもんっ……あっ、な、ないです……もんっ
lines.translated: "I-I'm not lying... Ah, I-I mean, I am not...!"

lines.content: と、千和。
lines.translated: Said Chiwa.

lines.content: しどろもどろだ。
lines.translated: She was completely flustered, tripping over her words.

lines.content: ふへえ……？
lines.translated: "Huuh...?"

lines.content: と、俺。
lines.translated: Said I.

lines.content: きょとんとしている（うわあなんだこいつキモいなあと、普段なら思うだろう顔と口調で）。
lines.translated: Looking utterly dumbfounded (with the exact kind of face and tone that would normally make someone think, "Whoa, what's with this guy, he's gross").

lines.content: 大雅きもい
lines.translated: "Taiga, gross."

lines.content: 案の定そう吐き捨てられた。
lines.translated: Sure enough, she spat the words right at me.

lines.content: うえ。身の毛がよだつぜ
lines.translated: "Blegh. Gives me the creeps."

lines.content: 唾棄される。
lines.translated: Utterly reviled.

lines.content: ……ふたりとも、ひどい。
lines.translated: You're both terrible.

lines.content: う、うううううう
lines.translated: "U-Ughhhhhh..."

lines.content: 千和は、手にしていたお盆で赤い顔を半分隠しながら、
lines.translated: Hiding half of her flushed face behind the tray in her hands, Chiwa mumbled under her breath.

lines.content: す、すごくやさしくしてほしいんじゃ、なくて……ちょ、ちょっと……ちょっとだけやさしくしてくたら、それでいいのに……そう言いたいだけなのに……
lines.translated: "I-It's not that I want you to be super nice to me... I-I just... if you were just a little bit nice to me, that'd be enough... That's all I wanted to say..."

lines.content: ぶつぶつとつぶやいている。
lines.translated: She kept muttering to herself.

lines.content: その度にみるみる真っ赤に。
lines.translated: Turning an even deeper shade of red with every word.

lines.content: これはこれは。ふふ。……はかあなですね？
lines.translated: "Well, well. Hehe. ...You really dug your own haka-ana there, didn't you?"

lines.content: 姫織はにやにやしている。
lines.translated: Himeori was grinning ear to ear.

lines.content: それ、たぶん[ぼけつ|墓穴]って読むやつだよ、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "I think those kanji are read 'boketsu,' Hiyo-chan. As in digging your own grave."

lines.content: 智仁もにやにやしている。
lines.translated: Tomohito was grinning, too.

lines.content: んー、なんだかよくわからんけども……俺もにやにやするぞ
lines.translated: "Hmm, I don't really get what's going on, but... I'm gonna grin, too."

lines.content: 俺も、にやにやしている。
lines.translated: And so, I grinned right along with them.

lines.content: 先輩の、ばかっ
lines.translated: "Senpai, you idiot!"

lines.content: 千和。両目をぎゅっとして、小さく叫んだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa squeezed both eyes shut and let out another little cry.

lines.content: もう、いいです。結局私がからかわれて終わるいつもの感じじゃないですかこれ……
lines.translated: "Whatever, I give up. This is just turning into the usual routine where I end up getting teased, isn't it...?"

lines.content: 小さくため息。
lines.translated: She let out a small sigh.

lines.content: アイスは、私がおごりますよ夜月先輩
lines.translated: "The ice cream is on me, Yotsuki-senpai."

lines.content: え？　そうなの？　むむ。いいのかしら
lines.translated: "Huh? Really? Hmm. Are you sure?"

lines.content: なんだか悪いー、と姫織は言うのだ。
lines.translated: "I'd feel kinda bad about that~" Himeori said.

lines.content: ……俺のときにもそれくらい、ちょっとくらい、遠慮を見せてくれればいいのに
lines.translated: "...I wish you'd show even a fraction of that hesitation when it's on my dime."

lines.content: いいんですよ夜月先輩。お店を開けるの手伝ってもらったお礼です。だからみなさんにもご馳走しますね。奏先輩以外のみなさんに
lines.translated: "It's fine, Yotsuki-senpai. Consider it my thanks for helping me open up the shop. So it's my treat for everyone! Everyone except Kanade-senpai, that is."

lines.content: え？　俺には、なしなの……？
lines.translated: "Huh? None for me...?"

lines.content: 当然です。なしです
lines.translated: "Obviously. None for you."

lines.content: つんとする。
lines.translated: She turned her nose up in a huff.

lines.content: だって先輩は手伝ってくれたわけじゃないですし。……にやにやするし。私、いらっとしたんです。だからなしです
lines.translated: "Because it's not like you helped out, Senpai. ...And you're grinning at me. It annoyed me. So you get nothing."

lines.content: 俺に小さく舌を出し――そして千和は厨房へと小走りで。
lines.translated: Sticking the tip of her tongue out at me--Chiwa scurried off toward the kitchen.

lines.content: ……ふむ
今朝も俺のちっこい後輩はとってもかわいい。
lines.translated: My tiny underclassman is super cute again this morning.

lines.content: 怒っていても笑っていても全部かわいい。
lines.translated: Whether she's angry or smiling, everything about her is cute.

lines.content: お父さんはなんだかうれしい気分だ。
lines.translated: Makes her old man feel kinda proud.

lines.content: ……と、まあ。
lines.translated: Well, anyway.

lines.content: それはそれとして、
lines.translated: Setting that aside,

lines.content: 驚いたな。まさか智仁までもう来ているとは
lines.translated: "I'm surprised, though. I didn't expect even you to be here already, Tomohito."

lines.content: え？　驚き……？　どうしてだ？
lines.translated: "Huh? Surprised...? Why's that?"

lines.content: なあ、親友。お前みたいな面倒くさがりがいったいどういう風の吹き回しなんだって話がしたいんだよ俺は
lines.translated: "Come on, best buddy. What I want to know is what kind of freak wind blew a guy who hates麻煩 as much as you do out of bed this early."

lines.content: ほう……
lines.translated: "Oh-ho..."

lines.content: 俺はお前の言いたいことこそがよくわからないぞ親友よ
lines.translated: "I have no idea what you're trying to imply, my dear friend."

lines.content: うむ。いいか、智仁。よく考えてみろよ
lines.translated: "Uh-huh. Listen here, Tomohito. Think about it carefully."

lines.content: わかってる？　今日って日曜日なんだぜ？　と少し鬱陶しい感じで絡んでみたりする。
lines.translated: "You do realize today's Sunday, right?" I pestered him in a deliberately obnoxious tone.

lines.content: はは。言われなくても知ってるさ
lines.translated: "Haha. I don't need you to tell me that."

lines.content: 今日は、日曜日。学校はお休みの日だ。[・|あ][・|れ]が爆発されず在り続けることについては、否が応でも不満は残るが……しかし、だ
lines.translated: "Today is Sunday. A day off from school. While I inevitably remain dissatisfied that *that* place continues to exist without blowing up... even so."

lines.content: とにかく一日限りの自由な時間なんだ。これを存分に堪能しないでいて、それで音楽の神に愛してもらおうなんてそんなのは……都合がよすぎる。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "In any case, it's a single day of precious free time. To not savor it to the fullest, and yet still expect to be loved by the god of music... that would be asking way too much. Don't you think?"

lines.content: 何が“そう”なのかはさっぱりだが、まあ、休日を楽しもうって心意気だけは、その気概だけは、理解できるかな
lines.translated: "I have zero clue how any of that connects, but well, I can at least understand the spirit and determination to enjoy your day off."

lines.content: だろ。音楽の神は“今”を楽しもうってやつにしか微笑んでくれないんだよ
lines.translated: "Right? The god of music only smiles upon those who try to enjoy the 'now.'"

lines.content: あー。うんうん、そうだなそうだな
lines.translated: "Ahh. Yep, yep, you said it, totally."

lines.content: 適当に相槌を打つ。
lines.translated: I nodded along half-heartedly.

lines.content: 今日は何か大変なことでも起きるんじゃあないのか――雪が降るとか槍が降るとか。そんなことを言いながら、俺はテーブルに着く。
lines.translated: Mentioning how something crazy might happen today--like it snowing or raining spears--I took my seat at the table.

lines.content: 丸く大きなテーブルである。店内の中心に置かれたそれを囲むようにして、全員が席についている。
lines.translated: It was a large, round table set right in the center of the shop, and everyone was seated around it.

lines.content: 姫織。千和。智仁。そして……ハルだ。柊ハル。
lines.translated: Himeori. Chiwa. Tomohito. And... Haru. Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: おはようハル。待たせてごめん
lines.translated: "Morning, Haru. Sorry to keep you waiting."

lines.content: ううん。私も今さっき、来たばかりだよ……おはよう大雅くん。昨日ぶりだね
lines.translated: "No, not at all. I just got here a moment ago myself... Good morning, Taiga-kun. First time seeing you since yesterday, huh?"

lines.content: にっこり。
lines.translated: She smiled brightly.

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 少し。ほんの少し、余所行きの顔だ。
lines.translated: Though it was a little--just a tiny bit--of a polite, company-ready smile.

lines.content: 再会したばかりのみんなへの緊張も、まだまだ抜け切れてはいないのだろう――さっきまでのバカ話にも割って入るタイミングがなかったのだろうなと思う。
lines.translated: Having only just reunited with everyone, the lingering tension probably hadn't completely faded yet--and I figured she hadn't found the right timing to jump into our silly banter earlier, either.

lines.content: そういうふうにいちいち勘ぐってしまうような真似をするのは、ハルに対して失礼だろうか。
lines.translated: Would overthinking every little detail like this be rude to Haru, I wondered?

lines.content: だから俺は注文したコーヒーに、少し長めに口をつけ――今日の予定について思う。
lines.translated: So I took a slightly longer sip of the coffee I'd ordered--and thought about our plans for today.

lines.content: 今日、こうして集まった目的。
lines.translated: The reason we had all gathered here like this today.

lines.content: それは、十数年の時を経て少しばかり変わってしまった“参禅町”を、改めてハルに案内するためだ。
lines.translated: It was to show Haru around Sanzen Town once again, now that it had changed a fair bit over the past十数 years.

lines.content: 昨日のお花見の席で、誰がともなくそういう提案をし、やはり誰がということもなく、“ああ、それっていいな”と受理された。
lines.translated: At yesterday's cherry blossom viewing party, someone had casually floated the idea, and just as naturally, everyone had agreed with an "Oh, that sounds nice."

lines.content: ……十数年前。
lines.translated: Over a decade ago.

lines.content: 幼かった頃のことを思わずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking back to when we were little.

lines.content: 元気いっぱいの彼女を中心として、この町を駆け回っていた俺たちだ。
lines.translated: With her brimming energy at the center of it all, we used to run all over this town.

lines.content: あの頃とは、町も俺たちも、ずいぶんと変わってしまった。
lines.translated: Both the town and we ourselves had changed quite a bit since those days.

lines.content: だけどまた、こうして出会えた俺たちが、新しく始められるそのために……。
lines.translated: Even so, so that all of us who had reunited like this could make a fresh start...

lines.content: この町にちりばめられた想い出を、みんなで一つひとつ、拾い上げて行けたなら……。
lines.translated: If we could all go around picking up the memories scattered across this town, one by one...

lines.content: そんな思いが言葉以上の何かとなって、俺たちはきっと、共有できているはずだった。
lines.translated: That sentiment had become something beyond words, and I was sure we all shared it.

lines.content: ごちそうさま。美味しかったです
lines.translated: "Thanks for the drink. That was delicious."

lines.content: コーヒーを飲み終わり、合掌。
lines.translated: Finishing my coffee, I clapped my hands together.

lines.content: さて。そろそろ行こうか。ドキドキワクワクの宝探しの始まりだな
lines.translated: "All right. Ready to head out? It's time to kick off our thrilling, exciting treasure hunt."

lines.content: ――宝探し。
lines.translated: --Treasure hunt.

lines.content: この町“参禅町”にはたくさんの“噂話”が眠っている。
lines.translated: Countless "rumors" lay dormant in this town, Sanzen Town.

lines.content: 幼い頃はその一つひとつに心をわくわくどきどき弾ませて……。
lines.translated: When we were little, every single one of them made our hearts race with excitement...

lines.content: それらの“謎”と実際に出会うため、この町中を探索し、駆け回っていた。それをかつての俺たちは[宝探し|そう]と呼んでいたのだ。
lines.translated: To actually encounter those "mysteries" for ourselves, we would explore and run all over town. Back then, we used to call that "treasure hunting."

lines.content: もう一度、昔みたいに。
lines.translated: Once again, just like the old days.

lines.content: 昔々の自分たちには、負けないように。
lines.translated: Making sure we don't lose to the kids we used to be way back when.

lines.content: ……制服から私服に着替えてきた千和が加わった。
lines.translated: Chiwa, having changed out of her uniform and into her casual clothes, joined us.

lines.content: では各自、装備の確認をしようと思う。何たって宝探しだからな。さ、並んで並んで
lines.translated: "Now then, let's do an equipment check for everyone. This is a treasure hunt, after all. Come on, line up, line up."

lines.content: おー。何かはじまったぞ。結構、乗り気なんだな大雅
lines.translated: "Ooh, looks like something's starting. You're pretty into this, huh, Taiga?"

lines.content: もー。そういうのいいから早く行きましょうよ先輩。のんびりしてたらお昼になっちゃいますよ
lines.translated: "Geez. Never mind all that, let's just get going already, Senpai. If we dawdle around, it'll be noon before we know it."

lines.content: あ。そうそう。ひとつ言い忘れてたけど……あのさ、千和
lines.translated: "Ah, right, right. I forgot to mention one thing, though... Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: はい？　何ですか？
lines.translated: "Yes? What is it?"

lines.content: うん。私服もかわいいよ。すごく
lines.translated: "Yeah. Your casual clothes are cute, too. Super cute."

lines.content: びくっとする。真っ赤だ。とっても。
lines.translated: She flinched. Bright red. Thoroughly so.

lines.content: 新しいお店の制服もよかったけど、その私服もいい。とてもいい
lines.translated: "The new shop uniform looked great, too, but those casual clothes are nice. Really nice."
"--Huh... eh... what?"

lines.content: 今日は素直でいたい気分な俺だから意地悪なしだ。……かわいい。すごくかわいいよ千和
lines.translated: "I'm in the mood to be honest with myself today, so no teasing from me. ...You're cute. Super cute, Chiwa."

lines.content: と、と、とちゅぜん何なんでちかっ、意味が――っ
lines.translated: "W-W-What's wipth you all of a chudden?! I don't--"

lines.content: 噛んだ。連続で。
lines.translated: She stumbled over her words. Twice in a row.

lines.content: い、意味が！　まったく！　わかりませんけど……っ
lines.translated: "I-I don't get what you mean! At all...!"

lines.content: どこが不明だというのか。物事はあまりに明瞭ではないか
lines.translated: "What part of it is unclear? Is the matter not abundantly obvious?"

lines.content: しみじみと千和を見る。
lines.translated: I gazed earnestly at Chiwa.

lines.content: こんなにかわいく育って……。お父さんはとってもうれしい。どこへ出しても恥ずかしくない美少女だ
lines.translated: "To think you've grown up this cute... It makes your dad so happy. You're a gorgeous girl I can be proud to take anywhere."

lines.content: うんうんとうなずく。そしてじろじろと見る。眺める。
lines.translated: I nodded approvingly. And then I stared right at her. Just admiring the view.

lines.content: 目を細め唇を尖らせる千和だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa narrowed her eyes and pouted.

lines.content: 俺の視線に居心地悪そうに身体をもじもじさせていた。
lines.translated: She fidgeted uncomfortably under my gaze.

lines.content: ねえねえたいがぁー、私は？　私はどーなの？
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Taigaaa, what about me? How do I look?"

lines.content: うむ。きゃわいい
lines.translated: "Indeed. Adorable."

lines.content: わっほい。やったぜ
lines.translated: "Woohoo! Score!"

lines.content: グッと、親指を立て合った。
lines.translated: We gave each other a big thumbs-up.

lines.content: よし。ではひよちゃん。まずは君からだ。忘れ物はないかな？
lines.translated: "All right. Let's start with you, Hiyo-chan. Did you forget anything?"
