lines.content: ひよちゃんにお願いしていたのはシャベルだったね。忘れずちゃんと、持ってきた？
lines.translated: "I asked you to bring a shovel, right, Hiyo-chan? Did you remember to bring it?"

lines.content: きたよー
lines.translated: "I brought it!"

lines.content: ポシェットから取り出したものを掲げる姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori held up what she'd pulled out of her pochette.

lines.content: あれ。……それ、小さくないかなひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Huh. ...Isn't that a little small, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: シャベルじゃなくてスコップだ。驚きだね
lines.translated: "That's a trowel, not a shovel. Color me surprised."

lines.content: 黄色い色だ。幼稚園児が使うような小さなやつだ。
lines.translated: It was yellow. A tiny little thing like the kind a kindergartener would use.

lines.content: ……だめ？
lines.translated: "...Is it no good?"

lines.content: ううん。だめではないが、いざというとき使うには……うーん。掘ったりしにくいんでないかな？
lines.translated: "No, it's not that it's no good, per se, but if we actually need to use it... Hmm. Won't it be kinda hard to dig with?"

lines.content: 昔々の思い出を探して回るんでしょう？　ハルちゃんに新しくなった町の部分を紹介して歩くついでに
lines.translated: "We're going around looking for memories from way back when, right? While showing Haru-chan the parts of town that have changed."

lines.content: だから持ち寄る道具も小さな頃に使っていたもののほうがよかろうかと思いまして……？
lines.translated: "So I thought it might be better if the tools we brought were the ones we used when we were little...?"

lines.content: 小首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: うん？　だったらまあ、それもいいかもね……？
lines.translated: "Hmm? Well, if you put it that way, maybe it's fine...?"

lines.content: 俺も小首をかしげながらそう言った。
lines.translated: I tilted my own head as I said that.

lines.content: じゃあ次は千和だ
lines.translated: "Okay, next up is Chiwa."

lines.content: ええっと……。
lines.translated: Let's see...

lines.content: 千和には何を持ってきてって頼んでたんだっけ
lines.translated: "What did I ask you to bring again, Chiwa?"

lines.content: コンパスですよ。もしかしたら山の中に入ることもあるかもしれないからって……
lines.translated: "A compass. Since you said we might end up going into the mountains..."

lines.content: うん。そうだった
lines.translated: "Right. That's what it was."

lines.content: お父さんから借りました。結構高いものらしいですけど……
lines.translated: "I borrowed it from my dad. Apparently it's pretty expensive, though..."

lines.content: 千和が取り出したのは小さな箱だ。指輪の箱くらいの小さなサイズ。
lines.translated: Chiwa pulled out a small box. Tiny, about the size of a ring box.

lines.content: その側面にあるスイッチを押すと――がちゃり。
lines.translated: When she pressed a switch on the side--*click*.

lines.content: 仕掛けられたギミックが作動する。一瞬で箱が開いた。
lines.translated: The built-in mechanism activated. The box snapped open in an instant.

lines.content: 中から円形の盤が飛び出すように現れて、
lines.translated: A circular dial popped right out from the inside, and--

lines.content: おお～。ガチャっていったぞガチャって
lines.translated: "Whoa~! It went click, it totally went click!"

lines.content: かぁっこいいなあこれ。ゼンマイ？　歯車？　どうなってんのかなあ、これ
lines.translated: "Man, that's so cool. A mainspring? Gears? How does this thing even work?"

lines.content: 歓声を上げる。
lines.translated: We let out a cheer.

lines.content: 男の子はこういうのが大好きなのだ。いつまで経っても。子どもであろうと、大人であろうと。
lines.translated: Boys love this kind of stuff. No matter how old they get. Whether they're kids or grown adults.

lines.content: トランスフォームするその動作をわいわい言いながら何度か堪能。
lines.translated: Making a big fuss over it, we thoroughly enjoyed watching its transforming action a few more times.

lines.content: よし。次はハルだな
lines.translated: "All right. Next is Haru."

lines.content: ひとしきり遊んだあと、俺はハルを振り向く。
lines.translated: After playing around with it for a good while, I turned back toward Haru.

lines.content: ハルにお願いしたのは小腹対策の飴玉だったね
lines.translated: "I asked you to bring hard candies in case we get hungry, right, Haru?"

lines.content: うん。持ってきたよ。昨日コンビニでいっぱい買って来たんだけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I brought them. I bought a whole bunch at the convenience store yesterday, though..."

lines.content: ハルはビニール袋をテーブルに置いた。
lines.translated: Haru set a plastic bag on the table.

lines.content: パックで販売されている飴玉の袋がいっぱい詰め込まれている。
lines.translated: It was stuffed full of packaged bags of hard candy.

lines.content: こんな感じでよかったかな。美味しそうなのを手当たり次第って感じなんだけど……買いすぎちゃったかも
lines.translated: "I hope this is okay. I kind of just grabbed whatever looked good... Maybe I bought too much."

lines.content: いやまあ、確かに。飴玉は俺のポケットにもいっぱい入ってるけどさ……
lines.translated: "Well, yeah, that's a lot. Though my pockets are stuffed with candy, too..."

lines.content: だめだよ。ともちゃんのポッケの中の甘いのは私だけのおやつなんだもん。だから誰にも渡さないのだ
lines.translated: "No way. The sweets in Tomo-chan's pockets are snacks just for me. So you're not giving them to anyone else!"

lines.content: ……と、まあ。食いしん坊のかいじゅーがいるからね。たぶん俺の持ってる分だけじゃおっつかないし。おやつはたくさんあっても困らないんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "...And, well, we've got a gluttonous little monster with us. What I've got on me probably wouldn't be enough to keep up anyway. Having plenty of snacks can't hurt, right?"

lines.content: そうだな。余れば全員でわけて帰ってもいいしな……それで、智仁はどうだ？
lines.translated: "True. If we have leftovers, we can just split them up among everyone before heading home... So, how about you, Tomohito?"

lines.content: ん？　どうとは？
lines.translated: "Hm? How about me what?"

lines.content: 智仁に頼んだのは町の地図だったが……
lines.translated: "I asked you to bring a map of the town, right...?"

lines.content: ああ、そっかそっか。もちろん持ってきたさ。これでいいかな？
lines.translated: "Ah, right, right. Of course I brought it. Will this do?"

lines.content: 智仁が取り出したものに、俺は首をかしげる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head at what Tomohito pulled out.

lines.content: 確かに地図は地図だが、これ、観光客用のグルメマップじゃないか。こんなの持ち出したら――
lines.translated: "I mean, it's definitely a map, sure, but isn't this a foodie map for tourists? If you whip out something like this--"

lines.content: ご飯の、けはいっ
lines.translated: "I sense... food!"

lines.content: ぎらり。
lines.translated: Glint.

lines.content: ――ほら、見ろよ。うちのかわいいかいじゅーが暴れ出しちゃうだろ。こんなの開いていたら宝探しどころじゃなくなっちまうぞ
lines.translated: "--See? Look! Our cute little monster's gonna go on a rampage. If you open something like that, you can kiss our treasure hunt goodbye."

lines.content: いやあ、自分の町の地図なんて、そんなのわざわざ持っておかないしなあ。そもそもどこで手に入れるのかわからなかったし。だからこれを買ってきた
lines.translated: "Come on, nobody goes out of their way to keep a map of their own town lying around. I didn't even know where to get one in the first place. So I bought this instead."

lines.content: どこって。ふつうに本屋で売ってるだろうに……たぶん。そうだよな？
lines.translated: "What do you mean, where? They'd sell them at any normal bookstore... probably. Right?"

lines.content: ――と、まあ、うん。
lines.translated: --Well, anyway, yeah.

lines.content: こうしてみんなに頼んだものは、どれも実際に使用されることはないだろうものだ。
lines.translated: None of the things I'd asked everyone to bring like this would likely see any actual use.

lines.content: “宝探し”っぽい装備を固めて挑もうと決めたのは、形から入ってみるのも楽しそうだなあという、ただそれだけの理由だったのだから。
lines.translated: Deciding to gear up with "treasure hunt"-style equipment for the occasion was simply because I figured getting into the spirit of things by looking the part sounded like fun, and nothing more.

lines.content: あとは各自お弁当さえ持って来てりゃ問題なしだな。まあ、それが一番大切な装備品だよな
lines.translated: "As long as everyone brought their own lunch, we're good to go. Well, that's the most important piece of equipment, anyway."

lines.content: 姫織はもちろんのこと、全員がちゃんと持ってきているとうなずいた。
lines.translated: Everyone nodded to confirm they'd brought theirs--Himeori included, of course.

lines.content: 水筒だってちゃんと持ってきているんだよ。中身はカルピス。ひよりちゃんは抜かりがないのだ
lines.translated: "I even made sure to bring my canteen! It's got Calpis inside. Hiyori-chan leaves nothing to chance!"

lines.content: おおー、偉いなぁ、さすがはひよちゃん。できる女って感じだね
lines.translated: "Whoa, good job. Leave it to Hiyo-chan. Total capable-woman vibes right there."

lines.content: ふっふん
lines.translated: "Heh heh."

lines.content: 得意そうにする姫織の頭を撫でてみたり。
lines.translated: I gave the proud-looking Himeori a little pat on the head.

lines.content: すると更に姫織は得意げな顔をするのだった。
lines.translated: Which only made Himeori look even smugger.

lines.content: そして俺たちは誰からともなく“行ってきます”と口にして、千和のお店から町へと繰り出す――
lines.translated: And then, without anyone in particular starting it, we all called out "See you later!" and headed out from Chiwa's shop into the town--

lines.content: そんな光景の中に、俺はふと思い出してしまう。
lines.translated: Amidst that scene, a memory suddenly came back to me.

lines.content: 十数年間。
lines.translated: Over a decade ago.

lines.content: 放課後にはみんなでこうして集まって“宝探し”をしようよ――ハルがそう言い出した、最初の日だ。
lines.translated: That was the very first day Haru had suggested we all get together after school like this and go on a "treasure hunt."

lines.content: 俺たちは同じようにそれぞれ装備を持ち合って、同じように、“行ってきます”とそう言って、町へと繰り出していったのだと。
lines.translated: Just like today, we had all brought our own gear, called out "See you later!", and headed out into the town.

lines.content: 『さあ冒険の始まりだね。どんな“噂話”から検証してみよっか』
lines.translated: "Now then, our adventure begins! Which 'rumor' should we investigate first?"

lines.content: 『……怖いのはちょっと嫌です』
lines.translated: "...I'd rather not do anything scary."

lines.content: 『そうだね。賛成。まずはね、やさしいのがいいかなあって思うよ？』
lines.translated: "Yeah, I agree. I think we should start with something nice and easy, don't you?"

lines.content: 『怖くないもの。安全なもの、かあ。むむむ。どんなものがあったかなあ』
lines.translated: "Something not scary. Something safe, huh? Hmmm. What kind of rumors did we have like that?"

lines.content: 『えっと……私たちの仲間を探しに行くんですよね？　楽しみです』
lines.translated: "Um... we're going to look for friends like us, right? I can't wait."
"...Friends?"

lines.content: 『うん、そうだよともくん』
lines.translated: "Yep, that's right, Tomo-kun."

lines.content: 『“この町には怖いこわい悪夢を刈り取る特別な少女たちがいる”』
lines.translated: "'In this town, there are special girls who reap terrible, scary nightmares.'"

lines.content: 『そんな噂は、本物だよね？』
lines.translated: "That rumor is real, right?"

lines.content: 『俺たちみんながその“噂話”の正体だ』
lines.translated: "All of us are the truth behind that 'rumor.'"

lines.content: 『うん。だからね、もしかしたら私たちみたいに、本当な“噂話”もあるかもしれないし……』
lines.translated: "Yeah. So, maybe there are other 'rumors' out there that are real, just like us..."

lines.content: 『そんな“何か”を探し出せたら、“噂話”同士、“都市伝説”同士、そして“不思議なもの”同士、わかり合えるような何かがあるかもしれないし……』
lines.translated: "And if we can find 'something' like that, maybe as fellow 'rumors,' fellow 'urban legends,' and fellow 'mysterious things,' we'll have something in common to help us understand each other..."

lines.content: 『そっか。だから仲間、なんだね……うんっ』
lines.translated: "I see. That's what you mean by friends... Yeah!"

lines.content: 『もしかしたらひとりぼっちでさみしい思いをしてるかもしれない、私たち以外にあるかもしれない本物の“不思議”を探し出してあげるのも、いいかもしれないね』
lines.translated: "Maybe there's another real 'mystery' out there besides us, all alone and feeling lonely. Tracking them down might be a nice thing to do, too."

lines.content: さあ、十年ぶりの小さなちいさな大冒険のはじまりだね。まずはどこに行ってみようか
lines.translated: "All right, it's the start of our tiny, little big adventure, ten years in the making! Where should we go first?"

lines.content: “特別”ではない[・|今][・|の][・|ハ][・|ル]がそう言って俺たちを振り向いた。
lines.translated: Saying that, the Haru of today--no longer "special"--turned back to look at us.

lines.content: 昔々の私たちみたいに、この町にいっぱいちりばめられている“噂”を、“秘密”を、そして“謎”を、みんなで一緒に解き明かしに出かけよう
lines.translated: "Just like we used to do a long, long time ago, let's all go out together to unravel the 'rumors,' the 'secrets,' and the 'mysteries' scattered all across this town!"

lines.content: 千和のお店を出てすぐだ。笑っていた。さくら色で満たされた町の風景に溶け込むように。
lines.translated: It was right after we stepped out of Chiwa's shop. She was smiling, as if blending right into the cherry-blossom-colored scenery of the town.

lines.content: その姿は、遠い昔の彼女の笑顔とダブって見えた。
lines.translated: Seeing her like that overlapped with the smiling face she used to have so long ago.

lines.content: ――町中に散らばっているのだろう遥か昔の面影を、こういうふうにして探し出せていければいい。俺たちがまた“幼馴染み”として新しく始められる、そのために。
lines.translated: --I hoped we could keep finding traces of the distant past scattered throughout the town just like this. All so that we could make a fresh start as "childhood friends" once again.

lines.content: そして俺は、“夜の左手”を握りしめる。
lines.translated: And then, I clenched my "left hand of the night."

lines.content: “拳銃”と“弾丸”だ。
lines.translated: The "handgun" and the "bullet."

lines.content: この俺、奏大雅は“魔法少女『使い』”である――柊ハルの笑顔を前にして、改めて俺は[・|そ][・|れ]を意識せずにいられない。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, am a "Magical Girl 'User'"--standing before Hiiragi Haru's smile, I couldn't help but be acutely aware of that fact all over again.

lines.content: 『……どうか私を、“魔法少女”に戻してください』
lines.translated: "...Please, turn me back into a 'magical girl.'"

lines.content: 彼女や彼女らの困難な“夢”を叶えるか。それとも、彼女らの“魔法”を危険と判断し、奪うのか。
lines.translated: Would I grant her and the other girls' difficult "dreams"? Or would I judge their "magic" to be dangerous, and strip it away?

lines.content: その決定権はこの俺の左手こそに宿されている。
lines.translated: The power to make that choice resided right here in my left hand.
There was very little time left.

lines.content: 今日という日の時間が、俺の中にある“夢”だとか“希望”だとかを叶えるための礎になればいいと、そう、願おう。
lines.translated: I could only pray that the hours of this day would become a foundation for fulfilling the "dreams" and "hopes" I held inside me.

lines.content: ……さあ。
lines.translated: All right.

lines.content: まずはどこへ行こうか。
lines.translated: Where should we head first?

lines.content: ハルと一緒に。千和と並んで。姫織と歩いて。智仁とふざけ合ってみたりして。
lines.translated: Together with Haru. Side by side with Chiwa. Walking with Himeori. Goofing around with Tomohito.

lines.content: 俺たちの[な|失]くした過去と未来を、探しに行こうか。
lines.translated: Let's go search for our lost past and future.

lines.content: 俺たちの失くした過去と未来を、探しに行こうか。
lines.translated: Let's go search for our lost past and future.

lines.content: 大通りを散策
lines.translated: Stroll down the main street

lines.content: 夜月神社
lines.translated: Yotsuki Shrine

lines.content: 小さな石橋
lines.translated: The small stone bridge

lines.content: 町の大通りにやって来た。
lines.translated: We arrived at the town's main street.

lines.content: うわあ。人がいっぱいだー
lines.translated: "Whoa. There are so many people~"

lines.content: 意外にも――と言えるかどうかは定かではないが、人混みがあまり得意ではない姫織である。げんなりとしたように目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Surprisingly--though I'm not sure if you could really call it surprising--Himeori wasn't very good with crowds. She was squinting her eyes, looking thoroughly exhausted already.

lines.content: 今日はお休みだからね。日曜日だ。人が多いのは仕方がないよ
lines.translated: "Well, it's a day off today. It's Sunday, so a big crowd is kind of unavoidable."

lines.content: “噂”とか。“不思議”なこととか。……うーん。こんな人気の多いところに何か“秘密”があるのかなあ
lines.translated: "'Rumors,' or 'mysteries'... Hmm. I wonder if there's really any kind of 'secret' in a place crowded with this many people."

lines.content: 人が多いと何かおかしいですか？
lines.translated: "Is there something wrong with having a lot of people around?"

lines.content: だって、ほら、秘密は隠されているから秘密なわけだし……。[・|そ][・|れ]が人だとしても、そうじゃないとしても。人目の多いところで隠れるのは難しいんじゃないかなって
lines.translated: "Well, I mean, a secret is only a secret because it's hidden, right...? Whether it's a person or something else entirely, wouldn't it be hard to stay hidden with so many eyes around?"

lines.content: だったらもうここはいいでしょう？　別のところに移動しようよ
lines.translated: "In that case, we're done here, right? Let's move somewhere else."

lines.content: まあ、そうだな。俺もひよちゃんと同じであまり人が多いのは得意じゃないけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah, good point. I'm not great with big crowds either, just like Hiyo-chan, though..."

lines.content: 智仁はぐるりと町を見渡す。
lines.translated: Tomohito looked all around at the town.

lines.content: しかしなあ。ここにいる一人ひとりに俺たちの関われない別の人生があるんだと思うと……なんだか、すごいな。世界って広いんだな
lines.translated: "Still, man. When you think about how every single person here has their own separate life that we'll never be a part of... it's kind of amazing. The world really is a big place, huh?"

lines.content: 大通りは観光客たちでガヤガヤとにぎわっていた。
lines.translated: The main street was bustling and noisy with tourists.

lines.content: 遠い町から。遠い国から。
lines.translated: From distant towns. From distant countries.

lines.content: 様々な場所から様々な人たちが集まってくる。
lines.translated: All kinds of people gathered here from all kinds of places.

lines.content: 彼らが目的とするものは様々あるのだが……。
lines.translated: They all had their own various reasons for coming, though...

lines.content: あ
lines.translated: "Ah."

lines.content: ハルが何かを発見したようだ。
lines.translated: It looked like Haru had spotted something.

lines.content: あれは……何？
lines.translated: "What is... that?"

lines.content: 指をさす。首をかしげて。
lines.translated: She pointed a finger, tilting her head.

lines.content: その先にあったもの。それは町に放置されたままの市電車両だった。
lines.translated: Just ahead of where she was pointing sat an old streetcar, left abandoned right there in the town.

lines.content: しかしハルの興味を引いたのは車両そのものについてではなくて……。
lines.translated: However, what had caught Haru's interest wasn't the streetcar itself...

lines.content: なんだかすっごく……きれいだよ？
lines.translated: "It's kind of... really pretty, isn't it?"

lines.content: ……車両の側面に絵が描かれているからだった。
lines.translated: It was because paintings had been drawn all across the sides of the car.

lines.content: さくらの絵だ。空と海の絵だ。紅葉に染まる道の絵だ。吹雪に煙る街の絵だ。
lines.translated: A painting of cherry blossoms. A painting of the sky and the sea. A painting of a road dyed in autumn leaves. A painting of a town hazy with a snowstorm.

lines.content: 四季折々の絵だけでなく、前衛的なものだったり写実的なものだったり……[・|そ][・|こ]には様々な絵が描かれている。
lines.translated: Not only were there scenes of the four seasons, but avant-garde pieces and realistic works as well... A wide variety of art was painted right onto it.

lines.content: ハルがいた頃はまだ市電が町中を走ってたように思うけど……
lines.translated: "I think the streetcars were still running through town back when you were here, Haru..."

lines.content: うん。そんな気がするよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I think I remember that."

lines.content: 少し前に廃線になっちゃったんだ。今はみんなバスを使って移動してる
lines.translated: "The line was shut down a little while back. Everyone uses the bus to get around now."

lines.content: しかし使われなくなった線路は敷かれたままだし、車両も車庫に収められることもなく町中にぽつりぽつりと放置されてしまっている。
lines.translated: Even so, the disused tracks had been left right where they were, and the streetcars themselves hadn't been put away in a depot, instead left sitting abandoned here and there across town.

lines.content: 市電の会社が夜逃げしたとかなんだとかで……。
lines.translated: Something about the streetcar company skipping town in the middle of the night, or whatever it was...

lines.content: そしてその頃の町は豊かとは言い難かった。まだ観光産業のようなものが盛んではなかった。
lines.translated: And back then, you couldn't exactly call the town prosperous. It didn't have a thriving tourism industry yet.

lines.content: 故に。仕方なく廃線上に放置され続けた車両たちだ。
lines.translated: Because of that, with no other choice, the streetcars had simply been left sitting on the abandoned tracks.

lines.content: だけどつい二年位前かな？　町に住んでた芸術家が放置された電車に絵を描きだしたんだよ
lines.translated: "But I think it was just about two years ago? An artist living in town started painting pictures on the abandoned train cars."

lines.content: それに触発されたのかは定かでないが――
lines.translated: Whether they were inspired by that or not, I couldn't say for sure, but--

lines.content: 他の芸術家たちも挙って車両に絵を描いたり、奇妙奇天烈なオブジェを作って車内を飾ったり、収まらなければ町中にまた放置したりし始めた。
lines.translated: Other artists all started painting the streetcars too, or making bizarre, eccentric art installations to decorate the interiors--and when they ran out of room inside, they started leaving them sitting all over town as well.

lines.content: それがなんだか珍しいとか芸術的価値だとか……なんだかんだとテレビの人たちが騒ぎ出したんだよな
lines.translated: "And then the TV people started making a big fuss about how unique it was, or how much artistic value it had, and all that."

lines.content: 結果。この町は観光客たちの巣窟となる――直接的な原因であったとしても、[・|そ][・|れ]が全要因ではないかもしれない。
lines.translated: As a result, this town became a hotbed for tourists--though even if that was the direct trigger, it might not have been the only factor.

lines.content: 実際に列車の絵や町中に散乱しているげーじゅつ的なオブジェだけを目的に[観光客|彼ら]たちはやって来るわけではないのだから。
lines.translated: After all, the tourists didn't just come here for the painted trains and the "artistic" installations scattered across town.

lines.content: 他にはさくらとか、夜月先輩の神社とか。猫ちゃんの姿を見つけられるかもしれない[・|気][・|配]だとか。そういうのを目的にたくさんの人たちがやって来るようになって……
lines.translated: "There are also the cherry blossoms, and Yotsuki-senpai's shrine. Plus the feeling that you might catch a glimpse of a kitty-cat. Lots of people started coming here looking for things like that..."

lines.content: うん。ここはね、このありさまなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. And now the place is in this state!"

lines.content: 姫織は小さな両手をいっぱいに広げ、
lines.translated: Himeori spread her small arms out wide.

lines.content: 昔は静かだったのに、今はわちゃわちゃってしてる。知らない人たちがいーっぱいなんだよ
lines.translated: "It used to be so quiet, but now it's all noisy and chaotic. It's packed full of people we don't know!"

lines.content: 私たちの生活してる区画はまだ静かですけど……。いつまでそうかはわからないですよね
lines.translated: "The neighborhood where we live is still quiet, though... Who knows how long that will last, right?"

lines.content: 千和のお店も大通りに面した場所にある。
lines.translated: Chiwa's shop faced the main street, too.

lines.content: しかしそこはまだ、ここのように大勢の人でごった返してはいない。
lines.translated: However, that area wasn't overflowing with huge crowds of people like it was here yet.

lines.content: 昔は静かだったのに、かあ
lines.translated: "It used to be so quiet, huh..."

lines.content: ハルは辺りを見渡す。
lines.translated: Haru looked around at the area.

lines.content: 昔の私たちって、ここでどんなことして遊んでたんだったっけ。どんな“噂話”とか“不思議”なことを探そうとしてたんだっけ
lines.translated: "What kind of games did we used to play here back then? What kind of 'rumors' or 'mysteries' were we trying to find?"

lines.content: みんなでこの大通りを何度も行き来していたってことだけは、なんとなく覚えてるんだけど……
lines.translated: "I vaguely remember all of us walking up and down this main street over and over again, though..."

lines.content: 人の群れが少なくなってきたところでハルが言った。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up as the crowd of people around us began to thin out.

lines.content: 十年って言葉にする以上に長い長い時間なんだね。……おかしいな。確かなことはもう殆ど思い出せないよ
lines.translated: "Ten years really is a much, much longer time than it sounds when you put it into words. ...It's strange. I can barely remember anything for sure anymore."

lines.content: そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 昔。十年前。思い出そうとするのは今より人通りも少なく、静かであっただろう大通りの風景だ。
lines.translated: Back then. Ten years ago. What I tried to picture was the scenery of the main street as it must have been--with fewer people passing through than now, and much quieter.

lines.content: 俺たちはそこでどのようなことに夢中になっていただろう。
lines.translated: What had we been so absorbed in doing here?

lines.content: それを僅かにでも思い出せれば、探し出さなければならない宝物の隠し場所についても思い出せるかもしれない――……ふと。
lines.translated: If I could remember even a little bit of it, maybe I'd be able to recall the hiding spot of the treasure we needed to track down, too--...Suddenly.

lines.content: 突然だった。
lines.translated: It came out of nowhere.

lines.content: 行き交う人が途切れたその瞬間だ。
lines.translated: Right at the moment when the flow of passersby broke off.

lines.content: 俺の頭の中に、まるでため息でもつくかのように、記憶が芽生えた。
lines.translated: Inside my head, as softly as letting out a sigh, a memory sprouted.

lines.content: 『ねえねえ知ってる？　この町の七不思議』
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, do you know? About the seven mysteries of this town!"

lines.content: 『え～？　それってどんなの？』
lines.translated: "Huh~? What are those like?"

lines.content: 『この町には地下帝国があってね、それは一階だけじゃなくて、二階、三階、四階って、ずっと、ずっと、地下にたくさんたくさん、広がっているんだって』
lines.translated: "They say there's an underground empire beneath this town! And it's not just one floor, either--it goes down two floors, three floors, four floors, spreading out way, way, waaay down underground!"

lines.content: 『地下帝国ぅ～？』
lines.translated: "An underground empire~?"

lines.content: 『ええ～っ、何それすごいっ、楽しそうね、おねえちゃんわくわくしちゃうなあ……そこには何があるのかな』
lines.translated: "Eeeh~, what is that, that's amazing! It sounds so fun, you're making big sis all excited... I wonder what's down there?"

lines.content: 『うん。とっても怖いものが住んでるって噂だよ』
lines.translated: "Yeah. The rumor is that something super scary lives down there."

lines.content: 『私たち地上の人より賢い頭の持ち主で、すっごいぶんめーの持ち主で……そのおかげで、地上の私たちにはずっとその人たちのこと、見つけられないんだっていう噂』
lines.translated: "They're way smarter than us surface people, and they have a super amazing civ-uh-lization... And the rumor says that's why we on the surface have never been able to find them."

lines.content: 『怖いもの……』
lines.translated: "Something scary..."

lines.content: 『あ、それ、私も知ってる』
lines.translated: "Oh, I know about that one, too."

lines.content: 『もしもその怖いものに出会えたなら。そして気に入ってもらえたなら……とってもすごい科学の力で、決して死なない身体にしてもらえるっていうやつだよね？』
lines.translated: "If you ever manage to meet that scary thing, and if it takes a liking to you... it uses the power of super amazing science to give you a body that can never die, right?"

lines.content: 『うん。それそれ。死なない身体……つまりはさ、永遠のいのちってことだよね』
lines.translated: "Yep, that's the one. A body that can't die... In other words, it means eternal life, right?"

lines.content: 『あはは。永遠の命、かあ。確かに立派な“噂話”だね。夢と希望に溢れてる』
lines.translated: "Ahaha. Eternal life, huh? That sure is a grand 'rumor.' Full of dreams and hope."

lines.content: 『不老不死ってやつかあ。そういうのときめいちゃうなあ』
lines.translated: "Immortality, huh? Stuff like that really gets the heart racing."

lines.content: 『えへへ。男の子ってこういうの好きだよねえ』
lines.translated: "Ehehe. Boys really love this kind of stuff, don't they?"

lines.content: 『とにかくそういう噂があるんだよ。この町の七不思議の、ひとつ』
lines.translated: "Anyway, that's the rumor going around. It's one of the seven mysteries of this town."

lines.content: 『うむ。ハルちゃんの言う通りだ。それならその不思議、俺たちが解明してやらなきゃならないよな』
lines.translated: "Mhm. Just like Haru-chan says. In that case, we're gonna have to get to the bottom of this mystery ourselves, right?"

lines.content: 『どうして……？』
『どうして？　はは。人生は穴掘りだって言うだろ？』
lines.translated: "Why? Haha. They say life is all about digging holes, don't they?"

lines.content: 『誰が言ってったっけ。その言葉』
lines.translated: "Who was it that said that again?"

lines.content: 『野暮だなあ大雅。俺に決まってるだろ』
lines.translated: "Don't play dumb, Taiga. Obviously it was me."

lines.content: 『穴を掘って掘って、地底の人たちとこんにちはってしてやるんだよ』
lines.translated: "We'll dig and dig a hole, and go say hello to the underground people."

lines.content: 『むむ。それにね、もしもね、こんにちわってしたその怖いのが、誰かを傷つけちゃってたら大変だしね。だったら私たちが怖いもの退治をしなきゃだよね』
lines.translated: "Mhm! Plus, you know, what if that scary thing we say hello to ends up hurting someone? That would be terrible! If that happens, we'll have to exterminate the scary thing ourselves, right?"

lines.content: だって私たちは“夜”になれば誰にも負けない“魔法少女”になれるから、と誰かが言った。
lines.translated: Because once "Night" falls, we can become "magical girls" who won't lose to anyone, someone had said.

lines.content: 『でも、地下の入り口はどこにあるのかなあ？　そんなの知らない。見たことないよ？　聞いたことだってないのかも』
lines.translated: "But I wonder where the entrance to the underground is? I don't know anything like that. I've never seen it! Maybe I've never even heard about it."

lines.content: 『うん！　だからそれを今から探しに行こうよっ』
lines.translated: "Yeah! So let's go look for it right now!"

lines.content: 『あ～……本気でやるんだね。“宝探し”』
lines.translated: "Ah~... We're seriously doing this, huh? A 'treasure hunt.'"

lines.content: 『もちろんだよ。やってみなきゃ何もわかんないもんね。楽しいことかも、怖いことかも。だからこれは立派に“宝探し”なんだよ。きっとね』
lines.translated: "Of course we are. We won't know anything unless we try, right? Whether it's something fun, or something scary. That's why this is a full-fledged 'treasure hunt.' For sure."

lines.content: 『俺はハルちゃんに賛成だなあ。大賛成だ。だって面白そうだろう』
lines.translated: "I'm with Haru-chan on this one. A hundred percent on board. It sounds fun, doesn't it?"

lines.content: 『あ～っ、私も私もー』
lines.translated: "Ah~, me too, me too!"

lines.content: 『え、えええ～……私は……私、その……』
lines.translated: "E-Eeeeh~... I... I, um..."

lines.content: 『よおし、それじゃあさっそく行こうよ。みんな揃って放課後の大冒険のはじまりだよっ』
lines.translated: "Alright, then let's get going right away! It's the start of a grand after-school adventure with everyone together!"

lines.content: 『や、やめようよ。きっと、危険だよ』
lines.translated: "L-Let's not. It's definitely dangerous."

lines.content: 『ねえ、[・|お][・|兄][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん]。お兄ちゃんもそう思うでしょう？　どうしてわざわざ、自分から、危なそうなことに向かって行かなきゃ、ならないの……？』
lines.translated: "Hey, Onii-chan. You think so too, right, Onii-chan? Why do we have to go out of our way to head straight into something that seems dangerous...?"

lines.content: 思い出せたのはそんな小さなワンシーン。
lines.translated: What I managed to remember was just that one little scene.

lines.content: みんなで探し出した興味深い“[宝物|謎]”
lines.translated: An intriguing "mystery" that we had all tracked down together.

lines.content: “地下帝国”“そこに住んでる怖いモノ”
lines.translated: The "Underground Empire," and the "Scary Thing living there."

lines.content: 嘘かほんとか。真実か、否か。
lines.translated: Was it a lie or the truth? Real, or not?

lines.content: かつての俺たちはそれらを確かめようとしていたはずだ。
lines.translated: Back then, we must have been trying to find out for ourselves.

lines.content: “地下帝国”というのは“夜の国”のことだったのではないか――誰かがそう推測していたのもまた思い出せる。
lines.translated: Couldn't the "Underground Empire" actually have been the "Country of Night"? --I could also remember someone speculating that.

lines.content: 入り口の存在しないこことは違う別の国。
lines.translated: A different country from this one, with no entrance to be found.

lines.content: この町と表裏一体で存在している“不思議の国”だ。
lines.translated: A "Wonderland" existing as two sides of the same coin with this town.

lines.content: その正体を知らない町の子らが、[・|そ][・|れ]は地下にあるのではないかと結論づけたのではないか。
lines.translated: Perhaps the town kids, not knowing its true nature, had concluded that *it* must be located underground.

lines.content: 子どもならではの……まさに、“想像力”を豊かにし。
lines.translated: Truly letting their "imaginations" run wild... in a way only children could.

lines.content: ともあれ、だ。
lines.translated: Regardless.

lines.content: 思い出せたそれらの記憶を、俺は簡単にみんなに伝えた。
lines.translated: I briefly shared those memories I had just recalled with everyone.

lines.content: あ、あはは。“地下帝国”かあ。うん。そんなこともあったよね。懐かしいなあ
lines.translated: "A-Ahaha. The 'Underground Empire,' huh? Yeah. That did happen, didn't it? How nostalgic."

lines.content: ハルは照れ笑いを浮かべてそう言った。
lines.translated: Haru said that with a bashful smile on her face.

lines.content: “地下帝国”に、そこに住まう“怖いモノ”――“不死のイキモノ”
lines.translated: "The 'Underground Empire,' and the 'Scary Thing' living there--an 'immortal creature.'"

lines.content: そんな“秘密”や“謎”の情報をこの大通りで収集して、確か俺たち、得られた情報を確かめようと、山の深くふかくに入り込んでいって……迷子になっちゃったんだよな
lines.translated: "We gathered info on 'secrets' and 'mysteries' like that right here on this main street, and if I remember right, we went deep, deep into the mountain to verify what we'd found... and ended up getting lost, didn't we?"

lines.content: “地下帝国”への入り口は山のどこかにあるのではないか。そのような“噂”を聞いて、それを確かめるため――深みにはまった。
lines.translated: Maybe the entrance to the "Underground Empire" was somewhere in the mountains. Hearing a "rumor" like that, we went to check it out--and got in way over our heads.

lines.content: 誰かが……
lines.translated: "Someone..."

lines.content: そんな俺たちのことを誰かが探しに来てくれて、それで助かったのを覚えてるな
lines.translated: "I remember someone came looking for us back then, and that's how we were saved."

lines.content: でも、それ、誰だったかな。ちょっと思い出せない。大人の人だったってことくらいしか
lines.translated: "Still, I wonder who that was. I can't quite remember. Only that it was an adult."

lines.content: その人にすっごく怒られちゃって、その“噂話”を追いかけるのはやめちゃったんだよね
lines.translated: "That person got super mad at us, so we stopped chasing after that 'rumor,' didn't we?"

lines.content: 怒られちゃうことは楽しくないことだって……誰かがそう言って。うん。私もちょっと思い出せたかもだね
lines.translated: "Someone said that getting scolded wasn't any fun... Yeah. I think I managed to remember a little bit, too."

lines.content: それを口にした誰かっていうのは、まあ、思い出そうとしなくてもわかるけどね。たぶん
lines.translated: "Though as for who said that, well, I think we can figure it out without even trying to remember. Probably."

lines.content: え？　な、何でみんなで私を見てるの……？
lines.translated: "Huh? W-Why is everyone looking at me...?"

lines.content: まあこんなこと始めるのも終わらせるのも、俺たちの中じゃあハルしかいないからな。つまりはそういうことだよ
lines.translated: "Well, out of all of us, you're the only one who would both start and end something like that, Haru. So that's basically what it means."

lines.content: みんな同時に思い出せた微かな記憶に安堵を覚えて……しかし。
lines.translated: Everyone felt a sense of relief at the faint memories we had recalled at the same time... However.

lines.content: 千和が静かに、いつかの俺たちが迷子になった山を見上げていたのが気にかかり……、
lines.translated: It bothered me that Chiwa was quietly looking up at the mountain where we had gotten lost back then...

lines.content: 俺、もうひとつ思い出せたよ。大切なこと
lines.translated: "I just remembered one more thing. Something important."

lines.content: ……俺は、隣の千和に向かい、言った。
lines.translated: I turned to Chiwa beside me and spoke.

lines.content: そうなんですか？　先輩はどんなこと、思い出したんですか？
lines.translated: "Oh, really? What kind of thing did you remember, Senpai?"

lines.content: こちらを振り返り、千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked back at me and asked.

lines.content: うん。あのね。思い出せたのはとっても大切で、重要なことなんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Well, you see. What I remembered is something super important and crucial."

lines.content: はい。それは、何でしょう
lines.translated: "Yes. What might that be?"

lines.content: 千和は小さな頃、俺のこと“お兄ちゃん”って呼んでたんだよなあって
lines.translated: "That when you were little, Chiwa, you used to call me 'Onii-chan.'"

lines.content: ……え？　そ、そ、それは……っ
lines.translated: "...Huh? T-T-That's...!"

lines.content: 千和。真っ赤になる。瞬く間に。
lines.translated: Chiwa turned bright red in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: どうして今はお兄ちゃんじゃなくて、先輩になっちゃったんだろうなあ。少しさみしい
lines.translated: "I wonder why it turned into 'Senpai' instead of 'Onii-chan' now. It makes me a little lonely."

lines.content: それは千和も女の子になったってことなんだよ。あの頃よりも、ずっと。大雅はもっと空気を読まなきゃだめだめだよ
lines.translated: "That just means Chiwa grew into a girl, too. Way more than she was back then. You really need to learn to read the room better, Taiga. No good, no good."

lines.content: うん、うん、と神妙に腕を組んでうなずく姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori folded her arms and nodded solemnly with a "mhm, mhm."

lines.content: 千和はね。一番ちっこくてもね、この中で一番、女の子なんだよ？　私たちと違って
lines.translated: "Even though Chiwa is the tiniest, she's the most girly out of all of us, you know? Unlike us."

lines.content: 私たちと、違うの……？
lines.translated: "Unlike... us...?"

lines.content: そう。全然、違うの
lines.translated: "Yep. Completely different."

lines.content: ちらり、と。
lines.translated: A quick glance.

lines.content: 俺たちはなんとなく揃って千和へ視線を投げていた。
lines.translated: For some reason, the rest of us all cast our gazes toward Chiwa in unison.

lines.content: すると千和はたじろいだふうに、
lines.translated: At that, Chiwa faltered a bit,

lines.content: な、何なんですかっ、いいじゃないですか、別に……っ
lines.translated: "W-What is it?! Leave me alone, it doesn't matter...!"

lines.content: 先輩のことどう呼ぼうと関係ないでしょうっ、と小さく叫ぶ。真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: It doesn't matter what I call you, Senpai! she shouted in a small voice. She was bright red.

lines.content: あ、あのときはど、どうか……どうかしてたんですっ
lines.translated: "B-Back then, I-I just... I wasn't thinking straight!"

lines.content: ただ……ただ……ただあのときは少しだけ、“お兄ちゃん”に、憧れていただけで……そう、呼べって、いわれて……だから……その……
lines.translated: "I just... just... Back then, I just admired having an 'older brother' a little bit... and, you told me to call you that... so... um..."

lines.content: 千和はすぐにもにょもにょしていた――ふむ。
lines.translated: Chiwa immediately started mumbling and fidgeting--hmm.

lines.content: 杏藤千和よ
lines.translated: "O Chiwa Andou."

lines.content: 今一度“お兄ちゃん”と呼んでみる気は
lines.translated: "Might you have any inclination to try calling me 'Onii-chan' once more?"

lines.content: ないです
lines.translated: "I do not."

lines.content: でも一度くらいは
lines.translated: "But just once?"

lines.content: ないんですってば
lines.translated: "I said I don't!"

lines.content: なぜっ、こんなにも熱い需要があるというのに……っ
lines.translated: "Why?! Even though there's such a burning demand for it...!"

lines.content: だって先輩は先輩です、私のお兄ちゃんじゃありませんっ
lines.translated: "Because you're my senpai, Senpai! You're not my older brother!"

lines.content: つんとそっぽを向いてしまう。
lines.translated: She huffed and turned her head away.

lines.content: そんな千和に、姫織がおかしそうに指をさし、
lines.translated: Himeori pointed at Chiwa in amusement,

lines.content: だって“お兄ちゃん”だと結婚できないもんねー？
lines.translated: "Because if he's your 'Onii-chan,' you wouldn't be able to marry him, right~?"

lines.content: もうっ
lines.translated: "Geez!"

lines.content: がばっ、と。
lines.translated: With a sudden lunge.

lines.content: 千和は姫織の頭を胸にしっかりと抱き寄せた。
lines.translated: Chiwa pulled Himeori's head tightly against her chest.

lines.content: ぶっふぉっ
lines.translated: "Bwffh!"

lines.content: それ以上余計なこと話すと、先輩……夜月先輩っ、このままぎゅ～ってして、息できなくしちゃいますからね……っ
lines.translated: "If you say anything else unnecessary, Senpai... Yotsuki-senpai! I'm going to squeeze you super tight just like this until you can't breathe...!"

lines.content: ふ、ふぉぉぉぉ～っ
lines.translated: "M-Mmphhh~!"

lines.content: 姫織。ジタバタしている。千和の胸の中で。
lines.translated: Himeori was flailing around right in Chiwa's chest.

lines.content: い、いい匂いがするよぅ～
lines.translated: "I-It smells so nice~."

lines.content: ちくしょう！　変わって！
lines.translated: "Dammit! Trade places with me!"

lines.content: ぎゃーぎゃーと言いあいながら、俺たちはそこで大通りは後にした。
lines.translated: Bantering back and forth noisily like that, we left the main street behind us.

lines.content: 姫織のお家、夜月神社。
lines.translated: Himeori's home, Yotsuki Shrine.

lines.content: その境内が目的地だった。
lines.translated: Its grounds were our destination.

lines.content: 俺たちは目的の[・|て][・|っ][・|ぺ][・|ん]を目指し、何十段と重なる石造りの階段をえっちらおっちら登っている。
lines.translated: Aiming for the *very top*, we huffed and puffed our way up the dozens upon dozens of stone steps.

lines.content: 小さな頃はよく姫織ちゃんの神社で遊んだよね。そのことは何でだかよく覚えてるよ
lines.translated: "When we were little, we used to play at Himeori-chan's shrine all the time, didn't we? For some reason, I remember that really well."

lines.content: 石段を登りながら、ハルが荒い呼吸を整えつつそう言った。
lines.translated: Haru said that as we climbed the stone steps, trying to catch her ragged breath.

lines.content: 神社は山の中腹に位置している。
lines.translated: The shrine is located halfway up the mountain.

lines.content: 半分くらい石段を登っただろうか――小休止。既に結構な高さだ。振り返ると広がる町の風景が小さく見えた。
lines.translated: We'd probably climbed about halfway up the steps--time for a short break. We were already pretty high up. Looking back, the sprawling townscape looked tiny below us.

lines.content: 言われてみれば、最近はあまりひよちゃんの神社には集まらなくなったなあ。昨日のお花見で集まったの、すごく久しぶりだった
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, we haven't really gathered at Hiyo-chan's shrine much lately. Getting together for cherry blossom viewing yesterday was the first time in ages."

lines.content: そうだったんだ？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Oh, really? Why's that?"

lines.content: 智仁の言葉に首をかしげたハルに、俺が答える。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head at Tomohito's words, and I answered her.

lines.content: どうして、ってこともないけどね。……ここ、ちょっと学園からは遠いから。集まるのは千和の店が最近は多いかもしれない
lines.translated: "There's no big reason or anything... It's just a bit far from the academy. Lately, we've mostly been hanging out at Chiwa's shop."

lines.content: そっかあ。やっぱり人も、町も、色々と変わっちゃうんだね。十年もあれば当然だよね、きっと
lines.translated: "I see. I guess people and the town really do change in all sorts of ways. With ten years passing, that's only natural, right?"

lines.content: ハルがしみじみとそんなことを言っていた。
lines.translated: Haru said wistfully.

lines.content: でも、今も変わらずみんなで集まってるっていうのは、なんだか少しうれしい気がしたよ
lines.translated: "Still, knowing that everyone still gets together just like before makes me feel a little happy."

lines.content: そして今度は照れたようにそう言うハルだった。
lines.translated: Then she added that, looking a bit bashful this time.

lines.content: 小休止を終えて残りの石段を登り始める。
lines.translated: Finishing our short break, we started climbing the rest of the stone steps.

lines.content: 小さな鳥居がいくつも列をなし、急こう配の石段を飾っていて――その先には、紅く、殊更大きな鳥居がひとつ、建っている。
lines.translated: Rows of small torii gates lined the steep stone staircase--and just beyond them stood a single, exceptionally large crimson torii.

lines.content: それをくぐると……、
lines.translated: Passing beneath it...

lines.content: ふわり。さくらが散った。
lines.translated: A soft flutter. Cherry blossoms scattered.

lines.content: 降り止まない雪の結晶のように、はらりと舞うのは、春の花。
lines.translated: Dancing gently down like never-ending snowflakes were the flowers of spring.

lines.content: 現れた境内は満開の花に溢れていた。
lines.translated: The shrine grounds that came into view were overflowing with blossoms in full bloom.

lines.content: そして、ここも学園と[・|同][・|様]だ。
lines.translated: And this place was *the same* as the academy.

lines.content: かつてここそのものが、ひとつの小さな駅として機能していた時代があった……と、いうのだ。
lines.translated: There was a time in the past when this very place functioned as a small station... or so the story goes.

lines.content: 山の中腹という場所にも関わらず、市電が坂道を上りやって来ていたということらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, despite being halfway up a mountain, streetcars used to climb the slope all the way up here.

lines.content: その名残が今も境内の隅に放置されている。廃線と同時に残された古く苔むした市電の車両が、一両ほど、境内に残されていた。
lines.translated: A relic of that era still sat abandoned in a corner of the grounds. A single, old, moss-covered streetcar, left behind when the line was decommissioned, remained on the shrine grounds.

lines.content: 静かな空気だ。
lines.translated: The air was quiet.

lines.content: 神社やお寺、仏閣特有の静謐とも感じられる空気が辺りを染めて……、
lines.translated: The serene atmosphere unique to shrines and Buddhist temples dyed the surroundings...

lines.content: 花びらと一緒に、香り豊かで鮮やかな時間が降り積もる。
lines.translated: And along with the petals, rich, fragrant, and vivid time piled up around us.

lines.content: この季節になると花見を目的に観光客だけでなく、町の住人たちもお弁当を持って町に繰り出すのだが……、
lines.translated: When this season comes around, not only tourists, but also the townsfolk head out with bento boxes for cherry blossom viewing, and yet...

lines.content: 相変わらずここはお花見の穴場ですね。昨日も私たちだけで、他には誰も来ませんでしたし
lines.translated: "As usual, this place is a hidden gem for cherry blossom viewing. Yesterday it was just us, too, and nobody else came."

lines.content: ……ここにはあまりお花見にやって来る人間はいなかった。
lines.translated: Hardly anyone ever came up here to view the blossoms.

lines.content: 神社ということでどこか遠慮心が働くのか。それとも単純にあまり知られていないだけのことなのか。
lines.translated: Was it because people felt hesitant since it was a shrine? Or was it simply not very well known?

lines.content: こんなにきれいなのに。景色も、すてきなのに
lines.translated: "Even though it's so pretty. And the view is so wonderful, too."

lines.content: だからあまり人に知られたくないって気持ちはありますけど、でも、誰にも知られていないっていうのは少し、もったいない気もします
lines.translated: "So part of me doesn't really want other people to find out about it, but at the same time, it feels like a bit of a waste that nobody knows."

lines.content: まあ、しみじみするよりもまず……“宝探し”だな
lines.translated: "Well, before we get all sentimental... first up is the 'treasure hunt.'"

lines.content: 智仁は言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito said.

lines.content: 実は俺、小さかった頃の俺たちがここによく集まっていたのは……
lines.translated: "Actually, the reason we used to gather here so much when we were little..."

lines.content: “謎”だとか“不思議”だとか、“噂話”だとか。そういったものを探しに来ていたんじゃないかって、そんな気がしてるんだ
lines.translated: "I have a feeling we came here looking for things like 'mysteries,' 'wonders,' and 'rumors.'"

lines.content: うう～ん。そうだったかなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm~. Was that really it?"

lines.content: 首をひねった。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: 昔の自分たちは確かに今の自分たちと繋がっていて――紛うことなく同一の人物であるはずなのに。
lines.translated: Our past selves were definitely connected to who we are now--we were unmistakably the exact same people.

lines.content: どうしてかな。
lines.translated: How come?

lines.content: どうにも“思い出せないことがある”というたったそれだけで、まったくの別人の過去について勝手に考えを巡らせているような、そんな居心地の悪い気分になってしまう。
lines.translated: Yet just because there were "things we couldn't remember," it gave me this uncomfortable feeling, as if I were arbitrarily speculating about the past of a complete stranger.

lines.content: 十年も経てば色々と思い出せないことが多くて……なんだかさみしいような、複雑な気持ちになっちゃうね
lines.translated: "After ten whole years, there's so much we can't remember... It makes me feel kind of lonely, or just gives me mixed feelings."

lines.content: みんなで首をひねった。
lines.translated: We all tilted our heads in thought.

lines.content: この場所にはどんな“不思議”や“謎”があったっけ。
lines.translated: What kind of "wonders" or "mysteries" were in this place, anyway?

lines.content: 昔々の自分たちは、いったい、どんな目的を持ち、ここに集まっていたのだったっけか。
lines.translated: What kind of purpose did our long-ago selves have for gathering here?

lines.content: ここに住んでる姫織ならすぐに思い出せるんじゃないのかな――そんな思いで隣に立っていた姫織をちらりと俺は見た。
lines.translated: Himeori lives here, so maybe she can remember right away--thinking that, I glanced over at Himeori standing next to me.

lines.content: あ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Oh, right."

lines.content: 姫織がパッと表情を咲かせて言った。
lines.translated: Himeori's expression lit up, and she spoke.

lines.content: 見てもらいたいものがあったんでしたわ
lines.translated: "There was something I wanted you all to see!"

lines.content: 忘れてた忘れてたと姫織は言うのだ。
lines.translated: "I totally forgot, I totally forgot," she said.

lines.content: ひよちゃん。何か、忘れ物？
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan? Did you forget something?"

lines.content: うん。忘れていたの。うっかりでした。でも、忘れ物はないの
lines.translated: "Yep. I forgot. How careless of me. I didn't leave anything behind, though."

lines.content: えぇ？？？
満面にはてなのマークだ。首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Question marks practically floated all over my face. I tilted my head.

lines.content: そんな俺に、姫織はにんまりとした。そして言う。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, Himeori grinned broadly. Then she spoke.

lines.content: ちょっと待っていてくれないかしら？
lines.translated: "Could you wait here for just a moment?"

lines.content: え？　うん。いいよ？
lines.translated: "Huh? Yeah, sure?"

lines.content: んっ、ありがとうございますっ
lines.translated: "Mhm, thank you very much!"

lines.content: ぴしっと敬礼。
lines.translated: She gave a crisp salute.

lines.content: くるりと背を向ける姫織に、俺は問いかけた。
lines.translated: As Himeori spun on her heel, I called out to her.

lines.content: 時間、かかっちゃうかい？
lines.translated: "Is it going to take long?"

lines.content: いえいえ。そのようなことは
lines.translated: "No, no. Nothing of the sort."

lines.content: すぐに？
lines.translated: "It'll be quick?"

lines.content: 終わりますとも
lines.translated: "I'll be done in a flash."

lines.content: うむ。では、改めて許可しよう。行ってきたまえ
lines.translated: "Very well. Then I formally grant you permission. Off you go."

lines.content: うむっ
lines.translated: "Indeed!"

lines.content: 深くうなずく。
lines.translated: She nodded deeply.

lines.content: そしてパタパタと姫織は家に戻っていった。
lines.translated: And with a pitter-patter of footsteps, Himeori headed back into her house.

lines.content: そこで気付いた智仁が目をパチパチとさせている。
lines.translated: Noticing this, Tomohito blinked in surprise.

lines.content: あれ？　ひよちゃん、どうしたんだ？　お家に帰ったのか？
lines.translated: "Huh? What's up with Hiyo-chan? Did she go back inside?"

lines.content: いや。わかんないな。何か忘れてたって言ってたけど……たぶん
lines.translated: "Nah, I don't know. She said she forgot something, though... probably."

lines.content: お弁当をもうひとつ持ってくるの忘れちゃったのかな。もうひとつどころかふたつ、みっつ……とか
lines.translated: "Maybe she forgot to bring another bento box. Or not just one, maybe two or three more..."

lines.content: ひよこのクセに食いしん坊だからなあ。うん。それもあり得なくはないけれど……。でも、忘れ物ではないとも言ってたな
lines.translated: "She is a total glutton for a little baby chick. Yeah, I wouldn't put it past her... Though she did say she didn't leave an item behind."

lines.content: しばし待つ。
lines.translated: We waited for a little while.

lines.content: 一回百円のおみくじでも引いて待っていようかという話になった。
lines.translated: We started talking about maybe drawing some hundred-yen fortune slips while we waited.

lines.content: ここ夜月神社のおみくじは少し特殊だ。
lines.translated: The fortune slips here at Yotsuki Shrine are a little unique.

lines.content: 久しぶりにハルを交えて[・|そ][・|れ]に興じてみるというのも悪くはない……。
lines.translated: Having fun with *that* together with Haru for the first time in a while wouldn't be a bad idea...

lines.content: と、思っていたところで。
lines.translated: Just as I was thinking that.

lines.content: がちゃり。
lines.translated: Click.

lines.content: 玄関の扉が開かれた。
lines.translated: The front door opened.

lines.content: 本堂に隣接する住居だ。姫織が駆け込んでいった扉である。
lines.translated: It was the residence adjacent to the main hall. The door Himeori had just dashed into.

lines.content: 思っていたより早かったなあと俺は、そちらへ視線を投げた。
lines.translated: Thinking that was faster than expected, I cast my gaze over in that direction.

lines.content: おお～
lines.translated: "Whoa~."

lines.content: 思わずそんな声が漏れてしまった。
lines.translated: My voice slipped out before I knew it.

lines.content: 扉を開き現れた姫織が[・|変][・|身]、してしまっていたからだった――
lines.translated: Because Himeori, emerging from the open door, had completely *transformed*--

lines.content: んっ、ただいま戻りましたっす
lines.translated: "Mhm, I'm back, 'kay!"

lines.content: ――変身とは言っても、彼女とて既に“特別”ではない。巫女服だ。
lines.translated: --Though I say transformed, it's not like she had become something "Magical." It was a shrine maiden outfit.

lines.content: 家の巫女服。この前新しくなったの
lines.translated: "My family's shrine maiden outfit. I got a new one the other day."

lines.content: 小首をかしげる。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: ほんとはね。昨日のお花見のときに見てもらおうかなあって思っていたの。でも大雅が持ってきたお弁当がね、あんまりにも美味しくて……
lines.translated: "To tell the truth, I was thinking of showing it to you during the cherry blossom viewing yesterday. But the bento Taiga brought was just way too delicious..."

lines.content: 忘れてしまっていたんだね。食べるのに夢中で
lines.translated: "You completely forgot because you were so absorbed in eating, huh?"

lines.content: そんな感じー
lines.translated: "Something like that~."

lines.content: 照れ照れとしながら、ふにゃりと笑う。
lines.translated: Looking bashful, she gave a soft, melting smile.

lines.content: しかしそんないつもの明るい表情を、すっと姫織は曇らせてしまう。
lines.translated: However, Himeori's usual bright expression suddenly clouded over.

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: どうしたのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder what's wrong.

lines.content: 首をかしげてしまう俺だけど……。
lines.translated: I tilted my head in confusion, and then...

lines.content: えっと……その……どうかな。……似合ってる……っす、かね
lines.translated: "Um... well... How is it? ...Does it suit me... 'kay?"

lines.content: もにょもにょと姫織は言った。
lines.translated: Himeori mumbled hesitantly.

lines.content: そして後ろも見てよとばかりに、姫織はくるりと一回転――しようとする。
lines.translated: Then, as if to say "look at the back, too," Himeori tried to do a little twirl--

lines.content: わ、わわわっ
lines.translated: "W-Whoa, whoa, whoa!"

lines.content: 慌てて姫織を制止した。
lines.translated: I hurriedly stopped her.

lines.content: 姫織は手にお盆を持っていたのだ。
lines.translated: Himeori was holding a tray in her hands.

lines.content: そこには人数分の湯飲みと急須が乗っている。
lines.translated: On top of it sat a teapot and enough teacups for everyone.

lines.content: 危ないあぶない。落としたら大変だ
lines.translated: "Careful, careful! It'd be bad if you dropped that."

lines.content: おお。うっかりでした
lines.translated: "Oh. How careless of me."

lines.content: 目をぱちくりとする。
lines.translated: She blinked in surprise.

lines.content: みんなに出す予定のお茶が台無しになっちゃうところでしたね
lines.translated: "I nearly ruined the tea I was planning to serve everyone."

lines.content: ううん。そうじゃなくてね。ひよちゃんが火傷したら大変だって、そう言いたかったんだよ
lines.translated: "No, that's not what I meant. I was trying to say it'd be terrible if you burned yourself, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: おおー。そ、それは……どうも……っす
lines.translated: "Ohhh. R-Right... thanks... 'kay."

lines.content: “っす”？
さっきから気にはなっていたけれど……。
lines.translated: It had been bugging me for a little while now, though...

lines.content: 体育会系部員にでもなるのかな、ひよちゃん。ご飯を美味しく食べられるように……運動いっぱいがんばるぞっていう感じ？
lines.translated: "Are you joining a sports club or something, Hiyo-chan? Like, you're gonna work out a ton so your food tastes even better?"

lines.content: ちゃうねん
lines.translated: "Nuh-uh, ya got it wrong."

lines.content: え？　……ちゃう？　ねん？
lines.translated: "Huh? ...Nuh-uh? Ya got it wrong?"

lines.content: ちょっちばかり、緊張しててん
lines.translated: "I was just a wee bit nervous, is all."

lines.content: ……ほう？　なぜに緊張しててんの？
lines.translated: "...Oh? And why might ya be nervous?"

lines.content: なんだよそれ。大雅。しゃべりかたうつってるのかどうか微妙だな
lines.translated: "What's with that, Taiga? I can't tell if her way of talking is rubbing off on you or not."

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a wry smile.

lines.content: しかし姫織はもじもじしていた。
lines.translated: Himeori, however, was fidgeting bashfully.

lines.content: 珍しい。とっても。とっても。
lines.translated: That's rare. Very, very rare.

lines.content: だって……ね？
lines.translated: "Well... you know?"

lines.content: 姫織は言う。小首をかしげて。
lines.translated: Himeori said, tilting her head slightly.

lines.content: うん。何かな？
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it?"

lines.content: 応える。俺も、首をかしげて。
lines.translated: I replied, tilting my head as well.

lines.content: 大雅はさ、時どきとぉっても意地悪になるからね
lines.translated: "You can be super mean sometimes, Taiga."

lines.content: え？　そうかな
lines.translated: "Huh? Really?"

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: ……だからね、私はね、ひよりちゃんはね、緊張してしまっているのです
lines.translated: "...So, you see, I... Hiyori-chan is feeling very nervous right now."

lines.content: ……ほう
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: この前に、千和のことはひそひそ褒めてたけれど……
lines.translated: "Earlier, you were quietly praising Chiwa, but..."

lines.content: 千和のことを？
lines.translated: "Praising Chiwa?"

lines.content: うん。だけど私のことは、どうかな、褒めてくれるのかな……着替えてるときにふっと思っちゃって……するとね、あらまあ不思議。大変だ
lines.translated: "Mhm. So I suddenly started wondering while I was changing... what about me? Will he praise me too? ...And then, lo and behold, what a mystery. Everything went haywire."

lines.content: にへら、と苦笑い。
lines.translated: She gave a floppy, awkward smile.

lines.content: ひよりちゃんはどきどきしちゃって、むにょむにょしちゃって……緊張、しちゃってね……大変になっちゃってるみたいなの……で、ごぜえまして……うへへ
lines.translated: "Hiyori-chan's heart started pounding, and I got all squirmy... and nervous... and it feels like I'm in a real bind right now... I tell ya... uhehe."

lines.content: 小さな身体をくねくねとさせていた。
lines.translated: She wriggled her petite body around.

lines.content: ふむ
lines.translated: "Hmm."

lines.content: なるほど……？
lines.translated: I see...?

lines.content: つまり、新しくなった巫女服を俺たちに見せてくれたんだね。千和が新しい制服を見せてくれたみたいに
lines.translated: "In other words, you wanted to show us your new shrine maiden outfit, right? Just like how Chiwa showed us her new uniform."

lines.content: ……そぉっす
lines.translated: "...That's right, 'kay."

lines.content: だけど意外と心配性で人見知りなひよりちゃんは、急に不安になってきたって感じなのかな。似合ってないって言われたらどうしようって
lines.translated: "But since Hiyori-chan is surprisingly a shy little worrywart, you suddenly got anxious. Wondering what you'd do if we said it didn't suit you."

lines.content: ……うっす
lines.translated: "...Yep, 'kay."

lines.content: こくこくと、うなずく。
lines.translated: She nodded repeatedly.

lines.content: そしてチラりチラりと俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: And she kept sneaking little glances at me.

lines.content: 更に、もっと、もじもじだってしている。
lines.translated: On top of that, she was fidgeting even more.

lines.content: むむむっ
lines.translated: "Mmmmgh."

lines.content: そんな姫織に俺は目を見開いた――あざとい！　だけど、かわいいっ。
lines.translated: My eyes went wide looking at Himeori like that--she knows exactly what she's doing! But it's so cute!

lines.content: なんとなくだがほっこりともしたのだ。
lines.translated: Somehow, it also warmed my heart.

lines.content: 心配するなよひよりちゃん。似合ってるよー。すっごいすっごい、似合ってる。そしてかわいい
lines.translated: "Don't worry, Hiyori-chan. It suits you. It really, really suits you. And you look cute."

lines.content: 俺は姫織の頭を撫でてみたりする。
lines.translated: I tried patting Himeori on the head.

lines.content: 嫌がられるかなと少し思った。
lines.translated: Part of me wondered if she'd dislike it.

lines.content: それでもまあいいかと少々強引に撫で続けていたけれど……、
lines.translated: Even so, I figured it'd be fine and kept patting her a bit insistently, but...

lines.content: 嫌がることなく、むしろ姫織は俺に撫でられるまま目を丸くするのだ。
lines.translated: Far from disliking it, Himeori just let me pat her, her eyes going wide.

lines.content: えっ……ほんと？　似合ってる？
lines.translated: "Huh... really? Does it suit me?"

lines.content: ああ。本当に
lines.translated: "Yeah. Really."

lines.content: かわいいの？
lines.translated: "Is it cute?"

lines.content: おうともさ
lines.translated: "You bet it is."

lines.content: そうだろ？　と俺は智仁にも同意を求める。
lines.translated: "Right?" I looked to Tomohito for agreement.

lines.content: ああ。嘘じゃない。似合ってるしかわいいし……ランクアップだな、凄いぞひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Yeah. No lie. It suits you, and it's cute... That's a rank-up right there. Amazing, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: アップ？　何がアップした？
lines.translated: "Up? What went up?"

lines.content: 魔性の女から、神秘的な女に
lines.translated: "From a femme fatale to a woman of mystery."

lines.content: ふぉぉ、それは……すっごいねっ
lines.translated: "Whoa, that's... amazing!"

lines.content: 目をキラキラさせた。
lines.translated: Her eyes sparkled.

lines.content: 毎日すくすくせいちょーちゅーだ……！
lines.translated: "I'm growing up big and strong every single day...!"

lines.content: わーい、夜月姫織は“神秘的な女”の称号を手に入れた――と、そんなことを格好つけたポーズを取って姫織は言った。
lines.translated: "Yay, Yotsuki Himeori has obtained the title 'Woman of Mystery'!"--Himeori said something along those lines while striking a dramatic pose.

lines.content: しかしその顔は薄っすら赤い。褒められて安心しちゃって、だけど今度は恥ずかしくなっちゃって照れ隠し。そんな感じだろうか。
lines.translated: However, her face was faintly flushed. Relieved at being praised, she had suddenly grown embarrassed and was trying to hide it. Something like that, probably.

lines.content: ……いやあ、うん。
lines.translated: Man, yeah.

lines.content: ひよちゃんはほんとにほんとにかわいいなあ
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan really, truly is cute."

lines.content: しみじみと微笑みながらそう言った。
lines.translated: I said with a heartfelt smile.

lines.content: すると、ふたつの視線を背後に感じてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Just then, I felt two pairs of eyes on my back.

lines.content: えー、なあにあれ。大雅くん、今日一番の笑顔だよ？
lines.translated: "Ehh, what is that? Taiga-kun, that's your biggest smile today, you know?"

lines.content: ううん、私、この町に帰って来てからはじめて見たよ、大雅くんのあんないっぱいの笑顔。……千和ちゃん、公然贔屓行為が当たり前みたいに展開されちゃってるよ
lines.translated: "No, actually, that's the first time I've seen Taiga-kun smile that much since I came back to this town. ...Chiwa-chan, blatant favoritism is unfolding right in front of us like it's the most natural thing in the world."

lines.content: ええ。いつも白昼堂々あんな感じなんですよ。奏先輩は夜月先輩にばっかり甘々なんです
lines.translated: "Yes. It's always like that in broad daylight. Kanade-senpai only ever spoils Yotsuki-senpai."

lines.content: ひそひそとふたりしてそんなことを言っている。
lines.translated: The two of them were whispering back and forth like that.

lines.content: むむむ。昔っからあんな感じだったっけ？　大雅くん、姫織ちゃんにだけ甘かったっけ……？　ちょっと思い出せないんだけど
lines.translated: "Hmm. Was he always like that? Did Taiga-kun only ever spoil Himeori-chan...? I can't quite remember."

lines.content: どうでしょう。私も正直なところ、あまり思い出せないですけれど……
lines.translated: "Who knows. To be honest, I don't really remember much either, but..."

lines.content: 昔は昔だけど。今は今、だけれど……。あんなにもずるっこなことが堂々と許されちゃっててもいいのかなあ。ううん、そんなのだめだよ。問題ありだよ
lines.translated: "The past is the past, and the present is the present, though... Is it really okay to let something so unfair slide right out in the open? No, that's no good. This is a problem."

lines.content: ええ、そうです。問題です。大問題です。だからこちらも何か作戦を考えておかなきゃいけませんよね
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. It's a problem. A huge problem. Which means we need to come up with a strategy of our own."

lines.content: 君たちは何をひそひそ話しているんだい……聞こえちゃってるけどさ
lines.translated: "What are you two whispering about over there...? I can hear you, you know."

lines.content: ――あ、今ので何か、思い出したかもしれない
lines.translated: "--Ah, hearing that just now might've reminded me of something."

lines.content: ふと、突然に智仁が声を上げた。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, Tomohito suddenly spoke up.

lines.content: え？　思い出す……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Reminded you...?"

lines.content: もしかして“噂話”のこと？
lines.translated: "Could it be about the 'rumor'?"

lines.content: 昔々の私たちがここで探していた……？
lines.translated: "The one we were looking for here a long, long time ago...?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 智仁は深くうなずき、
lines.translated: Tomohito nodded deeply.

lines.content: 俺たちさ、昔もここで、今と同じような会話をしたような気がするんだよ――……
lines.translated: "I feel like we had this exact same conversation right here a long time ago, too--..."

lines.content: 『ねえねえ、ひよちゃん。この神社でおみくじ買うと、神さまにお願い聞いてもらえるって本当なのかな？』
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Hiyo-chan. Is it true that if you buy a fortune slip at this shrine, God will grant your wish?"

lines.content: 『そう言われていますね。子どもの間でも。大人の間でも』
lines.translated: "So they say. Both among children and among adults."

lines.content: 『あ、それって……あれだよね。参禅町の七不思議のひとつだ』
lines.translated: "Ah, that's... that thing, right? One of the Seven Mysteries of Sanzen Town."

lines.content: 『そうそう。確か……ええっと。この神社で売られてる特別なおみくじを買うと、夢の中でこの町の守り神に会うことができて……』
lines.translated: "Right, right. If I remember correctly... um. If you buy a special fortune slip sold at this shrine, you can meet the guardian deity of this town in your dreams..."

lines.content: 『その神さまと夢の中で仲良くなれたら、お願いごとを叶えてもらえる。そんな噂でしたっけ……？』
lines.translated: "And if you make friends with that deity in your dream, they'll grant your wish. Wasn't that the rumor...?"

lines.content: 『うん、そうだよ。そんな噂で、そんな“七不思議”のひとつ、だったんだよ』
lines.translated: "Mhm, that's right. That was the rumor, and it was one of the 'Seven Mysteries.'"

lines.content: 『むむむ。その噂は[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|が][・|検][・|証]してみる必要ありかもしれないね』
lines.translated: "Hmm. *We might need to investigate* that rumor ourselves."

lines.content: 『……ううん、ハルちゃん。たぶんね。その神さまのこと、私たちたぶん知ってるよね』
lines.translated: "...No, Haru-chan. Probably... we probably already know that deity, don't we?"

lines.content: 『え？　……あっ、そうか。うん、そうだよね。だってその神さまって、きっと――』
lines.translated: "Huh? ...Ah, right. Yeah, you're right. Because that deity is definitely--"

lines.content: くすくすと声を殺して笑いあうかつての俺たち――……
lines.translated: Our past selves stifled our giggles as we laughed together--...

lines.content: 『じゃ、買っちゃおう。おみくじ買って、今夜も神さまとお話ししよう。この町の神さまはいつもひとりぼっちだから、会いに行ったらきっと喜んでくれるよね』
lines.translated: "Then let's buy some! Let's buy fortune slips and talk to God tonight, too. The deity of this town is always all alone, so I'm sure they'll be happy if we go visit."

lines.content: 『うーん。どうかなあ。あの神さまは人見知りだから……』
lines.translated: "Hmm. I wonder. That deity is pretty shy around strangers, so..."

lines.content: 『おみくじ買うより、カップ麺いっぱい持って行ったほうが、あの神さまは喜びそうですよね』
lines.translated: "Rather than buying fortune slips, I feel like that deity would be happier if we brought a bunch of cup noodles."

lines.content: 『ああ、確かに。それは間違いないね』
lines.translated: "Yeah, true. No doubt about that."

lines.content: 『んー。おみくじ、お姉ちゃん買おうかなあ。おこずかい今月きびしいけど』
lines.translated: "Hmm. Maybe Big Sis will buy a fortune slip, too. Even though my allowance is tight this month."

lines.content: 『一回百円』
lines.translated: "One hundred yen a draw."

lines.content: 『えー、お金取るのかい』
lines.translated: "Ehh, you're charging us?"

lines.content: 『とーぜん』
lines.translated: "Obviously."

lines.content: 『神社もお寺も、神さまだって。“ぼらんちぃあ”でご利益ばら撒いてるわけじゃあねぇのです』
lines.translated: "Shrines, temples, and even the gods themselves aren't handing out blessings as 'vuh-lun-teers,' you know."

lines.content: 『おおー、ひよちゃんが突然難しい言葉を』
lines.translated: "Whoa, Hiyo-chan suddenly busted out a big word."

lines.content: 『もしも“噂”通り、おみくじ買って、小さな神さまがお願いを聞いてくれるとしたら……みんなはどんなお願いをするのかな？』
lines.translated: "If the 'rumor' is true, and buying a fortune slip means the little god will grant your wish... what would everyone wish for?"

lines.content: あくまで百円程度で叶えられる“お願い”であって……、
lines.translated: Still, it would only be a "wish" that could be granted for about a hundred yen...

lines.content: それは、“魔法”を必要とする“夢”の話では、もちろんないけど……、
lines.translated: And of course, we weren't talking about the kind of "dream" that required "magic," either...

lines.content: 『えー……、お願いは人に教えちゃだめって気がしますけど』
lines.translated: "Ehh... I feel like you're not supposed to tell other people your wish, though."

lines.content: 『ふふふー。じゃあ私のを教えてあげましょー』
lines.translated: "Fufufu. Then I'll tell you mine!"

lines.content: 『“大雅くんがくーちゃんばっかり贔屓しなくなりますように”』
lines.translated: "'I wish Taiga-kun would stop playing favorites with Kuu-chan all the time.'"

lines.content: 『くーちゃん？　誰のこと？』
lines.translated: "Kuu-chan? Who's that?"

lines.content: 『大雅くんの黒猫ちゃんだよ』
lines.translated: "Your black cat, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 『ああ……クロのこと？』
lines.translated: "Oh... you mean Kuro?"

lines.content: 『うん。あの子のあだ名』
lines.translated: "Yep. That's her nickname."

lines.content: 『えへへ。あだ名っていいよね。なんだか仲良しだよーって感じがね、すっごく伝わって来る感じがするもん……って、あれ』
lines.translated: "Ehehe. Nicknames are nice, aren't they? They really get across the feeling that you're super close friends... Wait, huh?"

lines.content: 『ハルちゃんどうしたの？』
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Haru-chan?"

lines.content: 『大変なことに気づいてしまいましたけど……』
lines.translated: "I just realized something terrible..."

lines.content: 『え？　大変なこと……？』
lines.translated: "Huh? Something terrible...?"
"Gasp!"

lines.content: 『お顔が真っ青。大変』
lines.translated: "Your face is completely pale. Oh dear."

lines.content: 『プルプルしてます……？』
lines.translated: "Are you trembling...?"
"Y-Yeah..."

lines.content: 『えっと……クロちゃんは、くーちゃん。今決めました。そして姫織ちゃんはひよちゃん。千和ちゃんは、小さくてかわいい子だから、ちわっこい――』
lines.translated: "Um... Kuro-chan is Kuu-chan. I just decided that now. And Himeori-chan is Hiyo-chan. Chiwa-chan is small and cute, so she's Chiwakkoi--"

lines.content: 『……それ、やめてほしいっていつも言ってるのに』
lines.translated: "...I always tell you to stop calling me that, though."

lines.content: 『――あれ？　あれれ？　おかしいよ？　私だけ……女の子の中で、私だけ、あだ名がないよ？』
lines.translated: "--Huh? Wait a second? That's weird! Only me... Out of all the girls, I'm the only one without a nickname!"

lines.content: 『う、ううっ。仲間はずれ……っ』
lines.translated: "U-Uuu... I'm being left out..."

lines.content: 『い、いやいや。それはなんだかさすがに変じゃないかなあ』
lines.translated: "N-No, wait. Isn't that jumping to conclusions a bit?"

lines.content: 『うわーん……っ』
lines.translated: "Uwaaan...!"

lines.content: 『あ～、大雅がハルちゃん泣かしたぞ』
lines.translated: "Aaah, Taiga made Haru-chan cry."

lines.content: 『百円！　おみくじ買って、小さなちいさな神さまに、悪い子な大雅を叱ってもらわなきゃ……！』
lines.translated: "One hundred yen! I have to buy a fortune slip and get the tiny, tiny god to scold bad-boy Taiga...!"

lines.content: なんだ。思い出したって……殆ど“噂話”と関係ないじゃないか。ただの思い出話だ
lines.translated: "What the heck? You said you remembered something, but... that had almost nothing to do with the 'rumor.' That was just a random memory."

lines.content: 何を言うんだ親友。思い出は、宝物だろ？　思い出してみろよ。今の俺たちがしていることはいったいなんだ？　宝探しだろ？
lines.translated: "What are you talking about, my best friend? Memories are treasures, right? Think about it. What is it that we're doing right now? A treasure hunt, isn't it?"

lines.content: にやり。
lines.translated: He grinned.

lines.content: 得意そうにそんなことを言うのだ――少しイラッとした。
lines.translated: He said it so smugly--it ticked me off a little.

lines.content: 俺たちは姫織の巫女服姿を写真に撮ってみたり、お茶を美味しくいただいてみたりして……。
lines.translated: We took some photos of Himeori in her shrine maiden outfit, enjoyed some delicious tea, and then...

lines.content: 次の場所へ移動する。
lines.translated: We moved on to the next place.

lines.content: おみくじは今日のところは引かずにおいた。
lines.translated: We decided not to draw any fortune slips for today.

lines.content: 俺たちの町、参禅町の中心には河が流れている。
lines.translated: A river runs through the center of our town, Sanzen Town.

lines.content: 小さくもなく。大きくもない。
lines.translated: It's neither small nor large.

lines.content: 河川と呼ぶにはこじんまりとしていて、小川と呼ぶには大層な設備で環境を整備されていた。
lines.translated: It was a bit too cozy to be called a proper river, yet its banks were too heavily developed and maintained to be called a mere stream.

lines.content: さくら並木に囲まれたその河に、町は大きくふたつに分断されているけれど……。
lines.translated: Lined with rows of cherry trees, the river roughly divides the town in two, but...

lines.content: いくつかの小さな石造りの橋が、あちら側とこちら側を繋いでいた。
lines.translated: Several small stone bridges connected this side to the other.

lines.content: その内のひとつに俺たちは立っている。
lines.translated: We were standing on one of them.

lines.content: この橋は通学路として今も昔もよく利用していたるだが……。
lines.translated: We'd used this bridge a lot as a route to school both now and in the past, though...

lines.content: ここにはどんな“不思議”があったかなあ。俺たち。この橋をよく行ったり来たりしていたように思うんだけど
lines.translated: "I wonder what kind of 'mystery' was here. I feel like we used to walk back and forth across this bridge a lot."

lines.content: みんなと違って俺は昔のことをそれなりに覚えてはいる。
lines.translated: Unlike everyone else, I remembered the past reasonably well.

lines.content: 俺たちの“昔”には、大人の時間に持ち込めない多くの記憶で溢れてる――故に。
lines.translated: Our "past" is overflowing with many memories that can't be brought into adulthood--and therefore,

lines.content: 大人になり始めているみんなには、当時の思い出が薄いのは無理からぬこと。
lines.translated: It was only natural that everyone else, who were starting to become adults, had only faint memories of that time.

lines.content: まだまだ心も身体も大人になれないこの俺が、みんなよりその記憶を色濃く持つのもまた、無理からぬことなのだった。
lines.translated: And it was equally natural that I, who still couldn't become an adult in mind or body, held onto those memories more vividly than the others.

lines.content: だが、それはあくまでも[・|そ][・|れ][・|な][・|り]でしかない。
lines.translated: However, I only remembered them *reasonably* well.

lines.content: 何をしようとしていたのかは思い出せても、実際に何をしていたのか……その細部はみんなと同様に、曖昧だった。
lines.translated: Even if I could remember what we were trying to do, what we actually did... those details were just as hazy for me as they were for everyone else.

lines.content: だからこの場所に立ち、でこぼことした記憶の溝を洗い出そうと懸命になる。
lines.translated: That's why I stood in this place, trying desperately to uncover the bumpy grooves of my memory.

lines.content: 手すりにもたれかかり、足元を流れる河の水面を見下ろした。
lines.translated: I leaned against the railing and looked down at the surface of the river flowing beneath my feet.

lines.content: はらはらと降り注ぐさくらの花びらが、水面に微かな波紋を広げ……ゆっくりと流れ去っていく。
lines.translated: Gently falling cherry blossom petals spread faint ripples across the water's surface... and slowly drifted away.

lines.content: 人通りもそれなりに多いから、小さな子がちょろちょろしてたのなら、きっとたくさんの人に、たくさん迷惑かけちゃってたよね
lines.translated: "There's a fair amount of foot traffic here, so if a bunch of little kids were darting around, we must have caused a lot of trouble for a lot of people."

lines.content: かもしれません。ここは観光区画ではなくて、地元の人たちの生活圏寄りですから。ご近所迷惑、たくさんしてたかもしれないですね
lines.translated: "Maybe so. This isn't the tourist district, it's closer to where the locals go about their daily lives. We might have been a real nuisance to the neighborhood."

lines.content: あー……、うん。そういえばさ。幽霊も音楽を聞くのかな
lines.translated: "Ah... yeah. Come to think of it, do ghosts listen to music too?"

lines.content: 智仁がふとそんなことを言ったのだ。俺の隣で。同じように川の流れを見下ろしながら。
lines.translated: Tomohito suddenly said that right next to me, looking down at the flowing river just like I was.

lines.content: 幽霊……？
lines.translated: "Ghosts...?"

lines.content: 俺は首をひねった。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: どうしていきなりそんなことを言うんだろうかこいつは。
lines.translated: Why is this guy bringing that up out of nowhere?

lines.content: いや、わるい。この石橋に関する“噂”をふと、思い出したんだけどさ
lines.translated: "Nah, my bad. I just suddenly remembered the 'rumor' about this stone bridge."

lines.content: お？　そうなのか？
lines.translated: "Oh? Really?"

lines.content: それってどんな“噂”で、どんな“不思議”なのだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of "rumor" and what kind of "mystery" was it?

lines.content: そう問いかける俺に、智仁が答える前に、
lines.translated: Before Tomohito could answer my question,

lines.content: あ、幽霊……？　私もそれ、知ってるよ？
lines.translated: "Ah, ghosts...? I know that one, too!"

lines.content: ハルが目をぱちぱちとさせながら言った。
lines.translated: Haru said, blinking her eyes.

lines.content: えっと、この町には夜とは違うもうひとつ“夜”が、どこかにあって……
lines.translated: "Um, somewhere in this town, there's another 'Night' that's different from the regular night..."

lines.content: そこから抜け出した幽霊とか、そうじゃないモノとか色々と、昼も夜もなく、そこら辺を歩き回ってるんだって。そんな“噂”だよね、確か
lines.translated: "And ghosts, or things that aren't ghosts, slip out from there and walk around the area day and night. That was the 'rumor,' right? If I remember correctly."

lines.content: 夜とは違うもうひとつの“夜”
lines.translated: Another "Night" that's different from the regular night.

lines.content: その点については“噂”でも“謎”でも何でもないのだと知っているけれど……。
lines.translated: As far as that part went, I knew it was neither a "rumor" nor a "mystery" at all, though...

lines.content: 幽霊とは違う、色々なモノ
lines.translated: "All sorts of things that are different from ghosts..."

lines.content: そうだよー。怖いのだったり。やさしいのだったり。かわいい動物みたいなもの、だったり。色々なんだよ
lines.translated: "That's right! Scary ones. Nice ones. Ones that are like cute animals. There are all kinds!"

lines.content: 俺は辺りを何気なく見まわした――どこかに“夜”へと続く抜け穴でもぽっかり空いたままになっているのだろうか。
lines.translated: I casually looked around the area--wondering if a loophole leading to the "Night" was still gaping open somewhere.

lines.content: なんだか……
lines.translated: "Somehow..."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 帰ってきてすぐの柊先輩が知っていて、ずっとこの町に住んでる先輩が“初耳だなあ”“すごいなあ”みたいな顔してるの。なんだか、おかしいです
lines.translated: "It's kind of funny how Hiiragi-senpai, who just got back, knows all about it, while Senpai, who's lived in this town the whole time, has this look on his face like, 'That's the first I've heard of it, amazing.'"

lines.content: くすくすと千和が笑う。ほんとにねー、とハルも笑いながら、続けた。
lines.translated: Chiwa giggled. "Right?" Haru laughed along too, and continued.

lines.content: もしも怖い幽霊に出会ってしまったら。そして捕まってしまったら。どこか遠くへ連れていかれてしまうんだって、大人たちに言われてた。だから夜は早く眠りなさいねって
lines.translated: "The adults used to tell us that if you met a scary ghost and got caught, you'd be taken away somewhere far off. So they told us to go to sleep early at night."

lines.content: 私もその噂、聞いたことがあります。確かこの橋には幽霊は追ってこれないから……
lines.translated: "I've heard that rumor, too. If I remember right, ghosts can't chase you onto this bridge..."

lines.content: うんうん。だからもし幽霊に追いかけられたらこの橋を目指して走ろうねって。そんな噂だった気がするね
lines.translated: "Mhm, mhm. So if you ever got chased by a ghost, you were supposed to run for this bridge. I feel like that was the rumor."

lines.content: はは。まあだいたいさ、噂話とか怪談だとか。そういうのは子どものしつけの代わりだったり、聞き分けのない子どもに無理やりにでも言うこと聞かせるためにあるんだろうけどな
lines.translated: "Haha. Well, usually, rumors and ghost stories like that are just a substitute for disciplining kids, or a way to force stubborn children to behave."

lines.content: ……ああ、うん。なんだか俺も思い出してきたぞ
lines.translated: "...Ah, yeah. I think it's coming back to me, too."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき、言う。
lines.translated: I nodded and spoke up.

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ぱちくりとする。
lines.translated: Everyone blinked in surprise.

lines.content: なに、大雅くん？
lines.translated: "What is it, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: “この橋に幽霊が追ってこれない”……そんな噂を検証しようよ！　って。そんなことをハルが言いだしてさ。真夜中にここに集まったことがあったのを、思い出してしまったんだ
lines.translated: "'Ghosts can't chase you onto this bridge'... Haru suddenly suggested we test that rumor out! I just remembered how we all gathered here in the middle of the night once."

lines.content: あれは確か夜中も夜中、深夜過ぎのこと。
lines.translated: If I recall, it was the dead of night, well past midnight.

lines.content: 子どもたちだけで出歩くにはあまりにも遅い時間だった。
lines.translated: It was way too late for a bunch of kids to be out walking around by themselves.

lines.content: 『なあ、ハル。別にこんなこと、わざわざ検証することないって』
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru. We don't really need to go out of our way to test something like this, do we?"

lines.content: 『そ、そうだよお。それもこんな遅い時間に……さむいよ、ねむいよ、ちょっとこわいよ……へっぴちっ』
lines.translated: "T-That's right. Especially this late at night... It's cold, I'm sleepy, and it's a little scary... Achoo!"

lines.content: 『だめだよふたりとも。だめだめだ。何を弱気なこと言ってるの。“謎”はちゃんと調べておかなきゃ、いつか“危険”になっちゃうかもなんだよ』
lines.translated: "No way, you two. Absolutely not. Why are you being such wimps? If we don't investigate 'mysteries' properly, they might turn into 'dangers' someday, you know!"

lines.content: 『私たちの内の誰かがもし、怖い幽霊に追いかけられちゃうようなことがあったとして……そのときはここを目指して走っていけばいい。それがわかれば安心でしょう？』
lines.translated: "Suppose one of us ever gets chased by a scary ghost... If that happens, we just have to run for this spot. Wouldn't you feel relieved knowing that for sure?"

lines.content: 『ねえ、ハルちゃん。ハルちゃんは幽霊とか信じちゃう人なの？』
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru-chan. Are you the type of person who actually believes in ghosts?"

lines.content: 『うん。もちろんだよ。信じちゃう人だよ、私』
lines.translated: "Yep. Of course I am. I totally believe in them."

lines.content: 『だってこの世界には魔法も魔法少女も小さなちいさな神さまも、そして喋る猫だっているんだもん。幽霊くらいいてくれなきゃ不公平でしょう？』
lines.translated: "Because in this world, there's magic, and magical girls, and tiny, tiny gods, and even talking cats! It wouldn't be fair if there weren't at least a few ghosts too, right?"
"Unfair...?"

lines.content: 『あ～……そうですねえ。ハルちゃんの言いたいこと、少しだけわかる気がします。ほんのちょっとだけ』
lines.translated: "Ah~... Well, that's true. I feel like I kind of understand what Haru-chan is trying to say. Just a tiny bit."

lines.content: 『でもどうやってそれを検証するのかな。このままじっと待つ感じ？　幽霊が出るまで？』
lines.translated: "But how are we supposed to test it? Are we just going to stand here and wait? Until a ghost shows up?"

lines.content: 『うーん。それしかないのかなあ』
lines.translated: "Hmm. I wonder if that's the only way."

lines.content: 『ううん。違う。それじゃあだめだ……こちらから探しに行こうか』
lines.translated: "No. Wait. That won't work... Let's go look for them ourselves."

lines.content: 『だってテレビでよくやってるよね。たくさん幽霊が住んでるはずの有名な心霊スポットでも、テレビカメラが登場した途端、みんな恥ずかしがって出てこないでしょう？』
lines.translated: "Because they show it on TV all the time, right? Even at famous haunted spots where tons of ghosts are supposed to live, the second a TV camera shows up, they all get shy and won't come out, right?"

lines.content: 『だからこちらからお出迎えに行くんだね？』
lines.translated: "So we're going to go out and welcome them ourselves?"

lines.content: 『え、ええ～……っ、わざわざ自分から怖いものを見つけに行くんですか？　そ、そんなの嫌です。絶対に』
lines.translated: "E-Eeeh~...?! We're going out of our way to find something scary on purpose? N-No way, I don't want to. Absolutely not."

lines.content: 『そうだね。確かにちょっと、そういう危なそうなのは……』
lines.translated: "Yeah. Going after something that sounds that dangerous really is a bit..."

lines.content: 『ううん、大丈夫！　元気があったらきっと幽霊だって逃げてくよ！』
lines.translated: "No, it'll be fine! As long as we stay upbeat, I bet even the ghosts will run away!"

lines.content: 『……探してる相手を逃げさせちゃあだめじゃないか』
lines.translated: "...Wait, isn't it bad if we scare off the very things we're looking for?"

lines.content: 『とにかく行こうよっ、シャイな幽霊さんたちをお迎えに上がりましょー』
lines.translated: "Anyway, let's go! Let's go welcome those shy little ghosts!"

lines.content: 『あ～……だめだ。こうなっちゃもう誰もハルを止められないから……諦めるしかないのかも』
lines.translated: "Ah~... It's no use. Once Haru gets like this, nobody can stop her... We might just have to give in."

lines.content: 『う、うううー』
lines.translated: "U-Uuuu~"

lines.content: 拳を振り上げたハル。
lines.translated: Haru thrusting her fist into the air.

lines.content: どうしても幽霊を怖がり涙目だった千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa with tears in her eyes, utterly terrified of ghosts.

lines.content: 面倒だから早く終わらないかなあお布団恋しいと欠伸を繰り返していた姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori yawning over and over, wishing the hassle would end quickly so she could get back to her beloved futon.

lines.content: ひとりだけどこか上の空であった、あの頃の智仁。
lines.translated: Back then, Tomohito was the only one with his head in the clouds.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: そんなみんなに囲まれて、いつもよりうれしそうに微笑んでいたあず咲先輩。
lines.translated: Surrounded by all of us, Azusaki-senpai was smiling even more happily than usual.

lines.content: そんな場面をふと思い出せたのだった。
lines.translated: That scene suddenly came back to me.

lines.content: 俺たちの住む参禅町は結構広い。
lines.translated: Sanzen Town, where we live, is pretty big.

lines.content: それでいて、そこかしこに“うつくしい景色”“楽しい場所”“不思議な一瞬”そういった[・|そ][・|れ][・|ぞ][・|れ]に溢れている。
lines.translated: And yet, everywhere you look, it's overflowing with each and every one of those things--"beautiful scenery," "fun places," and "mysterious moments."

lines.content: 一日掛けてもそれらを全部、この瞳に映して歩くことは困難だろう。
lines.translated: Even if we spent a whole day walking around, it would be hard to take all of them in with our own eyes.

lines.content: 在りし日の俺たちはそんなこの町が好きだった。
lines.translated: In days gone by, we loved this town for being like that.

lines.content: 一日中走り回って遊んでも飽きることはなかったし、その度に新しい顔を見せてくれるこの町に、幼い俺たちはワクワクともさせられていたのだろう。
lines.translated: We never got tired of running around and playing all day long, and as little kids, our hearts must have raced every time the town showed us a new side of itself.

lines.content: そんな俺たちの町は今、いっぱいの春色に溢れている。
lines.translated: And right now, our town is overflowing with the colors of spring.

lines.content: “うつくしい景色”のそのひとつを、ここでならぐるりと見渡せた。
lines.translated: From right here, we had a panoramic view of one of those pieces of "beautiful scenery."

lines.content: 山の上の施設だ。その門前付近にある広場。
lines.translated: It was the facility up on the mountain. The plaza near its front gate.

lines.content: 俺たちはベンチに座り各自お弁当を広げていた。
lines.translated: We sat on the benches and unpacked our respective lunches.

lines.content: ……ありがとうあさひさん。いただきます
lines.translated: "...Thank you, Asahi-san. Let's eat."

lines.content: ふっわ～……っ、大雅のおべんとすっごいよっ
lines.translated: "Woooow... Taiga's bento is amazing!"

lines.content: 俺のお弁当を覗き込んだ姫織が目をキラキラさせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori's eyes sparkled as she peered into my lunchbox.

lines.content: お、おおう。確かにすっごいね、これ
lines.translated: "W-Whoa. This really is amazing."

lines.content: あさひさんから渡されたのはお重のお弁当箱だった。
lines.translated: What Asahi-san had handed me was a multi-tiered bento box.

lines.content: だからなんとなく予想というか、想像くらいはできていたのだが……。
lines.translated: Because of that, I had a vague idea of what to expect, or at least I could imagine it, but...
