lines.content: おせち料理みたいに手が込んでるね。どれもおかずがキラキラしてるよ。量もいっぱいで……作るの大変だったんじゃないかなあ
lines.translated: "It's as elaborate as a New Year's feast. Every single side dish is practically sparkling. And there's so much of it... It must've been really hard to make."

lines.content: うん。だからたぶん、みんなで分け合って食べなさいってことじゃないかな。あさひさんならそう言いそうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. So I think this is probably her way of telling us to share it with everyone. That sounds just like something Asahi-san would say."

lines.content: 昨日のお花見で食べたお弁当もあさひさんが用意してくれた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san had also prepared the bento we ate at yesterday's flower viewing.

lines.content: そのときもまた手の込んだ立派なものだったのだ。
lines.translated: That one had been a magnificent, elaborate spread as well.

lines.content: いつも本当にありがとうあさひさん。
lines.translated: Thank you so much for everything, Asahi-san.

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれのお弁当でお腹を満たし――それでも足りない者は（主に姫織が）俺のいっぱいのお弁当を突いて――宝探しはしばし休憩。
lines.translated: Everyone filled their stomachs with their own lunches--and those who still didn't have enough (mainly Himeori) picked at my huge bento--as we took a short break from our treasure hunt.

lines.content: 広場は町を展望するための整備が成されている。
lines.translated: The plaza was set up as an observation deck overlooking the town.

lines.content: 手すり付きの柵。その手前に百円玉で使用できる双眼鏡。いくつかのベンチ。東屋のような屋根付きの休憩所。
lines.translated: A fence with a handrail. Coin-operated binoculars right in front of it that took hundred-yen coins. Several benches. A roofed rest area like a gazebo.

lines.content: 小さな公園のようでもあった。
lines.translated: It was almost like a small park.

lines.content: みんなが思い思いに過ごす中、俺はその様子を少し離れた場所から見つめていた。
lines.translated: While everyone spent their time however they liked, I watched them from a short distance away.

lines.content: 広場はさくらの木々に囲まれている。
lines.translated: The plaza was surrounded by cherry trees.

lines.content: 風が吹けば花びらが晴れ渡る空を流れていった。
lines.translated: Whenever the wind blew, petals drifted across the clear sky.

lines.content: ふわふわ漂う甘い香りが、胸だけでなく心までをも満たしていくような。
lines.translated: The sweet scent wafting softly through the air felt like it was filling not just my lungs, but my heart as well.

lines.content: 大きなさくらの木を背に腰を下ろして、漂う甘い香りを胸いっぱいに吸い込んでいると、
lines.translated: As I sat down with my back against a large cherry tree, taking a deep breath of that sweet fragrance,

lines.content: 背にした木の背後から、そーっと伸びてくる小さな手に気付く。
lines.translated: I noticed a small hand reaching out ever so slowly from behind the tree I was leaning against.

lines.content: その手は、腰を下ろした隣に置いておいたお弁当に伸びていた。
lines.translated: That hand was reaching for the bento I had set down next to me.

lines.content: まだ半分くらい残っている、蓋を開けたままのお弁当だ。
lines.translated: It was still about half full, with the lid left open.

lines.content: クロもみんなと一緒に食べればいいのに
lines.translated: "You should just eat with everyone else, Kuro."

lines.content: 伸ばされた手がびくっとした。
lines.translated: The outstretched hand flinched.

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: ……見つかった
lines.translated: "...Caught me."

lines.content: ああ、うん。見つけちゃったよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, I sure did."

lines.content: 笑って俺はそう言った。
lines.translated: I said with a laugh.

lines.content: いつも傍にいてくれる小さな子。
lines.translated: The little girl who was always by my side.

lines.content: みんなと町を歩き回っている最中も、俺はきっと心のどこかで君の姿を探してた。
lines.translated: Even while walking around town with everyone else, some part of my heart must have been looking for her.

lines.content: クロは恐る恐るというように、さくらの木から顔を半分だけ出したまま、言った。
lines.translated: Timidly peeking just half her face out from behind the cherry tree, Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……お弁当
lines.translated: "...The bento."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……お弁当の、残り。分けてくれる？
lines.translated: "...The leftovers from your bento. Will you share them with me?"

lines.content: もちろん
lines.translated: "Of course."

lines.content: 笑顔でうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded with a smile.

lines.content: 何が欲しい？
lines.translated: "What do you want?"

lines.content: 何が、いらない？
lines.translated: "What do you... not want?"

lines.content: え？　“いらない”って？
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you mean, 'not want'?"

lines.content: 大雅がほしくないの、言って。わたしが食べるよ
lines.translated: "Tell me what you don't want, Taiga. I'll eat it."

lines.content: 残したらもったいないし。
lines.translated: It'd be a waste to leave anything behind, after all.

lines.content: クロはそう言って大きな目をパチパチとさせていた。
lines.translated: Kuro blinked her big eyes as she added that.

lines.content: 俺、好き嫌いないんだよ？　クロ、知ってるだろ？
lines.translated: "I'm not a picky eater, though. You know that, right, Kuro?"

lines.content: ……そうだった
lines.translated: "...Right."

lines.content: むむむ、と渋い顔。
lines.translated: She made a sour face, groaning softly.

lines.content: そういういの気にしなくていいよ。いっぱいあるから、いっぱい食べて。クロが好きなもの
lines.translated: "You don't need to worry about stuff like that. There's plenty, so eat as much as you want. Whatever you like, Kuro."

lines.content: 更に目を細めるクロだ。
lines.translated: Kuro narrowed her eyes even further.

lines.content: まだどこか遠慮気味だった。
lines.translated: She still seemed somewhat hesitant.

lines.content: ううむ。それじゃあ俺が食べさせてあげようか
lines.translated: "Hmm. Well then, how about I feed you?"

lines.content: パチクリとする。どうしてそうなるの、という顔だ。
lines.translated: She blinked in surprise. The look on her face asked how I'd jumped to that conclusion.

lines.content: 卵焼きとかはどうかな。……いや。ええっと、クロは卵とか食べても大丈夫なんだったっけ
lines.translated: "How about some rolled omelet? ...Wait. Um, is it actually okay for you to eat eggs and stuff, Kuro?"

lines.content: 猫に人間と同じ食事は毒となる。そのような話を聞いたことがある。
lines.translated: Human food is poisonous to cats. I'd heard stories like that before.

lines.content: しかし、あさひさんも十夜も食べてたし、ならばクロも平気だろうか。
lines.translated: However, both Asahi-san and Toya ate it, so maybe Kuro would be fine too.

lines.content: 以前あさひさんだったかクロ本人だったかが言っていたのだが――クロは“特別な猫”の中ではまだまだ子ども、幼い子なのだということだ。実はあの十夜よりも年下なのだ、と。
lines.translated: Either Asahi-san or Kuro herself had mentioned it before--that among "special cats," Kuro was still a child, very young. In fact, she was even younger than Toya.

lines.content: だからあのふたりと同じように考えるのはまずいだろうか。
lines.translated: So maybe it was a bad idea to assume she was the same as those two.

lines.content: 大丈夫
lines.translated: "It's okay."

lines.content: 俺の煩いを察したのだろう。クロがふるふると首を振った。
lines.translated: Sensing my worry, Kuro gave a little shake of her head.

lines.content: ……卵焼き、食べられる
lines.translated: "...I can eat rolled omelet."

lines.content: そうなんだ？
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: そう、なんだよ？
lines.translated: "Yes, really?"

lines.content: 小首をかしげるような仕草。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: わたしは猫だけど、人間の食べ物は、ほとんど食べれる
lines.translated: "I'm a cat, but I can eat almost all human food."

lines.content: ほとんど？
lines.translated: "Almost?"

lines.content: ほとんど
lines.translated: "Almost."

lines.content: 首をかしげあい……俺は、笑った。
lines.translated: We tilted our heads at each other... and I laughed.

lines.content: そっか。うん。なんたってクロはチョコレートが大好物だからね。クロの言う通り心配しなくても平気なのかな
lines.translated: "I see. Yeah. After all, chocolate is your absolute favorite, Kuro. Maybe I don't need to worry, just like you said."

lines.content: チョコ。ふつうの猫は食べられない？
lines.translated: "Chocolate. Normal cats can't eat it?"

lines.content: うん。確かそうだった気がするよ。ふつうの猫がチョコレート食べるとお腹壊すんだってさ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm pretty sure that's how it goes. They say if a normal cat eats chocolate, they'll get an upset stomach."

lines.content: クロは自分のお腹をナデナデとさすっていた。
lines.translated: Kuro gently rubbed her own belly.

lines.content: それじゃ、卵焼き。あーんして？　あさひさんの力作だよ
lines.translated: "Alright then, rolled omelet. Say 'aah'? It's Asahi-san's masterpiece."

lines.content: じーっと俺のことを見上げるクロだった。
lines.translated: Kuro stared straight up at me.

lines.content: ……さすがに“あーん”、だなんて。
lines.translated: Okay, asking her to say "aah" might be a bit much.

lines.content: そんなのは調子に乗り過ぎだろうか。
lines.translated: Was I getting a little too carried away?

lines.content: 無言で見つめられるとちょっと恥ずかしくもなるけれど、
lines.translated: Having her stare at me in silence made me feel a bit embarrassed, too, but...

lines.content: ……あーん
クロは目を瞑り、小さな口を開いてくれた。
lines.translated: Kuro closed her eyes and opened her small mouth for me.

lines.content: その中に卵焼きをそっと収める。
lines.translated: I gently placed the piece of rolled omelet inside.

lines.content: もぐもぐする。
lines.translated: She chewed softly.

lines.content: 美味しい？
lines.translated: "Is it good?"

lines.content: おいしい
lines.translated: "It's good."

lines.content: ふっと笑った――ように、見えた。
lines.translated: A faint smile crossed her face--or so it seemed.

lines.content: 珍しい。とても。
lines.translated: That was rare. Very rare.

lines.content: だから俺は調子に乗ってしまう。うれしく、なってしまう。
lines.translated: That made me get carried away. It made me feel so happy.

lines.content: 次は？
lines.translated: "What's next?"

lines.content: 更にお弁当を勧めた。
lines.translated: I offered her the bento again.

lines.content: 何を食べたい？
lines.translated: "What do you want to eat?"

lines.content: もっと、いいのかな
lines.translated: "Is it okay if I have more?"

lines.content: もちろん。何でも、好きなの
lines.translated: "Of course. Whatever you like."

lines.content: 好きなの……
lines.translated: "Whatever I like..."

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。わたしは大雅のお残しでいいんだよ？
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. I'm fine with just eating your leftovers, you know?"

lines.content: まあまあ、そう言わずに。何でも食べたいのを食べさせてあげるから
lines.translated: "Come on, don't be like that. I'll feed you whatever you want to eat."

lines.content: そこでクロは目を細めてしまう。
lines.translated: At that, Kuro narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: ……自分で、食べられる
lines.translated: "...I can eat by myself."

lines.content: つんとした。
lines.translated: She huffed.

lines.content: 子ども扱いしないでというように。
lines.translated: As if telling me not to treat her like a child.

lines.content: わざわざあーんしてくれなくても、平気だ。ご飯くらい、ひとりでも……
lines.translated: "I'm fine even if you don't go out of your way to feed me. I can at least eat a meal on my own..."

lines.content: うーん。でもさ、お箸使えないだろ。クロって不器用だからさ
lines.translated: "Hmm. You can't use chopsticks, though. You're clumsy, Kuro."

lines.content: ちょっと前まではチョコレートの銀紙だって上手に剥がせなくって困ってたよね
lines.translated: "Up until recently, you had a hard time even peeling the foil off chocolates neatly, right?"

lines.content: それを俺が食べやすいように剥いて渡すのが恒例だったけれど……いつの間にかその必要はなくなっていた。
lines.translated: It used to be our routine for me to peel them so they'd be easy for her to eat before handing them over... though before I knew it, she didn't need me to do that anymore.

lines.content: それについてはやはり、多少なりともさみしく感じられてしまうのだけれど、
lines.translated: And honestly, that made me feel a little bit lonely, too.

lines.content: むぅ。とクロは唇を尖らせ不満げな顔だった。
lines.translated: "Mmph," Kuro pouted, looking dissatisfied.

lines.content: だが不平や不満の声を上げるでもなく、クロは『それ……』とお弁当を指さす。
lines.translated: Even so, without voicing any complaints, she pointed at the bento and said, "That..."

lines.content: 次は、それを……
lines.translated: "Next, that one..."

lines.content: から揚げだね。了解
lines.translated: "Fried chicken, huh? Got it."

lines.content: ちがう。その隣。みどりのお野菜
lines.translated: "No. Next to that. The green vegetable."

lines.content: ブロッコリー
lines.translated: "Broccoli."

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: こっくりとする。
lines.translated: She gave a little nod.

lines.content: ぶろっこりー、だ
lines.translated: "Broccoli, yes."

lines.content: 下っ足らずでそう言った。
lines.translated: She said it with a slight lisp.

lines.content: 難しい外国の言葉を反芻するみたいに。
lines.translated: Like she was rolling a difficult foreign word around in her mouth.

lines.content: お肉は男の子が食べるものだよ
lines.translated: "Meat is for boys to eat."

lines.content: え？　そうかな？
lines.translated: "Huh? Really?"

lines.content: うん。大雅は、成長期なんだから。これからもっとすくすくおっきくなるには、毎日美味しいものでお腹いっぱいにならないと……だめ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because you're a growing boy, Taiga. If you want to grow up big and strong from now on, you have to fill your belly with delicious food every day... or else."

lines.content: だからお肉は大雅が食べる。わたしは、そのお野菜を……
lines.translated: "So you eat the meat, Taiga. I'll have that vegetable..."

lines.content: ブロッコリーなんて別に好きじゃないだろ、クロ
lines.translated: "You don't even really like broccoli, do you, Kuro?"

lines.content: そんなこと、ない。大好き
lines.translated: "That's not true. I love it."

lines.content: ふーん
lines.translated: "Uh-huh."

lines.content: まよ……まよ……なんだっけ。大雅
lines.translated: "Mayo... mayo... what was it again, Taiga?"

lines.content: マヨネーズ？
lines.translated: "Mayonnaise?"

lines.content: そう、それ
lines.translated: "Yes, that."

lines.content: また、こっくりする。
lines.translated: She gave another little nod.

lines.content: そして“まよねーず”と、下っ足らずに繰り返し、言った。
lines.translated: Then she repeated "mayonnaise" with that slight lisp of hers.

lines.content: “まよねーず”をかけると、“ぶろっこりー”はとっても美味しい。だから、好きだよ
lines.translated: "When you put 'mayonnaise' on it, 'broccoli' is super delicious. So I like it."

lines.content: お肉は大雅。お野菜は、わたし。そういう決まり
lines.translated: "Meat is for Taiga. Vegetables are for me. That's the rule."

lines.content: 決まりなんだ？
lines.translated: "It's a rule?"

lines.content: 苦笑いでそう言う俺と、
lines.translated: I gave a wry smile as I asked, and...

lines.content: そうだよ。決まりだよ
lines.translated: "That's right. It's the rule."

lines.content: うんうんと小さくうなずくクロだ。
lines.translated: Kuro nodded her head up and down.

lines.content: 美味しいものを年下の子に譲る、そんなお姉さんな自分に納得しているみたいに。
lines.translated: She seemed quite pleased with herself, acting like a big sister giving up the delicious food to a younger kid.

lines.content: そんなクロに、残念だな、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: Seeing her like that, I told her, "That's too bad."

lines.content: 俺さ、ブロッコリー大好物なんだよね
lines.translated: "See, broccoli is actually my absolute favorite."

lines.content: から揚げ、苦手だから。お残ししちゃうのはブロッコリーよりもから揚げのほうだと思うんだけどなあ
lines.translated: "I'm not big on fried chicken. So if I'm gonna leave leftovers, it'll probably be the fried chicken rather than the broccoli."

lines.content: クロは目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Kuro narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: ……なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: 毎日ちゃんとご飯食べてる？
lines.translated: "Are you eating proper meals every day?"

lines.content: そう問いかけると――
lines.translated: When I asked her that--

lines.content: クロは無言でついっと、視線を俺から逸らした。
lines.translated: Kuro silently darted her eyes away from me.

lines.content: それはなんだか好き嫌いを指摘されてしまった子どもみたいな印象だった。
lines.translated: She looked just like a kid who had been called out for being a picky eater.

lines.content: 今朝も朝食のときにはもういなかったし……
lines.translated: "You were already gone by breakfast this morning, too..."

lines.content: クロが俺にお腹いっぱいになってほしいって思ってくれてるみたいに、俺もクロがいつもお腹いっぱいでいてほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "Just like you want me to be full, Kuro, I want you to always have a full belly, too."

lines.content: ちゃんと食べなきゃだめだよと俺は言う。
lines.translated: You have to eat properly, I told her.

lines.content: 君らは俺たちみたいにもうそれ以上は大きくなれないのだとは言っても……。
lines.translated: Even though girls like her couldn't grow any bigger the way we do...

lines.content: クロがお腹空いてたら、嫌だよ。そんなのは悲しい
lines.translated: "I'd hate it if you were hungry, Kuro. That would make me sad."

lines.content: お腹が空くのはさみしいことだ。それにとても悲しいことでもあるはずだ――と、俺は知っている。実体験で理解している。
lines.translated: Being hungry is a lonely thing. And a very sad thing, too--I knew that. I understood it from personal experience.

lines.content: だからさ、俺の嫌いなから揚げ、全部食べてほしいな。クロ
lines.translated: "So, I want you to eat all of this fried chicken that I hate. Okay, Kuro?"

lines.content: クロは俺のことをじっと見ていた。
lines.translated: Kuro stared fixedly at me.

lines.content: そして小さく『うそつき』と言う。
lines.translated: Then, in a small voice, she said, "Liar."

lines.content: ……大雅の、うそつき
lines.translated: "...You're a liar, Taiga."

lines.content: 俺は苦笑いのまま、小さく首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Still smiling wryly, I tilted my head slightly.

lines.content: だけどクロは何も言わず“あーん”、と小さな口を開いた。目を閉じて。
lines.translated: However, without another word, Kuro closed her eyes and opened her small mouth with an "aah."

lines.content: そこに一番大きなから揚げをそっと収める。
lines.translated: I gently placed the biggest piece of fried chicken inside.

lines.content: もぐもぐしていた。目を閉じたまま。
lines.translated: She munched on it, keeping her eyes closed.

lines.content: 美味しい？　と問うと、うん……と小さく返事をしてくれた。
lines.translated: When I asked if it was good, she gave a tiny "Yeah..." in reply.

lines.content: 次、何が食べたい？
lines.translated: "What do you want to eat next?"

lines.content: 大雅が本当に嫌いなもの、全部
lines.translated: "Everything that you really hate, Taiga."

lines.content: クロは言う。
lines.translated: So said Kuro.

lines.content: から揚げだって。ブロッコリーだって。苦いものも辛いものも。大雅が嫌いなものは全部、わたしが食べるよ。任せてね
lines.translated: "Fried chicken. Broccoli. Bitter things and spicy things, too. I'll eat everything you hate, Taiga. Leave it to me."

lines.content: そんなふうにして、みんなと少し離れた場所でクロと一緒にお弁当の残りを食べた。
lines.translated: Just like that, a little ways away from everyone else, Kuro and I ate the rest of the bento together.

lines.content: 今日のクロは電話越しでもないのに少し素直だし、よく話してくれる。
lines.translated: Even though we weren't talking over the phone today, Kuro was being a bit more honest and talkative than usual.

lines.content: うれしいと思った。楽しいとも思った。
lines.translated: It made me happy. I thought it was fun, too.

lines.content: だけどそれは、きっと……。
lines.translated: However, that was probably because...

lines.content: （俺たちがわいわい騒いでるのを遠目に、ひとりぼっちで眺めてて、さみしかったんじゃないかな）
lines.translated: (Watching us making a racket from afar all by herself must have made her feel lonely.)

lines.content: ……なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: そんな予想がもしも正解であるなら、それは少しさみしいことだとも感じてしまう。
lines.translated: If my guess was right, that felt a little sad, too.

lines.content: クロはみんなを見ている。そして町を見ている。
lines.translated: Kuro was watching everyone. And she was watching the town.

lines.content: ……青空に流れて消えゆく小さな、とても小さな春の色を追いかけている。
lines.translated: Her eyes were chasing the tiny, ever-so-tiny colors of spring as they drifted into the blue sky and vanished.

lines.content: そんな彼女の横顔を、俺は盗み見るようにそっと、ただ見つめるばかりだった。
lines.translated: All I could do was quietly steal glances at her profile, simply gazing at her.

lines.content: 小さな彼女は俺の友だち。
lines.translated: This little girl was my friend.

lines.content: そして、俺の家族でもある。幼い頃からずっとふたり一緒に生きてきた。
lines.translated: And she was also my family. The two of us had lived together ever since I was a child.

lines.content: そんな君が、ぽつりと言うのだ。
lines.translated: And then, she murmured softly.

lines.content: 最初に、誰の“魔法”を使うか……もう、決めた？
lines.translated: "Have you decided... whose 'magic' you're going to use first?"

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: ハルと姫織と、そして千和。特別だった三人のうち、まずは誰の願いから、誰の“夢”から、紐解いていくか……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Haru, Himeori, and Chiwa. Out of the three who were special, whose wish, whose 'dream' are you going to unravel first...? Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: それはもう、決まったのかな。
lines.translated: "Have you decided on that yet?"

lines.content: クロは繰り返し俺にそう問いかける。
lines.translated: Kuro asked me the question again.

lines.content: だけど俺は、ただ目を細め、ここからみんなのことを見つめていた。
lines.translated: However, I simply narrowed my eyes and gazed out at everyone from where we sat.

lines.content: ……かつて“特別な女の子”だった彼女らの“願い”や“[・|謎]”を共に解き明かす。
lines.translated: To work together and unravel the "wishes" and "mysteries" of the girls who had once been "special."

lines.content: そして彼女らの叶えられなかった願いを叶える――そのために最大限の協力をする。
lines.translated: And to grant the wishes they hadn't been able to fulfill--offering my utmost cooperation Toward that end.

lines.content: それがこの俺、奏大雅に譲渡された“役割”だ。
lines.translated: That was the "role" that had been passed down to me, Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: この俺、奏大雅は“魔法少女『使い』”なのである。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, am a "Magical Girl 'User.'"

lines.content: 彼女らの願いを叶えるのか。それとも“彼女”らの魔法を奪うのか。
lines.translated: Would I grant their wishes? Or would I steal "their" magic?

lines.content: そうした“役割”を達成することで、俺は……。
lines.translated: By fulfilling that "role," I would...

lines.content: 俺は、俺の中の“特別”は、“最後の魔法”は、ようやく目覚めてくれるのだから――……。
lines.translated: I--the "special" part inside me, the "Last Magic"--would finally awaken...

lines.content: 大雅の“魔法”は、どんな“魔法”になるのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder what kind of 'magic' your 'magic' will be, Taiga."

lines.content: ふとつぶやいた君の声。俺はどうしてか驚いてしまい、首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Her sudden murmur caught me off guard for some reason, and I tilted my head.

lines.content: 大雅の願いを、夢を、叶えるために必要な“魔法”。それはどんなものであるべきなのか――
lines.translated: "The 'magic' needed to grant your wish, your dream, Taiga. What kind of magic ought it to be..."

lines.content: ふたりで一緒に思い描けていられたら、それはとてもすてきなんだろうって、思ってた。でも……
lines.translated: "I used to think how wonderful it would be if the two of us could envision it together. But..."

lines.content: そこでクロは唇をきゅっと結んだ。
lines.translated: At that point, Kuro pressed her lips tightly together.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: そして俺は、無言で首を振り、みんなのことを見つめ続けているばかりだった。
lines.translated: And all I could do was silently shake my head and keep gazing at everyone.

lines.content: 夕刻までぶらぶらと町をみんな一緒で探索し――解散の時刻だ。
lines.translated: We strolled around exploring the town together until evening--and then it was time to part ways.

lines.content: ばいばいみんな。また、明日
lines.translated: "Bye-bye, everyone. See you tomorrow."

lines.content: ハルがにこりと微笑んで。
lines.translated: Haru gave a bright smile.

lines.content: うん。さよならハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Yeah. Goodbye, Haru-chan."

lines.content: 手を振る姫織も笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: Waving her hand, Himeori replied with a smile of her own.

lines.content: 今日はね、楽しかったよ？
lines.translated: "Today was really fun, wasn't it?"

lines.content: ……私もです。楽しかったです。ちょっと恥ずかしいこともありましたけど
lines.translated: "...For me, too. I had a great time. Even if a few things were a little embarrassing."

lines.content: 千和も、姫織の隣でうなずいていた。
lines.translated: Standing next to Himeori, Chiwa nodded in agreement.

lines.content: ああ。そうだね。みんな、改めてこれからもよろしく、だな
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really was. Once again, I'm looking forward to hanging out with you all from here on out."

lines.content: 智仁に次いで俺も『ああ、よろしくな』と言い、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Following Tomohito's lead, I nodded and added, "Yeah, same here."

lines.content: うん、ありがとう……。千和ちゃん。姫織ちゃん。智仁くん。そして、大雅くん。おやすみなさい。また、“夜”の中で会えたらいいね
lines.translated: "Yeah, thank you... Chiwa-chan. Himeori-chan. Tomohito-kun. And Taiga-kun. Goodnight. It'd be nice if we could meet again inside the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 苦笑いでハルがそう言い――でもすぐにハルはため息をつくのだった。
lines.translated: Haru said this with a wry smile--though she immediately followed it up with a sigh.

lines.content: あ～、明日は学校かあ。宿題まだ全然やってない。少し億劫だなあ
lines.translated: "Ahh, school's tomorrow, huh? I haven't touched my homework at all yet. What a pain..."

lines.content: あえて子どもの頃みたいに“宿題”と言えばなんだかかわいい。
lines.translated: Deliberately calling it "homework" like a little kid made it sound kind of cute.

lines.content: だから問題もあの頃みたいに簡単でかわいい問題だったらいいのになあ。
lines.translated: "So I really wish the problems were as easy and cute as they were back then, too."

lines.content: そんなことをため息と同時に吐き出すハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru breathed those words out right along with her sigh.

lines.content: ハルちゃん、転校してきたばっかりなのに、もう学校行きたくない子になっちゃった？
lines.translated: "Haru-chan, you just transferred here, and you're already turning into a kid who doesn't want to go to school?"

lines.content: さっそく問題児みたいだよね。億劫というより不安なのかも。お勉強についていけるかなあとか。怖い先生いたら嫌だなあとか。そんな感じ
lines.translated: "I already sound like a problem child, don't I? Maybe I'm more anxious than reluctant, though. Wondering if I'll be able to keep up with the classes, or dreading the thought of scary teachers. Stuff like that."

lines.content: ハルちゃんでもそんな感じの心配、するんだね？
lines.translated: "Even you worry about things like that, Haru-chan?"

lines.content: とっても意外、と姫織は目をパチパチとさせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori blinked in surprise, finding it completely unexpected.

lines.content: そんな視線にハルは苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: Haru met her gaze with a wry smile.

lines.content: う、うん。転校生っぽい悩みでいっぱい。胸もいっぱい。ドキドキしちゃうよ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I'm full of typical transfer student worries. My chest is full of them, too. My heart is pounding."

lines.content: でもね、新しい学校で、お友だちできるかなあって不安は、えへへ、しなくてもいいけどね
lines.translated: "Although, ehehe, I guess I don't have to worry about whether I'll be able to make friends at my new school."

lines.content: そんな照れ笑いにつられて俺たちも笑ってしまった。
lines.translated: Drawn in by her bashful smile, the rest of us couldn't help but laugh, too.

lines.content: ここからみんなで一緒に宿題片づけようか……というのも悪くはないけど。でも
lines.translated: "'Why don't we all go knock out our homework together right now?' ...is what I'd like to say, and it's not a bad idea, but..."

lines.content: と、俺が言い。
lines.translated: I started to say.

lines.content: 今日はさすがに少し疲れましたね。宿題やったらすぐに寝たいかもです
lines.translated: "I think we're all a bit tired today. I might just want to go straight to sleep after finishing my homework."

lines.content: 千和が答えて……。
lines.translated: Chiwa answered...

lines.content: それが合図だ。
lines.translated: And that was our cue.

lines.content: 改めて、今日のところはさようならと手を振り、俺たちは別れた。
lines.translated: Waving goodbye once more for the day, we went our separate ways.

lines.content: 先輩？　帰らないんですか？
lines.translated: "Senpai? Aren't you going home?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 背後からかけられた声に驚き、振り向いた。
lines.translated: Startled by the voice calling out from behind me, I turned around.

lines.content: 千和？
lines.translated: "Chiwa?"

lines.content: そこには俺のかわいい後輩、杏藤千和がひとりで立っていた。
lines.translated: Standing there all by herself was my cute underclassman, Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: どうしたんだ？　千和こそ帰ったんじゃなかったっけ
lines.translated: "What's wrong? Didn't you head home yourself, Chiwa?"

lines.content: 目をぱちぱちとさせながらそう問いかける俺に、
lines.translated: I blinked in surprise as I asked her.

lines.content: はい……。一度は帰ろうと思ったんですけど、ふと見たら先輩だけ石橋の上に残って、なんだかぼーっとしてたから。少し……少しだけですよ？　気になって
lines.translated: "Yes... I was going to, at first, but when I happened to glance back, you were the only one left standing on the stone bridge, spacing out. So I got a little... just a little bit curious, okay?"

lines.content: だから戻って来たのだと千和は言う。決まり悪そうに、唇を尖らせながら。
lines.translated: That was why she had come back, Chiwa explained, pouting awkwardly.

lines.content: そんな千和から改めて『どうしたんですか』と問われる。
lines.translated: Then, she asked me once again what was wrong.

lines.content: 先輩。何か考え事ですか？　それとも……何か、悩みでも
lines.translated: "Senpai. Were you thinking about something? Or... is something troubling you?"

lines.content: あ、えっと……いや
lines.translated: "Ah, um... well..."

lines.content: 考え事だと言われればその通りだし、悩み事だと言われても、やはりその通りなのだけど……確かに。
lines.translated: If she called it thinking, she was right, and if she called it something troubling me, she was right about that, too... Admittedly.

lines.content: うん。確かに、だ。少しぼーっとしてたな。ほら、見て
lines.translated: "Yeah. You caught me. I was spacing out a bit. Here, look."

lines.content: 俺は石橋の低い欄干から顔を覗かせ、真下に流れる川の水面を視線で指した。
lines.translated: I leaned over the low railing of the stone bridge and pointed with my eyes toward the surface of the river flowing directly below.

lines.content: 川の流れをじっと見てたら、なんだかさ、ずっと行き詰まってしまってる考え事や、悩み事にも、自然といい解決法とかが頭の中に流れてくるような……そんな気がしないかな
lines.translated: "Don't you ever feel like... if you just stare at the flow of the river, a good solution to whatever thoughts or worries you're stuck on might naturally come flowing into your head?"

lines.content: うーん……
じっと、俺の隣に立った千和も、爪先立ちで欄干から顔を覗かせ、
lines.translated: Standing right beside me, Chiwa stood on her tiptoes to peer over the railing as well, staring intently down at the water.

lines.content: 先輩の言うこと、わかるような。わからないような……。微妙な感じですね
lines.translated: "I feel like I kind of get what you're saying, Senpai, and kind of don't... It's a bit of a stretch."

lines.content: 首をかしげ、苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: She tilted her head, a wry smile surfacing on her face.

lines.content: そんなつきあいのいい後輩に、俺は小さく笑顔を返してみせた。
lines.translated: I gave a small smile back to my obliging underclassman for humoring me.

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 先輩、どうして……考え事とか悩み事の解決法が、自然と流れてくるのを待っていたんですか？
lines.translated: "Senpai, why... were you waiting for a solution to your thoughts and worries to come flowing to you naturally?"

lines.content: 先輩の考え事や悩み事、ひとりでしか考えたり、悩んだりできない……そんな問題なんですか？
lines.translated: "Are the things you're thinking and worrying about... problems that you can only think and worry about all by yourself?"

lines.content: 俺を見上げる視線には、言葉はなくとも、“私、力になれませんか？”という問いかけがはっきりと見えていた。
lines.translated: Even without words, the gaze looking up at me clearly held the question: "Can't I be of any help?"

lines.content: ごめんな千和。ありがとうな、千和。
lines.translated: Sorry, Chiwa. And thank you, Chiwa.

lines.content: いつも意地悪ばかりしてしまうのに、そしていつも“先輩嫌い”と頬を膨らませてばかりなのに、いざというときはこうして一番、気に掛けてくれる。それはとてもうれしいことだけど……。
lines.translated: Even though I'm always teasing her, and even though she's always puffing out her cheeks and saying "I hate you, Senpai," when push comes to shove, she's the one who worries about me the most like this. That makes me really happy, but...

lines.content: でも、まだ、“実は俺、君たちの叶えられなかった夢を叶えられるかもしれないんだ”――とは言い出せるはずもなく。
lines.translated: Even so, there was no way I could bring myself to say, "Actually, I might be able to grant the dreams you girls couldn't fulfill" just yet.

lines.content: ……千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: はい？
lines.translated: "Excuse me?"

lines.content: 服、汚れちゃってるよ。ちょっとだけ
lines.translated: "Your clothes got a little dirty."

lines.content: 欄干に爪先立ちで寄りかかった際、胸のところに黒いススのような汚れが付着してしまっていた。
lines.translated: When she had leaned against the railing on her tiptoes, a smudge like black soot had gotten onto the chest of her uniform.

lines.content: その服
lines.translated: "That outfit..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: かわいい感じで……いいね。千和によく似合ってる
lines.translated: "It's got a cute vibe to it... It's nice. It really suits you, Chiwa."

lines.content: え、う
lines.translated: "Eh, uh..."

lines.content: え？　う？
lines.translated: "Eh? Uh?"

lines.content: ……な、なんでもありません
lines.translated: "...I-It's nothing."

lines.content: 少し赤い頬。それを隠すみたいについっとそっぽを向いたまま、
lines.translated: Her cheeks were slightly flushed. Quickly looking away as if to hide them, she spoke.

lines.content: ……お父さんから入学祝いに新しく買って貰った服なんです。一緒にお店に行って、ふたりで寸法測って……
lines.translated: "...My dad bought these new clothes for me to celebrate my enrollment. We went to the shop together, and had my measurements taken..."

lines.content: ちょっとだけ思い出のある制服なんですと千和は言う。
lines.translated: It was a uniform with a few special memories attached to it, Chiwa said.

lines.content: だから大切に、大切に、したかったんです。それなのに、うう、早速汚しちゃって……
lines.translated: "That's why I wanted to take really, really good care of it. And yet, ugh, I already got it dirty..."

lines.content: しゅんとしている千和に、俺は首をかしげ、言う。
lines.translated: Looking at the dejected Chiwa, I tilted my head and asked,

lines.content: お父さん……？
lines.translated: "Your dad...?"

lines.content: はい……。え？　なんで不思議そうな顔をするんですか？　私にだってお父さんくらいいますよ
lines.translated: "Yes... Huh? Why are you making such a puzzled face? Even I have a dad, you know."

lines.content: あ、ああ。そうだね。確かにそうだ
lines.translated: "Ah, right. Yeah, of course you do."

lines.content: ええ。そうです
lines.translated: "Yes, I do."

lines.content: そこでなぜか得意げに胸を張り、
lines.translated: For some reason, she puffed out her chest proudly at that.

lines.content: やさしいお父さんのひとりやふたり、私にだってちゃんといてくれるんですよ
lines.translated: "Even I have a kind dad or two looking out for me, you know."

lines.content: いや。お父さんがふたりもいるのは……まあ、義父とか養父とか、あり得ない話でもないかもだけど、複雑だよ。家庭環境とかがさ
lines.translated: "Hold on. Having two dads is... well, with stepfathers or adoptive fathers, I guess it's not impossible, but that sounds complicated. Family-wise, I mean."

lines.content: 苦笑いを交換し合い、俺の考え事だとか悩み事だとか、そんな話を誤魔化しきれた。
lines.translated: We exchanged wry smiles, and just like that, I managed to completely brush off the topic of my thoughts and worries.

lines.content: じゃあ、先輩。改めてさよならです
lines.translated: "Well then, Senpai. Goodbye again."

lines.content: 千和が取り出したスマホで時刻を確かめ、言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa pulled out her smartphone to check the time and spoke.

lines.content: そろそろ戻ってお店のお手伝いもしなきゃですし
lines.translated: "I have to head back soon and help out at the shop, too."

lines.content: ああ、うん。わかった
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Got it."

lines.content: だめですよ先輩
lines.translated: "Don't do it, okay, Senpai?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: またぼーっとしてたらだめですよ。なんだかさみしい人みたいに見えちゃいます
lines.translated: "You can't go spacing out again. It makes you look like a lonely person."

lines.content: 意地悪そうな笑顔でそう言う千和だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa said this with a teasing smile.

lines.content: うーん。さみしい人、か。そしたらまた戻って来てくれるかな。俺のこと、心配してくれるかな……？
lines.translated: "Hmm. A lonely person, huh? If I do, I wonder if you'll come back for me again. Will you worry about me...?"

lines.content: そんなの……。知りません
lines.translated: "How should I... I don't know."

lines.content: ぷいっとそっぽを向く千和である。
lines.translated: Chiwa huffed and turned her head away.

lines.content: それに、別に私は先輩のこと心配して戻って来たわけじゃないんですもん
lines.translated: "Besides, it's not like I came back because I was worried about you, Senpai."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: ええ、そうですよ
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right."

lines.content: ……たぶん
lines.translated: "...Probably."

lines.content: 小さくそうとだけ残し、“じゃあ、どうして戻って来たのかな”と俺が問いかける前に、千和は小走りで帰って行った。
lines.translated: Leaving only that quiet mutter behind, before I could ask, "Then why did you come back?", Chiwa scurried off toward home.

lines.content: それじゃあ先輩。また明日
lines.translated: "See you, Senpai. Until tomorrow."

lines.content: 早口で、そんな一言だけ残して……。
lines.translated: Rattling off just those parting words...

lines.content: ああ。……また明日、千和
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...See you tomorrow, Chiwa."

lines.content: ひとりでぽつりとそう零し、俺も帰路についた。
lines.translated: Murmuring that to myself, I started on my own way home.

lines.content: うう。たいがー……
lines.translated: "Ugh. Taigaaa..."

lines.content: ど、どうしたひよちゃん。そんなめそめそしちゃって
lines.translated: "W-What's wrong, Hiyo-chan? Why are you sniffling like that?"

lines.content: みんなとさよならした後、しばし石橋に残り、“みんなの魔法”についてぼーっと考え事をしていた俺だ。
lines.translated: After saying goodbye to everyone, I'd lingered on the stone bridge for a while, spacing out and thinking about "everyone's magic."

lines.content: そろそろ俺も帰らないとなあと、石橋を離れようとしたとき、ひとりぼっちの姫織がとぼとぼと戻って来たのだった。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to leave the bridge, thinking it was high time I headed home myself, Himeori came trudging back all alone.

lines.content: 何か、あった？　怪我してないか？
lines.translated: "Did something happen? Are you hurt?"

lines.content: 転けたりでもしたのだろうか。それとも、事故に巻き込まれたりとか……。
lines.translated: Had she tripped and fallen? Or maybe gotten caught up in an accident...?

lines.content: 姫織の身体を順番に確認していく。大丈夫、怪我はない。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: I checked Himeori's body over from head to toe. She was fine, no injuries. At least, there shouldn't be.

lines.content: ……お腹
lines.translated: "...Stomach."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: お腹、ぺこぺこで……。帰り道がよくわかんなくなっちって……
lines.translated: "My stomach is so empty... I kinda forgot the way home..."

lines.content: おおー。そっか、なるほど
lines.translated: "Ohhh. Right, I see."

lines.content: 安心し、俺はうなずく。微笑んで。
lines.translated: Relieved, I nodded with a smile.

lines.content: 食いしん坊な夜月さん[ち|家]の姫織ちゃんは、お腹が空くと不思議なことに迷子になっちゃう子だったね
lines.translated: "Our little glutton Himeori-chan from the Yotsuki family has a mysterious habit of getting lost whenever she's hungry, doesn't she?"

lines.content: そ、そう……みたいでして
lines.translated: "T-That... seems to be the case."

lines.content: 俺がまだ帰らずにいて、よかった。ひよちゃんが迷子のままだなんて……。一晩中、町のどこかでひとりぼっちだなんて。そんなの考えただけでもぞっとする
lines.translated: "I'm glad I hadn't gone home yet. To think you could've stayed lost, Hiyo-chan... All alone somewhere in town for the whole night. Just thinking about it gives me the chills."

lines.content: いいかいひよちゃん。よく聞くんだぞ、と俺は真剣な顔をする。
lines.translated: "Listen closely, Hiyo-chan," I said, putting on a serious face.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで迷子になっちゃったら遠慮なく電話してくれていいんだぞ？　そこが近くても、そうじゃなくても、飛んでいくからな
lines.translated: "If you ever get lost all by yourself, don't hesitate to call me, okay? Whether you're nearby or far away, I'll come flying right to you."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずくも、姫織は照れ照れしながら、
lines.translated: Himeori nodded, looking bashful.

lines.content: そう言ってくれるのはね、うれしいけれども……え、えへへ。[おんな|同]じくらい、恥ずかしくって
lines.translated: "It makes me happy to hear you say that, really, it does... E-Ehehe. But it's just as embarrassing."

lines.content: 迷子になるのが？
lines.translated: "Getting lost?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: だから、迷子になりましたって……中々、助けをお願いできない？
lines.translated: "So it's hard for you to tell someone you're lost... and ask for help?"

lines.content: ……ことも、あるかもしれないですね
lines.translated: "...That might be part of it, yes."

lines.content: 座り悪そうな表情で、姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori answered with an awkward expression.

lines.content: 大雅も、ともちゃんも、迷子になるのは別に格好悪くないよって言ってくれたけど……
lines.translated: "Both you and Tomo-chan told me that getting lost isn't anything to be ashamed of, though..."

lines.content: ああ、そうさ。格好悪いなんて……そんなことない。むしろかわいい。そう言ったろ？
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. There's nothing uncool about it at all. If anything, it's cute. Didn't I tell you that?"

lines.content: う、うん。そう……だったかもね
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I think... you might have."

lines.content: 姫織は小さな頭をふらふらとさせながら、
lines.translated: Himeori swayed her little head from side to side.

lines.content: それでもやっぱり、“迷子になりました”って言うのは恥ずかくって。でも、変だよね。お腹が空いたーって言うのは別に隠さず言えるのに
lines.translated: "Even so, saying 'I got lost' is still really embarrassing. Isn't that strange, though? I have no problem coming right out and saying I'm hungry."

lines.content: ……なるほど
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ひよちゃんの乙女心はちょっと複雑なんだなあ
lines.translated: "A maiden's heart is a complicated thing, huh, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: どちらともなく自然と手を繋ぐ。
lines.translated: Without either of us really initiating it, our hands naturally found each other.

lines.content: そして姫織を送り届けるための帰り道を、ふたり並んで歩き始める。
lines.translated: Then, walking side by side, we set off down the road to take Himeori home.

lines.content: ぬっふふー。大雅の手はおっきいですねー
lines.translated: "Nufufu~ Your hand is so big, Taiga~"

lines.content: ちょっと恥ずかしそうに繋いだ手をぶんぶん振る姫織だった。
lines.translated: Looking a little shy, Himeori swung our joined hands back and forth.

lines.content: 気づかないでごめんね。ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Sorry I didn't notice, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: えー？
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: 智仁がいるから大丈夫――だ、なんて。人任せにしてたのかもしれない
lines.translated: "I figured you'd be fine since Tomohito was there... I guess I was just leaving it up to him."

lines.content: あいつはあいつで俺がいるから大丈夫、と――無意識にでもそう思っていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: And for his part, he'd probably assumed things would be fine because I was there, even if only subconsciously.

lines.content: 今度からは気をつける。そりゃー、今日は一日町を歩き回ったんだ。ひよちゃんじゃなくてもお腹、空くって
lines.translated: "I'll be more careful from now on. I mean, we walked around town all day today. Anyone would be starving after that, not just you, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: 腹ぺこな怪獣を町に放てってしまったら人類のピンチでもあるからね。うん。だからちゃんとひよちゃんを送り届けるのは俺たちの義務なんだよ
lines.translated: "If a ravenous monster were unleashed upon the town, it'd be a crisis for all humanity. Yep. So making sure you get home safe and sound is our sworn duty."

lines.content: い、いや～……その……えへへ
lines.translated: "N-No, well... umm... ehehe."

lines.content: 身体をくねくねさせていた。なんだか言葉にしがたい気持ちに耐えているみたいにも見えた。
lines.translated: She squirmed bashfully. It almost looked like she was trying to hold back feelings she couldn't quite put into words.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 姫織の神社へと続く石階段にたどり着くと、姫織は言った。
lines.translated: When we reached the stone steps leading up to her shrine, Himeori spoke up.

lines.content: ん？　なに？
lines.translated: "Hm? What is it?"

lines.content: ちょっと……ちょっとだけ、聞きたいことがあるんだけど、いい？
lines.translated: "Um... There's just one little thing I want to ask you, if that's okay?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろん。どんなことかな
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course. What is it?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そして、階段の下で立ち止まる姫織だ。俺も合わせて、立ち止まる。
lines.translated: Himeori stopped at the bottom of the stairs. I stopped right alongside her.

lines.content: ひよちゃん？
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 大雅は
lines.translated: "Taiga, you..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅はまだあそこに……。“夜の国”の中に出入りできるんだよね？　私たちと違って
lines.translated: "You can still go there... You can still go in and out of the 'Land of Night,' right? Unlike the rest of us."

lines.content: ぽつりと言った。小首をかしげるような仕草で。
lines.translated: She murmured the question, tilting her head slightly.

lines.content: あ、ああ……。そうだね
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah... That's right."

lines.content: なんと応えていいのかわからず、俺はただそれだけ言って、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Not knowing how else to answer, I simply said that and nodded.

lines.content: ……そっか。そうなんだ
lines.translated: "...I see. So you can."

lines.content: それだけ言うと、姫織は階段の続いている先を――神社へと続くその一つひとつを、じっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: Saying only that, Himeori stared intently up the stairs, gazing at each and every step leading toward the shrine.

lines.content: 今日は、久しぶりだったね
lines.translated: "Today was the first time in a long while, wasn't it?"

lines.content: 姫織が言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: 久しぶり？
lines.translated: "A long while?"

lines.content: と、俺が応える。
lines.translated: I echoed.

lines.content: うん。そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. That's right."

lines.content: 平日は登下校、できるだけみんな一緒だけれども……。お休みの日まで、今日みたいにみんな一緒で遊ぶのはとても久しぶりだった
lines.translated: "On weekdays, we walk to and from school together as much as we can... but it's been a really long time since we all hung out together on a day off like today."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 言われてみればそうだったかもしれない。
lines.translated: Now that she mentioned it, she was probably right.

lines.content: 私、楽しかったよ。大雅やハルちゃん、千和ちゃん、ともちゃん、みんなはどうだったかはね、わからないけど……
lines.translated: "I had fun. I don't know how it was for you, Haru-chan, Chiwa-chan, or Tomo-chan, though..."

lines.content: でも私はとっても、とっても、楽しかったなあと姫織は言い――笑った。
lines.translated: "But I had a really, really wonderful time," Himeori said, and smiled.

lines.content: ひよちゃん……？
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan...?"

lines.content: なんだか言い得ぬ違和感を覚え……どうした？　何かあったのか？
lines.translated: I felt an indescribable sense of unease... What's wrong? Did something happen?

lines.content: そう問いかけようとしたけれど、
lines.translated: I was just about to ask her that, when--

lines.content: それではそれでは。ありがとう大雅。ここまで来ればもう迷わないよ
lines.translated: "Well then, well then. Thank you, Taiga. Now that I'm here, I won't get lost anymore."

lines.content: パッと繋いだ手を離し、姫織は頭を下げた。
lines.translated: Quickly letting go of my hand, Himeori bowed her head.

lines.content: さよなら大雅。……今夜、“夜で会えたらすてきだね”
lines.translated: "Goodbye, Taiga. ...'Wouldn't it be wonderful if we could meet in the Night' tonight?"

lines.content: それだけ残し――俺にとっては[・|懐][・|か][・|し][・|い]と感じる言葉を残し、姫織は階段を駆け上っていった。
lines.translated: Leaving only that behind--words that felt *nostalgic* to me--Himeori dashed up the stairs.

lines.content: 走ったら危ないよ！　そう言う俺には振り返らず、うん、わかってるーとだけ、姫織は元気に返してくれた。
lines.translated: "It's dangerous to run!" I called out, and without looking back, Himeori just cheerfully replied, "Yep, I know~!"

lines.content: ……さあ。お家に帰ろう。
lines.translated: Alright. Time to head home.

lines.content: あさひさんの待っていてくれる“ゆめのねどこ”へ帰ろうか。そして今日のことを報告したい。
lines.translated: Let's go back to the "Dream Bedchamber" where Asahi-san is waiting for me. I want to tell her all about today.

lines.content: 首から下げた“鍵”を取り出す。“ゆめのねどこ”の玄関を開き、こちらとあちらを繋ぐ“鍵”
lines.translated: I pulled out the "Key" hanging from my neck. The "Key" that opens the front door to the "Dream Bedchamber," connecting this side to the other.

lines.content: しかしすぐにはそれを使用しない。十夜を迎えに行かなくちゃ。
lines.translated: However, I didn't use it right away. I had to go pick up Toya first.

lines.content: ごめんね、遅くなったかも。待っててくれたのかな？
lines.translated: "Sorry, I might be a bit late. Were you waiting for me?"

lines.content: 公園の出入り口だ。
lines.translated: It was the entrance to the park.

lines.content: 金属製の車止めに腰かけ、小さな両足をぶらぶらさせていた十夜を見つけて、声をかけた。
lines.translated: Spotting Toya sitting on a metal bollard and swinging her little legs back and forth, I called out to her.

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 小さくうなずく。
lines.translated: She gave a small nod.

lines.content: そんな十夜が少し元気ないように見えて……。
lines.translated: She looked a little down, so...

lines.content: 手、つなごうか
lines.translated: "Shall we hold hands?"

lines.content: ……差し出した手をそっと握り返してくれた十夜。
lines.translated: Toya gently squeezed the hand I offered her.

lines.content: ……あのね。大雅
lines.translated: "...Um, Taiga."

lines.content: しばらく無言で歩いていると、十夜がぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: After we had walked in silence for a while, Toya spoke up softly.

lines.content: うん。何かな、十夜
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it, Toya?"

lines.content: ……大雅は忘れちゃったりしないよね？
lines.translated: "...You won't forget, right, Taiga?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 突然だった。
lines.translated: It came out of nowhere.

lines.content: 俺は少しだけ驚いてしまう。
lines.translated: That caught me slightly off guard.

lines.content: そんな俺に十夜は言うのだ。小首をかしげるようにして。不安そうな目で、俺を見上げながら。
lines.translated: Tilting her head slightly, Toya spoke to me again, looking up at me with anxious eyes.

lines.content: 大雅は、違うよね？　他の人間たちとは……違う男の子、なんだよね？　だって、大雅。お姉ちゃんから特別な力を貰った人、なんだよね……？
lines.translated: "You're different, right, Taiga? You're a different kind of boy... from the other humans, right? Because, Taiga... you received a special power from Onee-chan, didn't you...?"

lines.content: 十夜？　どうしたのかな
lines.translated: "Toya? What's wrong?"

lines.content: 俺があさひさんから受け取ったものは“役割”であって、決してそういうふうに働く“力”ではないのだけど……。
lines.translated: What I had received from Asahi-san was a "role," and definitely not a "power" that worked like that, though...

lines.content: 何かあったのかな？　と俺は問いかける。
lines.translated: "Did something happen?" I asked.

lines.content: もにょもにょとするばかり。はっきりとしない。
lines.translated: She just mumbled and fidgeted, unable to give a clear answer.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: うん。聞いてるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm listening."

lines.content: ゆっくりでいいよと俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Take your time," I told her.

lines.content: 言いにくいことならまた今度でもいいし、十夜が大丈夫になるまで待ってるよ
lines.translated: "If it's hard to talk about, we can save it for another time. I'll wait until you're ready, Toya."

lines.content: そんな言葉を重ねた俺に、十夜は『……うん』とうなずき、こう言った。
lines.translated: As I offered those reassuring words, Toya nodded with a quiet "...Okay," and said this.

lines.content: あのね。大雅は、大人になっても私たちが[・|見][・|え][・|る]人なんだよね？
lines.translated: "Um, you see. Even when you grow up, Taiga, you'll still be able to *see* us, right?"

lines.content: 見える……？
lines.translated: "See you...?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 人間たちは大人になると私たちのことが見えなくなっちゃう。忘れちゃう。私とお友だちでいてくれるのは、子どものときだけだから……
lines.translated: "When humans grow up, they stop being able to see us. They forget. Because they can only be friends with me while they're children..."

lines.content: ふと十夜はこちらを見上げる。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Toya looked up at me.

lines.content: だからね、大雅。私、これまでお友だちといっぱい、いっぱい、さよならしてきたよ……？
lines.translated: "That's why, Taiga... I've had to say goodbye to my friends so, so many times until now, you know...?"

lines.content: ……さよならも言えないまま、さよなら、してきたよ
lines.translated: "...I've had to say goodbye, without even getting to tell them goodbye."

lines.content: だからね。もうお友だちはいらないって、さみしいばかりだから絶対に作らないんだって、そう思ってたけど……
lines.translated: "So, you see. I used to think I didn't need any more friends, that I'd never make any again because it only ever made me lonely..."

lines.content: 不安なの……大雅も……いつか
lines.translated: "I'm scared... that you might, too, Taiga... Someday..."

lines.content: うつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: She looked down.

lines.content: いつか大雅も、私のこと、私たちのこと……忘れちゃう？
lines.translated: "Someday, will you forget about me... about us, too, Taiga?"

lines.content: 十夜……。
lines.translated: Toya...

lines.content: 何があったのかはわからない……いや。想像することくらいはできる。
lines.translated: I didn't know what had happened... No, I could at least imagine it.

lines.content: だがそんな程度のことで、十夜の気持ちをわかったふうな顔はできやしない。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't possibly act like I understood how she felt based on mere guesswork.

lines.content: だからこそ俺はあまりに軽率に、ともすれば薄情に、こう言えてしまったのだろうか――
lines.translated: Maybe that was why I ended up speaking so thoughtlessly, perhaps even heartlessly--

lines.content: 忘れないよ。絶対
lines.translated: "I won't forget. Never."

lines.content: ――……こんな無責任な言葉を、笑顔を、態度を。その数々を。
lines.translated: --...Offering such irresponsible words, smiles, and attitudes. All of it.

lines.content: 俺は大丈夫だよ。絶対にね
lines.translated: "I'll be fine. I promise."

lines.content: こんなふうに、十夜の小さな胸に燻る不安な気持ちに、投げかけられてしまうのだろうか。
lines.translated: How could I just toss words like that at the anxious feelings smoldering in Toya's little chest?

lines.content: だってさ、十夜。俺はいつまで経っても子どもだからね。心が幼いんだよ。だからほら、俺だけはいつまでも“夜の国”に出入りできるし……
lines.translated: "I mean, come on, Toya. I'm still a kid no matter how much time passes. I'm immature at heart. That's why I'm the only one who can keep coming and going from the 'Night Country' forever..."

lines.content: みんなは少しずつ“夜”に関する記憶さえ忘れてしまってきているけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though everyone else is gradually forgetting their memories of the "Night"...

lines.content: 俺は、大丈夫だよ。絶対に。十夜のことも、あさひさんのことも、忘れない。絶対だ
lines.translated: "I'll be fine. Definitely. I won't forget you, Toya, or Asahi-san. Never."

lines.content: クロのこともそうだ。俺は忘れないと誓える。その自信がある――[・|そ][・|れ]が必ずしも[・|幸][・|せ][・|な][・|在][・|り][・|方]ではなかったとしても。
lines.translated: The same went for Kuro. I could swear I wouldn't forget. I was confident of that--even if *that* wasn't necessarily a *happy way to be*.

lines.content: 軽率であろうと。薄情であろうとも。それは事実であろう。そうならなければならないのだ。
lines.translated: Thoughtless or heartless, it was the truth. It had to be.

lines.content: 故に。だから。俺は笑顔で言うのだ。
lines.translated: Therefore. Because of that. I told her with a smile.

lines.content: 十夜は今、さみしい気持ちかもしれないけど、俺は少しだけうれしいな。俺とさよならしたくないってそう思ってくれたんだよね
lines.translated: "You might be feeling lonely right now, Toya, capacity-wise, I'm actually a little happy. It means you don't want to say goodbye to me, right?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ……少しだけ
lines.translated: "...Just a little."

lines.content: もじもじとしながら十夜は言った。
lines.translated: Toya fidgeted as she spoke.

lines.content: そっか。少しだけ、か
lines.translated: "I see. Just a little, huh?"

lines.content: 微笑みながらそる応えるも、ふるふると十夜は首を振り、
lines.translated: I replied with a smile, and Toya gave a tiny shake of her head.

lines.content: 今夜は、大雅。少しだけでいいの。一緒に眠ってくれる……？
lines.translated: "Tonight, Taiga. Just for a little while is fine. Will you sleep with me...?"

lines.content: 俺と一緒に？
lines.translated: "With me?"

lines.content: うん。……だめ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Is that bad?"

lines.content: ううん、だめじゃない。いいよ
lines.translated: "No, not at all. Sure."

lines.content: それで十夜の不安とかさみしい気持ちが少しだけでも薄れるのなら。
lines.translated: If that would ease Toya's anxiety and loneliness even just a little bit.

lines.content: つないだ手をぎゅっと握って、いつもよりゆっくり、“ゆめのねどこ”へと続く道を十夜と歩いた。
lines.translated: Giving her hand a gentle squeeze, I walked with Toya down the path leading to the "Dream Bedchamber" more slowly than usual.

lines.content: ……そっか。お友だちが大人になっちゃったか
lines.translated: "...I see. So your friend grew up, huh?"

lines.content: お夕飯の席であさひさんが言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke up at the dinner table.

lines.content: どんなことがあったのかはわからないけど……うん。十夜。大変な日だったな。とてもさみしい、日曜日だったな
lines.translated: "I don't know what happened, but... yeah. Toya. It was a rough day, wasn't it? A very lonely Sunday."

lines.content: おかわりもあるからいっぱい食べよう。お腹がすくとさみしい気持ちが大きくなっちゃうから
lines.translated: "There's plenty for seconds, so eat up. Lonely feelings only get bigger on an empty stomach."

lines.content: ……今夜のメニュー。
lines.translated: Tonight's menu.

lines.content: 鰤の生姜照り焼き。レンコンのキンピラ。お野菜たっぷりのお味噌汁。レタスとプチトマトのおなじみのサラダ。そしてお茶碗一杯に盛られた五穀米のご飯である。
lines.translated: Ginger teriyaki yellowtail. Kinpira lotus root. Miso soup loaded with vegetables. The usual lettuce and cherry tomato salad. And a bowl heaped with five-grain rice.

lines.content: 美味しいそうだ。それに健康にもよさそうである。
lines.translated: It looked delicious. And healthy, too.

lines.content: ……お肉がないよ。お魚、苦手
lines.translated: "...There's no meat. I don't like fish."

lines.content: まるで猫とは思えないことを言いながら――
lines.translated: Saying something completely un-catlike--

lines.content: そして最初はちょっとぐずっていた十夜だったが、それでもちゃんと残さず平らげた。
lines.translated: Toya fussed a little at first, but she still ate every last bite.

lines.content: 健康にいいということは心にもいいということだ。
lines.translated: What is good for your health is also good for your heart.

lines.content: からっぽなお腹が満たされるということは、さみしい気持ちを身体の中から追い出すことだ。
lines.translated: Filling an empty stomach chases the loneliness right out of your body.

lines.content: でも、今の小さなさみしさを追い出したり、心もすっかり健康になるまでには、まだまだ色々と足りなかったみたいで……。
lines.translated: However, it seemed it still wasn't quite enough to chase away her little loneliness right now, or to make her heart completely healthy again...

lines.content: 美味しかった？
lines.translated: "Was it good?"

lines.content: あさひさんがそう問いかけると、
lines.translated: When Asahi-san asked that,

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 十夜は合掌し……立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Toya pressed her hands together... and stood up.

lines.content: パタパタとあさひさんのところに近寄っていく。
lines.translated: She padded over to Asahi-san.

lines.content: そしてあさひさんの背中に抱き着いた。
lines.translated: And hugged her from behind.

lines.content: ぐりぐりと顔を押し付けていた。
lines.translated: She rubbed her face against Asahi-san's back.

lines.content: その様子は最初に出会った頃の、まだまだ俺のことを警戒していた人見知りな十夜を思い出してしまう。
lines.translated: The sight reminded me of how shy and wary Toya had been of me when we first met.

lines.content: ……こんなさみしい気持ちにはなりたくないから
lines.translated: "...Because you don't want to feel this lonely anymore."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ああ、うん
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah."

lines.content: あさひさんは苦笑いで言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said with a wry smile.

lines.content: こんなさみしい“さよなら”はもうお腹いっぱいだから。だからもうお友だちは作らないんだ。お友だちは大雅だけで充分なんだ――十夜はそう言っていたのにな
lines.translated: "'I've had my fill of these lonely goodbyes. So I'm not making any more friends. Having Taiga as a friend is enough for me'--even though that's what you used to say, Toya."

lines.content: あさひさんはすり寄って来る十夜の頭を撫でながらそう言っていた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke while stroking Toya's head as the girl nuzzled against her.

lines.content: きっとすごくやさしい子を見つけちゃったんだな、十夜。その子の笑顔が見たいって、その子を笑わせてあげたいって、そう、思っちゃったんだよな。……きっと
lines.translated: "You must have found a really sweet kid, huh, Toya? You wanted to see them smile, you wanted to make them laugh, didn't you? ...I'm sure of it."

lines.content: 私たちの悪い癖だよなとあさひさんは苦笑いを浮かべている。
lines.translated: It's a bad habit of ours, isn't it? Asahi-san added with a wry smile.

lines.content: だから……十夜。“さよなら”がいつもより、もっともっと、さみしいんだな
lines.translated: "That's why... Toya. Saying 'goodbye' is so, so much lonelier than usual, isn't it?"

lines.content: ……いったい十夜の“今日”に何があったのか。
lines.translated: Just what had happened in Toya's "today"?

lines.content: どうしてそんなにさみしい気持ちになってしまったのか。
lines.translated: Why had she ended up feeling so lonely?

lines.content: それらをあえて掘り起こそうとはしないまま、あさひさんは微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Without trying to pry into any of that, Asahi-san smiled.

lines.content: うん。今夜はお姉ちゃんと一緒に眠ろうか。最近十夜は一緒のお布団で眠ってくれなくなって、お姉ちゃん、少しさみしかったんだぞ――
lines.translated: "Yeah. Let's sleep together tonight, okay? You haven't been sleeping in the same futon with me lately, Toya, so your big sister's been a little lonely, you know--"

lines.content: ……大雅も
lines.translated: "...Taiga, too."

lines.content: 十夜は言った。ぽつりと。あさひさんの背中に顔を押し付けたまま。
lines.translated: Toya murmured softly, her face still pressed against Asahi-san's back.

lines.content: ……大雅も、一緒
lines.translated: "...Taiga, too, together."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅も、一緒に……眠ってくれるって
lines.translated: "Taiga said... he'd sleep with me, too."

lines.content: そ、そうか。そうなのか
lines.translated: "I-I see. Is that so?"

lines.content: ふとあさひさんと目が合った。するとあさひさんは目を泳がせて、
lines.translated: My eyes suddenly met Asahi-san's. Her gaze darted around.

lines.content: う、うう～ん……わかった。それじゃ、三人一緒に今夜は眠ろうかな
lines.translated: "U-Umm... Okay. Well then, maybe the three of us should sleep together tonight."

lines.content: ちょっと赤くなりながらもあさひさんはそう言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said, blushing slightly.

lines.content: 昔はまだまだ大雅も子どもだったからさ。大雅も一緒によく三人で眠っていたけど……大雅、大きくなっちゃったからなあ
lines.translated: "Back in the day, you were still just a kid, Taiga. The three of us used to sleep together a lot... but you've grown up now, haven't you?"

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべてあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 何もしませんよ……？
lines.translated: "I won't do anything, you know...?"

lines.content: うん。わかってるよ。ちゃんとわかってる。大雅はいい子だもんな
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know. I know that very well. You're a good boy, after all, Taiga."

lines.content: にっこりと微笑んでくれるあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san beamed at me.

lines.content: ただ少し、ほんの少しだけな？　お姉ちゃんは恥ずかしいかもしれないなって……でも、うん
lines.translated: "It's just a little, a tiny bit, okay? Your big sister might feel a little embarrassed... But, yeah."

lines.content: 時にはさ、久しぶりにそういうことをしてみるのもいいよな。子どもの頃に帰るような。そんな感じでさ
lines.translated: "Sometimes, it's nice to do something like that after a long while. Like going back to being kids. Something like that."

lines.content: お夕飯を食べ終わる。
lines.translated: We finished eating dinner.

lines.content: “ごちそうさまでした”と合掌し、“美味しかったです”と、ありがとうがいっぱい伝わるようにと目を閉じた。
lines.translated: Clapping my hands together with a "Thank you for the meal," and saying "It was delicious," I closed my eyes, hoping to convey all my gratitude.

lines.content: そして俺と十夜、あさひさんの順番でお風呂に入り――寝床に収まる。
lines.translated: Then, after taking baths in the order of me, Toya, and Asahi-san--we settled into bed.

lines.content: 三人一緒に眠るには俺の部屋も、あさひさんと十夜の部屋も小さすぎた。
lines.translated: Both my room and Asahi-san and Toya's room were too small for the three of us to sleep together.

lines.content: だから居間に布団を敷いて三人並んで横になる。
lines.translated: So we laid out futons in the living room and lay down side by side.

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれの枕を抱いて居間に集まり――今日、どんなことがあったのかを簡単に報告し合った。
lines.translated: Each of us hugged our own pillow as we gathered in the living room--and briefly shared what had happened today.

lines.content: 十夜は相変わらず口数が少なかったけれど、それでもよかった。
lines.translated: Toya was as quiet as usual, but that was fine.

lines.content: そしてそのまま、十夜が眠くなるまでトランプをしてみたり。
lines.translated: After that, we played cards until Toya got sleepy.

lines.content: 電気を消してからは布団の中でしりとりをしてみたり。
lines.translated: And after turning off the lights, we played word chain from inside our futons.

lines.content: なんだかこんなのは、家族みたいだ。
lines.translated: Somehow, this felt just like a family.

lines.content: そんなバカみたいなことを思ってしまった自分に、少し、気恥ずかしさを感じながらも……。
lines.translated: I felt a little embarrassed at myself for having such a foolish thought...

lines.content: そんなのはまるで似合わないだろうがと、いつもみたいに眠る前の短い時間に、自分自身を呪ってみたり。
lines.translated: And in those brief moments before falling asleep, just like always, I cursed myself, thinking something like that didn't suit me at all.

lines.content: それでも悪くはない夜だと思える。
lines.translated: Even so, I felt it wasn't a bad night.

lines.content: でも、だめだ。だめだよ。足りない。ひとり、足りない。
lines.translated: No, it's no good. No good at all. Something's missing. One person is missing.

lines.content: そんなさみしい気持ちが大きくなってしまったり。
lines.translated: That lonely feeling would swell up inside me.

lines.content: いつだって大切なことは何も話してくれない[・|君]に、ふと悲しくなってしまったり。
lines.translated: Or I would suddenly feel sad because of *you*, who never tells me anything important.

lines.content: ……“おやすみなさい”
lines.translated: "Goodnight."

lines.content: 誰かがそっとそう言った。
lines.translated: Someone whispered softly.

lines.content: （おやすみ）
lines.translated: (Goodnight.)

lines.content: 心でつぶやく。
lines.translated: I murmured in my heart.

lines.content: （……おやすみ、クロ。また明日）
lines.translated: (...Goodnight, Kuro. See you tomorrow.)

lines.content: そうして俺たちは夢を見る。
lines.translated: And so, we dream.

lines.content: 誰も知らない“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: Deep within the "Night" that no one knows...

lines.content: やさしいばかりの幸せな夢を、思い描ければと願った。
lines.translated: I wished that we could picture a happy dream filled with nothing but kindness.

lines.content: 忘れないよ。……たぶん
lines.translated: "I won't forget. ...Probably."

lines.content: 十夜は、目を伏せてしまった。
lines.translated: Toya cast her eyes down.

lines.content: ……そっか。たぶん、だよね。仕方ないよね
lines.translated: "...I see. Probably, huh? I guess it can't be helped."

lines.content: 十夜……？
lines.translated: "Toya...?"

lines.content: 一瞬だ。
lines.translated: It was just for a moment.

lines.content: ほんの一瞬だけ、十夜の瞳に何か光るものを見た気がしたけれど、
lines.translated: For just a split second, I thought I saw something glisten in Toya's eyes,

lines.content: ううん。何でもないよ。大雅。ごめんね、変なこと言って。気にしないでね……お願い
lines.translated: "No, it's nothing, Taiga. Sorry for saying something weird. Don't worry about it... please."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 次に顔を上げてくれたとき、その表情は笑顔だった。
lines.translated: The next time she looked up at me, she was smiling.

lines.content: 帰ろう、大雅。もうお腹ぺこぺこなの
lines.translated: "Let's go home, Taiga. I'm starving."

lines.content: 早くはやくと手を引かれる。俺と十夜は足早に帰り道を進んだ。
lines.translated: She tugged on my hand, urging me to hurry. Toya and I walked briskly down the road home.

lines.content: 十夜……
lines.translated: "Toya..."

lines.content: 小さく名前を呼んだけど、それに十夜は気づかず……。
lines.translated: I softly called her name, but she didn't notice...

lines.content: それ以上は何も問いかけられず……。
lines.translated: And I couldn't bring myself to ask anything more...

lines.content: 俺は何か、正体のわからない若干の罪悪感が芽生えるのを感じていた。
lines.translated: I felt a faint, inexplicable sense of guilt beginning to sprout inside me.

lines.content: おかえり、ふたりとも。今日は楽しい一日だったかな
lines.translated: "Welcome back, you two. Did you have fun today?"

lines.content: 公園に迎えに行った十夜と一緒に帰宅した――そんな俺たちをあさひさんが笑顔で迎えてくれた。
lines.translated: I came home with Toya after picking her up from the park--and Asahi-san greeted the two of us with a smile.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんお腹空いたよー。今日のお夕飯はなあに？
lines.translated: "Big Sis, I'm hungry! What's for dinner tonight?"

lines.content: ん～、そうだなあ。どうするかちょうど考えていたところだよ。お魚と、お肉。どっちがいい？
lines.translated: "Hmm, let's see. I was just thinking about what to make. Fish or meat, which do you want?"

lines.content: む～……。お肉かなあ……？
lines.translated: "Mmm... Meat, maybe...?"

lines.content: 実は帰り道で少し元気がないように見えた十夜だったが……。
lines.translated: To tell the truth, Toya had seemed a little down on the way home...

lines.content: 気のせいだったのかもしれない。心配しすぎだったかも、しれない。
lines.translated: Maybe it was just my imagination. Maybe I was worrying too much.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんと一緒にお夕飯のメニューを考えているその横顔はすっかりいつもの表情だった。
lines.translated: Looking at her profile as she thought about the dinner menu with her sister, she had her usual expression back completely.

lines.content: 大雅もお肉でいいかな。今夜のご飯
lines.translated: "Are you fine with meat for dinner tonight too, Taiga?"

lines.content: はい。何でも
lines.translated: "Yes, anything is fine."

lines.content: 何でも、か。そういうのが一番困っちゃうんだぞ。いつまでも女心のわからない男の子だよなあ。大雅は
lines.translated: "Anything, huh? That's the most unhelpful answer you can give, you know. You're a boy who'll never understand a woman's heart, Taiga."

lines.content: ねー
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: ふたりが台所に立つ。
lines.translated: The two of them stood in the kitchen.

lines.content: 何も手伝うことのない俺は居間で待っていることにした。
lines.translated: Having nothing to help with, I decided to wait in the living room.

lines.content: 春先にもかかわらずまだ炬燵が片づけられていない。
lines.translated: Even though it was early spring, the kotatsu still hadn't been put away.

lines.content: やっぱり“特別”だろうと猫は炬燵が大好きなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Even if she's "special," I guess a cat still loves a kotatsu.

lines.content: ……テレビをつけてみた。
lines.translated: I tried turning on the TV.

lines.content: ブラウン管の古いテレビだ。
lines.translated: It was an old CRT television.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]は“月と太陽の狭間の時間”だ。“夜”でなければ“昼”でもない。故にどんな番組をやっているのかと興味があった。
lines.translated: *This place* is the "time between the moon and the sun." It is neither "Night" nor "Day." Because of that, I was curious about what kind of programs would be on.

lines.content: ……意外と、充実してる
lines.translated: "...There's a surprising amount of stuff on."

lines.content: 炬燵に頬杖をついてぼんやりとつぶやく。
lines.translated: Resting my chin in my hand on the kotatsu, I murmured absentmindedly.

lines.content: スポーツ。ニュース。バラエティにアニメにドラマ。最新のヒット映画もやっている。
lines.translated: Sports. News. Variety shows, anime, and dramas. They were even showing the latest hit movies.

lines.content: 日本だけでなくアメリカやイギリスなどといった、全世界のチャンネルを映してくれてもいた。まるで有料ケーブルテレビのようだった。
lines.translated: It wasn't just Japan, either; it broadcasted channels from all over the world, like America and the UK. It was just like premium cable TV.

lines.content: しかもどのチャンネルも自動的に日本語に翻訳してくれている。
lines.translated: What's more, every single channel was automatically translated into Japanese.

lines.content: どうなっているんだろう。これもまた“魔法”だろうか。
lines.translated: How does this even work? Is this "magic" too?

lines.content: 俺は、携帯を取り出す。
lines.translated: I took out my cell phone.

lines.content: これも誰かが“夜の国”で生み出した“魔法”のひとつ。
lines.translated: This was also a piece of "magic" that someone had created in the "Country of Night."

lines.content: 設定された[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]以外の誰にも繋がらない“魔法”の端末だ。
lines.translated: A "magical" device that couldn't connect to anyone other than *us*, the ones it was set up for.

lines.content: 呼び出し音が鳴る。いつまでも。ずっと。
lines.translated: The dial tone rang. On and on. Forever.

lines.content: 繋がらない。
lines.translated: It didn't go through.

lines.content: 残念だが落胆するほどではなかった。
lines.translated: It was a shame, but not enough to make me feel discouraged.

lines.content: 基本的に眠る前の短い時間でなければ、あの子は電話に出てくれないのだ。
lines.translated: Basically, unless it's that brief window right before going to sleep, that girl won't answer the phone.

lines.content: それを充分わかっていて呼び出し続けた。
lines.translated: I knew that full well, yet I kept calling anyway.

lines.content: ……声が聴きたい。
lines.translated: I want to hear her voice.

lines.content: [わけ|理由]もなくそう思ってしまったからだ。
lines.translated: I had thought that for no real reason at all.

lines.content: クロ、どこにいるのかな。クロも一緒にお夕飯、食べない？
lines.translated: Kuro, I wonder where you are. Won't you come eat dinner with us too, Kuro?

lines.content: あの子にそう言いたいとも思っていた。
lines.translated: I wanted to say that to her.

lines.content: しかし結局は繋がらないままお夕飯となってしまう。
lines.translated: However, in the end, dinner time arrived without the call ever connecting.

lines.content: 一応四人分は作ったけど……。今夜は戻って来てくれるかな
lines.translated: "I made enough for four just in case, though... I wonder if she'll come back tonight."

lines.content: あさひさんが配膳をしてくれながら言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said while setting the table.

lines.content: いつも真夜中くらいになったら帰って来てるよ。がさごそ音がするから
lines.translated: "She always comes back around midnight. I hear her rustling around."

lines.content: そうなんだ……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。あの子用に置いておいたご飯も少し食べてくれてはいるみたいだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. It looks like she eats a little bit of the food I leave out for her, too."

lines.content: 無理強いすることではない。それはわかっている。
lines.translated: It wasn't something to force on her. I understood that.

lines.content: 特に“みんなで一緒に”とか、“みんなで、仲良く”だとか。
lines.translated: Especially things like "all of us together," or "everyone getting along."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|っ][・|た][・|こ][・|と]は行き過ぎると――受け取り手が嫌悪を覚える程度になってしまうと――それは殆ど暴力と変わりがなくなってしまうように思えるから。
lines.translated: Because when *things like that* go too far--to the point where the person on the receiving end feels repulsed--it feels like it becomes almost no different from violence.

lines.content: だから今夜も俺たちは三人だけで手を合わせる。
lines.translated: So tonight, once again, just the three of us clapped our hands together.

lines.content: いただきます。……すごい。美味しそう
lines.translated: "Thank you for the food. ...Wow, this looks delicious."

lines.content: 今夜のメニュー。
lines.translated: Tonight's menu.

lines.content: 甘辛味噌の豚バラ大根。きのこと鶏のささみのホイル焼き。麦の混じったごはんにキュウリの浅漬け。お野菜たっぷりのお味噌汁。そして簡単なサラダまであった。
lines.translated: Pork belly and daikon radish in sweet and spicy miso. Foil-baked mushrooms and chicken tenders. Rice mixed with barley and lightly pickled cucumbers. Miso soup loaded with vegetables. And there was even a simple salad.

lines.content: 毎晩だ。あさひさんのお夕飯は毎晩手が込んでいる。決して手抜きなメニューであるときなどない。
lines.translated: Every single night. Asahi-san's dinners are elaborate every night. There is never a time when she cuts corners with the menu.

lines.content: いつもありがとうございます。こんなにいっぱいのご飯……作るの大変じゃないですか？
lines.translated: "Thank you as always. Making this much food... isn't it a lot of work?"

lines.content: ううん。全然だ
lines.translated: "Nope, not at all."

lines.content: むしろ楽しいんだよとあさひさんは笑う。私は料理作るの好きだから、と。
lines.translated: In fact, it's fun, Asahi-san laughed, adding that she loves cooking.

lines.content: 大雅や十夜が美味しそうに食べてくれる。そんなふたりを見られるんだなあって想像するだけで、全然、大変さなんてなくなっちゃうんだよ
lines.translated: "You and Toya always eat it with such gusto. Just imagining getting to see the two of you like that makes all the hard work disappear completely."

lines.content: そんなこと言われたら……あさひさん
lines.translated: "When you put it like that... Asahi-san..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: もしも嫌いなものが出てきても、これから絶対残せなくなっちゃうなあって……
lines.translated: "Even if you served something I hated, I'd never be able to leave any on my plate from now on..."

lines.content: あれ、大雅。嫌いなものってあったっけ
lines.translated: "Huh? Taiga, was there food you disliked?"

lines.content: えー。知らなかったなあ。大雅って好き嫌いあるの？
lines.translated: "Ehh? I didn't know that. Are you a picky eater, Taiga?"

lines.content: 意外だよねえと十夜が目を丸くしていた。
lines.translated: Toya's eyes went wide, saying how surprising that was.

lines.content: いやあ。嫌いなものとか食べられないものとかはないけど……
lines.translated: "Well, no. There isn't anything I dislike or can't eat, though..."

lines.content: でも、あさひさんの料理を残しちゃう自分が嫌いだなあって思うな。そんなの一度もなかったし、これからもないはずだけどね
lines.translated: "But I think I'd hate myself if I ever left any of Asahi-san's cooking behind. Not that I ever have, and I'm sure I never will."

lines.content: なんだあそれ
lines.translated: "What is that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: あさひさんはどこか困ったような苦笑い。
lines.translated: Asahi-san gave a somewhat troubled, wry smile.

lines.content: あっ、私もそんな大雅のこと大嫌いだよ。まあ、ね。うん、だけどね。今の大雅も大嫌いだけどね
lines.translated: "Ah, I'd hate a Taiga like that too. Well, yeah. Mhm, though. I hate the current Taiga too, though."

lines.content: 十夜はなぜか得意げにおすまし顔でそんなことを言っていた。
lines.translated: For some reason, Toya said that with a smug, prim look on her face.

lines.content: なにおぅ。ピーマン食べられないおこちゃまなクセして
lines.translated: "What was that? Coming from a little kid who can't even eat green peppers."

lines.content: ピーマンは食べ物じゃないんだよ。あれは毒。人参も一緒
lines.translated: "Green peppers aren't food. They're poison. Carrots are the same."

lines.content: はー？　何をしれっとした顔で言っちゃってるんだい。しかし十夜。君は、ちょっと好き嫌い多くないかい？
lines.translated: "Huh? How can you say that with a straight face? Seriously though, Toya, aren't you a bit too picky of an eater?"

lines.content: だって身体に悪いものだから、食べちゃ危険なものだから、苦いんだよね？　お口の中がぴりっとしちゃうんだよね？
lines.translated: "Because they're bad for my body, and dangerous to eat. That's why they're bitter, right? They make the inside of your mouth tingle, right?"

lines.content: 俺は別にぴりっとはしないけど？
lines.translated: "They don't really make my mouth tingle, though?"

lines.content: 私はするよ。ぴりぴりしちゃうの
lines.translated: "They do for me. They make it all tingly."

lines.content: 小さな舌をうえぇというように出して見せ、
lines.translated: She stuck out her little tongue as if going "blegh,"

lines.content: 大雅の身体には平気でも、私の身体にとっては毒だから、私の舌が食べちゃだめって言ってるんだよ。苦いよーって感じるんだよ。早くぺってはき出しなさいって言ってるの
lines.translated: "Even if it's fine for your body, Taiga, it's poison to mine, so my tongue is telling me not to eat it. That's why it tastes bitter. It's telling me to hurry up and spit it out."

lines.content: この幼女。得意そうである。
lines.translated: This little girl looked so proud of herself.

lines.content: 今の理屈のどこに自信をたっぷり感じられるのか。
lines.translated: Where in that logic did she find so much confidence?

lines.content: ……食べ終わる。
lines.translated: We finished eating.

lines.content: 俺たちは“ごちそうさまでした”と手を合わせた。
lines.translated: We clapped our hands together and said, "Thank you for the meal."

lines.content: 明日のお夕飯は何がいい？
lines.translated: "What do you want for dinner tomorrow?"

lines.content: 食器を片付けながらあさひさんが言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san asked while clearing the dishes.

lines.content: カレー。ハンバーグ。ステーキ。オムライス。から揚げ。
lines.translated: Curry. Hamburger steak. Steak. Omurice. Fried chicken.

lines.content: 次々と俺たちは食べたいものを挙げていく。
lines.translated: One after another, we listed off the things we wanted to eat.

lines.content: 牛丼！
lines.translated: "Beef bowl!"

lines.content: かつ丼！
lines.translated: "Pork cutlet bowl!"

lines.content: アイスクリーム！
lines.translated: "Ice cream!"

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: うん。アイスはデザートだな。簡単なのなら手作りできるし
lines.translated: "Yeah, ice cream is a dessert, though. If it's a simple one, I can make it by hand."

lines.content: ふふん
lines.translated: "Heheh."

lines.content: なぜか得意そうな顔である。十夜の中では勝負になっているようだ。いったい何の勝負なのかわからないが。
lines.translated: For some reason, she had a smug look on her face. In Toya's mind, this seemed to have turned into a competition. Though I had no idea what kind of competition it was.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんっ、全部っ、食べたいもの、ぜんぶ！
lines.translated: "Big Sis, everything! Everything I want to eat, all of it!"

lines.content: はは。十夜が食べたいもの全部かあ。作り甲斐がありそうだな
lines.translated: "Haha. Everything Toya wants to eat, huh? That sounds like it'll be well worth the effort to make."

lines.content: じゃ、じゃあ俺は……えっと……お寿司で！
lines.translated: "Th-Then I'll go with... um... sushi!"

lines.content: ごめんな大雅。お寿司はちょっと難しいかな。だって握ったことないし……
lines.translated: "Sorry, Taiga. Sushi might be a bit too difficult. I've never made it by hand before..."

lines.content: ぐぬぬ
lines.translated: "Urgh..."

lines.content: ふ、っふん
lines.translated: "H-Hmph!"

lines.content: この、幼女め。勝ち誇ったような顔しちゃってまあ。
lines.translated: Why you little brat. Just look at that triumphant face of hers.

lines.content: それから三人一緒に炬燵でテレビを見て過ごした。
lines.translated: After that, the three of us spent our time watching TV together under the kotatsu.

lines.content: 小さな十夜はアニメが見たい。厨二なあさひさんは特撮戦隊もの。無個性なこの俺は流行りの映画だ。
lines.translated: Little Toya wanted to watch anime. The chuuni Asahi-san wanted to watch a tokusatsu sentai show. And a guy with no personality like me wanted to watch a popular movie.

lines.content: チャンネル争いのじゃんけんはあさひさんの勝ち――だけどまあ、十夜と俺とでもう一回じゃんけんしなさいとあさひさんは言う。勝ったほうの好きなのを観ようと。
lines.translated: Asahi-san won the rock-paper-scissors match for the remote -- though she told Toya and me to play one more round against each other, saying we'd watch whatever the winner wanted.

lines.content: 勝ったのは十夜だ。アニメが終わるとお風呂の時間。
lines.translated: Toya won. Once the anime finished, it was bath time.

lines.content: 一緒にお風呂入ろうよとせがんでくる十夜だったが……。
lines.translated: Toya pestered me to take a bath together, however...

lines.content: うーん。どうしようかな
lines.translated: "Hmm. What should I do?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: きょとんとした。意外だとばかり。
lines.translated: She blinked in surprise, looking completely caught off guard.

lines.content: だって今日の十夜はちょっと意地悪だったから……大雅くんはちょっと拗ねてみたりしようかなって。これからお風呂は別々にしようかなって
lines.translated: "Well, you were a little mean today, Toya... so I figured I might try sulking a bit. Maybe we should take separate baths from now on."

lines.content: ……やだ
lines.translated: "...No way."

lines.content: 涙をためた。
lines.translated: Tears pooled in her eyes.

lines.content: 大雅。お風呂、一緒に入ってくれないと、やだ
lines.translated: "Taiga. I don't want to unless you take a bath with me."

lines.content: 急にしおらしくなった十夜に、『ごめんごめん冗談だから』と言ってふたりでお風呂に入り……。
lines.translated: Seeing Toya suddenly become so meek, I told her, "Sorry, sorry, I was just joking," and the two of us got into the bath together...

lines.content: 今夜は、ここまでだ。
lines.translated: That was all for tonight.

lines.content: そろそろ“夜”だ。
lines.translated: It was almost time for the "Night."

lines.content: ふかふかのお布団に包まって、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて――深呼吸。
lines.translated: I wrapped myself up in the fluffy futon, closed my eyelids -- and took a deep breath.

lines.content: そうして明日を迎えに行かなくちゃ。
lines.translated: And just like that, I had to go welcome tomorrow.

lines.content: あさひさんと十夜。ふたりに“おやすみなさい”と手を振って……。
lines.translated: Asahi-san and Toya. I waved to the two of them, saying "Goodnight"...

lines.content: それぞれの部屋に戻った。
lines.translated: And we returned to our respective rooms.

lines.content: すぐさま寝床に包まる。
lines.translated: I immediately burrowed into bed.

lines.content: 静かな夜。カチカチと秒針の音だけがする。
lines.translated: A quiet night. Only the ticking sound of the second hand could be heard.

lines.content: 俺はこの音が好きだった。
lines.translated: I liked this sound.

lines.content: 自分がちゃんと“今の時間”の中で生きているんだと、誰かにそう言ってもらっているような気がするからだ。
lines.translated: Because it felt like someone was telling me that I was truly living within the "present time."

lines.content: そんな俺の今日は、すてきな日だった。
lines.translated: Today had been a wonderful day for me.

lines.content: 今日は、目覚めてから再び眠りにつくまでずっと楽しいばかりの一日だったのだ。
lines.translated: From the moment I woke up until the moment I went back to sleep, today had been nothing short of fun.

lines.content: ……明日もきっと悪くない日になるんじゃないか。
lines.translated: Tomorrow will surely be a pretty good day too, won't it?

lines.content: 根拠なんてまるでない予感を抱くことだってできてしまう。
lines.translated: I could even hold onto a premonition like that without a shred of basis for it.

lines.content: たったひとりで[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる、眠る前の短い時間。
lines.translated: The brief moment before falling asleep, closing my eyelids all alone.

lines.content: お決まりのような嫌悪感も、今日はほんの僅かでいてくるけど。
lines.translated: Even that usual, routine sense of self-loathing was barely noticeable today.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: 一日の終わり。眠りに落ちる少し前。
lines.translated: At the end of the day. Shortly before drifting off to sleep.

lines.content: ……ふっとさみしい気持ちが芽生えてしまう“夜”の始まり。
lines.translated: The beginning of the "Night," when a sudden feeling of loneliness would sprout inside me.

lines.content: [・|君]とほんの少しだけでも話ができたら。
lines.translated: If only I could talk to *you*, even just a little bit.

lines.content: そうすればこの小さなちいさなさみしさも、明日へ持ち越すことなく手放していけるかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: If I could do that, I might be able to let go of this tiny, tiny loneliness without carrying it over into tomorrow, and yet...
(...Kuro.)

lines.content: （また明日も、どこかで俺を、見ていて……ほしいよ）
lines.translated: (Tomorrow, too... I want you to be watching over me from somewhere...)

lines.content: “おやすみ”の代わりにいつまでも鳴り止まず、今夜は決して繋がることのない――
lines.translated: Ringing endlessly in place of a "goodnight," a call that would never connect tonight --

lines.content: そんな電話の音に心を澄まして、俺は今夜も無事に眠りに落ちた。
lines.translated: Opening my heart to the sound of that ringing phone, I safely drifted off to sleep again tonight.

lines.content: ……はら、
lines.translated: Flutter,

lines.content: ……はら、
lines.translated: Flutter,

lines.content: ……はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter.

lines.content: 世界がそっと、ため息をつく。
lines.translated: The world lets out a soft sigh.
*Ten years ago*.

lines.content: 少女たちの前に、ついに“夜の王”が現れた。
lines.translated: Before the girls, the "King of the Night" finally appeared.

lines.content: それは少女たちにとって何の恨みもない宿敵のはずだった。
lines.translated: It was supposed to be a destined enemy toward whom the girls held no personal grudge.

lines.content: ただ必要な“魔法”を得るための戦いだったのだ。
lines.translated: It was simply a battle to obtain the "magic" they needed.

lines.content: しかし、なぜだろう。誰もがその[・|王][・|さ][・|ま]のことを憎からず感じていた。
lines.translated: Yet, why was it? Every one of them felt a deep hatred for that *King*.

lines.content: 人類の未来のために。
lines.translated: For the future of humanity.

lines.content: あるいは大切な人たちの人生のために。
