lines.translated: Or perhaps for the lives of the people precious to them.

lines.content: 私たちはこの王さまを、今夜、ここで、討ち滅ぼすのだ。
lines.translated: Tonight, right here, we will strike down and destroy this King.

lines.content: 少女たちは“夜”の空を見上げていた。
lines.translated: The girls were looking up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: そこにたゆたうは大きなおおきな“[夜の王|悪夢]”
lines.translated: Drifting up there was a massive, immense "Nightmare -- the King of the Night."

lines.content: そうだ。[・|そ][・|れ]はあんまりにも巨大に過ぎたのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. *It* was far too colossal.

lines.content: 誰が[・|あ][・|れ]を倒せるというのか。
lines.translated: Who could possibly defeat *that*?

lines.content: 誰が[・|あ][・|れ]を撃ち砕けるだけの“魔法”を“想像”できるというのか。
lines.translated: Who could possibly "imagine" enough "magic" to shatter *that*?

lines.content: ……ごめんな
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 少女ではない。
lines.translated: Not a girl.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]に立ち向かったのは、“特別な少女”ではなかった。
lines.translated: The one who stood up to *it* was not a "special girl."

lines.content: たったひとりの少年が、夜空に[うごめ|蠢]く王さまめがけ、銃口を突きつけて……。
lines.translated: A single, lone boy aimed the muzzle of a gun at the King writhing in the night sky...

lines.content: ……やっと、追いついたよ。俺のヒーロー
lines.translated: "...I finally caught up to you. My hero."

lines.content: 苦々しく唇を噛み、少年は“夜”の空に向かって、その引き金を引き絞る。
lines.translated: Biting his lip bitterly, the boy squeezed the trigger toward the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: 後には耳を、そして心を引き裂くかのような、夜の王さまの叫び声だけが、ただただ、残った。
lines.translated: All that remained afterward was the scream of the King of the Night, sounding as though it would tear apart their ears and their very hearts.

lines.content: 目を覚ます。
lines.translated: I woke up.

lines.content: いつもと変わらぬ朝だった。
lines.translated: It was an ordinary morning, no different from usual.

lines.content: かち、かち、かち
lines.translated: Tick, tick, tick.

lines.content: 秒針の音に満たされた部屋。
lines.translated: A room filled with the sound of the second hand.

lines.content: カーテンを閉め忘れていた窓から朝の光が差し込んでいる。
lines.translated: Morning light streamed in through the window where I had forgotten to close the curtains.

lines.content: ため息を、つく。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.

lines.content: どんな日もいつもと変わらず朝が来る。
lines.translated: No matter the day, morning comes just the same as always.

lines.content: 数ある時計のひとつで時刻を確認した。
lines.translated: I checked the time on one of the many clocks.

lines.content: 目覚ましの世話になることもなく、ちょうど良い時間に目覚められていた。
lines.translated: I had managed to wake up at just the right time without needing the help of an alarm.

lines.content: 唯一の特技とも言える。
lines.translated: You could call it my only special skill.

lines.content: いつも起きたい時間に自然と俺は目覚めることができた。
lines.translated: I was always able to wake up naturally at whatever time I wanted.

lines.content: まあ、こんなのまるで自慢にもなりはしないが――
lines.translated: Well, it's not like something like this is anything to brag about --

lines.content: しかしその程度のことを[・|特][・|技]と呼ぶくらいのことしか、俺には、この俺、奏大雅には何ひとつ優位なものを見いだせない。それほど俺という人間は凡百であった。
lines.translated: Yet having to call something of that level a *special skill* was the only advantage I -- Kanade Taiga -- could find in myself. That was how thoroughly mediocre of a human being I was.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: ……夢だ
lines.translated: "...A dream."

lines.content: 何か、夢を見ていたような気がする。
lines.translated: I felt like I had been dreaming about something.

lines.content: それは長いながい夢だった。
lines.translated: It was a long, long dream.

lines.content: だがその光景は思い出せない。ひとかけらもだ。
lines.translated: However, I couldn't remember what I saw in it. Not even a single fragment.

lines.content: ただ、何か……。
lines.translated: Just, something...

lines.content: とても大切な、意味ある夢を見ていたような。
lines.translated: It felt like I had been dreaming of something very important, something meaningful.

lines.content: この頃は、ずっとだ。ずっとこんなふうに目覚めがよくない。
lines.translated: Lately, it had been like this all the time. I hadn't been waking up feeling well at all.

lines.content: いつからだろう、と思う。
lines.translated: Since when has it been like this, I wonder.

lines.content: いつから夜に見た夢を思い出せなくなったんだろう。
lines.translated: When did I stop being able to remember the dreams I had at night?

lines.content: それはまるで、知らぬ間に自分が少年時代の境界線を越えてしまったような……。そんなさみしささえあった。
lines.translated: It almost felt as if I had crossed the boundary out of boyhood without even realizing it... There was even a loneliness like that to it.

lines.content: ……それも、全部
lines.translated: "...All of that, too."

lines.content: 些細な夢をも思い出せないほど眠りが浅いのも。寝起きの気分が悪いのも。全部、この環境のせいだろうか。
lines.translated: My sleep being so shallow that I can't even remember trivial dreams. Feeling awful when I wake up. Is all of it because of this environment?

lines.content: 秒針の音に溢れる部屋はあまり居心地がいいとは言えず――……
lines.translated: A room overflowing with the sound of ticking second hands couldn't really be called comfortable --...

lines.content: だからと言って、ここ以外の居場所などあろうはずもなく。
lines.translated: Even so, it wasn't as if I had anywhere else to belong.

lines.content: 出かけないと。
lines.translated: I have to head out.

lines.content: 寝床からもぞもぞ抜けだし支度を調える。
lines.translated: I sluggishly crawled out of bed and got ready.

lines.content: ネクタイを締める手がまごついている。
lines.translated: My hands fumbled as I tied my necktie.

lines.content: [・|遠][・|い][・|学][・|生][・|時][・|代]にはある程度綺麗に締められていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though back in my *distant student days*, I should have been able to tie it neatly enough.

lines.content: 『うん、私、すっごい！』
lines.translated: "Yup, I'm amazing!"

lines.content: そんなふうに笑顔を見せてくれた[誰か|子]も、もう、どこにもいなくて……。
lines.translated: The girl who had shown me a smile like that was no longer anywhere to be found...

lines.content: 鏡を覗き込む。ああでもないこうでもないと格闘する。
lines.translated: I peered into the mirror, struggling with it this way and that.

lines.content: そこに映る自分の顔にふと気づく。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I noticed my own face reflected there.

lines.content: ひどい顔だ。
lines.translated: What a terrible face.

lines.content: 今、目の前にいる冴えない顔のこいつはいったい誰なんだ……。
lines.translated: Just who in the world is this guy with the dull, lifeless face standing right in front of me...?

lines.content: 毎朝同じような愚問と共に、首をかしげ、髪にクシを通し……歯を磨いた。
lines.translated: With the same foolish question I asked myself every morning, I tilted my head, ran a comb through my hair... and brushed my teeth.

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 眩しい朝の光に目を細め――
lines.translated: Squinting against the dazzling morning light --

lines.content: ……鬱陶しいな。まったく
lines.translated: "...What a pain. Honestly."

lines.content: その日差しを、かざした手のひらで遮った。
lines.translated: I raised my palm to block out the sunlight.

lines.content: 春。
lines.translated: Spring.

lines.content: 町は咲き乱れるさくらの木々の、その花に、埋め尽くされている。
lines.translated: The town was completely buried in the blossoms of the wildly blooming cherry trees.

lines.content: 暖かな季節。柔らかな香り。甘やかな風。
lines.translated: A warm season. A soft fragrance. A sweet breeze.

lines.content: ああ。まったく、まったく……本当に。
lines.translated: Ah. Honestly, honestly... Truly.

lines.content: ……嫌気がさす
lines.translated: "...It makes me sick."

lines.content: 首を振り、歩き出した。
lines.translated: Shaking my head, I started walking.

lines.content: 足跡の代わりに、心から鬱々とした重い言葉を残すようにして――……背中を丸め、きらめく空を避け、足下ばかりをじっと見つめて。
lines.translated: As if leaving behind gloomy, heavy words from my heart in place of footprints --... I hunched my shoulders, avoided the glittering sky, and stared fixedly at the ground beneath my feet.
Morning...

lines.content: 朝はどうして毎日飽くこともなくやって来るんだろう。
lines.translated: Why does the morning come every single day without ever getting tired of it?

lines.content: 歩きながら考える。
lines.translated: I thought about it as I walked.
Hey, *Hero*.

lines.content: と、心でつぶやく。
lines.translated: I murmured in my heart.

lines.content: どこかでお前は今も戦っていて……この世界をもう何度も何度も救っているのかな。
lines.translated: Are you still fighting out there somewhere... having saved this world over and over again by now?

lines.content: ひとつ、お願いがあるんだ。
lines.translated: I have a favor to ask.

lines.content: そろそろ世界を救うのをやめてくれやしないかな。
lines.translated: Couldn't you stop saving the world already?

lines.content: 朝なんて来なければいい。いい加減、世界が終わってくれてもかまわない……。
lines.translated: I wish the morning would just never come. Honestly, I wouldn't mind if the world ended right about now...

lines.content: いつも、いつだって、そう願っている人間もここにこうしているんだよ――そんな俺にとって、誰がヒーローなのか。誰が、悪役なのか……。
lines.translated: Right here is a person who is always, at every moment, wishing for just that -- so to someone like me, who is the hero? And who is the villain...?

lines.content: 途中、花を買った。
lines.translated: Along the way, I bought some flowers.

lines.content: 店員に適当に見繕ってもらった花束だ。
lines.translated: It was a bouquet I had the shop clerk throw together at random.

lines.content: ……[・|彼][・|女]が好きな花はなんだったっけ。
lines.translated: What were *her* favorite flowers again?

lines.content: そんなことも忘れてしまった。覚えようともしていなかった。
lines.translated: I had even forgotten something like that. I hadn't even tried to remember.

lines.content: こんな俺は、去年、どんな花を彼女へ手向けたのだったか――……いや。そもそも俺と彼女は、そこまでの関係だったのだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of flowers had someone like me offered her last year --... No. In the first place, were she and I even that close to begin with?

lines.content: 歩いて行く。
lines.translated: I kept walking.

lines.content: かつて友人たちと騒ぎ、笑いながら歩いた通学路。
lines.translated: The route to school where I once walked with my friends, making a racket and laughing.

lines.content: 今はもう、俺以外、誰もいない道。
lines.translated: A road where now, there was no one left but me.

lines.content: 学園への坂道だ。
lines.translated: It was the sloped path leading up to the academy.

lines.content: 重い身体と心を引きずるようにして、登る――
lines.translated: Dragging my heavy body and heart along, I climbed --

lines.content: ――ああ
息が上がった。
lines.translated: I was out of breath.

lines.content: 学生時代よりそれほど歳を重ねているわけでもないはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I shouldn't have aged all that much since my student days...

lines.content: あの頃はこれくらい、別に苦でも何でもなかった。
lines.translated: Back then, a hill like this wasn't painful or anything of the sort.

lines.content: 身体も。心も。……関係性も。
lines.translated: Our bodies. Our hearts. ...Even our relationships.

lines.content: 俺たちは変わらずには生きていけない“イキモノ”だ。
lines.translated: We are "creatures" that cannot live without changing.

lines.content: 花を手向けた。
lines.translated: I laid down the flowers.

lines.content: 学園の校庭だ。
lines.translated: It was the academy schoolyard.
*Today is the anniversary of her death.*

lines.content: 数年前の今日。
lines.translated: On this day several years ago.

lines.content: ここで……。
lines.translated: Right here...

lines.content: この場所で。
lines.translated: In this very place.
*A precious friend of mine passed away from this world.*

lines.content: ……なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "...Hey, Haru."

lines.content: あれからもう何年経ってしまっただろうか。
lines.translated: Just how many years had passed since then?

lines.content: 俺は……。

lines.translated: *I couldn't save her.*

lines.content: いや……
違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 俺は……。
彼女を救おうとも、しなかった
lines.translated: "I didn't even try to save her."
*I couldn't pull the trigger.*

lines.content: その引き金とはいったい何を指しているのか。
lines.translated: Just what in the world did that trigger refer to?

lines.content: 今やもうそれさえもよく思い出せない。
lines.translated: By now, I couldn't even remember that very well anymore.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: ただ俺はあの子を救えなかった――彼女を、救わなかった。そのための引き金を引かなかった。そういう正体のわからない“後悔”だけが、今も心に根ざしてる。
lines.translated: Just that I couldn't save her -- I didn't save her. I didn't pull the trigger to do so. Only that inexplicable "regret" remained rooted in my heart even now.

lines.content: 頭を抱える。
lines.translated: I clutched my head.

lines.content: 歯を食いしばる。
lines.translated: I gritted my teeth.

lines.content: 涙も、溢れる。
lines.translated: Tears overflowed, too.

lines.content: 悪夢だ。
lines.translated: A nightmare.

lines.content: これがきっと、俺の悪夢だ。
lines.translated: This must be my nightmare.

lines.content: ……許して。ハル。
lines.translated: Forgive me, Haru.

lines.content: そんな思いだけが、いつも在り続けてる。
lines.translated: Only that thought continued to linger inside me, always.

lines.content: 柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 俺の幼馴染み。
lines.translated: My childhood friend.

lines.content: 大切な友人だ。
lines.translated: A precious friend.

lines.content: ……彼女は、この学園の屋上から身を投げた。
lines.translated: She threw herself from the roof of this academy.

lines.content: さくら舞い踊る春の中だった。
lines.translated: It was in the middle of spring, with cherry blossoms dancing in the air.

lines.content: なぜ。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: なぜだ。
lines.translated: Why did it happen?

lines.content: なぜ、君は死ななければならなかったのか。
lines.translated: Why did you have to die?

lines.content: 彼女が去ってしまった今、その理由はいつまでも永遠にわからぬままである。
lines.translated: Now that she was gone, the reason would remain forever unknown.

lines.content: 手を合わせ、目を閉じた。
lines.translated: I pressed my hands together and closed my eyes.

lines.content: 心の中で『……ハル。ごめんな』と祈りを捧げた。
lines.translated: In my heart, I offered a silent prayer: "...Haru. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 今日、学園は休みだ。
lines.translated: Today, the academy was closed.

lines.content: 生徒はいない。
lines.translated: There were no students.

lines.content: 職員室には仕事を残した教師が何人かはいる。俺も、[・|そ][・|の][・|内][・|の][・|ひ][・|と][・|り][・|だ]。学校が休みでも教師には仕事が山ほどある。
lines.translated: There were a few teachers in the staff room with leftover work. I was *one of them*. Even when school is out, a teacher has a mountain of work to do.

lines.content: 子どもの頃、教師とはとても楽な仕事であるように思えた。
lines.translated: When I was a child, being a teacher seemed like a very easy job.

lines.content: 自分よりも明らかに立場が下の子どもらを好きに叱っていれば労われるのだから気楽でいいよなと、そんなふうに言い合っていたこともある。
lines.translated: We used to talk about how carefree and nice it must be to get praised and appreciated just for scolding kids who were clearly in a lower position than you whenever you felt like it.

lines.content: しかし大人になれば子どもの頃に『楽でいいよなあ』と笑ったことも、実は[・|そ][・|れ][・|だ][・|け]ではない苦労があるのだということに気づく。
lines.translated: However, once you grow up, you realize that the things you laughed about as a kid, saying "it must be nice and easy," actually come with hardships that go far beyond *just that*.

lines.content: それは自分も大人になって、多少とも視野が広くなったからだろうか。
lines.translated: Is it because I've become an adult myself and my perspective has broadened, if only a little?

lines.content: それとも、知らなくてもいい苦労を知って、少しだけでも賢くなったつもりでいるだけだろうか。
lines.translated: Or am I just pretending to be a little wiser after learning about hardships I would have been better off not knowing?

lines.content: どちらにせよ[ろく|碌]なものではない。
lines.translated: Either way, it's nothing to be proud of.

lines.content: 褒められるような精神性はどこにもなかった――
lines.translated: There was no admirable spirituality to be found in me anywhere --

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅は母校であるこの学園で教師になった。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, became a teacher at this academy, my alma mater.

lines.content: 特段として今の仕事に不満があるわけではない。教師という仕事は忙しいばかりだが……。それなりに生きていくことができている。
lines.translated: It's not that I have any particular complaints about my current job. Working as a teacher is nothing if not busy, though... I'm managing to make a decent living.

lines.content: だが俺は本当にこのような未来を望んだのだろうか。
lines.translated: But did I really wish for a future like this?

lines.content: この学園に通っていた幼い俺は、いったい、自分の未来をどのように想像していただろう。
lines.translated: When my younger self attended this academy, just how did he imagine his own future would turn out?

lines.content: ……少なくとも、こういう形じゃなかった
lines.translated: "...At the very least, it wasn't in a form like this."

lines.content: 思わずため息と共にそんな言葉が漏れていた。
lines.translated: Those words slipped out unintentionally along with a sigh.

lines.content: 隣の席の同僚に『いや、何でもないです。すみません』と苦笑いで取り繕った。
lines.translated: I smoothed things over with a wry smile toward the colleague at the desk next to mine, saying, "No, it's nothing. Sorry."

lines.content: 昼休み。
lines.translated: Lunch break.

lines.content: ひとり、昼食を持って時計塔の管理室へと向かった。
lines.translated: Alone, I took my lunch and headed to the management room in the clock tower.

lines.content: ここは人気もなく静かでいい。
lines.translated: There's no one around here, so it's nice and quiet.

lines.content: 窓を開き、そこから下を見下ろした。
lines.translated: I opened the window and looked down from it.

lines.content: この光景を、いつかのハルもここで見たのだろうか。
lines.translated: Did Haru also look out at this scenery from here once upon a time?

lines.content: 風がふき、頬がひやりと冷たかった。
lines.translated: The wind blew, feeling chilly against my cheeks.

lines.content: 町の風景を眺めながら、職員机の引き出しに押し込んでおいた栄養食品のブロックにかじりついた。
lines.translated: As I gazed out at the townscape, I bit into a nutritional food block that I had shoved into my desk drawer in the staff room.

lines.content: 今日は、だめだな。
lines.translated: Today is no good, huh.

lines.content: ハルの命日ということで、心は、頭の中は、どうしたって昔のことで、拭いきれない後悔で、いっぱいになってしまう。
lines.translated: Because it's the anniversary of Haru's death, my heart and my head inevitably end up completely filled with the past, and with regrets I can never wipe away.

lines.content: ……[ミス|失敗]が多い。
lines.translated: I'm making a lot of mistakes.

lines.content: 採点ミスや報告漏れ、
lines.translated: Grading errors, forgotten reports...

lines.content: 同僚たちの前で教頭から長々と説教を受けてしまった。充分な嫌味と一緒に。
lines.translated: I ended up getting a long-winded lecture from the vice principal in front of my colleagues. Complete with plenty of snide remarks.

lines.content: 俺が学生の頃、既に老年であったはずのあの教師が、今は教頭である。そしてその教え子である俺は教師となり、学園に戻ってきた。
lines.translated: That teacher, who must have already been old back when I was a student, is now the vice principal. And I, his former student, became a teacher and returned to the academy.

lines.content: 立場は変われど、[・|先][・|生]の説教の長さは変わらなかった。
lines.translated: Even though our positions have changed, the length of *his* lectures hasn't changed a bit.

lines.content: ……疲れた。
lines.translated: I'm tired.

lines.content: しみじみと、思う。
lines.translated: I felt that to my very core.

lines.content: もちろん、長々と続いた説教にも、同僚たちに対する恥ずかしさにも――色々な意味で、疲れてしまった。
lines.translated: Of course, from the long, drawn-out lecture, to the embarrassment in front of my colleagues -- I was exhausted in all sorts of ways.

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: 生きることがこんなにも大変なものだとは想像していなかった。
lines.translated: I never imagined that living would be something this difficult.

lines.content: たったひとりで生きるには、この世界はあまりに[・|重][・|い]。
lines.translated: This world is far too *heavy* to live in all alone.

lines.content: なあ、ハル。
lines.translated: Hey, Haru.

lines.content: 君がいなくなってから俺たちは自然とバラバラになった。
lines.translated: Ever since you disappeared, we naturally drifted apart.

lines.content: ハルを亡くしても尚、以前のようにバカ話をしようという気にはとてもならず……。
lines.translated: Even after losing you, there was no way we could bring ourselves to joke around like we used to...

lines.content: 登下校もいつしか共にすることもなくなった。
lines.translated: Before we knew it, we stopped walking to and from school together, too.

lines.content: 休日会うことも当然なく、学園で、同じクラスで顔を合わせても、おはようとさよならを交わすことも段々となくなった。
lines.translated: Naturally, we never met up on holidays, and even when we saw each other in the same class at the academy, we gradually stopped exchanging "good mornings" and "goodbyes."

lines.content: 千和だけは俺たちが卒業するまで全員分のお弁当をいつも作ってきてくれていたらしいと、卒業式の後、姫織から聞かされそれを知り……。
lines.translated: It wasn't until after the graduation ceremony that Himeori told me Chiwa was the only one who had apparently kept making lunches for all of us right up until we graduated...

lines.content: とても申し訳ない気持ちになりながらも、それっきりだ。それっきり、俺はみんなと会っていない。
lines.translated: Even though I felt terribly sorry about it, that was the end of it. Since then, I haven't seen any of them.

lines.content: みんなは、今、何をしているだろうか。
lines.translated: What is everyone doing right now, I wonder?

lines.content: 智仁は紛争の止まない遠い国で写真を撮っていると言っていた。一年か二年前かに電話があったのだ。
lines.translated: Tomohito said he was taking photographs in a distant country where war never ceases. He called me a year or two ago.

lines.content: おいお前、音楽はどうしたんだよと聞いた。
lines.translated: "Hey man, what happened to your music?" I asked him.

lines.content: 『……言ったろ。俺は音楽そのものになりたかったんだよ。想いを。言葉を。ずっと遠い未来にいる人に届けたかった。何も音楽を奏でる誰かになりたかったわけじゃない』
lines.translated: "...I told you, didn't I? I wanted to become music itself. I wanted to deliver my feelings, my words, to someone in the far distant future. It's not like I specifically wanted to become someone who plays music."

lines.content: ああ、そうなのか。と俺は応えた。
lines.translated: "Right, is that how it is," I replied.

lines.content: ああ、そうなんだ。と返ってきた。
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's how it is," came the answer.

lines.content: 電話はたったそれだけで切れた。
lines.translated: The call ended with just that.

lines.content: [・|友][・|人][・|関][・|係][・|だ][・|っ][・|た]あの頃みたいに、無意味な話に花が咲くことはなかった。
lines.translated: Unlike back when *we were friends*, we didn't have a lively conversation about meaningless things.

lines.content: どちらが大人になったのか。
lines.translated: Which one of us had grown up?

lines.content: どちらも大人になりきれなかったのか。
lines.translated: Or had neither of us managed to fully grow up?

lines.content: 確信できたのはただひとつ。
lines.translated: There was only one thing I could be sure of.

lines.content: ……もう、昔みたいな関係には戻れない。
lines.translated: We can never go back to the way we used to be.

lines.content: それだけだ。
lines.translated: That's all.

lines.content: やはり、ただ“疲れた”という感想だけがある。
lines.translated: In the end, the only thought I'm left with is simply, "I'm tired."

lines.content: 大人になってからというもの、一日一日が重かった。やらなきゃならないことがあまりに多い。
lines.translated: Ever since I became an adult, every single day has felt heavy. There are far too many things I have to do.

lines.content: 考えなくてもいいことが、あまりに、増えた。
lines.translated: And far too many things I shouldn't even have to think about have piled up.

lines.content: 俺は、そんな今の自分という人間が、かつて思い描いていた自分とはあまりに違く……。
lines.translated: The person I am now is just far too different from the person I once envisioned myself becoming...

lines.content: 一日。一日。
lines.translated: Day by day.

lines.content: 一秒。一秒。
lines.translated: Second by second.

lines.content: 大人として生きてく時間が、自分自身への言い得ぬ嫌悪感となり……。
lines.translated: The time I spend living as an adult turns into an indescribable disgust toward myself...

lines.content: 心のどこか大切な部分に降り積もっていくような感覚に……もう、嫌だと思ったのだ。ほとほと疲れた。嫌気がさした。
lines.translated: Feeling as though it's piling up somewhere deep and precious within my heart... I thought, I've had enough. I'm completely exhausted. I'm sick of it all.

lines.content: ……ハル
lines.translated: "...Haru."

lines.content: もしも天国だとかそんな場所があるとして……。
lines.translated: Assuming a place like heaven actually exists...

lines.content: そこに俺が行けるのかどうかはわからないけれど。
lines.translated: I don't know if I'd even be allowed to go there, though.

lines.content: もしそこで会うことが叶うなら、ハル。
lines.translated: If my wish to meet you there comes true, Haru.

lines.content: 答え合わせをしよう――どうして君が死を選ばなければならなかったのか。俺なりに色々と考えたから。
lines.translated: Let's compare answers -- about why you had to choose death. Because I've thought about it a lot in my own way.

lines.content: 目を閉じる。
lines.translated: I close my eyes.

lines.content: 頬で風を感じた。
lines.translated: I felt the wind against my cheeks.

lines.content: ……命を軽く扱うものには最大の罪が待っているという。
lines.translated: They say the greatest sin awaits those who treat life lightly.

lines.content: だからやっぱり[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]は天国には行けないか。
lines.translated: So I guess *we* won't be able to go to heaven after all, huh?

lines.content: だけど、現実世界のほうが何より地獄だ。
lines.translated: Still, the real world is more of a hell than anything else.

lines.content: 地獄はどこでもない、今、ここにこそある――
lines.translated: Hell isn't anywhere else; it's right here, right now --

lines.content: ……なんてな
lines.translated: "...Yeah, right."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]ができればとっくにしてる。
lines.translated: If I could do *that*, I would have done it a long time ago.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|引][・|き][・|金]を引くことさえできなかったこの俺なのだ。
lines.translated: I'm the kind of guy who couldn't even pull *that trigger*.

lines.content: だからこそ、今、こんなふうに生きている。
lines.translated: That's precisely why I'm living like this right now.

lines.content: 何も、何ひとつ、上手くいかなかったし、“夢”も“希望”も何もなく……ただただ、生きてる。
lines.translated: Nothing, not a single thing, went well, and without any "dreams" or "hope"... I'm just simply existing.

lines.content: きっと、これからも変わらずに……ずっと。
lines.translated: Surely, it'll stay just like this from now on... forever.

lines.content: 仕事を終えて帰路につく。
lines.translated: Finishing my work, I head home.

lines.content: 定時に上がるとは良いご身分だなと教頭にちくりと嫌味を贈られる。
lines.translated: The vice principal throws a stinging, snide remark my way, saying it must be nice to be able to clock out on time.

lines.content: それならもう少し仕事しようかと席に着き直せば、さっさと帰れとどやされる――やる気のない者は不要だと。
lines.translated: When I sit back down at my desk, thinking I'll do a bit more work then, I get barked at to hurry up and go home -- told that they don't need anyone who lacks motivation.

lines.content: きもちよく定時にあがれないのであれば、いったい何のために公務員になったのかまるでわからない。
lines.translated: If I can't even clock out on time with peace of mind, I have no idea why on earth I became a civil servant in the first place.

lines.content: 部活で登校していたらしい数人の生徒が、『さよなら先生』と手を振り走っていった。
lines.translated: A few students who seemed to have come to school for club activities waved and ran past, calling out, "Goodbye, Sensei!"

lines.content: それに手を振り返すこともなく、俺は学園の坂道をゆるやかに下る。
lines.translated: Without even waving back at them, I slowly walk down the sloped road of the academy.

lines.content: 空腹は自覚できても、あまり食欲はなかった。
lines.translated: Even though I was aware of my hunger, I didn't have much of an appetite.

lines.content: コンビニでカップ麺と栄養食品のブロックと、デザートに小さなプリンをひとつ買って帰宅した。
lines.translated: I bought a cup of instant noodles, a nutritional food block, and one small pudding for dessert at the convenience store before returning home.

lines.content: ……ただいま
lines.translated: "...I'm home."

lines.content: と、言ってみたところで、そこに返事はない。
lines.translated: Even when I try saying that, there's no reply.

lines.content: 今夜もひとりぼっちで夕食を摂る。
lines.translated: Tonight, too, I eat dinner all by myself.

lines.content: テレビを付けても興味を示せるような番組はなかったので、すぐに電源を落とした。しんと静まりかえる――みしり。家鳴りがして、ハッとした。
lines.translated: Even when I turned on the TV, there were no programs that caught my interest, so I quickly turned the power off. A dead silence falls -- creak. The house settled, making me gasp.

lines.content: 振り返り、そこに誰かの名前を呼ぼうとして……。
lines.translated: I turned around, about to call out someone's name into the emptiness...

lines.content: ……やめた。
lines.translated: and stopped.

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 誰の名前を口にしようと思ったのか――わからなかった。
lines.translated: Whose name was I about to say? -- I didn't know.
*By that point, I could barely remember anything anymore.*

lines.content: ここで一緒に暮らした誰かがいたはず。
lines.translated: There must have been someone who lived here with me.

lines.content: やさしいひとたちが、ここで、俺の帰りを待っていてくれたはず。
lines.translated: Kind people must have been right here, waiting for me to come home.

lines.content: ……思い出せない。
lines.translated: I can't remember.

lines.content: 大切なことは日に日に、大切にしたいことは刻々と、俺の中から滑り落ちていく……。
lines.translated: Day by day, the things that are precious to me, and moment by moment, the things I want to cherish, slip away from inside me...

lines.content: この世界はどこまでも理不尽で、不公平で……。
lines.translated: This world is endlessly unreasonable, and unfair...

lines.content: 果たして生きていくだけの価値はあるものなのか。
lines.translated: Is it really something worth living on for?

lines.content: プリンは食べる気が起きず、冷蔵庫に納めた。
lines.translated: I didn't feel like eating the pudding, so I put it away in the fridge.

lines.content: 簡単にシャワーを浴び、歯を磨き――明日の準備を済まし、寝床についた。
lines.translated: I took a quick shower, brushed my teeth -- finished getting ready for tomorrow, and got into bed.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 疲れた。
lines.translated: I'm tired.

lines.content: もう、だめだ。布団にくるまってしまうともうだめだ。
lines.translated: It's no good anymore. Once I wrap myself up in my futon, I'm completely done for.

lines.content: 何も、する気が起きない――眠気が訪れるまで本を読んだり、映画を見たり、ゲームをしてみたりするだけの時間はある。
lines.translated: I don't feel like doing anything -- I have enough time to read a book, watch a movie, or try playing a game until sleepiness comes over me.

lines.content: 定時にあがったのだ。まだどんなことをして時間を食われてしまおうと、明日の仕事へ支障が出るほどのことではないはずなのに……。
lines.translated: I clocked out on time, after all. No matter what I do to eat up the time right now, it shouldn't be enough to interfere with tomorrow's work, and yet...

lines.content: 気力がわかないのだ。
lines.translated: I just can't muster the energy.

lines.content: ただ時間があるだけ眠っていたい。泥のように眠り続けていたかった。
lines.translated: I just want to sleep for as much time as I have. I wanted to keep sleeping like the dead.

lines.content: 包まった布団の中でため息をつく。
lines.translated: Wrapped up in my futon, I let out a sigh.

lines.content: ……こんなはずじゃなかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't supposed to be like this.

lines.content: ふと、そんな思いが脳裏を過ぎる。
lines.translated: Suddenly, that thought crosses my mind.

lines.content: 毎夜だ。こんな思いにかられるのは毎夜のことなのだ。
lines.translated: Every night. Being seized by thoughts like this happens every single night.

lines.content: 俺は、幼い頃、または楽しかった学生時代、いったいどんな未来を思い描いていただろうか。
lines.translated: Back when I was young, or during my fun student days, just what kind of future did I envision for myself?

lines.content: もっと笑顔の多い未来だろうか。
lines.translated: Was it a future with more smiles?

lines.content: もっと色々な人たちに囲まれた騒がしい毎日だろうか。
lines.translated: Was it noisy, everyday life surrounded by all sorts of people?

lines.content: 困難はあったとしても、それは戦うだけの価値があると認められる――そんな戦いに挑む俺の背中だろうか。
lines.translated: Or was it the sight of my own back, taking on battles where, even if there were hardships, I could acknowledge they were worth fighting for?

lines.content: （……バッドエンドだ）
lines.translated: (...It's a bad end.)

lines.content: そう、思った。
lines.translated: That was what I thought.

lines.content: 今、こうして、現実に疲れ果て――眠りにつこうしている俺が存在するこの時間は……間違いなく、バッドエンドのなれの果てだろう。
lines.translated: This present time, where I exist like this, completely exhausted by reality and about to fall asleep... is undoubtedly the tragic ruin of a bad end.

lines.content: どこで道を間違えた。
lines.translated: Where did I take the wrong path?

lines.content: どこで選択を間違えた。
lines.translated: Where did I make the wrong choice?

lines.content: 眠る。
lines.translated: I sleep.

lines.content: 眠り続ける。
lines.translated: I keep sleeping.

lines.content: ……夢などいっさい、見ないまま。
lines.translated: Without dreaming a single dream.

lines.content: 暗い。真っ暗だ。俺の光はいったいどこだ。
lines.translated: It's dark. Pitch black. Where on earth is my light?

lines.content: こんな人生がいつまで続いていくのだろう。
lines.translated: How much longer is a life like this going to continue?

lines.content: ああ、もう、いい。明日なんてこなければ良い。
lines.translated: Ah, whatever, I've had enough. I wish tomorrow would just never come.

lines.content: せめてそんなことを願い、夢見ながら、俺は……心の中にため息をひとつ、落とした。
lines.translated: Wishing and dreaming for at least that much, I... let a single sigh fall inside my heart.
Mm.

lines.content: なん、だ。
lines.translated: What... is that?

lines.content: ……騒がしい、な
lines.translated: "...It's noisy."

lines.content: 目覚まし時計の不具合――では、なさそうだ。
lines.translated: It didn't seem to be... a malfunction with my alarm clock.

lines.content: ……電話？
lines.translated: "...A phone?"

lines.content: 電話だ。このデジタル音はおそらく携帯電話だろう。
lines.translated: It was a phone. Going by the digital ringtone, it was probably a cell phone.

lines.content: しかし、いったいどこから……。
lines.translated: But where on earth was it coming from...?

lines.content: 俺は携帯電話を持っていない。
lines.translated: I don't own a cell phone.

lines.content: すべて固定電話で連絡は済ませている。
lines.translated: I handle all my correspondence over a landline.

lines.content: 携帯を持つと、いつでもどこでも呼び出されることが可能となり……。
lines.translated: Having a cell phone makes it possible to be called out anytime, anywhere...

lines.content: その状況がなんだかひどい焦燥となり、落ち着かないのだ。まるで見えない首輪でもはめられてしまっているかのようだ。
lines.translated: And that situation fills me with a terrible sense of restlessness, making it impossible to relax. It's almost like having an invisible collar snapped around my neck.

lines.content: いったい、どこで……鳴ってるんだ
lines.translated: "Where on earth... is it ringing?"

lines.content: 携帯を探した。眠たいばかりの意識と[まぶた|瞼]をこすりながら。
lines.translated: I searched for the cell phone, rubbing my eyelids as my mind remained heavy with sleep.

lines.content: しかし携帯は探す必要などなかった。
lines.translated: However, there was no need to search for it at all.

lines.content: 枕元にぽつんと置かれていたのだ。疑問は。不思議は。戸惑いは。あらゆる角度から湧いてくるけれど……。
lines.translated: It was sitting right there by my pillow, all by itself. Questions. Confusion. Bewilderment. They welled up from every possible angle, and yet...

lines.content: ……もしもし
lines.translated: "...Hello?"

lines.content: とにかく俺はその端末を手に取り、通話ボタンを押した。
lines.translated: Regardless, I picked up the device and pressed the answer button.

lines.content: ざーざーとノイズに混じった中で声がする。だが、聞こえない。スピーカーの向こうから誰かが喋りかけてきているのは、わかる。
lines.translated: A voice came through, mixed in with harsh static. However, I couldn't make it out. I could tell someone was speaking to me from the other side of the speaker.

lines.content: だけど、まるでテレビの砂嵐みたいなノイズ音が、その声を掻き消さんとばかりに鳴り続けていた。
lines.translated: Even so, a static noise like white noise on a TV kept blaring, as if trying to drown the voice out completely.

lines.content: 何度か“もしもし”と繰り返し呼びかけたが、状況は変わらない。次第に気味が悪いと感じ始めた。
lines.translated: I called out "Hello?" several times, but the situation didn't change. Gradually, it started to creep me out.

lines.content: 一応、“すみません。よく聞き取りづらいので……”と断りだけは入れ、スピーカーから耳を離そうとした。
lines.translated: Just in case, I offered a quick excuse--"I'm sorry, it's a little hard to hear you..."--and went to pull the speaker away from my ear.

lines.content: が……っ、たい、が……、やっと……やっと、繋がった……っ
lines.translated: "...ga... Tai... ga... Finally... it finally connected..."

lines.content: 急にノイズが晴れたのだ。そして、声だ。スピーカーの向こうからかわいい声がする。その声が俺のことを繰り返し、呼んでいた。
lines.translated: The static suddenly cleared up. And then, a voice. A cute voice was coming from the other side of the speaker. That voice was calling out to me, over and over.

lines.content: ……大雅っ、大雅っ、よかった……やっと、繋がった。繋がったよ
lines.translated: "...Taiga, Taiga, thank goodness... It finally connected. It connected."

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと……待って。君は、誰なんだ。どうして俺の名前を
lines.translated: "W-Wait... hold on. Who are you? How do you know my name--"

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: どこか掠れたような声だった。それは、電話の相手が泣いているせいなのだと、なんとなく、わかった。
lines.translated: Her voice sounded somewhat hoarse. Somehow, I could tell it was because the person on the other end of the line was crying.

lines.content: お願い……。大雅。もう時間はあまりない。だから用件だけ、伝えるよ
lines.translated: "Please... Taiga. There isn't much time left. So I'm only going to tell you what I called to say."

lines.content: 涙を拭えるだけの短い、ごくごく短い沈黙があった後――再び、声が届いた。
lines.translated: After a short, very brief silence--just long enough to wipe away tears--the voice reached me once again.

lines.content: 大雅。お願い。あなたに助けてほしい人が、いるんだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. Please. There is someone I need you to save."

lines.content: ……俺に？
助けてほしい人……？
lines.translated: Someone she needs me to save...?

lines.content: ……うん。お願い。お願い、します。どうかわたしの“夢”を、一緒に……叶えて
lines.translated: "...Yes. Please. I'm begging you. Please, make my 'dream' come true... together with me."

lines.content: 大雅……、お願い。応えて。ちゃんと、聞こえてる？　ちゃんと、繋がってる？
lines.translated: "Taiga... please. Answer me. Can you hear me clearly? Are we properly connected?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。ちょっと……。待ってくれ。お願いだ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Just... wait a second. Please."

lines.content: わからない。わけがわからない。
lines.translated: I don't get it. I don't understand any of this.

lines.content: ――真夜中。
lines.translated: --In the dead of night.

lines.content: 突然、見ず知らずの携帯電話に着信があった。
lines.translated: Suddenly, a call came in on an unfamiliar cell phone.

lines.content: そして知らない誰かが、かわいい声の女の子が、どうか助けてほしいと俺に言う。助けてほしい人がいるのだと、俺に、願っている。
lines.translated: And someone I don't know, a girl with a cute voice, is begging me for help. She is pleading with me, saying there is someone she wants me to save.

lines.content: ほんとにちょっと、待ってくれ。いきなりすぎて何がなんだか……
lines.translated: "Seriously, just wait a minute. This is so sudden, I have no idea what's going on..."

lines.content: 沈黙があった。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: ちくたくちくたく……。
lines.translated: Tick-tock, tick-tock...

lines.content: 部屋の時計の音がいやに大きく聞こえてしまう。
lines.translated: The sound of the clock in my room echoed terribly loud in my ears.

lines.content: ……そう、だよね。わからないよね。ちゃんと説明、しなくちゃ……だよね
lines.translated: "...Right, of course. You wouldn't understand. I have to explain it properly... don't I?"

lines.content: 鼻をすすり上げるような音がした――そして、電話の相手はぽつりと、『覚えてるのは……』と言った。
lines.translated: There was the sound of a sniffle--and then, the voice on the phone murmured quietly, "What do you remember...?"

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅。覚えているのは、どこまで？
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga. How much do you remember?"

lines.content: え？　覚えて……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Remember...?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 大雅が、あなたが、この町にやって来る前のこと
lines.translated: "About before you--before Taiga came to this town."

lines.content: わたしと一緒に……この世界に復讐しようって、そう、誓ったよね。それまでの時間について、大雅。どこまで覚えてる？
lines.translated: "Together with me... we swore that we would take revenge on this world, didn't we? About the time leading up to that, Taiga. How much do you remember?"

lines.content: 君と、一緒に……？　この町へ？
lines.translated: "Together... with you...? To this town?"

lines.content: ……うん。そこのところは、思い出せないならいいんだよ。さみしいけれど、今は、いい――重要なのは、この町へやって来る前のこと
lines.translated: "...Yes. If you can't remember that part, it's okay. It makes me lonely, but for now, it's fine--what's important is before you came to this town."

lines.content: あなたはそれをどれくらい覚えてる？
lines.translated: "How much of that do you remember?"

lines.content: 電話の相手は、“それが何より、どんなことより――たとえば世界が終わってしまうことなんかよりずっと大切なことなんだ”というように、力強く、俺に言った。
lines.translated: The person on the phone spoke to me with such force, as if to say that it was more important than anything, than any other matter--far more important than even the end of the world itself.

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 考える。
lines.translated: I thought about it.

lines.content: 俺がこの町へやって来る前のことを。
lines.translated: About the time before I came to this town.

lines.content: そして。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 俺が思い出せる、一番古い記憶はなんだろう――
lines.translated: What was the oldest memory I could recall--

lines.content: ……あれ。
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……お、おかしいな
lines.translated: "...Th-That's strange."

lines.content: ……何も、なかった。
lines.translated: There was nothing.

lines.content: 俺の中には思い出が何もない。
lines.translated: There were no memories inside me at all.

lines.content: どうして
この町にやって来て……。
lines.translated: I came to this town...

lines.content: たくさんの友だちができた。
lines.translated: I made a lot of friends.

lines.content: そして最も悲しい別れまでをも、経験した……。
lines.translated: And I even experienced the saddest of farewells...

lines.content: それら“この町にやって来てから”の記憶は――[・|不][・|思][・|議][・|な][・|こ][・|と][・|以][・|外][・|は]、殆どすべて覚えていられるはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Those memories from "after I came to this town"--aside from the strange things, I should be able to remember almost all of them, and yet...

lines.content: ……どうしてだ。何も、思い出せない
lines.translated: "...Why is this happening? I can't remember anything."

lines.content: 俺はいったいどこからここへやって来た。俺はいったい、何をしに、ここへ来た。
lines.translated: Where on earth did I come here from? What on earth did I come here to do?

lines.content: やっぱり……。う、うう
lines.translated: "I knew it... U-Ugh..."

lines.content: 電話の相手はまた泣いているようだった……。
lines.translated: It seemed the person on the phone was crying again...

lines.content: どうして。どうして泣くのか。
lines.translated: Why? Why is she crying?

lines.content: 何が、あったんだ。君に何が起こって……、あるいは、何が起こらなかったのか。
lines.translated: What happened? What happened to you... or rather, what didn't happen?

lines.content: 根拠は何もないけれど、電話の彼女を悲しませている原因が、この俺にもとても深い部分で関係してしまっている――そんな気がしてならない。そんな予感がして、ならないのだ。
lines.translated: I had no basis for it whatsoever, yet I couldn't shake the feeling--the premonition--that the reason making the girl on the phone so sad was deeply connected to me as well.

lines.content: 何を話していいのかわからず。何を問いかけていいのかも、わからず――ただただ沈黙を選ぶしかない。
lines.translated: Not knowing what to say, and not knowing what to ask--all I could do was choose silence.

lines.content: そんな俺に、電話の女の子は、『ごめんね』と言った。いきなりこんなこと言って、ごめんなさいと。
lines.translated: To me in that state, the girl on the phone said, "I'm sorry." She apologized for springing all of this on me so suddenly.

lines.content: ……時間、ないけど。説明、するよ
lines.translated: "...There isn't much time, though. I'll explain."

lines.content: ぐずぐずと鼻を啜る音と、悲しい気持ちに、今にも掻き消されてしまいそうな声だった。
lines.translated: It was a voice that sounded like it might be drowned out at any moment by the sound of her sniffling and her own sorrow.

lines.content: ……大雅、聞いて、くれるかな。わたしの話
lines.translated: "...Taiga, will you listen? To my story?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 少し、長くなってしまっても……いい？　平気？
lines.translated: "Even if it ends up being a little long... is that okay? Do you mind?"

lines.content: ……ああ。いいよ。平気、だよ。君の時間が大丈夫なら。どうせ今夜も眠れないんだ。お話くらい、いくらでも付き合うよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It's okay. I don't mind. As long as you have the time. I can't sleep tonight anyway. I'll gladly keep you company and listen to your story for as long as you want."

lines.content: 微笑んでみるけれど、当然、電話の相手には伝わらない――だけど女の子は少し安心したように、『ありがとう』と言ってくれた。
lines.translated: I tried smiling, though naturally, it wouldn't reach the person on the other end of the line--even so, sounding a little relieved, the girl said, "Thank you."

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……今から話すことはね。あなたにとって、とても遠い過去のこと
lines.translated: "...What I'm about to tell you is, for you, something from the very distant past."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……だけど、同時に、とても遠い未来の話でも、あるの
lines.translated: "...However, at the same time, it is also a story of the very distant future."

lines.content: どうしたの？
lines.translated: "What's wrong?"

lines.content: そこで急に黙ってしまった女の子だったけれど……。
lines.translated: At that point, the girl suddenly fell silent, however...

lines.content: わたしは……
ぽつりと、言う。
lines.translated: Quietly, she spoke.

lines.content: ……わたしは、今から、あなたのことを傷つける……かも……しれない。でも、それでも、わたしは……っ
lines.translated: "...From here on, I might... end up... hurting you. But, even so, I...!"

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: やっぱりまだまだわからないことばかりだ。
lines.translated: There were still so many things I didn't understand, after all.

lines.content: それでも女の子が泣いてるのなんて、聞きたくないし、そんな現実は許せもしない。
lines.translated: Even so, I didn't want to listen to a girl crying, and I couldn't forgive a reality that made her cry, either.

lines.content: だから……、
lines.translated: So...

lines.content: ……いいよ
lines.translated: "...It's okay."

lines.content: 俺は、言う。
lines.translated: I said.

lines.content: 傷つくことには慣れてるつもりだ。さんざんな毎日を過ごしているからね。放っておいても、俺の下らないプライドだとか自尊心はいつもいつでもボロボロなんだ
lines.translated: "I like to think I'm used to getting hurt. I've been having a pretty miserable time of it every day, after all. Even if you leave me be, my worthless pride and self-respect are always in tatters anyway."

lines.content: だからさ。どうせ放っておいても傷つけられる心なら、君みたいなかわいい声の女の子に傷つけられたい――なんて。こんなことを言うとなんだか変態みたいだな
lines.translated: "So, you know. If my heart is going to get hurt even when left alone, I'd rather have it hurt by a girl with a cute voice like yours--or something like that. Saying it like that makes me sound kind of like a pervert, huh?"

lines.content: 小さく笑って見せるけど――女の子も笑ってくれている……かどうかは、わからない。
lines.translated: I let out a small laugh--though whether or not the girl was smiling too... I couldn't tell.

lines.content: 今、この子がどこで、どんな顔で、この電話をしているのかもわからないけれど……。
lines.translated: Right now, I didn't know where this girl was, or what kind of expression she was making as she made this phone call, however...

lines.content: できることならこの子の助けになりたいと思い始めている。
lines.translated: I was starting to think that, if possible, I wanted to be of help to her.

lines.content: 君は、俺のことを傷つけてしまうかもしれないと言った――構わない。本当だ。
lines.translated: You said that you might end up hurting me--I don't mind. Really, I don't.

lines.content: それで君が、泣き止んでくれるのならいくらでも……。俺は、傷つけられても構わないよ
lines.translated: "If doing that will get you to stop crying, then as much as it takes... I don't mind getting hurt."

lines.content: ありがとうと君は、もう一度言った……ように思う。小さくて聞こえなかったけれど、きっとそうだ。
lines.translated: I think... you said "Thank you" one more time. It was so quiet I couldn't quite hear it, but I'm sure you did.

lines.content: そして君は語り始める。
lines.translated: And then, you began to tell your tale.

lines.content: ……これは、あなた達のための“物語”
lines.translated: "...This is a 'story' for the sake of all of you."

lines.content: どこか微妙に舌足らずなその声で。
lines.translated: In that voice with a faintly, subtly childish lisp to it.

lines.content: そして、これは、あなたの幸せを探し出すための、“物語”
lines.translated: "And this is a 'story' to find your happiness."

lines.content: 涙になんか負けないように、しっかりと前を見つめ直すかのような、力強い声で……。
lines.translated: In a strong voice, as if refusing to lose to her tears and firmly fixing her gaze straight ahead once more...

lines.content: もう二度と、あなた達が悲しまなくても済むようにと、わたしは、ずっと、いつまでも、ずっと……祈ってる
lines.translated: "So that none of you ever have to grieve again, I am always, forever, always... praying."

lines.content: ふと、身震いをして俺は目覚めた。
lines.translated: A sudden shudder ran through me, and I woke up.

lines.content: ちりんと小さな鈴の音がした。
lines.translated: A tiny bell gave a soft chime.

lines.content: 隣に眠る俺の相棒、友人、あるいは家族。
lines.translated: Sleeping beside me was my partner, my friend, or perhaps my family.

lines.content: 静かに寝息を立てるその顔を確認し、安心した。
lines.translated: I checked the face breathing softly in sleep and felt a wave of relief.

lines.content: ちゃんと隣にいてくれる。夢見てる間にふとどこかへ行ってしまっていないか。いつも心配だ。いつも、不安なのだ。
lines.translated: Still right here beside me. I'm always worried about waking up from a dream to find that presence suddenly gone. Always so anxious.

lines.content: この手を決して離さない。何度も重ねてそう誓うけれど……。
lines.translated: I will never let go of this hand. I swear it over and over again, and yet...

lines.content: ……ごめんな。すぐに戻るから
lines.translated: "...Sorry. I'll be right back."

lines.content: 眠りから覚めたのは、何もつらい悪夢を見ていたからではなく――ぞわりと肌を、そして心を荒々しく撫でる[・|あ][・|の][・|感][・|覚]が、あったからだ。
lines.translated: What woke me from my sleep wasn't a painful nightmare--it was that sensation, roughly brushing against my skin and my heart with a chilling prickle.

lines.content: ……行ってきます。朝までには戻るよ
lines.translated: "...I'm heading out. I'll be back by morning."

lines.content: 小さくつぶやき、立ち上がった。
lines.translated: Murmuring softly, I stood up.

lines.content: もう一度、ちりんと小さく鈴が鳴る。
lines.translated: Once again, the tiny bell gave a soft chime.

lines.content: その音に自然と頬が緩んだ。
lines.translated: The sound naturally brought a gentle smile to my face.
Stepping outside, I count my bullets.

lines.content: 残りは……。
lines.translated: What I have left is...

lines.content: 俺たちふたり分の未来を守るための[・|そ][・|れ]は、あと残り何発だけあっただろうか。
lines.translated: Just how many rounds of it were left to protect the future for the two of us?

lines.content: 見上げた夜空の先に時計塔がある。
lines.translated: Beyond the night sky I looked up into stood the clock tower.

lines.content: ヒーローだ
lines.translated: "A hero."

lines.content: ふと、つぶやいた。
lines.translated: The word slipped out.

lines.content: ……なあ、どこだよ。俺たちのヒーローは、どこへ行ってしまったんだ
lines.translated: "...Hey, where are you? Where did our hero go?"

lines.content: 苦々しく歯を食いしばる。
lines.translated: I ground my teeth bitterly.

lines.content: そして冷たい鋼鉄の固まりをポケットに忍ばせた。
lines.translated: Then I slipped the cold lump of steel into my pocket.

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅には生まれつき、奇妙な能力がある。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, was born with a strange ability.

lines.content: ――この手が握り込んだ“拳銃”で撃ち抜けないものは何もない。
lines.translated: --There is nothing that cannot be shot through by the "handgun" gripped in this hand.

lines.content: たとえば固いコンクリートの壁や地面だ。
lines.translated: Take a solid concrete wall or the ground, for example.

lines.content: 俺の指先が引き金を引けば、[・|そ][・|れ]がごくふつうの“拳銃”で、たった９ミリにも満たない弾丸ひとつでも、まるで砲弾をぶつけたようにばらばらに破壊できるし。
lines.translated: If my fingertip pulls the trigger, even if it's a completely ordinary "handgun" firing a single bullet smaller than nine millimeters, it can blast the target to pieces as though struck by an artillery shell.

lines.content: ……破壊の対象は必ずしも物理的なものである必要はなく。
lines.translated: And the target of destruction doesn't necessarily have to be physical.

lines.content: たとえ目に見えないものであっても破壊できてしまう。
lines.translated: Even things invisible to the eye can be destroyed.

lines.content: たとえば死霊、悪霊、あるいは夜に見る悪い夢。
lines.translated: Spirits of the dead, evil wraiths, or the bad dreams you see at night, for instance.

lines.content: または、望まない困難な未来であろうと、すべて撃ち抜き、砕いて滅ぼす。
lines.translated: Or even an unwanted, difficult future--it shoots through, shatters, and annihilates them all.

lines.content: それが、俺、奏大雅の持って産まれた能力だ……。
lines.translated: That is the ability I, Kanade Taiga, was born with...

lines.content: ……なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: そんなわかりやすい能力であればよかった。
lines.translated: Or rather, I wish it were an ability that straightforward.

lines.content: そうすれば、まさに“ヒーロー”だ。そういうふうに自分を勘違いもできただろう。
lines.translated: If it were, I really would be a "hero." I probably could have deluded myself into believing as much.

lines.content: ああ、そうさ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 自分こそは世界で唯一の存在なのだと、子どもらしく思い込むこともできただろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think I could have childishly convinced myself that I was the one and only special existence in the world.

lines.content: だけど、神さまは俺にそんなわかりやすさをくれなかった。
lines.translated: But God didn't grant me that kind of simplicity.

lines.content: 俺が産まれ持った本当の能力は……。
lines.translated: The true ability I was born with is...

lines.content: ざわりと悪寒を感じた。
lines.translated: A sudden chill prickled across my skin.

lines.content: 辺りを見渡す。
lines.translated: I looked around.

lines.content: すると、見つけた。
lines.translated: And then, I found it.

lines.content: 大通りの隅に設置されたベンチだ。女の人がひとり休憩している。その隣に若い男のひとがいたのだ。
lines.translated: A bench set up on the corner of the main street. A woman was resting there alone. And next to her was a young man.

lines.content: 女の人の手に自分の両手を重ねている。
lines.translated: He was resting both of his hands over the woman's.

lines.content: その震える両手は、今にも消えてなくなりそうな大切な人の命を、懸命につなぎ止めようとしているようにも見えた。
lines.translated: Those trembling hands looked as if they were desperately trying to tether the life of someone precious who might vanish at any moment.

lines.content: だけど女の人にそのひとの姿は見えない。
lines.translated: Yet the woman could not see him.

lines.content: ――ごめんね。
lines.translated: --I'm sorry.

lines.content: 男のひとは言う。
lines.translated: The man said.

lines.content: ――ずっと一緒に生きていこうって誓ったのに。こんな“さよなら”、あんまりだよね。
lines.translated: --Even though we promised we'd live together forever. A "goodbye" like this is just too cruel, isn't it?

lines.content: そんなふうに語りかけるそのひとの声もまた、女の人には届かないのだ。
lines.translated: The voice speaking to her like that couldn't reach the woman, either.

lines.content: それでも男のひとは絶え間なく何かを語りかけ続けている。
lines.translated: Even so, the man kept speaking to her ceaselessly.

lines.content: ずっと昔に笑顔を置き去りにしてきたままのような女の人の手に、しっかりと両手を添えたまま。
lines.translated: Keeping both of his hands firmly over the hand of the woman, who looked as though she had left her smile behind long, long ago.

lines.content: 俺は、そんな[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]の前に立つ。
lines.translated: I stood before the two of them.

lines.content: 女の人はふと俺を見上げ、小首をかしげるような仕草をした。
lines.translated: The woman suddenly looked up at me and tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: このひとが[・|あ][・|の][・|子]を傷つける存在ではないと、なんとなく勘づいてはいた。
lines.translated: I had a vague intuition that this person wasn't something that would harm that girl.

lines.content: それでも警戒しつつ、ポケットの中の“拳銃”に触れる。
lines.translated: Even so, staying on my guard, I touched the "handgun" inside my pocket.

lines.content: その冷たさを感じながら、俺は小さくちいさく、言った。
lines.translated: Feeling its coldness, I spoke in a very small, quiet voice.

lines.content: もしも大切な人にもう一度、会えたなら
lines.translated: "If you could meet someone precious to you just one more time..."

lines.content: ――その人に伝えたいことはありますか。
lines.translated: --Is there anything you would want to tell them?
I asked that question to both of them at the same time.

lines.content: 信じてもらえるかどうかわかりませんけど、あなたの隣に、あなたの手をずっと握ってる男のひとがいます
lines.translated: "I don't know if you'll believe me, but right next to you, there is a man who has been holding your hand this whole time."

lines.content: すると……。
lines.translated: And when I did...

lines.content: すると女の人の瞳からひとつ、大粒の涙がぽろりとこぼれた。
lines.translated: At that, a single large tear spilled from the woman's eyes.

lines.content: 愛してると伝えたい
lines.translated: "I want to tell him I love him."

lines.content: 女の人は、言った。
lines.translated: The woman spoke.

lines.content: もう一度、あの子の目を見て……あなただけが大好きだったと伝えたいんだ
lines.translated: "I want to look into his eyes one more time... and tell him that he was the only one I ever loved."

lines.content: そんなことも叶えられなかった人生なんて、今すぐここで手放してしまいたい――そう言い、女の人は泣いていた。
lines.translated: A life where I couldn't even do something like that is one I want to let go of right here and now--saying that, the woman wept.

lines.content: 結婚を約束していた大切な人がいたという。
lines.translated: She said there was someone precious she had promised to marry.

lines.content: 一周り以上も年下の男の人だった。
lines.translated: He was a man more than twelve years younger than her.

lines.content: その人は幼い頃に親を亡くしてひとりぼっちになった。女の人が引き取り、母親代わりに育てはじめたのは十年以上も昔の話だ。
lines.translated: He had lost his parents when he was very young and was left all alone. It was over ten years ago that the woman took him in and began raising him in place of a mother.

lines.content: たったひとりの子育ては大変なんて言葉では言い表せないほどだ。大変で、大変で、大変なことの連続だった。
lines.translated: Calling it "hard" wouldn't even begin to describe raising a child all by herself. It was hard, so hard, an endless series of hardships.

lines.content: だけどそんな大変さは全部、容易に幸せだったと言い換えることができる。
lines.translated: Yet all of those hardships could easily be rephrased as happiness.

lines.content: 私は子どもを産めない身体だった
lines.translated: "My body wasn't able to bear children."

lines.content: 女の人はそう言った。
lines.translated: The woman said.

lines.content: 幼い頃に大病をした後遺症だ。
lines.translated: It was the aftereffect of a serious illness she suffered in early childhood.

lines.content: 母親になることが夢だった。誰もが当たり前に叶えられる類いの夢だと思っていた
lines.translated: "My dream was to become a mother. I used to think it was the kind of dream anyone could naturally fulfill."

lines.content: そんな平凡な幸せも許されないのなら、私なんてその程度の存在で……。
lines.translated: If I wasn't even allowed such an ordinary happiness, then someone like me was worth no more than that...

lines.content: その程度なのだから、これからもきっと、幸せなんて訪れない。ならばいつ死んでしまっても構わない。そう思っていたけれど……
lines.translated: "And since that was all I was worth, happiness would surely never come to me in the future, either. If so, it wouldn't matter when I died. That's what I used to think, until..."

lines.content: その子を引き取り育てることで夢を叶えた。
lines.translated: By taking that boy in and raising him, she fulfilled her dream.

lines.content: 『私の夢を叶えるために、お前の人生を利用して悪かった』
lines.translated: "'I'm sorry for using your life to make my dream come true.'"

lines.content: その子が十八歳を迎える誕生日だ。ふたりきりで祝ったその夜に、女の人はそう伝えた。
lines.translated: It was the birthday when the boy turned eighteen. On that night, as just the two of them celebrated, the woman told him that.

lines.content: プレゼントは就職祝いもかねてネクタイと、少しのお金を包んで渡した。
lines.translated: For his present, doubling as a congratulatory gift for finding a job, she wrapped up a necktie along with a little bit of money and handed it to him.

lines.content: ――“そうだね。確かにあなたは俺の人生を利用した。それを少しでも悪いと思ってるなら”
lines.translated: --"That's right. You certainly did use my life. And if you feel even a little bit bad about it..."

lines.content: その子は、女の人からのプレゼントを大切そうに抱きしめ、言った。
lines.translated: Holding the present from the woman tightly as if it were a treasure, the boy spoke.

lines.content: ――“好きだ。俺と、結婚してほしい”
lines.translated: --"I love you. I want you to marry me."

lines.content: ……驚いた
lines.translated: "...I was stunned."

lines.content: ――“あなたとふたりっきりでこれからも生きていきたいんだ。いいか？　ふたりっきりで、だ。子どもなんていらない。むしろ邪魔だ”
lines.translated: --"I want to keep living with just the two of us from here on out. Got it? Just the two of us. I don't need kids. In fact, they'd just get in the way."

lines.content: ……あの子は真剣だった
lines.translated: "...He was dead serious."

lines.content: ――“このまま母親と、その子どものままじゃいやなんだよ。俺、あなたを本気で愛してる”
lines.translated: --"I don't want us to stay a mother and her child like this. I truly, genuinely love you."

lines.content: ――“俺の人生、あなたの夢のために利用されてたっていうのなら、最後まで、俺の人生に責任持ってくれよ”
lines.translated: --"If you say my life was used for the sake of your dream, then take responsibility for my life until the very end."

lines.content: そんなことは世間が許さない。
lines.translated: Society would never allow something like that.

lines.content: そう答えると、変だな、世間に許されなきゃあなたは何もできないのかよ。あの子に笑顔でそう言われ、ああ、確かに変だなと、妙に納得してしまったことを覚えてる。
lines.translated: When I answered him with that, he smiled and said, "That's strange. Can you really not do anything unless society gives you permission?" And I remember thinking, ah, that certainly is strange, finding myself oddly convinced.

lines.content: それに、これまでお母さんと呼ばれたことは一度もなくて、さみしさを覚えていたけれど……
lines.translated: "Besides, he had never once called me 'Mom' all that time, which had always made me feel a little lonely, but..."

lines.content: そこにそんな想いがあっただなんて、まるで[きづけ|気付]もしなかった。
lines.translated: I hadn't noticed at all that there were feelings like that behind it.

lines.content: 『こんなおばさんのどこが良いんだ』
lines.translated: "'What's so good about an old woman like me?'"

lines.content: そう言うと、全部いいんだ。決まってるだろとあの子は笑った。
lines.translated: When I said that, he laughed and replied, "Everything. Isn't that obvious?"
What kind of name do these feelings in my chest have, I wonder? Let me think about it for a little while. That was how I answered him.
"'A little while...'"

lines.content: もう少し。
lines.translated: Just a little longer.

lines.content: 『あと、少しだけ』
lines.translated: "'Just a little bit longer.'"

lines.content: いつ答えをくれるのかと迫るあの子には、いつもそう言ってはぐらかしてきたけれど……。
lines.translated: Whenever he pressed me on when I would give him an answer, I always brushed him off by saying that, and yet...

lines.content: 『――わかった。結婚くらいなら、してもいいぞ』
lines.translated: "'--Fine. If it's just marriage, I suppose I don't mind.'"

lines.content: この春。ぶっきらぼうに私はそう応えた。
lines.translated: This spring, I gave him that blunt reply.

lines.content: どうやら私もお前が好きみたいだ、とは恥ずかしくて言えなかった。
lines.translated: I was too embarrassed to say, "It seems I love you, too."

lines.content: 飛び上がってよろこぶあの子だったけど……。
lines.translated: Even so, that boy jumped for joy...

lines.content: いつかちゃんと“好きだ”と伝えられたらと、思っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: I kept thinking that someday, I would properly tell him "I love you," and yet...

lines.content: これからは夫婦として一緒に暮らしていけるよう、面倒な手続きとかも済ませたけれど……。
lines.translated: We even went through all the troublesome paperwork so we could live together as husband and wife from then on, and yet...

lines.content: 結婚式の日取りを決めたその夜に、あの子は通り魔に刺され、この世を去った。
lines.translated: On the very night we decided the date for our wedding, that boy was stabbed by a random attacker on the street and left this world.

lines.content: 命はどうしてこんなに簡単なんだ。
lines.translated: Why is life so fragile?

lines.content: 何を恨むべきだろう。
lines.translated: What should I resent?
Is it this era where people have lost their hearts?

lines.content: それとも勇気がなくて“好きだよ”と、たったそれだけをいつまでも伝えられなかった自分自身か。
lines.translated: Or is it myself, for lacking the courage to ever tell him something as simple as "I love you"?

lines.content: ……大好きだ
lines.translated: "...I love you so much."

lines.content: その想いを俺は伝えた。
lines.translated: I conveyed those feelings for her.

lines.content: ……あなたのことだけを、愛してた
lines.translated: "...You were the only one I ever loved."

lines.content: その言葉を俺は届けた。
lines.translated: I delivered those words for her.

lines.content: 伝えられることの叶わなかった想いと言葉だ。
lines.translated: They were feelings and words that had never been able to reach their destination.

lines.content: ふたりはほんの少しだけ微笑んだ――ひとりだけど、ひとりじゃない。これからはずっと一緒だ。
lines.translated: The two of them smiled just a little bit--alone, yet not alone. From now on, they would always be together.

lines.content: そう思えば、これから何とか生きてはいける。
lines.translated: Thinking of it that way, she would somehow manage to keep on living.

lines.content: そんな言葉と想いと、見ず知らずの俺に、ふたり分のありがとうを残し……。
lines.translated: Leaving behind those words, those feelings, and two people's worth of gratitude for a complete stranger like me...

lines.content: そうして寄り添う合うようにして、ふたりは去って行った。
lines.translated: Nestled close together, the two of them walked away.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: その背中を見送って、ポケットの“拳銃”から手を離した。
lines.translated: Watching their retreating backs, I took my hand off the "handgun" in my pocket.

lines.content: ……[・|あ][・|の][・|子]を狙った亡霊かと思ったけれど……違った。今夜は、[・|こ][・|れ]を使わず済んだ
lines.translated: "...I thought it might be a wraith targeting that girl, but... I was wrong. I didn't have to use this tonight."
--I can see "death."

lines.content: それが俺の能力だった。
lines.translated: That was my ability.
Beside every person, there is always one, or perhaps two, who care deeply for them.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た]が悲しいときはそっと寄り添い。
lines.translated: When you are sad, they gently nestle close to you.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た]がさみしいときは、震えるその手を強く握って。
lines.translated: When you are lonely, they tightly squeeze your trembling hand.

lines.content: 彼らにとって大切な[・|あ][・|な][・|た]が幸せに生きていけるようにと、いつも、いつでもやさしく応援し、力を貸そうとしてくれている。
lines.translated: So that you, who are so precious to them, may live a happy life, they are always, at all times, gently cheering you on and trying to lend you their strength.

lines.content: そんな見えない“誰か”を俺は見ることができた。
lines.translated: I was able to see those invisible "someones."

lines.content: それはいわゆる幽霊とかとは、少し違うものであるように思えてならない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but feel that they were slightly different from what people usually call ghosts.

lines.content: そう思うのは感覚的なものだ。理屈はない。だから俺は彼らのことを幽霊ではなく、“死”が見えると、そういうふうに呼びたかった。
lines.translated: Thinking of it that way was purely intuitive. There was no logic behind it. That was why I wanted to call it seeing "death," rather than seeing ghosts.

lines.content: ただ、そういった“[誰か|死]”は決していいものばかりではない。
lines.translated: However, those "deaths" were by no means all good things.

lines.content: 誰にも気づかれないさみしさのあまり、あるいはたったひとりで“[・|夜]”へと向かわなければならない悲しさのあまりに、大切な人を道連れにしてしまおうとするモノもいる。
lines.translated: Out of the unbearable loneliness of going unnoticed by anyone, or the overwhelming sorrow of having to head into the "Night" all alone, there were some that tried to drag their loved ones along with them.

lines.content: そういう場合は“拳銃”で撃ち抜いた。
lines.translated: In cases like that, I shot through them with my "handgun."

lines.content: 俺の“拳銃”は[・|形][・|あ][・|る][・|も][・|の]は何も破壊することができない。
lines.translated: My "handgun" cannot destroy anything that has a physical form.

lines.content: 壊せるものは目に見えない“想い”だけ。
lines.translated: The only things it can break are invisible "feelings."

lines.content: これはただのモデルガンなのだ。弾丸は“想い”を撃ち抜くために精製された特別製。
lines.translated: This is just a model gun. The bullets are specially refined to shoot through "feelings."

lines.content: 彼らが近くに現れるとぞくりと悪寒が身体に奔る。
lines.translated: Whenever they appear nearby, a chilling shiver runs through my body.

lines.content: [・|俺][・|た][・|ち]の後をつけてくる“悪意あるもの”かと思った。
lines.translated: I had thought it was something malicious stalking us.

lines.content: ……だめだ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: 俺は[・|あ][・|の][・|子]を護りたい。
lines.translated: I want to protect that girl.

lines.content: だからこの“拳銃”を手に、隠れ家からひとり、様子を探るために出てきたのだった。
lines.translated: That was why, with this "handgun" in hand, I had slipped out of our hideout alone to scout out the situation.

lines.content: 空を見上げる。
lines.translated: I look up at the sky.

lines.content: はらはらと夜を舞う小さな花びら。
lines.translated: Small flower petals flutter softly through the night.

lines.content: そのひとつを、ふっと息を吹いて飛ばした。
lines.translated: I blew gently on one of them, sending it flying away.

lines.content: 大人に近づいていくうちに、いつかこんな能力は消えてなくなると言われていたけど……
lines.translated: "I was told that an ability like this would fade away someday as I grew closer to adulthood, and yet..."

lines.content: その他の子ども達と同様に、そういうふうにして、ふつうの大人になれるのだと言われてきたけれど……。
lines.translated: I had always been told that, just like the other children, that was how I would become a normal adult, and yet...
I want to become an adult soon.

lines.content: そう願うばかりだ。
lines.translated: That is all I can wish for.

lines.content: 本当に会いたい人とは決して会えない。こんな力は、必要ない。
lines.translated: I can never meet the person I truly want to see. I don't need a power like this.

lines.content: ……眠ろう。
lines.translated: Let's go to sleep.

lines.content: 帰って眠ろう。
lines.translated: Let's go home and sleep.

lines.content: [・|ふ][・|た][・|り]で一緒に、今は朝まで眠るんだ。
lines.translated: For now, the two of us will sleep together until morning.

lines.content: また“夢”の中で[・|あ][・|の][・|子]と逢える日に“希望”を抱いて。
lines.translated: Holding onto "hope" for the day I can meet that girl again within a "dream."

lines.content: 歌い慣れた小さな“歌”を口ずさみ、俺は戻った。
lines.translated: Humming a familiar little "song," I headed back.

lines.content: ……ちょっと、待ってくれ
lines.translated: "...Wait a minute."

lines.content: そこまで聞いて、俺は女の子の話を遮断した――不思議な体験ではあった。
lines.translated: Having heard that much, I cut off the girl's story--it had been a strange experience.

lines.content: 女の子が話し始め、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。するとまるで夢を見るみたいにして、心の中に、語り聞かされる映像が、音が、再生されるような感覚に包まれていた。
lines.translated: When the girl began speaking and I closed my eyelids, I was wrapped in the sensation of images and sounds playing out inside my mind as she told the story, just as if I were dreaming.

lines.content: もっとも不思議であったのは、“そういうものだ”と思えてしまう（あるいは思わされてしまっているのか）感覚のほうであるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps the strangest part of all was the feeling of simply accepting that "that's just how it is" (or perhaps I was being made to feel that way).

lines.content: だが今は、それらに声を上げるよりもまず、気になることがあった。
lines.translated: Right now, however, before raising my voice about any of that, there was something else bothering me.

lines.content: ……どうして？
電話の向こうから聞こえる女の子の声だ。
lines.translated: It was the girl's voice coming from the other end of the phone.

lines.content: ……どうして、ちょっと待って、なの？
lines.translated: "...Why are you telling me to wait a minute?"

lines.content: その声は不安に震えているようでもあった。
lines.translated: Her voice sounded as though it were trembling with anxiety.

lines.content: 教えてほしい
lines.translated: "I want you to tell me."

lines.content: ……なにを
lines.translated: "...Tell you what?"

lines.content: それって俺の話、なんだよな
lines.translated: "That story is about me, isn't it?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: あなたの未来。あるいは過去
lines.translated: "Your future. Or perhaps your past."

lines.content: 囁くように響くその声に、だけど俺は頭を抱えたい。そんな気分だ。
lines.translated: Her voice echoed like a whisper, yet it made me want to clutch my head in my hands. That was how I felt.

lines.content: 俺の、過去の話。あるいは、未来の話……？
lines.translated: "A story of my past. Or a story of my future...?"

lines.content: つぶやいてみても疑念は晴れない。
lines.translated: Even when I mutter it aloud, my doubts don't clear away.

lines.content: ……まったく覚えがないのだ。
lines.translated: I have no memory of it whatsoever.

lines.content: 語り聞かされるものはまるで他人事のようにしか響いてこない。
lines.translated: Everything she tells me sounds completely like someone else's life.

lines.content: 未来の話ってことは、つまり、まだ今の俺には起きてない出来事だってことなのかな。そうなると、今の俺に、身に覚えなんてなくても当然ってことに……
lines.translated: "If it's a story of the future, does that mean these are events that haven't happened to the current me yet? In that case, it'd only be natural that I don't remember any of it right now..."

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 未来の話って。
lines.translated: A story of the future?

lines.content: そんなことを信じるのか。
lines.translated: Am I really supposed to believe something like that?

lines.content: そもそもこの子は誰なのか。いったい何を俺に伝えようとしているのか。
lines.translated: Who even is this girl in the first place? What on earth is she trying to convey to me?

lines.content: 疑念は尽きない。困惑もだ。
lines.translated: My doubts are endless. And so is my confusion.

lines.content: それに俺には、“死”が見えるとか、そんなおかしな力なんてまったくないし……
lines.translated: "Besides, I don't have any strange power like being able to see 'death' at all..."

lines.content: それは
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……それは、ね。大人になれば消えてしまう“能力”だから
lines.translated: "...That's because, you see, it's an 'ability' that disappears once you become an adult."

lines.content: 人間はみんな、子どもの頃は特別だから。女の子は微かな声で言った。
lines.translated: Because all humans are special when they're children, the girl said in a faint voice.

lines.content: そういう力があったってことを含めて、記憶の中からも消えてしまう――“夜”に関することはすべて、そうなる
lines.translated: "Including the fact that you ever had a power like that, it all vanishes from your memories--everything related to the 'Night' ends up that way."
"...The 'Night'?"

lines.content: チリン、と。
lines.translated: Ring.

lines.content: 電話の向こうから小さな鈴の音が聞こえた。
lines.translated: I heard the sound of a small bell from the other end of the phone.

lines.content: ……続き。話しても、いい？
lines.translated: "...May I continue the story?"

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: そう答えながらも、この先を聞いてしまって本当にいいのだろうか。そんな思いがないわけではない。
lines.translated: Even as I answer her, I can't help wondering if it's really okay for me to hear what comes next.

lines.content: 君は、もしかしたら俺のことを傷つけてしまうかもしれないって、そう言ってたけれど……
lines.translated: "You said before that you might end up hurting me, didn't you...?"

lines.content: この躊躇いの正体は、きっと恐怖だ。
lines.translated: The true nature of this hesitation is surely fear.

lines.content: これ以上、話を聞いてしまえば、俺はもう後戻りできなくなってしまうのではないか。
lines.translated: If I listen to any more of this story, won't I pass the point of no return?

lines.content: 平凡な苦しみを繰り返す毎日からでさえ、一歩踏み出すことが怖いと感じる。
lines.translated: Even when my days are nothing more than a repetition of mundane suffering, taking a single step away from them feels terrifying.

lines.content: だけど、同じくらい、[・|変][・|わ][・|り][・|た][・|い]。そんな期待が胸の中にある。
lines.translated: And yet, just as strongly, I want to change. That expectation rests inside my chest.

lines.content: こんなはずじゃなかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't supposed to be like this.

lines.content: 俺にはもっと違う、別の人生があったのではないか……。
lines.translated: Wasn't there supposed to be a different, separate life out there for me...?

lines.content: そんな思いが消えずにあるから。
lines.translated: Because that thought refuses to fade away.

lines.content: 嫌なことばかりの[・|今]が苦しくて、仕方がないから。
lines.translated: Because this present, filled with nothing but unpleasant things, is so unbearably painful.

lines.content: たとえどんなに残酷な過去を、そして未来を、突きつけられるのだとしても……。
lines.translated: No matter how cruel a past, or future, may be thrust before my eyes...

lines.content: ここで、遠い子ども時代に忘れてきてしまっているらしい何かを取り戻せたなら、俺の平凡な現実は何か変わるかもしれない。
lines.translated: If I can reclaim something here that I apparently left behind in my distant childhood, then maybe my mundane reality will change in some way.

lines.content: そんな都合の良い希望を込めて、言う――聞かせてほしい。
lines.translated: Putting that convenient hope into my words, I speak--I want you to let me hear it.

lines.content: ……話の続き、聞かせてほしいよ
lines.translated: "...Please let me hear the rest of the story."

lines.content: チリンとまた鈴の音がした。
lines.translated: Ring, went the sound of the bell once more.

lines.content: それが答えだ。
lines.translated: That is my answer.

lines.content: 俺の過去。あるいは、未来。
lines.translated: My past. Or perhaps, my future.

lines.content: そんなあやふやな時間が再びはじまる。
lines.translated: That ambiguous time begins once more.

lines.content: ……まずは、あなたの夢の話から
lines.translated: "...First, let's start with the story of your dream."

lines.content: 女の子は少しずつ、たどたどしくもある口調で、続きを語り始めてくれる。
lines.translated: Little by little, in a somewhat halting tone, the girl begins to tell the rest of the story.

lines.content: ……少し特別な力を持ったあなたは、特別な“夜”の中で、まっしろに輝く“夢”と出会った
lines.translated: "...Possessing a slightly special power, within a special 'Night,' you met a 'dream' shining in pure white."

lines.content: 手と手を伸ばし
lines.translated: "Reaching out your hands to each other..."

lines.content: ……微笑み合って
lines.translated: "...and smiling at one another."

lines.content: でも、ふたりはけして、触れられもしない“夜”の中……
lines.translated: "Even though the two of you were within a 'Night' where you could never even touch..."
"...The two of you fell in love."

lines.content: そうしてあなたは知ってしまうの。本当のヒーローは、どこに行ってしまったのかを
lines.translated: "And so, you ended up learning the truth. Of where the real hero had gone."

lines.content: 傷つくための覚悟は本当にできているのか。
lines.translated: Am I truly prepared to be hurt?

lines.content: そう問いかけられているようにも感じた。
lines.translated: It felt as though I were being asked that very question.

lines.content: だから俺はもう何も言わず、ただただ静かに、女の子の声に耳を傾けた。
lines.translated: So I said nothing more, simply listening in complete silence to the girl's voice.

lines.content: “歌”が聞こえる。
lines.translated: I hear a "song."

lines.content: はらはらと夜に舞う花びらみらいに、静かで、しかしとても力強くもある旋律を持つ“歌”だった。
lines.translated: Like petals fluttering down in the night, it was a "song" with a melody that was quiet, yet also deeply powerful.

lines.content: 忘れがたいその“歌”に、まるで呼ばれているような気がして……、
lines.translated: Feeling almost as if that unforgettable "song" were calling out to me...

lines.content: 目覚める。
lines.translated: I wake up.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I open my eyelids.

lines.content: すると、自分がきらびやかな場所に立っていることに、気づいた。
lines.translated: When I did, I realized I was standing in a dazzling place.

lines.content: ここは……
lines.translated: "Where is this...?"

lines.content: まるで絵画の中に迷い込んでしまったようだ。
lines.translated: It was as if I had wandered into a painting.

lines.content: まずそれが最初に抱いた感想だった。
lines.translated: That was the very first impression I had.

lines.content: きらきら眩しい夜の街。
lines.translated: A sparkling, dazzling city of night.

lines.content: そこらを行き交う不思議なもの達。
lines.translated: Mysterious beings passing to and fro all around.

lines.content: 見上げた空さえ不可思議だった。
lines.translated: Even the sky I looked up at was wondrous.

lines.content: 花の色彩に彩られた空には、見知った星座はひとつもなかった。
lines.translated: In a sky painted with the colors of flowers, there wasn't a single familiar constellation.

lines.content: 柔らかいまっしろな光りの粒が、風もないのにふわりふわりと、舞い上がっていく。
lines.translated: Soft, pure-white motes of light floated gently upward, even though there was no wind.

lines.content: ……ええっと
光りの粒子の行き先を、ぼんやりと視線で追いながら、思う。
lines.translated: As my gaze absently follows the destination of those particles of light, I think to myself.

lines.content: 俺は、いつものように眠りについたはず。
lines.translated: I should have fallen asleep just like I always do.

lines.content: そこに特別な儀式とかを行ったり、[・|こ][・|こ]へと通ずるための鍵だとかを持っていたわけではない。
lines.translated: It's not as if I performed some special ritual to get here, or held some kind of key that leads to this place.

lines.content: だというのに、次に目覚めたとき、ここにいた。真昼の世界よりもきらびやかな“夜”の中。
lines.translated: And yet, the next time I woke up, I was here. Inside a "Night" more dazzling than the midday world.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: ここが“噂”の、“夜の国”か
lines.translated: "So this is the 'rumored' 'Land of Night'..."

lines.content: 空を見上げたままつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured while still looking up at the sky.

lines.content: 本当に、この町でただ眠るだけで……[・|あ][・|の][・|時][・|計][・|塔][・|に]、[・|近][・|づ][・|く][・|だ][・|け][・|で]。ここに、やって来れるなんて
lines.translated: "To think that just by sleeping in this town... just by getting close to that clock tower, I could really come to a place like this."

lines.content: はらはらと降るさくらの花だ。耳を澄ませば遠い汽笛が空気を震わせている。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms are fluttering down. When I strain my ears, a distant steam whistle trembles through the air.

lines.content: 辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: I look around.

lines.content: 俺たちは[・|こ][・|こ]を目指し、この町へ――さくらの杜“参禅町”へとやって来た。
lines.translated: Aiming for this place, we came to this town--the cherry blossom forest of "Sanzen-cho."

lines.content: 探しているものがあるからだ。
lines.translated: Because there is something we are looking for.

lines.content: しかしふと辺りを見回す程度では、探し出したいものの姿はどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: However, just glancing casually around me, the figure of what I wanted to find was nowhere to be seen.

lines.content: また、“歌”が聞こえた。
lines.translated: I heard the "song" again.

lines.content: その不思議な旋律に促されるように、ふらふらと歩いた。
lines.translated: As if urged on by that mysterious melody, I walked forward in a daze.

lines.content: 気づくと大きな駅にいた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was at a grand station.

lines.content: 絶え間なく滑り込んでくる機関車たち。
lines.translated: Steam locomotives gliding in without cease.

lines.content: そこに乗り込み、下車してくる様々な何か。
lines.translated: All sorts of somethings boarding them and getting off.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]が行き交う構内には、色々な店が軒を連ねていた。
lines.translated: Inside the concourse where they bustled back and forth, all kinds of shops stood in a row.

lines.content: まるで大きな都市のよう。
lines.translated: Just like a great metropolis.

lines.content: 見上げる。
lines.translated: We looked up.

lines.content: その先には大きなおおきな時計塔。
lines.translated: And beyond it stood a huge, massive clock tower.

lines.content: あそこに行かなければならない。誰かがあそこで俺のことを呼んでいる。不思議とそう思え、俺は進んだ。
lines.translated: I have to go there. Someone is calling for me over there. Strangely convinced of this, I pressed on.

lines.content: 裏路地のような場所に入った。
lines.translated: I entered a place that looked like a back alley.

lines.content: すると途端、人気がなくなる。
lines.translated: Instantly, all signs of life vanished.

lines.content: ここを進んでしまっても本当に大丈夫だろうか。ふとした怖さが背筋をぞくりとさせていた。
lines.translated: Is it really okay for me to keep going down this way? A sudden chill of fear ran down my spine.

lines.content: だが見上げた先の時計塔へは、この通路を抜けていかなければならないようで……。
lines.translated: Yet to reach the clock tower I saw when looking up, it seemed I had to pass through this corridor...

lines.content: 微かな声を聞いた。
lines.translated: I heard a faint voice.

lines.content: 通路を半分くらい進むと、二階へ続く階段があった。見上げたその先には深い闇がある。階段の続く先を飲み込んでいた。その闇の向こうから聞こえてくる。
lines.translated: About halfway down the passage, there was a staircase leading to the second floor. Looking up, deep darkness lay ahead, swallowing the top of the stairs. It was coming from beyond that darkness.

lines.content: 歌だ。
lines.translated: It's the song.

lines.content: 耳を澄ませる。
lines.translated: I strain my ears.

lines.content: 間違いない。
lines.translated: There's no mistake.

lines.content: 闇の向こうから歌が微かに聞こえてくる。
lines.translated: A song can be heard faintly from beyond the darkness.
I know this song.

lines.content: それも、飽くことなく繰り返し聞いた歌だった。
lines.translated: Moreover, it was a song I had listened to over and over again without ever growing tired of it.

lines.content: その歌声に誘われるようにして、階段を一歩、踏み出した。
lines.translated: As if lured by that singing voice, I took a single step up the stairs.

lines.content: 恐る恐る辿り着いた二階の通路。
lines.translated: Timidly, I reached the second-floor hallway.

lines.content: アンティーク調の彫刻が刻まれた扉の前に行き着く。
lines.translated: I arrive in front of a door carved with antique-style engravings.

lines.content: 歌はその向こうから聞こえてきているようだった。
lines.translated: The song seemed to be coming from the other side.

lines.content: 古い蓄音機から響いてくるレコードの音。そんな印象の音色だった。
lines.translated: The sound of a record echoing from an old gramophone. Its timbre gave off that kind of impression.

lines.content: ドアノブを握る。
lines.translated: I grasp the doorknob.

lines.content: これを回してしまって平気だろうか。
lines.translated: Is it really okay for me to turn this?

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]より先に待っているのは悪夢かもしれないし、いつまでも目覚めることなく続いてほしいと祈れるほどの、楽しいばかりの喜劇かもしれない。
lines.translated: What awaits beyond this point might be a nightmare, or it might be a comedy so purely joyful that I'd pray for it to continue forever without me ever waking up.

lines.content: 長い、ながい間、探し続けたものがこの先にある。
lines.translated: What I have been searching for over a long, long time lies just ahead.

lines.content: そんな期待も同時にあって……。
lines.translated: Holding that expectation at the very same time...

lines.content: 逡巡する。
lines.translated: I hesitate.

lines.content: 若干の怖さもあった。
lines.translated: There was a slight fear in me as well.

lines.content: しかしこのまま背を向け、引き返す――そんな選択だけはなかった。
