lines.translated: "The moon will be pulled in by the Earth's gravity and plummet to the ground--and humanity will be wiped out. Every last one."

lines.content: それは“噂”だった。
lines.translated: That was a "rumor."

lines.content: “夜”の外――表の世界で囁かれているもののひとつだ。
lines.translated: It was one of the things whispered outside the "Night"--in the surface world.

lines.content: 確かに月は数年前よりもその輪郭が巨大になりつつあるように思うけど……。
lines.translated: It's true that the moon's silhouette seems to be growing larger compared to a few years ago, though...

lines.content: ……数百年後？
lines.translated: "...Several hundred years from now?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: 人類は……
lines.translated: "Humanity will..."

lines.content: 滅亡してしまう
lines.translated: "Be wiped out."

lines.content: ひとり残らず……？
lines.translated: "Every last one...?"

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: そんなのは……、
lines.translated: Something like that is...

lines.content: ……ただの“噂”だと思ってた
lines.translated: "...I thought it was just a 'rumor.'"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずき、“そうだね”とましろは言う。
lines.translated: Mashiro nodded and said, "That's right."

lines.content: “噂”だよ。本当のことじゃない
lines.translated: "It is a 'rumor.' It's not the truth."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺は首をかしげた。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: どういうこと……？
lines.translated: "What do you mean...?"

lines.content: そんなのは起こらないってこと――悪い“噂”も悪い予感も、いつだって本当じゃないし、当たらないんだよ
lines.translated: "It means something like that won't happen--bad 'rumors' and bad premonitions are never true, and they never come to pass."

lines.content: つまり……
lines.translated: "In other words..."

lines.content: 月は落ちてこないし、人類が絶滅することもない。……ううん。何千年後とか、何万年後とか、そういう遠いとおい未来になら、あり得ることかもしれないけれど……
lines.translated: "The moon won't fall, and humanity won't go extinct. ...Well, maybe thousands of years from now, or tens of thousands of years from now, in a distant, far-off future like that, it might be possible..."

lines.content: でも、あくまでも、今現在の運命線では、という細やかな補足は必要だろうけれど……ともあれ。
lines.translated: Though it probably requires the fine caveat of "strictly on the current timeline"... Regardless.

lines.content: そんな最悪の未来に人類が至ってしまうなんて――そんなのは、どこにも根拠のないただ“噂”なんだよ
lines.translated: "The idea that humanity will reach such a worst-case future--something like that is just a baseless 'rumor.'"

lines.content: だけど……と、ましろは言う。
lines.translated: "However..." Mashiro said.

lines.content: 誰ひとり月に直接殺される人はいないけれど……、だけどね、人の心は滅んでしまう
lines.translated: "Not a single person will be killed directly by the moon... However, the human heart will be destroyed."

lines.content: ましろは窓から“夜”の空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Mashiro looked up at the sky of the "Night" through the window.

lines.content: ましろの視線の先には銀色に輝く月がある。
lines.translated: At the end of her gaze was the moon, shining in silver.

lines.content: 俺も同じようにその月を見つめ、ましろの言葉を繰り返し、口にしてみる。
lines.translated: I stared at the moon just as she did, repeating Mashiro's words aloud to myself.

lines.content: 人は誰ひとり死なないけれど、代わりに、人の心は滅んでしまう
lines.translated: "Not a single person will die, but in exchange, the human heart will be destroyed."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: これから数百年後の未来。人は、心を失う
lines.translated: "In the future, several hundred years from now. People will lose their hearts."

lines.content: やさしい気持ちは人間の心の中にしかないものであるはずなのに……。月の光が[・|そ][・|れ]をひとつ残らずかき消してしまうんだよ
lines.translated: "Kind feelings are supposed to be something that only exists within the human heart... Yet the light of the moon will completely erase every last bit of *it*."

lines.content: ――満月の夜には凶悪な犯罪が増えるのだという統計があるらしい。
lines.translated: --Apparently, there are statistics showing that heinous crimes increase on the night of a full moon.

lines.content: 夜空に輝く満月の光りには、人の心の凶暴性のようなものに作用する“何か”が含まれている――と、そういう見解を示す人たちがいたりする
lines.translated: "There are people who hold the view that the light of the full moon shining in the night sky contains 'something' that acts upon the violent nature of the human heart."

lines.content: ましろはそうつぶやくようにして、言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro spoke as if murmuring to herself.

lines.content: 凶悪なオオカミ男について描かれた童話があるよね
lines.translated: "There are fairy tales written about vicious werewolves, right?"

lines.content: ……そうだね。詳しくは知らないけど、聞いたことくらいならあるよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I don't know the details, but I've at least heard of them."

lines.content: いつもはごくふつうの気弱な男の人なのに、満月の光りを浴びると、途端に恐ろしい“怪物”に変わってしまう
lines.translated: "Normally, he's just a very ordinary, timid man, but the moment he's bathed in the light of the full moon, he transforms into a terrifying 'monster.'"

lines.content: それは、昔々のこと、満月の夜になると凶悪な行為に及ぶ者を、“怪物”とたとえたが故に残った寓話なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: That might be an allegory left behind from a long, long time ago, likening those who committed heinous acts on the night of a full moon to "monsters."

lines.content: 月は、落ちてこない
lines.translated: "The moon won't fall."

lines.content: だけど、地球と月との距離は今とは比べものにならないくらい近くなる――人の心を“怪物”に変える光りの影響もまた、近くなる
lines.translated: "However, the distance between the Earth and the moon will become incomparably closer than it is now--and the influence of the light that turns the human heart into a 'monster' will also draw closer."

lines.content: 少しずつ……。
lines.translated: Little by little...

lines.content: 少しずつ。
lines.translated: Little by little.

lines.content: 最悪は頭上に接近してきているにも関わらず、誰もその異変の原因には気づけないままだ。
lines.translated: Even though the worst is approaching right above our heads, no one is able to notice the cause of this anomaly.
*Young people these days are beyond help.*

lines.content: そんなふうに、心の未熟さと置き換えられて、問題の本質はぼやけてしまう。
lines.translated: By replacing it with emotional immaturity like that, the true nature of the problem becomes blurred.

lines.content: ……この頃、外の世界では凶悪な事件がよく起きたりしないかな
lines.translated: "...Lately, haven't there been a lot of heinous incidents happening in the outside world?"

lines.content: たとえば、とましろは言う。
lines.translated: "For example," Mashiro said.

lines.content: 特に理由もないのに、単にむしゃくしゃしたとか、自分は不幸なのに他人が幸せになるのが許せない、とか――そんな理由で、人を簡単に傷つけたり、命を奪ってしまったり
lines.translated: "Without any particular reason, simply because they were frustrated, or because they couldn't stand seeing others happy while they were miserable--for reasons like that, they easily hurt people, or take their lives."

lines.content: ましろは[・|あ][・|の][・|人][・|た][・|ち]のことを言っているのだなと、わかる。
lines.translated: I could tell that Mashiro was talking about *those people*.

lines.content: ……数日前。
lines.translated: A few days ago.

lines.content: 俺が“想い”を伝えた人たちだ。
lines.translated: The people to whom I had conveyed those "feelings."

lines.content: ……今日。
lines.translated: Today.

lines.content: 愛する人と同じようにして、通り魔に、命を軽率に奪われてしまった女の人だ。
lines.translated: The woman whose life was so carelessly taken by a random attacker, meeting the exact same end as her beloved.

lines.content: だから、もし人類が絶滅してしまう未来が本当にあるのなら、その原因を作るのは月じゃない。月の光りの影響に負け、[・|心][・|を][・|失][・|っ][・|た][・|大][・|人][・|た][・|ち]自身なんだよ
lines.translated: "So if there really is a future where humanity goes extinct, the moon won't be what causes it. It will be *the adults who lost their hearts* after succumbing to the moonlight's influence."

lines.content: 月光の影響下で凶暴化した[・|大][・|人][・|た][・|ち]の蛮行は、理由なき殺人だとか、そんな程度の乱暴さで終わるはずもない。
lines.translated: The atrocities committed by *adults* driven savage under the moonlight wouldn't end with mere senseless murders or that level of violence.

lines.content: きっと大規模な争いが起きるはずだ。
lines.translated: A large-scale war would surely break out.

lines.content: 決して使用することがあってはならないものを乱用し、結果、この星は焼け野原になる。
lines.translated: They would recklessly abuse weapons that must never be used, and as a result, this planet would be reduced to scorched earth.

lines.content: そういう“未来”のほうが、よっぽどか想像に易しい――あの月が、まるで隕石みたいに降ってくる。そういう話よりは
lines.translated: "A 'future' like that is far easier to imagine--much more so than some story about the moon falling down like a meteorite."

lines.content: ……ううん
その“未来”の光景は、“噂”ではなく、実際に“未来”で見てきた人の証言だから
lines.translated: "Because the vision of that 'future' isn't a 'rumor'--it's the testimony of someone who actually went to the 'future' and saw it."

lines.content: だから私はその話を信じた、とましろは言った。
lines.translated: That's why I believed the story, Mashiro said.
*The adults wished to protect the future, to protect the children, from themselves after their own hearts had been driven mad.*

lines.content: それは……どういうこと？
lines.translated: "What... does that mean?"

lines.content: ……“過去”から“[ここ|未来]”にやって来た女の子だよ
lines.translated: "...A girl who came to 'this future' from the 'past.'"

lines.content: 少女は一度、この時代から更に“未来”へ飛んだ――深くふかく、眠ってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: Once, the girl leaped even further into the "future" from this era--she had fallen into a deep, deep sleep.

lines.content: そして“未来”の光景を目の当たりにした。
lines.translated: And there, she witnessed the state of the "future" firsthand.

lines.content: 心をなくした大人たちが、何の罪もない子ども達にとても酷いことをしている現実を、そんな未来を、女の子は実際に目にしたのだという――
lines.translated: She actually saw a reality, a future, where adults who had lost their hearts were doing terrible things to completely innocent children--

lines.content: ……間違っている。こんな未来はあってはならない。
lines.translated: This is wrong. A future like this must never come to pass.

lines.content: そう思った。
lines.translated: That's what I thought to myself.

lines.content: そう、思ったから……。
lines.translated: Because she thought that...

lines.content: あんな未来を回避させるそのために、何か自分にできることはないだろうか。
lines.translated: She wondered if there was anything she could do to avert such a future.

lines.content: “[ここ|現在]”に戻ってきた少女は、見てきたすべてをましろに話した。そして改めて、少女はここを――“夜の国”を作る決意を固めた。
lines.translated: Upon returning to "this present," the girl told Mashiro everything she had seen. And once again, she solidified her resolve to create this place--the "Country of Night."

lines.content: 女の子は知っていたんだね。誰かに教えられたのか、ふと耳にした“噂”話を信じたのかは、わからないけど……とにかく知ってた
lines.translated: "The girl knew about it, you see. I don't know if someone taught her, or if she believed a 'rumor' she happened to overhear... but either way, she knew."

lines.content: ……何を？
lines.translated: "...Found out what?"

lines.content: 大昔、この町に、“夜の国”とよく似た場所が存在していたことをだよ
lines.translated: "That a long, long time ago, a place very similar to the 'Country of Night' existed in this town."

lines.content: だからそれを模して創り上げたのが、この“夜の国”だった
lines.translated: "So what she created in imitation of that was this 'Country of Night.'"

lines.content: それがたとえ、今まで憎からず思っていた大人たちの望みどおりの結末に繋がるのだとしても、女の子にはどうしてもここが……願いを叶えてくれる不思議の国が必要だった。
lines.translated: Even if doing so would lead to the exact outcome desired by the adults she had been rather fond of until now, the girl desperately needed this place... a wonderland that would grant her wish.

lines.content: と、いうことは……。つまり
lines.translated: "Which means... In other words..."

lines.content: 気になることも謎も多いが――まずは一つひとつ、整理していこう。
lines.translated: There were many things that bothered me and plenty of mysteries, but--first, let's sort through them one by one.

lines.content: つまりその女の子の病は、“未来”にだけでなく“過去”へも行ける？
lines.translated: "In other words, that girl's illness allows her to go not just to the 'future,' but to the 'past' as well?"

lines.content: “[・|未][・|来]”[・|を][・|見][・|て][・|き][・|た]という言葉をそのまま受け取るなら、そういうことになる。
lines.translated: If I took the words *saw the "future"* at face value, that was what it meant.

lines.content: そうだね。正しくは“過去”へも[・|行][・|け][・|る][・|よ][・|う][・|に][・|な][・|っ][・|た]、と言うべきなんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "That's right. Though to be precise, I think it should be said that she *became able to go* to the 'past' as well."

lines.content: ――ただし、彼女なりの印を付けた[ポイント|時間]のみ、という条件付きではあったみたいだけれど
lines.translated: "--However, it seems there was a condition: she could only go to points in time where she had left her own kind of mark."

lines.content: 跳んでしまった先の“未来”で、再び眠りに落ちるとき、印をつけた時間を思い描いて[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: In the "future" she had leaped to, when falling asleep again, she would picture the marked time and close her eyelids.

lines.content: すると次に目を覚ましたときには“過去”へと戻って来れた。
lines.translated: Then, the next time she woke up, she was able to return to the "past."

lines.content: 一時的なものではあるけれど、彼女の“病”にはそういう制限のようなものが生まれてた
lines.translated: "Although it was only temporary, a restriction like that had been born within her 'illness.'"

lines.content: 思い描くすべてが叶う“夜の国”――その場所の効果みたいなものが、彼女の心に作用した結果なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: The "Country of Night," where everything one pictures comes true--perhaps it was the result of an effect of that place acting upon her heart.

lines.content: 彼女が一歩、大人になってしまうその瞬間まで、その効果は彼女の中に存在していた。
lines.translated: Right up until the moment she took a step toward becoming an adult, that effect existed within her.
*Therefore, after she became able to go to the "past" as well*--though there was that further condition, she could only go to a "past" she had visited at least once before.

lines.content: ……きっとね、あの女の子は天才だったんだよ
lines.translated: "...Surely, that girl was a genius."

lines.content: いつもおどおどしていて、はじめて会った人とはまともに目を見て話せもしない――内向的な性格だったけど。
lines.translated: Even though she was always timid and had an introverted personality--unable to even look people in the eye and talk properly when meeting them for the first time.

lines.content: いつだって人目を避け、自分の部屋で本を読んだり、音楽を聴いたりして、頭の中で自分の[世界|想像]に浸っている。そんな女の子だったけど
lines.translated: "She was the kind of girl who always avoided the eyes of others, reading books or listening to music in her room, immersing herself in her own imagination inside her head."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ううん。違う。
lines.translated: No. That's not it.

lines.content: ……その胸の中に、[・|誰][・|よ][・|り][・|強][・|い][・|悲][・|し][・|み]があったからこそ――誰より強い“魔法”が、詰まってた
lines.translated: "...Precisely because she held *a sadness stronger than anyone else's* within her chest--she was filled with a 'magic' stronger than anyone else's."

lines.content: “想像”すること。
lines.translated: To "imagine."

lines.content: “想い”を形にすること。
lines.translated: Giving form to "feelings."

lines.content: そういった“特別”に愛された女の子だった。
lines.translated: She was a girl beloved by that kind of "special" power.

lines.content: それ故に、その女の子は“夜”の中で、私という“何か”をも“想像”してしまえた
lines.translated: "Because of that, inside the 'Night,' that girl was even able to 'imagine' the 'something' that is me."

lines.content: ……命はないけど、ここにこうして心だけは存在している。こんな、空っぽみたいな、私という“何か”を
lines.translated: "...I have no life, yet my heart alone exists here like this. An empty-seeming 'something' like me."

lines.content: ましろは、まっしろなドレスの裾を摘まんでひらりとさせる。
lines.translated: Mashiro pinched the hem of her pure white dress and gave it a little twirl.

lines.content: えっと。……えへへ。なんだか、謎めいていて格好良いよね……？
lines.translated: "Um... Ehehe. Doesn't it seem kind of mysterious and cool...?"

lines.content: つま先立ちして澄ました顔だ。
lines.translated: She stood on her tiptoes with a prim look on her face.

lines.content: うん、そうだね。確かに謎めいてる。まさに“夜の女王さま”って感じがるすね――なんとなくだけど
lines.translated: "Yeah, it does. It's definitely mysterious. You really give off the vibe of a 'Queen of the Night'--somehow or another, at least."

lines.content: 俺がそう言いうなずくと、ましろは『そ、そうだよねえ』と、照れたように顔を赤くし、小さな身体をもじもじと揺らしていた。
lines.translated: When I said that and nodded, Mashiro blushed shyly, saying, "R-Right?" and fidgeted her small body.

lines.content: ……話の、続き
lines.translated: "...Back to the story."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: その女の子はね、“夜”を[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]“想像”するため、私を作った
lines.translated: "That girl made me in order to 'imagine' the 'Night' *in this way*."

lines.content: 女の子が望む通りの“夜”を想像するには、何者か助手のような存在が必要だった――天才的な“想像力”の持ち主だからといって、まるごとひとつ“国”を造り上げようというのだ。
lines.translated: To imagine the "Night" just as she wished, the girl needed someone like an assistant--even if she possessed a genius-level "imagination," she was trying to build an entire "country" from scratch.

lines.content: たったひとりでそれを成すには不充分。
lines.translated: Doing it all by herself wasn't enough.
She needed *someone to talk to*.

lines.content: だから女の子は“夜”の中で、まず最初に、自分の“隣”にましろを“想像”した。
lines.translated: That was why, within the "Night," the very first thing the girl "imagined" right "beside" her was Mashiro.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ましろに関しては“想像”というよりも、[・|救][・|い][・|上][・|げ][・|た]と言ったほうが正しいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: When it came to Mashiro, rather than saying she "imagined" her, it might be more accurate to say she *pulled her up and saved her*.

lines.content: ともあれだ。
lines.translated: Regardless.

lines.content: 静かな“夜”の中心で、ふたり語り合うようにして少しずつ、少しずつ、女の子とましろは一緒に“夜”の造形を“想像”していった。
lines.translated: In the center of the quiet "Night," as if chatting together, little by little, the girl and Mashiro "imagined" the shape of the "Night" together.

lines.content: あの女の子は、この“国”がどういうふうな場所ならすてきだと思うのか。私に“夢”と“希望”を語るみたいにして、話してた
lines.translated: "That girl talked to me about what kind of place would make this 'country' wonderful, as if speaking of her 'dreams' and 'hopes.'"

lines.content: つまりそれは、相棒というよりは語り部と聴き手。そういう“関係性”だった。
lines.translated: In other words, rather than partners, they were a storyteller and a listener. That was the kind of "relationship" they had.

lines.content: 女の子は、この時間の中に、過去に残してきた大切な人が、面白おかしく、いつも笑顔で、やさしく生きていけますようにと願いを込めた。そんな楽しい世界を作りたいと、願った
lines.translated: "Into this time, the girl poured her wish that the precious person she had left behind in the past would be able to live a fun, happy, always smiling, and gentle life. She wished to create a joyful world like that."

lines.content: 女の子が“こういうのどうかな”と言ってましろに話すと、ふたりっきりしかいなかった[・|星][・|空][・|の][・|中]に、次々と町ができあがっていった。
lines.translated: Whenever the girl said, "How about something like this?" and spoke to Mashiro, towns were built one after another *amidst the starry sky* where only the two of them had been.

lines.content: そして女の子は、もう二度と大切な人と会いに行けないのなら――せめて“夜”を通して、“夢”で出会えたらいいと願ってた
lines.translated: "And the girl wished that, if she could never go to see her precious person again--then at the very least, she hoped they could meet in a 'dream' through the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 夢で？　会う……？
lines.translated: "In a dream? Meet...?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: そうだよとうなずき、ましろは言った。
lines.translated: "That's right," Mashiro nodded and said.

lines.content: ……“眠ることは死者の世界に生きることである”
lines.translated: "...'To sleep is to live in the world of the dead.'"

lines.content: そういうふうに、この世界のことを言葉にした人がいたんだよと、あの女の子はましろに言ったのだという。
lines.translated: The girl had told Mashiro that there was once someone who described this world in those words.

lines.content: 『その言葉を私は信じる――眠ることも、命尽きてしまうことも、また次の世界に生まれ直すことと同じなんだって』
lines.translated: "'I believe those words--that both sleeping and having your life come to an end are the same as being reborn into the next world.'"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|こ]には、いつも私たちの“隣”で、私たちのことを力一杯、応援してくれている――私たちを大切に想ってくれる“誰か”がいる。
lines.translated: *There*, there is always "someone" right "beside" us, cheering us on with all their might--someone who cares for us dearly.

lines.content: 『毎晩、暖かなベッドで眠りに落ちれば、もう一度会いたいと願う――いつの日か“さよなら”してしまった大切な誰かと、また会える』
lines.translated: "'If you fall asleep in a warm bed every night, wishing to see them once more--you can meet again with that precious someone you had to say "goodbye" to someday in the past.'"

lines.content: そして、やっぱりだ。
lines.translated: And, sure enough.

lines.content: やっぱり、いつも[・|そ][・|の][・|人]が側で見守ってくれていることを、夢の中で知る。
lines.translated: Sure enough, inside the dream, you come to know that *that person* is always watching over you from right by your side.

lines.content: 大変なときは、力を貸してくれているのだと……。
lines.translated: That when times are hard, they are lending you their strength...

lines.content: もうさみしくはないんだなと、知ることができる。
lines.translated: You come to know that you don't have to be lonely anymore.

lines.content: 『現実世界はあんまりにも厳しくて……。心の中の地獄に飼い殺されるかのような苦しい時間の連続だ』
lines.translated: "'The real world is far too harsh... It's a continuous series of agonizing hours, as if being kept alive just to suffer in the hell inside your own heart.'"

lines.content: 『だからせめて眠るときだけは、いつでも、どんなときでも、安らかでいてほしい……。愛おしく想う誰かと過ごせるような、そんな時間であってほしい』
lines.translated: "'So at the very least, only when sleeping, I want it to be peaceful, always, no matter when... I want it to be a time you can spend with someone you hold dear.'"

lines.content: 女の子はここをそんな“国”にしようと、“夜”の中でいつまでも夢見ていたという――そういった女の子の“[祈り|想像]”が、きらきら眩しい“夜”を作った。
lines.translated: The girl dreamed endlessly within the "Night" of making this place into a "country" like that--and that "prayer" of hers, her "imagination," created the dazzling, sparkling "Night."

lines.content: そうして大人たちの期待どおりに産まれてしまった“夜の国”――
lines.translated: "And so, the 'Country of Night' ended up being born just as the adults had hoped--"

lines.content: 窓の外――きらきら瞬く“夜”を見た。
lines.translated: Outside the window--I looked at the glittering, twinkling "Night."

lines.content: 今は、いい。
lines.translated: For now, let's leave that aside.

lines.content: その子が造り上げた“夜”という名の不思議な国。
lines.translated: The wonderland named "Night" that the girl had built.

lines.content: 大人たちがこの“夜”をどのように利用し、どのようにして俺たち子どもの未来を案じていたのか――
lines.translated: How the adults had used this "Night," and how they had worried over the future of us children--

lines.content: そこにどのような理由があったとしても、虐げられてきたのだろうたくさんの子らを納得させられるだけの何かがあるとは思えない――故に。
lines.translated: Whatever reasons may have existed there, I couldn't imagine there was anything sufficient to convince the many children who had likely been oppressed--therefore.

lines.content: 故に今は、それよりも気になることがある。
lines.translated: Therefore, right now, there was something I cared about even more than that.

lines.content: ……その子は、会えたのかな
lines.translated: "...Was that girl able to meet them?"

lines.content: 遠い昔に置いてきてしまったらしい、大切な人……。
lines.translated: The precious person she had apparently left behind in the distant past...

lines.content: その人と、この“夜”の中で……。“夢”の中で、ちゃんと会えたのかな
lines.translated: "Inside this 'Night'... inside a 'dream,' was she properly able to meet that person?"

lines.content: ううん
lines.translated: "Unh-unh."

lines.content: ましろは首を振る。
lines.translated: Mashiro shook her head.

lines.content: 女の子は“願い”を……“夢”を、叶えられなかった
lines.translated: "The girl couldn't make her 'wish'... her 'dream,' come true."
"You see, the girl *had her 'dream' granted for her*."

lines.content: 誰に？　と俺は問う。
lines.translated: By who? I asked.

lines.content: ああ、そうか
lines.translated: "Ah, I see."

lines.content: 問いかけてすぐにハッとした。
lines.translated: Right after asking, it hit me.

lines.content: 君に……。“夜の女王”に、その子は“夢”を叶えてもらった？
lines.translated: "By you...? Did that girl have her 'dream' granted by the 'Queen of the Night'?"

lines.content: ううん。違うよ
lines.translated: "No. That's not it."

lines.content: ましろは微笑み、答える。
lines.translated: Mashiro smiled and answered.

lines.content: 私は誰の“夢”も叶えられない。私はこうして何かを話して、何かを聴くだけしかできない。ただのまっしろな“何か”でしかないから
lines.translated: "I cannot grant anyone's 'dream.' All I can do is talk about things and listen to things like this. Because I am nothing more than a pure white 'something.'"

lines.content: “歌”だよ
lines.translated: "It was a 'song.'"

lines.content: ましろが言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro said.

lines.content: すると蓄音機からいつもの“歌”が流れはじめた。
lines.translated: Just then, the usual "song" began to play from the phonograph.

lines.content: 遠い“過去”からあの“歌”が、女の子に届いたの
lines.translated: "From the distant 'past,' that 'song' reached the girl."

lines.content: “逢いたい”
lines.translated: "I want to see you."

lines.content: “あなたに逢いたい”
lines.translated: "I want to see you."

lines.content: “あなたひとりだけを生涯、愛し続ける”
lines.translated: "I will love only you for my entire life."

lines.content: そんな“想い”のこもった――“愛”と“勇気”の“歌”だった。
lines.translated: It was a "song" of "love" and "courage"--filled with those "feelings."

lines.content: 遠い“未来”であるはずの今現在――何年、何十年と、その“歌”は密やかに歌い継がれてきた
lines.translated: "Up until the present day, which should be the distant 'future'--for years, for decades, that 'song' has been secretly passed down and sung."

lines.content: 母から子へ。
lines.translated: From mother to child.

lines.content: 悲しみにくれる人から、さみしさに負けそうになっている人へ。
lines.translated: From those grieving in sorrow, to those about to be defeated by loneliness.

lines.content: 愛する人から、深く愛される誰かへと。
lines.translated: From those who love, to someone who is deeply loved.

lines.content: その“歌”は、女の子が過去に残してきてしまった“誰か”が、“未来”へ飛んでしまった女の子へ宛てて歌われた手紙でもあったんだよ
lines.translated: "That 'song' was also a sung letter addressed to the girl who had flown to the 'future,' from the 'someone' she had left behind in the past."

lines.content: そしてその“[歌|想い]”は、“夜”の中で“魔法”になった。
lines.translated: And that "song"--those "feelings"--became "magic" within the "Night."

lines.content: 女の子は、自分のいる“未来”にまで、この“歌”を歌い継いできたたくさんの人たちの“想い”が重なり、ついに[・|完][・|成]したのだろうその“歌”の力で、“夢”を叶えた――
lines.translated: "The 'feelings' of the many people who passed down and sang this 'song' all the way to the 'future' where the girl was overlapped, and by the power of that 'song,' which had likely finally been *completed*, the girl's 'dream' came true--"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]が、“過去”に取り残された“誰か”の、本当の“才能”だったのかもしれないし……。
lines.translated: *That* might have been the true "talent" of the "someone" who was left behind in the "past"...

lines.content: いつもは意地悪なはずの神さまが、ほんの少しの気まぐれを起こしたに過ぎないのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Or perhaps a god, who is usually supposed to be mean-spirited, had simply acted on a tiny whim.

lines.content: とにかく、ね。あの“歌”が女の子の心に届いた途端、“夜”もまた、完成した――
lines.translated: "Anyway, you see. The moment that 'song' reached the girl's heart, the 'Night' was also completed--"

lines.content: 女の子が逢いたい人に逢いに行くために造り上げた“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Country of Night" that the girl had built in order to go meet the person she wanted to see.

lines.content: 心に思い描けるすべてが叶う、不思議の国
lines.translated: "A wonderland where everything you can picture in your heart comes true."

lines.content: ……それはあらゆる時代、あらゆる世界、あらゆる心の“隣”にそっと、静かに、夢見るみたいに現れた
lines.translated: "...It appeared softly, quietly, as if dreaming, right 'beside' every era, every world, and every heart."

lines.content: あらゆる時代、あらゆる世界……
lines.translated: "Every era, every world..."

lines.content: そしてあらゆる心の、その“隣”
lines.translated: And right "beside" every heart.

lines.content: だから“夜”を通れば、女の子は、逢いたい人のいる“過去”にまで走って行ける……？
lines.translated: "So if she passes through the 'Night,' the girl can run all the way to the 'past' where the person she wants to see is...?"

lines.content: そういうことだね
lines.translated: "That's right."

lines.content: すべては女の子が、逢いたい人へ逢いに行くために作った効果だったから。
lines.translated: Because everything was an effect the girl had created in order to go meet the person she wanted to see.

lines.content: 女の子の逢いたい人はずっとずっと遠い過去にいる。だから“夜の国”は、幾千の夜を越える出入り口となるため――いつでも俺たちの“隣”に存在を表した。
lines.translated: The person the girl wants to see is in the far, far distant past. And so, to become a doorway crossing thousands of nights--the "Country of Night" manifested its existence right "beside" us at all times.

lines.content: ……そういうふうに“夜”を完成できたのは、“過去”から届いたこの“歌”があったから……？
lines.translated: "...Was the 'Night' able to be completed like that because of this 'song' that arrived from the 'past'...?"

lines.content: ……うん。間違いないよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Without a doubt."

lines.content: 間違いないと、私はそう信じてる。ましろは言って、目を細めた。
lines.translated: "Without a doubt, that's what I believe." Mashiro said, narrowing her eyes.

lines.content: 女の子は“過去”へ旅立った。逢いたい人に逢いに行った。この“夜”を通じて――“刻の終着駅”から汽車に乗って
lines.translated: "The girl set off on a journey to the 'past.' She went to meet the person she wanted to see. Through this 'Night'--riding a train from the 'Terminal Station of Time.'"

lines.content: 俺はましろが話して聞かせてくれた話を心の中で整理している――俺の探しているヒーローはこの“歌”を作った人物だ。
lines.translated: I was sorting through the story Mashiro had told me in my mind--the hero I'm looking for is the person who made this "song."

lines.content: そしてその人は、遠い“過去”に生きていた“誰か”だった。
lines.translated: And that person was "someone" who had lived in the distant "past."

lines.content: それはつまり……。
lines.translated: Which meant...

lines.content: 俺の探しているヒーローは、[・|こ][・|こ][・|に][・|は]いない。遠いいつかの“過去”にいる
lines.translated: "The hero I'm looking for *isn't here*. He's in the distant 'past' of someday long ago."

lines.content: ……そういうことになるね
lines.translated: "...That's what it comes down to."

lines.content: その人の生きてる“過去”は、何年くらい前……？
lines.translated: "How many years ago is the 'past' where that person lives...?"

lines.content: ごめんね。もう、亡くなってしまってる
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. He has already passed away."

lines.content: ましろは目を伏せ、首を振る。
lines.translated: Mashiro lowered her eyes and shook her head.

lines.content: ……その人の“想い”だけが“歌”となり、今を生きてるあなた達に届いたの
lines.translated: "...Only that person's 'feelings' became a 'song' and reached all of you living in the present."

lines.content: 俺の確認したかった“希望”を、即座に感じ取ったのだろう――ましろは目を閉じたまま、そう言った。
lines.translated: She must have immediately sensed the "hope" I had wanted to confirm--keeping her eyes closed, Mashiro said that.

lines.content: その人は歳を重ねていたとしても、まだ“[ここ|未来]”でも何とか生きている。俺はそういう可能性に[すが|縋]ろうとしたのだ。
lines.translated: Even if that person had grown old, he was still somehow alive "here"--in the "future." I had tried to cling to that possibility.

lines.content: けれど、そんな“希望”は断たれてしまった。
lines.translated: However, that "hope" had been severed.

lines.content: 心がずしりと重くなる。
lines.translated: My heart grew crushing and heavy.

lines.content: これはおそらく、“絶望”と呼んで良いだろう感情だ。
lines.translated: This was an emotion that could probably be called "despair."

lines.content: 俺たちの抱える問題を、俺たちの命を、探し求めたヒーローが解決してくれると信じていた。
lines.translated: I had believed that the hero we sought would solve the problems we carried, would save our lives.

lines.content: ……あの“拳銃”を使わずとも済む方法を、一緒に考えてくれるものだと思ってた。
lines.translated: I had thought he would think together with us to find a way to get by without having to use that "handgun."

lines.content: それなのに、その人に助けを求めることはもうできない。絶対に。
lines.translated: And yet, we could no longer ask that person for help. Never.

lines.content: ……“希望”は砕けた。
lines.translated: "Hope" was shattered.

lines.content: ああ、やっぱりこれは“絶望”だ。
lines.translated: Ah, this really is "despair" after all.

lines.content: こんなことになるならこの町になんて来なかった。
lines.translated: If it was going to turn out like this, I never would have come to this town.

lines.content: 大人しく大人たちの言いなりで、命を終えるのでも――よかった。
lines.translated: It would have been fine--even if I had just quietly obeyed the adults and ended my life.

lines.content: だって……。
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: そうだろう……？
lines.translated: Isn't that right...?

lines.content: ……[・|自][・|分][・|の][・|父][・|親]が、遠い“過去”の人間だっただなんて、いったい誰が想像できるっていうんだよ
lines.translated: "...Who on earth could ever imagine that *their own father* was a person from the distant 'past'?"

lines.content: 女の子の話がそこでふと、途切れた。
lines.translated: The girl's story suddenly cut off there.

lines.content: 俺の気持ちもまた、同じように途切れてしまう。
lines.translated: My feelings, too, were cut off in the exact same way.

lines.content: 携帯端末を握りしめた手のひらに、理由もわからない汗をじっとりとかいていた。
lines.translated: The palm of my hand gripping the mobile terminal was damp with sweat for reasons I didn't understand.

lines.content: ……ここまでの話をどう理解すればいいのだろう。
lines.translated: How am I supposed to make sense of the story up to this point?

lines.content: 智仁の顔が浮かぶ。
lines.translated: Tomohito's face came to mind.

lines.content: どうしてだ。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: 探し求めていたという俺のヒーロー……。
lines.translated: My hero, whom I had supposedly been searching for...

lines.content: その名前はまだ、電話口の女の子からは聞かされていないはずなのに、それなのにどうして、あいつの顔が浮かぶのか。
lines.translated: I shouldn't have heard that name from the girl on the other end of the phone yet, and yet why was his face coming to mind?

lines.content: 混乱していた。
lines.translated: I was confused.

lines.content: 困惑だって、していた。
lines.translated: I was bewildered, too.

lines.content: そういえば……
lines.translated: "Come to think of it..."

lines.content: つぶやく。独り言のように。
lines.translated: I murmured. Like I was talking to myself.

lines.content: そういえば俺、両親の記憶があまりない
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, I don't have many memories of my parents."

lines.content: いや。あまりどころか全然だ。
lines.translated: No. Far from "not many," I have none at all.

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅には父親と母親に関する記憶が欠落している。それでも問題なく生きてこれた。だからわざわざ考えてこなかったのだ。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, am missing memories regarding my father and mother. Even so, I had been able to live without any problems. That was why I had never gone out of my way to think about it.

lines.content: 覚えているのはいつもこの家で、“ゆめのねどこ”で、暖かなご飯を毎日用意してくれていた“誰か”の微笑みだけだ。
lines.translated: All I remember is the smile of "someone" who always prepared warm meals for me every day in this house, at the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: でも、それは母親の記憶だった。
lines.translated: But that was a memory of a mother.

lines.content: 探し求める[・|父][・|親]のものでは、ない。
lines.translated: Not of the *father* I was searching for.

lines.content: ……いいや。
lines.translated: No.
It was a memory of *someone who seemed like a mother*.

lines.content: 本当にその微笑みが自分の[・|お][・|母][・|さ][・|ん]のものだったのかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know if that smile really belonged to my own *mom*.

lines.content: ……問題なのは、微笑みをくれる“誰か”が、俺にとって本物の母親かどうかというより、記憶のどこにも父親に関するものがないことだ。
lines.translated: The problem isn't so much whether the "someone" who gave me that smile was my real mother or not, as it is the fact that there is nothing regarding my father anywhere in my memories.

lines.content: むしろそのことに混乱と困惑を覚えるべきなのだと、ようやくわかる。
lines.translated: I finally realized that *that* was what I should actually be feeling confused and bewildered about.

lines.content: 俺は……
手のひらを、見る。
lines.translated: I looked at the palm of my hand.

lines.content: 端末を握りしめていないほうの手だ。そこに小さな文字で刻まれた答えを探すように、じっと見つめた。
lines.translated: The hand that wasn't gripping the terminal. I stared intently at it, as if searching for an answer carved there in tiny letters.

lines.content: 俺には父親の記憶がない。
lines.translated: I have no memories of my father.

lines.content: そのはずだ。
lines.translated: That's how it should be.

lines.content: ……そのはず、だったけれど。
lines.translated: That's how it should have been, and yet.

lines.content: 今、語り聞かせられている[・|話][・|の][・|中][・|で][・|聞][・|こ][・|え][・|た]“[・|歌]”には、聞き覚えがあった。
lines.translated: The *"song" I had heard within the story* being told to me right now sounded familiar.

lines.content: ……智仁
lines.translated: "...Tomohito."

lines.content: あいつが学園祭で作った“歌”だ。
lines.translated: It was the "song" he had made for the school festival.

lines.content: そして大勢の生徒たちの前で、ハルが――今はもう二度と会うことのできなくなった幼馴染みが、勇気を持って歌った“歌”でもあったのだ。
lines.translated: And it was also the "song" that Haru--my childhood friend whom I could never meet again--had bravely sung in front of a crowd of students.

lines.content: お話の中にいた俺は、その“歌”を作った人物を自分の父親と言い……。
lines.translated: The me inside the story had called the person who made that "song" his own father, and...

lines.content: そこで話は途切れてしまってる。
lines.translated: That was where the story had cut off.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: ……大雅？
lines.translated: "...Taiga?"

lines.content: ……あ、ああ。うん。ごめん
lines.translated: "...Ah, yeah. Mhm. Sorry."

lines.content: 見つめていた手のひらを、グッと、握る。
lines.translated: I clenched the palm I had been staring at tightly into a fist.

lines.content: ……聞いてる。ちゃんと聞いてるよ
lines.translated: "...I'm listening. I'm listening properly."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 質問
lines.translated: "Question."

lines.content: ……なに？
lines.translated: "...What is it?"

lines.content: どうして君が、俺とましろ――だったかな。その子と俺とが話している場にいなかったはずの君が、それらの話を、まるで見てきたみたいに語れるのかな……
lines.translated: "Why is it that you, who shouldn't have been there when I was talking with Mashiro--I think her name was--are able to tell those stories as if you'd seen them yourself...?"

lines.content: こんな細やかな質問を投げかけることで、混乱や困惑を沈めようと俺はしている。
lines.translated: By tossing out minor questions like this, I was trying to quell my confusion and bewilderment.

lines.content: 俺のそんな意図を察したわけではないのだろう。電話口の女の子は、明らかにどう答えていいか迷うような口調で短く応えた。
lines.translated: She probably hadn't sensed that intention of mine. The girl on the other end of the phone gave a short reply in a tone that clearly sounded unsure of how to answer.

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 先を聞けば、わかる？
lines.translated: "Will I understand if I listen to the rest?"

lines.content: がんばる
lines.translated: "I'll do my best."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……わかってもらえるようにって、がんばるよ
lines.translated: "...I'll do my best so that you can understand."

lines.content: 電話の向こうから微かな鈴の音を聞いた。
lines.translated: I heard the faint sound of a bell from the other side of the phone.

lines.content: それは、女の子が話して聞かせてくれるお話の合間に、よく耳にする音だった――[・|お][・|話][・|の][・|中][・|に][・|登][・|場][・|す][・|る][・|俺]の隣でも、よく耳にするものとも、同じであるように思えた。
lines.translated: It was a sound I often heard in the pauses of the story the girl was telling me--and it seemed to be the exact same one I often heard right beside *the me who appeared inside the story*.

lines.content: 疑問がまた増えたように思えたけれど……、
lines.translated: It felt like my questions had only multiplied again, but...

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき、微笑む。
lines.translated: I nodded and smiled.

lines.content: 君は口下手で、説明が苦手だから
lines.translated: "Because you're not very good with words, and bad at explaining things."

lines.content: ……恥ずかしがり屋でも、あるよ。すっごく
lines.translated: "...I'm also shy, too. Really shy."

lines.content: だから電話であっても、中々上手くは話せない。
lines.translated: "Which is why even over the phone, I can't talk very well."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ありがとうと、俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Thank you," I say.

lines.content: ……苦手なのに、とっても恥ずかしがり屋さんなのに、一生懸命話してくれて
lines.translated: "...For trying so hard to tell me, even though you're bad at it and really shy."

lines.content: ……ごめんね。続き、聞かせてもらえる？
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Could you tell me the rest?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ごそごそと、衣擦れのような音がした。ちりんと小さな鈴の音もする。
lines.translated: There was a rustling sound, like clothes brushing together. A tiny bell chimed, too.

lines.content: それからひとつ、ふたつ、深呼吸を繰り返すような気配がして……、
lines.translated: Then, I sensed her taking one, two deep breaths...

lines.content: ……こっちこそ、ごめん。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...No, I'm the one who should apologize. I'm sorry."

lines.content: がんばるよ。
lines.translated: I'll do my best.

lines.content: ……がんばる。
lines.translated: I'll do my best.

lines.content: あなたのことを、できるだけ傷つけないようにって……がんばって、話すよ
lines.translated: "I'll do my best to tell it... in a way that hurts you as little as possible."

lines.content: 私たちが最初に作った“夜”はこの時計塔のある巨大な駅だった
lines.translated: "The first 'Night' we made was this giant station with the clock tower."

lines.content: ましろは言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro said.

lines.content: 女の子はその駅を通って“過去”へと旅立った。
lines.translated: The girl had set off on a journey to the "past" through that station.

lines.content: 届いた“歌”が“過去”と“未来”とをたったひとつの線路で繋いだ。
lines.translated: The "song" that reached them had connected the "past" and the "future" with a single railway track.

lines.content: ひとりきりになったましろは、この小さな管理室で自分の“夢”について考えていたのだという。
lines.translated: Left all alone, Mashiro said she had been thinking about her own "dream" inside this small office.

lines.content: あの女の子は“過去”へと旅立ち、自分の“夢”を叶えただろうか。
lines.translated: Had that girl traveled to the "past" and fulfilled her "dream"?

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: 私には何か、あの女の子みたいに“夢”と呼べるものがあるだろうか。
lines.translated: Do I have anything I could call a "dream," like that girl did?

lines.content: もしもどんな願い事でも叶うとしたら……
lines.translated: "If any wish at all could come true..."

lines.content: “過去”から届いた“歌”に耳を傾け、つぶやいてみた。
lines.translated: Listening to the "song" that had reached her from the "past," she murmured to herself.

lines.content: 自分にも何か、この“歌”みたいに残せるものはあるだろうか。
lines.translated: Is there anything I can leave behind, too, like this "song"?

lines.content: 考えて。
lines.translated: She thought about it.

lines.content: 考えて。
lines.translated: She thought about it.

lines.content: 考えてみて……。
lines.translated: She tried thinking about it...

lines.content: まっしろになる前の自分もいつか、この町に生きていたような気がして……。
lines.translated: Feeling as though the version of herself before she became pure white had lived in this town at some point, too...

lines.content: だけど少し、考え疲れて。
lines.translated: But she grew a little tired from thinking.

lines.content: 小さな“夜”のその中で、うとうととしはじめていた頃に……。
lines.translated: Just as she was starting to doze off inside that small "Night"...

lines.content: 女の子が“過去”から戻ってきた。
lines.translated: The girl returned from the "past."

lines.content: その腕の中には赤ん坊がひとり、抱えられていたのだという。
lines.translated: And in her arms, she was holding a baby.

lines.content: ……ほら、見て。私の“夢”、叶えられたよ
lines.translated: "...Look, see? I fulfilled my 'dream.'"

lines.content: 微笑む女の子に、ましろは祝福と共に、ほんの少しのうらやましさも感じていた。
lines.translated: Toward the smiling girl, Mashiro felt both a sense of blessing and just a tiny bit of envy.

lines.content: 自分もいつか、こんなかわいい“夢”を叶えることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would she ever be able to fulfill such an adorable "dream" one day, too?

lines.content: そうだ。女の子の抱えていた赤ん坊はとてもかわいい男の子だった。
lines.translated: That's right. The baby the girl held in her arms was a very cute baby boy.

lines.content: 戻った“過去”で逢えた人。
lines.translated: The person she had been able to meet in the "past" she returned to.

lines.content: その人との間にできた子だ。
lines.translated: It was a child born between her and that person.

lines.content: なぜかその子を身ごもり、産まれるまでは、女の子は眠りに落ちても“未来”へ飛ぶことはなかったのだという。
lines.translated: For some reason, from the time she conceived the child until he was born, the girl said she never leaped into the "future" even when she fell asleep.

lines.content: 幸せな一年間だったと女の子は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: The girl smiled, saying it had been a happy year.

lines.content: 決して誰からも祝福されることのない恋だ。どころか、誰からも嫌悪され、許されるはずのない恋でもあった。
lines.translated: It was a love that would never be blessed by anyone. Far from it, it was a love despised by everyone, one that could never be forgiven.

lines.content: だからふたりの生活は、たくさんの厳しい人たちの目から、常に逃げ回るようなものではあったけど……。
lines.translated: So their life together was one of constantly running and hiding from the eyes of many harsh people, and yet...

lines.content: それでも確かに幸せだったよ
lines.translated: "Even so, I was truly happy."

lines.content: 女の子はそう言い、笑っていた。
lines.translated: The girl said that and laughed.

lines.content: その赤ん坊には何か特別な力があると感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that the baby had some kind of special power.

lines.content: だから女の子がこの子を産むまでは、“病”が働かず、女の子は大切な人の“隣”にいられたのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: Wasn't that why the "illness" hadn't acted up until she gave birth to this child, allowing the girl to stay "beside" the person precious to her?

lines.content: もしもそうなら産まれる前から母親想いというか、とっても親孝行な子だなあと私は思った。
lines.translated: If that was the case, I thought to myself what a caring, deeply devoted child he was to his mother even before being born.

lines.content: ……その子、どうするの？
lines.translated: "...What are you going to do with him?"

lines.content: 私は聞いた。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: もちろん育てるよ
lines.translated: "Raise him, of course."

lines.content: あの子は言った。
lines.translated: She said.

lines.content: ……この子のお父さんは、ずっとずっと遠い“過去”の時間の中にいる
lines.translated: "...This child's father is in a time far, far away in the 'past.'"

lines.content: だから、この子にはとてもさみしい思いをさせてしまうかもしれないけれど……
lines.translated: "So I might end up making him feel very lonely, though..."

lines.content: でもね、と言ってあの子は微笑む。
lines.translated: "But you know," she said, smiling.

lines.content: でも、この子には私とあなたがいるんだもん。きっと、大丈夫だよ。そう、だよね……？
lines.translated: "But he has me and you. I'm sure it'll be okay. Right...?"

lines.content: もちろんだよと私は答えた。
lines.translated: "Of course," I answered.

lines.content: 一緒にこの子を育てよう。この子にはふたりもお母さんがいる。だからさみしい思いだけは決してさせない――そんなふうにましろは、冗談半分に女の子に答えたのだという。
lines.translated: Let's raise this child together. He has two mothers. So we'll never let him feel lonely--Mashiro said she had answered the girl half-jokingly like that.

lines.content: それからましろはその赤ん坊の“隣”に、いつもいるようにと心がけた。
lines.translated: After that, Mashiro made a point of always staying "beside" the baby.

lines.content: ……“夜”の中で赤ん坊を育てるには色々と不便なことが多すぎた。
lines.translated: There were far too many inconveniences to raising a baby inside the "Night."

lines.content: だから女の子は、赤ん坊を抱えて、自分の[・|子][・|孫]たちの家を訪ねた――
lines.translated: "So the girl took the baby in her arms and visited the home of her *descendants*--"

lines.content: 彼女は過去の人物で、それも“夜の国”を作る者として、一族の中では有名だったからね。すぐに受け入れられた
lines.translated: "Because she was a figure from the past, and famous within the clan as one who created the 'Night Country,' she was accepted right away."

lines.content: 私もこっそりふたりの“隣”について行った。
lines.translated: I secretly followed along "beside" the two of them, too.

lines.content: 私の姿は“半透明”――“夜”を出ると、女の子にも私のことは見えないみたいだった。
lines.translated: My form was "translucent"--once we left the "Night," it seemed even the girl couldn't see me.

lines.content: だけど、不思議だった。赤ん坊だけにはましろが見えていたみたいだ。
lines.translated: However, it was strange. It seemed that only the baby could see Mashiro.

lines.content: ……いつもそばで見ていた私に、かわいい笑顔を見せてくれていた。とっても、とってもね。うれしかったのを今でも忘れず覚えているよ
lines.translated: "...He used to show such a cute smile to me, as I was always watching over him from nearby. Really, really cute. Even now, I haven't forgotten how happy that made me."

lines.content: 赤ん坊は奏大雅と名付けられた。
lines.translated: The baby was named Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 遠い“過去”から、たくさんの人たちの心に奏でられ、まるで途絶えることのない[川|大河]の流れのように“未来”へ届けられたあの“歌”みたいに――
lines.translated: Just like that "song" played in the hearts of so many people from the distant "past," delivered to the "future" like the flow of a never-ending great river--

lines.content: いっぱい、いっぱいのすてきな“想い”に彩られるような人生でありますように。
lines.translated: May his life be colored by lots and lots of wonderful "feelings."

lines.content: 母親のそういう祈りが込められている。
lines.translated: Such a prayer from his mother was put into it.

lines.content: 奏という名字は[・|偶][・|然]だ。
lines.translated: The surname Kanade was a *coincidence*.

lines.content: 訪ねた一族の分家がそういう名字だったのだ。
lines.translated: That happened to be the surname of the branch family of the clan she visited.

lines.content: その女の子が産まれた家は、既に途絶えてしまっていて――……小さな偶然が重なって赤ん坊に付けられた名だからこそ、そこにはまた深く意味が重なっているようにも思えたのだ。
lines.translated: The house the girl had been born into had already died out--...and precisely because it was a name given to the baby through a series of small coincidences, it felt as though a deep meaning was layered into it as well.

lines.content: 赤ん坊の名前には、そういう[母親|女の子]の願いが込められていたはずだった。
lines.translated: Such a wish from the girl--his mother--was supposed to have been put into the baby's name.

lines.content: でも、私は不安だった
lines.translated: "But I was uneasy."

lines.content: この子は幸せに生きていけるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would this child be able to live happily?
"*I worried about the future of this child, who spent so much time all alone.*"

lines.content: 女の子は“過去”へはもう戻れなくなってしまっていた。
lines.translated: The girl was no longer able to return to the "past."

lines.content: 産み落とした小さくかわいいこの命に、“過去”から受け取った“歌の[力|想い]”のようなものをすべて注いでしまったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps she had poured everything like the "feelings--the power of the song" she received from the "past" into this small, cute life she had given birth to.

lines.content: しかしそれで“病”が治ったわけでもなかった。
lines.translated: However, that didn't mean her "illness" was cured, either.

lines.content: 赤ん坊が大きくなっていくにつれ、未来へ飛ぶ頻度もまた多くなり、そしてその[・|距][・|離]もまた、長くなっていった。
lines.translated: As the baby grew bigger, the frequency with which she leaped into the future increased again, and the *distance* grew longer as well.

lines.content: 女の子は――母親は、時どきしか赤ん坊を抱っこできない。
lines.translated: The girl--his mother--could only hold the baby once in a while.

lines.content: 父親は遠いとおい“過去”の世界に生きている。
lines.translated: His father was living in the world of the distant, faraway "past."

lines.content: 赤ん坊はひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: The baby was all alone.

lines.content: 母親が未来に跳んだ後、静かに時間を重ねれば、赤ん坊と私は、母親の跳んでしまった先の時間にいつか追いつく。
lines.translated: After his mother leaped into the future, if we quietly let time pass, the baby and I would eventually catch up to the time ahead where his mother had leaped.

lines.content: ……だけどこの調子だと、母親はすぐにでも赤ん坊のいる“[ここ|現在]”にいられなくなってしまうだろう。
lines.translated: But at this rate, his mother would soon be unable to stay in the "present"--"here" where the baby was--at all.

lines.content: いつか赤ん坊の追いつけないずっとずっと先の未来にまで、母親は跳んでしまうだろう。だからひとりだ。赤ん坊は、ひとりぼっち……[・|私][・|と][・|一][・|緒]だ。
lines.translated: Someday, his mother would leap into a future far, far ahead where the baby could never catch up. That's why he was alone. The baby was all alone... *just like me*.

lines.content: 赤ん坊は、母親を探し求めるように夜泣きすることが多くなった。
lines.translated: The baby began crying at night more often, as if searching for his mother.

lines.content: 誰かに抱っこされれば落ち着くようだけれど……。
lines.translated: He seemed to calm down if someone held him, though...

lines.content: この家の誰も、赤ん坊には見向きもしなかった。
lines.translated: No one in this house even spared the baby a glance.

lines.content: 芸術家を謳う誰もがみんな、自分の頭の中にある[想像力|世界]を形にすることにしか興味がない連中ばっかりだ。
lines.translated: Every last one of them claiming to be an artist was only interested in giving form to the world--the imagination--inside their own heads.
*Because they seriously believed that doing so would save the future.*

lines.content: 赤ん坊の機嫌やさみしさになんて、気づくことさえないのだろう。
lines.translated: They probably didn't even notice the baby's mood or loneliness.

lines.content: 私が、かわいいあなたを抱っこできたらよかったのに
lines.translated: "I wished I could hold you, cute little you."

lines.content: そうすればあなたのさみしさも、私のさみしさも、半分くらいにはなるかもしれない。だけど私は、“半透明”だから……
lines.translated: "If I could, maybe both your loneliness and my loneliness would be cut in half. But because I'm 'translucent'..."

lines.content: ごめんね。命あるあなた達には触れられないの。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. I can't touch those of you who have life.

lines.content: 次に“未来”へと飛んでしまった女の子との[・|時][・|間][・|が][・|追][・|い][・|つ][・|き]、会えたとき、私はひとつ提案してみた。
lines.translated: The next time *time caught up* with the girl who had leaped into the "future" and we were able to meet, I made a suggestion.

lines.content: ……“夜”を作ることはもう止めにしようよ
lines.translated: "...Let's stop making the 'Night' already."

lines.content: “夜”の空を満開に彩る大きなおおきなさくらの樹。あの樹が、私にそういうふうに[・|語][・|り][・|か][・|け][・|て][・|く][・|る][・|よ][・|う][・|に][・|も]思えたからだ。
lines.translated: The huge, massive cherry blossom tree coloring the sky of the "Night" in full bloom. It was because I felt *as though that tree were speaking* to me that way, too.

lines.content: あなたとこうして会えたとき、そのときはまたふたりでこうして語り合って、“夜”のディテールの細部を“想像”し続けてるけど……
lines.translated: "Whenever I'm able to meet you like this, the two of us talk together again and keep 'imagining' the fine details of the 'Night,' but..."

lines.content: 私は“夜”という存在が、あなたの“病”を作っているのではないかと感じてる――[・|こ][・|れ]は、ただの予感でしかない。
lines.translated: I feel that the existence of the "Night" might be what's causing your "illness"--*this* is nothing more than a hunch.

lines.content: どうしてもそう思えて仕方がなかったから、
lines.translated: Because I just couldn't help feeling that way,

lines.content: ……お願い。赤ちゃんのためにも、もう止めよう
lines.translated: "...Please. For the baby's sake, too, let's stop already."

lines.content: すがりつくようにしてましろは懇願したのだという。
lines.translated: Mashiro said she had pleaded with her, almost clinging to her.

lines.content: ……そのときましろが抱いた予感のようなものは半分程度、的を射ていたことを後に知るのだという。いや。ここでは思い出したというほうが的確かも知れない。
lines.translated: She said she would later learn that the hunch Mashiro had held back then was about half right. No. Here, it might be more accurate to say she remembered it.

lines.content: とにかく、だ。
lines.translated: In any case.

lines.content: 確かに赤ん坊の母親の“病”は、ふたりがこうして創り上げている“夜”にこそ原因があった。
lines.translated: It was true that the cause of the baby's mother's "illness" lay in the very "Night" the two of them were creating like this.

lines.content: だけどましろや赤ん坊の母親が“夜の国”を創ろうと創らなかろうと、ふたりにはどうすることもできないところに、根本的な原因は根ざしているのだった。
lines.translated: However, whether Mashiro and the baby's mother created the "Land of Night" or not, the fundamental cause was rooted in something neither of them could do anything about.

lines.content: それを知ってか知らずか――それとも無意識の部分で感覚的に察していたのだろうか、
lines.translated: Whether she knew that or not--or perhaps she sensed it intuitively in some unconscious part of herself--

lines.content: それはできない
lines.translated: "I can't do that."

lines.content: と、女の子は言ったのだ。
lines.translated: That was what the girl said.

lines.content: どうして……
……私たちがこうして“夜”を創ることは、私が、大切な人に逢いに行くためのものだった
lines.translated: "...Our creating the 'Night' like this was so that I could go meet someone precious to me."

lines.content: そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そういう“夢”はとてもすてきだと思った。
lines.translated: I thought a "dream" like that was very wonderful.

lines.content: だから一緒に“夢”を叶えたんだと私は感じてる――そうだよ。もう“夢”を叶えたのだから、これ以上、この場所を大きく想像していく必要はない。
lines.translated: That's why I feel like we made that "dream" come true together--that's right. Since the "dream" has already come true, there's no need to keep imagining this place any bigger than this.

lines.content: そういう理屈も持ち出して、ましろはこれ以上この場所を想像することは止めようと、改めて主張した。
lines.translated: Bringing up that logic as well, Mashiro insisted once again that they stop imagining this place any further.

lines.content: でも、女の子は首を振る。
lines.translated: But the girl shook her head.

lines.content: どんな理由があったとしても、ここを創ることは最初、意地悪な大人たちの思惑どおりみたいで、すごく悩んだけれど……。でも結局は、[・|そ][・|の][・|道]を私は選んだ
lines.translated: "Whatever the reason, creating this place at first seemed to play right into the hands of those mean adults, so I agonized over it a lot... But in the end, I chose *that path*."

lines.content: ……確かにあなたの言うとおり。もう“夢”は叶ったのだから、これ以上、ここを大きくする理由はないはずだよね
lines.translated: "...It's certainly just as you say. Since the 'dream' has already come true, there shouldn't be any reason to make this place any bigger, right?"

lines.content: だけど、と女の子は言った。
lines.translated: However, the girl said.

lines.content: だけど今は、あのときとはもう違う
lines.translated: "However, things are different now than they were back then."

lines.content: ほんの少しの困惑もなく、自ら進んで“夜”を創りたいと願ってる――[・|全][・|部][・|こ][・|の][・|子][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|だ][・|か][・|ら]。
lines.translated: Without even the slightest bit of hesitation, she wished to keep creating the "Night" of her own accord--*because it's all for this child's sake*.

lines.content: そう語る女の子の瞳に、鋭い“何か”を見た気がした。
lines.translated: In the eyes of the girl speaking like that, I felt I saw a sharp "something."

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。
lines.translated: What's going on with her?
*It wasn't like her at all*.

lines.content: 女の子は一度、“未来へ飛ぶ病”のせいで、遠い“未来”の世界を見てきている。まだ“過去”へと戻ることができた頃だった。
lines.translated: Because of her "illness that leaps into the future," the girl had once seen the world of the distant "future." It was back when she was still able to return to the "past."

lines.content: 月の影響で心を失いかけている大人たち。
lines.translated: Adults who were losing their hearts under the influence of the moon.

lines.content: そんな大人たちの手によって、とても酷い状況に押し込められている子ども達。
lines.translated: Children who were being forced into terrible situations by the hands of those adults.
*What she had seen was a story even further ahead than that*.

lines.content: 遠い“未来”。……でも、それほど遠いとおい先とも言えない“未来”の世界。人類は危機的な状況に陥るも、滅亡することだけは免れた
lines.translated: "The distant 'future.' ...Though it's a world of the 'future' that can't really be called all that far, far away. Even though humanity fell into a critical situation, they managed to escape extinction."

lines.content: ……なぜなら、一部の者たちがこの[ほし|惑星]を捨てたから
lines.translated: "...Because some of them abandoned this planet."

lines.content: 月は確かに落ちては来ない。未来永劫。そんなのはただの“噂”だった
lines.translated: "The moon certainly won't fall. Not for all eternity. That was just a 'rumor.'"

lines.content: だけど、この星はいつか焼け野原になる。きらめく月の光に、心をまっしろに塗りつぶされてしまった大人たちの手によって
lines.translated: "However, this planet will someday become a burned-out wasteland. By the hands of adults whose hearts have been painted pure white by the glittering light of the moon."

lines.content: そんな“未来”を私は見てきたと、女の子は言う。
lines.translated: That was the "future" I saw, the girl said.

lines.content: 一部のお金持ちや偉い人。何らかの理由でえこひいきされる誰かたち――……そして
lines.translated: "A handful of rich and important people. Certain others who were favored for one reason or another--...and..."

lines.content: そして、ね。光り輝くような“才能”を産まれ持った者たちは、危険地帯となってしまったこの星を捨て、旅立ってしまった
lines.translated: "And, you see. Those born with shining 'talent' abandoned this planet, which had become a danger zone, and set off on a journey."

lines.content: 宇宙の果てのその果てに、この星と同じような環境の惑星を見つけ、彼らはその星を第二の地球とするため旅立った。
lines.translated: Having found a planet with an environment similar to this one at the farthest reaches of the universe, they set off to make that star a second Earth.

lines.content: 人類の文化や歴史を保存、発展させられると選別された者たちだけが、その船に乗ることを許された。
lines.translated: Only those selected as being capable of preserving and developing human culture and history were permitted to board that ship.

lines.content: 地球上のあらゆるイキモノも、つがいが一組ずつ選ばれた。
lines.translated: Of every living creature on Earth, one breeding pair each was chosen as well.

lines.content: とある神話の名前がそのまま名付けられた巨大な船は、しかし、全人類をまるごと受け入れられるだけのものではない。当然、行ったっきり戻ってくるつもりもなかった。
lines.translated: However, the gigantic ship, named directly after a certain myth, was not large enough to take in the entirety of humanity. Naturally, once it left, it had no intention of ever returning.

lines.content: 置き去りにされたのは保存する価値のない弱い[情報|人間]だ。
lines.translated: Left behind were weak humans not worth preserving as information.

lines.content: 何も成し遂げない。何も思想的な光りを見いだそうとしない。何も、大きな利益を生み出さない。
lines.translated: Those who accomplish nothing. Those who do not seek to find any ideological light. Those who produce no great profit.

lines.content: ……何も特別な“才能”を持たない、平凡な人たちだ。
lines.translated: Ordinary people who possess no special "talent" whatsoever.

lines.content: 船は、そういった人類の多くを切り捨てた
lines.translated: "The ship cast aside the majority of such humanity."

lines.content: その中にはもちろん、何の罪もない少年少女も多く含まれる。
lines.translated: Included among them, of course, were many innocent boys and girls.
*The adults of this town living in the* "*past*" learned of such a "future" through some trigger or another--and they wished. *We want to save them*, they thought.

lines.content: 過去の大人たちが、多大なる犠牲を払ってでも“夜の国”を維持させたいと祈った理由は、大きくわけてふたつある――
lines.translated: "There are broadly two reasons why the adults of the past prayed to maintain the 'Land of Night' even at the cost of great sacrifice--"

lines.content: まず、ひとつ。
lines.translated: First, one.

lines.content: 月の光によって心をなくした自分たちが、愛しくかわいい子ども達を――人生の宝物を、この手で自ら壊してしまう。そんな“未来”はまっぴらだ
lines.translated: "Having lost our hearts to the light of the moon, we end up destroying our beloved, cute children--the treasures of our lives--with our very own hands. We want no part of a 'future' like that."

lines.content: ……だから現在の子ども達の命を持ってして、“夜”を未来へ維持させていこうと考えた――
lines.translated: "...So they thought to maintain the 'Night' into the future using the lives of the children of the present--"

lines.content: ええ、そうだよ。大人たちはもう既に心を狂わせてしまってる。そういう“[・|呪][・|い]”に掛かってる
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. The adults have already driven their own hearts mad. They're under that kind of '*curse*.'"

lines.content: 心をすでに[・|壊][・|さ][・|れ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|た]大人たちは、自身の抱いた夢に内包された矛盾に気づけない。そういう[・|呪][・|い]に掛かっているのだ。
lines.translated: The adults whose hearts *had already been broken* could not notice the contradiction inherent in the dream they embraced. They were under that kind of *curse*.

lines.content: そして、ふたつめだ。
lines.translated: And second.

lines.content: 自分たちの子孫には、才能の有無に限らず、うつくしいこの[ほし|惑星]で幸せに暮らしていってほしかった
lines.translated: "They wanted their descendants, regardless of whether they had talent or not, to live happily on this beautiful planet."

lines.content: 大人たちが懸命に、自らの心の切れ端みたいな芸術作品を[こぞ|挙]って残すのは、子ども達の生きていくこの世界を楽しく、明るく、鮮やかに彩りたいという動機だけでなく……。
lines.translated: The reason the adults worked so hard, one and all, to leave behind works of art like fragments of their own hearts was not only out of a motive to color this world where the children would live joyfully, brightly, and vividly...

lines.content: 未来の大人たちに警鐘を届けるためのものでもあった。
lines.translated: It was also to deliver a warning bell to the adults of the future.

lines.content: 心を作品として保存するのだ。
lines.translated: To preserve their hearts as works of art.

lines.content: それに触れた未来の大人たちが、やさしい心を取り戻してほしかった――愛する者をこれ以上傷つけてはほしくなかったのだ。
lines.translated: They wanted the adults of the future who touched them to regain their gentle hearts--they didn't want them to hurt the ones they loved any further.

lines.content: 今の自分たちはどうしても、どうしても、残酷にならざるを得ない“[・|呪][・|い]”に捕らわれてしまってる。
lines.translated: Right now, they themselves were inevitably, undeniably trapped by a "*curse*" that forced them to be cruel.

lines.content: だから、ほんの僅かに残ってる[・|正][・|常][・|な][・|心]で祈ってた。
lines.translated: That was why they prayed with the tiny shred of a *normal heart* they had left.

lines.content: 未来の大人たち――つまりは今現在の子ども達へ、自分と同じようにはならないでほしい――“絵”も、“物語”も、そして“歌”も、そういった“想い”のこもった“手紙”でもあったのだ。
lines.translated: To the adults of the future--in other words, the children of the present--please do not become like us--the "paintings," the "stories," and the "songs" were also "letters" filled with such "feelings."

lines.content: あの“[・|歌]”もまた、そういうふうにして“過去”から“未来”へ想いを繋いだ。
lines.translated: That "*song*," too, connected feelings from the "past" to the "future" in that way.

lines.content: それらをまるごと全部叶えるためには“夜の国”が必要だった。
lines.translated: In order to make all of those things come true in their entirety, the "Land of Night" was necessary.

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|の][・|場][・|所]がありさえすれば、たくさん、たくさんの人たちが救われる。ほんの少しの犠牲はあるだろうけれど……。未来の子ども達も。この[ほし|惑星]に取り残された人たちも
lines.translated: "...As long as *this place* exists, so, so many people will be saved. Though there will probably be a few sacrifices... Both the children of the future. And the people left behind on this planet."

lines.content: 皆みんな救済することが可能なはずだと、女の子は力強く言い切った。
lines.translated: It should be possible to bring salvation to each and every one of them, the girl declared forcefully.

lines.content: “夜の国”で、未来の子ども達や、取り残されてしまった人たちを助けたい……。でも、どうやって？
lines.translated: "You want to save the children of the future and the people who were left behind in the 'Land of Night'... But how?"

lines.content: “死”ぬことだよ
lines.translated: "By 'dying.'"

lines.content: 女の子は言った。
lines.translated: The girl said.

lines.content: 取り残された人たちはその殆ど全員が凄惨な死を遂げる。何の価値もない命だと、見向きもされないまま。多くの子ども達も同じだよ
lines.translated: "Almost all of the people left behind will meet a gruesome death. Without anyone even sparing them a glance, treated as lives of no value whatsoever. It's the same for many of the children, too."

lines.content: でも、死んだ人間はまた“次”の世界で生まれ直す――“夜”と言う名の“死後の世界”に。そういうふうに、この世界の時間を私が創る――私が、新しく“想像”する
lines.translated: "But people who die will be reborn again in the 'next' world--in an 'afterlife' called the 'Night.' That's how I will create the time of this world--how I will newly 'imagine' it."

lines.content: 私たちが[・|こ][・|こ]で“夜の国”を造るまで、人の命は死ねばそれまでだった。よく言う天国だとか、地獄だとか。そういう死後の世界と呼ばれるものは存在しなかった
lines.translated: "Until we built the 'Land of Night' *here*, a person's life ended when they died. What people often call heaven, or hell. Things called an afterlife like that didn't exist."

lines.content: だけどこれから[・|こ][・|こ]はそういう世界に生まれ変わる
lines.translated: "However, from now on, *this place* will be reborn into that kind of world."

lines.content: 遠い星に旅立っていった人たちにも負けないくらい、面白おかしく暮らしていける“死後の世界”……魂の安息の時間
lines.translated: "An 'afterlife' where they can live just as merrily and joyfully as the people who set off for a distant star... A time of rest for the soul."

lines.content: 私はそれを創りたい。この子のために。……この子がこれから、何の不安も心配もなく、幸せに生きていける世界に私がするの。私の愛したあの人のためにも
lines.translated: "I want to create that. For this child's sake. ...I will make it a world where this child can live happily from now on, without any uneasiness or worry. And for the sake of that person I loved, too."

lines.content: “さよなら”しても“死後の世界”でまた逢える。
lines.translated: Even if you say "goodbye," you can meet again in the "afterlife."

lines.content: それをわかっていれば、もう“死”ぬことは決して怖いことではないはずだ――この人生が、たとえつらくて悲しいことばかりでも。
lines.translated: If you know that, "dying" shouldn't be something scary at all anymore--even if this life is filled with nothing but painful and sad things.

lines.content: 多くの命がこの“夜”に産まれ直して、第二の人生を大切な人たちともう一度、暮らす。望むのならば永遠に
lines.translated: "Many lives will be reborn into this 'Night,' and live a second life once more with the people precious to them. Forever, if they so wish."

lines.content: それってとっても幸福な光景じゃないかなと女の子は、笑った。
lines.translated: Wouldn't that be a very happy sight? the girl said with a smile.

lines.content: そうかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe it did.

lines.content: “さよなら”はきっと、この世界の中にある悲しいことの上位に位置するはずだと思う。悲しいことはなくなってしまえばいい。ひとつでも多く。私だってそう感じるよ。
lines.translated: "Goodbye" must surely rank high among the sad things in this world. It would be best if sad things disappeared. As many of them as possible. Even I feel that way.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: それで本当に誰もが幸せになれるのかな。
lines.translated: Could everyone really become happy with that?

lines.content: たとえば。
lines.translated: For instance...

lines.content: 大勢の死者たちが“夜の国”で暮らすようになったとして――元々“夜”に暮らしてた“イキモノ”たちは、どうなるの？
lines.translated: "Suppose a great many of the dead come to live in the 'Land of Night'--what will happen to the 'creatures' who originally lived in the 'Night'?"

lines.content: 彼女が“過去”に残してきた大切な人。その人にとって幸せな世界でありますように――“夜”はそう願われ、作られた。
lines.translated: The precious person she had left behind in the "past." May it be a happy world for that person--the "Night" was wished for and made that way.

lines.content: だからそこには、人間たちのことを無条件に愛してしまう“イキモノ”が想像され、生きている。
lines.translated: That is why "creatures" who unconditionally love humans were imagined and live there.

lines.content: ……“夜のイキモノ”と“夜の外の生き物”が平和に暮らしていけるなんて。
lines.translated: For the "Creatures of the Night" and the "creatures from outside the Night" to live together in peace.

lines.content: そんな光景は、私にはとても想像できなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't possibly imagine a sight like that.

lines.content: いつか“夜”の中でも争いが起こるのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: Wouldn't conflict break out within the "Night" someday?

lines.content: そうなれば、“夜のイキモノ”たちは……、人間を無条件に深く愛してしまうものたちは、自らを犠牲にしてでもこの場所を、進んで人間たちに明け渡してしまうだろう。
lines.translated: If that happened, the "Creatures of the Night"... those who unconditionally and deeply love humans, would willingly surrender this place to the humans, even at the cost of sacrificing themselves.

lines.content: そうなれば彼らは行き場をなくし、消滅するほか道はないだろう。
lines.translated: If that happened, they would lose their place to belong, and have no other path than to vanish.

lines.content: ……自分たちが永遠に生き延びるため、彼らの居場所を奪うのだ。まるで、新大陸を発見しそこに暮らしていた原住民を追い出すようにして。
lines.translated: In order for the humans to survive forever, they would steal their place to belong. Just like discovering a new continent and driving out the natives who lived there.

lines.content: ……だめだよ
lines.translated: "...You mustn't."

lines.content: ましろは、言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro spoke.

lines.content: そんなこと、意味がない……とまでは言わないよ
lines.translated: "I won't go so far as to say... that doing such a thing is meaningless."

lines.content: 持つ者ばかりが――偉い人や有能な人、お金をたくさん持っている人たちだけが救われて――幸福になれて。持たざる者たちは永遠に、最期の時まで、不幸なままだなんて。
lines.translated: For only the haves--only the important people, the capable people, the people with lots of money--to be saved and become happy. While the have-nots remain unhappy forever, until the very end.

lines.content: そんな世界はあってはならないことだって、わかるよ
lines.translated: "I understand that a world like that shouldn't exist."

lines.content: 持つ者はますます富み、持たざる者はますます窮する――そんな言葉がたとえ真実であっても、決して真実であってはならないものだとそう思う。
lines.translated: The haves grow ever richer, and the have-nots grow ever poorer--even if such words are the truth, I believe they must never be allowed to be the truth.

lines.content: だからあなたの動機ならば、理解はできる。
lines.translated: So if it's your motive, I can understand it.

lines.content: 命のない私にも、それくらいは、わかるよ。でも……
lines.translated: "Even someone without a life like me can understand that much. But..."

lines.content: でもね。
lines.translated: But, you know.

lines.content: 多くの命を救う代わりに。またたくさんの[・|子][・|ど][・|も][・|達]を犠牲にしなきゃならないのなら……
lines.translated: "In exchange for saving many lives. If you have to sacrifice a lot of *children* again..."

lines.content: やさしい心の持ち主である“夜のイキモノ”たちの居場所を、奪うことにも繋がってしまうのなら……。
lines.translated: If it also leads to stealing the place to belong from the "Creatures of the Night," who possess such gentle hearts...

lines.content: それはもう、正しいことじゃ、ないよ
lines.translated: "Then that's no longer the right thing to do."

lines.content: “命とは夢”である。
lines.translated: "Life is a dream."

lines.content: ここは“終わってしまった命の世界”――“死者たちの暮らす国”
lines.translated: This is "the world of lives that have ended"--"the land where the dead live."

lines.content: ここでなら、どんな“願い”でも必ず叶う。思い描くだけですべて現実となる。
lines.translated: Here, any "wish" will surely come true. Just by picturing it in your mind, everything becomes reality.

lines.content: そういった世界を必要とされる“未来”まで、何とか維持させるためには、たくさんの子ども達の命が必要だった――[・|な][・|ぜ][・|な][・|ら]。
lines.translated: In order to somehow maintain such a world until the "future" where it is needed, the lives of many children were necessary--*because*.

lines.content: 町の中心に立つさくらの樹を見上げる。
lines.translated: I look up at the cherry blossom tree standing in the center of the town.

lines.content: “夜”はこのさくらの花が満開であるときこそ、その機能性のようなものを発揮するのだから。
lines.translated: Because it is precisely when these cherry blossoms are in full bloom that the "Night" exhibits something like its functionality.

lines.content: どうしよう……
lines.translated: "What should I do..."

lines.content: ましろは震えた。
lines.translated: Mashiro trembled.

lines.content: もう、私にはどうしようもできない。私では、あの女の子の“想像力”を止められない。
lines.translated: There is nothing more I can do. On my own, I cannot stop that girl's "imagination."

lines.content: あのさくらの樹の下には、大勢の子ども達が眠ってる。その子たちの“想像力”を大いに借りて、“夜”は維持されていく。
lines.translated: Beneath that cherry blossom tree, a great many children are sleeping. Borrowing heavily from their "imagination," the "Night" is maintained.

lines.content: そのためには、眠る子ども達に命を捧げ続けなければならなかった。そうでなければさくらの花は満開にならない。
lines.translated: For that purpose, lives had to be continually offered to the sleeping children. Otherwise, the cherry blossoms would not come into full bloom.

lines.content: そういった事情をも、[・|何][・|か][・|し][・|ら][・|の][・|き][・|っ][・|か][・|け][・|で]、この町に住んでいた“過去の大人たち”は知ったのだ。
lines.translated: Through *some kind of catalyst*, the "adults of the past" who lived in this town came to know of those circumstances as well.

lines.content: “未来”の世界を救うため、たくさんの少女たちの命を閉じ込め、さくらの樹へ生け贄とした――なんの才能も持たない平凡な女の子たちを犠牲にし続けた。
lines.translated: In order to save the world of the "future," they locked away the lives of many young girls and offered them as sacrifices to the cherry blossom tree--continually sacrificing ordinary girls who possessed no talent whatsoever.

lines.content: おかしい。気づかないのだろうか。
lines.translated: It's strange. Do they not realize it?

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]“夜”を維持する方法は、あなた達が嫌った“未来の大人たち”が選択した方法と殆ど変わらない。
lines.translated: Maintaining the "Night" *in that way* is almost no different from the method chosen by the "adults of the future" whom you all despised.

lines.content: トロッコ問題みたいなものだよ
lines.translated: "It's like the trolley problem."

lines.content: 女の子は言う。あんまりにも有名すぎる議題であるため口にするのも恥ずかしいというように。
lines.translated: The girl says, as if it were such an overly famous topic that she was embarrassed to even say it out loud.

lines.content: 暴走するトロッコが走る線路はふたつに分かれていて、片方にはたくさんの乗客を乗せた列車が停車している。もう片方には数人の作業員たちがいる
lines.translated: "The track a runaway trolley is running down splits into two. On one side, a train carrying many passengers is parked. On the other side, there are a few workers."

lines.content: どちらもトロッコの存在に気づかない。
lines.translated: Neither side notices the trolley's presence.

lines.content: 自分だ。自分の手の中にだけ、トロッコの進行方向を決めることのできるスイッチがある――さあ、あなたはどちらを選択する？
lines.translated: It's up to you. Only within your hand lies the switch that can decide the trolley's direction--now then, which will you choose?

lines.content: 大勢を助けるのか。数人を犠牲にするのか。
lines.translated: Will you save the many? Or will you sacrifice the few?

lines.content: どちらを選んだところで罪悪感は消えずに残る。深く、ふかく、心を蝕む。
lines.translated: Whichever you choose, the sense of guilt will remain without vanishing. Deeply, so deeply, eating away at your heart.

lines.content: 私なら、大勢を助けるための選択をする。迷うことなく。いっぱいの罪悪感も抱えて生きていく覚悟がある
lines.translated: "If it were me, I would make the choice to save the many. Without hesitation. I am prepared to live on carrying all that guilt."

lines.content: これはそれだけの問題なんだよ。そして、それだけの問題に関われるスイッチが、私の手の中にある――ううん。この心の中には、あるの
lines.translated: "This is a problem no more complicated than that. And the switch to get involved in a problem like that is right here in my hand--no, it's inside this heart of mine."

lines.content: 犠牲にした数人の中に、あなたの“大切な人”がいたら、それでも選択は変わらないの？　そんな意地悪な問いかけは、ましろにはできなかった。
lines.translated: If your "precious person" were among the few being sacrificed, would your choice still not change? Mashiro could not bring herself to ask such a cruel question.

lines.content: 気づいていたのだ。
lines.translated: Because she had noticed.

lines.content: “過去”から帰ってきてから、女の子は少しずつ、どこか瞳の奥に、それまで見たことのない鋭い光りのようなものを見せるようになっていた。
lines.translated: Ever since returning from the "past," little by little, deep within her eyes, the girl had begun to show something like a sharp light she had never seen before.

lines.content: ……彼女が産まれたのは芸術家の一族、さくらに命を捧げられた少女らの末裔である。
lines.translated: She was born into a family of artists, the descendants of the girls whose lives were offered to the cherry blossoms.

lines.content: あまりに高い“想像力”を持つがため、一族に産まれた者たちは、深く自身の“想像”に浸り――時おり心を病んでしまう。そういう“呪い”を宿命づけられている。
lines.translated: Because they possess far too high an "imagination," those born into the clan immerse themselves deeply in their own "imagination"--and at times, their minds fall ill. They are fated to bear such a "curse."

lines.content: “過去”から戻ってきた女の子は、もう大人になりはじめているのだ。ましろにはそう見えた。
lines.translated: The girl who returned from the "past" was already beginning to become an adult. That was how it looked to Mashiro.

lines.content: ましろはさくらの樹を見上げた。
lines.translated: Mashiro looked up at the cherry blossom tree.

lines.content: “夜”の中でも“夜”の外でも変わらずそこに咲き続ける大樹である。
lines.translated: A great tree that continues to bloom there unchangingly, both inside the "Night" and outside the "Night."

lines.content: あの樹の下には特別な少女たちが眠ってる。
lines.translated: Beneath that tree, special girls are sleeping.

lines.content: 芸術家の一族に時おり特別な“[病|才能]”を持って生まれる子たちがいる。その子たちは、さくらの樹で眠る少女たちの血を引く子孫だ。
lines.translated: In the family of artists, children are occasionally born with a special "talent." Those children are the descendants who carry the blood of the girls sleeping in the cherry blossom tree.
It feels as though *the me from when I was alive* was among them, too...

lines.content: だから“大勢を犠牲にできない”“少数の命も救う方法があるはずだ”――そんなふうに思ってしまう私の心も、どこか、自分が気づかない間に歪んでしまっているのだろうか。
lines.translated: So is my heart, which ends up thinking things like "we cannot sacrifice the many" and "there must be a way to save the lives of the few as well," also becoming twisted somewhere without my realizing it?

lines.content: ううん。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……違うよ
lines.translated: "...That's wrong."

lines.content: ましろは、言った――もうすでに“夜”は女の子が望むとおりの、そして“過去の大人たち”が期待したとおりの姿にまで、完成してしまいそうだった。
lines.translated: Mashiro spoke--already, the "Night" was on the verge of being completed into the exact form the girl desired, and the exact form the "adults of the past" had hoped for.

lines.content: ……こんなのは、間違ってるよ
lines.translated: "...Something like this is wrong."

lines.content: そう信じたい。
lines.translated: I want to believe that.

lines.content: でも、だからといってもっとも正しい答えも用意できない。そんな私だから……。
lines.translated: Even so, that doesn't mean I can prepare the most correct answer either. Because that's how I am...

lines.content: そんな、私のままだからこそ……。
lines.translated: Precisely because I remain the way I am...

lines.content: だから、ごめんね。もう私は手伝わない。あなたと“夜”を作ることはもう止める。だから……
lines.translated: "So, I'm sorry. I won't help you anymore. I'm going to stop making the 'Night' with you. So..."

lines.content: だから一緒に別の方法を考えよう。そう言いたかった。
lines.translated: So let's think of another way together. That was what she wanted to say.

lines.content: “過去”を犠牲にせず“未来”を救う。そのための方法が“[いま|現在]”のどこかにきっとあるはずだ。そう伝えようと、思った。
lines.translated: Saving the "future" without sacrificing the "past." There must surely be a way to do that somewhere in the "present." She thought to convey that to her.

lines.content: ……ああ、そう
lines.translated: "...Oh, is that so."

lines.content: けれど女の子は目を細め、ましろを見据えた。
lines.translated: However, the girl narrowed her eyes and stared fixedly at Mashiro.

lines.content: あなたとはここまでね
lines.translated: "This is as far as we go together, then."

lines.content: あなたは“夜”を“想像”するため、語り部の私の話を受け止める聴き手として、あのさくらの樹から救い上げたけど……。あなたと私は理想が違う。“夢”も“希望”も、まったく違う
lines.translated: "In order to 'imagine' the 'Night,' I rescued you from that cherry blossom tree as a listener to receive my stories as the storyteller, but... You and I have different ideals. Our 'dreams' and 'hopes' are completely different, too."

lines.content: 今日からあなたと私は敵同士ね、と女の子は言う。ひどく冷たい声だった。
lines.translated: From today on, you and I are enemies, the girl said. Her voice was terribly cold.

lines.content: それはまるで、“過去”に大切な大切な、やさしい心の一部を置いてきてしまったみたいだった。
lines.translated: It was as if she had left behind a part of her precious, precious, gentle heart in the "past."
*That was why Mashiro closed the "Night."*

lines.content: ……しっかりと“鍵”をかけたのだ。
lines.translated: She locked it tightly with a "key."

lines.content: そうした結果、崩壊の“未来”は変わらずこの運命線上に在る。
lines.translated: As a result of doing so, the "future" of collapse remains unchanged upon this line of fate.

lines.content: いつかこの星に最接近し、人々の心をむしばむ月のことを、いつしか誰もが“[・|夜][・|の][・|女][・|王]”と呼んで恐れることになるのだ。
lines.translated: Before long, everyone will come to fear the moon that will someday approach closest to this planet and eat away at people's minds, calling it the "*Queen of the Night.*"

lines.content: そして人類は、価値ある者以外をすべて残して宇宙の果てに旅立って――切り捨てられた命はすべて、無残に消えゆく運命だ。
lines.translated: And humanity will set off for the ends of the universe, leaving behind everyone except those of value--and all the cast-off lives are fated to ruthlessly vanish away.

lines.content: そうした命の中にはきっと、あなたや私にとって大切な“誰か”が含まれているはずだ。
lines.translated: Among those lives, a precious "someone" to you or me is surely included.

lines.content: ましろは願う。
lines.translated: Mashiro makes a wish.

lines.content: “夜の国”は人類の――子ども達の命を護るために創られた。だがそれを維持して行くには、悲しい想いを抱いた子ども達、その命が必要不可欠。
lines.translated: The "Land of Night" was created to protect the lives of humanity--of the children. Yet in order to maintain it, the children who harbored sad feelings, and their very lives, were indispensable.

lines.content: そんな矛盾しきった方法を破棄するために……。
lines.translated: In order to discard such a thoroughly contradictory method...

lines.content: この“夜”が必要とされるそのときが来るまでに、もう誰も犠牲にはしない新たな“[希望|方法]”を見つけ出したい。
lines.translated: Before the time comes when this "Night" is needed, she wants to find a new "hope" that will never sacrifice anyone again.

lines.content: ましろはそう祈り続け、ついに、見つけたのだ。
lines.translated: Mashiro continued to pray for that, and finally, she found it.

lines.content: 私の見つけた“希望”……。それが、あなたなんだよ。……大雅。奏大雅。あなたこそが私たちのヒーロー、なんだよ
lines.translated: "The 'hope' I found... That is you. ...Taiga. Kanade Taiga. You are the one who is our hero."

lines.content: あ、あはは。なんだかちょっと照れちゃうよねぇ……
lines.translated: "Ah, ahaha. It's kind of a little embarrassing, isn't it...?"

lines.content: まさか、こんな感じになっちゃうなんて――
lines.translated: Who would have thought it would turn out like this--

lines.content: 俺の隣を歩く、まっしろに輝く“夜の女王”は苦笑いを浮かべ、そう言った。
lines.translated: Walking beside me, the "Queen of the Night" shining in pure white gave a wry smile and said that.

lines.content: 彼女と出会ってから今夜で何度目の“夜”だろう。
lines.translated: How many "Nights" has it been tonight since I met her?

lines.content: 甘くて美味しいお菓子の話と、俺の知りたい様々な話。
lines.translated: Stories of sweet and delicious treats, and the various stories I want to know.

lines.content: それらを交換し合うのも、今宵はいつもと違う、別の場所――そうだね、たとえば“夜”の町を歩きながらお話しするのも、ときにはいいよね？
