lines.translated: Even when it comes to exchanging those with each other, tonight we're in a different place than usual--that's right, for instance, talking while walking through the town of the "Night" is nice once in a while too, isn't it?

lines.content: 昨晩、[・|俺][・|の][・|し][・|た][・|提][・|案]をはぐらかすようにしてましろが微笑み、そう言ったから。
lines.translated: Because last night, smiling as if to dodge *the proposal I had made*, Mashiro had said that.

lines.content: だから、時計塔の小さな部屋をふたり並んで出たは、いいけれど……。
lines.translated: So, it was all well and good that the two of us left the small room in the clock tower side by side, however...

lines.content: うん。とても、静かに話ができる状態じゃないね
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's really not a situation where we can talk quietly, is it?"

lines.content: 辺りを行き交う“夜の住人”たちは、ましろのことを目にすると必ずふっと立ち止まる。
lines.translated: Whenever the "residents of the Night" coming and going around us catch sight of Mashiro, they unfailingly stop in their tracks.

lines.content: 驚いた顔の誰か。
lines.translated: Someone with a surprised face.

lines.content: 笑顔になって手を振る誰か。
lines.translated: Someone breaking into a smile and waving their hand.

lines.content: 頭を深々と下げる誰か。
lines.translated: Someone bowing their head deeply.

lines.content: 思わずといったふうに駆け寄ってきて、こんばんはと、ほんの細やかな挨拶を口々に言う、誰かたち。
lines.translated: People running over as if on impulse, each offering a modest greeting of "good evening."

lines.content: その中には、ありがとうという感謝の言葉も聞こえた気がした。
lines.translated: Among them, I felt like I heard words of gratitude saying "thank you," too.

lines.content: 君は……
え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……うん。君は、たくさんのひとに愛されてる“女王さま”なんだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. You're a 'Queen' who is loved by a lot of people, aren't you?"

lines.content: そ、そうかなあ
lines.translated: "I-I wonder about that..."

lines.content: まっしろな頬を赤くした。
lines.translated: Her pure white cheeks turned red.

lines.content: だめだよ
lines.translated: "You mustn't."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私なんて褒めてもなんにも出ないよ。あげられるのは、そうだなあ。今夜もあなたがいい夢みれますようにって、そんなお祈りするくらいだよ……
lines.translated: "Even if you praise someone like me, nothing will come of it. About all I can give you is, let's see... A prayer that you'll have sweet dreams tonight too..."

lines.content: 小さな身体をもじもじさせていたけれど……。
lines.translated: She was fidgeting with her small body, though...

lines.content: でもね
lines.translated: "But, you know..."

lines.content: ふと、照れくさそうに浮かべていた微笑みを、困ったように緩ませた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, the bashful smile floating on her face softened into a troubled expression.

lines.content: 愛されてれば愛されてるほど、そうじゃなくなってしまったときのことを考えると……つらいよ
lines.translated: "The more you're loved, the more painful it is... when you think about the time when that won't be the case anymore."

lines.content: それはつぶやきよりも小さな声だった。雑踏の中、聞き逃してしまっても不思議ではないほどに。
lines.translated: It was a voice smaller than a murmur. So faint that it wouldn't be strange to miss it amid the bustling crowd.

lines.content: だけどいやしくも耳ざといこの俺は、気づいてしまう。
lines.translated: However, having sharp ears for better or worse, I ended up noticing it.

lines.content: 気づいてしまえばそのままにはできないから、
lines.translated: And once I notice it, I can't just leave it be,

lines.content: どういうこと……？
lines.translated: "What do you mean...?"

lines.content: と、俺は首をかしげてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: so I end up tilting my head.

lines.content: ご、ごめんね。……うん。これじゃお話、できないよね
lines.translated: "S-Sorry. ...Yeah. We can't really talk like this, can we?"

lines.content: パッといつもの笑顔を見せるましろだった。
lines.translated: Mashiro immediately flashed her usual smile.

lines.content: それ以上は追求できない。
lines.translated: I can't press the matter any further than this.

lines.content: 誰にだって……君にだって俺にだって、容易には話せないことがある。
lines.translated: Everyone... both you and I, have things we cannot easily talk about.

lines.content: 命はなくともそこに心があるのだから当然だ。
lines.translated: Even without a life, there is a heart there, so it's only natural.

lines.content: だからそのまま、さっきの言葉は“聞こえなかった”ことにする。
lines.translated: So I leave it at that, and pretend I "didn't hear" her words just now.

lines.content: まあ、確かにそうだね……。ここじゃ話はできそうにない
lines.translated: "Well, that's certainly true... It doesn't look like we'll be able to talk here."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ましろは苦笑いでうなずき、集まってくる雑踏を見渡していた。
lines.translated: Mashiro nodded with a wry smile, looking out over the gathering crowd.

lines.content: ……場所、変える？　いつもの部屋に戻ろっか
lines.translated: "...Shall we change locations? Should we go back to the usual room?"

lines.content: ざわざわと集まったひと達を、俺も見回し、
lines.translated: I also looked around at the people who had gathered with a noisy murmur,

lines.content: ううん。大丈夫
lines.translated: "No. It's fine."

lines.content: 首を振り、微笑みかける。
lines.translated: I shook my head and smiled at her.

lines.content: [・|昨][・|日]、[・|言][・|っ][・|た][・|よ][・|ね]。君は俺のヒーローの居場所を教えてくれた。その情報に釣り合うだけの“対価”として、今夜は俺が、君の“夢”をひとつ、叶えるよって
lines.translated: "*I said it yesterday, didn't I?* You told me where my hero is. As a 'price' to match that information, tonight I'm going to grant one of your 'dreams.'"

lines.content: そうして俺は小さな彼女の手を引いた――ここに住む誰もが愛する、小さく眩しい、まっしろな“夜の女王”を、今夜もひとりじめするそのために。
lines.translated: And so I took her small hand and led her along--in order to have this small, dazzling, pure white "Queen of the Night," whom everyone living here loves, all to myself again tonight.

lines.content: ……少しだけ昨晩の“夜”のことを思い出す。
lines.translated: I recall a little bit about last night's "Night."

lines.content: いつもあの子と話す小さな部屋で、俺はそれまでずっと探し続けてきたヒーローの所在を知った。
lines.translated: In the small room where I always talk with her, I learned the whereabouts of the hero I had been searching for all that time.

lines.content: 同時に、もう決して探し出せない遠い場所に、その人はいるのだということも、知った。
lines.translated: At the same time, I also learned that he is in a distant place where I can never track him down again.

lines.content: そして“夜”の[・|は][・|じ][・|ま][・|り]のような話も聞かせてもらった。
lines.translated: And she also told me a story like the *beginning* of the "Night."

lines.content: その話は、俺という存在が人類の“希望”なのだという大仰な言葉で結ばれた。
lines.translated: That story concluded with the grandiose words that my very existence is the "hope" of humanity.

lines.content: 困惑するばかりだ。
lines.translated: It only leaves me bewildered.

lines.content: この俺にいったい何ができるのか……。
lines.translated: Just what on earth could someone like me possibly do...?

lines.content: それでもやはり、今、俺の心に満ちているのは“父親”の話だ。
lines.translated: Even so, what fills my heart right now is still the story about my "father."

lines.content: ……俺はもう、ヒーローに助けを求めることが、できない。
lines.translated: I can no longer ask my hero for help.

lines.content: それについて“絶望”は……。
lines.translated: As for whether I feel "despair" about that...

lines.content: どうだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder.

lines.content: 正直に言えば、まったく感じなかったと言えば嘘になる。
lines.translated: To be honest, it would be a lie to say I didn't feel it at all.

lines.content: まだまだ子どもな自分たちでは、目の前に立ちはだかる問題を自力では解決できないどころか、逃避しきることさえ不可能だろう。
lines.translated: For kids like us, let alone solving the problems standing in our way on our own, it's probably impossible to even run away from them completely.

lines.content: だからこそ俺は、その人を――自分の父親のことを頼り、この町にまでやって来たのだ。
lines.translated: That's precisely why I came all the way to this town, relying on that person--on my father.

lines.content: そして[・|君]に、逢うために。
lines.translated: And in order to meet *you*.

lines.content: “希望”と“絶望”のふたつを握りしめ、この町に来た。
lines.translated: Clutching both "hope" and "despair" tightly in my hands, I came to this town.

lines.content: その[・|あ][・|て]が外れてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: And that *prospect* fell through.

lines.content: これから俺たちはどうしたらいいのだろうか。
lines.translated: What are we supposed to do from now on?

lines.content: ……頼れる人は誰もいない。
lines.translated: There is no one we can rely on.

lines.content: 未来に描いていた“希望”が潰えてしまった。
lines.translated: The "hope" I had pictured for the future has been crushed.

lines.content: そのはずなのに……。
lines.translated: That should be the case, and yet...

lines.content: どこかさっぱりとしてしまっている。
lines.translated: Somehow, I feel strangely refreshed.

lines.content: ただの開き直りなのか、それとも、まだ思いつけてもいない“良い作戦”が、頭に芽生える予感でもしているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is it just resignation, or do I have a premonition that a "good plan" I haven't even thought of yet is about to sprout in my head?

lines.content: いや。たぶん、[・|君][・|と][・|は]こうしてちゃんと逢えたからだ。
lines.translated: No. It's probably because I was able to properly meet *with you* like this.

lines.content: “夢”の中で君と話すときだけは、決してぐずぐずと泣き濡れることのない自分でいたい――そう感じられる自分が俺は好きだった。
lines.translated: Only when I'm talking with you inside a "dream," I want to be someone who never breaks down crying and fretting--I liked the part of myself that could feel that way.

lines.content: 『話を聞かせてもらえたお礼に何か、俺にできることはないかな』
lines.translated: "Is there anything I can do for you to thank you for telling me that story?"

lines.content: 昨晩の俺は君にそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: Last night, I asked you that.

lines.content: 『……もし君に、何か“叶えたい夢”みたいなものが……もしも、あるのなら。その“夢”が叶うように協力したい』
lines.translated: "...If you have something like a 'dream you want to come true'... if by any chance you do, I want to help make that 'dream' come true."

lines.content: 『お礼なんて……、どうして？』
lines.translated: "Thank me...? Why?"

lines.content: と、あの子は本当に不思議そうに首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Saying that, she tilted her head, looking genuinely puzzled.

lines.content: 『だって、ヒーローの居場所だ。……俺の命のルーツだ。そんな重要な[話|情報]をしてくれたんだ』
lines.translated: "Because it's the whereabouts of my hero. ...It's the roots of my life. You gave me such important information."

lines.content: チョコレートの話だけで釣り合うはずがない。
lines.translated: There's no way just a story about chocolate could balance that out.

lines.content: 君が……ましろが、それでいいんだよと笑顔を見せてくれたとしても、そんなのは俺自身が納得できない。
lines.translated: Even if you... even if Mashiro showed me a smile and said that was enough, I couldn't accept that myself.

lines.content: だけどやっぱり、思ったとおりましろは別に良いよと言った。
lines.translated: But sure enough, just as I thought, Mashiro said she didn't really mind.

lines.content: 『叶えたい“夢”なんて私にはない。だってさ、ほら、私自身が“夢”みたいなものなのに……だからね、そんなのはないよ。ほんとだよ』
lines.translated: "I don't have a 'dream' I want to come true. Because, look, I'm like a 'dream' myself... So I don't have anything like that. Really."

lines.content: 『命がないから“夢”も見ない？』
lines.translated: "Because you don't have a life, you don't dream either?"

lines.content: 『そう、かも……？　うん。きっとそうだよ』
lines.translated: "Maybe... so? Yeah. That must be it."

lines.content: 命はなくとも心があるなら、きっと“夢”もそこにはあるはずだ――命とは“夢”でなくてどうすると歌った人がいた。ならば心も、“夢”でできていなくて、いったい、どうする。
lines.translated: Even without a life, if there is a heart, then surely a "dream" must be there too--someone once sang that if life isn't a "dream," then what is it? In that case, if a heart isn't made of "dreams" either, what on earth is it?

lines.content: そういうふうに暑苦しく迫った俺に、ましろは困ったように首をひねるばっかりだったけど、
lines.translated: As I pressed her so fervently like that, Mashiro only tilted her head in troubled thought,

lines.content: 『だったら……』
lines.translated: "In that case..."

lines.content: 昨晩の“夜”が終わる頃――
lines.translated: Just as last night's "Night" was coming to an end--

lines.content: 『だったら……あのね。ちょっとだけ付き合ってもらえたらいいなあって思うこと、ひとつだけあるんだけど……』
lines.translated: "In that case... um, you know. There is just one thing I think it would be nice if you could go along with me on for a little bit..."

lines.content: そこまで言って、ましろは黙った。
lines.translated: Having said that much, Mashiro fell silent.

lines.content: 『……どうしたの？』
lines.translated: "...What's wrong?"

lines.content: 『……笑わない？』
lines.translated: "...You won't laugh?"

lines.content: ちらちらと俺の顔色をうかがうように、言った。
lines.translated: She said that, glancing at my face to gauge my reaction.

lines.content: 『私の“夢”……やっぱり、あったけど。聞いても、笑ったりしない？』
lines.translated: "My 'dream'... I did have one after all, though. Even if you hear it, you won't laugh or anything?"

lines.content: 『うん。笑わないよ。絶対』
lines.translated: "Yeah. I won't laugh. Definitely."

lines.content: 『ほんとう？』
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: 『本当』
lines.translated: "Really."

lines.content: 『……でも、もしうそだったら？』
lines.translated: "...But what if that's a lie?"

lines.content: 『そうだな……。いつか甘いお菓子をお腹いっぱい、食べさせてあげるよ。針の代わりに千個くらい』
lines.translated: "Let's see... Someday, I'll let you eat your fill of sweet treats. About a thousand of them, instead of needles."

lines.content: 『え、えへへ。そんな甘いうそならね、いっぱいついてくれてもいいかもね』
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe. If it's a sweet lie like that, you might be welcome to tell me lots of them."

lines.content: 俺の説得にようやく応じ、ましろはちょっと夢見がちなその“夢”を、俺に教えてくれたのだった。
lines.translated: Finally yielding to my persuasion, Mashiro told me that slightly fanciful "dream" of hers.

lines.content: ごめん――
lines.translated: Sorry--

lines.content: 『ごめんね』
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: さっそく嘘をついてしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up telling a lie right away.

lines.content: 俺は思わず、笑顔になっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, a smile had spread across my face.

lines.content: “夜の女王”が願った“夢”が、あんまりにもかわいく思えてしまったから……。
lines.translated: Because the "dream" wished for by the "Queen of the Night" seemed just far too cute to me...

lines.content: 『う、うう……、もう。笑わないって言ったのに。ひどいよ。大雅のうそつき』
lines.translated: "U-Uuu... Jeez. Even though you said you wouldn't laugh. That's mean. Taiga, you liar."

lines.content: ましろは唇を尖らせていた。甘いお菓子千個くらいじゃ全然足りないよ、と。
lines.translated: Mashiro was pouting. Saying that a thousand sweet treats wouldn't be nearly enough at all.

lines.content: 『……なんだか急に恥ずかしくなって来ちゃった……まあ、うん。でも』
lines.translated: "...Somehow I suddenly started feeling embarrassed... Well, yeah. But..."

lines.content: ため息をついて、苦笑い。
lines.translated: She let out a sigh and gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 『でも、ね。そうだよね。こんな“夢”、笑われるのも当然だよね。……すごく、子どもっぽいし。“夢”の中で夢見てるんじゃないよって感じだよね。だからやっぱり――』
lines.translated: "But, you know. That's right, isn't it? A 'dream' like this, it's only natural to be laughed at. ...It's super childish, and it feels like, 'Don't go dreaming inside a dream,' right? So after all--"

lines.content: ――お願いするの、止めるよ。
lines.translated: --I'll stop asking for it.

lines.content: そう続きそうになったのを、俺は急いで遮断したのだ。
lines.translated: When she seemed about to continue with that, I hurriedly cut her off.

lines.content: 『……ううん。わかった』
lines.translated: "...No. I understand."

lines.content: ごめんね、意地悪で笑ったんじゃないよ。と、そう言って。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, I didn't laugh to be mean," I said.

lines.content: 『俺は君の“夢”を叶えたいんだ。ううん。俺に、叶えさせてほしい。だって俺は……ずっと』
lines.translated: "I want to make your 'dream' come true. No. I want you to let me make it come true. Because I've... always..."

lines.content: 君とこうして逢えることをずっと願っていたんだから。
lines.translated: Because I had always wished to be able to meet you like this.

lines.content: そんな最後の言葉は、今は心の底に埋めておいた。
lines.translated: I buried those last words deep in my heart for now.

lines.content: 『えっと……ね』
lines.translated: "Um... you know."

lines.content: ちらちらと俺の顔色を伺うように見ながら、ましろは、えいやっと思い切るみたいにして、言った。
lines.translated: Glancing at my face to gauge my reaction, Mashiro braced herself and spoke as if taking the plunge.

lines.content: 『物語のヒロインみたいにね、一度くらいはなってみたいなあって、思うかな』
lines.translated: "I think... I'd like to try becoming like the heroine of a story, just once."

lines.content: それが昨晩、ましろの口にした“夢”だった――
lines.translated: That was the "dream" Mashiro spoke of last night--

lines.content: 『それもね。とびきりすてきな、恋するためのお話の……ヒロインみたいに』
lines.translated: "And at that... like the heroine... of an extraordinarily wonderful story about falling in love."

lines.content: 恥ずかしそうにましろは頬を赤くしていた。
lines.translated: Mashiro's cheeks were flushing red with embarrassment.

lines.content: どうして、そう思うのかな。
lines.translated: Why did she feel that way, I wondered.

lines.content: 俺はそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked her that.

lines.content: 『それは……』
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: だけど昨晩の君は、唇を尖らせそっぽを向いた。
lines.translated: However, the you of last night pouted and looked away.

lines.content: 『……また笑うから、秘密』
lines.translated: "...You'll laugh again, so it's a secret."

lines.content: そんな君の機嫌を直したい。
lines.translated: I wanted to cheer you up when you were like that.

lines.content: 『……小さな女の子は誰だって一度はさ、お姫さまに憧れるものなんだよ。男の子が正義の味方に憧れるみたいに』
lines.translated: "...Every little girl longs to be a princess at least once. Just like how boys long to be heroes of justice."

lines.content: 『……大人になれば誰もがみんな忘れちゃうけど、私はさ、ほら、見たとおりまだまだ全然子どもだから。まだそんな小さな“夢”の外に出られていない』
lines.translated: "...Everyone forgets about it once they grow up, but look, as you can see, I'm still a total kid. I still haven't been able to step outside of such a small 'dream.'"

lines.content: 『最後は必ずハッピーエンドで終われる物語。そこにいる誰もが私を、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]を笑顔で祝福してくれる――そんな絵本みたいな物語に、憧れてばかりいる』
lines.translated: "A story that always ends with a happy ending. Where everyone there blesses me--blesses *us*--with a smile... I'm always longing for a picture-book story like that."

lines.content: だから今夜は、この子のことを“女王さま”ではなく、“お姫さま”みたいに扱おう――……だ、なんて。
lines.translated: So tonight, I won't treat her like a "Queen," but like a "princess"--...or something like that.

lines.content: そんな幼稚なことを、君の手を引くまだまだ子どもなばかりのこの俺は、考えていた。
lines.translated: Leading you by the hand, still nothing more than a child myself, I was thinking such childish things.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ごめんね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: 昨日の“夜”は勢いで、“だったら俺が君をデートに誘うよ”、だとか……そんなこと言っちゃったけど
lines.translated: "Last 'Night,' I got carried away and said something like, 'Then I'll ask you out on a date,' or whatever, but..."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 言ってくれてたね、とましろは微笑む。なんだかとってもドキッとしちゃったよ、と。
lines.translated: "You did say that, didn't you," Mashiro smiled. "It made my heart skip a beat," she added.

lines.content: 大雅、格好よかったよ。いつもよりずっと
lines.translated: "You were really cool, Taiga. Much more than usual."

lines.content: そんなことをふと言われ――ふたりして照れ笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Being told something like that out of the blue--the two of us shared bashful smiles.

lines.content: これからどこへ一緒に行こうかって考えたけど……。ごねん。よく、わからないんだ
lines.translated: "I thought about where we should go together from here, though... Sorwy. I don't really know."

lines.content: 俺はましろと同じで、まだまだ子どもだ。
lines.translated: Just like Mashiro, I'm still a kid.

lines.content: 今までこうして、女の子と手を繋いだことさえなかった。
lines.translated: Until now, I had never even held hands with a girl like this.

lines.content: 今夜がはじめてなのだ。何もかもはじめてだ。
lines.translated: Tonight is the first time. Everything is a first.

lines.content: ……だけど君に格好つけてた。
lines.translated: Even so, I was trying to act cool in front of you.

lines.content: 君に、少しでも笑顔になってほしくて。
lines.translated: Because I wanted you to smile, even if just a little.
*Because I wanted to save you.*

lines.content: 俺はこうして、君の味方であることを伝えたかったのだけれど……。
lines.translated: By doing this, I wanted to convey that I am on your side, though...

lines.content: デートだなんて……わからないんだ
lines.translated: "A date... I don't really know how."

lines.content: 自分から誘っておいてこんなこと言うのはひどく……格好悪い。そう感じる。
lines.translated: To be the one to invite her and then say something like this is terribly... uncool. That's how I feel.

lines.content: でも、はじまってしまえば、まあ何とかなるかなあって思った
lines.translated: "Still, I figured that once we got started, things would work out somehow."

lines.content: こうして手を引き俺しか知らない秘密の場所、秘密のきらきら眩しいきれいな場所に連れて行き、驚かせてみるのも[・|そ][・|れ][・|っ][・|ぽ][・|い]のだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Leading her by the hand like this to a secret place only I knew--a secret, dazzlingly sparkling, beautiful place--to surprise her would probably feel *just like a real date*, though...

lines.content: “夜”の町は、俺よりむしろ君のほうがよく知ってるだろうし
lines.translated: "Besides, you probably know the town of the 'Night' much better than I do."

lines.content: うーん。……そうかもしれないね。それにさ、あんまり“夜”の町はデート向きじゃないかもだね
lines.translated: "Hmm... That might be true. And you know, the town of the 'Night' might not be very well suited for a date anyway."

lines.content: ましろは微笑み、言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro smiled and spoke.

lines.content: だって、ほら……。デートってさ、大好きな人と一緒に、甘いものとか美味しいものとか食べながら歩いたりするんだよね？
lines.translated: "Because, look... On a date, you walk around eating sweet and delicious things with the person you love, right?"

lines.content: そういうシチュエーション、捲った物語のページの中でいっぱい見たよとましろは言う。
lines.translated: Mashiro said she had seen plenty of situations like that within the pages of the stories she had flipped through.

lines.content: だけど、残念だね。ほんとに残念。“夜”には甘いものも美味しいものもあんまりないし……
lines.translated: "But it's a shame. A real shame. There aren't many sweet or delicious things in the 'Night'..."

lines.content: あるのは紅茶用の角砂糖だけ
lines.translated: "All we have are sugar cubes for black tea."

lines.content: そうだねえ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ましろはため息をつく。
lines.translated: Mashiro let out a sigh.

lines.content: でもでも。私がまだ知らないだけで、どこかに甘いものも美味しいものもあるかもしれないけどね。秘密の宝物みたいにどこかわかりにくいところに隠されちゃってるだけで
lines.translated: "But, you know! Maybe I just don't know about them yet, and there actually are sweet and delicious things out there somewhere. They might just be hidden away in a hard-to-find place like secret treasure."

lines.content: 隠されてる……。お砂糖が？　宝箱の中とかに？
lines.translated: "Hidden away... You mean sugar? Inside a treasure chest or something?"

lines.content: うん。甘いものを食べると幸せになれるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Eating sweet things makes you happy."

lines.content: そうだね。わかるよ
lines.translated: "That's true. I get that."

lines.content: だから秘密の場所に隠されてるの
lines.translated: "And that's why they're hidden in a secret place."

lines.content: 幸せなことはいつだってどこか難しいところに隠れてる。だからみんな一生懸命探してるんだよ――そう言うましろは腕を組み、うなずいている。
lines.translated: Happy things are always hidden somewhere difficult to find, and that's why everyone searches so hard for them--Mashiro crossed her arms and nodded as she said this.

lines.content: その横顔は“私、今、いいこと言ってる”みたいに得意そうに見え、おかしかった。
lines.translated: From the side, she looked so proud of herself, as if thinking, "I'm saying something really profound right now," and I found it endearing.

lines.content: そしてね、やっと見つけた宝箱の中には……
lines.translated: "And then, inside the treasure chest you finally find..."

lines.content: 幸せと一緒に、甘くて美味しいチョコレートがはいってるんだね
lines.translated: "Right alongside happiness, there's sweet, delicious chocolate inside, huh?"

lines.content: ましろは笑った。
lines.translated: Mashiro laughed.

lines.content: そして、でも、今は甘いものとかなくてもいいよね、と言う。
lines.translated: And then, she said that it was fine even without any sweets right now.

lines.content: こうしてあなたと並んで歩いてるだけで、なんだかちょっと……不思議だけどね。どきどきしてきて、もにょもにょしてきて……胸の中がね、不思議な感じがするんだよ
lines.translated: "Just walking side by side with you like this feels a little... strange, though. My heart is fluttering, and I feel all squirmy inside... There's this mysterious feeling in my chest."

lines.content: 甘いもの食べてないのに私の中がいっぱい甘いよ。そんなことをましろは言った。
lines.translated: Even though I haven't eaten anything sweet, I feel completely filled with sweetness inside. That was what Mashiro said.

lines.content: 俺は、照れたように微笑むましろの“隣”を歩いた。
lines.translated: I walked "beside" Mashiro as she smiled bashfully.

lines.content: そうだ。ただ、歩く。
lines.translated: That's right. We just walked.

lines.content: 一緒に見たいものがあるわけでもない。一緒に美味しいものを食べられるでもない。
lines.translated: It wasn't as if there was anything in particular we wanted to see together. Nor was there anything delicious we could eat together.

lines.content: ここには、“恋”するために必要だろうものはたぶん少ない。
lines.translated: There were probably very few of the things here that one would normally need to "fall in love."

lines.content: だけど、ただただこうして並んで歩いているだけで――ましろの言うとおりだった。何か、胸の中が不思議な感じになっていく。
lines.translated: Even so, just walking side by side like this--it was just as Mashiro said. A mysterious feeling was steadily growing inside my chest.

lines.content: こういう時間をもっと君といっぱい重ねたい。そう思うのは俺だけだろうか。
lines.translated: I want to spend so much more time like this with you. Am I the only one who feels that way?

lines.content: 君がどうしてそんな気持ちでいてくれるのかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know why you harbor those feelings for me.

lines.content: だけど俺が、こんな気持ちを抱いてしまうのは[・|不][・|思][・|議][・|で][・|は][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: However, it *wasn't strange at all* for me to harbor these feelings of my own.

lines.content: 理由は、わかる。充分に納得ができてしまう――このために俺は君に会いに来たのだから。
lines.translated: I know the reason. It makes complete sense to me--because this is the very reason I came to see you.

lines.content: “夜”の公園にまでやって来た。
lines.translated: We made our way all the way to the park of the "Night."

lines.content: ベンチに腰掛ける。
lines.translated: We sat down on a bench.

lines.content: ここからは“夜”の眩しい光景がよく見渡せた。
lines.translated: From here, we had a clear view looking out over the dazzling scenery of the "Night."

lines.content: 時計塔管理室の小窓から見える風景とはまた少し違っていて、ほんの少し、新鮮さも感じられた。
lines.translated: It was a little different from the view through the small window of the clock tower's office, and it felt just a tiny bit fresh.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: 隣に座るましろが言った。
lines.translated: Sitting next to me, Mashiro spoke up.

lines.content: うん。なに、ましろ
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it, Mashiro?"

lines.content: ……どうして？
え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……どうして私に、こんなことをしてくれるの？
lines.translated: "...Why are you doing all this for me?"

lines.content: こんなこと、って？
lines.translated: "All this?"

lines.content: 物語のヒロインみたいになってみたい……だ、なんて。改めて自分で言ってみても恥ずかしいよ。そんな私の“夢”を叶えてくれようとしてる。それは、どうしてなのかなって
lines.translated: "Saying I want to be like the heroine of a story... Even saying it out loud again myself is embarrassing. Yet you're trying to make that 'dream' of mine come true. I was just wondering why."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 昨晩も言ったと思うけど……。
lines.translated: I think I said this last night, too, though...

lines.content: 甘いお菓子と俺の知りたい話とでは釣り合わない。そう感じてるって言ったろ。たくさんのお釣りが必要だよ
lines.translated: "Sweet treats aren't a fair trade for the stories I want to hear. I told you that's how I felt, right? You're owed a lot of change."

lines.content: だからこれは、[・|そ][・|れ]を返しているようなつもりだったんだ。でも、どういうふうにしたらその“夢”を叶えられるのか。全然、わからないんだけどね……
lines.translated: "So I intended for this to be my way of paying *that* back. Though I have no idea how I'm supposed to actually make that 'dream' come true..."

lines.content: できることは君をあちらこちらと連れ回し、こうして格好悪く苦笑いを浮かべるだけだ。
lines.translated: All I can do is lead you around from place to place and offer this uncool, wry smile.

lines.content: それに……
lines.translated: "And besides..."

lines.content: うん。それに……？
lines.translated: "Yeah? Besides...?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は……。
きらきら瞬く“夜”に視線を投げたまま、少し沈黙を挟んでから、言った。
lines.translated: Keeping my gaze cast out over the sparkling, twinkling "Night," I let a brief silence pass before speaking.

lines.content: 今度は、君に教えてもらいたいことじゃなくて、俺から君に、知ってもらいたいことがあったんだ
lines.translated: "This time, it's not about something I want you to tell me. There's something I wanted you to know."

lines.content: 私に、知ってもらいたいこと？
lines.translated: "Something you want me to know?"

lines.content: うん。そうだよ……
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right..."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: あの部屋ではなんでだか少し、[・|秘][・|密]を口にする気になれなかったんだ。だから気分を変えたくて……
lines.translated: "Back in that room, for some reason, I couldn't quite bring myself to speak of this *secret*. So I wanted a change of pace..."

lines.content: この[・|想][・|い]を、君にどのようにして伝えるべきなのか――足りない頭で、幼い心で、懸命に考えながら、まずは一言、俺は口を開いた。
lines.translated: How should I convey these *feelings* to you? Thinking as hard as I could with my lacking head and childish heart, I opened my mouth to say the first words.

lines.content: ましろ。俺は、君のことを知っていたんだ
lines.translated: "Mashiro. I already knew about you."

lines.content: ずっと、昔から。ずっとずっと、今よりも小さな頃から……ずっとだよ
lines.translated: "From a long, long time ago. Since way, way back when I was much smaller than I am now... This whole time."
It's strange, capability-wise, yet I remember things from when I was much younger than I am now. *From when I was a baby who couldn't even crawl yet.*

lines.content: 俺は母親に抱っこしてほしくて泣きわめいていた。
lines.translated: I used to bawl my eyes out, wanting my mother to hold me.

lines.content: だけど誰も見向きもしない。母親に関してはそばにさえいなかった。
lines.translated: Yet no one paid me any mind. As for my mother, she wasn't even around.

lines.content: ますます俺は泣いただろう。
lines.translated: That probably only made me cry harder.

lines.content: もう殆ど助けを求めるかのような泣き方だった。きっと小さな心は、次から次へと湧いて出る――生まれてはじめて感じるさみしさに、びりびりと引き裂かれそうになっていた。
lines.translated: I was crying almost as if begging for help. My tiny heart was surely on the verge of being torn to shreds by the loneliness I was feeling for the very first time in my life, welling up over and over again.

lines.content: そんな俺を、やさしくあやしてくれる笑顔がいつもそばにいてくれたのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, there was always a smile right beside me, gently soothing me when I was like that.
"Translucent"...

lines.content: 不思議なひとだ。
lines.translated: A mysterious person.

lines.content: 決して触れられないけれど。
lines.translated: Though I could never touch her.

lines.content: 声も、届かないけれど……。
lines.translated: Though my voice could never reach her...

lines.content: だけどその姿だけは見えていた。
lines.translated: Her figure alone was visible to me.

lines.content: 赤ん坊の俺が、さみしさに耐えられなくて泣いていると……
lines.translated: "When I was a baby, crying because I couldn't bear the loneliness..."

lines.content: そのひとはそばで笑顔を見せてくれる。
lines.translated: That person would stay by my side and smile for me.

lines.content: 時におかしな顔をして見せてくれ――
lines.translated: Sometimes making funny faces for me--

lines.content: 時に、両手の指で、チョウチョやうさぎや猫だとか。そういう形を作って見せてくれていた
lines.translated: "Sometimes using the fingers of both hands to make shapes for me, like butterflies, or rabbits, or cats."

lines.content: それだけだ。
lines.translated: That's all.

lines.content: それだけなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though that was all it was...

lines.content: 頭を撫でてくれたり。やさしく抱っこしてくれるわけでも、なかったのに……
lines.translated: "Even though you couldn't pat my head, or gently hold me in your arms..."

lines.content: それでも赤ん坊の俺は安心できた。
lines.translated: Even so, the baby I was felt reassured.

lines.content: いつしか自然と泣き止んで、そのひとと一緒にただただ笑った。
lines.translated: Before long, I would naturally stop crying, and simply laugh right along with that person.

lines.content: 話せない。触れられない。ただ、笑顔を浮かべ合うだけの“半透明”なそのひとの“隣”で、俺は育った。
lines.translated: Unable to speak. Unable to touch. I grew up "beside" that "translucent" person, the two of us doing nothing more than sharing smiles with one another.

lines.content: その記憶は、まだ赤ん坊だったはずなのに、不思議なことだけど今もぼんやりと覚えている。
lines.translated: Even though I must have still been a baby, strangely enough, I still vaguely remember those memories even now.

lines.content: きっと、どこかで感じていた。
lines.translated: I must have sensed it somewhere deep down.

lines.content: 自分はいつもひとりじゃないんだ――“半透明”の不思議なひとが“隣”で笑ってくれる度に、言葉ではない部分で深く理解できたんだろうと、思う。
lines.translated: That I was never alone--every time that mysterious, "translucent" person smiled "beside" me, I think I was able to deeply understand that in a way that transcended words.

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: ましろは小さくため息をつき、笑った。
lines.translated: Mashiro let out a small sigh and smiled.

lines.content: やっぱりあなたは赤ん坊だった頃も、私のこと、見えてたんだね……
lines.translated: "So you really could see me even back when you were a baby..."

lines.content: やっぱり……？
lines.translated: "You knew...?"

lines.content: うん。だってね。赤ん坊だったあなたがいっぱい泣いてるとき、私が“笑ってほしいな”って思って変な顔してみせたらさ、すぐに泣き止んで笑ってくれてた
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because, you see, whenever you were crying your eyes out as a baby, I'd wish for you to smile and make a funny face for you, and you'd immediately stop crying and laugh for me."

lines.content: かわいかったなあと言い、ましろは目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Saying how cute it was, Mashiro narrowed her eyes fondly.

lines.content: あのとき、すごくうれしかったよ。ああ、私のことわかってくれる子がいる。話せないけど。触れられないけど。それでもちゃんと笑顔は届く
lines.translated: "I was so happy back then. Thinking, 'Ah, there's a child who notices me.' Even though we couldn't talk. Even though we couldn't touch. My smile still reached you."

lines.content: そう思うと……。この子は私が護らなきゃって。絶対、うれしいこといっぱい、この子の“隣”に届けなきゃって。そう思えたの
lines.translated: "When I realized that... I felt like I had to protect this child. That no matter what, I had to stay 'beside' this child and bring him lots and lots of happiness. That's how I felt."

lines.content: ……どうして
俺は首をかしげ、言う。
lines.translated: I tilted my head and asked her.

lines.content: どうしてそのことを、俺がここに来たときに教えてくれなかったのかな
lines.translated: "Why didn't you tell me about that when I first came here?"

lines.content: うん……、そうだね。別に隠すことでもないのと同じくらい、わざわざ実はね～って感じでさ、得意そうに言うようなことでもないし
lines.translated: "Hmm... well, you know. Just as much as it wasn't really something to hide, it also wasn't the kind of thing to go out of my way to bring up all smugly, like, 'Actually, the truth is~'"

lines.content: 複雑そうな笑みを浮かべ、ましろは言った。
lines.translated: Wearing a complicated smile, Mashiro continued.

lines.content: 赤ん坊じゃなくなってからも少しの間、一緒にいたよね
lines.translated: "Even after you grew out of being a baby, we were together for a little while, weren't we?"

lines.content: だからあなたが……大雅がもし私を見えていたとしたら。私のこと、少しくらい覚えてくれていたらうれしいなって、思ってた
lines.translated: "So I thought... if you--if Taiga really could see me back then, it would make me happy if you remembered me, even just a little bit."

lines.content: でも、すごいね。赤ちゃんの頃のこと、ずっと忘れずいられるなんて
lines.translated: "Still, that's amazing. To think you've never forgotten something from when you were a baby."

lines.content: 少しだけだよ。ほんとうに、少しだけ
lines.translated: "Only a little bit. Really, just a little."

lines.content: もしかしたら、とは思う。
lines.translated: Maybe, I thought to myself.

lines.content: もしかしたら“夜”の中にいるときだからこそ、いつもよりははっきりと、赤ん坊の頃のことをこうして思い出し、語ることができるのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe it's precisely because I'm inside the "Night" that I'm able to recall and talk about the time I was a baby so much more clearly than usual like this.

lines.content: ……赤ん坊の俺が、あめ玉だとか、甘いお菓子を握りしめてると……、君は“隣”で目をきらきらさせてたよね
lines.translated: "...Back when I was a baby, whenever I was clutching a piece of hard candy or some sweet treat... your eyes would always sparkle right 'beside' me, wouldn't they?"

lines.content: あ、あはは……、そんなこともあったかもしれないね。……ほんとに覚えてるんだね。恥ずかしいなあ
lines.translated: "Ah, ahaha... That might have happened, yeah. ...You really do remember. How embarrassing."

lines.content: 俺の握りしめていたのは、あめ玉か、キャラメルか……。
lines.translated: What I was clutching in my hand was either a hard candy, or a caramel...

lines.content: もしかしたらチョコレートだったかもしれない。
lines.translated: Or maybe it was chocolate.

lines.content: 君は[・|そ][・|れ]に釘付けだった。
lines.translated: Your eyes were always glued to it.
'Fuwaa~...'

lines.content: と、顔を緩ませ。
lines.translated: Your expression would melt like that.

lines.content: 『う、うう……じゅるり』
lines.translated: 'U-Uuu... *drool*'

lines.content: と、涎をこぼし。
lines.translated: And you'd start drooling.

lines.content: そんな“半透明”な君のことがなんだかおかしくて。
lines.translated: Seeing the "translucent" you act like that was kind of funny to me.

lines.content: たぶん、かわいくも思って……。
lines.translated: And I probably thought you were cute, too...

lines.content: 一緒に笑って甘いお菓子を食べてみたい。
lines.translated: I wanted us to laugh together and eat sweet treats together.

lines.content: そんな願いが叶ったら、とてもうれしい。
lines.translated: If a wish like that could come true, it would make me so happy.

lines.content: そういうふうに思い始めたのはもちろん、自我が芽生え始めた頃だった。
lines.translated: Naturally, it was around the time my sense of self began to bud that I started thinking that way.

lines.content: 同時に、それを叶えるのは難しいともわかってた。
lines.translated: At the same time, I also understood how difficult it would be to make that wish come true.

lines.content: だって……。
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: だって俺は、君に触れられないどころか、“お名前は？”と覚えたての言葉で問いかけてみても、その声だって届かない。
lines.translated: After all, not only could I not touch you, even when I tried asking "What's your name?" using the words I'd just learned, my voice wouldn't reach you either.

lines.content: 君はただ、微笑んだまま首をかしげるだけだった。
lines.translated: You would simply keep smiling and tilt your head.

lines.content: そんな[・|不][・|思][・|議][・|な][・|君]が、俺の“隣”からいなくなってしまったのはいつくらいのことだっただろう。
lines.translated: When was it that the mysterious you disappeared from "beside" me?

lines.content: 何気なく目を覚ましたその朝に、いつも“隣”にあるはずの微笑みがなかった。
lines.translated: On that morning when I casually woke up, the smile that was always supposed to be "beside" me was gone.

lines.content: 探し回ったけれどどこにもいない。
lines.translated: I searched all over, but you were nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 名前を呼ぼうにも、俺はあの子の名前を知らなかった。
lines.translated: Even if I wanted to call out your name, I didn't know what that girl's name was.

lines.content: ……誰の“隣”にも、あの子ような“半透明”がいてくれるのだと思ってた。
lines.translated: I had thought that everyone had someone "translucent" like her right "beside" them.

lines.content: いつも笑顔で力を貸してくれているものだと、思ってた。
lines.translated: I had thought it was only natural that they were always there smiling and lending their strength.

lines.content: だからたとえどんなに大変なことがあろうとも、この世界に生きている者は、その“[半透明|誰か]”と一緒に、すべて乗り越えていけるのだろうとも感じていた。
lines.translated: That's why I also felt that no matter what hardships might come, everyone living in this world would be able to overcome it all together with that "translucent someone."

lines.content: だから俺は、大人たちに“あのひとはどこへ行ったの？”と何度も問いかけ、君のことを探したけれど……。
lines.translated: So I asked the adults over and over, "Where did that person go?" as I searched for you, and yet...

lines.content: でも[・|そ][・|れ]は、決して当たり前なことなんかじゃなかったんだって、知ったんだ
lines.translated: "That's when I learned that it was never something to be taken for granted at all."

lines.content: そのとき俺が知ったのは、今まで自分が“特別”な時間の中にいたんだということと……
lines.translated: "What I learned back then was that I had been living inside a 'special' time all along, and..."

lines.content: 君についてだ。……ましろ。周りの大人たちから、俺は君についての話を聞かされたんだ
lines.translated: "About you. ...Mashiro. The adults around me told me the story about you."

lines.content: 私について……
lines.translated: "About me..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: あなたの周りの大人たちは、私のことをどんなふうに言ってたのかな。ちょっとだけ興味あるかもだね
lines.translated: "I wonder how the adults around you talked about me. I might be a little curious about that."

lines.content: 俺はそれを簡単に語った。大人たちから聞いた君についての話をだ。
lines.translated: I recounted it simply. The story about her that I had heard from the adults.

lines.content: ……[・|今]からずっとずっと遠い“[昔|過去]”のこと
lines.translated: "...This is a story from a 'past' far, far away from now."

lines.content: そんなふうに、おとぎ話でも語ろうかというような口上を添えてから。
lines.translated: I prefaced it like that, as though I were about to tell a fairy tale.

lines.content: 昔々……とある一本のさくらの樹の下に、毎夜集まる子ども達の姿があった。
lines.translated: Once upon a time... beneath a certain cherry tree, there were children who gathered every single night.

lines.content: ……子ども達はこの世界を生きることにもはや飽いていた。
lines.translated: The children had already grown weary of living in this world.

lines.content: 誰からも愛されず。誰からも疎まれて。……理由なき残酷さに、何度も嘆き、苦しんだ。
lines.translated: Loved by no one. Shunned by everyone. ...Over and over, they grieved and suffered from a cruelty that had no reason.

lines.content: つらいばかりの子ども時代だ。
lines.translated: It was a childhood filled with nothing but pain.

lines.content: 子どもらをそういう状況に閉じ込めるのは、本来、いっぱいの愛を持って微笑みかけてくれなくてはならないはずの大人たちで……しかし。
lines.translated: The ones trapping the children in that situation were the adults, who by all rights should have been smiling upon them with abundant love... and yet.

lines.content: お父さん。お母さん。
lines.translated: Father. Mother.

lines.content: そう呼ばれる大人たちこそが、少女らの心や身体を、よろこんで虐げていた。
lines.translated: It was the very adults called by those names who gladly abused the girls in body and mind.

lines.content: 怪物だ。
lines.translated: They were monsters.

lines.content: もはや大人たちは残酷な物語の中で微笑む恐ろしい怪物のようだった。
lines.translated: By that point, the adults were like terrifying monsters smiling inside a cruel story.

lines.content: 自分たちもいつか、あんなふうに――残酷な怪物めいた大人になるのか……。
lines.translated: Would they, too, someday become like that--cruel, monster-like adults...?

lines.content: いやだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……自分たちを追い詰め、なぶり、都合のいいように言いくるめ、まるで子どもらのほうにこそ咎があると言わんばかりに軽んじて……
lines.translated: "...Cornering them, tormenting them, twisting words to suit their own convenience, looking down on them as if to say the children were the ones at fault..."

lines.content: そんな怪物に自分たちもいつか必ず育ってしまう
lines.translated: "Someday, they too would inevitably grow up into monsters like that."

lines.content: ……いやだよ。
lines.translated: No, I don't want that.

lines.content: 自分以外の誰にもやさしくできなくなるような……。そんな心の持ち主になんて。
lines.translated: To become someone with a heart like that... incapable of being kind to anyone but oneself.

lines.content: そんなふうになるくらいなら、永遠に子どものままでいたい。
lines.translated: If they were going to end up like that, they would rather remain children forever.

lines.content: お願い。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: 助けて。
lines.translated: Help us.

lines.content: ……命や心を乱暴に、残酷に、削られ続ける毎日の中、いつも誰かに助けを求めてた
lines.translated: "...Every single day, as their lives and hearts were violently, cruelly whittled away, they were always crying out for someone to save them."

lines.content: だけど決して、誰も助けに駆けつけてきてはくれない――この世界にヒーローはいないのだと子ども達は知る。
lines.translated: Yet no one ever came rushing to their rescue--the children learned that there were no heroes in this world.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 恋するための物語どころの話ではない。
lines.translated: This was far from a story meant for falling in love.

lines.content: ここは地獄だ。やさしいばかりの物語が入り込む余地のないただの現実。
lines.translated: This place was hell. Nothing more than a reality with no room for gentle stories to slip in.

lines.content: ならばいっそ、自分たちで望む世界を作ってしまおう
lines.translated: "In that case, why not just create the world we wish for ourselves?"

lines.content: ……集まった子ども達は誰もがみんな“特別”だった。それぞれが夢を語る“才能”に富んでいた。
lines.translated: Every single one of the children who gathered there was "special." Each of them was richly blessed with the "talent" to speak of dreams.

lines.content: 毎夜、つらく苦しいばかりの現実からほんのひと時抜けだして――理想の世界を語り合い、歌い合い、描き合い――それぞれの“心”の中に、やさしいばかりのきらめく世界を“想像”した。
lines.translated: Every night, they would slip away for just a brief moment from a reality filled only with pain and suffering--talking, singing, and painting their ideal world together--and within each of their "hearts," they "imagined" a sparkling world filled with nothing but kindness.

lines.content: ……そうだ。あくまでも“想像”だった
lines.translated: "...Yes. It was strictly 'imagination.'"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は子どもらがつらい現実から目を逸らし、心を守るための空想でしかなかったのだ。
lines.translated: It was nothing more than a fantasy for the children to avert their eyes from a painful reality and protect their own hearts.

lines.content: この世に創造される“作品世界”とは往々にしてそういうものだ――苦しい現実に打ちのめされ、あるいは大切な人と“さよなら”をせざるを得なかった悲しい運命。
lines.translated: The "fictional worlds" created in this world are often like that--born from a sad fate where one is beaten down by a painful reality, or forced to say "goodbye" to someone precious.

lines.content: 大きなおおきな悲しみに、一度は倒れ伏してしまった者の心を言葉は、旋律は、色彩は、やさしく包み慰めて、時に、再び立ち上がらせるための“[ひかり|炎]”ともなるだろう。
lines.translated: For a heart that has been brought to its knees by a great, overwhelming sorrow, words, melodies, and colors can gently wrap around and console it, at times even becoming a "light"--a "flame"--to help them stand once more.

lines.content: そういう目には見えない力のようなものを求め、人の心は物語や歌を求めるはずだ――決して触れられもしない“世界”を造り上げようと願うのだ。
lines.translated: It must be in search of an invisible power like that that the human heart seeks out stories and songs--wishing to build a "world" that can never even be touched.

lines.content: そうして少女たちは、自分たちのために[空想した|造り上げた]“[それ|作品]”を“夜の国”と名付けた。
lines.translated: And so, the girls named "that"--the "work" they had fantasized and built for themselves--"the Land of Night."

lines.content: 自分たちが集まる夜にしか、それぞれの心の中にしか存在を開かない秘密の国だ。
lines.translated: It was a secret land that opened its existence only on the nights they gathered, and only within each of their hearts.

lines.content: 仲間同士の[・|心][・|の][・|中][・|に][・|だ][・|け]共通して存在するその“夜”は、少女らの“想像”するものすべてが叶う国”だった。
lines.translated: That "Night," which existed in common only within the hearts of those companions, was a land where everything the girls "imagined" would come true.

lines.content: ……もちろん[・|そ][・|れ]は実在しない
lines.translated: "...Of course, it didn't actually exist."

lines.content: たとえ、そこに住むのだと空想するモノへ語りかけてみても、もちろん何ら言葉は返ってこないし、この指先がそれらに触れられることもないけれど……
lines.translated: "Even if they tried speaking to the things they fantasized lived there, naturally no words would ever come back, and their fingertips could never touch them, either, and yet..."

lines.content: その[空想|世界]があれば。
lines.translated: As long as they had that fantasy--that world.

lines.content: その集いさえあれば。
lines.translated: As long as they had that gathering.

lines.content: ……仲間たちと“夢”を語り合えるその時間さえ、失われることがなければ。
lines.translated: As long as that time to share their "dreams" with their companions was never lost.

lines.content: ……子ども達は、ただそれだけで、自分のことをまるで人間とも扱わないような大人にも、苦しいばかりの下らない現実にも負けず、倒れず、泣かずにいられたのに
lines.translated: "...With just that alone, the children could have kept from losing, kept from falling, and kept from crying in the face of adults who didn't even treat them like human beings, and in the face of a worthless reality filled only with pain."
How did it happen?

lines.content: その子どもらは誰もがいわゆる天才で――物語や歌や風景など、仮想した現実を心の中に形作るため持ち寄ったその“才能”が――あんまりにも現実離れし過ぎていたためか。
lines.translated: Perhaps it was because every one of those children was a so-called genius--and the "talents" they brought together to give shape to that imagined reality within their hearts through stories, songs, and landscapes were simply far too detached from reality.

lines.content: いつしか少女らの“空想”と“現実”との境目が曖昧になった――……まず、さくらだ。
lines.translated: Before anyone knew it, the boundary between the girls' "fantasy" and "reality" grew blurred--...First, it was the cherry blossoms.

lines.content: この町のさくらの花が一斉に咲いた
lines.translated: "All the cherry blossoms in this town bloomed at once."

lines.content: その花びらはまるで溶けない雪の結晶だった。
lines.translated: Their petals were like crystals of snow that would never melt.

lines.content: それは幾重にもいくえにも降り重なって……。町は瞬く間に薄紅色の底へと沈んでいった。
lines.translated: They fell and piled up in layer upon endless layer... In the blink of an eye, the town sank to the bottom of a pale crimson sea.

lines.content: 更に夜が訪れると、町はその姿を変貌させた――
lines.translated: Furthermore, when night fell, the town transformed its appearance--

lines.content: 夜の隙間から見慣れぬ不思議で奇妙な“イキモノ”が現れて、そこら中を[ばっこ|跋扈]しはじめた。こしょこしょ何やら囁き合っては蠢いた。
lines.translated: From the crevices of the night, unfamiliar, mysterious, and bizarre "Creatures" appeared and began running rampant all over the place. They squirmed about, whispering to one another in hushed voices.

lines.content: 春の季節が過ぎ去ろうと、その“不思議”は止むこともなく……。
lines.translated: Even when the spring season passed, that "mystery" never ceased...

lines.content: 大人たちは恐れた。
lines.translated: The adults were afraid.

lines.content: このままだと町に人が住めなくなる。……このままだと、いっぱいの花びらに溺れてしまう。
lines.translated: At this rate, people won't be able to live in this town anymore. ...At this rate, we'll drown in all these flower petals.

lines.content: 夜になると現れる不思議な“イキモノ”に、いつか誰かが喰われることもあるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Someday, someone might even be devoured by the mysterious "Creatures" that appear when night falls.

lines.content: 身の丈ほどにも降り積もった花びらは、人々の生活を脅かすに留まらず……
lines.translated: "The petals, which had piled up as high as a person's head, didn't just threaten people's daily lives..."

lines.content: 子ども達を傷つけてきた意地悪な心を持つ一部の大人たちが、ふと[・|そ][・|れ]に触れたなら、その身体は、[・|た][・|っ][・|ぷ][・|り][・|時][・|間][・|を][・|掛][・|け][・|て][・|ば][・|ら][・|ば][・|ら][・|に][・|も][・|な][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: When some of the malicious-hearted adults who had been hurting the children happened to touch them, their bodies were slowly, painstakingly torn to pieces.

lines.content: 苦しみ、喘ぎ、のたうち回った挙げ句そうなるそのさまは……まるで。
lines.translated: The way they ended up like that after writhing around, gasping and agonizing... was just like...

lines.content: まるで自分たちが、子ども達に行ってきた仕打ちと殆ど同じ有様で……
lines.translated: "It was in almost the exact same state as the treatment they had been inflicting upon the children..."

lines.content: 乱暴に鞭打ったのなら、その背中には幾つものミミズ腫れが浮かび上がって。
lines.translated: If they had violently whipped a child, countless welts would rise upon their own backs.

lines.content: 心のない言葉で責め立てたのなら、その心は冷たくひび割れ病んでは滅ぶ。
lines.translated: If they had berated a child with heartless words, their own hearts would coldly crack, sicken, and perish.
This is a curse.

lines.content: そこに根拠なんて何もないのに、すべては子ども達のせいだとし――
lines.translated: Even though there was no basis for it whatsoever, they blamed it all on the children--

lines.content: そういう大人たちだから、元来、子ども達に人とも思えぬ扱いを強いていたのだ――これは自分たちへの復讐なのだと、大人達は身勝手に思い込んだ。
lines.translated: Because they were that kind of adults, they had been forcing inhuman treatment upon the children from the very beginning--and so the adults selfishly convinced themselves that this was revenge against them.

lines.content: 現実世界でしきりに虐げられていた子ども達の命を、咲き乱れるさくらの樹に捧げることで、その“不思議”は鎮まるものと、大人たちは強引に信じた。
lines.translated: The adults forcefully believed that by offering up the lives of the children, who had been relentlessly abused in the real world, to the wildly blooming cherry tree, that "mystery" would be quelled.

lines.content: “これは町を守るため、仕方のないことなのだ”
lines.translated: "This is to protect the town; it cannot be helped."

lines.content: そのような大義名分を得たことで、意地悪な大人たちはよろこんで少女らを順番に食い物とした。
lines.translated: Having obtained such a convenient justification, the malicious adults gladly preyed upon the girls one after another.

lines.content: 最初からそうできるだけの理由をいつも探していたのだから躊躇いもなかった。
lines.translated: Because they had always been looking for an excuse to do just that from the very start, there was no hesitation.

lines.content: 少女たちに対する普段と変わらぬ残酷な態度と方法で、その命をかけらも残さず、さくらの木の根に次々埋めた。
lines.translated: With the same cruel attitude and methods they always used toward the girls, they buried their lives one after another beneath the roots of the cherry tree, without leaving a single shred behind.

lines.content: ……君は、ましろ。そのとき犠牲になった少女たちのうちのひとりだ
lines.translated: "...Mashiro, you are one of the girls who was sacrificed back then."

lines.content: そう聞いてる。
lines.translated: That's what I was told.

lines.content: 今こうして目の前にいる君は、その子の幽霊……、ということになるのかな。そんな君を、さくらの樹に眠り続けていた君のことを、[・|誰][・|か]が起こした
lines.translated: "The you standing in front of me right now would be that girl's ghost... I suppose. And someone woke you up--you, who had been sleeping inside the cherry tree all that time."

lines.content: そういうふうに、聞いている――これは俺たちの家に代々伝わっている言い伝えだ。正しいか正しくないかはわからない。ただ、脈々と伝えられているのだ。
lines.translated: That's how I heard it--this is a legend passed down for generations in our family. I don't know whether it's true or not. It has simply been passed down in an unbroken line.

lines.content: その[・|誰][・|か]と共に、君はこの“夜”を創り上げたんだ
lines.translated: "Together with that someone, you created this 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……かつて数人の少女たちが、意地悪な大人たちからせめて心だけでも逃げ出そうと思い描いた世界を、現実の世界に掬い上げたんだ
lines.translated: "...You scooped up into the real world the world that those few girls once envisioned so that at least their hearts could escape from the malicious adults."

lines.content: それが、大人たちから君について聞いたことのすべてだ――と、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]俺は話した。
lines.translated: That is everything I heard about you from the adults--that was how I explained it to her.

lines.content: 君は俺に、自分には命はないと言っていたよね。……でも、大人たちからは、君という存在は命そのものだとも聞いたよ
lines.translated: "You told me that you didn't have a life of your own, right? ...However, I also heard from the adults that your existence is life itself."

lines.content: ……だから、幽霊だとかそういうものとはまた少し、違うのかもしれない。
lines.translated: So maybe you're a little different from a ghost or anything like that.

lines.content: 君は遠い昔にこの世を去ったはずの女の子。その命の形なんだって大人たちは言っている
lines.translated: "You're a girl who was supposed to have left this world a long time ago. The adults say that you are the shape of her life."

lines.content: ……そんな君が、今、この場所を――“夜の国”を守ってるとも聞いた。
lines.translated: I also heard that right now, you're protecting this place--the "Land of Night."

lines.content: 今も昔も変わることなく、一部の大人たちの心はどうしようもなく意地悪で……。
lines.translated: Unchanged from the past even now, the hearts of some of those adults are hopelessly malicious...

lines.content: そんな彼らは、君がここにこうしているから、“夜”に手出しすることができないのだとも言っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: And they also said that because you're here like this, they can't lay a hand on the "Night"...

lines.content: そうした最後の言葉は口にすることなく、俺は飲み込む。
lines.translated: Without speaking those final words aloud, I swallowed them back.

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: ましろは深く、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Mashiro nodded deeply.

lines.content: そういう[・|記][・|憶]が、確かに、私の中にはあるみたいだね
lines.translated: "It seems there really is a memory like that inside me."

lines.content: ……記憶？
lines.translated: "...A memory?"

lines.content: そうだよとましろはうなずき、答えてくれる。
lines.translated: "That's right," Mashiro nodded in reply.

lines.content: そういう記憶が、思い出がね、私の中にあるんだってことを……、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]が去ってひとりぼっちなってから、少しずつだけど、気づいてはいたんだよ
lines.translated: "Ever since that girl left and I ended up all alone, little by little, I've been realizing... that I have memories and recollections like that inside me."

lines.content: ……ひとりぼっちは時間だけはいっぱいあるからね。だからたくさん、自分のことを考えたよ。そしてその記憶を自分の中に見つけられたんだ
lines.translated: "...When you're all alone, the one thing you have plenty of is time. So I thought a lot about myself. And I was able to find those memories within me."
"I'm... surely nobody at all. I'm nothing more than a 'something' that is simply here."

lines.content: かつて意地悪な大人たちの犠牲になり、その心と命とを犠牲にした女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who once fell victim to malicious adults, sacrificing both her heart and her life.

lines.content: そんな“誰か”の記憶が“夜”を通じて――あるいは自分を起こした“誰か”の“才能”によって、都合良くここに形となったもの。
lines.translated: The memories of that "someone" conveniently took form here through the "Night"--or perhaps through the "talent" of the "someone" who woke her up.

lines.content: もしかしたら少女の“才能”そのもの、とも言えるのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps it could even be called the girl's very "talent" itself.

lines.content: ……だからここに本当の意味での命はないの。自分は、何者でもない。だから、まっしろ――“[ここ|夜]”で生きる“イキモノ”たちの中でそういう存在は珍しくないから
lines.translated: "...That's why there is no true life here. I am nobody. That's why I'm pure white--because among the 'Creatures' living in the 'Night,' existences like that aren't uncommon."

lines.content: 自分もその“珍しくないもの”の中のひとつでしかない。
lines.translated: She, too, was nothing more than one of those "uncommon things."

lines.content: ましろはそう言い、町に向けた視線をふと揺らし、足下へと落としてしまう。
lines.translated: Saying that, Mashiro let her gaze, which had been turned toward the town, waver slightly before dropping it to her feet.

lines.content: それ以上はなにも話そうとはしなかった。
lines.translated: She didn't try to say anything more than that.

lines.content: 名前を呼んでみても返事はない。ただ繋いだままの手のひらに、ほんの僅かに力がこもるだけだった。
lines.translated: Even when I tried calling her name, there was no answer. Only a faint trace of strength entered the palm of her hand, which was still joined with mine.

lines.content: だけど、不思議だ。
lines.translated: Still, it was strange.
What should I do?

lines.content: ましろは今、沈黙の中で、遠い昔の記憶にいて思っているのかもしれない。
lines.translated: In the silence right now, Mashiro might be dwelling inside the memories of the distant past, lost in thought.

lines.content: 繋いだ手からその記憶が、“想い”が……、ああ、どうしよう……“夜”を通し、止めどなく流れ込んでくる。
lines.translated: From our joined hands, those memories, those "feelings"... ah, what should I do... through the "Night," they came flowing into me endlessly.

lines.content: 目を覚ました。
lines.translated: I woke up.

lines.content: “夜”から朝へと心は戻る――ぼんやりと右手を見ていた。
lines.translated: My mind returned from the "Night" to the morning--I was staring blankly at my right hand.

lines.content: “夢”の中で彼女と繋いだ手のひらだ。
lines.translated: It was the palm that had been joined with hers inside the "dream."

lines.content: そこから、[・|ま][・|っ][・|し][・|ろ][・|に][・|な][・|る][・|前]の少女の記憶が、俺の中に流れ込んできていた。
lines.translated: From there, the memories of the girl from before she became pure white had been flowing into me.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じずともその光景は、“夢”から目覚めても尚、ありありと心の中で見つめることができる。
lines.translated: Even without closing my eyelids, even after waking from the "dream," I could still gaze vividly at that scenery within my mind.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]にあえて名前を付けるなら……。
lines.translated: If I had to give it a name...

lines.content: ……“悪夢”だ
lines.translated: "...It's a 'nightmare.'"

lines.content: ため息のように、あるいは寝苦しくうめくようにして、洩らした。
lines.translated: Like a sigh, or like a groan from a restless sleep, I let the words slip out.

lines.content: 抱えた頭のその中には、やはり、誰かの心の映像が止めどなく溢れてくる。
lines.translated: Inside my head as I clutched it, the images of someone's heart continued to overflow endlessly.

lines.content: ――[・|そ][・|れ]はつらいばかりの少女時代だった。
lines.translated: --It was a girlhood filled with nothing but pain.

lines.content: 真っ暗な部屋だった。
lines.translated: It was a pitch-black room.

lines.content: 小さな女の子がさみしくて泣いている。
lines.translated: A little girl was crying out of loneliness.

lines.content: 女の子は母親のことが大好きだった。
lines.translated: The girl loved her mother very much.

lines.content: でも、母親は、女の子のことになどかけらも興味はなかった。
lines.translated: However, her mother didn't have a shred of interest in the girl.

lines.content: だから暗く湿っぽい地下室に、長い間、女の子のことを閉じ込めていた。外の世界からその存在を[・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|こ][・|と]にしたかった。
lines.translated: That was why she had locked the girl away in a dark, damp basement for a long time. She wanted to pretend her existence had never happened, hiding her from the outside world.

lines.content: 地下室の女の子は重い病を患っていた。
lines.translated: The girl in the basement suffered from a severe illness.

lines.content: 生まれつき心臓の機能がとても、低い。身体が時を刻むだけ、鼓動は弱く、小さく、なっていく。
lines.translated: From birth, her heart function had been very low. With every passing moment her body ticked away, her heartbeat grew weaker and fainter.

lines.content: 医学も、信仰も。誰にもそれを止められない。
lines.translated: Neither medicine nor faith. No one could stop it.

lines.content: その苦しみに耐えかね細い声で母を呼べども、しかし、寝たきりのベッドに駆けつけてくれるものはいなかった――
lines.translated: Unable to bear the agony, she called out for her mother in a thin voice, yet no one ever came running to the bed where she lay bedridden--

lines.content: 地下室の天井からは、いつだって、楽しそうな家族の笑い声だけが聞こえてくる。
lines.translated: From the ceiling of the basement, all she could ever hear was the happy laughter of her family.

lines.content: お父さん。お母さん。
lines.translated: Father. Mother.
A family of three, with someone else.

lines.content: 『ねえ、教えてよ』
lines.translated: "Hey, tell me."

lines.content: 真っ暗な部屋でひとりきり、幸せそうな家族の笑い声を聞く度に、いつも女の子は天井に向かい問いかけている。
lines.translated: All alone in the pitch-black room, every time she heard the laughter of that happy-sounding family, the girl would always face the ceiling and ask.

lines.content: 『……あなたは、誰なの』
lines.translated: "...Who are you?"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|子]が呼ばれてうれしそうに返事をする名は、地下室の女の子こそが贈られた名前であったはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though the name that child happily answered to when called was supposed to have been the name given to the girl in the basement...

lines.content: きっと[・|私]はふたりの期待を裏切ったのだ。
lines.translated: I must have betrayed the two of their expectations.

lines.content: 何ひとつ自分で満足にできない我が子を、生涯看護し続けるだろう人生だ――そんな未来に、女の子の両親はいつしか“絶望”してしまったのだ。
lines.translated: A life spent nursing their own child, who couldn't do a single thing satisfactorily by herself, until the end of their days--before long, the girl's parents had fallen into "despair" over such a future.

lines.content: [・|だ][・|か][・|ら]母親は――“絶望”に心を呑まれてしまった、母親は――遠い町の病院から、かわいらしい女の赤ん坊をひとり、拉致してしまった。
lines.translated: That was why her mother--her mother, whose heart had been swallowed up by "despair"--abducted an adorable baby girl from a hospital in a distant town.

lines.content: 夫婦は共に名の知れた芸術家で、様々な業界に精通しており――優秀な闇医師を雇う予定だった。
lines.translated: The husband and wife were both renowned artists who were well-versed in various industries--and they had planned to hire a skilled black-market doctor.

lines.content: まず、赤ん坊を[・|適][・|正][・|時][・|期]まで成長させる。
lines.translated: First, they would raise the baby until the proper time.

lines.content: そして、雇った医師に頼んで娘の心臓――だけではなく、弱り切っているあらゆる臓器を入れ替え、娘を健康体にしようと、[・|は][・|じ][・|め][・|は]計画していたけれど……。
lines.translated: And then, at first, they had planned to ask the hired doctor to replace not just their daughter's heart, but every single one of her thoroughly weakened organs to give their daughter a healthy body, however...

lines.content: 母親は、気づいてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: The mother came to a realization.

lines.content: 悪いところだらけ。
lines.translated: Full of flaws.

lines.content: 弱いところだらけ。
lines.translated: Full of weaknesses.

lines.content: ……そんな我が子を助けるよりも、拉致してきた子を自分たちの子として育てたほうが、よっぽど手間が掛からなくていいのではないか。
lines.translated: Rather than saving a child of their own like that, wouldn't it be far less trouble and much better to simply raise the child they had abducted as their own?

lines.content: それはまるで、お気に入りが手に入らなかったからリセットしようというような感覚だ。
lines.translated: It felt just like hitting the reset button because they hadn't gotten the favorite they wanted.

lines.content: 母親も。父親も。愛情を与えるべき[対象|先]を、簡単に塗り替えることができた。
lines.translated: Both the mother and the father were easily able to overwrite the target to whom they should give their affection.

lines.content: なぜなら拉致してきた子はとっても可愛く、愛らしく……。
lines.translated: Because the child they had abducted was so very cute and lovely...

lines.content: ああ、うん、もうこの子でいいじゃない。
lines.translated: Ah, yes, isn't this child good enough already?

lines.content: 改めてそういうふうに思える自分の心に、両親は気づいてしまったのだった。
lines.translated: The parents realized that their own hearts had come to think of it that way.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: そういうことにしてしまおう。
lines.translated: Let's just make it so.

lines.content: はじめから自分たちの子は病んでなどいなかった。健康そのもの。そういうふうにしてしまおう――弱いばかりの[我が子|女の子]を、自分たちの人生の中から切り取ってしまうことにした。
lines.translated: From the very beginning, our child was never sick at all. The very picture of health. Let's make it like that--they decided to cut the girl, their own child who was nothing but weak, right out of their lives.

lines.content: その日以来、身体の悪い女の子は地下へ閉じ込められたままだ。
lines.translated: Since that day, the frail girl remained locked away underground.

lines.content: ……その日以来、その家に、地下室は存在しないものとなった。
lines.translated: Since that day, the basement ceased to exist in that house.

lines.content: 新しくやって来た赤ん坊が、ふたりの本当の子どもだということに、なった。
lines.translated: It was decided that the newly arrived baby was the two of their real child.

lines.content: [・|私]はもうふたりにとって存在しない。
lines.translated: To the two of them, I no longer exist.

lines.content: 食事も水も殆ど与えられず、ついには何日も忘れられ――身体は痩せて、細って……。
lines.translated: Given almost no food or water, and eventually forgotten for days on end--her body grew thin and frail...

lines.content: 『それでも……』
lines.translated: "Even so..."

lines.content: それでも、地下室の女の子は信じていたのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, the girl in the basement still believed.

lines.content: 『それでもいつか、お母さんも、お父さんも、これまでのことを全部ごめんねって言って、謝ってくれて……前みたいに、抱きしめてくれて……』
lines.translated: "Even so, someday, Mom and Dad will say they're sorry for everything up until now, apologize to me... and hug me tight just like before..."

lines.content: また前みたいにたくさん、たくさん、三人一緒にお出かけしたり、きれいなお洋服を着せてもらったり……。
lines.translated: Just like before, the three of us will go out together lots and lots of times, and they'll dress me up in pretty clothes...

lines.content: たくさん、いっぱい、私にやさしくしてくれるはずなんだ。
lines.translated: They'll surely treat me with lots and lots of kindness.

lines.content: 甘いお菓子をいっぱい、いっぱい――食べさせてくれるはず。
lines.translated: They'll surely let me eat lots and lots of sweet treats.

lines.content: ほら、なんだっけ。
lines.translated: Come on, what was it called again?

lines.content: 私の好きだった、あのお菓子。
lines.translated: That treat I used to love.

lines.content: 『甘くて、真っ黒、ぺろぺろ舐めたらあっという間になくなって……。なんだかすごく、幸せになれる甘いやつ』
lines.translated: "It's sweet, pitch-black, and when you lick it, it disappears in the blink of an eye... That sweet thing that somehow makes you feel so very happy."

lines.content: なんて名前のお菓子だったかな。思い出せない。もう心にも、頭にも、栄養が足りてない。
lines.translated: What was the name of that treat again? I can't remember. Neither my heart nor my head has enough nutrition anymore.

lines.content: でもね。大丈夫。いつかそんな大好物だった甘いのを、お母さんとお父さんが、お口いっぱいに頬張らせてくれるはず。そんな私を笑顔で包んでくれるはず。
lines.translated: But you know what? It's okay. Someday, Mom and Dad will surely stuff my cheeks full of that favorite sweet treat of mine. They'll surely wrap me up in their smiles.

lines.content: そういう未来を思い描いて……。
lines.translated: Picturing a future like that...

lines.content: 『せめて今は、“夢”の中だけでも……』
lines.translated: "At least for now, even if it's only inside a 'dream'..."

lines.content: 気づけば女の子は、大きなおおきなさくらの樹の下にいた。
lines.translated: Before she knew it, the girl was beneath a great, huge cherry tree.

lines.content: 町の中心にそびえ立つさくらの樹。
lines.translated: A cherry tree towering in the center of the town.

lines.content: すぐに“夢”だとわかった。
lines.translated: She immediately knew it was a "dream."

lines.content: はらはらと花びらが夜を舞い、その光景をただじっと仰ぎ見るようにして自分は立っている。
lines.translated: Petals fluttered down through the night, and she stood there simply gazing up intently at the sight.

lines.content: ……そこには何人かの子どもたちがいた。
lines.translated: There were several children there.

lines.content: みな一様に、満開に咲いた夜のさくらを見上げていて……“ようこそ”
lines.translated: Every one of them was looking up at the night cherry blossoms blooming in full glory... "Welcome."

lines.content: その子たちが、女の子に微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Those children smiled at the girl.

lines.content: “ようこそ。ぼくたちだけのきらめく世界――[・|夜][・|の][・|国]へ。さあ、一緒に、幸せなばかりの“夢”を見ようか”
lines.translated: "Welcome. To our very own sparkling world--the Land of Night. Come on, let's dream nothing but happy 'dreams' together."

lines.content: そうして差し伸べられた手を、女の子はそっと握った。
lines.translated: The girl gently took the hand that was held out to her.

lines.content: 地下室の女の子は夜になると自由になれた。
lines.translated: When night fell, the girl in the basement could become free.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]は“夢”の世界だ。
lines.translated: This was the world of "dreams."

lines.content: いつも暗く冷たい地下室で、ひとりぼっちで思い描いていた幸せな時間を、あり得たかもしれない人生を、まるで現実のもののように夢見させてくれる……。
lines.translated: It let her dream of the happy times she had always pictured all alone in the dark, cold basement, and the life that might have been, as if they were real...

lines.content: 『お母さん。お父さん。……そして、私』
lines.translated: "Mom. Dad. ...And me."

lines.content: 願ったのは三人一緒に笑い合った、いつか過ぎていった毎日だ。
lines.translated: What she wished for were the days that had long since passed, when the three of them laughed together.

lines.content: どこへ行くにも手と手を繋いだ。
lines.translated: They held hands wherever they went.

lines.content: 真っ青でどこまでも高い空。頬を撫でる暖かな風。時おり空から降り注ぐ雪、雨、光り、花の粒……きらめきのかけら達。
lines.translated: A deep blue sky stretching endlessly high. A warm breeze caressing her cheeks. The snow, rain, light, and flower petals that occasionally fell from the heavens... fragments of sparkling brilliance.

lines.content: 世界はいつでもきらきら輝いて見えていて……。
lines.translated: The world always looked like it was shining brightly...

lines.content: それに負けないくらい、お誕生日にはきらきらのドレスでかわいくきれいに、小さな身体を飾られたりもした。
lines.translated: And on her birthdays, her small body was dressed up just as dazzlingly, made cute and pretty in a sparkling dress.

lines.content: だけど女の子の心には、生まれ付いてほんの少しだけ“安心”が欠けていた。
lines.translated: Yet from the moment she was born, the girl's heart lacked just a tiny bit of "reassurance."

lines.content: ……きっと“嫌われる”ということが女の子にとって何より怖いことだった。
lines.translated: Surely, to the girl, being "hated" was more terrifying than anything else.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だからいつも、女の子は眩しく輝く世界中の一つひとつと自分とを指さして、大切なふたりへと問いかけていた。
lines.translated: That was why the girl would always point to each and every thing in the dazzlingly shining world, and then to herself, asking a question of the two people most precious to her.

lines.content: 『ねえ、お母さん。あのきれいな空と私、どっちが好き？』
lines.translated: "Hey, Mom. Which do you like more, that pretty sky or me?"

lines.content: “もちろんあなたよ”
lines.translated: "You, of course."

lines.content: お母さんはそう応えてくれる。
lines.translated: Her mother would answer her like that.

lines.content: そうすると安心な気持ちになれたのだ。
lines.translated: And when she did, the girl could feel relieved.

lines.content: 『ねえ、お父さん。お誕生日にくれたかわいいドレス。テレビの中のあの子と私、どっちが似合う？』
lines.translated: "Hey, Dad. About the cute dress you gave me for my birthday... Who does it look better on, that girl on TV or me?"

lines.content: もちろん君だよ。当たり前じゃないか。お父さんはそう応えてくれる。
lines.translated: "You, of course. Isn't that obvious?" Her father would answer her like that.

lines.content: そうすると得意な気持ちになれたのだ。
lines.translated: And when he did, she could feel proud.

lines.content: そうしてふたりは、女の子の手を片方ずつ握って歩いてくれた――安心だった。幸せ、だった。
lines.translated: Then the two of them would each take one of the girl's hands and walk with her--she felt safe. She was happy.

lines.content: “ただし”と、お母さんが言った。
lines.translated: "However," her mother said.

lines.content: “あなたがちゃんと、私たちの言うことを聞くいい子だったならね――そうすれば、あの空よりも。あの雲よりも。世界中のどんなものより、あなたが好きよ”
lines.translated: "Only if you're a good girl who properly listens to what we say--if you do that, I'll love you more than that sky. More than those clouds. More than anything else in the whole world."

lines.content: “ああそうだ”と、お父さんが言った。
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right," her father said.

lines.content: “いつまでもひらひらふわふわのドレスが似合うかわいいままの君でいてほしい。君はお父さんのかわいいお姫さまだ。いつまでも、ずっと。そんなかわいい君のままでいてほしい”
lines.translated: "I want you to stay cute forever, looking good in frilly, fluffy dresses. You are Daddy's cute little princess. Forever and always, I want you to stay just as cute as you are."

lines.content: そうでなければ、私たちはあなたのことを嫌いになるかもしれないね――それは何気ない悪戯のような言葉だったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Otherwise, we might come to hate you--perhaps those words were meant as nothing more than a casual, playful tease.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: そんなささいな大人の意地悪さにも、幼い心は不安になって……。嫌われて。見捨てられ。置いて行かれるのが怖くって。
lines.translated: Yet even such trivial adult unkindness made her young heart anxious... She was terrified of being hated. Of being abandoned. Of being left behind.

lines.content: 嫌われないよう“いい子”でいるよと女の子はうなずいた――“いつまでもこのお洋服が似合う子でいるからね”と、約束をした。
lines.translated: The girl nodded, saying she would be a "good girl" so they wouldn't hate her--she made a promise: "I'll forever be a girl who looks good in these clothes."

lines.content: “そう。あなたが私たちの言うことを聞くいい子で、自慢のかわいい子で在り続けるなら、[・|そ][・|れ][・|な][・|ら]私たちも、あなたのことが大好きよ”
lines.translated: "Good. As long as you keep being a good girl who listens to us, and a cute child we can be proud of, then we'll love you very much, too."

lines.content: 『ふたりに“大好きだよ”と認められてはじめて、自分はここにいてもいい子なんだ。そう思えた。そう、思えていたから……』
lines.translated: "Only when the two of them acknowledged me by saying 'We love you' could I feel like I was a child who was allowed to be here. Because that was how I felt..."

lines.content: だから[・|あ][・|の][・|頃][・|は]とても幸せだったのだ。
lines.translated: That was why, back then, she had been so very happy.

lines.content: そんないつかの日のことを、暗く冷たい地下室で、女の子は毎夜“夢”見て過ごした。
lines.translated: In the dark, cold basement, the girl spent every night "dreaming" of those bygone days.

lines.content: でもふたりの期待を裏切ってしまったから――病気になってお母さんの言うことを聞けなくなった、ドレスを来ても似合わない子になってしまった――
lines.translated: But because I betrayed their expectations--because I got sick and couldn't listen to what Mom said anymore, because I became a child who no longer looked good in dresses--

lines.content: ――だから私はここにこうして、閉じ込められている。
lines.translated: --That is why I am locked up in here like this.

lines.content: きっと新しいいい子で、かわいい子を、見つけてきたんだろうから。
lines.translated: Because they must have gone and found a new, good, cute child.

lines.content: でも、大丈夫。私は平気。
lines.translated: But it's okay. I'm fine.

lines.content: ……その日、どんなにふたりから無視されても。乱暴されても。投げかけた大好きなんだよの言葉に、返事をもらえなかろうとも。
lines.translated: On that day, no matter how much the two of them ignored her. No matter how rough they were with her. Even if she got no reply to the words "I love you" that she called out to them.

lines.content: 『また夜が来れば、まるで現実みたいな幸せな“夢”を、見ることができるから……』
lines.translated: "Because when night comes again, I can see a happy 'dream' that feels just like reality..."

lines.content: これからも何とか生きていけるはずだった。
lines.translated: She should have been able to manage to keep living from here on out.

lines.content: 『だけどもしもまた、現実の中ででも[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|き][・|る][・|な][・|ら]……もう一度だけ、ふたりに[・|問][・|い]かけてみたい』
lines.translated: "Still, if I could do that again, even in reality... Just once more, I want to try asking the two of them."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]が女の子の“夢”だった。
lines.translated: That was the girl's "dream."

lines.content: いい子にも、かわいい子にもなれなかった私だけれど……ふたりにとってそういう私になりたいと、誰よりも願ってきた。
lines.translated: Even though I couldn't become a good child or a cute child... more than anyone else, I wished to become that kind of person for the two of them.

lines.content: 『ねえ、お母さん。お父さん。教えてほしいな。新しく家に来た、あのかわいい子と、私、どっちのことが……』
lines.translated: "Hey, Mom. Dad. Please tell me. Between that cute child who newly came to our house, and me, which one of us do you..."

lines.content: そこまでで口を閉ざした。そして、[まぶた|瞼]と心も静かに閉じた。
lines.translated: She closed her mouth right there. And then, she quietly closed her eyelids and her heart as well.

lines.content: そうして今夜も“夢”を見る。
lines.translated: Like that, she would have a "dream" tonight, too.

lines.content: 一度“夜”で目覚めてからというもの、女の子は自由に[・|そ][・|こ]へ出入りすることができるようになっていた。
lines.translated: Ever since she first awoke in the "Night," the girl had become able to freely come and go from there.

lines.content: 『はじまりはいつも、さくらの樹の下からだ……』
lines.translated: "It always begins beneath the cherry tree..."

lines.content: 堅く冷たいベッドで[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて、次に開くと、はら、はら、はらりと舞い降る花のかけらを見上げているのだ――それが“夜”の始まりだった。
lines.translated: She would close her eyelids on the hard, cold bed, and when she opened them next, she would be looking up at the fragments of flowers fluttering softly down--that was the beginning of the "Night."

lines.content: そこから自由に思い描くのだ。
lines.translated: From there, she would freely picture it in her mind.

lines.content: 今夜、心をやさしく包んでほしい“夢”の内容を。
lines.translated: The contents of the "dream" that she wanted to gently wrap around her heart tonight.

lines.content: そうするだけで夜の中に私だけの“夜”が産まれる。そうするだけで、思い描いた以上のやさしさが芽生えてくれる。
lines.translated: Just by doing so, a "Night" of my very own is born within the night. Just by doing so, a kindness even greater than what I pictured buds into life for me.

lines.content: 『もう、ね。これ以上は何もいらない。現実も。そうでないものも。……この“夜”さえあれば、それだけで』
lines.translated: "Really, I don't need anything more than this. Not reality. Not anything else. ...As long as I have this 'Night,' that alone is enough."

lines.content: だけど、幾度目の夜だったか。
lines.translated: However, how many nights had it been?

lines.content: 『ここはいったい、何なんだろう』
lines.translated: "Just what on earth is this place?"

lines.content: ふとした疑問が今さらながら湧いたのだ。
lines.translated: A sudden question welled up in her after all this time.

lines.content: このさくらの樹はね、生きているんだよ
lines.translated: "This cherry tree, you know, is alive."

lines.content: 女の子の疑問に答える声があった。
lines.translated: There was a voice answering the girl's question.

lines.content: “夜”のはじまり。さくらの樹の下だった。
lines.translated: The beginning of the "Night." It was beneath the cherry tree.

lines.content: 今夜も幸せなばかりの“夢”を見ようと[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて、開いたのだけど……その隣に小さな子が立っていて、ふとしたつぶやきに応えてくれた。
lines.translated: Tonight as well, she had closed her eyelids and opened them to have a "dream" filled with nothing but happiness... yet a small child was standing beside her, answering her casual murmur.

lines.content: 長いながい時間を掛けて成長し、この町で産まれては死んでいく……そんなたくさんの[命|人生]をここでこうして、この樹はね、今も昔も見守り続けてきた
lines.translated: "Taking a long, long time to grow, being born in this town and then dying... Right here like this, now and in the past, this tree has kept watching over so many lives."

lines.content: ……そうした長い時間の中で、いつか、このさくらの樹にはぼくら人間の心とよく似た何かが宿ったんだよ
lines.translated: "...Over all that long time, at some point, something very similar to our human hearts came to dwell within this cherry tree."

lines.content: それはまるで、心を込めて作られた[・|物]や[・|作][・|品]に、長い歳月を経て新しく命がこもることがあるように。
lines.translated: It was just like how an object or a work of art made with all one's heart can sometimes take on a new life of its own over the course of many long years.

lines.content: そういう[心|存在]のことを、人は、昔から神さまと呼ぶのかもしれないね
lines.translated: "People might have called a heart--an existence--like that 'God' since long ago."

lines.content: とにかく、とその子は続ける。
lines.translated: "Anyway," the child continued.

lines.content: そうしてさくらの樹の中に産まれた心――によく似た何かは、つらくさみしい思いをしている子らの[命|人生]に、強く、共感したんだろう。何とかして救ってあげたいと、願ったんだろう
lines.translated: "The heart--or something very much like it--that was born inside the cherry tree must have felt a deep empathy for the lives of children suffering through painful, lonely feelings. It must have wished to save them somehow."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: せめて“夢”の中だけでも心休めるように……。
lines.translated: So that their hearts could rest, at least inside a "dream"...

lines.content: 幸せなばかりの明日を、信じられるように……。
lines.translated: So that they could believe in a tomorrow filled with nothing but happiness...

lines.content: 日々、理不尽に傷つけられてばかりの子ども達の“想い”を、あのさくらの中で、神さまみたいに育った“何か”は、自身の中に産まれた心を受け皿として迎え入れていたんだ
lines.translated: "That 'something' which grew like a god inside the cherry tree used the heart born within itself as a vessel to welcome in the 'feelings' of children who are unreasonably hurt day after day."

lines.content: それがぼくらで、それが[・|こ][・|こ]なんだよと、その子は言った。
lines.translated: "That is what we are, and that is what this place is," the child said.

lines.content: 君は今、どんな悲しみの中にいるのかな。
lines.translated: "What kind of sadness are you in the middle of right now, I wonder?"

lines.content: そう問われたけれど、女の子は何も応えられず、ただ[まぶた|瞼]を瞬かせた。
lines.translated: Though asked that question, the girl could not answer at all, and simply blinked her eyelids.

lines.content: ――心に思い描いたすべてが叶う場所
lines.translated: "--A place where everything you picture in your heart comes true."

lines.content: 男の子は、続けて言う。
lines.translated: The boy continued speaking.

lines.content: それは、現実世界に打ちのめされ、泣き濡れて、倒れ伏してしまった子どもたちの心を慰め、あるいは再び歩んでいけるよう応援したいと願う、あの樹が宿した心そのものだ
lines.translated: "It is the very heart housed within that tree, wishing to comfort the hearts of children who have been beaten down by the real world, soaked in tears, and left collapsed on the ground--or wishing to cheer them on so they can walk again."

lines.content: そうしたさくらの“心”をキャンバスにして、思いおもいの絵を描こう。歌を歌おう。物語を、描いていこう――
lines.translated: Using the cherry tree's "heart" as a canvas, let's paint whatever pictures we like. Let's sing songs. Let's weave stories--

lines.content: そうすることで、現実よりも幾分か生きやすい世界ができあがったなら……
lines.translated: "By doing so, if we can create a world that is somewhat easier to live in than reality..."

lines.content: 今もさみしさや悲しさに押しつぶされそうになっているたくさんの子どもたちを、その心を……
lines.translated: "Then the many children who are even now about to be crushed by loneliness and sadness, their hearts..."

lines.content: もしかしたらその人生だって、ここに芽生えはじめた“夜”が救ってあげられるかもしれない
lines.translated: "And perhaps even their lives, might be saved by the 'Night' that has begun to bud here."

lines.content: そのためにさくらの樹に呼ばれた自分たちは、毎夜のように特別な“夜”の世界を思い描いているのだという。
lines.translated: He said that for that purpose, those of them who had been called to the cherry tree pictured a special world of "Night" almost every single night.

lines.content: しかし、誰もが自身の“想像力”を上手に操れるわけではなくて……。
lines.translated: However, not everyone was able to skillfully wield their own "imagination"...

lines.content: きっと、さみしさや悲しみを人より多く感じられる心にこそ、絶望の底にいる誰かを勇気づけるような……そんな“夢”を語るのに相応しい“[想い|才能]”が、より多く、眠ってるんだ
lines.translated: "Surely, it is within hearts that can feel more loneliness and sadness than others that a greater 'talent'--the kind of feelings suited for telling 'dreams' that can give courage to someone at the bottom of despair--lies dormant."

lines.content: 男の子は、どこか悲しそうな表情を浮かべていた。
lines.translated: The boy wore a somewhat sad expression.

lines.content: 悲しみもさみしさも。……もしかしたら大変な苦しみの中にも。きらきら光る“特別”な何かが潜んでいたりするんだよ。この世界や、人間の心を造った[・|誰][・|か]は意地悪だから
lines.translated: "In both sadness and loneliness. ...And perhaps even in the midst of terrible suffering, something 'special' that shines brightly lies hidden. Because Whoever created this world and the human heart is unkind."

lines.content: だからね。と、男の子は続けた――だから君が、[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]ぼくらの中心となることは自然なことだったんだと思うよ。
