lines.translated: "That's why," the boy continued-- "that's why I think it was only natural for you to become the center of us all like this."

lines.content: そう言った男の子は、今夜見たいと願う“夢”の光景を女の子に語った。
lines.translated: Having said that, the boy told the girl of the scenes of the "dream" he wished to see tonight.

lines.content: 『……うん。わかった』
lines.translated: "...Okay. I understand."

lines.content: と、女の子はうなずく。
lines.translated: So the girl nodded.

lines.content: そして祈るように両手を合わせ、深く、ふかく、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じるのだ……。
lines.translated: Then she brought both hands together as if in prayer, and deeply, so deeply, closed her eyelids...

lines.content: 受け取った言葉の一つひとつを、受け取る子が勇気を出せるような“物語”として脚色し、“想像”し、さくらの樹に芽生えた心を通して、男の子の[心|内側]へと手渡した。
lines.translated: She adapted each and every word she received into a "story" that would give courage to the child receiving it, "imagined" it, and through the heart budding in the cherry tree, handed it over into the boy's heart.

lines.content: ありがとう、と男の子は微笑む。
lines.translated: "Thank you," the boy smiled.

lines.content: これで今夜も、想像以上の[夢|時間]を見て過ごせるよ。……ここにこうしてやって来るってことは、君だって相応に外の世界で酷い思いをしているんだろうけれど……
lines.translated: "With this, I can spend tonight seeing a dream--a time--beyond my imagination, too. ...The fact that you come here like this means you must be going through something terribly cruel in the outside world yourself, though..."

lines.content: でも、ね。こう言ってしまうと不謹慎だろうとは思うけど、君がここに来てくれて良かった。本当に
lines.translated: "Still, you know. I know it's probably indiscreet of me to say it like this, but I'm glad you came here. Truly."

lines.content: 男の子が“夢”のような“夢”を見るため、“夢”の中で眠りについた。
lines.translated: In order to see a dreamlike "dream," the boy fell asleep within the "dream."

lines.content: すると、女の子の前には次々と子ども達が集まって来て、短くもない列を造った。
lines.translated: Then, one after another, children gathered in front of the girl, forming a line that was by no means short.

lines.content: その一人ひとりに女の子は、満開に咲いた夜のさくらの樹の下で――想像以上の“夢”を本人に変わり“想像”し、贈っていった。
lines.translated: Beneath the night cherry tree blooming in full glory, the girl "imagined" on their behalf a "dream" beyond their own imagination for each and every one of them, and gifted it to them.

lines.content: 時にはおしゃべりな子の“夢語り”に耳を傾け、共に様々な光景を“想像”する――聞き役のような役目も担っていた。
lines.translated: At times, she would lend an ear to a talkative child's "telling of dreams" and "imagine" various scenes together with them--taking on the role of a listener as well.

lines.content: いつからだろうか。
lines.translated: Since when had it been?

lines.content: 男の子が言ったとおり、地下室の女の子が中心となり――
lines.translated: Just as the boy had said, that the girl from the basement had become the center--

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]に集められた子たちの“夢”を代弁するようにして語り、[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]その心へ手渡すようになったのは。
lines.translated: Speaking on behalf of the "dreams" of the children gathered here, and handing them over to their hearts like this.

lines.content: 誰もが自身の幸福の正体を掴めるわけではない。
lines.translated: Not everyone can grasp the true nature of their own happiness.

lines.content: ならば誰もが、自身の[想像力|心]を自在に操れるわけでも、やはりない。不安になりたくないのに嫌な未来の映像を止められないように。
lines.translated: If so, then neither can everyone freely control their own heart--their imagination. Just like how you cannot stop visions of an unpleasant future even when you don't want to feel anxious.

lines.content: だから女の子が、子どもたちに自身の幸福な時間について“想像”することを手伝った。
lines.translated: And so the girl helped the children "imagine" their own happy times.

lines.content: なぜ、女の子にそのようなことができたのか。
lines.translated: Why was the girl able to do such a thing?

lines.content: 『まだ、幸せだった頃……』
lines.translated: "Back when I was still happy..."

lines.content: 毎夜、お母さんと一緒に眠くなるまで、お姫さまや王子さまが手と手を繋ぐ――そんな創作の物語を語り合ったからだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it because every night until she fell asleep, she and her mother would share made-up stories together about princesses and princes holding hands?

lines.content: 毎朝、お父さんと一緒に、トーストにケチャップやマスタードで簡単に描いたキャラクターたちが、いったい何を考えているのかな――だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Or because every morning with her father, they would wonder what the characters they simply drew on their toast with ketchup and mustard were thinking about--

lines.content: お母さんに隠れて笑い合っていたからだろうか。
lines.translated: Laughing together in secret behind her mother's back?

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: それとも……。
lines.translated: Or perhaps...

lines.content: 『お母さん。お父さん。ふたりはどんなふうにして出会ったの』
lines.translated: "Mom. Dad. How did the two of you meet?"

lines.content: 『……互いのどんなところを好きになって、ふたりは、私のお母さんとお父さんになってくれたの』
lines.translated: "...What did you fall in love with about each other that made you become my mom and dad?"

lines.content: ふとした時間にそう問いかけて、ふたりがどんなふうに出会い、どんなふうに恋をして、どんなふうに[・|私]が産まれて……。
lines.translated: Was it because the girl loved asking that out of the blue, and having them tell her the story of how they met, how they fell in love, how she was born...

lines.content: そういった[・|現][・|在]までのお話を、ふたりから語り聞かせてもらうのが女の子は好きだったから、だろうか。
lines.translated: And everything that led up to the present?

lines.content: ふたりの出会いのお話を聞いたなら、その夜は、自分の未来について“想像”してみる。
lines.translated: Whenever she heard the story of how they met, she would spend that night "imagining" her own future.

lines.content: いつか自分も、お母さんとお父さんみたいに、大切に想いたい誰かと出会い、恋をして――
lines.translated: Wondering if someday, just like her mom and dad, she too would meet someone she wanted to cherish, fall in love--

lines.content: 自分の命よりも大切で愛しい、そんな小さな命をこの世界に誕生させることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: And be able to bring a tiny life into this world, one more precious and beloved to her than her own.

lines.content: それがたとえ男の子だろうと女の子であろうと、きっと自分は愛せるはずだ――幼い心は、そんなふうに思える自分自身も好きだった。
lines.translated: Whether it was a boy or a girl, she would surely love them--her young heart liked the part of herself that could think that way, too.

lines.content: ともあれ女の子は物語の語り部だ。
lines.translated: In any case, the girl was a storyteller.

lines.content: あるいは聴き手。
lines.translated: Or a listener.

lines.content: その“才能”に富んでいた。
lines.translated: She was richly blessed with that "talent."

lines.content: だけどそんな地下室の女の子が中心となり、“夜”に色を付けはじめたからだろうか。
lines.translated: However, perhaps it was because that girl from the basement had become the center and begun adding color to the "Night."

lines.content: さくらの樹に芽生えた“[心|夜]”には、いつもお母さん、お父さんにやさしくしてほしいと願う子ばかりが集まるようになっていた。
lines.translated: In the "Night"--the heart--that had budded within the cherry tree, children who wished for their mothers and fathers to always be kind to them had begun to gather almost exclusively.

lines.content: 類は友を呼ぶともいうが――ひとりぼっちでさみしい気持ちや、悲しい想いのその中に、無理矢理閉じ込められてしまっている子ども達……。
lines.translated: They say birds of a feather flock together--children who had been forcibly locked away inside feelings of loneliness and sorrow...

lines.content: ……あるいは、到底叶うはずもない恋するための物語を、その運命を、小さな胸に閉じ込め、夢見ているような子たちばっかりだ。
lines.translated: Or else, nothing but children who kept stories and destinies of impossible romances locked inside their tiny chests, dreaming of them.

lines.content: その誰もがみんな、大人になる前にこの場所で命を終えようとうなずき合っていた――もう二度と残酷な太陽の下には、現実世界には、心を戻さない。
lines.translated: Every single one of them nodded to one another, agreeing to end their lives in this place before growing up--never again would they return their hearts to the real world, beneath the cruel sun.

lines.content: 想像以上の幸せな“[時間|夢]”を胸にしまって、永遠にこの“夜”を生きていこうと、そう、誓いあっていた。
lines.translated: Holding happy "dreams"--times--beyond their imagination in their chests, they swore to one another that they would live in this "Night" forever.

lines.content: ……今もたくさんの子どもたちの命が、その心が、このさくらの樹の中で眠り続けてる
lines.translated: "...Even now, the lives of many children, and their hearts, continue to sleep inside this cherry tree."

lines.content: また、いつかの夜のことだった。例の男の子がそう言った。
lines.translated: That, too, happened on some night or another. The boy from before said those words.

lines.content: いつかぼくらも大人になるその前に、このさくらと共に長い、ながい――永遠にも等しいくらい、とても長い眠りにつくんだろう
lines.translated: "Someday, before we grow up, we too will probably fall into a long, long sleep alongside this cherry tree--a sleep so long it's practically eternal."

lines.content: そんなぼくらの命が尽きるとき、この特別な時間もまた終わるんだよ。さくらの中に芽生えた心は、子どもたちの“想い”を力に変えて満開に咲くもので……
lines.translated: "When our lives run out like that, this special time will come to an end as well. The heart that budded inside the cherry tree blooms in full glory by turning the children's 'feelings' into power..."

lines.content: それをなくせば花は咲かない。さくらは自身の心を維持できなくなる。この町の神は死ぬんだよ。その他大勢のふつうのさくらに戻ってしまう。だから……
lines.translated: "If it loses that, the flowers won't bloom. The cherry tree won't be able to maintain its own heart. The god of this town will die. It will turn back into just another ordinary cherry tree among many. That's why..."

lines.content: だから“夜”を長く維持するためには、このさくらの樹に心を、そして場合によっては命さえ、捧げ続けなければならない。
lines.translated: That was why, in order to maintain the "Night" for a long time, they had to keep offering their hearts--and in some cases, even their lives--to this cherry tree.

lines.content: だけど、それは決して怖いことではないはずだ
lines.translated: "Still, that shouldn't be a scary thing at all."

lines.content: この“夜”に呼ばれる子たちの殆どが、現実世界を生きることに、もう既に飽いていたから……。
lines.translated: Because most of the children called to this "Night" had already grown tired of living in the real world...

lines.content: きっとぼくらにはここしか生きる居場所なんてないんだよ。……弱いぼくらはそういうイキモノ。現実世界を傷つかずには生きていけない
lines.translated: "Surely, this is the only place where we belong and can live. ...Weak as we are, that's the kind of creatures we are. We can't live in the real world without getting hurt."

lines.content: だからそんなぼくらの命の結末なんて[・|そ][・|れ]でいいし、[・|そ][・|れ]以外の最期なんて……ぼくらにはどこにもないんだよ
lines.translated: "So it's fine for our lives to end like that, and there is no other end for us... anywhere else."
"...Yeah."

lines.content: そうだね。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 確かにそれでいいと思った。
lines.translated: She truly thought that was fine.

lines.content: 認めないと。悲しいけれど、いい加減、理解しないと――外の世界で自分を愛してくれる人はどこにもいない。
lines.translated: She had to accept it. As sad as it was, it was high time she understood--there was no one in the outside world who would love her.

lines.content: そんな自分を愛せる自信も、どこにもない。
lines.translated: Nor did she have any confidence anywhere within her that she could love herself like this.

lines.content: ならばこの場所で夢うつつのまま、心だけの存在で“永遠”に生きていくのも悪くはないかも。
lines.translated: If so, then living on for "eternity" in this place as an existence of pure heart, half-asleep in a dream, might not be so bad.

lines.content: それ以上、知りたいことも、理解すべきだと感じることもなにもなかった。
lines.translated: Beyond that, there was nothing she wanted to know, nor anything she felt she ought to understand.

lines.content: 『ただただ、似たもの同士な子たちと一緒に、これからもずっと、今夜も幸せな“夢”を見ていられれば……』
lines.translated: "If I can just keep seeing happy 'dreams' tonight and forevermore, together with children who are just like me..."

lines.content: せめて自分と同じようなさみしい子たちが、少しでも長く幸せな“時間”を過ごせるように――
lines.translated: So that lonely children like herself could spend a happy "time" for even a little bit longer--

lines.content: この存在すべてを、“夜”を維持させるため、さくらに捧げてしまうのもいいかもしれない。
lines.translated: Offering up her entire existence to the cherry tree to maintain the "Night" might be a good idea.

lines.content: そういうふうに思い始めてもいた――その頃だ。
lines.translated: It was right around the time she had begun to think that way.

lines.content: “特別”なさくらの樹の中で、ただ、幸せな“夢”を見る。
lines.translated: Simply seeing happy "dreams" inside the "special" cherry tree.

lines.content: たったそれだけではどうしても[・|収][・|ま][・|ら][・|な][・|い]子たちの心が、毎夜、さくらに呼ばれるようになった。
lines.translated: Every night, the hearts of children who could by no means be satisfied with just that alone began to be called to the cherry tree.
Those children were already broken.

lines.content: 自分たちを虐げる大人たちへの憎しみだとか、復讐心だとか、そういう激しい心を持て余し……。
lines.translated: Unable to contain such violent emotions as hatred and a desire for revenge against the adults who abused them...

lines.content: “ここは思い描けるすべてが叶う不思議な場所だ。ならばその力を持って、大人たちへ復讐しよう”
lines.translated: "This is a wondrous place where everything you can picture comes true. If so, let's use that power to take revenge on the adults."

lines.content: 壊れてしまった子らはそんな未来を描いて望んだ。
lines.translated: The broken children pictured and wished for such a future.

lines.content: 『そういう子らの想いはとても強くて……』
lines.translated: "The feelings of those children were so very strong..."

lines.content: “夜”の外にまで、たくさんの“想像力”がこぼれ出すようになってしまった――まず、さくらだ。
lines.translated: A great deal of "imagination" began to spill out even beyond the "Night"--first, it was the cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 町中のさくらの花が満開に咲いた。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms all throughout the town bloomed in full glory.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。その花びらが世界中を覆ってしまえばいい。
lines.translated: Ah, yes. Let those petals cover the entire world.

lines.content: そしてじわりじわりと溺れ死んでしまうがいいさ。心を壊した子どもはそう願った。
lines.translated: And let them slowly, gradually drown to death in them. So wished the child whose heart was broken.

lines.content: 誰も知らない、誰も見たこともない、そんな想像上の“イキモノ”に、日々おびえて暮らせばいい。
lines.translated: Let them live in daily terror of imaginary "creatures" that no one knows, that no one has ever seen.

lines.content: どこへ逃げてもその気配がお前たちを追っていく。心がひび割れた子どもは、そう、祈った。
lines.translated: No matter where you run, their presence will hunt you down. So prayed the child whose heart was cracked.

lines.content: ……さくらの樹に宿った“特別”な心も少なからず、身勝手に子どもたちを傷つける大人たちへ、怒りにも似た想いを抱いていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps the "special" heart dwelling within the cherry tree also harbored feelings akin to anger, at least to some degree, toward the adults who selfishly hurt the children.

lines.content: あっという間だった。
lines.translated: It happened in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: あっという間に“夜”は町を覆っていった。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, the "Night" covered the town.

lines.content: さくらの花は咲いて乱れて。おそろしい怪物たちが夜をぞろぞろ[ばっこ|跋扈]した。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms bloomed in wild profusion. Terrifying monsters roamed the night in droves.

lines.content: ……そして。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: 『……私の思い描いた“夢”まで、外の世界にこぼれてしまった』
lines.translated: "...Even the 'dream' I had pictured spilled out into the outside world."

lines.content: ――“いつかまた幸せだった三人家族に戻りたい”
lines.translated: --"Someday, I want us to go back to being the happy family of three we used to be."

lines.content: そう思い描いた光景が、まるでスクリーンに映し出される映画みたいにして、女の子の[・|家][・|の][・|中]に現れたのだ。
lines.translated: The scene she had pictured like that appeared inside the girl's house, just like a movie projected onto a screen.

lines.content: お母さんの悲鳴で目が覚めた。
lines.translated: She woke up to her mother's scream.

lines.content: 真っ暗な地下室。冷たく堅いベッドの上だ。
lines.translated: A pitch-black basement. On top of a cold, hard bed.

lines.content: 声が聞こえる。
lines.translated: She could hear voices.

lines.content: いつも“特別”な“夢”の中で思い描いた笑い声――やさしかった頃のお母さんと、お父さん、そして自分。
lines.translated: The laughter she always pictured inside her "special" "dreams"--her mother from back when she was kind, her father, and herself.

lines.content: 三人分の笑い声が、地下室の天井から響いて聞こえる。
lines.translated: The laughter of three people echoed down from the ceiling of the basement.

lines.content: そして、悲鳴だ。
lines.translated: And then, screams.

lines.content: やさしくなくなってしまった現実のお母さんと、お父さんと、そして三人目の[・|誰][・|か]。
lines.translated: Her real mother, who was no longer kind, her father, and a third someone.

lines.content: 三人分の笑い声と悲鳴とがごちゃ混ぜになって聞こえた。
lines.translated: The laughter of three people and the screams of three people sounded all jumbled together.

lines.content: いきなり目の前に現れた光景に、現実のふたりは混乱してしまっているに違いない。
lines.translated: The two of them in reality must have been thrown into confusion by the sight that had suddenly appeared before their eyes.

lines.content: ……これからこの世界がどうなってしまうのかはわからない。少女らが思い描こうとした新しい“夜”もどうなってしまうのか。
lines.translated: She did not know what would become of this world from here on. Nor what would become of the new "Night" the girls had tried to picture.

lines.content: それらはすべて、いっぱいの憎悪に呑まれ、消えゆくのが運命なのかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Perhaps it was the fate of all those things to be swallowed up by a flood of hatred and vanish away, but...

lines.content: 『お願い……』
lines.translated: "Please..."

lines.content: 私は、ふたりに思い出してほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted the two of them to remember.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|は]、[・|そ][・|の][・|光][・|景][・|は]、ねえ、覚えていないかな。ほんの少し前のことだよ。
lines.translated: Hey, don't you remember that--that scene? It was just a little while ago.

lines.content: あのときは楽しかった。あのときは、幸せだった。まだふたりは私のことを[・|い][・|な][・|い][・|子]みたいに扱わず……、笑顔をくれた。
lines.translated: Back then, it was fun. Back then, we were happy. The two of you still hadn't treated me like a child who didn't exist... and you gave me your smiles.

lines.content: 美味しいものも、甘いものも、いっぱいくれた。かわいいドレスも着せてくれたよね。
lines.translated: You gave me lots of delicious things, and sweet things, too. You dressed me in cute dresses, didn't you?

lines.content: ……きっと、今、ふたりの隣にいる子へそうしているように。
lines.translated: Surely, just like you're doing for the child beside the two of you right now.

lines.content: 『幸せだったんだよ。本当に……』
lines.translated: "I was happy. Truly..."

lines.content: そう思えていたのは私だけかな。ふたりは……違ったのかな。いつから私のことが邪魔になってしまったのかな。
lines.translated: Was I the only one who felt that way? Did the two of you... feel differently? Since when did I become a nuisance to you?

lines.content: 『お願い』
lines.translated: "Please."

lines.content: すり切れるような小さな声だけれど、お願い。ふたりに届いてほしかった。
lines.translated: Though it was a tiny voice that sounded worn thin, please. I wanted it to reach the two of them.

lines.content: 『思い出してよ。……私は、ここにいるんだよ』
lines.translated: "Please remember. ...I'm right here."

lines.content: ふたりにとってもう存在しない地下室の底で、女の子は、最期の力を振り絞り、囁いた。
lines.translated: At the bottom of the basement that no longer existed to the two of them, the girl mustered the very last of her strength and whispered.

lines.content: 『……ねえ、お母さん。お父さん。教えてほしいよ』
lines.translated: "...Hey, Mom. Dad. Please tell me."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。夢から覚めたばかりの心と一緒に。
lines.translated: She closed her eyelids. Along with her heart, which had just awakened from the dream.

lines.content: 『……今、ふたりの隣にいるかわいい子と、私』
lines.translated: "...Between the cute child beside the two of you right now, and me..."

lines.content: “どっちのほうが、好きだった？”
lines.translated: "Which one of us did you love more?"

lines.content: その問いかけは唇からこぼれることなく、掠れて消えて、しまったけれど……。
lines.translated: That question never spilled from her lips, rasping and fading away instead, and yet...

lines.content: 私はね。お母さん、お父さん。
lines.translated: As for me, you know. Mom, Dad.

lines.content: もう二度と笑いかけてくれなくても、抱きしめてくれなくなっても、ふたりのことが大切で、大好きで……。
lines.translated: Even if you never smile at me again, even if you never hug me again, the two of you are precious to me, and I love you so much...

lines.content: お願い。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: お願いします。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: いつか、誰かが、私だけのヒーローが……こんなさみしいばかりの“悪夢”から、私を連れ出してくれると願い、祈り、信じて――……
lines.translated: "Hoping, praying, and believing that someday, someone--a hero of my very own... would take me away from this 'nightmare' filled with nothing but loneliness--..."

lines.content: そこで“[・|夢]”は途切れた。
lines.translated: Right there, the "dream" cut off.
Because I abruptly let go of the hand I had been holding...

lines.content: ……ご、ごめんね。つい、考え事しちゃってた
lines.translated: "...S-Sorry. I got lost in thought without realizing."

lines.content: ……そこでましろが、まるで俺から距離を取るように立ち上がってしまったから。
lines.translated: And right then, Mashiro stood up as if to put distance between us.

lines.content: もしかしたら変な“夢”を見せちゃったかもしれない。……ごめんね。気にしないでね
lines.translated: "I might have shown you a strange 'dream.' ...I'm sorry. Please don't mind it."

lines.content: ほんとにごめんね。もしも何か見ちゃったとしても、お願い。気にしないでくれたらうれしいな
lines.translated: "I'm really sorry. Even if you did see something, please... I'd be happy if you didn't pay it any mind."

lines.content: 苦笑いでましろは俺を振り返る。
lines.translated: Mashiro looked back at me with a wry smile.

lines.content: ……さっきまで俺と繋いでいた手を、胸元にしっかりと抱いていた。
lines.translated: She was holding the hand that had been joined with mine until a moment ago tightly against her chest.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。本当に
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Truly."

lines.content: たぶん、酷い“夢”だったと思う。……嫌わないでくれたら、うれしいけれど
lines.translated: "I think it was probably a terrible 'dream.' ...It would make me happy if you didn't come to hate me for it, though."

lines.content: 嫌うだなんて、そんな。どうして……
lines.translated: "Hate you? Never. Why would I..."

lines.content: そう口にしたところで、思い至る。
lines.translated: Right as I said that, it hit me.

lines.content: ――今見た“夢”の女の子は嫌われることを極端に恐れてた。俺には少なくともそう見えた。
lines.translated: --The girl in the "dream" I had just seen was terrified to an extreme of being hated. At the very least, that was how it looked to me.

lines.content: だから近しい人たちに、いつも“自分のことをどう思っているのか”問いかけて、幼いばかりの心を安心させようと必死になっていた。
lines.translated: That was why she had always asked the people close to her what they thought of her, desperately trying to put her young heart at ease.

lines.content: なんだかそれはとても、とてもさみしく悲しいことであるように思えて……。
lines.translated: For some reason, that felt like such a terribly, terribly lonely and sad thing...

lines.content: 何も言えなくなった。
lines.translated: I couldn't say anything anymore.

lines.content: 唇を噛み、うつむいてしまう――
lines.translated: Biting my lip, I cast my eyes down--
In this world, it was not only the things one pictured that became reality, but the things one feared as well.
Just like that, the girl...

lines.content: 地下室の中で誰にも振り返ってもらえることのないままに、名前も、居場所も、存在さえも、見知らぬ[・|か][・|わ][・|い][・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|子]に奪われたまま、静かに息を引き取った。
lines.translated: Down in that basement, without anyone ever looking back at her, with her name, her place to belong, and even her very existence stolen away by a pitiful child she didn't even know, she quietly breathed her last.

lines.content: その命は、さみしい想いに満ちた心ごと、さくらの樹の中の“夜”に抱かれて、長い、ながい眠りについた――つらくさみしいばかりの人生だった。
lines.translated: Her life, along with her heart brimming with lonely feelings, was embraced by the "Night" within the cherry blossom tree and fell into a long, long sleep--it had been a life filled with nothing but pain and loneliness.

lines.content: だからせめて、その心が望む幸せな[夢|時間]の中で、いつまでも安らかに眠ればいい。神さまみたいにやさしいさくらの心はそう想った。
lines.translated: So at the very least, let her sleep peacefully forever inside the happy dream--the happy time--her heart wished for. That was what the heart of the cherry tree, kind like a god, had wished.

lines.content: 更にそこは、地下室の女の子の命だけでなく、たくさんの少年少女たちが傷を癒やすようにして眠り続けるための、ゆりかごのようなものだった。
lines.translated: Furthermore, that place was like a cradle, not only for the life of the girl in the basement, but for many boys and girls to keep sleeping so as to heal their wounds.

lines.content: それまで“夜”の中心に立ち、語り部のような役割を担っていた女の子が眠りについたことで[・|ひ][・|と][・|ま][・|ず]、特別な“夜”はそこで幕を下ろした。
lines.translated: Because the girl who had stood at the center of the "Night" and served a role like a storyteller until then had fallen asleep, the special "Night" closed its curtains there for the time being.

lines.content: 今、この場所を――新しい“夜”を創ったのは、さっき話したとおり、あの子だよ
lines.translated: "Just as I told you earlier, the one who created this place right now--the new 'Night'--was that girl."

lines.content: 奏大雅。あなたのお母さんだ。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga. Your mother.

lines.content: 生涯、自身の“[病|才能]”に翻弄され続けた女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who spent her entire life at the mercy of her own "illness"--her own "talent."

lines.content: あの子と私は、遠くとおく道筋を辿ってみれば、どこかで血が繋がっていた。あの子の[せいか|生家]はこの町を根城にする芸術家の家系。私も、そうだった
lines.translated: "If you trace our paths far, far back, that girl and I were related by blood somewhere along the line. Her birth family was a lineage of artists who made this town their stronghold. Mine was the same."

lines.content: だからあの子が、夢を語るための“才能”に恵まれていたのはそのせいで……
lines.translated: "So that was why she was blessed with the 'talent' to tell dreams..."

lines.content: 『現実世界はあんまりにも厳しくて……。心の中の地獄に飼い殺されるかのような苦しい時間の連続だ』
lines.translated: "'The real world is far too harsh... It's a continuous series of agonizing hours, as if being kept alive just to suffer in the hell inside your own heart.'"

lines.content: あの子が残したそんな言葉に。
lines.translated: To those words that girl left behind.

lines.content: 『だからせめて眠るときだけは、いつでも、どんなときでも、安らかでいてほしい……。愛おしく想う誰かと過ごせるような、そんな時間であってほしい』
lines.translated: "'So at the very least, only when sleeping, I want it to be peaceful, always, no matter when... I want it to be a time you can spend with someone you hold dear.'"

lines.content: そんなあの子の“想い”に。
lines.translated: To those "feelings" of hers.

lines.content: ……“眠ることは死者の世界で産まれることだ”
lines.translated: "...'To sleep is to be born into the world of the dead.'"

lines.content: そんな、どこかで見かけた言葉を愛おしく想う私の心は、あの子の言葉や想いによって、長いながい“夢”の中から目を覚まし……。
lines.translated: My heart, which held dear that phrase I had seen somewhere before, awoke from its long, long "dream" through that girl's words and feelings...

lines.content: あの子が思い描くままの[・|新][・|し][・|い]“[・|夜]”を、“夢”の語り部として……あるいは聴き手として、“想像”することを手伝った
lines.translated: "And as a storyteller of 'dreams'... or perhaps as a listener, I helped to 'imagine' the new 'Night' just as she pictured it."

lines.content: あの子はかつて、私たちがさくらの心の中で思い描き、創り上げた特別な“夜”のことを知っていて……
lines.translated: "She knew about the special 'Night' we had once pictured and created within the heart of the cherry tree..."

lines.content: 夜に咲くあのさくらの樹が、悲しい子どもたちの“想い”を叶えてくれることも、わかっていて
lines.translated: "And she also understood that the cherry tree blooming in the night would grant the 'wishes' of sad children."

lines.content: だから、さくらの樹と深く繋がっている私へと“夢”を語りかけることで、“夜”へと想いを繋いだ
lines.translated: "So by speaking her 'dreams' to me, who was deeply connected to the cherry tree, she connected her feelings to the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……そういうふうにしてこの“夜”は……新しい“夜の国”は、今の形に産まれ直した
lines.translated: "...And in that way, this 'Night'... this new 'Land of Night' was reborn into its current form."
Thus, it raised its curtains once again.

lines.content: 見渡す限り広がる町。きらきらと輝く“夜の国”
lines.translated: A town stretching out as far as the eye could see. A glittering, shining "Land of Night."

lines.content: この一つひとつのきらめきが、たったひとりの少女の“想像”により、あるいは叶えたい“夢”や“希望”だとかがあったからこそ、できあがっている……。
lines.translated: Every single one of these sparkles was made through the "imagination" of just one girl, or because there were "dreams" and "hopes" she wanted to come true...

lines.content: それは途方もないことのように思え……。
lines.translated: It felt like something unfathomable...

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。まさに“魔法”のように思えてしまった。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right. It truly felt just like "magic."

lines.content: 今夜は、ありがとう大雅
lines.translated: "Thank you for tonight, Taiga."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: “物語のお姫さまみたいになってみたい”――そんな無茶なお願いを叶えようとしてくれて
lines.translated: "'I want to try becoming like a princess in a storybook'--thank you for trying to grant such an unreasonable wish."

lines.content: そんな恥ずかしいばっかりの要望を、あまり笑わずにいてくれて。
lines.translated: For not laughing too much at such an utterly embarrassing request.

lines.content: ほんの少しの間だけれど……え、えっと。デートできて、楽しかったよ
lines.translated: "It was only for a tiny little while, though... U-Um. I had fun going on a date with you."

lines.content: どこかに隠されてるかもしれない甘い宝物は見つけられなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "We couldn't find the sweet treasure that might be hidden somewhere, though..."

lines.content: でもね、あなたに手を引かれて歩いたときは、なんだかね。王子さまに怖い場所から助けてもらうお姫さまになれた――そんな気分だったよ
lines.translated: "But you know, when you took my hand and led me along as we walked, somehow... I felt like I had become a princess being rescued from a scary place by a prince."

lines.content: ……それにね。昔々のことを覚えていてくれたんだってわかって、うれしかったよ。すごく
lines.translated: "...And besides. Finding out that you remembered things from a long, long time ago made me happy. Really happy."
Thank you. Mashiro said it over and over again--thank you for keeping me away from the "bad dreams" tonight.

lines.content: ましろ……
lines.translated: "Mashiro..."

lines.content: こちらを振り返っていたその身体が半透明に透けはじめていた。それは今夜はもう“さよなら”と言われているようだった。
lines.translated: Her body, turned back toward me, was beginning to turn translucent. It felt as though I were being told "goodbye" for tonight.

lines.content: また、次の“夜”で会えたら……
lines.translated: "If we can meet again in the next 'Night'..."

lines.content: そのときはすべて話すよとましろは言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro said she would tell me everything then.

lines.content: あなたの“[力|特別]”が、どういうふうに私たちを救ってくれるのか。それを伝えられればと思うから。……ごめんね。今夜はちょっと、疲れちゃって。先に戻るね
lines.translated: "Because I'm hoping I can convey to you how your 'special power' will save us. ...I'm sorry. I got a little tired tonight. I'll head back first."

lines.content: また懲りずに会いに来てくれたらうれしいな。甘いお菓子のお話をいっぱい聞かせてね。
lines.translated: "I'd be happy if you didn't let this put you off and came to see me again. Tell me lots of stories about sweet treats, okay?"

lines.content: そう言い残しましろはすうっと柔らかく、そして静かにその姿を消した。
lines.translated: Leaving those words behind, Mashiro softly, gently, and quietly vanished from sight.

lines.content: ……あの時計塔の部屋に戻ったのだろう。
lines.translated: She must have returned to that room in the clock tower.

lines.content: [・|ひ][・|と][・|り][・|ぼ][・|っ][・|ち][・|で]あの子は、ましろは、何を想い、あの部屋で過ごすのだろうか。
lines.translated: What does that girl--what does Mashiro think about as she spends her time in that room, all alone?

lines.content: ひとり残されてしまった俺は、“夜”の空をただ見上げていた。
lines.translated: Left behind all by myself, I simply gazed up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: とてもさみしい気持ちだ。
lines.translated: It was a terribly lonely feeling.

lines.content: 別に愛の告白をして見事玉砕――ひとり残されてしまう、といった事実はもちろんどこにもなかったのに、どうしてだか今はそんな気分だ。
lines.translated: Of course, it wasn't as if I had confessed my love, been spectacularly shot down, and been left all alone, yet for some reason, that was how I felt right now.

lines.content: ヒーローだ……
lines.translated: "A hero..."

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: ヒーローは、どこへ行ってしまったんだよ……
lines.translated: "Where the hell did the hero go...?"

lines.content: その行方についてはもう既に、残酷なまでに理解してしまっているけれど――だけどその口癖は直らない。きっと、永遠に。
lines.translated: I already understood where he had gone to a cruel degree--and yet, I couldn't break that habit of saying it. Surely, I never would for all eternity.

lines.content: もう一度ため息をついて、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じようとしたところで……。
lines.translated: Just as I let out another sigh and tried to close my eyelids...

lines.content: こんな俺を呼ぶ声がして、振り返ったのだった。
lines.translated: I heard a voice calling out to me in that state, and I turned around.

lines.content: “夢”から覚めた俺は、自身の右手をじっと見ていた――どうして。
lines.translated: Having woken from the "dream," I stared intently at my own right hand--why?

lines.content: ……どうして俺はあのとき、この手を、離してしまったんだろう
lines.translated: "...Why did I let go of her hand back then?"

lines.content: ましろと繋いだ手から、“夜”を通して心に流れ込んできた記憶。その“想い”
lines.translated: The memories that had flowed into my heart through the "Night" from the hand joined with Mashiro's. Those "feelings."

lines.content: 息を呑んだ。
lines.translated: I had gasped.

lines.content: たぶん心も停止しかけていた。
lines.translated: My heart had probably nearly stopped, too.

lines.content: 俺はおそらく、今までこう思っていた。[・|自][・|分][・|が][・|世][・|界][・|で][・|一][・|番][・|不][・|幸][・|な][・|ん][・|だ]――そういう思いが心のどこかであったのだ。
lines.translated: Up until now, I had probably thought this: that I was the most unfortunate person in the world--some part of my heart had harbored that thought.

lines.content: だから、自分にばかりいやなことが起こる。そう思い、どこかふて腐れていた部分もあったはず。
lines.translated: That was why bad things only ever happened to me. Thinking that, there must have been a part of me that had grown sulky and bitter.

lines.content: そんな人生を救ってほしくて。
lines.translated: I wanted someone to save this life of mine.

lines.content: そんな心にやさしくしてほしくって。
lines.translated: I wanted someone to be kind to this heart of mine.

lines.content: そんな都合のいいヒーローを捜し求めて、この町へ来たけれど……。
lines.translated: I had come to this town searching for a convenient hero like that, and yet...

lines.content: 俺がばかだった。あんまりにも、子どもだった
lines.translated: "I was an idiot. I was way too much of a child."

lines.content: [ましろ|あの子]の心を覗き見て、そう知ったのだ。
lines.translated: Peering into that girl's--into Mashiro's--heart, I had learned that.

lines.content: 自分だけがつらいわけじゃない――しかしそんなふうに断ずるのは、あんまりにも容易だ。
lines.translated: I'm not the only one who's hurting--however, coming to a conclusion like that is all too easy.

lines.content: 苦しみや悲しみは人それぞれだし、窮する状況だってそれぞれ違う。[・|同][・|じ]ものなど存在しない。
lines.translated: Suffering and sadness differ from person to person, and the desperate situations people find themselves in are all different, too. No two are the same.

lines.content: それでも俺は今まで、自分だけが苦しいとどこかで思っていて――
lines.translated: Even so, somewhere inside, I had thought until now that I was the only one suffering--

lines.content: そんなのはまた[・|同][・|じ][・|く][・|ら][・|い]あり得ないのだという、当たり前なことを、ましろと繋いだ手と手によって教えられたから……。
lines.translated: And because the hands Mashiro and I joined had taught me the obvious truth that such a thing was just as impossible...

lines.content: だから俺の心は今夜、ほんの少し大人になった。
lines.translated: Because of that, my heart grew up just a little bit tonight.

lines.content: 自分が恥ずかしくなり、何も言えなくもなり……。
lines.translated: I became ashamed of myself, unable to say a single word...

lines.content: 慌ててましろから手を離してしまったところで、流れ込んでくるましろの記憶は、途切れたのだった。
lines.translated: And right when I hastily let go of Mashiro's hand, the memories of hers flowing into me were cut off.

lines.content: ……あのときのましろの横顔が忘れられない
lines.translated: "...I can't forget Mashiro's profile from back then."

lines.content: 頭を抱え、そうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Clutching my head, I muttered that.

lines.content: ごめん、ましろ……。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Mashiro...

lines.content: ひとりぼっちの顔だった。
lines.translated: It was the face of someone all alone.

lines.content: 繋いだ手を離したあの子は、決して俺と目を合わせることなく、ただ薄く微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Having let go of my hand, that girl never once met my eyes, simply wearing a faint smile.

lines.content: その表情を見て、わかった。
lines.translated: Seeing that expression, I understood.

lines.content: ましろは今もずっと、遠い昔の記憶によって、その心に痛みを滲ませ続けている。
lines.translated: Even now, Mashiro's heart continues to ache and bleed from the memories of the distant past.

lines.content: その心は今もまだ、あの暗いくらい地下室で、愛する人たちが自分の名前を呼んでくれることを待っている。
lines.translated: Even now, her heart is still waiting in that dark, dark basement for the people she loves to call her name.

lines.content: そう、わかったのに……。
lines.translated: Yes, even though I understood that...

lines.content: 俺は何も言えなかったのだ。
lines.translated: I hadn't been able to say anything at all.

lines.content: 呆然と、さみしさに震えるましろの微笑みを、ただ見つめているだけで……。
lines.translated: Simply staring in a daze at Mashiro's smile as it trembled with loneliness...

lines.content: そんな俺の沈黙が、更にましろをひとりぼっちにさせてしまうことくらい、言葉ではなく心で理解できていた……はずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though I should have understood... not in words, but in my heart, that my silence would only make Mashiro even lonelier.

lines.content: 君をひとりになんてしないから――そう言う代わりに、あの子の手を再び掴むべきだったのに。
lines.translated: Instead of saying, "I'll never leave you all alone"--I should have grabbed her hand once again.
It's no use.

lines.content: ……できない。
lines.translated: I couldn't do it.

lines.content: 『今夜は、ありがとう大雅』
lines.translated: "Thank you for tonight, Taiga."

lines.content: そう言い、微笑む君のことを追いかけることさえ、できなかったのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't even chase after you as you said that and smiled.

lines.content: ……ヒーローだ
lines.translated: "...A hero."

lines.content: つぶやく――悲しいお話の中に閉じ込められたお姫さま。いつもひとりぼっちでうつくしい歌に耳を傾け――誰かが自分を迎えに来てくれるのを、助けに来てくれるのを、待っている。
lines.translated: I murmured to myself--a princess locked away inside a sad story. Always all alone, listening closely to a beautiful song--waiting for someone to come for her, to come and rescue her.

lines.content: そんな彼女を救い出すためのヒーローは……いったい、
lines.translated: The hero meant to rescue a girl like that... just where...

lines.content: ……いったいどこへ、行ってしまったんだよ
lines.translated: "...Just where in the world did he go?"

lines.content: ましろと別れたあのときの俺は、うなだれたまま、奇跡をただ祈るばかりだったのだ。
lines.translated: Back when I parted ways with Mashiro, I had simply hung my head and done nothing but pray for a miracle.

lines.content: そんな俺に声を掛けてきたのは“夜”の住人たちだった。
lines.translated: The ones who called out to me then were the residents of the "Night."

lines.content: 振り向くと様々な“イキモノ”たちがいた。
lines.translated: When I turned around, there were all sorts of "Creatures" standing there.

lines.content: どうか、ぼくたちの女王さまを助けてほしい
lines.translated: "Please, we want you to save our Queen."

lines.content: ふと、そんなことを願われてしまう。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, they made such a wish of me.

lines.content: 彼女は自分を犠牲にし、ぼくらのことを――“夜の世界”を守ろうとしている
lines.translated: "She is sacrificing herself to protect us--to protect the 'World of the Night.'"

lines.content: どういうこと……？
lines.translated: "What do you mean...?"
In truth, I already knew the answer without even having to ask.

lines.content: ましろと繋いだ手から様々な記憶が、“想い”が、俺の中に流れ込んできていたからだ。
lines.translated: Because all sorts of memories, all sorts of "feelings," had flowed into me through the hand I had joined with Mashiro's.

lines.content: 第三者からの説明がほしいと思った――俺が知ったものは夢ではなく、本当に真実なのかどうか。
lines.translated: I wanted an explanation from a third party--to know whether what I had learned was truly reality and not just a dream.

lines.content: 夜の“イキモノ”たちは口々に教えてくれた。
lines.translated: The "Creatures" of the Night each spoke up to tell me.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]は、いつか訪れる崩壊の未来から、無価値な人たちの命をも平等に守るだけの価値があるのだと願い、救うためにと、脈々と過去の大人たちが想いを重ね、維持してきた場所だ
lines.translated: "This is a place that adults of the past have maintained by piling their wishes upon one another through the generations, praying that even the lives of worthless people are worth protecting equally from a future of collapse that will one day arrive, all in order to save them."

lines.content: ……そのはじまりは遠い過去にあって、そして同時に、[・|現][・|在]にもあるものだけれど
lines.translated: "...Its beginning lies in the distant past, and yet at the same time, it also exists in the present."

lines.content: ……そうだね。この場所は複雑怪奇だ
lines.translated: "...That's right. This place is complex and bizarre."

lines.content: ……[現在|ここ]で、とある女の子が“夜の国”を完全なものにした。そのために、あらゆる時代の“隣”に、この場所は現れた
lines.translated: "...Right here in the present, a certain girl made the 'Night Realm' complete. Because of that, this place appeared 'next to' every single era."

lines.content: ……うん。だけど、[はじまり|発生]があやふやならば、[終わり|消滅]もまたあやふやなんだよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. However, if its beginning--its emergence--is ambiguous, then its end--its disappearance--is ambiguous as well."

lines.content: 情報を整理したい俺の問いかけに、彼らは丁寧に付き合ってくれた。
lines.translated: They patiently humored my questions as I tried to sort out the information.

lines.content: どこかの時代で一度でも、[・|そ][・|れ]が途切れてしまうようなことがあれば……
lines.translated: "If it were ever to be severed even once in any era..."

lines.content: ……“夜の国”は、消えてなくなる。永遠に
lines.translated: "...The 'Night Realm' would vanish and cease to exist. Forever."

lines.content: もちろん、それを必要とする未来の時間の“隣”からも。
lines.translated: Including, of course, from right "next to" the future time that needs it.

lines.content: そんな未来を不憫に思った大人たちはこの場所を、どうしても、何が何でも、維持したいと躍起になってる[・|―][・|―][・|時][・|に][・|心][・|を][・|、][・|悪][・|魔][・|に][・|さ][・|え][・|売][・|り][・|渡][・|し][・|な][・|が][・|ら]
lines.translated: "Taking pity on such a future, the adults are desperate to maintain this place no matter what, by any means necessary--at times even selling their own hearts to the devil."

lines.content: そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: [・|救][・|い]が必要となる未来まで“夜の国”を……[・|死][・|者][・|の][・|世][・|界]を維持し続けるには、たくさんの“子ども達”の心や命を、あのさくらの樹に捧げ続けなければならない
lines.translated: "In order to keep maintaining the 'Night Realm'... the 'World of the Dead,' until the future when salvation is needed, they must continue offering the hearts and lives of many 'children' to that cherry blossom tree."

lines.content: ……何かを得るなら、相応の何かを差し出す必要がある
lines.translated: "...If you want to gain something, you have to offer up something of equal value."

lines.content: うん。その通りだ――それは生け贄として捧げられた子たちにとってはまさに“悪夢”だっただろうね
lines.translated: "Yes. That's exactly right--for the children offered up as sacrifices, it must have been a literal 'nightmare.'"

lines.content: そこにどんな理由があろうと、そうすることで人類の未来が繋がれようとも。命を奪われた子どもらの未来はそこで終わるんだから
lines.translated: "No matter what reason there might be behind it, and even if doing so keeps the future of humanity connected. Because for the children whose lives were stolen, their future ends right there."

lines.content: それでも……。と誰かは続けた。
lines.translated: "Even so..." someone continued.

lines.content: ……それでも、いつか未来で犠牲となる無価値な人類の全体数を考えれば、それは、微々たる犠牲なのかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Even so, if you consider the total number of worthless humans who will be sacrificed one day in the future, perhaps it is a trifling sacrifice."

lines.content: 君らが話していたトロッコの問題だよ、と誰かが言う。盗み聞いていて、ごめんね。そう付け加えながら。
lines.translated: "It's the trolley problem you two were talking about," someone said, adding, "Sorry for eavesdropping."

lines.content: 大勢と少人数。どちらを犠牲にするのか。そのためのスイッチが、自分の手にはある。
lines.translated: The many versus the few. Which side do you sacrifice? The switch to decide is right in your own hand.

lines.content: だけど女の子は……ましろは、ぼくらの女王さまは。大勢を救うためのボタンを、押す――……そんな選択ができる子ではなかった
lines.translated: "However, that girl... Mashiro, our Queen. Pressing the button to save the many--...she wasn't a girl who could make a choice like that."

lines.content: ましろはね、三つ目の選択肢を想像できる子だったんだよ
lines.translated: "Mashiro, you see, was a girl who could imagine a third option."

lines.content: 三つ目？
lines.translated: "A third option?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: たった数人の命を守るため、大勢を犠牲にするか――あるいは、その真逆を選ぶか。与えられた選択肢はふたつきり。
lines.translated: Sacrifice the many to protect the lives of just a few--or choose the exact opposite. Only two options were given.

lines.content: だけどあの子は、自ら進む道を自ら作り出すことのできる子だ
lines.translated: "However, that girl is someone who can create her own path to walk down all by herself."

lines.content: 復唱するようにそう言った[イキモノ|誰か]は、空をふと、見上げた。
lines.translated: Repeating those words as if reciting them, someone--one of the Creatures--suddenly looked up at the sky.

lines.content: あのときの俺も、同じようにして“夜”を仰いだ。
lines.translated: Back then, I looked up at the "Night" in the exact same way.

lines.content: 満開だ。
lines.translated: It was in full bloom.

lines.content: さくらの花が咲いている。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms were blooming.

lines.content: そしてその向こうには――月だ。銀色に、あるいはまっしろに光り輝く満月がある。
lines.translated: And beyond them--was the moon. A full moon shining brilliantly in silver, or perhaps pure white.

lines.content: ……月が地上に墜ちてくる
lines.translated: "...The moon will fall to the earth."

lines.content: そうして、自分たちへいっぱいの残酷さを押しつけてきた大人へ報復を……
lines.translated: "And in doing so, bring retribution upon the adults who forced so much cruelty upon them..."

lines.content: そう考え、“想像”した黒色な子たちの命もまた、ましろの命と同様に、あのさくらの樹の大きな心をゆりかご代わりにして、眠ってる――
lines.translated: "The lives of the pitch-black children who thought that way and 'imagined' it are also sleeping, just like Mashiro's life, using the great heart of that cherry blossom tree as a cradle--"

lines.content: ――いわゆるそうした[・|過][・|激][・|派]の思考は、その“想像力”はね、実のところ未だ“夜”から外の世界へ少しずつだけれど、漏れ出し続けてる。だから……
lines.translated: "--In fact, the thoughts of those so-called 'radicals,' their 'imagination,' is still leaking out little by little from the 'Night' into the outside world. That's why..."

lines.content: ……だから、あの月は長い時間をかけて、いつか地上へ落下……はしないまでも、最接近する？
lines.translated: "...That's why, over a long period of time, that moon will eventually fall to the earth... or if not fall, make its closest approach?"

lines.content: そうだね。そして大人たちの心は壊れてしまう。殺し合いと崩壊の歴史はそこからはじまる
lines.translated: "That's right. And the hearts of the adults will be broken. A history of mutual slaughter and collapse will begin from there."

lines.content: 月の光は人々の心を狂わせる。いつの時代も、[ひとでなし|埒外の怪物]を生み出し続けてきた。
lines.translated: The light of the moon drives people's hearts mad. In every era, it has continued to birth monsters beyond the pale--inhuman brutes.

lines.content: 月の光が人の心を壊してしまう――
lines.translated: "Moonlight breaks the human heart--"

lines.content: そんなのは迷信だと思われていた時代には、狂気に堕ちる[人物|大人]は遺伝子の異常とか、遺伝する頭の病気なのだとか。科学はそういうふうに結論づけたがっていたけれどね
lines.translated: "In an era when such a thing was thought to be superstition, science wanted to conclude that adults who fell into madness had genetic abnormalities, or hereditary brain diseases."

lines.content: ……あるいはその非科学的な月の光の[・|そ][・|の][・|効][・|果]さえ、漆黒の子ども達の“呪い”なのかもしれない。ともかく人類の破滅はそうしてはじまってしまうんだ
lines.translated: "...Or perhaps even that unscientific effect of the moonlight is the 'curse' of the pitch-black children. Regardless, the ruin of humanity begins that way."

lines.content: そんな愚かで、自身の心を律することも叶わない無価値な人々を見捨て、価値ある人類たちは人知れずこの星を去る
lines.translated: "Abandoning such foolish, worthless people who cannot even control their own hearts, the valuable humans secretly leave this planet."

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 残された人類は殺し合いの果てに、愛すべきこの[ほし|惑星]のあらゆるすべてをぐずぐずに破壊してしまう
lines.translated: "At the end of their mutual slaughter, the humanity left behind utterly destroys anything and everything on this beloved planet."

lines.content: そういう未来を、[黒色|過激派]な少年少女たちの心は、いつまでもいつまでも、思い描き続けている。
lines.translated: The hearts of the pitch-black boys and girls--the radicals--continue to envision that kind of future, forever and ever.

lines.content: かつて少年少女たちを虐げていたのは、主に、この町に暮らすとある家系の大人たちだった。
lines.translated: The ones who had once oppressed the boys and girls were mainly the adults of a certain family line living in this town.

lines.content: ……“夜”を維持しようと少年少女の命を犠牲にし続けているのもまた同じだ。
lines.translated: And the ones continuing to sacrifice the lives of boys and girls to maintain the "Night" are the exact same.

lines.content: なぜ、その大人たちが残酷な行為に及んだのか――
lines.translated: "Why did those adults resort to such cruel acts?--"

lines.content: 彼らは自身の[・|作][・|品]のためなら、自身の[・|想][・|像][・|力]をより完璧な形で出力するためならば、まるで手段を選ばない。まさに[・|人][・|で][・|な][・|し]だったんだ
lines.translated: "For the sake of their own works, in order to output their own imagination in a more perfect form, they would stop at nothing. They were truly inhuman."

lines.content: 音楽。絵。物語。彼らの産み出す小さな世界。
lines.translated: Music. Paintings. Stories. The small worlds they produced.

lines.content: ……すべてにおいてリアリティをまず求めた。それを得るためには実体験が近道だ。
lines.translated: In all things, they sought reality first and foremost. To obtain that, actual experience was the shortest route.

lines.content: 殺人狂の心を描きたいのであれば、弱者をその手に掛けてみることが近道だ。
lines.translated: If they wanted to depict the mind of a homicidal maniac, cutting down the weak with their own hands was the shortest route.

lines.content: ……愛する者から相手にもされない、そのさみしさに窒息しそうな想いを描きたいのであれば、我が子を暗いくらい場所に閉じ込め、その心を間近で観察するのが近道だ。
lines.translated: If they wanted to depict the suffocating loneliness of being completely ignored by the ones you love, locking their own child in a dark, dark place and observing their heart up close was the shortest route.

lines.content: そういう家に生まれ付いたのだからしかたがない。作品作りにしかまるで興味を持てない大人たちは、本気でそんな方法が正道であると信じ込んでいた
lines.translated: "Having been born into such a family, it couldn't be helped. The adults, who could only take an interest in creating their works, genuinely believed that such methods were the proper path."

lines.content: リアリティだなんて。……笑えるよね
lines.translated: "Reality, they say. ...It's laughable, isn't it?"

lines.content: 誰かは[あざ|嘲]るように、言う。
lines.translated: Someone spoke, as if in mockery.

lines.content: 虚構と現実を混同してるのはいつだって大人たちのほうだ。創作物に[現実|リアル]だなんて必要ないのに……
lines.translated: "It's always the adults who confuse fiction with reality. Even though creative works don't need reality at all..."

lines.content: 必要なのは、[・|そ][・|れ]がリアルなのだと錯覚させてくれる高純度の[フィクション|偽物]だ。それを得るためには、いくら現実で実体験を積んだところで意味なんてどこにもないのに
lines.translated: "What's needed is high-purity fiction--a fake that creates the illusion of being real. To obtain that, there's no point whatsoever in piling up actual experiences in reality."

lines.content: 必要なのはいつだって“想像力”と、そこに芽生えるいっぱいの“想い”だ。
lines.translated: What is needed is always "imagination," and the abundance of "feelings" that sprout within it.

lines.content: ……それだけあれば現実なんて簡単に凌駕する――もうひとつの[現実|偽物]が、[ぼくら|受け手]の心に産まれ出る。その[体験|出会い]を求め、ぼくらはいつも新しい[作品|世界]を求めてる。
lines.translated: With just that, reality is easily surpassed--another reality, a fake, is born within our hearts as the audience. Seeking that experience, that encounter, we are always searching for new works, new worlds.

lines.content: ともかくね、と誰かは、話を先へと繋ぐ。
lines.translated: "Anyway," someone said, carrying the conversation forward.

lines.content: 過激な復讐思考を抱いた黒色の子らは、その血筋を深く憎んだ
lines.translated: "The pitch-black children who harbored radical thoughts of revenge deeply hated that bloodline."

lines.content: 自分たちへの仕打ち以上の理不尽を一つひとつ丁寧に、その身へ投げかけてやりたいと願った……しかし。
lines.translated: They wished to carefully hurl every single piece of unreasonableness back at them, even worse than what had been done to themselves... However.

lines.content: しかし即座に、その血筋を根絶やしにするのではなく、生かさず殺さず、真っ暗な苦しみの底へ、長い時間をかけ、堕とそうとした。
lines.translated: "However, rather than exterminating that bloodline immediately, they tried to cast them down into the pitch-black depths of suffering over a long period of time, letting them neither live nor die."

lines.content: ほら、[・|あ][・|れ]だよ。末代まで呪ってやるっていう、あれだ
lines.translated: "You know, that thing. Cursing them down to the very last generation."

lines.content: 呪い……
lines.translated: "A curse..."

lines.content: ああ。[・|そ][・|れ]はね、自身には到底扱いきれないような、不思議な[・|才][・|能]だったりという形で、その血筋の人間たちに現れる
lines.translated: "Yeah. It manifests in the people of that bloodline in the form of a mysterious talent that they could never possibly handle on their own."

lines.content: たとえば、眠りにつくと未来へと跳んでしまう、というものだったりね
lines.translated: "For example, something like leaping into the future whenever they fall asleep."

lines.content: あるいは大人になって、大切なものができたとき――幸せの絶頂にいるそのときに、またはもう少しで幸福を手に入られるかもしれない。そういうときに、限って……
lines.translated: "Or when they grow up and find something precious to them--right when they are at the peak of happiness, or perhaps when they are just about to grasp happiness. At times like that, and only at times like that..."

lines.content: その心が崩壊してしまうように、そして自らのその手で、大切なものを破壊してしまうようにと、憎悪を込めた……たとえば。
lines.translated: Filled with hatred, so that their hearts would collapse, and so that they would destroy what was precious to them with their own hands... For example:

lines.content: ……世界で一番愛しているはずの我が子を、暗闇の底に閉じ込め堕とす。[・|自][・|分][・|た][・|ち][・|が][・|そ][・|う][・|さ][・|れ][・|た][・|よ][・|う][・|に]。そして失ったあとでその大切さを思い出す。と、いった具合にね
lines.translated: "...Locking away and casting their own child, whom they should love most in the world, into the depths of darkness. Just as had been done to them. And only remembering how precious they were after losing them. Something along those lines."

lines.content: それじゃあまるで、過去の大人たちとやっていることは同じだ――結果として、同じに、なってしまっている。
lines.translated: Why, that's no different from what the adults of the past did--as a result, it has ended up becoming the exact same thing.

lines.content: それに、遠い先祖が――顔も名前も知らないもはや赤の他人同然の誰かが犯した罪によって、どうして、何ら悪に手を染めていない[俺たち|子孫]が、罰せられなければならないのだろう。
lines.translated: Besides, why must we descendants, who haven't dirtied our hands with any evil whatsoever, be punished for the sins committed by distant ancestors--people whose faces and names we don't even know, who are practically complete strangers to us now?

lines.content: そこにはこれ以上ないくらいの理不尽さと、絶望感とを感じずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but feel the utmost unreasonableness and despair in that.

lines.content: （……そう考えてしまうのは無責任なんだろうか。罪も罰も。……責任も。すべて自分の人生を生きたいと願うことは、罪なんだろうか）
lines.translated: (...Is it irresponsible of me to think that way? Both sin and punishment. ...And responsibility, too. Is it a sin to wish to live my own life in everything?)

lines.content: そんなやりきれなさにも似た想いを、どう口にしていいか。どんな言葉に変えて、いいのだろうか。
lines.translated: How should I voice these feelings that resembled unbearable frustration? What kind of words could I possibly turn them into?

lines.content: 幼い俺にはわからない。
lines.translated: Young as I was, I didn't know.

lines.content: どこか賢いふうを装っていても、やはりどうしようもなくまだまだ子どもだ。答えは出ない。
lines.translated: Even if I put on a somewhat clever front, I was still hopelessly a child. No answer came to me.
"As long as the moon doesn't approach the earth, it will be fine. That is what Mashiro is thinking."

lines.content: 語り続ける誰かは、未だ[・|あ][・|の][・|月]を見上げてる。
lines.translated: The one who kept speaking was still looking up at that moon.

lines.content: そうすれば大人たちの心は、[・|更][・|に]壊れることもない――
lines.translated: "That way, the hearts of the adults won't be broken any further--"

lines.content: 戦争ははじまらないし、ごく一部の人間がこの星を見捨てることもない。かも、しれない。そうすればぼくらの“夜”も、必要とはされなくなる
lines.translated: "The war won't start, and a handful of humans won't abandon this planet. Perhaps. And if that happens, our 'Night' won't be needed anymore, either."

lines.content: つまり前提を書き換えるのだ。
lines.translated: In other words, rewriting the premise.
Making it so that the runaway trolley never comes in the first place.

lines.content: それがあの子の描いた三つ目の選択肢
lines.translated: "That is the third option she envisioned."

lines.content: そもそも意地悪な[大前提|問題]そのものに乗ってなんてやるものか……そういう意思の現れみたいだ。運命に抗うとはこういうこと、みたいなさ。そう思わない？
lines.translated: "As if she'd ever play along with such a malicious premise--such a problem--in the first place... It's like a manifestation of that will. Like, this is what it means to defy fate. Don't you think so?"

lines.content: どうかな。……いや、うん。そうかもしれないね
lines.translated: "I wonder. ...No, yeah. Maybe so."

lines.content: まるで子どもみたいに目をきらめかせた[夜のイキモノ|誰か]に、俺は微笑み、そしてうなずいた。
lines.translated: To the Creature of the Night--that someone whose eyes were sparkling just like a child's--I smiled and nodded.

lines.content: ではその大前提を、思いどおりに書き換えてしまうために、ましろはどうしようと考えているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Then, in order to rewrite that grand premise just the way she wants, what is Mashiro planning to do?
I already know without even having to ask.

lines.content: 手と手で繋いだましろの心が教えてくれた――いや、ただ俺が、勝手にそれを覗き見ただけというのが正しいのかもしれないが……とにかく、わかってる。
lines.translated: Mashiro's heart, connected to mine hand in hand, had told me--no, perhaps it's more accurate to say that I simply peeked into it on my own... Either way, I know.

lines.content: ……ましろは、“未来”を上書きしようとしてる
lines.translated: "...Mashiro is trying to overwrite the 'future.'"

lines.content: 右の手のひらをじっと見つめながら、ひとり、つぶやいた。
lines.translated: Staring fixedly at the palm of my right hand, I murmured to myself.

lines.content: 忍び込んだ空き家の一室。目覚めたばかりの床の上。……隣には俺の相棒が眠ってる。
lines.translated: A room in an abandoned house we had snuck into. On the floor where I had just woken up. ...Next to me, my partner was sleeping.

lines.content: 俺はただ、今まで見ていた夢のことを思ってた。
lines.translated: I was simply thinking about the dream I had been having until just now.

lines.content: 黒色の子ども達の描いた破壊の[未来|光景]。
lines.translated: The vision of destruction--the future--depicted by the pitch-black children.

lines.content: そこにましろが新しい“未来”を想像し、上書きする――“月は地上に降っては来ない”“人々の心は護られる”
lines.translated: Mashiro imagines a new "future" and overwrites it--"The moon will not fall to the earth," "People's hearts will be protected."

lines.content: そういうふうに前提を覆すのだ。
lines.translated: That is how she overturns the premise.

lines.content: なるほど。だから、ヒーロー……。そのために、俺の“力”が必要なのか……
lines.translated: "I see. So that's why... a hero... And for that, she needs my 'power'..."

lines.content: この俺、奏大雅の持って生まれた“才能”……。
lines.translated: The "talent" I, Kanade Taiga, was born with...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 先ほどの話からすると、これは“才能”というより“呪い”なのかもしれないが――ともあれ、その効果は“夜”と“現実”とを繋ぐものだ。
lines.translated: Judging from the story just now, this might be more of a "curse" than a "talent"--regardless, its effect is to connect the "Night" and "reality."

lines.content: 目には見えない[・|も][・|の]の“想い”や言葉を、これまで、現実世界に残された人たちへと伝えてきたけれど……。
lines.translated: Until now, I have conveyed the "feelings" and words of unseen things to the people left behind in the real world, however...

lines.content: ましろの“想い”や言葉の代わりに、その“想像力”を、現実世界へと繋ぎ、呼び出して……
lines.translated: "Instead of Mashiro's 'feelings' or words, I connect her 'imagination' to the real world, calling it forth..."

lines.content: 俺たちはふたりで力を合わせる。
lines.translated: The two of us will join forces.

lines.content: 黒色の子ども達が描いた“復讐の未来”をまっしろに上書きし、撃ち破る――俺がましろの“想像力”を、外の世界に繋いで連れ出し、具現化して。
lines.translated: We will overwrite the "future of revenge" depicted by the pitch-black children in pure white, and shatter it--by having me connect Mashiro's "imagination" to the outside world, bringing it out, and materializing it.

lines.content: 場合によってはその“想像”を“魔法”のような武器として。
lines.translated: Depending on the situation, using that "imagination" as a weapon like "magic."

lines.content: 黒色の少年少女が描いた、巨大な“悪夢”に立ち向かうのだ。
lines.translated: We will stand against the massive "nightmare" depicted by the pitch-black boys and girls.

lines.content: “[・|夜][・|の][・|女][・|王]”と名付けられ畏怖されることとなる夜空の月。その[光景|未来]を破壊するために……
lines.translated: "The moon in the night sky, which will come to be named and feared as the 'Queen of the Night.' In order to destroy that sight--that future..."

lines.content: ……俺を、ヒーローなのだと彼女は呼ぶのだ。
lines.translated: She calls me a hero.

lines.content: しかしどういう道を選ぼうと“代償”は求められる。
lines.translated: However, no matter what path is chosen, a "price" is demanded.

lines.content: 何かを得るには同等の何かを支払う。“夜”のルールだ。
lines.translated: To obtain something, you must pay something of equal value. That is the rule of the "Night."

lines.content: ……“助けたいと願う愛する者たちから、いつまでも永遠に、憎まれ続けること”
lines.translated: "...'To be hated forever and ever by the loved ones she wishes to save.'"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]があの子の思い描いた“代償”だ――この手で繋いだ彼女の心が、そう言っていた。
lines.translated: That is the "price" she envisioned--her heart, connected to mine through this hand, told me so.

lines.content: かつて、あの子は“嫌われる”ということを何より恐れる子どもだった。
lines.translated: Once, she was a child who feared being "disliked" more than anything else.

lines.content: [・|誰][・|か]の期待に応えられず、嫌われ。憎まれ。[うと|疎]まれて……。ひとりぼっちになることを、いつも不安に思ってた。
lines.translated: Failing to meet someone's expectations, being disliked. Hated. Shunned... She was always anxious about ending up all alone.

lines.content: そんなましろは今、“夜の世界”と“外の世界”、そのふたつともを救おうとしている――期待された役割を果たそうとしている。もう二度と誰にも嫌われたくはないがため。
lines.translated: And now, that very same Mashiro is trying to save both the "World of the Night" and the "Outside World"--she is trying to fulfill the role expected of her. All because she never wants to be disliked by anyone ever again.

lines.content: ……なぜだ。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: なぜ、ましろが、[・|そ][・|う][・|ま][・|で][・|し][・|て]“夜”と“外”とを救おうとしているのか。
lines.translated: Why is Mashiro going to such lengths to save the "Night" and the "Outside"?
"I don't understand..."

lines.content: それは、[知らない|解らない]のではない。心を覗き見たせいで、理由は知っている。
lines.translated: It's not that I don't know. Because I peeked into her heart, I know the reason.

lines.content: ただ、理解できないのだ。
lines.translated: I just can't comprehend it.

lines.content: 願いが叶ってしまえば、ましろは、救ったはずのもの達から感謝されるのではなく、いっぱいの憎悪を向けられることになるだろう。
lines.translated: Once her wish comes true, rather than being thanked by the ones she saved, Mashiro will surely have an overwhelming amount of hatred directed at her.
The enemy of humanity, the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: そんなふうに揶揄されて、“夜”の中でも外ででも疎まれてしまう。
lines.translated: Mocked like that, she will be shunned both inside and outside the "Night."

lines.content: [・|今][・|と][・|は][・|ま][・|っ][・|た][・|く][・|真][・|逆]だ――嫌われてしまうことを何より恐れる女の子。それ故に、今、この“夜”の世界では、誰もに愛され生きている。
lines.translated: It is the exact opposite of how things are now--a girl who fears being disliked more than anything. Because of that, right now, in this world of the "Night," she lives loved by everyone.

lines.content: そんな彼女が、彼女自身の願いを叶えるための“代償”として、それ以上に相応しいものはない。きっと、ない。
lines.translated: For a girl like her, as the "price" to grant her own wish, there is nothing more fitting than that. Surely, nothing at all.

lines.content: その願いを叶えるための“[力|鍵]”を、この俺が握っているのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though I am likely the one holding the "key"--the "power"--to grant that wish...

lines.content: 『愛されてれば愛されてるほど、そうじゃなくなってしまったときのことを考えると……つらいよ』
lines.translated: "The more I'm loved, the more painful it is when I think about what happens when things aren't like that anymore..."

lines.content: ふとましろのつぶやきが脳裏に過ぎった。
lines.translated: Mashiro's murmur suddenly crossed my mind.

lines.content: お願いだ。あの子を助けてあげてほしい
lines.translated: "Please. I want you to save that girl."

lines.content: [夜のイキモノ|誰か]の声もまた、心を過ぎる。
lines.translated: The voice of someone--a Creature of the Night--also crossed my heart.

lines.content: 俺は、空っぽの手のひらを見つめ続けていた。
lines.translated: I kept staring at my empty palm.

lines.content: なあ、ましろ。どうして君はそこまでするんだ――[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|の][・|は]、[・|い][・|や][・|だ][・|よ]
lines.translated: "Hey, Mashiro. Why are you going that far--I don't want that."

lines.content: 冷たい不幸の底で命を落とした少女の命に、さくらの樹に芽生えた神さまは――神さまとも呼べる[心|何か]は。
lines.translated: Into the life of a girl who perished at the bottom of cold misfortune, the god that sprouted in the cherry blossom tree--a heart, a something that could be called a god...

lines.content: 残酷でさみしいばかりの人生を生きた彼女のような子らに、せめて幸せな夢を見てほしいと願ってた。
lines.translated: Wished for children like her, who had lived lives of nothing but cruelty and loneliness, to at least have happy dreams.

lines.content: 想像することがすべて叶う“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Land of the Night," where everything imagined comes true.

lines.content: そこは本来、彼女らのためだけの場所だった。
lines.translated: Originally, that place was meant solely for them.

lines.content: 求めた幸せを、夢の中でだけでも具現化させる。
lines.translated: Materializing the happiness they sought, even if only within a dream.

lines.content: しかしその暖かな眠りから、殆ど一方的に起こされた今、ましろはあの部屋で“悪夢”を見続けていると、俺は知った。
lines.translated: However, having been woken up almost unilaterally from that warm slumber, I learned that Mashiro is now continuing to have "nightmares" in that room.

lines.content: 本人は、何も言わなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "She didn't say anything about it herself, though..."

lines.content: 平気な顔して、毎晩、俺があの小さな時計塔の部屋にやって来るのを、迎えていてくれたけれど……。
lines.translated: Putting on a calm face, she welcomed me every night when I came to that small clock tower room, and yet...

lines.content: ましろは未だ、両親に愛されずにいた少女時代の記憶に苦しんでいる――ましろと繋いだこの手から、それを知った。
lines.translated: Mashiro is still suffering from the memories of her childhood when she wasn't loved by her parents--I learned that from this hand that connected with hers.

lines.content: ましろと[・|あ][・|の][・|子]……俺の母親だ。
lines.translated: Mashiro and that girl... my mother.

lines.content: そのふたりが造った[・|新][・|し][・|い]“[・|夜][・|の][・|国]”では、かつての[記憶|苦悩]でさえ“悪夢”として形になり、何度も何度も、繰り返し、繰り返し……心に鋭い牙をむく。
lines.translated: In the new "Land of the Night" created by those two, even past memories and agonizing struggles take shape as "nightmares," baring their sharp fangs at her heart over and over, again and again...

lines.content: それでもましろは再びさくらのゆりかごで眠りにつこうとはしなかった――[・|そ][・|の][・|理][・|由]を、俺は解ってるけれど、しかし決して理解はできないのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, Mashiro did not try to go back to sleep in the cherry blossom cradle--I know the reason for that, yet I can never comprehend it.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|に]あの時計塔の小さな部屋で、ましろは永遠に“悪夢”を見続けるつもりなのだろうか。
lines.translated: For the sake of something like that, does Mashiro intend to keep having "nightmares" forever in that small room in the clock tower?

lines.content: これから、世界を救ったその先で……“夜の中”でも、“夜の外”ででも、充分に憎まれながらも、永遠に……
lines.translated: "From now on, beyond saving the world... while being thoroughly hated both 'inside the Night' and 'outside the Night,' forever..."

lines.content: そんなましろのことを、俺に……この俺なんかに助けてほしいと、繰り返し[夜のイキモノたち|彼ら]は願っていた。
lines.translated: The Creatures of the Night repeatedly wished for me... for someone like me to save Mashiro from that.

lines.content: “お願いだ。あの子を“夜の世界”から連れ出してあげてほしいんだ――もうこれ以上、[・|ぼ][・|く][・|ら][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|に]苦しんでほしくない。君になら、君の力になら、それができるだろう？”
lines.translated: "Please. I want you to take that girl out of the 'World of the Night'--we don't want her to suffer for our sake any longer. If it's you, if it's your power, you can do that, right?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: できるだろうはずだ。
lines.translated: I should be able to do it.

lines.content: 俺の[・|右][・|手]は彼女を、その心ごと繋ぎ、“悪夢”の外へと――“夜”の外へと連れ出すことができるだろうと、思う。
lines.translated: I think my right hand could connect with her, heart and all, and take her outside the "nightmare"--outside the "Night."

lines.content: 俺の“[才能|力]”は“死が見える”というもの。
lines.translated: My "power"--my "talent"--is "seeing death."

lines.content: そして“夜と現実とを繋ぐことができる”と、いうものだ……死者の声を届けるなどして。
lines.translated: And it is "being able to connect the Night and reality"... by doing things like delivering the voices of the dead.

lines.content: そうして、遠いいつかの日のように。
lines.translated: And so, just like on some distant day.

lines.content: いつまでも変わらない、かわいい“半透明”な姿のまま……。
lines.translated: Remaining in that cute, "semi-transparent" form that never changes...

lines.content: まだ俺が赤ん坊だった頃のように、いつまでもずっと、そばにいてほしいと、そう願うことだってできるだろうとは思う。
lines.translated: Just like when I was still a baby, I think I could even wish for her to stay by my side forever and always.

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."
That is impossible.

lines.content: この町に探し求めたヒーローはどこにもいないのだと知った。
lines.translated: I learned that the hero I sought in this town is nowhere to be found.

lines.content: ならばもう、ここに留まる理由が[・|俺][・|に][・|は]ないのだ。
lines.translated: In that case, there is no longer any reason for me to stay here.
If I don't run away as soon as possible, I'll be dragged back. Even so...

lines.content: ごめん……。
lines.translated: I'm sorry...

lines.content: “後悔”してる。
lines.translated: I "regret" it.

lines.content: ……どうして俺は、ましろの手を離してしまったんだ
lines.translated: "...Why did I let go of Mashiro's hand?"

lines.content: 情けない。
lines.translated: It's pathetic.

lines.content: 今夜限りで“さよなら”だったのだとしても……。
lines.translated: Even if tonight was going to be our final "goodbye"...

lines.content: ここにいるのが本物のヒーローだとしたら、あの場面では決して手を離さずいたはずだ。
lines.translated: If a real hero were here, they would never have let go of her hand in that moment.

lines.content: そして君を“夜”の中から連れ出して、一緒にこの世界を、更には“夜”の世界をも救うため、力を合わせようともするのかもしれない――
lines.translated: And perhaps they would try to take you out of the "Night," and join forces to save this world together, and even the world of the "Night" as well--

lines.content: そういうふうに、心を固め直すことだってあるのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps they might even steel their resolve like that.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 俺にはできない。
lines.translated: I can't do it.

lines.content: 次に同じ場面があったとしても、俺は同じように手を離してしまっただろう――だから“後悔”はしていないと、言い換えなければならないのだ。
lines.translated: Even if the same situation were to happen again next time, I would probably let go of her hand in the exact same way--so I must rephrase it and say that I do not "regret" it.
Because--my running away from this town will end up protecting you... Mashiro.

lines.content: だから早く。
lines.translated: So, quickly.

lines.content: 一秒でも早く、この町から逃げ出さなければならない。
lines.translated: Even one second sooner, I have to run away from this town.
We are going to ignore the expectations of the adults.

lines.content: だからもうここにはいられない。一秒だって。ただの一瞬だって。
lines.translated: So I can't stay here anymore. Not even for a second. Not even for a single moment.

lines.content: ……俺は、ましろ。ごめん。本当に。君や君たちの期待にも、応えられそうにない
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Mashiro. Truly. It looks like I won't be able to live up to your expectations, or theirs, either."

lines.content: 首を振り。
lines.translated: Shaking my head.

lines.content: 唇を噛み。
lines.translated: Biting my lip.

lines.content: ……急いでこの町から逃げ出す準備を整えた。
lines.translated: I hurriedly prepared to run away from this town.

lines.content: ……これでいい
lines.translated: "...This is fine."

lines.content: これでいいはずなんだ。
lines.translated: This should be fine.

lines.content: 俺は、小さな[・|君]の手を握る。
lines.translated: I grasp your small hand.

lines.content: そして走り出そうと、する。
lines.translated: And I try to start running.

lines.content: そうだ。これでいい――もう二度と君とは逢わない。そうすることで“夜”に“鍵”は掛けられたまま。
lines.translated: That's right. This is fine--I will never meet you again. By doing so, the "Night" remains "locked."

lines.content: 誰も君に手を出すことは叶わない。
lines.translated: No one will be able to lay a hand on you.

lines.content: だからこれでいいのだと、信じてる
lines.translated: "That's why I believe this is fine."

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: それなのに……っ。
lines.translated: And yet... ngh.

lines.content: だめだ
lines.translated: "No can do."
Why?
"I can't run away...!"

lines.content: 俺にも護らなきゃならない相棒が――家族が、今も隣にこうしているのに。
lines.translated: Even though I also have a partner--a family--right next to me even now, whom I must protect.

lines.content: ましろ……
lines.translated: "Mashiro..."

lines.content: どうしても考えてしまうんだ。
lines.translated: I just can't help thinking about it.

lines.content: 君は今もまだ“夜”の中で、ひとりさみしいばかりの“悪夢”にうなされているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Are you still inside the "Night" even now, groaning in a "nightmare" of sheer loneliness all by yourself?

lines.content: 自分以外のあらゆるすべてを護るため。
lines.translated: In order to protect everything and everyone other than yourself.
All just to protect the future of someone like me.

lines.content: そう思うと、だめだ。足が止まった。
lines.translated: The moment I thought that, it was no good. My feet stopped in their tracks.
It's a "song."

lines.content: 心の中に、いつか聞いた懐かしい“歌”が繰り返し……繰り返し、響いていた。
lines.translated: Inside my heart, a nostalgic "song" I had heard once before echoed over... and over again.

lines.content: この“歌”は誰のための歌だろう。これを創り上げたのは俺の父親――[・|俺][・|の]、[・|ヒ][・|ー][・|ロ][・|ー][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Who is this "song" for? The one who created it was my father--my hero.

lines.content: だからもう一度、自分に問いかける――“これでいいのか”と。
lines.translated: So I ask myself once more--"Is this really fine?"
"This is fine."

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.
"This is fine..."
Like hell it is!

lines.content: “拳銃”を握りしめ、小さく叫んだ。
lines.translated: Clenching my "handgun" tightly, I let out a small shout.

lines.content: ヒーローはどこにいる。
lines.translated: Where is the hero?

lines.content: いつもの言葉のその中に、今――必要なだけの“勇気”の[ありか|在処]を、俺は探した。
lines.translated: Within those familiar words, I searched for the whereabouts of the "courage" I needed right now.

lines.content: ふと目を覚ます。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I wake up.

lines.content: “歌”が聞こえる。
lines.translated: I hear a "song."

lines.content: 小さくとも力強い“愛”の“歌”だ。
lines.translated: It is a small yet powerful "song" of "love."

lines.content: ……過去から現在へ。そして、未来へ。
lines.translated: From the past to the present. And into the future.

lines.content: たくさんの人たちが“想い”を重ね、歌い継がれてきた愛しい“歌”だ。
lines.translated: A beloved "song" passed down through voices, layered with the "feelings" of so many people.

lines.content: [・|私]はこの“歌”みたいに生きたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to live like this "song."

lines.content: ……この“歌”みたいに、大切な誰かへ力をあげられるような。……いつもそばで涙を拭いてあげられるような。そんな生き方がしたかった
lines.translated: "...To be able to give strength to someone precious to me, just like this 'song.' ...To always be by their side to wipe away their tears. That's the kind of life I wanted to live."

lines.content: ……それが私の“恋するための物語”になるんだと、漠然と、信じてた。
lines.translated: I vaguely believed that would become my "story for falling in love."

lines.content: 私は夢見てばかりだ。
lines.translated: All I ever do is dream.

lines.content: 生きていても、死んでしまっても、この心はいつまでも、子どもだ。
lines.translated: Whether alive or dead, this heart of mine remains a child forever.

lines.content: ずきりと胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: A sharp pain throbbed in my chest.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ため息をつく。
lines.translated: He let out a sigh.

lines.content: 胸の痛みが、増していく。
lines.translated: The ache in my chest grows stronger.

lines.content: ……今夜も夢がはじまる。
lines.translated: The dream begins again tonight.

lines.content: 苦しいばかりの“悪い夢”
lines.translated: An agonizing "bad dream."

lines.content: それは遠いいつかの悲しい“記憶”だ――[・|こ][・|こ]にこうして目覚めている限り、私は永遠に[・|こ][・|の][・|夢]を見続けるのだ。
lines.translated: It is a sad "memory" from a distant past--as long as I remain awake here like this, I will continue to see this dream for all eternity.

lines.content: 『助けて……』
lines.translated: "Help me..."

lines.content: “夜”の暗闇から声がする。
lines.translated: A voice calls out from the darkness of the "Night."

lines.content: 『誰かお願い』
lines.translated: "Someone, please."
Notice me.

lines.content: 深い地下室の底から響いてくる声だ。
lines.translated: It is a voice echoing from the bottom of a deep basement.

lines.content: 遠いいつかのさみしい記憶……。
lines.translated: A lonely memory from a distant time...

lines.content: 今夜も“悪夢”のはじまりだ。
lines.translated: Tonight, too, the "nightmare" begins.

lines.content: ――幸せだった[・|女][・|の][・|子]は、ある日突然、自由に外を駆け回ることができなくなった。
lines.translated: --The girl, who had once been so happy, suddenly became unable to run around freely outside one day.

lines.content: 重い病気にじわじわと身体を、命を、むしばまれはじめた。
lines.translated: A severe illness began to slowly eat away at her body, and her life.

lines.content: たくさんの病院をたらい回しにされた。
lines.translated: She was passed around from one hospital to another.

lines.content: 理由は病室に空きがないとか、あんまりにも珍しい難病であるため、ここには対処できる医師がいないとか。
lines.translated: The reasons given were that there were no empty beds, or that because it was such an exceptionally rare and incurable disease, there were no doctors there who could handle it.

lines.content: すべて言い訳だった。
lines.translated: They were all excuses.

lines.content: 誰も女の子の命に責任を取りたくないために、ありがちな理由をつけていただけだ。
lines.translated: Nobody wanted to take responsibility for the girl's life, so they just tacked on convenient reasons.

lines.content: 両親は自分たちが我が子を治すと決めた。
lines.translated: Her parents decided that they would cure their child themselves.

lines.content: 家の地下室は女の子の命を維持するため、小さな病室のような形に整えられた。
lines.translated: To sustain the girl's life, the basement of their house was arranged to look like a small hospital room.

lines.content: 今日からここがあなたの部屋よ。そんな言葉には笑顔が添えられていた。
lines.translated: Starting today, this is your room. Those words were accompanied by smiles.

lines.content: ……ふたりが女の子に笑顔を見せたのはそれが最後だった。
lines.translated: That was the last time the two of them ever showed the girl a smile.

lines.content: 女の子の世話をする[ふたり|両親]が、日々、心も身体も痩せ細っていくのが、女の子の目にも明らかにわかった。
lines.translated: Even to the girl's eyes, it was painfully obvious that her parents, who were taking care of her, were wasting away in both mind and body day by day.

lines.content: 毎夜、ふたりのけんかが絶えない。
lines.translated: Every night, their fighting never ceased.

lines.content: 地下室に怒鳴り声と泣き声とが響いてきては、女の子は耳を塞いだ――自分だ。自分のせいだ。
lines.translated: Whenever angry shouts and sobs echoed down into the basement, the girl would cover her ears--it's me. It's my fault.

lines.content: 自分がこんな、わけのわからない病気になってしまったそのせいで……。
lines.translated: Because I came down with this incomprehensible illness...

lines.content: あんなに、仲の良かった家族だったはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though we used to be such a close, loving family.

lines.content: 『……あんなに、いつも笑っていられた私たちだった、はずなのに』
lines.translated: "...Even though we used to be able to smile together all the time."

lines.content: それなのに今、ここは地獄だ。
lines.translated: And yet now, this place is hell.

lines.content: 『私が全部、壊してしまった』
lines.translated: "I ruined everything."

lines.content: どちらかがどちらかを叩き、暴れ、悲鳴さえ響き渡る毎夜の時間。幸せなんてどこにもない。かけらも、ない。
lines.translated: Every night was a time of one hitting the other, thrashing about, with even screams echoing through the house. Happiness was nowhere to be found. Not even a single fragment of it.
"God, please."

lines.content: いつもいつも祈ってた――
lines.translated: She prayed, always, always--

lines.content: 『どうか、お願いします。大好きなふたりがまた、笑顔で過ごせる世界にしてください……』
lines.translated: "Please, I beg of you. Please make this a world where the two people I love so much can spend their days smiling again..."
I don't care what happens to me.

lines.content: 『……だからお願い。私の“夢”を叶えてください』
lines.translated: "...So please. Grant my 'dream.'"

lines.content: 現実さえ彩る想像力で、生まれ付いたその“才能”で、彼女は強く祈ったのだ。
lines.translated: With an imagination vivid enough to color even reality, with that innate "talent" she was born with, she prayed with all her might.

lines.content: 悲しみは人の想像力を更に色濃く、強固なものにし、場合によっては更に悲しみの底へとおとしめる。
lines.translated: Sorrow makes a person's imagination even deeper and more unyielding, and depending on the circumstances, drags them even further down into the depths of grief.

lines.content: ……その“想い”が、さくらの樹に不思議な“心”を芽生えさせたのかもしれない――彼女の悲しみに呼応した“才能”が、そのきっかけを産む原因くらいには、なったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps those "feelings" caused a mysterious "heart" to sprout within the cherry blossom tree--perhaps the "talent" that resonated with her sorrow became at least the catalyst that gave birth to that beginning.

lines.content: だけど神さまは、運命を好きに書き換えることはできるかもしれないけれど――人の心を塗り替えることは、できない。
lines.translated: However, while God might be able to rewrite fate as He pleases--He cannot repaint a person's heart.

lines.content: さみしい心はいつまでもさみしいし、悲しい“想い”はいつまで経っても、悲しいままだ。
lines.translated: A lonely heart remains lonely forever, and sad "feelings" remain sad no matter how much time passes.

lines.content: ある日、女の子の“夢”が突然に、叶ったのだ。
lines.translated: One day, the girl's "dream" suddenly came true.

lines.content: ぴったりとふたりのけんかが止んだ。
lines.translated: The fighting between the two of them stopped completely.

lines.content: 代わりに小さな赤ん坊の笑い声が聞こえてくるようになった。
lines.translated: Instead, the sound of a tiny baby's laughter began to reach her ears.

lines.content: 自分の代わりに子どもがひとり、やって来た――そして大好きなふたりは、笑顔を取り戻すことができた。
lines.translated: A single child had arrived to take her place--and the two people she loved so much were able to regain their smiles.

lines.content: それからはふたりが地下室にやって来る頻度もグッと減った。
lines.translated: After that, the frequency of their visits to the basement dropped drastically.

lines.content: 寝たきりの枕元には、ワイヤレスのトランシーバーのようなものが置かれている。何か苦しいことがあればこれでふたりを呼ぶようにと言われていた。
lines.translated: By her bedside, where she lay bedridden, sat something like a wireless walkie-talkie. She had been told to use it to call for them if she was ever in pain or distress.

lines.content: 殆ど子どものおもちゃ程度のものだったが、地下と一階とを繋ぐのであれば、その程度で充分だった。
lines.translated: It was practically little more than a child's toy, but for connecting the basement to the first floor, it was more than enough.

lines.content: しかし、この家に“誰か”がひとり増えてからというもの、スピーカー越しに何度問いかけようと、誰も応えてくれなくなった。
lines.translated: However, ever since "someone" new was added to the house, no matter how many times she called out through the speaker, no one ever answered her again.

lines.content: 夏場はむしむしとする地下室だ。
lines.translated: In the summertime, the basement was stiflingly humid.

lines.content: 水が飲みたい。お腹が空いた。身体を拭いてほしかった。
lines.translated: She wanted a drink of water. She was hungry. She wanted someone to wipe her body down.

lines.content: ……いつの間にか動かなくなってしまった両足に、何か、見たことのない大きな虫が這いずっている。
lines.translated: Across both of her legs, which had stopped moving before she knew it, some kind of large bug she had never seen before was crawling.

lines.content: 泣いても、叫んでも、もちろん誰も助けてはくれなくて……。
lines.translated: Even if she cried, even if she screamed, naturally, no one came to help her...

lines.content: さみしい。
lines.translated: I'm lonely.

lines.content: 悲しい。
lines.translated: It's sad.

lines.content: そんなときは、枕元のマイクのスイッチを入れた。
lines.translated: At times like that, she flipped the switch on the microphone by her pillow.

lines.content: スピーカーからふたりの笑い声が聞こえてくると……それだけで、うれしかった。
lines.translated: When she heard the sound of the two of them laughing through the speaker... that alone made her happy.

lines.content: 『お母さんと、お父さんは、すごいなあ……』
lines.translated: "Mom and Dad are amazing..."

lines.content: ふたりが笑うその声を聞いていれば、どうしてだろう。どんなに怖い思いをしても、心細くても、身体が軋んで空いて苦しくても、不思議と安心できたから。
lines.translated: Whenever she listened to the sound of their laughter, she wondered why it was. No matter how terrified she felt, how lonely she was, or how much her body creaked with emptiness and pain, it strangely brought her relief.

lines.content: まるで子守歌のようだった。
lines.translated: It was just like a lullaby.

lines.content: その声は私だけに歌われる歌のように思えたのだ。
lines.translated: Those voices felt like a song being sung just for her.

lines.content: だからふたりにはいつも笑っていてほしかった。
lines.translated: That was why she wanted the two of them to always be smiling.

lines.content: 『……私がいないほうが、ふたりはきっと幸せになれるんだ』
lines.translated: "...The two of them will surely be happier if I'm not around."

lines.content: だから、これでいい。このままでいい。
lines.translated: So, this is fine. It's fine just like this.
