lines.content: 『私は死んでしまってはじめて、この世界の……ふたりの役に立てるんだ』
lines.translated: "Only by dying can I finally be of use to this world... and to the two of them."

lines.content: スピーカー越しにふたりが“誰か”のことを、私に贈ったはずの名前で呼んでいた。
lines.translated: Through the speaker, the two of them were calling "someone" by the name that had supposedly been given to her.

lines.content: ああ、そっか。
lines.translated: Ah, I see.

lines.content: 私はもうどこにもいないんだね。
lines.translated: I really don't exist anywhere anymore, do I?

lines.content: “私はどうなってしまっても構わないから”
lines.translated: "I don't care what happens to me."
It turned out like this because that was what I wished for.

lines.content: 神さまはいつだって、私たちのお願いを叶えてくれる。
lines.translated: God always grants our wishes.

lines.content: 『……ねえ、お母さん』
lines.translated: "...Hey, Mom."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|夜]も女の子はトランシーバーのスイッチを入れた。
lines.translated: That night, too, the girl flipped the switch on the walkie-talkie.

lines.content: 『……教えて、お父さん』
lines.translated: "...Tell me, Dad."

lines.content: 女の子は息も絶え絶えに、いつもひとりぼっちで、スピーカー越しに問いかける。
lines.translated: With her breathing faint and ragged, always all alone, the girl asked through the speaker.

lines.content: 『ふたりは……まだいい子だった頃の私と、[・|そ][・|の][・|子]、どっちのことが、好きだった？』
lines.translated: "Between the me back when I was still a good girl, and that child... which one of us did the two of you love more?"

lines.content: 返事なんてもらえるはずもない。笑い声。幸せそうな声にすべてかき消され――……安堵する。
lines.translated: There was no way she would ever get a reply. Laughter. Everything was drowned out by the sound of their happy voices--...and she felt relieved.

lines.content: 私の自分勝手な問いかけが、ふたりに届かなくてよかった。
lines.translated: Thank goodness my selfish question didn't reach the two of them.

lines.content: そうして女の子は冷たい地下室で[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: And so, the girl closes her eyelids in the cold basement.

lines.content: 静かに。
lines.translated: Quietly.

lines.content: たった、ひとりきり。
lines.translated: Completely, utterly alone.

lines.content: それが最期だ。
lines.translated: That is the end.

lines.content: そして“悪夢”はまた、最初に戻る――
lines.translated: And then, the "nightmare" returns to the very beginning once again--

lines.content: [・|私]の“夜”は永遠にこの繰り返しだ。
lines.translated: *My* "Night" is an endless repetition of this.

lines.content: ため息をついた。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.

lines.content: ほんのひと時、“悪夢”から解放された。
lines.translated: For just a brief moment, I was freed from the "nightmare."

lines.content: それでも、心の中にはたくさんの言葉がしがみついている。
lines.translated: Even so, countless words still cling tightly to the inside of my heart.

lines.content: “私はどうなっても構わないから――”
lines.translated: "I don't care what happens to me--"

lines.content: うそだ。
lines.translated: That's a lie.

lines.content: 本当は、愛されたかった。
lines.translated: The truth is, I wanted to be loved.

lines.content: 世界で一番だよと言って、抱きしめてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted them to tell me I was the most precious thing in the world to them, and hold me tight.

lines.content: ……最期まで一緒にいるよ。そばにいるよ。そう言って、この手を繋いでいてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted them to say, "We'll be together until the very end. We'll stay right by your side," and hold onto my hand.

lines.content: だけど私の大好きなふたりは、私の知らない小さな子に笑いかけ、『あなたが世界で一番だよ』と抱きしめている。
lines.translated: Yet the two people I loved so much were smiling at a little child I didn't even know, holding them close and saying, "You are the most precious thing in the world to us."

lines.content: 空っぽだ……。
lines.translated: It's empty...

lines.content: 私の手のひらは、いつまでもずっと、誰とも繋がれないままだった。
lines.translated: The palm of my hand remained forever unheld, never connecting with anyone.

lines.content: 神さまひどいよと何度も思った。
lines.translated: Over and over, I thought about how cruel God was.

lines.content: ……どうしてこんな、さみしいことばかりな世界に私を……私たちを造ったの
lines.translated: "...Why did you create me... create us, in a world filled with nothing but loneliness?"

lines.content: そんな言葉を何度も、心の中に押し込めてきた。
lines.translated: I had shoved those words back down into my heart countless times.

lines.content: するとすかさず止まない“悪夢”が応えてくれる――“お前の命は愛されるだけの価値がないからだよ”
lines.translated: Whenever I did, the unending "nightmare" would immediately answer me--"It's because your life isn't worth being loved."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."
"*Playing the tragic victim* over *something as trivial as this*? How arrogant can you be."

lines.content: “世の中にはもっとひどく、つらい目に遭っている子らがいる。それなのに、いつも自分の幸せばかり求めてる。だから誰にも、見向きもしない”
lines.translated: "There are children out there in the world going through much worse, much more painful things. And yet, all you ever do is wish for your own happiness. That's why no one spares you a second glance."

lines.content: そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: こんな“悪夢”を見たくなければ、またさくらの樹の寝床へと戻ってしまえばいい。
lines.translated: If I don't want to see this kind of "nightmare," all I have to do is go back to my bed beneath the cherry blossom tree.

lines.content: そうすれば、私にとって都合の良すぎる“夢”を、永遠に、見続けていられるだろう――
lines.translated: If I did that, I could probably go on dreaming a "dream" that is far too convenient for me, forever and ever--

lines.content: [・|あ][・|そ][・|こ]でなら、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]は世界で一番、私のことが大好きなままでいてくれる
lines.translated: "If I'm *there*, *the two of them* will go on loving me more than anything in the world."

lines.content: そんなこと、現実では絶対にあり得ないけれど。
lines.translated: Even though something like that could never possibly happen in reality.

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: テーブルにぺったりと突っ伏し、片肘で頬を支えて……[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: Slumping flat against the table, I prop my cheek up with one elbow and... close my eyelids.

lines.content: 蓄音機から流れてくる“歌”に耳を、そして心を澄ませた。
lines.translated: I opened my ears, and my heart, to the "song" flowing from the phonograph.

lines.content: だけどね、大雅……。あなたが会いに来てくれるとね。……そのときだけ、私、“悪い夢”を全然見ないの。不思議だよね
lines.translated: "But you know, Taiga... Whenever you come to see me... During that time alone, I don't have 'bad dreams' at all. Isn't that strange?"

lines.content: [あの子|大雅]はきっと特別な子だ。
lines.translated: That child--Taiga--is surely someone special.

lines.content: 赤ん坊のときも。少し大きくなった今現在も。
lines.translated: Both when he was a baby, and right now, when he has grown a little bigger.

lines.content: あの子のそばにいると、本当にどうしてなのかな、つい頬が緩んで――私は、笑顔になれる。
lines.translated: Whenever I'm by his side, I really wonder why it is, my cheeks just naturally relax--and I'm able to smile.

lines.content: そのときだけは、いつまでも消えない“私の[さみしい気持ち|悪夢]”を、かけらも残さず忘れてしまって……。
lines.translated: During those moments alone, I completely forget every last trace of my "nightmare"--this lonely feeling of mine that never fades away...

lines.content: ちょっとだけ、やさしい私になれるんだ。
lines.translated: And I can become a slightly kinder version of myself.

lines.content: 私はきっと、あなたの“隣”にいられるそんな私のこと[・|も]、好きだった
lines.translated: "I'm sure I *also* liked the version of myself who could be right beside you."

lines.content: だからいつでもあなたのことを笑わせたくって、そんな私になりたくって、そのためなら何でもできると思えてしまって。
lines.translated: That was why I always wanted to make you laugh, why I wanted to become that kind of person, and why I felt like I could do anything for that sake.

lines.content: なんだかね。私、あなたのお母さんになれたような気がしてたんだよ
lines.translated: "Somehow, you know... I felt as though I had become your mother."

lines.content: 図々しいからそんなこと、本人には決して言えるはずもなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: That was way too presumptuous of me, so there was no way I could ever say it to him directly, though...

lines.content: 命のない“半透明”な私には、あなたに触れることだって叶わないし。あの頃はまだ、あなたにはこの声だって届かなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "As a lifeless, 'semi-transparent' being, I can't even touch you. And back then, my voice couldn't even reach you yet..."

lines.content: それでもきっと、あなたの隣にいられた私は幸せだった。
lines.translated: Even so, I was surely happy just being able to stay by your side.

lines.content: ……まだ、私にやさしかった頃のお母さんが、私に、いっぱいの笑顔と幸せをくれたように。私もあなたに、何かできることはないのかなって、祈ってた
lines.translated: "...Just as my mother gave me so many smiles and so much happiness back when she was still kind to me, I prayed, wondering if there was anything I could do for you, too."

lines.content: 触れられなくても。声は、届かなくても――姿は見えてる。笑顔は届く。
lines.translated: Even if I couldn't touch you. Even if my voice couldn't reach you--you could still see me. My smiles could still reach you.

lines.content: ――“特別な夜と現実とを繋ぐ[才能|力]”
lines.translated: --"The power to connect the special Night with reality."

lines.content: それがあなたの持って生まれた“特別”だ。だからあなたには[死|私]が見える。
lines.translated: That is the "special" gift you were born with. That is why you can see me--why you can see death.

lines.content: だからいつか、“半透明”な私とあなたはもっと深く繋がれる。そんな日が来る。そう信じてもいた。
lines.translated: And so, I believed that someday, the "semi-transparent" me and you would be able to connect on a much deeper level. That such a day would come.

lines.content: 今の私が、ひとりぼっちでさみしいあなたにできること。いっぱい、考えたよ
lines.translated: "I thought a whole lot about what the current me could do for you, when you were all alone and lonely."

lines.content: 変な顔とか。手遊びとか。そんなことくらいだけれどね。
lines.translated: Making funny faces, playing hand games... It was really only little things like that, though.

lines.content: そのお礼、だなんてことではもちろんなかっただろうけど……。
lines.translated: Of course, I'm sure he didn't mean it as a way of thanking me for that, or anything...

lines.content: 時どき、あなたの持ってる甘そうなお菓子に釘付けになっちゃう私に、あなたはまだまだ赤ちゃんだったのに、心配そうな顔をして、私にそのお菓子を差し出してくれてたね
lines.translated: "Sometimes, when my eyes were glued to the sweet-looking treats you were holding, even though you were still just a baby, you'd get this worried look on your face and hold the treat out to me."

lines.content: うれしかったよ。
lines.translated: That made me so happy.

lines.content: ……本当に。
lines.translated: It really did.

lines.content: 涙が出るくらい。
lines.translated: Enough to bring tears to my eyes.

lines.content: この子はきっと、こんな意地悪な世界の中ででも、負けずに、折れずに、腐らずに……やさしい大人に育ってくれる。そう信じられたから
lines.translated: "Because it made me believe that even in such a cruel world, this child would surely grow up into a kind adult... without losing, without breaking, and without growing bitter."

lines.content: この子は、大人になると“半透明”な私のことが見えなくなるだろうか――大勢の大人たちと同じように。
lines.translated: When this child grows up, will he stop being able to see the "semi-transparent" me--just like all the other adults?

lines.content: それともこの子は“特別”だから、いつまでもこうして“姿”だけは届くのだろうか。
lines.translated: Or, because this child is "special," will my "figure" alone continue to reach him forever like this?

lines.content: いつも、そばにいられたらいいなあ
lines.translated: "I wish I could stay by your side forever."

lines.content: そう思った。
lines.translated: That's what I thought to myself.

lines.content: もしもあなたがこの先、何か困ったことに出会ったら……。そのときは、どうにかしてあなたの力になれたらいいのにな
lines.translated: "If you ever run into any trouble in the future... I wish I could somehow be there to help you when that time comes."

lines.content: そんな“いつか”を夢にまで見て……。
lines.translated: I even dreamed of that "someday"...

lines.content: まっしろな満月の夜。ひとりきりで眠るあなたの隣で歌った子守歌。
lines.translated: On a night with a pure white full moon, I sang a lullaby beside you as you slept all alone.

lines.content: “過去”から届いた春の“歌”だ。
lines.translated: It was a "song" of spring that had arrived from the "past."

lines.content: 口ずさむその中に、あなたとふたりで生きていく――そんな決してあり得ないだろう未来を想像したりもしていたけれど……。
lines.translated: As I hummed it, I even imagined a future where the two of us lived together--a future that could surely never come to pass...
*They came for me.*

lines.content: “お願いします。どうかぼくらに、あなたの力を貸してほしい”
lines.translated: "Please. We beg of you, lend us your power."

lines.content: それは“夜のイキモノ”たちだった。
lines.translated: It was the "Creatures of the Night."

lines.content: ……彼ら曰く。この世界は終わりに近づいているという。
lines.translated: According to them, this world is nearing its end.

lines.content: “夜”の中も。“夜”の外も。どちらも終わりの“[運命|想像]”に飾られている。
lines.translated: Both inside the "Night" and outside the "Night." Both are adorned with the "imagination"--the fate--of demise.

lines.content: そんな“未来”を避けるための方法を一緒に考えてほしい。そう願われた。
lines.translated: They pleaded with me to help them think of a way to avoid such a "future."

lines.content: “いつかの遠い“夜”の中で、君が、たくさんの子どもらと夢を語ったときのように。今度は、[・|ぼ][・|く][・|ら]と一緒に“未来”を“想像”してほしい”
lines.translated: "Just like when you spoke of dreams with so many children in a distant 'Night' long ago. This time, we want you to 'imagine' a 'future' together with *us*."

lines.content: その願いに私はうなずき、あなたの“隣”から“夜”へと戻った――……本当は。
lines.translated: I nodded at their plea, and returned from your "side" back into the "Night"--...Though in truth...

lines.content: ……本当は、ごめんね。[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]はどうでもよかったの
lines.translated: "...In truth, I'm sorry. I didn't care about *any of that* at all."

lines.content: 人類の未来とか。“夜”の世界の行く末だとか。
lines.translated: The future of humanity, or what becomes of the world of the "Night."

lines.content: 本当に、ごめんなさい。そういう大それたことには殆ど興味が持てなかった。
lines.translated: I'm truly sorry, but I had almost no interest in such grand things.

lines.content: 私に興味があったのは[・|あ][・|な][・|た]の未来だけだった。あなたが生きていく世界。その未来を護っていきたい
lines.translated: "The only thing I was interested in was *your* future. The world where you will live on. That is the future I want to protect."

lines.content: だからこそ“夜”に戻った。
lines.translated: That was precisely why I returned to the "Night."

lines.content: この小さな部屋で“破滅の未来”を回避する方法について、たくさん、たくさんの“夜のイキモノ”たちと語り合い――そして、[・|見][・|つ][・|け][・|た]。
lines.translated: In this small room, I discussed ways to avert that "future of ruin" with so, so many "Creatures of the Night"--and then, *I found it*.

lines.content: “夜の世界”も、“外の世界”も、同時に救う方法を見つけたよ
lines.translated: "I found a way to save both the 'World of the Night' and the 'Outside World' at the same time."

lines.content: そのために……。
lines.translated: For that sake...

lines.content: 大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: ――“特別な夜と現実とを繋ぐ[才能|力]”
lines.translated: --"The power to connect the special Night with reality."

lines.content: きっと、私の立てた計画には、あなたの“力”が必要になる。
lines.translated: The plan I came up with will surely require your "power."

lines.content: 私の立てた計画そのものに、“夜のイキモノ”たちは大反対だったけれど……。
lines.translated: The "Creatures of the Night" were fiercely opposed to the plan itself, though...

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|す][・|る]以外の方法には、私の“想像力”ではたどり着くことができなかった。
lines.translated: With my "power of imagination," I couldn't arrive at any method other than *doing that*.

lines.content: あなたに歌った子守歌が道しるべだ。
lines.translated: The lullaby I sang to you is the signpost.

lines.content: ……あなたへは決して届かないだろう声で歌った春の“歌”
lines.translated: The "song" of spring that I sang with a voice that would surely never reach you.

lines.content: もしもあの“歌”が、いつか、成長したあなたへ届いて……
lines.translated: "If that 'song' should ever reach you once you've grown up..."

lines.content: あなたを私のところへ導いてくれるようなことがあったなら――そういう“運命”めいた繋がりを、私たちが持てたなら。
lines.translated: And if it were to guide you to me--if we could share a connection that felt so much like "destiny."

lines.content: そのときはね、大雅。私が選び、覚悟したこの道は正しかったんだって、思えるはずだよ
lines.translated: "When that time comes, Taiga, I'm sure I'll be able to believe that this path I chose and resolved myself to walk was the right one."

lines.content: だから私はこの部屋に閉じこもり――“夜の世界”に“鍵”をした。
lines.translated: So I shut myself away in this room--and placed a "lock" upon the "World of the Night."

lines.content: “外の世界”からは決して……大雅。奏大雅。私が勝手に大切に想ってる小さな子。あなた以外の誰も、決して“夜”へ這入ることができないようにと。
lines.translated: So that from the "Outside World," no one... Taiga. Kanade Taiga. The little child I selfishly hold so dear. So that no one other than you could ever enter the "Night."

lines.content: “外の世界”の大人たちはそれにすぐ気づくだろう
lines.translated: "The adults of the 'Outside World' will surely notice it right away."

lines.content: [・|彼][・|ら]の中には“夜の世界”のことを、大人になっても忘れず覚えている者も多くいる。
lines.translated: Among *them*, there are many who remember the "World of the Night" without forgetting it, even after growing into adults.

lines.content: 私たち“夜のイキモノ”に牙をむく大人たちは、この町に古くから生きている芸術家の家系。更に言えば私の子孫たちでもあるはずだ。
lines.translated: The adults who bare their fangs at us "Creatures of the Night" belong to a lineage of artists who have lived in this town since ancient times. To go even further, they must also be my descendants.

lines.content: 彼らはその生き方の性質上、心にいつでも少年少女が住み着いている――だから“才能”ある[・|彼][・|ら]には、いつだって“夜”は愛すべき静かなる隣人だ。
lines.translated: By the very nature of how they live, a boy or girl always resides within their hearts--and so, for *those* with "talent," the "Night" is always a beloved, quiet neighbor.

lines.content: ……きっと何かとても意地悪な方法で、私が“夜”にかけた“鍵”をこじ開けようとしてくるはずだ
lines.translated: "...They will surely try to pry open the 'lock' I placed upon the 'Night' using some terribly cruel method."

lines.content: ずきりと胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: A sharp pain throbbed in my chest.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 胸の痛みはまた“悪夢”のはじまる合図だ。
lines.translated: The pain in my chest is the signal that the "nightmare" is beginning once again.

lines.content: 繰り返し。何度でも。私はこの小さな部屋で“過去”のさみしい“想い”に沈んでる。
lines.translated: Over and over. Countless times. In this small room, I sink into the lonely "feelings" of the "past."

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ふと“悪夢”の中でつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Within the "nightmare," I suddenly murmured to myself.

lines.content: ……今夜は、大雅。なんだか遅いな
lines.translated: "...You're kind of late tonight, Taiga."

lines.content: もうすぐあなたが“外の世界”で眠りに落ちる頃だろう――いつもなら、もうすぐ会いにやって来てくれる頃。
lines.translated: It must be just about time for you to fall asleep in the "Outside World"--usually, it would be right around the time you come to see me.

lines.content: あなたと一緒にいられるときだけ、私は私の“[悪夢|過去]”から解放される。さみしい気持ちはここから消える。
lines.translated: Only when I can be with you am I freed from my "past"--my "nightmare." The lonely feelings vanish from this place.

lines.content: ……代わりにほんの少しだけやさしくなった私が産まれる。
lines.translated: And in their stead, a version of me who is just a little bit kinder is born.

lines.content: そんな私になれる瞬間が。あなたと話せる時間が幸せだった。
lines.translated: Those moments when I could become that version of myself, the time I spent talking with you--it was pure happiness.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 今夜はまだ、部屋の扉は開かれない。時間だけが過ぎゆくばかり。
lines.translated: Tonight, the door to the room still hasn't opened. Only time continues to slip away.

lines.content: ……“歌”が終わる。
lines.translated: The "song" comes to an end.

lines.content: “悪夢”もまた最初からはじまった。ひとりぼっちの“悪い夢”
lines.translated: The "nightmare" started all over again from the beginning. A lonely "bad dream."

lines.content: さみしいなあと、思ってしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking how lonely it was.

lines.content: お願い助けてと、願ってしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help wishing someone would please save me.

lines.content: そしてあなたの名前を呼んでいた。
lines.translated: And I found myself calling your name.

lines.content: ……だめだ
lines.translated: "...No, I can't."

lines.content: 私はあなたのお母さん――にはなれなくとも、その代わりにくらいはなりたかった。
lines.translated: Even if I couldn't become your mother--I at least wanted to be a substitute for her.

lines.content: お母さんが自分の子どもに“助けて”だなんて。そんなこと、言えないし……
lines.translated: "A mother asking her own child to 'save' her? I could never say something like that..."

lines.content: そんな弱い自分にはなりたくない。
lines.translated: I don't want to be that weak.

lines.content: お母さんはいつでも人生の“見本”でいてほしい。そんな存在であってほしい。……そうだよ。
lines.translated: I want a mother to always be a "role model" in life. That's the kind of presence I want to be. ...Yes, that's right.

lines.content: 誰も助けてくれないのなら……
lines.translated: "If no one is going to save me..."
Then I have no choice but to save myself--*tonight, I feel like I can do something different from usual.*

lines.content: ふと、そう思った。
lines.translated: That thought suddenly crossed my mind.

lines.content: また“[夢|悪夢]”がはじまる。
lines.translated: The "nightmare" begins again.

lines.content: いつも同じ夢を繰り返し繰り返し、私は見続けている。
lines.translated: Over and over, I keep dreaming the exact same dream.

lines.content: 夢の終わりも。はじまりも。途中経過も。……さみしさも。すべて忠実になぞるように同じだ。
lines.translated: The end of the dream. The beginning. Everything in between. ...Even the loneliness. It's all the same, as if faithfully tracing over the exact same lines.

lines.content: だけど大雅とまた、会えたからかな
lines.translated: "Maybe it's because I got to see Taiga again."

lines.content: ……今夜もまた会えたらいいなと、祈っているからかな。
lines.translated: Or maybe it's because I'm praying that I'll get to see him again tonight.

lines.content: いつもと違うことをしてみよう
lines.translated: "Let's try doing something different from usual."

lines.content: そんな勇気が湧いたのだ。
lines.translated: That kind of courage welled up inside me.

lines.content: “悪夢”の中で、寝たきりのベッドから転げて落ちた。
lines.translated: Inside the "nightmare," I rolled right off the bed I was confined to.

lines.content: 階段を這いずってあがり――地下室と一階とを隔てた扉の前までたどり着く。
lines.translated: I crawled up the stairs--and reached the door separating the basement from the first floor.

lines.content: 笑い声が聞こえる。
lines.translated: I can hear laughter.

lines.content: 扉の向こうから三人分の笑い声。
lines.translated: The sound of three people laughing from beyond the door.

lines.content: ここを開けば私もその中に加われるだろうか。
lines.translated: If I open this, will I be able to join them too?

lines.content: これは、夢なんだ。
lines.translated: This is a dream.

lines.content: 現実にはあり得もしないことが起きたって不思議はないはず。
lines.translated: It shouldn't be strange at all if something impossible in reality were to happen here.

lines.content: 扉を開いた。
lines.translated: I opened the door.

lines.content: すると、真っ白な光りに包まれて……。
lines.translated: And then, I was enveloped in pure white light...

lines.content: 求めた笑顔はそこにはなかった。
lines.translated: The smiles I longed for weren't there.

lines.content: その代わり、青空だ。
lines.translated: Instead, there was a blue sky.

lines.content: 私は真っ青な空の下にいた。
lines.translated: I was standing beneath a deep blue sky.

lines.content: ……外の世界は眩しくて。
lines.translated: The outside world was so dazzling.

lines.content: いっぱいの花でふわふわしてて。
lines.translated: Filled with so many flowers, soft and airy.

lines.content: 細めた目から涙がひとつ、ぽろりとこぼれ、頬を伝った。
lines.translated: From my narrowed eyes, a single tear spilled out and rolled down my cheek.

lines.content: これは……
lines.translated: "This is..."

lines.content: これは、“悪夢”だ。
lines.translated: This is a "nightmare."

lines.content: またすぐにでも真っ暗な地下室へ戻されるだろう。そうしてまた繰り返し最初から“悪い夢”を見るのだろう。
lines.translated: At any moment now, I'll surely be sent right back to that pitch-black basement. And I'll have to watch the "bad dream" repeat from the very beginning all over again.

lines.content: ……“歌”が聞こえた。
lines.translated: I heard a "song."

lines.content: 誰かがすぐそばで囁くように歌ってる。
lines.translated: Someone is singing right beside me, like a whisper.

lines.content: 手のひらに誰かが触れた。そんな感触が、あった。
lines.translated: Someone touched the palm of my hand. I felt that sensation.

lines.content: 振り返れば――驚いた。
lines.translated: When I turned around--I was astonished.
*A baby.*

lines.content: いつの間にか、腕の中に赤ん坊の[・|あ][・|な][・|た]を抱いていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was holding the infant *you* in my arms.

lines.content: 驚いた私。
lines.translated: I was astonished.

lines.content: 思わず、泣いてしまいそうになる私。
lines.translated: I felt like I was about to burst into tears at any second.

lines.content: そんな私を、小さなあなたは笑顔で見上げてくれていた。
lines.translated: And the tiny you was looking up at me with a smile.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ため息を、つく。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.

lines.content: ……はじめて、あなたを抱きしめられたよ
lines.translated: "...For the very first time, I finally got to hold you."

lines.content: 暖かかった。
lines.translated: You were warm.

lines.content: 頬ずりをした。ふにふにだった。太陽の香りが、いっぱい溢れる。
lines.translated: I nuzzled my cheek against yours. It was so soft and squishy. Overflowing with the scent of the sun.

lines.content: この光景こそが私の“光り”だ。私の、“夢”だ。
lines.translated: This very sight is my "light." It is my "dream."

lines.content: ……もしも願いが叶うなら、迷わずこんな[・|い][・|つ][・|か]を想像するだろうと思う。
lines.translated: If my wish could come true, I think I would imagine a *someday* just like this without a moment's hesitation.

lines.content: だけどこれは決して叶うはずもない“光り”だと知っている。
lines.translated: Yet I know this is a "light" that can never possibly come true.

lines.content: ひとつ、涙がこぼれた――すると、暗闇だ。
lines.translated: A single tear spilled over--and just like that, there was darkness.

lines.content: ……青空は冷たい漆黒へと変わる。
lines.translated: The blue sky turns into a cold, pitch black.

lines.content: 腕に抱いたあなたの重さを失った。
lines.translated: I lost the weight of you in my arms.

lines.content: ……また、最初から
lines.translated: "...From the beginning, again."

lines.content: ずきりと胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: A sharp pain throbbed in my chest.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで“悪夢”を見る。いっぱいのさみしさが何度でも胸の奥を突き刺した。
lines.translated: Watching the "nightmare" all alone. An overwhelming loneliness pierced deep into my chest over and over again.

lines.content: 扉が開かれる音がする。
lines.translated: There is the sound of a door opening.

lines.content: 地下室に誰かが這入ってくる気配。
lines.translated: The presence of someone stepping into the basement.

lines.content: お母さん……？
“悪夢”はいつも同じだ。まったく同じ光景が、変わらず流れていくだけだ。
lines.translated: The "nightmare" is always the same. The exact same scene simply plays out without ever changing.

lines.content: 最初にいつも、お母さんが地下室にやって来る。
lines.translated: At the start, Mom always comes down to the basement.

lines.content: そして私の様子をただ確認し、一階へと戻っていくのだ。
lines.translated: Then she just checks on how I'm doing and goes back up to the first floor.

lines.content: ……私がどんなに話しかけても無反応。
lines.translated: No matter how much I try to talk to her, there's no response.

lines.content: それがとてもさみしいと感じてた。
lines.translated: That always made me feel so terribly lonely.

lines.content: だけどごめんね、お母さん。
lines.translated: But I'm sorry, Mom.

lines.content: 今夜もまた、質問してみてもいい？
lines.translated: May I ask you a question again tonight?

lines.content: 血の繋がらない同士でも、親子になれる……？
lines.translated: "Can people become parent and child, even if they aren't related by blood...?"

lines.content: 私は、さっきまで愛しい重さを抱いていた腕を伸ばした――今はもう、空っぽになってしまった手のひらだ。抱きしめられるのは暗闇だけだ。
lines.translated: I reached out the arms that had been holding that precious weight until just moments ago--my palms were completely empty now. The only thing I can embrace is the darkness.

lines.content: ねえ、お母さん
lines.translated: "Hey, Mom."

lines.content: 教えてほしい――“命”のない私でも、あの子のお母さんになれるかな？
lines.translated: "Please tell me--even without 'life' of my own, can I still become that child's mother?"

lines.content: その問いかけに応えてくれるやさしい人は誰もいない。
lines.translated: There is no kind soul here to answer that question.

lines.content: お母さんは背を向けて、地下室の扉を閉じた。
lines.translated: Mom turned her back and closed the basement door.

lines.content: そうだよね。私はもうここにはいない。だからこの声も、心も、誰にも届くことはない。
lines.translated: That's right. I'm no longer here. So neither this voice nor this heart will ever reach anyone.

lines.content: 力なく、伸ばした手を下ろしたけれど……。
lines.translated: Powerlessly, I lowered my outstretched hand, and yet...

lines.content: そっと、私のその手に触れる誰かがいた。
lines.translated: Someone gently touched that hand of mine.

lines.content: ごめん
lines.translated: "Sorry."

lines.content: 地下室の暗闇はあっという間に、時計塔の管理室へと姿を変えた。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, the darkness of the basement transformed into the clock tower's office.

lines.content: ……遅くなってごめん。君を、助けに来たよ
lines.translated: "...Sorry I'm late. I came to save you."

lines.content: すっかり大きくなった私のかわいい赤ちゃんが、まるで立派な王子さまみたいに……でも、どこか、とても悲しい表情で、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: My cute little baby, now all grown up, was smiling just like a dashing prince... yet with an expression that was somehow terribly sad.
*I squeeze her hand.*

lines.content: するとましろは目を覚まし、驚いたように[・|俺]を見た。
lines.translated: With that, Mashiro woke up and looked at *me* in surprise.

lines.content: 私を、助けに……？
lines.translated: "To save... me...?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうだよと、答える。
lines.translated: That's right, I answer.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: だけど次にどう言っていいのかわからず、俺は視線を手元に落としてしまう。
lines.translated: Not knowing what to say next, however, I drop my gaze to our hands.
*Tonight, I came here once again.*

lines.content: 町から逃げ出すその前に、どうしても確かめたいことがあったから。
lines.translated: Because there was something I absolutely had to confirm before running away from this town.

lines.content: どうしても、この手を離したままではいられなかったから。
lines.translated: Because no matter what, I just couldn't leave this hand behind.

lines.content: いつもより少し遅く管理室にやって来ると、ましろは蓄音機の置かれたテーブルに片肘をつき、うつらうつらとし……瞳を閉じたその表情は、“悪夢”にうなされ、苦しそうだった。
lines.translated: When I arrived at the office a little later than usual, Mashiro was resting one elbow on the table with the gramophone, dozing off... With her eyes closed, her expression looked pained, as if she were being tormented by a "nightmare."

lines.content: でも今、目の前のましろはそんなことなかったかのように、俺の手をしっかりと握り返して、
lines.translated: Yet now, Mashiro right in front of me squeezed my hand back firmly, acting as if nothing had happened at all,

lines.content: ……大雅？　どうしたの？
lines.translated: "...Taiga? What's wrong?"

lines.content: うつむいてしまった俺の顔を、心配そうに覗き込んでいた。
lines.translated: and peered worriedly into my face as I looked down.

lines.content: そんな君だからこそ、俺の胸はずきりと痛んだ。
lines.translated: Precisely because you're like that, a sharp pain throbbed in my chest.

lines.content: ごめん。……ましろ。もういいんだ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. ...Mashiro. It's okay now."

lines.content: 首を振り、俺は答えた。
lines.translated: Shaking my head, I answered her.

lines.content: ……昨日の夜、君とこうして手を繋いだとき――
lines.translated: "...Last night, when I held your hand like this--"

lines.content: 君の心とか。記憶とか。
lines.translated: Your heart. Your memories.

lines.content: ……君が考えていることだとか。
lines.translated: The things you're thinking about.

lines.content: その殆どすべてを、俺、知ってしまったんだよ。
lines.translated: I ended up learning almost all of it.

lines.content: ……“自分が護り、助けたもの達から憎まれ続ける”
lines.translated: "...'To be endlessly hated by the very ones you protected and saved.'"

lines.content: それが、君が、君自身の“願い”を叶えるために、“夜”に設定した“代償”だ。
lines.translated: That is the "price" you set upon the "Night" in order to grant your own "wish."

lines.content: その支払いの結果、ましろは望んだ世界を手に入れる――“外の世界”も“夜の世界”も救う。
lines.translated: As a result of paying it, Mashiro obtains the world she desired--saving both the "Outside World" and the "World of the Night."

lines.content: ……そうまでして君がこの世界を護ろうとしたのは、全部……ぜんぶ、俺のためだった。そうだよね
lines.translated: "...The reason you went so far to protect this world was all... all for my sake. Right?"

lines.content: なんだか受け取り方次第では、ひどく自意識過剰な言い方ではあった。しかし、ましろの沈黙が言葉以上の回答だった。
lines.translated: Depending on how you took it, that sounded awfully self-important. However, Mashiro's silence was an answer that spoke louder than words.

lines.content: これから俺が生きていく世界を護りたい。……そして同時に、愛するもの達の住む“夜”の世界も救いたい。だから君は、今もこうして、ひとりぼっちで“悪い夢”にうなされ続けてる
lines.translated: "You want to protect the world I'm going to live in from now on. ...And at the same time, you want to save the world of the 'Night' where the ones you love live. That's why, even now, you're still suffering from 'bad dreams' all by yourself."

lines.content: 俺の力がどうしても必要なんだって、君がそう言ってくれるなら。俺はいくらでも君に協力したいと思うよ。……でも
lines.translated: "If you tell me that you desperately need my power... I'd want to help you as much as I possibly can. ...But..."

lines.content: でも俺は、だめなんだ。
lines.translated: But I just can't do it.

lines.content: ……俺はさ。ほんの数人を助けるために、大勢を犠牲にする選択をする。そういうタイプの人間なんだよ
lines.translated: "...You see, I'm the type of person who'd choose to sacrifice the many just to save a select few."

lines.content: だってその数名の中に、大切な人の姿を見つけてしまったから……。
lines.translated: Because among those select few, I caught sight of someone precious to me...

lines.content: だから、押せない。大勢の未来を守るため、君を犠牲にするボタンだなんて、俺にはとても押せないよ
lines.translated: "So I can't press it. A button that sacrifices you to protect the future of the many... there's no way I could ever press something like that."

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."
*This is fine,* *no, I won't allow it*--I don't want to go back and forth arguing like that.

lines.content: そんなことをするために、こうして君に会いに来たわけではないのだ。
lines.translated: I didn't come here to see you just to do something like that.

lines.content: だから俺は、今夜ここへ来た理由を伝える。
lines.translated: So I tell her the reason I came here tonight.

lines.content: ……ごめん。俺は君の期待には答えられない。君の“願い”を叶えることは、できないよ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I can't live up to your expectations. I can't grant your 'wish.'"

lines.content: そのために“力”を使うことはできない。
lines.translated: I cannot use my "power" for that.

lines.content: だから……

lines.translated: "*So, let's run away together.*"

lines.content: そう伝えることが、今夜俺がここへ来た理由だ。
lines.translated: Telling her that is the reason I came here tonight.

lines.content: 俺は、君を護りたい。
lines.translated: I want to protect you.

lines.content: 君自身の“悪夢”から――そしてこの星全体の運命だなんていう巨大な“何か”から。
lines.translated: From your own "nightmare"--and from that massive "something" known as the fate of this entire planet.

lines.content: そのためにはもう、立ちはだかる大きなおおきな問題から、一目散に逃げ出すほかにない。子どもな俺たちにとっては尚更だろうと思うから……。
lines.translated: To do that, our only option left is to turn tail and run as fast as we can from the massive, towering problem standing in our way. And I think that's especially true for kids like us...

lines.content: どこか遠くへ一緒に逃げよう。……この“夜”も。“悪夢”も。何もかも全部、届かないくらい遠くまで
lines.translated: "Let's run away together, somewhere far away. ...So far that neither this 'Night,' nor the 'nightmares,' nor anything else can ever reach us."

lines.content: そうすることで俺は君を助けたい。護りたい。君を苦しめる“悪夢”から。そして君ひとりが背負い込もうとしている運命だとかから。
lines.translated: By doing so, I want to save you. I want to protect you. From the "nightmares" tormenting you. And from the fate you're trying to shoulder all by yourself.

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: ましろは俺から視線を逸らした。
lines.translated: Mashiro looked away from me.

lines.content: ……それは、無理だよ
lines.translated: "...That's impossible."

lines.content: ……私は“鍵”なんだよ。この“夜”に、“外”の誰かが無闇に入り込んでこないようにするための
lines.translated: "...I am the 'key.' The key to keep anyone from the 'Outside' from recklessly barging into this 'Night.'"

lines.content: ましろが再び、さくらの樹の中で眠ることなく起きてる。
lines.translated: Mashiro is awake inside the cherry blossom tree once more, never sleeping.

lines.content: そうすることでロックがかかる――“夜”の外へましろが出て行くこともまた、彼女が眠ることと同じだ。“夜”の施錠は外れてしまう。
lines.translated: Doing so keeps the lock in place--for Mashiro to leave the "Night" is the exact same as her falling asleep. The lock on the "Night" would come undone.

lines.content: だから、私は一緒には行けないよ
lines.translated: "So I can't go with you."

lines.content: 私がいなくなってしまったら、“外の世界”の人たちが――意地悪な心を持った大人たちが、“夜”の中に雪崩れ込んでくる。そのはずだから
lines.translated: "If I were to disappear, the people of the 'Outside World'--adults with cruel hearts--would come pouring into the 'Night' like an avalanche. I know they would."

lines.content: そうして残酷な心の持ち主は、“夜”に住むイキモノたちを場合によっては虐殺だってするだろう――その肉を喰らうことで、“永遠の命”を得られると信じてる大人たちがだ。
lines.translated: And those with cruel hearts would likely even slaughter the creatures living in the "Night"--adults who believe they can obtain "eternal life" by devouring their flesh.

lines.content: そうして“夜”は“夢”の国ではなくなってしまう。現実世界と同様の残酷なばかりの場所になる。
lines.translated: Then the "Night" would cease to be a land of "dreams." It would become a place of nothing but cruelty, just like the real world.

lines.content: ……大雅の言うとおり。私は確かにあなたが、大雅が無事に、幸せに生きていける世界を創りたい。そう願ってる
lines.translated: "...It's just as you say, Taiga. It's true that I want to create a world where you--where Taiga--can live safely and happily. That is my wish."

lines.content: だから、“夜”の中からこぼれ続ける漆黒色の子ども達――その“想像力”を、私がまっしろに塗り替えられたらって願ってる
lines.translated: "That's why I wish I could paint over those pitch-black children that keep spilling out from the 'Night'--that 'imagination'--and turn it all pure white."

lines.content: でもそれはこうして、“夜”に鍵を掛けているだけではとめられないから
lines.translated: "But I can't stop it just by keeping the 'Night' locked up like this."

lines.content: だから俺の力が必要だった――“夜と現実世界とを繋ぐ[才能|力]”が。
lines.translated: That was why she needed my power--the "power to connect the Night and the real world."

lines.content: ここに住む“イキモノ”たちは私のことを好きだと言ってくれる。[・|私][・|が]“[・|夜]”[・|の][・|中][・|で][・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|望][・|ん][・|だ][・|か][・|ら]かもしれないけれど……
lines.translated: "The 'creatures' living here tell me that they love me. Though it might just be *because I wished for it to be that way within the 'Night'*..."

lines.content: だからその“好き”は、作り物の“想い”でしかないのかも、しれないけれど……。
lines.translated: So that "love" might be nothing more than a fabricated "feeling," and yet...

lines.content: 私は、私のことを好きでいてくれる全員のことも、護りたいと思うようになってしまった……
lines.translated: "I've come to want to protect everyone who loves me, too..."

lines.content: だから私は一緒に行けない。
lines.translated: That is why I cannot go with you.

lines.content: ましろは繰り返し言い、俺と繋いだ手に力を込めた。
lines.translated: Mashiro repeated her words, squeezing my hand tighter.

lines.content: ……だから、私は、大雅
lines.translated: "...And so, Taiga, rather than..."

lines.content: あなたと一緒に、“夜”から逃げるのではなくて……
lines.translated: "Rather than running away from the 'Night' with you..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.
"*I want to be killed by these hands of yours.* That is what I wished for."

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: わかってるよ。
lines.translated: I know.

lines.content: 俺は、君と繋いだ右手を握りしめた――[・|だ][・|か][・|ら][・|だ]。
lines.translated: I squeezed the right hand connected to yours--*that's why*.

lines.content: だから俺は、この町から逃げ出そうと思った。
lines.translated: That's why I decided to run away from this town.

lines.content: たとえどんな理由があろうとも――どんな間違えがあったとしても、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]、絶対にあってはならないから。
lines.translated: Because no matter what the reason--no matter what mistakes were made, *something like that* must never, ever happen.

lines.content: ……大雅。あなたなら私を、“夜のイキモノ”を――命のない私のことを、殺すことができる
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You can kill me, a 'Creature of the Night'--you can kill me, even though I have no life."

lines.content: そうだよね、とましろは俺に言った。俺の手をしっかり、握りしめたまま。
lines.translated: Isn't that right? Mashiro said to me, still holding my hand tightly.

lines.content: “夜”と“外”とを繋ぐあなたの手。あなたが持って生まれたその“[才能|力]”なら、それが、可能なはずだよ
lines.translated: "Your hands that connect the 'Night' and the 'Outside.' With that 'power' you were born with, it should be possible."

lines.content: 思わずポケットに触れた。
lines.translated: I instinctively touched my pocket.

lines.content: いつもそこに“拳銃”を忍ばせている。大人たちが[・|そ][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|に]造った“拳銃”だ。
lines.translated: I always keep a "handgun" hidden in there. A "handgun" the adults made *for that very purpose*.

lines.content: しかし“夜”の中に[・|そ][・|れ]は持ち込めず、今夜もまたポケットは空っぽだった。
lines.translated: However, *it* couldn't be brought into the "Night," and my pocket was empty again tonight.

lines.content: ……私は、大雅に力を借りたいと願ってる
lines.translated: "...I wish to borrow your strength, Taiga."

lines.content: ましろは繰り返し、言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro said it again.

lines.content: “夜”と“外”とを繋ぐその“[才能|力]”で、“夜”からこぼれ出し続けてるまっくろな“[未来|想像]”を、きれいさっぱり……、まっしろに、上書きしたい
lines.translated: "With that 'power' to connect the 'Night' and the 'Outside,' I want to completely overwrite... the pitch-black 'future' that keeps spilling out of the 'Night,' and turn it pure white."

lines.content: 繰り返し口にするその“願い”が叶えられたなら……。
lines.translated: If that "wish" she kept repeating were to be granted...

lines.content: 大雅と一緒に“力”を合わせて、これからもし、私が“未来”をまっしろに書き換えられたなら……
lines.translated: "If we join our 'powers' together, Taiga, and I manage to rewrite the 'future' into pure white from here on..."

lines.content: 闇色の未来を回避させられることが、叶ったら。
lines.translated: If averting that dark-colored future were to come true.

lines.content: ましろは“代償”を支払うことになる。手にした“奇跡”と釣り合うだけの“代償”を。
lines.translated: Mashiro would have to pay the "price." A "price" equal to the "miracle" she obtained.

lines.content: そうなれば、私は……
lines.translated: "When that happens, I..."

lines.content: きっと、いつかの未来――まっしろに輝く満月を指さし、誰もが“[・|夜][・|の][・|女][・|王]”と畏怖する“何か”に変わるだろう。
lines.translated: Surely, in some future--when people point at the full moon shining pure white, she will have transformed into "something" that everyone fears as the "*Queen of the Night*."

lines.content: 人々の心を壊すのだというまっしろな月。その光。
lines.translated: A pure white moon said to destroy people's hearts. Its light.

lines.content: ……それはたぶん、“代償”を支払い、ある意味“夜の怪物”となった私自身だ
lines.translated: "...That is probably me, having paid the 'price' and, in a sense, become a 'monster of the Night.'"

lines.content: そうして“夜”の中、“夜”の外、そのあらゆるすべてから憎まれてしまう。
lines.translated: And thus, she would be hated by everything and everyone, both inside the "Night" and outside of it.

lines.content: ……そうなる前に、大雅に、私を殺してほしかった
lines.translated: "...Before that happens, I wanted you to kill me, Taiga."

lines.content: ましろは“嫌われる”ということを何より恐れる女の子だった。自分の愛する者たちから無視され続け、ひとりさみしく命を終えた。
lines.translated: Mashiro was a girl who feared "being hated" more than anything else. Continually ignored by those she loved, she ended her life all alone in solitude.

lines.content: だからこそ、その“代償”は他の何より釣り合い……だからこそ、“夜”に住む“イキモノ”たちの多くは、彼女を愛した。いつか心の底から彼女を憎む、そのために。
lines.translated: Precisely because of that, the "price" balanced the scales more than anything else could... and precisely because of that, many of the "creatures" living in the "Night" loved her. All so that one day, they would hate her from the bottom of their hearts.

lines.content: ましろにとってこの世界を救うということは、自身を愛してくれる多くのものたちから、自ら進んで憎まれようとする行為そのものだ。
lines.translated: For Mashiro, saving this world was the very act of willingly making herself hated by the many who loved her.

lines.content: それだけの覚悟を彼女は決めたのだろうけど……。
lines.translated: She must have steeled her resolve for that, and yet...

lines.content: 昨日まで笑顔をくれたものたちが。
lines.translated: Those who had given her smiles until yesterday.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|日]を境に、つめたく、怒りにも似た視線や言葉を投げかけてくる。
lines.translated: Starting *that day*, they would hurl cold gazes and words akin to anger at her.

lines.content: そんな未来には耐えられそうにない。
lines.translated: There was no way she could endure a future like that.

lines.content: 愛しいものたちの生きていく世界。その場所を救った後に、人々の中で“怪物”と化してしまうだろう自分を殺してもらう。
lines.translated: The world where her loved ones would go on living. After saving that place, she wanted to be killed once she turned into a "monster" in the eyes of the people.

lines.content: そのために、ましろは俺を“夜”の中に呼んだのだ……。
lines.translated: That was why Mashiro called me into the "Night"...

lines.content: まだまだ俺は幼いけれど、しかしもう赤ん坊ではない。そんな俺をだ。そんな俺に、引き金を引くことを期待して、だ。
lines.translated: I'm still young, yet no longer a baby. She called me here. Expecting me to pull the trigger.

lines.content: 沈黙した。
lines.translated: I fell silent.

lines.content: いつの間にか“歌”は終わってしまってる。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the "song" had ended.

lines.content: ……レコードが戻り、また“歌”が最初からはじまることもない。
lines.translated: The record didn't reset, and the "song" didn't start over from the beginning.

lines.content: ちくたくと秒針の音だけがふたりの間に響いていた。
lines.translated: Only the tick-tock of the second hand echoed between the two of us.

lines.content: この沈黙は、ましろがもう既に自身の行く末を――思い描いたその終わりを、[・|こ][・|れ][・|し][・|か][・|な][・|い]と覚悟し、受け入れている。そんな強い決意の表れのようにも感じられた。
lines.translated: This silence felt like a manifestation of Mashiro's strong determination--that she had already accepted her own fate, the end she had envisioned, resolving herself that *this is the only way*.

lines.content: ……だから行けない。俺と一緒には、逃げるわけには、いかない。
lines.translated: That's why she can't go. She cannot run away with me.

lines.content: 勝手だよ。……君は
lines.translated: "You're being selfish. ...You really are."

lines.content: ため息をつき、俺は言った。
lines.translated: Letting out a sigh, I spoke.

lines.content: そうだ。ましろ。……君はつくづく勝手だ。
lines.translated: That's right. Mashiro. ...You are thoroughly selfish.

lines.content: 君はさ。そうまでして救いたいと願うものたちのことを……俺や、“夜のイキモノ”たち全員のことを、少しは考えたことがあるのかな
lines.translated: "Hey, have you ever stopped to think, even for a second, about the ones you're going so far to save... about me, and all the 'Creatures of the Night'?"

lines.content: ましろは小首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Mashiro tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: そして大きな目をぱちぱちとさせている。言わずもがな、どういうこと？　という顔だった。
lines.translated: Then she blinked her big eyes repeatedly. Needless to say, her face was asking, "What do you mean?"

lines.content: 俺は君と繋いだままの手に意識を集める。
lines.translated: I focused my consciousness into the hand still joined with hers.

lines.content: 昨晩、こうして合わせた手のひらから、君の心が、その記憶が、俺の中へ流れ込んできた。
lines.translated: Last night, from our palms pressed together like this, your heart and your memories flowed into me.
*I tried doing the reverse.*

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”たちがましろへ宛てた言葉を、直接、ましろ本人に聞いてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted Mashiro to hear the words the "Creatures of the Night" had addressed to her, directly for herself.

lines.content: まっしろなぼくらの夜の女王。どうか、お願いだ。ぼくらのことは気にしないでほしい
lines.translated: "Our pure-white Queen of the Night. Please, we beg you. Don't worry about us."

lines.content: ――昨日の“夜”、ましろが去ってから、“夜のイキモノ”たちが俺に託した言葉だ。
lines.translated: --Those were the words the "Creatures of the Night" had entrusted to me after Mashiro left last "Night."

lines.content: ぼくらを見くびらないでくれよ。自分たちの命くらい、自分たちで守れるよ。いつまでも君に守ってもらわなくたって大丈夫だ
lines.translated: "Don't underestimate us. We can protect our own lives by ourselves. We'll be fine without you having to protect us forever."

lines.content: 彼らは言った。
lines.translated: They had said.

lines.content: どうしてもまずいって状況になったら、[・|月][・|に][・|移][・|住]するなりなんなりして、人間たちの手から逃れるよ
lines.translated: "If things get truly dire, we'll *migrate to the moon* or do whatever it takes to escape from the hands of humans."

lines.content: 見上げた夜空の星々には、この[ほし|惑星]と同じく“夜の国”がある。
lines.translated: Among the stars in the night sky above, just like on this planet, there are "Lands of the Night."

lines.content: この[ほし|惑星]で命の時間を使い切った死者の魂は、“刻の終着駅”から好きな[ほし|惑星]の好きな“夜”を選んで向かう。
lines.translated: The souls of the dead who have used up their allotted time of life on this planet choose whichever "Night" on whichever planet they like, departing from the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: そこで静かな眠りについて、次の人生について夢を見続けている。
lines.translated: There, they fall into a quiet slumber and continue dreaming of their next life.

lines.content: そういう“次”を選ぶこともできるけれど……。
lines.translated: They could choose that kind of "next," and yet...

lines.content: 月には“夜”が存在しない。
lines.translated: There is no "Night" on the moon.

lines.content: ……この[ほし|惑星]以外には、どの[ほし|惑星]にも現実世界は存在しないが、月にはそのどちらもないのだ。
lines.translated: Aside from this planet, no other planet has a real world, and the moon has neither.

lines.content: そこへ“夜の国”ごと移住し逃げ出すと、彼らは言うのだ。どうしてもという状況に、もしも追い詰められたなら。
lines.translated: They say they will migrate and flee there, taking the entire "Land of the Night" with them. If they are ever driven into a truly desperate situation, that is.

lines.content: ……だから安心してほしいんだ、と。
lines.translated: So they want you to rest easy.

lines.content: どうやって？
lines.translated: *How?*

lines.content: 昨晩の俺は彼らにそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: Last night, I asked them that very question.

lines.content: どうやって、この[ほし|惑星]の“夜”を月に移住させるつもりなのか。
lines.translated: How did they intend to migrate this planet's "Night" to the moon?

lines.content: さあ、と彼らは揃って首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: "Who knows?" they had all said, tilting their heads in unison.

lines.content: それを今から、ここにいる全員で相談するんだよ。そのためにこうして集まったんだ
lines.translated: "That's what everyone here is going to discuss starting right now. That's why we've all gathered like this."

lines.content: あのひと達は笑顔で[・|こ][・|う]言っていた。
lines.translated: They had said *this* with smiles on their faces.

lines.content: ましろ。いつもぼくらのことを見守っていてくれた夜の女王……。君は、ぼくらやぼくらの居場所を創ってくれた母親だ。……母親の、ひとりだ
lines.translated: "Mashiro. Our Queen of the Night, who has always watched over us... You are the mother who created us and our place to belong. ...One of our mothers."

lines.content: そんな君に、いつまでも護られていたいって気持ちも確かにあるけれど……
lines.translated: "While it's true a part of us wants to be protected by you forever..."

lines.content: でもさ。……わかってほしい
lines.translated: "Even so... we want you to understand."

lines.content: そろそろぼくらは独り立ちしたいんだ。いつまでも母親に護られてばかりの子じゃいられないし、そんな自分たちでは、ごめんね。いたくないんだよ
lines.translated: "It's about time we stood on our own two feet. We can't stay children who only ever get protected by their mother forever, and--we're sorry, truly--we don't want to be like that."

lines.content: ……お願いだよ。お母さん。そんなぼくらのことを見送ってほしいんだ
lines.translated: "...Please, Mom. We want you to see us off as we take that step."

lines.content: そして今度はどこか遠くから、あなたはあなたの幸せを生きながら……ぼくらのことを見守っていてほしい。どこかでぼくらがぼくらなりに生きていく道を、応援していてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "And this time, from somewhere far away, while living your own happiness... we want you to watch over us. Somewhere out there, we want you to cheer us on as we walk our own path in our own way."

lines.content: どこかでぼくらがぼくらなりに生きていく道を、応援していてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Somewhere out there, we want you to cheer us on as we walk our own path in our own way."

lines.content: 彼らは揃って、[・|こ][・|う]言ったのだ――
lines.translated: Together in unison, they said *this*--

lines.content: だから、お母さん。お願いだよ。これからはぼくらのことじゃなくて、自分の幸せだけを想像してほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "So, Mom, please. From now on, don't think about us--we want you to imagine only your own happiness."

lines.content: ようやく子どもが独り立ちしようっていうんだ。子育てが終わったらさ、あと親が考えるのは自身の余生をどう生きるのか――まさに第二の人生だ
lines.translated: "Your children are finally about to stand on their own. Once raising the kids is over, all that's left for a parent to think about is how to live the rest of their life--a true second life."

lines.content: 君には[・|あ][・|た][・|ら][・|し][・|い]“[・|夢]”を見つけてほしいんだよ。そうして君には、思うままに生きていってほしい。ここにいる全員がそう願ってるんだ
lines.translated: "We want you to find a *new 'dream.'* And we want you to live just the way you wish. Everyone here is wishing for that."

lines.content: 託された彼らの言葉をすべて手渡し終えた。
lines.translated: I finished handing over all the words they had entrusted to me.

lines.content: ……なぜかどうしても、俺から君へ届けてほしいと願われた彼らの言葉だ。
lines.translated: The words they had so desperately wished for me, for some reason, to deliver to you myself.

lines.content: ましろは細く息を吐き出して、
lines.translated: Mashiro let out a thin breath,

lines.content: ……おかしいよね
lines.translated: "...It's funny, isn't it?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……余生、だなんて。命のない私が思い描くのは、なんだかすごく、変な感じだよね
lines.translated: "...The 'rest of my life.' For someone without a life like me to picture that... it feels really, really strange, doesn't it?"

lines.content: ふと、ましろは笑ったのだった。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Mashiro smiled.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: すぐに、だ。
lines.translated: And then, right away--

lines.content: すぐにましろは唇を複雑そうに噛んでいた。
lines.translated: Right away, Mashiro bit her lip with a conflicted expression.

lines.content: 視線は俺と繋いだ手に落とされている。
lines.translated: Her gaze dropped to our joined hands.

lines.content: 何かを迷っているように、見えた。……いや。何かと必死に戦っているようにも見えた。
lines.translated: She looked as though she were hesitating over something. ...No. She also looked as if she were desperately fighting against something.

lines.content: ……ねえ、ましろ
lines.translated: "...Hey, Mashiro."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 君がどんなあたらしい“夢”を思い、描くのかは、わからないけれど……。俺も応援するよ。彼らと同じように。俺も君の“夢”を応援したい
lines.translated: "I don't know what kind of new 'dream' you'll envision and paint for yourself, but... I'll cheer for you, too. Just like they do. I want to support your 'dream' too."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だからまずは、ここから一緒に逃げ出そう。……君を苦しめる“悪夢”の“[・|外]”へ逃げるんだ
lines.translated: "So first, let's run away from here together. ...Let's escape *outside* of the 'nightmare' that's tormenting you."

lines.content: ましろは、うなずいてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: Mashiro didn't nod for me.

lines.content: うつむいたままの顔は、一度下した自身の“誓い”にどう釈明をつけるべきなのか――その言葉を探してるように、俺には見えた。
lines.translated: Her face remained cast downward; to me, she looked as though she were searching for the words to justify breaking the "vow" she had once made to herself.

lines.content: ああ。まったく……。
lines.translated: Ah. Honestly...

lines.content: 俺は心の中でため息をついた。
lines.translated: I sighed inwardly.
*I knew it.*

lines.content: まだまだ小さな赤ん坊だった頃には当然わからなかったけれど、ここ数日ほど、こうして君と話せて気づいたことがいくつかあったのだ。
lines.translated: Of course I hadn't understood when I was still a tiny baby, but over the past few days, being able to talk with you like this has made me realize a few things.

lines.content: 嫌われることを何より恐れる君だから、周りの期待や視線には誰より敏感であるはずだ。
lines.translated: Because you fear being hated more than anything, you must be more sensitive than anyone to the expectations and gazes of those around you.

lines.content: そんな内面を持つからこそ、ちょっと弱気にも見えるところもあるけれど……。
lines.translated: Precisely because you carry that inside you, you can seem a little timid at times, and yet...

lines.content: その心の内側には、こうした[・|ブ][・|レ][・|な][・|さ]のようなものを確かに持っている。
lines.translated: Deep down in your heart, you certainly possess this kind of *unwavering resolve*.

lines.content: そんな君だからこそ、大勢の命を救うため、少数の命を犠牲にするスイッチを、躊躇いを――いっぱいの躊躇いを持っていてもなお、押してしまう選択ができた。
lines.translated: It's because that's who you are that, in order to save many lives, you were able to make the choice to press the switch to sacrifice the few--even while holding hesitation, so much hesitation, in your heart.

lines.content: その少数の命とは、ましろ。
lines.translated: And that "few," Mashiro...

lines.content: ……君自身。たったひとりだ。
lines.translated: is yourself. Just you alone.

lines.content: そういう君だからこそだ。
lines.translated: It's precisely because that's the kind of girl you are.

lines.content: 一度覚悟を決めた自分自身の“想い”を裏切れないと、沈黙の中でひとり、こうして苦しんでしまうのだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Unable to betray the "feelings" you once resolved yourself to carry, you end up suffering all alone in silence like this, and yet...

lines.content: 俺は[・|や][・|っ][・|ぱ][・|り]、そんな君を“夜”の底から、その痛みや悲しみ、いっぱいのさみしさごと、救い出したいと願ってる。
lines.translated: Even so, I *still* wish to rescue you from the bottom of the "Night"--along with all that pain, all that sadness, and all that overwhelming loneliness.

lines.content: ……俺はさ、今日、本当はここに来るつもりじゃなかったんだ
lines.translated: "...To tell the truth, I wasn't actually planning on coming here today."

lines.content: 一度は君を置いて逃げようとさえ思ってた。
lines.translated: At one point, I even thought about leaving you behind and running away.

lines.content: 君のことを殺すだなんて……。俺には絶対に無理だ。そんな役目は、責任は、とてもじゃないけど引き受けられないよ……
lines.translated: "Killing you... There's no way I could ever do that. A role like that, a responsibility like that--there's just no way I could take it on..."

lines.content: だから俺は、君から逃げ出そうと思ってた。俺たちはもう二度と会わないほうがいい。……そんなふうに、自分に言い聞かせてもいたんだ
lines.translated: "So I thought about running away from you. That it would be better if the two of us never met again. ...I was even telling myself that."

lines.content: でも……
……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: でもね。こうして今夜もまた、ここに来てしまった
lines.translated: "But you see, tonight, I ended up coming back here all the same."

lines.content: ……ねえ、ましろ
lines.translated: "...Hey, Mashiro."

lines.content: 俺は君と繋いだ手を、今度は両手で包み込むようにした。
lines.translated: This time, I wrapped both of my hands around the hand I held with yours.

lines.content: どうして俺が、そうしたいと思ったか。……君を殺したくないのなら、こうして説得するよりも何も言わず逃げ出すのが一番だ
lines.translated: "Why did I want to do that? ...If I don't want to kill you, running away without saying a word would be far better than trying to persuade you like this."

lines.content: それなのに、こうしてまた君に逢いたいって。君と一緒にどこか遠くへ逃げ出したいって。そう思ったのか……わかる？
lines.translated: "And yet, why did I think that I wanted to see you again like this? That I wanted to run away somewhere far from here together with you? ...Do you know why?"

lines.content: 顔を上げ、恐る恐る俺を見た。
lines.translated: She raised her head and looked at me timidly.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。わからない
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I don't know."

lines.content: どうして？　とましろは首を振るのだ。
lines.translated: *Why?* Mashiro shook her head.

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 手をしっかり握りしめたまま、
lines.translated: Still holding her hand tightly,

lines.content: 今、俺が考えてること……。伝わらないかな
lines.translated: "What I'm thinking right now... Can't you feel it?"

lines.content: と、まっすぐにましろを見つめ、そう問いかけた。
lines.translated: Looking straight at Mashiro, I asked her that.

lines.content: ましろは首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Mashiro tilted her head.

lines.content: そして小さく、
lines.translated: And then, softly,

lines.content: 大雅の、考えてること……
lines.translated: "What you're... thinking, Taiga..."

lines.content: つぶやくように言ったましろは、繋いだままの俺たちの手を見、少し沈黙を差し込んだ後……、
lines.translated: Murmuring the words, Mashiro looked down at our still-joined hands, and after a brief pause of silence...

lines.content: ……たちまち真っ赤になってしまった。
lines.translated: she instantly turned bright red.

lines.content: 好きだよ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: 俺は、言った。
lines.translated: I said it.

lines.content: 俺、君が大好きなんだ
lines.translated: "I'm in love with you."

lines.content: ……誰よりもやさしくて、誰よりもさみしがり屋なぼくらの女王。……ぼくらのやさしいお母さん。君のことが好きなのは、彼らだけじゃない
lines.translated: "...Our Queen, who is kinder than anyone and lonelier than anyone. ...Our gentle mother. They aren't the only ones who love you."

lines.content: 俺も好きだよ、と俺はまっすぐにましろを見つめたまま、言った。
lines.translated: *I love you too,* I said, keeping my gaze fixed straight on Mashiro.

lines.content: でも、違うんだ
lines.translated: "But it's different."

lines.content: え？　……ち、違う、の？
lines.translated: "Huh? ...D-Different?"

lines.content: ああ。……うん
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...It is."

lines.content: 違うんだよ。でも、わかってるよね、伝わってるよね、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: *It's different. You understand, don't you? It's reaching you, isn't it?* I told her.

lines.content: 俺の“好き”はね、彼らのものとはまったく違う――
lines.translated: "My 'love' is completely different from theirs--"

lines.content: “[彼ら|夜のイキモノ]”は君を、母親として愛していたのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: "They"--the Creatures of the Night--likely loved you as a mother, but...

lines.content: ……お母さんじゃいやなんだ
lines.translated: "...I don't want you to be my mother."

lines.content: 俺は、奏大雅は、君のことをずっと、ずっと、昔から……大好きだった。ひとりの女の子として想ってた
lines.translated: "I, Kanade Taiga, have loved you for a long, long time... ever since way back. I've cared for you as a girl."

lines.content: そんな自分の気持ちに、今夜までの数日間、君とこうして直接話せて――ああ、[・|や][・|っ][・|ぱ][・|り][・|な]って、納得できたよ
lines.translated: "Being able to talk with you directly like this over the last few days leading up to tonight--it made me think, 'Ah, *I knew it*,' and I was finally able to accept these feelings of mine."

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅は、君のことが大好きだ。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, am in love with you.

lines.content: 君に逢いにやって来たのは、自分の気持ちの正体を突き止めるためという理由もあったんだ。
lines.translated: Part of the reason I came to see you was to uncover the true nature of my own feelings.

lines.content: 繰り返し俺はそう伝えた――俺の初恋は物心つく前から既にはじまっていた。
lines.translated: Over and over, I conveyed that to her--that my first love had already begun before I was even old enough to understand the world.

lines.content: さみしいとき。悲しいとき。
lines.translated: When I was lonely. When I was sad.

lines.content: ……わけもわからずつらいとき。
lines.translated: When I was hurting without even knowing why.

lines.content: いつも隣に君の笑顔があった。
lines.translated: Your smile was always right there beside me.

lines.content: まだ世界のことも、自分自身のことも何も知らない、小さすぎる俺だったけど……。
lines.translated: I was far too small back then, knowing nothing about the world or even about myself, and yet...

lines.content: でも、そのとき得た安心感が忘れられない。
lines.translated: Even so, I can never forget the sense of safety you gave me then.

lines.content: そんな気持ちが、君が姿を消してから、心の中で不思議と大きくおおきくなっていった。
lines.translated: After you vanished, that feeling mysteriously grew bigger and bigger inside my heart.

lines.content: この気持ちはなんだろうって、ずっと考えてた
lines.translated: "I spent all that time wondering what this feeling could be."

lines.content: ……この気持ちに名前を付けるなら、この想いは、“さみしい”だけじゃ足りない。そう思えて……
lines.translated: "...If I were to give this feeling a name, 'loneliness' alone wouldn't be enough to describe it. That's how it felt..."

lines.content: 君に会えたらその正体もはっきりするって思ったんだ
lines.translated: "I thought that if I could see you again, what it truly was would become clear."

lines.content: ……そして期待したとおり、わかったよ。はっきりした。
lines.translated: And just as I hoped, I understood. It became crystal clear.

lines.content: いや。本当は君にこうしてまた会えたその前から、自分の気持ちには気づけていたのかもしれないって思う
lines.translated: "No. Actually, I think I might have already realized my own feelings even before I was able to reunite with you like this."

lines.content: ……どういうこと？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: 首をかしげるましろに、俺はうなずき、言った――君とこうしてまた会う前に、“半透明”の男のひとと俺は出会った。
lines.translated: To Mashiro, who tilted her head, I nodded and spoke--that before I reunited with you like this, I met a "translucent" man.

lines.content: そのひとはね、ずっと母親代わりをしてくれていた人へ、気持ちを伝えるときに言ったんだよ
lines.translated: "When that man conveyed his feelings to the person who had always acted as a mother to him, he said something."

lines.content: その“想い”に触れた俺は気づいた。俺もだ。
lines.translated: When I touched those "feelings," I realized it. I felt the exact same way.

lines.content: ……ましろ。俺も、君はお母さんじゃいやなんだ。
lines.translated: Mashiro. I don't want you to be my mother, either.

lines.content: 何度でも言うよ。ましろ。俺は、君のことが好きなんだ
lines.translated: "I'll say it as many times as it takes, Mashiro. I'm in love with you."

lines.content: ……だから君のことを何としたって助けたい。君を殺すだなんてもってのほかだ。そんなことできない
lines.translated: "...And that's why I want to save you no matter what. Killing you is completely out of the question. I could never do that."

lines.content: ……君が小さな俺を一生懸命、笑わせようとしてくれたみたいに……。今度は俺が、君のことを笑わせられるようにって。そういうふうに俺は、生きていきたいんだよ
lines.translated: "...Just like how you tried so hard to make me smile when I was little... this time, I want to be the one to make you smile. That's how I want to live my life."

lines.content: 小さすぎるこの俺がこんなことを言ったところで、真剣には受け止められないということは、わかるよ。だけど俺は真剣だ。真剣以上に真剣だ。
lines.translated: I know you can't take me seriously when I'm still this small and saying things like this. But I am serious. More than serious.

lines.content: そう伝えると、ましろは何も言わないまま、首を振るだけだった。
lines.translated: When I told her that, Mashiro didn't say a word; she simply shook her head.

lines.content: 俺は……
俺は[・|あ][・|の][・|人]に憧れている。
lines.translated: I look up to *that man*.

lines.content: 生涯たったひとりを想い続けたのだという俺の父親――俺の、ヒーローだ。探し続けた俺の理想像。
lines.translated: My father, who spent his entire life loving only one person--he's my hero. The ideal I've been searching for all along.
I want to live my life *just like that*, too.

lines.content: きっとあの人なら、どんな理由があったとしても――大好きなひとを見捨てたまま、この町を去って行くことはしないはず。
lines.translated: If it were him, no matter what the reason--he would never abandon the person he loved most and leave this town behind.

lines.content: 俺は、ましろ。君のヒーローになりたい。君を苦しめる“悪夢”から救い出したい。自分のことさえ守れない子どもが何を言ってるんだって、笑われるかもしれないけれど……
lines.translated: "Mashiro, I want to become your hero. I want to save you from the 'nightmare' that's tormenting you. You might laugh at me and wonder what a kid who can't even protect himself is talking about, but..."

lines.content: それが俺の“夢”なんだ。世界の運命も。……ごめん、“夜の世界”のこともどうだっていい。
lines.translated: That is my "dream." The fate of the world... and I'm sorry, even the "Night World"--none of it matters to me.

lines.content: 俺は君を……。
lines.translated: As long as I can protect you...

lines.content: 君のことだけを守り続けられるヒーローになれれば、それでいい。
lines.translated: As long as I can become a hero who keeps protecting you and only you, that's all I need.

lines.content: どうか、お願いだ。この“夢”を叶えさせてほしい
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you. Let me make this 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ……で、でも
ましろ。君は、言ったじゃないか
lines.translated: "Mashiro, didn't you say it yourself?"

lines.content: 恋するための物語。そのヒロインみたいに生きてみたいって――
lines.translated: "A story about falling in love. That you wanted to live like the heroine of a story like that--"

lines.content: それが君のあたらしい“夢”なんじゃないのかな。
lines.translated: Isn't that your new "dream"?

lines.content: そう言う俺は……。
lines.translated: As I said those words...
I was *scared*.

lines.content: たぶん、ましろに拒絶されるのが怖かったんだ。
lines.translated: Maybe I was terrified of being rejected by Mashiro.

lines.content: だからましろの声を、殆ど強引に遮断して、俺は続けて言った。
lines.translated: So, almost forcefully cutting off her voice, I pressed on.

lines.content: ――だから、お願いだ。俺と一緒にここから逃げよう
lines.translated: "--So please. Run away from here with me."

lines.content: ……ましろ。
lines.translated: Mashiro.

lines.content: ……もし君が、俺の気持ちを受け入れてくれるなら――俺は君の“隣”で、君と同じ“夢”を見ていたいって、思うんだ
lines.translated: "...If you'll accept my feelings--I want to stay right 'beside' you and share the same 'dream' as you."

lines.content: ……俺と一緒に“[夜|悪夢]”から逃げよう。
lines.translated: Let's run away from this "nightmare" together.

lines.content: そして“外の世界”で暮らしてほしい。
lines.translated: And I want you to live with me in the "outside world."

lines.content: 繋いだ手に力を込めて、俺はそう伝えた。
lines.translated: Squeezing our joined hands tightly, I conveyed that to her.

lines.content: ……君のあたらしい“夢”
lines.translated: Your new "dream."

lines.content: 君が好きだと伝えた俺に、その“夢”を叶えさせてもらえないかな――そこまではもう口にできず、俺は唇を強く結んでしまった。
lines.translated: Now that I've told you I love you, won't you let me be the one to make that "dream" come true?--Unable to bring myself to say that last part out loud, I pressed my lips tightly together.

lines.content: そして、うつむく。
lines.translated: And then, I looked down.

lines.content: ほんのちょっと生まれた弱気が、頭の中にぶら下がり、重かった。
lines.translated: The tiny bit of cowardice that had sprouted within me hung heavy in my mind.

lines.content: そんな俺の頭をやさしく撫でるような声で、ましろが言った。
lines.translated: With a voice that felt like it was gently stroking my head, Mashiro spoke.

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……私、ね。あなたのお母さんに憧れてたんだよ
lines.translated: "...You know, I always admired your mother."

lines.content: 俺の、お母さん……？
lines.translated: "My... mother...?"

lines.content: “眠りに落ちると未来へ跳んでしまう”
lines.translated: "Whenever she fell asleep, she would leap into the future."

lines.content: そんな“[呪い|才能]”を背負って産まれた女の子。
lines.translated: A girl born bearing that kind of "curse"--that kind of "talent."

lines.content: あなたのお母さんのために歌われて、たくさん、たくさんの人たちが歌い継ぎ、遠い未来の現在にまで届けられた……あの“歌”だよ
lines.translated: "That 'song'... the one sung for your mother, passed down by so, so many people until it reached the distant future of the present day."

lines.content: そこに込められた“想い”に憧れたのだとましろは言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro said she longed for the "feelings" woven into that song.

lines.content: 生涯たったひとりを想い続ける。たとえ誰も祝福してくれなくても。たとえ、世界中が敵になってしまったとしても
lines.translated: "Continuing to love only one person for an entire lifetime. Even if no one gives them their blessing. Even if the whole world becomes their enemy."
*It's you.*

lines.content: あなたの“隣”だけを信じ、探し続ける。
lines.translated: Believing only in my place "beside" you, searching for you endlessly.

lines.content: ……そんな“想い”が過去から届いて、“夜”の中で“魔法”となった
lines.translated: "...Those 'feelings' reached across time from the past and became 'magic' within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: そうしてふたりは幾千の“夜”を越え……。
lines.translated: And so, the two of them crossed thousands of "Nights"...

lines.content: 愛する人と手と手を繋いだ。
lines.translated: And joined hands with the one they loved.

lines.content: ……きっと心よりも深いところで微笑みあえた。
lines.translated: Surely, they smiled at each other in a place deeper than their very hearts.

lines.content: そんなふたりの愛の結晶――なんて。そういう恥ずかしいことを言うのはやっぱり、恥ずかしいけれど……それが、あなたなんだよ。大雅
lines.translated: "The fruit of their love--or something like that. Saying something so embarrassing really is embarrassing, after all, but... that's who you are, Taiga."

lines.content: あなた達の人生を、たぶん、一番近くで見つめていられた私だから……。私も、あなた達みたいに。あの“歌”みたいに、生きたいと思ってた
lines.translated: "Because I was able to watch over your lives from closer than anyone else, probably... I wanted to live like all of you, too. Just like that 'song.'"

lines.content: ましろはそう言い、どこか不器用に微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: Saying that, Mashiro gave a somewhat awkward smile.

lines.content: ……とっくの昔に“命”をなくした。こんな、私だけど……
lines.translated: "...Even though I'm someone like this... someone who lost her 'life' a long, long time ago..."

lines.content: あの子みたいに、たったひとりのことを、大切に……たいせつに、想い続ける。そしていつか、かわいいあなたみたいな結晶を授かれたらすてきだな
lines.translated: "Just like that girl, I wanted to cherish... to deeply cherish and love only one person forever. And I thought how wonderful it would be if I could someday be blessed with a cute little treasure just like you."

lines.content: ……そういうふうに、私は、生きていけないかな
lines.translated: "...I wondered if I couldn't live my life that way, too."

lines.content: 命もないのに、生きていくなんて。そんな矛盾しきった表現には呆れてしまう。
lines.translated: Talking about living on when I don't even have a life. Such an utterly contradictory way of putting it leaves even me exasperated with myself.

lines.content: こんなふうに、あんまりにも夢見てばかりな私だったから……。
lines.translated: Because I was always lost in daydreams like that...

lines.content: だから、あんな……“恋するための物語”を生きてみたいって。そういう物語のヒロインになってみたいって
lines.translated: "That's why I said I wanted to live a 'story about falling in love' like that. That I wanted to become the heroine of that kind of story."

lines.content: ……密かに憧れを抱いてた、あなたのお母さんみたいに、誰かに愛されてみたいって。
lines.translated: That I wanted to be loved by someone, just like your mother, whom I secretly admired.

lines.content: そんな、バカみたいなことをつい、あなたにお願いしてみたりして
lines.translated: "I ended up asking you for something so foolish without thinking."

lines.content: ごめんねと言うましろに、俺は小さく首を振る。
lines.translated: As Mashiro apologized, I gave a small shake of my head.

lines.content: だったら……
lines.translated: "In that case..."

lines.content: だったら俺も、まるで夢物語みたいなその道を、君と一緒に歩いて行けないか。
lines.translated: In that case, couldn't I walk down that fairytale-like path together with you?

lines.content: それを許しては、受け入れては、もらえないかな。
lines.translated: Won't you allow me that? Won't you accept it?

lines.content: そんな想いを改めて、繋いだ手に込めたつもりだった。
lines.translated: I tried to pour those feelings once more into our joined hands.

lines.content: ましろは[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Mashiro closed her eyelids.

lines.content: そしてまた、沈黙だ。
lines.translated: And once again, silence fell.

lines.content: このまま“夜”が明けてしまい……。
lines.translated: At this rate, the "Night" would break into dawn...

lines.content: ましろは姿を消して。
lines.translated: Mashiro would vanish.

lines.content: もう二度と、俺たちは逢えない。
lines.translated: And we would never see each other again.

lines.content: そんな受け入れられない“未来”をふと、想像してしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: For a moment, I found myself imagining such an unacceptable "future," when...

lines.content: 私は……
小さな声で、沈黙に穴を空けたましろは、ぽつりぽつりと……、言う。
lines.translated: Piercing a hole in the silence with a quiet voice, Mashiro spoke... haltingly, word by word.

lines.content: ……私はね。さっきも言ったけれど、今日まで、自分はあなたのお母さん代わりなんだって。そうなれたらいいなって、思ってた
lines.translated: "...You know, like I said earlier, right up until today, I thought of myself as a stand-in for your mother. I hoped I could be that for you."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……可愛いかわいい小さな赤ちゃん。あなたは私と同じだ
lines.translated: "...A sweet, adorable little baby. You were the same as me."

lines.content: いつもあなたはひとりぼっちで泣いていた。いつかあなたのことを思い切り抱きしめたい。それが叶えば私は幸せ。あなたといるときはいつもそれだけ祈ってた。だから……
lines.translated: "You were always crying all alone. I wanted to hold you as tightly as I could someday. If that wish came true, I would be happy. Whenever I was with you, that was the only thing I ever prayed for. So..."

lines.content: だからあなたも、大雅。私と同じように感じてくれたらいいなって。私のことをお母さんみたいって、そう感じてくれてたら……すてきだなって。そう、思ってた
lines.translated: "So I hoped that you would feel the same way as me, Taiga. I thought... how wonderful it would be if you saw me as a mother, too. That's what I thought."

lines.content: ……図々しい話だってわかってる。だけど、ごめんね。心の中で……秘密だったけどね、そう思っていたの。ずっと、祈っていたんだよ
lines.translated: "...I know it's a presumptuous thing to say. But I'm sorry. Deep in my heart... it was a secret, though, that's how I felt. I was praying for it all along."

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: だけど違ったんだね、とましろは言う。
lines.translated: "But it wasn't like that at all, was it?" Mashiro said.

lines.content: 浮かべた表情は、苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: The expression on her face was a wry smile.

lines.content: あなたは私を、お母さんとしてじゃなくて、女の子として見ていて……
lines.translated: "You were looking at me not as a mother, but as a girl..."

lines.content: ……だから私を、置いては行けないって、思って
lines.translated: "...And that's why you felt you couldn't leave me behind."

lines.content: ……“俺と、一緒に”
lines.translated: "...'Together with me.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……“俺と一緒に外の世界で暮らしてほしい”
lines.translated: "...'I want you to live with me in the outside world.'"

lines.content: 俺の言葉をましろは繰り返した。
lines.translated: Mashiro repeated my words.

lines.content: そしてまた短い沈黙を挟んだあと、
lines.translated: And then, after another brief pause of silence,

lines.content: そ、それって
lines.translated: "D-Does that mean..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: あの……えっと
lines.translated: "Um... well..."

lines.content: もにょもにょと言って、また、沈黙してしまうけど……、
lines.translated: She mumbled bashfully and fell silent again, before...

lines.content: それって、プロポーズ……ってことに、なるのかな
lines.translated: "Does that... count as a proposal, I wonder?"

lines.content: 真っ赤だった。
lines.translated: Her face was bright red.

lines.content: 視線を逸らし、うつむいて……。
lines.translated: Averting her gaze and looking down...

lines.content: 繋いだ手が少し、震えてもいた。
lines.translated: The hand holding mine was trembling slightly, too.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 俺は、君のことが大好きなんだ。
lines.translated: I love you so much.

lines.content: これからは、もうだめだ。ひとりでなんて生きていけない。君が“隣”にいない未来なんて、“夜”の底より真っ暗だ。
lines.translated: From here on out, it's no good anymore. I can't live on my own. A future without you "beside" me is darker than the deepest depths of the "Night."

lines.content: そう伝えたかったけれど……。
lines.translated: I wanted to tell her that, but...

lines.content: だめだな。
lines.translated: It's no use.

lines.content: ……だめだ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: やっぱり俺はまだまだ子どもだ。
lines.translated: I really am still just a kid.

lines.content: 恋することを口にしたって。
lines.translated: Even if I speak of falling in love.

lines.content: ……そこに愛を誓って見せたって。
lines.translated: Even if I swear my love to her right here.

lines.content: やっぱりどこか、軽々しい――自身がどんなに真剣だと言ったところで、どうしようもない幼さが、どうしようもない軽率さだけが、後に残ってしまう。
lines.translated: It would still sound somewhat shallow -- no matter how seriously I claimed to mean it, only a helpless childishness, a helpless recklessness, would remain behind.

lines.content: そういうふうに“想像”できてしまうから。
lines.translated: Because I could "imagine" it turning out that way.

lines.content: それが、悔しくて……。
lines.translated: And that frustrated me so much...

lines.content: 俺は唇を噛んでしまっていた。
lines.translated: I ended up biting my lip.

lines.content: なんだか、おかしい
lines.translated: "Something feels strange."

lines.content: ほら。……大雅。伝わらないかな
lines.translated: "Look... Taiga. Can you feel it?"

lines.content: 繋いだ手に――何度目だろうか。ましろはぎゅっと、力を込めた。
lines.translated: Into our joined hands -- how many times had it been now? -- Mashiro put her strength, giving a tight squeeze.

lines.content: 私、どきどきしてる
lines.translated: "My heart is pounding."

lines.content: ……こんな気持ち、変なのかな。おかしい、のかな
lines.translated: "...Is it weird to feel this way? Is it strange?"

lines.content: だって……あなたはずっと、ずっとね。私にとって小さな赤ちゃんのままだって思ってた
lines.translated: "Because... for the longest, longest time, you know, I thought of you as remaining a tiny little baby to me."

lines.content: 幾つになっても親は親で、子は子なのだというのに。
lines.translated: Even though a parent is a parent and a child is a child, no matter how old they get.

lines.content: そんなあなたから好きって言われて、一緒に逃げようって、手を繋がれて……こんな気持ちになっちゃうなんて
lines.translated: "For you to tell me you love me, to hold my hand and ask me to run away with you... and for me to end up feeling like this..."

lines.content: 私、どこかおかしいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe there's something wrong with me.

lines.content: ……命がないと、心もふつうじゃなくなっちゃうのかな――ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "...When you don't have a life, does your heart stop being normal too? -- Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: こんな私でもいいの？　とましろが言った。
lines.translated: "Are you sure you're okay with me being like this?" Mashiro asked.

lines.content: 俺は、顔を上げる。
lines.translated: I raised my head.

lines.content: どこか複雑そうに微笑むましろの顔が、そこにはあった――頬は真っ赤に染まってた。
lines.translated: Mashiro's face was right there, smiling with a somewhat complicated expression -- her cheeks dyed bright red.

lines.content: いいんだ
lines.translated: "I'm okay with it."

lines.content: 俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そんな君だからこそ、いいんだ。大好きに、なっちゃったんだよ
lines.translated: "It's because you're like that that it's okay. I fell head over heels in love with you."

lines.content: そ、そっか。うん……
lines.translated: "I-I see. Okay..."

lines.content: 少し瞳を泳がせ、ましろは言う。
lines.translated: Letting her eyes wander slightly, Mashiro spoke.

lines.content: でも、私……
lines.translated: "But I..."

lines.content: ましろの瞳に“不安”がひとつ、揺らめいた。
lines.translated: A single trace of "unease" flickered in Mashiro's eyes.

lines.content: ……私、“夜の外”ではずっと、“半透明”だよ？
lines.translated: "...Outside of the 'Night,' I'm 'translucent' all the time, you know?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: あなたがこれからもっと、もっともっと……大きく育っても。立派な大人の男の子になったとしても。……私はずっと、あなたの“隣”で、小さいままで
lines.translated: "Even as you grow bigger, and bigger, and bigger from now on... Even if you become a wonderful grown-up man... I'll always stay small right 'beside' you."

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: それでいいの？　と、ましろは何度も俺に問いかける。
lines.translated: "Are you okay with that?" Mashiro asked me over and over again.

lines.content: ……わかってる？　私は、大雅。あなたと一緒に、大きくはなれない。大人には絶対になれないんだよ
lines.translated: "...Do you understand, Taiga? I can't grow up together with you. I can never become an adult."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 大雅と一緒に、私、美味しいご飯も食べられない
lines.translated: "I can't eat delicious food together with you either, Taiga."

lines.content: ……うん。それは少し、さみしいね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That is a little lonely."

lines.content: でも、少しだけだよ。と俺は言う。それで得られるさみしさはほんの少しだ。
lines.translated: "Only a little, though," I said. The loneliness that comes from that is only a tiny bit.

lines.content: ……君と一緒にいられない日々のことを思うと、そんなの、何でもない
lines.translated: "...When I think about the days I wouldn't get to spend with you, something like that is nothing at all."

lines.content: それと比べたら、そんなさみしさなんて、悲しいことに数えられないよ。だから……
lines.translated: "Compared to that, a loneliness like that doesn't even count as something sad. So..."

lines.content: だからこの手は離さない。絶対。……絶対。
lines.translated: So I won't let go of this hand. Never. ...Never.

lines.content: そう言って、俺はましろを真っ直ぐに見る。
lines.translated: Saying that, I looked straight at Mashiro.

lines.content: ……う、ううっ
慌てたように視線を彷徨わせ、ましろはうつむく。
lines.translated: Letting her gaze wander in a fluster, Mashiro looked down.

lines.content: は、“半透明”な、私……なんだよ
lines.translated: "I-I'll be... 'translucent,' you know?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: あなた以外には誰も、私のことは見えないんだよ。そんな私と話していたら……あなたはきっと、周りの人たちにおかしく見られる
lines.translated: "No one other than you will be able to see me. If you talk to me like that... the people around you will surely think you're strange."

lines.content: うん。そうかもしれないね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That might happen."

lines.content: ……そうなったら、[・|さ][・|み][・|し][・|い][・|よ]。あなたの周りから、どんどん人が離れていって……。あなたは孤独になってしまうかも
lines.translated: "...If that happens, it'll be lonely. People will drift further and further away from you... and you might end up all alone."

lines.content: 君がいるのに？
lines.translated: "Even though you're here?"

lines.content: 俺は微笑む。
lines.translated: I smiled.

lines.content: ちょっと自分と違うからって離れていくような人たちになんて興味はないよ。全然ない。そんな人たちに何を言われたところで、俺にはちっとも響かない
lines.translated: "I have no interest in people who would leave just because I'm a little different from them. None at all. No matter what people like that say to me, it won't bother me one bit."

lines.content: だって、君がいるんだ。誰よりやさしい“夜の女王”が……俺だけの“お姫さま”が、そばにいてくれる
lines.translated: "Because I have you. The 'Queen of the Night,' who is kinder than anyone else... my very own 'princess' will be right by my side."

lines.content: それなのに、孤独になるの？
lines.translated: "How could I be lonely with all that?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: いいんだ
lines.translated: "I'm okay with it."

lines.content: 俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: たとえ一緒に大人になれなくても。一緒に、美味しいものを食べられなくても。……君以外の誰もが、俺から離れていってしまったとしても。別に、いいんだ
