lines.translated: "Even if we can't grow up together. Even if we can't eat delicious food together. ...Even if everyone else in the world besides you leaves me behind. I don't mind."

lines.content: もし君が俺の“想い”を受け入れてくれるなら。君がそばにいてくれるなら……俺はもう、これからは孤独にだけは絶対なれない。さみしい気持ちになることだって、絶対、ないんだ
lines.translated: "If you'll accept my 'feelings.' If you'll stay by my side... then from here on out, there's no way I could ever be alone. And there's no way I'll ever feel lonely, either."

lines.content: 俺にとってこんな幸せが他に存在するだろうか。
lines.translated: Could there be any other happiness like this for me?

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: きっとだ。
lines.translated: Surely...

lines.content: きっと、どこにもないはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely, there couldn't be anywhere else.

lines.content: あ、あと
lines.translated: "A-Also..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: なに？　と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "What is it?" I asked.

lines.content: ……うん。あともうひとつだけ、できないこと……あるよ
lines.translated: "...Um. There's just one more thing... that I can't do."

lines.content: そう？　なんだろう
lines.translated: "Oh yeah? What's that?"

lines.content: ……私とは、え、えっちなことも、全然、できない
lines.translated: "...With me, you can't do, um, n-naughty things at all, either."

lines.content: 更に頬を赤くした。
lines.translated: Her cheeks turned even redder.

lines.content: ましろは瞳を泳がせる――
lines.translated: Mashiro's eyes darted around --

lines.content: 男の子は誰でも、大人になったら、えっちしないと愛が冷めちゃうって、本で読んだよ
lines.translated: "I read in a book that when boys grow up, every single one of them falls out of love if they don't do naughty things."

lines.content: そんなことを言って、もっともっと、真っ赤になった。
lines.translated: Saying something like that, she turned deeper and deeper crimson.

lines.content: “半透明”な私とは、えっち、できない……そ、そんな、私でも……いいの？　一緒に……ずっとふたりで、いてくれる？
lines.translated: "You can't do naughty things... with a 'translucent' girl like me... A-Are you okay... with me even so? Will you stay together... with me forever?"
Won't you start thinking along the way... that you don't want someone like me anymore...?

lines.content: 言葉にはされなかったそんなましろの不安が、するりと、繋いだ手から心に滑り込んできた。
lines.translated: That unspoken anxiety of Mashiro's slipped smoothly from our joined hands and into my heart.

lines.content: 大好きだったお母さんとお父さんに、ある日突然、存在を[・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|こ][・|と]にされた女の子。いっぱいさみしかった。いっぱいいっぱい、自分はいらないんだって、涙がこぼれた。
lines.translated: A girl whose very existence was suddenly treated as if it had never been there one day by the mother and father she loved so much. She had been so very lonely. Over and over, she had shed tears, thinking she wasn't wanted.

lines.content: 流れ込んできたのはその記憶のかけらだ。
lines.translated: What flowed into me was a fragment of that memory.

lines.content: だから俺は深く、うなずく。
lines.translated: So I nodded deeply.

lines.content: うん。もちろんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Of course I will."

lines.content: 俺にとって君が、君ひとりが、唯一の宝物だ。いらないなんて思うはずがない。
lines.translated: To me, you, and you alone, are my one and only treasure. There is no way I could ever think I don't want you.

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 私、あなたとの赤ちゃんだって、作れない……
lines.translated: "I can't even make a baby with you..."

lines.content: 震えながらもましろは言った。
lines.translated: Though trembling, Mashiro spoke.

lines.content: できないこと後ひとつだけって言ったけど……ううん。まだまだいっぱいあるよ。あなたと一緒にできないこと、私にはいっぱい、あるんだよ
lines.translated: "I said there was only one more thing I couldn't do, but... no. There are still lots more. There are so many things I can't do together with you."

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: それでも。と、俺は言った。
lines.translated: "Even so," I said.

lines.content: たくさんたくさん、君とは一緒にできないことで……うん。悔しいけれど、この世界は一杯だ。それでも……
lines.translated: "This world is full of so, so many things I can't do together with you... Yeah, it's frustrating, it really is. Even so..."

lines.content: それでも君の“隣”で、俺はしわくちゃになっていきたいんだ
lines.translated: "Even so, I want to grow old and wrinkled right 'beside' you."

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right.

lines.content: 君といっぱい、いっぱいの時間を過ごして……よぼよぼのおじいちゃんになって。それでも君と、俺にしか見えない“半透明”な君と、あったかな春には外を散歩したりして……
lines.translated: "I'll spend lots and lots of time with you... and become a tottering old man. Even then, I'll go for walks outside in the warm spring with you, the 'translucent' you that only I can see..."

lines.content: 今年もまた、さくらの花がいっぱいにもゆる春の景色を一緒に、こうして歩けたね。
lines.translated: Thinking, "This year, too, we were able to walk together like this through the spring scenery bursting with blooming cherry blossoms."

lines.content: 来年もまた……きっと。
lines.translated: And next year, too... surely.

lines.content: そういうふうに少しずつ、すこしずつ、“終わり”に向かって歩いて行けるのは……。
lines.translated: To be able to walk toward the "end" like that, little by little, step by step...

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: それはすごく幸せだなって思える。
lines.translated: I feel like that would be such incredible happiness.

lines.content: そうして迎える最期には、それまで君といっぱい重ねた思い出を、ふたりで静かに語り合っていたいんだ
lines.translated: "And when my final moments come like that, I want the two of us to quietly talk about all the many memories we built up together until then."

lines.content: まったく、まるで子どもらしくもない願いだなあと、自分でも感じ、苦笑いを浮かべながらも――俺は続けた。
lines.translated: Goodness, what an unchildlike wish to have, I felt to myself, and though a wry smile floated to my face -- I continued.

lines.content: そんなふうに、現実世界で安らかに、長い、ながい眠りについて……
lines.translated: "Like that, I'll fall into a peaceful, long, long sleep in the real world..."

lines.content: するとほら、“夜”の中でこうしてまた、手が繋げるよ。[・|君][・|に][・|よ][・|う][・|や][・|く][・|触][・|れ][・|ら][・|れ][・|る]。それが、その瞬間が、俺のあたらしい“夢”なんだ
lines.translated: "And then look, inside the 'Night,' we'll be able to hold hands like this again. I'll finally be able to touch you. That, that very moment, is my new 'dream.'"

lines.content: それだけで充分なんだよ。
lines.translated: That alone is more than enough.

lines.content: そういうふうに、君と一緒にいられると思い描いたこれからの人生は、どんなものより幸福だった。
lines.translated: The future life I envisioned being able to spend together with her like that was happier than anything else could ever be.

lines.content: 色々とふつうではないのはわかってる。君にも不自由な思いをさせてしまうだろうって思う
lines.translated: "I know that a lot of things about this aren't normal. And I think I'll probably end up putting you through a lot of inconvenience, too."

lines.content: だけどこれが、君に俺が渡せる“恋物語”……そんなふうに思ってはもらえないかな
lines.translated: "But couldn't you think of this as... the 'love story' that I can give to you?"

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり。
lines.translated: Ah, really now.

lines.content: 自分で口にしておきながらませた子どもだ。つくづくそう思う。そう、思うけど……。
lines.translated: Even as I say it myself, I'm such a precocious kid. I really, truly think so. I think so, and yet...

lines.content: 君のことをずっと、ずっと永遠に……この人生をかけて、お姫さまみたいに大事にだいじに、していくよ
lines.translated: "For all time, forever and ever... I'll spend this whole life of mine cherishing and treasuring you like a princess."

lines.content: 今、俺は、君にとってのヒーローになるときだ。そういうふうに自分自身に言い聞かせ、言葉を選んだ。
lines.translated: Right now is the time for me to become her hero. Telling myself that, I chose my words.

lines.content: ……どうして
うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……どうして、大雅。わからないよ。どうして私に、そこまでしてくれるの
lines.translated: "...Why, Taiga? I don't understand. Why would you go that far for me?"

lines.content: どうしてって……。それはもう、言ったじゃないか。俺は君のことが好きなんだ
lines.translated: "Why...? I already told you, didn't I? I'm in love with you."

lines.content: この数日で自分の気持ちを確かめられた。俺は、奏大雅は、君が好きだ……愛してる。君が“隣”にいない人生なんて、そんなの、一秒だって考えられない
lines.translated: "Over these past few days, I was able to make sure of my own feelings. I, Kanade Taiga, like you... I love you. A life without you 'beside' me -- I can't even imagine something like that for a single second."

lines.content: 信じられないなら何度だって言うよ。そう言って、俺は微笑んで見せた。
lines.translated: "If you can't believe it, I'll say it as many times as it takes." Saying that, I gave her a smile.

lines.content: さみしい気持ちはふたりで一緒に背負って歩いて行こう――そんなふうに、大人たちから笑われたってしかたのないきれいごとを、平気な顔をして、口にできる。
lines.translated: Let's carry our lonely feelings on our backs together, the two of us, and walk on -- I can say such idealistic platitudes, the kind that grown-ups would rightfully laugh at, with a completely straight face.

lines.content: だって俺は、ましろ。何度だって言うよ。君のことが大好きだから
lines.translated: "Because, Mashiro -- I'll say it as many times as it takes. Because I love you so much."

lines.content: この恋は最初で最後の恋なんだ。
lines.translated: This love is my first and last love.

lines.content: 幼くとも充分以上に大人びたこの心に、俺は、強く誓うのだ――もう二度とこの手を離さない。絶対だ。
lines.translated: Within this young, yet more than sufficiently mature heart of mine, I swore a fierce oath -- I will never let go of this hand again. Never.

lines.content: だめかな
lines.translated: "Is that not good enough?"

lines.content: と、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: 俺が君に、どうしてここまでしたいと思うのか――その理由は、もうこれ以上いらない。俺にはそう思えるよ……。こんな答えじゃ、だめかな
lines.translated: "The reason why I want to go this far for you -- I don't need any more reasons than that. At least, that's how I feel... Is an answer like this not good enough?"

lines.content: 所詮、子どもの戯れ言だから。君にもやっぱり相手にもされなくて……受け入れて、もらえないかもしれない。そういうふうに怖かった気持ちもあったけど
lines.translated: "After all, it's just the foolish prattle of a child. So you might not take me seriously either... and you might not accept it. A part of me was scared of that, too, though."

lines.content: 今夜。俺は、君に誓うよ――そう口にしたところで、蓄音機が動き始めた。
lines.translated: Tonight, I swear to you -- just as I spoke those words, the phonograph began to move.

lines.content: “歌”だ。
lines.translated: It was the "Song."

lines.content: “愛”と“勇気”の春の“歌”が、最初から流れはじめた。
lines.translated: The spring "Song" of "love" and "courage" began to play from the very beginning.

lines.content: 誓うよ
lines.translated: "I swear to you."

lines.content: 君のことだけ生涯ずっと、想い続ける
lines.translated: "I will keep loving only you for the rest of my life."

lines.content: ……大切に、たいせつに、たくさんの人たちが想いを乗せて、今日まで歌い継がれたこの“歌”みたいに――この“歌”を、創った人みたいに
lines.translated: "...Just like this 'Song,' which so many people have poured their precious, treasured feelings into and passed down until today -- and just like the people who created this 'Song.'"

lines.content: だけどこの“歌”は[・|あ][・|の][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]のためのものだった。
lines.translated: However, this "Song" was meant for the two of them.

lines.content: ……俺たちの前では、この“歌”は何か奇跡を起こすような“魔法”にはならなかったけれど……。でも、この誓いがその代わりには、ならないかな
lines.translated: "...In front of us, this 'Song' didn't become the kind of 'magic' that works miracles... Even so, couldn't this oath of mine take its place?"

lines.content: そうして“歌”が終わり……。
lines.translated: And then the "Song" ended...

lines.content: また最初から流れはじめようとするまで。
lines.translated: Right up until it was about to start playing from the beginning again.

lines.content: まるまる一曲ほどの時間を、ましろは沈黙の中で迷い続けていたのだろうけど……。
lines.translated: For the span of an entire song, Mashiro must have been hesitating in silence, and yet...

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: そっとうなずき、
lines.translated: She gave a gentle nod.

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ましろは……。
lines.translated: Mashiro...

lines.content: ふわりとやさしく、微笑んでくれた。
lines.translated: smiled at me, softly and gently.

lines.content: まだ私は、あなたの“好き”に、どういうふうに答えていいか……。ごめん。今すぐはわからない。でもね
lines.translated: "I still don't know how I should answer your 'love'... I'm sorry. I can't figure it out right away. But you know..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 大雅。……ありがとう。こんな私のことを“愛してる”って、言ってくれて。うれしい。……とっても
lines.translated: "Taiga... thank you. For telling someone like me that you 'love' me. I'm happy... So very happy."

lines.content: 涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: ましろはいっぱいの笑顔のまま、涙をひとつ、ぽろりとこぼした。
lines.translated: With a big, beaming smile still on her face, Mashiro shed a single, falling tear.

lines.content: 私も、あなたが大好きだよ。大雅
lines.translated: "I love you too, Taiga. So much."

lines.content: ……この“好き”がどんな種類の“好き”なのか。これからいっぱい時間を掛けて、ふたりで見つけていけたらすてきだなって、思うよ
lines.translated: "...What kind of 'love' this 'love' of mine is... I think it would be wonderful if the two of us could take lots and lots of time from here on out to find out together."

lines.content: そうして俺たちは、ふたりで一緒にこの“夜”から逃げ出すことを、決めたのだ。
lines.translated: And so, the two of us decided to run away from this "Night" together.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: [・|電][・|話]を耳に強く、とても強く押しつけていた手を、ため息と共にすっと緩めた。
lines.translated: With a sigh, I slowly relaxed the hand that had been pressing the phone hard -- so very hard -- against my ear.

lines.content: 俺の気持ちをその子は、えっと……“夜の女王”は、とりあえず受け入れてくれたんだ
lines.translated: "That girl -- um, the 'Queen of the Night' -- accepted my feelings for the time being, then."

lines.content: ここまでの話を真剣に、息を呑むようにして聞き入っていた。ぎゅっと手に込められた力に気づけないくらい。
lines.translated: I had been listening to the story up to this point so seriously, with bated breath -- so much so that I hadn't even noticed how tightly my hand was gripping the receiver.

lines.content: ここまで聞かせてもらっておいて、未だにまったく実感はないんだけど……。でも、これは俺の話なんだよね
lines.translated: "Even after hearing all of this, it still doesn't feel real to me at all... But this is a story about me, right?"
According to the girl on the other end of the line -- it was a story from when I was little. A tale from a long, long time ago.

lines.content: これは……ただ覚えていないだけで、俺が一度、経験している話なんだよね
lines.translated: "This is... a story about something I already experienced once, and I just don't remember it, right?"

lines.content: 問いかけた電話口からは沈黙だけが返ってきた。構わず俺は安堵する。
lines.translated: Only silence returned from the other end of the line in answer to my question. Regardless, I felt a sense of relief.

lines.content: なんだか複雑だけれど……そうか。上手くいったんだね
lines.translated: "I have mixed feelings about it, somehow, but... I see. So it went well."

lines.content: おめでとう、なんて言うのも奇妙な話だけれど、結論を聞いて安心を覚えたのもまた事実だった。
lines.translated: It would be strange to say congratulations to myself, yet it was also a fact that hearing the conclusion brought me relief.

lines.content: まあ……。
lines.translated: Well...

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: この話が本当のことならば。
lines.translated: Assuming this story is actually true.

lines.content: という本音は、何度だって飲み込まなければならないのだけれど。
lines.translated: Though I had to swallow back that honest doubt over and over again.

lines.content: 電話口の女の子の沈黙は続いていた。
lines.translated: The silence from the girl on the phone continued.

lines.content: ……もしもし？
lines.translated: "...Hello?"

lines.content: 問いかけても返答はない。
lines.translated: Even when I spoke to her, there was no reply.

lines.content: 俺の、未だ拭いきれない疑惑にも似た感情が伝わったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had my lingering feelings, akin to suspicion I still couldn't quite shake off, come through to her?

lines.content: そう思ったが、違った。
lines.translated: That was what I thought, but I was wrong.

lines.content: ……続き、話してもいい？
lines.translated: "...May I tell you the rest?"

lines.content: 囁くような声が返された。
lines.translated: A whispered voice came back.

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうだよね。まだ、終わりじゃないよね。
lines.translated: Right. It's not over yet, is it?

lines.content: ここまでの話は、俺個人としては、単純に好奇心をくすぐられるものではあった。
lines.translated: To me personally, the story up to this point had simply piqued my curiosity.
However, it wasn't the sort of thing someone would go out of their way to call and talk about when we weren't even supposed to be close.

lines.content: まだまだ続きはあるのだろう。
lines.translated: There must still be much more to come.

lines.content: でもすぐさま話の続きを聞くのは息が詰まる。なんとなくそんな気がした。
lines.translated: But listening to the rest of the story right away felt suffocating. For some reason, I had that feeling.

lines.content: 殆ど前のめりになりながら、女の子の語りに耳を傾けていたから。
lines.translated: Because I had been leaning almost all the way forward, hanging on every word of the girl's tale.

lines.content: 話の続きを聞く前に、幾つか質問してみてもいいかな
lines.translated: "Before I hear the rest of the story, do you mind if I ask a few questions?"

lines.content: ……休憩の代わりに俺は、今、こうして電話する子のことを少しでも知りたいと思った。
lines.translated: Instead of taking a break, I wanted to know even a little bit about the girl calling me like this right now.

lines.content: 君の名前は？
lines.translated: "What is your name?"

lines.content: そう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: 沈黙だった。
lines.translated: There was silence.

lines.content: そのまま答えてくれなくとも構わない。ただ俺から君に問いかけてみたい。それだけだったから。
lines.translated: I didn't mind if she chose not to answer at all. I just wanted to try asking her myself. That was all.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ぽつりと、声が届いた。
lines.translated: A quiet voice reached my ears.

lines.content: わたしは、クロだよ
lines.translated: "I'm Kuro."

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: つぶやいて、頭の中を探してみる。ニックネームだろうか。それとも外国の人？　……覚えていない。その名前は俺の中には見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: I murmured it to myself and searched my mind. Was it a nickname? Or was she a foreigner? ...I didn't remember. I couldn't find that name anywhere inside me.

lines.content: 電話の向こうから、ちりんと微かに鈴の音がした。
lines.translated: From the other end of the line came the faint, tinkling sound of a bell.

lines.content: 話して聞かされる物語の中ででも、何度か聴いた音だった――相棒。友人。あるいは、家族。
lines.translated: It was a sound I had heard several times even within the story she had been telling me -- partner. Friend. Or perhaps, family.

lines.content: 物語の中の俺は繰り返し、鈴の音を響かせるかわいい“誰か”のことをそう呼んでいた。
lines.translated: The me inside the story had repeatedly used those words to call that cute "someone" who made the bell ring.

lines.content: ……ねえ、クロ。俺、だめだな
lines.translated: "...Hey, Kuro. I'm no good, am I?"

lines.content: ……なにが？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: 覚えていないんだ。思い出せないんだ。ひとつ残らず。君が話してくれること、まったく自分に関係あることだって感じられないんだよ
lines.translated: "I don't remember. I can't recall a single thing. Not one bit of it. Everything you've been telling me, I can't feel like it has anything to do with me at all."

lines.content: ……ごめんね。もう少しだけ、君のことを聞いてみてもいいかな
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Do you mind if I ask just a little bit more about you?"

lines.content: そうすれば気持ちが落ち着くかもしれない。聞こえるか聞こえないかというほどの声で、そう付け加えた。
lines.translated: Maybe that would help calm my nerves. I added that in a voice barely loud enough to be heard.

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: いいよ、と小さな声で返してくれる。
lines.translated: "Go ahead," she replied in a small voice.

lines.content: ありがとう……
lines.translated: "Thank you..."

lines.content: 電話では伝わらないのに深くうなずき、俺は、言った。
lines.translated: Nodding deeply even though it wouldn't come across over the phone, I spoke.

lines.content: 答えられなかったり、答えたくないことだったら、何も言わなくていいよ。ただ俺が、今は一方的に話していたいだけだから
lines.translated: "If it's something you can't answer, or don't want to answer, you don't have to say anything. I just want to talk one-sidedly right now, that's all."

lines.content: クロ。君は今、どこにいるの？　どこから電話、してきてくれてるのかな
lines.translated: "Kuro. Where are you right now? Where are you calling me from?"

lines.content: クロと、ましろ。言われてみれば[・|対][・|照][・|的][・|だ]。何か、ふたりは関係があるのかな
lines.translated: "Kuro and Mashiro -- black and pure white. Now that I think about it, your names are complete opposites. Is there some kind of connection between the two of you?"

lines.content: [・|君][・|も]何か、甘いものが好きだったりする？　たとえば、あめ玉とか。……チョコレートとか
lines.translated: "Do you like sweet things too? Like hard candy, for instance... or chocolate?"

lines.content: もし教えてくれたら用意しておくよ。甘いお菓子をいっぱいだ。この先いつか会えたりすることがあるなら、色々話してくれたお礼に渡せればって思うけど……
lines.translated: "If you tell me, I'll get some ready for you. Lots and lots of sweet treats. If we ever get the chance to meet someday, I'd like to give them to you as thanks for telling me all of this, though..."

lines.content: このまま何も返答はないものかと思っていた。
lines.translated: I half expected there would be no reply at all.

lines.content: けれど……、
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……好き
ぽつりと、小さな声がする。
lines.translated: A small voice murmured.

lines.content: ……チョコレート、わたしも好き。大好きだよ
lines.translated: "...I like chocolate, too. I love it."

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 特にね。甘いのが、好きだよ。……ミルク味のやつ。好き。愛してる
lines.translated: "Especially the sweet ones. I like those... The milk-flavored ones. I like them. I love them."

lines.content: そう。愛してるんだ。嫉妬しちゃうね
lines.translated: "I see. So you love them. You're making me jealous."

lines.content: おどけたふうにそう言った。
lines.translated: I said it in a joking tone.

lines.content: すると返答はないのに、電話の向こうで女の子が微笑んでいるように感じられた。
lines.translated: There was no verbal reply, yet I felt as though the girl was smiling on the other end of the line.

lines.content: ……不思議な感覚だった。
lines.translated: It was a mysterious sensation.

lines.content: まるで……。
lines.translated: Almost as if...

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: まるで“夜”と現実とが繋がったような。そんな感覚が、あった。
lines.translated: Almost as if the "Night" and reality had been connected. That was the kind of sensation I felt.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: なに、大雅
lines.translated: "What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: 今、ここまで話して聞かせてくれたことを、俺なりに整理してみてもいいかな
lines.translated: "Do you mind if I try to sort out everything you've told me up to this point in my own way?"

lines.content: ……整理？
lines.translated: "...Sort it out?"

lines.content: うん。……別に君の説明のしかたがどうのと文句付けたい訳じゃあないんだよ。ただ少し複雑な部分も多かったから――だからさ。言葉にしてみて自分の理解度を把握しておきたいんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah... It's not like I'm trying to complain about the way you explained it or anything. It's just that there were a lot of complicated parts -- so, you know. I want to put it into words myself and make sure I've got a grasp on it."

lines.content: いいかな、と俺は問う。
lines.translated: "Is that okay?" I asked.

lines.content: もし俺の認識が間違えていたら容赦なくだめ出ししてほしい。確認は簡単に済ませるよ。……いいかな？
lines.translated: "If my understanding of it is wrong, I want you to correct me without holding back. I'll keep the check brief. ...Is that okay?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: いいよ、と君が言う。
lines.translated: "Okay," she said.

lines.content: ありがとう
lines.translated: "Thank you."

lines.content: とまた俺も言い、頭を整理させていく。
lines.translated: I echoed her words and began putting my thoughts in order.

lines.content: すごくざっくりとした、身も蓋もないような言い方になっちゃうかもだけど……、“夜の国”は、たとえば初期と第二期に別けられるよね
lines.translated: "This might end up sounding super rough and blunt, but... the 'Land of Night' can basically be divided into a first phase and a second phase, right?"

lines.content: 初期はつらく悲しい現実から子ども達を、残酷な心の持ち主である大人から護るため……さくらだ。
lines.translated: The first phase existed to protect the children from a painful, sorrowful reality, and from the adults who possessed cruel hearts... That was the cherry tree.

lines.content: 神さまみたいな心を抱いたさくらの樹に、毎夜のように夢で呼ばれた子たちが、望むままの幸せな“夜”を過ごすために存在していた。
lines.translated: It existed so that the children called out to in their dreams night after night by the cherry tree, which held a heart like that of a god, could spend a happy "Night" just as they wished.

lines.content: ……だから“夜の国”には昔も今も、[・|基][・|本][・|的][・|に][・|は]、子ども達だけしか這入れないのは……たぶん、そういうことだよね
lines.translated: "...So that's probably why, both back then and now, basically only children can enter the 'Land of Night,' right?"

lines.content: まさに子ども達だけの国だった。
lines.translated: It truly was a land just for children.

lines.content: そこには永遠があったのだ。望むまま、願うまま、いつまでも幸せな“夢”を見続けられる。
lines.translated: Eternity existed there. As long as they wished for it and desired it, they could keep having happy "dreams" forever.

lines.content: しかしましろが眠りについてから、いったん、不思議な“[夢|夜]”は幕を閉じた。
lines.translated: However, after Mashiro fell into her slumber, the mysterious "Night" temporarily closed its curtains.

lines.content: 第二期は、ひとりの少女が、かつてこの町に存在していた“夜の国”を復活させたもの
lines.translated: "The second phase was when a single girl revived the 'Land of Night' that once existed in this town."

lines.content: ……簡単に言えば、あたらしい“夜の国”は、“想像力”さえあれば誰もが願いを叶えられる不思議な場所だ。
lines.translated: Simply put, the new "Land of Night" is a mysterious place where anyone can make their wishes come true as long as they have the "power of imagination."

lines.content: “想像力”は“魔法”にもなり、“奇跡”ともなり、夜空の星々みたいに“夜”の中できらめいた。
lines.translated: The "power of imagination" became "magic," it became "miracles," and it twinkled within the "Night" like the stars in the night sky.

lines.content: 更には、あたらしい“夜の国”では終わってしまった命や、死者でさえも、そこで夢見るように生き続けることができるまでに、成長した――
lines.translated: "Furthermore, the new 'Land of Night' grew to the point where even lives that had ended, even the dead, could continue living there as if in a dream--"

lines.content: そしてこの町で起きた出来事を、楽しいことも、悲しいことも、すべて“夜”の空間が記憶している
lines.translated: "And the space of the 'Night' remembers everything that happened in this town, both the happy things and the sad things."

lines.content: それはまるで、大好きな[物語|本]の、大好きなページを、またいつでも気が向いたときに開けるよう、栞を挟み込んでおくみたいにして
lines.translated: "It's just like slipping a bookmark into your favorite page of your favorite story, so you can open it up again whenever you feel like it."

lines.content: そうだ。もはや第二の現実とまで言っていいほどの場所に、あたらしい“夜”は大きくおおきく育ったのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. The new "Night" had grown so vast and immense that it could practically be called a second reality.

lines.content: ……大人たちが“未来”に繋ぎ、残していきたいと願うのは、このあたらしいほうの“夜”だ
lines.translated: "...And the 'Night' that the adults wish to pass on and leave behind for the 'future' is this newer one."

lines.content: その動機はまるで絡み合った糸のように複雑だ――いいや。
lines.translated: Their motives are as complicated as tangled threads--no.

lines.content: 絡み合ってはいるけれど、決して解けないようにと意地の悪い細工まで施されていて、そうとは知らずに永遠とその糸を解こうと、格闘し続けている――
lines.translated: Not only are they tangled, they've even been maliciously rigged so they can never be unraveled, and without knowing that, they keep struggling forever to untangle those threads--

lines.content: 大人たちの事情を思うと、マッチポンプとまでは言わないが、そんなイメージだった。
lines.translated: Thinking about the adults' circumstances, I wouldn't quite call it a problem of their own making, but that was the impression it gave me.

lines.content: ……大人たちは、遠いとおい自分の先祖たちが犯した罪により、いつまでも、いつまでもずっと……
lines.translated: "...Because of the sins committed by their distant, distant ancestors, the adults are forever, and ever..."

lines.content: さくらの樹の中で眠り続ける子ども達に、憎悪され続けてる。それが複雑に絡んだ糸だ
lines.translated: "...hated by the children who continue to sleep inside the cherry tree. That is the intricately tangled thread."

lines.content: その糸を解く方法がないために、大人たちは心を壊してしまう――
lines.translated: Because there is no way to untangle that thread, the adults end up breaking their own hearts--

lines.content: “夜”の中からこぼれ出るいっぱいの憎悪が、じわり、じわりと、地上に引き寄せる夜空の月。その光が、大人たちを狂わせ続ける。
lines.translated: The sheer hatred spilling out from within the "Night" slowly, steadily draws the moon in the night sky closer to the earth. And its light continues to drive the adults mad.

lines.content: ……そんな自分たちの魔の手から護るため、子ども達を“夜の国”に避難させたい
lines.translated: "...In order to protect the children from their own clutches, they want to evacuate them to the 'Land of Night.'"

lines.content: いつか、それほど遠くもないうちに訪れる崩壊の“未来”
lines.translated: Someday, in a not-so-distant "future" of collapse...

lines.content: そんな光景でさえも、自分たちの手によって招かれてしまうのだ。そういったすべてから子ども達を護りたい――
lines.translated: Even a sight like that will be brought about by their own hands. They want to protect the children from all of it--
Even if it means sacrificing the lives of many children.

lines.content: その矛盾に気づけないほど、大人たちはその心を決定的に壊されていく。
lines.translated: The adults' hearts are being decisively broken to the point where they can't even notice that contradiction.

lines.content: こう言ってしまうのは情緒もなにもないけれど――大人たちにとって、“夜の国”はいわゆるシェルター代わりのようなものだったんだ
lines.translated: "Saying it like this lacks any kind of sentimentality, but--to the adults, the 'Land of Night' was basically a substitute for a shelter."

lines.content: 自分たちの魔の手から。そして破壊の“未来”から。多くの命と心とを護るための。
lines.translated: To protect many lives and hearts from their own clutches, and from a "future" of destruction.

lines.content: だから決して、それを絶やしてしまうわけにはいかなかった。
lines.translated: That was why they could never let it die out.

lines.content: 今もさくらの樹に抱かれ眠り続ける子ども達。彼らが憎からず思う血筋の子らの中には、あまりに特殊な力が発露させる者も少なくなかった
lines.translated: "The children who even now sleep embraced by the cherry tree. Among the descendants of the bloodlines they were fond of, there were quite a few who manifested extraordinarily special powers."

lines.content: それはおそらく、まっくろな心の持ち主である子ども達――
lines.translated: Those were likely the children who possessed pitch-black hearts--

lines.content: その“想像力”が“夜”から漏れ出すことの影響を、少なからず受けた結果なのではないか。俺はそういうふうに勝手ながら想像している。
lines.translated: I take the liberty of imagining that it was the result of being influenced, in no small part, by their "power of imagination" leaking out from the "Night."

lines.content: ……そんなふうに複雑に、そして殆ど自ら絡ませてしまったような糸を、ましろが一気に解いてしまおうと考えた――“夜の世界”も“外”の世界も、同時にすべて救いたい
lines.translated: "...Mashiro thought of unraveling those threads, which were so complicated and practically tangled by their own hands, all at once--wanting to save both the 'World of Night' and the 'outside' world at the same time."

lines.content: 自分ひとりが多大なる犠牲を払い、その願いを叶えようと決意を固めていたのだ。
lines.translated: She had hardened her resolve to pay an immense sacrifice all by herself to make that wish come true.

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: それを知った[・|過][・|去][・|の][・|俺]は、そんなのは認められないからとましろの手を引き、一緒に逃げようと申し出た。
lines.translated: Upon learning that, the past me refused to accept it, took Mashiro's hand, and proposed that we run away together.

lines.content: 彼女を想う“夜のイキモノ”たちからの、いっぱいの応援を得て……。
lines.translated: With the full support of the "Creatures of the Night" who cared for her...

lines.content: これからふたりは、もう、誰の期待どおりにも生きたりしない。自分たちの“夢”を叶えるために、この町を出る
lines.translated: "From here on out, the two of them wouldn't live according to anyone else's expectations anymore. They would leave this town to make their own 'dreams' come true."

lines.content: きっとそういう想いがふたりの間にはあったはず。そういうふうに想像できた。
lines.translated: The two of them must have shared those feelings. I could easily imagine it that way.

lines.content: そこで、お話は止まっているけれど……。
lines.translated: The story stops right there, though...

lines.content: おかしいな
lines.translated: "That's strange."

lines.content: 俺は、手のひらを見る。利き手である右手だ。
lines.translated: I look at my palm. My dominant right hand.

lines.content: ……今、俺の“隣”には誰もいないよ。ひとりぼっちだ。ずっと、ずっと……。ひとりきりで、この家で寝起きしてきた
lines.translated: "...Right now, there's no one 'beside' me. I'm all alone. Always, always... I've been living in this house all by myself."

lines.content: 恋人どころか好きな人だっていない。それどころか、家族と呼べる誰かも存在しないのだ。
lines.translated: Let alone a lover, I don't even have someone I like. On top of that, there isn't even anyone I can call family.

lines.content: 君から教えてもらってる話では、俺は、合間合間にあの子を……ましろのことを助けないとと、しきりに言っていたように思うけど
lines.translated: "In the story you've been telling me, I feel like I kept saying every now and then that I had to save that girl... that I had to save Mashiro."

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ましろは今、どこにいるの？
lines.translated: "Where is Mashiro right now?"

lines.content: ……目には見えないけれど、今もそばにいてくれる？
lines.translated: "...Even if I can't see her, is she still by my side right now?"

lines.content: 俺はもう、“死”は……“半透明”のひとはもう見えない。そんな特別な力をなくしてしまった俺だから、ましろの姿が、見えていないだけ……？
lines.translated: "I can't see 'death'... I can't see 'semi-transparent' people anymore. Is it just that I can't see Mashiro because I lost that special power...?"

lines.content: ……ううん。それは、ないよ
lines.translated: "...No. That's not it."

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: それは、ないのか――なぜだろう。
lines.translated: That's not it, huh--I wonder why.

lines.content: 心が少し痛みを覚えた。これはさみしさだ。そういう名前がついている。
lines.translated: I felt a slight ache in my heart. This is loneliness. That's the name it has.

lines.content: ……じゃあ、君がこの電話で、最初に俺に言ってた“あの子を助けて”っていうせりふ
lines.translated: "...Then, that line you said to me right at the beginning of this phone call, 'Save her.'"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: その“あの子”というのが、ましろなのかな……
lines.translated: "Is that 'her' you mentioned Mashiro...?"

lines.content: 過去の俺は――物語の中のこの俺は、ましろを護れなかったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Did the past me--the me in this story--fail to protect Mashiro?

lines.content: いったい何者からましろを護りたいと思っていたのかは、わからないけれど……俺は、ましろのことを護りきれなかった……？
lines.translated: "I don't know who on earth I wanted to protect Mashiro from, but... did I fail to protect her in the end...?"

lines.content: ならばなぜ、そのときの記憶が一切ないのだろうか――クロから語られる話が真実であるのなら、思い出せないということが一番、おかしい。そう感じてしまう。
lines.translated: If so, then why do I have no memory of that time whatsoever?--If the story Kuro is telling me is the truth, then the fact that I can't remember is the strangest part of all. That's how it feels to me.

lines.content: それとも……。クロ
lines.translated: "Or could it be... Kuro."

lines.content: ましろとは対照的な名前の女の子。君が語り聴かせてくれる“夜の国”は死者の世界だ。
lines.translated: A girl with a name that contrasts with Mashiro's. The "Land of Night" you tell me about is a world of the dead.

lines.content: それならば……。
lines.translated: If that's the case...

lines.content: 君はまさか、ましろの生まれ変わり……だなんてことは
lines.translated: "Don't tell me you're Mashiro's reincarnation... or something like that?"

lines.content: ないよ
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: きっぱりと言われた。
lines.translated: She said it flatly.

lines.content: 絶対、ないよ。誓ってもいい
lines.translated: "Definitely not. I can swear to it."

lines.content: 誓うって……何に？　神さまとかに？
lines.translated: "Swear... on what? On God or something?"

lines.content: チョコレート……とか
lines.translated: "On chocolate... or something."

lines.content: そっか。だったら確かに、絶対だね
lines.translated: "I see. Well, in that case, it really is definite."

lines.content: ……そう？
lines.translated: "...Really?"

lines.content: うん。だって、大好物にうそつく女の子は見たことがないから
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because I've never seen a girl tell a lie on her absolute favorite food."

lines.content: ちょっとだけ微笑みを浮かべ、
lines.translated: Letting a faint smile surface,

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: 俺は、問いかける――嫌な予感がしたのだ。
lines.translated: I ask her--because I had a bad feeling.

lines.content: 君が語り聴かせてくれるこの物語は、本当に、ハッピーエンドになるのかな。ましろは、死なないよな？　ちゃんと、俺……彼女のことを護れたんだよな？
lines.translated: "Will this story you're telling me really have a happy ending? Mashiro doesn't die, right? I... I managed to protect her properly, right?"

lines.content: お願いだ。……クロ。そうだと言ってくれ
lines.translated: "Please. ...Kuro. Tell me that's true."

lines.content: 返される沈黙の意味を考える。
lines.translated: I ponder the meaning of the silence returned to me.

lines.content: いや。そもそも誰もこのお話が幸せの内に終わるとは言ってない。
lines.translated: No. To begin with, nobody ever said this story would end happily.

lines.content: それなのに、無条件に幸福なばかりの道筋と終わりを期待してしまっている。
lines.translated: And yet, I'm unconditionally expecting a path and an ending filled with nothing but happiness.

lines.content: どころか、ハッピーエンドでなければおかしいと抗議したい自分さえいる――誰もそんな約束、一言だってしていないのに。
lines.translated: Not only that, a part of me even wants to protest that it would be wrong if it wasn't a happy ending--even though nobody ever made a single promise like that.

lines.content: おかしいことがいっぱいだ。混乱することばっかりだ
lines.translated: "There are so many strange things. Nothing but things that confuse me."

lines.content: ……まったく俺は、どういうふうにここに来て、そしてどういうふうに生まれ育ったのか
lines.translated: "...How on earth did I come here, and how was I born and raised?"

lines.content: 今のいままでそれを不思議にも思わなかったのか――異常なのは大人たちだけじゃない。俺の記憶だとかも同じように、異常でしかない
lines.translated: "How did I never even find that strange until this very moment?--The adults aren't the only abnormal ones. My memories and everything else are just as abnormal."

lines.content: ……話の続きに、答えはある？
lines.translated: "...Is the answer in the rest of the story?"

lines.content: ……あるよ
lines.translated: "...It is."

lines.content: クロが言う。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……大雅の、望むとおりのものかどうかは、わからない。でも答えはある
lines.translated: "...I don't know if it'll be the one you're hoping for, Taiga. But the answer is there."

lines.content: ……続き
lines.translated: "...The rest."

lines.content: 話すよ、とクロが言う。
lines.translated: "I'll tell you," Kuro says.

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: わかった、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Got it," I say.

lines.content: そして[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: And then I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: ここから先はどんなお話になるのだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of story will it be from here on out?

lines.content: 今やもう覚えていない、過ぎ去りし少年時代の淡い“恋物語”について、これまでみたいに一つひとつ、丁寧に語られるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Will she carefully recount every single detail, just like she has so far, of a faint "love story" from my bygone boyhood that I no longer even remember?

lines.content: そこに羞恥をかけらだって覚えられないほど、まったくの他人事としか感じられないのだけど……。
lines.translated: It feels so completely like someone else's life that I can't even feel a shred of embarrassment over it, though...

lines.content: でも俺は、話の続きを聞かなければならない。
lines.translated: Even so, I have to hear the rest of the story.

lines.content: そんな思いは確かにあった。
lines.translated: That feeling was certainly there.
I wake up from within the "dream."

lines.content: いつもの部屋だ。
lines.translated: It's the usual room.

lines.content: 以前、ここではどこの誰が、どういう生活を営んでいたのか――知るよしもない。
lines.translated: Who lived here before, and what kind of life did they lead?--There is no way of knowing.

lines.content: [・|ふ][・|た][・|り]で忍び込んだのはそんな空き家。その一室である。
lines.translated: It was a room in an abandoned house like that where the two of us had snuck in.

lines.content: 鈴の音がした。
lines.translated: A bell rang.

lines.content: 振り向いて、おはようと挨拶をする。
lines.translated: Turning around, I say good morning.

lines.content: 俺が目覚めるのを――ましろと出会い、“夢”の中から帰ってくるのを、すぐ隣で待っていてくれたのだろう小さな相棒に、ごめんとまずは謝った。
lines.translated: First, I apologized to my little partner, who must have been waiting right beside me for me to wake up--to meet Mashiro and return from within the "dream."

lines.content: ……ごめんね。お待たせ。俺の我がままに付き合ってくれて、ありがとう
lines.translated: "...Sorry. Kept you waiting. Thanks for going along with my selfishness."

lines.content: 一度はましろを置いて逃げ出そうと考えた――そうすることがましろを護ることに繋がるのは確かだったから。
lines.translated: At one point, I had thought about leaving Mashiro behind and running away--because doing so would certainly lead to protecting her.

lines.content: でも……。やっぱりそうはできなかったんだ
lines.translated: "But... in the end, I couldn't do that."

lines.content: ――今、ここで逃げ出して。
lines.translated: --If I ran away right here, right now.

lines.content: その先の人生に幸福はあるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Would there be any happiness in the life that lay ahead?

lines.content: そうして得られた未来に、笑顔は……光りは、あるのだろうか。
lines.translated: In a future obtained like that, would there be smiles... would there be light?

lines.content: そんなものは存在しない。
lines.translated: Nothing like that exists.

lines.content: あるのは生涯ずっと、逃げ出した今日の自分を責め続け。
lines.translated: All that would remain is spending the rest of my life blaming the version of myself who ran away today.

lines.content: 永遠に、今日という日を“後悔”し……。
lines.translated: Eternally "regretting" this day...

lines.content: やり直しの利かない人生を理不尽に恨み続けて終わるだけ。
lines.translated: And ending my life unreasonably resenting an existence with no do-overs.

lines.content: そんな自分は、許せない。愛せるわけもない。
lines.translated: I could never forgive a version of myself like that. There's no way I could love him.

lines.content: ……俺は、ヒーローになりたかったんだ。大切に思える誰かのことを、ひとりでも多く、真っ暗な場所から救い出したかった
lines.translated: "...I wanted to be a hero. I wanted to rescue the people I hold dear from pitch-black places, even if it's just one more person."
Only when I live that way can I love myself--that will become my "song," the song only I can sing. That's what I believe.

lines.content: 聞いてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "I want you to hear me out."

lines.content: 隣にそっと寄り添ってくれる相棒に向かい、問いかけるようにして、言った。
lines.translated: Turning toward my partner nestled quietly beside me, I spoke as if asking a question.

lines.content: ……俺、好きなひとができたんだ
lines.translated: "...I've found someone I love."

lines.content: そのひとと、これから長い時間を一緒に生きていこうって、誓ったんだよ
lines.translated: "And I vowed to live a long life together with her from now on."

lines.content: ……こんな子どもが何を言ってるんだって、思うよね。……実は俺もそう思う。夢ばかり見てるんじゃないって。もっと、現実を見ろって
lines.translated: "...You probably think, what is a kid like this talking about, right? ...Honestly, I think so too. That I shouldn't just be dreaming. That I need to face reality more."

lines.content: そうできないからこそ子どもなんだと、笑われてしまうこともわかってる。
lines.translated: I know I'll be laughed at and told that being unable to do that is the very reason I'm still a child.

lines.content: “夢”の中でましろと繋いでいた手を――右の手のひらを、見つめた。
lines.translated: I stared at the hand that had been holding Mashiro's in the "dream"--at the palm of my right hand.

lines.content: 目覚める直前のことを思っていた。
lines.translated: I was thinking about what happened right before I woke up.
Inside the "Night."

lines.content: 俺はましろに何度も言った。
lines.translated: I told Mashiro over and over again.

lines.content: 俺と一緒にここから逃げよう。どこか遠くへ逃げ出そう。
lines.translated: Let's run away from here together. Let's escape somewhere far away.

lines.content: 『逃げて、逃げて……逃げ続けて。そうしてたどり着いた、ここじゃない遠いどこかで一緒に、暮らしていこう』
lines.translated: "Let's run, and run... and keep on running. And in some distant place far from here that we finally reach, let's live together."

lines.content: [・|ふ][・|つ][・|う][・|で][・|は][・|な][・|い][・|俺][・|た][・|ち]が不自由なく暮らせていけるはずもない。
lines.translated: There is no way people like us, who aren't normal, could live without any hardships.

lines.content: 最初は大変なことばかりだろうとは思う。俺たちには足りないものばっかりだから。
lines.translated: I think it'll be nothing but struggles at first. Because there are so many things we lack.

lines.content: でも、きっと、俺たちならどうにかできると信じてる。根拠なんてなんにもないけど、まずは信じてみないとはじまらない。
lines.translated: But I believe that as long as we're together, we can manage somehow. I don't have any basis for it at all, but nothing will start unless we try believing first.

lines.content: そう言った殆ど無謀な俺に、
lines.translated: To me, who said something so utterly reckless,

lines.content: 『……うん。そうだね。私たち、もうひとりぼっちじゃないんだよね。だから、力を合わせて願えば、できないことなんてたぶん、何もないよね』
lines.translated: "...Yeah. You're right. We aren't all alone anymore, are we? So if we combine our strength and wish for it, there's probably nothing we can't do, right?"

lines.content: ましろは微笑み、うなずいてくれたから……。
lines.translated: Mashiro smiled and nodded for me...

lines.content: 俺は、ましろに“力”を使った。
lines.translated: So I used my "power" on Mashiro.

lines.content: “夜と外とを繋ぐこの[呪い|才能]”……。
lines.translated: "This talent--this curse--that connects the Night and the outside"...

lines.content: 途端、ましろの身体は“半透明”に溶けていく――“夜”から“外”へと、ましろは切り離されていく。
lines.translated: Immediately, Mashiro's body began to melt into "translucence"--severing her from the "Night" and sending her to the "outside."

lines.content: 『待ってて。すぐに、迎えに行くから』
lines.translated: "Wait for me. I'll come pick you up right away."

lines.content: ましろを“夜”から“外”へ連れ出した。それは表裏一体となっている町の表側へ彼女を“繋ぐ”ということで……。
lines.translated: I took Mashiro out from the "Night" to the "outside." That meant "connecting" her to the surface side of this two-sided town...

lines.content: 俺は寝床で、ましろは“外の世界”のここだ――時計塔の管理室で、目を覚ます。
lines.translated: I would wake up in my bed, and Mashiro would wake up here in the "outside world"--in the clock tower's office.

lines.content: 『この“夢”から目覚めたら、急いで君を迎えに走る。“夜の外”でもう一度……こうして触れられはしないけど、[・|君][・|と][・|手][・|を][・|重][・|ね][・|る][・|よ]』
lines.translated: "Once I wake up from this 'dream,' I'll run to pick you up right away. 'Outside the Night,' once more... even though we won't be able to touch like this, I will place my hand over yours."

lines.content: 薄らと輪郭が揺らぎ、溶けていく中、ましろは微笑み、そして一度だけ小さくうなずいた。
lines.translated: As her outline faintly wavered and melted away, Mashiro smiled and gave a single, small nod.

lines.content: するとずっと繋いだままの手が、その感触が、ふと、消えた。
lines.translated: And then, the hand I had been holding the whole time, and the sensation of it, suddenly vanished.

lines.content: 空き家だった隠れ家を出た。
lines.translated: I left the hideout in the abandoned house.

lines.content: 遠くにそびえる時計塔を、見る。
lines.translated: I look at the clock tower towering in the distance.

lines.content: あそこで、ましろは俺のことを待っていてくれる。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: Over there, Mashiro is waiting for me. She should be.

lines.content: 時計塔に向かって黙々と進み――ふと、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Walking silently toward the clock tower--I suddenly looked up at the sky.

lines.content: 心で小さな“歌”を口ずさむ。
lines.translated: In my heart, I hum a little "song."

lines.content: ……永遠の愛を誓う“春の歌”
lines.translated: A "Song of Spring" swearing eternal love.

lines.content: そこに込められたいっぱいの“想い”を……。
lines.translated: All the "feelings" poured into it...

lines.content: そのすべてを感じ取れるようにと、祈り……。
lines.translated: Praying that I can feel every single bit of them...

lines.content: 俺は、見えない何かに問いかけている。
lines.translated: I am questioning something unseen.

lines.content: 本当に……。
lines.translated: Really...

lines.content: （本当に、これでよかったんだよな）
lines.translated: (Was this really the right choice?)

lines.content: ずきりと胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: A sharp pain throbbed in my chest.

lines.content: （……ましろ）
lines.translated: (...Mashiro.)
The truth is, you didn't even need to wish for it.

lines.content: 委ねられた“拳銃”で。
lines.translated: With the "revolver" entrusted to me.

lines.content: 持って生まれた“[呪い|才能]”で。
lines.translated: With the "talent"--the "curse"--I was born with.
(...The reason I came to this town was to kill Mashiro, the "Queen of the Night.")

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: ずきりとまた、胸が鋭く痛んだ。
lines.translated: With a sharp throb, my chest ached painfully once more.

lines.content: “悪夢”だ。
lines.translated: It's a "nightmare."

lines.content: ほんの一瞬。
lines.translated: Just for an instant.

lines.content: 俺の“悪夢”が、心に小さく爪を立てていた。
lines.translated: My "nightmare" dug its claws slightly into my heart.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]は俺、奏大雅の“悪夢”だ。
lines.translated: This is my--Kanade Taiga's--"nightmare."

lines.content: ……ある日突然、“半透明”の不思議なひとが姿を消した。
lines.translated: One day, all of a sudden, the mysterious "translucent" person vanished.

lines.content: 物心ついて直ぐくらいのことだったと思う。
lines.translated: I think it happened right around the time I first became aware of the world around me.

lines.content: それまでは誰もが“隣”に、自分にだけやさしくしてくれる“半透明”がいてくれるのだと思ってた。
lines.translated: Until then, I thought everyone had someone "translucent" right "beside" them who was kind only to them.

lines.content: ……世界で一番の俺の味方だ。
lines.translated: My greatest ally in the world.

lines.content: だから気軽に、何の駆け引きだって当然あるはずもなく、俺は家の大人たちに問いかけたのだ――
lines.translated: So casually, without any ulterior motives of course, I asked the adults of the house--

lines.content: 『あの……俺の“隣”のあのひとがどこに行ったのか、知りませんか……？』
lines.translated: "Um... do you know where the person who was 'beside' me went...?"

lines.content: 大人たちの目の色が変わった瞬間だった。
lines.translated: That was the moment the look in the adults' eyes changed.

lines.content: それまでどんなふうに興味を惹こうと話しかけても、その殆どが無視されるばかりだったのに……。
lines.translated: Even though until then, no matter how I tried to talk to them to get their attention, they had almost always just ignored me...

lines.content: 大人たちの内の誰かが言った――
lines.translated: One of the adults said--

lines.content: “そうか。何の才能もないお前だと思っていたけれど。その命だけが唯一の所有物だと、そう決めつけていたけれど。……なるほど。それがお前の[・|特][・|別]か”
lines.translated: "I see. We thought you had no talent whatsoever. We had assumed that your life itself was the only thing you possessed. ...I see now. So that is your special trait."

lines.content: 『才能……。特別？』
lines.translated: "Talent... Special trait?"

lines.content: どうやら誰もが俺みたいに“半透明”の“イキモノ”を見つめることはできないようだ。そのときはじめてそう知った。これは俺だけの“特別”なのだ。
lines.translated: Apparently, not everyone could see "translucent" "Creatures" the way I could. That was the first time I learned of it. This was a "special trait" belonging only to me.

lines.content: ……俺、奏大雅はとある厳格な家で育った。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, was raised in a certain strict household.

lines.content: さくらの杜“参禅町”
lines.translated: The Sakura Forest, "Sanzen-cho."

lines.content: この町を拠点とし、古い芸事を脈々と受け継ぎ活動している。そんな血筋だ。
lines.translated: Based in this town, our family has passed down and practiced traditional arts for generations. That is the kind of bloodline it is.

lines.content: 本家。分家とわかれていて、それぞれに得意な“芸”がまた違う。
lines.translated: It is divided into the main house and branch houses, and the "art" each excels at is different as well.

lines.content: 祭事や季節の変わり目などには、伝統的な歌や舞いを披露して町に住む人々を楽しませてもいた。
lines.translated: During festivals and the changing of the seasons, they would perform traditional songs and dances to entertain the townspeople.

lines.content: 表向きは太陽のように華やかで暖かい。
lines.translated: On the surface, they are as brilliant and warm as the sun.

lines.content: しかしその裏側には、漆黒よりも暗い夜を持つ。
lines.translated: Yet on the flip side, they hold a night darker than pitch black.

lines.content: ……この家の子ども達はまず、どんな“才能”を持って生まれたのかを、それなりの時間を掛けて試される。
lines.translated: The children of this house are first tested over a fair amount of time to see what kind of "talent" they were born with.

lines.content: 物語を綴る才能を持つ子は、そのための芸を持つ家へと移され、そこで創作のための技術を磨くのだ。歌や絵の場合もまた同様だった。
lines.translated: A child with the talent to weave stories is moved to the house that practices that art, where they hone their skills for creation. The same held true for singing and painting.

lines.content: 『……俺は、どんな“[才能|特別]”にも恵まれていなかった。ただ、命があるだけ。空っぽだった』
lines.translated: "...I wasn't blessed with any 'special talent' at all. I just had a life. I was empty."

lines.content: 俺みたいに空っぽに生まれ付いてしまった子ども達は、[・|本][・|来]、どこへ連れて行かれるのだろう。
lines.translated: Where are children who were born empty like me normally taken?

lines.content: それなりに長い時間を掛け、才能の有無を試された結果、無能の烙印を押された子らは、その瞬間からどこか知らない場所へと連れて行かれた。
lines.translated: After being tested for the presence of talent over a fairly long period of time, the children branded as talentless were immediately taken away to some unknown place.

lines.content: まだ何者でもないまっしろな俺たちは、小さな倉のような建物の中に隔離され、集団で生活していたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Still pure white and nobody yet, we were isolated inside a building like a small storehouse, living together in a group...

lines.content: 一人ひとり、大人の人に手を引かれ、姿を消した――そして二度と戻ってくることはない。“才能”があろうと、無能であろうと、それだけは変わらなかった。
lines.translated: One by one, they were led away by the hand by adults and vanished--never to return again. Whether they had "talent" or were talentless, that much never changed.

lines.content: 大人たちに手を引かれた子らの行く先は、ふたつだ。天国と、地獄。そういうふうに子どもたちは囁き合っていた。
lines.translated: There were two destinations for the children led away by the adults. Heaven, and Hell. That was how the children whispered about it to one another.
The one chosen for me was Heaven.

lines.content: 『俺は確かに、空っぽだと烙印されたけれど……』
lines.translated: "I was certainly branded as empty, and yet..."

lines.content: この世界になんの言葉も音も、色彩も、生み出せない空っぽでは、あったけど……。
lines.translated: Though I was an empty vessel incapable of bringing forth any words, sounds, or colors into this world...

lines.content: しかしこの家系に産まれる子の中には、もっともっと特別な“才能”を持って生まれてくる子が希にいた。
lines.translated: On rare occasions among the children born into this bloodline, there were those born with a much, much more special "talent."

lines.content: “他人の心の声が文字になって身体の外へこぼれだし、それが見えたり”
lines.translated: "Seeing the voices of other people's hearts spill out of their bodies as written words."

lines.content: “満月きらめく夜に眠りにつくと、眠った時間の分だけ未来に跳んでしまったり”
lines.translated: "Falling asleep on a night when the full moon gleams, only to leap forward into the future by the exact amount of time spent sleeping."

lines.content: それらの症状は“才能”と呼ぶには少し異色だ。能力が持ち主自身を苦しめる。むしろ“呪い”だ。
lines.translated: Those symptoms are a bit too unusual to be called "talents." The abilities torment their own wielders. Rather, they are "curses."

lines.content: それもまたさくらに眠る、漆黒色の子ども達――その“復讐心”がもたらす結果なのだろう。
lines.translated: That too is likely the result brought about by the pitch-black children sleeping within the cherry blossoms--by their "desire for revenge."

lines.content: そうした特別な“[呪い|才能]”を持って生まれる子らの中に、更なる“特別”が現れるのを、大人たちは待ち続けているようではあったけど……。
lines.translated: Among the children born with such special "talents"--such "curses"--the adults seemed to be constantly waiting for an even greater "special trait" to appear...

lines.content: その特別中の“特別”の持ち主が、“夜”を創るきっかけをもたらした女の子――俺、奏大雅の母親だったなんて。
lines.translated: To think that the wielder of that most special of "special traits" was the girl who brought about the catalyst for creating the "Night"--my, Kanade Taiga's, own mother.

lines.content: 当然、当時の俺が推理できようはずもなかった。
lines.translated: Naturally, there was no way the me back then could have deduced such a thing.

lines.content: ともあれ、だ。
lines.translated: Regardless.

lines.content: 『教えてください。お願いします。いつも、俺の“隣”にいてくれたあのひとはどこへ行ったの……？』
lines.translated: "Please tell me. Please. Where did the person who was always 'beside' me go...?"

lines.content: ……不用意なそんな問いかけで、俺の中にも特別な“[呪い|才能]”があるのだと大人たちに知られてしまったのだった。
lines.translated: Through that careless question, the adults found out that there was a special "talent"--a "curse"--within me as well.

lines.content: その日を境に、俺は殆ど監禁状態だったと言っていい倉から出された。
lines.translated: From that day on, I was let out of the storehouse where I had practically been kept in confinement.

lines.content: 大人たちに手を引き、連れ出された先は……天国のほう。
lines.translated: Led away by the hand by the adults, my destination was... Heaven.

lines.content: ひとり部屋を与えられた。
lines.translated: I was given a room of my own.

lines.content: 毎食しっかり美味しいものを食べさせてもらえた。
lines.translated: I was fed proper, delicious food at every meal.

lines.content: 他の子らと集団生活をしていた頃では考えられない待遇だった。
lines.translated: It was treatment I couldn't have possibly imagined back when I was living in a group with the other children.

lines.content: ならば地獄はどんな場所で、そこに連れて行かれた子らはどんな扱いを受けるのだろう。
lines.translated: In that case, what kind of place was Hell, and how were the children taken there treated?

lines.content: ぼんやりとはそう考えた。
lines.translated: I vaguely wondered about that.

lines.content: だけど今も昔も、俺にとって重要なことは別にあったのだ。
lines.translated: However, both then and now, there was something else that mattered to me.

lines.content: 探し求めたのは、たったひとつ。
lines.translated: There was only one thing I was searching for.

lines.content: 『いつも俺のことを笑わせてくれていた“半透明”――[・|あ][・|の][・|女][・|の][・|子]だ』
lines.translated: "The 'translucent' person who always made me laugh--that girl."

lines.content: 大人たちはその行方についてまったく教えてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: The adults wouldn't tell me anything at all about where she had gone.

lines.content: ただ、“お前の才能の使い道を考える。それまで大人しくしているように”と言われるだけだった。
lines.translated: They only told me, "We will think of a way to use your talent. Behave yourself until then."

lines.content: そうだ。……何もだ。
lines.translated: That's right. ...Nothing at all.

lines.content: 大人たちは幼い俺に何も教えてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: The adults didn't teach the young me anything.

lines.content: 日々、生活するため知っておいたほうがいいことも。生きるために大切なことも。何も。何ひとつ。
lines.translated: Not the things I ought to know for daily life. Nor the things that were important for living. Nothing. Not a single thing.

lines.content: その代わり……。
lines.translated: Instead...

lines.content: 『……覚えておいて。たとえ、物語を綴れなくとも。歌を歌えなくとも。絵を[えが|描]けなかろうと。君らの人生は、その生き方そのものが、それらに決して劣らぬ作品ともなり得るはずだよ』
lines.translated: "...Remember this. Even if you cannot weave stories. Even if you cannot sing songs. Even if you cannot paint pictures. Your lives, and the very way you live them, can become works of art that are in no way inferior to those things."

lines.content: ……満月の夜になると、あの女の子とは別の“半透明”が俺の隣にやって来るようになった。
lines.translated: Whenever the night of the full moon came, a different "translucent" person from that girl started coming to sit beside me.

lines.content: 『……誰からも愛してもらえない人は、どうして、いっぱいのさみしい思いをしてまで、生きていかなきゃならないのかな』
lines.translated: "...Why do people who aren't loved by anyone have to keep on living, even when they have to feel so much loneliness?"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|子][・|た][・|ち]を数多く見てきた。だから自然とそういう問いがこぼれて落ちた。
lines.translated: I had seen so many children like that. That was why the question naturally spilled from my lips.

lines.content: 『俺にはお父さんもお母さんもいない。ひとりぼっちだ。それが、さみしい。とても悲しい』
lines.translated: "I don't have a dad or a mom. I'm all alone. It's lonely. And it makes me so sad."

lines.content: だけど代わりに、“半透明”のあの女の子が俺を愛してくれていたと、身勝手に希望を持っていた。
lines.translated: Even so, I had selfishly held onto the hope that the "translucent" girl had loved me in their place.

lines.content: しかし突然あの子は姿を消した。
lines.translated: Yet she had suddenly vanished.

lines.content: だから余計に、俺はさみしいのだと感じてしまう。
lines.translated: And because of that, I felt all the more lonely.

lines.content: そう言う俺に、新しく“隣”にやって来てくれた[・|彼][・|ら]は、大人たちの代わりに――[・|あ][・|の][・|子][・|の][・|代][・|わ][・|り][・|に]、色々なことを教えてくれた。
lines.translated: When I said that, the new ones who came to stay "beside" me taught me all sorts of things in place of the adults--in place of that girl.

lines.content: 『生きることは、自分だけの物語を書こうとする営みを指すんじゃないかな。……きっとね』
lines.translated: "Doesn't living refer to the act of trying to write a story that is yours and yours alone? ...I'm sure it does."

lines.content: 満月の夜にやって来た“半透明”の男のひとだ。そのひとが微笑みながら、言った。
lines.translated: It was a "translucent" man who had come on the night of the full moon. He spoke with a smile.

lines.content: 『自分にしか描けない物語を、歌を、誰もがその命の中に持っているはずで……。それを綴るに必要な絵の具は“才能”、[・|だ][・|け]じゃないはずだ』
lines.translated: "Everyone holds a story, a song, inside their life that only they can depict... And the paint needed to weave it shouldn't be 'talent' alone."

lines.content: 『……決して消えない深い悲しみについて想う“心”が大切だ。今、君が感じてるさみしさや悲しみは、君だけの物語を描くための最高の絵の具になるはずだ。僕はそう思うよ』
lines.translated: "...A 'heart' that reflects upon a deep, never-fading sadness is what matters. The loneliness and sadness you are feeling right now will surely become the finest paint for depicting your own story. That is what I think."

lines.content: 男のひとは言った。
lines.translated: The man spoke.

lines.content: 『君の物語に現れる[悲しみ|困難]は、君以外の誰にも乗り越えられない――なぜなら、悲しみにくれる君の物語を救うヒーローは、いつだって、君自身しかいないから』
lines.translated: "No one else can overcome the hardships and sorrows that appear in your story--because the hero who will save your grief-stricken story is, always, none other than yourself."

lines.content: 『そうして“勇気”を持って、何度でも立ち上がる君の生き方から、物語より、絵より、歌よりも、何より強い“勇気”を得られる“誰か”が、この世界のどこかにいるはずだ……』
lines.translated: "And from the way you live, rising up again and again with 'courage,' there is surely 'someone' out there in this world who will gain a 'courage' stronger than from any story, any painting, any song, or anything else..."

lines.content: まるで遠いとおい日々を夢見るみたいに、“半透明”の男のひとは囁いていた。
lines.translated: As if dreaming of days long, long ago, the "translucent" man whispered.

lines.content: 『そういうふうに生きようとした“イキモノ”が、遠い昔にね、いたんだよ』
lines.translated: "Long ago, you see, there was a 'Creature' who tried to live that way."

lines.content: 『何より、誰より、大切に想う人が、幸せに生きていけますようにと願い、祈って……』
lines.translated: "Wishing and praying that the person he cherished more than anything, more than anyone, could live happily..."

lines.content: 『たとえ自分は“悪役”になろうとも。……たとえ、護りたいと願った子から、憎まれてしまおうとも。孤独だった自分を救ってくれたその子のために生きようとした』
lines.translated: "Even if he himself were to become the 'villain.' ...Even if he were to be hated by the very girl he wished to protect. He tried to live for the sake of that girl who had saved him from his solitude."

lines.content: 言葉にできない“想い”を伝えるために、人は歌を歌うし、物語を綴り、絵を描こうとする。
lines.translated: In order to convey "feelings" that cannot be put into words, people sing songs, weave stories, and try to paint pictures.

lines.content: でも、そうできない“イキモノ”は、その生き方で、人生すべてをかけて――[形|言葉]にできない“想い”を伝えるほかにない。
lines.translated: However, a "Creature" who cannot do those things has no choice but to stake their entire life on the way they live--to convey the "feelings" that cannot be given form or words.

lines.content: 『僕の“役割”は、彼のことをこうして語り続けていくことだと信じてる』
lines.translated: "I believe that my 'role' is to keep telling his story like this."

lines.content: 『……彼の決断や、その生き方だったりは、きっと……今、倒れ伏すように日々を生きている誰かの“勇気”に、繋がることもあるかもしれない』
lines.translated: "...His decisions, and the way he lived, might surely... connect to the 'courage' of someone who is living their days right now on the verge of collapsing."

lines.content: ……時を越えて届いたあの“春の歌”みたいに。
lines.translated: Just like that "Spring Song" that reached us across time.

lines.content: 『もしもそうなれば、彼は……ううん。僕もまた、より多く報われるんだろうと思うから』
lines.translated: "If that happens, then he... no, I think I too will be rewarded all the more."

lines.content: 満月の夜にやって来る“半透明”のひとは、次の満月が訪れるまでそばにいてくれた。
lines.translated: The "translucent" person who came on the night of the full moon stayed by my side until the next full moon arrived.

lines.content: ……まんまるが欠け、またまんまるになるまでだ。
lines.translated: Until the perfect circle waned, and became a perfect circle once again.

lines.content: そして次の新しい満月の夜、“半透明”のひともまた新しいひとに入れ替わった。
lines.translated: And on the night of the next new full moon, the "translucent" person was replaced by someone new once more.

lines.content: 『生きることは、大切な人へ宛てた手紙を書くような……そんな愛しいばかりの営みを指すんだよ。……きっとね』
lines.translated: "Living refers to the act of writing a letter addressed to someone precious to you... an act filled with nothing but love. ...I'm sure of it."

lines.content: 次の夜にやって来た小さなひとがそう言った。
lines.translated: The small person who came on the next night said so.

lines.content: 『悲しいことも。さみしいことも。とってもつらい。それは、わかるよ。すごく、わかる。だけどね。何でもない日々の中、生きることについて考えることは忘れないでほしいな』
lines.translated: "Sad things. Lonely things. They are very painful. I understand that. I understand it very well. Even so, in the midst of your ordinary days, I want you to never forget to think about what it means to live."

lines.content: それは、[さみしさ|孤独]や悲しさを忘れず見つめるということと同じだと、そのひとは言う。
lines.translated: She said that doing so was the same as never forgetting to gaze squarely at solitude, loneliness, and sadness.

lines.content: 『悲しみについて。勇気について。愛について。……そして、幸せについて』
lines.translated: "About sadness. About courage. About love. ...And about happiness."

lines.content: 『いつも自分だけの答えについて考えることを忘れないでほしいんだ。あなた達人間は、誰もが自分の力で考えることのできるイキモノだから……』
lines.translated: "I want you to never forget to keep thinking about your own answers. Because all of you humans are Creatures capable of thinking with your own power..."

lines.content: そうして生きたあなたの想いを、すべて、私が長いながい手紙に変えて届けよう――あなたにとって大切なひと達へ。
lines.translated: And all of the feelings from the life you lived that way, I will turn into a long, long letter and deliver it--to the people who are precious to you.

lines.content: 小さなひとはそう言って、ふと、悲しそうに微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Saying that, the small person suddenly gave a sad smile.

lines.content: 『……不思議だな。どうして。自分がこんな想いを抱くのか』
lines.translated: "...How strange. Why do I hold feelings like these?"

lines.content: 『どうして私は、こんなことをあなたに言ってしまったのか。……その理由を、原因を、思い出せない自分が少し、悲しいな』
lines.translated: "Why did I end up saying such things to you? ...It makes me a little sad that I cannot remember the reason, the cause behind it."

lines.content: さみしそうに微笑む小さなひとと手を繋ぎたいと思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to hold hands with the small person who was smiling so lonely.

lines.content: そしてその決して消えないのであろう悲しみに、ただ“大丈夫”と言いたかった。確かにさみしい想いも悲しい気持ちも簡単には消えないけれど、今はこうしてふたりでいられる。
lines.translated: And to that sadness of hers that would likely never fade, I simply wanted to say, "It's okay." It was true that lonely thoughts and sad feelings wouldn't easily disappear, but right now, the two of us could be together like this.

lines.content: そういう想いを伝えたかった。
lines.translated: Those were the feelings I wanted to convey.

lines.content: ……世界中でさみしい想いをしているもの達、その全員が手を繋ぎ合えればいい。そうすればきっと、何もかもが“大丈夫”になれるように思えた。
lines.translated: If only everyone in the world who was feeling lonely could hold hands with one another. It felt like if we did that, surely everything could become "okay."

lines.content: でも“半透明”な君たちに触れることは叶わない。
lines.translated: Yet I couldn't touch any of you "translucent" ones.

lines.content: それをいつも悲しく、そしてさみしく思っていた。
lines.translated: That always made me feel sad, and lonely.

lines.content: 彼らは俺にとって大切なひとだ。
lines.translated: They were precious people to me.

lines.content: 友人であり、家族であり、相棒だった。
lines.translated: They were my friends, my family, and my partners.

lines.content: 彼らと話し、彼らと様々なことを考える。そういう少年期を過ごした。
lines.translated: Talking with them, thinking about all sorts of things with them. That was how I spent my boyhood.

lines.content: そのおかげで俺は、殆ど子どもらしくない自分に育ったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Because of that, I might have grown up to be hardly childlike at all.

lines.content: だけど彼らのおかげで、さみしいばかりだった俺の“隣”が空っぽになるようなことは、殆どなくて……。
lines.translated: Yet thanks to them, the spot "beside" me, which had been nothing but lonely, was almost never empty...

lines.content: 『“夜の女王”だよ』
lines.translated: "It's the 'Queen of the Night.'"

lines.content: “さよなら”となる次の満月の夜に、小さなひとが教えてくれた。
lines.translated: On the night of the next full moon, when it was time to say "goodbye," the small person told me.

lines.content: 『私たちは彼女にお願いされて、こうしてあなたに会いにやって来てるんだ。……あなたが、ひとりぼっちにだけはならないようにって』
lines.translated: "We are coming to meet you like this because she asked us to. ...So that, at the very least, you would never end up all alone."

lines.content: 俺が、未来を見失うことのないように……。
lines.translated: So that I would never lose sight of the future...

lines.content: ここには来れない自分の代わりに、俺のそばにいてほしいと……俺に様々なことを教えてほしいと、“夜”に住む“半透明”の“イキモノ”たちに彼女は願ったのだと教えられた。
lines.translated: I was told that she had pleaded with the "translucent" "Creatures" living in the "Night" to stay by my side in her stead since she couldn't come here herself... and to teach me all sorts of things.

lines.content: 『姿はなくても。声は届かなくても。……そばに、いられなくても。あの子はいつもあなたのことを想ってる』
lines.translated: "Even if she has no form. Even if her voice cannot reach you. ...Even if she cannot be by your side. That girl is always thinking of you."

lines.content: 『そう、なんだ』
lines.translated: "I... see."

lines.content: ……よかった。
lines.translated: Thank goodness.

lines.content: 急に隣からいなくなり、不安だったけれど……。
lines.translated: She had suddenly vanished from beside me, and I had been so anxious...

lines.content: 俺は、あの女の子に見捨てられたわけじゃない。そう思えるだけで安心だった。
lines.translated: But that girl hadn't abandoned me. Just being able to think that brought me relief.

lines.content: 『あなたがさみしく思う瞬間なんて、一秒だってなくなればいい。あなたが少しでも幸せに生きていければいい――あの子はそればかりを祈ってる。私には、そう見えたよ』
lines.translated: "She wishes that not even a single second would pass where you feel lonely. She wishes that you can live even a little bit more happily--that girl is praying for nothing else. At least, that is how it looked to me."

lines.content: 『……そっか』
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: そういうふうに思ってくれるのは。
lines.translated: For someone to think of me that way.

lines.content: そういうふうに、離れていても、どこか遠くから想い続けていてくれるというのは。
lines.translated: For someone to keep thinking of me from somewhere far away like that, even when we are apart.

lines.content: まるで……。
lines.translated: Almost as if...

lines.content: 『まるで、お母さんみたいだ』
lines.translated: "It's just like a mother."

lines.content: ふと俺はそうこぼした。
lines.translated: The words slipped out of my mouth.

lines.content: “お母さん”
lines.translated: "Mother."

lines.content: 俺はそれがどういう存在なのか、正確にはわからない。物心ついた頃にはもう既に、お母さんはどこにもいなかったから。
lines.translated: I didn't know with any certainty what kind of existence that was. By the time I was old enough to understand things, my mother was already nowhere to be found.

lines.content: でも、そう感じてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, that was how it felt to me.

lines.content: 『うん。そうだね。お母さん、か。そう言ってあげたら、あの子は……まっしろな“夜の女王”は、よろこんでくれるはずだよ。心からね』
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. A mother, huh? If you told her that, that girl... the pure white 'Queen of the Night' would surely be overjoyed. From the bottom of her heart."

lines.content: 小さなひとと“さよなら”をした。
lines.translated: I said "goodbye" to the small person.

lines.content: するとまたすぐ、別の“半透明”のひとがやって来てくれた。
lines.translated: And right away, another "translucent" person came to me.

lines.content: 彼らは幼い俺に、様々なことを思い思いに語った。
lines.translated: Each in their own way, they spoke to the young me about all sorts of things.

lines.content: 日々の営みに必要不可欠なこと。
lines.translated: Things that were indispensable for daily life.

lines.content: ……生きるうえでかけがえのないこと。
lines.translated: Things that were irreplaceable in living.

lines.content: もちろんそれらはこの世界にある唯一無二の答えというわけではない。すべて彼らの“理想”ではあったのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Of course, those weren't the one and only answers in this world. All of them were probably just their own "ideals," and yet...

lines.content: 本当に、様々なことを俺に教えてくれたのだ。
lines.translated: They truly taught me so many different things.

lines.content: 屋敷から外へは出してもらえない。
lines.translated: I wasn't allowed to go outside the mansion.

lines.content: 学校にも行けず。友だちも作れない。
lines.translated: I couldn't go to school. I couldn't make friends.

lines.content: ……大人たちは食事を運んでくるだけ。話をしてくれないどころか、目だって合わせてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: The adults only brought me my meals. Far from speaking to me, they wouldn't even meet my eyes.

lines.content: そんな俺の教師は、“半透明”の“夜のイキモノ”たちだった。
lines.translated: For someone like me, my teachers were the "translucent" "Creatures of the Night."

lines.content: 彼らには“半透明”である以外にも共通点があった。
lines.translated: They had something else in common besides being "translucent."

lines.content: 彼らは俺が眠るとき、いつも同じ“歌”を口ずさんでくれていた。
lines.translated: Whenever I went to sleep, they would always hum the same "song" for me.

lines.content: その“歌”を想うとき、いつも“半透明”の彼らが教えてくれたことについて、考えるのだ。
lines.translated: Whenever I thought of that "song," I would always reflect upon the things those "translucent" ones had taught me.

lines.content: 俺は、この命で、この人生で、いったいどんな物語を書けるだろう。俺にしか歌えない歌とはなんだ。
lines.translated: With this life, with this existence, just what kind of story could I write? What was the song that only I could sing?

lines.content: “半透明”のひとが語ってくれた“夜の怪物”のように、俺は、大切に想う誰かのために――この人生をかけて、何かを成せるだろうか。
lines.translated: Like the "Monster of the Night" that the "translucent" man had told me about, could I stake this life of mine to accomplish something--for the sake of someone I cherished?

lines.content: 特別な“歌”を創った[・|あ][・|の][・|人][・|み][・|た][・|い][・|に]俺も、生きることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: Could I also live like that person who created a special "song"?

lines.content: 幼いばかりの俺には難しい話だったけれど……。
lines.translated: It was a difficult subject for someone as young as I was, and yet...

lines.content: すべては“愛”と“勇気”と……“悲しみ”だ。
lines.translated: Everything is "love," "courage," and... "sorrow."

lines.content: その中にこそあなただけの“[幸福|希望]”が眠ってる。
lines.translated: Right within those is where your very own "hope" lies sleeping.

lines.content: 口ずさむ“歌”が、静かに、そっと、俺にそう囁いているように思えたから……。
lines.translated: Because it felt as if the hummed "song" was quietly, gently whispering that to me...

lines.content: 『俺は、行こう』
lines.translated: "I'm going to go."

lines.content: “勇気”を持って、無能と印された子らの行方を探ることにした。
lines.translated: Gathering my "courage," I decided to search for the whereabouts of the children branded as talentless.

lines.content: ……彼らは、大人たちにどこへ連れて行かれてしまうのだろう。
lines.translated: Where in the world were the adults taking them?

lines.content: 彼らの行く先は地獄だと、俺たちは噂していた。
lines.translated: Rumor among us had it that their destination was hell.

lines.content: 『もし本当に、彼らが地獄のように凄惨な生活を強いられているのなら、どうする……？』
lines.translated: "If they're really being forced to live a horrific, hellish life, what will I do...?"

lines.content: 俺は、彼らを救い出すことができるだろうか。そういう自分を描けたらいい。漠然とそう思っていた。
lines.translated: Would I be able to rescue them? I vaguely wished I could paint that kind of picture of myself.

lines.content: ……ヒーローだ。
lines.translated: A hero.

lines.content: 『今だ。この日、このとき、この瞬間こそ、俺が俺自身を救うヒーローに、なるときだ』
lines.translated: "Now is the time. This day, this hour, this very moment is when I become a hero who saves himself."

lines.content: そのとき隣にいてくれた“半透明”のひとは、そんな俺の行動に反対も賛成もしなかった。
lines.translated: The "translucent" person beside me at the time neither opposed nor agreed with my actions.

lines.content: ただそばで、隣で、俺の精一杯の“勇気”を見守ってくれているだけだった。
lines.translated: They simply stayed close, right beside me, watching over every ounce of "courage" I could muster.

lines.content: 彼らが同じ屋敷にいることは知っていた。
lines.translated: I knew the other children were in the same mansion.

lines.content: 俺とは違う部屋に連れて行かれていて……。
lines.translated: They had just been taken to a different room from mine...

lines.content: そこは天国なのか。地獄で、あるのか。
lines.translated: Was that place heaven? Or was it hell?

lines.content: 部屋をこっそり抜け出したその先で、[・|そ][・|れ]は簡単に見つけられた。
lines.translated: After sneaking out of my room, I found "it" easily enough.

lines.content: 結果……。
lines.translated: And the result...

lines.content: 『……地獄だ』
lines.translated: "...It's hell."

lines.content: これ以上ないくらいの地獄の底だった。
lines.translated: It was the absolute depths of hell, as bad as could possibly be.

lines.content: 長いながい階段の下。地下の地下だ。
lines.translated: Down a long, long flight of stairs. A basement beneath the basement.

lines.content: 屋敷には座敷牢があった。
lines.translated: The mansion had a dungeon cell.

lines.content: 湿っぽくてどこか生臭い。そんな場所に彼ら彼女らはぎゅうぎゅうに閉じ込められていたのだった。
lines.translated: It was damp and carried a faint, foul stench of blood and flesh. Those boys and girls had been crammed inside and locked away in a place like that.

lines.content: みんな痩せ細り、目は虚ろで、日頃から乱暴を繰り返されているのだろう、傷だらけでもあったのだ。
lines.translated: Every last one of them was emaciated, hollow-eyed, and covered in wounds--likely from being subjected to constant abuse day after day.

lines.content: 『……この子たちは餌なんだよ』
lines.translated: "...These children are bait."

lines.content: そのとき隣にいた“半透明”の女のひとが俺に言った。
lines.translated: The "translucent" woman beside me at the time spoke to me.

lines.content: 『こうして虐げられる子ども達の悲しい想いが、~“[私たち|夜のイキモノ]”のことをどうしようもなく引き寄せる。~……特に、“夜の怪物”だ』
lines.translated: "The sorrowful feelings of children oppressed like this irresistibly draw 'us'--the Creatures of the Night--to them. ...Especially the 'Monsters of the Night.'"

lines.content: 『彼らは自分が“夜”を維持させる“役割”を持つのだと信じてる』
lines.translated: "They believe they have a 'role' to maintain the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 『だから、悲しい心を抱いた子たちを“夜”に[さら|攫]って、そのつらくて痛い“想い”を切り取り、“夜”のさくらに捧げてる』
lines.translated: "So they spirit away children with sorrowful hearts into the 'Night,' cut out their painful, agonizing 'feelings,' and offer them up to the cherry blossoms of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 『……そしてもし、現実世界を生きることがつらいなら、元の居場所に戻ることが怖いなら、そういう子たちを仲間にするんだ。自分たちと同じような“永遠の命”を与えてね』
lines.translated: "...And if living in the real world is too painful for them, if they're too afraid to return to where they belonged, they make those children their companions. By granting them the same 'eternal life' they have."

lines.content: だけどこれは罠なのだ。
lines.translated: However, this was a trap.

lines.content: 悲しい“想い”におびき寄せられた“怪物”たちを、大人は捕らえ、その命ごと喰らうのだと言う。
lines.translated: She told me that the adults capture the "Monsters" lured in by those sorrowful "feelings" and devour them, life and all.

lines.content: そうすることで“[イキモノ|夜の怪物]”の中にある“永遠の命”を得られると信じてる。
lines.translated: They believe that by doing so, they can obtain the "eternal life" held within the "Monsters of the Night."

lines.content: 『……あるいは、“夜の怪物”に[さら|攫]われて、“夜”の中に引き込まれた子を攫い返す。そして、連れ帰ったその子の命も同じように喰らうんだ』
lines.translated: "...Or else, they snatch back the children who were spirited away by the 'Monsters of the Night' and drawn into the 'Night.' And then, they devour the lives of the children they brought back in the exact same way."

lines.content: それもまた“永遠”を手に入れるための方法と、一部の大人たちは信仰してる。
lines.translated: Some of the adults worship that practice as another method of obtaining "eternity."

lines.content: そういうふうに教えられたけれど……、[・|だ][・|め][・|だ]。
lines.translated: That was how it was explained to me, and yet... "no."

lines.content: 『どうして……』
『ねえ。どうして大人たちは、そうまでして“永遠に生きる命”がほしいのかな』
lines.translated: "Tell me. Why do the adults want 'eternal life' badly enough to go that far?"

lines.content: だめだ。俺にはどうしても理解できなかった。
lines.translated: It was no use. No matter how hard I tried, I couldn't understand it.

lines.content: 『それは……』
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: “半透明”のひとが教えてくれる。
lines.translated: The "translucent" person explained it to me.

lines.content: 『ここよりもう少し先の未来だけれど……』
lines.translated: "It happens a little further in the future from now, but..."

lines.content: 『世界は大人たちの歪みきってしまった心によって壊される』
lines.translated: "The world will be destroyed by the utterly twisted hearts of the adults."

lines.content: 『そんな破滅の光景から子ども達を避難させるために“夜の国”は創られ、維持されていく――大人たちの最初の動機は確かなやさしさからだった』
lines.translated: "In order to evacuate the children from that scene of ruin, the 'Land of Night' was created and continues to be maintained--the adults' initial motive came from genuine kindness."

lines.content: だけどその不思議の国には、大人たちは[・|死][・|ぬ][・|こ][・|と]でしか立ち入れない。善良だろうとなんであろうとだ。
lines.translated: However, adults can only enter that wonderland "by dying." Whether they are good people or anything else.

lines.content: ……“永遠に生きる命”さえあれば、たとえ“夜”に立ち入りを拒否されようと、多くの命が助かる。[・|生][・|き][・|て][・|い][・|け][・|る]。
lines.translated: If they just had "eternal life," then even if they were denied entry into the "Night," many lives would be saved. They "could keep on living."

lines.content: 更に言えば――“永遠に生きる”ことではじめて形にできる。そんな作品もあるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Furthermore--there might be works of art that can only be given form by "living forever."

lines.content: 『彼らは特段、“神”を信仰しているわけでもなかったけれど……』
lines.translated: "It wasn't as though they particularly worshipped 'God,' however..."

lines.content: 『だけど時を越えて“永遠”と、人々の心に語り継がれていく“[書物|福音]”には、無二の信仰を捧げていた』
lines.translated: "They offered peerless devotion to the 'gospel'--the 'scriptures' that transcend time and are passed down 'eternally' in people's hearts."

lines.content: ――“天地は過ぎ去る。しかし、私の言葉は過ぎ去ることはない”
lines.translated: --"Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away."

lines.content: それは、“神”として崇められたひとりの男が残した言葉だ。[・|確][・|か][・|に]それは過ぎ去ることなく、時を越え、[・|今]に語り継がれてる。
lines.translated: Those were the words left behind by a single man revered as "God." And "surely enough," without passing away, they have transcended time and are still passed down "today."

lines.content: 『彼らにとって“永遠の命”とは――[・|そ][・|れ]に導くものとは、口にすれば消費されてしまうパンなどといった、その日の糧だけではない』
lines.translated: "To them, 'eternal life'--and that which leads to 'it'--is not merely daily sustenance like bread, which is consumed the moment it is eaten."

lines.content: 『[・|そ][・|れ]に触れた人々の心や人生に、深く、影響を与え――時さえも越え語り継がれ、“永遠”と[・|過][・|ぎ][・|去][・|る][・|こ][・|と][・|な][・|く]残り続けていく“[作品|想い]”……言葉や、旋律、そして色彩』
lines.translated: "It is 'feelings'--'works' that deeply influence the hearts and lives of those who touch 'them,' passed down across time itself, remaining 'eternally' 'without ever passing away'... Words, melodies, and colors."

lines.content: それこそが彼らの求めた“永遠の命”だ。
lines.translated: That was the very "eternal life" they sought.

lines.content: それらは、困難に溺れそうな“誰か”の心に、勇気を……光りを、そっと手渡すことができるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Those things might be able to gently hand courage... and light, to the heart of "someone" about to drown in hardship.

lines.content: たとえその“誰か”の“隣”に、自分自身がいられなくとも。
lines.translated: Even if they themselves cannot be "beside" that "someone."

lines.content: ……たとえ、その“時”の中に、自分は生きてさえいなくとも――……自分の“想い”さえそこにあればいい。
lines.translated: Even if they are not even alive within that "time"--as long as their "feelings" are there, that is enough.

lines.content: [・|私][・|た][・|ち]の[想い|言葉]は、深い悲しみや苦しみの中にある“誰か”を探し求め、勇気とやさしさを届けられないかと、“永遠”と時の中を彷徨い続ける。
lines.translated: "Our" words continue to wander through "eternity" and time, searching for "someone" in deep sorrow or suffering, hoping to deliver courage and kindness to them.

lines.content: 『思い描いたすべてが叶う“夜の国”ならば、そういった自分だけに描ける“永遠”を、たとえ“才能”が足らなかろうと、[・|想][・|像][・|以][・|上]の形にし、残し続けることができると信じた』
lines.translated: "They believed that in the 'Land of Night,' where everything envisioned comes true, they could give that 'eternity' only they could depict a form 'beyond imagination' and leave it behind forever, even if they lacked the 'talent.'"

lines.content: 『でも、“夜”には“女王”が鍵を掛けてしまってる。どんなに強引な方法を試そうと、大人たちが生身を持って“夜”に這入ることはできなくて……』
lines.translated: "However, the 'Queen' has locked the door to the 'Night.' No matter what forceful methods they try, the adults cannot enter the 'Night' in the flesh..."

lines.content: ならば、こちらから“夜”に住むものたちをおびき寄せよう――[・|そ][・|の][・|よ][・|う][・|な][・|発][・|想][・|か][・|ら]、大人たちの心は“呪い”によって歪みはじめてた。
lines.translated: In that case, let us lure the ones who dwell in the "Night" over to our side--"from that very idea," the hearts of the adults began to twist under the "curse."

lines.content: 『……自身の口にする言葉に矛盾や歪みがあることにさえ、気づけるものがいなかった』
