lines.translated: "...There was no one left who could even notice the contradictions and distortions in the words coming out of their own mouths."

lines.content: 無能な子らの唯一の価値は持って生まれた命だけ。価値は利用できなければ意味を産まない。
lines.translated: The only value the talentless children had was the life they were born with. And value produces no meaning unless it is utilized.

lines.content: そう考えられた結果が、この地下牢だ――改めてそう言われ、結ばれた説明に、しかし……。
lines.translated: The result of that way of thinking was this underground dungeon--even as she reiterated that to conclude her explanation, however...

lines.content: しかし幼いばかりだったこの俺には、目の前の光景も、受け取った説明も、やっぱりかけらも理解できなかった。
lines.translated: However, to someone as young as I was, neither the sight before my eyes nor the explanation I had been given made a single shred of sense after all.

lines.content: ただ、疑問だけが残った。
lines.translated: Only questions remained.

lines.content: 『何の才能も持たず産まれた。たったそれだけのことが罪なのかな。こんなふうに、一方的に罰せられなきゃならないほどのことなのかな』
lines.translated: "Being born without any talent. Is something as simple as that really a sin? Is it really something they have to be unilaterally punished for like this?"

lines.content: そんな疑問とさみしさに落とされて、その夜は朝まで泣いたことを覚えてる。
lines.translated: Cast down into those questions and loneliness, I remember crying until morning that night.

lines.content: 『ヒーローだ……』
lines.translated: "A hero..."

lines.content: 彼らのことを助けてくれる正義の味方だ。
lines.translated: An ally of justice who would save them.

lines.content: 『彼らの命を、心を救うヒーローは、[・|あ][・|の][・|人]はいったい、どこにいってしまったんだよ』
lines.translated: "A hero who would save their lives and their hearts--just where on earth did 'that person' go?"

lines.content: どんな人にでも世界でひとりくらい、味方がいてほしいと願う。
lines.translated: No matter who they are, anyone wishes to have at least one ally in the world.

lines.content: 俺が彼らにできることはなんだろうと考えた。
lines.translated: I thought about what I could possibly do for them.

lines.content: 無能として地下牢に隔離されていた子どもたち。
lines.translated: The children quarantined in the dungeon as talentless.

lines.content: ……その間で“希望”となっている人物がいた。
lines.translated: Among them, there was a figure who had become their "hope."

lines.content: それは子ども達にとってまさにヒーローだった。
lines.translated: To the children, that person was truly a hero.

lines.content: 自分たちと同じように無能であるはずが、長い時間を掛けて――大人たちからいくらひどい仕打ちを受けようと、負けず、腐らず――ついには一遍のうつくしい“歌”を編んだのだという。
lines.translated: Though supposedly just as talentless as they were, over a long period of time--no matter how cruelly the adults treated them, never giving in and never losing heart--that person had finally woven a single, beautiful "song."

lines.content: その人は“歌”と一緒に幾つかの言葉を残した。
lines.translated: Along with the "song," that person left behind a few words.

lines.content: “想いが才能を越えることもあるはずだ……”
lines.translated: "Surely there are times when feelings can surpass talent..."

lines.content: “人は才能には憧れる”
lines.translated: "People admire talent."

lines.content: “人は、[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|な][・|く][・|て][・|も]立ち上がろうとする者には、共感を得る”
lines.translated: "And people empathize with those who try to stand up 'even without it.'"

lines.content: そしてこの“地獄”から、自らの“[想い|歌]”で抜け出したのだ。
lines.translated: And so, that person escaped from this "hell" through their own "song."

lines.content: 彼らにとってその人物の存在が。その生き方が。大きなおおきな“希望”の光りだったし、揺るぎない確かな“勇気”の炎でもあったのだ。
lines.translated: To those children, that person's existence. That way of life. It was a great, shining light of "hope," and an unwavering, unmistakable flame of "courage."

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: それはまさにヒーローの姿だった。
lines.translated: That was truly the figure of a hero.

lines.content: その人が作ったものは、たったひとりの誰かのために歌われた“歌”だった。
lines.translated: What that person had created was a "song" sung for the sake of just one single person.

lines.content: その“歌”は、無能な子らにとって“希望”の象徴として、永く歌い継がれる“歌”ともなった。
lines.translated: And that "song" also became a symbol of "hope" for the talentless children, a "song" passed down and sung for a long time to come.

lines.content: 地下牢に閉じ込められ、愛する大人たちに見放されても尚、子ども達は懸命に歌を歌った。
lines.translated: Even locked away in the dungeon and abandoned by the adults they loved, the children sang that song with all their might.

lines.content: ……絵を描いた。
lines.translated: They drew pictures.

lines.content: ……物語を書き記した。
lines.translated: They wrote down stories.

lines.content: いつかきっと振り向いてもらえると信じてた。
lines.translated: They believed that someday, surely, the adults would turn around and look at them.

lines.content: 愛する人たちに微笑みかけてほしい。抱きしめてもらいたい。その“想い”が無能を越えることを祈ってた。
lines.translated: They wanted the people they loved to smile at them. To hold them close. They prayed that those "feelings" would surpass their lack of talent.

lines.content: けれど、だめだ。
lines.translated: Yet, it was no use.

lines.content: ……自分たちの“想い”が愛されることはない。
lines.translated: Their "feelings" would never be loved.

lines.content: それでも、いつか。
lines.translated: Even so, someday.

lines.content: ……いつか。自分も“あの人”みたいに今を越えられるかもと“希望”を抱いた。
lines.translated: Someday. They held onto the "hope" that they, too, might be able to overcome the present, just like "that person."

lines.content: 彼らにとって創作とは、自分で自分を暗闇の底から掬い上げるための行為だった。
lines.translated: To them, creation was an act of scooping themselves up from the bottom of the darkness with their own hands.

lines.content: 『……“歌”は、すごいな。顔も名前も知らない子たちを、こうして知らない間に、勇気づけることができるなんて』
lines.translated: "...'Songs' really are amazing. To think it can encourage children whose faces and names they don't even know, all without realizing it."

lines.content: きっと[ヒーロー|彼]は知らないはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely that hero had no idea.

lines.content: 自分の残した“歌”が、多くの子たちの心をこんなにも救っているだなんて。
lines.translated: That the "song" he left behind was saving the hearts of so many children like this.

lines.content: 大人たちがそういう[・|も][・|の]を作りたいと、その人生を没頭させる理由も、少しは理解できる。
lines.translated: I could understand, at least a little, why the adults devoted their entire lives to wanting to create "something" like that.

lines.content: ……俺にはそういう[もの|作品]を作るための“才能”はない。
lines.translated: I don't have the "talent" to create works like that.

lines.content: だから俺は、俺だけの“歌”を歌うみたいに生きたいと、願った――どういうふうに考え、どういうふうに生きるのか。
lines.translated: So I wished to live my life as if I were singing a "song" of my very own--thinking about how I should think, and how I should live.

lines.content: それ次第であの“歌”のように、誰かに“勇気”を与えられるはず。
lines.translated: Depending on that, I should be able to give someone "courage," just like that "song" did.

lines.content: “半透明”のひとがそう話して聞かせてくれていたから。
lines.translated: Because that's what the "translucent" person had told me.

lines.content: 『そのために、できることは……』
lines.translated: "And what I can do for that sake is..."

lines.content: “死”が見える。そして“夜”と“現実”とを繋ぐことができる――それが俺の“[呪い|力]”だ。
lines.translated: I can see "death." And I can connect the "Night" with "reality"--that is my "power."

lines.content: 地下牢の中で衰弱しきって亡くなり、ひとり、またひとりと子ども達が“夜”へと旅立っていく中で……。
lines.translated: As the children wasted away and died inside the underground dungeon, setting off on a journey to the "Night" one by one...

lines.content: その子の“想い”を、彼らにとって大切な人へと届けることだ。
lines.translated: What I could do was deliver a child's "feelings" to the people precious to them.

lines.content: 『俺の持ってる“[力|呪い]”じゃあ、それくらいのことしかできなくて……』
lines.translated: "With the 'curse' I have, that's about all I can do..."

lines.content: でも、俺から、子ども達の“想い”を受け取った大人は――その子のお父さんは、お母さんは、誰もがまったく無関心だった。
lines.translated: However, the adults who received the children's "feelings" from me--their fathers, their mothers--were all completely indifferent.

lines.content: 俺が地下牢へ出入りしていることを咎めようとさえしなかった。本当に、心から、俺たちに興味がないのだ。
lines.translated: They didn't even try to scold me for going in and out of the underground dungeon. From the bottom of their hearts, they truly had no interest in us.

lines.content: その様子はまるで、私たちの期待どおりに産まれてこなかった[・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|の][・|責][・|任][・|だ]と言わんばかりに、俺には見えた。
lines.translated: To me, their attitude looked as if they were practically saying, "It's your own fault for not being born the way we expected."

lines.content: この家の大人たちには心がない。
lines.translated: The adults in this house have no hearts.

lines.content: ……もしくは心をとっくの昔に壊してしまった。
lines.translated: Or else they broke their hearts a long, long time ago.

lines.content: それは、“夜”の底に眠り続ける子らの“呪い”故だったと俺が知るのは、まだまだ先のことだけど……。
lines.translated: It wouldn't be until much, much later that I learned this was due to the "curse" of the children who continued to sleep at the bottom of the "Night," though...

lines.content: 黒色の子どもたちが大人たちを憎み、呪った結果、また自分たちと同じような境遇の子を数多く産んでしまってる。
lines.translated: As a result of the pitch-black children hating and cursing the adults, they ended up creating many more children in the exact same circumstances as themselves.

lines.content: その矛盾や理不尽さに俺が本当の意味で気づくのもまだ、まだまだ先のことだった。
lines.translated: It wouldn't be until much, much later that I truly realized the contradiction and absurdity of that, either.

lines.content: そして大人たちが“夜の国”を維持させようと考えたきっかけは、心を壊してしまった自分たちの魔の手から、子ども達を護ろうとしていたからだ。
lines.translated: And the reason the adults sought to maintain the "Realm of the Night" in the first place was to protect the children from their own malicious hands after their hearts had broken.

lines.content: 大人たちが、それぞれがそれぞれの“才能”でうつくしい作品を作ることに拘るのも、[・|本][・|来][・|は]、子ども達が生きていく世界をいっぱいの光りでに彩りたかったからだ。
lines.translated: The reason the adults were so obsessed with using their respective "talents" to create beautiful works was, originally, because they wanted to color the world the children would live in with an abundance of light.

lines.content: ……壊れてしまった心では、もはやそれを思い出すことさえも叶わないけれど。
lines.translated: Though with their broken hearts, they could no longer even remember that.

lines.content: そうした大人たちの[・|壊][・|れ][・|る][・|前][・|の][・|想][・|い]を、俺がましろから教えられるのもまだ、まだまだ……先のことだった。
lines.translated: It wouldn't be until much, much... later that Mashiro would teach me about the feelings those adults had before they broke.

lines.content: ただ、このときの俺にはどうしようもない悔しさと、さみしさだけが残っていた。
lines.translated: At the time, however, all that remained in me was a helpless frustration and loneliness.

lines.content: 『……会いたい』
lines.translated: "...I want to see her."

lines.content: その気持ちが強くなりはじめたのも、この頃だ――地下牢の子どもたちのさみしい想いを運ぶ度、俺は、俺だけは、ひとりぼっちじゃなかったんだと改めて強く理解できたから。
lines.translated: It was also around this time that those feelings began to grow stronger--because every time I carried the lonely feelings of the children in the dungeon, I was reminded all over again that I, and I alone, had never been truly alone.

lines.content: 『……赤ん坊だったあの頃は、まだ君の姿が見えるだけだった。“半透明”の女の子の笑顔だけが見えていた。でも今は……たぶん、君の声も俺に届くよ』
lines.translated: "...Back when I was a baby, I could only see your figure. I could only see the smiling face of a 'translucent' girl. But now... I think your voice would reach me, too."

lines.content: 『今、こうして[・|君]の声がちゃんと聞こえるみたいにね』
lines.translated: "Just like I can clearly hear your voice right now."
"Yeah..."

lines.content: 今“隣”にいてくれる“半透明”の子が、俺のつぶやきに微笑みを浮かべてくれていた。
lines.translated: The "translucent" girl currently "beside" me offered a smile at my murmuring.

lines.content: 『あなたががんばろうってしてること、私たちの“女王”さまにもちゃんと届くよ。いっぱい、たくさん、褒めてくれるって思うな』
lines.translated: "The fact that you're trying to do your best will definitely reach our 'Queen,' too. I think she'll praise you lots and lots."

lines.content: だからがんばれと言ってくれた。私も、あなたをいっぱい応援してるよと。
lines.translated: So keep doing your best, she told me. Saying that she was cheering for me a whole lot, too.

lines.content: さみしい“想い”をしているひとの気持ちを、できるだけ多くの人へ伝えること。
lines.translated: Conveying the feelings of those harboring lonely "thoughts" to as many people as possible.

lines.content: ……この生き方は[・|あ][・|の][・|人]の“歌”みたいに、顔も知らない誰かを勇気づけることができるだろうか。暗闇の底で悲しみに暮れる誰かに、光りをあげられるものになるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would this way of life be able to encourage someone whose face I didn't even know, just like that person's "song"? Would it become something capable of giving light to someone grieving at the bottom of the darkness?

lines.content: 天国のような自室と、地獄のような地下牢とを行き来する日々だった。
lines.translated: My days were spent going back and forth between my bedroom, which was like heaven, and the underground dungeon, which was like hell.

lines.content: ……ひとり。また、ひとりと力尽き、減っていく。
lines.translated: One by one, their strength gave out, and their numbers dwindled.

lines.content: 彼らを救うヒーローどころか、彼らを[さら|攫]う“夜の怪物”さえ現れない。
lines.translated: Let alone a hero to save them, not even a "monster of the Night" to spirit them away ever appeared.
Even so, someday...

lines.content: 彼らと一緒に俺も祈ってた。いつか救いが訪れますように。いつか、報われますように。
lines.translated: Together with them, I prayed too. That salvation would visit them someday. That they would be rewarded someday.

lines.content: そんなある日だ。
lines.translated: It happened on one such day.

lines.content: 俺は、とある大人にふと声を掛けられた。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, a certain adult called out to me.
--I want you to kill the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: 突然そう願われたのだ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, that wish was thrust upon me.

lines.content: ――あなたの持って生まれた“[呪い|才能]”ならそれができるはず。
lines.translated: --With the "talent" you were born with, you should be able to do it.

lines.content: 俺の手をキツく握りしめ、苦々しく言うと……。
lines.translated: Gripping my hand tightly, she spoke with bitterness...

lines.content: “拳銃”だ。
lines.translated: It was a "handgun."

lines.content: その大人の[・|女][・|の][・|人]は、俺の手に一挺の“拳銃”を握らせた。
lines.translated: That adult woman pressed a single "handgun" into my hand.

lines.content: ――今はまだ、平気だ。平静を保っていられる。他の大人たちのしていることが異常だと、わかる。
lines.translated: --Right now, I'm still fine. I can keep my composure. I can tell that what the other adults are doing is abnormal.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ――でもこのままだと私もいつか、他の大人たち同様に心を壊してしまう。日々その実感から逃れられない。完全にそんな自分になってしまうことが、怖い。
lines.translated: --But if things continue like this, someday my heart will break just like the other adults. Every day, I cannot escape that realization. I'm terrified of completely becoming like that myself.

lines.content: 女の人は言った。すべては“夜の国”なんて場所があるせいだ、と。
lines.translated: The woman spoke. She said it was all because a place like the "Realm of the Night" existed.

lines.content: ――“夜”の中から漆黒色の“[想像力|呪い]”がじわりとこぼれ、日々、私たちの心を蝕んでいる。
lines.translated: --A pitch-black "curse" is slowly seeping out from within the "Night," eroding our hearts day by day.

lines.content: ――いつか私も子ども達に、もっともっとひどいことをしてしまう。他の大人たちと同じように心を壊す。
lines.translated: --Someday, I too will do even more terrible things to the children. My heart will break just like the other adults.

lines.content: ――そうなる前に“夜の女王”を殺してほしい。
lines.translated: --Before that happens, I want you to kill the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: ――そして“夜”にかけられた“鍵”が解かれたならば……“夜”に侵入し、そこから流れ出る黒い意思を食い止めたい。
lines.translated: --And once the "lock" placed upon the "Night" is undone... we want to invade the "Night" and put a stop to the black will flowing out from it.

lines.content: ――……この手で愛する者をくびり殺してしまう。そんな未来だけは回避したいんだ。
lines.translated: --...Strangling the ones I love to death with my own two hands. That is the one future I want to avoid at all costs.

lines.content: 繰り返し、繰り返し、そう願われた。
lines.translated: Over and over, she begged that of me.

lines.content: “夜の国”は子ども達の避難場所でもある。
lines.translated: The "Realm of the Night" is also a place of refuge for the children.

lines.content: そこに“鍵”をされてしまえば、今、つらい子たちも――この先つらい思いをさせられる子たちもすべて、“夜”に、“夢”の中に逃避さえもできなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: If it were to be "locked" away, both the children suffering right now--and all the children who would be made to suffer in the future-- wouldn't even be able to escape into the "Night," into "dreams," anymore.

lines.content: だから“夜”と“現実”とを繋ぐ俺の“[呪い|力]”に頼りたい。
lines.translated: That was why she wanted to rely on my "power" to connect the "Night" with "reality."

lines.content: その力を持つ俺ならば、閉じられた“夜”の中へと這入ることもできるだろうから、と。
lines.translated: Because with that power, I would surely be able to slip inside the closed-off "Night."

lines.content: 『……その人は俺に、“夜の女王”を何とか“夜”の外へ連れ出せというんだ』
lines.translated: "...That person told me to somehow lure the 'Queen of the Night' outside of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 部屋の窓から満月を見上げながら、“半透明”の子にまるで愚痴るようにして俺はこぼした。
lines.translated: Looking up at the full moon from my bedroom window, I spilled the words out to the "translucent" girl as if venting my frustrations.

lines.content: そんな俺の“隣”で、“半透明”の子はただ静かに愚痴を、不安を、聞いてくれていた。
lines.translated: Right "beside" me, the "translucent" girl simply listened quietly to my complaints and anxieties.

lines.content: 『……この町の――“参禅町”の中心にある時計塔。その“夜”のどこかにあの子はいるらしい。だから、時計塔により近づけば近づくほど、“夜の国”へ這入りやすくなる』
lines.translated: "...The clock tower at the center of this town--of 'Sanzen Town.' Apparently, that girl is somewhere within its 'Night.' So the closer I get to the clock tower, the easier it will be to enter the 'Realm of the Night.'"

lines.content: だから明日の夜、屋敷の鍵を開けておくと、女の人はそう言った。他の大人たちに気づかれずこっそり屋敷を抜け出しなさいと。
lines.translated: That was why the woman told me she would leave the mansion unlocked tomorrow night. She told me to sneak out of the mansion secretly without the other adults noticing.

lines.content: 『渡されたこの“拳銃”は、大人たちが必死に創り上げた“作品”のひとつらしい。もちろん本物じゃない。弾薬もただの鋼鉄の固まりだけど……』
lines.translated: "This 'handgun' she handed me is apparently one of the 'works' the adults desperately created. Of course, it's not a real gun. And the ammunition is just a lump of steel, too, but..."

lines.content: そこには大人たちの心に残された、ありったけの“想像力”が込められている――“夜”に属する“イキモノ”を撃ち抜き、殺害することが可能ということだった。
lines.translated: Every last bit of "imagination" left in the adults' hearts had been poured into it--meaning it was capable of shooting through and killing a "Creature" belonging to the "Night."

lines.content: 『でもこの“拳銃”は“夜”の中に持ち込むことはできない。俺の“才能”があろうとも、“夢”に[・|肉][・|体][・|を][・|持][・|ち][・|込][・|め][・|な][・|い]ように、“外の世界”の所有物も同様だ。持ち込むことは、できない』
lines.translated: "But this 'handgun' can't be brought inside the 'Night.' Even with my 'talent,' just as you can't bring your physical body into a 'dream,' the same goes for possessions from the 'outside world.' They cannot be brought in."

lines.content: だから“夜の女王”を何とか[・|騙][・|し]、“夜”の外へ連れ出せと言うんだ。
lines.translated: So she told me to somehow deceive the "Queen of the Night" and lure her outside the "Night."

lines.content: 『そして、女王を“夜の外”へ連れ出したその先で、引き金を引けと――いいや、引いてくださいと、あの大人の女の人は、俺に言うんだ』
lines.translated: "And once I've taken the Queen 'outside the Night,' that adult woman told me to pull the trigger--no, she begged me to please pull it."

lines.content: 女の人はまだやさしい心を忘れず壊さず、持っているように最初は思った。
lines.translated: At first, I thought the woman had still remembered her kind heart and kept it unbroken.

lines.content: ……俺に土下座までして願ったのだ。
lines.translated: She had even gotten down on her knees and bowed her head to the ground to beg me.

lines.content: どうか私に、小さく愛しいもの達を傷つけさせないでほしいと――泣いて。泣いて。鼻水までこぼし、小さな俺を相手に懇願していた。
lines.translated: Crying and pleading with me not to let her hurt the small, precious ones she loved. Crying, with snot running down her face, she had begged a little kid like me.

lines.content: 愛しいもの達を殺したくない。そんな自分に、いつの間にか変わってしまうのが、怖い。
lines.translated: She didn't want to kill the ones she loved. She was terrified of turning into someone like that before she knew it.

lines.content: 『……そのために、大雅。あなたに“夜の女王”を傷つけさせるの？』
lines.translated: "...And for that sake, Taiga, she's going to make you hurt the 'Queen of the Night'?"

lines.content: 『そうだね……』
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: どころか殺せとまで願ってる。
lines.translated: Not only hurt her, she's wishing for me to kill her.

lines.content: 『それは、ねえ。……大雅。その大人の人は、本当にやさしい気持ちが壊れていないの？』
lines.translated: "Well, you know... Taiga. Are that adult's kind feelings really not broken?"

lines.content: やさしい人のように見えたのは、その心をまだ壊されずにいるのかなと思えたのは、そうだね。うん。君の言うとおり。最初だけだったよ。
lines.translated: Thinking she looked like a kind person, wondering if her heart might still be unbroken--yeah. You're right. It was just as you said. That was only at first.

lines.content: この家の大人は、一見やさしかろうとそうでなかろうと、同じだ。結局は自分の“罪悪感”を晴らすことしか考えていない。そう感じた。
lines.translated: Whether they seem kind at a glance or not, the adults in this house are all the same. In the end, all they care about is clearing away their own "guilt." That was how it felt to me.

lines.content: 最初は相手にするつもりはなかった。
lines.translated: At first, I had no intention of going along with her.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 『……ヒーローを、探し出せるかもしれない。そして地下牢で苦しむ子らを救い出してもらえるかも』
lines.translated: "...I might be able to track down the hero. And maybe get them to rescue the children suffering in the underground dungeon."

lines.content: この家の子ども達が探し求めるヒーローの手がかりは、ここ、“参禅町”にあると聞かされた。
lines.translated: I was told that a clue to the hero the children of this house were searching for lay right here in "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: やさしく見えた大人の女の人から、その情報を与えられたのだ。俺に願いを託すことの報酬のつもりだったのだろう。
lines.translated: That information had been given to me by the seemingly kind adult woman. She probably intended it as a reward for entrusting me with her wish.

lines.content: ……殺してほしいと願われた“夜の女王”もその町にいる。その町の“夜”にいる。
lines.translated: The "Queen of the Night" she begged me to kill is also in that town. Inside that town's "Night."

lines.content: どうするべきか悩んだ。たくさん、悩んだ。
lines.translated: I agonized over what I should do. I agonized a whole lot.

lines.content: 『まず、“夜の女王”だ……』
lines.translated: "First, the 'Queen of the Night'..."

lines.content: 大人たちの言う[・|そ][・|れ]と、俺のそばにいてくれる“半透明”たちの言う[・|そ][・|れ]は、おそらくは同一だ――そしておそらく、[・|そ][・|れ]は、あの子だ。
lines.translated: What the adults refer to as "that," and what the "translucent" ones who stay by my side refer to as "that," are most likely one and the same--and most likely, "that" is her.

lines.content: 一番最初に俺の“隣”で微笑んでくれていた女の子。
lines.translated: The girl who had smiled "beside" me at the very beginning.

lines.content: ……一番最初に、俺に、いっぱいの安心を届けてくれたひと。
lines.translated: The person who, at the very beginning, had given me so much peace of mind.

lines.content: そばにいなくなっても尚、“夜”の中から“半透明”のやさしいひとたちにお願いし、こうして俺がひとりにならなくてすむようにしてくれている。
lines.translated: Even after she was no longer by my side, she asked the kind "translucent" people from within the "Night" to stay with me like this so I wouldn't have to be alone.

lines.content: 『……会いたい』
lines.translated: "...I want to see her."

lines.content: 日々、一秒一秒、その思いばかりが強くなっていった。
lines.translated: Day by day, second by second, that feeling only grew stronger.

lines.content: 『もう一度、あのひとと会って……』
lines.translated: "To meet that person once more..."

lines.content: 赤ん坊だったあのときはその姿しか、笑顔だけしか、俺には届かなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: Back when I was a baby, only her figure, only her smile, could reach me, but...

lines.content: 『今度はたぶん、もっと近くにあのひとのことを感じられる。そんな気がするんだ』
lines.translated: "This time, I think I'll be able to feel her much closer. I have a feeling I will."

lines.content: その手を握ることは叶わずとも、話をすることくらいならば叶うはず――ずっとそばにいてくれてありがとう。
lines.translated: Even if I couldn't hold her hand, I should at least be able to talk to her--Thank you for always staying by my side.

lines.content: そばにいないときも、俺のことを気にしてくれて、ありがとう。
lines.translated: And thank you for caring about me even when you aren't here.

lines.content: そういうふうに伝えることくらいはきっと、叶えられるはずだから……。
lines.translated: Surely, I would at least be able to convey that much to her...

lines.content: 『もう一度だけでいい。……あのひとに、会いたい』
lines.translated: "Just one more time is enough. ...I want to see her."

lines.content: “隣”にいてくれる“半透明”の子が、ふと、俺と手を繋ごうとしてくれた。でも、伸ばしたその手は通り抜けてしまう。
lines.translated: The "translucent" girl staying "beside" me suddenly tried to hold my hand. However, her outstretched hand passed right through mine.

lines.content: さみしそうな顔をする小さな子。
lines.translated: The little girl wore a lonely expression.

lines.content: 今、あの子ならどんなふうにして、このさみしさを笑顔に変えようとするのだろうか。
lines.translated: Right now, if it were her, how would she try to turn this loneliness into a smile?

lines.content: 本当のやさしさは“半透明”のあの子だけが持っている。そう思えた。
lines.translated: It felt to me as though that "translucent" girl was the only one who possessed true kindness.

lines.content: いつしか会いたいは逢いたいに変わっていった。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, simply wanting to see her had turned into a deep longing to meet her.

lines.content: その思いも、想いに変わった。
lines.translated: And those thoughts had deepened into genuine feelings for her.

lines.content: けれどその正体を明確に紐解けるほど俺は[・|大][・|人]じゃない。
lines.translated: Yet I wasn't adult enough to clearly unravel the true nature of what I was feeling.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: あの子のことを、俺は“お母さんみたいだ”と言ったことがある。
lines.translated: I had once called her "like a mother" to me.

lines.content: 『うん。そうだね。お母さん、か。そう言ってあげたら、あの子は……まっしろな“夜の女王”は、よろこんでくれるはずだよ。心からね』
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. A mother, huh? If you told her that, that girl... the pure white 'Queen of the Night' would surely be overjoyed. From the bottom of her heart."

lines.content: そのとき“隣”にいてくれた“半透明”な小さな子から、そんな言葉をもらっていたけれど……。
lines.translated: The "translucent" little girl staying "beside" me at the time had passed those words along to me, though...

lines.content: 『……お母さん、か』
lines.translated: "...A mother, huh?"

lines.content: どうしてだろう。そうつぶやくと、胸の奥がもやもやとした。
lines.translated: I wonder why. Murmuring that left a restless, hazy feeling deep in my chest.

lines.content: 俺はあの子のことをどう思っているんだろう。
lines.translated: How do I really feel about her?

lines.content: どういう関係でありたいと、願っているんだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of relationship do I wish to have with her?

lines.content: あのひとの笑顔を思い出す。すると胸を突き刺すような痛みはなんだ。
lines.translated: I remember her smile. And when I do, what is this sharp pain piercing through my chest?

lines.content: この気持ちを確かめに行きたかった。あのひとに今すぐ逢いに、行きたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to go and confirm these feelings for myself. I wanted to go and meet her right this instant.

lines.content: 『そして、ヒーローだ……』
lines.translated: "And then there's the hero..."

lines.content: ずっと、[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]のことを救ってくれるヒーローを、その居場所を探し求めてた。あの家に産まれた子らは誰もがそうだ。
lines.translated: For so long, we had been searching for the hero who would save us, looking for where they might be. Every single child born in that house felt the same.

lines.content: ……この俺にしたところで、持って生まれてしまった“[呪い|才能]”が無価値とわかれば、とたん、他の子と同様に地獄へ沈められてしまうはず。今はその利用価値を探られているに過ぎない。
lines.translated: Even in my case, the moment this "talent"--this curse--I was born with is deemed worthless, I'll immediately be sunk into hell just like the other kids. Right now, they're merely probing to see how useful I can be.

lines.content: だけどいつまで待っても、祈っても、誰も救いの手を差し伸べてはくれなくて……。
lines.translated: Yet no matter how long we waited or how much we prayed, no one ever reached out a helping hand...

lines.content: やさしい顔で俺に“夜の女王”を殺してほしいと願った女の人からもらった、ヒーローの手がかりだ。
lines.translated: The clue to the hero had come from that woman who wore a gentle face as she begged me to kill the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: でも[・|そ][・|れ]は、俺にとってあんまりに衝撃的すぎる情報だった。
lines.translated: However, that information had been far too shocking for me to take in.

lines.content: 俺たちの[ヒーロー|英雄]が。
lines.translated: That our hero...

lines.content: 俺たちの心をいつも勇気づけてくれた春の“歌”
lines.translated: The "hope" we idolized, who had composed...

lines.content: それを作った“[憧れ|希望]”が……。
lines.translated: that spring "song" which always gave courage to our hearts...
"To think that he was actually my father..."
She said she didn't even know when this "song" had been written.

lines.content: だけど俺たちが口ずんでいた“歌”を作ったのは、確かに俺の父親であることだけは確かだと、女の人はさらりと俺に告げたのだった。
lines.translated: However, the woman casually informed me of one certainty: the person who composed the "song" we were always humming was unmistakably my father.
I remember a quiet heat rising in my chest.

lines.content: 俺が訴えればヒーローは……父さんは、きっと俺たちを助けに駆けつけてくれると信じた。
lines.translated: I believed that if I appealed to him, our hero... my dad would surely come rushing to save us.

lines.content: 『きっと俺たちのヒーローは……、父さんは、苦しんでいる子ども達の存在に気づけていないだけなんだ』
lines.translated: "Our hero... My dad surely just hasn't noticed that there are children suffering like this."

lines.content: ならばこちらから迎えに行こう。
lines.translated: If so, I'll go out to meet him myself.

lines.content: 彼らの悲しみを目の当たりにしたなら、必ず、誰より確かな味方でいてくれるはずだと信じたい。
lines.translated: I want to believe that once he sees their sorrow with his own eyes, he will without fail become a more reliable ally to us than anyone else.

lines.content: あんなにもうつくしい“愛”と“勇気”の“歌”をつむぐ人なのだ。瞬く間に彼らを地獄の底から救い出そうと全力で挑んでくれるはず。
lines.translated: He is the person who wove such a beautiful "song" of "love" and "courage." He would surely give his all to rescue them from the depths of hell in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: 『……そして“[あのひと|夜の女王]”のことも、一緒に救ってもらいたい』
lines.translated: "...And I want him to save her--the 'Queen of the Night'--along with them."

lines.content: そうすればまた、“[あのひと|夜の女王]”は、俺の“隣”にいてくれるようになるだろうか。
lines.translated: If he does, will she--the "Queen of the Night"--come to stay "beside" me once again?

lines.content: 根拠などなにもないけれど、そんな期待が胸を過ぎってしまったから……。
lines.translated: I had no basis for thinking so, yet that hope had crossed my mind...

lines.content: だから俺は、いっぱいの“希望”と“不安”とを胸に、この屋敷を抜け出すと決意した。
lines.translated: And so, with my chest full of both "hope" and "anxiety," I resolved to sneak out of this mansion.

lines.content: 『……気をつけて』
lines.translated: "...Be careful."

lines.content: “半透明”の小さな子が言った。
lines.translated: The "translucent" little girl spoke.

lines.content: たぶん意地悪な大人たちは、俺が“夜”の外へ“夜の女王”を連れ出した瞬間を狙ってる。
lines.translated: The mean adults are probably aiming for the exact moment I lead the "Queen of the Night" outside the "Night."

lines.content: 『もしあなたが“女王”さまを殺せなかったそのときは……』
lines.translated: "If you aren't able to kill the 'Queen' when the time comes..."

lines.content: どこかで見ているのだろう大人たちが、俺の代わりに引き金を引くのだろうか――
lines.translated: Will the adults watching from somewhere pull the trigger in my place--?

lines.content: “女王”の姿は見えずとも、俺が“夜”の外から出しさえすれば、大人たちには何か勝算のようなものがあるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Even if they can't see the "Queen," as long as I bring her out of the "Night," do the adults have some kind of plan to ensure victory?

lines.content: 『……私たち“夜のイキモノ”の中には、“外の世界”で大人たちに力を貸すひと達もいるの。そのひと達は“女王”さまを殺してしまって、“夜”と“外”を繋ぎたいって思ってる』
lines.translated: "...Among us 'Creatures of the Night,' there are some who lend their power to the adults in the 'outside world.' Those people want to kill the 'Queen' and connect the 'Night' with the 'outside.'"

lines.content: 大人たちが“夜”に憧れを抱くように、ごくごく一部の“夜のイキモノ”は、“外”へ憧れを抱くのだ。
lines.translated: Just as the adults harbor a longing for the "Night," a very small fraction of the "Creatures of the Night" harbor a longing for the "outside."

lines.content: 『そんなひと達から隠れるために、“女王”さまは時計塔の管理室に閉じこもってる』
lines.translated: "In order to hide from those people, the 'Queen' has shut herself away in the clock tower's control room."

lines.content: 『……気をつけて。怖い人も、乱暴なひとも、きっとね……あなたが“女王”さまを見つけるのを待っているから』
lines.translated: "...Be careful. Scary people and violent people are surely... waiting for you to find the 'Queen.'"

lines.content: 誰もがあの子の命を狙ってる。
lines.translated: Everyone is after her life.

lines.content: ……護らないと。
lines.translated: I have to protect her.

lines.content: “[あの子|夜の女王]”も、ふたつの世界も――未来も全部。
lines.translated: Her--the "Queen of the Night"--both worlds, and the future... all of it.

lines.content: そして、たくさんの子ども達の心も全部。全部だ。
lines.translated: And the hearts of all those many children, too. Every last one of them.

lines.content: 俺は、手渡された“拳銃”に触れ、祈った。
lines.translated: I touched the "handgun" I had been handed and prayed.

lines.content: 『……どうか、お願いします。神さまでも、悪魔でも、誰だってなんだって、いいんだ』
lines.translated: "...Please, I'm begging you. God, the devil, anyone or anything at all, I don't care who."

lines.content: 俺に、この[問題|物語]を乗り越えていけるだけの力を、知恵を。
lines.translated: Grant me the strength and the wisdom to overcome this story--this problem.

lines.content: そしていっぱいの“勇気”を、貸してください。
lines.translated: And please, lend me plenty of "courage."
It's a "song."

lines.content: はらはらと舞い踊る春の花を見上げるように、想いほころぶ――“愛”と“勇気”の愛しい“歌”が、俺の中に静かに、だけど確かに流れはじめていた。
lines.translated: As if looking up at spring blossoms fluttering and dancing through the air, my feelings began to bloom--the beloved "song" of "love" and "courage" had begun to flow quietly, yet unmistakably, within me.

lines.content: 待ち合わせた時計塔まであと少しだ。
lines.translated: Just a little further to the clock tower where we promised to meet.

lines.content: 気づけば“歌”を口ずさんでいる。そうして少し、この町へやって来るまでのことを考えてもいた。
lines.translated: Before I realized it, I was humming the "song." And as I did, I thought back a little on everything that had led up to my coming to this town.

lines.content: 俺は、ヒーローを探してた。
lines.translated: I had been looking for a hero.

lines.content: あのひとの笑顔を求めてた。
lines.translated: I had been seeking her smile.

lines.content: あのひとがどういう“想い”を持って、俺の“隣”にいてくれたのかを知りたかった。
lines.translated: I had wanted to know what kind of "feelings" she held in her heart when she stayed "beside" me.
Whatever the answer might be, I had wanted to grow up and become an adult as quickly as possible.

lines.content: 俺には……。
lines.translated: Because I have...
Because I have someone I want to save.

lines.content: あのひとの“隣”に並び立つに相応しい自分になりたかった――それは、つまり、あのひとを護れる自分になることだ。そう信じてる
lines.translated: "I wanted to become someone worthy of standing 'beside' her--which, in other words, means becoming someone capable of protecting her. That's what I believe."

lines.content: 俺は今、“半透明”のひと達の代わりに、あたらしく“隣”にいてくれる相棒に、友人に、そして家族に向かって、少し語った。
lines.translated: Right now, I spoke a little of this to the partner, friend, and family member who was newly staying "beside" me in place of the "translucent" people.

lines.content: ……これから続いていく短くもない一生を、ましろとただいっぱい話して、いっぱい笑って、暮らしていきたいんだ
lines.translated: "...For the rest of this long life ahead of us, I just want to live it talking a lot and laughing a lot with Mashiro."

lines.content: そんな夢のような時間を一秒でも多く生きていたいと願うから――俺は、君を意地悪な大人たちから護りたい。
lines.translated: Because I wish to live in that dreamlike time for even a single second longer--I want to protect you from the mean adults.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 探し求めた救いの主は存在しなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: The savior I had searched for didn't exist, though...

lines.content: ヒーローがいないなら、自分が理想のヒーローになればいい
lines.translated: "If there is no hero, then I just have to become my own ideal hero."

lines.content: ……誰もがあの子の命を狙ってる。
lines.translated: Everyone is after her life.

lines.content: “夜”の鍵を解いてからもやはり、油断はできないと感じてた。
lines.translated: Even after unlocking the "Night," I still felt that I couldn't let my guard down.

lines.content: 外の世界に連れ出すことは、危険きわまりないことなのかもしれない。だけどましろがこれ以上、たったひとり“夜”の中で悪夢にうなされ続けるのは放っておけない。
lines.translated: Taking her out into the outside world might be an extremely dangerous thing to do. Even so, I can't just leave Mashiro all alone inside the "Night" to keep suffering through nightmares any longer.

lines.content: ならば俺がずっとあの子のそばにいて、護り続けられるような自分になればいい。
lines.translated: If so, I just need to stay by her side forever and become someone who can keep protecting her.

lines.content: ……自分の“物語”を救うことができるのは自分自身だけなんだと、いつだったかな、“半透明”のひとが教えてくれたんだ
lines.translated: "...The only one who can save your own 'story' is yourself. I forget when it was, but one of the 'translucent' people taught me that."

lines.content: だから俺は……。
lines.translated: That's why I...

lines.content: ましろと一緒に生きていく――
lines.translated: "I'm going to live together with Mashiro--"

lines.content: 俺は、大人たちを裏切る。
lines.translated: I will betray the adults.

lines.content: ふたりで一緒に、どこかへ逃げ出す――
lines.translated: "The two of us will run away somewhere together--"

lines.content: 自分で言うのもおかしすぎる話だけれど、こんな小さな子どもがそう決めるのはそれなりに大きな“勇気”が必要で……。
lines.translated: It sounds absurd even to me as I say it, but for a little kid like me to make that decision takes a fair amount of "courage"...

lines.content: この決意と“勇気”が、何の“才能”も持たず生まれた無能な俺の、俺だけが歌える“歌”になればいい。そう願ってるんだ
lines.translated: "I hope that this resolve and 'courage' can become a 'song' that only I can sing--I, who was born talentless and without any 'gifts' at all. That's what I'm wishing for."

lines.content: もう一度、俺は空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Once again, I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: 俺はこの町にやって来て、少し、[・|大][・|人]になれたような気がしてる。
lines.translated: Since coming to this town, I feel like I've managed to become a little bit more of an adult.

lines.content: 苦しいときに期待するような都合のいいヒーローはどこにもいないと知った。ここにいるのはいつも自分、ただひとり。
lines.translated: I learned that the kind of convenient hero you hope for in times of hardship doesn't exist anywhere. The only one ever here is yourself, all alone.

lines.content: 同時に、完全なる“悪”も存在しないのだということも、俺はこの町で知った――世界は人ひとりの“才能”により語られる物語のように単純ではない。
lines.translated: At the same time, I also learned in this town that absolute "evil" doesn't exist, either--the world isn't as simple as a story told through a single person's "talent."

lines.content: 悪役がいて。ヒーローがいる。護られる人々の悲しみがある。そんなふうにわかりやすくできてはいないのだ。
lines.translated: There is a villain. There is a hero. There is the sorrow of the people being protected. The world isn't put together in such an easy-to-understand way.

lines.content: 残酷にさえ思える誰かの行為や言葉にも、その人にとっての譲れぬ“想い”が隠されている。
lines.translated: Even behind someone's seemingly cruel actions or words lies an unyielding "feeling" that they cannot compromise on.

lines.content: 誰もが自分の物語を生きることに必死なだけだ。
lines.translated: Everyone is simply desperate to live out their own story.

lines.content: だから俺たちは逃げるんだ。決して誰とも戦わないために
lines.translated: "That's why we're going to run away. So that we never have to fight anyone."

lines.content: 争えばどちらが勝っても負けても、必ず誰かが悲しむことになる。だから……どこまでも、どこまでも、逃げ続けてやるんだよ
lines.translated: "If we fight, no matter who wins or loses, someone is bound to end up grieving. So... we're going to keep running and running, no matter how far."

lines.content: ……ましろと生きていけるならどこだっていい。
lines.translated: As long as I can live with Mashiro, anywhere is fine.

lines.content: ああ、うん。そうだね。
lines.translated: Ah, yeah. That's right.

lines.content: “夜”を通って遠い“過去”の世界へ逃げてもいい
lines.translated: "We could even run away through the 'Night' into the world of the distant 'past.'"

lines.content: そして“過去”の世界で、ヒーローに……父さんに、会いたい。そんなもしもの“未来”を作ることだって、可能なはずだ
lines.translated: "And in the world of the 'past,' I want to meet our hero... my dad. Creating a 'what-if' future like that should be possible, too."

lines.content: ましろはもう“夜”には属せないけれど……。
lines.translated: Mashiro can no longer belong to the "Night," though...

lines.content: “夜”と現実とを繋ぐことのできる俺と一緒なら大丈夫。まだ少しなら“夜”に這入ることもできるだろう。
lines.translated: As long as she's with me, someone who can connect the "Night" and reality, it'll be fine. We should still be able to slip into the "Night" for a little while.

lines.content: ふたりで……いいや。三人で一緒に“過去”へ行こう。
lines.translated: Let's go to the "past" together, the two of us... no, the three of us.

lines.content: そのために作られた“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Night Country" was created for that very purpose.

lines.content: 俺たちには“[切符|歌]”がある――俺のお母さんを“過去”へ連れて行ってくれた“魔法の歌”が。
lines.translated: We have the "song"--our ticket--the "magical song" that took my mother to the "past."

lines.content: きっとましろも賛成してくれる。そんな予感があった。
lines.translated: Mashiro will surely agree to it, too. I had a feeling she would.

lines.content: この考えをましろに伝えたらどんな顔をするだろう。根拠はないのによろこんでくれると感じられた。
lines.translated: What kind of face will Mashiro make when I tell her about this idea? Even without any basis for it, I felt certain she would be happy.

lines.content: 一方的に話してごめんね。いきなりこんなこと言われても、君だって困ると思う
lines.translated: "Sorry for doing all the talking on my own. Having all this sprung on you out of nowhere must be troubling for you, too."

lines.content: ……ただ、さ。君に、俺の誓いの証人になってほしかったんだ
lines.translated: "...It's just, well. I wanted you to be the witness to my vow."

lines.content: もしも俺がこの先、弱気に負けて、“勇気”を忘れてしまいそうになったとき。そっと背中を押してほしいんだよ――今日の誓いを思い出させてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "If there ever comes a time down the road when I lose to my own cowardice and feel like I'm about to forget my 'courage,' I want you to gently give me a push--to remind me of the vow I made today."

lines.content: いつまでも“隣”にいてくれるましろを、大好きなひとのことを、大人たちから護り続けて生きていく。“夜”の施錠は解かれても、油断はできない。必ず俺がましろを護り続ける。
lines.translated: I will live on, continuing to protect Mashiro, who will always stay "beside" me--the person I love so much--from the adults. Even with the "Night" unlocked, I can't let my guard down. Without fail, I will keep protecting Mashiro.

lines.content: この気持ちを、いつか大人になった俺に、思い出させてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted my future, grown-up self to be reminded of this feeling someday.

lines.content: 人は忘れることで生きていけるっていうけれど……大切な気持ちまで簡単に忘れ去ってしまうものだから
lines.translated: "They say people are able to go on living by forgetting... and because of that, we end up easily forgetting even our most precious feelings."

lines.content: ……行こうか
lines.translated: "...Shall we go?"

lines.content: もう誓いも懺悔も充分だ。
lines.translated: I've done plenty of vowing and confessing now.

lines.content: あの時計塔に、俺たちの新しい友人が、相棒が……、家族が、待ってるよ
lines.translated: "In that clock tower, our new friend, our partner... our family, is waiting for us."

lines.content: 今は前に進みたい。
lines.translated: Right now, I want to move forward.

lines.content: 大切なひと達と一緒に、ただただ、ひとつでも多く明日を重ねていこうと思う。
lines.translated: Together with the people precious to me, I just want to keep piling up as many tomorrows as we possibly can.

lines.content: 俺たちの歩む未来に、想像以上のきらめきが待っていますようにと祈りを込めて……。
lines.translated: Offering a prayer that a brilliance beyond our wildest imaginations awaits us in the future we walk toward...

lines.content: 足早に、進んだ。
lines.translated: I quickened my pace and pressed on.

lines.content: ましろが待ってる時計塔はもうすぐそこだ。
lines.translated: The clock tower where Mashiro is waiting is just up ahead.

lines.content: ずきりと、した。
lines.translated: There was a sharp throb.

lines.content: 熱い。
lines.translated: It's hot.

lines.content: 胸に湧いた“勇気”の温度より、ずっとずっと、熱い何かが、突然お腹を突き刺し――……痛かった。
lines.translated: Something much, much hotter than the warmth of the "courage" welling in my chest suddenly pierced through my stomach--...and it hurt.

lines.content: 目を覚ますと[・|私]は“夜の外”にいた。
lines.translated: When I woke up, I was "outside the Night."

lines.content: 誰もいない。ひとりぼっちの部屋だった。
lines.translated: Nobody was there. I was all alone in the room.

lines.content: 時計塔の管理室。
lines.translated: The clock tower's office.

lines.content: この部屋は“夜”も“外”も、あまり代わりはしなかった。
lines.translated: Whether in the "Night" or "outside," this room didn't change much.

lines.content: 違いがあるとすれば蓄音機が見当たらない。だからもう“歌”を聴くことはできない。ただそれだけの変化だ。
lines.translated: If there was any difference, it was that the gramophone was nowhere to be seen. Which meant I could no longer listen to the "song." That was the only change.

lines.content: そして、あの子と……。
lines.translated: And the hand that had been holding...

lines.content: 大雅と繋いでいた手は、空っぽだった。
lines.translated: The hand that had been holding Taiga's was empty.

lines.content: 一瞬、いつも感じていたもの以上のさみしさが胸に溢れる。
lines.translated: For a moment, a loneliness even greater than what I usually felt flooded my chest.

lines.content: けれど、思い出した――
lines.translated: However, I remembered--

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ――あの子がくれた“誓い”を、私はすぐに思い出したのだ。
lines.translated: --I immediately remembered the "vow" that boy had given me.

lines.content: 私、あなたとこれからずっと、一緒にいられる……？
lines.translated: "Will I... be able to stay together with you forever from now on...?"

lines.content: つぶやいてみると、不思議だ。自然と頬が緩んでしまう。
lines.translated: Strangely enough, when I whispered the words aloud, my cheeks naturally relaxed into a smile.

lines.content: 大雅はこの手を握り、誓ってくれた。
lines.translated: Taiga had taken this hand of mine and sworn it to me.

lines.content: もうひとりぼっちになる必要はない。愛するもの達に嫌われる。……憎まれる。そんな自分になる必要も、もうない。
lines.translated: I don't need to be all alone anymore. To be disliked by the ones I love. ...To be hated by them. I don't need to become that version of myself anymore, either.

lines.content: ……あなたが、私をここから連れ出してくれる。これから一緒に、暮らしていける
lines.translated: "...You're going to take me out of here. From now on, we'll be able to live together."

lines.content: 愛するもの達から嫌われる未来より、よっぽど、幸せだよね。そんなのは比べるべくもないことだ。
lines.translated: That's so much happier than a future where I'm hated by the ones I love, isn't it? The two can't even be compared.

lines.content: 大雅の命の時間が終わるまで、私はもう“夜”に戻ることはない。
lines.translated: Until the time of Taiga's life comes to an end, I will never return to the "Night" again.

lines.content: ……そういう“呪い”を大雅が私にかけてくれた。
lines.translated: Taiga had cast that kind of "curse" upon me.

lines.content: そうすることで私たちはもう離ればなれにはなれない――それで本当にいいのかなと、少しは思う。
lines.translated: By doing so, the two of us can never be separated again--though a small part of me does wonder if that's really okay.

lines.content: 些細なことでけんかする日だってあるだろう。
lines.translated: There will probably be days when we fight over trivial things.

lines.content: 私たちは、見た目どおりまだまだ子どもだ。
lines.translated: Just as we look, we are still very much children.

lines.content: 引くに引けなくなって意地を張る――ちょっと言い過ぎてしまうこともあるかもしれない。そうして後から少し、後悔もする。そんなこともあるだろう。
lines.translated: Getting backed into a corner and acting stubborn--there might be times when we say a little too much. And then, afterward, we'll feel a bit of regret. Things like that will surely happen.

lines.content: いつか、大雅も大人になって
lines.translated: "Someday, Taiga will grow up, too."

lines.content: それでも“夜”と“現実”とを繋ぐ“特別”な大雅が、私のことを見えなくなってしまうようなことはないにしろ……。
lines.translated: Even so, while a "special" boy like Taiga, who connects the "Night" and "reality," won't ever become unable to see me...

lines.content: 常にそばにいる私の視線とかが恥ずかしいと感じることだってあるだろう。
lines.translated: There will probably be times when he feels embarrassed by my gaze, since I'll always be right beside him.

lines.content: 大雅もいつか年頃になるんだもん。それは、仕方ないよね
lines.translated: "Taiga will reach that age someday, after all. That can't be helped, right?"

lines.content: これからはあなたのお母さんじゃなくて、もっと近い関係を想像していける。あなたがそれを望んでると知ったから。
lines.translated: From now on, I can imagine a much closer relationship with you, rather than being your mother. Because I learned that's what you wish for.

lines.content: それは、私にとって望ましいことなのか。素直によろこんでもいいことなのか――今はまだ、ごめんね。やっぱりよくわからない。
lines.translated: Is that something desirable for me? Is it something I can simply be happy about? --Right now, I'm sorry. I still don't really know.

lines.content: そういう[・|曖][・|昧][・|な][・|距][・|離][・|感]だからこそ、落ち着かないことだってあるだろうはずだから。
lines.translated: Precisely because of that ambiguous sense of distance between us, there are bound to be times when we feel restless and unsettled.

lines.content: でも。そういう問題もふたりでひとつずつ丁寧に、乗り越えていけたなら……
lines.translated: "Even so. If the two of us can carefully overcome problems like that together, one by one..."

lines.content: そんな未来もまた、きっと幸せだと思えるはずだ。
lines.translated: I'm sure we'll be able to think of a future like that as a happy one, too.

lines.content: いつも笑えることよりも、けんかしたってすぐ仲直りできると信じられる関係のほうが、私は居心地がいいなと感じてしまう。
lines.translated: Rather than always being able to laugh together, I feel much more comfortable in a relationship where we can trust that we'll make up right away even if we have a fight.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: あなたの顔が早く見たいなと思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to see your face soon.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。この気持ちはなんだろう。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga. What is this feeling?

lines.content: “恋するための物語”をヒロインみたいに生きてみたい。
lines.translated: I want to try living out a "story for falling in love," just like a heroine.

lines.content: そんな恥ずかしいことを言ってみたけど、もちろん、“恋”する気持ちだなんてこれまでただの一度だって抱いたことはない。だからこそ憧れたのだ。
lines.translated: I had said something embarrassing like that, though of course, I had never once held a feeling like "love" before now. That was precisely why I longed for it.

lines.content: この気持ちについて早くあなたと話したかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to talk to you about this feeling as soon as possible.

lines.content: 不思議だけれど、あなたも今の私と同じことを不思議に感じているように思えていた。
lines.translated: It's strange, but I had a feeling you were wondering about the exact same thing I am right now.

lines.content: ……あなたの顔をもう一度、見つめられたなら
lines.translated: "...If only I could gaze at your face one more time."

lines.content: その瞬間に、この気持ちの正体もパッと理解できるはず。そう思えた。
lines.translated: In that very instant, I should be able to understand the true nature of this feeling in a flash. That's what I thought.

lines.content: ……大雅。遅いなあ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You're late."

lines.content: ちくたくちくたく。
lines.translated: Tick-tock, tick-tock.

lines.content: ……秒針の進む音だけがする。
lines.translated: The only sound is the ticking of the second hand.

lines.content: ぺったりとテーブルに突っ伏して、耳を澄ませた。
lines.translated: I slumped flat across the table and strained my ears.

lines.content: 部屋のドアがノックされる瞬間を待っている。
lines.translated: Waiting for the moment a knock sounds at the door of the room.

lines.content: それは、この部屋で永遠に見続けてきた、私の“悪夢”が終わる合図でもあるはずだ。
lines.translated: That should also be the signal that my "nightmare," which I have watched endlessly in this room, is finally coming to an end.

lines.content: ……あなたが私をここから連れ出してくれる。
lines.translated: You are going to take me out of here.

lines.content: まだまだ幼い心には“恋”することも、“愛”も“勇気”も、わからないことだらけだけれど……。
lines.translated: To my still-immature heart, falling in "love," "affection," and "courage" are still full of things I don't understand, and yet...

lines.content: ……大雅。かわいい赤ちゃんだった男の子。あなたが私の幸せだ。それだけは確かだよ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. The boy who used to be such a cute baby. You are my happiness. Of that much, I am certain."

lines.content: ……私の幸せが部屋の扉をノックする。
lines.translated: My happiness will knock on the door of this room.

lines.content: その瞬間を今かいまかと待っていた。
lines.translated: I waited eagerly for that moment to arrive at any second.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 遅い。
lines.translated: He's late.

lines.content: 本当に遅いなあ。
lines.translated: He really is taking a long time.

lines.content: あ……っ
立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood up.

lines.content: ノックの音だ。
lines.translated: The sound of a knock.

lines.content: 胸がどきっと大きく跳ねた。
lines.translated: My heart gave a huge leap.

lines.content: さっきまで“遅いなあ”と唇を尖らせていはずなのに――すぐに笑顔になれる自分がおかしかった。
lines.translated: Even though I had been pouting and thinking "He's late" just a moment ago--it was funny how quickly a smile came to my face.

lines.content: 扉に駆け寄り、ノブに手を伸ばした。
lines.translated: I rushed over to the door and reached my hand out for the knob.

lines.content: この扉の向こうには思い描いた以上の、期待以上の未来が待っている。
lines.translated: Beyond this door awaits a future greater than anything I pictured, greater than anything I hoped for.

lines.content: そんな期待を胸に、私は、扉を勢いよく明けた。
lines.translated: With that hope in my chest, I flung the door wide open.

lines.content: ……大雅！
lines.translated: "...Taiga!"
I called out his name... and then, ah, I see.
"I understand now."

lines.content: 扉を開け放った瞬間。
lines.translated: The moment I threw the door open.

lines.content: そこにいるあなたの顔を、思い描いた瞬間に。
lines.translated: The moment I pictured your face standing there.

lines.content: 曇り空が一気に晴れるみたいにして――自分の気持ちが、わかったのだ。
lines.translated: Like a cloudy sky clearing up all at once--I understood my own feelings.

lines.content: 私……私もねっ、あなたのことが
lines.translated: "I... I, too, really--"

lines.content: 大好きだって、わかったよ――飛びつこうと思った。触れられないけど。
lines.translated: --love you. I understood it now--and I wanted to leap into your arms. Even though I can't touch you.

lines.content: それでもあなたは私をしっかり抱き留めてくれる。そう思えた。
lines.translated: Even so, you would catch me and hold me tight. I was sure of it.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...
--It wasn't Taiga.

lines.content: そこにいたのは、真っ黒な子猫を抱きしめたまま立ちすくむ、見知らぬ小さな男の子だけ、だった。
lines.translated: The only one standing there was an unfamiliar little boy, frozen in place while hugging a pitch-black kitten in his arms.

lines.content: ――“夜空の月は地上に墜ちない。人類の多くを殺さない”
lines.translated: --"The moon in the night sky will not fall to the earth. It will not kill the majority of humanity."

lines.content: ……代わりに[・|そ][・|の][・|光][・|り][・|が]、人の心を漆黒色に[むしば|蝕]み殺す、か
lines.translated: "...Instead, its light will corrode people's hearts into pitch black and kill them, huh?"

lines.content: ため息みたいにそうこぼす。
lines.translated: The words spilled out of me like a sigh.

lines.content: 特に大人たちの心をめがけ、煌々と[・|そ][・|れ]は、遙か上空から降り注ぐ――遠いとおい昔、一部の大人たちの邪悪さの犠牲となった子らが、その胸に抱いた憎悪の結果だ。
lines.translated: Aiming especially for the hearts of adults, it pours down brilliantly from high up in the sky--the result of the hatred harbored in the chests of the children who fell victim to the wickedness of certain adults a long, long time ago.

lines.content: ……あつい
lines.translated: "...It's hot."
My abdomen is burning hot--I am crawling along the ground.

lines.content: そうだ。這ってでも行かないと。
lines.translated: That's right. Even if I have to crawl, I need to keep going.

lines.content: ……ましろが待ってる。
lines.translated: Mashiro is waiting.

lines.content: すれ違う人たちを無闇に傷つける通り魔事件が、この町で発生していると囁かれていた。
lines.translated: There had been whispers of phantom slasher incidents occurring in this town, someone indiscriminately hurting passersby.

lines.content: ……それはおそらく、次第次第に地上へと近づいてきているのだろう満月の光りに、“[・|誰][・|か]”が知らずその心を蝕まれ――理由なき犯行へと心が導かれてしまった結果なのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: That is likely the result of "someone" having their heart unknowingly corroded by the light of the full moon, which must be gradually drawing closer and closer to the earth--their mind guided into committing a senseless crime.

lines.content: そういう行為がエスカレートしていき、人類は自らの首をじわじわ締めていくようにして、自滅する。
lines.translated: As acts like that escalate, humanity will destroy itself, as if slowly wringing its own neck.

lines.content: それが黒色の心を持つ子らが思い描いた未来――“夜の国”からその“想像力”は少しずつ漏れ出し、現実世界へ作用しはじめている。
lines.translated: That is the future envisioned by the children with black hearts--that "imagination" is leaking out little by little from the "Night Country," beginning to act upon the real world.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]はそういう未来への一歩なのだろう。
lines.translated: This must be one step toward that kind of future.
"...I've been stabbed."

lines.content: しかし通り魔にでは、ない。
lines.translated: However, it wasn't by the phantom slasher.

lines.content: 先日、とある女の人へ、その人のことを大切に想っている死者の声を届けた。
lines.translated: The other day, I delivered the voice of a deceased man to a certain woman whom he cared for deeply.

lines.content: その女の人と婚約していた男性が通り魔に刺され死亡したのだ。しかしその男性は、悲しみにくれる女の人の隣にずっと寄り添っていた。
lines.translated: The man who had been engaged to her was stabbed to death by the phantom slasher. Yet, he remained right by her side as she drowned in grief.

lines.content: 目には見えない。触れられもしない。声も届かない――そんな“半透明”な姿でだ。
lines.translated: Invisible to the eye. Impossible to touch. Unable to make his voice heard--in that "translucent" form.

lines.content: そんなふたりの“想い”を俺が繋いだ。
lines.translated: I connected the "feelings" of those two.

lines.content: しかし、いったいどういうわけだ。数日後、その女の人まで同じ通り魔に刺殺されてしまった。
lines.translated: Yet, why on earth did this happen? A few days later, that very same woman was stabbed to death by the same phantom slasher.

lines.content: きっとそこには被害者と加害者の間に横たわる、俺には関与できない――どころか知るよしだってまったくない、何かしらの物語があったはず。
lines.translated: Surely there was some kind of story lying between the victim and the perpetrator, something I couldn't get involved in--or rather, had no way of knowing at all.

lines.content: ……俺は、その現場に居合わせただけだ。
lines.translated: I just happened to be present at the scene.

lines.content: 正確には“死”の気配を――“半透明”の気配を感じ、引き寄せられたにすぎない。ましろを狙う大人たち。その手先が現れたのかと警戒して……。
lines.translated: To be precise, I simply felt the presence of "death"--a "translucent" presence--and was drawn to it. On guard, wondering if the minions of the adults targeting Mashiro had appeared...

lines.content: 俺を刺したのはその現場にいた[・|母][・|親]だったろうと思う。婚約者に先立たれ、悲しみの底にいた女の人。その母親だ。
lines.translated: I think the one who stabbed me was the mother at the scene. The mother of the woman who had been in the depths of grief after losing her fiance.

lines.content: 後ろから突然、俺は刺された。
lines.translated: Suddenly, from behind, I was stabbed.

lines.content: “お前が犯人だ。そうでしょう？”
lines.translated: "You're the culprit. Aren't you?"

lines.content: 俺を刺した後、母親だろう女の人はそう言った。
lines.translated: After stabbing me, the woman who must have been the mother said that.

lines.content: “現場で私と目が合ったのはお前だけ。集まってきた雑踏の中、私のことをじっと見ていたな。犯人は犯行現場に舞い戻るって言う。だから、お前だ。お前が犯人だ”
lines.translated: "At the scene, you were the only one who made eye contact with me. In the middle of the crowd that had gathered, you were staring right at me. They say the criminal always returns to the scene of the crime. So it's you. You're the culprit."

lines.content: ……酷い濡れ衣だった。
lines.translated: It was a terrible false accusation.

lines.content: こんな子どもがどうして、通り魔だなんてことをする動機を持つっていうんだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of motive could a kid like me possibly have to go around acting like a phantom slasher?

lines.content: 光りだ。
lines.translated: The light.

lines.content: 満月の、光り。
lines.translated: The light of the full moon.

lines.content: ……俺を刺した人もまた、知らず知らずの内に心を蝕まれてしまったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps the person who stabbed me had also had her heart unknowingly corroded.

lines.content: あの人の物語の中で俺は悪役だった。どうしようもないほどのゴミで、どうしようもないほどのクズだった。子どもだろうとなんだろうと関係はない。
lines.translated: In that person's story, I was the villain. I was irredeemable trash, irredeemable scum. Whether I was a child or whatever else didn't matter.

lines.content: ……娘のために復讐を果たしただけなのだ。
lines.translated: She simply carried out revenge for her daughter's sake.

lines.content: そういうふうに見えていたあの人の世界がいつか、逆転する。その瞬間が――つまり俺が犯人ではなかったと知る瞬間が――訪れるのかどうかは、知らない。
lines.translated: Someday, the world as she saw it will be turned upside down. Whether that moment--the moment she learns I wasn't the culprit--will ever come, I don't know.

lines.content: そこでその人がどんな“後悔”を抱くのかも、どうだっていい。
lines.translated: And what kind of "regret" she might harbor then doesn't matter to me at all.

lines.content: 俺が紛らわしいことをするのが悪いのだと自己弁護するのかもしれないし、もしかしたら耐えられず自ら命を絶ってしまうのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe she'll defend herself by saying it was my fault for acting suspiciously, or maybe she won't be able to bear it and will take her own life.

lines.content: それらはあくまでその人の人生に用意された問題だ。そこで何をどのように感じるのかも、俺にはまったく関知しようがない。
lines.translated: Those are ultimately problems prepared for her own life. What she feels then, and how she feels it, is none of my concern.

lines.content: 世界は、物語とは、人生を歩む心の数だけ存在していると知ったばかりだ。
lines.translated: I have only just learned that there are as many worlds, as many stories, as there are hearts walking through life.

lines.content: ただ、確かなことは……。
lines.translated: Still, the one thing that is certain...

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅の人生は――そのお話は、ここで、終わり？
lines.translated: "Is my life--the story of Kanade Taiga--going to end right here?"

lines.content: ずきりと、腹部が痛んだ。
lines.translated: A sharp throb of pain shot through my abdomen.

lines.content: ……う、ううっ
うめく。
lines.translated: I groaned.

lines.content: ……ましろ
lines.translated: "...Mashiro."

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: 少し、遅れる。
lines.translated: I'm going to be a little late.

lines.content: でも必ず行くから……
lines.translated: "But I'll definitely be there..."

lines.content: 倒れ伏した地面は真っ赤な血で染まってる。まだだ。まだまだ赤色は絶え間なく、流れている。
lines.translated: The ground I collapsed onto is dyed bright red with blood. Not yet. The red is still flowing endlessly.

lines.content: 必ず……
lines.translated: "I'll definitely..."

lines.content: 幸せだと思える未来をふたりで掴もう。
lines.translated: Let's seize a future where we can be happy together.

lines.content: 大丈夫だ。
lines.translated: It's alright.

lines.content: こんなことくらいで、俺は死なない。……絶対だ。
lines.translated: Something like this won't kill me. ...Definitely not.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: “夜”の中で手を繋ぎ、一緒に思い描いたふたりの未来が、どういうわけだろう、暗く、閉ざされていくようで……。
lines.translated: Holding hands in the "Night," the future for the two of us that we envisioned together is, for some reason, growing dark and closing off...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: せめて。
lines.translated: At the very least.

lines.content: せめて最期に一度だけでも、ましろの手に、触れないと……
lines.translated: "At the very least, just once at the very end, I have to touch Mashiro's hand..."

lines.content: ……俺がもう一度、“外の世界”で、君に“[呪い|力]”を使う。君とは触れられないけど、[・|手][・|を][・|重][・|ね][・|る]。
lines.translated: Once more, in the "outside world," I will use my "power" on you. I can't touch you, but I will place my hand over yours.

lines.content: そうすることで、はじめて……
lines.translated: "Only by doing that..."

lines.content: はじめて俺が、ましろにかけた“[呪い|才能]”は完成するのだ――俺たちはもう二度と、離れない。ましろは俺が死ぬまでずっとそばに居続ける。そういう“呪い”の完成だ。
lines.translated: Only then will the "curse" I cast on Mashiro be completed--we will never be separated again. Mashiro will stay by my side until the day I die. That is the completion of that "curse."

lines.content: だから、進め。
lines.translated: So, move forward.

lines.content: 這ってでも行け。
lines.translated: Even if you have to crawl, go.

lines.content: ……“[呪い|力]”は、まだ、未完成だ
lines.translated: "...The 'curse' is still incomplete."

lines.content: このままだと君は“夜”に帰れなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: At this rate, you won't be able to return to the "Night."
You will end up wandering the "outside world" forever.

lines.content: ……君を、君の“悪夢”から――ひとりぼっちで終えた人生の記憶から救いたいんだって、誓ったのに。それなのに……
lines.translated: "...Even though I swore I wanted to save you from your 'nightmare'--from the memories of a life ended all alone. And yet..."

lines.content: 俺の“[呪い|力]”によって、ましろ……。
lines.translated: Because of my "curse," Mashiro...

lines.content: 君はまた、この世界で、永遠にひとりぼっちだ
lines.translated: "You'll be all alone again in this world, forever."

lines.content: 俺は、寿命を生ききり――そこには常に君が隣で微笑んでくれていて……そして最期のときは手と手を繋ぎ、一緒に“夜”へと帰っていこう。
lines.translated: I would live out my natural lifespan--with you always smiling right beside me... and at the very end, we would hold hands and return to the "Night" together.

lines.content: それが俺たちの理想とした未来だったのだ。
lines.translated: That was the ideal future we envisioned.

lines.content: ……でもこのままでは、俺はたったひとり、“夜”に旅立たなければならなくなる。
lines.translated: But at this rate, I will have to set off into the "Night" all by myself.

lines.content: いやだ。……こんなの、いやだよ。俺は、俺はヒーローに、なりたかったのに
lines.translated: "No. ...I don't want this. Even though I... I wanted to become a hero."

lines.content: この世界の行く末だなんてどうだってよかった。
lines.translated: I didn't care at all about what would happen to this world.

lines.content: ただひとりぼっちで悲しんでいる女の子を、たったひとり救えるだけでよかったんだ。
lines.translated: All I wanted was to save just one girl who was grieving all alone.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 世界が暗く、小さく、なっていく……。
lines.translated: The world is growing darker, smaller...

lines.content: ……後は、ごめんな。あの子のこと、頼んだ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry about the rest. Take care of her for me."

lines.content: “隣”にいてくれる相棒に、友人に……、家族に、俺は願いを託す。
lines.translated: To my partner, my friend... my family, who stays "beside" me, I entrust my wish.

lines.content: こんなにも小さくて、護らなきゃならないと誓ったはずの君に、こんなにも重苦しいものを託さなきゃならないだなんて……。
lines.translated: To think I have to entrust something so heavy to you, someone so small whom I swore I had to protect...

lines.content: 涙が溢れる。
lines.translated: Tears overflow.

lines.content: 悔しくて。
lines.translated: Out of frustration.

lines.content: さみしくて……。
lines.translated: Out of loneliness...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: こんな人生、求めてはいなかった。
lines.translated: I never asked for a life like this.

lines.content: ……俺は、本当に、誰もが憧れるような……、格好いいヒーローには、向いてないんだなあ
lines.translated: "...I really wasn't cut out to be a cool hero... the kind that everyone admires, huh?"

lines.content: 手を伸ばした先に立っている[・|男][・|の][・|子]。
lines.translated: The boy standing just beyond my outstretched hand.

lines.content: ……地獄の底から連れ出したこの子にすべて、俺は、託した。
lines.translated: To this child I brought out from the depths of hell, I entrusted everything.

lines.content: ……ごめん。ちょっと、待って
lines.translated: "...Sorry. Wait a second."

lines.content: また俺は途中で話を途切れさせた。
lines.translated: Once again, I interrupted the story midway through.

lines.content: ……俺、刺されたの？　通り魔に？
lines.translated: "...Was I stabbed? By the phantom slasher?"

lines.content: ……ちがう
ちりんと鈴の鳴る音がする。女の子が首を振っている気配を感じた。
lines.translated: A bell chimes softly. I sensed the girl shaking her head.

lines.content: ……通り魔ではなく。通り魔を恨んでる女の人に、大雅……あなたは、刺されてしまった。犯人と間違われて
lines.translated: "...Not by the phantom slasher. You were stabbed by a woman who held a grudge against the slasher, Taiga... Mistaken for the culprit."

lines.content: そして……、どうなったの？
lines.translated: "And... what happened?"

lines.content: まさかとは思うが……。
lines.translated: I don't want to believe it, but...
Judging from how it sounded, I can't help but think this way.

lines.content: まさか俺、死んじゃったの？
lines.translated: "Don't tell me... I died?"

lines.content: 少しの沈黙の後、また微かな鈴の音。
lines.translated: After a brief silence, the faint sound of the bell rang again.

lines.content: 首の振られた方向は、横だろうか。縦だろうか。
lines.translated: Did she shake her head side to side? Or nod up and down?

lines.content: そんなことを考える余裕まである、少し長めの沈黙の後……、
lines.translated: After a slightly longer silence that left me enough room to ponder such things...

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: クロは言った。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……大雅。あなたは、死んでしまった。ましろをひとり、この世界に置いて
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You died. Leaving Mashiro all alone in this world."

lines.content: 手のひらを見る。
lines.translated: I look at the palm of my hand.

lines.content: 今日はもう何度そうしたかわからない。ただじっと、手を見つめた――……[・|だ][・|っ][・|た][・|ら]。
lines.translated: I don't know how many times I've done this today. I just stared intently at my hand--...In that case.

lines.content: ……[・|だ][・|っ][・|た][・|ら]今、ここにいる俺は何なんだろう
lines.translated: "...In that case, what am I, being here right now?"

lines.content: まさか……
lines.translated: "Could it be..."

lines.content: クロは、最初に“がんばる”と言っていた――俺が傷つかないようがんばって、話すと。
lines.translated: At the beginning, Kuro had said she would "do her best"--that she would do her best to tell me the story without hurting me.

lines.content: ……ぐるりと、辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: Slowly, I look around me.

lines.content: まさか俺が、ずっと現実だと思って今日まで生きてきたこの世界が、実は、現実じゃなくて――死後の世界？
lines.translated: "Could it be that this world I've lived in until today, always believing it to be reality, isn't actually real--and is the afterlife?"

lines.content: つまりこここそが“夜の国”？
lines.translated: Meaning this very place is the "Night Country"?

lines.content: ……つまり、俺は、もう既に死んでしまってる？　俺自身が気づいていないだけで
lines.translated: "...Meaning, I'm already dead? And I just haven't realized it myself?"

lines.content: そんなアイディアに包まれた物語はいくつも見てきた。飽くほどに。
lines.translated: I've seen plenty of stories wrapped up in that kind of idea. Enough to grow sick of them.

lines.content: ……何も上手くいかない。楽しいことも何もない。仲の良かった幼馴染みさえ命を落とし、ちりぢり、ばらばらとなってしまった世界。
lines.translated: Nothing goes right. There's nothing fun at all. A world where even my close childhood friend lost her life, and everything was scattered and torn apart.

lines.content: こんな“悪夢”のような日常を生きることに、そろそろ飽き始めていた頃合いだ。
lines.translated: It was right around the time I was starting to get tired of living through such a "nightmarish" everyday life.

lines.content: 故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: こうした事実を今になって突きつけられてしまっているのだろうか――今まで見てきた現実は、実はただの虚構でしかないのだという、現実を。
lines.translated: Am I finally being confronted with a truth like this now--the reality that the reality I've been looking at until now is actually nothing more than fiction?

lines.content: ……ちがうよ
lines.translated: "...That's not it."

lines.content: ちりんとまた、鈴の音が聞こえた。
lines.translated: With a soft chime, I heard the sound of the bell again.

lines.content: ……ちがう
大雅。あなたはちゃんと生きてるよ。あなたの生きてるこの世界も、不思議の国の中じゃない
lines.translated: "Taiga. You really are alive. And this world you're living in isn't inside Wonderland, either."

lines.content: ……生きている。
lines.translated: I'm alive.
However, that in itself is the problem.

lines.content: まるでそう言われているような気になってしまったのは――どうだろう。自意識や被害者意識のようなものを、過敏に働かせすぎているだろうか。
lines.translated: Why did I feel as though that was what she was telling me? Was my self-consciousness or victim mentality working in overdrive?

lines.content: 大雅。奏大雅
lines.translated: "Taiga. Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: ……あなたはね、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]にとってヒーローだった。[・|あ][・|の][・|子]はいつもあなたみたいになりたいって、祈っていたの
lines.translated: "...You know, you were a hero to that child. That child was always praying to become just like you."

lines.content: ……あの子？
lines.translated: "...That child?"

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: クロの言うあの子とは、いつも小さな黒い子猫を抱いて……。
lines.translated: The child Kuro was talking about was always holding a small black kitten...
In the story, it was the child who was always right "beside" me.

lines.content: 俺は[・|そ][・|の][・|子]のことを相棒、友人、あるいは家族と呼んでいた。
lines.translated: I called that child my partner, my friend, or my family.

lines.content: その子は無口だ。
lines.translated: That child was quiet.

lines.content: そして感情をまるで表に出さない無表情。
lines.translated: And completely expressionless, never showing any emotion on the surface.

lines.content: 物語の中で俺が話しかけたり、微笑みかけたりする度に、うなずいたり、首を横に振ったりする。
lines.translated: Whenever I spoke or smiled at them in the story, the child would nod or shake their head.
With every faint gesture like that, the bell on the collar of the black cat always cradled in their arms would chime softly.

lines.content: ……クロ。君と電話で話してると、時どき同じ鈴の音がした。だからさ、なんとなく電話の相手は[・|あ][・|の][・|子]なんじゃないかと思ってた
lines.translated: "...Kuro. When I talk to you on the phone, I sometimes hear that same bell. So, for some reason, I had a feeling the person on the other end of the line might be that child."

lines.content: だって、物語の中で、いつも俺の“隣”にいてくれる子は、とてもかわいい子に見えたから
lines.translated: "Because in the story, the child who was always right 'beside' me looked so cute."

lines.content: ……だから今、こうして電話で話してくれる[・|女][・|の][・|子]が、あの子なのかなって、思ってた
lines.translated: "...That's why I wondered if the girl talking to me on the phone right now might be that child."

lines.content: ……そうだね。うん。[・|大][・|雅]は……かわいい、よね
lines.translated: "...I see. Yeah. Taiga is... cute, isn't he?"

lines.content: 微笑みがこぼれるような声音だった。
lines.translated: Her voice sounded as if a smile was spilling through.

lines.content: ……学園祭で、お友だちに、女の子のかっこ、させられちゃうくらい……とてもかわいいって、わたしもね、思うよ
lines.translated: "...Cute enough that your friends made you dress up as a girl for the school festival... I think you're very cute, too."

lines.content: 小さな頃はもっともっと……ほんとの女の子みたいに、かわいかった
lines.translated: "When you were little, you were even more... just like a real girl, so cute."

lines.content: ……学園祭？
lines.translated: "...The school festival?"

lines.content: 俺は女装だなんて――そんなこと、させられた覚えも、した覚えもなかった。
lines.translated: Dressing up as a girl--I had no memory of ever being made to do something like that, or of doing it myself.

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: クロが、言う。
lines.translated: Kuro speaks.

lines.content: ……大雅。お願い。あの子を、助けて
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Please. Save that child."

lines.content: あの子にとってあなたは……奏大雅は、ヒーローだったの。あの子は、あなたみたいになりたいからと祈り、願って――[・|あ][・|ら][・|ゆ][・|る][・|大][・|切][・|な][・|も][・|の][・|か][・|ら][・|憎][・|ま][・|れ][・|る][・|こ][・|と][・|に][・|し][・|た]
lines.translated: "To that child, you... Kanade Taiga, were a hero. That child prayed and wished to become just like you--and decided to be hated by everything precious to them."

lines.content: ……だからきっといつか、わたしもあの子のことを――
lines.translated: "...So surely, someday, I will also--"

lines.content: そんなのはいや、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: I don't want that, Kuro says.

lines.content: そんなのはひどすぎる、とクロは言うのだ。
lines.translated: That's just too cruel, Kuro says.

lines.content: お願い。……お願い、します
lines.translated: "Please. ...I'm begging you."

lines.content: わたしには、できない。無理なの。こんなに、こんなに、祈っているのに――だめだ。わたしにはあの子を、助けられない
lines.translated: "I can't do it. It's impossible for me. Even though I'm praying so, so hard--it's no use. I can't save that child."

lines.content: だからどうか、お願い……あの子のことを……あなたが、助けてあげて
lines.translated: "So please, I beg you... Please... save that child."

lines.content: 繰り返し願われた。繰り返し、祈られた。
lines.translated: She wished for it over and over. She prayed for it over and over.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……ヒーローって
lines.translated: "...A hero, huh."

lines.content: 自分の命さえ放り投げようと何度となく考えた人間が――自分の人生さえ救えない、こんな人間が。
lines.translated: Someone who has thought about throwing his own life away countless times--someone like me, who can't even save his own life.

lines.content: ……誰かのことを救うだなんて。
lines.translated: Me, saving someone else?

lines.content: ……誰かの人生を、救い上げようだなんて。
lines.translated: Me, salvaging someone else's life?

lines.content: そんなのは夢物語にもなっていない。
lines.translated: That doesn't even qualify as a pipe dream.

lines.content: こんな俺に何ができるって言うんだ。
lines.translated: What could someone like me possibly do?

lines.content: 投げやりとも言える言葉は何とか飲み込み――
lines.translated: Somehow, I swallowed those desperate, defeatist words--

lines.content: ……ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "...Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ちりんとまた鈴の音。電話の向こうに滲んだ微かな涙の気配を、小さな鈴の音がかき消している。
lines.translated: The bell chimes softly again. That tiny sound drowns out the faint trace of tears seeping through from the other end of the line.

lines.content: それからふたりは……ましろと、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は、どうなっちゃったのかな
lines.translated: "What happened to the two of them after that... to Mashiro, and to that child?"

lines.content: ……俺が誰かを救えるのか否か。
lines.translated: Whether I can save someone or not.

lines.content: それだけではない、いっぱいの疑問や困惑――そしてそれらはこの俺に、解決するだけの義務があるものなのかどうか。
lines.translated: Not just that, but the countless questions and confusions filling my head--and whether I even have an obligation to resolve them.

lines.content: その答えは、全部――
lines.translated: All of those answers--

lines.content: ……これからまた、俺に話して聞かせてくれるのかな
lines.translated: "...Will you tell me the rest of the story now?"

lines.content: ……うん。話すよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I'll tell you."

lines.content: ……[・|わ][・|た][・|し][・|達]にとっての救いの主が……ヒーローが、もう、どこにもいなくなってしまった世界の話。あなたに聞いてもらいたいって、思う
lines.translated: "...It's the story of a world where our savior... where our hero, was no longer anywhere to be found. I want you to hear it."

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: クロにとって、俺とこうして話すことは“希望”なのだと感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that for Kuro, talking to me like this was "hope."

lines.content: こんな頼りのなさ過ぎる“希望”でごめん。申し訳ない。……本当に。
lines.translated: I'm sorry for being such an utterly unreliable "hope." I'm so sorry. ...Truly.

lines.content: そんな思いを[くすぶ|燻]らせたまま、今は先を聞くしかなかった。
lines.translated: With those feelings smoldering inside me, all I could do right now was listen to the rest.
The boy who knocked on the door of the room in Taiga's place was very quiet.

lines.content: ……私のことが見えてる？　声も聞こえる？
lines.translated: "...Can you see me? Can you hear my voice?"

lines.content: そう問いかけてみても、首をかしげるだけだ。
lines.translated: Even when I ask him that, he just tilts his head.

lines.content: ……もしも[・|私][・|が][・|わ][・|か][・|る]なら……えっと、あなたのお名前、教えてほしいな
lines.translated: "...If you can perceive me... um, I'd like you to tell me your name."

lines.content: そういうふうに問いかけてみても、やっぱりまた首をかしげるだけだった。
lines.translated: Even when I phrase my question like that, he still just tilts his head again.

lines.content: ……困ったな
lines.translated: "...What should I do?"

lines.content: たぶん、声は届いてる。おそらく“半透明”な私も見えている。そんな気配だ。
lines.translated: My voice is probably reaching him. And he can likely see the "translucent" me, too. That's the impression I get.

lines.content: でも男の子は話さない。
lines.translated: But the boy doesn't speak.

lines.content: 私の呼びかけには殆ど反応しなかった――ただただ首をかしげるだけだ。
lines.translated: He barely reacted to my calls at all--he just kept tilting his head.

lines.content: その度に、しっかり腕に抱いている子猫の首で、小さな鈴がちりんと揺れた。
lines.translated: Every time he did, a tiny bell chimed softly on the neck of the kitten held securely in his arms.

lines.content: この子はいったい誰だろう。どうして私が見えるのかな。
lines.translated: Just who is this child? Why is he able to see me?

lines.content: [・|困][・|っ][・|た]ことはそれだけじゃない。
lines.translated: That isn't the only thing troubling me.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: いつまで待っても大雅がやって来ないことだ。
lines.translated: It's that no matter how long I wait, Taiga hasn't come.

lines.content: 直ぐ、迎えに行くから。
lines.translated: I'll come pick you up right away.

lines.content: 大雅はそう言ってくれた。
lines.translated: That's what Taiga had told me.

lines.content: ……“夜”の外で一緒に暮らそうと、言ってくれた。
lines.translated: He told me that we would live together outside of the "Night."

lines.content: だからここで待っていて、と。必ず行くから、と。
lines.translated: So wait right here, he said. I'll definitely come for you, he said.

lines.content: だけどそろそろ日が暮れる。
lines.translated: But the sun is about to set.

lines.content: 大雅はまだ、来ない――代わりに扉のドアをノックしたのは、私のことが見えるのだろう小さなかわいい男の子。
lines.translated: Taiga still hasn't come--instead, the one who knocked on the door was a cute little boy who seems able to see me.

lines.content: そして、その腕に抱かれた一匹の子猫だけ。
lines.translated: And a single kitten cradled in his arms.

lines.content: どうしよう……
lines.translated: "What should I do..."

lines.content: 不安に思った。
lines.translated: I felt anxious.

lines.content: “夜”以外の夜を過ごすのは、“[こういうイキモノ|半透明]”となってからはたぶん、はじめてだ。
lines.translated: This is probably the first time I've ever spent a night outside of the "Night" since becoming a "translucent creature like this."

lines.content: まるで、たったひとり、知らない場所に置いて行かれてしまったようで――怖い。さみしい。
lines.translated: It feels as though I've been left behind all alone in an unfamiliar place--it's scary. I'm lonely.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: 私、どうしたらいいのかな。
lines.translated: What am I supposed to do?

lines.content: 小さなお腹の鳴る音がした。
lines.translated: There was a quiet rumble of a stomach.

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: 男の子が私に寄り添うようにして立っていた。
lines.translated: The boy was standing close, nestling up beside me.

lines.content: ……そっか。お腹、空いちゃうよね
lines.translated: "...I see. You must be getting hungry, huh?"

lines.content: あなたには身体も命もあるんだもんね。
lines.translated: After all, you have a body and a life.

lines.content: ……行こっか
lines.translated: "...Shall we go?"

lines.content: ここには、美味しいものはなにもないから。一緒に何か探しに行こう
lines.translated: "There's nothing delicious to eat in here. Let's go look for something together."

lines.content: 大雅に何かあったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Something might have happened to Taiga.

lines.content: じっと待っているだけではつらかった。
lines.translated: Just waiting around still was too painful.

lines.content: 男の子には美味しいご飯を。
lines.translated: A delicious meal for the boy.

lines.content: ……私には、大雅の笑顔を。
lines.translated: And for me, Taiga's smile.

lines.content: 一緒に必要なものを探すため、部屋の外へ恐る恐る踏み出した。
lines.translated: To search for the things we needed together, I timidly stepped out of the room.

lines.content: 町はすっかり夜だった。
lines.translated: Night had completely fallen over the town.

lines.content: でも、知ってる光りはどこにもない。ここは私の知らない夜だった。
lines.translated: Yet, the familiar lights were nowhere to be found. This was a night I didn't know.

lines.content: 不安も、怖さも、更に大きく膨らむけれど……。
lines.translated: My anxiety and fear swelled even further, but...

lines.content: ごめんね。手を繋いで歩いてあげられなくて……。迷子にならないよう気をつけてね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I can't hold your hand as we walk... Please be careful not to get lost, okay?"

lines.content: 学園前の坂を下った。
lines.translated: I walked down the hill in front of the academy.

lines.content: 男の子は私の後をついてくる。
lines.translated: The boy follows behind me.

lines.content: どうしてこの子が、大雅の代わりに、私のところにやって来たんだろう――この子は大雅とどういう関係なんだろうか。
lines.translated: Why did this child come to me in Taiga's place--what kind of relationship does he have with Taiga?

lines.content: 聞きたいことはいっぱいある。
lines.translated: There are so many things I want to ask.

lines.content: だけど今は……、
lines.translated: But right now...

lines.content: ……とりあえず、ご飯を探そう。
lines.translated: For now, let's look for some food.

lines.content: 大雅のことも探さなきゃ。もしかしたら、大雅は迷子になっているのかも知れない。
lines.translated: I have to look for Taiga, too. Maybe Taiga got lost somewhere.

lines.content: 大雅は“夜”からしか時計塔に来たことがなかったし……。
lines.translated: After all, Taiga has only ever come to the clock tower from the "Night"...

lines.content: だから、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]からあなたのことを迎えに行こう。
lines.translated: So let's go meet up with him ourselves.

lines.content: ねえ、教えてほしいな。好きな食べ物とか、嫌いなものとか、あるのかな？
lines.translated: "Hey, tell me. Do you have any favorite foods, or things you don't like?"

lines.content: 笑顔でそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked him with a smile.

lines.content: 男の子はふるりと一度、首を振るだけだ。
