lines.translated: The boy simply gave a single, slight shake of his head.

lines.content: じゃあ……、ううんっと……嫌いなものは？
lines.translated: "Then... hmm... what about things you dislike?"

lines.content: やっぱり男の子は首を微かに振るだけだった。
lines.translated: Again, the boy only shook his head faintly.

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: 好きなものはないけれど……代わりに、嫌いもない。あなたは好き嫌いしない、いい子なんだね
lines.translated: "You don't have any favorites... and in return, nothing you hate either. You're a good boy who isn't a picky eater, huh?"

lines.content: だったら甘いものはどう？　好きじゃない？　微笑んで見せ、そう問いかける。
lines.translated: What about sweets, then? Do you like those? I gave him a gentle smile and asked.

lines.content: すると男の子はふっと、私を真似るようにして小さく――本当に小さくだけど、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: At that, as if mimicking me, the boy offered a tiny--truly tiny--smile of his own.

lines.content: なんだかとてもかわいい男の子だ。そう思う。
lines.translated: What an adorable little boy, I thought to myself.

lines.content: ううーん。デザートにはチョコレートがあれば完璧なんだけどなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm. If we had some chocolate for dessert, it would be absolute perfection, though."

lines.content: 不安も恐怖も笑顔で吹き飛ばせたならいい。男の子の微笑みを見てそう感じられた。
lines.translated: How nice it would be if we could blow away all our anxiety and fear with a smile. Seeing the boy's faint smile made me feel that way.

lines.content: そんな根拠も何もない希望をただただ抱き……。私たちは、進んだ。
lines.translated: Clinging blindly to such groundless hope... we pressed on.

lines.content: 男の子と並んで町を歩いた。
lines.translated: I walked through the town side by side with the boy.

lines.content: 町は私が生きていた頃と比べると、かなりの部分が変わってしまっていて……。
lines.translated: Compared to when I was alive, a great deal of the town had changed...

lines.content: 大雅を探すつもりが、私も迷子になってしまいそうだった。
lines.translated: I'd set out intending to look for Taiga, yet I felt like I was about to get lost myself.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。食べられそうなもの、何も見つけられなかったね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. We couldn't find anything that looks edible, could we?"

lines.content: 私たちは時計塔の管理室に戻ってきていた。
lines.translated: We had returned to the caretaker's room in the clock tower.

lines.content: 結局ここしか行くところはなかったし、大雅とは入れ違いになってしまってもいけない。
lines.translated: In the end, this was the only place we had to go, and we couldn't risk missing Taiga if he came by while we were out.

lines.content: もしかすると部屋に戻れば、大雅が私を……私たちを待っている。
lines.translated: Maybe if we went back to the room, Taiga would be waiting for me... for us.

lines.content: そんな期待もあった。
lines.translated: I had held onto that hope, too.

lines.content: でも、やっぱり部屋には誰もいなくて……。
lines.translated: Even so, the room was still completely empty...

lines.content: ……明日また考えよう。これからのこと、色々……たくさん。だから今日はもう、おやすみしようか
lines.translated: "...Let's think about it again tomorrow. About what we'll do from now on, and all sorts of things... There's a lot to figure out. So for tonight, let's get some sleep, okay?"

lines.content: “[・|夜]”[・|の][・|側][・|で][・|は][・|蓄][・|音][・|機][・|の][・|置][・|い][・|て][・|あ][・|っ][・|た]――しかしこちらには何も置かれていないテーブルの下で、男の子は子猫をしっかり抱いたまま丸くなった。
lines.translated: Underneath the table--where a phonograph had sat on the side of the "Night," though nothing rested upon it here--the boy curled up, still holding the kitten tightly.

lines.content: 抱きしめられた子猫は慣れた様子で、まったく窮屈そうにもせず、男の子の腕の中であくびをし、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Seeming quite used to this and not the least bit cramped, the kitten yawned in the boy's arms and closed its eyes.

lines.content: 眠る小さな男の子。
lines.translated: The little boy drifted off to sleep.

lines.content: ねえ、あなたは誰なの？
lines.translated: Hey, who are you?

lines.content: 心の中でそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked him silently in my heart.

lines.content: ……教えてほしいな。あなたは、大雅がどこにいるか……知ってる？
lines.translated: "...Please tell me. Do you know... where Taiga is?"

lines.content: そうつぶやいてみた途端。
lines.translated: The moment I whispered those words...

lines.content: 心に一瞬――ほんの一瞬だけ、触れた指先からこの子の声が、心が、流れ込んで来るようだった。
lines.translated: For a single instant--just a fleeting moment--it felt as though this child's voice, his very heart, flowed into mine through my touching fingertips.

lines.content: ……そっか。あなたもひとりぼっちなんだね
lines.translated: "...I see. You're all alone too, aren't you?"
Just like me.

lines.content: 男の子の心に触れて、私は知りたいことを、知ることができた。
lines.translated: By touching the boy's heart, I was able to learn what I wanted to know.
Taiga had lost his life.

lines.content: 大雅はもう、ここには来ない――いや。ここには来れなく、なってしまった。
lines.translated: Taiga wouldn't be coming here anymore--no. He could no longer come here.

lines.content: 大雅は最後に、この子に自分の“力”を手渡した。だからこの子は私の姿が見えている。
lines.translated: At the very end, Taiga had passed his "power" on to this child. That was why the boy could see me.

lines.content: だからこの子は、たったひとり、私のところへやって来た。
lines.translated: And that was why he had come to me all by himself.
He had carried the "power" entrusted to him by Taiga, bringing it all the way to me.

lines.content: ……[・|そ][・|れ]をこの子から受け取れば、私は、“夜”に戻れる？
lines.translated: "...If I accept that from this child, will I be able to return to the 'Night'?"

lines.content: そこでまた大雅と逢える……。
lines.translated: And then I can see Taiga again there...

lines.content: そのはずだよね。
lines.translated: That's how it should work, right?

lines.content: ……きっと大雅は、“夜”の中で、私が戻ってくるのを待っていてくれるよね
lines.translated: "...I'm sure Taiga is waiting for me to come back inside the 'Night,' isn't he?"

lines.content: そう小さな声で問いかけてみる。だけど男の子は眠ったままだ。
lines.translated: I tried asking in a quiet voice. However, the boy remained fast asleep.

lines.content: その腕に抱いた子猫の耳が少し震えるだけだった。
lines.translated: Only the ears of the kitten cradled in his arms twitched slightly.

lines.content: 私の“半透明”のこの手を、こうして男の子の手に触れるでもなく重ねれば――そして祈れば、完成だ。
lines.translated: If I just place my "translucent" hand over the boy's without truly touching him like this--and offer a prayer, it will be complete.

lines.content: “夜と外とを繋ぐ大雅の力”で、私は“夜”と繋がり、[・|願][・|い][・|を][・|叶][・|え][・|る][・|よ][・|う][・|に]して、“夜”へと戻ることができるだろう。
lines.translated: With "Taiga's power to connect the Night and the outside," I would link back to the "Night," and as if having a wish granted, I should be able to return there.

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 私は、男の子の手に自分の手を重ね――言った。あなたの[心|記憶]を、勝手に覗き見ちゃってごめんなさい。
lines.translated: Laying my hand over the boy's--I spoke. I'm sorry for peeking into your memories without asking.

lines.content: ……大雅は、この町にお父さんを探しにやって来た。そしてあなたは……[・|お][・|母][・|さ][・|ん]を探しに、やって来たんだね
lines.translated: "...Taiga came to this town looking for his father. And you... you came here looking for your mother, didn't you?"

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: 私はまだ、“外”にいる。“夜”には還らずにいた。
lines.translated: I am still on the "outside." I did not return to the "Night."

lines.content: さあ、一緒に行こう
lines.translated: "Come on, let's go together."

lines.content: 朝が来るのに合わせ、大きな時計塔の小さな管理室から、私たちは出た。
lines.translated: As morning arrived, we stepped out of the small caretaker's room in the grand clock tower.
"Let's go look for your mother... I'm sorry that Taiga's replacement is someone 'translucent' like me. But I'll do my very best. I'll try my hardest to fulfill his 'promise' in his stead."

lines.content: 男の子は無表情のまま、やっぱり首をかしげるような仕草を見せるだけだった。
lines.translated: His face remaining expressionless, the boy simply tilted his head slightly once again.

lines.content: でも、その瞳の中に感じるのは、男の子の“さみしさ”だ。
lines.translated: Yet what I felt deep within his eyes was his "loneliness."

lines.content: 一度は“夜”に還ろうと思った。
lines.translated: For a moment, I had intended to return to the "Night."

lines.content: ……大雅に逢いたい。
lines.translated: I want to see Taiga.

lines.content: 今すぐ会いたい。
lines.translated: I want to see him right now.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...
People do not truly die.

lines.content: “夜”に還ればきっと、私たちはすぐに逢える。
lines.translated: If I return to the "Night," I'm sure we will be able to reunite right away.

lines.content: そこで私が、あなたへ抱いた想いを――あなたのことが大好きだよっていう、やっと気づいた自分の想いを、あなたに直接伝えたい。
lines.translated: And there, I want to tell you directly about the feelings I hold for you--the feelings I finally realized, that I love you so much.

lines.content: そのために、男の子の手の中にある大雅の“力”を受け取ろうと、考えたけれど……。
lines.translated: For that sake, I had thought about taking Taiga's "power" resting within the boy's hand, and yet...

lines.content: ……あなたと私。なんだか似てるね
lines.translated: "...You and I. We're kind of alike, aren't we?"

lines.content: 思わずそうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: The words slipped out before I knew it.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: だからこの子をたったひとり、この世界に置いていくことはできないと思った。
lines.translated: That was why I realized I couldn't just leave this child behind, all alone in this world.

lines.content: なぜなら……、
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: ……あなたも、大好きな人に振り向いてほしくって……これまでいっぱい、さみしかったんだね
lines.translated: "...You wanted the person you love most to look your way, too... You've been so, so lonely all this time, haven't you?"

lines.content: なぜなら昨晩、私は男の子の心に触れた。
lines.translated: Because last night, I touched the boy's heart.

lines.content: そのとき垣間見た記憶を少し、思い出す。
lines.translated: I recalled a little of the memories I had glimpsed in that moment.

lines.content: 男の子は生まれて直ぐ、暗く冷たい地下牢に閉じ込められた。
lines.translated: Right after the boy was born, he was locked away in a dark, freezing dungeon.

lines.content: 無価値とされた無才能。
lines.translated: Talentless, and therefore deemed worthless.

lines.content: 唯一価値あるものは持って生まれた命だけ――大人たちの求める“永遠の命”を得るための供物だけ。
lines.translated: The only thing of value he possessed was the life he was born with--merely an offering for the adults to obtain the "eternal life" they sought.

lines.content: そこには大雅のような“呪い”も含まれていなかった。
lines.translated: He didn't even carry a "curse" like Taiga's.

lines.content: （……名前はない。両親の名前も知らない。自分を地下室に置いていった母親の横顔を、最後に、母親が残していった言葉を、ただぼんやり思い出せるくらい）
lines.translated: (...He has no name. He doesn't know his parents' names, either. All he can vaguely recall is the profile of the mother who left him in that cellar, and the final words she left behind.)

lines.content: 男の子はお母さんがくれた約束を今も覚えている。
lines.translated: Even now, the boy remembers the promise his mother gave him.

lines.content: “あなたが[ここ|地下牢]に閉じ込められたのは何かの間違いだ”とお母さんは言った。
lines.translated: "It's some kind of mistake that you were locked up in this dungeon," his mother had said.

lines.content: “あなたにはきっと[・|何][・|か]があるはず。真っ暗闇な未来を眩しいくらい明るく照らす――そのための力があるはず。今はまだ、それが目覚めていないだけ”
lines.translated: "You must surely have something within you. The power to illuminate a pitch-black future until it shines blindingly bright. It simply hasn't awakened yet."

lines.content: “必ずあなたを助けに戻るわ。だからそれまでがんばって”――そう言った男の子のお母さんは、地下牢の格子越しに男の子と指切りをした。
lines.translated: "I will definitely come back to save you. So hang in there until then"--saying that, the boy's mother hooked her pinky with his through the bars of the dungeon cell.

lines.content: いつか……。
lines.translated: Someday...

lines.content: （……いつか世界で一番、自分にやさしくしてほしい人が迎えに来てくれる）
lines.translated: (...Someday, the person I want to be kindest to me in the whole world will come to take me away.)

lines.content: 男の子は信じた。
lines.translated: The boy believed.

lines.content: そんな微かな記憶だけを希望のようにして、男の子はただ呼吸を繰り返すみたいに――心を無意識に閉ざして、日々を生きていた。
lines.translated: Holding onto only that faint memory as his sole hope, the boy lived through each day as if merely repeating the act of breathing--unconsciously shutting his heart away.

lines.content: 深く冷たい地下牢で起きる出来事は――飢えや、孤独や、悲しみや、ほんの幼い少年の心には、とても受け止めきれないことの連続だったから。
lines.translated: Because the things that happened in that deep, freezing dungeon--hunger, solitude, sorrow--were an endless succession of horrors far too heavy for a tiny little boy's heart to bear.

lines.content: そんな地獄の底に注がれる光はお母さんの“いつか必ずあなたを助けに戻るわ”という言葉だけ。
lines.translated: The only light pouring into the depths of that hell were his mother's words: "Someday, I will definitely come back to save you."

lines.content: （でも、この子のお母さんは、いつまで経っても迎えに来てはくれなくて……）
lines.translated: (However, no matter how much time passed, this child's mother never came for him...)

lines.content: “お母さんの言葉をただただ信じて、いつまでも地獄の底で待ち続けている”
lines.translated: "Simply believing in his mother's words, he kept waiting forever at the bottom of hell."

lines.content: ただどこからか地下牢に迷い込んできた子猫に、自分のご飯をわけてあげ、母親が迎えに来てくれる瞬間を待っていた。
lines.translated: He merely shared his meager meals with a kitten that had wandered into the dungeon from somewhere, waiting for the moment his mother would come to take him away.

lines.content: そんな男の子を地獄の底から救い上げたのは――待ち望んだ母親の“待たせてごめんね”という言葉ではない。
lines.translated: And the one who pulled the boy up from the depths of that hell--was not his long-awaited mother saying, "I'm sorry to have kept you waiting."

lines.content: 大雅だ。奏大雅。
lines.translated: It was Taiga. Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 一緒に行こう
lines.translated: "Let's go together."

lines.content: 大雅は言った。
lines.translated: Taiga had said.

lines.content: もうこんなところにいなくていいんだ。俺と一緒に、会いたい人に会いに行こう
lines.translated: "You don't have to stay in a place like this anymore. Come with me, and let's go see the person you want to see."

lines.content: 何も話さず、うなずく他に何の反応も示さない――
lines.translated: Never speaking a word, showing no reaction other than a simple nod--

lines.content: そんなふうに心を閉ざした少年の事情を、大人たちが少年にそうさせてしまったのだという道理を、足繁く地下牢に通っていた大雅は理解していたようだった。
lines.translated: Having visited the dungeon frequently, Taiga seemed to understand the circumstances of the boy who had locked his heart away like that, and the cruel truth that the adults were the ones who had made him this way.

lines.content: いつまで待っても大切な人はやって来ない。それなら、こちらから迎えに行けばいいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "No matter how long you wait, the person precious to you won't come. If that's the case, why don't we just go meet them ourselves?"

lines.content: ……俺も君と似たようなものだよ
lines.translated: "...I'm a lot like you, you know."

lines.content: いつまで待っても大切なひとも、大切な人も……大切にしたい[・|何][・|か]も、やっては来ない。だから、今から、会いたい全部に会いに行くんだ――この屋敷をさ、抜け出すんだよ
lines.translated: "No matter how long I wait, the girl precious to me, the person precious to me... the something I want to cherish, won't ever come to me. That's why, starting right now, I'm going to go see everything I want to see--we're breaking out of this mansion."

lines.content: ほら……幸せは歩いてこないって言うだろ。誰もが知ってる有名なあの歌だよ
lines.translated: "Come on... they say happiness doesn't just walk up to you on its own, right? It's from that famous song everyone knows."

lines.content: 大雅はそう言い、地下牢の格子を時間を掛け何とか壊した。そして少年に手を差し伸べた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Taiga spent time managing to break through the bars of the dungeon cell. And then, he held out his hand to the boy.

lines.content: “求めるものを待つのではなく、こちらから会いに行く”
lines.translated: "Instead of waiting for what you seek, go out and meet it yourself."

lines.content: たったそれだけの言葉だった。
lines.translated: Those were the only words he spoke.

lines.content: しかし人の“[心|世界]”は、認識される言葉の数で、それまで投げかけられてきた言葉の意味で、作られていく。
lines.translated: However, a person's "heart"--their world--is built from the number of words they recognize, and the meaning of the words that have been cast upon them up to that point.
Just as the casual words of "someone" had once caused the boy to lock his heart away.

lines.content: しかし男の子の“[心|世界]”は、大雅が発したたったそれだけの言葉で、ひとつ、開けた――“そんな方法があったのか”というひらめきにも似た感覚だった。
lines.translated: Yet with those simple words spoken by Taiga, a part of the boy's "heart"--his world--opened up. It was a sensation akin to a flash of inspiration: "So there was a way like that?"

lines.content: だから男の子は、差し伸べられた手を取った。
lines.translated: And so, the boy took the hand held out to him.

lines.content: 地獄の底から未来へ一歩、踏み出すために。
lines.translated: In order to take a single step out from the bottom of hell toward the future.
He had to live up to the adults' expectations.

lines.content: その“[心|世界]”を全うする、そのために。
lines.translated: All for the sake of fulfilling that "heart"--that world of his.

lines.content: どうかな。あなたのお家、どこかに見えてる？
lines.translated: "How about here? Can you see your house anywhere?"

lines.content: 町を一望できる公園にまでやって来た。
lines.translated: We had come all the way to a park overlooking the entire town.

lines.content: 男の子はじっと町の景色を見つめた後、ふるふると首を振った。
lines.translated: After staring intently at the townscape, the boy slowly shook his head.

lines.content: ……そっか。わかんないか。ゴールはまだまだ遠そうだね
lines.translated: "...I see. You can't tell, huh? Looks like the finish line is still a long way off."

lines.content: ふたりでベンチに座り、ぼんやりと春色の町を眺めていた。
lines.translated: Sitting together on a bench, we gazed absently out at the spring-colored town.

lines.content: ……大雅は男の子にふたつ約束をした。
lines.translated: Taiga had made two promises to the boy.

lines.content: 『……俺が君を、君の大切な人のところに連れて行く。絶対だ。“約束”するよ』
lines.translated: "'...I will take you to the person precious to you. Definitely. I "promise" you.'"

lines.content: 『君のお母さん[・|も]“参禅町”のどこかにいるらしい。やさしいふりした大人にそう教えてもらったよ。だから一緒に、こんな地獄の底から外へ出よう――[・|絶][・|対][・|だ]』
lines.translated: "'Apparently, your mother is somewhere in "Sanzen-cho" too. An adult pretending to be kind told me so. That's why we're going to get out from the bottom of this hell together--definitely.'"

lines.content: 『絶対に、君のことは俺が護るよ』
lines.translated: "'I will definitely protect you.'"

lines.content: 『外の世界の厳しさだとか。理不尽さだとか。……どうしようもないさみしさだとか。そういう目には見えないもの全部から、護ってみせる』
lines.translated: "'From the harshness of the outside world. From its unreasonableness. ...From its helpless loneliness. I'll protect you from all of those invisible things.'"

lines.content: 何でだか君のことを地下に置いたままではいられなかったんだと、苦笑いで大雅は男の子に言っていた。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, Taiga had told the boy that for some reason, he just couldn't bear to leave him behind in that basement.

lines.content: 『俺たちは仲間だ』
lines.translated: "'We're comrades.'"

lines.content: 大雅は言った。
lines.translated: Taiga had said.

lines.content: 『……大切なひと達に置いて行かれたさみしがり屋だ』
lines.translated: "'...Lonely souls left behind by the people precious to us.'"

lines.content: 『同じような心の持ち主だから、きっと、この先は助け合いながら生きていける。足りないものを補い合っていけるはず。そんな気がするよ』
lines.translated: "'Since our hearts are alike, I'm sure we can live on from here helping each other out. We should be able to make up for what the other lacks. I have a feeling we can.'"

lines.content: でも“約束”は果たされなかった。
lines.translated: However, that "promise" was never fulfilled.

lines.content: ……大雅は命を落とした。
lines.translated: Taiga lost his life.

lines.content: 心を壊した大人に奪われた。
lines.translated: It was stolen from him by adults whose hearts had broken.

lines.content: 私と待ち合わせた時計塔へ向かう途中のことだった――昨晩、男の子が眠ったあと私はこっそり、大雅が命を落とした場所へ行ってみた。
lines.translated: It happened while he was on his way to the clock tower where he was supposed to meet me--last night, after the boy fell asleep, I secretly went to the place where Taiga lost his life.

lines.content: 男の子の記憶でその場所を知った。
lines.translated: I learned of the location through the boy's memories.

lines.content: 怖い顔をした大人たちが大勢集まり、がやがやと怒鳴り合い、パトカーや救急車が、次々と入れ替わっていっていた。
lines.translated: A large crowd of grim-faced adults had gathered, shouting noisily at one another, while police cars and ambulances came and went one after another.

lines.content: 私は、ため息をつく。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.

lines.content: もう大雅と私は、一緒に思い描いた未来を歩めない――昨晩あの場所で見て聞いた騒々しさが、その何よりも大きな証拠だと感じてしまった。
lines.translated: Taiga and I could no longer walk toward the future we had envisioned together--I couldn't help feeling that the commotion I saw and heard at that place last night was the greatest proof of that above all else.

lines.content: それは、とても悲しいことだけど……。
lines.translated: That is a very sad thing, and yet...

lines.content: 本当に、ほんとうに、つらく悲しく、さみしいことだけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though it is truly, truly painful, sad, and lonely...

lines.content: でも、私は知っている。
lines.translated: Even so, I know.
People do not die.

lines.content: “外の世界”で、与えられた時間を使い切っても、命は“夜の世界”に生まれ直す。
lines.translated: Even if they use up all the time given to them in the "outside world," their lives are reborn into the "Night World."

lines.content: 紛れもないその事実を理解しているからこそ、私は悲しくないはずだった――“夜”に戻れば大雅とはまた逢えることを、知っていた。
lines.translated: Precisely because I understood that undeniable fact, I wasn't supposed to feel sad--I knew that if I returned to the "Night," I would be able to meet Taiga again.

lines.content: 確かに人は死なない。
lines.translated: It is true that people do not die.

lines.content: 命は死すとも魂は永遠だった。
lines.translated: Even if a life perishes, the soul is eternal.

lines.content: でも、人の心は死んでしまう。子ども時代に誰からも愛された記憶のない人は、その心は、いつまでも健全な大人になれない。
lines.translated: However, a person's heart can die. A person who has no memories of being loved by anyone during their childhood can never grow to have a healthy adult heart.

lines.content: この子をひとりぼっちで置いていくことは、過去、母親に、父親に、どうしても愛されたくて泣いていた自分自身を、またひとりぼっちにすることと同じように思え……。
lines.translated: Leaving this child behind all alone felt just like abandoning my own past self all over again--the girl who used to cry because she so desperately wanted to be loved by her mother and father...

lines.content: 置いていけない。
lines.translated: I can't leave him behind.

lines.content: 昨夜、男の子の心に触れた私はそう思った。
lines.translated: Having touched the boy's heart last night, that was how I felt.

lines.content: 大雅もこの男の子に、自分と似たところを感じたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps Taiga had also sensed something similar to himself within this boy.

lines.content: だから大雅は、男の子に“約束”をした――“必ず君を護ってみせる”
lines.translated: That was why Taiga made a "promise" to the boy--"I will definitely protect you."

lines.content: でも、もう、大雅はここにいないから……。
lines.translated: But because Taiga is no longer here...

lines.content: 私が、大雅の代わりに約束を果たすことにした――お母さんだ。男の子をお母さんに会わせてあげたかった。生前の私がどうしても、叶えられなかった“夢”のひとつでもあった。
lines.translated: I decided to fulfill that promise in Taiga's stead--his mother. I wanted to reunite the boy with his mother. It was also one of the "dreams" that I could never make come true while I was alive.

lines.content: ……なかったことにされた私はいつも、寝たきりの地下室のベッドの上で、直ぐ上の階で、楽しそうに笑うお母さん、お父さんに会いたいと、いつも願っていた。
lines.translated: Treated as though I never existed, lying bedridden in that basement, I had always, always wished I could see my mother and father laughing happily on the floor right above me.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: 心の中で呼びかける。
lines.translated: I called out within my heart.

lines.content: （……大丈夫だよね）
lines.translated: (...It's okay, right?)

lines.content: （この子をあなたの代わりに、お母さんのところに連れて行くまで……“夜”で待っていてくれるよね）
lines.translated: (Until I take this child to his mother in your stead... you'll wait for me in the "Night," won't you?)

lines.content: 男の子をお家まで送り届けたらすぐに行くよ。
lines.translated: As soon as I see the boy safely home, I'll come right away.

lines.content: （だから待ってて。お願いね。……大雅。どうか全部上手くいくように、私たちに力を貸してくれたらうれしいな）
lines.translated: (So please wait for me. Please. ...Taiga. I'd be so happy if you could lend us your strength so that everything goes well.)

lines.content: 目には見えない静かな“夜”に、そして今もそこに生き続けているたくさんの“想い”に、私は、繰り返しそう呼びかけ続けていた。
lines.translated: To the quiet, invisible "Night," and to the many "feelings" that continue to live on there even now, I kept calling out over and over again.

lines.content: ……ううーん。何も、見つからなかったね
lines.translated: "...Hmm. We didn't find anything at all, did we?"

lines.content: 一日中町を歩いたけれど、男の子の家は見つからなかったし、お腹いっぱい食べられそうなものも見つけられなかった。
lines.translated: We walked around town all day long, yet we couldn't find the boy's house, nor could we find anything that looked like it would fill his stomach.

lines.content: 私たちにはどこへも行く宛てはない。結局は時計塔の管理室に戻ってきていた。
lines.translated: We had nowhere else to go. In the end, we returned to the caretaker's room in the clock tower.

lines.content: ため息をつき、べったりとテーブルに突っ伏してしまう――そんな私のことを、男の子がじっと見ていた。
lines.translated: Breathing a sigh, I slumped flat onto the table--and the boy stared intently at me as I did.

lines.content: うん。わかってるよ。たった一日中歩き回っただけで、宝物が見つからなかったからって……そんなのはふつうだよね
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know. Just because we walked around for a single day and couldn't find any treasure... that's completely normal, isn't it?"

lines.content: 男の子が首をかしげていた――言葉はないけど、その視線は“宝物？”と、不思議がっているように見えた。
lines.translated: The boy tilted his head--he didn't say a word, yet his gaze seemed to be wondering, "Treasure?"

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: たぶん、本当にそう思っているのだろうと感じる。不思議だけれど、男の子の気持ちを何となく察することができた。
lines.translated: I felt that was probably what he was really thinking. Strange as it was, I could somehow sense the boy's feelings.

lines.content: 目には見えない“想い”を察することは、目には見えない“半透明”な自分には、きっと得意だ。
lines.translated: Sensing invisible "feelings" is surely something that an invisible, "translucent" being like myself is good at.

lines.content: そうだよ。宝物
lines.translated: "That's right. Treasure."

lines.content: と、私はうなずき、言った。
lines.translated: I nodded and said so.

lines.content: ……今日の分のご飯も、あなたのお母さんも。甘くて美味しいチョコレートみたいにね、この町のどこかに隠されている宝物だよ
lines.translated: "...Today's meal, and your mother, too. Just like sweet, delicious chocolate, they're treasures hidden somewhere in this town."

lines.content: だからそう簡単には見つけられないんだって覚悟しなくちゃだめだよね、と私は言う。
lines.translated: That's why we have to be prepared for the fact that we won't find them so easily, I told him.

lines.content: 宝物は見つけにくいものだからこそ宝物なんだし……。うん。明日もまた一緒にがんばろう
lines.translated: "A treasure is only a treasure precisely because it's hard to find, after all... Yeah. Let's do our best together again tomorrow."

lines.content: 男の子は何も答えない。
lines.translated: The boy didn't answer at all.

lines.content: うなずくことも、首を振ることもなく、ただ窓の外を――夜に染まった町の風景を、見つめていた。
lines.translated: Without nodding or shaking his head, he simply stared out the window--at the scenery of the town dyed in night.

lines.content: そんな男の子の[・|頑][・|な][・|さ]に、やっぱり私とこの子は良く似てる、と――自分のひらひらで、ふわふわで、まっしろなこの服装を見ながら、そう思わずにいられなかった。
lines.translated: Seeing that stubbornness of his, I couldn't help thinking that this child and I really are alike--as I looked down at my own frilly, fluffy, pure-white outfit.

lines.content: ……昨晩。
lines.translated: Last night.

lines.content: 眠る男の子の心に“半透明”な私は触れ、垣間見た一部を思い出す。
lines.translated: As a "translucent" being, I had touched the sleeping boy's heart, and I recalled a fragment of what I had glimpsed there.

lines.content: がちゃりと、地下牢の南京錠に鍵をしながら、顔も名前も知らない“[大人|誰か]”は言っていた。
lines.translated: With a metallic clack, while locking the padlock on the dungeon cell, "someone"--an adult whose face and name he didn't even know--had said:

lines.content: “泣いたり喚いたり、口答えしたりも絶対にしない。私たち大人の言うことをちゃんと聞く。そうできる子だけが、いい子なの。それ以外は全部、我がままばかりの悪い子だ”
lines.translated: "Never cry, scream, or talk back. Listen properly to what we adults tell you. Only a child who can do that is a good child. Anyone else is a terrible, selfish child."

lines.content: “いい？　ちゃんと聞いてる？”
lines.translated: "Understand? Are you listening properly?"

lines.content: “あなたがいい子になれれば、誰にも迷惑をかけない[・|大][・|人][・|に]なれれば、あなたのお母さんは、すぐにでもあなたのことを迎えに来てくれるはず”
lines.translated: "If you can become a good child, if you can become an adult who doesn't cause trouble for anyone, your mother will surely come to pick you up right away."

lines.content: “そうできないあなたのことは……いい？　私たちの期待どおりに生きていくことのできない、あなたなんかは、ここにいる誰も……誰ひとり、決して愛することはない”
lines.translated: "If you can't do that... understand? Someone like you, who cannot live up to our expectations, will never... not a single person here will ever love you."

lines.content: だから男の子は[・|期][・|待][・|ど][・|お][・|り]、我がままを言わない、泣いたり喚いたりも絶対しない、そんな自分であるようにと、願い――心を閉ざした。
lines.translated: And so, just as expected of him, the boy wished to be someone who never made selfish demands, who never cried or screamed--and locked his heart away.

lines.content: そうすれば、お母さんは迎えに来てくれる。そう信じた。
lines.translated: If he did that, his mother would come to take him away. That was what he believed.

lines.content: 私は、自分の姿を改めて見る。
lines.translated: I looked at my own appearance once again.

lines.content: ひらひらで。ふわふわで……。まっしろなドレス。
lines.translated: Frilly. Fluffy... A pure-white dress.

lines.content: この姿は“不安”な気持ちの表れだと、今になってようやく気づけた。
lines.translated: Only now did I finally realize that this appearance was a manifestation of my own "unease."

lines.content: 男の子の心に触れて、ようやく自分の心を知った――この姿は、お父さんの期待どおりに生きないとだめ。そうじゃない自分は愛されない。そういう不安の現れだった。
lines.translated: By touching the boy's heart, I finally understood my own--this form was the manifestation of my anxiety that I had to live up to my father's expectations, and that if I didn't, I wouldn't be loved.

lines.content: ……ばかみたいだよね。もう、この世界のどこにも私のお父さんはいないのに。それなのにまだ、昔々に投げかけられた言葉に、私はどこか怯えてる
lines.translated: "...It's foolish, isn't it? My father isn't anywhere in this world anymore. And yet, somewhere inside, I'm still afraid of the words cast upon me so long ago."

lines.content: 誰もが自分の心を通してでしか世界を見ることができない。
lines.translated: No one can see the world except through their own heart.

lines.content: そして心は、それまで投げかけられ、見つけてきた言葉でできてる。
lines.translated: And a heart is made of the words that have been cast upon it, and the words it has found up until then.

lines.content: うん。そうだね。私も……
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. I..."

lines.content: やっぱり私も、あなたと同じだ。
lines.translated: After all, I am just the same as you.

lines.content: 誰かの期待どおりの自分でいないと、ここにこうして生きている意味さえもらえないと、どこかで感じているのだろう――ばかみたいだなあと、思った。
lines.translated: Somewhere inside, I must have felt that unless I remained the person someone expected me to be, I wouldn't even be given a reason to live here like this--how foolish, I thought.

lines.content: 自分の人生は全部自分だけの時間だ。
lines.translated: One's own life is entirely one's own time.

lines.content: 誰かの機嫌を気にしたり。誰かの望みに振り回されたり。誰かの都合に浪費させられたり。
lines.translated: Worrying about someone else's mood. Being tossed around by someone else's desires. Having it wasted for someone else's convenience.

lines.content: そんな時間は、一秒だってもったいないから……。
lines.translated: Every single second spent like that is a waste, so...

lines.content: [・|私][・|も]、もう、誰かの期待どおりの自分はやめるよ
lines.translated: "I'm going to stop trying to be what someone else expects me to be, too."

lines.content: 大雅がくれた“大好き”の言葉が、私の世界を作ってる。そう実感できている――
lines.translated: The words "I love you" that Taiga gave me are what make up my world. I can truly feel that now--

lines.content: ……私はもう、この世界を救う代わりに、救ったはずの世界中から憎まれる――そんな“夜の女王”になるためには生きないよ
lines.translated: "...I won't live just to become the 'Queen of the Night' anymore--someone who saves this world, only to be hated by the very world she saved."

lines.content: そんな自分勝手な自分でいてもいい。
lines.translated: It's okay for me to be that selfish.

lines.content: 私は私の思うとおりに生きていていい。そんな私を“大好き”だと言い、愛してくれる人がいる。
lines.translated: It's okay for me to live the way I want to. There is someone who says "I love you" to that version of me, someone who loves me for who I am.

lines.content: ……そんな大雅の“想い”が、そして言葉が、私に安心をくれたのだ。
lines.translated: Those "feelings" of Taiga's, and his words, gave me peace of mind.

lines.content: それを私に実感させるそのために、大雅は“夜”から“外”へ、私を連れ出してくれたのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if Taiga brought me out from the "Night" to the "outside" just so I could truly realize that for myself.

lines.content: いつか“夜”で大雅と出会い、その答え合わせができる日を楽しみにしたい。
lines.translated: I want to look forward to the day I meet Taiga in the "Night" someday, when we can finally compare our answers.

lines.content: だけど今は、この子だ。
lines.translated: But right now, this child comes first.

lines.content: 大雅が地獄の底から連れ出したこの子に、僅かでも“夢”を残していきたかった。そうすることが遠い昔の自分自身の“さみしさ”に、本当の意味で決別できるような気がしてた。
lines.translated: For this boy whom Taiga brought out from the depths of hell, I wanted to leave behind even the slightest bit of a "dream." I felt that doing so would allow me to truly bid farewell to the "loneliness" of my own distant past.

lines.content: その決意表明というつもりも、少しはあって……、[・|瞼][・|を][・|閉][・|じ][・|る]。
lines.translated: With that partly intended as a declaration of my resolve... I close my eyes.

lines.content: ……うん。[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|感][・|じ]がたぶん、私らしいよね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Something like this is probably more like me, right?"

lines.content: ……思い描くのは一瞬だ。
lines.translated: It only takes an instant to picture it in my mind.

lines.content: 少しだけ、ぞくっとする。
lines.translated: I feel a slight shiver run through me.

lines.content: 感じられた変化はそれだけだった。
lines.translated: That was the only change I could feel.

lines.content: 閉じた[まぶた|瞼]越しにもわかるくらいの強い光りが弾けたり。
lines.translated: There was no burst of light bright enough to see through closed eyelids.

lines.content: 恥ずかしくなるような音楽なんて、もちろんない。
lines.translated: And of course, there wasn't any embarrassing music playing, either.

lines.content: ちゃんと上手にできたかな。自信はあんまりない。
lines.translated: I wonder if I pulled it off properly. I'm not very confident.

lines.content: 恐る恐る[まぶた|瞼]を開き……。
lines.translated: Timidly, I open my eyelids...

lines.content: あ、よかった。……うん。ちゃんとできてる
lines.translated: "Ah, thank goodness. ...Yeah. It worked properly."

lines.content: 管理室にあった小さな鏡を覗き見て、何度かうなずく。
lines.translated: Peeking into the small mirror in the caretaker's office, I nod a few times.

lines.content: そして男の子を振り向いた。
lines.translated: Then I turned back to face the boy.

lines.content: ど、どうかな。服、変えてみたんだけど……変じゃない？
lines.translated: "H-How does it look? I tried changing my clothes... Does it look weird?"

lines.content: くるりと回って見せたのは、照れくさい気持ちを隠したかったから。
lines.translated: The reason I did a little twirl to show him was to hide how embarrassed I felt.

lines.content: 今日一日、町を歩いていてね、今時の女の子っぽい衣装をいっぱい見たよ
lines.translated: "While walking around town all day today, I saw lots of fashionable, girly outfits."

lines.content: そんな服着てる自分も“想像”してはみたけれど……。でも、だめだね。私にはあんな短いスカートとか、想像しただけでも恥ずかしくなっちゃうくらい似合わないから
lines.translated: "I tried 'imagining' myself wearing clothes like that, too... But it's no good. Short skirts like those don't suit me to the point where just imagining it makes me feel embarrassed."

lines.content: 本当は目だつ服装は好きじゃない。
lines.translated: Truthfully, I don't like clothes that stand out.

lines.content: だからまっしろなドレスから、部屋着のような地味なものに変えた。髪型もちょっと変えてみた。
lines.translated: So I changed from the pure-white dress into something plain, almost like loungewear. I tried changing my hairstyle a little, too.

lines.content: あなた以外の誰に見られるわけでもないけれど……。あんな目だつ格好で町を歩くのはなんだかとっても恥ずかしかった
lines.translated: "It's not as if anyone other than you can see me, though... Walking around town in such a flashy outfit was somehow really embarrassing."

lines.content: それにね。ひらひらで。ふわふわで……。あんな丈の長いドレスじゃ歩きづらいし
lines.translated: "Besides, you know. With all those frills and fluff... a dress that long is hard to walk in, too."

lines.content: なんだか言い訳っぽく饒舌になってしまってる。そんな自分に気づいて、ますます恥ずかしくもなってしまった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I ended up chattering away as if making excuses. Realizing that only made me feel even more embarrassed.

lines.content: 男の子は首をかしげた――だったらどうして、あんな格好していたの？　そんな疑問が瞳には浮かんで見えた。
lines.translated: The boy tilted his head--Then why were you dressed like that in the first place? That was the question I saw floating in his eyes.

lines.content: う、うん……。たぶん、お父さんが、そういう私がかわいいって言ってくれたからだと思う
lines.translated: "W-Well... It's probably because my father told me I looked cute like that."

lines.content: 心の内を正直に話した。
lines.translated: I spoke honestly about what was in my heart.

lines.content: ……かわいいドレスがいつまでも似合う私でいてほしい。お父さんは、そういう私しか愛せない
lines.translated: "...He wanted me to always stay a girl who looked good in cute dresses. My father could only love me if I was like that."

lines.content: たぶんその言葉は冗談だったんだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Those words were probably meant as a joke, though...

lines.content: でも、小さな私は、その何気ない言葉を信じた。
lines.translated: Even so, my young self believed those casual words.

lines.content: 死んでしまった後になっても、お父さんの期待どおりの服を着て……。世界で一番好きだった人たちに、世界で一番、好きになってもらおうとがんばっていたけれど……
lines.translated: "Even after I died, I wore the clothes my father expected me to wear... I tried so hard to get the people I loved most in the world to love me the most in the world, too, but..."

lines.content: この服のほうが私らしいって自分では思うよ。だからこれはね、もう誰の期待どおりには生きないよって。そういう気持ちの証明のつもりかな
lines.translated: "I personally think these clothes are much more like me. So I guess you could say this is meant as proof of how I feel--that I won't live just to meet someone else's expectations anymore."

lines.content: これからは着たい服を着たいように着るし、なりたい自分になれるようにと願ってる。
lines.translated: From now on, I'll wear the clothes I want to wear the way I want to wear them, and I hope I can become the person I want to be.

lines.content: ……だからね、あなたも笑っていいんだよ。悲しいことがあったら泣けばいい。我がまま言って私をたくさん困らせたっていいんだよ
lines.translated: "...So you see, it's okay for you to smile, too. If something sad happens, it's okay to cry. It's even okay to be selfish and give me lots of trouble."

lines.content: ここにはそんなことくらいで、あなたのことを嫌いになるような人はどこにもいないよ
lines.translated: "There isn't a single person here who would come to hate you over something like that."

lines.content: ……え、ええっと。つまり、何が言いたいかって言うと……。うう。難しいけど
lines.translated: "...U-Um, well. In short, what I'm trying to say is... Ugh. It's hard to put into words, though."

lines.content: ちょっと迷って、私は言った。
lines.translated: After hesitating a little, I spoke.

lines.content: これからは、誰かの期待どおりじゃなくって、自分で自分に期待するどおりに生きていける。そんなすてきな大人になるために、私と一緒にがんばろうって。そう、言いたかったんだよ
lines.translated: "What I wanted to say is, let's do our best together so you can become a wonderful adult who lives not by someone else's expectations, but by the expectations you set for yourself from now on."

lines.content: 男の子のお腹が鳴った。
lines.translated: The boy's stomach growled.

lines.content: ううっ、そうだった……。ごめん。服よりもご飯だよね
lines.translated: "Ugh, that's right... Sorry. Food comes before clothes, doesn't it?"

lines.content: でももうすっかり夜だ。こんな時間で何か探しに行くわけにもいかないし……。
lines.translated: But it's already completely night. It's not like we can go out looking for something at this hour...

lines.content: あ、それ、どうしたの……？
lines.translated: "Oh, what's that...?"

lines.content: いつも男の子が腕に抱いていた黒い子猫が、何かを咥え、男の子の足下に立っていた。
lines.translated: The black kitten that the boy always held in his arms was standing at his feet with something in its mouth.

lines.content: 何か探しに行ってくれてたの？
lines.translated: "Did you go out looking for something for us?"

lines.content: いつの間に男の子の腕から離れ、外へ行き――そして何かを見つけ、戻ってきたのだろうか。
lines.translated: I wonder when it slipped out of the boy's arms to go outside--and found something before coming back.

lines.content: 男の子が、子猫の咥えていたものを受け取る。
lines.translated: The boy takes what the kitten was holding in its mouth.

lines.content: 銀色をした四角い板だ。
lines.translated: It's a silver, rectangular bar.

lines.content: その形には見覚えがある。
lines.translated: That shape looks familiar.

lines.content: えっと……ええっと……なんだっけ……
lines.translated: "Um... err... What was that called again..."

lines.content: 腕を組み、うんうん唸って……、薄らと思い出す。
lines.translated: Crossing my arms and groaning in thought... I faintly remember.

lines.content: ……あ、それってもしかして
lines.translated: "...Oh, could that be..."

lines.content: チョコレート……？
lines.translated: "Chocolate...?"

lines.content: そう私が問いかけるのに合わせ、パキッと音を立て、男の子がそれを半分に折った。
lines.translated: Right as I asked that, with a crisp snap, the boy broke it in half.

lines.content: ふ、ふわ～……甘い匂いだ……
lines.translated: "W-Whoa~... It smells so sweet..."

lines.content: 思わずうっとりしてしまう――すごい。私、“半透明”だけど匂いはわかるよ。
lines.translated: I can't help being enchanted by it--amazing. I may be "translucent," but I can still smell it.

lines.content: ちょっぴりビターな大人の味だね。うん。きっとそう。……すごいっ。あなたの子猫はすごい子だね。たった一匹で、こんな美味しそうな宝物、見つけて来ちゃったよ
lines.translated: "It's a slightly bitter, grown-up taste, isn't it? Yeah, I'm sure of it. ...Amazing! Your kitten is such a clever little thing. All by itself, it went and found such a delicious-looking treasure."

lines.content: 男の子が折った半分を差し出してくれた。
lines.translated: The boy held out the broken half to me.

lines.content: いいの……？
lines.translated: "Are you sure...?"

lines.content: 驚いて、言う。
lines.translated: Surprised, I ask him.

lines.content: ……そんなすごい宝物、私にも分けてくれるの？
lines.translated: "...You're willing to share such an amazing treasure with me?"

lines.content: もちろんだよと言うように、男の子はうなずいた。
lines.translated: As if to say "Of course," the boy nodded.

lines.content: わ～……ありがとう！
lines.translated: "Wow~... Thank you!"

lines.content: うれしいなあ、すごいなあ、“夢”がひとつ、叶ったよ。
lines.translated: I'm so happy, this is so wonderful. One of my "dreams" has come true.

lines.content: ……でも、うん。できれば大雅とも一緒に、食べたかったなあ
lines.translated: "...Still, yeah. If possible, I would've loved to eat this together with Taiga, too."

lines.content: 私は男の子に“あーん”ってしてもらい、チョコレートを口に運んでもらったけれど……。
lines.translated: I had the boy feed me with an "aah," bringing the chocolate to my mouth, but...

lines.content: ううう……っ。お口の中に入んないよ……っ
lines.translated: "Ugh...! It won't go into my mouth...!"

lines.content: 何となく想像したとおりの結果だった。
lines.translated: It was more or less the result I had imagined.

lines.content: いいよ、いいよ。気にしないで全部食べちゃって。溶けちゃったらもったいないよ
lines.translated: "It's okay, really. Don't worry about me and eat it all up. It'd be a waste if it melted."

lines.content: なんだか申し訳なさそうに、男の子はチョコレートを少しずつ口に運んだ。
lines.translated: Looking somewhat apologetic, the boy brought the chocolate to his mouth little by little.

lines.content: そのカケラを少し、子猫にも分けてあげている。
lines.translated: He shared a tiny piece of it with the kitten, too.

lines.content: 子猫は、チョコのカケラをぺろぺろ舐めているけれど……。
lines.translated: The kitten is licking the piece of chocolate, though...

lines.content: あれ。
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 猫にチョコレートって、あげてもいいんだったっけ。
lines.translated: Wait, is it actually okay to feed chocolate to a cat?

lines.content: そんな疑問も湧くけれど……、うう……っ。
lines.translated: That question pops into my head, too, but... ugh...

lines.content: いいなあー、いいなあー、私も一緒にチョコレート、食べたいなあ
lines.translated: "I'm so jealous, so jealous. I wish I could eat chocolate with you guys, too."

lines.content: 頬を膨らませてぶうたれてみた。
lines.translated: I puffed out my cheeks and pouted.

lines.content: そんな私に、男の子が小さく微笑んだように、私には見えた。
lines.translated: To my eyes, it looked as though the boy gave a small smile at seeing me like that.

lines.content: 次の日も私たちは町を歩いて回った。
lines.translated: The next day, we walked around the town again.

lines.content: 探しているのは男の子のお母さん。そのお家。
lines.translated: What we're looking for is the boy's mother. And their house.

lines.content: 手がかりは殆どなかった。
lines.translated: There were hardly any clues.

lines.content: ……私が男の子の心に触れて見た、お母さんの顔と声。それだけが唯一の手がかりだ。
lines.translated: His mother's face and voice, which I saw when I touched the boy's heart. Those are our only clues.

lines.content: 男の子のお家もぼんやりとは見えた。
lines.translated: I had caught a faint glimpse of the boy's house, too.

lines.content: でもその道筋はわからない。きっと男の子がそれを覚えていないか、どうしても思い出せないからだろう。
lines.translated: But I don't know the way there. It's probably because the boy either doesn't remember it or just can't recall it no matter how hard he tries.

lines.content: ……うー。いいなあ、いいなあ、ソフトクリーム。私も一緒に食べたいなあ
lines.translated: "...Ugh. I'm so jealous, so jealous of that soft-serve ice cream. I want to eat some together with you, too."

lines.content: ちょっと休憩しようかと立ち寄ったのは、昨日と同じ公園だ。
lines.translated: Thinking we should take a little break, we stopped by the same park as yesterday.

lines.content: 男の子は町を見渡せる位置にあるベンチに座り、ソフトクリームを美味しそうに少しずつ舐めていた。その様子をすぐ隣でうらめしそうに見つめる私だ。
lines.translated: The boy sat on a bench overlooking the town, deliciously licking the soft-serve ice cream little by little. And right next to him was me, staring at it enviously.

lines.content: 甘くて美味しそうなそれに視線は釘付け。きっと[よだれ|涎]も垂れてた。
lines.translated: My eyes were glued to that sweet, delicious-looking treat. I was probably drooling, too.

lines.content: そんな私に男の子が、ソフトクリームの先をそっと差し出してくれる。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, the boy gently held out the tip of the soft-serve ice cream toward me.

lines.content: わーいっ、いいの……っ、ありがとうっ
lines.translated: "Yay! Are you sure...? Thank you!"

lines.content: なんてはしゃいでみたりして、わくわくしながらあ～んって、してみるけれど……、
lines.translated: Acting all excited like that, I eagerly opened my mouth with an "aah~", only for...

lines.content: 男の子はしゅんとする。
lines.translated: The boy's shoulders drooped dejectedly.

lines.content: やっぱり“半透明”な私には、差し出した甘くて美味しいソフトクリームは食べられなかったから。
lines.translated: Because, sure enough, being "translucent," I couldn't eat the sweet, delicious soft-serve ice cream he held out to me.

lines.content: ごめんね。……そんな顔しないで。すっごく美味しそうだったから……つい、食べられないのわかってるのに、ふざけてみたくなっちゃっただけなんだ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. ...Don't make that face. It just looked so delicious... Even though I knew I couldn't eat it, I couldn't help wanting to play around a little."

lines.content: そんなことより私はね、無表情で無口なあなただけれど、それでも、あなたの微かな表情とか感情の変化を少しでも感じ取れるようになったことが、うれしいよ。
lines.translated: More importantly, even though you're so expressionless and quiet, I'm just really happy that I've become able to pick up on the faint changes in your expressions and feelings, even just a little.

lines.content: 私たちの間にそんな空気が生まれたのは、私の心に何か変化があったのか、それとも男の子のほうに何かがあったのか――わからないけれど。
lines.translated: Whether this atmosphere between us was born from some change in my own heart, or if something happened on the boy's side--I don't know, though.

lines.content: 昨晩一緒に話した時間が、その原因のひとつなら少しうれしい。そんなことを思う。
lines.translated: If the time we spent talking together last night was one of the reasons for it, that makes me a little happy. That's what I think to myself.

lines.content: 公園にはいくつかの屋台が並んでいた。
lines.translated: Several food stalls were lined up in the park.

lines.content: ソフトクリームはそこで購入した。
lines.translated: That was where we bought the soft-serve ice cream.

lines.content: 昨晩から今朝にかけ、男の子の子猫が、どこからか色々と必要なものを集めてくるようになった。
lines.translated: Between last night and this morning, the boy's kitten had started gathering various necessities from who knows where.

lines.content: お金もそこに含まれていて、小銭ばかりではあったけど、小さな男の子の小さなお腹を満たすには充分な食べ物くらいは購入できた。
lines.translated: Money was included among those things, and although it was nothing but loose change, it was enough to buy plenty of food to fill a little boy's small stomach.

lines.content: 私は、男の子がひとりで買い物できるかどうかそばで見ていた。
lines.translated: I watched from beside him to see if the boy could shop on his own.

lines.content: この子は賢い。
lines.translated: This child is smart.

lines.content: ソフトクリームを買うときも、ちゃんと求められただけの小銭を差し出した。百円玉三枚と、五十円玉一枚だ。
lines.translated: Even when buying the soft-serve ice cream, he properly held out the exact amount of change requested. Three hundred-yen coins and one fifty-yen coin.

lines.content: すごいね。ひとりでお買い物なんて。私があなたくらいの歳にはそんなことまだできなかったよ
lines.translated: "That's amazing, shopping all by yourself. When I was around your age, I couldn't do anything like that yet."

lines.content: 私ね、小さな頃は百円玉が一枚あればお金持ちだって思ってたんだよ。だって銀色でぴかぴかしてるんだもん。絵本の中の王子さまは銀色の硬貨で、お馬さんをいっぱい買ってたし……
lines.translated: "You know, when I was little, I thought having just one hundred-yen coin made you rich. Because it's silver and so shiny. And the prince in my picture book bought lots of horses with silver coins..."

lines.content: だからね。お小遣いで百円玉を二枚ももらえてた私は……
lines.translated: "So, you see. Getting two whole hundred-yen coins for my allowance meant that I..."

lines.content: まだ[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]がやさしかった頃、まだ私の身体が、元気だった頃――
lines.translated: Back when the two of them were still kind, back when my body was still healthy--

lines.content: どうしよう、実は王子さまくらいお金持ちかもしれないって思ってね、どきどきして眠れなくなるらい――[なん|何]にも知らないおばかちゃんだったんだよ
lines.translated: "I thought, 'What should I do? Maybe I'm actually as rich as a prince!' and my heart raced so much I couldn't sleep--I was such a silly girl who didn't know anything."

lines.content: 首をかしげる男の子だった。
lines.translated: The boy tilted his head.

lines.content: その膝に丸くなっている小さな黒猫。ちらりと私のほうを見て、興味なさげにあくびをし――もぞもぞと更に小さく丸くなっていた。
lines.translated: Curled up on his lap was the small black cat. It glanced my way, gave an uninterested yawn--and wriggled around to curl up into an even smaller ball.

lines.content: そんな黒猫をじっと見る。
lines.translated: I stared closely at the black cat.

lines.content: その視線にすぐに気づいて、居心地悪そうに、ちらちらと、子猫は私を見ていた。
lines.translated: Quickly noticing my gaze, the kitten kept glancing at me uneasily.

lines.content: あなたは……
lines.translated: "You are..."

lines.content: 私は、子猫に話しかける。
lines.translated: I spoke to the kitten.

lines.content: あなたは“夜のイキモノ”だね。ふつうの子猫じゃない、よね
lines.translated: "You're a 'Creature of the Night,' aren't you? You're not a normal kitten, right?"

lines.content: 何となくそうじゃないかとは最初から思ってた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I had suspected as much from the very beginning.

lines.content: だからあなたには私が見えるし、私の声も言葉も、届いてる。……そうだよね？
lines.translated: "That's why you can see me, and my voice and words reach you. ...Right?"

lines.content: ちらりとまたこちらを見た。
lines.translated: It glanced my way again.

lines.content: 何か話してくれるかなと期待したけれど……。
lines.translated: I hoped it might say something to me, however...

lines.content: やっぱり何も言わず、たった一言鳴くこともせず、そっぽを向くようにして[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Sure enough, without saying a word or letting out even a single meow, it turned away and closed its eyelids.

lines.content: 子猫に聞いてみたいことはいっぱいあった。
lines.translated: There were so many things I wanted to ask the kitten.

lines.content: どうしてこの男の子と一緒にいるのか。あなたにとってこの子はどういう人間なのか。
lines.translated: Why was it together with this boy? What kind of person was this child to it?

lines.content: ……色々だ。
lines.translated: All sorts of things.

lines.content: でも子猫のほうは私にいっさい興味がなさそう。
lines.translated: But the kitten seemed to have no interest in me whatsoever.

lines.content: 男の子がソフトクリームを食べ終えると、子猫はふと首をもたげた。
lines.translated: Once the boy finished eating his soft-serve ice cream, the kitten suddenly raised its head.

lines.content: 小さくちいさく、にゃあと鳴く。
lines.translated: It let out a tiny, tiny meow.

lines.content: かわいい声だった。
lines.translated: It had a cute voice.

lines.content: すると男の子がまたしっかりと、子猫を抱き上げ、その両腕で大切そうに抱きしめた。
lines.translated: Then the boy scooped the kitten up firmly again, holding it preciously in both arms.

lines.content: 子猫は抱きしめられた腕の中で、ご機嫌そうに目を細め、咽を微かに鳴らしてもいた。
lines.translated: In the embrace of his arms, the kitten narrowed its eyes contentedly, even purring faintly in its throat.

lines.content: そっか。そこがあなたのお気に入りなんだね
lines.translated: "I see. So that's your favorite spot, huh?"

lines.content: 抱きしめられるのが大好きな気持ちは、なんだかわかるよ――子猫なあなたが、男の子に呼びかけるみたいに鳴いたさっきの声。かわいい色の声だった。
lines.translated: I think I kind of understand that feeling of loving to be held--that voice you let out just now as a kitten, meowing as if calling out to the boy. It was a voice with a cute color.

lines.content: それだけで、わかる。[あなた|子猫]は男の子のことが大好きなんだね。
lines.translated: Just from that, I can tell. You really love the boy, don't you, little kitten?

lines.content: まだまだあなたも、あなたが大好きなのだろう男の子のことも、よくわからないことだらけだけど……。だけど今は、子猫の“想い”がわかっただけでいいことにした。
lines.translated: There are still so many things I don't understand about you, and about the boy you must love so much, too... But for now, I decided that just understanding the kitten's "feelings" was enough.

lines.content: 屋台はソフトクリームだけじゃなく、たこ焼きやかき氷などを売るものも並んでいた。
lines.translated: The stalls lined up weren't just selling soft-serve ice cream, but also things like takoyaki and shaved ice.

lines.content: どうやら花見客をターゲットにしただけでなく、数日後にお祭りが控えているようだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, they weren't just targeting cherry blossom viewers; it seemed a festival was coming up in a few days.

lines.content: 公園だけでなく町中に、それを知らせるポスターが張ってあるのを何度も見かけた。
lines.translated: Not only in the park, but all over town, I had seen posters put up to announce it many times.

lines.content: んー……。あなたの子猫ちゃんが拾ってきてくれたお金、まだ少し残ってるね。どうしよっか。たこ焼きとかも買えるよ。ソフトクリームだけじゃお腹空かない？
lines.translated: "Hmm... There's still a little bit of the money your kitten picked up for you left over, isn't there? What should we do? We could buy some takoyaki or something, too. Won't you still be hungry with just soft-serve ice cream?"

lines.content: 男の子は首を振る。
lines.translated: The boy shook his head.

lines.content: 男の子の胸元に抱かれた子猫の鈴がちりんと鳴った。
lines.translated: The bell on the kitten held against the boy's chest gave a little jingle.

lines.content: そっか。えらいね。お金は大事だもん。節約しなきゃだね
lines.translated: "I see. Good boy. Money is important, after all. We have to be thrifty."

lines.content: ……でも、無理もだめだよ。ちゃんと食べなきゃ力が出ないんじゃないかな。お母さんを探しに歩いて行けなくなっちゃったら大変だよ
lines.translated: "...Still, don't push yourself too hard, okay? If you don't eat properly, you won't have any energy. It'd be terrible if you couldn't walk around looking for your mom anymore."

lines.content: 男の子は目を細める。町の景色に視線を投げ、じっと見ていた。
lines.translated: The boy narrowed his eyes. He cast his gaze over the view of the town, staring at it intently.

lines.content: あなたのお母さん。どこにいるんだろうね。早く見つかったらいいね
lines.translated: "Your mom. I wonder where she is. I hope we find her soon."

lines.content: あのね。もし嫌なこと聞いてたら、ごめんね
lines.translated: "Hey. If I'm asking something you don't want to talk about, I'm sorry, okay?"

lines.content: 男の子が私を見上げる。色のない瞳に見つめられ、私は微笑みながら、言う。
lines.translated: The boy looked up at me. Gazed at by those colorless eyes, I smiled and spoke.

lines.content: ……お母さんに会えたら、どうしたい？　何か言いたいこととか、やってもらいたいこととか、あるのかな
lines.translated: "...When you get to see your mom, what do you want to do? Is there anything you want to say to her, or anything you want her to do for you?"

lines.content: 男の子は、抱いていた子猫をぎゅっとした――抱きしめてもらいたい。ただ、それだけ。そんな小さな“[・|想][・|い]”[・|を][・|見][・|た]気がした。
lines.translated: The boy gave the kitten he was holding a tight squeeze--he wanted to be hugged. Just that. I felt like I saw that small "feeling" of his.

lines.content: どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder why.

lines.content: 私の“半透明”な胸の奥がずきりと痛んだ。
lines.translated: Deep inside my "translucent" chest, a sharp pain throbbed.

lines.content: おかしいよね
lines.translated: "It's strange, isn't it?"

lines.content: ため息をつき、言った。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh and spoke.

lines.content: ……そうだよ。おかしいよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It's strange."

lines.content: こんなに、こんなに、あなたが会いたいって思ってるのに。それなのに、あなたの会いたい大切な人に、その“想い”は、中々届いてくれない
lines.translated: "Even though you want to see her this much, this badly. Even so, those 'feelings' of yours just won't easily reach the precious person you want to see."

lines.content: もしも男の子の“お母さんに会いたい”という“想い”が、言葉にせずとも、誰の目にも明らかな“形”になれば……。
lines.translated: If only the boy's "feeling" of "wanting to see his mom" could take on a "form" obvious to anyone's eyes, without needing to be put into words...

lines.content: 男の子のお母さんは、すぐにでも男の子のことを見つけてくれるんじゃないだろうか――嫌な大人が言う“我がまま”だなんて、そんなもの、笑顔で許してくれるんじゃないだろうか。
lines.translated: Wouldn't the boy's mother find him right away?--Wouldn't she forgive what unpleasant adults call "selfishness" with a smile?

lines.content: もどかしいよね。……すごく
lines.translated: "It's frustrating, isn't it? ...So very much."

lines.content: どうして“想い”は目に見えないのだろう。この世界には、目に見えないのに大切なものが多く、溢れてる。
lines.translated: Why are "feelings" invisible to the eye? This world is overflowing with so many things that are precious, yet invisible.

lines.content: 懸命に伝えようとする言葉だけでは、決して言い表せない“想い”が、もしも目に見えるものならば……。
lines.translated: If the "feelings" that can never be fully expressed through words alone, no matter how hard we try to convey them, were something visible to the eye...

lines.content: もっともっと人とひとは、心と心は、大切に繋がりあえることも増えるんじゃないだろうか。
lines.translated: Wouldn't people, and their hearts, be able to connect with each other in a precious way so much more often?

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: だから昔から人間は、言葉だけでは表せない“想い”を絵にしたり、物語にしたり、歌にしたりして、大切な人へ届けようとしたのかもしれないな。
lines.translated: Maybe that's why, since long ago, humans have tried to turn the "feelings" that can't be expressed in words alone into paintings, into stories, and into songs, to deliver them to the people precious to them.

lines.content: そう思うと……。
lines.translated: When I think of it that way...

lines.content: 不思議だな。
lines.translated: It's strange.

lines.content: そうしたたくさんの“想い”が重なりできている――そんなこの世界がとても愛しく、眩しいもののように見えてしまった。
lines.translated: Made up of so many of those overlapping "feelings"--this world ended up looking so very dear, and so dazzling to me.

lines.content: 本当はとても残酷で。とても、冷たい。そしてさみしい。
lines.translated: In truth, it's very cruel. Very cold. And lonely.

lines.content: そんな“想い”ばかりがここには降り重なっているけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though nothing but "feelings" like those are piled up here...

lines.content: 悲しみやさみしさの中にこそ、うつくしく輝く“光り”と“未来”があるのだと信じたい。
lines.translated: I want to believe that it is precisely within sadness and loneliness that a beautifully shining "light" and "future" exist.

lines.content: そういうふうに感じる“想い”を、昔々の誰かは“希望”とか“夢”だとか。……“愛”とか“勇気”だとか。そんな名前を付けて呼んだのかもしれないな。
lines.translated: Maybe someone long, long ago took the "feelings" that make you feel that way and gave them names like "hope" or "dreams"... or "love" or "courage."

lines.content: ……だ、なんて。
lines.translated: As if.

lines.content: 大人たちが聞いたら失笑されそうなことを平気で思える私はやっぱり、まだまだ子どもで……。
lines.translated: Being able to casually think things that would make adults laugh if they heard them means that, sure enough, I'm still very much a child...

lines.content: そんな自分が結構、私は嫌いじゃないかな。
lines.translated: And I don't think I really dislike that part of myself.

lines.content: よし。それじゃあ休憩はこれくらいにして、今日もあともう少しだけ、歩いてみよう
lines.translated: "Alright. Let's wrap up our break here and walk around just a little more today."

lines.content: まだあそこら辺は探してないよね。と、私は町を指さした。
lines.translated: "We haven't searched around that area yet, right?" I said, pointing toward the town.

lines.content: 今日も一日町を歩き回って……夜になり、私たちは時計塔の管理室に戻ってきた。
lines.translated: After walking around town all day again today... night fell, and we returned to the clock tower's office.

lines.content: 開かれた窓から外を見る――“夜”よりもせわしなく、鋭い光りの瞬く夜だ。
lines.translated: I looked outside through the open window--it was a night more restless than the "Night," twinkling with sharp lights.

lines.content: “探し物は見つけにくいものなのだから、いくら探してみてもそう簡単には見つからない”――そういうふうに歌われた歌を、どこかで幾度となく聞いたことがあった。
lines.translated: "'Because lost things are hard to find, no matter how much you look for them, they won't be found so easily'--somewhere, I had heard a song sung like that many times."

lines.content: それはきっと誰もが知ってるはずの名曲だった。
lines.translated: It was surely a famous song that everyone must know.

lines.content: ……[・|歌]は色々なことを教えてくれる。
lines.translated: Songs teach us all sorts of things.

lines.content: この歌を作った人はいったい、この世界の中にどんな宝物を探していたんだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of treasure in this world was the person who wrote this song looking for, I wonder?

lines.content: あなたのお母さんのお家、見つけられたね。がんばって歩いた成果だって思ってもいいかな
lines.translated: "We found your mom's house, didn't we? I wonder if we can think of it as the result of us working hard and walking so much."
That's right. We found the treasure we had been searching for.

lines.content: ……でももう、引っ越しちゃってる後みたいだったね
lines.translated: "...Though it looked like she had already moved away."

lines.content: 見つけられたのは宝箱だけ。肝心な箱の中は空っぽだった。
lines.translated: All we managed to find was the treasure chest. The crucial inside of the chest was empty.

lines.content: チャイムを鳴らしてみても、誰も、応えてくれなかったし……
lines.translated: "Even when we rang the doorbell, nobody answered..."

lines.content: あなたと子猫と、そして私……。[・|三][・|人]で窓から家の中を覗き込んでみた。
lines.translated: You, the kitten, and me... The three of us peered inside the house through the window.

lines.content: そこには家具もなにもなく、生活の気配は感じられなかった。
lines.translated: There was no furniture or anything in there, and no sign of life could be felt.

lines.content: その家を見つけたのは子猫だ。男の子がいつも抱いて歩いている黒い猫。
lines.translated: The one who found that house was the kitten. The black cat the boy always carries in his arms as he walks.

lines.content: ……公園での休憩を終えた後、町を歩いた。
lines.translated: After finishing our break at the park, we walked through the town.

lines.content: かつては活気があったのだろう商店街や、石の階段をたくさんのぼった先にある立派な神社。
lines.translated: A shopping district that must have once been lively, and a magnificent shrine at the top of a long flight of stone steps.

lines.content: 通りすがるそれらは全部、こぼれ落ちそうなほどいっぱいのさくら色に満たされている。
lines.translated: Everything we passed by was filled to the brim with cherry-blossom pink, almost overflowing.

lines.content: 満開の春に彩られた町並みには、決して私たちには関わることのできない――
lines.translated: In the townscape colored by spring in full bloom, when I thought about how the lives of people whom we could never get involved with--

lines.content: どころか知ることさえないのだろう人々の人生が、幾重にも折り重なっているのかと思うと、不思議な気持ちにもなった。
lines.translated: Or rather, whom we would probably never even know, were layered upon one another so many times over, it gave me a strange feeling.

lines.content: 神社は、町の人たちが共同で管理するようになって長いのだと、石段の麓に立てられた看板には書かれてあった。
lines.translated: According to a sign standing at the base of the stone steps, the shrine had long since come to be jointly managed by the townspeople.

lines.content: 今はもうここに住む神主だったり巫女だったりはいないようだけど……。
lines.translated: It seemed there were no longer any priests or shrine maidens living here now, though...

lines.content: 男の子のお母さんが早く見つかりますようにと並んで祈り、賽銭箱には男の子が、残った小銭の中から十円玉と五円玉を一枚ずつ入れていた。
lines.translated: Standing side by side, we prayed that the boy's mother would be found soon, and from his remaining loose change, the boy dropped one ten-yen coin and one five-yen coin into the offering box.

lines.content: 『あ、それ知ってるよ。五円と十円が一枚ずつで、“[ごえん|御縁]が充分ありますように”っていうおまじないだよね』
lines.translated: "'Oh, I know that one! One five-yen coin and one ten-yen coin is a good-luck charm asking for "plenty of good fortune and connections," right?'"

lines.content: なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 得意そうに言っちゃったのは、物知りなところを見せて、ちょっとお姉さんぶりたいところもあったのだ。
lines.translated: The reason I said it so proudly was partly because I wanted to show off how knowledgeable I was and act a little like an older sister.

lines.content: でも、男の子はいつものように何も言わず無表情なまま、ただ首をかしげるだけだった。
lines.translated: However, just like always, the boy said nothing and remained expressionless, merely tilting his head.

lines.content: 神社の石段を降りきると、男の子の腕から子猫がぴょんと飛び降り、どこかへとてとて走って行ってしまった。
lines.translated: Once we made it all the way down the shrine's stone steps, the kitten hopped right out of the boy's arms and pattered off, running somewhere.

lines.content: 男の子と一緒に追いかけた先には、閉店してしまったお店が軒をずらりと並べる、さっき通ったのとは別の商店街があった。
lines.translated: Chasing after it together with the boy led us to a different shopping district from the one we had passed through earlier, lined with row after row of shuttered shops.

lines.content: すっかり廃れてしまった喫茶店の前を通る。
lines.translated: We passed in front of a completely run-down cafe.

lines.content: お店の中には、立派な蓄音機がひとつと、レコードがたくさん並ぶ棚が、窓越しに見えた。
lines.translated: Through the window, we could see a single magnificent gramophone inside the shop, along with shelves lined with lots of records.

lines.content: なんだか懐かしい気持ちになる。
lines.translated: It made me feel somewhat nostalgic.

lines.content: “夜”の中ではいつも“歌”を聞いていた。
lines.translated: Inside the "Night," I was always listening to "songs."

lines.content: 時計塔の管理室で音楽に心を澄ませ、本を読み、物語を見上げた小さな天井に思い描いていた。
lines.translated: In the clock tower's office, I would quiet my heart to the music, read books, and picture the stories across the small ceiling above me.

lines.content: まだ“夜”から“外”へ出て数日と経っていないのに、もう随分と“歌”を聴いていないし、物語にも絵にも触れていないなあと思ってしまう――思えば“夜”は様々な色で満たされていた。
lines.translated: Even though only a few days had passed since we left the "Night" for the "Outside," I found myself thinking that it had already been quite a while since I listened to a "song," or touched a story or a painting--come to think of it, the "Night" had been filled with all kinds of colors.

lines.content: “外”はやっぱりなんだかさみしい。音も光りも色彩も。少し、少ない。
lines.translated: The "Outside" really did feel somewhat lonely. The sounds, the light, and the colors. There were just a little fewer of them.

lines.content: ふと、ため息をついてしまったところで……。
lines.translated: Just as I let out a sudden sigh...

lines.content: 子猫が数メートル先にちょこんと座り、私たちを待っていた。
lines.translated: The kitten was sitting primly a few meters ahead, waiting for us.

lines.content: 駆け足で追いつくと、更にまた子猫は歩いて行き――裏路地をいくつか曲がり、進んでいった先に、その家はあった。
lines.translated: When we jogged to catch up, the kitten started walking again--turning down several back alleys, and at the end of where it led us stood that house.

lines.content: ごくふつうの住宅だった。
lines.translated: It was a completely ordinary home.

lines.content: 特別、何か際立つ特徴があるわけでもない。
lines.translated: There wasn't anything particularly striking about it.

lines.content: でも見覚えのある家だった。
lines.translated: Yet it was a house I recognized.

lines.content: 男の子の心に触れた際、見たものと良くよく似ていた。
lines.translated: It closely resembled what I had seen when I touched the boy's heart.

lines.content: ちらりと隣の男の子の顔を見る。
lines.translated: I glanced at the face of the boy beside me.

lines.content: するとその瞳の中に“ここが、ぼくの家だ”――そういう“想い”を、私は見たのだった。
lines.translated: And in his eyes, I saw that "feeling"--"This is my house."

lines.content: ねえ。あなたは、男の子のお家の場所、知ってたのかな
lines.translated: "Hey. Did you know where the boy's house was?"

lines.content: 子猫に問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: I tried asking the kitten.

lines.content: だけどやっぱり私には興味がないようだ。にゃあとも鳴かず、ただそっぽを向くだけだった。
lines.translated: However, it still didn't seem to have any interest in me. Without so much as a meow, it simply looked the other way.

lines.content: 男の子は膝の上に座る子猫の身体を、ゆっくり、丁寧に撫で続けていた。
lines.translated: The boy continued to slowly and carefully stroke the body of the kitten sitting on his lap.

lines.content: ごろごろと咽を鳴らす子猫の存在に、何か、理由のない安心をもらえないかと、そう祈っているようにもなぜだか私には見えてしまった。
lines.translated: For some reason, it looked to me as though he were praying that the presence of the purring kitten might grant him some kind of groundless peace of mind.

lines.content: これからどうしようか。
lines.translated: What should we do from here on?

lines.content: そんなこと言えもせず――窓の外に、ふと視線を投げた。
lines.translated: Unable to even voice such a question--I cast my gaze out the window.

lines.content: 淡い瞬きを繰り返す夜の景色がそこにはある。
lines.translated: Out there lay a nightscape repeating its faint twinkling.

lines.content: でももう、この景色の中に“宝物”はないのだとわかってしまった。
lines.translated: But I now knew that the "treasure" was no longer within this scenery.

lines.content: そんな“答え”だけが、淡い光りの中に瞬いているようにも思えた。
lines.translated: It felt as if only that "answer" was flickering amid the faint light.

lines.content: 男の子が急に立ち上がり、窓をぱたりと、締めてしまった。
lines.translated: The boy suddenly stood up and shut the window with a click.

lines.content: ……どうしたの？
lines.translated: "...What's wrong?"

lines.content: そう問いかける私を、男の子は振り返り、
lines.translated: As I asked that, the boy looked back at me,

lines.content: ふるふると、首を横に振った。
lines.translated: and shook his head from side to side.

lines.content: そして私の目をじっと見、また首を振るのだった。
lines.translated: Then he stared straight into my eyes and shook his head once more.

lines.content: 最初は、何を言いたいのかわからなかったけれど……“もう、いいよ”
lines.translated: At first, I didn't know what he was trying to say, but..."It's okay now."

lines.content: 男の子はそう言いたいのではないかと、私には思えた……“もういいよ。ありがとう”
lines.translated: It felt to me like that was what the boy wanted to say..."It's okay now. Thank you."

lines.content: “ぼくのお母さんはこの町にはもういない”
lines.translated: "My mom isn't in this town anymore."

lines.content: 聞こえないはずの声が、見えないはずの“想い”が、手に取るように感じられてしまった。
lines.translated: A voice I shouldn't have been able to hear, and "feelings" I shouldn't have been able to see, could be felt as clearly as if I were holding them in my hands.

lines.content: それは気のせいかもしれないし、ただの思い込みかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: It might have just been my imagination, or maybe just wishful thinking, though...

lines.content: そのとき男の子が、無言のままに浮かべた微かな表情が……。
lines.translated: The faint expression that surfaced on the boy's face in silence at that moment...

lines.content: どうしようもなく、私の胸の奥をずきりとさせた。
lines.translated: Sent an unbearable, sharp pang deep into my chest.

lines.content: 小さな窓枠に腰掛けて、夜の景色を眺めていた。
lines.translated: Sitting on the small windowsill, I gazed out at the night scenery.

lines.content: 男の子は子猫と一緒に、テーブルの下で眠りについている。
lines.translated: The boy was fast asleep under the table along with the kitten.

lines.content: “夜”の中ではここに座って、大雅と色々な話をしたなあと思い出す。
lines.translated: I remembered how, inside the "Night," I used to sit right here and talk about all sorts of things with Taiga.

lines.content: 覚悟を決めたはずだった。
lines.translated: I was supposed to have made up my mind.

lines.content: 様々な覚悟をだ。
lines.translated: To have resolved myself to all sorts of things.

lines.content: それなのに今、どうして私はここにいるんだっけ。
lines.translated: And yet, why am I here right now?

lines.content: ……どうして、今、私の隣にはあなたがいないんだったっけ。
lines.translated: Why aren't you beside me right now, again?

lines.content: ずきりと胸が痛むのは、さみしさからか、悲しさからか……。
lines.translated: Was this sharp ache in my chest coming from loneliness, or from sadness...?

lines.content: そういった言葉にしづらい“想い”を、忘れることなんてやっぱりできず――眠る必要もない私は、ただただじっと、夜の底で眠りについた町を眺める。
lines.translated: Still unable to forget those hard-to-put-into-words "feelings"--I, who didn't even need to sleep, simply stared motionlessly out at the town slumbering at the bottom of the night.

lines.content: この町に、男の子のお母さんはいなかった。それがここ数日に渡る、私たちの宝探しの結果だ。
lines.translated: The boy's mother wasn't in this town. That was the result of our treasure hunt over the past few days.

lines.content: たどり着いた家のあの様子では、もう随分前に引っ越していったのだろうと感じる。
lines.translated: Judging by the state of the house we finally reached, I felt she must have moved away quite a long time ago.

lines.content: ……もう、私の役目は終わったのかな
lines.translated: "...I wonder if my role is already over."

lines.content: ううん……
役目、だなんて。
lines.translated: Calling it a "role."

lines.content: そもそも誰に頼まれたでも、願われたでもなくて
lines.translated: "In the first place, nobody asked me to do this, and nobody wished for it."

lines.content: ……ただ私が勝手に、あの男の子のそばにくっついていただけだよね。誰かが私を必要としてるわけでもないのに
lines.translated: "...I was just sticking by that boy's side all on my own, wasn't I? Even though nobody actually needs me."

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: ……いつか“夜”でまた大雅と逢えたら、よろこんでくれるんじゃないかって、思って
lines.translated: "...I just thought that if I ever met Taiga again in the 'Night' someday, it might make him happy."

lines.content: あなたの笑顔ならどんなふうにしたって、ひとつでも多く見つめていたい。
lines.translated: When it comes to your smile, no matter what it takes, I want to gaze at even one more of them.

lines.content: 大雅が助けたこの子を、最後まで、助けきることができたなら……。
lines.translated: If I could see things through to the very end and finish saving this child whom Taiga saved...

lines.content: そうすることで、大雅がこの世界に生きたことの証明になるような気がして……。
lines.translated: I felt like doing so would become proof that Taiga had lived in this world...

lines.content: もう、いいよね。これ以上、私は何もできない
lines.translated: "It's enough now, right? I can't do anything more than this."

lines.content: 男の子の手に託された大雅の“力”
lines.translated: Taiga's "power" entrusted to the boy's hand.

lines.content: それを受け取り“夜”へと戻ろう。
lines.translated: I'll receive it and return to the "Night."

lines.content: “お母さんに会いたい”――男の子の願いだ。
lines.translated: "I want to see my mom"--that was the boy's wish.

lines.content: “お母さんに抱きしめてもらいたい”――男の子の祈りだ。
lines.translated: "I want my mom to hug me"--that was the boy's prayer.

lines.content: それらはすべて叶わないと、わかったから。
lines.translated: Because we had learned that none of those would come true.

lines.content: その結末もまた、ひとつの結果だ。
lines.translated: That ending, too, was a result in itself.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: 何気なく名前を呼んでみただけのつもりだった。
lines.translated: I had only meant to call out his name casually.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: あ、あれ。おかしいな
lines.translated: "H-Huh? That's strange."

lines.content: どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder why.

lines.content: 涙がひとつ、こぼれた。
lines.translated: A single tear spilled over.

lines.content: ……悲しくはないはずだった。
lines.translated: I wasn't supposed to be sad.

lines.content: “夜”に戻ればまた必ず逢えるとわかってる。
lines.translated: I knew that if I returned to the "Night," we would definitely meet again.

lines.content: それなのに涙がたったひとつ、ぽろりと落ちたのはなぜだろう。
lines.translated: And yet, why did a single tear fall down my cheek?

lines.content: どうしようもなく悲しいと思ってしまうのは、どうしてなのかな。
lines.translated: Why do I find myself feeling so hopelessly sad?

lines.content: 大雅と一緒に“未来”を生きてみたかった。
lines.translated: I had wanted to try living in the "future" together with Taiga.

lines.content: うれしいときも、さみしいときも、悲しみが溢れてやまないときも――あなたと一緒に泣いて、笑って、みたかった。
lines.translated: In happy times, in lonely times, and in times when sorrow overflowed endlessly--I had wanted to try crying and laughing together with you.

lines.content: “外の世界”でそれを叶えたいと、ふたり、手と手を繋いで“夜”に願いをかけたのだ。
lines.translated: Wishing to make that come true in the "Outside World," the two of us had joined hands and made a wish upon the "Night."

lines.content: もし、そうして思い描いた時間が叶うなら、何が起きようともそのすべての時間が幸せだった。
lines.translated: If the time we envisioned like that had come true, then no matter what happened, every single moment of it would have been happy.

lines.content: そんな“想い”が、言葉にするまでもなく私の胸に溢れてる。
lines.translated: Such "feelings" were overflowing in my chest without even needing to be put into words.

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり……大雅。
lines.translated: Ah, sure enough... Taiga.

lines.content: ……今すぐあなたに、逢いたいよ
lines.translated: "...I want to see you right this second."

lines.content: この涙はそんな“想い”の形だと、わかった。
lines.translated: I realized that this tear was the shape of those "feelings."

lines.content: 微かな鈴の音がして、驚き――振り向く。
lines.translated: Startled by the faint sound of a bell--I turned around.

lines.content: すると男の子がそこに立っていた。じっと私を見つめてる。
lines.translated: The boy was standing right there, staring fixedly at me.

lines.content: どうしたの……？　眠れない？
lines.translated: "What's wrong...? Can't sleep?"

lines.content: バレないようにさっと涙を拭いて、微笑んでみた。
lines.translated: I quickly wiped away my tear so he wouldn't notice and gave him a smile.

lines.content: こくりとうなずく男の子。
lines.translated: The boy gave a small nod.

lines.content: その不安定な視線から、形にならない声を聞いた――“眠れない。全然”
lines.translated: From his wavering gaze, I heard an unformed voice--"I can't sleep. Not at all."

lines.content: 腕には子猫をしっかりと抱いたままだった。
lines.translated: He was still holding the kitten tightly in his arms.

lines.content: 独り言、聞かれちゃったかなと心配に思った。
lines.translated: I worried that he might have overheard me talking to myself.

lines.content: でもその心配はないようだ。男の子は小さな頭を眠そうにふらふらとさせている。
lines.translated: But it seemed I didn't need to worry about that. The boy's small head was swaying sleepily.

lines.content: ……眠気はあるのに眠れない。
lines.translated: He was sleepy, yet he couldn't fall asleep.

lines.content: 目を閉じると怖い“未来”ばかりが脳裏を過ぎる――お母さん。……お母さん。どうしてぼくを置いて行ってしまったの。わからない。わからないよ。お母さん。
lines.translated: Whenever he closed his eyes, nothing but frightening "futures" flashed through his mind--Mom. ...Mom. Why did you leave me behind? I don't understand. I don't understand, Mom.

lines.content: 胸に溢れて消えない“想い”が苦しいのだと言わんばかりに、私のことを、不安そうに見上げていた。
lines.translated: He looked up at me uneasily, as if to say that the "feelings" overflowing in his chest and refusing to fade were painful.

lines.content: そっか。眠れないか……
lines.translated: "I see. You can't sleep, huh..."

lines.content: 少し考え、私は言った。
lines.translated: After thinking for a moment, I spoke.

lines.content: だったら“夢”を数えるといいよ
lines.translated: "In that case, you should count 'dreams.'"

lines.content: そう言った私に、男の子は不思議そうに首をかしげた。
lines.translated: When I said that, the boy tilted his head curiously.

lines.content: ……うん。あのね。私のお母さんがね、今夜のあなたと同じように、何でだかどうしても眠れない私に、よく言ってくれてたことを思い出したの
lines.translated: "...Yeah. You see, it reminded me of something my mom used to tell me all the time on nights when, just like you tonight, I somehow couldn't fall asleep no matter what."

lines.content: お母さん……。
lines.translated: Mom...

lines.content: 胸がずきりとする。色々な“想い”がまぜこぜになった痛みだった。
lines.translated: A sharp pang shot through my chest. It was an ache made of all sorts of "feelings" jumbled together.

lines.content: その痛みを誤魔化せたらと願い、私は微笑む。
lines.translated: Hoping to hide that pain, I smiled.

lines.content: 眠れない夜は羊を数えるって言うでしょう？　羊が一匹、羊が二匹って。それもいいけど、“夢”を数えるほうがもっともっと効果的だよ
lines.translated: "People say to count sheep on nights when you can't sleep, right? One sheep, two sheep. That's fine too, but counting 'dreams' is much, much more effective."

lines.content: まだ私にやさしかった頃のお母さんが、同じ枕に頭を沈め、笑顔で、そう語ってくれた。
lines.translated: Back when she was still kind to me, my mother had rested her head on the same pillow as mine and told me that with a smile.

lines.content: だから私ね、[・|地][・|下][・|室][・|の][・|ベ][・|ッ][・|ド][・|で]悲しくて、さみしくて、眠れない夜はそのことを思い出してた。こうなったらいいなあっていう“夢”を“想像”して――この場合“妄想”なのかなあ
lines.translated: "So whenever I was sad, lonely, and couldn't sleep in my bed in the basement, I would remember that. I'd 'imagine' 'dreams' of how I wished things would turn out--though I guess in this case, they might have been 'daydreams.'"

lines.content: まあどっちでもいいんだけれどね。
lines.translated: Well, either way is fine, though.

lines.content: とにかくそういう、自分にばっかり都合のいい“未来”をひとつ、ふたつ、数えていくの。心の中で。……閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の“[暗闇|夜]”に
lines.translated: "Anyway, you just count those kinds of 'futures'--the ones that are completely convenient for yourself--one by one in your heart. ...In the 'night' of the darkness behind your closed eyelids."

lines.content: そうすればね、いつの間にかすっと眠れる。怖い夢だって全然見ないよ
lines.translated: "If you do that, you'll drift right off to sleep before you know it. You won't have any scary dreams at all, either."

lines.content: あ、信じてないって顔だな。いいよー、じゃあ、証明してみせてあげよう
lines.translated: "Ah, that look on your face says you don't believe me. Okay then, I'll prove it to you."

lines.content: 私は男の子に“こっちにおいで”と手招きをする。
lines.translated: I beckoned the boy over, gesturing for him to come here.

lines.content: そばに来た男の子と子猫、[・|三][・|人]並んで、ぺったりと床に座り込むと――私は男の子の手に、“半透明”な手をそっと重ねた。
lines.translated: Once the boy and the kitten came over, the three of us sat flat on the floor side by side--and I gently placed my "translucent" hand over the boy's.

lines.content: 互いに触れられない手を重ね――少し、沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: Laying our hands together, unable to touch one another--I fell silent for a moment.

lines.content: 男の子の手には大雅の“力”が宿ってる。
lines.translated: Taiga's "power" dwelled within the boy's hand.

lines.content: ここで少し祈れば、私は今すぐにでも“夜”に還れる。男の子の手のひらは、そのための“鍵”だった。
lines.translated: If I offered a small prayer right here, I could return to the "Night" this very instant. The palm of the boy's hand was the "key" for doing so.
But I wouldn't do that just yet.

lines.content: だけど祈ることはする。それは“夜と外とを繋ぐ大雅の力”を通して、私の“想像”を目に見える形とするための、祈りだ。
lines.translated: I would, however, offer a prayer. It was a prayer to give visible form to my "imagination" through "Taiga's power that connects the Night and the Outside."

lines.content: ……ふわり、と。
lines.translated: Softly.

lines.content: ひとつ、管理室の天井に光りが灯った。
lines.translated: A single light flickered to life on the ceiling of the caretaker's room.

lines.content: その光りはひとつ、ふたつと増えていき……。
lines.translated: The lights multiplied, one by one, two by two...

lines.content: 天井を見上げた男の子は目を丸くし、瞬きを繰り返している。
lines.translated: Looking up at the ceiling, the boy widened his eyes and blinked repeatedly.

lines.content: その横顔は、こう言っているように見えた――“すごい。まるで、[・|星][・|空]だ”
lines.translated: The profile of his face seemed to be saying--"Amazing. It's just like a starry sky."

lines.content: [・|三][・|人]揃って見上げた狭い天井には、私が今、思い描いたとおりの淡い星空が、描かれていた。
lines.translated: On the narrow ceiling the three of us looked up at together, a faint starry sky was painted, just as I had pictured it in my mind.

lines.content: 夜空の光りは全部“夢”だよ
lines.translated: "All the lights in the night sky are 'dreams.'"

lines.content: テレビもラジオも何もない、大昔の時代を生きてた人たちは、こうして見上げる星の空に、いっぱいの“夢”を思い、描いていたんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "Back in ancient times, when there were no TVs or radios or anything, I think the people living then must have looked up at the starry sky just like this, picturing and painting all kinds of 'dreams.'"

lines.content: だって、ほら。見てごらんよ。あれとあれを直線で繋いだら白鳥に――……見えないよね。うん。全然見えない。だけどさ、昔々の人たちには確かにそう見えたんだ
lines.translated: "I mean, look. Take a look at that. If you connect that one and that one with a straight line, it looks like a swan--...Wait, it doesn't, does it? Yeah, not at all. But to the people of long, long ago, it really did look like that."

lines.content: 昔の人たちの想像力はすごいよね。目に見えないものを見ようとする。その“想い”は星座と呼ばれ、時を越えて[今|現代]の私たちにまで届いてる
lines.translated: "People back then had amazing imaginations, didn't they? Trying to see things that are invisible to the eye. Those 'feelings' were called constellations, and they've crossed through time to reach us even today."

lines.content: それはまるで“魔法”のようだ――それはまるで、あの“愛”と“勇気”の春の歌の、ようだ。
lines.translated: It was just like "magic"--just like that spring song of "love" and "courage."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべた私は管理室の天井に、思い描いた星空に、人差し指を向けた。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, I pointed my index finger toward the ceiling of the caretaker's room, toward the starry sky I had envisioned.
