lines.content: だから私たちも、昔々の人たちみたいに、見上げた夜空の光りを思うままに繋いでいって、見えないものを形作るみたいにして――自分勝手な“夢”を描いてみたっていいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "So just like the people of long, long ago, I think it's fine for us to connect the lights in the night sky however we please, as if giving shape to the invisible--and paint our own selfish 'dreams.'"

lines.content: ほら、見てよ。あれはきっと……、ああして、こうして繋げてみたら……甘くて美味しいチョコレートだね。うん。間違いないよ
lines.translated: "Here, look. That one is surely... if we connect it like that, and like this... it's sweet, delicious chocolate. Yep, no doubt about it."

lines.content: 想像上の星空の中、指さした先の星々が静かに移動し、チョコレートの形になっていた。
lines.translated: Within the imaginary starry sky, the stars I pointed at quietly shifted, forming the shape of a piece of chocolate.

lines.content: ……[まぶた|瞼]を閉じれば、真っ暗だ。そこに誰だって、自由に“夢”を描ける、自分だけの星の空があるんだよ
lines.translated: "...When you close your eyelids, it's pitch dark. And right there, everyone has a starry sky all their own where they can freely paint their 'dreams.'"

lines.content: その暗闇の中にひとつ、ひとつ、瞬く星を灯すみたいに、自分の“夢”を思い描くようにして数えていければ……。
lines.translated: If only you can picture and count your own "dreams," as if lighting up twinkling stars one by one in that darkness...

lines.content: これから先の未来には、今夜あなたが思い描いた通りのきらきらの星が降る。……そう思えれば、今夜だけでも安心して、眠れるようになるはずだよ
lines.translated: "In the future ahead, glittering stars will rain down just as you pictured them tonight. ...If you can believe that, you should be able to sleep peacefully, even if it's just for tonight."

lines.content: さあ、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて。あなたの“夢”を数えようよ。と、私は言った。
lines.translated: Come on, close your eyelids. Let's count your "dreams," I said.

lines.content: 男の子はじっと、天井の星空を見つめてる――“うまく夢を数えられるかどうか、不安だ”
lines.translated: The boy stared intently at the starry sky on the ceiling--"I'm worried about whether I'll be able to count my dreams properly."

lines.content: そんな言葉を、男の子の横顔に見た気がした――“だってもう、この町にお母さんはいなかった。ぼくを置いて、どこか遠くへ行ってしまった。夢は叶わなかったんだ”
lines.translated: I felt as though I saw those words in the profile of his face--"Because my mom isn't in this town anymore. She left me behind and went somewhere far away. My dream didn't come true."

lines.content: そんな“想い”を、不安定に揺れる男の子の瞳の中に、見た気がした。
lines.translated: I felt as though I saw those "feelings" in the boy's uneasily wavering eyes.

lines.content: その不安や悲しみに、“大丈夫”と、安易に励ますことはできなかった。安易さはときに軽率さにもなるだろう。
lines.translated: Faced with his anxiety and sadness, I couldn't easily reassure him by saying, "It'll be okay." Easy comfort can sometimes be thoughtless.

lines.content: だから私は、私にとっての“理想”を、まるで“希望”のようにして語る他ない。
lines.translated: So I had no choice but to speak of my own "ideals" as though they were "hope."

lines.content: ……あなたのことを大切に想う[・|ひ][・|と]達は、いつも、あなたの“隣”で祈ってる――“夢を諦めてほしくない”って
lines.translated: "...Those who care deeply about you are always praying right 'beside' you--that they 'don't want you to give up on your dreams.'"

lines.content: でも同じように、あなたのことを大切に想う[・|人]たちは、いつもあなたの近くで願ってる――“夢を、諦めてほしい”って
lines.translated: "But in the very same way, the people who care deeply about you are always wishing near you--that they 'want you to give up on your dreams.'"

lines.content: 大人たちは知っている。この意地の悪い世界では、“夢”なんて諦めて生きることのほうが楽なのだ――
lines.translated: Adults know. In this unkind world, it's easier to live by giving up on things like "dreams"--

lines.content: この世界で一年でも多く生きた人は、一年分も多く、人生から困難を突きつけられながらも懸命に生きている。
lines.translated: Anyone who has lived even one year longer in this world is living with all their might while having one year's worth more of hardships thrust upon them by life.

lines.content: 大人たちはいつだって、自分の子どもには自分と同じ苦労はしてほしくはないから、“諦める”道が絶対なのだと子ども達に説くけれど……。
lines.translated: Because adults never want their own children to go through the same struggles they did, they preach to them that the path of "giving up" is absolute, and yet...

lines.content: 確かに苦労はないかもしれない。
lines.translated: It's true that there might not be any struggles.

lines.content: だけど、そこに楽しさはない。
lines.translated: But there is no joy there, either.

lines.content: 苦労はないけど楽しくはない人生と。
lines.translated: A life without struggles, yet without joy.

lines.content: いっぱい苦労はあるけど、いっぱい楽しい……かもしれない人生と――どちらが正しいなんて。
lines.translated: And a life full of struggles, yet full of joy... perhaps--as for which one is right...

lines.content: そんなのは、誰も知らない。
lines.translated: Nobody knows the answer to something like that.

lines.content: ……人それぞれに幸せだと数えたい“夢”の光景は、違うだろうし
lines.translated: "...Besides, the scenes of 'dreams' that each person wants to count as happiness are probably different."

lines.content: ただそうできなかった人たちだけが、いつも怖い顔して、言うことを聞くようにと怒るのだ。
lines.translated: It's just that only the people who couldn't do so always wear scary faces and get angry, telling you to do as they say.

lines.content: ……私はね、あなたのことを大切に想いたい[・|ひ][・|と]だから
lines.translated: "...You see, because I'm someone who wants to care deeply about you..."

lines.content: だからね、私、あなたには“夢”を諦めてほしくないんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why I don't want you to give up on your 'dreams.'"

lines.content: そういうふうに言葉にしてはじめて、私は自分の気持ちに気づけた――ああ、そっか。私はこの子に“夢”を諦めてほしくないんだ。
lines.translated: Only after putting it into words like that did I realize my own feelings--Ah, I see. I don't want this child to give up on his "dreams."
That is why I continue to stay right beside you like this.

lines.content: ……きっと、そういう生き方は苦しいけれど。問題の連続だろうけど
lines.translated: "...Walking that path in life is surely painful, and it'll probably just be one problem after another."

lines.content: それでもそういう人生を選んだなら、いつか、それまで苦しかったことと同じくらい、楽しいと思える時間に出会える。そんな人生が待ってるはずだよ
lines.translated: "Even so, if you choose that kind of life, you'll someday meet times that feel just as joyful as everything that was painful up until then. That's the kind of life waiting for you."

lines.content: ……これからもしも私が、こうして、あなたの隣にいられなくなってしまっても――いつも、いつでも、祈ってるよ。あなたが幸せに生きることができますようにって
lines.translated: "...Even if the day comes when I can no longer stay right beside you like this--I'll always, always be praying for you. Praying that you can live happily."

lines.content: あなたが“夢”を叶えるために、いつも力を貸せるよう祈ってる
lines.translated: "I'll always be praying to lend you my strength so that you can make your 'dreams' come true."

lines.content: だってあなたは、なんだか、小さな頃の……まだ命があった頃の私に、良くよく似てる。そんな気がして、ならないから。
lines.translated: Because for some reason, you really... really resemble the me from when I was little... back when I still had life in me. I just can't shake that feeling.

lines.content: その“想い”は言葉にしないまま、飲み込んだ。
lines.translated: I swallowed those "feelings" back without putting them into words.

lines.content: ……うんうん。いやあ。なんだか私、今、とってもいいこと言ってない？　どうかな。今の私、大人の女のひとに見えちゃわない？
lines.translated: "...Mhm, yep. Man, didn't I just say something really great right now? What do you think? Don't I look like a mature, grown-up woman right now?"

lines.content: 得意げな顔をして見せた。
lines.translated: I put on a proud, smug face for him.

lines.content: すると男の子は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた――……“ぼくの夢は”と、微かな声を、重ねた手を通して、心の中で聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: Then, the boy closed his eyelids--..."My dream is," I felt as though I heard a faint voice inside my heart through our overlapping hands.

lines.content: 男の子と子猫、そして“半透明”の私は、一緒に暮らす――今日、見つけられた空っぽのお家で。
lines.translated: The boy, the kitten, and the "translucent" me would live together--in the empty house we had found today.

lines.content: まるで、家族みたいに。
lines.translated: Just like a family.

lines.content: そんな“未来”の光景が、男の子のあたらしい“夢”が、[まぶた|瞼]の裏の暗闇に映った。
lines.translated: That vision of the "future," the boy's new "dream," was projected onto the darkness behind my eyelids.

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: 頬が緩んでしまう。
lines.translated: My cheeks softened into a smile.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う]“[・|夢]”も、……うん。すてきだなって思うよ
lines.translated: "That kind of 'dream' is... yeah. I think it's wonderful."

lines.content: 男の子は成長し、いつか“外の世界”で多くの友人を作るだろう。
lines.translated: The boy would grow up, and someday make many friends in the "outside world."

lines.content: そうした中で恋人だってできるだろうし、結婚し、子どもを持つこともあるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Amidst all that, he would probably find a lover, get married, and maybe even have children.

lines.content: その様子を、成長できない――大人になれない子猫と私は、そばでずっと見守り生きる。
lines.translated: The kitten and I, unable to grow--unable to become adults, would live on watching over him from right beside him the entire time.

lines.content: もう、自分たちがいなくても平気だね。そう思えるまではあの家で、三人一緒に……ずっと。
lines.translated: Until the day we could think, "He'll be fine even without us now," the three of us would stay together in that house... forever.

lines.content: それが、男の子の思い描くあたらしい“夢”だった。
lines.translated: That was the new "dream" the boy pictured in his mind.

lines.content: 賢い子猫に名前のない男の子。そして、あなた達以外の誰にも見えない、幽霊みたいな“半透明”の私
lines.translated: "A clever kitten, a nameless boy. And a ghost-like, 'translucent' me whom no one else can see besides you two."

lines.content: ……ヘンテコだけど、まるで家族みたいにして、生きてはいけるかもしれないね
lines.translated: "...It's a little strange, but maybe we really can live on together just like a family."

lines.content: 男の子の[・|そ][・|れ]は、もはや“夢”というより“願い”だった――……いいや。
lines.translated: For the boy, that was no longer a "dream" so much as a "wish"--...no.

lines.content: “夢”や“願い”というよりも、言葉では形にできない“祈り”であるように、感じられた。
lines.translated: Rather than a "dream" or a "wish," it felt more like a "prayer" that could not be shaped into words.

lines.content: ……その“想い”の名は、小さな胸には抱えきれないほどのさみしさだった。
lines.translated: The name of that "feeling" was a loneliness too vast to be held inside his tiny chest.

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: ふと思う。
lines.translated: A sudden thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: “夢”も“希望”もなにもない、命尽きてしまった私は――[・|私][・|た][・|ち]は、今を生きてるこの子の願いを叶えることで、この子に自分の果たせなかったすべてを、“希望”を、託してるのか。
lines.translated: With my life already spent, stripped of any "dreams" or "hopes"--am I, or rather, are *we* entrusting all of our unfulfilled "hopes" and everything we couldn't achieve to this child who is living in the present, simply by granting his wish?

lines.content: そんな自らの――あるいは、世の中の大人たちの身勝手な“想い”にも、気づいた。
lines.translated: I realized that selfish "feeling" of my own--or perhaps, of all the adults in the world.

lines.content: だから私は、何度となく、触れられもしない男の子の手に触れようとする。
lines.translated: That is why I keep trying, time and time again, to touch the boy's hand even though I can't actually touch it.

lines.content: ……うん。わかった。それじゃあ明日からあの家が、私たちのお家だね
lines.translated: "...Mhm. Got it. Then starting tomorrow, that house will be our home."

lines.content: あなたの“夢”は、遠い昔に、“夢”を叶えられなかった私が全部、叶えるよ。
lines.translated: As someone who couldn't make her own "dreams" come true long ago, I'll make all of your "dreams" come true for you.

lines.content: そんな“想い”を微笑みに乗せられるようにと、願った。
lines.translated: I wished that I could convey those "feelings" through my smile.

lines.content: ……それまで大雅は、私のこと、“夜”の中で待っていてくれるかな。
lines.translated: Until then, I wonder if Taiga will keep waiting for me inside the "Night."

lines.content: そんな“不安”は、どうか隠しきれますようにと祈ってた。
lines.translated: I prayed that I would be able to keep that "unease" completely hidden.

lines.content: ……また、ふたりで夜空を見上げる。
lines.translated: Once again, the two of us looked up at the night sky.

lines.content: 私の心が描く星の空。
lines.translated: The starry sky painted by my heart.

lines.content: そこに思いおもいの夢を描いた。
lines.translated: Upon that canvas, each of us painted our own dreams.

lines.content: “この世界のいやなこと。つらいこと。……さみしいこと、全部。夢の中のくじらが、残らず食べてくれたらいいのにな”
lines.translated: "All the awful things in this world. All the painful things. ...All the lonely things, every last bit of them. I wish a whale in my dreams would come and eat them all up."

lines.content: ふと、男の子の心の声を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I felt as though I heard the voice of the boy's heart.

lines.content: あれ？　悪い夢を食べるのはくじらじゃなくて[バク|獏]じゃなかったっけ――私のそんな疑問が伝わったのかな。男の子は不思議そうに首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Huh? Wasn't it a baku, not a whale, that eats bad dreams--I wonder if that question of mine got through to him. The boy tilted his head in confusion.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: そうだね。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ……人生とは忘れることだ。つらいことも。悲しいことも。すべて忘れて眠ってしまおう
lines.translated: "...Life is about forgetting. The painful things. The sad things, too. Let's forget it all and go to sleep."

lines.content: 今はそのようにして、すべてなかったことみたいに蓋をして……。
lines.translated: For now, we would just put a lid on everything like that and pretend none of it ever happened...

lines.content: 今夜、“夜”の中で不思議な何かが、私たちの……君の“悪い夢”を残らず全部、食べてくれますようにと私も祈った。
lines.translated: I prayed, too, that tonight, something mysterious within the "Night" would come and eat up every last one of our... of your "bad dreams."

lines.content: 私たちの目的は変わった。
lines.translated: Our goal had changed.

lines.content: 昨日までは男の子のお母さんを探していたけれど、今日からは、生活するのに必要そうなものを、各々が探して歩いた。
lines.translated: Up until yesterday, we had been searching for the boy's mother, but starting today, each of us walked around searching for things we might need for our daily lives.

lines.content: 男の子と子猫、そして私。
lines.translated: The boy, the kitten, and me.

lines.content: 手分けして一日中、町を探して周り……。
lines.translated: We split up and spent the entire day searching around town...

lines.content: 見つけられたものを時計塔の管理室に持ち寄った――“半透明”な私だけれど、命のないただの無機質な物体であるならば、触れることが叶う。
lines.translated: And brought everything we found back to the clock tower's maintenance room--even though I'm "translucent," I'm still able to touch lifeless, inorganic objects.

lines.content: 注意して探してみたら結構、色々と落ちてるものなんだね。びっくりだよ
lines.translated: "You can find all sorts of things lying around if you look carefully. What a surprise."

lines.content: 管理室の床に集められたものを散りばめ、三人で眺めた。
lines.translated: We spread the items we'd gathered across the maintenance room floor, and the three of us looked over them.

lines.content: ええっと……私が見つけてきたのは、これだね
lines.translated: "Umm... Here's what I found."

lines.content: 粗大ゴミに出してあった絵本が数冊、古びてるけどまだ充分使えるバックがひとつ。
lines.translated: Several picture books that had been put out with the oversized trash, and a single bag that was worn out, yet still had plenty of use left in it.

lines.content: それにねそれにね。河原の草むらに落ちてたの。えっちな本。雨でふにゃふにゃになってるけれど、大丈夫。大切なところはちゃんと読めるよ
lines.translated: "And also, and also! I found this lying in the grass down by the riverbank. A dirty magazine. It got all soggy from the rain, but it's okay. You can still see the important parts just fine."

lines.content: ほらほら見てよと、ぺらぺらページを開いてみせるけど、
lines.translated: I flipped through the pages, telling them to come take a look,

lines.content: 男の子はさっと視線を外してしまう。
lines.translated: but the boy quickly averted his eyes.

lines.content: そんな男の子に抱かれた子猫が、ジト目を私に向けていた――“やめて。そんなのこの子に必要ない”
lines.translated: Held in his arms, the kitten shot me an unimpressed glare--"Stop that. He doesn't need anything like that."

lines.content: そんな声を聞いた気がした――“女の人、みんなすっごい薄着だ。風邪ひいちゃうよ”
lines.translated: Then I felt like I heard another voice--"All the women are barely wearing anything. They're gonna catch a cold."

lines.content: ええ～。そうかなあ。大人になったら絶対、必要になるよ。うん。間違いないよ
lines.translated: "Ehh~? You think so? He's definitely going to need it when he grows up. Yep, no doubt about it."

lines.content: だって、男の子はね、どんなにかわいくても、カッコよくても、心の中はみんな同じで……すごくえっちなんだって
lines.translated: "Because you see, no matter how cute or cool a boy is, they're all the same on the inside... They're super perverted, apparently."

lines.content: 男の子はそういうイキモノだから仕方ないんだって、何かの本に書いてあったよ。
lines.translated: Boys are just wired that way, so they can't help it--I read that in some book once.

lines.content: 自分じゃあえっちな気持ちをどうにもできない。そういうイキモノな、かわいそうな男の子たちから、えっちなものを取り上げちゃうのはね、とってもかわいそうなことなんだよ
lines.translated: "They can't do anything about those perverted feelings on their own. Taking dirty things away from poor boys who are made like that is a really cruel thing to do."

lines.content: だから取り上げるんじゃなくて、逆にプレゼントするんだよ。そしたらさ、えっちな気持ちになるのはそんなに悪いことじゃないんだよって、わかるでしょ
lines.translated: "So instead of taking them away, you give them as a present! That way, he'll understand it's really not so bad to have perverted feelings, right?"

lines.content: だって、男の子がえっちじゃないと、誰も生まれてこれないわけだし……
lines.translated: "Besides, if boys weren't perverted, nobody would ever be born..."

lines.content: [・|子][・|育][・|て]はそういうふうにすることが正しいと、いつかの私は読んだのだ――本に書いてあることは絶対だと信じてる。
lines.translated: At some point, I had read that this was the proper way to raise a child--and I believe that whatever is written in books is absolute.

lines.content: “あんなふうに、[・|む][・|ぼ][・|う][・|び][・|に]お腹を出すのは[・|ふ][・|し][・|だ][・|ら]で、いけないことだよ”――子猫の鋭い視線がそう言っている。
lines.translated: "Exposing your belly so defenselessly like that is indecent and wrong"--that was what the kitten's sharp gaze was saying.

lines.content: “ああやってお腹を見せていいのは、大好きな人にだけって決まってるのに”
lines.translated: "You're only supposed to show your belly like that to someone you really, really love."

lines.content: “……この本の中の人たち、ところ構わずお腹を出して……みんな、発情期なのかな。ああ、そっか。だからえっちな本って名前なんだね”
lines.translated: "...The people in this book are showing their bellies all over the place... Are they all in heat or something? Oh, I see. So that's why it's called a dirty book."

lines.content: 子猫は奇妙に納得したような顔をして、ちらちらと、開かれたページを見ている男の子にも、細めた視線を向けていた――“発情した雌猫の写真の本なら、いくらでも、見てもいいのに”
lines.translated: Looking strangely convinced, the kitten narrowed her eyes at the boy, who was sneaking glances at the open pages--"If it were a photo book of female cats in heat, I wouldn't mind him looking at it as much as he wants, though."

lines.content: うーんと。あと、他に見つけられたのは、全部ひとりじゃ運べなさそうなものだったよ
lines.translated: "Hmm. Well, everything else I found was too big for me to carry on my own."

lines.content: テレビやオーブントースターといった大きな家電は、粗大ゴミ置き場に置いてきた。後で男の子と一緒にお家へ運べればと思う。
lines.translated: I had left large appliances like a TV and a toaster oven back at the oversized trash collection spot. Hopefully, the boy and I could carry them to the house together later.

lines.content: 一日でこれだけ見つけられたら上出来なんじゃないかな。
lines.translated: Finding all this in just one day was a pretty good haul, I thought.

lines.content: 次の日も手分けして色々と、探した。
lines.translated: The next day, we split up and searched for all sorts of things again.

lines.content: 錆だらけのシャベルと、後輪がパンクした子供用の自転車を私は見つけた。それだけだ。昨日と違って管理室に持ち帰れるものはなく、私は報告だけになってしまった。
lines.translated: I found a rusty shovel and a kid's bicycle with a flat back tire. That was it. Unlike yesterday, there was nothing I could carry back to the caretaker's office, so I could only give a report.

lines.content: 男の子と子猫は電池の切れてしまった置き時計や電卓、まだきれいな[・|鋏]やブラシを見つけてきていた。
lines.translated: The boy and the kitten had found a desk clock and a calculator with dead batteries, along with a pair of scissors and a brush that were still in good condition.

lines.content: 夜。
lines.translated: Night.

lines.content: 男の子が寝静まった後、私はひとり、考えた――日に日に、集めたものが増えていく。
lines.translated: After the boy fell fast asleep, I thought to myself alone--day by day, our pile of scavenged things was growing.

lines.content: それらを見ていて、これでいいのかなと感じてた。
lines.translated: Looking at it all, I wondered if this was really okay.

lines.content: ……あなた達と一緒に、家族みたいにして生きて……いける？　ほんとうに？
lines.translated: "...Can I really live together with you two... like a family? Truly?"

lines.content: きっと無理だ。
lines.translated: It's definitely impossible.

lines.content: そう感じてる。
lines.translated: That's what I feel.

lines.content: だって、私でもわかるよ――この世界は、“夜”の外は、[・|子][・|ど][・|も][・|達]だけで生きていけるほど、やさしい場所ではないことくらい。
lines.translated: After all, even I can tell that much--this world outside the "Night" isn't a kind enough place for children to survive on their own.

lines.content: それに私と一緒にいちゃだめだよ。[・|き][・|っ][・|と][・|危][・|な][・|い]。
lines.translated: Besides, you shouldn't stay with me. It's definitely dangerous.

lines.content: 意地悪な大人たちが私の命を狙っているのだという――もう“夜”の“鍵”は解かれてる。私がこうして“外”へ出てしまったから。
lines.translated: There are mean adults out there trying to take my life--and the "Key" to the "Night" has already been unlocked, now that I've come "outside" like this.

lines.content: だからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe that was why.

lines.content: もう“夜”から外に出て数日だけれど、大人たちの気配はまるで感じない。
lines.translated: It's already been a few days since I left the "Night," and I haven't sensed any sign of those adults at all.

lines.content: それでも油断をしてしまえる理由にはならず、その影に対して警戒心を忘れたことはない。
lines.translated: Still, that was no reason to let my guard down, and I never stopped staying vigilant against their shadows.

lines.content: ……そんな私と暮らすなんて。
lines.translated: Living with someone like me...

lines.content: あんまりにも、危険だ。
lines.translated: It's just way too dangerous.

lines.content: そんな不安や、疑問を、もやもやと抱えたまま――朝だ。
lines.translated: With those anxieties and doubts swirling hazily in my chest--morning came.

lines.content: 太陽と一緒に目を覚ました男の子と、今日もまた何かを探しに町へと出かけた。
lines.translated: The boy woke up with the sun, and today we headed out into town once again to search for whatever we could find.
It was just too hard to bring any of it up.

lines.content: 今日、私が見つけられたのは洗濯物を干すためのハンガーを、幾つか。
lines.translated: What I managed to find today were a few hangers for drying laundry.

lines.content: 子猫ちゃんが集めてきたのは……、あ、またチョコレートだ。甘くないやつとちょっと苦いの、ひとつずつだね。それに、美味しそうなあめ玉が、少しと……
lines.translated: "And what the little kitten gathered is... oh, more chocolate. One unsweetened and one slightly bitter, huh? Plus a few yummy-looking hard candies, and..."

lines.content: チョコとあめ玉に、何気なく手をふらふらと伸ばした。
lines.translated: Without thinking, my hand drifted toward the chocolate and candies.

lines.content: きっと甘いもの食べたい私の目はきらきらしてて、涎もたれてた。
lines.translated: Craving something sweet, my eyes were probably sparkling, and I was practically drooling.

lines.content: っ
子猫がさっと、私の手からチョコとあめ玉を、口と尻尾でさらい、護った――“これは、この子の。きみのじゃない”
lines.translated: The kitten swiftly swept the chocolate and candies away from my hand using her mouth and tail to guard them--"These are his. Not yours."

lines.content: そう言われてるみたいだった。
lines.translated: That was what she seemed to be saying.

lines.content: ……むぅ。別にいいじゃん。私、食べられないんだし、ただ、触るくらい……
lines.translated: "...Mmph. Come on, what's the big deal? I can't eat them anyway. Just letting me touch them a little..."

lines.content: 言いながら、私は首をかしげた。
lines.translated: As I said that, I tilted my head.

lines.content: あれ？　おかしいよね。命のないものなら触れられる私なのに、どうしてお菓子とか食べ物は、[・|触][・|れ][・|ら][・|れ][・|る][・|の][・|に]、でも、食べることはできないのかな
lines.translated: "Huh? That's weird, isn't it? I can touch anything that doesn't have life in it, so why is it that when it comes to sweets and food, I can touch them, and yet I can't eat them?"

lines.content: なんだか不思議だ。
lines.translated: It was kind of mysterious.

lines.content: 不思議すぎて、お腹が空くような気さえした。
lines.translated: So mysterious that it almost made me feel hungry.

lines.content: あと、子猫ちゃんが集めてくれたのは……お金。小銭ばかりで……いち、にい、さん……わあ、すごい。千円くらいあるよ
lines.translated: "And the other thing the kitten gathered for us is... money. It's all small change... one, two, three... wow, amazing. There's about a thousand yen here."

lines.content: 子猫は得意そうに、小さな鼻をつんとさせていた。
lines.translated: Looking quite proud of herself, the kitten puffed out her chest and tilted her little nose up.

lines.content: そういえば今夜、町の商店街でお祭りがあるらしいね。三人で行ってみない？　千円あれば色々買えるよ。かき氷とか。リンゴ飴とか。チョコバナナとか
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, I heard there's a festival at the town shopping district tonight. Want to go together, the three of us? With a thousand yen, we can buy all sorts of things. Like shaved ice. Or candy apples. Or chocolate bananas."

lines.content: 甘くて美味しそうなそれらを想像してみた。
lines.translated: I tried imagining all those sweet, delicious-looking treats.

lines.content: うーん。いいなあ……想像しただけでうっとりしちゃうよ
lines.translated: "Mmm, that sounds so nice... Just imagining it makes me feel all dreamy."

lines.content: どうにかして私も食べられないかなと、甘いため息をついていた。
lines.translated: I let out a sweet sigh, wishing there were some way I could eat them too.

lines.content: それに、ほら。もしかしたらお祭りに、あなたのお母さんも来てるかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "Besides, look. Maybe your mother will be at the festival too."

lines.content: ポスターを見たら結構大きなお祭りみたい。町中の人たちが集まるみたいだから、誰かを探すならぴったりだよね
lines.translated: "From the posters I saw, it looks like a pretty big festival. People from all over town will be gathering there, so it's the perfect place to look for someone, right?"

lines.content: 男の子は私を見上げた――“もうそれはいいって言ったのに”と、そういう視線だった。
lines.translated: The boy looked up at me--with eyes that seemed to say, "I already told you that doesn't matter anymore."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: わかってる。
lines.translated: I know.

lines.content: あなたは“夢”を諦めて、あたらしい“夢”を“想像”したんだよね。
lines.translated: You gave up on your "dream" and "imagined" a new "dream," didn't you?

lines.content: 確かに、あなたのお家はもう空っぽだったけど……。でも、あなたのお母さんが、この町から出て行っちゃったっていう証拠を見つけられたわけでもないし……
lines.translated: "It's true that your house was already empty... But it's not like we found any proof that your mother actually left this town..."

lines.content: もしかしたら、町の中にある別の家に越しちゃっただけかもしれない。諦めるにはまだまだ早いよ
lines.translated: "Maybe she just moved to a different house somewhere in town. It's still way too early to give up."

lines.content: だけど、男の子は首を振る。
lines.translated: Even so, the boy shook his head.

lines.content: そして“半透明”な私の手に、自分の手を重ね合わせた――“そのことはもう、本当にいいんだ”
lines.translated: Then he placed his hand over my "semi-transparent" one--"Really, I'm fine with leaving that behind now."

lines.content: 男の子の声にならない“想い”を、心で、聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: I felt as though I had heard the boy's voiceless "feelings" inside my heart.

lines.content: “もし、探しても探しても見つからなければ、悲しいし……”
lines.translated: "If we search and search and still can't find her, it'll just make me sad..."

lines.content: “見つかったとしても、ぼくはどうしたらいいのかわからない。お母さんの言いつけを破ってここに来た。よろこばれるはずがないことくらい、わかってる”
lines.translated: "And even if we do find her, I don't know what I'm supposed to do. I broke my mother's rule and came here. I know there's no way she'd be happy to see me."

lines.content: “どころか怒られてしまうかもしれない。どうして迎えに行くまで待っていられなかったのかって。どうして、言いつけを護れなかったのかって”
lines.translated: "In fact, she might even get angry at me. Asking why I couldn't just wait until she came to get me. Asking why I couldn't keep my promise."

lines.content: そんなあたなのことが、お母さんは、大嫌いよ――もし、そんな言葉を投げかけられるようなことになってしまったら。
lines.translated: Mommy hates a boy like you--what if she ended up throwing words like that at him?

lines.content: “そうなれば、もっと、もっと……ぼくは悲しい”
lines.translated: "If that happened, I'd be even sadder... so much sadder."

lines.content: 男の子はうつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: The boy cast his eyes down.

lines.content: その“もしも”は“悪い夢”と同じだなと私は感じた。
lines.translated: That "what if" felt just like a "bad dream" to me.

lines.content: ……昨日の夜、私に教えてくれたよね。あなたのあたらしい“夢”について
lines.translated: "...Last night, you told me about it, didn't you? About your new 'dream.'"

lines.content: 繋いだ手から流れ込んできた、男の子の言葉にならない“想い”が、私の“妄想”なんかじゃないのなら……。
lines.translated: If the boy's unspoken "feelings" that flowed into me through our joined hands weren't just my own "delusion"...

lines.content: あなた達と一緒に、三人で、家族みたいに暮らしていくこともすてきだなって思う。ほんとだよ。そんなのはまるで“夢”みたいだなって
lines.translated: "I think living together with you two, the three of us like a family, would be wonderful too. I really do. It would be just like a 'dream.'"

lines.content: 確かに[・|そ][・|れ]はすてきな未来予想図だと思う。だから今日は一日、町中を歩いて回り、三人で生活するのに必要そうなものを探してた。
lines.translated: I really did think *that* was a wonderful vision of the future. That was why I had spent the whole day walking around town, looking for things we might need for the three of us to live together.

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: その“夢”が叶うことは、とてもすてきだ。
lines.translated: Having that "dream" come true would be so wonderful.

lines.content: そこに[・|大][・|雅]がいてくれたなら、もっともっと、すてきだっただろうなって感じるよ
lines.translated: "And if *Taiga* were there with us, I feel like it would have been even more wonderful."

lines.content: [・|三][・|人]ではなく[・|四][・|人]でだったなら、私はきっとうなずいていたはずだ。
lines.translated: If it were the *four* of us instead of the *three* of us, I'm sure I would have nodded.

lines.content: でも、そうはならない。どんなに願っても。祈っても。
lines.translated: But that won't happen. No matter how much I wish for it. No matter how much I pray.

lines.content: ……だから私も、私のあたらしい“夢”について考えてみたよ
lines.translated: "...So I tried thinking about a new 'dream' of my own, too."

lines.content: 首をかしげた男の子に、“私のあたらしい夢について、聞いてくれる？”と言い、同じように少し首をかしげて見せた。
lines.translated: As the boy tilted his head, I asked, "Will you listen to my new dream?" and tilted my head slightly to match his.

lines.content: 私の“夢”はね
lines.translated: "My 'dream' is..."

lines.content: 少し、躊躇ってしまった。
lines.translated: I hesitated a little.

lines.content: 自分の“夢”を語ること。
lines.translated: Talking about your own "dream"...

lines.content: それは、ともすればとても恥ずかしくも思える行為だ。でも勇気を出して、口を開いた。
lines.translated: That was something that could easily feel very embarrassing. Even so, I summoned my courage and opened my mouth.

lines.content: 私の“夢”……。それは、本屋さんを創ることだよ
lines.translated: "My 'dream'... is to create a bookstore."

lines.content: また首をかしげる男の子に、私は、言う。
lines.translated: The boy tilted his head again, and I continued speaking to him.

lines.content: 人は死んだら夜空の星になったりもする。夜空の光りは“命”の光りだ
lines.translated: "When people die, they sometimes become stars in the night sky. The lights in the night sky are the lights of 'life.'"

lines.content: ――それが今、この世界と“夜”の成り立ちだけれど。
lines.translated: --That is how this world and the "night" are structured right now, however.
"*When a human dies, their 'life' becomes a single book.*"

lines.content: そして、星空みたいに広大なその本屋の書架に、“命の光り”は――“命の本”は、すべて収まる。
lines.translated: And on the shelves of that bookstore, as vast as the starry sky, every "light of life"--every "book of life"--will be housed.

lines.content: そういうふうに、この世界を書き換えたい。
lines.translated: That is how I want to rewrite this world.

lines.content: ……その本屋は人生の記録だ
lines.translated: "...That bookstore will be a record of people's lives."

lines.content: ずらり並べられた“[・|名][・|も][・|な][・|き][・|英][・|雄][・|た][・|ち]”の物語に、いつでも心で触れることのできる場所。
lines.translated: A place where your heart can touch the stories of those rows upon rows of "*nameless heroes*" whenever you wish.

lines.content: それは“刻の終着駅”のように、終わりある“命”のすべてが行き着く先だ。
lines.translated: Just like a "Terminal Station of Time," it is the final destination where every finite "life" eventually arrives.
"*How did you live your life?*"

lines.content: そう問いかけるようにして、ページを開く。
lines.translated: You open the pages as if asking that very question.

lines.content: きっと誰もが命の中に、それぞれ異なるテーマのようなものを抱いて、生まれてくるはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely everyone is born holding something like their own unique theme deep within their life.

lines.content: だからこそ人生は、それそのものが、どう生きたかによって誰かに確かな勇気をあげられる――立派なひとつの[作品|芸術]にだってなりえるはずだ。
lines.translated: And that is precisely why a person's life itself--depending on how it was lived--can give someone real courage, and even become a wonderful work of art in its own right.

lines.content: ……“夜のイキモノ”たちはね、誰もがそういうふうに、子どもみたいに、“夢”見てる
lines.translated: "...'Creatures of the Night,' you see, are all dreaming like that, just like children."

lines.content: ……だから、“本”だ。
lines.translated: That is why I chose "books."

lines.content: 命あるもの達が必死に生きた[人生|物語]を、そういうふうに形にしたい。
lines.translated: I want to give that kind of shape to the stories of the lives that living beings fought so desperately to live.

lines.content: どうして、人の“想い”は目に見えないんだろう
lines.translated: "Why are people's 'feelings' invisible to the eye?"

lines.content: いつもそう考えていた。
lines.translated: I was always thinking about that.

lines.content: ……言葉だけでは、決して伝えきれない“想い”を伝えるには、どうしたらいいんだろう
lines.translated: "...How can we convey the 'feelings' that words alone could never hope to express?"

lines.content: いつもその方法を探してた。
lines.translated: I was always searching for a way to do that.

lines.content: 決して上手に、何かを作り出せるわけではないけれど――それでも、ううん、だからこそ勇気を持って、懸命に生き抜いた名もなき人たちがいる
lines.translated: "There are nameless people out there who aren't necessarily good at creating things -- yet even so, no, precisely because of that, they lived out their lives with courage and all their might."

lines.content: そういう人たちは、どういうふうにして、目には見えず、言葉だけでは充分ではない“想い”を、それを必要としている大切な人に、伝えればいいんだろう
lines.translated: "How can people like that convey their 'feelings' -- which are invisible to the eye, and which words alone cannot suffice to express -- to the precious people who need them?"

lines.content: 深く悲しんでいる大切な人に、勇気を出してと励ませるだろう。……何も特別なものを持たないもののためにこそ、そのための方法を“夜”の中に残したい
lines.translated: "How can they encourage a deeply grieving loved one to be brave? ...Precisely for the sake of those who possess nothing special, I want to leave behind a way to do that within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: だから私は、決して目には見えない“想い”を、形ある本として残したい。
lines.translated: That is why I want to leave behind those invisible "feelings" in the tangible form of books.

lines.content: 物語を語ることも、聴くことも、生前の私は得意だったらしいから。
lines.translated: After all, it seems I was good at both telling and listening to stories back when I was alive.

lines.content: そういう成り立ちをこの世界の中で、あたらしい“夢”として、私は思い描きたい
lines.translated: "I want to envision that kind of structure within this world as my new 'dream.'"

lines.content: ……“刻”の最果てに“想像”したい特別な本屋さん。
lines.translated: A special bookstore that I want to "imagine" at the very end of "time."

lines.content: その書架に“命の本”は収まって、自分の物語が読まれる瞬間を心待ちにし――長く、静かで、幸福な“夢”を見続ける。
lines.translated: The "books of life" will rest upon those shelves, eagerly awaiting the moment their stories are read -- continuing to dream a long, quiet, and happy "dream."

lines.content: いつかその本に記述された人生と、同じような悲しみやさみしさを持った“誰か”が、まるで引き寄せられるようにして、そのページを開くとき……。
lines.translated: And someday, when "someone" carrying the same kind of sorrow and loneliness as the life recorded in that book opens its pages, as though drawn to it...

lines.content: そこに記された[物語|人生]に触れ、いっぱいの“想い”に触れて、読み手と語り手、[・|互][・|い][・|の]“夢”や“願い”が共感し合うようなことが、あったなら……
lines.translated: "If they touch the life recorded there, touch all those 'feelings,' and the reader and storyteller come to share a mutual empathy for each other's 'dreams' and 'wishes'..."

lines.content: 文字として記述された“[命|想い]”は、その人にしか見えない“半透明”な姿となり、本の中からもう一度“外の世界”へと現れるだろう。
lines.translated: The "feelings" written down as words will take on a "translucent" form visible only to that person, emerging from the book into the "outside world" once more.

lines.content: そして自分の本のページを開いた、今が悲しい、さみしい、どうしようもなく生きることが、苦しい――[・|自][・|分][・|と][・|そ][・|っ][・|く][・|り]な“想い”に苦しむその人の“隣”に、そっと、寄り添う。
lines.translated: And they will gently nestle "beside" the person who opened the pages of their book -- someone who is sad right now, who is lonely, who finds living unbearably painful, suffering from "feelings" that are the exact spitting image of their own.

lines.content: そして“あなたの人生が、全部、幸せに叶えられていきますように”と祈り続け、力を貸し続けていられる――
lines.translated: To keep praying, "May your entire life be fulfilled in happiness," and to keep lending them strength --

lines.content: そんな“存在”を……。
lines.translated: That kind of "existence"...

lines.content: 繋いだ手と手の間に、ふたりだけの特別な“魔法”だって、芽生えるような……。
lines.translated: Where a special "magic" belonging only to the two of them might even blossom between their joined hands...

lines.content: そういう唯一の“[・|関][・|係][・|性]”を、創りたい。
lines.translated: I want to create that kind of one-of-a-kind "relationship."

lines.content: そうして、そこに集められてくるいっぱいの光りに、“命の物語”に、私は、触れたい
lines.translated: "And in doing so, I want to touch all the lights gathered there -- all the 'stories of life.'"

lines.content: 誰にも読まれず、誰にも見られず、誰にも聞かれず……誰にも、知られないまま消えていくしかなかった――“名もなき人たち”の物語。
lines.translated: The stories of "nameless people" -- who had no choice but to fade away unread, unseen, unheard... and unknown to anyone.

lines.content: そこに刻まれた“想い”を誰かが読み、誰かが知ることが、必要だ。
lines.translated: Somebody needs to read the "feelings" carved into them; somebody needs to know them.

lines.content: 誰かに観測されてはじめて世界は存在することになるのだろう。人の“想い”も同じだと、信じてる。
lines.translated: The world likely only comes into existence once it is observed by someone. I believe people's "feelings" are the very same.

lines.content: 男の子はじっと私を見つめてた。
lines.translated: The boy was staring intently at me.

lines.content: ごめんね、と私は言う。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry," I said.

lines.content: ちょっと自分語りしすぎちゃったね。話、長くなっちゃって、ごめん
lines.translated: "I talked a little too much about myself, didn't I? Sorry for rambling on so long."

lines.content: 首を振る男の子に、私は“ありがとう”と小さく言い、もう少しだけ言葉を付け加える。
lines.translated: As the boy shook his head, I offered a quiet "thank you" and added just a few more words.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]が不思議な“夜”を思い描いて、現実にしてしまったというのなら――私は、この世界にそういう時間を作りたい
lines.translated: "If that girl envisioned a mysterious 'Night' and made it a reality -- then I want to create that kind of time in this world."

lines.content: 誰もが自分の物語を書くように生きていく。
lines.translated: Everyone lives as though writing their own story.

lines.content: 与えられた時間の一秒一秒が、その選択が、自分の人生を書く営みだ。
lines.translated: Every single second of the time we are given, every choice we make, is the act of writing our own life.

lines.content: たとえその“命”が終わってしまっても、“想い”だけは、いつまでも大切な人の“隣”に寄り添うもので、あってほしい
lines.translated: "Even if that 'life' comes to an end, I want their 'feelings' alone to stay nestled 'beside' their precious person forever."

lines.content: たとえそれが、その人にしか見えない“半透明”な姿であってたとしてもだ。
lines.translated: Even if it is only in a "translucent" form visible to that person alone.

lines.content: そういう形でならば――誰もそばにいないように思えても、いつもひとりじゃないのだと、わかれば――
lines.translated: If it takes that form -- if they can understand that even when it feels like no one is by their side, they are never truly alone --

lines.content: このすばらしくも底意地の悪い世界を、どうにかこうにか、二人三脚みたいにして、見えない“想い”と力を合わせて、生きていけるだろうはずだ。
lines.translated: Then surely, walking three-legged race style and joining forces with those invisible "feelings," they should be able to somehow live on through this wonderful yet spiteful world.

lines.content: それが私のあたらしい“夢”だよと、私は言った。
lines.translated: I told him that was my new "dream."

lines.content: こんな“夢”、多くの人たちからは叶わないって笑われるだろう。
lines.translated: Most people would probably laugh at a "dream" like this and say it could never come true.

lines.content: そもそもだ。
lines.translated: To begin with...

lines.content: そもそも自分自身でもまだ漠然としすぎている“夢”なのだ。どういうふうに叶えればいいのかさえわからない。
lines.translated: To begin with, it is a "dream" that is still far too vague even to myself. I don't even know how to go about making it come true.

lines.content: ……なんだそれはと呆れられても、何も言い返せないだろう。
lines.translated: Even if someone were to roll their eyes and ask what on earth I was talking about, I wouldn't be able to say anything back.

lines.content: でも私は、諦めないよ。きっとこの“夢”を叶えてみせる
lines.translated: "But I won't give up. I'll definitely make this 'dream' come true."

lines.content: だから今、こうして“隣”にいるあなたの“夢”も、絶対、叶えてみせる。そのために精一杯、力を貸すよ
lines.translated: "So I'll definitely make the 'dream' of you, who is right here 'beside' me now, come true as well. I'll do everything I can to help you with that."

lines.content: どんな“魔法”だって――どころか“奇跡”だって、起こしてみせる。
lines.translated: I will make any kind of "magic" -- no, even a "miracle" -- happen.

lines.content: ……だからね。お願い。諦めずにお母さんを探そうよ
lines.translated: "...So please. Don't give up, and let's look for your mother."

lines.content: この町にいないのなら、町の外にでも――手がかりをどうにか見つけて、探しに行こうよ
lines.translated: "If she isn't in this town, then even outside of it -- let's find a clue somehow and go look for her."

lines.content: ……あなたが“夢”を叶えられたら、私も安心して“夜”に還れるしね
lines.translated: "...Once you make your 'dream' come true, I'll be able to return to the 'Night' with peace of mind, too."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべ、そう言った。
lines.translated: With a wry smile on my face, I said that.

lines.content: あなたには子猫ちゃんがついてるんだもん。……お母さんが、いるんだもん。だから私がいなくたって、もちろん、平気だよね
lines.translated: "After all, you have the little kitten with you. ...And you have your mother. So even if I'm not around, you'll obviously be just fine, right?"

lines.content: 男の子は黙ったままだ。
lines.translated: The boy remained silent.

lines.content: ……私の“想い”は伝わっただろうか。
lines.translated: Did my "feelings" get through to him?

lines.content: 正直なところ、私も、私自身の気持ちを上手に言葉にできないでいる。
lines.translated: To tell the truth, I was failing to put my own feelings into words very well, either.

lines.content: こうしてぐるぐると考えている中ででも、正確にぴしゃりと的を射たような言葉には、実のところひとつだって巡り会えていない。
lines.translated: Even with my thoughts spinning around in circles like this, I hadn't actually come across a single word that hit the mark with pinpoint accuracy.

lines.content: ただ、男の子に前を向いてほしかった。
lines.translated: I just wanted the boy to look forward.

lines.content: 勇気を持ってほしかった――今、諦めてしまうと、数年後にこの子は“後悔”するかもしれない。そう感じていた。その“後悔”は成長した心をこそ蝕むだろう。
lines.translated: I wanted him to have courage -- I felt that if he gave up now, this boy might "regret" it several years down the line. And that "regret" would surely eat away at his heart once he grew up.

lines.content: それだけだ。
lines.translated: That's all.

lines.content: それだけの“想い”を、ただ、伝えたかっただけなのに……。
lines.translated: That was the only "feeling" I had simply wanted to convey, and yet...

lines.content: 男の子はまた更に深く、その心を閉ざしてしまうようにして――ただ私の言うことに、うなずくだけだった。
lines.translated: As if shutting his heart away even deeper once more -- the boy simply nodded at what I said.

lines.content: [・|三][・|人]でお祭りにやって来た。
lines.translated: The three of us came to the festival.

lines.content: 男の子は足下に視線を落としたまま、静かに私の隣をついてくる。子猫をしっかり抱きしめたままだ。
lines.translated: Keeping his gaze dropped to his feet, the boy quietly followed along beside me. He was still holding the kitten tightly in his arms.

lines.content: 町はきらびやかに飾られて、まるで夜空に瞬く満点の星を映す、静かな湖畔の水面のようでもあった。
lines.translated: The town was brilliantly decorated, looking almost like the surface of a quiet lakeside reflecting a night sky full of twinkling stars.

lines.content: しかし、あまりにも人が多かった。
lines.translated: However, there were far too many people.

lines.content: 数十分後には結構な規模の花火大会もあるようで、町中からだけでなく、国内外から人が集まってきているようだ。自分とはまったく顔つきも身体つきも違う外国の人も大勢見かけた。
lines.translated: It seemed there would be a fairly large-scale fireworks display in a few dozen minutes, and people were gathering not just from around town, but from all over the country and even abroad. I saw many foreigners whose facial features and builds were completely different from my own.

lines.content: 瞬く間に、雑踏に埋もれた――このままでははぐれてしまう。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, we were swallowed up by the throngs of people -- at this rate, we would get separated.

lines.content: 私たちは手も繋いで歩けないのだ。握りしめたお小遣いで、屋台のものを買う余裕だってなかった。
lines.translated: We couldn't even walk holding hands. And with the pocket money he was clutching, we couldn't afford to buy anything from the stalls, either.

lines.content: 結局またここに来ちゃったね
lines.translated: "We ended up coming back here after all, huh?"

lines.content: すし詰めみたいな大通りでもみくちゃにされ、人波から吐き出されるようにしてたどり着いたのは、いつもの休憩場所。公園だ。
lines.translated: Jostled about on the packed main street and spat out by the wave of people, the place we arrived at was our usual resting spot: the park.

lines.content: 夜の公園は静かだった。
lines.translated: The park at night was quiet.

lines.content: 証明に照らされた夜桜、その一つひとつの花びらが小さな装飾みたいに、淡い人工的な光りを映していた。
lines.translated: Every single petal of the night cherry blossoms illuminated by the lights reflected a pale, artificial glow like tiny ornaments.

lines.content: ちらほらと、カップルや家族の姿も見えている。
lines.translated: Here and there, couples and families could be seen as well.

lines.content: 誰もがきれいな浴衣を身につけている。ここから花火を見るのかな。
lines.translated: Everyone was wearing beautiful yukatas. I wondered if they were going to watch the fireworks from here.

lines.content: ここは、そのための穴場的な場所で……。
lines.translated: This was a hidden gem of a spot for that...

lines.content: それを知ってる地元の人たちだけが、こうしてこっそり集まっている。そんな気配だ。
lines.translated: And it felt like only the locals who knew about it were secretly gathering here like this.

lines.content: もしかしたらここに、男の子のお母さんも来るかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps the boy's mother might come here, too.

lines.content: 男の子は私の隣で、にこりともしないまま、きらびやかな町の光景を眺めていた。
lines.translated: Beside me, without cracking a single smile, the boy gazed out at the brilliant scenery of the town.

lines.content: 話しかけてみても瞬きを繰り返すだけ。もううなずくこともなかった。
lines.translated: Even when I tried talking to him, he only blinked repeatedly. He wouldn't even nod anymore.

lines.content: せっかく少し、男の子の気持ちを――見えない声を聞けるようになったと思っていたのに。
lines.translated: And just when I thought I had finally become able to hear a little of the boy's feelings -- his invisible voice.

lines.content: 今はもう、そーっと手を重ねてみても、その“想い”を知ることはできなかった。
lines.translated: Now, even when I gently placed my hand over his, I could no longer know his "feelings."

lines.content: でも、大丈夫だ。
lines.translated: But it was going to be okay.

lines.content: 根拠もなく私は思ってる――お母さんをみつけられたらきっと、また前みたいに笑顔を見せてくれる。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: With no basis whatsoever, I believed it -- once we found his mother, he would surely show me his smile again, just like before. It had to be that way.

lines.content: ……そのはず、だよね。
lines.translated: It had to be, right?

lines.content: 誰にともわからず私は祈ってた。
lines.translated: I was praying to no one in particular.

lines.content: 夜空が咲いた。
lines.translated: The night sky blossomed.

lines.content: 花火だ。
lines.translated: Fireworks.

lines.content: 大きな一発が打ち上がったのを合図に、色鮮やかな大小、様々形をした花火が、次々と打ち上がっていく。
lines.translated: With a single large shell shooting up into the sky as the signal, brightly colored fireworks of various sizes and shapes launched one after another.

lines.content: すごい。きれいだね……
lines.translated: "Amazing. It's so pretty..."

lines.content: ため息をつくみたいな言葉が唇からこぼれた。
lines.translated: Words like a sigh spilled from my lips.

lines.content: 私がまだ生きていた頃は、こんなふうにいっぱい花火を打ち上げるような、大きなお祭りはなかったんだけどな
lines.translated: "Back when I was still alive, there weren't any big festivals that launched this many fireworks, though."

lines.content: ふたりで花火を見ていた。
lines.translated: The two of us watched the fireworks.

lines.content: その光りはあんまりにも鮮やかで、眩しすぎ、夜空の星の瞬きも覆い隠してしまうほどだった。
lines.translated: Their light was so vivid and dazzlingly bright that it completely outshone even the twinkling of the stars in the night sky.

lines.content: 破裂音がする。たくさんだ。
lines.translated: Booms echoed out. So many of them.
Every time a dazzling flower of light shot up into the air, cheers rang out as well -- and amidst them, I definitely heard it.

lines.content: 夜の空へ打ち上がった色とりどりの色彩を――
lines.translated: As the people gathered in the park quietly looked up --

lines.content: 公園に集まってきた人たちは静かに見上げ――
lines.translated: At the colorful hues launched into the night sky --

lines.content: 夜に眩い色が咲く度に、ワッと上がる歓声の、その中に。
lines.translated: Amidst the roar of cheers that rose up every time a dazzling color blossomed in the night.

lines.content: ……探し求めた[・|宝][・|物]を、私は、確かに見つけた。
lines.translated: I definitely found the treasure I had been searching for.

lines.content: 宝物……
lines.translated: "Treasure..."

lines.content: [・|俺]は思わずそうつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: I involuntarily muttered the word.

lines.content: 女の子の――[・|ク][・|ロ]の話も、そこでまた、途切れた。
lines.translated: And there, the girl's -- Kuro's -- story broke off once again.

lines.content: 見つけられた宝物っていうのは……
lines.translated: "By the treasure you found, do you mean..."

lines.content: そう問いかけて、やめた。
lines.translated: I started to ask, then stopped myself.

lines.content: 教えられずとも明らかであるように思えたからだ。
lines.translated: Because it seemed obvious even without being told.

lines.content: 代わりに別の質問をすることにする。
lines.translated: Instead, I decided to ask a different question.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: ……なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: ずっと休まず話してくれてるけれど、疲れたりはしないかな。一度電話を置いて、続きはまた明日でも……
lines.translated: "You've been talking nonstop for a while now, though. Aren't you getting tired? We could hang up for now and continue the rest tomorrow..."

lines.content: この先の話を聞くことが怖いから、話を区切るための言い訳を――というわけでもなく、本当に、電話相手のことが気になっていた。
lines.translated: It wasn't that I was making up an excuse to cut the story short out of fear of hearing what came next -- I was genuinely worried about the girl on the other end of the line.

lines.content: 長い……。
lines.translated: It was long...

lines.content: とても長い話になってしまってきているから。
lines.translated: Because it had turned into a very long story.

lines.content: ……大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm okay."

lines.content: でも、クロはそう答えた。
lines.translated: However, that was Kuro's reply.

lines.content: ……もう少しで、このお話も終わるよ。だから、平気
lines.translated: "...This story will be over soon. So I'm fine."

lines.content: ……そっか。もう少しで終わるのか
lines.translated: "...I see. It's almost over, huh?"

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: そしてそこからようやく、わたし[・|達]のお話になる
lines.translated: "And from there, it will finally become our story."

lines.content: 大雅のほうは大丈夫なのと問われ、俺も大丈夫だよと答えた。
lines.translated: When she asked if I was okay on my end, I told her I was fine too.

lines.content: まあ、明日も仕事はあるんだけどね。いつものことだけど、だいたい、太陽よりも早く起きなきゃならない
lines.translated: "Well, I do have work tomorrow, though. It's the usual routine, so I pretty much have to wake up before the sun rises."

lines.content: まだまだ下っ端――新人の教員だ。
lines.translated: I was still at the bottom of the rung -- a rookie teacher.

lines.content: 他の先生方が登校してくる前に職員室をきれいにしておかなきゃならないし、御茶や茶菓子も、用意しておくことも新人の仕事のひとつ。だから結構な早起きをしなければならない。
lines.translated: I had to clean the staff room before the other teachers arrived at school, and preparing the tea and snacks was another one of a rookie's duties. Because of that, I had to wake up pretty early.

lines.content: 教師ってのは給料安いわりに、やること多くて大変だよ。仕事を家に持ち帰ることなんてしょっちゅうだしね
lines.translated: "For how low the pay is, being a teacher sure comes with a ton of work. It's rough. And I end up bringing work home with me all the time, too."

lines.content: ……どうして俺、この仕事をしようと思ったんだったっけ。最近よくわからなくなっちゃってるんだ。色々と、うまくできないことも多くて
lines.translated: "...Why did I ever think I wanted to do this job, anyway? Lately, I've kind of lost track of the reason. There are a lot of things I can't handle very well, too."

lines.content: たぶん俺、この仕事に向いてはいないんだろうな。
lines.translated: I probably wasn't cut out for this job.

lines.content: そう感じるけれど、では果たして、現在の仕事以上に向いてるものはと自身に問いかけてみたところで、鮮やかな回答は無論、得られなかった。
lines.translated: That was how I felt, yet when I asked myself what I might be better suited for than my current job, I naturally couldn't come up with any brilliant answers.

lines.content: ごめん。変な愚痴、こぼしてしまって
lines.translated: "Sorry for spilling out weird complaints like that."

lines.content: “別にいいよ”という言葉の代わりに、微かな鈴の音だけがした。
lines.translated: Instead of the words "I don't mind," there was only the faint ring of a bell.

lines.content: まあさ。確かに明日も早くから仕事はあるんだけど……
lines.translated: "Well, you know. It's true I have work early tomorrow, too, buuut..."

lines.content: だからこれ以上、話が長くなると結構つらい。翌朝早くには起きられなくなる――はずなのに、[・|ど][・|う][・|で][・|も][・|い][・|い]と感じてる。
lines.translated: So if the story dragged on much longer, it would be pretty rough on me. I wouldn't be able to get up early the next morning -- or so I should have thought, yet I felt like I didn't care at all.

lines.content: もう少しで終わるって言うんなら、このまま最後まで聞かせてもらうよ。明日はサボりだ
lines.translated: "If you say it's almost over, then let me hear it all the way to the end right now. I'm skipping work tomorrow."

lines.content: いや……
どうせ向いてない仕事だったんだ。今日限りで辞めちゃってもいいかな。特に未練はないし、俺がいなくても別に、現場が困るってこともないだろうしね
lines.translated: "It was a job I wasn't cut out for anyway. Maybe I'll just quit as of today. I don't have any lingering attachments to it, and it's not like the workplace will be in any real trouble without me."

lines.content: 結局この仕事をして何も残らなかったなと感じた。
lines.translated: In the end, I felt like doing this job hadn't left me with anything.

lines.content: 安い給料では安心を買えるだけの貯金ができたわけでもないし、代わりにかけがえのない経験を得られたという実感もない。
lines.translated: With the low pay, it wasn't as if I had built up enough savings to buy myself peace of mind, nor did I feel like I had gained any irreplaceable experiences in return.

lines.content: ではそこに得がたい仲間の存在を感じられたのかといえば、そういうこともやはりなかった――
lines.translated: And if you asked whether I had found irreplaceable friends there, the answer to that was no, too --

lines.content: 加えて特段、子どもが好きというわけではない。人に何かを教えるという行為もだ。
lines.translated: On top of that, I didn't particularly like kids. The same went for the act of teaching people things.

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり向いてなかったんだなあとしみじみと、思う。
lines.translated: Ah, I really wasn't cut out for it after all, I thought to myself, letting it sink in.

lines.content: だからさ。もうすぐ話は終わるって言ってたけれど、もっと長くなってしまっても……夜通し続いちゃっても、別にいいよ。明日から俺は結構な暇人だ
lines.translated: "So, you know. You said the story would be over soon, but even if it runs longer... even if it goes on all night, I don't mind at all. Starting tomorrow, I'm going to have plenty of free time on my hands."

lines.content: どこかすっとしながらも、俺は言った。
lines.translated: Feeling a strange sense of relief, I spoke.

lines.content: 聞かせてほしい。話の続き
lines.translated: "I want you to let me hear the rest of the story."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: わかったと言い、クロは話を続ける。
lines.translated: Saying she understood, Kuro continued her tale.

lines.content: ゆっくりと紡がれる言葉が、一つひとつ、心にするりと入り込んでくる――そんな感触に俺は、再び[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: The slowly spun words slipped smoothly into my heart, one by one -- and taking in that sensation, I closed my eyelids once again.
It was his mother.

lines.content: 探し求めた“宝物”
lines.translated: The "treasure" we had been searching for.

lines.content: 男の子の心に触れて、私は、その顔を知っている――花火を見るための穴場のような公園だ。そこに集まる浴衣姿の人たちの中に、私は見つけた。
lines.translated: Having touched the boy's heart, I knew her face -- in this park that served as a hidden gem for watching the fireworks, among the people gathered in their yukatas, I found her.

lines.content: ……よかった。やっぱりまだ、この町にいたんだ
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness. She really was still in this town after all."

lines.content: 根拠なんてかけらもないけど、たぶん[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|ん][・|じ][・|ゃ][・|な][・|い][・|か]と感じてた。
lines.translated: I hadn't had a shred of proof, yet I had a feeling that might be the case.

lines.content: 男の子のお母さんは、展望台の欄干付近で花火を見上げ、団扇を片手に微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: Near the railing of the observation deck, the boy's mother was looking up at the fireworks, smiling with a round fan in one hand.

lines.content: あの笑顔を、男の子にも分けてくれるならとてもうれしい。
lines.translated: It would make me so happy if she shared that smile with the boy, too.

lines.content: これで男の子もまた、笑って見せてくれるかな――私の隣を離れ、本来一緒にいてほしい人の隣に、戻っていける。
lines.translated: I wondered if this would make the boy show me his smile again -- leaving my side to return to the side of the person he truly wanted to be with.

lines.content: それはつまり、男の子たちとのお別れのときを意味してもいる。
lines.translated: Which also meant it was time to say goodbye to the boy and his sister.

lines.content: 少しさみしいとは感じた。
lines.translated: I did feel a little lonely.

lines.content: だけどそれ以上に、これでいいんだとも感じていた――男の子をお母さんの隣に連れて行くこと。
lines.translated: But more than that, I felt that this was for the best -- bringing the boy to his mother's side.

lines.content: 私の“役目”は、ここまでだ。
lines.translated: My "role" ended here.

lines.content: 男の子は[・|ま][・|だ]気づいていなかった。ぼんやりと花火を見上げたままだ。
lines.translated: The boy hadn't noticed yet. He was still absentmindedly gazing up at the fireworks.

lines.content: 浴衣姿のお母さんと、同じように――ふたりは少し離れた場所で、光る夜空を仰いでいた。
lines.translated: Just like his yukata-clad mother -- the two of them were looking up at the glowing night sky, just a short distance apart.

lines.content: ふたりの距離は、数メートルほどで。
lines.translated: The distance between them was only a few meters.

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: 私は、ベンチから立ち上がる――[・|だ][・|め][・|だ]。
lines.translated: I stood up from the bench -- No, I can't.
What do I do?

lines.content: 目の前には、探し続けたお母さんの笑顔がある。
lines.translated: Right before my eyes was the smiling face of the mother we had searched for all this time.

lines.content: それに気づかない小さな背中が、並んで見える。
lines.translated: And right beside her, I could see the small back of the boy who hadn't noticed her yet.

lines.content: 胸がずきりと、[・|さ][・|み][・|し][・|さ]で痛んでいた。
lines.translated: My chest throbbed with a sharp ache of loneliness.
Thank goodness.

lines.content: まだ[・|ど][・|ち][・|ら][・|も]気づいては、いない。
lines.translated: Neither of them had noticed yet.

lines.content: そのまま……お願い。
lines.translated: Stay just like that... Please.
Don't notice her.

lines.content: ……行こう
lines.translated: "...Let's go."

lines.content: 男の子に言った。
lines.translated: I spoke to the boy.

lines.content: [・|帰][・|ろ][・|う]。私たちのお家に
lines.translated: "Let's go home. Back to our house."

lines.content: 男の子は私を振り向く。
lines.translated: The boy turned to look at me.

lines.content: “約束”したよね。あなたの“夢”、私が全部叶えるよって。だから帰ろう
lines.translated: "We made a 'promise,' right? That I would make all of your 'dreams' come true. So let's go home."
We couldn't find the treasure. So let's just make our own instead.

lines.content: ……一緒に帰ろう。これからずっと、私たち、三人で一緒に暮らしていこうね
lines.translated: "...Let's go home together. From now on, let's live together forever, the three of us, okay?"

lines.content: ごめんね。あなたの言うとおりだった。この町にはもう、あなたのお母さんはいない。これだけ探したんだもん。きっと、そうだよね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. You were right. Your mother isn't in this town anymore. We've searched this much, after all. That has to be it, right?"

lines.content: ……困惑の表情だと、わかる。
lines.translated: I could tell he had a bewildered expression on his face.

lines.content: しかしその視線に答えるわけにはいかない。
lines.translated: However, I couldn't bring myself to answer his gaze.

lines.content: 触れられるのならその手を繋ぎ、今すぐこの場所から[・|逃][・|げ][・|出][・|し][・|た][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|け][・|れ][・|ど]……。
lines.translated: If I could touch him, I would have taken his hand and run away from this place right this instant, and yet...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 遅かった。
lines.translated: It was too late.

lines.content: 何もかも。
lines.translated: Everything was.

lines.content: 男の子は気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: The boy had noticed.

lines.content: 固まった視線の先には……。
lines.translated: At the end of his frozen gaze was...

lines.content: お母さんだ。男の子の待ち続けた人がいる。
lines.translated: His mother. The person the boy had been waiting for all this time was right there.

lines.content: いつの間にか増えていた雑踏の中、その人は眩しそうに夜空の光りを見上げ続けていた。
lines.translated: Amidst the crowd that had grown before I knew it, she continued to squint up at the bright lights in the night sky.

lines.content: 目を細めた男の子の表情は――“お母さん……”と、そう言っているように、見えた。
lines.translated: As the boy narrowed his eyes, his expression -- looked as though he were saying, "Mom..."

lines.content: 一歩、一歩、男の子は進んでいく――
lines.translated: Step by step, the boy walked forward --

lines.content: ま、待って……っ
lines.translated: "W-Wait...!"

lines.content: 私は、男の子の手を掴もうとする――でも、掴めない。触れられない。
lines.translated: I tried to grab the boy's hand -- but I couldn't grab it. I couldn't touch him.

lines.content: 男の子の歩調が少しずつ、早くなっていく。
lines.translated: Little by little, the boy's pace quickened.

lines.content: お願い、帰ろう……っ、私たち三人で、これからもずっと一緒に暮らそう……っ
lines.translated: "Please, let's go home...! Let's live together forever, the three of us...!"

lines.content: だけど男の子は、そんな私を振り払うようにして、進む。
lines.translated: Yet the boy moved forward, as if shaking me off.

lines.content: だめっ
lines.translated: "No!"

lines.content: 叫び、
lines.translated: I screamed,

lines.content: お願い……っ
lines.translated: "Please...!"

lines.content: 追いすがり、
lines.translated: Chasing after him,

lines.content: 話を聞いて……っ
lines.translated: "Listen to me...!"

lines.content: 必死だった。
lines.translated: I was desperate.

lines.content: 引き留めようとする私の手は、男の子の腕を、肩を、背中を――ことごとく通り抜けていく。
lines.translated: As I tried to hold him back, my hands passed right through the boy's arms, his shoulders, his back -- every single time.

lines.content: もう、“夜”に還るだなんて言わないっ。ずっとあなたのそばにいるからっ。だから、お願い……っ
lines.translated: "I won't say I have to return to the 'Night' anymore! I'll stay by your side forever! So please...!"
Don't go!

lines.content: 必死に叫び、追いすがる私の声は、男の子にはたぶん届いていなかった。
lines.translated: As I screamed desperately and chased after him, my voice probably wasn't reaching the boy at all.

lines.content: [・|お][・|母][・|さ][・|ん]は視線を、あるいは気配を、感じたのかもしれない――ふと、こちらを振り返る。
lines.translated: Perhaps his mother felt his gaze, or his presence -- suddenly, she turned to look this way.

lines.content: ふたりの目が合った。
lines.translated: Their eyes met.

lines.content: お母さんは驚いた顔をした。
lines.translated: A surprised look crossed his mother's face.

lines.content: ……男の子は、震えていた。
lines.translated: The boy was trembling.

lines.content: 小さな拳をぎゅっと握って。
lines.translated: Clenching his small fists tightly.

lines.content: 震えながらも恐る恐る、口を、開いた――
lines.translated: Trembling, he timidly opened his mouth --

lines.content: “お母さん”と、そう言いたかったはずだ。
lines.translated: He must have wanted to say, "Mom."

lines.content: “お母さん、会いに来たよ”と、そう伝えたかったはずだ。
lines.translated: He must have wanted to tell her, "Mom, I came to see you."

lines.content: 少しくらいは怒られて。
lines.translated: He had hoped she might scold him a little.

lines.content: 少しくらいは“よく来たね”って、褒めてもらえると、期待していた。
lines.translated: And that she might praise him a little, saying, "I'm glad you came."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 男の子はその口を閉ざした。
lines.translated: The boy closed his mouth.

lines.content: お母さんがふいに、自分から視線を外したから。
lines.translated: Because his mother suddenly looked away from him.

lines.content: ……その視線の先には、知らない女の子が、いたから。
lines.translated: And because at the end of her gaze, there was an unfamiliar girl.

lines.content: その子はお母さんの隣で、眩しそうに夜空を見上げている。
lines.translated: The girl was standing next to his mother, squinting up at the night sky.

lines.content: 片方の手は甘そうな綿菓子を握りしめ。
lines.translated: One of her hands clutched some sweet-looking cotton candy.

lines.content: もう片方の手は、お母さんと繋がれていた。
lines.translated: Her other hand was holding his mother's.

lines.content: 男の子はどうすべきか、迷い……。
lines.translated: The boy hesitated, unsure of what to do...

lines.content: だけどお母さんなら、きっとわかってくれると信じ……。
lines.translated: Yet believing that if it were his mother, she would surely understand...

lines.content: 弱々しくも前へ、手を伸ばし――
lines.translated: Weakly, he reached his hand out forward--

lines.content: “お願い。ぼくもそんなふうに、手を繋いでほしい”
lines.translated: "Please. I want you to hold my hand like that, too."

lines.content: ……と、もう一歩、踏み出そうとした。
lines.translated: Thinking that, he tried to take one more step forward.

lines.content: でもだめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: “想い”はかけらも、届かない。
lines.translated: Not a single fragment of his "feelings" reached her.

lines.content: そろそろ行こうかと、お母さんは手を繋ぐ女の子に言った。
lines.translated: His mother told the girl whose hand she was holding that it was about time to go.

lines.content: 笑顔でうなずく女の子が、ふと、男の子に気づく。
lines.translated: Nodding with a smile, the girl suddenly noticed the boy.

lines.content: “ねえママ。あの子、誰？　私たちのこと見てるよ”
lines.translated: "Hey, Mommy. Who's that kid? He's looking at us."

lines.content: という、女の子の問いかけがある。“お母さんの知ってる子？”
lines.translated: The girl asked a question. "Do you know him, Mom?"

lines.content: お母さんはもう一度だけこちらを見――……沈黙を挟んだ。
lines.translated: His mother looked this way just one more time--...and paused in silence.

lines.content: じっと、男の子を見ている。ただ、見ている。
lines.translated: She stared fixedly at the boy. Simply looking at him.

lines.content: その目をすっと細め、言った。
lines.translated: Gently narrowing her eyes, she spoke.

lines.content: “……さあ、知らない子ね。迷子かしら”
lines.translated: "...Who knows? I don't know him. Maybe he's a lost child."

lines.content: そのまま、お母さんは笑顔で――知らない女の子と手を繋ぎ、立ちすくむ男の子のすぐ隣を通り過ぎていった。
lines.translated: Just like that, with a smile on her face--holding hands with the unfamiliar girl, his mother walked right past the frozen boy.

lines.content: 私たちは取り残された。
lines.translated: We were left behind.

lines.content: 男の子は、胸に抱きしめていた子猫を、腕からするりと落としてしまう。
lines.translated: The kitten the boy had been hugging to his chest slipped right out of his arms.

lines.content: 上手に着地した子猫は、男の子の足下で心配そうに見上げてる。
lines.translated: Landing gracefully, the kitten looked up worriedly from the boy's feet.

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: 男の子の隣に、ただ寄り添うだけしかできない、こんな私は……。
lines.translated: Someone like me, who can do nothing but stay right beside him...

lines.content: どうしたら、いいの。
lines.translated: What am I supposed to do?

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: 何も、わからなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't know anything at all.

lines.content: いつの間にか花火は終わった。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the fireworks had ended.

lines.content: 公園には私たちだけが残される。もう誰もいなかった。
lines.translated: Only we were left behind in the park. There was no one else around anymore.

lines.content: 外灯さえも消え、月明かりだけが辺りを静かに照らしてた。
lines.translated: Even the streetlights went out, leaving only the moonlight to quietly illuminate the area.

lines.content: 男の子は一歩も動こうとしなかった。
lines.translated: The boy made no move to take even a single step.

lines.content: いつまでも立ちすくみ、呼吸だけが大きく、大きく、その小さな肩を膨らませてばかりいた。
lines.translated: He stood frozen forever, his heavy, ragged breaths making his small shoulders heave over and over.

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 私のせいだ。
lines.translated: It's my fault.

lines.content: ……ごめんっ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 何もかも全部、私のせい。
lines.translated: Everything is entirely my fault.

lines.content: 本当に、ごめん……っ、ごめんなさい……っ
lines.translated: "I'm really sorry... I'm so sorry...!"

lines.content: あなたはもう“夢は諦める”と言った。
lines.translated: You had already said you would "give up on your dream."

lines.content: 心のどこかで[・|こ][・|う][・|な][・|る]ことを、どこかの時点で察したのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Deep down in your heart, at some point, you might have sensed that it would turn out like this.

lines.content: 空っぽの家を見たときだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it when you saw the empty house?

lines.content: それとも何か、具体的なものではないところで、何となくそう感じとっていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, without anything concrete, you had simply felt it somehow.

lines.content: それなのに私が、そんなあなたを“諦めないで”と強引に引っ張り回した――結果、こんなことになってしまった。すべて私のせいだった。
lines.translated: Even so, I forcefully dragged you around, telling you "not to give up"--and as a result, this happened. It was all my fault.

lines.content: 男の子は泣くこともせずただ……ただ、立ち尽くしている。
lines.translated: The boy didn't even cry... he just stood there, completely still.

lines.content: まだ大声で泣くのなら、よかった。
lines.translated: It would have been better if he had cried out loud.

lines.content: 泣いて、叫んで――我がままを思いきりまき散らすくらいのほうが、よっぽどよかった。
lines.translated: If he had cried, screamed--and thrown a huge, selfish tantrum, it would have been so much better.

lines.content: どうして……ひどいよ……こんな
lines.translated: "Why... This is so cruel... How could this..."

lines.content: 泣いているのは私ばかりだ。
lines.translated: I'm the only one crying.

lines.content: 重ねた男の子の手のひらから、いっぱい――いっぱいの悲しさと、さみしさが、伝わってきた。
lines.translated: From the boy's palm resting against mine, so much--so much sadness and loneliness flowed into me.

lines.content: 本当に悲しいとき、人は泣くこともできない。涙さえも一瞬で枯れ果てる――
lines.translated: When people are truly sad, they cannot even cry. Even their tears dry up in an instant--

lines.content: そういう言葉を、いつか開いたページの中に見たことがある。
lines.translated: I once saw words like that on the pages of a book I opened long ago.

lines.content: 私は今、本当に、本当に悲しんでいる人を、はじめて見たのだ。
lines.translated: Right now, for the very first time, I was seeing someone who was truly, deeply grieving.

lines.content: それなのに私は、“半透明”
lines.translated: And yet, I am "translucent."

lines.content: 言葉もなく、涙もなく、泣いている――そんなあなたのことを抱きしめることも、できない。
lines.translated: Crying without words, without tears--I cannot even embrace you like this.

lines.content: ……ごめん。本当に、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I'm truly sorry."

lines.content: あなたはどこまでも、私とそっくりだった。
lines.translated: Through and through, you were just like me.

lines.content: 三人で時計塔の管理室へ戻った。
lines.translated: The three of us returned to the clock tower's caretaker's office.

lines.content: あの後、しばらくすると、男の子はとぼとぼと歩き出し、何とか私と一緒にここへついてきてくれた。
lines.translated: A while after that, the boy started trudging along and somehow managed to follow me back here.

lines.content: もう私の言うことなんて聞いてくれないかと思ったし、そうなってしまったとしても仕方がない。そう思っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: I thought he wouldn't listen to anything I said anymore, and even if it came to that, I couldn't blame him. That's what I thought, and yet...

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 何度となく私は言った。
lines.translated: Time and again, I spoke.

lines.content: ……あなたはほんとに、私とそっくり
lines.translated: "...You really are just like me."

lines.content: そうつぶやくと、いっぱいのさみしさでまた胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: As I murmured that, my chest ached once more with an overwhelming loneliness.

lines.content: 暗く冷たい地下室に取り残されて、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]の期待に応えられなかった私は――なかったことにされてしまった。
lines.translated: Left behind in a dark, cold basement, failing to live up to the expectations of those two--I was treated as though I had never existed.

lines.content: 私の代わりにかわいい子を、ふたりはどこからか誘拐してきたのだ。
lines.translated: To replace me, the two of them kidnapped a cute child from somewhere.

lines.content: 詳しい話や経緯は知らない――でも、男の子と自分とをどうしたって重ねずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I don't know the exact details or circumstances--but no matter what, I couldn't help seeing myself in the boy.

lines.content: 男の子のお母さん。その隣にいた女の子。
lines.translated: The boy's mother. The girl standing next to her.
That girl is the boy's replacement.

lines.content: 男の子は私と同じように、[・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|こ][・|と]にされたのだ。
lines.translated: Just like me, the boy was treated as though he had never existed.

lines.content: テーブルの下で、子猫を抱きしめたまま[まぶた|瞼]を閉じている男の子。
lines.translated: Underneath the table, the boy had his eyes closed while still hugging the kitten.

lines.content: “悪い夢”を見ていなければいい。
lines.translated: I hope he isn't having a "bad dream."

lines.content: そう願う。
lines.translated: That's what I wish for.

lines.content: 願うけど……。
lines.translated: I wish for it, but...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……あなたにとっての“悪い夢”は、この私、だったのかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Maybe the 'bad dream' for you was actually me."

lines.content: “半透明”の両手をじっと見た。
lines.translated: I stared intently at my "translucent" hands.
I was forcing my own "dream" onto you.

lines.content: ああ。こんなの、まるで……
lines.translated: "Ah. This is just like..."

lines.content: まるで、自分の未練を男の子に果たしてもらうため取り憑いている――ただの悪霊も同然だ。
lines.translated: It's as if I'm haunting the boy just to have him fulfill my own lingering regrets--I'm no different from a mere evil spirit.

lines.content: そうだ。私は“悪夢”だ
lines.translated: "That's right. I am a 'nightmare.'"

lines.content: この子を助けたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to save this child.

lines.content: この子をお母さんに会わせてあげたい――この子の“夢”を私が叶える。
lines.translated: I wanted to let this child meet his mother--to make his "dream" come true.
But I was wrong.

lines.content: 本当にお母さんを求めていたのは男の子じゃない。私のほうだった――私は、邪悪だ。
lines.translated: The one who truly wanted a mother wasn't the boy. It was me--I am wicked.

lines.content: 私、あなたに自分の“希望”を押しつけているだけだったんだ
lines.translated: "I was just forcing my own 'hope' onto you."

lines.content: どういう縁なのかわからないけれど、こうして出会えた、自分とどこか似ている男の子。
lines.translated: I don't know what kind of fate brought us together, but I met this boy who is somehow so similar to me.

lines.content: あなたがお母さんにやさしくされるということは、私も、お母さんにやさしくされるのと同じことだと――夢見てた
lines.translated: "I was dreaming--that if your mother was kind to you, it would be the same as my mother being kind to me."

lines.content: 繰り返しそうつぶやくことで、私は私の邪悪さを再認識する。
lines.translated: By murmuring that over and over, I reaffirmed my own wickedness.

lines.content: 男の子が“もういいよ”と、そう訴えかけてきていたのにも関わらず、それを許さなかった――[・|同][・|じ][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Even though the boy was pleading with me that "it's okay now," I didn't allow it--it's the exact same.

lines.content: 男の子を地下牢に閉じ込めて……。
lines.translated: Locking the boy up in an underground prison...

lines.content: “我がままは周りの人を不幸にする”
lines.translated: "Being selfish makes the people around you unhappy."

lines.content: そんなふうに空っぽな言葉で不安を煽り、自分の言うことを聞かせようとしていた大人たちと何も、何ひとつ、私は変わらない。
lines.translated: Using empty words like that to stir up his anxieties and make him obey me--I am no different, not in a single way, from those adults.

lines.content: だから邪悪だ。
lines.translated: That is why I am wicked.

lines.content: 無自覚な邪悪さほど……。
lines.translated: There is no evil worse than unconscious wickedness...

lines.content: 自分は正しいと、そう思い込んでいる邪悪さほどの悪はない。
lines.translated: No evil worse than the wickedness of believing oneself to be right.

lines.content: あなたに“夢を諦めないで”と語った、星空の話
lines.translated: "The story of the starry sky I told you, asking you 'not to give up on your dream.'"

lines.content: そして……私の思い描いたあたらしい“夢”の話
lines.translated: "And... the story of the new 'dream' I envisioned."

lines.content: すべてが邪悪だ
lines.translated: "All of it is wicked."

lines.content: きれいな見かけだけの言葉で、強引に手を引いて……私はひとつ、きれいな心を傷つけた。
lines.translated: Pulling him along by force with words that were only pretty on the surface... I hurt a pure heart.

lines.content: その言葉の中にあるものは、現実をまるで知らない幼稚さばかりだ。
lines.translated: Everything inside those words was just childish naivety that knew nothing of reality.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ただ、きれいめな言葉で自分に酔っていたいだけ。
lines.translated: I just wanted to intoxicate myself with pretty-sounding words.

lines.content: 戯れ言以下の空っぽな言葉の連なりにしか、今や感じられなかった。
lines.translated: Now, they felt like nothing more than a string of empty words, worse than nonsense.

lines.content: ごめん……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry..."

lines.content: 謝っても謝りきれない。
lines.translated: No matter how much I apologize, it's never enough.

lines.content: せめてこの子にできることを考えた。
lines.translated: I thought about what I could at least do for this child.

lines.content: 自分勝手な思いを押しつけ、傷つけてしまったこの子に今から、私が、できること……。
lines.translated: What I can do, starting now, for this child whom I hurt by forcing my selfish feelings onto him...

lines.content: 考えて。
lines.translated: She thought about it.

lines.content: ……考えて。
lines.translated: I thought about it.

lines.content: ……私は
私にはもう、残された道は[・|こ][・|れ]しかなかった。
lines.translated: For me, this was the only path left.

lines.content: ……“たったひとりのあなたを救うため、大勢の命を犠牲にする”のか。それとも“大勢の名前も知らない誰かを救うため、大切な人を犠牲にする”のか
lines.translated: "...Whether to 'sacrifice many lives to save you and you alone,' or to 'sacrifice someone precious to save many people whose names I don't even know.'"

lines.content: それは呪文のようなものだった。
lines.translated: It was like an incantation.

lines.content: 一瞬ほどの瞬きだ。
lines.translated: Just the blink of an eye.

lines.content: ふわふわで、ひらひらで……。
lines.translated: Fluffy, and fluttering...

lines.content: まっしろなドレス姿に、私は戻る。
lines.translated: I return to my pure white dress.

lines.content: これは決意の表れだ。
lines.translated: This is a manifestation of my resolve.

lines.content: 自分以外の誰かの“期待”を満たすため。
lines.translated: To fulfill the "expectations" of someone other than myself.

lines.content: 自分につらく当たる人にさえ、愛されたいと……。
lines.translated: Wishing to be loved even by those who treat me cruelly...

lines.content: そのようなさみしさはもはや、どこにも存在しないのだと、自分自身に言い聞かす。
lines.translated: I tell myself that such loneliness no longer exists anywhere inside me.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……せっかくあなたが、私を“夜”から外へ逃がしてくれたのに。私に“希望”を、くれたのに
lines.translated: "...Even though you went through all that trouble to help me escape from the 'Night.' Even though you gave me 'hope.'"

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: もしかしたらもう、私たち、二度と逢えなくなるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe the two of us will never be able to meet again.

lines.content: こんな邪悪な私には、あなたと幸せになんて――そんなふうに生きる資格なんて、きっとない。
lines.translated: Someone as wicked as me surely has no right to be happy with you--to live a life like that.

lines.content: 大雅。……この選択は、[・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|達]の言う“愛”とか“勇気”とか。せめてそういう“何か”には、なれるかな
lines.translated: "Taiga. ...This choice I'm making, I wonder if it can at least become 'something' like the 'love' or 'courage' that you all talk about."

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: この名前も何もない男の子のことを、今から私は、“[・|誘][・|拐]”することにした。
lines.translated: Starting now, I decided to "kidnap" this boy who had no name and nothing at all.

lines.content: ……そしてましろは、全人類の敵……“夜の女王”になることを決意した
lines.translated: "...And so Mashiro resolved to become the enemy of all mankind... the 'Queen of the Night.'"

lines.content: 大人たちの期待を満たすためじゃない。ただ、たったひとりの男の子を悲しみの底から救い出す。そのために
lines.translated: "Not to fulfill the expectations of adults. Just to save a single boy from the depths of sorrow. For that sake alone."

lines.content: ……世界中から。
lines.translated: By the whole world.

lines.content: そして愛しく想うもの達すべてから。
lines.translated: And by everyone she held dear.

lines.content: 彼女は憎まれ、疎まれ、恐れられる――それが、“嫌われること”を何より恐れる彼女自身が、自らに設定した、最大の“代償”であったから。
lines.translated: She would be hated, shunned, and feared--because for her, who feared "being hated" more than anything, that was the greatest "price" she set for herself.

lines.content: それから先、何があったのか。
lines.translated: What happened after that?

lines.content: ……クロはあまりよく知らないのだと言う。
lines.translated: Kuro says she doesn't know very well.
Because Kuro was always by the boy's side.

lines.content: ……故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: 要所をかいつまむようにして、クロの知っている範囲の出来事をぽつりぽつりと語り、教えてくれた。
lines.translated: Summing up the main points, Kuro spoke haltingly, telling me the events to the extent that she knew them.

lines.content: ……ましろは、あの子を[さら|攫]うことにした
lines.translated: "...Mashiro decided to abduct that child."

lines.content: 自ら町の警察へ電話をし、言ったのだ――“男の子をひとり誘拐した。無事に帰してほしければ……”
lines.translated: She called the town police herself and said--"I have kidnapped a boy. If you want him returned safely..."

lines.content: そこで、ましろは電話を切った。時計塔の管理室に自分たちはいる。最初にそれだけは、伝えて
lines.translated: "Right there, Mashiro hung up the phone. That they were in the clock tower's administration room. Conveying only that much at first."

lines.content: 瞬く間に人々は集まった。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, people gathered.

lines.content: 管理室の窓から外を覗いた。
lines.translated: She peeked outside from the administration room window.

lines.content: ここは学園の敷地内だ。校庭にはどこから話を聞きつけたのか、本当に様々な大人たちが集まり、こちらを見上げているのがわかった。
lines.translated: This was on the academy grounds. I could tell that all sorts of adults had heard the rumor from somewhere and gathered in the schoolyard, looking up this way.

lines.content: ましろは集まった人たちに向けて、叫んだ――[・|全][・|人][・|類][・|に][・|告][・|ぐ]、と
lines.translated: "Mashiro shouted toward the gathered people--'Attention, all mankind.'"

lines.content: 今夜、この町に、この場所に、自分にとって一番大切な“宝物”を持ってやって来い。
lines.translated: Tonight, come to this town, to this place, bringing your most precious "treasure."

lines.content: ……その“宝物”と子どもの命を交換だ
lines.translated: "...We will exchange that 'treasure' for the child's life."

lines.content: ましろは時計塔の小窓から、地上に集まった人たちへそんなふうに思いきり、叫んだ
lines.translated: "From the small window of the clock tower, Mashiro shouted that at the top of her lungs to the people gathered on the ground."

lines.content: “宝物”と子どもの命とが釣り合うようならすぐに、男の子は解放する。何かを得るなら、何かを差し出す。それがルールだ。
lines.translated: If the "treasure" balances out the value of the child's life, the boy will be released immediately. To gain something, you must offer something. That is the rule.

lines.content: そういうふうに、叫んだのだ。
lines.translated: That is how she shouted.

lines.content: 自分を“夜の女王”と名乗る小さな女の子が、同じく小さな男の子を“誘拐”し、具体的ではない“何か”を要求している。……大声で
lines.translated: "A little girl calling herself the 'Queen of the Night' had 'kidnapped' an equally little boy, and was demanding 'something' unspecific. ...At the top of her voice."

lines.content: その映像は全世界に中継された。
lines.translated: That footage was broadcast to the entire world.

lines.content: 朝日が昇るのと共に、手に“宝物”を持ってやって来た人がいる。男の子のお母さんだ。
lines.translated: As the morning sun rose, someone came holding a "treasure" in her hand. It was the boy's mother.

lines.content: “宝物”は、男の子を産んだときの母子手帳。
lines.translated: The "treasure" was the maternity health record book from when she gave birth to the boy.

lines.content: お母さんは“後悔してる”とそう言った。
lines.translated: The mother said, "I regret it."

lines.content: “もう二度と、あの子のことを離さない”と、そう言った。泣きながら。
lines.translated: "I will never let go of that child ever again," she said. While crying.

lines.content: ましろは……
lines.translated: "Mashiro..."

lines.content: “夜の女王”は、その“宝物”を認めなかった。
lines.translated: The "Queen of the Night" did not accept that "treasure."

lines.content: 窓から外へ放り投げた。
lines.translated: She threw him out the window.
Not the "treasure," but the boy.

lines.content: ……これは報いだ。[あなた|母親]が本当の“宝物”を大切にしないから、こうなる――ましろはそう言い、微笑んだ
