lines.translated: "...This is retribution. This happened because you, his mother, didn't cherish your true 'treasure'--Mashiro said that, and smiled."

lines.content: “夜”に響いたのは、男の子が固い地面にたたき付けられる音。
lines.translated: What echoed through the "Night" was the sound of the boy slamming into the hard ground.

lines.content: ……母親の、胸を引き裂くような大きな悲鳴。
lines.translated: And the mother's loud, heart-wrenching scream.

lines.content: ……“夜”に還ったましろは、そんな“[・|悪][・|夢]”を、この町の大人たちに……いいや。世界中の大人たちに、同時に、見せた
lines.translated: "...Mashiro, who had returned to the 'Night,' showed that 'nightmare' to the adults of this town... no, to the adults of the entire world, all at the same time."

lines.content: 大切なものは失わなければ、その大切さに気づけない。
lines.translated: You cannot realize how precious something is until you lose it.

lines.content: そんな手垢まみれのような言葉を、全世界の“母親”へと投げかけた――“誘拐”したのは男の子だけではない。
lines.translated: She cast those worn-out clichés at the "mothers" of the entire world--the boy wasn't the only one she "kidnapped."

lines.content: 町中の……あるいは世界中の子ども達を、ましろは“[・|夜]”[・|に][・|攫][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: All the children in the town... or rather, in the entire world, Mashiro "abducted into the Night."

lines.content: “夜の女王”を名乗る奇妙な少女が、時計塔の窓から外へ投げ捨てるのは――[・|自][・|分][・|の][・|子][・|ど][・|も]だ。
lines.translated: What the strange girl calling herself the "Queen of the Night" threw out the clock tower window was--their own child.

lines.content: 世界中の母親が、そして父親が、そういう“悪夢”にうなされた。愛あるものも。そうでないものも。
lines.translated: Mothers, and fathers, all over the world groaned in agony from that "nightmare." Both those who had love, and those who did not.

lines.content: ……ましろは男の子のお母さんに、思い出してほしかった
lines.translated: "...Mashiro wanted the boy's mother to remember."

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 男の子のお母さんだけではなく、心をなくしてしまった大人たちに。
lines.translated: Not just the boy's mother, but all the adults who had lost their hearts.

lines.content: これから[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|る]だろう人たちに。
lines.translated: And the people who would surely become like that from now on.

lines.content: 愛するものへのやさしさを、思い出してほしかった。
lines.translated: She wanted them to remember their kindness toward the ones they loved.

lines.content: どんなに大人たちが“呪い”によって、気づかぬうちに心をひび割れさせてしまおうと……きっと。
lines.translated: No matter how much the adults had let their hearts crack without realizing it due to the "curse"... surely.

lines.content: きっとだ。
lines.translated: Surely...

lines.content: ……自分の子が、一番の危険にあるときは、どんな母親でも思い出してくれるはず
lines.translated: "...When her own child is in the greatest danger, any mother should be able to remember."

lines.content: いったい何が世界で一番大切なのか――本当の“宝物”は何であるのか。
lines.translated: What on earth is the most precious thing in the world--what their true "treasure" is.

lines.content: それをこの“悪夢”の中で、必ず思い出してくれるはず。
lines.translated: Inside this "nightmare," they would surely remember it without fail.

lines.content: お母さんという存在は、何を犠牲にしてでも自分の子どものところに駆けつけてきてくれるはずなんだ……。
lines.translated: A mother is someone who should rush to her child's side no matter what she has to sacrifice...

lines.content: 母親とはそういう“イキモノ”であってほしいから……
lines.translated: "Because she wanted mothers to be that kind of 'creature'..."

lines.content: だからきっと、この“悪夢”から目覚めたら、男の子のお母さんはここに、駆けつけてきてくれるはず
lines.translated: "So surely, once she woke up from this 'nightmare,' the boy's mother would come rushing here."

lines.content: そう信じた。
lines.translated: She believed that.

lines.content: この期に及んでもましろは、そんな“希望”を捨てられなかった――ああ、また私は、自分の“期待”や“理想”を、誰かに押しつけようとしてしまってる。そんな思いも確かにあった。
lines.translated: Even at this late stage, Mashiro couldn't abandon that "hope"--Ah, I'm trying to force my own "expectations" and "ideals" onto someone again. She certainly felt that way, too.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 世界中の大人たちが、母親が、その“想い”を思い出してくれるなら……。再認識してくれるのなら
lines.translated: "If the adults of the world, if the mothers, would remember those 'feelings'... If they would recognize them once more..."

lines.content: 私はよろこんで“[最大の悪夢|夜の女王]”にだってなる。
lines.translated: Then I will gladly become the "Queen of the Night"--the greatest nightmare.
"Living that way was Mashiro's..."

lines.content: ましろだけに歌える、“愛”と“勇気”の“歌”だった――だ、なんて。
lines.translated: The "song" of "love" and "courage" that only Mashiro could sing--or so she thought.

lines.content: ……そんなふうになれますようにと、ましろは、祈った
lines.translated: "...Mashiro prayed that she could become like that."

lines.content: こうして固めた自分の覚悟が、ほんの少しの“勇気”が、男の子への“ごめんね”になりますようにと、必死に、祈っていた
lines.translated: "She prayed desperately that the resolve she had hardened this way, that this tiny bit of 'courage,' would become an 'I'm sorry' to the boy."

lines.content: 翌朝。
lines.translated: The next morning.

lines.content: 男の子が“夜”の外で目を覚ましたとき、もうましろはどこにもいなかった
lines.translated: "When the boy woke up outside the 'Night,' Mashiro was already nowhere to be found."

lines.content: 代わりに、泣き濡れた顔のお母さんがいた。
lines.translated: Instead, his mother was there, her face wet with tears.

lines.content: 抱きしめられた。
lines.translated: He was embraced.

lines.content: ごめんなさいと何度も言われた。
lines.translated: He was told "I'm sorry" over and over again.

lines.content: 悪い夢を見たのだという。本当に、本当に悪い夢。
lines.translated: She said she had a bad dream. A really, really bad dream.

lines.content: ……まるで現実みたいな“悪夢”だったのだ。
lines.translated: It had been a "nightmare" that felt just like reality.

lines.content: それを見て、思い出した――[・|あ][・|な][・|た]が生まれてきてくれた日のこと。
lines.translated: Seeing it made her remember--the day you were born.

lines.content: そのとき感じたはずの愛しい“想い”
lines.translated: The loving "feelings" she must have felt back then.

lines.content: どうして今まで忘れてしまっていたのか。
lines.translated: Why had she forgotten them until now?

lines.content: “これからは今までの分、あなたのことをいっぱい、いっぱい大切にする。約束するわ”――そう言って、微笑みかけてくれたお母さんに……。
lines.translated: "From now on, I'll cherish you so, so much, to make up for everything until now. I promise"--to his mother, who said that and smiled at him...

lines.content: ようやく自分を迎えに来てくれたお母さんに。
lines.translated: To his mother, who had finally come to pick him up.

lines.content: ……しっかりと、手を繋がれて。
lines.translated: With their hands firmly joined together.

lines.content: 同じような“悪夢”を見て、校庭に集まっていた大勢の人たちに見守られ、男の子は、[・|あ][・|た][・|ら][・|し][・|い][・|家]に帰った。
lines.translated: Watched over by the huge crowd of people who had seen the same kind of "nightmare" and gathered in the schoolyard, the boy returned to his new home.

lines.content: ……そうか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: 話の途中、[・|俺]は相づちを打つように、言った。
lines.translated: Halfway through the story, I spoke up just to chime in.

lines.content: ……男の子は、お母さんのところへ戻ることができた。ましろのおかげで
lines.translated: "...The boy was able to return to his mother. Thanks to Mashiro."

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: ……そして、男の子は、生涯幸せに暮らしていきましたとさ。めでたしめでたし――とは、もちろん
lines.translated: "...And so, the boy lived happily ever after. The end--is, of course..."

lines.content: ……ならない
lines.translated: "...Not how it goes."

lines.content: ああ。そうだよね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Right."

lines.content: 幸せに終わった後の物語なら、[・|無][・|関][・|係]な俺が、わざわざこうして語り聞かせられる道理もないはず。
lines.translated: If it were a story with a happy ending, there'd be no reason for an uninvolved guy like me to be told all this out of the blue.

lines.content: 残された男の子の物語は、ましろの想いとは裏腹に、幸福には終われなかった――……いいや
lines.translated: "Contrary to Mashiro's wishes, the story of the boy left behind couldn't end happily--...No."

lines.content: おそらく今現在もまだ、まだまだ道の途中だ。[・|そ][・|の][・|物][・|語][・|は][・|終][・|わ][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|な][・|い]。だからこそ君は……
lines.translated: "Even right now, it's probably still a long, long way from over. That story hasn't ended. And that's precisely why you..."

lines.content: 君は、こんな俺にすがりつくようにして、電話してきたのだろうから。
lines.translated: That's why you called me, clinging to someone like me for dear life.

lines.content: ……こんな俺にしか、助けを求められなかったのだろうから。
lines.translated: Because someone like me was the only one you could ask for help.

lines.content: ……あの子は
lines.translated: "...That boy..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……あの子は、お母さんの元には帰れなかった
lines.translated: "...That boy couldn't go back to his mother."

lines.content: クロは言う。
lines.translated: So said Kuro.

lines.content: ……お母さんは、男の子にやさしくしてくれた。これまでのことを何度も謝り、いっぱい抱きしめ、繋いだ手をぎゅっとして
lines.translated: "...His mother was kind to him. She apologized over and over for everything that had happened, hugged him lots, and squeezed his hand tight."

lines.content: ……これからはあなたのこと[・|も]大切にしていくと約束をしてくれた。何度も、何度も。繰り返し言って、男の子にいっぱいの安心をくれたんだ
lines.translated: "...She promised that from now on, she would cherish him, too. Over and over again. She repeated it, giving the boy so much peace of mind."

lines.content: だけどすぐに、男の子は、元いた地下牢へと戻された。
lines.translated: But right after that, the boy was thrown back into the underground dungeon he had been in before.

lines.content: お母さんが裏切ったわけではない。心をねじ曲げられた意地悪な大人たちに、[・|お][・|母][・|さ][・|ん][・|ご][・|と][・|捕][・|ま][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: It wasn't that his mother betrayed him. He was captured right along with his mother by cruel adults whose hearts had been twisted.

lines.content: 男の子のお母さんはもう二度と、男の子と会ってはならないとされていた。いっぱいの理不尽な“規則”に固められた家系なのだ。
lines.translated: The boy's mother had been forbidden from ever seeing him again. It was a family bound by all kinds of unreasonable "rules."

lines.content: ……“特別”な家系に“才能”なく生まれてきた男の子のその“命”は、“永遠の命”を得るため“怪物”を誘い出す“餌”だった。
lines.translated: Born into a "special" lineage without any "talent," the boy's "life" was nothing more than "bait" to lure out a "monster" so they could obtain "eternal life."

lines.content: だから男の子に名前はない。ただの消耗品。“外の世界”のどこにも居場所のない子だ。
lines.translated: That was why the boy had no name. Just a consumable item. A child with no place to belong anywhere in the "outside world."

lines.content: “夜の女王はどこにいる”
lines.translated: "Where is the Queen of the Night?"

lines.content: 地下牢で怖い大人に問われた。
lines.translated: Scary adults interrogated him in the dungeon.

lines.content: 男の子は首を振り“知らない”と答える。
lines.translated: The boy shook his head and answered, "I don't know."

lines.content: すると、目の前でお母さんを[・|消][・|さ][・|れ][・|た]。とてもひどい方法で。
lines.translated: And then, right before his eyes, his mother was erased. In a truly horrific way.

lines.content: “男の子に二度と会ってはならない”――ルールを破ったことで、どのみちそうなっていた。怖い大人は笑いもせずそう言った。
lines.translated: "Never meet the boy again"--by breaking that rule, she would have ended up like this anyway. The scary adults said that without even smiling.

lines.content: “夜の女王はどこにいる”
lines.translated: "Where is the Queen of the Night?"

lines.content: また同じように問われた。
lines.translated: They asked him the exact same question again.

lines.content: 必死になって首を振る。
lines.translated: He frantically shook his head.

lines.content: わからないんだ。本当に。……わかればぼくだって会いに行きたい。今すぐに。
lines.translated: He didn't know. He really didn't. ...If I knew, I'd want to go see her myself. Right this second.

lines.content: しかし大人たちがそれで納得し、許してくれるはずもない。
lines.translated: However, there was no way the adults would accept that and let him off the hook.

lines.content: 男の子が“わからない”と首を振るその度に、一人、またひとりと、消されていった。
lines.translated: Every time the boy shook his head and said "I don't know," they were erased, one after another.

lines.content: “夜の女王はどこにいる”
lines.translated: "Where is the Queen of the Night?"

lines.content: 機械仕掛けのように何度も問われる。
lines.translated: Like clockwork, he was questioned over and over.

lines.content: “あいつを消さねばいつまでも、夜空の月が人の心を壊し続ける”
lines.translated: "If we don't erase her, the moon in the night sky will keep destroying people's hearts forever."

lines.content: 何の話かわからない。
lines.translated: He had no idea what they were talking about.

lines.content: だからやっぱり首を振るしかできない。
lines.translated: So all he could do was keep shaking his head.

lines.content: ……ぼくのせいだ。
lines.translated: It's my fault.

lines.content: 男の子は頭を抱えた。
lines.translated: The boy clutched his head.

lines.content: ……ぼくが、“お母さんに会いたい”だなんて。
lines.translated: Because I wished for something like "wanting to see my mother."

lines.content: ……そんな我がままばかりを思ったせいだ。
lines.translated: It's because I kept having such selfish thoughts.

lines.content: ……そのせいで、たくさんの人や、[・|た][・|く][・|さ][・|ん][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]が、不幸になってく。
lines.translated: Because of that, so many people, and so many "people," are becoming miserable.

lines.content: 夜になり、大人たちが地下牢を去って行ったあと、隠れていた私を抱きしめた男の子。
lines.translated: When night fell and the adults left the dungeon, I came out of hiding, and the boy hugged me tight.

lines.content: その両腕から、聞こえないはずの心の声を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: Through his arms, I felt like I could hear the voice of his heart that should have been silent.

lines.content: ……ぼくのせいだ。ぼくが生まれてきたせいだ。こんなぼくなんて、いなければよかった。
lines.translated: It's my fault. It's because I was born. Someone like me never should have existed.

lines.content: 目の前で消されたのはお母さんだけではない。
lines.translated: His mother wasn't the only one erased right before his eyes.

lines.content: かつて[・|奏][・|大][・|雅]のそばにいてくれた“半透明”のひと達もまた、次々と、男の子の前で消されていったのだ――大人たちは、言った。
lines.translated: The "semi-transparent" people who had once stayed by Kanade Taiga's side were also erased in front of the boy, one after another--the adults said:

lines.content: “夜の女王の居場所を教えろ。知らないとは言わせない。隠しても無駄だ。女王がお前のそばにいつもいたことを我々は知っている”
lines.translated: "Tell us where the Queen of the Night is. We won't take 'I don't know' for an answer. Hiding it is useless. We know the Queen was always by your side."

lines.content: “正直に言え”
lines.translated: "Tell us the truth."

lines.content: “うそも黙りもどちらもなしだ”
lines.translated: "Neither lies nor silence will be tolerated."

lines.content: “そうでなければ、お前に無関係だったもの達も消していく。この特別な拳銃と弾丸で”
lines.translated: "Otherwise, we will start erasing the ones who have nothing to do with you, too. With this special handgun and these bullets."

lines.content: ……大丈夫。気にするな。こんなのは当然、君のせいじゃない。だけどせめてこっちを見ないようにしろ
lines.translated: "...It's okay. Don't worry about it. Obviously, none of this is your fault. Just... at least try not to look this way."

lines.content: そう言い、やさしく微笑むお姉さん。
lines.translated: An older girl said that with a gentle smile.

lines.content: その妹らしい黒髪の女の子。
lines.translated: A black-haired girl who seemed to be her younger sister.

lines.content: 長い髪を後ろでまとめた痩身の男のひと。
lines.translated: A slender man with long hair tied back.

lines.content: 真っ黒な車掌服に身を包んだ小さな子。
lines.translated: A little kid dressed in a pitch-black train conductor's uniform.

lines.content: 男の子が首を振る度、大人たちはその手で一人ひとり順番に、“半透明”な“夜のひと達”を消していった――どうしてそんなことをするのか。泣きながら、声もなく訴えた。
lines.translated: Every time the boy shook his head, the adults used their own hands to erase the "semi-transparent" "people of the Night" one by one, in order--Why are you doing this? Through his tears, he pleaded silently.

lines.content: “お前にとって奏大雅は特別だった。そうだろう？　大人は子どものことくらいなら何でも知ってる。隠し事などできると思うな”
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga was special to you. Isn't that right? Adults know everything when it comes to children. Don't think you can keep secrets from us."

lines.content: “だからな？　お前にとって特別だった奏大雅が、特別に思っていたもの達が、人質だ。お前が私たちの言うことを聞かないのなら、どうなるか。もうわかってるだろう”
lines.translated: "So, you see? The ones who were special to Kanade Taiga, who was so special to you, are our hostages. You already understand what will happen if you don't obey us, don't you?"

lines.content: “絶望”だった。
lines.translated: It was "despair."

lines.content: ……幼い心にはこれ以上ないくらいの“絶望”だ。
lines.translated: For a young heart, it was the greatest "despair" imaginable.

lines.content: 大人たちは言う。
lines.translated: The adults spoke.

lines.content: “さあ。夜の女王の居場所を教えろ。あいつを消さなければ、我々人類の未来はない。そのはずだ。……そのはず、なんだよな？”
lines.translated: "Now, tell us where the Queen of the Night is. If we don't erase her, there is no future for humanity. That's how it must be. ...That's how it must be, right?"

lines.content: ましろを消しさえすれば、これ以上、夜空の月は人々の心を蝕まない。結果。[・|ど][・|ち][・|ら][・|の]世界も救うこととなる。[・|前][・|提][・|を][・|書][・|き][・|換][・|え][・|る][・|の][・|だ]。
lines.translated: As long as they erased Mashiro, the moon in the night sky wouldn't eat away at people's hearts anymore. As a result, both worlds would be saved. It would rewrite the very premise.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 誰も[・|全][・|人][・|類][・|の][・|敵]――“夜の女王”の居場所を知らない。
lines.translated: No one knew the whereabouts of the enemy of all humanity--the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: 彼女は忽然と姿を消したのだ。
lines.translated: She had vanished without a trace.

lines.content: 誰もがそんな彼女を憎悪した。
lines.translated: Everyone hated her for it.

lines.content: ……“夜”の中でも。“夜”の外ででも。
lines.translated: Both inside the "Night," and outside the "Night."

lines.content: “夜の国”が存在している限り――“未来”の時間でも。“過去”の時間の中ででも。
lines.translated: As long as the "Night Realm" existed--both in "future" time, and in "past" time.

lines.content: ……その根拠のない“憎悪”こそ、彼女の“[魔法|想い]”の“代償”だとは、やはり、誰も知らない
lines.translated: "...And still, no one knows that this baseless 'hatred' is the very 'price' of her 'magic'--her feelings."

lines.content: 大切に護りたかったもの達に憎まれ。
lines.translated: Hated by the ones she wanted so dearly to protect.

lines.content: ……疎まれ。
lines.translated: Shunned by them.

lines.content: はじめて、ましろの願いは叶う――“夜の世界”も。“夜の外”も。どちらも救う。そんな彼女の願いが。
lines.translated: Only then would Mashiro's wish come true--to save both the "World of the Night" and the "Outside of the Night." That wish of hers.

lines.content: その結果が、その“未来”の光景が、[・|こ][・|れ]なのか。
lines.translated: Is this the result, the sight of that "future"?

lines.content: 自分のせいで、大勢が二度と帰らぬものと成りはて、去って行く。
lines.translated: Because of him, so many people were reduced to those who would never return, departing forever.

lines.content: 男の子は、そういう“未来”を書き換えたいから……
lines.translated: "Because the boy wanted to rewrite that kind of 'future'..."

lines.content: 本来、この時間は、奏大雅とましろとの“恋物語”がはじまるべき時間であったはず。
lines.translated: Originally, this time should have been when the "love story" between Kanade Taiga and Mashiro began.

lines.content: こんな“絶望”ばかりが散りばめられてる時間では、なかったはずだ……。
lines.translated: It shouldn't have been a time littered with nothing but this kind of "despair"...

lines.content: それなのに、本来ここにいなければならないはずの[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]はいない――[・|自][・|分][・|の][・|せ][・|い][・|で]死んでしまった。人生を奪われたのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, the two who were supposed to be here weren't--they had died because of him. Their lives had been stolen away.

lines.content: 代わりに、何の能力もない、誰かに愛されることもない、どころか名前さえもない、ただのモブのような“[自分|誰か]”がいるだけ。
lines.translated: In their place was just "someone" like a background character--myself--with no abilities, unloved by anyone, without even a name.

lines.content: だめだ。こんな“今”は、あり得てはいけないはずだ……。
lines.translated: No. A "present" like this must never be allowed to exist...

lines.content: 何かが間違えているんだと、男の子は強く信じた
lines.translated: "The boy strongly believed that something had gone wrong."

lines.content: こんな“未来”の世界はあってはならない。間違いは正されるべきものだ。
lines.translated: A "future" world like this must not exist. Mistakes are meant to be corrected.

lines.content: だからあの子は、[・|わ][・|た][・|し][・|と][・|一][・|緒][・|に]、ましろと奏大雅を救うため――目の前で消されていったお母さんと、“半透明”のひと達を救うために……長い、とても長い、“夜”の旅へと踏み出した
lines.translated: "So, together with me, that boy set out on a long, very long journey through the 'Night'... to save Mashiro and Kanade Taiga--to save his mother and the 'semi-transparent' people who were erased before his eyes."
And just like that, that boy vanished from this world.

lines.content: ……わたしのことひとりぼっちに、したままで。あの子は、どこかへ消えてしまったの
lines.translated: "...Leaving me all alone. That boy disappeared somewhere."

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: 湿った声が、心に届く。
lines.translated: Her tearful voice reached my heart.

lines.content: ……どうか、お願い
lines.translated: "...Please, I beg you."
"Our hero. ...Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: あの子のことを、助けてください
lines.translated: "Please, save him."

lines.content: 一度、わたし達は通話を終える。特別な黒色の電話、その受話器を置いた。
lines.translated: For now, we ended the call. I set down the receiver of the special black telephone.

lines.content: わたしがいるのは[・|大][・|雅][・|の][・|部][・|屋]。その寝床だ。
lines.translated: Where I am right now is Taiga's room. In his bed.

lines.content: 今、電話で話していたはずの人もこの部屋にいる――でも、わたしの隣には誰もいなかった。[・|場][・|所][・|は][・|同][・|じ][・|で][・|も][・|時][・|間][・|が][・|違][・|う]。
lines.translated: The person I was just talking to on the phone is in this room, too--yet there was no one beside me. The place is the same, but the time is different.

lines.content: ……鼻を啜る。
lines.translated: I sniffled.

lines.content: もう泣かないと決めたはず。……[あの子|大雅]とまた会えるまでは。絶対。
lines.translated: I thought I'd decided not to cry anymore. ...Not until I can see that boy--Taiga--again. No matter what.

lines.content: それなのに、いやだな。
lines.translated: And yet, I hate this.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: どこにいるの……。
lines.translated: Where are you...?

lines.content: お願い。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: 手を、握ってほしい。
lines.translated: I want you to hold my hand.

lines.content: じゃないと、だめだよ。涙がにじんで、止まらないよ――誰もいないとわかってる“隣”に、わたしはいつも心で、語りかけている。
lines.translated: If you don't, I can't take it. The tears are welling up, and they won't stop--in my heart, I'm always speaking to the space "beside" me, even knowing no one is there.

lines.content: ああ、きっと少し、わたしは安心したのだ。[・|本][・|当][・|の][・|奏][・|大][・|雅]と話ができて。もしかしたら本当に、きみのことを助けられるかもしれない。そんな“希望”を持てた。
lines.translated: Ah, I must have felt a little relieved. Being able to talk to the real Kanade Taiga. I was able to hold onto the "hope" that maybe, just maybe, he could really save you.

lines.content: だから涙が止まらないんだ。
lines.translated: That's why my tears won't stop.

lines.content: [男の子|大雅]と一緒に旅に出る。
lines.translated: Setting out on a journey together with the boy--with Taiga.

lines.content: ……そう決めた夜のこと。
lines.translated: About the night we made that decision.

lines.content: それから共に歩き続けた長い、とても長い時間のことを、わたしは、思い出している。
lines.translated: I'm remembering the long, very long time we spent walking together after that.
"...I'm scared."
That day--

lines.content: 『……怖いよ』
lines.translated: "...I'm so scared."

lines.content: 世界中の子ども達を“誘拐”し、“夜の女王”となったましろは、時計塔の管理室で震えていた。
lines.translated: Mashiro, who had "kidnapped" the children of the world and become the "Queen of the Night," was trembling in the clock tower's control room.

lines.content: 『……もう誰も、誰も私を、好きだと言ってくれる人はいなくなる。誰もが私を大嫌いに、なる』
lines.translated: "...There won't be anyone left who says they like me anymore. Everyone is going to hate me."

lines.content: それが怖いと泣いていた。
lines.translated: She cried, saying how terrifying that was.

lines.content: 『もう、大雅も……“夜”のどこかで、私のことを待っていてくれなくなるかもしれない』
lines.translated: "Even Taiga... might not wait for me anywhere in the 'Night' anymore."

lines.content: それがさみしいと、ましろは肩を震わせていた。
lines.translated: Mashiro's shoulders trembled at the loneliness of that thought.

lines.content: 『お母さんも、お父さんも、どこかでこんな私を見てるかも。……ふたりはきっと、今夜……私のことを、もっともっと、大嫌いになるんだ』
lines.translated: "Mom and Dad might be watching me like this from somewhere, too. ...Tonight, the two of them... are definitely going to hate me even more."

lines.content: それがどうしようもなく、つらい――
lines.translated: It was unbearably painful--

lines.content: ましろは今にも、消えてなくなってしまいそうだった。
lines.translated: Mashiro looked as if she might fade away at any moment.

lines.content: その姿を男の子は見つめてた。
lines.translated: The boy stared at her as she was.

lines.content: ごめんねと、ましろは言った。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry," Mashiro said.

lines.content: 『……情けないところを見せて、ごめん』
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry for letting you see me look so pathetic."

lines.content: その夜。
lines.translated: That night.

lines.content: 男の子を“夜”に連れてきたのは、こんな自分の姿を見せるためでは、なかったはずだ――……それなのに。ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: Surely she hadn't brought the boy into the "Night" just to show him this side of herself--...And yet. I'm sorry.

lines.content: 『泣いてばかりで、震えてばかりで。……こんな私で。ごめん。こんな私が、あなたを救えると少しでも思ってしまって。本当に、ごめんね』
lines.translated: "All I do is cry and tremble. ...Being the way I am. I'm sorry. For thinking, even for a moment, that someone like me could save you. I'm truly sorry."

lines.content: ましろは繰り返し、男の子に謝っていた。
lines.translated: Mashiro apologized to the boy over and over again.

lines.content: 『上手く言葉にできないけれど――あなたを、“[ここ|夜]”に連れてきたのは……』
lines.translated: "I can't put it into words very well, but--the reason I brought you to the 'Night,' to this place..."

lines.content: あなたのために生きたいと願うものが確かにいた。いや。その“想い”は利己的なものであったかもしれない。
lines.translated: There was certainly someone who wished to live for your sake. No. Perhaps those "feelings" were selfish ones.

lines.content: だからあなたへの気持ちは本物の“想い”だったのかと問われれば、怪しい。自分でもわからない。でも、それらをすべてひっくるめて、あなたに知ってほしかった。
lines.translated: So if asked whether my feelings for you were genuine, it would be doubtful. Even I don't know. But I wanted you to know all of it, everything included.

lines.content: あなたへの“ごめんなさい”を、言葉ではない部分で伝えたかった――……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: I wanted to convey my "I'm sorry" to you in a way that went beyond words--...Ah, that's right.
"Doing this is what I want to leave to you..."

lines.content: 世界中のあなた[・|達]へと残す、“愛”と“勇気”の歌としたい――やっぱりそういうふうに、幼稚であろうともましろは信じていたかった。
lines.translated: To all of you around the world, as a song of "love" and "courage"--even if it was childish, Mashiro still wanted to believe in it that way.

lines.content: ……この“[・|歌]”が、さみしいばかりの男の子に、その心に、少しでも“勇気”を残すことはできないかと、祈ってた。
lines.translated: She prayed that this "song" might leave even a little bit of "courage" in the heart of the boy who was so terribly lonely.

lines.content: 数多ある鮮やかな物語のように。
lines.translated: Like the countless vivid stories out there.

lines.content: きらきら眩しい絵のように。
lines.translated: Like a dazzling, sparkling picture.

lines.content: そういった、名もなき“誰か”が祈り、綴った“[想い|作品]”のように。
lines.translated: Like those "works"--those feelings--prayed over and woven together by some nameless "someone."

lines.content: ……遠い過去から時を越え、いっぱいの“勇気”と“愛”を届けたあの“歌”のように。
lines.translated: Like that "song" that transcended time from the distant past to deliver so much "courage" and "love."

lines.content: あなたの心の“夜”色に、少しでもいい、光りを求めた。
lines.translated: For the "Night"-colored heart within you, she sought light, even if just a little.

lines.content: 『最後に“夢”を語ろうか』
lines.translated: "Let me talk about a 'dream' one last time."

lines.content: ましろは小さく、男の子へ微笑んで見せた。
lines.translated: Mashiro gave the boy a small smile.

lines.content: 『“人はみんな[・|誰][・|か]になりたい”――ねえ、君はいったい、どんな[・|誰][・|か]になりたいと願う？』
lines.translated: "'Everyone wants to become *someone*'--hey, what kind of *someone* do you wish to become?"

lines.content: 『誰に嫌われたって。憎まれたって。いつかの私にそっくりな、あなたみたいな子たちをね、少しでも多くさみしさから救い出したい。そんな誰かに、私はなるよ』
lines.translated: "No matter who dislikes me. No matter who hates me. I want to save as many children like you--who are just like I once was--from their loneliness as I possibly can. That's the kind of person I'm going to become."

lines.content: 『……だからね、安心してよ。この先、どんな困難なことがあなたに、絶え間なく降り注ぐことがあったとしても――大丈夫だよ』
lines.translated: "...So don't worry. No matter what hardships may endlessly rain down on you from here on out--it'll be okay."

lines.content: こうしてそばに姿はなくても。声は、届かなくても。
lines.translated: Even if I'm not right here beside you. Even if my voice can't reach you.

lines.content: 『私が必ず、[・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|達]のことを護るから』
lines.translated: "Because I will definitely protect all of you."

lines.content: だからもう怖がらない。嫌われることを恐れない。誰かの期待どおりの自分ではいられない。
lines.translated: So I won't be scared anymore. I won't fear being hated. I can't be the person others expect me to be.

lines.content: ……いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: やっぱりどうしようもなく怖いけど、それでももう二度と、弱音は吐かない。
lines.translated: Of course, I'm still hopelessly terrified, but even so, I will never complain or show weakness again.

lines.content: 『……そんな私になれるよう、がんばる』
lines.translated: "...I'll do my best to become that kind of person."

lines.content: そういう自分だからこそ、私は私を愛せるようになるだろう――あなたのことを傷つけた私のことを、ようやく、許すことができるだろう。
lines.translated: Only by becoming like that will I be able to love myself--and finally, I might be able to forgive myself for hurting you.

lines.content: 『私は、あなたのことを傷つけた』
lines.translated: "I hurt you."

lines.content: 何度となくましろは言った。泣きながら。無理矢理に微笑みながら。
lines.translated: Mashiro said it time and time again. Through her tears. While forcing a smile.

lines.content: 『いやがるあなたのことを強引に励まして、上っ面で薄らさむい言葉と、張りぼてめいたお話に、どこか自分で陶酔しながらも……あなたに“夢”を、叶えさせようとした』
lines.translated: "I forcefully encouraged you even when you didn't want it, getting somewhat intoxicated on my own superficial, hollow words and a paper-thin story... as I tried to make you fulfill your 'dream.'"

lines.content: “諦めたほうがいい夢”もある。
lines.translated: There are some "dreams that are better given up on."

lines.content: 願いをすべて叶えることが正しいわけではない。
lines.translated: Granting every wish isn't necessarily the right thing to do.

lines.content: そんなことも知らなかった私は……。
lines.translated: Not even knowing something like that, I...

lines.content: 『いやがるあなたを強引に説得しながら、これはあなたのためなんだって。きっとそんなことを思いながら、自分の想いを、小さなあなたに押しつけていた』
lines.translated: "Forcefully persuading you when you were reluctant, telling myself it was for your own good. Surely thinking something like that, I pushed my own feelings onto someone as small as you."

lines.content: その罪は大きい。
lines.translated: That sin is heavy.

lines.content: ……幼い心には、あんまりに、大きすぎた。
lines.translated: For a young heart, it was far too heavy.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|う][・|で][・|も][・|し][・|な][・|い][・|と]、ましろは自分を永遠に、許すことはできないだろう――だから、叫んだ。
lines.translated: Unless she did at least this much, Mashiro would probably never be able to forgive herself for all eternity--and so, she cried out.

lines.content: 『……全人類に、告ぐ！』
lines.translated: "...Hear me, all of humanity!"

lines.content: 時計塔の小窓から、“夜”の世界へと、眠りについたたくさんの心へと、ましろは叫んだ。
lines.translated: From the small window of the clock tower, out into the world of the "Night," to the many hearts that had fallen asleep, Mashiro shouted.

lines.content: 『……今、この“夜”に！　人生でもっとも大切なものを、思い出せ――すべてだ！　そのすべてを私が、壊してみせよう！』
lines.translated: "...Right now, in this 'Night'! Remember the most precious thing in your life--everything! I will destroy every last bit of it!"

lines.content: そしてましろは全人類の敵――“夜の女王”という、漠然としていて、しかし大きなおおきな“[悪夢|不安]”となって、人々の心に根付いた。
lines.translated: And so Mashiro took root in people's hearts as the enemy of all humanity--a vague, yet massive, overwhelming "anxiety" and nightmare known as the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: 彼女は今も、“夜”の中に――あるいは人々の心の中に巣くってる。
lines.translated: Even now, she lurks within the "Night"--or perhaps within the hearts of the people.

lines.content: 彼女の居場所を突き止め、[・|と][・|ど][・|め][・|を][・|刺][・|す]ことで人類は救われる。いつからかそういうふうに“噂”されるようになった。
lines.translated: Humanity will be saved by tracking down her whereabouts and dealing her the finishing blow. At some point, that "rumor" began to spread.

lines.content: 彼女を消し去ったものには報酬さえ支払われる。どのような願いでも叶えられる“魔法”の力だ。
lines.translated: A reward would even be paid to the one who erased her. The power of "magic" that could grant any wish.

lines.content: “夜”の側ではそういう“憎悪”さえ、いつの間にか流布されはじめていた。
lines.translated: On the side of the "Night," even that kind of "hatred" had begun to circulate before anyone realized it.

lines.content: ……彼女が護りたいと願った愛しいものたち。
lines.translated: The beloved ones she had wished to protect.

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”
lines.translated: The "Creatures of the Night."

lines.content: 彼らは、人間を無条件に愛するようにと想像された“イキモノ”たちだ。
lines.translated: They are "creatures" imagined into being so that they would love humans unconditionally.

lines.content: かつてたったひとりの少女が、過去に残した思い人のため、[“夜”|ここ]を思い描いた結果の名残だ。
lines.translated: They are the remnants of a single girl once envisioning this place--the "Night"--for the sake of the one she loved and left behind in the past.

lines.content: 故に……。
lines.translated: Therefore...

lines.content: 人類に害なす“夜の女王”は彼らの敵だ。
lines.translated: The "Queen of the Night," who brings harm to humanity, is their enemy.

lines.content: かつては“ぼくらの母親”とまで言い、慕っていたはずの彼らまでもが、彼女を憎んだ――ましろがそうなるようにと、“夜”に、さくらの心に、願ったからだ。
lines.translated: Even those who had once adored her, going so far as to call her "our mother," came to hate her--because Mashiro had wished to the "Night," to the heart of the cherry blossoms, for it to be so.

lines.content: ……ましろは。
lines.translated: Mashiro.

lines.content: 誰よりも“嫌われる”ことを恐れていたはずの、女の子は。
lines.translated: The girl who had feared being "hated" more than anyone else.

lines.content: 名もないただの行きずりの男の子を救うため――この“未来”を、選んだ。
lines.translated: To save a nameless boy she had merely happened to cross paths with--she chose this "future."

lines.content: そういった[・|あ][・|の][・|日]の光景を、まだ子猫だったわたしは、抱きしめられた男の子の胸の中から覗き見た。
lines.translated: Still just a kitten, I peeked out at the sight of that day from within the chest of the boy holding me tight.

lines.content: ……ましろは“嫌われる”ことを何より恐れる女の子だった。
lines.translated: Mashiro was a girl who feared being "hated" above all else.

lines.content: 彼女が叶えがたい“夢”を叶えるためには、その“[・|代][・|償]”が、何よりきっと相応しい。
lines.translated: In order for her to fulfill a "dream" so difficult to grant, that "price" was surely the most fitting of all.

lines.content: “大勢を救うためたったひとりの犠牲を払う。そのためのスイッチを押す”
lines.translated: "Paying the sacrifice of just one person in order to save the many. Pressing the switch to make that happen."

lines.content: そのたったひとりの犠牲とは、ましろ自身だ。
lines.translated: That single sacrifice was Mashiro herself.

lines.content: しかしそうした“代償”の末に救われたはずの男の子は、何も、何ひとつ、救われないまま、再び地下牢に閉じ込められている。
lines.translated: Yet the boy who was supposed to have been saved at the end of that "price" wasn't saved at all--not in the slightest--and was locked away in the dungeon once again.

lines.content: 自分のせいで大切なひと達全員、二度と帰らぬ人となってしまった。そういうふうに、自分をずっと責め続けながら。
lines.translated: Blaming himself endlessly, believing that because of him, everyone precious to him had departed forever, never to return.

lines.content: わたしは男の子の腕の中から這い出した。
lines.translated: I crawled out from within the boy's arms.

lines.content: 男の子を見上げ、[・|言][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: I looked up at the boy and spoke.

lines.content: ……わ、わた、し
子猫の小さな口で、懸命に言う。
lines.translated: With my tiny kitten mouth, I tried as hard as I could to speak.

lines.content: きみから、もらった……やさしさを。きみに、少しでも……返したい
lines.translated: "The kindness... I received from you. I want to return it to you... even just a little."

lines.content: それだけ……そうできる、のを……ずっと、い、祈って……
lines.translated: "That's all... I've been p-praying... all this time, that I could do that..."

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: もう。
lines.translated: Jeez.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 子猫のままでは人の言葉は喋りづらい。
lines.translated: It's hard to speak human words while still a kitten.

lines.content: 小さな両目をそっと閉じ、想像してみた――今、この男の子が求めるのは“誰”だろう。
lines.translated: I gently closed my tiny eyes and tried to imagine--right now, "who" is it that this boy longs for?

lines.content: ……人は、誰でも誰かになりたい
lines.translated: "...Everyone wants to become someone else."

lines.content: 呪文のようにつぶやいた。まっしろな女王さまが言っていた言葉だ。
lines.translated: I murmured it like a spell. They were the words the pure-white Queen had spoken.

lines.content: ならばわたしは今、[・|あ][・|な][・|た]のようになりたい。
lines.translated: If that's the case, right now, I want to become like you.

lines.content: わたしの世界で一番大切な[きみ|男の子]を、安心させてあげられるのは、[・|あ][・|な][・|た]しかいないのだ。
lines.translated: You are the only one who can bring comfort to this boy--to you, the most precious person in my world.

lines.content: 閉じた[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。恐る恐る、慎重に。
lines.translated: I opened my closed eyelids. Timidly, carefully.

lines.content: 男の子は首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: The boy was tilting his head.

lines.content: その視線は“黒猫なのに、[・|人][・|の][・|姿]になったらまっしろになるんだね。不思議だ”と言っているように、わたしには感じた。
lines.translated: To me, his gaze felt as though it were saying, "Even though you're a black cat, you turn pure white when you take a human form, huh. How strange."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 確かに変だね。
lines.translated: It certainly is strange, isn't it?

lines.content: でも、おかしくはないって思う。
lines.translated: But I don't think it's wrong.

lines.content: ……わたしは、わたしなりに、まっしろになりたかった。……きみの安心に、なりたかったんだよ
lines.translated: "...In my own way, I wanted to become pure white, like Mashiro. ...I wanted to become your comfort."

lines.content: 男の子はいつもわたしのことを抱きしめてくれていた。それがわたしの安心だった。
lines.translated: The boy had always held me close. That was my comfort.

lines.content: だから今夜は……今夜からは、わたしが男の子を抱きしめて、眠りにつくことにした。
lines.translated: So tonight... from tonight on, I decided that I would be the one to hold the boy close as we fell asleep.

lines.content: ……どうかな。似てる、かな
lines.translated: "...How is it? Do I... look like her?"

lines.content: ……きみの心に住む“夜の女王”
lines.translated: The "Queen of the Night" who lives inside your heart.

lines.content: きっとあの子が、きみの“安心”の形だろうと感じる。
lines.translated: I feel like she must be the shape of your "comfort."

lines.content: だから、あの子の姿をわたしは目指した。
lines.translated: That's why I aimed to look like her.

lines.content: わたし[・|達]はいつか人の姿を選べるようになる。[・|そ][・|の][・|形][・|を][・|ど][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|す][・|る][・|か]決めなきゃならない日がやって来る。
lines.translated: Eventually, creatures like us become able to choose our human forms. A day comes when we have to decide what kind of shape to take.

lines.content: わたし達は、そうやって成長していくイキモノだ。
lines.translated: We're creatures that grow up that way.

lines.content: どうせならきみの役立つほうがいい。
lines.translated: If I have to choose anyway, I'd rather be of use to you.

lines.content: でも……
でもね。
lines.translated: But, you know.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: わたしは、人間みたいに鮮やかでいて明瞭な“想像力”を持たない。そういうイキモノ。
lines.translated: I don't possess the vivid, clear "imagination" that humans do. That's the kind of creature I am.

lines.content: だから、これが限界で……
lines.translated: "So, this is my limit..."

lines.content: うまく話せない。
lines.translated: I can't speak well.

lines.content: 気持ちを上手に言葉にできない。人の姿になってはみても、口下手なのは変わらなかった。
lines.translated: I can't put my feelings into words very well. Even after taking on a human form, my clumsiness with words didn't change.

lines.content: どうしたってたどたどしくなる口元が、はがゆい。
lines.translated: It's frustrating how my words inevitably come out so halting and awkward.

lines.content: 男の子は何も言わない。答えない。
lines.translated: The boy didn't say anything. He didn't answer.

lines.content: ただわたしの胸元に額を押しつけ、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: He just pressed his forehead against my chest and closed his eyelids.

lines.content: でも、中々眠れないようだった。
lines.translated: Even so, it seemed he was having trouble falling asleep.

lines.content: 何度も[まぶた|瞼]を開き、ため息をつく。
lines.translated: Again and again, he opened his eyelids and let out a sigh.

lines.content: そして今度こそ眠れますようにと祈るみたいに、[まぶた|瞼]をそっと閉じ直す。
lines.translated: And then, as if praying that he would finally fall asleep this time, he gently closed his eyelids once more.

lines.content: ……いつまでも[朝|次の日]が来ませんようにと、見えないなにかへ願うみたいに。
lines.translated: As if wishing to something unseen that the next day--the morning--would never come.

lines.content: その繰り返しだ。
lines.translated: Over and over again.

lines.content: やっぱりわたしじゃだめみたいだ。きみに安心をあげられない。そう思うと、さみしい。とても。
lines.translated: It looks like I'm just not good enough after all. I can't give you comfort. Thinking that makes me feel lonely. So very lonely.

lines.content: 何もできない。
lines.translated: There's nothing I can do.

lines.content: まっしろなあの子が、不安で眠れない男の子に語った星空の話とか……。
lines.translated: Like the story of the starry sky that the pure-white girl told the boy when he was too anxious to sleep...

lines.content: そういう“希望”ある何かを、今、話してあげらればいいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe it would be good if I could tell him something filled with "hope" like that right now.

lines.content: でも、わたしには無理だ。
lines.translated: But I can't do it.

lines.content: そうできる頭の良さも、口の上手さも、想いを言葉に代えようとする“勇気”も、ひとになってすぐの[・|今][・|は][・|ま][・|だ]、ないから……。
lines.translated: Because right now, having just become human, I still don't have the cleverness to do that, the skill with words, or the "courage" to turn my feelings into speech...

lines.content: だからわたしは、いつまでも眠れない夜と戦うきみのことを、ただ抱きしめることしかできなかった。
lines.translated: So all I could do was simply hold you close as you fought against the endless, sleepless night.

lines.content: それでもいつしか、きみの心に、とても浅い眠りの気配がやって来た。
lines.translated: Even so, before long, the faint sign of a very shallow sleep came over your heart.

lines.content: わたしは……。
lines.translated: I am...

lines.content: わたしは、きみを想う“夜のイキモノ”
lines.translated: I am a "Creature of the Night" who cares for you.

lines.content: そしてきみは、まだまだ小さな男の子。
lines.translated: And you are still just a little boy.

lines.content: だからあのときのわたし達が、“夜の国”へ自在に出入りすることは、そう難しいことではなかった。
lines.translated: So for the two of us back then, coming and going freely into the "Realm of the Night" wasn't all that difficult.

lines.content: 閉じ込められた地下牢で、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた男の子の心と共に、わたし達は[・|そ][・|の][・|場][・|所]へ向かった。
lines.translated: In the dungeon where we were locked away, together with the heart of the boy who had closed his eyelids, we headed toward that place.

lines.content: きみの“願い”はすべてわたしが叶える。……そのために。
lines.translated: I will grant all of your "wishes." ...For that very purpose.

lines.content: ……きみは今、どんな“夢”を見るのかな
lines.translated: "...I wonder what kind of 'dream' you're having right now?"

lines.content: わたしは手を繋いだ男の子と一緒に、“夜”の空を見上げ、つぶやくように言った。
lines.translated: Holding hands with the boy, I looked up at the sky of the "Night" and murmured.

lines.content: ……“思い描けるすべてが叶う”
lines.translated: "...'Everything you can envision will come true.'"

lines.content: “[想い|想像]”を形に変える国。
lines.translated: A realm that turns "imagination"--one's feelings--into form.

lines.content: ここで“希望”を探そう。きみの“夢”を叶えるための“魔法”を、一緒に探そう。きっと何か方法があるはずだよ
lines.translated: "Let's look for 'hope' here. Let's look for the 'magic' to grant your 'dream' together. I'm sure there must be some way."

lines.content: 繋いだ手と手で、男の子の“想い”にわたしは触れた――“ぼくには助けたいひと達がいる”
lines.translated: Through our joined hands, I touched the boy's "feelings"--"There are people I want to save."

lines.content: そのためには……。
lines.translated: And in order to do that...
He wanted to go back to a time when nothing had happened yet.

lines.content: こんな“未来”を変えるのだ。
lines.translated: To change this kind of "future."

lines.content: [・|不][・|幸][・|な][・|こ][・|と]は何も起きなかった。そういうふうに、時間をまっしろなものに塗り直したいのだと、男の子は願う。
lines.translated: No misfortunes ever happened. The boy wished to repaint time pure white, just like that.

lines.content: そのためなら何でもするし、何でもできる。
lines.translated: For that sake, he would do anything, and he could do anything.

lines.content: 男の子の決意が伝わってきた。
lines.translated: I could feel the boy's determination.

lines.content: すべての原因は自分にあると男の子は思っていた。
lines.translated: The boy believed that the cause of everything lay with him.

lines.content: ――“自分のことばかり考える我がまま言う子は、大切に想うすべての人を不幸にする”
lines.translated: --"A selfish child who only thinks of himself brings misfortune to everyone he holds dear."

lines.content: そんな言葉で、男の子の[世界|心]はできている。
lines.translated: The boy's heart--his entire world--was made of those words.
"So I want to stay just the way I was, without ever meeting Taiga or Mashiro, in the basement..."

lines.content: そういうふうに人生をやり直したいのだ。
lines.translated: That was how he wanted to start his life over.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。それは、無理だよ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I can't do that."

lines.content: わたしは首を振り、言った。
lines.translated: I shook my head and spoke.

lines.content: きみの願いならどんなものでも叶えてあげたい。
lines.translated: If it's your wish, I want to grant it, no matter what it is.

lines.content: でも、そういう“夢”なら協力できない。今すぐ“外”へ帰ろう。
lines.translated: But if it's that kind of "dream," I can't help you. Let's go back "outside" right now.

lines.content: わたしは、きみのことが大切だ。きみの“夢”より、きみの“命”や未来のほうが大切なんだ
lines.translated: "You are precious to me. Your 'life' and your future are more important to me than your 'dream.'"

lines.content: しかしわたしがそう言うまでもなく、“夜の切符売り場”で、男の子が望むその[時間|場所]へ向かうための切符は購入できなかった。
lines.translated: However, before I even needed to say that, we couldn't buy a ticket at the "Night Ticket Booth" to head to the place--the time--the boy desired.
We didn't have enough.

lines.content: そのための“特別”な“切符”を購入するには、たくさんの“代償”が必要だった。
lines.translated: Purchasing a "special" "ticket" for that purpose required a great "price."

lines.content: でも男の子にもわたしにも、支払えるだけのものを何も持たない。
lines.translated: But neither the boy nor I had anything we could use to pay it.

lines.content: ……“切符”を購入するための金や銀の硬貨は、死んだ後の“命”にしか[・|換][・|金]できないものだった。
lines.translated: The gold and silver coins needed to buy the "ticket" could only be exchanged for a "life" after death.

lines.content: わたしもまだまだ小さな子猫だ。“夜”について知らないことが多すぎたのだ。
lines.translated: I was still just a tiny kitten myself. There were too many things I didn't know about the "Night."

lines.content: わたし達は進むべき道を失った。
lines.translated: We lost the path we were meant to take.

lines.content: どのようにすれば“願い”を叶えられるのか。どのようにすれば、せめて小さくとも“希望”を得られるのか。誰に問いかけてみても、答えはまるで見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: How could we grant his "wish"? How could we obtain even the smallest bit of "hope"? No matter who we asked, we couldn't find an answer at all.

lines.content: それでも考えて……。
lines.translated: Even so, we kept thinking...

lines.content: 考えて。
lines.translated: She thought about it.
And so, we ended up boarding that train.

lines.content: お願い。“[・|夜][・|の][・|女][・|王]”から、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]の愛するものの暮らすこの世界を、救うため……。どうか、あなた達の力を貸してほしい
lines.translated: "Please. In order to save this world where our loved ones live from the 'Queen of the Night'... Please, lend us your strength."

lines.content: 道に迷ったわたし達を[・|必][・|要]だと言い、[・|こ][・|の][・|子]が列車に乗せてくれたのだった――汽笛を“夜”高く鳴り響かせて線路を走る鋼鉄の汽車。その車掌だろう小さなちいさな女の子だ。
lines.translated: Saying that she needed the two of us who had lost our way, this girl let us board the train--a steel locomotive running along the tracks, sounding its whistle high into the "Night." She was a tiny, tiny girl who seemed to be its conductor.

lines.content: わたし達の他に乗客のいないこの車両は、遠い過去へと向かい走るのだと、小さな車掌姿の女の子は言っていた。
lines.translated: The little girl dressed as a conductor told us that this train car, with no passengers other than us, was running toward the distant past.

lines.content: きみは……
lines.translated: "You're..."

lines.content: きみは確か、大雅が地下牢で、怖い大人たちから尋問されている際、[・|消][・|さ][・|れ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|た]中にいたように思えたけれど……。
lines.translated: If I remembered correctly, when Taiga was being interrogated by the scary adults in the dungeon, I thought she was among those who had been erased...

lines.content: ……そうか。[・|未][・|来][・|の][・|私]はそんなふうになっちゃったんだね
lines.translated: "...I see. So that's what happened to the future me."

lines.content: どこか憂いを帯びたような微笑みだった。
lines.translated: It was a smile tinged with a hint of sorrow.

lines.content: でも不思議とそこに“絶望”の色はなかったように思える。少しもだ。
lines.translated: Yet strangely, there didn't seem to be any trace of "despair" in it. Not even a little.

lines.content: 私は、誰でもないんだよ。いくつもの記憶や想いの集合体のような存在だから。そんな私に、明確な死は存在しない
lines.translated: "I am nobody. Because I'm an existence like an aggregation of countless memories and feelings. For someone like me, there is no definitive death."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|瞬][・|間]までの記憶はすべて消えてしまっただろうけど、また誰でもないまっしろな私が“夜”の中に産まれ直してるはずだよ
lines.translated: "All of my memories up to that moment probably vanished, but another pure-white me, who is nobody, should be reborn within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: だから私に関しては“救えなかった”とか、そういう罪悪感めいた感情を抱く必要はかけらもないからね。まったく気にしないでいいよ
lines.translated: "So when it comes to me, there's not a shred of need to harbor any guilty feelings like 'I couldn't save her.' You don't have to worry about it at all."

lines.content: それに、ね。なんだか夢物語みたいな、突拍子もないことを言うようだけれど……
lines.translated: "Besides, you know... It might sound like I'm saying something outlandish, like a fairy tale, but..."

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 実際どのような現実的な話を試みようと、“夢”のようなこの世界の中ででは、こうして語られるものは全てがすべて、夢物語にしかならないのだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Though in truth, no matter how realistic a story one might try to tell, within a dreamlike world such as this, everything spoken of would probably only ever amount to a fairy tale anyway...

lines.content: ここにいる私は、ここじゃないずっと昔の時間に[・|存][・|在][・|を][・|置][・|く]イキモノだ。あなた達の前で姿を消した私は、誰でもない以前に、私であって私じゃない
lines.translated: "The me who is here right now is a creature whose existence is rooted in a time long, long ago, far from here. Even before being nobody, the me who vanished in front of you is me, and yet not me."

lines.content: 未来の世界で。それも“夜”の外で起きたのだろう出来事で
lines.translated: "It's something that must have happened in a future world. And outside of the 'Night,' at that."

lines.content: 今、ここにいる私にはなんの影響もないし、だから未来で私がどうなってしまったのかは、まあ、それ以上は聞かないけれど……
lines.translated: "It has no effect on the me who is here right now, so while I won't ask any further about what happened to me in the future..."

lines.content: “夜の女王”は“[・|噂]”[・|ど][・|お][・|り]、大人たちの心を“絶望”でゆがませ、結果、世界をまるごと壊してしまおうとしている証拠なんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Isn't that proof that, just as the 'rumors' say, the 'Queen of the Night' is twisting the hearts of adults with 'despair,' and as a result, trying to destroy the entire world?"

lines.content: いったい誰がどういうふうにして、その“噂”の出所を確認したのかはわからないし……
lines.translated: "I don't know who on earth confirmed the source of that 'rumor,' or how..."

lines.content: 更には、あらゆる時代の“夜のイキモノ”の殆どが知るほどの規模で、この“噂”を流布できたのかは、やっぱり、わからないけれど
lines.translated: "And furthermore, I still don't know how this 'rumor' could have been spread on a scale large enough for almost every 'Creature of the Night' across all eras to know about it, either."

lines.content: そういった根も葉もない“噂”こそ、ましろが自身へ世界中の憎悪を集める“代償”の形なのだろう。
lines.translated: Groundless "rumors" like that must be the very form of the "price" Mashiro paid to gather the hatred of the entire world onto herself.

lines.content: けれど、ただ男の子のそばに居続けるだけの、殆ど部外者なわたしが“自分の意見”を挟んでいいとも思えず、ただ黙って、わたしは女の子の話に耳を傾けている。
lines.translated: However, as someone who was practically an outsider simply staying by the boy's side, I didn't feel it was my place to interject with my "own opinion," so I just kept quiet and listened to the girl's story.

lines.content: ……ただ口下手すぎて、知らない子にこれ以上、話をするだけの“勇気”がなかっただけだろうけど。
lines.translated: Though really, it was probably just that I was too clumsy with words and didn't have the "courage" to say anything more to a girl I didn't know.

lines.content: そういった絶望的な――ううん。絶望的な未来へ一歩、進み始めたのだろう世界を救いたいと、私は願う
lines.translated: "I wish to save this hopeless--no, this world that has likely begun to take a step toward a hopeless future."

lines.content: 女の子は言った。
lines.translated: The girl said.

lines.content: そのための仲間たちを集めようと、ここにいる私は“過去”も“未来”も、“現在”も――“夜の線路”が続く限りの世界を旅し続けてきた
lines.translated: "In order to gather companions for that purpose, the me who is here has continued to travel the world for as far as the 'tracks of the Night' reach--through the 'past,' the 'future,' and the 'present.'"

lines.content: そうしてこの“未来”の世界で、あなた達とこうして出会った。……あなた達の“絶望”ならば、きっと、強力な[武器|魔法]となるはずだから
lines.translated: "And that is how I met the two of you here in this 'future' world. ...Because if it's your 'despair,' I'm sure it will become a powerful magic--a powerful weapon."

lines.content: ……もしもこれから向かう時間の中で、[・|他][・|の][・|子][・|た][・|ち]と力を合わせ、“夜の女王”を倒せたのなら
lines.translated: "...If, in the time we are heading toward from here, you can join forces with the other children and defeat the 'Queen of the Night'..."

lines.content: 女の子が、言う。
lines.translated: The girl spoke.

lines.content: そのときはきっと“夜の世界”から、あなた達の願いを叶えるために必要な“魔法”が、与えられるはず――
lines.translated: "Then surely, the 'magic' needed to grant your wish will be bestowed upon you by the 'World of the Night'--"

lines.content: その“魔法”の力を使って、あなた達はあたな達の“絶望”を、明るい色に塗り替えていければいい
lines.translated: "Using the power of that 'magic,' you should be able to repaint your 'despair' into a bright color."

lines.content: それは“夜の女王”を憎からず思う“夜のイキモノ”たちが、彼らの愛しく思う人類を護るため、懸賞金のようにして立てられた“誓い”であった。
lines.translated: That was a "vow" set up like a bounty by the "Creatures of the Night"--who bore bitter feelings toward the "Queen of the Night"--in order to protect the humanity they held so dear.

lines.content: あなた達の願いは、確か……
lines.translated: "Your wish, if I recall, is..."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: わたしはうなずき、
lines.translated: I nodded, and...

lines.content: わたし達には、助けたいひと達が、いる
lines.translated: "There are people... that we want to save."

lines.content: 男の子の代わりにそう答えた。口下手で頭の弱いわたしだ。たどたどしく、もにょもにょと、しながらも。
lines.translated: I answered like that in the boy's stead. Clumsy with words and slow-witted as I am. Haltingly, mumbling and stumbling over my words as I did.

lines.content: ……そのために、過去へ戻る方法はないのかなと……探してた
lines.translated: "...For that sake, we were looking... to see if there might be a way to go back to the past."

lines.content: この“夜”を作った女の子が、かつて過去の時間へと“夜”を通って帰れたように。わたし達もそれを可能にできる“何か”を探してた。
lines.translated: Just as the girl who created this "Night" was once able to return to a past time by passing through the "Night," we too were searching for "something" that could make that possible.

lines.content: ……だけど、だめだった
lines.translated: "...However, it was no use."

lines.content: そのための方法はあったのかもしれない。でも、たくさんの“代償”を支払えないわたし達には、その方法を選べなくて……困ってた
lines.translated: "There might have been a way to do it. But for the two of us, who couldn't pay a heavy 'price,' we couldn't choose that method... so we were at a loss."

lines.content: だから私の誘いにうなずいくれたんだね。……遠い“過去”の世界へ旅立って、“夜の女王”を倒してほしいっていう、私のお願いに
lines.translated: "So that's why you nodded to my invitation, isn't it? ...To my request for you to set off on a journey to the world of the distant 'past' and defeat the 'Queen of the Night.'"

lines.content: 誰もが“夜の女王”の居場所を探してた。
lines.translated: Everyone was searching for the whereabouts of the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: 人類の未来を護るため。
lines.translated: To protect the future of humanity.

lines.content: あるいは、叶えがたい“夢”を叶えるための、“特別な魔法”を報酬として、得るために。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, to obtain "special magic" as a reward to grant a "dream" that was otherwise impossible to fulfill.

lines.content: ……“過去”も“未来”も“現在”も。そんなものはあんまりにも関係がなく、すべてのひと達の“隣”に――あらゆる刻の“隣”に存在し、あらゆる刻と刻とを繋ぐ“夜の国”
lines.translated: "...'Past,' 'future,' and 'present.' Things like that have very little relevance here in the 'Country of the Night,' which exists 'next door' to everyone--'next door' to every moment in time, connecting each moment to the next."

lines.content: そんな特異なものがあるから、[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]、あらゆる糸が絡み合い、無駄な複雑さを創り上げ、こんがらがってしまってる
lines.translated: "Because such a peculiar place exists, all sorts of threads get tangled up like this, creating needless complexity and making everything a knotted mess."

lines.content: そうした糸を少しずつ解いていくその中で、“夜の女王”は毎年、とある春の日の夜にだけ現れるのだということがわかったんだよ
lines.translated: "As we untangled those threads little by little, we discovered that the 'Queen of the Night' only appears once a year, on the night of a certain spring day."

lines.content: ……今から向かう場所に待つ、“夜の魔法使い”を名乗る猫が、それを見つけた
lines.translated: "...A cat who calls herself the 'Magician of the Night,' waiting at the place we're heading to right now, was the one who found that out."

lines.content: 一年に一度だ。決まって[・|そ][・|の][・|日]の夜にしか、“夜の女王”は現れないというのだ。
lines.translated: Once a year. They say the "Queen of the Night" unfailingly appears only on the night of that specific day.

lines.content: その日付を聞いて、どきりと少し胸が弾んで、痛んだ。
lines.translated: Hearing that date, my heart skipped a beat and ached slightly.

lines.content: それはましろが男の子のため、全人類の敵――“夜の女王”となることを決意し――世界中の子ども達を誘拐したあの夜と、まったく同じ日付であったから。
lines.translated: Because it was the exact same date as that night when Mashiro, for the boy's sake, resolved to become the enemy of all humanity--the "Queen of the Night"--and kidnapped children all across the world.
"In the 'Country of the Night,' regardless of past, future, or present, everything is connected by countless lines."

lines.content: 小さな女の子はそう繰り返す――何も知らないわたし達へと、せめてもの土産と言わんばかりに、目的地に到着するまでの時間、色々なことを教えてくれていた。
lines.translated: The little girl repeated this--teaching us, who knew nothing, all sorts of things during the time it took to reach our destination, as if offering it as a small parting gift.

lines.content: 更に言えばここは[・|選][・|ば][・|れ][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|時][・|間]の墓場でもあり、そうした可能性を、時間という形のないものそのものを記憶媒体とし、蓄積、保管する図書館のような場所でもある
lines.translated: "Furthermore, this place is also a graveyard of unchosen times, and like a library that accumulates and stores those possibilities, using the formless thing called time itself as a storage medium."

lines.content: だからすべての時間は多角的に繋がっているし、現象の記録媒体である時間の中で、一度起きてしまった出来事は、あらゆる時代の“夜”の中にその影を落としてしまう
lines.translated: "That's why all times are connected from multiple angles, and within time, which serves as a recording medium for phenomena, an event that has occurred even once casts its shadow into the 'Night' of every era."

lines.content: そのためどの時代であろうと、どの時間上であろうとも――
lines.translated: Therefore, no matter what era, no matter where along the timeline--

lines.content: 時間ではなく世界そのものが枝葉に別れるとなると、また、別問題だが――
lines.translated: Though if the world itself, rather than time, were to branch out like a tree, that would be another matter entirely--

lines.content: ともあれいずれかの[時代|時間]の中で、“夜の女王”を打倒すればいい。
lines.translated: In any case, we only needed to overthrow the "Queen of the Night" within one of those eras--one of those times.

lines.content: そうすれば、あらゆる時間の“隣”から、“夜の女王”は存在しなくなる。
lines.translated: If we did that, the "Queen of the Night" would cease to exist "next door" to every time.

lines.content: ……私たちが向かう先は、人間たちの“心”が……、その“想像力”がもっとも豊かだった時代だ
lines.translated: "...Our destination is an era when the 'hearts' of humans... when their 'imagination' was at its richest."

lines.content: あらゆるジャンルの中に、すばらしい創造物が次々と産み落とされた時代であった。後世長く語り継がれる著名な作家も多く産まれた。
lines.translated: It was an era in which wonderful creations were born one after another across every genre. Many renowned authors who would be spoken of for generations to come were also born then.

lines.content: 名もなき[・|壮][・|絶][・|な]創作者もたくさん、たくさん産まれた時代であった。
lines.translated: It was an era that gave birth to many, many nameless yet breathtaking creators as well.

lines.content: ……そのひとりが“夜”を創り上げた少女であり。その少女に宛てて、たったひとつきりの“歌”を歌った少年であった。奏大雅の両親である。
lines.translated: One of them was the girl who created the "Night." And the boy who sang a single, solitary "song" addressed to that girl. Kanade Taiga's parents.

lines.content: だから[・|そ][・|の][・|時][・|代]を、私たちは“夜の女王”との決戦の場に選んだ
lines.translated: "That's why we chose that era as the stage for our decisive battle against the 'Queen of the Night.'"

lines.content: しかしそのような時代に産まれた子たちだけでは、決戦の戦力として充分とは言えないかもしれない。
lines.translated: However, the children born in such an era alone might not be sufficient as a fighting force for the decisive battle.
"Imagination" is born precisely within sorrow.

lines.content: ……自分の力だけではもう、どうしようもできない深い、とてもふかい悲しみにあえぎ、それでも光りを求める子らはどの時代にも必ずいるはず
lines.translated: "...In every era, there are bound to be children who are gasping in deep, terribly deep sorrow that they can no longer do anything about with their own strength alone, yet who still reach out for the light."

lines.content: せっかくあらゆる時代へと続く静かなる隣人――“夜の国”が存在しているのだ。
lines.translated: After all, the quiet neighbor that leads to every era--the "Country of the Night"--already exists.

lines.content: だからこうして“魔法”を得るに[・|相][・|応][・|し][・|い]子たちを探し、求めてるんだと女の子は言った。
lines.translated: That was why, the girl said, she was searching and reaching out like this for children worthy of obtaining "magic."

lines.content: “夜の国”では、人間だけが持つ“想像”する力こそが――とりわけ年頃の少年少女の“想像力”こそが、その[・|悲][・|し][・|み]こそが、“悪夢”と戦うためのより強力な武器となる
lines.translated: "In the 'Country of the Night,' the power to 'imagine' that only humans possess--especially the 'imagination' of boys and girls of a certain age, and that very sorrow of theirs--becomes an even more powerful weapon for fighting against 'Nightmares.'"

lines.content: あなた達、名前はあるのかな
lines.translated: "Do the two of you have names?"

lines.content: “切符”の代わりに名を求められた。
lines.translated: We were asked for our names in place of "tickets."

lines.content: わたしは咄嗟に“クロ”と答えた。きみがつけてくれた大切な名前だった。その名前を自分の口で発音できることが、なんだか胸の奥がむずがゆく感じるくらい、うれしく思えた。
lines.translated: On impulse, I answered "Kuro." It was the precious name you had given me. Being able to pronounce that name with my own mouth made me feel so happy that it almost tickled deep inside my chest.

lines.content: クロ……。真っ白なのに？
lines.translated: "Kuro... Even though you're pure white?"

lines.content: ……そう。真っ白、なのに
lines.translated: "...Yes. Even though I'm pure white."

lines.content: わたし達はふたりで首をかしげ、うなずき合っていた。
lines.translated: The two of us tilted our heads and nodded to each other.

lines.content: だけど[・|き][・|み]は、少し固まるように沈黙している。
lines.translated: However, you remained silent, as if slightly frozen.

lines.content: この子には名前がない。誰でもないのだ。わたしと同じ。
lines.translated: This boy has no name. He is nobody. Just like me.

lines.content: どういうふうにそれを女の子へ伝えよう。
lines.translated: How should I convey that to the girl?

lines.content: そう思っていたけれど、
lines.translated: That was what I was thinking, but...

lines.content: ……人は
lines.translated: "...People..."

lines.content: ぽつりと、男の子はそう言った。それはわたしも久しぶりに聞く、男の子の声だった。
lines.translated: The boy murmured quietly. It was the boy's voice, which even I was hearing for the first time in a long while.

lines.content: 人は誰でも、誰かになりたい
lines.translated: "Everyone wants to become someone."

lines.content: まるで、固く閉ざされた扉の向こう側へ投げる、秘密の合い言葉みたいに、男の子はつぶやいて、
lines.translated: The boy whispered it, almost like a secret password tossed to the other side of a tightly closed door,

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: 首をかしげている車掌の女の子に、しっかりと、伝えた。
lines.translated: and then spoke firmly to the conductor girl, who was tilting her head.

lines.content: ……ぼくは
……ううん
俺は、大雅。奏大雅……
lines.translated: "I am Taiga. Kanade Taiga..."
"I want to become like that person who was supposed to save this world, and the people precious to him."

lines.content: 思えば、あの人こそがぼくの憧れ……ぼくの、ヒーローだったんだ
lines.translated: "Looking back, that person was the one I admired... He was my hero."

lines.content: ……あの人？
lines.translated: "...That person?"

lines.content: 何か大きなおおきな覚悟を固めるようにして、男の子は――……大雅は、
lines.translated: As if solidifying some vast, immense resolve, the boy--...Taiga, spoke.

lines.content: 俺たちはもう、誰の期待どおりには生きたりしない
lines.translated: "We won't live according to anyone's expectations anymore."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|人]は大人たちの期待を裏切り、大切なひとの手を引き逃げようとした……。世界の行く末なんかより、大切なひとをたったひとり、救えればいいと願ってた
lines.translated: "That person betrayed the expectations of the adults and tried to take the hand of the one precious to him and run away... More than the fate of the world, he wished only to save a single precious person."

lines.content: そんなあの人のように、苦しんでいる誰かをひとりでも助けられるように……そういうふうに、俺も、生きたい。あの人のように俺はなりたい。必ずだ。必ず、成し遂げてみせる
lines.translated: "Just like him, so that I can save even one person who is suffering... that's how I want to live, too. I want to become like him. Without fail. I'll definitely see it through."

lines.content: それは、どういう……
lines.translated: "What do you mean by..."

lines.content: 俺たちは“夜の女王”を傷つけないよ
lines.translated: "We won't hurt the 'Queen of the Night.'"

lines.content: 大雅は静かに空を、列車の天井を見つめ、
lines.translated: Taiga quietly gazed up at the sky--at the ceiling of the train,

lines.content: [・|彼][・|女][・|を][・|助][・|け][・|る]というのなら、力を貸すよ。……惜しみなく。こんな俺たちに……俺に、何ができるのかはわからないけれど
lines.translated: "If it's to save her, we'll lend our strength. ...Unsparingly. Even though I don't know what people like us... what someone like me can possibly do."

lines.content: 言葉を噛みしめ、そう言っていた。
lines.translated: Savoring each word, he said that.

lines.content: そんなきみの隣に座るわたしは、手を……きみと手を重ねるべきか、迷った。
lines.translated: Sitting next to you like that, I hesitated over whether I should place my hand... over yours.

lines.content: 今日、この瞬間――再び聞いた男の子のその声は、力強いものだった。これまでの男の子のことを知っていれば、驚くくらい。
lines.translated: Today, in this moment--the boy's voice, heard once again, was strong. Surprisingly so, if one knew how he had been up until now.

lines.content: それなのに、どうして。
lines.translated: And yet, why?

lines.content: 男の子の声も、言葉も、どこかとても、とても悲しいものであるように、わたしには聞こえていた。
lines.translated: Both the boy's voice and his words sounded somehow terribly, terribly sad to me.

lines.content: 悲しみこそが人の“想像力”の源だ。そういう言葉を残した、決して著名とは言えない人間がいたけれど……。たぶんそれは、この世界の秘密のひとつなんじゃないかなとは、私も思うよ
lines.translated: "'Sorrow itself is the source of human "imagination."' There was once a person, by no means famous, who left behind those words... And I, too, think that might just be one of the secrets of this world."

lines.content: [・|刻]を越える列車に揺られ、たどり着いた“夜の魔法使い”のその工房――“ゆめのねどこ”だ。
lines.translated: Rocked by the train that transcended time, we arrived at the workshop of the "Magician of the Night"--the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: そこでわたし達が、“魔法使い”に問いかけたものの返答として、以下の言葉が返された。
lines.translated: There, in response to what we asked the "Magician," the following words were returned to us.

lines.content: 持って生まれた“才能”が、いくら眩いものだろうと。生きることで“悲しみ”を多く知った心のほうにこそ、未来を切り開いていくための力がより強く秘められていると、私も信じたい
lines.translated: "No matter how dazzling the 'talent' one is born with may be, I want to believe that it is within a heart that has known much 'sorrow' through living that the power to carve open the future is hidden far more strongly."
"That is why I chose you."

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”の“魔法使い”に、わたしは、どうしてわたし達を“夜の女王”との決戦要員として選んだのか――下手な言葉で、そう問いかけていた。
lines.translated: In clumsy words, I had asked the "Magician" of the "Bed of Dreams" why she had chosen us to be part of the decisive battle against the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: わたし達にはなにもない。
lines.translated: We have nothing.

lines.content: “夜”の中で[・|何][・|か]を“想像”できるほどの“特別な才能”どころか、[・|個][・|人]さえもわたし達には存在しない。
lines.translated: Let alone a "special talent" capable of "imagining" something within the "Night," we don't even have individual selves.

lines.content: わたしもあの子も、憧れた“誰か”の姿を、……名前を、きっとこうして話す言葉でさえも、装っているだけだ。
lines.translated: Both he and I are merely putting on the appearance... the names, and surely even the very words we speak like this, of "someone" we admired.

lines.content: わたし達はまっしろだ。まっしろな空白以上に、なにもない偽物でしかないのだ。
lines.translated: We are pure white. More than a pure-white blank slate, we are nothing but fakes who have nothing at all.

lines.content: そんなわたし達に何ができるのか。
lines.translated: What could people like us possibly do?

lines.content: ……そんなわたし達に“夢”を、“願い”を、叶えることはできるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Could people like us really fulfill a "dream," a "wish"?

lines.content: そういう思いで、懸命に、足りない頭で、たどたどしくも問いかけた。
lines.translated: With those thoughts in mind, earnestly, with my lacking head, I had haltingly asked her.

lines.content: ……わ、わたしにも……あるのかな
lines.translated: "...Do I... have it, too?"

lines.content: 陽向井あさひ。冬月十夜。ふたりみたいに、わたし、にも……
lines.translated: "Hinatai Asahi. Fuyutsuki Toya. Like the two of them, do I, too..."

lines.content: 大切な人を応援できる。大切な人を、大切に、そばで護れる……そのための“力”が、あるのかな
lines.translated: "Have the 'power'... to cheer on someone precious to me? To cherish and protect someone precious, right by their side...?"

lines.content: その“力”を使って、あの子の……大雅の役に、わたしは……立てる？
lines.translated: "Using that 'power,' can I... be of use to him... to Taiga?"

lines.content: “魔法使い”が定期的に開く“満月の夜会”で、大雅が“魔法”について、その他の子ども達と学んでいる裏で、わたしは、自分の持って生まれた“力”について、“魔法使い”から学んでた。
lines.translated: Behind the scenes of the "Full Moon Tea Party" held regularly by the "Magician," while Taiga was learning about "magic" alongside the other children, I was learning from the "Magician" about the "power" I was born with.

lines.content: ……[・|あ][・|の][・|子]以外とは、こうしてふたりきりになることは殆どなかった。
lines.translated: Other than with him, I had almost never been alone with someone like this.

lines.content: だから、小さな胸をどきどきさせながら。
lines.translated: So, with my small chest pounding wildly,

lines.content: まっすぐに“魔法使い”を見つめることも、できないまま……。
lines.translated: unable to even look straight at the "Magician"...

lines.content: 今すぐここから逃げ出したい。そんな人見知りな気持ちを何とか耐えて、話を聞いた。
lines.translated: I wanted to run away from here right this instant. Somehow enduring those shy feelings, I listened to what she had to say.

lines.content: ああ……。あるよ。君にもきっと[・|何][・|か]がある
lines.translated: "Yeah... You do. There is definitely something within you, too."

lines.content: 私たち“夜の猫”たちは、無条件に人間を愛さなければならない。そんな“役割”を背負ってこの世に産まれた
lines.translated: "We 'Cats of the Night' must love humans unconditionally. We were born into this world bearing such a 'role.'"

lines.content: ……いいや。この世に“想像”されてしまったというべきか
lines.translated: "...No. Perhaps I should say we were 'imagined' into this world."

lines.content: ともかく、と“夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひは、言う。
lines.translated: In any case, the "Magician of the Night," Hinatai Asahi, continued.

lines.content: 私たち“夜”に産まれた“イキモノ”は各々、“夜”の中で生きるための特別な“役割”があり、しかし……その“役割”は、誰かが親切丁寧に教えてくれるものではない
lines.translated: "We 'Creatures' born into the 'Night' each have a special 'role' for living within the 'Night,' and yet... that 'role' isn't something that someone will kindly and carefully teach you."

lines.content: 正義も悪も、それぞれの心の世界や見つめる角度で違うように。
lines.translated: Just as justice and evil differ depending on the world within each person's heart and the angle from which they look.

lines.content: 人生に正しい教師が存在しないように。
lines.translated: Just as there is no single right teacher in life.

lines.content: 言葉にできるほど明確化できるものではない。
lines.translated: It is not something that can be defined clearly enough to put into words.

lines.content: 持って生まれた境遇や“力”を判断材料にして、己自身が生きていくその時間の中で、見い出していくしかないものだ――でも私たち特別な猫は、比較的わかりやすいほうだと思うよ
lines.translated: "Using the circumstances and 'power' you were born with as a basis for judgment, it's something you can only discover for yourself within the time you spend living--though I think for special cats like us, it's relatively easy to understand."

lines.content: “夜の猫”は、人間で言うところの血筋や家系のようなものを重んじている。
lines.translated: The "Cats of the Night" place great importance on something akin to bloodlines or family lineages among humans.

lines.content: その流れは幾つも存在しており、そうして続いていく血筋の中には一つひとつ、一族こどに違った“力”が受け継がれているのだという。
lines.translated: There are several such lineages in existence, and within each continuing bloodline, a different "power" is said to be passed down from clan to clan.

lines.content: その能力を持ってして、無条件に愛おしく感じてしまう人間たちの人生を、影ながら支え……。
lines.translated: Wielding those abilities, they support the lives of the humans they cannot help but find unconditionally endearing from the shadows...

lines.content: 彼ら彼女らが耐えがたい悲しみの中に在るときは、そばで勇気づけられる自分でありたいと願ってる。
lines.translated: Whenever those boys and girls are in the midst of unbearable sorrow, they wish to be someone who can encourage them right by their side.

lines.content: その“無条件”の中には、“夜”を“[創造|想像]”した少女の“想い”が込められているはずだ。
lines.translated: Within that "unconditional" nature, the "feelings" of the girl who "imagined" the "Night" into creation must surely be woven.

lines.content: 自分がそばにいられなくなった愛しい人が、ひとりぼっちでさみしい思いをしないよう、やさしく楽しい世界でありますように。
lines.translated: May this be a gentle and joyful world, so that the beloved person whose side she could no longer stay by would never feel lonely or all alone.

lines.content: そういう“想い”と願いが形となった世界だ。
lines.translated: It is a world where such "feelings" and wishes took form.

lines.content: “夜”の一部であるわたしの中にも、少女のそういう“想い”が込められているからこそ……。
lines.translated: And because those very "feelings" of the girl are woven into me, as a part of the "Night"...

lines.content: わたしは、どんなにひどい目に遭わされようとも、人間のことを憎むことは永遠にできないのだろう。
lines.translated: No matter how cruelly I might be treated, I will likely never be able to hate humans for all eternity.

lines.content: ……わたしにやさしくしてくれた。
lines.translated: He was kind to me.

lines.content: そんな大雅のことを、この命が尽きるまで、大切に想い続けたいと感じるのだろう。
lines.translated: That is probably why I feel like I want to keep cherishing Taiga until this life of mine runs out.

lines.content: “魔法使い”が続けて言う。
lines.translated: The "Magician" continued.

lines.content: 私の妹には……とは言っても、私と血は繋がっていないんだけれど……まあ、それは今はいいか
lines.translated: "My little sister... though I say that, we aren't actually related by blood, but... well, that doesn't matter right now."

lines.content: とにかく私の妹には、“最大十秒先の未来を見せる”という“力”が備わっている。より特別に思う人間にのみ、という条件は付くけれど。そういう[・|種][・|類]の猫なんだ
lines.translated: "Anyway, my little sister is endowed with the 'power' to 'show the future up to ten seconds ahead.' Though it comes with the condition that it only works on humans she considers extra special. She's that kind of cat."

lines.content: 私は、傷の治療だ。人体の自然治癒能力を増長させて、普段よりも数倍の早さで傷を治してやれる――
lines.translated: "As for me, it's healing wounds. I can amplify the human body's natural healing abilities and mend injuries several times faster than usual--"

lines.content: まあ、うん
lines.translated: "Well, yeah."

lines.content: 自分でも少し脆弱な“力”だなあとは感じてた
lines.translated: "Even I felt like it was a somewhat frail 'power.'"

lines.content: だからこうして、他のもの達より少し多い“夜”の知識とかを利用して、できることを増やし、“夜の魔法使い”だなんて名乗ってる
lines.translated: "So like this, I make use of my knowledge of the 'Night'--which is a little greater than that of the others--to expand what I can do, and call myself the 'Magician of the Night.'"

lines.content: “魔法使い”、というのは少し大げさかもしれないなあとも実は思うよ。“夜”の中で特殊な道具を作ったりはしているけれど……
lines.translated: "To be honest, I sometimes think 'Magician' might be a bit of an exaggeration, too. I do make special tools within the 'Night,' though..."

lines.content: ただ、“夜”に迷い込んだ人間たちの導きみたいなことをやってるだけだしね
lines.translated: "After all, I'm really just acting as a sort of guide for the humans who have wandered into the 'Night.'"

lines.content: そういうふうにして、“夜”に産まれた“猫”である私たちには、[・|も][・|れ][・|な][・|く][・|公][・|平][・|に]特別な“力”が宿ってる。
lines.translated: In that way, we "Cats" born into the "Night" are all, without exception and completely fairly, endowed with a special "power."

lines.content: だから必ず君にも何かあるはずだ。それがいったい何なのか。見いだすための手伝いくらいはできると思うよ
lines.translated: "So there is definitely something within you, too. As for what on earth that might be... I think I can at least help you find it."

lines.content: わたしは自分の両手をじっと見た。
lines.translated: I stared closely at my own two hands.

lines.content: ……わたしは
うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……わたしは野良だと、思ってた
lines.translated: "...I thought I was a stray."

lines.content: お父さんもお母さんも、いない。姉弟だって。気づいたら“夜”の外で迷子になってた。
lines.translated: I have no father and no mother. No brothers or sisters, either. Before I knew it, I was lost outside the "Night."

lines.content: お腹を空かせて死にそうだった。
lines.translated: I was starving and on the verge of death.

lines.content: わたし以外の子猫はみんな、お母さんにやさしく抱きしめられて眠るのに。
lines.translated: Even though all the other kittens besides me got to sleep gently cradled by their mothers.

lines.content: わたしには誰も……誰も、いない。
lines.translated: I had no one... no one at all.

lines.content: さみしい……。
lines.translated: I was lonely...

lines.content: どうしようもないさみしさで、いつも、苦しかった。
lines.translated: With a helpless loneliness, I was always hurting.

lines.content: わたしは誰もいらない子だから野良になったのだし、帰る場所もどこにもない迷子になってしまっているんだ。
lines.translated: I became a stray because I was an unwanted child, and I ended up a lost child with nowhere to return to.

lines.content: 誰も……。
lines.translated: No one...

lines.content: 『……誰も、わたしを、愛してくれない』
lines.translated: "'...No one loves me.'"

lines.content: 産まれたばかりの小さな心で、この[・|さ][・|み][・|し][・|さ]に、そういう理由をつけていた。
lines.translated: With my tiny, newly born heart, that was the reason I attached to this loneliness.

lines.content: そんなわたしをぎゅっと抱きしめてくれたのが、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]だった――今は奏大雅と名乗ってる、わたしみたいに小さなあの子。
lines.translated: The one who held me tight when I was like that was that boy--that boy as small as me, who now calls himself Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: どうしようもなく重いさみしさから、あの子は抱きしめた両手で、わたしのことを護ってくれた。
lines.translated: With the two hands that embraced me, he protected me from that overwhelmingly heavy loneliness.

lines.content: たくさんの夜を一緒に丸くなり、眠った。暖かかった。身体も。心も。
lines.translated: We curled up together and slept through so many nights. It was warm. Both my body. And my heart.

lines.content: ずっと一緒にいたいと願った。
lines.translated: I wished that we could stay together forever.

lines.content: ずっとずっとこうしていられたら、わたしは幸せ。そう、祈った。
lines.translated: If we could just stay like this forever and ever, I would be happy. That was what I prayed.

lines.content: それ以上、わたしがあの子を大切にしたいと願う気持ちに、理由はなにもいらなかった。
lines.translated: Beyond that, my desire to cherish him needed no other reason at all.

lines.content: 『……ぼくには名前がないから、だから代わりに、君に名前を付けてあげたい』
lines.translated: "'...I don't have a name, so instead, I want to give a name to you.'"

lines.content: わたしを抱きしめ、あの子は言った――わたしにだけ小さな声だけど話しかけてくれた。
lines.translated: Holding me tight, he said that--speaking in a quiet voice meant only for me.

lines.content: それがうれしかった。クロ。そう呼んでくれた。たくさん撫でてくれた。同じご飯を分けてくれた。
lines.translated: That made me happy. Kuro. That was what he called me. He petted me so much. He shared his own food with me.
Just that.
Right?

lines.content: ここにはそれ以上は何もないのだ。
lines.translated: There is nothing more than that here.

lines.content: ましろのように、人生の中に恋する物語を願う想いも、この世界と自分の想いとを天秤に掛けて語られるような、劇的な物語も、何もない。
lines.translated: Unlike Mashiro, there are no feelings wishing for a story of falling in love in life, nor is there any dramatic tale spoken of by weighing this world against one's own feelings--there is nothing at all.

lines.content: だからそんな、きみたちみたいに特別なものなんて、何もないと思ってた。でも……
lines.translated: "That's why I thought I didn't have anything special like you all do. But..."

lines.content: わたしの中にも、大切な人を応援できる“特別な力”があるのだという。
lines.translated: She says that within me, too, there is a "special power" to cheer on someone precious to me.

lines.content: なんの“才能”もないと想っていたわたしに、もしも何か“力”があるのなら……。
lines.translated: If I, who believed I had no "talent" whatsoever, really do have some kind of "power"...

lines.content: わたし……わたしは、これから続いてく、大雅の全部の時間が、少しでもいい、笑顔でいられるものにできるように……
lines.translated: "I... From now on, so that all of Taiga's continuing time can be spent with a smile, even if just a little..."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: そういう“想い”もまた、そういう“イキモノ”だから抱くものなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Do I harbor such "feelings" simply because I am that kind of "Creature," too?

lines.content: そう思うと、どうしてだろう。少し悲しい気持ちになった。
lines.translated: When I thought that, I wonder why... I felt a little sad.

lines.content: ……そうか。君もやっぱり、私たちと同じなんだな
lines.translated: "...I see. You really are the same as us, aren't you?"

lines.content: “魔法使い”が言う。
lines.translated: The "Magician" said.

lines.content: いつも胸に宿って消えない“[・|君][・|が][・|大][・|好][・|き]”という気持ちに、特別な原因はない。ただそういう“イキモノ”だからというだけだ
lines.translated: "There is no special cause behind the feeling of 'I love you so much' that always dwells in our chests and never fades. It's simply because we are that kind of 'Creature.'"

lines.content: それ以上の[わけ|理由]もなくあるものに思えるからこそ、なんだか時どき悲しいんだ。この“想い”は本当に、本物なのかなって
lines.translated: "Precisely because it feels like something that exists without any deeper reason than that, it somehow makes me sad sometimes. Wondering if these 'feelings' are truly, genuinely real."

lines.content: そういうふうに少し疑いたくなってしまうし、疑いを持ってしまう自分自身にさえもまた、悲しく感じてしまうんだ
lines.translated: "It makes me want to doubt it a little like that, and I end up feeling sad even toward myself for harboring such doubts."

lines.content: でも仕方がない。と“夜の魔法使い”、陽向井あさひは言う。
lines.translated: But it can't be helped, said the "Magician of the Night," Hinatai Asahi.

lines.content: 仕方がないよ
lines.translated: "It can't be helped."

lines.content: だって私たちはやっぱり、どこまでいっても……産まれながらにして、そういう“イキモノ”なんだから
lines.translated: "Because no matter how far we go, in the end... from the moment we are born, we are that kind of 'Creature.'"

lines.content: ……生まれつき人間を憎く思ってしまう。そんな薄暗い心を持って生まれて来なくて、よかった――せめてそう思うことにしてるよ
lines.translated: "...To naturally hate humans from birth. I'm glad we weren't born with such a dim, gloomy heart--at the very least, I choose to think of it that way."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|な][・|の][・|に]猫たちは、大切にしたいと願う人間たちより、ずっと……ずっと長生きだ
lines.translated: "And yet, cats live much... much longer than the humans they wish to cherish."

lines.content: だからまたもうひとつ、避けられないさよならとさみしさが、大切に想いたい人間と出会う度、私たちには待ち受けてるんだ
lines.translated: "So each time we meet a human we want to hold dear, another inevitable goodbye and loneliness awaits us."

lines.content: その事実のほうがよっぽど、悲しい――この気持ちが本物だとか。偽物だとか。そういう問題よりも
lines.translated: "That fact is far more sad--than questions like whether these feelings are real, or whether they're fake."

lines.content: そういったものも含めて全部、“夜の魔法使い”は仕方がないよと、やっぱりとてもさみしそうに、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Including all of those things, the "Magician of the Night" said it couldn't be helped, smiling so very lonely after all.

lines.content: わたしはそういうふうに強くなれるだろうか。“魔法使い”の言葉を聞いて、思ってた。
