lines.translated: Will I be able to become strong like that? Listening to the "Magician's" words, I wondered.

lines.content: あの男の子と……。
lines.translated: With that boy...

lines.content: ううん。あの子が[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|り][・|た][・|い]と言うのなら、わたしはきみを大雅と呼ぶよ。
lines.translated: No. If that boy says that is who he wants to be, then I will call you Taiga.

lines.content: そうだ。そんな[・|大][・|雅]と、いつか“さよなら”する日が来ることを、想像してみて――鼻先がつんとした。涙がこぼれそうだった。
lines.translated: That's right. Trying to imagine that a day will come when I have to say "goodbye" to that Taiga--the tip of my nose stung. Tears were about to spill over.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: わたしは、弱い。
lines.translated: I am weak.

lines.content: きっと誰より泣き虫だ。
lines.translated: I'm surely a bigger crybaby than anyone.

lines.content: いつか大雅とさよならするそのときは、きっと子どもみたいに泣いて、泣いて……いっぱい泣いて、きみのことをいっぱい、困らせてしまうはず。
lines.translated: When that time comes to say goodbye to Taiga someday, I'm sure I'll cry and cry like a child... cry so much, and cause you so much trouble.

lines.content: この“魔法使い”みたいに“仕方がないよ”とは、言えそうにもない。
lines.translated: I don't think I could ever say "It can't be helped" like this "Magician" does.

lines.content: それでも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: それでもわたしは、いつかその瞬間が訪れるそれまでは、大雅……。きみのそばに居続けたい。
lines.translated: Even so, until that moment arrives someday, Taiga... I want to keep staying by your side.

lines.content: それが願いだ。
lines.translated: That is my wish.

lines.content: きみの“隣”にいるときだけ、わたしはさみしい気持ちを忘れられるし、きみの時間はこれから全部、わたしの命を全部かけてでも、やさしくて楽しいものにしたいと願ってる。
lines.translated: Only when I am "beside" you can I forget my lonely feelings, and I wish to make all of your time from here on out gentle and joyful, even if it takes my entire life.
And yet.

lines.content: ……どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ううん。
lines.translated: No.
It is precisely because of that.

lines.content: わたしはきみと一緒に、いられなくなってしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up unable to stay together with you anymore.

lines.content: 電話がじりじり鳴っている。
lines.translated: The telephone was ringing shrilly.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”の奥座敷。
lines.translated: The back parlor of the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 何度目かの“満月の夜会”の後で、陽向井あさひからちょっと用事があるからお留守番していてほしいなとお願いされ、それくらいなら……と、うなずいた矢先のことだった。
lines.translated: It happened right after the umpteenth "Full Moon Tea Party," just as Hinatai Asahi asked me to watch the house because she had a small errand to run, and I nodded, thinking if it's just that much...

lines.content: 大雅は“夜会”でできたお友だちと一緒に、どこかへ走って行ってしまった。
lines.translated: Taiga had run off somewhere together with the friends he made at the "Tea Party."

lines.content: すぐに帰るよ。だからあさひさんには黙っておいて
lines.translated: "I'll be right back. So keep it a secret from Asahi-san."

lines.content: わたしにはそんなふうに言い残して。
lines.translated: Leaving me with those words.

lines.content: ……ひどいよ大雅。わたしも、連れてってほしかったのに
lines.translated: "...You're so mean, Taiga. I wanted you to take me with you, too."

lines.content: その日、ちょっとわたしは拗ねていた。
lines.translated: That day, I was pouting a little.

lines.content: 大雅はこの頃あんまりわたしに構ってくれない。
lines.translated: Lately, Taiga hasn't been paying much attention to me.

lines.content: 丸めた座布団を力いっぱい抱きしめて、誰もいない居間でごろごろしてた。
lines.translated: Hugging a rolled-up floor cushion with all my might, I rolled around in the empty living room.

lines.content: “夜会”で会った子たちと大雅は一緒にいることが多くなった。同い年くらいの子たち。しかも同じ人間だ。[・|奏][・|大][・|雅]として男の子は驚くほどよく喋るようになっていた。
lines.translated: Taiga had started spending a lot of time with the kids he met at the "Tea Party." Kids around his own age. And fellow humans, at that. As Kanade Taiga, the boy had started talking a surprising amount.

lines.content: 大丈夫？
lines.translated: "Are you okay?"

lines.content: 無理してない？
lines.translated: Isn't he pushing himself too hard?

lines.content: そんな想いも、わたしの中に芽生えて消えないけれど……。
lines.translated: Such thoughts had sprouted within me and wouldn't fade, either, but...

lines.content: 得たいのしれないこんな子猫と一緒にいるよりよっぽど健全。
lines.translated: It is far healthier than being together with a mysterious little kitten like me.

lines.content: それくらい、頭の足りないわたしでも良くよくわかる。
lines.translated: Even with my lacking head, I understand that much all too well.

lines.content: 大雅がうれしいほうがいい。どんなことでもそれが優先。きみのさみしい気持ちが少しでもなくなれば、わたしも[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|る]と思ってた。
lines.translated: It's better if Taiga is happy. No matter what, that takes priority. I thought that if your lonely feelings disappeared even a little, I would feel the same way, too.

lines.content: でもね。時どきでいいから……
lines.translated: "But you know. Just once in a while is fine, so..."

lines.content: 前みたいにわたしの頭を撫でてくれて、甘やかしてくれる日があってもいいんじゃないかなあって。また一緒に眠ってくれる夜があってもいいのになあって……。
lines.translated: I think it wouldn't hurt to have days where he pets my head and spoils me like before. I wish there could be nights where he sleeps together with me again...

lines.content: そんな我がまま、思ってみたりして。
lines.translated: Entertaining such selfish thoughts.

lines.content: ぷるぷると頭を横に振った。
lines.translated: I gave my head a little shake from side to side.

lines.content: なんだかわたし、甘えっ子みたい。急に自分が恥ずかしくなる――大雅よりわたしのほうが年上なのに。それなのに、年下な男の子に甘えたいだなんて。
lines.translated: Somehow, I'm acting like a spoiled child. Suddenly, I felt embarrassed of myself--even though I'm older than Taiga. And yet, wanting to be spoiled by a younger boy like this.

lines.content: こんなのちょっとおかしいよね。
lines.translated: This is a little weird, isn't it?

lines.content: わたし達は、“夜の女王”を倒して……
lines.translated: "We have to defeat the 'Queen of the Night' and..."

lines.content: ううん。違った。
lines.translated: No. That's not right.

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”や、その他の子たちと力を合わせて――“夜の女王”を[・|救][・|出]して、全員で“夢”を叶えるための“魔法”を、手に入れなきゃならないんだから
lines.translated: "Because we have to join forces with the 'Magician of the Night' and the other kids--rescue the 'Queen of the Night,' and obtain the 'Magic' to make everyone's 'dreams' come true."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでそうつぶやいて、気持ちを奮い立たせてた。
lines.translated: All alone, I murmured that to myself to rouse my spirits.

lines.content: そうだよ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: こんなふうに、大雅が構ってくれない、頭を撫でてくれない、ひとりで寝るのはさみしいよ……だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Thinking things like how Taiga isn't paying attention to me, how he isn't petting my head, how it's lonely sleeping by myself...

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで胸をもにょもにょさせてる暇はないはずだった。
lines.translated: I shouldn't have the time to sit here alone with this restless ache in my chest.

lines.content: 大雅が、わたし以外の誰かに笑いかけてると……変なの。もやっとするの
lines.translated: "When Taiga smiles at someone other than me... it feels strange. It makes my chest feel all cloudy."

lines.content: 抱きしめた座布団に向かって、わたしは独り言をこぼしてしまう。
lines.translated: To the floor cushion I was hugging, I ended up spilling those words to myself.

lines.content: あのね大雅
lines.translated: "You know, Taiga..."

lines.content: “魔法使い”に……あさひにヒントを、もらってね。
lines.translated: I got a hint from the "Magician"... from Asahi.

lines.content: やっとわたしの持ってる“力”が、わかったんだよ……
lines.translated: "I finally figured out what my 'power' is..."

lines.content: これで大雅の役に立てる。そう思うとうれしかった。尻尾の毛も逆立つくらい。いっぱいうれしくて、どきどきしたから……。
lines.translated: Now I can be of use to Taiga. Thinking that made me happy. So happy the fur on my tail stood on end. Because I was so full of joy, my heart was pounding...

lines.content: 大雅に、一番に聞いてもらいたかったのになあ
lines.translated: "I really wanted you to be the first to hear it, Taiga..."

lines.content: それなのに大雅はお友だちと出て行ってしまった。
lines.translated: And yet, Taiga went out with his friends.

lines.content: わたしは、唇を尖らせてばかりいる。
lines.translated: All I'm doing is pouting.

lines.content: [・|嫉][・|妬]しやすい自分が少し嫌にもなってた。もっと可愛げのあるわたしになりたい。
lines.translated: I was starting to hate myself a little for getting jealous so easily. I want to become a more lovable version of myself.

lines.content: 帰ってきた大雅に、こんなむくれた顔じゃなくて、笑顔で“おかえり”が言いたいのに。
lines.translated: When Taiga comes home, I want to say "Welcome back" with a smile, not with a sulky face like this.

lines.content: でも、気持ちがどうしても静かになってくれなくて……、
lines.translated: But my feelings just wouldn't calm down, no matter what...

lines.content: ううう～……っ
誰もいない“ゆめのねどこ”の居間で、ごろごろごろごろ、転げ回ってた。
lines.translated: In the empty living room of the "Bed of Dreams," I rolled around and around and around.

lines.content: 大雅の座ってた座布団を抱きしめて。
lines.translated: Hugging the floor cushion Taiga had been sitting on.

lines.content: ちょっと残った大雅の匂いで、安心しようとしてたけど……、
lines.translated: I was trying to soothe myself with the faint trace of Taiga's scent left on it, when...

lines.content: ……そんなとき、居間の隅に置かれてた黒電話が鳴り始めたのだった。
lines.translated: Just then, the black rotary phone placed in the corner of the living room started ringing.

lines.content: わたしはビクッと飛び上がる。
lines.translated: I jumped with a start.

lines.content: 誰かに見られたかもしれないっ。
lines.translated: Someone might have seen me!

lines.content: 大雅の座布団だきしめて、ちょっとうれしくなってたところ……っ。
lines.translated: Right when I was hugging Taiga's cushion and feeling a little happy about it...!

lines.content: 居間から飛び出し、どこか物陰に隠れようとしたけれど、
lines.translated: I bolted out of the living room and tried to hide in the shadows somewhere, but...

lines.content: 電話……
lines.translated: "The phone..."

lines.content: そろりと、鳴り続ける電話を覗き込んだ。
lines.translated: Slowly, I peeked back at the continuously ringing telephone.

lines.content: 『もしこの電話が鳴ることがあったなら、君が代わりに出てくれないかな』
lines.translated: "If this phone happens to ring, could you answer it for me?"

lines.content: 『この番号を知ってるのはちょっとした“魔法”の小道具作りを依頼してくるもの達だ。用件をメモしておいてくれたらうれしいな』
lines.translated: "The only ones who know this number are those who commission me to make little 'magical' props. I'd appreciate it if you could jot down their message."

lines.content: そのお願いに、“任せて”とは、うなずいてはいないけど……。
lines.translated: I hadn't nodded and said "Leave it to me" to that request, though...

lines.content: あさひが外出しているのは、判明したわたしの“力”を自在に制御するための道具、それを作るのに必要な材料を買いに行くためだった。
lines.translated: The reason Asahi went out was to buy the materials needed to make a tool that would let me freely control my newly discovered "power."

lines.content: あさひはわたしのためにお出かけしてる。それなのに、あさひのお願いをきけないのはだめな子のすることだ。
lines.translated: Asahi is out running an errand for my sake. Not being able to listen to her request despite that is what a bad girl would do.

lines.content: そう思ってしまったから……。
lines.translated: Because I ended up thinking that...

lines.content: 緊張で手も震えているし……。
lines.translated: My hands were trembling with nerves, too...

lines.content: 今朝、ご飯の代わりに食べたチョコレートも、全部口から飛び出てきそうだったけど……。
lines.translated: And all the chocolate I ate instead of breakfast this morning felt like it was about to come flying right back out of my mouth, but...

lines.content: 何より“嫌な予感”がしたのだ。
lines.translated: More than anything, I had a "bad feeling."

lines.content: できれば、大雅以外とは一生誰とも話さず過ごしていたい。
lines.translated: If possible, I want to spend my whole life without ever talking to anyone other than Taiga.

lines.content: そんなひどい人見知りなわたしだけれど、一度、二度……三度、四度と深呼吸し、黒電話の受話器を取った。
lines.translated: I'm terribly shy around strangers like that, yet I took one, two... three, four deep breaths, and picked up the receiver of the black phone.

lines.content: 恐る恐る受話器を耳に押しつける。
lines.translated: Timidly, I pressed the receiver to my ear.

lines.content: 誰かの叫ぶ声が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: I could hear someone shouting.

lines.content: でも、だめだ。ノイズがびりびりしててよくわからない。
lines.translated: But it was no good. The static was crackling so badly I couldn't make it out.

lines.content: 誰か……っ、――っ
lines.translated: "Someone...!--!"

lines.content: だけど相手が誰だかすぐにわかった。
lines.translated: However, I immediately knew who was on the other end.

lines.content: ……大雅？
lines.translated: "...Taiga?"

lines.content: 問いかけてみる。
lines.translated: I tried calling out.

lines.content: お願い――っ、――、もう少し大きな――……っ
lines.translated: "Please--!--a little louder--...!"

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: 繰り返し問いかける。
lines.translated: I called out again and again.

lines.content: ……大雅、なの？
lines.translated: "...Taiga, is that you?"

lines.content: どうやらノイズも少しずつ落ち着いてきているようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed the static was gradually settling down, little by little.

lines.content: わたしの声がちゃんと相手に届きはじめてる。そんな気配を感じた。
lines.translated: My voice was starting to properly reach the other end. I could sense that much.

lines.content: ……どうして、大雅がこの電話に？
lines.translated: "...Why are you calling this phone, Taiga?"

lines.content: もしかして……クロ？
lines.translated: "Could that be... Kuro?"

lines.content: ……うん。わたし
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It's me."

lines.content: どうしてクロが、この電話に……
lines.translated: "Why are you answering this phone, Kuro...?"

lines.content: 同じような疑問と言葉がなんだか少しおかしかったけど……。
lines.translated: It was a little funny how we asked the exact same question in the exact same way, but...

lines.content: それを笑う余裕はない。そんな空気をピンと立った両耳が感じてた。
lines.translated: There was no room to laugh about it. Both of my perked-up ears could sense that in the air.

lines.content: 今、みんなお出かけしてて、誰もいない
lines.translated: "Everyone's out right now, so nobody's here."

lines.content: 誰も……？
lines.translated: "Nobody...?"

lines.content: そう、誰も。わたしひとり
lines.translated: "Right, nobody. Just me by myself."

lines.content: もしも、この電話が鳴るようなことがあったなら……わたしが出るようにって、あさひから言われてて
lines.translated: "Asahi told me that if this phone happened to ring... I should answer it."

lines.content: そこで少しいつもの感じが戻ったように思った。
lines.translated: At that point, I felt like things returned to normal just a little bit.

lines.content: “何か、あったのかもしれない”――そう思わせる、ぴりぴりした雰囲気が和らいだから。
lines.translated: Because the tense atmosphere that made me think "Something might have happened" softened for a moment.

lines.content: ごめん、クロ。……ありがとう。こんな状況じゃなければ、言いたいことも聞きたいことも色々あったけど……
lines.translated: "Sorry, Kuro. ...Thank you. If we weren't in this situation, there's a lot I'd want to say and ask, but..."

lines.content: 大雅の声に再び緊張が戻った。……わたしの耳も尻尾も、嫌な予感を感じてぴりぴりしてる。
lines.translated: The tension returned to Taiga's voice once again. ...Both my ears and my tail were tingling with a bad feeling.

lines.content: 実は……
lines.translated: "The truth is..."

lines.content: 大雅が今、置かれている状況を早口で伝えられた。
lines.translated: Speaking rapidly, Taiga told me about the situation he was currently in.

lines.content: “夜会”で知り合った女の子、兎蛙あず咲。その女の子の“病”を治せないかと大雅は思った。
lines.translated: Togawa Azusaki, a girl he got to know at the "Tea Party." Taiga had wondered if there was some way he could cure that girl's "illness."

lines.content: だからあさひには秘密で、その子を連れて“ゆめのねどこ”を飛び出し、“刻の終着駅”へと向かったのだという。
lines.translated: So, keeping it a secret from Asahi, he took the girl, ran out of the "Bed of Dreams," and headed for the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: でも、少女の“病”は想像していた以上のものだった――今、大雅は、同じく“夜会”で出会った柊ハルという女の子と共に、未来へ飛ばされている最中だというのだ。
lines.translated: However, the girl's "illness" was far beyond anything he had imagined--right now, Taiga was in the middle of being flung into the future alongside a girl named Hiiragi Haru, whom he had also met at the "Tea Party."

lines.content: こうして電話で繋がれるのは、大雅の手にしている端末と、この黒電話が、どのような隔たりだろうと飛び越え繋がりあえる――“夜の魔法使い”が創り上げた“魔法”だからだ。
lines.translated: The reason we could connect by phone like this was because the device in Taiga's hand and this black phone could leap across any divide to connect with each other--it was "Magic" created by the "Magician of the Night."

lines.content: 大雅はたぶん、ましろの“呪い”を解くための方法を探そうとしたんじゃないだろうか――兎蛙あず咲の“呪い”は、間違いなく、さくらの樹に眠る漆黒の心を持った子らの“呪い”だろう。
lines.translated: Taiga was probably trying to find a way to break Mashiro's "curse"--Togawa Azusaki's "curse" was undoubtedly the "curse" of the children with pitch-black hearts sleeping in the cherry trees.

lines.content: わたしは……。
lines.translated: I am...

lines.content: わたしは、[・|よ][・|か][・|っ][・|た]と内心、安心のため息をついていた。
lines.translated: Deep down, I breathed a sigh of relief, thinking, "Thank goodness."

lines.content: わたしの“力”がどんなものなのか。それが判明した後で、本当によかった。
lines.translated: I was truly glad this happened after I found out what kind of "power" I have.

lines.content: ……あさひに、この“力”を制御する道具を作ってもらうのには、間に合わなかったけれど。
lines.translated: Even though we didn't make it in time for Asahi to craft the tool to control this "power."

lines.content: 大丈夫、とわたしは大雅に言ったのだ。
lines.translated: "It's okay," I told Taiga.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。わたし、おばかだから。あまり上手に説明できない。だけど、何とかなるよ。きっと
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Because I'm dumb, I can't explain it very well. But it'll work out. I'm sure of it."

lines.content: 何とかって……
lines.translated: "Work out...? How..."

lines.content: 今の大雅を助けられる方法は、道具は、“魔法”は……ここには、“ゆめのねどこ”にはないだろうけれど
lines.translated: "The method, the tool, the 'Magic' to save you right now... probably isn't here in the 'Bed of Dreams,' though."

lines.content: ……でも、わたしの中には、[・|そ][・|れ]はあるんだよ
lines.translated: "...But it IS inside of me."

lines.content: またノイズが走った。でも構わず続けてわたしは言った。
lines.translated: Static crackled across the line again. Even so, I didn't mind it and kept speaking.

lines.content: ……だから、大雅。きみに降りかかる大変なことは、これからも全部わたしが――
lines.translated: "...So, Taiga. All the terrible things that happen to you from now on, I will take them all--"

lines.content: だめだ。よく、聞こえない。だからもう一度言ってほしい
lines.translated: "No good. I can't hear you well. Please say it one more time."

lines.content: わたしの声はもう届かないようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed my voice wasn't reaching him anymore.

lines.content: それだけ遠くへ、ふたりは飛ばされていってしまっているのだろう。早くしないと。
lines.translated: The two of them must be getting flung that far away. I have to hurry.

lines.content: ……別れを。
lines.translated: No time for parting.
It looks like there's no time to mourn our "goodbye."

lines.content: ……大雅。電話を切って
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Hang up the phone."

lines.content: ……この電話をきみが切る。それを、合図にしよう。そうすれば、全部元通りになるはずだから
lines.translated: "...You hanging up this phone. Let's make that the signal. If we do that, everything should go back to the way it was."

lines.content: で、でも……
lines.translated: "B-But..."

lines.content: ノイズの隙間から大雅の声がちゃんと聞こえた。
lines.translated: Through the gaps in the static, I heard Taiga's voice clearly.

lines.content: 奏くん、誰と話してるの？　あさひさんじゃない……？
lines.translated: "Kanade-kun, who are you talking to? Is it not Asahi-san...?"

lines.content: そんな声も大雅の背後からわたしに届いた。不安そうな声だ。助けを求める、声だった。
lines.translated: A voice like that reached me from behind Taiga as well. It was an anxious voice. A voice pleading for help.

lines.content: ふたりを直ぐにでも助けてあげたい。不安から解放させたい。
lines.translated: I want to save the two of them right this instant. I want to free them from their anxiety.

lines.content: 早く……。大雅。電話を切って
lines.translated: "Hurry... Taiga. Hang up the phone."

lines.content: 祈るみたいにして、わたしは言った。
lines.translated: I said it as if offering a prayer.

lines.content: ほんの少しだ。沈黙があった。
lines.translated: Just for a tiny moment, there was silence.

lines.content: お願い、大雅
lines.translated: "Please, Taiga."

lines.content: このままわたしの声が、電話を通してでも届かなくなってしまったら……
lines.translated: "If my voice stops reaching you even through the phone like this..."

lines.content: それほど遠くにきみ達ふたりが飛ばされてしまったら、たぶん、わたしにも大雅たちをたすけられなくなる
lines.translated: "If the two of you get flung so far away that it can't, I probably won't be able to save you guys anymore either."

lines.content: ……クロ。電話、切るから
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I'm going to hang up the phone."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 電話越しにわたしはうなずき、
lines.translated: I nodded across the line,

lines.content: ……その前に、ひとつだけ約束をしてほしい
lines.translated: "...Before you do, I want you to make me just one promise."

lines.content: 何？　と、聞こえた大雅の声に、わたしは言った。
lines.translated: "What?" I heard Taiga's voice ask, and I told him.

lines.content: ……ハルとしっかり手を繋いでて。電話を切る前に
lines.translated: "...Hold Haru's hand tightly. Before you hang up."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: いい？　大雅。もうひとつだけ、約束
lines.translated: "Okay, Taiga? And just one more promise."

lines.content: これからどんなことが起きたとしても、絶対、ハルのその手を離しちゃだめだよ――“ゆめのねどこ”に帰るまでは、絶対に
lines.translated: "No matter what happens from here on out, you must never, ever let go of Haru's hand--not until you make it back to the 'Bed of Dreams,' no matter what."

lines.content: ……大雅？
lines.translated: "...Taiga?"

lines.content: ……クロ、また、会えるよね？
lines.translated: "...Kuro, we'll see each other again, right?"

lines.content: 不安そうな大雅の声がした――わたしの[・|不][・|安]が伝わったのかもしれない。……だめだ。きみにはいつも笑顔でいてほしい。
lines.translated: Taiga's voice sounded anxious--maybe my own anxiety had come through to him. ...No good. I want you to always be smiling.

lines.content: だから電話越しにでも、大雅に微笑みかけて、
lines.translated: So, even if it was over the phone, I smiled for Taiga,

lines.content: うん。大丈夫。また、会える。約束するよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's okay. We'll see each other again. I promise."

lines.content: わたしは、目覚めたばかりの“力”を使った。
lines.translated: And I used my newly awakened "power."

lines.content: ……ごめん大雅。わたしは、うそつきだ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. I'm a liar."

lines.content: “力”を使ったわたしは旅に出なければならなかった。
lines.translated: Having used my "power," I had to set out on a journey.

lines.content: “また、会える”という“約束”は、破らずにいられても――“きみをひとりぼっちにはさせないよ”という誓いのほうは……ごめん。……ごめんね。守れそうにない。
lines.translated: Even if I could keep my "promise" that "we'll see each other again"--as for my vow that "I won't let you end up all alone"... I'm sorry. ...I'm so sorry. It doesn't look like I'll be able to keep it.

lines.content: わたしの“力”は……
lines.translated: "My 'power' is..."

lines.content: 誰もいない部屋で、わたしはつぶやく。
lines.translated: In a room with no one else around, I murmur to myself.

lines.content: ……“大切に想う人に降りかかる不幸を、すべて、肩代わりすること”
lines.translated: "...'To take on all the misfortune that befalls the person I hold dear.'"

lines.content: それは、大雅の身に降りかかる問題のすべてをわたしが受け取る、ということだ。
lines.translated: That meant I would receive every single problem that befell Taiga.

lines.content: ……後々にわかったことだけれど、柊ハルはわたしの“力”を真似て、自身の“魔法”を“想像”したのだと言っていた。
lines.translated: Though I only found out much later, Hiiragi Haru said she had imitated my "power" when she "imagined" her own "Magic."

lines.content: 大雅は兎蛙あず咲の“病”に巻き込まれた。
lines.translated: Taiga had gotten caught up in Togawa Azusaki's "illness."

lines.content: 彼女の“病”は満月の夜に眠ることで、未来へ跳んでしまうというものだった。
lines.translated: Her "illness" was one where falling asleep on the night of a full moon caused her to leap into the future.

lines.content: 大雅もハルも、その“病”に罹患したのだ。[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]を助けるには“力”を使うしかなかった。
lines.translated: Both Taiga and Haru had contracted that "illness." The only way to save the two of them was to use my "power."

lines.content: [・|ま][・|だ][・|完][・|全][・|で][・|は][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|け][・|れ][・|ど]、迷ってる暇はなかった――大雅とハルの“病”を、電話越しで自分に移し。
lines.translated: Even though it wasn't complete yet, there was no time to hesitate--over the phone, I transferred Taiga and Haru's "illness" onto myself.

lines.content: [・|旅][・|立][・|つ]際には、真っ暗闇の中で迷子になってしまってたふたりのことを、元の時代の“ゆめのねどこ”にまで導いた。
lines.translated: And as I set off on my journey, I guided the two of them, who had gotten lost in pitch-black darkness, all the way back to the "Bed of Dreams" in their original era.

lines.content: そのとき、大雅だけ“病”を受け取ることもできただろう。
lines.translated: At that time, I probably could have taken on only Taiga's "illness."

lines.content: でも、そんなことをしたら大雅が悲しむ
lines.translated: "But if I did something like that, it would make Taiga sad."

lines.content: そんなことくらいなら、“心”も“想像力”も足りないわたしにも、わかったから……。
lines.translated: Even someone like me, lacking in both "heart" and "imagination," could understand that much, at least...

lines.content: “[・|大][・|切][・|に][・|想][・|う][・|人]の不幸をすべて肩代わりする”
lines.translated: "'Taking on all the misfortune of the person I hold dear.'"

lines.content: ――その前提条件を無視し、柊ハルにも移った“[不幸|病]”まで肩代わりできたのは、まだわたしがわたしの“力”を制御しきれていなかったからだろう。
lines.translated: --The reason I was able to ignore that prerequisite and even take on the "misfortune" that had spread to Hiiragi Haru was probably because I still couldn't fully control my own "power."

lines.content: だからほんとはわたしが決意するまでもなく、殆ど無差別に、手当たり次第に、この力は働いてしまった。
lines.translated: So the truth is, before I even made up my mind to do so, this power had acted almost indiscriminately, grabbing whatever was in reach.

lines.content: そうならないように、あさひが、“魔法”の道具を作ってくれようとしてたけど……
lines.translated: "Asahi was trying to make a 'magical' tool for me so that wouldn't happen, though..."

lines.content: 『間に合わなくて、ごめん』
lines.translated: "I'm sorry I didn't make it in time."

lines.content: 大雅との電話越しに“力”を使い――急激な眠気に襲われて、床にへたり込んでしまっていたわたしを抱き上げ、あさひは言った。
lines.translated: Having used my "power" over the phone with Taiga--I was assaulted by sudden drowsiness and had slumped onto the floor, when Asahi scooped me up into her arms and spoke.

lines.content: 『この黒電話を持って行け。この電話があれば、どんなに遠く離れていても“今の私たち”と会話はできるから』
lines.translated: "Take this black phone with you. As long as you have this phone, no matter how far apart we are, you'll be able to talk with the 'us of right now.'"

lines.content: ありがとうと、激しい睡魔にすり切れる声で、わたしは言った。
lines.translated: "Thank you," I said, my voice worn thin by the overwhelming urge to sleep.

lines.content: 『このことは、大雅には……』
lines.translated: "About this... to Taiga..."

lines.content: 言わないで、とわたしは弱々しくも、首を振った。
lines.translated: Don't tell him, I pleaded, shaking my head weakly.

lines.content: 『大雅には……大雅の、やらなきゃいけないこと、が……あるから』
lines.translated: "Because Taiga... has things... that Taiga has to do..."

lines.content: 『わたしは、[・|そ][・|れ]を、応援したい……。邪魔だけは、……絶対、したくないんだ』
lines.translated: "I want to... cheer him on in that... The last thing I ever want to do... is get in his way."

lines.content: “夜の女王”を倒すのではなく救い出すこと。
lines.translated: Not defeating the "Queen of the Night," but saving her.

lines.content: そして奏大雅を蘇らせること。
lines.translated: And bringing Kanade Taiga back to life.

lines.content: ……ふたりの人生を、取り戻すこと。
lines.translated: Taking back the lives of those two.

lines.content: そのための“魔法”を得る。
lines.translated: Obtaining the "Magic" to do that.

lines.content: 失われた命の再生どころか、世界の運命そのものを書き換えようとしている。……大きな。とても大きな“魔法”だった。
lines.translated: Far from just restoring a lost life, he was trying to rewrite the very fate of the world itself. ...It was a big. A very big "Magic."

lines.content: でもそれが大雅の“夢”で……。
lines.translated: But that was Taiga's "dream"...

lines.content: それを叶えられなければ、大雅はきっと、自分自身のことを永遠に許すことができないのだろう――
lines.translated: And if he couldn't make it come true, Taiga would surely never be able to forgive himself for all eternity--

lines.content: 大雅はたぶん、ふたりが[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う]になってしまったことの全部を、自分のせいだと感じてる。
lines.translated: Taiga probably feels like it's entirely his fault that the two of them ended up like that.

lines.content: けれど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 今、ここにいたるまで、わたし達はあまり面と向かって、[・|そ][・|の][・|こ][・|と]について話し合ったことがない。
lines.translated: Even up to this point, we haven't really sat down face-to-face and talked about that.

lines.content: 頭の足りないわたしは話すことがいつまで経っても得意じゃないし……
lines.translated: "I'm dumb, so I've never gotten any better at talking, no matter how much time passes..."

lines.content: 大雅は――男の子は、“自分は奏大雅だ”と口にしたあの日、あの瞬間から、いったい何を考えているのか、わからなくなった。
lines.translated: From that day, that very moment when Taiga--when the boy said the words "I am Kanade Taiga," I stopped being able to tell what on earth he was thinking.

lines.content: ……何も喋らなかった頃よりも、奏大雅として話すようになってからのほうが、あの子が何を考えてるのか……余計に、わからなくなってしまった
lines.translated: "...Even more than back when he didn't speak at all, ever since he started talking as Kanade Taiga... I've understood what he's thinking even less."

lines.content: たぶん、あの子とわたしは、どこまでいっても人間と猫だ。
lines.translated: Maybe, no matter how far we go, that boy and I are still human and cat.

lines.content: 人間は、人間以外の何者かに、自分の気持ちを素直に話すことのない“イキモノ”なのだ。
lines.translated: Humans are "creatures" who never honestly speak their true feelings to anything other than another human.

lines.content: 人生について一番大切な悩みは同じ“人”にしか話さない――それが仲間意識のようなものなのかもしれない。
lines.translated: They only share their most important worries about life with other "people"--maybe it's like a sense of camaraderie.

lines.content: だからわたしには、大雅は何も話してくれなくて……。
lines.translated: That's why Taiga never tells me anything...

lines.content: ……自分を許せないまま生きるというのは、きっと、とてもつらいことなんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "...Living on without being able to forgive yourself must be a really painful thing, isn't it?"

lines.content: だからましろも、自分のことが許せなかったから――[・|あ][・|あ][・|い][・|う][・|道][・|を][・|選][・|ん][・|だ]。
lines.translated: And because Mashiro couldn't forgive herself either--she chose that path.

lines.content: そういうふうに、わたしは、大雅たちの気持ちを勝手に“想像”してみるしかなかった。
lines.translated: Like that, all I could do was try to selfishly "imagine" what Taiga and the others were feeling.

lines.content: わたしも、人間だったらよかった
lines.translated: "I wish I were human, too."

lines.content: ため息と共にひとりでこぼした――どうして。神さま。
lines.translated: All alone, I let those words slip out with a sigh--Why, God?

lines.content: どうしてわたしは、猫に産まれてきたんだろう……。[・|大][・|雅][・|と][・|同][・|じ][・|に]、産まれたかったな
lines.translated: "Why was I born a cat...? I wish I could have been born the same as Taiga."

lines.content: きみとは違う形の耳と、尻尾をなでつけながら、いつもそんなことばかりを思ってる。
lines.translated: As I smooth down my ears, shaped so differently from yours, and my tail, that's all I ever think about.

lines.content: いつか……
lines.translated: "Someday..."

lines.content: いつか、大雅に、本当の気持ちを話して聞かせてほしい。
lines.translated: Someday, I want Taiga to tell me how he truly feels.

lines.content: そのときがいつか来るまで、わたしは、産まれたばかりの“力”を使い、きみのことを遠くから、でも時どきは近くから、そっと護っていきたいと願ったし……。
lines.translated: Until that day finally comes, I wished to use my newly born "power" to gently protect you from afar, and sometimes from up close...
And because of that, I became unable to sleep.

lines.content: 眠った分だけ“未来”に跳んで……。
lines.translated: For as long as I slept, I would leap into the "future"...

lines.content: そうして目を覚ましたわたしは、[・|こ][・|こ]にいた。
lines.translated: And when I woke up like that, I was here.

lines.content: ――ちく、たく、ちく、たく。
lines.translated: --Tick, tock, tick, tock.

lines.content: たくさんの時計が一秒一秒を刻んでる。“ゆめのねどこ”の一室だ。
lines.translated: Countless clocks are ticking away, second by second. It is a room in the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]は“刻”の調整室のような場所だ。
lines.translated: This place is like an adjustment room for "Time."

lines.content: 壁に掛けられた時計の針を少しいじれば、この部屋の時間だけ、外の時間から切り離すことができる。
lines.translated: By fiddling just a little with the hands of the clocks hanging on the walls, you can sever the time in this room alone from the time outside.

lines.content: この部屋の時間を進めている時計の針を止めれば、部屋の外の時間の進行から、[ここ|部屋]の時間だけが停止する。
lines.translated: If you stop the hands of the clock that advances the time in this room, the time here in the room alone comes to a halt, cut off from the progression of time outside.

lines.content: だからわたしが元いた時間世界が、[未来|ここ]に追いついてくるまで、わたしはこの部屋で、眠らずじっと待っている。
lines.translated: So until the time-world I was originally in catches up to me here in the future, I wait still in this room, without sleeping.

lines.content: 『時間と世界は少しでも何かしらの観測と干渉があれば、即座に、君の知らない世界へと無数に、無限に、枝分かれしてしまう。“未来”とは私たちにとって一番身近な平行世界だ』
lines.translated: "With even the slightest observation or interference, time and the world will instantly branch off into countless, infinite worlds unknown to you. The 'future' is the parallel world closest to us."

lines.content: 『だから君は、飛び越えてしまった先の時間に何も干渉することなく、刻の調整室で時間の進行を止め、過去が[今|現在]に追いついてくるのをたったひとりで、待つしかなかった』
lines.translated: "That's why, without interfering in any way with the time ahead that you've leapt into, you had no choice but to stop the progression of time in the adjustment room of time and wait all alone for the past to catch up to the present."

lines.content: 『そうでなければ、次に君と出会えた私たちは――奏大雅は、君の知ってる人物とは[・|ど][・|こ][・|か][・|違][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|る]かもしれない』
lines.translated: "Otherwise, the next time we meet you--Kanade Taiga might be somewhat different from the person you know."

lines.content: それは、つまり……。
lines.translated: Which meant, in other words...

lines.content: 『……君はたったひとり、時間の迷路に閉じ込められてしまうことになる。一度道をそれてしまえば、二度と元には戻れないと思っていたほうがいい』
lines.translated: "...You would end up trapped all alone in a labyrinth of time. You should assume that once you stray from the path, you can never go back to the way things were."

lines.content: わたしの足りない頭ではよくわからない。
lines.translated: With my dumb head, I don't really get it.

lines.content: だけどあさひから受けた警告どおり、わたしは時計の針を――この部屋の時間を示すものだけを、眠りから目覚める度に止めるのだった。
lines.translated: But just as Asahi warned me, every time I woke from my sleep, I would stop the hands of the clock--only the one that marked the time of this room.

lines.content: またわたしの知ってる大雅と出会いたいから。
lines.translated: Because I want to meet the Taiga I know again.

lines.content: ちく、たく、ちく、たく。
lines.translated: Tick, tock, tick, tock.

lines.content: 幾つも重なる秒針の音に、わたしはじっと耳を澄ませ、ただ時間が過ぎるのをここで小さくなって、待っていた。
lines.translated: Listening intently to the overlapping sounds of the second hands, I curled up small right here and simply waited for time to pass.

lines.content: 秒針の進む音は、きみが、わたしのいる未来にまで、ゆっくりと……、でも確実に進んできている足音のように、わたしには聞こえた。
lines.translated: To me, the sound of the advancing second hands sounded like your footsteps, slowly... yet surely making their way toward the future where I am.

lines.content: あくびをし……。
lines.translated: I let out a yawn...

lines.content: 眠らないように何度も顔をごしごし擦った。
lines.translated: And rubbed my face hard, over and over, to keep myself from falling asleep.

lines.content: お腹も空くし、ひとりでずっとさみしかった。
lines.translated: I got hungry, too, and being all by myself for so long was lonely.

lines.content: 泣き虫なわたしだから、ちょっと泣いたりもしたかもしれない。
lines.translated: Since I'm such a crybaby, I might have even cried a little.

lines.content: でも、夜になるのだけが楽しみだった。
lines.translated: Even so, the one thing I looked forward to was nightfall.
I am always calling you on the phone from here... from a future just a little bit ahead.

lines.content: きみが一日、何があったのかを話して聞かせてくれる――その時間が大好きだった。
lines.translated: You would tell me all about what happened during your day--I loved that time so much.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: お友だちと一緒に、毎日楽しそうで、よかったよ
lines.translated: "It sounds like you're having fun every day with your friends. I'm glad."

lines.content: 電話越しでも、そういうきみのことを知れて、うれしかった。
lines.translated: Even over the phone, being able to learn about that side of you made me happy.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: きみが不安や心配で眠れない夜は、あのひとみたいに――[・|ま][・|し][・|ろ][・|み][・|た][・|い][・|に]、上手な言葉で、きみに勇気をあげられたらと願ってた。
lines.translated: On nights when you couldn't sleep from anxiety or worry, I wished I could give you courage with skillful words, just like her--just like Mashiro.

lines.content: 面と向かっては簡単じゃなくても、どうしてだか、電話でなら大丈夫……
lines.translated: "Even if it's not easy face-to-face, for some reason, it's okay over the phone..."

lines.content: ふつうなら恥ずかしくて言えないようなことも、平気で言えた。眠れないきみを励ます言葉を、たくさん選べた。
lines.translated: Things I'd normally be too embarrassed to say, I could say without hesitation. I could choose so many words to encourage you when you couldn't sleep.

lines.content: それだけだ。
lines.translated: That's all.

lines.content: それだけが、たったひとりのさみしさを紛らわすための、わたしの“希望”だったように思う。
lines.translated: I think that alone was my "hope" to distract myself from the loneliness of being all on my own.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで時計の音を聞いてると、どうしても“さよなら”を意識してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Listening to the sound of the clocks all by myself, I inevitably start thinking about "goodbyes."

lines.content: きみの“不幸”を肩代わりすることで、こんなふうにひとりぼっちになってしまうなんて。
lines.translated: To think that by taking on your "misfortune," I would end up all alone like this.

lines.content: そんなのは予想なんて全然していなかった。あんまりに突然のことだったのだ。
lines.translated: I hadn't expected anything like that at all. It had happened far too suddenly.

lines.content: いつか訪れるのだろう、きみとの永遠の“さよなら”もまた、突然なのかもしれない。そう思うと怖かった。
lines.translated: The eternal "goodbye" with you that will surely come someday might also be sudden. Thinking that made me scared.

lines.content: たとえ大雅に死が訪れても、“夜の国”で再び会える――本当に？　本当に、“さよなら”はないの？
lines.translated: Even if death comes for Taiga, we can meet again in the "Land of Night"--Really? Will there really be no "goodbye"?

lines.content: 子猫なわたしにはよくわからないことだらけだ。
lines.translated: To a kitten like me, there are so many things I just don't understand.

lines.content: わからないことは全部不安に変わってしまう。
lines.translated: Everything I don't understand turns into anxiety.

lines.content: ……だから。
lines.translated: And so.

lines.content: 少しでも、多く
lines.translated: "As much as possible,"

lines.content: と、感じてしまう。
lines.translated: Is how I end up feeling.

lines.content: 大切な人との“さよなら”は、いつ訪れるかわからない。
lines.translated: You never know when a "goodbye" with someone precious to you will come.

lines.content: だから一秒でも多く、そばにいたいなあと思ってたけど……
lines.translated: "That's why I wanted to stay by your side for even a single second longer..."

lines.content: 今度はいつ会えるだろう。
lines.translated: When will we be able to meet next?

lines.content: この部屋の時間を止めても、すぐにわたしの知ってる大雅が……その時間が、ここに追いついてくるわけじゃない。
lines.translated: Even if I stop the time in this room, it doesn't mean the Taiga I know... that his time will catch up to this place right away.

lines.content: 永遠にも思える時間を、眠らずに、ひとりぼっちで待ち続けなければならなかった。
lines.translated: I had to keep waiting all alone, without sleeping, through what felt like an eternity.

lines.content: ……次に会えたそのときは、もう少しだけでも長くきみと一緒に、いられますように。
lines.translated: When we finally meet again, I hope I can stay with you just a little bit longer.

lines.content: そんな願いを込めて、わたしは壁掛けの時計の秒針を、止めるのだった。
lines.translated: Putting that wish into my actions, I stopped the second hand of the clock on the wall.

lines.content: [・|次]に大雅と会えたときには、もう、“夜の女王”との戦いは終わってしまっていた。
lines.translated: The next time I was able to meet Taiga, the battle with the "Queen of the Night" had already ended.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”に集められた子たちはそれぞれ、“夜”へ――見上げた満開のさくらの花へと、望む“魔法”を思い描いた。
lines.translated: The children gathered in the "Bed of Dreams" each envisioned the "magic" they wished for toward the "Night"--toward the full-blooming cherry blossoms they looked up at.

lines.content: その“想い”に応えたのは、さくらの樹に芽生えた“心”だろうか。それともそこで眠り続ける黒色の子ども達だろうか。
lines.translated: Was it the "heart" that sprouted within the cherry tree that answered those "feelings"? Or was it the black-colored children who continue to sleep there?

lines.content: 今となってはわからない。何も。……何ひとつ。
lines.translated: Now, there is no way of knowing. Nothing. ...Not a single thing.

lines.content: わたし達の生きるこの時間は、あまりにも色々なものが絡まり合いすぎている。
lines.translated: This time in which we live has far too many different things tangled up together.

lines.content: 大雅とわたしは、死んだ人間を蘇らせて、これから更にその絡まりを複雑なものにしようとしているのだ。
lines.translated: Taiga and I are trying to bring a dead human back to life, which is about to make that tangle even more complicated from here on out.

lines.content: そうして“魔法”と同時に、大雅と少女たちが手にしたのは――“魔法”を“夜の外”へ持ち出すために必要な“代償”だ。
lines.translated: And so, at the same time as the "magic," what Taiga and the girls obtained was--the "price" necessary to take that "magic" "outside the night."

lines.content: 大雅から“病”を引き受け少し先の“未来”へ跳んだ。
lines.translated: I took on the "illness" from Taiga and leapt into a "future" a little ways ahead.

lines.content: そのためわたしは、大雅や少女たちの得た“魔法”も“代償”も、[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら][・|の][・|事][・|情][・|も]、何も知らない。
lines.translated: Because of that, I know nothing of the "magic" or the "price" that Taiga and the girls obtained, nor the circumstances behind them.

lines.content: そんなわたしに、大雅の“魔法”や“代償”――そこに危険がないかどうか判断する。そのための“権利”を担えと“魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: To someone like me, the "Magician" told me to bear the "right" to judge whether there is any danger in Taiga's "magic" and "price."

lines.content: こんなわたしに、そんな大切なこと……
lines.translated: "For someone like me to be given such an important task..."

lines.content: 上手にできるはずがない。
lines.translated: There's no way I can do it well.

lines.content: まだ自分の“力”だって使いこなせていないのに。
lines.translated: Even though I haven't even mastered using my own "power" yet.

lines.content: でもその役目は、他の誰かに譲りたくはないという思いもまたあった。
lines.translated: However, there was also a part of me that didn't want to hand that role over to anyone else.

lines.content: 大雅は、わたしがそばにいられなかったとき、“魔法使い”とどういう時間を過ごし、どういう言葉を交わし合ったのだろう。
lines.translated: When I couldn't be by his side, what kind of time did Taiga spend with the "Magician," and what kind of words did they exchange?

lines.content: ……そこにわたしの知らないきみがいるようで、少し怖くて、少し、さみしい。
lines.translated: It feels like there's a version of you there that I don't know, and it makes me a little scared, and a little lonely.

lines.content: でも同時にうれしいとも感じてた。
lines.translated: But at the same time, I also felt happy.

lines.content: やっとだ。
lines.translated: Finally.

lines.content: やっとわたしも、大雅の人生に役立てるのかな……
lines.translated: "Can I finally be of some use to Taiga's life, too...?"

lines.content: 今までは何の役にも立てないのに、ただただそばにいるだけだった。
lines.translated: Until now, even though I couldn't be of any use at all, I simply stayed by his side.

lines.content: だからわたしは、大雅に、どういう“魔法”と“代償”とを想い、描いたのかを問いかけた――……ごめんね。
lines.translated: That's why I asked Taiga what kind of "magic" and "price" he had envisioned--...I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……一番大切なとき、そばにいなくて
lines.translated: "...For not being by your side at the most important time."

lines.content: 大雅が猫のわたしに心の内を、その悩みを、包み隠さず話して聞かせてくれることはないだろう。
lines.translated: Taiga will probably never lay bare his innermost thoughts and his troubles to a cat like me.

lines.content: 人間は人間同士にしか心の痛みを見せたりはしない“イキモノ”なのだ。
lines.translated: Humans are "creatures" who only show the pain in their hearts to other humans.

lines.content: ……それなのに、せめてそばにもいられなくもなってしまえば、大雅にとってわたしの価値は、どんどんと小さくちいさくなっていくようで。
lines.translated: Even so, if I can't even stay by his side anymore, it feels as though my value to Taiga will keep shrinking smaller and smaller.

lines.content: それもまた、怖かった。
lines.translated: That, too, frightened me.

lines.content: ううん。大丈夫
lines.translated: "No. It's fine."

lines.content: 大雅は、怖がってばかりなわたしに首を振る――誰にも知られたくない秘密の話だからと、わたし達は、時計塔の管理室で向かい合っていた。
lines.translated: Taiga shakes his head at me, as I do nothing but cower in fear--Saying it was a secret talk he didn't want anyone to know about, the two of us were facing each other in the clock tower's control room.

lines.content: ……大丈夫だよ。毎晩クロが電話してくれてたから。だからさみしくはなかったし……、それにね。みんながいたから、何とかなったよ
lines.translated: "...It's okay. Because you called me every night, Kuro. So I wasn't lonely... and besides, you know. Everyone was there, so things worked out somehow."

lines.content: その返答にほんの少しのさみしさを感じてた。やっぱり大雅にわたしは必要ないのかな。そういうさみしさだ。
lines.translated: I felt a tiny bit of loneliness at that reply. Maybe Taiga really doesn't need me after all. It was that kind of loneliness.

lines.content: それに。
lines.translated: And besides.
Things worked out somehow...

lines.content: それはどういう意味だろう――大雅は、“夜の女王を倒すのではなく、助け出すのなら協力する”と、最初に言っていたはずだ。
lines.translated: What could that mean--At the very beginning, Taiga should have said that he would "cooperate if it's to rescue the Queen of the Night, not defeat her."

lines.content: 大雅が、果たして“夜の女王”を[・|ど][・|う][・|し][・|た][・|の][・|か]を、わたしは知らない。あえて聞き出すこともできずにいる。それは勇気がないからだ。ただ、それだけの理由だ。
lines.translated: I do not know what Taiga ultimately did with the "Queen of the Night." I can't bring myself to press him for answers, either. That is because I lack the courage. That is the only reason.

lines.content: 俺が“魔法”で得たいと願うものは
lines.translated: "What I wish to obtain through 'magic' is..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: クロも、知ってるとおりだよ
lines.translated: "Just as you already know, Kuro."

lines.content: 大雅は微笑む。
lines.translated: Taiga smiles.

lines.content: “大切なひと達を取り戻すこと”――そして、ふたりにあり得ただろう幸せな“未来”を、ふたりに、返すこと
lines.translated: "'To take back the people precious to me'--and to return to the two of them the happy 'future' that they should have had."
"...Return?"

lines.content: その言葉に違和感を覚えた。
lines.translated: Something about that word felt off to me.

lines.content: でも、それを上手に言葉で表せるほどの頭を、わたしは持たない。
lines.translated: However, I don't have a good enough head on my shoulders to put that feeling into words skillfully.
My question--Taiga might not have heard it at all.

lines.content: 落ち着かないわたしの気持ちごと、大雅は置き去りにするみたいにして、続けて言った。
lines.translated: As if leaving me and my restless feelings behind, Taiga continued speaking.

lines.content: ましろが願い。大雅がやさしく受け入れようとした……“恋するための物語”だ。世界を救うためのお話よりも、ふたりは[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う]世界を生きたいと願ってた
lines.translated: "It's the 'story for falling in love'... that Mashiro wished for, and that Taiga gently tried to accept. Rather than a tale about saving the world, the two of them wished to live in that kind of world."

lines.content: そのすべてを叶えたい
lines.translated: "I want to grant all of that."

lines.content: そうすることがせめて、俺にできるふたりへの[・|恩][・|返][・|し]なんだ。……そのために俺は、こんなところにまで[・|逃][・|げ][・|て][・|き][・|た]
lines.translated: "Doing so is the very least I can do to repay the two of them. ...For that sake, I ran away all the way to a place like this."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: だめだった
lines.translated: "It was no good."

lines.content: だめ？
lines.translated: No good?

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……だめだったんだ。[・|み][・|ん][・|な][・|み][・|た][・|い][・|に]は、上手にそれを……“魔法の形”も、それを得るための“代償”も、俺には思い描くことができなかったよ
lines.translated: "...It was no good. Unlike everyone else, I couldn't skillfully envision it... neither the 'shape of the magic,' nor the 'price' required to obtain it."

lines.content: 大雅が手に入れたのは、願いを叶えるための“最後の魔法”を得られるという“権利”だけ――今は保留されている状態なのだと、大雅は言った。
lines.translated: What Taiga obtained was only the "right" to acquire the "final magic" to grant his wish--right now, it is being held on standby, Taiga said.

lines.content: 俺の“魔法”は規模が大きい
lines.translated: "The scale of my 'magic' is huge."

lines.content: 人をひとり蘇らせようといことは、つまりこの世界の“未来”ごと変えてしまおうとしてるのと[おんな|同]じだ。それと釣り合うだけの“代償”は、どういったものなら相応しいのか……
lines.translated: "Trying to bring a single person back to life is, in other words, the same as trying to change the very 'future' of this world. What kind of 'price' would be appropriate to balance that out...?"

lines.content: ひとりではどうしても考え至らなかったと、大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Taiga says that no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't come up with the answer on his own.

lines.content: ここは、奏大雅があっけなく殺されてしまう瞬間よりも、そしてましろが、俺のことなんかを救い出そうとするために、自分の全部を犠牲にしようと決めた、あの瞬間よりも
lines.translated: "This place is long before the moment Kanade Taiga is so easily killed, and before that moment when Mashiro decided to sacrifice everything she had in order to save someone like me."

lines.content: 更に言えば、“半透明”のひと達が……。
lines.translated: Furthermore, the "translucent" people...

lines.content: あさひさんが。十夜が。ナナちゃんが。……名も知らない男のひとが。あっけなく[・|消][・|さ][・|れ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|う]よりもずっとずっと、[・|前][・|の][・|時][・|間]だ。
lines.translated: It is a time long, long before Asahi-san, Toya, Nana-chan... and that man whose name I don't even know, are so easily erased.

lines.content: そんな結果にはならないよう時間を書き換える。“未来”を変えるそのために、“[ここ|過去]”から何か働きかける……
lines.translated: "To rewrite time so that it doesn't end up with that result. To do something from the 'past' in order to change the 'future'..."

lines.content: 本来ならそうすることが大道な解決手段なのだろうけど……しかし、だ。
lines.translated: Normally, doing that would be the most straightforward solution... however.

lines.content: そうするためには、あんまりにここは遠すぎるんだ
lines.translated: "To do that, this place is just far too distant."

lines.content: 変えたい“未来”は“[ここ|過去]”よりも何十年も先の[話|時間]だ。
lines.translated: The "future" he wants to change is a time decades ahead of the "past."

lines.content: こんなに遠く離れてしまっていては、[・|そ][・|こ]に働きかけることは容易ではなく難しいし……。
lines.translated: Separated by such a vast distance, trying to influence that time is far from easy, and...

lines.content: 問題は、それだけではない。
lines.translated: That isn't the only problem.

lines.content: たとえばあさひさん達に、これから何十年後の“未来”の世界で残酷な運命が待っている。だからお願い、気をつけて……。そういうふうに助言をしたとしても
lines.translated: "For example, even if I were to give Asahi-san and the others advice like, 'A cruel fate awaits you in the world of the "future" decades from now. So please, be careful...'"

lines.content: 本当に[・|そ][・|れ]で“未来”が変わったのか。確かめるだけの方法だってないのだ。
lines.translated: Did the "future" really change because of that? There isn't even a way to verify it.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの列車はあらゆる時代から、世界を救うことができるだろう“悲しみ”を持つ子らの元へと行けるだけ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's train can only travel to children across all eras who possess the "sorrow" capable of saving the world.

lines.content: 狙い澄ましたように特定の“未来”や“過去”へ行けるわけではなかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't as if it could pinpoint and travel to a specific "future" or "past."

lines.content: だから“魔法”が必要だ。
lines.translated: That's why "magic" is necessary.

lines.content: ふたりのことを確実に助けられるだけの、“[魔法|奇跡]”の力が
lines.translated: "The power of a 'miracle' strong enough to save the two of them for sure."

lines.content: でも、その“魔法”を得るための“想像力”が足りなかった。あんまりにも。
lines.translated: However, he lacked the "imagination" to obtain that "magic." Far too much so.

lines.content: 自業自得だよ
lines.translated: "I brought this on myself."

lines.content: ……じごー？
lines.translated: "...Brought this on?"

lines.content: 全部自分のせいだってこと
lines.translated: "It means it's all my own fault."

lines.content: 大雅は、首をかしげた私に微笑みかけている。
lines.translated: Taiga is smiling at me as I tilt my head.

lines.content: まるで奏大雅がいつも、ましろに……そして世界中の誰もに対して、そうしていたみたいに。
lines.translated: Just like Kanade Taiga always used to do toward Mashiro... and toward everyone else in the world.

lines.content: “心”だなんて眩しいもの、遠い昔に……ううん。遠い未来に置いてきたんだ
lines.translated: "Something as dazzling as a 'heart,' I left it behind in the distant past... no. In the distant future."

lines.content: 俺には自分自身なんてないんだよ。だからこうして“誰か”の真似をするしか、上手に世界と関わっていけない
lines.translated: "I don't have a 'self' of my own. That's why I can only interact well with the world by imitating 'someone' like this."
I was abandoned by someone precious to me.

lines.content: たったそれだけのつらいことから逃げ出すために、自ら、そうした――こんなにつらくてさみしいばかりなら、“心”なんて要らないと、思った。
lines.translated: In order to run away from a painful thing no greater than that, I did it to myself--thinking that if it was only going to be this painful and lonely, I didn't need something like a "heart."

lines.content: だから“想像する力”も同時に投げ捨て、失ったのだ。
lines.translated: And so, at the same time, he threw away and lost the "power to imagine."

lines.content: 自分で不要だと捨て去ったものが、突然必要になってしまって、こうして頭を抱えてる……後悔してる。本当に都合が良すぎる。自分でもつくづくそう思うよ
lines.translated: "Something I threw away because I deemed it unnecessary has suddenly become necessary, and now I'm holding my head in my hands like this... regretting it. It's truly way too convenient of me. Even I keenly think so."

lines.content: 大雅は自嘲する。
lines.translated: Taiga laughs in self-derision.

lines.content: どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder why.

lines.content: 大雅は、何もおかしなことなんて言っていないはずなのに……わからない。
lines.translated: Taiga shouldn't be saying anything strange at all, and yet... I don't understand.

lines.content: わたしには、大雅が何を考えてるのかわからない。
lines.translated: I don't understand what Taiga is thinking.

lines.content: 手を伸ばせば、簡単に届く。
lines.translated: If I reached out my hand, I could easily touch him.

lines.content: それほど近くにいるはずなのに……。
lines.translated: He should be right here, so close to me, and yet...

lines.content: それなのにきみが笑顔を見せてくれるその度に、どんどんと少しずつ、手の届かない遠いところへ離れていってしまっているように感じてしまう。
lines.translated: Every time you show me that smile, I feel like you're drifting further and further away, little by little, to a distant place beyond my reach.

lines.content: だからわたしは、その手をしっかり握りしめるみたいにして、言うのだ。
lines.translated: So, as if squeezing that hand tightly, I speak up.

lines.content: ……だったら
うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……だったら、ね。大雅。一緒だったら、どうなのかな
lines.translated: "...Then, hey, Taiga. What if we did it together?"

lines.content: 一緒？
lines.translated: "Together?"

lines.content: うん、そう……
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right..."

lines.content: ひとりじゃできないことでも、ふたりで一緒になら、できるかも
lines.translated: "Even if it's something you can't do alone, maybe we can do it if the two of us are together."

lines.content: わたしは、心も頭も足りない子だから
lines.translated: "Because I'm a girl who's lacking in both heart and brains."

lines.content: “魔法”に変えられるくらいの“想像力”は、とてもじゃないけど持ってはいない。
lines.translated: There is no way I possess enough "imagination" to turn into "magic."

lines.content: だから大雅と、わたし。ふたり合わせてやっと、一人前くらいにはなれる……かも、しれないよ
lines.translated: "So with you and me, Taiga... if we put the two of us together, we might finally add up to one whole person... maybe."

lines.content: わたしがあさひから受け取った“役割”は、そのためにあるものだとわたしは信じたかった。大雅の“力”に“許可”を出す“役割”だ。
lines.translated: I wanted to believe that the "role" I received from Asahi existed for that very purpose. The "role" to grant "permission" to Taiga's "power."

lines.content: 勇気を出して提案してみたわたしのことを、大雅はじっと見つめて、
lines.translated: Taiga stared intently at me as I mustered my courage to make the suggestion,

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 微かにうなずき、わたしに言った。微笑んで。
lines.translated: nodded faintly, and spoke to me with a smile.

lines.content: 一緒に考えよう
lines.translated: "Let's think about it together."

lines.content: ……クロ。君が“それなら大丈夫だ”って、そう思えるものを“想像”できるように、がんばるよ。時間はいっぱいかかってしまうかもしれないけれど
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I'll do my best to 'imagine' something that'll make you think, 'If it's like that, it'll be okay.' Though it might take a whole lot of time."

lines.content: だからクロも、協力してくれたらうれしいな
lines.translated: "So I'd be happy if you helped me out too, Kuro."

lines.content: その言葉は奏大雅として言ったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Did he say those words as Kanade Taiga?

lines.content: それとも……。
lines.translated: Or perhaps...

lines.content: 名もない“[ぼく|誰か]”として、口にしたものなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Or did he speak them as that nameless "someone"?

lines.content: どうしてもそういうふうに考えてしまう。
lines.translated: No matter what, I end up thinking that way.

lines.content: そんな自分が、堪らなく嫌だった。
lines.translated: I hated myself unbearably for being like that.

lines.content: ……いくつもの時間が過ぎ去った。
lines.translated: So much time passed by.

lines.content: 十年だ。
lines.translated: Ten years.

lines.content: わたし達の“願い”には何の進展もない。
lines.translated: There has been no progress at all toward our "wish."

lines.content: ふたり一緒ならどうかな、必要なもの全部、一緒なら“想像”することできないかな。そう言ってみたはいいけれど……。
lines.translated: "What if the two of us are together? Couldn't we 'imagine' everything we need if we're together?" It was all well and good that I tried saying that, but...

lines.content: ……そんな“約束”も、わたしには守れない
lines.translated: "...I can't even keep a 'promise' like that."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでそうつぶやく。
lines.translated: All alone, I mutter those words.

lines.content: 時計の音ばかりがする部屋だ。
lines.translated: It is a room filled only with the ticking of a clock.

lines.content: この十年。
lines.translated: For these ten years.

lines.content: 満月輝く静かな夜に、強い睡魔に誘われてしまっては、わたしはきみより少し先の“未来”へ跳んで……。
lines.translated: On quiet nights when the full moon shines bright, whenever I'm lured into a deep drowsiness, I leap into a "future" slightly ahead of you...

lines.content: また、わたしの知ってるきみに会えますようにと願いを込めて、この小さな部屋で時間の歩みを固定し、きみの生きてる時間が[・|こ][・|こ]に追いついてくれるまで、静かに待って……。
lines.translated: Then, praying that I'll be able to meet the you I know once again, I fix the passage of time in this small room, waiting quietly until the time you live in catches up to right here...

lines.content: 殆どその繰り返しだけで過ぎていく時間だった。
lines.translated: It was time spent doing almost nothing but repeating that cycle over and over.

lines.content: ひとりだ。
lines.translated: I am alone.

lines.content: 十年経ってもわたしはひとり、この部屋から、“過去”のきみへと電話を掛けるだけの毎日を、過ごしてる。
lines.translated: Even after ten years, I am alone, spending every day doing nothing but making phone calls from this room to the you in the "past."

lines.content: 『遅くなって、ごめん。クロ。君の力を制御するための“道具”だ。やっと、完成したよ』
lines.translated: "Sorry it took so long, Kuro. This is a 'tool' to control your power. It's finally finished."

lines.content: わたしの時間に追いついたあさひが、わたしに小さな鈴をひとつ、渡してくれた――これをいつも身につけていれば、手当たり次第に“不幸”を肩代わりするようなことはないという。
lines.translated: Asahi, having caught up to my time, handed me a single small bell--saying that as long as I wore it at all times, I wouldn't end up taking on "misfortune" indiscriminately.

lines.content: ……たとえば。
lines.translated: For example.

lines.content: 大雅と一緒に“病”に呑まれていた柊ハル。彼女に感染した“病”も引き受けたように。
lines.translated: Just like how I took on the "illness" that had infected Hiiragi Haru, who was being swallowed up by it right alongside Taiga.

lines.content: そのことに後悔はもちろんないけど……。
lines.translated: Of course, I have no regrets about doing that, but...

lines.content: わたしの“力”はあくまでも、“大切に想う人に降りかかる不幸を肩代わりする”、というものだ。
lines.translated: My "power" is strictly to "take on the misfortune that befalls someone I hold dear."

lines.content: あのときみたいに、大雅と関係している人たち全員の“不幸”を、今後も手当たり次第に肩代わりしていたら、いくらわたしに[・|い][・|っ][・|ぱ][・|い][・|命][・|が][・|あ][・|っ][・|て][・|も]追いつかない。
lines.translated: If I kept indiscriminately taking on the "misfortune" of everyone connected to Taiga from here on out just like I did back then, no matter how many lives I have, I wouldn't be able to keep up.

lines.content: 『“力”を使いこなせるようになるまでは、肌身離さず身につけているんだぞ。そうすればこの“鈴”が君を、君の“力”から護ってくれる』
lines.translated: "Keep it on you at all times until you learn to master your 'power.' If you do that, this 'bell' will protect you from your own 'power.'"

lines.content: “魔法使い”にありがとうとわたしは言い、その鈴を受け取った。
lines.translated: I said thank you to the "magician" and accepted the bell.

lines.content: 首輪の鈴と取り替える。
lines.translated: I swapped it with the bell on my collar.

lines.content: ……でも。この首輪があったとしても、わたしの受け取った“病気”がよくなるわけじゃない
lines.translated: "...Still. Even with this collar, it doesn't mean the 'illness' I took on is going to get any better."

lines.content: だからこうして、わたしはきみのそばにいられずひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: That's why I can't be by your side, and why I'm all alone like this.

lines.content: 少しずつ。
lines.translated: Little by little.

lines.content: ……すこしずつ。
lines.translated: Little by little.

lines.content: でも確実に大きく育っていくきみのことを、そばで見守ることもわたしにはできない。
lines.translated: I can't even stay by your side and watch over you as you steadily grow bigger.

lines.content: あっという間だった。
lines.translated: It happened in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: ……あっという間に、きみは大きくなっていっちゃうから
lines.translated: "...Because you grow up in the blink of an eye."

lines.content: たぶん、大雅は成長期というやつだ。
lines.translated: Taiga is probably going through what they call a growth spurt.

lines.content: 少し長めに時間を飛び越え、再び会えたそのときは、まるで――まるで別人みたいに大きくなってることも何度かあった。
lines.translated: There were several times when I leaped a bit further ahead in time, and when we met again, he had grown so much he looked like--like a completely different person.

lines.content: ……背も、わたしより小さかったのに、いつの間にか越されちゃってたし
lines.translated: "...You used to be shorter than me, too, and before I knew it, you'd already passed me by."

lines.content: いつの間にか変わってしまっているのは、大雅の成長具合だけではない。
lines.translated: Taiga's physical growth isn't the only thing that has changed before I knew it.

lines.content: なんだか、おかしい
lines.translated: "Something feels strange."

lines.content: この頃は大雅の目を真っ直ぐに見つめることができなくなっていた。電話越しでなければ素直に話すこともできなくなった。
lines.translated: Lately, I haven't been able to look Taiga straight in the eye. Unless it's over the phone, I can't even speak honestly with him anymore.

lines.content: ……顔を合わせるとなんだか変な気持ちにもなる。
lines.translated: Whenever we're face-to-face, I get a strange feeling inside.

lines.content: 変わったのは大雅の“成長”だけじゃない。わたしの心も何かが変わった。
lines.translated: Taiga's "growth" isn't the only thing that changed. Something in my own heart has changed, too.

lines.content: 大雅はお友だちを作って楽しそうに見える。でもわたしは、今もこうしてひとりぼっちで……。
lines.translated: Taiga has made friends, and he looks like he's having fun. Meanwhile, I'm still all alone like this...

lines.content: たぶん、わたしは嫉妬してるんだろうなと感じる。
lines.translated: I feel like I'm probably just jealous.

lines.content: わたしはさみしがり屋で、泣き虫で……
lines.translated: "I get lonely so easily, and I'm such a crybaby..."

lines.content: 思い通りにならないと、すぐに拗ねちゃうようないやな子だ。
lines.translated: I'm an unpleasant girl who immediately sulks whenever things don't go her way.

lines.content: そんな自分に、生きていると少しずつ、気づいていって――生きることは苦しいことばっかりだ。そう感じてばかりいる。
lines.translated: As I keep on living, I realize those things about myself little by little--and I can't help but feel that living is full of nothing but pain.

lines.content: 根拠はないけど……
lines.translated: "I didn't have any basis for it, though..."

lines.content: もう少し、自分はいい子だと思ってた。
lines.translated: I thought I was a slightly better girl than this.

lines.content: 大雅の“夢”が叶いますように。
lines.translated: May Taiga's "dream" come true.

lines.content: たったそれだけ、純粋に願い続けていけるのだと信じてたのに……。
lines.translated: I believed I could go on purely wishing for that and nothing else, yet...

lines.content: 『先に“代償”を決めたよ』
lines.translated: "I decided on the 'price' first."

lines.content: ……久しぶりに会った大雅はわたしに言った。
lines.translated: Meeting me for the first time in a while, Taiga told me that.

lines.content: 『“魔法”のほうはまだ、どういうふうに“想像”すればいいのかわからないままだけど……』
lines.translated: "I still don't know how I should 'imagine' the 'magic' part, though..."

lines.content: 『これから俺が、どんな“魔法”を願ったとしても釣り合うような。そんな“代償”になったと思う』
lines.translated: "I think it's become the kind of 'price' that will balance out no matter what kind of 'magic' I wish for from here on."

lines.content: それは、なに？
lines.translated: What is it?

lines.content: そう問いかけるわたしに、大雅は言った。微笑みながら。
lines.translated: When I asked him that, Taiga answered with a smile.

lines.content: 『みんなが“願い”を……、柊ハルが。杏藤千和が。夜月姫織が……。その“夢”を、叶えるための手伝いをする』
lines.translated: "Everyone's 'wishes'... Hiiragi Haru's. Andou Chiwa's. Yotsuki Himeori's... I'm going to help them make their 'dreams' come true."

lines.content: 大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Taiga says.

lines.content: 『“魔法少女『使い』”としてそういう“役割”を生きること――それが俺の“代償”だ』
lines.translated: "Living out that 'role' as a 'Magical Girl "Handler"'--that is my 'price.'"

lines.content: “代償”だなんて言い方は乱暴だろう。だがここだけではあえてそう呼ぶ。
lines.translated: Calling it a "price" might sound rough. However, just for now, I will dare to call it that.

lines.content: 『あさひさんと話してそう決めたんだ。……クロ。君のいないところで勝手に話を進めて、ごめんね』
lines.translated: "I talked it over with Asahi-san and decided on it. ...Kuro. Sorry for pushing the conversation forward on my own while you weren't around."

lines.content: 『……ううん』
大丈夫だよと、言っておきながら……。
lines.translated: Even as I told him it was okay...

lines.content: わたしは心の中で、頬を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Inside my heart, I was pouting.

lines.content: 人間は同じ人間相手にしか、悩み事だったりを相談したりしないイキモノだ……それなのに。
lines.translated: Humans are creatures who only talk about their troubles with other humans... and yet.

lines.content: ……あさひもわたしと同じ猫なのに、あさひには、秘密の話をするんだね
lines.translated: "...Even though Asahi is a cat just like me, you share your secret talks with her."

lines.content: そういうふうにふて腐れてしまってる。
lines.translated: I end up sulking like that.

lines.content: ……わたしには、全然頼ってくれないのに。あさひのことはなんだかすごく、大雅……信じてるように見える
lines.translated: "...Even though you never rely on me at all. When it comes to Asahi, Taiga... it looks like you really trust her."

lines.content: そういうふうに、嫉妬してしまってる。
lines.translated: I end up getting jealous like that.

lines.content: こんないやな自分に一つひとつ、気づいていくことがつらいから……。
lines.translated: Because noticing these unpleasant parts of myself one by one is so painful...

lines.content: これからは、あんまり嫉妬したりしないよう、さみしく思ったりもしないよう、大雅のことは遠くから……。
lines.translated: From now on, so that I won't get too jealous, and so that I won't feel too lonely, I'll watch over Taiga from afar...

lines.content: でも同時に、とても近くから見守っていこうと決めた――いつも“隣”にはいられなくとも、どんなに離れていても、電話で話せる。
lines.translated: Yet at the same time, I decided to watch over him from very close by--because even if I can't always be right "next" to him, no matter how far apart we are, we can still talk on the phone.

lines.content: それだけでも……、大雅に何か“悪いこと”が起きたとしても、全部、わたしが肩代わりすることができるから
lines.translated: "Even with just that... even if something 'bad' happens to Taiga, I'll be able to take it all on in his place."

lines.content: だけどそれもやっぱりすごく、さみしい……。
lines.translated: Even so, that still makes me feel terribly lonely...

lines.content: どうしたらいいのか。どう、したいのか。自分でもわからない。
lines.translated: What should I do? What do I want to do? I don't even know myself.

lines.content: 人の姿になってからこの胸の中に、小さくとも“心”が芽生えたように感じてる。
lines.translated: Ever since I took on a human form, I feel as though a "heart," however small, has sprouted inside my chest.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: 名前を呼んでみる。
lines.translated: I try calling out his name.

lines.content: それはきみの本当の名前ではない。だから、こうして口にすると複雑な気持ちにはなるけれど……。
lines.translated: It isn't your real name. So saying it out loud like this gives me complicated feelings, though...

lines.content: 何でかな。
lines.translated: I wonder why.

lines.content: ……苦しい。
lines.translated: It hurts.

lines.content: どうであれきみを思うと、うれしさと、つらさと、さみしさで、いつも胸が苦しいよ。
lines.translated: No matter what, whenever I think of you, my chest always aches with happiness, pain, and loneliness.

lines.content: 人の姿になればきみと話せると思った。同じような言葉で、同じような“心”を持てると思ってた。
lines.translated: I thought that if I took on a human form, I'd be able to talk with you. I thought we'd be able to use the same words and have the same kind of "heart."

lines.content: そうすればもっときみの近くにいられるようになるんじゃないかと、思っていた。
lines.translated: I thought that if I did that, I might be able to get even closer to you.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……こんなことなら……こんなに、つらいのなら、“心”なんていらなかった
lines.translated: "...If it was going to be like this... if it was going to hurt this much, I never wanted a 'heart' at all."

lines.content: ついそんな弱い気持ちがこぼれてしまう。
lines.translated: Weak feelings like that end up spilling out despite myself.

lines.content: 人間は、すごい。
lines.translated: Humans are amazing.

lines.content: 人間は誰もがみんな、こんな思うとおりにならない“心”を、思うとおりに操って生きてるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Do all humans live their lives manipulating a "heart" that refuses to do as they wish, making it bend to their will?

lines.content: つらくてもさみしくても、まるでそうじゃないフリをして、生きていける“イキモノ”なんだろうか。
lines.translated: Are they "creatures" who can go on living while pretending everything is fine, even when they're in pain or lonely?

lines.content: もしもそうなら、本当にすごい。
lines.translated: If so, that really is amazing.

lines.content: そうできるようになることが、“大人”になるってことなのかな……。ねえ、大雅。どう思う？
lines.translated: "Is learning how to do that what it means to become an 'adult'...? Hey, Taiga. What do you think?"

lines.content: 握りしめた黒い電話の受話器に、まだ誰にも繋がっていないのに、そっと、問いかけてみる。
lines.translated: Even though it isn't connected to anyone yet, I gently ask the black telephone receiver I'm clutching so tightly.

lines.content: ……大雅。もしも“夢”を叶えられたら。そこから先は、どうするの？
lines.translated: "...Taiga. If you manage to make your 'dream' come true... what are you going to do after that?"

lines.content: ひとつ困難なことを乗り越えられたからといって、きれいなだけが取り柄みたいな物語みたいに、そこで終わりにはならないはずだ。
lines.translated: Just because you overcome one difficult hurdle doesn't mean everything ends right there, like some story whose only merit is being pretty.

lines.content: それくらいは、わたしにもわかる。
lines.translated: Even I understand that much.

lines.content: わたし達の生きていく時間は、この命が終わるまで続いていく。
lines.translated: The time we spend living goes on until our lives come to an end.

lines.content: 大雅は……。
lines.translated: As for Taiga...

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]に幸せな時間を届ける、という“夢”を叶えられたなら……。
lines.translated: If he manages to grant that "dream" of delivering happy times to those two...

lines.content: そこからどういうふうに生きていこうと考えているのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder how he plans to live his life from that point on.

lines.content: 今度こそ奏大雅ではない、本当の自分自身の人生を歩き始めるのかな……だったら。
lines.translated: Will he finally start walking his own true life, not as Kanade Taiga...? If so...

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: ……その時間の中に、わたし……わたしも、一緒にいていい？
lines.translated: "...Within that time, may I... may I be there with you, too?"

lines.content: そんなたった一言も言えないまま……。
lines.translated: Unable to say even those few simple words...

lines.content: わたしは。
いつも[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]、たったひとりで、見えない自分の“心”と戦ってばかりいた。
lines.translated: I was always like this, all alone, doing nothing but fighting against my own invisible "heart."
"--...Making everyone's 'dreams' come true."

lines.content: それが大雅の選んだ“代償”だった。
lines.translated: That was the "price" Taiga chose.

lines.content: ……“代償”だなんて。
lines.translated: A "price," of all things.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]をそう呼ぶのは確かに変だし、どうにも“心”がないように思えてしまうけど……。
lines.translated: Calling this that certainly sounds strange, and it makes it seem terribly lacking in "heart," yet...

lines.content: “心”のありかたなんてもの、人間ではないわたしには考えるだけ意味のないことだ。
lines.translated: The nature of a "heart" is something pointless for a non-human like me to even think about.

lines.content: とにかくそうすることが、大雅が“魔法”を使うために必要なものなのだと決めてしまったらしい――あさひから譲り受けた“役割”だ。
lines.translated: In any case, it seems he decided that doing so was what he needed in order to use "magic"--the "role" he inherited from Asahi.

lines.content: 陽向井あさひは少女らのことを“魔法少女”と呼んでは大切に扱った。
lines.translated: Himukai Asahi called the girls "Magical Girls" and treated them with great care.

lines.content: 大雅たち男の子には、少女らの心に秘められた“魔法”を使うための方法を、日々、学ばせているようだった――奏大雅と兎蛙智仁。
lines.translated: Day by day, she seemed to be having the boys learn how to use the "magic" hidden within the girls' hearts--Kanade Taiga and Towa Tomohito.

lines.content: そのどちらかに、“少女の形をした魔法”――“魔法少女”の“[心|想像力]”を操るための、“夜の魔法使い”としての“役割”を引き継がせようと考えているようで。
lines.translated: It seemed she was planning to have one of them inherit her "role" as a "Magician of the Night," in order to wield the "imagination"--the "hearts"--of the "Magical Girls," who were "magic in the shape of girls."

lines.content: 結果、それは大雅が選ばれる形となった。
lines.translated: In the end, it turned out that Taiga was chosen.

lines.content: その理由は兎蛙智仁が辞退したからだと、わたしは聞かされているけれど……。
lines.translated: I was told the reason was that Towa Tomohito declined, though...

lines.content: ともあれ、大雅は、あさひから受け取ったその“役割”で。
lines.translated: Regardless, through that "role" he received from Asahi, Taiga would...

lines.content: みんなの心の中に眠る“魔法”を使い……。
lines.translated: Use the "magic" sleeping within everyone's hearts...

lines.content: それぞれが諦めかけていた“夢”を[・|叶][・|え][・|さ][・|せ][・|る]のだ。
lines.translated: And make the "dreams" they had each nearly given up on come true.

lines.content: ……十年前に叶えることができなかったのだろうその“夢”を。
lines.translated: Those "dreams" they probably couldn't fulfill ten years ago.

lines.content: だけど、[・|そ][・|う][・|す][・|る]のは、大雅が自身に課した“代償”だからとは、むろん、本人たちには言えるはずもない。
lines.translated: However, it goes without saying that he could never tell the girls themselves that he was doing this because it was a "price" he had imposed upon himself.

lines.content: 三人同時に[・|そ][・|う][・|す][・|る]ことも不可能だ――彼女らをまるで自身の“[魔法|道具]”として使うにしても、彼女らの“魔法”を使うにしても、今以上の“関係性”を築かねばならないからだ。
lines.translated: Doing so for all three of them at the same time was also impossible--because whether he was going to use them as his own "tools"--his "magic"--or use their "magic," he had to build a deeper "relationship" with them than what they had now.

lines.content: まずは柊ハルの“魔法”から使っていこう。彼女の“夢”を、叶えよう。
lines.translated: First, let's start by using Hiiragi Haru's "magic." Let's make her "dream" come true.

lines.content: 『そのために、クロ。力を貸してくれるかな』
lines.translated: "For that sake, Kuro... Will you lend me your strength?"

lines.content: ある日の電話で、大雅がわたしにそう言った。
lines.translated: On the phone one day, Taiga said that to me.

lines.content: 『ハルだけじゃない』
lines.translated: "It's not just Haru."

lines.content: 『千和や姫織の“夢”を叶えるために、俺は、その度に何か……必要な“魔法”を“想像”し、“夜”の外で使用しなくちゃならないこともあるかもしれない』
lines.translated: "In order to make Chiwa's and Himeori's 'dreams' come true, each time, I might have to 'imagine' whatever 'magic' is needed and use it outside of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 『だけど俺は、クロの“許可”がなければ“魔法”を使えない――たとえそれが俺自身の“夢”や“願い”を叶えるための“最後の魔法”であろうと、[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|な][・|か][・|ろ][・|う][・|と]』
lines.translated: "But I can't use 'magic' without your 'permission,' Kuro--whether it's the 'final magic' to grant my own 'dream' and 'wish,' or whether it isn't."

lines.content: だから力を貸してほしいんだ、と繰り返し、囁くように言う大雅に、
lines.translated: As Taiga repeated in a whisper that he wanted me to lend him my strength,

lines.content: うん。わかった……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Got it..."

lines.content: と、そのときのわたしは、うなずいただろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think the me back then must have nodded in reply.

lines.content: まず、最初に。ハルの“魔法”を使って、ハルの“夢”を叶えよう……
lines.translated: "First of all... Let's use Haru's 'magic' and make Haru's 'dream' come true..."

lines.content: 大雅の“魔法”に“許可”を出す――そんな“役割”を持たされていたわたしは、大雅の提案に、ただうなずいたのだ。
lines.translated: Having been given the "role" of granting "permission" for Taiga's "magic," I simply nodded at his proposal.

lines.content: 考えることは苦手だ。
lines.translated: I'm not good at thinking.

lines.content: だから順番とか、計画とか。そういうのは全部大雅に任せてた。
lines.translated: So the order of things, the plans, and all of that--I left everything to Taiga.

lines.content: わたしはただ、大雅が決めた[・|そ][・|れ]が安全かどうかだけ判断できればいい。
lines.translated: All I needed to do was judge whether what Taiga decided on was safe or not.

lines.content: 少し先の“未来”ではなく、大雅と同じ時間にいられるそのときは、[・|こ][・|こ]から大雅に電話をかけていた――
lines.translated: During those times when I wasn't in a slightly distant "future" and could exist in the same time as Taiga, I would call him from right here--

lines.content: 大雅の部屋として利用されるようになった調整室。その扉に背中をぴったり付けて。
lines.translated: Pressing my back flat against the door of the control room that had come to be used as Taiga's room.

lines.content: 面と向かって話すと、また思い通りにならない“心”が暴れて、痛いから。
lines.translated: Because if we talk face-to-face, my unruly "heart" will lash out again, and it hurts.

lines.content: 『……最近、おかしいんだ。前ほど昔のことを思い出せなくなってる』
lines.translated: "...Something's been strange lately. I can't remember the past as well as I used to."

lines.content: ……大雅は焦っているように感じた。
lines.translated: I felt as though Taiga was growing impatient.

lines.content: 『俺もみんなと同じように、心が大人になりはじめてるのかもしれない。……日に日にましろの記憶が薄くなっていってるように感じるんだ』
lines.translated: "Maybe my heart is starting to become an adult's, just like everyone else's. ...Day by day, I feel like my memories of Mashiro are fading away."

lines.content: 大雅は、みんなとは――柊ハルや杏藤千和、夜月姫織、兎蛙智仁よりもほんとは[・|年][・|下][・|だ]。だから幼馴染みのみんなよりも長く、“夜の国”に出入りできている。
lines.translated: In truth, Taiga is younger than everyone else--younger than Hiiragi Haru, Andou Chiwa, Yotsuki Himeori, and Towa Tomohito. That is why he has been able to go in and out of the "Night Realm" longer than all of his childhood friends.

lines.content: “大人になる”というのは、単純に肉体年齢を指すものではないだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: "Becoming an adult" probably doesn't simply refer to one's physical age, though...

lines.content: ともかく今は、奏大雅の名前だけでなく、その年齢も彼と同じものを語っているだけだ。大雅がかわいいのは、幼いからということも、ある。
lines.translated: In any case, right now, he is merely claiming the same age as Kanade Taiga, not just his name. Part of the reason Taiga is so cute is because he is still so young.

lines.content: 『ハルが町に帰ってくるまで、ましろのことを……、大雅のことを忘れてた――と、いうわけじゃあもちろんないけど』
lines.translated: "Until Haru came back to town, it's not like I had forgotten about Mashiro... or about Taiga, of course."

lines.content: 『でも、問題を先送りにしていたというか。どこか、なあなあに引き延ばしてきてたような気もしてる』
lines.translated: "But I feel like I was putting the problem off... or rather, somehow dragging my feet and letting things slide."

lines.content: それは、たぶん……と大雅は言う。
lines.translated: That's probably because... Taiga says.

lines.content: 『たぶん、みんなと過ごす毎日が、多少なりとも楽しかったからだろうと思う』
lines.translated: "I think it's probably because the days I spent with everyone were, to some extent, fun."

lines.content: 『だからもう、このままでもいいんじゃないか。このままこの時代で、奏大雅として、生きていくのも悪くないんじゃないか。そんなことを心のどこかで考えてしまってたのかもしれない』
lines.translated: "So maybe things were fine just the way they were. Maybe living on like this in this era, as Kanade Taiga, wouldn't be so bad. I might have been thinking something like that somewhere in my heart."

lines.content: 『……そんなことを考える権利なんて。おかしいよね……。俺にはまったくありはしないのに。それなのにふとそんな“もしも”を考えてしまう自分のことが……』
lines.translated: "...As if I have the right to think like that. It's ridiculous, isn't it...? I don't have that right at all. And yet, the fact that I find myself entertaining those 'what ifs'..."

lines.content: 少し、怖い。
lines.translated: It's a little scary.

lines.content: と、大雅は小さく言ったように聞こえた。
lines.translated: It sounded like Taiga said that in a quiet voice.

lines.content: 俺は彼の存在を乗っ取ろうとでもしているみたいで、怖い、と。
lines.translated: It's scary because it feels like I'm trying to hijack his very existence, he said.

lines.content: 『だって俺は、奏大雅じゃないどころか、誰でもないただのまっしろ、なんだから』
lines.translated: "Because far from being Kanade Taiga, I'm nobody at all--just a blank, pure white."

lines.content: 大雅の感じてる怖さを、すべてわかった顔はできない。
lines.translated: I can't pretend to understand all of the fear Taiga is feeling.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: やるべきことと決めた目的を、大雅の言うように引き延ばしにしてしまっていたのは仕方がないことだと、わたしは感じる。
lines.translated: Still, I feel that it couldn't be helped that he ended up putting off the purpose he had decided he must fulfill, just as he said.

lines.content: 大雅が“魔法”を得るため、自身に設定した“[条件|代償]”は……。
lines.translated: The "price"--the "condition"--Taiga set for himself in order to obtain "magic" is...

lines.content: 柊ハルたちみんなが今なお、十年前の戦いの果てに得た“魔法”の使い道に迷い、叶えきれずにいるその“夢”を叶えること――そのための手伝いをすることだ。
lines.translated: To make the "dreams" come true that Hiiragi Haru and the others have still been unable to fulfill, lost as to how to use the "magic" they obtained at the end of the battle ten years ago--to help them achieve that.

lines.content: 『そういうふうに自分の人生を、自分以外の“誰か”のために消費すること――そうして消費された時間分を、蘇らせたい人へ、残りの寿命の一部として差し出せる』
lines.translated: "Consuming my own life for the sake of 'someone' other than myself like that--I can offer up the amount of time consumed that way as a portion of my remaining lifespan to the person I want to bring back to life."

lines.content: 『それが、あのひと達の奪われた人生を……時間を、返すことになるんじゃないか』
lines.translated: "Wouldn't that mean returning the stolen lives... the stolen time, of those people?"

lines.content: 『そんな稚拙な“想い”が形になったのが、この“代償”なんだ』
lines.translated: "This 'price' is that childish 'feeling' given form."

lines.content: 『ハルが“参禅町”に帰ってくるまで、俺、この目的を曖昧にしてしまってたんだ……どこかで、忘れようとしてたのかもしれない』
lines.translated: "Until Haru came back to 'Sanzen Town,' I had let that purpose grow vague... Somewhere inside, I might have been trying to forget it."

lines.content: ごめん。……大雅。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. ...Taiga.

lines.content: 今、きみが思い悩んでいるのに、こんなことを感じてしまうのは、本当に身勝手なんだろうとも思うけど……。
lines.translated: I think it's truly selfish of me to feel this way when you're so troubled right now, yet...

lines.content: そんな“心”を、わたしにも話してくれたことがうれしかった。
lines.translated: I was happy that you shared that "heart" of yours with me, too.

lines.content: でもそれは、仕方がないよ。……大雅
lines.translated: "But that couldn't be helped. ...Taiga."

lines.content: うれしかったから――だから少しでも“勇気”に変わる言葉を、きみに伝えられたらと思い、足りない頭を精一杯働かせようとしていた。
lines.translated: Because I was happy--I tried to work my lacking brain as hard as I could, hoping to convey words to you that would turn into even the slightest bit of "courage."

lines.content: ……みんなの“夢”を叶えるための“役割”は、大雅が[・|今][・|年]の誕生日を迎えるまでは、あさひからもらえていなかった。……だから
lines.translated: "...You weren't given the 'role' to make everyone's 'dreams' come true by Asahi until you reached this year's birthday, Taiga. ...So..."

lines.content: 仕方がない――あんまり自分を責めないでと、わたしはそう言いたかったのだ。
lines.translated: It couldn't be helped--don't blame yourself so much. That was what I wanted to say.

lines.content: そんなわたしの励ましで、大雅の不安も焦りも、解消できるとは思えないけど……。
lines.translated: I don't think encouragement from someone like me could dissolve Taiga's anxiety or impatience, though...
Do I really even have the right to do something like that?

lines.content: “心”を理解していく度に、そんな言葉がわたしの中に産まれては、真っ黒な痛みを残していくけど……。
lines.translated: Every time I come to understand a "heart" a little better, words like that are born inside me, leaving behind a pitch-black pain...

lines.content: それでも懸命に、たどたどしい言葉でわたしは大雅に気持ちを伝えたのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I tried desperately to convey my feelings to Taiga in my halting, clumsy words.

lines.content: ……このまま。
lines.translated: Just like this.

lines.content: （このまま、ましろのことを忘れてしまったほうが……、大雅にとっては幸せなんじゃないかな）
lines.translated: (Wouldn't it be happier for Taiga... if he just forgot about Mashiro like this?)

lines.content: そんな言葉だけは決して、大雅に伝えられないままではあったけど……。
lines.translated: Those words alone, however, were something I could never, ever tell Taiga...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.
And that is precisely why, without telling Taiga, I searched for that girl and went to meet her.

lines.content: “お願い。大雅に、あなたの願いを叶えさせてあげてほしい”
lines.translated: "Please. I want you to let Taiga grant your wish."
