lines.content: あの子にそんなお願いを、するために。
lines.translated: In order to make that request of her.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: ひとりぼっちなわたしに、はじめてやさしい気持ちをくれた人。
lines.translated: The person who first gave me warm, gentle feelings when I was all alone.

lines.content: わたしはきみに、そのときもらったやさしさを返したい。
lines.translated: I want to return the kindness I received from you back then.
And by doing so, I want to be forgiven by myself.

lines.content: ……きみには、きみのことを大切に想ってくれる人が必要だと思う
lines.translated: "...I think you need someone who will cherish you."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちの部屋でつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured in the room where I was all alone.

lines.content: いつもいつも、飛び越えてしまった先の“未来”の中で、わたしはじっとひとりうずくまり、きみのことばかり考えている――そうだ。わたしは、きみが幸せならたならそれでいい。
lines.translated: Always, always, within the "future" I've leaped ahead into, I crouch all alone, motionless, thinking only of you--that's right. As long as you are happy, that is enough for me.

lines.content: 誰が間違えようのない正論で、きみを責め立てようともだ。
lines.translated: No matter who might blame you with indisputable logic.

lines.content: ましろも、奏大雅も。
lines.translated: Neither Mashiro nor Kanade Taiga...

lines.content: 確かに幸せな終わりを迎えられなかったけれど。
lines.translated: managed to reach a happy ending, that's true.

lines.content: でもそれはきみのせいなんかじゃない。あくまでもふたりの運命だったんだ。
lines.translated: But that isn't your fault at all. It was simply the fate of those two.

lines.content: だからきみはもうふたりのために生きようとなんかせず、きみ自身の幸せについて考えてほしいとわたしは願う。
lines.translated: So I wish you wouldn't try to live for their sakes anymore, and would think about your own happiness instead.

lines.content: 幸せという“心”をわたしは知らない。でも、それはひとりぼっちではない時間のことを言うのかもしれないとは、感じてる。
lines.translated: I don't know the "heart" called happiness. Still, I feel like it might refer to time spent not being all alone.

lines.content: だから……。大雅。
lines.translated: So... Taiga.

lines.content: きみの“未来”には、いつだって、きみのことだけを大切に想ってくれる人が必要だ。
lines.translated: In your "future," you will always need someone who cherishes only you.

lines.content: ……わたしみたいに、きみが大人になればさよならするようなひとじゃなくって。同じ時間を、同じ歩幅で、生きていける人が
lines.translated: "...Not someone like me, who has to say goodbye once you grow up. Someone who can live through the same time, at the same pace as you."

lines.content: ……わたしは自分の“心”に問いかけている。
lines.translated: I am questioning my own "heart."

lines.content: 柊ハルだ。
lines.translated: It's Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 彼女が大雅のことを“特別”に想っているのだと気づいたのは、いったい、どういう瞬間だっただろうか、と。
lines.translated: Just what kind of moment was it when I realized she thought of Taiga as someone "special"?

lines.content: その瞬間については思い出せない。
lines.translated: I can't remember the exact moment.

lines.content: だけど、そのとき感じた痛い気持ちは今でもずっと覚えてる。この胸の中に在り続けてる。
lines.translated: However, I still remember the painful feeling I had back then. It continues to remain inside my chest.

lines.content: きっとわたしは“[・|嫉][・|妬]”したのだ。
lines.translated: I must have felt "jealousy."

lines.content: もしハルの気持ちが大雅に届いて……
lines.translated: "If Haru's feelings reach Taiga..."

lines.content: そうしてはじまるふたりのこれからの時間が、幸せに色づいたのなら――ましろのことも、奏大雅のことも、そのまま忘れて、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は幸せに生きていけるかもしれない。
lines.translated: And if the time the two of them spend together from then on is colored with happiness--then maybe that boy could forget all about Mashiro and Kanade Taiga as things are, and live on happily.

lines.content: でも……
[・|ま][・|た]胸のあたりがずきりとした。
lines.translated: My chest throbbed with pain again.

lines.content: でも、わたしは[・|そ][・|こ]に……、いられない
lines.translated: "But I... can't be there."

lines.content: そうなることを願っているはずなのに、そうなることは絶対いやだと、わたしの“心”は感じてる――“心”にまっくろな何かが産まれた。
lines.translated: Even though I'm supposed to be wishing for that to happen, my "heart" feels that it absolutely hates the idea--something pitch-black was born in my "heart."

lines.content: “嫉妬”だ。
lines.translated: It's "jealousy."

lines.content: 想像上でしかないはずの“未来”なのに、心から祝福できない自分がいたのだ。
lines.translated: Even though it's a "future" that only exists in my imagination, there was a part of me that couldn't bless it from the bottom of my heart.

lines.content: ……まっくろだった。
lines.translated: It was pitch-black.

lines.content: まるで泥沼みたいにぐずぐずで、いやな気持ちだった――[・|一][・|緒][・|に][・|い][・|た][・|い]。
lines.translated: It was a sluggish, awful feeling, just like a bog--I want to be with him.

lines.content: 本当はずっと、大雅と生きていきたい。他の誰にも、大雅の“隣”を渡したくない。
lines.translated: The truth is, I want to live with Taiga forever. I don't want to hand the spot "beside" Taiga over to anyone else.

lines.content: そんな思いが心の中で、子どもみたいに暴れはじめる――……本当は。
lines.translated: Thoughts like that start thrashing around in my heart like a child--...The truth is.

lines.content: ……本当は大雅の幸せより、自分のことしかわたしは考えてないんじゃないのかな
lines.translated: "...The truth is, rather than Taiga's happiness, maybe I'm only thinking about myself."

lines.content: ため息と共にそう吐き出す。
lines.translated: I breathe those words out along with a sigh.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちだと考えても仕方のないことばかりを考えてしまう。
lines.translated: When I'm all alone, I end up thinking about nothing but things that can't be helped.

lines.content: そんな自分が嫌いだ。……大嫌い。
lines.translated: I hate myself for being like that. ...I despise it.

lines.content: わたしは、どこまでもまっくろだ。だから人の“心”を理解できない――だから、人の“心”に憧れた。
lines.translated: I am pitch-black through and through. That's why I can't understand a person's "heart"--and why I longed for a person's "heart."

lines.content: そんな視線で、大雅の周辺を見渡してみたときに――ごく自然と気づけたのかもしれない。ハルの気持ちに。
lines.translated: When I looked around Taiga with eyes like that--maybe I was able to notice it quite naturally. Haru's feelings.

lines.content: だからわたしは、ハルを探しに走った。
lines.translated: So I ran off in search of Haru.

lines.content: 大雅に、“夢”を叶えること以外の幸せを――ひとりぼっちではない時間を届けたいと、願い――走った。
lines.translated: Wishing to deliver a happiness to Taiga other than granting his "dream"--time spent not being all alone--I ran.

lines.content: ハルを探して。
lines.translated: Searching for Haru.

lines.content: 激しい睡魔に襲われながら。
lines.translated: While being assaulted by an intense drowsiness.

lines.content: それでも、走って……走り続けた。
lines.translated: Even so, I ran... and kept on running.

lines.content: ハル……。
lines.translated: Haru...

lines.content: ……あなたの“夢”が、どんなものだったのか、わたし達は知らないけれど……
lines.translated: "...We don't know what kind of 'dream' yours was, though..."

lines.content: 薄ら残った匂いを頼りに、やっと見つけたハルに、わたしは……、
lines.translated: To Haru, whom I finally found by relying on her faintly lingering scent, I...

lines.content: お願い。どうか大雅に、その“夢”を、叶えさせてあげて、ほしくって……その、だから……わたしは……
lines.translated: "Please. I want you to let Taiga grant that 'dream' of yours... Um, so... I..."

lines.content: ……殆ど懺悔するみたいな気持ちで、願ってた。
lines.translated: I pleaded with a feeling almost like making a confession of sins.

lines.content: ハルが大雅を、“夢”の呪縛から解き放ってくれるかもしれない――
lines.translated: Haru might be able to free Taiga from the curse of his "dream"--

lines.content: 誰かのためなんかじゃない、自分の幸せのために生きる。そういうあたらしい“夢”を、ハルが大雅に作ってくれるかもしれない。
lines.translated: To live not for someone else's sake, but for his own happiness. Haru might be able to create a new "dream" like that for Taiga.

lines.content: そんな“希望”と共に、“嫉妬”ばかりする自分の“心”を無理矢理にでも沈黙、させるため……。
lines.translated: Along with that "hope," in order to forcibly silence my own "heart" that does nothing but feel "jealousy"...

lines.content: 『大丈夫。安心して……とは、言い切れないかもだけど。でも、私に任せて。私の“魔法”が、きっと、大雅くんの助けになるはずだから』
lines.translated: "It's okay. Don't worry... Well, maybe I can't say that for sure. But leave it to me. Because my 'magic' will definitely be of help to Taiga-kun."

lines.content: そう言ってくれたハルにわたしは、大雅の“夢”と“希望”とを、託した。
lines.translated: To Haru, who told me that, I entrusted Taiga's "dream" and "hope."

lines.content: ハルに[・|お][・|願][・|い]したら、安心したのかもしれない
lines.translated: "Once I made my request to Haru, I might have felt relieved."

lines.content: わたしは気を失うようにして、少し、[・|眠][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: Almost as if passing out, I slept for a little while.

lines.content: 気づけばほんのちょっと先の“未来”の中だ。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was in a "future" just a little bit ahead.

lines.content: もしも……
lines.translated: "What if..."

lines.content: もしもハルが、わたしがお願いしたとおり、この町に帰ってきてくれたなら
lines.translated: "What if Haru returns to this town, just as I asked her to?"

lines.content: そのときは、大雅とハル、ふたりの“未来”をわたしの全部の力で応援しよう。そう決めた。
lines.translated: When that time comes, I will support the "future" of the two of them, Taiga and Haru, with all of my strength. That's what I decided.

lines.content: こんなこと……。もしも大雅が知ったなら、大雅は、怒るかもしれない。
lines.translated: Something like this... If Taiga were to find out, he might get angry.

lines.content: 裏切りも同じだ。
lines.translated: It's no different from a betrayal.

lines.content: だってわたしは、大雅の“夢”を応援するために、一緒に“未来”の世界からやって来たはずなのに……
lines.translated: "Because I was supposed to have come with him from the world of the 'future' in order to support Taiga's 'dream'..."

lines.content: それなのに応援するどころか、わたしは大雅の邪魔をしようとしている。
lines.translated: And yet, far from supporting him, I am trying to get in Taiga's way.

lines.content: でも、これが正しいと信じてるんだ。
lines.translated: Still, I believe this is the right thing to do.

lines.content: ……大雅は、ましろのことを忘れてしまったほうが幸せになれる
lines.translated: "...Taiga will be able to become happier if he forgets all about Mashiro."

lines.content: この時代で出会った人たちと、すべて忘れて……奏大雅として生きていくほうがいい。
lines.translated: It's better if he forgets everything, and lives on as Kanade Taiga with the people he met in this era.

lines.content: そしてわたしは……。
lines.translated: And as for me...

lines.content: わたしはね。大雅が歩き始めたあたらしい人生を、死ぬまでずっと……
lines.translated: "As for me... The new life Taiga has started walking, until the day I die, forever..."

lines.content: 見えない隣から、ずっと……、大雅に降りかかる“不幸”を、大きいものも小さいものもまるごと全部、わたしが肩代わりし続けて、生きていくよ
lines.translated: "From an unseen place beside him, forever... I will live on, continuing to take on all the 'misfortune' that befalls Taiga in his place, big and small, every single bit of it."

lines.content: そういう形で、大雅の、ふたりの人生を応援していく。それがわたし達の正しい[・|在][・|り][・|方]だ。そう信じてる。
lines.translated: In that way, I will support Taiga's life, the life of the two of them. That is the proper way for us to be. I believe that.

lines.content: そして大雅が、ハルの“魔法”を使ったそのときに……
lines.translated: "And the moment Taiga uses Haru's 'magic'..."

lines.content: ふたりの“未来”を全力で応援すると決めたわたしは、大雅の中からましろに関する記憶を、まるごと全部、大雅の“不幸”として受け取ることにした――わたしの“力”なら可能なはずだ。
lines.translated: Having decided to support their "future" with everything I have, I resolved to receive every single bit of the memories concerning Mashiro from inside Taiga as his "misfortune"--with my "power," it should be possible.

lines.content: あさひが作ってくれた“鈴”もある。
lines.translated: I also have the "bell" that Asahi made for me.

lines.content: きっとわたしは、わたしの“力”を[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]操れるはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely I should be able to manipulate my "power" in that way.

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ごめんね大雅。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Taiga.

lines.content: でも、[・|あ][・|の][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]だってきっとそれを望むよ。……大雅、きみには、きみ自身のために生きてほしいって
lines.translated: "But surely those two would wish for that as well. ...Taiga, they'd want you to live for your own sake."

lines.content: だから大雅は……[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は、忘れてしまうだろう。
lines.translated: So Taiga... that boy will probably end up forgetting.
Every time he talks with me on the phone, little by little.

lines.content: あの子が気づかないくらい、ゆっくりと。
lines.translated: So slowly that the boy won't even notice.

lines.content: ……そして、“最後の魔法”を使えばまた更に少しずつ、ましろのことを、自分の“夢”のことを。
lines.translated: And each time he uses the "Last Magic," he will forget a little bit more about Mashiro, and about his own "dream."

lines.content: “夜”に関することを。
lines.translated: About the things concerning the "Night."

lines.content: ……わたしのことを
lines.translated: "...And about me."

lines.content: 大雅は、忘れてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Taiga will end up forgetting.

lines.content: 胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: My chest ached.

lines.content: だめだ。痛い……。
lines.translated: No. It hurts...

lines.content: 助けて、大雅。
lines.translated: Help me, Taiga.

lines.content: 胸が。……心が。ずきずき、痛いよ。
lines.translated: My chest. ...My heart. It's throbbing, it hurts so much.

lines.content: 今までで一番大きな胸の痛みだった。
lines.translated: It was the biggest pain in my chest I had ever felt until now.

lines.content: 涙もこぼれる。
lines.translated: Tears spill over, too.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちじゃない時間を幸せというのなら、ずっとひとりでいると決めてしまったのなら、それはずっと不幸なままだということだ。
lines.translated: If time spent not being all alone is called happiness, then having decided to remain alone forever means remaining unhappy forever.

lines.content: わたしはふたりを影から応援すると決めた――わたしは、ひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: I decided to support the two of them from the shadows--I am all alone.

lines.content: でもそれでいい。それが、いいんだ。
lines.translated: But that's fine. That is how it should be.

lines.content: そう信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe that.

lines.content: 信じているから、わたしは立ち止まらない――大雅にましろを忘れさせる。あたらしい“夢”を見てほしい。
lines.translated: Because I believe it, I won't stop--I will make Taiga forget Mashiro. I want him to have a new "dream."

lines.content: その結果、もし大雅に、……きみに、本気で恨まれてしまったとしても。これが正しいのだとわたしは信じる。
lines.translated: Even if, as a result, Taiga... you end up truly hating me. I believe that this is right.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……だけどもしもハルが、帰ってこなかったら
lines.translated: "...However, what if Haru doesn't come back?"

lines.content: そのときは……。
lines.translated: When that time comes...

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: わたしはさくら色に染まった町に、その輝きに、目を細める。
lines.translated: I narrow my eyes at the town dyed the color of cherry blossoms, at its radiance.

lines.content: もしもハルが帰ってこなかったそのときは、わたしは、自分の気持ちを抑えられるだろうか。
lines.translated: If the time comes when Haru doesn't return, will I be able to hold back my own feelings?

lines.content: “大雅とずっと一緒に生きていたい”
lines.translated: "I want to live together with Taiga forever."
Even though someone pitch-black like me shouldn't have a right like that from the very beginning.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: ふと、通り抜けた春の風に乗せつぶやいてみる。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I try murmuring it upon the passing spring breeze.

lines.content: あまいの。苦いの。ちょっと、苦いの。どれがいい……？
lines.translated: "Sweet. Bitter. A little bitter. Which one would you like...?"

lines.content: 大雅に渡そうと思ったお誕生日のチョコレート。
lines.translated: The birthday chocolate I had thought about giving to Taiga.

lines.content: この日は本当にきみの産まれた日なのかな。わたしはきみのことが何もわからないし、これからも全部を知ることはないのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: I wonder if this day is really the day you were born. I don't know anything about you, and I probably won't ever know everything from here on out either, though...

lines.content: “産まれてきてくれて、ありがとう”――そんないっぱいの気持ちを込めて、わたしは、下手な字で大雅へ手紙を書いた。
lines.translated: "Thank you for being born"--pouring in so many feelings like that, I wrote a letter to Taiga in my clumsy handwriting.

lines.content: 面と向かって言うだなんて無理だった。
lines.translated: Saying it face-to-face was impossible.

lines.content: ……言えないよ。そんなこと。
lines.translated: I can't say it. Something like that.

lines.content: だってわたしはもう、立派な男の子に成長してしまったきみのことを、正面からじっと見つめることもできなくなってた。
lines.translated: Because I couldn't even look straight at you anymore, now that you've grown into such a fine young man.

lines.content: その気持ちの正体を、わたしは充分知っているようで、やっぱり何も知らないのだ。
lines.translated: Even though I feel like I know the true nature of that feeling well enough, in the end, I really don't know anything at all.

lines.content: だから、わたしは……。
lines.translated: And so, I...

lines.content: 大好きだよ……大雅
lines.translated: "I love you so much... Taiga."

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: この世界に産まれてきてくれて、本当に。本当に、ありがとう
lines.translated: "For being born into this world, truly. Truly, thank you."

lines.content: ……わたしは、たったひとりでそうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: All alone, I murmured those words.

lines.content: これからはこんなふうに、ひとりできみのことを想う時間ばかりが増えていく……。
lines.translated: From now on, the time I spend thinking of you all by myself like this is only going to keep increasing...

lines.content: そんな予感だけが膨らんでいた。
lines.translated: Only that premonition kept swelling inside me.

lines.content: ハルはわたしのお願いどおり、“参禅町”に帰ってきた。
lines.translated: Just as I had asked of her, Haru returned to "Sanzen-cho."

lines.content: ……うん。ありがとう、ハル
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Thank you, Haru."

lines.content: 小さな諦めと共に、わたしは小さくうなずいた。
lines.translated: Along with a small sense of resignation, I gave a slight nod.

lines.content: 特に、直接約束はしていなかった。でも、これからは……約束どおり、ふたりの未来をわたしの全部で、応援するね
lines.translated: "We didn't make any direct promise in particular. But from here on... just as promised, I'll cheer for the two of your futures with everything I have."

lines.content: ……諦め、だなんて。
lines.translated: Resignation, of all things.

lines.content: そんな言葉をわざわざ選ぶ“嫉妬”深い自分が嫌い。
lines.translated: I hate this deeply "jealous" side of myself that goes out of its way to choose a word like that.

lines.content: わたしは、まっくろ。
lines.translated: I am pitch-black.

lines.content: たぶんわたしは生涯、自分のことを好きにはなれないだろうと感じてる。
lines.translated: I feel like I probably won't ever be able to like myself for as long as I live.

lines.content: そんな醜い“心”を持って生まれてしまってごめんなさい……。
lines.translated: I'm sorry for being born with such an ugly "heart"...

lines.content: そう伝える代わりに、わたしは、ふたりの幸せを応援するんだ。
lines.translated: Instead of telling him that, I will cheer for the two of their happiness.

lines.content: 人は人。猫は猫――いつも一緒にいるべきなのは、同じ命を持つもの同士。同じ命の“イキモノ”同士が一番いい。
lines.translated: People are people. Cats are cats--the ones who should always be together are those who share the same kind of life. It's best for "creatures" with the same kind of life to be together.

lines.content: 大雅のことを大切に想ってくれてるはずのハルなら、大雅に、“夢”を忘れさせてくれるはず……
lines.translated: "Since Haru surely cares deeply for Taiga, she should be able to make him forget his 'dream'..."

lines.content: ましろのことを忘れて、大切な人と、自分自身のために生きていってくれるはず……。
lines.translated: He should be able to forget about Mashiro, and live on for the sake of someone precious to him, and for himself...

lines.content: 大雅は、[・|ま][・|ず][・|は]ハルの“魔法”から使用すると決めた。いつかの夜、電話でそういうふうに報告された。
lines.translated: Taiga decided to use Haru's "magic" first. Some night, he reported that to me over the phone.

lines.content: その選択をした先の時間で、大雅とハルは、“恋するための物語”を歩む結果になってほしい。わたしはそう願ってる。
lines.translated: In the time that lies beyond that choice, I want the outcome to be one where Taiga and Haru walk a "story for falling in love." That is what I wish for.

lines.content: そうだよ。
lines.translated: That's right.
Even Mashiro, who has vanished off to somewhere and stayed gone, is wishing for your life... for that story, to reach a happy ending more dazzling than anything.

lines.content: 全部……
lines.translated: "Everything..."

lines.content: 全部わたしが願ったとおりに世界は、きみ達の時間は、進んでいった。
lines.translated: Everything in the world, and the time of you two, moved forward just as I had wished.

lines.content: ……人生は、まるでうつくしいたったひとつの“歌”のよう。
lines.translated: Life is just like a single, beautiful "song."

lines.content: 大雅とハルは、“半透明”の兎蛙あず咲とその弟、兎蛙智仁の“想い”に触れた。
lines.translated: Taiga and Haru touched the "feelings" of the "semi-transparent" Togawa Azusaki and her younger brother, Togawa Tomohito.

lines.content: そこにはわたしの知らない“愛”とか“勇気”とか。そういう“心”がいっぱいあった。
lines.translated: There was so much "love" and "courage" there that I know nothing about. It was full of that kind of "heart."

lines.content: 大雅と、ハル。ふたりはその“想い”に触れて、何を感じただろうか。
lines.translated: Taiga, and Haru. Touching those "feelings," what did the two of them feel, I wonder?

lines.content: わたしなんかには想像もできない。
lines.translated: Someone like me couldn't even imagine it.

lines.content: ただふたりの生きる時間を、その物語を、わたしは近くから……そして遠くから、いつも見守っていたつもりだ。
lines.translated: I simply intended to always watch over the time the two of them lived, over their story, from up close... and from afar.

lines.content: [・|同][・|じ][・|時][・|間][・|に][・|い][・|ら][・|れ][・|る][・|と][・|き][・|は]、できるだけ大雅のことを見守れる距離にいつもいた。
lines.translated: Whenever we could be in the same time, I always stayed at a distance where I could watch over Taiga as much as possible.

lines.content: ……大雅に。ふたりにもし、何かあれば
lines.translated: "...If anything were to happen to Taiga. To the two of them."

lines.content: すぐにその“不幸”をわたしが連れ去ろうと思ってた。
lines.translated: I intended to immediately carry that "misfortune" away myself.

lines.content: わたしは、大雅の人生のために生きる。
lines.translated: I live for the sake of Taiga's life.

lines.content: この命に与えられたものは全部、きみだけのためにあるものだ――わたし、きみからもらったやさしさを返すために、生きていく。
lines.translated: Everything given to this life of mine exists solely for your sake--I will live on in order to return the kindness I received from you.

lines.content: そういうふうに生きることがわたしの“役割”――そう、決めたから
lines.translated: "Living that way is my 'role'--because that's what I decided."
So, I should have been prepared for that moment.

lines.content: ハル。好きだ。他の誰でもない、俺は君が好きなんだよ、ハル
lines.translated: "Haru. I love you. Not anyone else, it's you that I love, Haru."

lines.content: 大雅のそんな言葉と笑顔を、ふたりのそばで見つけてしまった瞬間だ。
lines.translated: It was the moment I ended up discovering those words and that smile of Taiga's right beside the two of them.

lines.content: いつもどこかで思ってた。俺も、君みたいになれたらいいって
lines.translated: "Somewhere in my heart, I always thought about how nice it would be if I could become like you too."

lines.content: つい弱音を吐いてしまっても、弱気な態度を取ってしまったとしても。それでも“もうだめだ”とは決して言わない……。そんな君に憧れていた
lines.translated: "Even if you accidentally let slip a complaint, or take a timid attitude. Even so, you never once say 'it's no use anymore'... I admired that about you."

lines.content: その憧れは、今だ。たった今、この瞬間、“好き”に変わった。……そんな気がする
lines.translated: "That admiration, right now. Just now, in this very moment, changed into 'love.' ...That's what it feels like."
Even though I should have wished for that kind of "future"...

lines.content: わたしの“心”は、まるでひび割れるみたいに痛んだ。
lines.translated: My "heart" ached as though it were cracking apart.

lines.content: わたしは、ふたりのいる場所から逃げ出した。
lines.translated: I ran away from the place where the two of them were.

lines.content: 夜の時計塔、その管理室だ。必死に、逃げ出すように背を向け……、走った。
lines.translated: It was the clock tower at night, in its caretaker's room. Frantically, turning my back as if to flee... I ran.

lines.content: ねえ、誰か教えて。
lines.translated: Hey, someone tell me.

lines.content: 何も知らないわたしに教えてよ。
lines.translated: Tell me, since I don't know anything.

lines.content: ふたりはあれからどうなるの？
lines.translated: What happens to the two of them after that?

lines.content: 大好きだよって。
lines.translated: Saying "I love you."

lines.content: ぼくも、わたしも、きみのことが大切だよって。
lines.translated: Saying "Both I, and I, treasure you."

lines.content: そんなすてきな言葉を渡しあって、やさしく、微笑みあって――手を繋ぎあうのだろうか。
lines.translated: Will they exchange such wonderful words, smile gently at one another--and join hands?

lines.content: わたしも……
lines.translated: "I also..."

lines.content: わたしも、ほしい。
lines.translated: I want it, too.

lines.content: そんなふうに思ってしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up thinking that way.

lines.content: わたしも大雅の“大好き”が、その言葉が、気持ちが、ほしいよと――……だめだ。
lines.translated: That I also want Taiga's "I love you," those words, those feelings--...No, I mustn't.

lines.content: ……だめ
わたしは、何を言ってるんだろう。
lines.translated: What am I even saying?

lines.content: わたしは猫で。きみは、人間。ずっと一緒にはいられない。
lines.translated: I am a cat. And you are a human. We cannot stay together forever.

lines.content: それなのにわたしはまた、“嫉妬”してるのだろか。
lines.translated: Even so, am I being "jealous" again?

lines.content: もう、いやだ。
lines.translated: No more.

lines.content: こんな自分が大嫌い。
lines.translated: I hate myself like this so much.

lines.content: こんな“心”なんて、ほしくなかった……。
lines.translated: I never wanted a "heart" like this...

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: 誰もいない草むらに飛び込んで、わたしは小さくなっていた。
lines.translated: Diving into an empty patch of grass, I curled up small.

lines.content: ……もう、眠りたい。お願いだよ。……[・|こ][・|こ]にはもう、いたくないんだよ
lines.translated: "...I want to sleep already. Please. ...I don't want to be here anymore."

lines.content: すべて自分で求めた結果のはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though all of this should be the result I sought for myself...

lines.content: 気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up realizing it.

lines.content: きみがハルに大好きだよと言った瞬間……。
lines.translated: The moment you told Haru that you loved her...

lines.content: わたしは、この世界のどこにも――
lines.translated: That anywhere in this world--

lines.content: “夜の世界”の中にも、
lines.translated: Even within the "World of Night,"

lines.content: きみの“隣”にも、
lines.translated: Even "beside" you,

lines.content: 居場所も、帰る場所も、何もなくなってしまったんだということを。
lines.translated: I had lost my place to belong, my place to return to, everything.

lines.content: わたしはひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: I am all alone.

lines.content: こんなつらい想いをするのなら、もうここには居たくない――お願い、もう、眠らせてほしい。
lines.translated: If I have to experience such painful feelings, I don't want to be here anymore--please, just let me sleep already.

lines.content: 深く、ふかく眠ってしまって……、
lines.translated: Falling into a deep, deep sleep...

lines.content: ずっとずっと遠い未来へ逃げ出してしまいたいんだ。
lines.translated: I want to run away into the far, far distant future.

lines.content: もし叶うなら……、ふたりの人生が終わるまで
lines.translated: "If it could be granted... until the two of their lives come to an end."

lines.content: それくらいの遙か遠くにだ。
lines.translated: Somewhere that far and distant.

lines.content: わたしが大雅とハルに届けたいと願ったはずの“恋するための物語”――ひとりぼっちではない時間。
lines.translated: Until the "story for falling in love" that I had wished to deliver to Taiga and Haru--the time spent not being all alone.

lines.content: そんなきらきらまぶしいばかりのお話が、幸せに、終わってしまうまで。
lines.translated: Until a tale so sparkling and dazzlingly bright comes to a happy end.

lines.content: 遠い、とおい……ずっと遠い時間の先まで、眠り続けていたいのに
lines.translated: "Far, far... I want to keep sleeping all the way to the end of a far distant time, and yet."

lines.content: でも、こういうときに限って眠れない。
lines.translated: But at times like this of all times, I cannot sleep.

lines.content: 不安や心配、そして怖さばかりが、わたしに少しの“夢”も見せてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: Anxiety and worry, and nothing but fear, wouldn't show me even a single bit of a "dream."

lines.content: 朝が来る。
lines.translated: Morning comes.

lines.content: あっという間だ。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye.

lines.content: 眠れないままだった。
lines.translated: I remained unable to sleep.

lines.content: ふらふらと草むらから抜け出して……。
lines.translated: Staggering out from the patch of grass...

lines.content: 大雅とハル。ふたりがあれからどうなってしまったのかな。
lines.translated: Taiga and Haru. I wonder what happened to the two of them after that.

lines.content: 怖いけど。さみしいけれど。
lines.translated: I'm scared, though. I'm lonely, though.

lines.content: ふたりがどうなったのかを知るために、踏み出した。
lines.translated: In order to know what became of the two of them, I stepped forward.

lines.content: ……そしてわたしは“後悔”する。
lines.translated: And then, I "regret."

lines.content: ……ハル。どうして
lines.translated: "...Haru. Why?"

lines.content: 柊ハルは、その夜――わたしがふたりから逃げ出したその夜に、自ら命を絶ったのだと知った。
lines.translated: I learned that Hiiragi Haru, on that night--on that night I ran away from the two of them, took her own life.

lines.content: わたしの“力”は、大切なきみに降りかかる不幸を肩代わりすることだ。
lines.translated: My "power" is to take on the misfortune that befalls you, who are so precious to me.

lines.content: わたしが“嫉妬”なんてしなければ。
lines.translated: If only I hadn't felt "jealousy" or anything like that.

lines.content: わたしが、ふたりから逃げ出すことなく、ちゃんといつもどおり見つめていたなら……。
lines.translated: If only I hadn't run away from the two of them, and had properly watched over them like always...

lines.content: ……ごめん、大雅。きっとそういうことにはならなかったのに
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. It surely wouldn't have turned out like that."

lines.content: “後悔”だ。
lines.translated: It is "regret."

lines.content: わたしの“心”は、いつも、いつも、“後悔”ばかりし続けている。
lines.translated: My "heart" is always, always doing nothing but "regretting."

lines.content: 大雅は“魔法”を使った――命をなくした柊ハル。
lines.translated: Taiga used "magic"--for Hiiragi Haru, who had lost her life.

lines.content: どうしてハルがそういう決断をしたのかはわからない。きっと誰にもわからないのだ。柊ハル本人以外には。
lines.translated: I don't know why Haru made a decision like that. Surely no one knows. No one except Hiiragi Haru herself.

lines.content: だから大雅は、ハルの知らない心も一緒に知ろうとし――彼女を助け出せるようにと“想像”し、その“想い”を“形”にした“魔法”を使った。
lines.translated: So Taiga tried to understand the parts of Haru's heart he hadn't known--he "imagined" a way to save her, and used "magic" that gave "form" to those "feelings."

lines.content: “拳銃”だ。
lines.translated: It was a "handgun."

lines.content: 大雅が“柊ハルを助けたい”という“想い”はそういう形の“魔法”となった。
lines.translated: Taiga's "feelings" of "wanting to save Hiiragi Haru" became "magic" of that form.

lines.content: その瞬間、わたしは大雅の中からましろに関しての記憶をすべて、“不幸”として認識し、受け取った――
lines.translated: At that moment, I recognized all of the memories regarding Mashiro inside Taiga as "misfortune," and took them into myself--

lines.content: まだ薄らとは残っていたかもしれないが、そうした残りの記憶も、少しずつ進んでいく時間の中で消えてなくなっていくはずだった。
lines.translated: Some faint traces might have still remained, but those leftover memories were supposed to fade away and disappear little by little as time moved forward.

lines.content: だから大雅は、その“魔法”を躊躇わずに使えてしまったのだろうと思う――……でも、本来は。
lines.translated: That's probably why Taiga was able to use that "magic" without hesitation--...but originally.

lines.content: ……その“魔法”の[・|権][・|利]は、ハルを助けるために手に入れたものじゃない
lines.translated: "...The right to that 'magic' wasn't something you obtained in order to save Haru."

lines.content: ましろだ。
lines.translated: It was for Mashiro.

lines.content: そして、奏大雅だ。
lines.translated: And for Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 十年前に、ふたりを助けるため、大雅が“夜”に求めた“魔法”――
lines.translated: The "magic" Taiga had sought from the "Night" ten years ago in order to save the two of them--

lines.content: その“想い”がようやく、ハルを救いたいという“想い”と重なり……ようやくだ、形となったもの。
lines.translated: Those "feelings" finally overlapped with his "feelings" of wanting to save Haru... and at long last, took form.

lines.content: でも大雅は、その“魔法”を……。
lines.translated: But Taiga took that "magic"...

lines.content: わたしのせいですべて忘れかけていた、大雅は……。
lines.translated: Taiga, who had nearly forgotten everything because of me...

lines.content: その“魔法”を[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]のためではなく、柊ハルのために使用したいと……。
lines.translated: Wanted to use that "magic" not for the two of them, but for Hiiragi Haru...

lines.content: そう願う大雅の心を、わたしは、感じられたから。
lines.translated: Because I could feel Taiga's heart wishing for that.

lines.content: だからわたしは[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]、ハルを救いたいと願った大雅に、その“魔法”に“許可”を出したのだった。
lines.translated: That was why, back then, I granted "permission" for that "magic" to Taiga, who wished to save Haru.

lines.content: でも……
だめだよ。
lines.translated: I can't do it.

lines.content: こんなの、ひどい
lines.translated: "This is awful."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]わたしはまた逃げ出すみたいに、大雅の部屋から飛び出して……頭を抱えてた。
lines.translated: Back then, as if running away all over again, I bolted out of Taiga's room... and held my head in my hands.

lines.content: ……こんな“形”の“魔法”なら。ちゃんと全部、大雅の気持ちに気づいていたなら。わたし……“許可”なんて、出さなかったのに
lines.translated: "...If the 'magic' had a 'form' like this. If I had properly noticed all of Taiga's feelings. I... never would have granted 'permission.'"

lines.content: たぶん、それをわかっていたから……。
lines.translated: Maybe because he knew that...

lines.content: だから大雅は、わたしにその想いを隠し、“魔法”の“許可”だけを引き出したんだと思う。
lines.translated: That's why I think Taiga hid those feelings from me, and drew out only the "permission" for the "magic."

lines.content: ――大雅が“想像”した“魔法”は自らを撃ち抜き、“心”だけ過去へと吹き飛ばすというものだった。
lines.translated: --The "magic" Taiga had "imagined" was something that would shoot through himself, blowing only his "heart" back into the past.

lines.content: 大雅もハルと同じように、自ら命を絶とうとしていた。自分の“魔法”で。
lines.translated: Just like Haru, Taiga was trying to take his own life. With his own "magic."

lines.content: そうすることしかもう“希望”はないのだと、大雅がそう感じているのも繋いだ手から伝わった。
lines.translated: Through our joined hands, I could also feel that Taiga believed doing so was the only "hope" left anymore.

lines.content: それなのにどうして……。
lines.translated: And yet, why...?

lines.content: ちゃんと、“魔法”の内容だけでも把握しておくべきだった――“後悔”だ。
lines.translated: I should have at least properly grasped what the "magic" entailed--it is "regret."
That I granted "permission" without even doing that.

lines.content: そして大雅を置いて、部屋を飛び出してしまったこと。
lines.translated: And that I left Taiga behind and bolted out of the room.

lines.content: この場面では、それが一番の“後悔”だった――一度“許可”を出した“魔法”を取り消す。そんな方法はないのか。
lines.translated: In this moment, that was my greatest "regret"--revoking "magic" once "permission" has been granted. Was there no way to do something like that?

lines.content: あさひに教えてもらおうとして、わたしは……。
lines.translated: Trying to get Asahi to tell me, I...

lines.content: 大雅を“魔法”と一緒に、部屋に置いてきてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Had left Taiga behind in the room, alone with that "magic."

lines.content: そのことに気づいたときには、遅い。
lines.translated: By the time I realized that, it was too late.

lines.content: あのときのわたしはすぐ、大雅の元に戻ろうとしたけれど……。
lines.translated: Back then, I immediately tried to go back to Taiga, but...

lines.content: 破裂音がした。
lines.translated: There was a bursting sound.

lines.content: それは大雅がたったひとり、“魔法”を使った音だった。
lines.translated: It was the sound of Taiga using the "magic" all alone.

lines.content: 急いで部屋に戻った。
lines.translated: I hurried back to the room.

lines.content: でも、遅かった――何もかも。
lines.translated: But it was too late--everything was.

lines.content: 真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: Bright red.

lines.content: そこには大雅の抜け殻だけが横たわっている。
lines.translated: Only Taiga's empty shell lay there.

lines.content: 意味なんてないとわかってる――でも、飛び散った大雅の全部を必死になって、わたしはかき集めていた。両手も。顔も。お腹も真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: I knew it was meaningless--but I frantically scooped up all of Taiga that had been scattered everywhere. Both my hands. My face. My stomach, too, were bright red.

lines.content: あさひが駆けつけ。
lines.translated: Asahi came rushing in.

lines.content: 十夜が、泣いた。
lines.translated: Toya cried.

lines.content: ああ、だめだ。
lines.translated: Ah, it's no use.

lines.content: もうだめだ。
lines.translated: It's no use anymore.

lines.content: この[時間|世界]は“不幸”になった。
lines.translated: This world has become "unfortunate."

lines.content: ……もう誰も、幸せにはなれない。大雅。きみのことを大切に想う人たちの世界は、ずっと。ずっと。……いつまでもずっと、永遠に、“不幸”だ。
lines.translated: No one can become happy anymore. Taiga. The world of the people who care so deeply about you is forever. Forever. ...Always and forever, for all eternity, "unfortunate."
It's always like this.

lines.content: いつもわたしに頭も、心も、何もかも足りていないばっかりに――こうして世界は“不幸”の底に沈んでいく。
lines.translated: Simply because I am always lacking in brains, in heart, in everything--the world sinks to the bottom of "misfortune" like this.

lines.content: あのときのわたしは唇を噛みしめて、ただ、願ってた。
lines.translated: Back then, I bit my lip and simply wished.

lines.content: ……大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm okay."

lines.content: 叶うはずだ。
lines.translated: It should come true.

lines.content: ……きみに追いつけるはずなんだ。
lines.translated: I should be able to catch up to you.

lines.content: わたしの“力”は、大雅。きみの“不幸”を肩代わりすること……
lines.translated: "My 'power,' Taiga, is to take your 'misfortune' upon myself..."

lines.content: 冷たくなっていく大雅の手を力いっぱい、あのときわたしは、握ったのだった。
lines.translated: Back then, I squeezed Taiga's hand with all my might as it grew colder and colder.

lines.content: ……大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: ハルを助け出すためにたくさん、たくさんのつらいことがあっただろうけど。
lines.translated: There must have been so, so many painful things in order to save Haru.
But your "magic" was a great success.

lines.content: ハッピーエンドだ。
lines.translated: It's a happy ending.

lines.content: 奏大雅と柊ハル。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga and Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: ふたりの物語は[・|今]、終わった。
lines.translated: The story of the two of them has now ended.

lines.content: 未成熟なわたし何かの“心”では、人生の善し悪しなんて計れやしないけど……。
lines.translated: With an immature "heart" like mine, there's no way I can measure the good or bad of a person's life, but...

lines.content: 幸せな終わりだったろうとは思う。
lines.translated: I think it must have been a happy ending.

lines.content: さくらの杜“参禅町”で恋をして、結婚したふたりは、生涯をずっとこの町で暮らした。
lines.translated: The two of them, who fell in love and got married in the cherry blossom forest of "Sanzen-cho," lived out their entire lives in this town.

lines.content: ふたりはいつも一緒だった。
lines.translated: The two of them were always together.

lines.content: 子どもを授かることはなかったけれど、だからこそ一緒に過ごす時間が全部、まるで宝物みたいにふたりの間に満ちていく――
lines.translated: They were never blessed with children, but for that very reason, all the time they spent together filled the space between them just like a treasure--

lines.content: 大きな病気もなく、大好きな歌を歌い、ふたりで夢を追いかけ、それを叶えて……年老いて。
lines.translated: Without any major illnesses, singing the songs they loved so much, chasing their dreams together, fulfilling them... and growing old.

lines.content: ふたり並んで眠ったふわふわないつものベッドで、“もう、いいかな。私たち、充分生きたね”と、微笑んで……。
lines.translated: In the soft, familiar bed where the two of them slept side by side, smiling and saying, "Maybe it's about time. We've lived plenty, haven't we?"...

lines.content: “うん。私、幸せだったよ”と、ハルは静かに息を引き取って。
lines.translated: "Yeah. I was happy," Haru said, quietly drawing her last breath.

lines.content: そんな穏やかな人生だったから、どちらかがひとりぼっちを悲しむような時間も少しで済んだのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Because it was such a peaceful life, perhaps the time spent mourning being left all alone was kept brief for whichever of them remained.

lines.content: 残されたきみも、愛しい人を追いかけるようにして、数日後、あるいは数週間後……。
lines.translated: And you, who were left behind, as if chasing after your beloved, a few days later, or perhaps a few weeks later...

lines.content: いいや、もう少しだけ先のことだったかもしれないけれど――きみもまた、同じベッドで深い眠りについたのだ。
lines.translated: No, it might have been just a little further on than that--but you, too, fell into a deep sleep in that very same bed.

lines.content: きっとふたりは“夜”で出会える。
lines.translated: Surely the two of them will be able to meet in the "Night."

lines.content: 離ればなれだったのはほんの短い間だけ。
lines.translated: They were only apart for a very short while.

lines.content: そしてまた、ふたりは誓い合うのだろう。
lines.translated: And then, the two of them will surely swear to each other once again.

lines.content: 次の人生でも同じように“恋”をしよう。
lines.translated: Let's fall in "love" the exact same way in our next lives, too.

lines.content: ……必ずだ。
lines.translated: No matter what.

lines.content: たとえどんな場所に、どんな姿に生まれ変わったとしても、必ず君を見つけ出すよ。
lines.translated: No matter where or in what form we are reborn, I will definitely find you.

lines.content: そんなふうに、まるで想像上の物語みたいなやさしい言葉を、最期の瞬間にまで渡し合う。
lines.translated: Like that, they exchanged gentle words just like an imaginary story right up until their final moments.

lines.content: それはまさに、わたしがふたりに願い、届けたかった“恋するための物語”だったのだ。
lines.translated: That was truly the "story for falling in love" that I had wished for the two of them, and wanted to deliver.

lines.content: ……そこにはもう、ましろの記憶も、わたしの影も、どこにもない
lines.translated: "...In it, there are no longer any memories of Mashiro, nor any shadow of me, anywhere at all."

lines.content: それでいい。
lines.translated: That's fine.

lines.content: それが、いいんだ。
lines.translated: That's how it should be.

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: だけど最後にひとつ、やり残したことがある。
lines.translated: However, there is one last thing I have left undone.

lines.content: それだけ果たせば、わたしはもう、きみの背中ばかりを追いかけるようなことはやめよう。ただの“猫”に戻ってしまおう。
lines.translated: Once I fulfill just that, I'll stop doing things like endlessly chasing after your back. I'll go back to being just a "cat."

lines.content: そうして、醜いばかりのこんな“心”も。
lines.translated: And then, this "heart" that is nothing but ugly, too.

lines.content: どうしたって思うようにならなかったこんな苦しい気持ちも。
lines.translated: These painful feelings that never went the way I wanted no matter what, too.

lines.content: 全部……。
lines.translated: Everything...

lines.content: 全部、捨て去ってしまうんだ。そうでなければとてもじゃないけど生きてはいけない。
lines.translated: I'll throw it all away. If I don't, there is no way I could possibly go on living.

lines.content: 思い通りにならない“心”こそ、一番近くにある一番の敵なのだと、わたしは、この人生の中で学んだから。
lines.translated: Because I have learned in this life that a "heart" that doesn't go the way you want is the greatest enemy, right there closest to you.

lines.content: たくさんの“命”行き交う、さくらもゆる“夜”の中。
lines.translated: Within the "Night" of budding cherry blossoms, where so many "lives" come and go.

lines.content: まるで物語みたいな人生を、たった今、終えたばかりの大雅をわたしは探した。
lines.translated: I searched for Taiga, who had just now finished a life that was just like a storybook.

lines.content: その背中はすぐに見つけ出すことができた。
lines.translated: I was able to find his back right away.

lines.content: 時計塔のそばに寄り添い立つさくらの樹。はらはらと舞う花びらに瞬く“夜”の空。
lines.translated: The cherry blossom tree standing close beside the clock tower. The sky of the "Night" twinkling through the fluttering petals.

lines.content: 大雅は、その光景をひとりで……。
lines.translated: Taiga was looking up at that scenery alone...

lines.content: たったひとりで、ただ静かに、見上げていた。
lines.translated: All alone, simply and quietly, looking up at it.

lines.content: それはわたしの良くよく知ってる大雅の姿だ。年老いてしまった姿ではない。
lines.translated: That was the figure of Taiga I knew so very well. Not the figure of him grown old.

lines.content: ハルはどこに行ったんだろう。どうしてふたりは一緒に居ないのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder where Haru went. Why aren't the two of them together?

lines.content: そんな不思議を抱えたままに、わたしは恐る恐る大雅の名前を呼ぼうとした。
lines.translated: Holding onto that sense of wonder, I timidly tried to call out Taiga's name.

lines.content: ……探したよ。クロ
lines.translated: "...I was looking for you, Kuro."

lines.content: 大雅が先にわたしを呼んだ。そしてこちらを振り返る。笑顔だった。
lines.translated: Taiga called out to me first. And then he turned to look back at me. He was smiling.

lines.content: わたしの知ってる……世界で一番、やさしいと信じる微笑みだった。
lines.translated: It was the smile I knew... the one I believed to be the gentlest in the entire world.

lines.content: ううん。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: わたしが世界で一番、そばで見つめていたいと想い続けた微笑みだ。
lines.translated: It was the smile I had constantly wished to gaze at from up close, more than anything else in the world.

lines.content: それだけで、涙がこぼれる。
lines.translated: Just from that alone, my tears spilled over.

lines.content: この瞬間まで、長い、ながい間、こうして大雅に名前を呼ばれることなく、ひとりぼっちで過ごしてきた。こうしてすぐ近くで声を聞けた。こうして目の前で、名前を呼んでくれた。
lines.translated: Until this very moment, for a long, long time, I had spent my days all alone, without ever having Taiga call my name like this. I was able to hear his voice right beside me like this. He called my name right in front of my eyes like this.

lines.content: 痛い。
lines.translated: It hurts.

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: また、思い通りにならない“心”が痛んだ。
lines.translated: Once again, the "heart" that never goes the way I want it to ached.

lines.content: 不思議だね
lines.translated: "It's strange, isn't it?"

lines.content: 大雅が言う。
lines.translated: Taiga says.

lines.content: こうして人生を終えるまで、俺、君のことも、“夜”に関することも、何もかも全部忘れてしまってた。でも、ここに立つと……
lines.translated: "Until I finished my life like this, I had completely forgotten about you, about everything related to the 'Night,' everything. But when I stand here..."

lines.content: 不思議だ、と大雅は繰り返し言った。
lines.translated: "It's strange," Taiga repeated.

lines.content: 少年だったあの頃を、まるでつい昨日のことのように思い出せるよ
lines.translated: "I can remember those days when I was a boy as if it were just yesterday."

lines.content: 大雅の隣にそっと立つ。
lines.translated: I quietly stand next to Taiga.

lines.content: そんなわたしを、大雅は見ることができる。
lines.translated: Taiga is able to see me like this.

lines.content: たったこれだけのことも叶わなかった、長い時間のことを思う。すると涙がにじんだ――大人になった大雅には、どんなにそばにいようと、わたしのことは見えていなかった。
lines.translated: I think back on the long stretch of time when even something as simple as this wouldn't come true. As I did, tears welled up in my eyes--to the grown-up Taiga, no matter how close I stayed by his side, I was completely invisible.

lines.content: 近くにいるのに、そばにいられない。
lines.translated: Even though I was right near him, I couldn't be by his side.

lines.content: そんな時間がとても、とてもさみしかった。
lines.translated: That time was so, so lonely.

lines.content: でも今は、違う。
lines.translated: But now, it's different.

lines.content: ……言わないと。
lines.translated: I have to say it.

lines.content: やり残したことを果たさないと。
lines.translated: I have to fulfill what I left undone.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: あのね。聞いてほしいことが、あるの。
lines.translated: Um, listen. There's something I want you to hear.

lines.content: あのね……実は、わたし
lines.translated: "Um... Actually, I..."

lines.content: ……知ってるよ
lines.translated: "...I know."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: クロが、言おうとしてること。俺に秘密にしてたこと。たぶんだけど、全部知ってる
lines.translated: "What you're trying to say, Kuro. What you kept secret from me. Probably, anyway, I know all of it."

lines.content: やさしい声と笑顔をわたしにくれた。
lines.translated: He gave me a gentle voice and a smile.

lines.content: だけどそのまま、大雅はわたしの反応を待たず歩き出す。
lines.translated: However, just like that, Taiga starts walking without waiting for my reaction.

lines.content: ……待って。
lines.translated: Wait.

lines.content: ……どういうこと、なの。大雅
lines.translated: "...What do you mean, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……行かないで。
lines.translated: Don't go.

lines.content: わたしの秘密って……、どういうこと？
lines.translated: "My secret... What do you mean by that?"

lines.content: ずきりと、胸が痛んだ。それは色々な、[・|怖][・|さ]だ。
lines.translated: My chest throbbed with a sharp pain. That was made of all kinds of *fear*.

lines.content: ……お願い。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ……わたしを置いて、追い行かないで。
lines.translated: Don't leave me behind and go on ahead.

lines.content: 不安だった。
lines.translated: She was anxious.

lines.content: このまま大雅はどこかへ消えて、わたしは永遠にひとりぼっち。これまでと何も変わらずに。
lines.translated: Taiga will disappear somewhere just like this, and I'll be all alone forever. With nothing changing from how it's always been.

lines.content: そんな一瞬の“悪夢”を、わたしの意地悪な“心”が思い描いてた。
lines.translated: My spiteful "heart" was painting such a fleeting "nightmare."

lines.content: 大雅は何も応えない。
lines.translated: Taiga doesn't answer at all.

lines.content: 立ち止まることなく歩いて行く。
lines.translated: He walks on without stopping.

lines.content: 広い駅を通り抜け……。
lines.translated: Passing through the spacious station...

lines.content: 雑踏の行き交う発着場にまでたどり着く。
lines.translated: We reach all the way to the platform bustling with crowds coming and going.

lines.content: そんな大雅に声を掛けるのもなんだか怖くて……。
lines.translated: Calling out to Taiga like that felt somewhat scary, too...

lines.content: わたしはとぼとぼと、その背中に付いて来た。
lines.translated: So I trudged along, following behind his back.

lines.content: 大勢のひと達を乗せた汽車が走り去っていく。わたし達はふたりきり、誰もいなくなってしまったホームに残された。
lines.translated: The train carrying a large crowd of people speeds away. The two of us were left behind, all alone on the now-deserted platform.

lines.content: 大雅は何も言わず、うつむきがちに立っている。
lines.translated: Taiga stands there without saying a word, looking somewhat downcast.

lines.content: わたしは、そんな大雅の後ろ――三歩、四歩ほど離れたところに立っていた。わたし達にはいつもこれくらいの距離がある。
lines.translated: I was standing behind Taiga--about three or four steps away. There is always about this much distance between us.

lines.content: あと一歩、前に進めばいい。
lines.translated: All I have to do is take one more step forward.

lines.content: そうすれば手を伸ばすだけで触れられる。
lines.translated: If I do that, I can touch him just by reaching out my hand.

lines.content: でもその距離を詰めることが、怖い。そんな見えない距離がある。心にも。身体にも。
lines.translated: But closing that distance is scary. There is an invisible distance like that. In my heart, too. And in my body.

lines.content: 列車、もう、今夜は来ないよ……？
lines.translated: "The train... isn't coming anymore tonight, you know...?"

lines.content: 恐る恐る、声を掛けた。
lines.translated: Timidly, I called out to him.

lines.content: 掲示板によるとたった今出て行った列車が最後のようだ――遠い[ほし|惑星]行きの列車だった。
lines.translated: According to the bulletin board, the train that just left seems to have been the last one--a train bound for a distant planet.

lines.content: 水色豊かな[ほし|惑星]にある“夜の世界”へ、たくさんの“命”を乗せて、さっきの列車は“夜”の鉄道を走って行くのだろう。
lines.translated: Carrying countless "lives" to the "World of the Night" on a lush, pale-blue planet, that train from just now is surely running along the railway of the "Night."

lines.content: うん。……そうだね。列車はもうない。今夜は終わりだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...That's right. There are no more trains. Tonight is over."

lines.content: 大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Taiga says.

lines.content: だけど、いいんだ。どんな列車だろうと、俺の行きたい場所には連れてってくれないから
lines.translated: "However, that's fine. No matter what kind of train it is, it won't take me to the place I want to go."

lines.content: どういうこと？
lines.translated: What do you mean?

lines.content: わたしがそう問いかけるよりも先に、ホームから大雅は飛び降りた。
lines.translated: Before I could even ask that question, Taiga jumped down from the platform.

lines.content: 線路だ。
lines.translated: Onto the tracks.

lines.content: 大雅は、最終便の走って行ってしまった線路に降りて、また、歩き始めた。
lines.translated: Taiga climbed down onto the tracks where the last train had already departed, and began to walk once again.

lines.content: 先へ、先へ、ただ歩く。
lines.translated: Ahead, further ahead, he simply walks.

lines.content: わたしもその後ろを付いていった。
lines.translated: I followed behind him, too.

lines.content: ……ちょっと段差の高いホームと線路だ。
lines.translated: It's a platform and tracks with a rather high drop.

lines.content: 猫なわたしだけれど、運動は苦手。大雅みたいに身軽にぴょんと飛び降りれない。
lines.translated: Even though I'm a cat, I'm bad at exercise. I can't nimbly hop right down like Taiga.

lines.content: おっかなびっくり足を付け、わたしはそこへ降りたのだ。
lines.translated: Gingerly finding my footing, I climbed down there.

lines.content: 線路は“夜”の闇の中を伸びている。足下に地面らしいものは見当たらない――あるのはいっぱいの小さな明かり。よく見ると、それは町の光りだとわかった。
lines.translated: The tracks stretch out into the darkness of the "Night." Nothing resembling the ground can be seen beneath my feet--all that's there are lots of tiny lights. Looking closely, I realized they were the lights of the town.

lines.content: 線路は“夜”の空の上に伸びている。
lines.translated: The tracks stretch out high above the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: もしここから落ちたらどうなっちゃうのかな。耳と尻尾の毛がぴりぴりしてた。
lines.translated: I wonder what would happen if I fell from here. The fur on my ears and tail was tingling on end.

lines.content: ……大雅は、大丈夫かな。
lines.translated: I wonder if Taiga is okay.

lines.content: 風が吹いたりして、もし大雅が足を踏み外してしまったらどうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do if the wind blows or something, and Taiga loses his footing?

lines.content: 何かあったらすぐ手を伸ばせるようにしないと……。もう少し、大雅の背中に近づいておく。
lines.translated: I have to make sure I can reach out my hand right away if anything happens... I'll stay just a little closer to Taiga's back.

lines.content: だけど大雅は危なげもなく、夜空に敷かれたレールの上を、その間にある木の板を、器用に踏んで歩いていた。
lines.translated: However, without any sign of danger, Taiga was walking deftly, stepping on the rails laid out across the night sky and the wooden ties between them.

lines.content: しばらく歩くと大雅はふと立ち止まる。わたしも合わせて歩きを止めた。
lines.translated: After walking for a while, Taiga suddenly stops. Matching him, I stopped walking too.

lines.content: 大雅はその場にしゃがみ込み、線路に腰を掛けた。わたしも真似をする。少し離れたところに座った。
lines.translated: Taiga crouched down right there and sat on the tracks. I mimic him. I sat down a short distance away.

lines.content: ……下を見る。
lines.translated: I look down.

lines.content: きらきら瞬く町の明かり。
lines.translated: The twinkling lights of the town.

lines.content: この町にある思い出のすべてが、小さな光りとなって瞬いているように、見えた。
lines.translated: It looked as though all the memories in this town had become tiny lights and were twinkling down below.

lines.content: そんな永遠のような一瞬の瞬きを、こうしてふたり、夜空の線路に腰掛け見下ろしていた。
lines.translated: Sitting on the tracks in the night sky like this, the two of us were looking down at that twinkling, which felt like a single moment of eternity.

lines.content: クロ
lines.translated: Kuro

lines.content: 大雅が言う。静かな声だった。
lines.translated: Taiga speaks. It was a quiet voice.

lines.content: ふっとした風の音だけでも掻き消されてしまうほど、小さな、とても小さなものだったけど、わたしはちゃんと聞き取り、“うん”と応え、うなずく。
lines.translated: It was so small, so very small that even the faint sound of a breeze could drown it out, yet I heard it clearly, answered "Yeah," and nodded.

lines.content: ……うん。なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……ありがとう、クロ
lines.translated: "...Thank you, Kuro."

lines.content: ありがとう……、どうして？
lines.translated: "Thank you... Why?"

lines.content: いつも俺たちのこと、遠くから、……近くから、クロが見守っていてくれてたの、知ってるよ。自分のことを全部、犠牲にしてまで
lines.translated: "I know that you were always watching over us from afar... and from up close, Kuro. Even to the point of sacrificing everything of yourself."

lines.content: クロの“力”は……、君の持つ“特別な猫”としての、“力”は――“大切に想う人の不幸を肩代わりすること”
lines.translated: "Your 'power,' Kuro... The 'power' you possess as a 'special cat' is--'to take on the misfortune of the person you hold dear in their stead.'"

lines.content: こんなときなのに顔が赤くなるのを感じた。
lines.translated: Even at a time like this, I felt my face turning red.

lines.content: 大切に想う人……。
lines.translated: The person I hold dear...

lines.content: その言葉に、わたしの胸は跳ねていた――誰にも知られたくない秘密を、一番知られたくない人にバレてしまった。そんな気持ちだ。
lines.translated: At those words, my heart leaped--a secret I didn't want anyone to know had been found out by the very person I least wanted to know it. That was how it felt.

lines.content: クロの秘密。……命を終えて、“夜”の中で目覚めたら全部わかった。あのさくらの樹を見上げていたら……、はらはら落ちるさくらの花びらに乗せて、色々なことがわかったんだ
lines.translated: "Your secret, Kuro. ...When I finished my life and woke up within the 'Night,' I understood everything. While I was looking up at that cherry blossom tree... carried upon the fluttering cherry blossom petals, I came to understand all sorts of things."

lines.content: 色々な、こと……
lines.translated: "All sorts... of things..."

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: “夜”の花びらに乗せ、自分の人生について――自分の知り得なかったことが、断片的な映像となり、柔らかく次々と降り注いできたのだと大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Carried upon the petals of the "Night," things about his own life--things he had no way of knowing himself became fragmentary images, raining down softly one after another, Taiga says.

lines.content: 俺が、ハルを助けたい一心で“魔法”を使い……。考えもなしに時間を飛び越えて、いくつもの時間を、悪戯に……、枝葉に分けていってしまっていたとき
lines.translated: "When I used 'magic' with the single-minded desire to save Haru... jumping through time without thinking, needlessly... branching so many different times off like twigs and leaves..."

lines.content: その裏で……クロ。君が、俺のために何をしていてくれてたのかも全部、わかったよ。あのさくらが、この“夜”が、教えてくれた
lines.translated: "Behind the scenes of all that... Kuro. I understood everything about what you were doing for my sake, too. That cherry blossom tree, and this 'Night,' taught me."

lines.content: ふたりで見下ろした町の風景。その光り。
lines.translated: The scenery of the town the two of us looked down upon. Its lights.

lines.content: “夜の国”とは時間の墓場のような場所でもある。誰かがそう語ってた。
lines.translated: The "Country of the Night" is also a place like a graveyard of time. Someone had spoken of it like that.

lines.content: 過ぎ去り終わってしまった時間もまた、時間という空間そのものを記憶媒体のようにして、永遠と“夜”に記録されているのだという。
lines.translated: They say that time which has passed by and ended is also recorded eternally in the "Night," using the very space called time itself as a storage medium.

lines.content: わたしには難しい話だ。よく、わからない。理解できない。
lines.translated: It's a difficult topic for me. I don't really get it. I can't understand it.

lines.content: だけどこうして見下ろす瞬きのひとつに、わたしが、大雅を助けたいと願った“あのとき”の時間もあるのだ。
lines.translated: However, within one of the twinkles we look down upon like this, there is also the time from "back then," when I wished to save Taiga.

lines.content: ならばここは時間の墓場と言うよりも、時間の図書館のようにわたしには思えた。
lines.translated: In that case, rather than calling this a graveyard of time, to me it felt more like a library of time.

lines.content: 大雅はそこに納められた[時間|本]をひとつ、手に取り、掬い上げるかのように――
lines.translated: As if Taiga were picking up and scooping out a single book of time stored away in there--

lines.content: ……七発目の“弾丸”
lines.translated: "...The seventh 'bullet.'"

lines.content: ぽつりと、そう言った。
lines.translated: Quietly, he said that.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: これ
lines.translated: "This."

lines.content: 大雅は、手のひらを開いてわたしに見せた。
lines.translated: Taiga opened the palm of his hand and showed it to me.

lines.content: わたしは少し離れた隣に座ってる。目を細め、その手にあるのはなんだろうとじっと見た。
lines.translated: Sitting next to him a short distance away, I narrowed my eyes and stared intently to see what was in his hand.

lines.content: あのときの“弾丸”だよ
lines.translated: "It's the 'bullet' from back then."

lines.content: 大雅は言った。そこにあったのは、撃ち終わったあとの薬莢だとわかった。
lines.translated: Taiga said. I realized what lay there was a spent shell casing.

lines.content: あのときの……？
lines.translated: "From back then...?"

lines.content: うん。そう……。俺がハルを助けたくて“想像”した“拳銃の魔法”
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right... The 'handgun magic' I 'imagined' because I wanted to save Haru."

lines.content: ……その“魔法”には使用制限のようなものがあった。全装弾数六発。込められた弾薬の数が使用できる“魔法”の上限。……俺は、六発すべてを撃ち尽くそうとしてた
lines.translated: "...That 'magic' had something like a usage limit. A total capacity of six rounds. The number of loaded cartridges was the upper limit of the 'magic' I could use. ...I was about to fire all six shots."

lines.content: ハルを助け出すためにはあと一発、どうしても、足りない――そのどうしようもない事実に頭を抱えてた。
lines.translated: In order to rescue Haru, he was hopelessly short by just one more shot--and he had been clutching his head in despair over that inescapable fact.

lines.content: そんな俺の前に、クロ。一緒に“拳銃の魔法”を想像した君が……
lines.translated: "And right in front of me, Kuro, you--who had imagined the 'handgun magic' together with me..."

lines.content: ……いや。俺が君の“[想像の力|心]”を利用してしまっただけ、なんだけれど
lines.translated: "...No. In truth, I had just taken advantage of your 'heart'--your power of imagination."

lines.content: とにかく。そのときの時間世界とは、違う――基本世界Ａ地点から、君は、この七発目を握りしめ、俺を追いかけて来てくれた。そして頭を抱えてた俺に渡してくれたんだ
lines.translated: "Anyway. From a different timeline than that one--from the base world, Point A--you chased after me, clutching this seventh shot tight. And you handed it to me while I was holding my head in despair."

lines.content: その七発目の“弾丸”はいったいどこから調達したんだろう。あのときもそれを不思議には思った。でも、あまり深く追求はしなかった
lines.translated: "Where on earth did you procure that seventh 'bullet'? I wondered about it back then, too. But I didn't pry into it too deeply."

lines.content: 大雅はそう言い、手のひらの薬莢を見つめてる。
lines.translated: Saying that, Taiga gazes at the shell casing in his palm.

lines.content: なぜなら俺には、ハルを助け出さなければという、揺るぎない目的があって必死だったし、クロも、どこかはぐらかそうというような態度があった。そう見えたんだ
lines.translated: "Because I was desperate, driven by the unwavering goal that I had to save Haru, and you also seemed like you were trying to dodge the question somehow, Kuro. That's how it looked to me."

lines.content: だから深くは追求できなかったし、そうしようともしなかった。
lines.translated: So he couldn't pursue it deeply, nor did he try to.

lines.content: それにさ。この“拳銃の魔法”は、俺だけの“想像物”じゃあない。クロと、俺。ふたりでひとつというふうに合わせた“想像力”――
lines.translated: "Besides, this 'handgun magic' wasn't my 'creation' alone. It was yours and mine, Kuro. Our 'imagination' combined together as two halves of a whole--"

lines.content: ここはあえて“想い”としようか。そう言う大雅は微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: Or perhaps he should dare to call it their "feelings" here. Saying that, Taiga smiles.

lines.content: ともあれだ。俺とクロ。不完全な“心”をくっつけあって、ようやくひとつとして創り上げられた“魔法”だったんだ……
lines.translated: "In any case, it was 'magic' that you and I finally managed to create as one by piecing our incomplete 'hearts' together, Kuro..."

lines.content: だからこれは俺の“魔法”であってそうではない。ふたりの“魔法”だ――だから。クロがこの“弾丸”を持っていることに、それほど不思議を引きずることはなかった
lines.translated: "So while it was my 'magic,' at the same time it wasn't. It was 'magic' belonging to the two of us--and because of that, I didn't dwell too much on how strange it was for you to have this 'bullet,' Kuro."

lines.content: クロにとっても自身の“魔法”だ。弾薬を全部俺が持っているというのもおかしな話。クロもいくつか手にしていた。
lines.translated: For Kuro, too, it was her own "magic." It would be strange for me to be holding all the ammunition myself. So Kuro had a few in her possession as well.

lines.content: そういうふうに考え、殆ど無意識的に、都合良く納得したのだ。あのときの俺は。
lines.translated: Thinking of it that way, the me of back then almost unconsciously convinced himself of what was most convenient.

lines.content: 同じような理屈で、あのときの俺はさ、クロが枝葉に別れた時間世界の中で、俺のことを追いかけて来れたことにもまた、深く追求することはなかった
lines.translated: "By that same logic, back then, I didn't look too deeply into how you were able to chase after me through those timelines that had branched off like twigs and leaves, either."

lines.content: 今になってそのときのクロが、どういう状況下にあったのかが、わかった。記憶の図書館。“夜の国”がそれを教えてくれた。大雅はそう言い、続けた。
lines.translated: Only now had he come to understand what kind of situation Kuro was in back then. The library of memories. The "Country of the Night" had taught him that. Saying so, Taiga continued.

lines.content: クロ。……ありがとう――本当に。[・|こ][・|れ]は君の“命”、だったんだね
lines.translated: "Kuro. ...Thank you--truly. This was your 'life,' wasn't it?"

lines.content: 心臓がどきっと跳ねた。
lines.translated: My heart gave a sudden leap.

lines.content: どういう気持ちでそうなったのだろう。わからない。わたしには何も、わからない。
lines.translated: What kind of feelings had made it do that? I don't know. I don't understand anything at all.

lines.content: ……猫の“命”は九つある。そういう“噂”というのか、伝説のようなものを聞いたことがあるけど。あれは、本当の話だったんだね
lines.translated: "...They say a cat has nine 'lives.' I'd heard that kind of 'rumor,' or legend, before. So that was a true story after all."

lines.content: 大雅は手のひらの“弾丸”を握りしめていた。
lines.translated: Taiga was clenching the "bullet" in the palm of his hand.

lines.content: 見下ろした町の光景――記憶の図書館には、[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き][・|の][・|わ][・|た][・|し][・|が][・|い][・|た]。あのときの記憶が、そこにはあった。
lines.translated: In the scenery of the town we looked down upon--in the library of memories, the me from back then was there. The memory of that time was right there.

lines.content: 大雅の手を握りしめている。
lines.translated: Clenching Taiga's hand tight.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”だ。大雅の部屋だ。
lines.translated: It's the "Dream Bed." It's Taiga's room.

lines.content: そこで一番最初に“拳銃の魔法”を使い、自分を撃ち抜き冷たくなった大雅の手をだ。
lines.translated: Holding the hand of Taiga, who had used the "handgun magic" for the very first time there, shooting himself through and growing cold.

lines.content: そうしてあのときのわたしは“力”を使い……。
lines.translated: And then, the me of back then used my "power"...

lines.content: わたしは、時間を飛び越えた大雅の後を、追いかけはじめた。
lines.translated: I began chasing after Taiga, who had leaped through time.

lines.content: こうして見下ろした光景の中から、あのときのわたしが、どういうふうにしたのかが……今のわたしの“心”に流れ込んでくる――
lines.translated: From within the scenery we look down upon like this, what the me of back then did... comes flowing into my "heart" right now--

lines.content: Ａ地点の大雅。
lines.translated: The Taiga of Point A.

lines.content: その“不幸”を取り込むことで、あのときのわたしは、大雅と同じように時間を飛び越えたのだ――Ａ地点のわたしは大雅と同じように死んだだろうか。
lines.translated: By taking in that "misfortune," the me of back then leaped through time just like Taiga did--did the me at Point A die in the same way as Taiga?

lines.content: ……その通りだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: わたしは死んだ。
lines.translated: I died.

lines.content: 大雅と同じように“弾丸”に頭を射貫かれ……。
lines.translated: With my head pierced through by a "bullet," just like Taiga...
And then, the Taiga of Point A woke up.

lines.content: ……ずっと気になってはいたんだ
lines.translated: "...It had been on my mind the whole time."

lines.content: 大雅が言う。
lines.translated: Taiga says.

lines.content: ハルを助け出す“魔法”の途中で。俺が、悪戯に枝葉に分けていったバットエンドの時間世界――柊ハルは自殺したまま。そして俺も、その後を追うようにして自ら命を絶ってしまった
lines.translated: "In the middle of the 'magic' to rescue Haru. Those bad-end timelines I needlessly branched off like twigs and leaves--where Hiiragi Haru remained dead by suicide. And where I, too, took my own life as if to follow right after her."

lines.content: そんな世界の中で、それからも暮らしていくあさひさんや、十夜。……幼馴染みのみんなのこと。俺は、俺のエゴで、みんなを無駄に傷つけ、不幸な時間を押しつけることを重ねてた
lines.translated: "In worlds like that, Asahi-san, Toya... and all my childhood friends would have to keep on living afterward. Out of my own ego, I kept needlessly hurting everyone and forcing unhappy timelines upon them over and over."

lines.content: それはみんなが、自分の死を悲しんでくれるという過剰な自意識を働かせなければならない。そういう前提があってのことではあるけれど……。
lines.translated: Though of course, that was based on the premise of an overinflated self-consciousness--assuming that everyone would grieve over his death...

lines.content: でもみんなは俺が想像するよりもずっと深く、悲しんでしまうはず――それをわかっていて俺は、引き金を引いたんだ
lines.translated: "Even so, everyone would surely grieve far more deeply than I could ever imagine--and knowing that full well, I pulled the trigger."

lines.content: 愛しい人を救い出したい。自分の“夢”を叶えるそのためだけを祈って。みんなの不幸に[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた
lines.translated: "Wanting to rescue the person I loved. Praying solely to fulfill my own 'dream.' I closed my eyes to everyone else's misfortune."

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."
"However, in those worlds, the only result left behind was that Kuro and Hiiragi Haru had died."

lines.content: クロは俺の“不幸”を受け取ることで、Ａ地点で死亡して――Ｂ地点へと跳んだ俺の後を追いかけた。
lines.translated: By taking on his "misfortune," Kuro had died at Point A--and chased after him when he leaped to Point B.

lines.content: あとはＣ地点、Ｄ地点と同じように君は繰り返し、死亡した俺に“力”を使って……その度に死を繰り返し、俺のところへ追いついてきてくれた
lines.translated: "After that, at Point C and Point D just the same, you repeatedly used your 'power' on me after I died... dying over and over again each time just to catch up to where I was."

lines.content: だけどクロは、七発目の“魔法”を届けようとして、俺の後を追いかけていたわけじゃない――クロは俺から“魔法”の使用許可を取り消そうとしていたんだ
lines.translated: "However, you weren't chasing after me in order to deliver the seventh shot of 'magic,' Kuro--you were trying to revoke my permission to use the 'magic.'"

lines.content: 少なくとも、最初の動機はそうであったはずだと大雅は言う。
lines.translated: At the very least, that must have been her initial motive, Taiga says.

lines.content: でも君は俺に、ハルとの時間を届けることを決めたから……。俺の“隣”に、ハルを届けようとしてくれたから
lines.translated: "But because you decided to deliver my time with Haru to me... Because you tried to bring Haru to my 'side'..."

lines.content: だからクロは俺の“魔法”を取り消すことはなく、七発目の“弾丸”をくれたんだ
lines.translated: "That's why you didn't revoke my 'magic,' Kuro, and gave me the seventh 'bullet' instead."

lines.content: でも……
クロが“特別な猫の力”を使う度――俺に起きた不幸を、君が肩代わりしてくれてたその度に。君は、九つある“命”をひとつずつ引き替えにしていた
lines.translated: "Every time you used the 'power of a special cat'--every time you took the misfortune that befell me onto your own shoulders in my stead. You were trading away your nine 'lives,' one by one."

lines.content: ……七発目の“[魔法|弾丸]”は、クロがその“命”のひとつを引き替えにして、創り上げたものだった――“夜の国”の影響下のもとで
lines.translated: "...The seventh 'bullet'--that seventh 'magic'--was something you created in exchange for one of those 'lives,' Kuro--under the influence of the 'Country of the Night.'"
"And that wasn't the only time you saved me, Kuro. Before then, and after then, it was always the same."

lines.content: ……“半透明”のあず咲先輩から、不用意に俺が受け取ってしまった“病”も、クロ、君が俺の代わりに引き受けてくれてたし
lines.translated: "...Even the 'illness' I carelessly took on from the 'translucent' Azusaki-senpai, you took upon yourself in my place, Kuro."
"And ever since then, too. Always."

lines.content: 俺がハルと一緒になって、その人生を終えるまで。君は、俺の……いいや。俺たちの人生を見守ってくれていた
lines.translated: "Until I got together with Haru and finished living out that life. You were watching over my... no, over our lives."

lines.content: 人生なんて当然、誰だっていいときばかりじゃない。むしろ良くなかったときのことのほうが強く印象に残ってる。それなのに……
lines.translated: "Naturally, nobody's life is made up of only good times. If anything, the bad times leave a much stronger impression. And yet..."

lines.content: 思えば俺たちの人生は、[・|上][・|手][・|く][・|い][・|き][・|す][・|ぎ][・|て][・|い][・|た]。大雅はそう言い、苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: Looking back on it, their lives had gone far too well. Saying that, Taiga gives a wry smile.

lines.content: 俺たちに何か悪いことが起これば、それを君が、その小さな身体で全部、受け止めていてくれたんだ
lines.translated: "Whenever something bad was about to happen to us, you took all of it upon yourself with that tiny body of yours."

lines.content: ハルと生きていく中で色々な困難や、もうだめかもしれないと思うことは何度かあったよ。でも、最後には必ず、それらは[・|上][・|手][・|く][・|い][・|く][・|ん][・|だ]
lines.translated: "While living my life with Haru, there were all sorts of hardships, and several times when I thought we might not make it through. Yet in the end, without fail, things always worked out."

lines.content: まるで誰かが……目に見えない誰かがそばにいて、俺たちのことをいつも手助けしてくれる
lines.translated: "It was as if someone... an unseen someone was right beside us, always helping us out."

lines.content: ……俺たちが困難を乗り越えるため、力を貸してくれている
lines.translated: "...Lending us strength so that we could overcome our hardships."

lines.content: そういうふうに感じざるを得ない場面が多くあった
lines.translated: "There were so many moments where I couldn't help but feel that way."

lines.content: ……そうした瞬間のことを、君が語らなくても……全部。“夜”が教えてくれたよ
lines.translated: "...Even without you speaking a word about those moments... All of it. The 'Night' taught me everything."

lines.content: ありがとうと大雅は言う。
lines.translated: "Thank you," Taiga says.

lines.content: 俺の“隣”に、ハルのことを届けてくれた。君はひとりぼっちになってしまうのに。それでも俺に、幸せを届け続けていてくれて……ありがとう。本当に、ありがとう
lines.translated: "You brought Haru to my 'side.' Even though it meant you would end up all alone. Even so, you kept delivering happiness to me... Thank you. Truly, thank you."

lines.content: ……全部？
lines.translated: "...Everything?"

lines.content: 恐る恐る問いかけた――わたしには、きみに謝らなくてはいけないことがある。
lines.translated: Timidly, I asked--there is something I have to apologize to you for.

lines.content: ……本当に、全部、わかったの？
lines.translated: "...Did you really figure out everything?"

lines.content: うん……。たぶんね
lines.translated: "Yeah... Probably."

lines.content: その心の動きまでは、さすがにわからないけれど……
lines.translated: "Though I can't go so far as to know the exact workings of your heart..."

lines.content: ちゃんと全部、わかってるよ
lines.translated: "I understand all of it properly."

lines.content: ……いや。少なくとも、俺が知りたいと願ったことはだいたいね。ちゃんとわかってると思う
lines.translated: "...Or rather, at least most of what I wished to know. I think I understand it properly."

lines.content: 俺がこの人生で、ハルと一緒に、幸せに生きられたのは君のおかげだ。すごく。……すごく、感謝してる
lines.translated: "It's thanks to you that I was able to live happily together with Haru in this life. I'm so... so very grateful to you."

lines.content: でも同じくらい、今となってはすごく、さみしいことでもあったよ。
lines.translated: "But just as much, looking back on it now, it was also something deeply lonely."

lines.content: 小さな声でそう続けた大雅に、でも、わたしは何も言えなかった――大雅がわたしのがんばりだとか、さみしさだとか。きみだけのためにと願い、過ごした時間。
lines.translated: To Taiga, who continued in such a quiet voice, I couldn't say anything at all--my efforts, my loneliness. The time I spent wishing solely for his sake.

lines.content: そういう気持ちや“心”を全部、わかってくれた。
lines.translated: Taiga had understood all of those feelings and my "heart."

lines.content: よろこんでいいはずだ。すべて報われたように感じてもいいはずなのだ。
lines.translated: I ought to be happy. I ought to feel as though everything has been rewarded.

lines.content: でも、胸には言葉にできない複雑な気持ちが溢れてる。
lines.translated: Yet my chest is overflowing with complicated feelings I cannot put into words.

lines.content: ……大雅。わたしには
lines.translated: "...Taiga. There is something I..."

lines.content: わたしにはやり残したことがある。
lines.translated: There is something I have left undone.

lines.content: それを果たすため、こうして“夜”の中できみを探した――謝るためだ。大雅に、わたしは謝りたい。
lines.translated: In order to fulfill it, I searched for you within the "Night" like this--in order to apologize. I want to apologize to Taiga.

lines.content: ましろだ
lines.translated: "It's Mashiro."

lines.content: 大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Taiga says.

lines.content: ……クロ。君は、ましろに関する記憶を俺から切り取ったよね。その“特別”な“猫”の持つ“力”でだ。そうして俺の中からきれいさっぱり“夢”も“希望”も消し去った
lines.translated: "...Kuro. You cut the memories of Mashiro out of me, didn't you? With the 'power' you possess as a 'special cat.' And by doing so, you wiped both my 'dream' and my 'hope' completely clean from inside me."

lines.content: それは、ましろのことは忘れてしまったほうが大雅は幸せだと感じたからだ――
lines.translated: That was because I felt Taiga would be happier if he forgot all about Mashiro--

lines.content: これからは“夢”を忘れ、柊ハルとこの時代の中でごくごくふつうに、奏大雅として生きていくことが幸せだ。
lines.translated: That forgetting his "dream" from then on, and living a completely ordinary life as Kanade Taiga in this era with Hiiragi Haru, would be his happiness.

lines.content: そんなあのときのわたしが下した身勝手な発想をも、大雅はもはやすべて見通してしまっているようだ。
lines.translated: It seems Taiga has already seen right through even that selfish notion I had decided upon back then.

lines.content: そして、俺の“隣”にハルを届けてくれた――クロ。君が真っ暗闇に迷ってしまったハルを導き。勇気づけてさえくれて
lines.translated: "And then, you brought Haru to my 'side'--Kuro. You guided Haru when she was lost in pitch-black darkness. You even gave her courage."

lines.content: ちゃんとわかってる。……全部、俺は知ってるよ
lines.translated: "I understand it properly. ...I know all of it."
I don't understand.

lines.content: わたしはきみが大切だ。わたしの中に九つもある“命”なんかより。きみの中にあるたったひとつの“命”が、この世界中の何より大切。
lines.translated: You are precious to me. Far more than the nine "lives" inside me. The single, solitary "life" inside you is more precious than anything in this entire world.

lines.content: それ以外の物語などわたしの“命”には存在しない。かけらもだ。[・|そ][・|う][・|信][・|じ][・|た][・|い]。
lines.translated: No story other than that exists within my "life." Not even a single fragment. That is what I want to believe.

lines.content: それなのに、わたしはきみのことが何も、わからない――
lines.translated: And yet, I don't understand anything about you at all--

lines.content: きみが今こうして話している中で、いったい何を考えているのか。これから何を、しようとしているのか。何もわからないままなんだ。
lines.translated: As you sit here talking like this right now, what on earth are you thinking? What are you about to do from here on? I still don't understand anything at all.

lines.content: ここからならわかるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to understand from here?

lines.content: 今日まで大雅が何を想い、願いながら、生きてきたのか。
lines.translated: What Taiga has felt, and wished for, as he lived up until today.

lines.content: ……その“心”の中を知ることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to know what is inside his "heart"?

lines.content: 星空みたいな町の光景を見下ろしてみる。
lines.translated: I look down at the view of the town, which looks just like a starry sky.

lines.content: 時間の墓場。あるいは記憶の図書館。
lines.translated: A graveyard of time. Or perhaps a library of memories.

lines.content: そのきらめきの中に、わたしの知りたい“いつか”の記憶を探そうとする――そのときだった。
lines.translated: Within that glittering light, I try to search for the memories of "someday" that I want to know--and it happened right then.

lines.content: わたしは……。
lines.translated: I am...

lines.content: 胸が、締め付けられるような痛さを覚えた。
lines.translated: I felt a wrenching pain in my chest.

lines.content: 呼吸が止まる。目の前が真っ白に、なった。
lines.translated: My breath stops. Everything before my eyes turned pure white.

lines.content: ……ごめん。クロ
lines.translated: "...Sorry, Kuro."

lines.content: わたしが[・|見][・|た][・|も][・|の]に気づいたのだろう。大雅は、言った。
lines.translated: He must have noticed what I had just seen. Taiga spoke.

lines.content: 俺も君と同じだったんだ
lines.translated: "I was the same as you."

lines.content: わたしと、同じ……？
lines.translated: "The same... as me?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……ずっと君に、隠してたことがある。どうしても話せなかった秘密があるんだ
lines.translated: "...There's something I've been hiding from you all this time. A secret I just couldn't bring myself to tell you."

lines.content: 大雅の秘密。
lines.translated: Taiga's secret.

lines.content: こうして見下ろす町の光りから、[・|そ][・|れ]をわたしはたった今、知ったのだ。
lines.translated: From the lights of the town we were looking down upon, I had just now learned what that was.

lines.content: “奏大雅とましろ。あのふたりを蘇らせる。そしてふたりにあり得たはずの幸せな未来を取り戻す”
lines.translated: "'To revive Kanade Taiga and Mashiro. And to take back the happy future that the two of them should have had.'"

lines.content: それが本来、大雅の願った“夢”だった。
lines.translated: That was originally the "dream" Taiga had wished for.

lines.content: でもわたしがその“夢”を引き受けた。大雅には大雅自身の人生を生きてほしかったから――だからもう、その“夢”はどこかに消えてなくなってしまったものと思っていた。
lines.translated: But I took that "dream" upon myself. Because I wanted Taiga to live his own life--so I had thought that "dream" had already vanished away to somewhere and ceased to exist.

lines.content: でもね。……クロ。俺も、君に隠し事をしてた
lines.translated: "Even so... Kuro. I was keeping a secret from you, too."

lines.content: 大雅は繰り返し、言う。
lines.translated: Taiga repeats himself.

lines.content: 俺、本当はあのとき、“最後の魔法”をちゃんと“想像”してたんだ
lines.translated: "Back then, the truth is, I really had properly 'imagined' the 'Last Magic.'"

lines.content: “夜の女王”と“魔法少女”たちの戦いだよ。その果てに、それぞれが人生に抱える“困難”を、見事打破するに必要な“[魔法|奇跡]”を自由に描き、“外の世界”に持ち帰る
lines.translated: "Through the battle between the 'Queen of the Night' and the 'magical girls.' At the end of it, everyone freely envisioned the 'miracle'--the 'magic'--needed to brilliantly overcome the 'hardships' they carried in their lives, and brought it back to the 'outside world.'"

lines.content: ハルも千和も、自分の人生を救うための“魔法”を思い描いた。
lines.translated: Both Haru and Chiwa envisioned the "magic" needed to save their own lives.

lines.content: 姫織はほんの少し迷いはしたけれど……。
lines.translated: Though Himeori hesitated just a little bit...

lines.content: 智仁もだ。
lines.translated: And Tomohito, too.

lines.content: “逢いたい人と時を超え出逢うための魔法”を、十年越しで歌という“形”にできたのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: After ten years, I think he was finally able to give the "magic to transcend time and meet the person he longed to see" the "form" of a song.

lines.content: だけど俺には無理だった。クロにはそう話してた
lines.translated: "However, it was impossible for me. That's what I told you, Kuro."

lines.content: 俺には“心”がない
lines.translated: "That I had no 'heart.'"

lines.content: そういうふうに育たなければと思ってた。大人たちに期待されたとおりにだ
lines.translated: "I thought I had to grow up that way. Just as the adults expected of me."

lines.content: “心”がないのにまとものな“想像力”など持ち得るはずもない。だから……俺には“魔法”を描けなかった
lines.translated: "Without a 'heart,' there was no way I could possibly possess any decent 'imagination.' And so... I couldn't envision any 'magic.'"

lines.content: うん。……そうだね。
lines.translated: Yeah. ...That's right.

lines.content: そういうふうに、聞いてたよ。だから一緒に必要な“魔法”を“想像”しようって。それが危ないものじゃないのなら、わたしが“許可”を出すからって
lines.translated: "That's what you told me. So I said we should 'imagine' the necessary 'magic' together. And that if it wasn't anything dangerous, I would grant you 'permission.'"

lines.content: そうだね。そういう“関係性”が障害だった。俺が本当の“代償”を支払うためには
lines.translated: "Right. That very 'relationship' was the obstacle. In order for me to pay the true 'price.'"

lines.content: 本当の……
lines.translated: "The true..."

lines.content: ああ。ごめんね。だから俺は、君を欺した――
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm sorry. That's why I deceived you--"

lines.content: “みんなの叶えられないままになってる願いを叶える。その手伝いをする”
lines.translated: "'To grant the wishes of everyone that have been left unfulfilled. To help them do that.'"

lines.content: そういう安全な“代償”を、君にはでっち上げて話したんだ
lines.translated: "I made up that safe 'price' and told it to you."

lines.content: そうでなければ、やさしい君からとてもじゃないけど、“許可”なんて得られるはずがない。そう、思った
lines.translated: "Otherwise, there was no way I could ever get 'permission' from someone as kind as you. That's what I thought."

lines.content: 俺は、みんなみたいに自分の“魔法”を使うことに躊躇う理由はなかった。すぐにでも得られた“奇跡”を実行してしまいたかった。でも、そうはできなかったんだ
lines.translated: "Unlike everyone else, I had no reason to hesitate to use my 'magic.' I wanted to carry out the 'miracle' I had obtained right away. However, I couldn't do that."

lines.content: 俺の求めた“魔法”はあんまりにも規模が大きい。世界そのものを――時間そのものを、未来永劫、改変させてしまおうというものだ
lines.translated: "The 'magic' I sought was simply far too massive in scale. It was something that would alter the world itself--time itself, for all eternity."
"...And on top of that, once it was granted, there would no longer be anyone left who could make the payment."

lines.content: だから“夜”は俺に、“魔法”を使用するより先に“代償”を支払う義務のようなものを、課したんだ
lines.translated: "That's why the 'Night' imposed something like an obligation upon me to pay the 'price' before using the 'magic.'"

lines.content: その“代償”は……
lines.translated: "And that 'price' was..."

lines.content: わたしの中に、[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]の光景が。
lines.translated: Inside me, the scene from that moment appears.

lines.content: 大雅がどのような“魔法”と“代償”とを描いたのか。
lines.translated: What kind of "magic" and "price" Taiga had envisioned.

lines.content: そのときの記憶が、見下ろした“夜の図書館”から、一瞬、フラッシュバックする――
lines.translated: For an instant, the memory of that moment flashes back from the "library of the Night" we were looking down upon--

lines.content: 『お願いします――』
lines.translated: "Please--"

lines.content: 幼い大雅が“夜”を見上げ、祈ってた。
lines.translated: A young Taiga was looking up at the "Night" and praying.

lines.content: 『どうか、この“夢”を叶えてください』
lines.translated: "Please, grant this 'dream' of mine."

lines.content: 幼い大雅が両手を合わせ、いっぱいの涙を流し……いっぱいの花びら舞うさくらの“夜”に、必死になって願ってた。
lines.translated: Pressing his hands together and shedding endless tears... in the cherry blossom "Night" where countless petals danced, the young Taiga was wishing with all his might.

lines.content: 『――“いつも一緒に笑い合い、生きていきたいと願う。そんな愛しい人たちに、憎まれ、疎まれ、嫌われてしまうこと”』
lines.translated: "--'To be hated, shunned, and despised by the beloved people I wish to always laugh and live together with.'"

lines.content: それが大雅の“代償”だった。
lines.translated: That was Taiga's "price."
