lines.content: “嫌われること”を誰より恐れた少女の“代償”――いいや。もはや“悪夢”と言ってさえいいだろうものと、同じものを大雅は自身に求めた。
lines.translated: The "price" of the girl who feared "being hated" more than anyone--no. Taiga had demanded for himself the exact same thing as what could practically be called a "nightmare."

lines.content: 奏大雅とましろを[・|蘇][・|ら][・|せ]、ふたりに幸せな未来を取り戻すこと――その“夢”を叶えるに相応しい“代償”はそれしかないと、大雅は、自身で納得してしまったのだ。
lines.translated: To revive Kanade Taiga and Mashiro, and take back a happy future for the two of them--Taiga had convinced himself that there was no other "price" worthy of granting that "dream."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.
To revive the two of them.

lines.content: 完全な“悪夢”と成りはててしまってたましろを、俺には……俺たちには、この手で消滅させてしまう以外に止める方法がなかったんだ
lines.translated: "Mashiro had completely turned into a 'nightmare,' and for me... for us, there was no other way to stop her than to erase her with our own hands."

lines.content: 大雅は“夜の女王を打倒するのではなく、救出するというのであれば協力する”――そのように言っていた。でも、そんなのは夢物語だった。まるで現実が見えていなかった。
lines.translated: Taiga had said, "If we're going to rescue the Queen of the Night rather than defeat her, then I'll cooperate." However, that was just a pipe dream. He had been completely blind to reality.

lines.content: ましろに芽生えたまっくろな“心”は……。
lines.translated: The pitch-black "heart" that had sprouted within Mashiro...

lines.content: 巨大な満月の形をしたましろの“悪夢”は……。
lines.translated: Mashiro's "nightmare," which had taken the shape of a gigantic full moon...

lines.content: 今にも地上に激突しようかというほど大きく、おおきく、ふくれあがってしまったその“闇”は……。
lines.translated: That "darkness," which had swollen so big, so very big, that it looked ready to crash into the earth at any moment...

lines.content: ましろの、自分自身を許せない心と……。
lines.translated: Was Mashiro's own heart that could not forgive itself...

lines.content: 愛されるべき小さな子たちを愛してほしいという、強い、とてもつよい願いの形でもあったのだ――
lines.translated: And it was also the form of a strong, overwhelmingly strong wish for the little children who deserved love to be loved--

lines.content: そんな気持ちの全部が最大の“悪夢”となって、毎年、あの日の“夜”に、現れる。
lines.translated: All of those feelings became the greatest "nightmare," appearing every year on the "Night" of that day.

lines.content: “[まっしろな満月|夜の女王]”が地上に落ちればすべてが終わりだ。
lines.translated: If the "Queen of the Night"--that pure-white full moon--were to fall to the earth, everything would end.

lines.content: 人々は見上げた夜空に浮かぶ“夜の女王”を憎み、その存在を打倒するため、あるいは遠い宇宙の果てに逃避するため、[・|そ][・|の][・|他][・|の][・|命]を見捨ててしまうのだろう。
lines.translated: People would hate the "Queen of the Night" floating in the night sky above, and in order to defeat her existence, or perhaps to flee to the far reaches of space, they would likely abandon all other lives.

lines.content: “夜”の中では、ましろとよく似た心を持つ子ども達が……。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," children with hearts very similar to Mashiro's...

lines.content: 両親から愛されたい、まるでなかったことのように捨てられたとしても、深いふかい闇の中に閉じ込められ続けたとしても……大切な人に振り向いてもらいたい。
lines.translated: Wanting to be loved by their parents, even if they were thrown away as though they had never existed, even if they were kept locked away in deep, deep darkness... wanting the people precious to them to look their way.

lines.content: 心はいつも、さみしいばかり。
lines.translated: Their hearts are always so terribly lonely.
In that way, it is precisely the girls carrying a sadness so similar to Mashiro's who are drawn to the "Night" and gather together--

lines.content: その子どもたちは力を合わせ、人間たちの未来を護ろうとするだろう。
lines.translated: Those children would join forces and try to protect the future of humanity.
"That in itself was Mashiro's goal."

lines.content: “夜”の中で、最大の“悪夢”と化した自身を憎悪させ、破壊させることで、ましろの“願い”を叶えるための“魔法”は、ようやく、発動される。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," by making them hate and destroy her own self, which had turned into the greatest "nightmare," the "magic" to grant Mashiro's "wish" would finally be activated.

lines.content: “夜の世界”“夜の外の世界”
lines.translated: The "World of the Night," and the "World Outside the Night."

lines.content: そのどちらの世界をも同時に救う――“前提を書き換える”
lines.translated: Saving both of those worlds at the same time--"rewriting the premise."

lines.content: たったひとつの[代償|犠牲]のもとに。
lines.translated: At the cost of a single sacrifice--a single price.

lines.content: その想いは強固であった。
lines.translated: That resolve was unshakeable.

lines.content: それはまるで、ましろが、[・|ぼ][・|く]への罪の意識から、自分自身を罰するかのような行為で……
lines.translated: "It was an act as though Mashiro were punishing herself out of a sense of guilt toward me..."

lines.content: ……その強固さは。
lines.translated: That unshakeable resolve.

lines.content: ましろが自分自身を嫌い、憎む想いが、“悪夢”として形となった結果なのだろう。
lines.translated: It must have been the result of Mashiro's feelings of disliking and hating herself taking form as a "nightmare."

lines.content: もはや救出するなどという戯れ言を受け付けられるようなものではなかった――力を合わせ、打倒するほかになかったのだ。
lines.translated: It was no longer something that could entertain foolish talk of a rescue--there was no choice left but to join forces and defeat her.

lines.content: ……[・|俺][・|が]、[・|俺][・|の][・|存][・|在][・|が]、[・|ま][・|し][・|ろ][・|を][・|殺][・|し][・|た]。たぶん二度もだ。一度目は遠い未来の中で。二度目は、遠い過去の中で
lines.translated: "...I, my very existence, killed Mashiro. Twice, probably. The first time was in the distant future. The second time was in the distant past."

lines.content: もう、引き返せない
lines.translated: "There's no turning back anymore."

lines.content: ……必ずだ。何があろうと必ず“夢”を叶えてみせる。この手でふたりを蘇らせて、幸せな時間をふたりに届ける――……クロ。君が俺に、そうしてくれたみたいに
lines.translated: "...Without fail. No matter what happens, I will make my 'dream' come true without fail. I will revive the two of them with these hands, and deliver a happy time to them--...Kuro. Just like you did for me."

lines.content: わたし達は、“夜”の町を見下ろした。
lines.translated: We looked down at the town of the "Night."

lines.content: 思い描くすべての“想い”が形となる“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Country of the Night," where every envisioned "feeling" takes form.

lines.content: あり得たかもしれない[時間|可能性]の眠る“時間の墓場”
lines.translated: The "graveyard of time," where the possibilities--the times--that might have been lie asleep.

lines.content: ……すべての可能性が、時間と空間とを記録媒体として保存される“記憶の図書館”
lines.translated: The "library of memories," where every possibility is preserved using time and space as a recording medium.

lines.content: 何とでも呼べば良い。わたしには何が正しく、何が一番ぴったりなのかなんてわからない。
lines.translated: You can call it whatever you like. I don't know what is correct, or what fits it best.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: 見下ろした景色のその中に、今日までこの町で起きた出来事と、起きた[・|か][・|も]しれない出来事とが、小さな星の光りのようにして瞬いていることだけは、わかる。
lines.translated: All I know is that within the scenery we look down upon, the events that have happened in this town up until today, and the events that *might* have happened, are twinkling like the light of tiny stars.

lines.content: 杏藤千和。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: 夜月姫織。
lines.translated: Yotsuki Himeori.

lines.content: ふたりそれぞれと大雅が歩んだ[・|か][・|も][・|し][・|れ][・|な][・|い]時間まで……。その光りの中には存在している。
lines.translated: Even the time that Taiga might have walked alongside each of those two... exists within that light.

lines.content: 千和との光りの中で、姫織との光りの中で、大雅は彼女らの“魔法”を使い……。
lines.translated: Within the light with Chiwa, within the light with Himeori, Taiga used their "magic"...

lines.content: そうして、その叶えがたい人生の難題を共に乗り越え、最期の瞬間まで手と手を取り合い、微笑み合い、生きていた。
lines.translated: And so, they overcame those insurmountable hardships of life together, holding hands and smiling at each other until the very last moment as they lived out their lives.

lines.content: ……その中でわたしが今回と同じように、大雅からましろの記憶を奪ってしまう。そういう瞬間さえもそこにはあった。
lines.translated: And within those lights, there were even moments where, just like this time, I stole the memories of Mashiro away from Taiga.

lines.content: ……わかってる。ちゃんと全部、わかってるよ
lines.translated: "...I know. I understand all of it properly."

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: わたしが大雅の“夢”を奪ったから……。
lines.translated: Because I stole Taiga's "dream"...

lines.content: この町のどこかに、大雅が千和と人生を共にする時間世界もあったろう。
lines.translated: Somewhere in this town, there must have been a timeline where Taiga spent his life together with Chiwa.

lines.content: 姫織と生きていく可能性の世界もまた、あったのだろう。
lines.translated: And there must also have been a world of possibility where he lived on with Himeori.

lines.content: そういう“もしも”まで、この町の時間と空間の図書館には“物語”として――もしかすると一冊の本として、記録されている。
lines.translated: Even those "what-ifs" are recorded as "stories" in this town's library of time and space--perhaps even as a single book.

lines.content: あるいは、誰も触れられない、知ることさえできもしない、[・|死][・|ん][・|で][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|た][・|時][・|間][・|と][・|し][・|て]、[・|時][・|層]深くに、埋葬されてしまっているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, as dead time that no one can touch or even know of, they have been buried deep within the strata of time.
"There might have been times like that, too. Just being able to confirm that here, like this, is more than enough."

lines.content: ……ようやくだ
lines.translated: "...Finally."

lines.content: 大雅は言った。
lines.translated: Taiga had said.

lines.content: 今夜。ようやく……、“魔法”の準備が整った
lines.translated: "Tonight. Finally... the preparations for the 'magic' are complete."

lines.content: 俺の、“魔法”の“代償”は――
lines.translated: "The 'price' of my 'magic' is--"
"To wish to always smile and live together... and yet to end up hated, shunned, and despised by *the beloved people whose lives I supported and whom I rescued*..."

lines.content: 大雅は、手のひらの薬莢を夜空に落とした。
lines.translated: Taiga dropped the shell casing from his palm into the night sky.

lines.content: すると……。
lines.translated: And when I did...

lines.content: するとまるで、花びらがひとひら舞い落ちた静かな湖畔のように、大きな……とても大きな波紋が、“夜”の空に広がった。
lines.translated: At once, just like a single flower petal drifting down onto a quiet lakeside, a large... an immense ripple spread across the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: ……いや
思わずだ。
lines.translated: It was involuntary.

lines.content: ……だめだよ
lines.translated: "...You mustn't."

lines.content: わたしは思わず、手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: Without thinking, I reached out my hand.

lines.content: その手のひらで何を掴もうと思ったのかは、自分でもわからない。
lines.translated: Even I didn't know what I had hoped to grasp with my palm.

lines.content: ただ、もう既に取り返しの付かなくなった時間のすべてを、どうにかしてたぐり寄せたいと願ってた……けれど、遅い。
lines.translated: I simply wished to somehow reel back all the time that was already beyond recovery... yet, it was too late.

lines.content: 何もかも、遅いのだ。
lines.translated: Everything was too late.
Everything *was being rewritten*.

lines.content: ……俺はあのふたりを蘇らせる
lines.translated: "...I will revive the two of them."

lines.content: 大雅は、言った。
lines.translated: Taiga said.

lines.content: そしてあのふたりに、あり得たはずの幸福なその先の人生を、贈りたいんだ
lines.translated: "And I want to gift the two of them the happy future lives they should have had."

lines.content: 時間と空間のその中に保存されたあらゆる時間。ありとあらゆる可能性。[・|そ][・|の][・|世][・|界]。
lines.translated: Every era preserved within that time and space. Every single possibility. *That world*.

lines.content: “夜の女王”はもうどこにもいない、と大雅は言った。
lines.translated: The "Queen of the Night" was no longer anywhere to be found, Taiga said.

lines.content: 今夜、世界中の嫌われ者は――……全人類の敵は、[彼女|女王]から[俺|王]になる
lines.translated: "Tonight, the most hated existence in the world--...the enemy of all humanity will change from her, the Queen, to me, the King."

lines.content: 俺の“命”は、今夜“代償”を支払い終えたことで、“夜の王”に産まれ直す――そうして、[彼女|女王]の存在した時間のすべてに、入れ替わる。
lines.translated: Having finished paying the "price" tonight, my "life" will be reborn as the "King of the Night"--and in doing so, I will take her place across all the time she existed as the Queen.

lines.content: あらゆる時代、あらゆる時間の静かなる隣人として存在する不思議の世界――“夜の国”を、通じて。
lines.translated: All through the wondrous world that exists as a silent neighbor to every era and every time--the "Country of the Night."

lines.content: それはつまり、少女たちに打倒された“悪夢”は“夜の女王”なんかではなく、“夜の王”として、多くのひとびとの心に刻まれ直すということだ。
lines.translated: In other words, the "nightmare" overthrown by the girls will be etched anew into the hearts of many people not as the "Queen of the Night," but as the "King of the Night."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。自分が、助け出したいと願い……
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Wishing to rescue them myself..."

lines.content: ハルの“魔法”を使い、その願いを叶え、その人生にハッピーエンドを引き寄せて……
lines.translated: "Using Haru's 'magic' to grant those wishes, drawing a happy ending into their lives..."

lines.content: そうして[少女たち|助け出したもの達]から、憎まれ、恨まれ、殺される
lines.translated: "And then, to be hated, resented, and killed by those very girls I rescued."

lines.content: ましろが大切にしていた“夜のイキモノ”たちから、ましろ自身が望み、そうされてしまったように
lines.translated: "Just as Mashiro herself wished for, and had done to her, by the 'Creatures of the Night' she cherished so much."

lines.content: ……そういう“代償”を支払うことではじめて、俺の求めた“魔法”はあのふたりを蘇らせてくれる。……そのはず、なんだよ
lines.translated: "...Only by paying that kind of 'price' will the 'magic' I sought finally revive the two of them. ...At least, that's how it should be."

lines.content: 今夜、俺は……全人類の敵となる
lines.translated: "Tonight, I... will become the enemy of all humanity."

lines.content: 少年時代のいつかの自分自身にさえ、俺は憎まれ、恨まれ、[殺される|消される]ことになるんだろう
lines.translated: "Even my own younger self from some point in my boyhood will probably come to hate me, resent me, and erase me."

lines.content: ああ、そうさ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: そうだとも。
lines.translated: Indeed it is.

lines.content: 誰もが俺を憎悪する。……そうして俺の“魔法”ははじめて、俺の“夢”を叶えてくれる――めちゃくちゃに絡まり合った糸は、そのようにして、解きほぐされていく必要があるんだよ
lines.translated: "Everyone will loathe me. ...And only then will my 'magic' finally grant my 'dream'--the hopelessly tangled threads need to be unraveled in just that way."

lines.content: 大雅の言うことの全部は、そのときのわたしにはわからなかった。
lines.translated: At the time, I couldn't understand everything Taiga was saying.

lines.content: でも、そんなことはしてほしくない――ましろの代わりをするのだということは、つまり、大雅は自分ひとりだけを犠牲にし、あらゆるものを救おうとしているということだ。
lines.translated: But I didn't want him to do something like that--taking Mashiro's place meant that Taiga was trying to sacrifice himself alone to save everything else.

lines.content: それくらいは、わたしにもわかった。
lines.translated: Even I understood that much.

lines.content: やめて……
lines.translated: "Stop..."

lines.content: と言っても、もう止まらないだろう。
lines.translated: Even so, there was probably no stopping him now.

lines.content: 大雅はこの瞬間のために、長い、とても長い時間を過ごしてきたのだろうから――
lines.translated: Because Taiga must have spent a long, very long time living just for this moment--

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|れ]は、心も名前も何もない、まっしろな[ぼく|あの子]だった頃から、ずっとその胸に秘めていた“夢”……、なのだろうから。
lines.translated: Because *this* must have been the "dream" he kept hidden in his heart ever since he was a pure-white boy with no heart, no name, and nothing at all...

lines.content: いったいいつ、その覚悟を決めたのだろう。わからない。
lines.translated: Just when had he made that resolve? I don't know.

lines.content: わたしには何もわからないよ。
lines.translated: I don't understand anything at all.

lines.content: だから代わりに“どうして”と、何度となくわたしは問い直す。
lines.translated: So instead, I asked "Why?" over and over again.

lines.content: ……どうしてなの、大雅。きみはどうして、あのふたりのためにそこまでするの。わからない
lines.translated: "...Why, Taiga? Why are you going that far for those two? I don't understand."

lines.content: わからないよ、大雅。
lines.translated: I don't understand, Taiga.

lines.content: 大雅のせいじゃない。あのふたりがああなったのは……望んだ未来を歩むことができなかったのは、それが、ふたりの運命だったから
lines.translated: "It's not your fault, Taiga. The reason those two ended up like that... the reason they couldn't walk the future they wished for was because that was their fate."

lines.content: それなのに、自分の全部を犠牲にしたいと願えるほどの……。ねえ、大雅。きみとあのふたりの関係は、そうまでして救いたいと願えるほどのもの、だったの……？
lines.translated: "And yet, to wish to sacrifice everything you have... Hey, Taiga. Was your relationship with those two really something that makes you wish to go so far to save them...?"

lines.content: わたしには大雅が何を考えているのかわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know what Taiga is thinking.

lines.content: それはわたしが人間じゃないからだろうか。だから人の“心”がわからない。
lines.translated: Is it because I'm not human? Is that why I don't understand the human "heart"?

lines.content: だからわたしは、大雅のことをいつまで経っても、理解できない――……さみしい。
lines.translated: That's why, no matter how much time passes, I still can't understand Taiga--...It's lonely.

lines.content: 大切な人が何を想い、苦しみ、泣いていたのかもわからないなんて――さみしいよ、ずっと、ずっと。わたしは、さみしい。
lines.translated: To not even know what the person precious to me was feeling, suffering over, and crying about--it's so lonely, always, always. I am so lonely.

lines.content: いやだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……だめ。泣いてしまいそう。
lines.translated: No good. I feel like I'm going to cry.

lines.content: ……胸が、痛い。痛いよ大雅。
lines.translated: My chest hurts. It hurts, Taiga.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ。考えたことはないかな
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. Have you ever thought about this?"

lines.content: ……なにを？
lines.translated: "...About what?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 大雅はうなずき、どこか晴れ晴れとしたような声で、言うのだ。
lines.translated: Taiga nodded, and spoke in a voice that sounded almost clear and bright.

lines.content: 子どもの頃からずっと、大好きな物語があったとする。本でも、映画でも、歌でもいいよ
lines.translated: "Suppose there's a story you've loved ever since you were a child. It could be a book, a movie, or a song."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: それは本当に、ほんとうに大切な物語なんだ。何度触れても飽きることはない。[・|そ][・|れ][・|以][・|外]の展開もエンディングもありえない。無駄のないうつくしい物語だ
lines.translated: "It's a truly, truly precious story. You never get tired of it no matter how many times you experience it. No *other* development or ending could possibly exist. It's a beautiful story with nothing wasted."

lines.content: でもさ、と大雅は言うのだ。
lines.translated: "But you know," Taiga said.

lines.content: でも……捲ったページの中に“こいつ”さえいなかったなら、そのお話は、いったいどうなっていたんだろうか……
lines.translated: "What if... within those turned pages, if only 'this guy' hadn't been there, just how would that story have turned out...?"

lines.content: もっともっと無駄もなく、うつくしいお話になっていたんじゃないだろうか。
lines.translated: Wouldn't it have become an even more flawless, even more beautiful story?

lines.content: たとえ“そいつ”自身には罪はなくとも、“そいつ”が存在してしまったから、大好きな物語を生きるヒーローもヒロインも、大いに苦しみ、無理矢理にでも成長せざるを得なかった
lines.translated: "Even if 'that guy' himself bore no sin, just because 'he' happened to exist, both the hero and the heroine living in that beloved story suffered terribly, forced to grow up against their will."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: “そいつ”さえ居なければ、大好きなヒーローもヒロインも、何もそこまで苦しまなくても良かった。
lines.translated: If only "that guy" hadn't been there, neither the beloved hero nor the heroine would have had to suffer that much at all.

lines.content: そういうふうに思ったことはないかな
lines.translated: "Have you ever thought about it like that?"

lines.content: 俺は、あるよ。いつもだ。いつもそう思ってばかりいた
lines.translated: "I have. Always. That was all I ever thought about."

lines.content: 奏大雅。そして、ましろ。ふたりを中心とした物語に……、主役のふたりを幸せに向かわせるはずだった、お話の中に。こんな俺がもし、関わらなければ――……ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga. And Mashiro. In the story centered around the two of them... inside the tale that was supposed to lead the two protagonists toward happiness. If someone like me had never gotten involved--...Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: もしそんな可能性がこの町のどこかの時間にあるのなら。そんな[未来|時間]を見つけられたなら。ふたりは、どうなっていたんだろう。それを試してみたいんだ
lines.translated: "If such a possibility exists in some era of this town. If I could find such a time, such a future. What would have become of those two? I want to test that out."

lines.content: それこそが、ふたりに未来を届けるということだ――見下ろした“夜”に満ちた記憶の“[瞬き|図書館]”には、しかし、ふたりがそんな人生を歩む時間世界は見当たらない。
lines.translated: That in itself is what it means to deliver a future to the two of them--yet, within the twinkling "library" of memories filling the "Night" we looked down upon, no timeline where the two of them walked such a life was anywhere to be found.
*Not yet*.

lines.content: だからだ。
lines.translated: That's why.

lines.content: だから誰かが、“魔法”くらいの“奇跡”を起こし、ふたりには決してあり得なかったのだろう可能性を……、幸せな時間世界を、贈り届けなくちゃならないんだ――ほら、あんなふうに
lines.translated: "That's why someone has to make a 'miracle' on the level of 'magic' happen, and gift them a possibility that could never have existed for the two of them... a happy timeline--look, just like that."

lines.content: 大雅が指をさす。
lines.translated: Taiga pointed his finger.

lines.content: 見下ろす“夜”の瞬きだ。
lines.translated: At the twinkling of the "Night" below us.

lines.content: そこにあたらしい光りがひとつ、産まれはじめていた。
lines.translated: There, a single new light was beginning to be born.
*In exchange*.

lines.content: やだ
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: わたしは、首を振る――……やめて。
lines.translated: I shook my head--...Stop.

lines.content: だめ、だよ……
lines.translated: "Don't..."

lines.content: 大雅が……。
lines.translated: Taiga is...

lines.content: きみが、消えてく……
lines.translated: "You're disappearing..."

lines.content: [・|代][・|わ][・|り][・|に]、名もない[きみ|あの子]だ。
lines.translated: *In exchange*, it was you--that nameless boy.

lines.content: あの子が確かに生きていた――そんな時間世界の瞬きが、消えていく。
lines.translated: That boy had certainly lived--and the twinkling of that timeline was fading away.

lines.content: そして、奏大雅とましろの、[・|そ][・|の][・|先]の人生が瞬きはじめていたのだ。
lines.translated: And the lives of Kanade Taiga and Mashiro *beyond that point* were beginning to twinkle.
*Back there*, Kanade Taiga *was never killed at all*.

lines.content: そして無事にましろとの待ち合わせ場所にたどり着けた――“夜”の中から一緒に、ふたりは逃げ延びられた。
lines.translated: And he safely reached the meeting place with Mashiro--together, the two of them escaped from within the "Night."

lines.content: そうしてふたりは、決して直接触れ合えはしなくとも。
lines.translated: And so, even if the two of them could never touch each other directly...

lines.content: まるで、心でそっと触れ合うようなやさしい、とても、やさしい……。春の陽射しのように暖かな“恋するための物語”を、共に描くようにして、幸せに生き――幸せなままに、終わる。
lines.translated: As if gently touching with their hearts, a tender, deeply tender... "story to fall in love," warm as the spring sunlight, would be drawn by the two of them together, living happily--and ending in happiness.

lines.content: そんな愛しいばかりのお話が、ふたりには待ち受けていたのだ――あの地下牢で、奏大雅が、名もない男の子を助け出そうとさえしなければ。
lines.translated: A story filled with nothing but such loveliness had been waiting for the two of them--if only, in that underground dungeon, Kanade Taiga hadn't tried to rescue a nameless boy.

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり
lines.translated: "Ah, I knew it."

lines.content: と、大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Taiga said.

lines.content: やっぱりだ。……想像通り。あそこに俺がいなければ――あそこに、[・|ぼ][・|く]が、いなければ。ふたりは幸せになれたんだ
lines.translated: "I knew it. ...Just as I imagined. If I hadn't been there--if *I* hadn't been there. The two of them could have been happy."

lines.content: そう言い微笑むその横顔は――
lines.translated: His profile as he said that and smiled--

lines.content: ……よかった。[・|ぼ][・|く]は、[・|ぼ][・|く]の役目を果たせたのかな。あの光りは。今夜、どうしても必要だったぼくの“勇気”が――ふたりの“夢”を、叶えられるってことなのかな
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness. I wonder if *I* managed to fulfill *my* role. That light... Does it mean that my 'courage,' which was needed no matter what tonight--can grant the 'dream' of those two?"

lines.content: ――一瞬だ。
lines.translated: --For a single instant.

lines.content: ほんの一瞬だけ、あのときの男の子に戻っていた。
lines.translated: For just one brief instant, he had returned to being the boy from back then.

lines.content: あのふたりは、この世界を救う[・|英][・|雄]だったんだ。そういう可能性の時間世界も、これから必ずどこかに産まれると思う
lines.translated: "Those two were the *heroes* who would save this world. I think a timeline with that kind of possibility will surely be born somewhere from now on, too."

lines.content: あのとき大雅が――ヒーローが、ちょっとした気の迷いを起こし、名もない“不幸”にさえ出会わなければ。
lines.translated: If only back then, Taiga--the hero--hadn't had a slight moment of hesitation and encountered a nameless "misfortune."

lines.content: “夜の国”だなんていう時間のイレギュラーが存在したばっかりに、あんまりにごちゃごちゃ絡まり合ってしまった時間の糸を、あのふたりなら解きほぐしてもくれるはず
lines.translated: "The threads of time that got so hopelessly tangled up just because a temporal irregularity like the 'Country of the Night' existed--if it's those two, they should be able to unravel them as well."

lines.content: そんな可能性も。
lines.translated: Such a possibility, too.

lines.content: あのふたりの心躍るような冒険譚も。
lines.translated: And the heart-racing adventure tale of those two, as well.

lines.content: ……これから産まれる光りの中にあるはずなんだ。
lines.translated: They must exist within the light that will be born from now on.

lines.content: ……ヒーローだ
lines.translated: "...A hero."

lines.content: ぽつりと、大雅はつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Quietly, Taiga murmured.

lines.content: ……[・|彼][・|ら]を救うヒーローを、いつも、ぼくは探してた
lines.translated: "...I was always searching for a hero who would save *them*."

lines.content: 大雅がきらめく町を見下ろす視線。
lines.translated: Taiga's gaze looked down at the glittering town.

lines.content: その先に――かつて過ぎ去った時間が、瞬いている。
lines.translated: Beyond it--a time that had once passed was twinkling.

lines.content: 奏大雅が、地下牢から名もなき男の子を連れ、さくらの杜“参禅町”にやって来る――その道中だ。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga, taking the nameless boy from the underground dungeon, coming to the town of cherry blossoms, "Sanzen-cho"--it was on their way there.

lines.content: 奏大雅は連れ立つ男の子に、様々なお話を話して聞かせていた。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga was telling all sorts of stories to the boy walking alongside him.

lines.content: 心も名前も何もない男の子を笑わせるため、ちょっとふざけてみたりして……。
lines.translated: Goofing around a little to make the boy who had no heart, no name, and nothing at all laugh...

lines.content: つらいことこそ笑顔で語る。そして、自分を暗闇の底から連れ出してくれる。そんな彼に、男の子は少しずつ憧れを感じ始めてた。
lines.translated: Speaking with a smile especially when talking about painful things. And leading him out from the depths of the darkness. Little by little, the boy had begun to feel a sense of admiration for him.

lines.content: そうして[・|彼]が男の子に語った、面白おかしい冗談やおとぎ話。そしてやさしい子守歌。
lines.translated: And so *he* told the boy funny jokes and fairy tales. And gentle lullabies.

lines.content: 更には、奏大雅がまだまだ小さい頃に出会った“半透明”のひと達の話をだ。
lines.translated: Along with stories of the "translucent" people Kanade Taiga had met when he was still very young.

lines.content: そのひと達が言っていたのだと教えられた話を、男の子は――[ぼく|大雅]はずっと、覚えてた。
lines.translated: The boy--Taiga--always remembered the words he was told those people had said.

lines.content: 自分の物語を助けられるのは自分自身しかいない。ヒーローはいつも、自分の中にいる。奏大雅がぼくにしてくれたそういう話を、今もずっと覚えてるんだ
lines.translated: "The only one who can save your story is yourself. A hero is always inside you. Even now, I still remember those stories Kanade Taiga told me."

lines.content: 満月の夜。
lines.translated: On nights of the full moon.

lines.content: 幼い奏大雅をひとりぼっちにしないため、いつも“半透明”のひとがそばにいた。
lines.translated: So that the young Kanade Taiga wouldn't be all alone, a "translucent" person was always by his side.

lines.content: [・|彼]は奏大雅に話して聞かせた。
lines.translated: *He* told Kanade Taiga a story.

lines.content: ……親愛なる“夜の怪物”の話。
lines.translated: The story of a dear "Monster of the Night."

lines.content: その目論見を手伝い、まったくの他人として長い時間を過ごした彼自身の話。
lines.translated: And his own story, of helping with that plan and spending a long time as a complete stranger.

lines.content: 彼らの話を覚えていたから、ぼくも……ぼくのヒーローである奏大雅として生きることにしたんだ
lines.translated: "Because I remembered their stories, I also... decided to live as my hero, Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: たぶん“半透明”の[・|彼]にとっても、夜の名を持つ“怪物”は、憧れのヒーローにも等しい存在だったはず――
lines.translated: Perhaps for that "translucent" *man* as well, the "monster" bearing the name of the night must have been an existence equal to an admired hero--

lines.content: 愛しい者の心を護るため、自分は、その子に憎まれてしまおうと構わない。
lines.translated: To protect the heart of a loved one, not caring even if that child comes to hate you.

lines.content: “怪物”のそんな想いに、[・|彼]は敬意を抱いていたはずだ。
lines.translated: *He* must have held deep respect for such feelings of the "monster."

lines.content: 奏大雅から語り聞かされたその物語は、空っぽなはずのぼくの心に、長いながい時を越え、確かな“勇気”を届けてくれたように思う。
lines.translated: I feel as though that story told to me by Kanade Taiga crossed a long, long stretch of time to deliver genuine "courage" to my supposedly empty heart.

lines.content: だからこそ、名もない[・|男][・|の][・|子]は、自分のことを奏大雅だと名乗ったのだ――それは自分を助け出してくれた憧れのヒーローの名だ。
lines.translated: That was precisely why the nameless *boy* called himself Kanade Taiga--it was the name of the admired hero who had rescued him.

lines.content: [ぼく|男の子]が憧れたのは、奏大雅にだけではないのだ。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga wasn't the only one the boy admired.

lines.content: 奏大雅が語り聞かせてくれた“半透明”のひとの物語。“夜の怪物”のお話しだ。
lines.translated: It was the story of the "translucent" person Kanade Taiga had told him. The tale of the "Monster of the Night."

lines.content: そこに見つけた確かな“勇気”――“大切に想う人のために人生すべてを掛け、生きようとしたその“勇気”だ。
lines.translated: The genuine "courage" found within it--the "courage" to stake one's entire life and try to live for the sake of someone held dear.

lines.content: [・|彼]らの描いたその人生の歌は、物語は、確かに[ぼく|男の子]の空っぽを満たしたのだ。
lines.translated: That song of life *they* drew, that story, had certainly filled the boy's emptiness.

lines.content: あのお話を聞かせてもらえたからぼくは、覚悟を決められたんだ――“勇気”を出せた
lines.translated: "Because I was able to hear that story, I could make up my mind--I could muster my 'courage.'"

lines.content: [・|ぼ][・|く][・|が][・|殺][・|し][・|た]ましろや、奏大雅を取り戻すためにこの“命”を使おうと、人生すべてをかけようと……そういう覚悟を決められたんだ
lines.translated: "I was able to make up my mind to use this 'life,' to stake my entire existence, in order to take back Kanade Taiga and Mashiro, *whom I killed*..."

lines.content: ……どうして
わたしは、繰り返し言う。
lines.translated: I repeated myself.

lines.content: ……どうして、きみがあのふたりのために。世界のために。そこまでするの？　そこまでする必要が、あるの？
lines.translated: "...Why are you going that far for the two of them? For the world? Is there really a need to go that far?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 少し言葉を詰まらせ、視線を彷徨わせたけれど……。
lines.translated: He stumbled over his words slightly and let his gaze wander, before...

lines.content: 大雅は宙を見つめるようにして、言った。
lines.translated: Looking out into empty space, Taiga spoke.

lines.content: 物語の中のヒーローはいつも命をかけて、[・|そ][・|の][・|物][・|語][・|に][・|は]何の価値もないぼく達みたいな名もない“誰か”のことを助けてくれるけど……
lines.translated: "Heroes in stories always risk their lives to save nameless 'nobodies' like us who have no value *to the story* at all, right...?"

lines.content: ――奏大雅はその通りに、名もないぼくを助けて死んだ。
lines.translated: --Just like that, Kanade Taiga had died saving the nameless me.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: 一度くらい……。ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Just once... Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: この世界のどこかに、たった一度くらいでも――いつも助けられてばかりのぼく達が、ピンチに陥ってる彼のことを助けに走る。……この、命をかけて
lines.translated: "Somewhere in this world, even if it's just once--for us, who are always the ones being saved, to run to the rescue of him when he's fallen into a pinch. ...Risking this very life."

lines.content: そんなお話がどこかにひとつだけでもあったっていいじゃないか
lines.translated: "Wouldn't it be fine for a story like that to exist in at least one place somewhere?"

lines.content: ……それだけだよ
lines.translated: "...That's all it is."

lines.content: いや。もちろんそれだけなんてわけはない。でも、結局はそういうことになるんだ。ぼくが、あのふたりを助けたいと願うのは
lines.translated: "No. Of course there's no way that's all it is. But in the end, that's what it comes down to. Why I wish to save those two."

lines.content: [・|ぼ][・|く]はそういう価値ある[・|俺]に、なりたかった――ぼくは、ぼく自身の中に、いつもヒーローを探してたんだ
lines.translated: "*I* wanted to become a worthwhile *me* like that--I was always searching for a hero inside myself."

lines.content: ……目の前のまっくらな現実に立ち向かえるだけの、目には見えない[勇気|ヒーロー]の存在を。そういう自分になれる時間だけ、自分自身に納得して、生きていけた
lines.translated: "...For the existence of an invisible hero just strong enough to stand up to the pitch-black reality in front of my eyes. Only during the time I could be that kind of person could I accept myself and keep on living."

lines.content: だけど、と大雅は言った。
lines.translated: "However," Taiga said.

lines.content: だけどもう、[・|俺]は[・|ぼ][・|く]に戻っていい。……苦しかったんだ。本当は……。ヒーローの真似事をして、強がることが
lines.translated: "However, *I* can go back to being *me* now. ...It was painful. Truly... Playing at being a hero, and putting on a brave front."

lines.content: 今夜、“夢”は叶ったのだ――……まだ見ぬいつかの時間のその中に、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]は、確かに生きている。幸せになれている。
lines.translated: Tonight, the "dream" had come true--...Somewhere within a time yet unseen, *the two of them* are certainly alive. Able to be happy.

lines.content: そういう未来を獲得するため、たくさんの“勇気”を自分に求めた。
lines.translated: In order to win that kind of future, I had demanded so much "courage" from myself.

lines.content: ……だからもう、ぼくは、無理して明るく喋ろうとしなくても、いいんだ
lines.translated: "...So I don't have to force myself to talk brightly anymore."

lines.content: 元々無口なぼくだけど……。
lines.translated: Even though I was originally quiet by nature...

lines.content: もうぼくは、無理して奏大雅みたいに、つらい誰かに微笑みかけなければいけないと――自分に課さなくても、いいんだ
lines.translated: "I don't have to force myself to be like Kanade Taiga anymore, imposing on myself the duty that I must smile at someone who's hurting."

lines.content: 大雅は……男の子は、穏やかな笑顔を浮かべてた。
lines.translated: Taiga... the boy, wore a gentle smile.

lines.content: ぼくは今夜、ましろの代わりに、最大の“悪夢”に――全人類の敵となる
lines.translated: "Tonight, in Mashiro's place, I will become the greatest 'Nightmare'--the enemy of all humanity."

lines.content: 世界中――あらゆる時間世界から、憎悪の対象となる。
lines.translated: To become the object of hatred from the entire world--from every timeline.

lines.content: でも、お願いだ。どうか笑って送り出してほしいんだよ。……クロ。別に俺は……ぼくはさ、絶望的な気持ちに追い込まれた末に、こうするわけじゃない
lines.translated: "Even so, please. I want you to send me off with a smile. ...Kuro. It's not like I'm... like I'm doing this after being backed into a corner by despair."

lines.content: ヒーローにならなければ――そういう強がりからも今夜から解放される。
lines.translated: *I must become a hero*--from tonight on, he would be freed from putting on that brave front as well.

lines.content: あくまで“夢”と“希望”を持って、自ら進んで、叶えるものなんだ
lines.translated: "To the very end, it's something I'm choosing to fulfill of my own accord, holding onto 'dreams' and 'hope.'"

lines.content: 笑って……。
lines.translated: With a smile...

lines.content: そんなの無理だ。
lines.translated: That's impossible.

lines.content: できるわけがない。
lines.translated: There's no way I can do that.

lines.content: でも、だからといって、わたしに何ができるのか……。
lines.translated: Even so, having said that, what is there that I can do...?

lines.content: ずっと考えている。
lines.translated: I kept thinking.

lines.content: 黙って大雅の話に耳を、心を傾けながらも、ずっとずっと考えている。
lines.translated: Even as I quietly lent my ears and my heart to Taiga's words, I kept thinking and thinking.

lines.content: 唇を噛むわたしに、大雅は苦笑いを浮かべ、“もともと……”と静かに言った。
lines.translated: Seeing me bite my lip, Taiga gave a wry smile and quietly said, "Originally..."

lines.content: もともとぼくは名もない命だ
lines.translated: "Originally, I was a nameless life."

lines.content: 本当なら与えられた人生の中で何も成せず、何者も救えず、ただただ無価値な時間を無価値なままに、浪費する。そんな人生だったはずなんだ
lines.translated: "By rights, within the life I was given, I shouldn't have been able to accomplish anything, or save anyone, simply wasting worthless time in a worthless way. That's the kind of life it should have been."

lines.content: たとえば、主人公が世界を救うための大冒険のその中で。たまたま通りかかった町の道……その隅っこで、格好いいばかりの彼に憧れ、チラチラ見てる――
lines.translated: "For example, in the middle of a grand adventure where the protagonist saves the world. In the corner of a town street he just happened to pass through... admiring him for how utterly cool he is, sneaking glances at him--"

lines.content: ぼくなんて、そんな通行人Ａみたいな存在なんだよ。そんな名もない“誰か”の物語なんて、本当なら誰も知らないし、知ろうとも思わないだろう
lines.translated: "Someone like me is just an existence like Passerby A. By rights, no one knows the story of a nameless 'somebody' like that, and no one would ever think of trying to know it."

lines.content: ……あんまりに平凡すぎて物語なんてとてもじゃないが呼べもしない。そんな誰も知らない物語になんて、ほんの少しの影響力だってないんだよ。本来ならさ
lines.translated: "...Too hopelessly ordinary to ever possibly be called a story. A story nobody knows like that doesn't have even the slightest bit of influence. Normally, anyway."

lines.content: そんなぼくが……
lines.translated: "And yet, someone like me..."

lines.content: 英雄に助けてもらい、長い余生を与えてもらったところで。何の価値も産み出さない……誰の心も救わない。そんな無価値な時間しか送ることのできやしない……このぼくが
lines.translated: "Even after being saved by a hero and given a long remaining life. Producing no value whatsoever... saving no one's heart. Able to spend only such worthless time... this me..."

lines.content: 大勢の名もなきものの、そのひとりが。
lines.translated: One among the multitude of the nameless.

lines.content: こうして、かりそめだろうとなんだろうと“役割”ができたことは幸福なんだ
lines.translated: "To have been given a 'role' like this, whether borrowed or whatever else, is a blessing."

lines.content: ……いつも英雄に、ヒーローに助けられてばかりの名もなき命が、今度は彼らを救済するんだ。彼らに助けられた命を使って
lines.translated: "...A nameless life, always doing nothing but being saved by heroes, will now be the one to bring them salvation. Using the life that was saved by them."

lines.content: そうすることで、ようやくだ
lines.translated: "By doing so, at long last."

lines.content: ……ようやく、誰かに見られてもまあ、物語の体くらいは成せるようになるんじゃないかな。このぼくという名もなき誰かの人生は
lines.translated: "...At long last, even if someone were to look at it, I think it might manage to take the shape of a story, at least. The life of this nameless somebody called me."

lines.content: ……いつかこの記憶の図書館“夜の国”をベースにし、命の図書館を刻の最果てに作りたいのだとましろは言った。
lines.translated: Mashiro had said that someday, using this library of memories, the "Country of the Night," as a base, she wanted to create a library of life at the very end of time.

lines.content: そこに納められるのだろう凡庸たる物語の一部としてでも、ようやく、ぼくは俺のお話を認めることができるようになる。
lines.translated: Even if only as part of the mundane stories that would likely be housed there, at long last, I would be able to acknowledge my own tale.

lines.content: だからさ。こんな無価値なぼくが消えてしまったところで誰も、……誰も、ぼく自身でさえも、悲しまないさ。……クロ
lines.translated: "That's why. Even if a worthless person like me disappears, no one... no one, not even I myself, will be sad. ...Kuro."

lines.content: 君、以外は……。
lines.translated: Except for you...

lines.content: と、そんなつぶやきは、通り抜ける風に[さら|攫]われ――本当につぶやかれた言葉だったのか、わからなくなる。
lines.translated: Such a murmur was snatched away by the passing wind--making it impossible to tell if those words had truly been murmured at all.

lines.content: ごめんねクロ、と男の子は言う。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Kuro," the boy said.

lines.content: ……クロ。君はもう、自由だ
lines.translated: "...Kuro. You are free now."

lines.content: 今までありがとうと男の子は言う。
lines.translated: "Thank you for everything until now," the boy said.

lines.content: ハルと一緒の幸せな人生。
lines.translated: A happy life together with Haru.

lines.content: その裏側で、クロはいつもぼくのためにぼろぼろになっていた。
lines.translated: Behind the scenes of it all, Kuro had always been worn to tatters for my sake.

lines.content: ぼく達に降りかかろうとした不幸を全部、ぼくらの知らない裏側で、君が……連れ去っていってくれていたから
lines.translated: "Because behind the scenes where we never knew, you... carried away all the misfortune that was about to rain down upon us."

lines.content: 語り聞いた“夜の怪物”も、同じだ。
lines.translated: The "Monster of the Night" he had heard about was the same.

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”は誰もがみんな、大切な人の不幸を持ち去ろうとする――……その身を賭してまで。心も身体もぼろぼろになりながら。誰にも、知られないままに。
lines.translated: Every single "Creature of the Night" tries to carry away the misfortune of those they hold dear--...even at the cost of their own lives. While their hearts and bodies are worn to tatters. Without anyone ever knowing.

lines.content: でも、もう、いいんだ。
lines.translated: But it's okay now.

lines.content: ぼくのことなんて構わないでいい。忘れてしまえばいいんだ。何もかも
lines.translated: "You don't need to worry about me anymore. You can just forget it all. Everything."

lines.content: ……ぼくがハルと生きていく中で、ましろのことを忘れてしまっていたように
lines.translated: "...Just as I ended up forgetting about Mashiro while living my life with Haru."

lines.content: クロ。お願いだ。これからは君自身の“夢”を探して、その“夢”を叶えるために、生きていってほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "Kuro. Please. From now on, I want you to search for your own 'dream,' and live to make that 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ……本当なら、今度はぼくが君の“夢”を叶えるために協力、する番なんだろうと思うけど
lines.translated: "...By rights, I think it should be my turn to help make your 'dream' come true next, though."

lines.content: でも……
それはもう、叶わない“夢”だ――そんな声にはならない思いを、わたしは、聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: *That is a "dream" that can no longer come true*--I felt as though I heard that voiceless thought.

lines.content: だから最後にひとつだけ、君にお願いしたいんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why, at the very end, there is just one thing I want to ask of you."

lines.content: と、大雅が言う。
lines.translated: So Taiga said.

lines.content: だからわたしは“……うん、なに？”と、そういうふうに応えただろうと思う。
lines.translated: And so I think I must have answered something like, "...Yeah, what is it?"

lines.content: [・|最][・|後]なんて、いやだ。
lines.translated: I don't want there to be a *very end*.

lines.content: 本当はそう叫びたかった。
lines.translated: Truthfully, I wanted to scream that out.

lines.content: でも、だめだ。
lines.translated: But I couldn't.

lines.content: 想いも、思いも、何もかも……。
lines.translated: My feelings, my thoughts, everything...

lines.content: わたしには言葉にできず――わたしの、思い通りにならない“心”は固まってしまってる。
lines.translated: I couldn't put them into words--my "heart," refusing to obey me, had frozen solid.

lines.content: ……まるで突然鳴り響いた物音に、部屋の隅で動けなくなってしまってる子猫みたいにだ。
lines.translated: Just like a kitten left unable to move in the corner of a room by a sudden, echoing noise.

lines.content: お願いだ……。クロ
lines.translated: "Please... Kuro."

lines.content: 大雅は、言う。奏大雅のような笑顔を浮かべ。
lines.translated: Taiga spoke, wearing a smile just like Kanade Taiga's.

lines.content: どうか、笑って送り出してほしい
lines.translated: "Please, I want you to send me off with a smile."

lines.content: 虫のいい話だけれど、ぼくは、君に祝福してほしいんだ――何者でもないぼくがここまで来れた
lines.translated: "I know it's selfish of me to ask, but I want your blessing--that a nobody like me managed to make it this far."

lines.content: お願いだよ。クロ……。笑顔と拍手で、君に、ぼくが選んだ“次”へと送り出してほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Please, Kuro... I want you to send me off with a smile and applause to the 'next' that I chose."

lines.content: きみの選んだ“次”は……。
lines.translated: The "next" that you chose...

lines.content: 夜空の星々で眠りにつくでもない。
lines.translated: Is not to fall asleep among the stars in the night sky.

lines.content: 次の人生に生まれ変わるでも、ない――[・|誰][・|も][・|が][・|な][・|ぜ][・|か][・|嫌][・|悪][・|す][・|る]最大の“悪夢”に産まれ直し、世界中のありとあらゆる命から憎悪される道。
lines.translated: Nor is it to be reborn into a next life--it is a path where you are reborn as the greatest "Nightmare" *that everyone inexplicably despises*, to be hated by every single life across the entire world.

lines.content: ……大切なひと達を幸福へ導くために選んだ道だ。
lines.translated: It is the path you chose in order to guide the people precious to you toward happiness.

lines.content: 何者でもなかったぼくが――
lines.translated: "That a nobody like me--"

lines.content: 才能も名前も何も持たない。そんな無価値なこのぼくが、こんなにも大きなことを成し遂げられたのは、クロ。君の助けがあったからこそだ
lines.translated: "Having neither talent, nor a name, nor anything at all. The only reason someone as worthless as me was able to accomplish something this huge is because I had your help, Kuro."

lines.content: だから、クロ……お願いだ
lines.translated: "That's why, Kuro... please."

lines.content: そんな顔、しないでほしいんだと大雅は言い、微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: Saying he didn't want me to make that kind of face, Taiga smiled.

lines.content: 笑ってほしい。君に、……君にだけ、ぼくは祝福されたい
lines.translated: "I want you to smile. By you... by you alone, I want to be blessed."

lines.content: ずっと、ずっと頑張ってきたんだ。この瞬間をいつも夢見てばかりいた
lines.translated: "I've worked so, so hard for so long. I was always dreaming of this very moment."

lines.content: ……でも
lines.translated: "...Even though..."

lines.content: 誰にも言えない秘密は、こんなぼくにはあんまりに重すぎる荷物だったんだ。それでも、途中で投げ出すこともなく、最後までこうしてここまで運んで来れた
lines.translated: "A secret I couldn't tell anyone was far too heavy a burden for someone like me to bear. Even so, without giving up along the way, I managed to carry it all the way here to the very end."

lines.content: その頑張りが報われて、やっと、……ああ、やっと“夢”が、叶ったんだ
lines.translated: "All that hard work has paid off, and finally... ah, finally, my 'dream' has come true."

lines.content: 大雅はわたしに微笑みかけたまま、
lines.translated: Still smiling at me, Taiga continued,

lines.content: だからクロ
lines.translated: "That's why, Kuro..."

lines.content: ……お願いだよ
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: 君にだけ、こんな、ぼくのことを――……
lines.translated: "By you alone, I want someone like me to be--..."

lines.content: そこで、言葉が途切れた。
lines.translated: Right there, his words cut off.

lines.content: 男の子は“夜”の町を見下ろしている。
lines.translated: The boy was looking down at the town of the "Night."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]が幸せに生きている――そんな[光り|可能性]を、眩しそうに見つめてる。
lines.translated: He was gazing, as if dazzled, at that light--that possibility--where *the two of them* were living happily.

lines.content: ……大雅？
lines.translated: "...Taiga?"

lines.content: 怖い。
lines.translated: I'm scared.

lines.content: 理由はないけど、そう感じた。
lines.translated: There was no reason for it, yet that was how I felt.

lines.content: どうしたの？　と問いかけたその声は、ちゃんと唇からこぼれたのかもわからない。
lines.translated: "What's wrong?" I asked, though I couldn't even tell if the voice had properly spilled from my lips.

lines.content: ……何もわからないわたしは、もっと、もっと、何もかも、わからないくなってしまう――きみの姿が透き通って見えた、そして、そこに光るものを見つけてしまったから。
lines.translated: Knowing nothing, I found myself understanding less and less of everything--because your figure looked transparent to me, and there, I caught sight of something shining.

lines.content: ……あれ？
涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: おかしいな
lines.translated: "That's strange."

lines.content: 涙が次々と、男の子の頬を伝いはじめる。
lines.translated: Tears began to stream down the boy's cheeks, one after another.

lines.content: ……おかしいよ
lines.translated: "...That's strange."

lines.content: 止まらない大粒の涙を、男の子は、必死になって拭う。
lines.translated: Desperately, the boy wiped away the large, unstoppable tears.

lines.content: だめだ。こんなの……平気なはず、だったのに
lines.translated: "No. This... I was supposed to be fine with this."
"...*I'm scared*,"

lines.content: と、[男の子|大雅]は言った。
lines.translated: the boy--Taiga--said.

lines.content: これは、ぼくが……ぼく自身が願った“夢”なのに。それがやっと、叶うのに。[・|そ][・|れ][・|な][・|の][・|に]
lines.translated: "Even though this is the 'dream' that I... that I myself wished for. Even though it's finally coming true. *And yet...*"

lines.content: ハル。
lines.translated: Haru.

lines.content: 千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa.

lines.content: 姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori.

lines.content: あさひさんに十夜。ナナちゃん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san and Toya. Nana-chan.

lines.content: 智仁にあず咲先輩。
lines.translated: Tomohito and Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: そして……、
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 怖いよ……
lines.translated: "I'm scared..."

lines.content: ……クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: ここから見えてるたくさんの“[時間|光]”の中で……。
lines.translated: Amidst the many "lights"--the many "times"--visible from here...

lines.content: ……ぼくはこれから、大好きだったはずの……大好きになっちゃだめだってわかってたのに、それでも好きになってしまったやさしいみんなに、嫌われてしまうんだ
lines.translated: "...From now on, everyone I loved so much... all those kind people I ended up loving even though I knew I shouldn't... they're all going to hate me."

lines.content: 頭を抱え、
lines.translated: Clutching his head,

lines.content: ……いやだ
lines.translated: "...I don't want that."

lines.content: 震える身体を抱きしめて、
lines.translated: Hugging his trembling body,

lines.content: ……どうして
これから訪れるひとりぼっちな時間を想い、
lines.translated: thinking of the lonely time that was about to begin,

lines.content: ああ……本当に
lines.translated: "Ah... really..."

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ……どうしても涙が、止まらないんだ。全部自分が、決めたことのはずなのに……っ
lines.translated: "...No matter what I do, the tears just won't stop. Even though I'm the one who decided all of this...!"

lines.content: その姿はまるで、“夜の女王”になるのだと決めた夜――時計塔の管理室で、ひとり震えていた[・|彼][・|女]のようだった。
lines.translated: That figure looked just like *her*, trembling all alone in the clock tower's control room on the night she decided to become the "Queen of the Night."

lines.content: ごめん、クロ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Kuro."

lines.content: ……ぼくなんて、産まれてこなければよかった
lines.translated: "...Someone like me never should have been born."

lines.content: その言葉に、わたしの胸がずきりとした。
lines.translated: A sharp pain pierced my chest at those words.

lines.content: お母さんに会いたい
lines.translated: "I want to see my mom."

lines.content: ……大好きだって、言われたい
lines.translated: "...I want her to tell me she loves me."

lines.content: でも。それは無理だとわかっていたから……
lines.translated: "But. Because I knew that was impossible..."

lines.content: だから今度は……ましろと一緒に、暮らしたい
lines.translated: "So instead... I wanted to live together with Mashiro."

lines.content: そんなことを言って聞かなかった。
lines.translated: I kept saying that and refused to listen to reason.

lines.content: ぼくがそんな我がまま言って、大切にしたいひとを困らせた、ばっかりに……
lines.translated: "Just because I was so selfish and troubled the person I wanted to cherish..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: そうか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: “人の心は、今日まで投げかけられたすべての言葉でできている”――
lines.translated: "'A person's heart is made of every single word that has been spoken to them up until today'--"

lines.content: ……誰もがみんな、ぼくにやさしくしてくれたひと達、みんな、不幸に……なるんだ
lines.translated: "...Every single one of them, all the people who were kind to me, every last one of them... ends up unhappy."

lines.content: わたしはそこではじめて、男の子の気持ちを――“絶望”を、知ったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps it was only then that I truly understood the boy's feelings--his "despair"--for the very first time.

lines.content: ぼくはいつも自分のことばかり考えてる。……自分が幸せになることばっかり、考えてる
lines.translated: "I'm always only thinking about myself. ...Always only thinking about making myself happy."

lines.content: 実際、こんなぼくさえ産まれてこなければ、ましろ……お母さん、あさひさん、十夜、ナナちゃんも
lines.translated: "In fact, if only someone like me had never been born, Mashiro... my mom, Asahi-san, Toya, and Nana-chan, too..."

lines.content: みんな……[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|酷][・|い][・|方][・|法][・|で]消されてしまうなんて。そんな、ひどいことには……ならなかったはずなんだ
lines.translated: "All of them... being erased *in such a cruel way*. Something so horrible... never would have happened to them."

lines.content: ぽろぽろと、こぼれる。
lines.translated: One after another, they spilled over.

lines.content: 全部、ぜんぶ、ぼくのせいだ……
lines.translated: "It's all, all my fault..."

lines.content: 涙が、いっぱい……。
lines.translated: So many tears...

lines.content: 何も持たないくせに、誰の役にも立てないくせに、誰かに大切にしてもらえるようなものを、ただのひとつも、持っていないくせに――
lines.translated: "Even though I have nothing, even though I'm useless to everyone, even though I don't have a single thing that would make someone cherish me--"

lines.content: 誰かに大切にしてもらえるものを……
lines.translated: "Something that would make someone cherish me..."

lines.content: 誰かに愛されるだけのものを、何も、差し出すことができない空っぽ、なのに……
lines.translated: "Even though I'm completely empty, unable to offer a single thing worthy of being loved by anyone..."

lines.content: ……それでも隣の誰かと[・|同][・|じ][・|よ][・|う][・|に]愛してほしいと、大切にしてもらいたいと、醜く駄々ばかりこねていた――
lines.translated: "...Even so, I threw such ugly tantrums, demanding to be loved and cherished *just like* the person next to me--"

lines.content: 自分が幸せになることばかりで、相手のことなんて何も、何も、考えていなかったんだ
lines.translated: "I only ever cared about my own happiness, and never once, not once, thought about the other person."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: ぼくが自分のことばかりを考える度、やさしい人も、やさしいひとも、次々と不幸になっていく――
lines.translated: "Every time I think only of myself, kind people, one after another, end up falling into misfortune--"

lines.content: ぼくは名もない“誰か”なんかじゃない。ただの邪悪な“何か”でしかないんだ。
lines.translated: I'm not some nameless "somebody" at all. I'm nothing more than an evil "something."

lines.content: この物語に“こいつ”さえいなければ、愛すべきもの達の生きるこの物語は――この世界は、どうなっていただろう。
lines.translated: If only "this thing" weren't in this story, what would have become of this story where the ones worthy of love live--what would have become of this world?

lines.content: ごめん、本当に、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, I'm truly sorry."

lines.content: 涙みたいな言葉がこぼれる。
lines.translated: Words like tears spilled forth.

lines.content: ごめん……クロ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry... Kuro."

lines.content: 次々、こぼれる。
lines.translated: Spilling out, one after another.

lines.content: こんなぼくと出会ってしまったばっかりに、君をもぼくは、不幸にしてる。こんなぼくのために、長いながい時間を無駄にさせてしまったんだ
lines.translated: "Just because you happened to meet someone like me, I'm making you unhappy, too. I made you waste such a long, long time for the sake of someone like me."

lines.content: ……ましろは自分を邪悪だと絶望し“悪夢”となった。
lines.translated: Mashiro despaired, believing herself to be evil, and became a "Nightmare."

lines.content: でも、本当に邪悪だったのは――ぼくだ。空っぽなこのぼくだ。
lines.translated: But the one who was truly evil--was me. This empty me.

lines.content: あんまりに何も持たない空っぽだから、その空っぽを埋めるためにたくさんのものを欲しがった。それがぼくの“罪”なんだ
lines.translated: "Because I was so utterly empty and had nothing at all, I wanted so many things to fill that emptiness. That is my 'sin.'"

lines.content: だから君の人生の中からも、ぼくという存在を“夜の王”として、書き換える――今のぼくはもう、どこにも存在しない。[・|君][・|と][・|ぼ][・|く][・|は][・|出][・|会][・|わ][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た]
lines.translated: "That's why I will rewrite my existence as the 'King of the Night' within your life as well--the me that I am now no longer exists anywhere. *You and I never met.*"

lines.content: 少しずつだけど世界はそういうふうに変わっていくはず――静かな水面に落とした薬莢、その波紋は、少しずつすこしずつ、湖面全体へと広がっていくはずだ。
lines.translated: Little by little, the world should change in that way--like a spent cartridge dropped onto still water, its ripples should spread, little by little, across the entire surface of the lake.

lines.content: そうすればクロの人生もまた、あのふたりのようにその先が――あるいはまったくあたらしいものが、幸せであるはずのものが、この時間世界のどこかに産まれてくるだろうから
lines.translated: "If I do that, then Kuro's life, too, will have a future just like those two--or perhaps something entirely new, something that is meant to be happy, will be born somewhere in this world of time."

lines.content: わたしは固まってしまってる。心も、身体も。……呼吸さえも止まってしまうかと、思った。
lines.translated: I was frozen solid. Both my heart and my body. ...I thought even my breathing might stop.

lines.content: はじめて触れた――はじめて、猫なわたしに聞かせてくれたきみの声。
lines.translated: It was the first time I had touched it--the first time I, a cat, had heard your real voice.

lines.content: 大切な人の“想い”、だったのに。
lines.translated: Even though those were the true "feelings" of someone precious to me.

lines.content: わたし……。
……わたしは
何も、できないでいる。
lines.translated: I couldn't do a single thing.

lines.content: “心”だけがずきずきと痛んで。心臓だけがばくばくと、暴れて。
lines.translated: Only my "heart" throbbed with a sharp ache. Only my pulse pounded wildly in my chest.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: ただただ涙だけが、溢れてた。
lines.translated: And nothing but tears kept overflowing.

lines.content: わたしは、首を振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: ……やだ
lines.translated: "...No way."

lines.content: やっとの思いでそう言った。
lines.translated: With everything I had, I finally managed to say it.

lines.content: ……行かないで、大雅
lines.translated: "...Don't go, Taiga."

lines.content: やだよ。
lines.translated: I don't want this.

lines.content: お願い……
lines.translated: "Please..."

lines.content: わたしを、ひとりぼっちにしないで……。
lines.translated: Don't leave me all alone...

lines.content: 大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: 聞いてよ、大雅。
lines.translated: Listen to me, Taiga.
"*I... I have always... about you...*"

lines.content: でも、だめだ。
lines.translated: But I couldn't.

lines.content: たぶんわたしの声はきみに届かない――“半透明”だ。
lines.translated: My voice probably wouldn't reach you--I was "translucent."

lines.content: もう殆どまっしろだと言っていいくらい、きみの姿は“夜”に溶け始めていた。
lines.translated: Your figure had already begun melting into the "Night," to the point where you were almost completely pure white.

lines.content: 大切に想う人たちを幸せにできない。どころか、不幸にしてばかりいる。手当たり次第に。こんな命に価値はないんだ。かけらだって、ないんだよ
lines.translated: "I can't make the people I care about happy. On the contrary, all I ever do is make them miserable. Indiscriminately. There's no value in a life like this. Not even a single shred of it."

lines.content: そんなことない。
lines.translated: That's not true.

lines.content: こんなぼくは“生きたい”と願うことそのものが我がままなんだ
lines.translated: "For someone like me, the very wish to 'live' is nothing more than selfishness."

lines.content: 違うよ。そんなことないんだよ。
lines.translated: You're wrong. That's not true at all.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 唇が震える。
lines.translated: My lips trembled.

lines.content: 言葉が胸の辺りでつっかえて、ただわたしは首を振るだけだ。
lines.translated: The words got stuck somewhere in my chest, and all I could do was shake my head.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ……そうだよ。いっぱい、いっぱいの大切なもの達を、不幸にし続けてきたこのぼくだ
lines.translated: "Ah, that's right... It's true. I'm the one who has kept making so, so many precious people miserable."

lines.content: ……だからもう、だめだ。今すぐ、消えてしまわなきゃ……
lines.translated: "...So I can't go on anymore. I have to disappear right now..."

lines.content: そうして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 最後の言葉も、わたしにくれた微笑みのその意味も、わたしには――わたし達には届かないまま、
lines.translated: Without his final words, or the meaning behind the smile he gave me, ever reaching me--ever reaching us--

lines.content: ……う、あ、ああ
lines.translated: "...Ugh, ah, aah..."

lines.content: あの子は、姿を消したのだ。
lines.translated: That boy vanished.

lines.content: わたしは……。
lines.translated: I am...

lines.content: 大雅……たいが……、いやだよ……
lines.translated: "Taiga... Taiga... No..."

lines.content: こぼれる涙を、両手で顔を覆って蓋をして……。
lines.translated: I covered my face with both hands to hold back the spilling tears...

lines.content: お願い……
lines.translated: "Please..."

lines.content: わたしの声は、届かないから……お願い。
lines.translated: Because my voice couldn't reach him... Please.

lines.content: 誰か……お願い、します。どうかあの子を、救って……
lines.translated: "Someone... please. Please, save him..."

lines.content: “夜”の空でたったひとり、ただただいつまでも、泣いて……泣いて。泣いてばかりいた。
lines.translated: All alone in the sky of the "Night," I just cried and cried forever... I did nothing but cry.

lines.content: 長い……。
lines.translated: It was long...

lines.content: とても長い思い出から目を覚まし、
lines.translated: Awakening from a very long memory,

lines.content: ……大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm okay."

lines.content: わたしはひとり、つぶやく。
lines.translated: I murmured to myself, all alone.

lines.content: 大丈夫。きみのことを絶対、ぜったい、ひとりぼっちになんてさせないよ……
lines.translated: "It's okay. I will never, ever let you end up all alone..."

lines.content: いつかきみに渡した“約束”だけど……。
lines.translated: It was a "promise" I had given you once, and yet...

lines.content: いつかわたしはきみに、そう“約束”したけれど。
lines.translated: Even though I had made that "promise" to you once upon a time.

lines.content: ……ひとりぼっちになってしまったのは、きみじゃなく、わたしのほうだ
lines.translated: "...The one who ended up all alone wasn't you, it was me."

lines.content: ちくたくちくたく――
lines.translated: Tick-tock, tick-tock--

lines.content: ひとりきりのわたしのため息は、時計の音に掻き消されてしまうばかりだった。
lines.translated: My solitary sighs were simply drowned out by the sound of the clock.

lines.content: ……“夜の王”、か
lines.translated: "...The 'King of the Night,' huh?"

lines.content: [・|俺]、[・|奏][・|大][・|雅]は、クロと名乗る女の子と通話し終えると、その端末を握りしめつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Once *I*--*Kanade Taiga*--finished my call with the girl who called herself Kuro, I gripped the phone tightly and muttered to myself.

lines.content: さっきまで電話越しに受けていた話を、自分なりに少し整理しようと考えている。
lines.translated: I was trying to sort out the story I had just heard over the phone in my own way.

lines.content: 『誰もが俺を憎悪する。……そうして俺の“魔法”ははじめて、俺の“夢”を叶えてくれる――めちゃくちゃに絡まり合った糸は、そのようにして解きほぐされていく必要があるんだよ』
lines.translated: "'Everyone will hate me. ...And only then will my "magic" finally grant my "dream"--the hopelessly tangled threads need to be unraveled that way.'"

lines.content: クロの話の中であの子はそう言っていた。
lines.translated: That's what that boy had said in Kuro's story.

lines.content: “夜の王”として“魔法少女”たちに――仲間たちによって消されてしまう度――
lines.translated: Every time he was erased as the "King of the Night" by the "magical girls"--by his friends--

lines.content: “夜”を通して絡まり合う糸のように発生した可能性の時間世界は、ひとつ、またひとつ消滅するようにと、あの子は祈った。
lines.translated: That boy prayed that the timelines of possibility, which had sprung up like tangled threads through the "Night," would vanish one by one.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|し][・|て]、あんまりにもごちゃごちゃと絡まり合いすぎた糸を元に戻そうとしたのだ――
lines.translated: *In that way*, he tried to restore the threads that had become far too messy and entangled--

lines.content: 悪戯に絡まり合うその中で、悪戯に、あんまりにも多くの悲しみを振りまきすぎたから。
lines.translated: Because amidst that needless entanglement, he had needlessly scattered far too much sorrow.

lines.content: その糸は主に、柊ハルを救うため“魔法”を使い、悪戯に、枝葉に分けられた不幸な時間世界を指している。
lines.translated: Those threads mainly referred to the unfortunate timelines that had needlessly branched out when he used "magic" to save Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 柊ハルは死亡し、後を追うようにして[あの子|ぼく]もまた自ら命を投げ出した。残されたもの達にたっぷりの絶望だけを残して。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru died, and as if to follow her, that boy--I--also threw his own life away. Leaving behind nothing but overwhelming despair for those who remained.

lines.content: 更には、クロだ。
lines.translated: And then, there was Kuro.

lines.content: あの女の子が自身の“命”を引き替えにして、[あの子|ぼく]のことを追いかけて――……なるほど。
lines.translated: That girl traded away her own "life" to chase after that boy--after me... I see.

lines.content: ああ、まったく……そうだな。
lines.translated: Yeah, really... that's how it is.

lines.content: ……複雑だ
lines.translated: "...It's complicated."

lines.content: 複雑に、色々なもの達の心や意図が、そして時間や空間が、絡まり合っていく。
lines.translated: The hearts and intentions of so many different people, along with time and space, had become intricately tangled together.

lines.content: そんな時間世界の果てで誕生した最大の悪夢“夜の王”
lines.translated: The greatest nightmare born at the very end of such a timeline: the "King of the Night."

lines.content: [・|彼]を[・|ひ][・|と][・|つ][・|滅][・|ぼ][・|す][・|度][・|に]、絡んだ糸を解くようにして、不幸な可能性[世界]は消滅していく――
lines.translated: *Every time* *he* *is destroyed*, the unfortunate possibilities--the worlds--vanish, like untangling a knotted thread--

lines.content: そうすることもまた、自分への罰のひとつだ。あの男の子はそういうふうに、考え、祈った。
lines.translated: Doing that was also one of the punishments he inflicted upon himself. That was how that boy thought, and how he prayed.

lines.content: 自分を罰するということは、自分自身の歩んできたこれまでの人生すべてを否定するということだ。
lines.translated: To punish oneself means to deny the entirety of the life one has walked up to that point.

lines.content: ……自分自身を消滅させるということは、これまで選んできたすべての時間を消し去ってしまうということだ。
lines.translated: To erase oneself from existence means to wipe away all the time one has ever chosen.

lines.content: 幾つも発生させた世界をひとつ、またひとつと収束させるためには、幾つも世界を繰り返し生きなければならなかっただろうはず。
lines.translated: In order to converge the numerous worlds he had generated, one by one, he must have had to live through countless worlds over and over again.

lines.content: ……そうだ
lines.translated: "...That's right."
"This world, this time, *has been repeated countless times*--*without even the very person who wished for it realizing*."
*Everything from here on is my own speculation.*

lines.content: ……“夜の王”と“魔法少女”たちとの“戦争”は、少女たちの勝利で決し続けてきた。
lines.translated: The "war" between the "King of the Night" and the "magical girls" had continually ended in the girls' victory.

lines.content: その度に、あの男の子は“命”を失い続けていき――そしてクロに、その“命”を返していったのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: And each time, didn't that boy keep losing his "life"--returning that "life" back to Kuro?

lines.content: この時間世界の中には、俺の知り得ない物語がまだどこかに隠れているのではないか。
lines.translated: Within this world of time, couldn't there still be stories hidden somewhere that I have no way of knowing?

lines.content: そう思うとやはり、複雑だ。
lines.translated: When I think about it like that, it really is complicated.

lines.content: ……あんまりにも。
lines.translated: Far too complicated.

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。確かに、だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. It really is."

lines.content: 確かに、時間の[・|糸]はめちゃめちゃに絡まり合ってしまっている
lines.translated: "The *threads* of time really have been tangled into a complete mess."

lines.content: ……“夜の国”とかいう時間と空間の特異点が存在してしまってるばっかりに、ありとあらゆるものがめちゃくちゃに、ごちゃごちゃに、絡まり合ってしまってる
lines.translated: "...Just because a singularity of time and space called the 'Land of Night' exists, anything and everything has been tangled up into a chaotic, jumbled mess."

lines.content: もう何がはじまりで、何がもともとの一本の糸だったのかもわからなくなってしまうくらい。
lines.translated: To the point where you can't even tell what the beginning was, or which one was the original single thread anymore.

lines.content: ……絡まり合った糸は解きほぐさなきゃ正しい使い方はできない
lines.translated: "...You can't put tangled threads to proper use unless you unravel them first."

lines.content: 誰かがそれをやらなくちゃならない。
lines.translated: Someone has to do it.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だからこそ、だ。
lines.translated: And that's precisely why.
"'*I want to die in the absolute worst, most miserable way possible*--...'"

lines.content: [あの子|ぼく]はそんな“夢”を抱き、それを叶えたのだろう。
lines.translated: That boy--I--harbored such a "dream," and must have made it come true.

lines.content: 自分がただそこに存在しているというだけで、自分にやさしくしてくれたひと達全員、不幸になった。
lines.translated: Simply because he existed there, everyone who had been kind to him became unhappy.
*Because of his youth, he had lived without realizing that was the case.*

lines.content: ……それはただ、不幸な偶然が重なっただけの結果なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps that was merely the result of a series of unfortunate coincidences piling up.

lines.content: 運命論なんて後付けの論法だ。
lines.translated: Fatalism is nothing more than hindsight reasoning.

lines.content: この世界には目に見えない意図などどこにもない。ただ、いつも結果だけが残る。
lines.translated: There is no invisible intent anywhere in this world. Only the results ever remain.

lines.content: そういう見方も――そういう世界の捉え方もできるだろうし、それはそれで正しくて、それはそれで正確では、ない。
lines.translated: You could look at it that way--you could perceive the world like that, and while that would be right in its own way, it also wouldn't be entirely accurate.

lines.content: 世界や空間だけでなく可能性とは多義に渡って広大で。
lines.translated: Not just the world and space, but possibilities themselves are multifaceted and vast.

lines.content: 世界は、その人の心次第で変わるのだ。
lines.translated: The world changes depending on a person's heart.

lines.content: しかし、どうであれなんであれ、現在、結果は覆ることなく存在している。
lines.translated: However, no matter the hows or whys, the result currently exists, impossible to overturn.

lines.content: ――[・|自][・|分]が存在してしまったせいでやさしいひと達は、やさしかったが故に、不幸の底へと堕とされた。
lines.translated: --Because *he* existed, the kind people were cast down into the depths of misfortune precisely because they were kind.

lines.content: それに気づいた男の子はひとつ、大人になったのだ。
lines.translated: Upon realizing that, the boy grew up a little.

lines.content: 悪意はなくとも、人は人を、不幸にしてしまうことがある。
lines.translated: Even without malice, people can end up making others unhappy.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]人生から学び、成長した心には、もはや[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]しか世界の姿は映らない――自分は、邪悪だ。人の幸せを邪魔ばかりする“イキモノ”だ。
lines.translated: To a heart that has learned from life and matured *in that way*, the world can no longer be seen *in any other way*--I am evil. I am a "creature" that does nothing but get in the way of others' happiness.

lines.content: そんな自分の存在自体が許せない。そんな自分を、罰したい。
lines.translated: He couldn't forgive his own very existence. He wanted to punish himself for being that way.

lines.content: ……自分なんて産まれてこなければよかった。
lines.translated: I never should have been born.

lines.content: そう思えるくらい重い、とても重い罰で、だ。
lines.translated: With a punishment heavy enough--terribly heavy enough--to make him think that.
"...*To be resented and hated by the ones he loved, and ultimately killed by them in the end.*"

lines.content: あの男の子もまた愛情に飢え、孤独に喘ぐようにして生きていた――故に。
lines.translated: Because that boy, too, had lived starving for affection, gasping for air in his loneliness.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]以上に相応しい“代償”はないだろう。その“夢”を叶えるために相応しいだろう最期は。
lines.translated: There could be no more fitting "price" than *that*. No more fitting end to make that "dream" come true.

lines.content: ……俺が今、こうして生きていること自体が、あの男の子の“想い”が、ちゃんと届いたってことの証明なんだろうなと、感じるよ
lines.translated: "...I feel like the very fact that I'm alive like this right now is proof that the boy's 'feelings' properly reached their mark."

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: その暗闇の向こうに……。
lines.translated: Beyond that darkness...

lines.content: さくらだ。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms.

lines.content: さくらの花びらが舞っている。
lines.translated: Cherry blossom petals were dancing.

lines.content: そんな光景の中に……。
lines.translated: Amidst that scenery...

lines.content: 名もない“誰か”の、人生の“歌”を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: I felt as though I heard the "song" of a nameless "somebody's" life.

lines.content: 『これは……』
lines.translated: "'This is...'"

lines.content: これは、幸せを探し出すための物語。
lines.translated: This is a story to find happiness.

lines.content: これは、あなたの人生のための、物語。
lines.translated: This is a story for the sake of your life.

lines.content: さくらもゆる“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: Within the "Night" where cherry blossoms flare into bloom...

lines.content: もう二度と、君が悲しまなくても済むように――
lines.translated: So that you will never have to grieve again--

lines.content: さあ、引き金を引け。
lines.translated: Now, pull the trigger.

lines.content: たったひとりの[君|ましろ]を救うため。
lines.translated: To save the one and only you--Mashiro.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]は。
[ぼく|俺]は何度だって、散りゆくのだと――……
lines.translated: No matter how many times it takes, I will scatter away--...

lines.content: 閉じた[まぶた|瞼]を静かに開く。
lines.translated: I quietly opened my closed eyelids.

lines.content: ……“夜”を舞うさくらのひとひら。
lines.translated: A single cherry blossom petal dancing through the "Night."

lines.content: ……ああ、確かに
lines.translated: "...Yeah, without a doubt."
*A single "handgun" is gripped tightly in the palm of my hand.*

lines.content: ……確かに、君の[歌|物語]は……“想い”は、今、俺に届いたよ
lines.translated: "...Without a doubt, your song--your story... your 'feelings' have reached me now."

lines.content: 握りしめた“拳銃”を見つめ、思う――
lines.translated: Staring at the "handgun" gripped in my hand, I thought--

lines.content: さあ、どうなんだ。奏大雅。
lines.translated: Well then, how about it, Kanade Taiga?

lines.content: [・|今][・|度][・|こ][・|そ]俺は、この“魔法”の引き金を引けるのか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to pull the trigger of this "magic" *this time for sure*?
Now that I had finished talking with Kuro, *I remembered everything*.

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: すべて、書き換えられていた。
lines.translated: Everything had been rewritten.

lines.content: 確かに俺、奏大雅は、[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]通り魔に殺されることなどなく、ましろとの待ち合わせ場所に、[・|ひ][・|と][・|り][・|で]たどり着けた。
lines.translated: Sure enough, I, Kanade Taiga, was never killed by a phantom slasher *back then*, and managed to reach the meeting spot with Mashiro *all by myself*.

lines.content: そして“夜の国”から外へとふたりで一緒に逃げ延びて……。
lines.translated: And then the two of us escaped together from the "Country of Night" to the outside...

lines.content: ああそうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 俺は今現在に至るまでの道のりを、一つひとつ確認するようにして、思い出している。
lines.translated: I recalled the path that led up to the present moment, as if confirming each and every step along the way.

lines.content: “夜の国”から……。あるいは意地悪な大人たちから逃げ延びた俺とましろは、自分たちのために思い描いた“恋するための”人生を――物語を、生涯共に過ごしたのだ。
lines.translated: From the "Country of Night"... Or rather, having escaped from the cruel adults, Mashiro and I spent our entire lives together living the life--the story--"for the sake of falling in love" that we had envisioned for ourselves.

lines.content: ……いつも“隣”に君がいた
lines.translated: "...You were always right 'beside' me."

lines.content: いつまでも、ふたりきりだった
lines.translated: "It was just the two of us, forever and always."

lines.content: もう一瞬たりともさみしいと感じることはなくなったけれど……
lines.translated: "I never felt lonely for even a single moment anymore, and yet..."

lines.content: しかしそれでも、ほんの少しのさみしい距離感だけは、永遠に、消えないままだった。
lines.translated: Even so, just a tiny bit of lonely distance remained between us forever, never fading away.

lines.content: “半透明”とふつうの人間。
lines.translated: A "translucent" girl and a normal human.

lines.content: 互いに姿は見えるのに触れられないのだ。
lines.translated: Even though we could see each other, we couldn't touch.

lines.content: 長い人生、寄り添い合って生きて行くには不便なことが多かった
lines.translated: "Through our long life, there were many inconveniences in trying to live huddled close together."

lines.content: それでもやはり、幸せな人生だっただろうと思う
lines.translated: "Even so, I still think it must have been a happy life."

lines.content: 花の季節がやって来れば、色づく町をふたりで一緒に散歩した
lines.translated: "When the season of flowers arrived, the two of us took walks together through the colorful town."

lines.content: 青空高く汗ばむ季節には、君を隣に乗せて遠くの海まで時間をかけて、車ででかけた
lines.translated: "In the sweaty season beneath the high blue sky, I put you in the passenger seat next to me and took my time driving all the way out to the distant sea."

lines.content: ……熟れた色彩がこぼれ落ちるような世界で満ちる季節には、一緒に美味しいものを食べられなくて悲しくはあったけど
lines.translated: "...In the season when the world brimmed with ripe, overflowing colors, it was sad that we couldn't eat delicious food together, though."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]も、[あの子|ぼく]がくれた贈り物だったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was *this*, too, a gift that boy--I--had given us?

lines.content: それとも自分の持って生まれた“夜”と“現実”とを繋ぐ才能のせい、だろうか――俺は、大人になってもましろのことだけは決して忘れず、生きていけたから……。
lines.translated: Or was it because of the talent I was born with to connect the "Night" and "reality"? Even after growing into an adult, I was able to live on without ever forgetting about Mashiro...

lines.content: 凍てつくようなまっしろな季節にも、互いに寄せ合える身体はないはずなのに、不思議ととても暖かくて……
lines.translated: "Even in the freezing, pure white season, when we didn't even have bodies we could press together, it was mysteriously so very warm..."

lines.content: そしてまた、花の季節がやって来る。
lines.translated: And then, the season of flowers would come around once more.

lines.content: 君と一緒の時間は飽くことなく巡っていった。
lines.translated: The time I spent with you cycled on and on, without us ever growing tired of it.

lines.content: そうしてましろは約束どおり、俺がよぼよぼのおじいちゃんになるまで静かにそばにいてくれて……
lines.translated: "And just as promised, Mashiro quietly stayed by my side until I became a frail old man..."

lines.content: 幸せだった。
lines.translated: I was happy.

lines.content: ……最期は触れられない君と手と手を重ね、眠るようにして[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた
lines.translated: "...At the very end, I placed my hand over yours, even though I couldn't touch you, and closed my eyelids as if falling asleep."

lines.content: 想像以上の人生だった。
lines.translated: It was a life beyond anything I could have imagined.

lines.content: 何事も起こらないことこそが幸福である――とは、いったい誰が口にした言葉だっただろう。
lines.translated: Who on earth was it that said happiness is when nothing happens at all?

lines.content: 本の中。歌の中。
lines.translated: In a book. In a song.

lines.content: どこで見かけた言葉であったかは思い出せなくとも、ああそれは確かに、この世界の答えのひとつだろうなとは感じられていた。
lines.translated: Even if I couldn't remember where I had seen those words, I could feel that, ah, that was certainly one of the answers of this world.

lines.content: でも、おかしいねと、ふたりでいつも思ってた。
lines.translated: But the two of us always thought it was strange.

lines.content: 何か……。
lines.translated: Something was off...

lines.content: 何か大切なものを忘れてる。
lines.translated: We were forgetting something important.

lines.content: そんな言葉にできない感覚だけが、いつも胸に消えず在り続けていた。
lines.translated: Only that indescribable sensation lingered in our chests, never fading away.

lines.content: “次”に目覚めたとき、俺たちは揃って“夜”に立っていた――そしてすべてを、知ったのだ。
lines.translated: The "next" time we woke up, we were standing together in the "Night"--and we learned everything.

lines.content: いや――“夜”に教えられた。
lines.translated: No--we were taught by the "Night."

lines.content: 俺たちが一緒に過ごした幸せな時間は全部、名もない“誰か”に支えられ、あり得たものなのだということを。
lines.translated: That all the happy times we had spent together were only possible because they were supported by a nameless "somebody."

lines.content: 『……まったく』
lines.translated: "'...Good grief.'"
Wait.

lines.content: 人生を終え、ましろと共に“夜”へと戻り、すべて知らされた俺は、空を――“夜”の空を見上げ、苦笑いを浮かべた。
lines.translated: Having finished my life, returned to the "Night" with Mashiro, and been told everything, I looked up at the sky--the sky of the "Night"--and gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 『[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は詰めが甘いなあ』
lines.translated: "'*That guy* really is too sloppy at the end.'"

lines.content: 最期の最期に至ろうともだ。
lines.translated: Even when it came down to the absolute very end.

lines.content: 『[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]真実を俺たちが知ることのないようにしなければ――これから俺たちがどうするかなんて、決まってるじゃないか』
lines.translated: "'If he didn't keep us from learning the truth *like this*--isn't it obvious what we're going to do from here on out?'"

lines.content: それとも……。
lines.translated: Or perhaps...

lines.content: それとも俺たちもまた、君を大切に想うのだろう人たち同様――[・|こ][・|こ][・|に][・|至][・|っ][・|て][・|も][・|ま][・|だ]、君を憎からず感じていると信じたのだろうか。全人類の敵“夜の王”として。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, just like the people who must have cared deeply for you, did you believe that *even after coming this far*, we still wouldn't hate you? Even as the enemy of all mankind, the "King of the Night."

lines.content: それとも[・|こ][・|れ]は[あの子|ぼく]の意思など関係なくて。
lines.translated: Or maybe *this* had nothing to do with that boy's--my--will at all.

lines.content: “夜”に住む何者かが……たとえば、あのさくらに眠るたくさんの“想い”が叶えてくれた[何か|奇跡]なのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it something--a miracle--granted by someone living in the "Night"... for instance, by the many "feelings" sleeping within that cherry tree?

lines.content: そう考えることもまた、悪くはないかもしれないなとそう思った。
lines.translated: I thought to myself that thinking about it that way might not be so bad either.

lines.content: まあ、何であれ……。
lines.translated: Well, whatever the case...

lines.content: やることは決まってる。
lines.translated: What we had to do was already decided.

lines.content: ――助けよう。
lines.translated: --Let's save him.

lines.content: “夜”に戻ったあのときのましろと俺。どちらともなくそう言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Mashiro and I, back when we had returned to the "Night." Neither of us was the first to say it; we both just did.
--*Let's go save that boy.*

lines.content: 『……いつも、いつもだ。何か大切なことを忘れてる。そんな気がしてたから。このまま俺たちだけで幸せになってもいいのかどうか――……』
lines.translated: "'...Always, all the time. I felt like I was forgetting something important. Because I had that feeling, I wondered if it was really okay for just the two of us to become happy like this--...'"

lines.content: 『心のどこかで少し、ほんの少しの落ち着かなさがあったのだ』
lines.translated: "'Deep down in my heart, there was a little, just a tiny bit of restlessness.'"

lines.content: 『でも、思い出せて良かった。すっきりしたよ』
lines.translated: "'But I'm glad I could remember. I feel refreshed now.'"

lines.content: 俺は、ふたり一緒に手を繋ぎ、“夜”へと戻ったましろにそう言った。
lines.translated: Holding hands together, I said that to Mashiro after we had returned to the "Night."

lines.content: それはとても[・|よ][・|か][・|っ][・|た]だなんて、そう言い切ることのできないものでは、あったけれど……それでもだ。
lines.translated: Though it wasn't something I could easily call *good* without any reservations... even so.

lines.content: 『このまま全部忘れたままで、取り返しなんてまったく付かないような状態になったあとにようやく、気づいてしまったら……』
lines.translated: "'If we had just forgotten everything like that, and only finally realized it after things had reached a point of no return...'"

lines.content: 『それこそ、そんなのは悪い夢だ。言葉になんてできないくらい“後悔”してただろうし』
lines.translated: "'That truly would have been a bad dream. We would have "regretted" it beyond words.'"

lines.content: 『うん。……そうだね。実は、私もだよ』
lines.translated: "'Yeah... You're right. Actually, I felt the same way.'"

lines.content: “隣”で、ましろが――ようやく[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]触れられる、手を繋いでいられる、もう“半透明”なんかではない君が、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: "Beside" me, Mashiro--you, whom I could finally touch *like this*, whose hand I could hold, who was no longer "translucent" at all--was smiling.

lines.content: 『私……幸せだった』
lines.translated: "'I... was happy.'"

lines.content: ましろは俺を見上げ、言う。
lines.translated: Mashiro looked up at me and spoke.

lines.content: 『“外の世界”では、こうしてあなたと触れあえなくても。そばにいられるだけで、本当にほんとうにね。幸せだったんだよ』
lines.translated: "'Even if I couldn't touch you like this in the "outside world." Just being able to stay by your side made me really, truly happy.'"

lines.content: 『……憧れだった恋することも叶えられたし。想像以上のそのお話を、あなたと、生きてこれた』
lines.translated: "'...My longing to fall in love came true, too. And I got to live out that story, which was beyond anything I could have imagined, with you.'"

lines.content: ……でも、とましろは言った。
lines.translated: But, Mashiro said.

lines.content: 『でもね。もしもうひとつだけ、幸せなことを重ねられるのなら……』
lines.translated: "'But you know. If I could pile on just one more happy thing...'"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 『私、あなたとの子どもがほしかった』
lines.translated: "'I wanted to have a child with you.'"

lines.content: ましろは苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: Mashiro gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 『そんなの、おかしいよね』
lines.translated: "'That's strange, isn't it?'"

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: 『だって、“外の世界”じゃこうして触れられもしなかったのに……願う順番とか、色々、変だなって自分でも思う』
lines.translated: "'I mean, we couldn't even touch each other like this in the "outside world"... Even I think the order of my wishes, and all sorts of things about it, are weird.'"

lines.content: 『でもね。私はいつも、そう願っていたの』
lines.translated: "'But you know. I was always wishing for that.'"

lines.content: 『あなたと一緒に、あたらしい“命”をこの世界に迎えられたならって。それが私の……、決して叶うことのない“夢”だった』
lines.translated: "'Thinking how wonderful it would be if I could welcome a new "life" into this world together with you. That was my... "dream" that could never come true.'"

lines.content: ましろはそう言い、俺と繋いだ手に力を込める。そして、満天に輝く“夜”の空を見上げ――“もしも”と囁き、微笑んだ。
