lines.translated: Saying that, Mashiro squeezed my hand tighter. Then, she looked up at the starry sky of the "Night"--whispered, "What if," and smiled.

lines.content: 『もしも、だよ？　……あんなかわいい子が、私に……私たちに、微笑んで……』
lines.translated: "'Just "what if," okay? ...If a cute kid like him smiled at me... at us...'"

lines.content: 『そしてね、お母さんって。お父さんって。そう呼んでくれたら……それは、うん。とっても幸せだろうなって思う。私も、負けずに笑顔になれるかもしれない』
lines.translated: "'And you know, if he called us Mom, and Dad... I think, yeah, that would make me so very happy. I might even be able to smile just as brightly as him.'"

lines.content: 『そうだね』
lines.translated: "'You're right.'"

lines.content: そういうのもありかもしれない。
lines.translated: Something like that might be nice, too.

lines.content: 『……ふたりではなく三人だったなら、もっともっと楽しかったかもしれないね。俺たちの時間は……、全部』
lines.translated: "'...If there had been three of us instead of two, it might have been even more fun. All of... our time together.'"

lines.content: ましろと俺は、しっかり手を繋いだままうなずき合った。
lines.translated: With our hands firmly clasped together, Mashiro and I nodded to each other.

lines.content: さあ、考えよう――……思い描こう。
lines.translated: Come on, let's think--...let's envision it.

lines.content: 俺たちに幸せを届けてくれたあの子のことを助け出す。そのための“魔法”は、どこにあるだろう。
lines.translated: Saving that boy who delivered happiness to us. Where could the "magic" for that be?

lines.content: ……思い描くすべてが叶う“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Country of Night," where everything you envision comes true.

lines.content: この場所を最大限に利用して、俺たちは、あたらしい俺たちの“夢”を、どういうふうに叶えられるだろうか。
lines.translated: By making the absolute most of this place, how can we make our new "dream" come true?

lines.content: 『あ、ああ……やっと、見つけた』
lines.translated: "'Ah, aah... I finally found you.'"

lines.content: 声がする。
lines.translated: Her voice rang out.

lines.content: 『お願い――……お願い、します。どうかあの子を、救って……ください』
lines.translated: "'Please--... I beg of you. Please, save... that boy.'"

lines.content: 振り向いた先に、いつもあの子のことだけ見つめてる――そんな“想い”が、いっぱいの涙を流し、うつむいていた。
lines.translated: When we turned around, there stood that "feeling" who always gazed only at him--shedding endless tears, her head bowed low.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だから[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]俺たちは、様々な可能性を想定しあった結果――……[・|も][・|う][・|一][・|度][・|だ]。
lines.translated: That was why, *back then*, after the three of us considered all the various possibilities together--... *One more time*.

lines.content: ……たったひとりの[・|君]を救うため。
lines.translated: In order to save the one and only *you*.

lines.content: さあ、あたらしい物語をはじめようか。
lines.translated: Come now, shall we begin a new story?

lines.content: ましろと俺は、しっかりと繋いでいた手を、離し……。
lines.translated: Mashiro and I let go of the hands we had been holding so tightly...

lines.content: もう一度だけ。
lines.translated: Just one more time.

lines.content: 俺たちは離ればなれになることを……、決めたのだった。
lines.translated: We decided... to part ways.
*Just a little more.*

lines.content: もう少しだけ、[・|現][・|在]にまで繋がる昔話について俺は、思う――
lines.translated: For just a little longer, I think back on the old tale that leads all the way to the *present*--

lines.content: 『大丈夫。心配しないで。……そんな顔、しないでよ。私はもうさみしくないよ』
lines.translated: "'It's okay. Don't worry. ...Don't make that face. I'm not lonely anymore.'"

lines.content: そう言いやさしく微笑む君と、あのときの俺は、たったひとつの“魔法”を想い――繋いだばかりの手を離したのだった。
lines.translated: With you smiling gently as you said that, the me of back then envisioned a single "magic"--and let go of the hand I had only just taken hold of.

lines.content: 『うん。もう、私はさみしくなんてない。だって、大雅。あなたと生きたいっぱいの時間があるんだもん。だから安心して――いってらっしゃい』
lines.translated: "'Yeah. I'm not lonely at all anymore. Because, Taiga, I have all the time I lived together with you. So don't worry--have a safe trip.'"

lines.content: お願いね。絶対、ぜったい、あの子のことを助けてね。
lines.translated: Please. Make sure you definitely, definitely save that boy.

lines.content: そんな君の言葉を胸に、
lines.translated: Holding those words of yours in my heart,

lines.content: もしも[・|あ][・|の][・|子]に会えたら伝えてほしいと渡された言伝を、胸に、
lines.translated: Holding the message I was given to pass along if I ever met *that boy* in my heart,
*By paying a tremendous "price" to the "Night," I* boarded the train and decided to set off *all alone* toward a distant--a very distant time.

lines.content: ましろと俺、そしてクロ。
lines.translated: Mashiro, me, and Kuro.

lines.content: 俺たち三人の取り戻したいと願う[・|あ][・|の][・|子]が、どんな人生を歩んだか。
lines.translated: What kind of life *that boy*, whom the three of us wished to bring back, had walked.

lines.content: その殆どすべてを、花びら舞い散る“夜”を通し、垣間見た俺たちだから……。
lines.translated: Because we had caught a glimpse of almost all of it through the "Night" of fluttering petals...

lines.content: 『あの子が私たちを取り戻してくれた手順を追って、[・|あ][・|の][・|子][・|と][・|同][・|じ][・|よ][・|う][・|に][・|し][・|て]、今度は、私たちがあの子を取り戻そう。……今は、そんな方法しか思いつけない』
lines.translated: "'Let's follow the steps he took to bring us back, *do things the same way he did*, and this time, let's bring him back. ...Right now, that's the only way I can think of.'"

lines.content: それが俺たちの描いた“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: That was the "magic" we envisioned.
"Magic"...

lines.content: 絵本の中みたいに奇跡的な出来事を、一瞬でたぐり寄せられるような“[魔法|もの]”じゃない。
lines.translated: It wasn't the kind of "magic" that could pull a miraculous event straight out of a picture book in a single instant.

lines.content: いつだって想像以上の奇跡は、たゆまぬ一歩から静かに、目立たず、はじまるものだ――ましろはそう言い、大人びた笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: Miracles beyond imagination always begin quietly and inconspicuously, from a single, tireless step--Mashiro said that, showing a mature smile.

lines.content: 『そういうふうに、私は、あなたと生きた人生の中で学んだよ。少しだけ……うん。私はようやく、少し大人になれたのかもしれないよ』
lines.translated: "'That's what I learned in the life I lived with you. Just a little... yeah. Maybe I've finally managed to grow up a little.'"

lines.content: あの子が俺たちを取り戻してくれた手順を追う。そうすることが重要だとましろは言った。
lines.translated: Following the steps that boy took to bring us back. Mashiro said doing so was important.

lines.content: ……想像するすべてが叶う“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Country of Night," where everything you envision comes true.

lines.content: そこで“魔法”と変わる“想像”の“力”は、悲しみやさみしさや……そういった心に育つ“想い”の“力”なのだと、そう言い換えることも可能だろう。
lines.translated: The "power" of "imagination" that turns into "magic" there could also be rephrased as the "power" of "feelings" that grow in the heart--things like sadness and loneliness.

lines.content: ならばあの子と同じような経験を経て、得られる[想い|何か]が必要だ――俺たちの求める“魔法”を、想像以上の“形”にするためには。
lines.translated: In that case, we needed the feelings gained by going through the same kinds of experiences he did--in order to give the "magic" we sought a "form" beyond imagination.

lines.content: そうして得られたあの子と同じ“魔法”で、あの子を、取り戻す。
lines.translated: And with that same "magic" of his gained that way, we would bring him back.

lines.content: それはつまり、まず、あの子が生きた[時間|人生]をなぞってみようということだ。
lines.translated: In other words, it meant I first had to try retracing the life he had lived.

lines.content: しかし奏大雅としての肉体を、寿命という時の流れの中で朽ちさせてしまったこの俺だ。
lines.translated: However, my physical body as Kanade Taiga had already withered away in the flow of time known as a lifespan.

lines.content: “夜”の中で生きる“命”はあっても、肉体がなければ“夜”の外では生きていけない。それがこの世界のルールだ。
lines.translated: Even if I had a "life" that lived within the "Night," without a physical body, I couldn't live outside the "Night." That was the rule of this world.

lines.content: だからましろが[・|支][・|払][・|い]を済ませ、“刻の終着駅”で素材を集め、この肉体を創り上げてくれた――[・|あ][・|の][・|子]と殆ど同じ身体をだ。
lines.translated: That was why Mashiro settled the *payment*, gathered materials at the "Terminal Station of Time," and created this physical body for me--a body almost identical to *that boy's*.

lines.content: 『……いってらっしゃい。大雅。私は[・|こ][・|こ]から、あなたのことを――あなた達のすべてを、ずっとここから応援してるね』
lines.translated: "'...Have a safe trip, Taiga. I'll be cheering for you--for everything you all do, always, right from *here*.'"

lines.content: ましろは微笑みながらそう言って、遠い“夜”の彼方へと姿を消した。
lines.translated: Mashiro said that with a smile, and vanished into the distant reaches of the "Night."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: だめだったんだ
lines.translated: I couldn't do it.

lines.content: [・|現][・|在]に至るまでの思い出をなぞり終え――俺は、つぶやく。
lines.translated: Having finished retracing the memories leading up to the *present*--I mutter to myself.

lines.content: そして自身の[・|弱][・|さ]を情けなくも、思う。
lines.translated: And I think, pathetically, of my own *weakness*.

lines.content: 俺はましろと話し合ったとおり、あの子が奏大雅として歩んだ道をなぞるように、生きた。
lines.translated: Just as I had discussed with Mashiro, I lived as if retracing the path he had walked as Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 幼馴染みの少女たちの人生に、共に向き合い、それぞれが胸に秘められた“魔法”を、目覚めさせる。
lines.translated: Facing the lives of the childhood friend girls together with them, and awakening the "magic" hidden within each of their hearts.
*I prayed that I would be able to do so*.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 俺は……
だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: すべて思い出した。
lines.translated: I remembered everything.

lines.content: 思い出してしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up remembering it all.

lines.content: ……俺は、ヒーローなんかじゃない。
lines.translated: I'm no hero at all.

lines.content: 俺はさ、本当にだめな奴だ
lines.translated: Man, I really am hopeless.

lines.content: 君に憧れてもらえるような人間じゃない。だって俺は、君のように――“魔法”の引き金を引くことが、できなかったんだ
lines.translated: I'm not the kind of person worthy of your admiration. Because unlike you--I couldn't pull the trigger of "magic."

lines.content: 怖かった。
lines.translated: I was scared.

lines.content: ただただ、怖かったんだ。
lines.translated: I was just so, so scared.

lines.content: [あの子|君]を救い出す“魔法”を得るには、あの子と同じように、少女らの願いを叶える必要があった。俺たちはそう信じた。
lines.translated: To obtain the "magic" to rescue you, I needed to grant the girls' wishes, just like he did. That was what we believed.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 柊ハルを救うため、“拳銃”の“魔法”で自身を撃ち抜く――そんな勇気はどうしても、どうしても、俺には持てなかったんだ
lines.translated: Shooting myself with the "magic" of the "handgun" in order to save Hiiragi Haru--no matter what, no matter how hard I tried, I just couldn't muster that kind of courage.

lines.content: ハルが自身の命を絶った翌日。
lines.translated: The day after Haru took her own life.

lines.content: 俺はぐずぐずと悩み、歩みを止め……。
lines.translated: I agonized endlessly, stopping in my tracks...
*Even though I was supposed to have braced myself, knowing that I would have to do this someday*...

lines.content: それなのにクロと描いた“魔法”を手にしたまま、俺は――……だめだ。
lines.translated: Even so, with the "magic" I envisioned with Kuro in my hand, I--...it was no use.

lines.content: 一歩も、動けなくなった。
lines.translated: I couldn't move a single step.

lines.content: 何度も銃口をこめかみに突きつけはした。
lines.translated: I pressed the muzzle to my temple again and again.

lines.content: 指先に力を込めようともした。
lines.translated: I tried to put strength into my fingertip, too.

lines.content: 本当に死ぬわけではないと知っている。次の時間世界を創り上げるだけ。そこでまたハルを助けるために、歩き出す。
lines.translated: I knew I wouldn't realmente die. It would just create the next time-world. And there, I would start walking again in order to save Haru.

lines.content: そのためのスタートなのだ。
lines.translated: It was the starting line for that sake.

lines.content: [あの子|ぼく]の歩んだ殆どすべてを理解していたのだから、こんなふうに恐怖だってする必要はないはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Because I understood almost everything he had walked through, there shouldn't have been any need for me to be terrified like this, and yet...

lines.content: それでも、だめだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't do it.

lines.content: ……だめだった
lines.translated: I couldn't do it.

lines.content: 湧いてくるのは勇気ではなく、ただいっぱいの、恐怖と……涙だ。
lines.translated: What welled up inside me wasn't courage, just an overwhelming amount of fear... and tears.

lines.content: 一日経った
lines.translated: One day passed.

lines.content: 二日経った
lines.translated: Two days passed.

lines.content: 三日、四日――一週間。一ヶ月。……一年。二年
lines.translated: Three days, four days--a week. A month. ...A year. Two years.

lines.content: ……[あの子|ぼく]ならとっくに、ハルのことを救い出してるはずだ
lines.translated: If it were him, he would have rescued Haru a long time ago.

lines.content: しかし俺は、どうだ。
lines.translated: But what about me?

lines.content: ……時間は無為に過ぎ去るけれど、いつまで経っても俺は“魔法”を使えなかった
lines.translated: Time passed by in vain, and no matter how much time went by, I couldn't use the "magic."

lines.content: 悩んでばかりで一歩たりとも、先へ前進できないままだった。
lines.translated: All I did was agonize, unable to move even a single step forward.

lines.content: その内に、俺の心は大人になってしまった。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, my heart had grown into an adult's.

lines.content: そして……すべて、忘れた
lines.translated: And then... I forgot everything.

lines.content: “夜”に関することをすべて、だ。
lines.translated: Everything related to the "Night."

lines.content: ましろと一緒に生きた最初の人生では、ましろのことだけは忘れなかったのに……
lines.translated: Even though in the first life I lived together with Mashiro, she was the one thing I never forgot...

lines.content: 彼女と離ればなれになってしまったら、その奇跡は俺に起きてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: Once I was separated from her, that miracle didn't happen for me.

lines.content: すべて忘れた俺は大人になり、教師として生きる道を選んだ。
lines.translated: Having forgotten everything, I became an adult and chose the path of living as a teacher.

lines.content: それはおそらく、あの子の時間を覗き見ていたが故、無意識のうちに選んだ道なのだろうと今だから、わかる。
lines.translated: Now, I can understand that it was probably a path I chose unconsciously because I had peered into his time.

lines.content: 俺には向かない道だった。
lines.translated: It was a path that didn't suit me.

lines.content: 人生の大半を費やす仕事は、できるならやりたいことを――必ずしも選べるわけではないかもしれないが――それでもせめて、得意なことを選ぶ必要がある。
lines.translated: For the work you spend the majority of your life doing, you need to choose what you want to do if possible--though you might not always get to choose--or at the very least, choose something you're good at.

lines.content: 仕事が充実するなら人生の九割は幸せだ。
lines.translated: If your work is fulfilling, ninety percent of your life will be happy.

lines.content: そんな言葉をどこかで見かけてことがある。
lines.translated: I've seen words like that somewhere before.

lines.content: きっとそれなりに偉い人が、未来を生きる人たちへと残した言葉だろうと思う。
lines.translated: I'm sure they were words left behind by someone reasonably great for the people living in the future.

lines.content: その人にとって正しい道なら、その道の中に嫌な奴など現れもしないと、そう言う人もいた。
lines.translated: Someone also said that if it's the right path for a person, unpleasant people won't even appear along that path.

lines.content: 確かに、そうだな。
lines.translated: That's certainly true.

lines.content: 教師なんて、俺には――奏大雅にはあんまりに向かない道だった。上手くできないことが多すぎる
lines.translated: Being a teacher was a path that just didn't suit me--didn't suit Kanade Taiga at all. There were far too many things I couldn't do well.

lines.content: ……日々を鬱々としながら生きてきた。
lines.translated: I lived my days in a state of gloom.

lines.content: 上手くいかない日々は、辛辣な言葉を正義として浴びせられる日々は、自己価値というか――
lines.translated: Days where things don't go well, days of being showered with biting words under the guise of justice, wear down your self-worth--

lines.content: 自己重要感のようなものを疲弊させていく。結果。自身の命さえ、投げだそうかと考えてしまう。
lines.translated: Or rather, your sense of self-importance. As a result, you even start thinking about throwing your own life away.

lines.content: ……結果。
lines.translated: As a result.

lines.content: あいつは、弱い。ただの甘え。
lines.translated: That guy is weak. He's just being spoiled.

lines.content: そんな言葉で、潰えた命は処理されていく。
lines.translated: With words like that, a crushed life is written off and processed away.

lines.content: ……何か
lines.translated: Something.

lines.content: 何か自分には、もっと向いている道があったのではないか。
lines.translated: Wasn't there some other path out there that suited me better?

lines.content: そんなことばかりを考えてきたけれど……。
lines.translated: That was all I ever thought about, and yet...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 向いてる道どころの話では、ない。
lines.translated: This isn't even a matter of finding a path that suits me.

lines.content: こんなにも、大切な、やるべきことを忘れていただなんて……
lines.translated: To think I had forgotten something so important, something I had to do...

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: クロから電話をもらうまで、何もかもすべて、忘れてしまっていたのだ。
lines.translated: Until I got that phone call from Kuro, I had completely forgotten everything.

lines.content: 恐らくいつもそばにあったのだろうこの端末のことも、大人になってしまった俺は、そばにあっても視界に入らず――気づいていなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: Even this terminal, which had probably always been right beside me--because I had become an adult, even though it was right there, it didn't enter my field of vision, and I probably never even noticed it.

lines.content: 今こうして思い出せていることはほとんど奇跡だ。
lines.translated: Being able to remember it like this right now is practically a miracle.

lines.content: またすべて忘れてしまう前に、この引き金を引き――成すべきことを成さなければ……ああ。
lines.translated: Before I forget everything again, I have to pull this trigger--and do what must be done... Aah.

lines.content: まったく。
lines.translated: Honestly.

lines.content: いったい誰に恥じ入るべきかもわからない。
lines.translated: I don't even know who I should be ashamed in front of.

lines.content: [・|君]は、すごいよ
lines.translated: *You* are amazing.

lines.content: クロと話したことで、またこうして再び握りしめた“拳銃”を――俺は、見つめる。
lines.translated: Having spoken with Kuro, I stare at the "handgun" that I'm gripping tightly once again.

lines.content: ……君は俺なんかのことをヒーローだと、そんなふうに呼んだけど。何度となく、そう呼んでくれていたけれど
lines.translated: You called someone like me a hero. You called me that over and over again, and yet.

lines.content: 世界や、大勢の人々の心を救う英雄のことを、多くの物語は勇気ある者と書く。
lines.translated: Many stories write of the heroes who save the world and the hearts of countless people as those who possess courage.

lines.content: それが真実であるのなら……[・|本][・|物][・|だ]。
lines.translated: If that is the truth... then *you're the real deal*.

lines.content: 君だ。君こそが、本当のヒーローだ
lines.translated: "It's you. You are the true hero."

lines.content: つぶやいて、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: I murmured and closed my eyelids.

lines.content: 君の勇気を少しだけでいい。俺に、貸してくれ。
lines.translated: Just a little bit of your courage is fine. Please, lend it to me.

lines.content: “拳銃”をこめかみに添えた。
lines.translated: I pressed the "handgun" against my temple.

lines.content: 今度こそ……。
lines.translated: This time, for sure...

lines.content: すべて忘れてしまう前に、この引き金を引いて……。
lines.translated: Before I forget everything, I'll pull this trigger...

lines.content: 今度こそ俺は、歩むべき道を行く。
lines.translated: This time for sure, I will walk the path I'm meant to take.

lines.content: 震える。
lines.translated: I tremble.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 涙が、止まらない。
lines.translated: My tears won't stop.

lines.content: お願いだ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: ……頼むよ
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: もう、俺は自分に失望したくない。
lines.translated: I don't want to be disappointed in myself anymore.

lines.content: ……頼むから、引き金を……引いてくれっ
lines.translated: "...Please, just let me pull... the trigger!"

lines.content: 一時間。二時間。
lines.translated: One hour. Two hours.

lines.content: 銃口を自身に添えてまま……時間だけ、経過し。
lines.translated: With the muzzle still pressed against myself... only time passed by.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: また、大人になった俺の中で、大切な記憶が薄く、引き延ばされていくけれど……。
lines.translated: And once again, inside my adult self, those precious memories were growing thin, stretched out further and further, and yet...

lines.content: 引き金を、引けない――……
lines.translated: I can't pull the trigger--...

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 歯を、噛みしめる。
lines.translated: I clench my teeth.

lines.content: ……あああああああああああああああああああああ！！
lines.translated: "...Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!"

lines.content: 暴れた。
lines.translated: I lashed out wildly.

lines.content: 俺は……っ、俺……あああくそ！！　いったい、俺は、何なんだ……！！！！！！
lines.translated: "I'm... ngh, I... Aaaah, dammit!! Just what the hell am I...?!?!"

lines.content: 部屋のものをめちゃくちゃに壊し、何かを誤魔化すように、叫び……。
lines.translated: Thrashing the things in my room to pieces, screaming as if to cover something up...

lines.content: ……誰かっ、誰か……ああ、あああっ
lines.translated: "...Someone, someone... aah, aaaah!"

lines.content: 自分で引けないなら誰かに頼む――そんなことも、孤独になってしまった今の俺には、願えないから……。
lines.translated: If I can't pull it myself, I'll ask someone else to do it--now that I've become completely alone, I can't even wish for something like that...

lines.content: ……ヒーローだっ
lines.translated: "...A hero!"

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.

lines.content: ……ヒーローは、どこにいってしまったんだよっ
lines.translated: "...Where the hell did my hero go?!"

lines.content: 自分の[人生|物語]を救えるヒーローは自分自身ただひとり。
lines.translated: The only hero who can save the story of your life is yourself alone.

lines.content: 今を乗り越えるための、勇気を――胸の中にその所在を探し、求め、泣きながら祈っては、駄々を踏むように暴れ回り……、
lines.translated: Searching inside my chest for the courage to overcome the present, begging for it, praying through my tears as I threw a tantrum and trashed the room...

lines.content: 引き金は、引かれた。
lines.translated: The trigger was pulled.

lines.content: 暴れ回った部屋で足を滑らせ転倒し、その弾みで発砲された――偶然発射された弾丸に、俺は、射貫かれたのだ。
lines.translated: My foot slipped in the trashed room, sending me tumbling down, and the gun went off from the momentum--I was pierced right through by a bullet fired by sheer accident.

lines.content: ああ、まったく。
lines.translated: Aah, honestly.

lines.content: ……この道は、俺にはあんまりに、重すぎた
lines.translated: "...This path was just far too heavy for me."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]は君の人生だ。
lines.translated: *This* is your life.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]は、君にしか解決できない道だったんだ。
lines.translated: *This* was a path that only you could resolve.

lines.content: こんなにも情けない俺を、これから誰がヒーローだなんて呼んでくれるだろう。
lines.translated: Who would ever call someone as pathetic as me a hero after this?

lines.content: だから今度は俺の番。
lines.translated: That's why it's my turn this time.

lines.content: ……俺は、俺の人生を救わなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to save my own life."

lines.content: そんな想いと共に、次に向かう先は決まってた。
lines.translated: With those thoughts in mind, my next destination was already decided.

lines.content: ……さあ、行こう。
lines.translated: Alright, let's go.

lines.content: 俺のヒーローに会いに行こう。
lines.translated: Let's go meet my hero.

lines.content: 遠い“夜”の彼方に、刻を越え、走り続ける列車の音を俺は聞いた。
lines.translated: Far beyond the distant "Night," transcending time, I heard the sound of a train continuing to run.

lines.content: 鳴り響いた[・|銃][・|声]でぼくは目覚める。
lines.translated: I wake up to the ringing echo of a *gunshot*.

lines.content: 真っ暗だ。
lines.translated: It's pitch black.

lines.content: 大人たちから無価値と言われ、閉じ込められた地下牢の中。
lines.translated: Inside the underground dungeon where I was locked away after being called worthless by the adults.

lines.content: このままここで大人しく、いい子にしていればいい。
lines.translated: All I have to do is stay here quietly and be a good boy.

lines.content: そうすればお母さんがいつか迎えに来てくれる――それが“希望”だった。
lines.translated: If I do that, Mom will come pick me up someday--that was my "hope."

lines.content: だからその日を待ってる。いつまでも、ずっとだ。
lines.translated: So I'm waiting for that day. Forever and always.

lines.content: そんな真っ暗闇の夜の中。
lines.translated: In the middle of such a pitch-black night.

lines.content: なにか、悪い夢を見ていた気がする。
lines.translated: I feel like I was having some kind of bad dream.

lines.content: だけどそれがどういった夢だったのか。
lines.translated: But what kind of dream was it?
*Who in the world was I?*
*I can't remember at all*...

lines.content: ……やあ、おはよう
lines.translated: "...Hey, good morning."

lines.content: ふと、投げかけられたその声には、聞き覚えがあった。
lines.translated: That voice, suddenly called out to me, sounded familiar.

lines.content: 毎晩のように、ここへぼくらの様子を見にやって来る男の子だ。
lines.translated: It's the boy who comes here almost every night to check on us.

lines.content: いつか必ず、ぼくらをここから救い出すと誓ってくれた[・|ヒ][・|ー][・|ロ][・|ー]だ。
lines.translated: He's the *hero* who swore that he would definitely save us from this place someday.

lines.content: 確か、[・|彼]はこういう名前だったはず。
lines.translated: If I remember right, *his* name was...

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: 奏、大雅だ。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga.
"Yeah, that's right. *We finally meet.*"

lines.content: ……続けられたその声と言葉で、なぜだろう、心の温度が一気に下がる。そんな気がした。
lines.translated: With that continuing voice and those words, for some reason, I felt the temperature of my heart drop all at once.
*Who I truly was.*

lines.content: それを、思い出してしまった――“夜の王”だ。
lines.translated: I ended up remembering it--I am the "King of the Night."

lines.content: どうしてぼくは、こんな所にいるんだ
lines.translated: "Why am I in a place like this?"

lines.content: ぼくは、ましろの代わりに、人々から嫌悪される“夜の王”となったはず――その[・|は][・|ず][・|だ]。
lines.translated: In Mashiro's place, I was supposed to have become the "King of the Night," loathed by the people--*I was supposed to*.

lines.content: 繰り返し、繰り返し……。
lines.translated: Over and over, again and again...

lines.content: 助け出したいと願った少女らに、枝葉に分けられた世界の数だけこの命を、ひとつ、またひとつと摘み取られていかなければならないはずなのだ。
lines.translated: By the girls I wished to save, this life of mine is supposed to be plucked away, one by one, for every single world branched out like leaves on a tree.

lines.content: そういう罰を自身に課した。
lines.translated: I imposed that punishment upon myself.

lines.content: そうでなければ叶えられない“夢”があった。
lines.translated: Because there was a "dream" that couldn't be granted any other way.

lines.content: それなのに、どうして……。
lines.translated: And yet, why...?

lines.content: ああ。やっと、追いついたよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I finally caught up to you."

lines.content: ……やっと、追いついたよ。俺の。……いいや。[・|俺][・|た][・|ち][・|の]“[・|魔][・|法]”は君に、届いたのかな
lines.translated: "...I finally caught up to you. Did my... No. Did *our* '*magic*' reach you?"

lines.content: 格子越しに立つ奏大雅は微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Standing on the other side of the bars, Kanade Taiga was smiling.

lines.content: でも、そこにはどこか疲労の色が濃く窺えた。
lines.translated: However, a deep exhaustion was clearly visible on his face.

lines.content: ここまでの道のりは、本当に長くて……。でもほんの一瞬のことでもあったんだ。様々なものを犠牲にだってしたと思う。自分自身に失望だってした。何度もだ。でも……
lines.translated: "The journey to get this far was truly long... Yet it also happened in just an instant. I think I sacrificed all sorts of things. I was even disappointed in myself. Over and over again. But..."

lines.content: 奏大雅が、格子越しに手をこちらへ向けた。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga reached his hand out toward me through the bars.

lines.content: ああ、本当にここまで長かった――でも、こうしてようやく君に、追いついた。だからもう、すべて無駄なんかじゃなかったと信じられる
lines.translated: "Aah, it really took so long to get here--but like this, I finally caught up to you. So now, I can believe that none of it was in vain."

lines.content: それはあのときと同じ光景だと、ぼくは思い出す。
lines.translated: I remember that this is the exact same sight as back then.

lines.content: 母親や大人たちの言いつけを護り、心を殺すように、暗闇の中で呼吸していたあの頃――“一緒にここから逃げよう”と、奏大雅が差し出してくれた手だ。
lines.translated: Back when I obeyed the orders of my mother and the adults, breathing in the darkness as if deadening my own heart--it was the hand Kanade Taiga held out to me, saying, "Let's run away from here together."

lines.content: そのときとまったく変わらないぼくは、そのときとまったく変わらず、差し出された手を取っていた。
lines.translated: Completely unchanged from back then, I took the hand held out to me, just as I had back then.
*Just who in the world am I?*

lines.content: そんな想いを未だ、拭いきれないままに……。
lines.translated: Still unable to wipe away that thought...

lines.content: 君は、すごいよ
lines.translated: "You're amazing."

lines.content: ため息を付くように、彼は言った。
lines.translated: He said it as if letting out a sigh.

lines.content: 俺には、とてもあんな“魔法”は使えなかった。……引き金を引く勇気なんて、どこにもなかったんだ
lines.translated: "There was no way I could ever use 'magic' like that. ...I didn't have the courage to pull the trigger anywhere in me."

lines.content: 不思議だ――
lines.translated: It's strange--

lines.content: ……さあ、行こう
lines.translated: "...Alright, let's go."

lines.content: 彼のその言葉がまるで、引き金だったかのように――
lines.translated: As if those words of his were a trigger--
"I came to save you--no. That's wrong. *There is someone waiting for your help.* Let's get out of here right now."

lines.content: 彼と繋いだ手から、たくさんの時間と記憶が……。
lines.translated: From the hand joined with his, so much time and so many memories...

lines.content: ここまでぼくを求め、歩いてきてくれた道のりについてのすべてが、一瞬で、この空っぽな心に流れ込んでくる――……ああ、[・|こ][・|れ]は彼の[物語|人生]だ。
lines.translated: Everything about the journey he walked in search of me to get this far flows into this empty heart of mine in a single instant--...Aah, *this* is the story of his life.

lines.content: 遠い“夜”に響いた汽笛の音を、心で聞いて……。
lines.translated: Listening with my heart to the sound of a train whistle echoing in the distant "Night"...

lines.content: ぼくは、ほんの少しの夢を見た。
lines.translated: I dreamed just a little dream.
*I hear the sound of a running train.*

lines.content: 偶然発射された“[弾丸|魔法]”により現在を吹き飛ばし――心は幼い自分の肉体に戻った[・|俺]、奏大雅は、[・|そ][・|の][・|場][・|所]を目指した。
lines.translated: Blowing away the present with a "magic bullet" fired by sheer accident--with my mind returned to my young physical body, *I*, Kanade Taiga, headed for *that place*.

lines.content: ……うーん。なるほど
lines.translated: "...Hmm. I see."

lines.content: 俺の[・|こ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で]の話を聞いて、“夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひは、うなずいていた。
lines.translated: Listening to my story of *everything up until now*, the "Magician of the Night," Himukai Asahi, was nodding.

lines.content: ……あの子の“想い”を模倣するかのように作った“拳銃の魔法”
lines.translated: The "handgun magic" I made as if to imitate that boy's "feelings."

lines.content: その力を借りやって来たのは“ゆめのねどこ”だ。
lines.translated: Borrowing that power, the place I arrived at was the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: まだ“夜の王”を[・|彼][・|女][・|ら]が打倒してしまう、少し前。
lines.translated: Just a little before *the girls* would overthrow the "King of the Night."

lines.content: あの男の子が幼い頃、クロと一緒にやって来たのと同じ時だ。
lines.translated: It was the exact same time that boy had come here together with Kuro when he was young.

lines.content: そっか。私たちが今まで、君たち人類の未来を救うため――とそう信じ、何とか打倒しなければと考えていた“夜の王”は、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]して産まれたのか
lines.translated: "I see. So the 'King of the Night' we've been trying to overthrow all this time, believing it would save the future of humanity, was born *that way*."

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”は俺たちの言うことを、殆ど疑うこともなくすんなりと信じてくれた。
lines.translated: The "Magician of the Night" readily believed what we told her with almost no doubt at all.

lines.content: ええっと。奏大雅、だったかな。君の言うことは信じるよ。まあ確かに、こうもすっぱり信じてしまえるだけの理由はないけど、同じように、疑う理由もないからね
lines.translated: "Let's see... Kanade Taiga, was it? I believe what you're saying. Well, I certainly don't have enough reason to believe you so easily, but by the same token, I have no reason to doubt you either."

lines.content: だから信じる、と“魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: And that's why I believe you, the "Magician" said.

lines.content: 私は君とこうして会うのははじめてだ。でも、君はもう、私とはもう何度となく会っている？
lines.translated: "This is the first time I'm meeting you like this. However, have you already met me many times before?"

lines.content: ……そう、ですね。そういうことになります
lines.translated: "...Yes, I suppose. That's how it turns out."

lines.content: 最初はあの子の人生を模倣するためここに来た。
lines.translated: At first, I came here to imitate that boy's life.

lines.content: だけど今度は、俺自身の物語に立ち向かうため、ここにいる。
lines.translated: But this time, I'm here to confront my own story.

lines.content: うん。なるほどなるほど。すると、つまり……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I see, I see. Then, in other words..."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: The "Magician" looks around the area.

lines.content: 今、私の目には見えていないだけで、君のそばにいるのかな
lines.translated: "Right now, I just can't see her with my own eyes, can I? Is she right there beside you?"

lines.content: ましろだよ。君の言うあの子が助けたいと願った“夜の女王”――君にしか見えない“半透明”だ。ふたりで一緒に、[・|も][・|う][・|一][・|度]、ここに戻ってきたのかな
lines.translated: "Mashiro, I mean. The 'Queen of the Night' that the boy you mentioned wished to save--the 'translucent girl' only you can see. Did the two of you come back here together *one more time*?"

lines.content: いえ……
首を振り、言う。
lines.translated: I shake my head and answer.

lines.content: ましろは“夜の国”に……未来の世界に、置いてきました
lines.translated: "I left Mashiro behind in the 'Country of the Night'... in the world of the future."

lines.content: 置いてきた。……どうして？
lines.translated: "You left her behind. ...Why?"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を“代償”としたからです
lines.translated: "Because I made *that* my 'price.'"

lines.content: ましろと俺が幸せに寄り添えあえる可能性は本来、あり得ないものだ。あの子が願ってくれなければ産まれることのない可能性だった。
lines.translated: The possibility of Mashiro and me happily snuggling close to each other was originally something impossible. It was a possibility that never would have been born if that boy hadn't wished for it.

lines.content: そのあり得ないものを自ら、手放す――
lines.translated: Letting go of that impossible thing of my own accord--

lines.content: 『“夜の国”なんて特異なものがあるからいけないの』
lines.translated: "'It's bad because something as singular as the "Country of the Night" exists at all.'"

lines.content: ましろは言っていた。
lines.translated: Mashiro had said that.

lines.content: 『……本来、ここはとある少女が愛しい人に会いに行くために作ったもので』
lines.translated: "'...Originally, this place was made by a certain girl so she could go meet the person she loved.'"

lines.content: 『だけどその“想い”にたくさん、たくさんの人たちの意図が絡みつき、少女自身も心を壊し……肥大してしまった場所だ』
lines.translated: "'However, the intentions of so, so many people got tangled up in those "feelings," and the girl herself broke her own heart... turning it into a bloated place.'"

lines.content: 『これは私の戦いだ』
lines.translated: "'This is my fight.'"

lines.content: ましろは言っていた。
lines.translated: Mashiro had said that.

lines.content: 『……今日から私たちは敵同士ね』
lines.translated: "'...From today on, we're enemies, aren't we?'"

lines.content: そう言い姿を消したあの子と私との戦いなんだ。
lines.translated: It is a fight between me and that girl who disappeared after saying those words.

lines.content: 『だから私は“[ここ|夜の国]”を、この世界を生きる人たちの“想い”や記憶や時間、そういった目には見えないものを保存する場所に、作り替えるよ』
lines.translated: "'That's why I'm going to remake this place, the "Country of the Night," into somewhere that preserves the unseen things of the people living in this world--their "feelings," their memories, and their time.'"

lines.content: 『そうしてあたらしく生まれ変わったこの場所から、私は、あなた達人間の描く人生を――恋するためのものがたりだけではないいっぱいの物語を――人生を、応援していきたい』
lines.translated: "'And from this newly reborn place, I want to cheer on the lives you humans paint--not just stories for the sake of falling in love, but all kinds of stories--your lives.'"

lines.content: 俺たちは繋いだばかりの手を離し、また、離ればなれになった。
lines.translated: We let go of the hands we had only just joined, and were separated once again.

lines.content: その別れを支払いとして、俺は切符を購入でき、時間を遡る列車に乗れたのだった――“何かを得るなら、同等の価値ある何かを支払わなければならない”
lines.translated: Using that farewell as payment, I was able to buy a ticket and board the train that travels back through time--"To obtain something, something of equal value must be paid."

lines.content: “夜”のルールだ。
lines.translated: That is the rule of the "Night."

lines.content: ……そうか。その男の子を助けるために、大切なひとと別れることにしたのか。君たちは
lines.translated: "...I see. In order to save that boy, you decided to part ways with someone precious to you. Both of you."

lines.content: そうまでしたのに、俺は……
lines.translated: "Even though we went that far, I..."

lines.content: “拳銃”の“魔法”を君は、使えなかった
lines.translated: "You couldn't use the 'handgun magic.'"

lines.content: その通りだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: そして今、その“拳銃”の“魔法”に射貫かれて、再びここに戻って来れた。でも、その引き金を引いたのは君の勇気ではなく、偶然の産物だ
lines.translated: "And now, pierced by that 'handgun magic,' I was able to return here once again. However, what pulled that trigger wasn't my courage, it was a product of sheer coincidence."

lines.content: ああそうだ。その通り以外の何ものでもない。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right. It is nothing other than the exact truth.

lines.content: お願いします
lines.translated: "Please."

lines.content: 俺は頭を下げる。
lines.translated: I bow my head.

lines.content: ……どうか、あの子を取り戻すため……力を貸してください
lines.translated: "...Please, in order to take that boy back... lend me your strength."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: “魔法使い”はうなずくけれど、
lines.translated: The "Magician" nods, however,

lines.content: どうしてなのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder why."

lines.content: と、首をかしげた。
lines.translated: She tilted her head.

lines.content: どうして、私に頼るのかな
lines.translated: "Why are you relying on me, I wonder?"

lines.content: 私はただの“魔法使い”だ、とあさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: I'm just a "magician," Asahi-san said.

lines.content: 君と一緒にいたという“半透明”の女王に叶えられなかったことを、たかだか一介の“魔法使い”に成せるとは思えないんだけれどね
lines.translated: "I really don't think a mere 'magician' like me can accomplish something that the 'translucent' Queen who was with you couldn't grant, though."

lines.content: しかも私はさ、ただ自分で“魔法使い”を名乗っているだけの痛い奴だ
lines.translated: "Besides, I'm just a cringey person who calls herself a 'magician' on her own."

lines.content: 私たち“夜のイキモノ”は誰ひとり、本当の“魔法”を使えない。[・|本][・|物]はいつも、いつだって、君ら人間の中にだけあるものだ。それなのに……
lines.translated: "Not a single one of us 'Creatures of the Night' can use true 'magic.' The *real thing* is always, at all times, found only inside you humans. And yet..."

lines.content: それなのにどうして、私を頼るのかな。具体的に誰がとは思いつけないけれど、それでもこんな私なんかより、今の君らの助けになってくれるものは別にいそうなものだけれど
lines.translated: "And yet, why are you relying on me? I can't think of anyone specific, but even so, it feels like there should be someone else out there who could be of more help to you right now than someone like me."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: こうして泣きつく相手はあなた[・|達]でなければならない絶対の理由は確かにない。
lines.translated: There certainly is no absolute reason why the ones I come crying to like this have to be you *all*.

lines.content: “魔法”であれ“得策”であれ、何か、特別な“道具”であれ――あなた達があの男の子を取り戻すため、どうしても必要な何かを持っているわけではないからだ。
lines.translated: Whether it's "magic," a "good plan," or some special "tool"--it's not as if you all possess something absolutely necessary to take that boy back.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: あの男の子を助け出すため協力してくれる相手が、あなた達であってほしい理由なら、あります
lines.translated: "If it's a reason why I want the ones helping me rescue that boy to be you all, then I have one."

lines.content: あの子の自身を憎む“想い”は強烈すぎたのだ。
lines.translated: That boy's "feelings" of self-hatred were simply too intense.

lines.content: 持って生まれた特別な“才能”ではなく、深く自身を抉った悲しみで描いた“魔法”は、やはり、どうしようもなく強烈すぎて……。
lines.translated: The "magic" painted not with a special inborn "talent," but with a sorrow that gouged deeply into himself, was, after all, hopelessly too intense...

lines.content: 俺たちだけでは無理だった。たった一度も引き金を引くことさえ、叶わなかった。
lines.translated: It was impossible for us alone. We couldn't even pull the trigger a single time.

lines.content: だからあえて、だ。
lines.translated: That is why I'm doing this deliberately.

lines.content: あえて俺は、あの子が信頼と好意を寄せていたのだろうこの[・|ひ][・|と][・|達]に、助けを請いたいと思った。
lines.translated: I deliberately wanted to ask for help from *these people* toward whom that boy surely held trust and affection.

lines.content: 実際、もうあなた達以外に頼る先がなかった――そんなつまらない状況に追い詰められていたということもあります。でも、それ以上に
lines.translated: "In truth, there's also the fact that I had nowhere else to turn besides you all--I was cornered into such a pathetic situation. But more than that..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……この世界は、持って生まれた[才能|能力]では越えられない“想い”が必ずあるはず
lines.translated: "...In this world, there must surely be 'feelings' that cannot be surpassed by inborn ability."

lines.content: そう信じたい。
lines.translated: I want to believe that.

lines.content: そういう目には見えない何かを、人は“奇跡”だとか“魔法”だとか呼びたがるものなんだと、信じたい。……信じたいから、あなた達こそを頼りたいと、思った
lines.translated: "I want to believe that people like to call those unseen things 'miracles' or 'magic.' ...Because I want to believe that, I wanted to rely on you all above anyone else."

lines.content: わかってる。
lines.translated: I know.

lines.content: ……本当はわかってるんだ。
lines.translated: In truth, I know.

lines.content: “才能”を越える“想い”の力だなんて、そんなもの、そう易々とありはしないだろうことくらい。
lines.translated: I know full well that something like the power of "feelings" surpassing "talent" doesn't exist so easily.

lines.content: よくある絆の力だとかなんだとか……。
lines.translated: The classic power of bonds, or whatever else...

lines.content: そんな下らないことを口にしたいわけではないし、すがりつく先としてはあんまりにも心許ない。
lines.translated: It's not that I want to spout such trivial nonsense, and it's far too unreliable a thing to cling to.

lines.content: そういうものを平気で口にできてしまえるのは、まるでお花畑のような思考回路で胸焼けだってする。心が粟立つような思いだって、する。
lines.translated: Being able to say things like that with a straight face takes a train of thought like a field of flowers, and it gives me heartburn. It even makes my skin crawl.

lines.content: だけどここは“夜”の世界だ。
lines.translated: However, this is the world of the "Night."

lines.content: 持って生まれた“才能”よりも……。
lines.translated: More than inborn "talent"...

lines.content: 悲しみの中に産まれる“想い”こそ、夜よりも暗い暗闇の底を照らす光で在ってほしいとそう願う。
lines.translated: I wish for the "feelings" born within sorrow to be the very light that illuminates the bottom of a darkness darker than night.

lines.content: “夜”を通して見たあの子の人生。……あなた達のことを、あの子はとても大切に想っていた。一緒に笑い合うだけの時間をとても楽しいと感じてた
lines.translated: "That boy's life, which I saw through the 'Night.' ...He cherished you all so very much. He felt that the time spent simply laughing together with you was so much fun."

lines.content: ただ覗き見ていただけなのに、その気持ちは充分に伝わってきた。……だから
lines.translated: "Even though I was only peeking in on it, those feelings came through to me more than enough. ...That's why."

lines.content: だからあなた達の力こそを借りたいのだ――
lines.translated: That's why it is your strength that I want to borrow--

lines.content: あの子のことを大切に想ってくれているだろうひと達ならば、俺なんかよりもずっと上手に、確実に、あの子のことを救ってくれるはず
lines.translated: "If it's the people who surely cherish that boy, they should be able to save him much better, and much more reliably, than someone like me."

lines.content: 繰り返しそう言う俺に、“魔法使い”は首をかしげるようにうなずいて、
lines.translated: As I repeat those words, the "Magician" nods as if tilting her head.

lines.content: そうだね。わかるよ。……君の言いたいことはなんとなく
lines.translated: "That's true. I get it. ...I more or less understand what you're trying to say."

lines.content: ここは“想い”こそが“力”となる“夜の国”だ。そういうことなら私たちが協力することも、君がそうしたいのだと言うこともまあ、わからないでもないけれど……
lines.translated: "This is the 'Country of the Night,' where 'feelings' themselves become 'power.' If that's the case, it's not that I don't understand why we would cooperate, or why you want to do it that way, however..."

lines.content: でもね、と“魔法使い”は更に深く、首をかしげた――……“[・|想][・|い]”[・|も][・|何][・|も]。
lines.translated: "But you see," the "Magician" tilted her head even deeper--...*Never mind "feelings" or anything else.*

lines.content: 私たちにその子をどうこう思う心はない
lines.translated: "We don't have a heart that feels one way or another about that boy."

lines.content: はっきりと“魔法使い”は言い切った――だって、そうだろう？　考えても見ろよ、と。
lines.translated: The "Magician" declared it flatly--Because that's how it is, right? Just think about it, she seemed to say.

lines.content: [・|今]の私たちは、その子を知らないどころか、まだ出会ってさえいないのに？
lines.translated: "The us of *right now* don't even know that boy, let alone have we even met him yet?"

lines.content: ……それは
今の私たちには、その子がどこの誰なのか。まったくわからないのに……？
lines.translated: "To the us of right now, who that boy is or where he's from... we don't know a single thing, you know...?"

lines.content: それどころか。
lines.translated: Far from it.

lines.content: 私たちとその子とが出会う瞬間を、こうして君が、今まさに書き換えてしまっているのに？
lines.translated: "Even though you, right here and right now, are in the middle of rewriting the very moment we meet that boy?"

lines.content: 君の話が真実であるのなら、今、ここに来るべきだったのはその男の子なんだろう？　相棒の黒猫と一緒に――……
lines.translated: "If your story is true, the one who should have come here right now is that boy, isn't it? Together with his black cat partner--..."

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。今はもう既に“夜の王”となってしまっているのなら、そうはならないのかもしれないけれど。だから君が、ここにこうしていられるのかも、しれないけれど
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. If he has already become the 'King of the Night' right now, maybe it wouldn't turn out that way. And maybe that's why you're able to be here like this."

lines.content: 時間と空間というものは複雑だな、と“夜の魔法使い”は肩を竦めた。
lines.translated: Time and space sure are complicated, the "Magician of the Night" shrugged her shoulders.

lines.content: 俺は何も言えなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't say anything.

lines.content: 確かに複雑だ。
lines.translated: It certainly is complicated.

lines.content: たまごが先か鶏が先か。
lines.translated: Which came first, the chicken or the egg?

lines.content: そういったお決まりの話があるけれど……。
lines.translated: There are cliched sayings like that, however...

lines.content: それどころではなく、あんまりにも複雑に、悪戯に、あらゆる糸が絡まり合ってしまってる。
lines.translated: Far beyond that, every single thread has gotten tangled up together all too intricately and mischievously.

lines.content: すべては“夜の国”だなんていう時間と空間の特異点が、安易に産み出されてしまったせいだ。ましろはそう言っていた。
lines.translated: It's all because a singularity of time and space like the "Country of the Night" was so carelessly created. That's what Mashiro had said.

lines.content: だから絡んだ糸をまずは一つ、またひとつ、解きほぐしていかなければならず――
lines.translated: Therefore, we first have to untangle the knotted threads one by one--

lines.content: そのために俺は、あの子の人生をなぞるようにしたけれど……。
lines.translated: For that sake, I tried to trace over that boy's life, however...

lines.content: しかしその思惑は失敗し――俺の勇気のなさという計算外のため、成り立たず――今、こうして“夜の魔法使い”に泣きついている。
lines.translated: However, that plan failed--falling apart due to the miscalculation of my own lack of courage--and now, I am crying to the "Magician of the Night" like this.

lines.content: ともあれ、だ。まだ出会ってもいない子に対して、私たちに“想い”も何もあるわけがない――……
lines.translated: "In any case. Toward a boy we haven't even met yet, there's no way we have any 'feelings' or anything--..."

lines.content: ……なんて
lines.translated: "...Yeah, right."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: そんな意地の悪いことは言わないよ。いやまあ、実際口に出してしまってはいたけれど……うん。ちょっとじゃれてみただけだ。ごめんな
lines.translated: "I won't say something so mean-spirited. Well, I did actually say it out loud, though... Yeah. I was just teasing a little. Sorry about that."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべ、“魔法使い”は言う。
lines.translated: With a wry smile on her face, the "Magician" speaks.

lines.content: わかった。協力する
lines.translated: "Got it. I'll cooperate."

lines.content: ほ、本当ですか……？
lines.translated: "R-Really...?"

lines.content: ああ。だけど実際、私たちに何ができるのかは、これからの話だ。じっくり考えてみないことにはわからないけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Though what we can actually do is something we have to talk about from here on out. We won't know until we really sit down and think it through, however..."

lines.content: でも……。話を聞いてると、すごいな。不謹慎だってわかってるけどどきどきもするんだ
lines.translated: "But still... just listening to your story, it's amazing. I know it's inappropriate, yet my heart is pounding too."

lines.content: ほら、時を幾つも改変したり飛び越えたりして、大切な人を取り戻そうとするのは、物語の中ではよく聞く部類ではあるけれど……
lines.translated: "Come on, rewriting and leaping across time over and over to take back someone precious is the kind of thing you hear about often enough in stories, however..."

lines.content: だからこそだ、と“魔法使い”は悪戯っぽく、笑った。
lines.translated: That's precisely why, the "Magician" laughed mischievously.

lines.content: だからこそ、自分のことを“魔法使い”だなんて呼んでるものからするとさ、俄然やる気のようなものが湧いてくるんだよ。必ずだ。必ずそのお話を成し遂げてみせようってね
lines.translated: "That's precisely why, for someone who calls herself a 'Magician,' it suddenly makes a feeling like motivation well up inside me. Without fail. Let's bring that story to fruition without fail, you know?"

lines.content: だから協力するよと“魔法使い”は繰り返し言い、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: So I'll cooperate, the "Magician" repeated, smiling.

lines.content: 奥間とお店とを繋ぐ入り口から、ちらちらとこちらを伺う顔があった。
lines.translated: From the entrance connecting the back room to the shop, there was a face peeking our way every now and then.

lines.content: 目が合うとびくっと震え、パタパタと走って行ったのは――“魔法使い”の妹だろう。
lines.translated: The one who flinched with a start when our eyes met and pitter-pattered away was--likely the "Magician's" little sister.

lines.content: そんな様子に“魔法使い”と俺は少し、笑った。
lines.translated: At that sight, the "Magician" and I laughed a little.

lines.content: なあ、奏大雅。その男の子はきっと、かわいい子なんだろうな
lines.translated: "Hey, Kanade Taiga. That boy must be an adorable kid, isn't he?"

lines.content: “魔法使い”が静かに言った。
lines.translated: The "Magician" said quietly.

lines.content: ……はい
俺はうなずいて、答える。
lines.translated: I nod and answer.

lines.content: ……とてもかわいいし、とても、やさしいい子なんです。そしてとても勇気のある子だ。……俺なんかより、ずっと
lines.translated: "...He's very adorable, and a very, very kind kid. And he's a kid with a lot of courage. ...Far more than someone like me."

lines.content: そうか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: うんうんと深くうなずき――“私も”と、あさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Nodding deeply--"Me too," Asahi-san says.

lines.content: [・|今]の私も、早くその子に会ってみたいな
lines.translated: "The me of *right now* wants to meet that kid soon, too."

lines.content: そして、腕によりを掛けるから――これからここに集まってくるのだろう全員で、暖かい料理を囲んだりしてみたい。
lines.translated: And I'll put my whole heart into cooking--so I'd love for everyone who will likely gather here from now on to sit around warm dishes together.

lines.content: ……その子には、好きなものいっぱい食べさせて、いっぱい、甘やかしてやりたい。なんだかそんな気がするよ
lines.translated: "...I want to let that kid eat lots of his favorite foods, and spoil him lots. For some reason, I have that kind of feeling."

lines.content: 誰か、ひとりでもいい。
lines.translated: Anyone, even just one person, is fine.

lines.content: 自分を[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]扱ってくれるひとが、誰の人生にでも必ずひとりは、いるべきなんだよ。きっと
lines.translated: "Everyone definitely ought to have at least one person in their life who treats them *like that*. Surely."

lines.content: ……厳しいことを言いたがる人は、[・|自][・|分][・|自][・|身][・|を][・|含][・|め]、放っておいてもいくらでもいるからね
lines.translated: "...Because even if you leave things alone, there are plenty of people who love to say harsh things, *including oneself*."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は――あさひさんはそんなことを言い、どこか複雑そうな笑みを見せていた。
lines.translated: The "Magician"--Asahi-san said such things, showing a somewhat complicated smile.

lines.content: 君たちにひとつ、お願いしたいことがあるんだ。一緒に“夜の王”を救ってほしい
lines.translated: "There is one thing I want to ask of you all. I want you to help save the 'King of the Night' together with us."

lines.content: あさひさんは食卓をぐるりと囲む[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]に、そう言った――……見知った顔の少年少女たちだ。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said that to *us* sitting in a circle around the dining table--...boys and girls with familiar faces.

lines.content: [・|前][・|回][・|と][・|同][・|じ][・|よ][・|う][・|に]、それぞれが乗り越えがたい人生の課題を抱え、“魔法”を頼り、“奇跡”を願い、“夜”へと訪れた子どもたち。
lines.translated: Children who, *just like last time*, each carried insurmountable life problems, relied on "magic," wished for a "miracle," and visited the "Night."

lines.content: その子たちに本来ならあひささんは……“夜の魔法使い”は、その願いを叶えるため共に“夜の王”と戦ってはくれないかと、願い出る。
lines.translated: Ordinarily, to those children, Asahi-san... the "Magician of the Night" would make a request, asking if they would fight the "King of the Night" together with her in order to grant their wishes.

lines.content: ここはそういう時間として、“夜”に[・|記][・|録]されているはずだ。
lines.translated: This place is supposed to be *recorded* in the "Night" as that kind of time.

lines.content: しかし今、物語は、ここに集められた幾つかの人生は、あたらしい時間と空間に枝分かれする。
lines.translated: However, right now, the story--the several lives gathered here--branches off into a new time and space.

lines.content: 俺という特異点との出会いを経た“魔法使い”は、集められた子らに、こう願ったのだ――どうか“夜の王”を[・|救][・|う]ため、力を貸してくれないか、と。
lines.translated: Having gone through an encounter with a singularity like me, the "Magician" made this wish to the gathered children--asking if they would please lend their strength in order to *save* the "King of the Night."

lines.content: そしてそのための方法をひとつ、示してみせたのだ――まずは[・|あ][・|の][・|子]が“夜の王”へと成りはてなければならなかった心の夜を……“悪夢”の所在を、見つけよう。
lines.translated: And she demonstrated one method for doing so--First, let's find the night of the heart where *that kid* had to end up becoming the "King of the Night"... the whereabouts of the "Nightmare."

lines.content: “夜”を通じてその“悪夢”と戦い、男の子の心の中から切り取ってしまうんだ。そのようにして原因を削除することが叶うのなら、未来の結果もまた変わるのかもしれない
lines.translated: "We will fight that 'Nightmare' through the 'Night,' and cut it out from inside the boy's heart. If we can delete the cause in that way, the result in the future might also change."

lines.content: 集められた子らは明らかに困惑し……。
lines.translated: The gathered children were clearly bewildered...

lines.content: まだ名前も知らない仲間たちと視線を合わせ、戸惑う心を交換しあっていた。
lines.translated: Exchanging glances with companions whose names they didn't even know yet, trading their confused feelings with one another.

lines.content: 無理もない。
lines.translated: It's no wonder.

lines.content: そもそも自分たちのことで精一杯なはずだ。
lines.translated: To begin with, they must have their hands full just dealing with their own matters.

lines.content: 自分の人生に少しでも光りがほしいと願い、“希望”を求め、“夜の王”を一緒に倒すなら求めるものを渡そうという言葉を信じ――ここにこうして、集められてきたはずなのだ。
lines.translated: Wishing for even a little light in their own lives, seeking "hope," believing the words that they would be given what they sought if they defeated the "King of the Night" together--they must have been gathered here like this.

lines.content: [・|ま][・|だ]見ず知らずであるはずの子を助けるだとか、どうだとか――そんなことを話し合う以前の問題だ。
lines.translated: Helping a kid who is *still* supposed to be a complete stranger, or whatever else--this is an issue that comes way before discussing things like that.

lines.content: 俺がもし彼らの立場なら、子どもらしく不平のひとつやふたつ口にして、平気な顔で場の空気をささくれ立たせていたはずだ。
lines.translated: If I were in their position, I would have voiced a complaint or two like a child and ruined the mood of the room with a straight face.

lines.content: 彼らがそうすることに、決して誰も文句も言えないはずだ。
lines.translated: Nobody could ever complain if they were to do that.

lines.content: 彼らは[だま|欺]されて連れてこられたのだと、そういうふうに言い換えることだってできてしまえるからだ。
lines.translated: Because you could even rephrase it to say that they were *deceived* and brought here.

lines.content: しかしあさひさんはそんな子らを前にして、
lines.translated: However, standing before such children, Asahi-san...

lines.content: すべて、話して聞かせたとおりだ
lines.translated: "Everything is just as I've told you."

lines.content: 念を押すようにして、言うのだ。
lines.translated: She says, as if to drive the point home.

lines.content: 今、君らが友人となるはずだった子が、深い“夜”の底に閉じ込められてる
lines.translated: "Right now, a kid who was supposed to become your friend is trapped at the bottom of the deep 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……いや。違うな
lines.translated: "...No. That's wrong."

lines.content: 今どころかずっとだ。ずっとずっと、長い間、永遠にも等しいだろう繰り返しの時間の中で、たったひとり、苦しみ続けてる
lines.translated: "Far from just right now, it's been that way the whole time. For a long, long time, within a repeating time that must be equal to eternity, he has been suffering all alone."

lines.content: たぶんその友だちを助けられるのは私たちだけ……いいや、君たちだけなんだ
lines.translated: "Perhaps we are the only ones who can save that friend... No, only you all."

lines.content: 君たちがこの話を信じるか否かは任せるよ。協力だってもちろん強制はしないし、できようはずもない――まあ、そのわりには、善意を期待するような物言いばかりしているけれどね
lines.translated: "Whether you believe this story or not, I'll leave up to you. Of course I won't force you to cooperate, nor could I possibly do so--well, for saying that, I sure am talking as if I'm expecting your goodwill, though."

lines.content: 君らの人生は、……君らの時間は、すべて君らだけのものだ。他の誰かのために使うべきものじゃない。一秒だって。ただでさえ君らの時間は短いからね
lines.translated: "Your lives... your time belongs entirely to you alone. It isn't something that should be used for someone else's sake. Not even a single second. Especially since your time is short enough as it is."

lines.content: それにほら、君らからまだ自己紹介だって受けていないのに、全員の名前も知っていたのは言わずもがな、この子だ。この奏大雅から教えてもらったからだ。たぶん、正解だろう？
lines.translated: "Besides, look, the reason I knew everyone's names even though I haven't even heard your self-introductions yet goes without saying--it's because of this kid. Because I was told by this Kanade Taiga. That's probably correct, right?"

lines.content: 顔を見ればわかるよ、とあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: I can tell just by looking at your faces, Asahi-san says.

lines.content: たったこれだけのことで、[・|こ][・|の][・|話]の信憑性とすることは難しいだろうけれど……
lines.translated: "Though it would probably be difficult to take just this alone as proof of *this story's* credibility..."

lines.content: どうかな。協力してもらえるかな
lines.translated: "What do you say? Could I get you to cooperate?"

lines.content: うだうだと迂遠なことを言ったけど、ちゃんと“約束”は守るよ。“夜の王”を倒すのではなく救い出せれば、君らの求める“魔法”を渡す
lines.translated: "I rambled on in a roundabout way, but I will properly keep our 'promise.' If we can rescue the 'King of the Night' rather than defeating him, I will hand over the 'magic' you seek."
"...*I think I will also do my best so that I can issue the 'permission' for that sake.*"

lines.content: 長々とした“魔法使い”の言葉をすべて受け止め、彼女らは改めて互いを見ていた。
lines.translated: Taking in all of the "Magician's" lengthy words, the girls looked at each other once again.

lines.content: ……俺からも、お願いします
lines.translated: "...I'm begging you, too."

lines.content: 頭を下げた。
lines.translated: I bowed my head.

lines.content: 黙って聞いているだけではいられない。すべて任せっぱなしなんて、それもまた、あり得ない。
lines.translated: I can't just sit here and listen in silence. Leaving everything entirely up to her is also out of the question.

lines.content: どうか、みんなの力を貸してほしい
lines.translated: "Please, I want you all to lend me your strength."
*Without hiding anything I could talk about right now, and without any lies, I told everyone everything.*

lines.content: “夜の王”を一緒に“夜”の底から、救い出してほしいんだ
lines.translated: "I want you to rescue the 'King of the Night' from the bottom of the 'Night' together with me."

lines.content: 精一杯の誠意のつもりだった。
lines.translated: I meant it as my utmost sincerity.

lines.content: うそもなく、これまで起きたことをすべて、話す――だけどもしかしたらそうすることは逆効果だったかもしれない。
lines.translated: Without any lies, telling them everything that has happened up to now--however, doing so might have actually had the opposite effect.

lines.content: ハルも。千和も。姫織もみんな、沈黙するばかり。言葉もなく見つめ合っている。
lines.translated: Haru. Chiwa. Himeori, and everyone else, only remained silent. They are looking at each other without a word.

lines.content: 困惑の空気が色濃くなっていく中で、あさひさんが、[あの子|男の子]を取り戻すために提案したものは、以下の通りだ――
lines.translated: As the atmosphere of bewilderment grew thicker, what Asahi-san proposed in order to take back *the boy* was as follows--

lines.content: 男の子が自分自身を“夜の王”とするまでの道のりを阻止しよう。“夜”を通してなら可能なはずだ
lines.translated: "Let's stop the path that leads to the boy making himself the 'King of the Night.' It should be possible through the 'Night.'"

lines.content: “夜の国”はもともと、ひとりの少女が過去へ旅立つために産まれたもので……。
lines.translated: The "Country of the Night" was originally born for a single girl to depart on a journey to the past...

lines.content: この町に産まれた時間世界のすべてを、その空間そのものを記憶媒体として保存する記憶の図書館。あるいは時間の墓場。それが“夜”という場所らしい
lines.translated: "A library of memories that preserves all the time-worlds born in this town, using the space itself as a storage medium. Or perhaps a graveyard of time. It seems that is the place called the 'Night.'"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はここより遙か遠い未来で産まれ……。
lines.translated: *It* was born in a future far, far distant from here...

lines.content: 以来、いついかなる時代の静かなる隣人として存在する“夜の国”は、[・|記][・|録][・|さ][・|れ][・|た][・|あ][・|ら][・|ゆ][・|る][・|時][・|間][・|世][・|界]への出入り口として存在し、干渉することを可能とする――
lines.translated: Ever since, the "Country of the Night," existing as a silent neighbor to any and all eras, exists as a doorway to *every recorded time-world*, making it possible to interfere with them--

lines.content: それは、ひとつの時間世界を軸とした過去や未来だけでなく、数多ある可能性の時間世界の過去や未来へも行き来できる。まるで、平行世界や異世界を行き来するように――……
lines.translated: "Not only can it go back and forth to the past and future centered around a single time-world, it can also go back and forth to the past and future of time-worlds of countless possibilities. Just like going back and forth between parallel worlds or different worlds--..."

lines.content: ……と、私は、奏大雅の話を聞いた中で感じたんだ
lines.translated: "...At least, that is what I felt while listening to Kanade Taiga's story."

lines.content: あさひさんは、言う――あくまでも私の所感や予感でしかないけれど、と。
lines.translated: Asahi-san says--Though it is ultimately nothing more than my own impression and premonition.

lines.content: 私も、ただ[・|こ][・|こ]で長く暮らしているというだけで、そのすべてを知っているわけじゃない。むしろ知らないことのほうが多いだろうと思う
lines.translated: "I have simply lived *here* for a long time, and it's not as if I know everything about it. Rather, I think there are probably more things that I don't know."

lines.content: 君ら人間が住処とするこの[ほし|地球]のことを、まだまだすべて知らないみたいに。だけどもし、私の予感が正しくて……
lines.translated: "Just like how you humans still don't know everything about this *planet* you call home. However, if my premonition is correct..."
If *doing so* becomes possible as the result of an *appropriate payment*...
"*If a new us, different from the us up until now*, can rescue the 'King of the Night' rather than defeating him..."

lines.content: そこからまた、あたらしい時間と世界がこの町に産まれるのではないか――まだ未来の確定していないまっしろな時間が、産まれるのではないか。
lines.translated: From there, wouldn't a new time and world be born in this town once again--wouldn't a pure white time, whose future is not yet fixed, be born?

lines.content: その空白の時間の中に、望んだ以上の未来を想い、今度こそ誰もが幸福を描くことも、可能なのではないか。
lines.translated: Within that blank time, imagining a future beyond what was wished for, wouldn't it be possible for everyone to paint their happiness this time for sure?

lines.content: そうした幾つもの“もしも”が、あさひさんの示した“希望”だった。
lines.translated: Those several "what ifs" were the "hope" that Asahi-san presented.

lines.content: 繰り返すようだけど、これはあくまで私の“できるかもしれない”という“希望”でしかないんだ
lines.translated: "At the risk of repeating myself, this is ultimately nothing more than my 'hope' that 'it might be possible.'"

lines.content: ……“夜”の性質を利用し、まるで自身を罰するようにして“夜の王”となった男の子の。その話を、今夜、奏大雅から教えてもらって……もしかしたらと思ったことでしかない
lines.translated: "...Of a boy who used the nature of the 'Night' and became the 'King of the Night' as if to punish himself. Having been told that story tonight by Kanade Taiga... it is nothing more than something I thought might just be possible."

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”を名乗るくせに、“夜”について多くを知らない。ただの猫が想像し得るものでしかないんだ
lines.translated: "Despite calling myself the 'Magician of the Night,' I don't know much about the 'Night.' It is nothing more than what a mere cat can imagine."

lines.content: そんなあんまりにも不確実な可能性を信じ、“夜”にこれから何かしら働きかけて――……
lines.translated: Believing in such an all-too-uncertain possibility, and working upon the "Night" in some way from here on out--...

lines.content: ……その結果。またあたらしく、複雑に、混沌と……時間の糸を絡ませてしまう結果にならないとも言い切れない
lines.translated: "...As a result of that. I cannot say for sure that it won't end up tangling the threads of time all over again, complexly, chaotically..."

lines.content: 今以上に手に負えない状況に自ら追い込んでしまう――まさに墓穴を掘るに等しい行為となることもまた、否めない。
lines.translated: Driving ourselves into a situation even more unmanageable than it is now--it also cannot be denied that it could become an act truly equal to digging our own graves.

lines.content: それでも、とあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Even so, Asahi-san says.

lines.content: まるで安っぽい言葉で申し訳はないけれど……それでも、やってみるだけの価値はあるんじゃないかと私は感じる。何もせず下手に考えてばかりいるよりずっとましだって
lines.translated: "I apologize for using such cheap-sounding words, however... even so, I feel that it might be worth trying. That it is far better than doing nothing and just overthinking things poorly."

lines.content: それだけ私はその子を助けたいと感じてる。
lines.translated: That is how much I feel I want to save that kid.

lines.content: あさひさんはそう言ってくれ、背筋を伸ばすようにした。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said that for me, straightening her back.

lines.content: だが、やはり……。
lines.translated: However, sure enough...

lines.content: これから何をするにしたって、“夜”に働きかけるのであれば[・|そ][・|れ][・|ぞ][・|れ]に相応の支払いは必要となる――時間や空間を幾つも飛び越え、干渉する。
lines.translated: No matter what we do from here on out, if we are going to work upon the "Night," an appropriate payment will be required for *each of us*--leaping across and interfering with time and space over and over.

lines.content: そんな殆ど“魔法”にも等しい行いを許されるには、きっと、失うものも生半可なものでは済まないと覚悟すべきだ。
lines.translated: To be permitted an act almost equal to "magic" like that, we should surely be prepared that what we lose won't end with something half-baked, either.

lines.content: 改めて君らに問いたい
lines.translated: "I want to ask you all once again."

lines.content: あさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san says.

lines.content: そうまでして、[・|今][・|は][・|ま][・|だ]まったくの他人でしかない男の子を救いたい。……そんなふうに思うお人好しだけ、明日の夜、改めて“ゆめのねどこ”に来てほしい
lines.translated: "Going that far, wanting to save a boy who is *right now still* nothing more than a complete stranger. ...Only the soft-hearted fools who think that way, I want you to come to the 'Bed of Dreams' again tomorrow night."

lines.content: そんな言葉を最後に、その日の“夜会”は締められた。
lines.translated: With those words as the last, that day's "Night Party" was brought to a close.

lines.content: ……次の晩。
lines.translated: The next evening.

lines.content: 俺は“ゆめのねどこ”の奥座敷にいた。
lines.translated: I was in the back parlor of the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 少女らは集まってきてくれるだろうか。力を貸して、くれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will the girls gather here for me? Will they lend me their strength?

lines.content: そんな不安を両手に抱え、ひとり、この部屋で少女らを待ちぼうけ……。
lines.translated: Clutching that anxiety in both hands, waiting in vain all alone in this room for the girls to arrive...

lines.content: そんな覚悟もしていた。
lines.translated: I was prepared for that, too.

lines.content: でも、[・|彼]が俺に少しの不安を感じる間も与えてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: However, *he* didn't even give me the time to feel a single bit of anxiety.

lines.content: なあ、お前は……奏大雅、だったっけ？　俺たち親友になれるんだよな。これからさ、俺たち、そういう時間を一度は辿ったことがあるんだよな
lines.translated: "Hey, you're... Kanade Taiga, right? We're gonna become best friends, aren't we? From here on out, we've walked through a time like that at least once before, right?"

lines.content: そう言ってテーブルの向かいから笑顔を見せるのは、少女ではなく少年だ。
lines.translated: Saying that and smiling from across the table is not a girl, but a boy.

lines.content: ああ～……、えっと。なんか変な言い方になっちゃったけど、つまりはそういうことなんだよな？　俺たちは親友になる。……なった？　なるかもしれない？
lines.translated: "Ah~... um. That came out sounding kinda weird, but basically that's what it means, right? We become best friends. ...We became best friends? Or maybe we might become best friends?"

lines.content: ……そうだね。俺たちがそういう関係になった時間が、確かにあったよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right. There certainly was a time when we had that kind of relationship."

lines.content: そっか。……うん。わかった
lines.translated: "I see. ...Yeah. Got it."

lines.content: だったらさ、他の子たちや姉ちゃんがどう思ってるかは知らないけど、俺は、いいよ。力になる
lines.translated: "In that case, I don't know what the others or my sister think, but I'm in. I'll help you out."

lines.content: なに、意外そうな顔してるんだよ。当然だろ
lines.translated: "What's with that surprised look on your face? It's only natural, isn't it?"

lines.content: 男の子は満面と破顔し、笑う。
lines.translated: The boy breaks into a huge grin and laughs.

lines.content: 親友のピンチを助けてもやれないなんて。見て見ぬ振りを決めこもうだなんて。そんなことを歌ってる歌はどこにもないし、そんな歌、歌いたくもないし聴きたくもねえよ
lines.translated: "Not even being able to help a best friend in a pinch? Deciding to just turn a blind eye? There's no song out there that sings about doing that, and I wouldn't wanna sing or listen to a song like that anyway."

lines.content: だからまかせろよ俺の親友（仮）と言って、胸を張っていたけれど、
lines.translated: "So leave it to me, my best friend (tentative)," he said, puffing out his chest, though,

lines.content: まあ……うん。ごめんな。偉そうなことを言っておいてなんだけど、何の取り柄のない俺なんかにできることがあるのかどうか。わからないけどね
lines.translated: "Well... yeah. Sorry. After talking all big like that, I don't actually know if there's anything a guy with no redeeming qualities like me can even do, though."

lines.content: 申し訳なさそうに小さく笑った男の子。
lines.translated: The boy gave a small, apologetic laugh.

lines.content: ……兎蛙智仁。
lines.translated: Toa Tomohito.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.
*I knew it.*

lines.content: あなたなら必ずそう言ってくれると、わかってたよ。
lines.translated: I knew that if it were you, you would definitely say that.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.
Thank you, *Dad*.

lines.content: 震える唇を悟られないよう必死に堪え、俺は、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Desperately holding back my trembling lips so he wouldn't notice, I nodded.

lines.content: 兎蛙智仁。
lines.translated: Toa Tomohito.

lines.content: あなたが俺の父さんであり……。
lines.translated: That you were my dad, and...

lines.content: たったひとつの恋の歌で、未来の世界を、絶望とさみしさに生きる多くの少年少女らの心に希望を与え、救い続けたヒーローなのだと知ったのは、引き金を引けなかった[・|一][・|回][・|目]。
lines.translated: That with just a single love song, in the world of the future, you were a hero who gave hope to the hearts of so many boys and girls living in despair and loneliness, continuing to save them--I learned this during the *first time*, when I couldn't pull the trigger.

lines.content: ……学園祭だ。
lines.translated: It was at the school festival.

lines.content: そこであなたが、愛する者へ歌った“歌”を聴いたときだった。
lines.translated: It was when I heard the "song" you sang there to the one you loved.

lines.content: ……少し、話を聞いてくれないかな
lines.translated: "...Could you listen to me for a bit?"

lines.content: 俺は言った。
lines.translated: I said.

lines.content: “拳銃”を使えなかった[・|一][・|度][・|目]のときは、あの子と同じ“魔法”を得るため、あの子と同じような人生をなぞる必要があった。……必要があると、自分に課した。
lines.translated: During that *first time* when I couldn't use the "pistol," in order to obtain the same "magic" as that kid, I needed to trace the same kind of life as him. ...I imposed upon myself that it was necessary.

lines.content: そうしてあの子の“想い”を実感する必要があるのだと、信じた。
lines.translated: I believed that by doing so, I needed to truly feel that kid's "feelings."

lines.content: だからあの子が口にするだろう言葉以外は、言えなかった――
lines.translated: That was why I couldn't speak any words other than the ones that kid would have spoken--

lines.content: そういう道をゆくのだと決断した俺のことを、四六時中、“夜”が監視しているのではないかという脅迫観念のようなものもあっただろう。
lines.translated: There was probably also something like an obsessive fear that the "Night" was watching me twenty-four seven, having decided to walk down that path.

lines.content: ……だから、自ら引き金を引けなかったことが、最大の失敗と成りはてた。
lines.translated: Therefore, failing to pull the trigger myself ended up becoming my greatest mistake.

lines.content: だからこそもう、[・|そ][・|の][・|必][・|要][・|は][・|な][・|い]。俺は俺の人生を生きる必要が、ある。
lines.translated: And for that very reason, *there is no longer any need for that*. I need to live my own life.

lines.content: 君に、少しでいいんだ。聞いてもらいたいことがある。ずっと、ずっと、言いたかったことなんだ
lines.translated: "Just for a little bit is fine. There's something I want you to hear. Something I've always, always wanted to say."

lines.content: まだ少女らのやって来ない待ちぼうけの中で、まだまだ幼いヒーローは、ただ静かに、俺にうなずいてくれた。
lines.translated: As we waited in vain with the girls still yet to arrive, the still-young hero simply nodded to me in silence.

lines.content: だから俺は、まるで独り言でもこぼすみたいにして、続ける。
lines.translated: So I continue, almost as if spilling out a monologue to myself.

lines.content: 俺、会いたい人がいたんだ
lines.translated: "There was someone I wanted to meet."

lines.content: その人にすべて救ってほしかった
lines.translated: "I wanted that person to save everything."

lines.content: たくさんの子どもたちが救いを求めてた。あの地下牢で、誰にも知られず死んでいった子たちだ
lines.translated: "So many children were crying out for salvation. The kids who died in that underground prison without anyone ever knowing."

lines.content: いつか必ず、ヒーローみたいな誰かが助けに来てくれると彼らは信じてた。そんな子たちを……
lines.translated: "They believed that someday, for sure, someone like a hero would come to save them. Those kids..."

lines.content: 自分が見捨てられたことにも気づけないまま、暗闇の中で悲しさや、さみしさに喘ぐばかりの、名もなき子たちのことを……[・|彼]に救ってほしかったんだ
lines.translated: "Without even realizing they had been abandoned, only gasping in sorrow and loneliness within the darkness, those nameless kids... I wanted *him* to save them."

lines.content: ……でも、一番救ってもらいたかったのは。きっと
lines.translated: "...But the one I wanted him to save the most was, surely..."

lines.content: ……きっと。
lines.translated: Surely.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: だめだ……。
lines.translated: It's no good...

lines.content: いざ、こうして“その人”を目の前にすると、上手く気持ちが言葉にならない。
lines.translated: Now that I'm actually facing "that person" right before my eyes like this, I can't put my feelings into words very well.

lines.content: こうまでままならないものなのかと、愕然としてしまうほどだ――絶望さえ、感じてしまうほどだ。
lines.translated: So much so that I'm left stunned by how frustratingly difficult it is--enough to make me feel even despair.

lines.content: もちろん俺自身の教養の問題だって無視はできないだろうが……。
lines.translated: Of course, the issue of my own lack of education probably can't be ignored either, but...

lines.content: それでも言葉は、ときに完璧ではないと感じる。
lines.translated: Even so, I feel that words are sometimes imperfect.

lines.content: 胸を満たすいっぱいの“想い”を形にするには、いつだって言葉だけでは足りない。
lines.translated: To give shape to the "feelings" filling my chest to the brim, words alone are never enough.

lines.content: ……言葉を越えた“想い”を伝えるにはどうしたらいい？
lines.translated: What should I do to convey "feelings" that go beyond words?

lines.content: いつも、いつでも、何の“才能”も持たない俺は、自身に問いかけ続けていた――今だ。その答えが必要なのは今、ここなのだ。
lines.translated: Always, at all times, possessing no "talent" whatsoever, I kept asking myself that question--and the time is now. It is right here, right now, that I need the answer.

lines.content: それでもまだ、その答えを見つけられていないから……、
lines.translated: Yet because I still haven't been able to find that answer...

lines.content: ……がんばった
lines.translated: "...I did my best."

lines.content: ……俺は、言う。
lines.translated: I say.

lines.content: いっぱい、がんばったなって……一言でいい。そう、言ってくれないかな
lines.translated: "That I really, truly did my best... Just a single phrase is fine. Could you... say that to me?"

lines.content: なぜそんなことを言ったのかは自分でもわからない。
lines.translated: Even I don't know why I said something like that.

lines.content: ただその一言をもらえたら、今までの全部が報われるような気がしたのだ。その理由はやはり、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I just felt like if I could receive that one phrase, everything up until now would be rewarded. Though I still don't know the reason why...

lines.content: とにかくそんな言葉がほしかった。
lines.translated: Anyway, I wanted those words.

lines.content: 首をかしげ、彼は言った。
lines.translated: Tilting his head, he said.

lines.content: 俺が？
lines.translated: "Me?"

lines.content: ……ああ。君が
lines.translated: "...Yeah. You."

lines.content: うなずき、答える。
lines.translated: I nod and answer.

lines.content: ……その人の代わりに、君が言ってほしいんだ。これから俺の親友になる、君こそが
lines.translated: "...In that person's place, I want you to say it. You, the very person who is going to become my best friend from here on out."

lines.content: 俺の事情は、話せることすべてを話した。
lines.translated: As for my circumstances, I told him everything I was able to tell.

lines.content: でも、あなたと俺との関係は、話すことができないままだった。[・|一][・|回][・|目][・|も]。[・|今][・|回][・|も]。
lines.translated: However, I remained unable to speak of the relationship between you and me. *Both the first time.* *And this time.*

lines.content: その理由をあげるとすれば、これからあなたが歩むのだろう、決して許されることのない“恋するための物語”
lines.translated: If I had to give a reason, it would be the "story in order to fall in love"--one that would never be forgiven--which you will likely walk down from here on out.

lines.content: その行く末までも伝えてしまうことになりかねず、そうなれば彼は一歩、踏み出すことを躊躇うかもしれない。
lines.translated: Doing so might end up revealing even the outcome of that path, and if that happened, he might hesitate to take that step forward.

lines.content: そんな迷いを与えていい権利など、たとえあなたの息子だろうと、俺にあるはずもない。そう感じてならなかったからだ。
lines.translated: Because I couldn't help but feel that even if I am your son, there is no way I have the right to give you that kind of hesitation.

lines.content: 何も知らない彼からしたらこんなお願い、あんまりにも不可解だろう。……それなのに。
lines.translated: From the perspective of someone who knows nothing like him, a request like this must be all too baffling. ...And yet.

lines.content: そっか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: 首をかしげながらも、
lines.translated: Even while tilting his head,

lines.content: 何か事情があるんだな。はっきりとは言えない何か、複雑な事情がさ
lines.translated: "There's some kind of circumstance behind it, huh. Some complicated circumstance you can't really say out loud."

lines.content: 智仁は――[・|父][・|さ][・|ん]は、そんな大人びたことを、子どものように屈託のない笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito--*Dad*--said something so mature with a carefree, childlike smile.

lines.content: そしてふと、頭を撫でられ……。
lines.translated: And then suddenly, my head was patted...

lines.content: ……がんばったな
lines.translated: "...You did your best."

lines.content: 静かな笑顔を、見せられて……。
lines.translated: He showed me a quiet smile...

lines.content: 本当に、ほんとうに。たったひとりで、今日までよく……、がんばった
lines.translated: "Really, truly. All by yourself, right up until today, you really... did your best."

lines.content: 震えるこの手を、そっと握られ……。
lines.translated: This trembling hand of mine was gently grasped...

lines.content: 大丈夫。……きっと、大丈夫だ
lines.translated: "It's okay. ...It'll definitely be okay."
"*Congratulations*," Dad said.

lines.content: これからお前には、たくさん、いいことが待ってる。今日まで乗り越え、やり過ごしてきたつらい日と同じくらいいいことが
lines.translated: "From here on out, there are lots of good things waiting for you. Just as many good things as the painful days you've overcome and endured up until today."

lines.content: そしてまた、幸せな日々のその後には、同じくらい厳しいこともあるだろうけど……、やっぱり、お前は大丈夫なんだよ。絶対にな
lines.translated: "And then again, after those happy days, there might be just as many harsh things too, but... even so, you're going to be okay. Definitely."

lines.content: だから俺は、今日までたくさん、つらいこともさみしいことも乗り越えてきたんだろうお前を……
lines.translated: "That's why, after overcoming what must have been so many painful and lonely things right up until today..."

lines.content: 大切に思ってる“歌”と同じくらい……。
lines.translated: Just as much as the "song" I hold so dear...

lines.content: 俺は、大雅。これから一番の親友になるお前のことを、世界で一番、誇りに思うよ
lines.translated: "Taiga, I am prouder of you--the guy who's gonna become my best friend from here on out--than anyone else in the world."

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: ……わかって、しまった。
lines.translated: I finally realized it.

lines.content: 俺が今日までずっと、何を求めて生きてきたのかを――心の中にいつも漠然と広がっていた気持ちの正体を、今、理解した。
lines.translated: What it was that I had been seeking all along as I lived right up until today--I now understood the true nature of the feeling that had always spread vaguely within my heart.

lines.content: 俺は君と――あなたと、父さんと、ただ手を繋いで歩きたかった。
lines.translated: I just wanted to hold hands and walk with you--with you, with my dad.

lines.content: 暖かな日も、
lines.translated: On warm days,

lines.content: 凍えるような日も、
lines.translated: On freezing days,

lines.content: 風の日も嵐の日も手を繋ぎ、世界の一つひとつを……[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]、難しいことも、楽しいことも、さみしいだろうことだって。
lines.translated: Holding hands on windy days and stormy days alike, learning every single thing about the world... *just like this*, the difficult things, the fun things, and even the things that would likely be lonely.

lines.content: ……あなたに俺は、教えてもらいたかったんだ。
lines.translated: I wanted to be taught all of it by you.

lines.content: 父さん……。
lines.translated: Dad...

lines.content: ……今日まで、ずっとさみしかったんだ
lines.translated: "...Right up until today, I was always so lonely."

lines.content: 涙が、にじむ。
lines.translated: Tears well up.

lines.content: 俺はいつもあなたを求めてた。
lines.translated: I was always longing for you.

lines.content: ケンカする日もあっていい。軽蔑しあうようなことだってあっていい。そうした時間を、あなたと同じ時間を、ただ生きたかった。
lines.translated: There could be days where we fought. There could even be times where we despised each other. I just wanted to live through times like those--the same time as you.

lines.content: それが俺の“夢”だったんだ。
lines.translated: That was my "dream."

lines.content: 今まで、ひとりで、知らず張り詰めていたのだろう何かが緩み……。
lines.translated: Something that had likely been wound tight inside me without my knowing, all alone up until now, came undone...

lines.content: ……いつも、願ってた
lines.translated: "...I was always wishing."

lines.content: にじんだ涙は、やまず、流れて落ちる。次々と。
lines.translated: The welling tears do not stop, flowing and falling. One after another.

lines.content: ……いつも、こんな気持ちから救ってほしいと願ってた
lines.translated: "...I was always wishing for you to save me from this feeling."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 自分の心をようやく、理解できた。
lines.translated: I was finally able to understand my own heart.

lines.content: ……俺があなたに救ってほしかったのは、こんなさみしさからだったんだ。
lines.translated: What I had wanted you to save me from was a loneliness like this.

lines.content: ……ほもほもしい
lines.translated: "...So homoerotic."

lines.content: ぽつりと声がし、慌てて振り向く。
lines.translated: A quiet voice spoke up, and I hurriedly turned around.

lines.content: ……男の子が手と手をにぎにぎしあって泣いてるよ。友情なんて軽く飛び越えちゃってそうなふーいきだね
lines.translated: "...Two boys are squeezing each other's hands and crying. The vibe here looks like it's easily leaped right past mere friendship."

lines.content: 居間に顔を出した夜月姫織が目を細め、
lines.translated: Yotsuki Himeori, poking her head into the living room, narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: 杏藤千和が真っ赤になって、視線をきょろきょろ彷徨わせ、
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa turned bright red, her gaze darting around restlessly.

lines.content: ともくん……！　そんなっ、お姉ちゃん知らなかったよっ、まさかともくんにそんな歪んだ性癖があったなんて――お姉ちゃん、すっごく、いいと思います！
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun...! No way, big sis had no idea! To think Tomo-kun had such a twisted fetish--big sis thinks that's *super* great!"

lines.content: いつも大人しいはずのあず咲さんが、なぜかちょっと興奮気味に目を瞬かせ、
lines.translated: Azusaki-san, who was normally so quiet, was blinking her eyes in slight excitement for some reason.

lines.content: ……あ、愛の形はそれぞれいっぱい、あってもいいんじゃないかな。歳がたくさん離れてても大丈夫なのと同じだよ。そう、だよね？　……お、男の子同士でも、い、いいよね？
lines.translated: "...I-I think it's okay for there to be lots of different forms of love. It's the same as how having a big age gap is okay. Right? ...E-Even between boys, it's o-okay, right?"

lines.content: ハルが小さな身体をもじもじと、揺すっていた。
lines.translated: Haru was fidgeting, swaying her small body back and forth.

lines.content: ち、違うからっ
