lines.translated: "Y-You've got it wrong!"

lines.content: 俺は父さんと――智仁と繋いでいた手を、離す。
lines.translated: I let go of the hand I had been holding with Dad--with Tomohito.

lines.content: そんなんじゃないから！　ただちょっと……話を、聞いてもらっていただけで
lines.translated: "It's nothing like that! I was just... having him listen to me talk for a bit, that's all."

lines.content: ふむ。性別を越えた愛、か――ロックじゃないか
lines.translated: "Hmm. Love that transcends gender, huh--isn't that rock 'n' roll?"

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: 大雅。俺は、別に構わないぞ
lines.translated: "Taiga. I don't really mind, you know."

lines.content: なに。言ってるんだ
lines.translated: "What... are you talking about?"

lines.content: そういう友情の形もあっていい。固定概念こそ人類の敵なんだ――“夜の王”よりよっぽど強敵なんだよ
lines.translated: "It's fine for a form of friendship like that to exist too. Stereotypes are the true enemy of humanity--a way stronger enemy than the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: にじり寄ってくる。無駄に言い声で。
lines.translated: He edged closer to me, using an unnecessarily suave voice.

lines.content: な？　愛する想いは音楽と同じで、自由だ。そう思うだろ？
lines.translated: "Right? The feeling of love is just like music--it's free. Don't you think so?"

lines.content: うるさいやめろ！
lines.translated: "Shut up, stop it!"

lines.content: 同性だからだとかだけじゃなく色々なものを軽く飛び越えすっごくまずい！
lines.translated: Not just because we're the same sex, this effortlessly leaps right past all kinds of things and is seriously bad!

lines.content: あー、はいはい。何やってるんだ君たちは
lines.translated: "Ah, alright, alright. What are you guys doing?"

lines.content: 呆れたような声がする。
lines.translated: An exasperated voice rang out.

lines.content: いつの間に君らはそんな仲良くなったのか知らないが、まあ、いいことだ――……うん
lines.translated: "I don't know when you two got to be such good friends, but well, that's a good thing--...yeah."

lines.content: 言って、あさひさんはぐるりと見渡す。
lines.translated: Saying that, Asahi-san looked around at everyone.

lines.content: 今夜。こうしてここに集まってきたってことは、それぞれ覚悟を決めてきたと解釈していいんだな
lines.translated: "Tonight. The fact that you've all gathered here like this means I can take it you've each made up your minds, right?"

lines.content: その問いに居間の空気は一瞬、静かになった。温度も鋭く下がったように感じた。
lines.translated: At that question, the air in the living room went quiet for an instant. It felt as though the temperature had dropped sharply, too.

lines.content: 私も……
lines.translated: "I also..."

lines.content: ぽつりと、姫織がまず口を開いた。
lines.translated: Quietly, Himeori was the first to speak.

lines.content: 私も、取り戻したい人がいる。だから、大雅の気持ちはわかるよ。……うん。だからね。ちゃんとご褒美の“魔法”をもらえるのなら、お手伝いしようかなって
lines.translated: "I also have someone I want to take back. So I understand how Taiga feels. ...Yeah. That's why, if I can properly get my 'magic' as a reward, I figured I'd help out."

lines.content: わ、私もです
lines.translated: "M-Me too."

lines.content: 千和が慌てて付け加えるようにして、言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa spoke up, as if hurriedly adding on.

lines.content: 私も気持ち、わかります。大切な誰かを取り戻したい気持ち。すごく、わかるんです。だから私もお手伝いできたらって、思って
lines.translated: "I understand the feeling, too. The feeling of wanting to take back someone precious to you. I really understand it. So I thought I'd like to help out if I can, too."

lines.content: 私は……どうせともくんが黙ってられないだろうなって思ったから。だから、追いかけてきただけなんだけど
lines.translated: "As for me... I just figured Tomo-kun wouldn't be able to sit still anyway. So I really just chased after him, though."

lines.content: あず咲さんは肩を竦めた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san shrugged her shoulders.

lines.content: でも、あなたは、ともくんにはじめてできたお友だちだから。大雅くんの助けになりたい。今はそう思ってるよ
lines.translated: "But you're the very first friend Tomo-kun has ever made. I want to be of help to you, Taiga-kun. That's how I feel right now."

lines.content: ……私は、まだわからない
lines.translated: "...I still don't know."

lines.content: ハルが言った。
lines.translated: Haru spoke.

lines.content: 私が何か力になれるのかも。私が、どう思っているのかも。……よくわかっていないんです。今はまだ
lines.translated: "Whether I can be of any help. Or even how I feel about this. ...I don't really understand it well. Not yet, right now."

lines.content: お願いします。ひとつだけ教えてください。そしたら決められます。[・|あ][・|な][・|た]に協力するかどうかを
lines.translated: "Please. Tell me just one thing. Then I'll be able to decide. Whether or not I will cooperate with *you*."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 何かな、と俺は問う。
lines.translated: What is it, I asked her.

lines.content: 私も、みんなと同じです。取り戻したいと願う人がいます――大切な、とても大切な人でした。その人のためなら何を“夜”に差し出しても構わない。そう思っていました
lines.translated: "I am the same as everyone else. There is someone I wish to take back--someone precious, very precious to me. For that person's sake, I wouldn't mind offering anything to the 'Night.' That's what I thought."

lines.content: ハルは――柊ハルは、俺を真っ直ぐに見つめ、言った。
lines.translated: Haru--Hiiragi Haru looked straight at me and spoke.

lines.content: 私の取り戻したいと願う大切な人は、あなたですか？　それとも……
lines.translated: "Is the precious person I wish to take back you? Or..."
"*Or is it that boy?*"

lines.content: 眼差しの奥に声にならない想いを見た気がした。
lines.translated: Deep within her gaze, I felt as though I saw a voiceless emotion.

lines.content: ……俺は、あの男の子が、成長した柊ハルとどういった物語を――人生を歩んだのか。そういう可能性の時間世界についてを知っている。
lines.translated: I know what kind of story--what kind of life that boy walked alongside the grown-up Hiiragi Haru. I know about that timeline of possibility.

lines.content: [・|彼]の“想い”を知らなければならないと、半ば脅迫的に自身に課して――
lines.translated: Half-compulsively forcing myself to believe that I had to know *his* "feelings"--

lines.content: しかし、ましろへの想いがこの胸にあるのだから、ハルと愛し合うようなことはもちろん、俺にはできないけれど。
lines.translated: However, because the feelings for Mashiro are in my chest, falling in love with Haru is, of course, something I cannot do.

lines.content: ――とにかく[・|彼]の人生と想いをなぞろうとして、失敗してしまったのだから、[・|今][・|は]忘れようにもそうできない。
lines.translated: --In any case, because I tried to trace *his* life and feelings and failed, *now* I couldn't forget it even if I tried.

lines.content: そのことは、ハルを含めた全員に、昨晩語った話の中に含まれていた。
lines.translated: That fact had been included in the story I told everyone, including Haru, last night.

lines.content: 俺の語った話から、[・|今]のハルは察したようだ――理解、できたようだ。
lines.translated: From the story I told, the *current* Haru seemed to have guessed it--seemed to have understood it.

lines.content: 自分の大切に想っている人の正体は、今目の前にいる[人物|俺]か、本来ここで出会うはずだった[誰か|ぼく]、その[・|ど][・|ち][・|ら][・|か][・|だ]ということを。
lines.translated: That the true identity of the person she holds so dear is *either* the person standing right in front of her, "me," or the someone she was originally supposed to meet here, "me."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は首を振り、答える。
lines.translated: I shook my head and answered.

lines.content: 俺じゃないよ
lines.translated: "It's not me."

lines.content: それは、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]のほうだ。
lines.translated: It is *that boy*.

lines.content: 俺にはとても――[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]、誰かのために自分の命を差し出せるような勇気なんて。とても、ないよ
lines.translated: "There's no way I could--I don't have the courage to offer up my own life for someone else's sake *like that*. Not at all."

lines.content: 首を振り、繰り返し俺は言う。
lines.translated: Shaking my head, I repeated myself.

lines.content: だからハル。君を命がけで守ったのは俺じゃない。あの男の子だ
lines.translated: "So, Haru. The one who risked his life to protect you wasn't me. It was that boy."

lines.content: ……そう、なんですね
lines.translated: "...Is that... so."

lines.content: 深く……、とても大切な宝物を見つけられたみたいに、ハルは深くうなずいていた。
lines.translated: Deeply... as if she had found a very precious treasure, Haru nodded deeply.

lines.content: もうひとつだけ、教えてください
lines.translated: "Please tell me just one more thing."

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: ……私、私は、一度は大切な人と、一緒に生きていくことができた。そんな時間が、この町の“夜”のどこかに眠ってる。それで、間違いない？
lines.translated: "...I, I was able to live together with my precious person, at least once. A time like that is sleeping somewhere within the 'Night' of this town. Am I right about that?"

lines.content: はっきりと肯定の言葉は発しなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't voice a clear affirmation.

lines.content: クロがそういう未来を[あの子|ぼく]に贈りたいと願った。だからあの子はましろや俺のことを忘れ、君と心から愛し合い、共に生きた。
lines.translated: Kuro had wished to gift a future like that to that boy, "me." That's why he forgot about Mashiro and me, loved you from the bottom of his heart, and lived together with you.

lines.content: そういう時間は確かに、この時間世界の中に産まれていたのだ。
lines.translated: A time like that had certainly been born within this world of time.

lines.content: だけどその沈黙が殆ど答えのようなものだった。
lines.translated: However, my silence was practically an answer in itself.

lines.content: ハルは安心したように……いや、どこかとてもさみしそうに、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Haru smiled as if relieved... no, looking somewhat very lonely.

lines.content: ……うん。わかった。いいよ。私も、奏大雅くん。あなたに協力したい
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Got it. Okay. Kanade Taiga-kun, I want to cooperate with you, too."

lines.content: 今の私じゃなくても、一度は“夢”を叶えられたのなら――……
lines.translated: "Even if it wasn't the current me, if I was able to have my 'dream' come true at least once--..."

lines.content: そこで少しの沈黙を挟んでから、“……でも”とハルは言う。
lines.translated: After a brief pause there, "...But," Haru said.
"But I don't know *if that was truly for the best*."

lines.content: [・|お][・|じ][・|さ][・|ん]の“隣”にいるのが私なんかでいいのか。きっと、幸せになれたのだろう時間の私も、今の私と同じように、消えない疑問を抱えてるだろうから……。
lines.translated: "Whether it was really okay for someone like me to be by *Mister's* 'side.' Because surely, the me in the time who was able to become happy must be carrying the same unyielding doubts as the me right now..."

lines.content: だから今度は……ううん。今度こそ私が、大切な人の“夢”を叶える番だよね
lines.translated: "So this time... no. This time for sure, it's my turn to make my precious person's 'dream' come true, right?"

lines.content: 幼いハルは苦笑いを浮かべ、言う。
lines.translated: The young Haru gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: ……おじさんはいつも“誰か”のことを探してるように感じてた
lines.translated: "...It always felt like Mister was looking for 'someone.'"

lines.content: もう二度と会えない大切な“誰か”の姿を、いつも探し、追い求めているように見えたの
lines.translated: "It looked like he was always searching for and pursuing the figure of a precious 'someone' he could never meet again."

lines.content: だから私は……違う時間の中の私は、その“誰か”に憧れて
lines.translated: "That's why I... the me in a different time admired that 'someone.'"

lines.content: 私の大好きなおじさんに、大好きだって思われてるその子みたいに、私も、なりたくて……
lines.translated: "I wanted to become like that girl who was loved so much by my beloved Mister..."

lines.content: だから私はね、その“誰か”と同じような“[力|魔法]”で、おじさんのことを救いたいと願ったんじゃないかな……
lines.translated: "So I think I wished to save Mister with the same kind of 'power'--'magic'--as that 'someone'..."

lines.content: この時間の私は[・|そ][・|れ]を、願わないよ。代わりに……
lines.translated: "The me of this time won't wish for *that*. Instead..."

lines.content: 代わりに、おじさんが大切に想ってるその“誰か”に、今度こそ、おじさんを引き合わせたい――おじさんに幸せを、届けたい。そのために“魔法”を使うよ
lines.translated: "Instead, I want to bring Mister together with that 'someone' he holds so dear, this time for sure--I want to deliver happiness to Mister. I'll use my 'magic' for that sake."

lines.content: ……だって
lines.translated: "...Well, that's because..."

lines.content: ハルは、さみしそうに笑う。
lines.translated: Haru smiled lonely.

lines.content: だって私たちは、ほんとは、出会わなければよかったんだよ――……別の時間の私はどうなのかはわからない。でも今の私は、まだ、そう思ってるから
lines.translated: "Because the truth is, it would have been better if we had never met--...I don't know how the me in another time feels. But the current me still thinks that way."

lines.content: “大切に想う人の不幸を肩代わりすること”――それが、“夜の王”との戦争後に柊ハルが願った“魔法”だった。
lines.translated: "Taking on the misfortune of the person she holds dear"--that was the "magic" Hiiragi Haru wished for after the war with the "King of the Night."

lines.content: おそらく“魔法”を想像する際に、あさひさんからその話を聞いたのではないだろうか――ハルにかけられたあず咲の時を超える“[病|呪い]”
lines.translated: Perhaps when imagining her "magic," she had heard that story from Asahi-san--the time-transcending "illness"--"curse"--of Azusaki that had been placed upon Haru.

lines.content: それを連れ去ったのは[・|あ][・|の][・|子]なのだと……。
lines.translated: That the one who had taken it away was *that boy*...

lines.content: ……うん。それぞれ容易ではない事情があるはずだ。それでも、こうして集まってきてくれた。その事実だけは、その覚悟だけは、できる限り尊重したい
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Each of you must have circumstances that are far from easy. Even so, you've gathered here like this for me. That fact alone, that resolve alone, I want to respect as much as I possibly can."

lines.content: それじゃあ早速、はじめようか。……まだ見ぬ友人を助け出すための戦いを、だ
lines.translated: "Well then, let's get started right away, shall we? ...Our battle to rescue a friend we have yet to meet."

lines.content: 全員の意思を確認し終えたところで、あさひさんが居間のテーブルにずらりと並べるものがあった。
lines.translated: Once she had finished confirming everyone's intentions, Asahi-san lined up a row of items on the living room table.

lines.content: なんだろうなんだろうと集まる子らに、あさひさんは得意そうに胸を張り、
lines.translated: As the girls gathered around wondering what they were, Asahi-san puffed out her chest proudly.

lines.content: 君らの魔法少女服だ。夜なべして作ったんだ。気に入ってもらえるといいけれど
lines.translated: "They're your magical girl outfits. I stayed up all night making them. I hope you like them, though."

lines.content: よく見れば少しやつれた顔で、そう言ったのだった。
lines.translated: Looking closely, her face was a little haggard as she said that.

lines.content: 昨晩、奏大雅の話を聞いたろ？　彼が歩んだ時間世界の中での私は、“夜の王”と戦う君らのことを“魔法少女”と呼んでは、こうしてきらきらかわいく着飾っていたらしい――
lines.translated: "You heard Kanade Taiga's story last night, right? In the timeline he walked through, I apparently called you girls who fought the 'King of the Night' 'magical girls,' and dressed you up all sparkly and cute like this--"

lines.content: うん、さすがだな私。と、あさひさん。
lines.translated: "Yep, I'm amazing as expected," said Asahi-san.

lines.content: だから今、ここにいる君らも今日から――この“夜”から“魔法少女”だ。閉ざされた暗闇の夜を一瞬の勇気で眩く照らす。そんな特別な存在だ
lines.translated: "So now, starting today--starting from this 'Night,' you girls here are also 'magical girls.' Special beings who brilliantly illuminate the closed, pitch-black night with a single moment of courage."

lines.content: さあ行こう。
lines.translated: Now, let's go.

lines.content: 一緒に、望んだ以上の“夢”と“希望”を、取り戻しに行こう
lines.translated: "Together, let's go take back a 'dream' and 'hope' even greater than what we wished for."

lines.content: ……ここからはじまる戦いの物語。
lines.translated: The story of the battle that begins from here.

lines.content: 立ち向かうべきは“夜の王”ではなく“運命”だ。
lines.translated: What we must stand against is not the "King of the Night," but "fate."

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……その多くは語らずにいようと思う
lines.translated: "...I think I'll refrain from speaking about most of it."

lines.content: 格子越しの奏大雅が、[・|ぼ][・|く]に言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke to *me* from behind the bars.

lines.content: ここから先に見つけられたのは、“夢”でも“希望”でもなく、ただの真っ暗な“絶望”だった
lines.translated: "What we found beyond this point was neither a 'dream' nor 'hope,' just pitch-black 'despair.'"

lines.content: つまり……。
lines.translated: In other words...

lines.content: つまり俺たちは負けてしまったんだよ。“運命”に、敗北してしまった。誰も救えなかったどころの話ではなく、あまりに大きなものを失ってしまったんだ
lines.translated: "In other words, we lost. We were defeated by 'fate.' Far from saving anyone, we ended up losing something far too great."

lines.content: 沈黙以外に何も選べないぼくを前に、大雅は……奏大雅は、そこから今現在に至るまでの戦いを――そのお話を、とても短く簡単に、話した。
lines.translated: Before me, who had no choice other than silence, Taiga... Kanade Taiga told the story of the battle from that point up to the present--very briefly and simply.

lines.content: 俺たちの“夢”や“希望”を取り戻すため、“夜の魔法使い”の手によって“魔法”となった少女たち――君と俺の友人は。幼馴染みたちは。まず、“刻の終着駅”へと向かった
lines.translated: "In order to take back our 'dreams' and 'hopes,' the girls who had become 'magic' at the hands of the 'Magician of the Night'--your friends and mine. Our childhood friends. First, they headed toward the 'Terminal Station of Time.'"

lines.content: 彼女たちがどのようにして君を取り戻そうとしたのか。その方法は、“君が夜の王へと成り果てる道を阻止する”こと……
lines.translated: "How did they try to get you back? Their method was to 'stop you on the path to becoming the King of the Night'..."

lines.content: それは“刻の終着駅”から、[君|男の子]が“夜の王”となるためたったひとり、奮闘していたのだろう時間世界へと進み……。
lines.translated: From the "Terminal Station of Time," they would advance into the timeline where the boy--you--must have been struggling all alone in order to become the "King of the Night"...

lines.content: そこで直接、[君|男の子]と話しあうことで説得できるのならいい――だけどそれが無理なら、乱暴な方法を選んででも彼を阻止する。
lines.translated: Once there, if they could persuade the boy--you--by talking directly, that would be fine--but if that proved impossible, they would stop him even if it meant choosing rough methods.

lines.content: 俺たちの戦いは“夜の王”でも“運命”でもない、彼自身ということになるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Our battle might end up being against neither the "King of the Night" nor "fate," but against him himself.

lines.content: そのための覚悟を決めた。あらゆる最低最悪の事態に備えようとした。
lines.translated: We steeled our resolve for that. We tried to prepare for every worst-case scenario.

lines.content: そうして、未来を変えるのだ。
lines.translated: And by doing so, we would change the future.

lines.content: そうして、あたらしい可能性の時間世界を作り出すのだ。
lines.translated: By doing so, we would create a timeline of new possibilities.

lines.content: そうして……あたらしく産まれたまっしろな時間の中で、誰もが笑いあえるような最高の人生を、想い、描くのだ。
lines.translated: And then... within the newly born, pure white time, we would envision and paint the best possible life where everyone could laugh together.

lines.content: そこで、端末が鳴ったんだ。クロだ。……少し先の未来から、[君|男の子]が姿を消してしまった時間世界の彼女が、電話を掛けてきてくれた
lines.translated: "Just then, my terminal rang. It was Kuro. ...She called me from a slightly distant future, from the timeline where the boy--you--had vanished."

lines.content: 本来繋がるべき[君|男の子]の手にした端末には、どの時間世界の[君|男の子]であれ繋がらないのだとクロは言っていた。
lines.translated: Kuro said that she couldn't get through to the terminal held by the boy--you--whom she was supposed to be connected to, no matter which timeline you were in.

lines.content: “夜の王”としてあらゆる時間世界で、自分の存在を削除していってしまったのだからそれは当然なのかもしれない
lines.translated: "Since you had been deleting your own existence across every timeline as the 'King of the Night,' maybe that was only natural."

lines.content: だから彼女からの電話を繋ぐことができるのは、俺だ……この俺、奏大雅が持つ端末しかない。
lines.translated: That was why I was the only one who could connect her calls... the terminal held by me, Kanade Taiga, was the only one left.

lines.content: それも繋がりが弱いのか、何十回――あるいは何百回とかけ直す中でようやく一度、繋がるかどうかなのだという。
lines.translated: Even then, perhaps because the connection was weak, she said it would barely connect once out of dozens--or even hundreds--of redials.

lines.content: そんなクロに奏大雅が現状を話すと、クロは、自分にもできることはないかと言った。
lines.translated: When Kanade Taiga explained the current situation to Kuro, she asked if there was anything she could do to help.

lines.content: ……わ、わたしも、あの子のために何か、したい
lines.translated: "...I-I want to do something for him, too."

lines.content: たどたどしく彼女は話した。
lines.translated: She spoke haltingly.

lines.content: ここで、わたしだけ……じ、じっとしてるばかりなんて……いや。耐えられない
lines.translated: "Just staying here... a-all by myself, doing nothing... No. I can't bear it."

lines.content: [君|男の子]以外には目も見て話すことのできない小さな子だ。それでも懸命に、話していたという。
lines.translated: She is a small girl who can't even look anyone in the eye to speak, other than the boy--you. Even so, she reportedly spoke as best as she could.

lines.content: 彼女が今、未来のどのような場所から電話をかけてきたのかはわからないが――電話越しに、ちくたくと時計の音がしていた。
lines.translated: I don't know what kind of place in the future she was calling from right now--but through the phone, there was the tick-tock sound of a clock.

lines.content: 未来に取り残された君の相棒。クロと協力し合うことは、他のみんなと話し合うまでもなく、こちらからも是非そうしてほしいとお願いしたんだ
lines.translated: "Your partner, left behind in the future. Without even needing to discuss it with everyone else, we eagerly asked her from our side to cooperate with us."

lines.content: 彼女のいる未来と俺たちのいる過去。その時間が果たして一本の線で繋がれているのか否か。
lines.translated: The future where she is, and the past where we are. Whether those times are truly connected by a single line or not, we didn't know.

lines.content: でも、彼女からの電話は、時間の壁は飛び越えられても、他世界とまで繋がるものではないはずだ。
lines.translated: However, even if her phone call could leap over the wall of time, it shouldn't be able to connect to an entirely different world.

lines.content: だから俺たちが時間に何かしら働きかけ、その作用が未来を変えられるものであったなら。クロのいる未来もまた、変わるはず
lines.translated: "So if we act upon time in some way, and that effect is enough to change the future, then the future where Kuro is should change as well."

lines.content: それはつまり答え合わせができるということだ。
lines.translated: In other words, it meant we could check our answers.

lines.content: 俺たちの行動が、未来を変えるための――誰もが幸福になっているだろう未来を作るものに、なっているかどうか
lines.translated: "Whether our actions are actually changing the future--whether they are creating a future where everyone will be happy."

lines.content: 本来なら自分たちのとった行動が、正しく望んだ結果を引き寄せられていたかどうかは、[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]まで時間が経過しなければわからないけど……。
lines.translated: Normally, we wouldn't know if the actions we took were properly drawing in the desired results until time had passed all the way to *that moment*, but...

lines.content: 逐一未来にいる彼女に電話をし、確認していこう
lines.translated: "Let's call her in the future step by step and check."

lines.content: 彼女のいる未来の中に、“夜の王”ではないあの子自身が生存できているか否か。そういう時間に書き換わっているか否かを
lines.translated: "To see whether or not that boy himself, not as the 'King of the Night,' is alive in the future where she is. Whether or not time has been rewritten that way."

lines.content: 未来にいるクロが、この戦いに協力するのはそれだけではない。
lines.translated: That wasn't the only way Kuro in the future would cooperate in this battle.

lines.content: クロ。君は、男の子の“悪夢”がどこに潜んでいるのかを探してほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Kuro. I want you to search for where the boy's 'nightmare' is lurking."

lines.content: 電話を代わったあさひさんが、クロに言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san, who had taken over the phone, spoke to Kuro.

lines.content: この町で一度起きた出来事であれば、[そちら|未来]も[こちら|過去]も関係ない――
lines.translated: "As long as it's an event that happened once in this town, it doesn't matter whether it's the future over there or the past over here--"

lines.content: 彼の心に、彼自身の心を苦しめる“悪夢”の産まれた瞬間が、“参禅町”の“夜”のどこかに記録されているはずなんだ
lines.translated: "The moment the 'nightmare' that torments his own heart was born within him must be recorded somewhere in the 'Night' of 'Sanzen Town.'"

lines.content: それは、すべてのはじまりだと言っていいはずだ――あさひさんは端末を強く、握りしめている。
lines.translated: You could call that the beginning of everything--Asahi-san gripped the terminal tightly.

lines.content: その瞬間に、何か……彼の心を救うヒントが隠されているかもしれない。もし私たちが何らかの方法で、彼の歩んだ道を阻止できたとしても……
lines.translated: "In that moment, something... a hint to save his heart might be hidden. Even if we manage to stop the path he walked by some method..."

lines.content: その心にまだ“夜”が残っていればすべて無駄になってしまうかもしれない。彼の心から“悪夢”を消し去らなければ、根本的な解決には至らないはずだ
lines.translated: "If the 'Night' still remains in his heart, it might all end up being for nothing. Unless we erase the 'nightmare' from his heart, we won't reach a fundamental solution."

lines.content: 彼の心の“夜”を――その根源を消し去らなければ、また彼は同じような結果を、また、別の道のりを経てでも、たぐり寄せるだろうことは想像に易しい。
lines.translated: It was easy to imagine that unless we erased the "Night" in his heart--its very root--he would just draw in the same kind of result again, even if by a different path.

lines.content: ……だから、彼の心から、彼自身を苦しめている“悪夢”を見つけてほしい
lines.translated: "...So, I want you to find the 'nightmare' within his heart that is tormenting him."

lines.content: 可能ならその“悪夢”を照らす、何らかの光りのようなものも見つけられたなら最善だ――……[・|そ][・|れ]はな、とあさひさんは、力強く言う。
lines.translated: If possible, it would be best if you could also find some kind of light to illuminate that "nightmare"--...*That* is, Asahi-san said forcefully.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は、“希望”なんだよ。クロ
lines.translated: "*That* is 'hope,' Kuro."

lines.content: 人は“夢”を持たなければ過去を肯定できないし……。未来に“希望”を感じていなければ、生きてさえいけない“イキモノ”なんだ。……それは、私たちも一緒だ。そうだろう？
lines.translated: "People cannot affirm the past unless they have a 'dream'... And they are 'creatures' who cannot even live unless they feel 'hope' in the future. ...It's the same for us, too. Right?"

lines.content: だからこそその役割は君にこそ頼みたい、とあさひさんは言った。
lines.translated: That is precisely why I want to entrust this role to you, Asahi-san said.

lines.content: あの子のことをおそらくは一番、大切に想っているだろう君にこそ、だ
lines.translated: "To you, who likely holds that boy more dear than anyone else."

lines.content: 私たちはまだ見ぬ未来を――“夢”を探し出す戦いへ出る。クロ。君は、“希望”を探す旅に出る。さあ、行こうか
lines.translated: "We will set out into a battle to seek the yet-unseen future--to find a 'dream.' Kuro, you will set out on a journey to find 'hope.' Now, let's go."

lines.content: 未来と過去とで共に戦い、幸福を得よう。
lines.translated: Let us fight together in the future and the past, and grasp happiness.

lines.content: あさひさんはそう言って、電話を切った。
lines.translated: Saying that, Asahi-san hung up the phone.

lines.content: ……時間は、もうあまりないだろう
lines.translated: "...We probably don't have much time left."

lines.content: 俺たちをぐるりと見、あさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Looking around at us, Asahi-san spoke.

lines.content: 奏大雅。君の言うことが正しいのであれば、私は……私たちは、“夜の王”の正体を知ってしまった
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga. If what you say is correct, then I... we have learned the true identity of the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: そうなれば少しずつ、すこしずつ……
lines.translated: "Now that we have, little by little, bit by bit..."

lines.content: 私たちは、その正体である男の子のこともまた、“夜の王”を憎むのと同じように憎悪してしまうことになるだろう――男の子自身の“魔法”と“代償”の影響によって
lines.translated: "We will likely come to hate that boy, who is his true identity, in the exact same way we hate the 'King of the Night'--due to the influence of the boy's own 'magic' and 'price.'"

lines.content: そうなってしまえば、私たちは今のように君に協力はできなくなってしまうかもしれない。……いや
lines.translated: "Once that happens, we might no longer be able to cooperate with you like we are now. ...No."

lines.content: あさひさんは小首をかしげるような仕草をし、俺を見た。
lines.translated: Asahi-san tilted her head slightly and looked at me.

lines.content: 奏大雅。君がまだその子のことを憎んでいないということは、蘇らせたいと思うほど大切に……大切に想っているということは、だ
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga. The fact that you still don't hate that boy, the fact that you care for him... cherish him enough to want to bring him back, means..."

lines.content: 憎悪の対象はあくまでも“夜の王”へと向けられるもので、その正体である子へは向かわない――そういうふうに[・|彼]は描いたのかな
lines.translated: "The target of hatred is directed strictly at the 'King of the Night,' and doesn't turn toward the boy who is his true identity--I wonder if *he* designed it that way."

lines.content: だがしかし、その正体は知らないまでも“[彼|夜の王]”のことを全世界が恐れ、無意識下にでも憎からず思っていることは事実だ。
lines.translated: Even so, despite not knowing his true identity, it is a fact that the entire world fears "him"--the "King of the Night"--and harbors no small amount of hatred toward him, even if only subconsciously.

lines.content: まず[・|彼][・|女]が最初に、刻を越えた戦いへと踏み出した。
lines.translated: First, *she* was the one to step forward into the battle across time.

lines.content: 柊ハルだ。
lines.translated: It's Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 一度起きてしまった時間はすべて、その時間と空間の中に保存されているという“記憶の図書館”――あらゆる時代の“隣”に存在する“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Library of Memories," where all time that has once occurred is said to be preserved within time and space--the "Land of Night" that exists "next door" to every era.

lines.content: ……そんな“夜”の中に記録されている、[ハル|自分]と[君|男の子]が共に歩んだ道のりだ
lines.translated: "...Recorded within that 'Night' is the path that Haru--herself--and the boy--you--walked together."

lines.content: そうした時間世界の中へと、[・|俺][・|に][・|は][・|秘][・|密]にされていた“代償”を少女は“夜”に支払い……。
lines.translated: Into that timeline, the girl paid a "price" to the "Night" that *had been kept secret from me*...

lines.content: “夜間鉄道”の切符を購入し、彼女は旅立つ。
lines.translated: Purchasing a ticket for the "Night Train," she set off on her journey.

lines.content: 『おね、がい……。大雅くん……』
lines.translated: "Plea...se... Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: その旅は、大切な人のすべてを救うため……。
lines.translated: That journey was to save everything of her precious person...

lines.content: 『おねがいだから、これ以上先へは、進まないで――お願いだよ。引き返して、ほしい』
lines.translated: "Please, don't go any further than this--I'm begging you. I want you to turn back."

lines.content: 大切な人をその“絶望”から、救うため……。
lines.translated: To save her precious person from that "despair"...

lines.content: 『この道の、先には……あなたの幸せは、どこにもない、の。だから引き返して……今、すぐに』
lines.translated: "Beyond this path... your happiness is nowhere to be found. So turn back... right now."

lines.content: 彼女は――幼いハルは、
lines.translated: She--the young Haru--

lines.content: 『お願い。……[・|神][・|さ][・|ま]。どうかお願いします――……私の“夢”を、叶えてください。わたしの、世界で一番、大好きだったひとを、助けてほしい』
lines.translated: "Please. ...*God*. I beg of you--...please grant my 'dream.' I want you to save the person I loved most in the world."

lines.content: “[特別な少女時代|魔法少女]”の柊ハルは、
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru, in her "special girlhood"--as a "magical girl"--

lines.content: 『お願い。あなたが、いつまでもずっと……、ずっと笑顔でいられる世界に、なりますように』
lines.translated: "Please. May it become a world where you can always, forever... forever keep smiling."

lines.content: 『わ、私は、[・|こ][・|こ]で、大好きなあなたの幸せだけを、祈っています』
lines.translated: "I-I will stay *here*, praying only for the happiness of you, whom I love so much."
*Over and over, she killed her future self, who was "no longer special."*

lines.content: そうした彼女のことを、[・|あ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側][・|で]、[・|君]たちは柊ハルの“悪夢”が暴れ出し、自身に牙向く存在となったのだとして恐れた
lines.translated: "Seeing her like that *on the other side*, *you* all feared that Hiiragi Haru's 'nightmare' had gone berserk and become an entity baring its fangs at her."

lines.content: ……いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 一番最初の時間では、確かに[・|そ][・|う]だったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: In the very first timeline, that might indeed have been *the case*.

lines.content: ……柊ハルは君を不幸にしてしまった自分自身を罰するため、彼女は“夜”の中で自分の“悪夢”に何度も、何度も、殺されてしまっていた
lines.translated: "...To punish herself for making you unhappy, Hiiragi Haru was killed over and over again by her own 'nightmare' within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 一番最初は確かに[・|そ][・|う]で。
lines.translated: In the very beginning, that was certainly *how it was*.

lines.content: そういった問題から君は、柊ハルを助けようとし、“拳銃”の“魔法”を使ったのだ。
lines.translated: Because of those troubles, you tried to save Hiiragi Haru and used the "handgun" "magic."

lines.content: だが、時間は変わった。
lines.translated: However, time changed.

lines.content: またひとつ、糸が絡まった。
lines.translated: Another thread became tangled.

lines.content: 改めて、言おう。俺たちが君の計画を阻止するために、[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]から、[・|そ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]へと乗り込んだんだ――“夜”を通じて
lines.translated: "Let me say it again. In order to stop your plan, we boarded *that side* from *this side*--through the 'Night.'"

lines.content: そしてまだまだその心に“特別”な“想像力”を秘めている“[特別な少女時代|魔法少女]”の彼女が、君らの前に現れたはずだ。
lines.translated: And she, as a "magical girl" in her "special girlhood" who still held "special" "imagination" hidden in her heart, must have appeared before you all.

lines.content: 最初は“それ以上、進まないで”と説得しようと、彼女も、君や未来の自分自身に呼びかけたはずだ。
lines.translated: At first, she too must have called out to you and her future self, trying to persuade you, saying, "Don't go any further."

lines.content: だけどその言葉も想いも、正しく君らに伝わらなかった。
lines.translated: However, neither those words nor her feelings reached you properly.

lines.content: きっと、こちら側と、あちら側との接続がそんなに上手くいかなかったんだ
lines.translated: "Surely, the connection between this side and the other side didn't go all that well."

lines.content: ……呼びかける声はノイズで濁り。
lines.translated: The voice calling out was muddied with static.
*Giggle, giggle, giggle, giggle--even her tears were distorted into a smile by the time they reached you.*

lines.content: きらきらしていたはずの真新しい少女の衣装は、漆黒のベールに包まれ、歪んで見えた――……君らの目には。
lines.translated: The girl's brand-new outfit, which should have been sparkling, was wrapped in a pitch-black veil and looked distorted--...to your eyes.
*Please. Don't go any further than this*--it was no longer a state where a conversation like that was even possible.

lines.content: ……あらゆる偶然だとか、すれ違いがそうさせたのかもしれないし、こちら側の柊ハルが、そうなるようにと、やはり無意識ながらに願ったのかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Maybe all sorts of coincidences and misunderstandings caused it to turn out that way, or maybe the Hiiragi Haru from this side subconsciously wished for it to happen after all."

lines.content: 彼女も君と同じだ、と奏大雅はぼくに言う。
lines.translated: She is the same as you, Kanade Taiga told me.

lines.content: ……彼女も自分なんて産まれてこなければよかったと感じてた
lines.translated: "...She also felt that she never should have been born."

lines.content: そうすれば、君を一度だって不幸な終わりに導いてしまうことはなかった
lines.translated: "Because if she hadn't been, she never would have led you to an unhappy ending even once."

lines.content: 『大雅くん。私たちは、出会わなければよかったんだよ』
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. It would have been better if we had never met."

lines.content: ――……柊ハルのさみしそうな声がした。
lines.translated: --...I heard Hiiragi Haru's lonely voice.

lines.content: すべての元凶は自分なのだと、彼女はいつも自分の心を責め続けてた
lines.translated: "She was always blaming herself in her heart, believing that she was the root cause of everything."

lines.content: だからハルは君に自分を殺してほしかったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe that is why Haru wanted you to kill her.

lines.content: そのために違う時間世界の自分を何度も、君の前で殺して見せたのかも、しれない。
lines.translated: And maybe that is why she showed you her self from another timeline being killed in front of you, over and over again.

lines.content: ……それでも彼女は、心のどこかで祈ってもいたのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, deep down in her heart, she was also praying.

lines.content: 愛する君と、もし未来を一緒に歩めたなら――……だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Wishing that if only she could walk into the future together with you, the one she loved--...or something like that.

lines.content: そんな未来を一瞬でも思い描いた自分のことを、彼女はきっと、許せなかったんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "I think she probably couldn't forgive herself for picturing a future like that, even for a split second."

lines.content: 君を不幸の底に突き落としたような存在が、何を虫のいいことを願ってるんだ、と。
lines.translated: Thinking, how could an existence who plunged you into the depths of misfortune wish for something so selfish?

lines.content: だから、彼女は望んでそういう結果を受け入れたんじゃないかと。俺は、そう思ってるんだ
lines.translated: "So, I wonder if she willingly accepted that outcome. That's what I think."

lines.content: だから、いいか？　自分を責めないでほしいと、奏大雅は言うのだ。
lines.translated: So, listen, okay? Kanade Taiga tells me not to blame myself.

lines.content: もう既に察しは付いてると思う。だけどごめんな。あえて、言葉にさせてほしい
lines.translated: "I think you've already figured it out. Still, I'm sorry. Let me put it into words anyway."

lines.content: ……[・|君]があのとき、柊ハルの心や過去を知るため撃ち抜いたのは、柊ハルの“悪夢”なんかじゃない
lines.translated: "...Back then, what *you* shot through in order to know Hiiragi Haru's heart and past wasn't Hiiragi Haru's 'nightmare' at all."

lines.content: 別の時間世界から、君のことを止めに来た――愛する君のことを止めにやって来た、柊ハル自身、なんだよ
lines.translated: "It was Hiiragi Haru herself, who came from another timeline to stop you--who came to stop the you she loved."

lines.content: そういう時間もまた、君が知らないうちに……“夜の王”となった後に、あたらしく産まれてしまったんだよ
lines.translated: "A timeline like that was also newly born without your knowledge... after you became the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: ぼくは、自分の手のひらを見つめた。
lines.translated: I stared at the palms of my hands.

lines.content: 震えている。
lines.translated: They are trembling.

lines.content: この手がハルを殺した。
lines.translated: These hands killed Haru.

lines.content: ぼくのことを、時を越えてまで助けに来てくれていたのだという彼女のことを……。
lines.translated: Killed the girl who had crossed through time itself just to come and save me...

lines.content: そうとは知らず。
lines.translated: Without knowing that.

lines.content: そうとは、思いもよらず。
lines.translated: Without even dreaming of it.

lines.content: ……想像だって、できず。
lines.translated: Unable to even imagine it.

lines.content: 何度だって言おう。
lines.translated: I will say it as many times as it takes.

lines.content: ぼくはそんな彼女を撃ち抜き、殺してしまった。
lines.translated: I shot right through her, and I killed her.

lines.content: 呼吸が止まった。
lines.translated: My breath stopped.

lines.content: う、あ、あああっ
lines.translated: "Uh, ah, aaaah!"

lines.content: 何度もだ。ぼくは何度も頭を掻きむしり、歯を食いしばる。
lines.translated: Over and over. I claw at my head over and over, clenching my teeth.
*Again*.

lines.content: すべて、大切なひとを救い出すためにと願い、はじめたことのはずだ。それなのに……っ。
lines.translated: All of this was supposed to have started from my wish to save the person precious to me. And yet...!

lines.content: また、大切な人を、ぼくは不幸にしたんだ……っ
lines.translated: "Once again, I made someone precious to me miserable...!"

lines.content: だから……こんなぼくだから、存在自体を消し去ってしまわなきゃと願ったのに……っ。
lines.translated: That's why... because this is who I am, I wished to erase my very existence...!

lines.content: ……どうしてっ
どうしてそのままでいさせてくれないっ。
lines.translated: Why won't it just let me stay erased?!

lines.content: ぼくなんて、産まれてこなければよかった……っ。誰に意地悪く指摘されるまでもなくわかっていたから、[・|そ][・|う][・|し][・|た]のに……なんでっ
lines.translated: "Someone like me never should have been born...! I knew that without needing anyone to spitefully point it out to me, and that's why *I did it*... so why?!"

lines.content: 奏大雅は喘ぐぼくを静かに見つめていた。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga quietly gazed at me as I gasped for air.

lines.content: 今、彼が何を思うのかなんて、想像もできやしないが……。
lines.translated: I can't even begin to imagine what he must be thinking right now, though...

lines.content: ああ、なんてことだ。
lines.translated: Ah, what have I done?

lines.content: ひどい。
lines.translated: It's awful.

lines.content: あんまりだ。
lines.translated: It's too much.

lines.content: こんなのひどすぎる。
lines.translated: This is just too cruel.

lines.content: ぼくは、殺した。
lines.translated: I killed her.

lines.content: “希望”もなにもないままに、ただただぼくは、大切な人を撃ち殺したのだ。
lines.translated: With no "hope" or anything left, I simply shot and killed the person precious to me.

lines.content: 手の震えも。
lines.translated: The trembling in my hands.

lines.content: 心の震えも。
lines.translated: The trembling in my heart.

lines.content: だめなんだ。
lines.translated: It's no use.

lines.content: 止まらない。
lines.translated: It won't stop.

lines.content: ……ごめんな
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 奏大雅がぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga murmured quietly.

lines.content: 彼女の、柊ハルの想いを君に、伝えたかったんだ
lines.translated: "I wanted to convey her feelings--Hiiragi Haru's feelings--to you."

lines.content: ……こんな事実なんてわざわざ君に伝えず、そのままでいてもよかったのかもしれない。こうして君を苦しめる結果になることは、想像しなくてもわかりきってる
lines.translated: "...Maybe it would have been better to just leave things be without going out of my way to tell you a truth like this. It's obvious without even imagining it that doing so would only end up tormenting you like this."

lines.content: でも、ごめん
lines.translated: "Even so, I'm sorry."

lines.content: 伝えずにはいられなかった。そうじゃなければ、いくらなんでも彼女が浮かばれない。……報われない。そう思ってしまったんだ
lines.translated: "I just couldn't keep it to myself. Because if I did, there's just no way her soul could ever rest. ...Everything she did would have been for nothing. I couldn't help thinking that."

lines.content: 真実なんてそんなもの、決してすべて知ることが正しいわけじゃない――張りぼてにもならない空っぽな言葉が、心に浮かんでは、沈む。
lines.translated: That's just what the truth is; knowing everything is by no means always the right thing--hollow words that couldn't even serve as a cheap facade float up in my mind and sink away.

lines.content: “絶望”だ。
lines.translated: It is "despair."

lines.content: 頭を抱えた。
lines.translated: I cradled my head in my hands.

lines.content: 震えは全身に広がった。
lines.translated: The trembling spread throughout my entire body.

lines.content: 涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: どうしようもなく、涙が、こぼれる。
lines.translated: Helplessly, tears spill over.

lines.content: 奏大雅は震えるぼくのことを見下ろし続けている。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga continues to look down at me as I tremble.
How did it happen?

lines.content: その心が、言葉にして話して聞かされたわけでもないのに、ぼくの頭の中に伝わってくるようだった。
lines.translated: Even though he hadn't spoken them aloud for me to hear, his thoughts seemed to flow directly into my mind.

lines.content: ……ぼくに撃ち抜かれた柊ハルは、ぼくの“魔法”によって強制的に、[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]の“ゆめのねどこ”へと戻された。
lines.translated: Shot through by my hand, Hiiragi Haru was forcibly returned by my "magic" to the "Dream Bed" on *this side*.

lines.content: ……俺のせいだ
lines.translated: "...It's my fault."

lines.content: そのときの奏大雅は“ゆめのねどこ”の座敷でひとり、頭を抱えていた。
lines.translated: Back then, Kanade Taiga was sitting alone in the tatami room of the "Dream Bed," holding his head in his hands.

lines.content: ……俺が、何の力もないばっかりに
lines.translated: "...Just because I don't have any power at all."

lines.content: その姿は今のぼくとまったく同じように、見えた。
lines.translated: That figure looked the exact same as I do right now.

lines.content: ……彼は、この時間世界に訪れた“絶望”について考えている。
lines.translated: He is thinking about the "despair" that has visited this timeline.

lines.content: 『ねえ……教えて』
lines.translated: "Hey... tell me."

lines.content: 胸を撃ち抜かれ重傷を負った幼い柊ハルが、治療できる“夜”の病院に急ぎ、“ゆめのねどこ”から運び出されようとしたとき――奏大雅に弱々しく、言ったのだった。
lines.translated: Mortally wounded with a gunshot through her chest, the young Hiiragi Haru was about to be rushed out of the "Dream Bed" to a hospital in the "Night" where she could be treated--when she spoke weakly to Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 『私……私ね、大切な人を、おじさんを、助けられるよね？』
lines.translated: "I... I can save my precious person, save Mister, right?"

lines.content: 『おじさんの大切なひとを、おじさんの“隣”に……幸せを……おじさん…………ごめん……私、届けられる、よね』
lines.translated: "Put Mister's precious person 'next to' him... bring happiness... Mister... I'm sorry... I can deliver it, right?"

lines.content: あ、ああ……っ、ああっ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah...! Yeah!"

lines.content: 『だから、お願い。……あなたが、届けて……、ほしい』
lines.translated: "So, please. ...I want you... to deliver it..."

lines.content: 『やっと、……私、“魔法”を見つけたの。……[・|今][・|の][・|私]の願いを、叶える……その、“魔法”……“想像”……できたよ……だ、だから……おね、がい……[・|こ][・|れ]を、届けて……』
lines.translated: "I finally... found the 'magic.' ...To grant the wish of *the me right now*... that 'magic'... I managed to 'imagine' it... S-So... plea...se... deliver *this*..."

lines.content: 真っ赤に染まった血まみれの手を、奏大雅は握りしめ、
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga tightly grasped her blood-soaked hand, dyed crimson,

lines.content: ……ましろっ
lines.translated: "...Mashiro!"

lines.content: 彼は、祈った。
lines.translated: And he prayed.

lines.content: どうか俺を、俺たちを、助けてくれ――幸運を授けてくれ。
lines.translated: Please save me, save us--grant us good fortune.

lines.content: どうかこの子を、助けてくれよ……っ
lines.translated: "Please, save this girl...!"

lines.content: でもましろに声は届かない。
lines.translated: Yet his voice does not reach Mashiro.

lines.content: もう奏大雅の“隣”は本当の空白だ。まっしろだ。誰も、彼に応援の言葉も励ましも、届けてはくれなかった。
lines.translated: The space "next to" Kanade Taiga is now a true void. Pure white. No one delivered words of support or encouragement to him.

lines.content: だから奏大雅はクロと話したいと願った。
lines.translated: That was why Kanade Taiga wished to talk to Kuro.

lines.content: ハルが運び出されてからすぐ、奏大雅は端末を取り出した。
lines.translated: Right after Haru was carried out, Kanade Taiga took out his terminal.

lines.content: こんな結果でもし未来が代わってしまっていたとしても、そんな未来は決して幸福なんかではないだろう。
lines.translated: Even if the future had been altered by an outcome like this, such a future could never be a happy one.

lines.content: それでも奏大雅は未来に“希望”を求めた。
lines.translated: Even so, Kanade Taiga sought "hope" in the future.

lines.content: かけた電話は一回で繋がったけれど、しかし“魔法”の効果のようなものが薄くなりはじめているのだろうか――……それとも。
lines.translated: The call connected on the first try, yet perhaps something like the effect of the "magic" was beginning to fade--...or else.
*Or else something had happened to Kuro*.

lines.content: そんなノイズまみれの言葉を最後に、
lines.translated: With those static-ridden words as the last,
"...found it--...Hello? Can you hear----' ...was--..."

lines.content: ぶつりと、通話は途切れてしまったのだった。
lines.translated: With a sharp click, the call was cut off.

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: そうしてひとり、奏大雅は“ゆめのねどこ”の居間で頭を抱え、何と名付けていいのかわからない心の重さに、今にも押しつぶされそうになっている。
lines.translated: And so, all alone in the living room of the "Dream Bed," Kanade Taiga holds his head in his hands, on the verge of being crushed at any moment by a heaviness in his heart he doesn't even know how to name.
It is "despair."

lines.content: こんな思いにそうと名付ける以外は思いつけない。
lines.translated: I cannot think of anything else to name a feeling like this.

lines.content: でも今や、そんな安易さでさえも憎からず感じてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Yet now, I even find myself hating how easy it is to call it that.

lines.content: ……だめだ。また、ぐちゃぐちゃになってしまった
lines.translated: "...It's no good. I've made a complete mess of things again."

lines.content: 絡んだ糸を解きほぐすどころか――最善と信じた道を行けばゆくほど、糸はめちゃめちゃに絡み行く――更にまたひとつ、“絶望的”な時間世界を生み出してしまったに、すぎない。
lines.translated: Far from untangling the knotted threads--the further I walk down the path I believed to be for the best, the more hopelessly tangled the threads become--I have done nothing more than give birth to yet another "hopeless" timeline.

lines.content: 自分の人生を救うことができるのは、自分自身ただひとり――……俺は、[男の子|彼]の人生を模倣するのはやめたはず。
lines.translated: The only one who can save my life is myself alone--...I was supposed to have stopped imitating his life.

lines.content: そうだ。これは俺自身が選んだ、俺のための人生のはずなんだ。
lines.translated: That's right. This is supposed to be a life for my own sake, chosen by my own self.

lines.content: ……それなのにどうして、乗り越えられないっ
lines.translated: "...And yet, why can't I overcome it?!"

lines.content: いったいどうしたらよかったんだ。
lines.translated: What on earth should I have done?

lines.content: いったい、どうしたらいいんだ。
lines.translated: What on earth am I supposed to do?

lines.content: 上手くいかない現実を前に……。
lines.translated: Faced with a reality where nothing goes right...

lines.content: また暴れ出しそうになった俺に、ふと、声が掛けられた。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to lash out again, someone suddenly called out to me.

lines.content: なあ、奏大雅。諦めんなよ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kanade Taiga. Don't give up."

lines.content: 智仁だ……。
lines.translated: It's Tomohito...

lines.content: 確かに酷いよな。こんな現実、あり得ない。神さまがもしいるならこんな意地の悪いことしやがって。いったい何がしたいんだって、一発くらいかましてやらねえと収まらないよな
lines.translated: "It's definitely awful. A reality like this shouldn't even be possible. If there's a God out there, pulling such a cruel stunt... You wouldn't be able to stomach it without landing at least one good punch and demanding to know what the hell He's playing at, right?"

lines.content: ……父さんだ。
lines.translated: It's Dad.

lines.content: でも、大丈夫だ。信じろよ。今のお前を救ってくれるものが、どこかに必ずあるはずだ
lines.translated: "Even so, it'll be okay. Believe in it. There's bound to be something out there that can save you right now."

lines.content: 俺の、探し求めていたヒーローだ。
lines.translated: The hero I had been searching for.

lines.content: 根拠なんてなくていい。自分に都合良く物事を“大丈夫だ”と信じ込むのは、いつだって、なんにも知らない子どもの特権だ。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "You don't need any proof. Conveniently convincing yourself that everything's going to be 'okay' is always the privilege of a kid who doesn't know anything. Right?"

lines.content: いつの間にか俺の隣に腰掛けていた彼は、情けなく震えてばかりの俺にそう言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Having sat down next to me before I knew it, he said those words to me as I did nothing but tremble pathetically.

lines.content: そして少し、自分のことについて話してくれた。
lines.translated: And then, he told me a little bit about himself.

lines.content: 俺は音楽に人生、めちゃくちゃにされたけど……。同じように救われたとも思ってる
lines.translated: "Music completely wrecked my life... but at the same time, I think it saved me, too."

lines.content: 音楽の“才能”を持って生まれてこなかったばっかりに、家では両親にさえ認めてもらえず、さみしく痛い思いばかりしてきたけれど……。
lines.translated: Just because he wasn't born with musical "talent," even his own parents wouldn't acknowledge him at home, leaving him with nothing but lonely and painful memories...

lines.content: そんなさみしい気持ちを癒やしてくれたのもまた、音楽だった。
lines.translated: Yet what healed those lonely feelings was also music.

lines.content: ぐずぐずと泣く俺と手を繋ぎ、さくら舞う夜を[・|一][・|緒][・|に]見上げて歩き……姉ちゃんが静かに、ときに熱く口ずさんでくれた“誰か”の歌だった。
lines.translated: Holding hands with him as he sniffled and cried, walking while looking up *together* at the night of dancing cherry blossoms... it was "someone's" song that his older sister quietly, and at times passionately, hummed for him.

lines.content: ずっと遠い時代を生きていたすげえ奴の作ったすげえ音が、そこに乗せられたうつくしい[言葉|詩]が、うじうじ悩んでは泣いてばかりいた俺のことを、一瞬で救ってくれたんだ
lines.translated: "An amazing sound created by some incredible person who lived in a distant era, and the beautiful poetry set to it... In a single instant, it saved me when all I ever did was fret and cry."

lines.content: それはまさかどこかで自分のことを見ていたんじゃないのかと、そんな錯覚さえ覚えてしまうほど音も言葉も今の自分にぴったりで――
lines.translated: Both the melody and the words fit his current self so perfectly that it almost gave him the illusion someone had been watching over him from somewhere--

lines.content: 自分のために歌われた“歌”だと、そう感じたのだという。
lines.translated: He said he felt as though it were a "song" sung just for him.

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: その歌は確かに、姉が彼のために歌ったものだと、彼はまだ知らない。
lines.translated: He still doesn't know that the song truly was sung for his sake by his older sister.

lines.content: そうして聴いた歌を元に、彼はたくさんの人たちの心を繋ぐ、“春”の“歌”を――たったひとつの“愛”の“歌”を編むことも、まだ知らない。
lines.translated: Nor does he know yet that, based on the song he heard back then, he will weave a "song" of "spring" that connects the hearts of many people--a single, solitary "song" of "love."

lines.content: いつ、どこのタイミングで彼がその真実を知るのかは、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't know when, or at what point, he will learn that truth, though...

lines.content: とにかく彼はまだまだ、何も知らない子どものはずなのに……、
lines.translated: In any case, even though he's supposed to still be a child who knows nothing at all...

lines.content: 今のお前を救ってくれるものがどこかに必ずあるはずだ。それが歌だとは言わない。ましてや[詩|言葉]や絵だとか、形に見えるものだとは言わない。でも、必ずどこかにあるんだよ
lines.translated: "There's bound to be something out there that can save you right now. I'm not saying it's a song. Much less words or a painting, or anything with a visible form. Still, it's definitely out there somewhere."

lines.content: ……それなのに、そんな子どもであるはずの彼の言葉は、奏大雅の心にちくりと刺さった。
lines.translated: Even so, the words of someone who was supposed to be just a kid pierced sharply into Kanade Taiga's heart.

lines.content: いいか、大雅
lines.translated: "Listen to me, Taiga."

lines.content: よく聞けよ、と父さんは言うのだ。
lines.translated: Listen closely, Dad says.

lines.content: 俺はさ、いつも都合良く信じてるんだ――いつだって、どんなことになってしまったって、この世界には……その人の人生には、どこかに必ず“希望”が眠ってるものなんだって
lines.translated: "You see, I always conveniently choose to believe--that no matter when, no matter what happens, in this world... in a person's life, there is always 'hope' sleeping somewhere."

lines.content: お前にしか見つけられない“希望”が、お前に見つけられるのを待っているんだって、信じてる……
lines.translated: "I believe that a 'hope' only you can find is waiting to be discovered by you..."

lines.content: だから諦めず探せよと父さんは言った。
lines.translated: So don't give up and keep looking, Dad said.

lines.content: 必要なら俺が付き合う。どこまでもな。地獄の底にだって一緒に行ってやるよ。親友。お前をひとりで、そこがどんなとこだろうと……行かせるわけないだろ
lines.translated: "If you need me to, I'll come with you. All the way. I'll even go to the depths of hell with you, my best friend. No matter what kind of place it is... there's no way I'd let you go alone, right?"

lines.content: ニッと白い歯を見せ、笑った。
lines.translated: He flashed a grin, showing his white teeth, and laughed.

lines.content: なあ、親友。思い出してみろよ
lines.translated: "Hey, best friend. Try to remember."

lines.content: お前がこれまで“勇気”をもらえた何かだ。ひとつくらいあるだろ？
lines.translated: "Something that has given you 'courage' up until now. There's got to be at least one thing, right?"

lines.content: そこにきっと、お前の“希望”が眠ってる。俺に“勇気”と“希望”をくれた“音楽”みたいな、何かがさ――お前にもあるだろ？
lines.translated: "Your 'hope' is surely sleeping right there. Something like the 'music' that gave me 'courage' and 'hope'--you have something like that too, don't you?"

lines.content: 遠いいつかの時の中から、悲しみに震えるお前の心を勇気づけてくれた誰かの“想い”が――それこそ“歌”や“絵”や、物語だ。
lines.translated: Someone's "feelings" from some distant time that encouraged your heart as it trembled in sorrow--whether it be a "song," a "painting," or a story.

lines.content: 大切に思えるそれらが何かひとつでも、あったはずだ。
lines.translated: There must have been at least one of those things that you could hold dear.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 父さん。
lines.translated: Dad.

lines.content: 俺はあなたに、何かに絶望し、躓いてしまったとき――こんなふうにして叱咤し、励ましてほしかった。人生について大切にしたい[言葉|宝物]を、あなたから、もらいたかった。
lines.translated: When I despaired over something and stumbled--this was how I wanted you to scold me and cheer me on. I wanted to receive words--treasures--to cherish about life, from you.

lines.content: ……“夢”は叶った。
lines.translated: My "dream" came true.

lines.content: ……俺の“希望”は
lines.translated: "...My 'hope' is..."

lines.content: だからもう、こぼれる涙を必死に拭い、
lines.translated: So I desperately wiped away the spilling tears,

lines.content: ……俺の“勇気”になった、誰かの“想い”は
lines.translated: "...Someone's 'feelings' that became my 'courage'..."

lines.content: これまで生きた時間を、振り返り……、
lines.translated: Looking back on the time I had lived until now...

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 父さんは“音楽”の中に“勇気”を見つけ、“希望”を抱いたと言っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Dad said he found "courage" in "music" and embraced "hope," while I...

lines.content: ……そうか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ……見つけた。
lines.translated: I found it.

lines.content: “物語”だ
lines.translated: "It's a 'story.'"

lines.content: 俺は、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]の歩んだ人生を――その“物語”を見つめていた。
lines.translated: I had been gazing at the life *that boy* walked--at his "story."

lines.content: “夜”に記録されていた彼の人生を一つ、ひとつ、ページを捲るようにして読み取ったのだ。
lines.translated: I read through his life, recorded in the "Night," one piece at a time, as if turning the pages of a book.

lines.content: そうして自分が生きている理由を知って……。
lines.translated: And in doing so, I learned the reason I am alive...
*I felt that he was amazing*.

lines.content: 彼こそが多くの物語を救う勇気ある者――ヒーローだと、思った。
lines.translated: I thought that he was truly a brave soul who saved many stories--a hero.

lines.content: 自分にも彼のように生きることができるだろうか。
lines.translated: Could I live like him, too?

lines.content: 救うべき者を救うため、彼は、自分自身を撃ち抜いた。
lines.translated: In order to save the one he needed to save, he shot right through himself.

lines.content: そして彼は……。
lines.translated: And then he...

lines.content: 救うべき者を救うため、救うべき者自身をも、撃ち抜いて……。
lines.translated: In order to save the one he needed to save, he even shot right through that very person...

lines.content: 自分はそこから、長い時間を孤独のまま生きる道を、選んだ。
lines.translated: From that point on, he chose the path of living in solitude for a long, long time.

lines.content: その“物語”にこそ、“勇気”が――
lines.translated: It is within that very "story" that "courage"--

lines.content: “絶望”に沈んだこの“物語”を救うための“[ヒント|希望]”が、眠ってる。そう感じた。
lines.translated: That the "hint"--the "hope"--to save this "story" sunk in "despair" lies sleeping. That was what I felt.

lines.content: 俺の[・|決][・|意]を聞いた父さんも……智仁も、試してみたらいいと言ってくれた。
lines.translated: Hearing my *resolve*, Dad... Tomohito told me I should give it a try.

lines.content: 柊ハルを犠牲にした“夜”から、幾つかの“夜”が過ぎ去って……。
lines.translated: Several "Nights" had passed since the "Night" Hiiragi Haru was sacrificed...

lines.content: “夜の王”だ。
lines.translated: It's the "King of the Night."

lines.content: “参禅町”の空に彼が現れた。
lines.translated: He appeared in the sky of "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: その姿は大きな……とても大きなくじらのように見えた。
lines.translated: His figure looked like a giant... a very giant whale.

lines.content: “夜”の空をたおやかに泳ぎ、口を大きく開き――泣き声を響かせている。
lines.translated: Gracefully swimming through the "Night" sky, opening his mouth wide--letting his cries echo out.

lines.content: それはまるで、世界中の“悪い夢”を、人々の不安や心配、そういった心をすべて、自分が飲み込んでしまおうとしているように俺には見えた。
lines.translated: To me, it looked as though he were trying to swallow up all the "bad dreams" in the world, all of people's anxieties and worries, and every heart like that into himself.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: まったく。
lines.translated: Honestly.
*You really are a hero through and through*.

lines.content: ……追いついた
lines.translated: "...I caught up."

lines.content: 俺は、見上げた空にため息をつく。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh toward the sky above.

lines.content: 手のひらに、“魔法の拳銃”
lines.translated: In my palm is the " magic handgun."

lines.content: 弾薬は充分に残ってる。
lines.translated: There is plenty of ammunition left.

lines.content: 俺が……。
本来君を倒すはずだった少女たちではなく、少年であるこの俺が……。
lines.translated: Not the girls who were originally supposed to defeat you, but I, a boy...

lines.content: 今、この“夜”の中で、[・|君]の成したことと同じように。
lines.translated: Now, within this "Night," just like what *you* accomplished.

lines.content: 救うべき者を、救うため――
lines.translated: In order to save the ones who need to be saved--

lines.content: やっと追いついたぞ。……俺の、ヒーロー
lines.translated: "I finally caught up to you. ...My hero."

lines.content: ――君を、“夜の王”を、“魔法”で撃ち抜いたのだった。
lines.translated: --I shot right through you, the "King of the Night," with "magic."

lines.content: 彼、奏大雅がここまで歩んだ道のりを、殆ど一瞬のうちに垣間見た。
lines.translated: In almost a single instant, I caught a glimpse of the path he, Kanade Taiga, had walked to get this far.

lines.content: 彼の言ったとおりだ。
lines.translated: It is just as he said.

lines.content: 確かに失ったものは大きすぎた。
lines.translated: What they lost truly was far too great.

lines.content: だから確かに、彼らは、敗北してしまったのだろう。
lines.translated: That is why they truly must have been defeated.

lines.content: ……いったい何に？
lines.translated: By what on earth?

lines.content: 運命だとかなんだとか。
lines.translated: Fate, or something like that?

lines.content: そんな大それたものじゃない。
lines.translated: It isn't anything so grand.

lines.content: 彼らを“絶望”に引きずり堕とした原因は、このぼくの身勝手さだ――ぼくが身勝手に、我がままに何かを求めれば、必ず大切な人が不幸になる。
lines.translated: The cause that dragged them down into "despair" is my own selfishness--whenever I selfishly, willfully wish for something, someone precious to me invariably ends up unhappy.

lines.content: ぼくの心はそういう世界に生きていて……。
lines.translated: My heart lives in that kind of world...

lines.content: 自らを罰したいと願うことさえ、まったく同じ結果を招くのか……。
lines.translated: Does even wishing to punish myself invite the exact same result...?

lines.content: ぼくはまた身勝手に、“絶望感”に打ちのめされていた。
lines.translated: Once again, out of my own selfishness, I was crushed by a "sense of despair."

lines.content: すべての“不幸”をこの時間世界の自分たちに集めて、この時間世界の自分たちごとまるめて破棄する
lines.translated: "Gathering all the 'misfortune' onto ourselves in this timeline, crumpling it all up together with our own selves in this timeline, and discarding it."

lines.content: 奏大雅がつぶやくように言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke in a murmur.

lines.content: ……少女たちと“魔法使い”が、“夜間鉄道”を利用するため、“夜”に支払った大きすぎる“代償”だ
lines.translated: "...It is the far-too-great 'price' paid to the 'Night' so that the girls and the 'Magician' could use the 'Night Train.'"

lines.content: 時を越え、時間世界を書き換えようと働きかける――そんな大きすぎる“夢”を叶えるためには、やはり相応の大きすぎる“代償”が必要だ。
lines.translated: Reaching across time and working to rewrite a timeline--in order to grant such an overwhelmingly vast "dream," a correspondingly vast "price" is naturally required.

lines.content: 他世界の中で起きる不幸を全部、自分たちの人生の中にまるめて閉じ込め、押しつぶすんだ
lines.translated: "We bundle up all the misfortune that occurs in other worlds, lock it inside our own lives, and crush it."

lines.content: この町で一度でも起きた出来事は、この町の“夜”に記録されてしまうというのなら……[・|そ][・|こ]に、[・|そ][・|れ]は確かな質量を伴い、時間と空間の中に存在することとなる。
lines.translated: If any event that has happened even once in this town is recorded in this town's "Night"... then *there*, *it* comes to exist within time and space, accompanied by a definite mass.

lines.content: その不幸の質量を打ち消す方法は思いつけない。一度不幸が発生してしまった事実は永遠に、残る。
lines.translated: I cannot think of a way to cancel out that mass of misfortune. The fact that a misfortune has once occurred remains forever.

lines.content: だが、移動させることは可能だ。
lines.translated: However, it is possible to move it.
From *that side* to *this side*--by paying a "price" to the "Night."

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”こと陽向井あさひと、四名からなる“[特別な少女たち|魔法少女]”が、[・|俺][・|に][・|秘][・|密][・|で]話し合い、決めたことだった。
lines.translated: It was something that Hinamukai Asahi, the "Magician of the Night," and the four "Special Girls"--the "Magical Girls"--discussed and decided *in secret from me*.

lines.content: 『今、この時間世界の私たちが犠牲になることで、あたらしい時間が――幸せに彩られた世界が、生まれるというのなら』
lines.translated: "'If sacrificing ourselves in this timeline right now will give birth to a new time--a world colored by happiness...'"

lines.content: 『どんな時間の中に生きてる私たちだって、同然の選択をしたはずだ』
lines.translated: "'Then no matter what time we might be living in, we surely would have made the exact same choice.'"

lines.content: あさひさんをはじめ、ここに生きてるみんながそう言い、力強くうなずいていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Starting with Asahi-san, everyone living here said that and nodded firmly, yet...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 何かを犠牲にしてまで手に入れられたものに、本当の価値はあるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is there any true value in something obtained even at the cost of sacrificing something else?

lines.content: それもまた、苦しみとなったんだ。俺の……俺たちの“絶望感”を更に大きく助長したんだよ。結果として
lines.translated: "That, too, became a source of suffering. In the end, it only served to further magnify my... our 'sense of despair.'"

lines.content: だから、[・|ハ][・|ル][・|が][・|あ][・|あ][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|た]のは君の……君だけのせいじゃない。そんなふうに言いたいのだろうか。
lines.translated: So, is he trying to say that *Haru ending up like that* wasn't my... wasn't *only* my fault?

lines.content: だから奏大雅はそんな話をしたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is that why Kanade Taiga told me all of this?

lines.content: どこからか携帯の鳴る音がした。
lines.translated: From somewhere, I heard a cell phone ringing.

lines.content: 思わずポケットを探るもそこは空っぽ。求めたものは得られない。
lines.translated: I reflexively checked my pockets, only to find them empty. What I reached for wasn't there.

lines.content: だが、ぶつりと音がし、通話がはじまる。
lines.translated: Even so, with a sudden click, the call connected.

lines.content: ノイズまみれの声が暗闇のどこからか響いてる。
lines.translated: A voice buried in static echoed from somewhere within the darkness.
"...found it--...Hello? Can you hear----' ...was--..."

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: この声は、クロだ。
lines.translated: This voice belongs to Kuro.

lines.content: ……久しぶりに聞いたその声に、じわりと、わけもなく涙がにじむ。
lines.translated: Hearing her voice after so long made tears well up in my eyes for no reason at all.

lines.content: それはさっき、奏大雅の記憶の中ででも聞いた声だった。
lines.translated: It was the same voice I had heard just moments ago inside Kanade Taiga's memories.

lines.content: でも、だめだ。
lines.translated: But I couldn't.

lines.content: 君が何を言ってるのかわからない。
lines.translated: I couldn't make out what she was saying.

lines.content: 今にも途切れてしまいそうな通話の声を、俺は必死になって拾おうと耳を澄ませた。
lines.translated: I strained my ears, desperately trying to catch the words on the other end before the call cut out completely.

lines.content: 『……見つけた』
lines.translated: "...I found it."

lines.content: 繰り返される君の声。今度はしっかり聞こえた。
lines.translated: Her voice repeated the words. This time, I heard her clearly.

lines.content: 『見つけたよ。探してたもの、見つけられた。……もしもし？　聞こえてる？　あの子の“希望”を、見つけられたよ』
lines.translated: "I found it. What I was looking for, I managed to find it. ...Hello? Can you hear me? I managed to find his 'hope.'"

lines.content: あの子の……
“希望”？
lines.translated: 'Hope'?

lines.content: いったい何のことを言ってるのかわからない。
lines.translated: I have no idea what on earth she's talking about.

lines.content: 本当に？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: 奏大雅がぼくに言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke to me.

lines.content: 本当に、わからない？
lines.translated: "Do you really not understand?"

lines.content: 彼女は、未来で俺たちと一緒に戦っていた。……君のことを取り戻すために
lines.translated: "She was fighting alongside us in the future. ...In order to get you back."

lines.content: 彼女が“魔法使い”から指示されたのは、[君|男の子]の“悪夢”が産まれた瞬間を、“夜”の中で探し出すこと――
lines.translated: What the "Magician" instructed her to do was to search within the "Night" for the exact moment that the boy's--my--"nightmare" was born--

lines.content: そしてその中に、[君|男の子]のことを救える可能性を、“希望”を、見出せたなら最善だ。
lines.translated: And if she could discover a possibility of saving me--a "hope"--within it, that would be for the best.

lines.content: 彼女はきっと愚直なまでに、君のため……、君だけのために、未来の時間の中でたったひとり、“夜”を駆け回ったに違いない
lines.translated: "I have no doubt that she ran through the 'Night' all alone in that future time, earnestly and single-mindedly, for your sake... for your sake alone."

lines.content: 君のことだけを想い、君の気持ちを理解できますようにとだけ祈り、“夜”の町で君の“悪夢”の所在を探し回った。
lines.translated: Thinking only of me, praying only to understand my feelings, she searched every corner of the town of the "Night" for the whereabouts of my "nightmare."

lines.content: そして彼女は……クロは、見つけたんだよ。君のまっくろな“夜”色に染まってしまった心を救う――そのための方法を
lines.translated: "And she... Kuro found it. A way to save your heart, which had been dyed pitch-black in the color of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: あのとき俺と電話で話したクロの声はノイズまみれで、俺には聞き取ることができなかった。何を言っていたのか、何を、伝えようとしていたのか。まるでわからなかった
lines.translated: "Back then, when Kuro spoke to me over the phone, her voice was so full of static that I couldn't make it out. What she was saying, what she was trying to tell me... I had no idea at all."

lines.content: ……でも、今ならすべて理解できる――“夜”を通してここへ来た。そんな俺になら、すべて
lines.translated: "...Even so, right now, I can understand all of it--now that I've come here through the 'Night.' As I am now, I understand everything."

lines.content: 奏大雅はもう一度、俺に手を差し伸べて――見せてやるよ、とぼくに言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga held his hand out to me once more--telling me that he would show me.

lines.content: 彼女が未来で何を見つけたのか。……どんな“希望”を手に入れられたのか
lines.translated: "What she found in the future. ...What kind of 'hope' she managed to obtain."

lines.content: それなのに、どうして――世界は今もまだ、誰も、幸福になれていないのか
lines.translated: "And despite that, why--even now, no one in the world has been able to find happiness."

lines.content: その答えを今の俺は理解できてる。だから見せよう。すべて君に届けよう。
lines.translated: The me of right now understands the answer to that. So I will show you. I will deliver all of it to you.

lines.content: そう言う奏大雅はまっすぐに俺を見ている。
lines.translated: Saying that, Kanade Taiga looked straight at me.

lines.content: 正直なところ怖かった。
lines.translated: To tell the truth, I was scared.

lines.content: もうこれ以上、心には荷物を背負い込むだけの余裕はない――……いつもだ。いつも自分のことだけで精一杯なんだ。ぼくは。
lines.translated: My heart no longer has the room to shoulder any more burdens--...it's always like this. It's always all I can do just to deal with myself. That's how I am.

lines.content: だから恐れた。
lines.translated: That was why I was afraid.

lines.content: 差し伸べられた手を再び取ることを。
lines.translated: Afraid to take the hand held out to me once again.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 『……見つけた』
lines.translated: "...I found it."

lines.content: 暗闇の中で繰り返される君の声。
lines.translated: Her voice repeated over and over in the darkness.

lines.content: 『見つけたよ。探してたもの、見つけられた。……もしもし？　聞こえてる？　あの子の“希望”を、見つけられたよ』
lines.translated: "I found it. What I was looking for, I managed to find it. ...Hello? Can you hear me? I managed to find his 'hope.'"

lines.content: 奏大雅はぼくを見ている。静かに、見ている。手を差し伸べたまま。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga was looking at me. Looking at me quietly, his hand still held out.

lines.content: その手を取ることを拒否したなら、クロを、永遠に未来の世界でひとりきりにしてしまう……。
lines.translated: If I refused to take his hand, I would leave Kuro all alone in that future world forever...

lines.content: それで構わないと言ってしまっているのと同じこのように思え、だめだ。
lines.translated: It felt the same as saying I would be fine with that, and I couldn't bear it.

lines.content: それだけは、絶対に。
lines.translated: Anything but that.

lines.content: 引き留める彼女を置いて、ひとり勝手に“夜の王”となったこのぼくが、そんなこと言えるはずもないだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Though someone like me, who left her behind when she tried to stop me and selfishly became the "King of the Night" all on my own, probably has no right to say such a thing...

lines.content: だからぼくは。
lines.translated: That was why I...

lines.content: だからこそ、ぼくは……恐る恐る、奏大雅の手を取ろうとした。
lines.translated: For that very reason, I... timidly reached out to take Kanade Taiga's hand.

lines.content: すると心の風景が一瞬で、今度は、未来の世界へと飛び立った。
lines.translated: Instantly, the landscape of my heart took flight, leaping this time into the world of the future.

lines.content: ちくたくとたくさんの時計の音が溢れる部屋で、[・|わ][・|た][・|し]は電話を切った。
lines.translated: In a room overflowing with the ticking of countless clocks, *I* hung up the phone.

lines.content: 過去世界の奏大雅と繋がっていた電話だ。
lines.translated: The phone that had been connected to Kanade Taiga in the world of the past.

lines.content: 奏大雅は言っていた。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga had told me.

lines.content: 自分たちが過去の時間世界に働きかけることにより、わたしの生きてる未来の時間が変わるかどうかを確かめ、答え合わせをしてほしいと。
lines.translated: He wanted me to check whether the future time I lived in would change as a result of them acting upon the timeline of the past, and to compare our answers.

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひは言っていた。
lines.translated: Hinamukai Asahi, the "Magician of the Night," had told me.

lines.content: わたしが未来の“夜”で、[あの子|男の子]の“悪夢”の所在を探し、そこに[あの子|男の子]の“希望”を見つけ出すことができれば最善だと。
lines.translated: That it would be for the best if I could search for the whereabouts of the boy's "nightmare" in the future "Night" and find his "hope" there.

lines.content: でも……
きみは人で、わたしは“猫”だ。わたしには[きみ|男の子]の心がわからない。
lines.translated: You are a human, and I am a "cat." I don't understand a boy's--your--heart.

lines.content: そんなわたしに、探せるのかな。きみの“悪夢”や“希望”が、いったいどこにあるのかなんて……。
lines.translated: Can someone like me really find it? Where on earth your "nightmare" and your "hope" could possibly be...?

lines.content: それでも、わたしひとりがこんなところでぼんやりとはしていられない。
lines.translated: Even so, I can't just sit around spacing out in a place like this all by myself.

lines.content: たくさんある時計のうちひとつを手に取った。
lines.translated: I picked up one of the many clocks.

lines.content: 金色の懐中時計。
lines.translated: A gold pocket watch.
*Something necessary to search for Taiga's heart*.

lines.content: 恐る恐る、部屋を出た。
lines.translated: Timidly, I left the room.

lines.content: “夜”の“参禅町”を彷徨い、歩く。
lines.translated: I wandered through the "Sanzen Town" of the "Night," walking on and on.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ふと名前を呼んでみた。
lines.translated: On impulse, I tried calling out his name.

lines.content: ……それは、わたしの求める人を指すものではない。本来は。
lines.translated: Originally, that name did not refer to the person I seek.

lines.content: でもあの子がそう呼んでほしいというのなら、誰に変だと言われても、わたしはそうする。
lines.translated: Yet if he wants me to call him that, then no matter who calls it strange, that is what I will do.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 心の中で、問いかける。
lines.translated: Inside my heart, I asked a question.

lines.content: きみはずっと、つらかったの……？
lines.translated: "Were you in pain this whole time...?"
Even *back then*, when you were smiling.

lines.content: 本当はいつも、ひとりで……心の中で、泣いてたの？
lines.translated: "Were you actually always all alone... crying inside your heart?"

lines.content: つんけんしてばかりのわたしに、やさしくしてくれた[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]も。
lines.translated: Even *back then*, when you were so kind to me despite how prickly and aloof I always was.

lines.content: 本当は……きみが一番、誰かにやさしくしてもらえるのを待ってたの……？
lines.translated: "Were you actually... the one waiting the most for someone to be kind to you...?"

lines.content: ふと蘇るきみの横顔。
lines.translated: Suddenly, the memory of your profile surfaced in my mind.

lines.content: 誰もきみを見ていないとき、時どきその眼差しはどこか遠くを見つめてた――でも、わたしの視線を感じると、きみはまたいつものように微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Whenever no one was looking at you, your gaze would sometimes drift off into the distance--yet the moment you felt me watching, you would smile again just like always.

lines.content: そんな横顔に、わたしは気づいてた。
lines.translated: I had noticed that expression on your face.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: わたしには、きみが何を考えていたのかわからなかった。わからないことが、さみしかった。
lines.translated: I didn't know what you were thinking. Not knowing made me lonely.

lines.content: でも、今なら少しだけ理解できる。
lines.translated: Even so, right now, I can understand just a little bit.

lines.content: 微笑んだその瞳の奥にはいつも、いっぱいのさみしさと、悲しい気持ちを隠そうと必死な想いがあったんだ。
lines.translated: Deep inside those smiling eyes, there was always an overwhelming loneliness, and a desperate desire to hide your sorrow.

lines.content: ごめん……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry..."

lines.content: 気づけなくて、ごめんね……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry I couldn't notice..."

lines.content: わたしは、唇を噛む。
lines.translated: I bit my lip.

lines.content: いつもそばには、いられなかったけど――それでもいつもどこかで、きみのこと、見てたいと思ってた
lines.translated: "I couldn't always be by your side--yet even so, somewhere deep down, I always wanted to watch over you."

lines.content: それなのにきみの気持ちを、心を、わたし、全然わからなくて……
lines.translated: "And yet, I didn't understand your feelings, or your heart, at all..."

lines.content: 本当に、ごめんなさい……。
lines.translated: I'm truly sorry...

lines.content: わたしは、きみを幸せにしたいのに。
lines.translated: Even though I want to make you happy.

lines.content: そんな“夢”も叶えられない。わたしは、わたしが嫌いだ。
lines.translated: I can't even grant a "dream" like that. I hate myself.

lines.content: “夢”を叶えられないどころか、大切に想いたい人の気持ちさえ理解できない。
lines.translated: Let alone granting a "dream," I can't even understand the feelings of the person I want to cherish.

lines.content: そんな自分が――“猫”に産まれてきた自分が、大嫌い。
lines.translated: I hate myself for being like this--I hate myself for being born a "cat."

lines.content: どうしてわたし、きみと同じに産まれて来れなかったんだろう
lines.translated: "Why couldn't I have been born the same as you?"

lines.content: いつも繰り返しそればかりわたしは考えている。
lines.translated: That is the only thing I think about, over and over again.

lines.content: そんな頭の中がぼんやりと、しはじめていた。
lines.translated: In the midst of those thoughts, my head began to grow hazy.

lines.content: 眠気だ。
lines.translated: Drowsiness.

lines.content: だめ……
まだ、眠っちゃだめだよ。
lines.translated: I mustn't fall asleep yet.

lines.content: ふるふると頭を振った。
lines.translated: I gave my head a little shake.

lines.content: また未来へ跳んでしまわぬよう、必死に耐えている。
lines.translated: Desperately fighting it off so that I wouldn't leap into the future again.

lines.content: もし更に先へ飛び越えてしまったら、過去の奏大雅への電話だって今以上に繋がりにくくなってしまうかもしれない。
lines.translated: If I were to jump even further ahead, it might become even harder than it already is to get a call through to Kanade Taiga in the past.

lines.content: だからだめ。どんなに眠くても我慢しなくちゃ。
lines.translated: So I mustn't. No matter how sleepy I am, I have to hold out.

lines.content: 重い頭で、“夜”の町をふらふら歩く――……思い出だ。
lines.translated: With a heavy head, I staggered through the town of the "Night"--...memories.

lines.content: わたしは、きみの記憶と“想い”を探す。
lines.translated: I searched for your memories and "feelings."

lines.content: そこに、きみの心を救う“希望”を探す。
lines.translated: Searching within them for the "hope" that will save your heart.

lines.content: 町はざわざわと騒がしい。
lines.translated: The town was abuzz with noise and commotion.

lines.content: “夜”の町のそこらには、大雅とわたしの過ごしたいつかの時間が、ぼんやりと、浮かび上がって見えていた。
lines.translated: All around the town of the "Night," the times Taiga and I had once spent together were faintly rising to the surface before my eyes.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]が過去であれ未来であれ現在であれ――一度発生した[出来事|時間]はすべて、“夜”という時間と空間を媒体として、“夜”の町の至るところに記録され、保存されている。
lines.translated: Whether *it* is the past, the future, or the present--every event, every moment of time that has occurred even once is recorded and preserved throughout the town of the "Night," using the time and space known as the "Night" as its medium.

lines.content: だからそこらを行き来する“影”たちは、いつかこの町で暮らしていた人たちの“命”そのものであるだけでなく、保存された記憶や出来事が、まるで再生される映像のように蠢いている。
lines.translated: Therefore, the "shadows" coming and going all around are not merely the very "lives" of the people who once lived in this town; preserved memories and events are also writhing within them, playing back just like projected footage.

lines.content: あさひが電話で、わたしにそう教えてくれた。
lines.translated: That was what Asahi had told me over the phone.
*And she had delivered this golden pocket watch to the future me.*

lines.content: 『……この時計は私の造った小さな“魔法”だ』
lines.translated: "...This watch is a small piece of 'magic' that I created."

lines.content: 『この時計の針と日付と、そして年数とを操作したなら、“参禅町”の“夜”に眠る[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]の記憶を、垣間見ることができるだろうと思う』
lines.translated: "If you adjust the hands, the date, and the year on this watch, I believe you will be able to catch a glimpse of the memories from *that time* sleeping within the 'Night' of Sanzen-cho."

lines.content: 『……“記憶の図書館”“終わってしまった時間の墓場”』
lines.translated: "...'A library of memories.' 'A graveyard of ended time.'"

lines.content: 『“夜の国”がそういった場所なのだとは想像もできなかった今までの私には、文字通り、想像だってできなかった“魔法”なんだよ』
lines.translated: "For my past self, who could never have imagined the 'Realm of the Night' was such a place, it is a 'magic' that was quite literally beyond my imagination."

lines.content: 『これを[今|過去]の私が、大雅の部屋に置いておく。何も問題が起こらなければ、未来の君へと届くはずだ』
lines.translated: "I, here in the past, will leave this in Taiga's room. As long as nothing goes wrong, it should reach you in the future."

lines.content: 『それを使って、一番[あの子|大雅]のそばにいただろう君が、[あの子|大雅]の“希望”を見つけてほしい』
lines.translated: "Using that, I want you--the one who was surely by Taiga's side more than anyone else--to find his 'hope.'"

lines.content: その“魔法”を造るにはいったいどれだけの“代償”が必要だったのだろう。
lines.translated: Just how much of a "price" did it take to create that "magic"?

lines.content: あさひは決して、それについて語らなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: Asahi never spoke a word about it, though...

lines.content: この時計があればわたしは、この町の“夜”に記録されたあらゆる記憶を垣間見ることが、できる。
lines.translated: As long as I have this watch, I can catch glimpses of every single memory recorded in the "Night" of this town.

lines.content: たとえば……。
lines.translated: For example...

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”を出る前に、“夜”を通じて、いつかのきみをわたしは見たよ。
lines.translated: Before leaving the "Bed of Dreams," through the "Night," I saw you from some point in the past.

lines.content: 『……お願いします』
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: 幼いきみは、たどり着いたばかりの“ゆめのねどこ”で……わたしの知らないところで、“夜の魔法使い”に願ってた。
lines.translated: A young you, having only just arrived at the "Bed of Dreams"... was making a wish to the "Magician of the Night," completely unbeknownst to me.

lines.content: 『どうか、お願いします。最低最悪な死に方を教えてください』
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you. Tell me the worst, most terrible way to die."

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 確かに、そうだ。
lines.translated: Indeed, that's right.

lines.content: 今ならわかる。
lines.translated: I understand it now.

lines.content: ましろの代わりに“夜の王”となり、世界中から――大切に想う人たちから、静かな憎悪を集めることと。
lines.translated: Becoming the "King of the Night" in Mashiro's place, and drawing quiet hatred from the entire world--from the people he cherished so dearly.
*And being hated by the entire world as the heinous criminal who kidnapped a poor little girl.*

lines.content: どちらも最低で、最悪な最期だろうと思う――このときの大雅はまだ、そんなふうに明確な方法も結果も思いついてはいなかっただろう。
lines.translated: I think either one would be the worst, most terrible end--though at that time, Taiga probably hadn't thought of such a specific method or outcome yet.

lines.content: ただ、“魔法使い”に自分の全部を見透かしてほしかったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe he simply wanted the "Magician" to see right through everything about him.

lines.content: だから最大限に自分を罰するための方法を、“魔法使い”に――あさひに、大雅は問いかけていた。
lines.translated: And so, Taiga was asking the "Magician"--asking Asahi--for a way to punish himself to the fullest extent.

lines.content: そんな大雅のことを、やさしくたしなめるあさひの顔と……。
lines.translated: Asahi's face as she gently chided him...

lines.content: 暖かくて美味しい料理と時間で、少しずつ、穏やかな顔に変わっていく大雅のこと……。
lines.translated: And Taiga, his expression gradually softening through the warm, delicious food and the time they spent together...

lines.content: この時点で少し、大雅の覚悟は鈍ったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: At that point, perhaps Taiga's resolve had dulled just a little bit.

lines.content: そんないつかの時間の中に、大雅へ“希望”をあげられるヒントはあるだろうかと、わたしは探した。
lines.translated: I searched within those moments from the past, wondering if there might be a hint to give Taiga "hope."

lines.content: ……今日って、何月で、何日だったっけ
lines.translated: "...What month and day was today again?"

lines.content: ふと、つぶやいた。
lines.translated: The word slipped out.

lines.content: 確か……
lines.translated: "If I remember right..."

lines.content: 部屋から持ち出した懐中時計を覗き込む。
lines.translated: I peered into the pocket watch I had brought out from the room.

lines.content: 文字盤には時を示す数字だけではなく、ゼンマイを巻くようにして合わせられる日付もあった。
lines.translated: On the dial, there were not only numbers indicating the hour, but also a date that could be set as if winding a mainspring.

lines.content: “参禅町”の“夜の国”――その時間を示してる。
lines.translated: The "Realm of the Night" of Sanzen-cho--it was showing that time.

lines.content: ……たとえば。
lines.translated: For example.

lines.content: 今日が四月一日だったとする。
lines.translated: Suppose today was April first.

lines.content: すると過去、あるいは未来の四月一日に起こる出来事のすべてが、その記憶が、“夜”の“参禅町”を彩っている。
lines.translated: Then every event that happened on April first in the past or the future, all of those memories, would color the "Night" of Sanzen-cho.

lines.content: ……持ち出した懐中時計は“魔法”なのだ。
lines.translated: The pocket watch I brought with me is "magic."
*If I set the time and date, I can change the time and date of the memories sleeping in the "Realm of the Night."*

lines.content: たとえば五月のいつの日かに合わせれば、過去や未来に起きたその日の[出来事|時間]を読むことができる――普段はそうできないけれど、今のわたしにはそうできる。
lines.translated: For example, if I set it to some day in May, I can read the time and events of that day from the past or the future--normally I couldn't do such a thing, but the me right now can.

lines.content: 今は、四月
lines.translated: "Right now, it's April."

lines.content: 春。
lines.translated: Spring.

lines.content: さくら咲く季節。
lines.translated: The season of blooming cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 同じ[とき|季節]。同じ月。同じ日を、きみは、この町でどういうふうに過ごしていただろう。
