lines.translated: The same season. The same month. How did you spend this very same day in this town?

lines.content: そこにわたしの知らないきみがいるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is there a side of you there that I don't know?

lines.content: そこにきみの悲しみが、ひっそりと隠されているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is your sorrow quietly hidden away there?

lines.content: 誰にも知られず、誰にも言えず、たったひとりで……きみは、泣いていたりしたのかな……
lines.translated: "Without anyone knowing, without being able to tell anyone, all by yourself... were you crying...?"

lines.content: わたしは、わたしの知らないきみのことを探して歩いた。
lines.translated: I walked on, searching for the you I didn't know.

lines.content: その時間の中に“希望”があるのだと、信じて。
lines.translated: Believing that there was "hope" within that time.

lines.content: たっ、
lines.translated: *Tap.*

lines.content: ……と、地面を蹴る軽やかな音がした。
lines.translated: There was the light sound of someone kicking off the ground.

lines.content: 誰かが肩を掠めるようにして、わたしを追い抜いていった。
lines.translated: Someone brushed past my shoulder, overtaking me.

lines.content: その背中は……。
lines.translated: That back...

lines.content: 今日と同じ日付のいつかの春の日……。
lines.translated: On a spring day from sometime in the past, sharing the exact same date as today...

lines.content: その日わたしは――記憶の中のわたしは、この大通りをどこかへ向かい、駆け抜けていた。
lines.translated: On that day, I--the me inside the memory--was dashing down this main street, heading somewhere.

lines.content: ……追いかける。
lines.translated: I chased after her.

lines.content: いつかのわたしが向かう先には、何が、あったっけ。
lines.translated: What was waiting ahead of the me from back then, again?

lines.content: 思い出せないけれど……。
lines.translated: I can't remember, though...

lines.content: でもとても大切なものがあったはず。
lines.translated: But it must have been something very important.

lines.content: だって、軽やかに走るいつかのわたしの背中は、耳も尻尾も、うれしそうに揺れている。
lines.translated: Because as my past self runs lightly along, from behind, both her ears and tail are swaying happily.

lines.content: きっと大雅に関するうれしいことだ。
lines.translated: It must be something happy involving Taiga.

lines.content: そうじゃないと、[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]わたしが笑顔になるなんて、そんなの、考えられなくて……。
lines.translated: Otherwise, I couldn't possibly imagine myself smiling *like that*...

lines.content: ああ、そっか
lines.translated: "Ah, that's right."

lines.content: 思い出した。
lines.translated: I remembered.

lines.content: 四月。さくら咲く春の季節。
lines.translated: April. The spring season of blooming cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 懐中時計をもう一度確認し、間違いないとわかる。
lines.translated: Checking the pocket watch once more, I knew there was no mistake.

lines.content: 今日は……
lines.translated: "Today is..."

lines.content: とても、とても大切な日じゃないか。
lines.translated: Isn't it a very, very important day?

lines.content: 今日は大雅の、お誕生日だ
lines.translated: "Today is Taiga's birthday."

lines.content: 奏大雅のふりをしていても、生まれた日は偽らずに本当だ。いつだったか、大雅は、わたしにそう教えてくれていた。
lines.translated: Even if he was pretending to be Kanade Taiga, the day he was born was the unfeigned truth. At some point, Taiga had told me that.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: 色々なことがありすぎて、ほんとは忘れちゃだめなことなのに――すっかり、忘れてしまってた。
lines.translated: So many things had happened, and even though it was something I really shouldn't forget--I had completely forgotten.

lines.content: いつかのわたしがたどり着いたのは丘の上。
lines.translated: The place my past self arrived at was the top of the hill.

lines.content: あのときのわたしは、さくらの樹の隣に寄り添うようにして立ち、町のきらめきを見つめていた。
lines.translated: Back then, I stood nestled beside the cherry blossom tree, gazing out at the sparkling lights of the town.

lines.content: 眩しそうに目を細め、何かを決意したみたいに小さくうなずく――……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Narrowing her eyes as if dazzled, she gave a small nod as though she had made up her mind about something--...ah, that's right.

lines.content: あのときのわたしは受け止めたんだ。
lines.translated: Back then, I had accepted it.

lines.content: もし柊ハルがわたしのお願いどおり、この町に帰ってきてくれたなら……。
lines.translated: If Hiiragi Haru returned to this town just as I had wished for...

lines.content: わたしは、ふたりの幸せを応援しよう。そういう自分の“役割”を、人生を、受け入れた。
lines.translated: Then I would root for the two of them to be happy. I had accepted that "role," that life, for myself.

lines.content: ……だから[・|あ][・|あ][・|し][・|て]、わたしが大雅のお誕生日をお祝いできるのは最初で、最後だったんだ
lines.translated: "...So celebrating Taiga's birthday *like that* was going to be the first, and the last time for me."

lines.content: そういうふうに具体的な言葉にはしなくとも、あのときのわたしは心のどこかでそう感じていただろうはず。
lines.translated: Even if I didn't put it into concrete words like that, the me back then must have felt it somewhere deep in my heart.

lines.content: 今になってわたしは、あのときの自分の気持ちに気づいた――あの頃よりも少し、賢くなったわたしだから、わかることも少し増えたのだ。
lines.translated: Only now did I realize my own feelings from that time--because I've grown a little wiser than I was back then, there are a few more things I can understand now.

lines.content: でも、何も知らないあの頃のわたしは……。
lines.translated: Even so, my past self, who knew nothing...

lines.content: 地面に小さな紙を直接置いて、そこにペンで何か書き付けようとしてる。
lines.translated: She placed a small piece of paper directly on the ground, trying to write something on it with a pen.

lines.content: 背中を丸めて。
lines.translated: Hunching her back.

lines.content: 顔を、紙面にくっつけんばかりに近づけて……必死になって。
lines.translated: Pressing her face so close it practically touched the paper... trying with all her might.

lines.content: 『……あまいの……にがいの……ど、どれでも……』
lines.translated: "'...Sweet... bitter... w-whichever you like...'"

lines.content: たどたどしくつぶやきながら、一生懸命、覚えたてのひらがなを書き付けようとしていた。
lines.translated: Muttering haltingly, she was trying as hard as she could to write down the hiragana she had only just learned.

lines.content: だめだよ。そんなふうにしても、ちゃんと書けない
lines.translated: "No, don't do that. You won't be able to write properly like that."

lines.content: 思わず声を掛けた。
lines.translated: I called out to her without thinking.

lines.content: けれどそこにいるのは過去のわたしだ。その記憶でしかない。
lines.translated: However, the one there was my past self. Nothing more than a memory.

lines.content: もちろん、この声が届くわけもない――力任せに押しつけたペン先は、いくつも紙を破いてた。
lines.translated: Naturally, there was no way my voice could reach her--the tip of the pen, pressed down with brute force, had torn through sheet after sheet of paper.

lines.content: 『……上手に書けない』
lines.translated: "'...I can't write it well.'"

lines.content: あの頃のわたしがつぶやいている。
lines.translated: My past self muttered.

lines.content: 当然だ。
lines.translated: Well, of course.

lines.content: もっとちゃんとした場所で書かないと……。
lines.translated: You have to write on a more proper surface...

lines.content: 今ならそうわかるけど、あの頃の[・|足][・|り][・|な][・|い]わたしは何度も、何度もやり直すけど……、
lines.translated: I know that now, and though my *clueless* past self tried over and over again...
"'...*Sniffle*.'"

lines.content: ついには泣き出し、ぐじぐじと鼻を啜っては涙を拭った。用意した紙も残り少ない。
lines.translated: Finally, she burst into tears, sniffling wetly and wiping them away. There were only a few sheets left of the paper she had prepared.

lines.content: 『大雅……うう……上手にできない。どうしよう……きみに、おめでとうってしたいのに……』
lines.translated: "'Taiga... ugh... I can't do it well. What do I do... I just want to tell you happy birthday...'"

lines.content: 耳も尻尾も元気なくしおれてる。
lines.translated: Both her ears and her tail were drooping lifelessly.

lines.content: うう。
lines.translated: Ugh.

lines.content: 恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: How embarrassing.

lines.content: ……こんなとこ、絶対大雅に見せられないよ
lines.translated: "...I could never let Taiga see me like this."

lines.content: [・|今]のわたしも別の意味で泣きそうになっている。
lines.translated: The *present* me was on the verge of tears in a completely different way.

lines.content: ……さみしがり屋なのと同じくらい見栄っ張りなわたしだ。
lines.translated: I'm just as vain as I am easily lonely.

lines.content: 大雅にこんなの、見られなくてよかった。心からほっとする。
lines.translated: I'm so glad Taiga didn't see me like that. It's a genuine relief from the bottom of my heart.

lines.content: やっと書けたらしい小さくて短い手紙を掲げ、
lines.translated: Holding up the small, short letter she had apparently managed to write at last,

lines.content: 『あまいの。苦いの。ちょっと、苦いの。どれでもどうぞ』
lines.translated: "'Sweet. Bitter. A little bitter. Have whichever you like.'"

lines.content: 下手くそな字を、あのときのわたしは満足げに――得意げにうなずきながら、読み上げている。
lines.translated: My past self read the clumsy handwriting aloud, nodding with satisfaction--and pride.

lines.content: 『……ちゃんと、気づいてくれるかな。行き過ぎちゃったりしないよね？』
lines.translated: "'...I wonder if he'll notice it properly. He won't just walk right past it, right?'"

lines.content: そして今度は、書いた手紙をどこに置こうか。
lines.translated: And next was figuring out where to put the letter she had written.

lines.content: 施設から出てきた大雅が、手紙にちゃんと気づいてくれる位置はどこだろう……。
lines.translated: Where was the best spot so Taiga would be sure to notice the letter when he came out of the orphanage...?

lines.content: わたしはいっぱい悩んでた。
lines.translated: I had agonized over it so much.

lines.content: 手渡しできればそれが一番。
lines.translated: Handing it to him directly would have been best.

lines.content: でも、たったそれだけのことなのに、なんだか上手にできる自分を想像することもできなかった。
lines.translated: Even though it was such a simple thing, for some reason, I couldn't even imagine myself pulling it off well.

lines.content: 『……うん。ここで、いいよね。大丈夫』
lines.translated: "'...Yeah. Right here should be good. This'll work.'"

lines.content: どうやら位置は決まったらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, she had decided on a spot.

lines.content: あとは風で飛ばされたりしないよう、あまいのと苦いの、ちょっと苦いの――手紙の上にプレゼントのチョコレートを三つ、重し代わりに置いて完成だ。
lines.translated: All that was left was to place the three gift chocolates--sweet, bitter, and a little bitter--on top of the letter as paperweights so the wind wouldn't blow it away, and it was complete.

lines.content: いつかのわたしは木の後ろに隠れ、大雅のことをそわそわしながら待っている。
lines.translated: My past self hid behind the tree, fidgeting restlessly as she waited for Taiga.

lines.content: 大雅……よろこんでくれるかな。はじめて書いた手紙だけれど、上手に書けたってほめてほしいな。
lines.translated: Will Taiga... be happy? It's the first letter I've ever written, so I hope he praises me for doing a good job.

lines.content: そんな声にならない気持ちまで、[・|今]のわたしにこうして全部読まれているなんて――もちろん、あのときのわたしは気づかない。
lines.translated: My past self had no idea, of course, that even those unspoken feelings were being read so completely by the *present* me.
*I love you.*

lines.content: そんな気持ちが、今のわたしにふと届いた。
lines.translated: That feeling suddenly reached the present me.

lines.content: 『大好きだよ……大雅』
lines.translated: "'I love you... Taiga.'"

lines.content: ほんとはプレゼントと一緒に渡したい言葉だった。でも……。
lines.translated: Truly, those were the words I had wanted to give him along with the present. But...

lines.content: 『この世界に産まれてきてくれて、本当に。本当に、ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'Thank you so much... truly, thank you for being born into this world.'"

lines.content: でも、そのときのわたしには[・|全][・|部]言えなかった。
lines.translated: But back then, I couldn't say *all* of it.

lines.content: 言ってはだめだと思ってた。
lines.translated: I thought I wasn't allowed to say it.

lines.content: だってハルが大雅と会うため、この町に帰ってきてくれるかもしれない――大雅の心にあたらしい“夢”を、連れてきてくれるかもしれないんだ。
lines.translated: Because Haru might come back to this town to see Taiga--she might bring a new "dream" to Taiga's heart.

lines.content: だからわたしがそんなこと、言っていいはずはない――こんなわたしが、そんなことを思ってさえもいけないはずなんだ。
lines.translated: So there was no way I had the right to say something like that--someone like me shouldn't even be allowed to think it.

lines.content: ずきりと胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: A sharp pain throbbed in my chest.

lines.content: その痛みは、あのときも、今も、同じだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think that pain is probably the same now as it was back then.

lines.content: 色々などきどきがわたしの胸で暴れてた。
lines.translated: All sorts of pounding emotions were thrashing around in my chest.

lines.content: 大雅が、施設から出てきた。
lines.translated: Taiga came out of the orphanage.

lines.content: その姿を見つけた途端、いつかのわたしはぱーっと、笑顔になった。尻尾も耳もぴんと立つ。
lines.translated: The moment she spotted him, my past self's face lit up with a beaming smile. Both her tail and her ears perked right up.

lines.content: さっきまで難しい顔をしたりしゅんとしたりしていたのが嘘みたいだ。
lines.translated: It was hard to believe she had been making such a troubled face and moping around just moments ago.

lines.content: ……ううう。こんな顔、してたなんて。わたし、知らなかった。……恥ずかしい。ばかみたい
lines.translated: "...Ugh. I had no idea I was making a face like that. ...How embarrassing. I look so stupid."

lines.content: 大雅は、手紙に気づいた。
lines.translated: Taiga noticed the letter.

lines.content: わたしの字を見て大雅は微笑んでくれる。
lines.translated: Looking at my handwriting, Taiga smiled.

lines.content: プレゼントのチョコレートも美味しそうに食べてくれていた。
lines.translated: He even ate the gift chocolates like they were delicious.

lines.content: その様子を、さくらの木の影からわたしは見てた。
lines.translated: I watched him from the shadow of the cherry blossom tree.

lines.content: 『クロも一緒に食べよう』
lines.translated: "'Let's eat them together, Kuro.'"

lines.content: そう言ってくれた大雅に、あのときのわたしは首を振り――……
lines.translated: When Taiga said that to her, my past self shook her head--...

lines.content: 大雅が背をつけ、腰を下ろしたさくらの木に、わたしは手を添えた。
lines.translated: I placed my hand against the cherry blossom tree where Taiga had leaned his back and sat down.

lines.content: 『……わたしには、[・|う][・|そ][・|つ][・|き]な、わたしなんかには。こんなこと言える権利なんて、ないけど。心配なんだ。凄く、すごく』
lines.translated: "'...I don't... someone like me, a *liar* like me, has no right to say something like this, but... I'm worried. Really, really worried.'"

lines.content: そんなことをかっこつけて言いながら、でも、心の中ではまったく違うことを考えている。
lines.translated: While she was trying to act cool saying things like that, inside her heart, she was thinking about something completely different.

lines.content: ここがいいかな。
lines.translated: Is right here good?

lines.content: こうがいいかな。
lines.translated: Is this pose good?

lines.content: （ううん。こうしたほうが格好良く見えるかな。……大雅に、ちょっとはかわいく映るかな）
lines.translated: (No. Maybe standing like this makes me look cooler. ...I wonder if I look at least a little cute to Taiga.)

lines.content: 立ち位置を色々悩んで見たりして……。
lines.translated: Fretting over all sorts of places to stand and testing them out...

lines.content: う、うう
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: そんないつかの自分を見るのは、とても、とても恥ずかしくって――
lines.translated: Watching my past self do that was so, so embarrassing--

lines.content: ……死んじゃいそう
lines.translated: "...I think I'm gonna die."

lines.content: 思わず顔を覆ってしまいそうになる。
lines.translated: I almost buried my face in my hands without thinking.

lines.content: お、おかしいな。
lines.translated: Th-That's strange.

lines.content: ……おかしいよ
lines.translated: "...That's strange."

lines.content: だってわたし、このとき、もっと自分は格好良く、ひとりで静かに町を眺めながら……大雅のこと、待ってたように思ったけど。
lines.translated: Because I remembered waiting for Taiga back then looking much cooler, quietly gazing out at the town all by myself...

lines.content: 手紙だってもっとすんなり書けてた気がしてた。
lines.translated: I even felt like I had written the letter much more smoothly.

lines.content: こうして端から見てると全然そんなことなくて。
lines.translated: Watching it from the sidelines like this, that wasn't the case at all.

lines.content: ちょっと、ううん……かなり、間抜けだ。恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: It's a little, no... pretty goofy. How embarrassing.

lines.content: ……わたし、大雅のことを知りたいと思ってたのに
lines.translated: "...Even though I wanted to learn about Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅の“悪夢”や“希望”だ。
lines.translated: Taiga's "nightmares" and "hopes."

lines.content: その場所を知ろうとしていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: I was supposed to be trying to find where they were...

lines.content: それなのにこうして、自分の恥ずかしい奴っぷりを改めて知らされて、いったい、何になるのかな。
lines.translated: And yet, being made to realize all over again what an embarrassing person I am like this--what good does that even do?

lines.content: 自分が情けなくて泣けてきた。
lines.translated: I felt so pathetic it made me want to cry.

lines.content: 鼻を啜って[まぶた|瞼]を擦る。
lines.translated: Sniffling, I rubbed my eyelids.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 『……ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'...Thank you.'"

lines.content: 『きみがこの世界に生まれてきてくれて、本当に、よかった』
lines.translated: "'I'm really, truly glad that you were born into this world.'"

lines.content: あのときのわたしが練習どおり、ほんとはいっぱいどきどきしながら大雅に言って、
lines.translated: My past self said that to Taiga just like she practiced, though her heart was actually pounding like crazy.

lines.content: 『……次はチョコよりもいいプレゼントが、できますように』
lines.translated: "'...I hope I can get you an even better present than chocolate next time.'"

lines.content: 『また来年も。無事に、大雅がこの日を迎えられますように』
lines.translated: "'And next year, too. I hope you can safely welcome this day again, Taiga.'"

lines.content: 真っ赤な顔を大雅にだけは見られたくなくて、走り出す。
lines.translated: Not wanting Taiga, of all people, to see her bright red face, she took off running.

lines.content: 『……やった、やったよ……ちゃんと、言えたよ……っ』
lines.translated: "'...I did it, I did it... I actually said it...!'"

lines.content: [・|全][・|部][・|じ][・|ゃ][・|な][・|い][・|け][・|ど]がんばれた自分がうれしくてしかたない――そんな顔したわたしが、走って行ってしまったとき。
lines.translated: She hadn't said *everything*, but she couldn't help being thrilled with herself for doing her best--and right when my past self ran off with that look on her face...

lines.content: 残された大雅が――男の子が、ほんの一瞬、笑顔をなくしたことに[・|今]のわたしは、気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: The *present* me noticed that Taiga, left behind--that boy--lost his smile for just a split second.

lines.content: 少しだ。
lines.translated: Just a little.

lines.content: ほんの少し、大雅は町の風景に目を細め――そして笑顔を、取り戻す。奏大雅としての笑顔をだ。
lines.translated: Ever so slightly, Taiga narrowed his eyes at the townscape--and then took back his smile. His smile as Kanade Taiga.
*Ah, this is it.*

lines.content: と、唐突に、わかった。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I understood.

lines.content: 今、きみの心を、“夜”を通じて読んだわたしは知ってしまった。
lines.translated: Having read your heart through the "Night" just now, I came to know the truth.
*At this very moment, the Taiga of that day made up his mind*--to become the "King of the Night" and save Mashiro. The truth was, he was a little scared.

lines.content: でも、その怖さを越えられるだけの“勇気”を、この日、大雅は得られた。
lines.translated: But on this day, Taiga gained the "courage" needed to overcome that fear.

lines.content: 『自由だあああああああああああああ！』
lines.translated: "'I'm freeeeeeeeeeeeeee!'"

lines.content: その叫びは宣戦布告だったのだ。
lines.translated: That shout was a declaration of war.

lines.content: 今を戦い。
lines.translated: To fight in the present.

lines.content: 過去に負けず。
lines.translated: To not lose to the past.

lines.content: 未来に、勝つための。
lines.translated: To win against the future.

lines.content: そしてあの子を――ましろを、取り戻す。
lines.translated: And to take back that girl--Mashiro.

lines.content: そのための決意表明。
lines.translated: A declaration of his resolve for that sake.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: きみが力いっぱい、叫んだ[・|本][・|当][・|の][・|理][・|由][・|が][・|も][・|う][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ]あることを、わたしは知った。
lines.translated: I learned that *there was one more true reason* why you shouted with all your might.

lines.content: 自由なんて。
lines.translated: Freedom.

lines.content: そんなもの、本当はありえないこれからの自分の人生に、少しの諦めと、だけどそれ以上の“希望”を大雅はこの日、その心に得られたからなのだと――……
lines.translated: For the life ahead of him, where such a thing was truly impossible, Taiga had gained a little bit of resignation, and yet an even greater "hope" in his heart on this day--...

lines.content: 大雅は何かを振り払うみたいにして、力いっぱい、駆け出していった。
lines.translated: As if shaking something off, Taiga broke into a run with all his might.

lines.content: その背中を今のわたしはじっと見送り……、
lines.translated: The present me stared after his retreating back, seeing him off...

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ため息が。
lines.translated: A sigh escaped me.

lines.content: わたしは……、
見つけた……
lines.translated: "I found it..."

lines.content: ……探し、求めていた以上の“希望”を、見つけてしまったんだ。
lines.translated: I had found a "hope" even greater than what I had been searching and wishing for.
That day--

lines.content: わたしが、大雅のお誕生日を祝った最初で最後の、あの日の中に[・|そ][・|れ]はあった。
lines.translated: *It* was right there inside that day, the first and last time I celebrated Taiga's birthday.

lines.content: ……う、ううう
わたしは両手で顔を覆い、しゃがみ込む――悲しいわけじゃない。
lines.translated: Covering my face with both hands, I crouched down--it wasn't that I was sad.

lines.content: さみしいわけでも、つらいわけでもない。
lines.translated: It wasn't that I was lonely, or in pain, either.

lines.content: それなのに涙が溢れた。
lines.translated: And yet, tears overflowed.

lines.content: 『……ぼくなんて』
lines.translated: "'...Someone like me...'"

lines.content: ――あの子の声が“夜”の底に響いてる。
lines.translated: --That boy's voice was echoing at the bottom of the "Night."

lines.content: 『……ぼくなんて、生まれてこなければよかった』
lines.translated: "'...Someone like me shouldn't have been born.'"

lines.content: それはあの子の“[絶望|悪夢]”だった。
lines.translated: That was his "nightmare."

lines.content: そんな心を誰にも知られず隠していたあの子に、この日のわたしは、言ったのだ。
lines.translated: To that boy, who had hidden such a heart without letting anyone know, the me of that day had said:

lines.content: 『……ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'...Thank you.'"

lines.content: きみの気持ちも知らないわたしは、澄ました顔で――でも、いっぱいどきどきしながら、言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Unaware of how you felt, I said those words with a composed face--even though my heart was pounding like crazy.

lines.content: 『きみがこの世界に生まれてきてくれて、本当に、よかった』
lines.translated: "'I'm really, truly glad that you were born into this world.'"

lines.content: 瞬間。
lines.translated: In that instant.

lines.content: あの子の胸は、いっぱいに、なる。
lines.translated: That boy's heart was filled to the brim.

lines.content: ……“人の心はそれまで投げかけられた言葉の色でできている”
lines.translated: 'A person's heart is made up of the colors of the words that have been spoken to them.'

lines.content: それがあの子の世界だった。
lines.translated: That was his world.

lines.content: 『……俺は。ぼくは、生まれてこなければよかった。その思いは変わらないけど……。でも』
lines.translated: "'...I... I shouldn't have been born. That feeling hasn't changed... But...'"

lines.content: でも君だけは、ぼくが生まれてよかったと言ってくれる――生まれてきてくれて、ありがとうって、言ってくれる。
lines.translated: *But you're the only one who tells me you're glad I was born--who tells me thank you for being born.*

lines.content: 熱い……。
lines.translated: It's warm...

lines.content: こうして見つめるあのときの大雅の心から、言葉以上に熱い何かが、わたしの胸に流れ込んでくる。
lines.translated: From Taiga's heart back then, which I was gazing into right now, something warmer than words flowed into my chest.

lines.content: 『……クロ。君だけはいつもぼくのそばにいてくれる』
lines.translated: "'...Kuro. You're the only one who's always by my side.'"

lines.content: 『君だけは、この先何が起きてもぼくの、味方でいてくれる――これからぼくが思い、描いた通りに、世界中の誰もがぼくを憎んでも』
lines.translated: "'You're the only one who'll stay on my side no matter what happens from here on out--even if everyone in the world comes to hate me, just as I've pictured and planned.'"

lines.content: 君だけはぼくを憎く思わないでいてくれる……。
lines.translated: *You're the only one who won't hate me...*

lines.content: そういうふうにはならなくとも、そうであったらいいなと、思えたから……。
lines.translated: *Even if things didn't turn out that way, I was able to wish that they would...*

lines.content: だから大雅は、ましろを、奏大雅を救い出すための最初の一歩を踏み出した――[・|踏][・|み][・|出][・|せ][・|た]と、感じてた。
lines.translated: That was why Taiga took the first step toward saving Mashiro, toward saving Kanade Taiga--he felt like he *was able to take that step*.

lines.content: 大雅の踏み出したその先には、もはや“絶望”しかないとわかっているのに……。
lines.translated: Even though he knew that nothing but "despair" lay ahead of the step he had taken...

lines.content: あのとき大雅が叫んだ本当の理由は、今にもこぼれそうになった涙を誤魔化すためだ。
lines.translated: The real reason Taiga shouted back then was to hide the tears that were about to spill over at any moment.

lines.content: そんなきみの“心”を、知ってしまって……。
lines.translated: Coming to know that "heart" of yours...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: だめ……。
lines.translated: No good...

lines.content: 涙があふれた。
lines.translated: My tears overflowed.

lines.content: わたしで、いいの……？
lines.translated: "Is it really okay... that it was me?"

lines.content: 他の誰かじゃなくて……。
lines.translated: Not someone else...

lines.content: ハルみたいに、かわいくないし……人間でもない
lines.translated: "I'm not cute like Haru... and I'm not even human."

lines.content: 拗ねたことを言うみたいで、嫌だけど……。
lines.translated: I hated that I sounded like I was sulking, but...

lines.content: こんなわたしなんかで……ほんとうに、よかったの？
lines.translated: "Was someone like me... really good enough?"

lines.content: わたしはきみと同じ時間を生きていける人間に、憧れてばかりいたただの子猫だ。
lines.translated: I'm just a kitten who did nothing but yearn to be a human who could live through the same time as you.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: こんなわたしの、できそこないなきみへの気持ちでも――“想い”でも、いいの……？
lines.translated: "Even with these flawed feelings I have for you--these 'emotions' of mine, is it really okay...?"

lines.content: 結果としてあの子は“夜の王”になってしまったけれど。
lines.translated: In the end, that boy ended up becoming the "King of the Night."

lines.content: ……結果として、[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き][・|芽][・|生][・|え][・|た]“[・|勇][・|気]”[・|を]、自分の“夢”を叶えるために使ってしまったのだろうけど。
lines.translated: In the end, he probably used *the "courage" that blossomed back then* to fulfill his own "dream."

lines.content: ……わたしはあのとき、きみに、“勇気”を……“希望”を、あげられてたの？
lines.translated: "...Back then, was I able to give you 'courage'... to give you 'hope'?"

lines.content: ふっと脳裏に浮かんだあの子の笑顔が、わたしの問いかけに答えてくれたような気がした。
lines.translated: That boy's smiling face suddenly floated into my mind, and I felt as though it had answered my question.

lines.content: ……“人の心はそれまで投げかけられた言葉の色でできている”
lines.translated: 'A person's heart is made up of the colors of the words that have been spoken to them.'

lines.content: “夜”を通して流れ込んできたきみの気持ちで、胸が、痛い。
lines.translated: My chest ached with your feelings that had flowed into me through the "Night."

lines.content: 苦しい――……熱いよ
lines.translated: "It hurts--...It burns."

lines.content: 力いっぱい胸を抑えてしゃがみ込む。
lines.translated: Clutching my chest with all my might, I crouched down.

lines.content: わたしの言葉が、いつもきみの心の真ん中に、まるでお守りみたいにして在ったのだ。
lines.translated: My words had always been right there in the very center of your heart, just like a good luck charm.

lines.content: そんな“心”が熱くて、痛い。
lines.translated: That "heart" burned so hot, it hurt.

lines.content: ……届けなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to deliver them."

lines.content: わたしは立ち上がり、前を見る。
lines.translated: I stood up and looked ahead.

lines.content: あのとき言った言葉と共に、[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き][・|全][・|部][・|言][・|え][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た]言葉の続きを、きみに、伝えなきゃ――……ああ、ああ、うそみたい。
lines.translated: Along with the words I said back then, I have to tell you the rest of the words *I couldn't say all of back then*--...Ah, ah, it seems unreal.

lines.content: わたしは影でこっそり、きみの幸せを守れる自分であれればそれでよかった。充分だった。
lines.translated: I was fine as long as I could secretly protect your happiness from the shadows. That was plenty for me.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: わたしなんかの言葉が、大雅……きみのためになってたなんて
lines.translated: "To think that words from someone like me, Taiga... were actually helping you."

lines.content: 自分の“想い”が、大切に想う人を勇気づけることができてたなんて。
lines.translated: To think that my own "feelings" were able to give courage to the person I cherished so much.

lines.content: すごい。
lines.translated: It's amazing.

lines.content: うそみたい。
lines.translated: It seems unreal.

lines.content: わたしも……。
わたしも、同じだ。
lines.translated: I'm the same.
*The same as Taiga*.

lines.content: ……わたし、生まれてこれてよかった
lines.translated: "...I'm glad I was born."

lines.content: ……ようやく、そう思えた。
lines.translated: Finally, I was able to feel that way.

lines.content: ……だってわたしは、きみを、救い出せるかもしれない。“夜”の底から
lines.translated: "...Because I might be able to save you. From the bottom of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: [・|も][・|し][・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]、恥ずかしがらず勇気を出して、きみに気持ちを全部伝えられてたら……。
lines.translated: *If back then*, I hadn't gotten embarrassed, and had mustered up my courage to tell you all of my feelings...

lines.content: どうかな。
lines.translated: I wonder.

lines.content: わたしの言葉で、きみの世界は変わっていただろうか。
lines.translated: Would your world have changed because of my words?

lines.content: きみの歩んだ[人生|物語]の結末は、こんなふうにはなっていなかっただろうか。
lines.translated: Would the ending of the story of your life you walked have turned out differently than this?

lines.content: そういうふうに考えてしまうのは、自意識過剰で……それこそ恥ずべきことなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is thinking that way just me being overly self-conscious... and something I should be ashamed of after all?

lines.content: なんであれ“希望”を見つけた。
lines.translated: Whatever the case, I found "hope."

lines.content: ……伝えなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to tell you."

lines.content: あのとき伝えられなかった言葉を、きみに、届けに行かなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to go and deliver the words I couldn't tell you back then.

lines.content: もしかしたらきみは、“夜の王”から元の姿へ戻ってくれるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe then, you'll turn back from the "King of the Night" to the way you used to be.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: そうは簡単にいかないだろう。
lines.translated: It probably won't go that easily.

lines.content: でも、予感はあった。
lines.translated: Still, I had a feeling.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]で何かが変わるはず。
lines.translated: *This* should change something.

lines.content: 何度だって、思う。言葉にする。
lines.translated: I'll think it and put it into words as many times as it takes.

lines.content: 完全にとはいかなくとも――わたしは、あの子の心を救えるのかもしれない
lines.translated: "Even if I can't do it completely--maybe I can save that boy's heart."

lines.content: すごい。
lines.translated: It's amazing.

lines.content: ……すごいよ。
lines.translated: It's amazing.

lines.content: なんだか途端、世界がきらきら輝いているように見えた。
lines.translated: All of a sudden, the world seemed to be sparkling and shining.

lines.content: わたしは[きみ|人]の心がわからない。
lines.translated: I don't understand the human heart--your heart.

lines.content: でも、幸せって言葉の意味が今、少し――ほんの少しだけ、理解できた気がした。
lines.translated: Even so, I felt like I finally understood the meaning of the word "happiness" a little--just a tiny bit, right now.

lines.content: 行かなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to go.

lines.content: “わたし。きみのことが、大好きだよ”
lines.translated: "I really, really love you."

lines.content: ……それが、言えなかったあのときの言葉の続き。
lines.translated: That was the rest of the words I couldn't say back then.

lines.content: それできみを救えるかもなんて思うのは、恥ずかしいことなのかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Thinking I might be able to save you with that might be something to be embarrassed about, though...

lines.content: きみにわたしの全部を届けなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to deliver all of myself to you.

lines.content: まずわたしは、過去の奏大雅に電話をかけた。
lines.translated: First, I called the Kanade Taiga of the past on the phone.

lines.content: ……見つけた
lines.translated: Found one.

lines.content: 見つけたよ。探してたもの、見つけられた。……もしもし？　聞こえてる？　あの子の“希望”を、見つけられたよ
lines.translated: "I found it. I managed to find what I was looking for. ...Hello? Can you hear me? I found that boy's 'hope.'"

lines.content: 電話は一層濃いノイズに阻まれ、途中で切れた――きっと時間はもうあまりないのだろうと感じた。
lines.translated: Blocked by even thicker static, the call cut off midway through--I could tell that there probably wasn't much time left anymore.

lines.content: でも、今のわたしなら大丈夫。
lines.translated: Still, as I am right now, I'll be fine.
*I don't care what I might lose*.

lines.content: たとえどんな場所だろうと、どこへでもきみの元へ走って行ける――
lines.translated: No matter what kind of place it might be, I can run to your side anywhere--

lines.content: でも。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ……こんなときに。
lines.translated: At a time like this.

lines.content: すぐにでも走り出そうとした足を、だけどわたしは動かせないでいた――……真っ暗だ。
lines.translated: My legs were about to break into a run at any second, and yet I couldn't move them--...It was pitch black.

lines.content: 目の前が一瞬で、真っ暗闇に染まってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: In an instant, everything before my eyes had been dyed in pitch-black darkness.

lines.content: ……“夜”に記録されていたいつかの春。
lines.translated: A certain spring recorded within the "Night."

lines.content: その記憶の中から外へ出たせいではない。
lines.translated: It wasn't because I had stepped outside of that memory.

lines.content: ひやりと、した。
lines.translated: A cold chill ran through me.
*Something was standing behind me*.

lines.content: 『……うそつき』
それはとても冷たい声だった。
lines.translated: It was a freezing cold voice.

lines.content: 『[・|わ][・|た][・|し]は大雅にうそばかり言ってる』
lines.translated: "'*I* do nothing but tell lies to Taiga.'"

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: すると、そこには一匹の黒猫がいた。
lines.translated: Turning around, I saw a single black cat there.

lines.content: 細めたふたつの瞳で、わたしを冷たく、睨み付けている――……この子は、
lines.translated: With its two narrowed eyes, it was glaring coldly at me--...This cat is...

lines.content: 『……生まれてきてよかった、だなんて。どの口で言ってるの。わたしも、生まれて来ちゃだめな命だった。大雅と同じだ』
lines.translated: "'...Saying you're glad you were born. How dare you say that? I was a life that never should have been born, too. Just like Taiga.'"

lines.content: この猫は、わたしだ。
lines.translated: This cat is me.

lines.content: わたしの“悪夢”だ――……いつもわたしの“心”を冷たく突き刺す暗闇だ。
lines.translated: It's my "nightmare"--...the darkness that always pierces my "heart" with an icy chill.

lines.content: “夜”の中で“希望”を得たのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I had gained "hope" within the "Night"...

lines.content: いつも胸の中にいる“悪夢”もまた、“夜”の中で形を得ていた――こんな、最悪なタイミングで。
lines.translated: The "nightmare" that was always inside my chest had also taken form within the "Night"--at the absolute worst possible timing like this.

lines.content: “悪夢”はわたしに語りかける。
lines.translated: The "nightmare" spoke to me.

lines.content: 『だって、そうでしょう？　わたしは、自分が大雅に、あの子に対して何をしたのか――もしかして忘れてしまったわけじゃ、ないよね』
lines.translated: "'Because that's the truth, isn't it? What I did to Taiga, to that boy--don't tell me you've forgotten.'"

lines.content: ……さっきまで暖かかった心の温度が一瞬で、絶対零度のような冷たさに変わる。
lines.translated: The temperature of my heart, which had been so warm until just a moment ago, instantly turned as freezing cold as absolute zero.

lines.content: 『だめだよ。……だめ』
lines.translated: "'No good. ...It's no good.'"

lines.content: 全然だめだよと、黒猫は首を振る。
lines.translated: It's no good at all, the black cat said, shaking its head.

lines.content: 『あの子の“不幸”を全部自分が受け止める。あの子の笑顔のために、自分は孤独になってでも……ひとりぼっちになってでも、構わない』
lines.translated: "'I'll take on all of that boy's 'misfortune' myself. For the sake of his smile, I don't care if I become lonely... even if I end up all alone.'"

lines.content: 『だからあの子のためならば、九つあった命をすべて差し出す――そのための覚悟と勇気をわたしは決めた』
lines.translated: "'So if it's for his sake, I'll offer up all nine of my lives--I made up my mind with the resolve and courage to do that.'"

lines.content: それが、どうしたの？
lines.translated: So what?

lines.content: と、子猫は言う。
lines.translated: The kitten said.

lines.content: 『[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]くらいで、罪滅ぼししたつもりになってるの？』
lines.translated: "'Do you really think *something like that* is enough to atone for your sins?'"

lines.content: ねえどうなのと“[わたし|悪夢]”が言う。ねえ、ほんとに忘れてしまったの？　と。
lines.translated: Well, what do you think? the "nightmare"--me--said. Hey, have you really forgotten?

lines.content: 『そう……。忘れてしまったのなら思い出さなきゃだめだよね。自分の罪を。自分の、邪悪さを』
lines.translated: "'Right... If you've forgotten, then you have to remember. Your sin. Your own wickedness.'"

lines.content: 『何度わたしが忘れてしまっても、このわたしがいつもきみの中で、何度だって、そうしてあげよう』
lines.translated: "'No matter how many times I forget, this me inside of you will always make you remember, over and over again.'"

lines.content: いい？
lines.translated: Understand?

lines.content: きみは。
lines.translated: You...

lines.content: ……わたしは。
幸せになんてなっちゃだめなんだよ――ほんの一瞬たりとも。
lines.translated: must never become happy--not even for a single moment.

lines.content: 『だってね？　わたしがいたから、あの子は、あんなふうに不幸になってしまったんだから』
lines.translated: "'Because, you know? It's because I existed that he ended up so miserable like that.'"

lines.content: ……いやだ……
頭を抱え、
lines.translated: Clutching his head,

lines.content: ……ちがう……
lines.translated: "...That's wrong..."

lines.content: 唸るように、わたしは言った。
lines.translated: I let out a groan.

lines.content: わたしは、空っぽなんだ。わたしの“命”には、なんの思いも――物語も、ない
lines.translated: "I'm empty. My 'life' has no feelings--no story to it."

lines.content: 『そう思いたいだけ』
lines.translated: "'That's just what you want to think.'"

lines.content: わたしにはましろと違って、大切な何かを犠牲にしてまで世界を救うか――思い、悩んで、決意する――そんな物語なんて、ないんだ
lines.translated: "Unlike Mashiro, I don't have some story where I agonize, struggle, and resolve to sacrifice something precious to save the world."

lines.content: 『……そう願っていただけ』
lines.translated: "'...That's just what you wished for.'"

lines.content: ただ、さみしがり屋なわたしは、同じくらいさみしがり屋な大雅と偶然出会って、抱きしめられて……この子を、守らなきゃって。そう感じただけなんだ
lines.translated: "I was just lonely, and I happened to meet Taiga, who was just as lonely as me, and when he held me... I just felt like I had to protect this boy. That's all it was."

lines.content: 『……そう、祈っていただけだよね』
lines.translated: "'...That's just what you prayed for, isn't it?'"
"'You've just been lying to yourself, *wishing that was how it was*.'"

lines.content: 子猫はわたしに背を向け歩き出す。
lines.translated: The kitten turned its back on me and started walking.
"'To keep thinking *that much* about that boy over *something so small*--there's no way you could do that, right?'"

lines.content: 『……[・|わ][・|た][・|し][・|達]が憧れ、ほしいなと願う人間の“心”をもし手に入れられたとしても、きっと無理。どこかであっさり諦めちゃうよ――何か、理由がない限り』
lines.translated: "'...Even if *we* could get our hands on the human 'heart' we long for and wish to have, it'd surely be impossible. We'd easily give up somewhere along the way--unless there was some kind of reason.'"

lines.content: とてとてと進んでいく子猫に、わたしは無理矢理ひっぱられるみたいに、付いていく。
lines.translated: As the kitten trotted ahead, I followed behind, as if being dragged along against my will.

lines.content: 『わたし達は、さくらの樹から生まれた』
lines.translated: "'We were born from the cherry blossom tree.'"

lines.content: ぱっと、暗闇の天井が咲いた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, the ceiling of darkness bloomed.

lines.content: 『……あのさくらの樹が抱いた、“心”によく似た何か』
lines.translated: "'...Something very much like a 'heart' that the cherry blossom tree harbored.'"

lines.content: 『……そこに眠り続ける漆黒色した子どもたち。自分たちを悪戯に貶めた意地悪な大人たちへの復讐心。[・|そ][・|れ]が、わたし達だ』
lines.translated: "'...The pitch-black children who continue to sleep there. A desire for revenge against the cruel adults who maliciously degraded them. *That* is what we are.'"

lines.content: ぱちり、と音がした。
lines.translated: There was a faint click.

lines.content: 持ち出した“懐中時計”だ。その針が勝手に動き、いつかの日付を指し示す。
lines.translated: It was the "pocket watch" I had brought out. Its hands moved on their own, pointing to a date from sometime in the past.

lines.content: すると子猫の進むその先に、真っ暗な地下牢で丸くなり眠る男の子がいた――……そんな男の子のことを、格子越しに見つめてる女の人が、いた。
lines.translated: Then, just ahead of where the kitten was walking, there was a boy curled up asleep in a pitch-black dungeon--...and a woman gazing at him through the bars.

lines.content: 『わたし達は、憎悪に沈んだ子ども達の“想い”が“夜”の中で形を得た“イキモノ”だ――かわいい黒猫の姿で大人に近づき、その心を少しずつ壊すんだ』
lines.translated: "'We are 'Creatures' formed in the 'Night' from the 'feelings' of children sunken in hatred--approaching adults in the form of cute black cats, and breaking their hearts piece by piece.'"

lines.content: そうして漆黒の底にその人生を、じわり、じわりと沈めていくのだ。
lines.translated: And by doing so, we slowly, steadily sink their lives to the bottom of the pitch-black abyss.

lines.content: 『安易に殺したりして命を奪うより、心をなくし、死んだように生き続けていくことのほうがよっぽどつらい。場合によっては』
lines.translated: "'Depending on the person, losing your heart and continuing to live like the walking dead is far more painful than easily being killed and having your life taken away.'"

lines.content: 『そういう罰則を、漆黒の子ども達は、いつまでもいつまでも、粘着質に、無関係な大人たちにまで押しつけ続けてた――……ほら、こんなふうに』
lines.translated: "'The pitch-black children kept forcing that kind of punishment onto even unrelated adults, forever and ever, relentlessly--...Look, just like this.'"

lines.content: 女の人が――あの子のお母さんが、近寄ってきた[わたし|黒猫]をふと、抱き上げた。
lines.translated: The woman--that boy's mother--suddenly picked up the black cat--me--that had walked up to her.

lines.content: だめ……っ
手を伸ばし叫ぶけど……。
lines.translated: I reached out my hand and screamed, but...

lines.content: そのばけものに、触れないで……っ
lines.translated: "Don't touch that monster...!"

lines.content: ……届かない。
lines.translated: It didn't reach her.

lines.content: わたしの声は誰にも届いてくれない。
lines.translated: My voice wouldn't reach anyone.

lines.content: どうかお願いと、わたしを撫でながらお母さんが言った。
lines.translated: Please, I beg of you, his mother said while petting me.

lines.content: どうかお願いね、この子のお友だちになってあげてね――……
lines.translated: Please, be this child's friend--...

lines.content: そんな気持ちはあっという間に、お母さんの心からひび割れ、消えた。
lines.translated: Those feelings cracked and vanished from his mother's heart in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: ああ……、だめね。
lines.translated: Ah... it's no use.

lines.content: 何の“才能”もないこの子を愛する理由はどこにもないわ。あたらしい子を作らなきゃ。
lines.translated: There's no reason at all to love this child who has no "talent" whatsoever. I have to make a new child.

lines.content: そんな黒色の気持ちが、お母さんの心に立ちこめた。
lines.translated: Such pitch-black feelings filled his mother's heart.

lines.content: 『もう、わかるよね？　思い出せたよね？』
lines.translated: "'You understand now, right? You remember now, don't you?'"

lines.content: 真っ赤な口を見せ、[わたし|子猫]は笑った。
lines.translated: Showing its bright red mouth, the kitten--I--laughed.

lines.content: 『ぼくなんて生まれてこなければよかった――あの子がそう感じてしまう原因を、わたしが、作ったんだ。あの子のお母さんの心を、わたし達が壊したんだよ』
lines.translated: "'I never should have been born--I'm the one who created the reason he came to feel that way. We broke his mother's heart.'"

lines.content: 『ね？　ほら……。わたしなんて、生まれてこなければよかった』
lines.translated: "'Right? See...? I never should have been born.'"

lines.content: [わたし|子猫]がいっぱいの涙を流し、そう言った。
lines.translated: Shedding a flood of tears, the kitten--I--said that.

lines.content: 自分の言葉が、大切な人の“希望”になるかも？
lines.translated: Thinking my words might become the "hope" of someone precious to me?

lines.content: 何を、ばかなことを。
lines.translated: What a foolish thought.

lines.content: 自分の存在そのものが、大切な人を“不幸”にしたのだ。
lines.translated: My very existence is what brought "misfortune" to the person precious to me.

lines.content: 暖かく抱きしめられたあの子の腕の中で、何も知らない邪悪なわたしはようやく、その事実に気づき……。
lines.translated: Held warmly in that boy's arms, the ignorant, wicked me finally realized that truth...

lines.content: もう、遅い。
lines.translated: It's too late now.

lines.content: どれだけ泣いて、泣いて、謝ろうと……。
lines.translated: No matter how much I cry, and cry, and apologize...

lines.content: わたしがきみの心に付けてしまったさみしさは、永遠に、消えない。
lines.translated: The loneliness I inflicted upon your heart will never, ever disappear.

lines.content: 暗闇の底に、くずおれて。
lines.translated: Collapsing to the bottom of the darkness.

lines.content: わたし……
涙も枯れた心を押しつぶすように、両手で顔を覆って――……もう、だめ。歩けない。
lines.translated: Covering my face with both hands as if to crush my heart that had even run dry of tears--...It's no use anymore. I can't walk.

lines.content: ……わたしなんて、生まれてこなければ、よかった
lines.translated: "...Someone like me never should have been born."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: わたしたちは、出会わなければよかったんだよ。
lines.translated: We never should have met.
"...*And that is how Kuro died*."

lines.content: そこまで語り終えた奏大雅のことを、[・|ぼ][・|く]は見上げた――……クロは、死んだ。
lines.translated: When Kanade Taiga finished speaking up to that point, *I* looked up at him--...Kuro died.

lines.content: その言葉の意味をすぐには理解できなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't immediately comprehend the meaning of those words.

lines.content: あの子は、いつかの時間の中に“希望”を見つけた
lines.translated: "That girl found 'hope' within a time from the past."

lines.content: ひとりつぶやくように奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke as if muttering to himself.

lines.content: “夜”に沈んだ君の心を、自分の言葉で――君への“想い”で、君のことを取り戻せるかもしれない。そんな、クロにとっては眩しすぎる[希望|可能性]を、見つけられたんだよ
lines.translated: "She thought that with her own words--with her 'feelings' for you--she might be able to win back your heart that had sunk into the 'Night.' She managed to find that possibility--that 'hope' which was far too dazzling for Kuro."

lines.content: すぐ……。
lines.translated: Right away...

lines.content: すぐにだ。
lines.translated: Immediately.

lines.content: クロはすぐにでも走って行こうと、思った。
lines.translated: Kuro intended to break into a run that very instant.

lines.content: 見つけたばかりの“希望”を胸に。
lines.translated: With the "hope" she had just found held in her chest.

lines.content: ……途端、心に芽生えた“夢”を両手に。
lines.translated: And the "dream" that had instantly sprouted in her heart held in both hands.

lines.content: どうすれば君と出会えるのかは、未だわからなかったけど……。
lines.translated: She still didn't know how she could meet you, though...

lines.content: それでも必ず君のことを見つけ出すんだ。わたしはどこへでも走って行ける――あの子はそう思ったんだ
lines.translated: "'Even so, I'll definitely find you. I can run anywhere'--that's what she thought."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……同時に
lines.translated: "...At the same time..."

lines.content: 奏大雅は首を振った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga shook his head.

lines.content: 同時にずっと、目を逸らし続けてきたあの子の“悪夢”もまた、“希望”と共に、“夜”の中で目覚め――……形を得たんだ
lines.translated: "At the same time, that girl's 'nightmare,' which she had kept averting her eyes from all along, also awoke in the 'Night' alongside her 'hope'--...and took form."

lines.content: 彼女の“悪夢”は決して消えない“罪悪感”だ。君の不幸の原因を自分が作った。
lines.translated: Her "nightmare" was a "guilt" that would never fade. That she herself had created the cause of your misfortune.

lines.content: しかし彼女自身は、漆黒色の子ども達の傀儡のようなものだった。
lines.translated: However, she herself had been something like a puppet to the pitch-black children.

lines.content: 彼女は名もなき大勢いるうちの一匹でしかなかったし、自ら考え行動するための心など持ち合わせていなかった
lines.translated: "She was nothing more than one nameless cat among many, and she didn't possess a heart to think and act for herself."

lines.content: 他の黒猫たち同様に、命じられるままに大人たちのもとへと歩いて行って……その心をひび割れさせていっただけ。
lines.translated: Just like the other black cats, she simply walked up to adults as ordered... and cracked their hearts.

lines.content: ただ淡々と与えられた“役割”をこなすのだ。
lines.translated: Simply carrying out the "role" she was given with indifference.

lines.content: そうすることに不快さだとか、疑問だとかを感じることもなかった。
lines.translated: She never felt any discomfort or doubt in doing so.

lines.content: ただ、幾つもいくつも大人たちの心を壊していくその中で……。
lines.translated: However, in the midst of breaking the hearts of so, so many adults...

lines.content: クロ一匹だけが[・|何][・|か]違った。大人たちの壊した心の破片を、自分の中に少しずつため込んでいっていたんだ
lines.translated: "Kuro alone was *somehow* different. Little by little, she had been storing up the broken fragments of the adults' hearts inside herself."

lines.content: どうしてクロにだけそういう事情が起きたのか。きっとクロは、傀儡として不出来だったのだろう。
lines.translated: Why did something like that happen only to Kuro? Surely, Kuro was poorly made as a puppet.

lines.content: 大量生産された中にたったひとつ生じた不良品。
lines.translated: A single defective product born among a mass-produced lot.

lines.content: ……そんなクロの心の中には、親が子を想う気持ちで満ちていく。
lines.translated: And inside Kuro's heart, the feelings of parents caring for their children began to fill her up.

lines.content: そして君の母親の心を壊し、その破片を飲み込んでしまった瞬間――クロは、一匹の心のない黒猫ではなくなった。君のことだけ想う“夜のイキモノ”に変わってしまった
lines.translated: "And the moment she broke your mother's heart and swallowed those fragments--Kuro ceased to be a single heartless black cat. She turned into a 'Creature of the Night' who cared only for you."

lines.content: 胸にため込んだ心のかけらが、そのときひとつになったんだ。
lines.translated: The fragments of hearts she had stored up in her chest became one at that moment.

lines.content: だからクロは君のさみしい気持ちを放ってなんていられない。だってあの子は君の友人で。相棒で。大切な、家族で。その心は、母親に良く似た[・|何][・|か]だったから
lines.translated: "That's why Kuro couldn't just leave your lonely feelings alone. Because she was your friend. Your partner. Your precious family. Because her heart was *something* very much like a mother's."
*It was* "*despair*."

lines.content: そんな自分が……。
lines.translated: That she herself...

lines.content: 大切に護らなければと感じ始めた君のことを、何も知らないわからない、ただの猫だった頃のこととはいえ――
lines.translated: Even though it happened back when she was just a mere cat who knew and understood nothing, toward the very person she had begun to feel she must cherish and protect--

lines.content: 自分こそが不幸にしたのだと、芽生えたばかりのクロの心は少しずつ、理解した。
lines.translated: Kuro's newly budded heart slowly came to understand that she was the very one who had made you miserable.

lines.content: そうして生まれた罪悪感が、更に彼女のことを突き動かさずにはいられないんだ……
lines.translated: "The guilt born from that realization couldn't help but drive her even further..."

lines.content: 君に本当のことを言って謝れるだけの勇気がない。嫌われるのが、怖い。君に憎まれてしまう未来を想うと今にも死にそう。そんな都合のいい自分も大嫌い……だから、せめて
lines.translated: "She didn't have the courage to tell you the truth and apologize. She was terrified of being hated. Just imagining a future where you despised her made her feel like she could die right then and there. And she hated herself for being so selfish, too... So, at the very least..."

lines.content: 言葉にできない“想い”を君に、[行動|生き方]で伝えるそのために……。
lines.translated: In order to convey her unspoken "feelings" to you through her way of life--through her actions...

lines.content: せめて影ながら君のことを護り、必ず、自分の全部をかけて幸せに導かないと……。そうで、なければ、自分はいったい、なんのために生まれてきたのかわからない
lines.translated: "'At the very least, I have to protect him from the shadows and give everything I have to guide him to happiness... Otherwise, I don't know what I was even born for in the first place.'"

lines.content: そんな罪悪感はいつしか“悪夢”となって大きく、おおきく、胸の中で肥大して、彼女自身を押しつぶしてしまう……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Before long, that guilt turned into a "nightmare," swelling larger and larger inside her chest until it crushed her very self... Yes, that's right.

lines.content: なんの比喩でもなく[・|文][・|字][・|通][・|り]つぶされてしまったんだ、あの子は
lines.translated: "It wasn't a metaphor at all. That girl was *literally* crushed."

lines.content: いつかの“夜”のその中で、たったひとり、死んでいったんだ。
lines.translated: Somewhere inside the "Night" of some bygone time, she died all alone.

lines.content: ……九つあったという猫の命もすべて、一つひとつ丁寧に、すり潰されるようにして尽き果てた。
lines.translated: Every last one of the nine lives a cat is said to have was painstakingly ground down, one by one, until none remained.

lines.content: ぼくは、まだ自分の両手を見つめてる。奏大雅は構わず続けた。
lines.translated: I was still staring at my own two hands. Kanade Taiga continued regardless.

lines.content: クロは、最後まで自分の“悪夢”に抵抗し、生き延びようと足掻いてた
lines.translated: "Kuro resisted her own 'nightmare' until the very end, struggling desperately to survive."

lines.content: しかし“夜の国”では、その時間と空間の中に、それが光りだろうと闇であろうと“想い”は形となって、現れる――……
lines.translated: However, within the time and space of the "Land of Night," whether it be light or darkness, "feelings" take form and manifest--...

lines.content: ……自分のことをどうしたって許せず、罰してしまいたいクロの“悪夢”は、君に“希望”を届けるまでは待ってほしいと、必死に懇願する自分自身をも許さなかった
lines.translated: "...Unable to forgive herself no matter what and wishing only to punish herself, Kuro's 'nightmare' refused to forgive even the part of her that was desperately begging it to wait until she delivered that 'hope' to you."

lines.content: ……自分にそんな資格があるはずもないとクロの“悪夢”は叫んでた。自分の言葉が君の“希望”になるなんて――本当に信じているのかと。思い上がるなと、泣いていた
lines.translated: "...Kuro's 'nightmare' screamed that she had no right to do such a thing. Did she really believe her words could become your 'hope'? Don't get so full of yourself, it wept."

lines.content: それでもクロは自分自身に力いっぱい抵抗したんだ。どうしても、どうしても、君の元へ駆けていきたかった。君に、“希望”だと信じるものを渡したかったんだ
lines.translated: "Even so, Kuro fought against herself with everything she had. No matter what, no matter what, she wanted to run to your side. She wanted to hand you what she believed to be 'hope.'"

lines.content: だから足掻いた。抵抗した。思い通りにならない自分の心に抗おうと、もがいた。君のところへ走って行けますようにと、祈ってた。
lines.translated: So she struggled. She resisted. She fought against her own heart that refused to obey her. She prayed that she might be able to run to where you were.

lines.content: 『……お願いっ』
lines.translated: "...Please!"

lines.content: “夜”の中でクロの叫ぶ声がした。
lines.translated: Kuro's crying voice echoed within the "Night."

lines.content: 『行かせて……っ、わたしは、どうなってもいいの――殺したいのなら、死んで……しまいたいのなら。この命を残らず全部、あげるから……でもっ』
lines.translated: "Let me go...! I don't care what happens to me--if you want to kill me, if I want to... die, I'll give you every last bit of this life... But!"

lines.content: 『お願い……お願いだよっ、最後にもう一度だけで、いいの……、大雅に、会いに、行かせてよ……っ』
lines.translated: "Please... I'm begging you! Just one last time is enough... Please let me go see Taiga...!"

lines.content: しかし“夜”の底でもがいたあの子の願いは、誰のもとに届くことなく潰えて消えた。
lines.translated: Yet the wish of that girl struggling at the bottom of the "Night" was crushed and vanished without ever reaching anyone.

lines.content: やっぱり、だめだった。あの子の“悪夢”は、決してあの子を――自分自身を許すことはなかった。一縷の光りだって差し込む余地もないくらい
lines.translated: "In the end, it was no use. That girl's 'nightmare' never forgave her--never forgave itself. Not even leaving room for a single sliver of light to shine through."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|が]自分自身への罰だった。
lines.translated: *That was* her punishment to herself.

lines.content: ……“希望”を抱き、世界がきらめいているように見えたときだ
lines.translated: "...Just when she embraced 'hope' and the world seemed to be sparkling."

lines.content: そのときこそ自分自身を“夜”の底にたたき落とそう――[・|そ][・|う][・|す][・|る][・|こ][・|と][・|が]、邪悪な自分への罰だった。
lines.translated: That was the exact moment to hurl herself down to the very bottom of the "Night"--*doing so was* the punishment for her wicked self.

lines.content: ……いつだって、決まってるんだ
lines.translated: "...It's always been decided."

lines.content: 奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke.

lines.content: ……いつだってさ。戦うべき最大の敵は自分自身の中にあるものなんだよ
lines.translated: "...Always. The greatest enemy we must fight lies within ourselves."

lines.content: わかりやすく意地の悪い強敵なんてこの世界には存在しない。戦うべきはいつだって、自分自身の心なんだよ
lines.translated: "There's no such thing as an easily understandable, malicious, powerful enemy in this world. What we must fight is always our own heart."

lines.content: ぼくはまだ手のひらを、見ている。じっと見ている。
lines.translated: I was still looking at my palms. Staring intently at them.

lines.content: 勘違いしないでほしいんだ
lines.translated: "I don't want you to misunderstand."

lines.content: 奏大雅が決して厳しくはない声で――しかし無意味にやさしいわけでもない言葉で、言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke in a voice that was by no means harsh--yet with words that weren't pointlessly gentle, either.

lines.content: こうして君に色々なことを語ったのは、君へ“絶望”を贈りたかったからじゃない。勘違いしないでほしい。俺は、君のことをかけらだって憎んじゃいないんだ
lines.translated: "I didn't tell you all these things because I wanted to give you 'despair.' Please don't get the wrong idea. I don't hate you in the slightest."

lines.content: ぼくを憎んでは、いない――かけら程もだと、奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: He doesn't hate me--not even a single bit, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: そうであるほうがつらいのだと知った。ぼくの胸はずきりと痛んだ。
lines.translated: I realized that it was actually more painful that way. A sharp ache pierced my chest.

lines.content: ぼくはあなた達に憎まれたい。ぼくと出会わなければよかったと思ってほしかった。そうでなければ報われない。
lines.translated: I wanted all of you to hate me. I wanted you to wish you had never met me. Otherwise, there would be no justice.

lines.content: でもそんなぼくに、奏大雅は言った。
lines.translated: Yet to someone like me, Kanade Taiga said:

lines.content: ……君に、救ってほしかったんだ。だからすべて話した
lines.translated: "...I wanted you to save them. That's why I told you everything."

lines.content: 顔を上げ、奏大雅を見る。
lines.translated: I raised my head and looked at Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: ……救う？
lines.translated: "...Save?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……誰を？
クロを……いいや、すべてをだ。今、君の世界で、“絶望”の淵にあるすべてを救ってほしい
lines.translated: "Kuro... No, everything. Right now, I want you to save everything standing on the brink of 'despair' in your world."

lines.content: ……誰が？
lines.translated: "...Who, me?"

lines.content: 君だよ
lines.translated: "Yes, you."

lines.content: 奏大雅は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga smiled.

lines.content: そして“できないなんて言わせないぞ”と、そう言った。
lines.translated: And then he said, "I won't let you say you can't do it."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]は君の人生だ。[・|こ][・|れ]は、君だけの物語なんだよ。だから俺じゃあ救えなかった。どころか、立ち向かうことさえ困難だった――
lines.translated: "*This* is your life. *This* is a story that belongs only to you. That's why I couldn't save it. In fact, it was hard enough just to face it--"

lines.content: 奏大雅は自分の胸を、心臓の位置を強く指し示す。ここに求めたものはなにもなかった。空っぽだったのだと、言いながら。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga pointed firmly at his own chest, right where his heart was. Saying that what he had sought wasn't there. That it had been completely empty.

lines.content: ――だからこの物語は君にしか乗り越えられない。君にしか、この“絶望”は倒すことができないんだ
lines.translated: "--That's why only you can overcome this story. Only you can defeat this 'despair.'"

lines.content: 俺にはできない。無理なんだと、奏大雅は繰り返し言う。
lines.translated: "I can't do it. It's impossible for me," Kanade Taiga repeated.

lines.content: なぜなら、君の[物語|人生]を救うことができる唯一のヒーローは、いつだって、自分自身だからだ
lines.translated: "Because the only hero who can save the story of your life is always yourself."

lines.content: ぼくは再び、うつむく。
lines.translated: I lowered my gaze once again.

lines.content: ……だめだ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: 何を言われたところで響かない。
lines.translated: No matter what he said to me, none of it resonated.

lines.content: ……無理だ
lines.translated: "...It's impossible."

lines.content: 首を振り、言った。
lines.translated: I shook my head and spoke.

lines.content: ……ぼくにそんな力はない
lines.translated: "...I don't have that kind of power."

lines.content: ぼくはぼく自身だって救えない――……どころか。
lines.translated: I can't even save myself--...let alone anyone else.

lines.content: ぼくは“特別”な物語を救う“特別”な存在じゃないんだ
lines.translated: "I'm not some 'special' existence who can save a 'special' story."

lines.content: この命はその他大勢だ。そこらに溢れる類似品。誰も名前も知らない。知ろうともしない。何の価値もないただの通行人Ａくらいの[・|何][・|か]でしかないんだ
lines.translated: "This life is just one of the crowd. A cheap knockoff overflowing everywhere you look. Nobody knows my name. Nobody even tries to know it. I'm nothing more than *something* on the level of a worthless Passerby A."

lines.content: いつだって救ってもらう側だった。救ってもらっておいてその恩を返そうともしない傲岸なるもののその一部。ただ都合良く、ヒーローに憧れてばかりいる名もない誰かだ。
lines.translated: I was always the one being saved. Just a part of the arrogant masses who are saved and never even try to repay that kindness. A nameless nobody who conveniently does nothing but admire heroes.

lines.content: だから精一杯、憧れた者を真似ようとした。あなたの名前を勝手に借りた。自分も誰かを助けられるようにと、祈った。
lines.translated: That's why I tried as hard as I could to imitate the one I admired. I borrowed your name without asking. I prayed that I might be able to save someone, too.
*If only it had stopped at that, it would have been fine*...

lines.content: じっと自分の手を見つめてる。
lines.translated: I stared fixedly at my own hands.

lines.content: この手は、ぼくのことを助けに別の時間世界から来ていたという柊ハルを、撃ち抜き殺した。
lines.translated: These hands shot and killed Hiiragi Haru, who had come from another timeline to save me.

lines.content: その罰はいったい誰が下してくれる。
lines.translated: Who on earth is going to pass judgment on me for that?

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: もはや救われる側どころか、罰せられる側なのだ。
lines.translated: Far from being the one who gets saved, I am now the one who must be punished.

lines.content: ……それにクロはもう、どこにもいない。
lines.translated: Besides, Kuro isn't anywhere anymore.

lines.content: 死んだ。
lines.translated: She died.

lines.content: いつかどこかの“夜”の中で……死んで、しまった。ぼくなんかのことを取り戻そうとした、ばっかりに。
lines.translated: Somewhere, in some "Night"... she ended up dying. All because she tried to win back someone like me.

lines.content: “絶望”だ。
lines.translated: It is "despair."

lines.content: 目の前に並べられた[もの|事実]があんまりにもどうしようもなくて……。
lines.translated: The facts laid out before my eyes were just far too hopeless...

lines.content: 誰を救うも、救わないも……ない。
lines.translated: There's no saving anyone, or not saving them... anymore.

lines.content: もうすべて終わってしまってるじゃないか。この時間世界はどうしようもないバットエンドだ。
lines.translated: Everything is already completely over, isn't it? This timeline has reached a hopeless bad end.

lines.content: そんな終わってしまった後の物語を前に、いったい、何をどうしろというのだろうか。
lines.translated: Faced with a story that has already ended like this, what on earth am I supposed to do?

lines.content: どういう手段を行使したのかは知らないが、こうして“夜の王”からぼくを元の姿に引きずり戻してまでして……。
lines.translated: I don't know what kind of methods he used, going so far as to drag me back to my original form from the "King of the Night" like this...
*However*.
*However, if doing such a thing were possible, to Kuro, I would*--

lines.content: ……君は、すごいよ
lines.translated: "...You're amazing."

lines.content: 奏大雅は言った。ぼくにこれ以上、考える暇を与えまいとするように。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke, as if refusing to give me any more time to think.

lines.content: 君は俺のことを[ヒーロー|英雄]だとか、そんなふうに思ってくれてたみたいだけれど……。違うな。やめてくれ。恥ずかしい
lines.translated: "It seems like you thought of me as a hero, or something like that, but... you're wrong. Please stop. It's embarrassing."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: A wry smile surfaced on his face.

lines.content: ……恥じ入りたいのは語感だとかの幼稚さを指してるわけじゃない。本物の勇気ある君にそういうふうに思われるなんて。自分が、恥ずかしくなるんだ
lines.translated: "...I'm not embarrassed because the word itself sounds childish or anything. To be thought of that way by someone like you, who possesses true courage... It makes me ashamed of myself."

lines.content: なあ、知ってるか？　と奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: "Hey, do you know?" Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: 君は自分のことを空っぽだと、何の才能も力もない無価値な人間だと、そう思ってるみたいだけれど……
lines.translated: "You seem to think of yourself as empty, as a worthless human being with no talent or power, but..."

lines.content: 違うな
lines.translated: "You're wrong."

lines.content: 君という人間は本当にすごいんだ――誰の命にも等しく同じだけ価値があるとか。そんな陳腐な話がしたいわけじゃない
lines.translated: "The person you are is truly amazing--and I'm not trying to give you some cliched speech about how everyone's life has equal value."

lines.content: 俺には、引けなかったんだよ。この引き金を、自分の力では引くことができなかった
lines.translated: "I couldn't pull it. I couldn't pull this trigger with my own strength."

lines.content: そう言う奏大雅の手には、いつの間にか“拳銃”が握りしめられていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, a "handgun" was gripped tightly in Kanade Taiga's hand as he said that.

lines.content: ……“魔法”だよ
lines.translated: "...It's 'magic.'"

lines.content: あくまで君の“想い”を模倣して創り上げたものではあるけれど――撃ち抜いたものの時間を巻き戻す。そういう“魔法”の効果を知っていても、だめだ。怖かった
lines.translated: "Though it's ultimately something created by imitating your 'feelings'--it rewinds the time of whatever it shoots through. Even knowing the effect of that 'magic,' it was no use. I was scared."

lines.content: 俺には無理だ。ハルを助けるため自分の命を犠牲にしようなんて。そんなこと、できなかったんだ
lines.translated: "It was impossible for me. Sacrificing my own life to save Haru... I couldn't do something like that."

lines.content: それなのに君はいっぱい悩み、苦しんで、強大な恐怖に呑まれてさえも――最後には“魔法”を使った。運命に自分の命を差し出したんだ
lines.translated: "And yet you agonized so much, suffered, and even while being swallowed up by overwhelming terror--in the end, you used the 'magic.' You offered up your own life to fate."

lines.content: ……何度だって言う。君の人生を救うことのできるヒーローは、君自身、ただひとりだけなんだ
lines.translated: "...I'll say it as many times as it takes. The only hero who can save your life is you yourself, and you alone."

lines.content: 君は確かに君の物語の中でヒーローだったと、奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: You were undeniably a hero within your own story, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: そんな君の物語を知り、そんな君に憧れを覚え、“勇気”をもらえたからこそだ。俺は、こうしてここにいられる。君と話すことができている
lines.translated: "It's precisely because I learned of your story, came to admire you, and received 'courage' from you that I can be here like this. That I'm able to talk to you."

lines.content: 首をかしげるぼくに、奏大雅は苦笑いを浮かべた。
lines.translated: As I tilted my head in confusion, Kanade Taiga gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 君は柊ハルを“魔法”で撃ち抜いたよな。そうして彼女の時間を巻き戻し、彼女に彼女自身の人生を救わせようとした
lines.translated: "You shot through Hiiragi Haru with 'magic,' right? By doing that, you rewound her time and tried to let her save her own life."

lines.content: 彼女にそのための“勇気”を、“希望”を、そして少しの“夢”を、君の“魔法”は与えたんだ――[・|だ][・|か][・|ら][・|俺][・|も][・|そ][・|う][・|す][・|る][・|こ][・|と][・|に][・|し][・|た]
lines.translated: "Your 'magic' gave her the 'courage,' the 'hope,' and a little bit of a 'dream' to do just that--*so I decided to do the same thing*."

lines.content: 結果、ここにこうして立っている。君を“夜の王”から元に戻せた
lines.translated: "As a result, I'm standing here like this. I was able to turn you back from the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: もう、わかるだろう？　俺は君の真似をしたんだよ――“勇気”をもらった君の[物語|人生]を模倣したんだ
lines.translated: "You understand now, don't you? I imitated you--I copied the story of your life that gave me 'courage.'"

lines.content: 君が柊ハルを撃ち抜いて、自分の人生に向き合ってくれるよう祈ったように、俺もまた、“夜の王”と化した君をこの“魔法”で撃ち抜いた
lines.translated: "Just as you shot through Hiiragi Haru and prayed that she would face her own life, I too shot through you with this 'magic' after you had become the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: そして君の時間を、遠いとおい過去へと吹き飛ばし、巻き戻した
lines.translated: "And I blasted your time back into the far, distant past, rewinding it."

lines.content: そうすることで君を、“夜”の底から引きずり戻した――それが今、ここなんだよと奏大雅はぼくに言う。
lines.translated: By doing that, I dragged you back from the depths of the "Night"--and that's how we're here right now, Kanade Taiga told me.
"*Come on, remember. Just who on earth are you?*"
"*Right now, I am talking to you--the you who has packed countless timelines into his chest.*"

lines.content: その奏大雅の言葉に、どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: Hearing those words of Kanade Taiga's, I wondered why.

lines.content: ……ほんの少し違和感のようなものを覚えた。
lines.translated: I felt a slight sense of something being out of place.

lines.content: だけどその正体を問いかけることもできないまま、奏大雅はぼくへと語り続ける。
lines.translated: However, before I could even question what it was, Kanade Taiga continued speaking to me.

lines.content: 君にも何かひとつくらい、悲しみの中にあるときに勇気をもらえた“物語”や“歌”があったはずだ
lines.translated: "You must have had at least one 'story' or 'song' that gave you courage when you were in the midst of sorrow."

lines.content: どこか遠い時間の中で書かれた手紙のようなそれを心で受け取り、誰かから声もなく励まされたように思えたことが、一度は、あるはずだ
lines.translated: "You must have experienced, at least once, receiving something like a letter written in some distant time within your heart, feeling as though someone had wordlessly encouraged you."

lines.content: そうして受け取った顔も名前も知らない誰かの“言葉”で、もう少し……あと少し、頑張ってみよう。立ち止まらずに進んでみよう。そういうふうに思えたこともあったはず
lines.translated: "And through the 'words' you received from someone whose face and name you didn't even know, you must have thought to yourself: let's try holding on a little... just a little longer. Let's try moving forward without stopping."

lines.content: 俺にとっては、君だ。君の描いた“人生”こそが[・|そ][・|う]だった。“愛”と“勇気”の“物語”であり、“歌”だったんだ
lines.translated: "For me, that was you. The 'life' you painted was *exactly that*. It was a 'story' of 'love' and 'courage,' and it was a 'song.'"

lines.content: ……まあ、全部、父さんの受け売りなんだけどな
lines.translated: "...Well, all of that is just repeating what my dad told me, though."

lines.content: ……ありがとう。と奏大雅は言った。
lines.translated: Thank you, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: 君のおかげだ。君が、たくさんの犠牲を払ったおかげで、俺は、俺の探し続けてたヒーローと出会えた
lines.translated: "It's thanks to you. Because you paid so many sacrifices, I was able to meet the hero I had been searching for all along."

lines.content: そしてその人と力を合わせて――想いを合わせて、結果、この方法を思いつくことができたんだ
lines.translated: "And by joining forces with that person--by uniting our feelings, as a result, I was able to come up with this method."

lines.content: ……まるで“夢”のような時間だったよと、奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: It was like a "dream" of a time, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: 世界はどうしようもなく“絶望”に染まってしまっていたけれど、それでも、あの人と一緒に問題に立ち向かおうとできた瞬間は、本当に“夢”のようだった
lines.translated: "The world had been hopelessly dyed in 'despair,' yet even so, the moment I was able to try and stand up to the problem together with that person truly felt like a 'dream.'"

lines.content: ……ああ、そうか
lines.translated: "...Ah, I see."

lines.content: 俺は君に助けられただけじゃなく、“夢”を叶えてもらっていたんだな。ひとつどころか、たくさんの“夢”を
lines.translated: "I wasn't just saved by you; you were granting my 'dreams.' Not just one, either, but so many 'dreams.'"

lines.content: 本当に、ありがとう
lines.translated: "Truly, thank you."

lines.content: 言葉だけじゃ君への感謝はまったく足りないなと、奏大雅は静かに言った。
lines.translated: Words alone aren't nearly enough to express my gratitude to you, Kanade Taiga said quietly.

lines.content: [・|俺][・|た][・|ち]を助けてくれてありがとう……。君のおかげでましろと俺は、幸せに生きていけたよ
lines.translated: "Thank you for saving *us*... Thanks to you, Mashiro and I were able to live happily."

lines.content: 本来あり得ないはずの幸福な人生だった。互いに触れあえないこともまた、互いの心をいつも近くで感じられる証しのようにさえ思えて……、ああ、うん。本当に幸せだった
lines.translated: "It was a happy life that originally should have been impossible. Even the fact that we couldn't touch each other felt like proof that we could always feel each other's hearts close by... Ah, yeah. I was truly happy."

lines.content: 俺たちの心は、ふたり寄り添い生きた人生の中で救われたんだと、奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Our hearts were saved within the life we lived huddled close together, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: そうだ。俺たちは君に救われた。君の偉大な“勇気”に、救われたんだ。
lines.translated: That's right. We were saved by you. Saved by your great "courage."

lines.content: 俺は君に何度となく助けられてきた――命も、心もだ。ああ、やっぱりだ。やっぱり君は、俺のヒーローだったんだ
lines.translated: "I have been saved by you time and time again--both my life and my heart. Ah, I knew it. You really were my hero all along."

lines.content: 言ったろう？　俺は君にわざわざ“絶望”を見せつけに来たわけじゃない。今の俺にできる精一杯の“希望”を手渡しに来た
lines.translated: "Didn't I tell you? I didn't go out of my way to come here just to shove 'despair' in your face. I came to hand over the very best 'hope' I can muster right now."

lines.content: そう言った奏大雅は“拳銃”をぼくに差し出した。その手は、その身体は、よく見れば輪郭が透けていた――……“半透明”
lines.translated: Saying that, Kanade Taiga held the "handgun" out to me. Looking closely at that hand, at that body, its outlines were see-through--... "translucent."

lines.content: どういうわけかわからない。
lines.translated: I don't understand how or why.

lines.content: わからないが……。
lines.translated: I don't understand, but...

lines.content: 今まで話していた奏大雅は肉体を持たず、ここにいるのは奏大雅の“想い”だけなのだと、知った。
lines.translated: I realized that the Kanade Taiga I had been talking to until now had no physical body, and that what was here was only Kanade Taiga's "feelings."

lines.content: 俺は、君の“魔法”と人生を……[・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ][・|を]模倣した
lines.translated: "I imitated your 'magic' and your life... *that one part of it*."

lines.content: ……ひとつ？
lines.translated: "...One part?"
*Again*.

lines.content: また、違和感がある。
lines.translated: Again, something feels out of place.

lines.content: だけど首をかしげた俺に、
lines.translated: However, as I tilted my head,

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: と奏大雅は言い、微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga said that and smiled.

lines.content: 君の人生。[・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ][・|を]模倣することで、乗り越えられる何かがあると信じたんだ
lines.translated: "Your life. I believed that by imitating *that one part of it*, there was something I could overcome."

lines.content: でもやっぱり君は君で、俺は俺だ。どんなに憧れ合おうと、真似をし合おうと、当然だけど[おんな|同]じにはなり得ない――[・|こ][・|れ]は、“希望”だ
lines.translated: "But in the end, you are you, and I am me. No matter how much we admire each other, or imitate each other, naturally we can never become the same--and *this* is 'hope.'"

lines.content: ぼくに差し出した“拳銃”を奏大雅は見つめてる。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga stared at the "handgun" he was holding out to me.

lines.content: 君の“魔法”は、撃ち抜いた者の心が“後悔”を感じた時点に巻き戻すものだった。だけど俺の“魔法”は、撃ち抜いた者が“希望”を感じた時点に、その心を巻き戻す
lines.translated: "Your 'magic' was something that rewound the heart of the person you shot through back to the point when they felt 'regret.' However, my 'magic' rewinds the heart of the person shot through back to the point when they felt 'hope.'"

lines.content: どんなに憧れを抱き合おうと決してすべて同じにはなり得ない俺たちだ――“魔法”の効果も同じにはなり得ず僅かに違う。
lines.translated: No matter how much admiration we hold for each other, we can never become completely the same--and so the effects of our "magic" cannot be the same either, differing ever so slightly.

lines.content: 確かに俺は“[君|夜の王]”のことを撃ち抜いた。だけどここから先に走って行くかどうかは、君自身が決断してほしい。……すべて、君に託すよ
lines.translated: "It's true that I shot through 'you, the King of the Night.' However, whether or not you run forward from here on out is something I want you to decide for yourself. ...I entrust everything to you."

lines.content: そう言って奏大雅はぼくに、その“拳銃”を――“魔法”を握らせた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Kanade Taiga made me grasp the "handgun"--the "magic."
The "handgun"...

lines.content: ぼくのものとは僅かに違う奏大雅の“魔法”を、ぼくは何も言わず見つめてる。
lines.translated: Without saying a word, I stared at Kanade Taiga's "magic," which was slightly different from mine.

lines.content: 大丈夫。心配ない。この時間世界で起きた“不幸”についてはすべて、俺に任せてほしい
lines.translated: "It's all right. Don't worry. As for all the 'misfortune' that happened in this timeline, I want you to leave it to me."

lines.content: 奏大雅はぼくに言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke to me.

lines.content: ここから先は、俺の物語だ
lines.translated: "From here on out, it's my story."

lines.content: 一度死んでしまった俺だけど……物語の中から離脱してしまった俺だけど
lines.translated: "Even though I died once... even though I dropped out of the story..."

lines.content: ――君と違って“魔法”の引き金を、自身に向かって引くことのできなかった俺だけど。
lines.translated: --Even though, unlike you, I couldn't pull the trigger of the "magic" while pointing it at myself.

lines.content: 君にこうして生き返らせてもらったことも含めて全部、俺の人生なんだ。君を取り戻すと、ましろと一緒に決断したことだって俺の、俺とましろの[物語|人生]だ
lines.translated: "Including the fact that you brought me back to life like this, all of it is my life. Deciding together with Mashiro to win you back is also my--mine and Mashiro's life, our story."

lines.content: 君と同じ“魔法”を得るため、君の[物語|人生]を模倣しようと考えて……でも、そうすることを止めたここから先の人生もまた、まるごと全部、俺の[物語|人生]で……きっと
lines.translated: "Thinking of imitating your life, your story in order to obtain the same 'magic' as you... and yet, the life from here on out where I stopped doing that is also, in its entirety, my life, my story... I'm sure of it."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 君の真似はもうやめる。ここからは、俺は俺として生きると決める。[・|だ][・|か][・|ら][・|こ][・|そ]、きっとだ
lines.translated: "I'm done imitating you. From here on, I've decided to live as myself. *And that's precisely why*, I'm sure of it."

lines.content: ここから俺に起きる困難はすべて、俺にしか乗り越えられないものだと信じて、戦うよ
lines.translated: "I will fight on, believing that all the hardships that happen to me from here on out are things that only I can overcome."

lines.content: だから君は君で、君の人生から逃げることなく立ち向かっていってほしい。懸命に、生きてほしいんだ――つらいときには少し休んで。悲しいときには思いっきり泣いて
lines.translated: "So I want you to be yourself, and stand up to your own life without running away. I want you to live with all your might--resting a little when things are painful, and crying your heart out when you're sad."

lines.content: ……自分を犠牲にするほど頑張れと吠える者の言葉にだけは、決して、惑わされることもなく。君は――
lines.translated: "...Never once being led astray by the words of those who bark at you to work hard to the point of sacrificing yourself. You--"

lines.content: ――……君は、君の人生を生きるんだと、奏大雅はぼくに言った。
lines.translated: --...You must live your own life, Kanade Taiga told me.

lines.content: 確かに君は柊ハルを撃ち抜いた。[・|で][・|も][・|そ][・|れ][・|は]、君であって君ではない
lines.translated: "It's true that you shot through Hiiragi Haru. *However, that* was you, and yet not you."

lines.content: それでも。柊ハルを撃ち抜いてしまったこと気にするのは、わかる
lines.translated: "Even so. I understand why it bothers you that you ended up shooting through Hiiragi Haru."

lines.content: 奏大雅は、疑問に満たされたぼくの視線に応えることなく、先を語り続けた。
lines.translated: Without answering my gaze, which was filled with questions, Kanade Taiga continued speaking.

lines.content: 罪悪感だなんて言葉にするのもまた軽率に思えるほどだ。それほど取り返しの付かないことを、してしまったんだ
lines.translated: "Even putting it into a word like 'guilt' feels thoughtless. That's how irrevocable a thing was done."

lines.content: つぶやくようにそう言いながら、でも奏大雅は怒りなんかではなく、申し訳なさそうな表情を浮かべ、ぼくを見ていた。
lines.translated: While saying that in a mutter, Kanade Taiga wasn't looking at me with anger or anything of the sort, but rather with an apologetic expression on his face.

lines.content: ……こういうふうに柊ハルの現状をわざわざ君に話したのは、あの子がそうまでして君を救おうとした“想い”を伝えたかったからだ。あの子がこのことを知ったら悲しむだろうが
lines.translated: "...The reason I went out of my way to tell you about Hiiragi Haru's current condition like this is because I wanted to convey the 'feelings' of that girl, who went to such lengths to try and save you. Though she would probably be sad if she knew about this."

lines.content: それでも、ごめんな
lines.translated: "Even so, I'm sorry."

lines.content: これは俺の勝手だ。[・|た][・|と][・|え][・|時][・|間][・|世][・|界][・|が][・|違][・|お][・|う][・|と][・|も]。どうしても彼女のことを伝えずにはいられなかった。そうでなければあんまりに彼女が報われないように、思えたから
lines.translated: "This is just my own selfishness. *Even if the timelines are different*. No matter what, I just couldn't stop myself from telling you about her. Because otherwise, it felt like her efforts would go far too unrewarded."

lines.content: ……ごめんな。本当に、勝手だよな
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. It really is selfish of me, isn't it?"

lines.content: “自分のことを大切に想ってくれる人が次々と不幸になっていく”――だからこそ君が、今、そういうふうに“絶望”してしまう気持ちもまた、理解できていたのに
lines.translated: "'The people who care deeply about me become unfortunate one after another'--and yet I understood why you would end up falling into 'despair' like that right now because of it."

lines.content: ……柊ハルは重傷だった
lines.translated: "...Hiiragi Haru was critically injured."

lines.content: 命を繋ぐためあさひさんに運ばれていったその姿は、あんまりにも絶望的で――目を、逸らしたくなるほどだった
lines.translated: "The sight of her being carried away by Asahi-san in order to keep her alive was just far too hopeless--so much so that it made me want to look away."

lines.content: でもな、と奏大雅は言うのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: でもそれは……柊ハルを撃ち抜いたのは君の“魔法”の弾丸だ
lines.translated: "Even so, that... what shot through Hiiragi Haru was the bullet of your 'magic.'"

lines.content: その効果で[・|時][・|を][・|引][・|き][・|戻][・|さ][・|れ][・|た]のだとしても、命を無為に奪ってしまうためのものじゃない
lines.translated: "Even if *time was pulled back* by its effect, it isn't something meant tosenselessly rob someone of their life."

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: あの“弾丸”は、大切な人を取り戻したい――そう願った君の“想い”が形になったものなんだ。そんな“想い”が、時間世界が違おうとなんだろうと、柊ハルを殺すはずがない
lines.translated: "That 'bullet' is the manifestation of your 'feelings,' your wish to win back someone precious to you. There is no way that such 'feelings' would ever kill Hiiragi Haru, regardless of whether the timeline is different or anything else."

lines.content: だから大丈夫。きっとあの子は助かる。こんな理屈じゃ“希望”を謳うには弱いかもしれないけれど……でも、必ずだ
lines.translated: "So it's all right. That girl will surely be saved. Reasoning like this might be too weak to sing the praises of 'hope,' but... even so, she definitely will."

lines.content: 奏大雅はぼくのことをまっすぐに、力強く見つめ、言った――……もし万が一のことがあったとしても、大丈夫。ここから先は俺の物語だ、と。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga looked straight at me with a powerful gaze and said--...Even if, by some remote chance, the worst were to happen, it's all right. From here on out is my story.

lines.content: 必ず俺が、助けてみせるよ。柊ハルのことを
lines.translated: "I will definitely save her. I'll save Hiiragi Haru."

lines.content: この時間世界で生死を彷徨う彼女を救うのは、君じゃない、そのきっかけを産んだのだろう俺の役目だ――心配するなとは言えない。でも、期待しておいてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Saving her as she wanders between life and death in this timeline isn't your job; it's mine, as the one who likely created the catalyst for it--I can't tell you not to worry. Still, I want you to count on me."

lines.content: きっと、上手くやるから。と奏大雅は確信深く、ぼくにうなずいて見せた。ようやくヒーローらしいことが少しできそうだと。
lines.translated: I'll definitely pull it off, Kanade Taiga nodded to me with deep conviction. Saying that it seemed he could finally do something a little bit heroic.

lines.content: ……手だ
lines.translated: "...Your hand."

lines.content: 手を、出してくれ。君に渡したいものがもうひとつだけ、ある。これは何よりきっと、大切なものだ
lines.translated: "Hold out your hand. There is just one more thing I want to give you. This is surely more precious than anything else."

lines.content: そう言われ、俺は手を差し出す――“拳銃”を握りしめてはいないほうの手を。
lines.translated: Told that, I held out my hand--the hand that wasn't tightly gripping the "handgun."

lines.content: “魔法”だ
lines.translated: "It's 'magic.'"

lines.content: 差し出したぼくの手にそっと触れ、奏大雅は、まるで“魔法”のための呪文を囁くようにして、言う。
lines.translated: Gently touching my outstretched hand, Kanade Taiga spoke as though whispering an incantation for "magic."

lines.content: 手渡したいのは、[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|の]時間世界の柊ハルが願い、“想像”し、君へ届けてほしいと願った“魔法”だよ
lines.translated: "What I want to hand over to you is the 'magic' that the Hiiragi Haru of *this* timeline wished for, 'imagined,' and prayed would reach you."

lines.content: 『だから、お願い。……あなたが、届けて……、ほしい』
lines.translated: "So, please. ...I want you... to deliver it..."

lines.content: 『やっと、……私、“魔法”を見つけたの。……[・|今][・|の][・|私]の願いを、叶える……その、“魔法”……“想像”……できたよ……だ、だから……おね、がい……[・|こ][・|れ]を、届けて……』
lines.translated: "I finally... found the 'magic.' ...To grant the wish of *the me right now*... that 'magic'... I managed to 'imagine' it... S-So... plea...se... deliver *this*..."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]はそのとき受け取った“魔法”なのだと、奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: *This* is the "magic" I received from her back then, Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: 『……ここじゃないいつかの時間。[あの子|クロ]は、私に幸せを届けてくれた。……そう、だよね？　だから今度は、私が[あの子|クロ]に幸せを届ける番だよ』
lines.translated: "'...In some other time, not here. That girl, Kuro, brought me happiness. ...That's right, isn't it? So this time, it's my turn to bring happiness to Kuro.'"

lines.content: “魔法”を受け取るため握りしめたハルの手から、彼女のそういう声もまた、胸の中に届いた。
lines.translated: From Haru's hand, which I had grasped tightly to receive the "magic," that voice of hers also reached deep into my chest.

lines.content: 俺は、君を撃ち抜いた。夜の王は倒されたんだ。だから彼女の願った“最後の魔法”も今夜、ここで、形となる
