lines.translated: "I shot through you. The King of the Night has been defeated. And so the 'final magic' she wished for will also take form here tonight."

lines.content: もう、いいだろう
lines.translated: "That should be enough now."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 充分だ
lines.translated: "It's plenty."

lines.content: もう充分すぎるほど、俺は君へ“想い”を伝えた。だからもういい――[・|思][・|い][・|出][・|す][・|ん][・|だ]
lines.translated: "I've already conveyed more than enough of my 'feelings' to you. So it's fine now--*remember*."

lines.content: 奏大雅はぼくに言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke to me.

lines.content: 今、ここにいる君は、いったい誰だ？
lines.translated: "Right now, just who is the 'you' standing here?"

lines.content: 首をかしげるぼくに、奏大雅は微笑んだ。
lines.translated: As I tilted my head, Kanade Taiga smiled.

lines.content: ごめんな。本当に
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Truly."

lines.content: ……君が、撃ち抜いてしまった柊ハルのこと。そして俺が模倣した、君の人生についてのこと
lines.translated: "...About Hiiragi Haru, whom you ended up shooting through. And about your life, which I imitated."

lines.content: それらを今まで、俺が語りかけていたのは、君であって君ではないんだ
lines.translated: "The one I have been speaking to about all of those things until now is you, and yet not you."

lines.content: 君の中に集められた“[時間|想い]”のひとつへ、ずっと語りかけていたにすぎなんだよ
lines.translated: "I was merely speaking this whole time to one of the 'feelings'--one of the 'times'--gathered inside of you."

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: 今、奏大雅が何を言おうとしているのか。
lines.translated: What is Kanade Taiga trying to say right now?

lines.content: ぼくにはまったく、わからない。
lines.translated: I don't understand at all.

lines.content: ……みんな、幸せになれた。[・|君][・|た][・|ち]以外のみんながだ
lines.translated: "...Everyone was able to find happiness. Everyone except for *the two of you*."

lines.content: 奏大雅はぽつりと、言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke quietly.

lines.content: 君が“夜の王”となり、ましろと俺を蘇らせる――そのために必要だった“魔法”を得ようとし、君は、俺として……奏大雅として生きた
lines.translated: "In order to become the 'King of the Night' and revive Mashiro and me--to obtain the 'magic' necessary for that, you lived as me... as Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: ……俺のことをヒーローだ、と。困難の底にあるたくさんの人たちを助けられる者なんだと。そう、信じてくれていた
lines.translated: "...You believed that I was a hero. Someone who could save the many people trapped in the depths of hardship."

lines.content: だから君は、そんな俺みたいになりたいと想い……俺を、真似ようとしてくれてたんだ。そうだよな？
lines.translated: "That's why you wished to become like me... and tried to imitate me. Isn't that right?"

lines.content: 奏大雅は照れたように笑った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga smiled sheepishly.

lines.content: そういうふうにして生きた君の、たくさん、たくさんの時間が、そして“想い”が、この“夜”の中には記録されている
lines.translated: "Countless, countless times and 'feelings' from the lives you lived that way are recorded within this 'Night.'"

lines.content: 柊ハルと生きた人生。杏藤千和と生きた人生。夜月姫織と生きた人生。……クロがその命をかけ、君に贈った幸せな時間だ
lines.translated: "The life you lived with Hiiragi Haru. The life you lived with Andou Chiwa. The life you lived with Yotsuki Himeori. ...Those are the happy times that Kuro risked her life to gift to you."
"*The versions of yourself who lived in timelines different from the you standing here right now*. Even all of their 'feelings' are recorded here."

lines.content: ……そういったあらゆる時間の中で得られた“想い”のすべてをかき集め、その果てに、世界中の誰もが憎む“夜の王”となることで、君は“魔法”を得られた――“夢”を叶えたんだ
lines.translated: "...By gathering together all of the 'feelings' obtained across every one of those timelines, and ultimately becoming the 'King of the Night' hated by everyone in the world, you obtained 'magic'--you granted your 'dream.'"

lines.content: ああそうだ。何度だって言おう
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I'll say it as many times as it takes."

lines.content: 君が奏大雅として生きたことで、あらゆる時間世界の人たちは、その人生にハッピーエンドを手に入れられた
lines.translated: "Because you lived as Kanade Taiga, the people across every timeline were able to obtain happy endings for their lives."

lines.content: 今も、この瞬間もだ。幸福であろうその時間は続いてる。この“夜”の世界に決してなくなることなく、記録されていっている
lines.translated: "Even now, at this very moment. Those surely blissful times are continuing on. They are being recorded in this world of the 'Night,' never to be lost."

lines.content: ……君は、柊ハルを“魔法”で撃ち抜いたしまった。そうした時間も確かに存在してしまっている
lines.translated: "...You ended up shooting through Hiiragi Haru with your 'magic.' A timeline like that certainly exists as well."

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: そうした話を今、俺がすべて語り聞かせたことで苦しみ、涙した“君”は。その、心は……
lines.translated: "And the 'you' who suffered and shed tears upon hearing me tell all of those stories just now. That heart is..."
"...the 'feelings'--the 'heart'--of yourself *who lived in a timeline different from this one*, which you gathered together in the 'Night' here in order to obtain 'magic.'"

lines.content: わからない。やっぱりぼくには何も、何ひとつ、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't know. I still don't understand anything, not a single thing, and yet...

lines.content: ふと、不思議な感覚が芽生えた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, a strange sensation welled up inside me.

lines.content: ぼくが奏大雅として生き……、
lines.translated: I lived as Kanade Taiga...

lines.content: そうしてぼくの中に、“魔法”を形にするためかき集めた時間や“想い”
lines.translated: And the times and "feelings" I gathered within myself to give form to "magic"...

lines.content: その“想い”があったから、ぼくは“魔法”を得られた――“夢”を叶えられたんだ。
lines.translated: It was because I had those "feelings" that I was able to obtain "magic"--that I was able to grant my "dream."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ぼくは“夢”を叶えられた。
lines.translated: I was able to grant my "dream."

lines.content: だからもう、“夜”の中で――いいや。
lines.translated: So inside the "Night"--no.

lines.content: [・|ぼ][・|く][・|の][・|中]で絡まり合った糸が一つ、またひとつ、解けていくような感覚があった。
lines.translated: It felt as though the tangled threads *inside of me* were coming undone, one by one.
And *what remained at the very end* inside of me was...
"...*Tangled threads cannot be used properly unless you unravel them*."

lines.content: 奏大雅が言葉を重ねる。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga continued speaking.
"*Remember*. *Just who are you*?"

lines.content: 再びかけられたその声と共に。
lines.translated: Along with that voice calling out to me once more...

lines.content: ……不思議だ。
lines.translated: How strange.

lines.content: 『……すべての時間が、“夜”の中に記録されてるなら』
lines.translated: "'...If all of time is recorded within the "Night"...'"
A single "feeling" *that still remained tangled up* echoed inside of me.

lines.content: 『私を助けるために死んでしまった[・|お][・|じ][・|さ][・|ん]の時間も、[・|こ][・|こ]には、あるはずだよね』
lines.translated: "'Then the time of the *mister* who died to save me must be *here* too, right?'"

lines.content: 『……そうだよ。おじさんの時間はまだ、救われないままどこかにあるはず』
lines.translated: "'...That's right. Your time must still be out there somewhere, unrescued.'"

lines.content: 『もし私が過去の世界で、おじさん。あなたのことを助けられたとしても……』
lines.translated: "'Even if I were able to save you in the world of the past, mister...'"

lines.content: 『そこで時間はまたひとつ、枝葉に別れてしまって……』
lines.translated: "'Time would just branch off once again right there...'"

lines.content: 『私を助けてくれたおじさん自身は。[あの子|クロ]をいつも探して、ひとりぼっちだったその人生は……誰にも、救うことができないままで……』
lines.translated: "'And the mister who saved me--that lonely life you spent always searching for Kuro, for that girl... would remain unable to be saved by anyone...'"
*That* is...

lines.content: 奏大雅から届けられた[・|こ][・|れ]は――最後に残った糸だ。
lines.translated: *This*, which was delivered to me by Kanade Taiga--is the final remaining thread.

lines.content: まだ解きほぐされていない、最後の糸……。
lines.translated: The final thread, still yet to be unraveled...

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.
Just who is *the me that remained at the very end*?

lines.content: 自分にそう問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked myself that question.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ぼくはいったい、何者なのか……。
lines.translated: Just who am I...?

lines.content: 迷い、戸惑い、ありもしない空を見上げる。
lines.translated: Lost and bewildered, I looked up at a nonexistent sky.

lines.content: そんなぼくにふと、またひとつ声が届いた。
lines.translated: And then, another voice suddenly reached me.
"'*I've come to get you, mister*.'"

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: ……そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: そう、だった。
lines.translated: That's what it was.
With that voice, *I remembered everything*.

lines.content: さっきから奏大雅の言葉に感じていた違和感の正体を。
lines.translated: The true nature of the sense of incongruity I had been feeling from Kanade Taiga's words just now.

lines.content: ……そして今、ここにいる[・|俺]が、何者なのかを。
lines.translated: And just who the *me* standing here right now is.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]は、幼い柊ハルを暗闇の部屋から助け出して……
lines.translated: "I rescued the young Hiiragi Haru from that dark room..."

lines.content: 柊ハルの母親と刺し違えるようにして、死んでしまった――[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]の[・|俺]だ。
lines.translated: And I died trading fatal blows with Hiiragi Haru's mother--I am the *me* from *that time*.

lines.content: 今、ここにこうしている[・|俺]は、あのときの時間世界の[・|俺]なのだと、[・|思][・|い][・|出][・|す]。
lines.translated: *I remembered* that the *me* standing here like this right now is the *me* from that timeline.

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|以][・|外][・|の][・|時][・|間]はすべて、君が“夜”の中で“最後の魔法”を得るために、必死になって掻き集めた“[記憶|想い]”のかけらだ
lines.translated: "*All the other times* are fragments of 'feelings'--of 'memories'--that you desperately gathered together within the 'Night' in order to obtain the 'final magic.'"

lines.content: 奏大雅は繰り返し、言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga repeated his words.

lines.content: ここにいる君は、あのときの君だ
lines.translated: "The you standing here is the you from back then."

lines.content: ……幼い柊ハルからどんなに好意を寄せられようと、その“想い”には応えられなかった
lines.translated: "...No matter how much affection the young Hiiragi Haru showed you, you couldn't answer those 'feelings.'"

lines.content: いつも、いつだって、探し求めていたたったひとりの女の子が、君の心の中で微笑んでいたから
lines.translated: "Because the one and only girl you had always, always been searching for was smiling inside your heart."

lines.content: そして、柊ハルの母親と刺し違え――……結果。その人生をかけて探し続けていた大切なひとと。クロと、最期に出会えた
lines.translated: "And then, you traded fatal blows with Hiiragi Haru's mother--...As a result, at the very end, you were able to meet the precious person you had spent your entire life searching for. You were able to meet Kuro."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]にいるのは、そんな人生を歩んだ君自身なんだ
lines.translated: "The one standing *here* is the very version of yourself who walked that life."

lines.content: 君の中にあった[・|今]以外の“[時間|想い]”はすべて、君が[・|こ][・|こ]で掻き集めたものだ。俺の告げた言葉に苦しんだ君の“想い”もすべて。“最後の魔法”を得るために
lines.translated: "All of the 'feelings'--the 'times'--inside of you other than *right now* were things you gathered together *here*. Including all of the 'feelings' of you that suffered from the words I told you. All to obtain the 'final magic.'"

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]は自分の手をじっと見つめる。
lines.translated: I stared intently at my own hands.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]の中にはもう、たくさんの“[時間|想い]”は残ってなかった。
lines.translated: The many "feelings"--the "times"--no longer remained inside of me.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]がいったいどの時点で、“夜”の中に記録されたたくさんの“想い”を掻き集め――“夜の王”と成りはてたのか。
lines.translated: At what point had I gathered together the countless "feelings" recorded within the "Night"--and ended up becoming the "King of the Night"?

lines.content: もうそれさえもわからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I didn't even know that anymore, but...

lines.content: 絡まり合った[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]はすべて、奏大雅から届けられた[・|も][・|の]をきっかけに[ほど|解]け、元の時間世界へ戻っていった。
lines.translated: Triggered by *what* Kanade Taiga had delivered to me, all of *those* tangled things came undone and returned to their original timelines.

lines.content: そして今、ここに残っているのはたったひとつだ。
lines.translated: And now, there was only one thing left remaining here.

lines.content: ……今、ここにいる君以外……[・|君][・|た][・|ち]以外みんな、幸せになれたんだ。君が奏大雅として生きたことで
lines.translated: "...Everyone other than the you standing here right now... everyone other than *the two of you* was able to find happiness. Because you lived as Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: だけどまだ、救われる可能性を示されることなく、不幸のただ中にある時間がひとつだけ、残ってる
lines.translated: "However, there is still just one time left remaining in the midst of misfortune, without having been shown any possibility of salvation."
*That* is me.

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right.

lines.content: 次々と思い出していく。
lines.translated: One memory after another came flooding back.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]は……

lines.translated: *I took the young Hiiragi Haru out of that dark room*.

lines.content: そして[ぼく|俺]は最期に、クロと逢えた。
lines.translated: And at the very end, I was able to reunite with Kuro.

lines.content: そのために[俺|ぼく]は死のうとしたんだ。
lines.translated: It was for that sake that I had tried to die.

lines.content: そしてこの手をクロに引かれ、“夜”の中へと導かれたけれど……。
lines.translated: And although Kuro took this hand of mine and guided me into the "Night"...

lines.content: それまでだ。
lines.translated: That was as far as it went.

lines.content: そこで[ぼく|俺]は自分の“夢”を思い出した――ましろ。奏大雅。ふたりを助ける。
lines.translated: There, I remembered my own "dream"--Mashiro. Kanade Taiga. To save the two of them.
*And so, I had no choice but to part ways with Kuro as well*.

lines.content: なぜなら、命をなくした人間は“次”へ向かわなければならないからだ。
lines.translated: Because a human who has lost their life must head toward the "next."

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]が、死ぬことでようやく出逢えたクロと、“夜”の中で過ごせたのは一週間程度が限界で……。
lines.translated: About a week was the limit of the time I could spend in the "Night" with Kuro, whom I had finally managed to meet by dying...

lines.content: やっぱり何も打つ手はなく。結局は、君たちふたりは別れざるを得なかった。そうだよな？
lines.translated: "There really was nothing you could do. In the end, the two of you had no choice but to part ways. Isn't that right?"

lines.content: 俺は“次”へ向かわなければならない。
lines.translated: I had to head toward the "next."

lines.content: ……たったひとり、永遠にも近い時間を生きるクロのことを残して。
lines.translated: Leaving behind Kuro, who lives through a span of time close to eternity, all alone.

lines.content: そのときに[ぼく|俺]はクロへと告げただろうか――“夢”を叶えるために、[ぼく|俺]は“夜の王”にならなくちゃいけないんだ、と。
lines.translated: Did I tell Kuro back then--that in order to grant my "dream," I had to become the "King of the Night"?

lines.content: 思い出せない。
lines.translated: I can't remember.

lines.content: ただ、[ぼく|俺]たちは泣いたように思う。
lines.translated: I just think that the two of us cried.

lines.content: このまま“[・|夜]”で、君と生きたい。
lines.translated: I want to stay like this and live with you in the "*Night*."

lines.content: 心はそう願っていたはずだ。
lines.translated: My heart must have wished for that.

lines.content: でも、無理だった。
lines.translated: But it was impossible.

lines.content: 命をなくしたただの人間である[ぼく|俺]は、“次”へ向かわなければ“夜”の一部に――“影”になるだけ。
lines.translated: As a mere human who had lost his life, if I didn't head toward the "next," I would only become a part of the "Night"--a "shadow."

lines.content: そのとき、届いたんだ。
lines.translated: That was when it reached me.
"'*I've come to get you, mister*.'"

lines.content: ぼくを。
lines.translated: To me...

lines.content: 『これが私の、“最後の魔法”……』
lines.translated: "'This is my "final magic"...'"

lines.content: ……俺を、幾千の夜を越え、助けに来てくれた小さな声が、届いた。
lines.translated: A small voice that crossed thousands of nights to come and save me reached me.

lines.content: 『おじさん。届けるよ。……今度こそ、あなたの“隣”に幸せを、届ける』
lines.translated: "'Mister. I'll deliver it to you. ...This time for sure, I'll deliver happiness right "beside" you.'"

lines.content: そして小さなその手に引かれ……。
lines.translated: And pulled along by that small hand...

lines.content: 暗闇の中を歩いて、歩いて……。
lines.translated: Walking and walking through the darkness...

lines.content: 俺は[・|こ][・|こ]で、目覚めた――奏大雅に撃ち抜かれることで。
lines.translated: I awoke *here*--by being shot through by Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: いや。違う
lines.translated: "No. You're wrong."

lines.content: 奏大雅は首を振った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga shook his head.

lines.content: 俺は確かに、“夜の王”と化した君を撃ち抜いた
lines.translated: "It's true that I shot through you after you became the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: だけどそれは俺の“[魔法|弾丸]”じゃない。柊ハル。俺が彼女から受け取った“魔法”だ。幼い彼女が君を……君だけを想い、“想像”した“最後の魔法”だよ
lines.translated: "But that wasn't my 'magic.' Hiiragi Haru. It was the 'magic' I received from her. The 'final magic' that her young self 'imagined' while thinking of you... and only you."

lines.content: そして君は――幼い柊ハルをその命を賭けてまで助けようとした君は、彼女の“最後の魔法”に手を引かれ、[・|今]、[・|こ][・|こ]に戻って来たんだ
lines.translated: "And you--the you who risked your very life to save the young Hiiragi Haru--were pulled along by the hand of her 'final magic' and brought back *here*, *now*."

lines.content: 幼い柊ハルを救おうとした君が、もう一度、新しい人生をはじめるために
lines.translated: "So that the you who tried to save the young Hiiragi Haru could start a new life once more."

lines.content: ……不幸の底に沈んでしまった時間を。新しく、ハッピーエンドの時間を作り上げる、そのためにね
lines.translated: "...To take the time that had sunk to the bottom of misfortune, and build a new time with a happy ending."

lines.content: 何度だって言おう。今、ここにいる君は、あのとき柊ハルを救い、命をなくした君自身――その人生の続きだ
lines.translated: "I'll say it as many times as it takes. The you standing here right now is the continuation of the life of the very same you who saved Hiiragi Haru back then and lost your life."

lines.content: 君はまだ、[・|こ][・|の][・|時][・|間][・|は]、不幸な終わりから脱していない。そんな自分自身の人生を救ってほしい
lines.translated: "You--*this time*--still haven't escaped from an unhappy ending. I want you to save that life of your own."

lines.content: ……君のためにと想い、“魔法”を描いた。そんな、[・|俺][・|た][・|ち][・|の][・|時][・|間][・|世][・|界][・|を][・|生][・|き][・|て][・|る]幼い柊ハルの“想い”に、どうか応えてあげてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "...She thought of doing it for your sake, and drew that 'magic.' I want you to please answer the 'feelings' of the young Hiiragi Haru *who is living in our timeline*."

lines.content: ……ここからだ
lines.translated: "...It starts from here."

lines.content: 奏大雅が言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga said.

lines.content: ここから君の人生がようやく、はじまるんだよ
lines.translated: "Your life finally begins from right here."

lines.content: ……君の幸せだけを願った幼い柊ハルはもちろん
lines.translated: "...Not just the young Hiiragi Haru, who wished only for your happiness..."

lines.content: 君を助けようとした千和や、姫織。あさひさんや十夜。そしてましろや、俺。今、君のことを想うたくさんの“想い”に応えてほしい
lines.translated: "Chiwa and Himeori, who tried to save you. Asahi-san and Toya. And Mashiro, and me. Right now, I want you to answer the many 'feelings' of everyone thinking of you."

lines.content: ……俺は今、そういうふうに君へ願い、頭を下げているんだよ。そのために長い、とても長い言葉と“想い”とを重ねてきたつもりだ
lines.translated: "...That is what I'm wishing of you right now as I bow my head. It's for that reason that I've piled up all these long, very long words and 'feelings.'"

lines.content: 最後に、ひとつ。ましろからの伝言だ
lines.translated: "And finally, one last thing. A message from Mashiro."

lines.content: 顔を上げたぼくに、奏大雅は微苦笑を浮かべ、“なんだよ”と言う。
lines.translated: When I raised my face, Kanade Taiga gave a faint, wry smile and said, "What's with that?"

lines.content: まったくさ、何なんだよ。色々と格好付けてさ、君の心に、大切に思える言葉を届けてはみたけれど……
lines.translated: "Seriously, what's with that? Here I went and tried to act all cool, delivering words to your heart that you could hold dear, and yet..."

lines.content: “ましろからの伝言”――そして“柊ハルから届いた[想い|魔法]”――それだけで、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|顔]、するんだもんな。やれやれだ。適わないな、本当に
lines.translated: "'A message from Mashiro'--and 'the feelings that arrived from Hiiragi Haru'--just hearing that is enough to make you *make a face like that*, huh. Good grief. I really can't compete with them."

lines.content: まあ、いつだって[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う]“役割”は女の子のものだ。男が男を心から励ませるよう場面なんて、そうそうないしね。別にいいんだ
lines.translated: "Well, *that kind of* 'role' has always belonged to girls. There aren't many scenes where a guy can truly encourage another guy from the bottom of his heart, anyway. So I don't really mind."

lines.content: 肩をすくめた奏大雅は、ぼくに[・|そ][・|の][・|言][・|葉]を届けてくれた。
lines.translated: Shrugging his shoulders, Kanade Taiga delivered *those words* to me.

lines.content: 『ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'Thank you.'"

lines.content: まず“夜”を通してそんな一言が、ぼくに響いた。
lines.translated: First, through the "Night," that single phrase echoed within me.

lines.content: 『あなたと、子猫ちゃんと、私。三人で少しの時間、過ごしたね。なんだか不思議な形の家族みたいでおかしかった』
lines.translated: "'You, the little kitten, and me. The three of us spent a little bit of time together, didn't we? It was funny, almost like a mysterious little family.'"

lines.content: 『けんかもしたし、不便なこともいっぱいあったけど……。でもね、とってもね、楽しかった――[・|今][・|の][・|私][・|に][・|は]そんな経験なんてないはずなのに』
lines.translated: "'We had fights, and there were lots of inconvenient things, too... But you know, it was really, truly fun--even though *the current me* shouldn't have any experience like that.'"

lines.content: 『それなのに、不思議』
lines.translated: "'And yet, it's so strange.'"

lines.content: 『あのときの楽しかったり、うれしかったり……悲しかったり、さみしかったりする気持ちもすべて、いいことも悪いこともまるごと全部、“夜”の中で取り戻せたから』
lines.translated: "'Because all the fun and happy feelings from back then... and all the sad and lonely feelings, too--both the good and the bad, every single bit of it--I was able to get it all back within the "Night."'"

lines.content: だから今、私の胸は、あのとき感じた気持ちでいっぱいなんだよとましろは言った――……ありがとう。
lines.translated: That's why right now, my chest is completely full of the feelings I felt back then, Mashiro said--...Thank you.

lines.content: 『ありがとうね、男の子』
lines.translated: "'Thank you, boy.'"

lines.content: 『私と出会ってくれてありがとう。私たちに幸せを届けてくれて、ありがとう……私、あなたと出会えて本当に、良かったよ』
lines.translated: "'Thank you for meeting me. Thank you for delivering happiness to us... I'm truly, truly glad that I was able to meet you.'"

lines.content: 『だからまた、会おうね。絶対』
lines.translated: "'So let's meet again, okay? Definitely.'"
"'*Next time*, in a different form...'"

lines.content: 『今度は、[・|四][・|人]一緒で暮らせますように』
lines.translated: "'Next time, I hope *the four of us* can live together.'"

lines.content: 『私、ここからずっと祈ってるから。君のこれからを全部、いっぱい、心から……応援してるからね』
lines.translated: "'I'll be praying from here the whole time. For everything in your future, with all I have, from the bottom of my heart... I'll be cheering for you, okay?'"

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]は、託された“魔法”を握りしめている――“その人の心はこれまで投げかけられた言葉の色でできている”
lines.translated: I clutched the "magic" that had been entrusted to me--"A person's heart is made of the colors of the words that have been cast upon them until now."

lines.content: ましろの言葉で少し、何かが動いた。
lines.translated: With Mashiro's words, something shifted slightly inside me.

lines.content: [ぼく|俺]を導いてくれた柊ハルの“想い”に、胸が、つまった。
lines.translated: At the "feelings" of Hiiragi Haru, who had guided me here, my chest tightened with emotion.

lines.content: 奏大雅の言葉で“勇気”が湧いた。
lines.translated: With Kanade Taiga's words, "courage" welled up within me.

lines.content: そして、クロがぼくに届けようとしてくれていた言葉と“想い”で――まっくらだったはずの心の中に、今、小さな星屑ほどの光りを見た気がした。
lines.translated: And with the words and "feelings" that Kuro had been trying to deliver to me--inside my heart, which should have been pitch-black, I felt as though I saw a light the size of a tiny piece of stardust right now.

lines.content: ぼくは……
いいや。[・|俺]は……
ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ぼくはあなた達と出会っても、良かったのかな
lines.translated: "Was it really okay for me to have met all of you?"

lines.content: ああ、良かったんだろうな
lines.translated: "Yeah, I'm sure it was."

lines.content: ……ぼくなんかが存在しなければ、どんな遠回りをしなくても、あなた達は幸せになれたのに？
lines.translated: "...Even though if someone like me hadn't existed, all of you could have become happy without having to take any of those detours?"

lines.content: ああ、それでもだ。俺たちは出会って良かったんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, even so. It was a good thing that we met."

lines.content: 少なくともましろはそう言ってたし、そう思ってる。あの子はうそがつけるほど器用じゃないし――だから今、こうして届けたあの子の言葉も気持ちも、うそじゃない。絶対に
lines.translated: "At the very least, Mashiro said so, and that's what she believes. That girl isn't clever enough to tell a lie--so the words and feelings of hers that I just delivered to you right now aren't a lie, either. Definitely not."

lines.content: 君と出会えて良かった、君のことを救いたい――
lines.translated: I'm glad I could meet you, I want to save you--

lines.content: そう思うのに確かな理由なんてなくてもいい。君のことが好きなんだ。君といると楽しいんだ。それだけで充分以上だ。だから、出会って良かった。君のことを取り戻したい。
lines.translated: You don't need a definite reason to feel that way. I like you. Being with you is fun. That alone is more than enough. That's why I'm glad we met. I want to take you back.

lines.content: 俺も、そう思ってるよ。君と出会えて良かった――……でも、どうかな
lines.translated: "I feel the same way, too. I'm glad I was able to meet you--...Though, who knows?"

lines.content: 俺はましろと違ってうそつきかもしれないぞ。大人は子どもにうそをつくのが仕事なんだ。だから本当にそう思ってるかどうかは、秘密だ
lines.translated: "Unlike Mashiro, I might be a liar. It's an adult's job to lie to children, after all. So whether or not I realmente feel that way is a secret."

lines.content: 少し、笑った。奏大雅も、ぼくも。
lines.translated: We laughed a little. Both Kanade Taiga, and I.

lines.content: ……ずっと
lines.translated: "...For the longest time..."

lines.content: ずっと、伝えたいことがあったんだ。
lines.translated: For the longest time, there was something I wanted to tell them.

lines.content: ……あなた達に伝えたいことがあった
lines.translated: "...There was something I wanted to tell all of you."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ぼくは、言う。
lines.translated: I said.

lines.content: ずっと、謝りたかった
lines.translated: "For the longest time, I wanted to apologize."

lines.content: 何度でも改めよう。
lines.translated: I would reaffirm it as many times as it took.

lines.content: ぼくがあなた達と出会わなければ、こんなことにはならなかった――
lines.translated: "If I hadn't met all of you, things wouldn't have turned out like this--"

lines.content: ぼくという存在そのものがこの物語の“悪性”だった。
lines.translated: My very existence itself was the "malignancy" of this story.

lines.content: だから無自覚の邪悪さを削除した。
lines.translated: That was why I deleted that unconscious wickedness.

lines.content: そうした先に生まれるのだろうあたらしい時間世界に、身勝手な“希望”を押しつけた。
lines.translated: And I forced my selfish "hope" onto the new timeline that would likely be born beyond that choice.

lines.content: ――ぼくがいなければ、少なくともあなたがあんなところで死ぬこともなかったし、ましろが、“夜の女王”になることもなかった
lines.translated: "--If I hadn't been there, at the very least you wouldn't have died in a place like that, and Mashiro wouldn't have become the 'Queen of the Night,' either."

lines.content: あなた達はもういいと言うだろうとわかってる。あなた達は、こんなぼくの存在を――邪悪さを、もういいんだよって、一瞬で許してくれるだろうとわかるんだ
lines.translated: "I know that all of you will probably say it's fine now. I know that you would forgive an existence like mine--this wickedness--in an instant, telling me that it's already okay."

lines.content: だからこそ自分で自分を罰する必要があったんだ。
lines.translated: And that was precisely why I needed to punish myself by my own hand.

lines.content: ……自己満足だろうといい。たとえ無意味だろうとそれでもいい。一度だけでいいんだ。こうして直接、謝りたかった
lines.translated: "...I don't care if it's just self-satisfaction. Even if it's meaningless, I don't mind. Just once is enough. I wanted to apologize to you directly like this."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 奏大雅は、笑う。満面と。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga smiled. A beaming, full-faced smile.

lines.content: なら、“夢”がひとつ叶ったな
lines.translated: "Then one of your 'dreams' has come true, hasn't it?"

lines.content: そして俺の頭をやさしく撫で、言った――……許すよ。
lines.translated: And then he gently stroked my head and said--...I forgive you.

lines.content: 俺は、君のことを許す
lines.translated: "I forgive you."

lines.content: まあ、一度だって俺は君を恨んだことはないんだけどなと言い、肩をすくめる――
lines.translated: "Well, not that I ever resented you even once in the first place," he added, shrugging his shoulders--

lines.content: 君のことをあの地下牢から外へ連れ出したのはまったくすべて、俺自身の問題なんだからと、そう言って。
lines.translated: Saying that taking me out of that underground dungeon was entirely, completely his own problem.

lines.content: だからさ。いい加減、君も自分の人生を生きろよ。いつまでもこんなところで立ち止まっていないで。そのためにいっぱいの言葉と、“想い”とを、君に届けたつもりだ
lines.translated: "So come on. It's about time you lived your own life, too. Stop standing still in a place like this forever. It was for that sake that I intended to deliver all those words and 'feelings' to you."

lines.content: それなのにもし今から[・|そ][・|う]しようとしないなら、君を許そうっていうこの気持ちもまた、変わってしまうかもしれないな
lines.translated: "Even after all that, if you still don't try to *do so* starting right now, this feeling of wanting to forgive you might just change, too, you know."

lines.content: 笑顔でそう言う奏大雅に、ぼくはうなずいて見せた。
lines.translated: As Kanade Taiga said that with a smile, I gave him a nod.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: “魔法”を握りしめる手が震えてる。
lines.translated: The hand clutching the "magic" was trembling.

lines.content: 恐怖なのか。
lines.translated: Was it fear?

lines.content: 安堵なのか。
lines.translated: Or was it relief?

lines.content: 自分でもよくわからない。
lines.translated: Even I didn't really know.

lines.content: ただ、この引き金を引くことをまだ、俺はまだは躊躇っている……。
lines.translated: It was just that, even now, I was still hesitating to pull this trigger...

lines.content: 君は、ヒーローの定義を知ってるかな
lines.translated: "Do you know the definition of a hero?"

lines.content: ふと、奏大雅は、震える俺にそう言った。俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Kanade Taiga said that to my trembling self. I shook my head.

lines.content: 自己犠牲の覚悟を決めた――そんな精神性を持つ者のことをヒーローと呼ぶんだよ。少なくともこの世界でヒーローという言葉を作った者にとって、それは、そういう存在だったんだ
lines.translated: "Someone who has resolved themselves to self-sacrifice--a person who possesses that kind of spirituality is what we call a hero. At the very least, to the person who created the word 'hero' in this world, that's the kind of existence it meant."

lines.content: 自分の全部を犠牲にし、俺たちのことを救ってくれた。君はまさにヒーローだった。そう言い切れる
lines.translated: "You sacrificed everything you had and saved us. You were truly a hero. I can declare that without a doubt."

lines.content: だけど、俺にとってのヒーローの定義には続きがあるんだ
lines.translated: "However, my own definition of a hero has a continuation."

lines.content: 奏大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga spoke.

lines.content: 君は、自分のことをその他大勢だと、何の価値も力もない通行人Ａだと言ったけど……
lines.translated: "You called yourself just another face in the crowd, a Passerby A with no value or power whatsoever, didn't you? But..."

lines.content: ヒーローは……
lines.translated: "A hero is..."

lines.content: 真の偉大さは、虐げられながらも何とか立ち上がり、懸命に生きようとする者たちの日常にこそあるものだと、信じてる
lines.translated: "I believe that true greatness lies within the everyday lives of those who, even while being oppressed, somehow manage to stand back up and try desperately to live."

lines.content: 俺たちの心はいつも、いつでも、さみしさや悲しみに病んでいるけれど。いつまでも明けない“夜”の暗闇に、いつだって、負けそうになってしまうけど……
lines.translated: "Our hearts are always, at all times, sick with loneliness and sadness. We are always on the verge of losing to the darkness of a 'Night' that never dawns, and yet..."

lines.content: 物語の中で戦うヒーローも。大勢の心を感動で震わせる創作者も。……所詮は悲しみの代弁者でしかないんだ
lines.translated: "Both the heroes who fight inside stories, and the creators who shake the hearts of the masses with emotion... in the end, they are nothing more than spokespeople for that sadness."

lines.content: “夜”より暗い明けることのない日常を、苦しみ、悲しみ、それでも生きる……そんな大勢の名もなき者たちがいなければ
lines.translated: "If not for the countless nameless people who suffer, grieve, and yet still live on through an everyday life darker than the 'Night' that never dawns..."

lines.content: ヒーローも。創作者も。彼らは戦うことも、一遍の“歌”さえ残すこともできないんだよ
lines.translated: "Neither the heroes, nor the creators. None of them would be able to fight, or even leave behind a single 'song.'"

lines.content: 真に尊い者は誰にも知られず、誰にも見つけてもらえず……。それでもその悲しみや苦しみをじっと静かに見つめ続けるものの中にこそあるものだ
lines.translated: "What is truly noble is found within those who, unknown to anyone and undiscovered by anyone... nevertheless continue to gaze quietly and steadily at that sadness and suffering."

lines.content: 誰の目にも留まらぬ名もなき者たちの名もなき闘争にこそ、同じように苦しむ誰かのたゆまぬ一歩に繋がる勇気になるだろう
lines.translated: "It is precisely the nameless struggles of the nameless people who catch no one's eye that will become the courage leading to a tireless step forward for someone else suffering in the same way."

lines.content: その一歩は、必ずこの世界を救う“希望”に変わると信じてる
lines.translated: "I believe that single step will surely turn into the 'hope' that saves this world."

lines.content: その手にひとつの武器や力を持たず、まるで、荒れ果てた荒野に放り投げられるようにして生まれ落ち……。
lines.translated: Born into this world holding not a single weapon or power in their hands, as if thrown out into a desolate wasteland...
*And what's more, those who look as though they are on the verge of dying at any moment*.
*Those who are the weakest of all*.
*That very figure of them trying to stand up against something overwhelming is what is truly the greatest of all*...
*And just how deeply moving a sight that truly is*.
"...And so."

lines.content: そういうふうに力なきものへ……、今を苦しむ名もなきもの達へと詠われた、[・|誰][・|か][・|の]“歌”と、君からもらった人生の中で俺は出会ったんだ
lines.translated: "In the life you gave me, I encountered *someone's* 'song' that was composed for the powerless like that... for the nameless people suffering in the present."

lines.content: ……遙か遠いいつかの時間の中で、たくさんの苦しみと悲しみを前に詠まれた“歌”が、俺の中に届いたんだよ
lines.translated: "...A 'song' composed before so much suffering and sadness, in some faraway time, reached inside of me."

lines.content: ふと足を止めた本屋。そこに並んだ一冊の本に、何気なく手を伸ばし……。
lines.translated: A bookstore where he had randomly stopped his feet. Casually reaching out a hand to a single book lined up there...

lines.content: 開いた中にその“[想い|言葉]”は綴られていた。
lines.translated: Those "words" were woven inside the pages he opened.

lines.content: その言葉は今も俺の“勇気”になってる。……目には見えない“魔法”になってる。自分は何の力もない人間だ――そういうふうに思い、悩んでばかりいたこの心に光りをくれた
lines.translated: "Those words have become my 'courage' even now. ...They have become an invisible 'magic.' They gave light to this heart of mine, which had done nothing but agonize, thinking that I was a human with no power whatsoever."

lines.content: だから同じように苦しむ君へ、この“歌”と“想い”を届けられたらとも、思ってた
lines.translated: "That's why I also wished that I could deliver this 'song' and these 'feelings' to you, who is suffering in the very same way."

lines.content: いつの間にか震えは止まっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the trembling had stopped.

lines.content: 俺はまだ自分自身を許せたわけじゃない。
lines.translated: It wasn't as though I had been able to forgive myself yet.

lines.content: それでももし、この暗闇の底から一歩、踏み出していけるなら……。
lines.translated: Even so, if I could take a single step forward out from the bottom of this darkness...
*I have to deliver it*.

lines.content: 俺は君に……。
lines.translated: To you, I...

lines.content: クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: 君に、届けなきゃならないものがある。
lines.translated: There is something I must deliver to you.

lines.content: “弾丸”は一発だけ。
lines.translated: There is only a single "bullet."

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|れ]こそれ奏大雅の“想像”した“魔法”
lines.translated: *This* is truly the "magic" that Kanade Taiga "imagined."

lines.content: やり直しは利かない。
lines.translated: There are no do-overs.

lines.content: 不安がないわけじゃないけれど……。
lines.translated: It's not that I have no anxieties, though...

lines.content: 心配も怖さも、まったく消えてしまったりはしないけど……。
lines.translated: Neither my worries nor my fears will ever completely disappear, either...

lines.content: いっぱいの罪悪感だってそうだ。完全に消えてなくなることは永遠にないだろう。
lines.translated: It's the same with all this overwhelming guilt. It will probably never vanish completely for all eternity.

lines.content: それでも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: それでも“拳銃”を握りしめる手は、不思議なことだけれど、もう震えは止まり――しっかりと“魔法”を握りしめている。
lines.translated: Even so, strangely enough, the hand clutching the "handgun" has already stopped trembling--holding tightly onto the "magic."

lines.content: そんな俺を見て、奏大雅は深くうなずく。どこか安心したように。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, Kanade Taiga gives a deep nod. As if somewhat relieved.

lines.content: そして、空を指さす。
lines.translated: And then, he points to the sky.

lines.content: 満天に光り輝く“夜”の空を。
lines.translated: Toward the sky of the "Night" shining radiantly across the whole heavens.

lines.content: ……さあ、行け。偉大なる名もなき者よ
lines.translated: "...Now, go. O great nameless one."

lines.content: ありふれた武器はいらない。強大な敵を打ち倒すための見栄えばかりが派手な特別な力もだ
lines.translated: "You don't need any commonplace weapons. Nor any flashy, special powers meant only for show to strike down mighty enemies."

lines.content: 自分自身の心と人生――そして、そんな自分の世界を作る大切なものたちを
lines.translated: "Your own heart and life--and the precious things that make up that world of yours."

lines.content: すべて……、全部だ
lines.translated: "All of them... every last one."

lines.content: 今まで重ねてきた君の苦しみと、悲しみと――いっぱいの“[想い|勇気]”の力だけを持って、君のその足で救いに走れ
lines.translated: "Carrying only the suffering and sadness you've accumulated until now--and the power of your overflowing 'courage,' run to save them on those two feet of yours."

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は、うなずき――何度もうなずき、“魔法”の銃口をこめかみに添えた。人差し指に力を込める。
lines.translated: I nodded--nodding over and over again, and pressed the muzzle of the "magic" against my temple. I put strength into my index finger.

lines.content: ああ……。最後にごめん。もうひとつだけ、アドバイスだ
lines.translated: "Ah... Sorry about this at the very end. Just one more piece of advice."

lines.content: 奏大雅が笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga said with a smile.

lines.content: 自分のことを異性というより、母性的な感情で好意を抱いてくれてる子を口説くのは、結構、簡単じゃないぞ。これは経験則だ。肝に銘じておくように
lines.translated: "Wooing a girl who holds affection for you out of maternal feelings rather than seeing you as the opposite sex is actually far from easy, you know. This is a rule of thumb from experience. Make sure you carve it into your heart."

lines.content: 俺は笑顔でうなずいた。
lines.translated: I nodded with a smile.
A "song"...

lines.content: とある“愛”と“勇気”の“歌”を心で口ずさんでいる。
lines.translated: In my heart, I am humming a certain "song" of "love" and "courage."
*What if*...

lines.content: この“歌”が幾つもの時を越え、たくさん、たくさんの人の心へ力を届けたように――
lines.translated: Just as this "song" crossed over countless eras and delivered strength to the hearts of so, so many people--
*If only*, I am permitted to do so...

lines.content: そういう可能性の時間が、どこかにあたらしく生まれるのなら。
lines.translated: If a time of such possibility is to be newly born somewhere out there.

lines.content: また会おう。
lines.translated: Let's meet again.

lines.content: 今度は違う形で。
lines.translated: Next time, in a different form.
*The four of us*, together...

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。その瞬間を信じて待ってる。いつまでも、ずっと
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I'll believe in that moment and wait for it. Forever, and always."

lines.content: 奏大雅はそう言った。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga said so.

lines.content: 俺は……。
返事の代わりに、引き金を引いた。
lines.translated: Instead of a reply, I pulled the trigger.

lines.content: その“弾丸”は俺の心を撃ち抜いた――駆け抜ける痛みも熱さもすべて、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]が俺に届けてくた“希望”の証しだ。
lines.translated: That "bullet" shot straight through my heart--the searing pain and the heat coursing through me were all proof of the "hope" that *the two of them* had delivered to me.

lines.content: そのまばゆさだけは決して忘れはしないと、俺は、漆黒の“夜”に咲くいくつもの光りに、誓った。
lines.translated: I swore to the countless lights blooming in the pitch-black "Night" that I would never forget that radiance alone.

lines.content: おやすみ、大雅。今夜はいい夢、見れますように
lines.translated: "Goodnight, Taiga. May you have sweet dreams tonight."

lines.content: 大雅との電話を終えた[・|わ][・|た][・|し]は、“ゆめのねどこ”の廊下でひとりつぶやいている。
lines.translated: Having finished my phone call with Taiga, *I* murmur to myself alone in the hallway of the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 受話器を置いて、一呼吸。
lines.translated: Setting down the receiver, I take a breath.

lines.content: どうしてなのかな。電話を終えるといつも、ちょっとだけ泣きたくなった。
lines.translated: I wonder why it is. Whenever I finish a phone call with him, I always feel a little bit like crying.

lines.content: なんだか大雅と繋がっていた全部が途切れてしまったようで……。
lines.translated: It feels as though everything that had been connecting me to Taiga has been severed...

lines.content: 胸の奥がちくちくする。
lines.translated: Deep inside my chest, it pricks with pain.

lines.content: これってなんていう気持ちなんだろう。
lines.translated: What is this feeling called, I wonder?

lines.content: ……わからない。
lines.translated: I don't know.

lines.content: わたしにはわからないことが多すぎる。
lines.translated: There are far too many things that I don't know.

lines.content: ため息をつくわたしは、大雅の部屋の――その扉に背中をぴったりつけて座り込んでいる。
lines.translated: Letting out a sigh, I am sitting slumped on the floor with my back pressed tightly against Taiga's room--against that door.

lines.content: 大雅と同じ時間の中に留まれているとき、電話をするのはここからと決めていた。
lines.translated: Whenever I was able to remain within the same flow of time as Taiga, I had decided that I would make my phone calls from right here.

lines.content: この扉の向こうに大雅がいる。
lines.translated: Taiga is just beyond this door.

lines.content: そう思うとなんでだか安心できたから。
lines.translated: Because thinking that made me feel relieved for some reason.

lines.content: 『……ねえ、クロ。今どこにいるの？』
lines.translated: "...Hey, Kuro. Where are you right now?"

lines.content: よく電話越しの大雅にそう問いかけられていた。でも、ここにいるとは言えなかった。
lines.translated: Taiga often asked me that over the phone. However, I couldn't tell him that I was right here.

lines.content: ほんとはすぐ近くにいるけれど、これ以上は近寄れない……近寄りたくない。だって。
lines.translated: The truth is that I'm right nearby, but I can't get any closer than this... I don't want to get any closer. Because.

lines.content: ……だってわたしは、きみの心を壊してしまうかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Because I might end up breaking your heart."

lines.content: 心のない黒猫から、[・|こ][・|の][・|姿]に変わった瞬間、もうわたしの中にその“[役割|力]”はなくなってしまったはずだけど……。
lines.translated: The moment I changed from a heartless black cat into *this form*, that "power" should have already vanished from within me, and yet...

lines.content: それでも不安だった。
lines.translated: Even so, I was anxious.

lines.content: わたしも……。
きみと一緒にいたいと願ったわたしも、あさひや十夜と同じような“夜の猫”に産まれ直すことができた。[・|そ][・|れ][・|な][・|り][・|の]“[・|代][・|償]”[・|を][・|支][・|払][・|っ][・|て]。
lines.translated: Having wished to be together with you, I too was able to be reborn as a "Cat of the Night" just like Asahi and Toya. *By paying a fitting "price"*.

lines.content: そんなわたしに“夜の猫”としてあたらしく産まれた力は、君の不幸をすべて、[・|こ][・|の][・|命]で肩代わりすることだ。
lines.translated: The power newly born within me as a "Cat of the Night" is to take on all of your misfortune in your stead with *this life of mine*.

lines.content: それはきみだけじゃない多くの子ども達をさみしくさせたわたしが、わたし自身に課した罪のようなものだった――……でも、それは[・|あ][・|と][・|か][・|ら][・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|っ][・|た][・|こ][・|と][・|な][・|の][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Having made not only you, but so many other children lonely, it was like a sin that I had imposed upon myself--...Even so, that was *something that only came to be after the fact*.

lines.content: わたしがきみの近くにいるのは危険だ。
lines.translated: For me to be near you is dangerous.

lines.content: いつまた[・|最][・|初][・|の][・|と][・|き]みたいに、無自覚に、誰かの心を壊してしまうかわからない――
lines.translated: I never know when I might unconsciously end up breaking someone's heart again, just like *that very first time*--

lines.content: さくらの樹に眠る夜色の子ども達。その心に命じられるまま、大雅のお母さんに近づき、その心を壊してしまったあのときみたいに。
lines.translated: The night-colored children sleeping in the cherry blossom tree. Just like back then, when I approached Taiga's mother just as ordered by their hearts, and ended up breaking her heart.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: まだ“さよなら”はできない。
lines.translated: I still can't say "goodbye" yet.

lines.content: きみに何かあったそのときは、こうしてできる限り近くにいないと、いざというときなにもできないから……。
lines.translated: Because if something were to happen to you, if I'm not as close to you as possible like this, I won't be able to do anything when the time comes...

lines.content: いつかきみに、わたしがしてしまった本当のことを話して……
lines.translated: "Someday, I'll tell you the truth about what I ended up doing..."

lines.content: そうしてもし、きみに嫌われてしまったとしても。
lines.translated: And then, even if you end up hating me for it.

lines.content: ……それでもきみのこと、わたし、護っていかなきゃ
lines.translated: "...Even so, I have to keep protecting you."

lines.content: いざというときそうできるだけの距離に、いつもいないとだめなんだ。
lines.translated: I always have to stay within a distance where I can do so if the worst should happen.

lines.content: だってこれは、わたしが、大雅……きみにできるたったひとつの“ごめんなさい”の気持ち、なんだから……
lines.translated: "Because this is the one and only way I can express my feelings of 'I'm sorry' to you, Taiga..."

lines.content: 抱え込んだ両膝に顔を埋め――少し、眠い。このままわたしも眠ってしまおう。そう思った。
lines.translated: Burying my face into the knees I was hugging to my chest--I'm a little sleepy. Maybe I'll just fall asleep like this, too. That was what I thought.

lines.content: 『……近寄るな』
lines.translated: "...Stay back."
Suddenly, inside my head as I began to doze off, I heard Taiga's voice--...*I had inadvertently let my mind wander into an awful imagination*.

lines.content: 『近寄るなよ』
lines.translated: "Stay back, dammit."

lines.content: 『[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]をしておいて、よく、何食わぬ顔でいつも近くに……』
lines.translated: "After doing *something like that*, how dare you always stay near me with such an innocent look on your face..."

lines.content: 『お前は、悪魔だ。まっくろだ』
lines.translated: "You're a demon. Pitch-black to the core."

lines.content: 『……来るな。あっちに行けよ』
lines.translated: "...Don't come near me. Go away."

lines.content: 『もう顔も見たくない。……後悔してる』
lines.translated: "I don't even want to see your face anymore. ...I regret it."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 『お前なんかと出会わなければよかった』
lines.translated: "I wish I had never met the likes of you."

lines.content: そう、だよね。[・|ハ][・|ル]の言うとおりだ。
lines.translated: That's right, isn't it? It's just as *Haru* says.

lines.content: ……わたし達は出会わなければよかったんだよ――ううん。わたしなんか、産まれてこなければよかったんだ
lines.translated: "...We never should have met--no. Someone like me never should have been born in the first place."

lines.content: わたしの“悪夢”がわたしの中で、大雅の声で、ときにわたし自身の姿と声で、絶え間なくわたしに囁いていた。
lines.translated: Inside of me, my "nightmare" was endlessly whispering to me in Taiga's voice, and at times with my own figure and voice.

lines.content: こんな嫌な夢がもし、現実になってしまったとしても……。
lines.translated: Even if a horrible dream like this were to become reality...

lines.content: ……わたし、きみのこと、ずっと護っていきたい。……護って、いかなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I want to keep protecting you forever. ...I have to protect you."

lines.content: そのために、いつもきみにバレないよう、気をつけて、そばにいないと……。
lines.translated: For that sake, I always have to be careful not to let you find out, and stay right by your side...

lines.content: ……うう
lines.translated: Ugh.

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: また、胸の奥がちくりとした。
lines.translated: Once again, a sharp prickle stung deep inside my chest.

lines.content: こんな自分勝手な心なんて今すぐ見捨てられますようにと願い――……わたしは、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Wishing that a selfish heart like this would just be abandoned right this instant--...I stand up.

lines.content: もう何日も寝ていない。
lines.translated: I haven't slept for days now.

lines.content: わたしは眠った分だけ少し先の未来に跳んでしまう。この命が、大雅からそういう“不幸”を受け取ったから。
lines.translated: I end up leaping slightly further into the future by the exact amount of time that I sleep. Because this life of mine received that kind of "misfortune" from Taiga.

lines.content: だから少しでも今と同じ大雅の側にいたくて、眠いの我慢していたけれど……。
lines.translated: That's why I had been holding back my sleepiness, wanting to stay by the side of the Taiga of this present moment for even a little bit longer, but...

lines.content: そろそろ限界そうだった。
lines.translated: It seemed I was just about at my limit.

lines.content: いつ眠ってしまうかわからない。だからその前に……少しだけ“さよなら”する前に、きみの顔を見つめていたいから、
lines.translated: I don't know when I might end up falling asleep. So before that happens... before I say "goodbye" for just a little while, I want to gaze at your face, so,

lines.content: こっそり扉を開き、大雅の部屋を覗き込んだ。
lines.translated: I quietly cracked open the door and peeked into Taiga's room.

lines.content: 見つからないかどきどきしたけど、大丈夫。ピンと立てた耳に確かに聞こえる。大雅は微かな寝息を立てていた。
lines.translated: My heart was pounding, worried I might get caught, but it was okay. With my ears perked up straight, I could hear it clearly. Taiga was breathing softly in his sleep.

lines.content: 寝顔を見つめられる距離まで近寄ってみる――音を立てないよう、慎重に。
lines.translated: I tried stepping closer until I could gaze at his sleeping face--carefully, so as not to make a sound.

lines.content: “さよなら”する前にどうしても顔を見たかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to see his face no matter what before saying "goodbye."

lines.content: でも、眠ることがあまり得意ではないきみだ。ようやく眠れたのに起こしてしまうなんていやだった。
lines.translated: Still, sleeping isn't really your strong suit. Now that you'd finally fallen asleep, the last thing I wanted was to wake you up.

lines.content: 大雅はいつも未来に不安を感じているように見えた。……そうした少しの怖さも。心配も。
lines.translated: Taiga always seemed anxious about the future. ...Even just that little bit of fear. And that worry.

lines.content: すべてが意地悪に作用して、大雅を夢の世界へ導くことを邪魔してるみたいに見えた。
lines.translated: It seemed like all of it was working against him out of spite, getting in the way of guiding Taiga into the world of dreams.

lines.content: 今夜もあんまり眠れそうにない――そう電話では言っていたけれど……、
lines.translated: He had told me over the phone that he probably wouldn't be able to sleep much tonight either, and yet...

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: 覗き込んだ寝顔は穏やかそう。
lines.translated: The sleeping face I peeked down at looked so peaceful.

lines.content: 今、大雅がどんな夢を見ているのかわからない。けれど、苦しそうには見えないからいい夢だと信じたい――……ごめんねと、わたしは小さく言った。
lines.translated: I don't know what kind of dream Taiga is having right now. Still, he doesn't look like he's in pain, so I want to believe it's a good dream--...I'm sorry, I whispered softly.

lines.content: ……ごめん。大雅
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga."

lines.content: 音痴なわたしは子守歌とか上手に歌えない。
lines.translated: Being tone-deaf, I can't sing lullabies very well.

lines.content: 何も知らないばかな子だから、静かな眠りに誘う物語を、枕元で話して聞かせることもできやしない。
lines.translated: Since I'm a foolish girl who doesn't know anything, I can't even sit by your pillow and tell you stories to lure you into a quiet sleep.

lines.content: でも、わたしと少し電話で話して……。
lines.translated: Even so, just talking with me on the phone for a little bit...

lines.content: 今夜、こうして眠れるくらいの安心は、わたし、きみにあげられたのかな
lines.translated: "Did I manage to give you enough peace of mind to fall asleep like this tonight?"

lines.content: そう思うとうれしかった。
lines.translated: Thinking that made me happy.

lines.content: きみに届けてしまった不幸を、これっぽっちでなかったことにできるとは思ってない。
lines.translated: I don't think something this small can undo the misfortune I brought upon you.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: ……大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: わたし、少しでもきみの役に立ってるかな。
lines.translated: Am I being even a little bit useful to you?

lines.content: わたし……
わたしは、もう少し生きててもいいのかな。
lines.translated: Is it okay for me to keep living just a little longer?

lines.content: そんな思いが少しだけ、心を過ぎり……、
lines.translated: Thoughts like that briefly crossed my mind...

lines.content: 大雅。おやすみ
lines.translated: "Taiga. Goodnight."

lines.content: ……今度は電話越しではなく、眠ってるきみへ直接――そっと、静かに囁く。
lines.translated: This time, not over the phone, but directly to the sleeping you--I whispered softly, quietly.

lines.content: きみが今、簡単に眠れなくなるくらい何を、苦しんで……悲しんでるのか。ばかなわたしにはわからない。……たぶん、この先もずっとそう
lines.translated: "What is making you suffer... and grieve so much right now that you can't even fall asleep easily? Someone as foolish as me doesn't understand. ...And I probably never will."

lines.content: ましろと奏大雅を不幸にしてしまった――そういう“想い”はわかるけれど、それでもたぶん、わたしはその悲しい気持ちのすべてをわかってあげられない。
lines.translated: I made Mashiro and Kanade Taiga miserable--I understand those "feelings," and yet I probably still can't fully grasp all of that sorrow for you.

lines.content: それはすごく、悲しいけれど。
lines.translated: Even though that makes me terribly sad.

lines.content: きみの、人生。これから続く時間の全部。わたしがすべて、護っていくよ。九つある命、全部使って。だから……
lines.translated: "Your life. All the time that continues from here on out. I will protect every bit of it. Using all nine of my lives. So..."

lines.content: だから安心してねと小さくちいさく、わたしは言った。
lines.translated: So please rest easy, I said in a tiny, tiny voice.

lines.content: そして、眠る大雅の手に触れた。
lines.translated: And then, I touched the sleeping Taiga's hand.

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: わたしはわたしの“力”を使う――[・|こ][・|の][・|程][・|度]なら命を使うまでもない。
lines.translated: I use my "power"--for *something on this level*, I don't even need to use up a life.

lines.content: そうして今夜も、明日の夜も、その次の夜だって……きみの心から悪い夢をすべて取り除けますようにと祈ってる――……ぎゅっ、と。
lines.translated: Like that, tonight, tomorrow night, and the night after that too... I pray that I can take away all the bad dreams from your heart--...Squeeze.

lines.content: 大雅に手を握りしめられた。
lines.translated: Taiga gripped my hand tightly.

lines.content: 驚いたわたしは飛び上がりそうになる。
lines.translated: Startled, I nearly jumped out of my skin.

lines.content: 大雅が目を覚ましたのかと思った。
lines.translated: I thought Taiga had woken up.

lines.content: ごめん大雅。せっかく眠れてたのに起こしちゃったかもしれない。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Taiga. You were finally able to sleep, and I might have woken you up.

lines.content: それに……。
lines.translated: Not only that...

lines.content: 眠ってる間に手を握ってたなんて知られたら――どうなるのかな。よく、わからない。でも、それってすごく恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: If you found out I was holding your hand while you slept--what would happen? I don't really know. Still, that's super embarrassing.

lines.content: 大雅に気づかれる前に隠れなきゃ――部屋から出なきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to hide before Taiga notices me--I have to get out of the room.

lines.content: だけど運動神経だってだめだめなわたしだ。咄嗟に動けず、身体は固まる。
lines.translated: Even my reflexes are hopeless, though. Unable to move on the spot, my body froze.

lines.content: 手を握られたままわたわたと焦るばかりで……。
lines.translated: With my hand still held in his, all I could do was fluster and panic...

lines.content: う、んん……
lines.translated: "U-Nnn..."

lines.content: でも、大雅は寝ぼけていただけみたいだ。
lines.translated: However, it seemed Taiga was just half-asleep.

lines.content: 微笑むみたいに口元を少し緩ませ……。
lines.translated: His lips relaxed slightly, as if breaking into a smile...

lines.content: まるで母猫に甘える子猫みたいに、わたしの手をずっと、繰り返しにぎにぎとしていて……、
lines.translated: Just like a kitten spoiling itself on its mother cat, he kept squeezing my hand over and over again...

lines.content: ……うう。どうしよう
lines.translated: "...Ugh. What do I do?"

lines.content: わたしは、真っ赤になる。
lines.translated: My face turned bright red.

lines.content: 胸の奥がうるさいくらいどきどきしてる――……[・|わ][・|か][・|ら][・|な][・|い]。どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: Deep in my chest, my heart was pounding loud enough to be noisy--...*I don't understand*. Why is this happening?

lines.content: どうしてわたしは、大雅と触れると、[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]なっちゃうんだろう。
lines.translated: Why do I end up *like this* whenever I touch Taiga?

lines.content: “心”は思い通りにならなくて、わからないことばっかりだ――こんなの要らないと思ったり。でも、やっぱり欲しいと思ったり。本当に、よくわからない。
lines.translated: A "heart" never does what you want it to, and it's full of things I don't understand--sometimes I think I don't need something like this. Other times, I think I want it after all. I really don't get it.

lines.content: ……どきどきうるさい胸の音。
lines.translated: The noisy, pounding sound in my chest.

lines.content: この音だけで大雅を起こしてしまうかも……。それくらい大きなおおきな音だった。
lines.translated: This sound alone might wake Taiga up... That was how loud, how terribly loud it was.

lines.content: 真っ赤な顔のその熱も、きみと繋いだ手のひらにじんわり広がっていくけれど……。
lines.translated: The heat from my bright red face was slowly spreading into the palm of my hand joined with yours, and yet...

lines.content: でも、繋いだ手は解けずにいた。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't bring myself to let go of your hand.

lines.content: これくらいなら、いいかな……。
lines.translated: Just this much is okay, right...?

lines.content: そんなふうに思ってる。
lines.translated: That's what I was thinking.

lines.content: 絶対、起こさないよう静かにしてる。うるさくしないよ。
lines.translated: I'll definitely stay quiet so I don't wake you. I won't make a fuss.

lines.content: だから……、
lines.translated: So...

lines.content: ……きみが眠ってる時間だけ、わたし、きみの側にいてもいいかな
lines.translated: "...Just for the time that you're asleep, is it okay if I stay by your side?"

lines.content: わたしはきみの側にいられない。きみを不幸にしたわたしに、そんな資格なんてどこにもない。
lines.translated: I can't stay by your side. After making you miserable, I don't have the right to do that anywhere.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: たったひとりで生きていくのはとてもつらくて、さみしいことだ――と、想像するよ。
lines.translated: Living all alone must be so painful and lonely--at least, that's what I imagine.

lines.content: だから大雅のことを大切に想ってくれるだろうハルや、千和や姫織みたいなかわいい子に、いつも大雅のそばにいてほしかった。大雅と一緒に生きていってくれる子を探してた。
lines.translated: That's why I wanted cute girls like Haru, Chiwa, and Himeori, who would surely cherish Taiga, to always be by his side. I was looking for a girl who would live her life together with Taiga.

lines.content: 大雅に“夢”を……ましろのことを忘れさせてくれるほど、きらきら眩しい人生を、一緒に過ごせる誰かのことを……。
lines.translated: Someone who could give Taiga a "dream"... someone he could spend a dazzling, sparkling life with, bright enough to make him forget about Mashiro...

lines.content: そんなひとりぼっちじゃない時間を、大雅……きみの“隣”に届けたい。
lines.translated: I want to deliver a time like that, where you aren't all alone, right "next" to you, Taiga.

lines.content: そのためならわたし、なんでもできるよ――……なんでも、しなきゃ。
lines.translated: For that sake, I can do anything--...I have to do anything.

lines.content: きみの時間は全部、きみを想うかわいい子たちと一緒にあれるようにと、祈らなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to pray that all of your time can be spent together with the cute girls who care about you.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: でもね。
lines.translated: But, you know.

lines.content: ……我がままを、ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry for being selfish.

lines.content: この時間だけは、わたしだけのものにしてもいいかな……。
lines.translated: Just for this moment, is it okay if I make it mine and mine alone...?

lines.content: 絶対、ぜったい、きみにバレないようこっそりするから……
lines.translated: "I'll definitely, definitely do it in secret so you won't find out..."

lines.content: 誰でもない誰かに言い訳するみたいにつぶやいて――眠る大雅の手を握り返してみたりする。
lines.translated: Murmuring as if making an excuse to no one in particular--I tried squeezing the sleeping Taiga's hand back.

lines.content: にぎにぎと、仕返してみたりする。
lines.translated: I tried giving it a little squeeze-squeeze in return.

lines.content: 両手で包んでみたりする。頬ずりしようとしてみて……それは恥ずかしいからやっぱりやめる。
lines.translated: I tried wrapping both hands around it. I tried rubbing my cheek against it... before deciding not to after all because it was too embarrassing.

lines.content: けど。
lines.translated: Still.

lines.content: お、おでこ、くっつけるくらいなら、いいかなあ
lines.translated: "J-Just pressing our foreheads together should be okay, right?"

lines.content: なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 誰にともなく言い訳してみたりした。
lines.translated: I tried making an excuse to no one in particular.

lines.content: いつも不思議に思ってる。
lines.translated: I always find it so mysterious.

lines.content: こうして大雅に触れてるだけで、心がぽかぽかするみたい。
lines.translated: Just touching Taiga like this makes my heart feel so warm and fuzzy.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 思わず言葉がこぼれた。
lines.translated: The words slipped out before I knew it.

lines.content: ……大雅。きみが産まれてきてくれたから……わたし、今、とってもうれしい
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Because you were born into this world... right now, I'm so, so happy."

lines.content: 心の中から、つい、そんな言葉がぽろぽろこぼれる。
lines.translated: Words like that inadvertently spilled out from deep within my heart.

lines.content: 大雅……。わたしね。自分のこともよくわからないくらい、何も、知らないけれど……。たぶん……わたしは……
lines.translated: "Taiga... You see, I don't know anything at all, to the point where I don't even really understand myself, and yet... Maybe... I..."

lines.content: でも、それ以上は口にできないままで……、
lines.translated: However, unable to put anything more into words...

lines.content: うとうとと、しはじめる。
lines.translated: I began to drift off.

lines.content: わたし……。
わたしね、きみの手を握ってると安心するんだよ――つい眠ってしまっても大丈夫、こうして手を繋いでいるんだから、きっとまたすぐに会えるよ。そう、信じられるから。
lines.translated: You see, holding your hand makes me feel safe--even if I accidentally fall asleep, it'll be okay, because we're holding hands like this, so we'll surely be able to meet again soon. Because I can believe that.

lines.content: だからわたしは、安心して。
lines.translated: So, feeling at ease.

lines.content: なんの不安もないままに……。
lines.translated: Without a single trace of anxiety left...

lines.content: わたしは今夜も、大雅と手を繋いだまま静かに眠りの世界へと落ちていき――……[・|消][・|え][・|て][・|い][・|く]。
lines.translated: Tonight, too, while still holding hands with Taiga, I quietly fell into the world of sleep--...*and faded away*.

lines.content: 今度はどれだけ先へと跳ぶのだろうか。
lines.translated: How far ahead will I leap this time?

lines.content: 今度はどれだけ、きみの時間が、わたしのいる時間に追いついてくれるまで、この部屋で……ひとりぼっちで待っていなきゃいけないのか――すべて、わからないけど。
lines.translated: How long will I have to wait all alone in this room this time, until your time catches up to the time where I am--I don't know any of that, and yet.

lines.content: 祈ってる。
lines.translated: I'm praying.

lines.content: 少し先の未来でいつもきみの無事だけを祈ってる。きみが、さみしくならないようにと願ってる。
lines.translated: In a future slightly ahead, I'm always praying solely for your safety. Wishing that you won't become lonely.

lines.content: いつか……。
lines.translated: Someday...

lines.content: こんな、わたしの……。
lines.translated: Wishing that these...

lines.content: [・|き][・|み][・|と][・|同][・|じ][・|に][・|な][・|り][・|た][・|い]出来損ないなわたしの“想い”が、いつか、あたたかな春の歌みたいに――きみのことを少しだけでいい、笑顔にできる何かへ変わりますように。
lines.translated: These "feelings" of a defective girl like me *who wants to become the same as you* will someday, like a warm spring song--turn into something that can make you smile, even if only just a little bit.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: おやすみ。
lines.translated: Goodnight.

lines.content: ……さよなら、ばいばい。いつまでも幸せにね、大雅
lines.translated: "...Goodbye, bye-bye. Be happy forever, Taiga."

lines.content: そんな細やかな未来を信じたいと、わたしは、いつも願ってて――……
lines.translated: I'm always wishing to believe in such a modest future--...
It was a "dream."

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 一瞬の“夢”を見ていた――
lines.translated: Was having a fleeting "dream"--

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”の空から、はらはらと、
lines.translated: From the "Night" sky I looked up at, fluttering down,

lines.content: まるで舞い散る花びらみたいに降り注ぐ光の中で、[・|そ][・|れ]を見た。
lines.translated: Amidst the light pouring down like scattering petals, I saw *it*.
What I had just seen was *a time from someday*.
One of the versions of you that I don't know, remembered by the "Night" of this town--*a time belonging to the two of us, you and me, that I don't know*.

lines.content: はらはらと舞うひとひらをひとつ、ふと、手のひらで受け止めたときそれを見た。
lines.translated: I saw it the moment I casually caught a single fluttering petal in the palm of my hand.

lines.content: “魔法”だ。
lines.translated: It was "magic."

lines.content: 俺は奏大雅の“魔法”で自分自身を撃ち抜き、[・|こ][・|こ]で、目覚めた。
lines.translated: I shot right through myself with Kanade Taiga's "magic" and woke up *here*.

lines.content: 見上げた空には満開に咲いたさくらの天井。
lines.translated: In the sky I looked up at was a ceiling of cherry blossoms in full bloom.

lines.content: しかし辺りは暗闇の底。耳を澄ませば、遠い“夜”の中から汽笛の音が響いてる。
lines.translated: Yet all around me was the bottom of darkness. Straining my ears, I heard the sound of a steam whistle echoing from within the distant "Night."

lines.content: ここは、いったい……
lines.translated: "Where in the world is this place...?"

lines.content: いったい[・|ど][・|こ]なのかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know *where* on earth I am.

lines.content: だが、予想することくらいはできる。
lines.translated: Still, I can at least make a guess.

lines.content: ここは“夜”に幾層も降り積もった記憶の書庫のような場所。
lines.translated: This place is like an archive of memories piled up in countless layers within the "Night."

lines.content: 辺りを見回せばいくつもの光りが見える。まるで満天の星空が足下に落ちてきたかのような風景だ。
lines.translated: Looking around, I can see numerous lights. The scenery looks as if a starry sky had fallen right down to my feet.

lines.content: その瞬きの中には[・|扉]があった。小窓があった。そこから中を覗き込む。
lines.translated: Within that twinkling, there were *doors*. There were small windows. I peered inside through them.

lines.content: するとそこには未来があった。通り過ぎ行く過去と現在があった。ありとあらゆる時間がここにはあった。
lines.translated: There, I found the future. There were the passing past and the present. Every conceivable kind of time existed here.

lines.content: そのひとつを今、俺は垣間見たのだろう。
lines.translated: I must have just caught a glimpse of one of them.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: クロが自身の“悪夢”に喰われ、死んでしまう――
lines.translated: A time where Kuro is devoured by her own "Nightmare" and dies--

lines.content: それ以外の道を辿る時間は、可能性の世界は、その光りの中にはなかった。どこにも、なかった。
lines.translated: Within those lights, there was no time, no world of possibility, that followed any other path. Nowhere at all.

lines.content: そういう可能性はまだ一度も、この時間と空間の中に産まれていないということなのだろう。
lines.translated: It probably means that such a possibility has never once been born within this time and space.

lines.content: 誰も……。
lines.translated: No one...

lines.content: あらゆる時間。あらゆる可能性のその中にあって尚――まだ誰も、誰ひとり、彼女のことを救えていないということなのだ。
lines.translated: Even amidst all of time and all possibilities--no one, not a single person, has been able to save her yet.

lines.content: それは、クロだけがひとりぼっちであるように思えて……。
lines.translated: That made it feel as though Kuro alone was all by herself...

lines.content: クロだけが、誰にも知られないまま、誰にも見向きもされないまま、“夜”の中に取り残されてしまっているように、思えて……。
lines.translated: It felt as though Kuro alone had been left behind in the "Night," unknown to anyone, unnoticed by anyone...

lines.content: ……行こう
lines.translated: "...Let's go."

lines.content: 歩いて行こう。
lines.translated: Let's start walking.

lines.content: クロ。あの日、[・|あ][・|の][・|瞬][・|間]の中で待っててほしい。俺は君に、どうしても伝えなければならないことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "Kuro. I want you to wait for me inside *that moment* on that day. There is something I absolutely must tell you."

lines.content: 誰も知らないクロの時間を見たからだろうか。それとも、奏大雅の“魔法”で自分自身を撃ち抜いたからだろうか。
lines.translated: Is it because I saw Kuro's time that no one else knows? Or is it because I shot through myself with Kanade Taiga's "magic"?

lines.content: まだ自分自身を許せたわけでは決してない。
lines.translated: It certainly doesn't mean I've been able to forgive myself yet.

lines.content: それでも今、俺は自分の心に確かな力を感じてる。どこまでもたゆまず歩いて行けるだろう覚悟をだ――奏大雅の“魔法”は俺のものとは少し違う。
lines.translated: Even so, right now, I feel a definite strength in my heart. A resolve that will let me keep walking tirelessly as far as it takes--Kanade Taiga's "magic" is a little different from mine.

lines.content: “希望”だ。
lines.translated: It is "hope."

lines.content: その“弾丸”で撃ち抜いた俺自身が、“希望”を感じた時間の中に戻ることができるというもの。
lines.translated: Having been shot through by that "bullet," I myself am able to return to a time where I felt "hope."

lines.content: はらはらはらりと舞い落ちる――
lines.translated: Fluttering, drifting down--

lines.content: この花びらはクロの時間と記憶だ。その一つひとつが、俺にとっての“希望”なのだろうか。
lines.translated: These petals are Kuro's time and memories. Could each and every one of them be "hope" for me?

lines.content: 『……大丈夫』
lines.translated: "...It's okay."

lines.content: ……はらり、
lines.translated: Fluttering down,

lines.content: 『……大丈夫だよ。絶対、ぜったい。きみをひとりぼっちにはさせないよ』
lines.translated: "...It's okay. Never, ever. I'll never let you be all alone."

lines.content: ……はらりと。
lines.translated: Fluttering softly.

lines.content: どこまでも歩くと決めた俺が一歩、また一歩と進む度――心にまたひとつ、俺の知らない時間が降り積もっていく。
lines.translated: Having decided to walk as far as it takes, with every step and then another that I take forward--another piece of time I didn't know piles up in my heart.

lines.content: 『……おやすみ大雅。きみの“隣”に、いつも幸せな“魔法”がありますように』
lines.translated: "...Goodnight, Taiga. May there always be happy 'magic' right 'beside' you."

lines.content: ……いつも少し先の未来から、俺の人生すべてを応援してくれていた。
lines.translated: From a future slightly ahead, she was always cheering on my entire life.

lines.content: 『いつか……大人になったきみが、わたしのことを忘れてしまっても。それでもずっと、きみのこと、見てるから』
lines.translated: "Someday... even if you grow up and forget all about me. Even so, I'll always be watching over you."

lines.content: 時の止まった部屋の中、君はいつもたったひとりで祈ってた。
lines.translated: Inside a room where time had stopped, you were always praying all by yourself.

lines.content: 『いやだよ大雅っ、大雅、どうしてこんなっ、無茶ばかり……っ』
lines.translated: "No, Taiga, Taiga, why are you always... being so reckless...!"

lines.content: 無茶した俺が勝手にボロボロになったとき、それで君を泣かせてしまったあのときも。
lines.translated: Even back when I acted recklessly and ended up battered and bruised on my own accord, making you cry because of it.

lines.content: 『きみが、いなくなってしまったら、わたしは……わたしっ、どうしたら……いいのっ』
lines.translated: "If you were to disappear, what... what am I... supposed to do...!"

lines.content: クロがこれまでどんなふうに想いながら、俺を見守り、助けてくれていたのか……。
lines.translated: What kind of feelings Kuro held all this time as she watched over me and saved me...

lines.content: さくらの花びらが舞い散る度に、一つ、またひとつ、俺はようやく知っていくのだ。
lines.translated: Every time a cherry blossom petal scatters, one by one, I finally come to know them.

lines.content: ……ありがとう、クロ
lines.translated: "...Thank you, Kuro."

lines.content: そうつぶやかずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but murmur the words.

lines.content: ……こんなにも俺は、君に想われていたなんて
lines.translated: "...To think I was cherished by you this much."

lines.content: ……それを知りもしないで。知ろうとも、しないで。
lines.translated: Without even knowing it. Without even trying to know.

lines.content: 俺は君をひとり、置いて行ったんだ
lines.translated: "I left you behind, all alone."

lines.content: はらはらと舞う花びらに触れ、取り残された君の気持ちを今になってようやく知った俺だから……。
lines.translated: Because I touched the fluttering petals and finally learned the feelings of the you who was left behind...

lines.content: 行こう。
lines.translated: Let's go.

lines.content: どこまでも。
lines.translated: As far as it takes.

lines.content: ……どこまでだって。
lines.translated: No matter how far.

lines.content: ……歩いて、行くんだ
lines.translated: "...I'm going to keep walking."

lines.content: やっぱりまだ、俺は[・|ぼ][・|く]自身を許せない。
lines.translated: Even so, I still can't forgive *myself*.

lines.content: たとえましろや奏大雅が“もういいんだよ”と言ってくれたとしても……。
lines.translated: Even if Mashiro and Kanade Taiga tell me that "it's okay now"...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.
*I just can't help but feel that I never should have been born.*

lines.content: でも、それもまた我がままなのだろうか。
lines.translated: But is that just me being selfish, too?

lines.content: 誰も自分を責め立ててやしないのに、それでも自分を罰しなければならないと頑なになっている。それはもはやエゴでしかないのだろうか――
lines.translated: Even though no one is blaming me, I'm still stubbornly insisting that I must punish myself. Is that nothing more than pure ego at this point--?

lines.content: そういった迷いのようなものはある。未だに消えず、燻っている。
lines.translated: I do have doubts like that. They still haven't vanished, smoldering away inside me.

lines.content: それでも俺は行かなきゃいけない。
lines.translated: Even so, I have to go.

lines.content: クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: ……君に、どうしても、どうしても伝えなきゃいけないことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "...There's something I absolutely, no matter what, have to tell you."
*Deep inside my chest, only our "goodbye" remains.*

lines.content: 幼い柊ハルを助けるために命を投げ出し……。
lines.translated: Throwing away my life to save the young Hiiragi Haru...

lines.content: その末に、クロ。
lines.translated: And at the end of that, Kuro.

lines.content: ようやく君と出逢えた。
lines.translated: I was finally able to meet you.

lines.content: それなのにどうしても、俺たちは別れなくてはならなくなって……。
lines.translated: And yet, no matter what, we had to part ways...

lines.content: ふたりで泣いて、泣いて、ただただ泣いた。
lines.translated: Together we cried, and cried, and simply cried our hearts out.

lines.content: あのときの“さよなら”が。
lines.translated: The "goodbye" from back then.

lines.content: ふたりで生きていける道はどこかにないかと、最後まで探し続けた。
lines.translated: Until the very end, we kept searching to see if there wasn't some way, somewhere, for the two of us to live on together.

lines.content: そのときの“想い”だけが。
lines.translated: Only the "feelings" from that time.

lines.content: ……今、この胸の中にある。
lines.translated: Are inside my chest right now.

lines.content: ……そんな、俺たちの[さよなら|時間]を書き換えたい。いや、書き換えないと。
lines.translated: I want to rewrite that time of our goodbye. No, I have to rewrite it.
*I swear that to the small hand that pulled mine along.*

lines.content: 延々と続くさくらの天井――その下をどこまでも歩いた。
lines.translated: An endlessly stretching ceiling of cherry blossoms--I walked beneath it as far as my feet would carry me.

lines.content: 目指すべき場所は……。
lines.translated: Toward the place I must reach...

lines.content: わかってる。
lines.translated: I know.

lines.content: どんなに暗闇が続こうと、迷うことだけはない。
lines.translated: No matter how long the darkness continues, I will never lose my way.

lines.content: 立ち止まることなく、歩く。
lines.translated: Without stopping, I walk.

lines.content: 前だけを見て。
lines.translated: Looking only ahead.

lines.content: どれくらい歩いただろう。
lines.translated: How far have I walked?

lines.content: ……はらり、と。
lines.translated: Softly.

lines.content: 花びらがまたひとつ、舞い落ちた。
lines.translated: Another petal fluttered down.

lines.content: もう見上げた先に花はない。ただ夜より暗い空があるばかり。
lines.translated: Looking up, there are no longer any flowers ahead. There is only a sky darker than night.

lines.content: そこからこぼれたひとひらは、今まで見たどんなものものより一層、輝いて見えて……。
lines.translated: The single petal that spilled down from there looked brighter than anything I had ever seen before...

lines.content: 『……ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'...Thank you.'"

lines.content: 声が聞こえた。
lines.translated: I heard a voice.

lines.content: 『きみがこの世界に生まれてきてくれて、本当に、よかった』
lines.translated: "'I'm really, truly glad that you were born into this world.'"

lines.content: その言葉が[・|ぼ][・|く]の“希望”だ。
lines.translated: Those words are *my* "hope."

lines.content: この暗闇の先は、あの日、あのとき、あの瞬間に繋がっていると、感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that what lay beyond this darkness was connected to that day, that time, that very moment.

lines.content: だから俺は、その最後のひとひらに手を伸ばし――……掴んだ。
lines.translated: So I reached my hand out toward that final petal--...and grasped it.

lines.content: ぼくは……。
いいや。
lines.translated: No.
*Right now*, *I* am still...

lines.content: クロ……。お願いだ。聞いてほしい
lines.translated: "Kuro... Please. I want you to listen."

lines.content: 探し求めた[・|こ][・|の][・|瞬][・|間]に、いっぱいの“想い”を抱え……。
lines.translated: Holding so many "feelings" inside *this moment* that I had searched for...

lines.content: ……君に、伝えたいことがある。そのためにここまで、長い、とても長い時間をかけて、戻ってきたんだ
lines.translated: "...There is something I want to tell you. For that sake, I spent a long, very long time coming all the way back here."

lines.content: ――君に伝えたいことがある。
lines.translated: --There is something I want to tell you.

lines.content: そう言った瞬間だった。
lines.translated: It was the exact moment I said that.

lines.content: ……あれ
ぽろりとひとつ、涙が頬を伝った。
lines.translated: A single tear spilled over and ran down my cheek.

lines.content: ここに歩いてくるまでに見た、たくさん、とてもたくさんのクロの時間と、その気持ちを思い出していた――……[ぼく|俺]は、産まれてこなければよかった。
lines.translated: I was remembering the many, so very many times of Kuro's that I had seen on my walk here, and her feelings--...*I* never should have been born.

lines.content: そんな俺の“想い”を知らないはずのきみなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though you shouldn't have known about those "feelings" of mine...

lines.content: 『……ありがとう。きみが、生まれてきてくれて、本当に――……』
lines.translated: "...Thank you. For being born... really--..."

lines.content: あの日、あのとき、君がくれたこの言葉が、いつまでも心に響いてた。
lines.translated: Those words you gave me on that day, at that time, echoed in my heart forever.

lines.content: いつまでも……。
lines.translated: Forever...

lines.content: いつまでもだ。
lines.translated: Forever and ever.

lines.content: その言葉があったから、俺は勇気を出して“夜”の一部になって消えていけた――“夢”を、叶えることができたんだ。
lines.translated: Because those words were there, I was able to muster up my courage, become a part of the "Night," and fade away--I was able to make my "dream" come true.

lines.content: その“夢”は本当に叶える必要があったのかどうか。今はもう、疑問に思ってしまっているけれど。
lines.translated: Though right now, I've begun to question whether that "dream" really needed to be fulfilled in the first place.

lines.content: こんな疑問に気づかせてくれたのも君の言葉だ。
lines.translated: It was your words that made me realize this doubt, too.

lines.content: 涙が、こぼれる。
lines.translated: Tears spill over.

lines.content: ……おかしいな
lines.translated: "...That's strange."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|の][・|と][・|き]のぼくは――俺は、こんな涙をぐっと我慢できていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: *At this time*, I--I should have been able to hold back tears like these.

lines.content: “自由だ！”、と。
lines.translated: "I'm free!"

lines.content: まったく自由にもなれやしないのに、
lines.translated: Even though I couldn't become free at all,

lines.content: そんなこと望んでもいなかったはずなのに、
lines.translated: Even though I shouldn't have even wished for something like that,

lines.content: それなのに大きくおおきく叫んだことで、震える想いも涙もすべて、封じ込められていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even so, by shouting that out loud with all my might, I should have been able to lock away all of my trembling feelings and tears...

lines.content: それなのに、だめだ。
lines.translated: And yet, it's no use.

lines.content: [・|今]はどうしても我慢できない。
lines.translated: *Right now*, I just can't hold them back no matter what.

lines.content: ぼくは生きていてもいいのかな。
lines.translated: Is it okay for me to be alive?

lines.content: ぼくは、誰かに愛されていたのかな。
lines.translated: Was I loved by someone?

lines.content: ……クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: ぼくは、君にとって少しでも必要な“何か”には、なれていたのかな。
lines.translated: Was I able to become "something" even a little bit necessary to you?

lines.content: そんな[・|今][・|さ][・|ら]に、心がいっぱいになって……。
lines.translated: My heart filled up *all over again* with those thoughts...

lines.content: ……涙だ。
lines.translated: It's tears.

lines.content: 涙が止めどなく、流れて落ちた。
lines.translated: Tears flowed and fell endlessly.

lines.content: ……大雅？　どうしたの？
lines.translated: "...Taiga? What's wrong?"

lines.content: 涙しながら震えてる。そんな俺のそばで、クロが心配そうな顔でおろおろしている。
lines.translated: I'm trembling as I cry. Beside me like that, Kuro is panicking with a worried look on her face.
*From here on out is a new time.*
It's a *new me*.

lines.content: まだ誰も知らない時間が産まれ出す。
lines.translated: A time that no one knows yet is being born.

lines.content: [・|前][・|回]は違った。
lines.translated: *Last time* was different.

lines.content: クロは俺にチョコを三つプレゼントしてくれて。
lines.translated: Kuro gave me three chocolates as a present.

lines.content: ……“産まれてきてくれてありがとう”の言葉を、“希望”を、俺に贈ってくれて。
lines.translated: She gifted me the words "Thank you for being born," she gifted me "hope."

lines.content: そこからすぐ、走って行ってしまったけど……。
lines.translated: And right after that, she ran away, though...

lines.content: ……大丈夫？　すごい震えてるよ。寒いの？　どこか、つらい？
lines.translated: "...Are you okay? You're trembling so much. Are you cold? Are you hurting somewhere?"

lines.content: 今、クロは俺のそばにいてくれる。
lines.translated: Right now, Kuro is staying by my side.

lines.content: 走り去っていこうとした足を止め、こぼれる涙を拭おうともしない俺のことを気遣ってくれていた。
lines.translated: Stopping the feet that were about to run off, she was worrying about me as I didn't even try to wipe away my spilling tears.

lines.content: そんな君に、俺はどう言えばいいだろう。
lines.translated: What should I say to you when you're being like this?

lines.content: ……今ここにいる俺も、前回の俺とは少し違う。[・|幼][・|い][・|小][・|さ][・|な][・|手][・|の][・|ひ][・|ら][・|に]、ここへ導かれたのだ。
lines.translated: The me who is here right now is also a little different from the me of last time. I was guided here *by the tiny palm of a young child's hand*.

lines.content: ……今度こそ失敗できない。
lines.translated: This time for sure, I cannot fail.

lines.content: この手を引いてくれた幼いあの子のためにも。
lines.translated: For the sake of that young girl who pulled this hand of mine along, too.

lines.content: そう感じてる。
lines.translated: That's what I feel.

lines.content: ここからの行動、一つひとつが未来を作る。きっとそういうことなのだろう。
lines.translated: Every single action from here on out will create the future. That's surely how it must be.

lines.content: 言葉ひとつだって取り間違えられない……。
lines.translated: I can't afford to get even a single word wrong...

lines.content: だから、
lines.translated: That's why,

lines.content: ……知ってるよ
lines.translated: "...I know."

lines.content: だから俺は、言ったのだ――届けるべき言葉を、今度は俺から君に、届けなければ。
lines.translated: That's why I said it--the words that need to be delivered, this time I must deliver them from me to you.

lines.content: ……クロ。俺、全部知ってるよ
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I know everything."

lines.content: 大きな目をぱちくりとし、君は首をかしげる。そんな君に俺は続けて言った。
lines.translated: Blinking your big eyes in surprise, you tilt your head. To you, I continued speaking.

lines.content: クロが“後悔”してること……。俺のこといつも遠くから、でも、とても近くから、見守り続けてくれていた理由。その全部を知ってるんだよ。だから……
lines.translated: "About what you 'regret,' Kuro... The reason why you always kept watching over me from afar, and yet from so very close by. I know all of it. That's why..."

lines.content: ……そこから続けようとした言葉こそ届けたかった。
lines.translated: The words I was about to continue with from there were the very ones I wanted to deliver.

lines.content: だけど俺は、それを飲み込んでしまう。
lines.translated: However, I ended up swallowing them down.

lines.content: 一歩、後じさったクロの顔が真っ青だったからだ。
lines.translated: Because Kuro's face, as she took a step backward, had gone deathly pale.
*What it was that I knew*. Her expression looked as though she had guessed it.

lines.content: クロはさっと背を向け走り出す――……だめだっ。
lines.translated: Kuro quickly turns her back and starts running--...No!

lines.content: クロ、待って……っ
lines.translated: "Kuro, wait...!"

lines.content: 俺もすぐに立ち上がり、クロを追いかけるため駆け出した。
lines.translated: I immediately stood up too and broke into a run to chase after Kuro.
*Losing sight of Kuro right here and now.*

lines.content: そんな[・|今]を、このあたらしい時間の中に産み出してしまえば、それで終わりだ。
lines.translated: If I were to give birth to a *present* like that within this new time, it would all be over.

lines.content: 今まで以上のバットエンドに沈んだかのような時間が、その先の時間の中に待っている――根拠はなくとも強くそう感じていた。
