lines.translated: A time as if sunken into a worse bad end than ever before is waiting in the time ahead of that--even without any basis for it, I felt that strongly.

lines.content: だから必死に追いかけた。
lines.translated: So I chased after her desperately.

lines.content: 追いかけようとした。
lines.translated: I tried to chase after her.

lines.content: ……猫の足に人間が追いつけるものなのか。
lines.translated: Can a human even catch up to a cat's feet?

lines.content: 一瞬、不安に思った。
lines.translated: For a moment, I felt anxious.

lines.content: だから叫んだ。
lines.translated: So I shouted.

lines.content: ……待ってっ
lines.translated: "...Wait!"

lines.content: 目の前を走る小さな背中に向かって……、
lines.translated: Toward the small back running right in front of my eyes...,

lines.content: 聞いてくれ！　クロ……！
lines.translated: "Listen to me! Kuro...!"

lines.content: 俺は、何度も叫んだけれど……、
lines.translated: I shouted over and over again, but...,

lines.content: ……う、は、あ、はあ……ううっ
lines.translated: "...Ugh, haah, ah, haah... ugh!"

lines.content: でも、クロは足が遅い。
lines.translated: However, Kuro is a slow runner.

lines.content: 数メートルも走っていないのに、もうはあはあとつらそうに喘いでた。
lines.translated: Even though she hadn't even run a few meters, she was already panting heavily and painfully.

lines.content: 猫なのに運動神経があまりよくない。
lines.translated: Even though she's a cat, she isn't very athletic.

lines.content: そんな自分を知られたくなかったのか――つんとしていた[・|い][・|つ][・|か][・|の][・|君]のことを思い出し、こんなときなのに少し、口元が緩んでしまった。
lines.translated: Maybe she hadn't wanted me to know that side of her--remembering *the you from back then* acting all aloof, even at a time like this, my lips relaxed into a slight smile.

lines.content: う～……ううー……ううううう～っ
lines.translated: "Ugh~... ughh~... ughhhhh~!"

lines.content: ふらふらとしながら、それでもクロは走る足を止めなかった。
lines.translated: Even while staggering unsteadily, Kuro still didn't stop running.

lines.content: その背中に、もうすぐ追いつきそうになるけれど……、
lines.translated: I was just about to catch up to her back, though...,

lines.content: あ……っ
つんのめり、クロは転けてしまった。固い地面に正面から、べったりと受け身も取らず……。
lines.translated: Pitching forward, Kuro tripped and fell. Right onto the hard ground face-first, sprawling flat without even breaking her fall...

lines.content: ここは坂道だ。
lines.translated: This place is a sloped road.

lines.content: 倒れたクロは、そのままころころと転がっていってしまう……。
lines.translated: Having fallen over, Kuro just keeps rolling and tumbling right on down...

lines.content: ……にゃうっ
lines.translated: "...Meowch!"

lines.content: 途中にあったさくらの木、その幹にぶつかり停止する。
lines.translated: She bumps into the trunk of a cherry blossom tree partway down and comes to a stop.

lines.content: う、うううう……いたい……かっこ、わるい……ぐすっ
lines.translated: "U-Ughhhh... owie... that's so, uncool... *sniffle*."

lines.content: 打ち付けたのだろう頭を抱え、しきりに鼻をすすり上げていた。
lines.translated: Holding her head, which she must have bumped, she was sniffling over and over.

lines.content: クロ……っ
lines.translated: "Kuro...!"

lines.content: 急いで駆け寄り、抱き起こそうとするけれど……、
lines.translated: I hurriedly ran over and tried to help her up in my arms, but...,

lines.content: や、やだ……っ
クロは両手を振り乱すようにして、俺を拒否した。
lines.translated: Kuro flailed both her hands around wildly, rejecting me.

lines.content: 爪を鋭く立てられるくらいなら仕方がない。そう覚悟した。
lines.translated: If she were to dig her sharp claws into me, then so be it. I braced myself for that.

lines.content: でも、振り上げられた両手は弱々しくて……。
lines.translated: However, the two hands she swung up were so weak and frail...

lines.content: 爪だってきれいに切られ、ただ、ふつうの人間の女の子みたいで……。
lines.translated: Even her nails were neatly trimmed, just like a normal human girl's...

lines.content: だから簡単にその手を受け止められてしまう。
lines.translated: So I was easily able to catch and hold her hands.

lines.content: だめ……っ、やだよう……っ
lines.translated: "Stop...! Nooo...!"

lines.content: クロは、俺に両手を掴まれたままいやいやをする。
lines.translated: With both of her hands caught in mine, Kuro shakes her head in refusal.

lines.content: ……は、離して……大雅……離してよ……
lines.translated: "...L-Let go... Taiga... let go of me..."

lines.content: クロ。ごめんクロ。君にどうしても聞いてほしいことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "Kuro. I'm sorry, Kuro. There's something I really need you to listen to no matter what."

lines.content: やだ……何も。……何も、聞きたくない……っ
lines.translated: "No... Nothing. ...I don't want to hear anything...!"

lines.content: 震えながらそう言った。
lines.translated: She said that while trembling.

lines.content: ちゃんと……わかってるっ
lines.translated: "I know... I know already!"

lines.content: 自分でもわかってるんだよ、大雅っ……わたし、わたしは……ただの化け物、ただの悪魔だ……きみのそばに、いていいわけない
lines.translated: "I know it myself, Taiga!... I, I'm... just a monster, just a devil... There's no way it's okay for me to be by your side."

lines.content: それを俺の口から聞くのが怖い――クロはそう言う。だからお願い。
lines.translated: I'm scared to hear that from your mouth--that's what Kuro is saying. So please.

lines.content: もう何も、言わないで……
lines.translated: "Don't say anything anymore..."

lines.content: ……お願い離して、もう、わたし……
lines.translated: "...Please let go, I won't, anymore..."
*I will never appear in front of you again.*
*So please, forgive me.*

lines.content: そんな声にならない呻きのようなものを、俺は、クロの頬を伝いはじめる涙の粒から、確かに聞き取ったように感じてしまった。
lines.translated: From the teardrops beginning to trail down Kuro's cheeks, I felt as though I had unmistakably heard something like that voiceless groan.

lines.content: ……ごめん、クロ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Kuro."

lines.content: [・|も][・|う][・|二][・|度][・|と][・|俺][・|の][・|前][・|に][・|は][・|現][・|れ][・|な][・|い]――それでも君は、俺の知らないどこか遠くから、いつも、いつまでも、俺の不幸をその命の中に受け止め続けていくのだろう。
lines.translated: *I will never appear in front of you again*--even so, from somewhere far away that I don't know, you would surely keep taking my misfortune into that life of yours, always and forever.

lines.content: そんなひとりぼっちな君の時間は、どんなものよりも想像しやすかった。たとえば自分自身の明日を思うよりも、ずっと……ずっとだ。
lines.translated: Such a lonely time of yours was easier to imagine than anything else. For instance, far... far easier than thinking about my very own tomorrow.

lines.content: 離さない。……ごめんね。ちゃんと話を聞いてくれるまで、絶対に、離さないよ
lines.translated: "I won't let go. ...I'm sorry. Until you properly listen to what I have to say, I will never, ever let you go."

lines.content: ……やだ、……はなして……いじわる……大雅の、意地悪……
lines.translated: "...No, ...let go... Meanie... Taiga, you meanie..."

lines.content: ごめん
lines.translated: "Sorry."

lines.content: う、ううう
lines.translated: "U-Ughhh."

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 掴んでいた両手を俺は[・|離][・|し][・|た]。
lines.translated: I *let go* of the hands I had been holding.

lines.content: そしてその手でクロを、力いっぱい抱きしめる。
lines.translated: And with those same arms, I wrapped Kuro in a tight embrace with all my might.

lines.content: 宥めるように、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I spoke as if to soothe her.

lines.content: 全部、[・|最][・|初][・|か][・|ら]知ってたんだ
lines.translated: "I knew all of it, *right from the start*."

lines.content: 耳元に息を呑むような気配を感じた。
lines.translated: I felt her catch her breath right beside my ear.

lines.content: 知って……？
lines.translated: "You knew...?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだよ。だからもういいんだ。何もかも
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. So it's okay now. Everything is."

lines.content: ……それって
lines.translated: "...What does..."

lines.content: どういうこと？　と。
lines.translated: *What does that mean?*

lines.content: 震える小さな身体が訴えていた。だから俺は、うなずきながら答える。
lines.translated: Her trembling little body was pleading for an answer. So I nodded as I replied.

lines.content: クロが俺の……[・|ぼ][・|く]のお母さんの心を壊してしまったこと
lines.translated: "About how you broke my... *my* mother's heart."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は、そのときのクロ自身では、どうしようもないことだったのも知ってる。でもクロはそれを“後悔”して……どうしようもなく、つらく思って
lines.translated: "I also know that *that* was something you couldn't have helped back then. Even so, you 'regretted' it... and it hurt you so terribly, beyond all help."

lines.content: ぼくのお母さんの代わりに、ぼくのことを生涯ずっと、命に代えてでも護り続けていこうと決めてくれていたことも……全部だ
lines.translated: "And how, in my mother's place, you decided to keep protecting me for the rest of my life, even if it cost you your own... I knew all of it."

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: 俺はさ。今までの君のことなら全部、ぜんぶ、[・|最][・|初][・|か][・|ら]ひとつも余さず、知っていたんだ
lines.translated: "You see, everything about you up until now, all of it--I knew every single bit of it *right from the start*."

lines.content: 君が自分のことを化け物だと。悪魔だと。そういうふうに言い切ってしまう理由を全部だ。
lines.translated: Every reason why you so definitively call yourself a monster. A devil.
*Even so*.

lines.content: それでもぼくは、君と一緒にいたかった
lines.translated: "Even so, I wanted to be with you."

lines.content: ……それでも、君に、一緒にいてほしかったんだよ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Even so, I wanted you to stay with me... Kuro."

lines.content: すべて知った上で、幼いぼくは、君と一緒にいることを選んだんだ。
lines.translated: Knowing all of it, the young me chose to be with you.

lines.content: 息を呑むような気配を感じた。今、クロがどんな表情をしているのかはわからない。
lines.translated: I felt her catch her breath. Right now, I can't tell what kind of expression Kuro is making.

lines.content: ……わからないから。
lines.translated: Because I can't tell.

lines.content: ぼくはそのまま、独り言のように続ける。
lines.translated: I simply continued on, as if talking to myself.

lines.content: ……[・|そ][・|れ]を知ったのは、一番最初に君のことを抱きしめたときだ
lines.translated: "...I found out about *that* the very first time I held you in my arms."

lines.content: ……暗闇の地下室の底。
lines.translated: At the bottom of that pitch-black basement.

lines.content: 母親に見捨てられひとりぼっちになってしまった。
lines.translated: I had been abandoned by my mother and left all alone.

lines.content: その悲しみとさみしさから逃れるため心を閉じた――そうでなければぼくという存在は愛されない。相手にもされない。そう言う言葉を信じてしまっていたからだ。
lines.translated: To escape that sadness and loneliness, I closed off my heart--because I had come to believe the words that unless I was a good boy, an existence like me wouldn't be loved. Wouldn't even be acknowledged.

lines.content: そうでなければぼくという存在は愛されない。相手にもされない。そう言われたからだ。
lines.translated: Because I had been told that unless I was, an existence like me wouldn't be loved. Wouldn't even be acknowledged.

lines.content: 自分が身勝手な我がままを口にした途端、大切な人たちは不幸に沈む――そんな呪いのような言葉に恐怖したからだ。
lines.translated: Because I was terrified of those curse-like words--that the moment I voiced a selfish whim, the people precious to me would sink into misfortune.

lines.content: ぼくはひとり、小さく丸まるようにして、暗闇の底で息を潜めていたけれど……。
lines.translated: All alone, I curled up small, holding my breath at the bottom of the darkness, and yet...

lines.content: そんなぼくの胸の中に、ふと、君が潜り込んできてくれた。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, you burrowed right into my chest.

lines.content: ……そのとき、全部知ったんだ
lines.translated: "...That was when I found out everything."

lines.content: [・|た][・|っ][・|た][・|今]、形になったばかりの君の“心”が、幼いばかりだったぼくの心と繋がったのか――見えたんだ。君の“心”の中が、全部
lines.translated: "Perhaps because your 'heart,' which had *just* taken shape, connected with my own young heart--I saw it. Everything inside your 'heart.'"

lines.content: 今、ぼくの胸の中に潜り込んできた子猫は――小さな身体を震わせながら、猫な自分は涙を流すこともできない。そんな自分を悔しくも思い……
lines.translated: "The kitten who had just burrowed into my chest was trembling in her tiny body, frustrated that, as a cat, she couldn't even shed tears..."

lines.content: 必死になって身体をこすりつけ、ぼくの悲しみやさみしさを、どうにかしてその小さな身体一杯に汲み取って――……どこかへ持って行こうとしているんだと、わかった
lines.translated: "Desperately rubbing yourself against me, trying somehow to soak up all my sadness and loneliness into that tiny body of yours--...to carry it away somewhere. I understood that."

lines.content: ……ぼくのお母さんの心を壊した瞬間、この子の中にそんな“心”が芽生えた。それもまた、理解できた。
lines.translated: The moment you broke my mother's heart, such a "heart" had sprouted inside you. I understood that, too.

lines.content: 君が何度も何度も、小さな額をぼくの胸や、頬に押し当て、こすりつける中……
lines.translated: "As you pressed and rubbed your tiny forehead against my chest and cheeks, over and over again..."

lines.content: “ごめんなさい”という声を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: I felt like I heard a voice saying, "I'm sorry."

lines.content: [・|自][・|分]のせいでぼくのお母さんの心が壊れた。
lines.translated: My mother's heart had broken because of *you*.

lines.content: ……その瞬間に産まれたその“心”は“ごめんなさい”の気持ちで溢れていた。
lines.translated: The "heart" born in that instant was overflowing with feelings of "I'm sorry."

lines.content: ……いっぱいの涙と叫びと、そして悶えるような呻きと嘆きで染まってた。
lines.translated: It was stained with so many tears and screams, and with agonizing groans and grief.

lines.content: ぼくとこの子猫は同じだって、どうしてかな、思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "For some reason, I thought to myself that this kitten and I were the same."

lines.content: ……そんな君のことを抱きしめたとき、ぼくらはたぶん、ずっと一緒に生きていける。不思議だけれど、閉ざしてしまったはずの心でぼくは、感じられたんだ
lines.translated: "...When I held you like that, I felt that maybe the two of us could live on together forever. Mysterious as it was, even with a heart that should have been closed off, I was able to feel that."

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: 改めて言おう。
lines.translated: Let me say it again.

lines.content: 言葉にしよう。
lines.translated: Let me put it into words.

lines.content: ぼくはそのとき、すべて知ったんだ
lines.translated: "I found out everything back then."

lines.content: ……君という“誰か”がしてしまったこと。それを悔やんだり、悲しんだりする気持ちを全部。……ぼくを生涯護っていくんだっていう、君の覚悟も全部だ
lines.translated: "...What the 'someone' who was you had done. All the regret and sadness you felt over it. ...And all of your resolve to protect me for the rest of my life."

lines.content: それでも――……
lines.translated: Even so--...

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……だからこそぼくは、君と一緒にいたいと願った
lines.translated: "...That's precisely why I wished to be with you."

lines.content: だって……。
lines.translated: Because...
"Because *you and I are the same*."

lines.content: 君の心に触れたぼくはそう強く、感じていたんだ。
lines.translated: Having touched your heart, I felt that so strongly.

lines.content: この[物語|世界]にもし、自分という存在が産まれていなければ……。
lines.translated: If only an existence like me had never been born into this world...

lines.content: この[物語|世界]はもう少しだけでも[・|ま][・|し]になっていたはずだ。
lines.translated: Then this world would have been at least a little bit *better off*.

lines.content: 自分という存在自体が諸悪の根源。世界中の善意から打ち倒されるべき存在なんだ。
lines.translated: My very existence is the root of all evil. Something that ought to be struck down by all the goodwill in the world.

lines.content: ……クロ。君も、そう考えていたに違いない。
lines.translated: Kuro. You must have been thinking the exact same thing.

lines.content: [・|ぼ][・|く]なんて、[・|わ][・|た][・|し]なんて、産まれてこなければよかった――君と俺は……君とぼくは、あんまりにも似たもの同士だ。
lines.translated: *Someone like me*, *someone like me*, should never have been born--you and I... you and I are just far too alike.

lines.content: だからぼくらは同じ気持ちを、同じときに、同じように理解し合える。そんな友人に、相棒に、……家族に、ぼくらはなれる。そう、思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why we can understand the same feelings, at the same time, in the exact same way. We can become that kind of friend, partner, ...and family. That's what I thought."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 同じような悲しい気持ちと、さみしい気持ちでいっぱいの君にこそ、ぼくはずっと一緒にいてほしい。そうじゃないと、とてもじゃないけど生きていけない
lines.translated: "Precisely because you're so full of the same sad and lonely feelings, you're the one I want to stay with me forever. Otherwise, there's just no way I could go on living."

lines.content: ……そうだよ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ぼくは君のことをただの一度だって憎いとか、許せないだとか、そんなふうに思ったことはなかったんだよ
lines.translated: "Not even once have I ever hated you, or thought I couldn't forgive you, or anything like that."

lines.content: だからこそぼくはすべて知っていて尚、君といることを選んだのだし……。
lines.translated: That's why, even knowing everything, I still chose to be with you...

lines.content: だからこそぼくは、君に伝えたいことがあったんだ――
lines.translated: And that's why there was something I wanted to tell you--

lines.content: ……ああ、そうか。ましろも。奏大雅も。今のぼくと同じ気持ちだったのかなと、気づいた。もう誰も[あなた|ぼく]のことを憎んでやしないのに、と。
lines.translated: Ah, I see. Mashiro, too. And Kanade Taiga. I realized that maybe they had felt the exact same way I do right now. Thinking, *No one hates you anymore*.

lines.content: 俺はここに至るまでの道のりをクロに話した。
lines.translated: I told Kuro about the journey that had brought me here.

lines.content: 俺が奏大雅やましろを取り戻すため、一度、“夜の王”となったこと。
lines.translated: About how, in order to get Kanade Taiga and Mashiro back, I had once become the "King of the Night."

lines.content: そんな俺のことを救うため、奏大雅をはじめ、[・|み][・|ん][・|な]が力を合わせてくれたこと。
lines.translated: About how, in order to save me, Kanade Taiga and *everyone* else had joined forces.

lines.content: ……その先で、クロ。
lines.translated: And how, beyond all that, Kuro.

lines.content: 君が、自分の“悪夢”に呑まれ、死んでしまったこと。
lines.translated: You had been swallowed up by your own "nightmare" and died.

lines.content: 一度は“絶望”の底にすべて沈んだ。
lines.translated: How everything had once sunk to the very bottom of "despair."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 奏大雅の“魔法”でぼくは“夜”の中から救い出された。
lines.translated: How I had been rescued from the "Night" by Kanade Taiga's "magic."

lines.content: そうして、真っ暗闇に咲いた満開のさくらの花。そのトンネルをどこまでも、どこまでも、歩いてきたこと。
lines.translated: And how I had walked on and on, endlessly, through a tunnel of cherry blossoms blooming in full glory amidst the pitch-black darkness.

lines.content: ……この日、この瞬間にこそ、君へ届けたいものがあったから。
lines.translated: Because on this day, in this very moment, there was something I wanted to deliver to you.

lines.content: そのすべてを、話した。
lines.translated: I told her all of it.

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.
*Today*.
*In this very moment*...

lines.content: 君がぼくにくれた[・|あ][・|の][・|言][・|葉]で、ぼくは“夜の王”になり――“夢”を叶える“勇気”を得られた。
lines.translated: Because of *those words* you gave me, I became the "King of the Night"--and gained the "courage" to make my "dream" come true.

lines.content: それが正しかったかどうかは問題じゃない。
lines.translated: Whether that was right or not doesn't matter.

lines.content: 君に“勇気”と“安心”をもらえた。
lines.translated: You gave me "courage" and "peace of mind."

lines.content: それだけが、俺にとって大切だったから……。
lines.translated: Because that alone was what mattered to me...

lines.content: ……クロ。聞いてほしい。君に届けたいことがあったんだ
lines.translated: "...Kuro. Please listen. There was something I wanted to deliver to you."

lines.content: クロは何も言わず、ぼくの話を聞き続けてくれている。
lines.translated: Without saying a word, Kuro keeps listening to my story.

lines.content: ……もう、どこへも逃げない。せめてこの話が終わるまで。
lines.translated: She won't run away anywhere anymore. At least not until this story is over.

lines.content: そんな気持ちを感じたからこそ、更に強くと、ぼくは抱きしめた両腕に力を込めた。
lines.translated: Because I sensed that feeling from her, I put even more strength into the arms holding her tight.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん。なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……もしも、この“夢”が叶うなら
lines.translated: "...If this 'dream' can come true..."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]がたったひとつの“魔法”のはじまり――そのための呪文であるようにと願い、ぼくは小さくつぶやいて、言った。
lines.translated: Wishing for *this* to be the beginning of one single "magic"--the incantation for its sake--I murmured softly and said:

lines.content: ……一緒に生きよう、クロ
lines.translated: "...Let's live together, Kuro."

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: ありがとうクロ。君が産まれてきてくれて、良かった――……ぼくは、君と出会えて本当に、良かったよ
lines.translated: "Thank you, Kuro. I'm so glad you were born--...I'm truly, truly glad that I met you."

lines.content: 届けたかったのはこれだけだ。
lines.translated: This is all I wanted to deliver to her.

lines.content: ……クロ。ぼくは君のことをただの一度だって憎いとか、許せないだとか、そんなふうに思ったことはなかったんだよ
lines.translated: "...Kuro. Not even once have I ever hated you, or thought I couldn't forgive you, or anything like that."

lines.content: 伝えたかったのは、たったこれだけの言葉だ。
lines.translated: These few simple words were all I wanted to convey.

lines.content: ただ、一緒にいたかった。いつまでもずっと、ずっと、君と一緒にいられる時間が続けばいい。それだけいつも願ってた
lines.translated: "I just wanted to be with you. I always just wished that the time I could spend with you would go on forever and ever."

lines.content: だって俺たちは唯一、同じ気持ちを理解し合える友人で、相棒で、……家族、なんだから
lines.translated: "Because we are the only friends, partners, ...and family who can understand the exact same feelings."

lines.content: こうして君へと渡した小さなちいさな宝の箱に、一杯の“想い”を、精一杯、納めようとした。
lines.translated: Into the tiny, tiny treasure box I handed over to you like this, I tried with all my might to pack a heart full of "feelings."

lines.content: きっと……。
lines.translated: Surely...

lines.content: きっとだ。
lines.translated: Surely...

lines.content: 君とぼくは同じだから、決して偽ることのない同じ言葉と、同じ“想い”で、君の“心”を夜の底から連れ出すことができると、信じる。
lines.translated: Because you and I are the same, I believe that with the same words that will never lie, and the same "feelings," I can lead your "heart" out from the bottom of the night.

lines.content: この日、この瞬間のぼくが[・|そ][・|う]だったように……。
lines.translated: Just as it *was* for me on this day, in this very moment...

lines.content: クロは何も言わなかった。
lines.translated: Kuro didn't say anything.

lines.content: ずっと抱きしめたままだから、やっぱり今、君がどんな表情をしているのかもわからない。
lines.translated: Since I'm still holding her tight, I still can't tell what kind of expression you're making right now.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 震えてる。
lines.translated: She's trembling.

lines.content: 君の小さな身体が震えている。それだけは確かに伝わってくる。
lines.translated: Your small body is trembling. That much, at least, comes through clearly to me.

lines.content: 今、君に届けた言葉が、そこに込めた精一杯の“想い”が。
lines.translated: The words I just delivered to you, and the "feelings" I poured into them with all my might...

lines.content: 少しでも多く、君がこれからも生きていくための“勇気”になりますようにと、祈ってた。
lines.translated: I prayed that they would become even the slightest bit more "courage" for you to keep on living from here on out.

lines.content: ……クロが言う。[・|今]の俺を表す名前を、ぽつりと、呼ぶ。
lines.translated: Kuro speaks. Softly, she calls out the name that represents the *present* me.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……わたし、うそつきだ
lines.translated: "...I'm a liar."

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ……わたし、きみにうそばかり言ってる
lines.translated: "...All I ever tell you are lies."

lines.content: ……うん。知ってるよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I know."

lines.content: ……いつもの電話、ちょっと先の未来から――きみと同じ部屋で、話してた
lines.translated: "...Our usual phone calls, from a little bit in the future--I was talking to you in the exact same room."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ……きみがお布団の上に座って電話するの、わたし、知ってたから……。だから、時間はずれてたけれど、同じようにお布団の上で……きみの隣で、話してた
lines.translated: "...Because I knew that you always sat on your futon when we talked on the phone... Even though our times were out of sync, I sat on the futon the exact same way... talking right beside you."

lines.content: でも、こうして同じ時間の中にいられるときは……ほんとはね、すぐ近くで電話してた。大雅の部屋の、扉の向こう
lines.translated: "But when we were able to be in the same time like this... the truth is, I was calling you from right nearby. Just on the other side of your bedroom door, Taiga."

lines.content: ……うん。何となく、気づいてたよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I kind of figured as much."

lines.content: ……これからもわたし、うそ、付かないって約束できない
lines.translated: "...I can't promise that I won't lie to you anymore from now on."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……たぶん、これからもいっぱい、わたしはきみにうそつくと、思う
lines.translated: "...I think I'll probably still tell you lots of lies in the future, too."

lines.content: それでも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……クロ。それでも俺は、君と一緒にいたかった。一緒に生きていきたかったんだよ。……ずっと
lines.translated: "...Kuro. Even so, I wanted to be with you. I wanted to live together with you. ...Forever."

lines.content: クロが視線を上げた。
lines.translated: Kuro raised her gaze.

lines.content: ふと、目が合う。
lines.translated: Suddenly, our eyes met.

lines.content: 真っ赤になった。
lines.translated: She turned bright red.

lines.content: そして瞳をしきりに泳がせ――ぽすっと、また俺の胸に額をくっつけた。
lines.translated: Her eyes darted around restlessly--and with a soft thud, she pressed her forehead against my chest again.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: ああ、なに？　クロ
lines.translated: "Oh, what is it, Kuro?"

lines.content: わたし……わたしね。もうひとつ、大雅にうそ、ついてる
lines.translated: "I... You know, I told you one more lie, Taiga."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: クロはうなずく。俺の胸元に額をくっつけ、こちらを見上げないまま。
lines.translated: Kuro nods, keeping her forehead pressed against my chest without looking up at me.

lines.content: ……ほんとはね
lines.translated: "...The truth is..."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ほんとは……
lines.translated: "The truth is..."

lines.content: ほんとは、わたし。チョコレートだって、あんまり好きじゃない
lines.translated: "The truth is, I don't even like chocolate all that much."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……ましろの真似、してただけ
lines.translated: "...I was just imitating Mashiro."

lines.content: クロは言う。
lines.translated: So said Kuro.

lines.content: 甘いのしか食べられないし、苦いのなんてすっごく苦手。ちょっと舐めただけで舌の先がぴりぴりしてくる
lines.translated: "I can only eat sweet things, and I'm really bad with bitter stuff. Just a little lick makes the tip of my tongue tingle."

lines.content: そ、そうなんだ
lines.translated: "I-Is that so?"

lines.content: そうだよ……
lines.translated: "It is..."

lines.content: ……だってほんとは、チョコレート……猫は食べちゃだめなんだよ
lines.translated: "...Because really, chocolate... cats aren't supposed to eat it."

lines.content: そんな今さらなことを言うクロに、思わずぼくは笑ってしまった。
lines.translated: Hearing Kuro bring up something so obvious at this point made me laugh in spite of myself.

lines.content: それでも、チョコレート、大好きなふうに見せていたのは……
lines.translated: "Even so, the reason I acted like I loved chocolate so much was..."

lines.content: ただ、大雅が……。
lines.translated: Just because, Taiga...

lines.content: きみが、大切に想ってるだろうまっしろなあの子を真似したいと思っただけ。
lines.translated: I just wanted to imitate that pure white girl whom you surely treasure so much.

lines.content: ……この姿も同じだよ
lines.translated: "...It's the same with this form, too."

lines.content: 黒猫なわたしがまっしろになりたいと願ったのは、自分の“邪悪”さを少しでも、見た目だけでも、[・|し][・|ろ][・|い][・|も][・|の]にしようという気持ちもあったけど……。
lines.translated: As a black cat, part of the reason I wished to become pure white was because I wanted to turn my own "wickedness"--even just a little, even if only in appearance--into *something white*, but...

lines.content: わたしはわたしなりに、あの子の姿を真似てみたつもりだった……
lines.translated: "In my own way, I was trying to imitate her appearance..."

lines.content: 何にもできないわたしだから。上手に真似られてるかも、わからないけど。それでもわたしは……
lines.translated: "Because I can't do anything right, I don't even know if I'm imitating her well. But even so, I..."

lines.content: わたしは、あの子みたいになりたかったとクロは言う。
lines.translated: I wanted to become like that girl, Kuro says.

lines.content: きみが、誰かのことを助けられる奏大雅みたいな……そんなヒーローになりたいと、そう願っていたみたいに
lines.translated: "Just like how you wished to become a hero who could save someone... like Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: ……わたしは、きみのことをいっぱい笑顔にできる――あの子みたいに、ましろみたいに、なりたかっただけなんだよ
lines.translated: "...I just wanted to become like her--like Mashiro--someone who could make you smile a whole lot."

lines.content: ――いつか一緒にチョコレートを食べようね。
lines.translated: --Let's eat chocolate together someday, okay?

lines.content: そんなきみとあの子との約束も、わたしが代わりに叶えてあげられればとも、思って……
lines.translated: "I also thought that maybe I could fulfill that promise between you and her in her place..."

lines.content: そこで少しクロはぼくの胸元から顔を上げる。そして唇を結び、苦笑いを作ってから、言った。
lines.translated: At that, Kuro lifted her face slightly from my chest. She pressed her lips together, forced a wry smile, and spoke.

lines.content: ……そうすればきみはいっぱい、笑ってくれるかなって思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "...I thought that if I did that, maybe you would smile a whole lot for me."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ぼくはうなずき、言った。
lines.translated: I nodded and spoke.

lines.content: それは知らなかったな
lines.translated: "I didn't know that."

lines.content: そうだよ。……わたしはいっぱいきみにうそついた
lines.translated: "That's right. ...I told you so many lies."

lines.content: だからいっぱい、これからもうそをつく。何度も。何度だって。
lines.translated: So I'll tell you lots more lies from now on, too. Over and over. As many times as it takes.

lines.content: そんなわたしでも、一緒に生きたいって……思う？
lines.translated: "Even though I'm like this... do you still want to live together with me?"

lines.content: 思うよ
lines.translated: "I do."

lines.content: ぼくは言った。
lines.translated: I said.

lines.content: 君のいない時間なんて考えられない
lines.translated: "I can't even imagine a time without you in it."

lines.content: ぼくは自分を許せない。
lines.translated: I cannot forgive myself.

lines.content: きっとこの思いからは生涯逃れられることはできないだろう――それでも今、君に正直に即答できた自分だけは好きでいられる。
lines.translated: Surely I will never be able to escape this feeling for the rest of my life--yet even so, I can at least like the part of myself that was able to answer you honestly and without hesitation right now.

lines.content: だからクロ。もし、君も同じように思ってくれるなら……
lines.translated: "So, Kuro. If you feel the same way..."

lines.content: ぼくはクロに手を差し出した。
lines.translated: I held my hand out to Kuro.

lines.content: ……どうかこの手を、握ってくれないかな
lines.translated: "...Won't you please take this hand?"

lines.content: クロ。君が一緒にいてくれるなら……
lines.translated: "Kuro. If you'll stay with me..."

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ごめん。こういう言い方は卑怯かもしれないけれど――君が一緒にいてくれるなら、ぼくはもう二度と“夜の王”になろうとか思わない
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Putting it this way might be cowardly of me, but--if you stay with me, I won't ever think about becoming the 'King of the Night' again."

lines.content: 自分自身を罰することで、勝手に罪を償ったような気になって――
lines.translated: "Punishing myself just to selfishly feel as though I've atoned for my sins--"

lines.content: ……いいや
もともと誰も怒っちゃいないのに。それでも[・|そ][・|う]して、自己満足に浸るようなこともない。この命に与えられた時間を、大切に、全うすることができると思う
lines.translated: "Even though nobody was ever angry at me to begin with. I won't do *that* anymore just to wallow in self-satisfaction. I think I'll be able to cherish and live out the time given to this life of mine."

lines.content: “ぼくなんて産まれてこなければよかった……”
lines.translated: "I wish I had never been born..."

lines.content: いつまでもそう思えてならないぼくを、きみは、大切に思ってくれた。
lines.translated: Though I could never stop feeling that way, you cherished me.

lines.content: “きみがこの世界に生まれてきてくれて、本当に、よかった”……。
lines.translated: "I'm truly glad that you were born into this world"...

lines.content: そういうふうに思ってくれる君と生きたいんだよ。ずっと、ずっと、いつまでも
lines.translated: "I want to live with the you who feels that way about me. Forever, and ever, for all time."

lines.content: 君が一緒にいてくれたら、もう自分はひとりぼっちだなんて……。そんな勘違い、しなくて済むから
lines.translated: "If you're with me, I won't have to make the mistake of thinking I'm all alone anymore."

lines.content: ……一緒に行こう
lines.translated: "...Let's go together."

lines.content: この日、このときから、色々な人たちと色々な“想い”を背負って、幾つもの時間へぼくらの可能性は枝分かれしていくのだろうけど……。
lines.translated: From this day, from this very moment, our possibilities will probably branch out into countless timelines, carrying all sorts of people and all sorts of "feelings" on our backs...

lines.content: ここから先はまったくのあたらしい時間だ。
lines.translated: Everything from here on out is a completely new time.

lines.content: ……ここから先に産まれるものはすべて、ぼく達だけのあたらしい時間だ
lines.translated: "...Everything born from this point on is a brand-new time belonging only to us."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ここから産まれるあたらしい時間の中で、ぼく達にしか描けない、歌えない――そんな物語みたいな、歌みたいな、たったひとつの人生を一緒に歩んでいけたらと願ってる。
lines.translated: Within the new time born from here, I wish that we can walk together through a single, irreplaceable life--like a story, like a song--that only the two of us can paint and sing.

lines.content: ……願ってるんだ。
lines.translated: That's what I'm wishing for.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: お願いだ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: もしもこの“想い”が君に届くなら。
lines.translated: If these "feelings" can reach you...

lines.content: ……どうかぼくの手を、握ってくれないかな
lines.translated: "...Won't you please take my hand?"

lines.content: クロは、差し出したぼくの手をじっと見ている。
lines.translated: Kuro stares intently at my outstretched hand.

lines.content: 長い……。とても長い時間が過ぎたように感じた。
lines.translated: A long... a very long time seemed to pass.

lines.content: 暖かな春の風が通り抜け、さくらの花びらがはらはらと舞う。
lines.translated: A warm spring breeze blows through, and cherry blossom petals flutter gently in the air.

lines.content: ……だめ
ぽつりと、クロが言った。
lines.translated: Softly, Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……わたしも、きみと同じ。まだ、自分のことが許せない
lines.translated: "...I'm the same as you. I still can't forgive myself."

lines.content: きみに“いいんだよ”って言われても、だめだよ。“心”の中の暗いのが、消えないよ
lines.translated: "Even if you tell me 'it's okay,' it's no good. The darkness inside my 'heart' won't disappear."

lines.content: ……どういうふうにしたら自分に“もういいんだよ”って言えるのか。ばかなわたしはきっと、永遠にわからないままだって思うから……
lines.translated: "...How can I ever tell myself 'it's okay now'? Because I'm so stupid, I think I'll probably never understand for all eternity..."

lines.content: そこまで言うと、クロはうつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: Having said that much, Kuro casts her eyes down.

lines.content: 風だ。
lines.translated: The wind.

lines.content: また、風が吹いた。今度はさっきよりも強い風だった。幾つかの花びらが顔に触れ、ぼくは一瞬だけ[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた――……ふと、
lines.translated: The wind blew again. This time, it was stronger than before. Several petals brushed against my face, and I closed my eyelids for just a moment--...Suddenly,

lines.content: ……わたし
……手のひらに、柔らかいものを感じた。
lines.translated: I felt something soft against my palm.

lines.content: 恐る恐る、[まぶた|瞼]を開く……。
lines.translated: Timidly, I open my eyelids...

lines.content: ……わ、わたしで、いいの？
lines.translated: "...I-Is it really okay for it to be me?"

lines.content: クロは言った。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: 差し出したぼくの手を握るではなく、そっと、重ねるようにして自分の手を置いていた。
lines.translated: Rather than grasping my outstretched hand, she had gently placed her own hand over mine.

lines.content: ……わたしなんかで、ほんとうに、いいの？
lines.translated: "...Is someone like me really okay?"

lines.content: 目を伏せ、ぼくのことを見ないまま、クロは言うのだ。
lines.translated: Keeping her eyes lowered, without looking at me, Kuro speaks.

lines.content: わたし……
わたしは、きっといつまでも自分が嫌いなままだって思う。いつまでも、きみを傷つけたことを悩み続ける。そんな暗い子と一緒にいても、だめ。楽しくないよ
lines.translated: "I think I'll surely keep hating myself forever. I'll keep agonizing forever over how I hurt you. Being together with such a gloomy girl is no good. It won't be any fun."

lines.content: だから、わたし……わたしは、きみに気づかれないくらいの距離から、いつも、きみのこと見てるくらいがちょうどいいんだって、思って……
lines.translated: "So I... I thought that just watching over you from a distance where you wouldn't notice me would be just right..."

lines.content: そこで言葉を区切り、
lines.translated: She cuts off her words there.

lines.content: 少しの、沈黙。
lines.translated: A brief silence.

lines.content: それは一生懸命、ぼくのために言葉を考えてくれてる証拠だとわかる。
lines.translated: I can tell that it's proof she is thinking as hard as she can to find the right words for my sake.

lines.content: ……きみのこと
lines.translated: "...About you..."

lines.content: クロは言う。
lines.translated: So said Kuro.

lines.content: ……きみのことを想う子は、他にもいるよ。わたしだけじゃない
lines.translated: "...There are other girls who care about you, too. Not just me."

lines.content: わたしみたいなできそこないな“心”じゃなくて……ちゃんとした人間の心で、きみのことを想ってる子はいるんだよ
lines.translated: "Not with a defective 'heart' like mine... There's a girl who cares about you with a proper, human heart."

lines.content: その子をきみの“隣”に届けられればって思って……そうすれば、きみは、幸せになれるんじゃないかって、思って……
lines.translated: "I thought if I could deliver that girl to your 'side'... then maybe, just maybe, you could be happy..."

lines.content: また少しの沈黙を挟み……、
lines.translated: Another brief silence falls between us...

lines.content: でも
でもね、とクロは言う。唇を噛んで。
lines.translated: "But you know," Kuro says, biting her lip.

lines.content: ……でも、ごめん。いやだって、思った
lines.translated: "...Even so, I'm sorry. I realized I didn't want that."
"The thought of you smiling by the 'side' of someone else who cares for you... while you don't even remember me anymore. Having completely forgotten me."

lines.content: そんなきみのこと、わたし、遠くからひとりぼっちで見つめてるだけ
lines.translated: "And me, just watching you like that from afar, all alone."

lines.content: そんな時間はさみしいって、思ってしまった
lines.translated: "I couldn't help thinking how lonely that kind of time would be."

lines.content: ……そんなの覚悟してたはずなのに。いつかそうなるんだってこと、わかってたのに。それなのに……ごめん。ごめんね。[・|ハ][・|ル]。……わたし、卑怯だ
lines.translated: "...Even though I was supposed to be prepared for it. Even though I knew it would turn out that way someday. And yet... I'm sorry. I'm so sorry, Haru. ...I'm such a coward."

lines.content: ……きみのこの手を、他の誰かが握るのかと思うと……う、……うう……どうしよう。それがいいんだって思ってたはずなのに。痛い。胸が、痛くて……ぐす……涙が……
lines.translated: "...When I think of someone else holding this hand of yours... ugh... uurgh... what do I do? Even though I thought that would be for the best. It hurts. My chest hurts so much... *sniff*... the tears..."

lines.content: ぽろぽろとこぼれだした涙を、クロはもう片方の手で何度も拭っていた。
lines.translated: With her other hand, Kuro kept wiping away the tears that were spilling down her cheeks in fat drops.

lines.content: ……きらい。だいきらい。こんなわたし、きらい……まっくろだ……自分のこと、ばっかり……こんなに痛いなら……“心”なんて、いらなかった……
lines.translated: "...I hate it. I hate it so much. I hate myself like this... I'm pitch-black inside... only ever thinking about myself... If it hurts this much... I never wanted a 'heart' at all..."

lines.content: ふと、重ねられていた手が離れそうになる。
lines.translated: Suddenly, the hand resting on mine begins to pull away.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: クロはぼくを見上げた。
lines.translated: Kuro looked up at me.

lines.content: 涙で頬はいっぱいに濡れている。その涙を拭えるものがぼくの言葉でありますようにと、祈ってる。
lines.translated: Her cheeks are completely drenched in tears. I pray that my words will be enough to wipe those tears away.

lines.content: 自分のことを母性的な感情で大切に想ってくれてる。そんな異性を口説くのは大変だ――そういうふうに奏大雅から言われてたから。だからさ、断られることも覚悟してたんだ
lines.translated: "She cares about you deeply with maternal affection, so wooing a girl like that is going to be tough--that's what Kanade Taiga told me. So, you know, I was prepared to be rejected."

lines.content: くどく……？
lines.translated: "Wooing...?"

lines.content: 小首をかしげるクロに、ぼくは言う。
lines.translated: As Kuro tilts her head slightly, I speak to her.

lines.content: 大好き
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: ……君のことが大好きだって、世界で一番大好きなひとに伝えることだよ
lines.translated: "...It means telling the person you love most in the world that you love them."

lines.content: 真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: Bright red.

lines.content: だ、大好き……
lines.translated: "L-Love..."

lines.content: クロはみるみる真っ赤になっていく。
lines.translated: Kuro turns bright red right before my eyes.

lines.content: クロは……どう、かな
lines.translated: "What about you... Kuro?"

lines.content: ……どう？
lines.translated: "...What about me?"

lines.content: ぼくのこと、どう思ってくれてるのか。返事を聞かせてくれたら、うれしい
lines.translated: "How do you feel about me? It'd make me really happy if you let me hear your answer."

lines.content: そ、それは……
lines.translated: "Th-That's..."

lines.content: 視線を泳がせながら、言う。
lines.translated: She speaks while her gaze darts around nervously.

lines.content: ……ぼ、母性、なんて
lines.translated: "...M-Maternal affection, I mean..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……た、確かにきみのお母さんの心を、わたし、もらってしまったけど……わ、わたしは別に、きみのお母さんになりたいわけじゃ……
lines.translated: "...I-It's true that I received your mother's heart, but... i-it's not like I want to become your mother or anything..."

lines.content: もにょもにょとしながら、またうつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: Mumbling restlessly, she casts her eyes down again.

lines.content: そんな君に、ぼくは仕切り直すようにして、言う。
lines.translated: Taking a breath to start fresh, I speak to her.

lines.content: クロ。……好きだよ
lines.translated: "Kuro. ...I like you."

lines.content: 大好きだ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: ありがとう。いつも側にいてくれて。いつも、ぼくのこと、上手くいくようにって見守っていてくれていて
lines.translated: "Thank you. For always being by my side. For always watching over me and hoping things would go well for me."

lines.content: 目には見えなくともいつも近くに、君のことを感じられていたと思う。
lines.translated: Even when I couldn't see you, I think I could always feel you close by.

lines.content: それは大きな、とても大きな安心感になっていたんだ――……安心できること。心配に思わないこと。
lines.translated: That gave me a huge, immense sense of security--...being able to feel at ease. Not having to worry.

lines.content: それがどれだけ、“生きる”ということにとって大切なのかを、言葉ではない部分で……、君のおかげで、知ることができたように思うんだ。
lines.translated: Thanks to you, in a way beyond words... I think I was able to learn just how important that is to "living."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: これからは、ぼくたちも自分の人生を生きよう。他の誰かのふりや真似をしなくてもきっと、ぼく達は、ふたりなら大丈夫
lines.translated: "From now on, let's live our own lives, too. Even without pretending to be someone else or imitating anyone, I'm sure we'll be okay, as long as we're together."

lines.content: 自分の時間の中に現れたあらゆる困難を、この手で、この足で――自分自身だからこそ、乗り越えていけるはずだから。
lines.translated: Because whatever hardships appear in our time, with these hands and these feet--precisely because we are ourselves, we should be able to overcome them.

lines.content: これからは自分の人生を、自分のために、君のために、生きていけるよ
lines.translated: "From here on out, I can live my own life, for my sake, and for yours."

lines.content: そういうふうに安心することができる――これからも、君と一緒にいられるのなら。
lines.translated: I can feel that kind of peace of mind--as long as I can be with you from now on, too.

lines.content: クロはやっぱりまだ少し悩んでる。
lines.translated: Even so, Kuro still looks a little conflicted.

lines.content: もし、君がうなずいてくれないのなら。何度でも“大好き”だという言葉を贈ろうと思ってた。その気持ちを伝えられたらと感じてた。
lines.translated: If she wouldn't nod for me, I intended to give her the words "I love you" as many times as it took. I just wanted to convey these feelings to her.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ぎゅっと、
lines.translated: Tightly,

lines.content: ……わたしも
lines.translated: "...Me too."

lines.content: ぼくの手を、握り返し……笑った。
lines.translated: She squeezed my hand back... and smiled.

lines.content: わたしも、だよ。……きみと[おんな|同]じ。いつも、わたしの“心”は、さみしいのも悲しいのも、うれしいのだってきみとお揃い……なのかも、しれない
lines.translated: "Me too. ...I'm the same as you. Maybe my 'heart' always matches yours... whether it's feeling lonely, or sad, or even happy."

lines.content: クロは……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: ……わたしもきみのことずっと、ずっと前から……出会ったときから、大好き、だったよ
lines.translated: "...I've loved you too, for a long, long time... ever since we first met."

lines.content: だぶんそういうことだよねと言い。
lines.translated: "That's probably what it means, right?" she said.

lines.content: クロは、ずきずき痛む傷に手を当てるみたいに“[胸|心]”に触れて、今まで見たことのないいっぱいの笑顔を、ぼくに見せてくれていた。
lines.translated: Touching her "heart" as if pressing a hand against a throbbing wound, Kuro showed me the fullest, brightest smile I had ever seen.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: 覚えてる？
lines.translated: "Do you remember?"

lines.content: と君が言った。吐息が頬をくすぐるほど近くでだ。
lines.translated: You said, so close that your breath tickled my cheek.
Night.

lines.content: ふたりで身体を寄せ合い、“夢”について語り合っていた。
lines.translated: The two of us were huddled together, talking about "dreams."

lines.content: 覚えてるかな。ましろがきみにした星空の話。……それをわたしが真似してきみに話した、星の空。あのお話のこと
lines.translated: "I wonder if you remember. The story about the starry sky that Mashiro told you. ...And the starry sky I told you about, imitating her. That story."

lines.content: ああ、覚えてる
lines.translated: "Yeah, I remember."

lines.content: 忘れるわけない。それは夜空に光る星を“夢”に見立てた話だった。それは、不安ばかりの未来に“希望”を見つけ出したいと願う話だった。
lines.translated: How could I possibly forget? It was a story that likened the stars shining in the night sky to "dreams." It was a story about wishing to find "hope" in a future filled with nothing but anxiety.

lines.content: 夜になるといつもあの話のことを思ってた。……わたしの“夢”はなんだろうって。いつも、考えてた
lines.translated: "Whenever night fell, I always thought about that story. ...I always wondered what my 'dream' could be."

lines.content: そしてね、いつの頃だったか……見つけたの。わたしの叶えたい“夢”
lines.translated: "And you know, at some point... I found it. The 'dream' I want to come true."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: クロの叶えたい“夢”は、どんな“夢”？
lines.translated: "What kind of 'dream' is the 'dream' you want to come true, Kuro?"

lines.content: ぼくが問いかけると、
lines.translated: When I asked her that,

lines.content: きみと同じになりたい
lines.translated: "I want to become the same as you."

lines.content: クロは言った。きっぱりと。
lines.translated: Kuro said decidedly.

lines.content: “心”は、きみと少しでも一緒になれたかもしれない。でも、“命”は違う
lines.translated: "My 'heart' might have become a little bit like yours. But my 'life' is different."

lines.content: きみは人間で、わたしは“猫”で……。産まれた形も、生きる時間も。全部違うよ……
lines.translated: "You're a human, and I'm a 'cat'... The form we were born into, the time we live through. It's all different..."

lines.content: だからそういう全部も、きみと同じになりたいなって、思う
lines.translated: "So I think I want all of those things to become the same as yours, too."

lines.content: それがわたしの“夢”だよと、クロは囁くみたいに言っていた。
lines.translated: "That is my 'dream,'" Kuro said in a near-whisper.

lines.content: “夢”を持つことが[・|人][・|間][・|の][・|証]しのように思えて……。だからわたしは、いつも“夢”について考えていたんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "Having a 'dream' felt like proof of being human... I think that's why I was always thinking about 'dreams.'"

lines.content: そうして見つけたクロの“夢”――ぼくと同じになりたい。
lines.translated: And the "dream" Kuro found that way--was to become the same as me.

lines.content: ぼくと同じ“命”になりたい――そうでなければ。
lines.translated: To have the same kind of "life" as me--because otherwise...
"Someday, you and I will..."

lines.content: そこで濁した言葉や“想い”、それそのものを打ち消そうとするみたいに、ぽつりと。
lines.translated: Quietly, as if trying to erase the very words and "feelings" she had just trailed off on,

lines.content: ……大好き
lines.translated: "...I love you."

lines.content: クロは、ぼくに言った。
lines.translated: Kuro said to me.

lines.content: わたし、きみのことが大好きだよ
lines.translated: "I really love you."

lines.content: きみがここにこうして生きていてくれるなら、わたしも、その分だけでも、ここで……この世界で生きていても、いいのかなって。そう思えた
lines.translated: "As long as you're alive right here like this, I felt that maybe, just for that much, it's okay for me to live here... in this world, too."

lines.content: クロは言う――わたし、自分の“心”がわからなかったんだよ、と。
lines.translated: Kuro says--that she didn't understand her own "heart."

lines.content: わたしはばかで、色々足りない。だからわからないことばっかりで……。でも、この世界で一番むずかしいのは自分の“心”と、自分の“気持ち”
lines.translated: "I'm stupid, and I lack so many things. So there's just so much I don't understand... But the hardest things in this world are my own 'heart' and my own 'feelings.'"

lines.content: 自分が何を想ってるのか。どういうふうに感じているのか。全然わからない。……“心”は難しいって思ってた
lines.translated: "What I'm thinking. How I'm feeling. I don't understand it at all. ...I thought having a 'heart' was so difficult."

lines.content: 自分のもののはずなのに思い通りに全然ならない――それどころか、痛いの
lines.translated: "Even though it's supposed to be mine, it doesn't do what I want at all--in fact, it hurts."

lines.content: ……わからないことが増える度、胸の奥にしまった“心”がずきずきするよ。こんなことなら、“心”なんて要らなかったのにとも思ってた
lines.translated: "...Every time the things I don't understand Pile up, the 'heart' tucked deep inside my chest throbs with pain. It made me think that if it was going to be like this, I never needed a 'heart' at all."

lines.content: でも、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: "But," Kuro says.

lines.content: それでもね、今日……ひとつだけ、自分の気持ちについてわかったんだよ
lines.translated: "Even so, today... I understood just one thing about my own feelings."

lines.content: ……きみがわたしのこと、好きだよって言ってくれたとき、気づいたの
lines.translated: "...When you told me that you liked me, I realized it."

lines.content: きみとわたしは[おんな|同]じだから……。だからね。[・|こ][・|れ]は、きみのことが大好きっていう気持ちなんだって。きみの言葉と気持ちに触れて、わかったの
lines.translated: "Because you and I are the same... That's why. By touching your words and your feelings, I understood that this is the feeling of loving you."

lines.content: 胸元にそっと手を置き[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: She gently places a hand over her chest and closes her eyelids.

lines.content: そんなクロの様子は、まるで[・|そ][・|こ]に産まれたばかりの儚いものがこぼれ出してしまわないよう、やさしく抑えているようにも見えた。
lines.translated: Looking at Kuro like that, it seemed almost as if she were gently holding down something fragile that had just been born right there, so it wouldn't spill out.

lines.content: きみのことだけ、ずっと見てた
lines.translated: "I was always watching only you."

lines.content: でもそれは、最初は罪悪感からだった。きみを傷つけたわたしにはそうする責任があるから……だからきみのことを見守って。いざというとき、助けなきゃって
lines.translated: "But at first, that was out of guilt. Because I hurt you, I had a responsibility to do so... so I thought I had to watch over you, and help you if the worst happened."

lines.content: ……いつも胸の奥が痛いのは。そんな痛いのが少しずつ大きくなるのは。きみへどういうふうに“ごめんなさい”を伝えていいかわからないせいだって、思ってたけど
lines.translated: "...I thought the reason it always hurt deep in my chest, and the reason that pain kept growing little by little, was because I didn't know how to say 'I'm sorry' to you."

lines.content: でも、それだけじゃなかった
lines.translated: "But that wasn't all it was."

lines.content: それがわかったせいなのか――今はもう、胸が痛いと感じることは[・|あ][・|ん][・|ま][・|り]ないよ。
lines.translated: "Maybe it's because I figured that out--now, my chest doesn't really hurt much anymore."

lines.content: クロはそう言い、笑ってた。
lines.translated: Kuro said that, and smiled.

lines.content: そんなきみへの“[気持ち|想い]”が、わたしの中に産まれたのはきっとあのとき
lines.translated: "I'm sure those 'feelings' for you were born inside me back then."

lines.content: 真っ暗な地下室に閉じ込められたきみ。その腕の中に潜り込んで――そんなわたしを、きみが抱きしめてくれたときだ。
lines.translated: "When you were locked in that pitch-black basement. When I crawled into your arms--and you held me tight."

lines.content: たったそれだけの痛みが、きみへの“恋心”の始まりだと……今だから、そう思える。
lines.translated: "Only now can I think... that such a small pain was the beginning of my 'love' for you."

lines.content: だからわたしは、きみのことが好き。いつまでもずっと、大好き……
lines.translated: "That's why I like you. Forever and ever, I love you..."

lines.content: 照れたようにクロははにかんだ。
lines.translated: Kuro gave a shy, bashful smile.

lines.content: ……たぶん、きみが教えてくれたいつかの未来の世界で、自分の悪い夢に食べられてしまったわたしが、きみに伝えたかった言葉も、同じ
lines.translated: "...Maybe in that future world you told me about, the words that the me who was eaten up by her own bad dreams wanted to convey to you were the same."

lines.content: きみが好きっていうこの“想い”だったんだろうって思う
lines.translated: "I think it must have been this feeling of loving you."

lines.content: ……きみは、わたしの言葉で、“勇気”を感じてくれていたんだよね……？
lines.translated: "...You felt 'courage' from my words, didn't you...?"

lines.content: それを知ったわたしはたぶん、世界がきらめいて見えただろうと思う
lines.translated: "I think that when I learned that, the whole world must have looked like it was sparkling."

lines.content: ずっと、きみを傷つけたことを後悔して……まっくらな中にいたから。本当に[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き][・|の][・|わ][・|た][・|し]はうれしかったんだろうと思う。幸せだったんじゃないかなって、思うよ
lines.translated: "Because for the longest time, I regretted hurting you... and I was in pitch darkness. So I think the me back then must have been truly glad. I think she must have been happy."

lines.content: そんなきみに、今度はわたしの“好き”を届けられたら……
lines.translated: "And if I could deliver my 'love' to you in return..."

lines.content: そうすれば、もしかしたらきみはもう、たったひとりで、自分に罰するみたいに消えていくこともないんじゃないかって。考え直してくれるんじゃ、ないかって。そう思えて……
lines.translated: "I felt like if I did that, maybe you wouldn't have to disappear all alone anymore, as if punishing yourself. That maybe you'd reconsider..."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はね、紛れもなく、わたしの“希望”だったんだろうなって感じるよ
lines.translated: "I feel like that was unmistakably my 'hope.'"

lines.content: それからもまた、幾つか互いの“夢”について語り合った。
lines.translated: After that, we talked about a few more of each other's "dreams."

lines.content: 君はぼくと同じになりたい。そう願ってくれる。
lines.translated: You wish to become the same as me.

lines.content: ならぼくは将来、どういう自分になりたいのだろう――ぼくはこれまでの“[目標|夢]”を失った。
lines.translated: Then what kind of person do I want to become in the future--I had lost the "dream" I carried until now.

lines.content: 幼い柊ハルを助けるためにと命を使った。そんな俺のこの手を引いてくれたクロ。
lines.translated: I used my life to save the young Hiiragi Haru. And it was Kuro who took my hand back then.

lines.content: もう二度と、悲しいばかりの“さよなら”は嫌だと願ったけれど……。
lines.translated: I wished never to have another "goodbye" filled only with sadness, and yet...

lines.content: でも、だめだ。君と一緒に生きていくことはできない。
lines.translated: It's no use. I cannot live my life together with you.

lines.content: ぼくらは違う。生きる時間も。命も、全部。
lines.translated: We are different. The time we live through. Our lives, everything.

lines.content: また、繰り返してしまう。
lines.translated: It will just repeat itself again.

lines.content: このままではまた、[・|俺]たちは別れなければならなくなる。
lines.translated: At this rate, we will have to part ways again.

lines.content: ……さよなら
lines.translated: "...Goodbye."

lines.content: きみの声だけ覚えてる。
lines.translated: I remember only your voice.

lines.content: ……さよなら、ばいばい。幸せに生きてね
lines.translated: "...Goodbye, bye-bye. Live a happy life, okay?"

lines.content: いつの間にか眠ってしまったぼくだけど……。
lines.translated: Though I had fallen asleep before I knew it...

lines.content: ……さみしがり屋なきみの隣に、いつも、きらきら光る“夢”のような“魔法”が、ありますように
lines.translated: "...May there always be a 'magic' like a sparkling 'dream' right beside you, my lonely boy."

lines.content: 朝、目を覚ますとクロはどこにもいなかった。
lines.translated: When I woke up in the morning, Kuro was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: ……眠ってしまえばクロは“さよなら”
lines.translated: Once she falls asleep, it's "goodbye" to Kuro.

lines.content: 少し先の未来にまで跳んでしまう。
lines.translated: She leaps into the future a little ways ahead.

lines.content: その“病”を、ぼくの“魔法”で――ましろと奏大雅とを蘇らせるために得た“魔法”は、もはやその使い道を失ってしまったから――打ち消してしまうことはできたかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps I could have canceled out that "illness" with my "magic"--since the "magic" I obtained to revive Mashiro and Kanade Taiga had already lost its purpose.

lines.content: だが[・|今]のぼくはまだ、この左手にあさひさんからそのための“役割”を与えてもらっていなかった。だから“魔法”は使えない。
lines.translated: However, the current me still hadn't been given the "role" for that in this left hand by Asahi-san. So I couldn't use "magic."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じれば君の笑顔がそこにはあった。
lines.translated: When I closed my eyelids, your smiling face was right there.

lines.content: ぼくにだけ見せてくれていた、やさしいばかりの微笑みだ。
lines.translated: A purely gentle smile that you showed only to me.

lines.content: 大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: ……君がどこかで心配したりしないよう。もう、ぼくは、これから何があっても落ち込んだりしないよ。意味もなく心を暗くさせたりも、しない
lines.translated: "...So that you won't worry about me wherever you are. No matter what happens from now on, I won't get depressed anymore. And I won't let my heart grow dark for no reason."

lines.content: 自分を無駄に責めたりもしない。自分勝手に自分のことを罰しようとも考えない。……考えないように、する。
lines.translated: I won't needlessly blame myself, either. I won't think about selfishly punishing myself. ...I'll try not to think that way.

lines.content: ……笑顔で。ひとりぼっちでも幸せに、生きていくから
lines.translated: "...With a smile. Even if I'm all alone, I'll live happily."

lines.content: あたらしく産まれたぼくらの時間を、せめて不幸せなものにはしないように生きるからと、そう誓う。
lines.translated: I swear to live so that this newly born time of ours won't be an unhappy one, at the very least.

lines.content: だから……
だから一度だけでもいい。
lines.translated: So just once is enough.

lines.content: また“夢”の中ででも、いいんだ。
lines.translated: Even if it's inside a "dream" again, that's fine.

lines.content: クロ。
lines.translated: Kuro.

lines.content: ……お願いだよ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: ……もう一度だけ、君と笑って逢える瞬間がありますように。それが、ぼくのあたらしい“夢”だよ、クロ
lines.translated: "...I pray there will be a moment where I can meet you and smile with you just one more time. That is my new 'dream,' Kuro."

lines.content: ……“さよなら”
lines.translated: "Goodbye."

lines.content: 最後にきみへそう囁いてから、どれくらい経っただろう。
lines.translated: How much time has passed since I last whispered that to you?

lines.content: ……“さよなら、ばいばい。幸せに生きてね”
lines.translated: "Goodbye, bye-bye. Live a happy life, okay?"

lines.content: [・|わ][・|た][・|し]がそう願ったとおり、きみは幸せに生きられただろうか。
lines.translated: Have you been able to live happily, just as I wished?

lines.content: ううん。
lines.translated: No.
I know that it didn't turn out that way.

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 小さくこぼしたわたしの声は、行き交う雑踏に呑まれて消える。
lines.translated: My softly spilled voice is swallowed up by the passing crowd and vanishes.

lines.content: わたしの祈りが……“想い”が、足りなかったのかな
lines.translated: "Were my prayers... my 'feelings,' not enough?"

lines.content: ……きみはずっとひとりぼっちだった。
lines.translated: You were always all alone.

lines.content: ……ひとりで生きる時間は、とてもさみしい
lines.translated: "...The time spent living alone is very lonely."

lines.content: わたしはそう思ってる。
lines.translated: That is what I think.

lines.content: もしそれが[・|答][・|え]のひとつであるのなら、やっぱりきみは、幸せに生きられているのかどうか――疑問が残る。
lines.translated: If that is one of the answers, then a doubt still remains--as to whether you are truly able to live happily.

lines.content: わたしは今、“夜”にそびえる巨大な駅に――“刻の終着駅”に立っている。
lines.translated: Right now, I am standing in a gigantic station towering within the "Night"--the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: 今夜の最終便がそろそろ出る頃だ。
lines.translated: It's almost time for tonight's last train to depart.

lines.content: わたしは“次”へ旅立たなきゃいけない。
lines.translated: I have to set off on a journey to the "next."
Because I have used up all nine of the lives I had. I lost the right to live in the "outside world."

lines.content: 手のひらに握りしめた一枚の切符。
lines.translated: A single ticket clutched tightly in my palm.

lines.content: この切符は、わたしの“夢”を叶えてくれる。
lines.translated: This ticket will grant my "dream."

lines.content: そのために購入したはずなのに、わたしの両足は重たかった。
lines.translated: Even though I bought it for that very purpose, both of my legs felt heavy.

lines.content: きみをひとり置いていくことがとても不安で……。ここから一歩、踏み出すことを躊躇している。
lines.translated: Leaving you behind all alone makes me so anxious... I am hesitating to take a single step forward from here.

lines.content: そんなわたしを置いて、幾つも列車が駅から走り去っていった。
lines.translated: Leaving me behind like that, several trains have already sped away from the station.

lines.content: そのどれにも乗車できないまま、わたしはホームのベンチに座り込んでいた。
lines.translated: Unable to board any of them, I sat slumped on a bench on the platform.

lines.content: そして今、目の前に今夜の最終便が留まってる。
lines.translated: And now, tonight's last train is stopped right in front of my eyes.

lines.content: これを乗り過ごしてしまえば、命を使い切ってしまったわたしはこの町の“夜”に、永遠に縛られたままの“[何か|影]”と化すだろう。
lines.translated: If I miss this one, having used up all my lives, I will turn into a "shadow" forever bound to the "Night" of this town.

lines.content: それはわかっているはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I know that...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: わたしは一歩も動けない。
lines.translated: I cannot move a single step.

lines.content: 今、きみはどうしてるだろう。
lines.translated: How are you doing right now?

lines.content: わたしのあげた九つ目の“命”は、ちゃんときみのことを生かしてあげられているだろうか。
lines.translated: Is the ninth "life" I gave you properly keeping you alive?

lines.content: それを確かめられないままでいることを未練に思い、わたしは“次”に踏み出せずにいる。
lines.translated: Feeling regret over not being able to confirm that, I am unable to step forward into the "next."

lines.content: ……ねえ、誰か教えて
lines.translated: "...Hey, someone tell me."

lines.content: わたしはひとり、誰にも届くはずないつぶやきをこぼしてる。
lines.translated: All alone, I let slip a murmur that could never reach anyone.

lines.content: わたし、わたしは……きみの役に、少しは立ててたのかな
lines.translated: "Was I, was I... able to be of even a little use to you?"

lines.content: きみに“さよなら”を言ったあの夜。
lines.translated: That night when I said "goodbye" to you.

lines.content: 予感していた。
lines.translated: I had a premonition.

lines.content: ……きみとわたしの“さよなら”はもう近い。
lines.translated: That our "goodbye" was already close at hand.

lines.content: きみはこれからもずっと、わたしと一緒に生きていきたいと言ってくれたけど。
lines.translated: Even though you told me that you wanted to keep living together with me forever from then on.

lines.content: わたし達はどんなに心が同じになれたとしても、同じ時間を一緒には生きていけない“イキモノ”だから……。
lines.translated: Because no matter how much our hearts become the same, we are "creatures" who cannot live through the same time together...

lines.content: だからわたしはきみに“さよなら”を言った。
lines.translated: That's why I said "goodbye" to you.

lines.content: たぶん、次に会えるときにはもう、きみはわたしのことを覚えていない――きみは、“夜”に関することをすべて忘れ、奏大雅として大人になってる。
lines.translated: Probably, the next time we can meet, you won't remember me anymore--you will have forgotten everything about the "Night" and grown up as Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: きみたち人間は大人になると、わたしたち“夜”に関することを忘れてしまう。
lines.translated: When you humans grow up, you forget everything about us and the "Night."

lines.content: きみの心に“大人の世界”が訪れる――その予感があったから“さよなら”と言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Because I had a premonition that the "adult world" was visiting your heart--I said "goodbye."

lines.content: わたしが次に目を覚ましたのは、きみに“さよなら”と言ってからちょうど一年ほど先の未来だった。
lines.translated: The next time I woke up, it was in the future, almost a year after I said "goodbye" to you.
It was just as I had foreseen.

lines.content: そのとき既に、きみはわたしのことを忘れてしまってた。
lines.translated: By that time, you had already forgotten all about me.

lines.content: わたしが目を覚ましたのは大雅の部屋の布団の中。
lines.translated: I woke up inside the futon in Taiga's room.

lines.content: 隣には眠る大雅の横顔がある。
lines.translated: Beside me was Taiga's sleeping profile.
"Taiga..."

lines.content: 声を掛けてみた。
lines.translated: I tried calling out to him.

lines.content: そのときのわたしは、どれくらいの時間を飛び越えたのかまだ知らず……。
lines.translated: At that time, I still didn't know how much time I had leaped across...

lines.content: 『ねえ、大雅。……きみは今、どんな夢を見てるのかな。楽しい夢だったらいいなあって思うけど』
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. ...What kind of dream are you having right now? I hope it's a fun dream."

lines.content: もし……。
lines.translated: What if...

lines.content: 『……もしもその中にわたしもいられたなら、もっといいけど』
lines.translated: "...Though if I could be in it too, that would be even better."

lines.content: そんなことを思い、でも口には出せないまま……。
lines.translated: Thinking things like that, yet unable to say them out loud...

lines.content: わたしは手を握った。
lines.translated: I held your hand.

lines.content: 眠るきみの手を握っていると安心できた。
lines.translated: Holding your sleeping hand brought me relief.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: でもそのときのきみは、わたしの手を握り返してはくれなかった。
lines.translated: But at that time, you didn't squeeze my hand back.

lines.content: わたしだけがきみの手を、いつまでもにぎにぎとするばかり。
lines.translated: It was only me, endlessly giving your hand little squeezes.

lines.content: 『いつか、握り返してくれるよね。……きっと。そうだよね、大雅』
lines.translated: "Someday, you'll squeeze my hand back, won't you? ...Surely. Right, Taiga?"

lines.content: このときが必ず来ると覚悟はしていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though I was supposed to have been prepared for this time to inevitably come.

lines.content: それなのに声が震えた。
lines.translated: Even so, my voice trembled.

lines.content: 祈りのような気持ちも、そこにはあったと思う。
lines.translated: I think there was also a feeling like a prayer in it.

lines.content: そのうち大雅は目を覚ます。
lines.translated: Before long, Taiga wakes up.

lines.content: 『おはよう大雅……っ』
lines.translated: "Good morning, Taiga...!"

lines.content: 飛びつきたくなるのをぐっと抑え――だって恥ずかしいし、そんなの格好悪いから――
lines.translated: Holding back the urge to pounce on him--because it's embarrassing, and doing that would be uncool--

lines.content: 身体をうずうずさせながら、こほんとひとつ小さく咳払いをし、わたしは仕切り直すように言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Fidgeting restlessly, I gave a small, polite cough to clear my throat, and spoke as if making a fresh start.

lines.content: 『お、おはよう。今日はいい天気だよ、大雅。ぽかぽかしてて洗濯物もよく乾きそう』
lines.translated: "G-Good morning. The weather is nice today, Taiga. It's nice and warm, so the laundry looks like it'll dry well."

lines.content: だけど大雅はそんなわたしに構うことなく、視線だって一瞬も、合わすことなく立ち上がり――制服に着替えはじめる。
lines.translated: However, paying no mind to me at all, without even meeting my eyes for a single instant, Taiga stands up--and begins changing into his uniform.

lines.content: 『あ、大雅。そっか。もう、三年生になったんだね。……すごい。男の子って不思議だね、どんどん大きくなってくね』
lines.translated: "Ah, Taiga. I see. You're already a third-year student now. ...Amazing. Boys really are mysterious, aren't they? Growing bigger and bigger so fast."

lines.content: 気づいてとばかりにまとわりついて、そんなことを言ってみても……。
lines.translated: Even when I clung to him as if begging to be noticed and tried saying things like that...

lines.content: 『今朝はあさひも十夜もいないんだね。どこ、行っちゃったのかな……。ひとりで朝ご飯はさみしいよね』
lines.translated: "Neither Asahi nor Toya is here this morning, huh. Where did they go, I wonder... Eating breakfast all alone is lonely, isn't it?"

lines.content: でも大丈夫。わたしがいるよ。ほら、ここにいる。ひとりで静かにトーストを焼いて食べる大雅の隣で胸を張り、そんなことを言ってみても……。
lines.translated: But it's okay. I'm here. Look, I'm right here. Puffing out my chest beside Taiga as he quietly toasted and ate his bread alone, even when I tried saying things like that...

lines.content: 聞こえない。大雅にわたしの声は届かない。もちろんこの姿だって見えてはいない。
lines.translated: He couldn't hear me. My voice didn't reach Taiga. And of course, he couldn't see my form either.

lines.content: 『……行ってきます』
lines.translated: "...I'm leaving."

lines.content: 玄関の扉を閉める前に、誰にともなくそう言って、大雅は学校へ出かけていく。
lines.translated: Before closing the front door, Taiga said that to no one in particular and headed off to school.

lines.content: 『きょ、今日はどんなお勉強、するのかな……。ねえ、大雅。得意な教科ってなんだったっけ？』
lines.translated: "W-What kind of studying will you do today, I wonder... Hey, Taiga. What was your best subject again?"

lines.content: 『きみはどんな大人になるの？　ねえ……大雅。……大雅。そういえば、きみの将来の夢とか、聞いたことなかったかも』
lines.translated: "What kind of adult will you become? Hey... Taiga. ...Taiga. Come to think of it, I don't think I ever asked about your dreams for the future."

lines.content: よかったら教えてほしいなあ……とか、なんだとか。
lines.translated: If you don't mind, I'd love for you to tell me... and things like that.

lines.content: ちょっとだけ泣きそうにもなりながら。
lines.translated: While feeling a little bit like crying.

lines.content: でも、必死になって笑顔を作り、わたしは次々きみへ話しかけてた。
lines.translated: Even so, desperately forcing a smile, I kept talking to you one thing after another.

lines.content: 電話じゃないのに……[・|い][・|つ][・|も]と違ってこんなにたくさん、話しかけられているのも――[・|わ][・|か][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|る][・|か][・|ら][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Even though we weren't on the phone... the reason I was able to talk to you so much, unlike usual--was because I already knew.

lines.content: わたしの全部はもう、きみには二度と届かない。
lines.translated: Everything that I am will never reach you again.

lines.content: それをわかっているから……、わかっているのに、いつもよりたくさん話しかけていた。
lines.translated: Because I knew that... even though I knew it, I talked to you much more than usual.

lines.content: もしかしたら何かのきかっけで気づいてくれるかも。そんな期待もあっただろうと思う。
lines.translated: Maybe some little thing would make you notice me. I think I must have held onto a hope like that, too.

lines.content: わたしはきみの手のひらにそっと、触れてみる。手を繋ごうとした。
lines.translated: I softly tried touching the palm of your hand. I tried to hold hands with you.

lines.content: でもきみは、ただ風が通り抜けただけみたいに気にもとめなかった。
lines.translated: But you paid it no mind, as if a breeze had simply blown past.

lines.content: 指を絡めようとしたわたしの手には気づかない。
lines.translated: You didn't notice my hand trying to intertwine my fingers with yours.

lines.content: ふりほどくわけではないけれど、きみの手が、わたしの指を擦り抜けていく……。
lines.translated: It wasn't that you shook me off, yet your hand slipped right through my fingers...

lines.content: そのまま、きみはわたしを置いて前へ前へと歩いて行った。
lines.translated: Just like that, you left me behind and kept walking further and further ahead.

lines.content: それでも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: それでもわたしは、大雅……きみの後ろをとぼとぼと付いていく。
lines.translated: Even so, Taiga... I trudged along behind you.

lines.content: 他に行く所なんてない。
lines.translated: I had nowhere else to go.

lines.content: きみの“隣”以外、わたしの居場所なんてどこにもないんだ。
lines.translated: Anywhere other than "beside" you, there is no place where I belong.

lines.content: ぽた、と。
lines.translated: Plip.

lines.content: 足下に雫が落ちた。
lines.translated: A droplet fell at my feet.

lines.content: 最初は、雨かな？　と思ったけど、違う。
lines.translated: At first, I wondered if it was rain, but I was wrong.

lines.content: わたしの頬から幾つもそれは伝って落ちている。
lines.translated: Countless drops were trailing down my cheeks and falling.

lines.content: わたしはしゃがみ込んでしまう。両手で顔に蓋をして。
lines.translated: I ended up crouching down, covering my face with both hands.

lines.content: いつか……。
lines.translated: Someday...

lines.content: いつかこういう日がやって来るのはわかってた。
lines.translated: I knew that a day like this would come eventually.

lines.content: それでも、きみがわたしを忘れてしまう――その瞬間を飛び越え、知らない間に[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|る]のは――とても、とてもさみしいと思った。
lines.translated: Even so, having leaped right past the moment you forgot about me--and finding that it had already happened without my knowing--felt so, so very lonely.

lines.content: その日、わたしはたくさん泣いたように思う。
lines.translated: I think I cried a lot that day.

lines.content: 大雅に泣いてることがバレる心配なんてないのに、きみの“隣”からずっとずっと遠い場所に走って行って――わたしは、泣いた。
lines.translated: Even though there was no need to worry about Taiga finding out I was crying, I ran to a place far, far away from "beside" you--and I cried.

lines.content: 泣いて……。
lines.translated: I cried, and cried...

lines.content: 泣いて。
lines.translated: Crying.

lines.content: そこはどこかの町の、どこかの草むらの中だったように思う。自分でも驚くくらいの声をあげ、わたしは、夜が終わるまで泣き続けてた。
lines.translated: I think it was in a patch of tall grass somewhere, in some town. Letting out a voice loud enough to surprise even myself, I kept crying until the night ended.

lines.content: こうなることがわかってはいても、ここまで悲しいなんてわからなかった。
lines.translated: Even though I knew it would turn out this way, I never knew it would be this sad.

lines.content: 朝日が昇ると共に涙も枯れた。
lines.translated: As the morning sun rose, my tears dried up as well.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 『……きみのそばにいても悲しいだけだ』
lines.translated: "...Staying by your side only makes me sad."

lines.content: ……さみしいばかりだ。
lines.translated: It only makes me lonely.

lines.content: だからもうわたしは、自分が口にしたとおり――きみと“さよなら”するべきなんだろう。
lines.translated: So just as I had put into words myself--I suppose I really should say "goodbye" to you now.

lines.content: この町で死んだ人間の“命”は必ず、“刻の終着駅”にたどり着く。
lines.translated: The "lives" of humans who die in this town always arrive at the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: だからまたいつか、きみとは“夜”の世界で必ず逢える。
lines.translated: So someday, I will definitely be able to meet you again in the world of the "Night."

lines.content: “夜”の中でなら、きみもわたしのことを思い出してくれてるはずだ。きみに、触れられるはずだ。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," you should remember me too. I should be able to touch you.

lines.content: そのときに今まで話せなかったことをいっぱい、たくさん、話せばいい――……でも。
lines.translated: When that time comes, we can just talk lots and lots about all the things we couldn't talk about until now--...Even so.

lines.content: “命”の尽きたものは“夜”の中にそう長くは留まれない。
lines.translated: Those whose "lives" have run out cannot stay in the "Night" for very long.

lines.content: “次”への“切符”を買って、一週間以内には列車に乗らなければならない。そうでなければその魂はこの町の“夜”に縛られる。
lines.translated: They must buy a "ticket" to the "Next" and board the train within a week. Otherwise, their soul will be bound to the "Night" of this town.

lines.content: “夜”の中でまた逢えたとしても、大雅。きみは一週間で“次”へ旅立つ。
lines.translated: Even if we can meet again within the "Night," Taiga, you will depart for the "Next" in a single week.

lines.content: だから同じ時間を生きることは……できない。わたし達には。永遠に。
lines.translated: That's why we cannot... live through the same time together. The two of us. Forever.

lines.content: 『話したいことはいっぱいあっても、ずっと、手を繋いでいたくても。きみとそうできる時間は、殆どないだろうけど……』
lines.translated: "Even if there are so many things I want to talk about, even if I want to hold your hand forever. We'll probably have almost no time to do that together, though..."

lines.content: 『……それでも、そんな“いつか”を待ってればいいよね。……大雅。一瞬だけでもまた話せる。また、きみに触れられる』
lines.translated: "...Even so, it's okay to just wait for that 'someday,' right? ...Taiga. Even if it's just for a single moment, we'll be able to talk again. I'll be able to touch you again."

lines.content: 人間は“夢”や“希望”がなければ生きていけない“イキモノ”だというけれど……、
lines.translated: They say humans are "creatures" who cannot live without "dreams" and "hope"...

lines.content: 『大丈夫。また、わたし達は、昔みたいにお話しできるよね……きっと』
lines.translated: "It's okay. We'll be able to talk just like we used to again... I'm sure of it."

lines.content: それがわたしの“希望”だった。きみと同じになりたいと願ってばかりいる。そんなわたしの“夢”だった。
lines.translated: That was my "hope." Always wishing to become the same as you. That was my "dream."

lines.content: その瞬間を信じて待とう。
lines.translated: I'll believe in that moment and wait.

lines.content: 静かに瞬く不思議な“夜”の片隅で。
lines.translated: In a corner of the mysterious, quietly twinkling "Night."

lines.content: 『だからそれまでほんの少し、お別れしよう……』
lines.translated: "So until then, let's part ways for just a little while..."

lines.content: 自分に言い聞かせるようにそうつぶやいていたけれど……。
lines.translated: I murmured that as if trying to convince myself, and yet...

lines.content: 『……だめだな、わたし』
lines.translated: "...I'm hopeless, aren't I?"

lines.content: 結局わたしはきみのそばに戻って来てしまった。
lines.translated: In the end, I wound up coming right back to your side.

lines.content: 声は届かなくても。触れられなくても。姿を、見つめてもらえなくても。
lines.translated: Even if my voice can't reach you. Even if I can't touch you. Even if you can't gaze upon my form.

lines.content: それでもきみのそばにいたかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I wanted to be by your side.

lines.content: 『……こんなわたしでも、きみが何かピンチのときには助けられることだってあるはずだから』
lines.translated: "...Because even someone like me should be able to help you if you're ever in a pinch."

lines.content: わたしの中には特別な“夜の猫”としての“力”が残ってる。
lines.translated: The "power" of a special "Cat of the Night" still remains within me.

lines.content: ……命もまだ、九つも残ってる。
lines.translated: And I still have nine lives left, too.

lines.content: だからわたしは、わたしの全部を使ってきみの人生を、これからもそばで――一番近くから、一番遠くから、応援し続けていよう。
lines.translated: So I will use everything I have to keep cheering on your life from right beside you--from the closest place, and from the farthest place.

lines.content: そうしたいと願うのは“罪悪感”から[・|だ][・|け]ではもうない。
lines.translated: Wishing to do so is no longer out of "guilt" alone.

lines.content: もちろん、ごめんなさいのその気持ちは生涯きえないだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Of course, that feeling of wanting to apologize will probably never fade for as long as I live, though...

lines.content: きみのそばにいたいと願うのは、今、ずきずきと胸が痛むから。
lines.translated: The reason I wish to stay by your side is because right now, my chest aches with a throbbing pain.

lines.content: この気持ちが、“きみが好きだよ”っていう証拠なんだろうと、思うから。
lines.translated: Because I think this feeling must be proof that "I love you."

lines.content: 『……そっか。猫の姿なら、きみに見てもらえるのかも』
lines.translated: "...I see. If I'm in the form of a cat, maybe you'll be able to see me."

lines.content: ふっと思いついた。
lines.translated: The thought suddenly struck me.

lines.content: 猫の姿。つまり黒猫。
lines.translated: The form of a cat. In other words, a black cat.

lines.content: あんまりこの姿は好きじゃない。あんまりどころかものすごく。
lines.translated: I don't really like this form. In fact, "don't really" doesn't even cover it--I hate it immensely.

lines.content: でももしかしたら、この姿ならきみに見つめてもらえるだけでなく……。
lines.translated: But maybe, if I'm in this form, you won't just be able to look at me...

lines.content: 『……ぎゅっと、抱きしめてもらえるかも』
lines.translated: "...Maybe you'll hold me tight."

lines.content: 黒猫の姿に戻った。
lines.translated: I returned to the form of a black cat.

lines.content: 久しぶりだったから上手にできるか不安だったけど、たぶん、大丈夫。
lines.translated: Since it had been a long time, I was worried about whether I could do it well, but I think it's okay.

lines.content: どきどきしながら“ゆめのねどこ”へわたしは戻った。
lines.translated: With my heart pounding, I returned to "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: 裏の勝手口が開いていた。
lines.translated: The back door was open.

lines.content: かりかり前足で押し、僅かに開いた扉の隙間に滑り込み、中に入った。
lines.translated: Scratching and pushing at it with my front paws, I slipped through the narrow gap in the slightly open door and went inside.
(...Taiga?)

lines.content: そう呼びかけてみても、にゃあという鳴き声に変わってしまう。
lines.translated: Even when I tried calling out like that, it turned into a "meow."

lines.content: 言葉も気持ちも伝わらないけど、この鳴き声ならきみにも聞こえるのかもしれない。大雅はどんな顔をするだろう。どきどきしてた。
lines.translated: Neither my words nor my feelings will get through, but if it's this cry, maybe you'll be able to hear it. What kind of face will Taiga make? My heart was pounding.

lines.content: でも覗いた部屋に大雅はいない。
lines.translated: However, Taiga wasn't in the room I peeked into.

lines.content: まだ学校から帰ってきてないのかも。
lines.translated: Maybe he hasn't come home from school yet.

lines.content: 寝床の上に丸まり、うつらうつらとしながら待っていた――眠らないよう、気をつけて。
lines.translated: I curled up on the bed and waited, dozing off in and out of sleep--being careful not to fall asleep completely.

lines.content: この姿になると眠気がいつもの何倍にも感じられた。
lines.translated: Whenever I take this form, drowsiness feels many times stronger than usual.

lines.content: かちかちと鳴る時計の音。少し、危険だ。子守歌みたいで心地いい。
lines.translated: The ticking sound of the clock. It's a little dangerous. It's as soothing as a lullaby.

lines.content: 日の光が沈み、暗くなる。
lines.translated: The sunlight sank, and it grew dark.

lines.content: （おかしいな……）
lines.translated: (That's strange...)

lines.content: 眠気で重い頭を持ち上げ、ぼんやりと時計を見た。
lines.translated: Lifting my head, heavy with sleepiness, I bleary-eyedly looked at the clock.

lines.content: （もう、夜なのに……大雅。まだ帰ってこないの？）
lines.translated: (It's already night... Taiga. Are you still not home yet?)

lines.content: 急に不安になってきた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I started feeling anxious.

lines.content: わたしがどこかの草むらで、いつまでもぐずぐず泣いてるとき、大雅に何かあったのかも。
lines.translated: While I was endlessly sniffling and crying in some patch of grass somewhere, maybe something had happened to Taiga.

lines.content: （どうしよう。どうしたらいい？）
lines.translated: (What do I do? What should I do?)

lines.content: 猫の姿に戻ったせいか、いつもよりずっと頭が働かない気がするよ……。
lines.translated: Maybe because I returned to the form of a cat, I feel like my head isn't working nearly as well as usual...

lines.content: 玄関の扉が開く音がした。
lines.translated: There was the sound of the front door opening.

lines.content: ぴんとわたしの耳が立つ。
lines.translated: My ears perked straight up.

lines.content: （大雅……っ）
lines.translated: (Taiga...!)

lines.content: 駆けていった。
lines.translated: I went running out.

lines.content: 玄関先に立つ大雅の姿を見つけた。
lines.translated: I found Taiga standing in the entryway.

lines.content: （おかえり大雅っ、わたしも、ほら、帰ってきたよ……っ）
lines.translated: (Welcome back, Taiga! Look, I've come home too...!)

lines.content: 大雅の足下にぐるぐるとまとわりつき、わたしはにゃあにゃあと鳴いていた。
lines.translated: Weaving around Taiga's feet in circles, I meowed again and again.

lines.content: そんなわたしを大雅はそっと抱き上げてくれた。ああ、よかった。触れてもらえる。声も、届くよ。
lines.translated: Taiga gently picked me up. Ah, thank goodness. He can touch me. My voice reaches him, too.

lines.content: 今にも泣き出しそうな気持ちも全部、猫の声でしか形にならない。
lines.translated: All my feelings, even how I was on the verge of tears right now, could only take shape as a cat's cries.

lines.content: そんなわたしをじっと見て、
lines.translated: Staring closely at me,
"You're..."

lines.content: と、大雅は首をかしげる。どこか疲れたように。
lines.translated: Taiga tilted his head. He looked somewhat exhausted.

lines.content: 『……君は、どこから入ってきたのかな』
lines.translated: "...Where did you come in from, I wonder?"

lines.content: 力なく微笑み、大雅がそう言って。
lines.translated: Offering a weak smile, Taiga asked that.

lines.content: わたしは[・|や][・|っ][・|と]気づいた――大雅は、ぼろぼろだった。
lines.translated: And I finally noticed--Taiga was battered and bruised.

lines.content: 頬には殴られたような傷がある。制服だってぼろぼろだ。
lines.translated: There was a mark on his cheek like he had been punched. Even his uniform was in tatters.

lines.content: （どうしたの……っ、まさか、いじめられてるのっ！？）
lines.translated: (What happened...?! Don't tell me you're being bullied?!)

lines.content: 頬の傷をぺろりと舐めた。
lines.translated: I gave the wound on his cheek a lick.

lines.content: （もう大丈夫だよ大雅っ、わたしが護るよっ、きみのこと……これからも全部、わたしがきっと……っ）
lines.translated: (It's okay now, Taiga! I'll protect you... From now on, I'll definitely protect you from everything...!)

lines.content: きみは黒猫なわたしを強く抱きしめた。そして声を殺して泣いていた。
lines.translated: You hugged my black cat body tightly. And then, stifling your voice, you cried.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: ねえ大雅。この一年の間に何があったの？
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga. What happened during this past year?

lines.content: どうしてだかわからないけど大雅はひとりだ。ひとりぼっちで暮らしてる。友だちもいない。本当にひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: I don't know why, but Taiga is alone. He's living all by himself. He doesn't have any friends, either. He is truly all alone.

lines.content: それがずっとさみしかったのだというように、その夜はわたしのことをずっと抱きしめたままだった。
lines.translated: As if to say he had been lonely this whole time, he held onto me all through that night.

lines.content: きみは変わらず奏大雅と名乗っていても、今はもうあのときのあの子のように無口で、無表情なきみに戻ってた。だからいじめっ子の標的になりやすいのかも。
lines.translated: Even though you still went by the name Kanade Taiga, you had reverted back to being as quiet and expressionless as that kid from back then. Maybe that was why you easily became a target for bullies.

lines.content: わたしの知らない時間の中で、きみに何があったのかはわからない。知る術はない。
lines.translated: I don't know what happened to you during the time I wasn't aware of. There's no way for me to know.
