lines.content: （大丈夫。……大丈夫だよ。ちょっと苦しいけど、今夜はずっとこうしていてね。わたしがいるよ。もうひとりぼっちじゃないよ大雅。こんな姿だけれど、ずっとそばにいるから）
lines.translated: (It's okay. ...It's going to be okay. It's a little tight, but stay just like this all night, okay? I'm right here. You aren't all alone anymore, Taiga. Even though I look like this, I'll stay by your side forever.)

lines.content: そんな“想い”を伝えるために、何度も、何度も、わたしはきみに頬ずりをした。
lines.translated: To convey those feelings, I rubbed my cheek against you over and over again.

lines.content: （約束するよ。……大雅。きみを絶対、ぜったいに、ひとりぼっちになんてさせないからね）
lines.translated: (I promise. ...Taiga. I will never, ever let you be all alone.)

lines.content: わたしの気持ちが伝わったのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if my feelings got through to him.

lines.content: 大雅は、わたしのことを抱きしめて、いつの間にか眠ってた。
lines.translated: Still holding me tight, Taiga had fallen asleep before I knew it.

lines.content: 暖かい。
lines.translated: It's warm.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: きみのにおい。
lines.translated: Your scent.

lines.content: きみの暖かさ。
lines.translated: Your warmth.

lines.content: きみの、さみしさ。
lines.translated: Your loneliness.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。きみの全部を、いっぱい、感じるよ。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga. I can feel all of you, so much of you.

lines.content: ああ、神さま、とわたしは思う。
lines.translated: Oh, God, I thought to myself.

lines.content: どうかお願い。
lines.translated: Please, I beg of you.

lines.content: （こんな時間がずっと、ずっと永遠に、続きますように……）
lines.translated: (Please let this time continue forever and ever...)

lines.content: でも……
だめだった。
lines.translated: It was no use.

lines.content: 人間じゃないわたしは、人間のきみと同じ時間を生きられない。
lines.translated: Not being human, I cannot live through the same time as a human like you.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: ……そんな時間、長く続くはずがないんだよ
lines.translated: Time like that could never last for long.

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”の空にため息をつき、もう少し――もう少しだけ、過ぎ去っていったきみとの時間について、わたしは思う。
lines.translated: Sighing up at the "Night" sky, I thought just a little more--just a tiny bit more, about the time with you that had passed by.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: やっぱりひとりぼっちがさみしかったのか、きみはわたしを飼うことにしてくれた。首輪をくれた。小さな鈴の付いた真っ赤な首輪だ。
lines.translated: Perhaps because being all alone really was lonely, you decided to keep me. You gave me a collar. A bright red collar with a tiny bell attached.

lines.content: うれしかった。町中の野良猫に自慢して歩きたいくらい。
lines.translated: I was so happy. Enough that I wanted to walk around boasting about it to every stray cat in town.

lines.content: わたし達はいつもふたりだった。ご飯も一緒。お風呂も。お布団も。
lines.translated: The two of us were always together. We ate meals together. Took baths together. Slept in the futon together.

lines.content: ずっと、きみと一緒だった。
lines.translated: I was always with you.

lines.content: ……たぶん幸せだったと思う。
lines.translated: I think I was probably happy.

lines.content: それは、人の姿のときに望んだような“形”では決してなかった。けれどこれもまた幸せだ。
lines.translated: It was never the "form" I had wished for when I had a human body. Yet this, too, was happiness.

lines.content: この姿ではきみと言葉を交わすことができないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though I couldn't exchange words with you in this form...

lines.content: それでもいい。こうしてそばにいられるのなら。
lines.translated: I was fine with that. As long as I could stay by your side like this.

lines.content: 『……君の名前はどうしようか。黒猫だからクロ、っていうのは安直すぎるかな』
lines.translated: "...What should we do about your name? Naming you Kuro just because you're a black cat might be a little too unimaginative, huh?"

lines.content: （そんなことないよ。それが一番いいな）
lines.translated: (Not at all. I like that best.)

lines.content: にゃあと鳴いてうれしい気持ちを伝えようとする。
lines.translated: I gave a meow, trying to convey how happy I was.

lines.content: そんなわたしの頭をきみがやさしく撫でてくれる。明日はどんな幸せなことがあるのかな。
lines.translated: You gently stroked my head in response. I wonder what kind of happy things will happen tomorrow.

lines.content: 一日中、家の中できみの匂いのする場所を探して……。
lines.translated: All day long, I would search the house for places that carried your scent...

lines.content: そこでうとうとまどろみながら、でも眠ってしまわぬよう気をつけて、きみの“ただいま”の声が聞こえるのを待っている――きっと明日も、そんな今日と変わらない一日だ。
lines.translated: Dozing off there, yet being careful not to fall completely asleep, waiting to hear your voice say "I'm home"--surely tomorrow will be another day no different from today.

lines.content: もうすっかりふつうの猫のような気になっていた。
lines.translated: I had started feeling completely like an ordinary cat.

lines.content: きみの手にやさしく触れられ、目を細め――……大雅と暮らし始めてから数日後。
lines.translated: Narrowing my eyes as your hand gently touched me--...A few days after I started living with Taiga.
I died.

lines.content: そうしてひとつ、命をなくした。残り八つだ
lines.translated: And so, I lost one life. Eight left.

lines.content: 一つ、ひとつ、思い出を日記に書き付けていくように、わたしは今までのことについて思ってる。
lines.translated: As if writing down memories one by one in a diary, I thought back on everything that had happened up to now.

lines.content: わたしの“力”はきみの不幸を、この命を使って肩代わりすること――……交通事故だった。
lines.translated: My "power" is to use this life of mine to take your misfortune upon myself--...It was a traffic accident.

lines.content: きみが学園の卒業式の日に、自動車に轢かれてしまい……。そのときの[・|全][・|部]をすべてわたしの命が請け負った。
lines.translated: On the day of your school graduation ceremony, you were hit by a car... My life took on every single bit of what happened then.

lines.content: 死んじゃうところをきみに見せるのはいやだった。
lines.translated: I didn't want to let you see me die.

lines.content: だからいつか、きみに忘れられてしまったことが悲しくてひとりで泣いた――どこかの町の、どこかの草むらにふらふらと潜り込み、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: So I staggered into a patch of grass somewhere in some town--the same place where I had once cried all alone out of sadness over being forgotten by you--and closed my eyes.

lines.content: 気づくとわたしは“夜”の中にいて……。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was inside the "Night"...

lines.content: 胸にそっと手を当て命を数えてた。
lines.translated: Gently placing a hand over my chest, I counted my lives.

lines.content: [わたし|子猫]が帰ってこなくて、きみはどう思ってるだろうか。
lines.translated: With the kitten--with me--not coming home, what must you be thinking?

lines.content: ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: 『……また、きみをひとりぼっちにしちゃったかもしれない』
lines.translated: "...I might have left you all alone again."

lines.content: きみはまたあの家で――“ゆめのねどこ”で、ひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: You are all alone again in that house--in "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: 『約束したのに。きみを絶対、ぜったい、ひとりぼっちになんてさせないよって……』
lines.translated: "Even though I promised. That I would never, ever let you be all alone..."

lines.content: でも、わたしはこんな方法でしか、きみの役に立てないの。きみのそばに、自分はいていいんだって思えない。
lines.translated: But this is the only way I can be of use to you. It's the only way I can feel like I'm allowed to stay by your side.
That's why I will keep doing this forever.

lines.content: 『九つの“命”全部使って、きみを護るよ』
lines.translated: "I'll use all nine of my 'lives' to protect you."

lines.content: 見上げてつぶやく“夜”の空から、はらりとひとつ、花びらが舞い――わたしの鼻先にそっと触れた。
lines.translated: From the "Night" sky I looked up at while murmuring, a single petal fluttered down--and gently brushed the tip of my nose.
It was the signal that the first me was coming to an end.

lines.content: 目の前が真っ暗になる。
lines.translated: Everything before my eyes went pitch black.

lines.content: さくらもゆる“夜”の中――……ひとつ、光りが灯った。
lines.translated: Within the "Night" of glowing cherry blossoms--...a single light was kindled.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は[・|次]がはじまる合図でもある。
lines.translated: That was also the signal for the next one to begin.

lines.content: 恐る恐る[まぶた|瞼]を開き――……わたしは、叫ぶ。
lines.translated: Timidly opening my eyes--...I cried out.

lines.content: （生まれ変われた……っ）
lines.translated: (I was reborn...!)

lines.content: どこかの町の、どこかの草むら――わたしは産まれたばかりの子猫だった。[お母さん|母猫]にミルクをねだる[・|た][・|く][・|さ][・|ん]の内の一匹だ。
lines.translated: In a patch of grass somewhere, in some town--I was a newborn kitten. One of many begging my mother cat for milk.

lines.content: 早く……。早く……。大きくなって。
lines.translated: Hurry... Hurry... Grow bigger.

lines.content: （きみに、会いに行かなきゃ……）
lines.translated: (I have to go see you...)

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでいる時間はすべて、幸せとは遠い場所にあるものだと思う。猫なわたしじゃだめかもしれない。それでも、誰かがきみのそばにいないとだめだ。
lines.translated: I think that every moment spent all alone is something far removed from happiness. Being a cat might not be enough. Even so, someone has to be by your side.

lines.content: 毎日お腹いっぱいミルクを飲んで――どの子よりも早く立てるようになり、歩けるようになり、走れるようになり――……わたしは、駆けていった。
lines.translated: Drinking my fill of milk every day--learning to stand faster than any of the other kittens, learning to walk, learning to run--...I took off running.

lines.content: 生まれ変わってわかったことがある。わたしはもう、眠ってしまっても“未来”へ跳ばなくなっていた。
lines.translated: There was something I realized after being reborn. Even if I fell asleep, I no longer leaped into the "future."

lines.content: その“病”を大雅の代わりに請け負ったのはひとつ前の命だ。その命が尽きたとき、“病”も一緒に消えてしまった。
lines.translated: It was my previous life that had taken on that "illness" in Taiga's place. When that life ran out, the "illness" vanished along with it.
These nine "lives" of mine--I wonder just how big each and every one of them is.

lines.content: どれくらいの量、きみの不幸を飲み込めるのかな。きっと容量みたいなものはあるはずだよね。
lines.translated: How much of your misfortune can they swallow up? Surely they must have some kind of capacity.

lines.content: そんなことを猫の頭で、ぼんやりと考えながらわたしは走った。
lines.translated: Vaguely pondering such things with my cat brain, I ran.

lines.content: 春に色づく“参禅町”
lines.translated: "Sanzen Town," taking on the colors of spring.

lines.content: 古い町だ。
lines.translated: It's an old town.

lines.content: 見渡した様子だけでは、[・|あ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]どれほど時間が経過してしまったのかはわからない。
lines.translated: Just from looking around, I couldn't tell how much time had passed since then.

lines.content: あたらしいきみの匂いがする。まだこの町に暮らしてる証拠だ。
lines.translated: I caught your fresh scent. Proof that you were still living in this town.

lines.content: その匂いを辿っていくと、学校にたどり着いた。
lines.translated: Following that scent, I arrived at a school.

lines.content: 卒業したのにどうして？
lines.translated: Why, when he already graduated?

lines.content: とは思うけど、すぐにわかった。
lines.translated: I wondered that at first, but I quickly understood.

lines.content: （そっか。もう、そんなに時間が経っちゃってたんだね）
lines.translated: (I see. So that much time has already passed, huh?)

lines.content: 大雅は“参禅町”で学校の先生になっていた。
lines.translated: Taiga had become a schoolteacher in "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: 大雅の声がする教室の中を、そっと窓から覗き込んでみる。大雅は大勢の子ども達の前で、何か難しそうなことを話してた。
lines.translated: Through the window, I quietly peeked into the classroom where Taiga's voice was coming from. In front of a large group of children, Taiga was talking about something that sounded difficult.

lines.content: 大人の人が着る服に、大人の人が履く靴に、大人の人が浮かべる笑顔――全部揃ってる。
lines.translated: The clothes an adult wears, the shoes an adult wears, the smile an adult wears--he had them all.

lines.content: きみはすっかり大人になっていた。
lines.translated: You had grown into a full-fledged adult.

lines.content: （わ～……、すごい。格好いいよ大雅。うん。すごくぴったりだと思う。学校の先生、かあ。……うん、本当に、きみにぴったりだよ）
lines.translated: (Wow~... Amazing. You look so cool, Taiga. Yeah. I think it suits you so well. A schoolteacher, huh... Yeah, it really suits you perfectly.)

lines.content: いっぱい、いっぱいの悲しさを知っているきみだから、同じように悲しい子、さみしい子たちに、未来を不安に思う子たち全員に、同じだけ、きみはやさしくできるだろうから。
lines.translated: Because you know so, so much sadness yourself, you'll be able to show just as much kindness to all the children who are sad, who are lonely, and who feel anxious about the future.

lines.content: 先に帰って待っていてもいいけれど、学校が終わるまで待つことにした。
lines.translated: I could have gone home ahead of you and waited, but I decided to stay until school was over.

lines.content: （驚くかな。……わたしのこと、わかるかな）
lines.translated: (I wonder if he'll be surprised. ...I wonder if he'll recognize me.)

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”な[・|わ][・|た][・|し]だってことには当然、気づかないだろうだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Though of course, he won't realize that it's *me*, a "Creature of the Night"...

lines.content: （あのときの子猫だって、わかってくれるかな。“お帰り”って言って、抱き上げてくれたらうれしいけれど……）
lines.translated: (I wonder if he'll realize I'm the kitten from back then. I'd be so happy if he said "Welcome home" and scooped me up in his arms...)

lines.content: どきどきしながら校庭の隅に隠れてた。
lines.translated: My heart pounding, I hid in a corner of the schoolyard.

lines.content: ……放課後。
lines.translated: After school.

lines.content: 空が夜に傾きはじめる頃になり、ようやく大雅が校舎から出てきた。
lines.translated: Just as the sky was beginning to tilt toward night, Taiga finally came out of the school building.

lines.content: 校門前の茂みの中で待っていたわたしは、きみの足下に飛び出した。
lines.translated: Waiting in the bushes in front of the school gate, I leaped out right at your feet.

lines.content: （ただいま大雅。……帰ってきたよ。わたしのこと、わかる？）
lines.translated: (I'm home, Taiga. ...I came back. Do you recognize me?)

lines.content: きっとにゃあとしか届かない声で、わたしはきみに訴えたけど……。
lines.translated: I pleaded with you in a voice that surely only reached you as a meow, and yet...

lines.content: 大雅は一瞬だけ、わたしのほうを見ただけだ。そのまま何も言わずに行ってしまった。
lines.translated: Taiga only glanced my way for a single moment. Then he just walked away without saying a word.

lines.content: （どうして？）
lines.translated: (Why?)

lines.content: （ほら、わたしだよ……？）
lines.translated: (Look, it's me...?)

lines.content: （首輪がないからわからない？）
lines.translated: (Can you not tell because I don't have my collar?)

lines.content: 昨晩降った雨でできた水たまり。それを飛び越えようとして、驚く。
lines.translated: There was a puddle left over from last night's rain. As I went to jump over it, I froze in surprise.

lines.content: （あ、あれ……っ、柄が違うよ……っ）
lines.translated: (H-Huh...? My pattern is different...!)

lines.content: わたし、黒猫だったはずなのに、[・|今]、水たまりに映ってるわたしは三毛猫だった。
lines.translated: I was supposed to be a black cat, and yet, the me reflected in the puddle *now* was a calico.

lines.content: まっくろな自分は嫌いだった。まるで心の中が身体に浮き出してきているみたいで。だからそうじゃなくなったのは、うれしいけれど……。
lines.translated: I used to hate being pitch-black. It felt as if the inside of my heart was rising to the surface of my body. So I was glad I wasn't like that anymore, and yet...

lines.content: （こんなんじゃ、大雅。わたしのことが誰だかわからない……）
lines.translated: (Like this, Taiga won't have any idea who I am...)

lines.content: ひとの姿になってもきみには見えない。
lines.translated: Even if I take on my human form, you can't see me.

lines.content: ……そもそもわたしのことなんてきみはもう忘れてしまってる。どんなに鳴いたってだめだ。きみは、わたしを振り向いてもくれない。
lines.translated: In the first place, you've already forgotten all about me. No matter how much I cry out, it's no use. You won't even look back at me.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちなのはいったいどっち、なのかな。
lines.translated: Which one of us is really the one who's all alone, I wonder?

lines.content: もう鳴く元気もなく、とぼとぼと大雅の後を付いていく。
lines.translated: With no energy left to even meow, I trudged along behind Taiga.

lines.content: お家の“ゆめのねどこ”に帰ったきみのことを、窓の外からそっと見た。
lines.translated: From outside the window, I quietly watched you after you returned home to "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: （やっぱり……）
lines.translated: (Just as I thought...)

lines.content: やっぱりきみは、今もずっとひとりぼっちだった。
lines.translated: Just as I thought, you were still all alone, even now.

lines.content: 持ち帰ったのだろう仕事を深夜まで続けて、ご飯はコンビニのお弁当。テレビを少しだけ見て、でも、一度だってくすりとも笑わないまま席を立つ。
lines.translated: You worked late into the night on what you must have brought home with you, and your dinner was a convenience store bento. You watched a little bit of TV, then got up from your seat without cracking a single smile.

lines.content: 中々寝付けないのかお布団の中でぼんやりとして、どうしてか自分の手をじっと見つめて……。
lines.translated: Unable to fall asleep easily, you lay spacing out in your futon, staring intently at your own hands for some reason...

lines.content: 携帯電話をぽちぽちいじっては、たぶん無意識にため息をつく。
lines.translated: You idly fiddled with your cell phone and let out what was probably an unconscious sigh.

lines.content: 空が白みはじめてようやく、大雅は小さな寝息を立てていた。
lines.translated: Only when the sky began to grow light did Taiga finally start breathing the quiet breaths of sleep.

lines.content: つらそうだった。
lines.translated: It looked painful.

lines.content: それにとてもさみしそう。
lines.translated: And so very lonely.

lines.content: わたしにはそう見えた。
lines.translated: That's how it looked to me.

lines.content: 一度だって笑わず、誰かと電話するでもなく、ひとりで静かに過ごす夜――……だめ。
lines.translated: Not smiling even once, not calling anyone on the phone, spending the night quietly all by yourself--...no.

lines.content: そんなのだめだよ。ひとりぼっちでいちゃだめだ。
lines.translated: That's no good. You mustn't be all alone.

lines.content: わたしは何とか窓を押し上げ、身体をねじ込み、家に入り――きみの寝床に潜り込む。
lines.translated: I somehow managed to push the window up, squeezed my body through, got inside the house--and crawled into your bed.

lines.content: 『なんだよ……。雨でびしょびしょじゃないか、君は』
lines.translated: "What the...? You're soaking wet from the rain, aren't you?"

lines.content: 次の日の朝。大雅は、わたしを抱きしめてくれて……。
lines.translated: The next morning. Taiga held me close, and...

lines.content: 『……もう、猫は飼わないって決めたのにな。……“さよなら”がつらいから』
lines.translated: "...Even though I decided I wouldn't keep a cat anymore. ...Because saying 'goodbye' is too painful."

lines.content: どろどろだったわたしをお風呂に入れて、前回のわたしにと買いためていてくれた猫用のご飯をいっぱいくれた。
lines.translated: He gave my muddy body a bath, and fed me lots of the cat food he had stocked up for the previous me.

lines.content: でも、ごめんね。あんまり食べられなかった。なんだか食欲がない。
lines.translated: But I'm sorry. I couldn't eat very much. For some reason, I didn't have an appetite.

lines.content: 子猫な身体で無理をしたせいかな。
lines.translated: Maybe it was because I pushed my tiny kitten body too hard.

lines.content: 予感があった。ふたつ目の命が終わってしまう。
lines.translated: I had a premonition. My second life was coming to an end.

lines.content: （……ごめん大雅。せっかくお風呂できれいにしてもらったのに。ご飯もたくさん、食べさせてもらったのに。……また、きみのことひとりにしちゃう）
lines.translated: (...I'm sorry, Taiga. Even though you went through the trouble of washing me clean in the bath. Even though you gave me so much food to eat. ...I'm going to leave you all alone again.)

lines.content: またきみから“さよなら”してしまう――……こんなわたしの“さよなら”で、きみにつらい思いをさせてしまうのは、いやだな。
lines.translated: I'm going to say "goodbye" and leave you again--...I hate that a "goodbye" from someone like me is going to put you through so much pain.

lines.content: （……本当に、ごめんね）
lines.translated: (...I'm really, truly sorry.)

lines.content: [・|眠][・|る]ところは見られたくない。
lines.translated: I didn't want him to see me *fall asleep*.

lines.content: 遠いどこかの草むらにまでは、なんとか這って行けたけど……。
lines.translated: I somehow managed to crawl away to a patch of grass somewhere far off, and then...

lines.content: そのままふっと、突然に視界が途切れる。
lines.translated: Just like that, my vision suddenly cut out.

lines.content: ……命をひとつ、無駄にしちゃった
lines.translated: I wasted one of my lives.

lines.content: 次に生まれ変わるときはもっとしっかりしないと。
lines.translated: The next time I'm reborn, I have to do a much better job.

lines.content: まっくらな“夜”の底でそう誓い……[・|次]がはじまる。
lines.translated: Vowing that at the bottom of the pitch-black "Night"... the *next* one began.

lines.content: 三つ目。
lines.translated: The third one.

lines.content: 次にまた別の柄の猫に生まれ変わって、きみに会いに行ったとき――……また、幾つか時間が経っていて、きみはその分だけ大人になってた。
lines.translated: The next time I was reborn as a cat with a different pattern and went to see you--...some more time had passed, and you had grown that much older.

lines.content: それに……。
lines.translated: Not only that...

lines.content: （それに今日は、大雅の誕生日だ。そうだよね？　空気の匂いでわかるよ）
lines.translated: (And today is Taiga's birthday. That's right, isn't it? I can tell by the scent in the air.)

lines.content: やっぱりひとりぼっちなままのきみ。今日はお誕生日で、休日だ。それなのにたったひとり、お家でぼんやりして過ごしてた。
lines.translated: You were still all alone, just as before. Today was your birthday, and a day off. And yet, you were spending it spacing out at home, all by yourself.

lines.content: そばに誰もいない。
lines.translated: There was no one by your side.

lines.content: おめでとうの声もない。
lines.translated: No voices wishing you a happy birthday.

lines.content: ……甘いものもない。かわいい花の飾りもない。こんなの、だめだよ。とってもさみしい。
lines.translated: No sweets, either. No cute flower decorations. This is no good. It's way too lonely.

lines.content: （待ってて。わたしがお誕生日をお祝いするよ。とびっきりのプレゼント、探してくるからね）
lines.translated: (Wait right there. I'll celebrate your birthday for you. I'll go find you an amazing present, okay?)

lines.content: チョコレートは持ってないし、どこにも見つけられなかったけれど、でもちょうどいい花を見つけた。折れたさくらの枝が道路に落ちてた。
lines.translated: I didn't have any chocolate, and I couldn't find any anywhere, either, but I found the perfect flowers instead. A broken cherry blossom branch had fallen onto the road.

lines.content: かわいい桃色の小さな花が、かわいい形に幾つも並んで咲いた、細い枝。
lines.translated: A slender branch with cute little pink flowers blooming in a lovely row.

lines.content: プレゼントにぴったりだ。そう思えたよ。
lines.translated: It's the perfect present. That's what I thought.

lines.content: だからそれを咥えて“ゆめのねどこ”へ走って行った。
lines.translated: So I took it in my mouth and ran toward "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: 驚いてくれるかな。よろこんでくれたらすてきだな。
lines.translated: I wonder if he'll be surprised. It would be wonderful if it made him happy.

lines.content: ……わたしのこと、抱き上げてくれるかな。お帰りって言って、くれるかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if he'll scoop me up in his arms. I wonder if he'll say "Welcome home" to me.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”に忍び込む。
lines.translated: I snuck into "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: 古い建物だ。子猫な身体なら、どこかしらの隙間からするりと這入れる。
lines.translated: It's an old building. With a kitten's body, I could easily slip inside through a gap somewhere.

lines.content: 大雅の匂いがする。店先のほう。
lines.translated: I caught Taiga's scent. Coming from the storefront.

lines.content: 駆けて行った。
lines.translated: I took off running.

lines.content: そして、プレゼントのお花ごと、きみの胸に飛び込んでいく――……
lines.translated: And then, together with the flowers I brought as a present, I went to leap right into your chest--...

lines.content: 『好きです』
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: ……でも、勝手なわたしの想像は、そんな誰かの声で、掻き消された。一瞬で。
lines.translated: However, my selfish fantasy was completely drowned out by someone's voice. In a single instant.

lines.content: 『お願いします。私と、付き合ってください』
lines.translated: "Please. Go out with me."

lines.content: どうしてかな。身体の奥がひやりとしたよ。
lines.translated: I wonder why. Deep inside my body, everything went ice cold.

lines.content: 飛び込んでいこうとした店先に、大雅と、知らない女の人がいる。
lines.translated: In the storefront I was just about to leap into stood Taiga, and a woman I didn't know.

lines.content: 『か、奏先生。ず、ずっと、あなたのことが好き、でした』
lines.translated: "K-Kanade-sensei. I-I've always been in love with you."

lines.content: 女の人は真っ赤な顔で、大雅に“好き”を伝えてた。
lines.translated: Her face bright red, the woman was telling Taiga that she loved him.

lines.content: わたしは、動けなくなる。
lines.translated: I couldn't move.

lines.content: 店先と奥座敷との境目で、立ち止まってしまう――女の人はどうやら大雅と同じ学校の先生みたいだ。
lines.translated: Right on the border between the storefront and the back room, I froze in my tracks--the woman seemed to be a teacher at the same school as Taiga.

lines.content: 『い、いつか。その……結婚も、できたらすてきだなって……お、思ってて』
lines.translated: "S-Someday, um... I-I've been thinking... how wonderful it would be if we could get married, too."

lines.content: 一生懸命そう言う女の人は、胸元に、色とりどりの大きな花束を抱えてた。
lines.translated: Speaking as earnestly as she could, the woman was holding a large, colorful bouquet of flowers against her chest.

lines.content: 『こ、こういうの、女性のほうから渡すのは変、かもですが……』
lines.translated: "I-It might be strange for a woman to be the one giving you something like this, but..."

lines.content: 『でも、告白するのは私です。あなたのことが好きです。大好きです。だから、私の気持ち、受け取ってもらえませんか……っ』
lines.translated: "Even so, I'm the one confessing here. I love you. I love you so much. So please, won't you accept my feelings...?"

lines.content: わたしが咥えてきた花よりも、ずっと立派で、ずっとすてきでかわいい花束だった。
lines.translated: Compared to the flowers I had carried in my mouth, it was a much grander, much more wonderful, and much cuter bouquet.

lines.content: 大雅は……。
lines.translated: As for Taiga...

lines.content: 『……ありがとう、ございます』
lines.translated: "...Thank you very much."

lines.content: 大雅はそう言い、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Taiga said that, and he was smiling.

lines.content: わたしは、“ゆめのねどこ”を飛び出した。
lines.translated: I bolted out of "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: ……走った。
lines.translated: I ran.

lines.content: 自分がどんな道を通ったのかも思い出せないくらい、力いっぱい。
lines.translated: With all my might, so hard that I couldn't even remember what kind of roads I had taken.

lines.content: 空が夕焼けに染まる頃、
lines.translated: By the time the sky was dyed in the colors of sunset,

lines.content: （……よかった）
lines.translated: (...Thank goodness.)

lines.content: 走るのを止め、わたしは心の中でつぶやく。
lines.translated: I stopped running and murmured to myself inside my heart.

lines.content: （……よかったね、大雅。これでもう、ひとりぼっちじゃないね）
lines.translated: (...I'm so glad for you, Taiga. With this, you won't be all alone anymore.)

lines.content: うれしい。
lines.translated: I'm happy.

lines.content: ……はずだ。
lines.translated: Or so I should have felt.

lines.content: 安心した。
lines.translated: I was relieved.

lines.content: ……はずだった。
lines.translated: Or so I should have been.

lines.content: それなのにあれ以上、見ていられなかった――……大雅がひとりぼっちじゃなくなる。よろこばなきゃいけないはずだ。それなのにどうして……。
lines.translated: And yet, I couldn't bear to watch any longer--...Taiga wouldn't be all alone anymore. I should have been happy for him. So why...?

lines.content: （……胸が、ずきずきする）
lines.translated: (...My chest is throbbing with pain.)

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: “心”が思い通りにならない。
lines.translated: My "heart" wouldn't do as I wanted it to.

lines.content: 何か、とても鋭いもので突き刺されるように痛かった――
lines.translated: It hurt, as if I were being pierced by something terribly sharp--

lines.content: （きみにおめでとうって、心から言いたいのに……どうして？　どうして、なのかな）
lines.translated: (I want to congratulate you from the bottom of my heart... so why? Why is it like this?)

lines.content: ……なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: そんなのわかってる。どうして？　とかそんなの今さらだ。
lines.translated: I already know the answer to that. It's far too late to be asking "why?" now.

lines.content: （だって、わたし、きみのことが好きだから）
lines.translated: (Because I'm in love with you.)

lines.content: だからおめでとうって、言えなかった。
lines.translated: That's why I couldn't say congratulations.

lines.content: （……言いたくなかったよ、大雅。わたし、きみのそばにいられもしないのに。きみに、覚えてももらえていないのに）
lines.translated: (...I didn't want to say it, Taiga. Even though I can't even stay by your side. Even though you don't even remember me.)

lines.content: 触れられないのに。話せないのに。……ほんとの姿は、見てさえももらえないのに。
lines.translated: Even though I can't touch you. Even though I can't talk to you. ...Even though you can't even see my true form.

lines.content: きみのいっぱいのさみしさを、拭ってあげられない“イキモノ”なのに。
lines.translated: Even though I'm a "creature" who can't wipe away all of your loneliness.

lines.content: （それでも……わたし、そばにいたい。きみが好き。きみが、大好き）
lines.translated: (Even so... I want to be by your side. I like you. I love you so much.)

lines.content: （きみが知らない誰かと笑ってる。そんなの見るのは、いや……いやなの、大雅。すごく、つらいよ。さみしいよ）
lines.translated: (You're smiling with someone I don't know. I don't... I don't want to see that, Taiga. It hurts so much. I'm so lonely.)

lines.content: ああ。わたしはやっぱりまっくろだ。いくら姿を変えようと。いくら、生まれ変わろうと。
lines.translated: Ah. I really am pitch-black after all. No matter how much I change my form. No matter how many times I'm reborn.

lines.content: 咥えていたプレゼントの花は、いつの間にかどこかに落としてしまってた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had dropped the flowers I was carrying in my mouth as a present somewhere along the way.

lines.content: とぼとぼ歩くわたしの足下に、涙もぽとぽと落ちていた。
lines.translated: As I trudged along, tears fell patter-patter at my feet.

lines.content: （おかしいな。猫なのに、こんなに涙が出るなんて……大雅。ねえ、大雅。ほんとに、わたし、おかしいよね……大雅…………うう……大雅…………大雅……っ）
lines.translated: (How strange. I'm a cat, and yet so many tears are coming out... Taiga. Hey, Taiga. I really am strange, aren't I... Taiga...... ugh... Taiga...... Taiga...)

lines.content: 大好きだ、と言いたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to tell him I loved him.

lines.content: （……う、うう、あああ……っ）
lines.translated: (...Ugh, ughh, ahhh...!)

lines.content: きみのことが大好きなんだよと、叫びたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to scream that I loved him so much.

lines.content: でも。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: （わたしの声はもう、きみに、届かない……こんなに、こんなに……こんなにっ、きみが大好きなのに……っ）
lines.translated: (My voice can't reach you anymore... Even though I love you... this much, this much... this much...!)

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.

lines.content: 声もなく、言葉もなく、ただただ叫んだ。
lines.translated: Without a voice, without words, I simply screamed and screamed.

lines.content: お願い……。
lines.translated: Please...

lines.content: （お願い神さま）
lines.translated: (Please, God.)

lines.content: （この“想い”が届くなら、願いを叶えて）
lines.translated: (If these "feelings" can reach you, then grant my wish.)

lines.content: （わたしの全部をあげるから）
lines.translated: (I'll give you everything I have.)

lines.content: （どうか代わりに、わたしの大好きな大雅を、誰よりも幸せに――……）
lines.translated: (So in return, please, make my beloved Taiga happier than anyone else--...)

lines.content: ぶつり、と。
lines.translated: Snap.
"I" was cut short.

lines.content: たぶん、車に轢かれた。
lines.translated: I was probably hit by a car.

lines.content: 大雅のことで頭がいっぱい。道路に、ふらふら飛び出していたせいだ。
lines.translated: My head was completely full of thoughts of Taiga. It was because I had stumbled blindly out into the road.

lines.content: わたしを轢いてしまった人は、わたしを抱き上げ泣いていた。ごめんねといっぱい言ってた。そんな声だけ最期に聞こえた。
lines.translated: The person who hit me scooped me up in their arms and cried. They said "I'm sorry" over and over again. That voice was the only thing I heard at the very end.

lines.content: いいよ。気にしないで。
lines.translated: It's okay. Don't worry about it.

lines.content: （わたしが悪い。……全部、わたしが悪いんだ。……全部、ぜんぶ）
lines.translated: (It's my fault. ...Everything is my fault. ...Everything, all of it.)

lines.content: 目を覚ますと“夜”の中。
lines.translated: When I woke up, I was inside the "Night."

lines.content: （……また、命をひとつ無駄にした）
lines.translated: (...I wasted another life.)

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”にわたしは思う。
lines.translated: Looking up at the "Night," I thought to myself.

lines.content: もう、生まれ変わらなくてもいいんじゃないかな。
lines.translated: Maybe I don't need to be reborn anymore.

lines.content: だって大雅はひとりぼっちじゃないし……。わたしの“役目”はどこにもない。
lines.translated: Because Taiga isn't all alone anymore... There is no "role" left for me anywhere.

lines.content: それなのにただ会いに行っても悲しいだけだ。……今よりもっと、さみしくなるだけ。
lines.translated: Going to see him despite that will only make me sad. ...It will only make me even lonelier than I am now.

lines.content: （たぶん、わたしの“恋するためのお話”は終わったんだね……。大雅。うん。きっとそう）
lines.translated: (Maybe my "story for the sake of falling in love" is over now... Taiga. Yeah. I'm sure that's it.)

lines.content: それでもまだ終わっていないお話はある。
lines.translated: Even so, there is still a story that hasn't ended yet.

lines.content: きみのことを生涯ずっと、この命をかけて護り続ける。
lines.translated: I will continue to protect you for the rest of your life, staking this life of mine on it.

lines.content: きみがわたしを忘れても関係ない。
lines.translated: It doesn't matter if you forget me.

lines.content: きみに、わたしの気持ちが届こうが届かなかろうが、そんなのは関係ないんだ。
lines.translated: Whether my feelings reach you or not, none of that matters at all.

lines.content: （……わたしは、きみのことが好き）
lines.translated: (...I love you.)

lines.content: （だからわたしは、きみのことを幸せにできてはじめて、自分を許すことができると思う）
lines.translated: (That's why I think I'll only be able to forgive myself once I've made you happy.)

lines.content: さあ、“次”をはじめよう。
lines.translated: Now, let's begin the "next" one.

lines.content: また別の柄の猫だった。
lines.translated: I was a cat with a different coat pattern again.

lines.content: はらはらとさくらの舞う季節。……春だ。わたしの命はこの季節にいつも産まれる。
lines.translated: The season of fluttering cherry blossoms. ...It was spring. My life is always born in this season.

lines.content: 今度はどれだけ時間が過ぎたのか。
lines.translated: How much time had passed this time?

lines.content: 変わらず町には大雅の匂いがする。
lines.translated: Just as always, the town carried Taiga's scent.

lines.content: 恐る恐る、“ゆめのねどこ”に向かい、窓から中を覗いてみる。
lines.translated: Timidly, I headed toward "Dream's Bed" and peeked inside through the window.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...
He was alone.

lines.content: また少し大人になったきみは、古い揺り椅子にひとりぼっちで腰掛けて、本を読んでた。
lines.translated: Having grown a little older again, you were sitting all alone in the old rocking chair, reading a book.

lines.content: 大雅に“好き”と言っていた女の人を、[・|こ][・|こ]に来る前に見かけた。かわいい女の子と男の子を連れていた。子ども達はふたりとも、女の人にそっくりだった。
lines.translated: Before coming here, I had caught sight of the woman who told Taiga she loved him. She had a cute little girl and boy with her. Both of the children looked just like the woman.
Which meant that was how it had turned out.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]大雅は、たぶん、花束を受け取らなかった。
lines.translated: Back then, Taiga probably didn't accept the bouquet.

lines.content: ああ、わたしはわたしが、大嫌い。
lines.translated: Ah, I hate myself so much.

lines.content: 大雅はきっとひとりでさみしい時間を生きてきた。
lines.translated: Taiga must have lived through lonely times all by himself.

lines.content: それなのに、[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|気][・|持][・|ち]……最悪だ。ほんとうに、まっくろ。
lines.translated: And yet, for me to feel this way... It's the worst. Truly pitch-black.

lines.content: こんな自分の“心”を醜いものとして、沈黙で踏みつぶそうとした。
lines.translated: Treating this "heart" of mine as something ugly, I tried to crush it underfoot in silence.

lines.content: 町の風景は変わらないから気づきづらいけど、今回もそれなりに多くの時間をわたしは飛び越えてきたみたいだ。
lines.translated: It's hard to notice because the scenery of the town hasn't changed, but it seems I leaped across a fair amount of time once again.

lines.content: 良く見ると、大雅の頭に白いものが見える。
lines.translated: Looking closely, I could see streaks of white in Taiga's hair.

lines.content: （……歳をたくさん取ったんだね。ひとりぼっちで、いっぱい）
lines.translated: (...You've grown so much older. All alone, for so long.)

lines.content: 変わってしまったのはそれだけじゃない。
lines.translated: That wasn't the only thing that had changed.

lines.content: 大雅は、学校の先生ではなくなっていた。
lines.translated: Taiga was no longer a schoolteacher.

lines.content: （どうして？　学校の先生。きみにぴったりだと思ったのに……）
lines.translated: (Why? Being a schoolteacher. I thought it suited you so well...)

lines.content: ちょっと残念だったけど、でもきみはあたらしい“夢”を見つけたみたいだった。
lines.translated: It was a little disappointing, but it seemed you had found a new "dream."

lines.content: きみは読んでいた本を閉じる。
lines.translated: You closed the book you were reading.

lines.content: その一冊を鞄につめて歩き出す。
lines.translated: Packing that single volume into your bag, you set off walking.

lines.content: きみは日本中を旅して回った。
lines.translated: You traveled all around Japan.

lines.content: わたしはその後ろをこっそりついていく。
lines.translated: I secretly followed behind you.

lines.content: そうすることで[・|今]のきみが、どういう時間を生きているのか。少しずつ、見えてきた。
lines.translated: By doing so, little by little, I began to see what kind of time the "current" you was living through.

lines.content: 日本中を旅行すること。
lines.translated: Traveling all across Japan.

lines.content: それがきみの、あたらしい“夢”――……では、ない。
lines.translated: That is your new "dream"--...no, it isn't.

lines.content: 学園の卒業式の日。大雅は、交通事故に遭った。
lines.translated: On the day of the academy's graduation ceremony, Taiga was in a traffic accident.

lines.content: 命に関わるような大きな怪我はすべて、わたしが持って行くことができたけど……。
lines.translated: I was able to take all of the major, life-threatening injuries away with me, but...

lines.content: すべて持って行けていた、[・|つ][・|も][・|り]になっていただけだった。
lines.translated: I had only thought I managed to take all of them away.

lines.content: 後遺症があったらしい。
lines.translated: It seemed there were lingering aftereffects.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は大雅の頭の中にある。
lines.translated: It was inside Taiga's head.

lines.content: 時を重ねるだけ症状は重くなっていったのだという――はじめは、手足の微かな痺れからだった。
lines.translated: They said the symptoms grew worse with the passage of time--starting at first with a faint numbness in his hands and feet.

lines.content: 次第に、時どきふっと意識を失うようにもなった。
lines.translated: Gradually, he also began to suddenly lose consciousness from time to time.

lines.content: 病院の先生に診断された結果、もう大雅にはあまり、自由に歩き回れるだけの時間が残されていないのだということだった。命の制限時間ではない。肉体の制限時間だ。
lines.translated: According to the doctor's diagnosis at the hospital, Taiga no longer had much time left in which he would be able to walk around freely. Not a time limit on his life, but a time limit on his body.

lines.content: そう告げられてすぐ大雅は先生を辞めた。
lines.translated: Right after being told that, Taiga quit being a teacher.

lines.content: それから大雅は、[・|自][・|分][・|と][・|同][・|じ][・|よ][・|う][・|に]苦しむ人の声を聞いて回るようになった。
lines.translated: From then on, Taiga began traveling around to listen to the voices of people who were suffering in the same way he was.

lines.content: 決して治ることのない重い病に苦しむ人。産まれながらに不自由なものを押しつけられてしまっている人。
lines.translated: People suffering from severe, incurable illnesses. People who had been forced to bear disabilities from birth.

lines.content: ……それだけではなく。
lines.translated: And not just them.

lines.content: ごくふつうの人が、ごくふつうに生きているだけで遭遇してしまう、静かな苦しみを――その悲しみを、さみしさを、ごくごくふつうに、乗り越えてはいけない人たち。
lines.translated: Completely ordinary people who have no choice but to overcome, in a completely ordinary way, the quiet suffering--the sadness, the loneliness--that they encounter simply by living completely ordinary lives.

lines.content: その一つひとつは、決して誰にも知られることなく終わりを迎える物語。そこに生きている人たちもまた、誰にも知られることなく眠りにつく。
lines.translated: Each and every one of those is a story that comes to an end without anyone ever knowing about it. And the people living within them also fall asleep without anyone ever knowing.

lines.content: そういった名もない彼ら彼女らの声に耳を傾け、“想い”を探り、いつかそれらを“[・|形]”にすること。
lines.translated: To lend an ear to the voices of those nameless men and women, to search out their "feelings," and someday give them "form."

lines.content: それが大雅のあたらしい“夢”なのだという。
lines.translated: That, it seemed, was Taiga's new "dream."

lines.content: 『……ぼくには特別な“何か”を作ることのできる“才能”はない。でも、言葉を伝えることはできる。だから書くことにした。そうすることが、ぼくの“歌”になると思ったんです』
lines.translated: "...I don't have the 'talent' to create 'something' special. But I can convey words. So I decided to write. I thought that doing so would become my 'song.'"

lines.content: 大雅は言った。
lines.translated: Taiga had said.

lines.content: “どうしてそんな旅をしようと思ったんですか？”と、ちょっと意地悪な顔をした“誰か”に、旅の途中で聞かれたときだ。
lines.translated: That was what he said when "someone" with a slightly mean-spirited look on their face asked him during his journey, "Why did you decide to go on a trip like this?"

lines.content: 『この世界には、聞こえのいい明るくすてきな歌や、物語や、言葉で、溢れてるけれど』
lines.translated: "Although this world is overflowing with pleasant-sounding, bright, and wonderful songs, stories, and words..."

lines.content: 『誰かが悲しみについて語らなければ、この世界はもっと、もっと深い悲しいことで溢れていくだろうと思う』
lines.translated: "I think that unless someone speaks of sadness, this world will overflow with deeper and deeper sorrow."

lines.content: 『……自分と同じ苦しみの中を生きる人から、勇気を学ぶことだってあるはずです』
lines.translated: "...Surely, there are times when we can learn courage from people who are living through the same suffering as ourselves."

lines.content: 『この声は、この言葉は、時を越えるほどのどこか遠くで、自分と同じように苦しむ誰かの心を救うことがあるかもしれない』
lines.translated: "Perhaps this voice, these words, might someday save the heart of someone suffering in the same way, somewhere far away, even across time."

lines.content: 『……名もないもの達の日常にこそ、もっとも尊い闘争は潜んでる。英雄の[物語|勇気]は、同じような戦いに挑む英雄にしか役に立たない――』
lines.translated: "...It is precisely in the everyday lives of the nameless that the noblest struggles lie hidden. The story--the courage--of a hero is only useful to another hero facing a similar battle--"

lines.content: 『ごくふつうの人を勇気づけるには、ごくふつうの人たちが、ごくふつうの人生の中で戦う姿こそ、その言葉や“心”こそが、必要なんだと思う』
lines.translated: "To give courage to completely ordinary people, I think what is needed is the very sight of completely ordinary people fighting within their completely ordinary lives--their words, and their 'hearts.'"

lines.content: 『……だからこの世界の悲しみを、まっすぐに、見つめることにしたんです』
lines.translated: "...That's why I decided to look straight at the sadness of this world."

lines.content: きっと、大人たちの多くは笑うだろう――大雅が口にしたことを。いつまでも子どものようなことを、と言って。
lines.translated: Surely, most adults would laugh at what Taiga said--telling him that he was spouting childish nonsense forever.

lines.content: そうして意地悪な人は意地悪なまま、肩をすくめて、どこかへ行ってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: And though that mean-spirited person simply stayed mean-spirited, shrugged their shoulders, and walked off somewhere...

lines.content: その旅の途中には、大雅のことを笑うそういう人たちが多く、いたけれど……。
lines.translated: And though there were many people along his journey who laughed at Taiga like that...

lines.content: 大雅は歩くのをやめなかった。日に日に鈍く、痛く、重くなっていく身体を連れて。
lines.translated: Taiga never stopped walking. Taking along a body that grew duller, more painful, and heavier by the day.

lines.content: そんなきみの後ろ姿を見つめるわたしは、“どうして？”と、思う。
lines.translated: Watching your back as you went, I wondered, "Why?"

lines.content: （ねえ、大雅。どうしてきみは、ひとりきりでいるの。……どうして、あの女の人と一緒に生きようとしなかったの）
lines.translated: (Hey, Taiga. Why are you all alone? ...Why didn't you try to live together with that woman?)

lines.content: 呼びかけてみても決して答えは返ってこないけど、それでもやっぱりわたしは思う……。
lines.translated: Even if I tried calling out to you, an answer would never come back, yet I still couldn't help wondering...

lines.content: （……どうして。その後遺症は、わたしの“力”が……“命”が、持って行けなかったのかな）
lines.translated: (...Why? Why couldn't my "power"... my "life," take those aftereffects away?)

lines.content: たぶん……。
lines.translated: Maybe...

lines.content: あの事故の後から見つかったものだってこともあるだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Part of it might have been because it was only discovered after the accident, but...

lines.content: 大雅にとって[それ|後遺症]は“不幸”じゃなかったんだ。
lines.translated: To Taiga, those aftereffects weren't a "misfortune."

lines.content: あたらしい“夢”を見つけられた。
lines.translated: He was able to find a new "dream."

lines.content: あたらしい生き方を――自分だけの歌を、物語を、そうであればいいと願うものを、見つけられた。
lines.translated: He was able to find a new way of living--his very own song, his story, something he wished to make a reality.

lines.content: そのきっかけを与えてくれた[・|そ][・|れ]を大雅は不幸だと思っていない。だからわたしの“力”は働かなかった。たぶん、そういうことだ。
lines.translated: Taiga didn't think of the thing that gave him that opportunity as a misfortune. That was why my "power" hadn't worked. Maybe that was what it meant.

lines.content: 旅に出て随分と時間が経った。
lines.translated: Quite a long time passed since he set out on his journey.

lines.content: 季節が移り変わる度、大雅の歩く速度は少しずつ遅くなっていく。つらそうに休み休み、歩いて行く。
lines.translated: Each time the seasons changed, Taiga's walking pace grew slower, little by little. He walked on, taking frequent breaks in pain.

lines.content: 空から降る花のかけらや、冷たい雪の結晶みたいにふわふわと、ふらふらと、心許ない足取りで前へと進んだ。
lines.translated: Like fragments of flowers falling from the sky, or cold crystals of snow, he drifted along, unsteady on his feet, moving forward with faltering steps.

lines.content: そんな大雅に親切にしてくれる人もたくさんいた。肩を貸しましょうかという人もいた。でも、大雅はその全部を笑顔で断っていた。
lines.translated: There were many people who were kind to Taiga as he was. There were even people who offered to lend him a shoulder. However, Taiga turned all of them down with a smile.

lines.content: そしてまた、ひとりぼっちで歩いて行く。
lines.translated: And then, he would walk on all alone again.

lines.content: 夏の強い陽射しにふらりとし、冷たくなりはじめた秋の風に肌をさすり……。
lines.translated: Staggering beneath the strong summer sunlight, rubbing his skin against the autumn wind as it began to turn cold...

lines.content: 誰もが大切な人と身体を寄せ合い過ごすのだろう真冬の空気に、まっしろな吐息を滲ませ、振り返ることなく前へと進む。
lines.translated: Breathing out pure white sighs into the midwinter air, when everyone else was surely huddling close to their loved ones, he pressed forward without ever looking back.

lines.content: そんな後ろ姿にわたしはついていくだけだ。
lines.translated: All I could do was follow behind his back.

lines.content: 肩を貸してあげられればよかった。
lines.translated: I wished I could have lent him a shoulder.

lines.content: そうしてふたりで歩いて行けるなら、それがどんな道だろうと構わないと思えた。
lines.translated: I felt that if we could walk together like that, I wouldn't care what kind of road it was.

lines.content: ……でも、わたしにはそうすることができない。
lines.translated: However, I couldn't do that.

lines.content: （今のわたしに、できることなんて……）
lines.translated: (What I can do right now is...)

lines.content: ひとつだけ。
lines.translated: Only one thing.

lines.content: きみのあたらしいその“夢”を、この命ぜんぶ使って応援することだけだ。
lines.translated: To use every bit of this life to cheer on that new "dream" of yours.

lines.content: 特殊な病気に苦しむ人たちと会うために、とある山の上の病院へと向かう途中。
lines.translated: On his way to a hospital atop a certain mountain to meet people suffering from a special illness...

lines.content: 急に大雅は発作を起こした。
lines.translated: Taiga suddenly had a seizure.

lines.content: 頭の中にある後遺症の発作だ――うずくまり、震え、ついには倒れた。
lines.translated: It was a seizure from the aftereffects inside his head--he crouched down, trembled, and finally collapsed.

lines.content: 急いで駆け寄り、何度も鳴いて呼びかけた。
lines.translated: I hurriedly ran up to him, meowing over and over to call out to him.

lines.content: でも反応がない。呼吸を、していない。
lines.translated: However, there was no response. He wasn't breathing.

lines.content: （だめ……。やっぱり、どんなに“力”を使おうと思っても、この後遺症は持って行けない）
lines.translated: (No good... Just as I thought, no matter how much I try to use my "power," I can't take these aftereffects away.)

lines.content: わたしは人を呼ぼうと駆け回った。
lines.translated: I ran around trying to call for help.

lines.content: 偶然近くを通っていた大人の人に、必死に鳴いて、訴えて――大雅のところへ連れて行くことができたけど。
lines.translated: Meowing desperately and pleading with an adult who happened to be passing by nearby--I managed to lead them to Taiga, however...

lines.content: （……今度は）
lines.translated: (...This time.)

lines.content: ……一生懸命、助けを求めて走り回って。
lines.translated: Running around with all my might to seek help.

lines.content: 大雅のことを助けてくれる人たちを見守って。
lines.translated: Watching over the people who came to save Taiga.

lines.content: そのまま草むらの中で少し休もうと瞼を閉じて。
lines.translated: Closing my eyelids in the tall grass just as I was, trying to rest for a little while.

lines.content: 殆ど何も食べずに走り回っていた小さなわたし、だったから。
lines.translated: Because I was so small, and had been running around while eating almost nothing at all.

lines.content: そのままわたしは、冷たくなってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: Just like that, I grew cold, however...

lines.content: （……今度は、無駄遣いじゃなかったよね。“力”を使って“命”をなくしたわけじゃ、ないけれど……）
lines.translated: (...This time, it wasn't a waste, right? Even though I didn't lose my "life" by using my "power"...)

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”の空にわたしはつぶやく。
lines.translated: Looking up at the sky of the "Night," I murmured to myself.

lines.content: でも“夜”の真ん中に立つさくらの樹は、ただ静かに、たくさんの花びらを散らし続けているだけだった。
lines.translated: However, the cherry tree standing in the center of the "Night" simply continued to quietly scatter countless petals.

lines.content: 早く……。
lines.translated: Hurry...

lines.content: 早く生まれ変わらないと、大雅、もっともっと大人になっちゃう。
lines.translated: If I don't hurry and get reborn, Taiga will grow into even more of an adult.

lines.content: “夜”に瞬く光りに向かい、わたしは駆け出す――……次だ。
lines.translated: Toward the light twinkling in the "Night," I broke into a run--...onto the next.

lines.content: わたしはまた別の柄の子猫に産まれる。
lines.translated: I was born again as a kitten with a different coat.

lines.content: 確か六つ目の“命”だ。
lines.translated: If I remember right, this is my sixth "life."

lines.content: もう残り少ない。
lines.translated: There aren't many left now.

lines.content: “参禅町”に戻ると、大雅の匂いがした。
lines.translated: When I returned to Sanzen Town, I caught Taiga's scent.

lines.content: いつもと同じように、窓から“ゆめのねどこ”の中をこっそり覗いた。
lines.translated: Just like always, I secretly peeked inside the "Bed of Dreams" through the window.

lines.content: 長い旅を終えた大雅は、一日何時間もずっと机に向かい、何かを書き続けていた。
lines.translated: Having finished his long journey, Taiga sat at his desk for hours every day, continuously writing something.

lines.content: でも頭を抱え、ため息をつく時間のほうが長いようにも見える――……ぼくには特別な“才能”はない。大雅はそう言っていた。
lines.translated: However, it looked like he spent even more time holding his head and sighing--..."I don't have any special 'talent.'" Taiga had said that.

lines.content: それでも何かを“形”にしようと懸命になっている。
lines.translated: Even so, he was trying his hardest to give "form" to something.

lines.content: きっと“夢”だ。
lines.translated: Surely, it was his "dream."

lines.content: 大雅は“夢”を“形”にしようと必死になってる。
lines.translated: Taiga was desperately trying to give "form" to his "dream."

lines.content: 書きたくともどうしても書けないのだと抱え込んだ頭には、また、白いものが増えたように見えた。
lines.translated: On the head he cradled in frustration, unable to write no matter how much he wanted to, it looked as though the streaks of white had increased once again.

lines.content: 毎日深夜過ぎまでがんばっていた。
lines.translated: Every day, he worked hard until well past midnight.

lines.content: 時には朝日が昇っても、書き続けていた。眠らず何日も書き進めることも珍しくはなかった。
lines.translated: Sometimes, he kept writing even after the morning sun rose. It wasn't uncommon for him to keep writing for days without sleeping.

lines.content: （……がんばれ、大雅）
lines.translated: (...Do your best, Taiga.)

lines.content: 応援してる。
lines.translated: I'm cheering for you.

lines.content: （……きみのしようとしてることなら、どんなことでも全部、上手くいくよう祈ってる）
lines.translated: (...If it's something you're trying to do, whatever it is, I'm praying that all of it goes well.)

lines.content: わたしも[・|書][・|く]ことにした。
lines.translated: I decided to write, too.

lines.content: 大雅にどうしても、今のわたしの気持ちを伝えたいと思った。
lines.translated: No matter what, I wanted to convey my current feelings to Taiga.

lines.content: （よかった……。まだちゃんと、この姿になれた）
lines.translated: (Thank goodness... I can still properly take this form.)

lines.content: 久しぶりに[・|ひ][・|と][・|の][・|姿]に私は変わった。手紙を書きたいと思ったからだ。
lines.translated: For the first time in a long while, I changed into a human form. Because I wanted to write a letter.
As if being hounded by a time limit, Taiga continued to write something.

lines.content: それは“歌”なのか“物語”なのか、“絵”なのか。それともそのどれとも違う、“想い”を込めた言葉の連なりか……。
lines.translated: Was it a "song," a "story," or a "picture"? Or was it something different from any of those, a string of words filled with "feelings"...?

lines.content: たぶん、手紙だろうとわたしは思う。
lines.translated: Maybe, I thought, it was a letter.

lines.content: 旅して集めたいっぱいの“想い”――それらを大雅の言葉で綴る、まだ見ぬ誰かへ宛てた“勇気”の“形”
lines.translated: All the many "feelings" he had gathered on his journey--the "form" of "courage" addressed to someone he had yet to meet, spelled out in Taiga's own words.

lines.content: ……大雅のその“想い”はいつか“誰か”に届くだろうか。
lines.translated: Would those "feelings" of Taiga's ever reach "someone" someday?

lines.content: そうして届いたものは、“誰か”にとって宝物になるだろうか。
lines.translated: And would what reached them become a treasure to that "someone"?

lines.content: この世界は残酷で、気まぐれだ。絶対なんて言い切れるものは何ひとつないけれど――それでも確かに、言えることはある。
lines.translated: This world is cruel and capricious. There isn't a single thing that can be declared an absolute certainty--yet even so, there is something I can say for sure.

lines.content: わたしには届いてる。
lines.translated: It is reaching me.

lines.content: 大雅ががんばってること。大雅が“夢”を叶えようと懸命になってること。大雅が、ひとりでも懸命に生きてること。
lines.translated: How hard Taiga is trying. How desperately Taiga is working to make his "dream" come true. How earnestly Taiga is living, even all on his own.

lines.content: 全部ぜんぶ、ずっときみを見つめてきたわたしには、届いてる。
lines.translated: All of it, every last bit of it, is reaching me, who has been watching over you this whole time.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: （……がんばって、ください。おうえん、して、ます）
lines.translated: (...Please, do your best. I am, cheering, for you.)

lines.content: わたしは、いつまでも上達しない下手くそな字で、きみ宛ての短い手紙を書いた。
lines.translated: In my clumsy handwriting that never seemed to improve, I wrote a short letter addressed to you.

lines.content: 久しぶりに書いたひらがなは、やっぱりどうしようもなく下手くそで……。
lines.translated: The hiragana I wrote for the first time in so long was hopelessly clumsy after all...

lines.content: でも、心は込めた。“想い”を込めた。だから届いてと願い、わたしはその手紙を“ゆめのねどこ”の玄関の前に置いた。
lines.translated: Even so, I put my heart into it. I put my "feelings" into it. Praying that it would reach you, I placed that letter in front of the entrance to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: できるだけかわいくてきれいな花を集めて作った花束と、拾った百円玉で買ったサバ缶も一緒に。
lines.translated: Along with a bouquet made from gathering the cutest, prettiest flowers I could find, and a can of mackerel I bought with a hundred-yen coin I had picked up.

lines.content: 早朝。それに気づいた大雅はその場で手紙を開き、読んで、きょろきょろと辺りを見渡す。
lines.translated: Early in the morning. Noticing it, Taiga opened the letter right there on the spot, read it, and looked around restlessly.

lines.content: 驚いたような顔をしていたけれど、花束に少し頬を緩ませていたように見えた。
lines.translated: He had a surprised look on his face, yet his cheeks seemed to soften slightly at the sight of the bouquet.

lines.content: いつも後遺症のしびれや痛みで、ここ最近はずっと顔をしかめていることが多かった。でも、久しぶりに笑顔を見れたように感じた。
lines.translated: Lately, he had spent so much time frowning from the constant numbness and pain of his aftereffects. Even so, I felt like I had been able to see him smile for the first time in a long while.

lines.content: その笑顔をわたしが作れたのなら、うれしい。とても。
lines.translated: If I was the one who managed to bring about that smile, I'm happy. So very happy.

lines.content: ……“想い”は届いた。きみに、届いた。そう思った。
lines.translated: My "feelings" reached him. They reached you. That was what I thought.

lines.content: （……拾ってきたような紙で、ごめんね。もっときれいな紙で、きれいな字で、手紙、書きたかったよ）
lines.translated: (...I'm sorry for using paper that looks like I just picked it up off the ground. I wanted to write you a letter on much prettier paper, with much prettier handwriting.)

lines.content: でも本当は、手紙を書くことよりも、またきみの元に走って行きたい気持ちもあったけど……。
lines.translated: Though in truth, more than writing a letter, part of me wanted to come running back to your side again...

lines.content: （また“さよなら”するのはつらいから、だからここからずっと、きみのこと見てるよ）
lines.translated: (Saying "goodbye" again would be too painful, so I'll keep watching over you from right here forever.)

lines.content: そうして六つ目の“命”は、“夢”を叶えようとひとりでがんばるきみを遠くからじっと見ているだけで、終わってしまった。
lines.translated: And so, my sixth "life" came to an end as I simply watched over you from afar, while you worked hard all alone to make your "dream" come true.

lines.content: 七つ目も、八つ目も、殆ど変わらない。
lines.translated: The seventh and the eighth were hardly any different.

lines.content: 時どき手紙を書いて。差し入れのつもりで缶詰だったり花束だったりを玄関の前に置いた。そういった日々の中で、それぞれ“夜の外”で寿命を迎えて、その“命”は静かに尽きた。
lines.translated: From time to time, I wrote letters. I left canned food or bouquets of flowers in front of the entrance as little gifts. Amidst such days, each of those lives reached the end of its natural span "outside the Night," and quietly burned out.

lines.content: ……それだけきみもまた歳を取った。家の中を歩くのもつらそうなのは、後遺症のせいなのか、それとも身体に重ねた時間のせいか。
lines.translated: And by that same measure, you grew older too. Was it because of the aftereffects that even walking around inside the house looked painful for you, or was it because of the time that had accumulated within your body?

lines.content: そんな大雅のことを見つめていると思い知らされるような気がした。
lines.translated: As I gazed at Taiga like that, I felt as though the truth was being driven home to me.

lines.content: やっぱりわたし達は、どこまでいっても同じ時間を、同じ速度で生きられない別の“イキモノ”なんだねと。
lines.translated: That no matter how far we go, we really are different "creatures" who cannot live through the same time at the same speed.

lines.content: 九つ目。
lines.translated: The ninth.

lines.content: 最後の“命”
lines.translated: My final "life."

lines.content: この“命”もまた、きみのことを静かに見つめ続け、最期を迎えるのだろう。
lines.translated: This "life," too, will surely meet its end while continuing to quietly watch over you.

lines.content: その後はどうなるのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder what will happen after that.

lines.content: “命”がなければ“夜の外”で生きることはできない。それがこの世界と時間、そして“命”のルールだ。
lines.translated: Without a "life," one cannot live "outside the Night." That is the rule of this world, of time, and of "life."

lines.content: わたしがそばにいられなくなった後、きみのことを誰が護ってくれるのか――……そう考えるのは傲慢だろうか。
lines.translated: After I can no longer be by your side, who will protect you--... Is it arrogant of me to think that way?

lines.content: （わたしなんていてもいなくても、一緒だ。何もできない。きみに何も、してあげられない。……でも）
lines.translated: (Whether someone like me is here or not, it makes no difference. I can't do anything. I can't do a single thing for you. ...Even so.)

lines.content: 心配だ……。
lines.translated: I'm worried...

lines.content: （とても心配だよ、大雅……）
lines.translated: (I'm so worried about you, Taiga...)

lines.content: 次に“命”が尽きればもう終わり。
lines.translated: When my next "life" runs out, it will truly be the end.

lines.content: そう考えると怖かった。
lines.translated: Thinking about that terrified me.

lines.content: 思いつく限りの色々な怖さが一度に押し寄せ、思い通りにならない“心”がパンクしてしまいそう――……そんなある日のことだ。
lines.translated: Every imaginable fear came rushing in all at once, making my unruly "heart" feel as though it were about to burst--... And then, one day, it happened.

lines.content: 九つ目の“命”は突然、終わった。
lines.translated: My ninth "life" ended suddenly.

lines.content: 早朝のことだった。
lines.translated: It happened early in the morning.

lines.content: その日も遅くまで書き物をしていた大雅を、わたしは、外の茂みの中から窓を通して見つめてた。
lines.translated: From inside the bushes outside, I was gazing through the window at Taiga, who had been writing until late that day as well.

lines.content: ……うとうととしてしまったのはほんの一瞬だったと思ってた。
lines.translated: I thought I had only dozed off for a single moment.

lines.content: 大雅がいつもの机に突っ伏し、動かなくなっているのに気づいた。また、発作が起きたみたいだった。
lines.translated: I noticed that Taiga had collapsed onto his usual desk and wasn't moving. It looked like he had suffered another attack.

lines.content: しかも台所のほうから白い煙が立ちこめはじめている。何かを火に掛けたまま、大雅は気を失ってしまったようだ。
lines.translated: Worse still, white smoke was beginning to billow from the direction of the kitchen. It seemed Taiga had lost consciousness while leaving something on the stove.

lines.content: 煙は次第に黒いものに変わっていった。
lines.translated: The smoke gradually turned black.

lines.content: 中に這入れる隙間を探したけれど、こういう日に限ってどこにも這入り込めるような場所が見当たらない……。
lines.translated: I searched for a gap to crawl inside, but as luck would have it on a day like this, I couldn't find a single place to slip through...

lines.content: わたしはひとの姿になり、少し躊躇い、窓を割って中に入った。
lines.translated: I took on my human form, hesitated for a moment, and then broke the window to get inside.

lines.content: 何とか大雅を外へ引きずっていき……。
lines.translated: Somehow, I managed to drag Taiga out of the house...

lines.content: 煙に気づいた近所の人が連絡を入れてくれていたらしい。そこで大人の人たちが大勢やって来て、大雅を大きな車に乗せていった。
lines.translated: Apparently, a neighbor had noticed the smoke and called for help. A large crowd of adults arrived and loaded Taiga into a big vehicle.

lines.content: その車の後ろを追いかけたけど、わたしの足ではともて追いつけなかった。
lines.translated: I chased after the vehicle, but my legs couldn't possibly catch up.

lines.content: わたしは猫のくせに足が遅い。運動音痴だ。何度生まれ変わっても、柄が変わってしまっても、そんなところだけは変わらなかった。
lines.translated: Even though I'm a cat, I'm a slow runner. I have terrible reflexes. No matter how many times I was reborn, even when the pattern of my fur changed, that one thing never did.

lines.content: 遠ざかっていく車の後ろ姿を、ぜえぜえ息をしながら見つめてた。
lines.translated: Gasping and wheezing for breath, I stared after the vehicle as it drove further and further away.

lines.content: （……ほんとは“さよなら”を言いたかったけど、でもどのみち、無理だったよね）
lines.translated: (...In truth, I wanted to say "goodbye," but it would have been impossible either way, wouldn't it?)

lines.content: 大雅は煙をたくさん吸ってしまってる。そのために昏睡状態だったのだと、駆けつけてきた大人たちが言っていたのを聞いた。
lines.translated: Taiga had inhaled a lot of smoke. I heard the adults who had rushed to the scene saying that was why he was in a coma.

lines.content: ……気を失っていたのは後遺症のためではなかったみたいだ。
lines.translated: It seemed he hadn't lost consciousness because of his aftereffects.

lines.content: （……それなら、大雅。きみのその“不幸”を、わたし、持って行けるよね）
lines.translated: (...In that case, Taiga. I can take that "misfortune" of yours away with me, can't I?)

lines.content: わたしのひとつの“命”が、どれくらいきみの“不幸”を取り込めるだけの容量があるのかは、知らない。
lines.translated: I don't know how much capacity a single "life" of mine has to absorb your "misfortune."

lines.content: でもこれで“さよなら”だという予感があった。
lines.translated: Even so, I had a premonition that this would be "goodbye."

lines.content: （……大雅。きみの“夢”が叶うところを見たかったけど……。もう、わたしの時間はこれで終わりみたい）
lines.translated: (...Taiga. I wanted to see your "dream" come true, though... It seems my time is up.)

lines.content: “さよなら”、と小さくつぶやく。
lines.translated: "Goodbye," I murmured softly.

lines.content: 何度も何度も色々な形の“さよなら”をしたけれど、これで本当に最後だ。
lines.translated: We had said "goodbye" in so many different ways over and over again, but this was truly the last time.

lines.content: わたしは“夜のイキモノ”
lines.translated: I am a "Creature of the Night."

lines.content: きみとは生きる時間が違うけど……。
lines.translated: The time I live through is different from yours, though...

lines.content: あさひや十夜みたいにひとつの命が長くながく、続いていくのではなく、九つ命を持っている――
lines.translated: Rather than having a single life that continues on and on for a very long time like Asahi or Toya, I possess nine lives--

lines.content: そういう種類の、“夜の猫”
lines.translated: I am that kind of "Cat of the Night."

lines.content: その一つひとつは、大切に“想う人”のためにしか使えない。
lines.translated: And each and every one of them can only be used for the person I hold dear in my "thoughts."

lines.content: だからこそそのすべてを使い切ったなら、それで“さよなら”
lines.translated: That is why, once all of them are used up, it means "goodbye."

lines.content: 大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: きみに……。
lines.translated: To you...

lines.content: （これまでたくさん、さみしいことがあった分だけ、きみに幸せなことがありますように……）
lines.translated: (Just as you have experienced so much loneliness until now, I pray that just as much happiness comes your way...)

lines.content: 誰にも届くことない願いを“心”の中でつぶやいて、わたしはそっと[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた――……そして。
lines.translated: Murmuring a wish in my "heart" that would never reach anyone, I gently closed my eyelids--... And then.

lines.content: そして今、わたしは“[ここ|夜]”にこうして座ってる。
lines.translated: And now, here I am, sitting in "this place"--the Night.

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”
lines.translated: "The Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: 今夜の最終便がとまっているホーム。そのベンチにだ。
lines.translated: On a bench on the platform where tonight's final train is stopped.

lines.content: なんだか……
lines.translated: "Somehow..."

lines.content: なんだかあっけない終わりだったなあと、そんなことを思う。
lines.translated: What an anticlimactic end that was, I thought to myself.

lines.content: でも所詮、自分はこんなものだよねという納得もまた同時にあった。
lines.translated: Yet at the same time, part of me accepted that this was all I amounted to in the end.

lines.content: それなのに一歩、踏み出せないのはなぜだろう。
lines.translated: Why is it, then, that I can't take a single step forward?

lines.content: わたしは“切符”を握りしめ、ベンチに座ったまま動けずにいる。
lines.translated: Clutching my "ticket" tightly, I remain sitting on the bench, unable to move.

lines.content: 命尽きたものは誰もが等しく、“夜”の中で“次”の行き先を決めなければならない。
lines.translated: All whose lives have ended must equally decide their "next" destination within the "Night."

lines.content: わたしという名の人生で、その“心”に得たものを金と銀の硬貨に変えて、それで購入できる“切符”が運んでくれる範囲内の“次”……。
lines.translated: Turning what I gained in my "heart" during the life known as "me" into gold and silver coins, my "next" destination lies within the range of where the "ticket" I can afford will carry me...

lines.content: わたしが選び、購入した“切符”は、次はふつうの“猫”として――“心”なんて持たない“イキモノ”として、きみの近くに生まれ落ちたい。それが握りしめた“切符”の行き先だ。
lines.translated: The destination of the "ticket" I chose and purchased is to be born near you next time as an ordinary "cat"--as a "creature" without a "heart" at all. That is the destination of the "ticket" clutched in my hand.

lines.content: 本当の“夢”は違うけど……。
lines.translated: My true "dream" is different, though...

lines.content: でもわたしの“心”で支払えるものでは、それくらいの“[行き先|切符]”が限界だった。
lines.translated: But with what I could pay using my "heart," a "ticket"--a destination--like that was the absolute limit.

lines.content: 列車に乗らなければこの町の“影”となり、永遠に“夜”の中を彷徨うことになる。
lines.translated: If I don't board the train, I will become a "shadow" of this town and wander through the "Night" for all eternity.

lines.content: いつか大雅にも死が訪れる。
lines.translated: Someday, death will visit Taiga as well.

lines.content: そしてこの“夜”を通過するだろう――でも、列車に乗らず“影”になってしまっては、わたしはもうわたしであってわたしではなくなっているだろう。
lines.translated: And he will surely pass through this "Night"--but if I fail to board the train and become a "shadow," I will likely remain myself yet no longer be myself at all.

lines.content: 最終便を逃した今夜を境に[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|る]。
lines.translated: Starting tonight, once I miss the final train, that is what will happen.

lines.content: でも、列車に乗ってしまっても、同じだ。今のわたしは消えてしまう。……わたしの“心”も。記憶も全部
lines.translated: "Even if I do board the train, though, it's the same. The me I am right now will disappear. ...My 'heart,' too. And all of my memories."

lines.content: 自分に言い聞かせるように、つぶやく――……それでいいの？　本当に？　と。
lines.translated: As if trying to convince myself, I murmured--... Is that really okay? Truly?

lines.content: 列車に乗っても乗れなくても、結果は殆ど変わらない。
lines.translated: Whether I board the train or fail to board it, the result hardly changes.

lines.content: この町の“夜”で“影”となり、自分ひとりの心の世界で永遠に、大雅の幻と戯れるようにして過ごすのか。
lines.translated: Will I become a "shadow" in the "Night" of this town, spending eternity inside the world of my own lonely heart as if playing with a phantom of Taiga?

lines.content: それとも列車に乗って、次のあたらしい人生では今より少しは幸せに――せめて、さみしいことの少ない時間でありますようにと願うのか。
lines.translated: Or will I board the train and wish that my next, new life will be at least a little happier than this one--that it will at least be a time with less loneliness?

lines.content: その答えがいつまでも、いつまでも、わたしは出せないままでいる。
lines.translated: Endlessly, forever, I remain unable to find the answer to that question.

lines.content: 大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: わたし、どうしたらいい？
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: そんなことを口にしてみても、誰もやさしく返事を返してはくれなかった。
lines.translated: Even when I tried voicing those words aloud, no one offered me a gentle reply.

lines.content: ……誰も、わたしの手を握っては、くれなかった。
lines.translated: No one took my hand.

lines.content: （うう）
胸が、痛い。ずきりとする。
lines.translated: My chest hurts. A sharp, throbbing ache.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]がわたしの“恋するための物語”
lines.translated: This is my "story for falling in love."

lines.content: それをもし“歌”にするなら、きっと泣いてるような“歌”になるだろうと思う。
lines.translated: If it were to be made into a "song," I think it would surely sound like someone crying.

lines.content: ……子猫がさみしくて泣き続けているかのような“歌”になるはず。
lines.translated: It would surely be a "song" like a kitten crying endlessly out of loneliness.

lines.content: だって、わたしがきみに恋することは、胸が痛いことばっかりだったから――……そうだ。わたしの“好き”は、胸がずきずき痛むこと。
lines.translated: Because falling in love with you was filled with nothing but heartache--... That's right. For me, "loving" means a sharp, throbbing pain in my chest.

lines.content: ふと、きみの笑顔をふと思い描いてた。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, I found myself picturing your smile.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: きみが好きだよと思えば思うだけ、いつも胸が、“心”が、とても痛いよ。
lines.translated: The more I think about how much I love you, the more my chest, my "heart," aches terribly.

lines.content: じりじりと列車のベルが鳴る。
lines.translated: The train bell rings with a shrill buzz.

lines.content: 発車を知らせる一回目のベルだ。次が鳴ればドアは閉まり、走り出す。そしてもう二度と“[現在|今]”へ戻ってくることはない。
lines.translated: It is the first bell announcing departure. When the next one rings, the doors will close, and the train will pull away. And I will never return to the "present"--to "now"--ever again.

lines.content: わたしは……。
lines.translated: I am...

lines.content: わたしは、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stand up.

lines.content: 列車に乗ることにした。
lines.translated: I decided to board the train.

lines.content: 重い腰を何とか持ち上げ、のろのろと、開かれたドアに向かって歩いた。
lines.translated: Forcing my heavy body up somehow, I walked sluggishly toward the open door.

lines.content: でも、まだ迷ってる。
lines.translated: Even so, I am still hesitating.

lines.content: このまま残るか。
lines.translated: Should I stay here like this?

lines.content: “次”へ進むか。
lines.translated: Or should I move on to the "next"?

lines.content: 大雅は望むだろうか。
lines.translated: Which would Taiga wish for?

lines.content: わたしが大雅のことを忘れられず、この町の“影”のひとつになり、永遠に留まり続けることを。
lines.translated: For me to be unable to forget about him, becoming one of the "shadows" of this town and remaining behind for all eternity?

lines.content: わたしがこのまま列車に乗って、きみの知らないあたらしい“何か”に生まれ変わることを。
lines.translated: Or for me to board the train just like this, and be reborn into a new "something" that you don't know?

lines.content: そう思うとまた足が止まった。
lines.translated: At that thought, my feet stopped once again.

lines.content: 開いたドアの前だ。あと一歩、踏み出せば乗車することになる。
lines.translated: I am right in front of the open door. One more step forward, and I will be on the train.

lines.content: わたしは最後の乗客。後ろには誰もいない。でも開いたドアの向こうに、“切符”を回収する係のひとがいた。
lines.translated: I am the last passenger. There is no one behind me. However, just beyond the open door stood an attendant who collects the "tickets."

lines.content: わたしに手を差し伸べている。
lines.translated: Extending a hand toward me.

lines.content: “切符”を拝見。
lines.translated: Let me see your "ticket."

lines.content: そういう仕草だ。
lines.translated: That was what the gesture meant.

lines.content: そんな様子を前にすると、別段誰に急かされたわけでもないのに、わたしはついその係のひとに“切符”を渡してしまった。
lines.translated: Faced with that, even though no one was particularly rushing me, I ended up handing my "ticket" over to the attendant without thinking.

lines.content: 係のひとは“切符”を見ている。行き先を確認しているようだ。
lines.translated: The attendant is looking at the "ticket." Apparently checking the destination.
Doing this is surely the right thing.

lines.content: 難しいことはばかなわたしにはわからない。
lines.translated: I'm too foolish to understand complicated things.

lines.content: でもいつまでも同じところに立ち止まることより、少しでもどこか別の場所に進んでいくことのほうが、たぶん、自然なのではないかとは思えた。
lines.translated: Even so, rather than standing still in the same place forever, moving forward even a little bit to somewhere else felt like it was probably the more natural thing to do.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: や、やっぱり、いい……です
lines.translated: "O-On second thought, never... mind."

lines.content: 渡した“切符”を返してもらおうと思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to ask for the "ticket" I had handed over to be given back to me.

lines.content: 間違っていてもいい。幻でもいい。それが本当じゃなくても、わたしは、この町で大雅と一緒に暮らしたい。きみと、同じ時間をわたしは生きたい。
lines.translated: I don't care if it's wrong. I don't care if it's an illusion. Even if it isn't real, I want to live together with Taiga in this town. I want to live through the same time as you.

lines.content: それがわたしの“夢”だから……。
lines.translated: Because that is my "dream"...

lines.content: 乗らない……。わたし、このまま、ここで……
lines.translated: "I'm not getting on... I'm staying right here, just like this..."

lines.content: それ以上は何も言えず口を閉ざした。
lines.translated: Unable to say anything more than that, I shut my mouth.

lines.content: 何をやってもだめなわたしは、大雅以外の誰かの前ではもっともっとだめになる。正面から係のひとを見ることもできない。
lines.translated: As useless as I am at everything I do, I become even more hopeless in front of anyone other than Taiga. I couldn't even look the attendant straight in the face.

lines.content: だから何も言えない代わりに、わたしは手を出した。
lines.translated: So instead of saying anything, I held out my hand.

lines.content: “切符”を返してほしいという意思表示。[・|そ][・|れ]はわたしの“心”で購入したものだ。
lines.translated: A gesture showing I wanted the "ticket" back. It was something I had purchased with my "heart."

lines.content: でも、“切符”を渡した係のひとは――
lines.translated: However, the attendant I had handed the "ticket" to--
The conductor.

lines.content: じっと、わたしの“切符”を見つめたまま、それを離してくれず――……
lines.translated: She just stared fixedly at my "ticket," refusing to let it go--...

lines.content: うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ……うなずき、言った。
lines.translated: Then she nodded, and spoke.

lines.content: “[これ|切符]”じゃ、乗れないね。この列車には
lines.translated: "You can't board with this 'ticket,' you know. Not on this train."

lines.content: ……今、なんて？
lines.translated: "...What did you just say?"

lines.content: 予想外の返答だったため、つい、聞き返してしまった。
lines.translated: Because it was such an unexpected reply, I ended up asking back without thinking.

lines.content: だから、乗れないんだよ。この“切符”は無効だ。どう心変わりしようと、あなたを列車に乗せるわけにはいかないよ
lines.translated: "Like I said, you can't get on. This 'ticket' is invalid. No matter how much you change your mind, I can't let you board this train."

lines.content: きっぱりとそう言う車掌さんの格好をした女の子。
lines.translated: The girl dressed as a conductor declared that flatly.

lines.content: そこでやっと、顔を上げたわたしは気づく。
lines.translated: Only then did I finally look up and realize.

lines.content: わたしは、この子のことを知っている。
lines.translated: I know this girl.

lines.content: きみは……
lines.translated: "You're..."

lines.content: 今まで気づかなかったのは、ずっと大雅のことばかり考えていたせいだ。……だめなわたしは、真っ直ぐ前も見れていなかったからだ。
lines.translated: The reason I hadn't noticed until now was because my mind had been completely filled with thoughts of Taiga. ...Because I'm so useless, I hadn't even been looking straight ahead.

lines.content: いつもそう。
lines.translated: It's always like that.

lines.content: ばかなわたしはきみのことを考えると、それ以外なにも見えなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: Because I'm so foolish, the moment I think about you, I become blind to everything else.

lines.content: わたしの言いたいことに気づいたのだろう。女の子は、わたしに言った――“違うよ”、と。
lines.translated: Perhaps realizing what I was about to say, the girl spoke to me--"You're wrong," she said.

lines.content: 私は誰でもない。ただここにいるだけの“何か”だよ。……あなたが知ってる私と、今ここにいる私とはたぶん、違う私だと思う
lines.translated: "I am no one. Just a 'something' that happens to be here. ...The me you know, and the me standing here right now, are probably different versions of me."

lines.content: う、うん……？
わたしは首をかしげて、目をぱちぱちとさせる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head and blinked my eyes.

lines.content: 難しいことはわからない。姿はひとになれても、頭や“心”の中身は人にはなれない。
lines.translated: I don't understand complicated things. Even if my form can become human, the insides of my head and my "heart" cannot.

lines.content: まあとにかくあなたの知ってる私によく似た誰かは、今の私とは違う別人だってことだよ
lines.translated: "Well, anyway, it just means that the person you know who looks a lot like me is a different person from the me right now."

lines.content: ……えっと。完全に別とは言い難くはあるけれど、とにかくそういうわけなんだ
lines.translated: "...Er, well. It's hard to say we're completely separate, but anyway, that's how it is."

lines.content: だからわたしはあなたのことを知らないし、他の乗客と区別したり特別扱いしたりはしない、と前置きするようにして言い、車掌さんの格好をした女の子は……、
lines.translated: Saying that as if to preface that she didn't know me and wouldn't distinguish me from other passengers or give me special treatment, the girl dressed as a conductor...

lines.content: でもね
lines.translated: "But, you know..."

lines.content: [・|ナ][・|ナ][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん]そっくりの、小さな子は、にこりと微笑む。
lines.translated: The little girl who looked just like Nana-chan smiled brightly.

lines.content: 確かに私は、あなたのことを知らないけれど――あなたがいつか、こうして[・|ひ][・|と][・|り][・|ぼ][・|っ][・|ち][・|で]ここに現れることは、知っていたよ。……ずっと、昔からね
lines.translated: "It's true that I don't know you--but I did know that someday, you would show up here all alone like this. ...I've known for a very long time."

lines.content: 予定どおりだねと言って、わたしの手に“切符”を返した。
lines.translated: Saying that it was right on schedule, she returned the "ticket" to my hand.

lines.content: 予定、どおり……？
lines.translated: "Right on... schedule...?"

lines.content: そうだよと言う代わりに、ナナちゃんに似た子はまた微笑む。
lines.translated: Instead of saying "That's right," the girl who looked like Nana-chan smiled again.

lines.content: まだ早い。……まだ、あなたはこの列車に乗るべきじゃない
lines.translated: "It's still too early. ...You shouldn't be boarding this train just yet."

lines.content: そうして、小さな身体で思いきり背伸びをし、
lines.translated: And then, stretching her small body up on her tiptoes as high as she could,

lines.content: だって、本当は――……
lines.translated: "Because the truth is--..."
--she whispered right into my ear.

lines.content: わたしは、固まる。
lines.translated: I froze.

lines.content: あなたに[・|こ][・|れ]を伝えること。そして、[・|そ][・|れ]を渡すこと。それが私の“役割”だった
lines.translated: "To tell you this. And to hand that over to you. That was my 'role.'"

lines.content: 女の子はわたしの手に何かを握らせた。
lines.translated: The girl pressed something into my hand.

lines.content: ……私だったいつかの“誰か”が、そう誓ったんだ。私はもうそのときの私とは違うけど……今も胸の中に、その記憶が少し、残ってる
lines.translated: "...A 'someone' who used to be me made that vow once. I'm no longer the same me from back then, but... even now, deep in my chest, a little bit of that memory remains."

lines.content: “約束”は果たしたよと言って、女の子はどこか安心したようにうなずいていた。
lines.translated: Saying that she had fulfilled the "promise," the girl nodded with a somewhat relieved look on her face.

lines.content: ほら、行って。ぼーっとしてないで。今ならまだ間に合う
lines.translated: "Come on, go. Don't just stand there spacing out. If you go now, you can still make it in time."

lines.content: とん、と軽く、女の子がわたしの胸を押す。
lines.translated: With a light tap, the girl pushed against my chest.

lines.content: 一歩、二歩、とふらふら後退し――ホームの堅い地面に尻餅をついた。列車から降ろされたのだと、気づく。
lines.translated: I staggered backward one step, then two--and landed flat on my backside on the hard ground of the platform. I realized I had been pushed off the train.

lines.content: 大丈夫。きっと間に合うよ。……だからほら、走って。あなたの“夢”が……幸せが、あなたのことを待ってるよ
lines.translated: "It's okay. You'll definitely make it in time. ...So come on, run. Your 'dream'... your happiness is waiting for you."

lines.content: ベルが鳴る。二度目のベルだ。
lines.translated: The bell rings. It is the second bell.

lines.content: 蒸気の音と金属音。列車のドアが閉まる音。
lines.translated: The hiss of steam and the clanging of metal. The sound of the train doors closing.

lines.content: 女の子の微笑みも見えなくなり、列車は――今夜の最終便はわたしを置いて、時の終わりの駅から、“夜”の最果てへと走り出す。
lines.translated: The girl's smile disappeared from view, and the train--tonight's final departure--left me behind, pulling away from the station at the end of time toward the farthest reaches of the "Night."

lines.content: ……列車を逃した。
lines.translated: I missed the train.

lines.content: もうわたしは“[ここ|夜の国]”から外へは出られない。この“町”の“影”として永遠に、過ごしていくのだろう。
lines.translated: I can no longer leave the "Land of Night." I will probably spend eternity as one of the "shadows" of this "town."

lines.content: 今、この瞬間から少しずつ、少しずつ……。
lines.translated: Starting right now, from this very moment, little by little, bit by bit...

lines.content: わたしは、“夜”の闇色に染まっていってしまう。
lines.translated: I will be dyed in the dark colors of the "Night."

lines.content: そしていつしか“[自分|心]”をなくす。この町の“夜”の一部になる。“次”へ生まれ変わることはもうできない。
lines.translated: And before I know it, I will lose my "heart." I will become a part of this town's "Night." I can never be reborn into the "next" anymore.

lines.content: でも、今はそんなことよりも……。
lines.translated: But right now, more importantly than any of that...

lines.content: 『だって、本当は――……』
lines.translated: "'Because the truth is--...'"

lines.content: ついさっき、耳元に届けられた[・|そ][・|の][・|先][・|の][・|言][・|葉]が、わたしの中に満ちていた。
lines.translated: The words that followed, delivered right to my ear just moments ago, filled me completely.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ばかなわたしでも、囁かれた言葉の意味は理解できるよ。
lines.translated: Even someone as foolish as me can understand the meaning of those whispered words.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だから、わたしは、
lines.translated: And so, I...

lines.content: 走った。
lines.translated: I ran.

lines.content: 囁かれた言葉がうそかほんとかなんてわからない。……どうだっていい。ただ、今はどうしてもきみに逢いたい。
lines.translated: I don't know if those whispered words are a lie or the truth. ...I don't care. Right now, I just desperately want to see you.

lines.content: ……きみの腕の中に、飛び込みたい。
lines.translated: I want to leap into your arms.

lines.content: でも。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: ホームを出て、
lines.translated: Leaving the platform,

lines.content: 大勢の“命”たちで溢れる構内を駆け抜け、
lines.translated: sprinting through the concourse overflowing with a vast crowd of "lives,"

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”を飛び出し、大きな門を急いでくぐり……、
lines.translated: bursting out of the "Terminal of Time" and hurriedly passing through the great gates...

lines.content: 駅へと続く坂道を、転がるように走ったところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was practically tumbling down the sloped road leading to the station,

lines.content: ……う、うううー……っ
だめなわたしは息があがって、ふらふらしはじめ……、
lines.translated: Useless as I am, I ran out of breath and started staggering...

lines.content: 大雅……大雅……っ
lines.translated: "Taiga... Taiga...!"

lines.content: それでも、走った。
lines.translated: Even so, I kept running.

lines.content: うそ、だよね……たいが……っ
lines.translated: "It can't be true, right... Taiga...!"

lines.content: ……きみが……、ほんとは、わたしのこと…………あっ
lines.translated: "...That you... really feel that way about me... Ah!"

lines.content: 小石に躓き、転けてしまった。
lines.translated: I tripped over a pebble and fell flat on my face.

lines.content: あ、ああうううう～……っ
lines.translated: "A-Aaaaughhh~...!"

lines.content: 打ち付けた鼻先を抑える。
lines.translated: I pressed a hand to my bruised nose.

lines.content: ぽろぽろと、理由のわからない涙が溢れてきた――……だめ。こんなところでぐずぐずしてちゃだめ。行かなきゃ。
lines.translated: Tears I didn't understand the reason for came spilling out in big drops--... No. I can't be dawdling in a place like this. I have to go.

lines.content: 今すぐきみに、会いに行かなきゃ……。
lines.translated: I have to go see you right this second...

lines.content: 立ち上がろうとする。震える両足に、力を込める。
lines.translated: I tried to stand up, forcing strength into my trembling legs.

lines.content: そんなわたしを追い抜いていく影があった。
lines.translated: Just then, a figure rushed past me.

lines.content: 『……クロっ』
大雅だ。
