lines.translated: It's Taiga.

lines.content: 『……どこに行ったんだ、クロっ』
lines.translated: "'...Where did you go, Kuro?!'"

lines.content: 大雅がわたしの名前を叫び、走っていた。
lines.translated: Taiga was shouting my name as he ran.

lines.content: 『ごめん！　ごめんよっ、ほんとは、俺……っ』
lines.translated: "'I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! The truth is, I...!'"

lines.content: 大雅……っ
lines.translated: "Taiga...!"

lines.content: わたしもきみを叫んだ。
lines.translated: I shouted for you, too.

lines.content: わ、わたし、ここ……ここだよ大雅っ
lines.translated: "I-I'm here... I'm right here, Taiga!"

lines.content: 何とか立ち上がり、走って、わたしはきみの胸に飛び込んでいく――……
lines.translated: Managing to scramble to my feet, I ran and threw myself toward your chest--...

lines.content: ……あ、ぶっ
lines.translated: "...Ah, oof!"

lines.content: でも、わたしは大雅の身体を擦り抜け、固い地面に倒れ込んでしまう。
lines.translated: However, I passed right through Taiga's body and crashed onto the hard ground.

lines.content: 『……クロ……どうして……』
立ち止まった大雅は、泣いていた。
lines.translated: Having come to a stop, Taiga was crying.

lines.content: 『どうして急に、いなくなっちゃっただよ……クロ……う、うう……』
lines.translated: "'Why did you suddenly disappear... Kuro... U-Ugh...'"

lines.content: そこで気づいた。
lines.translated: That was when I realized.

lines.content: 泣いている大雅の頭に白いものがない。服装も大人のものではなくて、学園の制服だった。顔も今よりずっと、若い。
lines.translated: There was no white in the hair of the crying Taiga. His clothes weren't those of an adult, either, but a school uniform. His face was much younger than it is now, too.

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: これは……。
lines.translated: This is...

lines.content: これは“夜”に記憶された[・|い][・|つ][・|か]の時間だと、わかった。
lines.translated: I realized that this was a time from "someday" in the past, recorded within the "Night."
Why?

lines.content: ……ここに来るまでは、こんなの、見えなかったのに
lines.translated: "...Even though I couldn't see anything like this on my way here."

lines.content: どうして[・|今][・|の][・|わ][・|た][・|し]に見えるのか、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't know why the "me right now" is able to see this, though...

lines.content: わたしを呼ぶ大雅は“半透明”で……。
lines.translated: The Taiga calling out for me is "translucent"...

lines.content: わたしの呼びかけは届かない。気づかない。……きみはわたしを、抱き留めてはくれない。
lines.translated: My cries don't reach him. He doesn't notice me. ...You won't catch me in your arms.

lines.content: 『ごめん……ごめんな、クロ……、こんなの、ひどいよな』
lines.translated: "'I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, Kuro... Doing this is just awful, isn't it?'"

lines.content: 『でも……、ごめん。こうするしか、方法……なくて……。だから』
lines.translated: "'But... I'm sorry. This is... the only way... So...'"

lines.content: 『だからもう、きみを、探しちゃいけないんだ。こんなふうに名前だって呼んじゃあだめなんだ、本当は』
lines.translated: "'So I can't look for you anymore. Truth be told, I shouldn't even be calling out your name like this.'"

lines.content: 怖い誰かに言い訳するみたいにつぶやいて。
lines.translated: He murmured, as if making excuses to someone terrifying.

lines.content: 大雅は、ふらふらと立ち上がる――道を歩いていた誰かに肩がぶつかった。
lines.translated: Taiga staggered to his feet--and his shoulder bumped into someone walking down the street.

lines.content: 謝らずに行こうとしてしまった大雅を、乱暴な誰かが殴りつけていた。
lines.translated: When Taiga tried to walk on without apologizing, the violent stranger struck him down.

lines.content: 力なく倒れてしまう大雅。制服はどろどろになり、頬には痛々しい傷ができてしまう。
lines.translated: Taiga collapsed powerlessly. His uniform became caked in mud, and a painful-looking wound opened on his cheek.

lines.content: そんな大雅の格好には、見覚えがある。
lines.translated: That state of his looked familiar to me.

lines.content: 黒猫の姿できみに会いに行った一回目だ。
lines.translated: It was from the first time I went to see you in the form of a black cat.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”できみの帰りを待っていたわたしを、きみは、泣きながら抱きしめてくれた。
lines.translated: While I was waiting for you to come home at the "Bed of Dreams," you hugged me, crying.

lines.content: その涙の意味を、あのときは学校でいじめられているのかも、とわたしは考えていた。
lines.translated: Back then, I wondered if the reason for those tears was that you were being bullied at school.

lines.content: だからその傷を舐めて、きみのこと絶対護るよと、わたしは改めて誓ってた。
lines.translated: So I licked that wound and swore all over again that I would definitely protect you.

lines.content: でも、違ったんだ。
lines.translated: But I was wrong.

lines.content: 大雅はわたしを探してた。夜の街でわたしをずっと呼んでいた。……そして、こうしてひとりで泣いていた。
lines.translated: Taiga had been looking for me. He had been calling out for me endlessly through the city at night. ...And crying all by himself like this.

lines.content: ……行かないと
lines.translated: "...I have to go."

lines.content: 立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood up.

lines.content: ……約束、したんだ。きみを絶対、ぜったい、ひとりぼっちにはさせないよって
lines.translated: "...I made a promise. That I would never, ever let you be all alone."

lines.content: だからわたし、行かないと――今すぐきみの“隣”に、走って……。
lines.translated: So I have to go--I have to run to your "side" right this second...

lines.content: 一歩、
lines.translated: One step,

lines.content: また一歩、
lines.translated: And another step,

lines.content: 震える足で、進む。
lines.translated: I press forward on trembling legs.

lines.content: そんなわたしの“心”に、はらはらと花びらが舞うように、[・|い][・|つ][・|か]の記憶が降ってくる。
lines.translated: Into my "heart," memories of "someday" come drifting down like fluttering flower petals.

lines.content: ――きみは“夢”を叶えるための旅へ出る。
lines.translated: --You set out on a journey to make your "dream" come true.

lines.content: どこまでも歩いて行くきみの後ろを、わたしはこっそりついていってるつもりだった。
lines.translated: I thought I was secretly following behind you as you walked on and on.

lines.content: でも、きみにはバレバレだったんだ。そんな小さなわたしの歩幅をいつも気にしてくれていた。
lines.translated: But you saw right through me the whole time. You were always being mindful of my tiny stride.

lines.content: 『……クロ。君は本当に、かくれるのが下手だなあ』
lines.translated: "'...Kuro. You really are terrible at hiding, aren't you?'"

lines.content: 小さな……本当に小さな声で、微笑みながらつぶやいた大雅が、何気ないふうに振り向いた先。
lines.translated: Murmuring in a quiet... truly quiet voice with a smile, Taiga casually glanced back.

lines.content: 草むらから尻尾が覗いている。時どき猫の耳も見えている。
lines.translated: A tail was poking out from the bushes. Every now and then, cat ears were visible, too.

lines.content: ……恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: How embarrassing.

lines.content: それを見た大雅はまた少し、笑ってた。
lines.translated: Seeing that, Taiga chuckled a little again.

lines.content: あれで隠れてるつもりだったなんて……。ばかみたい、わたし
lines.translated: "To think I actually thought I was hiding like that... I look like such an idiot."

lines.content: どうしよう。ほんとに格好悪い。
lines.translated: What do I do? That's seriously so uncool.

lines.content: こんなの全然、気づかなかった。
lines.translated: I had no idea about any of this.

lines.content: ……大雅が少し歩いては休憩してたのは、身体がつらかっただけじゃなかったんだ。わたしがちゃんとついてこれるように、猫の歩幅で歩いてくれてた
lines.translated: "...The reason Taiga kept stopping to rest after walking a bit wasn't just because his body was aching. He was matching a cat's pace so that I could keep up with him."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: わたし達はずっと、ふたりで旅をしていたのだと知った。
lines.translated: I realized that the two of us had been traveling together all along.

lines.content: ――“大好きです”と、きれいな女の人に大雅が告白されたとき。
lines.translated: --When a beautiful woman confessed to Taiga, telling him, "I love you."

lines.content: それを申し訳なさそうな微笑みで断った後、大雅は、わたし用のお皿にご飯をいっぱいよそって、わたしの帰りをずっと待っていた。
lines.translated: After turning her down with an apologetic smile, Taiga heaped a generous portion of food onto my dish and waited endlessly for me to come home.

lines.content: わたしが勝手に、“わたしの恋は終わったの……”と泣いていたときだ。
lines.translated: That was when I had jumped to conclusions and cried to myself, thinking, "My love is over..."

lines.content: 大雅は、わたしがいつ別の柄に生まれ変わり、帰ってきてもいいようにと……。
lines.translated: Just in case I was reincarnated with a different coat pattern and came back at any moment, Taiga...

lines.content: こっそり玄関や窓をちょっと空け、子猫が滑り込めるくらいの隙間を作ってくれていた。
lines.translated: Secretly left the front door and windows cracked open, leaving just enough of a gap for a kitten to slip through.

lines.content: ――旅を終え、“夢”を叶えようとがんばっている大雅に短い手紙を書いたとき。
lines.translated: --When he finished his journey and was working hard to fulfill his "dream," I wrote him a short letter.

lines.content: 玄関先に置いておいた“おうえん、してます”という手紙と缶詰。そして花束。
lines.translated: A letter reading "I'm cheering for you" left by his front door, along with some canned food. And a bouquet of flowers.

lines.content: それを抱き上げた大雅は迷っていた。部屋に戻り、わたし宛てに返事を書いてた。
lines.translated: Scooping them up into his arms, Taiga hesitated. He went back to his room and wrote a reply addressed to me.

lines.content: でも、それをわたしに渡しちゃいけない理由があって……。
lines.translated: However, there was a reason why he mustn't give it to me...

lines.content: 『だって、本当は――……』
lines.translated: "'Because the truth is--...'"

lines.content: ナナちゃんによく似た子の囁きが蘇る。
lines.translated: The whisper of the girl who looked just like Nana-chan came back to me.

lines.content: 『……本当はね。大雅は、あなたのことを覚えてる。ただの一度だって、忘れたことはないはずだよ』
lines.translated: "'...The truth is, Taiga remembers you. He hasn't forgotten you, not even once.'"

lines.content: 全部、ぜんぶ、知らなかったよ……。大雅。
lines.translated: I didn't know... I didn't know any of it at all, Taiga.

lines.content: ……ずっと、きみがわたしのこと、忘れずいてくれてたなんて。そんなの全然、わからなかった
lines.translated: "...To think you never forgot about me all this time. I had no idea at all."

lines.content: でも、[・|そ][・|の][・|こ][・|と]を、わたしには絶対に知られてはいけない理由があって……。
lines.translated: However, there was a reason why I could never be allowed to find out about "that"...

lines.content: 『あさひさん。俺の“魔法”を使ってもらえますか』
lines.translated: "'Asahi-san. Could I ask you to use my "magic"?'"

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”の奥座敷――ここにもいつかの記憶が、“半透明”の形になって広がっていた。
lines.translated: In the back parlor of the "Bed of Dreams"--here, too, the memories of someday were spreading out in a "translucent" form.

lines.content: 『十年前に得た“魔法”の権利。その使い道を、ようやく今、思い描くことができました』
lines.translated: "'The right to use "magic" that I obtained ten years ago. Just now, I was finally able to envision how to use it.'"

lines.content: 大雅がまっすぐに見つめる先にはあさひがいる。十夜がいる。そして、みんながいる。
lines.translated: Straight ahead of Taiga's gaze was Asahi. Toya was there. And everyone else was there, too.

lines.content: 町に帰ってきたばかりの柊ハルもだ。
lines.translated: Including Hiiragi Haru, who had just returned to town.

lines.content: 『……そうか。本当に、それでいいんだな。大雅』
lines.translated: "'...I see. Are you really sure about this, Taiga?'"

lines.content: あさひが言う。
lines.translated: Asahi spoke.

lines.content: 『君の言う[・|こ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で]のことはたぶん、理解できたと思うよ――大雅。君は、本当は奏大雅ではなくて、その名を語る何者か』
lines.translated: "'I think I've probably grasped what you told us about "everything up to now"--Taiga. You aren't actually Kanade Taiga, but someone else going by that name.'"

lines.content: 『そして十年前に得た“魔法”の権利で、君が……君自身が“夜の王”となった』
lines.translated: "'And with the right to "magic" you obtained ten years ago, you... you yourself became the "King of the Night."'"

lines.content: 『そんな君のことを、人類の敵と呼び――私たちはこぞって打倒しようとしていたわけか』
lines.translated: "'Which means we called you an enemy of humanity--and were all banding together to overthrow you.'"

lines.content: これまでの経緯を、大雅はあさひだけでなく、ここにいるすべての子たちに話して聞かせたようだった――まったく、やれやれだ。と、あさひは言う。
lines.translated: It seemed Taiga had explained the whole story up to this point not just to Asahi, but to all of the girls gathered here--Good grief, what a mess, Asahi said.

lines.content: 『ひどい話だな。本当に、まったく救いようのない話だし、そんな道を歩もうとひとりで決めて。本当にひどい奴だよ。君は』
lines.translated: "'What a terrible story. It's truly, utterly beyond salvation, and yet you decided to walk such a path all on your own. You really are an awful guy.'"

lines.content: 悲しそうな顔でそう言うあさひだけれど、でも、その声には、大雅のことを責め立てようという心はひとかけらも含まれてはいない。わたしにはそう思えた。
lines.translated: Asahi wore a sorrowful expression as she said this, yet there wasn't a single shred of blame toward Taiga in her voice. Or so it seemed to me.

lines.content: 『そして今度は、大雅。君は私たち“夜のイキモノ”を生涯、忘れることのできなくなる“魔法”を、自分にかけてほしいと言うんだからな』
lines.translated: "'And now, Taiga, you're asking me to cast a "magic" spell on you that will make you unable to forget us "Creatures of the Night" for the rest of your life.'"

lines.content: 『……違います』
大雅は首を振り、言った。
lines.translated: Taiga shook his head and spoke.

lines.content: 『それは正確じゃありません。……[・|そ][・|れ]は“魔法”ではなくて、“魔法”の効果を得るための“代償”のひとつです』
lines.translated: "'That isn't quite accurate. ..."That" isn't the "magic" itself, but one of the "prices" required to obtain the effect of the "magic."'"

lines.content: 『ああ、そうだな……』
lines.translated: "'Ah, right...'"

lines.content: 『君は自分の“魔法”で“夜の王”へと成り果ててしまう代わりに、[・|今][・|回]は、あたらしい“夢”を得たんだもんな』
lines.translated: "'Instead of ending up as the "King of the Night" through your own "magic," "this time," you've found a new "dream," haven't you?'"

lines.content: 『今の君が求めるものは[・|そ][・|れ]を叶えるための“魔法”だし、だからこそ君がひとりで支払うべき“代償”、なんだよな』
lines.translated: "'What you're seeking right now is the "magic" to make "that" come true, and that's precisely why it's a "price" you have to pay all by yourself, right?'"

lines.content: 改めよう。
lines.translated: Let's take a step back.

lines.content: その“夢”を叶えるために必要な“代償”とは――
lines.translated: The "price" required to make that "dream" come true is--

lines.content: 『大人になっても俺は生涯、クロのことを忘れない。……[・|忘][・|れ][・|ら][・|れ][・|な][・|い]』
lines.translated: "'Even when I grow up, I won't forget Kuro for the rest of my life. ...I "won't be able to forget" her.'"

lines.content: ……大雅が言う。
lines.translated: Taiga said.

lines.content: 『そして、孤独であること――たったひとりでこの人生を、クロを忘れられないまま、最期まで生ききること』
lines.translated: "'And to be alone--to live out this life until the very end all by myself, unable to ever forget Kuro.'"

lines.content: それが、大雅のあたらしい“夢”を叶えるための“代償”なのだという。
lines.translated: That, he said, was the "price" to make his new "dream" come true.

lines.content: 『孤独に生きる』
lines.translated: "'To live in solitude.'"

lines.content: 『……その“代償”を支払い終えるのは、いつまでだ？』
lines.translated: "'...How long until you finish paying off that "price"?'"

lines.content: 『死が、ふたりを別つまで』
lines.translated: "'Until death do us part.'"

lines.content: それまでは決してクロを求めない。どんなに苦しくても、さみしくても、ひとりきりで生き抜いてみせる。
lines.translated: Until then, he would never seek Kuro out. No matter how painful or lonely it got, he would survive it all on his own.

lines.content: きっと、何度も迷ったり。
lines.translated: Surely, he would waver many times.

lines.content: 思わず、さみしさに飲み込まれてしまいそうになることもあるだろうけど……。
lines.translated: And there would probably be times when he would almost be swallowed up by the loneliness without meaning to, but...

lines.content: 『何年。何十年。この先俺はどれくらい生きるのかはわからないけれど……』
lines.translated: "'How many years? How many decades? I don't know how much longer I'll live from here on out, but...'"

lines.content: 『残された人生の中で――俺が大人になってしまった先の時間の中で、俺はクロのことを忘れず、想い続け、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]で一緒に生きていく』
lines.translated: "'In the life I have left--in the time ahead after I've grown into an adult, I could never forget Kuro, keep loving her, and live on together as "the two of us."'"

lines.content: 『そういった“夢”のような人生も、もしかしたら俺は俺自身の“魔法”で、叶えることができるのかもしれない。……でも』
lines.translated: "'Perhaps I could make a "dreamlike" life like that come true with my own "magic," too. ...However...'"

lines.content: でもそれじゃだめなんだ、と大雅は言う。
lines.translated: However, that wouldn't do, Taiga said.

lines.content: 『確かにそういうふうに生きていける人生は、[・|俺][・|は]、幸せです。そんな時間をもし選べるならば、もう俺はさみしいなんて感じることは一度もないはずです』
lines.translated: "'Certainly, a life lived like that would make "me" happy. If I could choose a time like that, I'm sure I would never once feel lonely again.'"

lines.content: 『けれどそれは、ただ“さよなら”を先延ばしにしただけなんだと思う』
lines.translated: "'Yet I think that would only be putting off our "goodbye."'"

lines.content: 『……俺とクロは、[・|違][・|う]。人間と猫。同じ時間の中を生きてはいけない――いいえ、同じ時間を生きていくことができなくなってしまう“イキモノ”です』
lines.translated: "'...Kuro and I are "different." A human and a cat. We are "creatures" who must not live within the same flow of time--no, who inevitably become unable to live through the same time together.'"

lines.content: 『いつか、俺には必ず“死”が訪れる』
lines.translated: "'Someday, "death" will inevitably come for me.'"

lines.content: 『……でも、“夜のイキモノ”であるクロの時間は、その先もずっと続くんです』
lines.translated: "'...But for Kuro, who is a "Creature of the Night," her time will continue on and on long after that.'"

lines.content: 『……もし俺が“君を忘れることのない魔法”を思い描き、使うことができたとしても――そんなのは俺だけが“幸せ”で、結局は、いつかクロをひとりぼっちにさせてしまう』
lines.translated: "'...Even if I could envision and use a "magic to never forget you"--that would only make me "happy," and in the end, it would leave Kuro all alone someday.'"

lines.content: そうして残されたクロは、たったひとりで、どういうふうに生きていくのだろうか。
lines.translated: Left behind like that, how would Kuro go on living all by herself?

lines.content: ……もしかしたら自ら命を絶つこともあるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps she might even take her own life.

lines.content: そんな“未来”にだけは見ない振りなんてできない。だからその“魔法”は選べないし、選ばないのだと大雅は言った。
lines.translated: That was the one "future" he couldn't pretend not to see. That was why he couldn't, and wouldn't, choose that "magic," Taiga said.

lines.content: 『……俺たちはふたり一緒の時間を、同じようなスピードで、同じような“心”を持って、生きていきたい。それが[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]の“夢”なんです』
lines.translated: "'...We want to live our time together as two, at the same pace, with the same kind of "heart." That is "our" "dream."'"

lines.content: その“夢”を叶えるために、そのための“魔法”を得るために、この“代償”が必要なのだと大雅は言った。
lines.translated: In order to make that "dream" come true, in order to obtain the "magic" for it, this "price" was necessary, Taiga said.

lines.content: 『俺はクロを忘れることなく、けれど、あえて孤独に生きていく……』
lines.translated: "'I will not forget Kuro, and yet, I will deliberately live in solitude...'"

lines.content: 『それは、本来なら、大人になった俺に。いいや、[・|俺][・|た][・|ち][・|人][・|間][・|に]忘れ去られてしまう。そんなクロの未来に、あり得たかもしれない孤独な時間だ』
lines.translated: "'Normally, she would be forgotten by me once I grew up. No, forgotten by "us humans." That is the lonely time that might have awaited Kuro in her future.'"

lines.content: 『……その“不幸”を肩代わりするようにして、ひとりぼっちで生き抜くこと』
lines.translated: "'...To survive all alone, as if taking on that "misfortune" in her place.'"

lines.content: 『そんな俺の人生が終わるまで、この誓いを護り続けられたなら。そこではじめて、やっと俺の“夢”は叶うんです』
lines.translated: "'If I can keep this vow until my life comes to an end. Only then, at last, will my "dream" finally come true.'"

lines.content: 『でももし俺が、クロを忘れていないことが、途中でクロにバレてしまったり……』
lines.translated: "'But if Kuro happens to find out along the way that I haven't forgotten her...'"

lines.content: 『もしもふとしたさみしさに負けて、こちらからクロにすべてを話してしまうようなことがあったりしたら。その途端、“魔法”は消えてなくなる』
lines.translated: "'Or if I give in to a sudden moment of loneliness and end up telling Kuro everything myself. That very instant, the "magic" will vanish into nothing.'"

lines.content: 『……誰か近しい人を作ることも同様です』
lines.translated: "'...The same goes for letting anyone else get close to me.'"

lines.content: 『俺はこれからの人生、たったひとりで生きていかなきゃならない。友人も。恋人も。……家族も。俺は持たないし、俺は、持てない』
lines.translated: "'I'll have to live the rest of my life completely alone. Friends. A lover. ...Even a family. I won't have any of them, and I can't have any of them.'"

lines.content: 『それくらいの“代償”でなければ……人生をひとつ捧げるくらいの覚悟がなければ、俺の中で、この“魔法”を得るための対価にはならなかった。そう、感じています』
lines.translated: "'I feel like... without a "price" that steep--without the resolve to offer up an entire life--it wouldn't be enough within me to serve as compensation for obtaining this "magic."'"

lines.content: その“代償”のはじまりは、ここからだ。今、ここからそれははじまる。
lines.translated: The beginning of that "price" was right here. Now, from this very spot, it would begin.

lines.content: しかし“魔法使い”のあさひがもし、それはだめだと拒否したなら、その決意は一歩前へ踏み出すことも叶わない。
lines.translated: However, if the "magician," Asahi, refused and said it wasn't allowed, that resolve wouldn't even be able to take a single step forward.

lines.content: 『どうでしょうか、あさひさん。俺を……、いいえ、俺の“魔法”を使って、俺の“夢”を叶えてくれますか』
lines.translated: "'What do you say, Asahi-san? Will you use me... no, will you use my "magic" to grant my "dream"?'"

lines.content: あさひはじっと大雅を見ている。
lines.translated: Asahi stared fixedly at Taiga.

lines.content: 黙って大雅とあさひの話を聞いていた全員も、静かに、ふたりのことを見つめていたけれど、
lines.translated: Everyone else who had been listening silently to Taiga and Asahi's conversation was also quietly watching the two of them, until--

lines.content: ハルが視線を落とし、言った。
lines.translated: Haru lowered her gaze and spoke.

lines.content: 『私も、“魔法”を使えますか。あさひさん。……その“魔法”で、私は大雅くんと出会わなかったことにしたいです』
lines.translated: "'Can I use "magic" too, Asahi-san? ...With that "magic," I'd like to make it so that I never met Taiga-kun.'"

lines.content: 『でも、この“想い”が、私たちが出会ってしまったという時間を書き換えられるほどの“魔法”になるかはわからない。……ううん。たぶん、ならない』
lines.translated: "'Though, I don't know if these "feelings" can become "magic" strong enough to rewrite the time in which we ended up meeting. ...No. They probably won't.'"

lines.content: 『大雅くん。本当は、あなたと出会ったことをなかったことにしたくはない。たぶんそんな心が、私の中のどこかにあって、“魔法”になることを嫌がると思う』
lines.translated: "'Taiga-kun. The truth is, I don't want to undo the fact that I met you. I think there's probably a part of my heart somewhere inside me that feels that way, and it'll refuse to become "magic."'"

lines.content: 『だから、お願いします。私の中にある大雅くんに関する記憶をすべて、消して、なかったことに……できますか』
lines.translated: "'So, please. Can you... erase all the memories I have of Taiga-kun inside me, and make it as if they never existed?'"

lines.content: 私たちは、出会えた――そんな事実だけは消すことなく、記憶だけを消せますか……。
lines.translated: Without erasing the sole fact that we were able to meet--could you erase only the memories...?

lines.content: 『これからずっと孤独に生きる。友人も……恋人も、家族も、作らない。大雅くんの支払うその“代償”に、協力することになると思うから』
lines.translated: "'He's going to live in solitude forever from here on out. He won't make friends... or have a lover, or a family. And I think doing this will help him pay that "price" of his.'"

lines.content: 『……ああ、わかった。ハルの“魔法”はハルだけのものだ。ハル自身がそれを望むならたぶん、可能だよ』
lines.translated: "'...Yeah, I understand. Haru's "magic" belongs to Haru alone. If you wish for it yourself, Haru, then it's probably possible.'"

lines.content: あさひの言葉を受け、ハルはそれを噛みしめるようにうなずく。
lines.translated: Hearing Asahi's words, Haru nodded as if letting them sink in.

lines.content: 『クロちゃんが大雅くんの“隣”にいるのなら、全部、安心できる。ここから私の出番はきっとない。……だから私は、私だけの、あたらしい人生を探すよ』
lines.translated: "'As long as Kuro-chan is "by Taiga-kun's side," I don't have to worry about a thing. I'm sure there's no role left for me to play from here on out. ...So I'll go look for a new life of my very own.'"

lines.content: ありがとう、さよなら……いっぱいの“想い”をありがとう、と、ハルはさみしそうに、笑っていた。
lines.translated: Thank you, goodbye... thank you for all these "feelings," Haru seemed to say, smiling wistfully.

lines.content: 千和も姫織も、智仁も。
lines.translated: Chiwa, Himeori, and Tomohito, too.

lines.content: 互いに見つめ合い、うなずき合っている――きっと、ここにいる誰もがみんな、大雅のことを忘れてしまうのだろう。
lines.translated: They looked at one another and nodded--surely, everyone here was going to forget all about Taiga.

lines.content: 『ごめん。……ごめんみんな』
lines.translated: "'I'm sorry. ...I'm sorry, everyone.'"

lines.content: 大雅が震える拳を強く、握り、言った。
lines.translated: Taiga clenched his trembling fists tightly and spoke.

lines.content: 『何度も、何度もだ。自分の心の中にある“魔法”に問いかけたんだよ。本当に――本当に、[・|こ][・|う][・|す][・|る][・|以][・|外]、“夢”を叶える方法は――そのための“代償”は、ないのかって』
lines.translated: "'Over and over again. I asked the "magic" inside my own heart. Is there really--really no other way to make my "dream" come true, no other "price" for it, EXCEPT BY DOING THIS?'"

lines.content: 大雅の“魔法”は――そこに通ずる“夜”の返答は、決まって、こうだ――……“ああ、それしかない。そうすることしか、その“夢”とは釣り合わない”
lines.translated: Taiga's "magic"--and the answer from the "Night" connected to it--was always the same: "...Yes, that is the only way. Nothing else could ever balance the scales with that 'dream.'"

lines.content: だからこうする以外に道はなかった。
lines.translated: That was why there was no other path besides doing this.

lines.content: 『ごめん……』
lines.translated: "'I'm sorry...'"

lines.content: 大雅は繰り返し、言う。何度も“ごめん”と――それはこの最愛の友人たちが、自分のために必ずたくさん、たくさん悲しんでくれることを知っているからだ。
lines.translated: Taiga repeated it over and over. Saying "I'm sorry" again and again--because he knew that his dearest friends would inevitably grieve so, so much for his sake.

lines.content: 『本当に、ごめん。……みんな』
lines.translated: "'I'm truly sorry. ...Everyone.'"

lines.content: 『勝手な俺を許してとは、言えない。だから、[・|忘][・|れ][・|な][・|い][・|よ]――……今日からは他人だ。もし町で見かけても、声は掛けられないけど。もう、昔みたいに一緒に騒げないけど』
lines.translated: "'I can't ask you to forgive me for being so selfish. That's why I WON'T FORGET--...Starting today, we're strangers. Even if I see you in town, I won't be able to call out to you. Even though we can't fool around together like we used to anymore.'"

lines.content: 『……俺だけその輪に、入れないけれど』
lines.translated: "'...Even though I'll be the only one who can't join your circle.'"

lines.content: 『みんなのことも、絶対……』
lines.translated: "'I'll never, ever...'"

lines.content: 『ああ……みんなと笑って楽しかったあのときも、みんなといられて、うれしかった、あのことも……、ぜったい、ぜったい俺は、忘れず生きていく。死ぬまで、ずっとだ』
lines.translated: "'Yeah... Those fun times I spent laughing with all of you, and how happy I was just to be with you... I'll never, ever forget any of it for as long as I live. All the way until the day I die.'"

lines.content: 千和は泣いて。
lines.translated: Chiwa was crying.

lines.content: 姫織は目を閉じ。
lines.translated: Himeori closed her eyes.

lines.content: 智仁は、唇を噛みしめている。
lines.translated: Tomohito was biting his lip.

lines.content: もうそこに言葉はないけれど、でも、言葉にはできないいっぱいの“想い”が、心が、わたしには見えた気がした。
lines.translated: There were no more words left there, and yet, I felt as though I could see their hearts, brimming with unspoken "feelings."

lines.content: 『……さあ、大雅。君の“魔法”を使おうか』
lines.translated: "'...Now then, Taiga. Shall we use your "magic"?'"

lines.content: あさひは言う。そのための“許可”を君に出そう、と。
lines.translated: Asahi spoke, telling him she would grant him "permission" for it.

lines.content: 『でもその代わり、ひとつ私の望みも叶えてほしい』
lines.translated: "'But in exchange, there's one wish of mine I want you to grant, too.'"

lines.content: 『今日、ここで行われた話や、これから先の話を全部、クロ自身にも知る権利というか、そのための機会を作りたい――死がふたりを別つまで、だったよな。“代償”の支払いは』
lines.translated: "'Everything we talked about here today, and everything that will happen from here on out--I want to give Kuro herself the right to know, or rather, create an opportunity for her to learn about it. ...Paying the "price" is until death do you part, right?'"

lines.content: 『改めるけれど、そのときクロに、今日、このとき私たちが話したことを知らせたいんだ――“夜”の中に記録され続けているのだろう、私たちが話しているこのときを、クロに見せたい』
lines.translated: "'To put it formally, when that time comes, I want to let Kuro know what we talked about here today--I want to show Kuro this moment of us talking, which is surely being recorded within the "Night" as we speak.'"

lines.content: あさひは大雅の返答を待つことなく、言う。
lines.translated: Without waiting for Taiga's reply, Asahi continued.

lines.content: 『……人生は最期の瞬間、何を感じ、何を思うかによってその価値は決まると、そういうふうに書かれてた本があったんだ』
lines.translated: "'...There was a book I read that said the value of a life is determined by what you feel and what you think in your very final moments.'"

lines.content: 『ああ、なるほど。そういう考えは言ってしまえば暴論だし、それがすべてじゃなくとも、それでもなんだか悪くはない。そう思った』
lines.translated: "'Ah, I see. Put bluntly, that kind of thinking is a bit extreme, and even if it's not the whole truth, I still thought it wasn't half bad.'"

lines.content: 『[・|そ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で]がどんなに不幸でも、最期の瞬間、一瞬でもぱっと曇り空が晴れるような想いを持てればそれで幸せ――』
lines.translated: "'No matter how unfortunate your life UP UNTIL THEN may be, if in your final moments you can hold onto a feeling like a cloudy sky suddenly clearing up, even for just an instant, then that makes it a happy life--'"

lines.content: 『だからふたりには、最期、産まれて来れてよかったと。せめてそんな気持ちになっていてほしい』
lines.translated: "'That's why, at the very end, I want the two of you to at least feel glad that you were born.'"

lines.content: 『……[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]まで君と同じように、孤独に生きるのだろうクロに伝えたいんだ。これまでの孤独には、これまで続いた不幸なことには、ちゃんと意味があったんだよって』
lines.translated: "'...I want to tell Kuro, who will likely live in solitude just like you UNTIL THAT TIME COMES, that all the loneliness up until now, and all the misfortune that dragged on for so long, truly had meaning.'"

lines.content: 『それを、大雅。君が受け入れてくれるのなら、私も君の要望を受け入れようと思う。“孤独”になるための君の“魔法”を、今、ここで使おう』
lines.translated: "'If you can accept that, Taiga, then I will accept your request as well. Let's use your "magic" to embrace "solitude" right here, right now.'"

lines.content: 大雅は言葉の代わりに深くうなずき、差し出されていたあさひの手を取り、力強く握り返した。
lines.translated: Instead of words, Taiga gave a deep nod, took Asahi's outstretched hand, and squeezed it firmly back.

lines.content: そうして叶えられようとしている大雅の“夢”とは、いったい、どんなものだったのだろう。
lines.translated: Just what kind of "dream" was Taiga trying to make come true like this?

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]には、わたしの疑問に答えてくれるだけのものは見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: Right HERE, there was nothing to be found that could answer my question.

lines.content: ――その[・|記][・|録]は、次の日にも続いていた。
lines.translated: --That RECORD continued on into the next day.

lines.content: 『……クロ。君に伝えたいことがある。おそらくいつか、君はこれを見ることになるだろうと思うから』
lines.translated: "'...Kuro. There's something I want to tell you. Because I think that someday, you'll probably end up watching this.'"

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”の奥座敷。あさひが誰もいない空間に向かい、まるでカメラを前にするみたいにして、話している。
lines.translated: The back room of the "Bed of Dreams." Asahi was facing an empty space, speaking as if she were standing in front of a camera.

lines.content: そんな記憶が、過去の時間が、“夜”の空間に再生され続けていた。
lines.translated: That memory, that time from the past, kept playing out within the space of the "Night."

lines.content: 『もうあまり時間もないので簡潔に話すよ』
lines.translated: "'I don't have much time left, so I'll keep this brief.'"

lines.content: 『[・|こ][・|れ]はこの時間と空間に記録した、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]から君へ宛てた手紙のようなものだ。最後にどうしても言っておきたいことがあったから、これを残すよ』
lines.translated: "'THIS is like a letter addressed to you from US, recorded into this time and space. There was something I absolutely had to tell you at the very end, so I'm leaving this behind.'"

lines.content: 『[・|君]は、ナナちゃんから“切符”を受け取ったはずだ。私が[・|こ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]ナナちゃんにそうお願いするつもりだ。何か不都合なことが起きない限り、そうなってるはずだよ』
lines.translated: "'YOU should have received a "ticket" from Nana-chan. I'm going to ask Nana-chan to do that for me FROM HERE ON OUT. Barring any unforeseen problems, that's how it should have played out.'"

lines.content: 『その“切符”をよく見て欲しい。君がナナちゃんに渡したのとは違うものになってるはずだ。ナナちゃんにすり替えてもらうようにと頼もうと思ってる』
lines.translated: "'I want you to take a close look at that "ticket." It should be different from the one you handed over to Nana-chan. I'm planning to ask Nana-chan to swap them out.'"

lines.content: そういえば握りしめたままだった。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, I had been clutching it tight this whole time.

lines.content: 力いっぱい握った“切符”は、くしゃくしゃに丸まっていたけれど――確かにそうだ。わたしが購入したものとは違うと一目でわかった。
lines.translated: The "ticket" I had been gripping with all my might was crumpled up, but--it was true. I could tell at a glance that it was different from the one I had purchased.

lines.content: 『……それは“命”の“切符”だ』
lines.translated: "'...That is a "ticket" of "life."'"

lines.content: いつかのあさひがそう言った。
lines.translated: Asahi, from somewhen in the past, said so.

lines.content: 『私たちの“命”を[・|そ][・|こ]に込めた』
lines.translated: "'We poured our "lives" INTO IT.'"

lines.content: 『“命”をなくしたものは“夜”から外へ出ることができない。基本的には。“外の世界”は“命”あるものの世界だからだ』
lines.translated: "'Those who have lost their "lives" cannot leave the "Night." Under normal circumstances, at least. Because the "outside world" is a world for those who have "life."'"

lines.content: 『……だからその“切符”に込められた“命”を使って、外へ出るんだ』
lines.translated: "'...So use the "life" poured into that "ticket" to go outside.'"

lines.content: 『大雅には黙っていたけれど、クロ、どうせ君のことだ。九つある“命”を全部、使い果たしてしまったんだろう。だから[・|そ][・|う][・|し][・|て]、大雅よりも先に“命”が果てた。そうだよな？』
lines.translated: "'I kept quiet about it in front of Taiga, but knowing you, Kuro, you've probably used up all nine of your "lives" anyway, haven't you? And SO, your "life" ran out before Taiga's did. Am I right?'"

lines.content: 『もし大雅の“命”が先に尽きれば、今君が体験しているのと同じようなことが、大雅にも起きるようにと、大雅の“魔法”に“許可”を出したとき仕込んでおいた』
lines.translated: "'When I granted "permission" for Taiga's "magic," I set things up so that if Taiga's "life" happened to run out first, he would experience something similar to what you're going through right now.'"

lines.content: 『大雅にも今まで君が、……クロが、どういうふうにして大雅のことを助け続けてきたのかを、最期のときに知らせようと思ってた』
lines.translated: "'In his final moments, I intended to let Taiga know how you... how Kuro had kept on saving him all this time.'"

lines.content: 『でも可能性としては、クロ。君が先に“命”を終えるほうが高いだろうと思ってる』
lines.translated: "'But in terms of likelihood, Kuro, I think the chances are higher that your "life" will end first.'"

lines.content: 『そして君の命が尽きるとき、大雅の人生もまた、君のことを追いかけるようにして終わりを迎えることになっている』
lines.translated: "'And when your life runs out, Taiga's life is also set to come to an end, as if chasing after you.'"

lines.content: 『そうして人生をかけた大雅の“代償”の支払いも、そこでようやく終わるんだ。そうなるようにと、大雅自身が願ったからね』
lines.translated: "'With that, Taiga's lifelong payment of his "price" will finally come to an end. Because that's how Taiga himself wished for it to be.'"

lines.content: 『だけどもしも万が一、大雅の命が先に尽きたのなら。この手紙は開かれることのないまま、時間と空間の中に埋もれていくだけだろう』
lines.translated: "'However, on the off chance that Taiga's life runs out first, this letter will probably just be buried in time and space without ever being opened.'"

lines.content: 『そのときは君らふたりが“夜”の中で再会し、それまであったことを話し合えればいいなと願うよ。大雅の口で事実を君に告げて、大雅自身の手で“夢”を叶える。そうなればいい』
lines.translated: "'If that happens, I hope the two of you can reunite within the "Night" and talk over everything that happened up until then. For Taiga to tell you the truth with his own lips, and make his "dream" come true with his own hands. I'd be glad if it turned out that way.'"

lines.content: 『改めて言うよ。その“切符”に[・|私][・|た][・|ち]の“命”を込めた。クロ。それを使って、大切な人に会いに行け』
lines.translated: "'I'll say it again. We poured OUR "lives" into that "ticket." Kuro. Use it, and go see the person who is precious to you.'"

lines.content: 『君の“命”が尽きたとき、大雅は自分の“命”も尽きるようにと確かに願ったけれど……』
lines.translated: "'It's true that Taiga wished for his own "life" to run out when yours did, however...'"

lines.content: 『申し合わせたようにまったく同時にというわけにはいかない。本来人の“命”は、そこにどんな“奇跡”があったとしても一瞬でなかったことにできるほど弱い存在じゃないからね』
lines.translated: "'It won't happen at the exact same instant as if on cue. By nature, a human "life" isn't something so fragile that it can be snuffed out in an instant, no matter what kind of "miracle" is involved.'"

lines.content: 『……そして“命”を失った存在が“夜”の中に留まっていられるのは、一週間だけだ』
lines.translated: "'...And a being who has lost their "life" can only remain within the "Night" for a single week.'"

lines.content: 『大雅の“魔法”に“許可”を出したとき、たぶん[・|す][・|れ][・|違][・|い]が起きるだろうなと感じてた。一週間の猶予内に大雅の“命”は尽きるだろうか。……いや。きっとそうはならないなって』
lines.translated: "'When I granted "permission" for Taiga's "magic," I had a feeling the two of you would probably MISS EACH OTHER. Would Taiga's "life" run out within that one-week grace period? ...No. I figured it surely wouldn't happen that fast.'"

lines.content: 『このままだとクロ、君は大雅の願ったものを知ることのないまま、列車に乗るか――“夜”の一部になっているだろうなと思った』
lines.translated: "'At this rate, Kuro, I thought you'd probably either board the train or become a part of the "Night" without ever knowing what Taiga wished for.'"

lines.content: だからその“切符”をナナちゃんに託すことにする。とあさひは言う――もちろん大雅には秘密でね、と。たぶん大雅が知るといい顔なんてするはずがないからねとも、言っていた。
lines.translated: That was why she decided to entrust that "ticket" to Nana-chan, Asahi said--keeping it a secret from Taiga, of course. She also added that if Taiga found out, there was no way he would be happy about it.

lines.content: 『そうだろう？　クロ。どうせ最終便が出るまでずっと、“[ここ|夜]”に残るか、それとも“次”へ旅立つか――君は散々悩んでいたんだろう？』
lines.translated: "'Isn't that right, Kuro? Knowing you, you've been agonizing endlessly right up until the final train departs over whether to stay here in the "Night" or set off on a journey to the "next," haven't you?'"

lines.content: 『なあ、クロ。今、君がこれを見ているということは、少しずつすこしずつ、大雅は死を受け入れている最中だと思う。本来ならすれ違ったままだったかもしれないけれど……』
lines.translated: "'Hey, Kuro. The fact that you're watching this right now means that, little by little, Taiga is in the middle of accepting death. Ordinarily, you two might have just missed each other completely, but...'"

lines.content: 『だけど今ならまだ、きっと間に合う。君が大雅のことを迎えに行ってあげてほしい』
lines.translated: "'Right now, it's surely still not too late. I want you to go and meet Taiga to welcome him.'"

lines.content: 『……それに。どちらか片方の“命”が尽きたのなら。死がふたりを別れさせたのなら。もう、うそをつく必要はないよ。大雅は“代償”を支払い終えているはずだ』
lines.translated: "'...Besides. If one of your "lives" has already run out. If death has parted the two of you. Then there's no need to tell lies anymore. Taiga should have finished paying his "price."'"

lines.content: 『だから人生最期のときを、大切に想う人と一緒に過ごして欲しい。そうしてそれは、せめて“産まれて来れてよかった”と思えるような時間になれればいいと願ってる』
lines.translated: "'So I want you to spend the final moments of your life together with the person you hold dear. And I hope that it can at least become a time where you both feel glad to have been born.'"

lines.content: そこまで一気に話して、あさひは僅かな沈黙を挟んだ後、言った。
lines.translated: Having spoken all of that in one breath, Asahi paused in brief silence before continuing.

lines.content: 『私たちはそろそろ行くよ。列車が出る時間だ』
lines.translated: "'It's about time for us to go. It's time for the train to depart.'"

lines.content: 『その“切符”には私と十夜、ふたり分の“命”が詰まってる』
lines.translated: "'That "ticket" is packed with two "lives" worth--mine and Toya's.'"

lines.content: 『……でも所詮、君にとっては他人の“命”だ。ふたり分だろうとなんだろうと、“外”に出られるのは数分程度だろうと思う』
lines.translated: "'...Even so, at the end of the day, they're still someone else's "lives" to you. Whether it's two lives' worth or whatever else, I think you'll only be able to go "outside" for a few minutes at best.'"

lines.content: 『私たちは君と違って“命”はひとつきりしかない種類の猫だからね。……たったひとつの“命”をそこに込めたんだから、もう“次”へ旅立たなきゃいけない』
lines.translated: "'Unlike you, we're the kind of cats that only have a single "life," after all. ...Since we poured our one and only "lives" into that ticket, we have to set off for the "next" now.'"

lines.content: 『クロ。君にも大雅にも、直接お別れが言えなかったことはさみしく思うけど、十夜も、私も、こうすることに後悔はしていないよ』
lines.translated: "'Kuro. I do feel a bit lonely that we couldn't say goodbye to you and Taiga in person, but neither Toya nor I have any regrets about doing this.'"

lines.content: 『むしろこういう“命”の使い道を選べる自分たちのことをどこか誇らしくさえ思ってる。そんな私たちのお節介を、どうか受け取ってくれたらうれしく思うよ』
lines.translated: "'If anything, we're actually kind of proud of ourselves for being able to choose to use our "lives" this way. So I'd be happy if you would please accept this meddling of ours.'"

lines.content: 『お姉ちゃん、準備できた？』
lines.translated: "'Onee-chan, are you ready?'"

lines.content: 十夜だ。大きな鞄を両手に抱え、座敷に入ってきた。
lines.translated: It was Toya. Holding a large bag in both hands, she walked into the room.

lines.content: 『ああ、うん。私はばっちりだよ。もう忘れ物はないかな十夜』
lines.translated: "'Ah, yeah. I'm all set. Are you sure you haven't forgotten anything, Toya?'"

lines.content: 『うん、大丈夫』
lines.translated: "'Yep, I'm good.'"

lines.content: うなずいて、十夜は鞄をごそごそさせ、
lines.translated: Toya nodded and rummaged around in her bag,

lines.content: 『あ、トランプ忘れてた！』
lines.translated: "'Oh, I forgot the playing cards!'"

lines.content: 『そんなもの持って行ってどうするんだ？』
lines.translated: "'What are you going to do bringing something like that along?'"

lines.content: 『列車の中でお姉ちゃんとするの。ナナちゃんも一緒に』
lines.translated: "'Play with you on the train, Onee-chan. With Nana-chan, too.'"

lines.content: そんないつかのふたりを前に、わたしは“どうして？”と、思う。
lines.translated: Looking at the two of them from somewhen in the past, I thought to myself, "Why?"

lines.content: 『……どうして。わたしに、わたし達に、そこまでしてくれるの』
lines.translated: "'...Why? Why are you going so far for me... for us?'"

lines.content: 大雅とわたしが、ちゃんと出会えるように……最期の時間を過ごせるように――
lines.translated: Just so that Taiga and I could properly reunite... so that we could spend our final moments together--

lines.content: そんな一瞬をわたし達に贈るため、どうして自分の“命”を差し出せるのか。どうして、そこまでできるのか。
lines.translated: Why would they offer up their own "lives" just to gift us a single moment like that? How could they go that far?

lines.content: 『そんなの決まってるよ』
lines.translated: "'Isn't that obvious?'"

lines.content: 『今、君は“どうして？”と思ったろう？　違うかな？　う～ん、何となくそう思ったけど、違ったら恥ずかしいな。まあ、うん。[・|そ][・|う]だと想定して話すけど……』
lines.translated: "'Just now, you thought "Why?", didn't you? Or am I wrong? Hmmm, I just kind of had a feeling, though it'd be pretty embarrassing if I guessed wrong. Well, yeah. I'll keep talking assuming that IS what you thought, though...'"

lines.content: 『世界を救ったり。大勢の命を護ったり……そういった何か大きな物事が達成されるその裏では、必ずだ』
lines.translated: "'Saving the world. Protecting the lives of many... Behind the scenes of any grand accomplishment like that, it's a certainty.'"

lines.content: 『必ず、誰にも知られず、誰にも見向きもされず、決して報われることなく……それでも』
lines.translated: "'There is always someone unknown to all, noticed by none, who will never be rewarded... and yet.'"

lines.content: 『それでも、“世界を救うヒーローの物語”が上手くいくようにと願い、彼らを助けようとする“誰か”がいるはずだ』
lines.translated: "'And yet, there is surely "someone" out there wishing for the "story of the hero who saves the world" to go well, trying to help them along.'"

lines.content: 『そういった名もない小さな“命”にだって、報われるときがあってもいい。そのお話を見つめる誰かがいてもいい。最期のときくらい、幸せになってもいい』
lines.translated: "'Even those nameless, tiny "lives" deserve to have a moment where they are rewarded. It's okay for there to be someone watching over their story. At the very end, at least, it's okay for them to find happiness.'"

lines.content: 『だから私は、こうしたいと思った――……なんてね』
lines.translated: "'That's why I wanted to do this--...or something like that.'"

lines.content: 『そういうふうに、格好付けたような言い方はいくらでもできるだろうけど……』
lines.translated: "'I suppose I could come up with as many cool-sounding excuses like that as I want, but...'"

lines.content: 『なんだかんだ理屈をつけても、つまるところ理由なんてひとつだよ。いつだって、大切に思えるものには簡単な理由がひとつ、あるだけなんだ』
lines.translated: "'No matter what kind of logic you dress it up in, when it comes down to it, there's only ever one reason. Whenever you hold something dear, there's only ever one simple reason behind it.'"

lines.content: あさひは微笑み、言った。
lines.translated: Asahi smiled and spoke.

lines.content: 『君たちのことが大切だからだ』
lines.translated: "'It's because you two are precious to us.'"

lines.content: 『……君たちのことが、大好きだからだ』
lines.translated: "'...Because we love you both so much.'"

lines.content: 『そんな君らが何か、今、大きな苦しみの中にあるのなら、どんな犠牲を払ってでも応援したいと願うし、全力で、惜しみなく、力を貸したいと思うんだよ』
lines.translated: "'If the two of you are in the middle of some great suffering right now, then we want to cheer you on no matter the sacrifice, and we want to lend you our strength with everything we have, holding nothing back.'"

lines.content: 『“がんばれ。もう少しだ。負けるなよ。でも、ちゃんと休めよ、お願いだから。意地悪で、身勝手で、苦しんでる者の心を知ろうともしない。そんな誰かの言葉に飲まれちゃだめだよ”』
lines.translated: "'"Hang in there. Just a little further. Don't give up. But please, make sure you get some rest. Don't let yourself be swallowed up by the words of someone spiteful and selfish who doesn't even try to understand the hearts of those who are suffering."'"

lines.content: 『……そんなふうに、いつも君に語りかけている見えない“想い”が、いつだって、誰にだって、[隣|側]にあるんだと信じてる』
lines.translated: "'...I believe that invisible "feelings" speaking to you like that are always, for everyone, right there by your side.'"

lines.content: 『だから、この世界に生まれた“命”は、みんな……』
lines.translated: "'That's why every "life" born into this world, everyone...'"

lines.content: 『みんな。それがどんなに不可能に思えることであっても、それが君に必要であると思うなら、いつか必ず乗り越えられるし、どんな“夢”でも叶えることができるだろう』
lines.translated: "'Everyone. No matter how impossible something may seem, if you believe it is something you truly need, you will surely overcome it someday, and you'll be able to make any "dream" come true.'"

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。何度だって言うぞ、とあさひは笑う。
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I'll say it as many times as it takes," Asahi laughed.

lines.content: 『……だって、ほら。君の“隣”には、君のことを大切に想うたくさんの人の、たくさんの“想い”が、いつも君のことを助けられる瞬間を夢見て、寄り添っているんだから』
lines.translated: "'...Because, look. Right "beside" you, the countless "feelings" of the many people who hold you dear are altijd snuggled up close, dreaming of the moment they can be of help to you.'"

lines.content: 『たとえその姿が見えなくたって。応援の声が聞こえなくたって。繋いだ手と手に、触れられなくたって。それは、事実だ』
lines.translated: "'Even if you can't see their forms. Even if you can't hear their voices cheering you on. Even if you can't feel the warmth of their hands holding yours. That is a fact.'"

lines.content: 『その“切符”はね、そんな“想い”を込めた贈り物だよ』
lines.translated: "'That "ticket" is a gift packed with those exact "feelings."'"

lines.content: 『それにさ、私たちはもう充分生きた。いっぱい、いっぱい、大切に想う人と出会い、“さよなら”を重ねてきた。その度に、“お願い、置いて行かないで”と、悲しく思っていたんだよ』
lines.translated: "'Besides, we've already lived plenty long enough. We've met so, so many people we held dear, and we've piled up one "goodbye" after another. And every single time, we felt so sad, thinking, "Please, don't leave us behind."'"

lines.content: 『……私たちは人間を大切に思わずにはいられない“イキモノ”だ』
lines.translated: "'...We are "Creatures" that simply cannot help holding humans dear.'"

lines.content: 『でも。それなのに……。大切に想ったその人とは決して、同じ時間を生きることができない。こんなに、……こんなに、さみしいことは他にない』
lines.translated: "'But. Even so... We can never live through the same time as the people we come to cherish. There is nothing... nothing else as lonely as that.'"

lines.content: 『……さみしいのはもう充分だ。去って行った大切な人たちを想い、悲しくなる夜はつらいんだ。もう、泣きたくない。だからさ、今度はこっちから“さよなら”をする番なんだよ』
lines.translated: "'...We've had enough of being lonely. The nights spent growing sad as we think of the precious people who left us behind are just too painful. I don't want to cry anymore. So you see, this time, it's our turn to be the ones saying "goodbye" first.'"

lines.content: あさひは悪戯っぽく笑っていた。
lines.translated: Asahi smiled mischievously.

lines.content: 『それじゃあな。残された時間を精一杯、幸せに』
lines.translated: "'Well then, see ya. Live out the time you have left as happily as you possibly can.'"

lines.content: 『またいつか、[・|今]とは違う“[形|命]”で、私たちが悠久なる時のどこかで出会えることを、祈ってる――……なんて、な。ふふ、どうかな十夜。お姉ちゃん、キマってた？』
lines.translated: "'I pray that someday, in a different "life" than the one we have NOW, we'll be able to meet again somewhere in the eternal flow of time--...or something like that, right? Hehe, how was that, Toya? Did your big sister nail it?'"

lines.content: 『もう、そんなのいいから。まったくいつまでも恥ずかしいばっかりなお姉ちゃんだよ』
lines.translated: "'Geez, enough of that already. Honestly, you're just an endlessly embarrassing big sister through and through.'"

lines.content: ごめんね、クロちゃん。こんなお姉ちゃんを許してね、と十夜が言う。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Kuro-chan. Please forgive my big sister for being like this," Toya said.

lines.content: 『……私たちあんまりお話、したことなかったけど。次は今よりもっとお友だちになれたらうれしいな。……バイバイ。またね。大雅のこと、よろしくね』
lines.translated: "'...We never really got to talk all that much, did we? Next time, I'd be really happy if we could become even better friends than we are now. ...Bye-bye. See you later. Take good care of Taiga, okay?'"

lines.content: そうしてふたりは大きな荷物を両手に抱え、じゃれ合うように微笑み合って、旅立っていった。
lines.translated: And with that, the two of them held their large bags in both hands, smiled playfully at each other, and set off on their journey.

lines.content: わたしの手には、小さな“切符”の形をした“想い”がある。
lines.translated: In my hand was a set of "feelings" that had taken the shape of a small "ticket."

lines.content: 涙がこぼれそうになった。
lines.translated: Tears threatened to spill from my eyes.

lines.content: 自分のことを想ってくれる“誰か”がそばにいる。自分のことを、持てる力のすべてを使って応援し、力を貸してくれようとする“誰か”がいる。
lines.translated: There was "someone" right beside me who cared about me. There was "someone" cheering me on with every ounce of strength they had, trying to lend me their power.

lines.content: それを知ることができただけで、どうして、こんなに胸の奥がぎゅっとするのか……わからない。
lines.translated: Just being able to know that... I didn't understand why it made the depths of my chest ache so tightly.

lines.content: わからないけれど、いつかこの想いを理解したいと願ってる。
lines.translated: I didn't understand, yet I wished that someday I would be able to comprehend these feelings.

lines.content: でも今はきっと、泣いてる時間はないはずだ。
lines.translated: But right now, I surely didn't have time to be crying.

lines.content: 渡された“命”を今、使おう。
lines.translated: I would use the "life" that had been handed to me, right here and now.

lines.content: そして君に会いに行こう――何を話そう。最期に君と、どんな時間を過ごせばいい？
lines.translated: And I would go to see you--What should I say? How should I spend my final moments with you?

lines.content: 今まで考えてきたことの中で、それは最も簡単なことで、最も、難しいことのように思えた。
lines.translated: Out of everything I had ever thought about until now, that seemed like the simplest thing of all, and yet the most difficult.

lines.content: 光りだ……。
lines.translated: It's light...

lines.content: “切符”を握りしめた手の中から、強い光が輝いて――わたしは思わず目を閉じる。
lines.translated: From within the hand clutching the "ticket" tight, a brilliant light shone forth--and I instinctively closed my eyes.

lines.content: 『……ああ、そうそう。ひとつ言い忘れてた』
lines.translated: "'...Ah, right, right. There was one thing I forgot to mention.'"

lines.content: 閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の向こうからあさひの声が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: From beyond my closed eyelids, I heard Asahi's voice.

lines.content: 『大雅が、自分の人生を“代償”に捧げてまで叶えたかった“夢”。それを君に伝え忘れてた』
lines.translated: "'The "dream" that Taiga wanted to fulfill, even if it meant offering up his own life as the "price." I forgot to tell you what it was.'"

lines.content: 『……大雅本人から口にするのが筋なのかもしれないけれど。まあ、いいだろう。自分からは言い出しづらいってこともあるかもしれないしね』
lines.translated: "'...Maybe it would be more proper for Taiga to tell you himself, though. Well, it should be fine. It might be a little hard for him to bring it up on his own, after all.'"

lines.content: 大雅がどうしても叶えたいと願ったもの。
lines.translated: The thing that Taiga had wished to fulfill no matter what.

lines.content: 『それはね――……』
lines.translated: "'You see, it's--...'"

lines.content: 同じ時間を生きたい。
lines.translated: I want to live through the same time as you.

lines.content: 同じ“命”になりたい。
lines.translated: I want to become the same kind of "life" as you.

lines.content: ……全部きみと、同じになりたいんだよ。
lines.translated: I want everything about me to become the same as you.

lines.content: そんなわたしの――
lines.translated: Those wishes of mine--

lines.content: 『――……クロ。君の“夢”をすべて、叶えることだ』
lines.translated: "'--...Kuro. It was to make all of your "dreams" come true.'"

lines.content: どうか褒めてあげてほしい。
lines.translated: Please, make sure you praise him for it.

lines.content: あさひは言った。
lines.translated: Asahi said so.

lines.content: 『そのために大雅は長い、とてもながい時の中を、たったひとりでがんばったんだから』
lines.translated: "'Because for the sake of that, Taiga did his very best, all on his own, through a long, terribly long stretch of time.'"

lines.content: そんな言葉と共に光りが晴れた。
lines.translated: Along with those words, the light cleared away.

lines.content: わたしは、いつの間にか大雅の部屋に立っている。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was standing in Taiga's room.

lines.content: 大雅が眠っていた。
lines.translated: Taiga was sleeping.

lines.content: もうすっかり痩せて、年老いて……。
lines.translated: He had grown completely thin and frail, and so very old...

lines.content: 手も、頬も、額にも、深い皺が刻まれて。
lines.translated: Deep wrinkles were carved into his hands, his cheeks, and his forehead.

lines.content: 頭にはもう、黒い部分を探すことのほうが難しい。
lines.translated: On his head, it was already harder to find any strands of black left.

lines.content: でも、そのすべては、これまで生きてきた中で芽生えた、たくさんの“想い”の形なのだとわたしは感じた。
lines.translated: Even so, I felt that all of it was the shape of the countless "feelings" that had budded within him throughout the life he had lived until now.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: 名前を呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called his name.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで眠るきみの手を、わたしは握った。それだけで、どうしよう。涙が出るよ。だって、ずっとずっと、こうしたかったから。きみに、触れたかったから。
lines.translated: I took hold of your hand as you slept all alone. Just from doing that, what do I do? The tears are coming out. Because I've wanted to do this for so, so long. Because I wanted to touch you.

lines.content: ……わたし、帰ってきたよ……大雅
lines.translated: "...I'm back... Taiga."

lines.content: たくさんのひとの気持ちや、祈りや、それだけではないたくさんのものを借りて、きみのところに帰って来れた。
lines.translated: Borrowing the feelings and prayers of so many people, and so many other things beyond just that, I was able to come back to you.

lines.content: 握った大雅の手が震えてる。
lines.translated: Taiga's hand was trembling in my grasp.

lines.content: ……やっとわかった。伝わってる。わたしの声も、わたしが触れたこの手の感触も。ちゃんときみには全部、伝わっていたんだ。
lines.translated: I finally understood. It was reaching him. My voice, and the sensation of my hand touching his. Every bit of it was properly reaching you.

lines.content: もう、いい。……いいんだよ、大雅。ありがとう。わたしのためにいっぱい、がんばってくれて。きみの“想い”、全部わたしに、届いたよ
lines.translated: "It's okay now. ...It's okay, Taiga. Thank you. For working so, so hard for my sake. All of your 'feelings'... every last one of them reached me."

lines.content: 長い、ながい沈黙の後……、
lines.translated: After a long, drawn-out silence...

lines.content: 大雅は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じたまま唇を噛みしめた。
lines.translated: With his eyelids still closed, Taiga bit down on his lip.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……クロ。ずっと、こうしたかった
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I've wanted to do this... for so long."

lines.content: 大雅はわたしの手を握り返す。
lines.translated: Taiga squeezed my hand back.

lines.content: ……ずっと、ずっと……………………ずっと、君に触れたいと願ってた
lines.translated: "...Always, always................for so long, I wished I could touch you."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: もう、いいのかな……。ぼく……がんばれたのかな。ちゃんと、やり遂げられたのかな
lines.translated: "Is it... okay now...? Did I... do a good job? Was I able to... see it through properly?"

lines.content: ……君に少しは、返せたのかな
lines.translated: "...Was I able to pay you back... even a little?"

lines.content: 今までずっと、君に、護られてばかりいたぼくだけど……
lines.translated: "All this time, I was... always just being protected by you, but..."

lines.content: でも、一度もちゃんと、ありがとうって言えてなかった。だから、……だから、全部、返したかったんだよ、クロ
lines.translated: "Even so, I was never once able to... properly say thank you. That's why... that's why I wanted to pay it all back, Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 君からもらったたくさんの、気持ちを……返したかった
lines.translated: "All the countless feelings I received from you... I wanted to give them back."

lines.content: 大雅は呼吸するのも難しそうに、でも、懸命に話してくれた。
lines.translated: Even though it looked difficult for him just to breathe, Taiga spoke to me with everything he had.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "...Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん。ここにいるよ、大雅
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I'm right here, Taiga."

lines.content: ぼく……ひとりで、生きてこれたよ
lines.translated: "I... managed to live on, all by myself."

lines.content: くじけそうに、なったこともあったけど。……さみしくて、つらくて、ひとりが怖くて。思わず君の名前を叫んで、走って……そんなときも、あったけど
lines.translated: "There were times when I almost... broke down, though. ...It was lonely, and painful, and I was scared of being alone. There were times when I couldn't help shouting your name, running... times like that, too, though."

lines.content: 覚えてないふりをして、子猫な君を抱きしめてしまったときも、あったけど……。
lines.translated: Even though there was also that time when I pretended not to remember, and ended up hugging you when you were a kitten...

lines.content: ……でも、途中で、投げ出さなかったよ。君がいなくても、ひとりで……
lines.translated: "...But I didn't give up... halfway through. Even without you there, all by myself..."

lines.content: ねえ、クロ。見ていて、くれた？
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. Were you... watching over me?"

lines.content: ……うん。見てた
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I was watching."

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: ……ちゃんと、見てたよ。大雅。全部見てた
lines.translated: "...I was watching you the whole time, Taiga. I saw every bit of it."

lines.content: どうしよう。涙がいっぱい……とまらない。
lines.translated: What do I do? The tears are overflowing... They won't stop.

lines.content: でも、ごめんね。クロ。結局、君にいっぱい、助けられちゃったのかなあ……
lines.translated: "Still, I'm sorry, Kuro. In the end, I guess you wound up helping me out a whole lot anyway..."

lines.content: ……ううん。そんなことない
lines.translated: "...No. That's not true."

lines.content: ……わたしのほうこそ、いっぱい、いっぱい、きみに助けられてきたんだよ。……きみがいないと、わたし、生きていけなかった。きっと産まれてさえ来れなかったよ
lines.translated: "...I'm the one who has been helped by you so, so many times. ...Without you, I couldn't have gone on living. I'm sure I wouldn't have even been born."

lines.content: きみを傷つけてしまったこと。
lines.translated: The fact that I hurt you.

lines.content: それでもきみに、許してもらえたこと。
lines.translated: The fact that you forgave me even so.

lines.content: それでも……自分自身を許せないこと。
lines.translated: The fact that even then... I couldn't forgive myself.

lines.content: そういったすべてから、きみは救ってくれた。
lines.translated: You saved me from all of those things.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だからね、これで、おあいこだよ。……大雅
lines.translated: "So, you see, that makes us even. ...Taiga."

lines.content: わたしは人の“心”がわからない。だから精一杯、笑顔で言って、大雅を笑わせられるようにと願ってた。
lines.translated: I don't understand the human "heart." So I said that with the biggest smile I could muster, hoping I could make Taiga smile too.

lines.content: 大雅は小さく微笑んでくれる。
lines.translated: Taiga gave me a small smile.

lines.content: そしてもう一度“クロ……”と、わたしの名前を呼んだ。
lines.translated: And then, he called my name once more. "Kuro..."

lines.content: ……最後にひとつ、お願い、したいことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "...At the very end, there's one last... favor I want to ask of you."

lines.content: ……うん。なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……ぼくのあたらしい“夢”、まだ、完成してないんだ
lines.translated: "...My new 'dream'... still isn't finished yet."

lines.content: 大雅がいつも向かっていた机の上に、一冊のノートがある。
lines.translated: On the desk Taiga always sat at, there was a single notebook.

lines.content: ……“あなたの人生のための物語”
lines.translated: "...'A Story for Your Life.'"

lines.content: それがぼくのあたらしい“夢”の名前だ、と大雅は言う。
lines.translated: Taiga told me that was the name of his new "dream."

lines.content: ……もし、いつか、誰かがあのノートのページを、開くときがあったなら。その“誰か”の悲しみが、少しでも晴れるような――勇気に、なるような
lines.translated: "...If, someday, there comes a time when someone opens the pages of that notebook... I wanted it to be something that could clear away that 'someone's' sadness, even just a little--something that could become their courage..."

lines.content: ……そこにある言葉の多くが、まるで[・|自][・|分]のことを励ましてると、感じられるような……その人たちのそばに、寄り添えるような……そんなもので、あったらいい。そう願ってたんだ
lines.translated: "...Something where many of the words inside would make them feel as though they were encouraging *them* personally... something that could stay close by their side... I wished for it to be like that."

lines.content: そう、願ったから……たくさんの人の“想い”を、悲しみも、さみしさも、うれしさも、幸せな心も全部、集めてた
lines.translated: "Because that was my wish... I gathered the 'feelings' of so many people--their sadness, their loneliness, their joy, and their happy hearts, all of it."

lines.content: ……でも、最後がまだ……、最後のページがまだ空白のまま、なんだよ
lines.translated: "...But the ending is still... the very last page is still left blank."

lines.content: わたしはノートを手に取る。
lines.translated: I picked up the notebook.

lines.content: ……お願いだ、クロ
lines.translated: "...Please, Kuro."

lines.content: 大雅は目を瞑ったままだ。
lines.translated: Taiga's eyes remained closed.

lines.content: ……もう、目が見えない。ぼくは書けないんだ
lines.translated: "...I can't see anymore. I can't write it."

lines.content: だからクロ。ぼくの言う言葉を、君が、最後のページに書いてほしい。……君とふたりで、完成させたいんだ
lines.translated: "So, Kuro. I want you to write down the words I say on the very last page. ...I want to finish it together, just the two of us."

lines.content: でも……
いっぱいの戸惑いを乗せ、言う。
lines.translated: Filled with confusion and hesitation, I spoke up.

lines.content: でもわたし、ひらがなしか書けない……
lines.translated: "But I can only write in hiragana..."

lines.content: いいんだ
lines.translated: "I'm okay with it."

lines.content: ……字も、下手だよ？
lines.translated: "...And my handwriting is messy, too, you know?"

lines.content: ああ、いいんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's fine."

lines.content: ……上手いとか下手だとか、そんなのは、何をするにも、何を作るにも、本当にどうでもいいんだ。そこにいっぱいの気持ちがあれば、ぼくは、うれしい……だから
lines.translated: "...Whether it's neat or messy, things like that really don't matter at all, no matter what you're doing or what you're making. As long as it's filled with plenty of feelings, that makes me happy... So..."

lines.content: だからクロ、一緒にぼくのあたらしい“夢”を、完成させてほしい
lines.translated: "So, Kuro, I want you to finish my new 'dream' together with me."

lines.content: わたしはノートを開いた。
lines.translated: I opened the notebook.

lines.content: そこにはたくさんの名もない“誰か”の、いっぱいの叫びと、消えない嘆きと、忘れられない悲しみと……。でも、その中に見える少しの幸せで、溢れてた。
lines.translated: Inside, it was overflowing with the countless cries of so many nameless "someones," their undying grief, their unforgettable sorrow... And yet, shining through all of that, a little bit of happiness.

lines.content: 最後のページ。空白のページ。
lines.translated: The final page. A blank page.

lines.content: そこに埋めたいと願う“想い”を、大雅は、語りはじめる――……それは、わたし達ふたりのお話だった。
lines.translated: Taiga began to speak of the "feelings" he wished to fill that space with--...and it was the story of the two of us.

lines.content: がんばって、懸命に、書き写そうとするけれど……だめだ。だめだよ。涙がこぼれる。
lines.translated: I tried my hardest, doing everything I could to write it all down, and yet... No good. It's no good. My tears are spilling over.

lines.content: そこには大雅の、わたしへの“想い”で、いっぱい、溢れていたから。
lines.translated: Because the words were overflowing with so, so many of Taiga's "feelings" for me.

lines.content: わたしと一緒に笑ったこと。楽しかったこと。……さみしかったこと。少し悲しく思ったこと。
lines.translated: How he had laughed together with me. How much fun he had. ...How lonely he had been. How he had felt a little bit sad.

lines.content: だからこそ、わたしはいつでも、どこかで[自分|ぼく]を見守り、応援してくれていたのだと感じていたこと。
lines.translated: And how, because of all that, he had felt that I was always out there somewhere, watching over him and cheering him on.

lines.content: その全部を語り終えた後、大雅は言った。
lines.translated: After he finished telling me all of it, Taiga spoke.

lines.content: ……ごめん、ごめんクロ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I'm sorry, Kuro."

lines.content: 本当は、君が見えてた。本当は、君の声も聞こえてた。……それなのに、泣いてる君を無視するような真似をした
lines.translated: "The truth is, I could see you. The truth is, I could hear your voice, too. ...And yet, I acted like I was ignoring you while you were crying."

lines.content: 本当に、ごめんね
lines.translated: "I'm truly sorry."

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: こんな、必ずしも幸せだなんて、言えない……そんな最期になったけど……
lines.translated: "Even though my end turned out like this... something I can't necessarily call happy..."

lines.content: ……でも、でもクロ。ぼく
lines.translated: "...Even so, even so, Kuro. I..."

lines.content: ぼく……君が、好きだ。大好きだ
lines.translated: "I... love you. I love you so much."

lines.content: ありがとう。この世界に産まれてきてくれて。ぼくと、出会ってくれて……ぼくを、探し出してくれて
lines.translated: "Thank you. For being born into this world. For meeting me... and for finding me."

lines.content: ……最期に、会いに来てくれて
lines.translated: "...And for coming to see me, at the very end."

lines.content: 幸せだった
lines.translated: "I was happy."

lines.content: 求めたものはすべて、何も、与えられない人生だったけど……
lines.translated: "It was a life where I wasn't given anything... not a single thing I wished for, and yet..."

lines.content: でも今、ここに君がいてくれる。手を、握ってくれている。それだけで、誰にも負けないくらい……子どもの頃に“夢”見てたものよりずっと、この人生は、幸せだったと思うよ
lines.translated: "But right now, you're here with me. You're holding my hand. Just from that alone, more than anyone else could ever claim... far more than anything I 'dreamed' of when I was a child, I think this life of mine was a happy one."

lines.content: そうつぶやいて大雅が語り終わった言葉を、一生懸命、書き残したはずだけど。
lines.translated: Murmuring that, Taiga finished speaking, and I tried as hard as I could to leave every last word written behind, though...

lines.content: ちゃんとできたかどうかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know if I managed to do it properly or not.

lines.content: でも、わからないから、それでいいんだと今は思う。
lines.translated: Still, precisely because I don't know, I think right now that it's fine that way.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ノートを書きながらもずっと握りしめていた大雅の手。もう、冷たくなってた。
lines.translated: Taiga's hand, which I had been holding onto tightly the entire time I was writing in the notebook... had already grown cold.

lines.content: 震える唇を、ぐっと、堪える。泣かずにいたい。……せめて、せめて最期の瞬間は、幸せに。
lines.translated: I bit down hard to steady my trembling lips. I don't want to cry. ...At the very least, let his final moments be happy.

lines.content: ……おやすみ、大雅
lines.translated: "...Goodnight, Taiga."

lines.content: 暖かかったその手を握り、頬に触れ、手のひらに頬ずりをして――
lines.translated: Holding that hand that had been so warm, touching it to my cheek, nuzzling my face against his palm--

lines.content: 良く、よく、生きたね。立派だったよ。……格好よかったよ、すごく
lines.translated: "You lived... so, so well. You were wonderful. ...You were so cool, really."

lines.content: ノートを閉じた。
lines.translated: I closed the notebook.

lines.content: そしてわたしも、大雅と手を繋いだまま……、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: And then, with my hand still joined with Taiga's... I closed my eyelids, too.

lines.content: これはわたし達ふたりの物語。
lines.translated: This is the story of the two of us.

lines.content: ……これは、たくさん、たくさんの“あなた”の人生のためにと願った、物語。
lines.translated: This is a story wished into being for the sake of so, so many "your" lives.

lines.content: ここに残された“想い”は誰かに届くだろうか。
lines.translated: Will the "feelings" left behind here reach someone?

lines.content: それはその名もない悲しみに、寄り添えるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Will they be able to stay close beside that nameless sadness?

lines.content: ……わたしにはわからないけれど。
lines.translated: I don't know, though.

lines.content: 強く、強く……そうあれるようにと願った人の“想い”は、ここに必ず生きている。
lines.translated: The "feelings" of the person who wished so, so strongly for it to be that way are without a doubt alive right here.

lines.content: さあ、行こう。
lines.translated: Now, let's go.

lines.content: 待ってて。
lines.translated: Wait for me.

lines.content: 大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: わたしは今から、大好きなきみに、もう一度会いに行くよ。
lines.translated: I'm coming to see you again right now, the one I love so much.

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はらりと、ひとひらさくらが舞って。
lines.translated: Softly, a single cherry blossom petal fluttered down.

lines.content: 暗闇の中、その行方を視線で追いかけ。
lines.translated: In the darkness, I followed its path with my eyes.

lines.content: ふと、手のひらで受け止めようとした。
lines.translated: On impulse, I reached out to catch it in the palm of my hand.

lines.content: ……するとわたしは、“夜”の中で目を覚ます。
lines.translated: And as I did, I woke up within the "Night."

lines.content: 大きな時計塔と、大きなさくらの樹、それを仰ぎ見るようにして立っていた。
lines.translated: A grand clock tower and a great cherry blossom tree--I was standing there, looking up at them.

lines.content: “隣”にきみがいなかった。
lines.translated: You weren't "beside" me.

lines.content: きみと繋いでいたはずの手も空っぽだった。
lines.translated: The hand that was supposed to be holding yours was empty, too.

lines.content: でもきみが今、どこにいるのかはなんとなく、わかるよ。
lines.translated: Even so, I somehow know where you are right now.

lines.content: ゆっくり……。
lines.translated: Slowly...

lines.content: ゆっくりと、歩いて行く。
lines.translated: Slowly, I began to walk.

lines.content: 何度生まれ変わっても、決して忘れることのできないきみの匂いを辿って歩いた。
lines.translated: I walked, following your scent, which I could never forget no matter how many times I was reborn.

lines.content: それは直ぐ近くなのに、とても、とても長い道のりのように感じられる。
lines.translated: Even though it was right nearby, it felt like a very, very long journey.

lines.content: 時計塔の管理室。
lines.translated: The clock tower's office.

lines.content: その扉はもう、開かれていて……。
lines.translated: That door was already open...

lines.content: どきどきしながら、そっと中を覗き見る。
lines.translated: With my heart pounding, I gently peeked inside.

lines.content: その人は窓から外を見ていた。
lines.translated: That person was looking out the window.

lines.content: 今までの人生を一つ、またひとつ、思い返しているみたいに、静かに瞬く“夜”の町を見つめてた。
lines.translated: As if looking back on his life up until now, one memory after another, he was gazing out at the quietly twinkling town of the "Night."

lines.content: わたしはその人を……きみのことを、じっと、見ていた。
lines.translated: I stared fixedly at that person... at you.

lines.content: そんなわたしに君が気づいて、やさしく……とてもやさしく、微笑みかけてくれた。
lines.translated: Noticing me standing there, you smiled at me gently... so very gently.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: なんだか恥ずかしいし、
lines.translated: It felt kind of embarrassing,

lines.content: すごく格好、悪いけど……、
lines.translated: and terribly uncool, though...

lines.content: だめ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: もうがまんできない。
lines.translated: I can't hold back anymore.

lines.content: ……大雅っ
lines.translated: "...Taiga!"

lines.content: わたしは駆け出し、きみの胸に飛び込んだ。
lines.translated: I broke into a run and leaped into your chest.

lines.content: いっぱい泣いたと思う。
lines.translated: I think I cried a whole lot.

lines.content: いっぱい、いっぱい、きみの名前を呼んだと思う。
lines.translated: I think I called your name over, and over, and over again.

lines.content: きみはいつまでも子どもみたいなわたしを強く、抱きしめて……。とまらないわたしの涙を、何度だって拭ってくれた。
lines.translated: And no matter how much time passed, you held me tightly as I acted like a child... wiping away my unstoppable tears as many times as it took.

lines.content: おかえり、クロ。君のこと、ずっと待ってた
lines.translated: "Welcome back, Kuro. I've been waiting for you this whole time."

lines.content: 微笑む君を見つめると……。
lines.translated: As I gazed at your smiling face...
Ah, *that's right*. *That's how it was*.

lines.content: 胸が、ずきりとした。
lines.translated: My chest throbbed with a sharp ache.

lines.content: そんな“心”には気づかないふりをして、わたしは、大好きなきみと唇を合わせる。……“夢”だ。
lines.translated: Pretending not to notice that "heart" of mine, I pressed my lips against yours, the one I love so much. ...It's a "dream."

lines.content: こんな幸せすぎる時間は全部、“夢”なんだ。
lines.translated: All of this blissfully happy time is just a "dream."

lines.content: そう思う“心”がずきずきと、痛かった。
lines.translated: The "heart" that thought so throbbed and ached.

lines.content: 列車の走る音で目を覚ました。
lines.translated: I woke up to the sound of a running train.

lines.content: わたし……。
どうしたんだろう。
lines.translated: What's going on with her?

lines.content: よく、覚えていない。
lines.translated: I don't remember it very well.

lines.content: “夜”の中で、大雅と会って……。
lines.translated: Meeting Taiga within the "Night"...

lines.content: それから大雅とキスをして。
lines.translated: And then kissing Taiga.

lines.content: こんな“夢”みたいな時間が永遠ならいいのにと、願って。
lines.translated: Wishing that a "dream"-like time like this could last forever.

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: 思い出したんだ。
lines.translated: I remembered.
*I cannot go together with Taiga.*

lines.content: だってわたしは“命”を使い果たしたのに、“夜”の“最終便”を逃してしまった。
lines.translated: Because even though I used up all of my "life," I missed the "last train" of the "Night."

lines.content: だからわたしは、この町の“夜”の一部となるはずで……。
lines.translated: So I was supposed to become a part of this town's "Night"...

lines.content: また、わたしはきみと離ればなれだ。今度こそ、永遠に。
lines.translated: Once again, I'm separated from you. This time, forever.

lines.content: ……でも
lines.translated: "...Even though..."
Why?

lines.content: どうしてわたし、列車に乗ってるの？
lines.translated: Why am I riding on a train?

lines.content: 言ったろう、クロ
lines.translated: "I told you, didn't I, Kuro?"

lines.content: 顔を上げる。すると大雅が隣に座ってた。
lines.translated: I raised my head. Taiga was sitting right next to me.

lines.content: 俺が、俺の人生全部かけて何とか得られた“魔法”は……、クロ、君の“夢”を叶えることだよ
lines.translated: "The 'magic' I somehow managed to obtain by spending my entire life... is to grant your 'dream,' Kuro."

lines.content: それって……
lines.translated: "Does that mean..."

lines.content: 一緒に生きよう
lines.translated: "Let's live together."

lines.content: 大雅が言った。
lines.translated: Taiga said.

lines.content: ぼくらは、ぼくらのままでは一緒にいられなかった。いつか、“さよなら”をしなきゃならない。そういう人生で、そういう“命”だった
lines.translated: "We couldn't be together as we were. Someday, we would have had to say 'goodbye.' That was the kind of life, the kind of 'lives' we had."

lines.content: でも、本当に君が望んでくれるのなら――“次”は、同じになれる。そのための“魔法”が、ここにあるよ
lines.translated: "But if you truly wish for it--'next time,' we can become the same. The 'magic' for that is right here."
"'Magic'..."

lines.content: ……うん。同じような“命”になって、同じような“心”を持って。同じような、時間を生きていくことができる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. We can become the same kind of 'life,' have the same kind of 'heart,' and live through the same kind of time."

lines.content: だから生まれ変わった次の人生で、必ず……どんなに時間が掛かったって、難しくったって。何か意地悪な邪魔が入ってきたって、必ず君を探し出すから
lines.translated: "So in the next life when we're reborn, I promise... no matter how much time it takes, no matter how difficult it is, and even if some mean obstacle gets in the way, I will definitely find you."

lines.content: この“約束”だけは絶対、忘れても、忘れないから――と大雅は言う。
lines.translated: This "promise" alone, even if I forget everything else, I will never forget--so Taiga said.

lines.content: だからまた、クロ。最初からぼくらふたりのお話をはじめられたらと願ってる。……君がそう、望んでくれるなら
lines.translated: "So once again, Kuro. I hope we can start the story of the two of us from the very beginning. ...If that's what you wish for, too."

lines.content: 改めてそう言う大雅だ。
lines.translated: Taiga said that to me anew.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 重ね合わせるように握っていた手と手の間に、小さな“切符”が二枚、あった。
lines.translated: Between our hands, held tightly together one over the other, there were two small "tickets."

lines.content: その“切符”と、大雅の言葉の意味とを考える。足りない猫の頭で、考える。
lines.translated: I thought about those "tickets" and the meaning of Taiga's words. I thought about them with my lacking cat brain.

lines.content: わたし……
わたしは、きみのことを傷つけた。たぶん、その人生を台無しにした。だから生涯、自分自身を許せることはないだろうと感じてた。
lines.translated: I hurt you. I probably ruined your life. That's why I felt like I would never be able to forgive myself for as long as I lived.

lines.content: だからこんな自分の“夢”が叶わなくともそれは当然だと思ってた。……簡単に、諦められるとも感じてた。
lines.translated: So I thought it was only natural if a "dream" like mine never came true. ...I even felt like I could easily give up on it.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: たぶん、いっぱい震えてる唇と、“心”とで、わたしは言った。
lines.translated: With lips and a "heart" that were probably trembling like crazy, I spoke.

lines.content: わたし……、ねえ、大雅……わたし、“夢”を叶えても、いいの？
lines.translated: "I... hey, Taiga... Is it really okay for my 'dream' to come true?"

lines.content: ……これからもずっと、いつまでも、ずっと、ずっと、大雅と一緒にいたい、大雅と生きたい、大雅と、同じになりたい……。そう、願っても、いい？
lines.translated: "...From now on, forever and ever, always, always, I want to be with you, Taiga. I want to live with you, Taiga. I want to become the same as you, Taiga... Is it okay for me to wish for that?"

lines.content: 大雅は何も言わず、ただ、うなずいてくれて……。
lines.translated: Taiga didn't say anything, simply nodding for me...

lines.content: 胸に手を当ててみる――わたしは“心”がわからない。だから“恋するための物語”は、いつだって胸がずきずき痛むものだと思ってた。
lines.translated: I placed a hand over my chest--I don't understand what a "heart" is. That's why I always thought a "story for falling in love" was something that always made your chest throb with pain.

lines.content: ……きみのことを想うと、いつも、いつだって、泣きたいくらい痛かった胸の中。
lines.translated: Whenever I thought of you, always, every single time, it hurt so much inside my chest that I wanted to cry.

lines.content: でも今はもう、痛くない。
lines.translated: But now, it doesn't hurt anymore.

lines.content: ……全然、痛くないよ、大雅
lines.translated: "...It doesn't hurt at all, Taiga."

lines.content: きみと一緒にいられる。きみと生きていける。きみと、同じになれる。……それは今のわたし達とはどこか違う“誰か”なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: I can be together with you. I can live together with you. I can become the same as you. ...That might mean becoming "someone" a little different from who we are right now.

lines.content: それでもいい。それでも、うれしい。
lines.translated: Even so, that's fine. Even so, I'm happy.

lines.content: そう思うだけで、ずっと痛かった“心”が……いっぱいで……、なんだろう……たくさん、もにょもにょしてる。
lines.translated: Just thinking that made the "heart" that had hurt for so long feel... so full... how do I put it... all squirmy and fuzzy inside.

lines.content: う、うううう。もう、何も痛くない……けど。代わりになんだか、変だよ。大雅。ねえ、大雅。胸の中がすごく、すごく、むずむずして――……っ
lines.translated: "U-Uuuuu. Nothing hurts anymore... but instead, it feels kind of weird. Taiga. Hey, Taiga. Inside my chest, it feels so, so restless and tingly--...!"

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: じっとしていられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't sit still.

lines.content: わたしは、走る列車の窓を開け、
lines.translated: I opened the window of the running train,

lines.content: ――あ、あああああああああああああああああああ……！
lines.translated: "--Ah, aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...!"

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.

lines.content: 大好き……！！
lines.translated: "I love you...!!"

lines.content: わたしは叫んだ。
lines.translated: I shouted.

lines.content: 大雅……聞いてっ、大雅……わたし、わたしねっ、きみのことが、大好きなんだよ……大雅っ！！！！！！！！！
lines.translated: "Taiga... Listen to me, Taiga... I, you know, I love you so, so much... Taiga!!!!!!!!!"

lines.content: きみへの“想い”を叫べば叫ぶだけ……、
lines.translated: The more I shouted out my "feelings" for you...

lines.content: きみと繋いだ手と手の間に、いっぱいの幸せを思い描くその度に……、
lines.translated: Every time I pictured all the happiness waiting between our joined hands...

lines.content: 胸の痛さは、春の花咲く季節の、甘くてやわらかくって、暖かい――でも、時どき思い出したようにちょっと冷たい。
lines.translated: The pain in my chest turned into something like the season of blooming spring flowers--sweet, soft, and warm, yet occasionally a little chilly, as if suddenly remembering something.

lines.content: そんなむずむずする気持ちに変わっていった。
lines.translated: It changed into that kind of restless, tingly feeling.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: この“想い”は幾千の時を越え、いつまでも、どこまでも、この“命”と一緒に在り続ける。そう信じてる。
lines.translated: These "feelings" will cross thousands of eras, remaining together with this "life" forever, no matter how far. I believe that.

lines.content: だから、たとえどんな“形”に生まれ変わろうと、必ずわたし達はまた逢える。
lines.translated: So no matter what "form" we are reborn into, we will definitely meet again.

lines.content: わたしはね、大雅。そういうふうに、自分の人生を信じたいと思ったんだよ。
lines.translated: You know, Taiga, I decided I wanted to believe in my life that way.

lines.content: そんな“想い”がきみに、きみだけに伝わりますようにと、わたしは、さくらもゆる“夜”の中――……いつまでもずっと、きみと一緒に叫び続けていた。
lines.translated: Praying that these "feelings" would reach you, and only you, within the "Night" of glowing cherry blossoms--...for forever and ever, I kept shouting together with you.

lines.content: ――あなたの生きるその人生を、もしも自由に“歌”や“物語”、そして壮大な一枚の“絵”にたとえられるなら、あなたはいったい、どういうふうに思い描くだろうか。
lines.translated: --If the life you live could be freely compared to a "song," a "story," and a single magnificent "painting," just how would you picture it?

lines.content: 私はもちろん、決まってるよ
lines.translated: "For me, of course, that's already decided."
So said *Mom*.

lines.content: 大好きな[・|あ][・|な][・|た]と一緒にいられるこの人生は、とっても切ない“恋の歌”だし、誰に見せても得意になれる“愛の物語”
lines.translated: "This life where I get to be together with *you*, my darling whom I love so much, is a terribly bittersweet 'love song,' and a 'love story' I can proudly show off to anyone."

lines.content: そしてね、意地悪な誰かに笑われたって全然平気に思える“世界でたったひとつの時間の絵”になるよ
lines.translated: "And you know, it becomes a 'painting of a one-of-a-kind time in this world' where I wouldn't mind at all even if someone mean laughed at it."

lines.content: 朝食の席。
lines.translated: At the breakfast table.

lines.content: いったいどうして[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|話]になってしまったのかはわからない。でも、いつものことだった。
lines.translated: I have no idea how on earth it ended up turning into *that kind of conversation*. But it was the usual thing.

lines.content: そうだ。いつも[・|唐][・|突]なのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. It's always *out of nowhere*.

lines.content: はい、パパ。あ～ん……。今朝の目玉焼き、上手に焼けたの。お口に合えばいいなあって思うけど……
lines.translated: "Here, Papa. Say ahh... I fried this morning's sunny-side-up eggs really well. I hope they're to your liking, though..."

lines.content: おいおい、まったくやめなさいよ。[・|子][・|ど][・|も][・|達]が見てるじゃないか
lines.translated: "Hey now, knock it off already. The *kids* are watching, aren't they?"

lines.content: [・|父][・|さ][・|ん]は緩みきった顔で、真っ黒焦げなスクランブルエッグをじゃりじゃり噛んでいた。
lines.translated: With a completely dopey grin on his face, *Dad* was crunching away on pitch-black, burnt scrambled eggs.

lines.content: 美味しいよ、とっても、君が作るものならなんだって、と――うそなんてまったくない本気の声と表情で言う父さんと。
lines.translated: "It's delicious, really. Anything you make is," Dad said, with a completely genuine voice and expression that held no lie whatsoever.

lines.content: 本当にうれしそうに、照れくさそうに、もじもじとする母さんだ。
lines.translated: And Mom fidgeted bashfully, looking truly happy.

lines.content: いつも[・|ぼ][・|く][・|ら]のことなんてほっといて唐突にはじまるふたりの世界。今朝も朝日の光りに負けないくらい、きらきら眩しく見えている。
lines.translated: Leaving *us* completely behind, the two of them always abruptly slip into their own little world. This morning, too, they looked dazzlingly bright, refusing to be outshone by the morning sunlight.

lines.content: 正直、お腹いっぱいだ。胸もいっぱい。
lines.translated: Honestly, my stomach is full just watching them. My chest is full, too.

lines.content: そんなぼくらの前には、ふたりとは違う美味しそうな――本当に美味しそうな朝食が並んでる。
lines.translated: In front of the rest of us, a delicious-looking--a genuinely delicious-looking--breakfast was lined up, completely different from theirs.

lines.content: まったく。我が家はいったいどうなってるんだ。毎朝毎朝、[おんな|同]じような甘ったるいもの見せつけられて。堪ったもんじゃない
lines.translated: "Honestly. Just what is going on with our family? Every single morning, having the exact same sugary-sweet display shoved in our faces. I can't stand it."
