lines.content: ぼくの隣で姿勢良く食事する[・|姉][・|さ][・|ん]が、ぶつぶつと口を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: Sitting next to me and eating with impeccable posture, my *older sister* was pouting and grumbling to herself.

lines.content: しかも、お母さん。朝食だってお父さんの分しか作らないし。……どころかお弁当だってお夕飯だって全部、私がお母さんの代わりに作ってる始末だぞ
lines.translated: "And what's more, Mom only ever makes breakfast for Dad. ...Not only that, I'm the one who ends up making all the boxed lunches and dinners in Mom's place."

lines.content: こんなのもう育児放棄も[おんな|同]じなんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "At this point, isn't this practically the same as child neglect?"

lines.content: な？　そう思うだろ？　と、ぼくに賛同を求めてくる姉さんに、ぼくは何も言えずただ苦笑いを浮かべてた。
lines.translated: "Right? Don't you think so?" My sister looked to me for agreement, and unable to say anything, I just gave a wry smile.

lines.content: ま、いいんだ。うん。無駄に不得意なことをがんばられたりして、殺人的な料理を無理矢理、毎回気を使いながら食べなきゃならないよりは全然ましだ
lines.translated: "Well, it's fine. Yeah. It's way better than having her pointlessly try hard at something she's terrible at, forcing us to walk on eggshells every time while choking down her lethal cooking."

lines.content: それに、母親がああだから――あのふたりがいつまでも互いにぞっこんで、学生気分が抜けない[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|感][・|じ]だから、私は君のお母さんになれるんだからな
lines.translated: "Besides, because our mother is like that--because those two are forever head over heels for each other and *acting like that*, unable to grow out of their student days, it means I get to be your mom."

lines.content: にっこりと微笑みを渡され、ぼくはますますどう返答していいのかわからなくなる。
lines.translated: Handed a beaming smile, I found myself knowing even less how I was supposed to reply.

lines.content: 今日も美味しいお弁当、作っておいたぞ。君の好きなものばっかり詰めといた。栄養も愛情も満点だぞ
lines.translated: "I made a delicious boxed lunch for you today, too. I packed it full of all your favorite things. It gets full marks in both nutrition and love."

lines.content: お姉ちゃんの――……ううん、[私|お母さん]のお手製弁当。お昼を楽しみにしておいてくれたらうれしいな
lines.translated: "Your big sister's--...no, your mom's homemade lunch. I'd be happy if you looked forward to lunchtime."

lines.content: ちょっとちょっと。なあに今の。聞き捨てならないなあ。あなたはお姉ちゃんで、お母さんは私。[・|三][・|人][・|と][・|も]お母さんがお腹をいっぱい痛めて産んだ、かわいい子たちなんだよ
lines.translated: "Hold on a second. What was that just now? I can't just pretend I didn't hear that. You're the big sister, and I'm the mom. *All three of you* are my cute children whom Mommy went through a whole lot of pain in her tummy to give birth to."

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: 姉さんはつんとして、言った。
lines.translated: Turning her nose up primly, my sister spoke.

lines.content: たまたま私たちを産んだからって、たったそれだけのことで母親みたいな顔をするのはやめていただきたい――……と
lines.translated: "Just because you happened to give birth to us, I would appreciate it if you stopped acting like a mother over something as minor as that--...is what"

lines.content: なぜだかいつも私の“心”が叫んでる。そんな気がするんだよ
lines.translated: "my 'heart' always seems to be shouting, for some reason. I get that feeling."

lines.content: な、なにそれ……っ。なんだかオカルトっぽいこと言っても、ママは全然、怖くないんだからねっ
lines.translated: "Wh-What is that supposed to mean...? Even if you say something occult-like, Mama isn't scared at all, okay?!"

lines.content: ちょっと顔を青くしながら言う恐がりな母さんに、姉さんはぽつりと言う。
lines.translated: To our easily frightened mom, who was turning a little pale as she spoke, my sister muttered flatly.

lines.content: オカルトじゃない。厨二なだけだ
lines.translated: "It's not occult. It's just eighth-grader syndrome."

lines.content: もう……すぐそうやってママにわからない若者向けな言葉を使うんだから
lines.translated: "Geez... You always immediately use young people words that Mama doesn't understand like that."

lines.content: 母さんは頬を膨らませ、言う。
lines.translated: Puffing out her cheeks, Mom spoke.

lines.content: いーい？　何度でも言うからね。三人とも私が、この小さなお腹をすっごく痛めて――……ううん
lines.translated: "Listen up, okay? I'll say it as many times as it takes. I gave birth to all three of you after going through so much pain in this little tummy of mine--...no, wait."

lines.content: その前に、世界一格好いいあなた達のパパと出会って、駆け落ちして、学生結婚して、それからいっぱいいっぱい、えっちなことして、愛し合ってできた愛の結晶なんだよ
lines.translated: "Before that, I met your Papa, the coolest guy in the world, eloped with him, had a student marriage, and then did lots and lots of naughty things together. You're the結晶--the fruit of our love from loving each other!"

lines.content: ……朝から親の情事や恋愛事情について聞かされるなんて。最悪な一日の始まりだ
lines.translated: "...Being forced to hear about my parents' bedroom antics and love life first thing in the morning. What a terrible start to the day."

lines.content: とにかく！　あなた達の身体には、パパやママの愛の歴史がいっぱい詰まってるんだよ！
lines.translated: "Anyway! Your bodies are packed full of the history of Papa and Mama's love!"

lines.content: だから間違いなく、あなた達はママの子なんです
lines.translated: "So without a doubt, you are Mama's children."

lines.content: と、母さんは得意げに言うけれど、
lines.translated: Mom said that proudly, but...

lines.content: いいや。[・|こ][・|の][・|子]のお母さんは、私だ
lines.translated: "No. *This boy's* mother is me."

lines.content: きっぱりと、姉さんが言った。
lines.translated: My sister said flatly.

lines.content: たまたま産まれる順番とか、産まれてくる場所とか、そういうのをちょっとばかし間違えただけなんだ。神さまとかそういう何かが。……もしくは自分が
lines.translated: "It's just that the order we were born in, or the place we were born into, got mixed up a little bit by chance. By God, or something like that. ...Or maybe by myself."

lines.content: 人生は産まれる前に、自分の魂が、自分の人生をどういうふうにするか選んで産まれてくるっていうだろう？　と、姉さんは言う。
lines.translated: "They say that before you're born, your soul chooses what kind of life it wants to live, right?" my sister said.

lines.content: またオカルトだ……
lines.translated: "More occult stuff..."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせる母さんに構うことなく、姉さんはぼくに笑いかけてくれる。
lines.translated: Paying no mind to Mom pouting her lips, my sister smiled at me.

lines.content: まあそういうわけだ。本当は私がお腹を痛めて、君のことを産みたかったけれど……。どういうわけかこうなった。こうなって、しまった
lines.translated: "Well, that's how it is. Truthfully, I wanted to be the one to go through the pain of childbirth and give birth to you, though... Somehow or another, it turned out like this. It ended up this way."

lines.content: この人生を選んだのだろう[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]のことも、前世の自分はどこの誰だったのかも。全然まったく、思い出せないけれど……
lines.translated: "I can't remember a single thing about *that moment* when I must have chosen this life, or who and where I was in my past life, at all, though..."

lines.content: でもきっとそうなんだ。何か手違いがあったに違いない
lines.translated: "But I'm sure that's what happened. There must have been some kind of mix-up."

lines.content: だからな、今日から私のことは姉さんじゃなくて、母さんって呼んでくれたらうれしいな。……そうしてくれたら、姉さん。ううん。母さん、うれしくて泣いちゃうぞ
lines.translated: "So, you know, I'd be happy if you called me Mom instead of Big Sis starting today. ...If you did that for me, Big Sis--no, Mom would cry tears of joy."

lines.content: 違いますぅー、あなた達のママは私なんですぅー
lines.translated: "No wayyy! I'm your Mama!"

lines.content: ……あなたのような幼女幼女したお母さんなんて、いてたまるかって感じだ
lines.translated: "...Like hell there could ever be a mother who looks like a total little girl like you."

lines.content: も～……なに？　なんなの？　大学生になってまでまだ反抗期なの……もうっ、あなたって子はっ
lines.translated: "Geez... What? What is it with you? Are you still going through your rebellious phase even after becoming a college student...? Honestly, this girl!"

lines.content: 大人になりなよ！　と母さんが言う。
lines.translated: "Grow up already!" Mom said.

lines.content: こっちのせりふだロリばばあ、と姉さんが言う。
lines.translated: "That's my line, you loli hag," my sister replied.

lines.content: そんなふたりをにこにこしながら、父さんはただただ見てる。
lines.translated: Grinning from ear to ear, Dad simply watched the two of them go at it.

lines.content: [・|お][・|兄][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん]も毎朝大変だよねえ……。どうじょうするよ。本当に
lines.translated: "*Big Brother* sure has it rough every morning, huh...? You have my sympathies. Really."

lines.content: 小さなかわいい[・|妹]が、毎朝の定位置に――ぼくの膝の上に行儀良く座り、やれやれと首を振っていた。
lines.translated: My cute little *younger sister* was sitting politely in her usual morning spot--right on my lap--shaking her head in exasperation.

lines.content: ありがとう、わかってくれるの？　と言うぼくに、もちろんだよ、と小さなあごを引き、うなずいた。
lines.translated: When I said, "Thanks, so you understand?" she tucked her tiny chin in and nodded with an, "Of course I do."

lines.content: どっちもお兄ちゃんのお母さんなんかじゃないのにね
lines.translated: "Even though neither of them is your mom, Big Brother."

lines.content: え？　どういうこと？　とぼくは問いかける。すると小さなかわいい妹は、頬を染め、
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you mean?" I asked. At that, my cute little sister's cheeks flushed pink, and--

lines.content: ど、どうしてもって、言うなら……仕方がないから、私がね、お兄ちゃんのお母さんになってあげてもいいよ？　お嫁さんでも、いいんだよ？　って。そういう話
lines.translated: "I-If you really, really insist... then I guess I don't have a choice, so I wouldn't mind becoming your mom, Big Brother, okay? Or your bride, even! ...That's what I mean."

lines.content: え、えーっと。
lines.translated: U-Umm.

lines.content: なんだかとても、おかしいな。
lines.translated: Something feels really, really weird here.

lines.content: ぼくにはこんなにかわいいお母さんが、三人も、いる。
lines.translated: I have three whole mothers who are this cute.

lines.content: 春色に染まった並木道をひとりで歩く。
lines.translated: I walked alone down the tree-lined street dyed in the colors of spring.

lines.content: ぽかぽかしていて暖かい。
lines.translated: It was nice, sunny, and warm out.

lines.content: きっと昼寝するにはいい日になるだろう。
lines.translated: It would surely be a great day for an afternoon nap.

lines.content: でも、ぼくはなんだか胸がもやもやしていた。浮かない気分だ。
lines.translated: Even so, a hazy restlessness lingered in my chest. I was feeling down.

lines.content: 毎日騒がしくて、明るくて、とても楽しい。
lines.translated: Every day is lively, bright, and so much fun.

lines.content: 父さんがいて。母さんがいて。姉さんと妹がいる。
lines.translated: Dad is there. Mom is there. My older sister and younger sister are there.

lines.content: 大好きな家族だ。大切な、家族だ。けんかをしても、いつだって一緒だ。
lines.translated: They're my beloved family. My precious family. Even when we fight, we're always together.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: でも何かが足りない。
lines.translated: Yet something is missing.

lines.content: いつもそう思ってる。
lines.translated: I always feel that way.

lines.content: ……探してる。
lines.translated: I'm searching.

lines.content: そうだ。いつも[・|何][・|か]を探してるんだ。
lines.translated: That's right. I'm always searching for *something*.

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: こんな恥ずかしいせりふ、まるで姉さんみたいだな。
lines.translated: Saying an embarrassing line like that makes me sound just like my sister.

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべ、ぼくは学園へと続く坂道をひとりで歩いた。
lines.translated: With a wry smile on my face, I walked alone up the sloped road leading to the academy.

lines.content: ――なあ、聞いたか。
lines.translated: --Hey, did you hear?

lines.content: すれ違う生徒の声が聞こえた。同じクラスの子だとわかる。
lines.translated: I overheard the voices of students passing by. I recognized them as kids from my class.

lines.content: ――今日、転校生が来るってさ。しかも女の子だって。
lines.translated: --They say a transfer student's coming today. And it's a girl, too.

lines.content: うおおおおおおおおすげえ楽しみ、と早足で坂を行くふたり組の男子生徒だ。
lines.translated: "Wooooah, I can't wait!" said the pair of male students walking briskly up the hill.

lines.content: その背中をぼんやりと見ながら、思う。
lines.translated: Gazing absently at their backs, I thought to myself.

lines.content: 転校生……。
lines.translated: A transfer student...

lines.content: ぼくには関係ないことだ。
lines.translated: That has nothing to do with me.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|性][・|格]なんだ。その子と関わり合いになることはないだろう。
lines.translated: I have *this kind of personality*, after all. I doubt I'll ever have anything to do with her.

lines.content: ぼく[・|ら]は誰にも気づかれることなく教室の隅にぽつんとしてる。そんな日々の状態に変化など起こるはずもない。
lines.translated: *We* sit all alone in the corner of the classroom without anyone noticing us. There's no way any change could ever happen to those daily circumstances.

lines.content: そんなことより気になることがある。
lines.translated: More importantly, there's something else bothering me.

lines.content: 『あ、そうそう。実は今日からパパとママ、[・|新][・|婚][・|旅][・|行]に出かけることになったから、しばらくお家を空けちゃうね』
lines.translated: "'Oh, that's right. Actually, Papa and Mama decided to go on a *honeymoon* starting today, so we'll be away from home for a while, okay?'"

lines.content: いったい何度目の、何年目の新婚旅行だ。
lines.translated: Just how many honeymoons does this make, and how many years into their marriage?

lines.content: いつも突然勝手に決めてと、そう突っ込むことももう疲れてしまった――
lines.translated: I'm already too exhausted to even point out how they always decide these things so suddenly on their own--

lines.content: そんな母さんの発言を、出かける前の玄関先、急ぐ背中で受け止めた後、
lines.translated: After catching that remark from Mom with my back turned in a hurry at the front door before leaving,

lines.content: 『あとね、今日から家で預かることになった子がいてね――』
lines.translated: "'Also, there's a kid we've decided to take in at our house starting today--'"

lines.content: そこでぼくは走って行ってしまった。
lines.translated: At that point, I had bolted out the door.

lines.content: いつも“ねえねえ、ママに行ってきますのちゅ～は？”と続くのを、いつものように、全力で振り切るため駆け出してしまい――……いつもと違うそのせりふを聞き逃してしまっていた。
lines.translated: Because she always follows up with, "Hey, hey, where's Mama's goodbye kissy-kiss?" I had broken into a sprint as usual to shake her off with everything I had--...and ended up missing that out-of-the-ordinary line.

lines.content: “今の、なに？”と、聞きに戻る気にはなれなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't bring myself to go back and ask, "What was that just now?"

lines.content: 絶対、説明を受けた後、無理矢理ちゅうされるに決まってる。
lines.translated: If I went back for an explanation, she'd definitely force a kiss on me afterward for sure.

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: 家で預かる子、だなんて。
lines.translated: Taking a kid in at our house, though...

lines.content: 憂鬱だ。
lines.translated: How depressing.

lines.content: 知らない人と仲良くできないどころか、世間話すらできないし、目を合わせることくらいもできない。
lines.translated: Far from getting along with strangers, I can't even make small talk, nor can I so much as look them in the eye.

lines.content: せっかく居心地のいい家なのに……。
lines.translated: And our house is such a comfortable place to be, too...

lines.content: どんよりと、重い。
lines.translated: A gloomy, heavy feeling weighed on me.

lines.content: [・|昨][・|日]はとっても、楽しかったのになあ。
lines.translated: Even though *yesterday* was so much fun.

lines.content: ぼんやりとしながら教室へ入り、隣に“おはよう”とだけ言い、席に着く。
lines.translated: Spacing out as I walked into the classroom, I said only a quick "Good morning" to the person next to me and took my seat.

lines.content: ホームルーム。
lines.translated: Homeroom.

lines.content: クラスメイトたちがワッと、湧いた。
lines.translated: My classmates erupted into excited chatter.

lines.content: 転校生の女の子はとてもかわいい子だった――のだろう。
lines.translated: The transfer student was a very cute girl--probably.

lines.content: この“教室”というぼくにとっては大きすぎる世界にひとつ、大きなイベントが投下されたのだろうこの日だけれど……。
lines.translated: A major event had likely just been dropped into this "classroom," a world far too big for me, on this day, yet...

lines.content: でも、ぼくみたいな暗い生徒には関係ない。
lines.translated: Even so, it has nothing to do with a gloomy student like me.

lines.content: ため息をつく。何度も。
lines.translated: I sighed. Over and over again.

lines.content: これからどれくらい、知らない子と一緒に暮らすことになるのだろうか――姉さん達はそれでいいのかな。
lines.translated: Just how long am I going to have to live with a kid I don't know starting now? --Are my sisters really okay with that?

lines.content: そんな[・|こ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]のことを悶々と考えてばかりいる。
lines.translated: I did nothing but brood over what was *to come*.

lines.content: ぼんやりとするばかりで、あっという間に放課後になった。
lines.translated: While I did nothing but space out, after school arrived in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: 転校生を中心としたこの[教室|世界]は、既に、たくさんの出来事が錯綜しはじめていた。誰々があの子が好きだ、誰々が世話係をするんだ、誰々が誰々の邪魔をする。
lines.translated: Centered around the transfer student, this classroom--this world--was already beginning to tangle with all sorts of developments. Who likes that girl, who's going to be her guide, who's going to get in whose way.

lines.content: そんな裏側の声がぽつりぽつりと生まれはじめていた。
lines.translated: Behind-the-scenes whispers like that were beginning to crop up here and there.

lines.content: ――これからきっと、このクラスには、恋愛だったりそうじゃなかったりと、様々に派手で騒がしいイベントが起こるのだろうと思う。そんな気配だ。
lines.translated: --From here on out, I'm sure all kinds of flashy, noisy events, whether romantic or otherwise, are going to happen in this class. That's the vibe in the air.

lines.content: でも、そういう世界の中心には決して立つことのできないこのぼくだ。
lines.translated: However, I'm someone who can never stand at the center of that kind of world.

lines.content: どこまでいっても関係ないし、関係なんて、できやしない。ぼくという人間はいつだってそういう“何か”だ。
lines.translated: No matter how far it goes, it has nothing to do with me, and I could never form any connection to it. The person called "me" is always that kind of "something."

lines.content: 大きな中心的な物語には決して属することのない名もない“誰か”――なんて。
lines.translated: A nameless "somebody" who never belongs to the grand, central story--or something like that.

lines.content: 知らず知らずのうちに、姉さんの影響、受けまくってるなあぼく。
lines.translated: Without even realizing it, I've really been heavily influenced by my sister, haven't I?

lines.content: 放課後の教室は静かだ。
lines.translated: The classroom after school was quiet.

lines.content: もう殆ど人もいない。
lines.translated: There was hardly anyone left anymore.

lines.content: 帰ろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe I'll head home.
*Someone who's going to live at our house starting today*. Just what kind of person is coming, I wonder?

lines.content: 晴れない気持ちをいつまでも引きずりながら、帰り支度をしていた。
lines.translated: Dragging my gloomy mood along endlessly, I got ready to go home.

lines.content: ――……ことん、と。
lines.translated: --...Clunk.

lines.content: 机にひとつ、紙コップが転がってきた。
lines.translated: A single paper cup rolled onto my desk.

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: それをふと手に取った。
lines.translated: I casually picked it up.

lines.content: すると紙コップの底から、たこ糸らしいものが出ていて、それを視線で辿ると――……
lines.translated: Then, I saw what looked like kite string coming out of the bottom of the paper cup, and when I followed it with my eyes--...

lines.content: ……隣の席の子だ。
lines.translated: It was the girl in the seat next to mine.

lines.content: その手に握られた同じような紙コップの底に、たこ糸は繋がっていた。
lines.translated: The kite string was connected to the bottom of a matching paper cup held in her hand.

lines.content: 隣の子はもしょもしょと、紙コップに向かい何かを話している。
lines.translated: The girl next to me was mumbling something into her paper cup.
O-Oh, right, if I remember correctly, *this is how you're supposed to use this*.

lines.content: 紙コップの飲み口のほうを、片耳に当てた。
lines.translated: I held the rim of the paper cup up to one ear.

lines.content: ……おめでとう
lines.translated: "...Happy birthday."

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: そんなかわいい声が、聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: A cute voice like that reached my ear.

lines.content: ……お誕生日、おめでとう
lines.translated: "...Happy birthday to you."

lines.content: 隣の子は――ぼくの、[・|幼][・|馴][・|染][・|み][・|は]、頬を真っ赤にしながらそう言い、安堵したように息をつく。
lines.translated: The girl next to me--my *childhood friend*--said that with her cheeks bright red, then breathed a sigh of relief.

lines.content: ……よかった。ちゃんと、言えた
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness. I actually managed to say it."

lines.content: 今にも泣きそうに微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: She smiled, looking as though she might burst into tears at any moment.

lines.content: ほんとはね、昨日、直接いわなきゃなことだったけど……。でも、ごめんね。どうしてもだめだったから
lines.translated: "I really should've told you in person yesterday, though... I'm sorry. I just couldn't bring myself to do it."

lines.content: 昨日……。
lines.translated: Yesterday...

lines.content: ぼくの誕生日だった。
lines.translated: It was my birthday.

lines.content: 母さんや父さん、そして姉さんたちが、毎年誕生会を開いてくれる。
lines.translated: Every year, Mom, Dad, and my sisters throw a birthday party for me.

lines.content: この歳になってもまだそうされるのは、正直、恥ずかしいけれど――それでも、うれしいのもまた確かで。
lines.translated: Having them do that for me at this age is honestly a little embarrassing, though... even so, there's no denying it makes me happy.

lines.content: そして毎年、仲のいい隣の家の女の子も参加し、祝ってくれていた。
lines.translated: And every year, the girl next door who I'm close with would join in to celebrate with us.

lines.content: でも、隣の家の子は――幼馴染みのこの子とは、昔はよく笑顔で話したり、どこかへ一緒に遊びに行ったり、お風呂も一緒に入ったり……互いの家に泊まったりしていたけれど。
lines.translated: With the girl next door -- my childhood friend -- we used to talk and laugh all the time, go out to play together, take baths together... and even have sleepovers at each other's houses.

lines.content: でも、歳を取る度に昔みたいにはいかなくなって……。
lines.translated: But with each passing year, things couldn't stay the way they used to be...

lines.content: この頃はあんまり話もできていなかった。
lines.translated: Lately, we hadn't even been able to talk much.

lines.content: だから今年はもう、お祝いしに来てくれることはないかなと思ってた。
lines.translated: So I figured she probably wouldn't come over to celebrate with me this year.

lines.content: あ、あのね。き、昨日は、意地悪で“おめでとう”って言わなかったわけじゃ、なくて……。なんだか、恥ずかしくって。気持ちがいっぱい、もにょもにょしてて
lines.translated: "U-Um, you see... It's not that I didn't say 'happy birthday' yesterday to be mean, or anything... I was just really embarrassed. I had all these tangled-up feelings swirling around inside me."

lines.content: だから昨日は、どうしても言えなくて……。
lines.translated: That's why I just couldn't say it yesterday...

lines.content: と、幼馴染みは言葉を詰まらせながらも、言う。
lines.translated: My childhood friend stumbled over her words as she spoke.

lines.content: 幼馴染みの隣の子は、昨日のパーティーに今年も来てくれた。
lines.translated: She had come to my party again this year, just like always.

lines.content: でも、最後までうつむいたまま何も言わず、早々に帰って行ってしまったから。
lines.translated: But she had kept her eyes cast down without saying a word the whole time, and went home early.

lines.content: ぼくは、さみしさを感じてた。
lines.translated: It had left me feeling lonely.

lines.content: そんな自分に、少し、戸惑ってもいたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: And I was even a little bewildered at myself for feeling that way...

lines.content: で、でもね。あのね。昨日の夜、思いついたの。なんでだか[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|た][・|ら]、言えなかったおめでとうが言えるんじゃないかって
lines.translated: "B-But, um... Last night, I had an idea. For some reason, I felt like if I did it this way, I might finally be able to say what I couldn't before."

lines.content: ……こうすれば、もう恥ずかしがらないで、昔と[おんな|同]じように、きみと笑顔でお話、できるようになるんじゃないかなあって……思って
lines.translated: "...I thought maybe if we did this, I wouldn't be so embarrassed anymore, and I'd be able to talk to you with a smile again, just like we used to..."

lines.content: 言いながらもどんどん真っ赤になっていく幼馴染みだ。
lines.translated: My childhood friend blushed deeper and deeper as she spoke.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: そう、なんだ。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: ぼくは言う。
lines.translated: I opened my mouth to speak.

lines.content: 昨日のこともそうだけど……。
lines.translated: Yesterday was part of it, of course...

lines.content: それだけじゃない。
lines.translated: But that wasn't all.

lines.content: 同じクラスで、しかも隣の席になれた。ぼくはすごくうれしかったけれど、君は気まずそうだなあって、思ってた。でも……
lines.translated: "We ended up in the same class, and even got seats right next to each other. I was really happy about it, though I thought you seemed kind of uncomfortable. But..."

lines.content: ……違う。そんなことない
lines.translated: "...No. That's not true."

lines.content: ふるふると頭を振って、
lines.translated: She gave her head a little shake.

lines.content: た、ただ……わかんないけど、すっごく、すっごくね、恥ずかしかったの……きみと同じくクラスで、隣の席になれたことがじゃないよ
lines.translated: "I-It's just... I don't really know why, but I was super, super embarrassed... Not because we ended up in the same class or sitting next to each other, though!"

lines.content: ……大人になれば、なるだけね。“心”が、育っていく度に、どうして、なのかな……きみの顔、まっすぐ見れなくなってきて。ちゃんとお話も、できなくなってきて
lines.translated: "...The older I get, the more my heart grows, and I don't know why, but... I've found it harder and harder to look you straight in the eye. Or even talk to you properly."

lines.content: だから今日までずっと、もじもじもにょもにょしてばかりいたのと、幼馴染みは言う。
lines.translated: That's why I've been fidgeting and stumbling over myself all this time until today, she told me.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|と]、あとね、……ごめんね。謝らなきゃって、思って
lines.translated: "Also, um... I'm sorry. I felt like I needed to apologize to you."

lines.content: え？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why?"

lines.content: だって……今朝からずっと、ため息ばかりついてるよ？
lines.translated: "Because... you've been sighing nonstop since this morning, haven't you?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 誰か知らない人が、今日から家に住むことを憂鬱に思ってて……。
lines.translated: I had been feeling gloomy about some stranger coming to live at our house starting today...

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 繰り返し、幼馴染みはそう言った。
lines.translated: Over and over, my childhood friend apologized.

lines.content: 今日から、きみのお家に、お世話になっちゃうから。だから、ため息、ついてるんだと思って
lines.translated: "Since I'll be staying at your house starting today... I thought that was why you were sighing."

lines.content: ……お母さん達から聞いてない？　わたしのお父さんも、お母さんもね、きみのお父さんとお母さんの新婚旅行についていくんだって
lines.translated: "...Wait, didn't your moms tell you? My mom and dad are tagging along on your parents' honeymoon."

lines.content: わたしは？　わたしはどうするの？　って聞いたらね、隣の家の幼馴染みくんのところに泊めてもらいなさいって言うの。それに……
lines.translated: "When I asked, 'What about me? What am I supposed to do?', they told me to go stay with my childhood friend next door. And besides..."

lines.content: ……それに？
lines.translated: "...And besides?"

lines.content: ……そ、それに、ね
lines.translated: "...A-And besides, well..."

lines.content: 視線を彷徨わせ、ちょっと言いにくそうにしていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Her eyes wandered, finding it a little difficult to say...

lines.content: しょ、将来……
lines.translated: "I-In the future..."

lines.content: うつむいて、小さな声で言った。
lines.translated: She looked down and spoke in a tiny voice.

lines.content: 将来の……だ、だ、旦那、なんだから……、もう、一緒に……暮らし、はじめてもいいじゃないって……そん、な……そんなこと、言われて
lines.translated: "Since you're going to be my... f-f-future husband... they said we might as well... start living together now... Th-That's... what they told me."

lines.content: え？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "Huh? What was that?"

lines.content: きっとぼくの母さんが、この子の母親に“そういうふうに言っちゃいなよ”と、入れ知恵めいたことを吹き込んだに違いない。
lines.translated: My mom must have put her mom up to it, telling her to say something like that.

lines.content: だから聞こえないフリをした。
lines.translated: So I pretended I hadn't heard.

lines.content: 母さんの思いつきに振り回されるのがちょっと不満だったから。
lines.translated: I was a little annoyed at beingjerked around by my mom's whims.

lines.content: でもそうしてしまった後、どうしてだか、居心地の悪いものを感じてしまったのだけど。
lines.translated: Though after doing that, for some reason, I couldn't help feeling a bit awkward about it.

lines.content: そんなぼくに、幼馴染みは不満そうに唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: Seeing my reaction, my childhood friend pouted in dissatisfaction.

lines.content: と、とにかくね！　無理矢理、そういう話になっちゃってて……だ、だから、きみ、ため息ついてるのかなって。ごめんね
lines.translated: "A-Anyway! Things kind of got decided without my say-so... a-and I thought that might be why you were sighing. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 嫌だったらもちろん行かないよと、幼馴染みはそう言った。
lines.translated: If you don't want me to, I won't come over, of course, she added.

lines.content: でもどこかさみしそうだと、そう思ってしまうのは自意識とかが過剰だろうか。
lines.translated: Was I just being overly self-conscious, thinking she sounded a little lonely when she said that?

lines.content: だけど、今はとにかく……、
lines.translated: Still, for now, at least...

lines.content: そっか。そう、だったんだね……
lines.translated: "I see. So that's what it was..."

lines.content: 今日、家にやって来るのは知らない[・|誰][・|か]なんかじゃなく、君だったんだね。
lines.translated: The person coming to stay at our house today wasn't some random stranger at all -- it was you.

lines.content: ……教室を見回す。
lines.translated: I looked around the classroom.

lines.content: 転校生や、賑わうクラスメイトらはもうどこにもいない。
lines.translated: The transfer student and the noisy crowd of classmates were nowhere to be seen anymore.

lines.content: 教室には。
lines.translated: In this classroom.

lines.content: 世界には。ぼくらだけのように、思えた。
lines.translated: In this world. It felt as though we were the only ones left.

lines.content: 色々と安心した。
lines.translated: A wave of relief washed over me about so many things.

lines.content: すると、おかしいな。
lines.translated: And then, how strange.

lines.content: 自分でも驚いたけど……。
lines.translated: It caught even me by surprise, but...

lines.content: ぽろりと、涙がこぼれた。
lines.translated: A single tear spilled down my cheek.

lines.content: ど、どうしたの……っ
lines.translated: "Wh-What's wrong...?"

lines.content: 青い顔をする幼馴染みだ。そして泣きそうにも、なる。
lines.translated: My childhood friend turned pale, looking like she was about to cry herself.

lines.content: ご、ごめん、ごめんね、そんなに嫌だった、なんて……
lines.translated: "I-I'm sorry, I'm so sorry, I didn't think you'd hate the idea that much..."

lines.content: う、ううん。違う。違うよ。嫌なわけない。ただ、安心したんだ。それにすごく、うれしいよ
lines.translated: "N-No, that's not it. You've got it wrong. There's no way I'd hate it. I'm just relieved. And really, really happy."

lines.content: う、うれしい……
lines.translated: "H-Happy...?"

lines.content: ああ。それとね、何でかな……。不思議なんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. And also, I don't know why, but... it's strange."

lines.content: ……なにが？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: うん。君と[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]話してると、なんだかすごく、懐かしいような、胸がぎゅって、するような……。不思議な気持ちになったんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Talking to you like this gives me this really nostalgic feeling, like a tightness in my chest... It's such a mysterious feeling."
"A string telephone, of all things. Even though we've never done this before. ...It's really strange, isn't it?"

lines.content: なぜだか止まらない涙を拭こうともせず、ぼくは君に笑いかけた。
lines.translated: Without even bothering to wipe away the tears that wouldn't stop falling for some reason, I smiled at her.

lines.content: そんなぼくをじっと、真っ直ぐに見て……。
lines.translated: She gazed straight back at me...

lines.content: きみは少し、何かを考えていたようだけれど。
lines.translated: For a moment, she seemed to be mulling something over.

lines.content: でも、きみは笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, she smiled back at me.

lines.content: これまで開いていた距離が一息で昔に戻る。そんな気持ちを互いに感じられたように、思えた。
lines.translated: The distance that had grown between us closed in a single breath, taking us right back to how we used to be. It felt like we both shared that exact same feeling.

lines.content: 今日は久しぶりに一緒に帰ろうか。
lines.translated: Want to walk home together today, for old times' sake?

lines.content: ぼくは言う。
lines.translated: I opened my mouth to speak.

lines.content: うん。……いいよ。
lines.translated: Yeah... Okay.

lines.content: と、きみが言う。
lines.translated: So she said.

lines.content: 手、繋いでみたりする？　久しぶりに。
lines.translated: Should we try holding hands, too? It's been a while.

lines.content: なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: ぼくにしてはものすごく勇気を出して、柄にもない冗談を言ってみたりして。
lines.translated: Summoning a tremendous amount of courage for someone like me, I tried making an uncharacteristic joke.

lines.content: でも、真っ赤になった君はいっぱい、たくさん、悩んでて……。
lines.translated: Turning bright red, she agonized over it for a long, long time...

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 君は、昔からあまり冗談の通じない子だったなと、ぼくはほんの少しのうれしい気持ちと共に、思い出していて。
lines.translated: With a small flicker of happiness, I remembered that she had never been very good at taking a joke.

lines.content: だから本当に、もう子どもじゃないのに、手を繋いで帰ったりしてみたりして……。
lines.translated: And so, even though we weren't little kids anymore, we really did end up holding hands on the way home...
This is it.

lines.content: ぼくがずっと探していた[・|何][・|か]は、これなんだ――君とこうして過ごせる時間、だったんだ。
lines.translated: The "something" I had been searching for all this time was right here -- the time I get to spend with you like this.

lines.content: はら、はら、はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter, flutter, softly falling.

lines.content: さくらの花が舞っている。
lines.translated: Cherry blossom petals danced through the air.

lines.content: これからぼくらの時間にも、こんなふうに、静かに思い出が降り積もるようにして過ごしていきたい。そう願う。
lines.translated: Going forward, I hope the time we spend together will be just like this, with memories quietly piling up one after another. That is my wish.

lines.content: そんなぼくらのお話は、決して世界の中心にはなりえないだろうけど……。
lines.translated: A story like ours could never be at the center of the world, I'm sure...

lines.content: いや。ほんとはどんなヒーローも、ヒロインだって、大勢の命がきらめくこの世界では、誰の“心”も唯一の中心には決して、なれやしないけど……。
lines.translated: No. The truth is, no matter the hero or heroine, in a world sparkling with so many lives, no single person's heart can ever be the sole center of it all...

lines.content: いつだって……。
lines.translated: Always...

lines.content: いつだって[・|こ][・|れ]は、あなたの人生のための物語。
lines.translated: This is always a story for the sake of your own life.

lines.content: ぼくらはぼくらの中心で、ここから、あたらしい“物語”をはじめていくんだ。
lines.translated: Standing at the center of our own world, we're going to begin a new story right here.

lines.content: そんな予感を。
lines.translated: That premonition.

lines.content: そんな、“未来”を……、
lines.translated: That "future"...

lines.content: 『……ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'...Thank you.'"

lines.content: ……ふと。
lines.translated: Suddenly.

lines.content: 『きみがこの世界に生まれてきてくれて、本当に、よかった』
lines.translated: "'I'm really, truly glad that you were born into this world.'"

lines.content: 遠いとおい眩しいどこかから舞い降りた、春の花びらみたいにやわらかな[宝物|言葉]と共に。
lines.translated: Along with precious words as soft as spring petals, drifting down from somewhere far, far away and dazzlingly bright.

lines.content: 君と繋いだ手と手の暖かさのその中に、ぼくは、思い描かずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: Within the warmth of our joined hands, I couldn't help but picture it.

lines.content: ……はあ
lines.translated: "...Haah."

lines.content: ため息をつく。
lines.translated: He let out a sigh.

lines.content: どうして……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: 何度もだ。
lines.translated: Over and over.

lines.content: 何度となく考えている。
lines.translated: I've been thinking about it countless times.

lines.content: どうして、こんなことになってしまったんだろう
lines.translated: "How did things end up like this?"

lines.content: 暖かな風に流れゆくさくらの花が、ふわふわと、ひらひらと飾る、春の青空。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms drifted on the warm breeze, fluttering and dancing to adorn the blue spring sky.

lines.content: その晴れ渡る色彩に、ため息を滲ませるようにして……。
lines.translated: Letting a sigh bleed into those clear, vivid colors...

lines.content: ……ああ。もう
lines.translated: "...Man. Seriously."
I want to disappear and cease to exist right this second.

lines.content: ため息だ。何度目かのため息を垂れ流す。
lines.translated: A sigh. I let out yet another sigh, losing count of how many it's been.

lines.content: すべてのきっかけは数時間前のこと。
lines.translated: Everything started a few hours ago.

lines.content: 友人が発したこのたった一言で、何もかもはじまった――……“なあ、みんな”
lines.translated: With just one phrase uttered by my friend, it all began -- "Hey, everyone."

lines.content: ……なあ、みんな。俺の音楽になってくれないかな
lines.translated: "...Hey, everyone. Would you mind becoming my music?"

lines.content: 数時間前。お昼の時間。
lines.translated: A few hours ago. Lunchtime.

lines.content: いつものようにみんな揃ってお弁当を食べていたときだ。
lines.translated: We were all eating our boxed lunches together like usual.

lines.content: ん？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "Hm? What did you say?"

lines.content: あまりに突然、智仁が“俺の音楽になってくれ”だとか言い出すので、思わず俺は、聞こえなかったフリをしてしまった――……よく聞こえなかった。もう一回、言ってくれと。
lines.translated: Tomohito's sudden request to "become my music" caught me so off guard that I instinctively pretended not to hear him -- telling him I didn't quite catch that and asking him to say it again.

lines.content: いや。だからさ、みんなにお願いしたいんだよ。どうか俺の音楽になってほしいって
lines.translated: "Well, like I said, I have a favor to ask all of you. I want you to please become my music."

lines.content: とても簡単なお願いだろ？　と、智仁は首をかしげるような仕草を見せた。
lines.translated: "It's a pretty simple favor, right?" Tomohito tilted his head as if to say so.

lines.content: いや……。簡単とか言われましても
lines.translated: "Uh... Even if you call it simple..."

lines.content: どこをどう好意的に解釈すれば“簡単なお願い”になるのかどうかわからないが――
lines.translated: I didn't know how generously I'd have to interpret that for it to become a "simple favor" --

lines.content: そもそも、智仁の言わんとする意図さえわからないのに、それを簡単とはどう転んでも言えそうにないのだが。
lines.translated: In the first place, I didn't even understand what Tomohito was getting at, so there was no way I could call it simple no matter how you sliced it.

lines.content: ねえ、ともちゃん
lines.translated: "Hey, Tomo-chan."

lines.content: なんだい、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "What is it, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 大丈夫？　お腹、ぺこぺこなの？
lines.translated: "Are you okay? Is your tummy super empty?"

lines.content: 姫織は目をぱちぱちとさせる。
lines.translated: Himeori blinked rapidly.

lines.content: ともちゃん。いつも私にお菓子いっぱいくれるから……、だから自分の食べるのがなくなっちゃって、頭に栄養、足りなくなっちゃった？
lines.translated: "Tomo-chan, you always give me lots of sweets... so did you run out of food for yourself, and now your brain isn't getting enough nutrition?"

lines.content: ごめんね、大丈夫？　ともちゃんファイト、と姫織は両手をぐっと握って――これからは、お菓子、ちょっとで良いよとうなずいていた。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, are you okay? Hang in there, Tomo-chan," Himeori said, clenching both fists tightly -- nodding as she added that from now on, just a little bit of sweets would be fine.

lines.content: お腹空いたら、私ね、何でだか方向音痴になっちゃうけれども……ともちゃんは頭の中が迷子になっちゃう感じなの？
lines.translated: "When I get hungry, I somehow lose my sense of direction... Does the inside of your head get lost too, Tomo-chan?"

lines.content: い、いや。うん。心配してくれてありがとう。でも平気だよ。お腹は空いてないし、頭も充分、働いてるかな。うん……たぶん。きっと
lines.translated: "N-No. Yeah. Thanks for worrying about me. But I'm fine. I'm not hungry, and my brain is working plenty well. Yeah... probably. Definitely."

lines.content: でも……。兎蛙先輩。私たちが兎蛙先輩の音楽になるって、どういうことですか？　当然ですけど、私たち、音楽にはなれませんよ？
lines.translated: "But... Tooya-senpai. What do you mean by us becoming your music? Obviously, we can't actually turn into music, you know?"

lines.content: ふふん。そんなことはないさ。いいかい千和ちゃん。人は、人の心は、誰でも音楽になれる。絶対だ
lines.translated: "Heh heh. That's not true at all. Listen, Chiwa-chan. People -- the human heart -- anyone can become music. Absolutely."

lines.content: いや。そんな意味不明なことで満面のイケメンスマイルを見せつけられてもな。こちらは困る
lines.translated: "Look, flashing a dazzling pretty-boy smile while spouting complete nonsense doesn't really help us here."

lines.content: ……えっと、つまり
lines.translated: "...Um, so in other words..."

lines.content: ハルが言う。コンビニで買ってきたのだろうサンドイッチを、両手で包み込むようにして持っている。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up, cupping a sandwich she'd probably bought at a convenience store in both hands.

lines.content: 智仁くんは、私たちに何をお願いしたいのかな
lines.translated: "What is it that you'd like to ask of us, Tomohito-kun?"

lines.content: うん。理解の早そうな子がいてくれてうれしいよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm glad there's someone here who's quick on the uptake."

lines.content: ……さあ、これはどうしたものか。
lines.translated: Now then, what to do about this?

lines.content: 幼馴染みが。
lines.translated: My childhood friend.

lines.content: 我が親友が。
lines.translated: My best friend.

lines.content: よくわからないことを語り始めた――……
lines.translated: Had started talking about something completely incomprehensible --

lines.content: 一週間後だ
lines.translated: "In one week."

lines.content: え？　一週間？
lines.translated: "Huh? One week?"

lines.content: 何か、あったっけか
lines.translated: "Was there something going on then?"

lines.content: はい！　私、わかりますよ……ッ
lines.translated: "Yes! I know what it is...!"

lines.content: 姫織がピシッと手を上げ、
lines.translated: Himeori shot her hand straight up into the air.

lines.content: 大雅がッ、大雅が私を、私だけの腹をいっぱいにしてくれるすてきな日！
lines.translated: "It's the wonderful day when Taiga -- when Taiga stuffs me, and only me, completely full!"

lines.content: はは。ばかな。そんな日は生涯来ない
lines.translated: "Haha. Don't be ridiculous. That day will never come as long as I live."

lines.content: けっち……ッ
lines.translated: "Stingy...!"

lines.content: いーっと白い歯を見せる姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori bared her white teeth with a "grr."

lines.content: いや、まあ、うん
lines.translated: "Well, I mean, yeah."

lines.content: ただしひよちゃんが我が嫁に、あるいは彼女になってくれるような奇跡的なイベントがもしもいつかあるのなら――……ふむ。あり得ない話でも、ない
lines.translated: "Though if some miraculous event were to happen someday where Hiyo-chan became my wife, or my girlfriend -- hmm. It wouldn't be completely out of the question."

lines.content: そっかあ。ううーん。じゃあ、生涯ないのかも
lines.translated: "I see. Hmmm. Well, maybe it won't happen in our lifetime then."

lines.content: ……そっかあ。そいつはちょっと残念だ
lines.translated: "...I see. That's a bit of a shame."

lines.content: いや、まあ、そんな話はいいのだ。
lines.translated: Well, anyway, enough about that.

lines.content: ……一週間後がなんだと言うんだ。智仁
lines.translated: "...What's this about one week from now, Tomohito?"

lines.content: ああ。今、俺たちの学園にはとある一大イベントが一週間後に迫ってる。それがいったい何であるのか。わざわざ言わなくてもわかるだろ？
lines.translated: "Right. Right now, a certain major event at our school is coming up in a week. I don't need to spell out what it is for you to know, right?"

lines.content: ……いや。わからない。まったくだ。
lines.translated: No. I don't know. Not a clue.

lines.content: 姫織を見てみろ。“へー？”とか言いながら首をかしげ、何を言われてるのか、さっぱり、といった顔をしている。
lines.translated: Just look at Himeori. She's tilting her head, going "Huh?" with a look on her face that says she has no earthly idea what he's talking about.

lines.content: このとおりだ、智仁。俺たちはその日に何があるのかまったくわからん
lines.translated: "As you can see, Tomohito. We have no idea what's happening on that day."

lines.content: ……え。ほんとに？　みんな、ほんとにわからないのか？
lines.translated: "...Huh? Seriously? None of you really know?"

lines.content: ああ。さっぱりだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Not a clue."

lines.content: 一週間後……。あ、柊先輩のお誕生日……
lines.translated: "In one week... Ah, Hiiragi-senpai's birthday..."

lines.content: え？　そうだったっけ？
lines.translated: "Huh? Was it?"

lines.content: ……だったかなあって。すみません、当てずっぽうなこと言ってみました
lines.translated: "...I wondered if it might be. Sorry, I just took a wild guess."

lines.content: ううん。違うよ。私のお誕生日はもう過ぎちゃってるよ
lines.translated: "Nope, that's not it. My birthday already passed."

lines.content: ハルの誕生日はいつであるのか。改めて教えてもらった。
lines.translated: I had Haru tell me again when her birthday actually was.

lines.content: 先月だ。つまり三月だったことを知る。
lines.translated: Last month. Which meant I learned it was in March.

lines.content: へー。ハルちゃんはハルちゃんなのに、産まれた日は春じゃあないんだね
lines.translated: "Oh, really? Even though Haru-chan is named Haru, you weren't born in the spring?"

lines.content: いや。三月の下旬辺りはもう春なんじゃないかな。暦的には
lines.translated: "Well, late March is pretty much spring already, isn't it? According to the calendar, at least."

lines.content: ともあれまた来年だ。そのときが来たら盛大にお祝いしよう。ハルが恥ずかしがるくらい、盛大に
lines.translated: "Anyway, there's always next year. When the time comes, let's celebrate in a big way. So big it'll make Haru embarrassed."

lines.content: 俺が先日、みんなにお祝いしてもらったくらいには――……と。
lines.translated: Just as big as how everyone celebrated mine the other day -- ...Wait.

lines.content: 話題が盛大にズレてってしまったが……。智仁。一週間後に何があるんだ？
lines.translated: "We've gotten way off track, though... Tomohito. What's happening in a week?"

lines.content: いやいや。学園祭があるだろう？　毎年恒例、“春の学園祭”だ
lines.translated: "Come on. The school festival, remember? The annual 'Spring School Festival.'"

lines.content: 智仁は、信じられない、マジで誰もわかんなかったのかよと、驚いた顔だ――……いや。
lines.translated: Tomohito looked shocked, as if he couldn't believe nobody actually knew -- ...Wait a second.

lines.content: こちらのほうが驚きだ。ああ、確かに。一週間後にそんなイベントあったなあって感じだが……
lines.translated: "I'm the one who's surprised here. Oh, right, now that you mention it, I guess there was an event like that in a week..."

lines.content: お前だってさ、本来、こっち側の人間だろう？
lines.translated: "Aren't you normally on our side when it comes to this stuff?"

lines.content: こっち側とは？
lines.translated: "Your side meaning?"

lines.content: そういう学校の行事にはまるっきり興味ないっていう態度じゃないか。いつも、だ。それなのに知ってて同然みたいな顔されてもな
lines.translated: "You always act like you have zero interest in school events like that. Always. So don't give us a look like it's obvious we should know."

lines.content: まあ、それについて今はいいか。
lines.translated: Well, whatever, I'll let that slide for now.

lines.content: 若干の不満というか、穏やかではいられない気持ちもないではないが……、
lines.translated: I can't say I don't feel a little dissatisfied, or rather, a bit unsettled by it, though...

lines.content: で？　その学園祭が……一週間後のそのイベントが、いったいなんだっていうんだ？
lines.translated: "So? What about this school festival... What does this event a week from now have to do with anything?"

lines.content: “春の学園祭”
lines.translated: The "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: 本来、学園祭というのは秋頃に催されるのがふつうなのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: Normally, school festivals are held around autumn, aren't they?

lines.content: だがこの学園は少し変わっている。
lines.translated: But this academy is a little unusual.

lines.content: 秋ではなく、さくら咲き乱れる春に執り行われるのだ。
lines.translated: Instead of autumn, it's held in the spring when the cherry blossoms are in full bloom.

lines.content: しかも“学園祭”と銘打たれていながら、一般的な[・|そ][・|れ]とは違う――校庭に生徒たちが屋台を出したり、教室を改装しメイドカフェなりお化け屋敷なりを準備するでもない。
lines.translated: Moreover, even though it's billed as a "school festival," it's different from the usual kind -- students don't set up food stalls in the courtyard, nor do they remodel classrooms to prepare maid cafes or haunted houses.

lines.content: 数ある部活動のメンバーが校庭、校内、ありとあらゆるスペースで、新入生を勧誘するため、三者三様、部活動の魅力をアピールする。
lines.translated: Members of the numerous clubs use the courtyard, the school building, and every conceivable space to each show off the appeal of their clubs in their own way to recruit new students.

lines.content: それはまるで、大学のキャンパスで盛大に執り行われる新入生歓迎の騒ぎが、公式に認められているかのようなイベントだった。
lines.translated: It was an event that felt as if the chaotic freshman welcome rallies held on university campuses had been officially sanctioned.

lines.content: ちなみに秋には秋にごくふつうの学園祭も行われる。故に。“春の学園祭”なのだ。
lines.translated: Incidentally, a perfectly normal school festival is also held in the autumn. Hence, the "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: ……正直なところ、面倒な学園だなあと思う。
lines.translated: To be honest, I think it's a pretty troublesome school.

lines.content: 特に、俺みたいにそういう集団行動っぽい催しにはあまり好意的な態度ではいられない者としては、余計にだ。
lines.translated: Especially for someone like me, who can't really take a favorable view of group-oriented events like that.

lines.content: 年に二回もそんな面倒こと、しなくともいいだろうにと――……だが、うん。
lines.translated: They really don't need to do something that bothersome twice a year -- ...But, yeah.

lines.content: 俺たち、別に何も部活動なんかには所属していないし……。まったく他人事のイベントなんだよな
lines.translated: "We don't belong to any clubs or anything... so it's an event that has nothing to do with us."

lines.content: その催しをみんなで見て回ろうということだろうか。ちょうどハルも帰ってきたし、千和も入学してすぐの新入生だ。
lines.translated: Was he suggesting we all go look around the event together? Haru had just come back, after all, and Chiwa was a brand-new freshman who had just enrolled.

lines.content: 音楽云々はよくわからないものの……。
lines.translated: Though I still didn't get the part about music...

lines.content: そういう趣旨であるならば、わからないではなかったが、
lines.translated: If that was the idea, I could understand where he was coming from, at least.

lines.content: 学園祭でライブをしようと思う
lines.translated: "I'm thinking of putting on a live concert at the school festival."

lines.content: ……は？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "...Huh? What did you say?"

lines.content: 思わずだ。また、聞こえないフリをしてしまった。こいついま、ライブとかなんとか言わなかったか。
lines.translated: I couldn't help it. I pretended not to hear him again. Did this guy just say something about a live concert?

lines.content: いや、だからさ。今年の“春の学園祭”で、ライブをしたいと思ってるんだよ――できれば、俺たち全員で
lines.translated: "No, I mean it. I'm thinking I want to put on a live concert at this year's Spring School Festival -- preferably with all of us."

lines.content: ぜ、全員って……
lines.translated: "A-All of us...?"

lines.content: ハルのその表情がさーっと固まり、青くなるのが、わかった。たぶん俺にだけわかる変化ではないだろうか。
lines.translated: I could see Haru's expression instantly freeze and drain of color. Though I'm probably the only one who noticed the change.

lines.content: 本当はここにいる誰よりも引っ込み思案で、恥ずかしがり屋で、いつも緊張とか若干の怖さとかで、その胸はどきどき、どきどき、高鳴っている女の子だ。
lines.translated: The truth is, she's more reserved and shy than anyone else here, a girl whose heart is always pounding away with nervousness and a touch of fear.

lines.content: ……たぶん、様々な未来の可能性について、様々に、想像してしまったのだろう。
lines.translated: She was probably imagining all sorts of different possibilities for how the future might play out.

lines.content: 俺たち。去年は歓迎される側だったんだ。今年はさ、歓迎する側に立っていなきゃあ、それはなんだか不公平だろう？　平等性にあまりに欠けてる
lines.translated: "Last year, we were the ones being welcomed. If we don't stand on the welcoming side this year, wouldn't that be kind of unfair? It severely lacks equality."

lines.content: ……と、智仁くん
lines.translated: "...T-Tomohito-kun."

lines.content: うん。なんだい、ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it, Haru-chan?"

lines.content: その、全員っていうのには……私、私は、入っていないよね？
lines.translated: "Um, by 'all of us'... you don't mean me, right? I'm not included in that, am I?"

lines.content: だって私は去年、まだこの学園にいなかったし……。
lines.translated: "Because I wasn't even at this school last year..."

lines.content: だから私は、まだ、歓迎する側じゃなくって、歓迎される側……、だよね？
lines.translated: "So I'm still not on the welcoming side, I'm on the side being welcomed... right?"

lines.content: もちろんだ
lines.translated: "Of course."

lines.content: にこりと微笑む智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito flashed a warm smile.

lines.content: ハルは、ぱーっと笑顔になるも、
lines.translated: Haru's face lit up with relief, only for him to continue.

lines.content: もちろん。ハルちゃんだって“全員”に入ってる。仲間はずれにするはず、ないって
lines.translated: "Of course you're included in 'all of us,' Haru-chan. There's no way I'd leave you out."

lines.content: そ、そう……そう、なんだ。はは
lines.translated: "O-Oh... Is that... so? Haha."

lines.content: ずーんと。
lines.translated: A heavy gloom settled over her.

lines.content: 暗い表情になった。
lines.translated: Her expression went dark.

lines.content: ハルちゃんには一番目立つポジションを頼めればって思うんだ。なんたって一番、華がある。胸もある
lines.translated: "I'm hoping I can ask you to take the most prominent position, Haru-chan. After all, you have the most star power. And the biggest chest."

lines.content: おい
lines.translated: "Hey."

lines.content: こら
lines.translated: "Hey!"

lines.content: ……最低です
lines.translated: "...You're the worst."

lines.content: はっは！　ともあれそういった話はまたするからさ、楽しみにしておいてくれ。ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Haha! Anyway, we'll talk more about the details later, so look forward to it, Haru-chan."

lines.content: わーい。やったよぅ。私、一番目立てるんだね。楽しみだなあ
lines.translated: "Yay. Hurray. I get to stand out the most, huh? I can't wait."

lines.content: あ、ああ。ハル。死んだ魚の目とはまさにこのことか。
lines.translated: Ah, man. Haru. Her eyes are the very definition of dead fish eyes right now.

lines.content: 明らかに落ち込んでいる。明らかに、今からもうプレッシャーにつぶされそうに、なっている。
lines.translated: She is clearly depressed. Clearly on the verge of being crushed by the pressure already.

lines.content: ……だが、やっぱり、その感情の機微は俺にしかわからない。伝わらない。
lines.translated: Even so, I'm the only one who can pick up on those subtle shifts in her emotions. They don't get through to anyone else.

lines.content: 柊ハルはいつも、いつでも、元気いっぱいの女の子。
lines.translated: Haru Hiiragi is a girl who is always, at all times, full of energy.

lines.content: どんなことでも率先して行動し、自分たちを引っ張っていってくれるのだ――……と、そんな先入観がフィルターとなっている。
lines.translated: She takes the initiative in everything and pulls the rest of us along -- ...that's the preconception acting as a filter over everyone's eyes.

lines.content: 故に。こんなにも、こんなにもわかりやすい表情に、俺以外の誰も、気づけていないのだった。
lines.translated: Because of that, despite how painfully obvious her expression was, no one besides me noticed a thing.

lines.content: ……ライブって言ったってなあ、智仁。あと一週間しかないんだぞ。練習とか……いや、そもそも曲の準備とか。間に合うわけねえって。そもそも楽器とか全然だし。俺
lines.translated: "...Even if you talk about doing a live concert, Tomohito, we only have a week left. There's no way we'll make it in time for practice... no, for even preparing the songs in the first place. Besides, I can't play an instrument at all."

lines.content: そーだよそーだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right!"

lines.content: 姫織も俺の隣で唇を尖らせ、
lines.translated: Next to me, Himeori pouted as well.

lines.content: それにさ、私たちは帰宅部なんだよ？　どうして放課後が来たらさっさと帰っちゃう人たちが、学園祭で音楽しなきゃならねえんだって感じでさ。さっぱりなんだよ
lines.translated: "Besides, we're in the Go-Home Club, you know? Why the heck do people who head straight home after school have to play music at the school festival? It makes zero sense."

lines.content: そうですね……。帰宅部は帰宅部らしく？　帰り道の買い食いに適したお店を紹介する地図とかを作って配布するほうが、まだそれらしいって感じがしますよね
lines.translated: "I agree... Shouldn't the Go-Home Club act like the Go-Home Club? Making and handing out a map introducing good places to buy snacks on the way home feels much more fitting for us."

lines.content: 歓迎される側であるはずの一年生の千和もまた、智仁の“全員”に含まれているようだった。
lines.translated: Even Chiwa, a first-year who was supposed to be on the side being welcomed, seemed to be included in Tomohito's "all of us."

lines.content: みんなの心配もごもっともだが……大丈夫。平気だ
lines.translated: "Your concerns are completely valid, everyone, but... it's fine. Don't worry."

lines.content: 智仁は拳を握る。
lines.translated: Tomohito clenched his fist.

lines.content: ライブでやるべき音楽は、もうとっくにできてる
lines.translated: "The music we need to play at the concert is already long finished."

lines.content: えっ
lines.translated: "Eh?"

lines.content: それに、楽器とかできなくてもできるライブを考えてるんだ
lines.translated: "Besides, I have an idea for a concert we can pull off even without knowing how to play instruments."

lines.content: そう、なのか……
lines.translated: "Wait, really...?"

lines.content: ああ。この俺自身が、ずっと遠くの未来へさえも届く音楽になる。それが俺の“夢”だ。そんな俺が、今までまったく作詞も、作曲も、してこなかったわけがないだろう？
lines.translated: "Yeah. I myself will become music that reaches even the distant future. That's my 'dream.' With a goal like that, there's no way I'd have gone this whole time without writing any lyrics or composing any songs, right?"

lines.content: ……いや。そう得意げに言われてもな。お前が音楽になるというのは、まあ、乱暴な言い方をすればご自由にどうぞって感じだが――
lines.translated: "...Well, even if you say that so proudly. As for you becoming music, to put it bluntly, feel free to knock yourself out, I guess, but --"

lines.content: そもそも“歌手”になりたい、“バントマン”になりたい、“作曲家”になりたい、ではなく。
lines.translated: In the first place, he doesn't say he wants to become a "singer," a "bandman," or a "composer."

lines.content: “音楽そのものになりたい”と嘯くこいつだ。
lines.translated: This guy boasts that he wants to "become music itself."

lines.content: その真意もあまりよくわかっていない俺たちなのだが……。
lines.translated: Though the rest of us still don't really understand what he actually means by that...

lines.content: ……まずはわけを教えてくれよ
lines.translated: "...First, tell us the reason."

lines.content: お前がどうして、一週間後の“春の学園祭”でライブをやりたいと思ったのか――
lines.translated: "Why did you suddenly decide you want to put on a live concert at the Spring School Festival a week from now?"

lines.content: その理由をまずは教えてもらはないわけにはさ、もちろん、音楽活動なんてものに疎いどころかまったくの未経験な俺たちが、進んで協力しようって気にはなれないって
lines.translated: "Unless you tell us your reason first, there's obviously no way we're going to feel like willingly helping out, considering we aren't just unfamiliar with making music, we have zero experience altogether."

lines.content: ああ……。まあ、そうだよな。その通りだ。少し気がせいてしまってた
lines.translated: "Right... Well, you have a point. That's completely true. I was getting a little ahead of myself."

lines.content: ごめんなみんな。そう言い智仁は頭を下げて、『……届けたいひとがいるんだ』と、言った。
lines.translated: "Sorry, everyone," Tomohito said, bowing his head. "...There's someone I want to reach," he added.

lines.content: 俺の音楽。俺の音。俺の言葉だ。そんな俺自身を届けたいひとが、いるんだよ
lines.translated: "My music. My sound. My words. There's someone I want to deliver my very self to."

lines.content: そのためには何より、誰より――この世界で一番、目立たなきゃあだめなんだ。そうでなきゃ、そのひとどころか、誰にも気づいてもらえない。
lines.translated: "And to do that, more than anything, more than anyone -- I have to stand out the most in this entire world. Otherwise, forget that person, nobody will notice me at all."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。ただ作曲しましたってだけで満足しているようじゃ……そんな程度じゃ、届かないんだ。絶対に
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. If I'm satisfied with just having composed a song... at that level, it'll never reach her. Never."

lines.content: だから……、私たちが、協力を？
lines.translated: "So that's why... you want us to help?"

lines.content: ああ。無茶ぶりなのはわかってる。だけどさ。ハルちゃんが帰ってきてくれたから……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know it's an unreasonable ask. But, you see, since Haru-chan came back to us..."

lines.content: え？　私？
lines.translated: "Huh? Me?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: この前の日曜日、みんなで町を回ったろ？　昔のことを色々、たくさん、思い出せた
lines.translated: "This past Sunday, we all walked around town together, right? It brought back a lot of memories from the old days."

lines.content: そう、だね……
lines.translated: "It did, didn't it..."

lines.content: 子どもの頃、みんなで一緒に、どんなふうに遊んでたのか。色々、思い出せたよね
lines.translated: "We remembered all sorts of things about how we used to play together when we were kids."

lines.content: ああ。……自分の“夢”もだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Including my own 'dream.'"
"Your dream...?"

lines.content: 子どもの頃の俺は、どんな未来を思い描き、願っていたのか。それを思い出せたんだ。そして自分の、やるべきこともだ――……いや。違う。違うんだ
lines.translated: "I remembered what kind of future I used to picture and wish for when I was a kid. And I remembered what I need to do -- ...No. Wait. That's not it."

lines.content: 決して忘れていたわけじゃない。ただ、心のどこかで諦めかけていたかもしれない。そんな自分に、俺は気づけたんだ
lines.translated: "It's not that I had forgotten it. I just might have been close to giving up on it somewhere in my heart. I was able to realize that about myself."

lines.content: このままじゃ、だめだ。今まで何やってきたんだよ、俺。やるべきことをやれよ。今すぐに。そう思ったんだよ――そう、思えたんだよ。ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "I can't go on like this. What have I been doing all this time? Do what you need to do. Right now. That's what I thought -- what I was able to make myself think, Haru-chan."

lines.content: だから、俺は……。俺はさ。できるかぎりの最高の音楽を、あのひとに……
lines.translated: "That's why I... I want to deliver the best music I possibly can to her..."

lines.content: そこで智仁は黙ってしまった。
lines.translated: Tomohito fell silent there.

lines.content: そして苦笑いを浮かべ、自分の足下を見つめていた。
lines.translated: With a bitter smile on his face, he stared down at his feet.

lines.content: 珍しい。いつものんきなふうに笑っていることの多いこいつが……。
lines.translated: That was rare. For a guy who usually has a carefree smile on his face most of the time...

lines.content: 何か、自分自身の気持ちに行き詰まっているように、見えた。
lines.translated: He looked as if he had hit a wall within his own feelings.

lines.content: そんな智仁の様子に気づいたのだろう、
lines.translated: Haru must have noticed the state Tomohito was in.

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ハルは、うなずく。
lines.translated: Haru nodded.

lines.content: わかったよ。智仁くん
lines.translated: "Okay, Tomohito-kun."

lines.content: そしてにこりと、笑った。
lines.translated: Then, she gave him a warm smile.

lines.content: ……私、がんばってみるよ
lines.translated: "...I'll do my best."

lines.content: 智仁くんの気持ちにどれだけ応えられるかは、役立てるかは、わからないけれど……。がんばってみるよ
lines.translated: "I don't know how much I can live up to your feelings, or how useful I can be, but... I'll give it my best shot."

lines.content: ……まあ、そうだよな。そういうことになるよな。
lines.translated: Well, yeah. Of course it would turn out this way.

lines.content: ハルの性格上、そうなるだろうとは、どこかで予想できていた。
lines.translated: Given Haru's personality, a part of me had already predicted this would happen.

lines.content: どんなにどきどき胸が痛かろうとも。
lines.translated: No matter how hard her heart was pounding in her chest.

lines.content: どんなに大きなおおきな緊張で、押しつぶされてしまいそうになろうとも。
lines.translated: No matter how much the massive, overwhelming nervousness threatened to crush her flat.

lines.content: ……友だちが本気なら、放っておけるわけないもんな。ハル
lines.translated: "...When a friend is being this serious, there's no way we can just leave him hanging, right, Haru?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ううん。何でもないよ
lines.translated: "Nope, it's nothing."

lines.content: ハルに微笑んでそう答え、
lines.translated: I smiled back at Haru in reply, then turned to Tomohito.

lines.content: わかった。俺も手伝おう
lines.translated: "All right. I'll help out too."

lines.content: え？　いいのか？
lines.translated: "Huh? Are you sure?"

lines.content: ……ああ。準備期間一週間じゃ何ができるかわからないけど――……むしろ足を引っ張るだけなんじゃないかって、心配にもなるけど
lines.translated: "...Yeah. With only a week to prepare, I don't know what I'll even be able to do -- ...in fact, I'm worried I might just end up holding everyone back, though."

lines.content: 俺もだ。俺もハルと一緒に、できるだけのことを手伝おうって思うよ
lines.translated: "Count me in. I want to do whatever I can to help alongside Haru."

lines.content: むー。じゃあ、私も
lines.translated: "Mmph. Well, me too, then."

lines.content: 姫織がそっと手を上げる。
lines.translated: Himeori quietly raised her hand.

lines.content: 大雅がやるなら……、私も、やろっかなあ
lines.translated: "If Taiga is doing it... I guess I'll do it too."

lines.content: あ、じゃ、じゃあ……私も。私もやります。ライブとか言われても何をするのか、何ができるのか、全然、わからないですけど……
lines.translated: "Ah, w-well then... me too. I'll do it too. Even though I have no idea what we're supposed to do or what I even can do for a live concert..."

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 智仁は、ふっと微笑む。
lines.translated: Tomohito let out a soft smile.

lines.content: みんなありがとう。本当に……
lines.translated: "Thank you, everyone. Really..."

lines.content: 珍しく湿っぽい表情を見せる智仁だった。
lines.translated: Tomohito showed an unusually emotional expression.

lines.content: じゃあ早速だ。智仁。お前が一週間後の学園祭に、どんな展望を思い描いているのかを教えてくれよ
lines.translated: "Well then, let's get right to it, Tomohito. Tell us what kind of vision you have in mind for the school festival next week."

lines.content: 今、ここにあるのなら、そのときやろうとしている音楽も聞かせてくれないか
lines.translated: "And if you have it with you right now, could you let us hear the music you're planning to play?"

lines.content: そう言う俺に、智仁はにっこり微笑む――……あれ。なんだろう。どうしてだろう。おかしいな。
lines.translated: At my words, Tomohito beamed a bright smile -- ...Wait. What is this? Why do I feel like this? That's strange.

lines.content: 智仁が微笑むと……。
lines.translated: The moment Tomohito smiled...

lines.content: 急に、だ。
lines.translated: All of a sudden.

lines.content: 根拠もなく、理由もなく、微かにだが嫌な予感が。
lines.translated: With no basis or reason whatsoever, a faint, bad feeling washed over me.

lines.content: ……大雅。ありがとうな、大雅。本当に
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Thanks, Taiga. Really."

lines.content: え？　あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Huh? O-Oh, yeah..."

lines.content: ……本当に、助かった
lines.translated: "...You really saved me here."

lines.content: 智仁はそっと、俺の肩に手を置いた。そして微笑む。満面と。
lines.translated: Tomohito gently placed a hand on my shoulder. And then he smiled. A beaming, ear-to-ear grin.

lines.content: 大雅。役に立たないなんて、そんなことはない。決してない。……ありがとう。むしろ大雅が一番、役に立ってくれる。足を引っ張るなんて、とんでもないんだ
lines.translated: "Taiga. There's no way you'll be useless. Not a chance in hell. ...Thank you. In fact, you're going to be the most useful one of all. Holding us back? Ridiculous."

lines.content: そう、なのか……？
ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 深く、うなずく。
lines.translated: He nodded deeply.

lines.content: 特に、この一週間だ。[・|本][・|番][・|前][・|の][・|ア][・|ピ][・|ー][・|ル]に、大いに、おーいに、お前は役に立ってくれるはずなんだ
lines.translated: "Especially during this next week. When it comes to promoting the show beforehand, you're going to be a huge, huuuge help to us."

lines.content: にっこりと不適に微笑んだまま、智仁は――……言った。
lines.translated: Still wearing a bold, fearless smile, Tomohito... spoke.

lines.content: なあ、知ってるか。大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, did you know, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……何をだ
lines.translated: "...Know what?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 智仁は、そっと俺の頬に触れ、
lines.translated: Tomohito gently touched my cheek,

lines.content: お前、実は、すっごい――……
lines.translated: "You actually have a super..."

lines.content: そんなこんなと――現在。放課後なのである。
lines.translated: And with this and that -- we arrive at the present. It is now after school.

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: 何度となく息をつく。
lines.translated: I let out my umpteenth sigh.

lines.content: そして、思う。
lines.translated: And I thought to myself.
Just who in the world is that?

lines.content: 見ない顔だな。知らない子だな。
lines.translated: That's an unfamiliar face. A girl I don't know.

lines.content: でも結構、かわいい子だな。
lines.translated: Though she is a pretty cute girl.

lines.content: そんなことを思うのだ。
lines.translated: Those were the thoughts running through my head.

lines.content: まだまだ人通りの多い夕暮れどきの参禅町。
lines.translated: Sanzen Town at dusk, with the streets still bustling with people.

lines.content: 満開のさくらの花たちが、おもちゃ箱みたいな町を彩っている。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms in full bloom added vibrant color to the toy-box-like town.

lines.content: そんな人々行きかう大通りの中に……女の子。ひどく目立つ装いの女の子が、ひとり。
lines.translated: Amidst the crowd of people passing by on the main street... there was a girl. A single girl dressed in a terribly eye-catching outfit.

lines.content: 改めよう。知らない子だ。見ない顔だ。
lines.translated: Let me reiterate. She's a girl I don't know. An unfamiliar face.
Walking along while wearing the uniform from Chiwa's cafe.

lines.content: ふへ～、結構かわいい
lines.translated: "Heheh~, she's pretty cute."

lines.content: 智仁がそう言っている。感心しながら。
lines.translated: That was what Tomohito said, sounding impressed.

lines.content: うむ。おっぱいないところがとっても好感持てますね？
lines.translated: "Mhm. The fact that she has no boobs makes her very likable, doesn't it?"

lines.content: 姫織がそう言っている。納得しながら。
lines.translated: That was what Himeori said, nodding in satisfaction.

lines.content: 結構、目立ってるね。町の人たちみんな見てるよ。ウエイトレスさんがこんな時間に外を歩いてるのって、不自然なのかな？
lines.translated: "She really stands out, huh? Everyone in town is looking at her. Is it unnatural for a waitress to be walking outside at this hour?"

lines.content: ハルがそう言っている。狐疑しながら。
lines.translated: That was what Haru said, sounding dubious.

lines.content: いいえ、たぶんですけど……あの子がかわいいからみんな見ちゃうんですよ。つい振り返っちゃうんです。よしっ。お店の宣伝にもばっちりです
lines.translated: "No, I'm pretty sure... everyone is staring because she's so cute. They just can't help turning their heads to look. Yes! This is perfect publicity for the cafe, too!"

lines.content: 千和がそう言っている。興奮しながら。
lines.translated: That was what Chiwa said, sounding excited.

lines.content: ……うぅむ。確かにかわいい。かも、しれない
lines.translated: "...Hmm. She certainly is cute. Maybe."

lines.content: 俺が、そう言っている。共感しながら。
lines.translated: That was what I said, sympathizing with them.

lines.content: ……改めて問おう。
lines.translated: Let me ask once again.

lines.content: あれはいったい誰だろう。
lines.translated: Just who in the world is that?

lines.content: 道端のカーブミラーに映っているあの子は誰なのかな。
lines.translated: Who is that girl reflected in the roadside traffic mirror?

lines.content: ――美少女。たぶん。
lines.translated: -- A beautiful girl. Probably.

lines.content: ――みんなが振り返るほど。おそらく。
lines.translated: -- Enough to make everyone turn their heads. Most likely.

lines.content: ――だけど知らない女の子。きっと。
lines.translated: -- Yet a girl I don't know. Surely.

lines.content: あんなかわいい女の子のことを今まで知らなかったことが不思議である。
lines.translated: It's a mystery how I never knew such a cute girl existed until now.

lines.content: ああ……うん。
lines.translated: Yeah... right.

lines.content: なん、てね。
lines.translated: Just kidding.

lines.content: はは。
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: わかってる。
lines.translated: I know.

lines.content: わかってるよ？
lines.translated: I know already, okay?

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.
That's me, isn't it.

lines.content: どうしてこうなった
lines.translated: "How did it come to this?"

lines.content: 現実逃避の思考から、自分自身のつぶやきで一気に引き戻されて――
lines.translated: My own muttered words yanked me right back from my escapist thoughts --

lines.content: ……どうして、こう、なったの？
lines.translated: "...How did it come to this?"

lines.content: 美少女めいた誰かの瞳から、ハイライトがすぅっと消えるのだった。
lines.translated: The highlights quietly vanished from the eyes of that someone who looked like a pretty girl.

lines.content: どうしてこんなことになってしまったのか――もう一度だ。
lines.translated: Why did things end up like this? -- Once more.

lines.content: もう一度だけ、少し前の出来事を思い出さなければならない。
lines.translated: Just once more, I have to look back on what happened a little while ago.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は俺に、こう言ったのだ――“お前、実はすっごい――……”
lines.translated: That bastard said this to me -- "You actually have a super..."

lines.content: ……大雅。お前さ、実はすっごい、かわいい顔してるんだぜ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You actually have a super cute face, you know."

lines.content: 一瞬、思考停止しかけるも――……
lines.translated: My brain nearly ground to a halt for a second, and then...

lines.content: いいか大雅、よく聞けよ？　今日、これから。お前は[・|俺][・|の]女になるんだ。……いいよな？
lines.translated: "Listen up, Taiga, and listen close, okay? Starting today, from this moment on, you're going to become my woman. ...Got it?"

lines.content: ……バシッと。
lines.translated: Smack.

lines.content: 頬に触れた智仁の手をはたき落とす。
lines.translated: I slapped away Tomohito's hand that was touching my cheek.

lines.content: やめ、てっ
lines.translated: "S-Stop it!"

lines.content: つい、乙女みたいな声が出た。
lines.translated: A maiden-like voice accidentally slipped out of my mouth.

lines.content: 俺に、触らないでっ
lines.translated: "Don't touch me!"

lines.content: 一歩飛び跳ね、後退する。
lines.translated: I hopped a step back in retreat.

lines.content: 両腕で抱きしめるみたいにして、我が身を守った。
lines.translated: Wrapping my arms around myself, I protected my body.

lines.content: ……やっぱり
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: ……そうだったんだ
lines.translated: "...So that's how it was."

lines.content: え？　やっぱり？
lines.translated: "Huh? Knew what?"

lines.content: 姫織がうなずき千和がジト目でハルが首をかしげている――やっぱりふたりはそういう関係だったんだ、と。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded, Chiwa stared with half-lidded eyes, and Haru tilted her head -- as if to say, "I knew the two of them had that kind of relationship."

lines.content: やめろ。やめろってば――違う。まったく違う。俺はノーマルだ。野郎だなんて……同性なんて、好きになれない――っ
lines.translated: "Stop it. Stop it already -- you've got it wrong. Completely wrong! I'm straight! With another guy... There's no way I could fall for the same sex--!"

lines.content: やめろっ、変態っ、近寄るな、変態っ……と、俺は喚いた。
lines.translated: Stop it, pervert! Stay away from me, pervert!... I yelled at him.

lines.content: それは差別か
lines.translated: "Is that discrimination I hear?"

lines.content: ……はぁ？
睨み付ける。目の前の巨体を。
lines.translated: I glared at him. At the massive frame standing before me.

lines.content: 音楽はな、いつだって戦ってるんだよ
lines.translated: "Music, you see, is always fighting."

lines.content: ……何、言ってんだお前
lines.translated: "...What the hell are you talking about?"

lines.content: 音楽の宿敵は差別意識だって決まってる――古今東西。今も、昔も。音楽はいつだって弱きもののために。強者を挫く、そのために……戦ってるんだ
lines.translated: "Music's sworn enemy has always been prejudice -- across all ages and cultures. Now, and in the past. Music is always there for the weak. To crush the strong, for that very purpose... it fights."

lines.content: ……だから急に何なんだ。お前
lines.translated: "...Seriously, what is with you all of a sudden?"

lines.content: 同性との間にしか愛情の所在を見いだせない。そんな人間だっているだろ。生まれついての[さが|性]だよ――生まれついてしまったことだからこそ、自分ではどうすることもできない
lines.translated: "There are people out there who can only find love with someone of the same sex, right? It's in their nature from birth -- and precisely because they were born that way, there's nothing they can do to change it."

lines.content: それを、“変態”だなんて。そんな心ない言葉ひとつで切って捨てようなんて……
lines.translated: "And yet, to call that 'perverted'... To brush it aside with a single heartless word like that..."

lines.content: 智仁は悲しそうな目をする。
lines.translated: Tomohito looked at me with sad eyes.

lines.content: 大雅。俺は親友として、悲しいぞ
lines.translated: "Taiga. As your best friend, that makes me sad."

lines.content: お前の中に[正義|音楽]はないのかよ、と。
lines.translated: Don't you have any music -- any justice -- in your heart? he seemed to say.

lines.content: わけのわからない落胆の表情を見せつけられる。
lines.translated: He flashed a baffling look of utter disappointment at me.

lines.content: ただマイノリティであるからといって、差別されたり区別されたり。悲しいことや苦労を強要されたり……。[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|な][・|け][・|れ][・|ば][・|な][・|ら][・|な][・|い]理由には、ならないはずだろ？
lines.translated: "Being discriminated against or singled out just for being in the minority. Being forced to endure sadness and hardship... That shouldn't be a reason for why things have to be that way, right?"

lines.content: 数が多い意見だからといって必ずしも正しいとは限らないし、数の少ない意見だからといって、間違っているともまた限らないんだよ
lines.translated: "Just because an opinion is held by the majority doesn't necessarily make it right, and just because an opinion is held by the few doesn't necessarily make it wrong, either."

lines.content: 売れてる音楽がいい音楽だとは限らないようにな。そうだろ？　だとか、なんだとか。
lines.translated: "Just like how bestselling music isn't necessarily good music. Right?" And on and on he went.

lines.content: ……俺はさっきからいったい何を言われているんだろう。
lines.translated: What in the world have I been lectured about for the past few minutes?

lines.content: ……じゃあ、ひとつ質問だ
lines.translated: "...All right, then I have one question for you."

lines.content: ああ、なんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, what is it?"

lines.content: 同性の間にしか愛情を見いだせない人は確かにいるだろう。そういう人たちの権利だとかは守られて然るべきだし、ひとりの人間として平等に尊重されるべきなんだって話も、わかる
lines.translated: "I'm sure there are people who can only find love with the same sex. I understand that their rights ought to be protected, and I get the argument that they should be respected equally as human beings."

lines.content: じゃあ、何で……同じ少数派の……小さな女の子が好きな人間は、そんなふうに生まれついてしまった人間の性は、責められて当然といった風潮なんだ
lines.translated: "Then why is it... that another minority... people who like little girls, who were born with that kind of nature, are treated by society as if they deserve to be condemned?!"

lines.content: 同性愛を責めるのは心や価値観が狭量であり、まさにそれは差別であると……邪悪でさえあると扱われる場合も、ちらほらと、増えてきているのに……。
lines.translated: Even though condemning homosexuality is increasingly seen here and there as narrow-minded, as outright discrimination... and sometimes even treated as downright evil...

lines.content: なぜ。どうして。[・|そ][・|れ]はよくて[・|こ][・|れ]はだめなんだ。ロリコンは、許されないんだ。これこそ差別だ。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "Why? How come? Why is that okay, while this is a no-go? Why are lolicons never forgiven?! Now that's discrimination! Right?!"

lines.content: いや。違うな大雅。[・|そ][・|れ]は犯罪だ。犯罪は許されないことだから、だめなんだ
lines.translated: "No. You're wrong, Taiga. That is a crime. And because crimes are unforgivable, it's a no-go."

lines.content: 法律はちゃんと守れよと、いつも音楽の名の下に非常識を正当化しようとする奴が、こんなときだけ、杓子定規なことを言う。
lines.translated: Obey the law properly, he says -- the guy who is always trying to justify his own lack of common sense in the name of music suddenly starts spouting by-the-book rules at a time like this.

lines.content: ……いや。それこそ、差別だろ。マジで
lines.translated: "...No. That right there is discrimination. Seriously."

lines.content: ……いや。いやいや。んなこたあどうだっていいんだ。
lines.translated: Wait. No, no. None of that matters right now.

lines.content: ……どういうことだよ
lines.translated: "...What do you mean by all this?"

lines.content: 改めて、目の前の巨体を睨む。
lines.translated: Once again, I glared at the massive frame in front of me.

lines.content: ……俺が、お前の女の子になるって……いったい、どういうことなんだよ
lines.translated: "...What the hell do you mean by me becoming your girl?"

lines.content: ちゃんとしたわけを聞かず“変態”とあしざまにののしってしまったのは、確かに、早計ではあったかもしれない。
lines.translated: Hurling insults at him and calling him a "pervert" without hearing his side of the story might have been a bit hasty of me, admittedly.

lines.content: だからまずは、冷静になり……問い直さなければならないか。
lines.translated: So first, maybe I needed to calm down... and ask him again.

lines.content: ……わけだ。[りゆう|理由]だ。お前の発言の、真意だよ
lines.translated: "...The reason. The motive. What you actually meant by that."

lines.content: いったいどんな考えがあっての言葉だったのか。それをまずはちゃんと聞かせてくれ
lines.translated: "Just what kind of thought process led you to say those words? Let me hear that properly first."

lines.content: まず話はそれからなんだよと、伝える。
lines.translated: We couldn't even begin to talk until we got that out of the way, I told him.

lines.content: すると智仁は言う。
lines.translated: At that, Tomohito spoke up.

lines.content: ああ……。そうだなあ
lines.translated: "Right... Well, let's see."

lines.content: たとえば、と言って智仁は、微笑む。
lines.translated: "For example," Tomohito said with a smile.

lines.content: たとえば……、千和ちゃんのお店のウエイトレスさんだ。あの制服。つい先日、新しくなってて……。かわいかったよな
lines.translated: "For example... take the waitresses at Chiwa-chan's cafe. Those uniforms. They just got new ones the other day... They're really cute, right?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだな。そう、思うよ。すごくね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Sure. I think so, too. Very much so."

lines.content: 千和が着ると更にかわいいと、そう、思うよ。
lines.translated: And I think it looks even cuter when Chiwa wears it.

lines.content: ……だけど、それが何なのか
lines.translated: "...But what does that have to do with anything?"

lines.content: あの制服、大雅も着てみたいとは思わないか？
lines.translated: "Don't you ever feel like you want to try wearing that uniform too, Taiga?"

lines.content: は？　思わねえよ
lines.translated: "Huh? Hell no."

lines.content: 目を細くする。何言ってるんだこいつ、と。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes. What the heck is this guy talking about?

lines.content: いや。そんなはずはない。ああ、そんなはずはないんだ――……
lines.translated: "No. That can't be true. Yeah, there's just no way..."

lines.content: だって、大雅……。お前さ。実は、そんなかわいい顔しておいて。ただの一度も女装願望を抱いたことがないなんて。そっちのほうが不自然だ
lines.translated: "I mean, come on, Taiga... Let's be real. With a face as cute as yours, claiming you've never once harbored a desire to crossdress? That's way more unnatural."

lines.content: 本当に、さっきから何言ってるんだこいつは……。
lines.translated: Seriously, what the hell has this guy been talking about...?

lines.content: 睨み付ける視線にそんな言葉を込めたつもりだ。俺が？　かわいい？　女装？　本当に本当に、何を言ってるんだこいつ。
lines.translated: I tried to pack those exact words into the glare I shot him. Me? Cute? Crossdressing? Seriously, seriously, what the hell is he talking about?

lines.content: ほら。一度でいい。想像してみろよ
lines.translated: "Come on. Just once. Try imagining it."

lines.content: 智仁は目を閉じた。
lines.translated: Tomohito closed his eyes.

lines.content: 大雅……。あのかわいい制服を着て。ウイッグつけて。お化粧とかもばっちりで……うむ。とってもかわいい。どきどきするよな？
lines.translated: "Taiga... wearing that cute uniform. With a wig on. Makeup done to perfection... Mmm. Super cute. Doesn't that get your heart racing?"

lines.content: ぜんぜん？
lines.translated: "Not at all?"

lines.content: 真顔になってそう返した――おい、いい加減にしろ。
lines.translated: I replied with a completely deadpan expression -- Hey, knock it off already.

lines.content: 智仁。お前、いったい何がしたいんだ
lines.translated: "Tomohito. What on earth are you trying to do?"

lines.content: 早く[・|理][・|由]を聞かせろと、そう言おうとしたが……、
lines.translated: Just hurry up and tell me the reason, I was about to say, when...

lines.content: 賛成！
lines.translated: "I'm in favor!"

lines.content: ……そんな飛び跳ねるような声に、俺の不満も不平も掻き消されてしまう。
lines.translated: A bouncy, energetic voice completely drowned out all my complaints and grievances.

lines.content: よくわっかんないけども大賛成！
lines.translated: "I don't really get it, but I'm super in favor!"

lines.content: 姫織がぴょんぴょんとその場で小さく飛び上がっていた。
lines.translated: Himeori was hopping up and down in place.

lines.content: 大雅が女の子になったとこ、ひよりちゃん、すっげー見てみたいっ
lines.translated: "Hiyori-chan reaaally wants to see Taiga turned into a girl!"

lines.content: 笑顔で小さくジャンプを繰り返す。“何それすっごい楽しそう”って期待を全身で表現、しているのかな。
lines.translated: She kept doing little jumps with a big smile on her face. It looked like she was using her whole body to express her excitement, as if to say, "What's that? That sounds crazy fun!"

lines.content: 俺も俺もー。超楽しそうだよなあ？
lines.translated: "Me too, me too! Sounds super fun, right?"

lines.content: 智仁も姫織と一緒にぴょんぴょんしていた。
lines.translated: Tomohito started hopping up and down right alongside Himeori.

lines.content: 図体でかいのがうっとおしい！
lines.translated: Seeing a guy with his massive frame do that is seriously annoying!

lines.content: そんな憤慨と共に焦りが生まれた。まさかこいつら、本気なのか、と。
lines.translated: Along with that irritation, a sense of panic began to well up inside me. Don't tell me these guys are actually serious?

lines.content: な、なあ、ハル。ハルからも何か言ってやってくれよ――俺が、女装？　女の子？
lines.translated: "H-Hey, Haru. Back me up here, will you? Me, crossdressing? As a girl?"

lines.content: はは、まったく、全然、流れがわからないんだけど……
lines.translated: "Haha, seriously, I have no idea where this conversation is going..."

lines.content: 振り返ったハルは、しかし俺の顔をじーっと見ていた。
lines.translated: However, when I turned to Haru, she was just staring intently at my face.

lines.content: え？　な、何？
lines.translated: "Huh? W-What is it?"

lines.content: 戸惑う。
lines.translated: I felt bewildered.

lines.content: 俺の顔に、何かついてる？
lines.translated: "Is there something on my face?"

lines.content: うん。ついてるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. There is."

lines.content: ハルはうなずき、言った。
lines.translated: Haru nodded and spoke.

lines.content: 大雅くんの顔には、[・|か][・|わ][・|い][・|い]がいっぱいくっついてるよ？
lines.translated: "Your face has 'cute' stuck all over it, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ん？　んんん？
lines.translated: "Huh? Huuuuh?"

lines.content: えっと……大雅くん。ほんとに自覚、ないんだね？
lines.translated: "Um... Taiga-kun. You really aren't aware of it, are you?"

lines.content: 自覚？　いったい何の？
lines.translated: "Aware? Of what, exactly?"

lines.content: 大雅くんってとってもきれいな顔、してるよね？
lines.translated: "You have a really pretty face, don't you, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: え？　してないよ？
lines.translated: "Huh? No I don't?"

lines.content: またまた何を言ってるのかな。この子は。
lines.translated: Now what on earth is this girl talking about?

lines.content: 俺の顔、すっごい男らしいって思うけどな
lines.translated: "I think my face is super manly, though."

lines.content: きりっとしてみる。
lines.translated: I tried putting on a sharp, rugged expression.

lines.content: ほら。生まれついての男らしさが隠しきれない感じ？
lines.translated: "See? Like I just can't hide my natural-born manliness?"

lines.content: それはないよ
lines.translated: "No way."

lines.content: え。ないの？
lines.translated: "Huh? No way?"

lines.content: 絶対
lines.translated: "Definitely not."

lines.content: ぜ、絶対、なの？
lines.translated: "D-Definitely not?"

lines.content: うん。絶対に
lines.translated: "Yeah. Definitely not."
--...Or so she claimed.

lines.content: 小さな頃からハルや千和や姫織の女の子組の間では、ひとつ、話し合われていたことがあるらしい。
