lines.translated: Apparently, ever since we were little, there was something that Haru, Chiwa, and Himeori -- the girls' group -- had often talked about amongst themselves.

lines.content: 大雅くん。目もぱっちり二重だし、肌もまっしろですべすべだし、お鼻もすっと通ってて、でも高過ぎず低すぎない感じで……口元も小さくて
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun, you have big eyes with double eyelids, your skin is super pale and smooth, your nose is nice and straight, not too high and not too flat... and you have a small mouth, too."

lines.content: 大雅くんのそういったところ。私たちから見ると、ぜんぶ羨ましいなあって思っちゃうよ
lines.translated: "All of those features of yours, Taiga-kun... From our perspective, we're honestly jealous of every single one of them."

lines.content: だからね。私たち、大雅くんって女の子の格好、似合いそうだよねって……
lines.translated: "So, you see, we used to say that girls' clothes would probably look really good on you, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: いつかそんな大雅くんも見てみたいよねって……よくそんな話、していたの。智仁くんも入れて
lines.translated: "And that we'd love to see you like that someday... We talked about it a lot. With Tomohito-kun included."

lines.content: 智仁も？　子どもの頃からそんな話を……？
lines.translated: "Tomohito too?! You've been talking about that since we were kids...?!"

lines.content: そうだね。子どもの頃から、だね
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Since we were kids."

lines.content: 知らなかった。知りたくもなかった。そんな心外すぎる話が幼馴染みたちの間で交わされていただなんて。
lines.translated: I had no idea. I never wanted to know. To think such an utterly mortifying topic was being discussed among my childhood friends...

lines.content: と、いうか……ハル。
lines.translated: Or rather... Haru.

lines.content: ハルまで[・|そ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]の人間だとは思わなかった。ハルは味方してくれると期待していたのに。ショックだ。少なからず。
lines.translated: I never expected Haru, of all people, to be on their side. And here I was hoping she'd back me up. It's a shock. Not a small one, either.

lines.content: 大丈夫ですよ。先輩
lines.translated: "It's all right, Senpai."

lines.content: え？　大丈夫……？　何が？
lines.translated: "Huh? All right...? What is?"

lines.content: 確信深くうなずく千和に、俺は首をかしげるしかない。
lines.translated: All I could do was tilt my head as Chiwa nodded with deep conviction.

lines.content: 安心してください。任せてください。お店の新しい制服。大きいサイズもあるんですよ？
lines.translated: "Don't worry. Leave it to me. The new uniforms at the cafe? They come in larger sizes, too."

lines.content: にっこりする千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa beamed.

lines.content: お店の制服、貸し出します。場合によってはお店の[・|宣][・|伝]にもなりそうな……そんな予感もしますし
lines.translated: "I'll lend you a cafe uniform. Depending on how things go, I have a feeling... it might even serve as good publicity for the shop."

lines.content: 真っ青になる、俺――何も、何ひとつ、大丈夫じゃない。
lines.translated: I turned pale -- Nothing, not a single thing about this, is all right.

lines.content: いやっ、いやいやっ、ちょっと待てって……！
lines.translated: "No, no, no, wait just a second...!"

lines.content: 声を上げる。このままではなし崩し的に女装させられてしまう。俺がそうしなければならない理由も何も、わからないままに。
lines.translated: I raised my voice. At this rate, I was going to get railroaded into crossdressing without even knowing the reason why I had to do it in the first place.

lines.content: ど、どうして、俺がっ、女の子の格好をせねばならないんだ……っ
lines.translated: "W-Why the hell do I have to dress up like a girl...?!"

lines.content: まずはその理由を教えてくれないと――いや、たとえ[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら][・|し][・|い]理由を語られたからと言って、“はいわかりました”とは絶対、うなずけないが……、
lines.translated: First, they needed to tell me the reason -- no, even if they gave me a plausible-sounding reason, there was still no way in hell I'd just nod and say, "Okay, got it," buuut...

lines.content: 千和ちゃんの言ったとおり、宣伝だ
lines.translated: "Just like Chiwa-chan said, it's for publicity."

lines.content: ……と、智仁が口にしていく“理由”には、いっさい、俺の納得を引き出せるものは、なかった。
lines.translated: The "reason" Tomohito proceeded to lay out contained absolutely nothing that could convince me.

lines.content: アピールだよ。一週間後に控えた“春の学園祭”――ライブをやるなら、まず準備として考えられることは練習につぐ練習と、次は、集客だ
lines.translated: "It's about appeal. The Spring School Festival is coming up in a week -- if we're going to put on a live show, the first things we need to prepare for are practice after practice, and second, drawing a crowd."

lines.content: どんなに練習しようと、どんなにいい音楽をその日、その瞬間に用意できようと、まずは“俺たち、ライブやります”ってことを知ってもらわないと……
lines.translated: "No matter how much we practice, no matter how great the music we have ready for that exact day and moment is, first we have to let people know, 'Hey, we're doing a live show!'..."

lines.content: そうでなければ全部がぜんぶ、無駄になるってことも、まあ、ありえる話だからな――ライブ会場、来客ゼロ人だなんて、そんなのはあんまりにもさみしいじゃないか
lines.translated: "Otherwise, it's entirely possible that every last bit of our effort goes to waste -- having zero people show up to the venue would just be way too depressing, wouldn't it?"

lines.content: い、いや。だからって、どうして俺が女装なんか……
lines.translated: "N-No, even so, why does that mean I have to crossdress...?"

lines.content: 宣伝。アピール。そして集客。
lines.translated: Publicity. Appeal. And drawing a crowd.

lines.content: そういう目的があるのであれば（そのために何をするのかは未だにもって謎だが）、俺みたいな[奴|男]ではなく、もっと最適な人材がここに揃っているだろうに……。
lines.translated: If that's the goal (though what we're actually doing for it is still a complete mystery), instead of a guy like me, we have much better-suited talent right here...

lines.content: それにさ、智仁。やるのはライブなんだろ？　仮装大会をしようってわけじゃないんだ。それなのにどうして、宣伝するのに女装が必要になるんだよ……
lines.translated: "Besides, Tomohito. We're doing a live concert, right? Not a costume party. So why the hell is crossdressing necessary just to advertise it...?"

lines.content: そう言う俺に、智仁はいやいや違う、わかってないなと、首を振る。
lines.translated: At my words, Tomohito shook his head, as if to say, "No, no, you've got it all wrong, you don't get it at all."

lines.content: まず、ひとつ。確かに俺は学園祭でライブを計画していると言ったが、別にバンド形式だとは一言も言っていないぞ
lines.translated: "First of all. It's true I said I was planning a live show for the school festival, but I never once said a single word about it being a band."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: あ、うん。そうかも……？
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Maybe you didn't...?"

lines.content: まじめなハルがまじめに応え、首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Ever-serious Haru gave an earnest reply, tilting her head.

lines.content: 智仁くんはどんなライブを計画してるのかな……
lines.translated: "I wonder what kind of live show Tomohito-kun is planning, then..."

lines.content: ああ。よくぞ聞いてくれました
lines.translated: "Ah. I'm glad you asked."

lines.content: ……そんな言い方すれば誰だって聞くだろうが。“よくぞ聞いてくれた”も、何もない
lines.translated: "...Anyone would ask if you phrased it like that. 'Glad you asked,' my ass."

lines.content: ぶつくさと言う俺に、智仁は笑顔を向け、
lines.translated: As I grumbled under my breath, Tomohito turned a bright smile toward me.

lines.content: 俺が今回、求めている音楽は。人々の心に焼き付けたいエンタメは――……
lines.translated: "The music I'm pursuing this time... the entertainment I want to burn into people's hearts is--"

lines.content: そこで一言分の空白をわざと空け、ぽつりと、言った。
lines.translated: He paused deliberately for a beat, then let the word drop.

lines.content: アイドルだ
lines.translated: "Idols."

lines.content: ……はい？
lines.translated: "...Come again?"

lines.content: アイドル形式のライブだよ
lines.translated: "An idol-style live show."

lines.content: 楽器を手にがちゃがちゃとやるバンド形式もいいけれど、今回は、違う――
lines.translated: "Picking up instruments and making a racket as a band is fine and all, but this time, we're doing something different--"

lines.content: 歌って踊れる可愛いかわいいアイドルとして、君たちの幼馴染みを、俺が、プロデュースするんだ。学園アイドルグループとして売り出すんだよ
lines.translated: "I'm going to produce your childhood friends as super cute idols who can sing and dance. We're marketing them as a school idol group."

lines.content: ……うわあ
lines.translated: "...Whoa."

lines.content: さすがの姫織も渋い顔。
lines.translated: Even Himeori was making a sour face at that.

lines.content: ……歌って、踊るって。なんだかすっごい嫌な予感がしてきました。お手伝いすると言っておいて、ですけど
lines.translated: "...Singing and dancing? I'm starting to get a really bad feeling about this. And I know I already said I'd help out, too."

lines.content: 千和も鋭く目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa was narrowing her eyes sharply as well.

lines.content: そして、ハルは……、
lines.translated: And as for Haru...

lines.content: ……もう、殆ど酸欠状態みたいに、真っ青な顔をしていた。震えてさえいた。小さく、ぷるぷると。
lines.translated: She looked completely pale, almost like she was starved of oxygen. She was even trembling, shaking like a leaf.

lines.content: と、まあ、そういうわけで
lines.translated: "So, well, that's how it is."

lines.content: 智仁はまるで気にした様子もなく、あるいは気づいた様子もなく……言う。
lines.translated: Completely unbothered--or perhaps completely oblivious--Tomohito continued.

lines.content: そのための宣伝に、大雅。お前だ。お前を任命したいんだよ
lines.translated: "And to advertise it, Taiga. You're the one. I want to appoint you to the task."

lines.content: あ、ああ？
lines.translated: "H-Huh?"

lines.content: 実はかわいい顔をしてるお前の中に、アイドルとしての原石を俺は見たんだ。ずっと、ずっと昔から、今に至るまで……ずっとな
lines.translated: "Deep down beneath that cute face of yours, I saw a diamond in the rough--an idol in the making. For a long, long time now, all the way up to the present... I've always seen it."

lines.content: 俺は顔をしかめる。これ以上ないほど。そして、言う。
lines.translated: I scowled as hard as I possibly could. And then, I spoke.

lines.content: ……今日、こればっかり口にしてるな、俺
lines.translated: "...I feel like I've been saying nothing but this all day."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?
"...A diamond in the rough of an idol in me? What the hell is this guy talking about?"

lines.content: それにお前はいつからアイドルオタクになったんだ。なあ、智仁。お前の武器は音楽なんじゃなかったのか
lines.translated: "Besides, since when did you become an idol otaku? Hey, Tomohito. Wasn't music supposed to be your weapon?"

lines.content: はは！　まあそう謙遜するなよ
lines.translated: "Haha! Come on, don't be so modest."

lines.content: ……俺が、いつ、そんな殊勝な態度を取ったんだよ
lines.translated: "...When the hell was I ever being modest about this?"

lines.content: いいか？　大雅。かわいいお前に、もっとかわいく女装してもらい……ライブの宣伝のため、町を練り歩いてもらおうという予定だ
lines.translated: "Listen, Taiga. The plan is to take your already cute self, dress you up as a girl to make you even cuter... and have you parade around town to advertise the live show."

lines.content: グッと、拳を握りしめる智仁。
lines.translated: Tomohito clenched his fist tightly.

lines.content: 絶対だ。ぜったい爆釣、間違いなしなんだよ。これ以上の集客方法はない。俺の計算ではな
lines.translated: "It's a sure thing. We're guaranteed to reel in a massive crowd, no doubt about it. There's no better way to draw people in. At least, according to my calculations."

lines.content: ……どういう計算式で成り立ってる答えなのか全然わからんけど……俺の話、まるで聞いてねえな。こいつ
lines.translated: "...I have no clue what kind of formula you used to come up with that answer, but... this guy isn't listening to a single word I'm saying."

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: 理由を聞いても、やはりかけらも納得などできなかったし、そもそも突っ込みどころが多すぎて、もう、どうしていいやら……。
lines.translated: Even after hearing the reason, I still couldn't accept a single shred of it. There was so much wrong with this whole thing that I didn't even know where to start...

lines.content: 驚きや焦りを通り越し呆れてしまうこの俺だ。
lines.translated: I was way past surprise or panic at this point; I was just plain dumbfounded.

lines.content: ……お前が俺にどんな幻を見いだしたのかは知らないけどな、智仁。俺に女の子の格好なんて似合うわけないだろ。見ろよ。ガッチガチに引き締まったこの男らしい身体つき
lines.translated: "...I don't know what kind of delusion you're seeing in me, Tomohito. There's no way girls' clothes would ever look good on me. Look at this. Look at this rock-hard, toned, manly physique."

lines.content: 力こぶを作って見せる。
lines.translated: I flexed my arm to show off my bicep.

lines.content: 宣伝なんて。まるで逆効果に決まってる。だから――
lines.translated: "Publicity? This is obviously going to have the exact opposite effect. So--"

lines.content: 往生際、悪いぞ大雅
lines.translated: "Don't be a sore loser, Taiga."

lines.content: 智仁は、真顔で俺の肩を掴み、
lines.translated: With a deadpan expression, Tomohito grabbed my shoulder.

lines.content: 脱げよ
lines.translated: "Strip."

lines.content: いいから、脱げよ
lines.translated: "Come on, just strip."

lines.content: ごちゃごちゃ言ってないでさっさと脱いで、もっといっぱい、かわいくなれよ……大雅
lines.translated: "Quit whining, hurry up and take your clothes off, and get way, way cuter for me... Taiga."

lines.content: やめろ！
lines.translated: "Stop that!"

lines.content: 無駄にいい声で言ってんじゃあねえ！
lines.translated: "Don't say that in such a pointlessly handsome voice!"

lines.content: ……まずい。
lines.translated: This is bad.

lines.content: このままじゃほんとに女装させられてしまう。
lines.translated: At this rate, they're actually going to force me into girls' clothes.

lines.content: ……わかった。観念する
lines.translated: "...All right. I give in."

lines.content: 俺は、両手を挙げて降参の意思表示。
lines.translated: I raised both hands in a gesture of surrender.

lines.content: ここはじゃんけんで決めよう。公平に
lines.translated: "Let's settle this with rock-paper-scissors. Fair and square."

lines.content: じゃんけん……？
lines.translated: "Rock-paper-scissors...?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 俺だけが宣伝要因にかり出されるのは不公平だろ。だから勝負して、[・|ど][・|っ][・|ち][・|が]その“役”をやるか決めよう
lines.translated: "It's unfair if I'm the only one getting dragged into doing publicity, right? So let's have a match to decide which of us has to play that 'role.'"

lines.content: ……俺は、大雅。お前じゃないとだめだって言ってるんだけどな
lines.translated: "...Taiga, I'm telling you it has to be you, though."

lines.content: そーだよー。じゃんけんなんて……つまんないっ
lines.translated: "Yeah, he's right! Rock-paper-scissors is... boring!"

lines.content: すっごく不満そうな姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori looked extremely dissatisfied.

lines.content: 顔をぎゅっとしかめている。
lines.translated: She was scrunching up her face tightly.

lines.content: やだやだ。そんなのつまんないよ。せっかく楽しいことみつけたって思ったのに
lines.translated: "No, no! That's so boring. And right when I thought we'd found something fun to do, too."

lines.content: おかしいな。俺は楽しくない。全然
lines.translated: "That's weird. I'm not having fun. Not at all."

lines.content: いいからじゃんけんだ。それで公平に決めるんだ……。辱めを受けるのは、どっちであるのかを
lines.translated: "Just shut up and play rock-paper-scissors. We'll decide it fair and square... which one of us has to suffer this humiliation."

lines.content: どっち……？
lines.translated: "Which one...?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだ。さっきもどっちがって、言ったろ？　勝負をするのは俺と智仁、ふたりだけだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I said 'which of us' earlier, didn't I? This match is just between me and Tomohito."

lines.content: え？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why?"

lines.content: 奏先輩と、兎蛙先輩だけが、ですか？
lines.translated: "Only Kanade-senpai and Toa-senpai?"

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ……かわいい女の子がかわいい格好して、町を練り歩くだなんて。そんなのは単純に危ないだろ。変な奴に目を付けられでもしたらどうする
lines.translated: "...Having cute girls dress up in cute outfits and parade around town? That's just plain dangerous. What would we do if some creep set his sights on you?"

lines.content: まあ、うーん。……そうかもしれないな
lines.translated: "Well, hmm... You might have a point there."

lines.content: うちの子たちはみんなかわいい。もし変な奴が通り過ぎれば間違いなく狙われる。三人が怖い思いをしたらどうするんだ
lines.translated: "All of our girls are cute. If some weirdo happened to walk by, they'd definitely be targeted. What would we do if the three of them went through something scary?"

lines.content: え、ええ～……、そ、そっかなあ
lines.translated: "Eh, eeeh~...? Y-You think so?"

lines.content: ほんと？　私たち、かわいいの？
lines.translated: "Really? We're cute?"

lines.content: 三人そろってもじもじしていた。
lines.translated: All three of them were fidgeting bashfully together.

lines.content: おおー、うん。わかった。大雅の言う通りだな
lines.translated: "Oh, yeah. Got it. It's just like Taiga says."

lines.content: 珍しく格好いいよね。大雅なのに、男らしいよね
lines.translated: "You're being cool for once. Even though you're just Taiga, that's pretty manly of you."

lines.content: ははっ、何を言ってるのかなあひよりちゃんは。俺はいつも男らしいだろう？　珍しくもなんともなく。女の子の格好だって、似合うはずもなく
lines.translated: "Haha, what are you talking about, Hiyori-chan? I'm always manly, aren't I? Nothing unusual about it. Which also means there's no way girls' clothes would ever suit me."

lines.content: ともあれじゃんけんだ。
lines.translated: Anyway, it was time for rock-paper-scissors.

lines.content: 俺は智仁と向かい合う。
lines.translated: I faced Tomohito.

lines.content: おい、智仁。真剣勝負だ
lines.translated: "Hey, Tomohito. This is a serious match."

lines.content: ああ、大雅。もちろんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, Taiga. Of course it is."

lines.content: 男の戦いだぞ？
lines.translated: "This is a battle between men, got it?"

lines.content: 一回勝負。後だしは負け。それでいいな？
lines.translated: "A one-round match. Throw late and you lose. Fine by you?"

lines.content: いいだろう
lines.translated: "Fine by me."

lines.content: 俺は、にやりと笑って見せる。
lines.translated: I flashed him a grin.

lines.content: 智仁。いいか？　負けたらお前、ちゃんと女装するんだぞ。そしてもう二度と俺を女の子にしようなんて考えるんじゃあないぞ
lines.translated: "Listen up, Tomohito. When you lose, you'd better actually dress up like a girl. And don't you ever think about trying to turn me into a girl again."

lines.content: ああ。大雅もな
lines.translated: "Yeah. Same goes to you, Taiga."

lines.content: 智仁は余裕の笑みだ。
lines.translated: Tomohito wore a relaxed smile.

lines.content: 今すぐ素っ裸にひん剥いてやるぜ
lines.translated: "I'm gonna strip you buck naked right here and now."

lines.content: ……おい。お前まさか、脱がすことに執着してるんじゃあないだろうな
lines.translated: "...Hey. Tell me you're not just obsessed with getting my clothes off."

lines.content: 勝負。
lines.translated: The match began.

lines.content: 最初はぐーだ。
lines.translated: We started with rock.

lines.content: ……結果は、まあ、うん。言うまでもない。
lines.translated: As for the result, well, yeah. It goes without saying.

lines.content: ……どうして、こんなことになっちゃうのか
lines.translated: "...How did it end up like this?"

lines.content: 呆然とする。唖然ともする。
lines.translated: I was stunned. Completely dumbfounded.

lines.content: 勝負にあっさり負けてしまった俺。
lines.translated: I had lost the match without even putting up a fight.

lines.content: 駆け足で家に戻り、制服を持ってきた千和たちの手により……[・|こ][・|の][・|通][・|り][・|だ]。
lines.translated: And at the hands of Chiwa and the others, who had sprinted back home to fetch the uniform... here I was.

lines.content: ……怖い。女の子って、怖い
lines.translated: "...Scary. Girls are terrifying."

lines.content: どこをどう見ても男らしさしかないはずの俺を前にして尚、こんなにもかわいく（自分で言いながらも身の毛がよだつ思いなわけだが）変身させられてしまうだなんて。
lines.translated: Even when faced with someone like me, who should be nothing but pure manliness no matter how you look at it, they still managed to transform me into something this cute (though calling myself that sends chills down my spine).

lines.content: こんなの詐欺だよ。あり得ない
lines.translated: "This is straight-up fraud. It's impossible."

lines.content: 千和の着付けは完ぺきだった。服装だけでなくちょっとした小物などで俺はかわいく飾り付けられている。
lines.translated: Chiwa's dressing skills were flawless. It wasn't just the outfit, either; I was adorably decked out with all sorts of little accessories.

lines.content: こんなのって、変だよ。おかしいよ
lines.translated: "This is weird. It's just wrong."

lines.content: ハルの化粧もまた完ぺきだった。
lines.translated: Haru's makeup job was flawless, too.

lines.content: 姫織のウイッグのつけ方もまた、完璧だったのだ。地毛と上手にフィットさせている。
lines.translated: The way Himeori put the wig on me was also absolute perfection. She had blended it seamlessly with my natural hair.

lines.content: 巫女さんに変身するときの手順が生かされでもしたのだろうか……。
lines.translated: Maybe the steps she used when transforming into a shrine maiden had come in handy here...

lines.content: ひよちゃん。なんて言うか……君はこういうことには疎いって、食欲以外には本気を出さない子なんだって……勝手にそう思ってたけれど
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan. How do I put this... I just kind of assumed you were clueless about this sort of thing, and that you never got serious about anything other than your appetite, but..."

lines.content: ところがどうした。
lines.translated: Look at how things turned out.

lines.content: まだまだひよこなばかりだと思っていたけれど、君も立派に女の子なんだなあ。
lines.translated: I thought you were still just a little chick, but you're a full-fledged girl yourself, huh?

lines.content: ……気をつけないと
lines.translated: "...I need to be careful."

lines.content: ……女の子はみんな“変身”が大得意。
lines.translated: Every girl is a master of "transformation."

lines.content: たとえば、一目ぼれしたとってもかわいい女の子がいたとしよう。
lines.translated: For example, let's say there's a super cute girl you fall in love with at first sight.

lines.content: しかし化粧を落としたその下に、筋骨隆々な男の子が現れることだってあるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Once she takes off her makeup, a muscular, ripped guy might just appear from underneath.

lines.content: 今まさにそのような存在に仕立て上げられた俺がここにあるのだから。
lines.translated: After all, here I was, having just been tailored into that exact kind of creature.

lines.content: そんなことを、かわいい自分の姿を見つめながら思うのだ。
lines.translated: Such were the thoughts running through my head as I stared at my own cute reflection.

lines.content: 大雅くんってじゃんけん弱いんだね
lines.translated: "You're really bad at rock-paper-scissors, huh, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 背後。ひそひそとハルの声がした。
lines.translated: Haru's voice whispered from behind me.

lines.content: ああ。大雅、自覚がないのは女装が超似合いそうな顔してるってことだけじゃないんだ。じゃんけんも弱い。超絶弱い。絶対に最初は決まったものしか出さないんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Having a face that looks great in girls' clothes isn't the only thing Taiga's oblivious about. He's also terrible at rock-paper-scissors. Abysmally weak. He always throws the exact same thing first."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: 驚いたふうにハル。俺も驚いている。
lines.translated: Haru sounded surprised. I was surprised, too.

lines.content: 気付かなかった。知りもしなかった。そんなの十夜をまるで笑えないじゃないか。
lines.translated: I had never noticed. I didn't even know. At this rate, I had no right to laugh at Toya at all.

lines.content: 大雅くんは最初に何を出すのかな？
lines.translated: "What does Taiga-kun always throw first?"

lines.content: 俺も知りたい。俺は、さっき何を出したんだったっけ。
lines.translated: I wanted to know, too. What did I throw earlier, anyway?

lines.content: パーだ
lines.translated: "Paper."

lines.content: え？　頭が？
lines.translated: "Huh? Like an airhead?"

lines.content: ……おい。聞こえてるぞひよちゃん。
lines.translated: Hey. I can hear you, Hiyo-chan.

lines.content: そうだったんですね。先輩は最初にパーしか出さない……なるほど。大発見です。覚えておかなきゃ
lines.translated: "So that's how it is. Senpai only ever throws paper first... I see. What a huge discovery. I'll have to remember that."

lines.content: ああ。今度大雅とじゃんけんするときには試してみるといい
lines.translated: "Yeah. You should test it out next time you play rock-paper-scissors with him."

lines.content: 十夜にも教えてあげたほうがいい気がするなあ
lines.translated: "I feel like I ought to tell Toya about this, too..."

lines.content: え？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "Huh? What was that?"

lines.content: う、ううん。何でもないよと言い、ハルは首を振っていたい。
lines.translated: "N-No, it's nothing," Haru added, shaking her head.

lines.content: で、でも、智仁くん。それってちょっとズルっこじゃないのかな……？
lines.translated: "B-But, Tomohito-kun... isn't that kind of cheating...?"

lines.content: いやいや。ズルだなんて、そんな。勝つことがすべてなんだ。どんな手を使ってでもね。それが男と男の真剣勝負なんだよ、ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "No, no. How could you call it cheating? Winning is everything, no matter what methods you use. That's what a serious battle between men is all about, Haru-chan."

lines.content: ひそひそ、こそこそ、声がするのだ。
lines.translated: Hushed, sneaky voices drifted over to me.

lines.content: 背後から。
lines.translated: From behind.

lines.content: 電柱だとかの物陰に隠れ、俺のことを――恥ずかく着飾られた俺の姿を、覗き見ているみんなの声が。
lines.translated: The voices of everyone hiding behind utility poles and other cover, peeking at me--at my embarrassinglydolled-up figure.

lines.content: ふんっ、もうお前らとはじゃんけんしない。絶対。絶対だ
lines.translated: "Hmph. I'm never playing rock-paper-scissors with you guys again. Never. Ever."

lines.content: 吐き捨てるように言い――見る。
lines.translated: I spat the words out--and looked.

lines.content: そうだ。見る。改めて俺は見るのだ。カーブミラーに映った自分の姿を。
lines.translated: That's right, I looked. I took another good look at my reflection in the convex traffic mirror.

lines.content: ああ。嘆かわしいぞ俺。なんだよ、その恰好は
lines.translated: "Ugh, how pathetic can I get? What the hell is this outfit?"

lines.content: ウエイトレス。千和のお店の制服。
lines.translated: A waitress. The uniform from Chiwa's family cafe.

lines.content: お化粧。付まつげに薄い桃色のリップ。
lines.translated: Makeup. False eyelashes and pale pink lip gloss.

lines.content: ウイッグ。つやつやの黒髪ロング。
lines.translated: A wig. Glossy, long black hair.

lines.content: あれってほんとに俺なのかなあ。
lines.translated: Is that really me in there?

lines.content: カーブミラーや通り過ぎるお店のウインドウに映る自分は……女の子。紛れもなく女の子なのだ。
lines.translated: The person reflected in the traffic mirror and the shop windows I passed by was... a girl. Unmistakably a girl.

lines.content: 怖い。改めてそう思う。女の子って、怖い。
lines.translated: Scary. The thought hit me all over again. Girls are terrifying.

lines.content: 誰もがみんな……かわいいあの子、綺麗なその子も、こんなふうにかわいく“変身”してるんだ。
lines.translated: Every single one of them... that cute girl, that pretty girl, they all "transform" into something cute just like this.

lines.content: 漢気が。産まれ持った迸るほどの熱い男の魂が。うう。どういうことだろう……まるで、ぜんぜん、見る影もない
lines.translated: "My manliness. The surging, fiery manly soul I was born with. Ugh, what is going on here...? There isn't a single trace of it left."

lines.content: ひどい。
lines.translated: It's awful.

lines.content: あんまりだ。
lines.translated: It's too much.

lines.content: こんな姿、絶対、ぜったいに――見せられない。
lines.translated: There's no way, no way in hell I can let anyone see me like this.

lines.content: あさひさんにも十夜にも。もちろんクロにだって見せられない。見せられるはずもない。ああ、そうさ。知られるわけには、いかない。
lines.translated: Not Asahi-san, and not Toya. And obviously I can't let Kuro see me like this, either. There's no way I could. Yeah, that's right. They can never find out about this.

lines.content: きっとクロはこんな情けない俺の姿を見たら……。
lines.translated: If Kuro saw me looking this pathetic, she'd definitely...

lines.content: ……軽蔑、するかな
lines.translated: "...She'd despise me, wouldn't she?"

lines.content: そう思うと、だめだ。いけない。
lines.translated: Just thinking about it was too much to bear. No good.

lines.content: なんだかとっても泣けてきた……。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I really wanted to cry...

lines.content: ずびっ
lines.translated: "*Sniffle*."

lines.content: 鼻を啜った。
lines.translated: I sniffled.

lines.content: そんな俺を……。
lines.translated: And while I was like that...

lines.content: 俺の、痴態を……。
lines.translated: In such a disgraceful state...

lines.content: たくさんの人たちにじろじろと見られ……。
lines.translated: Countless people were staring right at me...

lines.content: ……こんなことして、本当に、意味なんてあるのかよ
lines.translated: "...Is there seriously any point in doing something like this?"

lines.content: 俺の心には深いふかい傷が刻まれた。そんな放課後だった。
lines.translated: A deep, profound wound was carved into my heart. That was the kind of afternoon it was.

lines.content: ――宣伝活動。初日の終わり。
lines.translated: --Promotional activities. The end of day one.

lines.content: 借りていた制服を千和に返却。
lines.translated: I returned the borrowed uniform to Chiwa.

lines.content: 宣伝活動としての手応えはまるでなかった。しかしそんな俺とは違い、智仁は満足げだった。
lines.translated: I didn't feel like we'd accomplished anything at all in terms of promotion. Unlike me, however, Tomohito looked completely satisfied.

lines.content: やっぱり俺の目に狂いはなかった。かけらも、なかった。[こいつ|大雅]は売れっ子になるぞ
lines.translated: "I knew my eyes didn't deceive me. Not even a little bit. This guy's gonna be a huge hit."

lines.content: ……こいつ。[・|次]は絶対、お前を女装させてやるからな。
lines.translated: This guy. *Next* time, I'm definitely forcing you into a dress.

lines.content: そんな誓いを胸に燃やしながら、本日は帰宅することになった。
lines.translated: With that vow burning in my chest, it was time to head home for the day.

lines.content: 暮れなずむ町の色。満たされるのは帰宅を促す哀愁の音楽だ。
lines.translated: The town was dyed in the colors of twilight, filled with the melancholic music chiming to tell everyone to head home.

lines.content: それじゃあね。また、明日
lines.translated: "See you later. Until tomorrow."

lines.content: それぞれが夜に帰りつく寝床へと向かうため、俺たちは“ばいばいまたね”と手を振り合った。
lines.translated: As we each headed back toward the beds awaiting us at night, we waved goodbye and called out, "Bye-bye, see you tomorrow!"

lines.content: うん。おやすみなさいだね。今日は、今日の放課後はね、とっても楽しかったよ……？
lines.translated: "Yep. Goodnight, everyone. Today--after school today was really fun, you know...?"

lines.content: ああ、俺もだ。すっごく楽しかった。大雅を素っ裸に剥けたからな。大満足だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, for me too. It was a blast. I got to strip Taiga buck naked, after all. I'm completely satisfied."

lines.content: 俺は全然まったく、楽しくもなんともなかったけどな。あと、俺を脱がすことに執着してるみたいな言い方はよせ。きもい
lines.translated: "It wasn't fun at all for me, not even slightly. Also, stop phrasing it like you're obsessed with undressing me. It's creepy."

lines.content: きもい、か。ふふ。俺にとってそれはご褒美だって忘れたのか、大雅
lines.translated: "Creepy, huh? Hehe. Did you forget that's a reward to me, Taiga?"

lines.content: 気　持　ち　悪　い　！　！　！　！
lines.translated: "SO GROSS!!!!"

lines.content: そんなこんなとを言い合ったりして、俺たちは手を振り別れた。
lines.translated: Trading banter like that, we waved to each other and parted ways.

lines.content: 今日はお疲れさまだったね。大雅くん
lines.translated: "Good work today, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ハルとふたり、並んで歩く――帰り道が途中まで同じなのだ。
lines.translated: Haru and I walked side by side--we shared the same route home part of the way.

lines.content: ……はは。ほんと、疲れたよ。ほんと
lines.translated: "...Haha. Yeah, I'm seriously exhausted. Really."

lines.content: 乾いた笑みを浮かべる俺だ。
lines.translated: A dry smile surfaced on my face.

lines.content: で、でもでも、大雅くん。かわいかったのはほんとだよ？　男の子なの黙ってれば、雑誌のモデルとかにもふつうになれそうなくらい
lines.translated: "B-But, really, Taiga-kun! You were genuinely cute, you know? If you kept quiet about being a boy, you could easily pass for a magazine model or something."

lines.content: ……ハル。それ、フォローになってないよ。全然
lines.translated: "...Haru. That doesn't make me feel any better. Not at all."

lines.content: ため息をつき――空だ。空を呆然と、見上げる。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh--and looked at the sky. I stared blankly up at the heavens.

lines.content: なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: うん？　何かな、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Hmm? What's wrong, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 今日の[・|あ][・|れ]、ライブの宣伝活動だとかなんだとか言ってたけどさ……。本当に意味が、効果が、あったのかな。俺はまったく手応え感じられなかったんだけど
lines.translated: "He called *that* promotional work for the concert today, or whatever, but... was there really any meaning or effect to it? I didn't feel like it accomplished anything at all."

lines.content: それに……。
lines.translated: Not only that...

lines.content: それにさ。まさかとは思うけど、これから一週間後の“春の学園祭”まで、ずっと[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]続けるつもりなのかな。あいつ
lines.translated: "Besides... I doubt it, but does that guy seriously plan on keeping *this* up for the whole week until the Spring School Festival?"

lines.content: そ、そうだね。智仁くん。明日もやるって言ってたけど……
lines.translated: "W-Well, yeah. Tomohito-kun did say we're doing it tomorrow, too..."

lines.content: ……ぞっとする
lines.translated: "...That gives me the chills."

lines.content: 身震いがした。
lines.translated: A violent shudder ran through me.

lines.content: ……スカート、すーすーするし。あんなの毎日履かされてたら風邪ひきそうだよ
lines.translated: "...Skirts are so drafty, too. If I'm forced to wear something like that every day, I'm gonna catch a cold."

lines.content: 女の子はすごいな。おしゃれのためならただでさえ短いスカートの丈を、更に短くしようとさえするのだから。
lines.translated: Girls are amazing. For the sake of fashion, they'll take a skirt that's already short and hike it up to make it even shorter.

lines.content: ……俺には無理だ。スカートなんて……。もう履けない。履きたくない。ああ。つくづく思うよ。男に生まれてきて、よかった
lines.translated: "...I can't do it. A skirt is just... I can't wear it anymore. I don't want to. Man, it really hits home. I'm so glad I was born a guy."

lines.content: ――いや。弱気になっていて、どうする。
lines.translated: --No. What good does being wimpy about it do?

lines.content: 今度は俺が勝てば良いだけの話だ――じゃんけん以外の何かで勝負し、勝てば良い。
lines.translated: All I have to do is win next time--challenge him to something other than rock-paper-scissors, and win.

lines.content: 明日はあいつに女装させてやるんだ。今度は絶対、勝負に負けない。ああ、絶対だ
lines.translated: "Tomorrow, I'm gonna make him crossdress. I definitely won't lose the match next time. Yeah, definitely."

lines.content: 拳を握る俺の隣で、ハルは苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Beside me as I clenched my fist, Haru wore a wry smile.

lines.content: うーん。宣伝の効果は……、どうなのかな。大雅くんの言うとおり、怪しいところだよね。きっと
lines.translated: "Hmm. As for how effective the promotion was... I wonder. Just like you said, Taiga-kun, it's pretty questionable. Probably."

lines.content: ハルが苦笑いで首をかしげ、俺がそこにため息を重ねようとしたところで――……くすくすと、笑い声がした。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head with a wry smile, and just as I was about to add another sigh of my own--...I heard a quiet giggle.

lines.content: いったい何をしてるのかと思えば……、[・|あ][・|れ]って、ライブの宣伝だったんですか？
lines.translated: "And here I was wondering what on earth you were doing... So *that* was promotion for a concert?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: I look around.

lines.content: ハルちゃんの言うとおりですね。宣伝としての効果はあまりなかったように思いますけど、目立ってはいましたよ。ええ、とっても
lines.translated: "It's just as Haru-chan says. I don't think it was very effective as an advertisement, but you certainly stood out. Yes, very much so."

lines.content: 声がしたほうを振り向く。
lines.translated: I turned toward the voice.

lines.content: するとそこには見慣れた笑顔があった――兎蛙あず咲。智仁のお姉ちゃんだ。
lines.translated: Standing there was a familiar smiling face--Toa Azusaki. Tomohito's older sister.

lines.content: 先輩……
lines.translated: "Senpai..."

lines.content: ふと笑顔になる自分を俺は意識する。
lines.translated: I caught myself breaking into a natural smile.

lines.content: そして『こんにちは』と、『元気ですか、先輩』と、声を掛けようとしたところで……あれ？　まさか、と俺は思い至ってしまう。
lines.translated: And just as I was about to call out, "Hello, how have you been, Senpai?"... Wait a second. No way, I realized.

lines.content: まさか、見られた？
lines.translated: Don't tell me she saw?

lines.content: 先輩に[・|あ][・|れ]を、見られたのか……？
lines.translated: Did Senpai see *that*...?

lines.content: 俺は、固まる。
lines.translated: I froze solid.

lines.content: ……そっか。まだまだ話がよく見えてきませんけれど、でも、明日も大雅くんの“かわいい”が見れるんですね。お姉ちゃん、今からどきどきしちゃいます
lines.translated: "...I see. I still don't quite have the whole picture, but this means I'll get to see your 'cute' side again tomorrow, doesn't it, Taiga-kun? Big Sis's heart is pounding already."

lines.content: くすくすと笑うあず咲先輩。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai giggled.

lines.content: 俺の額にはだらだらと、珠のような汗。
lines.translated: Beads of sweat poured down my forehead.

lines.content: ライブとかが絡んでるなら……、なるほど。あれはきっと、ともくんの仕業ですよね
lines.translated: "If a concert is involved... I see. That must be Tomo-kun's doing, isn't it?"

lines.content: あず咲先輩は微笑みを苦笑いに変えて、
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai's gentle smile shifted into an apologetic one.

lines.content: 大雅くん、いつも弟くんのはちゃめちゃに付き合ってくれてありがとうございます。弟くんの代わりに、私が、お姉ちゃんがお礼を言います。ありがとうございます
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun, thank you for always going along with my little brother's crazy antics. In my brother's stead, allow me, his big sister, to thank you. Thank you very much."

lines.content: ぺこりとした頭を上げると、あず咲先輩はハルへ笑いかけていた。
lines.translated: Raising her head from a polite bow, Azusaki-senpai turned her smile toward Haru.

lines.content: ハルちゃん、久しぶりですね。大雅くんから聞いてました。ハルちゃんが帰ってきたんだって……。やっとです。やっと、ご挨拶できました
lines.translated: "It's been a while, Haru-chan. I heard from Taiga-kun that you came back... At last. I finally got to say hello to you."

lines.content: ハルちゃん？
lines.translated: "Haru-chan?"

lines.content: あ、はい……っ
lines.translated: "Ah, yes...!"

lines.content: 何か呆然としたような表情だったハルが、更に驚いたように目を丸くし、言った。
lines.translated: Haru, who had been wearing a somewhat dazed expression, widened her eyes in even greater surprise and spoke up.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。ぼーっとしてしまってました……えへへ。大雅くんの女の子、思い出しちゃってて……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I was spacing out... Ehehe. I just started remembering Taiga-kun as a girl..."

lines.content: ……やめろ。やめろってば
lines.translated: "...Stop it. Seriously, stop it."

lines.content: 顔を両手で覆い、俺は恥ずかしがってみせるばかりだ。
lines.translated: All I could do was bury my face in my hands in embarrassment.

lines.content: もう、これ以上俺を、俺のナイーブな心を、もてあそばないでくれよ。お願いだから。じゃないと泣くぞ。泣いちゃうんだぞ
lines.translated: "Come on, please don't toy with me and my fragile heart anymore. I'm begging you. Or else I'm gonna cry. I'll really start crying."

lines.content: めそめそとしながら、言った――ああ、俺の男らしさはどこへいったんだよ。そんなことを思いながらも。
lines.translated: I whimpered out the words--Man, where the heck did my masculinity go? Even as that thought crossed my mind...

lines.content: そんな俺はあず咲先輩に、改めて言う。
lines.translated: I turned back to Azusaki-senpai and greeted her properly.

lines.content: こんにちは、先輩
lines.translated: "Hello, Senpai."

lines.content: ええ。こんにちはです。大雅くん。ハルちゃんも
lines.translated: "Yes, hello to you too, Taiga-kun. And to you, Haru-chan."

lines.content: ぺこりとハルは先輩に頭を下げた。
lines.translated: Haru gave Senpai a polite little bow.

lines.content: 石橋の上。三人で少し話をすることにする。
lines.translated: Right there on the stone bridge, the three of us decided to chat for a bit.

lines.content: 先輩。今日はどうしたんですか？　何か智仁に用があったとか？
lines.translated: "Senpai, what brings you out here today? Did you have some business with Tomohito?"

lines.content: ええ、そうです。そうなんです
lines.translated: "Yes, I did. That's right."

lines.content: ちょっと聞いてくださいよとあず咲先輩は、言う。
lines.translated: "Listen to this," Azusaki-senpai said.

lines.content: ともくんとちょっと話がしたくて家に寄ったんですけど……
lines.translated: "I wanted to have a quick talk with Tomo-kun, so I stopped by the house, but..."

lines.content: でも家は無人だった。
lines.translated: Nobody was home.

lines.content: 少し家で待ってたんですけれど、ともくん、中々帰ってこなくて……
lines.translated: "I waited at the house for a little while, but Tomo-kun just wasn't coming back..."

lines.content: 帰りのバスの時間も近いから、だから迎えに出てみたんです……するとまさか、です
lines.translated: "It was getting close to the time for my bus back, so I decided to come out and meet him on the way... And then, well, what a surprise."

lines.content: あず咲先輩はにこにことしながら、
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai beamed as she continued.

lines.content: まさかまさか、大雅くんのあんなかわいい姿を見せてもらえるだなんて。思いも寄らない幸運でした
lines.translated: "Never in my wildest dreams did I expect to be treated to such an adorable sight of you, Taiga-kun. What an unexpected stroke of luck."

lines.content: ……うう。ひどい。もうその話は終わったのかと思ったのに
lines.translated: "...Ugh. That's cruel. And here I thought we were done with that topic."

lines.content: 絶望的な気持ちになった。
lines.translated: A wave of despair washed over me.

lines.content: どうかあの弟を止めてくださいと懇願しそうになったけれど……。
lines.translated: I was on the verge of begging her to please stop that little brother of hers, when...

lines.content: ともくん、まだ怒ってるのかなあ……
lines.translated: "I wonder if Tomo-kun is still mad at me..."

lines.content: ……ぽつりと。
lines.translated: Quietly.

lines.content: あず咲先輩がさみしそうにそうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai murmured the words with a lonely look on her face.

lines.content: 怒ってる？　智仁くんが？
lines.translated: "Mad? Tomohito-kun is?"

lines.content: 私たち、ずっと喧嘩したままなんですよね。どこにでもよくある姉弟喧嘩ですけれど、ちょっと長引いてしまっています
lines.translated: "The two of us have been in the middle of a fight for a long time now. It's just a typical sibling quarrel you'd see anywhere, but it's dragged on a bit."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai gave a wry smile.

lines.content: どうしたらともくん、許してくれるのかなあ……。私、早く仲直りしたいのになあ
lines.translated: "I wonder what it'll take for Tomo-kun to forgive me... I really want us to make up soon."

lines.content: ため息をつくようにそう零したあず咲先輩は、暮れゆく空を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Breathing the words out like a sigh, Azusaki-senpai gazed up at the darkening sky.

lines.content: そんな先輩の横顔を前に、ハルは何もせずになどいられなかったのだろう、
lines.translated: Faced with Senpai's profile, Haru probably couldn't bear to just stand by and do nothing.

lines.content: ……ライブを見に来ませんか？　あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "...Would you like to come see the concert, Azusaki-senpai?"

lines.content: 恐る恐ると言う具合に、そう言った。
lines.translated: She asked the question hesitantly, almost timidly.

lines.content: え？　ライブを、ですか？
lines.translated: "Huh? The concert?"

lines.content: はい……
智仁くんがいったいどんな歌を用意してるのか、どんなライブを計画してるのか、まだまだ私たちは何も聞かされていませんけれど……
lines.translated: "We still haven't been told anything about what kind of song Tomohito-kun is preparing, or what kind of concert he's planning, though..."

lines.content: だけど、智仁くん。誰かに届けたい音楽があるって言ってました。だから今年の学園祭で……“春の学園祭”でライブをしたいとは聞いてます
lines.translated: "Even so, Tomohito-kun said there's music he wants to deliver to someone. That's why I heard he wants to put on a concert at this year's school festival... at the 'Spring School Festival.'"

lines.content: そうなんですか……。誰かに届けたい音楽、か。なんだかともくんらしいですね
lines.translated: "Is that so...? Music he wants to deliver to someone, huh? That sounds just like Tomo-kun."

lines.content: はい。私、もしかしたらって思って……
lines.translated: "Yes. I thought, just maybe..."

lines.content: ……もしかしたら、その“誰か”とは。
lines.translated: Just maybe, that "someone"...

lines.content: 仲間たちにわざわざ紹介するまでもなく、明確な“誰か”なのではないか。
lines.translated: Was a very specific "someone" he didn't even need to bother introducing to his friends.

lines.content: ハルはそのように予想してしまっているのだろう。
lines.translated: Haru had likely jumped to that conclusion.

lines.content: だから頼まれもしないのに（だ、なんて言うのは乱暴かもしれないが）、こうして誘いの言葉をかけたのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Which is why, even without being asked (though putting it like that might be a bit harsh), she had extended this invitation...

lines.content: しかし[・|当][・|の][・|本][・|人]は“その誰かっていったい誰なんだろう”、という顔をするばかりだった。
lines.translated: However, *the person in question* only wore a puzzled look that said, "I wonder who on earth that 'someone' could be?"

lines.content: だから俺たちもそれ以上は何も言えず。
lines.translated: And so, neither of us could say anything further.

lines.content: 当事者たちを置いてきぼりに、余計なことは何も、言うこともできず……。
lines.translated: Unable to butt in and say anything unnecessary that might leave the two of them behind...

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: はい？
lines.translated: "Excuse me?"

lines.content: ……早く、仲直りできたらいいですね
lines.translated: "...I hope the two of you can make up soon."

lines.content: ふたりがどんなことで喧嘩してしまっているのかは……わかりませんけれど。昔みたいに笑って話せる、そんな日が早くくれば、いいですね
lines.translated: "I don't know... what the two of you are fighting over, though. I just hope the day comes soon when you can laugh and talk like you used to."

lines.content: ……こんなふうに、あまりにも当たり障りのない言葉で、色々なものを濁すことしか、できなかった。
lines.translated: All I could do was gloss over everything with such terribly safe, noncommittal words.

lines.content: ……奏大雅。悪いが、お前には負けられないんだ
lines.translated: "...Taiga Kanade. Sorry, but I can't afford to lose to you."

lines.content: 十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: きらきら眩しい“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: In the dazzling, sparkling "Night"...

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”が、俺たち“魔法”を求めて集められた少年少女に様々な問いを投げかける――“満月の夜会”でのことだ。
lines.translated: It happened at the "Full Moon Soiree"--where the "Magician of the Night" posed various questions to us boys and girls who had been gathered in search of "magic."

lines.content: 俺はどうしても“夜の魔法使い”から、あさひさんから、[・|あ][・|の][・|役][・|割]を譲ってもらわなきゃならない。そのためにここに来た
lines.translated: "No matter what it takes, I have to get Asahi-san--the 'Magician of the Night'--to hand *that role* over to me. That's why I came here."

lines.content: 幼い俺は、同じように幼かった智仁から、まるで挑戦状めいた言葉と鋭い眼差しを向けられていた――“君はどこから来て、どんな願いを持っているのかな”
lines.translated: Back when I was a kid, an equally young Tomohito had fixed me with a sharp glare and words that sounded just like a challenge--"Where did you come from, and what kind of wish do you have?"

lines.content: そんな言葉を、挨拶代わりに投げかけてしまったことを俺はすぐさま後悔していた。
lines.translated: I immediately regretted tossing those words at him by way of a casual greeting.

lines.content: 俺は、姉ちゃんを助けるんだ。誰にも邪魔はさせない――奏大雅。もしもお前が俺の邪魔しようっていうのなら。いいか、容赦はしないぞ。わかったな
lines.translated: "I'm going to save my big sister. I won't let anyone get in my way--Taiga Kanade. If you're planning to stand in my way, listen up: I won't show any mercy. Got it?"

lines.content: 子どもらしく稚気に富んだ挑発の言葉だった。
lines.translated: It was a provocation brimming with childish naivete.

lines.content: そんな態度に、少なからずムッとくるところもあったのかもしれない、
lines.translated: Maybe his attitude rubbed me the wrong way more than a little.

lines.content: どうして君があの役割に、“魔法少女『使い』”……だったっけ。そんなものに拘るのか。まるで、全然、わからないな
lines.translated: "Why are you so fixated on that role--the 'Magical Girl Master'... was it? I don't get it. Not at all."

lines.content: 少し突き放すような口調で、俺はそう応えていた。
lines.translated: I replied in a somewhat standoffish tone.

lines.content: 君のお姉さんがどんなことで苦しんでいるのかはわからないし、そんなお姉さんを助けるために、君がどんな“魔法”を必要としているのかは……わからないけれど
lines.translated: "I don't know what's making your sister suffer, and I don't know... what kind of 'magic' you need to save her, either."

lines.content: ……今の俺は、そんなもの、わかろうとも思わないけれど
lines.translated: "...And right now, I don't have any intention of trying to understand it."

lines.content: “夜の王”だよ
lines.translated: "It's the 'King of the Night.'"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を倒せば願いは叶う
lines.translated: "Defeat *that*, and your wish will come true."

lines.content: 君だけじゃない。ここに集められた全員の願いがだ。そのための“魔法”を贈ると、“夜の魔法使い”は言っていたと思うけれど
lines.translated: "And not just yours. The wishes of everyone gathered here. I'm pretty sure the 'Magician of the Night' said she'd grant us the 'magic' to do that."

lines.content: だから彼が、智仁が、[・|そ][・|の][・|役][・|割]に固執する理由がわからなかった――わからなかったが、正直なところどうでもよかった。そんなことに拘っていられる余裕はなかった。
lines.translated: That's why I couldn't understand why he--why Tomohito--was so obsessed with *that role*--I didn't understand, and to be honest, I didn't care. I didn't have the leeway to get hung up on something like that.

lines.content: 別に、その役割事態には、俺は興味がないんだ。あさひさんは俺と君と、どっちが[・|そ][・|れ]に相応しいのかを[・|い][・|つ][・|か]決めると言っていたけれど、そんな面倒なこと、君に譲るよ
lines.translated: "I don't really have any interest in the role itself. Asahi-san said she'd decide *someday* which of us is more suited for *it*, me or you, but you're welcome to have such a troublesome job."
*As long as it's after I've used that "role" for my own purpose, you can have it all you want.*

lines.content: だから争う必要なんてどこにもない。
lines.translated: So there's no need for us to fight at all.

lines.content: そう伝えたかったのだけど、しかしあの頃の智仁は、そんな俺にまったく警戒心を緩めることなく――ただただ、鋭い視線を送り続けていた。
lines.translated: That's what I wanted to tell him, yet Tomohito back then didn't lower his guard around me in the slightest--he just kept shooting me that piercing glare.

lines.content: ……未来。それから十年後。
lines.translated: The future. Ten years later.

lines.content: この少年が、誰よりものんきな笑顔が似合う奴になろうとは、きっと、このときは誰も想像も出来なかったはずだ――たったひとりを、除いては。
lines.translated: Surely no one back then could have imagined that this boy would grow into someone who suited a carefree smile better than anyone else--with the exception of one single person.

lines.content: ……ごめんね、大雅くん。弟くんがひどいこと言って
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga-kun. My little brother said some terrible things to you."

lines.content: 困ったように笑う女の子は、俺にそう言った。
lines.translated: The girl gave me a troubled smile as she spoke.

lines.content: ――さんざん悪態をついた後、俺を置いて“ゆめのねどこ”を飛び出していった少年。その代わりに顔を出した女の子だ。
lines.translated: --After hurling a string of insults at me, the boy had stormed out of the "Bed of Dreams," leaving me behind. She was the girl who had poked her head in to take his place.

lines.content: ああ、この人があいつのお姉さんだ。そう直感できた。
lines.translated: Ah, this person is his older sister. I knew it intuitively.

lines.content: なぜならとってもふたりは良くよく似ていたし、そもそも“弟くん”と彼を呼ぶその声には、彼のことを心底心配に思う気持ちばかりが溢れていたから。
lines.translated: Because the two of them looked remarkably alike, and above all, the voice that called him "my little brother" was overflowing with nothing but heartfelt worry for him.

lines.content: 本当はやさしい子なの。本当はね、喧嘩なんて……、そんなことできるような子じゃないの
lines.translated: "He's really a sweet boy. Really, fighting... he isn't the kind of boy who can do things like that."

lines.content: 身体は大きいけど、泣き虫だし、さみしがり屋だし……
lines.translated: "He's big for his age, sure, but he's a crybaby, and he gets lonely easily..."

lines.content: そんなことを聞いてしまっていいのかなと思った。
lines.translated: I wondered if it was really okay for me to be hearing all this.

lines.content: また怒り出すんじゃないだろうか。今度は、恥ずかしがったりしながらも。
lines.translated: Wouldn't he fly off the handle again? Though this time, he'd probably be embarrassed, too.

lines.content: だからお願い。大雅くん
lines.translated: "So please, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: もしも良ければ弟くんを許してくれたらうれしいな……。もしも良ければ、仲良くしてくれたら、うれしいな
lines.translated: "If you don't mind, it would make me really happy if you could forgive my little brother... And if you don't mind, I'd be so glad if you could get along with him."

lines.content: にっこりと、困ったように笑う――そんな笑い方がどうしてだかとても良く似合ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: She gave a bright yet troubled smile--for some reason, that kind of expression suited her all too well.

lines.content: この女の子にこんな顔をさせるあいつに、俺は憤りを感じてはいただろうけれど、
lines.translated: I probably felt a flash of indignation toward that guy for making this girl wear such a face, yet...

lines.content: ……うん。わかった。あいつがいいなら
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Okay. As long as he's fine with it."

lines.content: 俺はそう言い、うなずいた。
lines.translated: I said that and nodded.

lines.content: 確かに悪態をつかれはしたけれど、確かにムッとしたことは認めるけれど……。
lines.translated: True, he had mouthed off at me, and I'll admit it ticked me off, but...

lines.content: しかし不思議とあまり憎いとは思えなかった。
lines.translated: Strangely enough, I couldn't really bring myself to hate him.

lines.content: まるで、誰かを“敵役”にでもしなければ耐えられない――そんな[すが|縋]るような気持ちさえ、幼い俺にでも彼の視線の中には、感じられていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Even as a kid, maybe I had sensed a desperate, clinging emotion in his eyes--as if he couldn't bear to go on unless he cast someone as the "villain."

lines.content: ありがとう……
lines.translated: "Thank you..."

lines.content: だけど、女の子はやっぱり困ったような笑顔でうなずいた。
lines.translated: Even so, the girl nodded with that same troubled smile.

lines.content: ともくんがああなってしまったのは、無理を、させてしまっているのは……全部、ぜんぶ、私のせいだから
lines.translated: "The reason Tomo-kun ended up like that, the reason he's pushing himself so hard... is all, every bit of it, my fault."

lines.content: だからきっと、私がいなくなれば……
lines.translated: "So I'm sure that once I'm gone..."

lines.content: そこで唇を結び、困ったような笑顔で首をかしげる――そんなあの人のことを、俺は[・|今]でも時どき、思い返してしまう。
lines.translated: She pressed her lips together there and tilted her head with a troubled smile--even *now*, I still find myself thinking back to her from time to time.

lines.content: ……この“役割”を、本当に俺が引き継いでしまってよかったのかな、と。
lines.translated: Wondering if it was really okay for me to have taken over this "role."

lines.content: 自室へ戻ると特別な電話が鳴った。
lines.translated: When I returned to my room, my special phone rang.

lines.content: お風呂上がりの湿った髪をタオルで拭きながら、急いでその端末を取り上げた。
lines.translated: Toweling off my damp hair fresh out of the bath, I hurriedly picked up the device.

lines.content: ぶるりと震える。
lines.translated: A shiver ran through it.

lines.content: ……携帯だけではなく、俺自身も。
lines.translated: Not just the phone, either, but me as well.

lines.content: 少し身体が冷えていた。
lines.translated: My body had gotten a little chilled.

lines.content: 湯上り後に身体も拭かず[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]をしていたから……。
lines.translated: Because right after getting out of the bath, I'd been doing *that* without even drying myself off...

lines.content: 洗面台。鏡の前で顔を引き締め、男らしいポーズを取ってみたりする。
lines.translated: At the bathroom sink, I tensed up my face in front of the mirror and tried striking a few manly poses.

lines.content: 脳内に染み込んだ自分の[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|姿]に上書きして消去するためだ。
lines.translated: To overwrite and erase the image of myself looking *like that* that had been burned into my brain.

lines.content: 『うむ。大丈夫。俺、男の子』
lines.translated: "Mhm. It's fine. I'm a boy."

lines.content: 見ろよこのシックスパック。キレッ、キレ。
lines.translated: Look at this six-pack. Totally shredded.

lines.content: かわいいなんてどこにもない。かけらもない。
lines.translated: There's nothing cute here at all. Not a single shred of it.

lines.content: 実に男の子らしい身体の細部を確認する。
lines.translated: I inspected the finer details of my thoroughly boyish physique.

lines.content: 俺は鏡の中の俺に内心で声をかけてみたりもする――……大雅！　キレてるよ！　格好いいよ！
lines.translated: I even tried cheering on the me in the mirror inside my head--...Taiga! Looking shredded! Looking cool!

lines.content: 『抱いてっ大雅っいいよっお願いっめちゃくちゃにして……っ』
lines.translated: "Hold me, Taiga, yes, please, mess me up...!"

lines.content: 『……大雅。何やってるの』
lines.translated: "...Taiga. What are you doing?"

lines.content: 心の声が漏れていた。そして、聞かれた。十夜に聞かれた。
lines.translated: My inner voice had leaked out. And I was heard. Toya heard me.

lines.content: 『……大雅。あのね、大雅。お腹も力こぶもぷにぷにしてるよ。お肌も真っ白。女の子みたい』
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Hey, Taiga. Your tummy and your biceps are both super squishy, you know. And your skin is pure white. Just like a girl's."

lines.content: 『もっと鍛えたほうがいいんではないでしょうか……と、とてもやさしいお姉ちゃんの、とっても賢い妹は、そう思うのでした』
lines.translated: "Might it not be better to work out some more... or so the very smart little sister of a very kind big sister thought to herself."

lines.content: どん引きされたような目で十夜は言った。
lines.translated: Toya said this, looking thoroughly weirded out.

lines.content: い、いいんだ。平気だ。大丈夫。
lines.translated: I-It's fine. I'm okay. Totally fine.

lines.content: ちょっと生意気盛りの幼女に何を見られたところで、どんなに蔑まれたところで、俺の羞恥心はびくともしない。ほんの少しも刺激されようはずもない。
lines.translated: No matter what a little girl at the peak of her sassy phase sees me doing, no matter how much she looks down on me, my sense of shame won't even flinch. There's no way it could be stirred up in the slightest.
After *that*.

lines.content: 何せあんな姿を、大勢の前に晒されてしまったのだから――……図太くだってなる。多少なりとも。
lines.translated: After all, having been exposed looking like that in front of a huge crowd--...it's only natural I'd develop a thicker skin. At least a little bit.

lines.content: ……いけない、いけない
lines.translated: "...No, no, bad."

lines.content: また思い出してしまった。せっかく男らしく上書きできたはずの、自分の[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|姿]を。
lines.translated: I remembered it again. That image of myself looking *like that*, which I'd finally managed to overwrite with something manly.

lines.content: 頭を振って通話ボタンを俺は押した。
lines.translated: Shaking my head, I pressed the call button.

lines.content: もしもし？
lines.translated: "Hello?"

lines.content: 最初は、沈黙。無言だけが返される。
lines.translated: At first, silence. Only wordlessness answered me.

lines.content: クロ……？
lines.translated: "Kuro...?"

lines.content: それ以外あり得ないとわかっていながら、俺はその名前を呼んでみた。
lines.translated: Even knowing it couldn't possibly be anyone else, I tried calling that name.

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: すると微かな声が返された。
lines.translated: And then, a faint voice answered back.

lines.content: わたし
lines.translated: "It's me."

lines.content: そっか。よかった。大正解だ
lines.translated: "I see. Thank goodness. Bingo."

lines.content: また、沈黙。
lines.translated: Again, silence.

lines.content: 少し、はしゃぎすぎただろうか。
lines.translated: Had I gotten a little too excited?

lines.content: そんな焦りとも疑念ともつかない感情が一瞬だけ芽生えるも……
lines.translated: A feeling that was somewhere between impatience and doubt sprouted in me for just an instant, yet...

lines.content: 今夜は……
lines.translated: "Tonight..."

lines.content: ……君の声。
lines.translated: Your voice.

lines.content: 大雅。……今夜は、どう？　いつもみたいに眠れない？
lines.translated: "Taiga. ...How is it tonight? Can't sleep, like usual?"

lines.content: 直接話すときとは違い、少し素直になってくれる君の声だ。
lines.translated: Unlike when we speak in person, it was your voice, just a little more honest with me.

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my eyes.

lines.content: 闇色。
lines.translated: The color of darkness.

lines.content: その中にやさしい睡魔の気配を探してはみたけれど……。
lines.translated: I tried searching within it for the gentle presence of sleepiness, but...

lines.content: 今夜も、あまりすぐには眠れなさそうだ
lines.translated: "It doesn't look like I'll be able to fall asleep very quickly tonight, either."

lines.content: 不安なことが多いから？
lines.translated: "Because there are a lot of things making you anxious?"

lines.content: ……心配に思うことも、怖いと思ってしまうことも、多いから
lines.translated: "...Because there are a lot of things I'm worried about, and a lot of things that scare me."

lines.content: 悲しいことも、多かったから
lines.translated: "And because there were a lot of sad things, too."

lines.content: クロは電話になると少し素直になるけれど……俺は、電話になると少し、弱気になる。
lines.translated: Kuro gets a little more honest over the phone... while I get a little weaker.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は嫌悪すべき自分である。
lines.translated: *That* is a side of myself I ought to despise.

lines.content: 自分というものをいくつもの[・|個]に切り分けて考えるのなら……。
lines.translated: If I were to carve the thing called "myself" up into several distinct *individuals*...

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]はとても愛することなどできようはずもない自分。
lines.translated: *This* is a self I could never possibly bring myself to love.

lines.content: 今すぐにでもここから追い出してしまいたい自分のひとつだけど……。
lines.translated: It's one of the selves I want to kick out of here this very instant, and yet...

lines.content: ……大雅。今夜も、眠れないのなら。心がそわそわ、落ち着かないなら
lines.translated: "...Taiga. If you can't sleep tonight, either. If your heart is restless and won't settle down."

lines.content: 今夜も“楽しいこと”を探して、数えてみよう
lines.translated: "Then let's look for 'fun things' and count them tonight, too."

lines.content: 楽しかったことを数えていれば、いつか必ず、安心できる。そしたらきっと、眠れるようになる
lines.translated: "If you keep counting the things that were fun, you'll definitely be able to feel at ease eventually. And then I'm sure you'll be able to fall asleep."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: あの頃、みたいに？
lines.translated: "Like back then?"

lines.content: そう。……あの頃みたいに
lines.translated: "Yes. ...Like back then."

lines.content: うなずき合うかのように君と言葉を交換するだけで、ほんの少しの安心を俺は覚えた。
lines.translated: Just exchanging words with you as though we were nodding to each other brought me a tiny bit of peace of mind.

lines.content: ……楽しいこと
lines.translated: "...Fun things."

lines.content: 眠れない夜。不安と心配。悲しさとさみしさ。そういったもので眠れぬ夜には――重苦しいばかりの自分にだけは、負けないように。
lines.translated: On sleepless nights. Anxiety and worry. Sadness and loneliness. On nights when things like that keep me awake--so that I don't lose to the part of myself that is nothing but suffocatingly heavy.

lines.content: だけど今日は……あまり“楽しいこと”はなかったなあ。だから余計に眠れそうにないのかも
lines.translated: "Though today... there really weren't many 'fun things.' Maybe that's why it feels even harder to fall asleep."

lines.content: 俺は寝床に潜り込む。[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。すると[・|あ][・|の][・|姿]が目に浮かぶのだ。
lines.translated: I slipped under the covers. I closed my eyelids. And when I did, *that image* floated up before my eyes.

lines.content: わたしは、いいことあった。すてきな日だった
lines.translated: "Something good happened to me. It was a wonderful day."

lines.content: へぇ、そうなんだ？
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: だからちょっとわたしはご機嫌……。かも、しれない
lines.translated: "So I'm in a bit of a good mood... Maybe."

lines.content: それはいいなあ。うらやましい
lines.translated: "That's nice. I'm jealous."

lines.content: 身近に思える誰かの一日に“いいこと”があった。
lines.translated: Something "good" had happened in the day of someone I felt close to.

lines.content: そう思うと素直にうれしくなれる。
lines.translated: Just thinking that made me genuinely happy.

lines.content: そんな俺の心もまだまだ捨てたものでもないかもしれない――……そう感じることができるから、俺は君と、クロとこうして話をするのが好きだ。
lines.translated: Maybe this heart of mine isn't completely beyond saving after all--...Because you make me feel that way, I like talking with you like this, Kuro.

lines.content: 君と話している自分が、好きだった。
lines.translated: I liked the person I was when I was talking to you.

lines.content: ……クロ。今日はどんな“楽しいこと”があったのかな
lines.translated: "...Kuro. What kind of 'fun thing' happened to you today?"

lines.content: クロの一日にあった“楽しいこと”を教えて貰えれば、今日はそれだけでとりあえず眠れるようにはなれそうだ。
lines.translated: If she'd tell me about the "fun thing" that happened in her day, I felt like that alone would be enough to let me fall asleep for tonight.

lines.content: たとえ俺の一日に、楽しいことなど何も、何ひとつ、なかったとしても。
lines.translated: Even if there hadn't been anything fun in my own day--not a single thing.

lines.content: 君が笑えば安心できる――簡単に言えばたったそれだけのことだった。
lines.translated: If you smile, I can feel at ease--put simply, that was really all there was to it.

lines.content: “楽しいこと”じゃなくて、“いいこと”だよ。[・|そ][・|れ]と[・|こ][・|れ]とはちょっと違う
lines.translated: "Not a 'fun thing,' a 'good thing.' *That* and *this* are a little different."

lines.content: クロは言う。そのかわいい声が頭にじんわり響いている。
lines.translated: Kuro said. Her cute voice echoed softly in my head.

lines.content: 俺は『そうなんだ』と君に答える。
lines.translated: "I see," I replied to her.

lines.content: “楽しいこと”と“いいこと”は違う、か。なんとなくだけどクロの言うこと、わかるかもしれないなあ
lines.translated: "A 'fun thing' and a 'good thing' are different, huh? Only vaguely, maybe, but I think I might get what you mean, Kuro."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そして閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の裏側に、どこかで君が微笑んでいる姿を想像しながら、そっと、問う。
lines.translated: And then, imagining you smiling somewhere on the backs of my closed eyelids, I gently asked.

lines.content: クロ。どんないいことがあったのかな
lines.translated: "Kuro. What kind of good thing happened?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 大雅のかわいいのが、見れたこと
lines.translated: "I got to see you looking cute, Taiga."

lines.content: わたしは、おばかだから。だから自分の気持ちも上手に言えないけど……大雅。かわいかった。色々とね、思い出すことも多かった
lines.translated: "I'm dumb, so... I can't put my feelings into words very well, but... Taiga. You were cute. It made me remember a lot of different things, too."

lines.content: だけど大雅はちょっと、ううん、すごく嫌そうだったけど
lines.translated: "Even though you looked a little--no, really unhappy about it, Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅……？
lines.translated: "Taiga...?"

lines.content: ……見て、たの？
lines.translated: "...You were... watching?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。見てた
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. I was watching."

lines.content: クロは言う。
lines.translated: So said Kuro.

lines.content: いつも、いつでも、大雅のことをわたしは見てるよ
lines.translated: "Always, at all times, I'm watching you, Taiga."

lines.content: そうして[まぶた|瞼]の裏に微笑む君の表情を、容易に思い描くことができたから――それは、うれしい。大げさでもなく幸せだとも思う。
lines.translated: Because that made it so easy to picture your smiling face behind my eyelids--it made me happy. Without exaggeration, I even felt blessed.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちになれないことが、どれだけ安心をくれるのかということを俺は知っているからだ。知ったつもりに、なっているからだ。
lines.translated: Because I know just how much peace of mind comes from not being allowed to be all alone. Or at least, I like to think I know.

lines.content: それでも俺は、今、ここにいるこの俺は、顔を覆ってしまうのだった。
lines.translated: Even so, the me right here, right now, ended up burying his face in his hands.

lines.content: う、うう。あんな姿。クロにだけは見られたくなかったのに……
lines.translated: "U-Ugh. Looking like that... You're the one person I didn't want seeing me like that, Kuro..."

lines.content: 目が冴えてしまった。睡魔の背中は、更に遠のいていく。
lines.translated: Now I was wide awake. The retreating back of my sleepiness drifted even further away.

lines.content: 報告するかどうか、考えてたけど……ごめんね、泣いてる？
lines.translated: "I wasn't sure whether to report it to you or not, though... I'm sorry, are you crying?"

lines.content: いや。うう。泣いてはないけど……
lines.translated: "No. Ugh. I'm not crying, but..."

lines.content: 泣きたい気分ではある。大いに。いたたまれない気分。存分に。
lines.translated: I sure feel like crying. Big time. I can't stand this embarrassment. Not one bit.

lines.content: ううー、あああー、と寝床の中で俺はじたばた暴れた。
lines.translated: Groaning "Uuugh, aaagh," I thrashed around under the covers.

lines.content: もしも誰もが心の中に“黒歴史ノート”、みたいなものを持っているとしたら、確実にその一ページが更新されたことだろう。
lines.translated: If everyone carries something like a "Notebook of Dark Past Memories" inside their hearts, a brand-new page had definitely just been added to mine.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ……なに、クロ
lines.translated: "...What is it, Kuro?"

lines.content: ごめんね。大雅のかわいいのが見られて、わたしにはとってもうれしい日だったけど……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Getting to see you looking cute made today a really happy day for me, Taiga, but..."

lines.content: 電話の向こう。少し素直なクロは『だからね』と続けて言った。
lines.translated: On the other end of the line, a slightly more honest Kuro continued with a "So, you see."

lines.content: だからね、大雅。わたしは改めて思ったよ
lines.translated: "So, you see, Taiga. It made me think all over again."

lines.content: うん。何を……。クロは何を、思ったのかな
lines.translated: "Yeah. About what...? What did you think about, Kuro?"

lines.content: 大雅は“特別”だった女の子たちの……みんなの“夢”を叶える方法を、探してる
lines.translated: "Taiga, you're looking for a way to grant the 'dreams' of all the girls... who used to be 'special.'"

lines.content: ぽつりと、クロは囁くようにそう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke those words softly, almost in a whisper.

lines.content: 女の子たちがいつか抱いたその“夢”は、いったいどんなものだったのか。きっと何よりそれは叶えがたいものだったはず
lines.translated: "Just what kind of 'dreams' did those girls hold in their hearts back then? Whatever they were, they must have been harder to grant than anything else."

lines.content: そして、大きなおおきなその“夢”を、もしかしたら叶えられるかもしれない……だから、“希望”を抱いた彼女たちの“魔法”とは、いったい、どんなものだったのか
lines.translated: "And thinking they might just be able to make those huge, enormous 'dreams' come true... they clung to 'hope.' So then, what exactly was their 'magic'?"

lines.content: 大雅はそれを解き明かしたいと思ってる
lines.translated: "That's the mystery you're trying to unravel, Taiga."

lines.content: そしてそのためには、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: And in order to do that, Kuro continued.

lines.content: そのためには、大雅。きみは今よりもっと、たくさん、あの子たちと仲良くならなきゃならないんだ
lines.translated: "In order to do that, Taiga, you have to get much, much closer to those girls than you are right now."

lines.content: ……うん。そう、だね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right, isn't it?"

lines.content: この俺にそのような重大すぎる役割が相応しいのか否か。
lines.translated: Whether or not someone like me was truly worthy of such a monumentally important role...

lines.content: そういった問題は未だにもって解消されずぶら下がっているけれど……。
lines.translated: Issues like that were still hanging over my head, completely unresolved, and yet...

lines.content: みんなの胸の中にあるらしい“特別な魔法”は、どうやら、彼女たちを使う者……
lines.translated: "The 'special magic' supposedly sleeping inside everyone's hearts apparently requires the person who wields them..."

lines.content: つまり、あさひさんの言うところの“魔法少女『使い』”と、その“魔法”である少女たちとが、心を更に深く通わせ合える。そんな“関係”にならなければ発動できない、らしいから
lines.translated: "In other words, what Asahi-san calls a 'Magical Girl *Wielder*,' and the girls who are that 'magic,' to connect on an even deeper level. Apparently, it can't be activated unless we form that kind of 'relationship.'"

lines.content: お友だちじゃあ全然足りない。幼馴染みじゃ不充分。
lines.translated: Being friends isn't nearly enough. Being childhood friends is insufficient.

lines.content: だったらどんな“関係”になれれば、それが彼女たちの心を開く“鍵”となり得るのか――わからない。
lines.translated: Then what kind of "relationship" do we need to have for it to become the "key" that opens their hearts--I don't know.

lines.content: いや。わからないふりをしているだけかもしれない。
lines.translated: No. Maybe I'm just pretending not to know.

lines.content: とにかくそれはとても、とても、難しいことのように思えてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: In any case, it feels like something very, very difficult to achieve.
*And the resolve it takes, too*.

lines.content: 何より[・|そ][・|れ]が難しいと感じてしまう。
lines.translated: More than anything, *that* is what feels the most difficult.

lines.content: 大雅はみんなの“夢”を叶える“希望”にならなければならないと思ってる
lines.translated: "You believe that you have to become the 'hope' that grants everyone's 'dreams,' Taiga."

lines.content: クロは改めるようにそう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro said this as if to drive the point home.

lines.content: そうして大雅が、あの子たちの“夢”とか“希望”とかを知りたいと願うなら……大雅
lines.translated: "And if you're wishing to learn about those girls' 'dreams' and 'hopes'... then, Taiga..."

lines.content: わたしは大雅のそれらを知りたい。そう思うよ
lines.translated: "I want to know yours, Taiga. That's how I feel."

lines.content: ……俺の？
lines.translated: "...Mine?"

lines.content: そう。大雅の“希望”。“夢”ではなくて……それを叶えるための“希望”だよ
lines.translated: "Yes. Your 'hope,' Taiga. Not your 'dream'... The 'hope' you need in order to make it come true."

lines.content: 大雅の“夢”は、もう、わざわざ語り合うようなことをしなくてもわかってる。だからそれを、大変だったあの時間のことを、わざわざ今の大雅に思い出させたくはない
lines.translated: "I already know what your 'dream' is without us having to talk it over. So I don't want to go out of my way to make the current you remember it, or how hard that time was for you."

lines.content: だからそれについては話さない。とクロは言うのだ。
lines.translated: So we won't talk about that, Kuro said.

lines.content: わたしはね。大雅があの“夢”を叶えるためには、ここにどんな“希望”が……どんなすてきな“魔法”があればいいと、願ってるのか。それを知りたいとずっと思ってた
lines.translated: "You see, for you to make that 'dream' come true, Taiga, what kind of 'hope'... what kind of wonderful 'magic' are you wishing you had right here? I've always wanted to know that."

lines.content: クロはそう言う。眠る前の短い時間。どこかで繋がる電話の遠いとおい向こう側。少し素直になってくれる今夜のクロが。
lines.translated: So said Kuro. During this brief moment before falling asleep. From the far, far-off other end of a phone line connected somewhere out there. The Kuro of tonight, who was being a little more honest with me.

lines.content: 俺は……
俺には、助けたい人がいる。
lines.translated: There is someone I want to save.

lines.content: 幸せになってほしい人たちがいる。
lines.translated: There are people I want to see happy.

lines.content: あの人たちを助けることが俺の“夢”
lines.translated: Saving those people is my "dream."

lines.content: そのためにはどんな“魔法”があればいい？
lines.translated: What kind of "magic" do I need in order to do that?

lines.content: ずっとずっと考え続けてきたことだ。
lines.translated: It's something I've been thinking about on and on, forever.

lines.content: だけどずっと、ずっと、答えが出ないままの問題だ。
lines.translated: Yet it remains a question I've never, ever been able to find an answer to.

lines.content: ……わからない
lines.translated: "...I don't know."

lines.content: 未だにそう答える他にない。
lines.translated: Even now, that's the only answer I can give.

lines.content: ……俺の心は不完全。
lines.translated: My heart is incomplete.

lines.content: “夜”の中でさえ充分に“[想像力|魔法]”を働かせることができないくらいに。
lines.translated: So much so that even within the "Night," I can't bring my "magic"--my imagination--to work well enough.

lines.content: 俺にどんな“魔法”があれば、“夢”を……助けたい人を助けられるのか。幸せになってほしい人たちを笑顔にできるのか。未だに具体的なその形を、探し続けてはいるけれど……
lines.translated: "What kind of 'magic' do I need to fulfill my 'dream'... to save the person I want to save? To bring smiles to the faces of the people I want to see happy? Even now, I'm still searching for a concrete form for it, but..."

lines.content: あの人を助ける。あの人たちに幸せな人生を。
lines.translated: To save that person. To give those people happy lives.

lines.content: そのためにどんな“魔法”を願うのか。どんな“希望”を求めるのか。
lines.translated: What kind of "magic" do I wish for to achieve that? What kind of "hope" do I seek?

lines.content: わからなかった。ほんの少しも。
lines.translated: I didn't know. Not even the slightest bit.

lines.content: ……もう時間もあまり多くは残されていないだろうというのに。
lines.translated: Even though there probably isn't much time left anymore.

lines.content: 沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: Fell silent.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]の裏の闇色に、その答えを探そうとした。
lines.translated: I tried searching for the answer in the dark colors behind my closed eyelids.

lines.content: 大丈夫
lines.translated: "It's okay."

lines.content: ……クロ？
lines.translated: "...Kuro?"

lines.content: 平気だ。大雅は何も心配しなくていいよ
lines.translated: "It's okay. You don't have to worry about a thing, Taiga."

lines.content: これからも続く大雅の時間に、人生に……どんな“魔法”が必要になったとしても、大丈夫。平気。わたしはその全部を叶えていける
lines.translated: "In the time and the life that will keep going for you from here on out, Taiga... no matter what kind of 'magic' you might come to need, it's all right. It's okay. I can grant every last bit of it."

lines.content: 君はきっぱりとそう言った。
lines.translated: You declared that firmly.

lines.content: だって、わたしは……
lines.translated: "Because I'm..."

lines.content: そして[まぶた|瞼]の裏の君が、微笑んだ。
lines.translated: And then, the you behind my eyelids smiled.

lines.content: わたしは大雅の、“魔法”、なんだから
lines.translated: "Because I am your 'magic,' Taiga."

lines.content: だから安心してほしい。何も心配、しないでほしい。
lines.translated: So I want you to rest easy. I don't want you to worry about anything.

lines.content: ……せめて[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]が来るまでは、そっと静かに眠ってほしい。いつもすてきな夢が大雅の心にありますようにと、祈ってる
lines.translated: "...At the very least, until *that time* comes, I want you to sleep softly and quietly. I'm praying that there will always be wonderful dreams in your heart, Taiga."

lines.content: 子守歌のように心に響く君の声――そうか。
lines.translated: Your voice echoed in my heart like a lullaby--I see.

lines.content: そうだった
lines.translated: "That's right."

lines.content: 君が俺の“夢”を叶えてくれる――……その“魔法”
lines.translated: "You're the one who'll make my 'dream' come true--...that 'magic.'"

lines.content: つぶやくようにそう言って、俺は問う。
lines.translated: Muttering that under my breath, I asked a question.

lines.content: ……だったら、クロ
lines.translated: "...In that case, Kuro."

lines.content: うん。何かな、大雅
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: こういう“夢”なら、どんな“希望”が持てるかな
lines.translated: "For a 'dream' like this, what kind of 'hope' could I have?"

lines.content: ……どんな“魔法”が相応しいかな。
lines.translated: What kind of "magic" would be fitting?

lines.content: クロ。お願い。“今日の記憶を消してほしい”
lines.translated: "Kuro. Please. 'I want you to erase today's memories.'"

lines.content: ……記憶？　今日の？
lines.translated: "...Memories? From today?"

lines.content: うん。俺から男らしさを奪った忌々しいあの変身についての記憶を……全部。さっぱり。俺たちの中からひとつ残らず
lines.translated: "Yeah. The memories of that accursed transformation that stripped me of my manhood... All of them. Completely. Without leaving a single trace inside any of us."

lines.content: それが俺の思い描く“夢”で、俺の求める“希望”の結果――なのかもしれない。きっと。たぶん
lines.translated: "Maybe that's the 'dream' I'm picturing, and the result of the 'hope' I'm wishing for. Definitely. Probably."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: だめ
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: それはできない相談だ
lines.translated: "That's out of the question."

lines.content: ええ～……
lines.translated: "Whaaat~...?"

lines.content: クロは俺の“魔法”なんじゃ、なかったの？
lines.translated: "Weren't you supposed to be my 'magic,' Kuro?"

lines.content: そうだよ。わたしは大雅の“魔法”だよ
lines.translated: "I am. I'm your 'magic,' Taiga."

lines.content: でも、だめなものもある。いくら大雅のお願いでも
lines.translated: "Even so, some things are just a no. Even if it is a request from you, Taiga."

lines.content: 今夜の君は素直なだけじゃなく少し意地悪だった。
lines.translated: Tonight, you weren't just being honest; you were being a little mean, too.

lines.content: そんな君は、今夜も俺が眠れるまでたくさんの話をしてくれた。
lines.translated: And yet, tonight as well, you talked with me about all sorts of things until I could fall asleep.

lines.content: うと、うと。
lines.translated: Drifting, drifting.

lines.content: こくり、こくり。
lines.translated: Nodding, nodding.

lines.content: 睡魔の微笑む音がする――その、瞬間まで。
lines.translated: Right up until the moment--I heard the sound of the sandman smiling.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: そして君が俺を呼ぶ声がした。
lines.translated: And then, I heard your voice calling out to me.

lines.content: ……いつか、きみの“夢”が叶うまで
lines.translated: "...Until the day your 'dream' comes true..."

lines.content: そのときまでは、こうして一緒に話していられる。わたし、そうであるようにと祈っていても――……いいのかな
lines.translated: "Until that time comes, we can stay together talking like this. Is it okay... if I pray for things to stay that way?"

lines.content: つぶやくように。囁くように。
lines.translated: Like a murmur. Like a whisper.

lines.content: 君が残したそんな言葉は、甘い眠りのその中で、聞こえないふりをして……。
lines.translated: Deep within my sweet slumber, I pretended not to hear those words you left behind...

lines.content: 今夜も“夜”は更けていく。
lines.translated: Tonight, too, the "Night" deepens.

lines.content: ……ひどい
lines.translated: "...This is awful."

lines.content: こんなのって、ひどい。
lines.translated: Something like this is just awful.

lines.content: あんまりだ
lines.translated: "This is way too much."
I'm in *this outfit* again.

lines.content: “春の学園祭”まで残り六日。
lines.translated: Six days left until the "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: 今日もまた智仁が計画しているのだというライブに向けて、放課後は宣伝活動に精を出すこととなったわけだが――
lines.translated: Today once again, we ended up dedicating our after-school hours to promotional activities for the live concert Tomohito is apparently planning, however--

lines.content: ……いや。違うだろ。順番が
lines.translated: "...No. We've got the order of things all wrong, don't we?"

lines.content: 宣伝する前にすることたくさん、あるだろうに。まだライブでどんな曲をするのかとかも全然、まったく、俺たちは知らされていないのに……
lines.translated: "There's a ton of stuff we should be doing before promoting it, isn't there? We still haven't been told a single thing about what songs we're even playing at the concert..."

lines.content: それなのに宣伝ばかりに傾注するなんて。
lines.translated: And yet here we are, pouring all our energy into promotion alone.

lines.content: まるで捕らぬ狸のなんとやら……とは、ちょっと違うが。それでもなんだかそんな気分だ。
lines.translated: It's practically counting our chickens before they hatch... well, maybe a little different from that. Still, it kind of feels that way.

lines.content: しかし[・|そ][・|れ]と[・|こ][・|れ]とは別問題。
lines.translated: However, *that* and *this* are two separate issues.

lines.content: 今回は、負けない。絶対だ
lines.translated: "This time, I won't lose. Absolutely not."

lines.content: そして智仁にこの屈辱ともいえる格好をさせてやる……、そう誓ったはずなのになあ。うう
lines.translated: "And I'll make Tomohito wear this utterly humiliating outfit instead... At least, that's what I swore I'd do. Ugh."

lines.content: 今回もまた“俺と智仁のどちらがかわいくなるのか決めよう”と挑んだ勝負――男らしくコイントスの一発勝負だった。互いの持ち得る運にのみ一任された勝負の行方だ。
lines.translated: Once again, I had challenged him to a match to "decide which one of us, me or Tomohito, gets to be cute"--a manly, one-shot coin toss. The outcome of the match was left entirely to the luck each of us possessed.

lines.content: 運にだけは自信のある。
lines.translated: My luck is the one thing I actually have confidence in.

lines.content: 故に。負けるはずはないのだと挑んだのだが……。
lines.translated: Therefore, I went into the challenge certain there was no way I could lose, and yet...

lines.content: 結果はこうだ。この様だ。俺の負け。
lines.translated: Here is the result. This sorry state. My loss.

lines.content: う、ううう
lines.translated: "U-Ughhh."

lines.content: 大通りを練り歩く。女の子の格好で。
lines.translated: Parading down the main street. Dressed as a girl.

lines.content: ……全然、これっぽちも、似合ってないのに。
lines.translated: Even though it doesn't suit me at all, not even the slightest bit.

lines.content: こんなことしてライブの宣伝になんてなるのかよ。何度となくそう思うばかり。
lines.translated: How the hell is doing something like this supposed to promote a live concert anyway? I just kept thinking that over and over again.

lines.content: やだ。どうしよう。みんな見てる
lines.translated: "Nooo. What should I do? Everyone's staring at me."

lines.content: 通り過ぎる人たちがちらちらと視線を投げてくるのだ――……思わず口調がおかしな具合になってしまったりもする。
lines.translated: People passing by keep throwing sidelong glances my way--...making even the way I talk slip into something weird without me meaning to.

lines.content: ……不自然なんだ。女装バレバレで気持ち悪がられているんだ。まさに変態を見るような目なんだ。この視線の数々は
lines.translated: "...It looks completely unnatural. It's painfully obvious I'm a guy in a dress, and they're totally creeped out by me. They're looking at me like I'm a total pervert. Every single one of these stares..."

lines.content: 悲しくって。悔しくって。……情けなくって。
lines.translated: It's so sad. So frustrating. ...So pathetic.

lines.content: 妊娠しちゃいそう
lines.translated: "I feel like I'm gonna get pregnant from all these stares."

lines.content: 顔を覆った。
lines.translated: I buried my face in my hands.

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと、大雅くん泣いてるよ……っ
lines.translated: "H-Hey, wait, Taiga-kun is crying...!"

lines.content: 背後からの声。
lines.translated: A voice from behind me.

lines.content: かわいそうだよっ、もう、やめよう……っ？　こんなことしても宣伝活動にはならないよ。だって、そうでしょう？　あのままじゃ――
lines.translated: "I feel so bad for him! Come on, let's stop this already, okay...? Doing something like this isn't going to promote anything. I mean, right? If we leave him like that--"

lines.content: いいや。だめだ
lines.translated: "No. Out of the question."

lines.content: 智仁のきっぱりとした、声だ。ハルの台詞を遮断する。
lines.translated: Tomohito's firm voice cut off Haru's words.

lines.content: ……ハルちゃんの言うとおりだ。確かに無理矢理はよくない。強引なのもだ。そこに気の置けない、何物にも代えがたい、強い友情があったとしても、だ――
lines.translated: "...You're right, Haru-chan. Forcing someone to do something against their will certainly isn't good. Being pushy isn't either. Even if there's an unreserved, irreplaceable, and powerful bond of friendship between us--"

lines.content: どうであれ、なんであれ、一方的なものは許されないんだ。そんなことを無理矢理に、強引に、押し通そうとしてしまっては……そこにはもう“友人関係”なんてものはなくなってしまう
lines.translated: "No matter how or what it is, something completely one-sided is unforgivable. If you try to forcefully, aggressively push something like that through... there won't be any 'friendship' left anymore."

lines.content: だ、だったら……もうこういうのは……
lines.translated: "Th-Then... we shouldn't do this kind of thing anymore..."

lines.content: でも。だけどな、ハルちゃん。それでも尚、なんだよ
lines.translated: "However. Even so, Haru-chan. Despite all that, we must."

lines.content: ……どうして？　どうして“それでも”、なの？
lines.translated: "...Why? Why 'despite all that'?"

lines.content: 姫織が言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: そうですよ。どうして、それでも尚……なんですか？
lines.translated: "Yeah! What do you mean, 'despite all that'?"

lines.content: 千和も言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa chimed in as well.

lines.content: 男の勝負は厳しいのだ。その結果はときに友情よりも優先される……ことだってある
lines.translated: "A match between men is ruthless. There are times... when the outcome takes precedence even over friendship."

lines.content: そういうふうにして、更にそこにあるべき友情は厚く激しくなっていく――ことだって、あり得るんだ。うつくしきかな友情ってね
lines.translated: "And through that very process, the friendship that ought to exist between them can grow even deeper and fiercer--such things are entirely possible. Ah, how beautiful friendship is."

lines.content: えー……。男の子って、よくわからない
lines.translated: "Ehh... I really don't understand boys."

lines.content: 物陰に隠れてこちらを伺っているみんなの声だ――……ああ、その通りだ。
lines.translated: Those were the voices of everyone hiding in the shadows, peeking out at me--...Yeah, he's right.

lines.content: 男の勝負は、その世界は、とっても厳しい。むしろ何より厳しいものであれと望んでさえいる。
