lines.translated: A match between men, and the world it belongs to, is utterly ruthless. In fact, I even want it to be ruthless above all else.

lines.content: 故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: 今回も甘んじよう。この醜態を。
lines.translated: I'll accept my fate this time, too. This utter humiliation.

lines.content: 悲しみながらも恥じ入りながらも受け入れよう。それが勝負の世界というものだ。
lines.translated: Even as I grieve, even as I burn with shame, I'll accept it. That is the nature of a world built on competition.

lines.content: だからこそ――……ちくしょう！
lines.translated: And that's exactly why--...Dammit!

lines.content: 今に見てろよあの野郎！　次はお前だっ、必ずお前に女装させてやるからなっ！
lines.translated: "Just you wait, you bastard! You're next! I swear I'm gonna make you wear a dress no matter what!"

lines.content: ねえねえともちゃん
lines.translated: "Hey, hey, Tomo-chan."

lines.content: なんだい、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "What is it, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 今回はコイントスで勝負、してたよね？　あのゲームも大雅はよわっちい感じなの？　何か弱点がある感じ？　じゃんけんのときみたいに
lines.translated: "You guys settled it with a coin toss this time, right? Is Taiga super weak at that game, too? Like, does he have some kind of tell or weakness? Just like with rock-paper-scissors?"

lines.content: いいや。今度はガチだ。まあ、コイン二枚重ねたりしてズルはできただろうけど、でも今回は正真正銘の真剣勝負――では、あるけれど
lines.translated: "Nope. It was completely legit this time. Well, I suppose I could have cheated by palming two coins or something, but this was a genuine, dead-serious match--however..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: それでもやっぱり、この勝負の結果にはそうなるべき道理がある。ああ、そうだ。そこには揺るぎようのない理由があるんだよ
lines.translated: "Even so, there is a natural law dictating that the match would end this way. Yes, that's right. There is an unshakable reason behind it."

lines.content: なに？　それ……？　道理？　理由？　智仁くんは、大雅くんに絶対に勝てちゃう……どんな道理と理由があるの？
lines.translated: "What? What's that...? A natural law? A reason? What kind of law or reason guarantees that you'll always beat Taiga-kun, Tomohito-kun?"

lines.content: ああ……、それはね、ハルちゃん。あまりにも単純で明快なんだ
lines.translated: "Ah... Well, Haru-chan, it's something painfully simple and clear-cut."

lines.content: うなずき、智仁は言う。その言葉に、俺は驚く。
lines.translated: Nodding, Tomohito spoke. His next words left me stunned.

lines.content: 大雅。俺に勝負事で勝ったこと一度もないんだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga has never once beaten me at any kind of game or bet."

lines.content: ……なん、だと
lines.translated: "...What did you say?"

lines.content: 俺はぴたりと足を止めた。
lines.translated: I stopped dead in my tracks.

lines.content: 普段の大雅はあまりそういうこと気にするタイプじゃないからね。いつもはあんなふうに勝ち負けにはこだわらないやつなんだよ。あくまで俺との間では、だけど
lines.translated: "Normally, Taiga isn't the type to care much about that sort of thing. He usually doesn't get hung up on winning or losing like that. Strictly when it's between him and me, though."

lines.content: だからたぶん、本人はわかってないと思うんだ
lines.translated: "So he probably hasn't even realized it himself."

lines.content: まあ、確かに。
lines.translated: Well, that's true.

lines.content: これまで智仁としてきただろう勝負の結果は――じゃんけんだろうとなんだろうと――全然、まったく、思い出せない俺だった。
lines.translated: When it came to the outcomes of the matches I must have had with Tomohito up until now--whether it was rock-paper-scissors or anything else--I couldn't remember a single one of them at all.

lines.content: 逆になぜだか、十夜には手加減もできない大人げなさが炸裂してしまうのだけど……。
lines.translated: Conversely, for some reason when it comes to Toya, my childish refusal to hold back always explodes to the surface...

lines.content: 故に衝撃的だった。
lines.translated: Which was why this came as such a shock.

lines.content: 俺。あいつに勝ったこと、ないのか……？
lines.translated: Have I really... never beaten him once...?

lines.content: え、ええ……。そうなんだ。大雅くん……男の勝負がどうとか、そんなこと言ってたのに……？
lines.translated: "W-Whaaat...? Really? Even though Taiga-kun was going on and on about a match between men and all that...?"

lines.content: ううーん。まあ、それはあれだね。その場のノリだね
lines.translated: "Hmm. Well, you know how it is. He just got swept up in the heat of the moment."

lines.content: ノリって……。ううーん。やっぱり男の子ってよくわからないなあ
lines.translated: "The heat of the moment... Hmm. I really don't get boys at all."

lines.content: まあ、今回は、大雅。よっぽど負けるのがいやだったんだな。何が何でも
lines.translated: "Well, this time around, Taiga really, really didn't want to lose. No matter what it took."

lines.content: それでも大雅くんは負けちゃって……。自分が智仁くんに勝ったことないって、気づかないまま、勝負しちゃって……女の子に
lines.translated: "And yet Taiga-kun still lost... He challenged you without even realizing he's never beaten you before, Tomohito-kun... and got turned into a girl..."

lines.content: かわいいよな
lines.translated: "Pretty cute, right?"

lines.content: やめろ！
lines.translated: "Stop that!"

lines.content: 心で叫んだ。
lines.translated: I screamed inside my head.

lines.content: かわいいとかやめて！　マジで！　折れちゃう！　心が！
lines.translated: Stop calling me cute! Seriously! My heart is gonna snap in two!

lines.content: あ、ああ。でも……、うん。かわいそうだけど、もしかしたら因果応報ってやつなのかもしれない
lines.translated: "A-Ah. But... yeah. I feel bad for him, but maybe this is what they call karma."

lines.content: 大雅くん。毎晩、トランプとかオセロとか……十夜に意地悪して、勝たせてあげないから……だから、こんなことに
lines.translated: "Every night, whether it's cards or Othello... Taiga-kun is always mean to Toya and never lets her win... So that's why this happened."

lines.content: ……くっ！
振り向いた。
lines.translated: I whipped around.

lines.content: 心だけでなく実際に叫んでやろうと思った――……それでもやっぱりこれはひどいよ！　と。
lines.translated: I was ready to scream it out loud instead of just in my head--..."Even so, this is still way too cruel!"

lines.content: が、そこで俺は見つけてしまう。ドキッと、してしまう。
lines.translated: However, right then, I spotted something. My heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: みんなとは別の物陰。
lines.translated: In a different patch of shadows from where the others were hiding.

lines.content: そこに見慣れた白い尻尾と耳が見え隠れ。
lines.translated: A familiar white tail and pair of ears were peeking in and out of sight.

lines.content: 良くよく見ると尻尾は細かく震え、その毛はぶわっと膨らんでいる。耳もぴこぴこしていた。
lines.translated: Looking closely, the tail was quivering finely, its fur puffed all the way out. The ears were twitching up and down, too.

lines.content: それは、喜んでる。その合図だと知っている。猫たちの無意識の感情表現だ。
lines.translated: She was delighted. I knew that was the sign for it. It's an unconscious display of emotion for cats.

lines.content: ――ううっ。
lines.translated: --Ugh.

lines.content: ――ずびっ
lines.translated: "--*Sniffle*."

lines.content: 鼻を啜り、空を仰いだ。
lines.translated: Sniffling, I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: ひどい。
lines.translated: It's awful.

lines.content: 俺に味方はいないのかしら。
lines.translated: Do I not have a single ally in this world?

lines.content: 今日もとってもかわいかったですよ。大雅くん
lines.translated: "You looked super cute today too, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 宣伝活動（という名目でただバカをしたいだけなのではないかと勘ぐりはじめてはいるが）を終えると、今日もとってもうれしそうなあず咲先輩と出くわした。
lines.translated: Once we wrapped up our promotional activities (though I was starting to suspect it was just an excuse to goof around), we bumped into Azusaki-senpai, who looked very happy again today.

lines.content: みんなと別れた後の石橋の上である。
lines.translated: This was on top of the stone bridge after parting ways with everyone else.

lines.content: こんにちは先輩といつものように頭をさげ、はい、こんにちはです、大雅くん、ハルちゃんも――と、今日もまた一緒に帰ろうかとしていた俺たちに、先輩は微笑みかけてくれた。
lines.translated: "Hello, Senpai," we said, bowing our heads like usual, and as Haru and I were about to head home together again today, Senpai gave us a warm smile and replied, "Yes, hello there, Taiga-kun, and Haru-chan too."

lines.content: 今日も、家に戻ってたんですか？　智仁に会いに？
lines.translated: "Did you go back to his house again today? To see Tomohito?"

lines.content: はい、そうです。だけど今日の放課後も、ともくん、大雅くんたちと遊んでたんですね。待っていても帰ってこないわけです。だからまた迎えに出てみたんですけど……
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. But it seems Tomo-kun was hanging out with you and the others after school today, too. No wonder he didn't come home no matter how long I waited. So I decided to come out and meet him again, and..."

lines.content: 大雅くん[・|と]遊んでいたのか、大雅くん[・|で]遊んでいたのか。微妙なところですけれどね
lines.translated: "Whether he was hanging out *with* Taiga-kun, or just toying *with* Taiga-kun, is up for debate, though."

lines.content: ……上手いこと言えました、みたいな顔しないようにな。ハル
lines.translated: "...Don't give me that smug 'I just said something clever' look, Haru."

lines.content: あはは
lines.translated: "Ahaha."

lines.content: くすくすと笑うあず咲先輩だ。その微笑みはいつもより若干、明るいもののように見えた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai giggled softly. Her smile looked slightly brighter than usual.

lines.content: ……ご機嫌そうですね、あず咲先輩。なんだか笑顔がちょっと眩しいくらいに
lines.translated: "...You seem to be in a really good mood, Azusaki-senpai. Your smile is practically dazzling."

lines.content: ふふ。だってあの格好は、あの服装は、大雅くん……ともくんに無理矢理させられてる感じなんですよね？　勝負で勝ったり負けたりした結果だとはいえ
lines.translated: "Fufu. Well, I mean, that look, that outfit... Tomo-kun is basically forcing you to wear it against your will, right, Taiga-kun? Even if it is the result of winning or losing a bet."

lines.content: まあ、そうですね
lines.translated: "Well, yeah, that's true."

lines.content: 決して似合いもしないのに女の子の格好だなんて……。
lines.translated: Dressing up like a girl when it doesn't suit me in the slightest...

lines.content: 進んでしようとは決して思いませんからね。無理矢理です。強引に、です
lines.translated: "I would never willingly do something like this. It's completely against my will. By pure force."

lines.content: だったら……
lines.translated: "In that case..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: あず咲先輩――その頬が、ぽっと染まり赤くなる。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai's cheeks suddenly flushed a bright red.

lines.content: 身体のおっきなともくんが、少し華奢なところもある大雅くんの服をはぎ取って……嫌がる大雅くんを……無理矢理……
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun, with his big build, stripping the clothes off the slightly slender Taiga-kun... and forcing an unwilling Taiga-kun to..."

lines.content: はあはあしている。その目はどこか遠くを見ているようでもあった。
lines.translated: She was breathing heavily. Her eyes looked as though they were gazing off into some distant place.

lines.content: あ、これ。だめだ。だめなやつだ。咄嗟にそんな気配がした。
lines.translated: Ah, wait. No. This is the bad kind of territory. I sensed it in an instant.

lines.content: ……やめてください
lines.translated: "...Please stop."

lines.content: ハルが目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Haru narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: あず咲先輩は勘違いしています
lines.translated: "You are having a misunderstanding, Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: 勘違い、ですか？
lines.translated: "A misunderstanding?"

lines.content: 何をでしょうかと、目をぱちくりさせるあず咲先輩に、ハルはどこか得意げなふうに言った。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai blinked in confusion as if to ask what she meant, and Haru spoke up with a somewhat proud look on her face.

lines.content: はい。そうです
lines.translated: "Yes. That is right."

lines.content: あず咲先輩はきっと大きなおおきな勘違いをしてしまっています――いいですか、先輩。ぐいぐい押すのは大雅くんですよ
lines.translated: "You are making a big, huge misunderstanding, Azusaki-senpai--listen closely, Senpai. The one who aggressively pushes things forward is Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……なんだと
lines.translated: "...What did you say?"

lines.content: そんな大雅くんに無理矢理されちゃうのは智仁くんのほうです。そうじゃないとだめなんです――本来なら
lines.translated: "And the one who gets forcefully swept along by Taiga-kun is Tomohito-kun. It has to be that way--originally, at least."

lines.content: それは……、むう。聞き捨てなりませんね、ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "That is... Hmph. I cannot just let that slide, Haru-chan."

lines.content: そこからふたりの間に飛び交うせりふの数々に、ふらりと、しながら――
lines.translated: Reeling slightly from the flurry of lines flying back and forth between the two of them--

lines.content: で、でも、ハル
lines.translated: "B-But, Haru."

lines.content: ――ちょっと腐臭漂う話題を切り落とさねばと、俺は声を挟んだ。
lines.translated: --feeling the urgent need to cut off this slightly rotten-smelling topic, I interjected.

lines.content: ハルだってさ、[・|あ][・|あ][・|い][・|う][・|格][・|好]、しなきゃならないんだぞ。智仁に協力するって言ってしまった手前だってあるし
lines.translated: "You're going to have to wear *that kind of outfit* too, you know. Especially since you already promised Tomohito you'd help him out."

lines.content: ハルは“やっぱりごめんね”とは絶対に言い出せないだろうし……。
lines.translated: And there's no way Haru could ever bring herself to say, "Sorry, I changed my mind," after the fact...

lines.content: こう言ってはなんだけれども、ハル。俺のことより自分のことを心配していたほうが、いいんじゃないかな……たぶん
lines.translated: "Not to put it bluntly, Haru, but shouldn't you be worrying about yourself rather than me right now...? Probably."

lines.content: え？　そうなんですか？　ハルちゃんもかわいい格好、するんですか？　大雅くんみたいに？　“春の学園祭”で？
lines.translated: "Eh? Really? Are you going to dress up in a cute outfit too, Haru-chan? Just like Taiga-kun? At the Spring School Festival?"
"Ugh... Y-Y-Yes..."

lines.content: 思い出してしまったのだろう。ハルは瞬時に真っ青に染まる。
lines.translated: She must have just remembered. Haru turned pale in an instant.

lines.content: ……何でだか……そんな流れに……何で、だか
lines.translated: "...Somehow... things ended up going that way... For some reason..."

lines.content: ぶつぶつと言うハルだ。
lines.translated: Haru muttered under her breath.

lines.content: 大雅くんがああいう格好していたのは、音楽に関することだって言ってましたけど……
lines.translated: "You mentioned that Taiga-kun dressing up like that had something to do with music, though..."

lines.content: はい。……あいつのやることなすこと殆ど全部、根底はどこかで音楽に繋がってるんじゃないでしょうか――あいつが主張するには、という感じですが
lines.translated: "Yes. ...I'm pretty sure almost everything he says and does is fundamentally connected to music in some way or another--at least, that's what he claims."

lines.content: そういえば。誰かに届けたい音楽があるんだって、ともくん、そう言っていたんですよね……？
lines.translated: "Come to think of it... Tomo-kun said he has music he wants to deliver to someone, didn't he...?"

lines.content: はい。そうですね。そう言っていました
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. That's what he said."

lines.content: そのために本番までの残り数日、あいつなりに色々考えているんだろうとは思うんですけど……
lines.translated: "With only a few days left until the actual performance, I figure he's thinking through a lot of things in his own way to make that happen, though..."

lines.content: しかしあまりに不可解だ。
lines.translated: Even so, it's completely baffling.

lines.content: 俺を女の子の格好になど仕立て上げ、いったいそれでどうなるというのだろう――そのような疑問はいつまでも消えず、もやもやと俺の中にくすぶり続けている。
lines.translated: Dressing me up like a girl--what in the world is that supposed to accomplish? That question refuses to go away, continuing to smolder in the back of my mind.

lines.content: でも、ライブでやるための曲は既にあるみたいです。あの口ぶりだと、たぶんあいつの作った曲をやることになるんじゃないかなあって思いますよ
lines.translated: "Still, it seems like he already has the song we're going to play for the live show. Going by the way he talked about it, I think we'll probably end up playing an original song he wrote."

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: あず咲先輩は暮れゆく空をふと見上げ、
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai suddenly looked up at the darkening sky.

lines.content: ともくん。誰に音楽、届けたいって思ってるんだろう
lines.translated: "I wonder who Tomo-kun wants to deliver his music to..."

lines.content: ため息を空に滲ませるかのようにして、言った。
lines.translated: She spoke as though letting a sigh bleed into the sky.

lines.content: ……大丈夫、なのかな
lines.translated: "...I wonder if it'll be okay."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: だって、ともくん。本当は……
lines.translated: "Because Tomo-kun, he actually..."

lines.content: 繰り返しそうつぶやいた先輩の横顔は、その瞳は、とても悲しそうに揺れているようで……。
lines.translated: As Senpai murmured those words over and over, her profile and her eyes seemed to waver with deep sadness...

lines.content: そんなあず咲先輩の様子を、ハルが目を細め、じっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: Haru narrowed her eyes, staring intently at Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: 君のお姉さんを助けるために、俺にもなにかできることはないかな
lines.translated: "Is there anything I can do to help save your older sister?"

lines.content: きっと[・|あ][・|の][・|人]ならそう言ったはずだ。
lines.translated: I'm sure *that person* would have said those exact words.

lines.content: そんな理想が胸に芽生えたからそこ――次だ。次の“満月の夜会”にて再び出会った男の子に、俺はそう問いかけたのだ。
lines.translated: It was precisely because that ideal had budded in my chest that--next time. When I met the boy again at the next Full Moon Soiree, I asked him that question.

lines.content: 俺の言葉に少年は、兎蛙智仁は、目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Hearing my words, the boy--Towazu Tomohito--narrowed his eyes.

lines.content: つまるところ、俺の問いかけにはこういう意図が含まれている――
lines.translated: Ultimately, my question carried this underlying intention--
"*Let's work together.*"

lines.content: ……協力？
lines.translated: "...Work together?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: そうすれば、俺と君、どちらがあの“役割”に選ばれたとしても問題はない。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "That way, it won't matter which one of us gets chosen for that 'Role.' Right?"

lines.content: あの“役割”――“魔法少女『使い』”とかいうものになり、そしてこの少年がそこから何を成そうとしているのかはわからないが……。
lines.translated: That "Role"--becoming a "Magical Girl 'Wielder'" or whatever it was called. I didn't know what this boy was trying to accomplish through it, though...

lines.content: もしも俺が選ばれたとしても、“魔法少女『使い』”として何ができるのかは知らないけれど、その力を君のために使うと誓うよ
lines.translated: "Even if I'm the one who gets chosen, I don't know what a 'Magical Girl Wielder' is capable of, but I swear I'll use that power for your sake."

lines.content: そうすることで、奏大雅。お前の得られるメリットは？
lines.translated: "And by doing that, Kanade Taiga... what's in it for you?"

lines.content: ああ……。理解してもらえないだろうけど、充分あるよ。充分ね
lines.translated: "Well... You probably won't understand, but there's plenty in it for me. More than enough."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|す][・|る][・|こ][・|と]で俺は俺に満足できる。ただそれだけだ。それだけのことが俺にとっては大切なのだ。
lines.translated: *By doing that*, I can be satisfied with myself. That's all it is. And that alone is what matters to me.

lines.content: 俺は[・|あ][・|の][・|人]のようになりたい。あの人みたいに誰かを助けられるかもしれない。それだけの“希望”があるだけでいい。
lines.translated: I want to be like *that person*. Maybe I can save someone just like he did. Simply having that much "Hope" is enough for me.

lines.content: ここに集められる子ども達は、その殆どが幾つもの叶えがたい“夢”を持っている――なあ、俺の“夢”を聞いてくれるか？
lines.translated: "Almost all the kids gathered here have several hard-to-grant 'Dreams'--hey, will you listen to my 'Dream'?"

lines.content: 俺は、ヒーローになりたいんだよ
lines.translated: "I want to become a hero."

lines.content: ……なんだって？
lines.translated: "...What did you say?"

lines.content: いいや。ヒーローに、なりたかったんだ。憧れだよ。理想の生き方だ。つまり将来の“[・|夢]”だよ
lines.translated: "Or rather, I *wanted* to become a hero. It's something I admire. An ideal way of life. In other words, it's my future '*Dream*.'"

lines.content: だからさ、そんな俺が困った人の力になりたいと思うのは、何も不自然なことじゃないだろ？
lines.translated: "So, see, there's nothing unnatural about someone like me wanting to help a person in trouble, right?"

lines.content: なんだか変な奴だな。お前って
lines.translated: "You're kind of a weird guy, aren't you?"

lines.content: 少年は苦笑いを浮かべ、そう言った――はじめて見た笑顔だった。ずっと笑っていればいいのに。そう思った。
lines.translated: The boy gave a wry smile and said that--it was the first time I'd seen him smile. I wished he would just keep smiling like that forever.

lines.content: そうすればきっと、誰もがこいつの友だちになりたいと思うんじゃないかな、と。
lines.translated: If he did, I was sure anyone would want to be his friend.

lines.content: ヒーローは困った誰かを無条件に助けに走るからヒーローなんだ。そこに見返りは求めない。“誰かを助けられる自分でいられる”ことが、ヒーローにとっては重要なんだよ
lines.translated: "A hero is a hero because they rush in to help someone in trouble unconditionally. They don't ask for anything in return. Being able to be someone who can save others is what's important to a hero."

lines.content: だけど、君を困らせる問題はいったい[・|ど][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|も][・|の][・|な][・|の][・|か]。それを話して聞かせてもらえない限りは、そうできない。ヒーローは走って行けない
lines.translated: "However, *what kind of problem* is troubling you? Unless you tell me about it, I can't do that. A hero can't come running."

lines.content: はは。敵がいなけりゃ正義の味方は存在できない、みたいな話だな。“困った人がいなければヒーローはヒーローになれない”
lines.translated: "Haha. That sounds like the whole 'a champion of justice can't exist without a villain' thing. 'Without someone in trouble, a hero can't be a hero.'"

lines.content: 苦笑いのまま肩をすくめ――智仁はぽつりと、言った。
lines.translated: Shrugging his shoulders with that same wry smile on his face--Tomohito spoke quietly.

lines.content: 聞いてくれるか。俺のヒーロー
lines.translated: "Will you hear me out, my hero?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: 俺は、姉ちゃんを助けたい
lines.translated: "I want to save my older sister."

lines.content: そのためにここへ来た、と智仁は言う。
lines.translated: That was why he came here, Tomohito said.

lines.content: それが俺の“夢”だけど……
lines.translated: "That's my 'Dream,' anyway..."

lines.content: でも、“夜の王”を倒した後にもらえる“魔法”だけじゃ、きっと、不充分なんだ。俺の“夢”は叶えられない
lines.translated: "However, the 'Magic' you get after defeating the 'King of the Night' probably won't be enough on its own. It won't grant my 'Dream.'"

lines.content: ……どうして？

lines.translated: "Because I lack 'Imagination.' *Because I'm completely devoid of that talent*--"

lines.content: ――そんな俺だから、姉ちゃんのことを助けるためにはどんな“魔法”が必要なのか。それをまるで“想像”できない
lines.translated: "--Because that's how I am, I can't even begin to 'imagine' what kind of 'Magic' is needed to save my sister."

lines.content: だから“魔法少女『使い』”なんだよ。俺の“希望”はそこにある
lines.translated: "That's why I need to be the 'Magical Girl Wielder.' That's where my 'Hope' lies."

lines.content: “[ここ|夜]”で、姉ちゃんのことを助けられる“魔法”を持った子を探し出すんだ。そして、“夜の魔法使い”から授けられる“役割”で。その、力で……
lines.translated: "Here in the 'Night,' I'm going to find a girl who has the 'Magic' that can save my sister. And with the 'Role' granted by the 'Magician of the Night'... with that power..."

lines.content: 俺の姉ちゃんを助けるために力を貸してもらうんだ。
lines.translated: I'll have her lend me her power to save my sister.

lines.content: そのためにここへきた。そのために、この手に“役割”が必要だ。
lines.translated: That's why I came here. That's why I need that "Role" in my hands.

lines.content: 智仁はそう言っていた。
lines.translated: That was what Tomohito told me.

lines.content: ……お姉さんを助けたい
lines.translated: "...You want to save your older sister."

lines.content: 独り言のようにつぶやき、俺は智仁に問いかける。
lines.translated: Murmuring as if talking to myself, I asked Tomohito a question.

lines.content: 君のお姉さんに何があったんだ？
lines.translated: "What happened to your sister?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 智仁は少し迷うような短い間を挟み、言った。
lines.translated: After a brief, hesitant pause, Tomohito spoke.

lines.content: 俺の産まれた家は古くからとある妄想に取り憑かれているんだよ
lines.translated: "The family I was born into has been possessed by a certain delusion since ancient times."

lines.content: 妄想……？
lines.translated: "A delusion...?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだ。妄想だよ――“夜の魔法使い”が俺たちに大切だと教えてくれる“想像力”じゃない。もはや妄執と言ってしまっていいものだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. A delusion--it's not the 'Imagination' that the 'Magician of the Night' teaches us is so important. You could honestly call it a monomania at this point."

lines.content: 妄執……。難しい言葉、知ってるんだな
lines.translated: "Monomania... You know some pretty difficult words, huh?"

lines.content: それってなんだ？　と問う俺に、異常な思い込みとか執着とか、そういう意味だと智仁は簡単に言った。
lines.translated: When I asked him what that meant, Tomohito simply explained that it meant an abnormal obsession or fixation.

lines.content: とにかく俺たちの実家はそういう“想い”に捕らわれていて……
lines.translated: "Anyway, our family home is trapped by those kinds of 'feelings'..."

lines.content: そんな檻のような想いから。呪いのような祈りから。俺は、姉ちゃんを自由にさせたいんだ。どこか遠くへ逃がしてやりたいんだよ
lines.translated: "From those cage-like feelings. From those curse-like prayers. I want to set my sister free. I want to help her escape somewhere far away."

lines.content: それが俺の願いだと智仁は言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito said that was his wish.

lines.content: ……その妄想とは？　呪いとは？
lines.translated: What was this delusion? What was this curse?

lines.content: 俺の産まれた家の大人たちは“永遠の命”を求めてる
lines.translated: "The adults in the family I was born into are seeking 'eternal life.'"

lines.content: そのために、“夜の国”に住む“夜の怪物”から[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]を奪った。いつか、自分たちの理想とする“[・|楽][・|園]”を作り上げるそのためにも、必要不可欠だからだ
lines.translated: "To achieve that, they stole *those things* from the 'Monsters of the Night' living in the 'Country of the Night.' Because they're indispensable if they want to someday build their ideal '*Paradise*.'"

lines.content: ……“楽園”とは？
lines.translated: "...What's 'Paradise'?"

lines.content: “夜の国”のことだよ
lines.translated: "It means the 'Country of the Night.'"

lines.content: 智仁は答える。
lines.translated: Tomohito answered.

lines.content: 思い描くものすべてを形にできる――少年少女の“夢”と“希望”でできている。そんな“夜”の世界だよ
lines.translated: "A world of 'Night' where everything you picture in your mind can be given form--made from the 'Dreams' and 'Hopes' of boys and girls."

lines.content: でも、それはおかしい
lines.translated: "Wait, that doesn't make sense."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: [・|い][・|つ][・|か]作り上げるためにと、そう言ったよな？　でも今、俺たちはそこにいる
lines.translated: "You said to build it *someday*, right? But we're standing in it right now."

lines.content: 俺は辺りを見渡した。
lines.translated: I looked around at our surroundings.

lines.content: ここは“ゆめのねどこ”だ。言ってみれば“夜の国”の只中だ
lines.translated: "This is the 'Bed of Dreams.' In a manner of speaking, we're right in the middle of the 'Country of the Night.'"

lines.content: ……それは作られるまでもなく、もう、ここにある。
lines.translated: There's no need to build it; it's already right here.

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。これはさ、[・|あ][・|れ]だよ。卵が先か鶏が先か。よくある[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|話]だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's true. Look, this is *that* thing. Which came first, the chicken or the egg? It's one of *those* common stories."

lines.content: よくある……？
lines.translated: "Common...?"

lines.content: お前はＳＦを見ないのか？　小説でも映画でもいいけどさ。とにかくそういう時間と時間とが複雑に絡み合って……色々とごちゃついてしまう例の[・|あ][・|れ]だよ
lines.translated: "Don't you watch sci-fi? Novels or movies, either is fine. Anyway, it's *that* classic trope where different timelines get tangled up in a complicated way... and everything becomes a huge mess."

lines.content: 幼い俺には難しすぎた。いや。知らないことが多すぎた。だから首をかしげる他にない。
lines.translated: It was too difficult for my young mind to grasp. No, there were just too many things I didn't know. All I could do was tilt my head in confusion.

lines.content: ……いつか“[楽園|夜の国]”を生み出すきっかけを作る者。それが、俺の姉ちゃんだと言われてる
lines.translated: "...The one who will someday create the catalyst that births the 'Country of the Night'--Paradise. They say that person is my older sister."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺が姉ちゃんを助けられたなら、きっとこの“夜の国”は消えてなくなる。そのはずなんだよ。だけどまだこうして存在してるってことは、まだまだ俺は未来を変えられてないってことだ
lines.translated: "If I manage to save my sister, this 'Country of the Night' will surely disappear. That's how it should work. So the fact that it still exists like this means I haven't managed to change the future yet."

lines.content: ……姉ちゃんは、ずっと苦しんでいるままだってことだ
lines.translated: "...It means my sister is still suffering, even now."

lines.content: だから、俺は……。と、智仁は唇を噛んでいた。
lines.translated: "And that's why I..." Tomohito trailed off, biting his lip.

lines.content: “夜の国”がなくなれば“永遠の命”も消えてなくなる。だから大人たちは必死になって、[・|予][・|定][・|通][・|り]姉ちゃんのことを犠牲にしようとしているけれど……
lines.translated: "If the 'Country of the Night' disappears, 'eternal life' will vanish right along with it. That's why the adults are desperately trying to sacrifice my sister *right on schedule*, but..."

lines.content: 大人たちの勝手な願いなんて知ったことか
lines.translated: "What do I care about the adults' selfish wishes?"

lines.content: 永遠に生きることにどんな願いを込めてるのかは知らないが――それが何であれ、何の罪もない女の子たちの命を犠牲にしていい理由にはならない。だろ？
lines.translated: "I don't know what kind of wishes they're pouring into living forever--but whatever it is, it's no excuse to sacrifice the lives of innocent girls. Right?"

lines.content: 本音を言えば人類の未来なんてどうでもいいんだ。正直なところ“夜の王”もどうだっていい
lines.translated: "If I'm being completely honest, I don't care about the future of humanity. Frankly, I don't care about the 'King of the Night' either."

lines.content: そのために、たったそれだけを叶えに、ここに来たんだ
lines.translated: "That's why I came here--just to make that one single wish come true."

lines.content: 未来を変える……。
lines.translated: Changing the future...

lines.content: “夜の国”とその原因となるらしい少女。智仁の姉。
lines.translated: The "Country of the Night" and the girl who would apparently be the cause of it. Tomohito's older sister.

lines.content: 聞き出したものはあまりに複雑に思え、正直なところ殆ど理解もできていなかっただろう。
lines.translated: Everything I had just heard seemed overwhelmingly complicated, and to be honest, I probably barely understood any of it.

lines.content: だが、予感はあった。
lines.translated: Even so, I had a hunch.

lines.content: お前は俺と一緒だな
lines.translated: "You and I are the same, huh?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: こう言うと迷惑かもしれないけれど……やっぱり、まるで他人とは思えない
lines.translated: "It might bother you to hear me say this, but... I really can't think of you as a stranger."

lines.content: 実のところその感覚こそが、智仁に協力したいと思えた本当の理由だった。
lines.translated: In truth, that very feeling was the real reason I wanted to help Tomohito.

lines.content: ……俺もだ。俺も、同じだよ
lines.translated: "...Me too. I'm the same way."

lines.content: この世界なんてどうだっていいんだ。“夜の王”だとかなんだとか。そんなのはさ、まったくくそ食らえってやつなんだよ
lines.translated: "I don't give a damn about this world. The 'King of the Night' or whatever else. Honestly, all of that can go to hell."

lines.content: 多くの人が滅びてしまおうと関係ない。ただ大切な人を救えたなら……それだけでいいんだ。それだけを叶えるために、俺もここへ来たんだ
lines.translated: "I don't care if countless people get wiped out. As long as I can save the person precious to me... that's all I need. I came here just to make that one wish come true, too."

lines.content: はは。なんだよ、それ。まったくヒーローに相応しくもないせりふだなあ
lines.translated: "Haha. What's with that? That's no line for a hero to be saying."

lines.content: 笑った。ふたりで、笑った。
lines.translated: I laughed. We both laughed together.

lines.content: そうだ。予感があった。共に代えがたい友人に――なれるかどうかはわからない。
lines.translated: Yes. I had a hunch. Whether we would become irreplaceable friends--I didn't know.

lines.content: ただ、これから俺たちはそれなりに長い付き合いにはなりそうだなと。
lines.translated: I just felt like the two of us were going to be dealing with each other for a pretty long time from here on out.

lines.content: ……なあ。聞いてくれるか、ヒーロー
lines.translated: "...Hey. Will you hear me out, hero?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: こんな世界よりもまず先に、俺がお前の世界を救ってやるよ
lines.translated: "Before worrying about a world like this, I'll save your world first."

lines.content: はは。頼もしいな
lines.translated: "Haha. Good to hear."

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑いを浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: ……俺の姉ちゃんは
lines.translated: "...My sister,"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 兎蛙、あず咲は
lines.translated: "Towa Azusaki..."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: あの人は……あまりにも天才で。あまりにも特別で。あんまりにも、少女だったから
lines.translated: "She was... far too much of a genius. Far too special. And far, far too much of an innocent girl."

lines.content: そんなふうに生まれ付いてしまったから……。
lines.translated: Because she was born that way...

lines.content: だから、姉ちゃんは――ごくごくふつうに、眠ることさえできないんだよ
lines.translated: "Because of that, my sister--can't even fall asleep like a normal person."

lines.content: もしも眠ってしまったら、姉ちゃんは――……
lines.translated: If she were to fall asleep, my sister would--...

lines.content: 部屋に戻る。
lines.translated: I returned to my room.

lines.content: 寝間着に着替え、携帯を取り出す。
lines.translated: After changing into my sleepwear, I took out my cell phone.

lines.content: 今夜はこちらからかけてみようかと操作する。
lines.translated: Thinking I might try calling her from my end tonight, I operated the keys.

lines.content: 発信ボタンを押そうかとしたところで……。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to press the call button...
*I remembered what Asahi-san had told me this morning*.

lines.content: 俺は、扉を見た。
lines.translated: I looked at the door.

lines.content: ぴったりと閉ざされた扉の向こう。
lines.translated: Just beyond the tightly shut door.

lines.content: するとタイミング良く、手の中で端末が鳴った。
lines.translated: Right on cue, the device in my hand started ringing.

lines.content: クロだ。
lines.translated: It was Kuro.

lines.content: ガラケーの画面にその名前が表示されている。
lines.translated: Her name was displayed on the screen of my flip phone.

lines.content: しかし俺はそれに応じない。
lines.translated: However, I didn't answer it.

lines.content: そのまま扉の前へと。
lines.translated: Instead, I walked straight to the door.

lines.content: ドアノブを掴んだ。
lines.translated: I grabbed the doorknob.

lines.content: 携帯は鳴り続けている。
lines.translated: My phone kept ringing.

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は勢いよく、扉を開いてみた。
lines.translated: With a swift pull, I flung the door open.

lines.content: クロが部屋に転がり込んできた。
lines.translated: Kuro tumbled right into the room.

lines.content: 扉に背をくっつけて座り込んでいたのだろう。
lines.translated: She must have been sitting on the floor with her back leaning against the door.

lines.content: コロコロコロリ、と。
lines.translated: Rolling, rolling, roll.

lines.content: まるででんぐり返りするみたいに。
lines.translated: Almost as if she were doing somersaults.

lines.content: にゃう
lines.translated: "Meow."

lines.content: ――トン、と。
lines.translated: --Thud.

lines.content: 小さな身体は向かいの壁にぶつかり停止する。
lines.translated: Her small body bumped into the opposite wall and came to a stop.

lines.content: 目が合った。
lines.translated: Our eyes met.

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: 黒色の電話の受話器を耳に付け……。
lines.translated: Holding the receiver of a black rotary phone to her ear...

lines.content: 顔が下。両足が上。
lines.translated: Her head was down. Both legs were up in the air.

lines.content: アクロバティックな格好だった。
lines.translated: It was quite the acrobatic pose.

lines.content: ……下着もちょっと見えてしまっている。
lines.translated: And her underwear was showing a little bit, too.

lines.content: すっと立ち上がる。
lines.translated: She smoothly stood up.

lines.content: パタパタとスカートを叩く。
lines.translated: Pat, pat. She brushed off her skirt.

lines.content: そしてすました顔で首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Then, with a prim and proper expression, she tilted her head.

lines.content: ……なに？
lines.translated: "...What is it?"

lines.content: 何か問題でも？　といった顔だった。
lines.translated: The look on her face seemed to ask, "Is there a problem?"

lines.content: いや。えっと。……うん
lines.translated: "No. Uh... yeah."

lines.content: 色々言いたいことはあるけれども……まずは、とりあえず。
lines.translated: There were plenty of things I wanted to say, but... first things first.

lines.content: クロ。あのさ。もしかして、だけど
lines.translated: "Kuro. Hey, it's just a guess, but..."

lines.content: いつも夜に電話してくれるとき、すぐそこにいたのかな？
lines.translated: "Whenever you call me at night, have you always been right outside?"

lines.content: クロは何も応えない。
lines.translated: Kuro didn't answer.

lines.content: 抱えていた黒い電話を……。
lines.translated: The black telephone she was holding in her arms...

lines.content: コードの繋がっていない古い形のその[魔法|電話]を、もぞもぞと長い後ろ髪の中へとしまい込んでいた。
lines.translated: She fidgeted as she tucked that old-fashioned, cordless phone--that piece of magic--away into her long back hair.

lines.content: ……それ。どうなってるんだろう。
lines.translated: Seriously, how does that work?

lines.content: 昔から抱いているそんな疑問も、改めて湧いてくるけれど。
lines.translated: That question I'd had for ages bubbled up all over again, but...

lines.content: まずは先にひとつ、確認だ。
lines.translated: First, there was something else I needed to confirm.

lines.content: 今朝、あさひさんが言ってたんだ。廊下に毛布が置いてあったって。俺の部屋の前にだよ。あれ、クロが使ってたやつ……？
lines.translated: "Asahi-san mentioned something this morning. She said there was a blanket left out in the hallway. Right in front of my room. Was that... the one you were using, Kuro?"

lines.content: もしかして、クロ。
lines.translated: Could it be that Kuro...

lines.content: 夜は自分の部屋には戻らず、いつも朝が来るまで、廊下で、俺の部屋の前で……丸くなっているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Instead of going back to her own room at night, does she always curl up in the hallway right outside my door until morning comes?

lines.content: 今回はたまたま毛布を片付け忘れていたと、そんな具合……？
lines.translated: And this time, she just happened to forget to put the blanket away...?

lines.content: ……知らない
lines.translated: "...Don't know."

lines.content: もにょもにょしていた。
lines.translated: She squirmed restlessly.

lines.content: スカートの裾をぐっと両手で握りしめ、
lines.translated: Clutching the hem of her skirt tightly with both hands,

lines.content: ……べ、別に。わたしは、ひとりでも眠れるから
lines.translated: "...I-It's not like... I can sleep all by myself just fine."

lines.content: たどたどしくクロは言う。まるでずっとずっと人と会話しておらず、話し方を忘れてしまった人みたいに。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke haltingly. Almost like someone who hadn't talked to another person in so long that she had forgotten how to speak.

lines.content: ひとりで……？
lines.translated: "All by yourself...?"

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: こっくりする。
lines.translated: She gave a little nod.

lines.content: わたしは、おばかだけど。だけどとっても、つよいから
lines.translated: "I might be silly, though. But I'm super strong."

lines.content: だから、別に……その
lines.translated: "So it's not like... um..."

lines.content: もにょもにょと。
lines.translated: Hesitantly.

lines.content: た、大雅のそばにいたい、だとか。そんなんじゃ、なく……なく
lines.translated: "I-It's not like I want to be near you, Taiga, or anything like that... Not... not at all..."

lines.content: 黙ってしまった。唇をぐっと結んで。
lines.translated: She fell silent, pressing her lips tightly together.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: ……なに
lines.translated: "...What?"

lines.content: いつも近くにいてくれるのに、どうして電話で話すのかな
lines.translated: "If you're always right near me, why do we talk over the phone?"

lines.content: 今さら過ぎる疑問を、それとないつもりで、投げかけてみた。
lines.translated: Trying to sound casual, I tossed out a question that was way overdue.

lines.content: それは
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: うん。それは？
lines.translated: "Yeah. Why is that?"

lines.content: ……そういう気分
lines.translated: "...Just feel like it."

lines.content: つんとする。
lines.translated: She turned her nose up in a huff.

lines.content: ……ただ、それだけ
lines.translated: "...That's all."

lines.content: うぅむ
lines.translated: "Hmm."

lines.content: 俺はクロと電話で話すときのことを思い出している。
lines.translated: I thought back to the times I talked with Kuro over the phone.

lines.content: 電話でなら多少、素直に話してくれるのに。
lines.translated: When we're on the phone, she's at least somewhat honest and talkative with me.

lines.content: だけどこうして直接会って話そうとしても……。
lines.translated: Yet when we try to meet and talk face-to-face like this...

lines.content: ……クロは、あまり話してくれない。
lines.translated: Kuro barely says anything to me.

lines.content: 沈黙だ。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: 居心地悪そうにそわそわしている。
lines.translated: She fidgeted uncomfortably.

lines.content: ……だけでなく、俺の顔も見てくれない。
lines.translated: Not only that, she wouldn't even look me in the eye.

lines.content: 激しい緊張を隠せないみたいに、足元に落とした視線を、絶え間なくきょろきょろとさせるばかり。
lines.translated: As if unable to hide her intense nervousness, she kept her gaze dropped to her feet, her eyes darting around endlessly.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: 聞いてる？
lines.translated: "Are you listening?"

lines.content: き、聞いてるよ。……なに？
lines.translated: "I-I'm listening. ...What?"

lines.content: 今夜もお話、してくれるのかな
lines.translated: "Will you talk with me again tonight?"

lines.content: ……する
lines.translated: "...I will."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: するよ
lines.translated: "I'll do it."

lines.content: ……大雅がそうしてほしいって、言うのなら
lines.translated: "...If you say you want me to, Taiga."

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 今夜も“安心”がすぐそばに在ってくれる。
lines.translated: Tonight, once again, "peace of mind" would be right here beside me.

lines.content: それだけでとてもうれしい気持ちになるけれど……。
lines.translated: That alone was enough to make me feel really happy, but...

lines.content: だったらさ。クロ。せっかくだし今日は電話じゃなくて直接お話、しないかな
lines.translated: "In that case, Kuro. Since we're already here, why don't we talk directly today instead of over the phone?"

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: ……しない
もにょもにょと言うのだ。
lines.translated: She mumbled under her breath.

lines.content: ……お話は、する。でも、このままじゃ、しない
lines.translated: "...I will talk with you. Just not like this."

lines.content: うつむいて。視線を下に。
lines.translated: She looked down, dropping her gaze.

lines.content: スカートを握りしめ、唇を尖らせて。
lines.translated: Clutching her skirt, she pouted her lips.

lines.content: また、沈黙だった。
lines.translated: Once again, silence fell.

lines.content: 唇を強く結んでいる。
lines.translated: She pressed her lips tightly together.

lines.content: 小さな子が人見知りな自分の心と戦うみたいだ。
lines.translated: She looked just like a little child battling her own shyness.

lines.content: そうか。残念だな
lines.translated: "I see. That's a shame."

lines.content: 俺は言う。やれやれと肩をすくめて。
lines.translated: I said, giving an exaggerated shrug.

lines.content: チョコレート
lines.translated: "I have chocolate."

lines.content: クロが喜んでくれるかなあって思ってさ。帰り道でひとつ、買ってきてたんだけど……
lines.translated: "I thought it might make you happy, Kuro, so I bought a bar on the way home, buuut..."

lines.content: ポケットから板チョコを取り出した。
lines.translated: I pulled a chocolate bar out of my pocket.

lines.content: クロが好きな苦くないやつ。ミルクチョコ。
lines.translated: The kind that isn't bitter, just the way Kuro likes it. Milk chocolate.

lines.content: コンビニで百円くらいで買えるもの。
lines.translated: Something you can buy at a convenience store for about a hundred yen.

lines.content: クロは俺の手の中のそれをじぃっと見ていた。
lines.translated: Kuro stared intently at the bar in my hand.

lines.content: 右へ左へ。
lines.translated: Left, then right.

lines.content: チョコを宙でふりふりとさせてみる。
lines.translated: I waved the chocolate back and forth in the air.

lines.content: するとクロの視線も、それに合わせて右へ、左へ……。
lines.translated: Kuro's gaze followed right along with it--to the right, to the left...

lines.content: 大好物の甘いチョコに視線も心も釘付けという具合。
lines.translated: Both her eyes and her heart were completely glued to her favorite sweet treat.

lines.content: そんなクロに、俺は意地悪く言うのだ。
lines.translated: Seeing her like that, I decided to tease her a little.

lines.content: このままお話ししてくれたら、これ、クロにあげようかな
lines.translated: "If you talk with me just like this, maybe I'll give it to you."

lines.content: ……むぅ
目を細めた。
lines.translated: She narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: 大雅は、意地悪
lines.translated: "You're being mean, Taiga."

lines.content: そんな子に育てた覚えはないんだよとクロは言うのだ。不満そうに。
lines.translated: "I certainly didn't raise you to be like that," Kuro grumbled discontentedly.

lines.content: 女の子の格好になって、かわいかったのに。……それなのに。性格は全然、かわいくない
lines.translated: "You looked so cute dressed up as a girl... And yet, your personality isn't cute at all."

lines.content: う。そのことは言わないで。思い出させないで
lines.translated: "Ugh. Please don't bring that up. Don't make me remember."

lines.content: ずきりと胸が軋むのだった。
lines.translated: A sharp pang of embarrassment shot through my chest.

lines.content: ……チョコは、ほしい
lines.translated: "...I want the chocolate."

lines.content: クロ。ぐっと唇を噛み締めた。
lines.translated: Kuro bit her lip tightly.

lines.content: でもお話は、できない
lines.translated: "But I can't talk like this."

lines.content: どうしても？
lines.translated: "No matter what?"

lines.content: どうしても
lines.translated: "No matter what."

lines.content: クロはうなずき、『だって……』と言った。
lines.translated: Kuro nodded and murmured, "Because..."

lines.content: ………………恥ずかしい、から
lines.translated: ".........Because it's embarrassing."

lines.content: それは小さなちいさな声だった。
lines.translated: It was a tiny, tiny voice.

lines.content: ともすれば、呼吸の気配くらの微かな音に、かき消されてしまうほど。
lines.translated: So faint that even the soft sound of breathing might have drowned it out.

lines.content: “どうして？”
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: そう問いたかった。
lines.translated: That was what I wanted to ask.

lines.content: 今まで、ずっと。
lines.translated: All this time.

lines.content: 小さな頃からずっとずっと、ふたりで過ごしてきたはずなのに。
lines.translated: We're supposed to have spent all our time together since we were little.

lines.content: この町に手を取り合い、寄り添い合い、ふたりっきりでやって来たはずなのに。
lines.translated: We're supposed to have come to this town all by ourselves, holding hands and leaning on each other.

lines.content: それなのにどうして、今になって“恥ずかしい”、だなんて……。
lines.translated: So why, after all this time, is she suddenly saying it's "embarrassing"...?

lines.content: だけどクロのその言葉は聞こえないふりをした。
lines.translated: Even so, I pretended not to hear those words of hers.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 問い返すようなことはしないと決めた。今のところは。
lines.translated: I decided not to press her on it. At least for now.

lines.content: じゃあ、クロ。ひとつ提案。こういうのはどうかな
lines.translated: "Alright then, Kuro. I have a suggestion. How about we try this?"

lines.content: ッ
俺はクロの小さな身体を、両脇に腕を差し込み、抱き上げた。
lines.translated: Slipping my hands under her arms, I lifted up Kuro's small body.

lines.content: 俺たちは寝床の上に背中を合わせて座った。
lines.translated: The two of us sat down back-to-back on the bed.

lines.content: ――電話でしか話せない。恥ずかしいから。
lines.translated: --She can only talk over the phone. Because she's embarrassed.

lines.content: それは顔を見合わせて話すのが大変だと、そういうことなのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe that just meant she found it too hard to talk while looking at each other face-to-face.

lines.content: そんなふうに強引な、あるいは一方的な結論を出したが故の形だった。
lines.translated: This setup was the result of me jumping to that somewhat forceful, one-sided conclusion.

lines.content: クロは俺と背中を合わせて座りチョコレートを食べている。
lines.translated: Sitting with her back against mine, Kuro began eating the chocolate.

lines.content: 丁寧に小さく割って、一つひとつ大切そうに。
lines.translated: She carefully broke it into small pieces, savoring each and every one.

lines.content: 美味しい？
lines.translated: "Is it good?"

lines.content: ……おいしい
lines.translated: "...It's good."

lines.content: 背中越しに返される小さな声だ。
lines.translated: Her quiet voice reached me from behind my back.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ。クロはどうしてチョコレートが好きなんだっけ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. Why is it that you like chocolate so much again?"

lines.content: ……好きなものは、好き。理由はそれだけ。ただ、それだけ
lines.translated: "...I like what I like. That's the only reason. Nothing more."

lines.content: 猫なのに
lines.translated: "Even though you're a cat."

lines.content: そう。猫なのに……チョコが好き。苦いのより、甘いのが
lines.translated: "Yes. Even though I'm a cat... I like chocolate. The sweet kind more than the bitter kind."

lines.content: お気に入りの味とかあるのかな。苦いのよりは甘いのが好きだっていうのは……うん。知ってるけど
lines.translated: "Do you have a favorite flavor or anything? Well, I already know you prefer sweet over bitter, though."

lines.content: ……そうだね。苦いのよりは、甘いのがいい。でも、やっぱり、どっちも好きだよ
lines.translated: "...Right. Sweet is better than bitter. But really, I like both."

lines.content: チョコは、甘くて。ときどき苦くて……。ぺろぺろしてるだけでも、しあわせな気持ちになってくる
lines.translated: "Chocolate is sweet. And sometimes bitter... Just licking it starts to make me feel so happy."

lines.content: 上手く言えないけどとにかく美味しい、だから好き。だから大好き、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: She couldn't quite put it into words, she said, but it was delicious anyway, which was why she liked it--why she loved it.

lines.content: さっきまでのおどおど、もにょもにょした雰囲気は、どこか小さくなっているように感じられた。
lines.translated: The timid, mumbling demeanor she had just a moment ago seemed to have faded away a bit.

lines.content: 言葉をつっかえたり噛んでしまったりと、そういった場面も少なくなった。
lines.translated: She was stumbling over her words and tripping on her tongue much less now, too.

lines.content: やっぱり顔を合わせず背中を向け合っている、この体勢が功を成したのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Sitting back-to-back without looking at each other's faces really might have done the trick.

lines.content: そして俺は、背中越しに問いかけるのだ。
lines.translated: And so, speaking over my shoulder, I asked her a question.

lines.content: あまりに美味しそうにチョコレートを食べているクロに。
lines.translated: To Kuro, who was eating the chocolate with such relish.

lines.content: ねえ、クロ。もしかしてそれが今日、まともに食べるご飯だとか。そんなわけじゃないよね……？
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. Don't tell me this is the only proper meal you're having today. That's not the case, right...?"

lines.content: ちゃんと食べないと大きくなれないよ、クロ。身体によくない
lines.translated: "You won't grow big if you don't eat properly, Kuro. It's bad for you."

lines.content: ……関係ない
lines.translated: "...It doesn't matter."

lines.content: ふるふるとクロが首を振る。その気配が背中から伝わってくる。
lines.translated: Kuro gave a little shake of her head. I could feel the motion through my back.

lines.content: わたしはこれ以上大きくなれない。小さいけど、これで大人。……大人、だよ？　だから栄養いっぱいとっても同じ。変わらないし、変われない
lines.translated: "I can't grow any bigger than this. I'm small, but I'm already an adult like this. ...I'm an adult, you know? So even if I get lots of nutrition, it's all the same. I won't change, and I can't change."

lines.content: そうなの？　もう、変われない？
lines.translated: "Is that so? You can't change anymore?"

lines.content: そう。変わらない。……この家の小さな子も、わたしと同じ
lines.translated: "Yes. I won't change. ...The little girl in this house is the same as me."

lines.content: 小さな子。十夜のこと？
lines.translated: "The little girl? Do you mean Toya?"

lines.content: うん、そう
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: あの子もわたしと同じだ。全然大きさ、変わらない
lines.translated: "That girl is the same as me. Her size doesn't change at all."

lines.content: 確かにそうだ。
lines.translated: That was certainly true.

lines.content: 出会った頃よりまるで背丈の変化がないのだ。それはあさひさんも同様だった。
lines.translated: Her height hadn't changed one bit since the time we first met. And the same went for Asahi-san.

lines.content: いつまでも幼いまま。いつまでも、若いまま。
lines.translated: Forever childlike. Forever young.
"...Because that's *what we are*."

lines.content: そっか。そういうもの、か
lines.translated: "I see. That's just what you are, huh."

lines.content: だからしっかり食べて、しっかり寝なきゃなのは、わたしよりも大雅のほうが、大事なんだよ
lines.translated: "So eating well and sleeping well is much more important for you than it is for me, Taiga."

lines.content: だって大雅は育ち盛りなんだから。今よりもっと、心も身体も、大きくおおきくなれるんだから
lines.translated: "Because you're still growing, Taiga. Both your heart and your body can grow much, much bigger than they are now."

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: 大雅も、食べる……？
lines.translated: "Do you want to eat some too, Taiga...?"

lines.content: 振り返ってみる。
lines.translated: I glanced back over my shoulder.

lines.content: すると、板チョコを半分割って、それを差し出してくれていた。
lines.translated: She had broken off half of the chocolate bar and was holding it out to me.

lines.content: ありがとう。ちょっとだけ貰うよ
lines.translated: "Thanks. I'll just take a little piece."

lines.content: 手渡されたカケラを更に三分の一くらいに割って、残りを返した。
lines.translated: I broke off about a third of the piece she handed me and gave the rest back to her.

lines.content: 少しの間ふたりでチョコレートを食べていた。
lines.translated: For a little while, the two of us ate chocolate together.

lines.content: かち、かち、かち、かち
lines.translated: Click, click, click, click.

lines.content: いつもは気にならない時計の音が、ほんの少し大きなものに感じられていた。
lines.translated: The ticking of the clock, which I usually never noticed, sounded just a little louder than normal.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: ぽつりとクロが俺を呼ぶ。なに？　と俺は問い返す。
lines.translated: Quietly, Kuro called my name. "What is it?" I asked in return.

lines.content: いつもの話の、続き……
lines.translated: "To continue our usual talk..."

lines.content: いつも？
lines.translated: "Our usual talk?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: ……大雅は、あの子たちの“夢”を叶えるための“[希望|魔法]”を探し続けてる
lines.translated: "...You're always searching for the 'magic' to grant those girls' 'dreams,' Taiga."

lines.content: だからわたしは、大雅の“夢”を叶えるための“[希望|魔法]”が知りたい。そういう話
lines.translated: "So I want to know the 'magic' to grant your 'dream,' Taiga. That's what I'm talking about."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: “夢”と“希望”
lines.translated: "Dreams" and "hopes."

lines.content: 俺には助けたい人がいる。幸せになってほしい人たちがいる。
lines.translated: There is someone I want to save. People I want to see happy.

lines.content: しかし困難な夢だ。難しい夢だ。果てしなく。どうしようもなく。
lines.translated: Yet it is an arduous dream. A difficult dream. Endlessly, hopelessly so.

lines.content: そういった夢の中に光を灯すことのできる“[希望|魔法]”とは、いったい、どんなものであればいいと俺は願い……“想像”するのだろうか。
lines.translated: Just what kind of "magic" -- what kind of "hope" -- do I wish for and "imagine" could light a spark within such a dream?

lines.content: それはとても簡単なことのように見え、同時に何より難しいことのようにも思えた。
lines.translated: It seemed like the simplest thing in the world, and at the same time, harder than anything else.

lines.content: ちゃんと、考えておいて
lines.translated: "Think it over carefully."

lines.content: そして[・|そ][・|れ]が決まったら、わたしに教えて。大雅が欲しいと感じたとおりをぜんぶ、わたしにちゃんと、伝えてほしい
lines.translated: "And once you decide on *that*, tell me. I want you to properly tell me everything, just the way you felt you wanted it, Taiga."

lines.content: クロは静かに『だってわたしは』と、そう言った。
lines.translated: "Because I am..." Kuro said quietly.

lines.content: だってわたしは、大雅の“魔法”に“許可”を出すための“鍵”……みたいなもの、なんだから
lines.translated: "Because I'm like... the 'key' to grant 'permission' to your 'magic,' Taiga."

lines.content: チョコレートの最後のカケラを俺は口に含んだ。
lines.translated: I popped the last piece of chocolate into my mouth.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: 明日からはこうして話をするようにできないかな
lines.translated: "Do you think we could talk like this starting tomorrow, too?"

lines.content: こうして……？
lines.translated: "Like this...?"

lines.content: そう。こうして布団の上で……いや。まあ、布団じゃなくてもそれはどこでもいいけど、こうして、背中をくっつけ合って
lines.translated: "Yeah. Sitting on the futon like this... Well, I guess it doesn't have to be the futon, anywhere is fine, really. Just sitting back-to-back like this."

lines.content: 顔は見合わせることなく。
lines.translated: Without looking at each other's faces.

lines.content: だけどすぐ近くで、話をしよう。
lines.translated: Just talking right next to each other.

lines.content: 電話でお話しできるのも、俺は、うれしいけど……
lines.translated: "I'm happy to be able to talk to you on the phone, too, of course, but..."

lines.content: そこで携帯に着信があった。
lines.translated: Just then, my phone went off.

lines.content: クロと繋がるためのものではない。
lines.translated: Not the one meant for connecting with Kuro.

lines.content: ふつうの端末が短く震えた。メールか。あるいは通信アプリを通じたメッセージか。
lines.translated: My normal device gave a short buzz. An email? Or maybe a message through a chat app?

lines.content: ……大雅の電話。鳴ってたよ
lines.translated: "...Your phone, Taiga. It went off."

lines.content: あ、ああ。そうだね
lines.translated: "O-Oh. Yeah, you're right."

lines.content: 電話の着信ではない。だから確認するのは後でもよかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't a phone call, so checking it could have waited until later.

lines.content: だけどなんとなく俺はポケットからその端末を取り出した。
lines.translated: Even so, for whatever reason, I pulled the device out of my pocket.

lines.content: ……ちょっとした気まずさのようなものを感じてしまっていたのかもしれない。それを振り払うようにして端末を確認する。
lines.translated: Maybe I was feeling a slight sense of awkwardness. I checked the screen as if trying to shake that feeling off.

lines.content: ……ハル？
lines.translated: "...Haru?"

lines.content: 画面に表示された名前が唇からふと零れた。
lines.translated: The name displayed on the screen slipped from my lips.

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。
lines.translated: What's going on with her?

lines.content: 『新しくしたスマートフォンから送ってみたよ。連絡先は千和ちゃんから教えて貰いました』
lines.translated: "I tried sending this from my new smartphone. Chiwa-chan gave me your contact info."

lines.content: そんな一文がメッセージアプリの画面上に表示されていた。
lines.translated: That single sentence was displayed on the messaging app screen.

lines.content: 『遅くにごめんね。あのね。相談したいことがあるんだけど……。いいかな？』
lines.translated: "Sorry for messaging so late. Um, there's something I'd like to talk to you about... Is now an okay time?"

lines.content: ポンと軽快な効果音と共に、続けてそんなメッセージが表示されていた。
lines.translated: Along with a light, cheerful sound effect, that follow-up message popped up right after.

lines.content: 『今夜はもう少し起きてるつもり。相談って？』
lines.translated: "I'm planning on staying up a little longer tonight. What did you want to talk about?"

lines.content: 手早くそう返した。
lines.translated: I typed back a quick reply.

lines.content: 即座に“既読”のマークが現れる。
lines.translated: A "Read" mark appeared almost instantly.

lines.content: ……どういうメールだった？
lines.translated: "...What kind of email was it?"

lines.content: 背中越しのクロが小さく俺にそう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro asked me quietly over her shoulder.

lines.content: メールの内容。それを聞いても良いものか、と少し迷ったふうにではあった。
lines.translated: She sounded a little hesitant, as if wondering whether it was okay for her to ask about the contents of the email.

lines.content: メールじゃないよ。メッセージだった
lines.translated: "It's not an email. It was a message."

lines.content: ……違いがわからない
lines.translated: "...I don't know the difference."

lines.content: おばかなわたしにもわかるように教えてほしい、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: Explain it so even a dummy like me can understand, Kuro said.

lines.content: チャットみたいに短い文章で会話するんだよ
lines.translated: "You have a conversation using short sentences, like a chat."

lines.content: ちゃっと……？　チョコレートの名前みたいだ
lines.translated: "Chat...? Sounds like the name of a chocolate."

lines.content: え？　そう、かな……？
lines.translated: "Huh? You think so...?"

lines.content: うん。甘々そうな予感がするよ。そんな感じだね
lines.translated: "Yeah. I have a feeling it's super sweet. It has that kind of ring to it."

lines.content: はは。そっか。じゃあハルから届いたチョコレートだ。甘々そうかは、わからないけど
lines.translated: "Haha, I see. Then it's a chocolate from Haru. Though I don't know about it being super sweet."

lines.content: 俺の返答があんまりお気に召さなかったのだろうか、クロはちょっとむすっとして、黙ってしまった。
lines.translated: Maybe my answer wasn't entirely to her liking, because Kuro went a little sullen and fell silent.

lines.content: そこで端末が短く鳴る。
lines.translated: Right then, my phone gave another short chime.

lines.content: ……また、鳴った
lines.translated: "...It went off again."

lines.content: うん。ハルからの返事だと思う
lines.translated: "Yeah. I think it's a reply from Haru."

lines.content: 端末を見る。
lines.translated: I looked at the screen.

lines.content: やっぱりそうだ。ハルから届いたメッセージがいくつか続けて並んでいた。
lines.translated: Just as I thought. Several messages from Haru were lined up one after another.

lines.content: 『智仁くんとあず咲先輩のことなんだけど……。やっぱり気になっちゃって』
lines.translated: "It's about Tomohito-kun and Azusaki-senpai... I just can't stop worrying about them."

lines.content: 『何かふたりの力になれることないかなあって、あれからずっと考えてたんだけど……。どうかな、大雅くん。私、あまり余計なことしないほうがいいかな』
lines.translated: "Ever since then, I've been wondering if there's anything I can do to help the two of them... What do you think, Taiga-kun? Would it be better if I didn't meddle too much?"

lines.content: その文面には、ハルの不安が隠されることなくはっきりと浮かんでいた。
lines.translated: Haru's anxiety came through plain as day in her text, completely unhidden.

lines.content: 『私、ふたりの役に立てるならそうしたいんだけど……』
lines.translated: "If I can be of help to them, I really want to..."

lines.content: 『でも、きっと私ががんばったら変なふうに空回りしちゃって、逆に迷惑掛けちゃうだろうなって思うから……』
lines.translated: "But I feel like if I try too hard, I'll just end up spinning my wheels in some weird way and causing trouble for them instead..."

lines.content: 『だから、ごめんね。大雅くん。もしよかったら、一緒にふたりの役に立てる方法を、何か考えてもらえたら、うれしいなって』
lines.translated: "So, I'm sorry, Taiga-kun. If you don't mind, I'd be really happy if we could think of some way to help the two of them together."

lines.content: ハルからのメッセージを読みながら、返答を考えていると……、
lines.translated: As I read through Haru's messages and thought about how to reply...

lines.content: ……どん、と。
lines.translated: Thud.

lines.content: クロがぴったりくっつけていた背中をぶつけてきた。
lines.translated: Kuro, whose back had been pressed right up against mine, bumped into me.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: クロは頬を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks were puffed out.

lines.content: どんどんと。
lines.translated: Thud, thud.

lines.content: 身体をゆらし、クロは背中をぶつけてくる。
lines.translated: Rocking her body back and forth, Kuro kept bumping her back against mine.

lines.content: く、クロ。痛い。どうしたの？
lines.translated: "K-Kuro, ow. What's wrong?"

lines.content: 今夜の大雅。ちょっと、きらい
lines.translated: "I kind of don't like you tonight, Taiga."

lines.content: えっ、ど、どうして？
lines.translated: "Huh? W-Why?"

lines.content: ……だって
lines.translated: "...Well, that's because..."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせた。
lines.translated: She pouted her lips.

lines.content: だって、大雅。ハルとばっかり……甘々な感じの、チョコレート
lines.translated: "Because, Taiga. You're only paying attention to Haru... with that super sweet chocolate."

lines.content: え？　チョコ？
lines.translated: "Huh? Chocolate?"

lines.content: あ、ああ、チャットのこと……？
lines.translated: "O-Oh, you mean the chat...?"

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: 俺を振り向く。ジト目だ。
lines.translated: She glanced back at me with a flat, unimpressed stare.

lines.content: そしてその視線をうつむくようにして落とす。
lines.translated: Then she cast her gaze downward.

lines.content: 今夜の大雅は、わたしとお話してたのに。ハルよりも先に、お話し……してたのに
lines.translated: "You were talking with me tonight, Taiga. You were talking with me... before Haru."

lines.content: クロはすっと立ち上がり……、
lines.translated: Kuro stood up in one smooth motion and...

lines.content: ……おやすみ大雅
lines.translated: "...Goodnight, Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅の“夢”
lines.translated: "Your 'dream,' Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅の、“[魔法|希望]”
lines.translated: "Your 'hope' -- your 'magic,' Taiga."

lines.content: 約束だよ。……お願いだよ。それだけ忘れず、考えておいて
lines.translated: "It's a promise. ...Please. Just don't forget to think about it."

lines.content: それだけ言うと、さっと部屋から出て行ってしまった。
lines.translated: With just those parting words, she quickly walked out of the room.

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: 悪いことをしてしまった。
lines.translated: I messed up.

lines.content: クロと直接お話できる貴重な時間を、その機会を、自ら手放してしまったようで……。
lines.translated: It felt like I had thrown away a precious opportunity to talk directly with Kuro with my own two hands...

lines.content: ごめんクロ。今度はもっと美味しいチョコレート、お詫びに買ってくるから
lines.translated: "Sorry, Kuro. I'll buy you some even tastier chocolate next time to make it up to you."

lines.content: スマホが短く震える。ハルからのメッセージが続けて届く。
lines.translated: My smartphone buzzed briefly. More messages from Haru came in one after another.

lines.content: それからハルと夜通し短いメッセージをやりとりし合った。
lines.translated: After that, Haru and I exchanged short messages all through the night.

lines.content: 今日も今日とて宣伝活動。
lines.translated: Today, once again, it was time for promotional activities.

lines.content: またかわいい格好をさせられ真っ赤な顔で羞恥に耐える。
lines.translated: Forced to wear another cute outfit, enduring the humiliation with a bright red face.

lines.content: そんな拷問めいた放課後のはじまりだ。
lines.translated: It was the start of another torturous afternoon after school.

lines.content: と、思いきや――
lines.translated: Or so I thought--

lines.content: ……う、ううううううううっ
lines.translated: "...U-Uuuuuuuuuugh..."

lines.content: 今日、かわいい格好をさせられ真っ赤な顔で羞恥に耐えていたのはハルだった。
lines.translated: Today, the one forced into a cute outfit and enduring the humiliation with a bright red face was Haru.

lines.content: 放課後過ぎの千和のお店。その店内である。
lines.translated: We were inside Chiwa's cafe after school.

lines.content: 閉店前の殆ど人のやって来ない時間帯だ。まるで貸し切り状態のようなこの場所で、ハルは智仁に“変身”させられていた。
lines.translated: It was right before closing time, when almost no customers ever came in. With the place practically reserved just for us, Haru had been "transformed" by Tomohito.

lines.content: ひ、ひどいよ……こんなの、ひどい……っ
lines.translated: "T-This is awful... It's too cruel..."

lines.content: もう、こんなはずかしい服……二度と着ることないって、思ってたのに……っ
lines.translated: "And here I thought... I'd never have to wear such embarrassing clothes ever again...!"

lines.content: ひらひら、ふりふりなその服装は、あの頃のことを……およそ十年前だ。みんなが特別だった頃のことをどうしたって彷彿とさせられる。そんなデザインだった。
lines.translated: With all its flutters and frills, the design of the outfit inevitably brought back memories of back then... about ten years ago, when everyone was special.

lines.content: 衣装のテーマは“魔法少女”だ。うん。よく似合ってるよ。ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "The theme of the costume is 'magical girl.' Yep, it suits you really well, Haru-chan."

lines.content: ここ数日、家に帰ってからというもの、課題をやる時間さえ惜しんでせっせと手縫いしてきたのだと、若干不気味なことを智仁は言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito said something slightly disturbing about how, for the past few days, he had been diligently sewing it by hand after getting home, even sacrificing the time he should have spent on homework.

lines.content: そのステッキはマイクにもなるんだよ。すごいだろ
lines.translated: "That wand doubles as a microphone, too. Pretty amazing, right?"

lines.content: いや。そんなもの作る暇があるならもっとすべきことがあるはずだろうに
lines.translated: "Come on. If you have the free time to make something like that, there are definitely other things you ought to be doing."
Wait.

lines.content: そう言ってしまうのは[・|意][・|地][・|の][・|悪][・|い]ことだろう。そうわかっていてもつい、そんな言葉がこぼれてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Saying that was probably *mean-spirited* of me. Even knowing that, the words just slipped out anyway.

lines.content: きょ、今日も、かわいい大雅くんを見られるって思ってたのに……っ、ううっ、それなのにっ
lines.translated: "A-And I thought I'd get to see Taiga-kun looking cute again today... Uuu, and yet...!"

lines.content: それなのにまさか今度は自分の番だとは思ってもみなかった――ぎゅっと眉根の寄せられた表情が、言葉よりも確かにそう語っていた。
lines.translated: And yet she had never dreamed it would be her turn this time -- her tightly furrowed brows spoke that truth louder than any words could.

lines.content: 言ったろう？　ハルちゃんには一番目立てる役をお願いするんだってさ。その期待に応えなきゃって思って、がんばったんだ
lines.translated: "I told you, didn't I? That I was going to ask you to take on the flashiest role, Haru-chan. I felt like I had to live up to those expectations, so I gave it my all."

lines.content: そう言う智仁に、ハルは笑顔を引きつらせていた。
lines.translated: At Tomohito's words, Haru's smile twitched.

lines.content: ……本番も、これ着るの？
lines.translated: "...Do I have to wear this for the real thing, too?"

lines.content: もちろんだ
lines.translated: "Of course."

lines.content: 歌ったり？
lines.translated: "And sing?"

lines.content: 踊ったりもだ
lines.translated: "And dance, too."

lines.content: 今日の放課後は歌やダンスの練習をしよう。智仁はひとりで息巻いている。
lines.translated: Let's practice singing and dancing after school today. Tomohito was getting all fired up on his own.

lines.content: こ、こんな、だめだよ……踊れないっ、こんな短いスカートで……い、色々、見えちゃうよ……っ
lines.translated: "I-I can't... I can't dance in a skirt this short... P-People will see all kinds of things...!"

lines.content: 真っ赤な顔。涙目。短いスカートの裾をぎゅっと引っ張っていた。
lines.translated: Bright red face. Teary eyes. She was tugging tightly at the hem of her short skirt.

lines.content: 歌とかダンスの練習って。お店の中でそんなことだめですよ。今はいいですけど、他のお客さんが来たら迷惑ですし
lines.translated: "Singing and dancing practice? You can't do that inside the cafe. It's fine right now, but it'll bother the other customers if anyone comes in."

lines.content: 千和が食器を片付けながらチラチラとハルを見ていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa kept glancing over at Haru as she cleared away the dishes.

lines.content: う、ううう。あんまり、見ないで……
lines.translated: "U-Uuuu. Don't look at me so much..."

lines.content: 恥ずかしそうに短いスカートをぐいぐいと引っ張っている。
lines.translated: Embarrassed, she kept tugging down hard on her short skirt.

lines.content: そんなハルの様子を智仁は満足げに見ていた。
lines.translated: Tomohito watched Haru's reaction with a look of satisfaction.

lines.content: 大雅。どうだ？
lines.translated: "Taiga. What do you think?"

lines.content: どう……とは？
lines.translated: "What do I think... about what?"

lines.content: 感想を求めたい
lines.translated: "I want your impressions."

lines.content: 感想……
lines.translated: "My impressions..."

lines.content: ああ。こんな感じで、ハルちゃんだけでなく、千和ちゃんやひよちゃんもかわいくなってもらってさ、“春の学園祭”を、俺プロデュースのライブを盛り上げていきたいんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Just like this, I want not only Haru-chan, but Chiwa-chan and Hiyo-chan to get all cute too, so we can really hype up my self-produced concert at the Spring School Festival."

lines.content: 熱弁を振るう智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito delivered an impassioned speech.

lines.content: しかし千和は空の食器やコップを片付けることに戻り、姫織は残り少ないパフェをゆっくりゆっくり食べている。
lines.translated: However, Chiwa went back to clearing away the empty dishes and glasses, while Himeori ate the last bit of her parfait very, very slowly.

lines.content: いつも驚くくらい早食いなのに――ふたりとも、聞こえないふりだった。
lines.translated: Even though she normally ate surprisingly fast -- both of them were pretending not to hear him.

lines.content: ううっ、ふたりもちゃんとやってくれるよね？　協力するって、言ったもんね？　こんな格好……私ひとりだけに、させないよね……っ？
lines.translated: "Uuu, you two are going to do it properly too, right? You said you'd help out, didn't you? You're not... going to make me wear an outfit like this all by myself, right...?"

lines.content: ぐずぐずと鼻を啜っていた。
lines.translated: She was sniffling.

lines.content: そんなハルを見て、思うのだ――感想、か。
lines.translated: Looking at Haru like that, I thought to myself -- my impressions, huh?

lines.content: いいぞ、ハル。今日から俺は柊ハル推しだ
lines.translated: "Looking good, Haru. Starting today, Hiiragi Haru is my oshi."

lines.content: 推し……？
lines.translated: "Oshi...?"

lines.content: 何それ？　とハルは目をぱちぱちとさせた。
lines.translated: What's that? Haru blinked her eyes in confusion.

lines.content: 他にどんなかわいい子が登場しようと生涯揺るぐこともなく……君だ、君ひとりだけだ。俺はハルのアイドル人生を支持していきたい。その誓いみたいなものだよ
lines.translated: "No matter what other cute girls might show up, I will never waver for the rest of my life... It's you, and only you. I want to support Haru's idol career. It's like a vow."

lines.content: グッと俺は拳を握りしめ、
lines.translated: I clenched my fist tightly.

lines.content: おおっ、ファン第一号ってことでいいんだな
lines.translated: "Oh! So I can count you as her number one fan, then?"

lines.content: 智仁が歓喜していた。
lines.translated: Tomohito was overjoyed.

lines.content: べ、別に、私、アイドルなんてなりたくないしならないよっ
lines.translated: "I-It's not like I want to be an idol, and I'm not going to become one!"

lines.content: サインください
lines.translated: "May I have your autograph, please?"

lines.content: きっと今週末にはその価値はうなぎ上りな具合になるはずだ
lines.translated: "I'm sure its value will skyrocket by this weekend."

lines.content: ……そ、そんなのないよ
lines.translated: "...I-I don't have one of those."

lines.content: じゃあ……仕方がない。抱き枕でもいいんで、なる早でグッズ化してほしい
lines.translated: "Well then... I guess it can't be helped. A dakimakura is fine too, so I want them to make merch of you ASAP."

lines.content: 何が“じゃあ”なのかさっぱりだよ……。抱き枕って、どういうこと？　そんなのだってどこにもないんだよ
lines.translated: "I don't get what you mean by 'well then' at all... What do you mean, a dakimakura? Something like that doesn't exist anywhere, either."

lines.content: もじもじしながら、『もうこれ脱いでいい？　いいよね？　脱ぐよ？　脱いじゃうよ？』と、ハルはものすごく居心地わるそうにしていた。
lines.translated: Fidgeting restlessly, Haru looked terribly uncomfortable, her body language practically begging, "Can I take this off now? It's okay, right? I'm taking it off, okay? I'm really gonna take it off!"

lines.content: そんなハルを眺めながら俺は言う。今まで疑問に思っていたことを。
lines.translated: As I watched Haru like that, I voiced something I had been wondering about up until now.

lines.content: 智仁。俺さ、いつも思ってたんだよ
lines.translated: "Tomohito. There's something I've always thought."

lines.content: おう？　何をだ？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What's that?"

lines.content: 熱中できる“何か”があることはすばらしいと思う。それだけできっと人生は光り輝く――だ、なんて
lines.translated: "I think it's wonderful to have 'something' you can be passionate about. Just having that is enough to make life shine brightly -- or so they say."

lines.content: おっさんみたいなことを先に添えさせてもらった上で、言わせてもらいたいんだが
lines.translated: "Allow me to preface this with something an old man would say, because there's something I want to get off my chest."

lines.content: あ、ああ？
lines.translated: "H-Huh?"

lines.content: 正直なところアイドルを応援する人たちの気持ち、まったく、全然、俺はわからなかったんだ。でも、考えが変わった
lines.translated: "To be completely honest, I never understood the feelings of people who cheer for idols. Not one bit, not at all. But I've changed my mind."

lines.content: ハルの変身は……マジで、尊い。みんなこんな気持ちだったんだな
lines.translated: "Haru's transformation is... seriously precious. So this is how everyone felt."

lines.content: 両手をすり合わせ、拝んだ。
lines.translated: I rubbed my hands together and bowed in worship.

lines.content: 引き気味なハルには構うことなく、俺は言うのだ。
lines.translated: Paying no mind to Haru, who was creeped out and backing away slightly, I continued speaking.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。これまではまったく、アイドルにどっぷりハマる人たちの気持ちは理解できなかった――
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Up until now, I couldn't understand the feelings of people who get completely hooked on idols at all--"

lines.content: だってさ、いくら課金したって感謝されないどころか“約束”だって守らない。アイドル業ってのはさ、公式であるだけのただの詐欺行為なんじゃないのかとさえ思ってたんだ
lines.translated: "Because, you know, no matter how much money you whale on them, not only do they not thank you, they don't even keep their 'promises.' I even thought the whole idol industry was just an officially sanctioned scam."

lines.content: 課金、言うなよ……詐欺ってなんだよ
lines.translated: "Don't call it whaling... And what do you mean, a scam?"

lines.content: 恋愛禁止だとかうたっておいて、ファンからお金を巻き上げてるじゃないか
lines.translated: "They preach about having a 'no dating rule' and use that to fleece money from their fans, don't they?"

lines.content: よくある批判だな。それ
lines.translated: "That's a pretty common criticism."

lines.content: ああ。そうだ。よくあるからこそ誰もが不思議に思ってるってことだろう？
lines.translated: "Yeah, it is. And the fact that it's so common means everyone finds it weird, right?"

lines.content: だというのに、恋愛してるのがバレたら今度はそれを応援できないファンは[きょうりょう|狭量]だとまで言い出しかねない雰囲気だ――
lines.translated: "And yet, the moment they get caught dating someone, the atmosphere shifts to acting like the fans who can't support their relationship are just being narrow-minded--"

lines.content: 私たちにだって人を好きになる権利くらいある！　こんなのひどい！　人権問題だ！　そんなこと言ってる当事者までいるだろ
lines.translated: "'We have the right to fall in love with people, too! This is awful! It's a human rights issue!' Some of the idols involved even say stuff like that, don't they?"

lines.content: いや。ちょっと待てよ。恋愛禁止はあんたらが言い出したことだろうが。その宣伝文句込みでＣＤ買ったりグッズ買ったり安くない買い物を、おっさん達はし続けてるんだ――
lines.translated: "No, hold on a minute. You guys were the ones who brought up the no-dating rule in the first place. All those middle-aged guys keep making pricey purchases, buying CDs and merch, with that advertising slogan factored into the deal--"

lines.content: ――それなのに、それなのにどうしてファンが悪役みたいな感じになってんだ。そう思ってた
lines.translated: "--And yet, despite all that, why do the fans end up looking like the bad guys? That's what I used to think."

lines.content: お、おお……。そうかな？
lines.translated: "O-Oh... You think so?"

lines.content: ああ。だってさ、考えてもみろよ。智仁
lines.translated: "Yeah. Just think about it, Tomohito."

lines.content: たとえば、めっちゃ美味しいラーメン食わせますぜ！　と宣伝しまくってる店で、うきうきしながら食券買ったのに、当然みたいな顔でカレーが出てきたら誰だって文句言うだろ？
lines.translated: "For example, if a shop advertises all over the place saying, 'We'll serve you crazy delicious ramen!' and you excitedly buy a meal ticket, only for them to serve you curry with a straight face like it's the most natural thing in the world, anyone would complain, right?"

lines.content: ……俺は今、何を言われてるんだろうか。もしかして怒られてるのか？　“何か”を代表して
lines.translated: "...What am I being told right now? Am I getting lectured? On behalf of 'something'?"

lines.content: いや。違う。怒ってはいないんだ。今まではそうだったかもしれないが……違うんだ。考えが変わった。ハル。かわいい。すっごく
lines.translated: "No, that's not it. I'm not angry. Maybe I was up until now, but... not anymore. I've changed my mind. Haru is cute. Super cute."

lines.content: か、かわいいって……
lines.translated: "C-Cute...?"

lines.content: こんなかわいい姿を見せられちゃあ……食べたくもないカレーくらいがまんして食ってやるさって気持ちには、なれるな。かわいいは、正義。まさに真理だ
lines.translated: "When I'm shown a sight this cute... it makes me feel like I can put up with eating a plate of curry I didn't even want. Cute is justice. That is the absolute truth."

lines.content: うう……さっきから、何なの……大雅くん、ちょっと変だよ
lines.translated: "Uuu... What have you been talking about this whole time...? Taiga-kun, you're acting a little weird."

lines.content: 真っ赤な顔でふるふると震えていた。
lines.translated: She was trembling with a bright red face.

lines.content: ああ……。こんなかわいい子なら、手が届かなくても、存在を知ってさえもらえなくても、公約違反があろうとも、生涯応援し続けたいって気持ちくらいにはなれるさ
lines.translated: "Yeah... For a girl this cute, even if she's out of reach, even if she doesn't know I exist, even if she breaks her public promises, I can still bring myself to want to support her for the rest of my life."

lines.content: そこに彼氏がいようと、実は性格めっちゃどす黒くっても……
lines.translated: "Even if she has a boyfriend, or even if her personality is actually pitch-black..."

lines.content: ……いや
俺のハルには彼氏もいないし性格もめっちゃいいよな
lines.translated: "My Haru doesn't have a boyfriend, and she has a super great personality, right?"

lines.content: お、俺のって……なんだよう……そ、そんな怖い顔、しないでよ……今日の大雅くん。やっぱりちょっと変だよ
lines.translated: "Y-Your Haru...? What is that supposed to mean...? D-Don't make such a scary face... Taiga-kun, you really are acting a little weird today."

lines.content: 今日[・|も]変っていうのがきっと正しいですよ。この場合
lines.translated: "In this case, I'm pretty sure saying he's acting weird *today, too* would be more accurate."

lines.content: 女装させられた鬱憤が炸裂しちゃってるんじゃあないの？
lines.translated: "Isn't all his pent-up frustration from being forced to crossdress just exploding?"

lines.content: 何を余裕ぶってるんだ君たち。当日、君たちもかわいくさせられるのを忘れちゃいないか
lines.translated: "Why are you two acting so relaxed? Have you forgotten that you're going to be made all cute on the day of the event, too?"

lines.content: 千和と姫織のかわいい姿を想像してみる――
lines.translated: I tried imagining Chiwa and Himeori in cute outfits--

lines.content: うん。ふたりもきっと、すっごくかわいい。保証する
lines.translated: "Yep. I'm sure you two will look super cute, too. I guarantee it."

lines.content: あ、ああー……
lines.translated: "A-Aaah..."

lines.content: ハルがジト目で俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: Haru stared at me with half-lidded, unimpressed eyes.

lines.content: 大雅くんの、うそつき
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun, you liar."

lines.content: え？　なにが……？
lines.translated: "Huh? About what...?"

lines.content: 私だけ生涯推してくれるって言ってたのに……。もう、浮気なんだ
lines.translated: "You just said I'd be your only oshi for the rest of your life... You're already cheating on me."

lines.content: い、いや。そういうわけじゃ……。それに、これって“浮気”であってるのかな。この業界、色々造語があって紛らわしいよな
lines.translated: "N-No, that's not what I... Besides, is 'cheating' even the right word for this? This industry has so much made-up slang, it's confusing."

lines.content: 苦笑いで誤魔化そうとしたけれど、余計なところに話が飛び火してしまう。
lines.translated: I tried to laugh it off with a wry smile, but the conversation ended up backfiring in an completely unnecessary direction.

lines.content: いやいや。大雅も余裕じゃいられないだろ。そんな他人事じゃ、いられないだろ
lines.translated: "No, no. You can't afford to act so relaxed either, Taiga. You can't act like this doesn't concern you."

lines.content: 千和ちゃんやひよちゃんだけじゃないんだぞ。お前だ。お前にだってかわいくなって舞台に立ってもらう
lines.translated: "It's not just Chiwa-chan and Hiyo-chan. It's you, too. I'm going to have you get all cute and stand on that stage as well."

lines.content: はぁ……っ！？
lines.translated: "Haaah...!?"

lines.content: あんなにかわいくなれる奴を放っておく訳がないだろう。敏腕プロデューサーを目指すこの俺がな
lines.translated: "There's no way I'd just leave someone who can get that cute on the sidelines. Not when I'm aiming to become a brilliant producer."

lines.content: いつからお前の目指す道はプロデューサーになったんだ。初耳だぞ
lines.translated: "Since when did becoming a producer become your life's goal? This is the first I'm hearing of it."

lines.content: 音楽はどうした音楽は、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: What happened to music? I asked him.

lines.content: それに俺は宣伝要因ってだけじゃなかったのかよ……
lines.translated: "Besides, wasn't I just supposed to be the promotional guy...?"

lines.content: 何言ってるんだ。宣伝のために登場させたアイドルが、蓋を開ければ影も形もありませんでした――だ、なんて。それこそ詐欺だろう
lines.translated: "What are you talking about? If an idol we debuted for promotion was nowhere to be seen once the curtains opened -- now *that* would be a scam."

lines.content: う、うう……っ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: まずい。何も言い返せなかった。墓穴を深く掘りすぎてしまったような気分だ。
lines.translated: Crap. I couldn't say anything back to that. It felt like I had dug my own grave way too deep.

lines.content: まあ、大雅の女装だとか、実のところ[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]しても宣伝にはまったくなっていないのくらい、わかってるんだけどな
lines.translated: "Well, to tell the truth, I know full well that having you crossdress and *doing all that* hasn't actually served as promotion at all."

lines.content: 何、だと……？
lines.translated: "Wait, what...?"

lines.content: だってそうだろう？　“春の学園祭でライブをやりますよ”って文句は何もなかったんだからな。ただ女装した大雅が町を練り歩いただけだ
lines.translated: "Well, think about it. We didn't have a single slogan saying, 'We're holding a live concert at the Spring School Festival!' You just paraded around town in girls' clothes."

lines.content: 唖然としてしまう。
lines.translated: I was dumbfounded.

lines.content: まあ、確かにそうなのだ。昨日までの二日間。俺はただ変装して町を歩いただけなのだ。
lines.translated: Well, he certainly had a point. For the past two days, I had literally just walked around town in disguise.

lines.content: 宣伝文句の書かれた看板や横断幕みたいなものを持つでもなく。声高に[・|そ][・|れ]をアピールするでもなく。
lines.translated: I hadn't held up a sign or a banner with a promotional message on it. Nor had I loudly advertised *it* out loud.

lines.content: なぜそんなことにも気づけなかったのか――自分自身に呆れてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: How had I failed to notice something so obvious? -- I was appalled at myself.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|れ]に何か効果があるとすれば、ハルちゃんの衣装を作るまでの時間稼ぎと、千和ちゃんのお店の宣伝にはなったのかもしれないなってくらいか
lines.translated: "If *that* had any effect at all, it probably just bought me time to finish making Haru-chan's costume, and maybe served as a bit of promotion for Chiwa-chan's cafe."

lines.content: そうですね。先輩が着ていたの、私のお店の制服でしたし
lines.translated: "That's true. What Senpai was wearing was my cafe's uniform, after all."

lines.content: だ、だったら……。俺が当日、ライブに参加する必要は――
lines.translated: "T-Then in that case... there's no need for me to participate in the concert on the day of--"

lines.content: そうだ。こんなのどうかな
lines.translated: "Oh, I know. How about this?"

lines.content: 声を上げようとした俺の前に、姫織が割り込んでくる。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to speak up, Himeori cut in.

lines.content: このままハルちゃんは千和のお店の専属アイドルになってしまうのはどうでしょう？
lines.translated: "What if Haru-chan just becomes the exclusive idol for Chiwa's shop?"

lines.content: えっ、今の流れでどうして私なの？　女の子な格好の大雅くんじゃなくって……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Given how this conversation was going, why me? Shouldn't it be Taiga-kun in his girl's clothes...?"

lines.content: あ、それ、いいですね、夜月先輩。お父さんに相談してきます
lines.translated: "Oh, that's a great idea, Yozuki-senpai. I'll go talk it over with my dad."
