lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと待とうよふたりとも……っ、私は？　私の気持ちは置いてきぼりなのっ？
lines.translated: "W-Wait a second, you two...! What about me? Are you just going to leave my feelings behind!?"

lines.content: ……いや
俺の気持ちもずっとずっと置いてきぼりなままなんだけれど……
lines.translated: "My feelings have been left way, way behind this whole time, though..."

lines.content: そんなこんなと今日の放課後は過ぎていく。
lines.translated: With all that going on, today's after-school hours passed by.

lines.content: “春の学園祭”まであと残り五日。
lines.translated: Five days left until the "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: こんなことしてて本当に大丈夫なのか？
lines.translated: Are we really going to be okay doing things like this?

lines.content: そう思っているのは俺だけなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Am I the only one thinking that?

lines.content: それもまた、不安だった。
lines.translated: That thought made me anxious, too.

lines.content: ……ぐす
lines.translated: "...*Sniffle*."

lines.content: 今日はさんざんだったな、ハル。心中お察しというか、なんというか……
lines.translated: "Today was really rough, huh, Haru? You have my sympathies, or rather, I don't even know what to say..."

lines.content: 鼻をすすり上げてばかりのハルの手を引き、俺は帰路についていた。
lines.translated: I was on my way home, leading a constantly sniffling Haru by the hand.

lines.content: あれから千和のお店の閉店時間がやって来るまで、ハルは智仁に言われるまま歌や踊りの練習に、散々付き合わされていた。
lines.translated: After that, right up until Chiwa's shop closed, Tomohito had dragged Haru through endless singing and dancing practice.

lines.content: また明日と手を振り、みんなと別れたところで、ハルは何もかも限界だったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: By the time we waved goodbye and parted ways with everyone, saying "See you tomorrow," Haru might have reached her absolute limit with everything.

lines.content: 『……もう、だめ』
lines.translated: "'...I can't go on.'"

lines.content: そこまではなんとかがんばって浮かべていた笑顔も、真っ青な顔色に変わってしまい、
lines.translated: The smile she had somehow managed to keep up until then vanished, leaving her face deathly pale.

lines.content: 『大雅くん……。手、繋いでくれないと、私……歩けない』
lines.translated: "'Taiga-kun... If you don't hold my hand... I can't walk.'"

lines.content: みんなと別れたとたん、ハルはぐずるようにしてその場にしゃがみ込んでしまった。
lines.translated: The moment we parted ways with the others, Haru crouched down on the spot, on the verge of tears.

lines.content: 仕方がないなと言い差し出した手を、ぐずぐず鼻を啜りながらハルは握った。
lines.translated: Saying "What am I going to do with you," I held out my hand, and Haru took it, sniffling away.

lines.content: そこからずっととぼとぼ歩くハルの手を引いていた。
lines.translated: Since then, I had been leading her by the hand as she trudged along.

lines.content: 本当のハルは恥ずかしがり屋ってだけじゃなく、時どきこんな甘えん坊にまでなっちゃうのか。意外だな。知らなかったな
lines.translated: "So the real Haru isn't just shy, she can also get this clingy and spoiled sometimes, huh? That's unexpected. I had no idea."

lines.content: みんなが知ったら驚くだろうな――とか、ちょっと意地悪に言ってみる。
lines.translated: Everyone would probably be surprised if they knew -- I teased her a little.

lines.content: ……うー
でもハルは反論するような気力も残っていないのだろう。“あー……”だとか“うううう”だとか“へっくち”、だとか。
lines.translated: But Haru probably didn't even have the energy left to argue back. All she let out were sounds like "Aaah..." or "Uuuuu" or "Achoo."

lines.content: 鼻をぐじゅぐじゅさせながら小さく唸ったりくしゃみしてばっかりだった。
lines.translated: With a runny nose, she just kept letting out little groans and sneezes.

lines.content: そういえば……
lines.translated: "Come to think of it..."

lines.content: 石橋を通り過ぎようとしたところで、俺は辺りを見渡す。
lines.translated: Just as we were about to cross the stone bridge, I looked around.

lines.content: 今日はあず咲先輩、見かけないな
lines.translated: "I don't see Azusaki-senpai today."

lines.content: まあ、今までも毎日見かけていたわけじゃないけれど……。ここのところよく話すことがあったから、ふと会えないとなんだか気になる
lines.translated: "Well, it's not like we saw her every single day before, either... We've just been talking to her a lot lately, so not running into her suddenly makes me wonder how she's doing."

lines.content: ……あ、ごめんね。聞いてなかった。私に話してる？
lines.translated: "...Ah, sorry. I wasn't listening. Were you talking to me?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。うん。……ハル。そこまで心的ダメージ深刻だとは
lines.translated: "A-Ah. Yeah. ...Haru. I didn't realize the mental damage was this severe."

lines.content: 苦笑いで俺はハルを振り返る。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, I looked back at Haru.

lines.content: だ、だって、あんな格好……私、似合わないよ
lines.translated: "B-Because, an outfit like that... It doesn't suit me at all."

lines.content: そんなことない。似合うよ。とっても
lines.translated: "That's not true. It suits you. A whole lot."

lines.content: う、……そう、かな
lines.translated: "Uuu... You think so?"

lines.content: ああ。今日から俺はハル推しだ――って、冗談みたいに言ったけど、結構本心でもあるんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I said 'Starting today, Haru is my oshi' like it was a joke, but I actually meant it quite a bit."

lines.content: かわいかったよ。すっごく。本当にハルがアイドルするなら心から応援できるんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "You were cute. Super cute. If you really became an idol, Haru, I think I could support you with all my heart."

lines.content: ハルは、うつむいてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Haru looked down at the ground.

lines.content: 嫌がってることを無理強いしてしまったような流れになっただろうか。
lines.translated: Had I made it sound like I was forcing her to do something she hated?

lines.content: どうしても嫌なら断ればいいのに。智仁だって話せばわかってくれるよ――というか、あいつはたぶんだけど、ハルも乗り気なんだって勘違いしてると思うな
lines.translated: "If you really hate it that much, you should just turn him down. Even Tomohito will understand if you talk to him -- or rather, I think he probably has the wrong idea and assumes you're totally into it, too."

lines.content: う、ううん。智仁くんのこと手伝うって決めたんだもん。だから今さら“やっぱり嫌だ”って言えないよ。……そんなこと言う自分には、なりたくないって思うよ
lines.translated: "N-No. I decided I was going to help Tomohito-kun. So I can't just say 'I don't want to do it after all' now. ...I don't want to become the kind of person who says things like that."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: [・|さ][・|す][・|が][・|だ][・|な]、と俺は心でつぶやき、うなずいた。さすがはハルだ。俺の[・|憧][・|れ]だ。
lines.translated: *That's Haru for you*, I murmured in my heart, nodding. I wouldn't expect anything less from Haru. She's the person I *admire*.

lines.content: そ、それに……。似合ってたんだよね？
lines.translated: "B-Besides... It suited me, right?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅くん、言ってたよね？　私にも、あんな、ふ、ふりふりで、ふわふわな感じの……かわいい服……ちゃんと、似合ってたんだよね？
lines.translated: "You said so, right, Taiga-kun? That a f-frilly, fluffy... cute outfit like that... actually suited me?"

lines.content: もちろん。似合ってた
lines.translated: "Of course. It suited you."

lines.content: また見たいって、思ってくれる？
lines.translated: "Do you want to see me in it again?"

lines.content: ああ。思ってる
lines.translated: "Yeah. I do."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: また見てみたい。写真を撮り忘れてしまってたことを今めちゃくちゃに後悔してるんだ。……うう。不覚だった。見とれてしまっていたのかもしれない
lines.translated: "I want to see it again. Right now, I'm regretting like crazy that I forgot to take a picture. ...Ugh. What a blunder. I might have been too mesmerized to think of it."

lines.content: ちょっとおどけるようにしてそう言う俺だったけれど、
lines.translated: I said it in a slightly joking tone, and...

lines.content: え、えへへ……
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe..."

lines.content: 照れくさそうに顔を緩ませるハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru's face relaxed into a bashful smile.

lines.content: だ、だったら、恥ずかしいけど……緊張で胸がどきどきして、痛いけど……。がんばれそうな気がしてきちゃうよ
lines.translated: "I-In that case, even though it's embarrassing... and my heart is pounding so hard from nerves that it hurts... I feel like I can do my best."

lines.content: 智仁くん……。音楽を届けたい人がいるって言ってたけど
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun... He said there's someone he wants to deliver his music to."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 言ってたよね、と俺。
lines.translated: "He did say that, didn't he," I replied.

lines.content: 本当に私、智仁くんの“やらなきゃならないこと”に役立てるのかなあ。もしもそうできるなら、恥ずかしいのも、もう少しはがんばれるんだけど……
lines.translated: "I wonder if I can really be of use for what Tomohito-kun 'has to do.' If I can, then I can put up with the embarrassment and try a little harder..."

lines.content: 俺も、ハルが思い巡らしているのだろうことと、同じことを――思う。
lines.translated: I found myself thinking the exact same thing Haru was probably mulling over.

lines.content: 『ともくん。誰に音楽、届けたいって思ってるんだろう』
lines.translated: "'Tomo-kun. I wonder who he wants to deliver his music to.'"

lines.content: さみしそうにつぶやいていた先輩の横顔を……。
lines.translated: I thought of Senpai's profile as she murmured that so wistfully...

lines.content: 『だから、姉ちゃんは――ごくごくふつうに、眠ることさえできないんだよ』
lines.translated: "'That's why my sister -- can't even go to sleep like a normal person.'"

lines.content: 遠いとおい昔、そう教えてくれたあいつのことを、思わずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but think of him, and what he had told me a long, long time ago.

lines.content: あのー……
うわっ
lines.translated: "Whoa!"

lines.content: ……突然、背後からの声。驚いて振り返る。
lines.translated: Suddenly, a voice called out from behind us. Startled, I turned around.

lines.content: ひぅ……っ
しかしそこにいた人物は俺以上に驚いていた。びくんと小さく飛び跳ねて。
lines.translated: However, the person standing there was even more startled than I was, jumping slightly in surprise.

lines.content: せ、先輩……？
lines.translated: "S-Senpai...?"

lines.content: あ、うう……っ。ごめ、ごめんなさい……。驚かせるつもりは、ぜ、全然なかったんですけども
lines.translated: "Ah, uuu...! I-I'm sorry... I didn't mean to startle you at all, really."

lines.content: こちらこそすみません。大きな声を出して。驚かせてしまいました
lines.translated: "No, I'm the one who should apologize. For yelling so loudly. I ended up startling you instead."

lines.content: 互いにすみません申し訳ありませんとぺこぺこ頭を下げ合っている。そして、どちらからともなく苦笑いを浮かべると、
lines.translated: We bowed our heads to each other repeatedly, trading apologies. Then, before we knew it, we both cracked wry smiles.

lines.content: 大雅くん。ハルちゃん。最近は何でだかよく会いますね？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. Haru-chan. For some reason, we've been running into each other a lot lately, haven't we?"

lines.content: そうですね。よくここでお話ししてますよね
lines.translated: "Yeah, we have. We've been talking right here quite a bit."

lines.content: だけど……、今日はもう会えないのかなと思ってました
lines.translated: "Still... I thought we wouldn't get to see you today."

lines.content: えっと……
そこであず咲先輩は、ハルと俺とを順番に見ると、
lines.translated: At that, Azusaki-senpai looked back and forth between Haru and me.

lines.content: お邪魔、でしたか……？
lines.translated: "Am I... interrupting?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 邪魔……？
lines.translated: "Interrupting...?"

lines.content: 何で？　と首をかしげるハルと俺。
lines.translated: Haru and I tilted our heads, wondering why she would think that.

lines.content: 今日はふたりで、なんだかいちゃいちゃしてるみたい……だったから？
lines.translated: "Well, the two of you looked like you were being all lovey-dovey today...?"

lines.content: べ、別に、そんな。い、いちゃいちゃだなんて……
lines.translated: "I-It's not like that at all. L-Lovey-dovey...?"

lines.content: ええそうですよ。止めてくださいよ。あず咲先輩。俺たちはそんなんじゃありませんよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Please stop teasing us, Azusaki-senpai. We aren't like that at all."

lines.content: ……むぅ。そんな、思い切り嫌がらなくってもいいのに
lines.translated: "...Muu. You don't have to deny it like you hate the idea that much."

lines.content: だって……先輩。柊ハルは恋愛禁止なんですよ
lines.translated: "Well, I mean... Senpai. Haru Hiiragi is under a romance ban, you know."

lines.content: ……えぇ？
あず咲先輩はぽかんとした。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai looked blankly at me.

lines.content: 数日後には学園の誰もが憧れる女の子になる予定の子なんです。そんな子が俺ひとりとそんな関係になんてなってられるわけがないでしょう先輩
lines.translated: "In just a few days, she's scheduled to become the girl everyone at the academy admires. There's no way a girl like that can get into that kind of relationship with just me, Senpai."

lines.content: そ、そうですか……アイドル？　学園の？
lines.translated: "I-Is that so...? An idol? Of the academy?"

lines.content: うう……ち、違います。私だけじゃないんです。み、みんなも……一緒に……その……歌ったりとか。踊ったりで……春だけど……学園祭で……
lines.translated: "Uuu... N-No, that's not it. It's not just me. E-Everyone else is doing it... together... umm... singing, and dancing... Even though it's spring... at the school festival..."

lines.content: もにょもにょと言いつつうつむいてしまうハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru mumbled incoherently, looking down at the ground.

lines.content: え、ええっと……。よく、わからないけど、ふたりが仲よさそうにしてたから、今は話しかけちゃだめかなあって心配してたんですけれど……
lines.translated: "U-Umm... I don't really understand, but since you two looked so close, I was worried that maybe I shouldn't call out to you right now..."

lines.content: そんなことないです。大丈夫ですよ
lines.translated: "Not at all. It's completely fine."

lines.content: そうなんですね。よかったです
lines.translated: "I see. Thank goodness."

lines.content: あず咲先輩はにこりと笑う……かと、思った。
lines.translated: I thought Azusaki-senpai was going to give us a warm smile.

lines.content: しかしあず咲先輩に笑顔はなかった。
lines.translated: However, there was no smile on Azusaki-senpai's face.

lines.content: ふたりが楽しそうに話してたから、邪魔せず今日はこのまま帰ろうかなあって思ったんです……。それでもやっぱり、どうしても話しかけずにいられませんでした
lines.translated: "Since you two were having such a fun conversation, I thought about just going home today without bothering you... Even so, I just couldn't stop myself from calling out to you."

lines.content: そう言うあず咲先輩はどこか気まずそうだった。
lines.translated: As she said that, Azusaki-senpai looked somewhat awkward.

lines.content: うつむいてしまい、言いにくいことを話すべきかどうか迷っている。
lines.translated: She looked down, hesitating over whether she should bring up something difficult to say.

lines.content: そんなふうにも見えたあず咲先輩は、しかし――
lines.translated: That was how Azusaki-senpai looked, and yet --

lines.content: ……お願いです
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: ……うつむいたまま、ぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: With her head still bowed, she murmured quietly.

lines.content: 大雅くん。あなたにお願いが、あるんです
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. I have a favor to ask of you."

lines.content: 俺に……？
lines.translated: "Of me...?"

lines.content: ……はい。だから今日は、ともくんではなく、大雅くんのことを探して、町を歩き回っていました
lines.translated: "...Yes. That's why today, I was walking around town looking for you, Taiga-kun, rather than Tomo-kun."

lines.content: 先輩が、俺を探してた……
lines.translated: "You were looking for me, Senpai...?"

lines.content: それは、どうして？　そう問いかける俺に、あず咲先輩は『お願いします』ともう一度そう言った。
lines.translated: When I asked her why, Azusaki-senpai said "Please" once more.

lines.content: 私は……大雅くん。あなたの“魔法”になれますか？
lines.translated: "Can I... Taiga-kun. Can I become your 'magic'?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: そして今度は顔を上げ、しっかりと俺のことを見つめると、あず咲先輩はこう言うのだった。
lines.translated: Then, raising her head this time and looking straight into my eyes, Azusaki-senpai said this.

lines.content: お願いです。……お願いします。大雅くん。どうか、[・|私][・|を]使ってください――……そして
lines.translated: "Please. ...I beg of you. Taiga-kun. Please, use me... and..."

lines.content: そしてどうか、お願いだから……。
lines.translated: And please, I'm begging you...

lines.content: 私の力で、私の“魔法”で、ともくんのことを助けてください
lines.translated: "With my power, with my 'magic,' please save Tomo-kun."

lines.content: ……俺さ。姉ちゃんに届けたいものがあるんだ
lines.translated: "...Hey. There's something I want to deliver to my sister."

lines.content: 幼い頃の智仁は俺にそう言った。
lines.translated: A young Tomohito had said that to me.

lines.content: 『だから、姉ちゃんは――ごくごくふつうに、眠ることさえできないんだよ』
lines.translated: "'That's why my sister -- can't even go to sleep like a normal person.'"

lines.content: もしも眠ってしまったら、姉ちゃんは――……
lines.translated: If she were to fall asleep, my sister would--...

lines.content: そうして続けられた言葉の先を、[・|突][・|拍][・|子][・|も][・|な][・|い][・|こ][・|と]を知らされても尚、俺はどうしてもこのふたりの力になりたいと願っていた。
lines.translated: Even after hearing the rest of his words and learning something so utterly absurd, I still desperately wished to help the two of them.

lines.content: そうでなければヒーロー失格。
lines.translated: Otherwise, I'd be a failure as a hero.

lines.content: そう、思えていたのだ。
lines.translated: That was how I felt.

lines.content: 俺に、できることは？
lines.translated: "Is there anything I can do?"

lines.content: そう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: さあな。わからない
lines.translated: "Who knows. I don't know."

lines.content: 智仁はそう答えた。
lines.translated: Tomohito answered.

lines.content: 何か……。君のお姉さんを助けるための方法があるはずだ。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "Something... There has to be some way to save your sister. Right?"

lines.content: ……それを知りたいから、その答えはどこにあるのか、わからないから、俺はこうしてここに来てるんだ
lines.translated: "...Because I want to know that, because I don't know where that answer is, I'm coming here like this."

lines.content: ……そうか。そうだよな。どうすれば助けられるのか。それがわかればとっくにそうしてるよな。行動に、移してるよな
lines.translated: "...I see. You're right. How to save her... If you knew that, you would've done it a long time ago. You would've taken action already."

lines.content: 頼りないヒーローで申し訳ない。
lines.translated: Sorry for being such an unreliable hero.

lines.content: そんなことを話したように思う。
lines.translated: I think I said something like that.

lines.content: いいや。そうでもないさ。
lines.translated: No, that's not true at all.

lines.content: 智仁は笑ってくれたように、思う。
lines.translated: I think Tomohito smiled at me.

lines.content: ……こうして話を聞いてくれてる誰かがいるだけで気持ちが楽になる――それを教えてくれただけでも、すごいよ。俺のヒーロー。ありがとうな
lines.translated: "...Just having someone listen to me like this makes me feel lighter -- just teaching me that much is amazing. My hero. Thanks."

lines.content: ずっと俺たちの周りは敵ばかりだったからな。智仁はそう言い、笑っていた。
lines.translated: Because we've always been surrounded by nothing but enemies. Tomohito said that, smiling.

lines.content: ……だからそのお礼に、大雅。俺からお前に、ひとつだけ注意させてほしい
lines.translated: "...So to thank you for that, Taiga. Let me give you just one warning."

lines.content: 智仁はそこで、笑顔をほんの少しだけ曇らせて、
lines.translated: At that point, a slight shadow fell over Tomohito's smile.

lines.content: 絶対だ。俺の姉ちゃんが眠そうにしているのを見かけたら――
lines.translated: "Promise me. If you ever see my sister looking sleepy--"

lines.content: ……見かけたら？
lines.translated: "...If I see her?"

lines.content: 逃げろ
lines.translated: "Run."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 一目散に……全速力で逃げるんだ。絶対に。いいな？
lines.translated: "Run for your life... at full speed. No matter what. Got it?"

lines.content: ……逃げろって。何言ってるんだお前
lines.translated: "...Run? What are you talking about?"

lines.content: たとえ姉ちゃんが泣いていたとしても、お前に何か助けを求めてきたとしても……絶対だ。絶対に、何も考えず逃げるんだ
lines.translated: "Even if my sister is crying, even if she asks you for help with something... no matter what. No matter what, don't think, just run."

lines.content: そうでなければ……。
lines.translated: Because if you don't...

lines.content: 智仁は、言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito said.

lines.content: そうでなければ。……大雅。もう二度と、お前は[・|こ][・|こ]へ帰って来れなくなるぞ
lines.translated: "If you don't... Taiga. You'll never be able to come back here again."

lines.content: 泣き笑いのように複雑な表情で、そんな警告を俺へとくれる智仁だ。
lines.translated: With a complicated expression like he was smiling through tears, Tomohito gave me that warning.

lines.content: そんなあいつの顔を見つめながら、
lines.translated: Staring at his face like that,

lines.content: （……ヒーローだ）
lines.translated: (...A hero.)

lines.content: 心の中で、俺はつぶやく。
lines.translated: I murmured in my heart.

lines.content: （……ヒーローは、いったいどこへ行ってしまったんだ）
lines.translated: (...Just where in the world did that hero go?)

lines.content: 今、お前の力が必要なんだよ。俺にも。そして、[・|こ][・|の][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]にも。
lines.translated: I need your power right now. For myself. And for the two of them.

lines.content: だから頼む。……頼むよ。どうか力を貸してくれ。
lines.translated: So please. ...I'm begging you. Please lend me your strength.

lines.content: 俺は[・|逃][・|げ][・|ず][・|に]、このふたりを助けるための方法をただただ探してばかりいた……。
lines.translated: Without running away, I was simply searching endlessly for a way to save the two of them...

lines.content: あず咲先輩と別れてすぐに帰宅した。
lines.translated: Right after parting ways with Azusaki-senpai, I went straight home.

lines.content: 今日のお夕飯はオムライスだった。
lines.translated: Tonight's dinner was omurice.

lines.content: それは変わらず暖かく、美味しくて……。
lines.translated: As always, it was warm, delicious, and...

lines.content: 美味しかった、はずだ。
lines.translated: It must have been delicious.

lines.content: ごめんなさいあさひさん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Asahi-san.

lines.content: 正直なところ考え事に忙しく、あまり味わっていられる余裕はなかった。
lines.translated: To be honest, I was so preoccupied with my thoughts that I didn't have the mental space to really savor it.

lines.content: ごちそうさまをし、あさひさんの後片付けを手伝った後、早々に部屋へと篭もる。
lines.translated: After thanking her for the meal and helping Asahi-san clean up, I quickly shut myself in my room.

lines.content: そして[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]のことを考えていた。
lines.translated: And I thought about the two of them.

lines.content: “俺は姉ちゃんのことを助けたい”“私の魔法で、ともくんを助けてください”、か
lines.translated: "'I want to save my sister,' and 'With my magic, please save Tomo-kun,' huh."

lines.content: かつて弟は姉のために“夜”へと這入り。
lines.translated: Once, the younger brother crept into the "Night" for his older sister's sake.

lines.content: そして今、姉は弟を助けるためにと祈ってる。
lines.translated: And now, the older sister is praying to save her younger brother.

lines.content: ひとまずあず咲先輩への返事は保留にさせてもらったのだけど……。
lines.translated: For the time being, I had asked to put my answer to Azusaki-senpai on hold, but...

lines.content: あの様子じゃあ、明日にでも返事しなきゃならないかもしれない
lines.translated: "The way she looked, I might have to give her an answer as early as tomorrow."
The way she looked...

lines.content: 先輩と別れた数時間前のことについて思う。
lines.translated: I thought back to a few hours ago, before I parted ways with Senpai.

lines.content: 私の力で、私の“魔法”で、ともくんのことを助けてください
lines.translated: "With my power, with my 'magic,' please save Tomo-kun."

lines.content: あず咲先輩のその一言で、俺はつい智仁の言葉を思い出してしまっていたのだ――“たとえ姉ちゃんが泣いていたとしても”
lines.translated: That one remark from Azusaki-senpai had inadvertently made me remember Tomohito's words -- "Even if my sister is crying."

lines.content: ……たとえ、助けを求められたとしても
lines.translated: "...Even if she asks me for help."

lines.content: ――“絶対に、何も考えず逃げるんだ”、か。
lines.translated: -- "No matter what, don't think, just run," huh.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……いや。何でもないです。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...No. It's nothing. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 独り言です。と俺は言い、首を振った。
lines.translated: I was just talking to myself, I said, shaking my head.

lines.content: 先輩。……先に、軽く質問だけさせてもらってもいいでしょうか
lines.translated: "Senpai. ...First, would it be all right if I asked you a quick question?"

lines.content: はい……
真剣な眼差しだ。そんな先輩の目を見ながら、俺は続けた。
lines.translated: Her gaze was serious. Looking into Senpai's eyes, I continued.

lines.content: あず咲先輩。俺があさひさんから譲り受けた“役割”のこと、知ってたんですね
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai. You knew about the 'role' passed down to me from Asahi-san, didn't you?"

lines.content: はい。……いえ。知っていた、というよりは、気づいたというほうがたぶん正しいんだろうと思いますけれど
lines.translated: "Yes. ...No. Rather than knowing about it, it would probably be more accurate to say that I noticed it."

lines.content: 知っていたというより気づいた。……と、いうのは？
lines.translated: "You noticed it rather than knew about it. ...What do you mean?"

lines.content: 私は、大雅くんや、もしかしたらハルちゃんもなのかな――ふたりと同じように、今も“夜”に出入りできるから
lines.translated: "Because just like you, Taiga-kun -- and maybe Haru-chan too? -- I can still go in and out of the 'Night' even now."

lines.content: だからなんとなく感じたんです。大雅くんの左手。……ええっと。なんて言ったらいいのかな。“夜”の中と同じ匂いがするとでも言いましょうか――
lines.translated: "So I just sort of felt it. Your left hand, Taiga-kun. ...Umm. How should I put it? Maybe I should say it has the same scent as the inside of the 'Night'--"

lines.content: ううん。違います。“夜の魔法使い”のあさひさんと同じ感じがしたんです。だから[・|そ][・|う]なのかなあって
lines.translated: "No, that's not it. It felt the same as Asahi-san, the 'Magician of the Night.' So I wondered if that was the case."

lines.content: そう……？
lines.translated: Really...?

lines.content: あさひさんは、[・|あ][・|の]“[・|役][・|割]”をともくんか大雅くんのどちらかに譲る気だったのは知ってましたから……
lines.translated: "Because I knew that Asahi-san intended to pass that 'role' down to either Tomo-kun or you, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: ……なるほど
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: 事情はなんとなく理解した。
lines.translated: I more or less understood the circumstances.

lines.content: 理解はしたが、完全に納得できているかどうかとはまた違うのだが……。
lines.translated: I understood, though whether I could completely accept it was another matter entirely...

lines.content: ごめんなさい。あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]には、実は先約がいて……
lines.translated: "For that, I actually have a prior commitment..."

lines.content: 俺はちらりと隣を見る。ハルだ。
lines.translated: I glanced beside me. It was Haru.

lines.content: 一言も発することなく、俺とあず咲先輩との会話を聞いていた……柊ハル。
lines.translated: Listening to the conversation between Azusaki-senpai and me without uttering a single word... Haru Hiiragi.

lines.content: 『……私を、“魔法少女”に戻してください』
lines.translated: "...Please turn me back into a 'magical girl.'"

lines.content: まずは彼女と話をしなければならないと、そう思っていた。
lines.translated: I had been thinking that I needed to talk with her first.

lines.content: 俺は、握りしめた携帯電話を見つめている。
lines.translated: I stared at the cell phone clutched tightly in my hand.

lines.content: あず咲先輩に[・|先][・|約]とは言ったが、別段ハルの“魔法”にこそ一番先に向き合うと約束したわけじゃない。
lines.translated: I had told Azusaki-senpai that I had a prior commitment, but it wasn't as if I had specifically promised to confront Haru's "magic" first.

lines.content: ましてやハルには、まだこの“役割”のことを話してさえいないのだ。
lines.translated: Much less had I even told Haru about this "role" yet.

lines.content: 千和や姫織だってそうだ。誰が先でなければならないという事情はない。今のところは。
lines.translated: The same went for Chiwa and Himeori. There was no particular reason why anyone had to be first. At least for now.

lines.content: ……けれど、あの場であず咲先輩に“わかりました”と即答などできようはずもなかった。
lines.translated: However, there was no way I could have given Azusaki-senpai an immediate "Understood" right then and there.

lines.content: 『……お願いします。どうか私を“魔法少女”に戻してください』
lines.translated: "...Please. Please turn me back into a 'magical girl.'"

lines.content: あんな言葉を、あんな表情を、目の当たりにしてしまっていては……。
lines.translated: Having witnessed such words, and such an expression, right before my eyes...

lines.content: ハルの目の前で別の誰かを優先することは、できなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't prioritize someone else right in front of Haru.

lines.content: あれからあず咲先輩には、『少しだけ時間をください。考えたいことがあるので』とだけ伝え、[・|そ][・|れ][・|ぞ][・|れ]別れた。
lines.translated: After that, I only told Azusaki-senpai, "Please give me a little time. There's something I want to think about," and we each went our separate ways.

lines.content: ハルに対しては、また今夜にでも電話する、そのときに色々と話すよとだけ言った。
lines.translated: As for Haru, I just told her that I would call her tonight, and that we'd talk about various things then.

lines.content: 『うん。わかった。また今夜……待ってるね』
lines.translated: "Yeah. Got it. See you tonight... I'll be waiting."

lines.content: ハルもあず咲先輩と同じようにうなずいてくれた。
lines.translated: Haru had nodded, just like Azusaki-senpai had.

lines.content: だからまずはハルと話すため、こうして電話を握りしめている。
lines.translated: That's why I was clutching my phone like this, to talk to Haru first.

lines.content: ハルにどう説明するか。
lines.translated: How should I explain it to Haru?

lines.content: それもまた重要だけれど……。
lines.translated: That was important too, but...

lines.content: “私には、どうしても叶えなきゃいけない夢がある”……。ハルはそう言っていた
lines.translated: "'I have a dream that I absolutely must fulfill'... That's what Haru said."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]に、なんだか引っかかりのようなものを俺はずっと感じてきた。
lines.translated: I had been feeling something like a lingering unease about that this whole time.

lines.content: “夢”を叶えるというのはうれしいことであるはずだ。能動的に“そうであれ”と願うことであるはずなのだ。
lines.translated: Fulfilling a "dream" is supposed to be a joyful thing. It's supposed to be an active wish for something to come true.

lines.content: それなのに、ハルの言葉には多少なりとも義務的なものを感じてしまう――叶えたい、ではなく、叶えなければ、とハルは言うのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, I couldn't help but sense a certain sense of obligation in Haru's words -- she didn't say she wanted to fulfill it, she said she had to.

lines.content: だから、なのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was that why?

lines.content: この“役割”には優先順位などない――
lines.translated: Even though I told myself there was no order of priority to this "role"...

lines.content: みたいなことを、言っておきながら……。
lines.translated: Despite thinking something like that...

lines.content: 俺は……
ハルの“魔法”に、その“夢”に、まっすぐ向き合うことを今日まで先送りにしてきたのだと言ってもいい。
lines.translated: You could say I had been putting off squarely facing Haru's "magic" and her "dream" until today.

lines.content: もし、まず先にあず咲先輩の“魔法”を優先するようなことがあったら……
lines.translated: "What if I were to prioritize Azusaki-senpai's 'magic' first...?"

lines.content: ハルはどう思うだろうか。
lines.translated: What would Haru think?

lines.content: やっぱり不愉快に感じるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would she feel displeased after all?

lines.content: ……クロに相談したいと、思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to talk it over with Kuro.

lines.content: 大切なことはいつもクロと相談して決めてきた。
lines.translated: Whenever something important came up, I had always consulted Kuro before deciding.

lines.content: だけど今夜はいくら待ってもクロから連絡はない。
lines.translated: Tonight, however, no matter how long I waited, no call came from her.

lines.content: 珍しいことではないけれど、いつだってそんな日は落ち着かない。
lines.translated: It wasn't unusual, yet days like this always left me restless.

lines.content: いっそこちらからかけてみようか。
lines.translated: Maybe I should just try calling her myself.

lines.content: クロの電話に繋がる番号。９６。たったふたつの数字だ。
lines.translated: The number that connected to Kuro's phone. 96. Just two digits.

lines.content: それを順番にプッシュしようとする。
lines.translated: I moved to press them in order.

lines.content: ……しかし、いつだって申し合わせたように[・|そ][・|れ]は起こるのだ。
lines.translated: However, as if on cue, that always happens.

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: すれ違うように……いいや。食い違うようにして、[・|そ][・|れ]は起こるものなのだ。いつだって。
lines.translated: As if passing each other by... no, as if falling out of sync, that always happens. Every single time.

lines.content: ――端末が震えていた。
lines.translated: --My phone was vibrating.

lines.content: クロと繋がるためのものではない。ごくふつうのほうの端末だ。画面を見る。着信画面には“柊ハル”とあった。
lines.translated: Not the one meant for connecting with Kuro. It was my completely ordinary phone. I looked at the screen. The caller ID read "Haru Hiiragi."

lines.content: もしもし？　ハル？
lines.translated: "Hello? Haru?"

lines.content: スピーカーの向こう側に声を掛ける。
lines.translated: I spoke to the person on the other end of the speaker.

lines.content: 『うん。私……ごめんね、大雅くん』
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's me... Sorry, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: え？　どうして……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why are you apologizing...?"

lines.content: 『大雅くんのほうからお電話くれるって話だったのに、待ちきれなくてこっちからかけちゃった。もし何か邪魔しちゃってたらごめんね』
lines.translated: "You said you would call me, Taiga-kun, but I couldn't wait and ended up calling you instead. I'm sorry if I'm interrupting anything."

lines.content: 忙しかったらかけ直すから言ってねとハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru told me to let her know if I was busy and she would call back.

lines.content: 俺は、いいや大丈夫、平気だよと答えた。
lines.translated: No, it's fine, I'm totally free, I replied.

lines.content: 『待ちきれなくて、か……』
lines.translated: "You couldn't wait, huh...?"

lines.content: 時間を確認する。数ある時計のうちのひとつで。
lines.translated: I checked the time on one of the many clocks in the room.

lines.content: 『こっちこそごめん。消灯時間がもう近いんだな。気を遣わせてごめん。もっと早く電話すべきだった』
lines.translated: "I'm the one who should apologize. Lights-out is coming up soon, isn't it? Sorry for making you worry. I should have called earlier."

lines.content: 『あ、う、うん……。そうだね。そういうことかも、だね』
lines.translated: "Ah, u-um, yeah... That's right. I guess that's part of it, too."

lines.content: 気まずげに声が小さくなっていた。
lines.translated: Her voice grew quiet and awkward.

lines.content: 『えっとね、だからあともう少しくらいしか、今夜はお電話できる時間がなさそうで……』
lines.translated: "Umm, so it looks like I only have a little bit of time left to talk on the phone tonight..."

lines.content: ああ。ハルに話したいこと。話さなきゃならないこと。急いで伝えるよ
lines.translated: "Right. What I want to tell you, Haru. What I need to tell you. I'll make it quick."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 俺もつい先日まで[そこ|施設]で暮らしてたのに。すっかりそこのタイムスケジュールを忘れてしまってた
lines.translated: "Even though I was living at the facility myself until just the other day, I completely forgot about the schedule there."

lines.content: 施設は二十二時には消灯となる決まり。
lines.translated: The facility had a strict rule that lights-out was at 10:00 PM.

lines.content: 俺たち遊びたい盛りの年頃にはあまりにも早いけど……。
lines.translated: It was way too early for kids our age who just wanted to have fun, though...

lines.content: あと三十分くらいかな。話せるの
lines.translated: "We have about thirty minutes left to talk, right?"

lines.content: 『うん。そうだね。……足りるかな？』
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. ...Will that be enough?"

lines.content: ……たぶんね
lines.translated: "...Probably."

lines.content: 俺は、うなずき――ハルに説明をした。
lines.translated: I nodded -- and explained things to Haru.

lines.content: 今日、あず咲先輩が俺に投げかけた質問の意味を。
lines.translated: I told her the meaning behind the question Azusaki-senpai had asked me today.

lines.content: 俺が“夜の魔法使い”であるあさひさんから、どのような“役割”を譲り受けているのかということを。
lines.translated: And what kind of "role" I had inherited from Asahi-san, the "Magician of the Night."

lines.content: ……だからさ、ハル。君のことを“魔法少女”に、特別だったあの頃に戻せるのは、今はもうあさひさんじゃなくて、俺なんだ
lines.translated: "...So you see, Haru. The one who can turn you back into a 'magical girl' -- back to the way you were when you were special -- isn't Asahi-san anymore. It's me."

lines.content: ごめん。もっと早くに伝えておくべきだったんだろうとは思うけど……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I know I probably should have told you sooner, but..."

lines.content: 君が、かつて“特別だった自分”を取り戻したいとあさひさんに願ったときの、切実そうなその表情を目の当たりにしたこの俺は……、
lines.translated: Having witnessed that desperate expression on her face when she begged Asahi-san to let her reclaim her once-"special self"...

lines.content: ……少し、戸惑っていたんだと思う
lines.translated: "...I think I was a little hesitant."

lines.content: 『え？　戸惑う……？』
lines.translated: "Huh? Hesitant...?"

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 思わずこぼれた言葉には、『いや。ごめん。何でもない』と結び、話の流れを修正する。
lines.translated: Realizing the words had slipped out unintentionally, I tacked on, "No, sorry. It's nothing," and steered the conversation back on track.

lines.content: ……今夜、ハルに電話するって言ったのは他でもないんだ
lines.translated: "...There's a specific reason I said I'd call you tonight, Haru."

lines.content: 『……うん。何かな。どんなこと、なのかな』
lines.translated: "...Okay. What is it? What's this about?"

lines.content: あず咲先輩。自分の“魔法”を俺に使ってほしいと言っていた。そして、智仁を助けてほしいって
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai. She told me she wants me to use her 'magic.' And she wants me to save Tomohito."

lines.content: 『そうだね。あず咲先輩。なんだか思い詰めてた』
lines.translated: "Right. Azusaki-senpai seemed really desperate."

lines.content: ああ……。だけどさ、それはハルだって同じだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... But you know, the same goes for you, Haru."

lines.content: 俺には[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]のハルも、あず咲先輩と同じように思い詰めているように見えたんだ
lines.translated: "To me, you looked just as desperate back then as Azusaki-senpai did today."

lines.content: ……いや。ハルだけではない。
lines.translated: No. It wasn't just Haru.

lines.content: およそ十年前の“夜”の中。集められた少年少女たちにはそれぞれ重い事情があるからこそ、その“戦い”に進んで参加したのだ。
lines.translated: Inside the "Night" roughly ten years ago, every single one of the boys and girls gathered there had their own heavy circumstances, which was precisely why they willingly joined that "battle."

lines.content: これは予感なんだけど
lines.translated: "This is just a hunch, though."

lines.content: 『うん』
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……なんとなく、あず咲先輩は今すぐ“魔法”を必要としてるんじゃないかと思えて
lines.translated: "...For some reason, I get the feeling that Azusaki-senpai needs her 'magic' right away."

lines.content: だからこそ、ハル。どうしてもあず咲先輩に返事をする前に、ハルに了解を取っておきたかったんだ
lines.translated: "That's why, Haru. Before giving Azusaki-senpai my answer, I really wanted to get your permission first."

lines.content: 『それは……、大雅くん』
lines.translated: "Does that mean... Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 少しの間、沈黙を挟み込み、ハルは言った。
lines.translated: After a brief pause of silence, Haru spoke.

lines.content: 『……もしかして順番を気にしてくれてるの？』
lines.translated: "...Are you worried about whose turn it is?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 単純に言えばそういうことになる。
lines.translated: Simply put, that was what it boiled down to.

lines.content: ハルがお願いをした相手は俺じゃなくてあさひさんだけど、それでも、あず咲先輩よりもハルのほうが先に[・|そ][・|う]願ったんだ
lines.translated: "The person you made your wish to was Asahi-san, not me, but even so, you wished for it before Azusaki-senpai did."

lines.content: それなのに、ハルよりも先に、ハルの思いを差し置いて、あず咲先輩と向き合おうだなんて……。そんなのは、違う。そう思えてならなかった
lines.translated: "And yet, to set your feelings aside and deal with Azusaki-senpai before you... That just felt wrong. I couldn't shake that thought."

lines.content: だからどうするにもまず先に、ハルに気持ちとか事情を確認しておきたいと思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "So no matter what I do, I wanted to check in with your feelings and circumstances first."

lines.content: 『私の気持ち……、私の、事情……？』
lines.translated: "My feelings... and my circumstances...?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだよと俺は答える。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right, I answered.

lines.content: 一度にふたり分の“魔法”と向き合うことだって、“魔法少女『使い』”という“役割”にとっては不可能なことではないだろう――ただそれは、俺のキャパ的にはどうなのか。
lines.translated: Dealing with two people's "magic" at once probably wasn't impossible for the "role" of a "Magical Girl 'User'" -- but how would that work out in terms of my own capacity?

lines.content: そういう側面では瞬く間に可能は不可能へと書き換えられてしまうだろう。
lines.translated: Looking at it from that angle, the possible would be rewritten into the impossible in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: もしもハルの“魔法”が、それを使って叶えたい“夢”が……もしも、急を要するものでないのなら
lines.translated: "If your 'magic,' Haru, and the 'dream' you want to fulfill with it... if it isn't something urgent..."

lines.content: ……どうかな。ハル
lines.translated: "...What do you think, Haru?"

lines.content: 先にあず咲先輩の“魔法”と向き合うことを、まずは選んでみてもいいかな
lines.translated: "Would it be all right if I chose to face Azusaki-senpai's 'magic' first?"

lines.content: 『……もしも急を要するものでないのなら』
lines.translated: "...If it isn't something urgent."

lines.content: ハルは俺のせりふを繰り返す。
lines.translated: Haru repeated my words.

lines.content: 『わからない』
lines.translated: "I don't know."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 『……私には確かに[・|叶][・|え][・|な][・|き][・|ゃ][・|な][・|ら][・|な][・|い]“夢”がある。これは、絶対なの。そうでなければ私は私を許せそうにない。今の今まで先延ばしにしてきたことだけれど……』
lines.translated: "...I definitely have a 'dream' that I must fulfill. That's absolute. Otherwise, I don't think I could ever forgive myself. Even though it's something I've been putting off until now..."

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: 『でもね。それは今の今まで先延ばしに[・|で][・|き][・|た]ことなんだよ。大雅くん。だから今すぐじゃないとだめってことじゃない……と、思うよ。私の“夢”にはまだ時間があると思う』
lines.translated: "But you know, it is something I was able to put off until now, Taiga-kun. So I don't think it has to be right this second. I think my 'dream' still has some time left."

lines.content: だから大丈夫だよ、とハルは言う。
lines.translated: So it's okay, Haru said.

lines.content: 『ありがとう大雅くん。私の気持ち、気にしてくれて』
lines.translated: "Thank you, Taiga-kun. For caring about my feelings."

lines.content: いや……
お礼を言われるようなことなんかじゃない。
lines.translated: It wasn't anything I deserved to be thanked for.

lines.content: 君の約束より別の人の気持ちを優先させてくれとお願いしているのだ。
lines.translated: I was asking her to let me prioritize someone else's feelings over my promise to her.

lines.content: 『でも、ひとつだけお願いがあるんだけど……。聞いてくれる？』
lines.translated: "But I have just one favor to ask... Will you hear me out?"

lines.content: ああ。もちろん
lines.translated: "Yeah. Of course."

lines.content: 俺にできることなら何でもと俺は答える。
lines.translated: Anything, if it's within my power, I answered.
"Anything...?"

lines.content: 何でもだよ
lines.translated: "Anything."

lines.content: 『そっか……』
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: だったらいっぱいお願いしたいことあるかもしれないよとハルは答える。その声には微笑みが浮かんでいるように感じられた。
lines.translated: Then I might have a whole lot of favors to ask you, Haru replied. I could hear the smile in her voice.

lines.content: 『あのね、大雅くん』
lines.translated: "Listen, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 『これは、あず咲先輩次第な部分も大きいけれど……。私もそこに、いさせてくれる？』
lines.translated: "This largely depends on Azusaki-senpai, too, but... would you let me be there?"

lines.content: ……そこ？
lines.translated: "...There?"

lines.content: 『うん。大雅くんがあず咲先輩の“魔法”を使って、あず咲先輩の“夢”を叶えるところに、私も立ち合わせてもらっても……、いいかな』
lines.translated: "Yeah. When you use Azusaki-senpai's 'magic' and fulfill her 'dream,' would it be okay... if I were there to witness it, too?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 『これから私も、あず咲先輩の後になったとしても、大雅くんに私の“魔法”を使って貰うことになる。そうしてほしいと私は願うよ。だから……』
lines.translated: "Even if my turn comes after Azusaki-senpai's, I'm going to have you use my 'magic' too. That's what I wish for. So..."

lines.content: 自分の“魔法”がどのように使われて。
lines.translated: How her own "magic" would be used.

lines.content: 自分の“夢”が、どのように叶えられていくのか。
lines.translated: And how her own "dream" would be fulfilled.

lines.content: 『[・|そ][・|れ]はどういうふうにはじまって、どういうふうに終わるのか……』
lines.translated: "How that begins, and how it ends..."

lines.content: それをもし許されるのであれば、目の当たりにしておきたいとハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru said that if she were allowed to, she wanted to witness it for herself.

lines.content: 『なんだか、多少でも不安に思ってることを人で試しているみたいに思えて、嫌な感じだけど……』
lines.translated: "It feels kind of awful, like I'm using someone else as a guinea pig just because I'm a little anxious about it..."

lines.content: いや。いいよ
lines.translated: "No, it's fine."

lines.content: 暗く落ち込みそうになっていたハルの言葉を遮断する。
lines.translated: I cut Haru off before she could spiral into gloom.

lines.content: ……まずはあず咲先輩に確認しなきゃならないのはもちろんだけど、俺は平気だ。問題ないよ。また明日、一緒にあず咲先輩にお願いしてみよう
lines.translated: "...We obviously have to check with Azusaki-senpai first, of course, but I'm totally fine with it. No problem at all. Let's go ask her together tomorrow."

lines.content: そこでそろそろ消灯の時間だ。
lines.translated: It was just about time for lights-out.

lines.content: 互いにおやすみ、また明日と言い合って、電話を切った。
lines.translated: We wished each other goodnight, promised to meet tomorrow, and hung up.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|こ]に近寄ってはいけないと言われれば近寄らないわけにはいかなくなるし。
lines.translated: Tell someone not to go near *there*, and they'll feel compelled to approach it.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]に関わってはならないと諭されれば、やはり積極的に関わろうとせずにはいられない。
lines.translated: Warn them not to get involved with *that*, and they won't be able to stop themselves from diving right in.

lines.content: どういう場面にもそういう捻くれたがる輩はだいたいひとりくらいいるものだ。
lines.translated: In any given situation, there's bound to be at least one contrarian like that.

lines.content: そしてそういう“誰か”は散々周りをかき回した挙げ句、早々にして退場することになる――というのが、まあ、いわゆる“お約束”なのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: And that "someone" ends up making a huge mess for everyone else before making an early exit -- which is, well, pretty much the standard cliche.

lines.content: 普段ならそういう“お約束”に虫ずが走るほどイラついていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Normally, that kind of cliche would irritate me to no end, and yet...

lines.content: ……助けるなと言われたからって、それで“はいわかりました”ってわけにはいかないって
lines.translated: "...Just because you told me not to try and save her doesn't mean I can just say, 'Okay, got it.'"

lines.content: いざ自分が[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|状][・|況]にあったなら、俺という人間はそういう“お約束”な行動を、知らず知らず取ってしまうタイプの人間であるようだった。
lines.translated: When I actually found myself in *that kind of situation*, it turned out I was the exact type of person to unconsciously play right into the cliche.

lines.content: あの頃の俺はたぶん、焦っていた。
lines.translated: Back then, I was probably just impatient.

lines.content: ヒーローだ。
lines.translated: A hero.

lines.content: あの人みたいにならなければ。
lines.translated: I had to become like her.

lines.content: 一刻も、早く。
lines.translated: As soon as possible.

lines.content: そのような、身の丈にまったく合わない焦燥に駆られていたのだ。
lines.translated: I was driven by a restless urgency that was completely beyond my station.

lines.content: た、大雅くん……こんなに急いで、どこへ行くんですかっ
lines.translated: "T-Taiga-kun... Where are we going in such a hurry?!"

lines.content: ……俺は、兎蛙智仁の姉、兎蛙あず咲の手を引き、走り出さずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't stop myself from grabbing the hand of Toa Tomohito's older sister, Toa Azusaki, and breaking into a run.

lines.content: 以前、あさひさんから聞いたことがあるんです
lines.translated: "Asahi-san told me about it once."

lines.content: 俺は、“夜”の空にそびえるその塔を指さす。
lines.translated: I pointed toward the tower soaring into the "Night" sky.

lines.content: あそこです。“刻の終着駅”です
lines.translated: "Over there. 'Time's Terminal.'"

lines.content: あそこでは様々なものを引き替えに、とても様々なものを――才能だとか、運だとか、能力だとかを、[・|魂][・|の][・|中][・|に]購入することができる場所らしいんです
lines.translated: "Apparently, it's a place where you can trade all sorts of things to purchase all sorts of other things -- like talent, luck, or abilities -- right *into your soul*."

lines.content: え、ええ。それは私も聞きました
lines.translated: "Y-Yes, I've heard that too."

lines.content: 息を上げ、小走りに進む俺に付いてきていた。
lines.translated: Out of breath, she hurried along behind me at a brisk jog.

lines.content: 私たちがいつか“夜の王”を倒して、その報酬として得られるらしい“魔法”も、あの場所で購入するものなんですよね――
lines.translated: "Even the 'magic' we're supposed to get as a reward if we ever defeat the 'King of the Night' is purchased there, isn't it...?"

lines.content: 少女たちが“夜の王”を倒したという“結果”を、[・|そ][・|の][・|未][・|来]を、支払いにして。
lines.translated: Using the "result" of the girls defeating the "King of the Night" -- *that future* -- as payment.

lines.content: 命の所有時間が過ぎた人たちが、どこか“次”へと向かうための場所でもあると聞いてます
lines.translated: "I've also heard it's a place for people whose allotted time of life has run out to move on to whatever comes 'next.'"

lines.content: はい。俺、思ったんです
lines.translated: "Yes. And it got me thinking."

lines.content: うなずき、俺は答える。
lines.translated: I nodded and answered her.

lines.content: あの場所で、あず咲さん。あなたのその[・|呪][・|い]を、[・|何][・|か]を購入するための支払いとしてしまえばいいんじゃないでしょうか
lines.translated: "At that place, Azusaki-san... couldn't you use that *curse* of yours as payment to buy *something*?"

lines.content: ごめんなさい。智仁から聞きました。あず咲さん、あなたは……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Tomohito told me about it. Azusaki-san, you..."

lines.content: 繋いだ手にぎゅっと力を込めた。
lines.translated: I squeezed her hand tightly.
"He said that *whenever you fall asleep, you leap into the future*."

lines.content: 兎蛙あず咲、その命は産まれながらにして呪われている――と、弟の兎蛙智仁は語ってた。
lines.translated: Toa Azusaki's very life was cursed from birth -- or so her younger brother, Toa Tomohito, had told me.

lines.content: いつ頃から姉に[・|そ][・|れ]が起こるようになったのかはわからない。
lines.translated: He didn't know when *it* had started happening to his sister.

lines.content: 弟が物心つくころには既にそうなっていたのかもしれないし、もっと明確なきっかけのようなものが存在していたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: It might have already been that way by the time he was old enough to understand, or perhaps there had been some clearer trigger.

lines.content: ともあれ[・|そ][・|れ]が起こるのは決まって満月の夜だったという。
lines.translated: Regardless, *it* always happened on the night of a full moon.

lines.content: 夜空に大きなおおきなお月さまが浮かぶとき……。
lines.translated: Whenever a great, big moon floated in the night sky...

lines.content: 兎蛙あず咲は強烈な睡魔に襲われる。
lines.translated: Toa Azusaki would be struck by an overwhelming drowsiness.

lines.content: 自身では抗いきれないその眠気に誘われるまま、深く、ふかく[まぶた|瞼]を閉じると――[・|未][・|来][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Drawn in by a sleepiness she couldn't resist, she would close her eyelids deeply, so deeply -- and then, *it would be the future*.

lines.content: 兎蛙あず咲が次に目覚めるのは未来の時間。[・|次][・|回][・|以][・|降][・|の][・|満][・|月][・|の][・|夜]。
lines.translated: The next time Toa Azusaki woke up, it would be in the future. *On the night of a subsequent full moon*.

lines.content: ……幾つ先の満月の夜に目を覚ますのかはわからない。どれほど深く眠ったのかで、飛び越える夜の数は増えていくと、智仁から聞きました
lines.translated: "...You never know how many full moons ahead you'll wake up. Tomohito told me that the deeper you sleep, the more nights you skip over."

lines.content: 満月の夜、眠りに落ちた兎蛙あず咲は、その瞬間、姿をふっと消すのだという。
lines.translated: On the night of a full moon, the moment Toa Azusaki fell asleep, she would vanish into thin air.

lines.content: そして幾つか先の満月の夜――姿を消したその場所に、また、ふっと姿を現す。
lines.translated: And then, on some future full moon -- she would suddenly reappear in the exact spot she had vanished from.

lines.content: 智仁は、またいつ姉が戻ってきてくれるのかをただただ待つしかないのだと言っていた。
lines.translated: Tomohito said that all he could ever do was wait and wonder when his sister would come back to him.

lines.content: ……そんなあなたの呪いを解くために、智仁はあなたと一緒に“ゆめのねどこ”に来たんだと言っていました。“夜の魔法使い”を頼って
lines.translated: "...Tomohito said he came here to the 'Bed of Dreams' with you in order to break your curse. Hoping to rely on the 'Magician of the Night.'"

lines.content: どうしてそんなことになってしまうのかは知らない。これ以上は俺には語り聞かせられていない。
lines.translated: I didn't know why something like that was happening to her. I hadn't been told anything beyond that.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|人]だったらきっとこうする。
lines.translated: If it were *her*, I was sure this is what she would do.

lines.content: だからこそ俺は、何もせずじっとなどしていられなかった。
lines.translated: That was why I couldn't just sit still and do nothing.

lines.content: ただ、試してみるくらいのことなら簡単にできる。
lines.translated: Just giving it a try was easy enough.

lines.content: すぐそこにある“刻の終着駅”に行き、帰ってくるだけのことなんだ。
lines.translated: All we had to do was go to "Time's Terminal" right over there and come back.

lines.content: そんな軽い気持ちで、俺はこの人の手を引き、走り出したのだけれど、
lines.translated: It was with that naive thought in mind that I had taken her hand and started running, and yet...

lines.content: あず咲さんは、立ち止まった。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san stopped in her tracks.

lines.content: 繋いでいた手は離れてしまう。
lines.translated: Her hand slipped away from mine.

lines.content: そしてそんなあず咲さんを振り返り見た俺に、
lines.translated: When I looked back at her...

lines.content: ……私も
lines.translated: "...Me too."

lines.content: 足下に視線を落としたまま、
lines.translated: With her gaze cast down at her feet,

lines.content: ……私も、同じです
lines.translated: "...It's the same for me."

lines.content: ぽつり、ぽつりと、あず咲さんはこう言ったのだった。
lines.translated: Quietly, haltingly, Azusaki-san spoke.

lines.content: ……私も同じ。ともくんのことを助けたいから、そのための“魔法”がほしいから、ここへ……“ゆめのねどこ”へ来たんです
lines.translated: "...It's the same for me. I want to save Tomo-kun, and I want the 'magic' to do that. That's why I came here... to the 'Bed of Dreams.'"

lines.content: う、ううううううううううっ、また、こんなカッコ……だよっ
lines.translated: "U-Uuuuuuuugh, I'm in this outfit... again!"

lines.content: 次の日の放課後。
lines.translated: The next day, after school.

lines.content: 相も変わらず、と表現して正しいものか。
lines.translated: Would it be right to say things were "business as usual"?

lines.content: もはや色々なものが怪しく麻痺してしまっているが……。
lines.translated: At this point, my sense of normal was becoming dangerously numb, though...

lines.content: な、なんだか昨日よりもスカートの丈、短くなってる気がするよぅ……っ
lines.translated: "I-I feel like this skirt is even shorter than it was yesterday...!"

lines.content: 今日も今日とて、数日後に控えた“春の学園祭”に向けた準備に忙しかった。
lines.translated: Today, once again, we were busy preparing for the "Spring School Festival" just a few days away.

lines.content: ……いや。これって、準備なんだよな。学園祭に向けての。そんな律儀に着替えてあげなくてもいいのに。ハルもやっぱりお人好しだよなあ
lines.translated: "...Wait. This counts as preparation for the school festival, right? She doesn't have to be so obliging and actually change into it for him. Haru really is too good-natured."

lines.content: 遠目に首をかしげ、苦笑いな俺に答える声はなかった。代わりに、智仁のちょっと興奮したような声ばかりが千和のお店には響いている。
lines.translated: Watching from a distance, I tilted my head with a wry smile, though no one answered me. Instead, only Tomohito's somewhat excited voice echoed through Chiwa's shop.

lines.content: いいよー、とってもいいよハルちゃん！　めちゃくちゃかわいいっ
lines.translated: "Looking good, looking super good, Haru-chan! You're crazy cute!"

lines.content: ぱしゃぱしゃとスマホでハルの姿を画像に納める智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito snapped photo after photo of Haru with his smartphone.

lines.content: しゃ、写真なんて……それ、どうするのっ、何に使うの……っ？
lines.translated: "P-Photos...? What are you doing with those? What are you going to use them for...?!"

lines.content: ぎゅーっとスカートを引っ張りながらハルは訴えている。
lines.translated: Haru pleaded, tugging desperately at the hem of her skirt.

lines.content: ポスターだよハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Posters, Haru-chan."

lines.content: 想像力豊かなハルは即座に真っ青になった。
lines.translated: Blessed with a vivid imagination, Haru instantly turned pale.

lines.content: ま、まさか……
lines.translated: "N-No way..."

lines.content: うん。ハルちゃんはさすが察しがいいね
lines.translated: "Yep. Quick on the uptake as always, Haru-chan."

lines.content: にこりとする智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito flashed a bright smile.

lines.content: 今度はちゃんとライブの開催時刻と場所とを添えて……。こんなにかわいいハルちゃんの写真付きのポスターを校舎中にばらまくんだ
lines.translated: "This time, I'll make sure to include the time and location of the concert... And then I'll plaster posters with these super cute photos of you all over the school building!"

lines.content: こ、校舎じゅう……
lines.translated: "A-All over the school..."

lines.content: ハル。ふらりとしていた。涙目だ。
lines.translated: Haru swayed on her feet, tears pooling in her eyes.

lines.content: ばら、まく……の？
lines.translated: "Plaster... them?"

lines.content: 今にもぺたりと腰を抜かしてしまいそうな顔だった――と、俺にはわかるけれど、智仁は気づかない。
lines.translated: She looked like her legs were about to give out right then and there -- which was obvious to me, though Tomohito remained completely oblivious.

lines.content: ああ、大いにばらまいちゃうよ。校舎中にね
lines.translated: "Yeah, I'm gonna plaster them everywhere. All over the school."

lines.content: 俺プロデュースのアイドル柊ハルちゃんのファンを増やすんだと、智仁は息巻いている。プロデューサーとしての腕の見せ所なんだよと。
lines.translated: Tomohito was all fired up, declaring that he was going to grow the fanbase of his self-produced idol, Hiiragi Haru-chan. He called it his time to shine as a producer.

lines.content: ハルちゃんの写真。でこでこで盛り盛りにしてマジまんじでぱない具合の最新プリクラ写真みたいな感じに仕上げちゃって流行に乗ってみるのもありだけど……
lines.translated: "With Haru-chan's photos, I could hop on the latest trend and deck them out with tons of flashy edits, making them look like those crazy, lit purikura pics, buuut..."

lines.content: お前、何言ってるんだよ。日本語しゃべれって
lines.translated: "What are you even saying, man? Speak Japanese."

lines.content: 口を尖らせる俺には肩を竦めて見せ、智仁は言う。
lines.translated: I pursed my lips, and Tomohito just shrugged at me before continuing.

lines.content: ……うん。さすがはハルちゃん。でこる必要なんてない。素でかわいいなっ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Expected nothing less from Haru-chan. No need to deck them out at all. She's naturally cute!"

lines.content: ……いや。涙目どころじゃない。もうあれは殆ど泣いてる。ふるふると震えてもいる。口から何か出てはいけない白いものさえ出てきてる気がする。魂的な何かが。
lines.translated: Wait. She wasn't just teary-eyed anymore; she was practically crying. Trembling like a leaf, too. I felt like I could even see something white and ghostly drifting out of her mouth that definitely shouldn't be leaving her body. Like her soul.

lines.content: だけど誰も[・|そ][・|れ]には気づかないのだ。思い込みって、怖い。そう思う。
lines.translated: Yet nobody else noticed *it*. Tunnel vision really is a terrifying thing, I thought.

lines.content: これなら大雅だけだけじゃなく、推してくれるファンがいっぱいできるんじゃあないかな。学園祭のライブ。大盛況で終われそうだ
lines.translated: "At this rate, it won't just be Taiga -- she'll get tons of fans cheering for her. The school festival concert is gonna be a massive hit."

lines.content: うん。うん。そうだよ。もしそうなれば、学園祭限定ではなく、これから色々と活動していくのもありか……。ゆくゆくはメジャーデビューを視野に
lines.translated: "Yeah. Yeah, that's right. And if that happens, maybe we don't stop at the school festival and keep doing all kinds of activities afterward... With an eye toward a major debut down the line..."

lines.content: ぶつぶつと言い始める智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito started muttering to himself.

lines.content: や、やだよそんなことっ、さすがにそこまでできないよ……智仁くん
lines.translated: "N-No way, I don't want that! There's no way I can go that far... Tomohito-kun!"

lines.content: いやあ。ハルちゃんのかわいさが想像以上に完璧で……インスピレーションだよ。どんどん湧いてくるね。こんなにかわいいハルちゃんを、更に[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]が囲んで歌って踊って……
lines.translated: "Man, Haru-chan's cuteness is way more flawless than I imagined... It's pure inspiration. The ideas just keep flowing. With Haru-chan looking this cute, flanked by *the other two* singing and dancing around her..."

lines.content: ちらりと[くだん|件]の[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]を智仁は見る。
lines.translated: Tomohito glanced over at *the two* in question.

lines.content: ああ、マジで完璧だ。これは[・|歴][・|史][・|に][・|残][・|る]ライブになるな。絶対に
lines.translated: "Yeah, it's seriously flawless. This is gonna be a concert *that goes down in history*. Definitely."

lines.content: ふたりは……姫織と千和は視線を逸らした。
lines.translated: The two of them... Himeori and Chiwa both averted their eyes.

lines.content: 姫織はお冷やの氷をポリポリしながら。千和はお客さんもいないのにオーダー票に何かを書き付けている。他人の振りだった。
lines.translated: Himeori crunched on the ice from her water glass, while Chiwa scribbled something onto an order slip even though there weren't any customers in the shop. They were pretending they didn't even know us.

lines.content: う、ううっ、だ、大丈夫だよね？　ほんとに当日、私だけがライブすることにはならないよね……？　ふたりとも、信じてるよ？　信じてるからね……？
lines.translated: "U-Uuuugh, i-it's going to be okay, right? I won't really end up doing the concert all by myself on the day of, right...? I believe in you two, okay? I'm counting on you...?"

lines.content: そんなみんなの様子を前に、大丈夫なのかなあと俺は思ってる。
lines.translated: Watching everyone act like this, I couldn't help wondering if things were really going to be okay.

lines.content: こんな調子で学園祭のライブは成功に終わるのか。
lines.translated: Would the school festival concert actually succeed at this rate?

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: そういった類いの心配ではない。
lines.translated: No, that wasn't the kind of thing I was worried about.

lines.content: ……智仁。
lines.translated: Tomohito.

lines.content: どうしたんだ。
lines.translated: What's going on with him?

lines.content: なんだか最近の智仁は無理にテンション上げているように、俺の目には映ってしまう。
lines.translated: Lately, it looked to me like Tomohito was forcing himself to act hyped up.

lines.content: こんなにも面倒な……。いや。こんなふうに人が嫌がっている雰囲気を、その空気を、まるで読めないような男じゃないはずなんだけれど。
lines.translated: What a pain... No, wait. He shouldn't be the kind of guy who's this completely oblivious to the mood when someone is clearly hating every second of it.

lines.content: 一通り写真を撮り終えたところで、ハルはお店の奥で学園の制服に着替え……。
lines.translated: Once he finished taking a full round of photos, Haru went to the back of the shop to change back into her school uniform...

lines.content: ふらふらと、涙目で戻って来た。
lines.translated: Then she tottered back out, tears still in her eyes.

lines.content: わ、わたし……
ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up.

lines.content: 智仁くん。私、ちゃんと役に立ててるのかな……？
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun. Am I really being helpful...?"

lines.content: え？　どういうこと？
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you mean?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 智仁くんは、音楽を届けたい人がいるって、そう言ってたよね……？
lines.translated: "You said there's someone you want to reach with your music, right, Tomohito-kun...?"

lines.content: うん、そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: ……そのために、よければハルちゃんたちに力を貸してもらえればって思ってる
lines.translated: "...And to do that, I was hoping you and the others would lend me your strength."

lines.content: ……私がこんな格好して歌って踊って、それでその人に届けられる音楽があるのかどうか。私にはよくわからないけど……本当にほんとうに、[・|こ][・|れ]で届けられるんだよね？
lines.translated: "...I don't really understand if me dressing up like this to sing and dance will actually create music that can reach that person... Are you really, truly sure that *this* will reach them?"

lines.content: ……ああ。そうだと信じてる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I believe it will."

lines.content: 智仁は確信深くうなずき、ハルも『わかった』とうなずく。
lines.translated: Tomohito nodded with deep conviction, and Haru nodded back with an "Okay."

lines.content: そこは智仁くんのこと、信じるよ。だからどんなに恥ずかしくっても……。ううん。どんなには言い過ぎだけど、気を失ったりしない限りは頑張ろうって思うよ
lines.translated: "I'll trust you on that, Tomohito-kun. So no matter how embarrassing it is... No, saying 'no matter how embarrassing' is going too far, but as long as I don't pass out, I'll do my best."

lines.content: だけど……、とハルは言う。
lines.translated: "However..." Haru continued.

lines.content: 教えてほしいの。智仁くん
lines.translated: "There's something I want you to tell me, Tomohito-kun."

lines.content: ……うん。何をかな、ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "...Sure. What is it, Haru-chan?"

lines.content: 智仁くんは、その人にどんな音楽を届けたいのかな。そしてね、どんな気持ちをその音楽に乗せて、伝えたいのかな
lines.translated: "What kind of music do you want to deliver to that person, Tomohito-kun? And what kind of feelings do you want to put into that music to convey to them?"

lines.content: もしよければそれを教えてほしいんだよと、ハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru asked him if he wouldn't mind telling her that.

lines.content: 当日にどんな音楽を……歌を歌うことになるのかもずっと気になってるけれど、まずはそこだけでもいいから教えてほしいかなって、思って
lines.translated: "I've been wondering what kind of music... what song we're going to sing on the day of the festival, too, but I thought I should at least ask you about that part first."

lines.content: いわば自分は智仁の[歌|思い]の代弁者。
lines.translated: In a way, she was the spokesperson for Tomohito's feelings -- his song.

lines.content: 故に[・|そ][・|れ]を知らないことには、あるいは深く共感を得ていなければ、届けられるものも半分以下も伝わらないのではないか――そう、思うから。
lines.translated: Because of that, she felt that if she didn't know *what they were*, or if she couldn't deeply empathize with them, she wouldn't even be able to convey half of what needed to be delivered.

lines.content: だから、よければそういう気持ちの部分をね……ごめんね、もしかしたら生意気なこと言ってるかもだけど、教えてもらえたらうれしいなって思う
lines.translated: "So, if it's okay, I'd like to know about your feelings... I'm sorry if I'm overstepping my bounds here, but it would make me really happy if you told me."

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね。ハルちゃんの言うとおりだ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. You're right. It's just like you say, Haru-chan."

lines.content: 智仁はうなずく。
lines.translated: Tomohito nodded.

lines.content: そして軽く頭を掻きながら、言う。
lines.translated: Then, scratching his head lightly, he spoke.

lines.content: ……俺、音楽に乗せて“ごめん”って気持ちを届けたいんだ
lines.translated: "...I want to put the feeling of 'I'm sorry' into the music and deliver it to them."

lines.content: ……ごめんって、気持ち？
lines.translated: "...The feeling of 'I'm sorry'?"

lines.content: うん。[・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]とはずっとずっと、喧嘩したままだから……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because *that person* and I have been in a fight for a really, really long time..."

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: A wry smile surfaced on Tomohito's face.

lines.content: だからさ。音楽の力を借りられれば、直接伝えられない思いも、言葉も、あの人に届くんじゃないかなあって。そんな期待をしてるんだよ
lines.translated: "So, you know. I'm hoping that if I borrow the power of music, the feelings and words I can't say to them directly might finally reach them."

lines.content: 自分の力量を計りきれずに見誤り、あれそれ構わず首を突っ込みたがる人間の行き着く先はいつだって決まってる。[・|後][・|悔]だ。
lines.translated: The destination for someone who misjudges their own abilities and insists on sticking their nose into everything without thinking is always set in stone. It's *regret*.

lines.content: ……大概がそういうふうに流れていくようこの世界はできている。
lines.translated: This world is built so that things generally flow that way.

lines.content: あず咲さんの手を引きやって来た“刻の終着駅”で、俺は今まさに後悔していた。
lines.translated: At the "Terminal of Time," where I had come pulling Azusaki-san along by the hand, I was drowning in regret right this very second.

lines.content: ……[・|あ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]、どれくらいの夜が過ぎてしまったんだ
lines.translated: "...How many nights have passed *since then*?"

lines.content: 自分が今こうして立ちすくむ場所は、[・|先][・|ほ][・|ど][・|ま][・|で]と変わらぬように見え、実は何年も、何十年も、何百年もの[とき|刻]を飛び越えてしまった先の未来……で、あるのかもしれない。
lines.translated: The place where I now stood frozen looked no different from how it had *just a moment ago*, yet in reality, it might have been a future years, decades, or even centuries ahead in time...

lines.content: そう考えるとぞっとした。
lines.translated: The mere thought sent a chill down my spine.

lines.content: 帰り道など見失ってしまう以前に、どこにも存在しないのではないか。
lines.translated: Forget losing our way back -- the path home might not even exist anywhere anymore.

lines.content: あまりにもあんまりな恐怖に呼吸をも忘れてしまいそうに、なる。
lines.translated: The sheer, overwhelming terror of it nearly made me forget how to breathe.

lines.content: ……私が
え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私が眠ると、未来に飛んでしまうんです
lines.translated: "When I fall asleep, I jump into the future."

lines.content: あず咲さんは[・|眠][・|そ][・|う][・|に][・|瞼][・|を][・|こ][・|す][・|り][・|な][・|が][・|ら]改めてそう言うと、更にその先を、続けた――
lines.translated: *Rubbing her eyelids sleepily*, Azusaki-san stated that once again, and then continued further --
"-- I'm so sorry, Taiga-kun. *Haru-chan*."
"I end up jumping into the future, *taking the people around me along with me*."

lines.content: ……どういうこと？　何が、どうなってるの？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean? What's going on?"
*As Haru shook me by the shoulders*, I remembered.

lines.content: 智仁の言葉だ――姉ちゃんが眠そうにしていたならすぐそこから逃げ出せよ。確かそういう言葉だったはずだ。
lines.translated: Tomohito's words -- "If my sister starts looking sleepy, run away from there immediately." I was pretty sure that was what he'd said.

lines.content: その警告に背いた結果が、今なのである――……後悔だ。愚か者はいつだって後悔ばかりする。
lines.translated: My current predicament was the result of ignoring that warning -- ...Regret. Fools do nothing but regret.

lines.content: そのクセ、その後悔から一切何も学ばない。故に。何度だって後悔をし続ける羽目になるのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, they never learn a single thing from it. Which is why they end up dooming themselves to repeat their regrets over and over again.

lines.content: ねえ、答えてよ、教えてよ[・|奏]くん。未来に飛ぶって？　どういうことなの？
lines.translated: "Hey, answer me! Tell me, *Kanade*-kun! Jump into the future? What does that mean?!"

lines.content: あず咲さんの手を引きやって来た“刻の終着駅”には――どうしてかハルがいたのだ。そして、俺とハルは、[・|巻][・|き][・|込][・|ま][・|れ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: At the "Terminal of Time," where I had brought Azusaki-san by the hand -- for some reason, Haru had been there too. And so, both Haru and I *had been dragged into it*.

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: 俺はまずこちらの事情をハルに話した。
lines.translated: First, I explained my side of the story to Haru.

lines.content: 俺は、あず咲さんを“呪い”から救いたかったんだよ
lines.translated: "I wanted to save Azusaki-san from her 'curse.'"

lines.content: だから、“刻の終着駅”に軒を連ねる不思議な店のどれかに引き取って貰いましょう――そんなふうに提案をした。
lines.translated: So I had suggested that we get one of the mysterious shops lining the streets of the "Terminal of Time" to take it off her hands.

lines.content: あず咲さんの魂に刻まれた“呪い”
lines.translated: The "curse" etched into Azusaki-san's soul.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]に名前はない。ただ“呪い”とだけ呼ぶに相応しい現象だけがそこにある。
lines.translated: *It* had no name. There was only a phenomenon there that could only fittingly be called a "curse."

lines.content: 結論を先に言ってしまうと、“刻の終着駅”に[・|そ][・|れ]を買い取ってくれる店など、どこにもなかった。
lines.translated: To skip to the conclusion, there wasn't a single shop in the "Terminal of Time" willing to buy *it*.

lines.content: “夜”だろうとそうではなかろうと、取引されるものは当然需要あるものに限られる。
lines.translated: Whether in the "Night" or not, anything traded in business is naturally limited to what is in demand.

lines.content: “呪い”などいったい誰が高い支払いをしてまで得ようとするのか――つまり商品価値などないと突っぱねられた。
lines.translated: Who on earth would pay a high price just to acquire a "curse"? In short, we were flatly rejected because it had no commercial value.

lines.content: だけど諦めず数ある店々を周り、交渉していく中で……ハルだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I didn't give up, and as we went around negotiating with shop after shop... we ran into Haru.

lines.content: あさひさんから渡されたメモ用紙を片手に、様々な不思議な[・|も][・|の]が販売されている“刻の終着駅”の店を見て回っている――そんなハルが、そこにいたのだ。
lines.translated: Holding a slip of memo paper handed to her by Asahi-san in one hand, looking around the shops of the "Terminal of Time" where all sorts of mysterious *things* were sold -- Haru had been right there.

lines.content: 空が……。
lines.translated: The sky...
*That was when the sky of the "Night" began to spin.*

lines.content: 瞬く間に“夜”は閉じ、太陽が空を照らす。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, the "Night" closed, and the sun lit up the sky.

lines.content: 同様に恐ろしい速度で空は暮れ……。
lines.translated: Just as quickly, the sky darkened at a terrifying speed...

lines.content: 星々や月が昇っては、“夜”のベールに細い光の線を幾つもいくつも刻んでは、消えていく……。
lines.translated: The stars and the moon rose, carving countless thin lines of light into the veil of the "Night" before vanishing...

lines.content: そしてまた朝が来る。その繰り返し。繰り返し。繰り返し。
lines.translated: And then morning came again. Over and over. And over. And over.

lines.content: 町で生活する往来も、俺たちを置いてものすごい早さで過ぎ去っていく……。
lines.translated: Even the people going about their lives in the town blurred past at a tremendous speed, leaving us behind...

lines.content: そんな景色を、俺とハルはどうすることもできず、ただただ見上げ……。
lines.translated: Helpless to do anything, Haru and I could only stare up at that sight...

lines.content: 奏くん……こわいよ……
lines.translated: "Kanade-kun... I'm scared..."

lines.content: ハルがふと、俺の手を握った。
lines.translated: Haru suddenly squeezed my hand.

lines.content: そしてそのとき気づいたのだ。
lines.translated: And that was when I noticed.

lines.content: ハルとは反対側の手で繋いだままのあず咲さんが、その場に倒れ込むようにして眠っていたことに――俺は、ようやく気づいた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san, whose hand I was still holding with my other hand, had collapsed right where she stood, fast asleep -- I finally realized it.

lines.content: 私が眠ると、世界はその度にまたひとつ枝分かれするんです
lines.translated: "Every time I fall asleep, the world branches off once again."

lines.content: あくびを必死にかみ殺し――あず咲さんはそう言った。
lines.translated: Desperately stifling a yawn -- Azusaki-san said that.

lines.content: あず咲さんが目覚めると同時、空や町の景色は元の速度に戻ったのだった。
lines.translated: The moment Azusaki-san woke up, the sky and the townscape returned to their normal speed.

lines.content: ……枝分かれ？　世界が？
lines.translated: "...Branches off? The world does?"

lines.content: ……はい
ハルの問いかけに、あず咲さんはうなずいた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san nodded at Haru's question.

lines.content: 一度未来へ飛んでしまうと、以前いた時間の延長線上に再び戻れる保証はないんです。目覚めた[・|そ][・|こ]は、幾つもいくつも枝分かれした先の可能性のひとつにすぎない
lines.translated: "Once I jump into the future, there is no guarantee that I can ever return to the direct continuation of the timeline I was in before. The *place* where I wake up is nothing more than one possibility at the end of countless diverging branches."

lines.content: そこで再び出会った大切な人も、眠りに落ちる前に笑い合った人と同じように見えて、[・|違][・|う][・|人]――[・|か][・|も]、しれない。
lines.translated: Even the precious people she met again there, though they might look the same as the ones she had laughed with before falling asleep, *might* actually be -- *different people*.

lines.content: こんな“呪い”があるせいで、私は……
lines.translated: "Because I have this 'curse,' I..."

lines.content: あず咲さんはそこで唇を噛み、うつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san bit her lip and looked down.

lines.content: えっと。それじゃあ……ここは、どこなの？
lines.translated: "Um. Then... where are we right now?"

lines.content: ハルは辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: Haru looked around at our surroundings.

lines.content: ここは未来？　それとも、私たちのいた“夜”の世界とは少し違う、別の……未来の世界？
lines.translated: "Is this the future? Or is it another... future world that's a little different from the world of the 'Night' we were in?"

lines.content: 複雑だった。
lines.translated: It was complicated.

lines.content: 幼い俺たちの頭で正確に理解するには、あんまりにも複雑にこんがらがってしまっているよう感じられた。
lines.translated: It felt far too tangled and complex for our young minds to grasp accurately.

lines.content: ……ハル。あず咲さん。とりあえず“ゆめのねどこ”に戻ろう
lines.translated: "...Haru. Azusaki-san. For now, let's go back to the 'Bed of Dreams.'"

lines.content: ここがどれほど先の未来であったとしても、今の俺たちが頼れる場所も、ひとも、そこにしかなかった。
lines.translated: No matter how far into the future this place might be, the only place and people we could rely on right now were back there.

lines.content: ……結局、俺は何をしに来たんだ。
lines.translated: In the end, what did I even come here to do?

lines.content: そんな悔しさを奥歯でかみしめ、ふたりの手を引き歩き出そうとした。
lines.translated: Clenching my back teeth in frustration, I took both of their hands and started to walk.

lines.content: そういえば、ハル。あさひさんのお使いって、いったいどんなものを……
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, Haru. What kind of thing did Asahi-san ask you to get for her errand...?"

lines.content: そこまで口にし、俺は気づいた。
lines.translated: Only after getting that far did I notice.

lines.content: ……あず咲さん？
lines.translated: "...Azusaki-san?"

lines.content: 繋いでいたはずのその手が解かれたのだ――振り返る。すると、あず咲さんはその場に立ちすくんでいた。
lines.translated: The hand I thought I had been holding had slipped free -- I turned around. Azusaki-san was standing frozen in place.

lines.content: まさか、どこか怪我でも……
lines.translated: "Don't tell me you're hurt somewhere..."

lines.content: 不安になり声を掛けた俺には答えず、うつむいたまま、
lines.translated: Worried, I called out to her, but she didn't answer. Keeping her head bowed,

lines.content: ……だめ
ぽつりと、あず咲さんは言ったのだ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san murmured quietly.

lines.content: ……私は、行けません
lines.translated: "...I can't go with you."

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”には、戻れない
lines.translated: "I can't go back to the 'Bed of Dreams.'"

lines.content: あず咲さん？　どうしたんですか？
lines.translated: "Azusaki-san? What's wrong?"

lines.content: だめ……来ちゃ、だめ、です……
lines.translated: "No... Stay back... You can't come near me..."

lines.content: それは悲鳴のような声だった――そしてあず咲さんは頭を抱え、視線を頭上へと投げかける。
lines.translated: Her voice sounded like a scream -- and then Azusaki-san clutched her head and cast her gaze up toward the sky.

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: また空の景色が少しずつ、少しずつ、その刻の経過が早くなっていて……。
lines.translated: Once again, the passage of time in the sky above was gradually, steadily speeding up...

lines.content: ……どう、しよう。また……。また眠く、なって……う、う、うう……っ
lines.translated: "...What do I do? It's happening again... I'm getting sleepy again... Ugh, ugh, ughh...!"

lines.content: ふらりとするあず咲さんだ。その場にへたり込んでしまう。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san swayed unsteadily, then sank to the ground right where she stood.

lines.content: そして最期の力を振り絞るようにして、叫ぶ。
lines.translated: Summoning the last of her strength, she cried out.

lines.content: ……お願い。お願い、します……逃げて。早く……っ
lines.translated: "...Please. I'm begging you... Run away. Hurry...!"

lines.content: そんなわけにいくか。
lines.translated: Like hell I could do that.

lines.content: 俺は、この俺、奏大雅には夢がある。
lines.translated: I -- Kanade Taiga -- had a dream.

lines.content: それは、苦しんでいる誰もを救えるようなヒーローに……。
lines.translated: And that dream was to become a hero who could save anyone who was suffering...

lines.content: お願い早くっ、なにしてるのっ、早く、逃げて……っ
lines.translated: "Please, hurry! What are you doing?! Hurry and run away...!"

lines.content: で、でも……っ
今、[・|私][・|か][・|ら]ハルちゃんを助けられるのは、君だけなんだよ、大雅くん……っ
lines.translated: "Right now, you're the only one who can save Haru-chan *from me*, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: 俺は……。
繋いだままのハルの手に、ぎゅっと、力を込めて……。
lines.translated: I squeezed Haru's hand, still joined with mine, as tightly as I could...

lines.content: 先日の件、考えてくれましたか？　大雅くん
lines.translated: "Have you given some thought to what we talked about the other day, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: その日もハルと一緒に歩く帰り道。いつもの場所に、いつもの時間に、いつものように――俺たちはあず咲先輩と出会った。
lines.translated: On our walk home together that day, at the usual place, at the usual time, just like always -- Haru and I ran into Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: 先日の件……
lines.translated: "What we talked about the other day..."

lines.content: とぼけるつもりはなかった。ただなんとなくつぶやいてみただけだ。
lines.translated: I wasn't trying to play dumb. I had just murmured it without thinking.

lines.content: だけどあず咲先輩は、そんな俺に“まさか忘れられちゃったんじゃ”というような、不安そうな顔を浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Yet Azusaki-senpai looked back at me with an anxious expression, as if worried I might have actually forgotten all about it.

lines.content: ……あず咲先輩の“魔法”のこと、ですよね？
lines.translated: "...You mean about your 'magic,' right, Azusaki-senpai?"

lines.content: あ、は、はい。そうです。私の“魔法”を大雅くんに使ってほしくって……
lines.translated: "Ah, y-yes. That's right. I was hoping you would use my 'magic,' Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: ほっと胸をなで下ろすあず咲先輩だ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai breathed a sigh of relief.

lines.content: そして、苦笑いにも似たいつもの笑顔を見せてくれていた。
lines.translated: Then she gave me her usual smile, the one that looked almost like a wry grin.

lines.content: “あの親にしてこの子あり”とはよく言うが、“あの弟にしてこの姉あり”――とはまるで言えない。
lines.translated: People often say "like parent, like child," but you definitely couldn't say "like brother, like sister" about these two.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は太陽。この人は月。
lines.translated: *He* was the sun. She was the moon.

lines.content: そのようなあんまりにもありふれた比喩などは口にするつもりもないけれど。
lines.translated: Not that I had any intention of voicing such a terribly cliche metaphor out loud.

lines.content: これほど正反対な姉弟もそうそういないのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: Still, you'd be hard-pressed to find an older sister and younger brother who were more complete opposites.

lines.content: あず咲先輩は、あず咲先輩の“魔法”で、智仁のことを助けたい……ということでしたよね
lines.translated: "You want to use your 'magic' to help Tomohito... right, Azusaki-senpai?"

lines.content: はい。……そうです
lines.translated: "Yes. ...That's right."

lines.content: こっくりとうなずくあず咲先輩に、『もしもよければ』と俺は言う。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai gave a firm nod, and I prefaced my next words with, "If you don't mind."

lines.content: ……よければ、先輩。わけを教えてもらえますか？
lines.translated: "...If it's all right with you, Senpai, could you tell me the reason why?"

lines.content: 智仁は今、“魔法”を必要とするほどの“何か”に窮しているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was Tomohito currently struggling with "something" so serious that it required "magic"?

lines.content: それがどうしても気に掛かっていた。
lines.translated: I couldn't help worrying about that.

lines.content: それって……
lines.translated: "Does that mean..."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は言う。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai spoke up.

lines.content: それって、もしもですけど……
lines.translated: "Does that mean, hypothetically speaking..."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: もしも大雅くんに、本当のことを言わずにいたら、私は“魔法”を許可してもらえなかったりしますか？
lines.translated: "If I didn't tell you the truth, Taiga-kun, would I not be granted permission to use my 'magic'?"

lines.content: 本当のことを、ですか？
lines.translated: "The truth?"

lines.content: はい。たとえば、私が“魔法”を必要だって思ってる理由をなんとなく言いにくくて、大雅くんにうそをついたりしてみたら……
lines.translated: "Yes. For example, if I found it a little hard to talk about why I feel I need 'magic,' and ended up lying to you..."

lines.content: そうしたら大雅くんは、私の“魔法”を……。私の中にある“願い”を、叶えることができなくなってしまったりしますか？
lines.translated: "If I did that, Taiga-kun, would you be unable to use my 'magic'...? Would you be unable to grant the 'wish' inside me?"

lines.content: いえ
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: 首を振り、答える。
lines.translated: I shook my head and answered.

lines.content: きっとそうはならないと思います
lines.translated: "I'm sure that wouldn't happen."

lines.content: ……そうなんですか？
lines.translated: "...Really?"

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|こ]に一欠片のうそがあろうと、[・|そ][・|こ]には真実のみしかなかろうと……
lines.translated: "Whether there's a shred of a lie *in there*, or whether *there's* nothing but the truth..."

lines.content: 結果として[・|殆][・|ど]変わらず、俺は“許可”を出せてしまうし、“魔法”を使うことはできるだろうと思います
lines.translated: "The end result would be *almost* unchanged -- I'd still be able to grant 'permission,' and I think we'd still be able to use the 'magic.'"

lines.content: だから、先輩。繰り返すようですが、先輩の事情をすべて、包み隠さず教えてもらえなかったとしても、“許可”することだけはできるだろうと感じます。……ただ
lines.translated: "So, Senpai, at the risk of repeating myself, even if you didn't tell me all of your circumstances without holding anything back, I feel like I'd still be able to at least 'permit' it. ...However."

lines.content: え？　ただ……？
lines.translated: "Huh? However...?"
"...Yes. *However, I said 'almost' unchanged.*"

lines.content: 首をかしげる先輩に、俺は続けた。
lines.translated: Senpai tilted her head in confusion, so I continued.

lines.content: 先輩の事情をすべて教えてもらえなければ、信頼関係はそこまで……ということになるかもしれません
lines.translated: "If you can't tell me all the details of your situation, it might mean that our level of mutual trust only goes that far..."

lines.content: すると許可した“魔法”のその効果は低くなってしまう可能性はあると思います
lines.translated: "And if that's the case, I think there's a chance the effectiveness of the permitted 'magic' would be weakened."

lines.content: ……信頼関係、ですか？
lines.translated: "...Mutual trust?"

lines.content: はい……
――“関係性”こそが“魔法”の“鍵”になるのだと、あさひさんは言っていた。
lines.translated: -- "Relationships" are the very "key" to "magic," Asahi-san had told me.

lines.content: ……先輩。もし可能ならうそはなしで、本当のことを教えてもらえればとは思います
lines.translated: "...Senpai. If possible, I'd really like you to tell me the truth, without any lies."

lines.content: 確かに、事実を教えてもらわなくても、効果は低くなることはあっても“魔法”は使えるだろうと思いますが……
lines.translated: "It's true that even if you don't tell me the facts, we could probably still use the 'magic,' even if its effect might be weaker..."

lines.content: そこに少しでもうそがあると感じられてしまえば、すみません先輩……俺は、あず咲先輩の“魔法”を使うわけにはいかないです
lines.translated: "But if I sense even the slightest lie in what you tell me, then I'm sorry, Senpai... I won't be able to bring myself to use your 'magic.'"

lines.content: その“魔法”はあず咲先輩にとって危険なものではないだろうか。
lines.translated: Could that "magic" be something dangerous to Azusaki-senpai herself?

lines.content: あず咲先輩が意図しない方向で、誰かを傷つけたりする恐れはないだろうか。
lines.translated: Was there a risk that it might hurt someone in a way Azusaki-senpai hadn't intended?

lines.content: それらを第三者として判断する必要がある。
lines.translated: I needed to judge those things as a third party.

lines.content: それが俺の“役割”なのだ――故に。[・|安][・|全]だと判断できたときにのみ、“魔法”に許可を出せるし、そうでなければ俺という存在や、その“役割”に意味が成さなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: That was my "role" -- and therefore, I could only grant permission for "magic" when I judged it to be *safe*. Otherwise, my very existence and my "role" would lose all meaning.

lines.content: そういうふうに“夜の魔法使い”であるあさひさんから注意を受けている。
lines.translated: Asahi-san, the "Magician of the Night," had warned me about that very thing.

lines.content: そうですか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は、うなずく。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai nodded.

lines.content: ……そうでなければ“使えない”、ではなくって、“使うわけにはいかない”、ということなんですね
lines.translated: "...So it's not that you 'can't use it' otherwise, but that you 'can't allow yourself to use it.'"

lines.content: わかりました、とあず咲先輩は言う。
lines.translated: "I understand," Azusaki-senpai said.
