lines.content: はじめからうそをつく気は[・|殆][・|ど]ありませんでした。事実のみを話します
lines.translated: "From the very beginning, I had *almost* no intention of lying. I'll tell you only the facts."

lines.content: 殆ど、ですか
lines.translated: "'Almost,' huh?"

lines.content: 微笑みながらそう言う俺に、あず咲先輩は苦笑いを返した。
lines.translated: When I said that with a smile, Azusaki-senpai returned a wry smile of her own.

lines.content: ……うそをついたほうがいいのかなって、ちょっとだけそう思った理由はひとつです
lines.translated: "...There's only one reason why I briefly wondered if it might be better to tell a lie."

lines.content: ともくんが困ってるだろうこと。それは、あまりお友だちには知られたくないんじゃないかなって思ったから
lines.translated: "It's about what Tomo-kun is probably struggling with. I thought he might not want his friends finding out about it."

lines.content: だから秘密のままにしていられるのなら、できるかぎりそうしようとも思っていましたとあず咲先輩は言う。いつもの苦笑いを浮かべたままで。
lines.translated: So if she could keep it a secret, she had intended to do so as much as possible, Azusaki-senpai explained, still wearing her usual wry smile.

lines.content: ともくんの音楽が、その想いが、届けたい人にちゃんと届きますように。そのために、私は、ずっと[思い|想像]続けてきた。そのために“魔法”を使いたいと願います
lines.translated: "I want Tomo-kun's music, and his feelings, to properly reach the person he wants them to reach. For that sake, I've kept imagining and wishing for it all this time. And for that sake, I wish to use 'magic.'"

lines.content: そう言い、あず咲先輩は俺へと手を差し伸べた。
lines.translated: With those words, Azusaki-senpai held her hand out to me.

lines.content: その手を掴み、あず咲先輩の事情を充分に伝え聞かせて貰った上で――許可を出す。
lines.translated: I would take her hand, hear out the full story of her circumstances -- and grant permission.

lines.content: そのために、差し出された手を握ろうかとしたところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was about to take her outstretched hand to do so,

lines.content: ……あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "...Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: ハルが言った。少しばかり複雑そうな表情を浮かべたまま。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up, a somewhat complicated expression on her face.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。あず咲先輩。あの、大きなお世話だとわかってます。だけど、どうしても言わずにはいられなくって……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Azusaki-senpai. Um, I know it's none of my business. But I just couldn't keep quiet..."

lines.content: ごめんなさいとハルはもう一度だけ言いい、恐る恐ると続けた。
lines.translated: Haru apologized one more time, then timidly continued.

lines.content: 智仁くんには音楽を届けたい人がいる……
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun has someone he wants his music to reach..."

lines.content: ……ええ。そう、みたいですね
lines.translated: "...Yes. It seems so."

lines.content: その人に、智仁くんは音楽を通じて伝えたい想いがあるって言っていました
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun said there are feelings he wants to convey to that person through his music."

lines.content: 伝えたい想い……
lines.translated: "Feelings he wants to convey..."

lines.content: あず咲先輩はふと目を細める。なんだか眩しいものでも見つめるみたいに。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai suddenly narrowed her eyes, almost as if she were gazing at something dazzling.

lines.content: その人がいったい誰なのか。それはまだ教えてもらえていませんけれど……。だけどきっと、智仁くんにとってその人はとても、とっても、大切な人なんだろうなって思います
lines.translated: "Who that person actually is... he hasn't told us yet, though. But I think that person must be someone very, very precious to Tomohito-kun."

lines.content: ……そっか。大切な人、か
lines.translated: "...I see. Someone precious, huh?"

lines.content: ともくんも青春しちゃってるんですね。私の知らない間に大人になっちゃったんだなあ
lines.translated: "So Tomo-kun is having his own springtime of youth, too. He's grown up before I even knew it."

lines.content: しみじみと言う。しかし、どこかさみしそうにも見える横顔だった。
lines.translated: She spoke earnestly, yet her profile looked somewhat lonely.

lines.content: うーん。その相手って誰なのかなあ。余計なお世話だろうけれど、お姉ちゃんとしてはなんだか気になってしまいます
lines.translated: "Hmm. I wonder who the lucky girl could be. It's probably none of my business, but as his older sister, I can't help being curious."

lines.content: えっと。あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "Um... Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: 視線を泳がせていたハルだったが、そこで意を決したように、あず咲先輩を真っ直ぐに見て、
lines.translated: Haru's eyes had been darting around, but then, as if making up her mind, she looked straight at Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: 智仁くんが音楽を届けたい人って、私、あず咲先輩なんじゃないかなって思うんですけど……
lines.translated: "The person Tomohito-kun wants his music to reach... I think it might actually be you, Azusaki-senpai..."

lines.content: それはきっと誰もがどこかで予想していることだった。
lines.translated: That was surely something everyone had suspected on some level.

lines.content: 姫織も。千和も。みんながだ。
lines.translated: Himeori, too. And Chiwa. All of us had.
*However, for that very reason, it was*...

lines.content: 違いますよ
lines.translated: "You're mistaken."

lines.content: きっぱりと、あず咲先輩は言った。まるで俺の心の内を代弁するかのように。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai said it flatly, almost as if speaking my own inner thoughts aloud for me.

lines.content: だって私は、ともくんの大切な人なんかじゃありませんし……
lines.translated: "Because I'm nothing like someone precious to Tomo-kun..."

lines.content: で、でも
lines.translated: "B-But..."

lines.content: ハルは前のめりになりながらも、言う。
lines.translated: Haru leaned forward as she pressed on.

lines.content: あず咲先輩、智仁くんと喧嘩してるって言ってましたよね？　ずっとずっと長い間……ずっと
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai, you said you've been in a fight with Tomohito-kun, right? For a really, really long time... all this time."

lines.content: ええ……
智仁くんも同じように言ってました。音楽を届けたい人とはずっと喧嘩してるんだって
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun said the exact same thing. He said he's been fighting with the person he wants his music to reach this whole time."

lines.content: 音楽に乗せて“ごめんなさい”って気持ちをその人に伝えたいんだって……
lines.translated: "He said he wants to put his feelings of 'I'm sorry' into his music and convey them to that person..."

lines.content: だから、と。
lines.translated: "And so," she added.

lines.content: まるで、必ずここで理解を得なければならないわけがあるのだとばかりに、必死なふうにハルはあず咲先輩のことを見つめていた。
lines.translated: Haru stared desperately at Azusaki-senpai, as though there were some reason she absolutely had to make her understand right here and now.

lines.content: ……ううん
そんなハルの視線から逃れるみたいに、首を微かに振り、そしてやっぱりいつもの苦笑いのような笑みのまま、あず咲先輩は言ったのだった。
lines.translated: As if trying to escape Haru's gaze, Azusaki-senpai gave a faint shake of her head, and with that same usual wry smile on her face, she spoke.

lines.content: 私は、違いますよ。ハルちゃん。ともくんが大切に想うような人じゃない
lines.translated: "It isn't me, Haru-chan. I'm not someone Tomo-kun holds dear."

lines.content: だって私は、ともくんの大切な人じゃないどころか……
lines.translated: "Because far from being someone precious to Tomo-kun, I..."

lines.content: 私はね、とあず咲先輩は言い、
lines.translated: "You see, I..." Azusaki-senpai began.

lines.content: ……私は、本当はともくんの、お姉ちゃんでさえない存在なんですから
lines.translated: "...In truth, I'm not even really Tomo-kun's older sister."

lines.content: まるで、自分の言葉に掻き消されでもしそうなほど、薄く、儚い微笑みを見せるのだった。
lines.translated: She gave a smile so faint and fleeting that it looked as if it might be swallowed up by her own words.

lines.content: 今、[・|私][・|か][・|ら]ハルちゃんを助けられるのは、君だけなんだよ、大雅くん……っ
lines.translated: "Right now, you're the only one who can save Haru-chan *from me*, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: あず咲さんの悲痛とも感じられる叫び声。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san let out a cry that sounded almost agonizing.

lines.content: 俺は……。
早く、私からできるだけ……離れてっ
lines.translated: "Hurry, get as far away... from me as you can!"

lines.content: 俺は。
逃げ出してしまった――ハルの手を引き、走った。
lines.translated: I ran away -- grabbing Haru by the hand, I bolted.

lines.content: ごめん智仁。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Tomohito.

lines.content: ゆるしてくれ。
lines.translated: Forgive me.

lines.content: あず咲さんはたったひとり、遠い未来へと飛ばされた。自身が抱える“呪い”によって。
lines.translated: Azusaki-san was sent flying all alone into the distant future. By the "curse" she carried within herself.

lines.content: 俺は、お前のお姉さんを見捨ててしまった……。
lines.translated: I abandoned your older sister...

lines.content: いいや。見捨てるも、何も。
lines.translated: No. It wasn't even a matter of abandoning her.

lines.content: 俺がお前の警告を無視して、余計なことをしなければこんなことには……。
lines.translated: If I hadn't ignored your warning and meddled where I shouldn't have, none of this would have happened...

lines.content: 謝っても謝りきれない。あいつと顔を合わせるのが怖いとさえ感じる。
lines.translated: No amount of apologies could ever make up for it. I even feel terrified of facing him again.

lines.content: それでも俺は、ハルを連れて走った。あず咲さんからできだけ遠く離れなければ、と。
lines.translated: Even so, I kept running with Haru in tow, telling myself we had to get as far away from Azusaki-san as possible.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: か、奏くん……全然、空も、町も、全然元に戻らないよ……っ
lines.translated: "K-Kanade-kun... The sky, and the town, they aren't going back to normal at all...!"

lines.content: いくら走っても、いくらあず咲さんから遠く離れようとも、速度の増した風景は元に戻らない。
lines.translated: No matter how much we ran, no matter how far we got from Azusaki-san, the accelerated scenery didn't return to normal.

lines.content: むしろどんどんその速さは増していっているように見えた。
lines.translated: If anything, it looked like it was only picking up more and more speed.

lines.content: う、うう……っ、どうなってるんだ、これはっ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh...! What is going on here?!"

lines.content: 太陽がのぼり、沈む。
lines.translated: The sun rose, and set.

lines.content: 月や星々が瞬き、そして再び太陽が顔を出し、闇を吹き払う。
lines.translated: The moon and stars twinkled, and then the sun peeked out once more, blowing away the darkness.

lines.content: いったいどれほどの日々が足早に通り過ぎていってしまっているのか……。
lines.translated: Just how many days were rushing past us at breakneck speed...?

lines.content: このままでは俺たちの知らない、遠いとおい未来にまで連れて行かれてしまうのではないか――そう思うとあまりに怖く。
lines.translated: At this rate, wouldn't we be carried off to some far, distant future we didn't even know? -- The mere thought of it was terrifying beyond words.

lines.content: ついには走り続けることも叶わず、ただその場に立ち尽くしてしまった。
lines.translated: In the end, I couldn't even keep running anymore, and simply stood frozen to the spot.

lines.content: “夜の国”の大通り。往来が猛スピードで行き交うその中だ。
lines.translated: Right in the middle of the main street of the "Country of Night," with traffic whipping past at breakneck speed.

lines.content: ……くそう
lines.translated: "...Dammit."

lines.content: 拳を握りしめる。かちかちと歯が鳴っていた。恐怖だ。俺の心はふつふつとわき出す[・|怖][・|さ]に溺れはじめている。油断すると涙さえ流れかねない。
lines.translated: I clenched my fists. My teeth were chattering. It was fear. My heart was beginning to drown in the *fear* bubbling up inside me. If I let my guard down, tears might even spill over.

lines.content: ……情けない。
lines.translated: How pathetic.

lines.content: （……こんな程度のことで足がすくんで動けなくなるだなんて）
lines.translated: (...To think my legs would freeze up and leave me unable to move over something like this.)

lines.content: これで、ヒーローになることが“夢”だ。なんて。
lines.translated: And I call becoming a hero my "dream." Yeah, right.

lines.content: あまりに自分が情けなく、ぎゅっと、恐怖を閉じ込めるため[まぶた|瞼]を閉じていた――
lines.translated: Ashamed of how utterly pathetic I was, I squeezed my eyelids shut to lock the terror inside --

lines.content: ……あの。奏くん
lines.translated: "...Um. Kanade-kun."

lines.content: 服の裾を遠慮気味に引かれていた。
lines.translated: Someone was tugging hesitantly at the hem of my shirt.

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 閉じていた[まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I opened my closed eyelids.

lines.content: ごめんと謝り、そして、振り返った――涙がこぼれていたらどうしよう。咄嗟に思い、腕の裾でごしごしと目元をこすった。
lines.translated: Saying "Sorry," I turned around -- What if tears were spilling down my face? The thought struck me instantly, and I scrubbed at my eyes with my sleeve.

lines.content: そんな俺に、ハルは言う。
lines.translated: Watching me do that, Haru spoke.

lines.content: あさひさんから言いつけられてたお買い物
lines.translated: "The shopping errand Asahi-san asked me to do..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……電話、だよ
lines.translated: "...It's a phone."

lines.content: ごそごそと、ハルはスカートのポケットから[・|そ][・|れ]を取り出した。ぼろぼろの携帯端末だった。
lines.translated: Rummaging around, Haru pulled *it* out of her skirt pocket. It was a battered old mobile device.

lines.content: これは、あさひさんの作った“魔法”……みたい
lines.translated: "This seems to be... a 'magic' that Asahi-san made."

lines.content: ……“魔法”？　これが？
lines.translated: "...'Magic'? This thing?"

lines.content: ごめんね、奏くん。私も詳しくはよくわからないんだけど……
lines.translated: "Sorry, Kanade-kun. I don't really know the details myself, either, but..."

lines.content: どこにいても、どんなときでも、必ず[・|繋][・|が][・|る]電話なんだって……、あさひさん、言ってた
lines.translated: "Asahi-san said... it's a phone that will always *connect*, no matter where you are or when it is."

lines.content: どこにいても……必ず？
lines.translated: "No matter where you are... without fail?"

lines.content: 端末を受け取り、まじまじと確かめる。
lines.translated: Taking the device, I stared at it closely to check.

lines.content: [・|繋][・|が][・|る]どころか電源も入らないのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Far from *connecting*, it wouldn't even turn on, though...

lines.content: うん。どこにいても。どんなときでも。どんな場所に、迷い込んでしまったとしても。この電話は、あさひさんの……“ゆめのねどこ”にある黒電話に必ず繋がる
lines.translated: "Yeah. No matter where you are. No matter when. Even if you get lost in some strange place. This phone will always connect to Asahi-san's... black rotary phone in the 'Bed of Dreams.'"

lines.content: ……そういう“魔法”なんだって、あさひさん言ってたよ
lines.translated: "...Asahi-san told me that's the kind of 'magic' it is."

lines.content: じゃ、じゃあ、それがあれば、あさひさんに“助けて”って伝えられる？
lines.translated: "T-Then, with this, can we tell Asahi-san to help us?"

lines.content: うん。かもしれない
lines.translated: "Yeah. We might be able to."

lines.content: そんな“魔法”をどうしてハルが持っているんだろう。
lines.translated: Why did Haru have that kind of "magic" on her?

lines.content: あさひさんに任されたというお使いと、どう関係しているのだろうか。そう問いかける俺に、ハルはうなずき、答える。
lines.translated: How was it connected to the errand Asahi-san had entrusted to her? When I asked her that, Haru nodded and answered.

lines.content: ……あさひさんが言うにはね、私の“[想像力|魔法]”は、この“魔法”の[・|元]と相性がいいんだって。だから私が一番よさそうなものを選んで、購入してきてほしいって……
lines.translated: "...According to Asahi-san, my 'magic' -- my imagination -- has good compatibility with the *source* of this 'magic.' So she wanted me to pick out the one that looked best and buy it for her..."

lines.content: えっと……
ハルはうなずき、またひとつポケットから何かを取り出した。それは……。
lines.translated: Haru nodded and pulled something else out of her pocket. It was...

lines.content: ……押し花？
lines.translated: "...A pressed flower?"

lines.content: 小さなちいさな、見たこともない花が、薄く平べったいフィルムに閉じ込められていた。
lines.translated: A tiny, tiny flower, unlike any I had ever seen, was sealed inside a thin, flat film.

lines.content: この携帯電話の“魔法”は、“夜”に咲く花を原動力に動くもの……みたいだよ
lines.translated: "It seems like this cell phone's 'magic'... runs on a flower that blooms in the 'Night' as its power source."

lines.content: フィルムからその花をハルは取り出す。
lines.translated: Haru took the flower out of the film.

lines.content: それをどうするのかと思っていると、
lines.translated: Just as I was wondering what she was going to do with it,

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: ちらちらと、ハルは俺の顔を見ていた。
lines.translated: Haru kept glancing furtively up at my face.

lines.content: どうか、した？
lines.translated: "Is something the matter?"

lines.content: 正直なところ焦れていた。何か打つ手があるのなら早くしてほしい。
lines.translated: To be honest, I was getting impatient. If there was something we could do, I wanted her to hurry and do it.

lines.content: こうして言葉を交わし合っている間にも、時間は刻々と過ぎていっているのだから……。
lines.translated: Because even while we were exchanging words like this, time was ticking away moment by moment...

lines.content: ……え、えっと。この花を、私の“魔法”で咲かせなきゃいけないんだけどね
lines.translated: "...U-Um. I have to make this flower bloom using my 'magic,' you see."

lines.content: もにょもにょとしながらハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru mumbled hesitantly.

lines.content: そのためにはちょっと、ちょっとだけね、恥ずかしいことしないといけなくて……
lines.translated: "And to do that, I have to do something just a little, a little bit embarrassing..."

lines.content: ハルは、きゅっと唇を噛みしめる。そしてふるふると小さな頭を振り、
lines.translated: Haru bit her lip tightly. Then she gave her small head a little shake,

lines.content: う、ううん。ごめんね。そんなこと言ってる場合じゃ、気にしてる場合じゃあ、ないよね
lines.translated: "N-No. I'm sorry. This isn't the time to be saying things like that, or worrying about it, is it?"

lines.content: 言いながらハルは空を見る。ぐるぐるぐるぐる。日はまたのぼり。また、沈む。
lines.translated: As she spoke, Haru looked up at the sky. Round and round and round it went. The sun rose again. And set again.

lines.content: ……わ、私たちが――ま、“魔法”を、使うには
lines.translated: "...F-For us to -- u-use 'magic'..."

lines.content: 目を閉じ、深呼吸。
lines.translated: She closed her eyes and took a deep breath.

lines.content: すると途端、ハルは薄ぼんやりとした光に包まれ……、
lines.translated: Immediately, Haru was enveloped in a faint, hazy light...

lines.content: へ、変身しなきゃ……だめに、なったの
lines.translated: "W-We have to... transform now."

lines.content: ……その光が晴れた中に、なんだかとってもかわいい格好をしたハルがいた。
lines.translated: When the light cleared, Haru was standing there in a really, terribly cute outfit.

lines.content: な
lines.translated: "Wha--"

lines.content: ぽかんとし、
lines.translated: My jaw dropped.

lines.content: なに、それ。……変身？
lines.translated: "What is that? ...Transform?"

lines.content: つい、そう言ってしまった。
lines.translated: The words slipped out before I could stop them.

lines.content: う、うう……っ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: じわりと、涙目。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in her eyes.

lines.content: やっぱりそんな反応だよね。やっぱり、そんなふうに、呆れちゃうよね……っ
lines.translated: "I knew you'd react like that. I knew you'd be exasperated with me...!"

lines.content: 短いスカートの裾をぐいぐい伸ばそうとしながら、ハルは涙目で、言う。
lines.translated: Desperately trying to tug down the hem of her short skirt, Haru spoke with teary eyes.

lines.content: ……“魔法少女”、なんだって
lines.translated: "...Apparently, I'm a 'Magical Girl.'"

lines.content: ……え？　魔法……なに？
lines.translated: "...Huh? Magical... what?"

lines.content: “魔法少女”……だよ
lines.translated: "A 'Magical Girl'..."

lines.content: これから私たちのことをそう呼ぶことにしようって……この前の“満月の夜会”でね、あさひさんが女の子たちだけを部屋に集めて言ったんだよ
lines.translated: "At the last 'Full Moon Soiree,' Asahi-san gathered only the girls in a room and told us... that's what we'd be calling ourselves from now on."

lines.content: 変身って言っても、この服もあさひさんのお手製で……。呼び方も、かわいい服も、全部あさひさんの趣味だって言ってた
lines.translated: "Even though I called it a transformation, Asahi-san handmade these clothes herself... She said both the name and the cute outfits are all just her personal hobby."

lines.content: もじもじとしながら言うハルの声は、だんだんと小さくちいさく萎んでいく。
lines.translated: Fidgeting restlessly, Haru's voice gradually shrank smaller and smaller until it practically withered away.

lines.content: だ、だからね……この格好そのものに意味だったり、特別な力だったりが込められているわけじゃないけど……
lines.translated: "S-So, you see... it's not like this outfit itself holds any special meaning or power..."

lines.content: この場所で、“夜の国”で、私たちが“魔法”を使うなら、必ずこの格好になってしまうようにって……
lines.translated: "It's just that if we use 'magic' here in the 'Country of Night,' we're bound to end up in these outfits no matter what..."

lines.content: あさひさんが[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]、女の子たち一人ひとりの心に誓いというか、“約束”を書き込んだのだという。
lines.translated: Apparently, Asahi-san had written a vow -- or rather, a "promise" -- into each of the girls' hearts *so that it would work that way*.

lines.content: へ、へえ……？
lines.translated: "O-Oh, really...?"

lines.content: 少女の形をした“魔法”、つまり“魔法少女”だ――と、確かに、俺にもあさひさんは言っていた。
lines.translated: "Magic" in the form of a girl -- in other words, a "Magical Girl." Asahi-san had definitely said the exact same thing to me.

lines.content: そんな少女らの力を、“魔法”を、自在に使えるようになる“役割”を、[・|戦][・|争][・|の][・|後][・|に]俺か智仁のどちらかに譲りたい。
lines.translated: And *after the war*, she wanted to hand over the "role" of freely wielding the girls' power -- their "magic" -- to either me or Tomohito.

lines.content: それがあさひさんの目的のひとつだ、ということは聞いていたけれど……。
lines.translated: I had heard that was one of Asahi-san's goals, but...

lines.content: ……まさかここまで、あらかさまだったなんて
lines.translated: "...I never expected it to be this blatant."

lines.content: あ、あからさま……っ
lines.translated: "B-Blatant...!"

lines.content: じわりと涙目になってしまうハルだった。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in Haru's eyes again.

lines.content: うううっ、やっぱり変だよねこんな格好、私、似合わないよね……っ
lines.translated: "Ugh, I knew this outfit was weird! It doesn't suit me at all, does it...!"

lines.content: ハルは更に強くスカートの裾を引っ張っている。
lines.translated: Haru tugged even harder on the hem of her skirt.

lines.content: 今にも破けてしまいそうで、不安だ――みんなの前ではいつも“何でも平気。どんとこい”みたいな笑顔でいる彼女なのに。
lines.translated: I was worried it might tear at any moment -- even though, in front of everyone else, she always wore a smile that said, "Everything's fine! Bring it on!"

lines.content: ……どうしたんだろう。
lines.translated: What was going on with her?

lines.content: 今日は、今夜は、あんまりにもその言動行動が不安定で、弱々しくて……。
lines.translated: Today -- tonight -- everything she said and did was just way too unstable and frail...

lines.content: 俺は、そんな彼女の心にいて想像したからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe it was because I was putting myself in her shoes and imagining how she felt.

lines.content: 尚更に動揺を、そして弱気を隠せなかった。
lines.translated: Either way, it made it even harder to hide my own agitation and weakness.

lines.content: い、いや、ごめん、違うよ……その、つい……口がすべって……ご、ごめん
lines.translated: "N-No, I'm sorry, that's not what I meant... Um, it just... slipped out... I-I'm sorry."

lines.content: 頭を下げる俺に、ハルはぐじぐじと鼻をならしながら、言った。
lines.translated: As I bowed my head, Haru sniffled and spoke.

lines.content: 私たちは、私たち自身が、“夜の魔法使い”のあさひさんが使う“魔法”だから……
lines.translated: "We... we ourselves are the 'magic' used by Asahi-san, the 'Wizard of the Night'..."

lines.content: だから、本来なら、自分勝手に“魔法”を使うことはできないんだけれど
lines.translated: "So normally, we can't just use 'magic' on our own."

lines.content: でも……
小さなちいさな“夜”の花を咲かせるくらいのことなら、許可がなくても、こんな私にでも、きっとできるよ――……なぜなら。
lines.translated: "But if it's just making a tiny, tiny flower of the 'Night' bloom, then even someone like me can surely do it without permission... Because."

lines.content: ……なぜなら私、柊ハルは、そういう属性を持つ“魔法”、だから
lines.translated: "...Because I, Hiiragi Haru, am 'magic' that holds that kind of attribute."

lines.content: そう言い、取り出した小さな花を手の中に包んだ。
lines.translated: Saying that, she cupped the tiny flower she had taken out in her hands.

lines.content: ふと[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: She softly closed her eyelids.

lines.content: そして、ハルは、閉ざされた瞳の奥に望む未来を“想像”している――そんな気配のようなものを、なぜだか俺にも感じることができた。
lines.translated: And behind those closed eyes, Haru was "imagining" the future she wished for -- for some reason, I could sense a presence like that, too.

lines.content: ……これできっと、大丈夫
lines.translated: "...This should do it."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開く。包み込んだ手のひらも、開く。
lines.translated: She opened her eyelids. She opened her cupped palms, too.

lines.content: するとそこには、押し花にされていた花が瑞々しく蘇った姿があった。
lines.translated: Right there lay the pressed flower, revived in fresh, vibrant bloom.

lines.content: 淡い光に包まれた小さな花だ。
lines.translated: A tiny flower wrapped in a faint light.

lines.content: 今度はそれを、携帯端末と一緒に、もう一度、小さなその手の中に包み込むと……、
lines.translated: Next, she cupped it inside her small hands once more, this time together with the mobile device...

lines.content: ……あさひさんから、この“魔法”の使い道だとかをあらかじめ話してもらっていて、よかった
lines.translated: "...I'm glad Asahi-san told me ahead of time how to use this 'magic' and what it was for."

lines.content: ……再び開かれた手の中には、携帯端末がひとつだけ。そして数枚の花びらがハルの手のひらからはらはらと零れた。
lines.translated: When she opened her hands again, only the mobile device remained inside. A few petals fluttered down from Haru's palms.

lines.content: 先ほどまで電源さえ入らなかったはずの[・|そ][・|れ]は、今度は触れてもいないのに、煌々と人工的な蛍光色をディスプレイに灯していた。
lines.translated: *The device*, which hadn't even turned on a moment ago, was now brightly illuminating its display with an artificial fluorescent glow, even though she hadn't touched a button.

lines.content: あ、あの……奏くん
lines.translated: "U-Um... Kanade-kun."

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: お願い……
lines.translated: "Please..."

lines.content: 不安そうに震える眼差しで、ハルは俺を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Haru looked up at me, her gaze trembling with anxiety.

lines.content: わ、私、今の状況を上手に伝えられる自信がないから。全然、ないから……。だから、お願い。奏くんが話してほしいよ
lines.translated: "I-I'm not confident I can explain our current situation well. Not at all... So, please. I want you to talk to them, Kanade-kun."

lines.content: あ、ああ……。わかった
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah... Got it."

lines.content: 躊躇いながらも、俺は端末を受け取った。
lines.translated: Though I hesitated, I took the device from her.

lines.content: やっぱり今夜のハルはいつもと違う。そのことのほうによほど俺は躊躇っていた。
lines.translated: Haru really was different from usual tonight. That fact was making me hesitate far more than anything else.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: （俺は、何を言ってるんだ。ハルは女の子なんだぞ）
lines.translated: (What am I even thinking? Haru is a girl.)

lines.content: こんな得体の知れない状況に追い詰められていれば不安にもなるし、俺と同じように――いいや、もしかしたら俺以上に怖かったりもするはずだ。
lines.translated: Being cornered in a bizarre situation like this would make anyone anxious, and just like me -- no, maybe even more than me -- she had to be terrified.

lines.content: （ここで不安がってる女の子の手を引けなくて、どうする。ヒーローどころか男としても、いいや、いいや……人間としてだって、あんまりに失格すぎるだろう）
lines.translated: (If I can't even take an anxious girl by the hand and lead her right now, what good am I? Never mind being a hero or a man... no, that'd make me a complete failure as a human being.)

lines.content: ふるふると首を振る。
lines.translated: I gave my head a shake.

lines.content: そしてハルから受け取った端末を操作した。
lines.translated: Then I operated the device I had received from Haru.

lines.content: 登録されている番号はひとつきりだった。その番号こそがきっと“ゆめのねどこ”だ。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: There was only a single number registered in it. That number had to be the "Bed of Dreams." It just had to be.

lines.content: 祈るように携帯を耳に押し当てた。
lines.translated: Like I was praying, I pressed the phone to my ear.

lines.content: ぷるるるる、ぷるるるる、と――まどろっこしい呼び出し音が繰り返される。
lines.translated: *Brrrrring, brrrrring* -- the agonizingly slow ringtone repeated over and over.

lines.content: まだたった数回ほどだ。
lines.translated: It had only rung a few times so far.

lines.content: それなのに、それは何分も何十分も、長い、長い時間であるように思え、焦る。
lines.translated: And yet, it felt like minutes, tens of minutes -- a long, endless stretch of time -- making me grow impatient.

lines.content: ……頼む、誰か出てくれっ
lines.translated: "...Please, someone pick up!"

lines.content: ぎゅっと端末を握りしめ……祈る。
lines.translated: I squeezed the device tightly... and prayed.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: こんな祈りが届くはずもない。
lines.translated: There was no way a prayer like this could reach them.

lines.content: ここは未来だ――いいや、どこかの遠い未来へと駆け抜けていく刻の中である。
lines.translated: This was the future -- no, we were inside a stream of time hurtling toward some distant future.

lines.content: それでも祈らざるを得ない。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't help but pray.

lines.content: そんな幼いばかりの無力な俺をあざ笑うように、呼び出し音ばかりが繰り返され……止まない。
lines.translated: As if mocking how childish and powerless I was, the ringtone just kept repeating... never stopping.

lines.content: ……もう
lines.translated: "...Geez."

lines.content: だめか、と思った。
lines.translated: *It's no use,* I thought.

lines.content: 空を……。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky...

lines.content: 高速で過ぎゆく月と太陽を。その光景を見上げ、なあ、ヒーロー、と心でつぶやく。
lines.translated: At the moon and the sun streaking past at high speed. Looking up at that sight, I murmured in my heart: *Hey, hero.*

lines.content: もしも[・|あ][・|ん][・|た]がここにいてくれたなら、この窮地をどういうふうに乗り越えてみせたのだろう。
lines.translated: If *you* were here right now, how would you have pulled through a predicament like this?
*And what would you have done at a time like this?*

lines.content: たくさんの人たちの顔が、走馬燈のように脳裏を過ぎる――
lines.translated: The faces of so many people flashed through my mind like a lantern of memories --

lines.content: ――突然だった。
lines.translated: -- It happened suddenly.

lines.content: ぶつりと、呼び出し音が止んだのだ。
lines.translated: With a click, the ringing stopped.

lines.content: も、もしもし……っ？
lines.translated: "H-Hello...?!"

lines.content: 食いつくように呼びかけた。
lines.translated: I called out desperately, latching onto the connection.

lines.content: 誰か……っ、聞こえてますかっ
lines.translated: "Anyone...?! Can you hear me?!"

lines.content: 誰かの声がする。しかしノイズがひどくて聞き取れない。
lines.translated: I heard someone's voice. However, the static was so terrible I couldn't make it out.

lines.content: お願いしますっ、よく、聞こえなくて……、もう少し大きな声で……っ
lines.translated: "Please! I can't hear you very well... Speak a little louder...!"

lines.content: じりじりというノイズの向こうに、聞き慣れた声を見つけた。
lines.translated: Beyond the crackling static, I found a familiar voice.

lines.content: ……大雅、なの？
lines.translated: "...Taiga, is that you?"

lines.content: 電話の相手もこちらの声を見つけられたのだろう。
lines.translated: The person on the other end must have recognized my voice, too.

lines.content: ……どうして、大雅がこの電話に？
lines.translated: "...Why are you calling this phone, Taiga?"

lines.content: もしかして……クロ？
lines.translated: "Could that be... Kuro?"

lines.content: ……うん。わたし
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It's me."

lines.content: どうしてクロが、この電話に……
lines.translated: "Why are you answering this phone, Kuro...?"
Wait.

lines.content: つい、焦りのあまりクロのせりふをオウム返しするみたいして、問いかけてしまっていた。
lines.translated: In my haste, I ended up parroting Kuro's words right back at her as a question.

lines.content: そんな俺に、クロは答えてくれる。
lines.translated: And to that, Kuro answered me.

lines.content: 今、みんなお出かけしてて、誰もいない
lines.translated: "Everyone's out right now, so nobody's here."

lines.content: 誰も……？
lines.translated: "Nobody...?"

lines.content: そう、誰も。わたしひとり
lines.translated: "Right, nobody. Just me by myself."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: それはつまり、あさひさんもそこにはいないということなのか。
lines.translated: Did that mean Asahi-san wasn't there, either?

lines.content: 瞬く間に絶望を間近に感じてしまうけれど……。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, I felt despair looming right in front of me, but...

lines.content: ……もしも
lines.translated: "...What if--"
I could hear Kuro's voice right by my ear. *That alone was enough to make me breathe a sigh of relief.*

lines.content: もしも、この電話が鳴るようなことがあったなら……わたしが出るようにって、あさひから言われてて
lines.translated: "Asahi told me that if this phone happened to ring... I should answer it."

lines.content: ……でも、ほんとは、電話に出るつもりはなかった
lines.translated: "...Wait, actually, I wasn't planning on answering the phone."

lines.content: だってわたし、電話なんかでまともに話せる自信、なかったし
lines.translated: "Because I wasn't confident I could talk properly on a phone..."

lines.content: もにょもにょとした声が耳元をくすぐる。
lines.translated: Her mumbly voice tickled my ear.

lines.content: だけど……。だけどなんだか嫌な予感、みたいなものがあって……
lines.translated: "But... I kind of had a bad feeling, or something like that..."

lines.content: だからジリジリと鳴る電話の前で、散々悩んだ挙げ句、恐る恐る、受話器を取ってみたのだという。
lines.translated: So after agonizing over it in front of the ringing phone, she had timidly picked up the receiver.

lines.content: ……電話なんて、はじめてだったから……緊張した
lines.translated: "...It was my first time using a phone... so I was nervous."

lines.content: お腹がきりきりして、今朝大雅と一緒に食べたチョコレート、全部吐いちゃうかと思った
lines.translated: "My stomach was twisting in knots, and I thought I was gonna throw up all the chocolate I ate with you this morning, Taiga."

lines.content: 女の子が吐いちゃうとか言っちゃだめだよ。もっと、えっと……恥じらい？　とか、そんなのを大切にしたほうがいいって思うよ。クロ
lines.translated: "A girl shouldn't be talking about throwing up. I think you should value, um... modesty? Or stuff like that a little more, Kuro."

lines.content: 急いでいるのに間延びした会話だ。何をしてるんだ俺は、とは思うものの……。
lines.translated: Despite the urgency, our conversation was dragging out at a leisurely pace. *What am I doing?* I thought to myself, and yet...

lines.content: うん……。だけど、電話の相手が大雅でよかった。大雅となら、ほら、こうしてふつうに、ちゃんと話せる
lines.translated: "Yeah... Still, I'm glad it was you on the phone, Taiga. Since it's you, see, I can talk normally like this."

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: ……時間がない中ではあるけれど、君と話せて良かった。そう思う。
lines.translated: We were running out of time, but I was glad I got to talk to her. I really felt that way.

lines.content: クロとこうして話していると、少しずつ冷静さが戻ってくる。そんな感覚があった。
lines.translated: Talking to Kuro like this, I could feel my composure returning bit by bit.

lines.content: ごめん、クロ。……ありがとう。こんな状況じゃなければ、言いたいことも聞きたいことも色々あったけど……
lines.translated: "Sorry, Kuro. ...Thank you. If we weren't in this situation, there's a lot I'd want to say and ask, but..."

lines.content: 俺は、今の状況を早口でクロに伝えた。
lines.translated: Speaking rapidly, I explained our current situation to Kuro.

lines.content: 何か方法はないだろうか。何か、俺たちを助けてくれるような方法は、道具は、“魔法”は、そこに……“ゆめのねどこ”にないだろうか。
lines.translated: Was there any way out of this? Was there any method, tool, or "magic" that could save us there... in the "Bed of Dreams"?

lines.content: 一縷の望みを掛け、俺はクロへたたみかけるようにして問いかけた。
lines.translated: Clinging to a sliver of hope, I pressed Kuro with one question after another.

lines.content: するとクロは、黙ってしまう。
lines.translated: At that, Kuro fell silent.

lines.content: 一秒。二秒。あるいは三秒。その沈黙はそれほど短いものであったはず。
lines.translated: One second. Two seconds. Or maybe three. That silence couldn't have lasted much longer than that.

lines.content: しかしその間にも過ぎ去る“夜”の早さは止まらない。
lines.translated: Yet even during that brief pause, the speed of the passing "Nights" never slowed down.

lines.content: もう何百年も先へと飛ばされてしまっていたとしても不思議ではない――それほど多くの太陽と月とを見ていた。
lines.translated: I wouldn't have been surprised if we'd already been flung hundreds of years into the future--that was how many suns and moons we had watched fly by.

lines.content: ……ない
lines.translated: "...There isn't."

lines.content: ぽつりと、小さな針先のような声が、沈黙の中に落とされた。
lines.translated: A tiny, pinprick of a voice dropped quietly into the silence.

lines.content: ……ごめん大雅
lines.translated: "...Sorry, Taiga."

lines.content: ……何もない
lines.translated: "...There's nothing."

lines.content: きみたちを助けられるような方法も、道具も、“魔法”も、[・|こ][・|こ]にはないよ
lines.translated: "There's no method, or tool, or 'magic' that can save you guys *here*."

lines.content: 端末を握りしめた。
lines.translated: I gripped the phone tightly.

lines.content: とてもじゃないが後ろのハルを振り向けない。
lines.translated: There was no way I could bring myself to turn around and look at Haru behind me.

lines.content: 思わず何かしらの感情が、強く結んだ唇をこじ開け、外へと飛び出さんばかりだったけれど……。
lines.translated: Some kind of raw emotion nearly pried open my tightly pressed lips and burst out, but...

lines.content: ……でも、大丈夫
lines.translated: "...Even so, it'll be okay."

lines.content: 大丈夫……？
lines.translated: Okay...?

lines.content: ……ごめんね。わたし、おばかだから。あまり上手に説明できない。だけど、なんとかなるよ。きっと
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I'm kind of dumb, so I can't explain it very well. Still, things will work out. I'm sure of it."

lines.content: なんとかって……
lines.translated: "What do you mean, work out...?"

lines.content: 今の大雅を助けられる方法は、道具は、“魔法”は……ここには、“ゆめのねどこ”にはないだろうけれど
lines.translated: "The method, the tool, the 'Magic' to save you right now... probably isn't here in the 'Bed of Dreams,' though."

lines.content: でも、という君の声。
lines.translated: "Even so," your voice began.

lines.content: そこに少しのノイズが走り、
lines.translated: A burst of static ran through the line,

lines.content: ……でも、わたしの中には、[・|そ][・|れ]はあるんだよ
lines.translated: "...But it IS inside of me."

lines.content: 君の声がじりじりと割れていた。
lines.translated: crackling and breaking up your voice.

lines.content: ……だから、大雅。きみに降りかかる大変なことは、これからも全部わたしが――
lines.translated: "...So, Taiga. All the terrible things that happen to you from now on, I will take them all--"

lines.content: だめだ。よく、聞こえない。
lines.translated: No good. I couldn't hear her very well.

lines.content: だからもう一度言ってほしい。そう願う俺の声も、やはりノイズに飲まれ、君へと届かなかったのか……。
lines.translated: So I begged her to say it one more time. Did the static swallow up my voice too, keeping it from reaching you...?

lines.content: ……大雅。電話を切って
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Hang up the phone."

lines.content: ……静かに囁く君の声だけがする。今度はノイズもなくクリアに聞こえた。
lines.translated: All I could hear was the quiet whisper of your voice. This time, it came through clearly without any static.

lines.content: ……この電話をきみが切る。それを、合図にしよう。そうすれば、全部元通りになるはずだから
lines.translated: "...You hanging up this phone. Let's make that the signal. If we do that, everything should go back to the way it was."

lines.content: で、でも……
lines.translated: "B-But..."

lines.content: なんだろう。嫌な予感がしていた。
lines.translated: What was this? I had a bad feeling about it.

lines.content: この電話を切ってはいけない。わけもなくそんな気がしてならないけれど……。
lines.translated: I mustn't hang up this phone. For no particular reason, I couldn't shake that feeling, and yet...

lines.content: 奏くん、誰と話してるの？　あさひさんじゃない……？
lines.translated: "Kanade-kun, who are you talking to? Is it not Asahi-san...?"

lines.content: 背後からハルの不安そうな声がする――だめだ。躊躇っている余裕はない。ノイズがどんどん濃くなっていくのだ。
lines.translated: Haru's anxious voice came from behind me--no good. I couldn't afford to hesitate. The static was growing thicker by the second.

lines.content: クロは早くと言う――このままわたしの声が俺に届かなくなったら、それほどまで遠くに俺たちが飛ばされてしまったら、わたしにも大雅たちを助けられなくなるから、と。
lines.translated: Kuro told me to hurry--saying that if her voice stopped reaching me like this, if we were flung that far away, then she wouldn't be able to save us anymore either.

lines.content: ……クロ。電話、切るから
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I'm going to hang up the phone."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: その前に、ひとつだけ約束をしてほしいとクロは言う。
lines.translated: Before that happened, Kuro asked me to make just one promise.

lines.content: ……ハルとしっかり手を繋いでて。電話を切る前に
lines.translated: "...Hold Haru's hand tightly. Before you hang up."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 言われたとおり、ハルとしっかり手を繋ぐ。
lines.translated: Just as she told me to, I took Haru's hand and held it tight.

lines.content: いい？　大雅。もうひとつだけ、約束
lines.translated: "Okay, Taiga? And just one more promise."

lines.content: これからどんなことが起きたとしても、絶対、ハルのその手を離しちゃだめだよ――“ゆめのねどこ”に帰るまでは、絶対に
lines.translated: "No matter what happens from here on out, you must never, ever let go of Haru's hand--not until you make it back to the 'Bed of Dreams,' no matter what."

lines.content: ……大雅？
lines.translated: "...Taiga?"

lines.content: ……クロ、また、会えるよね？
lines.translated: "...Kuro, we'll see each other again, right?"

lines.content: どうしても、どうしてもだ。そう問いかけずにはいられなかった俺に、
lines.translated: No matter what, I just couldn't help asking her one last time. And to me,

lines.content: うん。大丈夫。また、会える。約束するよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's okay. We'll see each other again. I promise."

lines.content: クロは力強くそう答えてくれた。
lines.translated: Kuro gave a firm, powerful answer.

lines.content: だから俺も……、
lines.translated: So I...

lines.content: ……わかった
lines.translated: "...Okay."

lines.content: 俺も、うなずく――今はこれ以上時間はないのだ。クロの声がどんどんと遠ざかっていく。クロの声が届かなくなるとそこで終わり。
lines.translated: I nodded, too--there was no time left now. Kuro's voice was growing fainter and fainter. Once her voice stopped reaching me, it would all be over.

lines.content: クロにも俺たちを助けられなくなる。
lines.translated: Even Kuro wouldn't be able to save us anymore.

lines.content: クロがそう言うから……だから、君を信じる。君の言うことを全部信じる。
lines.translated: Because Kuro said so... I believed in you. I believed everything you said.

lines.content: 俺は携帯のスイッチを、オフにした――……途端。
lines.translated: I switched off my phone--...and that very instant.

lines.content: ふっと、辺りが真っ暗になった。
lines.translated: Suddenly, everything around us went pitch-black.

lines.content: “夜”だとか夜だとかはまったく関係ない。
lines.translated: It had nothing at all to do with the "Night" or normal nights.

lines.content: 何もないのだ。
lines.translated: There was simply nothing.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じたように何も……何も見えない。本当の暗闇だった。
lines.translated: Just like closing my eyelids, I couldn't see... anything at all. It was true darkness.

lines.content: ハルがぎゅっと俺の手を握りしめる。そんな気配だけは伝わってきた。
lines.translated: Haru squeezed my hand tightly. That was the only sensation I could feel.

lines.content: クロは絶対にこの手を離してはいけないと言っていた――強く、握り返す。その手は震えていた。
lines.translated: Kuro had told me I must never let go of this hand--so I squeezed back hard. Her hand was trembling.

lines.content: 勇気づけるための言葉を探した。
lines.translated: I searched for the words to encourage her.

lines.content: 北も南もわからない。上下左右さえも不明瞭。
lines.translated: I couldn't tell north from south. Even up, down, left, and right were unclear.

lines.content: そんな暗闇の中にふたりっきり取り残されて……それでも。
lines.translated: Left behind all alone together in this pitch darkness... and yet.

lines.content: ……大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm okay."

lines.content: ……それでもそうだと言い切れる。
lines.translated: Even so, I could say it with certainty.

lines.content: 大丈夫だって、クロは言ってた。さっきの電話で。だからきっとこれで大丈夫なことなんだ。何も問題はないんだよ。絶対
lines.translated: "Kuro said it'll be okay. Just now on the phone. So I'm sure everything's going to be fine like this. There's nothing to worry about. Definitely."

lines.content: 行こう、とハルの手を引き踏み出そうとする。
lines.translated: Saying "Let's go," I gently pulled Haru's hand and tried to take a step forward.

lines.content: や、闇雲に歩いても平気なのかな。何も、何にも見えないのに……
lines.translated: "I-Is it really okay to just walk around blindly? Even though we can't see... anything at all..."

lines.content: ああ。確かに不安なのはわかるけど……このままじっとしてるわけにもいかないし
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know it's scary, for sure... but we can't just stand still like this, either."

lines.content: 互いの姿も見えない中で、手探りみたいに会話する。
lines.translated: Unable to even see each other, we talked as if feeling our way through the dark.

lines.content: せめて、小さくてもいいので灯りの代わりになるものはないだろうか。ポケットを探る。さっきの携帯端末のことを思い出した。それを取り出そうとしたところで、
lines.translated: Wasn't there anything we could use as a makeshift light, even a tiny one? I fished around in my pocket. Then I remembered the phone from earlier. Just as I was about to pull it out,

lines.content: ……あ、あれ見て、奏くん
lines.translated: "...Ah, look at that, Kanade-kun."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 声のした方を振り向く。
lines.translated: I turned toward the direction of her voice.

lines.content: するとそこに小さな光がぽっと灯っていた。
lines.translated: Right there, a tiny light had softly blinked on.

lines.content: 淡い光だ。
lines.translated: It was a faint glow.

lines.content: だけど周りがあんまりにも真っ暗なので、その光だけでも充分だった。隣にいてくれるハルの顔も、おかげで薄ぼんやりとだが確認することができるようになっていた。
lines.translated: However, because our surroundings were so completely pitch-black, even that tiny light was enough. Thanks to it, I could dimly make out Haru's face right beside me.

lines.content: あれって……、なんだろう。猫の足跡？
lines.translated: "What is... that, I wonder? A cat's paw print?"

lines.content: ハルが首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head.

lines.content: するとその小さな光は、とてとて、とてとて。
lines.translated: Then, with a little pitter-patter, pitter-patter, the tiny light began to move.

lines.content: まるで見えない子猫が歩いて行くみたいにして、暗闇の中に、光の足跡を真っ直ぐに伸ばしていった。
lines.translated: As if an invisible kitten were walking along, a trail of glowing paw prints stretched straight ahead into the darkness.

lines.content: 俺たちはその後に付いていく。
lines.translated: We followed right behind it.

lines.content: 真っ暗闇の中、おっかなびっくり俺たちは進む。
lines.translated: Timidly, we made our way through the pitch-black dark.

lines.content: 光の足跡は、俺たちが少し遅れてしまうと、その度にこちらを振り返るみたいにして、止まる。
lines.translated: Whenever we fell a little behind, the glowing paw prints would stop, almost as if looking back at us.

lines.content: 俺たちが追いつくと、またとてとてと進んでいった。
lines.translated: And once we caught up, they would pitter-patter forward again.

lines.content: どれだけそうして歩いただろう。
lines.translated: How long had we walked like that, I wondered?

lines.content: （……そういえば、こうしてハルとふたりきりになるのはこれがはじめてなのか）
lines.translated: (...Come to think of it, is this the first time Haru and I have been alone together like this?)

lines.content: そんなことをふと考える余裕が産まれていた。
lines.translated: I'd calmed down enough for a thought like that to cross my mind.

lines.content: ……あ、あの。奏くん
lines.translated: "...U-Um, Kanade-kun."

lines.content: ん？　なに？
lines.translated: "Hm? What is it?"

lines.content: 今日のこと……。お願い。みんなには秘密にしていてくれたら、うれしいなあって
lines.translated: "About today... Please. I'd be really happy if you kept it a secret from everyone."

lines.content: ……今日のこと？
lines.translated: "...About today?"

lines.content: う、うん。私が泣いちゃいそうになってたこととか……色々
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Like how I almost started crying... and stuff."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: ふと、俺は今夜の柊ハルに対して覚えた違和感を思い出す。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I remembered how out of place Hiiragi Haru had seemed to me tonight.

lines.content: 確かに意外だった、かもしれない。ハル。君はいつも、みんなの前では元気いっぱいって感じな子だから……
lines.translated: "It was definitely a little surprising, maybe. Haru, you always seem so full of energy in front of everyone..."

lines.content: 俺たちはまだそれほど仲の良い間柄というわけではない。
lines.translated: We weren't really all that close yet.

lines.content: だからこの柊ハルという女の子が、いったいどういう心根の持ち主であるのかを、談ずることができるほど、俺はこの子のことを知らないのだ。
lines.translated: So I didn't know this girl named Hiiragi Haru well enough to talk about what kind of person she truly was deep down.

lines.content: だけどこの子は、柊ハルは、いつも集団を率先して問題に取り組もうとするような、そんな明るく元気な子なのだというイメージを持っていた。
lines.translated: Still, the impression I had of her, of Hiiragi Haru, was that of a bright, cheerful girl who always took the lead in our group when tackling a problem.

lines.content: だが、今夜のハルはそういう印象とは真逆と言って良いかもしれない。おどおどと不安そう。ぐずぐずと、涙目だ。
lines.translated: Yet tonight, you could say Haru was the exact opposite of that impression. Timid and anxious. Sniffling and teary-eyed.

lines.content: ……いつも誰かと話すときはどきどき胸が痛くなるの。ほんとは私、とっても緊張しやすくて……知らない人とは目を見て話もできない
lines.translated: "...Whenever I talk to someone, my heart always pounds so hard it hurts. The truth is, I get nervous really easily... I can't even look strangers in the eye when I talk to them."

lines.content: だけど、そんな弱気な自分を知られたられないようにって。いつも、みんなの前では元気いっぱいでいられるようにって、がんばってて
lines.translated: "Still, I didn't want anyone to find out how timid I really am. So I've always tried my hardest to act super energetic in front of everyone."

lines.content: で、でも、どうしてかな。今夜の奏くんの前だと……ううん。こうしてふたりっきりになると、素が出ちゃって……
lines.translated: "B-But, I wonder why. In front of you tonight, Kanade-kun... no, now that we're alone together like this, my true self just came out..."

lines.content: わかった。君が秘密にしてほしいって言うのなら秘密にするよ
lines.translated: "Got it. If you want me to keep it a secret, then my lips are sealed."

lines.content: 真っ暗闇の中、小さなふたりで小さな約束をした。
lines.translated: In the pitch-black darkness, the two small children made a small promise.

lines.content: ねえ、奏くん
lines.translated: "Hey, Kanade-kun."

lines.content: ああ、なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah, what is it?"

lines.content: ……これから私も、奏くんのこと、大雅くんって下の名前で呼んでも……いいかな？
lines.translated: "...From now on, would it be okay if I... called you by your first name, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 下の……？
lines.translated: "My first name...?"

lines.content: う、うん。奏くんも私のことハルって呼んでくれるし……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Since you call me Haru, too..."

lines.content: も、もしもよければなんだけど……。どうかな？
lines.translated: "I-If you don't mind, that is... What do you think?"

lines.content: うーん……
私たち、ただ“夜の王”を倒すために、あさひさんに“ゆめのねどこ”に集められただけだけど……
lines.translated: "We were only gathered in the 'Bed of Dreams' by Asahi-san to defeat the 'King of the Night,' after all..."

lines.content: でも、お友だちにはなっちゃいけないってことはないし……。だ、だから……そのう……
lines.translated: "Still, it's not like there's a rule saying we can't become friends... S-So... um..."

lines.content: なるほど。友だち、か
lines.translated: "I see. Friends, huh."

lines.content: ハルの心境を想像してみるけれど……。
lines.translated: I tried to imagine how Haru was feeling, though...

lines.content: そんなのは吊り橋効果とかと酷似した何かだ。
lines.translated: Something like this was probably really similar to the suspension bridge effect.

lines.content: ふたりでこうして危険なことに遭遇している。そういった空気を共有しているからこそ……今だけだ。今だけそんなふうに感じるに過ぎないだろうと、思うから。
lines.translated: The two of us were facing a dangerous situation together like this. It was only because we were sharing this tense atmosphere... that she felt this way right now. It was probably just a temporary feeling in the heat of the moment.

lines.content: こんなことを考える自分はいやな子どもだなと、我ながら思うから。
lines.translated: Even I thought to myself what an unpleasant kid I was for thinking things like that.

lines.content: ……ああ。うん。わかった。全然いいよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Sure, I got it. I don't mind at all."

lines.content: だから俺は、気軽にそう答えられる。
lines.translated: That was why I could answer her so casually.

lines.content: 別に今夜が過ぎて、これまでのような距離感の“関係性”に戻ったとしても、特に何を思い煩うことはない。
lines.translated: Even if tonight passed and our "relationship" went right back to the distant one we'd had before, it wouldn't really bother me at all.
Wait.

lines.content: そう思っていたけれど。
lines.translated: That was what I thought, anyway.

lines.content: だけどここから、ことあるごとにハルの相談につきあったり……。
lines.translated: And yet, from this point on, I'd end up listening to Haru's troubles whenever something came up...

lines.content: 本当は弱気だったり内気だったり、そういったハルの心の内を心配したり……。
lines.translated: And worrying about how she was actually timid and shy deep down...

lines.content: そんな関係になろうだとは、このときは予想さえできていなかった。
lines.translated: At the time, I never could have imagined we'd end up with a relationship like that.

lines.content: とてとてと足跡は続いていく。
lines.translated: The footprints pattered along ahead of us.

lines.content: その後をいつまでも追いかけていくあの頃の俺たちだ。
lines.translated: Back then, the two of us just kept chasing after them endlessly.

lines.content: ……た、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...T-Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ああ、なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah, what is it?"

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: 何かあった？
lines.translated: "What's up?"

lines.content: う、ううん。ちょっと呼んでみただけ
lines.translated: "N-Nothing. I just wanted to try saying it."

lines.content: へにゃりと笑う。
lines.translated: She gave a bashful little smile.

lines.content: こんなときだというのに。少々呆れもするけれど、
lines.translated: Even at a time like this. I was a little exasperated, though...

lines.content: ご、ごめんね。私、お友だちとかひとりもいなかったから……。だ、だからね、ちょっとうれしくって
lines.translated: "S-Sorry. I've never had a single friend before... S-So, you know, it just made me a little happy."

lines.content: そんなふうに言われてしまうと、もうこれ以上こちらは何も言えない――またしばらくふたりで歩いた。
lines.translated: When she put it like that, there wasn't really anything more I could say--so the two of us just walked on together for a while longer.

lines.content: 暗闇の中、これまで不足気味だった自己紹介じみた会話を、俺たちは重ねていった。
lines.translated: In the darkness, we traded the kind of introductory small talk we hadn't really had the chance to share until now.

lines.content: あ、見て。足跡が……
lines.translated: "Ah, look. The footprints..."

lines.content: ハルが指さす。それまでとてとて進んでいた光の足跡が、ほんの数メートル先の闇の中、進むのを止めていた。
lines.translated: Haru pointed ahead. The glowing footprints that had been pattering along in front of us had come to a stop in the darkness just a few meters away.

lines.content: そこまで俺たちが辿り着いたところで、ふと、足跡が消える。
lines.translated: The moment we caught up to that spot, the footprints suddenly vanished.

lines.content: また、辺りは暗闇に包まれる。
lines.translated: Once again, the area around us was swallowed up by darkness.

lines.content: そしてぎゅっと、俺たちは互いの握る手に力を込めた――……息を呑む。[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。クロ。クロ。俺は何度も心で君の名前を呼んでいた。
lines.translated: We squeezed each other's hands tightly--...and held our breath. I closed my eyelids. Kuro. Kuro. Over and over in my heart, I called out your name.

lines.content: すると……、
lines.translated: And...

lines.content: ちりんちりんと、
lines.translated: Jingling softly,

lines.content: どこかから鈴の音が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: the sound of a bell drifted over from somewhere.

lines.content: ……クロ？
lines.translated: "...Kuro?"

lines.content: 恐る恐る、[まぶた|瞼]を開くと……。
lines.translated: Timidly, I opened my eyelids...

lines.content: 同時だ。
lines.translated: At the exact same moment.

lines.content: パッと、新しい光が灯った。
lines.translated: A new light flickered on.

lines.content: それは柔らかい玄関先の光だ。扉が目の前に現れたのだ。“ゆめのねどこ”の玄関だと、わかる。
lines.translated: It was the soft glow of a front porch. A door had appeared right before our eyes. I could tell right away that it was the entrance to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 磨りガラスから暖かな灯りが煌々と漏れ出している。
lines.translated: Warm light spilled brightly through the frosted glass.

lines.content: ……ああ、よかった
lines.translated: "...Oh, thank goodness."

lines.content: その扉は、俺たちが手をかけるよりも早くがらりと開いた。
lines.translated: Before we could even reach for the handle, the door rattled open.

lines.content: おかえりふたりとも。一時はどうなることかと思ったよ
lines.translated: "Welcome back, you two. For a while there, I didn't know what was going to happen."

lines.content: あさひさんが俺たちを迎えてくれた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san welcomed us back inside.

lines.content: あの、あさひさん。今は、何年何月何日ですか？
lines.translated: "Um, Asahi-san. What year, month, and day is it right now?"

lines.content: まさか自分の人生でこんなことをひとに聞くことがあろうとは思ってもみなかった。
lines.translated: I never thought the day would come in my life when I'd have to ask someone a question like that.

lines.content: そんな俺にあさひさんは答えてくれる――俺たちが帰り着いた今は、いったい何年の何月で、何日であるのかを。
lines.translated: Even so, Asahi-san gave me an answer--telling me the exact year, month, and day of the present we had returned to.

lines.content: よかった……。戻ってこれた
lines.translated: "Thank goodness... We made it back."

lines.content: 教えられた月日に俺は安堵し、その場にへたり込んでしまうけれど……。
lines.translated: Relieved by the date she gave me, I slumped to the floor right then and there, though...

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: ハッとする。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I gasped.

lines.content: あ、あさひさん。クロはいますか？
lines.translated: "A-Asahi-san. Is Kuro here?"

lines.content: あたりを見回す。
lines.translated: I looked around the area.

lines.content: 俺たち、たぶんクロに助けてもらって……、クロのおかげで、ここまで帰って来れたんだと思うんです。だから、すぐクロにお礼を……
lines.translated: "I think Kuro saved us... Thanks to her, we were able to make it all the way back here. So I want to thank her right away..."

lines.content: ああ。うん。事情はあの子から直接聞いてるよ。だけど……
lines.translated: "Ah. Yeah. I heard about what happened directly from her. Only..."

lines.content: あさひさんは気まずそうに目を逸らし、
lines.translated: Asahi-san averted her gaze awkwardly,

lines.content: あの子は、クロは、君の友人は……少し旅に出ると言っていたよ
lines.translated: "That girl... Kuro, your friend... she said she was going away on a little journey."
"Huh...? A journey?"

lines.content: うん……。でも、心配するな、すぐ戻ってくるから、ってあの子は言ってた。あの子から君への伝言だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... Still, she told me to tell you not to worry, because she'll be right back. That's her message for you."

lines.content: 心がぞわりとした。
lines.translated: An uneasy chill ran through my heart.

lines.content: クロ。ちゃんとまた会えるって言ってたのに。約束、したのに。
lines.translated: Kuro. Even though you said we'd definitely meet again. Even though we promised.

lines.content: 俺は、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood back up.

lines.content: また玄関から外へ飛び出そうとした。クロを探さなければ。連れ戻さなければ。
lines.translated: I was about to bolt right back out the front door. I had to find Kuro. I had to bring her back.

lines.content: そう思ってのことだったけれど……、
lines.translated: That was what drove me to move, yet...

lines.content: ……しかし俺のその足は停止する。
lines.translated: Even so, my feet came to a dead stop.

lines.content: それは何者かに、たとえばあさひさんに“やめろバカ”と襟をひっ捕まえられたわけでもないし、ハルに“お願いだから落ち着いて”とたしなめられたわけでも、ない。
lines.translated: It wasn't because someone--like Asahi-san--had grabbed me by the collar and snapped, "Stop it, you idiot," nor was it because Haru had chided me with a, "Please, just calm down."

lines.content: ふたりも……おかえりなさい
lines.translated: "Welcome back... both of you."

lines.content: そこにいるはずのない人物が、変わらぬ顔でそこにいて、
lines.translated: Someone who shouldn't have been there was standing right in front of me with the same expression as always,

lines.content: 無事でいてくれて、よかった
lines.translated: "I'm so glad you're safe."

lines.content: 今にも駆け出そうとしていた俺へと、手を差し伸べていたのだ……。
lines.translated: reaching a hand out to me just as I was about to go rushing out the door...

lines.content: 俺は唖然とし、そのひとを見る。
lines.translated: Dumbfounded, I stared at her.

lines.content: あ、あなたは……
lines.translated: "Y-You're..."

lines.content: ……あず咲さんが俺へと差し出す手。
lines.translated: The hand Azusaki-san was holding out to me.

lines.content: あなたは……いったい、誰ですか？
lines.translated: "Who... Who in the world are you?"

lines.content: 思わずだ。思わずそう問いかけずには、いられなかった。
lines.translated: It slipped out before I could stop myself. I couldn't help asking her that.

lines.content: 差し出されたその手は……いいや。
lines.translated: Because that outstretched hand... no.

lines.content: その身体は。
lines.translated: Her entire body.
No matter how I looked at it, no matter how many times I blinked and looked again--it was semi-transparent, and I could see right through her.

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。そうか。いつかこうなるんじゃないかと思ってたんだ
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. I see. Part of me always thought it might turn out like this someday."

lines.content: そう言い苦笑いを浮かべていたのは、幼い頃のあいつだった。兎蛙智仁。あず咲さんの弟だ。
lines.translated: The one saying that with a bitter smile was a young boy. Usaga Tomohito. Azusaki-san's younger brother.

lines.content: どんなに俺がない知恵絞って足掻こうと、何度だって無力な自分を思い知らされるばっかりで……。[・|未][・|来][・|は]、[・|ま][・|る][・|で][・|変][・|わ][・|ら][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た]。だからここへ、“ゆめのねどこへ”来たけれど……
lines.translated: "No matter how hard I racked my brains and struggled, all it ever did was remind me over and over again just how powerless I am... The future didn't change at all. That's why I came here, to the 'Bed of Dreams,' and yet..."

lines.content: ああ、そうか。と、ため息と共に智仁は言う。
lines.translated: "Ah, I get it now," Tomohito said with a sigh.

lines.content: ここへこうして、俺が姉ちゃんを連れて来ることが、何もかもの始まりだったってことなのかな。本当に、間抜けだ
lines.translated: "Me bringing my sister here like this was the start of it all, wasn't it? Man, what an idiot I am."

lines.content: ……助けたいと願ってたはずの人を、率先して危険な場所に連れて来るだなんて
lines.translated: "...To think I'd take the initiative and lead the very person I wanted to save straight into a dangerous place."

lines.content: 疲れたような乾いた笑みで、あいつは言った。
lines.translated: With a tired, dry smile, he spoke.

lines.content: ……これじゃ連中の思うつぼじゃあないか
lines.translated: "...Doesn't this mean I played right into their hands?"

lines.content: 俺は、[・|そ][・|の][・|原][・|因]を作ってしまったのだろうこの俺は、何も言葉を掛けられず……。ただ智仁の言葉を聞いている。
lines.translated: As the one who had likely caused all of this, I couldn't find a single word to say to him... All I could do was listen to Tomohito speak.

lines.content: 俺の産まれた家の連中は頭のおかしい奴らばっかりなんだよ。不死がどうだの[・|月]だの[・|未][・|来]だの。夢だの希望だの。そんなことをいい大人がくそまじめにいつも話してる
lines.translated: "The people in the family I was born into are all completely out of their minds. Going on and on about immortality, the moon, the future. Dreams and hope. Grown adults, talking about that stuff dead seriously all the time."

lines.content: 俺には、大人たちが何をしようとしてるのかなんてまったくわからないけれど……。頭どころか、心さえどうかしちゃってるような奴らがさ、言ってたんだよ
lines.translated: "I have no idea what the adults are trying to do... Still, those people, whose hearts are just as messed up as their heads, used to say something."

lines.content: 大雅。お前には、この前言ったと思うが……俺の姉ちゃんは、[・|い][・|つ][・|か][・|遠][・|い][・|未][・|来]でこの不思議の国を……、“夜の国”を作り出すために産まれた[女の子|少女]なんだって
lines.translated: "Taiga. I think I told you this the other day, too... They said my sister is a girl born to create this wonderland--this 'Country of the Night'--in some distant future."

lines.content: まったくバカみたいな話だろと智仁は肩を竦める。
lines.translated: "Sounds like a total load of crap, right?" Tomohito said with a shrug.

lines.content: こんな話、ふつうなら絵空事も良いところだ。誰も信じない。俺だって最初は信じなかった。でも、どんなにバカみたいでも、これは実際の話なんだ
lines.translated: "Normally, a story like that would just be a complete pipe dream. Nobody would buy it. Even I didn't believe it at first. Still, no matter how ridiculous it sounds, it's the actual truth."

lines.content: 俺の姉ちゃんは満月の夜、もし睡魔に一瞬でも負けてしまえば……、その存在ごと未来に飛んでしまう。それは、事実なんだ
lines.translated: "On the night of a full moon, if my sister gives in to sleepiness for even a single moment... her entire existence leaps into the future. That's a fact."

lines.content: どうして……
知らない。知りたくもない。すべて大人たちの事情だ。もしくは長いながい積み重ねの結果だ――俺たちガキにはなにもわからない
lines.translated: "I don't know why. I don't want to know, either. It's all got to do with the adults' circumstances. Or maybe it's the result of a long, drawn-out buildup over generations--kids like us don't know a damn thing."

lines.content: 智仁は首を振り、言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito shook his head and continued.

lines.content: 最初は、たった数時間程度のことだった……みたいだ
lines.translated: "At first, it was only for a few hours at a time... apparently."

lines.content: 満月の夜に眠ってしまうと、数時間ほど未来に姉ちゃんは飛ぶ。姉ちゃんが未来で目覚めるまで、姉ちゃんの姿はどこにも消えてなくなってしまう
lines.translated: "Whenever she fell asleep on the night of a full moon, she'd leap a few hours into the future. And until she woke up in that future, she'd completely vanish from the world, nowhere to be found."

lines.content: 最初は、焦った。姉ちゃんがそういう呪いめいたものに悩まされてるだなんて、どうしてそうなってしまうのかを含め、俺は何も聞かされてなかったから……
lines.translated: "At first, I panicked. Nobody had told me a thing about my sister suffering from something so much like a curse, or why it was happening to her in the first place..."

lines.content: 突然いなくなってしまった姉を探して、幼い弟は、夜の中を必死に探し回ったという――しかし姉の姿はどこにもない。見つからない。
lines.translated: Searching for his sister who had suddenly vanished, the young brother frantically scoured the night--yet she was nowhere to be found. He couldn't find her anywhere.

lines.content: 一緒に歩いた帰り道。一緒に遊んだ小さな公園。一緒に通った古い学校。その校舎。
lines.translated: The road they walked home on together. The small park where they played together. The old school they attended together. Its school building.

lines.content: ふたりでいれば何でもないそれらの場所も、今はひとりぼっちで、暗闇で……怖かった。何よりずっとさみしかった。
lines.translated: All those places that felt completely ordinary when the two of them were together were terrifying now that he was all alone in the dark... Above all else, it was endlessly lonely.

lines.content: 大人たちに訴えても、“そういうものだ。お前が知らなかっただけで”と相手にもされなかった。
lines.translated: Even when he pleaded with the adults, they didn't take him seriously, brushing him off with, "That's just how it is. You simply didn't know."

lines.content: 何時間も町中を探し、疲れ切って部屋に戻る。
lines.translated: After searching the town for hours on end, he returned to his room completely exhausted.

lines.content: すると姉は何事もなかったように自分の寝床で眠っている。そういうことが何度となくあったという。
lines.translated: And when he did, his sister was fast asleep in her own bed as if nothing had ever happened. Apparently, that sort of thing happened time and time again.

lines.content: ……姉が帰ってくるまでの時間が次第次第に長くなっていった。
lines.translated: Little by little, the time it took for his sister to come back grew longer and longer.

lines.content: 数時間から一日へ。一日から丸二日。更には数週間も。そういう具合に。
lines.translated: From a few hours to a whole day. From a day to two full days. And eventually, even several weeks. Just like that.

lines.content: このままじゃ姉ちゃんは、いつか、俺なんてとっくの昔に死んでしまった遠い未来にまで飛ばされる。それもその日はそう遠くない。そう、思った
lines.translated: "At this rate, I figured she'd eventually get sent so far into the distant future that I'd already be long dead. And that day wasn't too far off, either. That's what I thought."

lines.content: 姉ちゃんの[・|そ][・|れ]は病気のようなものだと俺は思った。病気ならきっと何か直す方法があるはずなんだ。その方法を見つけるまでは、予防することくらいできるはず……
lines.translated: "I thought of that condition of hers as a kind of illness. And if it was an illness, there had to be some way to cure it. Until I found that cure, I figured I could at least keep it from happening..."

lines.content: そう感じた弟は、姉のそばを片時も離れないと誓った。
lines.translated: Feeling that way, the younger brother swore never to leave his sister's side for even a moment.

lines.content: ……満月の夜に眠ってしまうのが問題なら、俺がずっとそばに付いていて、姉ちゃんを寝かさなければ良いだけの話だ。そう思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "...If falling asleep on the night of a full moon was the problem, then all I had to do was stay right by her side and keep her from falling asleep. It was as simple as that. Or so I thought."

lines.content: だから危険を感じた夜は、いつも姉ちゃんと夜通し話したりゲームをしたりして、うとうとする姉ちゃんを励ましたりしながら、月が沈むまで一緒にずっと眠らずにいた
lines.translated: "So on nights that felt dangerous, I'd always stay up all night talking or playing games with her, encouraging her whenever she started to nod off, staying awake together until the moon went down."

lines.content: ……その中で、姉ちゃんが眠りに落ちるのと同じ部屋にいた人間は、姉ちゃんと一緒に未来へ飛ばされてしまうことを知ったんだ
lines.translated: "...During all of that, I found out that anyone in the same room as my sister when she falls asleep gets sent into the future right along with her."

lines.content: それは、[・|最][・|初][・|っ][・|か][・|ら][・|そ][・|う][・|だ][・|っ][・|た][・|の][・|か]。それとも次第にその病が重くなっていった結果なのか。ともあれ、姉ちゃんの病にはそういう症状さえもあったんだ
lines.translated: "Whether it had been like that from the very beginning, or if it was the result of her illness gradually getting worse, I don't know. Either way, her illness even had a symptom like that."

lines.content: ならば、いつだって姉ちゃんのそばにいると誓った俺は、姉ちゃんと一緒にときを越え続け……ずっと、ずっと、そばを離れず一緒にいられる。そう思っていたのに
lines.translated: "If that was the case, then since I'd sworn to always stay by her side, I figured I'd just keep crossing through time with her... and we'd be able to stay together forever and ever, never apart. That's what I thought, and yet..."
Even though we'd done it so many times before.

lines.content: ……そうしていつか、姉ちゃんの病を治す方法を探し出すんだと思ってた。“夜の国”の中でなら、それを可能に出来る“[女の子|魔法]”がいるはずだって、“希望”を持ってた
lines.translated: "...I thought that if we kept doing that, I'd eventually find a way to cure her illness. I held onto 'hope' that here in the 'Country of the Night,' there had to be a 'magic' that could make it possible."

lines.content: 噂では、俺の姉ちゃんはいつか未来の世界で“夜の国”を作る張本人――“夜の国”が消えない限り、姉ちゃんが未来に飛ばされちまう結果を変えられていないってことだ
lines.translated: "According to the rumors, my sister is the very person who creates the 'Country of the Night' in some future world--which means that as long as the 'Country of the Night' doesn't disappear, the outcome of her getting sent to the future hasn't changed."

lines.content: 何かないのか。姉ちゃんを救うための方法は、どこかにないのか。そうでなければ[・|い][・|つ][・|か]姉ちゃんと永遠にさよならする日が来るかもしれない。そう思って、ずっと焦っていたけれど……
lines.translated: "Isn't there something? Isn't there some way to save my sister out there somewhere? Otherwise, the day might come when I have to say goodbye to her forever. Thinking that, I was always so desperate, and yet..."

lines.content: [・|い][・|つ][・|か]来ると思ってたその日が今日だ。つまり想定内の出来事だ。ああ、これは、ただそれだけの話だったんだよ
lines.translated: "That day I knew would come someday is today. In other words, it was all within expectations. Yeah, that's really all there is to it."

lines.content: 疲れたように微笑み、智仁は言う。
lines.translated: With a tired smile, Tomohito spoke.

lines.content: ……姉ちゃんを“夜の国”に連れてきたのが失敗だった。それだけの話だ。お前が気にすることじゃない
lines.translated: "...Bringing my sister to the 'Country of the Night' was a mistake. That's all there is to it. It's nothing for you to worry about."

lines.content: 現実世界で眠りに落ちることも充分以上に危険だったのに。ここではそれが、病の効果が、何十倍、何百倍にもなったんだ
lines.translated: "Falling asleep in the real world was already more than dangerous enough. Here, the effect of her illness was multiplied dozens, maybe even hundreds of times over."

lines.content: ああ、きっとそうだ、と智仁は青い顔で震えていた。
lines.translated: Yeah, that has to be it, Tomohito trembled, his face pale.

lines.content: 大雅の話を聞く限り、そう感じる。空や月や太陽が、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|な][・|る]なんてことは一度もなかった。ときを飛び越えた夜に、また眠るなんてことも……だから
lines.translated: "Judging from what you told me, Taiga, that's how it feels. The sky, the moon, and the sun have never turned out like that before. Nor has she ever fallen asleep again on a night after leaping through time... That's why..."

lines.content: だからもう、姉ちゃんはどれだけ待っても帰ってこない……。ずっと、ずっと先の未来に俺を置いて、行ってしまったんだ
lines.translated: "That's why, no matter how long I wait, my sister isn't coming back anymore... She left me behind and went off into the far, far distant future."

lines.content: ああ、そうか……
lines.translated: "Ah, I see..."

lines.content: 智仁は力なく首を振り、うなだれる。
lines.translated: Tomohito weakly shook his head and hung it low.

lines.content: だから家の連中は、俺たちをわざと見逃したのか
lines.translated: "So that's why the people in my family let us go on purpose."

lines.content: わざと、見逃す？
lines.translated: "Let you go on purpose?"

lines.content: 俺の隣で話を聞いていたハルが、思わずという具合に声を発した。そんなハルに、智仁は力なくうなずいて、
lines.translated: Haru, who had been listening beside me, blurted that out almost despite herself. Tomohito gave her a weak nod and continued.

lines.content: 姉ちゃんはそういう病で。その病を家の連中は何事かに利用しようとしていて――親も、俺以外の姉妹も。親戚も。皆、みんなだ
lines.translated: "My sister has that illness. And the people in my family are trying to use it for something--my parents, my other sisters, our relatives. All of them. Every single one."

lines.content: だから姉ちゃんは、この頃は学校もやめさせられて、いつも大きなお屋敷の部屋に閉じ込められてた
lines.translated: "Because of that, they made her quit school recently and kept her locked up inside a room in our huge mansion all the time."

lines.content: 俺……、俺はさ。病からも、家族からも、姉ちゃんのことを助けたくて……。姉ちゃんの手を引いて、家を出てきたんだ。……しかし。いやに簡単に脱出できたと思ったら
lines.translated: "I... I wanted to save my sister from both her illness and our family... So I took her by the hand and ran away from home. ...Still, to think that's why we were able to escape so suspiciously easily."

lines.content: 自嘲気味の笑みをうかべ、智仁は言う。
lines.translated: A self-deprecating smile surfaced on Tomohito's face as he spoke.

lines.content: “夜の国”は子どもしか出入りできない不思議の国だ。連中はまだまだガキなこの俺が、姉ちゃんを“夜の国”に連れて行くだろうことをきっと予想してて……
lines.translated: "The 'Country of the Night' is a wonderland that only children can enter and leave. Those people must have predicted that a kid like me would end up bringing my sister here..."

lines.content: ……ああ、まったく。ものの見事に、俺は連中に利用されたってことなんだな
lines.translated: "...Man, seriously. That means they played me like a fiddle and used me, huh."
Children are always used by adults. Locked away by everything and anything.

lines.content: それが嫌だから、それがどうしたって認められないから……だから俺たちは、いつも自由になりたいと願うけど
lines.translated: "Because we hate that, because we can't accept it no matter what... we always wish to be free, and yet..."

lines.content: その度に自分があんまりにも無力で、どうしようもなく子どもなんだって気づくんだよな。たぶん。……今まさにそんな気分だよ
lines.translated: "Every single time, we're forced to realize just how utterly powerless we are, and how hopelessly we're still just kids. Probably. ...That's the exact mood I'm in right now."

lines.content: 俺は、うなだれる智仁に……この友人に、どういった言葉をかけていいものか、わからない。これもまた無力な自分を痛感させられる要因のひとつだ。
lines.translated: Looking at Tomohito hanging his head... I didn't know what kind of words I could possibly offer my friend. This, too, was just another reminder making me painfully aware of my own powerlessness.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら、俺は何度も、何度だって、謝罪を繰り返した。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I apologized to him over and over, time and time again.

lines.content: その度に智仁は“ああ”“もういいんだ”“お前のせいじゃない”“本当に、心からそう思ってる”
lines.translated: And each time I did, Tomohito would reply, "Yeah," "It's fine already," "It's not your fault," "I really mean that from the bottom of my heart."

lines.content: “お前は、姉ちゃんを助けようとしてくれたんだもんな”“言ったろ。いつか、こうなると思ってたんだ”
lines.translated: "You were trying to help my sister, after all," "Like I said, I knew it would turn out like this someday."

lines.content: 本当に怒ってないよ。本当なんだよ。むしろ俺たちに手を貸してくれようとしたことに感謝だってしてる。本当なんだ……わかってほしい
lines.translated: "I'm really not mad. I mean it. In fact, I'm grateful that you tried to lend us a hand. It's the truth... I want you to understand that."

lines.content: 力なくそう言うばかりだから……。
lines.translated: Because that was all he would weakly say...

lines.content: だから今度は、謝罪の代わりに、こう問いかける。
lines.translated: Instead of apologizing again, I asked him a question this time.

lines.content: 智仁……
lines.translated: "Tomohito..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: “夜の国”とは、何なんだ？
lines.translated: "What exactly is the 'Country of the Night'?"

lines.content: 君のお姉さんが[・|そ][・|れ]を作る張本人――みたいなことを、言っていたけれど……
lines.translated: "You said something about your sister being the very person who creates it, right...?"

lines.content: こんな質問、あさひさんや十夜、そしてクロだ。“夜”の住人たる彼女らのいる前では決して口にできない。そう感じながら、俺は智仁へ問いかける。
lines.translated: A question like this was something I could never voice in front of Asahi-san, Toya, or Kuro--the residents of the "Night." Feeling that way, I asked Tomohito.

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 智仁はうなだれたまま、言う。
lines.translated: Keeping his head hung low, Tomohito answered.

lines.content: 俺はまだまだガキだ。知らないことのほうが多い。それだけじゃなく、わけあって俺は家族の連中に相手にもされてない。だから詳しくはわからないけれど……
lines.translated: "I'm still just a kid. There's way more I don't know than what I do. Not only that, for certain reasons, the people in my family don't even give me the time of day. So I don't know the details, but..."

lines.content: “夜の国”とは、何なのか。ここはあらゆる“時間の墓場”なんだと誰かが言ってた
lines.translated: "As for what the 'Country of the Night' is... Someone once said that this place is the 'Graveyard of All Time.'"

lines.content: 時間の墓場……？
lines.translated: "The Graveyard of Time...?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 姉ちゃんの病に巻き込まれ、未来に飛ばされたお前とハルちゃんが通ってきた帰り道の暗闇だよ。[・|そ][・|れ]こそが“夜”の正体だ。舞台裏と言ったほうがより正しいのかもしれないが……
lines.translated: "It's that darkness on the way back that you and Haru-chan passed through after getting caught up in my sister's illness and sent to the future. That is the true nature of the 'Night.' Though calling it the backstage might be more accurate..."

lines.content: ……大人たちが口々に言っていた。それによると、あの場所からはどこへでも行けるし、どこへも行けない。まさに“時間の墓場”――それこそが“夜”の正体
lines.translated: "...The adults were all talking about it. According to them, from that place, you can go anywhere, and you can go nowhere. Truly a 'Graveyard of Time'--that is the true nature of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: そういうふうに何度も耳にして来たけれど、
lines.translated: I've heard it put that way so many times before, and yet...

lines.content: だけど、ごめんな
lines.translated: "Still, I'm sorry."

lines.content: 智仁は力なく首を振る。
lines.translated: Tomohito weakly shook his head.

lines.content: それがどういう意味なのかはわからない
lines.translated: "I don't actually know what that means."

lines.content: 時間の墓場、か
lines.translated: "The Graveyard of Time, huh..."

lines.content: その言葉にはあんまりにも聞き覚えがありすぎた。
lines.translated: Those words sounded all too familiar to me.

lines.content: 一瞬脳裏に浮かんだ微笑みを、閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の裏にそっとしまった。
lines.translated: The smile that flashed across my mind for a brief instant, I gently tucked away behind my closed eyelids.

lines.content: ただ……
lines.translated: "It's just..."

lines.content: 智仁が語り続けている。
lines.translated: Tomohito continued speaking.

lines.content: ただ、さ。墓場って言うのは、もう二度と会えない人が眠りにつく場所で……
lines.translated: "It's just, you know. A graveyard is a place where people you can never meet again go to sleep, and..."

lines.content: そこで智仁は口を閉ざした。
lines.translated: At that point, Tomohito shut his mouth.

lines.content: しかし、言わんとせんことはわかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I understood what he was trying to say.

lines.content: 時間の墓場。ここで眠りについたということは、つまり姉とはもう二度と……。
lines.translated: The Graveyard of Time. Falling asleep here meant that he and his sister would never...

lines.content: どうしよう。俺は、そう思わずにはいられない。
lines.translated: What do I do? I couldn't help thinking that.

lines.content: 俺が出しゃばらなければこんなことにはならなかった。そんな事実ばかりが降り積もっていく。
lines.translated: None of this would have happened if I hadn't stuck my nose in where it didn't belong. Facts like that just kept piling up higher and higher.

lines.content: 何も事情を知らないのに、それでも“なんとかしたい”という気持ちさえ在れば、すべてなんとかなるのではないか。そんなふうに思っていた。
lines.translated: Even though I didn't know any of the circumstances, I'd thought that as long as I had the desire to "do something about it," everything would work out somehow.

lines.content: だってここは思い描いたすべてが叶う“夜の国”――だったら、ヒーローになるくらい、[・|憧][・|れ][・|続][・|け][・|た][・|あ][・|の][・|人]になることくらい、容易だと思ったんだ。
lines.translated: Because this was the "Country of the Night," where everything you imagined came true--and if so, I'd thought that becoming a hero, becoming like that person I'd admired for so long, would be easy.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: 俺は……っ
だからさ、大雅。気にするなって何度も言ったろ
lines.translated: "Come on, Taiga. How many times do I have to tell you not to worry about it?"

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑いを浮かべ、言う。
lines.translated: A bitter smile surfaced on Tomohito's face as he spoke.

lines.content: 俺の姉ちゃんは未来の世界で“夜の国”を作る中心人物だ――
lines.translated: "My sister is the central figure who creates the 'Country of the Night' in some future world--"

lines.content: ――智仁は、語る。
lines.translated: --Tomohito explained.

lines.content: どういう理屈か知らないが、“夜の国”という不思議の国は、発生源が未来であろうと過去であろうとも、だ。
lines.translated: I don't know the logic behind it, but with this wonderland called the "Country of the Night," it doesn't matter whether its point of origin is in the future or the past.

lines.content: 一度発生してしまったなら、過去、現在、未来、それがどのような時間上の話だろうと、現存するすべての時間軸の裏側に、[・|そ][・|れ]は現れる……ということらしい。
lines.translated: Once it comes into existence, whether it happens in the past, present, or future, it apparently manifests on the flip side of every existing timeline... Or so the story goes.

lines.content: 時間の墓場。因果律の歪曲。
lines.translated: The Graveyard of Time. The distortion of causality.

lines.content: そのようなことが実際ありえるのかどうか。
lines.translated: Whether something like that was actually possible or not...

lines.content: あんまりにも子どもな俺たちには計りかねないし、計り知ろうとすることも、できない。
lines.translated: For kids as young as us, it was impossible to fathom, and we couldn't even begin to try.

lines.content: えっと。つまり……
lines.translated: "Um. In other words..."

lines.content: それでも智仁がなんとか説明をしてくれようとする。
lines.translated: Even so, Tomohito tried his best to explain it to me.

lines.content: 俺たちの隣から“夜の国”が消えない限り、いつか姉ちゃんが未来に飛ばされるっていう結果は変わらないってことなんだ。少なくとも俺はそう信じた
lines.translated: "As long as the 'Country of the Night' doesn't disappear from beside us, the outcome of my sister eventually getting sent to the future won't change. At least, that's what I believed."

lines.content: “夜の国”が消えるということは、兎蛙あず咲が未来へ飛ばされることはなくなった――その証明になると信じてた。
lines.translated: He had believed that if the "Country of the Night" disappeared, it would serve as proof that Usaga Azusaki would no longer be sent into the future.

lines.content: その結果を引き出すために、何か方法はないのかとずっと焦っていたけれど……。だめだった。俺にはそんな力も知識もなにもない
lines.translated: "I was always so desperate to find some way to bring about that outcome, and yet... it was no good. I don't have that kind of power, or knowledge, or anything."

lines.content: だからいつか来ると思ってたその日が今日だ。それだけの話だったんだよ
lines.translated: "So that day I knew would come someday is today. That's really all there is to it."

lines.content: だからさ、大雅
lines.translated: "So look, Taiga."

lines.content: もしこの結果の責任を誰かが求められるとしたら、それは赤の他人なお前なんかじゃない。実弟の俺なんだよ。姉を今日の日までに救えなかった、この俺の責任だ
lines.translated: "If anyone is to be held responsible for this outcome, it's not a complete stranger like you. It's me, her own younger brother. The responsibility is mine for failing to save my sister before today came."

lines.content: まるで子どもじみたところもなく、ひとりでしっかり立つ大人みたいに、智仁はそう言い切った。
lines.translated: Without a single trace of childishness, like a grown adult standing firmly on his own two feet, Tomohito declared that flatly.

lines.content: ……俺が、あんまりにもあんまりな表情をしていたのだろう。
lines.translated: I must have been making a truly awful face.

lines.content: 今、最も慰められなきゃならない人物から、俺は何度も慰められている――情けない。本当に。
lines.translated: Right now, I was being comforted over and over again by the very person who needed comforting the most--how pathetic. Truly.

lines.content: とにかく、だ
lines.translated: "Anyway."

lines.content: ここが、この“夜の国”がどんな場所であるのかなんて、そんなことはどうだっていいんだ。俺は“夜の王”を倒して願いを叶える。そのための“魔法”を得る
lines.translated: "What kind of place this 'Country of the Night' is doesn't matter at all anymore. I'm going to defeat the 'King of the Night' and make my wish come true. I'll obtain the 'magic' to do that."

lines.content: ……必ず姉ちゃんを取り戻す
lines.translated: "...I'll definitely get my sister back."

lines.content: 少し順番とかがおかしくなってしまったけれど、[・|そ][・|れ]が本来、俺や、俺たちがここに集められた目的だし……それに
lines.translated: "The order of things got a little messed up, sure, but that's the whole reason I--the whole reason we were gathered here in the first place... And besides..."

lines.content: ……それに？
lines.translated: "...And besides?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: それに……。もしもだ
lines.translated: "Besides... what if..."

lines.content: もし万が一、“夜の王”を倒せなくても……。いいや。違う。“夜の王”は必ず倒す。人類の未来だとかが掛かってるんだもんな
lines.translated: "What if, by some slim chance, we can't defeat the 'King of the Night'... No. That's wrong. We will defeat the 'King of the Night' no matter what. The future of humanity and all that is riding on it, after all."

lines.content: 倒せなきゃあ未来にいる姉ちゃんにだって被害がある。そういうふうに想像するのがきっと正しい。だから必ず“夜の王”は倒すけれど……
lines.translated: "If we don't defeat it, my sister in the future will get hurt, too. Imagining it that way is surely the right call. So we'll definitely defeat the 'King of the Night,' but..."

lines.content: だけど、もしもだ
lines.translated: "Even so, what if..."

lines.content: そうして得られる“魔法”が、姉ちゃんを取り戻してくれるに値するものじゃあ、なかったとして……
lines.translated: "What if the 'magic' I obtain by doing that isn't enough to bring my sister back to me...?"

lines.content: そこで智仁はほんの少し瞳を泳がせ――しかし、屹然と前を向き、言った。
lines.translated: There, Tomohito's eyes wavered ever so slightly--yet he resolutely faced forward and spoke.

lines.content: 音楽だ
lines.translated: "Music."

lines.content: 音楽……？
lines.translated: "Music...?"

lines.content: ああ。……あさひさんがこの前、言ってたろ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Asahi-san said it the other day, didn't she?"

lines.content: ……何をかな
lines.translated: "...Said what?"

lines.content: 俺たち人間の産み出す言葉や旋律、そして風景。芸術だとか呼ばれてるものは、俺たちにしか使えない“魔法”で……それらは全部、時を超えた手紙にも等しいものなんだって
lines.translated: "That the words, melodies, and scenery we humans create--the things called art--are a 'magic' only we can use... and that all of them are equal to letters that transcend time."
