lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: だから俺は、俺の音楽を未来に届ける。どこか遠い未来にいるはずの姉ちゃんに……。ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "So I'm going to deliver my music to the future. To my sister, who must be out there in some distant future... Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 未来永劫、いつまでも、どこまでも色あせず――人々が歌い、語り継いで、未来の姉ちゃんにまで届けていってくれるような、そんな素晴らしい音楽を……必ずだ。必ず造る
lines.translated: "Music so wonderful that it will never fade, for all eternity, no matter when or where--music that people will sing and pass down, carrying it all the way to my sister in the future... I'll definitely do it. I'll definitely create it."

lines.content: そうすればきっと、姉ちゃんは安心してくれるから。俺はひとりでも立派に生きたんだってわかってくれる。そう、信じてる。だから俺は……
lines.translated: "If I do that, I know it'll put my sister's mind at ease. She'll understand that I lived a good, proper life even on my own. I believe that. That's why I..."

lines.content: 智仁がなぜそのようなことを言い出したのか。わからないではない。
lines.translated: Why had Tomohito started saying something like that? It wasn't hard to understand.

lines.content: なぜなら“夜の王”を倒して得られる“魔法”はひとりひとつずつと決められているからだ。
lines.translated: Because the "magic" obtained by defeating the "King of the Night" was strictly limited to one wish per person.

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”陽向井あさひから、最初にそう注意を受けていた。それ以上は“夜の国”から外に持ち出せない決まりなのだと。
lines.translated: We had been warned of that right from the start by the "Magician of the Night," Hinamukai Asahi. It was the rule that nothing more than that could be taken outside the "Country of the Night."

lines.content: 当初、智仁の“願い”はひとつだった。姉の病を治したい。
lines.translated: At first, Tomohito had only one "wish": to cure his sister's illness.

lines.content: だが、今はそれがふたつになっている――“姉の病を治したい”、そして“姉のことを取り戻したい”
lines.translated: Now, however, that had split into two--"to cure his sister's illness," and "to get his sister back."

lines.content: そのどちらかひとつを叶えたとしても、また智仁と姉は離ればなれになってしまう。
lines.translated: Even if he managed to grant one of them, Tomohito and his sister would still end up torn apart again.

lines.content: 現在に姉を取り戻したところで、病は消えず彼女の中に潜んでる。
lines.translated: Even if he got his sister back into the present, the illness wouldn't disappear; it would still be lurking inside her.

lines.content: ……またいつか未来へ飛ばされてしまうだろう。
lines.translated: Eventually, she would likely be sent to the future all over again.

lines.content: 得られた“魔法”で姉の病を治したところで、姉は現代に戻ってこられる術を持たない。
lines.translated: And even if he used the "magic" he obtained to cure her illness, his sister wouldn't have any way to return to the present day.

lines.content: ハルと俺が通って来た“刻の墓場”は、“夜の国”の住人たる何者かが手を貸さなければその扉を開かないのだという。
lines.translated: Apparently, the "Graveyard of Time" that Haru and I had passed through wouldn't open its doors unless someone who was a resident of the "Country of the Night" lent a hand.

lines.content: 故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: 彼が“夜の王”を倒して得られる“[報酬|魔法]”は、たった一度、姉と再会を果たせるかもしれない。そんな細やかな希望でしかなくなってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: The "magic"--the reward he would obtain by defeating the "King of the Night"--had been reduced to nothing more than a faint hope that he might be able to reunite with his sister just one single time.

lines.content: そうして俺たちは再び、人類の未来に多大なる危害を加えるのだという最悪最凶の悪夢であるらしい“夜の王”、その出現に備え、戦うための準備を整えていくのだけれど……。
lines.translated: And so, we once again began readying ourselves to fight in preparation for the appearance of the "King of the Night," that worst and most atrocious of nightmares said to inflict massive harm upon the future of humanity, and yet...

lines.content: 智仁の後ろでずっと、ずっと、姉への思いを語る弟のことを、ただじっと見守る[・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]の……。
lines.translated: Behind Tomohito, watching over the younger brother as he spoke endlessly of his feelings for his sister, was that person...

lines.content: 薄ぼんやりとした照明さえその身に映すことのない――“半透明”なそのひとの。
lines.translated: That "semi-transparent" person, whose body didn't even reflect the dim, hazy lighting.

lines.content: ただたださみしそうな表情だけは、どうしても忘れることができなかった。
lines.translated: The utterly lonely expression on her face was the one thing I simply could not forget.

lines.content: 私の願いは、ともくんが、思い通りの音楽を作れるようになることです
lines.translated: "My wish is for Tomo-kun to become able to create the music he envisions."

lines.content: あず咲先輩が俺に言った。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai said to me.

lines.content: そしてどうか、お願いします
lines.translated: "And please, I beg of you."

lines.content: 遠いとおい、いつかの未来にいる[・|本][・|当][・|の][・|お][・|姉][・|さ][・|ん][・|へ]、思い通りの音楽に乗せて、ともくんの想いを届けさせてあげてください
lines.translated: "Please let Tomo-kun's feelings ride on the music he envisions, and help deliver them to his real big sister, somewhere in the far, distant future."

lines.content: 今、目の前にいるあず咲先輩は、けして満月が訪れようと睡魔に負けることはない。
lines.translated: The Azusaki-senpai standing before my eyes right now would never succumb to the urge to sleep, even if a full moon were to arrive.

lines.content: もしそこで眠ってしまおうと、そばにいた者たちを、その“[病|呪い]”に巻き込んでしまうこともない……そもそもこのひとは眠ることを知らないのだ。
lines.translated: And even if she were to fall asleep then, she wouldn't drag those around her into that "curse"--that illness... In the first place, this person didn't even know how to sleep.

lines.content: なぜなら、このひとは……、
lines.translated: Because this person is...

lines.content: ……私は、兎蛙あず咲の心の一部です。“夜の国”の中でふたつに別れた……いわば“影”のほう
lines.translated: "...I am a piece of Usaga Azusaki's heart. The half that split off inside the 'Country of the Night'... her 'shadow,' so to speak."

lines.content: 兎蛙あず咲が未来へ飛ばされてしまう瞬間に、眠りに落ちてしまうその瞬間に、ともくんのことがどうしてもどうしても、気がかりで……
lines.translated: "At the exact moment Usaga Azusaki was sent into the future, at the exact moment she fell asleep, she was just so, so worried about Tomo-kun..."

lines.content: いつも私に――ううん、いつもお姉ちゃんのそばを離れず、ちょっと泣き虫でさみしがり屋なところのある弟を、たったひとり残してしまうことが、どうしても、できなくて……
lines.translated: "She just couldn't bear to leave her younger brother behind all alone, when he never left my--no, his big sister's side, and could be a bit of a crybaby who got lonely easily..."

lines.content: かわいい弟が心配で、心配で……。弟がこれからひとりで生きていけるのか。悲しいことに負けずに生きていけるのか。不安で、不安で……
lines.translated: "She was so worried about her cute little brother, so terribly worried... Could he go on living by himself from now on? Could he go on living without losing to the sadness? She was so anxious, so terribly anxious..."

lines.content: そんな想いだけが“夜の国”の力で形になり、現在に残った。それが私です
lines.translated: "Those feelings alone took form through the power of the 'Country of the Night' and remained in the present. That is who I am."

lines.content: それは、“夜”の中で“悪夢”を心の中から切り離す事情とよく似ているようにも思えた。
lines.translated: The circumstances seemed very similar to how a "Nightmare" is severed from within one's heart during the "Night."

lines.content: そうして切り取られた心の一部は、“夜の国”で次第次第に、自立した心を持つようになる。
lines.translated: The piece of the heart cut away like that gradually develops an independent mind of its own inside the "Country of the Night."

lines.content: その心が宿主の心に色々なことを呼びかける。
lines.translated: That mind then calls out to the host's heart in various ways.

lines.content: その声が、葛藤や悩みなどとなり、[宿主|本人]を苦しめることとなる――いつか自身の命を手放してしまいたいと願うほど。
lines.translated: That voice turns into conflict and anguish, tormenting the person themselves--to the point where they wish to let go of their own life someday.

lines.content: 故に。[・|そ][・|れ]を、その想いを、俺たちは“悪夢”と呼んでいる。
lines.translated: Therefore. We call that, those feelings, a "Nightmare."

lines.content: でも私は、ぐずぐずと不安だったり心配だったりを語りかける本人がここにはいません。遠いどこかの未来に飛んでいってしまいました。だから私はきっと“悪夢”ではありませんよね？
lines.translated: "However, the actual person I would normally be fretting over, calling out my anxieties and worries to, isn't here. She flew off to some distant future. So that means I'm surely not a 'Nightmare,' right?"

lines.content: おどけたように言うあず咲先輩だ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai said this in a joking tone.

lines.content: ……先輩。あず咲先輩が望む願いは、智仁に望み通りの音楽を作れるだけの……才能を与える。そういうことで正しいですか？
lines.translated: "...Senpai. The wish you desire is to grant Tomohito enough... talent to create the music he envisions. Is that correct?"

lines.content: 才能……。そうですね。そういうことになると思います
lines.translated: "Talent... Yes. I think that's what it comes down to."

lines.content: そうですか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: そこには別段、驚きはなかった。
lines.translated: There was nothing particularly surprising about that.

lines.content: これまで兎蛙智仁が音楽を自作しているところなど見たことがなかったし、あいつが何か、楽器なりを演奏し――心打つ旋律を奏でて見せてくれたこともまた、ない。
lines.translated: Up until now, I had never once seen Usaga Tomohito composing his own music, nor had he ever played an instrument for me--performing a melody that struck at the heart.

lines.content: あいつが音楽を実際に好いているのかさえも実は怪しいと俺は思っていた。
lines.translated: To tell the truth, I had even suspected whether he actually liked music at all.

lines.content: ……ともくん。本当は音楽が嫌いなんだと思います
lines.translated: "...I think Tomo-kun actually hates music."

lines.content: 苦笑いであず咲先輩は、言う。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai said with a bitter smile.

lines.content: ……私たちの産まれた家は――すみません。ややこしいから本当の[本体|私]のことも“私”と呼びますね？
lines.translated: "...The family we were born into--I'm sorry. It's confusing, so I'll refer to the real me as 'I' as well, okay?"

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: えっと。私たちの産まれた家は、古くから多くの芸事を学び、次の世代へ脈々と受け継いでいってる家系です。表舞台に立ち脚光や喝采を浴び続け、現代まで生き続けてきました
lines.translated: "Um. The family we were born into is a lineage that has studied many traditional arts since ancient times, passing them down unceasingly from one generation to the next. We've stood on center stage, bathing continuously in the spotlight and applause, surviving all the way to the modern day."

lines.content: しかしそれは、表向きの顔ということにはなりますが……
lines.translated: "Though, well, that is only the public face of it..."

lines.content: それでも、そのための“才能”を持たない者に、居場所なんてかけらも与えられない。そういった厳しい人たちの集まるところでした
lines.translated: "Even so, those who don't possess the 'talent' for it aren't given a single shred of a place to belong. It was a gathering of very strict people like that."

lines.content: 昔々は実の子どもを、不死の命を得るだとかなんだとかで、生け贄のようにして“夜の住人”に捧げていたみたいです
lines.translated: "Long, long ago, it seems they used to offer up their own biological children like sacrifices to the 'Residents of the Night' in order to obtain immortal life or something of the sort."

lines.content: その生け贄に選ばれるのが、多くの場合、芸事の才能を持たず産まれた子ども――つまり、ともくんのような子たちの“役割”でした
lines.translated: "And in most cases, being chosen as that sacrifice was the 'role' of children born without a talent for the arts--in other words, children like Tomo-kun."

lines.content: 私たちの家系は、総まとめの本家から、多くの分家に枝分かれしています。それぞれ得意な芸事が異なり、私たち兎蛙の血筋は音楽を得意とする者たちです
lines.translated: "Our lineage branches out from the main family that oversees everything into many cadet houses. Each excels in a different art, and those of our Usaga bloodline are the ones who excel in music."

lines.content: 私たちは産まれたその日から、厳しい音楽の英才教育を受けながら育ってきましたが……
lines.translated: "From the very day we were born, we were raised under a strict regime of gifted musical education, however..."

lines.content: ともくんは、無理でした
lines.translated: "For Tomo-kun, it was impossible."

lines.content: 音楽の道を進むために必要なあらゆるものを、ともくんはまったく持っていなかったんです
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun didn't possess a single one of the things necessary to walk the path of music."

lines.content: ……別に、他人が求める才能を持たないからといってその人がだめになるわけじゃない。その命が無価値に堕とされるわけでもない
lines.translated: "...It's not as if lacking the talent others demand of you makes you a failure as a person. Nor does it degrade your life into something worthless."

lines.content: たったそれだけのことで命の尊厳を欠くことはないし、この世に産まれた命が、心ない他人から蔑まれていい理由には一切ならない
lines.translated: "Something as trivial as that doesn't strip away the dignity of a life, and it provides no justification whatsoever for a life born into this world to be scorned by heartless people."

lines.content: ともくんにだって、音楽以外に、すばらしい別の才能があるかもしれない。何も持たずにこの世に産まれる人は存在しないと私は信じています。それなのに……
lines.translated: "Even Tomo-kun might have a wonderful, different talent outside of music. I believe there is no one born into this world who has nothing at all. And yet..."

lines.content: それなのに、ともくんはいつも家族からひどい扱いを受けていて……。ともくんだって家族の一員なはずなのに……それは、あんまりにも、ひどいことで
lines.translated: "And yet, Tomo-kun was always treated horribly by our family... Even though Tomo-kun is supposed to be a member of the family too... It was just far too cruel."

lines.content: [・|私]は、そんなともくんのことがかわいそうで
lines.translated: "I felt so sorry for Tomo-kun."

lines.content: ともくんがひどい言葉を投げかけられたり、痛い思いをさせられたり、ひとりぼっち除け者にされてばかりの光景を目の当たりにする度に、心が、どうにかなってしまいそうで……
lines.translated: "Every time I witnessed the sight of Tomo-kun having cruel words thrown at him, being made to suffer painful experiences, and constantly being left all alone as an outcast, it felt like my heart was going to break..."

lines.content: それなのに、ともくんは……
lines.translated: "And yet, Tomo-kun..."

lines.content: ……この血筋から、[・|す][・|べ][・|て][・|の][・|家][・|々][・|が][・|待][・|ち][・|望][・|ん][・|で][・|い][・|た]未来へ飛ぶ“呪い”を持って産まれた子が出たからと……私だって、音楽の才能にそれほど恵まれていたわけじゃないのに
lines.translated: "...Just because a child born with the 'curse' of flying into the future--which all the families had been longing for--finally appeared from this bloodline... Even though I wasn't all that blessed with musical talent myself, either."

lines.content: それでも、ただ呪いを受けて産まれてきたというだけで、家族から手厚く扱われていた私のことを、ともくんは恨むこともなく――
lines.translated: "Even so, Tomo-kun never once resented me for being treated so lavishly by the family simply because I was born bearing the curse--"

lines.content: むしろ“俺が姉ちゃんのことを絶対に助けるから”って、笑顔で、そう言ってくれて……
lines.translated: "On the contrary, he smiled and told me, 'I'll definitely save you, Sis'..."

lines.content: ただ望まれた才能を持たないってだけで、どうしてこんなにも良い子が、こんなにこんなに、つらい想いをしなきゃいけないのか……
lines.translated: "Why did such a good kid have to go through so, so much pain, just because he didn't have the talent they wanted...?"

lines.content: いつも、いつもです。ともくんが笑ってくれる度、いつも心がずきずき痛んだんです。私がこの子のことをずっと守っていきたい。そう、思ったんです
lines.translated: "Always, every single time. Whenever Tomo-kun smiled for me, my heart would throb with pain. I wanted to protect this child forever. That is what I thought."
"And I think the heart born inside Usaga Azusaki from those feelings is me," Azusaki-senpai gave a small smile.

lines.content: そんなともくんが、あんなにも音楽に拘るのは、きっと私のことを――未来にいる本物の私のことを、安心させるためなんだろうと思います
lines.translated: "The reason Tomo-kun is so fixated on music despite all that is surely to put my mind--the real me in the future's mind--at ease."

lines.content: いつか未来へ届くくらい、すばらしい音楽を創ることで
lines.translated: "By creating music wonderful enough to reach the future someday."

lines.content: ……そうです
lines.translated: "...That's right."

lines.content: 未来へ飛ばされた本当のお姉さんにさえ届く音楽が創れたのなら、智仁はもう家族の中で蔑まれることもなく、幸福に生きていけたという、証明にもなるから……？
lines.translated: "Because if he can create music that reaches even his real sister who was sent to the future, it'll also serve as proof that Tomohito was no longer scorned within the family, and was able to live happily...?"

lines.content: そうですね……
lines.translated: "I suppose so..."

lines.content: 才能のあるなしで子どもを愛せなくなるような家族に、丁寧に扱われたからといって、それがともくんの幸福になるかどうかはわかりませんが……
lines.translated: "Even if he were treated well by a family that stops loving a child based on whether or not they have talent, I don't know if that would actually bring Tomo-kun happiness, though..."

lines.content: でも、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|生][・|き][・|て][・|行][・|け][・|た]、ということを未来に伝えられる。それこそがともくんの“夢”で、“希望”なんですよ。きっと
lines.translated: "Still, being able to convey to the future that he was able to go on living like that... That itself is surely Tomo-kun's 'dream,' and his 'hope.'"

lines.content: これまで兎蛙智仁が音楽好きであることを疑ったことはあっても、だからといってそれで俺があいつに対してどうと思うことはなかった。
lines.translated: Even though I had doubted whether Usaga Tomohito actually liked music before, that hadn't changed how I felt about him one bit.

lines.content: 相手に[・|こ][・|れ][・|が][・|な][・|け][・|れ][・|ば]友人関係ではいられなくなる――
lines.translated: If the other person doesn't have this, we can't stay friends--

lines.content: そんなものは[・|本][・|物]ではないし、そんなことを発想してしまう自分は醜い。そうとさえ感じる。
lines.translated: Something like that isn't the real thing, and I even feel that I would be ugly for having such a thought cross my mind.

lines.content: だからこれまで“お前、本当は音楽なんてまるっきりできないんだろ”と追求しようとは微塵も考えたことはなかった。
lines.translated: That's why I had never once considered pressing him with something like, "You actually can't do music at all, can you?"

lines.content: 何であれ、どうであれ、兎蛙智仁は兎蛙智仁である――といったような定番の言い回しは、善意を着飾っているだけのようで薄ら寒くて嫌いだが、しかし今はそうとしか言い様がない。
lines.translated: Cliche phrases like "Whatever happens, however things are, Usaga Tomohito is Usaga Tomohito" send a chill down my spine and I hate them because they feel like they're just dressing up goodwill, yet right now, there is no other way to put it.

lines.content: 音楽が得意だろうと不得意だろうとあいつはあいつだ。そう言い切れる。
lines.translated: Whether he's good at music or bad at it, he is who he is. I can declare that with certainty.

lines.content: そこだけはなんとなくだが、自分にやさしく思ってやってもいいんじゃないかと、ふと感じてしまった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I suddenly felt like I could allow myself to feel a little good about myself for that one thing, at least.

lines.content: あんまりにも自己陶酔が過ぎるというか、独善的に過ぎるというか、あらゆる意味で自意識が過剰すぎるだろうけれど。
lines.translated: Though it's probably way too narcissistic, or way too self-righteous, or just an excess of self-consciousness in every sense of the word.

lines.content: ……ヒーローにはなれなかったこの俺だが。
lines.translated: I couldn't become a hero, that much is true.

lines.content: ……あいつの友人にはきっとなれた。そう思う。
lines.translated: But I think I definitely managed to become his friend.

lines.content: ……わかりました
lines.translated: "...I understand."

lines.content: 俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: あず咲先輩。あなたの“魔法”を使い、あなたの“夢”を叶えさせてもらいたいと思います
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai. I would like to use your 'magic' to make your 'dream' come true."

lines.content: 数日後に控えた“春の学園祭”
lines.translated: The "Spring School Festival" was coming up in just a few days.

lines.content: そこで智仁は自作の音楽を披露するのだと言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito had said he was going to unveil his own original music there.

lines.content: 全校生徒たちの前で、未来の姉に言葉を届けるために旋律を奏でようとしているのだろう――その一歩になれば良いと、そう願っているのだろう。
lines.translated: In front of the entire student body, he was likely planning to play a melody to deliver his words to his sister in the future--hoping that it would serve as the first step toward that.

lines.content: だがあいつはそのために必要なものを何も持たない。
lines.translated: However, he possessed none of the things necessary to do so.

lines.content: 智仁がなぜ、自らを追い詰めるかのような発言をしたのかはわからないが……。
lines.translated: I didn't know why Tomohito had made a declaration that seemed to back himself into a corner like that, but...

lines.content: 俺もあいつのことを応援したいです。あいつが“夢”を叶えるところを見てみたい。だから……
lines.translated: "I want to support him, too. I want to see him make his 'dream' come true. So..."

lines.content: 俺は、あず咲先輩の手を取った。
lines.translated: I took Azusaki-senpai's hand.

lines.content: しかし、このひとが誰よりもあいつのことを想っていたとしても。
lines.translated: However, even if this person cared for him more than anyone else did.

lines.content: だからといってその想いが“魔法”となり、智仁に力を与えられるのかと言われれば……。
lines.translated: If you asked me whether those feelings could turn into "magic" and grant Tomohito power just because of that...
The answer is: I don't know.

lines.content: そう応えるのが、もっとも寄り添った言い方になってしまう。
lines.translated: Answering like that was the most sympathetic way I could put it.

lines.content: なぜなら俺が今、手を握っているこのひとは、本人の言葉を借りるのなら――本物では、ない。
lines.translated: Because the person whose hand I was holding right now was, to borrow her own words--not the real thing.

lines.content: 智仁へのたくさん、たくさんの想いを重ねて、今ここに存在しているのだろうあず咲先輩の心の一部――それが、彼女なのだ。
lines.translated: A piece of Azusaki-senpai's heart, likely existing here right now by piling up countless, endless feelings for Tomohito--that was who she was.

lines.content: その心が現実を打ち破るだけの“[魔法|奇跡]”となり得るのかどうか……。
lines.translated: Whether or not that heart could become a "miracle"--a "magic" strong enough to shatter reality...

lines.content: そんな俺の不安が伝わったのだろう。
lines.translated: My anxiety must have come through to her.

lines.content: ……ともくんの才能は人を笑顔にできることです
lines.translated: "...Tomo-kun's talent is that he can make people smile."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は、微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai smiled gently.

lines.content: そしていつも笑顔を絶やさずにいること。それが一番大切で、一番最強の才能、ですよね？　きっと……そうですよね？
lines.translated: "And that he never stops smiling himself. That is the most important, most powerful talent of all, isn't it? Surely... that's right, isn't it?"

lines.content: ええ。きっとそうです
lines.translated: "Yeah. It surely is."

lines.content: 俺は深くうなずき、
lines.translated: I nodded deeply,

lines.content: あいつが笑うと、なんだかこっちも笑顔になれる。不思議ですけど
lines.translated: "When he laughs, it somehow makes me smile, too. It's strange, though."

lines.content: そして、あず咲先輩と繋いだ手に力を込めた。
lines.translated: And then, I put strength into the hand joined with Azusaki-senpai's.

lines.content: 今からこのひとの想いを智仁に届ける。そのために。
lines.translated: To deliver this person's feelings to Tomohito, starting right now. For that sake.

lines.content: 翌日からハルは積極的に“春の学園祭”へ向けた練習に望むようになった。
lines.translated: Starting the next day, Haru began taking a proactive approach to practicing for the "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: ……え、えっと。智仁くんの歌ができあがるまで、何を練習しておけば良かったんだったっけ
lines.translated: "...U-Um. Until Tomohito-kun's song is finished, what was it that I was supposed to practice again?"

lines.content: 昨晩のことだ。智仁からみんなへメッセージが届いた。
lines.translated: It happened last night. A message from Tomohito had arrived for everyone.

lines.content: ――急なことで悪いけど“学園祭”には新しい曲を書いて持って行くことにする。
lines.translated: --Sorry for the sudden notice, but I've decided to write a new song and bring it to the "School Festival."

lines.content: そんな短いメッセージだった。
lines.translated: It was a short message like that.

lines.content: あず咲先輩の“魔法”を使ってすぐ後のことだ。
lines.translated: It came right after I used Azusaki-senpai's "magic."

lines.content: ――急いで作るからそれまで待っててほしい。
lines.translated: --I'll make it in a hurry, so please wait for me until then.

lines.content: その言葉を俺たちは信じ、今日もまた放課後に集まっていた。
lines.translated: Believing in those words, we had gathered again after school today.

lines.content: んーっとね。確か、今はまだ仮だけど、とりあえずこの曲で踊りとか練習しといてって言っていた気がするよ
lines.translated: "Hmm, let's see. If I remember right, he said it's just temporary for now, but we should practice dancing and stuff to this song in the meantime."

lines.content: 姫織がスマホで歌を再生させ、聴かせてくれる。
lines.translated: Himeori played a song on her smartphone and let us listen to it.

lines.content: う、うわ～……。聴けば聴くほどきらきらしててすごい曲だね
lines.translated: "W-Whoa... The more I listen to it, the more sparkling and amazing this song sounds."

lines.content: 積極的になれたからといって、しかし本質が変わるわけではもちろんない。緊張のため顔色は変わらず青色に近かった。
lines.translated: Even though she had become more proactive, her fundamental nature obviously hadn't changed. Due to her nerves, her complexion remained close to pale blue, just like before.

lines.content: このグループ、なんていう名前の子たちだったっけ……。よく町とかでも聴くような気もするけれど……今、流行ってるの？
lines.translated: "What was the name of the girls in this group again...? I feel like I hear them around town a lot, too... Are they popular right now?"

lines.content: うん。とってもとっても
lines.translated: "Yep. Super, super popular."

lines.content: そ、そっか。とってもとっても、なんだね
lines.translated: "I-I see. Super, super popular, huh."

lines.content: ハルちゃんは[りゅうこう|流行]にうとい女の子なんだね。おっぱいはおっきいのに
lines.translated: "You really don't keep up with trends, do you, Haru-chan? Even though your boobs are so big."

lines.content: ……それとこれって何か関係あるのかな
lines.translated: "...Does one thing have anything to do with the other?"

lines.content: 両腕で胸元を隠すようにする。姫織がジト目で見ていたからだ。
lines.translated: She crossed both arms over her chest as if to hide it. That was because Himeori was staring at her with half-lidded eyes.

lines.content: この子たちはね
lines.translated: "You see, these girls..."

lines.content: う、うん……？
今、萌え豚どもの間でちょー流行ってるんだよ。地下の地下から瞬く間に駆け上がってきたかと思えば、気づけばヒットチャートさえ駆け上がろうかという激かわな子たちなんだよ
lines.translated: "Right now, they're suuuper popular among the moe-pigs. Just when you thought they'd shot up from the deepest underground in the blink of an eye, before anyone knew it, these ultra-cute girls were on the verge of climbing up the hit charts, too."

lines.content: こらこら、ひよちゃん。言葉が悪いぞ。豚とか[ども|共]とか言わない
lines.translated: "Hey now, Hiyo-chan. Watch your language. Don't call people pigs or 'the likes of them.'"

lines.content: 萌え豚さんたち
lines.translated: "Mr. Moe-pigs."

lines.content: さんをつけてもだめなものはだめ
lines.translated: "Slapping a 'Mr.' on it doesn't make it okay."

lines.content: ……ふんだ
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: ぷいっとする。
lines.translated: She turned her head away in a huff.

lines.content: これだから男の子は。すぐに仲間同士でかばい合おうとするんだから
lines.translated: "This is why boys are such a pain. You immediately try to cover for your fellow comrades."

lines.content: 仲間って……
lines.translated: "Comrades...?"

lines.content: そ、そうなの……？
lines.translated: "I-Is that true...?"

lines.content: そうなの
lines.translated: "It's true."

lines.content: 姫織はこっくりうなずく――いや、違うけれども。
lines.translated: Himeori gave a firm nod--no, she's wrong, though.

lines.content: そっか……。大雅くん、アイドルとか本当に好きだったんだね。冗談じゃなかったんだ
lines.translated: "I see... Taiga-kun, you really do like idols and stuff, huh. You weren't joking."

lines.content: 得心深くうなずいているハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru nodded in deep understanding.

lines.content: そして自身を包むひらひらな衣装の裾を手持ちぶさたにいじっていた。いやいや。本当に違うから……たぶん。
lines.translated: And then, with nothing else to do with her hands, she fidgeted with the frilly hem of the outfit she was wearing. No, wait. You're really got it wrong... probably.

lines.content: ともかくね、ハルちゃん。この子たちがすばらしい点はね、人気がぐんぐん出ているのはね。歌とか持ち前のかわいらしさだけじゃないんだって、ひよりちゃんは分析します
lines.translated: "Anyway, Haru-chan. The wonderful thing about these girls, and the reason their popularity is skyrocketing, isn't just because of their songs or their natural cuteness, according to Hiyori-chan's analysis."

lines.content: へ、へえ……？
lines.translated: "O-Oh, really...?"

lines.content: この子たち。プロデューサーの趣味なのかどうか知らないけども、みんな揃って貧乳ばっかり。すばらしいよね
lines.translated: "These girls. I don't know if it's the producer's personal taste or what, but every single one of them is flat-chested. Isn't that wonderful?"

lines.content: ぐっと拳を握りしめる姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori clenched her fist tightly.

lines.content: 小さなお胸の持ち主にでも、誰もがかわいいの頂点を目指す業界を極められるのかもしれない――そんな夢とか希望とかを与えてくれる、すばらしいグループなのだと思います
lines.translated: "Even someone with a small chest might be able to reach the top of an industry where everyone aims for the pinnacle of cuteness--I think they're a wonderful group that gives people dreams and hope like that."

lines.content: うんうんとうなずきながら、姫織は『だけど……』と言う。
lines.translated: Nodding to herself, Himeori continued, "However..."

lines.content: だけどハルちゃんはそんな彼女たちのことをまったく知らないって言う。それは強者の……否。巨乳の余裕ということ何ですね
lines.translated: "However, you say you don't know anything about them at all, Haru-chan. That must be the composure of the strong... No, the composure of the busty."

lines.content: だ、だからそんな怖い顔しないでよひよちゃん……。私だって好きでおっぱい、おっきくなったわけじゃないんだよ……
lines.translated: "L-Like I said, please don't make such a scary face, Hiyo-chan... It's not like my boobs got big because I wanted them to..."

lines.content: しゅんとして、もじもじとする。
lines.translated: She wilted and fidgeted bashfully.

lines.content: くわっと。
lines.translated: Snap.

lines.content: 姫織は、言いようのない表情をした。
lines.translated: Himeori made an indescribable expression.

lines.content: 唇を噛みしめ、目を見開き、今にも“ちくしょうあざとい！”と叫び出しそうで……。
lines.translated: Biting her lip and opening her eyes wide, she looked as if she were about to shout "Damn it, how calculated!" at any second...

lines.content: ふんっ
lines.translated: "Hmph."

lines.content: ぱん
lines.translated: Smack.

lines.content: あ……っ
しかし叫び出す代わりに、姫織は無言でハルのおっぱいを引っぱたいていた。
lines.translated: However, instead of shouting, Himeori silently slapped Haru's boobs.

lines.content: い、痛いよひよちゃん、何するの……？
lines.translated: "O-Ow, that hurts, Hiyo-chan, what are you doing...?"

lines.content: 涙目なハルだけど、姫織は更にぺちりと叩いた。
lines.translated: Haru had tears in her eyes, yet Himeori gave them another light smack.

lines.content: この――
lines.translated: "These--"

lines.content: や
lines.translated: "Yo."

lines.content: おっぱいが――
lines.translated: "Boobs--"

lines.content: あ、あう……っ
ぜんぶ――
lines.translated: "All of them--"

lines.content: んんっ
lines.translated: "Nnh!"

lines.content: ぜんぶほしいよ、大雅……っ
lines.translated: "I want all of them, Taiga...!"

lines.content: そ、そうですか……
lines.translated: "I-Is that so..."

lines.content: 目のやり場に困り、とりあえずそっぽを向いておいた。
lines.translated: Not knowing where to look, I just turned my head away for the time being.

lines.content: ……とにかくだ。
lines.translated: Anyway.

lines.content: 昨日までほど“恥ずかしい”と訴えることもなく、ハルはひらひらの衣装に自ら着替え、自ら歌の練習をしてみたり……。
lines.translated: Without complaining about how "embarrassing" it was nearly as much as she had until yesterday, Haru had changed into the frilly outfit on her own, and tried practicing the song on her own...

lines.content: 昨日までとは打って変わって積極的な態度なのだ。
lines.translated: In complete contrast to how she was until yesterday, she had a proactive attitude.

lines.content: まあ、うん。歌の練習といっても千和のお店を借りてる訳だから、あんまり大声を出すわけにもいかないのはわかるんだけど……
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. Even though we call it singing practice, we're borrowing Chiwa's shop, so I get that you can't exactly belt it out at the top of your lungs, but..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: いや、それにしてもさ、ハル。もう少しだけでも大きな声、出して歌ってみてもいいんじゃないかな。それじゃあ練習にならないんじゃない？
lines.translated: "No, even so, Haru. Couldn't you try singing with a slightly louder voice, at least? Otherwise it's not really much of a practice, is it?"

lines.content: そ、それは……。そうかもだけれども
lines.translated: "Th-That's... That might be true, though..."

lines.content: そうかもだけれども？
lines.translated: "Might be true, though?"

lines.content: うん……。そうできない理由が、のっぴきならない事情が、ありまして……
lines.translated: "Yeah... There is a reason I can't do that, some unavoidable circumstances..."

lines.content: それは、実は誰より恥ずかしがり屋な内面が原因となっている――わけでもなさそうだ。
lines.translated: It seemed the cause wasn't actually her inner nature of being shyer than anyone else.

lines.content: もしかして、ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Could it be, Haru-chan..."

lines.content: ハッとした表情の姫織。
lines.translated: A look of sudden realization crossed Himeori's face.

lines.content: な、なに……かな？
lines.translated: "Wh-What... is it?"

lines.content: ハルちゃんはもしかしてとっても音――
lines.translated: "Could it be that you're actually super tone--"

lines.content: 歌にあまり自信がないとかですか？　柊先輩
lines.translated: "Is it that you don't have much confidence in your singing, Hiiragi-senpai?"

lines.content: 厨房から洗い物を終えた千和が顔を出し、姫織のせりふを遮断した。
lines.translated: Having finished the dishes, Chiwa poked her head out from the kitchen and cut off Himeori's line.

lines.content: う、うん。えへへ……。バレてしまいました……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Ehehe... You found me out..."

lines.content: 頬を僅かに染めていた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks flushed slightly.

lines.content: で、でも音痴じゃないよ？　ほんとだよ？　人並みくらいには歌えるって思う――いや、うん。自分が音痴だってわかんないくらい、どうしようもないってこともあるかもだけど……
lines.translated: "B-But I'm not tone-deaf, okay? Really! I think I can sing about as well as the average person--no, well. There's a chance I'm so hopeless that I don't even realize I'm tone-deaf, though..."

lines.content: そうですか……。とにかく、本番当日まで後数日もないですけど、ちょっとでも自信を持てるよう練習したほうがいいですよね
lines.translated: "Is that so... Anyway, there aren't even a few days left until the actual performance, so we should probably practice so you can gain even a little bit of confidence."

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: ああ。千和の言うとおりだ。練習して自信がつけば、自ずと人前で歌えるくらいの勇気は整うんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Yeah. Chiwa's right. If you practice and build up your confidence, the courage to sing in front of people will naturally fall into place, don't you think?"

lines.content: ううっ。人、前、で……っ
lines.translated: "Ugh. In front... of people...!"

lines.content: たぶん考えないようにしていたのだろう――ハルは瞬く間に真っ青になっていた。
lines.translated: She had probably been trying not to think about it--in the blink of an eye, Haru turned dead pale.

lines.content: 本番まであと何日でしたっけ……
lines.translated: "How many days left until the performance, again...?"

lines.content: んー。あとねえ、五日だよ？
lines.translated: "Hmm. Let's see, five days, you know?"

lines.content: い、五日しか
lines.translated: "O-Only five days..."

lines.content: いや、ハル。あと五日したらこの緊張感から解放されるんだって考えられれば、少しは精神衛生上いいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Look, Haru. If you think of it as being freed from this tension in just five more days, wouldn't that be a little better for your mental health?"

lines.content: ……そうかなあ
lines.translated: "...I wonder."

lines.content: とにかくもうあまり時間はないんだって思いますけど、でも、歌の練習なら思う存分ここを使ってくださいね、柊先輩
lines.translated: "Anyway, I don't think we have much time left, but please feel free to use this place to your heart's content for singing practice, Hiiragi-senpai."

lines.content: 流行の歌はないですけど、ここにはいっぱいレコードありますし……、何かの役に立つかもしれません
lines.translated: "We don't have any trendy songs, but there are lots of records here... so they might be useful in some way."

lines.content: うん。ありがとう千和ちゃん
lines.translated: "Yeah. Thank you, Chiwa-chan."

lines.content: にこりとするハルだったけれど、瞬く間に真剣な顔つきに変わる。
lines.translated: Haru gave a little smile, but her expression turned serious in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: で、でも、千和ちゃん、ちゃんと覚えてる？　忘れてないよね？　千和ちゃんもひよりちゃんも、一緒に歌って踊るんだよね……？
lines.translated: "B-But, Chiwa-chan, you remember properly, right? You haven't forgotten, right? Both you and Hiyori-chan are going to sing and dance with me, right...?"

lines.content: ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: えっ
lines.translated: "Eh?"

lines.content: ごめんなさい柊先輩。今日はこれから団体のお客さんが来ると連絡があって……。一緒に練習はできそうにないです
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Hiiragi-senpai. We got a call saying a large group of customers is coming in soon today... So it doesn't look like I'll be able to practice with you."

lines.content: 苦笑いの千和だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa gave a wry smile.

lines.content: だけど大丈夫です。明日からちゃんと私もがんばります。先輩だけ生け贄に――う、ううん。先輩にだけ恥ずかしい思いはさせませんよ。絶対
lines.translated: "But it's okay. Starting tomorrow, I'll do my best properly, too. I won't make you the only sacrifice--n-no, wait. I won't let you be the only one who has to feel embarrassed, Senpai. Definitely."

lines.content: ち、千和ちゃん……っ
lines.translated: "Ch-Chiwa-chan...!"

lines.content: ハルはじんわりと涙目だ。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in Haru's eyes.

lines.content: 千和と手と手を合わせ“ありがとう私がんばる私もがんばる”と、睦まじい感じでうなずき合っていた。
lines.translated: Clasping hands with Chiwa, they nodded harmoniously at each other as if saying, "Thank you, I'll do my best," "I'll do my best too."

lines.content: 団体さん、か。そんなことがあるんだね
lines.translated: "A large group, huh. So things like that happen here."

lines.content: 俺は鞄を手に取り立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I picked up my bag and stood up.

lines.content: はい……。ご近所の老人会でゲートボール大会があったみたいです。その打ち上げみたいですね
lines.translated: "Yes... Apparently the neighborhood senior citizens' club had a gateball tournament. It seems this is their after-party."

lines.content: そっか。それはお邪魔しちゃ悪いな
lines.translated: "I see. It'd be bad if we got in the way, then."

lines.content: ここはご近所さんの憩いの場なのだ。なんだかほんわりとした気分になった。
lines.translated: This place was a local hangout spot for the neighbors. Just thinking about that gave me a warm, fuzzy feeling inside.

lines.content: 今日のところは解散とするが――……結局、
lines.translated: We'd be calling it a day for now, though... In the end,

lines.content: 智仁、今日は来なかったな
lines.translated: "Tomohito didn't show up today, huh."

lines.content: 店内に備え付けられた時計を見る。もう夜と夕との境目の時間だ。
lines.translated: I glanced at the clock mounted inside the shop. It was already that borderline hour between evening and night.

lines.content: 歌を一曲、新しく書き上げる。それは半日程度でなせるはずもないだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Writing a brand-new song from scratch. There was no way someone could pull that off in half a day, though...

lines.content: あまり根を詰めず、しかしいっぱい、たくさん、がんばれよ……親友。
lines.translated: Don't push yourself too hard, pal, but give it everything you've got... my best friend.

lines.content: 目には見えないけれど。
lines.translated: Even if you can't see her.

lines.content: 声は、届かないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even if her voice... can't reach you...

lines.content: お前にはあのひとの想いが、“魔法”が、そばにある。
lines.translated: You have her feelings--her "magic"--right there beside you.

lines.content: だからきっと大丈夫さ。絶対に。
lines.translated: So I'm sure you'll be fine. Definitely.

lines.content: ハルと一緒に歩く帰り道。
lines.translated: Haru and I walked home together.

lines.content: 今日は最後まで智仁と会うことはなかったし、あず咲先輩に会うこともなさそうだった。
lines.translated: We never ran into Tomohito today, and it didn't look like we'd be seeing Azusaki-senpai, either.

lines.content: 大雅くん……
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 並んで歩いているハルがぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: Walking beside me, Haru murmured something under her breath.

lines.content: その横顔は、何か大切なことを切り出そうとしているように見えた。きっと智仁やあず咲先輩のことだろうと感じる。
lines.translated: Looking at her profile, she seemed to be on the verge of bringing up something important. I had a feeling it was about Tomohito and Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: ……昨日。
lines.translated: Yesterday.

lines.content: 俺はここであのひとの“魔法”を使うため、その手を取った。“夜”と繋がる左手で。
lines.translated: Right here, in order to use her "magic," I took her hand. With my left hand, the one connected to the "Night."

lines.content: 『……ありがとうございます。これでもう、ともくんは大丈夫ですよね？』
lines.translated: "...Thank you so much. With this, Tomo-kun will be all right now, won't he?"

lines.content: きらきらと輝く光りの粒となり、俺たちの前から――“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”の中から姿を消した兎蛙あず咲。
lines.translated: Turning into glittering particles of light, Toa Azusaki vanished from before our eyes--from within the "Time of the Sun," the real world.

lines.content: 『私はともくんの“[夢|願い]”を叶えるための“魔法”になれて、ともくんは“[夢|願い]”を叶えて――思い通りの歌を作れる』
lines.translated: "I can become the 'magic' to grant Tomo-kun's 'wish,' his dream, and Tomo-kun can fulfill his 'wish'--and write the exact song he wants to."

lines.content: そしてその歌は遙か遠い未来へと、智仁の想いを乗せて届くはず。
lines.translated: And that song would surely carry Tomohito's feelings all the way into the distant future.

lines.content: 『……そして、ともくんはやっと家族の一員として認めてもらえる。ちゃんと、その他の姉妹たちと[おんな|同]じように扱ってもらえる――そうなりますよね？』
lines.translated: "...And then, Tomo-kun will finally be accepted as a member of the family. He'll be treated properly, just the same as the other sisters--that's how it'll turn out, right?"

lines.content: 彼女は笑顔でそう言い残し、“夜”の中へと去って行った。
lines.translated: Leaving those words behind with a smile, she departed into the "Night."

lines.content: きっとその“夢”のすべてが叶うはず。なぜならあのひとの想いはそういう“魔法”……なのだから。
lines.translated: I was sure every part of that "dream" would come true. Because her feelings were that kind of "magic"... after all.

lines.content: 今、あず咲先輩は――いいや。
lines.translated: Right now, Azusaki-senpai--no.

lines.content: 正しくは、兎蛙あず咲の、“大切な弟の幸福を願う心”が、“夜の国”の影響で分離し、形を得たものではあるけれど……。
lines.translated: To be precise, she was Toa Azusaki's "heart wishing for her precious little brother's happiness," which had separated and taken form under the influence of the "Realm of Night"...

lines.content: まだ“夜の国”と関わっていられるハルや俺にしか、その姿も声も認識できない[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]は。
lines.translated: That person, whose figure and voice could only be perceived by Haru and me since we were still able to stay involved with the "Realm of Night."

lines.content: 今、智仁のそばにいて、智仁が懸命に音楽を作り上げようとするのを、精一杯の“魔法”で応援しているのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: Right now, I imagined she was right by Tomohito's side, cheering him on with all her "magic" as he worked his hardest to create his music.

lines.content: 智仁が昨晩、みんなにメッセージを送ってきたことが。
lines.translated: The fact that Tomohito had sent a message to everyone last night.

lines.content: そして今日、突然に学校を休んだのがその証拠であるはずだ。
lines.translated: And the fact that he had suddenly skipped school today had to be proof of that.

lines.content: あいつと再び会うときは、姉弟が力を合わせて創った音楽が、その手の中に握られているのだろうと俺は期待している。
lines.translated: I was holding out hope that the next time we met up with him, the music created by brother and sister working together would be clutched tightly in his hand.

lines.content: あのね。大雅くん
lines.translated: "Um, hey. Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 真剣な眼差しを足下へ落としたまま、きっと俺と同じようなことを感じているだろうハルが言う。
lines.translated: Keeping her serious gaze cast down at her feet, Haru--who was surely feeling the exact same way I was--spoke up.

lines.content: ……さっき、言いそびれちゃったんだけど
lines.translated: "...I missed my chance to say it earlier, though."

lines.content: ああ。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: 大雅くんも一緒に、やるんだよね？
lines.translated: "You're going to do it with us too, right, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 俺は、首をかしげる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: やるって、何を？
lines.translated: "Do what, exactly?"

lines.content: ……やっぱり忘れてる？
lines.translated: "...Did you forget after all?"

lines.content: ハルは目をぱちぱちとさせていた。
lines.translated: Haru blinked in surprise.

lines.content: 大雅くんもかわいいカッコとかわいいダンスで、とってもかわいいだろう歌を、私たちと一緒に歌ってくれるんだよね……？
lines.translated: "You're going to wear a cute outfit, do a cute dance, and sing what's sure to be a super cute song together with us too, right, Taiga-kun...?"

lines.content: い――いや、いやいや
lines.translated: "N--No, no, no."

lines.content: まったくだ。まったく俺とは違うことを真剣に考えていたらしいハルに、俺は全力で首を振る。いやいや何を言ってるんだいハルちゃんは、と。
lines.translated: Good grief. Haru had apparently been dead serious about something completely different from what I was thinking, so I shook my head with everything I had. No, no, what in the world are you talking about, Haru-chan?

lines.content: はっはっは。かわいいカッコでダンスと歌……？　まったく冗談きっついなあ。うん
lines.translated: "Hahaha. Dancing and singing in a cute outfit...? Man, that's a rough joke. Yup."

lines.content: ううん。冗談じゃ、ないよ？
lines.translated: "No, it's not a joke, you know?"

lines.content: 首をかしげている。
lines.translated: She tilted her head.

lines.content: 智仁くんもお願いって言ってたし……
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun asked you to do it, too, so..."

lines.content: ハルちゃん。君に良いことを教えよう
lines.translated: "Haru-chan. Let me tell you something useful."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……普段のあいつの言うことは大体九割くらい当てにならない。戯れ言にもならないただのぼやきみたいなもんだよ。だから聞き流してほしいんだ。できるだけ
lines.translated: "...About ninety percent of what that guy usually says can't be trusted. It's less than nonsense, more like mererambling complaints. So I want you to just let it go in one ear and out the other. As much as possible."

lines.content: そ、そっかな
lines.translated: "I-Is that so?"

lines.content: そうだとも
lines.translated: "It sure is."

lines.content: でも……うーん
lines.translated: "But... hmm."

lines.content: 腕を組み、渋い顔のハルだ。
lines.translated: Haru crossed her arms, making a reluctant face.

lines.content: きっとかわいい大雅くん、大人気になれると思うんだけどなあ
lines.translated: "I think a cute Taiga-kun would become super popular, though."

lines.content: 大人気になれたところでどーしろと
lines.translated: "And what am I supposed to do even if I do get super popular?"

lines.content: そうだっ
lines.translated: "I know!"

lines.content: ハルは急に笑顔になる。
lines.translated: Haru suddenly broke into a smile.

lines.content: 大雅くんが学園の噂のひとつになっちゃおうよ――“春の学園祭”に突如として現れた正体不明の超絶美少女！　あの子はいったい誰だったんだ……！
lines.translated: "Let's make you one of the school rumors, Taiga-kun--'An unidentified, drop-dead gorgeous girl suddenly appeared at the Spring School Festival! Just who on earth was she...?!'"

lines.content: みたいな感じで？　と、ハルは俺の顔を伺うみたいに、上目遣いだ。
lines.translated: "Something like that?" Haru added, glancing up at my face to gauge my reaction.

lines.content: そ、そういうのもきっと楽しいよ。話題作りにいいって思うな。うん、そうだよ。話題になればなるだけ、智仁くんの音楽が未来に届きやすくなるのかもしれないし……？
lines.translated: "Th-That kind of thing would surely be fun, too. I think it'd be great for creating buzz. Yeah, that's right. The more people talk about it, the easier it might be for Tomohito-kun's music to reach the future, right...?"

lines.content: ああ、なるほど
lines.translated: "Ah, I see."

lines.content: 俺がため息と共にうなずくと、
lines.translated: When I nodded with a sigh,

lines.content: ぱーっと笑顔になるところから、やっぱり[・|そ][・|う][・|か][・|な]と確信した。
lines.translated: Her face lit up with a bright smile, which made me certain of my suspicions--so *that's* what this is about.

lines.content: ねえ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: う、うん。何かな、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah? What is it, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 君は、あれだろ。なんだかんだといちゃもん付けて、智仁から指名されたセンターの立ち位置を俺に押しつけようとしてるだろ
lines.translated: "You're doing that thing, aren't you? Making up all sorts of excuses to try and push the center position Tomohito assigned you onto me, right?"

lines.content: そ、そんなこと……っ
lines.translated: "Th-That's not...!"

lines.content: 背筋をピンと伸ばし、頭を激しくふるふると振っていたけれど……、
lines.translated: She stiffened her back and shook her head furiously, but...

lines.content: そんなことは――な、ない……ことは、なく……ない……です
lines.translated: "That's--n-not... entirely... un-true... I guess."

lines.content: しおしおと縮こまってしまっていた。
lines.translated: She wilted and shrank back into herself.

lines.content: ご、ごめんなさい……
lines.translated: "I-I'm sorry..."

lines.content: しゅんとしてしまうハルだった。
lines.translated: Haru drooped dejectedly.

lines.content: まあ、うん。素直に謝れるのはハルの良いところなんじゃないかな――だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Well, yeah. Being able to apologize honestly is one of Haru's good points, isn't it--or something like that.

lines.content: いったいどこから目線なんだよ俺はと自分に呆れながらも、ハルにもうひとつ問いかける。
lines.translated: Exasperated with myself for acting so high and mighty, I asked Haru one more question.

lines.content: いいかいハルちゃん。教えてくれ
lines.translated: "Listen, Haru-chan. Tell me this."

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: まず、俺がそんなことして誰が喜ぶの……？
lines.translated: "First of all, who would even be happy if I did something like that...?"

lines.content: あず咲先輩、とか……？
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai, maybe...?"

lines.content: う……むぅ
lines.translated: "Urk... Mmm."

lines.content: 俺の女装姿に殆ど興奮したような言動を見せていたあず咲先輩のことを思い出してしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help remembering Azusaki-senpai, who had acted practically thrilled when she saw me dressed as a girl.

lines.content: それは何か、うーん。否定できそうにないのが悔しいけれど……
lines.translated: "That's, well, hmm. It frustrates me that I can't really deny that, though..."

lines.content: でしょう？
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: ちょっと得意げな笑顔だった。
lines.translated: She wore a slightly smug smile.

lines.content: あと、私だよ。私もね、すごく喜んじゃうんじゃないかなって思うなあ……
lines.translated: "And also, me. I think I'd be super happy about it too, you know..."

lines.content: ちらりと上目遣いで俺を見る。
lines.translated: She sneaked an upward glance at me.

lines.content: え、えへへ。また大雅くんのかわいいの、見てみたいし
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe. Besides, I want to see you looking cute again, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ちらり、ちらりと俺を見ている。
lines.translated: She kept sneaking little glances my way.

lines.content: い、いや。騙されないぞ。いくらそんなかわいい素振りをされようと。
lines.translated: N-No. I won't be fooled. No matter how cute she acts.

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと考えてもみてほしい
lines.translated: "J-Just think about it for a second, please."

lines.content: うん……？
lines.translated: "Yeah...?"

lines.content: もしもハルの言うとおり、“春の学園祭”で歌っていたあの子は誰だって、全校生徒たちの間で話題になって――その結果
lines.translated: "What if, just like you said, Haru, the whole school starts talking about who that girl singing at the 'Spring School Festival' was--and as a result..."

lines.content: おい、あのとき歌ってたのはあいつだってよ、ほら見てみろよ、あの男子だよ、あいつが女子の格好で……うそやだまじむりちょうきもーい――
lines.translated: "Hey, I heard the one singing back then was that guy, look over there, it's that boy, he was dressed up like a girl... no way, gross, seriously can't deal, super creepy--"

lines.content: なんて話にならないって保証はどこにもなくて。
lines.translated: There was zero guarantee it wouldn't turn into a conversation like that.

lines.content: ……ぞっとする
lines.translated: "...That gives me the chills."

lines.content: そんな未来は全力で回避しなければ。
lines.translated: I had to avoid a future like that with everything I had.

lines.content: それとね、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Besides, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私たちは、幼馴染みの智仁くんが“お姉さんに想いを届けたい”って願いを叶えるためにがんばるんだよね
lines.translated: "We're doing our best to grant our childhood friend Tomohito-kun's wish of 'wanting to convey his feelings to his older sister,' right?"

lines.content: あ、ああ……？
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah...?"

lines.content: 戸惑う。急にまじめな話になった。
lines.translated: I was thrown off. The conversation had suddenly turned serious.

lines.content: もしかしたらだけど、“春の学園祭”でみんな一緒にがんばったステージが、インターネットとかを通じて広まって、結果、世界レベルでアイドルの歴史に名を刻んじゃう――
lines.translated: "It's just a 'what if,' though, what if the performance we all worked so hard on together at the 'Spring School Festival' spreads across the internet and stuff, and as a result, carves our names into idol history on a global scale--"

lines.content: ――……なんてことも、絶対にないとは言えないよね？
lines.translated: "--...You can't say there's an absolute zero percent chance of something like that happening, right?"

lines.content: ……いや、それはまあ
lines.translated: "...No, well, I guess."

lines.content: 受け取り方次第でどれだけ自意識が過剰なのだと言い出す者もなくもない言い方だけれど……。
lines.translated: Depending on how you took it, some people might call that being way too full of yourself, though...

lines.content: うーん。すべては箱を開けてみなければわからないって人もいるくらいだし……、まあ、うん。絶対にない話ではないかもね
lines.translated: "Hmm. Some people do say you never know anything until you open the box... so well, yeah. I guess it's not a completely impossible scenario."

lines.content: もしも万が一、ううん。もしかしたら億とか兆とか、その中のひとつでしかない可能性かもしれないけれど……とにかくもしもそうなってしまったら
lines.translated: "If by some chance--no, maybe it's only a one-in-a-hundred-million or one-in-a-trillion chance... anyway, what if it actually did turn out like that?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうなって、しまったら？
lines.translated: "...Yeah. What if it did turn out like that?"

lines.content: そこに参加していなかった大雅くんだけ、未来のあず咲先輩には届かないってことになるのかもしれない
lines.translated: "If you didn't participate in it, Taiga-kun, you might be the only one whose feelings don't reach the future Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: ……つまり？
lines.translated: "...Which means?"

lines.content: つまりね。未来にいるあず咲先輩、とってもさみしい気持ちになっちゃうかもしれないよ……？
lines.translated: "Which means, the Azusaki-senpai in the future might end up feeling super lonely, you know...?"

lines.content: たじろぐ。
lines.translated: I faltered.

lines.content: 未来でどんな生活をしてるのかわからないけれど……。もしかしたら、あず咲先輩。知らない人ばかりの未来の世界で、ずっとひとりぼっちで、さみしい想いをしてるのかもしれない
lines.translated: "I don't know what kind of life she's living in the future, though... Maybe Azusaki-senpai is all alone in a future world full of strangers, feeling really lonely."

lines.content: そんなあず咲先輩に、みんなで一緒に……智仁くんと一緒に、何か歌に乗せてメッセージを届けたいって思う
lines.translated: "I want us all to work together... along with Tomohito-kun, to put a message into a song and deliver it to Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: それにはやっぱり、大雅くんも欠けてちゃいけないんじゃないかって、そう思って……
lines.translated: "And for that, I really felt like we couldn't do it without you, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: う、うう
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: いやいや。だったらやっぱり俺が女装してちゃあず咲先輩、混乱するんじゃないかなとは思うけれど……。
lines.translated: No, no. If that's the case, wouldn't Azusaki-senpai just be confused if I dressed up like a girl...?

lines.content: くそう。ハルちゃんめ。十年も会っていない間に、いやに交渉ごとが上手な子に育ってしまったじゃないか
lines.translated: "Damn it. Darn you, Haru-chan. In the ten years since I last saw you, you've grown into quite the skilled negotiator, haven't you?"

lines.content: えへへ～
lines.translated: "Ehehe~"

lines.content: へにゃりと笑う。
lines.translated: She gave a bashful little smile.

lines.content: いや。今のはあまり褒めてないんですけども
lines.translated: "No, that wasn't really a compliment, though."

lines.content: 大雅くんが一緒だったら心強いよ
lines.translated: "It's reassuring having you with me, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 色々と言ってみたけどね、やっぱりそれが一番の理由だって思うの。だから……
lines.translated: "I gave you all sorts of reasons, you know, but I think that's really the biggest one of all. So..."

lines.content: だからお願い、とハルは言う。
lines.translated: So please, Haru said.

lines.content: 一緒にがんばってくれたら、うれしいなあって……
lines.translated: "I'd be really happy if you did your best together with me..."

lines.content: そしてじっと、俺を見つめている――
lines.translated: And she stared straight at me--

lines.content: う、うう
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: ――また、たじろぐ。
lines.translated: --I faltered again.

lines.content: それ以外に反応のしようを知らない。
lines.translated: I didn't know how else to react.

lines.content: 千和ちゃんや姫織ちゃんが一緒にいてくれるのだって、すっごい勇気になるけれど……
lines.translated: "Having Chiwa-chan and Himeori-chan with me gives me a ton of courage too, of course, but..."

lines.content: だ、だったらそれでいいんじゃ……
lines.translated: "Th-Then isn't that good enough...?"

lines.content: ううん
lines.translated: "Unh-unh."

lines.content: ふるふると首を横に振るのだ。
lines.translated: She shook her head from side to side.

lines.content: 大雅くんが、いいの
lines.translated: "I want it to be you, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: きっぱりと、言う。
lines.translated: She said it flatly.

lines.content: 何かがんばろうって思うときにはね、いつも大雅くんがそばに……私の“[・|隣]”に、いてほしい
lines.translated: "Whenever I decide to try my best at something, I always want you nearby, Taiga-kun... right 'beside' me."

lines.content: ……ぐ、うう
lines.translated: "...Guh, ugh."

lines.content: いつも俺の前ではおどおどとしているハルなのに、どうしてこいうことを言うときに限って、そう真っ直ぐな態度でいられるのだろう――こちらのほうが戸惑ってしまう。
lines.translated: Even though Haru was always so timid around me, how could she be so straightforward only when saying things like this?--It left me the one feeling flustered instead.

lines.content: お願い。大雅くん……。ステージには立たなくてもいいの。本番ぎりぎりまでそばにいてくれたら……
lines.translated: "Please, Taiga-kun... You don't even have to stand on stage. Just stay by my side right up until the performance starts..."

lines.content: それだけで、私……緊張して、どきどき、どきどき……胸が痛いのも、ちょっとはましになってくれるから
lines.translated: "Just that alone will make my nervousness, and this pounding, thumping... ache in my chest a little easier to bear."

lines.content: どうして……
どうしてそこまでのがんばりを自身に課そうとするのか。俺はそう問いかける。
lines.translated: Why was she pushing herself to try this hard? I asked her that.

lines.content: 智仁のことを応援したいという気持ちはわかる。理解できる。
lines.translated: I got that she wanted to support Tomohito. I could understand that.

lines.content: だけどそこまで自身の心を摩耗させてまでやらなければならないことなのだろうか、と。
lines.translated: But was it really something she had to do even if it meant wearing down her own heart this much?

lines.content: するとハルは『だって……』と応える。
lines.translated: To that, Haru answered, "Because..."

lines.content: だって私、[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]……十年前、あのふたりの役に立てなかった。全然だめだった
lines.translated: "Because back then... ten years ago, I couldn't be of any use to those two. I was completely useless."

lines.content: だから今回はふたりの力になれる私でいたいの……十年経ってもまだまだ子どもな私だけれど、もうあのときとは違う。あのときよりも強くなれてる。そう、信じたい
lines.translated: "So this time, I want to be someone who can help them... Even after ten years, I'm still just a kid, but I'm not the same as I was back then. I've grown stronger than I was. I want to believe that."

lines.content: だからせめて、大切な人たちの役には立ちたい。そんな自分に成長できてるんだって、思いたいんだよ
lines.translated: "So at the very least, I want to be useful to the people who are precious to me. I want to believe that I've grown into someone who can do that."

lines.content: でも、そのためにはやっぱり今よりずっと強い勇気が、必要で……
lines.translated: "But to do that, I really need way stronger courage than what I have right now..."

lines.content: だからお願い。大雅くんに、この手を取ってほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "So please. I want you to take this hand, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ハルは、俺に手を差し伸べる。
lines.translated: Haru held her hand out to me.

lines.content: 大雅くんが“隣”にいてくれると、手を繋いでいてくれると、何があってももう大丈夫って思えるから
lines.translated: "When you're 'beside' me, Taiga-kun, when you're holding my hand, I feel like everything will be okay no matter what happens."

lines.content: にっこりとしながら、ハルはそんなことを言う――ねえ、覚えてる？　と。
lines.translated: Smiling brightly, Haru said that--adding, "Hey, do you remember?"

lines.content: 覚えてるかな。大雅くん
lines.translated: "I wonder if you remember, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……十年前。真っ暗闇の“夜”の中。大雅くん、私の手を引いて歩いて行ってくれたよね？
lines.translated: "...Ten years ago. In the pitch-black darkness of the 'Night.' You took my hand and led me along, didn't you, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 覚えている。
lines.translated: I remembered.

lines.content: ハルは自分の手を引いていってくれた、と好意的なふうに言ってくれているけれど……。
lines.translated: Haru spoke of it fondly, saying that I had taken her hand and led her along, but...

lines.content: だがその思い出は、あくまでも俺にとってしてみれば、まったく自分自身に恥じ入るような印象しかない。
lines.translated: To me, at least, that memory left no impression other than utter shame in myself.

lines.content: ……ハル。ごめん。巻き込んじゃって
lines.translated: "...Haru. I'm sorry. For dragging you into that."

lines.content: ……俺は昔々のことを思い出さずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help remembering what happened all those years ago.

lines.content: 俺がヒーローになりたいだとか、そんなバカみたいなことを思わなければ……
lines.translated: "If I hadn't thought something so stupid, like wanting to become a hero..."

lines.content: ヒーロー……
lines.translated: "A hero..."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 俺が、あず咲さんや智仁のことを助けたいだなんて……。そんな余計なことを考えなければ、あず咲さんは未来へ飛ばされることもなかったかもしれないし……
lines.translated: "Thinking I wanted to save Azusaki-san and Tomohito... If I hadn't had such needless thoughts, maybe Azusaki-san wouldn't have been sent flying into the future..."

lines.content: しかも、ハルにあんな怖い思いまでさせて
lines.translated: "And on top of that, I even put you through something so terrifying, Haru."

lines.content: ううん。違うよ。謝らないでよ大雅くん。私、巻き込まれて良かったよ
lines.translated: "Nuh-uh. That's not true. Don't apologize, Taiga-kun. I'm glad I got dragged into it."

lines.content: 幼い頃のハルは首を振り、言った。
lines.translated: The young Haru shook her head and spoke.

lines.content: もしも私があそこにいなければ、私が持ってた電話がなかったら、大雅くん……戻って来れなかったかもしれないし
lines.translated: "If I hadn't been there, if it weren't for the phone I had with me, Taiga-kun... you might not have been able to come back."

lines.content: それにね、一緒にいてくれて安心だった。絶対守るからって。そう言ってくれてうれしかった――大雅くん。大雅くんは私を守ってくれるヒーローだったよ
lines.translated: "Besides, having you with me was a relief. You told me you'd definitely protect me. Hearing you say that made me happy--Taiga-kun. You were a hero who protected me, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: にっこりと、ハルは笑った。
lines.translated: Haru smiled brightly.

lines.content: ……もちろん、その言葉が俺にとってどれだけ大切なものかなど、ハルが知っているわけもなく。
lines.translated: Of course, there was no way Haru could know just how precious those words were to me.

lines.content: そのときどれだけ小さな俺は救われたことか。
lines.translated: Or just how much my young self was saved at that moment.

lines.content: 実は柊ハルという女の子は、この俺の心を救ってくれた恩人のひとりなのだ。
lines.translated: In truth, the girl named Hiiragi Haru was one of the benefactors who had saved my heart.

lines.content: ハル本人にはまったくその意識はないだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Though Haru herself was probably completely unaware of it...

lines.content: あのとき。あの瞬間。あの言葉がなければ、俺の心は緩やかに崩壊し――
lines.translated: Back then. In that moment. Without those words, my heart would have slowly crumbled away--

lines.content: “最も深い苦しみの果てに死んでしまいたい”というあの願いが、更に加速していたはずだと感じているのだった。
lines.translated: And I felt certain that my wish to "die at the end of the deepest suffering" would have accelerated even further.

lines.content: それから俺は、柊ハルという女の子とふたりきりで話すことが多くなった。
lines.translated: After that, I ended up talking alone with the girl named Hiiragi Haru much more often.

lines.content: この電話、返すよ
lines.translated: "I'm giving this phone back to you."

lines.content: あの“夜”、ハルから借りたままになっていた“魔法”の端末だ。
lines.translated: It was the "magical" terminal I had borrowed from Haru on that "Night" and held onto ever since.

lines.content: あさひさんからお使いを頼まれたものなら、これはあさひさんに返すべきなのかもしれないけど
lines.translated: "If it was an errand Asahi-san asked you to run, maybe I should be returning it to Asahi-san instead, though."

lines.content: ううん。それ、大雅くんにあげるよ
lines.translated: "Nuh-uh. You can have that, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: え？　でも……
lines.translated: "Huh? But..."

lines.content: あさひさんには、その“魔法”を創るために必要な材料を買って来てって言われてた。それは、この“魔法”が動き出すために必要な“花”だった。電池みたいなものだね
lines.translated: "Asahi-san asked me to go buy the materials needed to create that 'magic.' It was a 'flower' needed to make this 'magic' start working. Kind of like a battery."

lines.content: ああ……。だから、返さなきゃって
lines.translated: "Oh... That's why I thought I had to give it back."

lines.content: でもね。その“魔法”はあさひさんのものじゃなくて、私が、あさひさんに創ってほしいってお願いしたものだから……
lines.translated: "But you see, that 'magic' doesn't belong to Asahi-san. It's something I asked Asahi-san to make for me..."

lines.content: だからあさひさんには返さなくてもいいんだよとハルは言った。
lines.translated: So you don't have to return it to Asahi-san, Haru said.

lines.content: だったらやっぱりこれは返すよ。ハル。この“魔法”がハルには必要だから、あさひさんにお願いして創ってもらったんだよね？
lines.translated: "Then I really should give this back to you, Haru. You asked Asahi-san to make this 'magic' for you because you needed it, right?"

lines.content: うん……。そうだけど
lines.translated: "Yeah... That's true, but..."

lines.content: だけど……？
今はもう、私より大雅くんにそれは必要なんじゃないかなって思う……
lines.translated: "Right now, I think you need it a lot more than I do, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は、姿を消してしまった大切な友だちのことを思う。
lines.translated: I thought of my precious friend who had vanished.

lines.content: 遠い未来の時間を彷徨っていた俺とハル。そんな俺たちを助けてくれたクロ……。あの晩からクロはどこかへ出かけたまま帰ってこない。
lines.translated: Haru and I had been wandering through a distant future time. And Kuro had saved us... Since that night, Kuro had gone off somewhere and hadn't come back.

lines.content: だけど毎晩この端末に電話を掛けてきてくれていた。毎晩欠かさずだ。
lines.translated: Yet every night, she called this terminal for me. Every single night without fail.

lines.content: 今、あの子と俺が繋がれるのはこの小さな“魔法”の機械しかなくて……。
lines.translated: Right now, this tiny "magical" machine was the only thing connecting that girl and me...

lines.content: だからいいの。私の“魔法”を大雅くんにあげるよ……気にしないで。私にはもう必要なくなっちゃったものだし
lines.translated: "So it's fine. I'm giving my 'magic' to you, Taiga-kun... Don't worry about it. It's something I don't need anymore anyway."

lines.content: どうして……？

lines.translated: "Because, you see, I was able to find my hero. So I don't need that phone anymore."

lines.content: 幼いハルはそう言って、淡い微笑みを見せてくれていた。
lines.translated: Saying that, the young Haru gave me a faint smile.

lines.content: 柊ハルという女の子は少し不思議だなと感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that the girl named Hiiragi Haru was a little mysterious.

lines.content: みんなと一緒にいるときと、こうして一対一で話をするときとでは、感じる雰囲気が違って見えた。
lines.translated: The atmosphere around her seemed different when she was with everyone else compared to when we were talking one-on-one like this.

lines.content: みんなの前では元気な子。
lines.translated: In front of everyone else, she was an energetic girl.

lines.content: 俺の前では少々引っ込み思案なところはあれど、こうして穏やかに微笑んで見せてくれるやさしい子。
lines.translated: In front of me, though she was a bit reserved, she was a kind girl who would show me a gentle smile like this.

lines.content: どちらのハルも俺は好きだと感じられていた。
lines.translated: I felt like I liked both sides of Haru.

lines.content: ハルとふたりで過ごすときは、俺もなんだか穏やかな心でいられたし……。
lines.translated: Whenever I spent time alone with Haru, my own heart felt strangely calm, too...

lines.content: みんなのことを先導するかのような元気なハルには、ついふさぎ込みそうになる幼い心に勇気とかをもらえたような気になっていた。
lines.translated: And the energetic Haru who seemed to take the lead for everyone else made me feel as though she were giving courage to my young heart, which was always on the verge of sinking into gloom.

lines.content: （……ハル。実はずっと、君に秘密にしていたことがあるんだよ）
lines.translated: (...Haru. The truth is, there's something I've been keeping a secret from you this whole time.)

lines.content: ――“大雅くんは私を守ってくれるヒーローだったよ”
lines.translated: --"You were a hero who protected me, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 君は俺にそう言ってくれた。
lines.translated: You said that to me.

lines.content: だけど俺も同じだ。
lines.translated: But I feel the exact same way.

lines.content: 君は俺の恩人であり、同時に俺のヒーローだった。
lines.translated: You were my benefactor, and at the same time, you were my hero.

lines.content: （いつも傷ついた誰かにやさしい言葉をくれるだけでなく、[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]誰かのためにがんばろうとする――）
lines.translated: (Not only do you always offer kind words to someone who is hurting, you also try your best like this for someone else's sake--)

lines.content: （歌とか。ダンスだとか。本来の内気なハルには決して得意じゃないだろうことなのに……）
lines.translated: (Singing. Dancing. Even though those are things the naturally shy Haru could never be good at...)

lines.content: （どんなに恥ずかしいことでも。どんなに苦手なことでも。誰かのためにとがんばれる。笑顔で[・|平][・|気][・|な][・|ふ][・|り]ができる子だ）
lines.translated: (No matter how embarrassing it is. No matter how bad she is at it. She can do her best for someone else's sake. She's a girl who can pretend she's completely fine with a smile on her face.)

lines.content: （君はすごいよ。ハル。まさに俺の求める[・|理][・|想][・|の][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ]なんだ。俺も、君のようにありたいよ）
lines.translated: (You're amazing, Haru. You truly embody one of the ideals I strive for. I want to be like you, too.)

lines.content: それは十年という時間が過ぎ去った今もなお、変わることなくこの胸の中に在り続けてくれる思いだから――
lines.translated: Because that is a feeling that continues to live on unchanged inside my chest even now, ten years later--

lines.content: ねえ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 今回のことは……“春の学園祭”は、もしも私ひとりになっても、絶対、ぜったいがんばるから……
lines.translated: "For this... for the 'Spring School Festival,' even if I end up all alone, I'll definitely, definitely do my best..."

lines.content: 両手を握りしめ、そう言うハルだけれど……、
lines.translated: Haru clenched both hands tightly as she said that, and yet...

lines.content: う、うう……っ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: ハル……？
lines.translated: "Haru...?"

lines.content: がんばるって決めても……や、やっぱりその日のこと色々想像しちゃって、胸も、心も、どきどきずきずき、いっぱい痛いけど……。それでも私、がんばるから
lines.translated: "Even though I decided to do my best... I-I still end up imagining all sorts of things about that day, and my chest and my heart are pounding and throbbing, hurting so much... Even so, I'm going to do my best."

lines.content: だからね、大雅くん。もしもライブがこれ以上ないくらく上手くいったら、お願いだよ。ひとつ私のお願い、きいてくれないかな
lines.translated: "So, Taiga-kun. If the concert goes as well as it possibly could, please. Would you grant one wish for me?"

lines.content: ――恩人であり、密かに憧れてもいる人である。そんな君が、こうして俺のことを頼ってくれるのなら……、
lines.translated: --She is my benefactor, and someone I secretly admire. If a person like you is relying on me like this...

lines.content: もしも上手くいったら――お願いします。大雅くん。“魔法少女『使い』”の男の子。どうか、私の“魔法”で、私の“夢”を、叶えてください
lines.translated: "If it goes well--please, Taiga-kun. The 'Magical Girl "User"' boy. Please, with my 'magic,' make my 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ……その願いに、俺は可能な限り、うなずきたいと願うのだった。
lines.translated: In response to that wish, I hoped to nod in agreement as much as I possibly could.

lines.content: ……“春の学園祭”まであと残り三日となった。
lines.translated: There were now only three days left until the "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: しかし智仁がライブでやるという歌を用意することはなかったし、今日もまた、学園を休んでいた。
lines.translated: However, Tomohito still hadn't prepared the song we were supposed to perform at the concert, and today, once again, he was absent from school.

lines.content: うーん。大丈夫なのかな。携帯に電話してみても繋がらないし……
lines.translated: "Hmm. I wonder if he's okay. Even when I try calling his cell phone, it doesn't go through..."

lines.content: 学園を休んでいるだけならまだいい。だがまったく音沙汰なしといった具合だ。
lines.translated: If he were just taking days off from school, that would be one thing. But we haven't heard a single word from him.

lines.content: ともちゃん……。生きてるのかな
lines.translated: "Tomo-chan... I wonder if he's still alive."

lines.content: そ、そんな怖いこと言わないでくださいよ。心配になっちゃいます
lines.translated: "P-Please don't say something so scary! You're going to make me worry."

lines.content: だって……
lines.translated: "Because..."

lines.content: 姫織は唇を尖らせている。
lines.translated: Himeori was pouting.

lines.content: ともちゃんさ、すっごく面どっちがりだけど、電話とかメールとか、絶対にすぐ返してくれる男の子だったのに。それなのに電話も全然繋がらないのは……
lines.translated: "Tomo-chan finds everything super bothersome, yet he was always the kind of boy who would reply to calls and texts right away. For his phone not to connect at all despite that..."

lines.content: そうだね。意外だけど、実はそういうところマメなんだよね。あいつ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's surprising, but he's actually pretty diligent about that sort of thing."

lines.content: だからこそあいつが色々と途中でほっぽり出すようなことはないだろうと思うが……。
lines.translated: Which is precisely why I don't think he'd just abandon everything halfway through, and yet...

lines.content: まあ、学園側に許可取ってスペースとか時間とかを用意してもらってるわけでもない――ただのゲリラって予定だしなあ。
lines.translated: "Well, it's not like we got permission from the school to have a space or time slot prepared for us--it's just planned as a guerrilla concert, after all."

lines.content: なくなったとしても誰かに迷惑かかるわけじゃあないけれど……
lines.translated: "Even if it gets canceled, it won't really cause trouble for anyone, though..."

lines.content: 心配、だよね。がんばりすぎてなければいいけど……
lines.translated: "It's worrying, isn't it? I hope he isn't pushing himself too hard..."

lines.content: そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 姫織の言うように生死を疑うまではいかずとも、部屋でぶっ倒れていたりしなければいいけれど。
lines.translated: Even if we don't go as far as doubting whether he's alive like Himeori said, I hope he hasn't collapsed in his room or anything.

lines.content: あと三日、か
lines.translated: "Three days left, huh?"

lines.content: 店内に飾られたカレンダーを改めて見る。
lines.translated: I looked again at the calendar displayed inside the shop.

lines.content: ハルたちの歌や踊りだとかの練習にも時間は必要だろうし……。諸々平気なのかなあ
lines.translated: "Haru and the others are going to need time to practice singing and dancing, too... I wonder if everything's going to be okay."

lines.content: と、とにかく、今は智仁くんを信じるしか私たちにはできること、ないよね
lines.translated: "A-Anyway, right now, all we can do is believe in Tomohito-kun, right?"

lines.content: グッと胸の前で両手を握りしめるハルだ。
lines.translated: Haru clenched both hands tightly in front of her chest.

lines.content: そうですね。がんばって練習しましょう――今日はもうお店、閉めちゃってもいいよってお父さんが言ってくれましたし
lines.translated: "That's right. Let's do our best to practice--especially since my dad said it's fine for us to close up the shop for the day."

lines.content: そーなの？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: はい。だからいっぱい歌も踊りも、練習できるって思いますよ
lines.translated: "Yes. So I think we'll be able to practice our singing and dancing plenty."

lines.content: ねー……。ハルちゃん。大雅。この練習に何か意味があるのかなあ
lines.translated: "Hey... Haru-chan. Taiga. Is there even any point to this practice?"

lines.content: 不満そうに唇を尖らせている姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori was pouting in dissatisfaction.

lines.content: 本番で使う歌と、自称敏腕プロデューサーであるらしい智仁が欠けていながらも、とりあえず雰囲気だけでもとはじめた練習だったが……。
lines.translated: Even though we were missing the song we'd use for the actual performance as well as Tomohito, our self-proclaimed hotshot producer, we had started practicing just to get a feel for the atmosphere, but...

lines.content: 先輩……。私たちのこの服装。あさひさんが用意してくれたんでしたっけ
lines.translated: "Senpai... These outfits we're wearing. Was it Asahi-san who prepared them for us?"

lines.content: ……今日は、ハルだけではなく千和も姫織もかわいい格好。
lines.translated: Today, not only Haru, but Chiwa and Himeori were also dressed in cute outfits.

lines.content: うん。ちょっとライブの話をしたのがまずかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Bringing up the concert was a mistake."

lines.content: 今のところハルにだけ衣装が用意されてて、だけど智仁はあとふたり分も用意できる余裕がなさそうだと、なんとなくお夕飯の席で話してみたら……。
lines.translated: At the dinner table, I had casually mentioned that only Haru had a costume prepared so far, and that Tomohito didn't seem to have the leeway to prepare outfits for the other two...

lines.content: あさひさん。徹夜でふたり分、用意してくれたみたいなんだ……。すっごい笑顔で渡されてしまったよ。自信作だからって。きっとふたりにぴったりだって
lines.translated: "It seems Asahi-san pulled an all-nighter to make outfits for the two of you... She handed them over to me with a huge smile on her face. Saying she was really proud of them, and that they'd definitely look perfect on you two."

lines.content: そっか。なんだか懐かしいね
lines.translated: "I see. It feels kind of nostalgic, doesn't it?"

lines.content: なつかしいって？
lines.translated: "Nostalgic?"

lines.content: ハルが言い、姫織が首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Haru spoke, and Himeori tilted her head.

lines.content: うん。だって……。十年前の私たちの衣装も、あさひさんが手縫いで用意してくれたものだったもんね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because... the costumes we wore ten years ago were also hand-sewn for us by Asahi-san, right?"

lines.content: んー……。そうだねえ
lines.translated: "Hmm... That's true."

lines.content: あさひさんが夜なべして、アイドル衣装つくってくれたよ
lines.translated: "Asahi-san stayed up late into the night, making idol costumes for us~"

lines.content: 童謡を口ずさむみたいに言った姫織は、ひらひらのスカートの裾を――いきなりだ。
lines.translated: Saying that as if humming a nursery rhyme, Himeori took the hem of her frilly skirt--and out of nowhere.

lines.content: いきなり、突然、たくし上げた。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, completely suddenly, she hiked it up.

lines.content: っ
なに……っ。
lines.translated: Wha--!

lines.content: なに、してんのっ
lines.translated: "What are you doing?!"

lines.content: 下着見えてるしっ。
lines.translated: I can see your underwear!

lines.content: 俺は急いで顔を背けた。
lines.translated: I hurriedly turned my face away.

lines.content: えー……？
えー、じゃなくって……！
lines.translated: "'Huh?' is not the right response here...!"

lines.content: だってここには女の子しかしないし……？
lines.translated: "Well, there are only girls here anyway...?"

lines.content: お、俺がいますが……
lines.translated: "I-I'm right here, though..."

lines.content: ははっ
lines.translated: "Haha."

lines.content: ……なぜ笑うし
lines.translated: "...Why are you laughing?"

lines.content: い、いいから、夜月先輩。そんなことしちゃだめですよ。ちゃんとしまって……
lines.translated: "C-Come on, Yozuki-senpai. You mustn't do things like that. Put it down properly..."

lines.content: 大雅は準備はしないのかい？
lines.translated: "Aren't you going to get ready, Taiga?"

lines.content: 恐る恐る振り向いた。
lines.translated: I timidly looked back.

lines.content: 大雅も、私たちと一緒にライブ出るんだよね？　かわいい服で
lines.translated: "You're going to perform in the concert with us too, right, Taiga? In a cute outfit."

lines.content: ……何か、同じ質問を何度も受けてるような気がするなあ
lines.translated: "...I feel like I've been asked this exact same question multiple times already."

lines.content: 出ないから。
lines.translated: "Because I'm not performing."

lines.content: と、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: と、姫織は言う。
lines.translated: So Himeori responded.

lines.content: 出ないものは出ない。ずるい！　ずるいって、何で。私たちばっかり働いて大雅は何もしないのずるい。
lines.translated: "If I say I'm not performing, I'm not performing." "Unfair!" "What do you mean, unfair?" "It's unfair that we're the only ones working while you don't do anything, Taiga."

lines.content: むさい女装男子の歌と踊りを見たい者などどこにいるのか。ここに、ここにいますが。
lines.translated: "Where on earth is there anyone who wants to see a scruffy guy in drag singing and dancing?" "Right here, there's one right here."

lines.content: 等と、よくわからない攻防を繰り返してしまう。
lines.translated: And so on, we ended up repeating that nonsensical back-and-forth.

lines.content: ……どうして。なあ、どうしてなんだいひよちゃん。どうしてそんな頑なに俺を引き込もうとするんだ
lines.translated: "...Why? Hey, why, Hiyo-chan? Why are you so dead set on dragging me into this?"

lines.content: かわいくならば、[もろとも|諸共]
lines.translated: "If we're going to be cute, we're going down together."

lines.content: まったくよくわかんないことを
lines.translated: "You're making no sense at all."

lines.content: ……等々と。
lines.translated: And so on and so forth.

lines.content: どうしていいかわからず時間を持て余している俺たちだったが、
lines.translated: Not knowing what to do, we were left with too much time on our hands, when--

lines.content: ……いや。実は俺も大雅には結構、期待してるんだけどな
lines.translated: "...No, actually, I've got pretty high hopes for Taiga myself."

lines.content: お店の扉が開かれると共に、そんな言葉が聞こえてきた。振り返る。
lines.translated: Along with the shop door opening, those words reached our ears. I turned around.

lines.content: やあ、みんな。学園休んでたの少しの間だけなのに、なんだかすごく久しぶりに会ったような気がする
lines.translated: "Hey, everyone. I only took a few days off from school, yet it feels like it's been a really long time since I saw you all."

lines.content: 智仁がいた。ちょっと疲れたような表情でそこに立っていた。
lines.translated: It was Tomohito. He was standing there with a slightly tired expression on his face.

lines.content: あ、ああ……。みんな心配してたぞ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah... Everyone was worried about you."

lines.content: もちろん俺もだ。
lines.translated: Myself included, of course.

lines.content: 連絡もつかないし、学園は無断で休んでるみたいだったし……。もしかして部屋でぶっ倒れてるんじゃないかって、そんな話もしてたんだぞ
lines.translated: "We couldn't get in touch with you, and it seemed like you were skipping school without notice... We were even talking about how you might have collapsed in your room."

lines.content: ごめん。スマホも殆ど放置だった
lines.translated: "Sorry. I pretty much left my smartphone untouched."

lines.content: 苦笑いで智仁は言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito said with a wry smile.

lines.content: 本当なら今日は学園、行こうと思ってたんだけど……。[・|完][・|成]がずるずる伸びて、気づいたらもうこんな時間だ
lines.translated: "I actually meant to go to school today, though... Finishing it kept dragging on and on, and before I knew it, it was already this late."

lines.content: 着信いっぱい溜まってたのにも気づいたから、まず電話しようか悩んだんだけど。まだお店にみんないるなら先に直接顔出してみようと思って。よかった。間に合ったんだな
lines.translated: "I noticed I had a ton of missed calls piled up too, so I debated calling first. But I figured if everyone was still at the shop, I'd try showing up in person first. Thank goodness. I made it in time."

lines.content: 智仁くん、それって……
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun, does that mean..."

lines.content: ああ、うん
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah."

lines.content: 何も言わず引きこもっちゃて、ごめん――不思議だけど、いきなり曲が書けるようになったんだ。少し前の朝だよ。目を覚ましたら急に何か書けるような気がして……
lines.translated: "Sorry for shutting myself in without saying a word--it's strange, but all of a sudden, I became able to write a song. It happened a few mornings ago. When I woke up, I suddenly felt like I could write something..."
He became able to write a song.

lines.content: その言葉に誰も無用な突っ込みを入れるものはこの場にいなかった。
lines.translated: There was no one here who would make any unnecessary remarks about those words.

lines.content: そうか。それからずっと引きこもって作業してたってことなんだな
lines.translated: "I see. So you've been holed up working on it ever since then, huh?"

lines.content: ああ……。まさかそこまで心配してもらえてるとは思わなかったんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah... I never thought you guys would be that worried about me."

lines.content: ごめんなと智仁はもう一度言い、微笑む。
lines.translated: Tomohito apologized once more and smiled.

lines.content: でも、おかげでできたよ。ついさっき、ちょうどだ
lines.translated: "But thanks to that, it's done. Just a moment ago, right on time."

lines.content: 智仁の言う“不思議”には心当たりがありすぎた。
lines.translated: I had a very good idea of what the "strange" thing Tomohito spoke of was.

lines.content: 兎蛙あず咲の思い残しが形となった“誰か”が“魔法”となって、“夢”を叶えるためにがんばりたいと願う弟の力となってくれたのだろう。
lines.translated: The "someone" formed from Towa Azusaki's lingering regrets had become "magic," lending strength to her younger brother who wished to do his best to make a "dream" come true.

lines.content: 今、あのひとはどうしているんだろうか。
lines.translated: What is she doing right now, I wonder?

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら、今は弟の――智仁の声に耳を傾ける。
lines.translated: Thinking about that, I listened closely to her younger brother's--to Tomohito's voice for now.

lines.content: 本当に不思議だけれど、急に……はは、なんだかこんなこと言うのは気恥ずかしいけどさ、急に“何か”が降りてきたって、いうか
lines.translated: "It's really strange, though. All of a sudden... Haha, it's kind of embarrassing to say something like this, but it's like 'something' suddenly came down to me, or rather..."

lines.content: おお～、すんごいともちゃん。まるでプロの人みたい
lines.translated: "Ooh~, amazing, Tomo-chan! You sound just like a pro!"

lines.content: ぱちぱちと手を叩く姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori clapped her hands together.

lines.content: いや……、えっと
ちょっと複雑そうな表情を見せつつも、智仁は言う。
lines.translated: Though he showed a slightly conflicted expression, Tomohito spoke.

lines.content: と、とにかくさ……。作曲のための知識や技術だけは子どもの頃から教育されてた。とは言っても、本当に最低限の最低限しか俺は教えられなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "A-Anyway... I was taught the knowledge and techniques for composing since I was a kid. Though even then, I was really only taught the absolute bare minimum..."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|の]はさ、知識や技術があったところで、ある程度以上のものは絶対形にできないものなんだろうからね
lines.translated: "With stuff like this, even if you have the knowledge and technique, you probably can't ever give shape to anything beyond a certain level."

lines.content: だけどある日突然、ふっと降りてきた“何か”を決して逃さぬよう、そのまま懸命に、懸命に、“何か”をたぐり寄せようとし――ようやく完成だ。
lines.translated: However, one day out of nowhere, determined not to let that "something" that suddenly came down to him slip away, he desperately, frantically tried to reel it in--and finally, it was complete.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は智仁の手にしているスマホの中にあるのだという。
lines.translated: He said that "it" was right inside the smartphone in his hand.

lines.content: ……聴かせてもらえるのかな？
lines.translated: "...Can we listen to it?"

lines.content: もちろん。みんなに聴いてほしいよ――俺、兎蛙智仁の、[・|最][・|初][・|で][・|最][・|後]の自作曲だから
lines.translated: "Of course. I want everyone to hear it--because it's the first and last original song by me, Tomohito Towa."

lines.content: 最後の……？
lines.translated: "The last...?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 首をかしげたハルに、智仁は照れくさそうに微笑む。そしてスマホを操作し始めた。
lines.translated: As Haru tilted her head, Tomohito gave a sheepish smile and began operating his smartphone.

lines.content: もうみんな、わかってると思うけどさ。今まで俺は一曲もまともに音楽作ったことがないんだ
