lines.translated: "I think everyone already knows this, though. Until now, I've never properly written a single piece of music."

lines.content: それなのにさも[・|そ][・|れ]は潤沢と日々、蓄えられていってる――みたいな言い方してきたけれど
lines.translated: "And yet, I kept talking as if I were steadily building up a huge stockpile of them every day..."

lines.content: なんだっけ。ほら……[ひょうたん|瓢箪]から駒だよ
lines.translated: "What do they call it? You know... a stroke of luck out of nowhere."

lines.content: 言葉にしていればいつかは現実にならないかと、心のどこかで願ってた。だって、俺たちは思い描けばすべて叶う。そんな世界を出入りしていたんだから
lines.translated: "Somewhere in my heart, I was hoping that if I just put it into words, it might become reality someday. Because if we just picture it in our minds, everything comes true for us. That's the kind of world we were going in and out of, after all."

lines.content: ごめんな。今までうそばかりついてて
lines.translated: "Sorry for telling nothing but lies until now."

lines.content: ……いや
俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: 誰も傷つけることのない小さな嘘だ。そんなことで、ここにいる誰も不平や不満を発する者はいないはずだ。
lines.translated: It was a harmless little lie that didn't hurt anyone. No one here would ever voice any complaints or dissatisfaction over something like that.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 誰も不平や不満も、口にはしない。
lines.translated: Nobody said a single word of complaint.

lines.content: ただ疑問はきっとあるはずだ。
lines.translated: Still, there was bound to be a question on their minds.

lines.content: ともちゃん。もしその“不思議”がなかったら、どうしてたの？
lines.translated: "Tomo-chan. What would you have done if that 'strange' thing hadn't happened?"

lines.content: 姫織が首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head.

lines.content: 何日か前の朝に突然、ともちゃんに“不思議”が起きて……。それで歌を作れるようになったって言ってたけれど
lines.translated: "You said that something 'strange' suddenly happened to you a few mornings ago... and that's how you became able to write a song, right?"
"What if that hadn't happened...? What were you going to do?"

lines.content: んー……。いやあ、簡単な話だよ。深い意味も考えも何もないんだ
lines.translated: "Hmm... Well, it's pretty simple. There wasn't any deep meaning or thought behind it at all."

lines.content: 回避しようのない締め切りみたいなものを作って自分を追い込めば、これまでにない“何か”が自分に起こるんじゃないかって……
lines.translated: "I figured if I backed myself into a corner by setting up an unavoidable deadline, maybe an unprecedented 'something' would happen to me..."

lines.content: ぎりぎりにまで追い込まれたほうが、何か……ふつうのときに作るのとはまた全然違う“何か”が、歌に、音楽に、こもるんじゃないかって。そんな期待もあったんだ
lines.translated: "I also had this hope that if I were pushed to the absolute limit, maybe... a 'something' completely different from what I'd make under normal circumstances would be poured into the song, into the music."

lines.content: まあ、うん。今思えば、あんまりにもあんまりな見切り発車だけれどね。でも、それくらいのことをしなければ、俺にはとても……どんな歌も作れなかった――
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. Looking back on it now, I jumped the gun way too recklessly. But if I hadn't gone that far, there's no way I could have... written any song at all--"

lines.content: そこで智仁はスマホの画面を俺たちに向けた。
lines.translated: At that point, Tomohito turned the screen of his smartphone toward us.

lines.content: ――本番まで時間はもうない。もし、このメロディに少しだけでも共感してくれたなら、お願いだ。みんな、俺の我がままに力を貸してくれないかな
lines.translated: "--There's no time left until the real performance. If you can resonate with this melody even just a little bit, please. Everyone, won't you lend me your strength for my selfish wish?"

lines.content: 智仁の手の中で、その端末がたったひとつの旋律を発している。
lines.translated: In Tomohito's hand, the device began playing a single melody.

lines.content: 俺たちは静かにそれを聴いていた。
lines.translated: We listened to it quietly.

lines.content: シンセサイザーで主となるメロディと、それを簡単な和音で飾り付けたものだった。
lines.translated: It consisted of a main melody played on a synthesizer, dressed up with simple chords.

lines.content: それだけの音源でも、不思議だ。智仁がそこに何を込めたいのか、何を込めようとしていたのか、語られずとも理解できるようだった。
lines.translated: Even with just that simple audio track, it was strange. Without a single word being spoken, I felt like I could understand what Tomohito wanted to pour into it, what he had been trying to put into it.

lines.content: これって……
lines.translated: "This is..."

lines.content: まず最初に反応したのはハルだった。
lines.translated: The very first to react was Haru.

lines.content: 息をのむ。
lines.translated: Breathless.

lines.content: その横顔はまさにそんな言葉がぴったりであるように、見えた。
lines.translated: Looking at her profile, that word seemed to fit her expression to a T.

lines.content: ……え、えっと。どう、だったかな。気に入らなかった？
lines.translated: "...U-Um. How was it? Did you not like it?"

lines.content: ハルの表情に不安そうな智仁だった。
lines.translated: Seeing Haru's expression, Tomohito looked anxious.

lines.content: どこかぼんやりとしたまま、智仁を見て、
lines.translated: Gazing at Tomohito in a slight daze,

lines.content: ……あっ、う、ううん。そんなことないよ
lines.translated: "...Ah, n-no. That's not it at all."

lines.content: 我に返ったようにハッとして、ハルは首を勢いよく横に振っていた。
lines.translated: Gasping as if coming back to her senses, Haru shook her head vigorously.

lines.content: すごいよ。智仁くん。……智仁くんの気持ちが全部、手に取るようにわかる。そんな気がするよ
lines.translated: "It's amazing, Tomohito-kun. ...I feel like I can clearly understand all of your feelings, Tomohito-kun. That's what it feels like."

lines.content: ……ハルが、まるで俺の気持ちを代弁するみたいにして微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Haru was smiling, speaking as if on behalf of my own feelings.

lines.content: 生意気な言い方かもしれないけれど、思ってたよりずっとずっといい感じだったから、驚いちゃって
lines.translated: "This might sound a littlecheeky, but it was so, so much better than I expected that it caught me completely by surprise."

lines.content: そ、そっか……
lines.translated: "I-I see..."

lines.content: よかった、と智仁はうなずく。
lines.translated: "Thank goodness," Tomohito nodded.

lines.content: せめて歌ってもらうみんなが恥ずかしくないくらいの曲になっていてくれたらって、そう祈ってたんだけど……
lines.translated: "I was just praying that it would at least turn out to be a song you guys wouldn't feel embarrassed singing, so..."

lines.content: 私、この曲好きです
lines.translated: "I really like this song."

lines.content: 千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa piped up.

lines.content: 流行の歌のことはよくわからない私ですけど……、きっと、この曲はたくさんの人が好きになってくれるような気がします
lines.translated: "I don't know much about popular music, though... I have a feeling that lots of people are going to fall in love with this song."

lines.content: うん。そうだね。私もそう思うよ？
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I think so too, you know?"

lines.content: うんうんと姫織はうなずいている。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded in agreement.

lines.content: 何かね、こう……心の奥のほうがぴりぴりってする感じ。とっても大好き
lines.translated: "It's like... it gives me this tingling feeling deep inside my heart. I love it so much."

lines.content: い、いやあ……。何か、あれだ。こんなに褒められたことないから、素直に照れるなあ
lines.translated: "W-Well... Man, you know. I've never been praised this much before, so it's honestly making me blush."

lines.content: 苦笑いで智仁は言い、時計をちらりと見た。
lines.translated: Tomohito said with a wry smile, glancing at the clock.

lines.content: 今日はどうなのかな、千和ちゃん。まだ時間は大丈夫？
lines.translated: "How are things looking today, Chiwa-chan? Are we still good on time?"

lines.content: はい。お父さんが貸し切り状態にしてくれました。だからもう少し練習できるって思います――あ、でも、あんまり遅くはならないようにねって、お父さんからの伝言です
lines.translated: "Yes. My dad closed the shop to the public just for us. So I think we can practice a little longer--ah, but my dad did leave a message saying not to stay too late."

lines.content: よーし。それじゃあ……ダンス？　ダンスの練習？　大雅をかわいい感じにして、四人で歌って踊っちゃう？
lines.translated: "Alrighty! Well then... dancing? Dance practice? Shall we make Taiga look all cute and sing and dance together as a quartet?"

lines.content: いや、だからね？　俺はしないって言ってるじゃん？
lines.translated: "No, like I keep saying, didn't I tell you I'm not doing it?"

lines.content: ……大丈夫だよね。平気だよね。
lines.translated: I'm good, right? I'm safe, right?

lines.content: このままずるずるなし崩される、なんてこと、ないよね？
lines.translated: I'm not going to get slowly worn down and dragged into this, right?

lines.content: 学園祭まであと三日か
lines.translated: "Three days left until the school festival, huh?"

lines.content: 智仁は店内の時計を見ながら、渋い顔だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito made a grim face as he looked at the clock inside the shop.

lines.content: うーん。ダンスは……惜しいけど、今回は止めておこう。練習してる時間がない
lines.translated: "Hmm. It's a shame about the dancing... but let's drop it this time. We don't have the time to practice."

lines.content: ダンスなしで、歌を歌うだけ？
lines.translated: "No dancing, just singing the song?"

lines.content: そうだね。衣装はこのままで。みんなかわいいからそれでも充分以上だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Keep the outfits as they are. Everyone looks cute, so that alone is more than enough."

lines.content: 今夜はみんなで詩を作れればって思う
lines.translated: "I'm thinking it'd be great if we could all write the lyrics together tonight."

lines.content: あ、そっか。まだ歌詞がないんだ
lines.translated: "Ah, right. We don't have any lyrics yet."

lines.content: うん。申し訳ない。それだけの余裕も……別に必要以上に自分を卑下するわけじゃあないけれど、そのための力もなかった。だからみんなに協力を願いたいんだ。それに
lines.translated: "Yeah. Sorry about that. I didn't have the leeway for it... and I'm not trying to put myself down more than necessary, but I didn't have the ability for it either. That's why I want to ask for everyone's help. Besides..."

lines.content: それに？
lines.translated: "And besides?"

lines.content: ああ。それにね。これは大切な誰かに届けるための歌だ。その誰かは、みんなも知っているひとだから……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Besides, you know... this is a song meant to reach someone precious to me. And since that someone is a person you all know too..."

lines.content: だからさ、もしお願いできるのなら、みんなにもその誰かへ届ける言葉を、一緒に考えてもらえればと思うんだ
lines.translated: "So, if it's not too much to ask, I was hoping everyone could help me come up with the words to deliver to that person together."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up.
"...I'm going to--we're going to make this 'song.' We're going to bring it closer to completion."

lines.content: ハル？
lines.translated: "Haru?"

lines.content: う、ううん。何でもない
lines.translated: "N-No, it's nothing."

lines.content: ハルは首を振り、微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Haru shook her head and smiled.

lines.content: 本当に、本当にね。いい歌にできたらいいなあって、そう思ったんだよ。ただ、それだけ
lines.translated: "Really, truly. I just thought about how nice it would be if we could make it a really good song. That's all."

lines.content: そこから全員で作詞をすることとなった。
lines.translated: From there, we all ended up working on the lyrics together.

lines.content: もちろんここにいる誰もがみんな、はじめてのことだった。わいわいと話すばかりでは形になるはずもない。
lines.translated: Of course, it was the very first time for everyone here. Just chatting noisily wasn't going to give it any real shape.

lines.content: うーん……。歌を作るのって難しいんだね
lines.translated: "Hmm... Writing a song is really hard, isn't it?"

lines.content: ハルが腕を組み、言う。
lines.translated: Haru crossed her arms and spoke.

lines.content: 流行の歌とか何気なく聴いてるけど、誰もがいっぱいがんばって、うんうん困りながら、一曲一曲作っていってるんだね……
lines.translated: "I always listen to popular songs without thinking much about it, but everyone works so hard and racks their brains to make each and every song, huh..."

lines.content: ちょっと私、お父さんにアドバイスもらって来ます
lines.translated: "I'm going to go ask my dad for some advice real quick."

lines.content: お父さんに……？
lines.translated: "Your dad...?"

lines.content: はい。私のお父さん、そういうのに詳しいんですよ
lines.translated: "Yes. My dad knows a lot about this kind of thing."

lines.content: にっこりと言い、千和はフロアから出て行った。
lines.translated: Saying that with a bright smile, Chiwa left the floor.

lines.content: そしてしばらくして戻って来たけれど、
lines.translated: She came back after a little while, though,

lines.content: う、ううー……
lines.translated: "U-Uuu..."

lines.content: 千和ちゃん……？
lines.translated: "Chiwa-chan...?"

lines.content: 戻ってきた千和は真っ赤になっていた。
lines.translated: When she returned, her face was bright red.

lines.content: どうかしたの？　千和。ほっぺがリンゴみたいだよ？
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Chiwa? Your cheeks look just like apples, you know?"

lines.content: お父さんに“かわいい服だね”って言われちゃって……。うう。着替えるの忘れてました。恥ずかしいです……
lines.translated: "My dad told me, 'That's a cute outfit'... Ugh. I completely forgot to change back. That's so embarrassing..."

lines.content: 詞を考えるため、三人とも学園の制服に戻る。
lines.translated: In order to brainstorm the lyrics, all three of them changed back into their school uniforms.

lines.content: 本番前にしわになったり汚れてしまったりしたら大変だから。
lines.translated: After all, it would be terrible if the outfits got wrinkled or dirty before the actual performance.

lines.content: 千和がお父さんからもらってきたアドバイスはこんな感じだった。
lines.translated: The advice Chiwa got from her dad went something like this.

lines.content: ……まずはテーマを決めるといいんじゃないかなと言ってました
lines.translated: "...He said it might be good to decide on a theme first."

lines.content: テーマ……？
lines.translated: "A theme...?"

lines.content: はい。たとえば友情の歌にするのか。恋の歌にするのか
lines.translated: "Yes. For example, whether to make it a song about friendship, or a song about love."

lines.content: 恋の歌かあ……。なんだか美味しそうじゃないけど、流行の歌はだいたいみんなそんな感じだよね
lines.translated: "A love song, huh... That doesn't sound very appetizing, though popular songs are pretty much all like that, aren't they?"

lines.content: その場合は悲しい恋のお話になるのか、希望のあるお話になるのか……。そのお話の主人公は誰なのか。季節はいつなのか
lines.translated: "In that case, will it be a sad love story, or a hopeful story...? Who is the protagonist of that story? What season is it set in?"

lines.content: そういうふうに、物語を書いていくみたいに少しずつ決めていくといいんじゃなかなって言ってました
lines.translated: "He said it would be good to decide on things like that little by little, just like writing a story."

lines.content: そっか。物語、か
lines.translated: "I see. A story, huh?"

lines.content: うなずき、少し考えたところで、
lines.translated: After nodding and thinking for a moment,

lines.content: この歌のテーマは……
lines.translated: "The theme of this song is..."

lines.content: しかしそこで智仁は固まってしまっていた。
lines.translated: However, right there, Tomohito froze completely.

lines.content: 智仁？
lines.translated: "Tomohito?"

lines.content: どうした？　と俺は首をかしげる。
lines.translated: "What's wrong?" I tilted my head.

lines.content: いや……。ええっと
lines.translated: "Well... Um..."

lines.content: たとえばさ、ここで俺がこの歌のテーマは“恋”にしよう、とか言い出すと……それってつまり
lines.translated: "For example, if I were to come out right now and say let's make the theme of this song 'love'... then that would basically mean..."

lines.content: うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 姫織がうなずき、言う。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded and spoke up.

lines.content: ともちゃんはただいま絶賛恋愛の真っ最中なんだなあって、ここにいる誰もが察しちゃって、大雅あたりはちょっと気まずくなってしまう可能性も大いにありますよね
lines.translated: "Everyone here would figure out that Tomo-chan is right in the middle of a big romance, and there's a strong chance someone like Taiga would end up feeling a little awkward about it."

lines.content: う、むう……。まあ、そうなるよな
lines.translated: "U-Ugh... Well, yeah, that's how it'd go."

lines.content: いやいや。なぜ、俺が気まずく
lines.translated: "Wait, hold on. Why would I feel awkward?"

lines.content: 男の子は仲良しの友だちが先に[・|い][・|い][・|人]見つけるとひがんじゃうんだって聞いたよ？
lines.translated: "I heard that boys get jealous when a close friend finds a 'special someone' before they do, though?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: うん。あながち嘘でもないが
lines.translated: "Yeah, well, that's not entirely untrue, I guess."

lines.content: ぐぅ……
いや大丈夫だって。まあ、確かに？　ちょっとこれから智仁に、お前に対して冷たくはなるだろうが、それだけだ――テーマは“恋”だな？　それでいいんだな？　どうなんだ智仁
lines.translated: "Nah, it's fine, really. I mean, sure? I might be a little cold toward you from now on, Tomohito, just a bit, toward you specifically, but that's all--so the theme is 'love,' right? You're good with that? Well, how about it, Tomohito?"

lines.content: た、大雅くん……
lines.translated: "T-Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: うわあ……
先輩……
lines.translated: "Senpai..."

lines.content: 三人分の冷ややかな視線にも俺は負けない。
lines.translated: I refused to be defeated by the icy stares of the three girls.

lines.content: い、いいんだよ。別に――
lines.translated: "I-It's fine. Seriously--"

lines.content: 俺が言いたかったのは[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]じゃなくて。
lines.translated: That wasn't *what I was trying* to say.

lines.content: ――ここにいるみんなちゃんとわかってる。今さら、[・|そ][・|れ][・|く][・|ら][・|い]なんだよ。智仁。色々な“恋”の形があったっていいじゃないか
lines.translated: "--Everyone here already understands. At this point, *that much* is obvious, Tomohito. There's nothing wrong with having all kinds of different forms of 'love,' is there?"

lines.content: ああそうだ。みんななんとなくわかってた。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right. Everyone more or less knew.

lines.content: 兎蛙智仁。
lines.translated: Toa Tomohito.

lines.content: 誰もがこいつのことを嫌わない。“無敵”な男だ。
lines.translated: Nobody disliked this guy. He was an "invincible" man.

lines.content: イケメンで実際にモテモテなこいつがどうして彼女を進んで作ろうとしないのか。
lines.translated: Why did a handsome guy who was genuinely popular with girls never actively try to get a girlfriend?

lines.content: それは叶わぬ恋をずっとずっとしてるからだ。
lines.translated: It was because he had been harboring an unrequited love for a very, very long time.

lines.content: いいや。叶わぬどころか、決して許されない“恋”をしてるから――
lines.translated: No. Far from just being unrequited, he was in a "love" that could never be allowed--

lines.content: その気持ちを智仁はいつまでもずっと、秘密にし続けていたのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Tomohito had probably intended to keep those feelings a secret forever and ever, though...

lines.content: そしてこれからも秘密にしたまま、あるいは孤独に生涯を終えるつもりだったのだろうけれど。
lines.translated: And he had probably intended to keep them a secret from here on out too, maybe even living out the rest of his life alone.

lines.content: ……実の姉に“恋”の歌を届けたがる弟なんて。そんなの、あんまりにも気持ち悪いよな
lines.translated: "...A younger brother wanting to deliver a 'love' song to his own biological older sister. Something like that is way too creepy, isn't it?"

lines.content: でもさ、と智仁は言う。
lines.translated: "But you know," Tomohito said.

lines.content: これは今までの俺の気持ち全部と“さよなら”するための歌でもあるんだ。確かに俺は姉ちゃんが好きだった。でも、その気持ちは本当に……本当に[・|そ][・|う]だったのか
lines.translated: "This is also a song to say 'goodbye' to all the feelings I've had up until now. It's true that I loved my sister. But were those feelings really... really *like that*?"
*What did I actually want to become with my sister*...?

lines.content: 今となってはもうそれを確かめる術がない。この気持ちを伝える相手だってどこにもいない
lines.translated: "At this point, there's no way to confirm that anymore. And the person I want to convey these feelings to isn't anywhere to be found."

lines.content: だから、この歌を届けたい
lines.translated: "That's why I want to deliver this song."

lines.content: この歌は姉ちゃんへの告白の言葉であり、姉ちゃんへの別れの言葉でもあって……え、えっと、つまり。これは“愛”と“勇気”の歌なんだ
lines.translated: "This song is a confession to my sister, and at the same time, it's a farewell to her... U-Um, in other words, this is a song of 'love' and 'courage.'"

lines.content: 智仁が、言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito spoke.

lines.content: 生涯たったひとりを……。[・|あ][・|な][・|た]だけを愛し続けると誓うための“歌”であってほしい。そんな“想い”を込めたい。そう、願ってる。だ、だから……
lines.translated: "Only one person in my whole life... I want it to be a 'song' to swear that I'll keep loving only *you*. That's the kind of 'feeling' I want to put into it. That's what I'm wishing for. S-So..."

lines.content: ああ。わかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Got it."

lines.content: 俺は、うなずく。もうそれ以上何も言わなくていいと。
lines.translated: I nodded, telling him he didn't need to say anything more than that.

lines.content: テーマは“恋”だ。ああ、そうだ。これは……この“歌”は、これ以上ないくらいの“愛”と“勇気”の“歌”にしよう
lines.translated: "The theme is 'love.' Yeah, that's right. Let's make this... let's make this 'song' the greatest 'song' of 'love' and 'courage' there could ever be."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そして……他に決めなきゃならないことは、どうする？　物語みたいにして、テーマの他にも登場人物だとかを色々決めれば、やりやすいかもって話だったけど
lines.translated: "And... what should we do about the other things we need to decide? We talked about how it might be easier if we treated it like a story and decided on the characters and stuff in addition to the theme."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 物語の季節は、春にしたい。姉ちゃんは春が……さくらの花が、大好きだったから
lines.translated: "I want the season of the story to be spring. Because my sister loved spring... she loved cherry blossoms."

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑いを浮かべ、天井を見た。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a wry smile and looked up at the ceiling.

lines.content: みんなもつられて見上げる。
lines.translated: Everyone else followed his gaze and looked up too.

lines.content: あのさくらが……。学園の枯れざくらだよ。姉ちゃんはあのさくらが満開に咲くのをいつかまた見たいって言ってた
lines.translated: "That cherry tree... The withered cherry tree at the academy. My sister said she wanted to see that tree bloom in full glory again someday."

lines.content: そしたら一緒にお花見しに行こうって。……手を、繋いで。ふたりで。そんな約束もしてたんだ
lines.translated: "She said that when it did, we'd go cherry blossom viewing together. ...Holding hands. Just the two of us. We made a promise like that, too."

lines.content: だからさ、あのさくらが満開に咲いた風景も“歌”に乗せて届けたい。どうかな？
lines.translated: "So, I want to put the scenery of that cherry tree in full bloom into the 'song' and deliver it to her. What do you think?"

lines.content: ああ。異論なんてどこにもないさ
lines.translated: "Yeah. No objections here at all."

lines.content: これはお前の歌なんだ。智仁。お前が好きに彩れば良い。
lines.translated: This is your song, Tomohito. You should color it however you like.

lines.content: ……千和のお父さんのアドバイス通りだった。
lines.translated: It went just like Chiwa's dad had advised.

lines.content: テーマなどを色々と決めてしまうと、目標みたいなものが狭まるからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe it was because deciding on the theme and other details narrowed down our goal.

lines.content: 後は、するすると――とまではさすがに言い難くとも、しかし深夜前には殆ど歌詞の形ができあがってしまった。
lines.translated: After that, even if you couldn't quite say it went effortlessly, the lyrics had mostly taken shape before midnight.

lines.content: ああ……っ、施設に連絡し忘れてたっ、遅くなりますってっ
lines.translated: "Aaah...! I forgot to contact the facility to tell them I'd be late!"

lines.content: スマホに着歴いっぱいだよ……っ、とハルは涙目で連絡を入れていた。
lines.translated: "My phone is full of missed calls...!" Haru said with teary eyes as she contacted them.

lines.content: おおぅ……。なんだかお腹がぐーぐー鳴ると思ったら、もうこんな大変なお時間に
lines.translated: "Oh my... Here I was wondering why my stomach was growling so much, and it's already such a late hour."

lines.content: あんまり遅くならないようにねってお父さんに言われたのに……。集中しちゃってました
lines.translated: "Even though my dad told me not to stay out too late... I got completely absorbed in it."

lines.content: それぞれがわたわたと帰りの準備をする中で、智仁が……ぽつりと、言った。
lines.translated: While everyone was hurriedly getting ready to go home, Tomohito... murmured quietly.

lines.content: “さくら、もゆ”
lines.translated: "'Sakura, Moyu.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……この歌のタイトルだよ
lines.translated: "...It's the title of this song."

lines.content: “さくら、もゆ”で、どうかな。智仁ははにかんで、そう言った。
lines.translated: "How about 'Sakura, Moyu'?" Tomohito said with a shy smile.

lines.content: その意味は？
lines.translated: "What does it mean?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 智仁は、笑顔のままうなずいた。
lines.translated: Still smiling, Tomohito nodded.

lines.content: これは“恋”の歌だ
lines.translated: "This is a song about 'love.'"

lines.content: ……生涯たったひとりを愛すると誓う、“愛”と“勇気”の歌なんだ
lines.translated: "...A song of 'love' and 'courage,' swearing to love only one person for the rest of my life."

lines.content: そして、この歌を聴いた人たちにとって、その人生にとって、ほんの少しでいいんだ。夜の中でも花咲くような“希望”であってほしいと、俺は、思ってる――
lines.translated: "And for the people who listen to this song, for their lives, even if it's just a little bit... I want it to be a 'hope' that blooms even in the middle of the night. That's what I think--"

lines.content: いいことも。悪いことも。誰にも様々な出来事が押し寄せてくるのが“人生”だ。苦しいけれど。悲しいけれど。そういうふうになっている。
lines.translated: Good things. Bad things. "Life" is when all sorts of events come crashing down on everyone. Even though it's painful. Even though it's sad. That's just how it's made.

lines.content: そんな世界の中ででも“恋”することができるのは、それがどんな結果になろうとも……それはきっと、“幸せ”であることの証しなのではないか。
lines.translated: Being able to fall in "love" even in a world like that, no matter what the outcome may be... isn't that surely proof of being "happy"?

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: この小さな“春の歌”を聴いた少年少女たち、すべての心に芽生える小さな“恋”が……
lines.translated: "The little 'love' that buds in the hearts of all the boys and girls who listen to this little 'spring song'..."

lines.content: その先に待ち構えてるだろうそれぞれの人生が……
lines.translated: "And each of their lives waiting for them ahead..."

lines.content: あの大きなおおきなさくらの花と一緒に、いつか満開に花咲くことを、祈って――この歌のタイトルを、“さくら、もゆ”と、そうしたい
lines.translated: "Praying that they'll someday bloom in full glory alongside those big, huge cherry blossoms--I want to name this song 'Sakura, Moyu.'"

lines.content: 智仁は、作詞のために言葉がずらりと並んだノートを見つめ、そう言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito stared down at the notebook lined with words for the lyrics as he said that.

lines.content: ああ。いいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Yeah. Sounds good to me."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: きっとその想いも、誰かに届くさ
lines.translated: "I'm sure those feelings will reach someone, too."

lines.content: “春の学園祭”
lines.translated: The "Spring School Festival."

lines.content: そこにゲリラ的につっ込むための歌も殆ど仕上がった。
lines.translated: The song for our guerrilla performance was mostly finished now, too.

lines.content: あとは、当日。
lines.translated: All that was left was the day itself.

lines.content: 生徒たちの心に残るよう祈り……。
lines.translated: Praying that it would remain in the students' hearts...

lines.content: 大人たちには大いに叱られるだろうことを覚悟して……。
lines.translated: And bracing ourselves for the massive scolding we'd surely get from the adults...

lines.content: 残り数日。
lines.translated: Only a few days left.

lines.content: できるかぎりの準備をしよう。
lines.translated: Let's prepare as much as we possibly can.

lines.content: 俺の女装がどうのという話は、このままうやむやになってしまえと、密かに祈っていた。
lines.translated: I secretly prayed that the whole talk about me crossdressing would just get swept under the rug as things went on.

lines.content: ――用意するに最大の難関であっただろう“歌”が完成したからといって。
lines.translated: --Just because the "song," which was probably the biggest hurdle to prepare, was now complete...

lines.content: 多大なる練習時間を要したであろう“歌”に合わせたダンスも、さすがに時間の関係上免除されたからといって。
lines.translated: And just because we were spared from doing a dance routine to match the "song"--which would have required a massive amount of practice time--due to time constraints...

lines.content: もちろんそれだけで準備が終わるわけもない。
lines.translated: Of course, that didn't mean our preparations were over just like that.

lines.content: しかし、残りの日数でできることなど限られてしまっている。
lines.translated: However, what we could actually accomplish in the remaining days was limited.

lines.content: 次の日からも俺たちは放課後を可能な限り練習に使った。
lines.translated: Starting the next day, we used as much of our after-school time as possible for practice.

lines.content: ――残り二日。
lines.translated: --Two days left.

lines.content: 歌詞やメロディはできたがまだ編曲（ざっくり言えばカラオケ部分）を作らねばならない。
lines.translated: The lyrics and melody were done, but the arrangement (roughly speaking, the karaoke track) still had to be made.

lines.content: バックバンドなど呼べようはずもないし、たとえ呼べたところでまた更にそのバンドが練習する時間だって必要となる。
lines.translated: There was no way we could call in a backing band, and even if we could, that band would need time to practice on top of everything else.

lines.content: 昨晩のメロディを編曲するため、この日も智仁は学園を休んだ。
lines.translated: In order to arrange the melody from last night, Tomohito took the day off from the academy again.

lines.content: 当日までにカラオケとなるバックの[・|音]が間に合えばいいが……。
lines.translated: I just hoped the backing *track* that would serve as the karaoke would be ready in time for the big day...

lines.content: しかしそんな心配は無用だった。
lines.translated: However, such worries proved unnecessary.

lines.content: 智仁がこの日の夜までに編曲を済ませ、すっかり俺たちのたまり場みたいになってる千和のお店にやって来たのにはさすがに驚いた。
lines.translated: I was genuinely surprised when Tomohito finished the arrangement by that night and showed up at Chiwa's shop, which had completely turned into our hangout spot.

lines.content: 智仁……。お前本当に才能、ないのかよ
lines.translated: "Tomohito... Are you seriously telling me you have no talent?"

lines.content: 思わずだ。
lines.translated: It was involuntary.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]からそう聞いていたから、俺は苦笑いで零してしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: Because I had heard that from *her*, I couldn't help letting those words slip out with a wry smile...

lines.content: 才能より想いが勝つ場合だってきっとあるんだよ……きっとな。そして、たぶんだけど、それはそう珍しくもないことなんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "There are bound to be times when feelings win out over talent... I'm sure of it. And, maybe, that's not even all that rare of a thing."

lines.content: ……いつもの笑顔で智仁はそう言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito said that with his usual smile.

lines.content: この日はみんなの歌うパートを決めた。
lines.translated: That day, we decided on everyone's singing parts.

lines.content: 練習は深夜まで続いた。
lines.translated: Practice continued until late at night.

lines.content: 千和のお父さんがそれぞれの家に連絡を入れてくれ、美味しいコーヒーと焼き菓子を差し入れてくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's dad contacted each of our homes for us and brought us delicious coffee and baked treats.

lines.content: ――残り一日。
lines.translated: --One day left.

lines.content: 学園祭前日だ。
lines.translated: The day before the school festival.

lines.content: 今日は俺たちもみんな智仁と同じように学園を休み、時間いっぱい歌の練習などをした。
lines.translated: Today, the rest of us took the day off from the academy just like Tomohito, spending every last bit of our time practicing the song and preparing.

lines.content: うう……。やっぱり私が真ん中なんだね
lines.translated: "Uuu... So I really am in the center after all, huh?"

lines.content: がんばるって決めたことだけど、[・|こ][・|こ]だけはどうにかならないかなあって、少しは期待してたんだけど
lines.translated: "I know I decided to do my best, but I was kind of hoping we could do something about *this* part, at least."

lines.content: 休憩時間にふとふたりきりになると、ハルは俺の前でだけ少しばかりうなだれ、弱音めいた言葉を吐いていた。
lines.translated: When the two of us happened to be alone during a break, Haru slumped her shoulders a bit--only in front of me--and let out something that sounded like a complaint.

lines.content: 仕方ないよ
lines.translated: "It can't be helped."

lines.content: ……どうして？
ハルは、ほんとに音痴じゃなかった
lines.translated: "You really weren't tone-deaf at all, Haru."

lines.content: えー……？
ハルが一番歌が上手かったってことだよ。俺でもわかるくらい。別に千和や姫織が下手ってわけじゃないんだ。ただ、ハルが思ってたよりずっと上手で驚いたってことだ
lines.translated: "It just means you were the best singer out of all of us. Even I could tell that much. It's not like Chiwa or Himeori are bad or anything. It's just that you were way better than I expected, and it surprised me."

lines.content: それは
lines.translated: "That's..."

lines.content: それは？
lines.translated: "And what else?"

lines.content: 私が、この“歌”のこと……
lines.translated: "Well, about this 'song'..."

lines.content: そこでハルは“どう言葉にしていいかわからない”とばかりに、複雑そうな表情で首をかしげていたので、俺が『それに』と言って、会話を繋いだ。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head with a complicated expression, as if she didn't know how to put it into words, so I chimed in with a "Besides," to keep the conversation going.

lines.content: それに？
lines.translated: "And besides?"

lines.content: ああ……。それに、さ。ハルが一番[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|の]似合ってると思うよ。みんなもそう思ってるはずだ
lines.translated: "Yeah... Besides, you know, I think *this kind of thing* suits you best, Haru. I bet everyone else thinks so, too."

lines.content: こういうのって？　歌を歌うこと？
lines.translated: "This kind of thing? You mean singing?"

lines.content: うん。そうだけど、ちょっと違う。うーん。なんて言って良いか
lines.translated: "Yeah. Well, yes, but it's a little different. Hmm. How should I put it..."

lines.content: 少し悩んでから、答える。
lines.translated: After thinking it over for a moment, I answered.

lines.content: つまり
lines.translated: "In short..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: つまりハルが一番、かわいかったってことなんだと思う
lines.translated: "In short, I think it's because you were the cutest, Haru."

lines.content: え、ええ
lines.translated: "E-Eh?"

lines.content: アイドルは“かわいい”が一番の商売道具だ。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "An idol's biggest selling point is being 'cute.' Right?"

lines.content: そう、なのかなあ……？
lines.translated: "Is... that how it works...?"

lines.content: ああ。かわいい服が一番似合って、一番歌が上手くて、一番かわいい。そんな子がセンター以外のどこにいたって、結局は一番目立つんだ。だから、仕方がないんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Cute clothes suit you best, you're the best singer, and you're the cutest. Even if a girl like that stood anywhere other than the center, she'd still stand out the most in the end. So there's just no helping it."

lines.content: ……かわいい、二回も言ってるよ
lines.translated: "...You said 'cute' twice."

lines.content: もにょもにょと言い、うつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: She mumbled under her breath and looked down.

lines.content: 大雅くん。約束、覚えてる？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. Do you remember our promise?"

lines.content: 顔を伏せたまま、ハルが言った。
lines.translated: Keeping her head bowed, Haru spoke.

lines.content: 約束……？
lines.translated: "Promise...?"

lines.content: “春の学園祭”……。このライブ、私、がんばるよ。はずかしくっても、どきどきして胸がいっぱい、痛くても……絶対やりきる。だからお願い
lines.translated: "The 'Spring School Festival'... I'm going to do my best at this concert. Even if it's embarrassing, even if my heart is pounding so hard it hurts... I'll definitely see it through to the end. So, please."

lines.content: ハルが俺の手に触れた。
lines.translated: Haru touched my hand.

lines.content: それは左手だった。“夜”の付与された俺の左手。
lines.translated: It was my left hand. My left hand, granted the power of the "Night."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]がもしも上手くいったら、私の“夢”も、私の“魔法”で……
lines.translated: "If *this* goes well, then my 'dream' too, with my 'magic'..."

lines.content: ……ああ。わかってる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I know."

lines.content: 左手に触れたハルの手を取り、微かな力を込め……俺は繋いだ。
lines.translated: I took Haru's hand where it touched my left, gave it a gentle squeeze... and laced my fingers with hers.

lines.content: その日も深夜近くまで練習を続けた。
lines.translated: Practice continued until late into the night that day as well.

lines.content: 本番前日。ぎりぎりだけれど、メロディも歌詞もみんな殆ど完璧に暗記できたはず。
lines.translated: It was the day before the real thing. We were cutting it close, but everyone had managed to memorize the melody and lyrics almost perfectly.

lines.content: 千和のお父さんを前に、予行演習を何度か重ねて……。
lines.translated: We ran through a few dress rehearsals in front of Chiwa's dad...

lines.content: ――……そして、当日。
lines.translated: --...And then, the day arrived.

lines.content: あ、ううう……。どうしよう。すっごく緊張してきました
lines.translated: "Ah, uuu... What do I do? I'm getting super nervous."

lines.content: 私も……。お腹がぐうぐういっててさあ大変だよ。覚えた歌詞も忘れちゃいそう
lines.translated: "Me too... My stomach is growling so much, I'm in real trouble. I feel like I'm gonna forget the lyrics I memorized."

lines.content: 胸がどきどきじゃあないんだ？
lines.translated: "Shouldn't your heart be pounding instead?"

lines.content: 私はね、お腹の中の怪獣が本体だから……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Well, you see, the monster in my stomach is the real me... Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: うん、なに、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Yeah, what is it, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 私の心配よりもっと気にしてあげたほうがいい人がそこにいる
lines.translated: "There's someone over there you should be worrying about way more than me."

lines.content: うわっ、ハル、どうしたっ、顔が真っ青だぞっ
lines.translated: "Whoa, Haru, what's wrong?! Your face is completely pale!"

lines.content: 柊先輩、息、息してください……っ
lines.translated: "Hiiragi-senpai, breathe, please breathe...!"

lines.content: ふ、ふへへ……どーしよう。人、人だよ。学園祭で……人が、いつもより、いっぱい……ははっ、きんちょーで、死んじゃうぞーう
lines.translated: "F-Fuhehe... What do I do? People, there are people. Because of the festival... there are way more people than usual... Haha, I'm gonna die from nervousness~"

lines.content: あ、ああ、ハル。緊張でついにおかしく
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah, Haru. The nerves have finally gotten to her..."

lines.content: すごい。ハルちゃんでも緊張することあるんだ。ちょっと意外だよ
lines.translated: "Amazing. So even Haru-chan gets nervous sometimes. That's a little surprising."

lines.content: えっと……
もともとこの中で一番緊張しいなのはハルなんだけど……。とはもちろん言えもしない。
lines.translated: Haru is actually the most high-strung out of all of us to begin with... Though of course, I couldn't just say that out loud.

lines.content: んっ、もうそろそろ出番が近いぞ。みんな、準備はいいか？
lines.translated: "Mm, it's almost time for us to go on. Is everyone ready?"

lines.content: 俺たちが慣行するのは学園側に許可を得ているわけではないゲリラライブだ。
lines.translated: What we were about to pull off was an unauthorized guerrilla concert, done without the academy's permission.

lines.content: そうしたほうが誰かの記憶にも残りやすいのではないか。そんな稚拙にすぎる狙いもあってのことである。
lines.translated: Doing it that way might make it stick in someone's memory more easily, or so we thought. It was driven in part by that overly childish aim.

lines.content: 着替えを済ませたそれぞれが機材を抱え、校舎のエントランスから、わいわい騒がしい校庭内をそーっと見渡している状況。
lines.translated: Having finished changing into our outfits, each of us carried our equipment and quietly peered out from the school building's entrance at the bustling, noisy schoolyard.

lines.content: そこから、全部活動の出し物だとかが落ち着いてきただろう頃を見計らい、
lines.translated: From there, we waited for the right moment when all the club exhibitions and events seemed to have settled down, and then--

lines.content: よし！　行くぞ……！
lines.translated: "Alright! Let's go...!"

lines.content: 俺たちは、飛び出していった。
lines.translated: We dashed out.

lines.content: 一曲だ。
lines.translated: Just one song.

lines.content: たった一曲のオリジナル曲をひっさげて、俺たちは即席のステージに立つ。
lines.translated: Armed with only a single original song, we stood upon our makeshift stage.

lines.content: お、お忙しいところ、すみません……っ、みなさんに、ぜ、ぜひ、聞いてもらいたい歌があります……っ
lines.translated: "E-Excuse us for interrupting while you're busy...! T-There is a song we'd really love for everyone to hear...!"

lines.content: 中心に立つハルがマイクを握りしめている――呼びかけくらい俺がしたほうがよかったか、と今さら後悔。
lines.translated: Standing in the center, Haru gripped the microphone tightly--making me regret, a little too late, that I probably should have at least handled calling out to the crowd.

lines.content: しかしハルは勇気を出して、その声をできうる限り張り上げている。
lines.translated: Even so, Haru mustered her courage and projected her voice as loudly as she possibly could.

lines.content: 私たちの最初で最後のライブです。がんばります。がんばりますので、どうか、私たち……、あ、あれ？
lines.translated: "This is our first and last concert. We'll do our best. We're going to do our best, so please, we're... A-Are?"

lines.content: そこでハルはぴたりと止まってしまった。
lines.translated: Right there, Haru froze completely.

lines.content: ざわざわとする。
lines.translated: A murmur rippled through the crowd.

lines.content: 物珍しさに惹かれ、ぽつりぽつりと集まりだした生徒はおよそ数十人。
lines.translated: Drawn in by curiosity, a few dozen students had gradually begun to gather around.

lines.content: 結構な人数がたちまち俺たちをぐるりと囲っていた。
lines.translated: Before we knew it, a sizable crowd had completely surrounded us.

lines.content: そんな中で停止してしまったハルは、周りの[メンバー|みんな]を振り返った。
lines.translated: Having frozen up in the middle of all that, Haru looked back at the rest of us.

lines.content: そして、マイクを持ったまま、
lines.translated: And then, still holding the microphone,

lines.content: ……私たちのグループ名って、なんだっけ？
lines.translated: "...What was our group's name again?"

lines.content: あ、やっべ。決めてなかった
lines.translated: "Ah, crap. We never decided on one."

lines.content: 姫織が目をぱちぱちとさせ、首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Himeori blinked rapidly and tilted her head.

lines.content: ちょっとだけ笑いが起こり、少しハルの気持ちも緩んだのかもしれない。
lines.translated: A small ripple of laughter broke out, which might have helped ease Haru's tension a little.

lines.content: 穏やかな声で、微笑みを添え、言った。
lines.translated: With a gentle voice and a soft smile, she spoke.

lines.content: この“歌”はまだまだほんとは“[・|未][・|完][・|成]”……
lines.translated: "Truthfully, this 'song' is still *unfinished*..."

lines.content: だけど今、ここで、たくさんの人たちに私たちの想いが伝わり……
lines.translated: "But if our feelings can reach lots of people right here, right now..."

lines.content: 幾つも、いくつも、“想い”重なることがあったなら。この“歌”はまたひとつ、完成に近づいていくんだと、信じています
lines.translated: "And if our 'feelings' can overlap again and again... I believe this 'song' will take one more step closer to completion."

lines.content: そしてその“想い”はどこまでも遠い、未来へと……。
lines.translated: And those "feelings" would travel on, into the endlessly distant future...

lines.content: そこでハルはうなずき、マイクをぎゅっと握りしめた。
lines.translated: With that, Haru nodded and squeezed the microphone tightly.

lines.content: それでは、聞いてください――[・|あ][・|な][・|た]へ届くよう、心を込めて歌います。この“歌“の名前は……
lines.translated: "Everyone, please listen--We'll sing with all our hearts so that it reaches *you*. The name of this 'song' is..."

lines.content: “さくら、もゆ”
lines.translated: "'Sakura, Moyu.'"

lines.content: 持参した小さなスピーカーから、はらはらと花びらが舞い落ちるような、淑やかなイントロが流れ始める。
lines.translated: From the small speakers we had brought with us, a graceful intro began to play, sounding like flower petals fluttering gently to the ground.

lines.content: ……お願いします
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up.

lines.content: どうか、この歌が届く限りのすべての人に、きらきらで、眩しくて、笑顔ほころぶ……満開に花咲く未来が、ありますように
lines.translated: "I pray that everyone this song reaches will have a sparkling, dazzling future... blooming in full glory and filled with warm smiles."

lines.content: 音が弾る。
lines.translated: The music burst to life.

lines.content: 今、ここに閉じ込めた想いよ届けとばかり、祈りにも似た歌声が響いた。
lines.translated: A singing voice akin to a prayer rang out, wishing for the feelings sealed within this moment to reach their mark.

lines.content: そして俺、奏大雅がこのステージにかわいい格好で参加したのかどうかは……。
lines.translated: As for whether or not I, Kanade Taiga, participated on this stage dressed in a cute outfit...

lines.content: ご想像にお任せしたい。
lines.translated: I'll leave that to your imagination.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]へはそのように報告しておこう。そう、思った。
lines.translated: That's how I'll report it to *her*. Or so I thought to myself.

lines.content: そうですか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: 兎蛙智仁の姉、兎蛙あず咲。
lines.translated: Toa Tomohito's older sister, Toa Azusaki.

lines.content: その心の一部が……あず咲先輩が『よかった』と微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: A fragment of her heart... Azusaki-senpai was smiling, saying, "Thank goodness."

lines.content: ライブは、大成功だったんですね
lines.translated: "So the concert was a huge success, then."

lines.content: はい……。確かに大成功でしたけど
lines.translated: "Yes... It certainly was a huge success,不过..."

lines.content: あれ……？　ハルちゃん。なんだか浮かない顔、ですけど
lines.translated: "Huh...? Haru-chan. You look a little down, though."

lines.content: あ、いいえ。ライブは本当に大成功でした
lines.translated: "Ah, no. The concert really was a huge success."

lines.content: 歌詞は一度も間違えることなく歌えたし、たぶん音程だって外れてなかった――
lines.translated: "We managed to sing the whole thing without messing up the lyrics once, and I don't think we went off-key, either--"

lines.content: 持ち曲は一曲しかないのにアンコールまでしてもらえました。まあ、その。ただ[・|面][・|白][・|が][・|っ][・|て]る人もいたかもしれませんけど……
lines.translated: "Even though we only had one song in our repertoire, they even asked for an encore. Well, um... some people might have just been *amused* by the spectacle of it all, though..."

lines.content: でも、今の私たちにとってはこれ以上ないくらいの大成功だったと思います
lines.translated: "Still, for us right now, I think it couldn't have been a bigger success."

lines.content: あとはこの歌が本当に未来へ届いたのかどうか。ううん……。たった一回のライブでそこまで望むのはあんまりにも贅沢ですよね
lines.translated: "All that's left is whether or not this song truly reached the future. No... Hoping for that much from just a single concert is way too greedy, isn't it?"

lines.content: それって、これからもハルちゃんたちは歌い続けていくってことですか？
lines.translated: "Does that mean you and the others are going to keep singing from here on out, Haru-chan?"

lines.content: はい……。そうですね
lines.translated: "Yes... That's right."

lines.content: そのつもりですと言い、うなずく。
lines.translated: Saying that was her intention, she nodded.

lines.content: 最初で最後のライブだって思ってたんですけど、今日のライブで覚悟が決まってしまいました
lines.translated: "I thought it would be our first and last concert, but after today's performance, my mind is made up."

lines.content: 歌をうたいはじめるまで胸はどきどきで、心はいっぱいいっぱいでしたけど……私、結構、歌を歌うの好きみたいです。すごい発見です――……だけど
lines.translated: "Right up until we started singing, my heart was pounding and I was completely overwhelmed, but... it seems I actually like singing quite a bit. It's a huge discovery--...However..."

lines.content: だけど……？
はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 色々なものを得られたように思う今日のライブですが、代わりに私たちみんな、一週間の停学処分になっちゃいましたけど
lines.translated: "While I feel like we gained a lot from today's concert, in exchange, all of us ended up getting suspended from school for a week."

lines.content: ……一週間も？　それは大変です
lines.translated: "...A whole week? That's awful."

lines.content: はい。でも、いいんです
lines.translated: "Yes. But it's okay."

lines.content: どうしてですか……？
lines.translated: "Why is that...?"

lines.content: その間、新しい歌をまたみんなで作れるから、良いんです
lines.translated: "Because during that time, we can all make a new song together again, so it's fine."

lines.content: ……すごい
lines.translated: "...Amazing."

lines.content: やっぱりハルちゃんはすごいですね。いつも明るくて、前向きで。もっと見習いたかったです
lines.translated: "You really are amazing, Haru-chan. Always so bright and positive. I wish I could have been more like you."

lines.content: “夢”があることはいいことですよね。生きてないとできないことです。あず咲先輩は笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: Having a "dream" is a wonderful thing, isn't it? It's something you can only have when you're alive. Azusaki-senpai said this with a smile.

lines.content: そう、ですね……
lines.translated: "Yes, I suppose so..."

lines.content: やる気はあります。いっぱいあります。未来にちゃんと歌が届いたんだってわかるまではがんばりたいです。みんなにもそう話してます。また、一緒に歌を歌おうねって
lines.translated: "I'm motivated. Really motivated. I want to do my best until I know for sure that our song has reached the future. That's what I've been telling everyone else, too. That we'll sing together again."

lines.content: にっこりと、微笑む。
lines.translated: I smiled brightly.

lines.content: でも、どうしてかな。
lines.translated: Still, I wondered why.

lines.content: ついがまんできずにこんな言葉がぽろりと零れた。
lines.translated: Unable to hold it back, these words slipped from my lips.

lines.content: だけど、私ってだめなんです
lines.translated: "Even so, I'm really no good."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅くんには甘えてしまって……全然違うこと、言ってしまってて
lines.translated: "I end up spoiling myself around Taiga-kun... and saying completely different things to him."

lines.content: 違うこと、ですか？
lines.translated: "Different things?"

lines.content: あっ、えっと……
lines.translated: "Ah, um..."

lines.content: 何でもありませんと首を振る――だって私もどうして自分が[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|な][・|の][・|か]わからないから。
lines.translated: I shook my head and told her it was nothing--because even I didn't understand why I was *like this*.

lines.content: 大雅くんの前と、今、こうして別の誰かの前とでは、見せる自分の顔が全然違う。
lines.translated: The face I showed in front of Taiga-kun and the one I showed in front of someone else like this right now were completely different.

lines.content: 大雅くん、か
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun, huh..."

lines.content: そこであず咲先輩が首をかしげる。
lines.translated: At that, Azusaki-senpai tilted her head.
"Speaking of Taiga-kun, *I wonder what's keeping him*."

lines.content: きょろきょろとする。
lines.translated: She glanced around restlessly.

lines.content: もうそろそろ列車が来ちゃいます……。最後に一言、お別れと、ありがとうを言いたかったんですけれど
lines.translated: "The train will be here any minute now... I was hoping to say one last goodbye and thank you to him."

lines.content: ……遅いですよね。どうしたんだろう
lines.translated: "...He is late, isn't he? I wonder what happened."

lines.content: 私も辺りをせわしなく見渡してしまう。
lines.translated: I found myself looking around restlessly as well.

lines.content: 忘れ物を思い出したって、でもすぐ戻ってくるからって、言ってたんですけど……
lines.translated: "He said he remembered something he forgot, and that he'd be right back, though..."

lines.content: 汽笛の音が近づいてくる。
lines.translated: The sound of a steam whistle drew closer.

lines.content: あず咲先輩を遠い“夜”の果てにまで連れ去る音だ。
lines.translated: It was the sound that would carry Azusaki-senpai away to the far reaches of the "Night."

lines.content: 夜空の月がちょうど真上に位置する頃にそれはここにやって来る。時刻表にはそうあった。
lines.translated: It would arrive here right when the moon in the night sky reached its zenith. That was what the timetable said.

lines.content: そして[・|そ][・|れ]は、すぐだ。すぐにそのときは訪れる。
lines.translated: And *that* would be very soon. The time would be upon us any moment now.

lines.content: 汽笛と蒸気。少しの振動。それらを引き連れ、それは構内に滑り込んでくる。
lines.translated: The whistle and the steam. A slight tremor. Trailing all of those behind it, the train slid into the station.

lines.content: ……間に合いませんでした
lines.translated: "...Looks like he didn't make it in time."

lines.content: 苦笑いで私を振り向くあず咲先輩。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai turned back to me with a wry smile.

lines.content: 大雅くんにさよならを伝えられないのは残念ですけど……。でも、こうしてハルちゃんが見送ってくれます。それだけでさみしい気持ちもなくなります
lines.translated: "It's a shame I won't get to say goodbye to Taiga-kun... But having you see me off like this, Haru-chan, is enough to make the loneliness fade away."

lines.content: ありがとうございますと微笑む。
lines.translated: She smiled and thanked me.

lines.content: そして、ひとりでに開いた車内へと続く扉を前に、そこへ乗り込むべきか……最後に躊躇しているようにも見えた。
lines.translated: Then, standing before the door leading into the carriage that had opened on its own, she seemed to hesitate one last time over whether she should step aboard...

lines.content: あず咲先輩……
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai..."

lines.content: 大雅くんにその手を握られ、“魔法”となって……。
lines.translated: Having her hand held by Taiga-kun, becoming "magic"...

lines.content: そして弟の智仁くんの願いを叶えたのだろうあず咲先輩――あず咲先輩の心。その一部。今はもう私たちにしかこうして認識することもできない、[・|あ][・|な][・|た]という存在。
lines.translated: And surely granting her younger brother Tomohito-kun's wish, Azusaki-senpai--or rather, Azusaki-senpai's heart. A fragment of it. The existence known as *you*, whom only we could even perceive like this now.

lines.content: 今夜、あなたは遠い“夜”の果てに旅立ってしまう。
lines.translated: Tonight, you will depart for the far reaches of the "Night."

lines.content: “夜”の外に“魔法”を持ち出すのためには、それを願った者が何かしらの“代償”を支払わなければならなくなる。
lines.translated: In order to bring "magic" outside of the "Night," the one who wished for it must pay some kind of "price."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は、智仁くんに音楽の“才能”を芽生えさせることを望んだ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai wished for musical "talent" to blossom within Tomohito-kun.

lines.content: その引き替えに、自分が智仁くんのそばから去ることを選んだ。永遠に。
lines.translated: In exchange, she chose to leave Tomohito-kun's side. Forever.

lines.content: その“想い”しか“代償”として釣り合うものはない。そう感じたからだ。
lines.translated: Because she felt that only those "feelings" could serve as an equal "price."

lines.content: だから、智仁くんが作り上げた歌が、多くの人たちに届いたのだと見届けた……今夜。あず咲先輩は私たちの前から去って行く。
lines.translated: So tonight... having witnessed the song Tomohito-kun created reach so many people, Azusaki-senpai was going to leave us.

lines.content: 私たち以外の誰にも知られず。
lines.translated: Unknown to anyone else.

lines.content: ……私たち以外の誰にも、別れを惜しまれることもなく。
lines.translated: With no one else to mourn her parting.

lines.content: あず咲先輩は列車に乗り込む。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai boarded the train.

lines.content: 多くの“何か”が列車から乗り降りし……。
lines.translated: Many "somethings" got on and off the train...

lines.content: じりじりと。
lines.translated: Slowly, steadily, time ticked away.

lines.content: 構内に発車が間もないことを知らせるベルが鳴り響く。
lines.translated: The bell signaling the train's imminent departure echoed throughout the station.

lines.content: あず咲先輩の姿をホームから私は探した。
lines.translated: From the platform, I searched for Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: ひとつ車窓が開かれ、あず咲先輩が顔を出していた――ざわざわと騒がしい構内で、ハルちゃん、お願い、と私を呼んでる。
lines.translated: One of the train windows opened, and Azusaki-senpai leaned her head out--calling out to me amid the noisy bustle of the station, saying, "Haru-chan, please."

lines.content: お願いします。大雅くんにありがとうって伝えてください。私のことを上手に“魔法”として使ってくれて
lines.translated: "Please. Tell Taiga-kun thank you for me. For using me so well as 'magic.'"

lines.content: ……おかげでともくんが“夢”を叶えることができました
lines.translated: "...Thanks to him, Tomo-kun was able to make his 'dream' come true."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Haru-chan."

lines.content: ……はい
ありがとう、ハルちゃん
lines.translated: "Thank you, Haru-chan."

lines.content: 私みたいな[・|何][・|か]と……
lines.translated: "For being friends with *something* like me..."

lines.content: 私みたいな、兎蛙あず咲の[・|偽][・|物]と仲良くしてくれて、ありがとう
lines.translated: "For being friends with a *fake* Toa Azusaki like me, thank you."

lines.content: 短い間だったけど、とても、とってもね、ハルちゃんやみんなと遊んだり、笑ったりできて……楽しかったよ
lines.translated: "It was only for a short while, but getting to play and laugh with you and everyone else, Haru-chan... it was really, truly fun."

lines.content: ……十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: 私たちの“戦争”が終わった後だ。
lines.translated: It was after our "war" had ended.

lines.content: 世界を救った後の私たちは、今度は自分たちの人生を救わなければならなかった。
lines.translated: After saving the world, we then had to save our own lives.

lines.content: だけどそれは、どうしようもなく少女だった無力な私たちには、あんまりにも難しく……。
lines.translated: However, for helpless girls like we hopelessly were, that was far too difficult...

lines.content: そんな私たちの幼馴染みとして、この町で一緒に遊び回ってくれたのは[・|あ][・|な][・|た]だった。
lines.translated: It was *you* who played around with us in this town as our childhood friend.

lines.content: 私たちより少し大人なあなたが、いつもそばに付いていてくれたから――だから私たちは、つらいばかりの現実に打ちひしがれることもなかった。
lines.translated: Because you, who were a little more grown-up than us, always stayed by our side--we were able to keep from being crushed by our endlessly painful reality.

lines.content: そんなあなたのことを、あの頃の私たちはちゃんとまっすぐ見つめられていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Back then, we were able to look straight at you properly...

lines.content: でも、私たちが少しずつ大人になっていく中で、あなただけが[・|こ][・|こ]に取り残された。
lines.translated: Yet as we grew up little by little, you alone were left behind *here*.

lines.content: たぶんその別れは突然に訪れたはずだ。
lines.translated: That parting must have come suddenly.

lines.content: ……誰も自分にきづいてくれない。
lines.translated: No one noticed her anymore.

lines.content: 昨日まで楽しく笑い合えていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though they had been laughing happily together until just yesterday.

lines.content: 誰もが少しずつ自分のことを忘れてさえいく。
lines.translated: Everyone even began to forget about her, little by little.

lines.content: 大切な家族なはずの智仁くんも、そばにいる自分のことに気づいてくれなくなって……。
lines.translated: Even Tomohito-kun, her precious family, stopped noticing her right beside him...

lines.content: いつもあなたはひとりぼっちで町をさまよい歩く。
lines.translated: You always wandered the town all alone.

lines.content: あなたは、“弟のことが心配でならない”という兎蛙あず咲の気持ちが、現代に取り残されたもの。
lines.translated: You were Toa Azusaki's feelings of "endless worry for her younger brother," left behind in the present day.

lines.content: 弟が幸せになれると確信できなければ、自由に消滅することさえ叶わない。
lines.translated: Unless you could be certain that your brother would find happiness, you couldn't even freely fade away.

lines.content: これまでは、まだ“夜”と関われる大雅くんしか話し相手もいないまま、あず咲先輩はひとりぼっちで過ごしてたのだ。
lines.translated: Up until now, with only Taiga-kun--who could still interact with the "Night"--to talk to, Azusaki-senpai had spent her time all alone.

lines.content: 夕暮れ時――いつもバスに乗って帰っていった先は、遠い町の学園なんかでは決してない。
lines.translated: At dusk--the place she always rode the bus back to was never a school in some distant town.

lines.content: どこよりも遠くて近い場所、“夜”の中に帰って行っていただけなのだ。
lines.translated: She was simply returning into the "Night," a place farther away and yet closer than anywhere else.

lines.content: ……あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "...Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: 誰に気づかれなくても、誰に忘れられてしまっても、あなたはいつも私たちのことをそばでずっと見守ってくれていた。
lines.translated: Even if no one noticed you, even if everyone forgot you, you were always right beside us, watching over us the whole time.

lines.content: それなのに、こうして最後のときを迎えても、私以外に誰もあなたへお別れが言えないなんて……。
lines.translated: And yet, now that the final moment had come, for no one other than me to be able to say goodbye to you...

lines.content: そんなのは、さみしい。
lines.translated: That's just too lonely.

lines.content: あまりにも悲しく思う。
lines.translated: It felt far too sad.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: 早く戻って来て、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Hurry and come back, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: あず咲先輩、行っちゃうよ……。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai is going to leave...

lines.content: たったひとりで。
lines.translated: All by herself.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで。
lines.translated: All alone.

lines.content: また、遠いとおい“夜”の果てに……ひとりきりで、帰って行っちゃう。
lines.translated: Going back to the far, far reaches of the "Night" again... completely alone.

lines.content: こんなさみしいさよならなんて、絶対に……、
lines.translated: Such a lonely goodbye is something I definitely...

lines.content: やだ……
列車が少しずつ、前進し始める。小走りで私はそれについて行く。
lines.translated: Little by little, the train began to move forward. I broke into a trot to keep up with it.

lines.content: このままさよならなんて、私、いやだよ……
lines.translated: "I don't want us to say goodbye like this..."

lines.content: だからお願い。
lines.translated: So please.

lines.content: ……大雅くん。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun.

lines.content: 思い描くすべてが叶う“夜の国”――どうか私の願いを、叶えてください。
lines.translated: O "Country of the Night," where everything one envisions comes true--please, grant my wish.

lines.content: 走り出した車窓に手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: I reached out toward the window of the moving train.

lines.content: あず咲先輩も手を伸ばしてくれる。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai reached her hand out to me as well.

lines.content: 私は、祈った。
lines.translated: I prayed.

lines.content: もしもその手に触れられたなら、ここにはいない誰かの想いも全部、ぜんぶ、あなたへ伝えられますように……。
lines.translated: If I could just touch that hand, may all the feelings of the one who isn't here right now be conveyed to you, every last bit of them...

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 伸ばした手は届かない。
lines.translated: My outstretched hand couldn't reach.

lines.content: あなたの姿が遠ざかっていく……。
lines.translated: Your figure was moving farther away...

lines.content: 今はもう、あなたが、どんな顔をしてるのかもわからなくなって……。
lines.translated: Now, I couldn't even tell what kind of expression you were making anymore...

lines.content: あ
lines.translated: "Ah."

lines.content: 大きな背中が、私を追い抜いていった。
lines.translated: A broad back rushed past me.

lines.content: 姉ちゃん！
lines.translated: "Nee-chan!"

lines.content: 叫び声。
lines.translated: A shout rang out.

lines.content: 待って……まだ、行かないでくれっ
lines.translated: "Wait... Please, don't go yet!"

lines.content: ともくん……っ
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun...!"

lines.content: あず咲先輩は走り出した車窓から、大きく身体を乗り出し――手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai leaned far out of the moving train window--and reached out her hand.

lines.content: ともくん、どうして……っ
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun, why...?"

lines.content: 伸ばされたふたつの手と手が、結ばれる。
lines.translated: Their two outstretched hands clasped together.

lines.content: ずっとだ……！
lines.translated: "All this time...!"

lines.content: ……俺っ、姉ちゃんのこと、ずっと探してたっ
lines.translated: "...I've been looking for you this whole time, Nee-chan!"

lines.content: あがった息も絶え絶えに、叫ぶ。
lines.translated: Gasping for breath, he shouted out.

lines.content: 俺、姉ちゃんに……言いたいこと、伝えたいこと、いっぱい、あるんだよ……姉ちゃんっ
lines.translated: "I have... so many things I want to say, so many things I want to tell you... Nee-chan!"

lines.content: だからまだ行かないでくれよと智仁くんは、叫ぶ。
lines.translated: So please don't go yet, Tomohito-kun shouted.

lines.content: あず咲先輩が、智仁くんの手をしっかり握り返したのがここからでも見えた。
lines.translated: Even from where I stood, I could see Azusaki-senpai squeeze Tomohito-kun's hand tightly in return.

lines.content: ごめんっ。ごめん姉ちゃん……っ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry! I'm sorry, Nee-chan...!"

lines.content: 俺……。何で俺、姉ちゃんと[・|喧][・|嘩]なんてしたんだろう。何であんな[・|ひ][・|ど][・|い]こと、言ったんだろう。ずっと、謝りたかったんだ
lines.translated: "I... Why did I ever fight with you, Nee-chan? Why did I say such terrible things? I've wanted to apologize for so long."

lines.content: それなのに俺、気づいたら姉ちゃんのことわからなくなってて……っ
lines.translated: "And yet, before I knew it, I couldn't even perceive you anymore...!"

lines.content: ともくん……
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun..."

lines.content: 姉ちゃんのこと、ずっと探してたんだ。一緒に遊んだ公園とか。一緒に手を繋いで歩いた道だとか……。一緒に隠した宝物の場所だとか
lines.translated: "I looked for you everywhere. The park where we used to play together. The roads we walked down holding hands... The place where we hid our treasure together."

lines.content: 姉ちゃんが好きだったあのさくらの木が今年こそ咲いたなら、どこかで、姉ちゃんに会えるんじゃないかって。そんな期待をした夜もいっぱいあったけど……
lines.translated: "There were so many nights I hoped that if the cherry tree you loved finally bloomed this year, I might be able to meet you somewhere, Nee-chan..."

lines.content: でも、姉ちゃんはどこにもいなくて……っ
lines.translated: "But you weren't anywhere to be found...!"

lines.content: ごめん。ごめんなさい。違うの。謝るのは、こっちだよともくん
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. You're wrong. I'm the one who should be apologizing, Tomo-kun."

lines.content: 違わない……っ
lines.translated: "I'm not wrong...!"

lines.content: ううん。ともくんお願い。聞いてほしい。私は……違うんだよ。あなたが探してた人じゃない
lines.translated: "No. Tomo-kun, please. I want you to listen to me. I'm... not her. I'm not the person you were looking for."

lines.content: いいや！　何も、違わないんだっ
lines.translated: "No! Nothing is different at all!"

lines.content: ともくん。あのね、私は……。ごめん。私はね、[・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|の][・|言][・|う][・|と][・|お][・|り]、あなたの本当のお姉さんじゃ――
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun. Listen, I'm... I'm sorry. Just as you said, I'm not your real older sister--"

lines.content: 違う！
lines.translated: "You're wrong!"

lines.content: 違うんだよ、姉ちゃん！
lines.translated: "You're wrong, Nee-chan!"

lines.content: 俺、……俺がっ、歌を……あの“春の歌”を届けたかったのは、未来の姉ちゃんだけじゃないんだ……っ
lines.translated: "I... The one I wanted my song--that 'Spring Song'--to reach wasn't just the Nee-chan in the future...!"

lines.content: 列車が更にスピードを増していく。
lines.translated: The train picked up even more speed.

lines.content: 俺はっ、俺が、歌に込めたかった気持ちは……全部っ
lines.translated: "I... The feelings I wanted to put into that song... all of them!"

lines.content: まだだ。
lines.translated: Not yet.

lines.content: まだいっぱい、いっぱい、ふたりには伝えたい言葉や、伝えなければならない想いがあったはず。
lines.translated: The two of them surely still had so, so many words they wanted to say, and feelings they needed to convey.

lines.content: だけどもう言葉も心も、気持ちも全部、重ねていけるだけの時間はなくて。
lines.translated: Yet there was no longer enough time left for them to share all their words, hearts, and feelings.

lines.content: 繋がれた手と手も、次第次第に離されていってしまうから……。
lines.translated: Because their joined hands were gradually being pulled apart...

lines.content: 大好きだ！
lines.translated: "I love you!"

lines.content: ……叫ぶ。
lines.translated: I shouted.

lines.content: 大好きだよっ、姉ちゃん……っ
lines.translated: "I love you, Nee-chan...!"

lines.content: ともくん……
lines.translated: "Tomo-kun..."

lines.content: あなたが本物だとか偽物だとかどうでもいいんだ！
lines.translated: "I don't care whether you're real or a fake!"

lines.content: ただ、そばにいてくれた。うれしいときも。悲しいときも。どうしようもなくうまくいかないときもだ。あなたが俺のためだけに笑いかけていてくれたから……
lines.translated: "You were simply there by my side. When I was happy. When I was sad. And when things just wouldn't go right no matter what. Because you were smiling just for me..."

lines.content: あなたがそうしてそばにいてくれなければ、俺はもう、とっくにだめになってた……っ
lines.translated: "If you hadn't been there beside me like that, I would have fallen apart a long time ago...!"

lines.content: だから、ありがとう、と智仁くんは言う。
lines.translated: So thank you, Tomohito-kun said.

lines.content: ありがとう！　ありがとう姉ちゃんっ
lines.translated: "Thank you! Thank you, Nee-chan!"

lines.content: いつもそばにいてくれて……。いつも俺のこと、そばで応援してくれていて……ありがとう。姉ちゃん。俺の、一番大切なひとっ
lines.translated: "For always being by my side... For always cheering me on from right beside me... Thank you. Nee-chan. The most precious person in the world to me!"

lines.content: “夜”の中で、智仁くんの心が聞こえてくる――
lines.translated: Within the "Night," I could hear Tomohito-kun's heart--
I wished I could turn all of these feelings, every last one of them, into a song...!

lines.content: 姉ちゃん！　姉ちゃん……っ
lines.translated: "Nee-chan! Nee-chan...!"

lines.content: 手の届かない遠い未来へと。
lines.translated: Toward a distant future out of reach.

lines.content: 近くて遠い、あなたへと、伝えたい。
lines.translated: Toward you, who are so close yet so far away, I want to convey this.

lines.content: いつまでもずっと、ずっと……大好きだよ、姉ちゃん！
lines.translated: "Forever and ever, always... I love you, Nee-chan!"

lines.content: ……たったそれだけの気持ちを届けたくって、俺はあの歌を作ったんだよ。
lines.translated: I wrote that song just because I wanted those simple feelings to reach you.

lines.content: ありがとう！　ごめん……！　大切にする……っ、姉ちゃんからもらったもの全部っ、大切に、生きていくから……っ
lines.translated: "Thank you! I'm sorry...! I'll treasure them... Everything you gave me, Nee-chan, I'll treasure it all and keep on living...!"

lines.content: だから、お願いだよ。
lines.translated: So, please.

lines.content: この声も、気持ちも全部……ぜんぶ、あの“歌”にのせて、いつもあなたのそばに、いさせてくれよ……っ
lines.translated: "Let me put this voice, and all of these feelings... all of it into that 'song,' and stay by your side forever...!"

lines.content: 最後の声は汽笛に消され、そこでふたりの手と手は離された。
lines.translated: His final words were drowned out by the train whistle, and right then, their hands were torn apart.

lines.content: あず咲先輩が行ってしまった後……。
lines.translated: After Azusaki-senpai had gone...

lines.content: [・|俺]は智仁に[・|そ][・|れ]を渡した。
lines.translated: I handed it to Tomohito.

lines.content: ――才能を越えることなんてこの世の中にはいくらでもある。
lines.translated: --There are plenty of things in this world that transcend talent.

lines.content: あず咲先輩が智仁へ[・|手][・|紙]という形で残した言葉は、まずそんな一文からはじまっていた。
lines.translated: The words Azusaki-senpai had left behind for Tomohito in the form of a letter began with that single sentence.

lines.content: 『ねえ、ともくん。この世界はとてもわかりやすく残酷なんだよ』
lines.translated: "Hey, Tomo-kun. This world is cruel in a very easy-to-understand way."

lines.content: 『才能を持つ者が持たない者の努力を一瞬でふいにする――』
lines.translated: "Those who have talent can reduce the efforts of those who don't to nothing in an instant--"

lines.content: 『そんなありきたりな残酷さと同様に、才能を持たない者の重ねた“想い”が、圧倒的だったはずの才能を、やっぱり一瞬で凌駕して……』
lines.translated: "Yet just like that commonplace cruelty, the accumulated 'feelings' of someone without talent can, in a single moment, surpass a talent that should have been overwhelming..."

lines.content: 『[・|持][・|つ][・|者]には決して形にできない風景を、多くの人の心に、気持ちに、届けてしまう――そういった残酷さもまた、この世界の中にはあるもので』
lines.translated: "Delivering a scenery that 'those who have it' could never give form to, straight into the hearts and feelings of so many people--that kind of cruelty also exists in this world."

lines.content: 『……だから、才能なんてものを言い訳にして“夢”見ることを諦めないで――』
lines.translated: "...So please, don't use something like talent as an excuse to give up on 'dreaming'--"

lines.content: 『――……なんて。そんなことを無責任に言うのもまた簡単で。残酷で』
lines.translated: "--...Just kidding. Saying something like that so irresponsibly is also easy. And cruel."

lines.content: 『諦めることを選んだ人のことを、どうして私たちが偉そうに何か言えるのでしょうか』
lines.translated: "What right do we have to act high and mighty and say anything to someone who has chosen to give up?"

lines.content: 『そういう道を選んで生きていくと決意したのにも、たくさん、たくさんの“想い”が重なっているはずだから』
lines.translated: "Because the decision to choose that path and keep on living must also be built upon so, so many 'feelings' piled together."
"It's just..."

lines.content: 『人はきらめく才能に憧れるけど、たゆまぬ“想い”に強く共感するイキモノだと思います』
lines.translated: "I think that while people admire dazzling talent, we are creatures who empathize deeply with unwavering 'feelings.'"

lines.content: 『……だって、どうしたって私たちは、心から逃れられないイキモノだから』
lines.translated: "...Because no matter what we do, we are creatures who cannot escape from our hearts."

lines.content: 『あの人は天才だと呼ばれる誰かも、もしかしたら……』
lines.translated: "Even someone whom others call a genius might, perhaps..."

lines.content: 『……もしかしたら今日までたくさんの悲しいことや苦しいこと、さみしいことに涙を拭いて、歩いて、歩いて、歩き続けてきたからこそ今日があるのかもしれない』
lines.translated: "...Perhaps they only are where they are today because, up until now, they wiped away their tears through so much sadness, pain, and loneliness, and kept walking, walking, and walking."

lines.content: 『だから、ともくん。あなたにはあえてお願いしたいの。最初で最後だなんて、言わないで』
lines.translated: "So, Tomo-kun. I want to dare to ask this of you. Please don't say that it's your first and last."

lines.content: 『今日まで色々な“想い”を閉じ込めて、それでも笑顔でいられるあなただから……』
lines.translated: "Because you are someone who has locked away all kinds of 'feelings' until today, and yet can still keep smiling..."

lines.content: 『そんなあなたにしか作れない“歌”が必ずあるはずだから。だから、ともくん。お願いね』
lines.translated: "There is bound to be a 'song' that only someone like you can create. So, Tomo-kun. Please."

lines.content: 『これからもたくさん、たくさん、すてきな“歌”を、音楽を、あなたの“想い”をつむいでいってほしいです――未来の本物の私に届くよう。夜空の星の向こうに旅立つ私にも、届くよう』
lines.translated: "From here on out, I want you to keep weaving lots and lots of wonderful 'songs,' music, and your 'feelings'--so that they may reach the real me in the future. And so that they may reach the me who is setting off on a journey beyond the stars in the night sky."

lines.content: 『きっと[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]苦しんで、悲しんで生きていくあなたの姿に強く憧れる。そんな誰かがそばにいてくれるはずだから』
lines.translated: "Because I am sure there will be someone right beside you who deeply admires the way you live on through that kind of pain and sadness."

lines.content: ……ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: きっと、ともくんの歌、未来の私にまで届いたよ。
lines.translated: I'm sure your song reached all the way to the me in the future, Tomo-kun.

lines.content: 智仁はその手紙を読み終え、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Tomohito finished reading the letter and closed his eyes.

lines.content: ありがとうな。大雅。姉ちゃんのところに連れてきてくれて
lines.translated: "Thanks, Taiga. For bringing me to Nee-chan."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: あのひとが[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]言葉を残すというのなら、お前の言葉や想いも、あのひとへ届けなきゃフェアじゃない。そう思ったんだよ。だからギリギリだったけど引き返した
lines.translated: "If she was going to leave words behind like this, it wouldn't be fair unless your words and feelings reached her, too. That's what I thought. So I turned back, even though we barely had any time."

lines.content: 間に合ってよかったよ、と俺は言う。本当に、よかった。
lines.translated: I'm glad we made it in time, I said. Really, so glad.

lines.content: ……なあ、大雅。俺、目が覚めたら今夜のこと、忘れてるのかな
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga. When I wake up, am I going to forget about tonight?"

lines.content: ああ……。そうだな
lines.translated: "Yeah... That's right."

lines.content: だけど、大丈夫さ
lines.translated: "Still, it'll be okay."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 朝になれば、今夜のことは確かにお前は忘れてるけれど、でも、ちゃんと覚えてる。忘れてるけど覚えてるんだ。そういうものさ。絶対に
lines.translated: "When morning comes, it's true you'll forget about tonight, yet you'll still remember it properly. You'll forget, yet you'll remember. That's just how it works. Definitely."

lines.content: ……そっか。忘れるけれど、覚えてる、か
lines.translated: "...I see. Forget, yet remember, huh?"

lines.content: 智仁は微笑み、少しだけ[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]との話を語ってくれた。
lines.translated: Tomohito smiled and told me a little bit about his past with her.

lines.content: ……十年前だ。
lines.translated: It was ten years ago.

lines.content: 幼い頃、“[呪い|病]”によって未来に飛んでしまった兎蛙あず咲。
lines.translated: When she was young, Toa Azusaki was sent flying into the future by the "illness"--the curse.

lines.content: しかしその想いだけがここに残った。
lines.translated: However, only her feelings remained behind here.

lines.content: それから智仁はあのひとを姉として慕い、少年時代を過ごしたのだ。
lines.translated: From then on, Tomohito adored her as his older sister and spent his boyhood with her.

lines.content: ただのひとりも理解者のいない家族の中で、いつもそばにいてくれるあのひとだけが智仁の救いだった。
lines.translated: In a family where not a single person understood him, she was the only one who always stayed by his side, his only salvation.

lines.content: ……いつも励ましてくれた。いつもやさしく頭を撫でてくれた。いつも、手を繋いで歩いてくれた
lines.translated: "...She always encouraged me. She always gently stroked my head. She always held my hand and walked with me."

lines.content: ただひとりの味方だった。
lines.translated: She was his one and only ally.

lines.content: いつも智仁の人生が上手くいくよう、そばで祈り続けていてくれた。
lines.translated: She was always right beside him, praying continuously for Tomohito's life to go well.

lines.content: つらいことも悲しいことも。苦しいことも。
lines.translated: Through the hard times and the sad times. And the painful times.

lines.content: あのひととのことはすべて大切な思い出だ。
lines.translated: Everything with her was a precious memory.

lines.content: そうだ。あのひとは智仁にとって姉であり、もっと大切で特別な何かになった。
lines.translated: That's right. To Tomohito, she was an older sister, and she became something even more precious and special.

lines.content: だけどある日のことだ。
lines.translated: However, one day.

lines.content: 『うそつき！』
lines.translated: "Liar!"

lines.content: ほんの些細なことで喧嘩をしたのだ。
lines.translated: They got into a fight over something completely trivial.

lines.content: 『近寄るな！　[・|偽][・|物]のくせに……！』
lines.translated: "Stay away from me! You're just a fake...!"

lines.content: そう口にしてしまった瞬間、あのひとがすごく悲しそうな顔をした。
lines.translated: The moment those words left his mouth, she made a terribly sad face.

lines.content: ……その瞬間だけはどうしても忘れられない。
lines.translated: That single moment was the one thing he could never forget.

lines.content: 一緒に手を繋いで下校するのがいつもの約束だったのに、その日はいつもより迎えに来てくれるのが遅かった――あのひとに叫んでしまったのは、ただそれだけが理由だった。
lines.translated: Even though it was their usual promise to hold hands and walk home from school together, she had come to pick him up later than usual that day--and that was the only reason he had yelled at her.

lines.content: いつも[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]で感情的にはならないのに、その日はどうしてか虫の居所が悪かった。
lines.translated: Normally, he wouldn't get emotional over something like that, but for some reason, he was in a terrible mood that day.

lines.content: 父親と母親の前で正座させられ、“才能”について長い間おしかりごとを受けたあとだったからか。
lines.translated: Perhaps it was because he had just been forced to sit straight in front of his father and mother to receive a long lecture about "talent."

lines.content: お前はこの家には必要ない。お父さんもお母さんも、あなたのことが心から恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: You aren't needed in this house. Your father and mother are deeply ashamed of you.

lines.content: そんな言葉を、何度も何度も、繰り返し聞かされた後だったから……。
lines.translated: Because it was right after he had been forced to listen to those words over and over again...

lines.content: とにかく俺は、あのひとに当たり散らしてしまったんだ
lines.translated: "Anyway, I ended up taking all my frustration out on her."

lines.content: あんなふうに怒鳴ったことなんて後にも先にもきっとあのときだけだ。そうであってほしいと、願うよ
lines.translated: "Before or since, that was definitely the only time I ever yelled like that. At least, I really hope it was."

lines.content: あのひとは智仁を少しの間ひとりにし、気持ちが落ち着くまで待とうとしたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps she had intended to leave Tomohito alone for a little while and wait until he calmed down.

lines.content: 部屋に智仁を残し、出て行った。
lines.translated: Leaving Tomohito in the room, she walked out.

lines.content: 一時間。二時間。三時間が経ち……。
lines.translated: One hour. Two hours. Three hours passed...

lines.content: 夜になった。姉ちゃんは帰ってこない。
lines.translated: Night fell. His sister didn't come back.

lines.content: 謝ろう。バカだった。どうしてあんなこと、言ってしまったんだ。
lines.translated: I should apologize. I was an idiot. Why did I say something like that?

lines.content: 俺は家を飛び出した。姉ちゃんを探した。たくさんたくさん、探し回った
lines.translated: "I ran out of the house. I looked for Nee-chan. I searched and searched everywhere for her."

lines.content: 怖かった。
lines.translated: I was scared.

lines.content: このままあのひとが、姉ちゃんが帰ってこなかったらどうしよう……。
lines.translated: What if she--what if Nee-chan never comes back...?

lines.content: そうなれば、ひとりだ。ひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: If that happens, I'll be alone. Completely alone.

lines.content: 俺にはもう誰も味方がいてくれなくなる。
lines.translated: I won't have anyone on my side anymore.

lines.content: いやだよ。姉ちゃん。ごめん。ごめんなさい……っ。
lines.translated: No. Nee-chan. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry...

lines.content: 『お願いっ、俺を置いていかないでよ……姉ちゃんっ』
lines.translated: "'Please, don't leave me behind... Nee-chan!'"

lines.content: 夜の街を裸足で走り回った。何度も名前を呼んだ。ごめん。許して。あんなの嘘だよ。大好き。姉ちゃん……俺は姉ちゃんが、大好きなんだ。そう何度も叫んだ。
lines.translated: He ran barefoot through the night streets. He called her name over and over. I'm sorry. Forgive me. I didn't mean it. I love you. Nee-chan... I love you so much, Nee-chan. He screamed those words again and again.

lines.content: でも……
その日を境に、智仁の心は少し大人へと近づいたのかもしれない――
lines.translated: Perhaps from that day onward, Tomohito's heart grew a little closer to adulthood--

lines.content: 両親から受けたありふれていてあんまりに理不尽な説教が、その日の智仁の心に突き刺さり、もう子どもではいらない、早く大人にならなければと感じたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: The all-too-common, overwhelmingly unreasonable lecture from his parents had pierced Tomohito's heart that day, perhaps making him feel that he could no longer remain a child, that he had to grow up quickly.

lines.content: ともあれ智仁は[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]のことが見えなくなった。
lines.translated: In any case, Tomohito became unable to see her anymore.

lines.content: あんなにもひどいこと言ったのに、それなのに一言も謝ることもできないなんて……
lines.translated: "Even though I said such awful things to her, I couldn't even say a single word of apology..."

lines.content: 子ども心にこんな残酷なことがあるのか。
lines.translated: Could anything be more cruel to a child's heart?

lines.content: たった一言謝りたかった。
lines.translated: He had just wanted to say one word of apology.

lines.content: いつも味方でいてくれてありがとう。その気持ちを伝えたかった。
lines.translated: Thank you for always being on my side. He had wanted to convey those feelings to her.

lines.content: もうどこにも姿が見えなくなってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though he could no longer see her anywhere...

lines.content: だけどきっと、どこかで自分のことを見ていてくれる。
lines.translated: Surely, she was still watching over him from somewhere.

lines.content: 今も隣で、俺の手をそっと握ってくれているはずなんだ。
lines.translated: Even now, she must be right beside me, gently holding my hand.

lines.content: そう思ったから。そう、信じたかったから。
lines.translated: Because that was what he thought. Because that was what he wanted to believe.

lines.content: ……だから俺は、そばで見ていてくれるだろうあのひとへも“歌”を届けたかったんだ。ごめんと。ありがとうと。そして、大好き……。そんな“想い”を乗せた“歌”を、あのひとに
lines.translated: "...That's why I wanted my 'song' to reach her, too, since I knew she was probably watching over me right by my side. To say I'm sorry. To say thank you. And to say I love her... I wanted to send her a 'song' carrying those 'feelings.'"

lines.content: ……なあ、大雅
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ああ。なんだ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it?"

lines.content: 俺はさ、音楽になりたかったんだ――俺自身の“想い”のすべてが、遠く未来にも歌い継がれていくような音楽に。そう願ってた
lines.translated: "You know, I wanted to become music--music where all of my own 'feelings' would be sung and passed down far into the future. That was what I wished for."

lines.content: それが俺の“夢”だったと智仁は言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito said that had been his "dream."

lines.content: ちゃんと、届いたよな
lines.translated: "It reached her properly, right?"

lines.content: 未来の姉ちゃんへは、悔しいけど、どうかわからない。それを知る術さえもない……
lines.translated: "It's frustrating, but I don't know about the Nee-chan in the future. I don't even have a way of knowing..."

lines.content: だけど。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: いつも俺のそばにいてくれた姉ちゃんには、俺の言葉、俺の“想い”……全部、ちゃんと届いてくれたよな。もう、姉ちゃん。俺のこと心配しなくても平気だよって、わかってくれたよな
lines.translated: "To the Nee-chan who was always by my side, my words, my 'feelings'... all of it reached her properly, right? She understood that she doesn't have to worry about me anymore, right?"

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: ……ああ、なんだ智仁
lines.translated: "...Yeah, what is it, Tomohito?"

lines.content: ……お前も見たろ。姉ちゃん。この手が離れた瞬間だよ……最後に笑っていてくれたよな。そうだよな、大雅
lines.translated: "...You saw her too, didn't you? Nee-chan. The moment our hands parted... she was smiling at the very end, wasn't she? Right, Taiga?"

lines.content: 俺の“想い”、届いたんだよな。そういうことだよな。
lines.translated: My "feelings" reached her, right? That's what it means, right?

lines.content: 智仁が少し不安そうにつぶやいている。
lines.translated: Tomohito murmured, sounding a little anxious.

lines.content: だから俺は、深く、しっかりとうなずいた。
lines.translated: So I gave a deep, firm nod.

lines.content: ああ、当たり前だろ。お前の作ったあの“歌”が誰にも届かないわけない。俺は、そう信じてる
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course they did. There's no way that 'song' you made wouldn't reach anyone. That's what I believe."

lines.content: 智仁……
lines.translated: "Tomohito..."

lines.content: ……ああ。そう、だよな
lines.translated: "...Yeah. You're right."

lines.content: 智仁は、笑った。
lines.translated: Tomohito smiled.

lines.content: ああ。そうだよ。自分で言うのもなんだけど、結構、名曲だもんな。届かないわけ、ないよな
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. Though I say so myself, it's a pretty great song, after all. There's no way it wouldn't reach her, right?"

lines.content: どこかが痛むみたいな笑顔でそう言い、智仁はいつまでも、いつまでも、遠ざかっていく列車の姿を見つめ続けていた。
lines.translated: Saying that with a smile that looked almost pained, Tomohito kept staring forever and ever at the train as it faded into the distance.

lines.content: その夜。ほんの短い夢を見た。
lines.translated: That night, I had a very short dream.

lines.content: いつも下を向いてばかりの小さな弟。
lines.translated: A little brother who was always looking down.

lines.content: 同じように自信なさげに、だけど弟のために笑顔でいようとがんばる小さな姉だ。
lines.translated: And a little sister who was just as unsure of herself, yet tried her hardest to keep smiling for her brother's sake.

lines.content: ふたりは満開の下、手を繋いで歩いていた。
lines.translated: The two of them were walking hand in hand beneath the trees in full bloom.

lines.content: 歌が聞こえる。
lines.translated: I can hear a song.

lines.content: 知ってる歌だ。
lines.translated: It's a song I know.

lines.content: だけどまだまだ未完成なばかりの歌だった。
lines.translated: Yet it was a song that was still completely unfinished.

lines.content: 歌詞もなく、メロディも穴あきで……。
lines.translated: It had no lyrics, and the melody was full of gaps...

lines.content: そんな小さな歌のかけらを、はらはらと舞い降るたくさんの花びらに、一つひとつ丁寧に名前をつけるみたいにして、ふたりは小さな声で口ずさんでいた。
lines.translated: The two of them were humming that tiny fragment of a song in quiet voices, as if carefully giving a name to each and every one of the many petals fluttering down around them.

lines.content: いつか……
lines.translated: "Someday..."

lines.content: 姉は言う。
lines.translated: The older sister spoke.

lines.content: いつかふたりで、この“歌”が完成させられたら。そのときはきっと、私たちの“夢”も全部叶う。そんな気がするよ
lines.translated: "If the two of us can finish this 'song' together someday... I feel like all of our 'dreams' will surely come true when that happens."

lines.content: もう弟が家族にひどい扱いを受けないように……。
