lines.translated: So that her little brother would never be treated terribly by their family again...

lines.content: 姉は弟に歌を贈りたかった。一緒にその歌を口ずさみ、ふたりで完成させたかった。
lines.translated: The sister wanted to give her brother a song. She wanted to hum that song together and complete it with the two of them.

lines.content: 私の“夢”はね、ともくん。あなたがいつも笑っていられる世界を作ることだよ
lines.translated: "My 'dream,' Tomo-kun, is to create a world where you can always keep smiling."

lines.content: だからほら、笑ってよ。私はあなたの笑顔が大好きだから……
lines.translated: "So come on, smile for me. Because I love your smile so much..."

lines.content: あなたの笑ったかわいい顔をもっと見せてよと言い、姉は弟の長い前髪をヘアピンで留めた。
lines.translated: Asking him to show her more of his cute smiling face, the sister pinned back her brother's long bangs with a hairpin.

lines.content: うん。これであなたの顔がよく見える。どんなに小さくてもあなたが笑えば、私も、[・|世][・|界]も、すぐに気づける
lines.translated: "Yep. Now I can see your face clearly. No matter how small it is, when you smile, both I and the world will be able to notice right away."

lines.content: ……えへへ。かわいい。お姉ちゃんとお揃いだね
lines.translated: "...Ehehe. It's cute. Now we match, right?"

lines.content: 姉は微笑み、だけど少しさみしそうな顔をした。
lines.translated: The sister smiled, though her expression looked a little lonely.

lines.content: あなたの笑顔はきっと無敵よ。あなたが笑えば、そばにいる誰もが暖かい気持ちになれるから……
lines.translated: "Your smile is surely invincible. Because whenever you smile, everyone around you feels warm inside..."

lines.content: ……ううん
きっと、あなたが笑うと、この世界そのものだって笑顔にできる。それがあなたの誰にも負けない才能なんだって、信じてる
lines.translated: "I'm sure that when you smile, you can bring a smile to the world itself. I believe that's your talent, one that won't lose to anyone else's."

lines.content: お揃いのヘアピンを指先で撫で、姉はやさしく微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Stroking the matching hairpin with her fingertips, the sister smiled gently.

lines.content: もしもいつか、私があなたのそばにいられなくなってしまっても……。大丈夫。あなたの顔がよく見える。[・|こ][・|れ]でもう、どこにいても、あなたのかわいい笑顔を見逃さないわ
lines.translated: "Even if someday I can no longer be by your side... it'll be okay. I can see your face clearly. With this, no matter where I am, I'll never miss your cute smile again."

lines.content: 姉は弟のことが大好きだ……。
lines.translated: The sister loved her little brother dearly...

lines.content: だけど弟は、そんな姉のことが……。
lines.translated: However, the little brother loved his sister...

lines.content: もっとだ。
lines.translated: Even more.

lines.content: 誰よりも、何よりも、姉が自分を思ってくれるよりもっと、大好きだった。
lines.translated: More than anyone, more than anything, and even more than she cared for him, he loved her.

lines.content: だから笑おうと、思った。
lines.translated: So he decided he would smile.

lines.content: これからどんなことがあっても笑って生きよう。あなたが好きだと言ってくれた自分でいられるように努めよう。
lines.translated: No matter what happens from here on out, I'll live with a smile. I'll do my best to stay the person you said you loved.

lines.content: 姉ちゃんのことは俺が絶対護るから――
lines.translated: Because I'll definitely protect you, Nee-chan--

lines.content: 果たせるはずもない約束をした。
lines.translated: He made a promise he could never possibly keep.

lines.content: そして笑ってみせると、姉はうれしそうに微笑んでくれた。
lines.translated: And when he smiled for her, his sister gave him a happy smile in return.

lines.content: それは[・|あ][・|の][・|人]だったのか。それとも[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]だったのか。
lines.translated: Had that been the real her? Or had it been the her formed from her feelings?

lines.content: 今となってはもう何も、思い出せなくなってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: By now, he could no longer remember anything at all...

lines.content: それからおよそ十年後。
lines.translated: About ten years after that.

lines.content: 大切な人。大切だったひと。二度も、“さよなら”を重ね……。
lines.translated: Someone precious. Someone who had been precious. Having piled up two "goodbyes"...

lines.content: 弟は[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]の記憶をたどるようにして、歌をひとつ、作り上げた。
lines.translated: As if tracing back the memories of that time, the younger brother completed a single song.

lines.content: 暖かな春の空に、はらはらと花びらが舞い上がるかのような……。
lines.translated: As though petals were fluttering up into a warm spring sky...

lines.content: そんな淡い情景を抱いた旋律だった。
lines.translated: It was a melody that embraced such a faint, fleeting scene.

lines.content: たったひとりで紡いだものではない。ふたりで一緒に作り上げたのだ。弟はそう思っている。
lines.translated: It wasn't something he had spun all by himself. The two of them had created it together. That was what the brother believed.

lines.content: 諦めないで、最初で最後だなんて言わないでと、あなたは言ったけど……。
lines.translated: You told me not to give up, and not to say that this would be my first and last, but...

lines.content: やっぱり自分に音楽の才能はないと思う。
lines.translated: Even so, I don't think I have a talent for music.

lines.content: これ以上の歌を果たして自分は創ることができるだろうか。自信はなかった。
lines.translated: Could he really create a song any better than this one? He didn't have the confidence.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た]が“魔法”で、記憶の底に眠っていた[・|ふ][・|た][・|り][・|の][・|メ][・|ロ][・|デ][・|ィ]を思い出させてくれたに過ぎない。そう、思っている。
lines.translated: You simply used your "magic" to help me remember the melody of the two of us that had been sleeping at the bottom of my memories. That's what I think.

lines.content: ただ、あなたへの“想い”は本物だ。
lines.translated: Still, my "feelings" for you are real.

lines.content: いつまでも枯れることなく、この胸に、この心に、在り続けるのだと信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe they will never wither, and will continue to remain in this chest, in this heart, forever.

lines.content: ……これはふたりで作った“愛”と“勇気”の歌だ。
lines.translated: This is a song of "love" and "courage" that the two of us made together.

lines.content: あなたのことだけを生涯愛し続けると誓う。
lines.translated: I swear to keep loving only you for the rest of my life.

lines.content: その“想い”が。その生き方が。
lines.translated: Could those "feelings"? Could that way of life?
Could it not become a song that no one else could ever write...?

lines.content: その“夢”を叶えるための道はどこにあるのか。
lines.translated: Where did the path to making that "dream" come true lie?

lines.content: 春だ……。
lines.translated: It was spring...

lines.content: 弟はたったひとり、出会いと別れの空を見上げた。
lines.translated: All alone, the younger brother looked up at the sky of meetings and partings.

lines.content: 少年はきっと、もうひとつ大人になった。
lines.translated: Surely, the boy had grown up just a little bit more.

lines.content: 大切な“さよなら”を数え、痛みを覚え、またひとつやさしくなれた。
lines.translated: Counting his precious "goodbyes," learning the meaning of pain, he had become just a little bit kinder.

lines.content: そんな弟と生涯、大切な友人として歩んで行けたなら……。
lines.translated: If I could walk alongside that younger brother as a dear friend for the rest of my life...

lines.content: それはとても、とてもうれしく楽しい未来になりそうだ。
lines.translated: That sounded like it would be a very, very happy and joyful future.

lines.content: ……夢を。
lines.translated: A dream.

lines.content: そんな夢を、“夜”の中で俺は見ていた。
lines.translated: Inside the "Night," I was having a dream like that.

lines.content: ぼんやりと空を見ていた。
lines.translated: I was gazing blankly up at the sky.

lines.content: はらはらと花びらが舞うのは“夜”の空だ。
lines.translated: It was the sky of the "Night" where petals were fluttering gently down.

lines.content: “春の学園祭”が終わったばかりだが、今度は“夜”の中で次のイベントが待っている。
lines.translated: The "Spring School Festival" had only just ended, yet the next event was already waiting for us inside the "Night."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は“夜”の中で毎年の恒例行事、なのだけど……。
lines.translated: That was an annual tradition in the "Night," however...

lines.content: ごめんね大雅くん。お待たせしちゃったかも……
lines.translated: "Sorry, Taiga-kun. Did I keep you waiting...?"

lines.content: 声がした。
lines.translated: A voice called out.

lines.content: 振り向く。
lines.translated: I turned my head back.
Standing there was Haru, who had just finished changing her clothes.

lines.content: ……ど、どうかな。これ、変じゃないかな
lines.translated: "...H-How is it? Does this look weird on me?"

lines.content: ハルは照れくさそうに指を絡ませる。
lines.translated: Haru bashfully intertwined her fingers.

lines.content: お食事処でもある“ゆめのねどこ”で働くお手伝いさん用の制服だった。
lines.translated: It was the uniform for the helpers working at "Dream's Bed," which also served as an eatery.

lines.content: 変なんかじゃないよ。よく似合ってると思う
lines.translated: "It doesn't look weird at all. I think it suits you really well."

lines.content: え、えへへ。そっか。なら、よかったよ
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe. Really? I'm glad, then."

lines.content: 素直な感想を伝えると、ハルも素直な笑顔を返してくれた――まだ少しその頬は赤かったけれど。
lines.translated: When I gave her my honest impression, Haru returned an honest smile of her own--though her cheeks were still a little flushed.

lines.content: ……今夜、“夜の国”でお祭りがある。
lines.translated: Tonight, there was going to be a festival in the "Country of Night."

lines.content: 猫たち主催の[・|そ][・|れ]は季節の変わり目に行われる。
lines.translated: Hosted by the cats, it was held at the turning of the seasons.

lines.content: 祭りが終われば、その日を境に季節は完全に移ろうのだ。
lines.translated: Once the festival ended, that day would mark the complete transition to the next season.

lines.content: ……お寝坊な草木もすべて花開き。
lines.translated: Even the sleepy plants and trees would all burst into bloom.

lines.content: ……肌寒く感じるような日はもう来ない。
lines.translated: And there would be no more chilly days to come.

lines.content: “春の夜”と名付けられた今夜の祭りは、猫たちなりの春を迎え入れるための儀式のようなものでもある。
lines.translated: Named the "Spring Night," tonight's festival was also like a ritual for the cats to welcome the spring in their own way.

lines.content: そして“春の夜”は、他の季節の祭りより、猫たちにとって特別な思い入れがあるらしかった。
lines.translated: Furthermore, it seemed the cats had a much deeper attachment to the "Spring Night" than to the festivals of any other season.

lines.content: 今年こそ咲かないさくらが花をつけてくれないか……。町中がそんな期待でいっぱいだ。今夜は忙しくなりそうだぞ
lines.translated: "Everyone's hoping the unblooming cherry tree will finally blossom this year... The whole town is brimming with that expectation. Looks like tonight's going to be a busy one."
Haru and one other person.

lines.content: ふたり分の着付けを終えて奥間から出てきたあさひさんがそう言った。
lines.translated: Having finished dressing the two of them, Asahi-san came out from the back room and said that.

lines.content: 学園校舎に寄り添うような形で立つ古いふるいさくらの巨木。
lines.translated: An ancient, towering cherry tree stood nestled close against the school building.

lines.content: このさくらはもう随分と長い間、花を咲かせていない。
lines.translated: This cherry tree hadn't bloomed for a very long time now.

lines.content: とは言えあの木の寿命が尽きてしまっているわけではない。夏になれば青青とした葉をつけるのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, it wasn't as if the tree had reached the end of its lifespan. Come summer, it would put out lush, green leaves.

lines.content: だというのに、春になるとまるで真冬の枯れ枝のような姿で沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: Despite that, when spring arrived, it would fall completely silent, looking just like dead branches in the middle of winter.

lines.content: 町を埋め尽くすたくさんのさくらの木が騒がしく咲き誇ろうと――あの木だけはなぜだかひとりぼっちで静かなままだ。
lines.translated: Even as the countless cherry trees filling the town bloomed in a boisterous display--that tree alone remained all by itself and quiet for some reason.

lines.content: だから祭りで自分たちが大騒ぎしていれば、咲かないさくらもそれにつられてついつい花を咲かせてはくれないか――
lines.translated: So if they made a huge racket during the festival, maybe the unblooming cherry tree would get swept up in the mood and accidentally blossom--

lines.content: あのさくらの木が満開に色づけば、この町の“夜”にも、ようやく本当に春が来る。
lines.translated: Once that cherry tree burst into full color, true spring would finally come to the "Night" of this town as well.

lines.content: そんな期待で猫たちはそわそわうきうきしながらも、“春の夜”をおもしろおかしく騒がしく、今年も満開に咲かせようとするのだった。
lines.translated: Restless and giddy with such expectations, the cats were determined to make the "Spring Night" fun, rowdy, and bring it to full bloom again this year.

lines.content: 今夜の祭りで、私たちのお店では炭酸ラムネを出そうかと思ってる。あとしらたまあんみつだ。我が家自慢の手作りだぞ
lines.translated: "For tonight's festival, I'm thinking of serving carbonated ramune at our shop. Along with shiratama anmitsu. It's our household's specialty, made from scratch."

lines.content: ラムネは全部で百本あまり。
lines.translated: There were a little over a hundred bottles of ramune in total.

lines.content: 俺たちもせっせと瓶詰めを手伝った。
lines.translated: We had also pitched in and worked hard to help bottle it all.

lines.content: ひとつ五十円で売るのだとあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said she was going to sell them for fifty yen apiece.

lines.content: それ。採算取れるんですか
lines.translated: "Are you actually going to turn a profit with that?"

lines.content: そんなもの気にするのは人間といやしい一部の飼い犬だけだぞ大雅
lines.translated: "The only ones who worry about stuff like that are humans and a handful of greedy pet dogs, Taiga."

lines.content: 偏見たっぷりなことをぴしゃりと言われてしまう。
lines.translated: She shot back with a remark full of prejudice.

lines.content: 犬猿の仲というか、犬猫の仲とでもいおうか。
lines.translated: Like cats and monkeys, or rather, fighting like cats and dogs.

lines.content: それ以上にこの町の猫たちは犬の存在を煙たがっているようだった――と、まあ、そんなことはとりあえずいいとして。
lines.translated: More than that, the cats in this town seemed to find the very existence of dogs to be a nuisance--well, setting that aside for now.

lines.content: [・|も][・|う][・|ひ][・|と][・|り]はいつ戻ってくるんだろう。
lines.translated: I wondered when the other one was going to come out.

lines.content: あさひさんにそれを問いかけようとしたところで、俺はふと視線を感じ、振り向いた。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to ask Asahi-san about it, I suddenly felt someone's gaze and turned around.

lines.content: 奥座敷の扉から猫の耳。そして尻尾が覗いていた。
lines.translated: A pair of cat ears--and a tail--were peeking out from behind the door to the back parlor.

lines.content: クロ？　どうしたんだ？
lines.translated: "Kuro? What's wrong?"

lines.content: そんなところに隠れてないで出てくればいいのに
lines.translated: "You don't have to hide back there. Just come on out."

lines.content: とはいえ、クロの性格からしてそれは無理からぬ話だ。
lines.translated: That said, given Kuro's personality, it was understandable.

lines.content: ここには今、俺だけではなくハルとあさひさんがいる。警戒してしまうのはクロの性格上、しかたのないことか。
lines.translated: Right now, it wasn't just me here, but Haru and Asahi-san as well. Given her nature, she couldn't help being on her guard.

lines.content: そう、思っていたけど。
lines.translated: Or so I thought.

lines.content: どうやらそういう理由ではないらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, that wasn't the reason at all.

lines.content: …………はずか、しい
lines.translated: "...It's embar... rassing."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: …………恥ずかしいよ、大雅
lines.translated: "...I'm embarrassed, Taiga."

lines.content: ぷるぷると耳と尻尾がふるえていた。
lines.translated: Her ears and tail were trembling.

lines.content: ……どうして、こんな。わたしまで、こんな
lines.translated: "...Why do I have to wear something like this? Why even me...?"

lines.content: ふふん。そんなのは決まってる
lines.translated: "Heheh. Isn't it obvious?"

lines.content: あさひさんが得意そうに言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke smugly.

lines.content: 売り子はかわいい子に限る。理由はそれ以上必要だろうか――否。まったく不要だ。そうだろう大雅
lines.translated: "Salesgirls have to be cute. Do we really need any more reason than that? Nay. None whatsoever. Right, Taiga?"

lines.content: え？　あ、はぁ……
lines.translated: "Huh? Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 意味もわからず俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: Not really getting what she meant, I nodded along.

lines.content: すると不満たっぷりの声が返ってきた。
lines.translated: At that, a voice full of displeasure answered back.

lines.content: ……なら、ハルだけでいい。わたしは、そこにいらない。必要ない
lines.translated: "...Then Haru is enough. You don't need me out there. I'm unnecessary."

lines.content: いいや必要だ。ひとりよりふたり。ふたりよりも……もっともっとなんだ。ハルと、十夜と、そして君だ
lines.translated: "No, we definitely need you. Two is better than one. And even better than two is... the more the merrier. Haru, Toya, and you."

lines.content: 考えてもみなさい。私や大雅がかわいい格好で売り子なんかしてもおぞましいばっかりだ。集まる客も集まってこないじゃないか
lines.translated: "Just think about it. If Taiga or I dressed up in cute outfits to work the stall, it would just be a horrifying sight. We'd drive away the customers we're trying to attract."

lines.content: ……何気に俺にも自分にも大変失礼なことを言いますねあさひさん
lines.translated: "...You're casually saying something terribly rude to both me and yourself, Asahi-san."

lines.content: あと、ふいにトラウマに触れられてどきりともした。
lines.translated: Also, having a past trauma suddenly poked at made my heart skip a beat.

lines.content: だが事実だ。悲しいけれど。……そうだろ？
lines.translated: "It's the truth, though. Sad as it may be. ...Right?"

lines.content: ……そう、ですかね
lines.translated: "...I guess so."

lines.content: いや。実はがんばれば俺もかわいくなれるんですよあさひさん――そんな自分を追い詰めかねないことは口にしない。決して。
lines.translated: No, actually, if I really try, I can look pretty cute too, Asahi-san--I made sure never to voice something like that, which would only corner me. Never ever.

lines.content: 私のような歳でふりふりのかわいい服なんて着るのは見るに耐えない。そんなのまるで犯罪だよ。大雅
lines.translated: "Someone my age wearing frilly, cute clothes would be painful to look at. It'd practically be a crime, Taiga."

lines.content: そこまで自分を卑下しなくても。あさひさんは充分かわいい……というか、充分に美人ですよ
lines.translated: "You don't need to put yourself down that much. You're plenty cute, Asahi-san... or rather, you're a real beauty."

lines.content: ふ、ふん
lines.translated: "H-Hmph."

lines.content: 少し戸惑うような表情になるあさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san looked slightly flustered.

lines.content: 大雅……。いつから君はそんな平気な顔して、ちょっとドキッとするようなことを言えるようになっちゃったんだ。お姉さんはびっくりだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga... Since when did you learn to say things that make a girl's heart skip a beat with such a straight face? Big Sis here is shocked."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせそう言っていた。
lines.translated: She pouted as she said that.

lines.content: でも別に、あの服着なくても売り子くらいはできるでしょう？
lines.translated: "Still, you can at least work the stall without wearing that outfit, right?"

lines.content: わかってないなあ大雅。すべては形からなんだよ。“魔法少女”がかわいい服に変身しなきゃならないみたいにさ
lines.translated: "You just don't get it, Taiga. It's all about looking the part. Just like how a 'magical girl' has to transform into a cute outfit."

lines.content: まあ、そんなこんなで。大雅のかわいい相棒。そろそろ出て来なさい。今からお店の前にラムネを売るための屋台を組むんだ。それを一緒に手伝ってくれないかな
lines.translated: "Well, anyway. Taiga's cute little partner, it's about time you came on out. We're going to set up the stall in front of the shop to sell the ramune now. Mind giving us a hand with that?"

lines.content: ……いやだ
lines.translated: "...I don't want that."

lines.content: 耳が少し引っ込む。もうその先っぽしか見えない。
lines.translated: The ears pulled back slightly. Now only the very tips were visible.

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|の][・|服]。わたしには似合わない
lines.translated: "...These clothes. They don't suit me."

lines.content: ぶかぶかだし。ふりふりだし。[・|騙][・|さ][・|れ][・|た][・|ん][・|だ]。だからいやだ。やっぱり、やめる
lines.translated: "They're baggy. And frilly. I was tricked. So I don't want to. I'm quitting after all."

lines.content: お祭りなんて……勝手にやってればいい。わたしは部屋で眠ってる。しらんぷりだよ
lines.translated: "You can just... go do the festival on your own. I'm going to sleep in my room. I'm ignoring all of it."

lines.content: ……そっか。そんなに自分のかわいさに自信があるのか
lines.translated: "...I see. So you're that confident in your own cuteness, huh?"

lines.content: ……むぅ。どうして、そうなる
lines.translated: "...Muu. How did you come to that conclusion?"

lines.content: 耳がぴしっと立っていた。
lines.translated: Her ears perked straight up.

lines.content: 不満の現れだ。
lines.translated: A sign of her displeasure.

lines.content: あるいはほんの少しの怒りの現れ。
lines.translated: Or perhaps a sign of a tiny bit of anger.

lines.content: ……そんなことだれも言ってないのに
lines.translated: "...Nobody said anything like that."

lines.content: 恥ずかしがれば恥ずかしがるだけ、逆に自信があるんじゃないかと勘ぐられても無理はないかなって思うけどな
lines.translated: "Well, the more bashful you act, the more natural it is for people to suspect you're actually confident in how you look, don't you think?"

lines.content: ……理屈がおかしい
lines.translated: "...Your logic makes no sense."

lines.content: そっかなあ。少なくとも私はそう思っちゃうけどな
lines.translated: "Really? That's how it looks to me, at least."

lines.content: だってそうだろう。そんなにいやがるのに、じゃあどうして[・|そ][・|れ]に着替えたんだ？　それは、あれだろ。ここにいる[・|誰][・|か]に見てもらいたかったんだろ
lines.translated: "I mean, come on. If you hate it that much, then why did you change into it in the first place? It's because of that, isn't it? You wanted a certain someone here to see you in it."

lines.content: あさひさんは意地悪げに俺を見た。
lines.translated: Asahi-san shot me a teasing look.

lines.content: 私がこの服着れば[・|誰][・|か]がかわいいと言って誉めてくれるんじゃないかとそう言ったからで――
lines.translated: "Because I told you that if you wore this outfit, a certain someone might compliment you and call you cute--"

lines.content: がらりと扉が開かれた。
lines.translated: The door slid open with a clatter.

lines.content: ……ちがう
クロが不満そうなジト目で現れた。
lines.translated: Kuro emerged, glaring with a deeply dissatisfied look on her face.

lines.content: ……断じて、ちがう
lines.translated: "...Absolutely not."

lines.content: 繰り返し力強くそう言うクロ。
lines.translated: Kuro repeated the words forcefully.

lines.content: いつもと違う――ハルのものとも違う、かわいい服装をしていた。
lines.translated: She was wearing a cute outfit, completely different from her usual clothes--and different from Haru's, too.

lines.content: ひらひらで。ふりふりで――
lines.translated: It was fluttery. And frilly--

lines.content: おお。すごい
lines.translated: "Whoa. Amazing."

lines.content: ――俺は、驚きの声をあげていた。
lines.translated: --I let out a gasp of surprise.

lines.content: ついっとクロはそっぽを向いてしまった。
lines.translated: Kuro abruptly turned her head away.

lines.content: 長い髪に隠れてしまいその顔はよく見えない。
lines.translated: Her long hair fell over her face, hiding her expression from view.

lines.content: クロはそのままもにょもにょと、言う。
lines.translated: Staying like that, she mumbled under her breath.

lines.content: ……この服きたのは、あさひが、わたしの服を洗濯しちゃったから。これしか着るのがなかったから。だから、仕方なくて……
lines.translated: "...I only wore these clothes because Asahi washed mine. I had nothing else to wear. So I had no choice..."

lines.content: ずっと同じ服着てるなんて、だめだ。女の子として失格どころの話じゃないよ。いったいどこで何をしてるのか知らないけど、どろどろに汚れてたんだぞ
lines.translated: "You can't just wear the exact same clothes all the time. That goes way beyond just failing as a girl. I have no idea where you go or what you do, but they were covered in mud."

lines.content: ……しらない。ほっといてほしい
lines.translated: "...Who cares. Just leave me alone."

lines.content: 不潔な子は嫌われるぞ。[・|誰][・|か]にも愛想を尽かされるかもしれない。それでもいいのかな
lines.translated: "People don't like girls who are dirty, you know. A certain someone might even get fed up with you. Would you really be okay with that?"

lines.content: 長い長い沈黙の後、
lines.translated: After a long, drawn-out silence,

lines.content: 構わない――と。
lines.translated: "--care," she finished.

lines.content: クロは、小さくちいさくそう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke in a tiny, barely audible voice.

lines.content: ……別にだれかに好かれたいから、生きてるわけじゃないんだ。嫌われたっていい。だから……
lines.translated: "...It's not like I'm living just to be liked by someone. I don't care if I'm hated. So..."

lines.content: クロ。その服すごく似合ってる。かわいいなあって、思うよ
lines.translated: "Kuro. That outfit looks great on you. I think it's really cute."

lines.content: 思わずというようにクロは俺を見上げた。
lines.translated: Kuro looked up at me as if by reflex.

lines.content: 奥間から姿を見せてくれてから、ずっと、俺の目を一切見ようとせずうつむいていたのに。
lines.translated: Even though she had been staring at the floor and refusing to meet my eyes ever since she came out of the back room.

lines.content: 確かにふりふりで。ふわふわしだけど。こんなクロ、はじめて見たけれど……うん。すごくいいんじゃないかなって思うよ
lines.translated: "Sure, it's frilly and fluffy. And I've never seen you dressed like this before, Kuro... Yeah. I think it looks really good."

lines.content: あさひさんの言うとおりだ。
lines.translated: Asahi-san was right.

lines.content: こんなかわいい子が売り子をしてくれたら、ちょっと作りすぎたかもしれないラムネの瓶もあっという間に完売しそうだ。
lines.translated: With such a cute girl working the stall, all those bottles of ramune we might have overproduced would probably sell out in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: クロはまたうつむいた。
lines.translated: Kuro looked down again.

lines.content: そしてぽつりと、言う。
lines.translated: And then, she murmured quietly.

lines.content: ……大雅。騙されてはいけない
lines.translated: "...Taiga. You mustn't be deceived."

lines.content: 騙される？　何を？
lines.translated: "Deceived? By what?"

lines.content: ……色々
lines.translated: "...A lot of things."

lines.content: 色々？
lines.translated: "A lot of things?"

lines.content: 色々だよ
lines.translated: "A lot of things."

lines.content: そっか。色々か
lines.translated: "I see. A lot of things, huh."

lines.content: クロはこっくりとうなずく。
lines.translated: Kuro gave a firm nod.

lines.content: そして、小走りであさひさんと店から出ていった――屋台の準備とかをするためだろう。
lines.translated: Then, she hurried out of the shop with Asahi-san--probably to get the stall ready.

lines.content: うん、うん、確かにそうだね。すごくかわいい
lines.translated: "Yep, yep, that's definitely true. Super cute."

lines.content: ハルが得心深く何度もうなずいていた。
lines.translated: Haru nodded repeatedly, looking thoroughly convinced.

lines.content: すっごくよく似合ってたよね。これで商売繁盛間違いなしだよね――って、あれ
lines.translated: "It suited her so well. Business is guaranteed to boom now--wait, huh?"

lines.content: そこでハルは何かに気づいたらしい。ハッとした表情を浮かべた。
lines.translated: Haru seemed to realize something right then. A look of sudden realization crossed her face.

lines.content: そしていつの間にか隣に立っていた十夜に耳打ちをしていた。
lines.translated: Then she leaned in and whispered into the ear of Toya, who had quietly come to stand beside her at some point.

lines.content: ……ねえ十夜。おかしいよね。十夜も、私も、ほら、かわいい服に着替えたのに。なんだか大雅くんの扱いに差があるような気がするよ……気のせいかな。気のせいだよね？
lines.translated: "...Hey, Toya. Isn't it weird? Both you and I changed into cute clothes too, look. Don't you feel like there's a difference in how Taiga-kun is treating us... Is it just my imagination? It's just my imagination, right?"

lines.content: ハルちゃん……
lines.translated: "Haru-chan..."

lines.content: 十夜はそっとハルに微笑みかけた。
lines.translated: Toya gave Haru a gentle smile.

lines.content: ハルちゃんはかわいいよ。凄くすごくかわいいって私は思うな
lines.translated: "You're cute, Haru-chan. I think you're really, really cute."

lines.content: え。そ、そうかな
lines.translated: "Huh? R-Really?"

lines.content: うん。そうだよ。……ねえハルちゃん。私たちももっともっと、誉めてもらえる人生だったらよかったね
lines.translated: "Yeah, really. ...Hey, Haru-chan. Wouldn't it have been nice if we'd lived lives where we got praised a whole lot more, too?"

lines.content: だからね、ハルちゃん、元気出してね？　と、なぜだかかわいそうな子を見る目でそう言った。
lines.translated: "So cheer up, okay, Haru-chan?" she added, looking at her with eyes full of pity for some reason.

lines.content: うう。急に十夜が年上のお姉ちゃんみたいに思えてきちゃったよ
lines.translated: "Ugh. All of a sudden, Toya feels like an older sister to me."

lines.content: ふたりしていじいじとしていた。
lines.translated: The two of them sulked together.

lines.content: いやあ。ふたりともかわいいよ。いやマジで
lines.translated: "Come on, you're both cute too. No, seriously."
"Huuuh?"
"Oh, reaaally?"

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。いや。マジで
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. No, seriously."

lines.content: 恨めしそうなふたつの視線に俺は思わず背を向けてしまうのだった。
lines.translated: Faced with two resentful glares, I couldn't help but turn my back on them.

lines.content: ――“春の夜”は大盛況だった。
lines.translated: --The "Spring Night" was a massive success.

lines.content: この日の“夜”を飾りたてる猫たちは、日常的な“夜の国”の開催に比べても気合い充分という具合だったし――
lines.translated: The cats decorating this "Night" were way more enthusiastic than they usually were for the everyday "Night Realm"--

lines.content: [眠りの中|“夜の国”]に夢見るためやってきた人間たちの“心”も、賑やかな祭りの風景に笑顔をこぼすことが多かった――
lines.translated: And the human "hearts" who had come to the "Night Realm" in their sleep to dream often broke into smiles at the lively festival scenery--

lines.content: きっといつもよりたくさん、その心を苦しめる“悪夢”を“夜の国”に捨てていくことができたのだろう。
lines.translated: They were surely able to cast away far more of the "nightmares" tormenting their hearts into the "Night Realm" than usual.

lines.content: みんなで用意し販売したラムネの瓶は完売――とまではいかなかったが、それでも数本を残す程度だった。売れ行きは上々だったと言える。
lines.translated: The bottles of ramune we had all prepared and sold didn't quite sell out completely--but we were only left with a handful. It was safe to say sales had gone exceptionally well.

lines.content: ラムネを買った“心”たちは、みなどこか穏やかな顔をしているように見えた。
lines.translated: All the "hearts" who bought ramune seemed to have peaceful expressions on their faces.

lines.content: 今夜はとてもいい“夢”が見れるに違いない。
lines.translated: There was no doubt they would have wonderful "dreams" tonight.

lines.content: ……だが、“春の夜”がすべてうまくいったかと言えば、そうではない。
lines.translated: However, if you asked whether everything about the "Spring Night" had gone well, that wasn't entirely the case.

lines.content: ……さくらの木。咲かなかったね
lines.translated: "...The cherry blossom tree. It didn't bloom, did it?"

lines.content: ハルがぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: Haru murmured quietly.

lines.content: ふたりで屋台を片付けている最中だった。
lines.translated: The two of us were in the middle of packing up the stall.

lines.content: お祭りもそろそろ終わっちゃうけど……今年もだめだったってことになるのかな
lines.translated: "The festival is almost over, too... I guess that means it didn't work out this year either, huh?"

lines.content: その視線の先には学園がある。
lines.translated: The academy lay at the end of her gaze.

lines.content: そしてそこに寄り添うようにしてたつ大きなおおきなさくらの木が――いぜん、沈黙したまま立っていた。
lines.translated: And standing right beside it, the huge, towering cherry blossom tree--remained completely silent, just as before.

lines.content: 不思議だね
lines.translated: "It's strange, isn't it?"

lines.content: ん？　何が？
lines.translated: "Hm? What is it?"

lines.content: 夢の外で咲いてるさくらの木は、“夜の国”でも咲いてるんだなあって
lines.translated: "I was just thinking how the cherry trees blooming outside the dream are blooming in the 'Night Realm' too."

lines.content: 学園の年老いたさくらの木は咲かずとも、その他、町中を飾る若いさくらの木々は満開に咲いている。その光景は夢の中も外も殆ど変わらず同じもの。
lines.translated: Even though the old cherry tree at the academy hadn't bloomed, all the other young cherry trees decorating the town were in full bloom. That scenery was almost completely identical both inside and outside the dream.

lines.content: そこには何かしらの相互関係があるのか。それともまったくの偶然なのか――ハルの疑問はそういうことだろう。
lines.translated: Was there some kind of mutual connection between them? Or was it a total coincidence?--That was probably what Haru was wondering about.

lines.content: 木や花は夢を見ないからね。現実と夢を区別できない。だから……
lines.translated: "Trees and flowers don't dream, after all. They can't tell reality and dreams apart. That's why..."

lines.content: 夢の中でも外でも、花は咲くし、花は、枯れる？
lines.translated: "Inside the dream and outside it, flowers bloom, and flowers wither?"

lines.content: かもね
lines.translated: "Maybe."

lines.content: この町に春を迎え入れるため、猫たちが作り上げる季節の祭り――“春の夜”
lines.translated: A seasonal festival put together by the cats to welcome spring into this town--"Spring Night."

lines.content: 町中さくらの色でいっぱいだ。甘い香りで、いっぱいだ。
lines.translated: The whole town was filled with the color of cherry blossoms. Filled with a sweet fragrance.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: だけど今年も、猫たちの希望はかなえられそうになかった。[・|あ][・|の][・|さ][・|く][・|ら][・|の][・|木]は咲かぬままだ。
lines.translated: Even so, it looked like the cats' wish wouldn't come true this year either. That cherry blossom tree remained unbloomed.

lines.content: なぜだか次の言葉を選べずにいた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't find the words to say next.

lines.content: ふたりして“夜”の町をただ、眺めた。
lines.translated: The two of us simply gazed out at the town of the "Night."

lines.content: きっと互いに話さなければならないだろうことはわかっている。
lines.translated: I knew there was something we both undoubtedly needed to talk about.

lines.content: だが、どんなふうに切り出して良いものか……。
lines.translated: Yet I had no idea how to bring it up...

lines.content: あのね、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Um, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 何？　と俺は答える。
lines.translated: "What is it?" I replied.

lines.content: ふと沈黙が破られたことに少しばかり動揺していた。
lines.translated: Having the silence suddenly broken threw me off balance a little.

lines.content: だけどハルが口にしたのは、想定していた[・|そ][・|の][・|こ][・|と]とは少し違った。
lines.translated: However, what Haru brought up was slightly different from that topic I had been expecting.

lines.content: あの日のこと、質問してみてもいいかな
lines.translated: "Could I ask you a question about that day?"

lines.content: あの日？
lines.translated: "That day?"

lines.content: うん。あず咲先輩の“心”とさよならした“夜”のことだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. About the 'Night' we said goodbye to Azusaki-senpai's 'heart.'"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: まだ、あれから一週間も経ってないんだな。もうずっと昔のことみたいに思えるけど
lines.translated: "It hasn't even been a week since then, huh. Even though it already feels like it happened a long time ago."

lines.content: ……そうだね。同じくらい、つい昨日のことみたいにも思えるけれど
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Though just as much, it also feels like it happened just yesterday."

lines.content: うなずく俺に、ハルは続ける。
lines.translated: As I nodded, Haru continued.

lines.content: 私たち、あず咲先輩と二回もさよならしちゃったけれど……
lines.translated: "We ended up saying goodbye to Azusaki-senpai twice, didn't we..."

lines.content: 一度目は、十年前の“夜”の中。
lines.translated: The first time was inside the "Night" ten years ago.

lines.content: あのときのまだまだ小さな私たちは、あず咲先輩や智仁くんに、何もできなかった……でも
lines.translated: "Back then, we were still so small, and we couldn't do anything for Azusaki-senpai or Tomohito-kun... But..."

lines.content: 二度目のさよならは、一週間ほど前の“夜”の中。
lines.translated: The second goodbye was inside the "Night" about a week ago.

lines.content: でも、あの日は……
lines.translated: "But on that day..."

lines.content: 二度目のあの日は、遠い昔と違って、大雅くんが智仁くんを連れてきてくれたから……
lines.translated: "On that second day, unlike so long ago, you brought Tomohito-kun there, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: それは私たちが……ううん。大雅くんが、あの日よりもずっと大きく、強い、大人に……ヒーローになれたんだって、ことなんだよね
lines.translated: "That means we... no, it means you grew into an adult--a hero--who is so much bigger and stronger than you were back then, right, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 大人になるってことは、できることが増えることだって誰かが言ってたし……
lines.translated: "Someone once said that growing up means being able to do more things, after all..."

lines.content: ヒーロー……か。
lines.translated: A hero... huh.

lines.content: 大雅くん
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……うん？
lines.translated: "...Yeah?"

lines.content: 智仁くんに“才能”をあげるため、“魔法”になったあず咲先輩は……その代償に、“夜”の向こうに旅立たなくちゃいけなくて
lines.translated: "In order to give Tomohito-kun 'talent,' Azusaki-senpai became 'magic'... and in exchange for that, she had to depart beyond the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ハルと俺とで、そんなあず咲先輩を見送ることになったのだけど……。
lines.translated: And Haru and I ended up being the ones to see Azusaki-senpai off, however...

lines.content: あの日。あの“夜”。旅立つあず咲先輩を連れて、一度、“刻の終着駅”の前まで来てたのに……忘れ物を思い出したからって言って、引き返していったよね
lines.translated: "That day. That 'Night.' Even though you brought Azusaki-senpai all the way to the front of the 'Terminal Station of Time' as she was about to depart... you said you remembered something you forgot, and turned right back around, didn't you?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: その忘れ物が智仁くんのことだとは思わなかった。何も教えてくれてないんだもん。ちょっとびっくりだったよ
lines.translated: "I never thought the thing you forgot was Tomohito-kun. You didn't tell me anything at all, after all. It surprised me a little."

lines.content: いや……
俺は首を振り、言う。
lines.translated: I shook my head and spoke.

lines.content: 違うよ。あれは、ハルのおかげだ
lines.translated: "No. That was all thanks to you, Haru."

lines.content: ああ。俺ひとりじゃあ智仁を連れてこようとは思えなかった……ハル、覚えてないかな。ずっと言ってたろ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. On my own, I never would've thought of bringing Tomohito there... Don't you remember, Haru? You kept saying it the whole time, right?"

lines.content: えっと。私……。何を言ったのかな。ごめん。よく覚えてなくて
lines.translated: "Um. I did...? What did I say? Sorry, I don't really remember."

lines.content: 最初に、ハルはこう言ったんだよ
lines.translated: "First, this is what you said, Haru."

lines.content: “智仁くんが音楽を届けたい人は[・|あ][・|ず][・|咲][・|先][・|輩]のことじゃないかな”
lines.translated: "'Could it be that the person Tomohito-kun wants to reach with his music is actually Azusaki-senpai?'"

lines.content: “だって、智仁くん。音楽を届けたい人とはずっと喧嘩したままだって言ってたし……”
lines.translated: "'Because Tomohito-kun said he's still in the middle of a fight with the person he wants his music to reach...'"

lines.content: それがずっと胸に引っかかってた
lines.translated: "That had been stuck in the back of my mind the whole time."

lines.content: ハルがそんな疑問をくれなければ、智仁はそばにいてくれる“お姉さんの想い”については、もうすっかり忘れてしまっていて……
lines.translated: "If you hadn't raised that question, Haru, I would've never doubted that Tomohito had completely forgotten about the 'feelings of the older sister' staying right by his side..."

lines.content: だから智仁は、未来のお姉さんに[・|だ][・|け]届くように歌を作りたい――そう願ってるんだと、俺は疑いもしなかった
lines.translated: "And that because of that, he was wishing to write a song that would reach only his sister in the future."

lines.content: それは、ハル……。
lines.translated: That was, Haru...

lines.content: だぶんだけど、君はそれになんとなくだけど、気づいてたんじゃないかな。確証はなくても、雰囲気というか予感というか。そういった感じで
lines.translated: "Maybe I'm wrong, but I feel like you vaguely picked up on it, didn't you? Even without solid proof, just from the atmosphere, or a hunch, or something like that."

lines.content: ど、どうかな……。ちょっと私を買いかぶりすぎじゃないかな。大雅くん
lines.translated: "I-I wonder... Aren't you giving me a little too much credit, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 苦笑いでハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru said with a wry smile.

lines.content: だけど、いいんだ。俺がそう思いたいのだから、俺の世界は[・|そ][・|う]なのだ――柊ハル。君は俺のヒーローなんだ。だから、それでいい。そういうことにしておきたい。
lines.translated: Still, that was fine. Because that was what I wanted to believe, that was how it was in my world--Hiiragi Haru. You're my hero. So that's fine. I want to leave it at that.

lines.content: 智仁くんの歌は届いた
lines.translated: "Tomohito-kun's song reached her."

lines.content: ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up.

lines.content: 未来へ想いを届けるのにはまだまだ時間が掛かるかもしれない。でも、[・|今]、智仁くんが一番気持ちを届けたかった誰かには、きっと届いた
lines.translated: "It might still take a long time to deliver his feelings to the future. But right now, they definitely reached the person Tomohito-kun wanted to convey his feelings to the most."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: だからきっと、大成功だよね
lines.translated: "So it was definitely a huge success, right?"

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: うなずき、笑う。
lines.translated: I nodded and smiled.

lines.content: 一週間も停学くらったけど、大成功だ
lines.translated: "We got hit with a week-long suspension, though, so yeah, a huge success."

lines.content: う、うん。そうだね……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. That's true..."

lines.content: 私たち、すっかり問題児になっちゃったね
lines.translated: "We've completely turned into problem children, haven't we?"

lines.content: ハルは苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: A wry smile floated onto Haru's face.

lines.content: そして小さな声で、『……覚えてる？』と言った。
lines.translated: And then, in a quiet voice, she said, "...Do you remember?"

lines.content: 今回の“春の学園祭”……がんばるから。いっぱい、いっぱい、がんばって……もしも大成功できたなら
lines.translated: "This 'Spring Cultural Festival'... I did my best. I tried really, really hard... and if we managed to make it a huge success..."

lines.content: 約束、だったよね？　とハルが言う。
lines.translated: "It was a promise, right?" Haru said.

lines.content: 大雅くんが、私の“夢”を叶えてくれるって……
lines.translated: "That you would grant my 'dream,' Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 俺へと手を差し伸べる。
lines.translated: She held her hand out toward me.

lines.content: 大雅くんが私の“魔法”を使って、私の“夢”を叶えてくれるって……約束、してくれたよね？
lines.translated: "You promised me that you would use my 'magic' and grant my 'dream'... right, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだね。覚えてるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. I remember."

lines.content: 俺は差し出された手を……まずは、見つめる。
lines.translated: First... I stared at the hand she held out to me.

lines.content: 大雅くん……？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun...?"

lines.content: なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: うん。なに
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it?"

lines.content: 改めて、まずは少しだけ教えてほしい。君の“夢”は、“[魔法|希望]”は、どんなものなのかな
lines.translated: "Before we do that, I want you to tell me just a little bit. What kind of thing is your 'dream'--your 'hope'?"

lines.content: 俺は確かに君と約束した。学園祭をがんばって、がんばって……大成功させられたなら、次はハルの“魔法”を使うって
lines.translated: "I definitely made a promise with you. That if we tried hard, really hard at the cultural festival... and made it a huge success, I'd use your 'magic' next, Haru."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: でも、俺はさ。学園祭が成功しようとしなかろうと、ハルの“魔法”をいつかは使おうと思ってたんだ
lines.translated: "But you know, whether the cultural festival succeeded or not, I was planning on using your 'magic' eventually anyway."

lines.content: だけどまずは[・|そ][・|れ]を教えてもらわないと……。ハル。ごめん。言いにくいことなのかもしれないけど、ちゃんとそれが何なのか、わかった上で君の“魔法”に許可を出したい
lines.translated: "However, first I need you to tell me what it is... Sorry, Haru. It might be hard for you to talk about, but I want to properly understand what it is before I give permission for your 'magic.'"

lines.content: それが俺の“役割”だから。
lines.translated: Because that is my "role."

lines.content: 俺は自分のやるべきことを果たしたい。
lines.translated: I want to fulfill what I'm supposed to do.

lines.content: そう言う俺を前にして、
lines.translated: Facing me as I said that,

lines.content: 私の“夢”は……、あの、さくらだよ
lines.translated: "My 'dream' is... that cherry blossom tree."

lines.content: ハルは“夜”の空をふと見上げた。
lines.translated: Haru suddenly looked up into the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: あのさくらを、ずっと枯れたままのさくらの木を、満開に咲かせたい。それが私の“夢”なんだよ。大雅くん
lines.translated: "I want to make that cherry blossom tree--the cherry tree that has remained withered for so long--bloom in full glory. That is my 'dream,' Taiga-kun."

lines.content: さくらの木を、満開に
lines.translated: "Make the cherry blossom tree bloom in full glory..."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: それは、どうして？　どうしてそういう“夢”をハルは持ったのかな
lines.translated: "Why is that? Why did you come to have a 'dream' like that, Haru?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: そこでハルは沈黙してしまう。
lines.translated: At that, Haru fell silent.

lines.content: なんだか複雑そうな笑顔のままで。
lines.translated: Wearing a somewhat complicated smile on her face.

lines.content: 俺には話せない“何か”があるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was there "something" she couldn't tell me?

lines.content: ……智仁があまり積極的には、姉への“想い”を俺たちに打ち明けられなかったように。
lines.translated: Just like how Tomohito hadn't been very eager to confide his "feelings" for his sister to us.

lines.content: 確かに。
lines.translated: That's true.

lines.content: 自分が実の姉を特別に想っているのかもしれない――そんな事情には、どんな理由があれ、本来は赤の他人が踏み込んで良いものではなかった。
lines.translated: That he might harbor special feelings for his own blood-related sister--circumstances like that, regardless of the reason, weren't something complete strangers had any right to pry into in the first place.

lines.content: もしもハルに智仁と同じような事情があったとしたら……。
lines.translated: If Haru had circumstances similar to Tomohito's...

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ん、んん？
lines.translated: "Hm? Hmmm?"

lines.content: くいくいと後ろから服を引っ張られる感触。
lines.translated: I felt a tugging sensation on my clothes from behind.

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: 十夜がいた。首をかしげて、俺を見上げている。
lines.translated: Toya was there. She was tilting her head, looking up at me.

lines.content: なに？　どうかした？
lines.translated: "What is it? Is something wrong?"

lines.content: ううん。ハルちゃん、どうしたの？　大丈夫？
lines.translated: "No. What's wrong, Haru-chan? Are you okay?"

lines.content: あ、うん。ありがとう、大丈夫。ちょっとだけ考え事してたんだよ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Thank you, I'm fine. I was just thinking about something for a bit."

lines.content: 心配そうに自分を見上げる十夜に、ハルはパッと笑顔を見せていた。
lines.translated: Haru flashed a bright smile at Toya, who was looking up at her worriedly.

lines.content: でも十夜は納得できなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: However, Toya didn't seem convinced.

lines.content: ……ねえ、ねえ。ほんとに大丈夫？　もしかして、大雅に意地悪なことされちゃったの？
lines.translated: "...Hey, hey. Are you really okay? Did Taiga do something mean to you?"

lines.content: む
lines.translated: "Urk."

lines.content: なんだか十夜の中での俺の評価が気になりはするものの……。
lines.translated: It kind of bothered me how low Toya's opinion of me seemed to be, though...

lines.content: 殆ど無理矢理にハルの“夢”だとか“魔法”だとか、そういったものを聞き出そうとしていたのだ――十夜の言うこともあまり間違っていないので、反論できない。
lines.translated: I had practically been trying to force Haru to spill her "dream" and her "magic" and all that--so what Toya was saying wasn't too far off the mark, leaving me unable to argue back.

lines.content: だから俺はズボンのポケットをごそごそと探り、言った。
lines.translated: So I rummaged around in my pants pocket and spoke.

lines.content: 十夜。君にいいものをあげよう
lines.translated: "Toya. I'll give you something nice."

lines.content: えー？　いいもの？
lines.translated: "Ehh? Something nice?"

lines.content: 目を細める。疑いの目だ。
lines.translated: She narrowed her eyes. A look of pure suspicion.

lines.content: そんな十夜に、俺は五百円玉を差し出した。
lines.translated: To the suspicious Toya, I held out a five-hundred-yen coin.

lines.content: ……これはこの前の仕事であさひさんから貰った、バイト代という名のお小遣い。その残りだ
lines.translated: "...This is what's left of the allowance--or rather, part-time pay--that Asahi-san gave me for that job the other day."

lines.content: つまり今の俺の全財産だ。
lines.translated: In other words, my entire life savings right now.

lines.content: この前のって？
lines.translated: "From the other day?"

lines.content: ほら、一緒に“ぬいぐるみ”の子を見送ったろ？
lines.translated: "You know, when we saw off that 'stuffed animal' kid together?"

lines.content: ずるい……。私はお小遣い、もらってないのに。お姉ちゃんは大雅にばっかり甘々なんだから
lines.translated: "No fair... I didn't get any allowance. Big Sis only ever spoils you, Taiga."

lines.content: まあまあそう言わず。この五百円玉を君に託すので、ほら、そこの自動販売機で好きなジュースを三人分、買ってきてくれないかな
lines.translated: "Now, now, don't say that. I shall entrust this five-hundred-yen coin to you, so hey, could you go buy three cans of whatever juice you like from that vending machine over there?"

lines.content: “夜”の中にも自販機あるとかなんだか不思議だけれども
lines.translated: "Though it is kind of weird that there's a vending machine inside the 'Night' at all."

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: むすっとした顔で、言う。
lines.translated: Making a sulky face, she spoke.

lines.content: 私のことが……、この妹のことが邪魔だから、甘いジュースでここを離れさせる気だね
lines.translated: "I'm... Your little sister is in the way, so you're trying to use sweet juice to get rid of me, aren't you?"

lines.content: 十夜。とっても賢い。
lines.translated: Toya is very smart.

lines.content: でも、いいよ。ハルちゃんと何かお話あるんでしょう？　大雅の言うこと聞いてあげる。ジュース、買ってくるよ
lines.translated: "But fine. You have something to talk about with Haru-chan, right? I'll listen to you, Taiga. I'll go buy the juice."

lines.content: ほんと賢い。
lines.translated: Seriously smart.

lines.content: だけどそのまま俺を見上げ、小首をかしげた。
lines.translated: However, she kept looking up at me and tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: ……あのね大雅
lines.translated: "...Um, hey, Taiga."

lines.content: うん。なに十夜
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it, Toya?"

lines.content: しゅわしゅわのジュース、買ってもいい？
lines.translated: "Can I buy fizzy juice?"

lines.content: しゅわしゅわの？
lines.translated: "Fizzy?"

lines.content: 炭酸のやつ
lines.translated: "The carbonated kind."

lines.content: 炭酸？　コーラとか？
lines.translated: "Carbonated? Like cola?"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: いいけども。あれ？　あさひさんのラムネではだめなのかな？
lines.translated: "I don't mind, sure. Huh? Is Asahi-san's ramune no good?"

lines.content: いいんだけれど……
lines.translated: "It's good, but..."

lines.content: お姉ちゃん、ラムネしか作らないし、それにお姉ちゃんの作る炭酸以外は炭酸強くて身体に悪いって、骨が溶けちゃうからだめだぞって、変なこと言うんだもん
lines.translated: "Big Sis only ever makes ramune, and besides, she says weird stuff like how any soda other than the ones she makes is too strongly carbonated and bad for my body, and that I'm not allowed to drink them because they'll melt my bones."

lines.content: はは。なんだかおばあちゃんみたいだ。あさひさん
lines.translated: "Haha. Asahi-san sounds kind of like a grandma."

lines.content: そうだよ。大雅もそう思うよね
lines.translated: "Right? You think so too, don't you, Taiga?"

lines.content: 十夜はぷりぷりしていた。
lines.translated: Toya was huffing indignantly.

lines.content: お外ではいっつもオレンジジュースとかしか買ってくれないんだもん。ちょっと違う味の炭酸、飲んでみたい。だから、いいかなって……
lines.translated: "Out in the real world, she only ever buys me orange juice and stuff. I want to try drinking a soda with a slightly different flavor. So I was wondering if it was okay..."

lines.content: ああ、もちろんいいよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course it is."

lines.content: やったあ！
lines.translated: "Yay!"

lines.content: おつりは進呈しましょう
lines.translated: "And I shall present the change to you."

lines.content: しんてー……？
lines.translated: "Pre-sent...?"

lines.content: 十夜のお財布に入れちゃって良いってことだよ――……ふ、ふへへ。お小遣いだよ、お嬢ちゃん
lines.translated: "It means you can put it in your wallet, Toya--...Hehehe. It's an allowance for you, little missy."

lines.content: ほんとっ、いいのっ！？
lines.translated: "Really?! Is it really okay?!"

lines.content: あ、ああ。いいとも……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. You bet..."

lines.content: しかし、十夜。いいかい。もし外で知らないおっちゃんにお小遣いあげるからこっちおいでって言われても……絶対だ。ぜったいついてっちゃだめなんだぞ？
lines.translated: "However, listen up, Toya. If some strange old guy outside ever tells you to come over because he'll give you an allowance... Never, okay? You must never, ever follow him, got it?"

lines.content: わかってるよー
lines.translated: "I know that!"

lines.content: にこにこと満面の笑顔だった。
lines.translated: She was beaming from ear to ear.

lines.content: うむ。ならば、いいだろう。改めてこれを君に進呈しましょう――あさひさんには秘密だぞ
lines.translated: "Good. In that case, very well. Once again, I present this to you--keep it a secret from Asahi-san, okay?"

lines.content: わーいっ、大雅大好きっ
lines.translated: "Yaaay, I love you, Taiga!"

lines.content: 飛び跳ねる。
lines.translated: She jumped up and down.

lines.content: うれしさ余って猫の耳。
lines.translated: So overjoyed that her cat ears popped out.

lines.content: 十夜は賢い。そしてかわいい。
lines.translated: Toya is smart. And cute.

lines.content: 大雅はちょろいよね！
lines.translated: "You're such a pushover, Taiga!"

lines.content: ……そして時どきちょっと小生意気。
lines.translated: And sometimes a little cheeky.

lines.content: ぱたぱたと自動販売機へと走って行った。
lines.translated: She pattered off toward the vending machine.

lines.content: そんな十夜の背中を見つめながら、
lines.translated: Watching Toya's back as she ran off,

lines.content: さ。行こう
lines.translated: "Come on. Let's go."

lines.content: ハルの手を、俺は掴んだ。
lines.translated: I grabbed Haru's hand.

lines.content: え？　行くって、どこに？
lines.translated: "Huh? Go where?"

lines.content: どこって。ハルの“夢”を叶えにだよ
lines.translated: "Where else? To make your 'dream' come true, Haru."

lines.content: 学園の方角を――今は“刻の終着駅”と姿を変えた、その建物の方角を、見上げる。
lines.translated: I looked up in the direction of the academy--toward the building that had now transformed into the "Terminal of Time."

lines.content: お邪魔な幼女さまが甘々な炭酸飲料に小さなお脳を痺れさせるその隙に……さあ、早く
lines.translated: "While themeddlesome little missy is numbing her tiny brain with super-sweet carbonated drinks... come on, hurry."

lines.content: も、もう。そんなこと言って……。十夜にバレても知らないよ？
lines.translated: "J-Jeez. Saying stuff like that... Don't blame me if Toya finds out, okay?"

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべるハルの手を引き、俺は“夜”の中を走って行った。
lines.translated: Pulling a wryly smiling Haru by the hand, I ran off into the "Night."

lines.content: “魔法少女”――
lines.translated: "Magical Girl"--

lines.content: この言葉が俺はきらいだ。
lines.translated: I hate those words.

lines.content: どんなに時が過ぎようと。
lines.translated: No matter how much time passes.

lines.content: どんなに、きらびやかに着飾ろうとも……。
lines.translated: No matter how dazzlingly they dress up...

lines.content: その姿を希望の象徴のようには、どうしたって思えないからだ。
lines.translated: I just can't bring myself to see that figure as a symbol of hope.
Even so, I decided to use her "magic."

lines.content: 柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 彼女はかつて俺が密かに、そして淡く憧れを抱いたヒーローだ。
lines.translated: She is the hero I once secretly and faintly admired.

lines.content: そんな彼女が求める“魔法”
lines.translated: The "magic" that she seeks...

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は必ず彼女自身を、あるいは彼女と関わるすべての者を、幸せな終わりへと導いてくれる。
lines.translated: It will surely lead her, or everyone involved with her, to a happy ending.

lines.content: そのはずだ。
lines.translated: That's how it should be.

lines.content: そうだよな。ハル。
lines.translated: Right, Haru?
Haru's "final magic" is to make that cherry tree bloom.

lines.content: そうすることでどんな“夢”が叶うのかは、まだ聞かされてはいないけれど……。
lines.translated: I haven't been told yet what kind of "dream" will come true by doing so, though...

lines.content: 俺は、君の“想い”を信じることにした。
lines.translated: I decided to believe in your "feelings."

lines.content: あとは君次第だ。
lines.translated: The rest is up to you.

lines.content: 君は、ハル。俺のことを信じてくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will you believe in me, Haru?

lines.content: ――“関係性”こそが俺たちの“魔法”の“鍵”となる。
lines.translated: --Our "relationship" is the very "key" to our "magic."

lines.content: 互いの心の距離がより近ければ近いほど、“魔法”は効果的に使えるようになるものだ。
lines.translated: The closer our hearts are to each other, the more effectively the "magic" can be used.

lines.content: そう伝えると、ハルは言った。
lines.translated: When I told her that, Haru said,

lines.content: 私たちの関係は、まだまだ昔のまま――幼馴染みのままだけど。今の私たちの“関係性”で、私は上手く大雅くんの“魔法”になれるかな
lines.translated: "Our relationship is still the same as it was back then--just childhood friends. With our 'relationship' as it is now, I wonder if I can properly become your 'magic,' Taiga-kun."

lines.content: あのさくらを咲かせるのはきっと容易な“魔法”では成し遂げられない。
lines.translated: Making that cherry tree bloom surely cannot be accomplished with simple "magic."

lines.content: だからより強固な“関係性”が必要だ。
lines.translated: That is why a stronger "relationship" is needed.

lines.content: たとえ“夜”の中で、あのさくらを……長いながい間、花を咲かせていないあの木を咲かせられたとしても、それはやっぱりただ一瞬の、一晩かぎりの“夢”になるだろうと思う
lines.translated: "Even if we manage to make that cherry tree--that tree that hasn't bloomed for such a long, long time--blossom within the 'Night,' I think it will still just be a fleeting 'dream' for a single night."

lines.content: 夜の中で咲いても、現実世界でその花が芽吹くことはないだろう。
lines.translated: Even if it blooms within the Night, those flowers probably won't bud in the real world.

lines.content: ハル。さくらを咲かせたいのはもちろん、“夜”の中だけじゃない。[・|外]の世界でも満開にさせたい。だから、俺に“魔法”の“許可”がほしいんだよな
lines.translated: "Haru. Naturally, it's not just within the 'Night' that you want to make the cherry tree bloom. You want to bring it to full bloom in the outside world, too. That's why you want 'permission' for your 'magic' from me, right?"

lines.content: “魔法”を“夜”の[・|外]へと持ち出すための“許可”が。
lines.translated: "Permission" to bring the "magic" outside of the "Night."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: だったら尚更だ。……現実でも。夢の中ででも。花を咲かせるのには、やっぱりそれ相応の“[魔法|関係性]”が必要だ
lines.translated: "In that case, all the more reason. ...Whether in reality, or within a dream. To make the flowers bloom, we really do need a commensurate 'relationship'--our own 'magic.'"

lines.content: 一緒にいけないことをするのはどうかな
lines.translated: "How about we do something naughty together?"

lines.content: え？　いけないこと？
lines.translated: "Huh? Something naughty?"

lines.content: ああ、“今のままの関係でちゃんと魔法を使えるか、不安”――だったら、俺たちは今より仲良くなれればいい。そうだろ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. 'I'm worried if we can properly use magic with our relationship as it is now'--if that's the case, we just need to get closer than we are now. Right?"

lines.content: そう、かも……？
聞いたことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "I heard something once."

lines.content: うん。……なにを？
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...What did you hear?"

lines.content: 仲良くなりたい誰かともっと仲良くなる一番の方法は、一緒にいけないことをすればいい――
lines.translated: "That the best way to get closer to someone you want to get along with is to do something naughty together--"

lines.content: そして、誰にも言っちゃあだめだよって。ふたりだけの秘密を共有すること。それが仲良しになる一番の近道だって
lines.translated: "And then tell each other, 'You mustn't tell anyone.' Sharing a secret just between the two of you. They say that's the shortest route to becoming close."

lines.content: え、ええ。なんだかそれってあんまり信じちゃいけないタイプの“噂”だって思うなあ
lines.translated: "U-Umm. Somehow, I think that's the type of 'rumor' you really shouldn't believe."

lines.content: “噂”かあ。確かにそうかも
lines.translated: "A 'rumor,' huh? That might be true."

lines.content: でも、うん。面白そうではあるよね
lines.translated: "But, yeah. It does sound interesting, doesn't it?"

lines.content: 俺たちは少しだけ笑い合う。
lines.translated: We shared a small laugh.

lines.content: だったら、大雅くん。今夜の私たちはどんないけないこと、するのかな
lines.translated: "In that case, Taiga-kun. What kind of naughty thing are we going to do tonight?"

lines.content: うーん……
少し考えて、言う。
lines.translated: I thought for a bit, then spoke.

lines.content: さくら、かな
lines.translated: "The cherry tree, maybe."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: まずは“夜”の中であのさくらを咲かせるんだ。一晩かぎりの満開だよ
lines.translated: "First, we'll make that cherry tree bloom within the 'Night.' A full bloom for one night only."

lines.content: それだけでも、町の猫たちは大慌てだろうって思う。あさひさんも十夜もだ。何があったんだって
lines.translated: "Just that alone will probably throw the town's cats into a huge panic. Asahi-san and Toya, too. Wondering what on earth happened."

lines.content: そんなひとたちのことを、影でこっそり、ふたりで笑いながら見てやろう。
lines.translated: Let's secretly watch them from the shadows, laughing together.

lines.content: うん。これは最高に悪いことだ。悪いことだけど、決して誰も傷つけない――許されていいレベルの“いけないこと”だと思う。どうかな
lines.translated: "Yeah. This is the ultimate bad deed. It's bad, yet it doesn't hurt anyone--a 'naughty thing' on a level that's okay to be forgiven. What do you think?"

lines.content: たとえ思い描くすべてを叶えられる“夜”の中だとはいえ、あのさくらを咲かせるのはやはり、容易ではないだろう。
lines.translated: Even though we are inside the "Night" where anything we envision can be granted, making that cherry tree bloom still won't be easy.

lines.content: 容易に成せることならもう既に誰かがそうしてる。
lines.translated: If it were something easily done, someone would have already done it.

lines.content: だけど十年前に“特別”だった彼女の力を借りられれば、それは、達成できるはず。
lines.translated: But if I can borrow the power of the girl who was "special" ten years ago, we should be able to achieve it.

lines.content: ……うん。確かにそうかもだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That might really be true."

lines.content: そして[・|同][・|時][・|に]、“夜”の外でもさくらを満開にできるようになれたなら……。
lines.translated: And if, at the same time, we become able to bring the cherry tree to full bloom outside the "Night" as well...

lines.content: ほんのちょっとの悪戯の果て、そういうふうに俺たちの心の距離が縮まったのなら。
lines.translated: If, at the end of a tiny little prank, the distance between our hearts shrinks like that.

lines.content: あさひさんや十夜だけじゃなくって、千和ちゃんや姫織ちゃん、そして智仁くんたちも、いっぱい驚かせられちゃうかもしれないね
lines.translated: "Not just Asahi-san and Toya, we might be able to give Chiwa-chan, Himeori-chan, and Tomohito-kun and the others a huge surprise, too!"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: みんなを驚かせるのは、なんであれ、想像するだけで楽しそうだ。そんな悪戯心が芽吹いてしまう。
lines.translated: Surprising everyone, no matter how, sounds fun just imagining it. That kind of mischievousness began to bud within me.

lines.content: 俺たちは時計塔をのぼり、その場所にまでやって来た。
lines.translated: We climbed the clock tower and arrived at that place.

lines.content: ここが、この町で、あのさくらに一番ちかいところだけれど……
lines.translated: "This is the closest place in town to that cherry tree, though..."

lines.content: 辺りをそっと見回す。意図して小声になり、言う。
lines.translated: I quietly looked around. Deliberately lowering my voice, I spoke.

lines.content: 立ち入り禁止を全力で無視してのぼってきてしまったね
lines.translated: "We completely ignored the 'Keep Out' sign and climbed all the way up here, huh."

lines.content: そ、そうだね。どきどきするよね
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah, we did. It makes your heart race, doesn't it?"

lines.content: これは、どうかな。いけないことレベルの判定は？
lines.translated: "How about this? What's the verdict on the naughtiness level?"

lines.content: そう問いかけると、ハルは腕を組み思案して、
lines.translated: When I asked that, Haru crossed her arms and pondered.

lines.content: うん。ぎりぎりで、セーフかな？　いけないことだけど、誰も傷つけていないよね……？
lines.translated: "Yeah. Just barely safe, maybe? It's naughty, but we aren't hurting anyone, right...?"

lines.content: 苦笑いでそう言った。
lines.translated: She said with a wry smile.

lines.content: ……“刻の終着駅”
lines.translated: "The Terminal of Time."

lines.content: 時計塔の最上階。その管理室だ。
lines.translated: The top floor of the clock tower. Its control room.

lines.content: 窓の外には“夜”の光景が広がっている。
lines.translated: Outside the window, the scenery of the "Night" spread out.

lines.content: そして空には、咲かないさくらが、目一杯にその枝先を広げていた。
lines.translated: And in the sky, the unblooming cherry tree spread the tips of its branches as far as they could go.

lines.content: ここから見渡せる“夜”の街。
lines.translated: The town of "Night" overlooked from here.

lines.content: この光景を見ると思い出す。
lines.translated: Seeing this scenery brings back memories.

lines.content: やはり俺はどうしたって“魔法少女”を好ましくは思えない……。
lines.translated: After all is said and done, I really can't bring myself to like "Magical Girls"...

lines.content: だけど、[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]とはもう違う。
lines.translated: However, it's no longer like it was back then.
Right now, I am not being led by the hand by a girl.
I took the girl's hand, and came here just like this.

lines.content: ……大雅くん。大丈夫？
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun. Are you okay?"

lines.content: ん。あ……え？
lines.translated: "Hm? Ah... huh?"

lines.content: ぼーっとしてたから。顔色も、悪いよ……？
lines.translated: "You were spacing out. And you look pale, too...?"

lines.content: 気分悪いの？　平気なの？
lines.translated: "Do you feel sick? Are you alright?"

lines.content: ハルがしきりに俺を気遣う。
lines.translated: Haru fussed over me worriedly.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ハル。今回は、君の“夢”を叶えるためにここへ来たはずなのに――それなのにこうして、まずは俺のことを心配に思ってくれる。
lines.translated: Haru. We were supposed to have come here this time to make your "dream" come true--and yet, here you are putting your worry for me first.

lines.content: いつもすぐ自分のことばかりでいっぱいいっぱいになってしまう……こんな俺なんかとは違って。
lines.translated: Unlike someone like me... who always gets immediately overwhelmed with just his own problems.
Just what kind of "magic" is yours--wanting to bring this cherry tree into full bloom?

lines.content: その結果。柊ハルという女の子が、いったい何を得るのか。
lines.translated: And as a result, what on earth will the girl named Hiiragi Haru gain from it?

lines.content: 単純に興味が尽きない。その未来を見てみたいと、思う。
lines.translated: My curiosity simply knows no bounds. I want to see that future.

lines.content: そのためには文字通り、[・|心][・|の][・|準][・|備]が互いに必要なのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Though to do that, we both literally need to prepare our hearts for it first...

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: こっちへ、来てほしい
lines.translated: "Come over here."

lines.content: 手を差し伸べる。
lines.translated: I held out my hand.

lines.content: “夜”の力を付与された左手だ。
lines.translated: I held out my left hand, the one granted the power of the "Night."

lines.content: 早速だけどためしてみよう
lines.translated: "Right away, let's give it a try."

lines.content: 今から君の“魔法”を使いたい――ふたりであのさくらの花を咲かせようか。それが、ハル。君の“夢”、なんだよね
lines.translated: "I want to use your 'magic' right now--let's make those cherry blossoms bloom together. Because that's your 'dream,' isn't it, Haru?"

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: ハルが再び俺の手を取った。
lines.translated: Haru took my hand once again.

lines.content: ふたりで、一緒に……
lines.translated: "The two of us, together..."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 立ち入り禁止の場所に侵入しちゃう。そしてあのさくらを今から一緒に咲かせて、みんなを驚かせてやるんだ――って。そんなどきどきするような悪いことしようとしてる
lines.translated: "Sneaking into a keep-out zone. And now, making that cherry tree bloom together to surprise everyone. We're about to do something so bad it makes my heart race."

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: だからきっと、今夜の俺たちは、今までの俺たちよりもっと仲良くなれてるし、あのさくらを咲かせたなら――これからもっと、仲良しになれてる
lines.translated: "Which means that tonight, the two of us have surely grown closer than we've ever been before. And once we make that cherry tree bloom--we'll become even closer from here on out."

lines.content: なぜなら一緒にちょっとだけいけないことをして、秘密を共有する仲なのだ。それが俺たちの関係性。きっとそこに“魔法”が宿るはず。そう、信じる。
lines.translated: Because we're partners in crime, doing something just a little bit naughty together and sharing a secret. That is our relationship. "Magic" is bound to dwell within that. I believe it will.

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる――彼女のことを俺の“魔法”とするために。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids--to make her my "magic."

lines.content: 満開のさくらの風景を“想像”する。
lines.translated: I "imagined" the scenery of the cherry tree in full bloom.

lines.content: 隣のハルと、思い描いたその“[光景|想い]”を、重ねようとする。
lines.translated: I tried to overlap that "vision"--those feelings--I pictured with Haru beside me.

lines.content: ……柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: かつて特別だった女の子。
lines.translated: The girl who was once special.

lines.content: 十年前の“夜”の中で、彼女そのものが“夜の魔法使い”の使用する“魔法”となった。
lines.translated: Within the "Night" ten years ago, she herself became the "magic" used by a "Magician of the Night."

lines.content: “魔法”自体が独立した意志を持つ存在――“少女の形をした魔法”――ゆえに、“魔法少女”
lines.translated: Because the "magic" itself is an entity possessing an independent will--"magic in the form of a girl"--she is a "Magical Girl."

lines.content: その構図ゆえに彼女らを道具としてしかみなさない者たちがいることを知っている。
lines.translated: I know that because of how this works, there are those who view them as nothing more than tools.

lines.content: あさひさん以外、殆どの“夜の魔法使い”もそうなのだと聞く。特に別の町の“夜”に住む[・|彼][・|ら][・|彼][・|女][・|ら]は。
lines.translated: I've heard that aside from Asahi-san, almost all "Magicians of the Night" are like that. Especially those men and women living in the "Nights" of other towns.

lines.content: 俺は、“この町の魔法使い”陽向井あさひに育てられた。
lines.translated: I was raised by "this town's magician," Hinamukai Asahi.

lines.content: 彼女や彼女らのことを道具のように扱うことなどもちろんしない――そうでなければ“魔法”は強力に機能しない。それがあさひさんの考え方だ。
lines.translated: Of course I would never treat her or the other girls like tools--because if you do, the "magic" won't function powerfully. That is Asahi-san's way of thinking.

lines.content: なぜなら俺たちの“魔法”は、“関係性”こそが“鍵”となるのだから。
lines.translated: Because for our "magic," the "relationship" itself is the "key."

lines.content: だから俺は“君を使う”ではなく、“君の魔法を使いたい”と、細やかな気配りのつもりで、ハルにはそう言ったのだけど……。
lines.translated: That's why, intending to be considerate, I didn't say "use you" to Haru, but rather "I want to use your magic"...

lines.content: ……あ、あれ？
“想像”は、望む光景は、問題なく思い描けたはずだった――それなのに。
lines.translated: I should have been able to picture the "imagination," the desired scenery, without any problem--and yet.

lines.content: 花、咲かないな……
lines.translated: "The flowers aren't blooming..."

lines.content: 管理室の窓から見上げた枝には変化がない。
lines.translated: Looking up through the control room window, there was no change in the branches.

lines.content: それは、ハルと俺との心が上手に繋がらなかったということだ。
lines.translated: That meant Haru's heart and mine hadn't connected properly.

lines.content: うーん。まだまだ、一緒に悪いことし足りないのかな
lines.translated: "Hmm. Maybe we still haven't done enough bad things together yet?"

lines.content: おどけたようにそう言った。
lines.translated: I said jokingly.

lines.content: 隣のハルを見る。
lines.translated: I looked at Haru beside me.

lines.content: ……ハル？
lines.translated: "...Haru?"

lines.content: だけどハルは、うつむいたまま沈黙してしまっていた。
lines.translated: However, Haru was looking down, having fallen into silence.

lines.content: どうかしたのかなと問いかけようとしたところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was about to ask her what was wrong,

lines.content: ……あの、ね。大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Um, hey. Taiga-kun."

lines.content: バツの悪そうな声で、ハルが言った。
lines.translated: Haru spoke in an awkward-sounding voice.

lines.content: こんなこと言うの、変かもしれないけれど……。ずっと気になっていたことがあるんだよ
lines.translated: "It might be strange for me to say something like this, but... there's something that's been on my mind for a really long time."

lines.content: 気になっていたこと？　ずっと？
lines.translated: "Something on your mind? For a long time?"

lines.content: うん……。十年前からずっとだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... Ever since ten years ago."

lines.content: その“気になってること”が私の胸の中に今もあるから、だからそれが“魔法”の邪魔になってるんじゃないかなって……
lines.translated: "Because that 'thing on my mind' is still inside my chest right now, I was thinking maybe it's getting in the way of the 'magic'..."

lines.content: だけど私、勇気がなくて。どうしても今まで大雅くんに聞けなかった
lines.translated: "But I didn't have the courage. I just couldn't bring myself to ask you until now, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: それは……。どんなこと？
lines.translated: "And that is...? What kind of thing?"

lines.content: また少しだけ沈黙を挟み、ハルは答える。
lines.translated: After another brief pause of silence, Haru answered.

lines.content: あ、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]のこと……なんだけど
lines.translated: "I-It's about... that girl, though."

lines.content: あの子って？
lines.translated: "That girl?"

lines.content: 大雅くんの大切なあの子だよ
lines.translated: "That girl who's precious to you, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 大切な……
lines.translated: "Precious..."

lines.content: そう言われ、思い浮かぶのはたったひとりしかいなかった。
lines.translated: Hearing her put it that way, only one person came to mind.

lines.content: クロのこと？
lines.translated: "You mean Kuro?"

lines.content: うん。……そう、だね
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...That's right."

lines.content: クロが、どうかした？
lines.translated: "What about Kuro?"

lines.content: え、えっと、ね……
lines.translated: "U-Um, well..."

lines.content: ふいに、言いにくそうにする。視線をふらふらとさせていた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, she looked like she was having a hard time saying it. Her gaze wandered restlessly.

lines.content: そんなハルに釘を刺すわけでもないが、俺は苦笑いを浮かべ、言う。
lines.translated: Not that I was trying to head her off, but I gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: ごめん、ハル
lines.translated: "Sorry, Haru."

lines.content: 正直なところクロに関しては俺もよくわからないことが多いんだ。小さな頃からずっと一緒にいたのに。こんなの、おかしいよな
lines.translated: "To tell you the truth, there's a lot I don't really understand when it comes to Kuro, either. Even though we've been together since we were little. It's strange, isn't it?"

lines.content: クロはあのとおり秘密主義だから、と俺は笑った。
lines.translated: "Kuro is as secretive as ever, after all," I laughed.

lines.content: それにさ、この頃は俺にもあまり[・|直][・|接][・|は]話してくれないし。だから、クロのことは直接クロに聞けない限り、俺にはあまり答えられないかもしれなくて――
lines.translated: "Besides, lately she doesn't really talk to me directly all that much, either. So unless we ask Kuro herself directly, I might not be able to give you much of an answer about her--"

lines.content: う、ううん。平気だと思う
lines.translated: "N-No. I think it'll be fine."

lines.content: ふるふるとハルは首を振った。
lines.translated: Haru gave a small shake of her head.

lines.content: 確かに私は、あの子のこと……クロちゃんのことで、大雅くんに教えてもらいたいって思ってるけど
lines.translated: "It's true that I want you to tell me about that girl... about Kuro-chan, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: でも、私のほしい答えは、クロちゃんよりも大雅くんのほうがよくわかってるはずで……
lines.translated: "But you should know the answer I want much better than Kuro-chan does..."

lines.content: そんなふうに若干の遠回りを見せながら、
lines.translated: Taking a slightly roundabout way like that,

lines.content: だ、だから思い切って、聞かせてもらうね。大雅くん……。今の機会を逃したらたぶん一生聞けないって思うし……
lines.translated: "S-So I'm going to muster up my courage and ask you, okay, Taiga-kun...? Because I feel like if I miss this chance right now, I'll probably never be able to ask you for the rest of my life..."

lines.content: 一生……？
lines.translated: "The rest of your life...?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ハルはそっと胸に触れた。それから目を伏せ、
lines.translated: Haru gently touched her chest. Then, lowering her eyes,

lines.content: やっぱりこの胸のもやもやが、“魔法”が上手に働かない原因だって、思うから――
lines.translated: "Because I really do think this hazy feeling in my chest is the reason the 'magic' isn't working properly--"

lines.content: ちょっとばかり唇を噛んでから、言った。
lines.translated: She bit her lip slightly, then spoke.

lines.content: ――た、大雅くん
lines.translated: "--T-Taiga-kun."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 僅かに気圧されながら、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Feeling slightly overwhelmed by her intensity, I nodded.

lines.content: あ、あの……えっと
lines.translated: "U-Um... well..."

lines.content: 大雅くんは……その
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun, do you... um..."

lines.content: え、えっと、ね……っ
lines.translated: "W-Well, you see...!"

lines.content: ……うん。聞いてるよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I'm listening."

lines.content: ちゃんと聞いてるよ。だから、落ち着いて話して。
lines.translated: I'm listening properly. So calm down and tell me.

lines.content: そう答えると、ハルは一度深くうなずき、言った。
lines.translated: When I answered her like that, Haru gave one deep nod and spoke.

lines.content: クロちゃんのことが、大雅くんは、す、好き……なのかなって
lines.translated: "I was wondering if you... l-like... Kuro-chan, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 俺は、ぽかんとし、首をかしげるばかりだ。
lines.translated: I could only stare blankly and tilt my head.

lines.content: 俺が……誰を、どうって？
lines.translated: "If I... what, toward who?"

lines.content: だ、だから……
lines.translated: "I-I mean..."

lines.content: 大雅くんはクロちゃんのこと、どう思ってるのかな……。好きなのは、わかってるよ。ただその好きが、家族として？　お友だちとして？　それとも……
lines.translated: "I'm wondering how you feel about Kuro-chan, Taiga-kun... I know that you like her. Just, is that 'like' as family? As a friend? Or..."

lines.content: ハルはぎゅっと、スカートの裾を握りしめる。
lines.translated: Haru tightly gripped the hem of her skirt.

lines.content: ……それとも。女の子として、大好きなのか
lines.translated: "...Or do you love her as a girl?"

lines.content: そ、それを教えてほしくって。……だめ、かな
lines.translated: "I-I wanted you to tell me that. ...Is that not okay?"

lines.content: いや。だめってことは
lines.translated: "No. It's not that"

lines.content: ない、けれど……。
lines.translated: it's not okay, but...

lines.content: 困惑している。
lines.translated: I was bewildered.

lines.content: ハルの突然の問いかけよりも。
lines.translated: Even more than I was by Haru's sudden question.

lines.content: その問いに、想像以上に動揺している自分にだ――俺は、クロのことをどういうふうに想っているんだろう。俺も俺自身にそう問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: I was bewildered by myself, for being far more shaken by that question than I would have imagined--just how do I feel about Kuro? I tried asking myself that same question.

lines.content: 答えは簡単なはずなのに、どうしてだか即答することができなかった……。
lines.translated: Even though the answer should have been simple, for some reason, I couldn't answer right away...

lines.content: 俺の沈黙に、ハルは複雑そうな笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: At my silence, Haru showed a complicated smile.

lines.content: ……そっか。やっぱり、そうなんだね
lines.translated: "...I see. So that really is it, huh?"

lines.content: やっぱりって
lines.translated: "What do you mean by 'really'...?"

lines.content: ……私だけじゃない。たぶん、みんなも心のどこかで気づいてるんじゃないかと思う。大雅くんにとって、クロちゃんは特別なんだって
lines.translated: "...It's not just me. I think everyone else probably realizes it somewhere in their hearts, too. That Kuro-chan is special to you, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: それは、どういうこと？
lines.translated: "What do you mean by that?"

lines.content: 智仁くんがお姉さんのこと、特別に思ってるのを、なんとなくみんながわかってたみたいに
lines.translated: "Just like how everyone somehow knew that Tomohito-kun thought of his older sister as someone special."

lines.content: いや、違う。
lines.translated: No, that's not it.

lines.content: 俺が問いたかったのはそうではない。
lines.translated: That wasn't what I wanted to ask.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]と[・|こ][・|れ]とはいったいどういう繋がりがあるんだろう。そう問いたかった。
lines.translated: What on earth was the connection between that and this? That was what I wanted to ask.

lines.content: 俺がクロのことをどう想っているかを知ることと、ハルの“魔法”やその“願い”が、どう関係しているというのだろうか。
lines.translated: How could knowing how I feel about Kuro have anything to do with Haru's "magic" or her "wish"?

lines.content: その繋がりについて、不思議に思うばかりで……。
lines.translated: I could only wonder about the connection between them...

lines.content: 頭が少し、混乱してしまっている。
lines.translated: My head was getting a little confused.

lines.content: た、大雅くん。そんな難しい顔、しないでほしいな
lines.translated: "T-Taiga-kun. I wish you wouldn't make such a serious face."

lines.content: ハルが笑顔で言った。
lines.translated: Haru said with a smile.

lines.content: 別に大雅くんがクロちゃんのこと、大好きでも――……大雅くんのその気持ちを、みんなに言いふらしたりはしないよ。絶対
lines.translated: "Even if you really love Kuro-chan, Taiga-kun--...I won't go spreading your feelings around to everyone. Definitely not."

lines.content: ああ、わかってる。
lines.translated: Yeah, I know.

lines.content: 君がそんなことをするはずがないのはわかってるよ。ハル。
lines.translated: I know there's no way you would ever do something like that, Haru.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: 気にかかるのは、今ハルが浮かべている笑顔だ。
lines.translated: What bothered me was the smile Haru had on her face right now.

lines.content: それは取り繕うような表情だった。
lines.translated: It was an expression like she was putting up a front.

lines.content: その顔が意味するところを俺は知っている。
lines.translated: I knew what that face meant.

lines.content: 俺以外の誰かといるとき、必ず浮かべる表情だ。
lines.translated: It was the expression she always wore when she was with anyone other than me.

lines.content: 明るくて。元気いっぱいで。ちょっと無茶なことでも平気なふりでがんばろうとする。
lines.translated: Bright. Full of energy. Trying her best to act like she's fine even when doing something a little reckless.

lines.content: それはある種、みんなの期待に答えるかのような[キャラクター|存在]造形だ。
lines.translated: In a way, it was a persona built to live up to everyone's expectations.

lines.content: そのきっかけは単純だった。
lines.translated: What started it was simple.

lines.content: 一度[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う]に取り繕ってしまったが、最後。
lines.translated: Once she put up that kind of front, there was no going back.

lines.content: そんな自分をどうにもこうにも崩せなくなってしまった……ちょっとかわいい見栄っ張り。
lines.translated: She ended up completely unable to break out of that version of herself... a slightly cute show-off.

lines.content: だけど俺の前だけでは取り繕わずいてくれた。
lines.translated: Yet only in front of me, she didn't put up a front.

lines.content: いつも緊張とか不安だとかでどきどき痛いのだという胸の内を、その弱気を、なぜだか俺にだけ語ってくれた。
lines.translated: For some reason, she spoke only to me of that weakness, of the feelings inside her chest that always throbbed and ached with nervousness and anxiety.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: 大雅くんがクロちゃんのことをどう想ってるのか。大雅くんが私にだけ、[・|秘][・|密]を打ち明けてくれたなら。私の胸のもやもやも、きれいに晴れてくれると思う
lines.translated: "How you feel about Kuro-chan, Taiga-kun. If you confided that secret to me and me alone... I think this hazy feeling in my chest would clear right up, too."
A smile.

lines.content: この話題のどこに、彼女を[・|そ][・|う][・|さ][・|せ][・|る]要素が潜んでいるのかは、今の俺には想像もできやしないが……。
lines.translated: Right now, I couldn't even begin to imagine what element hidden in this topic could be making her act like that, and yet...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違うんだ。
lines.translated: No, that's not true.

lines.content: なんとなく予想というか、予感というのか。
lines.translated: Call it a vague guess, or maybe a hunch.

lines.content: そういった[・|気][・|づ][・|き]は、ある。
lines.translated: I did have that kind of inkling.

lines.content: これまで触れてきたたくさんの物語の中で、鈍感なばかりの主人公に心をもやもやとさせてきた。
lines.translated: In the many stories I'd experienced up until now, my heart had often been frustrated by protagonists who were nothing but dense.
Could this be one of those scenes?--No, maybe I'm just being full of myself. I still had those kinds of doubts.

lines.content: ハルが俺を特別に想ってくれているから、こんな空気になっているのではないか。俺は、そう思ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Isn't the atmosphere like this because Haru thinks of me as someone special? I couldn't help thinking that.

lines.content: もしも間違ってしまっていたなら、本当にどれほど自分に自信があるんだよって話で……。
lines.translated: If I happened to be mistaken, it would really raise the question of just how full of myself I could possibly be...

lines.content: それはもう恥ずかしいどころの話じゃなくなる。もう二度と、俺はハルの顔をまっすぐ見られなくもなってしまいそうだけど……。
lines.translated: It would go way beyond just being embarrassing. I probably wouldn't ever be able to look Haru straight in the face again, and yet...
Haru continued with her usual smile.

lines.content: 秘密を共有し合うと、今よりずっと仲良くなれるんだよね？　そうすれば“魔法”はもっと上手に使える。だから大雅くんの秘密を、教えてもらえたらなあって、思って
lines.translated: "When we share secrets with each other, we can become much closer than we are now, right? If we do that, I'll be able to use my 'magic' much better. So I was thinking how nice it would be if you could tell me your secret, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ちょっと無理矢理すぎるかなと、ハルが取り繕って笑うから……。
lines.translated: Because Haru put up a front and laughed, saying it might be forcing things a little too much...

lines.content: 俺は……。
ああ、まったく。
lines.translated: Aah, honestly.

lines.content: 決して鈍感な[ヒーロー|主人公]にだけは、なりたくはないこの俺は……。
lines.translated: I, who never wanted to become a dense hero under any circumstances...

lines.content: ごめんね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: 秘密を共有っていっても、大雅くんが言っていたのはこういうことじゃないんだって、わかるけど――変なお願いしてごめん。面倒くさくて、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "Even if I call it sharing a secret, I know this isn't what you meant when you said it, Taiga-kun--I'm sorry for making such a weird request. I'm sorry for being such a pain."

lines.content: でもそうすれば、やっと私は、ちゃんと大雅くんの“魔法”になれるんじゃないかって予感があるのは、本当で――
lines.translated: "But it's true that I have a hunch that if we do that, I'll finally be able to properly become your 'magic,' Taiga-kun--"

lines.content: 好きだよ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: 大好きだ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: そ、そっか
lines.translated: "I-I see."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 俺は。
やっぱり、そうだったんだね……う、うん。そうだと思ってた。あはは。[・|思][・|っ][・|て][・|た][・|と][・|お][・|り]、だなんて。こんなの秘密でも何でもないのかもね
lines.translated: "So that really was it, huh... Y-Yeah. I thought so. Ahaha. To think it was just as I thought. Maybe something like this isn't even a secret at all."

lines.content: ああ……。ごめん
lines.translated: "Yeah... I'm sorry."

lines.content: ううん。どうして謝るの、大雅くん
lines.translated: "No. Why are you apologizing, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ……ごめんな。ハル
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Haru."

lines.content: 俺は、
俺はさ。
lines.translated: You see, I...

lines.content: や、やめてよ。大雅くん。何か言ってよ。じゃないと……変だよ。おかしいな。私、なんだかとっても悲しい気分になっちゃうよ
lines.translated: "S-Stop it, Taiga-kun. Say something. Otherwise... it's weird. That's strange. It's making me feel really sad for some reason."

lines.content: ……ハル。
lines.translated: Haru.

lines.content: [・|い][・|つ][・|も][・|の][・|笑][・|顔]を絶やさず浮かべる君だから……。
lines.translated: Because you're someone who never stops wearing that usual smile...

lines.content: 鈍感どころか、ただ自意識過剰なこの俺だから。
