lines.translated: And because I'm someone who, far from being dense, is just overly self-conscious.

lines.content: 君の[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|笑][・|顔]を壊してしまいたいと、思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to shatter that smile of yours.

lines.content: 好きだよ。ハル
lines.translated: "I like you, Haru."

lines.content: ハルはポカンとし、目を丸くした。
lines.translated: Haru froze, her eyes going wide.

lines.content: 柊ハル
lines.translated: "Hiiragi Haru."

lines.content: は、はい
lines.translated: "Y-Yes?"

lines.content: 君は、知らないだろうな
lines.translated: "You probably don't know this."
"...K-Know what?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 君は俺のヒーローだったんだよ。ハル
lines.translated: "You were my hero, Haru."

lines.content: 目を丸くしたまま、ハルは俺を見上げた。
lines.translated: With her eyes still wide, Haru looked up at me.
"...Were?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 俺は笑顔を浮かべ、言う。
lines.translated: Bringing a smile to my face, I spoke.

lines.content: でも、勘違いしないでほしい
lines.translated: "But I don't want you to misunderstand."

lines.content: いつも笑顔で、いつも元気いっぱいで。今回、智仁の力になろうとして、自分の苦手なことにも全力で取り組んだ。君は困った人のことを絶対に放っておけない――
lines.translated: "Always smiling, always full of energy. This time, wanting to help Tomohito, you gave it your all even with things you aren't good at. You can never just leave someone in trouble alone--"

lines.content: そんな、[・|俺][・|以][・|外]の誰もが君に持つのだろう印象も、そんな君のことも、もちろん嫌いじゃあないけれど
lines.translated: "Of course, I don't dislike that impression that everyone other than me probably has of you, nor do I dislike that side of you."

lines.content: ……そういう君のたった一言に、俺は……十年前のまだまだ小さかったあの頃の俺は、確かに救われたんだ
lines.translated: "...By just a single word from that side of you, I... back ten years ago when I was still so small, I was truly saved."

lines.content: あのとき君は、俺の一番ほしい言葉をくれたんだ。それがどれだけ心強く思えたことか。
lines.translated: Back then, you gave me the words I wanted more than anything. You have no idea how reassuring that felt.

lines.content: でも
……でもさ
lines.translated: "...But, you know."

lines.content: いつからかハルは俺にだけ、みんなの前とは違う顔を見せてくれるようになってくれた
lines.translated: "At some point, Haru, you started showing a face only to me that was different from the one you show in front of everyone else."

lines.content: 人は、才能に憧れる。
lines.translated: People admire talent.

lines.content: 人は、[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|な][・|く][・|て][・|も]立ち上がろうとする者には、共感を得る。
lines.translated: And people empathize with those who try to stand up even when they don't have it.

lines.content: つい最近耳にしたそのような言葉がふと蘇っていた。
lines.translated: Words like that, which I had heard just recently, suddenly came back to me.
It's probably the same for heroes, too.

lines.content: 本当は、心配や不安がつきない胸の内
lines.translated: "Inside your chest, where worry and anxiety never truly end."

lines.content: いつも緊張だったり、少しの怖さだったりで……胸がどきどき、どきどき、痛んで大変
lines.translated: "Always feeling nervous, or a little scared... your chest throbbing, throbbing, hurting so much it's hard to bear."

lines.content: それでも決して、多くの人たちの前ではそんな素振りを見せないよう、頑張っている――
lines.translated: "Even so, you do your best never to let any hint of that show in front of most people--"

lines.content: そんな君の姿にこそ、俺はより強い共感を得ていたんだと思う。十年前も。そして、今も
lines.translated: "I think it was that exact side of you that I felt a much stronger empathy with. Ten years ago. And right now, too."

lines.content: ……勘違いしないでほしいのは、俺は、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|君][・|だ][・|か][・|ら]、ハルを好きになったんだって、そういうことだと……思う
lines.translated: "...What I don't want you to misunderstand is that it's because you're like that, that I came to like you, Haru... I think that's what it means."

lines.content: 思う……？
lines.translated: "You think...?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずき、言う。
lines.translated: I nodded and spoke.

lines.content: ……ハル。だめだよ
lines.translated: "...Haru. You can't do that."

lines.content: ……だめ？
lines.translated: "...Is it no good?"

lines.content: 君が俺の前でも、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|笑][・|顔]を浮かべてるだなんて。そんなのはさ、勝手なことを言うようだけれど……いやなんだよ。すごく
lines.translated: "Wearing that kind of smile even in front of me. I know it sounds selfish of me to say this, but... I hate it. So much."

lines.content: だから、俺は。
lines.translated: That's why I...

lines.content: ごめんなハル。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Haru.

lines.content: 君も俺と同じ気持ちでいてくれるんじゃないかと、期待していたいから。
lines.translated: Because I want to hope that you might feel the same way I do.

lines.content: 鈍感なばかりの[ヒーロー|主人公]ではいたくないから。
lines.translated: Because I don't want to be a hero who's nothing but dense.

lines.content: だからこそ俺は、君のその笑顔を壊してやりたいと、願うから――
lines.translated: That's precisely why I wish to shatter that smile of yours--

lines.content: 好きだよ。ハル
lines.translated: "I like you, Haru."

lines.content: 自分勝手な“希望”を込めて、何度でも言う。
lines.translated: Filling my words with selfish "hope," I'll say it as many times as it takes.

lines.content: 俺は、君が好きだ。そんな自分の気持ちに今、この“夜”に――俺の好きなハルの笑顔が消えてしまった、今この瞬間になってやっと、気づいた
lines.translated: "I like you. Right now, in this 'Night'--at this very moment when the smile of the Haru I like vanished, I finally realized those feelings of mine."

lines.content: 俺は、俺の大好きな君を取り戻したいと願う。願ってしまっている。
lines.translated: I wish to take back the you that I love. I can't help wishing for it.

lines.content: 鈍感なばかりに幾度となく機会を逃すヒーローたちを何度も見てきた。
lines.translated: Over and over, I've seen heroes miss their chances time and again simply because they were too dense.

lines.content: 選択したこの[道|方法]は正しいとは言えないかもしれない。くだらない自意識ばかりが過剰に育った結果とも言えるだろう。
lines.translated: This path I've chosen might not be the right one. You could probably even call it the result of my foolish self-consciousness growing way out of hand.

lines.content: だけど違うんだ。ハル。俺は今、他の誰でもない。君のことを大切に想ってる。
lines.translated: But that's not it, Haru. Right now, it's no one else. It's you that I care about so deeply.

lines.content: そんな自分に今、ハル……君の笑顔をなくしてしまうかもしれないという不安が、気づかせてくれた。
lines.translated: Right now, Haru... the fear that I might lose your smile made me realize that about myself.

lines.content: だから何度でも、言おう。
lines.translated: So I'll say it as many times as it takes.

lines.content: 俺の大切な[笑顔|それ]を取り戻せる可能性が少しでもあるなら、何度でも。
lines.translated: If there's even the slightest chance I can get that precious smile of mine back, I'll say it over and over.

lines.content: ハル。好きだ。他の誰でもない、俺は君が好きなんだよ、ハル
lines.translated: "Haru. I love you. Not anyone else, it's you that I love, Haru."

lines.content: ……う。え、ええ？
lines.translated: "...Uh. H-Huh?"

lines.content: いつもどこかで思ってた。俺も、君みたいになれたらいいって
lines.translated: "Somewhere in my heart, I always thought about how nice it would be if I could become like you too."

lines.content: つい弱音を吐いてしまっても、弱気な態度を取ってしまったとしても。それでも“もうだめだ”とは決して言わない……。そんな君に憧れていた
lines.translated: "Even if you accidentally let slip a complaint, or take a timid attitude. Even so, you never once say 'it's no use anymore'... I admired that about you."

lines.content: その憧れは、今だ。たった今、この瞬間、“好き”に変わった。……そんな気がする
lines.translated: "That admiration, right now. Just now, in this very moment, changed into 'love.' ...That's what it feels like."

lines.content: き、気がするだけなの？
lines.translated: "I-It just feels like it?"

lines.content: 俺を見上げる。不安そうに。
lines.translated: She looked up at me uneasily.

lines.content: それはもうすっかり、俺にとっていつも通りのハルの顔だった。
lines.translated: Her expression had completely returned to the usual Haru I knew.

lines.content: それを安心して良いのか。よろこんで良いのか。
lines.translated: Should I feel relieved about that? Should I be happy?

lines.content: あまりに微妙な気持ちではあるけれど……。
lines.translated: My feelings were all too complicated, though...

lines.content: よかった。いつものハルだ
lines.translated: "Thank goodness. You're back to your usual self, Haru."

lines.content: とにかく今は、そういうふうにうなずいていたかった。
lines.translated: For now, at least, I just wanted to nod and leave it at that.

lines.content: もう二度と俺の前で、ハルは弱音を吐いたり、弱気な姿を見せてくれないんじゃないかと思った
lines.translated: "I was worried you might never complain or show your timid side in front of me ever again."

lines.content: いつもの君と、こうして面と向かって話せなくなるのかなって想像してしまったんだ。すると、こわかった。すごくさみしいって、思った
lines.translated: "I started imagining what it would be like if I could never talk face-to-face with the usual you like this anymore. And it scared me. I thought about how incredibly lonely that would be."

lines.content: ……こんな、一瞬で？
lines.translated: "...All in just a single moment?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah, I guess so..."

lines.content: 確かにそうだ。唐突だ。あんまりにも。
lines.translated: It certainly was. It was sudden. Way too sudden.

lines.content: だけど君がまたどこか遠くへ行ってしまうのではないかという不安も、心配も――
lines.translated: Yet the anxiety and worry that she might go somewhere far away again--

lines.content: 鈍感な自分はいやだ、君のことをつなぎ止めたいと感じた身勝手も――
lines.translated: And the selfishness of hating how dense I was, of wanting to hold onto her--

lines.content: すべて一瞬で浮かんでは消えていった“俺自身”だったのだ。
lines.translated: All of it had flashed through my mind and vanished in an instant, and all of it was the real "me."

lines.content: それに、ごめんな。ハル。急にハルがクロのことを言い出して……。それで、[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|笑][・|う]から
lines.translated: "Besides, I'm sorry, Haru. You suddenly brought up Kuro... and then you smiled like that."

lines.content: だからちょっとだけムッとしてしまった、というのもあるかもしれない。今、クロのことはまったく関係ないじゃないかって
lines.translated: "So maybe I got a little bit annoyed, too. Thinking about how Kuro had nothing at all to do with this right now."

lines.content: そのとき芽生えたこの気持ちの正体はなんだろう。
lines.translated: What was the true nature of this feeling that had sprouted inside me right then?

lines.content: そう思ったら……。
lines.translated: When I thought about that...

lines.content: そう自身の胸の内を探ってみたら……。
lines.translated: When I searched deep inside my own heart like that...

lines.content: そうか。俺は、柊ハル。君のことが好きなのかもしれない。改めてそう思えた
lines.translated: "I see. Maybe I'm in love with you, Hiiragi Haru. It made me realize that all over again."

lines.content: やっぱり……かも、なんだね
lines.translated: "So it really is... a 'maybe,' huh?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。今はまだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, well. Just for now."

lines.content: うなずき、答える。
lines.translated: I nod and answer.

lines.content: でも、今はこの気持ちで充分だとも感じてる――ハルの“魔法”を使うには
lines.translated: "Still, I feel like this feeling is plenty for right now--at least when it comes to using your 'magic,' Haru."

lines.content: 私の、“魔法”を
lines.translated: "My... 'magic'?"

lines.content: ああ。もしも、ハルが俺の気持ちを受け入れてもらえたら、だけど
lines.translated: "Yeah. Though only if you're willing to accept my feelings, Haru."

lines.content: う、ううー……。なんだかずるい言い方だね。それ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh... That's kind of an unfair way to put it, you know."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべるハルだった。ああ、まったく本当にねと俺もうなずく。
lines.translated: Haru gave a wry smile. Yeah, it really is, I agreed with a nod.

lines.content: なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: う、うん。何、かな。大雅くん
lines.translated: "O-Okay. What is it, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 俺はハルと、これからもっと仲良くなりたいと思ってる――ここへ来るまでは、一緒にいけないことをして、幼馴染みだけではない“何か”になりたいと思ってた
lines.translated: "I want to get even closer to you from here on out, Haru--until we came here, I thought that by doing something naughty together, we could become 'something' more than just childhood friends."

lines.content: だけど今は、それ以上の“何か”になりたいと願ってる
lines.translated: "But right now, I'm wishing for us to become 'something' even more than that."

lines.content: 俺のそんな思いが叶うなら――もしかしたら今夜、直ぐにでもハルの“願い”を叶えられるかもしれないとも期待してる
lines.translated: "If that wish of mine comes true--I'm hoping that maybe, right here tonight, we might be able to grant your 'wish' right away, too."

lines.content: あのさくらの花を咲かせられるのではないかと思ってる。
lines.translated: I think we might be able to make those cherry blossoms bloom.

lines.content: その結果、ハルが何を得るのか。
lines.translated: And as a result, what would Haru gain?

lines.content: それをまた俺も知ることができるのではないか。
lines.translated: Maybe I would get to find that out, too.

lines.content: そんな期待も抱いていた。
lines.translated: I was holding onto that expectation as well.

lines.content: ハル。君は、俺のことが嫌いかな
lines.translated: "Haru. Do you... hate me?"

lines.content: やっぱりこれはただの自意識過剰だったのか。鈍感なままでいたほうがよかっただろうか。
lines.translated: Had I just been overly self-conscious after all? Would it have been better if I had stayed dense?

lines.content: そ……っ、そんなこと……っ
lines.translated: "Th... That's..."

lines.content: 顔を上げる。ハッと、目が合う。
lines.translated: She raised her head. With a start, our eyes met.

lines.content: な、ない……と、思う……
lines.translated: "N-Not true... I think..."

lines.content: そっか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: ……よかった。本当に。
lines.translated: Thank goodness. Really.

lines.content: それなら、この手を取ってほしい
lines.translated: "In that case, I want you to take this hand."

lines.content: ハルへと手を差し伸べる――左手だ。かつて特別だった少女を“魔法”とするための手のひらだ。
lines.translated: I reached my hand out toward Haru--my left hand. The palm meant to turn a girl who had once been special into "magic."

lines.content: この手をハルが、ハル自身の意思で握ってくれるなら、俺たちの心の距離はきっとさっきよりもずっと近いものになれている。俺は、そう信じたい
lines.translated: "If you take this hand of your own free will, Haru, then I'm sure the distance between our hearts will be much closer than it was a moment ago. That's what I want to believe."

lines.content: ハルは差し出した俺の手を見つめていた。
lines.translated: Haru stared at the hand I held out to her.

lines.content: 少しの間だ。ほんの少しの間そうしていたけれど、恐る恐る――ハルは俺の手に、触れた。
lines.translated: It was only a brief pause. She hesitated for just a fleeting moment, and then, timidly--Haru touched my hand.

lines.content: 瞬間。
lines.translated: In that instant.

lines.content: ハルがまばゆい光に包まれる。
lines.translated: A dazzling light enveloped her.

lines.content: な、なな何っ、これっ
lines.translated: "Wh-Wh-What is this?!"

lines.content: 光りが解ける。
lines.translated: The light faded away.

lines.content: するとそこには、ふわふわで、ひらひらで……。
lines.translated: And standing there, in something fluffy and frilly...

lines.content: かわいく、きらびやかな服装に飾られたハルの姿があった。
lines.translated: Was Haru, decked out in a cute, dazzling outfit.

lines.content: “魔法少女服”
lines.translated: A "magical girl outfit."

lines.content: と、そう呼んで良いものをハルは身につけている。
lines.translated: Haru was wearing something that could rightfully be called just that.

lines.content: かわいくて。きれいで。見とれてしまう――
lines.translated: It was cute. It was pretty. Enough to leave anyone entranced--

lines.content: はずだ。
lines.translated: Or so it should have been.

lines.content: 本来ならば。
lines.translated: Ordinarily, anyway.

lines.content: 俺は“魔法少女”が嫌いだ。
lines.translated: I hate "magical girls."

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: その姿は、まるで――……
lines.translated: Because looking like that is almost as if--...

lines.content: ……いや
首を振り、笑顔を作る。
lines.translated: I shook my head and forced a smile.

lines.content: ええっと、あれだ。いわゆる“変身”だよ
lines.translated: "Um, well. It's what you'd call a 'transformation.'"

lines.content: 昔はあさひさんの手作りの衣装を着て、ハルたちは“悪い夢”と戦ってたろ？　そのときの服をイメージしてみたんだけど
lines.translated: "Back in the day, you and the others used to wear handmade outfits Asahi-san made to fight against 'bad dreams,' right? I tried basing it on the clothes from back then."

lines.content: ううっ、どうして……。ひどいよ大雅くん
lines.translated: "Ugh, why...? You're awful, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 涙目でハルは訴えている。
lines.translated: Haru protested with teary eyes.

lines.content: ま、“魔法少女”だなんて……。そんなの。許されるのは中学生までがぎりぎりだよ
lines.translated: "A-A 'magical girl'... Seriously, middle school is the absolute limit for getting away with something like that."

lines.content: そ、それなのに、この歳でこんなかわいい服着させるだなんて……しかもこれで、二度目だよっ
lines.translated: "A-And yet, making me wear such a cute outfit at my age... Not to mention, this is the second time!"

lines.content: え？　二度？
lines.translated: "Huh? The second time?"

lines.content: アイドルの次は、“魔法少女”
lines.translated: "First an idol, and now a 'magical girl.'"

lines.content: あ、ああ。うん。確かに
lines.translated: "Ah, right. Yeah, true."

lines.content: あれは俺が着せたわけじゃないけれど……。
lines.translated: Though I wasn't the one who made her wear that first one...

lines.content: ――ううう！　大雅くん、ひどいっ
lines.translated: "--Uuuuugh! Taiga-kun, you're the worst!"

lines.content: それにスカート短すぎるよっ、とハルはぎゅーっと裾を引っ張っていた。
lines.translated: Plus, this skirt is way too short! Haru tugged hard on the hem.

lines.content: アイドル衣装のときよりもっと短くなってる気がするよぅ……っ
lines.translated: "I feel like it's even shorter than the idol outfit was...!"

lines.content: いや……。えっと
lines.translated: "Well... um."

lines.content: あさひさんがさ、[・|こ][・|こ]で少女の“魔法”を使うにはそういうふうにしなきゃだめだって。そんな難儀なルールを作っちゃってるから。その名残なんだよ。ごめん
lines.translated: "You see, Asahi-san made this troublesome rule that you have to dress like that to use a girl's 'magic' here. It's a leftover from that. Sorry."

lines.content: 俺にはルールを書き換えられるほど“夜”を使いこなせないんだ。やれやれまったくと、俺はおどけたように首を振る――……でも。
lines.translated: I haven't mastered the "Night" well enough to rewrite its rules. Good grief, what a pain, I thought, shaking my head in mock exasperation--...Still.

lines.content: よかった
lines.translated: "Thank goodness."

lines.content: う、うう。何も、よくないよ……
lines.translated: "U-Ugh. Nothing about this is good..."

lines.content: ううん。そうじゃなくて。無事に“変身”できたってことは……
lines.translated: "No, that's not what I mean. The fact that you were able to 'transform' safely means..."

lines.content: はらり、と。
lines.translated: Gently fluttering.

lines.content: 俺たちの間に、舞い落ちるひとひらが、あった。
lines.translated: A single petal danced down between us.

lines.content: はらり、
lines.translated: Fluttering down,

lines.content: はらり、
lines.translated: Fluttering down,

lines.content: その数は増していき……。
lines.translated: Their numbers began to grow...

lines.content: 窓の外を、俺たちは見上げる。
lines.translated: Together, we looked up and out the window.

lines.content: すごい……
lines.translated: "Amazing..."

lines.content: 満開だった。
lines.translated: They were in full bloom.
"It's amazing, Taiga-kun. This is... beyond 'imagination.'"

lines.content: きらびやかな“夜”の街。その空を覆うように広がる枝には、満開の花が咲き始めていた……。
lines.translated: The dazzling city of the "Night." Across the branches spreading out to cover its sky, flowers had begun to burst into full bloom...

lines.content: その光景をハルはただ見つめている。
lines.translated: Haru simply gazed at the sight.

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.
"I 'grant you permission.'"

lines.content: 今の俺たちの“関係”なら問題はない。大丈夫。
lines.translated: With our "relationship" the way it is right now, there won't be any problem. It's okay.

lines.content: ハルが“夜”の外でも“魔法”が使えるようにって……。“最後の魔法”を、使えるようにって
lines.translated: "For you to be able to use your 'magic' outside the 'Night' as well, Haru... For you to be able to use the 'Final Magic.'"

lines.content: 色づきき始めた“夜”の空。
lines.translated: The sky of the "Night" was beginning to take on color.
I could feel the cherry blossoms on the "outside" taking on color in the exact same way.

lines.content: ハル。これで君の“夢”は叶うのかな
lines.translated: "Haru. Will this make your 'dream' come true?"

lines.content: ……ハル？
lines.translated: "...Haru?"

lines.content: ……うん。ありがとう、大雅くん。本当に
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Thank you, Taiga-kun. Truly."

lines.content: 少し声を震わせて、ハルは俺に笑いかけてくれた。
lines.translated: With her voice trembling ever so slightly, Haru smiled at me.
"With this, my 'dream' has come true."

lines.content: これ以上、私は何も要らない。
lines.translated: I don't need anything more than this.

lines.content: これからのすべてが、このさくらみたいにやさしく、やわらかく、望んだ以上に叶えられていく――
lines.translated: Everything from here on out will be granted gently, softly, and even more wonderfully than I ever hoped for, just like these cherry blossoms--

lines.content: 小さくちいさく、ハルはそうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Haru whispered those words ever so softly.

lines.content: あとは明日、“夜”の中でも外ででも、満開に咲いたさくらを見て、[・|み][・|ん][・|な]がどんなふうに驚いてくれるか……。楽しみだね
lines.translated: "Now we just have to wait until tomorrow to see how surprised everyone will be when they see the cherry blossoms in full bloom, both inside and outside the 'Night'... I can't wait."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そんないけないことを考えちゃう私たちだから、もっと……これからもっと、仲良くなれるよね？
lines.translated: "Since the two of us are the kind of people who come up with such naughty ideas, we'll get even closer... even closer from now on, right?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだね。きっとそうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I'm sure we will."

lines.content: 繋いだままの俺の手を、ぎゅっとハルは力を込め、握りしめていた。
lines.translated: Our hands still joined, Haru squeezed mine tightly.

lines.content: その手を握り返す。
lines.translated: I squeezed her hand back.

lines.content: 叶えられたという君の“夢”
lines.translated: Her "dream" that had supposedly come true.

lines.content: それが、どんなものだったのか――
lines.translated: Just what kind of dream was it--?

lines.content: いつか、聞かせてもらえるのかな
lines.translated: "Will you let me hear about it someday?"

lines.content: ……うん。必ず
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I promise."

lines.content: いっぱいの笑顔をほころばせ、ハルは言う。
lines.translated: Breaking into a radiant smile, Haru spoke.

lines.content: ごめんね、大雅くん。……そしてありがとう。私の“魔法”に“許可”をくれて
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Taiga-kun. ...And thank you. For granting 'permission' for my 'magic.'"

lines.content: 今は、上手な言葉が思いつかないけれど――いつか必ず、大雅くんに聞いてほしいよ。私の“夢”のお話を
lines.translated: "Right now, I can't think of the right words to say--but someday, I definitely want you to hear it, Taiga-kun. The story of my 'dream.'"

lines.content: はら、はら、はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter, flutter, softly falling.

lines.content: ……降り止まない春のかけら。
lines.translated: Fragments of spring falling without end.

lines.content: ふと、目が合う。
lines.translated: Suddenly, our eyes met.

lines.content: するとハルは微笑み……。
lines.translated: Then Haru smiled...

lines.content: 何も言わず、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Without saying a word, she closed her eyes.

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は、ほんの一瞬だけ誰かの横顔が脳裏を過ぎったようにも思えたけれど……。
lines.translated: For just a split second, it felt as though someone's profile flashed across my mind, but...

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: だけど[・|そ][・|れ]には、気づかないふりをして。
lines.translated: I pretended not to notice it.

lines.content: 俺は、ハルと唇を合わせた。
lines.translated: And I pressed my lips to Haru's.

lines.content: 朝。
lines.translated: Morning.

lines.content: 通学途中のバスの中。
lines.translated: Inside the bus on the way to school.

lines.content: 千和、智仁、そして俺。三人で登校中。
lines.translated: Chiwa, Tomohito, and I. The three of us were commuting together.

lines.content: 千和と智仁が挨拶がわりの雑談に花を咲かせていた――停学がとけてから最初の登校日である。
lines.translated: Chiwa and Tomohito were deep in lively small talk by way of a morning greeting--today was our first day back at school since our suspension had been lifted.

lines.content: 普段は“学園爆発しねえかなあ行きたくねえよもう帰りたい”とぶつぶつ言うばかりの智仁も、どこか晴れやかな顔つきだった。
lines.translated: Even Tomohito, who usually did nothing but grumble things like, "Man, I wish the school would just blow up, I don't wanna go, I wanna go home already," had a somewhat bright expression on his face.

lines.content: そしてハルの“魔法”を使った翌日でもある。
lines.translated: And it was also the day after Haru had used her "magic."

lines.content: ……ハルと“特別な関係”になれてから、はじめての朝と言うこともできる。
lines.translated: You could also call it the very first morning since Haru and I entered a "special relationship."

lines.content: 昨晩。ハルと別れてから、気持ちが高ぶっていたのかあまりよく眠れなかった。
lines.translated: Last night, after parting ways with Haru, I hadn't been able to sleep very well, perhaps because my emotions were still running high.

lines.content: あくびをかみ殺し――俺は、車窓の外を見つめる。
lines.translated: Stifling a yawn--I gazed out the bus window.

lines.content: ひら、
lines.translated: Drifting,

lines.content: ひら、
lines.translated: Drifting,

lines.content: ひらり、
lines.translated: Fluttering,

lines.content: さくらの花びらがまるで吹雪のように流れゆく。
lines.translated: Cherry blossom petals flowed past like a blizzard.

lines.content: そんな光景をただ眺め、昨晩のことを思い出していたのだが……。
lines.translated: I was simply watching the scenery, reminiscing about last night, when...

lines.content: 先輩、どうしたんですか？
lines.translated: "Senpai, what's wrong?"

lines.content: 目の前に千和の顔がある。
lines.translated: Chiwa's face was right in front of me.

lines.content: 心配そうに俺を見上げていた。
lines.translated: She was looking up at me with concern.

lines.content: さっきからずっと黙ってるから、どこか調子が悪いのかなって思いました……
lines.translated: "You've been quiet this whole time, so I was wondering if you weren't feeling well..."

lines.content: いいや
lines.translated: "Nope."

lines.content: ふるふると首を振ってみせる。
lines.translated: I gave my head a little shake.

lines.content: 大丈夫。どこも悪くないよ。ありがとう
lines.translated: "I'm fine. Nothing's wrong at all. Thank you."

lines.content: 驚いたような顔をする千和だった。
lines.translated: A surprised look crossed Chiwa's face.

lines.content: ど、どうした千和。すごい顔してるけど……
lines.translated: "Wh-What's wrong, Chiwa? You're making a crazy face..."

lines.content: 先輩。今日、調子悪いんですか？
lines.translated: "Senpai. Are you feeling sick today?"

lines.content: え……どうして？
lines.translated: "Huh...? Why?"

lines.content: だ、だって……。先輩が私に、素直に“ありがとう”って
lines.translated: "B-Because... You just said 'thank you' to me so honestly, Senpai."

lines.content: む……。何か変かな
lines.translated: "Hmph... Is there something weird about that?"

lines.content: 変ですよ。す――……っごく変です
lines.translated: "It's weird. Su--...per weird."

lines.content: ちょっとためを効かせつつ千和はうなずいていた。もしかして熱でもあるんですか先輩、と。
lines.translated: Chiwa nodded, putting a deliberate pause in her words. "Do you have a fever or something, Senpai?" she added.

lines.content: それとも、先輩……。奏先輩。先輩は本物の先輩ですか？　もしかして昨日までの先輩と違う人……？
lines.translated: "Or maybe, Senpai... Kanade-senpai. Are you the real Senpai? Could it be that you're a different person from the Senpai I knew until yesterday...?"

lines.content: 何を言うんだ千和。心外だぞ。俺は俺だ。だってほら、見てみろよ。俺以外にこんな格好いい先輩がいるはずないだろ？
lines.translated: "What are you talking about, Chiwa? I'm offended. I'm me. I mean, come on, look at me. There's no way there's another senpai as handsome as me out there, right?"

lines.content: なにその疑わしきは罰せよというような目。先輩は傷つきました。
lines.translated: What's with that "guilty until proven innocent" look in your eyes? You're hurting your senpai's feelings.

lines.content: ……いいか、千和。それに俺、いつも君には素直だろ？
lines.translated: "...Listen, Chiwa. Besides, I'm always honest with you, aren't I?"

lines.content: 毎朝ちょっと挨拶がてら意地悪なことしてしまいたいという衝動に、いっつも素直な俺じゃあないか。
lines.translated: I'm always completely honest with my urge to tease her a little bit every morning as a way of saying hello, aren't I?

lines.content: ……ふむ
なんだ智仁。お前まで何か言いたげだな
lines.translated: "What is it, Tomohito? Even you look like you want to say something."

lines.content: ……いやあ。うーん
lines.translated: "...Nah. Well..."

lines.content: 小首をかしげた智仁だったが、
lines.translated: Tomohito tilted his head slightly,

lines.content: あ
lines.translated: "Ah."

lines.content: と小さな声を上げ、走る車窓から外を指さす。
lines.translated: let out a small "Oh," and pointed outside the window of the moving bus.

lines.content: かわいい子、発見
lines.translated: "Cute girl spotted."

lines.content: お、おい。かわいい子が……そこに、いたんだが
lines.translated: "H-Hey. There was... a cute girl right out there."

lines.content: それがどうした
lines.translated: "So what?"

lines.content: うそだろ
lines.translated: "No way."

lines.content: だから、何がだ
lines.translated: "I mean, what about it?"

lines.content: ……見もしないのかよ。かわいい子
lines.translated: "...You're not even gonna look? It's a cute girl."

lines.content: ふん。見たからと言ってどうなるでもなし
lines.translated: "Hmph. It's not like anything's going to happen just from looking at her."

lines.content: 信じられない。世界の終わりだ。そんな顔で俺を見ていた。不愉快な。
lines.translated: Unbelievable. It's the end of the world. That was the kind of face he was looking at me with. How unpleasant.

lines.content: おい、智仁
lines.translated: "Hey, Tomohito."

lines.content: あ、ああ？
lines.translated: "H-Huh?"

lines.content: お前は、あれか？　アイドル雑誌のかわいい子を二度見、三度見し続けていれば、いつかその子が自分の彼女なってくれるとでも考えてるような痛い奴だったのか――
lines.translated: "What, are you one of those guys? Some pathetic dude who thinks that if he keeps doing double and triple takes at cute girls in idol magazines, one of them will magically become his girlfriend someday--?"

lines.content: おのれ偽者！
lines.translated: "Why, you imposter!"

lines.content: はあ……っ！？
ううっ、返せ！　返せよぅ！
lines.translated: "Uuuugh, give him back! Give him back to me!"

lines.content: 急にめそめそしはじめる智仁だ。
lines.translated: Tomohito suddenly started blubbering.

lines.content: 俺のっ、俺の大切な親友をどこにやった……！
lines.translated: "What did you do... with my precious best friend...?!"

lines.content: ……何ガチ泣きしてんだお前。引くからやめろ
lines.translated: "...Why are you actually crying, man? You're creeping me out, stop it."

lines.content: だ、だって……。だってさあ
lines.translated: "B-Because... Come on, man..."

lines.content: 図体でっかいのが“だってだって”とか言ってんじゃあない
lines.translated: "A big guy like you shouldn't be whining 'because, because' like a kid."

lines.content: 学園祭ですてきな曲を書いてきたお前のこと、やっぱりすごいなあさすが俺の親友だ――と得意に思っていたのに。全部台無しだぞ智仁
lines.translated: "Here I was feeling so proud of you for writing such a great song for the school festival, thinking, 'Man, he's amazing, that's my best friend for you'--and now you've completely ruined it, Tomohito."

lines.content: だって……！
lines.translated: "Because...!"

lines.content: いつもの大雅だったら“え、どこどこ？　巨乳だった？　すっげえ揉みたい――おい、ちょっと揉ませてもらえるか聞いてこいよ”って言ってさ、一番に食いついてくるだろ？
lines.translated: "The usual Taiga would be the first one to jump on that, saying, 'Huh, where, where? Did she have huge boobs? Man, I wanna grope 'em so bad--hey, go ask her if she'll let me cop a feel,' wouldn't you?!"

lines.content: 微妙に話をねつ造するな。それに俺は巨乳になど興味ない。控えめなものにほど美しさを感じて止まないタイプな男の子なんだよ。俺は
lines.translated: "Stop subtly fabricating things I've never said. Besides, I have zero interest in huge breasts. I'm the type of boy who endlessly finds beauty in more modest proportions. That's who I am."

lines.content: と、言いつつ。
lines.translated: Even as I said that,

lines.content: ハルのことをふと思い……。
lines.translated: Haru suddenly crossed my mind...

lines.content: つい、無言になってしまった。
lines.translated: And I inadvertently fell silent.

lines.content: すると千和が鼻をすすり上げていた。涙目だ。
lines.translated: Just then, Chiwa sniffled. She had tears in her eyes.

lines.content: ご、ごめんなさい先輩っ
lines.translated: "I-I'm so sorry, Senpai!"

lines.content: え？　なぜ謝るの……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why are you apologizing...?"

lines.content: 私と兎蛙先輩ばっかり話してて、奏先輩のこと、ちょっと、無視してて……
lines.translated: "Tooya-senpai and I were doing all the talking, and we were kind of ignoring you, Kanade-senpai..."

lines.content: だ、だから、その、仲間外れで怒っちゃって……頭とか心とか、そういうのがいつもよりおかしくなっちゃったんじゃないかって……っ
lines.translated: "S-So, um, I thought maybe you got mad about being left out... and it made your head and your heart go even weirder than usual...!"

lines.content: それが心配で……。
lines.translated: "I was so worried..."

lines.content: と、微妙に失礼なことを言うかわいい後輩だった。
lines.translated: Or so my cute junior said, phrasing it in a subtly rude way.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。いつも奏先輩に意地悪されるから。ちょっとしたことで、すぐいじめられるから
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. It's just that you're always so mean to me, Kanade-senpai. You always tease me over the littlest things."

lines.content: だ、だからいつものお返しのつもりというか。ただの悪戯の、つもりだったんです……。それが、そんなに傷つくなんて、思ってなくて……
lines.translated: "S-So I meant it as a little payback for usual, I guess. It was just supposed to be a harmless prank... I didn't think it would hurt your feelings this much..."

lines.content: ……う、うん。悪戯、か
lines.translated: "...Y-Yeah. A prank, huh?"

lines.content: “今夜、一緒にいけないことをしよう”――
lines.translated: "Let's do something naughty together tonight"--

lines.content: そんな言葉と共に、ハルと俺は“夜”の中でさくらを咲かせた。あの咲かないさくらをだ。
lines.translated: With those words, Haru and I had made the cherry blossoms bloom inside the "Night." Those cherry blossoms that never bloomed.

lines.content: ……驚いた。
lines.translated: I was surprised.

lines.content: それがハルの“魔法”なのだとはいえ、こんなにも簡単にあのさくらが咲くとは思っていなかった。
lines.translated: Even knowing it was Haru's "magic," I never expected those cherry trees to bloom so easily.

lines.content: 俺はバスが向かう先を見る。
lines.translated: I looked ahead toward the bus's destination.

lines.content: 学園だ。
lines.translated: The academy.

lines.content: この坂道を登り切り、そして校門をくぐったなら――[・|そ][・|の][・|姿]は見えてくるだろう。
lines.translated: Once we climbed to the top of this hill and passed through the school gates--that sight would surely come into view.

lines.content: 千和と智仁、そして姫織は満開のさくらを見てどう思うだろうか。俺たちの目論見通り驚いてくれるかな。
lines.translated: What would Chiwa, Tomohito, and Himeori think when they saw the cherry blossoms in full bloom? Would they be surprised, just like we planned?

lines.content: そして、ハルと俺は“特別”になれたんだ、と――みんなへ[・|報][・|告]したいと思う。
lines.translated: And I also wanted to announce to everyone--that Haru and I had become "special" to each other.

lines.content: 本当は、それにこそ驚いてほしくて……。
lines.translated: Truthfully, that was what I really wanted them to be surprised about...

lines.content: 同じくらい、おめでとうとも言ってもらいたくて。
lines.translated: And just as much, I wanted them to tell us "congratulations."

lines.content: 実は、いいことがあったんだ
lines.translated: "Actually, something good happened."

lines.content: まずはそういうふうに伝えておこう。そう思った。
lines.translated: I figured I should start by telling them that much.

lines.content: だから少しぼーっとしてたのかもしれない。色々、うれしくて
lines.translated: "So maybe I was spacing out a little. I'm just really happy about a lot of things."

lines.content: いいこと……ですか？
lines.translated: "Something good...?"

lines.content: ああ。だからさ、千和。別に何も怒ってないよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. So, Chiwa, I'm not mad about anything at all."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 智仁が言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito said.

lines.content: それは、かわいい子も目に入らなくなるくらいか？
lines.translated: "Good enough that you don't even notice cute girls anymore?"

lines.content: そうだな
lines.translated: "I guess so."

lines.content: それは、先輩。もう私に意地悪しなくてもいいくらい、なんですか……？
lines.translated: "Does that mean it's good enough that you don't even need to be mean to me anymore, Senpai...?"

lines.content: う、うん……。いや。うーん。それは、どうだろう
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah... Wait, no. Hmm. I wonder about that."

lines.content: なんだか微妙な気持ちにはなるものの、
lines.translated: Although that left me with somewhat mixed feelings,

lines.content: とにかくいいことがあったんだよ。だからさ、ふたり共。学園に着いたら報告したいことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "Anyway, something good happened. So, you two, there's something I want to tell you once we get to the academy."

lines.content: 報告……？
lines.translated: "Something to tell us...?"

lines.content: それっていいこと、なんだよな？
lines.translated: "And it's a good thing, right?"

lines.content: そうだな。俺たちにとっては
lines.translated: "Yeah. For us, at least."

lines.content: ああ、えっとな
lines.translated: "Ah, well..."

lines.content: ――本当はすぐにでも言ってしまいたいけれど、
lines.translated: --Truthfully, I wanted to blurt it out right this second,

lines.content: ひよちゃんも一緒に聞いてほしいから、学園に到着してからだ。それまでは少しだけ待っていてほしい
lines.translated: "I want Hiyo-chan to hear it with you guys, so it'll have to wait until we get to the academy. Just hold on a little longer until then."

lines.content: う～ん。なんだかもったい付けた感じだなあ。変にどきどきしてくるじゃないか
lines.translated: "Hmm. You're really dragging this out, aren't you? Now you've got me all weirdly nervous."

lines.content: ぽつりと言いながら、千和はじぃっと俺の顔を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Murmuring that to herself, Chiwa stared intently up at my face.

lines.content: ん？　千和、どうした？　俺の顔に何かついてる？
lines.translated: "Hm? What's wrong, Chiwa? Is there something on my face?"

lines.content: いえ……
ふるふると首をふり、
lines.translated: She gave a tiny shake of her head.

lines.content: それって、柊先輩にも関係あることなんですか？
lines.translated: "Does this have something to do with Hiiragi-senpai, too?"

lines.content: 鋭いことを言う千和だった。
lines.translated: Leave it to Chiwa to be so sharp.

lines.content: あ、ああ、そうだね。ハルも関係あることだよ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah, that's right. It involves Haru, too."

lines.content: 奏先輩だけじゃなくって、柊先輩にもいいことあったってことなんでしょうか？
lines.translated: "Does that mean something good happened to Hiiragi-senpai too, not just you, Kanade-senpai?"

lines.content: ……うん。きっと
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I'm sure it did."

lines.content: ハルもそう思ってくれていたらいいけれど。
lines.translated: At least, I hoped Haru felt the same way.

lines.content: そう言いながら、俺は昨晩の出来事を改めて思い出している――
lines.translated: As I said that, I thought back once more to what happened last night--

lines.content: 『それじゃあ、また明日。学園で会おうね、大雅くん』
lines.translated: "Well then, see you tomorrow. Let's meet at the academy, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 昨晩の別れ際、ハルが笑顔でそう言った。
lines.translated: Haru had said that with a smile as we were parting ways last night.

lines.content: そんなハルに俺は問いかける――もう帰るのかな、と。
lines.translated: I asked her if she was heading back already.

lines.content: 『ハル。今夜は“ゆめのねどこ”に泊まっていくのかと思ったんだけど』
lines.translated: "Haru. I thought you might stay over at the Bed of Dreams tonight."

lines.content: 『う、うん。そうしたい気持ちは少し……ううん。いっぱいあるけれど』
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I do want to a little... No, I want to a lot, actually."

lines.content: 照れ笑いを浮かべ、ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Haru gave a bashful smile and continued.

lines.content: 『だけど今夜は帰らなきゃって』
lines.translated: "But I feel like I really should go back tonight."

lines.content: 『そっか……。でも、どうして？』
lines.translated: "I see... Why is that, though?"

lines.content: 『そ、それは……』
lines.translated: "W-Well..."

lines.content: ハルはそろりと小首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Haru gently tilted her head.

lines.content: 『なんとなく、かな。施設で待ってる人もいるし』
lines.translated: "Just a feeling, I guess. And there are people waiting for me at the home."

lines.content: 『なあ、ハル』
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."
"...Yeah?"

lines.content: 『もう少し一緒にいたい』
lines.translated: "I want to stay with you a little longer."

lines.content: 『ああ。だから帰らないでほしい』
lines.translated: "Yeah. So I don't want you to go back."
"U-Uuu..."

lines.content: 消え入りそうな声だった。顔は赤い。目も伏せている。
lines.translated: Her voice was barely a whisper. Her face was red, and her eyes were cast downward.

lines.content: 『お、おかしいよ大雅くん』
lines.translated: "Y-You're acting strange, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 『そうかな……何が？』
lines.translated: "Am I...? How so?"

lines.content: 『……だって今夜はいつもよりずっと積極的っていうか。一緒にいると……その。いつもよりどきどきして、大変だよ』
lines.translated: "...Because you're being way more forward tonight than usual. Being with you... um, it's making my heart pound even harder than usual. It's overwhelming."

lines.content: 『俺さ、ハル。今夜もうひとつわかったことがあるんだ』
lines.translated: "You know, Haru, there's one more thing I figured out tonight."

lines.content: 『え？　もうひとつ……？』
lines.translated: "Huh? One more thing...?"

lines.content: 『ハルと一緒にいると、俺はなんだかいつも以上に素直になれるような気がするんだよ』
lines.translated: "I feel like when I'm with you, I can be way more honest with myself than usual."

lines.content: 『そう、なの？』
lines.translated: "Is... that so?"
"Yeah..."

lines.content: 人には誰しも“対する者”と同じ数だけ顔がある。
lines.translated: Everyone has as many faces as there are people they interact with.

lines.content: 目上のひとと対するときの自分。友人と対するときの自分。こうして好きな人と対するときの自分。
lines.translated: The person I am when dealing with superiors. The person I am when hanging out with friends. And the person I am right now, facing the girl I love.

lines.content: ……誰と一緒にいるときの自分が好きなのか。
lines.translated: Who am I with when I like myself the best?

lines.content: ふとそう考えることが俺には多くある。
lines.translated: I often find myself wondering about that out of nowhere.

lines.content: 『たぶん、誰かのことを好きになるっていうのは、その人といるときの自分が一番好きだからってこともあるんじゃないかなと思うんだ』
lines.translated: "Maybe part of falling in love with someone is liking the person you are when you're with them the best."

lines.content: 『大好きな人と一緒にいるときの自分でいられる。それが一番心地よく思える。だから、その人とできるだけ長く一緒にいたい。そう感じるんじゃないかと思うんだよ』
lines.translated: "You get to be the version of yourself that exists when you're with the person you love. And that feels the most comfortable of all. Maybe that's why you end up wanting to stay with them for as long as possible."

lines.content: 『“俺、奏大雅は、柊ハルと一緒にいると素直になれる”――』
lines.translated: "'I, Kanade Taiga, can be honest with myself when I'm with Hiiragi Haru'--"

lines.content: 『なんだかさ、ハルの前だと躊躇わず思ってることを素直に言えてしまうんだ――帰ってほしくないときには、もっと一緒にいたいと、こうして目を見て言えるくらい』
lines.translated: "For some reason, when I'm in front of you, I can just say whatever I'm thinking without holding back--enough to look you right in the eye and tell you I want to stay together longer when I don't want you to leave."

lines.content: 『“好きだ”って、ためらわず言えちゃうくらい……？』
lines.translated: "Enough to say 'I love you' without hesitating...?"

lines.content: 『ああ、そうだね。俺はハルが大好きだ』
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I love you, Haru."

lines.content: 『……う、うん。そっか』
lines.translated: "...Y-Yeah. I see."

lines.content: ハルは照れ笑いを満面に映し、うなずく。
lines.translated: A bashful smile spread across Haru's entire face as she nodded.

lines.content: 『私も、そうだよ』
lines.translated: "It's the same for me, too."

lines.content: 『みんなの前ではがんばって格好付けなきゃって――誰にも求めてられていないのに、勝手に張り切っちゃおうとするけれど』
lines.translated: "In front of everyone else, I feel like I have to try hard and put on a brave front--getting all worked up on my own even though nobody asked me to."

lines.content: 『でも、大雅くんの前だと、ううん……あなたの“[・|隣]”だと、格好付けなくても許してもらえる――』
lines.translated: "But in front of you, Taiga-kun--no, when I'm right *beside* you, I feel like it's okay not to put on airs--"

lines.content: 『大雅くんと一緒にいるときは無理をしなくていいって思える。そんな自分でいられるのは、とても心地良いことだって感じるよ』
lines.translated: "When I'm with you, Taiga-kun, I feel like I don't have to push myself. Being able to be that version of myself feels so nice and comfortable."

lines.content: だからふたりはできるだけ一緒にいたい。
lines.translated: That was why the two of us wanted to be together as much as possible.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 『今夜は、ごめんね。帰らなきゃ』
lines.translated: "I'm sorry about tonight. I really have to go back."

lines.content: 『……そっか。わかった』
lines.translated: "...I see. Got it."

lines.content: 繋いだままでいた手を離した。
lines.translated: I let go of her hand, which I had been holding this whole time.

lines.content: 『どうしようか。俺たちのこと、みんなには明日、報告してもいいかな』
lines.translated: "What should we do? Is it okay if we tell everyone about us tomorrow?"

lines.content: 『……うん。そうだね。隠すようなことでもないし』
lines.translated: "...Yeah, you're right. It's not something we need to hide, anyway."

lines.content: 『みんなにおめでとうって言ってもらえたら、うれしい――そんなこと思うのは勝手かな』
lines.translated: "I'd be happy if everyone congratulated us--is it selfish of me to think that?"

lines.content: 『うーん。どうかなあ』
lines.translated: "Hmm. I wonder."

lines.content: 苦笑のような小さな笑顔を浮かべたけれど、
lines.translated: A small, somewhat wry smile appeared on her face,

lines.content: そこでハルは唇を結んだ。どうかした？　と問いかける。するとハルは難しい顔で、こう言った。
lines.translated: but then Haru pressed her lips together. I asked her what was wrong, and with a troubled look, she said this:

lines.content: 『……千和ちゃんになんて言ったらいいかな。絶対、気にしないでって千和ちゃんは言うだろうけど……少し、困るな』
lines.translated: "...I wonder how I should tell Chiwa-chan. I'm sure she'll tell me not to worry about it, but... it's a little tough."
"Huh? Chiwa...?"

lines.content: 千和がどうかしたのかなと首をかしげる俺に、ハルは唇を尖らせた。
lines.translated: As I tilted my head, wondering what this had to do with Chiwa, Haru pouted.

lines.content: 『大雅くんのそういうところは、私、あんまり好きじゃあないかもだね。やっぱり君は鈍感だよ。人の気持ちをもっとわかってあげてほしいって思うな』
lines.translated: "I don't think I like that side of you very much, Taiga-kun. You really are dense. I wish you'd try to understand people's feelings a little better."
"Urk."

lines.content: なんだかよくわからないけれど――
lines.translated: I didn't really get what she meant, but--

lines.content: 『ごめんなさい』
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: 素直に謝っておくことにした。
lines.translated: I decided to just apologize honestly.

lines.content: 『とにかく、また明日だよ。大雅くん』
lines.translated: "Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 『みんなに私たちのこと、どんなふうに伝えるか……。どきどきしながら今夜は眠るね』
lines.translated: "I'll fall asleep tonight with my heart pounding... wondering how we're going to tell everyone about us."

lines.content: そうしてその“夜”は別れたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: And that was how we parted ways that "Night"...

lines.content: 正直なところ、俺はうかれていた。自分でも驚くほどだ。
lines.translated: To be honest, I was on cloud nine. Enough to surprise even myself.

lines.content: これからのことを思うと、昨晩は殆ど眠れていなかったくらいなのだ。
lines.translated: Thinking about what lay ahead for us, I could barely even sleep last night.

lines.content: 週末はハルとデートの約束をした。
lines.translated: Haru and I promised to go on a date this weekend.

lines.content: どこに行きたいかと問いかける。一緒にいられればどこでもと君が答える。じゃあどこにも行かなくても同じじゃない？　と少し笑う。
lines.translated: I asked her where she wanted to go. She answered that anywhere was fine as long as we were together. "Then wouldn't it be the same even if we didn't go anywhere?" I teased with a little laugh.

lines.content: いいんだよ、ふたりでいられればどこだって。
lines.translated: It really didn't matter where we went, as long as it was the two of us.

lines.content: ふたり一緒だと、いつもの世界が驚くほどきらきらしてる――漫画とかで見た[・|あ][・|あ][・|い][・|う][・|感][・|じ]は本当だったんだねと、また少し笑った。
lines.translated: When we were together, the everyday world sparkled so much it was amazing--and we shared another little laugh over how *that kind of feeling* we'd seen in manga and stuff was actually real.

lines.content: そんなやりとりを思い出すとつい、頬が緩んでしまって――……
lines.translated: Remembering that exchange, I couldn't help breaking into a goofy grin--...

lines.content: 千和がまた、じぃっと俺を見上げていた。気づかなかった。こほんとひとつ咳払い。
lines.translated: Chiwa was staring right up at me again. I hadn't even noticed. I cleared my throat with a little cough.

lines.content: な、何かな。千和
lines.translated: "W-What is it, Chiwa?"

lines.content: 取り繕いながらも思い出していた。昨晩、ハルが言っていたことだ――“千和ちゃんになんて言ったらいいかな”
lines.translated: Even as I tried to play it cool, I remembered what Haru had said last night--'I wonder how I should tell Chiwa-chan.'

lines.content: あの、先輩
lines.translated: "Um, Senpai."

lines.content: 千和が先に口を開いた。少しどきりとする。
lines.translated: Chiwa spoke up first. My heart skipped a slight beat.

lines.content: さっきから呼んでるんですけど。何度も。何をそんな……きもち悪い顔してるんですか
lines.translated: "I've been calling your name for a while now. Over and over. Why are you making such a... gross face?"

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: でれでれしたりにまにましたり
lines.translated: "Getting all mushy and grinning like an idiot."

lines.content: ……そんな顔、してましたか
lines.translated: "...Was I really making a face like that?"

lines.content: してましたよ。ずっとです
lines.translated: "You were. The whole time."

lines.content: 何度も呼んでたって、どうして？
lines.translated: "Why were you calling my name over and over?"

lines.content: あ。はい。そうでした――……先輩
lines.translated: "Oh, right. About that--...Senpai."

lines.content: 千和が俺の制服の裾を小さく引っ張りながら、車内を見回す。
lines.translated: Giving the hem of my uniform a small tug, Chiwa looked around the inside of the bus.

lines.content: なんだかちょっと騒がしくないですか？　って。そう言いたかったんです
lines.translated: "Doesn't it seem a little noisy in here? That's what I wanted to say."

lines.content: 騒がしい……？
lines.translated: "Noisy...?"

lines.content: はい。何かあったのかなあって
lines.translated: "Yes. I was wondering if something happened."

lines.content: 確かに。
lines.translated: That's true.

lines.content: 気づけばバスの車内がざわつきはじめている。
lines.translated: Now that she mentioned it, a murmur was starting to spread through the bus.

lines.content: こんなちょっとした騒動にも気づけないくらい、俺はでれでれしたりにまにましたりしていたみたいだ。
lines.translated: Apparently, I'd been so busy getting all mushy and grinning like an idiot that I hadn't even noticed a minor commotion like this.

lines.content: 車内の生徒たちはバスの向かう先――学園の方角へと挙って視線を送っていた。
lines.translated: All at once, the students on the bus were directing their gazes toward where we were headed--toward the academy.

lines.content: 何かをしきりに気にかけている。そんな具合だ。
lines.translated: It seemed like something had really caught their attention.

lines.content: ああ。確かに……どうしたのかな。何かあったのかな
lines.translated: "Yeah, you're right... What's going on? Did something happen?"

lines.content: みんな、学園の方を気にしてるみたいですけど……。やっぱり何かあったみたいです。全員が……町を歩く人たちもみんな、学園のほうを見ています
lines.translated: "Everyone seems to be looking toward the academy, though... Something really must have happened. Every single person... even the people walking through town are all looking that way."

lines.content: 窓の外を見る。
lines.translated: I looked out the window.

lines.content: 歩道にはたくさんの人たちが立ち止まり、一方向を揃って見上げていた。
lines.translated: Crowds of people had stopped on the sidewalks, all looking up in the same direction.

lines.content: 花びらが舞う。
lines.translated: Petals danced through the air.

lines.content: 走り続ける車窓の向こうだ。
lines.translated: Right outside the windows of the moving bus.

lines.content: いつもよりその一つひとつが色濃くて。いつもより、たくさん、たくさんで……。
lines.translated: Each and every one of them was more vividly colored than usual. And there were so, so many more of them...

lines.content: “見ろよ”
lines.translated: 'Look.'

lines.content: ふと、誰かの声がした。
lines.translated: Suddenly, someone's voice rang out.

lines.content: “さくらだ。……学園のさくらが、咲いてるぞ”
lines.translated: 'It's the cherry blossoms. ...The academy's cherry blossoms are blooming!'

lines.content: さくら……？
lines.translated: "Cherry blossoms...?"

lines.content: つま先立ち。
lines.translated: Standing on his tiptoes,

lines.content: 一番背の高い智仁がバスの向かう先を見ようとする。
lines.translated: Tomohito, the tallest among us, tried to see ahead of the bus.

lines.content: んー。だめだ。よく、見えないなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm. No good. I can't really see."

lines.content: 車内の喧騒はざわめきに変わり始めている。
lines.translated: The chatter inside the bus was starting to turn into an excited buzz.

lines.content: ……心なしかバスの走る速度まで上がっているように感じられた。
lines.translated: Maybe it was just my imagination, but it felt like the bus was even picking up speed.

lines.content: ……学園は“魔法”に溢れ。
lines.translated: The academy was overflowing with "magic."

lines.content: 桃色の花びらが舞い踊り。
lines.translated: Pink petals danced and swirled.

lines.content: 真冬の雪のように、降り積もり。
lines.translated: Piling up like midwinter snow.

lines.content: きっと、たくさんの驚きに満たされているはず。
lines.translated: I was sure the place was filled with sheer amazement right about now.

lines.content: みんなは気付くだろうか。そこにある確かな“魔法”の存在に。
lines.translated: Would everyone notice it? The unmistakable presence of "magic" right before their eyes.

lines.content: そして、驚いてくれるだろうか。よろこんでくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: And would they be surprised? Would it make them happy?

lines.content: たださくらが満開。それ以上でも以下でもない。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms were simply in full bloom. Nothing more, nothing less.

lines.content: これは、たったそれだけの悪戯でしかないけれど……。
lines.translated: This was nothing more than a simple little prank, and yet...

lines.content: 咲くはずのないいっぱいの春色の中で、俺は、俺たちにとって大切な友人たちに伝えたいことがある。祝福してもらいたいことがある。
lines.translated: Amidst all those spring colors that shouldn't have been blooming, there was something I wanted to tell the friends who were so dear to us. Something I wanted them to congratulate us on.

lines.content: そこからやっと、本当の“特別な関係”になれた俺たちの新しい毎日が、ようやく始まる――そんなふうにも、心のどこかで感じていたから。
lines.translated: Because somewhere in my heart, I felt that once we did, our new everyday lives--now that we truly had a "special relationship"--would finally begin.

lines.content: 到着。
lines.translated: We arrived.

lines.content: 学園前のバス停だ。
lines.translated: It was the bus stop in front of the academy.

lines.content: ぞろぞろと生徒たちが下車していく。半ば争うように。
lines.translated: The students filed off the bus in droves, practically scrambling over one another to get out.

lines.content: 俺たちもその流れに押し出されるような形で、下車。
lines.translated: Caught up in the flow, we were practically pushed off the bus as well.

lines.content: すると……。
lines.translated: And when I did...

lines.content: すごい……
lines.translated: "Amazing..."

lines.content: ため息をもらすように。
lines.translated: Like letting out a sigh.

lines.content: 桃色の天井です……
lines.translated: "It's a pink ceiling..."

lines.content: 千和が空を見上げている。
lines.translated: Chiwa was looking up at the sky.

lines.content: はらはらとさくらの花が舞う。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms fluttered softly down.

lines.content: たくさん、たくさんの花びら。
lines.translated: So, so many petals.

lines.content: ああ……、なんだこれ。こんなのはじめて見た
lines.translated: "Whoa... what is this? I've never seen anything like it."

lines.content: さくらの花は、この町に住む人間にとって珍しいものではないけれど……。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms weren't an uncommon sight for the people living in this town, and yet...

lines.content: 学園の時計塔だ。そこに寄り添うように立つさくらの樹。この花は、別だ。
lines.translated: It was the academy's clock tower. And the cherry tree standing nestled right beside it. These blossoms were different.

lines.content: バス停に下車した者。自転車通学の者。徒歩での通学の者。みんながみんな立ち止まり、空を見上げるようにする。
lines.translated: Those who had gotten off at the bus stop. Those commuting by bike. Those walking to school. Every single one of them stopped in their tracks and looked up at the sky.

lines.content: 行こう。もっと近くで見てみたい
lines.translated: "Let's go. I want to see it up close."

lines.content: 智仁は俺に微笑みを送り、早足でバス停を離れる。
lines.translated: Shooting me a smile, Tomohito briskly walked away from the bus stop.

lines.content: 俺は、千和は、その背中について行く。
lines.translated: Chiwa and I followed right behind him.

lines.content: 伝説は実際に目で見て確認しないと意味がないだろ
lines.translated: "There's no point in a legend if you don't actually confirm it with your own eyes, right?"

lines.content: んん？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "Huh? What's that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: いつだって、伝説を目の当たりにした生き証人くらいにはなりたいって思うだろ
lines.translated: "Don't you always want to at least be a living witness who saw a legend unfold firsthand?"

lines.content: 伝説の中心人物にはなれないのなら、それを語り継ぐくらいの役割は欲しい。そう思わないか？
lines.translated: "If you can't be the central figure of a legend, you at least want the role of passing the story down. Don't you think?"

lines.content: いつもながら何が言いたいのかよくわからないぞ――……と、いうか。お前は語り継がれる側になるんじゃなかったのかよ
lines.translated: "As usual, I have no idea what you're trying to say--...Or rather, weren't you supposed to be the one having legends passed down about you?"

lines.content: おお。確かにそうだ。こんな風景、いつか、ありったけの音楽で飾って歌ってやらなきゃ収まらないよな
lines.translated: "Oh, right, good point. A sight like this... I won't be satisfied unless I dress it up with all the music I've got and sing about it someday."

lines.content: 校門前へと辿り着く。
lines.translated: We arrived in front of the school gates.

lines.content: これ。どうなってるの……？
lines.translated: "What is going on here...?"

lines.content: そこに立ち尽くした千和がそう漏らす。
lines.translated: Standing frozen in place, Chiwa let those words slip out.

lines.content: 校舎は。
lines.translated: The school building.

lines.content: そして学園そのものが。
lines.translated: And the academy itself.

lines.content: 大きなおおきなさくらの色で包まれていた――それは、いつか“夜”の中で見た満開の[・|そ][・|れ]と、殆ど同じ姿でもあった。
lines.translated: Were wrapped in the color of a massive, towering cherry tree--looking almost identical to the *one* we had seen in full bloom within the "Night" once before.

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 何？　と俺は千和に答える。
lines.translated: "What is it?" I asked Chiwa.

lines.content: 私の記憶違いじゃなければ、昨日はさくら、咲いていませんでした
lines.translated: "Unless my memory is playing tricks on me, the cherry blossoms weren't blooming yesterday."

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: たった一晩でこの変わりよう……。すごいです
lines.translated: "To change this much in just a single night... It's amazing."

lines.content: 俺は辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: I looked around the area.

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: ……これは“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: This was "magic."

lines.content: 実は一晩ですべて散ってしまわないだろうかと心配していた。
lines.translated: To tell the truth, I had been worried that they might all scatter away in a single night.

lines.content: だけど花はまだまだ満開。見慣れた校舎は“春”で埋め尽くされている。
lines.translated: But the flowers were still in full bloom. The familiar school building was completely buried in "spring."

lines.content: そしてここから見渡せる校庭は、今なお降り続ける花びらで敷き詰められていた。甘い香りが辺りを包む。
lines.translated: And the schoolyard stretching out before us was carpeted in petals that were still falling even now. A sweet fragrance enveloped the air.

lines.content: ふわふわ、
lines.translated: Softly drifting,

lines.content: はらはら、
lines.translated: gently fluttering,

lines.content: ピンク色の欠片が絶え間なく、ここには降り注いでいた。
lines.translated: pink fragments poured down endlessly upon this place.

lines.content: 立ちすくむ生徒たち。
lines.translated: The students stood rooted to the spot.

lines.content: そこら中にため息が満ちる。
lines.translated: Breathless sighs filled the air all around us.

lines.content: （なあ、ハル。どこかで見てるか。これだけでも充分、俺たちの“悪戯”は成功だ）
lines.translated: (Hey, Haru. Are you watching from somewhere? Even just this much is enough to make our "prank" a success.)

lines.content: 俺たちふたりの悪戯に意味なんてない。
lines.translated: There was no deep meaning behind our little prank.

lines.content: そもそもこれはハルの願った“魔法”、その結果なのだ。
lines.translated: In the first place, this was the result of the "magic" Haru had wished for.

lines.content: みんなのことを少し驚かせてやりたいというのは殆どおまけだ。ただ平凡な毎日をちょっとした驚きで飾れればそれで充分。
lines.translated: Wanting to give everyone a little surprise was mostly just a bonus. As long as it dressed up our ordinary everyday lives with a little bit of wonder, that was plenty.

lines.content: あとはみんなの前にハルが姿を見せて……。
lines.translated: Now all that was left was for Haru to show herself in front of everyone...

lines.content: 俺たちからみんなに伝えたい。
lines.translated: We wanted to tell everyone together.

lines.content: それだけだ。
lines.translated: That's all.

lines.content: それだけで、何もかも充分なんだ。
lines.translated: Just that alone would be more than enough.

lines.content: きっと千和や智仁。そして今、この学園のどこかにいるだろうはずの姫織も……みんな“おめでとう”と言ってくれるはず。
lines.translated: I was sure Chiwa and Tomohito, and Himeori, who had to be somewhere in the academy right now... all of them would say "congratulations" to us.

lines.content: ……そう俺は願ってやまない。
lines.translated: I wished for that with all my heart.

lines.content: 行こうか。こんなところで立ち止まってても仕方がない
lines.translated: "Shall we head in? There's no point just standing around out here."

lines.content: ふたりを促し、校門から校庭へ入る。
lines.translated: Urging the two of them on, I walked through the school gates and into the schoolyard.

lines.content: あそこ。なんか、人が集まってるな
lines.translated: "Over there. Looks like a crowd is gathering."

lines.content: 指をさす。
lines.translated: He pointed a finger.

lines.content: 玄関口付近の一カ所だ。
lines.translated: At a spot near the main entrance.

lines.content: 何かあったんでしょうか。みんな立ち止まってますね
lines.translated: "I wonder if something happened. Everyone's stopped in their tracks."

lines.content: ちょうど時計塔が真上に位置する場所。
lines.translated: Right beneath the clock tower.

lines.content: 一番さくらの天井が色濃い場所だ。
lines.translated: The spot where the canopy of cherry blossoms was thickest.

lines.content: そこに、生徒たちが集まっているのに俺たちは気づく。
lines.translated: We noticed the students gathering there.

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: 騒がしい。
lines.translated: It was noisy.

lines.content: なんだろう。校庭に入ってからいっそう騒がしくなったよな
lines.translated: "I wonder what's going on. It's gotten way noisier since we stepped into the schoolyard, hasn't it?"

lines.content: 辺りを見回す。確かに人の密度は高くなっているけれど……。
lines.translated: I looked around. There were definitely more people packed in here, but still...

lines.content: ん？　そうか？　……騒がしい？
lines.translated: "Hm? Really? ...You think it's noisy?"

lines.content: んー……。よくわかりませんけど、でも、いつもと違うといったら、そうかもしれませんね
lines.translated: "Hmm... I'm not really sure, but if you're asking whether it's different from usual, then maybe."

lines.content: ふたりは首を傾げていた。
lines.translated: The two of them tilted their heads.

lines.content: ……昨日まで枯れていた木に、一晩で花が満開だなんて。誰だって驚きます。いつもよりちょっとくらいは騒がしくもなりますよ。きっと
lines.translated: "...A tree that was completely bare until yesterday is suddenly in full bloom overnight. Anyone would be surprised. Of course it's going to be a little noisier than usual. I'm sure that's all it is."

lines.content: この喧騒を騒がしく感じているのは俺だけなのか。
lines.translated: Was I the only one who found this commotion so loud?

lines.content: ……それだけ俺は舞い上がり、浮かれてしまっているということなのかな。
lines.translated: Did that just mean I was that giddy and carried away?

lines.content: なんだか自分がひどく恥ずかしいもののように思えて……。
lines.translated: It made me feel terribly embarrassed of myself...

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: 騒がしい校庭内。
lines.translated: The noisy schoolyard.

lines.content: ぞわぞわ
lines.translated: Crawl, crawl...

lines.content: 騒がしい胸の内。
lines.translated: The noisy restlessness inside my chest.

lines.content: そんな、少し気恥ずかしい騒がしさを振り払うように、俺はハルの姿を探した。
lines.translated: As if to shake off that slightly embarrassing clamor, I searched for Haru.

lines.content: （別に、約束をしたわけじゃないけれど……）
lines.translated: (It's not like we promised to meet up here or anything, though...)

lines.content: ハルはすぐ近くにいてくれるような気がした。
lines.translated: Even so, I felt like Haru would be right nearby.

lines.content: 早く会いたいと、思った。
lines.translated: I wanted to see her as soon as possible.

lines.content: 別れてからまだ数時間だ。
lines.translated: It had only been a few hours since we parted ways.

lines.content: （それなのにこんな気持ちになるなんて）
lines.translated: (And yet I already feel like this.)

lines.content: 驚いている。俺は本当にハルのことが好きなんだな、と。
lines.translated: It surprised me. I really do love Haru, I realized.

lines.content: 一秒一秒、重ねていく度、自分の気持ちを自覚していくようで……。
lines.translated: With every passing second, I seemed to become more and more aware of my own feelings...

lines.content: 俺たちのことを早くみんなに報告したい。
lines.translated: I wanted to tell everyone about us right away.

lines.content: 気が急いてしかたがなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help feeling impatient.

lines.content: どきどきしていた。わくわくしていた。
lines.translated: My heart was pounding. Thrumming with excitement.

lines.content: おい、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 智仁が、言う。
lines.translated: Tomohito spoke.

lines.content: ちょっとあそこ、見てみろ
lines.translated: "Take a look over there."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: なんだか、様子が変じゃないか？
lines.translated: "Doesn't something seem kind of weird?"

lines.content: 智仁のそのせりふが合図だったように思う。
lines.translated: Tomohito's words felt like a cue.

lines.content: その瞬間――
lines.translated: In that instant--

lines.content: 俺は、その[・|異][・|変]に、気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: I noticed that something was *wrong*.
"...*No one is looking at the sky*?"

lines.content: 異変はいくつか認められた。
lines.translated: There were several signs that something was amiss.

lines.content: まず、ひとつ。
lines.translated: First, one.

lines.content: そこに時計塔の下に集まる生徒らは、さくら色の空天井を見上げてなどいなかった。[・|下][・|を][・|見][・|て][・|い][・|た]。
lines.translated: The students gathered beneath the clock tower weren't looking up at the cherry-pink canopy overhead at all. *They were looking down*.

lines.content: 他の生徒たちはとりつかれたように、頭上のきれいな花びらを見上げているというのに……。
lines.translated: Even though all the other students were gazing up at the beautiful petals overhead as if spellbound...

lines.content: もうひとつ。
lines.translated: And one more thing.

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: 大人たちが――教師たちが駆けつけてくる。
lines.translated: Adults--the teachers--were coming at a run.

lines.content: 不穏な空気。
lines.translated: A tense, unsettling atmosphere.

lines.content: ……誰かが細く、そして高い声を発したような気がした。
lines.translated: I thought I heard someone let out a thin, high-pitched cry.

lines.content: なんだ。
lines.translated: What is it?

lines.content: 何が、あったのだ。
lines.translated: What happened?

lines.content: ずきり
lines.translated: Throb.

lines.content: 胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: My chest ached.

lines.content: それは何度も何度も経験した、慣れ親しんだ痛みだったように思う。
lines.translated: It felt like a familiar pain I had experienced over and over again.

lines.content: これは予感だ。
lines.translated: This was a premonition.

lines.content: この胸を突き刺す、嫌な予感は……。
lines.translated: This awful premonition stabbing into my chest...

lines.content: 歩を進める両足が、なぜだろう、重苦しくて仕方がなくなる。
lines.translated: For some reason, my legs grew unbearably heavy with every step I took.

lines.content: 早鐘をうつ心臓のどきどきは、歓迎できない色合いへと変貌し始めている。
lines.translated: The rapid pounding of my heart was beginning to twist into something deeply unwelcome.

lines.content: どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder why.

lines.content: いやだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: あの集団に近づきたくはない。
lines.translated: I didn't want to go near that crowd.

lines.content: そう、思ってしまったが……。
lines.translated: That was what I thought, and yet...

lines.content: 接近したその集団から、ほんの少しだけ離れたところに佇むひとりの生徒を認めた。
lines.translated: Just a short distance away from the crowd as we drew closer, I spotted a single student standing still.

lines.content: 真新しい制服と鞄。
lines.translated: A brand-new uniform and bag.

lines.content: 新しい環境へ飛び込むことに備えて綺麗に整えられた髪。
lines.translated: Hair neatly arranged in preparation for diving into a new environment.

lines.content: 新しいもので固められたその存在。
lines.translated: A figure clad entirely in newness.

lines.content: ……柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 彼女の背中がそこにはあった。
lines.translated: Her back was right there.

lines.content: ハルも他の子らと一緒に下を見つめていた。
lines.translated: Haru was staring downward along with the other kids.

lines.content: ……ハル
lines.translated: "...Haru."

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: なぜだかとても安心した。
lines.translated: For some reason, I felt an immense wave of relief.

lines.content: 俺は、その決して大きくはない背中に“おはよう”と声をかけようとする。
lines.translated: I opened my mouth to call out "good morning" to that small back of hers.

lines.content: 大雅くん……
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 振り返るハル。
lines.translated: Haru turned around.

lines.content: どきりとする。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: その表情を前に……。
lines.translated: Faced with the look on her face...

lines.content: ごめん。大雅くん。私……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Taiga-kun. I..."

lines.content: その、青ざめた表情のハルを前に……。
lines.translated: Faced with Haru's deathly pale expression...

lines.content: 私、私……
……そのときはじめて、俺は知る。思い知る。
lines.translated: In that moment, for the very first time, I knew. It was driven home to me.

lines.content: そうだ。忘れてしまっていた。
lines.translated: That's right. I had completely forgotten.

lines.content: 誰かが言った――……この世界は残酷なおとぎ話でできている。
lines.translated: Someone had once said it--...this world is made of a cruel fairy tale.
*Happiness comes to sweep your feet out from under you*.

lines.content: 下を見る集団の中心。そこに転がる[・|そ][・|れ]を俺は、見つめた。
lines.translated: At the center of the crowd staring downward. I looked at *that* lying there on the ground.
"I... I'm sorry, Taiga-kun. *I lied to you*. *I deceived you*."

lines.content: 俺のことを返ったハルの背後……。
lines.translated: Beyond Haru, who had turned back to face me...

lines.content: ……これが私の、[・|本][・|当][・|の]“最後の魔法”
lines.translated: "...This is my *true* 'last magic.'"

lines.content: 降り積もった花びらの隙間から、真っ白な手のひらと、細い指先が見えている。
lines.translated: Through the gaps in the fallen petals, a pure white palm and slender fingertips were visible.

lines.content: ……そしてじわりと広がる。花びらよりも濃い、命の色だ。
lines.translated: And something was slowly spreading. A color deeper than the petals--the color of life.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。ごめん。ごめんなさい。こうするしか他になかった
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. There was no other way."

lines.content: そ[・|れ]は――……柊ハルの、亡骸だった。
lines.translated: *It* was--...the lifeless body of Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 地面に広がるものは命の赤色。
lines.translated: Spreading across the ground was the crimson of life.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はいつから動かなくなったのか。
lines.translated: When had *it* stopped moving?

lines.content: いつから、その鼓動を止めたのか。
lines.translated: When had that heartbeat come to a stop?

lines.content: 冷たくなった小さな身体に。赤みをなくしたその頬に。
lines.translated: Upon that small body grown cold. Upon those cheeks drained of all color.

lines.content: はらはらと……、
lines.translated: Softly fluttering...,

lines.content: ふわふわと……、
lines.translated: gently drifting...,

lines.content: まるで、柔らかな毛布でも掛けられたように降り積もる、たくさん、たくさんの、花びら。
lines.translated: countless petals piled up, as though tucking her in beneath a soft blanket.

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: そこに倒れているのは、確かに、君で。
lines.translated: The one lying there was unmistakably you.

lines.content: だけど。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: ……だけど。
lines.translated: Even so.

lines.content: たった今、言葉を交わしたのだって、間違いようもなく君のはずで……。
lines.translated: And yet the one I had just exchanged words with a second ago was unmistakably you as well...

lines.content: わけがわからない。
lines.translated: I don't understand.

lines.content: いったい何が、起きている……。
lines.translated: What on earth is happening...?

lines.content: 振り返る。もう一度ハルと話がしたい。
lines.translated: I turned back. I wanted to talk to Haru again.

lines.content: だが俺は今にも泣き出しそうになる。
lines.translated: But I was on the verge of bursting into tears at any moment.

lines.content: 声を上げ――悲鳴にも似た何かを、吐き出しそうになる。
lines.translated: I was about to cry out--to vomit up something akin to a scream.

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: 騒がしい校庭内。
lines.translated: The noisy schoolyard.

lines.content: ぞわぞわ
lines.translated: Crawl, crawl...

lines.content: 騒がしい胸の内。
lines.translated: The noisy restlessness inside my chest.
A *grating, unpleasant sound* that only I could hear.

lines.content: 彼女を振り返った俺の目に映ったものは。
lines.translated: What met my eyes when I turned back to look at her...

lines.content: 今まで話していたハル。
lines.translated: Was the Haru I had been speaking to until just now.

lines.content: その姿は、まるで霊体のような半透明に薄くなっていて。
lines.translated: Her figure had grown faint and translucent, like a spirit.

lines.content: そしてその、背後には……。
lines.translated: And right behind her...

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...
*Crawl, crawl...*

lines.content: 俺にしか聞こえないザワメキの正体が、そのおぞましい姿を見せていた。
lines.translated: The true source of the rustling murmur only I could hear was baring its hideous form.

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...
*Crawl, crawl...*

lines.content: 先ほどから耳に付く不愉快な騒がしさ。
lines.translated: The unpleasant clamor that had been grating on my ears since earlier.

lines.content: それはこの俺と、半透明なハルにしか聞こえていない。他の誰にも[・|見][・|え][・|て][・|い][・|な][・|い]。
lines.translated: Only the translucent Haru and I could hear it. No one else *could see it*.

lines.content: ハルの背後に突然、姿を表した……異形の者が。[それ|悪夢]が。
lines.translated: Suddenly manifesting right behind Haru was a grotesque entity. A nightmare.

lines.content: 口元を卑しくも歪ませる、その度に――ざわざわ、ざわざわ――真紅の喉の奥から発する騒音だった。
lines.translated: Every time its mouth twisted into a vile sneer--rustle, murmur--that grating noise spilled from the depths of its crimson throat.

lines.content: ごめん。うそをついて、大好きなあなたのことを騙して……本当にごめんなさい。大雅くん。でも――
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. For lying to you, for deceiving the person I love so much... I'm truly sorry, Taiga-kun. But--"

lines.content: [・|半][・|透][・|明]なハルが言う。
lines.translated: The *translucent* Haru spoke.

lines.content: ――もしも人生をやり直せるのなら
lines.translated: "--If I could live my life all over again..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?
"*No matter how many times I started over, no matter how many times I was reborn, I would surely do the exact same thing every single time.*"

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: 大好き
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: ぽつりと、ハルが……半透明の彼女が、言った。
lines.translated: Quietly, Haru... the translucent girl, murmured the words.

lines.content: ……大好きです。大好き、でした
lines.translated: "...I love you. I loved you."

lines.content: 誰にも、触れられない心で……。
lines.translated: With a heart that no one could ever touch...

lines.content: ずっとずっと、あなたのことだけを、ずっと、想ってました
lines.translated: "For so, so long, you were the only one in my thoughts. Always."

lines.content: 誰にも届くことない、その声で……。
lines.translated: With a voice that would never reach anyone...

lines.content: ……さよなら。あなたの人生から、私はここで消えるけど。後悔はない
lines.translated: "...Goodbye. I'm going to vanish from your life right here, but I have no regrets."

lines.content: 微笑んでいた――どうか幸せに生きてほしいと、ハルは言う。
lines.translated: She was smiling--wishing with all her heart for me to live a happy life.

lines.content: こんな私のことなんて、もう、思い出さなくてもいいくらい幸せに
lines.translated: "I hope you're so happy that you never even have to remember someone like me."

lines.content: そこで死んでいる子はただの通りすがりの名無しの子。
lines.translated: The girl lying dead over there is just a nameless passerby.

lines.content: あなたはその子のことなど明日にはもうすっかり忘れてしまうだろう――それが“魔法”。私の“夢”だ。
lines.translated: By tomorrow, you'll probably have forgotten all about her--that is "magic." That is my "dream."

lines.content: ほら、見て。大雅くん。あの花が満開だよ
lines.translated: "Look, Taiga-kun. Those flowers are in full bloom."

lines.content: ハルが空を指さす。
lines.translated: Haru pointed up at the sky.

lines.content: あなたと一緒に、こうしてあの花を見上げることができた。だからもう、後悔はない。“夢”は、叶った
lines.translated: "I got to look up at those flowers together with you like this. So I don't have any regrets left. My 'dream' came true."

lines.content: 微笑む。
lines.translated: I smiled.

lines.content: だけど涙がひとつ、その頬を濡らした。
lines.translated: Yet a single tear trickled down her cheek.

lines.content: ……ありがとう。あなたでよかった。最初で、最後に……好きになった人があなたで、本当に……本当に、幸せでした
lines.translated: "...Thank you. I'm so glad it was you. That the first and last person I ever fell in love with was you... It made me truly... truly happy."

lines.content: ゆらり
lines.translated: Sway...

lines.content: ハルの側に“悪夢”が寄り添う。
lines.translated: The "Nightmare" drifted closer, nestling up beside Haru.

lines.content: ハル。だめだ
lines.translated: "Haru. No."

lines.content: 今、何が起きているのかはわからない。だけど嫌な予感だけは止まらなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't understand what was happening right now. But I couldn't stop the terrible premonition welling up inside me.

lines.content: このまま“さよなら”してはいけない。
lines.translated: I couldn't let her say "goodbye" like this.

lines.content: だめだよハル。行くな
lines.translated: "Don't do this, Haru. Don't go."

lines.content: 俺は、ハルに手を伸ばす――
lines.translated: I reached my hand out toward her--

lines.content: しかしだめだった。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 差し出した指先が彼女に届く、その前に、
lines.translated: Before my outstretched fingertips could reach her,

lines.content: 神さま。お願い。……お願いします。この命はあげる。好きにして。地獄におとされて永遠に苦しむのでも構わない
lines.translated: "God, please... I beg of you. I'll give you this life. Do whatever you want with it. I don't care if I'm cast into hell to suffer for all eternity."

lines.content: 祈るように手を組んだハルは、俺の目の前で――
lines.translated: Clasping her hands together in prayer, right before my eyes, Haru--

lines.content: だけど神さま。お願い。大切な人との、大切な思い出だけは――お願いだから持って行かないで。ずっと、ずっと、せめて心の中でだけでも、あなたと一緒に……
lines.translated: "Just, God, please. My precious memories with my precious person--please, I beg you, don't take those away. Forever and ever, even if it's only inside my heart, let me stay with you..."

lines.content: ――ハルは、去って行った。
lines.translated: --Haru was gone.

lines.content: 見たこともない形をした“悪夢”に、“夜”の中へとずるりと飲み込まれ、姿を消した。
lines.translated: Swallowed whole into the "Night" by a "Nightmare" of a shape I had never seen before, she vanished without a trace.
*This world is like an impenetrable box.*

lines.content: 俺たちはいつでもそこへ強引に閉じこめられていて……。
lines.translated: We are always forcefully locked away inside it...

lines.content: 見えない誰かがその箱にふたをする。
lines.translated: Someone unseen places the lid upon that box.

lines.content: そしてしっかりと鍵をかけてしまう。
lines.translated: And locks it up tight.

lines.content: 何重にも、何重にも。外からも中からも開けられてなるものかと厳重に。
lines.translated: Layer upon layer, lock upon lock. Secured so strictly that it can never be opened from the outside or from within.

lines.content: ……そして世界は終わる。
lines.translated: And so, the world ends.

lines.content: 春はこない。
lines.translated: Spring will not come.

lines.content: “夜”は、明けない――また、真冬のような冷たい場所に、閉じこめられる。
lines.translated: The "Night" will never break--and once again, we are trapped in a freezing place like the dead of winter.

lines.content: そして俺たちは祈るのだ。
lines.translated: And so we pray.

lines.content: いつか自分たちにもまばゆい朝が、暖かな春が、訪れますように。
lines.translated: Praying that one day, a dazzling morning, a warm spring, will visit us too.

lines.content: 祈るばかりでは何もできず、何も変わらないのだと知っていながら。
lines.translated: Even knowing full well that praying alone accomplishes nothing, and changes nothing.

lines.content: それでも祈ることばかりしか、俺たちには残されていなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, praying was the only thing left to us.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 俺たちはいったいどこで道を間違えたのか。
lines.translated: Where on earth did we take a wrong turn?

lines.content: 柊ハル
lines.translated: "Hiiragi Haru."

lines.content: “元”魔法少女
lines.translated: "Former" Magical Girl

lines.content: ４月２７日・死亡
lines.translated: April 27th - Deceased
Cause of Death - *Suicide by leaping*

lines.content: ……がちり。
lines.translated: Click.

lines.content: またひとつ、世界の小箱に重い鍵がかけられた。
lines.translated: Once again, a heavy lock was turned upon the little box of the world.

lines.content: ざわざわ
lines.translated: Rustle, murmur...

lines.content: ぞわぞわ
lines.translated: Crawl, crawl...

lines.content: そんな意地の悪い騒音を。
lines.translated: Such a spiteful, grating noise.

lines.content: 世界が再びひび割れるその音を――俺は、聞いた気がしたのだった。
lines.translated: The sound of the world cracking once more--I felt as though I had heard it.

lines.content: 俺はひとり、暗闇と静けさに包まれている。
lines.translated: Alone, I was wrapped in darkness and silence.

lines.content: かちかちかち……。
lines.translated: Tick, tick, tick...

lines.content: 幾つもの秒針がときを刻む音。
lines.translated: The sound of countless second hands marking the passage of time.

lines.content: すっかり聞き慣れているはずのものだ。
lines.translated: It was a sound I should have been completely used to hearing by now.

lines.content: しかしどうにも今夜は心地良いとは感じられなかった。
lines.translated: Yet tonight, I couldn't find any comfort in it at all.

lines.content: 俺は今、“ゆめのねどこ”の自室で深く目を閉じていた。
lines.translated: Right now, I had my eyes tightly shut in my room at the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 俺の左手の中にはたったひとつ、“魔法”が握りしめられている。
lines.translated: Clutched tightly within my left hand was a single piece of "magic."

lines.content: この俺の“願い”や“夢”を叶えるために。
lines.translated: Meant to grant my "wishes" and "dreams."

lines.content: そんな想いが形となった[・|そ][・|れ]だが……。
lines.translated: *It* was the crystallization of those feelings, and yet...

lines.content: その代償は、少しばかり大きなものだった。
lines.translated: The price for it had been a little too steep.

lines.content: ……数時間前のことだ。
lines.translated: It happened a few hours ago.

lines.content: ……どうして
どうして、こんなことになってしまったんだろう。
lines.translated: How did things end up like this?

lines.content: 俺は頭を抱えうなだれていた。
lines.translated: I hung my head, cradling it in my hands.

lines.content: ……“ゆめのねどこ”
lines.translated: The "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: その奥座敷。
lines.translated: In its inner tatami room.

lines.content: 俺。あさひさん。そして十夜。
lines.translated: Me. Asahi-san. And Toya.

lines.content: 三人で囲んだ座卓には、いつもの美味しい料理の代わりに、重苦しいばかりの空気が折り重なっていた。
lines.translated: On the low table the three of us sat around, instead of the usual delicious food, a suffocatingly heavy atmosphere lay piled up between us.

lines.content: ハルが死んだ
lines.translated: "Haru died."

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: 柊ハルが、死んでしまった
lines.translated: "Hiiragi Haru... is dead."

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 呻く、と言ったほうが正しいだろう声で絞り出す。
lines.translated: I squeezed the words out in a voice that was closer to a groan.

lines.content: ずきり。
lines.translated: Throb.

lines.content: 心が、命が、痛烈に軋んだ。
lines.translated: My heart, my very life, creaked in agonizing pain.

lines.content: ……自殺、でした
lines.translated: "...It was suicide."

lines.content: 死因は全身打撲に脊髄損傷。脳挫傷のおまけつきといった具合です
lines.translated: "The cause of death was full-body contusions and a severed spinal cord. With a cerebral contusion thrown in for good measure."

lines.content: その日、起こってしまったことをあさひさんに俺は語る。
lines.translated: I recounted to Asahi-san everything that had happened that day.

lines.content: ……昨日の夜はそんな様子なんていっさい、見せなかったのに
lines.translated: "...Even though she didn't show a single sign of it last night."

lines.content: 時計塔の管理室。その窓からの飛び降り。
lines.translated: The clock tower's maintenance room. Leaping from its window.

lines.content: 遺言は、
lines.translated: Her final words were,

lines.content: 『……ごめんなさい。私は、あなたを騙した』
lines.translated: "'...I'm sorry. I deceived you.'"

lines.content: という、言葉。
lines.translated: Those were the words.

lines.content: いや。遺言というのもまた違う。
lines.translated: No. Calling them final words isn't quite right either.

lines.content: それは死後から届いた言葉のひとつだ。
lines.translated: They were words that reached me after her death.

lines.content: ハルは、その魂は、連れ去られてしまったのだ――……いったい、どこに？
lines.translated: Haru--her soul--had been taken away... But where on earth to?

lines.content: きっと“夜”の中だ
lines.translated: "It has to be inside the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ハルを連れて行った[・|あ][・|れ]は、ハルとそっくりだった。
lines.translated: *That thing* that took Haru away looked just like her.

lines.content: たぶんあれは“夜の国”で形になったハルの“悪夢”だったんだ
lines.translated: "That was probably Haru's 'Nightmare,' given form in the 'Land of Night.'"

lines.content: どうして[・|そ][・|れ]が“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”に姿を現したのかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know why *it* manifested in the "Hours of the Sun"--the real world.

lines.content: しかし今はそうとしか想定できない。
