lines.translated: But right now, that's the only assumption I can make.

lines.content: ハルの命は、自身の“[心の痛み|悪夢]”に飲まれ、“夜”の中へと引きずり込まれた……。
lines.translated: Haru's life was swallowed up by her own "Nightmare"--her heartache--and dragged deep into the "Night"...

lines.content: でも、どこにもいなかった
lines.translated: "But she wasn't anywhere."

lines.content: ハルの命を追い、俺は“夜の国”を駆け回った。
lines.translated: Chasing after Haru's life, I had run all throughout the "Land of Night."

lines.content: 本当にハルを連れ去ったものが、ハル自身の“悪夢”だったのなら……。
lines.translated: If the thing that took Haru away really was her own "Nightmare"...

lines.content: ハルの形をしたあの漆黒を廃することで、ハルを取り戻せるのではないかと希望を抱いた――でも、だめだった。
lines.translated: I had clung to the hope that by destroying that pitch-black figure shaped like Haru, I might be able to take her back--but it was no use.

lines.content: ハルはどこにも見つかりませんでした
lines.translated: "I couldn't find Haru anywhere."

lines.content: “夜”の中を走り回り、まさに這々の体という具合で“ゆめのねどこ”へと帰宅した俺に、
lines.translated: After I ran all over the "Night" and returned to the "Bed of Dreams" completely exhausted and at my wits' end,

lines.content: それは、確かなのかな
lines.translated: "Are you sure about that?"

lines.content: あさひさんは俺の目を静かに見つめ、そう言ったのだった。
lines.translated: Asahi-san looked quietly into my eyes and asked me.

lines.content: ハルは自身の“悪夢”に“夜の国”へと連れ去られた。……それは確かなことなのかな
lines.translated: "Haru was taken away to the 'Land of Night' by her own 'Nightmare.' ...Are you sure that's what happened?"

lines.content: 念を押すようにそう問われた。
lines.translated: She pressed me to make sure.

lines.content: 俺はうなずく。間違いありません、と。
lines.translated: I nodded. There's no mistake, I told her.

lines.content: この目で見ました
lines.translated: "I saw it with my own eyes."

lines.content: ……こんなの、俺の知る限りただの一度もなかったことです。だからもう、どうしていいのか
lines.translated: "...As far as I know, something like this has never happened even once. So I just don't know what to do anymore..."

lines.content: どうしていいも、ない。
lines.translated: There's nothing I *can* do.

lines.content: ハルはもういないのだ――しかしそれを認められないこの俺は、まだ何か方法があるはずだと、みっともなくあさひさんにすがりついている。
lines.translated: Haru is already gone--yet unable to accept that, I'm pathetically clinging to Asahi-san, hoping there might still be some way.

lines.content: ……確かに、そうだな
lines.translated: "...Indeed, you're right."

lines.content: あさひさんはうなずく。
lines.translated: Asahi-san nodded.

lines.content: 大雅が目撃してしまったようなことは、これまでただの一度だって起きたことがない――“悪夢”が“夜の国”から外に出てくるだなんて
lines.translated: "What you witnessed, Taiga, has never happened a single time before--a 'Nightmare' coming out from the 'Land of Night'..."

lines.content: しかも[・|本][・|人][・|の][・|命]を“夜”の中に引きずり込もうだなんてことは、ただの一度も。
lines.translated: Not to mention trying to drag *that person's very life* into the "Night"--not even once.

lines.content: だけどそれは現実に起こったことで……実際に、ハルはもうどこにもいない
lines.translated: "But it actually happened... And in reality, Haru is nowhere to be found anymore."

lines.content: あさひさんは力なく首を振り、言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san shook her head weakly and spoke.

lines.content: 今、私たちの計り知れない[・|何][・|か]が起きてる。それは確かなことなんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "Right now, *something* beyond our comprehension is happening. I think that much is certain."

lines.content: ……十年前
lines.translated: "...Ten years ago."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 十年前だよ。私たちは人類の未来を脅かす最大の“悪夢”と戦った。決定済みの運命に“そんなものには従えない”と喧嘩を売ったんだ
lines.translated: "It was ten years ago. We fought against the greatest 'Nightmare' threatening humanity's future. We picked a fight with a predetermined fate, declaring that we refused to obey it."

lines.content: それは人類の未来を守ると言うことで。[・|予][・|言]された崩壊の未来を撃ち壊すということで……
lines.translated: "That meant protecting the future of humanity. It meant shattering the *prophesied* future of ruin..."

lines.content: 故に。[・|未][・|来][・|と][・|敵][・|対][・|し][・|た]私たちの身に、何が起きても不思議じゃなかったんだ
lines.translated: "Therefore. Having *made an enemy of the future*, it wouldn't be strange no matter what happened to us."

lines.content: ……どういうことですか？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: 私たちは“夜の王”を打倒して運命を書き換えた。たくさんの“魔法”と、たくさんの“希望”とを両手に抱えて
lines.translated: "We overthrew the 'King of the Night' and rewrote fate. Holding lots of 'Magic' and lots of 'Hope' in both hands."

lines.content: それはつまり時間そのものを穿ったということでもある。穿たれたその穴を埋めるため、時間が……未来が。いいや、この世界そのものが、敵対する私たちに牙をむく
lines.translated: "Which also means we pierced a hole through time itself. To fill that pierced hole, time... the future. No, this very world itself is baring its fangs at us for defying it."

lines.content: そういうことがあっても不思議じゃなかったんだよと言うあさひさん。
lines.translated: It wouldn't be strange at all for something like that to happen, Asahi-san said.

lines.content: これまでの十年間はあんまりにも平和だった。このまま何事もなく、ときは過ぎゆくものと信じていたけれど……
lines.translated: "The past ten years have been far too peaceful. I believed time would just keep passing by without incident like this, but..."

lines.content: でも、“夜の王”を倒してから十年間。その間に何も異常がなかったことこそ、もしかしたら異常だったのかもしれない
lines.translated: "In the ten years since we defeated the 'King of the Night,' the very fact that nothing abnormal happened might have been what was truly abnormal."

lines.content: 私たちの敵はあんまりにも強大だったことを忘れてしまっていた、とあさひさんは言う。
lines.translated: We had forgotten just how overwhelmingly powerful our enemy was, Asahi-san said.

lines.content: 私たちが戦うべき相手は“悪夢”なんかではない。この世界という名の運命だ。決して目に見えず触れられもしない存在だ――
lines.translated: "The opponent we must fight isn't 'Nightmares' or anything like that. It's fate, which goes by the name of this world. An existence that can never be seen or touched--"

lines.content: ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: だから何が起きても不思議じゃないんだ。[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と][・|も][・|起][・|こ][・|り][・|え][・|る]。それを、忘れてしまっていたんだ。いいや。暢気にも、間抜けにも、考えもしていなかった……
lines.translated: "That's why nothing that happens should be a surprise. *Even something like this can happen.* I had forgotten that. No. Carefree and foolish as I was, I hadn't even considered it..."

lines.content: 俺たちの戦うべき敵は[・|実][・|在][・|し][・|な][・|い]。
lines.translated: The enemy we have to fight *doesn't physically exist*.

lines.content: 正義のヒーローが仲間たちと力を合わせて打倒するわかりやすい“敵”など、この世界にはもとより存在しないのだ。
lines.translated: An easy-to-understand "enemy" that a hero of justice can join forces with their friends to defeat never existed in this world to begin with.
What we declared war on--*the opponent we made an enemy of, is this very world itself. So it's no wonder if anything happens.*

lines.content: 俺たちが世界に敵対した十年後の今。
lines.translated: Now, ten years after we defied the world.

lines.content: 世界はようやく俺たちに牙をむいた――のかも、しれなかった。
lines.translated: The world had finally bared its fangs at us--perhaps.

lines.content: 結果、ハルがいない。
lines.translated: As a result, Haru is gone.

lines.content: 死んでしまった。
lines.translated: She died.

lines.content: ……いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 殺された。
lines.translated: She was killed.
*She was killed by this world.*

lines.content: 俺たちがふっと気を緩める隙を淡々と狙う、意地の悪いこの世界そのものに。
lines.translated: By this malicious world itself, which had been coldly waiting for the moment we let our guard down.

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: いいや……。
lines.translated: No...

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……違うぞ
lines.translated: "...That's wrong."

lines.content: 俺は左手を見る。じっと、見る。
lines.translated: I looked at my left hand. I stared at it intently.

lines.content: ……何を、責任を転嫁しようとしてやがるんだ
lines.translated: "...Why the hell am I trying to shift the blame?"

lines.content: あさひさんが首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san tilted her head.

lines.content: どうした大雅。何が、違うんだ？
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Taiga? What do you mean, wrong?"

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ハルは、この世界に殺された……
lines.translated: "Haru was killed by this world..."

lines.content: ああ。そうとも言えるのかもしれないって話だよ。ごめんな大雅。私が、あんまりにも平和ボケしてしまっていたから……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm saying you could look at it that way. I'm sorry, Taiga. Because I let peace make me far too complacent..."

lines.content: いや。違う。違いますよあさひさん。
lines.translated: No. That's wrong. You're wrong, Asahi-san.

lines.content: 柊ハルは、この世界そのものに殺された……本当に？
lines.translated: "Hiiragi Haru was killed by this world itself... Really?"

lines.content: 俺は、手のひらを握りしめ、
lines.translated: I clenched my palm tightly,
"Is that *really* true?"

lines.content: あまりに浅はかだった自分に強く、俺はそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I strongly questioned myself, having been far too shallow.

lines.content: ハルを殺したのは俺だ。この世界なんかじゃない
lines.translated: "I'm the one who killed Haru. Not this world or anything like it."

lines.content: そうつぶやき、[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。
lines.translated: Muttering that, I opened my eyes.

lines.content: ……現在。
lines.translated: The present.

lines.content: 俺は、“ゆめのねどこ”に与えられた自室に引きこもっている。
lines.translated: I was cooped up in my own room given to me at the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 少し、ひとりで考える時間をくださいとあさひさんにはそう言って……。
lines.translated: Having told Asahi-san to please give me a little time to think by myself...

lines.content: ハルを殺してしまったのは俺だ。この俺の怠慢だ。
lines.translated: I'm the one who killed Haru. It was my own negligence.

lines.content: 自分の“役割”を忘れてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I had forgotten my own "role."

lines.content: 俺は何者だ。この手が担う“役割”を思い出せ。
lines.translated: Who am I? Remember the "role" this hand bears.

lines.content: 俺は、ハルの意図に“魔法”を使う正しさがあるのかどうか。それを判断する“役割”を与えられていたはずなのに
lines.translated: "I was supposed to have been given the 'role' of judging whether Haru's intentions for using 'Magic' were right or not."

lines.content: それなのに俺は、深く、考えることもせずに……
lines.translated: "And yet, without even thinking deeply about it, I..."

lines.content: 俺はハルの力を使ってしまった――[・|ハ][・|ル][・|の][・|こ][・|と][・|を][・|信][・|じ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|た]。そして安易に“許可”を与えてしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up using Haru's power--*I ended up trusting Haru.* And I carelessly gave her "permission."

lines.content: 騙された。
lines.translated: I was deceived.

lines.content: 信じていたのに。
lines.translated: Even though I trusted her.

lines.content: ハル。どうしてなんだ――……
lines.translated: Haru. Why--...

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: そんなふうにハルを責め立てるつもりはない。
lines.translated: I have no intention of blaming Haru like that.

lines.content: ただ……思うのは。思ってしまうのは。“こんなはずじゃなかった”という思い。ただそれだけだ。
lines.translated: It's just... what I think. What I can't help thinking, is the thought that "it wasn't supposed to be like this." That's all it is.

lines.content: （そうだ。こんなはずじゃなかったんだ）
lines.translated: (That's right. It wasn't supposed to be like this.)

lines.content: （もしも[・|あ][・|の][・|人]なら。憧れの[ヒーロー|あの人]なら。こんなひどいミスなど絶対にしないはずなのに……）
lines.translated: (If it were *that person*. If it were the hero I admired. She never would have made such a terrible mistake...)
*It wasn't supposed to be like this.*

lines.content: どうしてここにいるのがあの人ではなく俺なのだ。
lines.translated: Why am I the one here instead of her?

lines.content: そればかりが悔やまれる。
lines.translated: That's the only thing I regret.

lines.content: 俺は、頭を抱えてしまう。
lines.translated: I buried my head in my hands.

lines.content: もう少し俺に慎重さがあれば。
lines.translated: If only I had been a little more cautious.

lines.content: もう少し、俺に思慮深さがあれば。
lines.translated: If only I had been a little more thoughtful.

lines.content: もう少しだけ、自身を卑下するかのような言葉を選べば……。
lines.translated: Or to put it in slightly more self-deprecating terms...

lines.content: ハルが、俺なんかと再会しなければ
lines.translated: "If only Haru hadn't reunited with someone like me."

lines.content: 少女の形をした魔法……“魔法少女”
lines.translated: Magic in the form of a girl... a "Magical Girl."

lines.content: その力に“許可”を出すのが本来通り、あさひさんであったなら……。
lines.translated: If the one giving "permission" to that power had been Asahi-san, as it originally was...

lines.content: ハルは、死ぬこともなかったのに
lines.translated: "Then Haru wouldn't have had to die."

lines.content: それは、ちがう
lines.translated: "That's not true."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: きっぱりと断ずる声があり、振り向いた。
lines.translated: A voice flatly declared, and I turned around.

lines.content: ちがうよ。大雅。……きみはぜったい、悪くない
lines.translated: "That's not true, Taiga. ...You're definitely not to blame."

lines.content: 気づけばクロが側にいた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, Kuro was by my side.

lines.content: 寝床に座り込み、頭を抱えた俺の隣にいてくれる。
lines.translated: Sitting on the bed, staying right next to me as I held my head in my hands.

lines.content: クロ。いつの間に
lines.translated: "Kuro. When did you get here?"

lines.content: ひとりきりで閉じこもっていると思っていたのに……。
lines.translated: And here I thought I had locked myself away completely alone...

lines.content: ……気配を消すのは、得意。ねこだから
lines.translated: "...I'm good at erasing my presence. Because I'm a cat."

lines.content: 小首をかしげるような仕草でそう言った。
lines.translated: She said, tilting her head slightly.

lines.content: だから、大雅。いつもどこかから、きみのこと、見てたよ
lines.translated: "So, Taiga. I've always been watching over you from somewhere."

lines.content: ……そっか。いつも、か
lines.translated: "...I see. Always, huh?"

lines.content: ありがとう。気づかなかったとうなずき、少し微笑む。
lines.translated: Thank you. I nodded, saying I hadn't noticed, and smiled a little.

lines.content: 確かに全然気配を感じなかったよ。クロ、かくれんぼは苦手なのにね
lines.translated: "I really didn't sense your presence at all. Even though you're bad at hide-and-seek, Kuro."

lines.content: クロが俺の手をそっと握る。
lines.translated: Kuro gently took my hand.

lines.content: 左手だ。俺の“夜”の左手。
lines.translated: My left hand. My left hand of the "Night."

lines.content: ハルは、あの子自身のために“魔法”を使い、“夢”を叶えることを望んだ
lines.translated: "Haru wished to use 'Magic' for her own sake, to make her 'Dream' come true."

lines.content: ……そしてあの子は、望み通り、自分の“夢”を叶えたんだと思う
lines.translated: "...And I think she made her own 'Dream' come true, just as she wished."

lines.content: その結果が……
lines.translated: "And the result of that is..."

lines.content: そうだね。ハルがどんな“魔法”を願い、どんな“夢”を叶えたのかは、今となってはわからないけれど……
lines.translated: "That's right. Although now there's no way of knowing what kind of 'Magic' Haru wished for, or what kind of 'Dream' she made come true..."

lines.content: ハルが“最後の魔法”を使った結果が……[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]になるだなんて。誰も。ハル以外の誰にも、予想だってできないことだよ
lines.translated: "That the result of Haru using her 'Final Magic' would turn out *like this*... Nobody. Nobody other than Haru could have ever predicted that."

lines.content: だから自分を責めないでと、俺を見つめるクロの目がそう言ってくれているように、思えた。
lines.translated: So don't blame yourself--Kuro's eyes, gazing straight at me, seemed to be telling me just that.

lines.content: 大雅のせいじゃない
lines.translated: "It's not your fault, Taiga."

lines.content: 繰り返しそう言い、クロは[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Repeating those words, Kuro closed her eyes.

lines.content: ……わたしのせいだよ
lines.translated: "...It's my fault."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: わたしが悪い。大雅のせいじゃ、ない
lines.translated: "I'm the one to blame. Not you, Taiga."

lines.content: どうして……
どうしてそんなことを言うんだ。クロ。
lines.translated: Why are you saying something like that, Kuro?

lines.content: わたしは、頭がよくないから。おばかだから。考えることはいつも全部大雅にお任せで……
lines.translated: "Because I'm not very smart. Because I'm silly. I always leave all the thinking up to you, Taiga..."

lines.content: だけど、ハルたちの“魔法”をどんなふうに使うのか――もっとわたしも注意して、見つめて、考えて、大雅と相談できていれば、よかった
lines.translated: "Even so, when it came to how Haru and the others would use their 'Magic'--I wish I had paid more attention, watched more closely, thought it through, and talked it over with you, Taiga."

lines.content: だってわたしは、いつもそばできみのこと、見てたはずなのに……
lines.translated: "Because I was supposed to always be right by your side, watching over you..."

lines.content: それなのに。どうして。
lines.translated: And yet. Why?

lines.content: 肝心なときに、わたしはいつも何もできない。役に立てない――こんなわたしは、いったいどうして、大雅のそばにいたのかわからない
lines.translated: "When it really matters, I can never do anything. I'm completely useless--being like this, I don't even know why I was by your side in the first place, Taiga."

lines.content: クロは唇を噛みしめた。
lines.translated: Kuro bit her lip.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。大雅
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga."

lines.content: ……どうして
俺の心にはいっぱいの“どうして”で溢れている。クロ。どうして君が謝ることなんてあるんだろう。
lines.translated: My heart is overflowing with so many "whys." Kuro. Why on earth would you have anything to apologize for?

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ハルと笑顔になれてるきみをそばで見てたら、ちょっと……ちょっとね。何でだろう。[・|奥][・|の][・|ほ][・|う]が変な感じがしたの
lines.translated: "When I was by your side watching you smile with Haru, it felt a little... just a little, you know. I wonder why. *Deep down inside*, it felt strange."

lines.content: 胸元辺りをそっと触れ、クロは悲しそうな顔をする。
lines.translated: Gently touching her chest, Kuro made a sad face.

lines.content: ……わたし、なんだかおかしいんだよ。大雅
lines.translated: "...Something is wrong with me, Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅が誰かと笑顔になったら、わたしもきっとうれしいはずだと思ってた。その誰かと大雅が会えたなら、きっとわたしも幸せだって信じてた。それなのに……
lines.translated: "I thought that if you smiled with someone else, I would surely be happy too. I believed that if you were able to meet that someone, I would surely feel blessed as well. And yet..."

lines.content: それなのにわたしは苦しくて、大雅がハルに“許可”を出す瞬間、ふたりから目を逸らしてしまった――とクロは言う。
lines.translated: And yet it hurt so much that the moment you gave Haru "permission," I looked away from the two of you--so Kuro said.

lines.content: ……こんなわたし、大嫌い
lines.translated: "...I hate being like this."

lines.content: 大雅が笑顔になれてたのに、わたしは笑顔になれないんだろうって――どうしてこんなに嫌な子なんだって。わたし、泣きたくなった
lines.translated: "Even though you were able to smile, Taiga, I wondered why I couldn't smile too--why I had to be such an awful girl. It made me want to cry."

lines.content: だから昨日から、あんまり……大雅のそばにいられなかった。あの夜、大雅とハルがどんなふうにお話ししてたのかも、わたしは知らない
lines.translated: "That's why, since yesterday, I couldn't really... stay by your side, Taiga. I don't even know what kind of conversation you and Haru had that night."

lines.content: わたしが、いつもみたいにそばで大雅のことを見ていられれば――ハルに何かおかしなところがあれば、もしかしたら、わたしにでも気づけた何かがあったかもしれないのに……
lines.translated: "If I had just stayed by your side watching over you like I always do--if there was something off about Haru, maybe there was something even I could have noticed..."

lines.content: それなのにわたしはふたりから目を逸らしてしまったんだよ――繰り返しそう続けるクロの顔。悲しい。さみしい。そんな気持ちが一杯で、俺は何も言えなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: And yet I looked away from the two of you--Kuro's face as she kept repeating those words. Sad. Lonely. Filled to the brim with those feelings, I found myself unable to say anything at all.

lines.content: ……だから、わたしが悪いの
lines.translated: "...That's why I'm to blame."

lines.content: 大雅のせいじゃ……ううん。大雅[・|だ][・|け][・|の]せいじゃない
lines.translated: "It's not your fault, Taiga... No. It's not *only* your fault, Taiga."

lines.content: クロは俺が納得しやすいだろう言葉を選んだ。そして、続けてこう言った。
lines.translated: Kuro chose words that would be easier for me to accept. And then, she continued.

lines.content: ……だから、お願い。大雅、聞いてほしい
lines.translated: "...So please. Taiga, I want you to listen to me."

lines.content: 俺の左手に触れた手に、クロはほんの少しだけ力を込めた。
lines.translated: Kuro put just a little bit of strength into the hand touching my left hand.

lines.content: “希望”はまだある。ふたりで、“夢”を語ろう
lines.translated: "There is still 'Hope.' Let's talk about our 'Dream' together."

lines.content: 俺は……。
大雅。今こそきみの“魔法”を使うときだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. Now is the time to use your 'Magic.'"

lines.content: 頭を抱えていた情けないこの俺は、ゆっくりと顔を上げた。
lines.translated: Pathetic as I was, holding my head in my hands, I slowly raised my face.

lines.content: ……大雅は、女の子たちの“魔法”に“許可”を出す
lines.translated: "...Taiga, you give 'permission' to the girls' 'Magic.'"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……そして、そんな大雅の“魔法”に“許可”を出すのが、わたしの役目
lines.translated: "...And giving 'permission' to your 'Magic', Taiga, is my role."

lines.content: 覚えてる？　とクロは言う。
lines.translated: Do you remember? Kuro asked.

lines.content: もちろんだよと、俺は答える。
lines.translated: Of course I do, I answered.

lines.content: すると安心したように、そしてとてもうれしそうに、クロは微笑んでくれる。
lines.translated: At that, looking relieved and very happy, Kuro smiled at me.

lines.content: 小さなころの大雅の“夢”は、どうしたって叶えられるものじゃなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "Your 'Dream' when you were little was something that could never be granted no matter what, though..."

lines.content: ――“お願い。できるだけ苦しんで死にたい。最低最悪の最期がほしい”
lines.translated: --"Please. I want to suffer as much as possible and die. I want the absolute worst ending."

lines.content: そんな“夢”を叶えるための“魔法”だなんて、“想像”だって、してほしくなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "I didn't want you to even 'Imagine' a 'Magic' meant to grant a 'Dream' like that, though..."

lines.content: 大雅。今ならきっと大丈夫
lines.translated: "Taiga. Now, I'm sure it'll be okay."

lines.content: そうだよね？　とクロは俺を見つめる。
lines.translated: Right? Kuro gazed at me.

lines.content: 自分の命を殺すためじゃない。大切な人の命を救う……。そのために“魔法”を“想像”してくれるよね……？
lines.translated: "Not to kill your own life. To save the life of someone precious to you... You'll 'Imagine' a 'Magic' for that sake, won't you...?"

lines.content: ……幼い頃。
lines.translated: When I was little.

lines.content: 俺とクロは、殆ど毎晩のように俺の“魔法”について話し合ってきた。
lines.translated: Kuro and I used to talk about my "Magic" almost every single night.

lines.content: 寝る前の短い時間、いつもクロがやさしい言葉をくれるから……。
lines.translated: Because in that brief time before going to sleep, Kuro would always give me kind words...

lines.content: あさひさんが暖かな料理で、捻くれた俺の心を解きほぐしてくれたから……。
lines.translated: Because Asahi-san unraveled my twisted heart with her warm cooking...

lines.content: いつしか俺は“夢”を失ったのだ。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had lost my "Dream."

lines.content: だから、新しい俺の“夢”はなんなのか。
lines.translated: So, what was my new "Dream"?

lines.content: それを叶えるための“魔法”はどんなものだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of "Magic" would it take to make it come true?

lines.content: 眠る前にクロとそれを話し合うのが、思えば俺は楽しみだった――いつからかあまりそれを語り合うような頻度も、次第次第に少なくなってしまっていたけれど。
lines.translated: Thinking back, I used to look forward to talking about that with Kuro before going to sleep--even though at some point, the frequency of those talks had gradually dwindled away.

lines.content: ……でも、それは大雅が大人になりはじめてる証拠なんだって思って、安心だった
lines.translated: "...Still, I thought that was proof you were starting to grow up, Taiga, so I was relieved."

lines.content: 自分の“夢”は自分の力で叶えられる――“魔法”なんかに頼ることなく。そんな大人に大雅はなり始めてるんだって
lines.translated: "You can make your own 'Dream' come true with your own power--without relying on something like 'Magic.' I thought you were starting to become that kind of adult, Taiga."

lines.content: だから、大雅が“魔法”をこのまま忘れてしまってもいいんだって思ってた。そのまま[・|全][・|部]を忘れてしまっても……
lines.translated: "So I thought it would be fine if you just forgot about 'Magic' altogether. Even if you ended up forgetting *everything*..."

lines.content: ……でも、今の大雅には“魔法”が必要。[・|こ][・|の][・|問][・|題]を打ち破るのは、いくら大人になれたからって、不可能だ
lines.translated: "...Even so, the current you needs 'Magic,' Taiga. Breaking through *this problem* is impossible, no matter how much of an adult you've become."
"Taiga. *Let's save Haru together*. Let's carry that girl's life into the future."

lines.content: きみの“魔法”は、きみの祈りは、それを可能にできるだけの力をたしかに持ってる……はずだから
lines.translated: "Because your 'Magic,' your prayer, certainly holds enough power to make that possible... or at least, it should."

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|こ]は“ゆめのねどこ”だ。
lines.translated: *This place* is the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 正確に言えば“夜の国”ではない。故に“魔法”は使えない。
lines.translated: Strictly speaking, it is not the "Country of Night." Therefore, "Magic" cannot be used.

lines.content: しかし俺の左手はここがどこであろうと、“魔法”を“夜”の中から引き出せる。
lines.translated: However, no matter where this place is, my left hand can draw "Magic" out from within the "Night."

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。クロと手を繋いだまま。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids. Still holding hands with Kuro.

lines.content: そして考える――“想像”する。
lines.translated: And I think--I "Imagine."

lines.content: 今、ここにどのような“魔法”があればいいと俺は願うのだろう。どんな“魔法”であれば、ハルを取り戻すことを叶えられるのだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of "Magic" do I wish were here right now? What kind of "Magic" could possibly make taking Haru back come true?

lines.content: ――“もしも人生をやり直せるなら”
lines.translated: --"If I could redo my life..."

lines.content: そんな声を思い出す。
lines.translated: I remember that voice.

lines.content: ――“私は何度だって同じことをする”
lines.translated: --"I would do the same thing over and over again."

lines.content: そんなハルの言葉を、思い出すのだ。
lines.translated: I remember those words of Haru's.

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開いた俺に、クロが首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: When I opened my eyelids, Kuro was tilting her head at me.

lines.content: ……クロ。だめだ
lines.translated: "...Kuro. It's no good."

lines.content: 俺は首を振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: 俺には“想像”できない――どんな“魔法”が今ここにあれば、ハルのことを救い出せるのか。俺にそれを思い描くのは難しすぎる
lines.translated: "I can't 'Imagine' it--what kind of 'Magic' being here right now would allow me to rescue Haru. Picturing that is far too difficult for me."

lines.content: 俺が自身の“魔法”を今日まで形にできなかったのは、もちろん幼い頃の“夢”があんまりにもあんまりなものだったため、クロが許可をくれなかったということもあるけれど……。
lines.translated: The reason I haven't been able to give form to my own "Magic" until today is, of course, partly because my childhood "Dream" was far too awful, so Kuro wouldn't give me permission...

lines.content: 俺は、みんなとは違う。“魔法”として形にできるほど“想像力”が足りていないんだ
lines.translated: "I'm different from everyone else. I lack the 'Imagination' needed to give it form as 'Magic.'"

lines.content: だから今日まで俺は、自身の“魔法”がどういったものであってほしいのかと考えることを先送りにしてきていたのだ。
lines.translated: That's why, up until today, I had been putting off thinking about what I wanted my own "Magic" to be like.

lines.content: ……ハルの命を助けるには、どんな奇跡があればいい。それをただ言葉にするのは簡単だ――“何でも良いからハルを蘇らせてほしい”。それだけだ。それ以上はない
lines.translated: "...What kind of miracle do we need to save Haru's life? Putting it into mere words is easy--'I don't care how, just bring Haru back to life.' That's all. There's nothing more than that."

lines.content: しかしそれだけではだめなのだ――思い描けるすべてが叶う“夜の国”
lines.translated: However, that alone is no good--in the "Country of Night," where everything one can picture comes true.

lines.content: 言葉ではなく、明確に“想像”できなければだめなのだ。
lines.translated: Not just words; it's no good unless you can clearly "Imagine" it.

lines.content: そうでなければ“[想像|想い]”は“魔法”にならない――なっては、くれない。
lines.translated: Otherwise, "Imagination" will not become "Magic"--it refuses to become it.

lines.content: “想像”するってことは“魔法”の設計図を書くってことでもあるんだ
lines.translated: "To 'Imagine' also means to draw up the blueprint for 'Magic.'"

lines.content: 俺は[・|そ][・|れ]があまりにも不得意だから……
lines.translated: "Because I am just far too terrible at *that*..."

lines.content: そんな俺がヒーローになりたいとか言っては聞かず――結果、あず咲先輩を失ってしまったし、
lines.translated: Someone like me insisted on wanting to become a hero--and as a result, I lost Azusaki-senpai,

lines.content: 十年前の戦いでも、みんなの足を引っ張り続けていたんだ
lines.translated: "And in the battle ten years ago, I kept holding everyone back."

lines.content: それはきっと、持って産まれてしまったもの――“才能”と呼ばれるものについての話になるはずだ。
lines.translated: That surely comes down to something you're born with--a matter of what is called "talent."

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅は、“想像力”という“才能”を持って産まれてこれなかった。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, was not born with the "talent" known as "Imagination."

lines.content: そんな俺が、十年経ったところで“想像”を上手くこなせるはずがなく……。
lines.translated: There was no way someone like me could suddenly pull off "Imagining" well just because ten years had passed...

lines.content: ……大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm okay."

lines.content: それでもクロは“平気だよ”と深く、そして力強くうなずいてくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, Kuro nodded deeply and powerfully, saying, "It'll be fine."

lines.content: ……ひとりでできないことなら、ふたりでしよう。きっと大丈夫だよ
lines.translated: "...If it's something you can't do alone, let's do it together. I'm sure it'll be okay."

lines.content: ぎゅっと握られる手。
lines.translated: A hand squeezing mine tightly.

lines.content: わたしも、大雅と同じ。“夢”とか“希望”とか。“想像”することは苦手だけれど……。ううん。“想像力”は、人間だけの特別な“魔法”、なんだよね
lines.translated: "I'm the same as you, Taiga. Things like 'Dreams' and 'Hopes.' I'm bad at 'Imagining' them, though... No. 'Imagination' is a special 'Magic' that belongs only to humans, isn't it?"

lines.content: だから、いつまでも子猫なわたしひとりだと、絶対に、無理だけど……
lines.translated: "So for me, forever a kitten, doing it alone is绝对 impossible, though..."

lines.content: 繋いだ手と手に、更に強い力を感じた。
lines.translated: I felt an even stronger force in our joined hands.

lines.content: きっと、大丈夫。信じてる――大雅とわたし、ふたりでならできる。絶対
lines.translated: "I'm sure it'll be okay. I believe in it--if it's you and me together, Taiga, we can do it. Definitely."

lines.content: だから大雅、もう一度試してみてとクロは言う。
lines.translated: So Taiga, try it one more time, Kuro said.

lines.content: ……わたしも大雅と同時に“想像”するよ
lines.translated: "...I'll 'Imagine' at the same time as you, Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅の大切な人……。ハルを助けられる“魔法”
lines.translated: Your precious person, Taiga... A "Magic" that can save Haru.

lines.content: こうしてしっかり繋いだ手と手で、気持ちもきっと繋がってくれるはず――わたし達なら、ふたりでひとり分になれるはずだよ
lines.translated: "With our hands joined this tightly, our feelings will surely connect too--if it's the two of us, we should be able to equal one whole person together."

lines.content: わかったと言う代わりに深くうなずき返し、俺は再び[まぶた|瞼]を閉じ――祈るように“想像”した。
lines.translated: Instead of saying I understood, I nodded back deeply, closed my eyelids once again--and "Imagined" as if praying.

lines.content: そうだ。ただ、祈るのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. I just have to pray.

lines.content: クロと今日まで過ごした時間を思う。
lines.translated: I think of the time I've spent with Kuro up until today.

lines.content: こんなにも、あんなにも、俺たちは寄り添い合って生きてきた。その時間を、信じたい。
lines.translated: We have lived side by side through so much, leaning on each other all this way. I want to believe in that time we shared.

lines.content: そう思った。
lines.translated: That's what I thought to myself.

lines.content: そう思えたから……。
lines.translated: Because I was able to think that way...

lines.content: 繋いだ“夜”の左手で、クロの胸に秘められた想いや祈りの形を感じ取り――
lines.translated: With my joined left hand of "Night," I sensed the shape of the feelings and prayers hidden within Kuro's chest--

lines.content: それらをしっかりとこの手のひらが握りしめられたなら――
lines.translated: And if this palm of mine could grasp them tightly--

lines.content: 俺とクロの“想像力”を、混ぜ合わせるようなイメージで――
lines.translated: With an image like blending my and Kuro's "Imagination" together--

lines.content: 大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: できると感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that I could do it.

lines.content: ありがとう、クロ。
lines.translated: Thank you, Kuro.

lines.content: ふたりで……。
lines.translated: Together...

lines.content: 君とふたりで、“奇跡”をここへ、現実を[・|撃][・|ち][・|破][・|る]ための“魔法”を、この手のひらの中へと、引き上げるのだ。
lines.translated: Together with you, I will pull a "Miracle" here--the "Magic" to *shatter* reality--right into the palm of my hand.

lines.content: ……結果。
lines.translated: As a result.

lines.content: 閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の向こうから、まばゆい光りを感じた。
lines.translated: From beyond my closed eyelids, I sensed a dazzling light.

lines.content: う、ううっ
lines.translated: "U-Ugh!"

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開いた先に、かわいい姿のクロが立っていた。
lines.translated: When I opened my eyelids, Kuro was standing before me in an adorable outfit.

lines.content: 恥ずかしそうにうつむき。
lines.translated: She looked down bashfully.

lines.content: 強く量の[まぶた|瞼]を閉じており。
lines.translated: Keeping both of her eyelids tightly shut.

lines.content: スカートの裾をぎゅっと握りしめている。
lines.translated: She was clutching the hem of her skirt tightly.

lines.content: それは、学園の制服だった。
lines.translated: It was our school uniform.

lines.content: ……どうして、こんな
lines.translated: "...Why is it like this?"

lines.content: と、クロは言う。苦しげに。
lines.translated: Kuro said, sounding pained.

lines.content: ご、ごめん。“夜”の“魔法”を使うときは、こういうふうになるよう、この左手の“役割”にあず咲さんが設定してしまってるままで……
lines.translated: "S-Sorry. Azusaki-san left the 'Role' of this left hand set so that things turn out this way whenever I use the 'Magic' of 'Night'..."

lines.content: ……わ、わたしは別に、ハルたちみたいな“魔法少女”じゃないのに
lines.translated: "...I-I'm not a 'Magical Girl' like Haru and the others, though."

lines.content: もっと言えば人間でさえ、ないのに……。
lines.translated: To put it even more plainly, I'm not even human...

lines.content: それなのにどうして、こんな……こんな、格好
lines.translated: "Even so, why am I in an... an outfit like this?"

lines.content: おかしいよとクロは言う。
lines.translated: It's strange, Kuro said.

lines.content: そう、だよね。変身するのは“魔法少女『使い』”の“魔法”だけなのに。それなのにどうしてクロまで
lines.translated: "Yeah, you're right. Only the 'Magic' of a 'Magical Girl "User"' is supposed to transform. So why did even you, Kuro..."

lines.content: 俺自身も驚きだけれど――俺とクロは互いの小さな“想像力”を合わせようとした。
lines.translated: I was surprised myself--but Kuro and I had tried to combine our small "Imaginations."

lines.content: だからクロも俺の“魔法”なのだと、この左手の“役割”はそう判断したのかもしれない。
lines.translated: So perhaps the "Role" of this left hand judged that Kuro was also my "Magic."

lines.content: そのように想定はできうるけれど……。
lines.translated: I could make that assumption, at least...

lines.content: クロは[・|そ][・|れ]以外にも不満げだった。
lines.translated: However, Kuro seemed dissatisfied with something other than *that*.

lines.content: ……どうして。変身するのはふりふりで、ふわふわで、そんな衣装じゃないの？
lines.translated: "...Why? Isn't a transformation outfit supposed to be all frilly and fluffy?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。えっと……。たぶんだけど
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Um... It's just a guess, though."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……この制服、クロに絶対似合うだろうなあって、実はいつも思ってたんだ
lines.translated: "...To tell the truth, I've always thought that this uniform would definitely look great on you, Kuro."

lines.content: いつかクロもこの制服を着て、俺たちみんなと学園生活送れれば良いなあって
lines.translated: "That it would be nice if someday you could wear this uniform too, Kuro, and spend school life together with all of us."

lines.content: そんなことを常日頃から“夢”見ていたのだ。
lines.translated: I had been "Dreaming" of something like that on a daily basis.

lines.content: そんな“想像”……というか妄想を、つい、クロと一緒に“魔法”を思い描く中に、滑り込ませてしまってた……のかも、しれない
lines.translated: "Maybe I accidentally let that kind of 'Imagination'... or rather, delusion, slip in while I was picturing the 'Magic' together with you..."

lines.content: クロは、目を少しだけ伏せた。
lines.translated: Kuro lowered her eyes just a little.

lines.content: そして唇を尖らせ、ぺたぺたと、自身の身体を包んだ制服に触れる。
lines.translated: Then, pouting her lips, she lightly patted the uniform wrapping her body.

lines.content: スカートを引っ張ったり、お腹がぽかぽかするとつぶやいてみたりして、
lines.translated: Tugging at the skirt and murmuring about how her stomach felt nice and warm,

lines.content: ……にあう？
lines.translated: "...Does it suit me?"

lines.content: と、上目遣いで――俺の顔を伺うみたいにして、言った。
lines.translated: she asked, looking up at me--as if trying to read my face.

lines.content: ……ああ。とっても
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Very much."

lines.content: ……なら、いいけど
lines.translated: "...Well, if you say so."

lines.content: ふいっと視線を外した。
lines.translated: She abruptly averted her gaze.

lines.content: そんなクロの横顔を見つめながら――思う。
lines.translated: Gazing at Kuro's profile like that--I thought to myself.

lines.content: ごめん。クロ。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Kuro.

lines.content: その姿を望んだのは半分は意図的だった。
lines.translated: Wishing for her to take that form was half-intentional.

lines.content: こんなときだからこそ少しでいい。笑顔がほしかったのだ……。
lines.translated: Precisely because it was a time like this, even just a little would do. I wanted a smile...

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: こんなときだからこそ、必要以上に暗く沈み込んだかのような雰囲気をまずは払拭したかった。
lines.translated: Precisely because it was a time like this, I wanted to first dispel the atmosphere that felt more darkly depressed than necessary.

lines.content: あくまでもだ。俺たちが手と手を取り合い立ち向かった時間の先には、あくまでも明るく、うれしい――
lines.translated: To the very end. Beyond the time where we joined hands and faced this together, I wanted something bright and happy to the very end--

lines.content: できることなら、笑顔で幸福だと言ってのけられる結果こそがそこにあってほしい。
lines.translated: If possible, I wanted an outcome right there where we could smile and declare that we were happy.
*From here on out, I am all alone. I can't rely on anyone.*

lines.content: だからこそ、せめてスタート地点であるこの場所は、できうる限り明るいもので飾りたい――いつも夢見てばかりいた、君のこんなかわいい姿で。
lines.translated: That was why, at the very least, I wanted to decorate this place, my starting line, with something as bright as possible--with this adorable figure of yours that I had always been dreaming of.

lines.content: さあ、“魔法”を使おう。
lines.translated: Now, let's use "Magic."

lines.content: 代償は[・|こ][・|れ]に決めた。
lines.translated: I have decided on *this* as the price.

lines.content: ぱちり。
lines.translated: Click.

lines.content: “魔法”の安全装置が外れる音がする。
lines.translated: The sound of the "Magic's" safety device coming off rang out.

lines.content: これは君と一緒に思い描いた――ハルを助けるための“希望”の形。
lines.translated: This was the shape of "Hope" to save Haru--pictured together with you.

lines.content: どこまでも身勝手なこの俺は、そう思っていたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Utterly selfish as I am, that was what I had been thinking, however...

lines.content: ……クロの横顔が、みるみる青くなっていくのに、気づいた。
lines.translated: I noticed Kuro's profile rapidly turning pale.

lines.content: どうしたんだと問いかけるよりも早く、
lines.translated: Before I could even ask what was wrong,

lines.content: ……無理だ
lines.translated: "...It's impossible."

lines.content: ぽつりと、クロが一言そうこぼした。
lines.translated: Kuro let a single murmur spill out.

lines.content: 無理だよ。大雅
lines.translated: "It's impossible, Taiga."

lines.content: ……わたしには、できない
lines.translated: "...I can't do this."

lines.content: 繋いだ手が震えているのにも、気づく。
lines.translated: I also noticed that our joined hands were trembling.

lines.content: どうして……こんなこと
lines.translated: "Why... something like this..."

lines.content: こんな、こんな“魔法”の形だなんて。ひどい
lines.translated: "For the 'Magic' to take a shape like this... It's awful."

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: ……ごめん。大雅。やっぱりわたしは嘘つきだ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. I really am a liar after all."

lines.content: クロは言った。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: 歯を食いしばり。涙さえ、滲ませて。
lines.translated: Clenching her teeth. With tears even welling up in her eyes.

lines.content: ……わたしは、きみの“魔法”に“許可”を出すことは――ごめんなさい。絶対に、できない
lines.translated: "...Giving 'Permission' to your 'Magic' is--I'm sorry. I definitely can't do it."

lines.content: ひとりだ。今度こそひとりきり。
lines.translated: I'm alone. This time, I'm truly all alone.

lines.content: クロが部屋から出て行ってしまった後、どれくらいの時間が過ぎただろうか。
lines.translated: How much time had passed since Kuro ran out of the room?

lines.content: 俺は未だ[・|こ][・|の]“[・|魔][・|法]”を使う勇気がない。
lines.translated: I still lacked the courage to use *this* *"Magic."*

lines.content: 『……ちがう。わたしはこんな“魔法”だなんて、望んでいない』
lines.translated: "'...No. I don't wish for a "Magic" like this.'"

lines.content: 泣き崩れてしまったクロの声だけが、たくさんの秒針の音に混じり、俺の耳には響き続けていた。
lines.translated: Only the voice of Kuro, who had broken down crying, continued to echo in my ears, mingling with the ticking of countless second hands.

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 確かに、そうだよな。[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|も][・|の]。クロが“想像”できるはずもない
lines.translated: "That's certainly true, isn't it? *Something like this.* There's no way Kuro could have 'Imagined' it."

lines.content: 左手には“魔法”が握られている。
lines.translated: In my left hand, the "Magic" was grasped tightly.

lines.content: クロと一緒に思い描いた“魔法”
lines.translated: The "Magic" I pictured together with Kuro.

lines.content: 俺の願いを叶えるために必要な“魔法”のはずだ。
lines.translated: It should be the "Magic" necessary to grant my wish.

lines.content: 自分ひとりの“想像力”だけでは足りないからと、手を繋いだ君の心の力を借り――[・|俺][・|ひ][・|と][・|り][・|が][・|組][・|み][・|上][・|げ][・|た]“魔法”の形だ。
lines.translated: Thinking my own "Imagination" alone wasn't enough, I borrowed the power of your heart as we held hands--it was the form of "Magic" *that I built up all by myself*.

lines.content: 使用するだけならばもはやクロの“許可”さえも不要だ。
lines.translated: If it's just to use it, I no longer even need Kuro's "Permission."

lines.content: 俺の“魔法”に“許可”を出す。そのための権限を持ったクロの心を利用して、俺が勝手に作り上げた[・|も][・|の]。
lines.translated: Giving "Permission" to my "Magic." It was *something* I selfishly created by taking advantage of Kuro's heart, which held the authority to do just that.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: どうした。
lines.translated: What's wrong?

lines.content: どうしたんだよ俺。
lines.translated: What the hell is wrong with me?

lines.content: さっきからなぜ座り込んだまま何もしない。なぜ、“魔法”を使わない。
lines.translated: Why have I been sitting here doing nothing for a while now? Why don't I use the "Magic"?

lines.content: クロをあんなふうに泣かせてまで手に入れた“魔法”じゃないか。
lines.translated: Isn't this the "Magic" I obtained even at the cost of making Kuro cry like that?

lines.content: それなのにどうして……。
lines.translated: And yet, why...?

lines.content: 延々と。
lines.translated: Endlessly.

lines.content: 鬱々と。
lines.translated: Gloomy and brooding.

lines.content: 考えを巡らせてみせるばっかりで……。
lines.translated: Doing nothing but letting my thoughts run in circles...

lines.content: ……いや
もはや考えることさえしていない。真っ白だ。心の中も、頭の中も、まるで空白――何も考えられなかった。
lines.translated: I wasn't even thinking anymore. It was pure white. Inside my heart, inside my head, it was completely blank--I couldn't think of anything at all.
*Why am I unable to muster the courage just to put a tiny bit of strength into this fingertip?*

lines.content: ……覚悟を、決めろ
lines.translated: "...Make up your mind."

lines.content: ……俺は“魔法”をこめかみに突きつけた。
lines.translated: I pressed the "Magic" against my temple.

lines.content: ……これしかない
lines.translated: "...This is the only way."

lines.content: もうこれしかないんだ。俺に残された“希望”はこれひとつしか……。
lines.translated: There's no other way left. This is the one and only "Hope" left to me...

lines.content: 唇を、噛みしめた。
lines.translated: I bit down on my lip.

lines.content: この“魔法”でしか[・|今]を変えることは……ハルの命を救うことは、できない
lines.translated: "Only with this 'Magic' can I change the *present*... can I save Haru's life."
Therefore. *I have no choice but to do this*--I'm sorry, Kuro.

lines.content: ハルがどうしてだか俺に嘘をつき、未だ不明なハル自身の[・|本][・|当][・|の]“[・|夢]”を叶えるために利用したと、いうのなら。
lines.translated: If Haru lied to me for some reason and used me to grant her own *true "Dream,"* which remains unknown to me even now.

lines.content: この俺は、クロのことを利用した。
lines.translated: Then I used Kuro.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]は人の命を蘇らせるため“奇跡”なのだ――あさひさんに選ばれた少女たちならいざ知らず、この俺にそれほどの力を形にできるはずがない。
lines.translated: *This* is a "Miracle" to revive a human life--setting aside the girls chosen by Asahi-san, there was no way someone like me could give form to such immense power.

lines.content: だから君の力を利用した。
lines.translated: That's why I used your power.

lines.content: ひとりでできないことなら、ふたり一緒に……。君が、そう言ってくれたから。そういう“関係”でいたいと、願ってくれたから。
lines.translated: If it's something we can't do alone, then the two of us together... Because you said that to me. Because you wished for us to have that kind of "Relationship."

lines.content: だから、決して君が“許可”できないだろう“魔法”を、君と俺と、ふたりの力で作り上げたのだ。
lines.translated: That's why, with the power of the two of us--yours and mine--I created a "Magic" that you would never be able to "Permit."

lines.content: ごめん、クロ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Kuro."

lines.content: 君には謝らなきゃならないことが一杯だけど――本当に、ごめんな。もう俺にはこの道しか、ないんだ。この道しか考える力が、ないんだよ
lines.translated: "There are so many things I have to apologize to you for, but--I'm truly sorry. This is the only path left for me now. I only have the strength to think of this path."

lines.content: どんなに誰かを泣かせてしまおうと。
lines.translated: No matter how much I make someone cry.

lines.content: どんなに、地獄の底を這いずる結果に至ろうとも。
lines.translated: No matter how much it leads to me crawling at the bottom of hell.

lines.content: それでも取り戻したいと願うんだ――……ハル。柊ハル。
lines.translated: Even so, I wish to take her back--...Haru. Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 俺は、あの子が好きだ。
lines.translated: I love that girl.

lines.content: あの子の笑顔をもう一度、取り戻したい――そのためには、この“魔法”がこれ以上なくベストなのだと、俺は、信じる。
lines.translated: I want to take back her smile one more time--and for that sake, I believe this "Magic" is the absolute best way.

lines.content: ひとり、言い訳のようにつぶやいて、
lines.translated: Muttering to myself as if making an excuse,

lines.content: ……ふぅ
lines.translated: "...Phew."

lines.content: 深呼吸。
lines.translated: A deep breath.

lines.content: これから行うことは誰にも見せてはならない。
lines.translated: What I am about to do must not be seen by anyone.

lines.content: いや。[・|後][・|始][・|末]を願わなければならないのなら、その配慮ももはや意味もなしという具合だが……。
lines.translated: No. If I have to wish for someone to *clean up the mess*, then that consideration is already meaningless anyway, though...

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を、閉じる。
lines.translated: I close my eyelids.

lines.content: もういい。
lines.translated: That's enough.

lines.content: 充分考えた。
lines.translated: I've thought about it plenty.

lines.content: 覚悟を決めろ。
lines.translated: Steel yourself.

lines.content: 祈れ。
lines.translated: Pray.

lines.content: 誰のためにとも言えない祈りを、捧げ、終わったならば――……はじめよう。
lines.translated: Once I have offered a prayer--one I can't even say who it's for--and finished... let's begin.

lines.content: “奇跡”を願い――
lines.translated: Wishing for a "Miracle"--

lines.content: “希望”を信じ――
lines.translated: Believing in "Hope"--

lines.content: “魔法”は目覚め――
lines.translated: The "Magic" awakens--

lines.content: 君と[・|ぼ][・|く]とで作り上げた“最後の魔法”で……さあ、行くぞ。
lines.translated: With the "Last Magic" created by you and *me*... Here I go.

lines.content: 大切な人を取り戻すそのために。
lines.translated: In order to take back the person precious to me.

lines.content: 俺は――
――俺は何度だって、散りゆく。
lines.translated: --I will scatter and fall, no matter how many times it takes.

lines.content: 指先に力を込めた。
lines.translated: I put strength into my fingertip.

lines.content: 雷鳴のような鋭い音がすべてを切り裂き――
lines.translated: A sharp sound like a clap of thunder tore through everything--

lines.content: この世界という名の“悪夢”を撃ち抜くための“[魔法|弾丸]”が、俺の命を、撃ち抜いた。
lines.translated: And the "Bullet"--the "Magic" meant to shoot through this "Nightmare" called the world--shot through my life.

lines.content: 次に目を覚ますと列車の中にいた。
lines.translated: When I next woke up, I was inside a train.

lines.content: 手のひらには“魔法”が握られたまま……。
lines.translated: The "Magic" was still grasped in my palm...

lines.content: 隣には、小さな“夜の神さま”が座っていた――神さまは『大雅。あなたはとんでもない“魔法”を“想像”してしまったんだね』と言い、小さな頭を力なく振っていた。
lines.translated: Sitting next to me was the little "God of the Night"--the God said, "Taiga. You've 'Imagined' an outrageous 'Magic,' haven't you?" and weakly shook her small head.

lines.content: ……その“[魔法|拳銃]”は、[対象|撃ち抜いたもの]の“今”を殺すことができるものだ
lines.translated: "...That 'Handgun'--that 'Magic'--is something capable of killing the 'Present' of whatever it shoots through."

lines.content: 小さな“夜の神さま”が――ナナちゃんが、“魔法”の想像主である俺に、その“魔法”の効果を改めるようにして、語る。
lines.translated: The little "God of the Night"--Nana-chan--spoke to me, the creator of the "Magic," as if to review its effects.

lines.content: あなたは[・|そ][・|れ]がいったいどういうものかわかってるのかと問いただすみたいに、だ。
lines.translated: It was as though she were questioning me, asking if I truly understood just what *that* was.

lines.content: ……どうしてナナちゃんが、たった今“想像”したばかりの俺の“魔法”……その効果をわかってるのかな
lines.translated: "...Why do you know the effects of my 'Magic'... the one I only just 'Imagined' right now, Nana-chan?"

lines.content: 私を誰だと思ってるのかな。“夜の神さま”だよ――“夜”に関することならある程度は、わかってしまうんだよ
lines.translated: "Who do you think I am? I'm the 'God of the Night'--if it's something related to the 'Night,' I can understand it to a certain extent."

lines.content: おかしいな。ナナちゃん、いつもは神さまって呼ばないでって言ってるのに
lines.translated: "That's strange. You always tell me not to call you a god, Nana-chan."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: A wry smile surfaced on his face.

lines.content: そして俺は左手に収まっている“魔法”の形を見つめていた。
lines.translated: And then, I stared at the form of the "Magic" resting in my left hand.

lines.content: ……総弾数六発の回転式拳銃。
lines.translated: A six-shot rotary handgun.

lines.content: いわゆる“リボルバー”と呼ばれるものだ。
lines.translated: What is commonly called a "revolver."

lines.content: たった今、装填されていた六発のうち一発を消費したばかりの銃口は、未だ若干熱を帯びている。
lines.translated: Having just expended one of the six loaded rounds a moment ago, the muzzle still retained a slight heat.

lines.content: 撃ち放たれた弾丸は……。
lines.translated: The fired bullet...

lines.content: この俺の肉体を、その頭部を、容赦なく破壊したはずだった。
lines.translated: Should have mercilessly destroyed this physical body of mine, my head.

lines.content: しかし俺は今ここにいる。
lines.translated: Yet here I am now.

lines.content: 俺の魂だけがここにある。
lines.translated: Only my soul is here.

lines.content: 死んだ人間はみんな私と出会ってしまうんだよ
lines.translated: "All dead humans end up meeting me, you know."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said.

lines.content: そして私の列車に乗って、最後の駅に向かうことになる
lines.translated: "And they ride my train, heading toward the final station."

lines.content: そこから天国だったり地獄だったり。そのどちらでもない場所だったり。進みたい場所に、進みたいように、あなた達は進むことになるんだよ
lines.translated: "From there, it might be heaven, or it might be hell. Or a place that is neither. You all move on to the place you want to go, in the way you want to go."

lines.content: 人生の終わりと始まりの場所……“刻の終着駅”に死者の命を連れて行く。それが私と、私の列車の仕事のひとつ
lines.translated: "The place of life's end and beginning... Taking the lives of the dead to the 'Terminal Station of Time.' That is one of the jobs belonging to me and my train."

lines.content: ……要するに、俺は
lines.translated: "...In short, I..."

lines.content: 大雅は……奏大雅は死亡した
lines.translated: "Taiga... Kanade Taiga has died."

lines.content: その手に握った拳銃で自ら頭を撃ち抜いたんだよ。ハルの命を救い出すため、自らその命を手放してしまった
lines.translated: "You shot yourself through the head with the handgun grasped in that hand. To save Haru's life, you let go of your own life."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはふと、俺から視線を外し……言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan suddenly averted her gaze from me... and spoke.

lines.content: だから今、大雅はこうしてこの列車に乗っている。私と、一緒に
lines.translated: "That's why right now, you're riding on this train like this, Taiga. Together with me."

lines.content: がたん、ごとん、列車は進む。
lines.translated: Clickety-clack, the train moves forward.

lines.content: 鋼鉄の車輪が線路を滑り。
lines.translated: Steel wheels sliding along the tracks.

lines.content: その音や振動を全身で感じながら――
lines.translated: Feeling that sound and vibration with my whole body--

lines.content: 既に失ってしまった肉体で、“夜”の気配を感じたつもりになりながら――
lines.translated: Feeling as though I were sensing the presence of the "Night" with a physical body I had already lost--

lines.content: 俺は、流れる車窓の風景を見つめている。
lines.translated: I gaze at the scenery flowing past the train window.
*At that scenery rewinding, as if playing a video in reverse.*
"*However, the current Taiga is a little different.*"

lines.content: ナナちゃんが言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan says.

lines.content: 本来なら死者である大雅を、私は[・|終][・|着][・|駅]にまで送り届けなければならない……
lines.translated: "Ordinarily, since you are deceased, Taiga, I would have to escort you all the way to the *terminal station*..."

lines.content: そして“次”の場所に向かう大雅を送り出さなければならない……はずだった
lines.translated: "And I would have to send you off as you head toward the 'next' place... Or so it should have been."

lines.content: ……はず？
lines.translated: "...Should have been?"

lines.content: うん。だけどね、大雅。あなたのその手の中にある“魔法”が、例外を作り出してしまってる
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because, you see, Taiga. The 'Magic' inside that hand of yours has created an exception."

lines.content: 今、私たちは、あなたの“夢”を叶えるための旅の途中――あなたの“[奇跡|魔法]”のまっただ中に立っているんだよ――とナナちゃんは、言った。
lines.translated: Right now, we are in the middle of a journey to grant your "Dream"--standing right in the very midst of your "Magic," your "Miracle"--Nana-chan said.

lines.content: あなた達の“魔法”とは誰もが持ち得るはずの“想像力”だ。それはつまり、あえて甘いばかりの言葉で着飾るのなら“想いの力”ということにもなる
lines.translated: "Your 'Magic' is the 'Power of Imagination' that anyone should be able to possess. In other words, if we dare to dress it up in overly sweet words, it also comes down to the 'Power of Feelings.'"

lines.content: そんな力が。誰かを想うというただそれだけの力が、[決まり事|世界の法則]までねじ曲げようとしているだなんて……
lines.translated: "To think that such a power. A power that is nothing more than thinking of someone, is trying to twist even the rules--the laws of the world..."

lines.content: ……ううん。あなたのことを想う“夜”の住人と心を重ねてしまったから
lines.translated: "...No. It's because you overlapped your heart with a resident of the 'Night' who cares for you."

lines.content: ……あなたを想う[・|あ][・|の][・|子]と一緒に、“魔法”を創ってしまったから。だからこんな例外も起こりえてしまうのかな
lines.translated: "...Because you created 'Magic' together with *that girl* who cares for you. I wonder if that's why an exception like this could happen."

lines.content: つくづくあなた達の“心”は予想不可能というか。恐ろしいまでに、ううん、愚かなくらいにまっすぐだ……見ていて気が気でないよ。はらはらさせられてばっかりだ
lines.translated: "Your 'Hearts' really are unpredictable, or rather... frighteningly--no, foolishly straightforward... I can't help but worry watching you. You're always keeping me on edge."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはため息をつく。
lines.translated: Nana-chan breathes a sigh.

lines.content: 一度“魔法”をはじめてしまったのなら、もう後戻りはできないだろうけれど――せめてここから先は慎重に行動してほしいよ。大雅
lines.translated: "Once you've started the 'Magic,' you probably can't turn back anymore, but--at the very least, I want you to act carefully from here on out. Taiga."

lines.content: 慎重に……。
lines.translated: Carefully...

lines.content: つまり、それはどういうことなのかな
lines.translated: "In other words, what does that mean?"

lines.content: そう問いかけた俺に、ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: To me, who asked that, Nana-chan says:
"Toward *your world that is about to begin*... In place of *that girl*, Taiga, I intend to question your resolve."

lines.content: 俺は首を傾げた。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: 覚悟？
lines.translated: Resolve?

lines.content: ……問う？
lines.translated: "...Question it?"

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 誰かがあなたに問いかける必要があるんだって思う
lines.translated: "I think someone needs to question you."

lines.content: これからあなたが立ち向かおうとしているものに対して……あなたは、どれだけの覚悟を持って臨めるのかということを
lines.translated: "Regarding what you are about to face from here on... just how much resolve you have to confront it."

lines.content: 一つひとつ言葉にして、形にし、確認することで、必要な知識と心構えを整理するのだ。
lines.translated: By putting it into words one by one, giving it form, and confirming it, I will organize the necessary knowledge and mindset.

lines.content: なぜなら、大雅。わたしはこの“魔法”を、あなたには絶対、成功させてほしいから
lines.translated: "Because, Taiga. I absolutely want you to succeed with this 'Magic.'"

lines.content: 大雅は大雅で思うところもあるだろうと感じるよ。こんなところで私の話を聞くよりも早くハルを助けに行きたいよね――先を急ぐ気持ちだって理解できるよ
lines.translated: "I can sense that you have your own thoughts on the matter, Taiga. Rather than listening to me talk in a place like this, you want to hurry and go save Haru, right?--I can understand your impatience to press on, too."

lines.content: でもね。そんなときだからこそ焦ってこけてしまったりしないよう、私に、あなたの中の覚悟を問わせてほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "But you see. It's precisely at a time like this, so you don't rush and trip yourself up, that I want you to let me question the resolve inside you."

lines.content: 言葉を返す代わりに、深く俺はうなずいた。
lines.translated: Instead of returning words, I nodded deeply.

lines.content: 今、ここでおさらいしておくべき最優先事項そのいち
lines.translated: "First and foremost among the top priorities we should review right here, right now."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは人差し指を立てる。
lines.translated: Nana-chan raises her index finger.

lines.content: その“拳銃”は、撃ち抜く対象の“[現在|今、ここ]”を破壊する
lines.translated: "That 'Handgun' destroys the 'Present'--the 'Here and Now'--of the target it shoots through."

lines.content: そして、使用者を過去の時間へと巻き戻してしまう――それが、その“魔法”の効果だね
lines.translated: "And it rewinds the user back to a past time--that is the effect of that 'Magic,' isn't it?"

lines.content: 巻き戻す。
lines.translated: Rewinds.

lines.content: つまり人生をやり直すと言うことだと、ナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: In other words, it means redoing life over again, Nana-chan said.

lines.content: それは、大ざっぱに言えばタイムスリップとかそういった事情に類似する――
lines.translated: "Roughly speaking, it's similar to a time slip or circumstances like that--"

lines.content: その“魔法”の効果を上手に利用できたなら、確かに、ハルの命を救うことは可能だろうね
lines.translated: "If you can skillfully utilize the effect of that 'Magic,' it will certainly be possible to save Haru's life."

lines.content: 俺がハルを助けるためにと思い描いた光景は――まさに[・|そ][・|れ]だ。
lines.translated: The vision I pictured in order to save Haru--is *precisely that*.

lines.content: ハルの“最後の魔法”がいったいどういうものなのかは未だわからない。
lines.translated: I still don't know just what kind of thing Haru's "Last Magic" is.

lines.content: だけどハルのその“魔法”が、最悪の結果を招いているのだろうくらいは想像できる。
lines.translated: However, I can at least imagine that her "Magic" is inviting the worst possible outcome.

lines.content: だからハルに“許可”を出す前に戻りたい。
lines.translated: That's why I want to return to before I gave Haru "Permission."

lines.content: 俺は“後悔”しているのだ。
lines.translated: I am feeling "Regret."

lines.content: ハルに“許可”を出してしまったことを。ろくにハルの“魔法”を調べもしなかったことを。
lines.translated: That I ended up giving Haru "Permission." That I didn't even bother properly looking into what Haru's "Magic" was.

lines.content: ……だからね、大雅。この列車は今、あなたをその日、そのとき、その瞬間に、運んでいるんだよ。あなたの“魔法”が、その“弾丸”が、そのための切符の代わりなんだ
lines.translated: "...That's why, Taiga. This train is currently carrying you to that day, that time, that very moment. Your 'Magic'--that 'Bullet'--is serving as your ticket there."

lines.content: だけど、この世界はいつもほどよく底意地が悪い。いつも。どこでも。どんなときでも。何に対しても如才なく。便利なだけの“魔法”など、この世界には存在しないんだよ
lines.translated: "However, this world is always just the right amount of spiteful. Always. Everywhere. At all times. Thoroughly and toward everything. There is no such thing as purely convenient 'Magic' in this world."

lines.content: ……その“魔法”には、いくつかの注意点がある
lines.translated: "...There are a few caveats to that 'Magic.'"

lines.content: 跳躍を可能にするのは過去へのみ。未来へは向かえない。言うなればその“弾丸”は一方通行の片道切符といったところだよ
lines.translated: "It only allows you to jump into the past. You cannot head into the future. So to speak, that 'Bullet' is something of a one-way ticket."

lines.content: そしてその“拳銃”は。時間跳躍の性質は。たった今口にした自分の言葉を否定するようだけど……タイムスリップと一概には言い難いものだとも言える
lines.translated: "And as for that 'Handgun'--the nature of its time jump. Though this may sound like I'm contradicting the words that just left my mouth... you can't really lump it together as a simple time slip, either."

lines.content: どちらかと言えば、タイムリープに似た類だね
lines.translated: "If anything, it's closer in nature to a time leap."

lines.content: タイムスリップと、タイムリープ。
lines.translated: A time slip, and a time leap.

lines.content: その、違いは？
lines.translated: "What's the difference?"

lines.content: “タイムスリップ”は時の旅行者そのものが過去へと飛ぶ現象を指す
lines.translated: "A 'time slip' refers to the phenomenon where the time traveler themselves physically flies into the past."

lines.content: その特徴としては、同じ時代、同じ時間軸、そういった時の舞台に同じ人物が同時に存在してしまうといった[パラドックス|事態]に陥る危険と、常に寄り添わなければならないということ
lines.translated: "Its defining trait is that you must constantly live alongside the danger of falling into a paradox--a situation where the exact same person exists simultaneously on the stage of the same era, the same timeline."

lines.content: 一方、“タイムリープ”は、旅行者の意識のみを過去へと跳躍させるケースを指す。簡単に言えば現在の記憶を持ったまま過去の自分自身に戻るんだ
lines.translated: "On the other hand, a 'time leap' refers to a case where only the traveler's consciousness jumps into the past. Simply put, you return to your past self while retaining your current memories."

lines.content: ……この拳銃の“魔法”は、後者に当たる
lines.translated: "...The 'Magic' of this handgun falls under the latter."

lines.content: そういうことだね
lines.translated: "That's right."

lines.content: ……タイムスリップよりはタイムリープのほうが、過去に生きる自分自身と出会ってしまうといったリスクを犯さなくて済むぶん、安全性は高いのではないかと個人的には思うよ
lines.translated: "...Personally, I think a time leap is safer than a time slip, since it spares you the risk of running into your past self living in that era."

lines.content: そう、か
lines.translated: "I... see."

lines.content: だとするなら。
lines.translated: If that's the case...

lines.content: ……これは見た目に反して安全な“魔法”、なのかな
lines.translated: "...Does that mean this is a safe 'Magic,' contrary to how it looks?"

lines.content: どちらかといえばという話だよ。完全完璧に安全なものなど何もない――そう構えているくらいのほうがいいって思う。これからは
lines.translated: "Only relatively speaking. Nothing is ever completely and utterly safe--I think it's better to brace yourself with that mindset. From here on out."

lines.content: 俺は、手にずっしりと重い感触を意識する。
lines.translated: I become acutely aware of the heavy weight resting in my hand.

lines.content: “拳銃”
lines.translated: The "Handgun."

lines.content: 本来、それは人の命を効率よく奪うためにあるものだ。
lines.translated: Originally, it is something meant to efficiently rob people of their lives.

lines.content: 人差し指にほんの少し力を込める、たったそれだけの――労力とも呼べないほどの労力で、簡単に人を破壊してしまえる。恐ろしく鋭利な意図が、その重さには含まれている。
lines.translated: Putting just a tiny bit of strength into your index finger. With nothing more than that--an effort so small it can't even be called effort--it can easily destroy a person. A terrifyingly sharp intent is packed into that weight.

lines.content: だがこの手の中にある“拳銃”は、たったひとつ命を差し出すだけで、代わりに誰かの命を――どころか、大勢の命をも救うことができるかもしれない代物だ。
lines.translated: Yet the "Handgun" resting in my hand is something that, in exchange for offering up just a single life, might be able to save someone else's--or rather, the lives of many.

lines.content: なぜなら時を破壊し、間違いを正せるかもしれないものなのだから。
lines.translated: Because it is something that can destroy time, and perhaps right my wrongs.

lines.content: 俺は……。
（……俺は、大丈夫か。やれるのか）
lines.translated: (...Will I be okay? Can I really do this?)

lines.content: この“魔法”でハルを救えるか？
lines.translated: Can I save Haru with this "Magic"?

lines.content: そして俺はようやく……、
lines.translated: And will I finally...

lines.content: （ヒーローのように、なれるだろうか）
lines.translated: (Will I be able to become like a hero?)

lines.content: 憧れ続けた[・|あ][・|の][・|人]のようになれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to become like *that person* I've admired for so long?

lines.content: こんな気持ちで一度は大切な友人を――あず咲先輩を失ったというのに――それなのに性懲りもなく、俺はふとそう思ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Even though holding onto feelings like that once cost me a precious friend--cost me Azusaki-senpai--despite all that, without ever learning my lesson, I found myself thinking it again.

lines.content: 大雅。ここからだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. It starts from here."

lines.content: ナナちゃんの声に、俺は顔を上げた。
lines.translated: At the sound of Nana-chan's voice, I raised my head.

lines.content: ここから先が、重要なんだ。あなたに覚悟を問うのはここからだよ
lines.translated: "What comes next is the important part. Questioning your resolve starts right here."

lines.content: わざわざその“魔法”を創った張本人に投げかけるには、あんまりにも今さらなんだろうけれど――私はあなたに、まずは少々ややこしいことを話さなきゃならないみたいだ
lines.translated: "It's probably way too late to be bringing this up to the very person who created that 'Magic' in the first place, but--it seems I have to explain something a little complicated to you first."

lines.content: まず、大雅。あなたがその“拳銃”で、その頭を撃ち抜いた[時間|世界]を、基本地点のＡとするね
lines.translated: "First off, Taiga. Let's call the world--the time--where you shot yourself through the head with that 'Handgun' our baseline, Point A."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは人差し指を立て、言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan raises her index finger and speaks.

lines.content: この“[魔法|拳銃]”で過去へと戻り、何か、この基本世界Ａに至るまでの筋道とは違う言動行動を、どこかの瞬間に重ねてしまった場合――
lines.translated: "When you return to the past with this 'Handgun'--this 'Magic'--if, at any moment, you pile up words or actions that differ from the path leading up to this baseline World A--"

lines.content: ――その瞬間、即座に世界は枝分かれする
lines.translated: "--at that very instant, the world will immediately branch off."

lines.content: 枝分かれ……
lines.translated: "Branch off..."

lines.content: うん。原因と結果、というやつだね。何事にも原因があって、それ相応の結果がある。そういうものだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Cause and effect, as they call it. Everything has a cause, and a corresponding effect. That's just how it works."

lines.content: この世界は。この時間は。そういうふうに折り重なっている。
lines.translated: This world. This time. That is how they are folded and layered together.

lines.content: ……因果の法則？
lines.translated: "...The law of causality?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。そうだね。あなた達の間ではそう呼ばれることもあるね
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. That's right. It's sometimes called that among you humans, isn't it?"

lines.content: よく知ってるねとナナちゃんは小さく笑う。
lines.translated: "You know your stuff," Nana-chan says with a small smile.

lines.content: そうして細かく枝分かれして出来上がるのは、このＡの世界とよく似た、けれど、作用点となる人物が重ねる“[行動|原因]”次第で――まったくの別物であるＢの世界が出来上がる
lines.translated: "What gets created through those fine branches is a World B--one that closely resembles this World A, yet depending on the 'causes'--the 'actions'--piled up by the person acting as the point of application, becomes something completely different."

lines.content: パラレルワールドという言葉を一度は聞いたことがあると思う
lines.translated: "I think you've heard the term 'parallel world' at least once before."

lines.content: ああ、……うん
lines.translated: "Yeah... I have."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そして苦笑いを浮かべた。
lines.translated: And then, a wry smile surfaced on my face.

lines.content: ……まさか自分の人生のうちで、いや、もう[・|今][・|回][・|の][・|人][・|生]は終わってしまったんだったか――
lines.translated: "...Never in my life--no, I guess *this life* of mine is already over, huh--"

lines.content: とにかくそんな言葉を引き合いに、真剣に、話し合わなけりゃならなくなるなんて。欠片も考えちゃいなかった
lines.translated: "Anyway, I never even remotely imagined I'd end up having to bring up a word like that in a dead-serious discussion."

lines.content: うん。そうだろうね
lines.translated: "Yeah. I bet."

lines.content: ナナちゃんも少しだけ笑ってくれる。
lines.translated: Nana-chan gives me a small smile, too.

lines.content: あなた達は何かと“理解できないもの”、“不思議なもの”、“不可思議なもの”、そういったものたちと距離を取りたがるイキモノだからね。……でも、良かった
lines.translated: "You humans are creatures who always try to keep your distance from 'things you can't understand,' 'mysterious things,' and 'the inexplicable,' after all. ...Still, I'm glad."

lines.content: ようやく少し笑ったね
lines.translated: "You finally smiled a little."

lines.content: 大雅がこの列車に乗ってきたときは驚いたよ。ふつうの死人より、もっと死人みたいに真っ青な顔してたから
lines.translated: "I was shocked when you boarded this train, Taiga. Your face was even paler and more dead-looking than an ordinary corpse."

lines.content: ……そっかな。そんな冴えない顔してた？
lines.translated: "...Was it? Did I really look that awful?"

lines.content: してたよ。すごく。さっきカップ麺にお湯を注いだばかりだったの、忘れちゃうくらい
lines.translated: "You did. Terribly so. So much that I completely forgot I had just poured hot water into my cup noodles a moment earlier."

lines.content: ほら見てよ。伸び伸びだよ。もったいない……
lines.translated: "Look at this. They're completely soggy. What a waste..."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは完全にふやけてしまったカップ麺を、『これはもう、食べられない……』と、惜しそうな目で見つめていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan stared at the completely bloated cup noodles with regretful eyes, muttering, "I can't eat this anymore..."

lines.content: ……幼馴染みの女の子が、死んでしまった。笑えるはずもないのは仕方のないことだけど……。心配だったんだ
lines.translated: "...Your childhood friend died. It can't be helped that you wouldn't be able to smile, of course... I was just worried about you."

lines.content: ――死んだ人間はナナちゃんに会う。
lines.translated: --People who die meet Nana-chan.

lines.content: ならハルはここへ来たのだろうか。ナナちゃんには最初にそう問いかけていた。だけどその答えは予想の通りだ。[・|来][・|て][・|い][・|な][・|い]。
lines.translated: Then did Haru come here, too? That was the very first thing I had asked Nana-chan. However, the answer was just as I expected. *She hasn't come here.*

lines.content: “悪夢”に飲まれたハルの命は、跡形もなく消滅したということなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Does that mean Haru's life, swallowed up by the "Nightmare," was erased without leaving a single trace behind?

lines.content: 心が疲れてしまったら、どころか壊れてしまいでもしたら……。誰かのことを助けるなんて。そんなの、とてもじゃないけど不可能だ
lines.translated: "If your heart gets exhausted, let alone if it ends up breaking... saving someone else would be completely out of the question. There's just no way."

lines.content: だからまずは自分を大切にしてほしい――とは、今のあなたには口が裂けても言えないのかもしれないけれど
lines.translated: "That's why I want you to take care of yourself first--though I probably couldn't bring myself to say that to you right now even if my life depended on it."

lines.content: とにかく、とナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: "Anyway," Nana-chan says.

lines.content: “パラレルワールド”。今、ここの世界と、それはどこかよく似ていて、しかしどこか確実に違ってしまっている、もうひとつの世界
lines.translated: "'Parallel worlds.' Another world that closely resembles the here and now in some ways, yet has become undeniably different in others."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はほんの些細なことでいくらでも生まれ、まるで際限もないかのように広がっていく。たとえば――
lines.translated: "*They* are born in endless numbers from the most trivial things, spreading out as if without limit. For example--"

lines.content: ――今朝。
lines.translated: --This morning.

lines.content: 新品の自転車にまたがるのが勿体なかったから、徒歩で学園へと登校した。
lines.translated: Because it felt like a waste to ride a brand-new bicycle, you walked to the academy instead.

lines.content: あるいは、喜び勇んで真新しい自転車で風を切り、学園へと向かった。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, brimming with excitement, you cut through the wind on your brand-new bicycle and headed for the academy.

lines.content: 前者を選ぶか。後者を選ぶのか。はたまた何も、選ばないのか。
lines.translated: Do you choose the former? Do you choose the latter? Or do you choose nothing at all?

lines.content: たったそれだけのことでも、ほら、世界はふたつ、いや、みっつも、出来上がる
lines.translated: "Even from something as small as that, look--two, no, three worlds are created."

lines.content: この世界はまさにカオスだよ。理論も法則も想いも言葉も現象も、すべて入り乱れては絡まり合って、ひとつの舞台を成している――
lines.translated: "This world is pure chaos. Theories, laws, feelings, words, phenomena--all of them jumble together and intertwine to form a single stage--"

lines.content: そして、そのようにして、世界は、今を生きている命のその心の数だけ……何十、何百、何千と――この瞬間にも際限なく増え続けていっていることになる。あくまでも、理屈としてはね
lines.translated: "And in that way, the worlds continue to multiply limitlessly even at this very moment--by the dozens, hundreds, thousands... matching the number of hearts of the lives living in the present. Strictly in theory, at least."

lines.content: ここまでは、まあ、あなた達が好きな映画や小説などによく見られる、ごくありふれた時間旅行の性質なのだとも言えるだろうけれど……
lines.translated: "Up to this point, well, you could say this is just the commonplace nature of time travel you often see in the movies and novels you guys like, but..."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそこでふと言葉を区切った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan suddenly paused her words there.

lines.content: が、すぐに先を続けた。目を伏せ、少し、ため息にも似た細い息を吐き出して。
lines.translated: However, she quickly continued, lowering her eyes and letting out a thin breath that resembled a sigh.

lines.content: 問題なのは……。その“拳銃”では、既に決定してしまった“未来”は変えられない。それが、それこそが、大問題なんだよ。そこにこそあなたの覚悟は試される
lines.translated: "The problem is... with that 'Handgun,' you cannot change a 'Future' that has already been decided. That--that right there is the biggest problem. And that is precisely where your resolve will be tested."

lines.content: 俺は、手のひらの“拳銃”を見つめる。
lines.translated: I stare at the "Handgun" resting in my palm.

lines.content: 改めるよ。大雅。その“拳銃”の力では……
lines.translated: "Let me put it plainly, Taiga. With the power of that 'Handgun'..."

lines.content: ハルを。既に死んでしまった柊ハルの命を救うことは、決して、できない
lines.translated: "Haru--you can never, ever save the life of Hiiragi Haru, who has already died."

lines.content: “柊ハルの命を救うことは決してできない”
lines.translated: "You can never save the life of Hiiragi Haru."

lines.content: それはどのような例外も、どのような形を成した奇跡であろうと、決して……何があろうと決して覆すことのできない結果のひとつだとナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: No matter what kind of exception occurs, no matter what form a miracle might take, that is one outcome that can never... never be overturned no matter what, Nana-chan said.

lines.content: ……この“魔法”では、ハルを救うことはできない
lines.translated: "...With this 'Magic,' I can't save Haru."

lines.content: 俺は、つぶやく。
lines.translated: I muttered.

lines.content: “人生にリセットは利かない”
lines.translated: "There is no reset button in life."

lines.content: それが基本中の、基本。
lines.translated: That is the most fundamental of fundamentals.

lines.content: それは、神さまだってもしかしたら変えることのできない、絶対不変のルールなのかもしれない。
lines.translated: It might even be an absolute, immutable rule that not even God can change.

lines.content: ……確かに。
lines.translated: It's true.

lines.content: ハルはもう、帰らない。帰ってこれない。
lines.translated: Haru isn't coming back anymore. She can't come back.

lines.content: 嘆こうと。
lines.translated: No matter how much I grieve.

lines.content: 喚こうと。
lines.translated: No matter how much I kick and scream.

lines.content: 泣き叫ぼうと。
lines.translated: No matter how much I cry out.

lines.content: それは絶対に、変わらない。
lines.translated: That will absolutely never change.

lines.content: そう。
lines.translated: Yes.
*At this baseline point we named A, that is.*

lines.content: さっき、パラレルワールドの話題を出したけど、私が問題視したいのはその点なんだよ
lines.translated: "I brought up the topic of parallel worlds earlier, and that's the exact point I want to call into question."

lines.content: 私たちが今こうして話し合っている基本の[世界|時間]。仮にＡと名付けたこの地点
lines.translated: "The baseline time--the world--where we are having this discussion right now. This point we tentatively named A."

lines.content: ここで生きていた大雅が、大雅自身の時間を撃ち殺し――過去へと、跳躍する。そのために“魔法”の引き金を引いた
lines.translated: "The Taiga who lived here shot his own time to death--and leaps into the past. You pulled the trigger of 'Magic' for that sake."

lines.content: ……これから大雅が到達する[そこ|過去]でハルをうまく救済できたとしよう。何事もなく、邪魔も入らず、柊ハルに降りかかる死の運命に打ち勝てたとしよう――
lines.translated: "...Let's say you manage to successfully save Haru in the past--the place you're about to reach. Let's say everything goes smoothly, nothing gets in your way, and you manage to overcome the fate of death descending upon Hiiragi Haru--"

lines.content: 意地悪な[世界|敵]が押しつけてくる死の運命に、その[宣告|戦い]に、勝利できたとしよう――
lines.translated: Let's say you win against the fate of death forced upon her by a malicious world--an enemy--against that sentence, that battle--

lines.content: だがその時点で、過去を変えた大雅は、大雅の時間は、大雅の、世界は。即座に新たなＢの世界へと分岐することとなる
lines.translated: "Even so, at that very moment, the Taiga who changed the past--your time, your world--will immediately branch off into a new World B."

lines.content: そして問題なのは、覚悟を問うのはここからだよ大雅
lines.translated: "And here is the problem, Taiga. This is where your resolve will truly be tested."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan spoke.

lines.content: 私が問題視しているのは――その[拳銃|魔法]を使い、ハルを助け出した大雅は、このＡ地点の世界にはどう足掻いても帰ってくることは叶わない――ということなんだ
lines.translated: "What I see as the issue is this--once you use that Handgun, that 'Magic,' to rescue Haru, no matter how hard you struggle, you will never be able to return to the world of Point A."

lines.content: それはつまり、“今、ここ”。Ａ地点の柊ハルは永遠に死亡したままだ。Ａの彼女が生き返るというようなことはない
lines.translated: "Which means that 'right here, right now,' the Hiiragi Haru of Point A remains dead forever. There is no scenario in which the 'her' of World A comes back to life."

lines.content: ハルは、永遠に
lines.translated: "Haru will... forever..."

lines.content: 俺は、目を細めた。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: 永遠に、死亡した、まま
lines.translated: "Remain dead, forever..."

lines.content: ああ、そうだね。大雅がその“魔法”を使い、柊ハルを救済できたという[時間|可能性]を造り上げられたとしても……
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right. Even if you use that 'Magic' to forge a new time--a new possibility--where you managed to save Hiiragi Haru..."

lines.content: その行動力は、“今、[Ａ地点|ここ]”においては、何の影響下にも属することがない
lines.translated: "That action will hold no sway whatsoever over the 'here and now' of Point A."

lines.content: 奏大雅が柊ハルを救い出せたというＢ地点の[パラレルワールド|世界]。そこであなた達はもしかしたら幸福に生きていけるのかもしれないけれど
lines.translated: "In the parallel world of Point B, where Kanade Taiga managed to rescue Hiiragi Haru, perhaps the two of you might be able to live happily."

lines.content: だけどその裏側で、バッドエンドに落とされてしまったＡ地点の時間も、同時に、併走するかのような時間の速度で存在し続けている
lines.translated: "However, on the flip side of that, the timeline of Point A that plunged into a bad ending will continue to exist simultaneously, running parallel to it at the exact same speed."

lines.content: “柊ハルが自殺したというエンディングを内包したこの世界”
lines.translated: "This world, which holds the ending where Hiiragi Haru took her own life."

lines.content: それは過去で何をしようと、どんな“魔法”の作用点を刻み込もうと……。
lines.translated: No matter what I do in the past, no matter what points of action I carve into it with "Magic"...

lines.content: どこまでも、どこまでも。ただただ、陰鬱な様相をはらみ――柊ハルと、[・|奏][・|大][・|雅][・|と][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|た][・|り][・|の][・|人][・|間]が死んでしまった。と、そういう事実が刻まれたこの世界もまた、永遠に、続いてく
lines.translated: "On and on, forever and ever. Steeped in nothing but gloom--this world etched with the fact that Hiiragi Haru and *Kanade Taiga, two human beings*, have died, will also continue on for all eternity."

lines.content: ……あなたも同じなんだよ大雅。ハルと同じ。あなたはＡ地点ではすでに死人だ
lines.translated: "...It's the same for you, Taiga. Just like Haru. At Point A, you are already a dead man."

lines.content: 奏大雅は“ゆめのねどこ”の一室で自ら頭を撃ち抜いて絶命した――
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga shot himself in the head and died in a room at the 'Bed of Dreams'--"

lines.content: あなたのことを支えてくれていた者たちに色々な後処理と、どうしようもないやるせなさを残して、あなたは逝った
lines.translated: "You passed away, leaving behind all sorts of aftermath to clean up and a helpless, unbearable grief for the people who supported you."

lines.content: そこに“魔法”の所在を感じ取ることのできる者はそうそういない。
lines.translated: Very few people would be able to sense the presence of "Magic" there.

lines.content: ただただ理由もわからない自殺体だけが残される。
lines.translated: All that is left behind is the body of a suicide victim, the reason for it completely unknown.

lines.content: なぜなら当然――その結果に至るまでの説明も何もなしに引き金を引いてしまったからだ。
lines.translated: Because, naturally--I pulled the trigger without leaving behind a single word of explanation for why it came to that.

lines.content: そういったＡ地点の結果は、過去をいくら改変しようと変わることなく存在し続ける……。
lines.translated: That outcome at Point A will continue to exist unchanged, no matter how much I alter the past...

lines.content: あさひさん。
lines.translated: Asahi-san.

lines.content: 十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: ふたりの顔が過ぎる。
lines.translated: Two faces flash through my mind.

lines.content: ……俺は、俺はなんてことをしてしまったんだ。
lines.translated: What have I done? What in the world have I done?

lines.content: ハルを一刻も早く助けたいばかりに。
lines.translated: Just because I was so desperate to save Haru as quickly as possible.

lines.content: そのくせ、思い切り悩みに悩み、躊躇い続け……。
lines.translated: And yet, despite that, I agonized and agonized over it, hesitating endlessly...

lines.content: 引き金を絞った頃にはもう、目的以外の何も見えていなかった。
lines.translated: By the time I squeezed the trigger, I was already blind to everything except my goal.

lines.content: 自分がしてしまったことに今更ゾッとしてしまう。
lines.translated: Only now does a chill run down my spine at the horror of what I've done.

lines.content: ……ナナちゃんの言うとおりだ。
lines.translated: It's just as Nana-chan says.

lines.content: 俺は何の前触れもなく自殺した。
lines.translated: I committed suicide without any warning whatsoever.

lines.content: 何の相談もなく。何の、説明もなく……。
lines.translated: Without consulting anyone. Without any explanation at all...

lines.content: 少なくとも、あさひさんと十夜はそう感じてしまうだろう。
lines.translated: At the very least, that's how Asahi-san and Toya will feel about it.

lines.content: どちらだ。
lines.translated: Which one of them?

lines.content: 第一発見者はどちらだろうか。
lines.translated: Which one of them will be the first to find me?

lines.content: 十夜……。
lines.translated: Toya...

lines.content: 十夜っ。
lines.translated: Toya...!

lines.content: 頼む……っ。
lines.translated: Please...!

lines.content: お願いだ俺の部屋の扉を開けないでくれ……っ。
lines.translated: I'm begging you, please don't open the door to my room...!

lines.content: ……神さま。神さまお願いします。十夜に、どうか俺の死体を見ないでくれっ。
lines.translated: God. God, I beg you. Please, don't let Toya see my dead body!

lines.content: 頭を抱え、
lines.translated: Clutching his head,

lines.content: 歯を、食いしばり、
lines.translated: I grit my teeth,

lines.content: 胸が痛むかのような姿をするけれど……。
lines.translated: clutching at my chest as though it aches, and yet...

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 俺は、最悪だ。
lines.translated: I am the absolute worst.

lines.content: どこまでも。どこまでも、どうしようもない奴だ。
lines.translated: Through and through. I'm a completely hopeless piece of trash through and through.

lines.content: 自分の命を、どこか軽薄なものとしてとらえてはいるが……。
lines.translated: I may have treated my own life as something somewhat frivolous, but...

lines.content: 俺は……一切、残されたふたりのことを考えもせず、“魔法”を使ってしまったのだ。
lines.translated: I... I used "Magic" without giving a single thought to the two people I was leaving behind.

lines.content: ごめん、ごめんなさい……あさひさん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry... Asahi-san.

lines.content: あなたに救われたはずの心と、命、だったのに……こんなに、簡単に、手放して……。
lines.translated: Even though you were the one who saved my heart and my life... I threw them away so easily...

lines.content: ふたりはどう思っただろうか。
lines.translated: What must the two of them have thought?

lines.content: 驚き。怒り。呆れかえり。……俺を、嫌いになってしまっただろうか。
lines.translated: Shock. Anger. Utter exasperation. ...Did they come to hate me?

lines.content: どこまでも。いつまでも。あまりに身勝手だった自身に嫌悪するばかりだ。
lines.translated: Deeper and deeper. Forever and ever. All I can feel is disgust toward myself for being so overwhelmingly selfish.

lines.content: （……戻りたい。やり直したい。一時間だけでいい。せめて、ふたりに事情を伝えてからでも）
lines.translated: (...I want to go back. I want to do it over. Just one hour is fine. Even if it's just to explain the situation to the two of them first.)

lines.content: それもまたひどく自己中心的な考えや主張だとはわかっているけれど……。
lines.translated: I know that's also a terribly self-centered thought and demand, and yet...

lines.content: どんなに嘆こうが、どんなに後悔をしている振りを見せようが……もう、だめなのだ。
lines.translated: No matter how much I grieve, no matter how much I act like I regret it... it's already too late.
