lines.content: そう言ったおじさんの横顔は、これまで見たどんなものよりさみしいものであるように、私には見えた。
lines.translated: As he said that, the man's profile looked lonelier to me than anything I had ever seen before.

lines.content: それから私たちは列車で日本中、色々な場所を逃げて回った。
lines.translated: After that, we fled by train to all sorts of places across Japan.

lines.content: ……行く先々でお母さんの影を感じた。
lines.translated: Everywhere we went, I felt my mother's shadow.

lines.content: 街角のテレビから。
lines.translated: From the televisions on street corners.

lines.content: ゴミ箱に押し込められた新聞や雑誌から。
lines.translated: From the newspapers and magazines stuffed into trash cans.

lines.content: いつでも“かわいそうなお母さん”の声や、言葉が、私たちの前に飛び出してきては、その度に緊張した。
lines.translated: Whenever the voice or words of the "poor, pitiful mother" jumped out in front of us, I tensed up every single time.

lines.content: ……柊ハル。君は何が好物なのかな
lines.translated: "...Hiiragi Haru. What's your favorite food, I wonder?"

lines.content: 雨降りの午後。
lines.translated: On a rainy afternoon.

lines.content: 隠れるように立ち寄ったどこかのファミリーレストランでそう言われた。
lines.translated: He asked me that at some family restaurant we had ducked into as if to hide.

lines.content: おじさんから『何でも好きなものを頼んでいい』と言われ、真剣にデザートのページを見つめていたときだった。
lines.translated: The man had told me I could order whatever I liked, and I was staring intently at the dessert page when it happened.

lines.content: わからないと私は応える。
lines.translated: I answered that I didn't know.

lines.content: 甘いものが食べたいとは思っていても、本当にそれが今食べたいものなのか……。
lines.translated: Even if I thought I wanted to eat something sweet, was that really what I wanted to eat right now...?

lines.content: 二年間もずっと閉じ込められて生きてきた。お母さんの求める“私”でいることだけを望んでた。
lines.translated: I had lived locked away for two whole years. All I had wished for was to be the "me" that my mother wanted.

lines.content: 自分が何を好きだったのか。[・|自][・|分][・|が][・|い][・|っ][・|た][・|い][・|誰][・|だ][・|っ][・|た][・|の][・|か]。明るい子だった？　それとも泣き虫だった？
lines.translated: What I used to like. *Who on earth I used to be*. Was I a cheerful kid? Or was I a crybaby?

lines.content: ……私は私がわからなくなってしまっている。
lines.translated: I no longer understood myself.

lines.content: そうか
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: おじさんは、言う。
lines.translated: The man spoke.

lines.content: 私はどきりとしてしまう。なぜだかわからないけれど怒られると思った。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat. I didn't know why, but I thought he was going to get mad at me.

lines.content: ……それならこうしよう
lines.translated: "...In that case, let's do this."

lines.content: 私の手の中からメニューを受け取り、ぺらぺらと捲る。
lines.translated: He took the menu from my hands and flipped through the pages.

lines.content: このお店のメニューに載ってる料理全部……一番美味しいものを探して、食べに行こうか
lines.translated: "Every dish listed on this restaurant's menu... Let's go find the most delicious versions of them and eat them all."

lines.content: 一番？
lines.translated: "The most delicious?"

lines.content: そう。たとえばハンバーグだ。ここのもまあ美味しいだろうけど、どうせなら最高級のものを食べてみたくはないかな
lines.translated: "Right. Take hamburger steak, for example. The one here is probably pretty good too, but if we're going to do this, wouldn't you want to try eating the highest-grade one out there?"

lines.content: さいこーきゅう
lines.translated: "High-est grade..."

lines.content: すっごいお高いってことだ。ハンバーグ一個に紙のお金が何枚もいるようなやつだよ
lines.translated: "It means super expensive. The kind where a single hamburger steak costs several bills of paper money."

lines.content: う、うーん。どうだろう
lines.translated: "U-Umm. I don't know..."

lines.content: お金のことは心配しなくてもいい
lines.translated: "You don't need to worry about money."

lines.content: ……そうなの？
lines.translated: "...Really?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 悪い人はたいていお金持ちかそうじゃない人ばかりだけれど、俺はお金持ちなほうの悪い人なんだ
lines.translated: "Bad guys are usually either rich or not, and I happen to be the rich kind of bad guy."

lines.content: 逃走資金は潤沢だと言い、おじさんは熱いコーヒーをひとつだけ頼んでいた。
lines.translated: Saying we had plenty of funds for our getaway, the man had ordered just a single cup of hot coffee for himself.

lines.content: なあ、柊ハル。せったく行く当てもない旅なんだ。そういう目的を作ってみても面白いんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Hey, Hiiragi Haru. Since this is a journey with no destination anyway, wouldn't it be fun to make a goal like that?"

lines.content: ……自分がどんな食べ物が好きなのか。
lines.translated: What kind of food you like.

lines.content: 大好物はどんな料理なのか。
lines.translated: What kind of dish is your absolute favorite.

lines.content: それを探し当てられれば、ハル。君はわからなくなってしまった自分をひとつ、見つけられるんじゃないかな。
lines.translated: If we can track that down, Haru, don't you think you might be able to find one piece of the self you lost sight of?

lines.content: おじさんはそう言い、そのまま温かなハンバーグを注文してくれた。お子さまランチだ。小さなプレートにハンバーグだけでなく、所狭しと色々な料理が少しずつ盛り付けられている。
lines.translated: Saying that, the man went ahead and ordered a warm hamburger steak for me. It was a kids' meal. On a small plate, not only was there a hamburger steak, but all sorts of different foods were packed tightly together in little portions.

lines.content: 自分でも驚くほどあっという間に食べてしまった――おかわりは？　と聞かれ、私はうなずく。
lines.translated: I ate it all in the blink of an eye, surprising even myself--and when he asked if I wanted seconds, I nodded.

lines.content: デザートには大きなイチゴのパフェが運ばれてきた。
lines.translated: For dessert, a big strawberry parfait was brought to the table.

lines.content: ああ。確かに、そうだった
lines.translated: "Yeah. That really was true."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 誰かが美味しそうにご飯を食べているのを見るのは、それだけでこっちもなんだか幸せな気分になってくる――そう言っていたひとがいたけれど、確かに、そうだなあ
lines.translated: "Just watching someone eat their food with gusto is enough to make you feel kind of happy yourself--someone used to say that, and it really is true."

lines.content: あのひとの言うことはいつも本当だな。おじさんはそう言い、笑っていた。
lines.translated: What that person said is always right. The man said that, smiling.

lines.content: ……そのひとはどんなひとだったの？
lines.translated: "...What was that person like?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 小さかった俺に、まだまだひねくれ者で可愛げもまったくなかったこの俺に、たくさん、美味しいものを食べさせてくれたひとで……。ごめんな。それ以上は思い出せない。今は、まだ
lines.translated: "Back when I was little, when I was still a twisted brat without an ounce of charm, that person fed me lots of delicious food... Sorry. I can't remember any more than that. Not yet, anyway."

lines.content: おじさんがとてもさみしそうな顔をする。それ以上問いかけてはいけないことなんだと思った。
lines.translated: The man made a very lonely face. I felt like it was something I shouldn't ask about any further.

lines.content: 次の日からは色々なお店に連れて行ってもらった。
lines.translated: Starting the next day, he took me to all sorts of restaurants.

lines.content: 海の近い古びたお店で、美味しいお魚をいっぱい食べた。
lines.translated: At an old, weathered shop near the sea, I ate lots of delicious fish.

lines.content: ひとりじゃとても食べきれない大きなハンバーガーを、ふたりで分け合って食べた。
lines.translated: We shared and ate a huge hamburger that I never could have finished all by myself.

lines.content: 一杯が驚くほど高いラーメンも食べたけど、量も少ないし、私にはよくわからない味だった。
lines.translated: We also ate ramen that was shockingly expensive for a single bowl, though the portion was small and the flavor was a bit lost on me.

lines.content: 時には“……大人になったらわかる味なのかな”と首をひねってしまうものもあったけど、おじさんと一緒に食べたものは殆どどれも美味しかった。
lines.translated: Sometimes there were things that made me tilt my head and wonder, "...Is this a flavor I'll understand when I grow up?"--but almost everything I ate with the man was delicious.

lines.content: ……どうして私に美味しいもの、いっぱい食べさせてくれるの？
lines.translated: "...Why do you let me eat so many delicious things?"

lines.content: ある日の寝床で私はそう問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: One day, as we lay in bed, I tried asking him that.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]が、小さかった頃のおじさんに、美味しいものをいっぱい食べさせてくれたから？
lines.translated: "Is it because *that person* fed you lots of delicious things when you were little, Mister?"

lines.content: 問いかけてはいけないことなのかもしれないとは予感しつつも、小さな私はどうしても聞かずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: Even though I had a feeling it might be something I shouldn't ask, the little girl I was back then just couldn't help asking anyway.

lines.content: おじさんはさみしそうな顔をする。
lines.translated: The man made a lonely face.

lines.content: 俺はたぶん、ごめんな。たくさんのひと達が俺にしてくれたことを、君を通して返せたらいいと考えてるんだ
lines.translated: "I'm probably... sorry. I think I'm hoping I can pay back the things so many people did for me, through you."

lines.content: “死にたい心”を、暖かな料理で柔らかく溶かしてくれたことも。
lines.translated: Melting a "heart that wanted to die" softly away with warm cooking.

lines.content: “[・|新][・|し][・|い][・|夢]”を教えてくれたことも。
lines.translated: Teaching me a "*new dream*."

lines.content: ……こんなふうにして、見えもしない、ありもしない“希望”を探して、幼い君の手を引いていくことも
lines.translated: "...And leading a young girl like you by the hand like this, searching for an invisible, nonexistent 'hope.'"

lines.content: 全部、ぜんぶ、いつか、俺が誰かにしてもらったことのはずだから……
lines.translated: "Because all of it, every last bit of it, must be something someone did for me once upon a time..."

lines.content: お布団の中。
lines.translated: Under the covers.

lines.content: おじさんと繋いだ[・|左][・|手]から――不思議だ。誰かの笑顔が私の心に流れ込んでくるようだった。
lines.translated: From the *left hand* I held with the man--it was strange. It felt as though someone's smiling face was flowing into my heart.

lines.content: おじさんの心の中にはたくさんのひとが住んでいる。そう感じた。
lines.translated: There are so many people living inside this man's heart. That was what I felt.

lines.content: なあ、柊ハル。ずっと言いたかったんだが
lines.translated: "Hey, Hiiragi Haru. I've been meaning to say this for a while now."

lines.content: ……なに？
lines.translated: "...What is it?"

lines.content: ……おじさんは、やめろよ。俺はまだまだ若いんだぞ。報道されてるよりもずっとだ
lines.translated: "...Stop calling me 'Mister.' I'm still plenty young, you know. Way younger than what's being reported on the news."

lines.content: じゃあ、名前を教えてよ。おじさん。おじさんはどういう名前なの？
lines.translated: "Then tell me your name, Mister. What kind of name do you have, Mister?"

lines.content: [・|お][・|じ][・|さ][・|ん]。おじさんはどうしてこんなにいっぱい美味しいお店を知ってるの？
lines.translated: "*Mister*. Why do you know so many delicious places to eat, Mister?"

lines.content: するとおじさんはため息をつく。
lines.translated: At that, the man let out a sigh.

lines.content: そしてまた、少しさみしそうな顔をして、言った――一緒に日本中、世界中を旅して回った奴がいたんだ、と。
lines.translated: And then, making a slightly lonely face again, he said--that there used to be a guy he traveled with all over Japan, and all over the world.

lines.content: 君と回ったお店は全部、そいつと食べ歩いたお店だよ
lines.translated: "Every single restaurant I visited with you is a place I went eating around at with him."

lines.content: “どうせなら最高級のものを食べて回ろうぜ。このファミレスにあるメニュー全部だ”――それもまたあいつの提案だったんだ
lines.translated: "'If we're gonna do this, let's go eat the highest-grade stuff out there. Everything on this family restaurant's menu'--that was his suggestion too."

lines.content: その人は今どうしてるの？
lines.translated: How is that person doing now?

lines.content: なぜかその疑問は口にすることができなかった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't bring myself to voice that question.

lines.content: この数日の間に食べたもので一番美味しかったのはなんだろう。それが君の好物ってことでいいんじゃないかな。……ハル
lines.translated: "What was the most delicious thing you ate over these past few days? I think we can just call that your favorite food. ...Haru."

lines.content: ……好きな食べ物がわかったら、私は、私のことがひとつずつわかるようになる？
lines.translated: "...If I figure out my favorite food, will I start to understand myself one piece at a time?"

lines.content: かもしれないな
lines.translated: "Maybe so."

lines.content: ……うん。ありがとう、おじさん。いっぱい美味しいもの食べさせてもらったけど
lines.translated: "...Okay. Thank you, Mister. You let me eat so many delicious things, though."

lines.content: ……一番美味しかったものはといえば、そうだなあ。
lines.translated: If I had to say what the most delicious thing was, let's see.

lines.content: あの部屋から逃げ出して――一番最初におじさんと一緒に食べた物。
lines.translated: After running away from that room--the very first thing I ate together with him.

lines.content: さくらの杜の大通り。
lines.translated: On the main street of Sakura no Mori.

lines.content: そこにあった屋台で売っていた“たいやき”だ。
lines.translated: It was the "taiyaki" sold at a food stall there.

lines.content: 暖かくって。甘くって。なんだか少し怖くもあって。
lines.translated: It was warm. And sweet. And somehow a little scary, too.

lines.content: それらが全部混ぜ合わさって、とってもとっても美味しかったよ――……わからなくなっていた本当の私をひとつ、見つけたよ。
lines.translated: All of those things mixed together, and it was so, so delicious--...I found one piece of the real me that I had lost sight of.

lines.content: そう伝えると、
lines.translated: When I told him that,

lines.content: そうか。はは。たいやき、かあ。まったく、君はお金の掛からない子だな
lines.translated: "I see. Haha. Taiyaki, huh? Honestly, you're a cheap date of a kid."

lines.content: おじさんは私の頭を撫でてくれる――夜。眠る前の短い時間はいつもそうだ。
lines.translated: The man stroked my head--at night. The short time before we fell asleep was always like this.

lines.content: その日あったことを一緒に話していると、私はいつの間にか夢の中に落ちていく。
lines.translated: As we talked together about what happened that day, I would drift off into my dreams before I knew it.

lines.content: このままずっと一緒に眠っていられればいいのに。
lines.translated: I wished we could just stay asleep together like this forever.

lines.content: そう思うこともたくさんあった。
lines.translated: There were so many times I thought that.

lines.content: でも、私たちはお母さんから逃げている。
lines.translated: But we are running away from my mother.

lines.content: この世界中のすべてから逃げ続けている。ひとつの場所に留まってはいられない。
lines.translated: We keep running away from everything in this whole world. We can't stay in one place.

lines.content: 時には公園の遊具の中で身を寄せ合って眠ったり。
lines.translated: Sometimes we huddled together and slept inside playground equipment at a park.

lines.content: 誰とも会わなくても泊まれるホテル、その大きなベッドで、ふたり一緒に眠ったり。
lines.translated: Sometimes the two of us slept together in a big bed at a hotel where you could stay without meeting anyone.

lines.content: 夜通し歩くおじさんの背中に揺られ、眠ったこともあった。
lines.translated: And sometimes I slept while being rocked on his back as he walked all through the night.

lines.content: ……んん
……そして、ある夜。
lines.translated: And then, one night.

lines.content: 私はおじさんの背中で目を覚ます。
lines.translated: I woke up on his back.

lines.content: そういえば、一番最初もこの背中の上で目を覚ましたんだった。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, the very first time I woke up, it was on this back too.

lines.content: おじさんが鼻歌を口ずさんでいた。
lines.translated: He was humming a tune.

lines.content: その歌を私は知っている。
lines.translated: I knew that song.

lines.content: やさしかった頃のお母さんが、子守歌の代わりによく歌ってくれていたものだ。
lines.translated: Back when my mother was still kind, she used to sing it to me all the time in place of a lullaby.

lines.content: その歌……、私、知ってるよ
lines.translated: "That song... I know it."

lines.content: ……そうか。それは、すごいな
lines.translated: "...Really? That's amazing."

lines.content: 目を覚ました私に、おじさんは言う――……これは俺の親友が作った最初で最後の歌なんだ、と。
lines.translated: Seeing that I had woken up, the man told me--...that this was the first and last song his best friend ever wrote.

lines.content: あいつは、すごい奴だった
lines.translated: "He was an amazing guy."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: ああ。まるで自分が作った歌みたいな人生を、一直線に駆け抜けていったような奴だったんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. He was the kind of guy who raced straight through a life that was just like the song he wrote."

lines.content: これは“愛”について歌った歌だ。
lines.translated: This is a song about "love."

lines.content: おじさんはそう囁いて、夜の空を見上げた――そしてこれは、誰にも負けない“勇気”の歌でもあるんだよ、と。
lines.translated: The man whispered that and looked up at the night sky--adding that it was also a song of "courage" second to none.

lines.content: たったひとりの人を生涯想い続けるということは……
lines.translated: "To keep loving just one single person for your entire life..."

lines.content: しかも、その人とはもう二度と会うことが叶わないとわかっているのに
lines.translated: "And even knowing that your wish to meet them again will never come true."

lines.content: それでも“その人が好きだ”って気持ちを、目には見えないそんな自分の想いを、最後まで信じ続けることは、きっと、生半可な覚悟では叶えられないはずのもので……
lines.translated: "Even so, to keep believing until the very end in the feeling of loving that person, in your own invisible feelings like that, is surely something that can't be achieved with half-hearted resolve..."

lines.content: それでもあいつは最後までそんな生き方を選び抜いたんだ。ずっと、ずっと、ひとりきりで
lines.translated: "Yet he still chose that way of life all the way to the end. Always, always, all by himself."

lines.content: ――そんな人生は果たして幸せだったと言えるのだろうか。
lines.translated: --Could a life like that really be called happy?

lines.content: 想い続けられる相手は、もう自分のことなんて忘れて、別の誰かと幸せになってほしいと願っているのかもしれない――……でも。
lines.translated: The person he kept loving might have wished for him to just forget about them already and find happiness with someone else--...even so.

lines.content: 『いいんだ。これは俺の人生なんだ。どんなふうに生きるかは俺にしか決定権はないんだよ』
lines.translated: "'It's fine. This is my life. I'm the only one who has the right to decide how I live it.'"

lines.content: 『誰かの期待だとか。誰かの願い、だとか。そんなものを俺が俺の人生を消費してまで叶えてやる道理も、義理も、どこにもない』
lines.translated: "'Someone else's expectations. Or someone else's wishes. There's no reason or obligation anywhere for me to use up my own life just to grant things like that.'"

lines.content: 『誰が何を言おうと、この歌だけを生涯大切に歌い続けるし。好きな仕事を好きなだけやり続けるし。好きな人を、好きなだけ、想い続けてやる』
lines.translated: "'No matter who says what, I'll keep singing only this song with all my heart for the rest of my life. I'll keep doing the work I love as much as I want. And I'll keep loving the person I love, as much as I want.'"

lines.content: 『……たとえそれが大切な人の願いであっても、何も……何ひとつ、俺が俺の選んだ人生を変えていい理由にはならないんだよ』
lines.translated: "'...Even if it's the wish of someone precious to me, nothing... not a single thing can be a good enough reason for me to change the life I chose for myself.'"

lines.content: 俺も、あいつみたいに誰かひとりを心から愛して……。いいや。[・|心][・|か][・|ら][・|愛][・|し][・|て][・|い][・|た][・|ひ][・|と]のことを、いつか、取り戻せると信じて
lines.translated: "Like him, I also want to love one person with all my heart... No. Believing that someday, I can get back the person *I loved with all my heart*."

lines.content: “二度と会えない人だけど、この歌がきっと未来に届く”――あいつの信じたそんな“希望”と、同じように……何か
lines.translated: "'She's someone I can never meet again, but this song will surely reach the future'--just like that 'hope' he believed in... something."

lines.content: 何か、目には見えないけれど、それでも確かに隣にあるはずのものを強く、つよく信じて生きていける。愛と、勇気だよ。俺にも、そんな生き方ができないだろうか
lines.translated: "To live on while believing strongly, so strongly, in something invisible to the eye, yet surely right there beside me. It's love and courage. I wonder if I can live like that, too."

lines.content: この歌を思い出すとき、あいつの生きた全部が、あいつの言葉が、あいつの想いが、そのすべてが過去から届いた手紙のように、いつも隣にいてくれるような気がするんだよ
lines.translated: "Whenever I remember this song, I feel like everything he lived for, his words, his feelings--all of it is always right there beside me, like a letter delivered from the past."

lines.content: おじさんはその歌を歌い続ける――実はまだ[・|未][・|完][・|成]なのだというその歌を。
lines.translated: The man kept singing that song--the song that he said was actually still *unfinished*.
*Both the lyrics and the melody are full of holes*.

lines.content: だけど未完成というのは、そういう理由だけじゃない。
lines.translated: But that wasn't the only reason it was unfinished.

lines.content: たくさんの人たちに歌い継がれるその中で、たくさんの人たちの想いが重なり、[歌|作品]は“完成”に近づいていくんじゃないかな。[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]が、そう言ってた
lines.translated: "As it gets passed down and sung by lots of people, their feelings will overlap, and the song, the work itself, will draw closer to 'completion.' That's what *she* said."

lines.content: これは“愛”と“勇気”の歌なんだ、とおじさんは繰り返し言う。
lines.translated: This is a song of "love" and "courage," he repeated.

lines.content: だから、俺がこの歌を歌い続けることで、俺なりの“愛”だとか、“勇気”だとか、そういった想いもこの歌に重なって……俺の中でこの歌は完成するんだと思ってた
lines.translated: "So I thought that by continuing to sing this song, my own kind of 'love' and 'courage' and feelings like that would overlap with it too... and this song would be completed inside of me."

lines.content: いつか、この歌に重ねた俺の想いも、あいつの想いも、大切な誰かに届くはずなんだって、信じたかった
lines.translated: "I wanted to believe that someday, both my feelings layered into this song and his feelings would surely reach someone precious."

lines.content: そして、この歌を大切に歌い継ぐ誰もの心の中で、いつか、この歌は完成するんだって信じていたかったんだ
lines.translated: "And I wanted to believe that inside the hearts of everyone who treasures this song and passes it on, someday, this song would be completed."

lines.content: ……とにかく、さ。驚いた
lines.translated: "...Anyway, I'm surprised."

lines.content: どういう経緯かわからないけど、君がこの歌を知ってるってことは、ちゃんとあいつの全部は未来に届いてるんだな。よかった。本当に
lines.translated: "I don't know how it happened, but the fact that you know this song means everything of his really did reach the future. Thank goodness. Truly."

lines.content: “何があっても私が味方”“たとえ世界中の誰もが君の敵になったとしても”“ぼくだけはいつまでだって君のそばにいる”
lines.translated: "No matter what happens, I'm on your side." "Even if everyone in the whole world becomes your enemy." "I alone will stay by your side forever."

lines.content: そんな歌詞を私も一緒に口ずさみたいと、思ったけれど……。
lines.translated: I wanted to hum those lyrics along with him, too, but...

lines.content: 愛についての歌。勇気についての歌。
lines.translated: A song about love. A song about courage.

lines.content: それを私に歌いかけてくれていた頃のお母さんは、この歌の意味を知っていたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Back when my mother used to sing it to me, did she know the meaning of this song?

lines.content: もしも知っていたのなら、私はお母さんに愛されていたからこそ、その歌を毎夜のように贈られていたのだろうか。
lines.translated: If she did know, was I gifted that song almost every night precisely because my mother loved me?

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: 今となってはわからないことが多すぎた。
lines.translated: By now, there were just too many things I didn't understand.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: でもね、おじさん。
lines.translated: But you know, Mister.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 私は大きな背中に額を強く、押しつけた。
lines.translated: I pressed my forehead hard against his broad back.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。私のせいで、おじさんがもっと悪い人に
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Because of me, you've been made out to be an even worse person..."

lines.content: 少し前のことだ。
lines.translated: It happened a little while ago.

lines.content: 私たちは、私たちを追いかける人に見つかった。
lines.translated: We were found by someone chasing after us.

lines.content: 通りかかったどこかの町の駅。
lines.translated: At a train station in some town we were passing through.

lines.content: お手洗いのためにおじさんの隣を少し離れた。
lines.translated: I stepped away from his side for a moment to use the restroom.

lines.content: 手を洗っている私を見た誰かが『あなた、もしかして……』と声を掛けてきたのだ。『もしかしてあなた、柊ハルちゃん？』
lines.translated: Someone saw me washing my hands and called out to me, "Wait, could you be...?" "Could you be Hiiragi Haru-chan?"

lines.content: 瞬間。
lines.translated: In that instant.

lines.content: 私は、固まり。
lines.translated: I froze.

lines.content: ……瞬間。
lines.translated: In an instant.

lines.content: 私は、抱きかかえられ、『ああ、よかった。もう大丈夫。今まで怖かったでしょう。すぐお母さんのところに連れて行ってあげるからね』と笑顔を向けられ。
lines.translated: I was scooped up into their arms, and they smiled at me, saying, "Oh, thank goodness. Everything's okay now. You must have been so scared all this time. I'll take you right back to your mother, okay?"

lines.content: ……そして、次の瞬間。
lines.translated: And then, the next instant.

lines.content: 私を抱き上げ、手洗いを駆け出したその人から、おじさんが私を取り上げた――……叫び声。
lines.translated: From that person who had picked me up and gone running out of the restroom, the man took me back--...screams.

lines.content: たくさんの声が飛び交った。
lines.translated: So many voices flew back and forth.

lines.content: そのすべてが、おじさんのことを悪魔のように突き刺すものばかり。
lines.translated: Every single one of them was piercing him as if he were the devil.

lines.content: そこから何があったのかはよく覚えていない。
lines.translated: I don't really remember what happened after that.

lines.content: ただ、もうテレビとかを見るのが怖い。
lines.translated: I'm just scared to look at the TV or anything anymore.

lines.content: そこには私を救い出そうとした“誰か”から、私を乱暴に[さら|攫]っていった[おじさん|犯人]のことで溢れているはずだった。
lines.translated: It was sure to be overflowing with stories about the man, the culprit, who had violently snatched me away from the "someone" who tried to rescue me.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。おじさん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Mister."

lines.content: どうしてもう少しお手洗いを我慢できなかったんだろう――もうすぐ次の列車が来るよ。次の駅まで我慢できない？　そう言われたとき、どうして私はうなずかなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: Why couldn't I have held it in a little longer--The next train is coming soon. Can you hold it until the next station? When he asked me that, why didn't I nod?

lines.content: そんな“後悔”ばかりが、夢の中にたくさん溢れかえっていた。
lines.translated: My dreams had been overflowing with nothing but regrets like that.

lines.content: そうして私は目を覚ました。
lines.translated: And then I woke up.

lines.content: 私は、おじさんの背中に負ぶわれている――安心した。涙が出るくらい。
lines.translated: I was being carried on his back--I was so relieved. Enough to bring tears to my eyes.

lines.content: 次に目覚めた私を迎えてくれるのは[・|ど][・|っ][・|ち]だろう。そんな悪い夢を見ていたから。
lines.translated: Because I had been having such a bad dream, wondering *which one* would be there to greet me the next time I woke up.

lines.content: ごめんなさいと繰り返す私に、おじさんは大丈夫だと応える。
lines.translated: As I kept repeating "I'm sorry," he answered that it was alright.

lines.content: そんなことで怒ったりしないよ。
lines.translated: I wouldn't get mad over something like that.

lines.content: 言ったろ。俺は、悪い人なんだ。君を[さら|攫]った悪い人。今さら誰に何を言われても平気なんだよ――おじさんはそれ以上何も言わず、私を一度も責めるようなことはなかった。
lines.translated: I told you, didn't I? I'm a bad person. A bad person who kidnapped you. It doesn't bother me what anyone says about me at this point--he didn't say anything more than that, and never once blamed me.

lines.content: ……この歌を作ったあいつの気持ちが、今だから少しわかるよ
lines.translated: "...Because of how things are now, I can understand a little of how the guy who wrote this song felt."

lines.content: おじさんは独り言のようにつぶやき続けていた。
lines.translated: He kept murmuring as if talking to himself.

lines.content: あいつがたったひとりのことを最後まで想い続けたのは、あいつには、その人の“隣”にいるときの自分のことしか愛せなかったからなんだ。きっと
lines.translated: "The reason he kept loving only one person until the very end is surely because he could only love the version of himself that existed when he was right 'beside' her."

lines.content: ……どういうこと？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: これもまた受け売りだけれど、とおじさんは断りを入れてから、私に語った。
lines.translated: Though I'm just borrowing someone else's words again, he prefaced, before telling me.

lines.content: 人の心の中には、誰でも、誰かの“隣”にいるのと同じ数だけ別の自分がいるんだよ。お母さんと一緒にいるときの君と、俺と一緒にいるときの君。そういう具合にだ
lines.translated: "Inside everyone's heart, there are as many different versions of themselves as there are people to stand 'beside.' The you when you're with your mother, and the you when you're with me. Just like that."

lines.content: たとえば[・|こ][・|の][・|人]の“隣”にいるときの自分はいつも緊張している――苦しい。
lines.translated: For example, the version of yourself when you're "beside" *this person* is always nervous--it's painful.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|人]の“隣”にいるときの自分はいつも愛想笑いばかりしている――恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: The version of yourself when you're "beside" *that person* is always forcing a smile--it's embarrassing.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|人]の“隣”にいるときの自分は、何でだかいつも穏やかだ――ただそこにいるだけで、心地いい。
lines.translated: And the version of yourself when you're "beside" *that other person* is, for some reason, always calm--just being there feels comfortable.

lines.content: お母さんの“隣”にいるときの君は、お母さんの言うことを聞かなければ愛してもらえないと、いつも恐れてばかりいる。そんな自分でいるのはきっと苦しいはずだ
lines.translated: "The you when you're 'beside' your mother is always terrified that you won't be loved unless you do what she says. Being that version of yourself must be so painful."

lines.content: 人を好きになるっていうことは、たぶん、その人の“隣”にいるときの自分自身が一番好きだからだ
lines.translated: "Falling in love with someone probably means that you love the version of yourself that exists when you're 'beside' them the most."

lines.content: だからもっとその人と一緒にいたいと思うし……
lines.translated: "That's why you want to be with that person even more..."

lines.content: 自分のこと[・|も]好きになれる“隣”を見つけるために、誰もがみんな長い、ながい旅を続けたり、想いをいっぱい閉じ込めた“[もの|作品]”を作ったりするんじゃないかなと思うよ
lines.translated: "I think everyone continues on a long, long journey, or creates 'works' filled with their feelings, all in order to find a 'beside' where they can come to love *themselves*, too."

lines.content: あいつにとって[・|あ][・|の][・|人]の“隣”だけがそうだった。だから歌い続けた。いつまでも。
lines.translated: For that guy, only being "beside" *her* was like that. So he kept singing. Forever.

lines.content: だから、俺もあいつと同じように、好きな自分になれる“誰かの隣”を探し続けていたんだ
lines.translated: "That's why, just like him, I kept searching for 'someone's side' where I could become a version of myself that I liked."

lines.content: そう言うおじさんの手の中から、また誰かの笑顔が流れ込んでくるようだった。
lines.translated: From inside his hand as he said that, it felt as though someone's smiling face was flowing into me again.

lines.content: おじさんの心の中には、いつもたくさんの“誰か”が住んでいる……。
lines.translated: Inside Mister's heart, there are always so many "someones" living there...

lines.content: ハル。君もいつか自分を自分で愛せる“誰かの隣”を見つけられればいいと祈るよ
lines.translated: "Haru. I pray that someday, you too will be able to find 'someone's side' where you can love yourself."

lines.content: そうすれば、“お母さんの望み通りにしないと愛されない”だ、なんて。そんなふうにしか思えない苦しい自分とさよならできるはずだ
lines.translated: "If you do, then you should be able to say goodbye to that painful version of yourself who can only think, 'I won't be loved unless I do what my mother wants.'"

lines.content: おじさんの心の中でいつも“誰か”が微笑んでいる。おじさんは、いつもそのひとのことだけを探してる。
lines.translated: Inside Mister's heart, "someone" is always smiling. He is always searching only for that person.

lines.content: それは……。
lines.translated: That...

lines.content: それはなんだか、私にとってとてもさみしいことのように思えた。いつか私だけが置いて行かれてしまう。そんなふうに、思えた。
lines.translated: Somehow, to me, that felt like a very lonely thing. Someday, I alone would be left behind. That's how it felt to me.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だからきっと、こんなことを言ってしまったんだと、思う。
lines.translated: That's surely why I ended up saying something like this, I think.

lines.content: ねえ、おじさん。覚えてる？　おじさんは私の夢を叶えてくれるんだよね
lines.translated: "Hey, Mister. Do you remember? You're going to grant my dream, right?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだな。君の大好物が何かわかったらね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. Once we figure out what your favorite food is."

lines.content: ……それは、もう大丈夫。おじさんと最初に食べた“たいやき”だよ。あのときの甘いのと、あのときの温かいのが、私の大好物だから
lines.translated: "...That's fine now. It's the 'taiyaki' I first ate with you. Because the sweetness from back then, and the warmth from back then, are my favorites."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き][・|の]、か。それは大変な大好物だなあ
lines.translated: "*From back then*, huh? That's quite the challenging favorite food."

lines.content: うん……。あのときの私が、おじさんといられる今の私が、私は、一番大好きだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... The me from back then, the me right now who gets to be with you, is the me I love the very best."

lines.content: ……ねえ、おじさん
lines.translated: "...Hey, Mister."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: おじさんが私の“夢”を叶えてくれるなら、私も、おじさんの“夢”を叶えたい。色々してもらうばかりじゃだめだって思うから。だから教えて。おじさんの“夢”は、どんなもの？
lines.translated: "If you're going to grant my 'dream,' then I want to grant your 'dream' too. Because I don't think it's right for you to be the only one doing things for me all the time. So tell me. What is your 'dream' like?"

lines.content: 俺の“夢”……
lines.translated: "My 'dream'..."

lines.content: おじさんは夜空を見上げたまま、少し黙った。
lines.translated: Still looking up at the night sky, he fell silent for a moment.

lines.content: さくらだ
lines.translated: "Cherry blossoms."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……さくらの杜に、咲かない大きなおおきなさくらの樹がある。あのさくらが咲くのをもう一度、見たかった。大切なひとと一緒に
lines.translated: "...In Sakura no Mori, there's a big, huge cherry tree that doesn't bloom. I wanted to see those cherry blossoms bloom one more time. Together with someone precious to me."

lines.content: ……どうしたらその花は咲くの？
lines.translated: "...How can those flowers bloom?"

lines.content: どうかな。確かなことはわからない
lines.translated: "Who knows. I don't know for sure."

lines.content: ただ……俺はそのために、かわいそうな女の子たちを助け続けてた。そうすればいつかあの花は咲くんだと、信じてた
lines.translated: "Just... for that sake, I kept saving pitiful little girls. I believed that if I did, those flowers would bloom someday."

lines.content: あのさくらが咲けば、いつか“不思議の夜の世界”への扉が開かれる――そういう“噂”があった。
lines.translated: If those cherry blossoms bloomed, someday the door to the "world of the mysterious night" would open--there was a "rumor" like that.

lines.content: そうすれば、大人になってしまった俺でも、もう一度、大切なひとと会うことができるはずなんだって、そう信じてたんだ
lines.translated: "I believed that if that happened, even someone like me who had grown into an adult would surely be able to meet that precious person one more time."

lines.content: おじさんのその言葉に、その声に、私の胸はずきりとしてしまうけど、
lines.translated: At those words of his, at that voice, a sharp pain pierced my chest,

lines.content: だったら、こんなところにいちゃだめだよ。戻らなきゃ。あの町に
lines.translated: "Then we can't stay in a place like this. We have to go back. To that town."

lines.content: 私はおじさんの背中から降ろしてもらい、繋いだ手を引っ張った。
lines.translated: I had him let me down from his back, and I pulled on our joined hands.

lines.content: 早くしないと春が終わっちゃう。今、もしかしたら咲いてるかもしれない花が散っちゃうよ
lines.translated: "If we don't hurry, spring will end. The flowers that might be blooming right now will scatter away."

lines.content: いいんだ。あのさくらは咲かない。何年もずっとそうだった。何人助け出そうとずっと変わらなかった。だからもう、俺は“夢”を諦めたんだよ
lines.translated: "It's fine. Those cherry blossoms won't bloom. It's been that way for years. No matter how many people I rescued, it never changed. So I've already given up on my 'dream.'"

lines.content: どうして……。そんなのわからない。おじさんは私のことを助けてくれた。もしも“噂”の通りなら、花が咲くのに必要だったのは私で最後だったのかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "Why...? You don't know that. You saved me, Mister. If the 'rumor' is true, then maybe I was the last one needed for the flowers to bloom."

lines.content: ……そうかな
lines.translated: "...You think so?"

lines.content: きっとそうだよ
lines.translated: "I'm sure that's it."

lines.content: だって、私はハルっていうんだよ。さくらの花が咲く[とき|季節]とおんなじ名前
lines.translated: "Because my name is Haru. The same name as the season when the cherry blossoms bloom."

lines.content: そんな私を、おじさんは外に連れ出してくれたから――だからきっと、花は咲いてる。春はもうそこまで来てるはずだよ
lines.translated: "You took me outside, Mister--so I'm sure the flowers are blooming. Spring must be right around the corner."

lines.content: ……だからおじさん。もしもその樹に、本当に春が来てたら
lines.translated: "...So, Mister. If spring really has come to that tree..."

lines.content: きれいに咲いた満開の下。
lines.translated: Beneath the beautiful, full bloom.

lines.content: もしも、[・|私][・|も]あなたの“隣”にいられたら。
lines.translated: If *I, too,* could be "beside" you.

lines.content: おじさん。次は私のお願いを、叶えてくれる？
lines.translated: "Mister. Will you grant my wish next?"

lines.content: 首をかしげるおじさんに、“君の夢は？”と聞かれたように思えたから、私は……。
lines.translated: As he tilted his head, it felt as though he were asking, "What is your dream?" so I...

lines.content: もしもその花が咲いていて。おじさんの“夢”が、叶ったら――
lines.translated: "If those flowers are blooming, and your 'dream' comes true--"

lines.content: ……私は、“愛”と“勇気”の歌を、心で歌い――
lines.translated: I sang a song of "love" and "courage" in my heart--

lines.content: ……おじさん
lines.translated: "...Mister."

lines.content: お願い
lines.translated: "Please."

lines.content: どうか、私と――……
lines.translated: "Please, with me--..."

lines.content: 私は勇気を出して、あなたに、叶うはずもない“愛”を伝えられますようにと、願った。
lines.translated: Summoning my courage, I wished that I could convey this "love" that could never come true to you.

lines.content: ――それからの出来事を私は生涯忘れないだろう。
lines.translated: --I will probably never forget what happened after that for the rest of my life.

lines.content: あなたと過ごした楽しい時間も。悲しい瞬間も。決して消えないさみしい想いも。
lines.translated: The fun times I spent with you. The sad moments. The lonely feelings that will never fade.

lines.content: ……あってはならない“後悔”も。
lines.translated: And the "regret" that never should have been.

lines.content: ほんとはすべて私の得がたい宝物。
lines.translated: Truly, all of it is my irreplaceable treasure.

lines.content: だからこそ[・|そ][・|れ]は私だけのものとして、この世界中のすべてから消し去ってしまわなければならなかったのに……。
lines.translated: Which is precisely why *it* had to be mine alone, and had to be erased from everything else in this whole world, and yet...

lines.content: ……ひどい
lines.translated: "...This is awful."

lines.content: こんなのって、ないよ。神さま。
lines.translated: Thisisn't fair, God.

lines.content: 私は冷たくなったおじさんの手を握る。
lines.translated: I grasp Mister's hand, which has grown cold.

lines.content: はら、はら、はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter, flutter, softly falling.

lines.content: おじさんの身体に降り積もる春の花。
lines.translated: Spring flowers piling up on his body.

lines.content: おじさん。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "Mister. I'm sorry."
*We never should have met.*

lines.content: ……私があの電話に出たりしなければ。
lines.translated: If only I hadn't answered that phone call.

lines.content: ……私がおじさんのそばを離れなければ。
lines.translated: If only I hadn't left his side.

lines.content: ……私が、おじさんのことを“好き”だなんて、言わなかったら
lines.translated: "...If only I hadn't said that I 'loved' you, Mister."
--Then it wouldn't have turned out *like this*.

lines.content: 私の心はたくさんの“後悔”で溢れてる。
lines.translated: My heart is overflowing with so many "regrets."

lines.content: ……ねえ、おじさん。あの町に戻ろう。
lines.translated: Hey, Mister. Let's go back to that town.

lines.content: 一緒にさくらの花を見に行こう。
lines.translated: Let's go see the cherry blossoms together.

lines.content: もしかしたら今年は咲いているかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe they're blooming this year.

lines.content: 私は、おじさんの手を引いた。
lines.translated: I pulled his hand.

lines.content: ふたりで見上げる満開の下。
lines.translated: Beneath the full bloom we would look up at together.

lines.content: 私もおじさんと一緒に、“夜の世界”へ連れて行ってほしい。
lines.translated: I want you to take me with you to the "world of the night," too.

lines.content: そうお願いするはずだったのに……。
lines.translated: That was what I was supposed to wish for, and yet...

lines.content: 『おじさん。お願い。どうか私と――……いつか』
lines.translated: "Mister. Please. Please, with me--...someday..."

lines.content: いつか結婚、してくれますか。
lines.translated: Will you marry me someday?

lines.content: 気持ちとは裏腹に、あのとき、そんな言葉が唇からするりとこぼれたのだ。
lines.translated: Contrary to my intentions, back then, those words slipped right out from my lips.

lines.content: ……あのときの私はどうかしていた。
lines.translated: Something was wrong with me back then.

lines.content: おじさんの心の中にはたくさんのひとが住んでいる。そして、おじさんはいつもたったひとりのことを想ってる。
lines.translated: So many people live inside Mister's heart. And he is always thinking of just one person.

lines.content: だから断られるのなんてわかっていたし、そもそも子どもな私の言うことなんてきっと相手にもしてもらえない。
lines.translated: So I knew I would be turned down, and in the first place, he surely wouldn't even take the words of a child like me seriously.

lines.content: そうなれば、もっと悲しい気持ちになるだけだともわかっていた。
lines.translated: I knew that if that happened, it would only make me feel even sadder.

lines.content: それでも私は気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: Even so, I had realized it.

lines.content: 私は、あなたの“隣”が大好きなんだと。
lines.translated: That I loved being "beside" you so, so much.

lines.content: そんなあなたに、少しでもいい。振り向いてほしかった――“不思議の国”で待っているという、おじさんの大切なひと。
lines.translated: I wanted you to look my way, even just a little bit--away from that precious person of yours who you said was waiting in "Wonderland."

lines.content: その“誰か”のことを見続ける想いを、ほんの少し、私にもわけてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted you to share just a tiny fraction of those feelings that kept gazing at that "someone" with me, too.

lines.content: 『……それは、無理だよ』
lines.translated: "...That's impossible."

lines.content: おじさんはそう言った。
lines.translated: That was what he said.

lines.content: どうして？　と私は言った――私がまだまだ小さいから？
lines.translated: Why? I asked--Is it because I'm still too small?

lines.content: ……それなら私の背が、いつかおじさんと同じくらい大きくなれたら、おじさん。私、おじさんの“隣”にいてもいい？
lines.translated: "...Then if I grow as tall as you someday, Mister... can I stay 'beside' you?"

lines.content: 歳は、どうしたって、おじさんには追いつけないけど……
lines.translated: "No matter what I do, I can't catch up to you in age, though..."

lines.content: でも、でもね、……きっと、背はいつかきっと追いつける。追いつけるように、がんばって、美味しいものいっぱい食べるから
lines.translated: "But, but you know... I'm sure I can catch up to your height someday. I'll do my best and eat lots of delicious food so I can catch up to you."

lines.content: だからお願い、と私は祈る。
lines.translated: So please, I prayed.

lines.content: お願い。いつか、私と結婚してほしい……おじさん。好きなの。大好きなの
lines.translated: "Please. Someday, I want you to marry me... Mister. I like you. I love you so much."

lines.content: だけどおじさんはそれ以上、何も言わなかった。
lines.translated: But he didn't say anything more than that.

lines.content: お願い。……おじさん。私に“愛”を信じさせてよ
lines.translated: "Please. ...Mister. Let me believe in 'love.'"

lines.content: あの町へ戻る途中、たった一度だけ――
lines.translated: On the way back to that town, just once--

lines.content: おじさんの手の中にあった携帯電話に着信があり、『……そうか。今までありがとう』と、一言だけ口にして、おじさんは短い通話を終えていた。
lines.translated: The cell phone in his hand rang, and after saying only a single phrase, "...I see. Thank you for everything up until now," he ended the brief call.

lines.content: どうして、と私は何度も言った。
lines.translated: Why, I asked over and over again.

lines.content: ……どうして、だめなの
lines.translated: "...Why can't we?"

lines.content: あの部屋に閉じ込められてから、私は私のことがわからなくなっていた。
lines.translated: Ever since I was locked up in that room, I had stopped understanding myself.

lines.content: お母さんの思うとおりにしか生きられない私。
lines.translated: The me who could only live the way my mother wanted me to.

lines.content: お母さんに“私のために死にましょう？”と言われれば、よろこんでそうしようとうなずいていた。ほんとの気持ちなんてどこにあるのか。
lines.translated: If my mother had asked me, "Shall we die for my sake?" I would have gladly nodded and done so. Where were my true feelings?

lines.content: いつの間にか、好きな食べ物さえもよくわからなくなってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I didn't even really know what my favorite foods were anymore.

lines.content: ……そんな空っぽみたいな自分が嫌だった。
lines.translated: I hated that empty version of myself.

lines.content: お母さんの機嫌ばかりを気にする自分が苦しかった。
lines.translated: It was painful being someone who only ever worried about my mother's mood.

lines.content: そんな自分と“さよなら”したいと願うあまり、私はお母さんの言うとおり死んでしまってもいいと、そう思ったのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Wanting so badly to say "goodbye" to that version of myself, I probably thought it would be fine to just die like my mother told me to, and yet...

lines.content: ……私は、おじさんの“隣”にいるときの自分が好き。そんな自分を見つけられたよ。おじさん
lines.translated: "...I like the person I am when I'm 'beside' you, Mister. I managed to find that version of myself. Mister."

lines.content: 顔色をうかがわなくてもいい。怖い思いをしなくていい。自然と笑顔でいられる。不安なことも素直に話せる――
lines.translated: I don't have to tiptoe around you. I don't have to feel scared. I can smile naturally. I can talk honestly about my anxieties--

lines.content: 全部、今までの私にはなかった“私”だ。
lines.translated: All of that is a "me" that never existed until now.

lines.content: おじさんの前では弱気をみせたり、泣いてみたりしてもいいんだと思える。
lines.translated: In front of Mister, I feel like it's okay to show weakness, or even to cry.

lines.content: それがおじさんの“隣”にいるときに産まれる私だ。そのときの私が、私は好きだ。なんだかとても安心するから。
lines.translated: That is the me born when I am "beside" Mister. I like who I am during those times. Because somehow, it makes me feel so safe.

lines.content: ……一緒にいたい
lines.translated: "...I want to stay with you."

lines.content: 他の誰かの“隣”じゃ私は私でいられない。
lines.translated: I can't be myself "beside" anyone else.

lines.content: ……おじさんの“隣”がいい。ずっと、ずっと、おじさんの“隣”に私はいたいの
lines.translated: "...I want to be 'beside' you, Mister. Forever and ever, I want to stay 'beside' you."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: おじさんの心の中にいる“誰か”に私は勝てない。理由はないけどそんな予感があった。
lines.translated: I can't win against the "someone" living inside Mister's heart. I had no reason to think so, yet I had that premonition.

lines.content: だから私は焦ったし、少しムキにもなってしまったんだろうと思う。
lines.translated: That's probably why I got impatient, and why I ended up getting a little stubborn, too.

lines.content: ……ねえ、教えてよおじさん。私はどうして私なんかに産まれてきたのかな
lines.translated: "...Hey, tell me, Mister. Why was I born as someone like me?"

lines.content: おじさんに好きになってもらえたひとに……、おじさんがずっと会いたいと思ってるそのひとに、私、産まれてきたかった
lines.translated: "I wanted to be born as the person you fell in love with... as the person you've been wanting to see all this time."

lines.content: それから私たちは沈黙したまま列車に揺られた。
lines.translated: After that, we swayed with the motion of the train in silence.

lines.content: 向かう先はさくらの杜。私が閉じ込められていた[・|あ][・|の][・|部][・|屋]のある町だ。
lines.translated: Our destination was Sakura no Mori. The town with *that room* where I had been locked away.

lines.content: 大丈夫
lines.translated: "It's okay."
Mister *let go of my hand that was intertwined with his*, and spoke.

lines.content: たとえ今が少しさみしくたって、大丈夫さ
lines.translated: "Even if it's a little lonely right now, you'll be fine."

lines.content: 子どもの頃の“想い”なんて。それがどんなものであるにせよ、大人になれば全部忘れられる。人生は忘れるためにあるものなんだ
lines.translated: "Childhood 'feelings,' no matter what kind they are, can all be forgotten once you grow up. Life exists so that we can forget."

lines.content: だからきっと大丈夫だと言い、おじさんは私の頭をやさしく撫でた。
lines.translated: Saying that it would surely be alright, Mister gently stroked my head.
*It was his left hand.*

lines.content: その手のひらから……。
lines.translated: From the palm of that hand...

lines.content: 不思議だ。
lines.translated: How strange.

lines.content: 今度は誰の笑顔も、私の心には流れ込んでこなかったけれど。
lines.translated: This time, nobody's smile flowed into my heart, however.

lines.content: 代わりにおじさんが、今、考えていることが流れ込んでくる――……だめだ。[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|の][・|だ][・|め]。涙がたくさん、こぼれてしまう。
lines.translated: Instead, what Mister was thinking right now flowed into me--...No. *Not that. No.* So many tears came spilling out.

lines.content: 幸せにな。柊ハル
lines.translated: "Be happy. Hiiragi Haru."

lines.content: おじさんは、笑った。
lines.translated: Mister smiled.

lines.content: 俺には“夢”があったんだ
lines.translated: "I had a 'dream.'"

lines.content: ……小さな頃の“夢”を叶えられなかった俺だ。せめて、君みたいな子たちの心を導く教師だとか。そういった職業に就きたいと願ってた。大人になった俺の新しい“夢”だ
lines.translated: "...I'm someone who couldn't fulfill his childhood 'dream.' So at the very least, I wished to take on a profession like a teacher who guides the hearts of kids like you. That was my new 'dream' as an adult."

lines.content: だから、ごめんな。ハル。俺は君を通して自分の“夢”を叶えようとした
lines.translated: "So, I'm sorry, Haru. I tried to fulfill my own 'dream' through you."

lines.content: 心を“夜”に捕らわれてしまっているような君に、どうか……どうか、お願いだから前を向いてもらえる方法はないかと、思って
lines.translated: "For you, whose heart seemed trapped in the 'night,' I wondered if there was some way, please... please, to get you to look forward."

lines.content: この手を繋ぎ。心を繋ぎ。君の未来を光りのほうへと導ける。そんな、先生みたいな振りをしてみたくって。
lines.translated: Holding this hand. Connecting our hearts. Guiding your future toward the light. I wanted to try pretending to be like a teacher who could do that.

lines.content: 色々と、面倒なことを偉そうに語ってしまったけれど……
lines.translated: "I ended up lecturing you high-and-mightily about all sorts of complicated things, though..."

lines.content: ありがとう。ハル。本当に
lines.translated: "Thank you, Haru. Truly."

lines.content: もしも、あのさくらの花が咲いていなかったとしても――ハル。ありがとう。君は、幼い頃に抱いていた俺の、本当の“夢”を叶えてくれる
lines.translated: "Even if those cherry blossoms aren't blooming--Haru. Thank you. You are going to fulfill the true 'dream' I held when I was young."

lines.content: 俺は、本当はヒーローになりたかったんだ、とおじさんは言う。
lines.translated: The truth is, I wanted to become a hero, Mister said.

lines.content: たくさんの他人を救い出すための自分はいらない。救い出せるのはたったひとりで充分だ。……君だけで、充分なんだ
lines.translated: "I don't need to be someone who saves a lot of strangers. Being able to save just one person is enough. ...Just saving you is enough."

lines.content: 俺は、ハル。君の“夢”を叶えてはあげられないけれど、それでも君のヒーローには、きっとなれる
lines.translated: "Haru, I can't make your 'dream' come true for you, but even so, I can surely become your hero."

lines.content: 私は頭を振った。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: でも、どうしてだろう。声が出ない。出るのは大粒の涙ばっかりだ。
lines.translated: But why is it? My voice wouldn't come out. All that came out were large drops of tears.

lines.content: 最後に君と出会えて、よかった
lines.translated: "I'm glad I got to meet you at the very end."

lines.content: だめ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: [・|も][・|し][・|も][・|ま][・|た][・|会][・|え][・|た][・|な][・|ら]。なあ、ハル。そのときは、今度こそ日本中の美味しいもの、食べて回ろうな
lines.translated: "*If we ever meet again.* Hey, Haru. When that time comes, let's travel around eating delicious food from all over Japan for sure next time."

lines.content: 今度なんて、やだよ……。
lines.translated: I don't want a next time...

lines.content: ……祈ってる
lines.translated: "...I'm praying."

lines.content: お願い……。
lines.translated: Please...

lines.content: 君の未来に。君の“隣”に。いつも幸せな“魔法”が、ありますように
lines.translated: "That in your future. That 'beside' you. There will always be happy 'magic.'"

lines.content: どうか、お願い。
lines.translated: Please, I beg you.

lines.content: おじさん。
lines.translated: Mister.

lines.content: 私を置いて、行かないで……。
lines.translated: Don't leave me behind and go...

lines.content: そこで意識が途切れた。
lines.translated: Right then, my consciousness faded away.

lines.content: おじさんが私を眠らせたのだ。
lines.translated: Mister had put me to sleep.

lines.content: ……私をたったひとり、置いて行ってしまうために。
lines.translated: In order to leave me behind, all alone.

lines.content: ……どうして
私は神さまに問いかける。
lines.translated: I ask God.

lines.content: ……どうして、こんなことになってしまったの
lines.translated: "...Why did it turn out like this?"

lines.content: 目を覚ましたとき、私の隣には誰もいなかった。列車の中。ひとりきり。
lines.translated: When I woke up, there was no one beside me. Inside the train. All alone.

lines.content: 薬で眠らされたのか頭がずきずき痛かった。
lines.translated: My head throbbed with pain, perhaps because I had been put to sleep with medicine.

lines.content: 到着した次の駅。私は、列車を飛び出した。
lines.translated: At the next station we arrived at, I bolted off the train.

lines.content: たくさんの大人たちに呼び止められながら、私は、走った。
lines.translated: While many adults called out to stop me, I ran.

lines.content: 頭をやさしく撫でられたとき、おじさんの心が私の中に流れ込んできた。だからおじさんが今、どこにいて、何をしようとしているのか、わかったから。
lines.translated: When he had gently stroked my head, Mister's heart had flowed into me. Because of that, I knew where Mister was right now, and what he was about to do.

lines.content: おじさんを追い、駆けつけたのは、[・|こ][・|こ]だ。さくらの杜――“参禅町”
lines.translated: Chasing after Mister, the place I rushed to was *here*. Sakura no Mori--"Sanzen Town."

lines.content: その中心にある学園。校庭だ。
lines.translated: The academy at its center. The schoolyard.
Night.

lines.content: まだまだ肌がひやりと冷たい春の夜。
lines.translated: A spring night that still felt chilly against the skin.

lines.content: おじさんは学園の時計塔の下にいた。
lines.translated: Mister was beneath the academy's clock tower.

lines.content: その手を握る。そっと、握りしめる。
lines.translated: I take his hand. Gently, I squeeze it tight.

lines.content: お願い起きてと何度も呼びかけてみるけれど……。
lines.translated: I try calling out to him over and over, begging him to wake up, yet...

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.
"*I didn't make it in time.*"

lines.content: 私の声に振り向く人は誰もいない。
lines.translated: Nobody turns around at the sound of my voice.

lines.content: おじさんは。
lines.translated: Mister.

lines.content: この世界でたったひとりの私の味方は。
lines.translated: My one and only ally in this world.

lines.content: ……味方でいてほしいと願う、その人は。
lines.translated: The person I wished would stay my ally.

lines.content: もう二度と、誰の問いかけには応えない。
lines.translated: Will never again answer anyone's questions.
Someone like God whispers to me--...*You two never should have met.*

lines.content: 私の心はたくさんの“後悔”で溢れてる。
lines.translated: My heart is overflowing with so many "regrets."

lines.content: ――おじさんが私を誘拐した本当の理由。
lines.translated: --The real reason Mister kidnapped me.
It was his mother.

lines.content: おじさんの目的は私じゃない。私のお母さん。
lines.translated: Mister's objective wasn't me. It was my mother.

lines.content: 私を誘拐することで、[・|標][・|的]のお母さんをおびき出そうとした。
lines.translated: By kidnapping me, he tried to lure out my mother, his *target*.

lines.content: ……私を閉じ込めた部屋にはもう決して姿を現すことのなかったお母さん。
lines.translated: My mother, who never again showed herself in the room where she had locked me up.

lines.content: 最悪の場合は、私の監視役としていたおばさんにすべての罪を被せるつもりだったのだろう。
lines.translated: In the worst-case scenario, she probably intended to pin all the blame on the lady who was acting as my warden.

lines.content: おばさんはお母さんの命令には絶対遵守の家系の人なのだ。その結末に至ってしまえばもはや拒否権はない。
lines.translated: That lady came from a family line that obeyed my mother's orders without question. If it came to that conclusion, she would no longer have the right to refuse.

lines.content: お母さんはどこに身を隠しているのかはわからない。居場所がわかるのはテレビ番組の中継で、“かわいそうなお母さん”でいるときくらいだ。
lines.translated: There was no telling where my mother was hiding. The only time her whereabouts were known was during live television broadcasts, when she was playing the "poor, pitiful mother."

lines.content: そんなお母さんのことをおびき出すため、おじさん達は私のことをあの部屋から外に連れ出した。
lines.translated: In order to lure my mother out, Mister and the lady took me out of that room.

lines.content: ――“娘は預かってる。お前の秘密を知ってるぞ。世間にばらされたくなければ、今から言う場所にまでひとりで来い”
lines.translated: --"I have your daughter. I know your secret. If you don't want it exposed to the world, come alone to the place I'm about to tell you."

lines.content: そのような脅迫のメッセージを、お母さんに送りつけていた。
lines.translated: He had sent a threatening message like that to my mother.

lines.content: そしておじさん達はお母さんから反応があるのを待っていた。
lines.translated: And then, Mister and the lady waited for a response from my mother.

lines.content: 列車の中でおじさんの携帯電話にあった短い着信。
lines.translated: The brief call to Mister's cell phone on the train.

lines.content: それは、“母親から反応があった。指定した場所に今夜、現れる”というおばさんからの報告だった。
lines.translated: That was a report from the lady saying, "There was a response from the mother. She will appear at the designated place tonight."

lines.content: おじさん……。[・|こ][・|れ]が、おじさんの叶えたかった本当の“夢”なの？
lines.translated: "Mister... Is *this* the true 'dream' you wanted to fulfill?"

lines.content: はらはらと舞い降る花のかけらたち。
lines.translated: Fragments of blossoms fluttering down.

lines.content: ……握りしめた冷たい左手。
lines.translated: The cold left hand I squeezed tightly.

lines.content: その中からじんわりと、微かに残った記憶のようなものが流れ込んでくる。
lines.translated: From within it, something like faintly remaining memories slowly seeps into me.

lines.content: おじさんがお母さんに指定したのがこの学園の時計塔。その管理室。
lines.translated: The place Mister designated for my mother was this academy's clock tower. Its caretaker's room.

lines.content: お母さんは時間どおり、そして約束どおり、たったひとりでやって来た。
lines.translated: Right on time, and just as promised, my mother came all alone.

lines.content: 娘はどこだと叫ぶお母さん。
lines.translated: My mother shouting, asking where her daughter is.

lines.content: ここにはいないと応えるおじさん。
lines.translated: Mister answering that I'm not here.

lines.content: あんたはいったい誰なんだと泣くお母さん。
lines.translated: My mother crying, asking just who on earth he is.

lines.content: 誘拐犯だよと、うなずくおじさん。
lines.translated: Mister nodding, saying he's the kidnapper.

lines.content: 俺はあなたの娘を誘拐した悪役だ。そしてあなたは正義の味方。[・|今][・|か][・|ら][・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|る]。おじさんは、笑った。
lines.translated: I'm the villain who kidnapped your daughter. And you are the hero of justice. *That's how it's going to be from now on.* Mister smiled.

lines.content: なあ、ハルのお母さん。あなたは世界中から同情という注目がほしいんだろう？　その夢。果てることないその欲望。俺が、叶えてやろう――その代わり
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru's mother. You want the attention known as sympathy from the entire world, don't you? That dream. That endless desire. I'll make it come true for you--In exchange..."

lines.content: 悪いけど、申し訳ないけれど、あなたには、俺の“夢”を叶えるための犠牲になってもらう
lines.translated: "My bad, and I'm sorry to do this, but I'm going to have you become the sacrifice to make my 'dream' come true."

lines.content: 自分の子を、あんなにもかわいい子を、自分の心を満たすことだけに利用しようとした。その報いだと思ってくれていい
lines.translated: "You tried to use your own child, such an adorable child, just to satisfy your own heart. You can think of this as your retribution for that."

lines.content: おじさんに襲いかかるお母さん。
lines.translated: My mother lunging at Mister.

lines.content: その手には、大きなおおきな刃物が握られていて。
lines.translated: In her hand, a huge, massive blade was gripped tightly.

lines.content: 取っ組み合いになったふたりは、小さな部屋で何度もぶつかり、何度も倒れ、何度もののしり合ったりもして。
lines.translated: Locked in a struggle, the two of them crashed into each other over and over in the small room, falling down again and again, hurling curses at one another.

lines.content: ふいに、おじさんは管理室の窓から突き落とされた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Mister was pushed out the window of the caretaker's room.

lines.content: 数十メートルも下の堅い地面に、全身がたたき付けられる音が響いた。
lines.translated: The sound of his entire body slamming against the hard ground dozens of meters below echoed out.

lines.content: そんなおじさんの姿を、開け放たれた窓から見下ろすお母さん。
lines.translated: My mother looking down at Mister's figure from the wide-open window.

lines.content: そのお腹には、手に握られていたはずの大きな刃物が、突き刺さっていて……。
lines.translated: Plunged deep into her stomach was the massive blade she had been gripping in her hand...

lines.content: ふたりはここで命を落とした。
lines.translated: The two of them lost their lives here.

lines.content: 狭まっていくおじさんの視界に、最後に映った涙はいったい[・|誰]のものだっただろう。
lines.translated: Whose tears were the very last thing reflected in Mister's narrowing vision?

lines.content: 私じゃない。
lines.translated: Not mine.

lines.content: おじさんの脳裏に、最後に過ぎった想いも、私へのものじゃない。
lines.translated: The final thoughts that flashed through Mister's mind weren't for me, either.

lines.content: ……ただいま。やっと、会えた
lines.translated: "...I'm home. I finally got to see you."

lines.content: いやだよ。……クロ。泣かないでくれよ。お願いだ。ようやく、俺……君の“隣”に、帰って来れたんだよ
lines.translated: "Don't do that. ...Kuro. Please don't cry. I'm begging you. I've finally... managed to come back to your 'side.'"

lines.content: ――私は、おじさんの“夢”を叶えてしまった。
lines.translated: --I ended up fulfilling Mister's "dream."

lines.content: おじさんは、死ぬことによって“夜の世界”へと戻ると決めたのだ。
lines.translated: Mister had decided to return to the "World of Night" by dying.

lines.content: そうすることで、ずっと想い続けたひとと最後に会える。やっと話せる。やっと触れる。やっと、手を繋いでいられる。
lines.translated: By doing so, he could finally meet the person he had longed for all this time. He could finally talk to her. Finally touch her. Finally hold her hand.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|方][・|法]は、こうでなければならないと信じていた。
lines.translated: He believed *that method* had to be this way.

lines.content: “世界中から愛される正義や慈愛の象徴である母親が、自分の娘を守るため、果敢にもたったひとりで凶悪な誘拐犯に立ち向かい、命を落とした”――
lines.translated: "A mother, beloved by the entire world as a symbol of justice and compassion, bravely stood alone against a vicious kidnapper to protect her daughter, and lost her life"--

lines.content: そういう具合に、変わらずお母さんは世界中から賞賛される。変わることなく、おじさんは世界中から憎まれる。
lines.translated: Just like that, my mother would continue to be praised by the entire world. And without change, Mister would be hated by the entire world.

lines.content: そんな未来は容易に想像できてしまったし……。
lines.translated: It was all too easy to imagine a future like that...

lines.content: そして、そんな世界は間違っている。
lines.translated: And a world like that is wrong.

lines.content: でも、その結末を、誰であろうおじさん自身が望んだのだ。
lines.translated: Yet, that ending was wished for by none other than Mister himself.

lines.content: おじさんの、うそつき。
lines.translated: Mister, you liar.

lines.content: 死ぬことでなせるものなんてないって、言っていたのに。
lines.translated: Even though you told me there's nothing that can be accomplished by dying.

lines.content: おじさんの本当の“夢”
lines.translated: Mister's true "dream."

lines.content: ――“この世で一番の最低最悪な方法で死んでしまいたい”
lines.translated: --"I want to die in the absolute worst, most miserable way in this world."

lines.content: 誰からも憎まれたまま、悪役のまま、たったひとりで死んでいくこと――……それは確かに“最低最悪な死に方のひとつ”だと、私にもそう感じられた。
lines.translated: Dying all alone, hated by everyone, remaining the villain to the very end--...Even I could feel that was certainly "one of the absolute worst ways to die."

lines.content: おじさん……
lines.translated: "Mister..."

lines.content: 私だけの正義の味方。
lines.translated: My very own hero of justice.

lines.content: 私だけが本当のあなたを知っている。
lines.translated: Only I know the real you.

lines.content: ……あなただけが、本当の私を知っている。
lines.translated: And only you know the real me.

lines.content: ねえ、おじさん。教えてよ
lines.translated: "Hey, Mister. Tell me."

lines.content: あなたの“隣”にいるときだけ、私は本当の私になれたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I could only be the real me when I was by your "side"...

lines.content: 私、これからどうやって、生きていけばいいの……？
lines.translated: "How am I supposed to go on living from now on...?"

lines.content: もう私の“隣”に味方はいない。誰も、いない。
lines.translated: There is no longer an ally by my "side." Nobody is there.

lines.content: 長い、ながい、心の“夜”の中で、私はこれからずっとひとりぼっちだ。
lines.translated: In the long, endless "night" of my heart, I will be all alone from here on out.

lines.content: ひどいよ、おじさん。こんなことなら、どうして私を助けたの
lines.translated: "That's awful, Mister. If it was going to end up like this, why did you save me?"

lines.content: おじさんは、命をかけてお母さんの呪縛から私を助けてくれた――結果としては、わかる。あのまま私とふたりきり、どこまでも逃げ続けることは不可能だっただろう。
lines.translated: Mister risked his life to save me from my mother's curse--as a result, I understand. It probably would have been impossible for just the two of us to keep running forever like that.

lines.content: いつか必ず私たちはお母さんに捕まった。世界中がお母さんの味方なのだから。
lines.translated: Someday, my mother definitely would have caught us. Because the whole world was on my mother's side.

lines.content: そうなってしまえば、私はお母さんに殺されてしまっていただろう――私がお母さんの正体を訴えて、周りの人たちは信じてくれただろうか。
lines.translated: If that had happened, my mother probably would have killed me--even if I had tried to expose my mother's true nature, would the people around us have believed me?

lines.content: おじさんとお母さん。そして私。誰の言うことを世界は信じたいと思い込むのだろうか。
lines.translated: Mister and my mother. And me. Whose words would the world want to convince itself to believe?

lines.content: だからおじさんはお母さんを道連れにした。私の人生の中から、お母さんという存在を切り取った。
lines.translated: That's why Mister took my mother down with him. He cut the existence known as my mother out of my life.

lines.content: 私たちが辿り着く結末はそれしかなかったというのも、なんとなくわかる。わかるようにと、努力した。
lines.translated: Deep down, I understand that this was the only ending we could have reached. I tried hard to make myself understand.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: つらく、悲しい――こんな想いだけが残るなら、私たち、出会わなければよかった――……私はあのまま、あの部屋で消えてなくなってしまいたかった。
lines.translated: Painful and sad--if only feelings like these were going to remain, we never should have met--...I wish I had just faded away and disappeared in that room back then.

lines.content: そうすれば、おじさんだってもっと別の未来を歩いて行けたはず。
lines.translated: If I had, then even Mister could have walked toward a much different future.

lines.content: “後悔”だ。
lines.translated: It is "regret."

lines.content: “後悔”ばかりが胸に溢れる。
lines.translated: Nothing but "regrets" overflow in my chest.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だから、私は……。
lines.translated: That is why I...

lines.content: 柊ハル。あなたは、あなたの願いを叶えるために、全人類の敵――“夜の王”と戦うことを選ぶんだね
lines.translated: "Hiiragi Haru. In order to grant your wish, you choose to fight the enemy of all mankind--the 'King of the Night,' don't you?"

lines.content: だから私は、差し伸べられたその小さな手を取ったのだ。
lines.translated: That is why I took that small hand held out to me.

lines.content: 私の愛したたったひとりの“隣”に、もう一度だけ並ぶ、そのために。
lines.translated: Just to stand once more by the "side" of the one and only person I loved.

lines.content: 短い夢から[・|俺]は目覚めた。
lines.translated: *I* woke from the brief dream.

lines.content: 俺の“魔法”が射貫いたハルの“悪夢”
lines.translated: Haru's "Nightmare," pierced through by my "magic."

lines.content: ……そこから伝わってきたハルの思い。
lines.translated: Haru's feelings that were conveyed to me from within it.

lines.content: それは、まだ見ぬ[・|未][・|来]から届いたたくさんの言葉たちだ。
lines.translated: They were countless words reaching me from a *future* yet unseen.

lines.content: ……そう。未来だ。
lines.translated: That's right. The future.

lines.content: 今見た光景は、まだ起こっていない出来事。
lines.translated: The scene I just witnessed is an event that hasn't happened yet.

lines.content: これから何年もの先に、この町で起こる出来事なのだ。
lines.translated: It's an event that will take place in this town many years from now.

lines.content: ……ハル。俺たちはまだ出会ってさえいなかった。
lines.translated: Haru. The two of us hadn't even met yet.

lines.content: ……しかし、まったく
lines.translated: "...Still, good grief."

lines.content: やれやれだ。
lines.translated: What a mess.

lines.content: ため息しか出ない。
lines.translated: All I can do is sigh.
"...What the hell are you doing, *future me*?"

lines.content: 遙か昔の少年時代に克服したはずの“死にたい気持ち”
lines.translated: That "desire to die" I was supposed to have overcome way back in my boyhood.

lines.content: それをまた引きずって……。
lines.translated: Dragging that around again...

lines.content: 今現在の俺でさえ、どうしてそんな“願い”を抱いていたのか、[・|思][・|い][・|出][・|せ][・|も][・|し][・|な][・|い][・|の][・|に]……。
lines.translated: Even though the current me *can't even remember* why I ever held such a "wish" in the first place...

lines.content: また、死にたいだのとのたまった挙げ句……
lines.translated: "Spouting off about wanting to die all over again..."

lines.content: その結果、ハルをひとりにさせてしまってどうする――……その、結果、
lines.translated: And as a result, leaving Haru all alone--what the hell are you doing? ...And as a result of that,

lines.content: 自分が守ろうとした女の子に、ハルに、助けられてしまって……、どうするんだよ
lines.translated: "Ending up being saved by the girl you were trying to protect, by Haru... What the hell are you doing?"

lines.content: “悪夢”の続きだ――その中で、ハルの“魔法”がわかったのだ。
lines.translated: It was in the continuation of that "Nightmare"--within it, I figured out what Haru's "magic" was.

lines.content: 十年前の“夜”
lines.translated: The "Night" ten years ago.

lines.content: 全人類の敵――“夜の王”をみんなと一緒に打倒した先に、静かに見上げた満開の下、ハルが願った“魔法”
lines.translated: Beyond the battle where we defeated the enemy of all mankind--the "King of the Night"--together, quietly looking up beneath the full bloom, the "magic" Haru wished for.

lines.content: 『おじさん……』
lines.translated: "*Mister...*"
"*We never should have met.*"

lines.content: “大切な人に起こる未来の不幸を肩代わりすること”
lines.translated: "To take on the future misfortune that will befall someone precious to me."

lines.content: それが、幼いハルの願った“魔法”だった。
lines.translated: That was the "magic" young Haru wished for.

lines.content: 俺の未来にこれから起こる[死|不幸]を、運命を、ハルがその“魔法”で肩代わりしてしまったからこそ――ハル。彼女は、逃れられない死の運命を背負い込んでしまっていた。
lines.translated: Precisely because Haru used that "magic" to take on the misfortune--the death, the fate--that would happen in my future... Haru. She ended up shouldering an inescapable fate of death.

lines.content: 全部、俺のためだ。
lines.translated: It was all for my sake.

lines.content: 全部、俺のせいだ。
lines.translated: It is all my fault.

lines.content: いつか訪れる未来。俺に降りかかる死を回避させるため、ハルは“魔法”を使った。
lines.translated: A future that would arrive someday. To help me avoid the death that would befall me, Haru used her "magic."

lines.content: そして、現在。
lines.translated: And now, in the present.

lines.content: 俺は、そんなハルを助けようと“魔法”を使った――……
lines.translated: I used my "magic" to try and save Haru--...

lines.content: ああ、そうか
lines.translated: "Ah, I see."

lines.content: ハルの“悪夢”が嘆いていた言葉を思い出す。
lines.translated: I remember the words Haru's "Nightmare" had lamented.

lines.content: 『おねがいだから、これ以上先へは、進まないで』
lines.translated: "*Please, I'm begging you, don't go any further than this.*"

lines.content: 何度“魔法”を使っても。
lines.translated: No matter how many times I use "magic."

lines.content: 何度“過去”へ戻っても。
lines.translated: No matter how many times I return to the "past."

lines.content: 何度、やり直そうとも。
lines.translated: No matter how many times I try to start over.

lines.content: すべて上手くいかない理由を、ここでようやく理解した。
lines.translated: Here, I finally understood the reason why nothing was working out.

lines.content: ……ハル。俺たちは、ずっと互いを助けようとしてたんだな
lines.translated: "...Haru. We've been trying to save each other this whole time, haven't we?"

lines.content: 俺が君を助ければ、未来の中で俺が死に……。
lines.translated: If I save you, I die in the future...

lines.content: 君が俺を助ければ、現在の中で君が死に……。
lines.translated: If you save me, you die in the present...

lines.content: 君は、俺を。
lines.translated: You, trying to save me.

lines.content: 俺は、君を。
lines.translated: Me, trying to save you.

lines.content: 互いの想いがぶつかり合っていて……。
lines.translated: Our feelings for each other are clashing head-on...

lines.content: 辿り着くべき未来はどこだ。
lines.translated: Where is the future we are supposed to reach?

lines.content: ……“[魔法|弾丸]”は残り、あと、一発だけ
lines.translated: "...There is only one 'bullet'--one piece of 'magic'--left."

lines.content: 俺は、深く静かな“夜”の中――たったひとり、そうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: In the deep, quiet "night"--all alone, I muttered those words.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]既に数日が経過していた。
lines.translated: Several days had already passed *since then*.

lines.content: この学園の生徒、柊ハルが、自らその命を手放して――今日、学園は通常どおりの流れに戻った。
lines.translated: A student of this academy, Hiiragi Haru, let go of her own life--and today, the academy returned to its normal routine.

lines.content: せわしなく出入りしていた外部の者たちが、これは自殺であり、事件性は皆無であると判断したからだった。
lines.translated: Because the outsiders who had been busily coming and going determined that it was a suicide, with no foul play involved whatsoever.

lines.content: そんな中。
lines.translated: Amidst all of this.

lines.content: 俺は……。
（……どうする。次に“魔法”を使えば、もうそれで[・|終][・|わ][・|り]だ）
lines.translated: (...What do I do? The next time I use "magic," it'll be *all over*.)

lines.content: 俺は、残り一回限りの“魔法”を、未だに使うことができずにいた。
lines.translated: I still hadn't been able to use the one and only piece of "magic" I had left.

lines.content: （……最後の“魔法”を使い切り、またあの時計塔の管理室に戻ったところで、そこからどうすればいい？）
lines.translated: (...Even if I use up my last "magic" and return to that clock tower control room again, what am I supposed to do from there?)

lines.content: この俺には元より“悪夢”と対するための方法がない。
lines.translated: From the very beginning, I never had a way to fight against the "Nightmare."

lines.content: 唯一の武器は“拳銃の魔法”だけだった――自らの死によって（文字通りこの時間世界の肉体的な死によって）[・|あ][・|の][・|日]に戻る。直接的な攻撃を“悪夢”に仕掛けられるものではない。
lines.translated: My only weapon was the "handgun magic"--returning to *that day* through my own death (quite literally, my physical death in this timeline). It wasn't something that could launch a direct attack on the "Nightmare."

lines.content: しかしもはやあと一度きりしか、リセットすることは叶わない。
lines.translated: However, I could only reset things one last time.

lines.content: 残された一度きりの“魔法”を使った先で、これまで同様、ハルが、ハル自身の“悪夢”に殺されてしまえば……。
lines.translated: If I used that one remaining "magic," and just like every time before, Haru ended up being killed by her own "Nightmare"...

lines.content: 終わりだ。
lines.translated: It would be over.

lines.content: そこが本当の終わりなのだ。もう俺の手の中にハルを取り戻すための“魔法”はない。
lines.translated: That would be the true end. I wouldn't have any more "magic" in my hands to bring Haru back.

lines.content: だからといって、このままずるずると無駄に時を重ねていくわけにもいかない。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't just keep dragging my feet and wasting time like this.

lines.content: ……俺は、ハルを助けると決めた。
lines.translated: I had decided I was going to save Haru.

lines.content: ハルの真意を知った今であっても、ごめんハル、尚更に俺の決意は強くなる一方だ。
lines.translated: Even now that I knew Haru's true intentions--sorry, Haru, my resolve is only growing stronger.

lines.content: （まずは、ハル……。もう一度君と会って、色々なことを、君の口から直接聞きたい）
lines.translated: (First of all, Haru... I want to see you one more time and hear everything directly from your own lips.)

lines.content: [・|君][・|に][・|は][・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|き][・|な][・|い][・|理][・|由][・|が][・|あ][・|る]のは知っている。さっき覗き見た“悪夢”の続きの中にその理由は語られていた。
lines.translated: I know *you have a reason why you can't do that*. That reason was told within the continuation of the "Nightmare" I had caught a glimpse of earlier.

lines.content: （だからこそ、俺は君からちゃんとした説明をしてもらわなきゃならないんだ）
lines.translated: (That's precisely why I need to get a proper explanation from you.)

lines.content: ならばどれだけこうして悩もうと、いつかはまた“魔法”を使わねばならないのだ。
lines.translated: If that was the case, no matter how much I agonized over it like this, I would eventually have to use the "magic" again.

lines.content: 柊ハルは死亡した。その事実を書き換えるために。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru died. In order to rewrite that fact.

lines.content: そんな反問を延々と今日まで俺は繰り返してきた。
lines.translated: I had been endlessly repeating this back-and-forth inside my head all the way until today.

lines.content: どころか、今日まで“ゆめのねどこ”の自室に殆ど引きこもっていた。
lines.translated: In fact, up until today, I had practically shut myself away in my room at "Dream's Bed."

lines.content: ふさぎ込んでいたわけではない。これから自分がどうすべきなのかを、自分なりに考えていたつもりだった。
lines.translated: It wasn't that I was moping around. In my own way, I had been trying to figure out what I needed to do from here on out.

lines.content: ……自分なりにこの行き詰まった道のどこかに、きらりと光る“希望”を探しているつもりでは、あったのだ。
lines.translated: In my own way, I was trying to search for a shining glimmer of "hope" somewhere along this dead-end road.

lines.content: だが、下手な考え休むに似たりとでもいおうか――どう考えを巡らせても、[・|残][・|り][・|一][・|発][・|で][・|試][・|せ][・|る][・|解][・|決][・|案]は、ついに今日まで芽生えることはなかった。
lines.translated: However, as the saying goes, poor thinking is no better than resting--no matter how much I racked my brain, a *solution I could try with my one remaining shot* never once sprouted up until today.
(*It's not enough*...)

lines.content: そんなふうに嘆き、頭を抱えてばかりいた。
lines.translated: All I could do was lament like that and hold my head in my hands.
(*No matter how I look at it, I'm one shot short.*)

lines.content: 数日ぶりに顔を合わせた智仁や千和や姫織とは、言葉を交わすことは殆どなかった。
lines.translated: When I saw Tomohito, Chiwa, and Himeori for the first time in several days, we barely exchanged a word.

lines.content: 誰も何も言わなかったけれど、ふとぶつかり合う視線の色で、言葉以上の心を理解し合えたと思う――“どうして、こんなことに”
lines.translated: Nobody said anything, yet from the emotion in our eyes whenever our gazes happened to meet, I felt we understood each other's hearts more deeply than words could ever convey--"Why did it have to come to this?"

lines.content: そんな動揺とも悲しさともつかない感情が、みんなの瞳の奥に今もまだ揺れ動いていた。
lines.translated: That indefinable mix of turmoil and sorrow was still wavering deep within everyone's eyes even now.

lines.content: もしあと一発弾丸があったところで、そして俺の[・|思][・|惑][・|ど][・|お][・|り]に運んだところで。
lines.translated: Even if I had one more bullet, and even if everything went *just as I hoped*.

lines.content: 彼らの中の悲しさをぬぐい去ることは、できない――この時間世界の中の柊ハルは、永遠に死んだままなのだ。
lines.translated: I wouldn't be able to wipe away the sadness inside them--the Hiiragi Haru of this timeline would remain dead forever.

lines.content: （ハル……。俺、どうしたらいいのかな）
lines.translated: (Haru... What am I supposed to do?)

lines.content: 手のひらの中には“[魔法|弾丸]”が一発。それを堅く、強く、握りしめている。
lines.translated: There was a single "bullet" of "magic" in the palm of my hand. I was gripping it tightly, fiercely.

lines.content: ……授業内容は特に事件前と変わらない。
lines.translated: The content of the classes hadn't particularly changed from before the incident.

lines.content: 俺が今、最も解決しなければならない問題の答えを、その黒板に書き記してくれることもない。
lines.translated: Nor would the answer to the problem I needed to solve most right now ever be written out for me on that blackboard.

lines.content: たったひとりの命が消えてなくなってしまっても、この世界は何ら問題なく淡々と続いていくのだ……
lines.translated: Even when a single life vanishes and is lost forever, this world simply carries on indifferently as if nothing is wrong...

lines.content: そんなありきたりな言葉で、一番最初にこの[・|空][・|気]を表現したのはいったい誰だろう。
lines.translated: Who on earth was the very first person to describe this *atmosphere* with such cliche words?

lines.content: その安易さに、今はどこか胸焼けさえ覚えてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Right now, the sheer cheapness of that thought almost gave me heartburn.

lines.content: チャイム。
lines.translated: The chime rang.

lines.content: 本日の就業過程がすべて終わる。
lines.translated: All of today's school hours came to an end.

lines.content: 帰り支度を整え、俺はひとり立ち上がった。
lines.translated: Getting my things ready to go home, I stood up alone.

lines.content: 誰の声も背後から投げかけられることはない。
lines.translated: No one called out to me from behind.

lines.content: 俺は、教室から出た。
lines.translated: I walked out of the classroom.

lines.content: 玄関へ向かい一階廊下を進んでいると、[・|そ][・|れ]に気づいた。
lines.translated: As I was walking down the first-floor hallway toward the entrance, I noticed *it*.

lines.content: 中庭の花壇だ。
lines.translated: It was the flowerbed in the courtyard.

lines.content: そこに植えられた花の中心が、がさがさと揺れていた。
lines.translated: The center of the flowers planted there was rustling and shaking.

lines.content: ……なんだろう
lines.translated: "...What could that be?"

lines.content: つぶやきながらも、予感はあった。
lines.translated: Even as I muttered that, I had a hunch.

lines.content: こんな光景、つい最近、俺は見たことがある。
lines.translated: I had seen a sight just like this very recently.

lines.content: ぴょこりと、花の中から真っ白な尻尾と耳が飛び出した。
lines.translated: With a little pop, a pure white tail and ears sprang out from among the flowers.

lines.content: クロ……？
lines.translated: "Kuro...?"

lines.content: 名前を呼ぶと素直に顔を出してくれた。
lines.translated: When I called her name, she obediently poked her face out.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: 目が、合う。
lines.translated: Our eyes met.

lines.content: 小首をかしげるようないつもの仕草。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly in her usual gesture.

lines.content: 今にも『……見つかっちゃった』と、少しだけ照れくさそうないつもの表情を見せてくれそうだった。
lines.translated: She looked as though she were about to show me her usual, slightly sheepish expression at any moment and say, "...You found me."

lines.content: 思わず、だ。
lines.translated: It was completely involuntary.

lines.content: そんなクロの顔を見た瞬間、思わず俺は叫び出しそうに、なった――“クロ。どうしよう。どうしたら、いい？　何かいい方法、一緒に考えてほしい”
lines.translated: The instant I saw Kuro's face like that, I almost cried out on impulse--"Kuro. What do I do? What should I do? Please, help me think of a good way out of this."

lines.content: [・|自][・|分][・|ひ][・|と][・|り][・|だ][・|け][・|で]解決しなければならないはずの問題を、その重さを、お願いだから半分だけでも背負ってくれないかと、祈るように――思わず弱音を吐き出しそうになっていた。
lines.translated: Like a prayer, begging her to shoulder even half the weight of this problem that I was supposed to solve *entirely on my own*--I was on the verge of spilling out all my weakness without thinking.

lines.content: だが、だめだ。
lines.translated: No, I can't.

lines.content: 弱音を吐くことの善し悪しでは、ない――……クロ。俺の相棒。あるいは、大切な家族。
lines.translated: It wasn't a matter of whether showing weakness was right or wrong--...Kuro. My partner. Or rather, my precious family.

lines.content: 俺の代償は“孤独”
lines.translated: My price was "solitude."

lines.content: 今、目の前にいる君は、俺の知ってる君だけど、そうではないとも言えるのだ。
lines.translated: The you standing in front of me right now is the you I know, and yet, in a way, you aren't.

lines.content: 君の[想像力|心]を利用するような真似をして、“拳銃の魔法”を作り上げた――[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]の君ではない。
lines.translated: You aren't the you from *back then*--when I practically took advantage of your heart, your imagination, to create the "handgun magic."

lines.content: 一緒に“ハルを助けるための魔法”を作り出そうとした君のいた時間。
lines.translated: The timeline where you tried to create "magic to save Haru" together with me.

lines.content: その一番最初を“Ａ”と仮定するなら、ここは既に“Ｅ”なのだ。
lines.translated: If we assume that very first one was "A," then this place is already "E."

lines.content: ……たくさん、たくさんの君たちに、俺は身勝手な“死”だけを置いて、ここまで駆け出してきた。
lines.translated: Leaving behind nothing but my own selfish "death" for so, so many versions of you, I had come running all the way here.

lines.content: ハルを助けたい。そのためにはこの方法が最善なのだと、信じて。
lines.translated: I want to save Haru. Believing that this method was the best way to do so.

lines.content: だけど……、
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……クロ。ごめん
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 俺は、とんでもないことをしでかしてしまっているのではないか――今さらになって、そんな罪悪感にも似た感情に襲われていた。
lines.translated: Haven't I done something utterly unforgivable?--Only now was I overcome by an emotion akin to guilt.

lines.content: 俺が敵対しているものはハルの“悪夢”ではなく、もしくは“運命”なんかでもなく。
lines.translated: Perhaps what I am fighting against isn't Haru's "Nightmare," nor is it even "fate."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を作った神のような“何か”なのでは、ないだろうか。
lines.translated: Could it be "something" like a god that created *all of it*?

lines.content: もしもそうなら、こんなちっぽけなこの俺に、勝ち目などはじめからないのではないか……。
lines.translated: If that's true, then someone as tiny and insignificant as me never stood a chance of winning from the very start...

lines.content: だからこの“孤独”は自身の決めた“代償”なんかではない。神さまからの罰なのか――そう思えて、ならなかった。
lines.translated: Which means this "solitude" isn't a "price" I chose for myself at all. Could it be divine punishment?--I couldn't help but feel that way.

lines.content: ……ほんとに、ごめん。クロ。みんな。許してほしい
lines.translated: "...I'm really sorry. Kuro. Everyone. Please forgive me."

lines.content: わかってる。わかっているんだ。
lines.translated: I know. I know already.

lines.content: 今、ここにいる君に謝っても伝わらない。
lines.translated: Even if I apologize to the you who is here right now, it won't reach the right place.

lines.content: 本来謝らなければならないはずの君は、もうずっと、ずっと、二度と会うことのできない遙か彼方に置いてきてしまっていて……、
lines.translated: The you I truly owe an apology to has been left behind so, so far away, in a place I can never return to again...

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: ……ふと、クロがつま先立ちをし、俺の頬に指先で触れた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Kuro stood on her tiptoes and touched my cheek with her fingertips.
"...I finally *caught up to you*. Taiga."

lines.content: 息を、呑む。
lines.translated: My breath caught in my throat.

lines.content: ……大雅は歩くの、速いから。わたし……いつだってきみに追いつくの、大変なんだ
lines.translated: "...You walk so fast, Taiga. It's... always so hard for me to catch up to you."

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: 君が俺の名前をそっと呼ぶ。
lines.translated: You softly called my name.

lines.content: 今まで、たぶん、大雅はひとりでたくさんがんばってきた――ハルのことを助けるために。そうだよね……？
lines.translated: "Up until now, Taiga, you've probably been working so hard all by yourself--to save Haru. Right...?"

lines.content: あ、ああ……え？
