lines.translated: "Ah, yeah... Huh?"

lines.content: 唇が、震えていた。
lines.translated: My lips were trembling.

lines.content: どうして、クロ。君がそのことを
lines.translated: "How, Kuro? How do you know about that...?"

lines.content: たぶんこの声も震えていただろうはず。
lines.translated: My voice must have been trembling, too.

lines.content: ……そんな俺に、クロは微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Looking at me like that, Kuro was smiling.

lines.content: ……わかるよ
lines.translated: "...I can tell."

lines.content: わたしは、おばかな子だけど……それだけは、わかる
lines.translated: "I'm a silly girl, but... I can tell that much, at least."
"Because I'm *the me who made the 'magic' together with you*."

lines.content: ……でもね。大雅。もしもそうじゃなかったとしても、わたしは[・|そ][・|う][・|だ]ってわかったはずだと、思う。たとえ誰にも頼れなくても、大雅はひとりでハルを助けようとしてるはずだって
lines.translated: "...Even so, Taiga. Even if that weren't true, I think I still would have known *that was the case*. That even if you couldn't rely on anyone else, you would be trying to save Haru all by yourself."

lines.content: どうして……
大雅は知らないだろうけど、大雅……きみはね、とってもやさしい子なんだよ。そんなきみが[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]、放っておくなんて。できない。絶対に
lines.translated: "You probably don't realize it yourself, Taiga... but you're a very, very kind boy. There's no way someone like you could just leave *something like that* alone. You couldn't. Never."

lines.content: だからきっと、わたしの知らないところでもいっぱい、たくさん、何かとてもすごく大変なことをがんばってきていたはずだよと、クロは、いつものようにたどたどしく言うのだ。
lines.translated: "So I'm sure that even in places I don't know about, you've been doing your absolute best, working so, so hard on something terribly difficult," Kuro said in her usual halting way.

lines.content: そんなきみのこと、わたし、近くで見てはいられなかったけど……でも、わかるんだよ。誰がなんと言おうと、きみがなんと言おうと、大雅、きみはいっぱいがんばってきたんだ
lines.translated: "I couldn't be right there beside you to watch over you... but I still know. No matter what anyone says, no matter what you say, Taiga, you've worked so, so hard."

lines.content: 違うとは言わせないよ。絶対に――クロの声にはそんな強い意思のようなものを、感じさせられた。
lines.translated: I won't let you say otherwise. Never--I could feel a fierce determination like that in Kuro's voice.

lines.content: だからね、大雅。そんなきみに渡したいものが、あって……だからわたしも、きみのことを追いかけて、やっと、なんとかここまで――……っ
lines.translated: "That's why, Taiga. There's something I want to give you... So I chased after you, too, and finally, somehow made it all the way here--...!"

lines.content: 抱きしめていた。
lines.translated: I was hugging her.

lines.content: クロの小さな身体を、強く。
lines.translated: Holding Kuro's small body tightly against me.

lines.content: た、大雅……
lines.translated: "T-Taiga..."

lines.content: そのままふたり、その場にへたり込むようにして、膝を折った。
lines.translated: Just like that, the two of us sank down to the ground, our knees giving out beneath us.

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 涙だ……。
lines.translated: Tears...

lines.content: 涙が、にじんだ。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in my eyes.

lines.content: そんな俺のことを、クロは小さな身体で必死に抱き留めようとしてくれていた。背中に回された君の腕の感触がしっかりと伝わってくる。
lines.translated: With her small body, Kuro was desperately trying to hold me up. I could clearly feel the warmth of your arms wrapped around my back.

lines.content: ……情けない。
lines.translated: How pathetic.

lines.content: 何なんだ、俺は。
lines.translated: What the hell is wrong with me?

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: 自分よりずっと小さな子に抱きしめられて、がまんできずに泣くなんて。
lines.translated: Being hugged by a girl so much smaller than me, unable to hold back my tears and crying like this.

lines.content: それでも、涙も言葉も、止められないだなんて。
lines.translated: And yet, I couldn't stop the tears, nor the words, from spilling out.

lines.content: ……クロ。ごめん、聞いてほしい
lines.translated: "...Kuro. I'm sorry, please listen to me."

lines.content: うん。聞いてる
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm listening."

lines.content: ハルを救いたい。その気持ちは絶対に、正しい。神さまにだって文句は絶対に言わせない。それくらい、正しいんだ――……
lines.translated: "I want to save Haru. That feeling is绝对, undeniably right. I wouldn't even let God complain about it. That's how right it is--..."

lines.content: ……そんなふうに思い込みたいばっかりに、俺は、この世で唯一絶対不変であるはずの“時間”に、その領域に、土足で踏み込み……結果、
lines.translated: Because I wanted so badly to convince myself of that, I trampled right into the domain of "time"--the one thing in this world that is supposed to be absolute and unchanging... And as a result,

lines.content: 大きなおおきな……神さまとか、それくらいの大きな“何か”を、怒らせてしまったのかもしれない
lines.translated: "I might have angered something huge, something massive... like God, or 'something' just as immense."

lines.content: ハルを助けたいと願うのは俺のエゴなのだ。
lines.translated: Wishing to save Haru is nothing more than my own ego.

lines.content: ハル自身は“死んでしまいたい”と願ってる――こんな俺なんかの、ために。
lines.translated: Haru herself wishes to die--for the sake of someone like me.

lines.content: 俺、自分の気持ちを解消したいばかりで、その度に、別の時間に自分だけ逃げていって……残された君たちの気持ちを、まったく考えてこなかった。[・|こ][・|れ]はその罰なんだ。きっと
lines.translated: "I just wanted to ease my own conscience, and every time, I ran away all by myself to another timeline... I never once thought about how all of you left behind would feel. *This* must be my punishment for that. I'm sure of it."

lines.content: ……だから、どんなに不安でも怖くても……“孤独”でも。絶対に諦めちゃだめなんだって、思ってた
lines.translated: "...So I thought that no matter how anxious or scared I was... no matter how 'alone' I was, I must never, ever give up."

lines.content: 誰も味方はいない。頼れる者は誰ひとりとして存在しない――[孤独|これ]が神さまからの罰なのだと感じていた。
lines.translated: I had no allies. There wasn't a single person I could rely on--I felt that this solitude was my punishment from God.

lines.content: だから決して弱音を吐いてはいけない。諦めてもいけない。
lines.translated: So I must never complain or show weakness. I must never give up.

lines.content: 自分にそう言い聞かせてきた。
lines.translated: That was what I had been telling myself all this time.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: こうして、どういうわけだか俺と同じように“時間”を飛び越え、俺の“[孤独|代償]”をも振り払い、やって来てくれた味方がたったひとり、そばにいてくれる――……それだけで、クロ。
lines.translated: And yet here you are, my one and only ally, having somehow leaped across "time" just like me, shaking off the price of my solitude to come be by my side--...Just that alone, Kuro.

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: それだけで、たくさんの“想い”が瞬く間に決壊していくようだった。
lines.translated: Just that alone made it feel as though the floodgates holding back all my emotions were breaking open in an instant.

lines.content: どれだけの間このままでいただろう。
lines.translated: How long did we stay like that?

lines.content: 君の小さな胸元は、なんだかチョコレートみたいに甘い匂いがしていた。
lines.translated: Your small chest carried a sweet scent, almost like chocolate.

lines.content: ……ざわざわと辺りが騒がしくなってくる。
lines.translated: Gradually, a noisy commotion began to stir around us.

lines.content: ごめん、クロ。君にはまだまだたくさん、ごめんなさいも、ありがとうも、伝えなきゃならないんだけど……
lines.translated: "Sorry, Kuro. There are still so many apologies and thank-yous I need to give you, and yet..."

lines.content: 俺は、君の胸元から離れる――
lines.translated: I pulled away from your chest--

lines.content: ――少し、さみしそうな顔。
lines.translated: --A slightly lonely expression on her face.

lines.content: そう感じるのもやはりこの俺のエゴだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it just my own ego making me think she looked that way, too?

lines.content: そんな俺だから、今さら[・|そ][・|れ]に気づく。
lines.translated: Because I was so caught up in myself, it took me until now to notice *it*.

lines.content: ……クロは良くよく見れば[・|制][・|服][・|姿]だ。
lines.translated: Looking closely, Kuro was *wearing a school uniform*.

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: その、制服。やっぱり、クロに良く似合ってるよ
lines.translated: "That uniform. It really does look great on you, Kuro."

lines.content: すっごくかわいい――そう伝えると、クロの頭から猫の耳が、弱々しくぴこりと飛び出し、揺れていた。
lines.translated: It's super cute--when I told her that, a pair of cat ears weakly popped out from her head, twitching and swaying.

lines.content: たくさんの視線を避け、時計塔の管理室にまで移動した。
lines.translated: Avoiding the many prying eyes around us, we moved all the way to the clock tower's caretaker room.

lines.content: ――クロが俺に渡したいもの。
lines.translated: --The thing Kuro wanted to give me.

lines.content: それは一発の“弾丸”だった。
lines.translated: It was a single "bullet."

lines.content: 差し出されたクロの小さな手のひらに、それは握られていた。
lines.translated: It rested in the small palm Kuro held out to me.

lines.content: これって……
lines.translated: "This is..."

lines.content: “魔法”
lines.translated: "Magic."

lines.content: クロは言う。
lines.translated: So said Kuro.

lines.content: ……柊ハルの命を取り戻すために作った、大雅とわたしの“魔法”だよ
lines.translated: "...This is the 'magic' you and I made together to take back Hiiragi Haru's life, Taiga."

lines.content: でも、クロ
lines.translated: "But, Kuro..."

lines.content: おかしい。
lines.translated: That's strange.

lines.content: “魔法”の“弾丸”は六発限りなんじゃ……
lines.translated: "Aren't there only six 'magic bullets'...?"

lines.content: 七発あったなんて。
lines.translated: To think there was a seventh.

lines.content: ならばどうして、最初から七発目は俺の手の中に現れなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: If so, then why hadn't the seventh bullet appeared in my hand from the very beginning?

lines.content: 猫の命は
lines.translated: "Because a cat..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?
"...has *lots* of lives."

lines.content: それはどういうことなのか。
lines.translated: What did she mean by that?

lines.content: その問いかけを予想してのことだろうか――クロは俺の口を塞ぐみたいに、素早く言った。
lines.translated: Perhaps anticipating that very question--Kuro spoke quickly, as if to stop the words in my mouth.

lines.content: 大雅。この“魔法”がほんとにほんとの“最後”だよ
lines.translated: "Taiga. This 'magic' is the real, absolute 'last one.'"

lines.content: これがあれば大雅[・|だ][・|け]は安心して、もう一度、時間を撃ち破ることができる――力強くうなずくクロから、[・|そ][・|れ]を俺は受け取った。
lines.translated: With this, *only* Taiga can safely shatter time once more--as Kuro nodded firmly, I took *it* from her hand.
"...*Only* me?"

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: わたしはこの先に、もう、大雅とは一緒に行けない
lines.translated: "I can't go with you beyond this point anymore, Taiga."

lines.content: どきりとした。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: ……もう、どんなに歩いても、走っても……叫んでも。わたしはきみの隣には、追いつけなくなる
lines.translated: "...No matter how much I walk, or run... or shout. I won't be able to catch up to your side anymore."

lines.content: さっき届いたばかりの安心が、次の瞬間には根こそぎ消えてなくなってしまう。そんな感覚があった。
lines.translated: It felt as though the relief that had just reached me a moment ago was ripped away by the roots in the very next instant.

lines.content: どうして……
どうして、そんなことに。
lines.translated: Why would that happen?

lines.content: そう力なく問いかける俺に、クロは答えてくれる。
lines.translated: When I weakly asked her that, Kuro answered me.

lines.content: ……ここまでは大雅[・|だ][・|け]の“魔法”だった
lines.translated: "...Up until now, it was *only* your 'magic,' Taiga."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: この“魔法”は、大雅とわたし、ふたりで作り上げたものだから……。だから、この“魔法”を使うとき、大雅ひとりだけじゃ力の効果も半分になってた
lines.translated: "This 'magic' was created by the two of us, you and me... So when you used it all by yourself, Taiga, its power and effect were cut in half."

lines.content: 一番最初に“魔法”を使ったとき。
lines.translated: The very first time I used the "magic."

lines.content: クロはこの“魔法”の正体を知り、その“[・|代][・|償]”の有り様を知り、部屋から飛び出してしまっていた。
lines.translated: Kuro had realized the true nature of this "magic," and the nature of its "*price*," and had fled from the room.

lines.content: 最期の瞬間なんてわざわざ見せる必要はない。そんな思いから、俺はたったひとり、引き金を引いたけれど……。
lines.translated: Thinking there was no need to go out of my way to make her watch my final moments, I had pulled the trigger all alone, and yet...

lines.content: しかしこの“魔法”は確かに、クロと俺、ふたりで作り上げたものだ。互いの心の中にこそ“魔法”の原石のようなものが眠ってる。
lines.translated: This "magic" was indeed something Kuro and I had built together. The raw, unpolished stone of that "magic" slumbered within both of our hearts.

lines.content: それをどちらか片方だけが使用しても、その効果が半分になってしまうのもまた当然といえば当然だったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: So if only one of us used it on our own, perhaps it was only natural for its effect to be halved.

lines.content: そんなことにも思い至れないほど、俺は必死になっていた――必死に、懸命に、ハルを助けたい一心で、それ以外には注視すること叶わず、走り続けてきた。
lines.translated: I had been so desperate that I hadn't even realized something so simple--desperately, earnestly, with the single-minded desire to save Haru, I had kept running, unable to pay attention to anything else.

lines.content: きれい事で今現在を飾るのであれば、そういうことにもなる。
lines.translated: Or at least, that's how it would sound if I dressed up my current state in pretty words.

lines.content: ……でも、わたしはきみに追いつけた
lines.translated: "...But I managed to catch up to you."

lines.content: 俺が最後の一発を使うことを躊躇い、立ち止まってしまっていたから。
lines.translated: Because I had hesitated to use the final bullet, stopping in my tracks.

lines.content: だから、大雅の“魔法”と、わたしの“魔法”は、ここでひとつになれたよ
lines.translated: "So your 'magic' and my 'magic' were able to become one right here."

lines.content: ……つまり？
lines.translated: "...Which means?"

lines.content: ここからようやく、ふたりの“魔法”になるんだよ
lines.translated: "From here on out, it finally becomes our 'magic' together."

lines.content: ……大雅。試してみたいことが、あるんだよね。その“[魔法|弾丸]”で
lines.translated: "...Taiga. There's something you want to try, isn't there? With that 'magic bullet.'"

lines.content: 確かにそうだ。
lines.translated: That was certainly true.

lines.content: ハルを救い出すための最善の方法はなんであるのか。
lines.translated: What was the absolute best way to save Haru?

lines.content: 今日まで俺は繰り返し考え続けてきた――結果、あと一発足りない。そんな結論に至ったのだ。
lines.translated: I had thought about it over and over again right up until today--and in the end, I had reached the conclusion that I was one bullet short.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を、この管理室に来るまでの間、クロに聞いてもらっていた。
lines.translated: I had explained *that* to Kuro on our way to this caretaker room.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は言うほど画期的ではないし、めざましいほどの“希望”を与えてくれる方法でも、なかった――なぜなら[・|そ][・|れ]は、あんまりにも人任せであるからだ。
lines.translated: *It* wasn't as groundbreaking as it sounded, nor was it a method that offered any remarkable "hope"--because *it* relied far too heavily on leaving things up to someone else.

lines.content: だけどクロは『信じてみてもいいかもしれない』と言ってくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, Kuro had told me, "Maybe it's okay to try believing in it."

lines.content: おばかなわたしじゃ、正しい答えなんて、わからないけど……
lines.translated: "I'm a silly girl, so I don't know what the right answer is, though..."

lines.content: でも、大雅。きみがそうしてみたいと思うなら、それはきみの未来にとって大切なことで……きっと、どこかに、確かな“希望”があるからなんだよ
lines.translated: "But, Taiga. If that's what you want to try doing, then it must be something important for your future... and I'm sure it's because there is real, certain 'hope' somewhere in it."

lines.content: だからわたしは、その“希望”に、わたし達の“夢”のすべてを賭けてみたいよと、クロは静かにそう言った――……でも。
lines.translated: "That's why I want to bet everything on our 'dream' for the sake of that 'hope,'" Kuro had said quietly--...And yet.

lines.content: ……これで、“最後”
lines.translated: "...This is the 'last one.'"

lines.content: 俺は、つぶやく。
lines.translated: I muttered.

lines.content: ……そして、クロはもう、俺を追いかけては来れなくなる。この時間の外には、出られない
lines.translated: "...And Kuro, you won't be able to chase after me anymore. You can't step outside of this time."

lines.content: それはつまり――……。
lines.translated: Which meant--...

lines.content: これを使えば、クロとはもう
lines.translated: "If I use this, then you and I will never..."

lines.content: ふっと、クロは窓の外を見た。
lines.translated: Softly, Kuro looked out the window.

lines.content: そして、言う。安心して、と。
lines.translated: And then, she told me not to worry.

lines.content: わたしは平気。こんなの、何でもない
lines.translated: "I'll be fine. Something like this is nothing at all."

lines.content: さよならには慣れてるし、大雅。きみの死体は、わたしが……わたしだけしか知らない場所に、隠すから
lines.translated: "I'm used to goodbyes, Taiga. And as for your body, I'll... hide it in a place that only I know about."

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: ……この時間の中の千和たちには、やっぱり悲しい思いをさせちゃうんだろうけど
lines.translated: "...I'm sure it will still make Chiwa and the others in this timeline terribly sad, though."

lines.content: せめてきみの最後の姿だけは、わたしだけの秘密にする。約束するよ
lines.translated: "At the very least, I'll keep the way you looked at the very end a secret known only to me. I promise."

lines.content: どこか素っ気ないともとれる声でクロは言うのだ。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke in a voice that could almost be taken as detached.

lines.content: ……そんな
lines.translated: "...No way."

lines.content: いやだ。だめだ。
lines.translated: No. I can't let that happen.

lines.content: 君に、そんなひどい役割を押しつけたくなんて――
lines.translated: I don't want to force such a cruel role onto you--

lines.content: こんなの、平気だよ
lines.translated: "Something like this is fine, really."

lines.content: クロが言う。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: こんなちっぽけな“さよなら”なんて、すぐだよ。すぐに忘れちゃえるよ。きみも、わたしも
lines.translated: "A tiny little 'goodbye' like this will pass in no time. We'll be able to forget it right away. Both you and me."

lines.content: 大丈夫とクロは言うのだ。
lines.translated: It's okay, Kuro told me.

lines.content: きみたちの人生なんて、たくさんのさよならの固まりだ。これはね、大雅。そのうちのひとつでしかないんだ
lines.translated: "Human lives are just a big clump of goodbyes. This is just one of them, Taiga. Nothing more."

lines.content: だから……ほら。早く
lines.translated: "So... come on. Hurry."

lines.content: 早く“魔法”を使って――“引き金”を、引くんだよ。大雅
lines.translated: "Hurry and use the 'magic'--pull the 'trigger,' Taiga."

lines.content: わたしたちはずっと一緒にはいられない。はじめからそういう“関係”だった
lines.translated: "We can't stay together forever. That's the kind of 'relationship' we had from the very beginning."

lines.content: ……きみがいつか大人になったとき。わたしたちは、それでさよなら。もう会えない。……それが、今日だった。さよならがいつ来るかの違いでしかないんだよ
lines.translated: "...Someday, when you grow up into an adult, that would be goodbye for us anyway. We'd never be able to meet again. ...That day just happened to be today. The only difference is when the goodbye comes."

lines.content: ほら早く――どうしたの。あの日、あのとき、あの瞬間。この場所で……ハルがきみを待ってるよ
lines.translated: "Come on, hurry--what's wrong? On that day, at that time, in that moment. Right here in this place... Haru is waiting for you."

lines.content: 俺が“魔法”を使う度、あの日、あのとき、あの瞬間に戻るのは、俺の“後悔”がそこにあるからなのだとクロは言う。
lines.translated: Every time I use the "magic," the reason I return to that day, that time, and that moment is because that is where my "regret" lies, Kuro told me.
*Almost as if the moment "regret" sprouted in my life is a save point.*

lines.content: これは[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う]“[・|魔][・|法]”なのだ――誰の“魔法”も、そうなのだ。重く苦しい“後悔”を打ち砕くためにある。
lines.translated: This is *that kind of "magic"*--everyone's "magic" is like that. It exists to shatter heavy, agonizing "regret."

lines.content: ……俺はハルに“魔法”の許可を出した。それを悔やんでる。だから、あの“夜”に戻る
lines.translated: "...I gave Haru permission to use her 'magic.' And I regret it. That's why I return to that 'night.'"

lines.content: そう
lines.translated: "Right."

lines.content: ……なら、どうして
lines.translated: "...Then why..."

lines.content: “許可”を出してしまう前に戻ってくれないのだろう――いつも俺は“許可”を出してしまった後にしか戻れていない。
lines.translated: Why won't it take me back to before I gave her "permission"--I've only ever been able to return to just after I already gave it to her.

lines.content: ……それがきみとわたしの限界だから
lines.translated: "...Because that's the limit of what you and I can do."

lines.content: わたし達はふたりでようやく、ふつうの人の、ひとり分の“想像力”しか生み出せない
lines.translated: "Even with the two of us together, we can barely muster the 'imagination' of a single normal person."

lines.content: ……そんなわたし達の“魔法”が、思い描いた通りに――[・|想][・|像][・|ど][・|お][・|り][・|に]働いてくれないのは、諦めるしかない
lines.translated: "...So we just have to accept that our 'magic' won't work the way we picture it--*just as we imagined*."

lines.content: ……なるほど。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: 不足なふたりが手と手を取って作り上げても、それでもこれは、この“魔法”は、どこまでも“不良品”なんだな。都合のいい“奇跡”を起こしては、くれないか
lines.translated: "Even when two lacking people join hands to create it, this 'magic' is still thoroughly 'defective' through and through, huh? It won't grant us a convenient 'miracle.'"

lines.content: ハルに“許可”を出す前と出した後。
lines.translated: Before giving Haru "permission," and after giving it to her.

lines.content: ほんの一瞬の差であるはずなのに、そこを飛び越えることが何より遠い――心が不完全な俺たちに、とっては。
lines.translated: It should only be a fraction of a second's difference, yet leaping across that gap is further away than anything--for the two of us, with our incomplete hearts.

lines.content: ……でも、わたし達の“魔法”はひとつになった。ここから先は、もう[・|無][・|駄][・|に]世界が枝分かれするようなことはない
lines.translated: "...Even so, our 'magic' has become one. From here on out, the world won't branch off *pointlessly* anymore."

lines.content: クロが言う。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: “魔法”の精度は、相変わらず、ずれてしまったままだろうけど……
lines.translated: "Though the accuracy of the 'magic' is probably still off the mark, just as always..."
*Which is why I can no longer catch up to stand beside you.*

lines.content: ……早くして、大雅
lines.translated: "...Hurry, Taiga."

lines.content: “さよなら”は一瞬がいい。クロは目を閉じた。
lines.translated: It's best to get "goodbyes" over with in an instant. Kuro closed her eyes.

lines.content: そうじゃないと、決意とか、覚悟とか、そういうのがなくなって……、怖くなってしまっても、知らないよ。わたしはそこまできみの面倒なんて、見てられない
lines.translated: "Otherwise, if you lose your resolve and your conviction... and end up getting scared, don't blame me. I can't keep looking after you that far."

lines.content: ありがとう、クロ。
lines.translated: Thank you, Kuro.

lines.content: そう言いたかった。
lines.translated: That was what she wanted to say.

lines.content: 君は、いつもみたいにやさしくしてたら、俺がいつまでも“魔法”を使えないだろうって……、
lines.translated: That if she were kind to me like she always is, I'd never be able to bring myself to use the "magic"...

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: やめよう。
lines.translated: Let's stop this.

lines.content: やさしいものは、きれいなものは、いつだって無駄にべたべた触れると簡単に壊れてしまうものだから。
lines.translated: Because gentle things, beautiful things, always break so easily when you touch them too clumsily and needlessly.

lines.content: だからこのまま行こう。
lines.translated: So let's just leave it at this and go.

lines.content: 君とは、いつでも笑顔でいたかったけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though I wanted to always be smiling with you...

lines.content: そんな“夢”を犠牲にし、俺は次の“夢”を叶えると、決めた。最後の“弾丸”を拳銃に込めた。
lines.translated: I decided to sacrifice that "dream" in order to fulfill the next "dream." I loaded the final "bullet" into the revolver.

lines.content: クロは何も言わず、背中を向けた。
lines.translated: Without a word, Kuro turned her back to me.

lines.content: 俺は撃鉄を起こす。
lines.translated: I cocked the hammer.

lines.content: クロは、両手で耳を押さえた。
lines.translated: Kuro covered her ears with both hands.

lines.content: 俺は、目の前の背中が小さく震えているのに、気づかないふりをする。
lines.translated: I pretended not to notice that the back right in front of me was trembling faintly.

lines.content: ……クロは、足下にこぼれる涙のあとを、踏みつけて、隠す。でも、いっぱいこぼれる。抱えた頭を小さく横に振っていた。
lines.translated: Kuro stepped on the traces of tears spilling at her feet to hide them. Even so, they kept spilling over. Clutching her head, she was shaking it ever so slightly from side to side.

lines.content: クロ
lines.translated: Kuro

lines.content: ……俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じない。
lines.translated: I didn't close my eyelids.

lines.content: さよなら
lines.translated: "Goodbye."

lines.content: いつもどこかで俺を見守ってくれていた。その小さな背中を、しっかりと、見つめたまま――……
lines.translated: She had always been watching over me from somewhere. Keeping my eyes fixed firmly on her small back--...

lines.content: さよなら。バイバイ……ごめん。本当に
lines.translated: "Goodbye. Bye-bye... I'm sorry. I really am."

lines.content: こんな[・|願][・|い]はあんまりにも身勝手だけれど、それでもたった一言、どうしても言わせてほしかった――……ごめんな。クロ。
lines.translated: Even though a *wish* like this is far too selfish, I still desperately wanted her to let me say just one last thing--...I'm sorry, Kuro.

lines.content: どうか、幸せに
lines.translated: "Please, be happy."

lines.content: ……それを合図に、引き金を、引いた。
lines.translated: With those words as my signal, I pulled the trigger.

lines.content: 頭の中に鋭い衝撃が突き刺さり――……
lines.translated: A sharp impact pierced straight through my head--...

lines.content: 視界が、強烈な熱量で薙ぎ払われて――……
lines.translated: My vision was swept away by a wave of intense heat--...

lines.content: でも、最後に、確かに見たのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, at the very end, I definitely saw it.

lines.content: 倒れる俺のことを、小さな君が、必死に抱き留めてくれて――……
lines.translated: As I collapsed, your small figure desperately caught me in your arms--...

lines.content: がんばれ、大雅っ
lines.translated: "Do your best, Taiga!"

lines.content: 強く、つよく……俺は、抱きしめられて、
lines.translated: Tightly, so tightly... I was held in her embrace.

lines.content: いつも、きみのことだけ、想ってるっ
lines.translated: "I'm always thinking only of you!"

lines.content: そんな声だけが、最後に届いた。
lines.translated: Only that voice reached me at the very end.

lines.content: 膝から崩れ落ちる。
lines.translated: I crumpled to my knees.

lines.content: 色々なものが心に、身体に、ずっしりと食い込んで――重かった。痛かった。
lines.translated: So many things dug heavily into my heart and my body--it was heavy. It hurt.

lines.content: 押し寄せる“死”の衝撃。嘔吐。
lines.translated: The crashing impact of "death." Nausea.

lines.content: ……そして、“さよなら”のさみしい想い。
lines.translated: And the lonely ache of "goodbye."

lines.content: 泣いてしまいそうになるのを、どうにか抑える。それがやっとだ。
lines.translated: Somehow, I held back the urge to burst into tears. That alone took everything I had.

lines.content: 声がする。
lines.translated: Her voice rang out.

lines.content: 床に手をついたまま、見上げる。
lines.translated: With my hands still planted on the floor, I looked up.

lines.content: 大雅くん……？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun...?"

lines.content: ハルが驚いた顔で俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: Haru was looking at me with a startled expression.

lines.content: きゅ、急にどうしたの、大丈夫……？
lines.translated: "Wh-What's wrong all of a sudden? Are you okay...?"

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: 今すぐ君を抱きしめたい。“悪夢”を撃ち抜き垣間見た君の心を思わずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I wanted to pull her into my arms right this instant. Having shot through her "nightmare" and caught a glimpse of her heart, I couldn't help but feel for her.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: 今は、どうしたって、そういう気持ちにはなれなかった。
lines.translated: Right now, though, there was just no way I could bring myself to feel like doing that.

lines.content: ハル……俺
う、うん……？　なに、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah...? What is it, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 俺、全部、知っちゃったんだよ……ハル
lines.translated: "I found out about everything... Haru."

lines.content: 全部、って……？
lines.translated: "Everything...?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ハルにすべてを話した。
lines.translated: I told Haru everything.

lines.content: 俺が何度も[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|て]この“夜”に戻ってきていたこと。
lines.translated: That I had returned to this "night" *like this* over and over again.

lines.content: “悪夢”を“魔法”で撃ち抜き、君の心に食い込む“後悔”を知ったこと。
lines.translated: That I had shot through her "nightmare" with my "magic" and learned of the "regret" digging into her heart.

lines.content: ……“私たちは出会わなければよかった”
lines.translated: "...'We never should have met.'"

lines.content: それが君の“後悔”で。
lines.translated: That is your "regret."

lines.content: ……“大切な人の未来に訪れる不幸を肩代わりする”
lines.translated: "...'Taking on the misfortune that will visit someone precious to you in the future.'"

lines.content: それが、君の願った“[希望|魔法]”の正体で。
lines.translated: That is the true nature of the "magic"--the "hope"--you wished for.

lines.content: そして君が、その奇跡を得るために支払うべき、“[・|代][・|償]”は――……
lines.translated: And the "*price*" you have to pay in order to obtain that miracle is--...

lines.content: ハルに笑顔はなかった。
lines.translated: There was no smile on Haru's face.

lines.content: 真っ青だ。
lines.translated: She was pale as a sheet.

lines.content: 唇が震えている。
lines.translated: Her lips were trembling.

lines.content: その表情は、今まで見たことないほど冷たく凍り付いていて……。
lines.translated: Her expression was frozen colder than I had ever seen it before...

lines.content: ……いや
……ハルは首を力なく振り、一歩、二歩、後じさっていく。
lines.translated: Haru weakly shook her head and took a step back, then another.

lines.content: ……だめ。そんなの、だめだよ
lines.translated: "...No. You can't. That's not allowed."

lines.content: 涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: ……[・|そ][・|れ]を、知られてしまったら。知られてしまったって、わかったら……私
lines.translated: "...If someone finds out about *that*. Once I know that someone has found out... I..."

lines.content: ひとつ。ふたつ……ぽろぽろと、
lines.translated: One drop. Then two... spilling down one after another.

lines.content: ……私っ、もう、“魔法”を使えない……っ
lines.translated: "...I can't use my 'magic' anymore...!"

lines.content: ハルの瞳から大粒の涙が、こぼれる。
lines.translated: Large teardrops spilled from Haru's eyes.

lines.content: 大雅くんのことを、……あなたのことを、私はもう……助けられないっ
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun... I can't... save you anymore!"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ……わ、私の“魔法”は、その“効果”は、誰にも話しちゃいけないし……誰にも、知られちゃだめだったんだよ……大雅くんっ
lines.translated: "...M-My 'magic,' and its 'effect,' are things I must never speak of to anyone... and no one was ever supposed to find out about them... Taiga-kun!"

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right."
*That is precisely right.* That is your "price."

lines.content: 俺も君の“悪夢”の中で、それを知ったんだ
lines.translated: "I learned that inside your 'nightmare,' too."

lines.content: ……だから、ハルはもう“魔法”を使うことができない。
lines.translated: And because of that, Haru can no longer use her "magic."

lines.content: ハル……。柊ハル。君の“願い”に価するほどの“代償”は……
lines.translated: "Haru... Hiiragi Haru. The 'price' worthy of your 'wish' is..."

lines.content: それは、“魔法”の[正体|効果]も、[・|そ][・|れ]が必要になった理由も――“誰にも知られてはいけない”“誰にも話してはいけない”というものだった。
lines.translated: That both the true nature--the effect--of her "magic," and the reason *it* became necessary in the first place--"must never be known by anyone," and "must never be spoken of to anyone."

lines.content: ……遠い未来、“母親に誘拐されている自分”という真実を、世界中の誰にも話すことができなかったように。
lines.translated: Just like how, in the distant future, she wasn't able to tell a single soul in the entire world the truth that she was "being kidnapped by her own mother."

lines.content: だからハルは、“あのさくらが咲くのを一緒に見たい。それが私の夢だ”と俺に嘘をついたのだ――
lines.translated: That was why Haru had lied to me, saying, "I want to see that cherry tree bloom together with you. That is my dream"--

lines.content: “それが私の夢だから。どうか、お願い。私の“魔法”に許可を出してもらえないかな”、と。
lines.translated: Saying, "Because that is my dream. Please, I'm begging you. Won't you give permission for my 'magic'?"

lines.content: 本当のことを俺に言えなかったのは、真実を伝えたところで“魔法”は“許可”されないだろうという、そんな予想があったからだけではない。
lines.translated: The reason she couldn't tell me the truth wasn't just because she figured I wouldn't grant "permission" for her "magic" if she told me what it really was.

lines.content: 話してしまえば、知られてしまえば、とたんに消えゆくもろすぎる“奇跡”だったのだ。
lines.translated: It was a far too fragile "miracle" that would vanish the very instant it was spoken of, the very instant it became known.

lines.content: だからハルは誰にも本当のことを言えず、ひとりで決意し、ひとりで時計塔の管理室の窓から、飛び降りた――……いや
lines.translated: "That's why you couldn't tell anyone the truth, Haru. You made up your mind all alone, and jumped from the window of the clock tower's caretaker room all by yourself--...No."

lines.content: 今この時点では、飛び降りようと決意したところ、ということなんだろうけど――君は確かに飛び降りた。この管理室の小さな窓から。俺はその未来をこの目で見てきた
lines.translated: "At this exact point in time, I guess you've only just resolved to jump--but you definitely jumped. From the small window of this caretaker room. I've seen that future with my own two eyes."

lines.content: ……誰にも話せないのは“孤独”だったはずだ。
lines.translated: Not being able to talk to anyone about it must have been pure "solitude."

lines.content: その気持ちが、今の俺には僅かにだがわかる。
lines.translated: Right now, I can understand that feeling, even if only a little.

lines.content: 少なくない時間世界を“こんなのはいやだ”と飛び越え、君と歩める未来を探し続けてた。味方はどこにもいなかった。そう思い込んでいた。
lines.translated: Thinking "I don't want this," I had leapt across no small number of timelines, endlessly searching for a future where I could walk alongside her. I had no allies anywhere. Or so I had convinced myself.

lines.content: だから俺も、少しは君の気持ちが理解できてるはずなんだ。だから、“どうして話してくれなかったんだ……”だ、なんて
lines.translated: "That's why I think I can understand how you feel, at least a little. So asking something like, 'Why didn't you tell me...?'"

lines.content: ほんの少しだって、君のことを責めようって気にはなれない
lines.translated: "I don't feel like blaming you even the slightest bit."

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: その胸に隠した“後悔”は、自分と出会ってしまったせいで[・|あ][・|の][・|人]は死んだ――私たちは出会ってはいけなかった。そういう言葉だ。
lines.translated: The "regret" hidden inside her chest was the thought that *that person* had died because they met her--that they never should have met. Those were the words.

lines.content: 故に。すべてひとりで覚悟して、誰にも相談できないままこの“夜”を迎える決意を――日々、固めていっていた。それに俺は気づかなかった。気づこうとも思わなかった。
lines.translated: And so, resolving herself to carry everything alone, unable to confide in anyone, she had spent each day hardening her determination to face this "night." I hadn't noticed that. I hadn't even tried to notice.

lines.content: ……大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 私たちは……
そこでぺたりと、ハルはその場に腰を落とした。緊張の糸が切れてしまったみたいに。
lines.translated: Right there, Haru sank down onto the floor, as if the thread of tension holding her up had finally snapped.

lines.content: そして、一言。
lines.translated: And then, she spoke a single phrase.

lines.content: ……“私たちは、出会ってはいけなかった”
lines.translated: "...'We never should have met.'"

lines.content: ため息をつくようにしてたった一言、そう吐き出した。
lines.translated: She breathed out just that single phrase, as if letting out a sigh.

lines.content: つなぎ合わせた[・|左][・|手]から、ハルの“これまで”が俺の心に流れ込んでくる。
lines.translated: Through our joined *left hands*, Haru's "past up until now" came pouring into my heart.

lines.content: ハルのお母さんが凶悪な誘拐犯に殺害され、世界が悲嘆の底に暮れる中……。
lines.translated: While the world sank into the depths of grief after Haru's mother was murdered by a vicious kidnapper...

lines.content: ……違う
lines.translated: "...Wrong."

lines.content: ハルはそう訴えたかった。
lines.translated: Haru had wanted to make a plea.

lines.content: ……おじさんは私を助けてくれた。悪いのは……悪いのはきっと、私なんだよ
lines.translated: "...The mister saved me. The one at fault... the one at fault is surely me."

lines.content: ハルは、そう願い続けた。
lines.translated: Haru kept wishing for that.

lines.content: 誰かお願い、わかってください
lines.translated: "Someone, please, understand."

lines.content: 私が、私だけが、いけないの。
lines.translated: I'm the one--the only one--to blame.

lines.content: 私がおじさんからの電話に出なければ
lines.translated: "If only I hadn't answered the mister's phone call..."

lines.content: 私が、お母さんの言うことをちゃんと聞いてれば……、こんなことにはならなかった。絶対に
lines.translated: "If only I had listened properly to what my mother told me... none of this would have happened. Never."

lines.content: だけどハルは……[・|私]は、誰にもそう訴え、願うことができなかった。
lines.translated: But Haru... *I* couldn't make that plea or wish to anyone.

lines.content: 知らない人の前では、いつもその人が求める私にしか、私はなれない――何もしゃべれなくなる私。愛想笑いの私。悲しそうな素振りの私。
lines.translated: In front of strangers, I can only ever become the version of myself they want me to be--the me who goes completely mute. The me who puts on an obliging smile. The me who acts sorrowful.

lines.content: そうすればとりあえず笑顔を見せられ、安心した。
lines.translated: If I did that, I could at least get them to smile, and I would feel relieved.

lines.content: 私の心はまだあの真っ暗な部屋の中に座り込んでいる。誰かの期待通りに生きなければ、私は私に価値がない。
lines.translated: My heart is still sitting huddled inside that pitch-black room. Unless I live up to someone else's expectations, I have no worth to myself.

lines.content: お母さんは誰もが愛する正義の味方。
lines.translated: My mother was an ally of justice loved by everyone.

lines.content: 私は、おじさんに酷いことをされ続けたかわいそうな女の子。
lines.translated: I was a poor little girl who had been subjected to terrible things by that man over and over.

lines.content: ……おじさんだけが邪悪な悪役。
lines.translated: And the mister alone was the wicked villain.

lines.content: 大人は誰もが“見えているもの”しか信じようとしない。
lines.translated: Every adult only tries to believe in "what they can see."

lines.content: 大人は誰もが、“見たいもの”しか信じない。
lines.translated: Every adult only believes in "what they want to see."

lines.content: いやだと思った。
lines.translated: I hated it.

lines.content: こんな世界は間違ってると思った。
lines.translated: I thought a world like this was wrong.

lines.content: ……こんな自分は大嫌いだと、思った。
lines.translated: I thought that I despised myself for being like this.

lines.content: でも、この世界のどこにも、私の大切な“隣”は、私が私を好きになれる――私が幸せになれるその場所は、なくなってしまった。
lines.translated: Even so, my precious place "beside" him--the place where I could come to like myself, where I could be happy--was nowhere to be found in this world anymore.

lines.content: だから私は逃げ出した。
lines.translated: So I ran away.

lines.content: 走って、走って。
lines.translated: I ran, and I ran.

lines.content: 裸足で走った両足は、何度も転んだ両頬は、傷だらけになったけど……。
lines.translated: Both of my bare feet, and both of my cheeks from falling down so many times, became covered in scrapes and cuts...

lines.content: 小さな歩幅でどこまでも、走って行って……。
lines.translated: Yet I kept running on and on with my tiny strides...

lines.content: ……ひどいよ、神さま
lines.translated: "...You're so cruel, God."

lines.content: 辿り着いたのは“さくらの杜”だ。
lines.translated: The place I finally reached was the "Sakura Grove."

lines.content: 見上げた空にさくらが咲いている。満開だ。もうその季節はとっくに過ぎているはずなのに。
lines.translated: Looking up, cherry blossoms were blooming in the sky. In full bloom. Even though their season should have long since passed.

lines.content: もう二度と咲かないのだと、おじさんが少しさみしそうに微笑みながら言っていた……あのさくらが、咲いているのだ。
lines.translated: Those cherry blossoms... the ones the mister had said would never bloom again while smiling a little lonely smile, were blooming.

lines.content: はらはらと。
lines.translated: Fluttering softly down.

lines.content: ふわふわと。
lines.translated: Drifting softly.

lines.content: 満開の花の雨。
lines.translated: A rain of flowers in full bloom.

lines.content: ……こんな景色を一番願っていた人はもういない。いなくなって、しまった。
lines.translated: The person who had wished for this scenery more than anyone is no longer here. He's gone now.

lines.content: その瞬間にこうもうつくしく咲き乱れるだなんて。本当に、酷い。私たちの生きる世界はどこまで意地が悪いのか。
lines.translated: For them to bloom so gorgeously the very moment he's gone. It really is cruel. Just how spiteful is this world we live in?

lines.content: おじさんが命を散らせたその場所で、私は春色に満たされた夜空の光景を、ただただ見つめる。
lines.translated: In the very place where the mister lost his life, I simply stared and stared at the sight of the night sky filled with the colors of spring.

lines.content: おじさん……。私の“夢”、叶えてくれるって言ったのに
lines.translated: "Mister... Even though you said you'd make my 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ふたりで一緒に見上げたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted the two of us to look up at it together.

lines.content: 微笑んで。
lines.translated: Smiling.

lines.content: 手を繋いで。
lines.translated: Holding hands.

lines.content: でも、心は決して繋がらないのだと、小さな私でも少しずつ理解していって……。
lines.translated: Even as a little girl, though, I had gradually come to understand that our hearts would never be connected in that way...

lines.content: そうして私は、諦められていたはずだった。
lines.translated: And so, I thought I had already given up.

lines.content: どんなに願ってみても、小さな私は、おじさんの“隣”に選んではもらえないんだと……。
lines.translated: That no matter how much I wished for it, little old me would never be chosen to stand "beside" him...

lines.content: だから私は、おじさんの心の中に住んでいるひとに、どうかおじさんの“隣”にいてほしいと願っていたはずで……。
lines.translated: That was why I thought I had wished for the person living inside the mister's heart to please stay "beside" him instead...

lines.content: だからさくらの花は咲いていてほしいと、祈った。おじさんが大切なひとと再会できることを願ってた。
lines.translated: That was why I prayed for the cherry blossoms to be in bloom. I wished for the mister to be reunited with the person precious to him.

lines.content: ……好きな人が幸せになれている未来が一番だ。
lines.translated: A future where the person you love gets to be happy is best of all.

lines.content: たとえその笑顔の“隣”に自分はいられなくても……。
lines.translated: Even if I can't be the one standing "beside" that smile...

lines.content: いや。自分がいないほうがいいのだ。だって私たちは“出会わなければよかった”のだから。
lines.translated: No. It's better if I'm not there. Because "we never should have met."

lines.content: それなのに。
lines.translated: And yet.

lines.content: ねえ、神さま。
lines.translated: Hey, God.

lines.content: ……お母さん。
lines.translated: Mom.

lines.content: ……どうしてこんなことに、なってしまったのかな
lines.translated: "...Why did things end up like this?"

lines.content: “私たちは出会わなければよかった”
lines.translated: "We never should have met."

lines.content: そんな言葉や思いばかりが、ふわふわ、はらはら舞い降る花と一緒に、私の心に降り積もっていくようで……。
lines.translated: Only words and thoughts like that seemed to drift down softly, fluttering alongside the falling petals, piling up inside my heart...

lines.content: 走り続けて疲れたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe I was exhausted from running so much.

lines.content: もう息をすることも面倒だと、思ってしまったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Or maybe I had started to feel that even breathing was too much trouble now.

lines.content: いつの間にか私は眠ってしまっていたみたいで……。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I seemed to have fallen asleep...

lines.content: がたん。
lines.translated: Clack-clack.

lines.content: ごとん。
lines.translated: Clunk-clunk.

lines.content: 車輪が線路を滑る音して。
lines.translated: Came the sound of wheels gliding along train tracks.

lines.content: ……おはよう。柊ハル。君の“後悔”をもらいに来たよ
lines.translated: "...Good morning, Hiiragi Haru. I've come to take your 'regret.'"

lines.content: あのさくらが咲いたからか。
lines.translated: Was it because those cherry blossoms had bloomed?

lines.content: それとも[・|そ][・|れ]を一番望んでいたおじさんが、たくさんの女の子たちを助け続けていたらしいおじさんが、死んでしまったからなのか。
lines.translated: Or was it because the mister who had wished for *that* more than anyone--the mister who apparently kept saving so many girls--had died?

lines.content: 満開に咲いたさくらを見上げたまま眠りに落ちた私は――おじさんの言っていた“不思議な夜の世界”で、目を覚ましたのだった。
lines.translated: Having fallen asleep while looking up at the cherry blossoms in full bloom--I woke up inside the "mysterious world of the night" the mister had told me about.

lines.content: 私の目覚めを待っていた小さな“夜の神さま”は、殆ど事情を問いかけることなく、あなたに叶えたい“夢”はあるのかとだけ私に言った。
lines.translated: The little "God of the Night" who had been waiting for me to wake up barely asked about my circumstances, asking me only if there was a "dream" I wanted to make come true.
A "dream"...

lines.content: 私はきっとうなずいた。
lines.translated: I nodded firmly.

lines.content: そうして私は“夜の魔法使い”の[すみか|住処]に連れて行かれた。
lines.translated: And so I was taken to the dwelling of the "Magician of the Night."

lines.content: 全人類の敵“夜の王”
lines.translated: The enemy of all mankind, the "King of the Night."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を倒せば人類の未来が救われるだけでなく、自分の未来でさえ救われるのだと教えられた。
lines.translated: I was taught that defeating *it* would not only save the future of humanity, but would even save my own future as well.

lines.content: “魔法”だ。
lines.translated: It was "magic."

lines.content: 私の人生に横たわる最大の[後悔|困難]を打ち払う“奇跡”を、“魔法使い”は外の世界ででも使えるようにしてくれるのだと、私たちに約束してくれた。
lines.translated: The "Magician" promised us that she would make it so we could use a "miracle" in the outside world to sweep away the greatest hardship--the greatest regret--lying across our lives.

lines.content: 私は“夜の王”を倒すと誓った。迷いはなかった。
lines.translated: I vowed to defeat the "King of the Night." I had no hesitation.

lines.content: ……私には
私には、取り戻したい人がいる。
lines.translated: I have someone I want to take back.

lines.content: あの人の未来に幸せを届けたい。
lines.translated: I want to deliver happiness to his future.

lines.content: ……あの人の“隣”に、あの人が一番大切に想うひとを届けたい
lines.translated: "...I want to deliver the person he cherishes most to his 'side.'"

lines.content: 私が暗闇の部屋から連れ出してもらえたように――あの人に“希望”をあげたい。
lines.translated: Just as I was led out of that dark room--I want to give him "hope."

lines.content: 連れて来られた[・|こ][・|こ]がどれほど遠いとおいところであったとしても。
lines.translated: No matter how far, far away *this place* I had been brought to might be.

lines.content: 神さまの列車は一方通行。もう二度と[・|元][・|の][・|時][・|間]に戻れなくなってしまったとしてもだ。
lines.translated: God's train is a one-way trip. Even if it meant I could never return to my *original time* ever again.

lines.content: 私はその“夜”から、同じように集められた少年少女たちと共に、“夜の王”と戦うために“魔法使い”から色々なことを教えられたけれど……。
lines.translated: From that "night" onward, alongside the other boys and girls who had been gathered in the same way, the "Magician" taught me all sorts of things in order to fight the "King of the Night," and yet...

lines.content: ふと、ひとりで眠る夜がさみしいと感じる。
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, I would feel lonely during the nights I slept by myself.

lines.content: そんなとき私は[・|そ][・|れ]を握りしめるのだ。
lines.translated: At times like that, I would clutch *it* tightly.

lines.content: 一度壊してしまった携帯電話。
lines.translated: The cell phone I had once broken.

lines.content: お守りのようにあの部屋から持ち出して、ポケットに忍ばせたままになっていた。
lines.translated: I had brought it out of that room like a good luck charm, keeping it tucked away in my pocket ever since.

lines.content: その携帯電話を見ると思い出さずにはいられない。
lines.translated: Whenever I looked at that cell phone, I couldn't help but remember.

lines.content: ……あの暗闇の部屋の中。
lines.translated: Inside that dark room.

lines.content: 眠る前の短い時間に、あの人から掛かってきていた電話のことを、私は思わずにはいられないのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking about the phone calls that used to come from him during that brief window of time before I went to sleep.

lines.content: 声が聞きたいといつも思ってた。
lines.translated: I was always wishing I could hear his voice.

lines.content: うなずいてくれないとわかっていても、何度でもあなたが好きだよと伝えたい。そう思ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Even knowing he wouldn't nod back, I wanted to tell him "I love you" over and over again. I couldn't stop feeling that way.

lines.content: ……やっぱり
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: やっぱりおじさんは私にとってヒーローだった。悪い人なんかじゃない。そう、伝えたかった。
lines.translated: The mister really was a hero to me after all. He wasn't a bad person at all. That was what I wanted to tell him.

lines.content: 名前も知らない。どんな人なのかもわからない。
lines.translated: I didn't even know his name. I didn't even know what kind of person he was.

lines.content: でも、正義の味方は誰だってそうだ。苦しんでいる子を助けに駆けつけ、名前も言わずに去って行く。
lines.translated: Still, every ally of justice is like that. They rush in to save a suffering child, and leave without even giving their name.

lines.content: ……私を助けてくれたおじさんは、私のヒーローは、どうしようもないほど遠くに行ってしまったけれど。
lines.translated: Even though the mister who saved me, my hero, had gone impossibly far away.

lines.content: そんなさみしいばかりのこの気持ちも、あなたともう一度だけ話ができたら、すべてあっという間に報われるんじゃないかとも、思ってた。
lines.translated: I also thought that if I could just talk with him one more time, all of these endlessly lonely feelings would be rewarded in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: ……“魔法”だ
“不思議な夜の世界”の中には“魔法”がある。思い描いたすべてが“魔法”に変わる。
lines.translated: Inside the "mysterious world of the night," there is "magic." Everything you envision turns into "magic."

lines.content: この携帯電話に“魔法”をかけることは可能だろうか。私のさみしい気持ちを閉じ込められないだろうか。そう考えた。
lines.translated: Would it be possible to cast "magic" on this cell phone? Couldn't I seal my lonely feelings inside it? That was what I thought.

lines.content: 話したい人がいる、か。しかも[・|こ][・|こ]ではない別の[未来|時間]に――……それができたら、ハル。君はどうするつもりなのかな？
lines.translated: "There's someone you want to talk to, huh? And in another time--another future--separate from *here*, at that... If you could do that, Haru, what do you intend to do?"

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”からの問いかけに、私はこう答えた。
lines.translated: To the question from the "Magician of the Night," I answered like this.

lines.content: この携帯電話で、もしも、[・|未][・|来]を生きてるおじさんと繋がれたなら……
lines.translated: "With this cell phone, if I could connect to the mister living in the *future*..."

lines.content: 私はおじさんに警告したい。
lines.translated: I want to warn him.

lines.content: どうかお願い――お願いだから、私のことを助けようと考えないで。
lines.translated: Please, I beg you--please, don't ever think about trying to save me.

lines.content: だけど上手く言葉にはできなかった。
lines.translated: But I couldn't quite put it into words.

lines.content: それだけ私は幼かったし……。
lines.translated: I was just that young, after all...

lines.content: そのときはまだ“夜の王”を倒す前だった。
lines.translated: Back then, we still hadn't defeated the "King of the Night."

lines.content: 働いてもないのに報酬がほしいとごねているようなもの。
lines.translated: It was like whining for a reward before I had even done any work.

lines.content: それなのに、“夜の魔法使い”がうなずいてくれるとは思えなかったから……。ただ私は沈黙するばかりだった。
lines.translated: Because of that, I didn't think the "Magician of the Night" would nod in agreement... so all I could do was fall silent.

lines.content: ……条件がある
lines.translated: "...There is a condition."

lines.content: 黙ってしまった私に“夜の魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: The "Magician of the Night" spoke to me after I had gone quiet.

lines.content: これから君も、一緒にお夕飯だけでもいいから私たちと食べよう
lines.translated: "From now on, why don't you join us, even if it's just for dinner?"

lines.content: ハル。君はいつも笑顔だけれど、でも不思議だな、何か思い詰めているように私には見えるけれど……
lines.translated: "Haru. You're always smiling, yet it's strange--to me, you look like you're brooding over something..."

lines.content: ああ、まあね。うん。他の子らと同様に、解決しがたい悩みがあるからこそ、今、人生に奇跡を求め、こうして君は私の目の前にいるんだろうけれど……
lines.translated: "Well, I suppose that makes sense. Yeah. Just like the other kids, you have a trouble that's hard to solve, which is why you're seeking a miracle in your life and standing right in front of me like this, right...?"

lines.content: とにかくさ。あまり思い詰めすぎても願いは叶わないよ
lines.translated: "Anyway, if you brood over it too much, your wish won't come true."

lines.content: そうなんですか？
lines.translated: "Is that how it works?"

lines.content: ああ。人間は悩んではいけないイキモノなんだよ。悩んだら悩んだ分だけ“夢”は遠ざかっていく
lines.translated: "Yeah. Humans are creatures that aren't meant to worry. The more you worry, the further away your 'dream' drifts."

lines.content: だから明るく生きれるならそれが一番なんだ。きっとね。その近道は美味しいご飯だ。私はそう思うな
lines.translated: "So if you can live brightly, that's for the best. Definitely. And the shortcut to that is a delicious meal. That's what I think, anyway."

lines.content: さて、ハル。私の提案を受け入れてくれたら、いいよ。その携帯電話に“魔法”をかけよう
lines.translated: "Now then, Haru. If you accept my proposal, then sure. Let's cast 'magic' on that cell phone."

lines.content: “魔法使い”は笑っていた。
lines.translated: The "Magician" was smiling.

lines.content: “夜”の中でも、“夜”の外ででも、自由自在に、君の話したい誰かの電話と繋がるように。そんな“魔法”を……特別だ。君にだけ贈ろう
lines.translated: "So that you can freely connect to the phone of that special someone you want to talk to, whether inside the 'Night' or outside of it. That kind of 'magic'... is special. I'll give it only to you."

lines.content: 拒否する理由はどこにもない。私はうなずいた。
lines.translated: There was no reason anywhere to refuse. I nodded.

lines.content: なんだか“魔法使い”の笑顔に、私は懐かしさを感じてしまう――おじさんと一緒に食べたご飯を、私は思い出し、少し涙がにじんだりもするのだった。
lines.translated: For some reason, the "Magician's" smile made me feel nostalgic--remembering the meals I had eaten with the mister, my eyes welled up with a few tears.

lines.content: それから何度目かの夕飯の席、あさひさんは『ごめんな。例の“魔法”にはもう少しだけかかる』と、そう断りを入れてから、私の名前を呼んだ。
lines.translated: Several dinners later, Asahi-san prefaced her words with, "Sorry. That 'magic' is going to take just a little bit longer," before calling my name.

lines.content: ……なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "...Hey, Haru."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 君は、町の施設で寝起きしているらしいね。私の妹がそれを見たんだって言ってたけれど
lines.translated: "I hear you're living at the facility in town. My little sister told me she saw you there."

lines.content: はい、そうです……
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right..."

lines.content: そうか。あの子の見間違いかとも思ったが、本当だったんだな
lines.translated: "I see. I thought she might have been mistaken, but it was true after all."

lines.content: その妹はあんまりにも人見知りなため、まだ私の前には顔を見せてくれてはいない。
lines.translated: Because her little sister was terribly shy around strangers, she still hadn't shown her face in front of me yet.

lines.content: 知らないひとが自分のことを見たという話だ。なんだか不思議な気持ちになりながら、あさひさんの話に私は耳を傾ける。
lines.translated: Hearing that someone I didn't know had seen me left me with a strange feeling as I listened closely to Asahi-san's words.

lines.content: “魔法”や“魔法少女”について学ぶ会――“満月の夜会”が終わると、君も他のみんなと同じようにここを出ていくから、てっきり帰る場所がちゃんとあるものだと思ってたよ
lines.translated: "When the 'Full Moon Soiree'--our gathering to study 'magic' and 'magical girls'--ends, you leave this place just like everyone else, so I completely assumed you had a proper place to go home to."

lines.content: ごめんなさい。別にうそをつくつもりじゃなかったんです。ただ……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. It's not that I meant to lie. It's just..."

lines.content: うん。わかってる。私を心配させたくなかったんだよな
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know. You didn't want to make me worry, right?"

lines.content: 違うかな、とあさひさん。
lines.translated: "Or am I wrong?" Asahi-san added.

lines.content: 君はやさしい子だ。それくらいの“想像”はつくよ……どうかな。間違ってるかな
lines.translated: "You're a kind girl. I can 'imagine' that much, at least... How about it? Am I wrong?"

lines.content: いいえ。正解、だと思います
lines.translated: "No. I think... that's right."

lines.content: 私がやさしいかどうかはわからないけれど……と、無理矢理に微笑み、そう答えていた。
lines.translated: *Though I don't know if I'm really kind or not...* I thought, forcing a smile as I answered her.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”の外には……つまり“夜”の外には身寄りがいない。だって[・|こ][・|こ]は私の知らない時間の中なのだ。
lines.translated: Outside the "Bed of Dreams"... which is to say, outside the "Night," I had no relatives. Because *this place* was inside a time I didn't know.

lines.content: だから私は山の上の施設に預けられていた。
lines.translated: That was why I had been placed in the care of the facility up on the mountain.

lines.content: ふらふらと町をさまよい歩いていた私を、親切な大人がそこへ連れて行ってくれたのだ――色々な場所をたらい回しにされた挙げ句ではあるけれど。
lines.translated: A kind adult had found me wandering aimlessly around town and taken me there--though only after I had been passed around from one place to another.

lines.content: そのことを今夜まで知らなかった“魔法使い”は……あさひさんは、とても悲しそうな顔をしていたけれど、その晩のご飯はいつもより少し美味しく感じられるものだった。
lines.translated: Having not known about that until tonight, the "Magician"... Asahi-san, wore a very sad expression, yet dinner that evening tasted a little more delicious than usual.

lines.content: あさひさんは私にたくさんやさしくしてくれた。お腹いっぱい、温かなご飯を食べさせてくれた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san showed me so much kindness. She fed me warm meals until my stomach was full.

lines.content: でもどうしてか、私はその度におじさんのことを思い出し、さみしくて、悲しくて、心の中がぐちゃぐちゃになる。
lines.translated: Yet for some reason, every time she did, I would remember the mister, and I would feel so lonely and sad that everything inside my heart would turn into a jumbled mess.

lines.content: やさしくされてうれしいはずなのに、ひとりで帰って泣いたりもした。
lines.translated: Even though being treated kindly should have made me happy, there were times I went back alone and cried.

lines.content: お夕飯を一緒に食べる日を重ねると、次第にあさひさんの妹も顔を出すようになり、その中で何度か[・|知][・|ら][・|な][・|い][・|男][・|の][・|子]も夕飯の食卓に並んでいたりもした。
lines.translated: As the days we ate dinner together piled up, Asahi-san's little sister gradually started showing her face, and a few times during all of that, an *unfamiliar boy* was sitting at the dinner table as well.

lines.content: そういった時間は楽しいものだったと思う。
lines.translated: I think those times were fun.

lines.content: あさひさんや、その妹の十夜のことが大好きになった。こんな私に懐いてくれる内気だった十夜のことが、なんだかとてもかわいく思えた。
lines.translated: I came to really love Asahi-san and her little sister, Toya. The shy Toya taking a liking to someone like me made me think she was somehow very cute.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……私はやっぱり、おじさんの“隣”でしか、私の好きな私にはなれないみたい
lines.translated: "...It seems that I really can't become the me that I like unless I'm by the mister's 'side.'"

lines.content: あさひさんの前では愛想笑いばかり浮かべてる。
lines.translated: In front of Asahi-san, all I ever do is put on forced, polite smiles.

lines.content: こんなにやさしくしてくれるひとをがっかりさせたくない。嫌われたくない。このひとのことが好きだから、尚更に。
lines.translated: I don't want to disappoint someone who treats me so kindly. I don't want to be hated. All the more so because I love her.

lines.content: 怖い。
lines.translated: I'm scared.

lines.content: あさひさんは私をやさしい子だと言う。期待どおりのやさしい子でないと、いい子でいないと、いつか見向きもされなくなるのでは……。
lines.translated: Asahi-san calls me a kind girl. I worry that if I'm not the kind girl she expects me to be, if I don't stay a good girl, she'll stop paying attention to me someday...

lines.content: そんなふうにあさひさんのことを、心のどこかで信じることのできない自分――
lines.translated: The part of me that, deep down, couldn't bring itself to trust Asahi-san like that--

lines.content: ……大嫌い
lines.translated: "...I hate it."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: あさひさんの“隣”では、そんな[私|自分]が顔を出すから、たぶん……心のどこかが苦しかった。こんな自分が大嫌いだった。
lines.translated: When I was by Asahi-san's "side," that version of me would rear its head, so maybe... somewhere in my heart, it was painful. I hated myself for being like this.

lines.content: もしも願いが叶うなら――おじさんともう一度だけでいい。話がしたい。
lines.translated: If my wish could come true--just one more time with the mister would be enough. I want to talk to him.

lines.content: あの人ともう一言だけでも話せたら、私は私の好きだった自分を思い出せるかもしれない。そう思っていた。
lines.translated: If I could exchange even a single word with him again, I might be able to remember the version of myself that I used to like. That was what I thought.

lines.content: あの人と話すとき自然と笑顔になれる自分が好きだった。
lines.translated: I liked the me who could smile naturally when talking with him.

lines.content: あの人と歩くとき、少し小走りになりながら、必死に並んで歩こうとする自分が嫌いになれない。そんな私に気づき、歩く速さを緩めてくれるおじさんを、愛しく思う。
lines.translated: When walking with him, I couldn't bring myself to hate the me who would break into a slight trot, desperately trying to walk alongside him. And I dearly loved the mister for noticing me doing that and slowing his pace.

lines.content: そんな私とは、[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|と][・|は]、もう二度と出会えないのだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I never be able to meet that me--*that us*--ever again?

lines.content: いつも私は叶えられない願いばかりを抱いてる。
lines.translated: I'm always holding onto nothing but wishes that can't come true.

lines.content: あさひさんはそんなうそばかりな私にも、約束どおり、携帯電話に“魔法”をかけてくれた。
lines.translated: Even though I was so full of lies, Asahi-san cast the "magic" on my cell phone just as she had promised.

lines.content: その“電話”があれば誰とでも話せる。相手がどこにいようとも
lines.translated: "With that 'phone,' you can talk to anyone. No matter where they are."

lines.content: 誰とでも……
lines.translated: "Anyone..."

lines.content: ああ。番号さえわかればな
lines.translated: "Yeah. As long as you know the number."

lines.content: それさえわかっていれば、距離が離れていようと――そこに時間と時間の隔たりまであったとしても、そんなものは余裕で飛び越え、繋がることができる
lines.translated: "So long as you know that, no matter how far the distance--even if there's a gap between one time and another--it can easily leap right over all of that and connect."

lines.content: まずは、そうだな。とりあえずそこの骨董品だ。あの古い黒電話だよ。その番号を携帯に登録しておいた。[・|お][・|使][・|い]に行った先から、電話を使ってみようか
lines.translated: "First off, let's see. For now, let's use that antique right there. That old black rotary phone. I registered its number into your cell phone. Why don't we try using the phone from the destination of your *errand*?"

lines.content: ……お使い？
lines.translated: "...Errand?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 今から君には“夜”の中にある大きな駅で……“刻の終着駅”に並ぶお店で、この“魔法”を作るのに必要なものを買ってきてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Right now, I want you to go to the big station inside the 'Night'... to the shops lined up at the 'Terminal Station of Time,' and buy what we need to make this 'magic.'"

lines.content: 素材に必要な買い物をした後に、私が“魔法”を完成させて、その場で実験的に使用してみる。そういう流れだ。
lines.translated: After shopping for the necessary materials, I would complete the "magic" and test it out right there on the spot. That was the plan.

lines.content: “魔法”に必要な素材は花だと、あさひさんは言った。“刻の終着駅”で売られている“特別な花”
lines.translated: Asahi-san told me that the material needed for the "magic" was a flower. A "special flower" sold at the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: そしてその“魔法”が花開くのに必要なのは、もうひとつ……
lines.translated: "And for that 'magic' to blossom, there is one more thing you need..."

lines.content: あさひさんは私の頭を撫でながら、『必要なのは、君の中にある君だけの“[想像力|魔法]”だよ。君は花を咲かせることが得意な“魔法”みたいだからね』と言い、笑顔を見せてくれていた。
lines.translated: Patting my head, Asahi-san gave me a smile and said, "What you need is the 'imagination'--the 'magic'--that belongs only to you, right inside of you. Because it seems your 'magic' is really good at making flowers bloom."

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: そうして私は、“魔法使い”のお使いに出かけた先の暗闇で――ずっと、ずっとだ。
lines.translated: And so, in the darkness of the place I went to on the "Magician's" errand--for so, so long.

lines.content: ずっと探し求めていた人に、私だけのヒーローに、私は突然、出会えてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: All of a sudden, I ended up meeting the person I had been searching for all along, my very own hero.

lines.content: 大きな時計塔の小さな管理室。
lines.translated: The small office of the big clock tower.

lines.content: そこに身を寄せ合い、俺たちは座り込んでいる。
lines.translated: Huddled close together, we sat there on the floor.

lines.content: ちく、たく、ちく、たく……。
lines.translated: Tick, tock, tick, tock...

lines.content: 町に“夜”が満ちゆく音がする。
lines.translated: I could hear the sound of the "Night" filling the town.

lines.content: しかし、朝はもう近いはず。
lines.translated: However, morning had to be close by now.

lines.content: 遠い“夜”の空に、太陽の気配が滲みははじめていた。
lines.translated: In the distant sky of the "Night," signs of the sun were beginning to bleed through.

lines.content: それなのに、
lines.translated: Even so,

lines.content: （……おかしい）
lines.translated: (...That's strange.)

lines.content: こうしてハルとこの部屋にこもってから、既に数時間は経過してしまっているはずなのだ。
lines.translated: Several hours should have already passed since Haru and I shut ourselves up in this room like this.

lines.content: （……どういうことだ。とっくに[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]が姿を見せてもいい時間なのに）
lines.translated: (...What's going on? It's well past the time *that thing* should have shown itself.)

lines.content: それなのにあいつは――“夜”の中で形を得たハルの“悪夢”が、いつまで経っても現れないのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, that thing--Haru's "Nightmare," given form inside the "Night"--hadn't appeared no matter how much time passed.

lines.content: いつもまったく同じ時間に現れるわけではない。それもまた事実だ。
lines.translated: It didn't always appear at the exact same time. That much was also a fact.

lines.content: 少し早いときもあれば、前回よりも少し遅いこともあった。
lines.translated: Sometimes it was a little early, and other times it was a little later than the time before.

lines.content: しかしその誤差はいつも数分ほどだった。
lines.translated: However, that margin of error had always been just a few minutes or so.

lines.content: それらの些細なズレを産み出している原因は俺の“[リセット|魔法]”だ。
lines.translated: The cause producing those minor discrepancies was my "reset"--my "magic."

lines.content: 俺が“魔法”の引き金を引く度に、時間世界は[・|こ][・|の]“[・|夜]”を境に枝葉に別れる。
lines.translated: Every time I pulled the trigger of my "magic," the timeline branched off with *this "Night"* as the dividing line.

lines.content: （……こうしている間にも、俺が悪戯に発生させてしまったバッドエンドの時間は、消滅することもなく続いてる）
lines.translated: (...Even while we're doing this, the bad-end timelines I recklessly brought into existence are continuing on without disappearing.)

lines.content: その時間世界について、当然の罪悪感を挟み込む余地も――申し訳ない、今はまだない。今は、まだ。
lines.translated: There wasn't even room to wedge in the natural guilt I should feel toward those timelines--I'm sorry, but I don't have it in me right now. Not right now, not yet.

lines.content: ともあれ、“悪夢”が現れる時間がいつも同じでないことと、ハルを殺害する手段が違うことも、やはり俺の“魔法”の影響なのだろう。
lines.translated: Regardless, the fact that the time the "Nightmare" appeared wasn't always the same, and that the methods used to kill Haru varied, were likely the effects of my "magic" after all.

lines.content: しかし、こんなふうに、数時間も大きくズレてしまうようなことは一度もなかった。
lines.translated: However, there had never once been a massive discrepancy of several hours like this.

lines.content: （いや。それは、どうかな）
lines.translated: (No. I wonder about that.)

lines.content: （……一番最初の“夜”だ。あのときも俺はハルの“悪夢”と出会ってはいない――ハル自身はどうだったのか、今となってはもう知るよしもないけれど）
lines.translated: (...The very first "Night." Back then, I didn't encounter Haru's "Nightmare" either--though what happened with Haru herself back then, there's no way of knowing anymore.)

lines.content: これまでの“夜”と今回の“夜”
lines.translated: The "Nights" up until now, and this "Night."

lines.content: 相違点を探すなら、ひとつだけある。
lines.translated: If I were to look for a point of difference, there was only one.

lines.content: 俺は、拳銃の“魔法”でハルの“悪夢”を撃ち抜いた。そしてハルの心を知ったのだ。
lines.translated: With the "magic" of my handgun, I had shot right through Haru's "Nightmare." And I had learned what was in Haru's heart.

lines.content: その瞬間に、ハルの中から“悪夢”は消滅してしまったのだろうか――まさか俺の“魔法”が破壊してしまったのだろうか。
lines.translated: In that instant, had the "Nightmare" vanished from inside Haru--could my "magic" have actually destroyed it?

lines.content: しかし[・|そ][・|れ]は、ひとつ前の時間世界でのことなのだ。今回の“夜”に影響を及ぼせる道理はないように、思える。
lines.translated: However, *that* happened in the previous timeline. It didn't seem like there was any logical way it could affect this current "Night."

lines.content: あくまでも、今現在の俺が持ち得る情報のみを鑑みれば、ではあるが。
lines.translated: Strictly speaking, that was only if I considered the information I currently possessed, though.

lines.content: （わからない……）
lines.translated: (I don't know...)

lines.content: いくら考えを巡らせてみても、今の俺には理解できそうにないものばっかりだ。
lines.translated: No matter how much I turned it over in my head, everything right now was beyond my ability to understand.

lines.content: ……ただ、胸騒ぎがする。
lines.translated: Still, I have a bad feeling about this.

lines.content: 根拠のない不安だが、[・|何][・|か]……。
lines.translated: It's a baseless anxiety, and yet, *something*...

lines.content: 俺には想像もできない[・|何][・|か]が、今、起きているのではないか。
lines.translated: Isn't *something* I can't even imagine happening right now?

lines.content: そう思えてならないのだが……。
lines.translated: I can't help but feel that way, though...

lines.content: （でも、同時に……）
lines.translated: (Wait, at the same time...)

lines.content: ……とても奇妙な感覚なのだ。
lines.translated: It's a very strange sensation.

lines.content: もう“悪夢”は現れないのではないか――そんな予感のようなものが根拠もなく、俺の中に産まれ始めている。
lines.translated: A premonition that the "Nightmare" might not appear anymore--something like that is beginning to take root inside me, completely without basis.

lines.content: ハルの“魔法”は――幼いハルと出会ったことにより、死の運命を背負うことになった人。その“不幸”を自身の命が肩代わりすること。
lines.translated: Haru's "magic" is--for the person who became burdened with a fate of death by meeting her when she was little, to have her own life take on that "misfortune" in his stead.

lines.content: その“代償”は――“誰にも話せない”“誰にも知られてはいけない”
lines.translated: Its "price" is--"You must never speak of it to anyone," "You must never let anyone find out."

lines.content: “代償”とは、ハル自身が自分に課した枷のようなものだ。
lines.translated: A "price" is like a shackle Haru imposed upon herself.

lines.content: 望み通りの“魔法”を得るならそれ相応の“代償”を、触媒のようにして支払わなければならない。それが“夜”の外に“魔法”を持ち出すためのルールだ。
lines.translated: To obtain the "magic" you wish for, you have to pay an appropriate "price" as a catalyst. That is the rule for bringing "magic" outside of the "Night."

lines.content: 自分の求めた“魔法”には[・|こ][・|れ][・|く][・|ら][・|い]の“代償”が相応しい。ハルはそう自分自身の心を設定した。
lines.translated: A "price" of *this much* is fitting for the "magic" she sought. That was how Haru set the terms within her own heart.

lines.content: だからこそ今夜まで大事に、大切に、ハルは“魔法”を守り続けてきたのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Which is probably why she had been protecting her "magic" with such care and devotion right up until tonight, and yet...

lines.content: 今夜、その“代償”は破られた。もうハルは“魔法”を使えない。
lines.translated: Tonight, that "price" was broken. Haru can no longer use her "magic."

lines.content: だがハルは、そこに更なるペナルティを自身に課していた。
lines.translated: However, Haru had imposed an even further penalty upon herself.

lines.content: “[条件|代償]”を破れば、俺の未来から死の運命は削除されない。更にハル自身も、削除しようとした死の運命を背負い込んでしまう。
lines.translated: If the "price" is broken, the fate of death will not be erased from my future. Furthermore, Haru herself will also end up bearing the very fate of death she tried to erase.

lines.content: ……人の命を救済する“魔法”を得るには、それほどの面倒な“[条件|代償]”が必要だと、ハルは“夜”の中で“想像”してしまっていた。
lines.translated: Inside the "Night," Haru had "imagined" that obtaining a "magic" capable of saving a person's life required such a troublesome "price."

lines.content: 俺に“魔法”の正体を知られてしまった。
lines.translated: The true nature of her "magic" had been found out by me.

lines.content: 知られてしまったという事実を、ハルが認識してしまった。瞬間。ハルは自身も俺と同じように、死の運命を背負う羽目になってしまった。
lines.translated: And Haru had recognized the fact that it had been found out. In that instant, Haru ended up saddled with a fate of death, just like me.

lines.content: （だから“悪夢”も、ハルの中から消えてしまった……？）
lines.translated: (Is that why the "Nightmare" vanished from inside Haru, too...?)

lines.content: 結果として“魔法”の“[条件|代償]”を破ってしまったハルは、わざわざ“悪夢”に殺害されるまでもなくなってしまったということだ――故に。“悪夢”は消えた？
lines.translated: As a result, having broken the "price" of her "magic," Haru no longer even needed to be killed by the "Nightmare"--therefore, did the "Nightmare" disappear?

lines.content: 俺は隣に座るハルの横顔を、見る。
lines.translated: I look at the profile of Haru sitting beside me.

lines.content: ハルはずっと俺の手を握りしめていた。
lines.translated: Haru had been holding my hand tightly the entire time.

lines.content: 俺たちは肩が触れあう距離で、時計塔の管理室の床に座り込んでいた。
lines.translated: We were sitting on the floor of the clock tower's office, close enough for our shoulders to touch.

lines.content: ハルの“悪夢”がまだどこかに潜んでいるかもしれない、だから朝が来るまではこのままでいようと、そう提案してのことだった。
lines.translated: It was because I had suggested we stay like this until morning came, since Haru's "Nightmare" might still be lurking somewhere.

lines.content: ……そしてそのまま何も話さない。
lines.translated: And we haven't said a word since.

lines.content: そんな時間が、俺たちの間に数時間分も降り積もっていた。
lines.translated: Several hours' worth of that silent time had piled up between us.

lines.content: ハル。
lines.translated: Haru.

lines.content: 今、君は何を思っているんだろうか。
lines.translated: What could you be thinking right now?

lines.content: 俺が君の“魔法”を台無しにした。
lines.translated: I ruined your "magic."

lines.content: その正体を知ってしまったからといって、それをハルに報告せず黙ってさえいれば、まだ“魔法”は消滅せずハルの胸の中にあったはず。
lines.translated: Even though I found out what it really was, if I had just kept quiet and not told Haru about it, the "magic" shouldn't have vanished and would still be inside her chest.

lines.content: “代償”は破られてしまうことはなかった。
lines.translated: The "price" wouldn't have been broken.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|あ][・|っ][・|て][・|は][・|い][・|け][・|な][・|い]と感じたからこそ、俺はハルに報告したのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't do that. It was precisely because I felt *it must not be that way* that I told Haru.

lines.content: なんであれもう一度君とちゃんと話がしたい。
lines.translated: Whatever happens, I want to have a proper talk with you one more time.

lines.content: そして覚悟を決めたい。
lines.translated: And I want to steel my resolve.

lines.content: そう思って、またここへ[リセットして|戻って]来た俺なのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I reset and came back here thinking that...

lines.content: 沈黙だ。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: ふたりでただ静かに朝が来るのを待っている。
lines.translated: The two of us are just quietly waiting for morning to come.

lines.content: 握りしめた手のひらから、ハルの心を覗き見ることはできうるのかもしれない――まだ“夜”の力を自在に使いこなすことのできない俺ではあるけれど。
lines.translated: Through our tightly clasped palms, it might be possible to peek into Haru's heart--even if I still can't freely wield the power of the "Night."

lines.content: 俺たちはもう既にそれだけの“関係”ではあるはずだ。
lines.translated: We should already have that kind of "connection."

lines.content: だけど俺は、ハルに対してそうはできないと感じていた。
lines.translated: However, I felt that I couldn't do that to Haru.

lines.content: ……いや、そうできないのではなく、そうはしたくないのだ。
lines.translated: No, it's not that I can't, it's that I don't want to.

lines.content: これからハルとは可能な限り、ちゃんと言葉にして気持ちを確認し合いたい。
lines.translated: From here on out, as much as possible, I want to put our feelings into proper words and confirm them with each other.

lines.content: だからほんの少し勇気を出して、俺はハルに、いつ気づいたのかと問いかけた。
lines.translated: So, mustering just a little bit of courage, I asked Haru when she had realized it.

lines.content: およそ数時間ぶりに、俺は口を開いた。
lines.translated: For the first time in several hours, I opened my mouth to speak.

lines.content: ……名前も何も知らなかったはずの人なのに、それがどうして……なあ、ハル。どうして、その人が未来の俺だって、気づけたのかな
lines.translated: "...Even though he should've been someone whose name and everything else you didn't know, how did you... Hey, Haru. How did you realize that person was the future me?"
"...Your hand."

lines.content: うつむいたまま、ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Still looking down, Haru speaks.

lines.content: ……たぶん、この手だよ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...It was probably this hand, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ぎゅっと、繋いだ手にハルは力を込めた。
lines.translated: Haru gave our joined hands a tight squeeze.

lines.content: ……十年前の“夜”の中。ふたりで迷子になってしまったときのこと、覚えてる？
lines.translated: "...Inside the 'Night' ten years ago. Do you remember when the two of us got lost?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: 迷子。
lines.translated: Lost.

lines.content: その言葉で思い出せるものはひとつしかない。
lines.translated: There is only one thing that word brings to mind.

lines.content: 俺がヒーローになりたいだなんて思いを理由に、向こう見ずな行動をしてしまい――結果、あず咲先輩を助けられなかった。
lines.translated: Using my desire to become a hero as an excuse, I acted recklessly--and as a result, I couldn't save Azusaki-senpai.

lines.content: どころかあず咲先輩のことを俺は見捨ててしまったのだ――
lines.translated: Far from it, I ended up abandoning Azusaki-senpai--

lines.content: 誰もそういうふうに俺を責める者はいなかったけれど、しかしあのとき自分自身に落胆した幼心に、今もなお、俺は責め立てられ続けている。
lines.translated: Nobody blamed me like that, yet even now, I continue to be tormented by my young heart that was so disappointed in itself back then.

lines.content: 故に忘れられるはずもない。
lines.translated: Therefore, there is no way I could ever forget.

lines.content: ……あず咲先輩の“才能”に引っ張られて、どこか未来の時間にまで連れて行かれてしまった俺たちだけど
lines.translated: "...We were pulled in by Azusaki-senpai's 'talent' and taken somewhere into a future time, though."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 真夜中よりも真っ暗な不思議な空間を、ふたりで手を繋いで歩いた。確かにあれは迷子だと言えると思う
lines.translated: "The two of us held hands and walked through a strange space that was darker than midnight. I think you could definitely call that being lost."

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: [・|電][・|話]に出たクロちゃんが助けてくれて、私たち……“夜”より深い真っ黒の中を、歩いたよね
lines.translated: "Kuro-chan answered the *phone* and saved us, and we... walked through a pitch-blackness deeper than the 'Night,' didn't we?"

lines.content: そのとき俺は決して離さぬようにと、ハルとこうして手を繋ぎ、前へ前へと歩いていった。
lines.translated: Back then, determined never to let go, I held hands with Haru just like this and walked forward, on and on.

lines.content: この子だけは絶対に助けたい。
lines.translated: I want to save this girl no matter what.

lines.content: そうでなければ、俺は生涯自分を許すことができない――きっと、そういうふうに思っていたはずだ。
lines.translated: Otherwise, I'll never be able to forgive myself for as long as I live--I'm sure that's how I must have felt.

lines.content: そんな小さすぎた俺の背中を見つめ、ハルは気づいたのだという――“ああ、もしかして”、と。
lines.translated: Gazing at my back, which was far too small back then, Haru says she realized it--thinking, "Oh, could it be?"

lines.content: あなたの話し方や、あなたのふとした癖だとか。そんな小さなものが“もしかして”って、私の中に重なっていって
lines.translated: "The way you talked, and your little habits. Small things like that piled up inside me as 'could it be?'"

lines.content: そして極めつけはあの一言だったと、ハルは言うのだ。
lines.translated: And the deciding factor, Haru says, was that one phrase.

lines.content: 大雅くんはきっと、覚えてないよね
lines.translated: "You probably don't remember it, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: そこではじめて俺を見て、ハルは力なく微笑む。
lines.translated: Looking at me for the first time then, Haru gives a weak smile.

lines.content: “ヒーローになりたい”
lines.translated: "'I want to be a hero.'"

lines.content: いつかあなたが私の“隣”でつぶやいたその一言で……ああ、そうか。この人だって、思ったの
lines.translated: "With that one phrase you once murmured 'beside' me... 'Ah, I see. It's him,' I thought."

lines.content: ……それに、あなたの“隣”だと素直になれた。みんなの前だと“元気な私”を期待されてて、そうじゃないと愛されないんだって、思って……少しだけ……勝手に疲れてた
lines.translated: "...Besides, when I was 'beside' you, I could be honest with myself. In front of everyone else, I felt like they expected the 'cheerful me,' and I thought I wouldn't be loved if I wasn't like that... so I got a little... tired all on my own."

lines.content: でもね、あなたの“隣”で、私はもう一度なりたい“私”になれた
lines.translated: "But you know, 'beside' you, I was able to become the 'me' I wanted to be once again."

lines.content: 内気で。すぐ泣く。相手の目も見て話せない。相手の期待どおりにしないと嫌われてしまうかも――と、不安に思うこともない。ただただ自然に笑えた。
lines.translated: Shy. Quick to cry. Unable to look people in the eye when talking. Never having to worry that she might be hated if she didn't live up to others' expectations. She could just smile naturally.

lines.content: もうこの世界のどこにも、私が幸せになれる“[場所|隣]”はなくなってしまったんだって、思ってたのに
lines.translated: "Even though I thought there was no longer any 'place' left anywhere in this world where I could be happy..."

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: ずっと探してたその“[場所|隣]”が、まさかこんなところに、あったなんて……
lines.translated: "To think that the 'place' I had been searching for all along was somewhere like this..."

lines.content: ここは過去だ。柊ハルにとって、まだまだ自分が産まれるより以前の時間。
lines.translated: This is the past. For Hiiragi Haru, it is a time long before she was even born.

lines.content: 当然、[あの人|おじさん]が小さな子だったとしても、不思議はなかった。
lines.translated: Naturally, it wasn't strange at all for that man to be a little kid.

lines.content: そのことに気づいて……。
lines.translated: Realizing that...

lines.content: あんまりにも仕組まれたような出会いに、息を呑み……。
lines.translated: Having her breath taken away by an encounter that felt all too orchestrated...

lines.content: あの真っ暗な空間で、俺に手を引かれ歩いていたすぐ後ろで、ハルは声を殺して泣いていたという。
lines.translated: In that pitch-black space, right behind me as I led her by the hand, Haru says she was crying, stifling her voice.

lines.content: ……すごいって思った
lines.translated: "...I thought it was amazing."

lines.content: 話し方とか。仕草とか。そんな些細なことで、私は少しずつだけどあなたに気づけて。そんな自分を褒めたいって、思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "The way you talked. Your mannerisms. Through such trivial things, little by little, I was able to notice it was you. I wanted to praise myself for that."

lines.content: 遠い未来の世界で、[あの人|おじさん]は、“あなたが好きです”という私の気持ちを、子ども心の一時的なものだからすぐに忘れると、そういうふうに言っていたけれど……違う。
lines.translated: In that distant future world, he told me that my feelings of "I love you" were just a temporary whim of a child's heart and that I would soon forget them, though... he was wrong.

lines.content: やっぱり私、あなたのことが大好きなんだって。この気持ちは勘違いなんかじゃないんだって……。大雅くん。あなたに手を引かれながら、思ったの
lines.translated: "I really do love you so much after all. These feelings aren't a misunderstanding at all... Taiga-kun. As you led me by the hand, that's what I thought."

lines.content: そしてね、大雅くん。私は同時にわかってしまったんだよ
lines.translated: "And you know, Taiga-kun. At the same time, I ended up understanding something."

lines.content: ……なにを
lines.translated: "...Tell you what?"

lines.content: ハルはいったい、なにをわかってしまったんだろう。
lines.translated: What on earth had Haru ended up understanding?

lines.content: 私が愛したあの人とは、本当に、ほんとうに短い時間しか一緒にいられなかったけれど……。でも、気づいてた。その心の中にはいつも私の知らない“誰か”がいた
lines.translated: "I was only able to be with the man I loved for a really, truly short time... But I noticed. Inside his heart, there was always 'someone' I didn't know."

lines.content: ……あの人の心の中にずっと住んでいたひと。それが誰だったのか。あなたに手を引かれながら、私はわかったの
lines.translated: "...The person who had always lived inside his heart. Who that person was. As you led me by the hand, I understood."

lines.content: だからハルは、俺に“魔法”の携帯電話を譲ったのだという。
lines.translated: That was why Haru says she handed the "magic" cell phone over to me.

lines.content: 私たちが迷子になってしまったあの“夜”を境に、クロちゃんは大雅くんのそばにあまり帰ってこなくなった
lines.translated: "Starting from that 'Night' when we got lost, Kuro-chan stopped coming back to your side as much, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 大雅くん。気づいてたかわからないけど、本当に、本当にね、さみしそうだったよ
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. I don't know if you realized it, but you looked really, truly lonely."

lines.content: それは未来の世界で、大人になった俺がよく見せていた横顔だったのだという。
lines.translated: She says that was the same profile the grown-up me often showed in the future world.

lines.content: ……だから私は、大雅くんの“隣”にあの子の笑顔を届けたかった
lines.translated: "...That's why I wanted to deliver that girl's smile to your 'side,' Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 私の“夢”はあなたの“隣”に、あなたの一番大切な人を届けることだ。
lines.translated: My "dream" is to deliver the person most precious to you right to your "side."

lines.content: それも、あの人に光りの中へ誘拐された未来で芽生えた、私の“夢”のひとつだった。
lines.translated: That, too, was one of my "dreams" that budded in the future where I was kidnapped into the light by that man.

lines.content: ……おじさんは、小さな私には絶対に振り向いてくれない。そして、小さな頃のあなたも同じ。ずっとたったひとりを想い続けてる――
lines.translated: "...He would never look my way while I was little. And you were the same when you were little. Always having feelings for just one person--"

lines.content: 私にはそう見えたし、そんなあなたのことを私は好きになったんだって思えた
lines.translated: "That's how it looked to me, and I felt like that was the version of you I fell in love with."

lines.content: だから、[・|そ][・|れ][・|で]いい。私の大好きな“[場所|隣]”は、あなたの一番大切なひとに贈りたい
lines.translated: "So, *that's* fine. I want to gift the 'place' by your side that I love so much to the person most precious to you."

lines.content: ……大好きな人が幸せになれるなら、これから先の私の人生、ただの一度だって笑えることがなくなってしまってもいいって思えた――
lines.translated: "...If the person I love so much can be happy, I felt like it would be fine even if I never got to smile a single time for the rest of my life--"

lines.content: それがあなたと過ごしたほんの短い時間への、私の心に淡い光りを届けたくれたいっぱいの言葉への、私なりのお返しなんだと、信じたから……。
