lines.translated: Because I believed that was my own way of giving back for the very short time I spent with you, and for all the words that delivered a faint light into my heart...

lines.content: 私が神さまからもらえる予定の幸せを、全部あなたに贈りたいって思ったの
lines.translated: "I wanted to gift all the happiness I was supposed to receive from God to you."

lines.content: “魔法の携帯電話”を俺に渡すということは、クロに俺の“隣”を譲るのだという意思表示のつもりだった。
lines.translated: Handing the "magic cell phone" over to me was meant to be a declaration of her intent to yield the spot "beside" me to Kuro.

lines.content: きっと、あの子が……クロちゃんが、あなたの未来を救ってくれる。絶対に。いつかの未来、あなたが私なんかと出会うようなことにはさせないはずだ
lines.translated: "Surely, that girl... Kuro-chan will save your future. Definitely. Someday in the future, she shouldn't let you end up meeting someone like me."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|の][・|こ][・|と][・|が][・|大][・|好][・|き][・|な][・|あ][・|の][・|子][・|な][・|ら]、きっとあなたのことを幸せな未来に導いてくれるはず。そう信じられた。
lines.translated: *Because she is the girl who loves you so much*, she would surely guide you to a happy future. I was able to believe that.

lines.content: ……だから私が“魔法”なんて使わなくっても大丈夫。もう、平気
lines.translated: "...So it's okay even if I don't use 'magic' or anything. Everything's fine now."

lines.content: そう思ったから、ハルは俺たちの前から去る決意をしたのだという。
lines.translated: Thinking that, Haru says she made up her mind to leave us behind.

lines.content: ちょうどよく施設暮らしだったハルを迎えに来たのは、子どもを授かれなかった心やさしい年老いた大人たち。
lines.translated: With perfect timing, the ones who came to take in Haru, who had been living in an orphanage, were kindhearted elderly adults who had never been blessed with children.

lines.content: 私たちと暮らそう。
lines.translated: Come live with us.

lines.content: そう言われた。
lines.translated: That was what they told her.

lines.content: これまであなたに降り注いださみしいことを全部忘れられるくらい、私たちは、あなたのことを幸せにするために努力する。約束するわ。
lines.translated: We will work hard to make you happy, enough to make you forget all the lonely things that have rained down on you until now. I promise you.

lines.content: 笑顔と。
lines.translated: With smiles.

lines.content: 励ましと。
lines.translated: With encouragement.

lines.content: 暖かなご飯と。
lines.translated: With warm meals.

lines.content: 柔らかな手を、伸ばしてくれた。
lines.translated: They reached out their gentle hands to me.

lines.content: そんなやさしい全部にうなずいて、ハルはこの町を去ったのだ。
lines.translated: Nodding to all of that kindness, Haru left this town.

lines.content: ……ううん。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...No. I'm sorry."

lines.content: うそだよ
lines.translated: "That's a lie."

lines.content: ……うそ？
lines.translated: "...A lie?"

lines.content: 本当は、いやだっただけ
lines.translated: "The truth is, I just couldn't bear it."

lines.content: 一番大好きなあなたの“隣”で、誰かが笑顔でいるのを見ることが……
lines.translated: "Seeing someone else smiling 'beside' you, the person I love most of all..."

lines.content: あなたが“誰か”のそばで、幸せそうにしている姿を、ただ、見つめ続けていなきゃならないことが……想像しただけでも、いや。胸が痛い。息ができない。涙ばかりが、こぼれるの
lines.translated: "Having to just keep staring at you looking happy by 'someone' else's side... Even just imagining it, I hate it. My chest hurts. I can't breathe. Nothing but tears come spilling out."

lines.content: だからハルは、ちょうどよく差し伸べられた手を取った。
lines.translated: And so Haru took the hands that were extended to her at just the right time.

lines.content: 私の一番大切なあなたの“隣”を、あなたの一番大切なひとに贈りたい……、自分で選んだことなのに。そこに“後悔”は、ないはずなのに
lines.translated: "Wanting to gift the spot 'beside' you, my most precious person, to your most precious person... Even though it was something I chose myself. Even though there shouldn't be any 'regret' in that."

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: そんなふたりを見ていたら、私はきっとこう考えてしまう
lines.translated: "If I were to watch the two of you like that, I would surely end up thinking this:"

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ……どうして私はそこにいられないの。
lines.translated: Why can't I be the one standing there?

lines.content: ……どうして私は、あの子じゃないの――どうして。神さま。どうして私、あの人の大好きなひとに……クロちゃんに、産まれて来れなかったの
lines.translated: "...Why am I not that girl--why? God, why couldn't I have been born as the person he loves so much... as Kuro-chan?"

lines.content: 何度もそう考えて、何度でも泣いただろう。
lines.translated: She would have thought that over and over, and cried just as many times.

lines.content: そんなふうに、自分のことしか考えられない私を、私はどうしても好きになんてなれそうになかったから……。そんな自分が、私の中に産まれてなんてほしくなかったから
lines.translated: "Because there was no way I could ever come to like a version of myself who could only think about her own feelings like that... Because I never wanted a version of me like that to be born inside me."

lines.content: だから私は、ただただふたりの前から逃げ出しただけなんだよと、ハルは言った。
lines.translated: That's why I simply ran away from the two of you, Haru said.

lines.content: ……本当は
lines.translated: "...The truth is..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……本当はね。もう二度とこの町に戻ってくるつもりはなかった
lines.translated: "...The truth is, you know, I never intended to come back to this town ever again."

lines.content: 十年前。あさひさんの計算ミス……って言っていいのかな。とにかくそういうふうな不都合で、私たちは“夜”の外に“魔法”を持ち出すことはできなかった
lines.translated: "Ten years ago. Asahi-san's miscalculation... I wonder if it's okay to call it that. Anyway, because of a complication like that, we couldn't bring our 'magic' outside of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: それはつまり“夜の王”と命がけで戦ったのにも関わらず、“夢”を叶えられなかったということで……。
lines.translated: In other words, despite risking our lives to fight the "King of the Night," we weren't able to have our "dreams" granted...

lines.content: 最初から一方通行の片道切符でこの時間にやって来た。だから、元の時間に戻ることもできないし……ううん。戻れたとしてもそうするつもりも、なかった
lines.translated: "From the very beginning, I came to this time on a one-way ticket. So I couldn't return to my original time... No. Even if I could have gone back, I had no intention of doing so."

lines.content: それでも私に不都合はなかった
lines.translated: "Even so, that wasn't a problem for me."

lines.content: 私の願いはあの人が幸せになること。ただそれだけが叶えばいい。それ以上を望んではいけない。そう、思ってた
lines.translated: "My wish was for him to be happy. As long as that alone came true, it was enough. I shouldn't wish for anything more. That's what I thought."

lines.content: その[・|過][・|程]として、私は手に入れた“最後の魔法”で、あの人の身に起こる“不幸”を肩代わりしようとしていただけだから……
lines.translated: "As part of that *process*, I was only trying to use the 'Last Magic' I obtained to take on the 'misfortune' that would befall him in his stead..."

lines.content: その[・|過][・|程]は必ずしも私の“魔法”である必要はない。
lines.translated: That *process* didn't necessarily have to be my "magic."

lines.content: 私はあの人に、あの人の一番大切なひととの繋がりを渡すことができた――“[電話|魔法]”だ。
lines.translated: I was able to hand over a connection to his most precious person--the "magic" cell phone.

lines.content: どんなに遠く離れていても、あの“魔法”さえあればふたりは話すことができる。
lines.translated: No matter how far apart they are, as long as they have that "magic," the two of them can talk.

lines.content: きっとふたりの心はもう離れない。
lines.translated: Surely their hearts will never drift apart again.

lines.content: 私の“魔法”が、あの人の……おじさんの未来を幸せへと導けたはず。
lines.translated: My "magic" should have been able to guide his... the old man's future toward happiness.

lines.content: ――“私たちは、出会ってはいけなかった”
lines.translated: --"We never should have met."

lines.content: ……クロちゃんなら、大丈夫。どんな未来を歩もうと……あの人を、あの人の不幸の根源みたいな私になんか、近寄らせない。絶対
lines.translated: "...If it's Kuro-chan, it'll be fine. No matter what kind of future they walk... she won't let him get anywhere near someone like me, who was like the very root of his misfortune. Definitely."

lines.content: そう、信じたかった。
lines.translated: That was what I wanted to believe.

lines.content: だから私は、今度は、私自身の歩いて行くべき道を探さなきゃって……
lines.translated: "So I thought that this time, I had to find the path that I myself should walk..."

lines.content: さくらの杜“参禅町”から遠く離れた港町で、ハルはぼんやりと、自分の未来をどうにか思い描こうとしていた。
lines.translated: In a port town far away from the Cherry Blossom Forest of "Sanzen-cho," Haru was vaguely trying to picture her own future somehow.

lines.content: そんなハルの心の中には、いつも“夜の魔法使い”――陽向井あさひの言葉が響いていた。
lines.translated: Inside Haru's heart, the words of the "Magician of the Night"--Hinatai Asahi--were always echoing.

lines.content: 『限りある時間を生きる君たちの人生は、一瞬一瞬が、それそのものが、うつくしい歌や絵画や物語と同等なんだと私は思うよ』
lines.translated: "'I think that every single moment of the lives you all live within your limited time is, in and of itself, equal to a beautiful song, painting, or story.'"

lines.content: “永遠”を生きるしかない私たちには理解できない、到達できない一瞬が、その心が、君たちの未来には隠されているはずだから――
lines.translated: Because a single moment and a heart that we, who have no choice but to live through "eternity," can neither understand nor reach must be hidden within your futures--

lines.content: 『だから私たちは、いつも、君たち人間に憧れるんだ。君たちのように生きてみたいと、願うんだ』
lines.translated: "'That's why we always yearn for you humans. We wish we could try living just like you.'"

lines.content: 『……だからな、子ども達。うつくしく生きろよ』
lines.translated: "'...So listen up, kids. Live beautifully.'"

lines.content: “魔法使い”は言った。
lines.translated: The "Magician" said.

lines.content: 『君が大人になって、私たちのことが見えなくなっても、私たちはいつでもそばで君の人生を見つめてる』
lines.translated: "'Even when you grow up and can no longer see us, we will always be right beside you, watching over your lives.'"

lines.content: 私たちが君のそばで、君の選ぶ生き方を見ているよ。
lines.translated: We will be by your side, watching the way of life you choose.

lines.content: 君たちが私が望むように生きようと、生きまいと、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]生きようと生きまいと、私たちがずっとその生き方を応援していこうと思う。
lines.translated: Whether you live the way I hope you will or not, whether you live *like that* or not, we intend to keep cheering on your way of life forever.

lines.content: ピンチのときはいつだって力を貸したいって、そう願うよ。
lines.translated: Whenever you're in a pinch, our wish is to always lend you our strength.

lines.content: 『人の命にはそれぞれ乗り越えるべき命題のようなものが、産まれながらに刻み込まれているように思えることがよくある』
lines.translated: "'It often seems to me as though every human life is engraved from birth with something like a proposition that must be overcome.'"

lines.content: 『その命題をクリアしようが、途中であきらめてしまおうが……。どんなふうに生きたって、必ずだ』
lines.translated: "'Whether you clear that proposition, or give up halfway through... No matter how you live, without fail.'"

lines.content: 『きっと君たちが懸命に生き抜いた人生は、同じようにつらい思いを抱えて生きる誰かの勇気になるはずだ。その“誰か”が、君にとって何より大切な人であることを……祈ってるよ』
lines.translated: "'Surely the lives you lived through with all your might will become courage for someone else living with the same painful feelings. And I pray... that this "someone" is the person most precious to you above all else.'"

lines.content: ……十年前の幼い頃だ。
lines.translated: That was ten years ago, when we were little.

lines.content: “満月の夜会”にて、“魔法使い”が子ども達に語った幾つもの話のひとつだった。
lines.translated: It was one of the many stories the "Magician" told the children at the "Full Moon Soiree."

lines.content: 自分の人生を、これからも続いていく長い時間を、私はどんなふうに使おうか。
lines.translated: How should I use my life, and the long stretch of time that will continue from here on out?

lines.content: あさひさんは言っていた。人の心が紡ぎ、創造する作品たちは、何であれそれは手紙のようなものなのだと――
lines.translated: Asahi-san had said that the works spun and created by the human heart, whatever they may be, are like letters--

lines.content: 未来を生きている、今、自分と同じような“何か”で苦しむ人たちへ送るエールなのだ、と。
lines.translated: That they are cheers sent to people living in the future who are suffering from the same "something" as oneself right now.

lines.content: おじさんと口ずさんだ“愛”と“勇気”の歌が心に響いた。
lines.translated: The song of "love" and "courage" that I hummed with him echoed in my heart.

lines.content: あの歌みたいに、未来へ届くほどのうつくしい“[何か|作品]”と同等するくらい、私の命が価値あるものになれるとは、どうしたって思えないけれど……
lines.translated: "Even though I can't possibly imagine my life ever becoming something valuable enough to equal a beautiful 'work' like that song that reaches into the future..."

lines.content: 私はこの命に、この人生に、どんな絵を描けるだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of picture will I be able to paint upon this life of mine?

lines.content: この人生に、どんな歌を歌えるのだろう――苦しんでいる誰かを勇気づけられるものになるのだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of song will I be able to sing in this life--will it become something that can give courage to someone who is suffering?

lines.content: 私のうつくしい生き方とは――“自分で自分を愛せるような生き方”だ。
lines.translated: My own beautiful way of living is--"a way of living where I can love myself."

lines.content: いつも誰かに見られているつもりで生きてみた。何かを選ぶとき、その選択は自分を愛せる選択だろうか。誰かを励ませるような未来に繋がるだろうか。
lines.translated: I tried living as if someone were always watching over me. Whenever I chose something, would that choice be one that allowed me to love myself? Would it lead to a future where I could encourage someone else?

lines.content: そうして重ねていく今が、私の手紙だ。
lines.translated: The present moments I pile up that way are my letter.

lines.content: その手紙が、その心が、言葉が、未来の[誰か|あの人]へと届くかどうかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know whether that letter, that heart, those words will reach that person in the future.

lines.content: でも、そういうふうに、誰かの笑顔を祈れるような生き方を、できたなら……
lines.translated: "But if I can live in a way where I can pray for someone else's smile like that..."

lines.content: それはきっと、好きな歌にそっと耳を傾けているときみたいに、うつくしい絵を眺めているときみたいに、魂の刻まれたような物語に、ため息をつくときみたいに……。
lines.translated: Surely, just like when you quietly lend an ear to a favorite song, or gaze at a beautiful painting, or let out a sigh over a story that feels as though a soul has been carved into it...

lines.content: 今がつらい誰かの心を生かすことにはならないだろうか――そんなことをぼんやりと……ほんとうにぼんやりと考えていた。
lines.translated: Wouldn't it end up keeping alive the heart of someone who is going through a painful present?--I was vaguely... truly vaguely thinking about such things.
*Thank you very much.*
*Thanks to both of you, even though it was only for a short time, I was able to live happily.*

lines.content: 深いふかい悲しみに暮れる夜のこと……。
lines.translated: It happened on a night when I was lost in deep, deep sorrow...

lines.content: 暗闇の中、小さな鈴の音がした。
lines.translated: In the darkness, there was the sound of a small bell.

lines.content: ……やっと、見つけた
lines.translated: "...I finally found you."

lines.content: 振り返ると子猫がいた。黒猫だ。首輪に小さな鈴が揺れている。
lines.translated: When I turned around, a kitten was there. A black cat. A small bell was swaying on her collar.

lines.content: もしかして……
lines.translated: "Could you be..."

lines.content: 私はその子を知っている。
lines.translated: I know her.

lines.content: ……“不思議の国”と関係していたのはもう十年も前。
lines.translated: It was already ten whole years ago that I was involved with "Wonderland."

lines.content: それでもまだ、大人になりきれていないのだろう私は、まだまだその子のことを忘れずちゃんと覚えてた。
lines.translated: Even so, perhaps because I hadn't fully grown into an adult yet, I still hadn't forgotten her and remembered her clearly.

lines.content: クロ、ちゃん……？
lines.translated: "Kuro-chan...?"

lines.content: 名前を呼んでみた。
lines.translated: I tried calling her name.

lines.content: よかった。ちゃんと忘れてはいなかった。安堵する。でも、少しだけ自信がなかったのも本当だった。
lines.translated: Thank goodness. I really hadn't forgotten her. I felt relieved. Though it was also true that I had been a little unsure of myself.

lines.content: クロちゃんは立ち上がる――するとすぐに人の姿になっていた。目深にフードを被っている。
lines.translated: Kuro-chan stands up--and immediately takes on a human form. She is wearing her hood pulled down low over her eyes.

lines.content: ここに来るまで色々なことがあったのだろう。そんな想像をしてしまうほど、どこか疲弊しきっているように見えた。
lines.translated: A lot must have happened before she made it here. She looked so utterly exhausted that I couldn't help imagining as much.

lines.content: でも、そんなあなたのことを労うような言葉よりも先に、どうして、と私は思ってしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Yet, even before words to comfort her in that state could come out, the thought of "Why?" rose up inside me.

lines.content: ……どうして、クロちゃんが、こんなところにいるの
lines.translated: "...Why are you in a place like this, Kuro-chan?"

lines.content: あなたはあの人の……大雅くんの“隣”にいないとだめなのに。
lines.translated: Even though you have to be "beside" him... beside Taiga-kun.

lines.content: あなたがあの人の笑顔を見つめ。
lines.translated: For you to gaze at his smile.

lines.content: あなたがあの人の未来を護って。
lines.translated: For you to protect his future.

lines.content: あなたが、あの人の“隣”をずっと、歩き続けてほしいと願っていたのに……。どうして。
lines.translated: Even though I wished for you to keep walking "beside" him forever... Why?

lines.content: あなたが、こんなところに
lines.translated: "Why are you in a place like this..."

lines.content: そうつぶやくと、急に悲しくなった。
lines.translated: When I murmured that, I suddenly felt sad.

lines.content: [・|さ][・|っ][・|き][・|ま][・|で]ずっと我慢してきた涙がじわりとにじみもした。
lines.translated: The tears I had been holding back *until just a moment ago* slowly welled up in my eyes, too.

lines.content: そんな私にクロちゃんは、大きな目をぱちぱちとさせながら、
lines.translated: Looking at me like that, Kuro-chan blinked her big eyes,

lines.content: ……ハル
lines.translated: "...Haru."

lines.content: 私の名前をぽつりと、呼んで、
lines.translated: quietly called my name,

lines.content: ……あの町に。さくらの杜に、帰れる？
lines.translated: "...Can you come back to that town? To the Cherry Blossom Forest?"

lines.content: 不安そうに私をちらりと見、
lines.translated: glanced at me anxiously,

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: ぎゅっと、拳をにぎりしめ、
lines.translated: and clenched her fists tightly.

lines.content: ……あなたがいないと、大雅が、大変に
lines.translated: "...Without you there, Taiga is going to be in so much trouble..."

lines.content: そこでクロちゃんは唇を固く結んだ。
lines.translated: Right there, Kuro-chan pressed her lips tightly together.

lines.content: 大雅くんが……なに？　どうしたの？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun is... what? What happened?"

lines.content: ……え、えっと
一度大きく息を吸い、だけど、クロちゃんは下を向いてしまった。
lines.translated: She took one deep breath, yet ended up looking down.

lines.content: ……わたしは、大雅のそばにいられない
lines.translated: "...I can't stay by Taiga's side."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……そばにいるけど、いられないの。どうしても
lines.translated: "...I am by his side, but I can't stay there. No matter what."

lines.content: どういうこと……？
lines.translated: "What do you mean...?"

lines.content: ご、ごめんなさい……
lines.translated: "I-I'm sorry..."

lines.content: クロちゃんはふるふると頭を振った。
lines.translated: Kuro-chan gave a trembling shake of her head.

lines.content: わたし、ばか、だから……。大雅以外の人とも、上手に……話せないから
lines.translated: "Because I'm... stupid... I can't even talk... very well with anyone other than Taiga."

lines.content: だからちゃんと説明できない。ごめんなさい。ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: *So I can't explain it properly. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.*

lines.content: クロちゃんはそう繰り返す。フードを更に深く被ってしまってもいた。
lines.translated: Kuro-chan repeated those words over and over. She had even pulled her hood down lower over her face.

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: ……あなたの“夢”も、“魔法”も、どんなものだったのか、わたし達は知らないけれど……
lines.translated: "...What your 'dream' and your 'magic' were like, we don't know, but..."

lines.content: お願い。どうか大雅に、その“夢”を、叶えさせてあげて、ほしくって……その、だから……わたしは……
lines.translated: "Please. I want you to let Taiga grant that 'dream' of yours... Um, so... I..."

lines.content: そこからクロちゃんは、うつむいたまま、たぶん彼女の事情のようなものをぽつりぽつりと、話していた。
lines.translated: From there, while still looking down, Kuro-chan haltingly spoke about what seemed to be her own circumstances.

lines.content: ……た、大雅が“夢”を、叶えるには――
lines.translated: "...F-For Taiga to make his 'dream' come true--"

lines.content: ……ハル、だけじゃない。きみ達、ぜ、全員の……“夢”を、大雅は、叶えなくちゃ……だめ、で……だ、だから、えっと――
lines.translated: "...It's not just you, Haru. Taiga has to... make the 'dreams' of... a-all of you come true, or else... S-So, um--"

lines.content: 息を切らすみたいに途切れ途切れ、クロちゃんは何かを話し続けてた。
lines.translated: In broken, breathless fragments, Kuro-chan kept trying to tell me something.

lines.content: だけど、ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: But I'm sorry.

lines.content: 私の耳には、その声は殆ど届いていなかった。
lines.translated: Her voice barely reached my ears at all.

lines.content: ……気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: I had realized it.

lines.content: 大雅くんのためにさくらの杜に戻ってほしい――
lines.translated: *I want you to come back to the Cherry Blossom Forest for Taiga-kun's sake--*

lines.content: そう言われ、私は気づいたのだ。
lines.translated: Being told that made me realize the truth.

lines.content: 私があの町から、あなた達ふたりの前から逃げたのには、もうひとつ理由があったことを。
lines.translated: That there was one more reason why I had run away from that town, and from the two of you.

lines.content: ……怖かった
lines.translated: "...I was scared."

lines.content: 私は……
死ぬのが、怖かった。
lines.translated: I was scared of dying.

lines.content: 涙がこぼれた。
lines.translated: Tears spilled over.

lines.content: あの人のためにこの命を犠牲にしても構わない。あの人が私を助けるために、そうしてくれたみたいに――私もあなたに未来を贈りたい。私に思い描ける以上の眩しい未来を。
lines.translated: I wouldn't mind sacrificing this life of mine for his sake. Just as he had done to save me--I wanted to gift him a future, too. A dazzling future beyond anything I could ever picture.

lines.content: そのはずだったのに……。
lines.translated: That was how it was supposed to be, and yet...

lines.content: ……私、どうしても、どうしても……怖くって
lines.translated: "...No matter what, I was just... so, so scared."

lines.content: だからあの町から逃げ出した。
lines.translated: That was why I ran away from that town.

lines.content: ……あなた達ふたりが、幸せになるのを見るのが、つらい
lines.translated: "...Seeing the two of you become happy together hurt."

lines.content: 私の手の届かない場所に……、クロちゃん。あなたが、大雅くんを連れて行ってしまう――でも、私には、その背中を見送ることしかできなくて。それが、悲しかった
lines.translated: "Kuro-chan, you would take Taiga-kun away... to a place beyond my reach--and all I could do was watch your backs as you walked away. That made me so sad."

lines.content: そんな“私”も確かにいた。
lines.translated: That version of "me" had certainly existed, too.

lines.content: でも……
私はただただ単純に怖かったんだ、死ぬことが、怖くて、怖くて、仕方がなかったんだ。
lines.translated: I was simply, purely terrified. Dying was so scary, so unbearably scary, that I couldn't help it.

lines.content: だから私は、“あの人の隣に[あなた|クロ]がいれば大丈夫だ”、というふうに……。
lines.translated: So I told myself that as long as Kuro was "beside" him, everything would be fine...

lines.content: 私……私は、“魔法”を使わなくても済む言い訳を、上手に作れたような、気がして……ひとりで勝手に、納得してた。
lines.translated: I... I felt like I had managed to come up with a clever excuse not to use my "magic"... and I convinced myself of it all on my own.

lines.content: 恋することを大切な人の未来のために諦める――“[・|か][・|わ][・|い][・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|女][・|の][・|子]”
lines.translated: *"A pitiful girl"*--giving up on falling in love for the sake of her precious person's future.

lines.content: そんな自分を演じられ、どこかで[・|浸][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|た]のかも、しれない。
lines.translated: Playing that role, maybe some part of me was *reveling in it*.

lines.content: ああ。私の心はやっぱり、まだあの薄暗い部屋に閉じ込められいるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Ah. Is my heart really still locked away inside that dimly lit room after all?

lines.content: いやだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: そんな“私”は大嫌い。
lines.translated: I hate that "me."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……それはもう、十年も“昔の私”の話だから
lines.translated: "...Because that's a story about the 'me from ten years ago.'"

lines.content: ……ハル？
lines.translated: "...Haru?"

lines.content: どこかぽかんとしていたクロちゃんは、首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Looking somewhat dazed, Kuro-chan tilted her head.

lines.content: 首輪の鈴がかわいい音で立てていた。
lines.translated: The bell on her collar let out a cute ring.

lines.content: その鈴の音を、そして光り輝く小さな足跡を頼りに、十年前の私たちは真っ暗な闇の中、歩いて行けた。
lines.translated: Ten years ago, relying on the sound of that bell and her small, shining footprints, we were able to keep walking through the pitch-black darkness.

lines.content: そのことを思い出し、ふと、笑顔になれた。
lines.translated: Remembering that suddenly brought a smile to my face.

lines.content: もう、大丈夫。“今の私”なら……きっと、できるよ
lines.translated: "It's okay now. The 'me of today'... can surely do it."

lines.content: クロちゃん。あなたにも私の“魔法”の秘密は話せない。話せばたちどころに“魔法”は消える。
lines.translated: Kuro-chan. I can't tell even you the secret of my "magic." If I speak of it, the "magic" will vanish on the spot.

lines.content: だからひとりでやり遂げる。
lines.translated: So I will see it through all by myself.

lines.content: もう、“昔の私”じゃない。
lines.translated: I am no longer the "me of the past."

lines.content: まだまだ子どもな私でも、あのときよりはずっと……心も大きくなれたはずだから
lines.translated: "Even if I'm still just a child, my heart must have grown... so much bigger than it was back then."

lines.content: そうだ。今の私なら、怖くても“魔法”を使える――あの人のために。
lines.translated: That's right. The me of today can use "magic" even if I'm scared--for his sake.

lines.content: それが私の“愛”と“勇気”の歌になるはずだ。
lines.translated: That will surely become my song of "love" and "courage."

lines.content: [・|た][・|と][・|え][・|大][・|切][・|な][・|人][・|を][・|騙][・|す][・|こ][・|と][・|に][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|で][・|も]、必ず、最後までやり遂げる――それが私の歌なんだ。そんな未来を描くことが、私にしか歌えない歌になるはずなんだ。
lines.translated: *Even if it means deceiving the person I cherish*, I will definitely see it through to the very end--that is my song. Painting a future like that is supposed to become the song that only I can sing.

lines.content: （今度こそ本当に、私の“魔法”で……。あなたの“隣”に、あなたの未来に、大雅くん。あなたのかわいい幸せを、届けるよ）
lines.translated: (This time, for sure, with my "magic"... To your "side," to your future, Taiga-kun. I will deliver your sweet happiness.)

lines.content: 私は私の命に、そう誓った。
lines.translated: I swore that upon my own life.

lines.content: あの町に戻る準備はできている。
lines.translated: I am ready to return to that town.

lines.content: 私はクロちゃんにそう伝えた。
lines.translated: I told Kuro-chan as much.

lines.content: するとクロちゃんは微笑んだ。
lines.translated: When I did, Kuro-chan smiled.

lines.content: はじめて見るあなたの笑顔は、とても、かわいい。
lines.translated: Seeing your smile for the first time, it was so very cute.

lines.content: うん。そっか。これは敵わないよねと、思う。
lines.translated: Yeah. I see. I'm really no match for her, I thought.

lines.content: こんなにかわいい子が、あなたのことが大好きだって言って微笑んで、いつも“隣”にいてくれたなら……。
lines.translated: If a girl this cute told you she loved you, smiled at you, and stayed right "beside" you all the time...

lines.content: そうだよ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: そんなの、私だって、この子のことを大好きにしかなれなくなる。
lines.translated: With someone like that, even I couldn't help falling completely in love with her.

lines.content: だから、昔の私が、クロちゃんがあの人の“隣”にいてほしいと願ったのは、そこだけは、間違いじゃなかった。そう思えた。
lines.translated: That was why it felt like the wish my past self had made--for Kuro-chan to stay "beside" him--wasn't a mistake, at least in that regard.

lines.content: だから私もクロちゃんに微笑みかける。
lines.translated: So I smiled back at Kuro-chan, too.

lines.content: 大丈夫。安心して……とは、言い切れないかもだけど。でも、私に任せて。私の“魔法”が、きっと、大雅くんの助けになるはずだから
lines.translated: "It's okay. You don't have to worry... well, maybe I can't say that for sure. But leave it to me. My 'magic' will definitely help Taiga-kun."

lines.content: するとクロちゃんは安心したみたいに[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。そしてそのまま、倒れ込むようにして膝を折る。
lines.translated: Hearing that, Kuro-chan closed her eyelids as if in relief. And just like that, her knees buckled as though she were collapsing.

lines.content: 私は慌てて抱き留めようとした。
lines.translated: I hurriedly reached out to catch her.

lines.content: でも、私が伸ばした手が触れる前に――不思議だ。クロちゃんの小さな身体は、夜の黒色に解けていくみたいにして、消えてしまった。
lines.translated: But before my outstretched hands could touch her--how strange. Kuro-chan's small body vanished, as if melting into the black of the night.

lines.content: 夜空を見上げる。
lines.translated: I looked up at the night sky.

lines.content: 幾千。幾万。幾億の光りたち。
lines.translated: Thousands. Tens of thousands. Hundreds of millions of lights.

lines.content: 今夜、その瞬きは[・|ふ][・|た][・|つ]ほど増えたはず……。
lines.translated: Tonight, that twinkling must have increased by *two*...

lines.content: 突如として今日の私に降りかかってきた悲しみについて、思う。
lines.translated: I thought about the sorrow that had suddenly befallen me today.

lines.content: 私を引き取ってくれたやさしいふたりが亡くなった。原因は事故だった。
lines.translated: The two kind people who had taken me in had passed away. It was an accident.

lines.content: 私の進路相談のため、忙しい仕事場から『絶対に行くからね。大切なあなたの未来の話だもの。待っててね』と電話をくれてから、私が待ってる学校へ、ふたりは急いで……。
lines.translated: For my career counseling meeting at school, they had called me from their busy workplace saying, "We'll definitely be there. It's a talk about your precious future, after all. Wait for us, okay?" and hurried toward the school where I was waiting...

lines.content: まだ寒い季節だ。湿った道路は滑りやすく、ふたりを乗せた車は電信柱に衝突した。
lines.translated: It was still the cold season. The damp road was slick, and the car carrying the two of them crashed into a utility pole.

lines.content: 車は原型をとどめてはいなかった。中のふたりも、同じように。
lines.translated: The car was mangled beyond recognition. And the two people inside it, just the same.

lines.content: ……私は泣いた。
lines.translated: I cried.

lines.content: いっぱい泣いて。泣いて。
lines.translated: I cried my heart out. Cried and cried.

lines.content: “聞いてないぞ。あの子はなんだ。ああ、なるほど、遺産目当てか。あんなかわいい顔して恐ろしい。あいつらの店は俺のもんだぞ。
lines.translated: *"Nobody told me about this. What's the deal with that kid? Oh, I get it, she's after the inheritance. What a terrifying girl behind that cute face. Their shop belongs to me.*

lines.content: いや待て、あの子、誰が引き取るんだ。私はいやよ。俺だって”
lines.translated: *No, wait, who's going to take that kid in? Not me. Count me out, too."*

lines.content: そんなありがちな言葉に満ちた火葬場。そこにいるのがつらくなり、飛び出して……。走って。いっぱい走って。
lines.translated: The crematorium was filled with cliched words like that. Staying there became too painful to bear, so I bolted outside... and ran. I ran and ran.

lines.content: その先で、かわいい鈴の音を聞いたのだった。
lines.translated: And at the end of that run, I heard the cute sound of a bell.

lines.content: ……いつも誰かが、私のために命を落とす
lines.translated: "...Someone always loses their life because of me."

lines.content: 私の人生にはこんな悲しいことばかりが起こる。
lines.translated: Nothing but sad things like this ever happen in my life.

lines.content: そう思い、目に見えない何かを何度も呪ってた。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I cursed something invisible over and over again.

lines.content: おじさん。
lines.translated: Mister.

lines.content: お母さん。
lines.translated: Mom.

lines.content: そしてやさしいふたり。
lines.translated: And those two kind people.

lines.content: 誰もが私の“隣”から去って行った。
lines.translated: Everyone left my "side."

lines.content: それは、偶然だろうか。
lines.translated: Was that a coincidence?

lines.content: それとも私の命がそういう命だからこそ、私は十年前のあの“夜”に呼ばれたのだろうか――誰もが憎む全人類の敵、“夜の王”を倒すために。
lines.translated: Or was it precisely because my life is that kind of life that I was called to that "Night" ten years ago--to defeat the enemy of all mankind whom everyone hates, the "King of the Night"?

lines.content: 確かめたいことはたくさんある。
lines.translated: There are so many things I want to make sure of.

lines.content: そのために私は荷物をまとめた。
lines.translated: For that purpose, I packed my bags.

lines.content: 十年間もお世話になった暖かかった家を出る。
lines.translated: I left the warm house that had taken care of me for ten whole years.

lines.content: 握らされたほんの少しのお金を持って。
lines.translated: Carrying the tiny bit of money that had been pressed into my hands.

lines.content: 遠い未来で出会った大切な想いだけを抱きしめて。
lines.translated: Holding tight only to the precious feelings I had encountered in the distant future.

lines.content: ……幾つもの駅を通り過ぎ、幾つもの町を横切って。
lines.translated: Passing through station after station, crossing town after town.

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: さくらもゆる“夜”へと向かい……。
lines.translated: Heading toward the "Night" where cherry blossoms bud...

lines.content: 十年ぶりだ。
lines.translated: It has been ten years.

lines.content: 私はこの町に、戻ってきた。
lines.translated: I have returned to this town.

lines.content: 懐かしいお店はまだあった。
lines.translated: The nostalgic shop was still there.

lines.content: 私は少しの間、そのお店の扉の前で立ちすくむ。
lines.translated: For a little while, I stood frozen in front of that shop's door.

lines.content: ……大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm okay."

lines.content: 深く、うなずく。
lines.translated: He nodded deeply.

lines.content: そして、手のひらに強く“鍵”を握りしめた。“夜”へと繋がる“鍵”だ。
lines.translated: Then, I squeezed the "Key" tightly in my palm. The "Key" that connects to the "Night."

lines.content: 小さな頃からこれだけはずっと、宝物のように大切にたいせつに、持っていた。
lines.translated: Ever since I was little, this was the one thing I had always kept with me, cherishing it like a treasure.

lines.content: 大丈夫だよ。……うん。大丈夫。きっと、成し遂げられるはず
lines.translated: "I'm okay. ...Yeah. I'm okay. I'm sure I can see this through."
*I've stopped cursing* fate or some invisible "someone."

lines.content: いつも私の“隣”には、声も届かず、目にも映らないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even if no voice reaches me, and nothing is visible to my eyes, right at my "side"...

lines.content: 震える私の手を握り、私のことをいつでも応援し、力を貸してくれるやさしい“何か”がいてくれるのだと、信じたい。
lines.translated: I want to believe there is always a gentle "something" there holding my trembling hand, cheering me on, and lending me strength.

lines.content: それは誰かの“想い”かもしれないし。
lines.translated: Maybe it's someone's "feelings."

lines.content: 星になったやさしい[意思|命]が、本当にそこにいてくれるのかもしれないし。
lines.translated: Maybe the gentle lives that became stars are really right there with me.

lines.content: そんな想いが幾つも重なり、ようやく完成した歌なのかもしれないし……。
lines.translated: Or maybe it's a song finally completed from so many of those feelings overlapping...

lines.content: だから、大丈夫。
lines.translated: So, I'm okay.

lines.content: たくさんの“想い”が私の“隣”にある限り……、
lines.translated: As long as all those "feelings" are at my "side"...

lines.content: どんなことでも乗り越えられる。どんな悲しいことでも、平気なふりして歩いて行ける――私にできないことなんて何もないんだ。そうだよね。おじさん
lines.translated: "I can overcome anything. No matter how sad things get, I can pretend I'm fine and keep walking--there's nothing I can't do. Right, Mister?"

lines.content: どんな結末になったって、私は、この選択に後悔しない。
lines.translated: No matter how this ends, I won't regret this choice.

lines.content: ……これが私の“愛”と“勇気”の歌だから
lines.translated: "...Because this is my song of 'love' and 'courage.'"

lines.content: そうつぶやいた私の唇からは、おじさんと、お母さんが口ずさんでいたあの歌が、まるで夜を彩る花びらみたいにこぼれて落ちる。
lines.translated: As I whispered that, the song Mister and Mom used to hum spilled from my lips like flower petals coloring the night.

lines.content: その歌を最後まで歌いきったなら……。
lines.translated: Once I finished singing that song to the very end...

lines.content: 私は、懐かしいお店の玄関に手を掛けた。
lines.translated: I placed my hand on the front door of the nostalgic shop.

lines.content: ……おじさん。私たちは、出会わなければよかったんだよ
lines.translated: "...Mister. We never should have met."

lines.content: これから先に待ち受ける意地悪な運命と、まるで取引するみたいにそうつぶやいて、私は十年ぶりに、そのお店の玄関を開く。
lines.translated: Whispering that as if making a deal with the cruel fate lying ahead, I opened the front door of that shop for the first time in ten years.

lines.content: さあ、見ていてね。
lines.translated: Now, watch me.

lines.content: 目を逸らさないでいてほしい。
lines.translated: Please don't look away.

lines.content: 私は今から、私だけの“歌”を歌うよ。
lines.translated: Starting now, I'm going to sing my very own "song."

lines.content: 私は、あなたの“隣”にはいられないけれど……。
lines.translated: I can't stay by your "side," though...

lines.content: それでも、私が私のことを好きになれる――世界で唯一の“[場所|隣]”を、護るため……。
lines.translated: Even so, to protect the only "place"--the only "side"--in the world where I can love myself...
I will live *for your sake*.

lines.content: ここから先に進むのは、やっぱりまだ少し怖いけど。
lines.translated: Moving forward from here is still a little scary, after all.

lines.content: でも、できるだけ胸を張って駆け抜けるんだと、私は、決めた――……[・|こ][・|れ]が私の人生だ。
lines.translated: But I've decided to run through it with my head held as high as I can--...*this* is my life.

lines.content: ……お願いします。あさひさん
lines.translated: "...Please, Asahi-san."

lines.content: そうだよ、これが、世界で一番大好きなあなたに贈る、私の“愛”と“勇気”の歌なんだって――私は、決めたの。
lines.translated: That's right. I've decided that this is my song of "love" and "courage," dedicated to you, the person I love most in the world.

lines.content: お願いします。どうか私を、“魔法少女”に戻してください
lines.translated: "Please. Make me a 'magical girl' again."

lines.content: ……ハル、聞いてほしい。試してみたいことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "...Haru, listen to me. There's something I want to try."

lines.content: ハルをまっすぐに見つめ、言った。
lines.translated: I looked straight at Haru and spoke.

lines.content: “夜”は少しずつ明け始めている。
lines.translated: The "Night" was gradually beginning to break.

lines.content: 朝の日差しが俺たちの頬を照らしていた。ハルの両頬がほんのり赤いのは、まだ少し肌に冷たい春の日差しのせいだろうか。
lines.translated: The morning sunlight illuminated our cheeks. Was the faint blush on Haru's cheeks because the spring sunlight still felt a little cold against the skin?

lines.content: 試したいこと……？
lines.translated: "Something you want to try...?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……俺は、ハルの“魔法”の……本当の“効果”を知ったけど
lines.translated: "...I found out the true 'effect'... of your 'magic,' Haru."

lines.content: そのために、ハルは自身の命で“代償”を支払わなければならなくなった――
lines.translated: Because of that, Haru now had to pay the "price" with her own life--

lines.content: ハル自身が、自分の“魔法”を形にするには、それほどの“代償”が相応しいと納得してしまったからだ。
lines.translated: Because Haru herself had accepted that such a heavy "price" was necessary to give form to her "magic."

lines.content: 幼い頃のハルの心が、そういうふうに、“夜”の中で思い描いてしまったからだ……故に。
lines.translated: Because young Haru's heart had envisioned it that way within the "Night"... That was why.

lines.content: ……このままだとハルは、いつかの未来、俺の代わりに――いいや、違うか。[・|俺][・|と][・|一][・|緒][・|に]、この管理室の窓から身を投げることになるんだろう
lines.translated: "...At this rate, sometime in the future, Haru, you'll take my place--no, that's not it. *Together with me*, you'll end up throwing yourself from this office window."

lines.content: どういった経緯を辿り、ふたりは予定されてしまったその最期を迎えるのかは、もちろんわからない。
lines.translated: Of course, I had no idea what kind of events would lead the two of us to meet that predetermined end.

lines.content: 俺がハルの“魔法”の正体を知り、その瞬間に新しく産まれたバットエンドの時間世界が、今もこうして、成長し続けているのだろう。
lines.translated: The bad-end timeline newly born the moment I learned the true nature of Haru's "magic" was likely still continuing to grow even now.

lines.content: ……その日を迎えた俺たちの前に、またあの“悪夢”が現れるのかもしれない。そういうふうに想像、予想をすることは、できる。
lines.translated: When that day came for us, that "Nightmare" might appear before us again. It was easy enough to imagine and predict that.

lines.content: ……俺がハルの“魔法”の効果を知ってしまった、ということを、ハルに黙ったままならば、そういった最悪の“代償”は機能しなかったのかもしれない――
lines.translated: "...If I had just kept quiet and not told you that I found out the effect of your 'magic,' maybe this worst-case 'price' wouldn't have kicked in--"

lines.content: だけど、それでは[・|こ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で]と何も変わらない。
lines.translated: But then, nothing would be any different from *how it's been until now*.

lines.content: それでは、またハルひとりを犠牲にさせてしまうだけだから……。
lines.translated: Because that would just mean letting Haru sacrifice herself all alone again...

lines.content: でも、大雅くん。私の“魔法”の、“代償”は……
lines.translated: "But, Taiga-kun. The 'price' of my 'magic'..."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 未来の世界で、あなたのことを死に追いやってしまった私への罰のようなものだった。そうしないと自分自身を許せそうになかった
lines.translated: "It was like a punishment for myself for driving you to your death in the future world. I felt like I could never forgive myself otherwise."

lines.content: そうまでしないと、“魔法”を得るために同等な“代償”と納得することができなかった。
lines.translated: Unless she went that far, she couldn't accept it as an equal "price" to obtain her "magic."

lines.content: だからこの“代償”そのものが、私の“悪夢”と同じなんだよ。これは私の心の問題。だから、私が自分で対処しなきゃならない問題だった
lines.translated: "So this 'price' itself is the same as my 'Nightmare.' It's a problem within my own heart. That's why it was something I had to deal with myself."

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: こうして、“[呪い|代償]”をふたりで一緒に背負い込んでしまう必要は……どこにも……
lines.translated: "There's no need... for the two of us to shoulder this 'curse'--this 'price'--together like this... None at all..."

lines.content: うん、ないよな。どこもない――今のままじゃあ何ひとつ解決していない。むしろ被害が二倍になったとも言える
lines.translated: "Yeah, there isn't. None at all--as things stand right now, nothing is solved. In fact, you could say the damage has doubled."

lines.content: ……そしてハルの“愛”とか“勇気”とか、そういったものをあまりにも蔑ろにしていると、そういうふうに捕らえることもできうるかもしれない。
lines.translated: And one could also see it as completely disregarding Haru's "love" and "courage," and everything she stood for.

lines.content: ただ、ハル。君にちゃんと事情を伝えておかないと、俺の[・|試][・|し][・|た][・|い][・|方][・|法]は、おそらく充分には働いてくれなかった
lines.translated: "However, Haru. Unless I properly explained the situation to you, the *method I want to try* probably wouldn't have worked well enough."

lines.content: そう言う俺に、ハルは不安そうに首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Hearing me say that, Haru tilted her head uneasily.

lines.content: なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: ……うん。なに、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Okay. What is it, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ハルの“魔法”は、俺の未来の[死|不幸]を肩代わりする、ということ……
lines.translated: "Your 'magic,' Haru, is to take on my future misfortune--my death--in my stead..."

lines.content: ……そうして、願わくば
lines.translated: "...And, if possible..."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ……願わくば。未来の時間の中で、私たちは出会わない――
lines.translated: "...If possible, in the future timeline, we never meet--"

lines.content: ――そしてあなたの“隣”には、あなたの一番大切なひと。そんな未来を描きたかった。そうすることができる“魔法”のはずだったんだよ……大雅くん
lines.translated: "--And by your 'side' is the person most precious to you. That was the future I wanted to paint. It was supposed to be 'magic' that could make that happen... Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ああ。ごめんな……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm sorry..."

lines.content: そんな君の“想い”を、俺は撃ち消してしまった。
lines.translated: I had shot down those "feelings" of yours.

lines.content: ……ハルの“魔法”は、“魔法”というより、“夢”とか“願い”とか“、祈り”、とか。そういうものに近い気がするよ
lines.translated: "...Haru, I feel like your 'magic' is less like 'magic' and more like a 'dream,' a 'wish,' or a 'prayer.' Something close to that."

lines.content: ……そして俺の“魔法”は、これだ
lines.translated: "...And my 'magic' is this."

lines.content: 手のひらに“拳銃”を呼び出す。
lines.translated: I summoned the "handgun" into my palm.

lines.content: ここは“夜”の中である。これくらいの非現実なら容易に可能だ。
lines.translated: We were inside the "Night." Something this unreal was easily possible.

lines.content: この“拳銃”で撃ち抜いたものを過去へと戻す。無機物を撃ち抜いたならどうなるかは、自分の“魔法”ながらまったくわからないけれど――
lines.translated: "Whatever I shoot through with this 'handgun' is sent back to the past. Though even as its user, I have no idea what would happen if I shot an inanimate object--"

lines.content: そこが想像の欠落した俺らしいのだけれど……、
lines.translated: Which was typical of someone lacking in imagination like me, though...

lines.content: ……人を撃ち抜けば、その心を、過去の[・|そ][・|の][・|人][・|自][・|身]の中に押し戻す
lines.translated: "...If I shoot a person, it pushes their mind back into *their past self*."

lines.content: リターンポイントは、その人が人生の中で“後悔”を覚えた瞬間だ。その“後悔”を、リセットした先の時間の中で、取り戻す
lines.translated: "The return point is the moment in their life when they felt 'regret.' In the time after the reset, they undo that 'regret.'"

lines.content: そういうふうにして、この“魔法”を、俺は……
lines.translated: "That is how I was able to imagine and create this 'magic'..."

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: ……[・|俺][・|た][・|ち]は、想像し、創り上げることができた
lines.translated: "...How *we* were able to imagine and create it."

lines.content: ……すごい“魔法”だね
lines.translated: "...That's amazing 'magic.'"

lines.content: ああ。俺[・|た][・|ち]はふたりでようやくひとり分。そのはずだったけど……。“夜”の住人のクロの[心|力]を借りたからなのかな。自分でも驚くほどの“魔法”になった
lines.translated: "Yeah. The two of *us* together finally make one whole person. That was how it was supposed to be, anyway... Maybe it's because I borrowed the power--the heart--of Kuro, a resident of the 'Night.' It turned into 'magic' that surprises even me."

lines.content: ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: 俺は、その名前を口にする。そして“拳銃”に最後の“弾丸”を込めた。クロから渡された七発目だ。
lines.translated: I spoke her name aloud. And then I loaded the final "bullet" into the "handgun." The seventh shot handed to me by Kuro.

lines.content: 聞いてほしい。俺が、試したいことは
lines.translated: "Listen to me. What I want to try..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: この“[魔法|拳銃]”で……
lines.translated: "Is with this 'handgun'--this 'magic'..."

lines.content: 手にした銃口を、俺は、自身のこめかみに添える――……のでは、なく。
lines.translated: I raised the muzzle of the gun in my hand to my own temple--...no, I didn't.

lines.content: ハル。この“弾丸”で、君を撃ち抜く
lines.translated: "Haru. With this 'bullet,' I'm going to shoot you."

lines.content: 目の前のハルの胸元へ、突きつけた。
lines.translated: I pointed it right at Haru's chest in front of me.

lines.content: 今、ここにいる君を撃ち抜いて、君の心を、過去へと連れて行く――君が人生でもっとも“後悔”し続けているポイントへ。そして、そこからは君が変えてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "I'm going to shoot the you who is here right now, and send your mind back to the past--to the point in your life that you continuously 'regret' the most. And from there, I want you to change it."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ハル自身が、ハルの運命を変えてほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "I want you to change your own fate, Haru."

lines.content: ……ハルに“魔法”の“許可”を安易に出してしまったことを“後悔”してる
lines.translated: "...I 'regret' giving you 'permission' to use your 'magic' so carelessly."

lines.content: そんな俺は、この“魔法”を何度使おうと、君を救いたいと願えば願うほど……この“夜”にしか戻って来れない。だから君を、救えない
lines.translated: "Because of that, no matter how many times I use this 'magic,' the more I wish to save you... the more I can only return to this 'Night.' That's why I can't save you."

lines.content: 俺の“魔法”は、人生でもっとも“後悔”しているポイントに戻るはずのもの。それなのにこの“夜”ばかりに戻ってくるんだよ
lines.translated: "My 'magic' is supposed to take me back to the point of greatest 'regret' in my life. And yet, I keep coming back only to this 'Night.'"

lines.content: 改めて口にして……おかしいよなと、苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: Saying it out loud again... I gave a bitter smile, thinking how strange it was.

lines.content: 本当に。
lines.translated: Seriously.

lines.content: 俺の人生、“後悔”だらけだったはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though my life was supposed to be full of "regrets."

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: 人生でもっとも後悔していたはずの瞬間も、どうしてだろう――今やぼんやりとしてしまっていて。
lines.translated: Why was it that even the moment I was supposed to have regretted the most in my life--had now grown so hazy?

lines.content: それがどうしようもなく、悲しくも思えて。
lines.translated: And that felt hopelessly sad to me.

lines.content: ……大雅くん？
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ふと、不安そうにハルが俺を呼ぶ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Haru called my name uneasily.

lines.content: だから俺は大丈夫だよと言い、少し、笑った。
lines.translated: So I told her I was fine, and smiled a little.

lines.content: しかもこの“魔法”はいつまで経っても精度が低い。“後悔”している瞬間のピンポイントから、いつも少しずれるんだ
lines.translated: "On top of that, this 'magic' still has low accuracy. It always misses the exact pinpoint of the 'regretted' moment by a little bit."
"That's because it's me. Because my 'imagination' is lacking... *That's why it's always off the mark*."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: だけど、ハル。十年前、“特別”だった君なら……
lines.translated: "However, Haru. If it's you, who was 'special' ten years ago..."

lines.content: そんな君の特別な“想像力”でなら、きっと、俺にできなかったことを成せるはず。そう考えた
lines.translated: "With your special 'imagination,' I'm sure you can accomplish what I couldn't. That's what I thought."

lines.content: とにかく俺はこの“夜”に縛られてる。これより以前には、一秒たりとも後ろへ戻ることができない
lines.translated: "Anyway, I'm bound to this 'Night.' I can't go back even a single second further than this."

lines.content: だからすべて君に託したいんだ、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: That's why I want to entrust everything to you, I told her.

lines.content: 君は、自分の“魔法”を[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]“[・|想][・|像]”したことを“後悔”していないと言い切った――
lines.translated: "You declared that you don't 'regret' *imagining* your 'magic' *that way*--"

lines.content: それはつまり、俺の“魔法”が、君のことを連れて行くだろう過去とは、君が“魔法”を“想像”した以前となるはずだ……と、思いたい。
lines.translated: Which meant the past my "magic" would take her to should be before she "imagined" her "magic"... or so I wanted to believe.

lines.content: その時間の中では、“代償”はまだ俺たちに発生していないのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: In that time, wouldn't the "price" not have taken effect on us yet?

lines.content: そこからならば、どうにでも人生を書き換えられるのでは、ないか。
lines.translated: From there, wouldn't it be possible to rewrite her life however she wanted?

lines.content: そういうふうに都合良く俺は期待してしまっているのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't help holding onto such convenient hopes.

lines.content: 人生を、やり直すんだよ。君が“魔法”を必要としなくてもよくなるように
lines.translated: "You'll start your life over. So that you won't even need 'magic' anymore."

lines.content: ……そのために、俺は最後の“[弾丸|魔法]”を使いたい。そう、思ってる
lines.translated: "...That's what I want to use this final 'bullet'--this final 'magic'--for. That's how I feel."

lines.content: ハルを撃ち抜き、その心を、あるいは魂そのものを、過去へと戻す。
lines.translated: I would shoot through Haru, sending her mind, or perhaps her very soul, back to the past.

lines.content: そうして[・|今][・|ま][・|で][・|の][・|記][・|憶][・|を][・|持][・|っ][・|た][・|ま][・|ま]、もう一度、ハルに“困難”へと立ち向かってほしい――
lines.translated: And then, *keeping all her memories up until now*, I wanted Haru to stand up against her "hardships" once more--

lines.content: ごめんな。ハル。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Haru.

lines.content: そんな、あまりにも人任せな方法しか、もう、俺には思いつけないでいた。
lines.translated: I couldn't come up with any other way besides a method that left everything up to someone else.

lines.content: ハルは俺の突きつけている銃口を、言葉もなくただじっと見ている。
lines.translated: Haru simply stared wordlessly at the muzzle of the gun I was pointing at her.

lines.content: 俺の提案は、あんまりにも乱暴だ。
lines.translated: My proposal was far too reckless.

lines.content: 本当に上手くいくという保証あってのことではない――だというのに、
lines.translated: There was no guarantee that it would actually work--and yet,

lines.content: ……そのために、ハル。今ここにいる君には一度、死んでもらわなきゃ、ならないんだ
lines.translated: "...To do that, Haru, the you who is here right now has to die once."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|し][・|て]、もうこの方法しか残されていないのだと、半ば強引に迫っているに等しい状況なのだ。
lines.translated: *Doing it this way* was practically the same as forcefully pressuring her by claiming this was the only method left.

lines.content: これはあんまりにも取り返しがなさすぎる“魔法”だと、しみじみと、思う。
lines.translated: It really hit me just how utterly irreversible this "magic" was.

lines.content: 小さな頃から命を軽薄に扱ってきた俺の本質が思い描いたというなら、これほど自分にしっくりとはまり込む“魔法”はないだろうと、感じてしまう。
lines.translated: If it was envisioned by the true nature of someone like me, who had treated life so flippantly since I was little, I felt there could be no "magic" that suited me better.

lines.content: それでも……いや、だからこそ俺は、問いかけないわけにはいかない。
lines.translated: Even so... no, precisely because of that, I had to ask her.

lines.content: ……もしも
lines.translated: "...What if--"

lines.content: もしも人生、どこかの[・|時][・|点]からやり直せるなら……
lines.translated: "If you could start your life over from *some point*..."

lines.content: 引き金に人差し指を掛けた。
lines.translated: I rested my index finger on the trigger.

lines.content: ……ハル、君は、どんな瞬間を選ぶ
lines.translated: "...Haru, what moment would you choose?"

lines.content: 俺の言葉に、ハルは目を細め、
lines.translated: At my words, Haru narrowed her eyes,

lines.content: 私は……
ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: しかし足下に視線を落とす。
lines.translated: only to drop her gaze to her feet.

lines.content: ……少しの沈黙。
lines.translated: A brief silence.

lines.content: そして、再び俺を見上げたとき、その瞳は震えていた。
lines.translated: And when she looked up at me again, her eyes were trembling.
"Taiga-kun. *We*..."

lines.content: 声をも震わせ、そこまで言って――
lines.translated: Her voice trembled too as she said that much--

lines.content: だけど、ハルはまた唇をきつく結んでしまった。
lines.translated: But then Haru pressed her lips tightly together again.

lines.content: “私たちは……”ハルの言葉の先を、どういうわけだか予想できてしまっていた。
lines.translated: "We..." For some reason, I could already predict what would come after Haru's words.

lines.content: だからというわけでは、ない。
lines.translated: It wasn't just because of that, though.

lines.content: 好きだよ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: ただ本心を伝えたい。
lines.translated: I simply wanted to tell her my true feelings.

lines.content: 俺は、君が好きだよ。ハル。大好きなんだ。心から
lines.translated: "I love you, Haru. I really love you. From the bottom of my heart."

lines.content: 本心を、伝えなければ……、強く、そう思うのだ。
lines.translated: I had to convey my true feelings... I felt that urge strongly.

lines.content: これからもずっと、君と一緒に生きていきたい。……こんな“魔法”を突きつけておいて尚、そう願ってる
lines.translated: "I want to keep living together with you forever. ...Even while pointing this kind of 'magic' at you, that's what I wish for."

lines.content: ハルの“悪夢”を撃ち抜き知った。
lines.translated: I learned it when I shot through Haru's "nightmare."

lines.content: 大人になった未来の俺だ。その心をだ――未来の俺は、いつも[・|あ][・|の][・|子]のことを焦がれてた。子どもではいられなくなり、あの子とも、もう友だちでさえいられなくなり……。
lines.translated: It was the future me, grown into an adult. It was his heart--the future me always yearned for *that girl*. Unable to remain a child, unable to even remain friends with her anymore...

lines.content: 会いたい。
lines.translated: I want to see her.

lines.content: 未来の俺はそう願ってた。
lines.translated: That was what the future me wished for.

lines.content: もう一度、君と会いたい……。
lines.translated: I want to see you one more time...

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]の“隣”が唯一やすらげる場所だった。[・|あ][・|の][・|子]と“さよなら”してから、そんな自分に気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: By *that girl's* "side" was the only place I could find peace. After saying "goodbye" to *her*, I came to realize that about myself.

lines.content: ……“不思議な夜の住人たち”
lines.translated: "The mysterious residents of the Night."

lines.content: 彼女ともう一度出会うには、現実世界から離れるしかないと未来の俺は悟った。
lines.translated: The future me realized that the only way to meet her again was to leave the real world behind.

lines.content: つまり、死に場所を求めてた――幼い頃の俺とまったく変わらず。まったく成長も、することなく。
lines.translated: In other words, he was looking for a place to die--no different at all from when I was a child. Without having grown up in the slightest.

lines.content: だけど、ただ何も成さずに人生から去りゆくのは、[・|う][・|つ][・|く][・|し][・|く][・|な][・|い]。
lines.translated: However, leaving life behind without accomplishing anything at all *wasn't beautiful*.

lines.content: そう思ったから。
lines.translated: Because that was what he thought.

lines.content: 自分にも何か、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]みたいに――智仁みたいに、その命をもやすような“歌”を残せないだろうか。
lines.translated: He wondered if he too could leave behind a "song" that burned with his very life, just like *that guy*--just like Tomohito.

lines.content: たったひとりを想い続けるための“歌”
lines.translated: A "song" to keep loving just one single person.

lines.content: ……どんなに不格好でも、情けなくっても、与えられたこの人生を生き抜いたんだという証拠が、ほしかった。
lines.translated: No matter how clumsy or pathetic it was, he wanted proof that he had lived through this life he was given to the very end.

lines.content: そんな想いを幼いハルに重ねたのだ。
lines.translated: He projected those feelings onto the young Haru.

lines.content: もしもハルの命を未来に繋ぐことができたなら、このさみしい命の持ち主を、幸せな未来へと導けたなら。
lines.translated: If he could connect Haru's life to the future, if he could guide the owner of this lonely life toward a happy future.

lines.content: それだ。それが俺の“歌”になる――
lines.translated: That's it. That would become my "song"--

lines.content: そんなことを、そんな、あんまりにも青臭くて仕方のないことを、大人になってまで俺は思っていた。
lines.translated: Even after growing into an adult, I was still thinking such hopelessly naive things.

lines.content: そういうふうにして、未来の俺は、納得できる命の使い道を見つけたのだ……。
lines.translated: That was how the future me found a way to use his life that he could accept...

lines.content: 未来の自分が見ていた風景を理解していて尚、俺は、今――目の前にいてくれる君へと伝えたい。
lines.translated: Even understanding the scenery my future self had been looking at, right now--I wanted to convey this to the girl standing in front of me.

lines.content: ……お願いだ。ハル。君が、俺の“隣”にいてほしい
lines.translated: "...Please, Haru. I want you to be by my 'side.'"

lines.content: ……ハルが恐る恐る視線を上げ、俺を見た。
lines.translated: Timidly, Haru raised her gaze and looked at me.

lines.content: 未来の俺が君にどう言ったのかは、知ってる。“小さなハルの想いには応えられない”――その気持ちも、わからないではないけれど……
lines.translated: "I know what the future me said to you. 'I can't return little Haru's feelings'--it's not that I don't understand how he felt, either, but..."

lines.content: ……ハル
lines.translated: "...Haru."

lines.content: 君は俺の好きな人で、憧れの人でもあるんだよ
lines.translated: "You're the person I love, and also someone I admire."

lines.content: そんな君とふたりで生きていける未来を、その道を、一緒に“想像”することはできないのかな
lines.translated: "Can't we 'imagine' a future where the two of us can live together--and the path to get there--together?"

lines.content: ――君は、俺にとってのヒーローなんだ。そのひとりなんだよ。
lines.translated: --You are a hero to me. One of my heroes.

lines.content: そんな君の“隣”にこそ俺はいたいのだと、願うのだ。
lines.translated: It's right by your "side" that I wish to be.

lines.content: 俺も、ハルと同じなんだよ
lines.translated: "I'm the same as you, Haru."

lines.content: ……同じ？
lines.translated: "...The same?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ハルは俺の“隣”にいるときだけ、好きな自分になれると言ってくれていたけれど……俺もだ
lines.translated: "You told me that you can only become a version of yourself you like when you're by my 'side'... and it's the same for me."

lines.content: ハルの“隣”にいるとき、俺も好きな自分になれる。君と話していると、“困った人を絶対に見過ごせない”――そんな君のようになりたいと、俺も思えるようになるんだ
lines.translated: "When I'm by your 'side,' Haru, I can become a version of myself that I like, too. When I talk to you, it makes me want to become someone like you--someone who 'can never ignore a person in trouble.'"

lines.content: ハルの“隣”で、俺はなりたい自分を思い描けた。
lines.translated: By Haru's "side," I could envision the person I wanted to become.

lines.content: それは、“希望”みたいに暖かいもので……。
lines.translated: It was something warm, like "hope"...

lines.content: いつも最悪な死に方を探し歩いていた俺にとって、眩しいほどの光りに思え……。
lines.translated: To someone like me, who had always walked around looking for the worst way to die, it seemed like a dazzling light...

lines.content: 少しでも長く、そんな暖かなものを感じる自分でいたいと、思ったから……。
lines.translated: Because I wanted to be someone who could feel that warmth for even just a little bit longer...

lines.content: ……だからこうして何度も、何度でも、君のことを求めて、君と一緒に生きていける道を探して、この“夜”に戻ってきたんだ
lines.translated: "...That's why I've come back to this 'Night' over and over, as many times as it takes, seeking you out and searching for a way to live together with you."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 何度でも言おう。柊ハル。俺は、君が好きだ。
lines.translated: I'll say it as many times as it takes. Hiiragi Haru. I love you.

lines.content: こんな“魔法”を突きつけておいて言えたせりふじゃないだろうけれど……、本当に、大好きなんだよ。ハル
lines.translated: "I know it's not something I have any right to say while pointing this kind of 'magic' at you... but I really do love you, Haru."

lines.content: お願いだ。一緒に、この先の未来の中に、ふたり分の幸せを探せないのかな
lines.translated: "Please. Can't we search for enough happiness for the two of us in the future ahead, together?"
*That girl* wished for *that* from me.

lines.content: 俺の“隣”にはハルがいてほしいと。
lines.translated: She wanted Haru to be by my "side."

lines.content: もしも俺が[・|あ][・|の][・|子]の“隣”を選ぼうものなら……。
lines.translated: If I were to choose *that girl's* "side" instead...

lines.content: ハルの“悪夢”を通し垣間見た未来の俺のように、孤独に喘ぎ、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]の面影ばかりを追いかけて、ついには自ら死を選ぶ――そんな[バッドエンド|不幸な未来]が訪れることになる。
lines.translated: Just like the future me I caught a glimpse of through Haru's "nightmare," I would gasp in loneliness, chasing only the traces of *that girl*, and finally choose death on my own--such an unhappy future, a bad end, would come to pass.

lines.content: そんな未来を、幾つもの“さよなら”ばかりを重ねる“夜の住人”である[・|あ][・|の][・|子]が、危惧できないはずもなく……。
lines.translated: There was no way *that girl*, a "resident of the Night" who had experienced so many "goodbyes," wouldn't have feared such a future...

lines.content: そして、おそらくはずっと、だ。
lines.translated: And, most likely, for the entire time.

lines.content: 自分のことを見えなくなってしまった後も、俺のそばにいてくれたのだろう[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は……。
lines.translated: Even after I could no longer see her, *that girl* had probably stayed by my side...

lines.content: 未来の俺が最後に見上げた[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は、泣いていたのだ――俺にこんな未来を選んでほしくはなかった、と。
lines.translated: *That girl*, whom the future me looked up at in his final moments, had been crying--as if to say she hadn't wanted me to choose a future like this.

lines.content: もう[・|あ][・|の][・|子]を泣かせたくはない。
lines.translated: I don't want to make *her* cry anymore.

lines.content: だから俺は。
lines.translated: That's why I...

lines.content: それだけではなく、俺は。
lines.translated: And not just because of that, I...

lines.content: ハル……。
lines.translated: Haru...

lines.content: 柊ハル。
lines.translated: Hiiragi Haru.

lines.content: 君の“隣”にいさせてほしいと、願う。
lines.translated: I wish for you to let me stay by your "side."

lines.content: ……なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "...Hey, Haru."

lines.content: たくさん、たくさんの言葉を重ね、遠回りをも重ねてしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: I had piled up so, so many words, and taken so many detours, too, but...

lines.content: なんだか変だよな。おかしい、よな
lines.translated: "It's kind of strange, isn't it? Funny, even."

lines.content: 未来の世界では、君が俺に“うなずいてほしい”と願ってた。そして今、いや……過去と呼んで良いのかどうかは複雑だけれど……とにかく今だ。俺のほうがハルに願ってる
lines.translated: "In the future world, you were the one wishing for me to 'nod.' And now, well... whether it's right to call this the past is complicated, but... anyway, right now. I'm the one wishing to you, Haru."

lines.content: お願いだから“うなずいてほしい”と、思ってる。
lines.translated: Thinking, please, I want you to "nod."

lines.content: 俺の“魔法”と、ハルの“想い”で、未来を変えよう――……お願いだ。ハル。どうかうなずいてはもらえないかな
lines.translated: "With my 'magic' and your 'feelings,' Haru, let's change the future--...Please, Haru. Won't you nod for me?"

lines.content: そうでなければこの“魔法”の引き金を引けない――そのための“覚悟”が、決まらない。
lines.translated: Otherwise, I couldn't pull the trigger of this "magic"--I couldn't find the "resolve" to do it.

lines.content: 俺たちの間に沈黙が降りる。
lines.translated: Silence fell between us.

lines.content: ……私も
lines.translated: "...Me too."

lines.content: ぽつりと、ハルがこぼした。
lines.translated: Quietly, Haru murmured.

lines.content: 私も、好き……なんだよ
lines.translated: "I love you, too..."

lines.content: あなたのことが、ずっと、ずっと……大好きだったんだよ。大雅くん
lines.translated: "I've always, always... loved you so much, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: だけど……うん、そうだね
lines.translated: "But... yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 確かにそうだよねと、ハルは微笑む。
lines.translated: That really is true, isn't it, Haru smiled.

lines.content: どんなに好きだよって伝えても、未来の世界では絶対にうなずいてもらえなかった
lines.translated: "No matter how much I told you I loved you, in the future world, you would never nod for me."

lines.content: それなのに……今の世界では、私のことを好きだって言ってくれる。私のことを離したくないって、言ってくれる
lines.translated: "And yet... in this world right now, you tell me that you love me. You tell me that you don't want to let me go."

lines.content: もしも、願いが叶うなら……。そうすることが可能なら。私も、あなたと一緒にいたい。これからもそういう未来を選んでいきたい。そう、思うけど……
lines.translated: "If my wish could come true... If doing that were possible. I want to be with you, too. I'd want to keep choosing that kind of future from now on. That's what I think, but..."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: でも、やっぱりだめなんだよ
lines.translated: "Even so, it's just not possible."

lines.content: 大雅くんが、私を好きだって言ってくれて……私も、それに応えられて……、今夜は本当に幸せな“夜”だった
lines.translated: "You told me you loved me, Taiga-kun... and I was able to return those feelings... Tonight really was a happy 'Night.'"

lines.content: 思い出してみてよと、ハルは言った。
lines.translated: Try to remember, Haru said.

lines.content: 未来で交わした約束だよ。覚えてる？
lines.translated: "It's a promise we made in the future. Do you remember?"

lines.content: 未来で……？
lines.translated: "In the future...?"

lines.content: そう。未来の世界で
lines.translated: "Yes. In the future world."

lines.content: ハルは微笑み、言う。
lines.translated: Haru smiled and spoke.

lines.content: ……あなたと、満開に咲いたあのさくらを一緒に見上げられた。私の“魔法”が咲かないはずの花を“夜”の中で咲かせられた――それで私の“夢”は叶ったんだよ
lines.translated: "...I was able to look up at that cherry tree in full bloom together with you. My 'magic' made flowers that shouldn't have been able to bloom blossom inside the 'Night'--and with that, my 'dream' came true."

lines.content: ……未来で約束したよね、大雅くん――ううん、おじさん
lines.translated: "...We made a promise in the future, didn't we, Taiga-kun--no, Mister?"

lines.content: あのさくらがもしも咲いていたら。そんな景色をふたりで一緒に、手を、繋いで……見上げられたなら。あなたが私の願いを叶えてくれるって
lines.translated: "That if that cherry tree were ever to bloom... If the two of us could hold hands, and look up at that scenery together... you would grant my wish."

lines.content: 私の“願い”
lines.translated: My "wish."

lines.content: ……私の“夢”
lines.translated: My "dream."

lines.content: 私はあなたのことが大好きで。誰よりも、大好きだと信じたくって……そんな気持ちを受け止めてもらいたかった
lines.translated: "I love you so much. I wanted to believe that I loved you more than anyone else... and I wanted you to accept those feelings."

lines.content: ……ありがとう。全部ぜんぶ、未来ではなくて、今のあなたが叶えてくれたよ
lines.translated: "...Thank you. All of it, every last bit of it, wasn't granted by the future you, but by the you who is here right now."

lines.content: もう……いいの。これ以上、私はいらない。そう思った。これ以上を私が望んじゃだめなんだ――
lines.translated: "That's... enough for me. I don't need anything more than this. That's what I thought. I mustn't wish for anything more--"

lines.content: だって私は、本当なら、お母さんに閉じ込められていたあの小さな部屋の中で、誰にも知られず死んでいた。そうすることが一番だった
lines.translated: "Because if things had gone the way they were supposed to, I would have died unknown to anyone inside that tiny room my mother locked me in. That would have been for the best."

lines.content: そんな私に、こんな、すてきなこと……もう、うれしすぎて、幸せすぎて。もう一生分の[いいこと|幸せ]を、この“夜”で使い切っちゃっただろうから……
lines.translated: "For someone like me to experience something so wonderful... I'm already too glad, too happy. I've probably used up a whole lifetime's worth of happiness in this 'Night'..."

lines.content: これから私にはどんな不幸なことが待ってるんだろう。そう考えると、すごく怖くもあって……
lines.translated: "What kind of misfortune is waiting for me from here on out? When I think about that, it's really scary, too..."

lines.content: だからもうこのまま、幸せなまま死んでしまったほうがいいって。私に幸せをくれたあなたのためになら、怖くないって、思えて……
lines.translated: "So I thought it would be better if I just died right here, while I'm still happy. I felt like if it was for you, the one who gave me this happiness, I wouldn't be afraid..."

lines.content: そうしてようやく覚悟が決まったのだという――
lines.translated: And that, she said, was how she had finally made up her mind--

lines.content: ……ううん。やっぱり、違う。覚悟なんて簡単に決まらない。怖かった。ずっと、怖かった
lines.translated: "...No. Actually, that's wrong. Resolve isn't something you can find so easily. I was scared. I was scared the whole time."

lines.content: ……やっと“夢”が叶ったのに。
lines.translated: Even though my "dream" finally came true.

lines.content: やっとあなたに想いが、届いたのに
lines.translated: "Even though my feelings finally reached you..."

lines.content: それなのに、どうして……。
lines.translated: And yet, why...?

lines.content: ……私は死ななきゃいけない……
lines.translated: "...I have to die..."

lines.content: いやだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 私は、大好きなあなたにさよならしないと、いけない
lines.translated: "I have to say goodbye to you, the person I love so much."

lines.content: いやだよ。
lines.translated: I don't want that.

lines.content: またあなたの“隣”を、誰かに譲らなければならないなんて……
lines.translated: "To have to give up my place by your 'side' to someone else again..."

lines.content: そんなのは……、
lines.translated: Something like that is...

lines.content: あなたが誰かと笑ってる。そんな未来を思ってしまって……そんなのは、[・|痛][・|い]どこか奥のほうがすごく、痛かった
lines.translated: "I ended up imagining a future where you're smiling with someone else... and that *hurt*. Somewhere deep inside, it hurt so much."

lines.content: ……そんな自分のことも、私はすごく嫌だと思った。こんな嫌な自分のことなんて、消してしまいたいって、思った
lines.translated: "...And I hated myself so much for feeling that way, too. I wanted to erase this awful version of myself."

lines.content: だからここで、この“夜”で、私は予定どおり“魔法”を使い、あなたの未来に訪れる予定の“不幸”を、肩代わりする――最後にそうできた自分のことを、私はきっと誇ることができる
lines.translated: "So right here, in this 'Night,' I'll use my 'magic' just as planned, and take on the 'misfortune' meant to visit your future in your stead--and in the end, I'm sure I'll be able to be proud of myself for doing that."

lines.content: ……そうすることで、私の歌は……私の“愛”と“勇気”の歌は、あなたへのたくさんの“想い”を重ねて、完成するんだって思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "...By doing so, I thought my song... my song of 'love' and 'courage,' layered with all of my 'feelings' for you, would finally be complete."

lines.content: だからハルは今夜、自身の“[悪夢|代償]”に[・|命][・|を][・|握][・|り][・|つ][・|ぶ][・|さ][・|せ][・|た]――怖かったけど。どうしようもなく、[・|痛][・|か][・|っ][・|た]けど。
lines.translated: That was why, tonight, Haru *let her life be crushed in the grip of* her own "nightmare"--her price. Even though it was scary. Even though it *hurt* so hopelessly much.

lines.content: そうするしかなかった。
lines.translated: I had no choice but to do so.

lines.content: そうするしか、未来を変える方法は思いつけなかったから……
lines.translated: "Because that was the only way I could think of to change the future..."

lines.content: だから、だめなんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why we can't do this."

lines.content: [・|私][・|だ][・|け][・|が]、今夜の“夜”の中で散っていかないと……、未来は変わらない。そのはずだったのに……
lines.translated: "Unless *I alone* scatter away inside tonight's 'Night'... the future won't change. That's how it was supposed to be, and yet..."

lines.content: その“魔法”は、助け出したいと願った俺の手によって、打ち砕かれた。
lines.translated: That "magic" was shattered by my own hands, because I wished to save her.

lines.content: 今はもう、ほんの些細な“希望”でさえ消えてなくなってしまった。
lines.translated: Now, even the faintest shred of "hope" had vanished completely.

lines.content: だから、大雅くん。やっぱり、[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|は]……
lines.translated: "So, Taiga-kun. In the end, *we*..."

lines.content: そこでまたハルはうつむいてしまう。その先の言葉をどうしても口にできない。そんなふうに、苦しんでいるようにも見えた。
lines.translated: Haru cast her gaze down again. She just couldn't bring herself to speak the words that came after. She looked as if she were in pain.

lines.content: ……信じてる
lines.translated: "...I believe."

lines.content: ……“私も、あなたと一緒にいたい”――今、そう言ってくれたハルの言葉を、ハルの想いを、俺は信じたい
lines.translated: "...'I want to be with you, too'--the words you just said to me, Haru, and your feelings... I want to believe in them."

lines.content: 引き金に掛けた指に力を込める。
lines.translated: I tightened my finger against the trigger.

lines.content: ……俺の“魔法”とハルの“想い”が、俺たちの未来を変えてくれるはずだって、信じてる
lines.translated: "...I believe that my 'magic' and your 'feelings' will change our future."

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだ。信じてる
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right. I believe."

lines.content: まるで重要な呪文のように繰り返す。
lines.translated: I repeated it as if it were an important spell.

lines.content: ……俺は、ハルのことを信じてる。誰よりも強く信じたいと思ってる。自分自身のことよりも、ずっとだ――ああ、だってさ、ハル。君は俺のヒーローなんだ
lines.translated: "...I believe in you, Haru. I want to believe in you more strongly than anyone. Far more than I believe in myself--yeah, because, Haru, you're my hero."

lines.content: 微笑みを浮かべ、俺は、引き金を……、
lines.translated: With a faint smile on my face, I began to pull the trigger...

lines.content: 俺なんかには絶対に成し遂げられないことでも、きっと君なら、やり遂げてくれるはずだと……
lines.translated: "Even if it's something someone like me could never pull off, I know that if it's you, you'll see it through..."

lines.content: 引き金を……、俺は……、
lines.translated: The trigger... I...

lines.content: ……大雅くん？
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ごめん、ハル。俺は……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Haru. I..."

lines.content: 俺はあんまりにも無責任に、“君にならできるはず”だ、なんて……あんまりにも独りよがりな期待を、俺は……俺の大好きな人に押しつけようとしている。
lines.translated: How utterly irresponsible of me, saying "if it's you, you can do it"... I was trying to force such selfish expectations onto the person I loved so much.

lines.content: だが、これしかないんだ。
lines.translated: Even so, this was the only way.

lines.content: これしかもう、ハルの命を、その未来を救う方法は、なにも……。
lines.translated: There was no other way left to save Haru's life, to save her future...

lines.content: だから長々と軽口めいた言葉を残し、何でもないことのように見せ、俺は、この引き金を引いてしまうはずだった。
lines.translated: That was why I had meant to leave behind a long string of lighthearted words, act as if it were nothing at all, and pull this trigger.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: ……大雅くん。顔が、真っ青だよ……
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun. You're pale as a sheet..."

lines.content: 俺は、震えていた。
lines.translated: I was trembling.

lines.content: 涙さえ流れ始めた。
lines.translated: Even tears had begun to spill down my cheeks.

lines.content: ……“魔法”を使う。引き金を、引く。
lines.translated: Use my "magic." Pull the trigger.

lines.content: それはつまり、今、目の前にいるハルのことを、大好きな君のことを、俺は撃ち殺さなければならなくて……。
lines.translated: That meant I had to shoot and kill Haru, who was standing right in front of me--shoot and kill the girl I loved so much...

lines.content: 怖い。
lines.translated: I'm scared.

lines.content: そう、思った。
lines.translated: That was what I thought.

lines.content: ……君を救うために、君のことを殺さなきゃ。
lines.translated: To save you, I have to kill you.

lines.content: いったいなんだ。これはいったい何の冗談だ。あんまりにも悪趣味すぎる。
lines.translated: What the hell is this? What kind of sick joke is this? It's in way too poor taste.

lines.content: 心で悪態をつかずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help cursing inside my head.

lines.content: ……自分自身が“想像”に荷担した“魔法”であるはずなのに。それは、わかっているはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though this was "magic" I had helped "imagine" myself. Even though I knew that full well.

lines.content: ……今、この手にある“魔法”は完成品だ
lines.translated: "...The 'magic' in my hand right now is a finished product."

lines.content: 独りごちるように、言う。
lines.translated: I spoke as if talking to myself.

lines.content: 一緒に“魔法”を思い描いたクロが俺に渡してくれたもの。最後の“弾丸”……だからもう、時間世界が枝葉に別れてしまうようなことは、なくて……
lines.translated: "Kuro envisioned this 'magic' together with me, and passed it to me. It's the final 'bullet'... so the timelines won't branch off like leaves on a tree anymore..."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……だからといって、今、ここにいてくれるハルのことを、殺さなきゃならないことには、変わりがなくて……っ
lines.translated: "...Even so, that doesn't change the fact that I have to kill the you who's standing right here for me, Haru...!"

lines.content: 震えてばかりな俺なのだ。
lines.translated: All I could do was tremble.

lines.content: 情けない。あんまりにも情けない。ヒーローなんてほど遠い。どころか光り輝く彼ら彼女らに助けを請うばかりの無力な小さな子どものままだ。
lines.translated: Pathetic. Utterly pathetic. I was nowhere near being a hero. Far from it, I was still just a helpless little kid who could only beg those shining heroes and heroines to save me.

lines.content: あのね、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Um, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: そんな俺の手に――“魔法”を堅く握りしめている左手に、ハルはそっと触れたのだ。
lines.translated: And then, Haru gently touched my hand--my left hand, which was gripping the "magic" so tightly.

lines.content: ……大雅くん。私も、怖い。すごく怖いよ
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun. I'm scared, too. I'm so scared."

lines.content: ……ハル？
lines.translated: "...Haru?"

lines.content: 私、決めたよ
lines.translated: "I've made up my mind."

lines.content: 決めたって……
lines.translated: "Made up your mind...?"

lines.content: 大雅くんの“試してみたいこと”に賭けてみたいって、思う
lines.translated: "I think I want to bet on that 'thing you want to try,' Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……大雅くんが私たちのために考えて、考えて、一生懸命に覚悟を決めてくれたことなんだもん
lines.translated: "...Because you thought, and thought, and worked so hard to find your resolve for our sake, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……違うかな。ううん、きっとそうだよね。いっぱい悩んで、考えてくれた結果、なんだよね
lines.translated: "...Am I wrong? No, I'm sure that's it, right? This is the result of you worrying and thinking so much for me, isn't it?"

lines.content: だったら……
lines.translated: "In that case..."

lines.content: うん。あなたのことが大好きな私が、あなたの信じたいと願うその方法を信じない理由なんて、どこにもない――そう、思い直せたから
lines.translated: "Yeah. I love you so much, so there's no reason anywhere for me not to believe in the method you want to believe in--I was able to rethink things and realize that."

lines.content: だからその“魔法”を私に使って、とハルは言う。俺のことを真っ直ぐに見つめながら。
lines.translated: So use that "magic" on me, Haru said, looking straight into my eyes.

lines.content: やっぱり私はこの“夜”で、どうしたって一度は死んでしまう運命だったんだね……だったら、大雅くん。あなたの“魔法”に撃ち抜かれてしまうほうがいい
lines.translated: "In the end, I really was fated to die at least once in this 'Night,' no matter what... If that's the case, Taiga-kun, I'd rather be shot through by your 'magic.'"

lines.content: ……でもね。やっぱり怖いよ
lines.translated: "...But you know, I'm still scared."

lines.content: その“魔法”に撃ち殺されてしまった私は、それからどうなってしまうの……痛いの？　苦しいの？　そんな全部は、一瞬で、終わるの？
lines.translated: "Once I'm shot and killed by that 'magic,' what's going to happen to me after that...? Will it hurt? Will I suffer? Will all of that be over in an instant?"

lines.content: 大雅くんに色々と教えてもらってはいるけれど……
lines.translated: "Even though you've explained so much to me, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: それでもやっぱり、怖い気持ちは消えてくれない。だってこれは、私たちに残された“希望”なんだとわかってはいても……一度は死んでしまうことなんだから
lines.translated: "Even so, my fear just won't go away. Because even though I know this is the only 'hope' we have left... it still means I'm going to die once."

lines.content: 深呼吸をしようとする。震える唇に力を、込めようとする。
lines.translated: She tried to take a deep breath. She tried to steady her trembling lips.

lines.content: でも……、
lines.translated: But...

lines.content: ……でも、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: やっぱりうまくいかない。
lines.translated: She couldn't quite manage it after all.

lines.content: 自分を撃ち抜くことには――怖かったが、勇気は必要だったが――それでもここまで悩むことはなかった。
lines.translated: When it came to shooting myself--though it was terrifying, and though it took courage--I still hadn't agonized over it to this extent.

lines.content: どうして自分の好きな人を撃ち殺すことに躊躇わずいられるだろうか。
lines.translated: How could anyone not hesitate to shoot and kill the person they love?

lines.content: どうして、平気な顔してこの引き金を引いてしまえるのだろうか。故に。この心の反応は正常なものだと理解はできる。
lines.translated: How could anyone pull this trigger with a calm face? Because of that, I could understand that the way my heart was reacting was completely normal.

lines.content: それでも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ハルの死体を見るのが怖いのか。そこから先、自分のすべきことが怖いのか。
lines.translated: Was I afraid of seeing Haru's dead body? Or was I afraid of what I had to do after that?

lines.content: ……もう、何もわからなくなってしまっている。
lines.translated: I didn't know anything anymore.

lines.content: 大雅くん……
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: ハルが俺を呼ぶ。
lines.translated: Haru called out to me.

lines.content: お願いが、あるの……
lines.translated: "I have... a favor to ask..."

lines.content: ……お願い？
lines.translated: "...A favor?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ハルは、うなずく。
lines.translated: Haru nodded.

lines.content: これまではずっと……、ほんとは、今でもずっと、あなたの“隣”にはあの子だけがいていい場所だって、思ってる
lines.translated: "All this time... to tell the truth, even now, I've always thought that the place by your 'side' belongs only to her."

lines.content: でも、すごい……。そうハルは独り言のように短くこぼし、少し、笑った。
lines.translated: "But it's amazing..." Haru let those few words slip out as if talking to herself, and smiled a little.

lines.content: 私にもその権利というか、その想いと、いうか……
lines.translated: "That I might have that right, too... or rather, those feelings..."

lines.content: とにかく私も、あなたの“隣”にいていいんだって。そういう未来を望んでみるくらいなら許されるのかもって。[・|今][・|の][・|あ][・|な][・|た]と話していると、そう、思えたから……だから
lines.translated: "Anyway, that it's okay for me to be by your 'side,' too. That maybe I'm allowed to at least wish for a future like that. Talking with *the you of right now* made me feel that way... and so..."

lines.content: そしてハルは、震えてばかりの俺の手を引き――
lines.translated: Then, Haru took my endlessly trembling hand and pulled it toward her--

lines.content: ……お願い。聞いてほしいよ、大雅くん。私は覚悟を、決めたから……
lines.translated: "...Please. I want you to grant this for me, Taiga-kun. Because I've made up my mind..."

lines.content: ――俺と、唇を合わせた。
lines.translated: --And pressed her lips to mine.

lines.content: だから最後に、お願い。あなたが私に、“勇気”をください
lines.translated: "So at the very end, please. Give me 'courage.'"

lines.content: そうすれば……。
lines.translated: If I did that...

lines.content: そうすれば、私は……大丈夫
lines.translated: "If you do that, I'll... be okay."

lines.content: これから先、もしも何か悲しいことがあったとしても、つらいことばかりが終わらなかったとしても、耐えられる。がんばれる……
lines.translated: "From here on out, even if something sad happens, even if the painful things never seem to end, I'll be able to endure it. I'll do my best..."

lines.content: 私は最後まで諦めないで、私たちの未来を書き換えられるんだって、思えるから
lines.translated: "Because it'll make me feel like I can keep from giving up until the very end, and rewrite our future."

lines.content: だから、お願い……、とハルはつぶやく。
lines.translated: "So please..." Haru whispered.

lines.content: 恐がりな、私に……
lines.translated: "To someone as easily frightened as me..."

lines.content: あなたがいないと、だめな私に……
lines.translated: "To someone like me, who's no good without you..."

lines.content: あなたの“隣”にいないと、本当に、心から笑ったりもできない、こんな私に……どうか、お願いします。最後に“勇気”をください
lines.translated: "To someone like me, who can't even truly smile from the heart unless I'm by your 'side'... Please, I'm begging you. Give me 'courage' one last time."

lines.content: そう言い、震えていたハルを……。
lines.translated: Saying that, Haru trembled...

lines.content: 俺は強く、ただただ強く、抱きしめ返した。
lines.translated: And I held her back tightly, just as tightly as I could.

lines.content: もう一度、俺はハルの胸に拳銃を、向ける。
lines.translated: Once again, I pointed the handgun at Haru's chest.

lines.content: 指先はまだ震えている。
lines.translated: My fingertips were still trembling.

lines.content: ……“勇気”が必要だったのは俺のほうだ。
lines.translated: The one who needed "courage" was me.

lines.content: 君との[・|別][・|れ]を覚悟しなければならないのもまた、俺のほうなのだ。
lines.translated: And the one who had to steel himself for *parting* with her was also me.

lines.content: 不安だ。
lines.translated: I was anxious.

lines.content: ……俺たちは本当にまた会えるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would we really be able to meet again?

lines.content: 心配だ。
lines.translated: I was worried.

lines.content: ……この“魔法”は本当に、ハルを救ってくれるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Would this "magic" truly save Haru?

lines.content: そんな俺の手を、握りしめた“魔法”ごと、ハルは両手で包み込むようにして触れる。
lines.translated: Haru touched my hand, wrapping both of hers around it along with the "magic" I was gripping so tightly.

lines.content: そして、『[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|は]……』と、きれいな歌をささやくようにして、言った。
