lines.translated: And then, as if whispering a beautiful song, she said, "'*We*...'"
"'...*We never should have met*.'"

lines.content: ……ハル？
lines.translated: "...Haru?"

lines.content: この言葉は、私が私自身の人生にかけた呪いなんだって、思う――
lines.translated: "I think those words are a curse I placed on my own life--"

lines.content: この世界は、きっと、その唇が歌う言葉でできていて……。
lines.translated: Surely, this world is made of the words sung by those lips...

lines.content: どうか、お願い。そんな私の“[言葉|悪い夢]”も一緒に、大雅くんのその“魔法”で、消し飛ばしてほしいよ
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you. I want you to blow away that 'bad dream' of mine, too, along with your 'magic,' Taiga-kun."

lines.content: そして歌われる言葉は、呪いにも祝福にもなるはずで……。
lines.translated: And the words that are sung can become either a curse or a blessing...

lines.content: ……私も、信じてる。絶対。絶対だよ。私たちはまた会えるって、心から信じてる――
lines.translated: "...I believe in it, too. Definitely. Definitely. I believe from the bottom of my heart that we'll meet again--"

lines.content: “信じる。それだけで、越えられないものはない”
lines.translated: "Just by believing, there is nothing we cannot overcome."

lines.content: そういうふうにいつか誰かが歌ってた。
lines.translated: Someone had sung that once upon a time.

lines.content: その言葉はきっと真実だ。そうだよね？
lines.translated: Those words must be the truth. Right?

lines.content: ハルはそう言い、微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Haru said that, smiling.

lines.content: だけど俺は首を振り――歯を、食いしばる。
lines.translated: But I shook my head--and grit my teeth.

lines.content: ……だめだ
lines.translated: "...No, I can't."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……まったく、どうかしてる。情けない。ハルはもうとっくに、“覚悟”をきめてるっていうのに。それなのに、俺は……、俺は……っ
lines.translated: "...Man, I must be losing my mind. It's pathetic. Even though you've already made up your 'resolve' a long time ago, Haru. Even so, I... I...!"

lines.content: だめだ……。
lines.translated: It's no good...

lines.content: いつまで経っても、この引き金を引く“勇気”が持てない。
lines.translated: No matter how much time passed, I couldn't muster the "courage" to pull this trigger.

lines.content: 溢れてくるのは涙と不安と恐怖ばかりだ。
lines.translated: All that welled up inside me were tears, anxiety, and fear.

lines.content: 俺は、ハルみたいに、怖くとも微笑んで、目の前の運命を受け入れることが、できない。
lines.translated: Unlike Haru, I couldn't smile through the fear and accept the fate right in front of my eyes.

lines.content: やっぱり君はすごいよ、俺の憧れだ、ヒーローだ、そんなことを言う俺に、ハルはやっぱり複雑そうに微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: As I told her, "You really are amazing, you're my idol, my hero," Haru smiled with that same conflicted look on her face.

lines.content: 少しの沈黙。
lines.translated: A brief silence.

lines.content: それを打ち消すように、俺は……、
lines.translated: As if to shake it off, I...

lines.content: ……ハル
lines.translated: "...Haru."

lines.content: ……俺は撃鉄を、起こす。
lines.translated: I cocked the hammer.

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ハルは俺をまっすぐに見つめている。
lines.translated: Haru was staring straight at me.

lines.content: ……なに、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...What is it, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: ……好きだ
lines.translated: "...I love you."

lines.content: ……大好きだ。ハル
lines.translated: "...I love you so much, Haru."

lines.content: ……私も
lines.translated: "...Me too."

lines.content: うなずき、微笑んでくれる。
lines.translated: She nodded and smiled for me.

lines.content: 私も、あなたが好きだよ。……誰よりも。何よりも
lines.translated: "I love you, too. ...More than anyone. More than anything."

lines.content: 俺は……
うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ハル。俺は、信じてる。君の“想い”だけを、これからずっと忘れずに……信じ続けてる
lines.translated: "Haru. I believe. I'll never forget your 'feelings' from here on out... I'll keep believing in them alone."

lines.content: ……さよなら。大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Goodbye, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 見つめ合い、うなずき合って、
lines.translated: We looked into each other's eyes, nodded to each other, and...

lines.content: 少しの間……さよならだ、ハル
lines.translated: "Just for a little while... goodbye, Haru."

lines.content: また遠い、とおい……こことは違うどこかの未来で、俺たちは必ずまた出会える――その瞬間を信じてる。ずっと、信じてるから
lines.translated: "In a distant, faraway... future somewhere different from here, we'll definitely meet again--I believe in that moment. Because I'll always keep believing in it."

lines.content: たったそれだけを、確かに誓い……、
lines.translated: Swearing firmly to that alone...

lines.content: また俺たちが出会えた、そのときは……なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "When that time comes, when we meet again... hey, Haru."

lines.content: 俺は……、
lines.translated: That I...

lines.content: 誰にも想像だってできなかっただろうすばらしい未来を、きらきらで、眩しくて、いつだって笑っていられるような……そんな夢みたいな未来を描き、歩んでいこう。ふたりで、一緒に
lines.translated: "Let's paint a wonderful future that no one could have ever imagined--a sparkling, dazzling, dreamlike future where we can always keep smiling--and walk through it. The two of us, together."

lines.content: 俺は、引き金を引いた――
lines.translated: I pulled the trigger--

lines.content: 弾けた。
lines.translated: It burst.

lines.content: ハルの胸元が、真っ赤に弾けて……、
lines.translated: Haru's chest burst into bright red...

lines.content: ……う、あ、ああっ
lines.translated: "...Ugh, ah, aah!"

lines.content: 俺は、崩れ落ちたその身体を抱き留める。
lines.translated: I caught her collapsing body in my arms.

lines.content: 名前を呼んだ。何度も呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called her name. I called it over and over again.

lines.content: でも、応えてくれる声はない。
lines.translated: But there was no voice to answer me.

lines.content: ……抱きしめた胸元から噴き出し、流れ、止まらない命の色。
lines.translated: The color of life gushed from the chest I held against me, flowing, never stopping.

lines.content: 真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: Bright red.

lines.content: 取り繕えるものなどかけらだってなく、ただ……ただただ、赤い。
lines.translated: There wasn't a single shred of anything that could be undone; it was just... simply, utterly red.

lines.content: ここにはもう紛うことなき“死”だけがあった。
lines.translated: Only unmistakable "death" remained here now.

lines.content: “魔法”なんて。“夢”なんて。“希望”なんて。そんなもの……どこにもない。
lines.translated: "Magic." "Dreams." "Hope." Things like that... weren't anywhere to be found.

lines.content: ここには“絶望”めいた真っ赤な色だけがあるのだ。
lines.translated: All that existed here was a bright red color that looked just like "despair."

lines.content: 泣いた。
lines.translated: I cried.

lines.content: 驚くほどの早さで冷たくなっていくその身体を、強く、抱きしめ……俺は、ひとりで泣いた。
lines.translated: Holding that body tightly as it grew cold with alarming speed... I cried, all alone.

lines.content: そうだ。これからはもう、俺は、ずっとひとりぼっち……。
lines.translated: That's right. From now on, I'll always be all alone...

lines.content: 本当の“[孤独|代償]”のはじまり。
lines.translated: The beginning of the true "price"--solitude.

lines.content: これは報いだ。
lines.translated: This is my retribution.

lines.content: ごめん。十夜。あさひさん。そして、クロ。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. Toya. Asahi-san. And Kuro.

lines.content: これまで俺は何度も、何度も、こんな思いを大切な君たちに押しつけてきた……。
lines.translated: Until now, over and over again, I've forced feelings like this onto all of you, the ones who were so precious to me...

lines.content: その重大さに、俺はようやく、本当の意味で気づけたのかもしれない――何よりも大切なはずの人を、こうして抱きしめている今になって、やっとだ。
lines.translated: Maybe I've finally realized the true weight of that--only now, as I'm holding the person who is supposed to be more precious to me than anything else.

lines.content: こんな俺には、本当なら泣く権利さえもない。
lines.translated: Someone like me doesn't even really have the right to cry.

lines.content: “弾丸”はすべて撃ち尽くした。手のひらの中から俺の“魔法”が消えていく。その感覚が、確かにあった。
lines.translated: I had fired every last "bullet." My "magic" was fading away from inside my palm. I could distinctly feel it.

lines.content: もう“奇跡”は起こらない。
lines.translated: "Miracles" wouldn't happen anymore.

lines.content: これより先は、ただただ、残酷なばかりが正義と歌う、冷たくさみしい[大人の世界|現実]だけが、待ち受けている。
lines.translated: From here on out, all that awaited me was a cold, lonely reality--an adult world that sings of nothing but cruelty as justice.

lines.content: ……俺は大切な人を撃ち抜いた。
lines.translated: I shot through the person precious to me.

lines.content: そしてその身体を、君の抜け殻を、これから[・|処][・|理]する――“夜”の中で処分すれば、現実世界では[・|証][・|拠]も残らず、ただ行方不明とされるだけ。
lines.translated: And from here, I would *dispose* of that body, the empty shell of you--if I disposed of it within the "Night," no *evidence* would remain in the real world, and she would simply be treated as a missing person.

lines.content: ああ……。繰り返し、心に刻もう。
lines.translated: Aah... Let me carve it into my heart, over and over again.

lines.content: この罪を、この凄惨さを、この苦しみを、ここからはたったひとり、背負って歩いて行かなければならないのだ。それが俺の“代償”なのだ。
lines.translated: This sin, this gruesomeness, this agony--I have to carry them on my back and walk on from here, all by myself. That is my "price."

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: 俺は……。
君のことを貫いた俺自身の“[心|魔法]”を。
lines.translated: My own "heart"--my magic--that pierced right through you.

lines.content: すべての“想い”を託した、君のことを……。
lines.translated: And you, to whom I entrusted all of my "feelings"...

lines.content: なあ、ハル。
lines.translated: Hey, Haru.

lines.content: 俺は生涯、信じ続けていられるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I be able to keep believing in you for the rest of my life?

lines.content: ……俺たちの未来を、俺たちの行きたいところまで、連れて行ってくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will it carry our future all the way to the place we want to go?

lines.content: そんな想いを、そんな弱気を、眩しく目覚めたばかりの朝日の光りが、暖かく照らし出してくれますようにと、祈るばかりだった。
lines.translated: All I could do was pray that the dazzling light of the newly awakened morning sun would warmly illuminate those feelings, and that weakness of mine.
--"*We never should have met*."

lines.content: この言葉の呪いはあんまりにも強力で……。
lines.translated: The curse of those words was far too powerful...

lines.content: ――“信じてる”
lines.translated: --"I believe."
A blessing of words like that *could never possibly shoot through it*.

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: ……はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter.

lines.content: さくらもゆる“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: Within the "Night" where cherry blossoms flare into bloom...

lines.content: 大雅くん……。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun...

lines.content: [・|今][・|年]も私は思うのです。
lines.translated: *This year*, too, I find myself thinking.

lines.content: やっぱり私たちは、出会ってはいけなかったんだって。
lines.translated: That we really never should have met, after all.

lines.content: 目を覚ます。
lines.translated: I woke up.

lines.content: ここは、どこだろう。
lines.translated: Where is this place?

lines.content: いつもまず最初にそう思う。
lines.translated: That is always the very first thing I think.

lines.content: おかえり、ハル。最後に目を閉じたのは一年前だよ。
lines.translated: "Welcome back, Haru. The last time you closed your eyes was a year ago."

lines.content: 私に寄り添うあなたがそう教えてくれた。
lines.translated: You, snuggled close beside me, told me so.

lines.content: そんなあなたに、私は問いかけずにいられない――ねえ、教えて。あなたは幸せだったの？
lines.translated: And to you, I cannot help but ask--hey, tell me. Were you happy?

lines.content: ……私なんかと一緒に生きて、あなたは本当に幸せだったの？　あなたはこの世界の幸せに、ちゃんと祝福してもらえたの？
lines.translated: "...Living together with someone like me, were you truly happy? Were you properly blessed by the happiness of this world?"

lines.content: するとあなたはいつも微笑み、もちろんだよと言い、私の手に触れ、頬に触れ、最後はやさしく頭を撫でてくれるけど……。
lines.translated: And when I do, you always smile and say, "Of course I was," touching my hand, touching my cheek, and finally patting my head gently, and yet...

lines.content: あなたと出会った小さな頃に、あなたがそうしてくれたみたいに、またその手とこの手を繋いで、どこまでも歩いて行きたいと願うけど……。
lines.translated: Just like you did for me when I was little and we first met, I wish I could hold my hand in yours again and walk with you forever, to the ends of the earth, and yet...

lines.content: そんなあなたがここにはいないことを、私はちゃんと知っている。理解できてる。
lines.translated: I know full well that the you who does that isn't really here. I understand it.

lines.content: だってあなたは私が[・|こ][・|う][・|な][・|る]より以前に、不幸な死を遂げ、この世を去った。
lines.translated: Because before I ever ended up *like this*, you met a tragic death and left this world behind.

lines.content: さくらもゆる“夜”に目覚めると、いつだって最初にその悲しみを思い出す。
lines.translated: Whenever I wake up into the "Night" where cherry blossoms flare into bloom, that sorrow is always the very first thing I remember.

lines.content: ここにいないのはあなただけじゃない。私も、同じだ。
lines.translated: You aren't the only one who isn't really here. It's the same for me.

lines.content: ……答え合わせをしよう。
lines.translated: Let's check the answers.

lines.content: 誰にささやくこともなくそう言って。
lines.translated: I say that without whispering it to anyone in particular.

lines.content: 私は、ここにはいないあなたの“隣”で、そっと[まぶた|瞼]を閉じてみる。
lines.translated: And right "beside" the you who isn't here, I gently close my eyelids.

lines.content: もう昔々のことになる。
lines.translated: It all happened a long, long time ago now.

lines.content: 私たちは、私たちの未来を信じた。
lines.translated: We believed in our future.

lines.content: いつか絶対また会える。
lines.translated: That someday, we would definitely meet again.

lines.content: そのときは、誰にも想像だってできなかっただろう幸せな未来を歩んでいこう。ふたりで、一緒に。
lines.translated: And when that time came, we would walk toward a happy future that no one could have ever imagined. Just the two of us, together.

lines.content: そういうふうに誓い、願い、ふたり分の祈りを乗せて――あなたは最後の“魔法”を私に放った。
lines.translated: Vowing that, wishing for it, and loading it with prayers for the both of us--you fired your final "magic" into me.

lines.content: 私は、私のことを貫いたその衝撃に、深く静かな“夜”の中へと、心ごと吹き飛ばされて……。
lines.translated: From the impact that pierced right through me, my very heart was blown away into a deep, quiet "Night"...

lines.content: 痛い。
lines.translated: It hurts.

lines.content: 苦しい。
lines.translated: It hurts.

lines.content: 身体中が、熱い。
lines.translated: My whole body is burning hot.

lines.content: そんな感覚に力一杯もがいた私を待っていたのは、[・|あ][・|の][・|部][・|屋][・|だ][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: As I thrashed with all my might against that sensation, what awaited me *was that room*.

lines.content: 小さな頃の私を閉じ込めていた部屋だ。真っ暗でたださみしいばかりのあの部屋だった。
lines.translated: The room that had locked my little self away. That pitch-black room filled with nothing but loneliness.

lines.content: そして、小さな私だ。
lines.translated: And there I was, little again.

lines.content: 身体も、時間も、あのときの[・|未][・|来]に戻ってる。
lines.translated: Both my body and time had returned to the *future* of back then.

lines.content: ……ここが、私の“後悔”
lines.translated: "...This is my 'regret.'"

lines.content: 大雅くんの“魔法”は、その“弾丸”で撃ち抜いた者の心を、人生で一番“後悔”しているポイントに巻き戻すものだ。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun's "magic" rewinds the heart of the person pierced by its "bullet" back to the point of greatest "regret" in their life.

lines.content: “後悔”とはその性質上、常に過去にあるものだけれど……。
lines.translated: By its very nature, "regret" is something that always lies in the past, and yet...

lines.content: 私の過去とは未来の話だ。
lines.translated: My past is a story of the future.

lines.content: だからこうして、私は未来の時間世界に戻ってきた。
lines.translated: That's why I returned to this future timeline.

lines.content: ……今までは不完全な“魔法”だったのだという。
lines.translated: Up until now, they said it had been an incomplete "magic."

lines.content: だけど[・|あ][・|の][・|子]とふたりでふたつとなった最後の“[弾丸|魔法]”は、撃ち抜いた私の心をも取り込み、三人分の[魔法|心]となった。
lines.translated: But the final "magic"--the bullet that became one from the two of them, him and *that girl*--took in my pierced heart as well, becoming the heart--the magic--of three people.

lines.content: だから、ちゃんと、私が人生で一番の“後悔”を得るより[・|以][・|前]に引き戻してくれた。
lines.translated: That's why it properly pulled me back to a time *before* I ever gained the greatest "regret" of my life.

lines.content: その“後悔”とは……。
lines.translated: And that "regret" was...

lines.content: 電話だ。
lines.translated: The phone.

lines.content: 暗く小さなこの部屋に、電話の呼び出し音が鳴り響き始めた。
lines.translated: In this dark, tiny room, the ringing of a telephone began to echo.

lines.content: 私は咄嗟に呼吸を止めた。
lines.translated: I held my breath in an instant.

lines.content: [・|最][・|初][・|の][・|私]は、この電話に慌てて出た。
lines.translated: *The first me* had frantically answered this phone.

lines.content: 部屋を出て行ったお母さんに……そして隣の部屋にいるのだろうお母さんの仲間に。監視役のおばあさんに勘づかれることを、恐れた。
lines.translated: I had been terrified of my mother, who had left the room... and of her associates, who were probably in the room next door. Terrified that the old woman watching over me would find out.

lines.content: だけど[・|今]の私は、二回目の私には、わかる。
lines.translated: But the *current* me, the me doing this for the second time, knows.

lines.content: この電話はおばあさんが置いたもの。おじさんを私に引き合わせるためのもの。
lines.translated: This phone was placed here by that old woman. Placed here to bring Ojisan and me together.

lines.content: 確かに私の“後悔”はここからはじまったんだ。
lines.translated: My "regret" certainly began right here.

lines.content: そう――
lines.translated: Yes--

lines.content: ……私が、この電話に出なければ
lines.translated: "...If I don't answer this phone..."

lines.content: ――私たちは、出会わなかった。
lines.translated: --Then we will never meet.

lines.content: でも何も知らない[・|最][・|初][・|の][・|私]は電話に出た。出てしまった。
lines.translated: However, knowing nothing, *the first me* answered the phone. I ended up answering it.

lines.content: それが私の“後悔”だ。
lines.translated: That is my "regret."

lines.content: やり直す。
lines.translated: I'll do it over.

lines.content: このまま私は電話には出ず、今の段階で電話を壊す――そして私たちは出会わない。それで、終わりだ。
lines.translated: I won't answer the phone like this, and I'll destroy it right now--and then we won't meet. With that, it'll all be over.

lines.content: そうだね。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: そうするために、大雅くんの“魔法”に撃ち抜かれた私の心は、ここに戻ってこようと、無意識のうちにでも考えた。だからこうしてここで、私は目覚めた。
lines.translated: In order to do that, my heart, pierced by Taiga-kun's "magic," had unconsciously sought to return to this exact place. And so, here and now, I woke up.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...
*And so, I broke it*.

lines.content: 電話を壊した。
lines.translated: I broke the phone.

lines.content: このままお母さんのプラン通りになることにした。
lines.translated: I decided to let things play out just as my mother planned.

lines.content: つまり……。
lines.translated: In other words...

lines.content: 私は“かわいそうな女の子”になれて。
lines.translated: I would get to become a "pitiful little girl."

lines.content: お母さんは、“かわいそうなお母さん”になれて。
lines.translated: And my mother would get to become a "pitiful mother."

lines.content: ……おじさんはいつまでも、大切な[・|あ][・|の][・|子]を探し求めて、人生をさまよい歩く。でも、いつか必ず[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]は出会える。
lines.translated: Ojisan would wander through life forever, searching for *that girl* who was so precious to him. But someday, the *two of them* would surely meet.

lines.content: ……それで[・|世][・|界][・|は]ハッピーエンド
lines.translated: "...And with that, *the world* gets its happy ending."

lines.content: そのはずだった。
lines.translated: That was how it was supposed to be.

lines.content: ……“私たちは、出会ってはいけなかった”
lines.translated: "...'We never should have met.'"

lines.content: ごめんなさい大雅くん。そんな呪いの言葉を、私は、撃ち抜くことができなかったんだ。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Taiga-kun. I couldn't shoot through those cursed words after all.

lines.content: その数日後。
lines.translated: A few days after that.

lines.content: お母さんが私の最後の日と[決定|プラン]した日だ。
lines.translated: It was the day my mother had planned--the day she decided would be my last.

lines.content: お母さんはやっぱりその日も私の部屋には現れなかった。
lines.translated: Just as expected, my mother didn't show up in my room on that day either.

lines.content: カメラの前で私をプラン通りに処すのは、お母さんが雇った乱暴な大人たち。
lines.translated: The ones who would deal with me in front of the camera according to the plan were the violent adults my mother had hired.

lines.content: その人たちに、私は、お母さんに愛してもらうため、バラバラにされることを望んだ……。
lines.translated: In order to be loved by my mother, I wished to be torn apart by those people...

lines.content: そうすることで私たちは永遠に出会うことはない。
lines.translated: By doing so, the two of us would never meet for all eternity.

lines.content: そのはずだったのに……。
lines.translated: That was how it was supposed to be, and yet...

lines.content: ……どうして

lines.translated: And yet, *he* appeared.

lines.content: ……どうしてなの。おじさん
lines.translated: "...Why, Ojisan?"

lines.content: 乱暴な大人たちから無理矢理に私を連れ去り、あの部屋を飛び出した。
lines.translated: He forcibly tore me away from the violent adults and dashed out of that room.

lines.content: 私は、電話に出なかった
lines.translated: "I didn't answer the phone."

lines.content: 未来の[・|あ][・|な][・|た]に言っても、わかってはもらえないかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even if I say this to the *you* of the future, you might not understand, and yet...

lines.content: 私は電話に出なかったんだよ。私たちは、出会わなかったんだよ、おじさん――それなのに、どうしてこんな
lines.translated: "I didn't answer the phone. We never met, Ojisan--so why is this happening...?"

lines.content: 満開に咲いた春の下。
lines.translated: Beneath the spring in full bloom.

lines.content: 私はあなたの背中に負ぶわれている。
lines.translated: I am being carried on your back.

lines.content: ふわふわと。はらはらと。
lines.translated: Gently. Fluttering down.

lines.content: 暖かなかけらだけが降り止まない。
lines.translated: Only warm fragments fall without ceasing.

lines.content: そんな春色の空だけを、私たちは見上げている。
lines.translated: We are looking up at nothing but that spring-colored sky.

lines.content: ……どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: Why is it, I wonder?

lines.content: こんな光景はもう[・|二][・|度][・|目]なのに、はじめて見上げるもののように眩しく見えた。
lines.translated: Even though this is already the *second time* I've seen a sight like this, it looked so dazzling, as if I were looking up at it for the very first time.

lines.content: “魔法”だ
lines.translated: "It's 'magic.'"

lines.content: クロと俺の“魔法”は、完全になったんだ
lines.translated: "Kuro's and my 'magic' became complete."

lines.content: だからもう、あの“夜”……最後の“弾丸”を君に放ったあの“夜”から、時間世界は枝葉に別れることはなく、今夜まで一本の[道|時間]で繋がっている
lines.translated: "So from that 'Night' on... from the 'Night' I fired that final 'bullet' into you, the timelines didn't branch off anymore. They've been connected by a single road of time all the way to tonight."

lines.content: それはつまり……。
lines.translated: Which meant...

lines.content: 長かった
lines.translated: "It was a long time."
*He* says.

lines.content: 長かったなあ
lines.translated: "Man, it was such a long time."
*Ojisan* says.

lines.content: ……あの“夜”から、ハル。今夜、また君とこうして出会えるまで、本当に長かったよ
lines.translated: "...Ever since that 'Night,' Haru. Until tonight, when I could finally meet you again like this, it really was a long time."
*Taiga-kun* said so--with a smile.

lines.content: 君はあの電話に出てしまったことを“後悔”してるとわかってた。感じたんだ、君の“悪夢”を覗き見てしまった俺だから
lines.translated: "I knew you 'regretted' answering that phone. I felt it, because I ended up peeking into your 'nightmare.'"

lines.content: だから……。と、すっかり歳を取ってしまったふうに見える大雅くんは、言う。
lines.translated: "That's why..." says Taiga-kun, who looks as though he has grown so much older.

lines.content: だからさ、ハル。ずっとひとりで、君が、過去から目覚める夜を待っていたんだ……。ああ、やっとだ。やっと君に追いついたよ、ハル
lines.translated: "That's why, Haru. All this time, all by myself, I was waiting for the night you would wake up from the past... Aah, finally. I've finally caught up to you, Haru."

lines.content: 私はその背中を力一杯、抱きしめた。ごめんなさいと、言った。何度も言った。
lines.translated: I hugged his back with all my might. I said I was sorry. I said it over and over again.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: なにが？
lines.translated: "What is?"

lines.content: だって……
lines.translated: "Because..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: だって、私……諦めないって言ったのに。またあなたとちゃんとこうして出会えることを信じてるって、言ったのに……。それなのに、私……私はっ、うそつきだよ、大雅くん……っ
lines.translated: "Because, I... even though I said I wouldn't give up. Even though I said I believed we'd properly meet again like this... Even so, I... I'm a liar, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: 最初は、“あのさくらを咲かせることが私の夢だよ”とそう言って。
lines.translated: The first time, I said, "Making those cherry blossoms bloom is my dream."

lines.content: そして今回は、“私たちはまた会えるって信じてる”とそう言って。
lines.translated: And this time, I said, "I believe that we'll meet again."

lines.content: だけど私は、“私たちは出会わなければよかった”――そんな言葉に、そんな自分の[悪夢|呪い]に、飲み込まれ、電話を壊した。
lines.translated: Yet I was swallowed up by the words, "We never should have met"--swallowed up by my own curse of a nightmare--and I broke the phone.

lines.content: 未来を“あなたと私は出会わない”という結論に、書き換えようとした。
lines.translated: I tried to rewrite the future into the conclusion that "you and I never meet."

lines.content: 私は……
ハル
lines.translated: Haru

lines.content: 信じてるって、言ったろ
lines.translated: "I told you I believed, didn't I?"

lines.content: 私を負ぶったまま、すっかり大人になった大雅くんは、言った。
lines.translated: Still carrying me on his back, the fully grown-up Taiga-kun spoke.

lines.content: 必ず俺たちはまた出会えるって。そのときは、誰にも想像だってできないくらい幸せな未来を、ふたりで一緒に歩いて行こうって。そう、約束したろ
lines.translated: "That we would definitely meet again. And that when that time came, we'd walk together toward a future so happy no one could ever imagine it. That's what we promised, right?"

lines.content: だからいいんだ、と大雅くんは言う。
lines.translated: "So it's fine," Taiga-kun says.

lines.content: 何であれまたこうして会えたんだ。だからもういいんだよ、と。
lines.translated: Whatever happened, we were able to meet again like this. So it's all okay now, he tells me.

lines.content: 今度はもう、君からの“好き”に首を振ったりはしないよ――たぶんそれも俺の“後悔”だったんだ
lines.translated: "This time, I won't shake my head at your 'I love you' anymore--that was probably my own 'regret,' too."

lines.content: [・|違][・|う][・|時][・|間][・|世][・|界]の俺の気持ちを正確に代弁できてるかはわからないけどね……
lines.translated: "Though I don't know if I can accurately speak for the feelings of the me from a *different timeline*..."

lines.content: でも、おそらくそれほど遠い予想でもないはずだよと、大雅くんは言うけれど……。
lines.translated: "Still, it probably isn't too far off the mark," Taiga-kun says, and yet...

lines.content: ふと、そこで大雅くんは沈黙してしまった。
lines.translated: Suddenly, right there, Taiga-kun fell silent.

lines.content: ……大雅くん？
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 不安になり、私は呼びかけた。
lines.translated: Growing anxious, I called out to him.

lines.content: なあ、ハル
lines.translated: "Hey, Haru."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ちょっと気になることがあるんだけど
lines.translated: "There's just one thing that's been on my mind."

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: 俺と、ハル。確かに年齢はめっちゃ離れてるのは、[・|前][・|回][・|も][・|今][・|回][・|も]変わりないんだろうけど……。でも、心はそうでもない。だろ？
lines.translated: "Me and you, Haru. There's no changing the fact that there's a huge age gap between us, both *last time and this time*... Still, it's not really like that on the inside. Right?"

lines.content: 中身が[・|前][・|回]とは違うんだ。ハルの中身は子どもじゃない。その心は過去から未来へ飛んできたんだ。これって……なあ、ハル。これってさ、ロリコンになるのかな。俺
lines.translated: "What's on the inside is different from *last time*. You aren't a child at heart, Haru. Your heart leaped from the past into the future. So does this... Hey, Haru. Does this make me a lolicon?"

lines.content: 真剣にそんなことを考えているあなたのことがおかしくなった。愛しくも思った。私は、笑った。いっぱい笑った。
lines.translated: Seeing you think so seriously about something like that struck me as funny. And endearing, too. I laughed. I laughed and laughed.

lines.content: どうして笑うんだよ。男としては大変な問題なんだよ、これって
lines.translated: "Why are you laughing? As a guy, this is a very serious issue."

lines.content: ――ロリコンかそうじゃないのか。違う時間世界の俺が、君の“好き”にうなずけなかったのは、その大問題をクリアできなかったからで……
lines.translated: "--Whether I'm a lolicon or not. The reason the me from a different timeline couldn't nod to your 'I love you' was because I couldn't clear that huge hurdle..."

lines.content: まだ、年が離れてるの……気になる？
lines.translated: "Does the age gap between us... still bother you?"

lines.content: それは、気になるよ。すごく……。今の君はやっぱりあんまりにも小さいから
lines.translated: "Well, yeah, it does. A lot... Because right now, you're still just way too small."

lines.content: だったら、大雅くん
lines.translated: "In that case, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: いつか私の身体が、あなたの歳に追いついたら、今度こそ私と結婚してくれる……？
lines.translated: "Someday, when my body catches up to your age, will you marry me this time...?"

lines.content: それは[・|一][・|回][・|目]の私があなたに願った“夢”だ。
lines.translated: That was the "dream" the *first* me had wished for from you.

lines.content: そのときは断られてしまった。二回目の今なら、どうだろう。あなたはどう応えてくれるだろう。
lines.translated: Back then, you turned me down. What about now, the second time around? How will you answer me?

lines.content: 背は追いつくことはあっても、年齢は追いつけないよ。俺だって同じだけ歳を取るわけだし……。君がどれだけ大きくなれば、俺はロリコンじゃなくなるんだろうか
lines.translated: "Your height might catch up, but your age never will. I'm going to get older at the exact same pace, after all... Just how much do you have to grow before I'm not a lolicon anymore?"

lines.content: 唇を尖らせそう言うあなたが、私はやっぱりおかしくてしかたなくって……。
lines.translated: Watching you pout as you said that, I really couldn't help finding you funny...

lines.content: 歳が追いつくことはなくても結婚はしよう。約束だ。いつか、君がそれにちょうどいい歳まで大きくなれたら
lines.translated: "Even if your age never catches up, let's get married. It's a promise. Someday, once you've grown to the right age for it."

lines.content: あなたがそんなうれしい約束をくれたから……。
lines.translated: Because you gave me such a wonderful promise...

lines.content: “私たちは、出会ってしまった”
lines.translated: "We ended up meeting."

lines.content: 大丈夫。そんな呪いも乗り越えていけるよね。
lines.translated: It's okay. We can overcome a curse like that, right?

lines.content: もう一度そう信じてみるんだと、思って。
lines.translated: I thought to myself that I would try believing in that one more time.

lines.content: そこから私たちはお母さんから逃げ続けた。
lines.translated: From then on, we kept running away from my mother.

lines.content: 町を出た
lines.translated: "We left the town."

lines.content: 国を出た
lines.translated: "We left the country."

lines.content: 私が成長するまでは、知らない国でふたり一緒に暮らした
lines.translated: "Until I grew up, the two of us lived together in an unfamiliar country."

lines.content: 身体や顔に刃物を入れて形を変える勇気はなかったし、そうするのはどうしてもという状況になるまではよそうということになった
lines.translated: "Neither of us had the courage to take a scalpel to our bodies or faces to change our appearances, so we decided to hold off on doing that unless we were backed into a corner."

lines.content: 日本中は私たちの話題でしばらくはもちきりだったけど、でも海外に出てしまえば、私たちのことを指さす者は殆どいなかった
lines.translated: "For a while, we were the talk of all of Japan, but once we made it overseas, hardly anyone pointed a finger at us."

lines.content: いや。私たちが身を隠した国が小さかったからかもしれない。
lines.translated: No. Maybe it was just because the country we hid in was small.

lines.content: 東洋人の女の子が[さら|攫]われた――そんな事件でわざわざ大騒ぎしていられるほど余裕のある国でもなかったのだろう
lines.translated: "An Asian girl was kidnapped--it probably wasn't a country with enough leeway to go out of its way to make a huge fuss over an incident like that."

lines.content: 私たちを気にする人がいたとしても、“日本人がいるぞ”という、的外れすぎる中傷の的でしかない
lines.translated: "Even if anyone did pay attention to us, we were merely the targets of completely off-the-mark slurs like, 'Look, there are Japanese people here.'"

lines.content: そんなささいな不愉快さも、むしろ逃亡中の私たちにとっては安心の材料にもなったのだ。
lines.translated: Even minor unpleasantries like that actually became a source of relief for the two of us on the run.

lines.content: ……数年間の海外生活で得たものはなんだったろう
lines.translated: "...What did we gain from those several years of living overseas, I wonder?"

lines.content: ふたりきりの幸せな生活。
lines.translated: A happy life for just the two of us.

lines.content: 少しのお金。そして知識と経験。
lines.translated: A little bit of money. Along with knowledge and experience.

lines.content: 数ヶ月で日本食が恋しくなり、その想いは日に日に増して、消え去ることはないのだということ。
lines.translated: And the realization that within a few months we would start missing Japanese food, and that the craving would only grow day by day, never to fade away.

lines.content: やっぱり食事は大切だねと納得し合い、数年ぶりに日本に帰ってきて……。
lines.translated: Agreeing with each other that food really is important after all, we returned to Japan for the first time in several years...

lines.content: まず最初に食べたのは“たいやき”だった。
lines.translated: And the very first thing we ate was "taiyaki."

lines.content: 日本のご飯が恋しくて帰ってきたはずなのに、最初に食べたのが[・|こ][・|れ]なんて……。
lines.translated: Even though we supposedly came back because we missed Japanese meals, to think the first thing we ate was *this*...

lines.content: おいしいねと私が笑う。
lines.translated: "It's delicious," I laughed.

lines.content: ああ、そうだねと大雅くんも笑っていた。
lines.translated: "Yeah, it sure is," Taiga-kun laughed, too.

lines.content: もう日本でも私たちのことで騒ぐ人は殆どいなかった。当時はあんなに騒ぎ立てていたのに。
lines.translated: Hardly anyone in Japan made a fuss about us anymore. Even though there had been such an uproar back then.

lines.content: ……だいぶ大きくなったな、ハル
lines.translated: "...You've grown quite a bit, Haru."

lines.content: 一回り以上も歳の違うあなたが、言う。
lines.translated: You, who are more than a dozen years older than me, said so.

lines.content: もうこうして手を繋いで歩いたり、頭を撫でたり、おんぶとか抱っことか、そんなことする感じでもなくなって来ちゃったな
lines.translated: "It's gotten to the point where it doesn't really feel right to walk holding hands like this, or pat your head, or give you piggyback rides or carry you in my arms anymore."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうかもね、と言いながら、私は背の高い大雅くんに追いつこうと背伸びをしてみる。
lines.translated: "Maybe so," I said, standing on tiptoe to try and catch up to the tall Taiga-kun.

lines.content: もう少しで肩に頭が届きそう。それくらい私の身体は大きくなってた。
lines.translated: My head almost reached his shoulder. That was how much my body had grown.

lines.content: 大雅くんの言うとおり、ずっと中身は子どもじゃないんだよ。だからどんなに身体が小さくても、抱っこされたり、おんぶされたりするのは、恥ずかしかったけど……
lines.translated: "Just like you said, Taiga-kun, I haven't been a child on the inside for a long time. So no matter how small my body was, being carried in your arms or on your back was embarrassing, but..."

lines.content: でもね、ときにはそうしてほしいかなあって。おんぶも、抱っこも。頭だって時どきいっぱい、撫でたりしてほしいかなって
lines.translated: "Still, you know, I think I'd like you to do that sometimes. Both piggyback rides, and holding me in your arms. And I wouldn't mind if you patted my head a whole lot every now and then, too."

lines.content: 私たちの歩むこの道は、ふつうの人生とは必ずしも言い難いけれど――でも、幸せな時間をふたりで歩んでいけるのではないかと思った。
lines.translated: This road we walk can't necessarily be called an ordinary life--yet I thought that maybe the two of us could walk through happy times together.

lines.content: そんな予感があったのだ。
lines.translated: I had a feeling we would.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: やっぱり……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: “私たちは、出会ってはいけなかったんだよ”
lines.translated: "We never should have met."

lines.content: 大雅くん……。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun...

lines.content: しばらくは私たちの幸せな生活は続いた。
lines.translated: For a while, our happy life continued.

lines.content: そろそろあなたとの子どもがほしいなあ、なんて。
lines.translated: "I think I'd like to have your baby soon," and so on.

lines.content: ちょっと甘えたふうにあなたに言ってみたりした。
lines.translated: I even tried saying things like that to you in a slightly spoiled tone.

lines.content: そんなときだ……。
lines.translated: It happened right around then...

lines.content: きっかけはほんの些細なことだった。
lines.translated: It started with the smallest thing.

lines.content: 自分の名前がわからなくなる日があった。
lines.translated: There was a day when I couldn't remember my own name.

lines.content: あなたの名前はちゃんと覚えているのに、それ以外の全部を思い出せなくなることもあった。
lines.translated: There were also times when I remembered your name clearly, yet couldn't recall anything else at all.

lines.content: 大好物だったはずの甘くて暖かな[お菓子|あれ]の名前もわからなくなった。思い出すのに三日はかかった。
lines.translated: I even forgot the name of *that* sweet, warm snack that was supposed to be my absolute favorite. It took me three days to remember it.

lines.content: そんな異常がずっと続いた。
lines.translated: Abnormalities like that kept happening.

lines.content: 私は、私の心は、病気になったのだと気づいた。
lines.translated: I realized that I--that my mind--had fallen ill.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は年老いた人がなるものだとばかり思ってた。
lines.translated: I had always thought *that* was something only old people got.

lines.content: しかし、若年性のものが最近目立つようにもなってきたのだと、私のことを診察してくれた、正規ではない腕のいいお医者さんが言っていた。
lines.translated: However, the skilled, albeit unlicensed doctor who examined me said that early-onset cases had been becoming more noticeable lately.

lines.content: しかも私が発病した[・|そ][・|れ]は、少しばかり症状が変わっていて……。
lines.translated: Moreover, the *version* I developed had slightly unusual symptoms...

lines.content: “さくらの季節にしか、私は自分を思い出せない”……？
lines.translated: "'I can only remember myself during the cherry blossom season'...?"

lines.content: なんだ、それは。
lines.translated: What is that supposed to mean?

lines.content: ここは“夜”の中ではない。ただの現実。
lines.translated: This isn't inside the "Night." It's just reality.

lines.content: それなのに、なんだ……。まるで耳障りのいいものばかりが好まれる物語の中のような出来事だ。
lines.translated: And yet, what is this...? It's like something straight out of a story that only favors pleasant-sounding things.

lines.content: それもなぜだか、“さくらの杜”のさくらの花が咲いている時期にだけ、たった一度、たった一日、私の記憶は戻るのだ。
lines.translated: And for some reason, it is only during the season when the cherry blossoms of the "Sakura Forest" are in bloom--just once, for a single day--that my memories return.

lines.content: 私の心がその季節、その花に、強く印象づけられているからだろうとお医者さんは言っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: The doctor said it was probably because that season and those flowers were so strongly imprinted on my heart, but...

lines.content: 思い当たるのは、春の花について歌った“愛”と“勇気”の歌だった。
lines.translated: What came to mind was the song of "love" and "courage" that sang of spring flowers.

lines.content: そしてあなたとの“約束”だった。
lines.translated: And my "promise" with you.

lines.content: それだけは忘れず、私の中に在り続けるから、私の心はその季節にだけ“夜”の中から戻ってくるみたいだった。
lines.translated: Because I never forgot those things alone, and because they continued to exist within me, it seemed my heart would return from the "Night" only during that season.

lines.content: それ以外の季節では、私はまるで抜け殻みたいにぼんやりと宙を見つめながら過ごしているらしい。
lines.translated: During all the other seasons, I apparently spend my days staring blankly into space like an empty shell.

lines.content: 大雅くんが話しかけても聞こえない。時どきにこりと微笑むのが精一杯。
lines.translated: Even when Taiga-kun speaks to me, I can't hear him. Giving a faint smile every now and then is the best I can do.

lines.content: 遺伝性のものだとも説明された。
lines.translated: It was also explained to me that it's hereditary.

lines.content: だからこそ回避しようのないものであるのだとも。
lines.translated: And that because of that, there was no way to avoid it.

lines.content: ――あなたの両親のどちらかが、いつかを境に、急に性格が豹変したようなことはありませんでしたか？
lines.translated: --Did either of your parents ever undergo a sudden, drastic change in personality at some point?

lines.content: これは遺伝子に関係する脳の病気です。もしそういうことがあったなら……。
lines.translated: This is a brain disease related to genetics. If something like that ever happened...

lines.content: 心当たりならありすぎた。
lines.translated: It rang all too many bells.

lines.content: でも、だったらどうしろというのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, what was I supposed to do about it?

lines.content: お母さん。私はあの人の子どもだ。あの人の色々なものを引き継いでいる。それだけはどんな“魔法”でも変えようがない。
lines.translated: My mother. I am that woman's child. I've inherited all sorts of things from her. No amount of "magic" can change that one fact.

lines.content: そうだよ……。
lines.translated: That's right...

lines.content: これは、“魔法”とか“代償”だとか。
lines.translated: This isn't about "magic" or a "price."

lines.content: そういった不思議な話の介入する余地のない話だ。ただの現実。
lines.translated: It's a story with no room for such supernatural things to intervene. It's just reality.

lines.content: “魔法少女”の“魔法”にも。その“代償”も。“夜の魔法使い”にも。あるいは“夜の王”との戦いも。
lines.translated: Neither a "magical girl's" "magic." Nor its "price." Nor a "Magician of the Night." Or even a battle with the "King of the Night."

lines.content: 何もかも関係のない[話|不幸]。
lines.translated: It is a misfortune that has nothing to do with any of it.

lines.content: 私の身体が抱えていた不具合が原因でしかない話。
lines.translated: A story caused by nothing more than a defect my own body was carrying.

lines.content: あなたの“魔法”で私たちは運命を書き換えたけれど……。
lines.translated: We rewrote our fate with your "magic," and yet...

lines.content: その先にはこんな不幸が待っていた。
lines.translated: Waiting ahead of us was a tragedy like this.

lines.content: ……これはきっと誰にでもありえるだろう、運命の落とし穴のようなもの。
lines.translated: This is like a pitfall of fate, something that could surely happen to anyone.

lines.content: だからね、大雅くん――あなたは、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|私]なんかとは、出会わなければよかった
lines.translated: "That's why, Taiga-kun--you never should have met someone like *me*."

lines.content: あなたは私のことを懸命に介護して。
lines.translated: You nursed me with everything you had.

lines.content: 春の季節に一度しか戻らない私の記憶を心待ちにして。
lines.translated: You eagerly awaited my memories, which only returned once every spring.

lines.content: その日はいつも“おかえり”と言って、また私が再び[まぶた|瞼]を閉じるまで、精一杯私のことを楽しませてくれた。
lines.translated: On that day, you would always say, "Welcome back," and do everything you could to make me happy until I closed my eyelids once again.

lines.content: こんな私を連れて逃げるのは大変だったはずだ。
lines.translated: Running away while bringing someone like me along must have been agonizingly hard.

lines.content: そんな大雅くんは、騒ぎが落ち着いてきているとはいえ、私の世話をしながらの逃亡生活で、疲れ切っていたのだろう。
lines.translated: Even though the uproar had died down, Taiga-kun must have been completely exhausted from a life on the run while taking care of me.

lines.content: ほんの些細な不注意がもとの事故で、あなたはあっさりとこの世を去った。
lines.translated: In an accident caused by a moment of slight carelessness, you were taken from this world all too easily.

lines.content: すべて、世話好きな誰かが私に残した手紙でわかった。
lines.translated: I learned all of it from a letter some kindhearted person left behind for me.

lines.content: 私は大雅くんのお葬式にも出ることなく、家でずっとぼんやりとして、過ごしていた。らしい。
lines.translated: Without even attending Taiga-kun's funeral, I stayed at home spacing out the entire time. Apparently.

lines.content: 今年も春がやって来て、私は[まぶた|瞼]を開いたのだ。
lines.translated: Spring came again this year, and I opened my eyelids.

lines.content: 今の私はちゃんと全部を思い出せてる。誰が大切だったのか。私の名前はなんだったのか。
lines.translated: Right now, I can remember everything clearly. Who was precious to me. What my own name was.

lines.content: だけど深い眠りについたなら、また次の春まで、私は私が誰なのかもわからずに、ぼんやりとしてすごすのだ。
lines.translated: However, once I fall into a deep sleep, I will spend my days spacing out until the next spring, not even knowing who I am.

lines.content: そんな私の隣には、“半透明”のあなたが寄り添い、笑いかけてくれていた。
lines.translated: Next to me as I am now, a "translucent" version of you was staying close by my side, smiling at me.

lines.content: 声は、聞こえない。
lines.translated: I can't hear your voice.

lines.content: 触れられもしない。
lines.translated: I can't touch you, either.

lines.content: だけどあなたは確かにそこにいて、どこにもいない……。
lines.translated: Yet you are unmistakably there, and at the same time, nowhere at all...

lines.content: 私にしか見えないあなただ。
lines.translated: You are a version of you that only I can see.

lines.content: そんなあなたはきっと、今もさくらもゆる“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: Even now, you are surely still inside the "Night" where cherry blossoms smolder...

lines.content: 私のことが心配で、心配で、しかたがないから。
lines.translated: Because you're so worried, so endlessly worried about me, that you can't help it.

lines.content: だから“夜”の[・|そ][・|の][・|先]へ行けず、留まり続けてる。
lines.translated: That's why you can't move *beyond* the "Night," and continue to linger here instead.

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: いつもあなたはそばにいて、私にそうして微笑みかけて、私のことを“応援”してくれている。
lines.translated: You are always by my side, smiling at me like that, "cheering" me on.

lines.content: 私があなたの姿だけを、こうして見つめられるのは――私の心がもうここには殆どいないからだろうか。私も半分“夜”の中だ。
lines.translated: Is the reason I can gaze at just your figure like this--because my heart is barely even here anymore? Half of me is inside the "Night" too.

lines.content: でも、幸せにならなくちゃ。
lines.translated: Still, I have to become happy.

lines.content: あなたにそんな私を見ていてもらいたい。
lines.translated: I want you to watch over me being happy.

lines.content: そう思うのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I think that...

lines.content: ……“私たちは、出会わなければよかった”
lines.translated: "...'We never should have met.'"

lines.content: 泣いた。
lines.translated: I cried.

lines.content: 私は、泣いた。
lines.translated: I cried.

lines.content: こんな私なんかと出会わなければ、あなたにはもっと別の人生があったはず。
lines.translated: If you hadn't met someone like me, you surely would have had a completely different life.

lines.content: 今、私のそばについていてくれる“半透明”のあなたが、泣いてる私に何もできず……、悲しそうな顔をすることもなかった。
lines.translated: And the "translucent" you staying by my side right now wouldn't have had to make such a sad face... powerless to do anything for me as I cry.

lines.content: ……やっぱり、あなたはあの子と一緒に生きていくべきだったんだね。やっぱりそうすることが、大好きなあなたへ幸せを届けることだった
lines.translated: "...You really should have lived your life together with her, shouldn't you? Doing that really was the way to bring happiness to you, the person I love so much."

lines.content: あなたの“隣”はあの子だけのものだった。
lines.translated: The place "next" to you belonged to her and her alone.

lines.content: 私の……。私たちの“魔法”は失敗だった。
lines.translated: My... Our "magic" was a failure.

lines.content: 私たちの人生は[バッドエンド|不幸]だった。
lines.translated: Our lives ended in a "bad end."

lines.content: どこで選択を間違えたのだろう。
lines.translated: Where did we make the wrong choice?

lines.content: それとも間違えなかったからこそ、こんな終わりに行き着いたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Or was it precisely because we didn't make a mistake that we arrived at an ending like this?

lines.content: そもそも私たちに[・|こ][・|れ]以外の選択肢なんてあったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Did we ever even have any choice other than *this* in the first place?

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 眠い。
lines.translated: I'm sleepy.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]が、重い。
lines.translated: My eyelids are heavy.

lines.content: また深い、ふかい、一年間もの深い記憶の底へ落ちていくのだ。
lines.translated: Once again, I am falling into the deep, deep bottom of my memories for an entire year.

lines.content: 誰か……。誰か、お願い。
lines.translated: Someone... Someone, please.

lines.content: この声が届くことがあるのなら、どうかお願い、私たちにもう一度、“夢”を見させて……、こんな人生をもう一度だけ、やり直させて、ください
lines.translated: "If this voice can reach anyone, then please, I beg you, let us see a 'dream' one more time... Please, let us do this life over, just once more."

lines.content: もしもそんな“夢”が叶うなら……。
lines.translated: If such a "dream" could come true...

lines.content: ……私はもう、あなたの“隣”にいたいだなんて。そんな、我がまま……言わないから
lines.translated: "...I won't ask to be 'next' to you anymore. I won't say anything... so selfish."

lines.content: そのとき聞いたのは小さな鈴の音だ。
lines.translated: What I heard just then was the sound of a small bell.

lines.content: 私はそれを聞いたことがある。[・|あ][・|の][・|子]がそばにいるのだと、わかった。
lines.translated: I had heard it before. I knew that *she* was nearby.

lines.content: ……ねえ、聞こえてる？
lines.translated: "...Hey, can you hear me?"

lines.content: もしもこの声が、あなたに、届くなら……お願いします。私は、大雅くんに幸せを届けたい。それだけが私の“夢”だった――私は、もう、“愛されたい”なんて、願わないから……
lines.translated: "If this voice can reach you... then please. I want to bring happiness to Taiga-kun. That alone was my 'dream'--I won't wish to 'be loved' anymore, so..."

lines.content: やっと、わかったの。[・|そ][・|れ]は私には叶えられない“夢”だった。
lines.translated: I finally understand. *That* was a "dream" I could never fulfill.

lines.content: だから、お願い。ここではないどこかで、私の、世界で一番大切な人を幸せにしてほしい。それは、あなたしかできないことだから……
lines.translated: "So, please. Somewhere that isn't here, I want you to make the person most precious to me in the whole world happy. Because you're the only one who can do that..."

lines.content: ……あの子がうなずき、私の“隣”から、“半透明”のあなたのことを連れて行く。
lines.translated: She nods, and takes the "translucent" you away from "next" to me.

lines.content: 手と手を繋ぎ。
lines.translated: Joining hands.

lines.content: そっと、一歩を踏み出して。
lines.translated: Gently, taking a step forward.

lines.content: 遠い……。
lines.translated: Far away...

lines.content: とても遠い、私の手の届かないどこかへと。
lines.translated: To somewhere very far away, completely out of my reach.

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 私は泣いて。
lines.translated: I cried.

lines.content: （……いやだ）
泣いて……。
lines.translated: I cried, and cried...

lines.content: （……ひとりは、いやだよ）
lines.translated: (...I don't want to be alone.)

lines.content: そんな言葉を心に閉じ込め……。
lines.translated: Locking those words away inside my heart...

lines.content: （……さみしいのはいやなんだよ。大雅くん）
lines.translated: (...I don't want to be lonely. Taiga-kun.)

lines.content: 唇を、強く噛み。
lines.translated: Biting my lip hard.

lines.content: やさしいあなたが、私のことなんて気にしなくてもいいように……。
lines.translated: So that someone as kind as you wouldn't have to worry about me...

lines.content: 今にも泣いて叫んでしまいそうな口を、両手で、必死に押さえた。
lines.translated: With both hands, I desperately covered my mouth, which felt like it would burst into tears and screams at any moment.

lines.content: ただ静かに見送ろうと、思った。
lines.translated: I thought I would just see them off quietly.

lines.content: だけど、涙がぽろぽろこぼれる瞳だけは、閉じることなく真っ直ぐ前を見て……。
lines.translated: Yet my eyes, with tears spilling endlessly from them, refused to close and looked straight ahead...

lines.content: ふたりの背中が、ゆっくりと“夜”に消えていくのを、いつまでも見つめていた。
lines.translated: Gazing forever at the two of them from behind as they slowly vanished into the "Night."

lines.content: （――行かないで）
lines.translated: (--Don't go.)

lines.content: とは言えなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't say that.

lines.content: （――どうか最後に、一度だけでいいから、お願いだよ……私のことを振り向いて……）
lines.translated: (--Please, just once at the very end, I beg you... look back at me...)

lines.content: とは、願えなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't wish for that.

lines.content: ただ、涙ばかりが溢れてやまない。
lines.translated: Only the tears kept overflowing without end.

lines.content: 今にもこぼれ出しそうな言葉を全部、両手で押し止めるていたけれど、
lines.translated: I was holding back all the words that were about to spill out with both hands, and yet,

lines.content: ふと、あなたの顔が心に浮かんだ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, your face rose in my mind.

lines.content: 私にやさしく笑いかけてくれていた。私の小さな手のひらを引いていてくれた。
lines.translated: You had smiled gently at me. You had taken my small palm and led me by the hand.

lines.content: もう私には、そんな幸せな瞬間は訪れない。
lines.translated: Moments as happy as those will never come to me again.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]にすべて手渡してしまった。
lines.translated: I handed everything over to *her*.

lines.content: そう思うと、だめだった。
lines.translated: The moment I thought that, I couldn't hold back anymore.

lines.content: や――やっぱり、いやだ、いやだよ！　私も連れて行って、置いて、行かないで……っ
lines.translated: "N--No, I don't want this, I don't want this after all! Take me with you too, don't leave me behind...!"

lines.content: 手を伸ばした先には……。
lines.translated: Beyond my outstretched hand...

lines.content: もう、だめだ。
lines.translated: It's too late.

lines.content: 誰もいない。
lines.translated: No one is there.

lines.content: 誰も私に、振り向いてはくれない。
lines.translated: No one will turn around to look at me.

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 心の中から、大好きなあなたの笑顔がするすると消えていく……。
lines.translated: From inside my heart, the smile of the person I love so much slips away and vanishes...

lines.content: 絶対、ぜったい、これだけは忘れたくないものだったのに……。
lines.translated: Even though this was the one thing I never, ever wanted to forget...

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: あなたのことだけじゃない。“夜”に関するものが、私の中からすべて解けて消えていくのだ。
lines.translated: It isn't just you. Everything related to the "Night" is coming undone and disappearing from within me.

lines.content: ああ、どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: Ah, why is this happening?

lines.content: こんな最後を私は願っていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though an ending like this was what I must have wished for...

lines.content: “私たちは、出会ってはいけなかった”
lines.translated: "We never should have met."

lines.content: そんな言葉が何度となく、胸に響いて鳴り止まないのに。
lines.translated: Even though those words echo over and over in my chest without stopping.

lines.content: それなのにどうしようもなく悲しいのは、心が痛くてしかたがないのは、どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: Despite that, why am I so helplessly sad? Why does my heart ache so much I can't bear it?

lines.content: ……お願い
lines.translated: "...Please."

lines.content: お願いだよ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: ……こんな悲しい気持ちも、さみしい思いも、お願い、私の中から消し去ってほしい
lines.translated: "...These sad feelings, this lonely heartache, please, I want you to erase them all from inside me."

lines.content: それだけをただ祈り、私はたったひとりで、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Praying only for that, all alone, I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: ……今のは、なに
lines.translated: "...What was that just now?"

lines.content: ドアノブに触れようとした[・|私]の頭上に、長いながい、だけど一瞬の[・|映][・|像]が流れ、途切れた。
lines.translated: Right above *my* head as I reached out to touch the doorknob, a long, long, yet instantaneous *vision* flowed past and cut off.

lines.content: 今のは、もしかして……
lines.translated: "Could that have been..."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は、[・|こ][・|の][・|扉]を選んだ先に待ち受ける私の運命なのだと――心で理解できた。
lines.translated: In my heart, I understood--that *it* was the fate awaiting me if I chose *this door*.

lines.content: 私はその扉から一歩二歩と後じさる。
lines.translated: I take a step or two back from the door.

lines.content: そして[・|も][・|う][・|一][・|度]、ぐるりと辺りを見回した――真っ暗な空間だ。夜より深い“夜”の中。
lines.translated: And *once again*, I looked all around me--it was a pitch-black space. Inside a "Night" deeper than night itself.

lines.content: しかし、そこここにぽつりぽつりと光りの点が見受けられる。
lines.translated: However, scattered here and there, tiny points of light can be seen.

lines.content: その光景は、まるで真っ直ぐに伸びる真夜中の道を、等間隔で照らす街灯のようだった。
lines.translated: The sight was just like streetlights spaced at equal intervals, illuminating a midnight road stretching straight ahead.

lines.content: いいや――
lines.translated: No--

lines.content: これはまるで、星空が地上に落ちてきたみたいだと、そう表現したほうがよりしっくり来るのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps it would be more fitting to describe it as looking as though the starry sky had fallen to the earth.

lines.content: 見渡した闇はどこまでも広く、ぽつりと灯った光りは、おそらく幾千、幾万と、広大な暗闇の中にちりばめられているからだ。
lines.translated: Because the darkness I surveyed was endlessly vast, and the solitary lights were scattered across the immense gloom in the thousands, perhaps tens of thousands.

lines.content: そうして、幾つも光り輝く[・|星]の中に浮かび上がるもの――それは、[・|扉]だ。
lines.translated: And what emerged amidst those many shining *stars*--were *doors*.

lines.content: 闇の中に立つそれぞれ違うデザインの扉たち。
lines.translated: Doors of all different designs standing in the darkness.

lines.content: この光景に、多少なりとも見覚えがあった。
lines.translated: This scenery looked somewhat familiar to me.

lines.content: ……あのときだ
lines.translated: "...It's from back then."

lines.content: 十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: 私たちが“夜の王”と戦うため、“ゆめのねどこ”に集められていたとき……。
lines.translated: When we were gathered at the "Bed of Dreams" to fight the "King of the Night"...

lines.content: ……私は大雅くんに手を引かれて、この闇の中を、進んだ
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun took me by the hand and led me forward through this darkness."

lines.content: あのときはこんなにもたくさんの光りが、私たちの前に現れるようなことはなかった。
lines.translated: Back then, there weren't this many lights appearing before us.

lines.content: 歩いて。
lines.translated: We walked.

lines.content: 進んで。
lines.translated: We moved forward.

lines.content: 立ち止まったその先に、ぼんやりと、扉はただひとつだけ浮かび上がった――“ゆめのねどこ”の玄関だ。
lines.translated: And right ahead where we stopped, only a single door floated faintly into view--the entrance to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: あのときの私たちは、あず咲先輩の“呪い”によって、ほんの少し先の未来へと連れて行かれてしまっていたらしい。
lines.translated: Back then, it seemed Azusaki-senpai's "curse" had taken us just a little bit further into the future.

lines.content: そんな私たちの前に現れた“ゆめのねどこ”の扉。
lines.translated: That was when the door to the "Bed of Dreams" appeared before us.

lines.content: そこを開くと、私たちは元の時間の中に戻ってきてた。
lines.translated: When we opened it, we had returned to our original time.

lines.content: ……えっと、それはつまり
lines.translated: "...Um, so does that mean..."

lines.content: もう一度辺りを良くよく私は見渡して、
lines.translated: I look all around me once again, very carefully, and...

lines.content: ……このたくさん、たくさんある扉の中から、私が……本当に私が望む未来を選んで、進むことができるってこと、なのかな
lines.translated: "...Out of all these many, many doors, does this mean I... can choose the future I truly wish for, and move forward into it?"

lines.content: ここは、時間と時間とを結ぶ、架け橋のような空間なのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is this a space like a bridge connecting one time to another?

lines.content: そう考えてしまうのはあまりにも都合が良すぎるだろうか――“想像力”をあんまりにも自分本位に働かせすぎているだろうか。
lines.translated: Would thinking that be far too convenient--am I letting my "imagination" work far too selfishly?

lines.content: いや。そもそも“夜の国”とはいったいなんなのか。
lines.translated: No. What even is the "Land of the Night" in the first place?

lines.content: そこは“想像することがすべて叶えられる場所”ではなかったか。
lines.translated: Wasn't it "a place where everything you imagine comes true"?

lines.content: それなのにこうして時間にまで、運命にまで、干渉できてしまうだなんて、いったいここはどういう場所なのだろうか。
lines.translated: And yet, for it to be able to interfere even with time, even with fate like this... what kind of place is this, really?

lines.content: そういったことにまで、至らない考えが枝を伸ばしていきそうだけれど……。
lines.translated: My inadequate thoughts threaten to branch out into questions like that, however...

lines.content: だけど、ここに連れてきてくれた[・|ナ][・|ナ][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん]が言っていた。
lines.translated: Even so, *Nana-chan*, who brought me here, had told me.

lines.content: 大雅くんの“魔法”に撃ち抜かれ、次に目を覚ました私は、ナナちゃんの列車の中で目覚めたのだった。
lines.translated: Shot through by Taiga-kun's "magic," the next time I opened my eyes, I had woken up inside Nana-chan's train.

lines.content: 『……ハル。今から君は、きっと無限に提示される可能性から、たったひとつを選ばなきゃならなくなる。きっと、そうなる』
lines.translated: "...Haru. From now on, you'll surely have to choose just one single path from an infinite number of possibilities presented to you. It will surely come to that."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは私にそう言った。
lines.translated: That was what Nana-chan said to me.

lines.content: 『慎重に、大切に、そして丁寧に選ぶんだよ――忘れないで。君の未来は、君自身の願いに掛かってる。君たちは自分の未来を、思い通りに想像することができるイキモノなんだ』
lines.translated: "Choose carefully, preciously, and deliberately--don't forget. Your future depends on your own wish. You humans are creatures who can imagine your own futures however you wish."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそう言って、私をこの闇の中にまで運んでくれた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Nana-chan carried me all the way into this darkness.

lines.content: 『この光りはすべて、君の“想像”した可能性だよ』
lines.translated: "All of these lights are possibilities that you 'imagined.'"

lines.content: 『君が、自分の幸せとはどんなものなのか。自分の未来とはどんなふうであることが相応しいと、[・|あ][・|き][・|ら][・|め][・|る]のか……。すべては君が想像しうる可能性なんだ』
lines.translated: "What kind of thing your happiness is. What kind of future you *resign yourself* to thinking is fitting for you... Everything is a possibility that you are capable of imagining."

lines.content: 忘れないで、すべては君の“想像力”にかかってる、とナナちゃんは繰り返す――
lines.translated: Don't forget, everything depends on your "imagination," Nana-chan repeated--

lines.content: 『君たち人間はすべて、“想像”した未来を手に入れることのできるイキモノだ。そういう“魔法”を自然と使えてしまう存在だ。だから私たちは、誰もが君らに憧れる』
lines.translated: "All of you humans are creatures capable of obtaining the future you 'imagine.' You are beings who can naturally use that kind of 'magic.' That is why every single one of us longs to be like you."

lines.content: 『……あなたの“想い”と、完全になった大雅の“魔法”とが重なって、[・|こ][・|れ]を、星空みたいなこの光景を、可能にさせたんだよ』
lines.translated: "...Your 'feelings' and Taiga's perfected 'magic' overlapped, making *this*--this starry sky-like scenery--possible."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそう言っていた。
lines.translated: That was what Nana-chan had said.

lines.content: こんなにも広大にちりばめられた可能性。無限とも思える選択肢。
lines.translated: Possibilities scattered across such a vast expanse. Choices that seem infinite.

lines.content: その中から好きな“未来”を自由に選べと、大雅くんの“魔法”が……。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun's "magic" is telling me to freely choose whichever "future" I like from among them...

lines.content: ううん、“夜の国”そのものが、そして私自身が、私の心にそう囁いている。
lines.translated: No, the "Land of the Night" itself, and I myself, are whispering that to my heart.

lines.content: これはきっとそういうふうに、自分勝手に解釈してみてもいいのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think it's probably okay for me to interpret this in my own selfish way like that.

lines.content: ……この扉は、だめ
lines.translated: "...Not this door."

lines.content: 首を振る。改めて[・|そ][・|の][・|扉]から私は離れる。
lines.translated: I shake my head. Once again, I step away from *that door*.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの列車を降りた場所から一番近い扉だった。
lines.translated: It was the closest door to the place where I got off Nana-chan's train.

lines.content: だから恐る恐る、そのドアノブに手を伸ばしたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: That was why I had timidly reached out my hand toward its doorknob, however...

lines.content: ……この扉の向こうは、[・|あ][・|の][・|部][・|屋]に繋がっていて
lines.translated: "...Beyond this door, it connects to *that room*."
"...And the time beyond that connects to *that kind of ending*."

lines.content: いやだよ。
lines.translated: I don't want that.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|未][・|来]は、ごめんなさい――選べない。選びたくはない。
lines.translated: *A future like that*--I'm sorry, I can't choose it. I don't want to choose it.

lines.content: 私は、別の扉の前に立つ。
lines.translated: I stand in front of a different door.

lines.content: すると今度はノブに触れることもなく、[・|扉][・|の][・|先]の光景が、私の中に流れ込んできた。
lines.translated: When I do, this time without even touching the knob, the scenery *beyond the door* flowed into me.

lines.content: ――やはり私はあの部屋で目覚める。
lines.translated: --Just as I thought, I wake up in that room.

lines.content: そこに私の“後悔”があるのだからしかたがない。
lines.translated: That is where my "regret" lies, so it can't be helped.

lines.content: その扉の向こうの私は、最初に掛かってきた電話に出た。
lines.translated: The me beyond that door answered the first phone call that came in.

lines.content: そしてその電話で繋がった大雅くんに、“魔法”が成功したことを伝えた――
lines.translated: And to Taiga-kun, who was connected through that call, I told him that the "magic" had succeeded--

lines.content: 私の心はあなたの“魔法”で“未来”に戻った。もう、お母さんのプラン通りに生きない。そう、伝えた。
lines.translated: My heart returned to the "future" through your "magic." I won't live according to my mother's plan anymore. That was what I told him.

lines.content: 『……そうか、成功したんだ。よかった。ハル……。今から迎えに行く。そこで、待ってろ』
lines.translated: "...I see, it succeeded. Thank goodness. Haru... I'm coming to get you right now. Wait right there."

lines.content: それが大雅くんの最期の言葉になった。
lines.translated: Those became Taiga-kun's final words.

lines.content: 私をばらばらにするため雇われた、乱暴な大人の人たちに大雅くんは鉢合わせた。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun ran right into the violent adults hired to tear me apart.

lines.content: そして大雅くんは、私よりも先に、ばらばらに……。
lines.translated: And before it could happen to me, Taiga-kun was torn apart...

lines.content: ……こんな未来、だめ。絶対いやだよ
lines.translated: "...A future like this is no good. I絕對 don't want this."
Right in front of my eyes, Taiga-kun suffered *something like that*...

lines.content: その光景が心にこびりついて離れない。涙が滲む。
lines.translated: That sight is burned into my heart and won't leave. Tears well up.

lines.content: ――だめ。次の扉だ。
lines.translated: --No good. The next door.

lines.content: 今見た悲しい終わりを振り払い……振り払えるようにと、祈り……。
lines.translated: Shaking off the sad ending I just saw... praying that I can shake it off...

lines.content: 次は少し離れた場所の扉だ。その前に立つ。
lines.translated: Next is a door a little further away. I stand before it.

lines.content: 扉の先の未来が心に流れ込んでくる。
lines.translated: The future beyond the door flows into my heart.

lines.content: またあの部屋だった。
lines.translated: It was that room again.

lines.content: 今度は電話にも出ず、私は自力で部屋から逃げ出した。
lines.translated: This time, without even answering the phone, I escaped from the room on my own power.

lines.content: ……最初から、そうすればよかった
lines.translated: "...I should have done that from the very beginning."

lines.content: そういう思いが私の中にずっとあった。
lines.translated: That thought had always been inside me.

lines.content: だから[・|こ][・|の][・|選][・|択][・|を][・|し][・|た][・|未][・|来]も“想像”できたのだろう――だからこそ、そこへと繋がる扉があるのだ。
lines.translated: That's probably why I was able to "imagine" *a future where I made this choice* as well--and that is precisely why there is a door leading to it.

lines.content: あの部屋の扉に鍵は元々かけられていなかった。
lines.translated: The door to that room was never locked in the first place.

lines.content: 私は望んであの部屋に留まっていたにすぎない。お母さんの言葉によって、あの薄暗い部屋の中に縛られていたに、すぎない――
lines.translated: I was merely staying in that room because I wished to. I was merely bound inside that dimly lit room by my mother's words--

lines.content: 『“ハル。お母さんに愛されたいなら、自分がどうすべきなのか、わかっているわよね。いい子になるのよ。ただ、それだけでいいの”』
lines.translated: "Haru. If you want to be loved by Mommy, you know what you have to do, don't you? Be a good girl. That's all you need to do."

lines.content: だから私は、自らあの部屋の外に逃げ出そうという気が、わかなかった。
lines.translated: That was why the urge to flee outside that room on my own never welled up in me.
"*If I'm not 'beside' my mother, my mother will break.* I had thought that, too."

lines.content: でも、今はもう違う。
lines.translated: But now, it's different.

lines.content: ごめんなさい、お母さん。私はあなたの“隣”から、一歩、踏み出したいと願ってる。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Mommy. I wish to take one step away from your "side."

lines.content: 私はもう、あの部屋にはいられない――大好きな人が、できたの。お母さん。その人は、“かわいそうな女の子”としての私と出会うと不幸になる。
lines.translated: I can't stay in that room anymore--I found someone I love very much, Mommy. If that person meets me as a "pitiful girl," he will become unhappy.

lines.content: だから私はこの部屋を、自分の意思で、自分の足で、飛び出さなければいけない――書き換えるんだ。
lines.translated: That's why I must rush out of this room by my own will, on my own two feet--I will rewrite it.

lines.content: 私は、私たちの運命を書き換えるんだ。
lines.translated: I will rewrite our fate.

lines.content: 大雅くんと誓った言葉が、この胸の中にあるから――
lines.translated: Because the words I swore with Taiga-kun are right here inside my chest--

lines.content: ……“信じてる”
lines.translated: "...'I believe in you.'"

lines.content: そうだ。私は運命を書き換える。そのために大雅くんの“魔法”を受け入れた。
lines.translated: That's right. I will rewrite fate. For that purpose, I accepted Taiga-kun's "magic."
We will surely *be able to meet again in a different way*.

lines.content: その時間の先でなら、ふたりで一緒に幸せになれる。そう信じた。
lines.translated: Beyond that time, the two of us can become happy together. That was what I believed.

lines.content: だから、私は……。
lines.translated: That is why I...

lines.content: この扉の向こうの私は、部屋を飛び出す。大好きな人を探し出すために。
lines.translated: The me beyond this door rushes out of the room. In order to find the person I love so much.

lines.content: 誘拐犯とその被害者。そういう出会いとは違う出会いを、するために。
lines.translated: A kidnapper and his victim. In order to have a meeting different from that kind of encounter.

lines.content: 理想は、“何者かに誘拐された被害者の私が監禁場所から自力で逃げ出し、そんな私のことを大人になった大雅くんが一番最初に発見し、保護してくれる”
lines.translated: The ideal scenario was: "As a victim kidnapped by someone, I escape from the place of confinement on my own power, and a grown-up Taiga-kun is the very first one to discover me and take me into his protection."

lines.content: ――そんな大雅くんのことを、世界は悪者になんてしないはず。きっと正義の味方みたいに愛してくれるはず。それが、理想だった。
lines.translated: --The world surely wouldn't turn a Taiga-kun like that into a villain. Surely they would love him like a hero of justice. That was the ideal.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 私はすぐに捕まった。
lines.translated: I was caught immediately.

lines.content: 私を保護したのは知らない大人の人だった。
lines.translated: The one who took me into protection was an adult I didn't know.

lines.content: 事情を話したってもちろん信じてもらえず……。
lines.translated: Even when I explained the circumstances, of course no one believed me...

lines.content: そしてお母さんに引き渡された私は、そのままお母さんの手によって、“かわいそうな女の子”になって……、終わり。
lines.translated: And handed back over to my mother, I was turned into a "pitiful girl" right then and there by my mother's hands... and it ended.

lines.content: 終わりだ。
lines.translated: It would be over.
*We never met.*

lines.content: それがこの扉の向こうに待ち受ける未来と結末。
lines.translated: That is the future and conclusion awaiting beyond this door.

lines.content: 以前の私ならこの未来を選んだかもしれない。
lines.translated: The old me might have chosen this future.

lines.content: ……結果として、おじさんは私と出会わなかったから。
lines.translated: Because as a result, Mister never met me.

lines.content: でもおじさんは、大雅くんは、いつか未来の世界で私が目覚めることを知っている。[・|も][・|う][・|既][・|に][・|一][・|回][・|目][・|の][・|お][・|じ][・|さ][・|ん][・|じ][・|ゃ][・|な][・|い]
lines.translated: "But Mister--Taiga-kun--knows that I will wake up in the future world someday. *He is already no longer the Mister from the first time around.*"

lines.content: そういう“魔法”を私に使ったからだ。私の命を、その“[弾丸|魔法]”で、撃ち抜いたからだ。
lines.translated: Because he used that kind of "magic" on me. Because he shot through my life with that "magic" bullet.

lines.content: 大雅くんは私が去った世界で、今度は私を探して彷徨い続けるのだろうか。
lines.translated: In the world I left behind, will Taiga-kun continue to wander in search of me this time?

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 私はもうこれまでの私じゃない……。
lines.translated: I am no longer the me I was up until now...

lines.content: 大雅くんは私が運命を書き換えると信じた。
lines.translated: Taiga-kun believed that I would rewrite fate.

lines.content: だから“魔法”で私を未来へ送り出したのだ。
lines.translated: That is why he sent me off to the future with his "magic."

lines.content: 私は、大雅くんが信じてくれた私になりたい。だからもう不幸な終わりは選ばない。
lines.translated: I want to become the me that Taiga-kun believed in. So I won't choose an unhappy ending anymore.

lines.content: 大雅くんが私に重ねたヒーローみたいに、決して諦めることなく走って行きたいと願うから……
lines.translated: Because I wish to keep running without ever giving up, just like the hero Taiga-kun saw in me...

lines.content: ……違う。これじゃない
lines.translated: "...Wrong. Not this one."

lines.content: 次だ。
lines.translated: Next.

lines.content: 私は次の扉の前に立つ。
lines.translated: I stand in front of the next door.

lines.content: でも、だめ。
lines.translated: But, no good.

lines.content: 行き着く先はバットエンドだ。
lines.translated: What lies at the end is a bad ending.
Next...

lines.content: これもだめ。
lines.translated: This one's no good either.

lines.content: だったら、次は……。
lines.translated: Then, the next one...

lines.content: だめだった。
lines.translated: It was no use.

lines.content: 凄惨な終わりは更に色濃くなるばかり。
lines.translated: The gruesome endings only grow darker and more vivid.

lines.content: どこ……
lines.translated: "Where..."

lines.content: 私は、幾つもの扉の前に立つ。
lines.translated: I stand before countless doors.

lines.content: 私たちのハッピーエンドは、どこにあるの……
lines.translated: "Where is our happy ending...?"

lines.content: 彷徨う。
lines.translated: I wander.

lines.content: 真っ暗な世界をたったひとりで彷徨い続ける。
lines.translated: I keep wandering all alone through a pitch-black world.

lines.content: 私は、誰もが想像だってできやしないだろう幸せな未来を、探し続けたけれど……。
lines.translated: I kept searching for a happy future that probably no one could ever even imagine, and yet...

lines.content: いつしか私は、立ち止まってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had stopped in my tracks.

lines.content: いったいどれくらい歩いただろう。
lines.translated: Just how far have I walked?

lines.content: 長い時間を掛け、暗闇の中を進んだ気がする。
lines.translated: I feel as though I've spent a long time pressing forward through the darkness.

lines.content: 時間の感覚なんて[・|生][・|前]とまったく同じであるとは思えないけれど……。
lines.translated: Though I can't imagine my sense of time is the exact same as it was *when I was alive*...

lines.content: とにかく長いながい時間を、たったひとりで彷徨ったはずで……。
lines.translated: Regardless, I must have wandered all alone for a long, long time...

lines.content: ……私の、私たちの幸せは、どこにもない
lines.translated: "...My happiness, our happiness, isn't anywhere."

lines.content: そんな結論に行き着くほか、なかった。
lines.translated: I had no choice but to arrive at that conclusion.

lines.content: ……ひとつとして同じ[扉|未来]はなく。
lines.translated: Not a single door--not a single future--was the same.

lines.content: ひとつとして、私たちが笑顔で幕を下ろせる[物語|時間]は、探し出せない。
lines.translated: And I cannot find a single story--a single time--where we can lower the curtain with a smile.

lines.content: その理由はなんとなくわかってた。
lines.translated: I somehow understood the reason why.

lines.content: 私の心が、私自身の未来に、幸せな光景を思い描くことができないからだ――ここは、“夜の国”
lines.translated: It's because my heart cannot picture a happy scene in my own future--this place is the "Country of Night."

lines.content: 思い描いたすべてを形にする“不思議の国”だ。
lines.translated: A "Wonderland" that gives form to everything you envision.

lines.content: 私は、産まれてきて一番最初に愛されたかった人に、愛されなかっただけでなく――憎まれてさえいた。
lines.translated: Not only was I unloved by the very first person I wanted to be loved by after being born--I was even hated.

lines.content: 愛されない者が果たして幸せになれるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Can someone who is unloved truly become happy?

lines.content: 答えは、[ノー|否]だ。私の心がそう言っている。
lines.translated: The answer is no. My heart tells me so.

lines.content: だから、私は、[・|自][・|分][・|の]“[・|魔][・|法]”[・|を][・|あ][・|あ][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|し][・|か][・|描][・|け][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た]。愛する人の不幸を肩代わりすることで、どうか私を愛してほしいと、心のどこかで願ってた。
lines.translated: That is why *I could only envision my "magic" in that way*. By taking on the misfortune of the person I loved, somewhere in my heart, I was wishing that he would please love me.

lines.content: ……そうすることで、私の命はあなたの心の中で生きていけるのではないかと、思った。それもまた“永遠の命”のひとつであるようにも思えた。
lines.translated: By doing so, I thought my life might be able to live on inside your heart. That, too, seemed to me like one form of "eternal life."

lines.content: ……くらい
lines.translated: "...It's dark."

lines.content: 真っ暗だ。
lines.translated: It's pitch black.

lines.content: 私が選ばないと決めた[扉|未来]はすべて、光りを閉ざし、消えていった。
lines.translated: Every door--every future--that I decided not to choose shut out its light and vanished.

lines.content: その度にどんどん闇の色が濃くなっていくのだ。
lines.translated: Each time, the color of the darkness grows deeper and deeper.

lines.content: あなたとの未来を信じてる。幸せな未来を、信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe in a future with you. I believe in a happy future.

lines.content: でも、少し……。
lines.translated: But, just a little...

lines.content: ほんの少しだけ、
lines.translated: Just a tiny bit,

lines.content: ……疲れた
lines.translated: "...I'm tired."

lines.content: あきらめるわけではない。あなたとの未来を手放すわけでも、ない。
lines.translated: It's not that I'm giving up. Nor am I letting go of a future with you.

lines.content: ただ、ちょっと休憩するくらいならいいじゃないかな。
lines.translated: I just thought it might be okay to take a little break.

lines.content: ……眠ろう
lines.translated: "...Let's sleep."

lines.content: 少しだけ、立ち止まって。少しだけ、眠るのだ。
lines.translated: I'll stop for just a little while. And sleep for just a little while.

lines.content: そうして見る夢の中で、私には決して“想像”できない幸せな[光景|時間]と出会えたなら、いい。
lines.translated: If, in the dream I have then, I can encounter a happy scene--a happy time--that I could never "imagine" on my own, that would be nice.

lines.content: そこにはたぶんあの人がいてくれるはず。
lines.translated: That person will probably be there for me.

lines.content: 大切なあなたが、やさしく咲いた満開の下、小さな私を負ぶって歩き……。
lines.translated: Under the gently blooming flowers in full blossom, my precious you will walk while carrying little me on your back...

lines.content: そうしてふたり、夢見るよりも幸せな[・|そ][・|の][・|先]へと、あなたが連れて行ってくれるはず。
lines.translated: And like that, the two of us together, you will surely take me *beyond that*, to a place happier than any dream.

lines.content: もしもそんな夢を、見れたなら……。
lines.translated: If only I could have a dream like that...

lines.content: ……もう、夢から覚めなければ、いいんだけどな
lines.translated: "...It would be nice if I never had to wake up from the dream."

lines.content: そんな諦観めいた思いを抱いたのは一瞬だった。ほんの、一瞬。
lines.translated: It was only for an instant that I harbored such a resigned thought. Just a single instant.

lines.content: それなのに、そんな私をめざとく責め立てるみたいに――パチリ、と。
lines.translated: And yet, as if sharply rebuking me for it--*click*.

lines.content: まるで、ブレーカーを乱暴に落とすみたいな音がして、すべての光りが一斉に、消えた。
lines.translated: There was a sound like a circuit breaker being roughly thrown, and all the lights went out at once.

lines.content: まだまだいくつも残っていた扉の光りが、一斉に、だ。
lines.translated: The lights of the many doors that still remained, all at once.

lines.content: 辺りは本当の暗闇に包まれる。
lines.translated: My surroundings are swallowed in true darkness.

lines.content: 不思議と焦る気持ちはなかった。
lines.translated: Strangely, I didn't feel panicked.

lines.content: 眠るのなら[明かり|光り]はいらない。おやすみなさいの言葉と一緒に部屋の電気を切るのと同じだ。
lines.translated: If I'm going to sleep, I don't need any light. It's the same as turning off the room lights along with the words "good night."

lines.content: 気づけばあの部屋が目の前に現れている。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, that room had appeared right in front of my eyes.

lines.content: 私が私を閉じ込めていたあの部屋だ。その寝床に包まり、眠ろう。
lines.translated: That room where I had locked myself away. Let's curl up in that bed and sleep.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じると夢の香りがした。
lines.translated: When I closed my eyelids, there was the scent of a dream.

lines.content: 本当にこのまま眠ってしまって大丈夫……？
lines.translated: Is it really okay to fall asleep like this...?

lines.content: 私、またちゃんと目を覚まして……走って行ける？
lines.translated: Will I be able to wake up properly again... and start running?

lines.content: そんな不安ごと飲み込むように、夢のはじまりが訪れる。
lines.translated: As if swallowing up those anxieties whole, the beginning of a dream arrives.

lines.content: 幸せ色の予感がした。
lines.translated: I had a premonition the color of happiness.

lines.content: 私は今からすてきな夢を見る。
lines.translated: I am about to have a wonderful dream.

lines.content: ……再び歩いて行くだけの気持ちも全部、置き去りにして。そんな予感だ。
lines.translated: Leaving behind even the will to start walking again. That's the kind of premonition it is.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。大雅くん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 私は……あなたの期待には応えられない、かも、しれない
lines.translated: "I... might not be able to live up to your expectations."

lines.content: ……あなたのヒーローには、私はなれない。
lines.translated: I cannot become your hero.

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: ……はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter.

lines.content: 花びらが舞っている。
lines.translated: Petals are dancing in the air.

lines.content: 歌が、聞こえた。知ってる歌だ。
lines.translated: I heard a song. It's a song I know.

lines.content: それは、あの人が私に歌ってくれた“愛”の歌。
lines.translated: It's the song of "love" that he sang to me.

lines.content: 私も口ずさんでみる。囁くように聞こえてくる、あの人の声と合わせるように。
lines.translated: I try humming along, too. Matching my voice with his, which reaches me like a whisper.
"...Haru."

lines.content: 私を呼ぶ声がする。
lines.translated: I heard a voice calling out to me.

lines.content: “……ほら、見て”
lines.translated: "...Look, see."

lines.content: 夢の向こうから、あなたが私を呼んでいる。
lines.translated: From beyond the dream, you are calling for me.

lines.content: “……世界はこんなにも、きれいだ”
lines.translated: "...The world is this beautiful."

lines.content: ああ、幸せな夢のはじまり。
lines.translated: Ah, the beginning of a happy dream.
It is the beginning of *my end*.

lines.content: ここで幸せすぎる夢を一度でも見てしまえば、さみしいことばっかりな現実に戻れなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: If I have a dream that is too happy here even once, I will never be able to return to a reality filled with nothing but loneliness.

lines.content: 私の心は永遠に、“夜”の中に閉じ込められてしまう……。
lines.translated: My heart will be locked away inside the "Night" forever...

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開いたその瞬間に、夢は現実となり――本当に[・|こ][・|こ]が、私たちのお話の、私の歌の、[終わり|結末]になってしまう。
lines.translated: The moment I open my eyelids, the dream will become reality--and *this place* will truly become the end--the conclusion--of our story, of my song.

lines.content: そんな恐怖はもはや予感ではない。確信と言ってもいいはずだ。
lines.translated: That fear is no longer a premonition. You could call it a certainty.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: 私は、弱い。
lines.translated: I am weak.

lines.content: 今までたくさんつらいこと、悲しいことが、あって……。
lines.translated: Because so many painful, sad things have happened until now...

lines.content: 夢の中でくらい、幸せになりたい。そう願ってしまったから。
lines.translated: And I wished to be happy, at least inside a dream.

lines.content: だから私は、やさしい歌に誘われるまま――[まぶた|瞼]をそっと、開いた。
lines.translated: So, guided by the gentle song--I softly opened my eyelids.

lines.content: “……ようやく、見つけたよ。ハル”
lines.translated: "...I finally found you, Haru."

lines.content: 声がする。あなたの声だ。世界で一番の私の味方。
lines.translated: I hear a voice. It's your voice. My greatest ally in the world.

lines.content: “……ごめん”
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ふと、あなたが言った。
lines.translated: Suddenly, you said.

lines.content: “……ごめんなさい”
lines.translated: "...I'm so sorry."

lines.content: それはまだ、ぼんやりと不確かに響く声だった。
lines.translated: It was a voice that still echoed vaguely and uncertainly.

lines.content: “本当に、ごめんなさい”
lines.translated: "I'm truly sorry."

lines.content: 私は問いかける。
lines.translated: I ask a question.

lines.content: どうして、謝るの……？
lines.translated: "Why are you apologizing...?"

lines.content: すると、その声が――
lines.translated: And then, that voice--

lines.content: “……よかった”
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: ――不確かだったあなたの声が、色づいた。
lines.translated: --your uncertain voice took on color.

lines.content: ……間に合って、良かった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness I made it in time."

lines.content: ……本当に、ごめんなさい。ハル
lines.translated: "...I am truly sorry, Haru."

lines.content: 私は……
[・|お][・|母][・|さ][・|ん]は、もう少しで、[・|ま][・|た]大切な宝物をなくしてしまうところだった
lines.translated: "*Mommy* almost lost her precious treasure *again*."

lines.content: ふわふわで暖かな満開の下。私は……、
lines.translated: Under the fluffy, warm flowers in full bloom. I was...

lines.content: ……お母さん？
lines.translated: "...Mommy?"

lines.content: 世界で一番の味方でいてほしいと、いつも願い続けてきた人に、負ぶわれていた。
lines.translated: I was being carried on the back of the person I had always wished would be my greatest ally in the world.

lines.content: お母さん、なの……？
lines.translated: "Mommy... is that you...?"

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ……私をこうして抱き上げ、歩いてくれるのは[・|あ][・|の][・|人]だけだと思っていたのに。
lines.translated: Even though I thought *he* was the only one who would ever pick me up and walk with me like this.

lines.content: お母さんは、言う――私のことを長いながい間、[・|こ][・|こ]で探し続けていたんだ、と。
lines.translated: Mommy tells me--that she had been searching for me *here* for a long, long time.

lines.content: ……あなたには本当に、ほんとうに、謝らなきゃならないことがたくさんで……
lines.translated: "...There are so, truly so many things I have to apologize to you for..."

lines.content: ……ハル
