lines.translated: That was my new "dream."

lines.content: そのひとは少し驚いた顔をして、
lines.translated: That person looked a little surprised, and...

lines.content: 『……そうか。う、うん。なるほど』
lines.translated: "...Is that so. Y-Yeah. I see."

lines.content: と、ただ、それだけ。
lines.translated: That was all she said.

lines.content: ぶっきらぼうに言って、小さく笑っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: She spoke bluntly and gave a small smile, though...

lines.content: そのひとが根気強く俺に勉強を教えてくれたし。
lines.translated: That person patiently helped me with my studies.

lines.content: テストの点などに少しずつ成果が見え始めると、まるで自分のことのようにそのひとは喜んでくれた。
lines.translated: When my test scores and such gradually started showing results, that person rejoiced as if it were happening to her.

lines.content: 受験が近づき、夜遅くまで勉強を続ける俺に、毎夜欠かさず美味しい夜食を作ってもくれた。
lines.translated: As entrance exams drew near and I kept studying late into the night, she never failed to make me a delicious late-night snack every single evening.

lines.content: 志望校に無事合格し、[・|ハ][・|ル][・|と][・|一][・|緒][・|に]町を離れることになった。
lines.translated: I safely passed the exam for my first-choice school, and it was decided that I would leave town together with Haru.

lines.content: まるで巣立つ息子を見送る母親みたいな心境だとそのひとは言い、俺たちを見送ってくれた駅で、人目もはばからず泣いてくれていた。
lines.translated: Saying she felt just like a mother seeing off her son as he left the nest, that person cried without caring who saw at the station where she came to see us off.

lines.content: 最後に渡されたお弁当を、列車でハルと食べながら、あのひとが泣いたところをはじめて見たことにやっと気づき……俺も、涙が止まらなくなった。
lines.translated: While eating the bento she handed us at the very end on the train with Haru, I finally realized it was the first time I had ever seen that person cry... and my own tears wouldn't stop either.

lines.content: 必ず戻ってきますとあのひとに誓った。
lines.translated: I swore to that person that I would definitely come back.

lines.content: その言葉を決して忘れないようにと、俺は自分自身にも誓ったのだった。
lines.translated: And I swore to myself that I would never forget those words.

lines.content: 俺と同じ大学に通うことになったハルと、数年間を同じ小さなアパートの部屋で暮らした。
lines.translated: Haru ended up attending the same university as me, and we lived together in the same small apartment room for several years.

lines.content: ケンカもしたし、同じくらい笑ったし、同じくらいすれ違うこともあった。
lines.translated: We had our fights, laughed just as much, and had just as many misunderstandings.

lines.content: だけど無事、何事もなく手と手を繋ぎ、過ごしていけた数年間だった。
lines.translated: Even so, those were several years we spent safely and peacefully, walking hand in hand.

lines.content: ハルと過ごしたその時間が、俺の決意を新たにさせてくれたから……。
lines.translated: Because the time I spent with Haru renewed my determination...

lines.content: さくらの町“参禅町”
lines.translated: The town of cherry blossoms, "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: その母校に新任教師として、この春、通うことになった。
lines.translated: This spring, I began commuting to my alma mater there as a newly appointed teacher.

lines.content: 約束通り戻ってきた俺に、あのひとは本当にうれしそうに笑ってくれて。
lines.translated: When I returned just as promised, that person gave me a truly overjoyed smile.

lines.content: 三年経っても大きくも小さくもなっていない、全然かわらないあのひとの妹も、俺たちの帰りをよろこんでくれていた。
lines.translated: That person's younger sister, who hadn't grown any bigger or smaller even after three years--completely unchanged--was also happy to have us back.

lines.content: 俺はハルと一緒に“ゆめのねどこ”で暮らすことになった。
lines.translated: Haru and I ended up living together at the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 同時に……。
lines.translated: At the same time...

lines.content: これからおそらく、人生の殆どの時間をこの町で暮らしていくことになるのだろうなと予感した。
lines.translated: I had a premonition that I would probably end up spending most of the rest of my life in this town.

lines.content: そして、今日。
lines.translated: And then, today.

lines.content: はじめての給料日だった。
lines.translated: It was my very first payday.

lines.content: 使い道は決めていた。
lines.translated: I had already decided how to spend it.

lines.content: ハルと俺、そしてあのひと達と一緒に美味しいものを食べに行こう。今までのお礼がしたい。
lines.translated: Haru, me, and those people would all go out to eat something delicious together. I wanted to thank them for everything up until now.

lines.content: 学費の面倒まで見てくれたことはもちろん、今までずっと、美味しいものを俺たちのために作ってくれていたお礼をだ。
lines.translated: Not only for going so far as to take care of my tuition, of course, but also to thank them for always making delicious food for us all this time.

lines.content: 『そっか。今夜を楽しみにしてるよ。……本当に』
lines.translated: "I see. I'm looking forward to tonight. ...Really."

lines.content: あのひとは微笑み、『私もお返しを用意しておくから、そちらも楽しみにしておいてくれたらうれしいな』とそう言っていた。
lines.translated: That person smiled and said, "I'll have a return gift ready too, so I'd be happy if you looked forward to that as well."

lines.content: 前日には少し値の張る店に電話で予約を入れた。
lines.translated: The day before, I called ahead to make a reservation at a slightly pricey restaurant.

lines.content: 当日の今日、帰り道にコンビニに寄り、まだ使い慣れていないＡＴＭを操作し、必要だろうお金も財布にしっかり詰め込んだ。
lines.translated: Today, on the day itself, I stopped by a convenience store on my way home, operated an ATM Istill wasn't quite used to, and made sure to stuff my wallet with all the money I would likely need.

lines.content: たったそれだけで、[・|大][・|人][・|に][・|な][・|れ][・|た][・|こ][・|と]をしみじみと実感できてしまった。
lines.translated: Just doing something like that was enough to make me deeply feel that I had truly become an adult.

lines.content: そんな自分に気恥ずかしさを覚えながらも……。
lines.translated: Even as I felt a bit embarrassed with myself for thinking that way...

lines.content: きっとあのひとはよろこんでくれるはず。もしかしたらまた泣いてくれたりするのかも。
lines.translated: I was sure that person would be happy. Maybe she would even cry for me again.

lines.content: そんな気持ちをいっぱいに弾ませて、帰ってきたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: With my heart bounding full of those feelings, I came home, and yet...

lines.content: おかしいな。
lines.translated: That's strange.

lines.content: たった今、振り返った思い出の中のそのひとの顔に、その存在そのものに、薄らと影のようなものが降りてきて……。
lines.translated: Just now, over the face of that person in the memories I was looking back on, over her very existence itself, something like a faint shadow descended...

lines.content: ……名前も
lines.translated: "...Her name, too."

lines.content: 名前さえも、今や思い出せない。
lines.translated: Right now, I can't even remember her name.

lines.content: おかしい。
lines.translated: That's strange.

lines.content: そもそもあのひと達と、俺は、いったいどういうふうにして出会ったんだったっけ……。
lines.translated: To begin with, how on earth did I ever meet those people in the first place...?

lines.content: それにもうひとり、大切に想っていたはずの誰かがいたようにも、思えて……。
lines.translated: On top of that, I feel like there was someone else, too, someone I must have cared for deeply...

lines.content: ああ……なんだ、これは。
lines.translated: Ah... What is this?

lines.content: “不思議”だ。
lines.translated: It's a "mystery."

lines.content: こんなことあっていいのだろうか。
lines.translated: How could something like this be happening?

lines.content: しかしこんな“不思議”は、俺の人生に訪れる最後の“不思議”だろうと、心のどこかで感じていた。
lines.translated: However, deep down in my heart, I felt that a "mystery" like this would probably be the very last "mystery" to ever visit my life.

lines.content: それがまた悲しくて……。
lines.translated: And that made me sad all over again...

lines.content: 大切なひと達のうれし涙を期待していたはずなのに、今にもさみしいばかりの涙が、頬を伝っていきそうだった。
lines.translated: I was supposed to be looking forward to the happy tears of the people precious to me, yet tears of pure loneliness were on the verge of rolling down my cheeks at any moment.

lines.content: ……あ、あの。大雅くん？
lines.translated: "...U-Um. Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 帰ったの？　と。
lines.translated: "Are you back?" she asked.

lines.content: 奥座敷のほうから声がした。扉の向こう。ハルの声だ。
lines.translated: A voice came from the direction of the inner parlor. Beyond the door. It was Haru's voice.

lines.content: あ、ああ。ただいま、ハル
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I'm home, Haru."

lines.content: 滲み始めた涙を急いで拭った。そして扉の向こうに呼びかける。
lines.translated: I hurriedly wiped away the tears that had begun to well up. Then, I called out to the other side of the door.

lines.content: 今日は外で一緒に、お夕飯を食べようって約束だったけど……どうかな。もう出かける準備、できてるかな
lines.translated: "We promised to go out and eat dinner together today, right...? How is it? Are you ready to head out yet?"

lines.content: 返事がなかった。
lines.translated: There was no reply.

lines.content: どうしたんだろうと思っていると、
lines.translated: Just as I was wondering what was wrong,

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Hey, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 扉の向こうから声がする。奥座敷と店内とを区切る扉だ。
lines.translated: A voice came from beyond the door. The door separating the inner parlor from the shop floor.

lines.content: お食事に行く前に、その……、えっと……ね。見てもらいたいものがあるんだけど、いいかな
lines.translated: "Before we go eat, um... well... you see. There's something I'd like you to look at, if that's okay?"

lines.content: ……俺に？　今すぐ？
lines.translated: "...Me? Right now?"

lines.content: うん。できれば今、すぐに。大雅くんに、だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Right now, if possible. For you to see, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: それは、うん。もちろん大丈夫だけど
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. Of course that's fine, though."

lines.content: なんだろう。と俺は問いかける。
lines.translated: "What is it?" I asked.

lines.content: ちょ、ちょっと、待っててね。少し準備が……
lines.translated: "J-Just wait a moment, okay? I need a little bit to get ready..."

lines.content: ああ、わかった。何か手伝えることは？
lines.translated: "Yeah, got it. Is there anything I can help with?"

lines.content: う、ううん。大丈夫。必要な準備は、心のほうだけだから……
lines.translated: "N-No. It's fine. The only preparation I need is for my heart..."

lines.content: 何か逡巡しているような気配を、扉の向こうから僅かに感じた。
lines.translated: From beyond the door, I faintly sensed her hesitating over something.

lines.content: これ、どこも間違ってないよね。大丈夫だよね……。うう。でも、変だったらどうしよう
lines.translated: "There's nothing wrong with this, right? It's fine, right...? Uu. But what do I do if it looks weird?"

lines.content: よく、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't really get it, though...

lines.content: ここは焦らず待っていよう。
lines.translated: Let's just wait patiently for now.

lines.content: 着替えをするだけの余裕はあるだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I even have enough time to change my own clothes?

lines.content: そんな些細なことを計りかねていると、
lines.translated: While I was pondering such trivial things,

lines.content: よ、よし。大丈夫。……大丈夫ってことにしよう。うんっ
lines.translated: "O-Okay. It's fine. ...Let's just say it's fine. Yep!"

lines.content: 何かの決意が固まったみたいだ。
lines.translated: It seemed she had made up her mind about something.

lines.content: どうしてだか俺は扉の前で正座をし、そこが開かれる瞬間を待っていた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I sat down in seiza right in front of the door, waiting for the moment it would open.

lines.content: ……扉が開かれる。恐る恐る、ゆっくりと。
lines.translated: The door opened. Timidly, slowly.

lines.content: そこに見えたハルの姿に、俺は思わず息を呑む。
lines.translated: At the sight of Haru standing there, my breath caught in my throat.

lines.content: 真っ白な衣装に身を包んだハルがいたのだ。
lines.translated: Haru was there, clad in a pure white outfit.

lines.content: 結婚式でその身を飾る花嫁衣装――つまりウエディングドレス姿だった。
lines.translated: Bridal attire meant to adorn oneself at a wedding ceremony--in other words, she was in a wedding dress.

lines.content: あまりのことに無言となってしまった。
lines.translated: It was so overwhelming that I was left speechless.

lines.content: 俺は目を丸くし、[まぶた|瞼]をぱちぱちとさせ。
lines.translated: My eyes went wide, and I blinked my eyelids rapidly.

lines.content: ハルは、真っ赤になっていた頬を、更に赤く染めていく。
lines.translated: Haru's cheeks, which were already bright red, flushed an even deeper crimson.

lines.content: ……あ、あの、ね
lines.translated: "...U-Um, you see."

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 贈り物、だって
lines.translated: "It's a gift, she said."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私たちが町を離れていた間に、少しずつ、作ってくれてたみたいだよ
lines.translated: "While we were away from town, it looks like she was making it for me little by little."

lines.content: 今夜、みんなで食事に行くのに合わせて、準備してくれてたみたいで……
lines.translated: "It seems she got it ready to match us all going out to eat together tonight..."

lines.content: 贈り物……
lines.translated: "A gift..."

lines.content: 少しずつ作ってくれていた。
lines.translated: She had been making it little by little.

lines.content: いったい、誰が……？
lines.translated: "Who on earth...?"

lines.content: え？　誰って。そんなの決まってるよ
lines.translated: "Eh? What do you mean, who? Isn't it obvious?"

lines.content: ……そっか。決まってるのか
lines.translated: "...I see. It's obvious, huh."

lines.content: うん、そうだよ。こんなきれいなの作れるのはあのひとしかいないんだよと、ハルは言う。
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. That person is the only one who could make something this pretty," Haru said.

lines.content: ……似合ってる、かな
lines.translated: "...Does it suit me, I wonder?"

lines.content: ハルは視線を彷徨わせていた。
lines.translated: Haru's gaze wandered nervously.

lines.content: ずっと昔に作ってもらった“魔法少女”服も、着方が複雑で大変だった思い出、あるけど……
lines.translated: "I remember the 'magical girl' outfit she made for me a long time ago was also complicated and really hard to put on, though..."

lines.content: こんな大人の衣装も着るのは大変だねと、ハルは照れくさそうにはにかんでいる。
lines.translated: Haru smiled bashfully, adding that a grown-up outfit like this was tough to put on, too.

lines.content: ひとりで着るのは難しくって
lines.translated: "It was really hard to get into by myself."

lines.content: もちろん、はじめて着るものだから……。だからね、どこか変なところとかあるんじゃないかって、不安で……。そもそも似合ってるかどうかのほうがもっと不安なんだけど
lines.translated: "It's my first time wearing something like this, of course... So I was worried something might look out of place... Though I'm even more worried about whether it actually suits me at all."

lines.content: ううん。変じゃない。似合ってる……、とっても
lines.translated: "No, nothing looks weird. It suits you... so much."

lines.content: 正直にそう応える。
lines.translated: I answered her honestly.

lines.content: 色々な疑問だとかをまずは置き去りにしてしまえるほど、俺には目の前のハルの姿が眩しく見える。
lines.translated: Haru looked so dazzling standing in front of me that all my questions and doubts were completely swept away for the moment.

lines.content: すごくきれいだ
lines.translated: "You look really beautiful."

lines.content: う。あ、……え、えへへ。そう、かな
lines.translated: "Uu. Ah... e-ehehe. Do you think so?"

lines.content: 照れくさそうにする。顔は真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: She acted bashful, her face bright red.

lines.content: もじもじとスカートの前を、手持ちぶさたのように指先でいじってもいた。
lines.translated: Fidgeting restlessly, she toyed with the front of her skirt with her fingertips, as if unsure what to do with her hands.

lines.content: ……曰く。
lines.translated: According to her:

lines.content: 一足先に帰宅したハルは、俺たちの部屋に一通の簡単な手紙と共に、この衣装が置かれていたのに気づいたのだという。
lines.translated: When Haru got home a little ahead of me, she noticed this dress laid out in our room along with a short, simple letter.

lines.content: 俺たちが町を離れている間に少しずつ作り上げてくれていたこと。
lines.translated: It explained how it had been made for her little by little while we were away from town.

lines.content: 今夜、俺がみんなに食事をご馳走したいと言い出したのに合わせ、お披露目するつもりであったこと。
lines.translated: That it was meant to be unveiled tonight, timed with my suggestion to treat everyone to a meal.

lines.content: そして[・|ふ][・|た][・|り][・|と][・|も]急用ができてしまい、出かけなければならなくなったこと。
lines.translated: And that something urgent had come up for *both of them*, forcing them to head out.

lines.content: 帰りは遅くなる。
lines.translated: They would be back late.

lines.content: だからこの衣装だけ置いていく。
lines.translated: So they were leaving just the dress behind.

lines.content: 食事はまた今度。いつか、必ず。
lines.translated: We'll have that meal together another time. Someday, for sure.

lines.content: 手紙にはそういうふうなことが、言葉少なく並んでいたという。
lines.translated: Those were the sorts of things written in the letter, strung together in few words.

lines.content: ハルは俺が帰ってくるまでの間に、少しだけ試着してみようと思っていたら、着るのも脱ぐのもあんまりにも手間取ってしまい……。
lines.translated: Haru had thought she would just try it on quickly before I got back, only to find it took way too much effort both to put on and to take off...

lines.content: そうこうしているうちに俺が帰ってきてしまった。そういう具合なのだという。
lines.translated: And while she was struggling with it, I came home. That was apparently how it happened.

lines.content: 贈り物。
lines.translated: A gift.

lines.content: 今日に合わせて準備してくれていた衣装。
lines.translated: An outfit prepared specifically for today.

lines.content: 急用ができた。帰りは遅くなる。だから、衣装だけ置いていく。
lines.translated: Something urgent came up. They'll be back late. So they're leaving just the dress behind.

lines.content: だから食事は、また今度。
lines.translated: And we'll have that meal together another time.

lines.content: 本当に……？
lines.translated: Really...?

lines.content: 手紙の主は、本当にちゃんと帰ってきてくれるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Will the writer of that letter really come back to us?

lines.content: それ以上を言及するのがなぜだか、怖い。そう感じてしまうけど……。
lines.translated: For some reason, I'm afraid to touch upon it any further. Even though I feel that way...

lines.content: 『あんまり悲しむなよ。さよならなんて、よくあることだ』
lines.translated: "Don't be too sad. Goodbyes happen all the time."

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 『君らの心に“夢”と“希望”が消えずにそっと、在り続けるなら。いつかまた、必ず会えるさ』
lines.translated: "As long as 'dreams' and 'hope' quietly live on in your hearts without fading, I'm sure we'll meet again someday."

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 誰かが俺たちのすぐ近くから、あるいは一番遠いどこかの場所から、微笑んでくれているように感じられた。
lines.translated: It felt as though someone was smiling upon us from right nearby--or perhaps from the farthest place imaginable.

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: 何かが終わったんだなあと、感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that something had come to an end.

lines.content: そして“次”へ進むときなのだ、と。
lines.translated: And that it was time to move on to what came "next."

lines.content: 友人だったり。恋人であったり。家族であっても。
lines.translated: Whether they are friends, lovers, or even family.

lines.content: 俺たちの短い人生において、奇跡的に関わり合えたひと達と永遠に歩んでいけるわけではない。
lines.translated: In our short lives, we cannot walk forever alongside the people we've miraculously crossed paths with.

lines.content: いつか、そのひと達と歩んだ時間とはさよならをして。
lines.translated: Someday, we have to say goodbye to the time we spent walking with them.

lines.content: また次の時間を見つけ、なんとか折り合いを付け、寄り添い合って……。
lines.translated: Then we find our next chapter, come to terms with it somehow, and lean on one another...

lines.content: 俺たちはそういうふうに繰り返し、いくつもの終わりに向かい歩いて行くしかないイキモノだから。
lines.translated: Because we are creatures who can only keep repeating that cycle, walking on toward one ending after another.

lines.content: だからそろそろ俺も“次”に進むときなのだ。
lines.translated: So it's about time for me to move on to what's "next," too.

lines.content: ハル……
lines.translated: "Haru..."

lines.content: いつか……。
lines.translated: Someday...

lines.content: いつか[・|君]と一緒の時間にも、さよならしなければならない日が来るのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if the day will come when I have to say goodbye to my time with *you*, too.

lines.content: でもそれは、今ではないから。
lines.translated: But that day isn't today.

lines.content: だからもう一度、誓おう。
lines.translated: So let's make a vow once more.

lines.content: ……俺もだ
lines.translated: "...Me too."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺も、少しずつ準備していたものがあるんだよ。ハル
lines.translated: "There's something I've been preparing little by little, too, Haru."

lines.content: 立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood up.

lines.content: そして、用意していたものを俺は取り出す。
lines.translated: With that, I took out what I had gotten ready.

lines.content: ごめん。安いもので、悪いけど……。今はこれくらいが精一杯だった
lines.translated: "Sorry. I feel bad that it's something cheap, but... this was the best I could do right now."

lines.content: 大雅くん……、それって
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun... is that..."

lines.content: あ、ああ。指輪、だね
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. It's a ring."

lines.content: ちょっと照れくさくなり、視線を外してしまう。
lines.translated: Feeling a bit sheepish, I averted my gaze.

lines.content: ……そのドレス
lines.translated: "...That dress."

lines.content: え？　ドレス？
lines.translated: "Huh? The dress?"

lines.content: ああ。そのドレスはさ、俺たちのために、数年掛けて少しずつ作られたものらしいけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. It seems that dress was made for us little by little over the course of several years, right...?"

lines.content: うん……。すごいよね。手作りなんて信じられない
lines.translated: "Yeah... It's amazing, isn't it? I can't believe it's handmade."

lines.content: ああ、そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really did."

lines.content: でも……この指輪も、学生時代から、ハルに隠れてこっそりバイトして貯めてたお金で買ったんだ。家庭教師とか。色々
lines.translated: "Well... I bought this ring with money I've been secretly saving up from part-time jobs behind your back since my student days, too. Tutoring, and all sorts of things."

lines.content: ……そう、だったんだ
lines.translated: "...So that's what that was."

lines.content: ハルは微笑む。
lines.translated: Haru smiled.

lines.content: いつも決まった日に帰りが遅くて、何してるのかなあって不安になっちゃって。聞いても全然教えてくれないし。だから少しだけ、けんかしちゃったこともあったけど……
lines.translated: "You always came home late on specific days, and I got anxious wondering what you were up to. You wouldn't tell me anything even when I asked. We even had a little fight over it once..."

lines.content: ああ、そうだね。そんなすれ違いもあったよね
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. We did have a misunderstanding like that, didn't we?"

lines.content: ……もう。ちゃんと言ってくれなきゃわからないよ。いっぱい心配しちゃったんだからね
lines.translated: "...Geez. I won't know unless you tell me properly. You made me worry so much, you know."

lines.content: 浮気は、してないよ？　これからだって、もちろんしないよ？
lines.translated: "I wasn't cheating on you, okay? And I obviously never will in the future, either."

lines.content: わかってる。……違うもん。そういうことが言いたいんじゃなくって
lines.translated: "I know that. ...That's not it. That's not what I'm trying to say."

lines.content: ハルは『もう、全然わかってくれないんだから』と、頬を膨らませ……。
lines.translated: Haru puffed out her cheeks as if to say, "Geez, you don't get it at all..."

lines.content: 俺たちは、小さく笑い合う。
lines.translated: And the two of us shared a quiet laugh.

lines.content: 本当は……
lines.translated: "To tell the truth..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 本当はね、俺たちを大切に想ってくれるたくさんのひと達の前で、ハルに指輪を渡したかったけど……
lines.translated: "To tell the truth, I wanted to give you this ring in front of all the people who care so deeply about us, Haru..."

lines.content: そのひと達に祝福してもらいたくて、今夜まで渡さずいたものだけれど……。
lines.translated: I had held onto it until tonight because I wanted us to receive their blessings, but...

lines.content: 『私と結婚、してくれますか……？』
lines.translated: "Will you... marry me...?"

lines.content: ハルが俺に伝えてくれた言葉と想いだ。
lines.translated: Those were the words and feelings Haru had once conveyed to me.

lines.content: その言葉に俺は今日まではっきりとは応えてこなかった――まだまだ子どもだったからだ。ただの口先だけの想いになりかねなかったからだ。
lines.translated: Until today, I hadn't given her a clear answer to those words--because I was still just a kid. Because my feelings easily could have ended up as nothing more than empty words.

lines.content: だからちゃんと自分の“夢”を叶え、大人になって、君を守れる自分になれたと思えるまでは……。
lines.translated: So until I could properly fulfill my own "dream," grow into an adult, and feel like someone capable of protecting her...

lines.content: そんなふうに、自分自身に誓いを立てていた。
lines.translated: That was the vow I had made to myself.

lines.content: もう、大丈夫だろう。
lines.translated: It should be okay now.

lines.content: 俺は大人になれた。
lines.translated: I've become an adult.

lines.content: たぶん子ども時代の自分にだって、恥じることのない自分になれているはずだ。いや。これからそうなっていくはずなんだ。
lines.translated: I think I've become someone my childhood self wouldn't be ashamed of. No--that's who I'm going to keep becoming from here on out.

lines.content: だから今度は俺から、君に伝えたいんだ
lines.translated: "So this time, I want to be the one to say it to you."

lines.content: ハルの前に片膝をつく。
lines.translated: I dropped to one knee in front of Haru.

lines.content: 君のことを……。ハル。君だけのことを、生涯愛し続けると誓います
lines.translated: "I vow to love you... Haru. To keep loving only you for the rest of my life."

lines.content: そうして俺は、まるで古い外国のヒーローみたいに、ハルの手を取る。
lines.translated: And then, just like the hero of some old foreign movie, I took Haru's hand.

lines.content: ……俺と、結婚してくれますか
lines.translated: "...Will you marry me?"

lines.content: 真っ直ぐにハルを見つめ、そう言った。
lines.translated: Looking straight into Haru's eyes, I said the words.

lines.content: ハルは微笑んだまま、
lines.translated: Still smiling, Haru...

lines.content: はい……
お願いしますと言って、うなずいてくれる。
lines.translated: nodded and said, "Yes, please."

lines.content: 私も……。大雅くん。私もあなたのことを、あなたひとりだけのことを生涯愛すると、誓います
lines.translated: "I vow, too... Taiga-kun. I vow to love you, and only you, for the rest of my life."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 微笑みかけて、俺は応える。
lines.translated: Smiling back at her, I replied.

lines.content: うん。知ってるよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know."

lines.content: なに、それ
lines.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: 俺たちは笑った。
lines.translated: We both laughed.

lines.content: ……なぜだろう。
lines.translated: Why was it, I wonder?

lines.content: 声は聞こえない。姿も見えない。きっと、触れられもしないけど……。
lines.translated: I couldn't hear their voices. I couldn't see their faces. And I surely couldn't touch them, either...

lines.content: でも、不思議だ。
lines.translated: Yet, it was strange.

lines.content: 今、ここに、俺たちのことをたくさん、たくさんの笑顔が包んでくれているように、思えて……。
lines.translated: Right here, right now, it felt as though so, so many smiles were wrapping gently around us...

lines.content: そんなたくさんの“想い”が、いつまでも、俺たちの人生を大切に見守ってくれているのだと、信じて……。
lines.translated: Believing that all of those warm feelings would forever watch over our lives...

lines.content: 俺は、ハルの薬指に指輪をはめた。
lines.translated: I slipped the ring onto Haru's ring finger.

lines.content: ほんの微かな鈴の音が確かに聞こえた。
lines.translated: I was certain I heard the faint chime of a bell.

lines.content: ここから先は、ふたり一緒の最高の人生が待っている。
lines.translated: From here on out, the greatest life imaginable awaits the two of us together.

lines.content: そんな予感ばかりが花咲き、止むことはなかった。
lines.translated: Premonitions of that happiness bloomed endlessly in my heart, never to fade.

lines.content: じゃあ先輩。試しにオーダーを取ってきてもらってもいいですか
lines.translated: "Alright, Senpai. Would you mind trying to take an order for practice?"

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき、差し出された伝票を受け取った。
lines.translated: I nodded and took the order slip she held out to me.

lines.content: その伝票を。
lines.translated: That order slip.

lines.content: 真っ白なその紙面を、じっと見つめる。
lines.translated: I stared intently at the blank white paper.

lines.content: 先輩？
lines.translated: "Senpai?"

lines.content: 千和が俺の顔をのぞき込み、
lines.translated: Chiwa peered into my face,

lines.content: 大丈夫ですか？　やっぱり、もう少し練習してからのほうが……
lines.translated: "Are you okay? Maybe we should practice a little more first..."

lines.content: いや、ううん。だいじょーぶ
lines.translated: "No, uh-uh. I'm fine."

lines.content: こくこくとうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded repeatedly.

lines.content: さすがにこれくらいのこと……注文を取ってくるくらいのこと、平気でできなきゃさすがにまずい。笑われちゃうって
lines.translated: "Seriously, if I can't even manage something as simple as taking an order, I'm in real trouble. Everyone will laugh at me."

lines.content: 別に私は笑いませんよ
lines.translated: "I won't laugh at you."

lines.content: 小首をかしげるように千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: 誰にだって得意とか不得意とかあるって思いますもん
lines.translated: "I think everyone has things they're good at and things they're not."

lines.content: い、いや、……うん。ありがとう。千和はそう言ってくれるだろうけど……
lines.translated: "W-Well... yeah. Thanks. I know you'd say that, Chiwa, but..."

lines.content: 大雅！
lines.translated: "Taiga!"

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: 早く！
lines.translated: "Hurry up!"

lines.content: わいわいがやがやと学園の生徒たちで賑わった放課後の喫茶ブルームーン。そのテーブルのひとつは見知ったメンバーに占拠されていて、
lines.translated: Cafe Blue Moon was bustling with students after school. One of the tables was occupied by some very familiar faces.

lines.content: 早く、ご注文を！
lines.translated: "Take our order already!"

lines.content: ぱんぱんと。
lines.translated: Bam, bam.

lines.content: でないと私の中の怪獣が暴れ出しちゃう五秒前って感じだよ！
lines.translated: "Otherwise, the monster inside me is five seconds away from going on a rampage!"

lines.content: お腹をすかせた小さな怪獣が、両手でテーブルを叩いて『早く早く！　じゃないと地球滅亡の危機！』と焦れていた。
lines.translated: A starving little monster was pounding both hands on the table, impatiently demanding I hurry up before the Earth faced total destruction.

lines.content: ……じゃ、行ってくる。怪獣に食べられてしまわないよう祈ってて
lines.translated: "...Alright, I'm going. Pray I don't get eaten by the monster."

lines.content: わかりました。がんばってください
lines.translated: "Understood. Good luck."

lines.content: ぐっと拳を握り混み、俺にうなずいて見せるウエイトレス姿の千和だ。
lines.translated: Dressed in her waitress uniform, Chiwa balled her fists tightly and gave me an encouraging nod.

lines.content: あ、先輩。ちょっと待ってください
lines.translated: "Oh, Senpai. Wait just a second."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 一歩踏み出しかけた俺は振り返る。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to take a step forward, I looked back.

lines.content: ネクタイ、曲がってますよ
lines.translated: "Your tie is crooked."

lines.content: あ、ああー
lines.translated: "Oh, right..."

lines.content: 確かにちょっと歪んでる。
lines.translated: Sure enough, it was a little askew.

lines.content: こういうの苦手なんだよなあ。俺、将来は会社勤めとかしなくてもいい職種を選ばないとだ
lines.translated: "I'm terrible at this kind of thing. I'm gonna have to pick a career in the future where I don't have to work at an office."

lines.content: 締め直そうとする。
lines.translated: I tried to retie it.

lines.content: だけど……、おかしいな。
lines.translated: But... huh, that's weird.

lines.content: あれ。うーん。元から苦手だけど、急いでるとますますこんがらがって……まあいいか
lines.translated: "Huh? Hmm. I'm bad at this to begin with, and rushing is just getting it more tangled up... Ah, whatever, good enough."

lines.content: もう。よくありません。身だしなみくらいしっかりしてください。先輩。接客業なんですから。それに、せっかく……
lines.translated: "Honestly. It is not good enough. Please take proper care of your appearance, Senpai. You're working in customer service. Besides, after we finally..."

lines.content: せっかく？
lines.translated: "After we finally?"

lines.content: え？　私、何か言いましたっけ
lines.translated: "Huh? Did I say something?"

lines.content: と、何でもないように言いつつも。
lines.translated: She played it off like it was nothing.

lines.content: 一瞬、視線を泳がせていた。少し赤くもあった。そんな様子をいちいちめざとく見逃せない俺である。
lines.translated: For a split second, her eyes darted away, and she blushed slightly. Naturally, I was too sharp to miss a reaction like that.

lines.content: しかし……何か追求してはいけないことなのかもしれない。忘れよう。
lines.translated: Still... maybe it was something I shouldn't pry into. Best to forget about it.

lines.content: 得意なことも、苦手なことも、誰にだってあるって思いますけど……でも
lines.translated: "I do think everyone has their strengths and weaknesses... However,"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 先輩。ネクタイ締めるのが不得意だからって、職業を限定しないでくださいよ。それだったら私のお店でも長く働けないじゃないですか
lines.translated: "Senpai, please don't limit your career options just because you're bad at tying a necktie. If you do that, you won't be able to work at my cafe for very long either."

lines.content: ……言いながら。
lines.translated: As she spoke,

lines.content: 千和が俺の制服のネクタイを慣れた手つきで締め直してくれる――……制服。学園のものではない。千和のお店。喫茶ブルームーンの制服だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa deftly retied the necktie of my uniform--not my school uniform, but the uniform for Chiwa's shop, Cafe Blue Moon.

lines.content: 今日の放課後から俺は千和のお店で働くことにした。
lines.translated: Starting today after school, I had decided to work at Chiwa's cafe.

lines.content: お小遣いはあさひさんからもらっている。
lines.translated: I was already getting an allowance from Asahi-san.

lines.content: だから経済的な不足を覚えてのことではない。
lines.translated: So I wasn't doing this because I was strapped for cash.

lines.content: ――“関係性”こそが“鍵”となる。
lines.translated: --"Relationships" are the "key."

lines.content: あさひさんはそう言っていた。
lines.translated: That was what Asahi-san had told me.

lines.content: “鍵”とは[・|彼][・|女][・|た][・|ち]の“最後の魔法”がしまわれている[箱|心]を開くためのものである。
lines.translated: A "key" to unlock the boxes--the hearts--where the girls' "final magic" was kept.

lines.content: 少し恥ずかしい“夢”でも真剣に語り合える関係に。
lines.translated: To build a relationship where we could seriously talk about even our slightly embarrassing "dreams."

lines.content: そのような信頼ある関係性に至れてこそ――俺は、“魔法少女『使い』”であるこの俺は、“[彼女|魔法]”たちの“魔法”を“太陽”の下でも使えるようになる。
lines.translated: Only by reaching such a trusting relationship would I--as a "Magical Girl 'User'"--be able to wield their "magic" even beneath the "sun."

lines.content: あさひさんにはそうできなかった。そこまでの“関係性”を、みんなと結ぶことができなかった。
lines.translated: Asahi-san hadn't been able to do that. She hadn't been able to forge that kind of "relationship" with everyone.

lines.content: なぜなら、“夜のイキモノ”である自分には、人間の心というものを充分に理解はできなかったからだと、あさひさん本人はそう言っていた。
lines.translated: According to Asahi-san herself, that was because, as a "Creature of the Night," she couldn't fully understand the human heart.

lines.content: だからこそこの俺に、その“役割”を譲ったのだ。杏藤千和。
lines.translated: And that was precisely why she had passed that "role" on to me. Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: 俺の幼馴染み。
lines.translated: My childhood friend.

lines.content: かわいい後輩。
lines.translated: My cute underclassman.

lines.content: ……それだけでは、足りない。
lines.translated: Just being that wasn't enough.

lines.content: 今、俺の持っている“[関係性|鍵]”では、その施錠を解くことができない――
lines.translated: With the "key"--the relationship--I currently held, I couldn't unlock her heart--

lines.content: （……だからこうして、千和のお店で働くことで、千和との時間をこれまで以上に増やしていければ）
lines.translated: (...So by working at Chiwa's shop like this, I'm hoping to spend even more time with her than before.)

lines.content: 幼馴染み以上の何かに。
lines.translated: To become something more than childhood friends.

lines.content: 親友よりも近しい何かに。
lines.translated: Something closer than best friends.

lines.content: 互いが互いの夢を、人生を、応援し合えるような、特別な関係になれれば――俺は千和の中に眠る“最後の魔法”を引き出せるのかもしれない。
lines.translated: If we could build a special relationship where we supported each other's dreams and lives--then maybe I could draw out the "final magic" sleeping inside Chiwa.

lines.content: そうして、かつて“特別な少女”であった千和の“夢”を叶えることができる……かも、しれない。
lines.translated: And by doing so, maybe... just maybe, I could grant the "dream" of Chiwa, who had once been a "special girl."

lines.content: 千和のお店で働こうと考えた動機は、ある種不純なものとも言えるから……。
lines.translated: In a sense, you could say my motive for wanting to work at Chiwa's cafe was somewhat impure...

lines.content: ……うん。こんな感じかな
lines.translated: "...There. That should do it."

lines.content: 千和がネクタイを締めてくれている。身体を密着させて。
lines.translated: Chiwa finished tying my necktie, her body pressed close to mine.

lines.content: 小さなちいさなその姿を見下ろしながら、俺は……。
lines.translated: Looking down at her tiny, petite figure, I...

lines.content: （なんだか千和のことを騙してるように、思えなくもないから……）
lines.translated: (I can't help feeling like I'm deceiving her a little...)

lines.content: 少し、申し訳ないような。
lines.translated: I felt a little apologetic.

lines.content: 少し、後ろめたいような。
lines.translated: A little guilty, even.

lines.content: しかしだからこそ、だ。
lines.translated: But that was all the more reason to see it through.

lines.content: おそらくは十年前……。
lines.translated: It was probably ten years ago...

lines.content: もう既に、とっくに諦めてしまったのだろうその“夢”を、俺が叶えてあげられればいい。あさひさんの代わりに。
lines.translated: She had likely given up on that "dream" long ago, so I wanted to be the one to make it come true for her. In Asahi-san's stead.

lines.content: 先輩？　どうか、しましたか……？
lines.translated: "Senpai? Is something the matter...?"

lines.content: え、あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Huh? Oh, yeah."

lines.content: 我に返る。
lines.translated: I snapped back to reality.

lines.content: 長々とこれまでとこれからのことを考えていた。
lines.translated: I had gotten lost in thought, dwelling on the past and the future.

lines.content: 気づくと、俺の胸元により近い場所から見上げる千和と、視線が合ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was locking eyes with Chiwa, who was looking up at me from right against my chest.

lines.content: 苦笑い……。
lines.translated: I gave a wry smile...

lines.content: そして、『何でもないよ』と俺は言う。
lines.translated: And told her, "It's nothing."

lines.content: そ、それじゃあ、行ってくる。ネクタイありがとう。助かった
lines.translated: "W-Well then, I'm heading over. Thanks for the tie. You saved me."

lines.content: はい。がんばってくださいね。先輩
lines.translated: "Yes. Do your best out there, Senpai."

lines.content: 千和はそう言い、また……グッと。両手を胸の前で握りしめて見せる。そして別のテーブルに呼ばれ、注文を取りに行った。
lines.translated: Saying that, Chiwa balled both hands tightly in front of her chest again. Then, called over by another table, she went off to take their order.

lines.content: ……俺も怪獣のいるところへ、向かった。
lines.translated: And I headed over to where the monster was waiting.

lines.content: 大雅。遅いぞ
lines.translated: "Taiga. You're slow."

lines.content: ……おい。何やってるんだ、君たち
lines.translated: "...Hey. What are you guys doing?"

lines.content: ひゃいががおほいから、ごびょうひゃっちゃったはら
lines.translated: "Becauh Taiga wath thlow, five thecondth pathed."

lines.content: んんん？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "Huuuh? What did you say?"

lines.content: 大雅が遅いから。五秒たっちゃったから――と、怪獣は申しております
lines.translated: "'Because Taiga was slow, five seconds passed'--so says the monster."

lines.content: がじがじと。
lines.translated: Nom, nom.

lines.content: 姫織に右腕を[かじ|囓]られながら智仁は言った。真顔で。
lines.translated: Tomohito translated with a completely straight face while Himeori gnawed on his right arm.

lines.content: ……痛くないのか、それ
lines.translated: "...Doesn't that hurt?"

lines.content: 痛い。すっげえ
lines.translated: "It hurts. Like hell."

lines.content: でも、ひよちゃんの食事を邪魔しちゃだめだろ。男として
lines.translated: "But as a man, I can't very well interrupt Hiyo-chan's meal, can I?"

lines.content: いや。よくわかんない矜持だが……
lines.translated: "Yeah, I don't really get your sense of pride, man..."

lines.content: しかし、なるほど。
lines.translated: Still, I see how it is.

lines.content: ひとりで人類の危機を食い止めてくれていたわけだな……ご苦労だった。我が友よ。さあ、ひよこなサイズの怪獣よ。何が食べたいのかな。言ってみよ
lines.translated: "So you were single-handedly averting a crisis for humanity, huh... Good work, my friend. Now then, o chick-sized monster. What would you like to eat? Speak."

lines.content: この奏大雅くんが華麗にご注文を承ろうじゃあないか。
lines.translated: Allow me, Kanade Taiga-kun, to magnificently take your order.

lines.content: そう言って、俺は伝票とペンを取り出す。
lines.translated: With a flourish, I pulled out my order pad and pen.

lines.content: ……がちゃり。
lines.translated: Clatter.

lines.content: 落とした。
lines.translated: I dropped them.

lines.content: その手は若干、震えているのだ。
lines.translated: My hands were trembling ever so slightly.

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: ひゃにごと？
lines.translated: "Whah happened?"

lines.content: 何事？　と、怪獣は申されている
lines.translated: "'What happened?' so asks the monster."

lines.content: 大雅くん。もしかして……緊張してる？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. Are you... nervous, by any chance?"

lines.content: ハルが落とした伝票とペンを拾ってくれた。
lines.translated: Haru picked up the dropped order pad and pen for me.

lines.content: ふふ。ハルちゃん。何を言うのかな。この俺がウエイターごときで緊張など――……
lines.translated: "Heh heh. What are you talking about, Haru-chan? As if someone like me would get nervous over waiting tables--"

lines.content: 正直、していた。緊張していた。ばりばり、していた。
lines.translated: To be honest, I was. I was nervous. Super nervous.

lines.content: ……俺、はじめて知った。
lines.translated: I had just learned something for the very first time.

lines.content: 自分が結構な緊張しいだということを。
lines.translated: The fact that I'm actually a pretty nervous person.

lines.content: 千和のお店でバイトさせてほしいと言い出し、こうして現場に立つまでは――まるで、全然、知らなかった事実である。
lines.translated: Until I asked to work part-time at Chiwa's shop and actually stood out here on the floor--it was a fact I had been completely, utterly unaware of.

lines.content: まったくの他人に話しかけ、あまつさえ、笑いかけさえもして――注文を取る。
lines.translated: Talking to complete strangers, even smiling at them--and taking their orders.

lines.content: たったそれだけといえばそれだけなのだが、どきどき、どきどき、緊張が止まらないのだ……いや。
lines.translated: If you say that's all there is to it, well, it is, but my heart was pounding away and the nerves just wouldn't stop... No, wait.

lines.content: 今は他人なんかではなく、幼馴染みに話しかけているだけなのに。
lines.translated: Right now I wasn't even talking to strangers, just my childhood friends.

lines.content: お店の制服を着ているからだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe it was because I was wearing the shop's uniform.

lines.content: 緊張で、手さえも震える。
lines.translated: Even my hands were trembling with nerves.

lines.content: もう。あんまり先輩をいじめないでくださいね
lines.translated: "Jeez. Please don't tease Senpai too much."

lines.content: 千和が様子を見に来てくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa had come over to check on me.

lines.content: この意地悪な先輩は、いつも私にばっかり意地悪なのに……こう見えて結構繊細なんですから
lines.translated: "This meanie of a senpai is always picking on me... yet despite how he looks, he's actually pretty delicate."

lines.content: そ、そんなことは
lines.translated: "Th-That's..."

lines.content: ない。
lines.translated: Not true.

lines.content: はず。
lines.translated: Probably.

lines.content: 別にいじめてないよー。ただ早くご注文を受け付けてくれないと、もっと、いっぱい、私の中の怪獣が暴れちゃうってだけで……
lines.translated: "We're not teasing him! It's just that if he doesn't take our orders soon, the monster inside me is gonna go on a huge rampage..."

lines.content: むしろいじめられてるのはこっちなんじゃないかな。と姫織。
lines.translated: "If anything, I think I'm the one being teased here," said Himeori.

lines.content: お腹ぺこぺこでずっとステイ状態なんだよ。しかも、こんなにこんなに、美味しそうなメニューと香りがいっぱいなところで……
lines.translated: "I'm starving, and I've been stuck on 'stay' this whole time! And in a place filled with so many delicious-looking dishes and amazing smells, too..."

lines.content: 恨めしそうに辺りのテーブルを見回す。
lines.translated: She looked around at the surrounding tables resentfully.

lines.content: ほかほか美味しそうな料理やコーヒー。そしてデザート。
lines.translated: Steaming hot, delicious-looking food and coffee. Plus desserts.

lines.content: 笑顔だ。わいわい。がやがや。楽しそうな声でフロアは満たされている。
lines.translated: Smiles everywhere. Chatter and lively conversation filled the floor with joyful voices.

lines.content: 確かに食いしん坊が放り込まれてしまって平静でいられるような環境ではなさそうだ。
lines.translated: It certainly didn't seem like an environment where a glutton could be tossed in and expected to stay calm.

lines.content: まあ、そうだね。私もちょっとお腹すいちゃったかも。今日は体育とかでいっぱい身体動かしたせいかなあ
lines.translated: "Well, that's true. I might be getting a little hungry myself. Maybe it's because we moved around so much in PE today."

lines.content: 俺もだ。奇遇だなあハルちゃん。身体を動かすとお腹が減るよな
lines.translated: "Me too. What a coincidence, Haru-chan. Moving your body really works up an appetite, huh?"

lines.content: お昼もちょっと食べ足りない気がしてたんだ。うん。お腹が減ってしまうのはしかたがない
lines.translated: "I felt like lunch wasn't quite enough today, either. Yeah. Can't be helped that I'm hungry."

lines.content: お前は“この俺を支配できるのは音楽だけだ”とかなんとかスカしたこと言って、体育には参加してなかったけどな。サボりだ
lines.translated: "You dropped some pretentious line like 'Only music can rule over me' and didn't even participate in PE, though. You totally skipped."

lines.content: そういえばお前、あの時間はどこに行ってたんだよ、と俺は問う。
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, where did you even go during that period?" I asked.

lines.content: いつだって音楽と自由と革命はセットだろう。つまりはそういうことだ
lines.translated: "Music, freedom, and revolution always come as a set, right? In short, that's how it is."

lines.content: 何言ってんだこいつ
lines.translated: "What is this guy even talking about?"

lines.content: なあ、大雅。体育が人より成績良かったからと言って、将来、人の心を打つような音楽が編めるのかよ
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. Just because you get better grades in PE than other people, does that mean you'll be able to compose music that touches people's hearts in the future?"

lines.content: 知ったことか
lines.translated: "How should I know?"

lines.content: だろ？
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: 何を、得意げに
lines.translated: "Why do you look so smug?"

lines.content: もうー……っ、そ　ん　な　の　い　い　か　ら　！　もう！
lines.translated: "Jeez... E-N-O-U-G-H O-F T-H-A-T! Come on!"

lines.content: 姫織。両手を振り乱す。
lines.translated: Himeori flailed both arms around wildly.

lines.content: 早くっ、とにかく……早くしてくれないとっ、ふたりまとめて丸呑みだよ……！　がうううううう！
lines.translated: "Hurry, just... if you don't hurry up, I'm gonna swallow you both whole...! Graaaawr!"

lines.content: 殺意を感じた。
lines.translated: I sensed murderous intent.

lines.content: このままでは本気で怪獣に丸呑みにされそうだ。
lines.translated: At this rate, we really might get swallowed whole by the monster.

lines.content: すぅ……はぁ
lines.translated: "Inhale... Exhale."

lines.content: 深呼吸――大丈夫。俺ならできる。
lines.translated: Deep breath--it's fine. I can do this.

lines.content: 注文を受け付けた。
lines.translated: I took their orders.

lines.content: ハル。今日のサービスコーヒーセット（ブレンドコーヒーとミニサラダとバニラアイス）。
lines.translated: Haru: Today's special coffee set (blend coffee, mini salad, and vanilla ice cream).

lines.content: 智仁。ラーメンセット（たわけが。そんなもの喫茶店にあるわけが……あったし。餃子も。チャーハンも。そういえば軽食もあるみたいなこと言ってたか）。
lines.translated: Tomohito: Ramen set (You fool. As if a coffee shop would have something like... Oh, they do. Gyoza, too. And fried rice. Come to think of it, didn't they mention having light meals?).

lines.content: 姫織。ラーメンセット大盛りとオムライスとミートソースパスタとコロッケふたつとデザートは季節のいろどり果物パフェ等など（全部大盛り）。
lines.translated: Himeori: Large ramen set, omurice, meat sauce pasta, two croquettes, and for dessert, the colorful seasonal fruit parfait, etc., etc. (all large sizes).

lines.content: ひよちゃん。それ、誰が代金払うのかな
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan. Who might be paying the bill for all that?"

lines.content: 大雅のお給金で……
lines.translated: "With Taiga's paycheck..."

lines.content: 却下
lines.translated: "Rejected."

lines.content: ぶぅ……っ
だが、ふむ。そうだな。注文遅れてしまったことのお詫びだ。何か一品くらいはごちそうしよう
lines.translated: "However, hmm. Let's see. As an apology for being late with taking your orders, I'll treat you to at least one item."

lines.content: マッジ……！？
lines.translated: "For reeeal...!?"

lines.content: おう。マジだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. For real."

lines.content: まあ、そうなれば姫織だけにではなく、
lines.translated: Well, if I'm doing that, I can't just do it for Himeori.

lines.content: ハルにも、智仁にも
lines.translated: "For Haru and Tomohito, too."

lines.content: す、すごい
lines.translated: "W-Wow!"

lines.content: だろうともさ
lines.translated: "You know it."

lines.content: 大雅……！
lines.translated: "Taiga...!"

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: かっこいいよ大雅くん……っ
lines.translated: "You're so cool, Taiga-kun...!"

lines.content: お、おう
lines.translated: "R-Right."

lines.content: 男前だぜ大雅！
lines.translated: "What a man, Taiga!"

lines.content: ……だろうとも
lines.translated: "...Damn straight."

lines.content: 大雅！　格好いい！　すっごい、いっぱい！　男前！
lines.translated: "Taiga! So cool! Super, duper! Manly!"

lines.content: ああ、ああ、そうだとも。わかってるさ
lines.translated: "Yeah, yeah, that's right. I know."

lines.content: ……うなずきながらもちょっと鬱陶しくもなってきた。なんだこのノリ。
lines.translated: Even as I nodded along, it was starting to get a little annoying. What is this vibe?

lines.content: だけどまあ、おかげで今日のところはなんとかがんばれるかも。
lines.translated: Still, thanks to them, I might be able to pull through for today somehow.

lines.content: そんなよくわからない安心を得ていると、
lines.translated: Just as I was feeling that inexplicable sense of relief...

lines.content: 先輩。ふざけてないでちゃんとお仕事してください
lines.translated: "Senpai. Please stop fooling around and do your job properly."

lines.content: 千和がため息交じりでそう言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa said with a sigh mixed into her voice.

lines.content: じゃないと今日の分の先輩のお給料はなしにしてって、お父さんに告げ口しちゃいますからね
lines.translated: "Otherwise, I'll tattle to my dad and tell him to dock your pay for today."

lines.content: う。お給金なし。それってつまり、三人へのおごりが、そのままダイレクトにお財布を直撃するってことなのか……
lines.translated: "Ugh. No pay. Wait, doesn't that mean treating the three of them will deal a direct hit straight to my wallet...?"

lines.content: 働かないと。まじめに。しっかり。
lines.translated: I have to work. Seriously. Properly.

lines.content: ほら、先輩。一緒にあっちのテーブルの注文、取りに行きましょう。さっきから呼ばれてますよ
lines.translated: "Come on, Senpai. Let's go take that table's order together. They've been calling for a while now."

lines.content: 一緒に？
lines.translated: "Together?"

lines.content: 一緒に、です
lines.translated: "Together."

lines.content: いや、俺、がんばるよ？　ひとりは確かに緊張するけど。でも、注文くらいはなんとか……
lines.translated: "No, I'll do my best, okay? Doing it alone is definitely nerve-wracking, sure. But I can at least manage taking an order..."

lines.content: ふたりで行きましょう。まだ先輩には教えなきゃいけないお仕事もあるんです。だから、ほら、早く
lines.translated: "Let's go together. There are still things about the job I need to teach you, Senpai. So come on, hurry."

lines.content: あ、う、うん
lines.translated: "Ah, y-yeah."

lines.content: 千和が俺の手を取る。
lines.translated: Chiwa took my hand.

lines.content: そしてみんなのテーブルから離れようかとしたところで、
lines.translated: And just as we were about to leave everyone's table,

lines.content: あ、千和ちゃん。もうひとつだけ注文があるんだけど……
lines.translated: "Ah, Chiwa-chan. I have just one more order to make..."

lines.content: ハルが俺たちを引き留めた。
lines.translated: Haru stopped us.

lines.content: そうなのか？　だったら千和じゃなくてこの俺が承ろう。ここのテーブルの担当は俺なので
lines.translated: "You do? Then let me take it instead of Chiwa. Since I'm in charge of this table."

lines.content: ううん。大雅くんじゃダメかもしれなくて……
lines.translated: "No, I don't think you'll do for this one, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: え？　何で？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why?"

lines.content: 女の子同士の秘密のご注文だよ
lines.translated: "It's a secret order just between girls."

lines.content: 何、それ
lines.translated: "What's that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: 今から女の子限定のお話をしようかなって。男子禁制な感じで
lines.translated: "I was thinking of having a girls-only chat right now. A no-boys-allowed kind of thing."

lines.content: そうか。鈍い俺で申し訳ない。
lines.translated: I see. Sorry for being so dense.

lines.content: しかしそれなら……、
lines.translated: Wait, if that's the case...

lines.content: ……智仁は、いいの？
lines.translated: "...Is it okay for Tomohito to be here?"

lines.content: 知らなかったのか大雅。音楽はな、男だろうが女だろうが関係なく、誰にだって理解できるから、言語よりも奥深いんだぜ
lines.translated: "Didn't you know, Taiga? Music can be understood by anyone, regardless of whether they're a man or a woman, which makes it much deeper than language."

lines.content: だから意味わかんねえんだって
lines.translated: "Like I said, you're making zero sense."

lines.content: あ、ほら、呼ばれてるよ大雅くん。別のテーブルから
lines.translated: "Ah, look, someone's calling for you, Taiga-kun. From another table."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 言われるままにテーブルを離れる。
lines.translated: I left the table as I was told.

lines.content: ……なんだろう。いやな予感だ。
lines.translated: What is it? I have a bad feeling about this.

lines.content: ちらりと振り返ってみた。
lines.translated: I cast a quick glance back.

lines.content: 女の子たちだけで（ひとり図体のでっかい例外が紛れているが）何かを話している。
lines.translated: Just the girls (though one massive exception was mixed in) were talking about something.

lines.content: 千和が驚き。ハルがうなずく。姫織はべったりテーブルに突っ伏している。智仁は目を瞬いている。何、話してるのかな……気になる。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked surprised. Haru nodded. Himeori was slumped completely flat across the table. Tomohito was blinking in surprise. What could they be talking about...? Now I'm curious.

lines.content: 非常に、気になるが……。
lines.translated: Extremely curious, even...

lines.content: ドアベルの音。
lines.translated: The sound of the door chime.

lines.content: お店の扉が開かれる。
lines.translated: The shop door opened.

lines.content: 腹を空かせた生徒たちが雪崩れ込んできた。
lines.translated: A wave of hungry students came pouring in.

lines.content: いらっしゃいませ。喫茶ブルームーンへようこそ
lines.translated: "Welcome. Welcome to Cafe Blue Moon."

lines.content: 本日のピークが訪れた。
lines.translated: Today's peak rush had arrived.

lines.content: 懸命に働いて、
lines.translated: Working as hard as I could,

lines.content: 緊張にも慣れ始め、
lines.translated: starting to get used to the nerves,

lines.content: 仕事もなんとか覚えられ、
lines.translated: managing to learn the ropes somehow,

lines.content: 時間は、あっという間に過ぎていく。
lines.translated: time flew by in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: アルバイト初日はなんとか終わり……。
lines.translated: My first day at my part-time job came to an end somehow...

lines.content: 先輩。今日はありがとうございました。お疲れさまでした。もしこれで懲りたりしてなかったら……明日もまた、よろしくお願いします
lines.translated: "Senpai. Thank you very much for today. Good work out there. If this hasn't put you off... I look forward to working with you again tomorrow."

lines.content: 千和に見送られ、この日はそのまま帰宅した。
lines.translated: Seen off by Chiwa, I headed straight home for the day.

lines.content: あさひさんの『おかえり』と、『……大雅、おかえり。今日はちょっと遅かったんだね』と、暇を持て余していた十夜に迎えられ……。
lines.translated: Greeted by Asahi-san's "Welcome home," and "...Welcome home, Taiga. You're a little late today," from Toya, who had been at a loss for how to pass the time...

lines.content: ……大雅。今日はどんな一日だった？
lines.translated: "...Taiga. How was your day today?"

lines.content: 耳朶を撫でるその声に、俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。
lines.translated: At the voice caressing my ears, I opened my eyes.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ][・|に][・|は][・|い][・|な][・|い]君の姿を、出来るだけ正確に思い浮かべようとする。
lines.translated: I tried to picture her face as accurately as I could -- the girl who wasn't here right now.

lines.content: 今日は……
lines.translated: "Today is..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 今日はちょっと、色々と緊張することの多い一日だったよ
lines.translated: "Today was a day with a whole lot of nerve-wracking moments."

lines.content: 寝床にごろりと横になったまま、俺は携帯を耳に押しつけ、話している。
lines.translated: Sprawled out on my bed, I pressed my phone to my ear and talked.

lines.content: 千和のお店の手伝い初日。
lines.translated: The first day helping out at Chiwa's shop.

lines.content: 身につけ慣れていない衣装を纏い、慣れない仕事に四苦八苦。
lines.translated: Wearing an outfit I wasn't used to, struggling desperately with unfamiliar work.

lines.content: 挙げ句――
lines.translated: And to top it all off--

lines.content: 幼馴染みたちが揃って茶化しにやって来るものだから……疲れた。余計にね
lines.translated: "All my childhood friends showed up together just to tease me... so I'm exhausted. Even more than usual."

lines.content: 苦笑いで俺はそう言う。
lines.translated: I said with a wry smile.

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: えらいね。ちゃんと、昨日の夜に話したとおりにできたんだね。大雅
lines.translated: "Good job. You managed to do it just like we talked about last night, huh, Taiga?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 千和のお店で働くことにしたのは、クロと一緒に話し合って決めたものだった。
lines.translated: Working at Chiwa's shop was something Kuro and I had discussed and decided on together.

lines.content: ……大雅が千和のお店で働くことにした、その理由
lines.translated: "...The reason you decided to work at Chiwa's shop, Taiga."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ……少女たちが秘めた“最後の魔法”を使うには、大雅。きみが、“魔法少女『使い』”である君こそが、あの子たちにとって、特別な“関係”にならなければいけない
lines.translated: "...In order to use the 'final magic' hidden within the girls, Taiga, you -- as the 'Magical Girl Wielder' -- must form a special 'relationship' with them."

lines.content: そのために、今以上……幼馴染み以上の関係にならないと、だめ
lines.translated: "To do that, you have to become something more than what you are now... something more than childhood friends."

lines.content: ……らしい
lines.translated: "...Apparently."

lines.content: “関係性”こそがより強い“魔法”を使うための“鍵”であり、呪文なのだということだ。
lines.translated: It meant that our "relationship" was the very "key" and incantation needed to use stronger "magic."

lines.content: だから俺は、俺たちは、今までよりもっと、千和と一緒の時間を増やせるようにと、考えた――
lines.translated: So I -- we -- thought about how I could spend even more time with Chiwa than before--

lines.content: 互いに互いの大切な“夢”を語り合えるような、そんな特別な“関係性”に至るための近道を探して。
lines.translated: Looking for a shortcut to reach that kind of special "relationship" where we could talk to each other about our precious "dreams."

lines.content: 俺は左手を見つめる。この手の中にある“夜”は、未だに大切な友人たちの心と繋がることはない。
lines.translated: I stared at my left hand. The "Night" within this hand had yet to connect with the hearts of my dear friends.

lines.content: ……あの子の中から[・|呼][・|び][・|出][・|す]“魔法”が、千和の[時間|人生]を悩ませる、彼女にとっての最大の悪夢を、晴らしてくれる
lines.translated: "...The 'magic' you call forth from within her will clear away her greatest nightmare, the one plaguing Chiwa's life."

lines.content: そのためにはまず、何よりも、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: And to do that, first and foremost, Kuro said:

lines.content: ……十年前の千和が、“魔法”を必要とした理由を、探し出すこと
lines.translated: "...You have to find the reason why the Chiwa of ten years ago needed 'magic.'"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……それは、千和の[時間|人生]のどこに“悪夢”が潜んでいるのか。それを見つけ出すということでも、ある
lines.translated: "...That also means finding out where the 'nightmare' is lurking within Chiwa's life."

lines.content: 大切な“夢”を語り合える関係。
lines.translated: A relationship where we can talk about our precious "dreams."

lines.content: 切実な“困難”を告白し合える関係。
lines.translated: A relationship where we can confess our deepest "struggles" to one another.

lines.content: 人間ではない自分には無理だった、とあさひさんは言った。だから[・|そ][・|れ]を俺に託した。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said it was impossible for her, since she wasn't human. That's why she entrusted *that* to me.

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: 黙ってしまった俺の耳に、クロの心配そうな声が届く。大丈夫。ごめん。少し考え事してたんだ――と、苦笑い。
lines.translated: As I fell silent, Kuro's worried voice reached my ears. "I'm fine. Sorry. I was just lost in thought for a bit," I said with a wry smile.

lines.content: そして、
lines.translated: And then,

lines.content: ……ともあれ
lines.translated: "...Anyway."

lines.content: と、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: クロの声を聞けて、今日一日分の緊張感から解放されたように思えた。
lines.translated: Just hearing Kuro's voice made me feel like all the tension from today had been washed away.

lines.content: ともあれ、また明日、千和のお店で働いてくるよ。あんまりに遠回りしすぎてるんじゃないかって自分でも少し思うけれど……
lines.translated: "Anyway, I'll go work at Chiwa's shop again tomorrow. Though even I feel a little like I might be taking way too much of a roundabout approach..."

lines.content: 何もしなければ何もしないまま、ずるずると時間ばかり過ぎていくわけだし。
lines.translated: If I don't do anything, time will just keep dragging on with nothing accomplished.

lines.content: 何かヒントのようなものを掴めればって思う。だから明日も頑張るよ
lines.translated: "I'm hoping I can grab hold of some kind of hint. So I'll do my best tomorrow, too."

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。頑張ろう。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right. Let's do my best.

lines.content: クロがどこかから見ていてくれると思えば、頑張れるし、安心なんだけれど……
lines.translated: "If I think about how you're watching over me from somewhere, Kuro, it gives me the strength to try hard, and puts my mind at ease, though..."

lines.content: クロ？
lines.translated: "Kuro?"

lines.content: ……そうしたいけど
lines.translated: "...I want to do that, too."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: でも、だめ。しばらくはそうできそうに、ない
lines.translated: "But I can't. It doesn't look like I'll be able to for a while."

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: そう問いかけても返事はない。
lines.translated: Even when I asked her why, there was no reply.

lines.content: ごそごそと何かが擦れ合うような音がするばかり。
lines.translated: All I could hear was a rustling sound, like something rubbing together.

lines.content: クロ、今、どこにいるの？
lines.translated: "Kuro, where are you right now?"

lines.content: 会いたいと、急にそう思った。
lines.translated: I suddenly felt the urge to see her.

lines.content: 選択したこの道は、この時間は、間違ってはいないだろうか。俺や君にとって正しいものだったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was this path I chose, this time I was spending, a mistake? Was it the right thing for me and for her?

lines.content: 君と顔を合わせることは――……今夜、今すぐには無理であっても、居場所くらいは知りたいと思う。
lines.translated: Even if meeting her face-to-face was impossible right now, tonight... I at least wanted to know where she was.

lines.content: そうすれば今よりもっと、不安も心配も、軽くなってくれるように、思えたんだけど――……
lines.translated: It felt like doing so would make my anxiety and worry much lighter than they were now, though--...
--Silence.

lines.content: ほんの短い空白の後、
lines.translated: After a very brief pause,

lines.content: 近く
lines.translated: "Close."

lines.content: ぽつりと、返事がある。
lines.translated: came her quiet reply.

lines.content: ……近くに、いる
lines.translated: "...I'm close by."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: でも、遠い
lines.translated: "But far away."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: とても。とっても。遠い場所
lines.translated: "A very, very faraway place."

lines.content: えっと……
考える。そして、答える。
lines.translated: I thought about it. And then I answered.

lines.content: ……なぞなぞ？
lines.translated: "...Is this a riddle?"

lines.content: ちがう
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: 小さく頬を膨らませている光景がふと過ぎり――俺の口元に、笑顔がこぼれた。
lines.translated: The image of her puffing her cheeks out slightly flashed through my mind--and a smile spilled onto my lips.

lines.content: ……ちがう、けど
lines.translated: "...No, it's not, but..."

lines.content: けど？
lines.translated: "But?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……声を微かに振るわせるようにして、
lines.translated: With a faint tremor in her voice,

lines.content: 大雅。安心していい
lines.translated: "Taiga. You can rest easy."

lines.content: クロは、言った。
lines.translated: Kuro said.

lines.content: ……大雅の選択は、きっと、正しい
lines.translated: "...Your choice is definitely the right one, Taiga."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大丈夫。心配しないでいいんだよ。きっと全部うまくいく。何も、怖くない。だって、わたしは……
lines.translated: "It's okay. You don't need to worry. Everything will surely work out. There's nothing to be afraid of. Because I..."

lines.content: ふっと、
lines.translated: Softly,
"...Because I can see your future, Taiga."

lines.content: 君が笑ったように、思えた。
lines.translated: It felt as though she smiled.

lines.content: え？　それは、どういう……
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you mean by..."

lines.content: だから、平気。心配することはない
lines.translated: "So it's fine. There's nothing to worry about."

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: 大雅。あのね。わたしは、おバカだけれど……でもね
lines.translated: "Taiga. Listen. I might be silly... but even so..."

lines.content: いつでもきみに、これだけは、きみに……伝えたいんだ
lines.translated: "I always want to tell you... at least this much, to you."

lines.content: きみのこれからの時間に、何も、何ひとつ、困ったことなんて起こらない。絶対に
lines.translated: "In your time going forward, nothing -- not a single troubling thing -- will happen. Absolutely nothing."

lines.content: 俺は、問いかけてみる。
lines.translated: I tried asking her.

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……クロが、俺の未来を知っているから？　だから、平気だって。大丈夫なんだって……わかるということ？
lines.translated: "...Because you know my future, Kuro? Does that mean... you know for sure that it'll be fine, that everything's okay?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ため息のような淡い声で、『大雅』と、俺の名を呼び、君は答えた。
lines.translated: Calling my name, "Taiga," in a faint voice like a sigh, she answered.

lines.content: 側にはいられないけど
lines.translated: "I can't be by your side, though."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 会うことも、今は、できないけれど
lines.translated: "And I can't see you right now, either."

lines.content: 大雅……。今はこうして、ふたりで目の前の“謎”について、言葉とか、気持ちとか、交換するようなことしか、出来ないけれど……
lines.translated: "Taiga... Right now, all we can do is exchange words and feelings like this about the 'mystery' in front of us, though..."

lines.content: ……でも
lines.translated: "...Even though..."

lines.content: 大雅。
lines.translated: Taiga.

lines.content: 勇気を出して……がんばれ、大雅。いつもどこかで、応援してる
lines.translated: "Be brave... and do your best, Taiga. I'm always cheering for you from somewhere."

lines.content: 電話は切れた。
lines.translated: The call disconnected.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]の裏に思い描いていたクロは、小さく微笑んでくれているように、感じられた。
lines.translated: Behind my closed eyelids, the Kuro I pictured in my mind felt like she was giving me a small smile.

lines.content: 次の日の放課後。
lines.translated: The next day, after school.

lines.content: この日も俺は千和のお店で働く。
lines.translated: Today, too, I worked at Chiwa's shop.

lines.content: 大雅ー、早く。早くご注文をー
lines.translated: "Taigaaa, hurry. Hurry and take my ordeeerrr."

lines.content: え、ええー、すごい。また何か注文するの？　ひよちゃん、そんなに間食しちゃって……太っても知らないよ？
lines.translated: "W-Whaaat, amazing. You're ordering something else? Hiyo-chan, snacking that much... don't blame me if you get fat, okay?"

lines.content: ひよちゃんの食べたものの栄養はお腹の中の怪獣に全部持って行かれるからな。太らないんだよ。食べても食べても
lines.translated: "All the nutrients from the food Hiyo-chan eats get completely stolen by the monster inside her stomach, you see. She doesn't gain weight. No matter how much she eats."

lines.content: そんな[ひどい|不公平な]話が……
lines.translated: "That's so unfair..."

lines.content: ハルはすごい顔をして姫織のお腹を見た。
lines.translated: Haru made an incredible face and stared at Himeori's stomach.

lines.content: ……私も飼いたい。怪獣。怖いものでもいいから。暴れん坊なのでも、いいから
lines.translated: "...I want to keep one as a pet, too. A monster. I don't care if it's scary. I don't even care if it's a rowdy one."

lines.content: 昨日に引き続き今日もみんな揃ってる。
lines.translated: Continuing from yesterday, everyone was gathered here again today.

lines.content: 暇なのかな。
lines.translated: Do they have nothing better to do?

lines.content: 暇なのかな
lines.translated: "Do you guys have nothing better to do?"

lines.content: つい本音がぽろりと。
lines.translated: My honest thoughts accidentally slipped right out.

lines.content: む。暇とは失敬だな
lines.translated: "Hmph. How rude to assume we have nothing better to do."

lines.content: あ、ああ。これは失礼した
lines.translated: "A-Ah, right. My apologies."

lines.content: 伝票を持ってテーブルの側に立ち、言う。
lines.translated: Standing beside the table with the order pad in hand, I spoke.

lines.content: つい、本音が
lines.translated: "My honest thoughts just slipped out."

lines.content: ええ～、それ、全然悪いって思われてない感じがしちゃうよね
lines.translated: "Ehh, that doesn't make it sound like you feel bad about it at all."

lines.content: ハルが苦笑いでそう言った。
lines.translated: Haru said that with a wry smile.

lines.content: まあ、暇であるかどうかはわからないが、時間を持て余してはいるだろう。
lines.translated: Well, I didn't know if they actually had nothing to do, but they certainly seemed to have time on their hands.

lines.content: ついこの間まで、放課後はみんなとだらだら過ごしていたのだ。それが今は喫茶店でアルバイトである――俺と、千和だけが。
lines.translated: Up until just recently, we had all spent our afternoons hanging out lazily together after school. Now, however, I was working a part-time job at a cafe -- just me and Chiwa.

lines.content: みんなにしてみれば、急にぽっかりと時間が空いてしまったような感じだろうか。
lines.translated: From everyone else's perspective, it probably felt like a sudden, gaping hole had opened up in their schedules.

lines.content: なんだか悪いなと急に思えてしまった。
lines.translated: All of a sudden, I felt kind of bad about it.

lines.content: 昨日に引き続き一品だけ何か奢ろう。だからちょっと静かにしておいてもらえれば――……
lines.translated: "Following up from yesterday, I'll treat you each to one item. So if you could just keep it down a little--"

lines.content: 若干の罪悪感からそのようなことを口走ってしまった。すぐに後悔する。
lines.translated: Driven by a slight sense of guilt, I blurted that out. I regretted it immediately.

lines.content: 私、パフェ大盛り！
lines.translated: "I want a large parfait!"

lines.content: 姫織がピシッと手を挙げる。
lines.translated: Himeori shot her hand straight up into the air.

lines.content: だったら俺もパフェだ。抹茶パフェ。クリーム一杯。大盛りで
lines.translated: "Then I'll have a parfait, too. A matcha parfait. Loaded with cream. Make it a large."

lines.content: 智仁も手を挙げる。
lines.translated: Tomohito raised his hand as well.

lines.content: ……おい。君たち。誰が大盛りを許可した。しかも智仁。お前のは一番高いパフェじゃないか
lines.translated: "...Hey. You two. Who gave you permission to order larges? And Tomohito, yours is the most expensive parfait on the menu."

lines.content: え、ええっと。だったら私は……私は、太らない[甘いもの|お菓子]を……ひとつ
lines.translated: "U-Umm. In that case, I'll... I'll have one... sweet treat that won't make me fat."

lines.content: そんな都合の良い甘いものはないよハル。食べれば太る。世の常だ。パフェは甘くともこの世は甘くないんだよ。だが、怪獣は別だ。例外だ
lines.translated: "No such convenient sweet exists, Haru. If you eat, you gain weight. That's the way of the world. Parfaits may be sweet, but life isn't. The monster, however, is a different story. An exception."
"E-Ehhh...?"

lines.content: ……みんなにはさ、悪いなと思ってるんだ
lines.translated: "...Look, I really do feel bad about this, guys."

lines.content: え？　急にどうしたんだよ
lines.translated: "Huh? Where's this coming from all of a sudden?"

lines.content: ……ごめん。何の相談もなくバイトはじめて。いつも放課後は一緒に遊んでたのに
lines.translated: "...Sorry for starting a part-time job without talking to you guys first. Even though we always used to hang out together after school."

lines.content: みんなが顔を見合わせていた。
lines.translated: Everyone exchanged glances with one another.

lines.content: だからさ、一品程度は何か奢らせてもらおうと考えたんだけど……
lines.translated: "So, you know, I figured I'd at least treat you all to an item each, buuut..."

lines.content: 俺は、目を細めた。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: こんな遠慮心のかけらも持ち合わせていない幼馴染みだとは思わなかった。大盛りの追加料金だけは支払えよ。そこまでの面倒は、見ない
lines.translated: "I never expected my childhood friends to lack even a shred of restraint. You're paying the extra charge for the large sizes yourselves. I'm not covering you that far."

lines.content: ええええええ～……っ
lines.translated: "Ehhhhhh...!"

lines.content: 気にしないでいいよ。大雅くん
lines.translated: "You don't need to worry about it, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ハルが言う。
lines.translated: Haru spoke up.

lines.content: ほら、聞いたかふたりとも。ハルはちゃんと遠慮ってものをわかってくれてるじゃなにか。大盛りの追加料金くらい払えって
lines.translated: "See? Did you two hear that? Haru actually understands the concept of restraint. Come on, at least pay the extra fee for the large size."

lines.content: ハルを見習えよと俺は言うけれど、『違うよ。そうじゃないよ』とハルは言った。違うの？
lines.translated: I told them to follow Haru's example, only for her to say, "No, that's not what I meant." It isn't?

lines.content: 私たちは……私たちの“やるべきこと”を見つけちゃったから。だから気にしなくてもいいよって言いたかったの
lines.translated: "We've... found 'something we need to do' of our own. That's why I wanted to tell you not to worry about it."

lines.content: え？　そうなの？
lines.translated: "Huh? Really?"

lines.content: それはなんだろうと問いかけるも、ハルは『えへへ』と笑いながら秘密だと言う。
lines.translated: I asked her what it was, but Haru just giggled and said it was a secret.

lines.content: 今はまだ、ちょっと……大雅くんには教えてあげられない。かもしれない
lines.translated: "I don't think... we can tell you about it just yet, Taiga-kun. Maybe."

lines.content: 俺にだけ……？　むう。つれないじゃないか
lines.translated: "Just me...? Hmph. Isn't that a little cold?"

lines.content: そんなことないもん。つれつれなくない
lines.translated: "That's not true at all. We're not being co-cold."

lines.content: え？　つれつれ……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Co-cold...?"

lines.content: ……いいの。気にしないで。噛んだだけ
lines.translated: "...Never mind. Don't worry about it. I just bit my tongue."

lines.content: ちょっと恥ずかしそうにする姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori looked a little embarrassed.

lines.content: とにかく……大雅が私たちをほっぽって、千和のお店で働こうって決めちゃったんだもん。ハルちゃんやともちゃんはどうか知らないけど、私はおこだよ。ぷんぷんなんだよ
lines.translated: "Anyway... you're the one who ditched us and decided to work at Chiwa's shop, Taiga. I don't know about Haru-chan and Tomo-chan, but I'm mad. Super mad."

lines.content: ぷりぷりとしながら『暇なの』『構って』『奢って』『今度』『いっぱい』『甘やかして』と姫織が言う。
lines.translated: Fuming in a huff, Himeori rattled off complaints: "I'm bored," "Pay attention to me," "Treat me," "Spoil me," "Lots," "Next time."

lines.content: だからね、大雅。大雅がお仕事がんばってる間に、私たちは私たちで色々がんばるんだよ。そう決めたの
lines.translated: "So listen, Taiga. While you're working hard at your job, we're going to work hard on all sorts of things on our end, too. That's what we decided."

lines.content: うう……、まあ、うん。みんなに相談もなしに決めてしまったこと……それを言われてしまうとぐう音のも出ないのが実際だなあ
lines.translated: "Ugh... Well, yeah. Deciding this without consulting any of you... When you put it like that, I honestly don't have a leg to stand on."

lines.content: ここで働こうと決めたのにはわけがあるんだよ。
lines.translated: There's a reason I decided to work here, you know.

lines.content: そういうふうには言えるはずもなく……。
lines.translated: Not that there was any way I could tell them that...

lines.content: ……まあ、今は、それはそれとして。
lines.translated: Well, setting that aside for now.

lines.content: 本当はもっと気になることがあるのだ。
lines.translated: Honestly, there was something else bothering me much more.

lines.content: その“気になること”を誤魔化すみたいに、ぐるぐると、奢るだの奢らないだのと話していたけれど――……限界だ。
lines.translated: I'd been going in circles talking about treating them or not treating them as if to distract myself from that "something," buuut... I'd reached my limit.

lines.content: やっぱり気になる。気になってしまう。
lines.translated: It really was bothering me. I couldn't help being curious.

lines.content: どうしたの、大雅くん
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: みんなから視線を外し、つい沈黙してしまっていた俺に、ハルが言った。
lines.translated: Having averted my gaze from everyone and fallen silent, Haru spoke to me.

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は、みんなから視線を外したまま、
lines.translated: Keeping my eyes turned away from the group,

lines.content: ……なあ、ハル。話は変わるようだけど……ひとつだ。ひとつだけ、聞きたいことが
lines.translated: "...Hey, Haru. Sorry to change the subject, but... there's one thing. Just one thing I want to ask."

lines.content: 別のテーブルのほうを見ながら、言った。
lines.translated: I spoke while looking over toward another table.

lines.content: 実はさっきから……、いや、仕事を始める前からずっと、すごい、すっごい、気にかかってることがあるんだけど
lines.translated: "Actually, for a while now... no, ever since before I even started my shift, there's been something really, seriously bothering me."

lines.content: うん？　なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."
I had a feeling I wasn't supposed to look, so I'd been pretending not to see it,

lines.content: ……聞いちゃいけないことなのかなって、思って。あえて何も言わなかったんだけれど
lines.translated: "...I figured it might be something I shouldn't ask about, so I deliberately didn't say anything, but..."

lines.content: うんうん、だから、何？
lines.translated: "Uh-huh, so what is it?"

lines.content: この店はいつから……
lines.translated: "Since when did this place..."

lines.content: 振り返り……改めて、見る。
lines.translated: I turned around... and looked at it anew.

lines.content: その光景に人差し指を向け、
lines.translated: Pointing my index finger at the sight,

lines.content: ……いつから、あんな、格好……猫耳喫茶に、なってしまったんだろう
lines.translated: "...Since when did this place involve dressing like that... and turn into a cat-ear cafe?"

lines.content: ……千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa.

lines.content: いつもの制服。
lines.translated: Her usual uniform.

lines.content: いつもの笑顔。
lines.translated: Her usual smile.

lines.content: いや、いつもより若干堅い笑顔を浮かべ……、
lines.translated: No, she was wearing a slightly stiffer smile than usual...

lines.content: い、いらっしゃいませ～……。喫茶ブルームーンへ、よ、ようこ、そー……
lines.translated: "W-Welcoooome... Welcome to... C-Cafe Blue Mooooon..."

lines.content: にっこり。
lines.translated: She smiled brightly.

lines.content: なんだか決め顔っぽい表情をした。
lines.translated: She struck what looked like a signature pose.

lines.content: 俺はぽかんとしてしまう。
lines.translated: My jaw dropped.

lines.content: そんな俺の視線に気づいたのだろう千和――
lines.translated: Chiwa must have noticed me staring at her--

lines.content: ひうっ
lines.translated: "Eek!"

lines.content: 涙目である。
lines.translated: Her eyes were brimming with tears.

lines.content: 真っ青だ――“私、何か間違えたのかな”というように。
lines.translated: She was pale as a sheet -- looking as though she were thinking, "Did I make some kind of mistake?"

lines.content: いや。いやいや。色々と思うことはあるけれど、
lines.translated: No. No, wait. I had plenty of thoughts running through my head,

lines.content: ……なぜ、あんな。猫耳なんて
lines.translated: "...Why is she wearing those? Cat ears, of all things."

lines.content: 俺だけではない。
lines.translated: And it wasn't just me.

lines.content: お客さんの殆どが千和のことを注目していた。ざわついてもいる。千和ちゃんいったいどうした。常連のおじさんがぽつりとこぼす。
lines.translated: Almost all the customers had their eyes glued to Chiwa. A murmur was rippling through the room. "What on earth happened to Chiwa-chan?" one of the older regulars muttered under his breath.

lines.content: そんな中、ハルが言う。わかっていないなあというように首を振りながら、
lines.translated: Amidst all this, Haru spoke up, shaking her head as if to say I just didn't get it.

lines.content: 違うよ大雅くん
lines.translated: "You've got it wrong, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: ……違うとは？
lines.translated: "...Wrong how?"

lines.content: あれはね、猫耳じゃないの。なんと犬耳なんだよ
lines.translated: "Those aren't cat ears, you see. Believe it or not, they're dog ears."

lines.content: そんなのどうでもいーわ。
lines.translated: Like that makes any difference!

lines.content: そう軽い突っ込みを入れようかと思ったが、
lines.translated: I was about to toss out a light retort like that,

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: どうでもよくはなかった。全然。まったく。
lines.translated: Except it did make a difference. A huge one. Completely.

lines.content: そうか、あれは、犬耳。
lines.translated: I see, so those are dog ears.

lines.content: 千和にとっても似合ってる。
lines.translated: They suited Chiwa wonderfully.

lines.content: あれが猫耳だった場合を想像してみよう。
lines.translated: Let's try imagining what it would be like if those were cat ears.

lines.content: ……うむ
それは、それで、
lines.translated: That, in its own way,

lines.content: うむっ
lines.translated: "Indeed!"

lines.content: すっごい似合ってはいそうだけれど……。
lines.translated: Would probably look amazing on her, too, buuut...

lines.content: なるほど！！！！！
しかしその差違はとても重要なことだろうと理解できてしまった――千和。子犬っぽいもんな。だからすっごい、[・|こ][・|っ][・|ち][・|の][・|ほ][・|う][・|が]似合ってる。
lines.translated: Even so, I now fully grasped that the distinction was of the utmost importance -- it's Chiwa, after all. She's got that puppy-like vibe. Which is why these suit her way, way better.

lines.content: 俺のなめ回すような視線に気づいた千和が、ビクッと小さく飛び跳ねて、真っ赤になった。
lines.translated: Noticing the way my eyes were practically licking her from head to toe, Chiwa gave a tiny, startled jump and turned bright red.

lines.content: う、う、ううううっ
lines.translated: "U-U-Ughhhh..."

lines.content: おろおろとしている。
lines.translated: She was completely flustered.

lines.content: もう、も、もう、どうして、こんなの……っ
lines.translated: "Jeez, j-jeez, why is this happening...?"

lines.content: ぷるぷるとしている。
lines.translated: She was trembling all over.

lines.content: わ、わたし……ばか、みたい……ぐす
lines.translated: "I-I look... like an idiot... *sniffle*."

lines.content: うるうる、していた。
lines.translated: Her eyes were misty with tears.

lines.content: 先輩……せんぱいの……ばか
lines.translated: "Senpai... You big dummy, Senpai..."

lines.content: 丸いお盆で顔を隠す。
lines.translated: She hid her face behind a round tray.

lines.content: そしてその場に、しゃがみ込んでしまっていた。
lines.translated: Then she crouched right down on the spot.

lines.content: 大雅……！
lines.translated: "Taiga...!"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 何やってるの、大雅！　早く！
lines.translated: "What are you doing, Taiga?! Hurry!"

lines.content: あ、ご注文……？
lines.translated: "Oh, ready to order...?"

lines.content: ちっ、げーし！
lines.translated: "Wro-o-ong!"

lines.content: もうっ、信じらんないよ！　と長い髪を振り乱すようにして頭を抱え、姫織は言う。
lines.translated: "Jeez, I can't believe you!" Himeori said, clutching her head and whipping her long hair around in frustration.

lines.content: 早く千和を慰めに……ごー、だよ！
lines.translated: "Hurry up and go comfort Chiwa... Go, go!"

lines.content: え、ええ……？
lines.translated: "Wh-Whaaat...?"

lines.content: 大好きな女の子がピンチなんだよ、そんなとき、いったい誰が駆けつけるっていうの。君だよ！　君しかいないんだよ。ほらほら、早く！
lines.translated: "A girl you love is in a pinch! Who else is supposed to rush to her rescue at a time like this? You! It can only be you! Come on, hurry!"

lines.content: ……大好きって
lines.translated: "...A girl I love?"

lines.content: なんだよ、それ。
lines.translated: What the heck is she talking about?

lines.content: あと、今日のハル、ちょっと面倒っちいぞ。なんとなく。
lines.translated: Also, Haru is being kind of a pain today. For some reason.

lines.content: ……う、ううっ
千和は小走りで厨房へと引っ込んでしまった。
lines.translated: Chiwa scurried off into the kitchen.

lines.content: おい大雅！
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga!"

lines.content: ……なんだよ。お前まで
lines.translated: "...What now? You too?"

lines.content: なんだも何もねえだろうが、後を追わなきゃだめだろう！
lines.translated: "Don't 'what now' me! You've gotta go after her!"

lines.content: おいおい何を突っ立ってんだよ大雅っ。早くっ、いいのかっ、俺がっ、千和ちゃんの後を追いかけるその役をっ、俺が横取りしちまってもいいのかよっ
lines.translated: "Hey, what are you just standing around for, Taiga?! Hurry up! Are you okay with me stealing the role of chasing after Chiwa-chan from you?!"

lines.content: ……なんだこいつら
lines.translated: "...What is with these guys?"

lines.content: うざい。
lines.translated: Annoying.

lines.content: うるさい。
lines.translated: Loud.

lines.content: 面倒くさい。
lines.translated: Such a pain.

lines.content: ……わかったよ。わかった。今日のところはお前らに乗っかってやる。明らかに何か企んでるのは見え見えだがな
lines.translated: "...Fine, I get it. I'll play along with you guys for today. Even though it's painfully obvious you're scheming something."

lines.content: 千和の後を追った。
lines.translated: I went after Chiwa.

lines.content: 俺、ちょっと不機嫌なんだからな、というような雰囲気を惜しげもなく醸し出しながら。
lines.translated: All while making no effort to hide the fact that I was in a slightly bad mood.

lines.content: ……そう。そんなことがあったんだ
lines.translated: "...I see. So that happened."

lines.content: その日の夜。
lines.translated: That night.

lines.content: いつものように電話でクロと話をしている。
lines.translated: I was talking with Kuro on the phone like usual.

lines.content: 大雅は……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 大雅は猫より犬が、好きなんだ
lines.translated: "So you like dogs more than cats, Taiga."

lines.content: え？　いや、どうして……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Wait, why do you say that...?"

lines.content: どうしてそんな話になっちゃうのかな。
lines.translated: How did the conversation jump to that?

lines.content: ……だって。[・|そ][・|っ][・|ち]のほうがかわいいって、言ったんだよね？
lines.translated: "...Because. You said *those* were cuter, right?"

lines.content: そっち？
lines.translated: "Those?"

lines.content: 猫耳よりも、犬耳がかわいい。大雅はそう、言った……んだよね？
lines.translated: "Dog ears are cuter than cat ears. That's what you said... right, Taiga?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。うん
lines.translated: "O-Oh. Yeah."

lines.content: 確かにそう言ったけれど……。
lines.translated: I did say that, sure, but...

lines.content: それは、千和には犬耳のほうが似合っててかわいいという意味で。別にさ、猫よりも犬が好きってわけじゃ……
lines.translated: "I just meant that dog ears suited Chiwa better and looked cute on her. It's not like I prefer dogs over cats in general..."

lines.content: ……まさか
lines.translated: "...Of course not."

lines.content: ……なに？
lines.translated: "...What is it?"

lines.content: 嫉妬？
lines.translated: "Are you jealous?"

lines.content: ちがう
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: ちょっと食い気味に、クロの声。
