lines.translated: Kuro's voice cut in before I could even finish.

lines.content: ……ちがうよ
lines.translated: "...That's not it."

lines.content: 違うんだ
lines.translated: "Oh, so you're not."

lines.content: ……そう。ちがう。だって
lines.translated: "...Right. I'm not. Because..."

lines.content: だって？
lines.translated: "Because?"

lines.content: うん。……だって。黒猫は、嫉妬なんてしない……イキモノなんだから
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Because. Black cats are creatures... that don't get jealous."

lines.content: もにょもにょとした声が届いた。
lines.translated: Her voice came through, soft and mumbled.

lines.content: だから、別に……。別に大雅が猫より犬が好きでも別に……。千和のこと、かわいいって言ったからって……別に
lines.translated: "So I don't care... I don't care if you like dogs more than cats, Taiga... And just because you called Chiwa cute... I don't care."

lines.content: そこまで言って、クロは黙ってしまった。
lines.translated: After saying that much, Kuro fell silent.

lines.content: クロ……？
lines.translated: "Kuro...?"

lines.content: 沈黙に言葉を投げかける。
lines.translated: I called out into the silence.

lines.content: 返答は、ない。
lines.translated: There was no reply.

lines.content: どうしたのかなと俺は感じてしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help wondering what was wrong.

lines.content: いつもこうして電話するときは、素直に話をしてくれるクロだけど……。
lines.translated: Usually, when we talked on the phone like this, Kuro was much more open and honest with me...

lines.content: 今夜はあまりその“素直さ”を感じられなかった。
lines.translated: Tonight, I couldn't really feel that usual honesty from her.

lines.content: それがどうしても、どうしても、気に掛かってしまい、
lines.translated: And for some reason, I just couldn't shake it from my mind.

lines.content: 何か、悩みとかがあるのかな……
lines.translated: "Is something bothering you...?"

lines.content: だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: ちょっと唐突に過ぎる言葉が、つい……ぽろりと唇からこぼれてしまった。
lines.translated: The overly abrupt question slipped right out of my mouth before I could stop it.
Long ago.

lines.content: この町に“夜”を通じてやって来た頃。およそ十年前だ。
lines.translated: Back when we first came to this town through the "Night." About ten years ago.

lines.content: 君と俺とで長い、長い旅をしてきた。
lines.translated: You and I went on a long, long journey together.

lines.content: あの頃の君は言葉が多く、表情も多く、俺の頭を撫でてくれることも、多く。
lines.translated: Back then, you talked a lot more, showed a lot more expression, and patted my head a lot more, too.

lines.content: 今では電話の中でだけ、あの頃の君に出会えていたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Nowadays, I could only meet the you from back then over the phone...

lines.content: 今夜はどうもそのような印象を、電話の中にでもあまり感じられなかった。それが、違和感といえば違和感だった。
lines.translated: Yet tonight, I didn't really get that impression from her, not even over the phone. If I had to call it anything, it felt like something was off.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: その違和感を拭いきれず。
lines.translated: Unable to shake that feeling that something was off...

lines.content: 一度吐き出してしまった言葉を飲み込み直すことだって、当然、叶わず……。
lines.translated: And naturally unable to swallow back the words I'd already let slip...

lines.content: 俺は、続けてクロに問いかけてみることにする。
lines.translated: I decided to press on and ask Kuro again.

lines.content: 何か、あったの？
lines.translated: "Did something happen?"

lines.content: と、俺は問う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: 何か……
lines.translated: "Something..."

lines.content: と、クロはつぶやく。
lines.translated: Kuro murmured.

lines.content: ああ。クロを悩ませる“何か”がもしも、あるのなら……
lines.translated: "Yeah. If there's 'something' troubling you, Kuro..."

lines.content: もしよかったら、君の気持ちを……全部じゃなくてもいいから、俺に――
lines.translated: "If you don't mind, I want you to tell me how you feel... It doesn't even have to be everything, just--"

lines.content: ――話して聞かせてほしい。
lines.translated: --talk to me and let me listen.

lines.content: そう伝えようとしたときだった。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to tell her that.

lines.content: ――いつも俺が話を聞いてもらうばっかりだ。そのお礼に、今度は俺が君の話を、聞けたなら。
lines.translated: --You're always the one listening to me talk. To return the favor, I'd like to listen to you this time.

lines.content: そう、言おうとしたときだった。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to say those words.

lines.content: 携帯が、鳴った。ぶるり。短く震えた。
lines.translated: My cell phone rang. *Bzzzt.* It gave a short vibration.

lines.content: クロと話している電話ではない。“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”で普段使っているものだった。
lines.translated: It wasn't the phone I was using to talk to Kuro. It was the one I normally used in the "Time of the Sun"--the real world.

lines.content: ベッドの枕元に置いていた端末。
lines.translated: The device resting by my pillow on the bed.

lines.content: そのディズプレイが明滅し、メッセージを受信したことの合図――“千和：今日はありがとうございました”
lines.translated: Its display blinked, signaling that I'd received a message--"Chiwa: Thank you for today."

lines.content: そんな短い一文が、画面に表示されていた。
lines.translated: That short single sentence was displayed on the screen.

lines.content: ……千和？
lines.translated: "...Chiwa?"

lines.content: 思わず小さくその名をつぶやく。
lines.translated: I inadvertently murmured her name under my breath.

lines.content: すると、不思議だ。
lines.translated: And then, strangely enough.

lines.content: 沈黙の中に、何か圧のようなものをじわりと感じてしまった。
lines.translated: Amidst the silence, I felt a sort of heavy pressure slowly creeping in.

lines.content: ち、ちが。今のは……その、メールが
lines.translated: "N-No, wait. That was just... uh, I got a text."

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: ぼそり、と。
lines.translated: Then, in a quiet mutter.

lines.content: ……さよなら
lines.translated: "...Goodbye."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: さよなら、バイバイ。大雅。また、明日
lines.translated: "Goodbye, bye-bye, Taiga. See you tomorrow."

lines.content: ちょっと低い声だった。
lines.translated: Her voice was a little low.

lines.content: 電話は切れた。
lines.translated: The call disconnected.

lines.content: 唇を尖らせてそっぽを向く――そんなクロの様子が、[まぶた|瞼]の裏にありありと思い浮かぶようだった。
lines.translated: Pouting her lips and looking away--I could vividly picture Kuro doing just that behind my eyelids.

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 届くはずもないとわかっていながらそうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured those words, even knowing they would never reach her.

lines.content: そしてメールの届いた携帯を手に取る。
lines.translated: Then, I picked up the cell phone that had received the text.

lines.content: 『今日はありがとうございます。先輩のおかげで色々助かりました』
lines.translated: "'Thank you for today. You really helped me out a lot, Senpai.'"

lines.content: そう始まった短いメール。
lines.translated: The short message began like that.

lines.content: その締めに添えられた言葉に、俺は、
lines.translated: When I saw the words added at the very end, I...

lines.content: 目を丸くし、
lines.translated: Widened my eyes,

lines.content: 口をぽかんと開き、
lines.translated: Let my jaw drop open,

lines.content: まさか読み間違えてはいないかと――……何度も、何度も、その文面を読み返すのだった。
lines.translated: And read the message over and over again, wondering if my eyes were playing tricks on me.

lines.content: ……今日も騒がしいなあ。この町は
lines.translated: "...This town is as lively as ever today."

lines.content: 小走りで進む俺は、たくさんの観光客とすれ違う。
lines.translated: Jogging along, I passed by crowds of tourists.

lines.content: カメラやスマホを構えて歩く人たち。
lines.translated: People walking around holding up cameras and smartphones.

lines.content: ぱしゃり、ぱしゃり。
lines.translated: *Click, click.*

lines.content: シャッター音が聞こえてくる。
lines.translated: The sound of camera shutters reached my ears.

lines.content: 町の名物を売る店先からは、香ばしい匂いもふわり漂う。
lines.translated: Savory aromas wafted gently from the storefronts selling local specialties.

lines.content: それらに誘われる人たちはみな一様に笑顔だ。
lines.translated: Everyone drawn in by the sights and smells wore the same bright smile.

lines.content: ……さくらの杜と呼ばれる我が町、参禅町。
lines.translated: Sanzen-cho, our hometown, known as the Grove of Cherry Blossoms.

lines.content: 春。うつくしい風景がそこここにあふれかえる季節だからこそ、休日もになれば賑わいを見せることは、住人にとってもう既に周知の事実だ。
lines.translated: In spring, a season overflowing with beautiful scenery everywhere you look, the fact that weekends brought bustling crowds was already common knowledge to the locals.

lines.content: ごめん。遅れちゃったかな
lines.translated: "Sorry. Am I late?"

lines.content: ……待ち合わせしていた人物はもう既にやって来ていた。
lines.translated: The person I was meeting had already arrived.

lines.content: いいえ。そんなこと……私も今来たところです
lines.translated: "No, not at all... I just got here myself."

lines.content: 待ち合わせていた女の子――杏藤千和が微笑んで俺を迎えてくれた。
lines.translated: The girl I was meeting up with--Andou Chiwa--greeted me with a smile.

lines.content: 今、来たところ……。
lines.translated: She just got here...

lines.content: そうは言っても、こうして待たせてしまったことには変わりない。
lines.translated: Even if she said that, it didn't change the fact that I'd kept her waiting.

lines.content: 俺は頭を下げてもう一度『ごめん』と言った。
lines.translated: I bowed my head and said "sorry" one more time.

lines.content: 言い訳するわけじゃないんだけどさ。約束の十分前を意識して家を出たはずなんだけど……
lines.translated: "Not to make excuses, but I made sure to leave the house aiming to get here ten minutes early..."

lines.content: スマホで時間を確認――確かにそうだ。約束は、十時。今は九時五十分。
lines.translated: I checked the time on my smartphone--sure enough, I was right. Our meeting time was ten o'clock. Right now, it was nine-fifty.

lines.content: 約束した時間に遅れたわけではないことを知って安心する。
lines.translated: I felt relieved knowing I hadn't actually been late for our promised time.

lines.content: だけど、待たせてしまったことは事実なのである。一分だろうと、二分だろうと。
lines.translated: Even so, it was still a fact that I had kept her waiting. Whether it was for one minute or two.

lines.content: ごめんな千和。待たせてしまって。……どれくらい待ったかな
lines.translated: "Sorry about that, Chiwa. For making you wait. ...How long were you waiting?"

lines.content: いいえ。本当に、全然ですよ？
lines.translated: "No, really, not long at all!"

lines.content: にこりと。
lines.translated: She beamed.

lines.content: 本当に、私も今来たところなんですよ。先輩――
lines.translated: "Honestly, I really did just get here too, Senpai--"

lines.content: 千和がもう一度、微笑んだときだ。
lines.translated: Just as Chiwa smiled once more,

lines.content: 一組の親子連れが通りかかった。
lines.translated: A mother and child happened to walk past us.

lines.content: ママ～、あのお姉ちゃん、まだあそこにいるよ～
lines.translated: "Mama~, that big sister is still over there~."

lines.content: っ
びくり、と。
lines.translated: *Twitch.*

lines.content: 千和は身体を震わせた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's body trembled.

lines.content: 千和……？
lines.translated: "Chiwa...?"

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。千和は真っ青になっていた。
lines.translated: What was wrong? Chiwa had gone completely pale.

lines.content: 親子連れは続ける。
lines.translated: The mother and daughter continued.

lines.content: えっとぉ～、私たちがお買い物いくときも、お母さんがお財布忘れて、お家に取りに戻ったときも……ずっと、あそこにいたけれど
lines.translated: "Um~, she was there when we went shopping, and when you forgot your wallet and we went back home to get it... she was standing right there the whole time."

lines.content: そうねえ。一時間くらい前からかしらね
lines.translated: "She was, wasn't she? Since about an hour ago, I think."

lines.content: え、一時間も……？
lines.translated: "Wait, a whole hour...?"

lines.content: もう一度、びくりとし――
lines.translated: She twitched once more--

lines.content: 小さくちいさく、その場で千和は飛び跳ねる。
lines.translated: And gave a tiny, little jump right on the spot.

lines.content: あ、でも、もうひとりじゃないみたい
lines.translated: "Oh, but it looks like she's not alone anymore."

lines.content: 本当ね。やっと待ち合わせの人が来たみたいね
lines.translated: "You're right. It looks like the person she was waiting for finally showed up."

lines.content: にこにこしながらそんなことを言っている――小さな女の子とお母さん。親子連れ。
lines.translated: The little girl and her mother--the parent and child pair--were saying all this with warm smiles on their faces.

lines.content: 本人らはひそひそと小さく話しているつもりなのだろうが、その会話内容はハッキリこちらにまで届いていた。
lines.translated: They probably thought they were whispering quietly to each other, but every word of their conversation reached our ears loud and clear.

lines.content: 女の子が千和に人差し指を向け、
lines.translated: The little girl pointed her index finger at Chiwa,

lines.content: あのお姉ちゃん。ずっとひとりで、にこにこしたり、同じとこうろうろしたり……鏡ばっかり見て、髪の毛さわったりしてたよね
lines.translated: "That big sister kept smiling to herself, pacing around the same spot all alone... and she kept looking in her mirror and fixing her hair, didn't she?"

lines.content: そうねえ。待ち合わせの相手はよっぽど大好きな人だったんじゃないかしら。ちゃんと会えてよかったわね
lines.translated: "She sure did. She must really, really love the person she was waiting for. I'm glad they managed to meet up."

lines.content: 俺、何も言えずにいるばかり。
lines.translated: I just stood there, completely speechless.

lines.content: あ、あ、ああ、ち、ちが、ちがくって……っ
lines.translated: "Ah, ah, aah, n-no, that's not...!"

lines.content: あわあわし始める千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa started getting completely flustered.

lines.content: 涙目で首を激しく横に振るけれど……。
lines.translated: She shook her head furiously with teary eyes, but...

lines.content: 親子連れはまだまだ続ける。
lines.translated: The mother and child kept right on going.

lines.content: お父さんとお母さんも、あんなふうにどこかで待ち合わせしたりしていたの？
lines.translated: "Did you and Dad used to meet up somewhere like that too, Mom?"

lines.content: あのお姉ちゃんみたいに、お母さんも……大好きなお父さんと会うの、どきどきしたの？
lines.translated: "Just like that big sister, did your heart go doki-doki when you went to meet Dad because you loved him so much?"

lines.content: 俺たちとはまったくもって関係のない話だ――それは、わかっている。
lines.translated: Their conversation had nothing to do with us anymore--I knew that.

lines.content: わかってはいるけれど、
lines.translated: I knew that, and yet...

lines.content: 大好き……
lines.translated: "Love..."

lines.content: ち、ちち、ちが……っ
lines.translated: "N-N-No, that's wrong...!"

lines.content: 真っ赤になったり。
lines.translated: She turned bright red.

lines.content: 私は、別に……っ、先輩のことなんて……っ
lines.translated: "It's not like I... feel that way about Senpai...!"

lines.content: 真っ青に、なったり。
lines.translated: Then she turned ghostly pale.

lines.content: ええ……懐かしいわねえ。お母さんも同じよ。お父さんとデートするときはいつもあの橋で待ち合わせしていたの
lines.translated: "Yes... that brings back memories. It was the same for me. Whenever I went on a date with your father, we always met up at that bridge."

lines.content: お父さんとデートするのが楽しみで仕方なくって……約束の時間よりもずっとずっと早くに着いちゃって……どきどきしちゃって。そわそわ、しちゃって
lines.translated: "I always looked forward to my dates with your father so much... I'd end up arriving way, way before our promised time... My heart would pound, and I'd get all restless and fidgety."

lines.content: ちがいます、から……っ
lines.translated: "That's not what this is...!"

lines.content: 叫ぶ――
lines.translated: She cried out--

lines.content: 私っ、わ、私はっ、ちがいますっ
lines.translated: "I-I'm telling you, it's not like that for me!"

lines.content: せ、せんぱ、先輩との[・|約][・|束]なんか、楽しみになんて……して、ませっ、ませんからっ
lines.translated: "I-It's not like I was looking forward to my *plans* with S-Senpa-Senpai or anything...!"

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: た、ただ……ただ、今日は……その……お店も、お休みで……だから……やることも、なくって……
lines.translated: "I-It's just... today, um... the shop is closed... so... I didn't have anything else to do..."

lines.content: 千和はぐすりと鼻をすすり上げ、
lines.translated: Chiwa gave a little sniffle,

lines.content: 早く着いちゃった理由は、それだけで……だから……だらか、先輩との、約束……で、でデート、は……関係、なくって……
lines.translated: "That's the only reason I got here early... so... sbow, my plans with Senpai... o-our d-date... has nothing to do with it..."

lines.content: もにょもにょとしながら、そう言った。
lines.translated: She mumbled, stumbling over her words.

lines.content: デート。
lines.translated: A date.

lines.content: ああ。そうだ、デートだ。
lines.translated: Yeah. That's right, a date.

lines.content: 『先輩。明日は何か予定ありますか？』
lines.translated: "'Senpai. Do you have any plans for tomorrow?'"

lines.content: 昨晩、突然届いた千和からのメールだ――そのメールは、やはり突然、このような言葉で締められていた。
lines.translated: It was in a text from Chiwa that had arrived out of the blue last night--and just as suddenly, the message had concluded with these words.

lines.content: 『もし何も予定が入っていないなら、明日、私に時間もらえませんか……先輩』
lines.translated: "'If you don't have anything planned, could you spare some time for me tomorrow... Senpai?'"
"'Tomorrow...'"

lines.content: 『もしよければ私と、デート、してくれませんか？』
lines.translated: "'If you don't mind, would you go on a date with me?'"

lines.content: （デート……）
lines.translated: (A date...)

lines.content: つまるところ、それは[・|お][・|礼][・|の][・|一][・|環]だった。
lines.translated: Simply put, it was *part of her way of thanking me*.

lines.content: 俺は、千和のお店を手伝うにあたって報酬を通常の半額しか受け取っていない。
lines.translated: For helping out at Chiwa's shop, I was only accepting half the usual pay.

lines.content: 今はまだ研修期間のようなものだから、満額もらうわけにもいかない――と、千和には告げている。
lines.translated: I'd told Chiwa that since it was still basically a training period, I couldn't possibly accept the full amount.

lines.content: だが本音の部分では、“千和のお店を手伝うと考えた動機が少々不純に感じれた”――からである。
lines.translated: But in all honesty, it was because I felt my motives for wanting to help out at Chiwa's shop were a little impure.

lines.content: “魔法少女『使い』”だとかいう、そんな自分の“役割”を全うするためだ。
lines.translated: It was to fulfill my "role" as a "Magical Girl 'Handler'" or whatever.

lines.content: そのためのヒントを探れないだろうかと、破れかぶれみたいな作戦に巻き込んでしまっているから……。
lines.translated: Because I had dragged her into a desperate scheme just to see if I could fish for some hints toward that goal...

lines.content: なんだか千和のことを騙してしまっているような気になってしまっている部分があった。
lines.translated: Part of me felt like I was deceiving Chiwa.

lines.content: だから半額でももらいすぎなのではないかと思っていたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: So I'd actually thought that even half pay might be too much to accept, and yet...

lines.content: 『明日、もしよければお礼をさせてください。そのためのデートです』
lines.translated: "'Tomorrow, if it's alright with you, please let me thank you properly. This date is for that.'"

lines.content: デート、なんていう言葉を選んだのは、千和なりの冗談というか、いつもの意地悪に対する意趣返しなのではないかと、俺は受け取っているのだけど――……
lines.translated: Choosing the word "date" was probably just Chiwa's way of making a joke, or maybe getting back at me for my usual teasing--at least, that was how I took it, buuut...

lines.content: は、早く！
lines.translated: "H-Hurry!"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……千和に手を引かれ、ハッとする。
lines.translated: I snapped back to reality as Chiwa grabbed my hand and pulled me along.

lines.content: 早く行きましょう、先輩！
lines.translated: "Let's hurry and get going, Senpai!"

lines.content: だ、誰も見てないところに……早くっ
lines.translated: "S-Somewhere nobody is watching... Hurry!"

lines.content: そして、走り出す。
lines.translated: And with that, she broke into a run.

lines.content: いいですか、先輩っ。今日の私は、先輩と――デッ
lines.translated: "Listen to me, Senpai! Today, you and I are--ow!"

lines.content: 噛んだみたいだ――ぎゅっと、顔をしかめる。
lines.translated: It seemed she bit her tongue--she scrunched her face up tightly.

lines.content: だ、大丈夫？
lines.translated: "A-Are you okay?"

lines.content: ん～……っ
ふるふると。
lines.translated: *Shake, shake.*

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じたまま首を振り、
lines.translated: Keeping her eyelids shut tight, she shook her head,

lines.content: き、今日の、私はっ、先輩と……デ、デート、するんですから……っ
lines.translated: "T-Today, I'm going on a... d-date with you, Senpai...!"

lines.content: 目をぐるぐるさせながら、言った。
lines.translated: She declared, her eyes spinning.

lines.content: だ、だか、だからっ、だからちゃんと……楽しいこと、一緒に、いっぱい、しに行きましょう……先輩っ
lines.translated: "S-So, so, that's why... let's go do lots of fun things together properly... Senpai!"

lines.content: 俺の手を引きながら、千和はそう小さく叫び……、
lines.translated: Pulling me by the hand, Chiwa let out that small shout...

lines.content: そんな千和の背中を俺は見つめながら、思う。思ってしまう――……千和。なあ、千和。
lines.translated: And as I stared at Chiwa's back, a thought crossed my mind. I couldn't help but wonder--...Chiwa. Hey, Chiwa.

lines.content: これは、冗談なんだよな？　いつもみたいに、ちょっとふざけてみたりしてるだけなんだよな？
lines.translated: This is just a joke, right? You're just messing around a little like usual, right?

lines.content: 千和と一緒に町を歩いた。
lines.translated: I walked through the town together with Chiwa.

lines.content: デートだ。
lines.translated: A date.

lines.content: たとえ千和なりの“お礼”なのだとしても、これは間違いなくデートなのだと……噛みしめるように、俺は自分に言い聞かせていた。
lines.translated: Even if it was just Chiwa's way of thanking me, I kept telling myself, savoring the thought, that this was undeniably a date.

lines.content: ……なぜならとても、楽しかったからだ。
lines.translated: Because I was having so much fun.

lines.content: まず千和は、お礼として、新しく出来た喫茶店で美味しいコーヒーとケーキのセットをご馳走してくれた。その店で一番、高いセットメニューだった。
lines.translated: First, as her thank-you, Chiwa treated me to a delicious coffee and cake set at a newly opened cafe. It was the most expensive set menu they had.

lines.content: もともと千和に対して罪悪感にも似た感情があるからこそ、バイト代は半分しか受け取っていなかったのに……。
lines.translated: I'd only been taking half my pay in the first place because I felt something akin to guilt toward Chiwa...

lines.content: それなのに、こうしてご馳走されてしまってはもともこもない気もした。
lines.translated: And yet, letting her treat me like this felt like it completely defeated the purpose.

lines.content: いつか今度はこちらが千和に何かご馳走しよう。
lines.translated: Next time, I'd have to treat her to something instead.

lines.content: そんなことを思っている俺の隣で、
lines.translated: Right beside me as I was thinking that,

lines.content: これは……。うん。先輩へのお礼ですけど、敵情視察も充分にできました
lines.translated: "Well... yes. This is to thank you, Senpai, but I also got plenty of recon done on the competition."

lines.content: 満足そうにうなずく千和だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa nodded with satisfaction.

lines.content: ……あのお店のコーヒーもケーキも、すっごく美味しかったですね。何かうちも対抗メニューを考えなきゃいけないかもしれません
lines.translated: "...Both the coffee and the cake at that shop were super delicious. We might have to come up with a rival menu item of our own."

lines.content: 美味しいケーキとコーヒーをご馳走してくれた。だからこれでお礼は済んだ。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: She treated me to delicious cake and coffee. So with that, her thank-you was taken care of. Or at least, it should have been.

lines.content: でも、どちらも『帰ろうか』と言い出すことはなかった。
lines.translated: Yet neither of us brought up the idea of heading home.

lines.content: そこからはまるで本当にデートみたいだった。
lines.translated: From that point on, it felt just like a real date.
*Without either of us really initiating it, we held hands*...

lines.content: 観光客用に整備された騒がしい区画ではなく――人気の少ない路地裏を選んで歩いた。
lines.translated: Instead of the bustling districts maintained for tourists--we chose to walk down the quiet, less-traveled back alleys.

lines.content: 静かで、穏やかな、俺たちが普段の生活を営む静かな町の側面だ。
lines.translated: It was the quiet, peaceful side of town where we lived our everyday lives.

lines.content: きれいに整備された石畳の細い街路を、俺たちは並んで進む。
lines.translated: Side by side, we made our way down a narrow, neatly paved cobblestone street.

lines.content: どちらともなく結んだ手と手は、いつまでも、繋いだままで。
lines.translated: The hands we had joined without thinking stayed linked the entire time.

lines.content: あ、先輩見てください。新しい猫ちゃん発見です
lines.translated: "Ah, look, Senpai. I've discovered a new kitty."

lines.content: 隣を歩く千和が指さした先には……、
lines.translated: Walking beside me, Chiwa pointed ahead toward...

lines.content: 猫地蔵……？
lines.translated: "A cat Jizo statue...?"

lines.content: 丸い石に猫の絵が書かれたモニュメントが（そう言ってしまっていいのかわからないが）あった。
lines.translated: There was a monument (though I wasn't sure if you could call it that) consisting of a round stone with a picture of a cat painted on it.

lines.content: 石畳の街路。
lines.translated: A cobblestone street.

lines.content: 途中にバスの停留所があり……そのすっかり[くたび|草臥]れてしまったベンチの隣だ。寄り添うようにして[・|そ][・|れ]はあった。
lines.translated: Partway down was a bus stop... and right next to its thoroughly worn-out bench, *it* was nestled against the side.

lines.content: だいぶ古いものなのだろう。
lines.translated: It must have been quite old.

lines.content: 緑に苔むし、
lines.translated: Covered in green moss,

lines.content: 所々が小さく欠けて、
lines.translated: Chipped in small places here and there,

lines.content: 半分は、もう地中に埋まりかけている。
lines.translated: With half of it already sinking into the dirt.

lines.content: 千和は小走りで駆けていき――ぱしゃりと。
lines.translated: Chiwa trotted over to it--and *snap*.

lines.content: スマホで写真を撮っていた。
lines.translated: She took a picture with her smartphone.

lines.content: んー、この子ははじめて見た子ですね。こんな所にまだ見ぬ子がいたなんて。気づきませんでした。不覚です……ええっと、君は何番かなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm, this is my first time seeing this little one. To think there was still an undiscovered one in a place like this. I never noticed. What an oversight... Let's see, what number are you?"

lines.content: 千和は像の周りをきょろきょろと見、土をぱたぱたとはたいたり。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked all around the statue, brushing away the dirt with her hands.

lines.content: あ、ふむふむなるほど、君は二百番目の猫ちゃんなんだね
lines.translated: "Ah, I see, I see. So you're the two-hundredth kitty."

lines.content: 取り出したメモ帳に千和は何かを書き付けていた。
lines.translated: Taking out a notepad, Chiwa jotted something down.

lines.content: そういえば……なんだっけ。スタンプラリーみたいな催しがあるんだったっけ？
lines.translated: "Come to think of it... what was that thing again? Wasn't there some kind of event like a stamp rally going on?"

lines.content: はい。そうです
lines.translated: "Yes. That is right."

lines.content: 町中に設置してある猫の像には一つひとつ番号が振ってあって、そのとき対象になっている番号の子を探して写真に撮って、市役所の地域振興課に持って行けば記念品がもらえるんです
lines.translated: "Each of the cat statues placed around town has a number assigned to it. If you find the one with the current target number, take a picture of it, and bring it to the Regional Revitalization Division at City Hall, they give you a souvenir."

lines.content: 記念品。
lines.translated: A souvenir.

lines.content: それはこの町限定の折り紙だという。
lines.translated: Apparently, it was origami paper exclusive to this town.

lines.content: 封を開けるとさくらの香りがふわりと漂う、和紙で作られた折り紙なのだと。
lines.translated: Made of traditional Japanese paper, it supposedly gave off a gentle cherry blossom scent the moment you opened the package.

lines.content: 本当は観光客向けの催しだから、私みたいな町の住人が参加するのは、きっとあまりいい顔されないんじゃないかって思いますけど……
lines.translated: "It's really an event meant for tourists, so I figure people probably wouldn't look too kindly on a local resident like me participating, though..."

lines.content: そうなの？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Really? Why's that?"

lines.content: だって、記念品だって無限にあるわけじゃないって思いますから……ひとつでも多く観光の人に渡ったほうがいいんだって思います。本当は
lines.translated: "Well, I don't think they have an infinite supply of souvenirs... so I feel like it's better if as many of them as possible go to the tourists. Honestly."

lines.content: そうか。まあ、そうかもね
lines.translated: "I see. Well, maybe you're right."

lines.content: でも、あまり参加する人も多くないイベントみたいですし。それに……
lines.translated: "Still, it doesn't seem like an event that gets very many participants anyway. And besides..."

lines.content: それに？
lines.translated: "And besides?"

lines.content: はい。それに、ですね。記念品の折り紙。いつも、とてもきれいな柄なんです
lines.translated: "Yes. Besides, you see, the souvenir origami... it always has such pretty patterns."

lines.content: 季節が変わると探し出さなきゃいけない番号の猫の像も、記念品の柄も変わってしまって……
lines.translated: "Whenever the seasons change, both the number of the cat statue you have to find and the pattern on the souvenir change..."

lines.content: その柄がどうしても欲しいものだったときにだけ、千和はイベントに参加するようにしているのだという。
lines.translated: Chiwa told me she only tries to participate in the event when the pattern is one she really, truly wants.

lines.content: 随分昔にはそのイベントに（対象の番号が振られた猫の像を探すため）俺もよくかり出されていたけれど……。
lines.translated: A long time ago, I used to get dragged along to help with that event pretty often (to hunt down the cat statues with the target numbers), though...

lines.content: いつからかそういうこともあまりなくなっていた。
lines.translated: At some point, we'd mostly stopped doing things like that.

lines.content: それは殆どの番号の像を、その居場所を見つけられてしまったからなのか――それとも俺たちの関係が、昔より少しどこかが変わってしまったからなのか。
lines.translated: Was it because we'd already found the locations of almost every numbered statue--or was it because our relationship had changed a little compared to how it used to be?

lines.content: ともかく。
lines.translated: Regardless.

lines.content: まだ千和にも居場所のわからない像はあるのだろう。今回のように見逃してしまっていたり、見つけづらい場所に入り込んでしまっていたりと。
lines.translated: There were probably still statues whose locations even Chiwa didn't know. Ones she had overlooked like today, or ones tucked away in hard-to-find spots.

lines.content: 住人でさえ見つけづらい場所にある像を、観光客たちがまともに探し出せるものなのかな
lines.translated: "If these statues are in spots that even locals have a hard time finding, I wonder if tourists can actually manage to track them down."

lines.content: それは……はい。確かにそうですね。ちょっと親切心に欠けてるイベントなのかもしれませんね。だから参加する人も少ないみたいで
lines.translated: "That's... yes, a good point. Maybe the event is a little lacking in consideration. Which would explain why so few people participate."

lines.content: 千和に前回もらったという記念品の折り紙を見せてもらった――ああ、確かに。きれいな柄だった。
lines.translated: Chiwa showed me the souvenir origami she'd gotten the last time--and yeah, she was right. It was a pretty pattern.

lines.content: 十枚セット。さくらの花だ。空の色。猫の足跡。
lines.translated: A set of ten sheets. Cherry blossoms. The color of the sky. Cat paw prints.

lines.content: きれいなものだけではなくかわいいものも。
lines.translated: Not just pretty designs, but cute ones too.

lines.content: 見ているだけで充分楽しい。
lines.translated: They were fun enough just to look at.

lines.content: 使ってしまうのが少しもったいなくも思えてくる。
lines.translated: It almost felt like a waste to actually fold them.

lines.content: ――数人の観光客たちが、脇道の階段をのぼっていった。
lines.translated: --Just then, a few tourists walked up the stairs of a side path.

lines.content: この階段ってどこに続いてるのかな。
lines.translated: "I wonder where these stairs lead."

lines.content: 頂上に何かあるんじゃない？　神社とか。御茶屋とか。
lines.translated: "Maybe there's something at the top? Like a shrine. Or a teahouse."

lines.content: ……そんなことを笑顔で言い合いながら。
lines.translated: They chatted away like that with smiles on their faces.

lines.content: その背中を見送りながら、
lines.translated: Watching their backs as they went,

lines.content: 教えてあげたほうがいいのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder if I should tell them."

lines.content: 千和が小首をかしげるようにつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Chiwa murmured, tilting her head slightly.

lines.content: そこ、地元の人のお散歩コースで……。頂上には特に何もないですよって。ただ、景色がいいだけ
lines.translated: "That it's just a walking course for locals... and there's nothing special at the top. Just a nice view."

lines.content: 神社も。御茶屋も。何もなくて……。猫のお地蔵さんもいなかった。階段が一杯いっぱい続いてるだけで……ただ、それだけなんだって
lines.translated: "No shrine. No teahouse. Nothing at all... Not even a cat Jizo statue. Just flight after flight of stairs... and that's really all there is."

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: ……でも、まあ、景色がきれいなら充分なんじゃないかな。あの人たちにとっては
lines.translated: "...Still, if the view is pretty, don't you think that's plenty? At least for them."

lines.content: そうですか？　充分、ですか？
lines.translated: "Do you think so? Is that really enough?"

lines.content: ああ。旅行は日常の中にある一番身近な非日常だって言うだろ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. They say travel is the most accessible kind of extraordinary you can find in everyday life, right?"

lines.content: えっと……はじめて聞きました。誰の言ってた言葉ですか？
lines.translated: "Umm... that's the first I've heard of it. Who said that?"

lines.content: 俺だよ。俺に決まってる。俺が言ってた
lines.translated: "Me. Obviously me. I just said it."

lines.content: 何ですかそれ。なんだか兎蛙先輩みたいですよ
lines.translated: "What is that supposed to mean? You sound kind of like Tooya-senpai."

lines.content: くすくすと千和が笑う。
lines.translated: Chiwa giggled.

lines.content: 俺もつられて笑ってしまった。
lines.translated: Her laughter was contagious, and I ended up chuckling too.

lines.content: まあ、なんだ
lines.translated: "Well, you know."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 旅行は誰にでも体験できる非日常で……特別な時間だから。きっとさ、何でもないものでも特別に見えるんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Travel is a break from the ordinary that anyone can experience... It's a special time. So I bet even the most mundane things end up looking special."

lines.content: だからあの人たちにとって“景色がきれい”だけで充分なんだ。たくさんの階段を登ってのぼってある先に見つけられるものは。
lines.translated: That's why "a pretty view" is more than enough for those people, as the reward waiting for them after climbing all those stairs.

lines.content: ……なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 良くわからないところで良くわからない饒舌さがこぼれ出てしまったけれど――
lines.translated: I'd gotten weirdly talkative out of nowhere, rambling on about something I barely understood myself, but--

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ……特別な時間の中では、何でもないものでも特別に見えるんですよね？
lines.translated: "...During a special time, even ordinary things look special, right?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。うん。そういう場合もよくあるよねって話で
lines.translated: "Uh, yeah. Right. I just meant that happens a lot."

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……デートも、特別ですよね？
lines.translated: "...A date is special too, isn't it?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: なぜだかドキリとしてしまう。
lines.translated: For some reason, my heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: ……デートは……旅行よりも、きっと、特別ですよね？
lines.translated: "...A date is... surely even more special than a trip, right?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 先輩……。今日、私たちって、で、デート……してるんですよね？
lines.translated: "Senpai... Today, you and I are on a d-date... aren't we?"

lines.content: 俺は何も言えずにたたうなずいた――なんだかそんな自分をひどく情けないもののように感じながら。
lines.translated: Unable to say a word, I simply nodded--feeling like I was being awfully pathetic in the process.

lines.content: そうだ。ただうなずいただけなのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. All I did was nod.

lines.content: それなのに千和が、
lines.translated: And yet, Chiwa...

lines.content: え、えへへ
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe."

lines.content: ふにゃりと、微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Her face softened into a gentle smile.

lines.content: うれしそうに。
lines.translated: Looking so happy.

lines.content: ともすれば、幸せそうに……？
lines.translated: Or perhaps, even blissful...?

lines.content: そんな千和の表情に俺は、
lines.translated: Seeing that expression on Chiwa's face,

lines.content: 俺は。
自分の中に、何かこれまで意識もしていなかった気持ちが、ちょっとだけ、芽生――……いやっ、
lines.translated: Inside me, a feeling I'd never even been conscious of before began to sprout, just a little--...No, wait,

lines.content: っ
いやいや！
lines.translated: No, no!

lines.content: 俺は頭をぶんぶんと振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head furiously.

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違うぞ。
lines.translated: You've got it wrong.

lines.content: これは、ただのお礼なのだ。
lines.translated: This is just her way of thanking me.

lines.content: それ以上でも以下でもない。
lines.translated: Nothing more, nothing less.

lines.content: 千和だってそういうつもりしかないはずなんだ。
lines.translated: That has to be all Chiwa intends it to be, too.

lines.content: だって、そうだろう……？
lines.translated: I mean, that has to be it, right...?

lines.content: 昨日までごくふつうに幼馴染みの“関係性”だったのに、その距離感をぐっと縮めるかのような出来事だって、何もなかったはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Up until yesterday, we had a completely normal childhood-friend relationship, and nothing has happened to suddenly close that distance between us, yet...

lines.content: 自分を戒めるみたいに、ぎゅっと目を閉じ、唇を、噛んだ。
lines.translated: As if to admonish myself, I squeezed my eyes shut and bit my lip.

lines.content: だったら……先輩
lines.translated: "Then... Senpai."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: だったら？
lines.translated: Then what?

lines.content: 今日が……先輩と私との、その。えっと……特別な日……なら
lines.translated: "If today is... um, a special day... for you and me, Senpai..."

lines.content: 顔を伏せ……、
lines.translated: She lowered her gaze...

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: もにょもにょと、しながら、
lines.translated: Fidgeting and mumbling hesitantly,

lines.content: ただのお散歩も、先輩と一緒なら……その……特別な時間に、なりますよね……？
lines.translated: "Then even a simple walk... turns into a special time if I'm with you, right, Senpai...?"

lines.content: ふと、上目遣いで千和が俺を見上げた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Chiwa looked up at me through her lashes.

lines.content: 真っ赤だった。瞳が微かに揺れていた。
lines.translated: Her face was bright red. Her eyes were wavering slightly.

lines.content: 小さな唇をきょっと引き結び――勇気だ。勇気を出してようやく言えた言葉なんだと、そう、その表情が語っていた。
lines.translated: Her small lips were pressed tightly together--it was courage. Her expression told me it had taken all of her courage just to finally get those words out.

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: うそだろ。
lines.translated: No way.

lines.content: 千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa.

lines.content: なんだよ、その顔。
lines.translated: What's with that look on her face?

lines.content: ……まずい。
lines.translated: This is bad.

lines.content: ……かわいい
lines.translated: "...Cute."

lines.content: つい、言葉が唇から滑り落ちていた。
lines.translated: The word slipped right from my lips before I could stop it.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ぶぉっほっ！
lines.translated: "Bwah, cough!"

lines.content: 何言ってんだ、俺！
lines.translated: What am I saying?!

lines.content: げほげほと嘔吐く――わざとらしく。そうやってこぼれて落ちた言葉を掻き消そうとする。
lines.translated: I broke into a loud, obviously fake coughing fit, trying to drown out the word that had just spilled out.

lines.content: 先輩……？
lines.translated: "Senpai...?"

lines.content: 何でもない。いや。何でもないから
lines.translated: "It's nothing. Really. It's nothing at all."

lines.content: ふっ、と。
lines.translated: Hah.

lines.content: 平静を装い笑顔を見せたが……。
lines.translated: I put on a smile and pretended to be calm, but...

lines.content: 内心、焦っている。とってもだ。
lines.translated: Inside, I was panicking. Big time.

lines.content: なんだ。
lines.translated: What is it?

lines.content: どうした。
lines.translated: What's wrong?

lines.content: おかしいぞ。
lines.translated: This is weird.

lines.content: 今日の俺、どこかが変だぞ――と、そんな自分にようやく気づいた。
lines.translated: Something is seriously off with me today--I finally realized it.

lines.content: “千和とデート”
lines.translated: "A date with Chiwa."

lines.content: “いつもとちょっと違う互いの空気”
lines.translated: "The slightly different atmosphere between us than usual."

lines.content: そんな中で、俺は浮かれてしまっていたのだと……ようやくだ、ここに来てようやく俺は気づいた。
lines.translated: Caught up in all of that, I had gotten completely carried away... It took me until just now to finally realize it.

lines.content: 考えてみれば昨日の夜は眠れなかった。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, I couldn't sleep at all last night.

lines.content: 千和からもらったメールを何度も見返していた。
lines.translated: I kept rereading the text message Chiwa sent me over and over again.

lines.content: 眠れないのはいつものことだ。未来を不安に思い。過去を後悔に塗りつぶし。
lines.translated: Not being able to sleep is nothing new for me. Anxious about the future. Drowning the past in regret.

lines.content: そんな俺だから、いつもみたいに、[・|君][・|に]に甘えていたかった。
lines.translated: Because that's how I am, I wanted to lean on her for comfort, just like I always do.

lines.content: 『なあクロ。明日のことなんだけどさ……千和とデートすることになったんだ』
lines.translated: "'Hey, Kuro. About tomorrow... I ended up agreeing to go on a date with Chiwa.'"

lines.content: 一度切られたクロとの電話を、わざわざ繋ぎ直してまで俺は[・|明][・|日][・|の][・|不][・|安]を口にした。
lines.translated: Even after Kuro hung up on me once, I went out of my way to call her back just to voice my anxieties about tomorrow.

lines.content: 『まさか千和がこんな誘いをしてくれるなんて……どうしよう』
lines.translated: "'I never thought Chiwa would invite me out like this... What should I do?'"

lines.content: 『冗談だとは思うけど。何か、遊びの一環なんじゃないかって、思ってはいるけど……クロ。デートって。どんなふうにすればいいと思う？』
lines.translated: "'I think it's just a joke, though. I figure it's probably just part of some game, buuut... Kuro. How do you think I should act on a date?'"

lines.content: だが、そういう感じで、クロに今日のことを相談しようにも、
lines.translated: However, when I tried to consult Kuro about today like that...

lines.content: 『……デートのやりかたなんて、わたしに、わかるわけないよ。大雅は相談する相手を間違えてしまってる』
lines.translated: "'...There's no way I would know how to go on a date. You're asking the wrong person, Taiga.'"

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 『……大雅。わたしとは一度も……遊びでも、デートとか、してくれたことないのに』
lines.translated: "'...Taiga. You've never once... taken me on a date, not even as a game.'"
Wait.

lines.content: 『……このお電話は現在電波の届かないところにあるか持ち主の子猫が拗ねてしまっているのでまた明日の夜にお掛け直しください』
lines.translated: "'...The number you have dialed is currently out of service range, or the kitten who owns it is pouting, so please try calling again tomorrow night.'"

lines.content: そんな言葉を残して電話は切れた。それからは何度呼び出してみても繋がらなかった。
lines.translated: Leaving me with those words, the line went dead. After that, no matter how many times I tried calling back, it wouldn't connect.

lines.content: ふとそんな昨晩の出来事が脳裏を過ぎり……。
lines.translated: What happened last night suddenly flashed through my mind...

lines.content: なぜだか千和の犬耳姿が思い浮かんだ。
lines.translated: And for some reason, the image of Chiwa wearing dog ears popped into my head.

lines.content: そして同時に、なんだかちょっと面倒っちい感じだった、みんなの態度も脳裏を過ぎったのだ。
lines.translated: At the same time, the somewhat tiresome way everyone else had been acting crossed my mind, too.

lines.content: なんだか奇妙な違和感があった。
lines.translated: Something felt weirdly off about it all.

lines.content: まさか……。
lines.translated: Wait, could it be...?

lines.content: まさか、千和の態度におろおろする俺を、みんな、どこかで見てるんじゃ……。
lines.translated: Could everyone be hiding somewhere right now, watching me get all flustered over how Chiwa is acting...?

lines.content: あまりにもあんまりな邪推だろうとは思いつつも、辺りをきょろきょろと見回してしまう。
lines.translated: Even though I knew I was being way too paranoid, I couldn't help glancing around nervously.

lines.content: 先輩？　どうしたんですか？
lines.translated: "Senpai? What's wrong?"

lines.content: 隣の千和が、ぱちくりと目を瞬かせ、
lines.translated: Beside me, Chiwa blinked in surprise.

lines.content: 何か、先輩。さっきからきょろきょろばっかりしてますけど……気になることがありますか？　私にも教えてください。秘密は嫌です
lines.translated: "Senpai, you've been looking around restlessly for a while now... Is something bothering you? Please tell me too. I don't like secrets."

lines.content: 小首をかしげるような……何でもない仕草。
lines.translated: She tilted her head slightly... a completely ordinary gesture.

lines.content: そうだ。何でもない仕草だったはずなのだ。
lines.translated: Right. It should have been a completely ordinary gesture.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: デート……。
lines.translated: A date...

lines.content: そんな言葉が邪魔をして、
lines.translated: That word got in the way, and...

lines.content: くそ！
lines.translated: "Damn it!"

lines.content: 拳を握りしめ、叫ぶ。
lines.translated: I clenched my fist and shouted.

lines.content: ……心の中で。
lines.translated: In my mind.

lines.content: かわいいなあ、もう！
lines.translated: "She's way too cute, geez!"

lines.content: 幼馴染みのかわいい後輩とデートをしている……。
lines.translated: I'm on a date with my cute childhood friend and underclassman...

lines.content: そんな、いつもと違う特別な時間の中で、いつも見ているはずの千和が、俺は、なんだかとっても特別に――かわいく見えてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Caught up in this special, out-of-the-ordinary time, the same Chiwa I always saw somehow looked extra special--extra cute to me.

lines.content: 沈黙。
lines.translated: Silence.

lines.content: 千和は真っ赤に。
lines.translated: Chiwa turned bright red.

lines.content: 俺も、真っ赤に。
lines.translated: I turned bright red, too.

lines.content: 俺たちは見つめ合いながら、互いに目をぱちぱちとさせていた。
lines.translated: We stared at each other, both of us blinking in surprise.

lines.content: っ
バッと顔を背ける。
lines.translated: I whipped my head away.

lines.content: そして口を押さえた。
lines.translated: And slapped a hand over my mouth.

lines.content: “かわいいなあ、もう！”――と。
lines.translated: "She's way too cute, geez!"--

lines.content: 心の中で叫んだつもりが……おかしいな。思い切り口に出てしまっていたようだった。
lines.translated: I meant to shout that in my head, and yet... how weird. It seemed I had blurted it right out loud.

lines.content: せ、先輩……今、今の……かわいいって……
lines.translated: "S-Senpai... J-Just now... did you say cute...?"

lines.content: う。いや。その……えっと。うん
lines.translated: "Ugh. No. Um... well. Yeah."

lines.content: ダメなのか、千和。
lines.translated: No good, huh, Chiwa?

lines.content: 今の、聞こえなかったことにはしてくれないのか……千和。
lines.translated: You can't just pretend you didn't hear that for me... Chiwa?

lines.content: 俺はしどろもどろだ。
lines.translated: I was a stuttering mess.

lines.content: 視線もきょろきょろ定まらず……、
lines.translated: My eyes darted around, unable to focus on anything...

lines.content: ……きょ、今日、千和、えっと……いつもと雰囲気が少し……ち、違うから……あ、ああ！　髪っ、髪の毛、切った……？
lines.translated: "...T-Today, Chiwa, um... the vibe around you is a little... d-different than usual, so... Ah, right! Your hair, did you cut your hair...?"

lines.content: ああもう……。
lines.translated: Oh, man...

lines.content: 俺、何言ってんだろう。
lines.translated: What am I even saying?

lines.content: 会話に詰まると“あれ？　髪、切った？”ととりあえず聞いて会話を繋げ――と。
lines.translated: "When the conversation stalls, just ask 'Oh, did you get a haircut?' to keep things going"--

lines.content: いつか、どこかで読んだハウツー本に書いてあったのだ。
lines.translated: I'd read that in some how-to book somewhere, once upon a time.

lines.content: 黙ってしまう。沈黙だ。
lines.translated: I clammed up. Silence fell.

lines.content: 会話なんて繋がらない。
lines.translated: The conversation wasn't keeping going at all.

lines.content: ハウツーなんて。成功論なんて。
lines.translated: So much for how-to guides. So much for tips for success.

lines.content: そのどれもが[・|そ][・|の][・|人]にだから上手くいく方法論なのだ。
lines.translated: Every single one of those methodologies only works because of the person using them.

lines.content: ……ため息だ。
lines.translated: What a sigh.

lines.content: 心の中でため息をつく。
lines.translated: I heaved a sigh in my mind.

lines.content: 何、やってるんだろう……俺。
lines.translated: What am I even doing...?

lines.content: しかし、
lines.translated: However,

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: 突然、その沈黙に穴が開けられ、
lines.translated: Suddenly, a hole was pierced through that silence,

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 俺は、明らかに動揺しながら問いかけた。
lines.translated: And I asked a question, clearly shaken.

lines.content: な、なに、かな……
lines.translated: "W-What is it...?"

lines.content: あの……今日は……髪の毛、整えてきたんです
lines.translated: "Um... Today... I had my hair trimmed."

lines.content: え？　そ、そう、なの……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Y-You did...?"

lines.content: はい……。[・|お][・|父][・|さ][・|ん]にきれいにしてもらってきました
lines.translated: "Yes... I had my dad tidy it up for me."

lines.content: お父さんに……？
lines.translated: "Your dad...?"

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 髪……。ばっさり切ったわけじゃないけど、ちょっと整えてみただけだけど……先輩、あの……気づいてくれたんですか？
lines.translated: "My hair... I didn't cut a whole lot off or anything, just had it trimmed a little bit, but... Senpai, um... did you notice?"

lines.content: 前髪をちょいちょいと触りながら、真っ赤な頬のまま……千和が言う。
lines.translated: Fidgeting with her bangs, her cheeks still bright red... Chiwa spoke.

lines.content: さっきから、それを……気にしてくれていたんですか？　先輩……
lines.translated: "Is that what... you've been paying attention to this whole time? Senpai..."

lines.content: えっ……う、うん。まあ、うん。そういうこと、かな。うん。あ、あはは
lines.translated: "Huh...? Y-Yeah. Well, yeah. Something like that, I guess. Yeah. A-Ahaha."

lines.content: 嘘だ。
lines.translated: A lie.

lines.content: まったくの嘘をついてしまった。
lines.translated: I just told a complete and utter lie.

lines.content: 千和、本当に髪を切ってたなんて……。
lines.translated: To think Chiwa actually did get her hair cut...

lines.content: もちろん気づいてた。今日の千和、昨日と全然ちがうもんな。いつ言おうかずっと考えてたんだけど……はは、やっと言えたよ
lines.translated: "Of course I noticed. You look totally different from yesterday, Chiwa. I was trying to figure out the right time to bring it up... Haha, glad I finally got to say it."

lines.content: こんなのはバレバレの嘘だったと思う。
lines.translated: It had to be the most obvious lie in the world.

lines.content: なぜなら冷や汗も声のブレも視線の定まらなさも、まったくひどいものだったから――にも、関わらず。
lines.translated: Because between the cold sweat, my shaky voice, and my darting eyes, I was an absolute wreck--and yet, despite all that.

lines.content: え、えへへ。よかった
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe. What a relief."

lines.content: 千和はへにゃりと笑うのだった。
lines.translated: Chiwa broke into a soft, melting smile.

lines.content: あ、ありがとうございます。先輩
lines.translated: "Th-Thank you, Senpai."

lines.content: あの……実は、ちょっと切り過ぎちゃったかもって、お父さん言ってて……変だったら、似合ってなかったら、どうしようって……どきどきしてました
lines.translated: "Um... my dad actually said he might have cut off a little too much... I was so nervous about what I'd do if it looked weird or didn't suit me..."

lines.content: でもよかった、安心しましたと千和は言う。
lines.translated: "So I'm really glad, that's such a relief," Chiwa said.

lines.content: えへへ。先輩って意外と色々見てくれてるんですね。……私のこと。うれしいです
lines.translated: "Ehehe. You actually pay attention to a lot of little things, don't you, Senpai? ...About me. It makes me happy."

lines.content: は、はは……
lines.translated: "H-Haha..."

lines.content: それじゃ、行きましょうか。先輩
lines.translated: "Well then, shall we get going, Senpai?"

lines.content: え、って何ですか。デートです。デートの続きですよ
lines.translated: "What do you mean, 'Huh?' Our date. We're continuing our date."

lines.content: 千和は頬を膨らませ、
lines.translated: Chiwa puffed out her cheeks,

lines.content: だけどすぐに笑って、
lines.translated: But quickly broke into a smile,

lines.content: 今まで見つけられなかった猫ちゃんも、今日の先輩と一緒なら全部見つけられそうな気がしちゃいます
lines.translated: "I feel like I'll be able to find all the kitties I couldn't find before, as long as I'm with you today, Senpai."

lines.content: お、おおう……、そう、かな
lines.translated: "O-Oh... You think so?"

lines.content: はい。そうですよ。きっと
lines.translated: "Yes, I do. Definitely."

lines.content: 千和がにっこり笑う。まだ薄ら赤い頬を緩めて。
lines.translated: Chiwa beamed, her cheeks still tinged with a faint blush as her expression softened.

lines.content: 俺もつい、微笑んでしまう――……すっかりだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't help smiling back--...Man, she really got me.

lines.content: もうすっかり、今日は“お礼”のために集まったはずなのに目的が“デート”そのものにすり替わってしまっている――……ように、勘違いしてしまいそうになる。
lines.translated: Even though we were supposed to have met up today just to say "thank you," the whole point had completely shifted into an actual "date"--...or at least, it was easy to fool myself into thinking so.

lines.content: だってまた、手、繋いでるし……いつの間にか。
lines.translated: Especially since we were holding hands again... before I even realized it.

lines.content: ……手、繋いだまま歩くなんて。幼馴染み同士でそんなこと、変ですよね。本当なら
lines.translated: "...Walking around holding hands like this. It's weird for childhood friends to do that, isn't it? Normally, I mean."

lines.content: 俺と手を繋いだまま歩く千和が、ご機嫌そうにそんなことを言うものだから、
lines.translated: Walking beside me with her hand in mine, Chiwa said that in such a cheerful tone that,

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は……、
lines.translated: That I...

lines.content: 確かに、そうだろうけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah, it probably is, but..."

lines.content: 俺は、次第次第に[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|空][・|気]を強く意識し始めているのだと……気づいた。
lines.translated: I realized I was starting to become... acutely aware of *that kind of mood* between us.

lines.content: ……うん。行こうか
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Let's go."

lines.content: 気づいたからこそ、今日は、今日くらいは、そういう雰囲気を楽しんでみてもいいかもしれない――そんなふうに思った。
lines.translated: And precisely because I realized it, I figured it might be okay to just enjoy that atmosphere today, if only for today--that's what I thought.

lines.content: ある種、開き直りはじめたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: In a way, maybe I was just giving in to it.

lines.content: ……幼馴染みだって手くらい繋ぐさ。友人同士なんだから。小さな頃はそういうことも何度となくあっただろうし――
lines.translated: "...Even childhood friends hold hands sometimes. We're friends, after all. We probably did it plenty of times when we were little, too--"

lines.content: ――あの頃は[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]“恥ずかしい”と思わず、ごくふつうに、ごく当たり前に、手くらい繋げていたようにも思う。
lines.translated: --Back then, I don't think I ever felt embarrassed *like this*; holding hands was just a completely normal, natural thing to do.

lines.content: そしていつ頃から、こんなふうに、手を繋ぐことに抵抗感が芽生えてしまい始めたのだろうか――
lines.translated: When did I start feeling so hesitant about holding hands like this, anyway--?

lines.content: それは大人とか子どもとか、そういうものを明確に線引きするもののように思え――……。
lines.translated: It felt like something that drew a clear line between being a kid and being an adult--...

lines.content: [・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|も][・|の]に、俺は、抵抗したかったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe *that* was what I wanted to resist.

lines.content: 今日だけでも、昔に戻ったような気になってもいいかもしれない。何たって今日は、俺たちにとってちょっと特別な日だからね
lines.translated: "Maybe it's fine to pretend we're kids again, just for today. After all, today's a pretty special day for us."

lines.content: 俺は、千和と繋いだままの手を引いた……けれど。
lines.translated: I gently tugged Chiwa's hand, still laced with mine... however.

lines.content: 今日だけ……
lines.translated: "Just for today..."

lines.content: ぽつりと千和はそう言い、唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa murmured under her breath, pouting slightly.

lines.content: 千和と一緒に町中を歩いて回った。
lines.translated: I walked around town together with Chiwa.

lines.content: ……猫の像は確かにふたりで探すと見つけやすい。
lines.translated: The cat statues really were much easier to find with the two of us looking.

lines.content: 細い裏路地の隅々。
lines.translated: Every corner of the narrow back alleys.

lines.content: 家と家の間や側溝の端。
lines.translated: The spaces between houses and the edges of gutters.

lines.content: 山の急勾配に敷かれた階段をいくつも登っては降り。
lines.translated: Up and down countless flights of stairs built into the steep mountain slopes.

lines.content: これまで千和が見落としていたらしいものを、俺の視界でいくつか見つけることができた。
lines.translated: From my vantage point, I managed to spot several that Chiwa had apparently overlooked until now.

lines.content: 先輩、わたしよりずっと背が高いですもんね
lines.translated: "You're way taller than me, after all, Senpai."

lines.content: ぐっと背伸びをする千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa stretched up on her tiptoes.

lines.content: 俺の肩に頭をつけるみたいにして。
lines.translated: Resting her head almost against my shoulder.

lines.content: 視界が高いと、やっぱり、見えてる世界も私と違って全然高いんですよね。少しうらやましいです
lines.translated: "When your line of sight is higher, the world you see really is from a completely different height than mine. I'm a little jealous."

lines.content: あー……
一歩だ。
lines.translated: One step.

lines.content: いや、半歩だろうか。
lines.translated: No, maybe half a step.

lines.content: 俺は殆ど無意識に千和から距離を取りながら、
lines.translated: Almost unconsciously putting a little distance between myself and Chiwa, I said,

lines.content: 智仁だったらもっと見つけやすいのかもしれないな。あいつ、俺よりずっとイケメンで背が高いから。見えてる世界が全然ちがうだろうし
lines.translated: "Tomohito would probably have an even easier time finding them. That guy's way taller and better-looking than me. The world he sees must be totally different."

lines.content: イケメンなのは関係ありますか？
lines.translated: "Does being good-looking have anything to do with it?"

lines.content: ありますねえ。うん。関係は大ありだ
lines.translated: "Oh, it sure does. Yep. It has everything to do with it."

lines.content: この世はイケメンに限るんだよ。何を置いても、何をするにしても――……俺、思うんだけどさ
lines.translated: "This world is all about good-looking guys. No matter what the situation, no matter what you're doing--...At least, that's what I think."

lines.content: はい？
lines.translated: "Excuse me?"

lines.content: “ただしイケメンに限る”って名言があるよね
lines.translated: "You know that famous saying, 'Only applies if you're handsome,' right?"

lines.content: それ、名言なんだっていうのははじめて知りましたけど……はい。知ってますよ？
lines.translated: "This is the first I've heard of it being a famous saying, um... yes. I do know it?"

lines.content: この世界の神さまはさ、きっとイケメンが大好物なんだよ――
lines.translated: "The god of this world must have a massive soft spot for handsome guys--"

lines.content: だからさ、イケてる顔面が涙とかでぐちゃっとならないよう、いつも爽やかに微笑んでいられるよう、イケメンには楽しいことばかりを用意してるんだ
lines.translated: "So to make sure their handsome faces never get ruined by tears, and so they can always keep flashing those refreshing smiles, God lines up nothing but fun things for them."

lines.content: だって、ほら、イケメンはイケメンに産まれただけでさ、なんだかすっごい人生幸せそうっていうか、楽しそうに生きてるだろ？
lines.translated: "I mean, look, handsome guys seem like they're living these super happy, fun lives just by virtue of being born handsome, right?"

lines.content: うーん……
まあ……うん
lines.translated: "Well... yeah."

lines.content: 千和は首をかしげる。ちょっと考えるような仕草で。
lines.translated: Chiwa tilted her head in a slightly thoughtful gesture.

lines.content: 美人さんはそれだけで得なことは多そうですよね。男の人って、いやらしい人ばっかりだし
lines.translated: "Pretty girls probably get a lot of perks just for being pretty, too. Since men are all a bunch of perverts, anyway."

lines.content: お、おう。思わぬ矛先が……と、まあ、それはそれとしてね
lines.translated: "O-Oh. Didn't expect to catch a stray bullet there... B-But anyway, setting that aside."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: きっとイケメンとブサイクとでは見えてる世界そのものが違うんだよ。だからイケメンを連れてくれば何でもうまく行くって話だ。世界が味方してくれる
lines.translated: "I bet the very world a handsome guy sees is completely different from what an ugly guy sees. Which means if you bring a handsome guy along, everything will work out. The whole world is on their side."

lines.content: 捜し物はすぐ見つかるだろうし、悩み事も即座に解決。一攫千金だって夢じゃない。ああ、すてきだなあ。一家に一体、イケメンを飼育したいもんだよね
lines.translated: "Lost items turn up right away, and any troubles get solved on the spot. Even striking it rich isn't just a pipe dream. Ah, must be nice. Every household really ought to keep a pet handsome guy."

lines.content: 等と。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: やれやれと肩をすくめる俺に、
lines.translated: As I shrugged dramatically,

lines.content: 先輩はブサイクじゃないですよ？
lines.translated: "You aren't ugly, Senpai."

lines.content: 首をかしげながら、千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa said, tilting her head.

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: ……そう、なのかな
lines.translated: "...You think so?"

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: うなずく千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa nodded.

lines.content: 先輩は……かわいいですよ？
lines.translated: "You're... cute, Senpai."

lines.content: え。かわ、いい……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Cu-Cute...?"

lines.content: はい、そうです
lines.translated: "Yes, you are."

lines.content: だから自信持ってくださいよと千和が言うのだ。
lines.translated: "So please have more confidence in yourself," Chiwa added.

lines.content: 先輩は自分が思ってるより全然ブサイクじゃないし……。むしろとてもかわいい顔だって思います
lines.translated: "You're not ugly at all like you think you are, Senpai... In fact, I think you have a very cute face."

lines.content: ……う、うん。そっか、かわいいか
lines.translated: "...Y-Yeah. I see, cute, huh?"

lines.content: 私だけじゃなくって、みんなそう思ってるんじゃないかなあって思います
lines.translated: "And it's not just me, I think everyone feels that way."

lines.content: み、みんな……？
lines.translated: "E-Everyone...?"

lines.content: はい。みんなです。柊先輩も。夜月先輩も。たぶん、兎蛙先輩も
lines.translated: "Yes, everyone. Hiiragi-senpai, too. Yotsuki-senpai, too. And probably Tokawa-senpai, too."

lines.content: ……素直にありがとうと言えないな。なんとなく
lines.translated: "...Somehow, I can't bring myself to just say thank you to that."

lines.content: それに、神さまのイケメンの基準は兎蛙先輩じゃなくて奏先輩のほうかもしれませんよ？
lines.translated: "Besides, God's standard for a handsome guy might actually be you instead of Tokawa-senpai, Kanade-senpai."

lines.content: お？　お、おおう……？
lines.translated: "Huh? O-Oh, really...?"

lines.content: なぜかどきっとしてしまう我が胸だ。
lines.translated: For some reason, my heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: ダデ食う虫も好き好きって意味かな
lines.translated: "Guess there's no accounting for taste, huh?"

lines.content: はは
lines.translated: Haha.

lines.content: にこりとするが……、
lines.translated: She smiled sweetly, though...

lines.content: あ、あれ？
lines.translated: "H-Huh?"

lines.content: 目が笑っていなかった――もしかして、怒ってる？
lines.translated: The smile didn't reach her eyes--wait, is she mad?

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: あのですね、先輩
lines.translated: "Listen here, Senpai."

lines.content: ……何でしょう
lines.translated: "...Yes, ma'am?"

lines.content: 先輩の嫌いなところはすぐ私に意地悪してくるところと、そうやって時どきちょっと弱気だったりするところです。それがなければ……
lines.translated: "The things I hate about you are how quick you are to tease me, and how you get a little down on yourself like that sometimes, Senpai. If it weren't for those..."

lines.content: ……なければ？
lines.translated: "...If it weren't for those?"

lines.content: ……先輩は、とてもすてきな先輩だって思いますよ？
lines.translated: "...I think you're a really wonderful senpai, you know?"

lines.content: にこりとする。
lines.translated: She smiled sweetly.

lines.content: お、おおう
lines.translated: "O-Oh, right."

lines.content: 動揺してしまう。
lines.translated: That threw me for a loop.

lines.content: 今日の俺は、何度となく千和に[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|気][・|持][・|ち]にさせられてばかりだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa has been making me *feel like this* over and over again today.

lines.content: それからもう少し猫の像を探して町を回ると――お昼だ。
lines.translated: After we walked around town looking for cat statues a little longer--noon rolled around.

lines.content: そろそろお腹が空いてきた。太陽が一番高い位置。
lines.translated: I was starting to get hungry. The sun was at its highest point in the sky.

lines.content: 千和が俺の分までお弁当を作ってきてくれていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa had made and brought along a bento for me, too.

lines.content: 最初っから“お礼”だけでなく、こうしてふたりで過ごすことを千和は考えていたのかも知れない。
lines.translated: Maybe from the very beginning, Chiwa had been planning on spending time with me like this, not just thanking me.

lines.content: お弁当は公園で食べることにする。
lines.translated: We decided to eat the bento at the park.

lines.content: ベンチにふたり並んで腰を下ろした。
lines.translated: We sat down side by side on a bench.

lines.content: それぞれ膝に広げるお弁当。
lines.translated: Each of us opened a bento box on our lap.

lines.content: おお
lines.translated: "Whoa."

lines.content: 美味しそうだ。すごく。
lines.translated: It looked delicious. Really delicious.

lines.content: 千和、料理も上手なんだよな。
lines.translated: Chiwa is a great cook, too.

lines.content: あさひさんのおかげで手料理に飢えるようなことはなくとも、やはり、わざわざこうして作ってもらえるのはとてもうれしい。
lines.translated: Even though I'm never starved for home-cooked meals thanks to Asahi-san, having someone go out of their way to make food for me like this still makes me really happy.

lines.content: 正直町を歩き回ってお腹が空いた。
lines.translated: Honestly, walking all around town had worked up my appetite.

lines.content: 俺の分のお弁当はボリュームもある。さすがは幼馴染みだ。俺の好きなものがいっぱい入っていた。
lines.translated: My bento was pretty filling, too. Leave it to my childhood friend. It was packed with all of my favorite foods.

lines.content: 今すぐ合掌し、箸をつけたいところなのだけど……、
lines.translated: I wanted to clap my hands together in thanks and dig right in with my chopsticks, except...

lines.content: 手だ。
lines.translated: My hand.

lines.content: 千和とまだ手を繋いだままだった。
lines.translated: Chiwa and I were still holding hands.

lines.content: ……あの、千和？
lines.translated: "...Um, Chiwa?"

lines.content: と俺は言う。
lines.translated: I spoke up.

lines.content: はい。何ですか、先輩？
lines.translated: "Yes. What is it, Senpai?"

lines.content: と千和が首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Chiwa tilted her head.

lines.content: そろそろ手、離さない？
lines.translated: "Shouldn't we let go of each other's hands soon?"

lines.content: と、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: え？　どうしてですか？
lines.translated: "Huh? Why?"

lines.content: と、千和が目をぱちくりとさせる。
lines.translated: Chiwa blinked in surprise.

lines.content: いや、どうしてって……
lines.translated: "Well, I mean..."

lines.content: お弁当、食べづらいし。
lines.translated: It's hard to eat a bento like this.

lines.content: それに、
lines.translated: And besides,

lines.content: ……俺の手。汗ばんできてるから。気持ち悪いだろ？
lines.translated: "...My hand is getting sweaty. Isn't it gross?"

lines.content: 俺は、困ったように首をかしげる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head sheepishly.

lines.content: どうして気持ち悪いんですか？
lines.translated: "Why would it be gross?"

lines.content: 千和は、不思議そうに首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Chiwa tilted her head curiously.

lines.content: 私だって汗ばんでますよ。きっと。……いっぱい
lines.translated: "My hand is sweaty, too. I'm sure of it. ...Really sweaty."

lines.content: 照れたように笑うのだ。
lines.translated: She smiled bashfully.

lines.content: そして、繋いだ手にまた少し力が込められる。
lines.translated: Then, she squeezed my hand a little tighter again.

lines.content: いや、えっと……このままじゃお弁当、食べられないよ？　片手だけだと食べづらいっていうか
lines.translated: "No, um... We can't eat our bento like this, can we? It's kind of hard to eat with just one hand."

lines.content: そうですね……、だったら食べさせあいっこしましょう
lines.translated: "That's true... Then let's feed each other."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: た、食べさせあいっこって……。
lines.translated: F-Feed each other...?

lines.content: 薄々感じてはいたけれど……。確信に変わる。
lines.translated: I'd had a sneaking suspicion for a while now... and it just turned into certainty.

lines.content: 今日の千和はいつもと違い、なんだかとても大胆だ。
lines.translated: Unlike her usual self, Chiwa is being awfully bold today.

lines.content: 何が食べたいですか？
lines.translated: "What would you like to eat?"

lines.content: え、えっと……
戸惑っている。千和のいつもと違う、積極的な態度に……。
lines.translated: I was thrown off by Chiwa's unusually assertive attitude...

lines.content: 卵焼き。自信作です
lines.translated: "How about the rolled omelet? I'm really proud of how it turned out."

lines.content: あ、ああ。そうなんだ。だったらそれを
lines.translated: "O-Oh, really? Then I'll have that."

lines.content: はい。ど、どうぞ……あ～ん、してください
lines.translated: "Okay. H-Here you go... Please say 'aah.'"

lines.content: あ、あ～ん……
lines.translated: "A-Aah..."

lines.content: そっと口に納められる卵焼き。
lines.translated: She gently placed the rolled omelet into my mouth.

lines.content: うん。確かに美味しい。
lines.translated: Mmm. That really is good.

lines.content: 千和は卵焼きに砂糖を入れる派なんだね
lines.translated: "So you're the type who puts sugar in your rolled omelets, Chiwa."

lines.content: あ、はい。苦手でしたか？
lines.translated: "Oh, yes. Do you not like them sweet?"

lines.content: ううん
lines.translated: "Unh-unh."

lines.content: あさひさんが砂糖は断然なし派だからね。あの人の味付けは絶妙で、そして趣向が渋いんだよ。だから甘い卵焼きは珍しいんだ。俺にとって
lines.translated: "Asahi-san is strictly against using sugar, you see. Her seasoning is exquisite, and she has pretty refined tastes. So sweet rolled omelets are a rare treat for me."

lines.content: あ、ああー、そうだったような気もします
lines.translated: "O-Oh, right, I think I remember hearing that."

lines.content: 苦笑いを浮かべ、『今度は私に』と千和が言う。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, Chiwa said, "Now it's my turn."

lines.content: 私も卵焼き、ほしいです。先輩、お願いします
lines.translated: "I want a piece of the rolled omelet, too. Please, Senpai."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 慎重に箸を操って、千和の口に卵焼きを納める。
lines.translated: Carefully maneuvering my chopsticks, I placed a piece of the rolled omelet into Chiwa's mouth.

lines.content: 何度かそうして食べさせ合った。
lines.translated: We went back and forth feeding each other a few times like that.

lines.content: 手は、繋いだままだ。
lines.translated: All the while, we kept holding hands.

lines.content: ……離さない。
lines.translated: Refusing to let go.

lines.content: だけどお弁当は食べる。
lines.translated: Even so, we ate our bento.

lines.content: 互いに順番で食べさせ合う。
lines.translated: Taking turns feeding each other.

lines.content: 疑似のデートで疑似の恋愛。
lines.translated: A pretend date, a pretend romance.

lines.content: 未だになぜこういう運びになってしまったのか、上手に納得できてはいないが――手を繋いだまま、お弁当。
lines.translated: I still couldn't quite wrap my head around how things had ended up like this--eating our bento while holding hands.

lines.content: う、うーん。
lines.translated: H-Hmm.

lines.content: なんだか今日は奇妙なことの連続だなあと思う。
lines.translated: Today really has been one strange thing after another, I thought.

lines.content: ……なんだかさ、積極的だなあ、千和
lines.translated: "...You know, you're being pretty assertive today, Chiwa."

lines.content: つい、そう口走ってしまった。
lines.translated: The words slipped out before I could stop them.

lines.content: そ、そうですか……？
lines.translated: "D-Do you think so...?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 今朝はまだ、何をするのにもすぐ真っ赤になってたように思うけど……
lines.translated: "Just this morning, I feel like you were turning bright red over every little thing..."

lines.content: そ、それは……その。はい
lines.translated: "T-That's... well. Yes."

lines.content: 少し赤くなる。だけどそのままにこりと、笑う。
lines.translated: She blushed a little. Even so, she broke into a warm smile right after.

lines.content: ちょっとだけ慣れてきたのかもしれません。それに
lines.translated: "Maybe I've gotten a little used to it. And besides..."

lines.content: うん？　それに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? Besides?"

lines.content: はい……
ちょっとだけ、ですよ？　先輩と[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]するのが楽しいって……そう、思えてきたのかもしれません。恥ずかしいより、楽しいが勝ってきてるんだと、思います。え、えへへ
lines.translated: "Just a little bit, okay? I think I'm starting to feel like... doing *this* with you is fun, Senpai. I think the fun is starting to win out over the embarrassment. E-Ehehe."

lines.content: 笑顔だった。満面の。
lines.translated: She was smiling. Beaming from ear to ear.

lines.content: 俺へと真っ直ぐに向けられた……笑顔。
lines.translated: A smile... aimed straight at me.

lines.content: 俺はついそこから目をそらし、一度、二度、と軽く咳払いをするばかりだった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help looking away, clearing my throat lightly once, then twice.

lines.content: ……お弁当は俺のほうが大きい。
lines.translated: My bento was bigger than hers.

lines.content: 千和が先に食べ終える。
lines.translated: So Chiwa finished eating first.

lines.content: だから最後は、千和が俺に一方的に食べさせてくれる形になった。
lines.translated: Which meant that toward the end, it turned into a one-sided affair of Chiwa feeding me.

lines.content: 大丈夫自分で食べられるよと言うけれど、
lines.translated: I told her I was fine and could eat on my own, but...

lines.content: だめですよ。私には全部食べさせてくれたのに……中途半端なのは嫌いです。はい、あ～んしてください、先輩。もう少しで“ごちそうさま”ですよ
lines.translated: "No way. You fed me every last bite of mine... I don't like leaving things halfway done. Here, please say 'aah,' Senpai. You're almost completely finished."

lines.content: 結局最後まで食べさせてもらってしまった。
lines.translated: In the end, I wound up letting her feed me the rest of it.

lines.content: ……ああ、もう。
lines.translated: Oh, man.

lines.content: 千和は慣れてきたと言うけれど……、だめだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa said she's gotten used to it, but... I haven't.

lines.content: 今度は俺のほうが妙に気恥ずかしさを覚え始めている。
lines.translated: Now I'm the one starting to feel strangely embarrassed.

lines.content: 公園に集まり遊んでいた子どもらが、にやにやしながらこちらを見ているのが、なんだか……なんだかすごく、居心地悪い。
lines.translated: The kids who had gathered to play in the park were grinning as they watched us, which made me feel... really, really self-conscious.

lines.content: だから少し気を紛らわせるため、
lines.translated: So, to distract myself a little,

lines.content: ……千和の、お父さんだけど
lines.translated: "...About your dad, Chiwa."

lines.content: まったくこの場には相応しくない話を、俺はする。
lines.translated: I brought up a topic that didn't fit the mood at all.

lines.content: え？　お父さん、ですか？
lines.translated: "Huh? My dad?"

lines.content: うん。ちょっと不思議に思ったことがあって
lines.translated: "Yeah. There's something I've been wondering about."

lines.content: ……はい。何でしょう
lines.translated: "...Okay. What is it?"

lines.content: ああ。別に何がどうってことじゃないんだけどさ
lines.translated: "Well, it's nothing major or anything, really."

lines.content: 等と言い訳じみた前口上を添え、言う。
lines.translated: After prefacing it with something that sounded like an excuse, I continued.

lines.content: 千和のお父さん。お店で働き始めてまだ数日だけど――まだ一度も会ってないなあって
lines.translated: "Your dad. I know it's only been a few days since I started working at the cafe, but--I realized I haven't met him even once yet."

lines.content: 前々から思ってはいたんだ
lines.translated: "It's something I've been wondering about for a while now."

lines.content: 何を、でしょうか
lines.translated: "What have you been wondering about?"

lines.content: いつもお店、千和は殆どひとりでこなしてるけど――
lines.translated: "You pretty much always handle the cafe all by yourself, Chiwa, so--"

lines.content: 厨房のスタッフなどは数人いるが、それだけだ。店内スタッフは千和だけ。大忙しな時間帯を迎えて尚、千和ひとりだけが小さな店内を走り回っている。
lines.translated: There are a few kitchen staff members, but that's it. Chiwa is the only one working the floor. Even during the busiest rush hours, Chiwa is the only one running around the small cafe.

lines.content: ……千和のお父さんは、お店を手伝ったりしないのかなって。大きなお世話だろうと思うけど、ふと気になってさ
lines.translated: "...I was just wondering if your dad ever helps out at the cafe. I know it's probably none of my business, but it crossed my mind."

lines.content: 俺が手伝いに入ったことでとても助かった、と千和は言ってくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa had told me that having me come in to help was a huge relief.

lines.content: それほど忙しいのなら、どうして、千和のお父さんは職場であろうはずのお店に姿を見	せないのだろうか――
lines.translated: If things were that busy, why did her dad never show his face at the cafe, which was supposed to be his workplace?

lines.content: それはお客としてお店に出入りしていた頃から、僅かながらに抱いていた疑問だった。
lines.translated: It was a slight question I'd had ever since I was just a regular customer dropping by the shop.

lines.content: ……私のお父さんは、ちょっと身体が弱いんです
lines.translated: "...My dad has a somewhat weak constitution."

lines.content: 千和が言う。苦笑いで。
lines.translated: Chiwa said with a wry smile.

lines.content: この頃は特に身体の調子が悪いみたいで……。日中はいつも自分の部屋で寝ているみたいです
lines.translated: "Lately, he's been feeling especially unwell... It seems like he spends the whole day sleeping in his room."

lines.content: でも、お父さん。夜になると身体の調子が少し良くなるみたいで……。夜のうちに次の日の準備を色々としておいてくれるんです
lines.translated: "But once night falls, he starts feeling a little better... So he takes care of all sorts of preparations for the next day during the night."

lines.content: 次の日の準備。……お店の？
lines.translated: "Preparations for the next day... For the shop?"

lines.content: そうです。コーヒー豆や食材の発注とか、お金の管理だとか。難しいことは全部お父さんが夜にやっていてくれます。あと、新しいメニューを一緒に考えたりもしていますよ
lines.translated: "Yes. Like ordering coffee beans and ingredients, or managing the finances. My dad handles all the complicated stuff at night. Oh, and we also come up with new menu items together."

lines.content: ……なるほど
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: 俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: 千和のお父さんが夜にがんばってくれていて、そして俺たちがお昼にがんばる。そんな感じなのかな。役割分担としては
lines.translated: "So your dad works hard at night, and we work hard during the day. I guess that's how the roles are divided up, huh?"

lines.content: そうですね。そういう感じでしょうか
lines.translated: "Right. I suppose that's a good way to put it."

lines.content: 千和のお父さん、か。
lines.translated: Chiwa's dad, huh?

lines.content: そのことについて千和に問いかけたのは、あまり真剣な意図があってのことではなかったが……ふと、思い出したのだ。
lines.translated: I hadn't asked her about him with any serious intentions, but... it suddenly jogged a memory.

lines.content: 俺の中に、“千和のお父さん”に関する思い出があることを。
lines.translated: The fact that I had a memory of "Chiwa's dad" inside me.

lines.content: ……随分と昔のことだけど、千和と一緒に、絵を描いてもらったよね
lines.translated: "...It was a really long time ago, but he painted a picture of the two of us together, didn't he?"

lines.content: 思い出されるのは鼻をつく絵の具とシンナーの香り。そして穏やかに流れる旋律だった。
lines.translated: What came to mind was the sharp smell of paint and thinner. And a gentle melody drifting through the air.

lines.content: ふたりの似顔絵を……本格的な感じだったから肖像画と言ったほうがいいのかもしれませんが……はい。そういうこともありましたね。……本当に、ずっとずっと昔のことですけど
lines.translated: "A picture of the two of us... Though it looked so professional it might be better to call it a portrait... Yes, that did happen, didn't it? ...Really, a long, long time ago."

lines.content: 千和のお父さんは“芸術家”である――と、記憶している。カフェを営業するのと同時、自室をアトリエとし、様々な創作を日々行っている。
lines.translated: If I remember right, Chiwa's dad is an "artist." Alongside running the cafe, he uses his room as an atelier, spending his days creating all sorts of works.

lines.content: それが杏藤千和のお父さん[あんどう|杏藤][かずま|一磨]だ。
lines.translated: That man is Chiwa Ando's father, Kazuma Ando.

lines.content: ……今も[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]のことを忘れずいるのは、どういう流れでそうなったのかは思い出せないが……。
lines.translated: Even though I can't remember the exact chain of events that led to it, I still haven't forgotten *that time*...

lines.content: 自室に呼ばれた俺と千和は、カンバスに向かうお父さんの前に並んで座らされ――
lines.translated: Chiwa and I were called into his room and made to sit side by side in front of her dad as he faced a canvas--

lines.content: そんな俺たちふたりの肖像画を、千和のお父さんはものの数分で描き上げた。
lines.translated: And he painted a portrait of the two of us in a matter of minutes.

lines.content: その出来映えがあまりに[・|き][・|れ][・|い]だったので、今もこうして記憶はすり切れることもなく、俺の心に残っている。
lines.translated: The finished piece was so *beautiful* that the memory remains vivid in my heart even now, never fading away.

lines.content: ……俺、やっぱり千和のお父さんに挨拶くらいしないとだよな。このままお店で働かせてもらうなら
lines.translated: "...I really should go say hello to your dad, shouldn't I? If I'm going to keep working at the shop."

lines.content: そんな――ごくごく当たり前にすぎるだろう常識を欠いてしまっていたことに、ここにきてようやく気づけた俺であった。
lines.translated: It took until now for me to finally realize I had been lacking such utterly basic common sense.

lines.content: お弁当を食べ終え、少し休憩。
lines.translated: After finishing our bentos, we took a short break.

lines.content: いっぱいに満たされたお腹を落ち着かせようと……、しばし俺たちはぼーっとしながら町の光景を眺めていた。
lines.translated: Letting our full stomachs settle... we zoned out for a little while, gazing out over the townscape.

lines.content: この公園は山の少しだけ高い場所にある。
lines.translated: This park sits slightly up on the mountain.

lines.content: だから町の景色をこうして眺めることができた。
lines.translated: Because of that, we had a clear view of the town below.

lines.content: 風が吹く。
lines.translated: The wind blew.

lines.content: 花の香りを運ぶ春の風。
lines.translated: A spring breeze carrying the scent of flowers.

lines.content: 隣に座る千和が眩しそうに目を細めていた。
lines.translated: Sitting beside me, Chiwa squinted against the bright light.

lines.content: 千和。今、何を考えているんだろう。
lines.translated: Chiwa. I wonder what she's thinking about right now.

lines.content: ……今日の千和は、なんだか積極的であるように思える。
lines.translated: She seems kind of assertive today.

lines.content: 今に至るまでの言動行動を見ていてもそれは明らか――と言っていいはずだ。
lines.translated: Looking at everything she's said and done up to this point, that much is obvious--or at least, it's fair to say so.

lines.content: 俺は、不思議でならない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but wonder why.

lines.content: いきなり“デートしましょう”と誘ってきたことや。そのモチベーションも、いったいどこから産まれるのだろう。
lines.translated: Inviting me out on a "date" out of the blue like that. Where on earth did the motivation for all of this come from?

lines.content: 千和に限らず、女の子の考えることはよくわからないなあ。
lines.translated: Not just with Chiwa, either--I really don't understand what goes on inside a girl's head.

lines.content: 等と。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: そんなことを悶々と、延々と……、
lines.translated: Round and round those thoughts went, endlessly...

lines.content: まだずっと繋がれたままの手を見つめ、俺は考えている。
lines.translated: As I stared down at our still-intertwined hands, lost in thought.

lines.content: 今日はありがとうございます。先輩
lines.translated: "Thank you for today, Senpai."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 先輩のおかげで今日はたくさん、猫の像を見つけられました
lines.translated: "Thanks to you, I was able to find a whole bunch of cat statues today."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: いつも通学で使ってる道にも一匹見つかって……驚きました。捜し物は背の高い人のほうが得意だっていうのは本当なんですね
lines.translated: "We even found one on the road I always take to school... That really surprised me. It really is true that tall people are better at finding things."

lines.content: いや。きっとそうでもないよ。反対に低い場所にあるものは見つけにくいんじゃないかな。背の高い人間には
lines.translated: "Nah, I don't think that's necessarily true. On the flip side, it's probably harder for tall people to spot things down low."

lines.content: じゃあ先輩と私、ふたりで探したら見つからないものはどこにもないかもしれませんね。背がおっきい先輩と……まあ、どちらかといえば、ちっさい私ですから
lines.translated: "Then if the two of us look together, Senpai, maybe there's nothing in the world we couldn't find. Since you're so tall... and, well, I'm on the smaller side, relatively speaking."

lines.content: 自分で言っておいてもやっとしたのか、千和は唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: As if she'd annoyed herself just by saying it, Chiwa pouted.

lines.content: 千和が番号の振られてる像をすべて見つけ出したいのは、景品の折り紙が、気に入った柄に更新されたとき。ゲットしやすいように、と言っていたけれど……
lines.translated: "You said the reason you want to find all the numbered statues is so you can easily get the origami prize whenever they update it to a pattern you like, right? Still..."

lines.content: 千和は、何をお願いするんだろう
lines.translated: "I wonder what you'd wish for, Chiwa."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 番号の振られた像をすべて見つけて、順番に願い事をしながら手を合わせて回れば、その願い事を叶えてもらえる――だったかな
lines.translated: "If you find all the numbered statues and go around putting your hands together to make a wish at each one in order, your wish will come true--that was how it went, right?"

lines.content: ……はい。この町の“噂”のひとつですね
lines.translated: "...Yes. That's one of the 'rumors' around this town."

lines.content: ああ。千和と猫の象を探して歩いてるとき。ふと、思い出したんだ。その“噂”について
lines.translated: "Yeah. While we were walking around looking for the cat statues together, I suddenly remembered that 'rumor.'"

lines.content: うなずいて、俺は続ける。
lines.translated: Nodding, I continued.

lines.content: もしもこの先、番号の振られている像をすべて見つけられる未来に、千和が行き着いたとして……
lines.translated: "If you eventually reach a future where you've found every single numbered statue, Chiwa..."

lines.content: そのとき千和は、どんなお願いをするんだろう。それが少し気になったんだ
lines.translated: "What kind of wish would you make then? I got a little curious about that."

lines.content: 千和の“願い”
lines.translated: Chiwa's "wish."

lines.content: そこにこそ千和の“夢”に関係する何かがあるのではないか。根拠だってまるでないけれど、そう思えたのだ。
lines.translated: Couldn't there be something connected to her "dream" right there? I had zero basis for it, yet I couldn't shake the feeling.

lines.content: かつての幼い彼女が、“[奇跡|魔法]”までをも必要としたもの。
lines.translated: Something her younger self had needed even a "miracle"--"magic"--to achieve.

lines.content: 彼女の困難。
lines.translated: Her struggles.

lines.content: 彼女の悲しみ。
lines.translated: Her sorrow.

lines.content: 彼女の叶えたかった“夢”
lines.translated: The "dream" she had wanted to fulfill.

lines.content: 俺は、左手を握りしめ――……
lines.translated: I clenched my left hand tightly--...

lines.content: もしも千和にどうしても叶えたい願いや夢があったとして……
lines.translated: "Supposing you had a wish or a dream you wanted to come true no matter what, Chiwa..."

lines.content: その願い事は、千和。君ひとりではどうしても叶えられないものだったのかな？
lines.translated: "Was that wish something you could never make come true all by yourself?"

lines.content: 猫たちや、もしかしたら神さまに祈らなければならないほど、どうしようもなく大変なもの、だったのかな
lines.translated: "Something so overwhelmingly difficult that you'd have to pray to the cats, or maybe even to God?"

lines.content: ……思わず俺は、神妙なふうにしてそう聞いてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Without thinking, I asked her that with a solemn look on my face.

lines.content: しかしすぐに後悔した。
lines.translated: But I regretted it right away.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 早まっただろうか。
lines.translated: Had I jumped the gun?
