lines.content: まだまだ時期尚早だっただろうか。
lines.translated: Was it still way too soon for this?

lines.content: “関係性”こそが“魔法の鍵”だとあさひさんは言った――“関係性”、ふたりの関係。
lines.translated: Asahi-san had told me that our "relationship" was the "key to magic"--a "relationship," the bond between the two of us.

lines.content: 俺は……。
千和の“魔法”で、千和の“夢”を叶えたい。
lines.translated: I want to grant Chiwa's "dream" using Chiwa's "magic."

lines.content: そうすることで俺自身の“夢”も叶うはずだと信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe that doing so will make my own "dream" come true as well.

lines.content: だから俺は、千和と今以上に近しい距離に……何らかの関係に前進しなければならないのだけれど。
lines.translated: That's why I need to get closer to Chiwa than I am now... to move our relationship forward somehow, and yet.

lines.content: ……先輩？
lines.translated: "...Senpai?"

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: ハッとする。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I gasped.

lines.content: いや、ごめん。何でもないよ
lines.translated: "Nah, sorry. It's nothing."

lines.content: 思わず千和の顔をじっと見つめてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I realized I had been staring intently at Chiwa's face.

lines.content: どうして、先輩が謝るんですか？
lines.translated: "Why are you apologizing, Senpai?"

lines.content: いや……
不躾だったよな。人の願いだとか。夢だとか。そういうのってさ、あまり軽々しく問いかけていいものじゃないって、俺は思ってたはずなのに……
lines.translated: "That was insensitive of me. People's wishes, their dreams... I always thought those weren't things you should pry into so lightly, and yet..."

lines.content: 夢も願いも誰に言われるまでもなく千差万別。
lines.translated: It goes without saying that dreams and wishes vary wildly from person to person.

lines.content: ならばその夢や願いに対する態度も、また、千差万別……十人十色だ。
lines.translated: Which means the way people feel about their dreams and wishes varies wildly, too... Everyone is different.

lines.content: 様々な事情や道理が、その人その人の人生には横たわっているはず。
lines.translated: Every single person has all sorts of circumstances and reasons underlying their life.

lines.content: 俺に……、
lines.translated: Just like how I have...

lines.content: どうしても……、
lines.translated: No matter what...

lines.content: ……どうしても、
lines.translated: No matter what,

lines.content: 助けなければならない人たちがいるように。
lines.translated: People I have to save.

lines.content: その人のことを誰にも、話すわけにはいかないように。
lines.translated: And just like how I can't tell anyone about her.

lines.content: 私は、平気ですよ
lines.translated: "I don't mind."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私は、平気なんです。先輩
lines.translated: "I really don't mind, Senpai."

lines.content: 千和が小さく微笑みながら、そう応えてくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa answered with a small smile.

lines.content: 先輩になら平気です。何でも話して、何でも聞いて欲しいって、ずっと昔から思っていますよ
lines.translated: "If it's you, Senpai, I don't mind. For a long, long time now, I've wanted to tell you everything, and for you to listen to everything."

lines.content: そう言い向けられた微笑みがどうにも眩しすぎて、
lines.translated: The smile she turned on me as she said that was far too dazzling.

lines.content: 俺は、唇を強く結んでしまう。
lines.translated: I pressed my lips tightly together.

lines.content: ……先輩の言うとおり、私には叶えられなかった夢があります
lines.translated: "...Just like you said, Senpai, there is a dream I couldn't make come true."

lines.content: ……そのとき叶えるはずだった“夢”も、
lines.translated: Both the "dream" I was supposed to fulfill back then,

lines.content: ……そのとき得られるはずだった“魔法”も、
lines.translated: and the "magic" I was supposed to obtain back then,

lines.content: どちらも今の自分にはないもので……
lines.translated: "Neither of them is something I have right now..."

lines.content: どちらも、もう、どうしようもできないものになってしまったけれど……、
lines.translated: And both have become things I can no longer do anything about on my own, yet...

lines.content: もし先輩が私の夢を叶えるために、何か力を貸してくれるなら――ううん。知恵とかでもいいんです。意見だとか。そんな感じでもいい。そういう何かを、貸してくれるなら
lines.translated: "If you're willing to lend me your strength to help make my dream come true, Senpai--no, even just your wisdom would be fine. Or your opinion. Anything like that. If you'll lend me something like that..."

lines.content: 先輩になら……
lines.translated: "If it's you, Senpai..."

lines.content: そこで言葉を切り、千和がじっと俺を見つめた。
lines.translated: Cutting herself off there, Chiwa stared straight at me.

lines.content: 千和……？
lines.translated: "Chiwa...?"

lines.content: 俺は、首をかしげる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: そんな俺がおかしかったのか、千和は少しだけ意地悪そうな顔をして、
lines.translated: Maybe my reaction amused her, because a slightly teasing look crossed her face.

lines.content: ううん。やっぱり前言、撤回してもいいですか？
lines.translated: "No, wait. Can I take back what I just said?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 今日の先輩じゃないといやです
lines.translated: "I don't want to unless it's the Senpai from today."

lines.content: 今日の、俺？
lines.translated: "The me... from today?"

lines.content: はい……。今日の、私にやさしい先輩になら、いいですよ？　私の叶えられなかった夢を聞いてもらっても……って思います
lines.translated: "Yes... If it's the Senpai from today who's being so sweet to me, then I don't mind. I think I'd like you to hear about the dream I couldn't fulfill..."

lines.content: どこか得意そうな顔で千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa said with a somewhat smug look on her face.

lines.content: いつもの意地悪な先輩じゃありませんよ？　今日の、私にやさしい先輩じゃないとだめです。私の夢、私のお願い……教えてあげたくありません
lines.translated: "Not the usual mean Senpai, okay? It has to be the Senpai from today who's sweet to me. Otherwise, I don't want to tell you... about my dream, or my wish."

lines.content: ……むう
lines.translated: "...Mmph."

lines.content: 俺は眉根を寄せた。
lines.translated: I furrowed my brow.

lines.content: ……それは
はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: んんんん～……っ。それはとても、とっても、難しい要求だな。少し考えさせてほしい
lines.translated: "Hmmmm... That's a very, very difficult demand. Let me think about it for a bit."

lines.content: もう。どうしてそんな真剣に考え込んでるんですか
lines.translated: "Geez. Why are you thinking it over so seriously?"

lines.content: 呆れたような顔だった。
lines.translated: She gave me an exasperated look.

lines.content: 簡単なお願いじゃないですか。明日からずっと、今日みたいに私にやさしくしてほしいって、ただそれだけなのに……
lines.translated: "Isn't it a simple request? All I'm asking is for you to keep being sweet to me starting tomorrow, just like you were today..."

lines.content: でも、俺さ。そんなにいつもと変わった態度、取ってるつもりもないんだけどな
lines.translated: "Yeah, well... I don't really feel like I'm acting all that different from usual, though."

lines.content: ううん。そんなことないです。今日の先輩、いつもより私にやさしいです
lines.translated: "No, that's not true. You're much sweeter to me today than you usually are, Senpai."

lines.content: 微笑んで見せてくれる。
lines.translated: She flashed me a gentle smile.

lines.content: あんまり意地悪なことしないし、言わないし……。それにちゃんと……ほら。お願いしたように、ずっと私と手、握ったままでいてくれますよ
lines.translated: "You haven't done or said anything too mean... And besides... look. You're still holding my hand, just like I asked you to."

lines.content: だから今日の私にやさしい先輩になら、秘密を話してみても平気です。改めてそう言う千和から、俺は思わず、視線を逸らしてしまう。
lines.translated: "So if it's the Senpai from today who's so sweet to me, I don't mind telling you my secret." As Chiwa reiterated that, I couldn't help looking away from her.

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私、“さよなら”が嫌いなんです
lines.translated: "I hate 'goodbyes.'"

lines.content: ぽつりと、千和がそう言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa murmured the words quietly.

lines.content: ……さよならが？
lines.translated: "...Goodbyes?"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]が千和の秘密なのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was that Chiwa's secret?

lines.content: ならば慎重に対応しなければならないとは、感じつつ――しかし思わず、すぐに問い返してしまった。
lines.translated: Even though I knew I needed to tread carefully here--I ended up asking her right back without thinking.

lines.content: どうして……、千和はさよならが嫌いなんだろう
lines.translated: "Why... do you hate goodbyes, Chiwa?"

lines.content: 俺は、だめだな。どうしてかそう問わずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: Man, I'm hopeless. For some reason, I just couldn't stop myself from asking.

lines.content: 彼女らの“夢”を叶えるための“魔法”……。
lines.translated: The "magic" meant to grant these girls' "dreams"...

lines.content: それらに危険が潜んではいないか。それらの善悪の所在はいかほどであるのか。
lines.translated: Did danger lurk within it? Where did it fall on the line between good and evil?

lines.content: そう見極めることを“夜の魔法使い”から期待された“魔法少女『使い』”として、まだまだ全然、未熟なのだろう――慎重さというものがまるで足りない。
lines.translated: As a "Magical Girl 'User'" expected by the "Magician of the Night" to discern those things, I was still completely inexperienced--utterly lacking in caution.

lines.content: それでも俺は知りたい。
lines.translated: Even so, I wanted to know.

lines.content: 千和の心を知りたいと思っている。
lines.translated: I wanted to know what was in Chiwa's heart.

lines.content: 私は
……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 私は、大切な、大切な……せめて大切だと思いたいたくさんのものを、守りたかったんです
lines.translated: "There were so many precious, precious things... or at least, things I wanted to believe were precious, that I wanted to protect."

lines.content: 守りたい。……何から？
lines.translated: "Protect them... From what?"

lines.content: “さよなら”からです
lines.translated: "From 'goodbye.'"

lines.content: 千和は言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa said.

lines.content: 苦笑いで。
lines.translated: With a bitter smile.

lines.content: ともすれば、さみしそうな眼差しで。
lines.translated: And what looked like a lonely gaze.

lines.content: 私は、私の大切なものを“さよなら”から守りたかった
lines.translated: "I wanted to protect the things precious to me from 'goodbye.'"

lines.content: そこで、千和は唇を結んだ。続きかけた言葉を沈黙で切り落としてしまう。
lines.translated: With that, Chiwa pressed her lips together, cutting off whatever she was about to say next with silence.

lines.content: 俺は、その先の言葉を待っていた。
lines.translated: I waited for the rest of her words.

lines.content: 握られた手と手。
lines.translated: Our hands remained clasped together.

lines.content: 千和の唇からもしも“秘密”の“答え”がこぼれ落ちたなら――
lines.translated: If the "answer" to her "secret" were to spill from Chiwa's lips--

lines.content: 俺と千和はその瞬間にも“夢を語り合える”ような、今までよりももっと近しい関係となり……。
lines.translated: Would Chiwa and I become closer than ever before in that very moment, sharing a bond where we could talk about our dreams together...?

lines.content: 俺は、君の“夢”を叶えるための一歩を、共に、一緒に、踏み出せる？
lines.translated: Would I be able to take a step forward together with her, side by side, to make her "dream" come true?

lines.content: だけど……――
lines.translated: However...--

lines.content: これ以上は、秘密です。意地悪な先輩には言えません
lines.translated: "Anything beyond that is a secret. I can't tell a mean Senpai."

lines.content: ――だけど千和はその先を語ってはくれなかった。
lines.translated: --However, Chiwa didn't tell me the rest.

lines.content: 私にやさしい今日の先輩は、さよならしたら、もう私には会えなくなってしまうんですよね
lines.translated: "Once we say goodbye, I won't be able to meet the Senpai from today who's sweet to me anymore, right?"

lines.content: え？　……さよなら？
lines.translated: "Huh? ...Say goodbye?"

lines.content: はい……
だって、今日のやさしい先輩と、私は、お礼のためにこうして一緒にいるだけで……
lines.translated: "Because the sweet Senpai from today and I are only together like this as my thank-you gift..."

lines.content: さよならしたら。バイバイしたら……、今日が、終わってしまったら。今日の先輩と、私はもう会えなくなる。そうですよね？
lines.translated: "Once we say goodbye... once we say bye-bye, and today comes to an end... I won't be able to meet the Senpai from today anymore. Right?"

lines.content: ……明日になればまた、私にばっかり意地悪な先輩に戻っちゃうんですよね？
lines.translated: "...When tomorrow comes, you'll go right back to being the Senpai who's only ever mean to me, won't you?"

lines.content: だから、話せません
lines.translated: "So I can't tell you."

lines.content: 意地悪な先輩は嫌いなんですからと千和は言う。
lines.translated: Because I hate it when you're mean, Senpai, she added.

lines.content: 嫌いな人に大切だった願い事や、夢だとか、話せるわけないですもん。またそれで意地悪されたら私、泣いちゃうかもしれません。だからこれ以上は秘密なんですよ
lines.translated: "There's no way I could talk about my precious wishes or dreams to someone I hate. If you teased me about them again, I might end up crying. So anything beyond this is a secret."

lines.content: 秘密を話せるのは私にやさしい先輩だって決めたんです、と千和は意地悪そうな笑顔を見せていた。
lines.translated: I've decided I can only tell my secret to the Senpai who's sweet to me, Chiwa said, flashing a mischievous smile.

lines.content: そのとき、俺は自分が何を考えているのか――自分自身、わからなかった。
lines.translated: At that moment, I didn't even know what I was thinking myself.

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: そんなことない
lines.translated: "That's not true."

lines.content: ……ふと、そんなことを口にしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the words had slipped from my mouth.

lines.content: え？　そんなこと……？
lines.translated: "Huh? What's not...?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: そんなことはないよ、千和
lines.translated: "That's not true, Chiwa."

lines.content: 明日も俺はこのままだ。もう千和に意地悪なことはしない……と、思う
lines.translated: "I'll stay just like this tomorrow, too. I won't be mean to you anymore... I think."

lines.content: え？　せ、先輩。急にどうしたんですか？
lines.translated: "Huh? S-Senpai, what's gotten into you all of a sudden?"

lines.content: 千和が大きな目をぱちぱちとさせている。
lines.translated: Chiwa blinked her large eyes in surprise.

lines.content: さよならしても、さよならじゃない。明日からもできるだけ千和にはやさしく……できるように、がんばるよ
lines.translated: "Even if we say goodbye, it won't really be a goodbye. Starting tomorrow, I'll try my best... to be as sweet to you as I can."

lines.content: その言葉をどういう意図で口にしたのか。俺自身、正直なところ正確には説明できない。
lines.translated: Honestly, I couldn't even explain to myself what I meant by saying that.

lines.content: ただ言えることは、千和と過ごした今日の時間がそれなりに心地よかったということだ。
lines.translated: All I could say was that the time I'd spent with Chiwa today had felt pretty nice.

lines.content: 千和と幼馴染みとしてふざけ合うのもいい。それはそれで楽しい。
lines.translated: Goofing around with Chiwa as childhood friends was fine, too. It was fun in its own way.

lines.content: この“関係”にこそ、俺が“魔法少女『使い』”としての“役割”を果たすための“鍵”なのではないか、と。
lines.translated: Maybe this "relationship" was the very "key" I needed to fulfill my "role" as a "Magical Girl 'User.'"

lines.content: 俺は、そういうふうに期待もしている。
lines.translated: Part of me was hoping for that, too.

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ただ、それだけだったんだ。
lines.translated: That was all it was.

lines.content: そんなつもりでしかない言葉だったんだ。
lines.translated: That was all I meant by those words.

lines.content: それ以上の深い意味なんて、俺の言葉の中にはなかったはずなのに……、
lines.translated: There shouldn't have been any deeper meaning behind what I said, and yet...

lines.content: ……先輩、それって
lines.translated: "...Senpai, does that..."

lines.content: 目をぱちぱちとさせている千和が、
lines.translated: Blinking rapidly, Chiwa continued.

lines.content: それって……明日からも、私たち……こ、[・|恋][・|人][・|同][・|士]って……こと、ですか？
lines.translated: "Does that mean... starting tomorrow, we'll still be... l-lovers...?"

lines.content: 顔を真っ赤にさせて、ぽつりと、そう言った。
lines.translated: She murmured the question, her face turning bright red.

lines.content: 俺は、首をかしげた――そして自身が口走った言葉と、千和の赤面の意味とが、半端な俺の中でようやく繋がる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head--and then, in my half-baked mind, I finally connected the dots between the words I'd blurted out and the reason Chiwa was blushing.

lines.content: ……こ、恋人……っ？
そう、つぶやくと……。
lines.translated: As I murmured that...

lines.content: 千和は真っ赤になって、うつむいてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa turned bright red and looked down at the ground.

lines.content: 今日の関係をなかったことにするのはいやだなと――そう思っただけなんだ。それだけ、なんだ。
lines.translated: I had just thought it would be a shame to pretend today's dynamic never happened. That was really all it was.

lines.content: それなのにどうして、そんな話に……。
lines.translated: So how did it turn into a conversation like this...?

lines.content: ちっ――
今度は、俺が真っ赤になる番だった。……一瞬で。
lines.translated: Now it was my turn to blush bright red. ...In an instant.

lines.content: ――違うっ
思わずだ。
lines.translated: It was involuntary.

lines.content: 違うからっ
lines.translated: "That's not it!"

lines.content: 思わず……、
lines.translated: Without thinking...

lines.content: 繋いだままの手を離してしまいそうになるも、
lines.translated: I almost pulled my hand away from hers.

lines.content: い、今のはそういう意味で言ったわけじゃ……っ
lines.translated: "I-I didn't mean it like that just now...!"

lines.content: しかし千和に手をぎゅっと握られたまま、
lines.translated: However, with Chiwa squeezing my hand tightly,

lines.content: そして千和に、じっと、見つめられたまま、
lines.translated: and staring straight at me without wavering,

lines.content: う、うう
lines.translated: "U-Ugh..."

lines.content: 身動きさえ、取ることができなくなってしまっていた。
lines.translated: I found myself completely unable to move a muscle.

lines.content: ……い、今のは、その……
lines.translated: "...J-Just now, I meant, uh..."

lines.content: ……はい
いや。べ、別に、千和と明日からも、ずっと……こういう感じでいたいなって、そう思えたからで……ただ、それだけで……それ以上の意味は……
lines.translated: "No, it's not like... I just thought it'd be nice if we could keep... being like this tomorrow and from now on, too... That's all it was... I didn't mean anything more than..."

lines.content: しどろもどろにそう答えてしまう。
lines.translated: I stammered out a flustered excuse.

lines.content: そんな俺に……、
lines.translated: Seeing me like that...

lines.content: 情けないばかりのこの俺に、
lines.translated: Seeing how utterly pathetic I was being,

lines.content: 千和は、目を細めた。
lines.translated: Chiwa narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: ……そんな
lines.translated: "...No way."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……そんなに、思いっきりいやがらなくてもいいのに
lines.translated: "...You don't have to act so completely repulsed by the idea."

lines.content: 頬を膨らませていた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks were puffed out.

lines.content: 千和？
lines.translated: "Chiwa?"

lines.content: そして『ふんっ』とそっぽを向くと、
lines.translated: Then, turning her head away with a "Hmph,"

lines.content: ……嫌い
lines.translated: "...I hate you."

lines.content: やっぱり先輩なんて、大嫌いです
lines.translated: "I knew it. I really hate you, Senpai."

lines.content: 言いながらも、手は離さず握ったままだったけれど……。
lines.translated: Even as she said that, though, she didn't let go of my hand...

lines.content: ……沈黙。
lines.translated: Silence fell between us.

lines.content: 互いに何も言わない。話さない。
lines.translated: Neither of us said a word. We didn't speak.

lines.content: ただ、町を見つめている。春色に染まった町の景色を。
lines.translated: We simply gazed out at the town. At the scenery dyed in the colors of spring.

lines.content: 公園で遊び回る子ども達の楽しそうな声だけが、やたらと大きなもののように聞こえていた。
lines.translated: Only the cheerful voices of children running around the park echoed, sounding disproportionately loud.

lines.content: 千和と繋がったままの手を俺は見る。
lines.translated: I looked down at our hands, still intertwined.

lines.content: 静かな風が、通り抜け、
lines.translated: A quiet breeze drifted past,

lines.content: 少しだけ……汗ばんだ肌がひやりとしたところで、
lines.translated: and just as it sent a slight chill over my sweaty skin,

lines.content: ……やっぱり
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: 千和が、言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa spoke up.

lines.content: いつだって[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|沈][・|黙]に穴を開けるのは千和からだった。
lines.translated: Whenever a silence like this fell between us, Chiwa was always the one to break it.

lines.content: やっぱり私の秘密、聞いてもらっていいですか……？
lines.translated: "Um, would it be alright if you listened to my secret after all...?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 驚いた俺は隣に座る千和を振り向く。
lines.translated: Surprised, I turned to look at Chiwa sitting next to me.

lines.content: だけど……、
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 先輩は、今日、さよならしても……明日も今日のまま、私にもやさしい先輩のままでいてくれるんですよね？
lines.translated: "Even after we say goodbye today... tomorrow, you'll still be just like you were today, right, Senpai? You'll keep being kind to me?"

lines.content: ……だけど千和は、俺を振り返らないままに言う。
lines.translated: Yet Chiwa spoke without turning back to look at me.

lines.content: それなら……そんな先輩になら、聞いてほしいです
lines.translated: "If that's true... if that's the kind of Senpai you'll be, then I want you to hear it."

lines.content: 今日のやさしい先輩になら、私、ちゃんと全部話せると思うから……
lines.translated: "Because to the kind Senpai you've been today, I think I can properly tell you everything..."

lines.content: ……先輩。聞いてくれますか？　私の“秘密”
lines.translated: "...Senpai. Will you listen to my 'secret'?"

lines.content: 待ってくれ。
lines.translated: Hold on.
Something feels off.

lines.content: これはおかしい。
lines.translated: This is weird.
I have a strange feeling about this.

lines.content: だから――
lines.translated: So--

lines.content: 千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa.

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: お願いだ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: ……好きです
lines.translated: "...I like you."

lines.content: もう少しだけ、俺に、時間を……
lines.translated: Just give me a little more time...

lines.content: 先輩、好きです。……大好き、です
lines.translated: "I like you, Senpai. ...I really love you."

lines.content: 先輩……ずっとずっと、大好きでした
lines.translated: "Senpai... I've loved you for so, so long."

lines.content: 十年前、まだまだ小さかった頃……はじめて会ったときから、ずっと……
lines.translated: "Ever since ten years ago, back when I was still really little... ever since the very first time we met..."

lines.content: ……俺は、
出会ってからずっと……十年間もずっと、先輩のことばかり考えてました。先輩のことばかり、ずっと……見てました
lines.translated: "Ever since we met... for ten whole years, all I've ever thought about is you, Senpai. You're the only one... I've ever looked at."

lines.content: ……俺は真っ白に、なった。頭も。心も。
lines.translated: Everything went completely blank. My head. My heart.

lines.content: ……今日、先輩に振り向いてほしくて、私を見てもらいたくって、色々がんばりました。……でも、今日だけじゃないんです
lines.translated: "...Today, I tried really hard at all sorts of things because I wanted you to turn my way, because I wanted you to look at me. ...But it wasn't just today."

lines.content: 私、先輩に振り向いてほしくて……私のこと、見てほしくて……色々、がんばってきたつもりです
lines.translated: "Because I wanted you to notice me... because I wanted you to look at me... I've been trying my best in all kinds of ways."

lines.content: 千和はぎゅっと、俺と繋いだ手に力を込めて、
lines.translated: Chiwa gave the hand she was holding a tight squeeze.

lines.content: ……でも先輩は、全然私のこと……そういうふうに、見てくれなくて……
lines.translated: "...Even so, you never looked at me... in that way at all, Senpai..."

lines.content: うつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: She looked down.

lines.content: ……だけど、好きなんです。すごく、すごく……先輩のこと……私……大好き、なんです
lines.translated: "...Still, I like you. So, so much... I really... love you, Senpai."

lines.content: そしてまた、沈黙だ。
lines.translated: And once again, silence fell.

lines.content: うつむいた千和のその表情を伺うことができない。
lines.translated: With her head bowed, I couldn't read her expression.

lines.content: 震えている。
lines.translated: They are trembling.

lines.content: 繋いだ千和の小さな手が震えていた。
lines.translated: Her small hand, still holding mine, was trembling.

lines.content: そしてその横顔は、真っ赤だった。頬も。耳も。鼻も。先まで真っ赤に。
lines.translated: And her profile was bright red. Her cheeks. Her ears. Her nose. Right down to the very tips, she was completely flushed.

lines.content: それが、千和の……“秘密”？
lines.translated: "That's your... 'secret,' Chiwa?"

lines.content: ああ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: 間抜けだ。
lines.translated: What an idiot.

lines.content: もっと、何か……もっと違う、言うべきことがあるはずだろう。
lines.translated: Surely there was something more... something else I should have said.

lines.content: 俺は心底、自分を呪いたい気分だった。
lines.translated: From the bottom of my heart, I wanted to curse myself.

lines.content: しかし千和は、こっくりとうなずいて、
lines.translated: However, Chiwa gave a small nod,

lines.content: ……はい。そうです
lines.translated: "...Yes. It is."

lines.content: ……ずっと先輩に隠してきた、私の“秘密”です
lines.translated: "...It's the 'secret' I've been hiding from you all this time, Senpai."

lines.content: ぽつりと、千和はそう言い――
lines.translated: Chiwa murmured those words--

lines.content: そのまま唇を堅く結ぶと、繋いだ手まで真っ赤になってしまっていた。
lines.translated: and pressed her lips tightly together, even the hand holding mine turning bright red.

lines.content: 好き？
lines.translated: She likes me?

lines.content: 千和が？
lines.translated: Chiwa does?

lines.content: ……俺のことが、大好き？
lines.translated: She's in love with me?

lines.content: 確かにそれは“秘密”、なのだろう。
lines.translated: That certainly would qualify as a "secret."

lines.content: しかし千和の“秘密”はもっと深刻で、
lines.translated: However, I'd assumed Chiwa's "secret" was something much more serious,

lines.content: もっともっと、深い闇色をした難解な事情があるものなのだろうと、勝手に想像してしまっていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: jumping to conclusions on my own that there were far darker, more complicated circumstances behind it.

lines.content: しかし……、
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: しかし、驚いてはいる。
lines.translated: Even so, I was shocked.

lines.content: 千和が俺のことを……？
lines.translated: Chiwa feels that way about me...?

lines.content: うそだろ。
lines.translated: No way.

lines.content: どうして……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: そんな。
lines.translated: No way.

lines.content: 信じられない。
lines.translated: I can't believe it.

lines.content: ……返事
lines.translated: "...Your answer."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……お返事、くれないんですか、先輩
lines.translated: "...Aren't you going to give me an answer, Senpai?"

lines.content: うつむいたまま、震えたまま、小さな声で千和が言う。
lines.translated: Keeping her head down and still trembling, Chiwa spoke in a tiny voice.

lines.content: ……お願い、します。何か言ってくださいよ、先輩
lines.translated: "...Please. Say something, Senpai."

lines.content: 私……勇気、出したんです。がんばったんです。だからお願い。どうか……どうかお返事、ほしいです
lines.translated: "I... mustered up all my courage. I tried my hardest. So please. Please... I want to hear your answer."

lines.content: その横顔に。
lines.translated: In her profile.

lines.content: その、声に。
lines.translated: In her voice.

lines.content: 本心以外のものは何ひとつ見つけられないように、思えてしまい……。
lines.translated: It felt as though I couldn't find a single shred of anything other than her true feelings...

lines.content: だからこそ焦り。
lines.translated: Which only made me panic more.

lines.content: だからこそ、困惑してしまうけれど、
lines.translated: Which only left me more bewildered, yet...

lines.content: そこでどうしてだろうか。
lines.translated: Why did it happen right then?

lines.content: 俺の中にふと、突然にとある記憶が蘇ってきた――
lines.translated: Out of nowhere, a certain memory suddenly resurfaced in my mind--
--It was that thing from the other day.

lines.content: 千和が突然、犬耳姿をしていたあの日のこと。
lines.translated: That day when Chiwa had suddenly shown up wearing dog ears.

lines.content: そしてなんだか幼馴染みたちみんなの態度が、若干……いやかなり面倒だったこと。
lines.translated: And how all our childhood friends had been acting slightly... no, pretty obnoxious.

lines.content: それらの[・|理][・|由]をまるで納得できないままに、うやむやにしてしまっていたこと。
lines.translated: And how I'd brushed the whole thing aside without ever really buying the reasons for any of it.

lines.content: ……千和。かわいかったなあ。
lines.translated: Chiwa really was cute back then, though.

lines.content: 等と、少し意識がズレてしまうものの――
lines.translated: My thoughts wandered off track for a second with things like that, but--

lines.content: まさか……
lines.translated: "Could it be..."

lines.content: と、思うのだ。
lines.translated: That was when it hit me.

lines.content: まさか、これは……[・|あ][・|れ]なのか？
lines.translated: "Wait, could this be... because of that?"

lines.content: と、俺は……気づいてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: I... finally put the pieces together.

lines.content: あ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: 危ない。
lines.translated: That was a close call.
So that's what this is all about.

lines.content: 俺は、ふるふると首を振っていた。
lines.translated: I found myself shaking my head.

lines.content: 先輩……？
lines.translated: "Senpai...?"

lines.content: そんな俺を、隣で千和が見上げていた。少し涙をためた大きな瞳で。
lines.translated: Sitting beside me, Chiwa looked up at me. Her big eyes were brimming with tears.

lines.content: ……まさかって。あれって。何が、ですか？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean, 'could this be'? What's 'that'?"

lines.content: 頬が赤い。真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: Her cheeks were red. Bright red.

lines.content: 俺を見上げる瞳は不安そうに震えてる。
lines.translated: The eyes looking up at me were trembling with unease.

lines.content: ……だけど。
lines.translated: Even so.

lines.content: そんな不安の中にも、淡い期待がこもっているようにも見えてしまって……。
lines.translated: Yet even amidst that anxiety, it looked as though a faint hope was shining through...

lines.content: どきりと、する。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: 俺を見つめる震える瞳。
lines.translated: Those trembling eyes staring right at me.

lines.content: それはまるで、本当に、うそも偽りも何もない――純粋さの結晶でできているように思えたけれど。
lines.translated: They really did look as if they were made of crystallized purity--completely free of any lies or deception.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: これは、そういう[・|作][・|戦]なんだ――そうだよな？
lines.translated: This is all just part of some scheme--right?

lines.content: 千和？
lines.translated: "Chiwa?"

lines.content: は、はい
lines.translated: "Y-Yes?"

lines.content: ……これって、さ。何かの悪戯……なのかな？
lines.translated: "...Hey, is this... some kind of prank?"

lines.content: 千和は、ぽかんとする。何を言われたのかわからない、というように。
lines.translated: Chiwa stared at me blankly, as if she had no idea what I was talking about.

lines.content: ……悪戯？
lines.translated: "...A prank?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。思い出したんだ。この前、千和がみんなに犬耳なコスプレさせられてたこと……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I just remembered. The other day, when everyone made you dress up in those dog ears..."

lines.content: そうだよな？　あれって、みんなにそうさせられていたんだよな？　理由はわからないけれど、きっとそうなんだよな……？　俺は千和にそう問いかける。
lines.translated: Right? Everyone put you up to that, didn't they? I don't know why, but that has to be it, right...? I silently pleaded with Chiwa as I asked.

lines.content: だからさ。今日のこともあの日の延長で……
lines.translated: "So, you know. Today is just a continuation of that day..."

lines.content: 今もずっと、朝からずっと、ハルたちがどこかで見てるんだよな……俺と、千和のこと
lines.translated: "Even right now, ever since this morning, Haru and the others have been watching us from somewhere, haven't they...? Watching me and you, Chiwa."

lines.content: 呼吸が止まってしまったみたいに、千和は小さな口をぽかんとさせて。
lines.translated: As if she had forgotten how to breathe, Chiwa's small mouth fell open in a daze.

lines.content: ……その表情、その視線に、どうしてか耐えられず、俺はあたふたとしながら、言う。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't bear to look at that expression or meet her gaze, so I scrambled to keep talking.

lines.content: だ、だってさ、やっぱりおかしいよ。お礼だからといっても、いきなり一緒にデートだなんて……。千和がそんなこと言い出すなんて、あまり想像できないんだ
lines.translated: "I-I mean, come on, it really is weird. Even if it was just to thank me, suddenly asking me out on a date... I just can't picture you suggesting something like that on your own, Chiwa."

lines.content: だからそこには第三者の意図を明確に意識せざるを得ないくて……。
lines.translated: Which meant I couldn't help being acutely aware of a third party's intentions behind it all...

lines.content: だから、千和の告白は……
lines.translated: "So, Chiwa, your confession is..."

lines.content: 千和は、みるみる真っ青に、なっていく……。
lines.translated: Before my eyes, Chiwa turned deathly pale...

lines.content: ち、千和？　な、なあ、えっと……その。繰り返すようで申し訳ないけれど、これはみんなの悪戯……で、いいんだよな？
lines.translated: "Ch-Chiwa? H-Hey, um... well. Sorry to repeat myself, but this is just a prank everyone's pulling... right?"

lines.content: たとえば、音楽がどうのこうのっていう智仁のいつものノリに、わざわざ千和が付き合ってやってるだけなんだよな……？
lines.translated: "Like, you're just going out of your way to humor Tomohito and his usual 'for the sake of music' routine, right...?"

lines.content: 尚もそう言いながら、俺は笑顔が引きつっている。
lines.translated: Even as I kept talking, my smile was twitching.

lines.content: おそらく予感があったのだ。
lines.translated: I probably already had a sinking feeling.

lines.content: 俺はきっと、何か……大変なことをしてしまっていると。
lines.translated: A feeling that I was making a... terrible mistake.

lines.content: だがどうしても信じられなかった。受け入れられなかった。
lines.translated: Still, I just couldn't believe it. I couldn't accept it.

lines.content: だ、だって……千和が俺のこと、好きになるわけ……
lines.translated: "I-I mean... there's no way you'd actually fall for me, Chiwa..."

lines.content: 独り言のようにそう呟いた。
lines.translated: I muttered the words as if talking to myself.

lines.content: そのときの俺は、きっとブサイクに過ぎる苦笑いを浮かべていたに違いない。
lines.translated: Right then, I must have had a painfully ugly, forced smile on my face.

lines.content: ああ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: なんだ、何なんだ、こいつは。
lines.translated: What the hell is wrong with this guy?

lines.content: こんな俺に俺は苛立つ。いったい何を言ってるんだこのバカはと。
lines.translated: I was furious with myself. What on earth was this idiot even saying?

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ここにいるのが[・|あ][・|の][・|人]であるならいざ知らず。俺だ。この俺だ。あり得ない。
lines.translated: It'd be one thing if *that person* were standing here. But it's me. Just me. It's impossible.

lines.content: だから、そのまま千和から視線を外した。
lines.translated: So I looked away from Chiwa.

lines.content: そうしてきょろきょろと辺りを見回す――俺たちのことを最初からつけてきているはずの視線を探した。悪戯好きの幼馴染みたちの姿を、探した。
lines.translated: Then I glanced restlessly around us--searching for the eyes that must have been tailing us from the very beginning. Searching for my prank-loving childhood friends.

lines.content: い、いや。すごかったよ。千和……本当に、すごかった。悪戯だとわかってもまだどきどきしてる。真に迫っていたって言うか――
lines.translated: "N-No, really, you got me good, Chiwa... You were amazing. Even knowing it's a prank, my heart is still pounding. Your acting was so convincing--"

lines.content: へらへらとしながらそんなことを言い、恐る恐る、千和を振り返った俺は……とんでもない、阿呆だ。
lines.translated: Babbling on with a foolish grin, I timidly looked back at Chiwa... What an absolute idiot I was.

lines.content: ぽろり、
lines.translated: Plip.

lines.content: 涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: 涙が、こぼれた。
lines.translated: A tear spilled over.

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 俺を見つめる千和の瞳から、大粒の涙が、次々と。
lines.translated: From Chiwa's eyes, fixed straight on me, large teardrops began to fall one after another.

lines.content: ち、千和……、どう、して
lines.translated: "Ch-Chiwa... why..."

lines.content: 千和……。
lines.translated: Chiwa...

lines.content: 俺と、今日はずっと繋いだままでいてくれた手を、離し、
lines.translated: She let go of my hand, the hand she had held onto all day today.

lines.content: う、うう、ううー……
lines.translated: "U-Ugh, ugh..."

lines.content: 次々とこぼれてくる大粒の涙を千和は拭う。両手で。必死に拭う。でも、止まらない。次々と溢れる。いっぱいの涙が千和の胸元まで濡らしていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa wiped at the large tears spilling endlessly down her cheeks. With both hands. Frantically wiping them away. Yet they wouldn't stop. They just kept overflowing. So many tears that they were soaking the front of her chest.

lines.content: 俺は、動けなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't move.

lines.content: 呼吸さえも忘れてしまっていたかもしれない。
lines.translated: I might have even forgotten how to breathe.

lines.content: うそ、だろ……千和？
lines.translated: "No way... Chiwa?"

lines.content: 俺はやっぱり、とんでもない間違いを犯してしまったのではないか……。
lines.translated: Had I really just made a terrible, unforgivable mistake after all...?

lines.content: 怖くなった――
lines.translated: Fear took hold of me--

lines.content: “関係性”だの“魔法”だの……君の“夢”を叶えるだのと……それ、以前だ。
lines.translated: All that talk about our "relationship," about "magic," about... making her "dream" come true... This went way beyond any of that.

lines.content: 何か、俺はとても大切な何かを壊してしまったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: I might have just shattered something irreplaceably precious.

lines.content: 離された手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: I reached out the hand she had let go of.

lines.content: もう一度繋いでほしいとは言わない。
lines.translated: I wasn't going to ask her to hold it again.

lines.content: ただもう一度だけ、千和に触れて……謝りたい。
lines.translated: I just wanted to touch Chiwa one more time... and apologize.

lines.content: できることなら今の言葉をすべて破り捨ててしまいたい。
lines.translated: If I could, I would tear up every single word I had just spoken and throw them all away.

lines.content: しかしそれを避けるように、千和はベンチから立ち上がり、
lines.translated: Yet as if to dodge my hand, Chiwa stood up from the bench.

lines.content: ……ごめ、うう、ごめん、なさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sor--ugh, I'm... sorry."

lines.content: しゃくり上げながら千和が言う……どうして。
lines.translated: Chiwa spoke between hiccuping sobs... Why?

lines.content: ……ごめんな、さい、先輩。わ、わたし……、ぐす……ちょうしに、のって……あ、う、うう……
lines.translated: "...I'm so sorry, Senpai. I-I... *sniff*... got carried away... ah, ugh, ugh..."

lines.content: どうして千和が、謝るんだ……。
lines.translated: Why is Chiwa the one apologizing...?

lines.content: い、いまの……うそ、です……なかったことに……なりますか、先輩
lines.translated: "W-What I just said... was a lie... Can we pretend... it never happened, Senpai?"

lines.content: 千和は涙を拭う。……懸命に、笑顔を作ろうとしながら。
lines.translated: Chiwa wiped her tears... trying desperately to force a smile.

lines.content: でもだめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: どうしようもなく涙が溢れ、
lines.translated: Yet the tears overflowed uncontrollably.

lines.content: う、うう……こ……こんな、ごめ……わたしみたいなの……が、……ぐず
lines.translated: "U-Ugh... I-I'm sorry... that someone... like me... *sniff*..."

lines.content: ……迷惑、で……ご、ごめんな、さい……せんぱい、ほんとに……で、でも、お願い、します――どうか……わたしを
lines.translated: "...For bothering you... I-I'm so sorry... Senpai, really... B-But please--I beg you... don't..."

lines.content: そこまで言って、
lines.translated: Having said that much,

lines.content: 最後の言葉を弱々しく呟いて、
lines.translated: and weakly murmuring her final words,

lines.content: 千和は、走って行ってしまった。
lines.translated: Chiwa turned and ran away.

lines.content: ……千和っ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa!"

lines.content: 叫ぶ。
lines.translated: It screamed.

lines.content: だが、その背中を追いかける権利など俺にはまるでない気がした。
lines.translated: Yet I felt like I had no right whatsoever to chase after her.

lines.content: 残された空っぽのお弁当。
lines.translated: Left behind was the empty lunchbox.

lines.content: そして千和の残した最後の言葉。
lines.translated: And the final words Chiwa had spoken.

lines.content: “……でも、お願いします。どうか、きらいにはならないで”
lines.translated: "...But please. I beg you, don't hate me."

lines.content: 千和はそう言って、走って行ってしまった。
lines.translated: With those words, Chiwa had run off.

lines.content: その言葉がなぜだかとても、胸に痛い。
lines.translated: For some reason, those words ached terribly in my chest.

lines.content: ……頭を抱える。
lines.translated: I buried my head in my hands.

lines.content: ここにいるのが[・|あ][・|の][・|人]ならば。
lines.translated: If only *that person* were the one here.

lines.content: たとえば物語の主人公で、あったなら。
lines.translated: If only I were the protagonist of a story, for instance.

lines.content: もちろん、こんなふうにかわいい誰かを傷つけようはずがない。
lines.translated: Then of course, I never would have hurt someone so cute like this.

lines.content: あさひさんの書斎で読んだ……頭の中に詰め込んだ物語の[主人公|ヒーロー]たちに、総出で呆れられている――そんな気もした。
lines.translated: I felt as though all the heroes from the stories I'd read in Asahi-san's study and crammed into my head were collectively looking down on me in disgust.

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: ヒーローだ。
lines.translated: A hero.

lines.content: ヒーローは、どこにいってしまったんだよ
lines.translated: "Where did the hero go...?"

lines.content: いつもの言葉を繰り返し、俺は、離された手のひらを見つめるばかりだ。
lines.translated: Repeating those familiar words, all I could do was stare at the palm of the hand she had let go.

lines.content: ……そう。そんなことが
lines.translated: "...I see. So that happened."

lines.content: ……その日の晩。
lines.translated: That night.

lines.content: 俺はクロへと今日の出来事を報告していた。
lines.translated: I was telling Kuro about what had happened today.

lines.content: 耳に押しつけたスピーカーから弱々しい声がする。
lines.translated: A faint voice came through the speaker pressed against my ear.

lines.content: ……わたしのせい、かな
lines.translated: "...Maybe it's my fault."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……どうして？　と俺は問う。
lines.translated: Why? I asked her.

lines.content: どうして、クロのせいだなんてことに……
lines.translated: "Why would it ever be your fault, Kuro...?"

lines.content: 昨日の夜
lines.translated: "Last night..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……わたしが、大雅の相談を、“そんなの知らない”って。“大雅は相談する相手を間違えてるよ”って。そう言って、電話を切ったから
lines.translated: "...When you came to me for advice, Taiga, I said, 'I don't know anything about that.' I told you, 'You're asking the wrong person, Taiga.' And then I hung up on you."

lines.content: いや。それは、違うよクロ
lines.translated: "No. That's not it at all, Kuro."

lines.content: 気にしてくれてうれしいけれど、違う。クロのせいなんかじゃない
lines.translated: "I'm glad you care, really, but you're wrong. It's not your fault in the slightest."

lines.content: ここでほんの僅かにでも今日の失敗を誰かのせいにしようものなら、それこそまったく救えない。そう思った。
lines.translated: If I tried to pin even a fraction of today's failure on someone else right now, I really would be beyond saving. That's what I thought.

lines.content: それこそ“情けない”だなんていう言葉では収まりきらないほどに。
lines.translated: To the point where a word like "pathetic" wouldn't even begin to cover it.

lines.content: ……別に、いいんだよ
lines.translated: "...It's okay, really."

lines.content: 考え耽っていた俺の耳元に、ふっと、君の声。
lines.translated: As I sat lost in thought, your voice drifted softly into my ear.

lines.content: ……えっと。わたしね、おばかだから。ちゃんと君を、大雅を、応援できるような言葉をいつも、ちゃんと、選べないけど……
lines.translated: "...Um. I'm kind of dumb, you know. So I can never really choose the right words to cheer you on properly, Taiga, to support you..."

lines.content: 少しだけ何かを考えるような沈黙を、クロは挟み、
lines.translated: Kuro paused for a brief silence, as if mulling something over.

lines.content: 別に……大雅。あのね、大雅。情けなくてもいいって、わたしは思うよ
lines.translated: "It's okay... Taiga. Listen, Taiga. I think it's okay to be pathetic."

lines.content: 情けなくても？
lines.translated: "Okay to be pathetic?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 誰かが“こうじゃなきゃ格好悪い”って期待するような生き方をしなきゃいけない……そんな理由は、ないって思う
lines.translated: "I don't think there's any reason... why you have to live your life meeting someone else's expectations of what's 'cool' or 'uncool.'"

lines.content: たどたどしく言葉を並べるクロの声に、俺は耳を傾けている。
lines.translated: I listened closely to Kuro's voice as she haltingly pieced her words together.

lines.content: ……だけど
lines.translated: "...However."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: もし誰かの期待をみたさなきゃならないことがあるとしたら、それは、他の誰でもない――きみはきみ自身の期待に応えるために、生きないと。わたしはいつも、そう、思ってるよ
lines.translated: "If there ever is someone's expectations you have to live up to, it shouldn't be anyone else's--you have to live to meet your own expectations. That's what I always think."

lines.content: クロの声に[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids at the sound of Kuro's voice.

lines.content: 懸命に、慎重に、そして大切に、言葉を選んで俺へと届けようとしてくれる……小さなちいさなクロの声。
lines.translated: Earnestly, carefully, and tenderly choosing her words to reach me... Kuro's tiny, fragile voice.

lines.content: その声の形に、声の彩に、耳を傾けているだけで、どうしてだろう。いつでも俺は穏やかな気持ちになることができる。
lines.translated: Just listening to the shape and color of her voice always managed to calm my heart, though I didn't know why.

lines.content: 幼い頃、いつでも側で見守ってくれていた。
lines.translated: Back when I was little, she was always by my side watching over me.

lines.content: 今も尚、俺をこうして、案じてくれている。
lines.translated: And even now, she still worries about me like this.

lines.content: それだけで、俺にとっては何より充分なのに……、
lines.translated: That alone is more than enough for me, and yet...

lines.content: ……ごめんね。大雅
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga."

lines.content: 君はいつも、不安そうだった。
lines.translated: You always sounded so anxious.

lines.content: わたしは、恋愛のことはわからない。わたしたちは人の心がわからないから。わたしはちは、そういうイキモノ、だから
lines.translated: "I don't understand romance. Because we don't understand the human heart. Because that's the kind of creatures we are."

lines.content: だから、今、きみが苦しんでいる問題に、一番の言葉を、応援を、贈ってあげられることがわたしにはできない……
lines.translated: "So I can't give you the best words, or the best encouragement, for the problem you're suffering through right now..."

lines.content: 電話で話す素直な君は、自分の声が、俺にちゃんと届いているのかどうか――不安で、心配で、少し怖くて堪らない……そんな声音で話すのだ。
lines.translated: Speaking so earnestly over the phone, you sounded unbearably anxious, worried, and a little scared--wondering whether your voice was truly reaching me.

lines.content: その君の不安を少しでも軽くしたいと俺も願うから、
lines.translated: And because I wanted to ease that anxiety of yours even a little,

lines.content: 恋愛……なのかな
lines.translated: "Romance... I wonder if that's what it is."

lines.content: 俺は苦笑いを浮かべ、そう言った。
lines.translated: I said with a wry smile.

lines.content: 重くなりすぎないように、だからといって軽口にもならないように、気をつけて。
lines.translated: Being careful not to sound too heavy, yet not making light of it either.

lines.content: どういうこと？
lines.translated: What do you mean?

lines.content: ……ああ。俺が今、こうして頭を抱えているのは……恋愛の問題、と言っていいのかな
lines.translated: "...Yeah. This whole thing I'm agonizing over right now... I wonder if you can even call it a romantic problem."

lines.content: ……わからない
lines.translated: "...I don't know."

lines.content: 俺の想いと君の声。ふたつが重なる。
lines.translated: My thoughts and your voice. The two overlapped.

lines.content: ……わたしには、何も、わからない
lines.translated: "...I don't know anything at all."

lines.content: 不安そうな、心配そうな、少し恐怖だってしているそのせりふを、しかし“……でもね”という微かな声が先へと繋ぐ。
lines.translated: Those words, so anxious, worried, and even a little afraid, were nonetheless carried forward by a faint "...But you know."

lines.content: ……でもね、大雅。きみのその悩みは、今は苦しいかもしれないけれど……とっても大変かもしれないけれど、間違ってはいないよ。それは、絶対
lines.translated: "...But you know, Taiga. Your struggle right now might be painful... and it might be really hard, but you aren't wrong. I'm positive of that."

lines.content: え？　間違って、いない？
lines.translated: "Huh? I'm... not wrong?"

lines.content: そう。……上手く言えないけど、絶対、だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...I can't put it into words very well, but I'm positive."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 俺は、電話をもう片方の手に持ち替え、言う。
lines.translated: I switched the phone to my other hand and spoke.

lines.content: ……クロは、俺の未来を知っているから？
lines.translated: "...Is that because you know my future, Kuro?"

lines.content: ……うん。そう、だね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right, isn't it?"

lines.content: 俺の未来がクロにはわかるから……だから、大丈夫だって、間違っていないって、そう言える……？
lines.translated: "Because you can see my future, Kuro... is that why you can tell me it's okay, that I'm not wrong...?"

lines.content: うん……。その通り、だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah... That's right."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じる――すると、君が苦笑いを浮かべている姿が思い浮かんだ。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids--and the image of you smiling wryly floated into my mind.

lines.content: そんな[まぶた|瞼]の裏に浮かんだ君が、また“ごめんね”と俺にそう言った。
lines.translated: Beneath my closed eyelids, that vision of you said "I'm sorry" to me once again.

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 今度お電話するときには、もっと、上手な言葉を探しておくよ。大雅の眠れない夜が、できるだけ少なくなるようにって
lines.translated: "Next time we talk on the phone, I'll look for better words to say. So that you have as few sleepless nights as possible, Taiga."

lines.content: ……俺たちはそこから少し、とりとめもない話をして時間を重ねた。
lines.translated: From there, we spent a little while longer chatting about nothing in particular.

lines.content: 俺がデートしてるときクロは何をしていたのかな。いつもみたいに側で見ていてくれたのかな
lines.translated: "What were you doing while I was on my date, Kuro? Were you watching over me from nearby like usual?"

lines.content: ……ううん
今日もそういうわけにはいかなかった。でも、上手くいくように祈ってた。ほんとだよ？
lines.translated: "I couldn't do that today, either. But I was praying it would go well. Really, I was."

lines.content: 他に、どんなことがあった？　今日は、何を食べたのかな？　チョコレート。大雅がくれた、苦くないやつ。
lines.translated: What else happened? What did you eat today? Chocolate. The sweet kind that you gave me, Taiga.

lines.content: いくつも君と言葉を交わした。
lines.translated: You and I exchanged all sorts of words.

lines.content: ……ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: Hey, Taiga.

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……“魔法”は決まった？
lines.translated: "...Have you decided on your 'magic'?"

lines.content: クロが言う。
lines.translated: Kuro spoke.

lines.content: ……大雅の“夢”を叶えるための“魔法”。その形は。その効果は。いったい、どんなものであれば、万全なのか――思い描けた？
lines.translated: "...The 'magic' to grant your 'dream,' Taiga. Have you been able to picture what shape and effect it would need to have to be completely foolproof?"

lines.content: 幼い頃から何度となく投げかけられるその問いには、今夜も俺は『……ううん』と首を振り、応える。
lines.translated: To that question she had asked me countless times since I was little, I shook my head once again tonight and answered, "...No."

lines.content: これから先の未来、俺は、自分の願いだとか夢だとか、そういったもの叶えるために、どんな“魔法”を望むのか……。
lines.translated: In the future that lies ahead, what kind of "magic" will I wish for to make my hopes and dreams come true...?

lines.content: その答えはまだまだ、見つけられないけれど。
lines.translated: I still couldn't find the answer to that yet, though.

lines.content: 君の小さな声は、まるで俺だけのために歌われる子守歌のよう。
lines.translated: Your tiny voice was just like a lullaby sung for me alone.

lines.content: 俺の不安や、重苦しい心や、重なる怖さのようなものが段々と軽くなっていき――やさしい眠りの気配を感じ始めた頃、
lines.translated: As my anxiety, my heavy heart, and the mounting fear inside me gradually grew lighter--just as I began to feel the gentle pull of sleep,

lines.content: ……さよなら。大雅
lines.translated: "...Goodbye, Taiga."

lines.content: そっと、心に触れるかのような声がした。
lines.translated: Came a voice, as if softly touching my heart.

lines.content: ……祈ってる
lines.translated: "...I'm praying."

lines.content: いつも、祈ってるよ、大雅。きみの未来に、いつもやさしい“魔法”がありますようにって
lines.translated: "I'm always praying for you, Taiga. That there will always be gentle 'magic' in your future."

lines.content: ……翌日。
lines.translated: The next day.

lines.content: 千和は学園を休んだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa was absent from school.

lines.content: いつもはみんなで揃ってお昼を食べている。だけど今日はその場に千和がいない。
lines.translated: We always ate lunch together as a group. Today, however, Chiwa wasn't there.

lines.content: 千和ちゃん、大丈夫かな……
lines.translated: "I wonder if Chiwa-chan is okay..."

lines.content: そう言うハルの机には、コンビニのサンドイッチとパックの牛乳。
lines.translated: On Haru's desk as she said that sat a convenience store sandwich and a carton of milk.

lines.content: サンドイッチのビニールを剥ぎながら、不安そうに、心配そうに、首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: While peeling the plastic wrapper off her sandwich, she tilted her head, looking anxious and worried.

lines.content: お店も休みだったよ
lines.translated: "Her shop was closed, too."

lines.content: そうなんだ？
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: ……うん。そう
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It was."

lines.content: 姫織はうなずく。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded.

lines.content: ……ハルの手の中にあるサンドイッチをじぃっと見つめながら。
lines.translated: While staring intently at the sandwich in Haru's hands.

lines.content: ……千和のお店。定休日とか以外でお休みするの、とってもめずらしいよね
lines.translated: "...Chiwa's shop. It's really rare for them to close on a day that isn't a regular holiday, isn't it?"
"U-Ugh... I knew it, that has to be why."

lines.content: ハルはサンドイッチを置いて頭を抱えた。
lines.translated: Haru set her sandwich down and clutched her head.

lines.content: よっぽど犬耳が嫌だったんだよ。よっぽど、[・|デ][・|ー][・|ト][・|の][・|こ][・|と][・|も]……無理させちゃってたんだよ――千和ちゃん、あのとき泣いてたし……
lines.translated: "She really hated those dog ears that much. And we really pushed her way too hard... with the date, too--Chiwa-chan was even crying back then..."

lines.content: うん。犬耳の日は部屋に篭もって出てきてくれなかったよね。サンドイッチはたまごとハムとレタスとチーズだね
lines.translated: "Yeah. On the day with the dog ears, she locked herself in her room and wouldn't come out, right? That sandwich has egg, ham, lettuce, and cheese, doesn't it?"

lines.content: え？　サンドイッチ？
lines.translated: "Huh? The sandwich?"

lines.content: 私、好きだよ？
lines.translated: "I like those, you know?"

lines.content: う、うん。そう、なんだ？
lines.translated: "U-Um, yeah. Is that so?"

lines.content: 苦笑いで、とりあえずといった感じにうなずくハルだ。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, Haru gave a noncommittal nod.

lines.content: うう。ごめんね千和ちゃん……。私、千和ちゃんにひどいことしちゃった……かもだよ
lines.translated: "Ugh. I'm so sorry, Chiwa-chan... I think I might have done something awful to her..."

lines.content: ……今朝
lines.translated: "...This morning."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……千和のお店であったこと。そして[・|昨][・|日][・|の][・|こ][・|と]。今朝、みんなから事情を話してもらったけれど
lines.translated: "...What happened at Chiwa's shop. And what happened yesterday. Everyone explained the circumstances to me this morning, though."

lines.content: じじょー？
lines.translated: "Circumstances?"

lines.content: もぐもぐしながら姫織が言った。
lines.translated: Himeori asked while munching away.

lines.content: こらこら、だめじゃないか。人のサンドイッチを食べちゃ
lines.translated: "Hey, now, you shouldn't be eating someone else's sandwich."

lines.content: え……？　あっ
lines.translated: "Huh...? Oh!"

lines.content: ……いらにゃいのかちょほもって
lines.translated: "...I thought you didn't want it."

lines.content: もにょもにょ[は|食]みながら姫織が言う。
lines.translated: Himeori mumbled with her mouth full.

lines.content: はるちゃん。さんどいっち……机に起きっぱなしだったから……
lines.translated: "Haru-chan. The sandwich... you just left it sitting on your desk..."

lines.content: あ……あー……
机に置いたサンドイッチが、姫織の口の中に収まっているのを見たハルは、一瞬だけ驚いた顔をしたけれど、
lines.translated: Seeing the sandwich she had left on her desk now sitting inside Himeori's mouth, Haru looked surprised for a split second,

lines.content: う、ううん。いいよ。あげる。姫織ちゃんのお腹の中の怪獣さんに
lines.translated: "N-No, it's fine. You can have it. For the little monster inside your tummy, Himeori-chan."

lines.content: なんだか食欲なくって……、とハルがため息をついていた。
lines.translated: "I don't really have an appetite anyway..." Haru sighed.

lines.content: 今日は珍しく、ハルに笑顔がなかった。
lines.translated: Unusually for her, Haru wasn't smiling at all today.

lines.content: 今朝の登校時。俺はハルたちに、先日の喫茶店での件を問いかけていた。そして昨日のデートについてもだ。
lines.translated: On the way to school this morning, I had asked Haru and the others about what happened at the cafe the other day. And about yesterday's date, too.

lines.content: 千和が犬耳つけてちょっとかわいいポーズを取ってみたり。
lines.translated: How Chiwa had put on dog ears and struck a slightly cute pose.

lines.content: その晩、千和からデートのお誘いメッセージが届いてみたり――……あれはみんなの仕業だったのかな、と。
lines.translated: And how that evening, I had gotten a message from Chiwa asking me out on a date--...I asked if that had been everyone's doing.

lines.content: するとみんなは[・|そ][・|れ]を認めた。
lines.translated: And they admitted to it.

lines.content: 千和にかわいい格好をしてもらったのも、そしてその勢いを逃しちゃだめだよと、殆ど無理矢理、俺をデートに誘うよう千和の背中を押したのも、すべて自分たちの差し金なのだと。
lines.translated: Having Chiwa dress up in a cute outfit, telling her she couldn't let the momentum go to waste, and practically forcing her into asking me out on a date--they admitted that all of it had been their instigation.

lines.content: 今朝はハルに何度も謝られた。
lines.translated: Haru apologized to me over and over this morning.

lines.content: 余計なお世話だということはわかっていたし、良くよく想像できていれば、その出来事をきっかけに……喧嘩にだってなっていたかもしれない。
lines.translated: She knew they had been meddling, and if they had just thought it through properly, they would have realized it could have even led to a fight.

lines.content: 結果、千和のことを傷つけてしまった……と、ハルは今にも泣きそうな顔で、『想像力が足らなかった』と嘆いていた。
lines.translated: In the end, they had ended up hurting Chiwa... Haru lamented on the verge of tears, saying she had "lacked imagination."

lines.content: あのときの自分たちは、全部が上手い具合にいくだろうと、何の根拠もないのに都合良く想像してしまっていたという。
lines.translated: Back then, she said, they had conveniently imagined that everything would work out just fine, despite having no basis for it whatsoever.

lines.content: ……反省だ。
lines.translated: Remorse.

lines.content: とても反省しているんだよと、落ち込み、うなだれてしまっているハルの表情が、雄弁にそう語っていた。
lines.translated: Haru's crestfallen, downcast expression spoke volumes about how deeply remorseful she was.

lines.content: 私が、千和ちゃんに無理矢理、かわいい格好させちゃって……その……
lines.translated: "I forced Chiwa-chan to wear that cute outfit, and... um..."

lines.content: ちらりと、ハルは俺を見上げる。
lines.translated: Haru glanced up at me.

lines.content: ……千和ちゃんの今までの気持ち、とか。そういうの、全部伝わればいいなあって、そう思ったんだけど……大きなお世話だったよね。そんなの
lines.translated: "...The feelings Chiwa-chan has had all this time, and all that. I thought it would be great if she could get all of that across to you, but... I was totally sticking my nose where it didn't belong, wasn't I?"

lines.content: 気持ち……？
lines.translated: "Feelings...?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 大雅くんの“隣”には、千和ちゃんでもって、思って……
lines.translated: "I thought that the spot 'next' to you, Taiga-kun, could go to Chiwa-chan, too..."

lines.content: そこまで言って、ハルはううん、何でもないと首を振り、また項垂れていた。
lines.translated: Having said that much, Haru shook her head, murmured, "No, never mind," and hung her head again.

lines.content: 私、千和ちゃんを傷つけちゃった……
lines.translated: "I hurt Chiwa-chan..."

lines.content: それは、学校、休んじゃうほど？
lines.translated: "Enough to make her skip school?"

lines.content: お店も閉めちゃうほど、だったのかなあ
lines.translated: "I wonder if it was enough to make them close the shop, too..."

lines.content: 智仁も姫織もばつの悪そうな顔でもにょもにょと言っていた。
lines.translated: Both Tomohito and Himeori mumbled with awkward expressions on their faces.

lines.content: どうしよう……
lines.translated: "What should I do..."

lines.content: そしてハルが、ぽつりとつぶやく。
lines.translated: And then, Haru murmured quietly.

lines.content: ……千和ちゃん。このまま学校来なくなったらどうしよう
lines.translated: "...What if Chiwa-chan stops coming to school altogether like this?"

lines.content: 登校を拒否する感じで？
lines.translated: "Like she's refusing to attend school?"

lines.content: ……そんな感じ、かもだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah, maybe something like that."

lines.content: もしかしたら、卒業まで……？
lines.translated: "Could it last all the way until graduation...?"

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: もしかしたら、転校まで……しちゃうかも？
lines.translated: "Could she maybe even... transfer schools?"

lines.content: ううっ、ま、まさか、そこまで……？
lines.translated: "Ugh, n-no way, she wouldn't go that far, right...?"

lines.content: いや。さすがにそこまでのことはないだろうけど……、ハルちゃんだけが悪いんじゃない。俺たちも反省しないとだめだ
lines.translated: "No, I doubt it would go that far, at least... Besides, it isn't just your fault, Haru-chan. The rest of us need to reflect on what we did, too."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ハルたちが千和にあんな格好をさせた理由――千和が俺のことを想っているのだと、みんなは既に知っていたということだった。
lines.translated: The reason Haru and the others had made Chiwa dress up like that--it meant everyone already knew that Chiwa had feelings for me.

lines.content: だから千和が、その想いを俺へと伝えるための勇気に、きっかけに、なればいいと……。
lines.translated: So they had hoped it would serve as the catalyst, the courage Chiwa needed to convey those feelings to me...

lines.content: いつから？
lines.translated: Since when?

lines.content: いつからみんなはそれに気づいていたのだろうか……。
lines.translated: Just how long had everyone been aware of it...?

lines.content: 俺だけが千和の気持ちを知らなかった。いや。もしかすると知ろうともしていなかったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: I was the only one who didn't know how Chiwa felt. No. Maybe I hadn't even tried to know.

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: ……わからない。
lines.translated: I don't know.

lines.content: 俺には何も、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't understand anything, though...

lines.content: 千和は勇気を出して、俺に告白までしてくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa mustered up her courage and even confessed to me.

lines.content: それは確かだ。
lines.translated: That much is certain.

lines.content: ……あのときの千和の好きに、うそはなかった。
lines.translated: There was no lie when Chiwa told me she loved me back then.

lines.content: それは、確かなようだった。
lines.translated: That much seemed certain.

lines.content: その瞬間、千和の気持ちはどんなふうに揺れ動いていたのか。それは想像することさえも俺には難しいけれど……。
lines.translated: Just how much had Chiwa's feelings been wavering in that moment? Even imagining it was difficult for me, though...

lines.content: 反省。
lines.translated: Remorse.

lines.content: 智仁やハルだけではなく、俺たち全員が反省しなければと言っていたが……しかし。
lines.translated: Tomohito had said that all of us, not just him and Haru, needed to reflect on what we'd done... However.

lines.content: それは俺にこそ必要だろうはずだった。
lines.translated: I was the one who needed to do that more than anyone.

lines.content: だけどなんだか変だよな
lines.translated: "Still, isn't it kind of strange?"

lines.content: 変……？　何が？
lines.translated: "Strange...? What is?"

lines.content: 智仁のふとした問いかけに、ハルが首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head at Tomohito's sudden question.

lines.content: あ、えっと。ちょっとした違和感というか。そんな程度の話なんだけどさ……
lines.translated: "Ah, well. It's more like a slight sense of unease. It's nothing major, really, just..."

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑を浮かべ、肩を竦める。
lines.translated: Tomohito gave a wry smile and shrugged his shoulders.

lines.content: 千和ちゃんが学校休んだ理由は、色々と恥ずかしいことがあったから、俺たちの……大雅の顔を見れないってことは、なんとなく想像がつくけど
lines.translated: "I can more or less imagine why Chiwa-chan took the day off school. A lot of embarrassing stuff happened, so she can't bear to face us... or rather, to face Taiga."

lines.content: だけどさ、それはあくまで千和ちゃんの事情だろ？　それなのにお店まで休業するのはどうしてだろうって。そこを少し不思議に思ったんだ
lines.translated: "Even so, that's strictly Chiwa-chan's personal issue, right? Despite that, why would they close the shop, too? I just found that part a little odd."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: ない話じゃないんでないかしら
lines.translated: "I don't think it's entirely out of the question, though."

lines.content: そう？
lines.translated: "Yeah?"

lines.content: うん。だって、看板娘が元気なくってお休みしたら、ご注文をとって回る人がいなくなっちゃう。ウエイターさん、千和しかいなかったし
lines.translated: "Yeah. I mean, if their poster girl isn't feeling well and takes the day off, there's nobody left to go around taking orders. Chiwa was the only waitress they had, after all."

lines.content: 人手が足りないから、今日は閉めてる？
lines.translated: "So they closed for the day because they're short-staffed?"

lines.content: かもしれないねって、話
lines.translated: "I'm just saying that might be the case."

lines.content: いや……うーん。そんなときこそ大雅だろう。千和ちゃんが休んでる間に、大雅が代わりにがんばればいいんじゃないかな。新人ウエイターとしての腕の見せどころじゃないか
lines.translated: "No... hmm. That's precisely when Taiga should step up, right? While Chiwa-chan is resting, shouldn't Taiga work hard in her place? It's the perfect chance to show off his skills as the rookie waiter."

lines.content: いや。俺は……
大雅はねー、クビになったんですってー
lines.translated: "Taiga got fired, apparently~"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ハルが目をぱちぱちとさせ、
lines.translated: Haru blinked in surprise.

lines.content: クビ？　そうなの？
lines.translated: "Fired? Really?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 昨日あったことのすべてをみんなに話しているわけではなかったが……。
lines.translated: I hadn't told everyone everything that happened yesterday, though...

lines.content: 千和を泣かせてしまったのだと、俺はここに至ってようやく、みんなに伝えた。
lines.translated: Now that it had come to this, I finally confessed to everyone that I had made Chiwa cry.

lines.content: 俺があんまりにあんまりだったから千和を傷つけてしまった。そういう具合に。そのとき千和からもらった言葉だとかは、秘密にしたまま。
lines.translated: I explained it along the lines of me being so utterly awful that I ended up hurting her. All while keeping the words Chiwa had given me back then a secret.

lines.content: それを知ったからだと思う。昨日の夜に千和のお父さんから電話があったんだ。そのとき、きっぱり言われたよ。君はもう来なくて良いよって
lines.translated: "I think it's because he found out about that. Chiwa's dad called me last night. He told me flat out that I didn't need to come in anymore."

lines.content: それはひどく冷たい声だった。
lines.translated: His voice had been terribly cold.

lines.content: しかし有無を言わせぬ勢いのようなものがそこにはあり、何も言えず黙ってしまった俺を置いてきぼりに、電話は直ぐに切れてしまったのだった。
lines.translated: There was a finality to it that brooked no argument, and the call ended immediately, leaving me behind in stunned silence, unable to say a word.

lines.content: ……どうしてそんなことになっちゃうの、と。
lines.translated: How did things end up like that?

lines.content: ここにいる誰かから叱責の言葉のひとつやふたつくらいは投げられるだろうと覚悟をしていたけれど、
lines.translated: I had braced myself to have a word or two of reprimand thrown at me by someone here,

lines.content: しかし、そこには沈黙だけがあった。
lines.translated: Yet, there was only silence.

lines.content: ハルだけではない。姫織や智仁からも同じだった。
lines.translated: Not just from Haru. It was the same from Himeori and Tomohito, too.

lines.content: 叱責どころかこちらを心配してくれている。そんな眼差しと呼吸を俺は感じられてしまい……、
lines.translated: Far from scolding me, they were worried about me. I could feel it in their gazes and their very breathing...

lines.content: ……少しだ。
lines.translated: Just a little.

lines.content: ほんの少しだけでも君らに叱ってほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted you guys to scold me, even if just a little bit.

lines.content: そんな甘えた気持ちもどこかにあったことに気づいてしまった。
lines.translated: I realized that somewhere deep down, I had been harboring such a spoiled wish.

lines.content: あれからまだ一度も千和の顔を見れていない。
lines.translated: I still hadn't seen Chiwa's face even once since then.

lines.content: ……どころか、俺はその声も聞けていない。連絡だって取れてはいないのだ。
lines.translated: Far from it, I hadn't even heard her voice. I hadn't been able to get in touch with her at all.

lines.content: 電話――拒否されたらどうしよう。
lines.translated: A phone call--what if she rejected it?

lines.content: メッセージ――既読さえ付かなかったなら、どうしよう。
lines.translated: A message--what if she didn't even mark it as read?

lines.content: そういった“怖さ”から、俺は千和のお父さんから連絡を受けてもなお、自分の端末をただ見つめているばかりだった。
lines.translated: Out of that kind of "fear," even after getting that call from Chiwa's father, all I could do was stare at my phone.

lines.content: 大雅と千和は喧嘩して……。大雅は千和をいっぱい泣かせてしまった
lines.translated: "Taiga and Chiwa had a fight... and Taiga made Chiwa cry a whole lot."

lines.content: 姫織が呪文を唱えるみたいにそう言った。
lines.translated: Himeori said it as if chanting a spell.

lines.content: 大雅と喧嘩して泣いちゃったから……千和。大雅の顔なんてもう見たくないっ、て。そんな感じ？
lines.translated: "Because she fought with Taiga and cried... Chiwa doesn't ever want to see Taiga's face again. Something like that?"

lines.content: だね
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 俺、千和にひどいことしちゃったんだよ
lines.translated: "I did something terrible to Chiwa."

lines.content: ふぅん
lines.translated: "Hmm."

lines.content: 姫織はただ何でもないようにうなずいただけだった。
lines.translated: Himeori simply nodded as if it were nothing out of the ordinary.

lines.content: ……ひよちゃん。怒らないの？
lines.translated: "...Hiyo-chan. Aren't you mad?"

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: どうして怒るの？　と姫織は目をぱちぱちとさせている。
lines.translated: "Why would I be mad?" Himeori blinked at me.

lines.content: いや。なんとなくのイメージだけどさ、ひよちゃん……君には、千和を泣かせるなんてひどい！　って怒られちゃうんじゃないかなって。そう思ったんだけど……
lines.translated: "No, it's just a vague impression I had, Hiyo-chan... I thought you might get mad at me and say something like, 'How could you make Chiwa cry, you're terrible!' At least, that's what I thought..."

lines.content: 大雅はひどいから私と千和にお菓子をいっぱい奢ってください！　そんなふうにも言われるだろうか。
lines.translated: Or maybe she'd say something like, "You're terrible, Taiga, so treat me and Chiwa to lots of sweets!"

lines.content: むしろそれをどこかで期待もしていたのかもしれないが……。
lines.translated: In fact, part of me might have even been hoping for that...

lines.content: 別に
lines.translated: "Not really."

lines.content: 姫織はふるふると首を振り、言う――
lines.translated: Himeori shook her head and said--

lines.content: それって大雅と千和、ふたりのことでしょう？　何も事情を知らない私が、大雅ひどい！　って。大雅のばか！　って。えらそーには言えないよ
lines.translated: "That's between you and Chiwa, isn't it? When I don't know any of the circumstances, I can't very well get all high and mighty and say, 'You're terrible, Taiga!' or 'You idiot, Taiga!'"

lines.content: わあ……ひよちゃん、大人だなあ
lines.translated: "Wow... You're so mature, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: ふっふん
lines.translated: "Heh heh."

lines.content: 姫織は胸を張る。
lines.translated: Himeori puffed out her chest.

lines.content: 夜月さん家の姫織ちゃんはできる女の子なので
lines.translated: "Because Himeori-chan of the Yozuki household is a capable girl."

lines.content: おー
lines.translated: "Yeah!"

lines.content: ぱちぱちぱちと手を打ってみた。
lines.translated: I clapped my hands in applause.

lines.content: でもまあ大雅はいつだってひどいし、大雅はいつだって、おばかなんだけどね
lines.translated: "Although, well, you're always terrible, Taiga, and you're always a dummy, too."

lines.content: ……無念だ
lines.translated: "...How regrettable."

lines.content: がっくりとした。
lines.translated: My shoulders slumped.

lines.content: だけどね大雅
lines.translated: "Still, you know, Taiga."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 千和を……大雅が泣かせちゃったんなら、ちゃんと、大雅が千和のこと笑顔にできないとだめなんじゃないかなーって。できる子なひよりちゃんはね、そう思うのであった
lines.translated: "If you... made Chiwa cry, Taiga, then I don't think it's any good unless you're the one to properly put a smile back on her face. That's what a capable girl like Hiyori-chan thinks."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ひよちゃんの言うとおりだ
lines.translated: "You're completely right, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: 千和のことを笑顔に。
lines.translated: Putting a smile back on Chiwa's face.

lines.content: それはひどく難しいことのように感じられたし、何よりとても簡単なことであるようにも感じられた。
lines.translated: It felt like something terribly difficult to do, and yet above all, it also felt like something very simple.

lines.content: それを実現させるため、今の俺に必要なものは、きっと……。
lines.translated: In order to make that happen, what I needed right now was surely...

lines.content: チャイム。
lines.translated: The chime rang.

lines.content: 午後の授業が始まった。
lines.translated: Afternoon classes began.

lines.content: それぞれが消化不良な表情で席に着いた。
lines.translated: Everyone took their seats with unsatisfied expressions on their faces.

lines.content: 俺は、考えている。
lines.translated: I was thinking.

lines.content: ……今、ここでは“魔法”のことは置いておこう。
lines.translated: Right now, let's set the matter of "magic" aside.

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: やはりそれは、どうしても完全には無視できない事情ではあるものの……。
lines.translated: Even though it was definitely a circumstance I couldn't completely ignore...

lines.content: それでも今、最優先に考えるべきことはそこではないはず。
lines.translated: Even so, that shouldn't be my top priority to think about right now.

lines.content: 俺は、千和のことをどう思っているのか。
lines.translated: How do I feel about Chiwa?

lines.content: 俺は、千和とどんな関係になりたいのか。
lines.translated: What kind of relationship do I want to have with Chiwa?

lines.content: 情けない限りだが。
lines.translated: It's utterly pathetic of me, though.

lines.content: この期に及んで、俺は、俺自身の心の内がわからない。
lines.translated: Even at this late stage, I don't understand my own heart.

lines.content: ただ、言えることは……ひとつ。
lines.translated: However, there is... one thing I can say.

lines.content: 千和に会いたい。
lines.translated: I want to see Chiwa.

lines.content: そう思った。
lines.translated: That's what I thought to myself.

lines.content: 千和と会ってちゃんと話したい。
lines.translated: I want to see Chiwa and talk to her properly.

lines.content: そう、願った。
lines.translated: That was what I wished for.

lines.content: たった一日その顔を見ていないだけでこんなことを思うのも、また、どうかしてしまっているのかもしれないが……。
lines.translated: Thinking like this after not seeing her face for just a single day might mean there's something wrong with me, too, though...

lines.content: もしもこのまま一度も会えないまま卒業を……“さよなら”をしてしまうとしたら。
lines.translated: What if we were to graduate... to say "goodbye" like this, without ever seeing each other again?

lines.content: そんなばかなことをふと想像してしまっていた。
lines.translated: I suddenly found myself imagining something so foolish.

lines.content: 悩むことばかりが専売特許。
lines.translated: Worrying is practically my specialty.

lines.content: まだまだ心が子どもだからと言い訳をならべては、無意味な思考ばかりを広げてる。
lines.translated: Lining up excuses about how my heart is still that of a child, I just let meaningless thoughts spin out of control.

lines.content: ……茫漠と引き延ばされた想いは底なしに時間を飲み込む。
lines.translated: Those vaguely drawn-out feelings swallowed up time like a bottomless pit.

lines.content: あっという間に放課後だ。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, school was over for the day.

lines.content: 今日はみんなで遊んで帰るような気持ちにはもちろんなれない。
lines.translated: Naturally, none of us were in the mood to hang out together on the way home today.

lines.content: 千和のことを心配しすぎたのだろうか。姫織も、智仁も、どこか疲れた顔をしていた。
lines.translated: Perhaps they had worried too much about Chiwa. Both Himeori and Tomohito looked somewhat exhausted.

lines.content: 荷物をまとめ、今日はまっすぐ帰ろうかと言ったところで。
lines.translated: Just as we packed up our things and talked about heading straight home today...

lines.content: ……あれ？
ハルは？
lines.translated: "Where's Haru?"

lines.content: きょろきょろ見回すけれど、その姿は教室のどこにも見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: I looked around the room, but she was nowhere to be seen in the classroom.

lines.content: んー。チャイムが鳴ったのと同時に走って教室出て行っちゃったけど……
lines.translated: "Hmm. She ran out of the classroom the second the bell rang, though..."

lines.content: ハルちゃんの荷物はまだあるし、先に帰っちゃったってわけでもなさそうだ
lines.translated: "Haru-chan's bag is still here, so it doesn't look like she went home ahead of us."

lines.content: そうか。だったら戻ってくるまで待ってようか
lines.translated: "I see. Then let's wait until she comes back."

lines.content: 三人で何でもないことを話して待った。
lines.translated: The three of us chatted about nothing in particular while we waited.

lines.content: しかし俺たちにしては珍しく会話が途切れ……。
lines.translated: However, in a rare turn for us, the conversation died down...

lines.content: ふたりが、チラチラと時計を見始めていた。
lines.translated: The two of them started glancing repeatedly at the clock.

lines.content: ……ごめん、ふたりとも。俺ちょっと先に帰ってる
lines.translated: "...Sorry, you two. I'm gonna head out a little early."

lines.content: 俺は鞄を取り上げ、席を立った。
lines.translated: I picked up my bag and stood from my seat.

lines.content: え？　大雅、帰っちゃうの？
lines.translated: "Huh? You're leaving, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……ああ。悪いけどハルに伝えておいてくれないかな。千和の家に寄ってから帰るって
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Sorry, but could you pass a message on to Haru for me? Tell her I'm stopping by Chiwa's house before heading home."

lines.content: わかった。じゃあ、俺たちも後から寄る。千和ちゃんのお店で待ち合わせだ
lines.translated: "Got it. In that case, we'll swing by later too. Let's meet up at Chiwa-chan's shop."

lines.content: ああ、そうだな。そうしようか
lines.translated: "Yeah, sounds good. Let's do that."

lines.content: もし千和ちゃんに会えなかったりしたら連絡してくれないか？　その場合は別のところで待ち合わせよう
lines.translated: "If you can't get a hold of Chiwa-chan or anything, could you let us know? If that happens, we can meet up somewhere else."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: もう一度、ハルにもちゃんと伝えておいてほしいとふたりに言って、俺は、小走りに教室を横切り――
lines.translated: Asking the two of them once more to make sure they passed the message along to Haru, I jogged across the classroom--

lines.content: うわ
lines.translated: "Whoa."

lines.content: 教室の扉を開いて、驚いた。
lines.translated: I opened the classroom door and froze in surprise.

lines.content: そこにハルが立っていたからだ。
lines.translated: Because Haru was standing right there.

lines.content: ハルもちょうど扉を開けようかとしていたところだったらしい。
lines.translated: It seemed she had just been about to open the door herself.

lines.content: ハルは、目を丸くし俺を見上げている――そしてそのまま固まってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Haru was looking up at me with wide eyes--completely frozen in place.

lines.content: なんだか驚きが瞳の中から次々と溢れてきているみたいに見えた。
lines.translated: It looked almost as if waves of shock were spilling out of her eyes one after another.

lines.content: ……その驚きは、今ここで産まれたものではない。そう思えた。だから俺は問いかける。
lines.translated: That shock hadn't been born right here and now. Or so it felt to me. That was why I asked her.

lines.content: どうした、ハル。何かあったのか？
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Haru? Did something happen?"

lines.content: 大雅くん……
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 今、千和ちゃんのクラスの先生に、聞いてきたんだけど……
lines.translated: "I just went and asked Chiwa-chan's homeroom teacher, and..."

lines.content: 言いよどむハル。
lines.translated: Haru hesitated, trailing off.

lines.content: それでも先を促さないわけにはいかなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I had no choice but to urge her on.

lines.content: ハル。何を聞いてきたんだ？
lines.translated: "Haru. What did you hear?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 今朝、千和ちゃんのお父さんから、学校に連絡があったみたいで
lines.translated: "It seems the school got a call from Chiwa-chan's father this morning..."

lines.content: ぽつり、ぽつりとハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru spoke in halting,broken phrases.

lines.content: ……嫌な予感がする。
lines.translated: I had a bad feeling about this.

lines.content: 千和ちゃんが、転校するって……
lines.translated: "Saying that Chiwa-chan is transferring schools..."

lines.content: ……まさか、そこまでするとは。
lines.translated: No way. I can't believe he'd go that far.

lines.content: そんなこと俺にはまるで想像もできていなかった。
lines.translated: I hadn't even remotely imagined something like that happening.

lines.content: ハルちゃん……それって本当？　聞き間違えじゃなくって？
lines.translated: "Haru-chan... is that true? You didn't mishear?"

lines.content: 駆け寄ってきた姫織が俺の背中にしがみつく。
lines.translated: Himeori rushed over and clung to my back.

lines.content: そして智仁が、俺にしがみつきがくがくと揺すって来る姫織を宥めるように、その頭を撫でていた。
lines.translated: And Tomohito gently stroked Himeori's head to calm her down as she clung to me, shaking me back and forth.

lines.content: 俺は、そんなみんなの顔をぐるりと見渡す。そして、[・|覚][・|悟][・|を][・|決][・|め][・|た]。
lines.translated: I looked around at everyone's faces. And then, I made up my mind.

lines.content: ……なあ、みんな。俺に少しだけ、協力してくれないかな
lines.translated: "...Hey, everyone. Could you lend me a hand, just a little?"

lines.content: ……勇気だ。
lines.translated: It was about courage.

lines.content: 千和はいっぱいの勇気を出して、俺に告白をしてくれた。
lines.translated: Chiwa had mustered up so much courage to confess her feelings to me.

lines.content: だから次は俺の勇気が試される番だ。
lines.translated: So next, it was time for my own courage to be tested.

lines.content: そうだよな。クロ。
lines.translated: Right, Kuro?

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺自身にかけた期待に、今こそ応えなければと……思った。
lines.translated: Now was the time I had to live up to the expectations I'd placed on myself... or so I thought.
Why did I ever fall in love with him in the first place?

lines.content: カーテンを閉め切った自室でひとりきり。
lines.translated: All alone in my room with the curtains drawn tight.

lines.content: 私、杏藤千和はベッドの中で丸くなり、スマートフォンとにらめっこ。
lines.translated: I, Andou Chiwa, was curled up in bed, having a staring contest with my smartphone.

lines.content: メッセージアプリで先輩と会話する画面を開いたまま……、
lines.translated: Leaving the screen open to my messaging app chat with Senpai...

lines.content: ……はぁ
lines.translated: "...Haah."

lines.content: 何度目かの、ため息だ。
lines.translated: I let out my umpteenth sigh.

lines.content: ずっと変化のない画面。諦めて電源を落とす。
lines.translated: The screen remained completely unchanged. Giving up, I turned off the power.

lines.content: 心はもやもやしっぱなし。
lines.translated: My heart felt endlessly heavy and restless.

lines.content: だからすぐまたスマートフォンを覗き込み――ため息だ。
lines.translated: Which was why I immediately peeked at my smartphone again--and sighed.

lines.content: 昨晩からずっとずっとその繰り返し。
lines.translated: I'd been repeating that exact cycle over and over since last night.

lines.content: あんな一方的な“さよなら”をしておいて、それでも私はどこかできっと期待してしまってる。
lines.translated: Even after giving him such a one-sided "goodbye," deep down, part of me was surely still hoping.

lines.content: 電話とか、かかってこないかな。
lines.translated: Wondering if he might call me.

lines.content: もしかしたらメッセージとかあるかもしれないし。
lines.translated: Thinking maybe, just maybe, there'd be a message from him.

lines.content: そんな思いがあるから手放せない。
lines.translated: Because I had those thoughts, I couldn't let go of my phone.

lines.content: だけど、手の中の小さな端末が震えることはない。いつまでも。ずっと。
lines.translated: However, the small device in my hand never vibrated. Not once. Never.

lines.content: 学園も休んでしまった。
lines.translated: I'd even skipped school today.

lines.content: 先輩の顔を見るのが怖いから――……それもある。
lines.translated: Because I was scared to see Senpai's face--...that was part of it, too.

lines.content: 先輩、私のこと、少しくらい心配してくれてるかな……そんな気持ちがどこかにあって。それに、気づいて。
lines.translated: I wondered if Senpai was at least a little worried about me... That feeling was somewhere inside me. And realizing that...

lines.content: ああ、もう。
lines.translated: Ugh, seriously.

lines.content: 私は自分が嫌になる。
lines.translated: I hate myself right now.

lines.content: ため息だ。ため息ばかりを私はついてる。
lines.translated: Another sigh. All I'm doing is sighing.

lines.content: ……どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: いくつもいくつも私の中に渦巻く“どうして”が、またひとつ、ぽろりとこぼれる――
lines.translated: Of the countless "whys" swirling around inside me, another one slipped out softly--

lines.content: ……どうして私、あんなことしちゃったのかなあ
lines.translated: "...Why did I go and do something like that?"
That was how it all started in the first place.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my eyes.

lines.content: もぞもぞとベッドの中に潜り込み――まず最初に思い出すのは、数日前のこと。
lines.translated: Wriggling deeper under the covers--the very first thing that came to mind was from a few days ago.

lines.content: 進められるまま[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|格][・|好]をしてしまった日のことだ。
lines.translated: It was the day I let myself get talked into wearing that outfit.

lines.content: ……こんな格好で、本当に先輩がよろこんでくれるんですか？
lines.translated: "...Will Senpai really be happy seeing me dressed like this?"

lines.content: 手渡されたのは犬耳付きのカチューシャだった。
lines.translated: What had been handed to me was a headband with dog ears attached.

lines.content: もちろんだよ。これを頭につけてかわいいポーズをすれば大雅なんていちころだよ
lines.translated: "Of course he will. Put this on your head and strike a cute pose, and Taiga will fall head over heels in an instant."

lines.content: 夜月先輩が自信たっぷりにそう言っていた。
lines.translated: Yotsuki-senpai had said that brimming with confidence.

lines.content: うーん……
嫌な予感。そのとき私の脳裏には昔々のことが過ぎっていた。
lines.translated: I had a bad feeling about it. At that moment, memories from a long, long time ago flashed through my mind.

lines.content: そんな私の気持ちを察したのだろう夜月先輩が、ぐっと拳を握って私に言った。
lines.translated: Perhaps sensing how I felt, Yotsuki-senpai clenched her fist tightly and spoke to me.

lines.content: 平気だよ。心配しなくても大丈夫。大雅は絶対、よろこぶよ
lines.translated: "It'll be fine. You don't need to worry. Taiga will definitely be thrilled."

lines.content: ……そうですか？　絶対、ですか？
lines.translated: "...Really? Are you sure about that?"

lines.content: うん。そうなの。絶対。だってね、大雅は変態だから
lines.translated: "Yep. I am. Definitely. Because, you see, Taiga is a pervert."

lines.content: 得意げに夜月先輩は、胸を張る。
lines.translated: Yotsuki-senpai puffed out her chest proudly.

lines.content: 変態な人はケモ耳が大好物なんだって、そう聞いたことがあります故……平気。問題はないんだよ
lines.translated: "I have heard it said that perverts absolutely love animal ears, therefore... it's fine. There's no problem at all."

lines.content: ……違います
lines.translated: "...That's not true."

lines.content: 先輩は、変態さんじゃないです
lines.translated: "Senpai is not a pervert."

lines.content: なんだかムッとしてそう言い返してしまった。
lines.translated: Feeling somewhat annoyed, I ended up snapping back like that.

lines.content: ……そ、それに、変態さんな人がよろこぶような格好なら、私、したくないです
