lines.translated: "...B-Besides, if it's the kind of outfit that makes a pervert happy, I don't want to wear it."

lines.content: ん～、でもね？　ひよりちゃんは見てしまったのです
lines.translated: "Hmm~ But you know what? Hiyori-chan saw it with her own eyes."

lines.content: 何をですか？
lines.translated: "Saw what?"

lines.content: 大雅がね、この前、スマホをじーっと見てたから、何か美味しそうなお店でも見つけたのかなあって思って……後ろから覗き込んでみたの。そしたら
lines.translated: "Well, the other day, Taiga was staring really hard at his smartphone, so I wondered if he'd found a tasty-looking restaurant or something... and I peeked over his shoulder. And then..."

lines.content: ……そしたら？
lines.translated: "...And then?"

lines.content: うん。大雅。けものっ娘なメイドさんの画像を見ていたの。食い入るみたいに
lines.translated: "Yep. Taiga was looking at a picture of an animal-eared maid. Like his eyes were glued to it."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: そして大雅ったらね、真剣な顔で“うむ”ってだけ言って、何回もうなずいていて……その後デレデレもしちゃってた
lines.translated: "And then, get this, with a dead-serious look on his face, all he said was 'Indeed,' nodding over and over... and after that, he was grinning like a total idiot over it."

lines.content: おまけにその画像、二次元で……爆乳だった――……
lines.translated: "On top of that, the picture was 2D, and... she had huge, explosive breasts--..."

lines.content: そこで夜月先輩の表情が、一転。怖い顔。
lines.translated: Right there, Yotsuki-senpai's expression completely changed. A scary face.

lines.content: はは！　ゆるせん。あ、この人、変態な人だとそのときはじめてひよりちゃんは思いました
lines.translated: "Haha! Unforgivable. 'Ah, this person is a pervert,' was what Hiyori-chan thought for the very first time right then."

lines.content: ……どうしてそこで変態さんになるんですか？
lines.translated: "...How does that make him a pervert?"

lines.content: 巨乳が好きな人はみんなまとめて変態だから。ケモ耳好きと同じに
lines.translated: "Because everyone who likes big breasts is collectively a pervert. Just like people who like animal ears."

lines.content: なるほど
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: ひ、姫織ちゃん、それはどうなのかなあって思うけど……あと、お願い。ふたりして私の胸、見ないでほしいなあ……って
lines.translated: "H-Himeori-chan, I'm not so sure about that... Also, please. I wish you two wouldn't stare at my chest like that..."

lines.content: ふん。おっきなお胸のハルちゃんは黙ってて
lines.translated: "Hmph. Big-boobed Haru-chan can just stay quiet."

lines.content: ぷいっとそっぽを向いてしまう夜月先輩――これは戦争なんだよ、負けられない戦いなの、とそんなことをつぶやいて。
lines.translated: Yotsuki-senpai huffed and turned away--muttering things like, "This is war, a battle we cannot afford to lose."

lines.content: きっと大雅のスマホの中身はけものっ娘でちょっとエッチで爆乳な二次元画像で溢れてるんだよ
lines.translated: "I'm sure the inside of Taiga's smartphone is overflowing with slightly naughty 2D pictures of animal-eared girls with huge breasts."

lines.content: だからね、千和。二次元よりも三次元が強いところ、爆乳よりも貧乳がすてきなんだってところ、大雅に見せてあげなきゃ
lines.translated: "That's why, Chiwa, we have to show Taiga that 3D is stronger than 2D, and that small breasts are much more wonderful than huge ones."

lines.content: 二次元って……なんだろう。
lines.translated: 2D... What's that?

lines.content: そこはよくわからなかったけど。
lines.translated: I didn't really understand that part, though.

lines.content: ……ふぅん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: 私は、目を細めてしまう。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: 爆乳。デレデレしていた先輩。
lines.translated: Huge breasts. Senpai grinning like an idiot over them.

lines.content: ……むかつく。
lines.translated: How annoying.

lines.content: なんだか胸の中がもやっとしたから。
lines.translated: Because it left a weird, frustrating feeling in my chest.

lines.content: だからそのまま、犬耳を受け取ってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: So I just went ahead and accepted the dog ears, but...

lines.content: ……大雅、悪い
lines.translated: "...My bad, Taiga."

lines.content: ……兎蛙先輩が、すっと視線を逸らし、何か小さくつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: Usagaeru-senpai quickly averted his gaze and muttered something under his breath.

lines.content: ……それってたぶん、俺が、すげえ絵見つけたって言って送ったやつだな。うん。……面倒だから黙ってよう
lines.translated: "...That's probably the one I sent him, saying I found a super amazing picture. Yeah. ...It'll be a pain, so I'll just keep my mouth shut."

lines.content: ……うう、やっぱりあんなことするんじゃなかった
lines.translated: "...Ugh, I really shouldn't have done that."

lines.content: ベッドの中で頭を抱えた。
lines.translated: I buried my head in my hands beneath the covers.

lines.content: 先輩が見ていたらしい画像に対抗して……。
lines.translated: Trying to compete with the picture Senpai had apparently been looking at...

lines.content: デレデレしていたらしい[・|そ][・|の][・|娘]には、負けられないからって……。
lines.translated: Telling myself I couldn't lose to *that girl* he was supposedly fawning over...

lines.content: 犬耳……。
lines.translated: Dog ears...

lines.content: 言われるまま、ちょっとかわいいポーズをとってみたり……。
lines.translated: Even striking a slightly cute pose just like I was told to...

lines.content: 私がそんなことをしたのにはわけがある。
lines.translated: There's a reason why I went and did something like that.

lines.content: それはもちろん、デレデレしていたらしい先輩にムッとしたからというのもあるけれど……。
lines.translated: Of course, part of it was because I was annoyed at Senpai for supposedly grinning like an idiot over that picture, but...

lines.content: この後悔は、ずっと昔の十年前にもさかのぼる。
lines.translated: This regret actually goes all the way back to ten years ago.

lines.content: ……私は、奏先輩のことが好き。
lines.translated: I am in love with Kanade-senpai.

lines.content: だけどあの頃の私は“好き”という気持ちが怖くて。その気持ちは、ひとりで抱えるには重すぎて。
lines.translated: Back then, though, the feeling of "being in love" scared me. It was far too heavy for me to carry all by myself.

lines.content: だからつい、お友だちになったばかりのみんなに、相談してしまったのだ――私、あの人のこと。奏大雅くんのこと、好きになっちゃったみたい。
lines.translated: So I ended up confiding in everyone I had just become friends with--telling them I thought I had fallen in love with him, with Kanade Taiga-kun.

lines.content: その理由をみんなに問われた。
lines.translated: They all asked me why.

lines.content: 『どうして千和ちゃんは大雅くんのことを好きになったの？』
lines.translated: "How come you fell in love with Taiga-kun, Chiwa-chan?"

lines.content: でも、応えられない。
lines.translated: But I couldn't answer them.

lines.content: きっとわかってもらえない。そう思ったから。
lines.translated: Because I figured they wouldn't understand.

lines.content: ……だって、あの頃の私自身もまだ、その気持ちをしっかりと理解もできていなかったから。
lines.translated: After all, back then, I didn't even fully understand those feelings myself.

lines.content: だけど、“あの人のことが私は大好き”
lines.translated: Still, "I love him."

lines.content: その気持ちが私の中にあることだけは確かだった。
lines.translated: The one thing I knew for sure was that those feelings were inside me.

lines.content: それだけはみんなに隠さず伝えた。
lines.translated: That much, at least, I told everyone without hiding it.

lines.content: そんな私に、あの頃の柊先輩が言ったのだ。
lines.translated: That was when Hiiragi-senpai back then said to me:

lines.content: 『じゃあじゃあ、大雅くんのことを“お兄ちゃん”って呼んでみようよ。男の子はみんなかわいい妹に恋をするって聞いたことがあるよ？』
lines.translated: "In that case, why don't you try calling Taiga-kun 'Onii-chan'? I've heard that all boys fall in love with a cute little sister!"

lines.content: 柊先輩……。
lines.translated: Hiiragi-senpai...

lines.content: あれっていったい、どこで仕入れてきた話だったんだろう。
lines.translated: Where on earth did she even pick up an idea like that?

lines.content: 犬耳の件も、昔々のこの件も、発案者はいつだって[・|柊][・|先][・|輩]だ。
lines.translated: Both the dog ears incident and this one from way back then--the mastermind behind them is always *Hiiragi-senpai*.

lines.content: そしてみんなが賛成だとうなずいた――夜月先輩が面白そう！　と両手を挙げた。
lines.translated: And everyone nodded in agreement -- Yatsuki-senpai threw both hands in the air, saying it sounded like fun!

lines.content: 冷静に思えばそんなことで、好きな人に振り向いてもらえるはずもないってわかるのに……。
lines.translated: Thinking about it calmly, I should have known a stunt like that wouldn't make the person I like look my way...

lines.content: 私、昔も今も、本当にどうかしてる。
lines.translated: Really, whether it's back then or right now, there's something wrong with me.

lines.content: 信じてみたいと思ってしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up wanting to believe in it.

lines.content: もしかしたら柊先輩の……ハルちゃんの言うことが正しいかもしれない。
lines.translated: That maybe Hiiragi-senpai... maybe Haru-chan was right.

lines.content: だからあの頃の私は、先輩に意地悪されると、
lines.translated: So back then, whenever Senpai teased me, I would say:

lines.content: 『ひどい……ひどいよ。あんまり意地悪しないで……お、お兄ちゃん……』
lines.translated: "You're so mean... That's so mean. Please don't tease me so much... O-Onii-chan..."

lines.content: 涙目で。
lines.translated: With teary eyes.

lines.content: 上目使いに。
lines.translated: Looking up at him from beneath my lashes.

lines.content: 柊先輩に、あるいは夜月先輩にレクチャーされたように、言ってみて……後悔だ。
lines.translated: I tried saying it just the way Hiiragi-senpai, or rather Yorugetsu-senpai, had coached me to... and I immediately regretted it.

lines.content: あのときのことを思い出すと、決まって身体が、頬が、熱くなる――うう、あんなこと、するんじゃなかった。そんな具合に。
lines.translated: Whenever I remember that moment, my whole body and my cheeks unfailingly burn up--ugh, I really shouldn't have done that. Just like that.

lines.content: そんな私に、幼い頃の先輩はぽかんとしていた。
lines.translated: Back then, the young Senpai just stared at me in blank amazement.

lines.content: 喜ぶよりも私のこと、心配そうに見つめてた。
lines.translated: Rather than looking happy, he just gazed at me with concern.

lines.content: 私は、真っ赤になった。今も昔も変わらずに。
lines.translated: I turned bright red. That hasn't changed at all, then or now.

lines.content: ……そして十年後の、今。
lines.translated: And now, ten years later.

lines.content: 一度“さよなら”したけれど、また帰ってきてくれた柊先輩は、そのときのことを覚えていて……。
lines.translated: Even though we had said "goodbye" once, Hiiragi-senpai came back to us, and she still remembered what happened back then...

lines.content: まだ私が奏先輩のことを、ずっとずっと、好きなままなことも知ったから……。
lines.translated: And because she found out that I was still in love with Kanade-senpai, after all this time...

lines.content: だから十年前の延長で、お兄ちゃんと呼ぶ代わりに、今度は奏先輩の好きそうな格好で……かわいいポーズで。
lines.translated: So as a continuation of what happened ten years ago, instead of calling him Onii-chan, this time I dressed up in an outfit Kanade-senpai would probably like... and struck a cute pose.

lines.content: ああ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: もう、
lines.translated: Honestly,

lines.content: やってることは今も昔もあまり変わらない――……後悔だ。後悔ばかり私はしてる。
lines.translated: what I'm doing hasn't really changed much between then and now--...It's all regret. All I ever do is regret things.

lines.content: そして、今度は“デート”だ。
lines.translated: And the next step was a "date."

lines.content: 犬耳姿で。かわいいポーズで。そんな私にきっと奏先輩は悩殺されたはずだから……。だから“デート”に誘ってみよう。そう言い出したのは誰だったっけ。
lines.translated: Wearing dog ears. Striking a cute pose. Since Kanade-senpai was surely bowled over by seeing me like that... I should try asking him out on a "date." Who was it that came up with that idea again?

lines.content: やっぱりそれも柊先輩だったと思う。
lines.translated: I'm pretty sure that was Hiiragi-senpai, too.

lines.content: 『そんな、いきなり……。告白なんて』
lines.translated: "Wait, out of nowhere...? Confess to him?"

lines.content: そんなの無理だよ。そんなの、できないよ。
lines.translated: There's no way. I can't do something like that.

lines.content: 焦るばかりの私に、
lines.translated: As I panicked, she said to me,

lines.content: 『ううん。そんなことないよ。千和ちゃん。十年も“好き”って気持ちを忘れず持っていたんだよね？』
lines.translated: "No, that's not true, Chiwa-chan. You've held onto your feelings of love for ten whole years without forgetting them, right?"

lines.content: 『だから千和ちゃんにとって全然、いきなりでも、突然でも、ないんじゃないかな……たぶん。だからさ。勇気を持って……告白してみていいんじゃないかな……きっと』
lines.translated: "So for you, Chiwa-chan, it's not out of nowhere or sudden at all... probably. That's why... I think it's okay for you to be brave and confess to him... surely."

lines.content: そんなことを言われた私は、どうしてだろう――“嫌だ”とは断れなかった。
lines.translated: For some reason, when she put it like that -- I couldn't bring myself to say no.

lines.content: だって、私にそう勧める柊先輩の笑顔が少し、さみしそうなものに見えたから……。
lines.translated: Because the smile Hiiragi-senpai wore as she encouraged me looked just a little bit lonely...

lines.content: だからそうしなきゃだめなんだって、どこかで思った。
lines.translated: So somewhere deep down, I felt like I had no choice but to do it.

lines.content: 本当に、もしかしたら私の好きなあの人が振り向いてくれるかも……。
lines.translated: Maybe, just maybe, the person I loved would actually look my way...

lines.content: そんな希望もどこかにきっとあったから。
lines.translated: Because I must have held onto a sliver of that hope somewhere in my heart.

lines.content: だから言われるまま、流されるまま……。
lines.translated: So I just did as I was told, letting myself be swept along...

lines.content: 告白、してしまって……
lines.translated: "And I ended up confessing..."

lines.content: それでも結局だめだった。
lines.translated: Even so, it was no good in the end.

lines.content: 先輩は私の気持ちを、言葉を、真っ直ぐに受け止めてもくれなかった――悪戯だと、そう、言われてしまった。
lines.translated: Senpai didn't even take my feelings or my words seriously--he just brushed it off as a prank.

lines.content: はぁ……
lines.translated: *Exhale*...

lines.content: ……ため息をつく。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.

lines.content: ……先輩。何をしても、何をしなくても……やっぱり先輩は私のこと、見てくれないんですよね
lines.translated: "...Senpai. No matter what I do, or what I don't do... you really won't ever look at me, will you?"

lines.content: そうつぶやくと小さな胸がきゅっとした。
lines.translated: As I murmured that, my small chest gave a painful squeeze.

lines.content: ……あの人の隣にはいつもあの子がいる。
lines.translated: That girl is always right beside him.

lines.content: 小さくて、かわいくて。
lines.translated: Small and cute.

lines.content: きらきら眩しい夜みたいに静かで、真っ白で……。
lines.translated: Quiet like a dazzling, glittering night, and pure white...

lines.content: いつも私の大好きな人の笑顔をひとりじめしている不思議な子。
lines.translated: A mysterious girl who always has the smile of the person I love all to herself.

lines.content: ……先輩はきっとあの子のことを想ってる。今も、昔も。ずっと変わらず。
lines.translated: Senpai's heart surely belongs to her. Both now and back then. Never changing.

lines.content: あの子がどこかへ行ってしまって、長い間帰ってこないとき。いつも先輩はさみしそうな顔をしている。
lines.translated: Whenever she goes off somewhere and doesn't come back for a long time, Senpai always has such a lonely look on his face.

lines.content: 私と一緒だ。
lines.translated: Just like me.

lines.content: 私も、先輩のこと……ずっとずっと、好きなんだよ。あなたに会えないときはたった一秒だってずっと苦しい。
lines.translated: I've been in love with you, too, Senpai... for so, so long. Whenever I can't see you, every single second is pure agony.

lines.content: だから、少しでいい。ほんの少しでいい。
lines.translated: That's why just a little was fine. Even the tiniest bit would have been enough.

lines.content: 幼い頃の私は、先輩があの子に向けるやさしい笑顔を、ほんの少しだけでもわけてほしかったから……。
lines.translated: When I was little, I just wanted Senpai to share even a tiny fraction of that gentle smile he always gave her with me...

lines.content: 『待ってよお兄ちゃん、行かないで……意地悪、しないで……っ』
lines.translated: "'Wait, Onii-chan, don't go... Don't be so mean...'"

lines.content: 先輩の気を引きたくて、何度も……恥ずかしくって堪らなかったけど……何度も何度も“お兄ちゃん”と呼んで、その背中を追いかけていた。
lines.translated: Wanting to get Senpai's attention, over and over... even though I was so embarrassed I could barely stand it... I called him "Onii-chan" again and again, chasing after his back.

lines.content: だけど先輩は振り向いてくれなかった。
lines.translated: But Senpai never turned around for me.

lines.content: ……さみしい私の手を握ってはくれなかった。
lines.translated: He never held my lonely hand.

lines.content: 先輩の左手は、いつもあの子としっかり繋がれている……。
lines.translated: Senpai's left hand is always tightly holding hers...

lines.content: 枕をぎゅっと抱きしめた。思い切り。強く。
lines.translated: I hugged my pillow tightly. With all my might. As hard as I could.

lines.content: ……先輩。
lines.translated: Senpai.

lines.content: 私は、あなたのことが大好きです。
lines.translated: I love you so much.

lines.content: この気持ちは、きっと……。
lines.translated: These feelings will surely...

lines.content: たとえ報われることなくても、きっと生涯忘れることはないだろう。そんな子どもっぽい予感が私を満たす。
lines.translated: Even if they are never returned, I'm sure I will never forget them for the rest of my life. A childish premonition like that fills me up inside.

lines.content: たったひとりぼっちでおばさんになっても。
lines.translated: Even if I grow into an old lady all by myself.

lines.content: ……先輩が、誰か、私の知らないかわいい誰かと生涯、笑って過ごしていたとしても。
lines.translated: Even if Senpai spends his whole life smiling alongside some cute girl I don't even know.

lines.content: 私はずっと、ずっと、この気持ちを忘れず持っていたいと願ってる。
lines.translated: I hope to hold onto these feelings forever and ever, without ever forgetting them.

lines.content: いつまで経っても子どもだなあって、あなたに笑われてしまうだろうか。
lines.translated: Would you laugh at me and say I'll always be a child no matter how much time passes?

lines.content: そんなあなたに、私はちょっと怒ったふりをしてみたりして……。
lines.translated: And maybe I'd pretend to be a little mad at you for saying that...

lines.content: そしてほんの少しだけ笑い合う。
lines.translated: Then the two of us would share a small laugh together.

lines.content: また明日も笑って話そう。
lines.translated: Let's smile and talk again tomorrow.

lines.content: たったそれだけの約束をして、“さよなら”をする。
lines.translated: Making only that simple promise, we say "goodbye."

lines.content: 特別な関係になれなくてもそんな未来もまた愛しい。
lines.translated: Even if we can't have a special relationship, a future like that is still precious to me.

lines.content: この気持ちは私だけの宝物。
lines.translated: These feelings are my very own treasure.

lines.content: 叶わなくても報われなくとも何より大切。
lines.translated: Even if they never come true, even if they are never returned, they are more precious to me than anything.

lines.content: せめて、そう思い続けていたいから……。
lines.translated: Because at the very least, I want to keep feeling that way...

lines.content: だからこそ、どうして。
lines.translated: Which is why... I don't understand.

lines.content: どうして私は、告白なんてしてしまったの――思い描いていた細やかな幸せさえ、私は、自分で壊してしまったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Why did I go and confess to him? I might have destroyed even that small, quiet happiness I'd pictured for myself with my own hands.

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: ……どうしよう。先輩
lines.translated: "...What am I going to do, Senpai?"

lines.content: また、じわりと、
lines.translated: Once again, slowly...

lines.content: ……なんだかとっても、さみしいよ
lines.translated: "...I feel so, so lonely."

lines.content: 涙だ。涙が、じわりと滲んで……、
lines.translated: Tears. Tears were welling up in my eyes...

lines.content: 扉がノックされる音がした。
lines.translated: There was a knock at the door.

lines.content: 鼻を啜り、急いで涙をごしごし拭い――……なあに？　と返事をする。
lines.translated: I sniffled, hurriedly scrubbed the tears away, and called back, "...What is it?"

lines.content: すると、『時間だよ』と返ってくるお父さんの声。
lines.translated: My father's voice answered from the other side, telling me it was time.

lines.content: 千和。準備はできたかい？　そろそろ行くよ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Are you ready? It's almost time to go."

lines.content: いや……。
lines.translated: No...

lines.content: 行きたくないよ、お父さん。
lines.translated: I don't want to go, Dad.

lines.content: だけどそんなことは言えない。絶対に、言えない。
lines.translated: But I couldn't say that. I could never say that.

lines.content: 私は、お父さんにとって聞き分けのいい子でいたいから。
lines.translated: Because I want to be a good, obedient daughter for him.

lines.content: だから『わかった……』と私は応える。
lines.translated: So I replied, "Okay..."

lines.content: 少しだけ、元気なく。
lines.translated: Just a little listlessly.

lines.content: それが精一杯の抵抗だった。
lines.translated: That was all the resistance I could muster.

lines.content: ……先輩。
lines.translated: Senpai.

lines.content: 私、行きたくないよ。
lines.translated: I don't want to go.

lines.content: もしも先輩が私を引き留めてくれたなら……
lines.translated: "If only Senpai would stop me..."
If only he would convince my father...

lines.content: そんなこと絶対にあり得ないのはわかってる。
lines.translated: I know something like that could never happen.

lines.content: だって、私……。
lines.translated: Because I...

lines.content: 私は先輩に告白して……受け入れて、もらえなかった。
lines.translated: I confessed to Senpai... and he didn't accept my feelings.

lines.content: 思い出す度に涙がじわりと滲んでしまう。
lines.translated: Every time I remember it, tears well up in my eyes.

lines.content: 本当にどうしてあんなことしてしまったんだろ。
lines.translated: Why on earth did I do something like that?

lines.content: 何度も。何度も。思ってしまう――
lines.translated: Over and over. Over and over, the thought circles through my head--

lines.content: 先輩はあの子のことが好き。私はただの幼馴染み。それ以上にはなれない。わかってた。勇気を出して告白しても断られるのはわかっていた。
lines.translated: Senpai is in love with her. I'm just a childhood friend. I can never be anything more than that. I knew it. I knew that even if I mustered my courage and confessed, I would be rejected.

lines.content: そうなってしまえば気まずくなる。
lines.translated: And once that happened, things would get awkward between us.

lines.content: 先輩は私に笑いかけてもくれなくなる。
lines.translated: Senpai wouldn't smile at me anymore.

lines.content: ……ちょっと意地悪なこともしてくれなくなる。
lines.translated: He wouldn't tease me a little anymore, either.

lines.content: 先輩と気まずくなりたくない。嫌いになって、ほしくない。だから、私、幼馴染みのままでよかったはずなのに……
lines.translated: "I don't want things to be awkward with Senpai. I don't want him to hate me. So I should have been fine with just staying his childhood friend..."

lines.content: ぶるり、と。
lines.translated: Bzzzt.

lines.content: 手の中の端末が短く震えた。
lines.translated: The phone in my hand gave a short vibration.

lines.content: メッセージ。
lines.translated: A message.

lines.content: ドキッとする。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: 飛び起きて確認した。
lines.translated: I practically jumped up to check it.

lines.content: 届けられた言葉に、私は……、
lines.translated: Looking at the words on the screen, I...

lines.content: ……どういう、こと？
lines.translated: "...What does this mean?"

lines.content: ……私は、首をかしげるばかりだ。
lines.translated: All I could do was tilt my head in confusion.

lines.content: “差出人：柊先輩”
lines.translated: "From: Hiiragi-senpai"

lines.content: “千和ちゃん……”
lines.translated: "Chiwa-chan..."

lines.content: “急いで学園に来て”
lines.translated: "Hurry and come to the school."

lines.content: “大雅くんが……”
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun is..."

lines.content: “千和ちゃんに……”
lines.translated: "To you, Chiwa-chan..."

lines.content: そこまででメッセージは途切れていた。
lines.translated: The message cut off right there.

lines.content: 先輩が、私に……？
lines.translated: "Senpai is... to me...?"

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: 返信してみても電話をかけてみても返事はない。
lines.translated: I tried replying and even calling, but there was no answer.

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: そろそろ出かけなければならない時間。
lines.translated: It was almost time for me to leave.

lines.content: 今、学園に向かえば間に合わなくなる。
lines.translated: If I headed to the school now, I wouldn't make it in time.

lines.content: お父さんにも先方さんにも迷惑が掛かる。
lines.translated: I would cause trouble for both my father and the people we were meeting.

lines.content: 私はベッドから降り、着替えを済ませ――
lines.translated: I got out of bed, finished changing my clothes--

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。お父さん。すぐに戻るから
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Dad. I'll be right back."

lines.content: お父さんにバレないよう静かに、そっと、家を出た。
lines.translated: Quietly, carefully, so my father wouldn't notice, I slipped out of the house.

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。何か、あったのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder what's going on. Did something happen?"

lines.content: 放課後の学園。
lines.translated: The school after hours.

lines.content: 校庭にたくさんの生徒が集まっていた。
lines.translated: A large crowd of students had gathered in the schoolyard.

lines.content: ざわざわと騒がしい。
lines.translated: The air was buzzing with noisy chatter.

lines.content: 集まった殆どの生徒が上を見ている。
lines.translated: Almost everyone gathered there was looking up.

lines.content: その視線の先を辿ってみても何もない。あるのはずっとずっと咲かないままの枯れ桜。
lines.translated: I followed their gaze, but there was nothing there. Nothing except the withered cherry tree that never, ever bloomed.

lines.content: その枝が両手をいっぱいに開いたみたいに広がっているだけだ。そして、屋上……。見上げた先にあるのはたったそれだけ。
lines.translated: Its branches were simply spread out wide, like two open arms. And beyond that, the rooftop... That was the only thing up there.

lines.content: 校門前で少し尻込み。
lines.translated: I hesitated a little in front of the school gates.

lines.content: 学園をサボってしまった手前気まずい気持ちもあったから。
lines.translated: Having skipped school earlier, I felt a bit awkward showing my face.

lines.content: だけどメッセージの内容が気になる。
lines.translated: But the message was bothering me.

lines.content: “急いで学園に来て”
lines.translated: "Hurry and come to the school."

lines.content: “大雅くんが……”
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun is..."

lines.content: “千和ちゃんに……”
lines.translated: "To you, Chiwa-chan..."

lines.content: とても、気になる。
lines.translated: It was bothering me so much.

lines.content: 柊先輩にメッセージを送り、学園に到着したことを伝えた。でもやっぱり返事はなかった。
lines.translated: I sent a message to Hiiragi-senpai to let him know I'd arrived at the school. Still, there was no reply.

lines.content: 先輩に何かあったのかな。
lines.translated: Had something happened to Senpai?

lines.content: そう思うとそわそわして仕方ない。
lines.translated: The thought made me hopelessly restless.

lines.content: ……勇気だ。
lines.translated: It was about courage.

lines.content: 勇気を出して先輩にも電話をかけてみた。メッセージも送ってみた。[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]があった後だから本当にどきどきした。
lines.translated: Mustering my courage, I tried calling Senpai, too. I even sent him a message. After what had happened between us, my heart was pounding like crazy.

lines.content: “大丈夫ですか？　柊先輩から連絡があって……何か、あったんですか？”
lines.translated: "Are you okay? Hiiragi-senpai contacted me... Did something happen?"

lines.content: そんな短い一文を送ることも怖かった。
lines.translated: Sending even that short little sentence terrified me.

lines.content: ……いやだな。
lines.translated: I hate this.

lines.content: ぐずぐずと後ろ向きなことばかり考えている。
lines.translated: I'm just moping around, thinking nothing but negative thoughts.

lines.content: 嫌い。こんな自分、本当に大嫌い。
lines.translated: I hate it. I really, truly hate myself like this.

lines.content: 好きな人に告白して、振られてしまった。相手にもしてもらえなかった。
lines.translated: I confessed to the person I love, and I got rejected. He didn't even take me seriously.

lines.content: だから少しくらい暗い気持ちになってしまうのも当然といえばそうかもしれないけど……。
lines.translated: So maybe it's only natural that I'd feel a little gloomy, but still...

lines.content: もう一度だけ勇気を振り絞り、私は、校門を跨いだ。
lines.translated: Summoning my courage just one more time, I stepped through the school gates.

lines.content: ……そのとき。
lines.translated: Right at that moment.

lines.content: 集まった生徒たちのざわめきが大きくなった。
lines.translated: The murmuring of the gathered students grew louder.

lines.content: 上に向かって指をさしている人たちもいる。
lines.translated: Some of them were pointing upward.

lines.content: ふと、私も改めて見上げてみると……。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I looked up again myself, and...

lines.content: 時計塔の管理室。その窓だ。
lines.translated: The clock tower's control room. The window up there.

lines.content: 開け放たれたその向こう側に、誰かが立っていた。
lines.translated: Someone was standing just beyond the wide-open frame.

lines.content: ……先輩？
lines.translated: "...Senpai?"

lines.content: それは、私の大好きな人。
lines.translated: It was the person I love more than anyone.

lines.content: 周りの人たちは“あれは誰だ？”とざわざわ話しているけれど……。
lines.translated: The people around me were buzzing, asking each other, "Who is that?"...

lines.content: 間違いない。
lines.translated: There's no mistake.

lines.content: どんなに高くて遠い場所に立っていても、私にはあなただとわかる。ずっとその姿を、その背中ばかりを見つめてきた。
lines.translated: But no matter how high up or far away you are, I can tell it's you. I've spent my whole life gazing at your figure, chasing after your back.

lines.content: 窓の向こうに立つ先輩は、身を乗り出すようにして立っていた。
lines.translated: Standing beyond the window, Senpai was leaning forward over the sill.

lines.content: ……先輩、何、するの？
lines.translated: "...Senpai, what are you doing?"

lines.content: やめて。どうして……。そんなことしないで。危ないよ。
lines.translated: Stop. Why...? Don't do that. It's dangerous.

lines.content: だけど私の気持ちは届かない。心配も、不安も何もかも全部。
lines.translated: But my feelings couldn't reach him. Not my worry, not my fear, not any of it.

lines.content: 先輩は更に一歩、窓から身を乗り出した。
lines.translated: Senpai leaned another step further out the window.

lines.content: ……悲鳴が聞こえた。
lines.translated: I heard a scream.

lines.content: 見上げた人たちが口々に何か叫んでる。
lines.translated: The people looking up were all shouting at once.

lines.content: 頭の中が真っ白になる。
lines.translated: My mind went completely blank.

lines.content: 何が起きているのかわからない。
lines.translated: I didn't understand what was happening.

lines.content: 今から何が始まろうとしてるのかも。
lines.translated: Or what was about to begin.

lines.content: だけどこのままじゃダメだと思った。
lines.translated: All I knew was that I couldn't just stand here like this.

lines.content: 私は[・|ま][・|た]後悔する……。
lines.translated: I would regret it again...

lines.content: そんな気がしてしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't shake that feeling.

lines.content: 思い出す。思い出してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: I remembered. I couldn't stop myself from remembering.

lines.content: “さよなら”……。
lines.translated: "Goodbye"...

lines.content: 私の“後悔”
lines.translated: My "regret."

lines.content: もう二度と会えない、大切なひと……。
lines.translated: Someone precious to me, whom I can never see again...

lines.content: っ
私は、駆け出す。
lines.translated: I break into a run.

lines.content: いつもだ。私はいつも後悔ばかりしている。
lines.translated: It's always like this. I'm always full of regrets.

lines.content: 今、走り出さなければ……。
lines.translated: If I don't start running right now...

lines.content: たとえば十年後に、今日のことを思い出し後悔するかもしれない。そして泣いてばかりの日々。そんなのはいや。絶対に。だから私は、駆け出したけれど……。
lines.translated: Ten years from now, I might look back on today and regret it. And then I'd spend my days doing nothing but crying. I don't want that. Never. So I took off running, and yet...

lines.content: 千和……聞いてるか？
lines.translated: "Chiwa... Can you hear me?"

lines.content: 声が響いた。
lines.translated: A voice echoed out.

lines.content: 先輩の声。
lines.translated: Senpai's voice.

lines.content: 一瞬、何が起きたのかわからなかった。
lines.translated: For a moment, I didn't understand what had happened.

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: それは[マイク|拡声器]のようなものを通した声だった。
lines.translated: The voice was coming through a microphone or a megaphone of some kind.

lines.content: ……行くなよ。千和。どこにも行くな
lines.translated: "...Don't go, Chiwa. Don't go anywhere."

lines.content: 駆け出したばかりの足を止め、私は見上げた。
lines.translated: Stopping dead in my tracks just after starting to run, I looked up.

lines.content: いいか。千和……今から俺が、君を、[さら|攫]いに行くぞ
lines.translated: "Listen to me, Chiwa... Right now, I'm coming to sweep you off your feet."

lines.content: 空を見上げ、俺は思う――[・|勇][・|気]だ。
lines.translated: Looking up at the sky, I think to myself--it's about courage.

lines.content: 足りないものはいつだって勇気なのだ。
lines.translated: What I'm lacking is always courage.

lines.content: これからやろうとしていることはみんなと話し合って決めた。
lines.translated: What I'm about to do was decided after talking it over with everyone.

lines.content: ハルはぽかんと目を丸くしたままだったし。
lines.translated: Haru had just stared blankly with her eyes wide.

lines.content: 姫織には若干だが引かれさえもして。
lines.translated: Himeori had even been slightly put off by it.

lines.content: 智仁に関しては、いつもみたいに笑みを崩さずいるだけだ。
lines.translated: As for Tomohito, he just kept that usual smile on his face the whole time.

lines.content: ……言うほどたいしたことをしようというのではない。
lines.translated: It's not like I'm about to do anything all that grand.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]にいったい何の意味があるのか。
lines.translated: What's the point of doing something like this, anyway?

lines.content: きっと意味なんてないだろう。
lines.translated: There probably isn't any point at all.

lines.content: それでもそうしないわけにはいかなかった。何もしないという選択だけはありえない。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't just not do it. Doing nothing was the one option that was completely out of the question.

lines.content: だけど、自信がなかった。
lines.translated: Still, I didn't have any confidence.

lines.content: 上手くいくかどうかではなく、この俺に、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]が本当にできるのかどうか。
lines.translated: Not in whether it would go well, but in whether someone like me could actually pull something like that off.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 改めて、思う。
lines.translated: Once again, the thought crosses my mind.

lines.content: 勇気……。
lines.translated: Courage...

lines.content: 必要なものはいつだってそれだけなんだ。
lines.translated: That's always the only thing I ever need.

lines.content: だから俺は、最後の相談相手にあの人を選んだ――……少し、前のことだ。
lines.translated: That's why I chose her as the last person to ask for advice--...just a little while ago.

lines.content: 俺がこうして、この場所に立とうと決めた……数時間前のこと。
lines.translated: A few hours ago... when I decided to stand in this very spot.

lines.content: ……うーん。なるほど。色々考えたんですね、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...Hmm. I see. You've really thought this through, haven't you, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: 俺のバカみたいな提案に、その人は柔らかく微笑んでくれる。
lines.translated: She offers me a gentle smile in response to my ridiculous proposal.

lines.content: ……兎蛙あず咲。智仁のお姉さん。
lines.translated: Toa Azusaki. Tomohito's older sister.

lines.content: 今日も智仁とは会えず終いのままで、遠いとおい学生寮にまで戻らなければならない。
lines.translated: Once again, she hadn't been able to meet up with Tomohito today, and now she had to head all the way back to her distant student dorm.

lines.content: あず咲先輩はバス停で帰りの便を待っている。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai was waiting at the bus stop for her ride back.

lines.content: その姿をちょうどよく見かけた俺は、少しの間だけ話を聞いてほしいと、あず咲先輩の隣に立った。
lines.translated: Having conveniently spotted her there, I stood beside Azusaki-senpai and asked if she could hear me out for just a little while.

lines.content: 先輩は、どう思いますか？　俺の考え
lines.translated: "What do you think of my idea, Senpai?"

lines.content: そうですね……
lines.translated: "I suppose so..."

lines.content: 少し首をかしげて考えるような仕草。そんなあず咲先輩に、俺は続けて問いかける。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai tilts her head slightly, looking deep in thought. I press on with another question.

lines.content: こんなことして千和は喜んでくれるでしょうか。そこが心配です。不安です
lines.translated: "Do you think doing something like this will make Chiwa happy? That's what I'm worried about. It's making me anxious."

lines.content: うーん
lines.translated: "Hmm."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]。独りよがりでしかないんなら……やる意味なんてないです。あず咲先輩の意見次第では今すぐ中止しようかって思います。だから……
lines.translated: "Doing something like this... If it's just me being self-indulgent, then there's no point to it at all. Depending on what you think, Azusaki-senpai, I'm considering calling the whole thing off right now. So..."

lines.content: お願いします。あず咲先輩の意見を教えてもらえないでしょうか、と俺は改めてそう言った。
lines.translated: Please, could you tell me what you think, Azusaki-senpai? I asked her once more.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: はい。何ですか、あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "Yes. What is it, Azusaki-senpai?"

lines.content: ……どうしてそれを私に聞くんですか？
lines.translated: "...Why are you asking me about this?"

lines.content: おどおどと不安げに、あず咲先輩は言うのだ。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai speaks hesitantly, sounding anxious.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]をして、千和ちゃんがどう思うのかって……私に聞いても、気の利いた返事はできませんよ。……たぶん
lines.translated: "Asking me how Chiwa-chan would feel if you did that... I don't think I can give you a very clever answer. ...Probably."

lines.content: そんなことないです
lines.translated: "That's not true."

lines.content: そうでしょうか……
lines.translated: "Do you really think so...?"

lines.content: きっぱりと答える俺に、あず咲先輩はますます不安げにうつむいてしまうけれど、
lines.translated: Despite my firm reply, Azusaki-senpai looks down, seeming more anxious than ever, but...

lines.content: 俺、女の子の気持ちに詳しいほうでもありません
lines.translated: "I'm not exactly an expert when it comes to how girls feel, either."

lines.content: そう続けた俺の言葉には、
lines.translated: At what I said next...

lines.content: そうですね。そう思いますよ
lines.translated: "That's true. I agree with you there."

lines.content: 随分とはっきりあず咲先輩は肯定し、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai nodded, agreeing with me rather definitively.

lines.content: 大雅くんは鈍感ですもんね。自覚があったことがむしろ驚きかもしれませんよ？
lines.translated: "You really are dense, after all, Taiga-kun. Honestly, it might be more surprising that you're actually aware of it."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai is smiling.

lines.content: その笑顔に『まったく、そうですよね』と俺は応えた。
lines.translated: Looking at that smile of hers, I replied, "Tell me about it."
Even though the one thing I'd always wished for was to never become a dense hero.

lines.content: 鈍感、どころか……女の子が何を考えて生きてるのか。想像するのだって難しいです
lines.translated: "Forget being dense... It's hard for me to even imagine what goes through a girl's head in her day-to-day life."

lines.content: だから、あず咲先輩。俺に女の子の視点で教えてほしいんです――今、俺がしようとしていることは、女の子を、千和を喜ばせることのできるものなのかを
lines.translated: "That's why I want you to tell me from a girl's perspective, Azusaki-senpai--whether what I'm about to do is something that could make a girl, make Chiwa, happy."

lines.content: んー……。そうですねえ
lines.translated: "Hmm... Let's see."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じ、頭をふらふらとさせながら考えて――あず咲先輩は答えてくれる。
lines.translated: Closing her eyes and swaying her head slightly as she thinks it over--Azusaki-senpai gives me her answer.

lines.content: もうみんなには……ハルちゃんや姫織ちゃんには聞いてみたんですよね？
lines.translated: "You've already asked everyone else... like Haru-chan and Himeori-chan, right?"

lines.content: はい……
だったら女の子の感想はもうもらえてるんじゃないでしょうか？
lines.translated: "In that case, haven't you already gotten a girl's perspective?"

lines.content: そうですね。確かに
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. That's true."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ハルやひよちゃんの意見はもう既に聞いてます
lines.translated: "I've already heard what Haru and Hiyo-chan think."

lines.content: ……ふたりとも、なんて言っていました？
lines.translated: "...What did the two of them say?"

lines.content: どちらも最初は少し引いてるような反応ではあったんですが、それでも賛成はしてくれました。協力もしてくれるって
lines.translated: "They were both a little put off at first, but they still agreed with the idea. They even said they'd help me out."

lines.content: そうですか。やっぱり……持つべきものは幼馴染みですね。ピンチなときはそうして力を貸してくれる。すてきだなあって思います
lines.translated: "I see. Having childhood friends really is a wonderful thing, isn't it? Helping you out like that when you're in a pinch... I think that's lovely."

lines.content: だからこそ……、とあず咲先輩は言う。
lines.translated: "And that's exactly why..." Azusaki-senpai continues.

lines.content: 私の意見、もう要らないんじゃ……？
lines.translated: "You don't really need my opinion anymore, do you...?"

lines.content: ふたりとも協力してくれるってことは、大雅くんの作戦に賛成で、女の子の視線で、少なからず前向きな意見をくれたってことですよね？
lines.translated: "The fact that they're both willing to help means they agree with your plan, and that they gave you a reasonably positive opinion from a girl's perspective, right?"

lines.content: それならもう、私は、お姉ちゃんは……大雅くんの役には立てないと思いますけど……
lines.translated: "If that's the case, then I don't think I--your big sister here--can be of much use to you anymore, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: いいえ。そんなことありません
lines.translated: "No, that's not true at all."

lines.content: 俺は首を振った。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: 年上の女の人の気持ちがまだ聞けてない
lines.translated: "I still haven't heard how an older woman feels about it."

lines.content: え？　年上？
lines.translated: "Huh? An older woman?"

lines.content: 男子三日会わざるば刮目して見よと言いますが……
lines.translated: "There's that old saying that a boy matures so fast you have to look at him with fresh eyes after just three days apart..."

lines.content: だったら男なんかより心も身体も成長の早い女の子なんて、一年もあればずっとずっと大人ですよ
lines.translated: "And if that's true, then since girls mature way faster than guys in both mind and body, a whole year makes them infinitely more grown-up."

lines.content: だからあず咲先輩の意見がほしいんです。ハルやひよちゃんより、一年も大人な女の人のあず咲先輩の意見が
lines.translated: "That's why I want your opinion, Azusaki-senpai. The opinion of a woman who's a whole year more mature than Haru and Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: ……等と。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 下らなすぎる戯れ言を並べながら、本音は違う。もちろん別のところに隠してる。
lines.translated: While I rattle off this ridiculous nonsense, my true feelings are different. Naturally, I'm hiding them somewhere else entirely.

lines.content: ただ単純に勇気がほしかったのだ。
lines.translated: I just simply wanted courage.

lines.content: もう既にやると決めた。変更はない。
lines.translated: I've already decided to go through with it. That isn't going to change.

lines.content: だが、まだ心のどこかで少しの躊躇いがある。
lines.translated: However, deep down in my heart, there's still a slight hesitation.

lines.content: その躊躇いが俺に語りかけている――“そんなこと、本当に成功すると思ってるのか？”
lines.translated: That hesitation is whispering to me--"Do you really think a stunt like that is going to work?"

lines.content: だから今一度背中を押してくれる誰かの意見がほしかった。
lines.translated: That was why I wanted someone else's opinion to give me one more push forward.

lines.content: あず咲先輩なら俺のやろうとしていることに反対はせず、送り出してくれるだろうというあまりに矮小な期待があったから。
lines.translated: Because I had this painfully petty hope that Azusaki-senpai wouldn't oppose what I was about to do, and would gently send me off instead.

lines.content: だからこうして俺は、あず咲先輩に相談を持ちかけたのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: That's probably why I came to Azusaki-senpai for advice like this.

lines.content: な、なるほど。それは……え、えへへ。大変な期待を寄せられてしまって……お姉ちゃん、がんばらなくっちゃですね
lines.translated: "I-I see. Well, that's... e-ehehe. You're putting some pretty heavy expectations on me... Looks like your big sister has to do her best, huh?"

lines.content: ぎゅっと唇を噛みしめ、あず咲先輩は何度か深くうなずいていた。自信のない自分を鼓舞するみたいにして。
lines.translated: Biting her lip tightly, Azusaki-senpai nodded deeply several times, as if trying to psych up her own unconfident self.

lines.content: あず咲先輩。改めて、相談に乗ってもらえますか
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai. Let me ask you again--will you hear me out?"

lines.content: は、はい。もちろんですよ、大雅くん
lines.translated: "Y-Yes. Of course I will, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: あず咲先輩。俺、千和にひどいことをして、泣かせてしまったんです
lines.translated: "Azusaki-senpai. I did something terrible to Chiwa, and I made her cry."

lines.content: あず咲先輩は無言で先を促してくれる。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai silently urges me to go on.

lines.content: 千和がせっかく勇気を振り絞って見せてくれたことを、俺は、茶化すみたいにして……。いつもの意地悪みたいなのりで、誤魔化そうとして。最悪でした。本当に
lines.translated: "Chiwa mustered up all her courage to show me how she felt, and I... I treated it like a joke. I tried to brush it off by acting like my usual teasing self. It was the worst. It really was."

lines.content: ええ……これ以上ないってくらい、邪悪だったとさえ思います
lines.translated: "Yeah... I think it was about as awful and wicked as it gets."

lines.content: ……俺、千和が本気だなんて思わなかったんです。いったい誰が、俺なんかのことを……いや。違う。今のは違う
lines.translated: "...I never thought Chiwa was actually serious. I mean, who in the world would ever fall for someone like me... No. Wait. Scratch that."

lines.content: 聞かなかったことにしてくださいと、俺は首を振った。
lines.translated: Shaking my head, I asked her to pretend she hadn't heard that last part.

lines.content: 今さら言い訳がしたいんじゃない。
lines.translated: It's far too late to be making excuses now.

lines.content: この期に及んでぐずぐずと、そんな情けない姿をさらしたいわけじゃあないんだ。
lines.translated: At this stage, I have no desire to drag my feet and put such a pathetic side of myself on display.

lines.content: ……だから。えっと……なんて言っていいのか
lines.translated: "...So. Um... How do I put this..."

lines.content: がりがりと頭を掻いて、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Scratching my head furiously, I continued.

lines.content: 千和はたくさん、俺なんかのために勇気を……いっぱいの勇気を見せてくれた
lines.translated: "Chiwa showed me so much courage for the sake of someone like me... just a whole lot of courage."

lines.content: だからもらった勇気にはそれ以上の勇気で返したい。そう思ったんです。そうでなきゃだめなんだって。だから俺は[・|こ][・|れ]を考えました
lines.translated: "So I want to return the courage she gave me with even more of my own. That's what I thought. That it has to be that way. And that's why I came up with this."

lines.content: ……勇気、ですか
lines.translated: "...Courage, is it?"

lines.content: そうつぶやくあず咲先輩は微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai smiled as she murmured that.

lines.content: うん。大雅くんが[・|そ][・|れ]をしようと思ったきっかけはわかりましたけど……でも[・|そ][・|れ]は、とっても勇気の要ることですもんね
lines.translated: "Okay. I understand what made you want to do it, Taiga-kun... though doing that really will take a lot of courage, won't it?"

lines.content: はい……
大雅くんの気持ちを教えてもらった上で、改めて私の意見、伝えますね
lines.translated: "Now that you've shared your feelings with me, let me give you my honest opinion."

lines.content: 私も賛成です。ハルちゃんや姫織ちゃんと同じで賛成です。大雅くんは正しいって思います
lines.translated: "I'm in favor of it, too. Just like Haru-chan and Himeori-chan, I agree with your plan. I think you're doing the right thing, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: だけどひとつだけ、アドバイスです
lines.translated: "However, I just have one piece of advice."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 君たちより三日どころか一年も先の未来を生きてる大人な先輩の意見ですよ？　謹んで耳を傾けてくださいね？
lines.translated: "This is the opinion of a mature upperclassman who's lived not just three days, but a whole year further into the future than all of you, okay? Please listen with the utmost respect."

lines.content: 得意そうに言うあず咲先輩に、俺はふと頬が緩んでしまっていた。
lines.translated: Seeing Azusaki-senpai say that so proudly brought an involuntary smile to my face.

lines.content: 大雅くん。あなたが、千和ちゃんを[さら|攫]いに行くんですよ
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. You're going to go sweep Chiwa-chan off her feet."

lines.content: え？　[さら|攫]う……ですか？
lines.translated: "Huh? Sweep her off her feet...?"

lines.content: 突然の言葉に俺は面食らう。
lines.translated: Her sudden words caught me completely off guard.

lines.content: あなたが千和ちゃんのことをどう思ってるのかはこの際、先送りしてしまってもいいと思います――いいえ
lines.translated: "For now, I think it's fine to put off figuring out how you actually feel about Chiwa-chan--no."

lines.content: 本当は、よくないのかもしれないけれど……。でも、わからないことに無理して答えを出すよりは、未来の自分に回答権を譲ったほうが、きっとマシだろうと思います
lines.translated: "Maybe it's not really fine... But rather than forcing yourself to come up with an answer to something you don't understand yet, I think it's definitely better to leave that right to your future self."

lines.content: 好きか嫌いか。恋とか愛とか。女の子か、男の子か――そういうのはとっても大切なことだけど、今はいい
lines.translated: "Whether you like her or not. Romance and love. Being a girl, or being a boy--those things are very important, of course, but they can wait for now."

lines.content: ただ、このまま千和ちゃんを行かせてしまうのは……お姉ちゃん。それはとっても格好悪いことなんじゃないかなあと思ってしまって……
lines.translated: "It's just, letting Chiwa-chan leave like this... Well, your big sister here thinks that would be terribly uncool..."

lines.content: ……格好悪いこと
lines.translated: "...Uncool."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 大雅くん。君は、勇気を振り絞ってみせてくれた千和ちゃんにひどいことをして泣かせてしまった。そう言ってましたけど……
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. You said that you did something terrible to Chiwa-chan after she mustered up all her courage for you, and that you made her cry..."

lines.content: 一度格好悪いことをしてしまったのなら、次は必ずそれを自分自身の力で……この場合は勇気で、挽回しなきゃいけないんですよ。それがきっとヒーローの条件です
lines.translated: "If you've done something uncool once, then next time, you absolutely have to make up for it with your own strength... or in this case, your own courage. I'm sure that's what it takes to be a hero."

lines.content: その言葉にドキリと俺の胸が大きく跳ねた。
lines.translated: My heart leaped in my chest at her words.

lines.content: 大雅くん。君はね、きっと千和ちゃんのヒーローなんですよ。格好悪くても。時どき弱いことがあったとしても……、そんな程度のことじゃああの子の中で揺るぐこともなく
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun. I'm sure you're Chiwa-chan's hero. Even if you're uncool. Even if you have moments of weakness... something that small would never shake how that girl sees you."

lines.content: 千和ちゃんがどうしてあなたをそこまで想うようになったのかは、きっと誰にもわからない……だけど
lines.translated: "Why Chiwa-chan came to care for you that deeply is probably something no one knows... However..."

lines.content: だけど、幼い頃からずっとあの子が君のことだけ見ていたのは、きっと、誰もが知ってます。ええ、そうです。そんなの、君以外の全員がわかってましたよ
lines.translated: "However, I'm sure everyone knows that she's been looking only at you ever since she was little. Yes, that's right. Everyone except you knew that."

lines.content: どうしてかな。
lines.translated: How come?

lines.content: この人には千和から告白を受けたとは一言も言っていないのに。
lines.translated: Even though I hadn't said a single word to her about Chiwa confessing to me.

lines.content: それなのに、すべてを既に悟られてしまっているように感じられてならない。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't help feeling like she had already figured everything out.

lines.content: それはこの人が特別察しがいいからなのか。
lines.translated: Was it because she was especially perceptive?

lines.content: それともあまりに容易な問題だからなのか。
lines.translated: Or was it just because the whole thing was far too obvious?

lines.content: ……千和ちゃん。もしかするとあなたが[さら|攫]いに来てくれるのを待っていたり……するかもしれませんよ。今も、ずっと
lines.translated: "...Chiwa-chan. For all we know, she might be waiting... for you to come sweep her away. Even now, all this time."

lines.content: [さら|攫]いに……
lines.translated: "Sweep her away..."

lines.content: ええ。だって私には、お姉ちゃんにはね、千和ちゃんが転校したいと思ってるなんて、そんなの考えられないんです
lines.translated: "Yes. Because to me--to your big sister here--the idea that Chiwa-chan actually wants to transfer schools is completely unthinkable."

lines.content: だからですね、大雅くん。もう一度言います
lines.translated: "So, Taiga-kun. I'll say it one more time."

lines.content: ……はい
あなたのやろうとしていることは、きっと間違ってはいないと思います……私が、お姉ちゃんがね、何の根拠もなく保証してあげちゃいましょう
lines.translated: "I don't think what you're about to do is a mistake at all... I--your big sister--will guarantee it for you, even if I have no basis for it whatsoever."

lines.content: にっこりとするあず咲先輩。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai beamed at me.

lines.content: そこには不安そうに震える瞳なく……。
lines.translated: There was no trace of anxious trembling in her eyes anymore...

lines.content: しかし照れくさそうな微笑みだけがあった。
lines.translated: Instead, there was only a slightly bashful smile.

lines.content: だから頑張って、勇気を出して、そして安心して、千和ちゃんに格好いいところ見せに行ってくださいよ。大雅くん
lines.translated: "So do your best, muster up your courage, put your mind at ease, and go show Chiwa-chan how cool you can be, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 今……この世界で一番、あなたの格好いいところを見たいのは千和ちゃんだと思います。だから千和ちゃんはきっと喜びますよ
lines.translated: "Right now... I think the person in this world who wants to see your cool side the most is Chiwa-chan. So I'm sure she'll be thrilled."

lines.content: それが私の意見です、感想です、そう言い、やっぱりぎこちない微笑みに戻るあず咲先輩だった。
lines.translated: "That's my opinion, and how I feel about it," Azusaki-senpai said, returning to her usual awkward smile after all.

lines.content: ヒーローの条件、か。
lines.translated: What it takes to be a hero, huh?

lines.content: きっとあず咲先輩は俺の背中を押すために、強い言葉を選ぼうとして、結果、そのせりふがこぼれ出たのだろう。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai had probably tried to choose strong words to give me a push, and as a result, that line had slipped out.

lines.content: ……いつも弱気なふうであるあず咲先輩が。
lines.translated: Coming from Azusaki-senpai, who always seemed so timid.

lines.content: その言葉を選んだことに、何かしらの意図がその裏にあるというわけでは、もちろんないだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Of course, there probably wasn't any deeper meaning behind why she chose those specific words, and yet...
At a time like this, what would he do?

lines.content: 何か選択を迫られたとき、俺は常に自身にそう問いかけてしまうのだ……。
lines.translated: Whenever I'm forced to make a choice, I always end up asking myself that question...

lines.content: これから、大雅くんがしようとしていること……
lines.translated: "What you're about to do from here on out, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 沈黙し、内側に篭もろうとしてしまっていた俺に、あず咲先輩はぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: As I fell silent and started retreating into my own head, Azusaki-senpai spoke up softly.

lines.content: ……ええっと、確か。千和ちゃんを学園に呼び出して
lines.translated: "...Um, if I remember correctly, you're going to call Chiwa-chan out to the school, and..."

lines.content: ふと、意地悪げにあず咲先輩は笑っていた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, a mischievous smile appeared on Azusaki-senpai's face.

lines.content: “君が転校なんてしないって言うまでぼくはここから降りないぞ！　死んでやるんだ！　君の心の中で永遠に生きるんだ！”って泣いて叫んでしまうんでしたっけ？
lines.translated: "You're going to cry and scream, 'I'm not coming down from here until you say you won't transfer! I'll die! And I'll live on forever in your heart!'... right?"

lines.content: ええ……
俺はうなずき、
lines.translated: I nodded,

lines.content: 違いますよ
lines.translated: "You're mistaken."

lines.content: 思わず、苦笑いをうかべてしまう。
lines.translated: a wry smile slipping onto my face despite myself.

lines.content: 何ですかそれ。めっちゃ格好悪いじゃないですか
lines.translated: "What the heck is that? That's super uncool."

lines.content: いやあ。千和ちゃんって実はダメな男の子が好きなんじゃないかなあって、お姉ちゃんはね、思ってるんですけど
lines.translated: "Well, your big sister here actually suspects that Chiwa-chan might have a thing for hopeless boys."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ダメダメな男の子ほどほっとけないって感じでしょうか。“ほんとに仕方ない先輩ですね”って言いながらも、色々とお世話するのが実は大好きなんですよ
lines.translated: "It's like, the more hopeless a boy is, the less she can leave him alone. Even while saying, 'You really are hopeless, Senpai,' she actually loves taking care of him in all sorts of ways."

lines.content: だから千和ちゃん、大雅くんを選んだんじゃないかなあって、お姉ちゃんは思ったり思わなかったりです
lines.translated: "So I kind of sort of think that might be why Chiwa-chan chose you, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: それ、聞き捨てならんですね
lines.translated: "I can't just pretend I didn't hear that."

lines.content: あはは
lines.translated: "Ahaha."

lines.content: だけど今は時間もないんでおいておきます。その件については、後日、ゆっくり話しましょうか先輩
lines.translated: "Though I'm short on time right now, so I'll let it slide. Let's have a long, thorough chat about this on another day, shall we, Senpai?"

lines.content: 苦笑いでそう言い、俺はつぶやく。
lines.translated: Saying that with a wry smile, I murmured softly.
"...A long time ago..."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: ……その学園の生徒が一人ひとり屋上に立って、校庭に集まった生徒たちや教師たちに向かい、日頃胸にため込んだ鬱憤だとかを吐き出すテレビ番組があったんです
lines.translated: "...There was this TV show where students at a school would stand on the roof one by one and shout out all their pent-up frustrations and whatnot to the students and teachers gathered in the courtyard below."

lines.content: へぇ……？
随分昔のバラエティです。俺も実際、リアルタイムで見たことはないんです
lines.translated: "It's a pretty old variety show. I've never actually seen it air live myself."

lines.content: ただ最近、智仁とネットで見つけた面白いなあと思った動画や画像を交換することがよくあるんですけど……
lines.translated: "It's just, lately, Tomohito and I often trade funny videos and pictures we find on the internet..."

lines.content: へえ、そうなんですね。知りませんでした。なんだか楽しそうですね。でも……あれ？　ふたりだけですか？　千和ちゃんたちとはしていないんですか？
lines.translated: "Oh, I see. I didn't know that. That sounds like fun. But... huh? Just the two of you? You don't share them with Chiwa-chan and the others?"

lines.content: まあ、男同士のことですから
lines.translated: "Well, it's a guy thing, so..."

lines.content: 男同士……ふぅん……？
lines.translated: "A guy thing... Hmm...?"

lines.content: あず咲先輩はすぅっと目を細めた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai slowly narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: あ、まずい。
lines.translated: Ah, crap.

lines.content: 勘が働いたのだろう――将来、思春期の息子を奈落の底に突き落とすのであろう母性本能的感覚の例の[・|あ][・|れ]である。
lines.translated: Her intuition must have kicked in--that maternal instinct thing doomed to plunge her future adolescent son into the depths of despair.

lines.content: と、ともあれ
lines.translated: "A-Anyway!"

lines.content: 智仁と“よくこんなことできるよなあ。しっかりネットに残るのに。俺なら恥ずかしくってぜったい無理だ”なんてこと言いながら見てて……
lines.translated: "Tomohito and I would watch them and say stuff like, 'How the heck can they do this? It's gonna stay on the internet forever. I'd be way too embarrassed, there's no way I could pull that off'..."

lines.content: 動画の中で叫んでるやつ、今はなにしてんのかなあって。将来の夢を叫んでるやつもいるし……好きな子に告白しているやつもいた。全校生徒を目の前に
lines.translated: "We wondered what the people screaming in those videos are up to now. Some of them were shouting out their dreams for the future... and some were confessing to the person they liked. Right in front of the entire student body."

lines.content: うわあ……。それは、それは……想像するだけで胸がどきどきしてしまいます
lines.translated: "Wow... That's, well... just imagining it makes my heart pound."

lines.content: ですよね
lines.translated: "Right?"

lines.content: うなずき、俺は笑顔で続ける。
lines.translated: Nodding, I continued with a smile.

lines.content: 屋上から、告白です。集まった生徒たちの中から意中の相手の名前を呼んで指名するんですよ
lines.translated: "Confessing from the rooftop. They'd call out the name of their crush from among all the gathered students."

lines.content: 何年何組の出席番号何番の何々さん！　どうか俺と、私と、付き合ってください！　って
lines.translated: "Saying stuff like, 'So-and-so from year whatever, class whatever, student number whatever! Please go out with me!'"

lines.content: そして告白された相手はその場で返事を叫んで伝える。そんな[・|お][・|約][・|束]があったりもした。
lines.translated: And the person being confessed to would shout their answer right back on the spot. It was practically a classic trope of the show.

lines.content: すごい勇気だと思った。
lines.translated: I thought it took incredible courage.

lines.content: 愛する誰かを助けるためでも、世界を救うためでもないけれど……。
lines.translated: It wasn't to save someone they loved, or to save the world, either...

lines.content: それでも[・|あ][・|れ]は、彼らにとってそれ以上の[・|何][・|か]を成すのにきっと等しい。
lines.translated: Even so, to them, doing that must have been equal to accomplishing something even greater.

lines.content: それほど大きな勇気が必要だったはずだと思うから――その勇気は、報われたのかな。
lines.translated: Because I'm sure it took that much immense courage--so I wonder if that courage was ever rewarded.

lines.content: こいつらは全員、夢を叶えたのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder if all of these people made their dreams come true."

lines.content: ……こいつらの恋は今も続いていたりしないかな
lines.translated: "...I wonder if their relationships are still going strong even now."

lines.content: さすがにそれは夢を見すぎなのかな
lines.translated: "Or maybe that's just being way too idealistic."

lines.content: そういったことを智仁と一緒に話しながら見るのがなんとなく楽しかったんですよ
lines.translated: "Talking about stuff like that with Tomohito while watching the videos was somehow really fun."

lines.content: そうして話している内に、俺たちも一度、ゲリラ的にこれをやってやろうぜという話になってたんです……。たとえば、卒業式の日とかに
lines.translated: "And while we were talking about it, we ended up saying we should pull a guerrilla stunt like that ourselves one day... Like on graduation day, for example."

lines.content: 卒業式は普段と違う。若干程度だが特別な日だ。気持ちも浮ついていることだろう。
lines.translated: Graduation day is different from normal days. Only slightly, perhaps, but it's a special day. Everyone's bound to be feeling a little giddy and lightheaded.

lines.content: そういったふわふわした気持ちを利用して、いつもは恥ずかしくてできないようなことでも、勇気を出してチャレンジできそうな気がしたのだ。
lines.translated: We figured that by riding that floaty, lightheaded mood, we might be able to muster up the courage to try something we'd normally be way too embarrassed to do.

lines.content: ……本気だったのかと問われれば首をかしげるしかない。ただの雑談の延長だ。
lines.translated: If someone asked whether we were actually serious, I could only tilt my head. It was just an extension of our idle chatter.

lines.content: 卒業式。そのときまで覚えているかさえも疑わしいくらい。
lines.translated: Graduation day. It was doubtful whether we'd even remember the idea by the time it rolled around.

lines.content: だけど、必要なのが勇気であるというのなら……。
lines.translated: However, if what I needed right now was courage...

lines.content: 今、ここ以上に相応しい場面などないように思えた。千和が俺に贈ってくれた勇気には、それと同等か、それ以上の勇気で返したい――……
lines.translated: Then it felt like there was no time or place more fitting than right here, right now. I wanted to return the courage Chiwa had gifted me with equal, or even greater, courage of my own--...

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 今日で、卒業だ。
lines.translated: Today is my graduation.

lines.content: 昨日までのうじうじ悩んでいた自分自身からの卒業の日だ――なんて。
lines.translated: The day I graduate from the indecisive, brooding person I was up until yesterday--or something like that.

lines.content: 強引に理屈をこじつけて、俺は[・|そ][・|れ]を実行しようとしている。
lines.translated: Stringing together some forced logic, I was about to actually go through with *that*.

lines.content: 喫茶店のお手伝いで、注文を取るくらいのことで緊張してしまう俺なんです。そんな自分につい最近、気づいてしまいました
lines.translated: "Just taking orders while helping out at a cafe is enough to make me nervous. And I only just realized that about myself recently."

lines.content: だから[・|こ][・|れ]にはきっと、今日まで生きてきた中で最大に勇気が必要なことになっちゃうんじゃないかって。大げさなようだけど、そう感じてもいるんです。だから……
lines.translated: "So I figured *this* would probably take the most courage I've ever had to muster in my entire life. It might sound exaggerated, but that's genuinely how I feel. So..."

lines.content: 今からやろうとしていることの動機を簡単に伝えると、あず咲先輩は[・|真][・|っ][・|赤]になっていた。
lines.translated: When I briefly explained the motive behind what I was about to do, Azusaki-senpai turned *bright red*.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: こちらが思わず驚くくらい、真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: So bright red that it caught me completely off guard.

lines.content: どうしたんですか？　先輩……何か変なところありましたか？
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Senpai...? Did I say something weird?"

lines.content: いや。変なことだらけだ。
lines.translated: No, everything about it was weird.

lines.content: 行動動機があまりにも少年で。あまりにも幼稚で。赤面されても仕方がないほど子どもであった――しかし。
lines.translated: My motivation was way too boyish. Way too childish. So juvenile I couldn't blame her for blushing--and yet.

lines.content: ……告白、するんですか？
lines.translated: "...Are you going to confess to her?"

lines.content: ……あず咲先輩は真っ赤な顔で言う。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai asked, her face bright red.

lines.content: ……大雅くん。千和ちゃんに……全校生徒の前で、告白しちゃうんですか？
lines.translated: "...Taiga-kun. Are you going to confess to Chiwa-chan... right in front of the entire school?"

lines.content: 俺が想像していたものとはまるで違う理由で、あず咲先輩は顔を真っ赤に染めていた。
lines.translated: Azusaki-senpai's face was flushed crimson for a reason completely different from what I had imagined.

lines.content: 改めて想像してしまうと――うう。自分のことじゃないのに、とても、とっても、恥ずかしくなってきてしまいました
lines.translated: "Now that I'm actually picturing it--ugh. It's not even happening to me, and yet I feel so, so terribly embarrassed."

lines.content: 告白……。
lines.translated: A confession...

lines.content: 千和に好きだと俺から伝える……？
lines.translated: Me, telling Chiwa that I like her...?

lines.content: あず咲先輩の問いに言葉を返そうとしたところで――……バスだ。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to reply to Azusaki-senpai's question--...the bus.

lines.content: あず咲先輩の待っていたバスが来た。道の向こうにその姿が見え始めている。
lines.translated: The bus Azusaki-senpai had been waiting for arrived, its frame coming into view down the road.

lines.content: ……それは、確かに、とっても勇気のいることだろうと思いますけど……でも、大雅くん
lines.translated: "...That would certainly take a whole lot of courage, I'm sure, but... still, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: そうすると……。今さらですがやっぱり君は千和ちゃんのことが……
lines.translated: "If you do that... Well, it's a little late to be asking, but does that mean you really do feel that way about Chiwa-chan...?"

lines.content: 告白……。
lines.translated: A confession...

lines.content: 千和から告白されたから、今度は俺が、俺なりのやり方で千和に告白し返す。
lines.translated: Because Chiwa confessed to me, it's now my turn to confess back to her in my own way.

lines.content: そういう形がきっと一番わかりやすいだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Putting it like that would probably be the easiest way to understand it, except...

lines.content: ……違います
lines.translated: "...That's not true."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺は、千和に告白をしたいわけじゃありません
lines.translated: "It's not that I want to confess to Chiwa."

lines.content: 俺が千和に言いたいことは、そういうことじゃあなくて……。
lines.translated: What I wanted to say to Chiwa wasn't something like that...

lines.content: そうなんですか？　だったら大雅くんは何を、千和ちゃんに伝えたいんですか……？　たくさんの人の前で。一杯の、勇気を振り絞ってまで
lines.translated: "It isn't? Then what is it that you want to tell Chiwa-chan, Taiga-kun...? In front of all those people, mustering up every last bit of your courage."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 俺は、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: 俺は俺自身、千和のことをどう思っているのかわからない。
lines.translated: Even I didn't know how I truly felt about Chiwa.

lines.content: 恋とか。愛とか。
lines.translated: Romance. Or love.

lines.content: ……そんなことを語る以前の問題なのだ。
lines.translated: This was a matter that came way before talking about things like that.

lines.content: だから千和へ“君が好きだ”とは叫べない。
lines.translated: That's why I couldn't shout "I love you" to Chiwa.

lines.content: だけど、
lines.translated: Even so,

lines.content: ……それでも、
lines.translated: Even so,

lines.content: 確信を持って言えることがたったひとつだけある。
lines.translated: There was only one thing I could say with absolute certainty.

lines.content: それを伝えられないまま“さよなら”はできない。
lines.translated: And I couldn't say "goodbye" without telling her that first.

lines.content: だから。
lines.translated: So.

lines.content: 俺は……。
……千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: ……つぶやく。
lines.translated: I muttered.

lines.content: ……行くなよ、千和
lines.translated: "...Don't go, Chiwa."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my eyes.

lines.content: ……理屈なんていい。道理だってわからない
lines.translated: "...Forget about logic. I don't care what makes sense."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を論ずるための材料さえ、俺はまるで持たないのだ――それでも。千和。
lines.translated: I didn't even have a single shred of what I needed to argue *that*--and yet. Chiwa.

lines.content: 行ってほしくない
lines.translated: "I don't want you to go."

lines.content: 君に、側にいてほしい
lines.translated: "I want you to stay by my side."

lines.content: また、手を繋いで色々話して……笑っていられる時間がほしい。それだけなんだ。
lines.translated: I just want more time where we can hold hands, talk about all sorts of things... and laugh together. That's all it is.

lines.content: たったそれだけ、俺は君に伝えたい
lines.translated: "That's the only thing I want to tell you."

lines.content: 君が好きだとか。君が恋しいだとか。
lines.translated: Saying I love you. Or that I yearn for you.

lines.content: 今はまだ……少なくとも現時点のこの俺にはとても言えやしないけど。
lines.translated: Right now... at least as I am in this moment, there's no way I can say those words, but...

lines.content: 君が、こんな身勝手にもなりきれていないような気持ちを、もし受け入れてくれるなら――そんな返事をもしももらえるのなら。
lines.translated: If you're willing to accept feelings that can't even commit to being completely selfish--if you could give me an answer like that.

lines.content: そしてもし君が……本当にもしもだが、君が“行きたくない”と言ってくれるなら。
lines.translated: And if you... if by some miracle, you were to tell me, "I don't want to go."
*I'd be a hero*.

lines.content: ……千和、俺は、君をどこか遠くへ[さら|攫]いにだって行けるはず
lines.translated: "...Chiwa, I'm sure I could even whisk you away somewhere far from here."

lines.content: 今日一日だけでいい。
lines.translated: Just for today is fine.

lines.content: 俺は、君にとってのヒーロー……には、やっぱりなりきれないだろうが。それでも、それらしい真似事くらいは、できるだろうと思いたい。
lines.translated: I probably still can't fully become a hero for you... Even so, I'd like to believe I can at least pull off a decent imitation of one.

lines.content: ……君を救うヒーローはここにいる。そう叫んでみたい。一度だけでいいから。それが俺の夢なんですよ。あず咲先輩
lines.translated: "...The hero who's going to save you is right here. I want to try shouting that out. Just once is enough. That's my dream, Azusaki-senpai."

lines.content: 最後にそう言い、俺たちは笑い合った。そして手を振り別れた。
lines.translated: Once I finished saying that, the two of us shared a laugh. Then we waved goodbye and parted ways.

lines.content: ああ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ヒーローだ。
lines.translated: A hero.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|人]みたいに俺はなりたい。
lines.translated: I want to become like *that person*.

lines.content: 苦笑いのまま、俺は[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。
lines.translated: With a wry smile still on my face, I opened my eyes.

lines.content: ――……聞いてるか。聞こえてるか、千和。
lines.translated: --...Are you listening? Can you hear me, Chiwa?

lines.content: 行くな
lines.translated: "Don't go."

lines.content: 君に、ありったけの[想い|勇気]を伝えたい。
lines.translated: I want to convey every last bit of my courage--my feelings--to you.

lines.content: いきなり、転校だなんて……
lines.translated: "Transferring schools right out of nowhere..."

lines.content: そんなのは、絶対に認めたくないから……。
lines.translated: Because there's no way I can ever accept something like that...

lines.content: 千和……今から俺が、君を、[さら|攫]いに行くぞ
lines.translated: "Chiwa... I'm coming to whisk you away right now!"

lines.content: 千和……今から俺が、君を、[さら|攫]いに行くぞ
lines.translated: "Chiwa... I'm coming to whisk you away right now!"

lines.content: 校庭一杯に響いたその声は、[・|私]を驚かせるには充分で……真っ白だ。頭の中が真っ白に、なった。
lines.translated: That voice echoing across the entire courtyard was more than enough to shock *me*... Blank. My mind went completely blank.

lines.content: ざわつく校庭。
lines.translated: The courtyard buzzed with commotion.

lines.content: 誰かが笑い。
lines.translated: Someone laughed.

lines.content: 誰かが、悲鳴にも似た歓声を上げている。
lines.translated: Someone else let out a cheer that sounded almost like a scream.

lines.content: ……なあ、千和
lines.translated: "...Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: 先輩の声が続く。
lines.translated: Senpai's voice continued.

lines.content: ……君は、すごいな
lines.translated: "...You're amazing, you know that?"

lines.content: 何が？
lines.translated: What is?

lines.content: 私の、何が……？
lines.translated: What part of me is...?

lines.content: “君にどこにも行ってほしくない”――それだけだ。俺が千和に伝えたいと思ったことはたったそれだけ
lines.translated: "'I don't want you to go anywhere'--that's all. That's the only thing I wanted to tell you, Chiwa."

lines.content: それなのに、たったそれだけのことが、すごい……大変だ。本当に
lines.translated: "And yet, doing something as simple as that is... insanely hard. It really is."

lines.content: 緊張で今にも吐きそうだ。先輩の声がそう続く。
lines.translated: I'm so nervous I feel like I could throw up at any second. Senpai's voice continued like that.

lines.content: ……誰かに自分の想いを伝えるということが、こんなにも……苦しくて。勇気が、必要で。大変なことだとは思わなかった
lines.translated: "...Telling someone how you feel... I never knew it was this painful. That it took this much courage. That it was this overwhelming."

lines.content: それはきっと、こんな場所だとか、こんな場面だとか、こんな……バカみたいな状況だとかに関わらず……気持ちを伝えるってことはさ、きっと何より勇気がいることなんだ
lines.translated: "And I'm sure it doesn't matter that it's in a place like this, or a scene like this, or a... ridiculous situation like this... Conveying your feelings to someone takes more courage than anything else."

lines.content: ……ここにこうして立つまで、本当の意味でそれを理解できていなかった――想像力が欠如してるにも程がある
lines.translated: "...Until I stood right here like this, I didn't truly understand what that meant--talk about a complete and utter lack of imagination."

lines.content: 校庭に集まっていた人たち。
lines.translated: The people gathered in the courtyard.

lines.content: その数人が校舎に駆け込んでいる。先生たちだ。その姿が先輩にも見えたのか。声のトーンが少し変わった。
lines.translated: A few of them were rushing into the school building. The teachers. Maybe Senpai caught sight of them too, because the tone of his voice shifted slightly.

lines.content: 千和
lines.translated: Chiwa

lines.content: なあ、千和
lines.translated: "Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: 本当に……本当にどこか遠くに行っちゃう気なのか。俺が、君に、ひどいことをしたから……？
lines.translated: "Are you really... really planning on going somewhere far away? Is it because I did something terrible to you...?"

lines.content: 先輩の姿がふらりと揺れる。
lines.translated: Senpai's figure swayed unsteadily.

lines.content: 君を、バカみたいな一言で、泣かしてしまったから……だから
lines.translated: "Because I said something so stupid and made you cry... Is that why?"

lines.content: だから、千和。もう俺のことなんて、顔も見たくないって……そう思ったのかな
lines.translated: "Is that why, Chiwa? Did you decide you never even want to see my face again...?"

lines.content: だから遠くへ行ってしまおうと、そんな気持ちになったのかなと先輩は言う。小さな声で。
lines.translated: So did that make you feel like going far away? Senpai asked, his voice quiet.

lines.content: でも、機械がその声をどうしたって大きくおおきく広げてしまう。
lines.translated: Even so, the equipment inevitably amplified his voice, spreading it loud and clear across the grounds.

lines.content: いいや。転校なんて、思い立ったからってすぐできることじゃない。昨日の今日じゃあもちろん無理だ。不可能だ
lines.translated: "No. Transferring schools isn't something you can just do on a whim. There's no way it happened overnight. That's impossible."

lines.content: だからずっと……前からずっと、それは予定されていたことで……それならどうして、これまでずっと、千和はそれを秘密にしてきたんだろう
lines.translated: "Which means for a long time... it must've been planned for a really long time... And if that's true, then why did you keep it a secret all this time, Chiwa?"

lines.content: ……色々だ。色々なことを思ってしまう。どうしても考えてしまうんだ
lines.translated: "...All sorts of things. It makes me think all sorts of things. I can't help but wonder."

lines.content: 君が側にいなくなると思うと……心が不安でいっぱいだ。怖かった
lines.translated: "When I think about you not being by my side anymore... my heart fills with anxiety. I was scared."

lines.content: そこでやっと何かに気づいた気がした。自分の気持ちが少しだけわかった気がした
lines.translated: "And that's when I felt like I finally realized something. Like I understood my own feelings just a little bit better."

lines.content: ……千和。わざわざこんなことをしてるのは、君の勇気に報いたかったからだ。勇気を勇気で返したかった
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. The reason I'm going out of my way to do something like this is because I wanted to answer your courage. I wanted to return your courage with courage of my own."

lines.content: バカなやつだって自分でも笑える。だけどこれしかいい方法を思いつけなかった
lines.translated: "Even I have to laugh at what an idiot I'm being. But this was the only good way I could come up with."

lines.content: 千和の店で、注文を取ることくらいで緊張するような俺だから……。これが、俺には限界だ。これ以上は……いい感じのせりふも思いつけない
lines.translated: "Because I'm the kind of guy who gets nervous just taking orders at your cafe... This is my absolute limit. Beyond this... I can't even come up with any cool lines to say."

lines.content: だからこうして、言いたいこともまとまらずぐだぐだと……
lines.translated: "So here I am, rambling on without even getting my thoughts together..."

lines.content: ……つまるところ、伝えたいことはたったひとつだけなんだよ。千和
lines.translated: "...In the end, there's only one thing I want to tell you, Chiwa."

lines.content: 一呼吸ほどの沈黙があった。
lines.translated: There was a silence lasting the length of a single breath.

lines.content: ……後悔してるんだ
lines.translated: "...I regret it."

lines.content: あのとき。君が勇気を出して見せてくれたとき。ちゃんと君と向き合おうとしなかったこと……悔やんでも悔やみきれないくらい……後悔してる。だから……
lines.translated: "Back then. When you mustered up your courage and showed it to me. The fact that I didn't try to face you properly... I regret it so much I can never regret it enough. That's why..."

lines.content: ……千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: ……聞いてくれ、千和
lines.translated: "...Listen to me, Chiwa."

lines.content: すぅっと……息を吸い込む音がする。
lines.translated: There was the soft sound of him drawing in a breath.

lines.content: ……一年三組。出席番号一番。杏藤千和さん！
lines.translated: "...First year, Class Three. Student number one. Andou Chiwa-san!"

lines.content: 先輩は、叫んだ。
lines.translated: Senpai shouted.

lines.content: 俺と……っ
lines.translated: "With me...!"

lines.content: 俺と！　どうか俺と……もう一度、デートしてくれませんかっ
lines.translated: "With me! Would you please... go on a date with me one more time?!"

lines.content: マイクがハウリングした。誰もが耳をふさいだ。
lines.translated: The microphone screeched with feedback. Everyone covered their ears.

lines.content: だけど、私は……、
lines.translated: But I...

lines.content: 何も言えず、
lines.translated: Couldn't say a word,

lines.content: 何もできないまま、
lines.translated: Couldn't do a thing,

lines.content: ……立ちすくむ。
lines.translated: And just stood there, frozen.

lines.content: 気づくと校庭に集まった生徒たちが私を見ていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the students gathered in the courtyard were all looking at me.

lines.content: たくさんの視線が今度は私に集まっている。たじろぐ。呼吸が……止まるかと思った。
lines.translated: Now all those eyes were focused on me. I flinched. I thought my breathing... was going to stop.

lines.content: そんな私の手をそっと握ってくれる人がいた。
lines.translated: Then, someone gently took my hand.

lines.content: さ。どうぞどうぞ
lines.translated: "Here. Go right ahead."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 夜月先輩だ。
lines.translated: It was Yotsuki-senpai.

lines.content: 先輩が私にマイクを一本、握らせてくれていた。
lines.translated: She pressed a microphone into my hand.

lines.content: ここでお返事するのがお約束らしいよ？　バカみたいだけど。何やってんのってちょっと白けちゃうけどさ。まあ……うん。付き合ってあげてよ。千和
lines.translated: "Giving him your answer right here is how these things usually go, isn't it? Even if it is kind of silly. And a little cringeworthy, like, 'what is he even doing?' But well... yeah. Humor him, Chiwa."

lines.content: 夜月先輩……
lines.translated: "Yotsuki-senpai..."

lines.content: じゃないと、ほら。あのおバカさん。きっと千和がお返事するまであそこから降りてこないんじゃないかな？
lines.translated: "Otherwise, look. Knowing that idiot, he probably won't come down from there until you give him an answer, right?"

lines.content: どんどんとドアを叩く音が聞こえた。
lines.translated: A loud banging echoed as someone pounded on a door.

lines.content: そこにあるのだろうマイクが、その場の音声を拾い、拡大させている。ここを開けろ。何をしている。これは問題だぞ！　大問題だ！　そんな大人たちの声がする。
lines.translated: The microphone up there was picking up the sounds in the room and amplifying them. Open this door! What do you think you're doing?! You're in big trouble! Huge trouble! The voices of adults rang out.

lines.content: うっせえ黙ってろ！　今、大事なところなんだよ！　見ててわかんだろうが！
lines.translated: "Shut up and stay out of this! I'm right in the middle of something important! Can't you tell just by looking?!"

lines.content: ……なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: あんたら大人の事情なんて知ったことじゃねえんだよ！　こっちはいつだって問題だらけだ！
lines.translated: "I don't give a damn about your adult circumstances! My life is always full of problems anyway!"

lines.content: いつもの先輩らしくない声が響いた。
lines.translated: A voice completely unlike the usual Senpai echoed across the grounds.

lines.content: ね？
lines.translated: "See?"

lines.content: やれやれと夜月先輩は肩をすくめた。
lines.translated: Yotsuki-senpai shrugged with an exasperated sigh.

lines.content: すっかり頭に血がのぼっちゃって……まるでお猿さんだよね。まったく。男の子って本当に仕方ないよね
lines.translated: "All the blood's rushed to his head... He's acting just like a monkey. Honestly. Boys really are hopeless, aren't they?"

lines.content: やれやれと首を振る夜月先輩。
lines.translated: Yotsuki-senpai shook her head, sighing again.

lines.content: なんだっけ？　恋は[もうろく|耄碌]ってやつかしら？
lines.translated: "What's that saying again? Love makes you senile?"

lines.content: 恋は盲目、ね。惜しいぞひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Love is blind. Close, though, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: 兎蛙先輩も苦笑いで肩を竦めていた。
lines.translated: Toa-senpai was also shrugging with a wry smile.

lines.content: 俺からも頼むよ。千和ちゃん。どうかあいつの呼びかけに応えてあげてほしい
lines.translated: "I'm asking you too, Chiwa-chan. Please answer his call."

lines.content: 辺りをぐるりと見渡す兎蛙先輩。たくさんの視線が私たちに集まっている。
lines.translated: Toa-senpai glanced around at our surroundings. Countless eyes were fixed on us.

lines.content: まあ、なんて言うか……こんなんじゃどっちの勇気がより必要なのかって話で。本末転倒だよなとは思うけどさ
lines.translated: "Well, how do I put it... Putting you on the spot like this makes you wonder which one of you actually needs more courage. It kind of defeats the whole purpose, if you ask me."

lines.content: はー……まったくだよね。ほんとに、男の子ってお世話が焼けちゃうよね
lines.translated: "Sigh... You can say that again. Boys really are such a handful."

lines.content: 私は、うなずいた。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: 本当に……。
lines.translated: Really...

lines.content: 本当に先輩は、いつまでも仕方のない先輩だなあって、思うから。
lines.translated: Because I really did think that Senpai would always, always be completely hopeless.

lines.content: ぎゅっとマイクを握りしめ。
lines.translated: I squeezed the microphone tightly.

lines.content: ……ふぅ
lines.translated: "...Phew."

lines.content: ……勇気を、振り絞り。
lines.translated: And mustered up all my courage.

lines.content: ……いやです！
私は、叫んだ。
lines.translated: I shouted.

lines.content: 先輩のこと、嫌いです！　大嫌い！
lines.translated: "I hate you, Senpai! I hate you so much!"

lines.content: こんな……人、いっぱいなところに、いきなり呼び出して……こんな、恥ずかしいこと……っ
lines.translated: "Calling me out all of a sudden... in front of all these people... doing something this embarrassing...!"

lines.content: 先輩ひどい！　と私は叫ぶ。
lines.translated: "You're the worst, Senpai!" I yelled.

lines.content: 先輩はいつもいっつも私にばっかり意地悪だし、私が怒るのばっかり、よろこんで……本当に嫌い。大嫌いっ
lines.translated: "You're always, always picking on me, and you just love making me mad... I really hate you. I hate you so much!"

lines.content: そんな先輩と、もう一度デートだなんて……いやです！　お断りです！
lines.translated: "Going on another date with a Senpai like that... No way! I refuse!"

lines.content: わっと歓声が上がった……気がした。
lines.translated: A huge cheer went up from the crowd... or so I felt.

lines.content: 先輩。
lines.translated: Senpai.

lines.content: その姿がふらりとしたように見えたけれど……。
lines.translated: It looked like his figure staggered for a moment up there...

lines.content: でも、ダメ。いやだよ。
lines.translated: But no. I don't want that.

lines.content: 私だってこのままじゃ終われないから。
lines.translated: Because I can't let it end like this either.

lines.content: ……で、でも
唇を噛む。お願い……もう少しだけがんばれ、私。
lines.translated: I bit my lip. Please... just hang in there a little longer, me.

lines.content: ……でも。先輩
lines.translated: "...Wait. Senpai."

lines.content: あ、あのときみたいに
lines.translated: "L-Like back then..."

lines.content: 私に、意地悪しない……私にやさしい、先輩となら……も、もう、一度だけ……くらいなら……その……
lines.translated: "If it's with the Senpai who doesn't pick on me... the Senpai who's sweet to me... then m-maybe... just one more time... um..."

lines.content: 辺りがシンとした。
lines.translated: The whole courtyard fell dead silent.

lines.content: う、うう。どうして。どうして静かになっちゃうの。
lines.translated: Ngh, ugh. Why? Why did everyone go quiet?

lines.content: ぎゅっと目を閉じる。
lines.translated: I squeezed my eyes shut.

lines.content: 深呼吸。
lines.translated: A deep breath.

lines.content: そして私は……、
lines.translated: And then I...

lines.content: 大嫌いな私の先輩……！
lines.translated: "My stupid,awful Senpai that I hate so much...!"

lines.content: ……私は、もう一度声を大きく張り上げた。
lines.translated: I raised my voice as loud as I could one more time.

lines.content: そんなところから叫ばなくっても、私、ちゃんと、ずっと……先輩からの連絡……待ってたのに！
lines.translated: "You didn't have to shout from all the way up there! I was... I was waiting for you to call me this whole time!"

lines.content: まただ。
lines.translated: There it is again.

lines.content: また、歓声が上がった……気がした。聞こえない。恥ずかしくって。どきどきで。もう何も聞こえなかった。
lines.translated: Another cheer went up... I think. I couldn't hear it. I was too embarrassed. My heart was pounding too hard. I couldn't hear anything anymore.

lines.content: もういや。
lines.translated: I can't take this anymore.

lines.content: そこから自分が何を叫んだのかよく覚えていない。
lines.translated: I don't really remember what I shouted after that.

lines.content: ただすごく……すっごく恥ずかしい何かをいっぱい、たくさん、叫んだ気がしてる。
lines.translated: I just feel like I shouted a whole lot of really... really embarrassing things.

lines.content: どうしてこんなことになってるんだろう。
lines.translated: How did things end up like this?

lines.content: 先輩のせいだよ。
