lines.translated: It's all Senpai's fault.

lines.content: 私、一生分の勇気を使い果たしてしまった気がするよ。
lines.translated: I feel like I just used up a whole lifetime's worth of courage.

lines.content: はは。そんなことがあったのか。すごいな
lines.translated: "Haha. So that happened, huh? Amazing."

lines.content: 千和の一日を近くから、遠くから、いつも見つめている[・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]の報告を受け、[・|私]は思わず苦笑してしまっていた。
lines.translated: Hearing the report from that person who was always watching over Chiwa's days, from up close and from afar, I couldn't help but smile wryly.

lines.content: 私たちの愛しい[千和|子]が選んだ少年――奏大雅。
lines.translated: The boy our beloved child, Chiwa, had chosen--Kanade Taiga.

lines.content: 中々にめちゃくちゃなことをする子だね。うん。私は気に入ったよ。その少年にならあの子を任せられるかもしれない
lines.translated: "He does some pretty crazy things, doesn't he? Yeah. I like him. I think I might be able to entrust her to a boy like that."

lines.content: 一度は千和を泣かせてしまい、そのときはさすがにどうしたものかと、はらはらしながら見守ってはいたものの……。
lines.translated: He had made Chiwa cry once, and back then I'd watched over them on pins and needles, wondering what on earth was going to happen...

lines.content: 千和のためにいっぱい悩んで。覚悟を決めて。精一杯の行動力で、千和をつなぎ止めようともがいてくれた――充分だ。これ以上はない。私は、そう思えたよ
lines.translated: "He agonized so much for Chiwa's sake. He made up his mind. And he struggled with everything he had to keep her from leaving--that's plenty. I couldn't ask for more. That's how I see it."
What about you?

lines.content: あなたは、あの少年は、千和と共にこれからの人生を歩んでいってくれる者として、認めることはできないかな
lines.translated: "Can't you acknowledge that boy as someone who will walk alongside Chiwa through the rest of her life?"

lines.content: 音もなく舞い降りた深いふかい闇色に、私はそう、問いかけた。
lines.translated: I posed that question to the deep, profound darkness that had descended without a sound.

lines.content: ……振り返らずに。
lines.translated: Without turning around.

lines.content: だが[・|あ][・|な][・|た]がそこにいることだけは、わかる。
lines.translated: Even so, I knew without a doubt that you were there.

lines.content: 背後に忍び寄ってくる闇が、私の耳元に囁いた――ああ。そろそろ時間か。なるほど。
lines.translated: The darkness creeping up behind me whispered in my ear--Ah. Is it about that time? I see.

lines.content: ……そうか。私の役割も、ここまでか
lines.translated: "...I see. So my role ends here, huh?"

lines.content: 長かった。
lines.translated: It was long.

lines.content: 長かったなあ……。
lines.translated: It was so long...

lines.content: 本当に。本当に。……長かった。
lines.translated: Really. Truly. ...It was a long time.

lines.content: 私は、立てかけたカンバスにそっと触れ……。
lines.translated: I gently touched the canvas resting on the easel...

lines.content: ……やり遂げたよ
lines.translated: "...I saw it through to the end."

lines.content: 見ててくれたかな。私は上手に、できていたかな。
lines.translated: Were you watching? Did I do a good job?

lines.content: でも……教えてほしい
lines.translated: "Still... there's something I want you to tell me."

lines.content: もう殆ど義務として行ってきたように思うけど……。
lines.translated: I feel like I've been doing this almost purely out of obligation by now, though...

lines.content: こんなことに今さらどんな意味が、あったのかな
lines.translated: "What kind of meaning was there in doing all of this after all this time?"

lines.content: 私は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: 忍び寄る闇色よりも深いふかい闇が広がり――……。
lines.translated: A darkness far deeper than the creeping shadows spread before me--...

lines.content: あと少しだけ、猶予をやろう
lines.translated: "I will grant you just a little more time."

lines.content: そんな囁きが耳元を撫でては消えた。
lines.translated: That whisper brushed against my ear and vanished.

lines.content: そうか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: 後、少しだけ……。
lines.translated: Just a little more...

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 最後はあの子と、かわいい千和と……どれだけ思い出を作れるかな。
lines.translated: At the very end, how many more memories will I be able to make with her, with my sweet Chiwa...?

lines.content: そんなことを思える私はきっと、私自身に満足できていた。
lines.translated: The fact that I could think such things surely meant I was satisfied with myself.

lines.content: ……最近クロと電話がつながらない。
lines.translated: Lately, I haven't been able to reach Kuro on the phone.

lines.content: ぼんやりと、そのことばかりを思ってる。
lines.translated: That's all I've been absently thinking about.

lines.content: 千和とのことを報告したかった。君に、一番に。
lines.translated: I wanted to tell her about what happened with Chiwa. I wanted her to be the first to know.

lines.content: 手の中にある古い型の端末を俺はもう一度、操作する。今日、何度目だろう。この番号を順番に押すのは。
lines.translated: I fiddled with the old-model device in my hand once more. How many times has it been today, pressing these numbers in this exact order?

lines.content: “９６”――意味はあえて言わずとも、という具合。
lines.translated: "96"--a number whose meaning goes without saying, since it reads "Kuro."

lines.content: 市外局番だとかはまったく不要。そもそも正式な電波を利用してのものではない。
lines.translated: There's no need for an area code or anything like that. In the first place, it doesn't even use official radio waves.

lines.content: 設定したこの番号を押しさえすれば、必ず君の持っている端末に繋いでくれる。これはこういう“魔法”なのだ。
lines.translated: As long as I press this preset number, it's guaranteed to connect me to the device she carries. That's the kind of "magic" this is.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: ……やっぱり、繋がらないな
lines.translated: "...Still not going through, huh."

lines.content: コール音はする。
lines.translated: The dial tone rings.

lines.content: だがどれだけ待っても君が応えてくれることはなかった。
lines.translated: Yet no matter how long I waited, she never answered.

lines.content: ……気になっている。
lines.translated: It's been bothering me.

lines.content: 『わたしが、意地悪したから……』
lines.translated: "Because I was being mean to you..."

lines.content: 前回の電話で君はそう言い、落ち込んだふうなまま電話を切ったから……。
lines.translated: During our last phone call, she had said that and hung up sounding depressed...

lines.content: だからこそ一層、君に報告したかった。
lines.translated: That was all the more reason I wanted to give her an update.
(...I managed to make up with Chiwa.)

lines.content: 俺の未来……。
lines.translated: My future...

lines.content: 俺はクロの“力”を知らない。
lines.translated: I don't know what Kuro's "power" is.

lines.content: 悩める人類の側に寄りそう相棒たる特別な猫たちは特別な“力”を持っている。
lines.translated: The special cats who stand by troubled humans as their partners all possess special "powers."

lines.content: 十夜は最大十秒先の未来を教えてくれる。
lines.translated: Toya can tell the future up to ten seconds ahead.

lines.content: あさひさんは治療だ。どのような負傷も元通りに治してくれる。
lines.translated: Asahi-san's is healing. She can mend any injury right back to normal.

lines.content: しかし、クロは？
lines.translated: But what about Kuro?

lines.content: 君の力は今もよく知らないままで……。
lines.translated: Even now, I still don't really know what her power is...

lines.content: だけど今は、君と電話が繋がらないことのほうが問題だ。
lines.translated: Right now, though, the bigger problem is that I can't get through to her on the phone.

lines.content: もう一度だ。
lines.translated: One more time.

lines.content: もう一度、専用の端末で“９６”をプッシュしようとした。
lines.translated: I was just about to press "96" on the dedicated device once more.

lines.content: そんなにぼーっとしなくても平気だよ。大雅
lines.translated: "You don't need to space out like that, Taiga. Everything's fine."

lines.content: そこでふと、声がかけられた。我に返る。……振り返る。
lines.translated: Suddenly, someone called out to me. I snapped back to reality. ...And turned around.

lines.content: 心配しなくても千和はすぐ帰ってくるよ。ただ遊びに行ってるだけでしょう？　だから、ほら……お仕事おさぼりしてないで、ご注文だよ大雅
lines.translated: "Don't worry, Chiwa will be back soon. She just went out to have some fun, right? So come on... stop slacking off on the job and take our order, Taiga."

lines.content: 繋がらない端末を握りしめ、ひとりぼーっと考え事に耽っている。そんな姿に少し誤解を与えてしまったようだった。
lines.translated: Clutching a phone that wouldn't connect, lost in thought all by myself. It seemed seeing me like that had given her the wrong idea.

lines.content: 俺は端末を制服のポケットにしまった。
lines.translated: I slipped the device into my uniform pocket.

lines.content: そして背筋を伸ばし、ペンと伝票を構え――微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Then I straightened my posture, readied my pen and order pad--and smiled.

lines.content: ご注文は？　奢りませんよ？
lines.translated: "May I take your order? I'm not treating, you know."

lines.content: ケッチ……！
lines.translated: "Stingy...!"

lines.content: いーっと白い歯を見せる姫織。そして隣の席の智仁にねえねえお願いとすり寄っている。そんな光景にハルは苦笑いだった。
lines.translated: Himeori bared her white teeth with a "grr." Then she sidled up to Tomohito in the seat next to her, begging him with a "Hey, hey, please?" Haru watched the scene with a wry smile.

lines.content: ……今、俺は千和のお店でフロア仕事をこなしている。一日中。ひとりで、だ。
lines.translated: Right now, I'm working the floor at Chiwa's cafe. All day long. All by myself.

lines.content: 今は、放課後。
lines.translated: It's currently after school.

lines.content: そろそろ店がごった返す時間が迫ってきている。
lines.translated: The hour when the shop gets packed is fast approaching.

lines.content: 大雅は本当にケチだよ。あんなに私たち、大雅のお手伝いがんばったのに……それなのにお礼もないなんて
lines.translated: "You really are stingy, Taiga. After we all worked so hard to help you out... you won't even give us a thank-you treat."

lines.content: ぶつぶつと姫織は頬を膨らませている。
lines.translated: Himeori puffed out her cheeks, grumbling to herself.

lines.content: 手伝い。
lines.translated: Help.

lines.content: 俺が学園の屋上から叫んだ際……。
lines.translated: Back when I shouted from the academy rooftop...

lines.content: そのセッティングをみんなには頼んだのだ。
lines.translated: I had asked everyone to set all of that up for me.

lines.content: まずハルに全校生徒へとこれからすることを伝え、校庭に集まるよう呼びかけてもらった。
lines.translated: First, I had Haru tell the entire student body what I was about to do and call for them to gather in the schoolyard.

lines.content: 端末にインストールされたメッセージ交換アプリ。国民の殆どが使用しているという有名なもの。
lines.translated: A messaging app installed on our devices. A famous one used by nearly everyone in the country.

lines.content: そこにクラスごとにコミュニティが作られてあり、学園行事など連絡事項はそれを介して伝えられるようになっている。
lines.translated: Communities are set up for each class on there, used to pass along announcements for school events and the like.

lines.content: 智仁にはマイクなどの音響（とまで言ってしまえるような大げさなものでもないが）を用意してもらった。
lines.translated: I had Tomohito prepare the microphone and audio equipment (though it wasn't anything grand enough to really call it that).

lines.content: 姫織は……。
lines.translated: As for Himeori...

lines.content: えっと……。
lines.translated: Let's see...

lines.content: 何、してくれたんだったっけ……？
lines.translated: What did she do for me again...?

lines.content: ひどい！　私も協力したよ！　ちゃんとお役に立ったよ……！
lines.translated: "How rude! I helped out too! I made myself plenty useful...!"

lines.content: ぷりぷりとご立腹。
lines.translated: She huffed indignantly.

lines.content: 千和にどうぞってマイク渡したのは誰だと思う？　何を隠そう、この私なのだ
lines.translated: "Who do you think handed the microphone to Chiwa and told her to go ahead? Believe it or not, it was none other than me!"

lines.content: ふふんと得意げ。
lines.translated: She gave a proud little hum.

lines.content: その働きは、このお店の全メニューを無料提供してもらってもなお足らぬと……お腹の怪獣が申しておりますわ
lines.translated: "The monster in my belly declares that for such a feat, even offering me this shop's entire menu for free wouldn't be enough!"

lines.content: がおがおと姫織は言うのだ。
lines.translated: "Rawr, rawr," Himeori went.

lines.content: ふーむ。そっか。協力してくれてありがとう。でも、それだけの働きじゃ……ダメだな。全メニュー無料提供だなんてとてもとても
lines.translated: "Hmm. I see. Thanks for helping out. Still, if that's all you did... no dice. Giving you the whole menu for free is completely out of the question."

lines.content: どうしよう！　怪獣があばれちゃう！　ちきゅーほうかいの危機だよ！
lines.translated: "What do I do?! The monster's gonna go on a rampage! The Earth is in danger of being destroyed!"

lines.content: 全メニューは無理だけど、ちゃんと助けてくれたひよちゃんには……そうだな。抹茶パフェのクリーム大盛りくらいしか奢れないなあ
lines.translated: "I can't do the whole menu, but since Hiyo-chan did help me out... let's see. The best I can treat you to is a matcha parfait with extra cream."

lines.content: 好き。大雅……。大好き、だよ？
lines.translated: "I like you, Taiga... Actually, I love you, okay?"

lines.content: わいわいと、騒ぐ。
lines.translated: We bantered noisily.

lines.content: だがここに千和はいない。
lines.translated: However, Chiwa isn't here.

lines.content: だから俺がひとりで仕事をこなしてる。
lines.translated: Which is why I'm handling the work all by myself.

lines.content: 学園の屋上で叫び散らし教師の制止さえ振り切って千和の元へと駆けていき――結果、停学処分中。俺の時間は放っておくと腐り落ちてしまいそうなほど余ってる。
lines.translated: Screaming my lungs out on the academy rooftop, shaking off the teachers trying to stop me, and sprinting away to Chiwa's side--as a result, I'm currently suspended from school. I have so much free time on my hands that if I leave it alone, it feels like it might rot away.

lines.content: とはいえ、いくら時間を余らせようと、たったひとりで慣れない仕事をこなせるのかと言えばもちろん、そんなわけはなく……。
lines.translated: That said, no matter how much free time I have, does that mean I can handle unfamiliar work all by myself? Of course not...

lines.content: 千和はお父さんと一緒に隣町のテーマパークへと出かけていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa had gone out with her father to a theme park in the next town over.

lines.content: なぜ、そんなことになってしまっているのかというと……[・|土][・|下][・|座][・|だ]。
lines.translated: As for why things ended up like this... it was because of a dogeza.

lines.content: 『先輩……ごめんなさい』
lines.translated: "Senpai... I'm sorry."

lines.content: [・|昨][・|晩]、俺のスマホに千和からメッセージが届いた。
lines.translated: Last night, I received a message from Chiwa on my smartphone.

lines.content: 用件は――明日、つまり本日、お店の仕事をお願いできないかというものだった。
lines.translated: Her request was to ask if I could cover her shift at the shop tomorrow--meaning today.

lines.content: 『お父さんがどうしても一緒に遊びに行こうって言って……聞いてくれなくて。今、こんな状態なんです』
lines.translated: "My dad is insisting that we go out and have fun together... and he won't take no for an answer. Right now, things are like this."

lines.content: そんなメッセージの後、すぐに送られてきたスタンプは――デフォルメされたお侍のキャラが額を床にぐりぐりと押しつけているもの――つまり、土下座だった。
lines.translated: Right after that message, she sent a sticker--a chibi samurai character grinding his forehead into the floor--in other words, a dogeza.

lines.content: うそだろ。
lines.translated: No way.

lines.content: 娘と一緒に遊びに行きたいからどうかお願いと土下座をする父親とは……いったい。
lines.translated: What kind of father gets down on his hands and knees to beg his daughter to hang out with him...?

lines.content: 『突然変なお願いしてしまってごめんなさい。……お父さんとふたりでお出かけするの、すごく久しぶりで、ちょっとだけ楽しみかもしれなくて』
lines.translated: "I'm sorry for springing such a weird request on you all of a sudden. ...It's been a really long time since just the two of us went out together, so I might actually be looking forward to it a little."

lines.content: 続いて千和からそう送られてきたから……、
lines.translated: Because Chiwa followed up with that message...

lines.content: 『わかった、いいよ。楽しんできて』
lines.translated: "Got it, no problem. Go have fun."

lines.content: 俺は、そう返した。
lines.translated: That was how I replied.

lines.content: 『俺も千和に何かお詫びしなきゃって思ってたんだ。あんな恥ずかしい思いをさせちゃったから。だからちょうどいいかなとは思うよ』
lines.translated: "I was thinking I needed to make it up to you somehow anyway, Chiwa, after putting you through something so embarrassing. So I think this works out just fine."

lines.content: 一日仕事を任されるくらい何でもない。
lines.translated: Being left in charge of the work for a single day is no big deal.

lines.content: そう自身に言い聞かせてはいるのだが……。
lines.translated: That's what I keep telling myself, anyway...

lines.content: （……俺だって千和と色々と話したかった）
lines.translated: (...I wanted to talk with Chiwa about all sorts of things, too.)

lines.content: それが本音だった。
lines.translated: That was how I truly felt.

lines.content: （たとえば今度のデートのこととか。[・|互][・|い][・|に]時間も余ってるんだ。ふたりで色々と下見をしに行くのだって……）
lines.translated: (Like about our upcoming date, for instance. Both of us have plenty of free time on our hands. We could have gone out to scout different places together...)

lines.content: 俺たちはふたり揃って停学処分を受けていた。
lines.translated: The two of us had both been suspended from school together.

lines.content: なぜ俺だけではなく千和も一緒に……。
lines.translated: Why not just me, why did Chiwa have to get suspended too...?

lines.content: 不満はあるが、仕方ないですよねと千和本人は受け入れているようなので、それ以上は何も言えなくなってしまった。
lines.translated: I had my complaints, but since Chiwa herself seemed to accept it, saying it couldn't be helped, I couldn't really say anything more about it.

lines.content: ともあれそうして余った互いの時間を共有しようかと目論んでいたのだ。
lines.translated: In any case, I had been planning for us to share all that extra time we both had.

lines.content: それなのに、お父さんと一緒に遊びに行く、かあ。
lines.translated: And yet, she went out to have fun with her dad, huh?

lines.content: そこで、ふと。
lines.translated: Right then, a sudden thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: これから千和とデートだとかする場合、毎度一緒に父親が同伴してくるという地獄絵図のような想像がふっと、意味もなく、脳裏を過ぎったけれど……、
lines.translated: For no real reason, a hellish vision flashed through my head of her father tagging along every single time Chiwa and I go on a date from here on out...

lines.content: 大雅くん、聞いてる？　またぼーっとしてるよ？
lines.translated: "Taiga-kun, are you listening? You're spacing out again, you know?"

lines.content: メニューを開いたハルが首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Haru, who had opened her menu, was tilting her head at me.

lines.content: 今は仕事中だ。目の前の仕事に集中しよう。
lines.translated: I'm on the clock right now. Let's focus on the work in front of me.

lines.content: む。ごめん。ちょっと考え事が止まらなくて……。ご注文は？
lines.translated: "Mm. Sorry. I just couldn't stop thinking about something... May I take your order?"

lines.content: ハル？
lines.translated: "Haru?"

lines.content: 考え事って、千和ちゃんのこと？
lines.translated: "Thinking about something... Do you mean about Chiwa-chan?"

lines.content: う、ま、まあ……そうだね。うん
lines.translated: "Uh, w-well... yeah. Pretty much."

lines.content: なぜだろう。ハルの問いに若干動揺してしまっている自分がいた。
lines.translated: I wonder why. For some reason, Haru's question left me feeling slightly flustered.

lines.content: あー……えっと。ぼーっとしててごめん。ご注文、まだ聞いてなかった。承りますよ？
lines.translated: "Ah... um. Sorry for spacing out. I still haven't heard your order yet. What can I get for you?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ハルはペラリとメニューのページをめくる。そして俺を見ないまま、ぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: Haru flipped a page of the menu. Then, without looking at me, she murmured quietly.

lines.content: ご注文はね、大雅くんの気持ち、かな
lines.translated: "For my order... I think I'd like to hear how you feel, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: え？　どういう……こと？
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you... mean?"

lines.content: うん。教えてほしくて
lines.translated: "Yeah. I want you to tell me."

lines.content: なにを？
lines.translated: "Tell you what?"

lines.content: 大雅くんは、千和ちゃんのこと……
lines.translated: "How you feel about Chiwa-chan, Taiga-kun..."

lines.content: 開いたメニューに視線を止めたまま、ハルは言う。
lines.translated: Keeping her gaze fixed on the open menu, Haru continued.

lines.content: その……す、好き、なのかな……やっぱり
lines.translated: "Um... D-Do you like her... after all?"

lines.content: やっぱり、というのはどういうことなのか。
lines.translated: What did she mean by "after all"?

lines.content: そんなところに食いついても仕方がない。おそらくそういうことではこの場をごまかせはしないだろう。だから俺は素直に応える。
lines.translated: There was no point latching onto that part. Trying to do so probably wouldn't help me dodge the question anyway. So I answered honestly.

lines.content: いや。正直なところよく、わからない
lines.translated: "No. To tell you the truth, I don't really know."

lines.content: え、ええー……？
lines.translated: "Wh-Whaaat...?"

lines.content: は～？　わかんないってどういうことー？
lines.translated: "Huuuh? What do you mean, you don't know?"

lines.content: 自分の気持ちでしょ、ハッキリしなよ、と姫織が言う。
lines.translated: They're your own feelings, so figure them out already, Himeori said.

lines.content: まったくだ。この期に及んで何言ってるんだよ。大雅。よくわからないのにあんなことしたのか？
lines.translated: "Seriously. What are you saying after all that, Taiga? Did you really pull a stunt like that without even knowing how you felt?"

lines.content: 智仁がポケットから取り出したあめ玉を姫織に渡しながらそう言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito said this while pulling a piece of hard candy from his pocket and handing it to Himeori.

lines.content: あそこで大雅が千和ちゃんに告白して……晴れてふたりは恋人同士、みたいな流れになるんじゃないかって思ってたんだ。そうなっても誰も不思議に思わない
lines.translated: "I figured you were going to confess to Chiwa-chan right there... and the two of you would officially become a couple, or something along those lines. Nobody would've been surprised if it turned out that way."

lines.content: それなのに、大雅……お前さ。そもそも好きかどうかわからないって
lines.translated: "And yet, Taiga... here you are saying you don't even know if you like her in the first place."

lines.content: ……仕方ないだろ。わからないものはわからないんだ。うそはつけない。そもそも千和のことが好きだからああしようと思ったわけじゃない
lines.translated: "...I can't help it. If I don't know, I don't know. I'm not gonna lie. Besides, it's not like I did all that because I had feelings for Chiwa."

lines.content: ただ、千和に遠くに行ってほしくないと思った。そばにいてほしい。どんなことをしてでも。そう思ったのは本当だよ
lines.translated: "I just didn't want her to go somewhere far away. I wanted her to stay by my side, no matter what it took. That part was completely true."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ハルはメニューを閉じた。そして、沈黙してしまう。その横顔は何か複雑そうに俺には見えた。
lines.translated: Haru closed her menu and fell silent. From the side, her expression looked somewhat conflicted to me.

lines.content: ハルちゃん……
lines.translated: "Haru-chan..."

lines.content: 俺と同じような不安を覚えたのだろうか。姫織がハルにそっと声をかける。
lines.translated: Maybe Himeori felt the same kind of unease I did, because she gently called out to Haru.

lines.content: ハルちゃん、泣いちゃうの……？
lines.translated: "Haru-chan, are you gonna cry...?"

lines.content: え？　ど、どうして……っ、そんな……どうして私が泣くのかなっ
lines.translated: "Huh? W-Why would I...? Come on... why would I cry?"

lines.content: 慌ててハルが笑顔を作る。そのまま俺を見上げ、
lines.translated: Haru hurriedly put on a smile. Looking straight up at me, she said,

lines.content: おめでとう、大雅くん。先にお祝いしておくね？
lines.translated: "Congratulations, Taiga-kun. I'll celebrate for you in advance, okay?"

lines.content: え？　お祝い……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Celebrate...?"

lines.content: 何の？　と俺は問う。
lines.translated: Celebrate what? I asked.

lines.content: えっと……千和ちゃんと大雅くん。つきあい始めて、おめでとう……？
lines.translated: "Um... You and Chiwa-chan. Congratulations on starting to go out...?"

lines.content: いや。だから違うって
lines.translated: "No, I just told you it's not like that."

lines.content: んー……
首をかしげて考えるような仕草のハル。にこりと笑う。
lines.translated: Haru tilted her head as if in thought, then beamed.

lines.content: でもきっとそうなるよ。うん。きっと
lines.translated: "But I'm sure it'll turn out that way. Yeah. Definitely."

lines.content: どこか晴れ晴れしたような顔でハルは言った。さっきまでの複雑そうな表情は影さえも見えなかった。
lines.translated: Haru said this with an almost radiant look on her face. Not even a shadow of her complicated expression from a moment ago remained.

lines.content: 千和ちゃん、早く帰ってこないかなあ
lines.translated: "I wonder if Chiwa-chan will come back soon."

lines.content: ハルは再びメニューを開く。
lines.translated: Haru opened the menu again.

lines.content: 千和ちゃんに無理矢理恥ずかしい格好をさせたことをちゃんと謝りたい。だけどまだ、直接伝えられていない。
lines.translated: She wanted to properly apologize to Chiwa-chan for forcing her to wear such an embarrassing outfit, though she hadn't been able to tell her in person yet.

lines.content: だから今日はお店に寄ったのだとハルは言っていた。
lines.translated: Haru had said that was why she stopped by the cafe today.

lines.content: 千和が帰ってきたのはお店が終わって、後片付けが済んでから……。
lines.translated: Chiwa didn't get back until after the cafe had closed and I had finished cleaning up...

lines.content: すっかり日が暮れ、夜になった頃だった。
lines.translated: By then, the sun had completely set, and night had fallen.

lines.content: 隣町の水族館へ行ってきたそうだ。お土産をたくさん買ってきてくれた。
lines.translated: Apparently, she had gone to the aquarium in the next town over. She bought a ton of souvenirs for us.

lines.content: 中には『これ、なんだろう……』と首をひねってしまうマスコットのグッズがいくつかあった。お世辞にもかわいいとは言い難い。
lines.translated: Among them were a few mascot goodies that made me tilt my head and wonder, "What even is this...?" Even just to be polite, it would be hard to call them cute.

lines.content: ……だが千和がうれしそうに、楽しそうに、それらのグッズを買い求めている姿がありありと目に浮かぶ。
lines.translated: Still, I could vividly picture Chiwa happily and excitedly picking out those very items.

lines.content: なんというか……。
lines.translated: How should I put it...

lines.content: 千和はちょっと不細工な感じのマスコットが好きなのだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa had a thing for mascots that were a little on the ugly side.

lines.content: 本人は[・|そ][・|れ]を本気でかわいいと感じているのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Though she herself probably found *that* genuinely cute...

lines.content: ともかく今日一日、お父さんと色々なことをして遊んできたらしい。
lines.translated: In any case, it seemed she had spent the whole day doing all sorts of fun things with her dad.

lines.content: お土産話も大いに花咲くことだろう――……だと、いうのに。
lines.translated: No doubt she had plenty of stories to tell about the trip--...or so you would think, and yet.

lines.content: ……どうして俺は、あなたと向かい合って座ってるんでしょうか
lines.translated: "...Why am I sitting here face-to-face with you?"

lines.content: お客さんの帰った店内フロア。
lines.translated: Out on the cafe floor, after all the customers had gone home.

lines.content: テーブルを挟んだ客席に座り、俺は千和の[・|お][・|父][・|さ][・|ん]と顔をつきあわせていた。
lines.translated: Sitting in the customer seating across a table, I was face-to-face with Chiwa's *father*.

lines.content: はは。そう邪険にしなくてもいいじゃないか。大雅くん。千和がお夕飯を作ってくれてる間だけでいいんだ。少し、話そう
lines.translated: "Haha. No need to be so cold, Taiga-kun. Just while Chiwa is making dinner for us is fine. Let's have a little chat."

lines.content: 千和のお父さん。[あんどうかずま|杏藤一磨]は、俺と向かい合うような形で椅子に座り、柔和な笑顔を見せていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's father, Andou Kazuma, sat in the chair across from me, wearing a gentle smile.

lines.content: 肌は、真っ白。
lines.translated: His skin was pure white.

lines.content: 太陽の光を知らないのかと思えるほど真っ白だ。
lines.translated: So pale it made you wonder if he had ever known the light of the sun.

lines.content: 痩身の高身長で、長く伸びた髪を肩の辺りでひとつにまとめている。
lines.translated: He was tall and slender, with long hair tied back loosely around his shoulders.

lines.content: こうして向かい合うのは[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]以来だ――千和とふたり、肖像画を描いてもらったときいらい。あのときの絵は今どこにあるんだろう。
lines.translated: This was the first time we'd sat across from each other since *back then*--since the time he painted a portrait of Chiwa and me together. I wondered where that painting was now.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながらも、しかし、千和の一日を独占し満足げに帰宅してきたこの人に、俺はやっぱり、若干以上の不満を禁じ得ないわけで……。
lines.translated: Even as that thought crossed my mind, I still couldn't help feeling more than a little dissatisfied with this man, who had monopolized Chiwa for the entire day and come home looking thoroughly pleased with himself...

lines.content: しかも、どうして……
lines.translated: "Not only that, why..."

lines.content: ん？　なんだって？
lines.translated: "Hm? What did you say?"

lines.content: ……はい。どうして、娘とたくさん遊んできて大満足なお父さんの自慢話を延々と聞かされ続けなきゃならないんですか
lines.translated: "...Yes. Why do I have to sit here and listen to a thoroughly satisfied father brag endlessly about how much fun he had hanging out with his daughter?"

lines.content: 水族館で巨大なエイを見つけて目をキラキラさせる千和がかわいかった。
lines.translated: How cute Chiwa was when her eyes lit up after spotting a giant stingray at the aquarium.

lines.content: ペンギンショーでちびっこに混じって拍手する千和が愛おしかった。
lines.translated: How adorable Chiwa was clapping along with the little kids at the penguin show.

lines.content: トンネル型の水槽ではしゃぐ千和の笑顔が忘れられない……等など。
lines.translated: How he could never forget Chiwa's beaming smile as she frolicked in the tunnel tank... and so on and so forth.

lines.content: なあ、それってさ、お父さん。
lines.translated: Hey, listen here, Dad.

lines.content: 全部ぜんぶ……どちらかといえば、俺が千和と一緒にこなすべきイベントなんじゃあないのかな。
lines.translated: Every single one of those... aren't they the kind of events *I* should be doing together with Chiwa instead?

lines.content: 言ったろう？　大雅くん。千和はお夕飯の準備をしてくれてるし……今、暇なのは私しかいないんだよ。悪いけど少し話し相手になってくれないかな
lines.translated: "Didn't I tell you, Taiga-kun? Chiwa is getting dinner ready for us... and right now, I'm the only one with free hands. I hate to ask, but could you keep me company for a bit?"

lines.content: そう邪険にするなよ少年
lines.translated: "Don't be so cold, my boy."

lines.content: 苦笑いで千和のお父さんは言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa's father said with a wry smile.

lines.content: なあ、少しくらい話をしてくれてもいいじゃないか。千和が戻ってくるまでの間だけなんだって。そう長い時間じゃないはずだ。そうだろ
lines.translated: "Come on, it wouldn't hurt to talk with me for a little while, would it? It's only until Chiwa gets back. It shouldn't take that long, right?"

lines.content: ……さいよ
lines.translated: "...let me."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 邪険にくらい、させてくださいよ。だって俺、あなた達が遊んでる最中、働いてたんですよ。それに……
lines.translated: "At least let me be a little cold to you. I mean, while you two were out having fun, I was here working. Besides..."

lines.content: ああ、なんだろう
lines.translated: "Sure, what is it?"

lines.content: ……千和のお父さん。あなたが紛らわしいことさえ、しなければ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa's dad. None of this would have happened if you hadn't made things so confusing in the first place."
Before I knew it, that bitter complaint had slipped from my mouth--...*It happened yesterday, right after all of that went down.*
"Senpai...?"

lines.content: 教師たちの追従を振り切り、千和の立つ校庭まで辿り着いたところで（いや、まあ、千和のところに辿り着いたときにはほとんど取り押さえられていたのだけど）、
lines.translated: Just as I shook off the pursuing teachers and made it to the schoolyard where Chiwa was standing (well, to be fair, by the time I reached her, they had practically pinned me down anyway),

lines.content: 『あの。ところで、先輩……』
lines.translated: "Um, by the way, Senpai..."

lines.content: 『転校って、どういうことですか……？』
lines.translated: "What do you mean by 'transferring schools'...?"

lines.content: 千和がきょとんとしながらそう言ったのだった。
lines.translated: Chiwa had asked that with a blank, bewildered look on her face.

lines.content: だから俺たちは、どこか遠くへと逃げ出すはずだった足先を、駅ではなくて千和の家へと向けたのだった。
lines.translated: And so, instead of heading for the train station to run away somewhere far off like I had planned, we turned our steps toward Chiwa's house.

lines.content: 『お父さん、どういうこと？　私、転校なんて……聞いてないよ？』
lines.translated: "Dad, what is this about? Transferring schools... I haven't heard anything about that!"

lines.content: 『ああ……いや。えっと』
lines.translated: "Ah... well. Um."

lines.content: 『私が行かなきゃいけないのは、隣町の喫茶店だったはずよね……？』
lines.translated: "The place I had to go to was supposed to be a cafe in the next town over, right...?"

lines.content: 『う、うん。そうだね。その通り、だね』
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. That's right. Exactly right."

lines.content: 千和がお父さんから受け取っていた説明は――
lines.translated: The explanation Chiwa had been given by her father was--

lines.content: 先日の犬耳付きの制服姿での接客が、千和のそんなかわいい姿が、一部の客層に大受けだったという。
lines.translated: Apparently, her waiting tables in that uniform with the dog ears the other day--that adorable look of hers--had been a massive hit with a certain subset of customers.

lines.content: そのため隣町にあるというメイド喫茶で[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|方][・|向][・|性][・|を]研修してきてほしいということだった。既に先方には連絡を入れてあり、許可は得ている。
lines.translated: Because of that, he wanted her to go train in *that kind of approach* at a maid cafe in the next town over. He had already contacted them and gotten their permission.

lines.content: 学園を休んだ本日と週末とを入れてみっちり三日。色々と教えてもらえる。かわいい仕草。かわいい言葉遣い。かわいい気配り。その他諸々。
lines.translated: Three full days of intensive training, counting today--which she took off from school--and the weekend. They would teach her all sorts of things: cute gestures, cute ways of speaking, cute attentiveness, and everything else.

lines.content: その間お店は休業だ。
lines.translated: Our cafe would be closed in the meantime,

lines.content: 研修を終えた千和の帰りを待っている。
lines.translated: waiting for Chiwa to return from her training.

lines.content: ……そういう説明を受けたのだという。
lines.translated: That was the explanation she had been given, apparently.

lines.content: 『……いやだった』
lines.translated: "...I hated it."
Chiwa squeezed *my hand, which she was still holding,* tightly.

lines.content: 『……すっごく、すっごく、いやだったんだよ……お父さん。それにとっても怖かった。だから、行きたくなかった。研修なんて、したくなかったんだよ……それなのに』
lines.translated: "...I really, really hated the idea... Dad. And I was so scared. That's why I didn't want to go. I didn't want to do any training... And yet..."

lines.content: ぐすりと千和は鼻を啜り、
lines.translated: Chiwa sniffled,

lines.content: 『それって全部、うそだったの……？』
lines.translated: "Was all of that a lie...?"

lines.content: 『いや。まあ……その……うん。そういうことになる……かな？』
lines.translated: "No, well... um... yeah. I suppose... it comes down to that?"

lines.content: 『ひどいよ、お父さん』
lines.translated: "That's awful, Dad."

lines.content: 『お父さんが、どうしてもって……どうしてもお願いって……土下座まで、するんだもん……』
lines.translated: "You insisted no matter what... begging me please... and you even got down on your hands and knees..."

lines.content: 『お願いだから、もう一度だけかわいい格好してほしいって……そんなの……断れないよ。なのにうそだったなんて、そんなの……ひどい』
lines.translated: "You begged me to dress up in something cute just one more time... How was I supposed to say no to that? Finding out it was a lie... that's just awful."

lines.content: 『うわあ』
lines.translated: "Whoa."

lines.content: 格好悪っ――
lines.translated: *How lame--*

lines.content: とは、口にしなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't say that part out loud back then.

lines.content: けれど。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: ――格好悪っ
lines.translated: "--How lame."

lines.content: 一日分の時を超え、言葉が追いついてきた。
lines.translated: Crossing the span of a full day, the words finally caught up and slipped out.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: きょとんとする千和のお父さんに、『いえ。ごめんなさい、何でもないです。独り言です』と首を振り、言った。
lines.translated: To a bewildered-looking Kazuma, I shook my head and said, "No, I'm sorry, it's nothing. Just talking to myself."

lines.content: ただ、こう思っただけです
lines.translated: "It's just, I couldn't help thinking this."

lines.content: あ、ああ……。大雅くんは何を、どう、思ったのかな
lines.translated: "Ah, right... And what, or how, were you thinking, Taiga-kun?"

lines.content: はい……
とりあえず意識を、視線を、今現在に戻し――俺は言う。
lines.translated: Bringing my thoughts and my gaze back to the present for the time being--I spoke up.

lines.content: 千和のお父さん。あなたは、自分の部屋からあまり外には出られないと……千和からは聞いていたんですけど。身体が少し悪いからって
lines.translated: "Chiwa's dad. I heard from Chiwa... that you can't really leave your room much. Because your health isn't very good."

lines.content: だから日頃、お店の手伝いもまともにできず……。
lines.translated: Which was why, on a daily basis, he couldn't properly help out with the cafe...

lines.content: 一番忙しくなる時間帯。学園の生徒らの放課後には、娘の千和にお店を任せっきりで……。
lines.translated: And during the busiest hours of the day, after school let out for the academy students, he left the cafe entirely up to his daughter, Chiwa...

lines.content: それなのに、平気な顔して娘と一緒にお出かけなんて。
lines.translated: Yet despite all that, he went out on a trip with his daughter like it was nothing.

lines.content: そしてその自慢話を得意そうな顔して延々、長々、語ろうだなんて……。
lines.translated: And then, to go on and on bragging about it with such a smug look on his face...

lines.content: 不満くらい。“なんだよ、それ……”という愚痴くらい、心に芽生えてだって来る。
lines.translated: Anyone would feel at least a little dissatisfied. A complaint like "Come on, what is that..." was bound to sprout in my heart.

lines.content: こっちとしては、ちょっとだけでも邪険にくらい扱いたい気分にはなりますよ
lines.translated: "From where I'm sitting, it makes me want to give you the cold shoulder, if only a little bit."

lines.content: あー……それは……まあ、うん
lines.translated: "Ah... well... yeah, I suppose so."

lines.content: よわったな、どう説明すべきかな、という具合に頭をがりがりと掻く。
lines.translated: He scratched his head furiously, looking troubled over how he ought to explain himself.

lines.content: それだけ、心配だったんだ。確かめてみたかったんだ。そして、安心したかった――と、いうのでは理由にならないかな？
lines.translated: "Would it count as a reason if I told you I was just that worried? That I wanted to make sure for myself... and that I wanted to put my mind at ease?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺は首をかしげる。
lines.translated: I tilted my head.

lines.content: ありがとう大雅くん。時間をくれて、ありがとう。安心したよ
lines.translated: "Thank you, Taiga-kun. Thank you for giving me this time. You've put my mind at ease."

lines.content: にっこりと微笑む千和のお父さんだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa's father offered a warm smile.

lines.content: 安心、ですか……？
lines.translated: "Put your mind at ease...?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 今日一日、千和とふたりっきりで色々……じっくり話して、千和にとって君がどんな存在なのかということを、肌で感じられることを期待していたんだよ
lines.translated: "Spending the whole day alone with Chiwa today, talking at length about all sorts of things... I was hoping to get a firsthand sense of what kind of person you are to her."

lines.content: 今日は、そのための一日だった。
lines.translated: "That's what today was for."

lines.content: そして、結果――……
lines.translated: "And as a result--"

lines.content: ……千和にいい人ができたみたいで、よかった。本当に。安心できたよ
lines.translated: "...I'm glad it seems Chiwa has found someone good. Truly. It's a real relief."

lines.content: きっとこの先、千和が何か困ったことに巻き込まれてしまったとしても、君が、君という男の子がそばにいてくれるのなら……うん
lines.translated: "I'm sure that even if Chiwa gets caught up in some kind of trouble down the road, as long as you--a boy like you--are by her side... yeah."

lines.content: 少なくとも全力であの子のことを、千和のことを助けようとしてくれる。結果はどうあれ。千和を全力で守ろうとはしてくれるはずだ
lines.translated: "At the very least, you'll do everything in your power to help that girl, to help Chiwa. Whatever the outcome, I know you'll give it your all to protect her."

lines.content: そう確信を持てたから……いいんだ。君がいい。少なくとも私は、君という人間に不安はないよ
lines.translated: "Now that I can be certain of that... I'm satisfied. I'm glad it's you. At the very least, I have no doubts about the kind of person you are."

lines.content: 千和がお父さんにどのようにして俺のことを話してくれたのかは、わからない。
lines.translated: I didn't know how Chiwa had talked about me to her father.

lines.content: だがそこにはだいぶ脚色というか、美化された何かが介入していそうで――俺はむずがゆい思いがしてしまう。
lines.translated: Still, it sounded like quite a bit of embellishment--or rather, idealization--had crept into her version of events, leaving me feeling squirmy and embarrassed.

lines.content: ……夢だったんだよ
lines.translated: "...It was a dream of mine."

lines.content: え？　夢？
lines.translated: "Huh? A dream?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: かわいい娘とお出かけすることが、ですか……？
lines.translated: "You mean going on an outing with your cute daughter...?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。まあそれもないわけじゃないけど……違うな。私の夢はそれだけじゃない
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Well, it's not that that wasn't part of it, either... but no. That wasn't my only dream."

lines.content: テーブルに片肘を立て、そこにあごを乗せる。そしてにこりと微笑み、『君だよ』と千和のお父さんは言う。
lines.translated: He propped an elbow on the table and rested his chin in his hand. Then, with a gentle smile, Chiwa's father said, "It's you."

lines.content: ……娘の好きな子と娘をかけて言い争ってみたり。その後にお酒でも一緒に飲んで語り合ってみたり
lines.translated: "...Getting into an argument with the boy my daughter likes, with her on the line. And then sharing a drink together afterward and having a heart-to-heart."

lines.content: いや。うん。君とは喧嘩をするほどの仲にはなり得なかったけれど……
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. You and I didn't quite end up on terms where we'd get into a fight, though..."

lines.content: それがほんの少し、さみしくはあるけれど……と、千和のお父さんは言い、苦笑い。
lines.translated: "Which makes me just a little bit lonely..." Chiwa's father added with a wry smile.

lines.content: ああ、そうだね。時には喧々囂々と言い争うこともいい。殴り合うこともあるかもな。そういうのが夢だったんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Sometimes it's good to have a loud, heated argument. Maybe even trade a few punches. That sort of thing was my dream."

lines.content: 千和と暮らして……あの子がどんどん大人になっていくその中で、ふとさ、そんな未来を想像して……ああ、いいなあってさ、憧れてたんだよ
lines.translated: "Living with Chiwa... watching that girl grow up more and more into an adult, I'd find myself imagining a future like that out of nowhere... thinking, 'Man, wouldn't that be nice,' and longing for it."

lines.content: 千和のお父さんは照れくさそうにする。
lines.translated: Chiwa's father looked a bit sheepish.

lines.content: 当たり前すぎるだろ？　大人の抱く夢なんてそんなものさ
lines.translated: "Pretty ordinary, right? The dreams adults hold on to are all like that."

lines.content: 若い君にはまだ実感は乏しいかもしれないけれど、歳を重ねて大きくなる度に夢は小さく、当たり前なものになっていくものだ。それがふつうだ
lines.translated: "It might be hard for someone as young as you to really feel it yet, but the older you get and the more years you put behind you, the smaller and more ordinary your dreams become. That's just normal."

lines.content: ……でも、まあ、“ふつう”で当たり前なことが正解だというわけじゃない。“ふつう”なことほどつまらないし、下らないことはないんだよ
lines.translated: "...Still, well, just because something is 'normal' and ordinary doesn't mean it's the right answer. There's nothing more boring and pointless than being 'normal.'"

lines.content: 世の大人たちは誤解してる。千和のお父さんはそう言った。
lines.translated: "The adults of the world have got it wrong," Chiwa's father said.

lines.content: 大人はさ、“ふつう”になれれば安泰だと信じてる者ばっかりだ。だけど……“ふつう”であることはさ、たいていつらいことばかりなんだよ。そこを勘違いしてるんだ
lines.translated: "Adults are all convinced that as long as you can become 'normal,' you're set for life. But... being 'normal' is mostly just full of hardship. That's where they're mistaken."

lines.content: だから少年、大人の言うことばかり鵜呑みにするなよ、と千和のお父さんは言う。いつだって自分の尺度で物事を計るんだ、とも。
lines.translated: "So, my boy, don't just swallow everything adults tell you whole," Chiwa's father said. "Always measure things by your own standards."

lines.content: もしそのときの選択が間違っていると気づけばその都度修正していけばそれでいい。たったそれだけのことで人生なんてたいてい上手くいくんじゃないかな……なんて
lines.translated: "If you realize a choice you made at the time was wrong, all you have to do is correct course as you go. I figure life mostly works out fine with just that much... or something like that."

lines.content: ……いや。ごめんな。と千和のお父さんは苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: "...No, I'm sorry," Chiwa's father said, a wry smile rising to his face.

lines.content: 歳を取ると説教臭くもなる。しかもさ、その説教がまたどうしようもない。当たり前のことをさもそれ以外正解のない真理だとばかりに語りたがってしまう
lines.translated: "You get preachy when you get old. And what's worse, the preaching itself is hopeless. You start wanting to talk about obvious things as if they're the one and only absolute truth."

lines.content: まったく、いけないな。そういうところは若い子たちに嫌われる。私も若い頃はそうだったしな
lines.translated: "Good grief, that's no good. That's the kind of thing that makes young people hate you. I was the same way when I was young, after all."

lines.content: ……やれやれだ。自分が嫌っていた大人と同じようなことをするなんて
lines.translated: "...Oh, boy. To think I'd end up doing the exact same thing as the adults I used to hate."

lines.content: 本当に私は歳を取ってしまったんだなあと、千和のお父さんは笑っていた。
lines.translated: "I really have gotten old, haven't I?" Chiwa's father laughed.

lines.content: あ、ああ……。ごめんな。大雅くん
lines.translated: "Ah, right... I'm sorry, Taiga-kun."

lines.content: 私が君にこんなことを言うのもおかしいのはわかってるけど……あまり嫌ってもらはないでいてくれるとうれしい
lines.translated: "I know it's strange for me to say something like this to you, but... I'd be happy if you didn't hate me too much."

lines.content: 大人は説教好きだけど、何より君らに嫌われることが怖いんだよと、千和のお父さんは苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: "Adults love to preach, you see, but more than anything, they're terrified of being hated by kids your age," Chiwa's father said with a wry smile.

lines.content: そんな千和のお父さんを前に、俺はため息をつく。
lines.translated: Facing Chiwa's father like that, I let out a sigh.

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 少し堅くなってしまっていた肩の力を抜き、笑顔を浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: I let the tension drain from my slightly stiff shoulders, put on a smile, and spoke.

lines.content: ……俺、お酒、飲めませんよ？
lines.translated: "...I can't drink alcohol, you know?"

lines.content: そんな俺の対応が意外だったのか……。
lines.translated: Maybe my response had caught him off guard...

lines.content: 少しの間、目を丸くしていた千和のお父さんだったけれど、
lines.translated: For a brief moment, Chiwa's father's eyes went wide,

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ふと柔らかく微笑んで、『そうか』と言った。
lines.translated: before he suddenly smiled softly and said, "Is that so?"

lines.content: ……奇遇だな。私もだよ
lines.translated: "...What a coincidence. Neither can I."

lines.content: 何ですかそれと俺は笑う。
lines.translated: "What's with that?" I laughed.

lines.content: できないことができたらいいなあと願うのが夢だろう？　と千和のお父さんも笑った。
lines.translated: "Wishing you could do the things you can't do is what a dream is, right?" Chiwa's father laughed back.

lines.content: ふたりで何話してるの？
lines.translated: "What are you two talking about?"

lines.content: 千和が厨房から料理を持ってやって来た。
lines.translated: Chiwa came over from the kitchen carrying the food.

lines.content: ……なんだか楽しそうな声、してたよ？
lines.translated: "...You sounded like you were having fun?"

lines.content: 千和がお父さんにそう言った。お夕飯のお皿をテーブルに並べながら。
lines.translated: Chiwa said that to her father as she set the dinner plates out on the table.

lines.content: 大雅くんと、私。どちらが千和のことが好きなのかって話だよ
lines.translated: "We were talking about which one of us likes you more--Taiga-kun or me."

lines.content: ……な、何それ
lines.translated: "...Wh-What is that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: 真っ赤になった。
lines.translated: She turned bright red.

lines.content: 俺のほうは見ないまま配膳を終える。
lines.translated: She finished setting the table without looking my way.

lines.content: 急遽仕事に出てもらったことのお礼にとお呼ばれしたお夕飯。
lines.translated: Dinner, which I'd been invited to as thanks for coming in to work on such short notice.

lines.content: イカスミのパスタだった。すごい。家庭でできる料理なのか。知らなかった。実ははじめて食べるかもしれない。
lines.translated: It was squid ink pasta. Amazing. Was this the kind of dish you could make at home? I had no idea. In fact, this might be my first time eating it.

lines.content: それに、なんて言うか。
lines.translated: Besides, how should I put it...

lines.content: 水族館帰りで海の生き物をいただくというのも……ちょっと[・|あ][・|れ]な気がしないでもないけれど。
lines.translated: Eating sea creatures right after coming back from an aquarium felt... just a little bit *iffy*, I couldn't help thinking.

lines.content: まあ、むろん俺は水族館で遊んでいたほうではなく働いていた側だ。そのような躊躇いは感じることなく美味しくいただけそうだ。
lines.translated: Well, of course, I wasn't the one who had been visiting the aquarium for fun; I was on the side working back home. So I'd probably be able to enjoy the meal without any of that hesitation.

lines.content: ……それで？
千和がテーブルを前に立ったまま、言う。
lines.translated: Standing in front of the table, Chiwa spoke up.

lines.content: それで……どっちに、なったの？
lines.translated: "So... which one did you decide on?"

lines.content: お夕飯のお皿を運んだお盆。それで顔を半分隠しながら千和はそう言った。
lines.translated: Hiding half her face behind the tray she'd used to carry the dinner plates, Chiwa asked the question.

lines.content: ど、どっちが……その……私のこと、好きだってことに……なったの？
lines.translated: "Wh-Which one of you... um... did you decide likes me more?"

lines.content: そ、それは……
lines.translated: "Th-That's..."

lines.content: 少し戸惑ってしまう。不覚だ。
lines.translated: I faltered a little. Careless of me.

lines.content: もうおどおどうじうじする俺とは“さよなら”するんだと決めたはずだったのに。
lines.translated: Even though I was supposed to have made up my mind to say goodbye to the timid, wishy-washy version of myself.

lines.content: そんな俺に対して千和のお父さんがにやりとする。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, Chiwa's father grinned.

lines.content: 私に決まってるだろう？　私は千和のお父さんだぞ？　ぽっと出の男の子に負けるはずがない
lines.translated: "Obviously it's me, isn't it? I'm Chiwa's father, you know? There's no way I'd lose to some boy who just showed up out of nowhere."

lines.content: 違う
lines.translated: "No, you're wrong."

lines.content: 思わず、前のめりに。
lines.translated: Without thinking, I leaned forward.

lines.content: 俺のほうが、千和が……好きだ
lines.translated: "I'm the one who... likes Chiwa more."

lines.content: と、言った後に気づく――まあ、はめられたんだなあ、と。
lines.translated: Right after saying it, I realized--well, I'd been played right into his hands.

lines.content: にやにやしている千和のお父さんの表情が雄弁にそう語っていたし。
lines.translated: The smug grin on Chiwa's father's face spoke volumes to that effect, too.

lines.content: へ、へえ……。そう、ですか……、でも、もう先輩には騙されないんですから
lines.translated: "O-Oh... Is that... so... Well, you're not going to trick me anymore, Senpai."

lines.content: つんとしてそう言う千和だったけど、そのまま俺の隣の席に腰を下ろした。お父さんの隣の席ではなくて。
lines.translated: Chiwa said it with a prim little huff, yet she went right ahead and sat down in the seat next to mine. Not the one next to her father.

lines.content: その距離が少し近いような気がするけれど……。
lines.translated: I couldn't help feeling like she was sitting a little close, though...

lines.content: は、早く食べないと冷めちゃいますよ
lines.translated: "I-If you don't hurry up and eat, it's going to get cold."

lines.content: ああ、うん。いただきます
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. Thanks for the food."

lines.content: ……今夜の料理、上手にできたと思うんですけど……どうですか？
lines.translated: "...I think dinner turned out really well tonight, though... How is it?"

lines.content: うん。イカスミパスタとかはじめて食べたけど……すごい、美味しいよ。千和、料理上手いんだなあ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's my first time eating squid ink pasta or anything like it, and... it's amazing, really delicious. You're a great cook, Chiwa."

lines.content: 息が掛かるくらいの近い距離で笑い合う。
lines.translated: We smiled at each other, close enough to feel each other's breath.

lines.content: そんな俺たちの様子を、千和のお父さんはどこか安心したような目で見ていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's father watched the two of us with something like relief in his eyes.

lines.content: ……ごめんな。千和。思い出はこれで、充分だよ
lines.translated: "...Sorry, Chiwa. This is more than enough memories for me."

lines.content: ……お父さん、泣いてたんです
lines.translated: "...My dad was crying."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: お夕飯の後、少し話があるからと呼ばれた千和の部屋。
lines.translated: After dinner, Chiwa had called me into her room, saying she had something to talk to me about.

lines.content: なんだろう。変な期待がなかったとは言えないけれど……まさかこのような話になるとは思わなかった。
lines.translated: What could it be? I couldn't say I didn't have any weird expectations, per se... but I never imagined the conversation would take this kind of turn.

lines.content: 千和のお父さんが、泣いていた？
lines.translated: Chiwa's father had been crying?

lines.content: 一ヶ月くらい前の夜だったと思います
lines.translated: "I think it was a night about a month ago."

lines.content: 夜中に目が覚めてしまった。
lines.translated: She had woken up in the middle of the night.

lines.content: ふとこの時間、お父さんは何をしてるのかな――お店の準備を夜の間にしてくれてるみたいだけど、眠れないから手伝おうかな。
lines.translated: She found herself wondering what her father was doing at that hour--it seemed he did the prep work for the shop during the night, and since she couldn't sleep, she thought she might help him out.

lines.content: そう思いお父さんの部屋を訪れた。
lines.translated: Thinking that, she went to visit her father's room.

lines.content: 扉が薄く開いていた。別に盗み見るつもりじゃなかった。だけどその薄い光の向こうで……お父さんが泣いていたのだという。
lines.translated: The door was cracked open slightly. She hadn't meant to peek inside. Yet beyond that thin sliver of light... her father was crying, she said.

lines.content: 部屋で、ひとり……。
lines.translated: Alone in his room...

lines.content: 背中を丸め、嗚咽を漏らす。
lines.translated: With his back hunched over, letting out muffled sobs.

lines.content: 声を殺して泣いている。
lines.translated: Stifling his voice as he wept.

lines.content: ……私、声をかけられなかった。お父さんの泣いてるところなんてはじめて見たから……怖かったのかもしれないです
lines.translated: "...I couldn't bring myself to call out to him. It was the first time I'd ever seen my dad cry... so maybe I was just scared."

lines.content: だからそのままそっとお父さんの部屋から離れた。
lines.translated: So she quietly stepped away from her father's room just like that.

lines.content: 忘れなきゃいけないと思ったんです。私が見てたことを知ったら、お父さん、傷つくんじゃないかって……
lines.translated: "I thought I had to forget about it. I was afraid that if my dad found out I'd seen him, it would hurt him..."

lines.content: だけど次の日、お父さん……いつもみたいに笑顔で私におはようって言ってくれて……
lines.translated: "Even so, the next day, my dad... he said good morning to me with a smile, just like always..."

lines.content: だけど千和にはすぐにわかったという。
lines.translated: Yet Chiwa said she could tell right away.

lines.content: お父さん、元気がありませんでした。いつもと変わらない笑顔だったけど……。お父さんの元気がないのはその日からずっと続いていたんです
lines.translated: "My dad seemed really down. His smile looked the same as always, though... He stayed like that ever since that day."

lines.content: 心配だった。
lines.translated: She was worried.

lines.content: 自分に何かできることはないかと探してた。だからそんなお父さんから一緒に出かけようとお願いされて……うれしかった。
lines.translated: She had been looking for something she could do for him. So when her father asked her to go out together like that... she was happy.

lines.content: 元気のないお父さん。大好きな、お父さん。
lines.translated: Her father, who had been feeling down. The father she loved so much.

lines.content: 私とお出かけして、それで少しでも元気になってくれたら……。
lines.translated: If going out with her could cheer him up even a little bit...

lines.content: そう思っての今日だったけれど……。
lines.translated: That was what she had been hoping for today, and yet...

lines.content: お父さん。すっかり元気みたいです。たぶん先輩のおかげですね
lines.translated: "My dad seems completely back to normal now. I think it's probably thanks to you, Senpai."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: いきなりそう言われ、驚く。
lines.translated: Having her tell me that out of nowhere caught me by surprise.

lines.content: 俺の？
lines.translated: "Thanks to me?"

lines.content: はい。男親は息子がほしいって願うことが多いみたいですよ。何かでそう読みました
lines.translated: "Yes. It seems fathers often wish they had a son. I read that somewhere."

lines.content: 将来、一緒に何かできることを想像するのが楽しいみたいです
lines.translated: "Apparently, they enjoy imagining the things they'll be able to do together in the future."

lines.content: キャッチボールとか、お酒を一緒に飲んでみたりとか、ときには喧嘩をしてみたりとか――
lines.translated: Like playing catch, having a drink together, or even getting into fights sometimes--

lines.content: だから先輩と話しているの、お父さん、楽しいんじゃないかなあって思います。たぶんですけど
lines.translated: "So I think my dad really enjoys talking with you, Senpai. Probably, anyway."

lines.content: 今日は本当にありがとうございますと千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa thanked me sincerely for today.

lines.content: お仕事を急遽手伝ってくれて……。
lines.translated: For helping out with the shop on such short notice...

lines.content: それだけじゃなくて、お夕飯の前、お父さんの話し相手になってくれてありがとうございます。
lines.translated: And not just that, for keeping her father company and talking with him before dinner.

lines.content: 千和はそう言う。
lines.translated: That was what Chiwa told me.

lines.content: 私とお出かけしたことよりも、きっと先輩と笑顔でお話しできるようになったことのほうがうれしいんじゃないかなあって……そんなことを思ってしまいます
lines.translated: "I can't help thinking that... being able to smile and talk with you probably made him even happier than going out with me today..."

lines.content: にっこりと笑う千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa gave a bright smile.

lines.content: そこで沈黙してしまった俺は、少し眉根を寄せていた。渋い顔だ。
lines.translated: Falling silent at that, I furrowed my brow slightly, wearing a sour expression.

lines.content: 先輩？
lines.translated: "Senpai?"

lines.content: 首をかしげる千和に俺は言う。
lines.translated: As Chiwa tilted her head in confusion, I spoke up.

lines.content: ……あのさ、千和
lines.translated: "...Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: 千和はさ、お父さんと話すときはすごい距離が近い感じで話すよね。すごく、仲良しに見えるよ
lines.translated: "When you talk to your dad, you speak so casually, like there's no distance between you two at all. You look really close."

lines.content: それは……自分のお父さんに敬語で話すなんて少し変ですもん。そうですよね？
lines.translated: "Well, that's... Speaking formally to my own father would be a little weird, after all. Right?"

lines.content: そうかな
lines.translated: "You think so?"

lines.content: ……たぶん
lines.translated: "...Probably."

lines.content: 負けてる気がする
lines.translated: "I feel like I'm losing to him."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: もう、俺さ、うじうじぐずぐず考えてばかりの自分とは決別した。だけど、嫉妬はする
lines.translated: "I've already said goodbye to the wishy-washy version of myself who just mopes around overthinking things. Even so, I still get jealous."

lines.content: え？　な、何言ってるのかわかりませんよ、先輩。……嫉妬って
lines.translated: "Huh? I-I don't know what you're talking about, Senpai. ...Jealous?"

lines.content: 俺にもいつかあんな感じで話してくれることは……
lines.translated: "Will you ever talk to me casually like that someday...?"

lines.content: そ、それは
lines.translated: "Th-That's..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……いつか
lines.translated: "...Someday."

lines.content: 千和はうつむく。そして尖らせた唇をもにょもにょとさせながら、
lines.translated: Chiwa looked down. Then, pouting and fidgeting with her lips, she continued.

lines.content: ……いつか、そうしてもいいかなあって、思えたら
lines.translated: "...Someday, if I start feeling like it's okay to do that..."

lines.content: 赤くなり、もじもじともしていた。
lines.translated: Blushing red, she squirmed shyly.

lines.content: 今はそれで充分だ。
lines.translated: For now, that was plenty.

lines.content: だって俺も、千和にまだはっきりとした気持ちを伝えていない――そんなあまりに半端な状況なのだから。
lines.translated: Because I still hadn't clearly conveyed my own feelings to Chiwa yet--leaving things in such a half-hearted state between us.

lines.content: ところで、千和。今度の週末に行くデートの話だけど
lines.translated: "By the way, Chiwa. About our date this coming weekend..."

lines.content: は、はい……
lines.translated: "Y-Yes..."

lines.content: “デート……”と、千和は小さくつぶやく。
lines.translated: "'Date...'" Chiwa murmured softly to herself.

lines.content: その声はうれしそうなものに聞こえた。
lines.translated: Her voice sounded happy.

lines.content: あまりそこを意識すると恥ずかしくなる。だからできるだけ意識しないようにと努め、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Thinking about it too much made me feel embarrassed. Doing my best not to dwell on it, I spoke up.

lines.content: 今日、お父さんと出かけた水族館よりも楽しい思い出を作ってみせるよ。約束だ。うん。もう誓うと言ってもいい
lines.translated: "I'll make sure we create even more fun memories than you had at the aquarium with your dad today. It's a promise. Yeah. You could even call it an oath."

lines.content: えー……
千和は意地悪そうな顔をする。
lines.translated: Chiwa gave me a teasing look.

lines.content: 先輩が張り切るとなんだか怖いです。嫌な予感がしますよ
lines.translated: "It's kind of scary when you get this enthusiastic, Senpai. I have a bad feeling about this."

lines.content: いや、大丈夫。もう意地悪はしないよ？
lines.translated: "No, it'll be fine. I won't be mean to you anymore, okay?"

lines.content: ……は、はい
lines.translated: "...O-Okay."

lines.content: ただ例のメイド喫茶で働く千和のかわいい姿を想像、いや、妄想するくらいのことは許されるじゃないかと……猫耳だ。今度は犬じゃなくて猫のほうほ試して――
lines.translated: "Though I figure I should at least be allowed to imagine--no, fantasize about how cute you'd look working at that maid cafe... Cat ears. Next time, instead of dog ears, try the cat ones--"

lines.content: いやです
lines.translated: "No thank you."

lines.content: 目を細めた。
lines.translated: She narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: 意地悪な先輩と同じくらい、変態な先輩もきらいです
lines.translated: "I hate Pervy Senpai just as much as I hate Mean Senpai."

lines.content: そっぽを向いてしまった千和に、俺は言う。
lines.translated: As Chiwa turned her head away in a huff, I spoke to her.

lines.content: ……お父さんのことだけど
lines.translated: "...About your dad."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: きっと、俺たちが笑顔で、仲良くしてればあの人も……千和のお父さんも、もっと元気になるんじゃないかな。そんなふうに思ってみても、まあ、悪くはないんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "I'm sure that if the two of us are smiling and getting along, he... your dad will cheer up even more, too. Thinking about it that way isn't so bad, right?"
So let's use *the tickets we got from your dad* to have as much fun as we can this weekend, I told her.

lines.content: 今までのごたごたのお詫びなのだと言って、ふたり分のテーマパークのチケットをくれたのだった。
lines.translated: Saying it was an apology for all the trouble up until now, he had given us two tickets to a theme park.

lines.content: ……ああ、もうこんな時間か
lines.translated: "...Man, is it this late already?"

lines.content: そろそろ日付が変わる頃だ。
lines.translated: It was just about midnight.

lines.content: 長居しすぎた。
lines.translated: I'd overstayed my welcome.

lines.content: 千和と夜通し話してはいたいけど、そういうわけにもいかない。
lines.translated: As much as I wanted to stay up all night talking with Chiwa, I couldn't do that.

lines.content: あさひさんにもうすぐ帰りますと連絡を入れてしまったし、そもそも[・|ま][・|だ]そういうのは千和のお父さんが許さないだろう。まだまだ、俺たちはそういう関係性にはない。
lines.translated: I had already texted Asahi-san to let her know I'd be heading home soon, and besides, Chiwa's father wouldn't allow that sort of thing *yet*. We still weren't in that kind of relationship.

lines.content: それじゃ、また明日。お店の手伝いに来るよ。時間はいっぱいあるからね。何せ停学処分だ。まさに時間だけは有り余ってるって感じだよ
lines.translated: "Well, see you tomorrow. I'll come by to help with the shop again. I've got plenty of time on my hands, after all. Since I'm suspended and all. Time is the one thing I've got to spare."

lines.content: おどけるように言う俺に、微笑む千和だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa smiled at my joking tone.

lines.content: はい。おやすみなさい、先輩……あ、でも、学園は休みだけど、課題は出てますよね？
lines.translated: "Okay. Goodnight, Senpai... Ah, wait. Even if you're off from school, you still have homework assigned, right?"

lines.content: ……出てたっけ
lines.translated: "...Did I?"

lines.content: 出てましたよ。先輩は反省文もあるんじゃないですか？
lines.translated: "You did. And don't you have to write a letter of reflection too, Senpai?"

lines.content: あった……かもね
lines.translated: "I might... have one of those, yeah."

lines.content: 先輩、すっごい嫌そうな顔ですよ
lines.translated: "You're making a super sour face right now, Senpai."

lines.content: くすくすと千和が笑う。
lines.translated: Chiwa giggled.

lines.content: 私も課題出てるので……一緒にやりましょう？　ふたりでがんばればきっとすぐ終わりますよ
lines.translated: "I have homework assigned too, so... why don't we do it together? If we both work hard at it, I'm sure we'll finish in no time."

lines.content: うーん。明日も千和の美味しいお夕飯、期待してもいいのかな。そしたら仕事も課題もがんばれる……気がする
lines.translated: "Hmm. Can I look forward to another one of your delicious dinners tomorrow, Chiwa? If so, I feel like... I could power through both work and homework."

lines.content: ……はい。リクエストがあれば、がんばりますよ？
lines.translated: "...Yes. If you have any requests, I'll do my best to make them, okay?"

lines.content: おお、やった
lines.translated: "Ooh, awesome."

lines.content: 男の人は……まずお腹から……胃袋から掴むものだって……何かで読みましたし
lines.translated: "Besides, I read somewhere that... the way to a man's heart... is through his stomach..."

lines.content: お、おおう……
lines.translated: "O-Oh, right..."

lines.content: なんだか千和の顔が見れなかった。きっと、互いに顔が赤いとわかったからだ。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't look Chiwa in the eye. Probably because I knew both of our faces were bright red.

lines.content: ……待っていてもいいですか。先輩
lines.translated: "...Is it okay if I keep waiting, Senpai?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 部屋を出ようとした背中に声をかけられ、振り返る。
lines.translated: Called out to from behind just as I was about to leave the room, I turned around.

lines.content: 私……先輩に、告白しました
lines.translated: "I... confessed my feelings to you, Senpai."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: でも、あのときは振られたんだと思ったんです。まじめに応えてももらえないくらい……先輩は私のことなんて、なんとも思ってないんだって
lines.translated: "Back then, I thought I'd been rejected. That you didn't even care enough about me... to give me a serious answer."

lines.content: ……だけど、あのときの先輩は、私に意地悪な先輩だったから……だから、その
lines.translated: "...Even so, back then, you were being Mean Senpai to me... So, um..."

lines.content: ぎゅっと目を閉じ、千和が言う。
lines.translated: Squeezing her eyes shut, Chiwa spoke.

lines.content: わ、私に意地悪しない、私にやさしい先輩のお返事を、もらえるの……私、待っていても、いいですか……？
lines.translated: "Is it... okay if I wait... to hear the answer from the Senpai who isn't mean to me, the Senpai who is kind to me...?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: ……必ず。
lines.translated: Without fail.

lines.content: ……いつか必ず伝えるよ
lines.translated: "...Someday, I'll tell you for sure."

lines.content: ……まだ自分の気持ちの[ありか|在処]がわからない。
lines.translated: I still didn't know where my own feelings truly lay.

lines.content: 勇気を振り絞って気持ちを伝えてくれた君にだからこそ半端なことはしたくないから……。
lines.translated: Precisely because she had mustered up all her courage to share her feelings with me, I didn't want to give her a half-hearted answer...

lines.content: だから今日のところはこれまでだ。
lines.translated: So this was as far as we'd go for today.

lines.content: おやすみ、千和。
lines.translated: Goodnight, Chiwa.

lines.content: また明日。
lines.translated: See you tomorrow.

lines.content: 互いにすてきな夢が見れますようにと微笑み合って、別れた。
lines.translated: Smiling at each other and wishing one another sweet dreams, we parted ways.

lines.content: 先輩が帰ってから[・|私]はお父さんの様子を見に、部屋の前までやって来た。
lines.translated: After Senpai went home, *I* went over to my dad's room to check on him.

lines.content: ……お父さん、まだ起きてる？
lines.translated: "...Dad, are you still awake?"

lines.content: 声をかけた。でも、返事はない。
lines.translated: I called out to him. However, there was no answer.

lines.content: 少し不安になった。
lines.translated: I started to feel a little uneasy.

lines.content: ……ここ最近、元気のないように見えたお父さん。
lines.translated: Lately, my dad had seemed really down.

lines.content: 先輩のおかげで元気になってくれた――そう見えたのは本当だ。
lines.translated: Thanks to Senpai, he had cheered up--it really had looked that way to me.

lines.content: 私の知らないところでお父さんが先輩にちょっと意地悪なことをしていたのも知ってる。
lines.translated: I also knew that my dad had been a little mean to Senpai behind my back.

lines.content: そんな意地悪する中でも、お父さんは先輩と話せて楽しかったんじゃないかと私は勝手に感じていた。それがお父さんが元気になった理由のひとつだ。
lines.translated: Even while he was being mean like that, I couldn't help feeling like my dad was actually having fun talking to Senpai. That was one of the reasons he'd perked up.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: （……お夕飯食べ終わって、部屋に戻るとき、お父さん。また少し元気がないように見えた）
lines.translated: (...When Dad went back to his room after dinner, he looked a little down again.)

lines.content: そして、そんなお父さんが微笑んだまま、小さな声でこう言った――ごめんね、千和。
lines.translated: And then, still smiling, he had said in a quiet voice--I'm sorry, Chiwa.

lines.content: それは聞き間違えだったかもしれない。
lines.translated: I might have misheard him.

lines.content: 小さなちいさな声だったから……。
lines.translated: Because his voice was so, so quiet...

lines.content: だから気のせいかもとも思ったのだ。
lines.translated: So I thought it might have just been my imagination.

lines.content: でも、どうしても気になった。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't stop thinking about it.

lines.content: このままじゃ眠れないとも。
lines.translated: I knew I wouldn't be able to sleep like this.

lines.content: お父さん……
ノックする。
lines.translated: I knocked.

lines.content: それでもやっぱり返事がない。
lines.translated: Still, there was no answer.

lines.content: どころか扉の向こうには気配すらないような……。
lines.translated: In fact, I couldn't even sense anyone on the other side of the door...

lines.content: 電気は付いてる。
lines.translated: The light was on.

lines.content: 薄らと扉は開いていた。そこから光が漏れている。
lines.translated: The door was cracked open slightly, and light was spilling out from the gap.

lines.content: いつかの夜が脳裏を過ぎった。
lines.translated: A certain night from the past flashed through my mind.

lines.content: お父さんが泣いていた夜。たったひとりで。静かに泣いてた。
lines.translated: The night my dad was crying. All alone. Crying quietly.

lines.content: 何か、あったの……お父さん。
lines.translated: Did something happen... Dad?

lines.content: どうしてひとりで泣いてたの？
lines.translated: Why were you crying all by yourself?

lines.content: お父さんの悲しかったこと、私には教えてもらえない？
lines.translated: Won't you tell me what made you so sad?

lines.content: 先輩のおかげで、お父さん、前より笑顔が増えた気がするけれど……。
lines.translated: Thanks to Senpai, I feel like you've been smiling more than before, Dad, and yet...

lines.content: 私も、お父さんの役に立ちたいんだよ。
lines.translated: I want to be helpful to you too, Dad.

lines.content: 私はドアノブを握った。
lines.translated: I took hold of the doorknob.

lines.content: そこで少し躊躇ってしまう。
lines.translated: Right then, I hesitated a little.

lines.content: 返事もないのに勝手に開けるといやがられるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would he be upset if I just opened it without getting an answer?

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ありがとう、お父さん。
lines.translated: Thank you, Dad.

lines.content: 今日は一杯いっぱい、楽しかったよ――でも、忘れてた。まだお父さんにありがとうを言ってなかった。ありがとうくらい寝る前にちゃんと言わなきゃ。
lines.translated: I had so, so much fun today--Wait, I forgot. I still haven't said thank you to Dad. I have to at least thank him properly before going to bed.

lines.content: ――お父さんが元気かどうか顔を見たい。そしてありがとうと言ってから眠りたい。
lines.translated: --I want to see his face to make sure he's doing okay. And I want to say thank you before I go to sleep.

lines.content: ノックをしても。
lines.translated: Even when I knocked.

lines.content: 声をかけても。
lines.translated: Even when I called out.

lines.content: 全然返事はないけれど。
lines.translated: There was no answer at all.

lines.content: でも、この扉を開くだけの理由は充分だと感じたから……、
lines.translated: Still, I felt like that was more than enough reason to open this door, so...

lines.content: ごめんね、開けるよ……お父さん
lines.translated: "Sorry, Dad... I'm opening the door."

lines.content: 扉を、開いた。
lines.translated: I opened the door.

lines.content: 心がどくりと、脈打った。
lines.translated: My heart gave a violent thump.

lines.content: 真っ赤だった。
lines.translated: Her face was bright red.

lines.content: そこはむせ返るような赤色だ。
lines.translated: The room was a suffocating shade of red.

lines.content: ずたずたで。
lines.translated: Shredded.

lines.content: ぼろぼろで。
lines.translated: Mangled.

lines.content: ばらばらで。
lines.translated: Torn to pieces.

lines.content: ……そこらに散らばり、転がっているものは、なんだろう。
lines.translated: What are those things scattered and rolling around everywhere?

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: そんな真っ赤な部屋の中心に、こちらに背を向け立っているのは……。
lines.translated: Standing in the center of that bright red room, with his back turned to me, was...
*Papa*...?

lines.content: そのひとはゆっくりとこちらを振り返る。
lines.translated: That person slowly looked back at me.

lines.content: ……千和。大きくなったな
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. You've grown."

lines.content: たった、それだけ。
lines.translated: Just that.

lines.content: たった一言だけを残し、そのひとは[・|ま][・|る][・|で][・|そ][・|こ][・|に][・|な][・|い][・|も][・|の][・|み][・|た][・|い][・|に]漆黒の影となり――窓の外の闇夜に消えた。吸い込まれるように。
lines.translated: Leaving behind only those few words, he turned into a pitch-black shadow *as if he were never really there at all*--and vanished into the dark night outside the window. As though sucked away.

lines.content: その手に、さっきまで私のお父さんだったものを――切り離されて、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じ、もう二度と微笑んでくれないお父さんのかけらを、鷲づかみにしたまま。
lines.translated: Clutching in his hand what had been my dad until just moments ago--a severed piece of him, eyelids closed, never to smile at me again.

lines.content: 私はあのひとの消えた窓を、思い切り開け放つ。
lines.translated: I threw the window he vanished through wide open with all my might.

lines.content: そして私は、叫んだ。
lines.translated: And then, I screamed.
*The name of my other papa*.

lines.content: ナハト！
lines.translated: "Nacht!"

lines.content: それは深いふかい“夜”という意味だった。
lines.translated: A name that meant deep, deep "night."

lines.content: さんざんな夜だ。
lines.translated: What a terrible night.

lines.content: いったい何が起きている――
lines.translated: Just what in the world is going on--

lines.content: やっと落ち着いた千和をベッドに寝かせ、その寝顔を見つめながら……[・|俺]はこれまでの経緯について思う。
lines.translated: Having finally calmed Chiwa down and tucked her into bed, I gazed at her sleeping face... and *I* thought back on everything that had happened so far.

lines.content: まず、ひとつの結論から。
lines.translated: First, one conclusion.

lines.content: 杏藤一磨という人物はこの世のどこにも存在していなかった。
lines.translated: The person named Andou Kazuma did not exist anywhere in this world.

lines.content: ……昨晩。
lines.translated: Last night.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”に帰り着いてからすぐ千和から電話があった――“お父さんが、死んでしまった”
lines.translated: Right after I got back to the "Bed of Dreams," I got a phone call from Chiwa--"My dad is dead."

lines.content: どういうことだ。何が、起きた。
lines.translated: What did that mean? What happened?

lines.content: 千和と電話を繋いだまま、泣きじゃくる千和をなんとか宥めながら、俺は走って千和の家に引き返した。
lines.translated: Keeping Chiwa on the line and doing my best to soothe her as she sobbed uncontrollably, I ran all the way back to her house.

lines.content: 駆けつけた千和のお父さんの部屋。
lines.translated: I rushed into Chiwa's father's room.

lines.content: 開け放たれた扉の向こう。煌々と明かりが廊下に漏れている。独特の臭いがした。鉄の混じった生き物の臭い。血の臭い。
lines.translated: Beyond the wide-open door, bright light spilled out into the hallway. There was a distinct smell. The scent of a living creature mixed with iron. The smell of blood.

lines.content: そこは……。
lines.translated: That place was...

lines.content: そこはまさに凄惨な殺人現場といった惨状だった。
lines.translated: It was a gruesome scene, looking every bit like the site of a horrific murder.

lines.content: 真っ赤だ。
lines.translated: Bright red.

lines.content: ずたずたに引き裂かれた[・|何][・|か]がそこら中に散らばっていた。
lines.translated: *Something* torn to shreds was scattered all over the place.

lines.content: その中に千和がうずくまっている。俺と繋がったスマホを、震える手で握りしめたまま……。
lines.translated: Chiwa was crouching right in the middle of it. Clutching the smartphone still connected to mine in her trembling hand...

lines.content: 『千和！』
lines.translated: "Chiwa!"

lines.content: 俺は小さなその肩を抱き寄せた。
lines.translated: I pulled her small shoulders close.

lines.content: すると千和が俺に力一杯抱きついて、唇を震わせながら――言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa clung to me with all her might, her lips trembling as she--spoke.

lines.content: 『お父さんが……殺された』
lines.translated: "My dad... was killed."

lines.content: いったい、誰に？
lines.translated: By who on earth?

lines.content: 『お父さんに……』
lines.translated: "By my dad..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: どういうことだ。わかるように言ってくれ。
lines.translated: What does that mean? Say it so I can understand.

lines.content: だけどそれ以上は何も応えてくれず……応えられず、千和はずっと泣いていた。
lines.translated: However, she didn't answer any further... she couldn't answer, and just kept crying the entire time.

lines.content: そこから俺はまず千和を部屋で休ませ、すぐに警察に連絡をした。
lines.translated: After that, I first had Chiwa rest in her room and immediately called the police.

lines.content: ものの十分もしないうちに数台のパトカーや警官たちがやって来たが……。
lines.translated: In less than ten minutes, several patrol cars and police officers arrived, but...

lines.content: 『うそ、だろ……』
lines.translated: "You've gotta be kidding me..."

lines.content: 案内した千和のお父さんの部屋。真っ赤に染まったその部屋は……だがしかし、そこはそれ以上、おかしなものは何もなかった。
lines.translated: I led them to Chiwa's father's room. That room stained bright red... However, aside from that, there was nothing else strange in there.

lines.content: ……俺が駆けつけたときは確かに、そこら中にずたずたに引き裂かれ、無残にも散らばった[・|も][・|の]があったはずなのに。
lines.translated: When I rushed over, there had definitely been *things* torn to shreds and gruesomely scattered all over the place.

lines.content: ない。何もない。どこにも、ない。
lines.translated: Gone. There was nothing. Nowhere to be found.

lines.content: ……残されたのは、べったりと床や壁や天井や家具などを赤く染めた大量の血液だけだった。大げさなくらい、大量の。
lines.translated: All that remained was a massive amount of blood staining the floor, walls, ceiling, and furniture a thick red. An almost absurdly massive amount.

lines.content: 警察署に連れて行かれた千和と俺は、ふたり別けられ、警官たちに様々な質問を個別にされた。
lines.translated: Taken to the police station, Chiwa and I were separated and questioned individually about all sorts of things by the officers.

lines.content: その中で知ったのだ。杏藤一磨という人物は戸籍上、存在しない人物なのだということを。
lines.translated: It was during that process that I found out. That a person named Andou Kazuma did not exist in the family registry.

lines.content: 警官たちは疑惑の目で俺たちを見た。
lines.translated: The officers looked at us with suspicious eyes.

lines.content: 本当に、誰かが殺されたのか、と。
lines.translated: Wondering if anyone had really been killed at all.

lines.content: どうやら性質の悪い悪戯だと思われ始めているようだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, they were starting to think it was some kind of malicious prank.

lines.content: ……悪戯だなんて。
lines.translated: A prank, seriously?

lines.content: もしそうなら千和は今まで、保護者もおらずたったひとりで暮らしてきたことになるじゃないか。
lines.translated: If that were true, wouldn't it mean Chiwa had been living all alone without a guardian this whole time?

lines.content: しかし部屋を染める血液は確かに人間のものではあるようだ。まずこの血液の持ち主は誰であるのか。そこから調べる。
lines.translated: However, the blood staining the room did appear to be genuinely human. First, they would find out who the blood belonged to. They'd start the investigation from there.

lines.content: 今夜のところはそういった方針を固めるのみで、俺たちは警察署から帰された。
lines.translated: Having only settled on that course of action for tonight, we were sent home from the police station.

lines.content: ……先輩？
lines.translated: "...Senpai?"

lines.content: 千和が目を覚まし、そこで俺は我に返る。
lines.translated: Chiwa woke up, snapping me out of my thoughts.

lines.content: 千和……大丈夫か？
lines.translated: "Chiwa... Are you okay?"

lines.content: ベッドから身体を起こそうとする千和を支えながら、俺は、問いかける――いったい何があったのか。
lines.translated: Supporting Chiwa as she tried to sit up in bed, I asked her--just what on earth had happened.

lines.content: もう少し詳しく教えてくれないかな。昨日の夜にあったこと。お父さんが、お父さんに殺されたというのは……
lines.translated: "Could you tell me in a little more detail? About what happened last night. What you meant when you said your dad was killed by your dad..."

lines.content: 昨晩、千和が俺に漏らしたその言葉。
lines.translated: Those words Chiwa had let slip to me last night.

lines.content: 警察には伝えていない。
lines.translated: I hadn't told the police about them.

lines.content: 千和は唇を噛み、うつむいて、
lines.translated: Chiwa bit her lip, looking down.

lines.content: ……いつか
lines.translated: "...Someday."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: いつかこうなるんじゃないかと、心のどこかで思ってました……
lines.translated: "Somewhere in my heart, I always thought it might turn out like this someday..."

lines.content: 声を震わせながら、言った。
lines.translated: She spoke, her voice trembling.

lines.content: ……きっと、このままなはずないって……きっと何かがあるって……でも、どうして……こんなこと
lines.translated: "...That things couldn't possibly stay the way they were... that something was bound to happen... But why... something like this..."

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: そこで沈黙、してしまう。うつむいたまま。
lines.translated: Right there, she fell silent. Still looking down.

lines.content: まだそっとしておいたほうがいいだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe it'd be better to just leave her alone for now.

lines.content: ただでさえ警察で色々と強引な質問などをされたはず。その疲労はそんなすぐには回復するはずもないだろう……。
lines.translated: As it was, the police had surely subjected her to all sorts of pushy questioning. There was no way she'd recover from that exhaustion so quickly...

lines.content: ましてや父親が殺された……らしいのだ。
lines.translated: Especially since her father had been killed... apparently.

lines.content: そんな状態の千和から、こちらの好奇心を満たすためだけに無理矢理事情を聞き出そうだなんて、そんなこと、できるはずもない。
lines.translated: Forcing Chiwa to explain the situation in her current state just to satisfy my own curiosity--there was no way I could do something like that.

lines.content: 千和、お腹空いてない？　良ければ何か作るよ？
lines.translated: "Chiwa, are you hungry? I can make something if you'd like."

lines.content: 笑顔で問う。
lines.translated: I asked with a smile.

lines.content: 大げさにならぬよう、不自然にならぬよう……意識しながら。
lines.translated: Making a conscious effort... not to sound overly dramatic or unnatural.

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: 弱々しく千和が俺を呼ぶ。
lines.translated: Chiwa called out to me weakly.

lines.content: ああ。千和みたいに美味しくはできないだろうけど、消化に良さそうなものが今はいいよな。うどんとか、簡単なものしかできないだろうけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I probably can't make it as delicious as you do, Chiwa, but something easy to digest would be best right now, huh? Though I can probably only manage something simple like udon..."

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: 今度はもう少しだけ強く、俺を呼ぶ。
lines.translated: This time, she called out to me just a little more firmly.

lines.content: そして顔を上げ、『教えてください』と千和は言う。
lines.translated: Then Chiwa raised her head and said, "Please tell me."

lines.content: ……私、どうしたらいいですか……先輩
lines.translated: "...What should I do... Senpai?"

lines.content: 声を震わせ、両手で顔を覆ってしまう。
lines.translated: Her voice trembling, she covered her face with both hands.

lines.content: そしてまた……涙がこぼれる。次々と。たくさん。
lines.translated: And once again... tears spilled over. One after another. So many of them.

lines.content: そんな千和の姿に、俺は……左手だ。自分の利き手。“夜の左手”を握りしめる。
lines.translated: Seeing Chiwa like that, I... looked at my left hand. My dominant hand. I clenched my "Left Hand of the Night."

lines.content: ……千和。なあ、千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: 今から俺が話すこと……応えたくなければそのまま聞き流していてほしい。一方的に話す
lines.translated: "What I'm about to say... if you don't want to answer, I want you to just let it pass right over you. I'm just going to talk on my own."

lines.content: ……ただの予感だ。ただの予想だ。……今、起きている問題は、君が十年前……“魔法少女”として“夜”の中で戦ったことと、関係がある？
lines.translated: "...It's just a hunch. Just a guess. ...Does the problem happening right now have something to do with when you fought in the 'Night' as a 'magical girl' ten years ago?"

lines.content: 応えない。
lines.translated: She didn't answer.

lines.content: 十年前の“夜”で千和が手に入れたはずのもの。“最後の魔法”。それを持たなければ解決できない。そんな問題なのかな
lines.translated: "What you should have obtained in the 'Night' ten years ago. The 'final magic.' Is it the kind of problem that can't be solved unless you have that?"

lines.content: 千和は何も、応えない。
lines.translated: Chiwa didn't answer at all.

lines.content: ……もしもそうなら
lines.translated: "...If that's the case..."

lines.content: 俺は千和に手を差し出す。左手。特別な手のひら。
lines.translated: I held my hand out to Chiwa. My left hand. My special palm.

lines.content: ……千和。俺は君の“魔法”を、“夜”の中から引き出すことができる。あさひさんからその“役割”を譲り受けたんだ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. I can draw your 'magic' out from within the 'Night.' I inherited that 'role' from Asahi-san."

lines.content: もしも俺の予想が正しいのなら……千和。この手を握ってほしい。君に、君のほしかった“魔法”を授けることができる。だけど……ひとつ。条件があるんだ
lines.translated: "If my guess is right... Chiwa. I want you to take this hand. I can grant you the 'magic' you wanted. However... there's one condition."

lines.content: 俺のこの手は“夜”と繋がってる。君がもしこの手を握ったなら、俺は“夜”を通じて君の心を覗き見る。夢見るみたいに
lines.translated: "This hand of mine is connected to the 'Night.' If you take this hand, I'll peer into your heart through the 'Night.' Just like dreaming."

lines.content: たぶん、そういうふうになるはずだ。
lines.translated: That's probably how it should work.

lines.content: ……そうすることで君の“魔法”に危険がないかを判断する
lines.translated: "...By doing that, I'll judge whether there's any danger in your 'magic.'"

lines.content: 俺は、君の“魔法”が君にとって本当に必要なものなのか。君に危害を加えるようなものではないか。それを見極めなきゃいけない。俺の役割はそういう役割なんだよ
lines.translated: "I have to determine whether your 'magic' is truly necessary for you. Whether it's something that might bring you harm. That's the kind of role I have."

lines.content: 手を繋げばそれが叶う。叶ってしまう。
lines.translated: If we joined hands, that would come true. It would end up coming true.

lines.content: 今までそうしなかったのは、そうできなかったからだ。関係性だ。
