lines.translated: Maybe I would have a bad dream.

lines.content: 眠っている間に、困ったことは更に大きな困ったことに生まれ変わってしまっているかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: While I was asleep, my troubles might be reborn into even bigger troubles...

lines.content: そんな悪い予感を振り払い……。
lines.translated: Brushing away such bad premonitions...

lines.content: ……ほら、安心して今夜は眠ろう。君はどんなときもひとりじゃないし、大変なときはいつだって、大切な“誰か”が、そばで力を貸そうと応援してくれている
lines.translated: "...There now, rest easy and sleep tonight. You're never alone at any time, and whenever things get hard, a precious 'someone' is always right beside you, cheering you on and trying to lend you strength."

lines.content: 残された君が不自由なく生きていけたなら、きっと、それが“さよなら”をした人たちにとって一番うれしいことなんじゃないかな……きっとね
lines.translated: "If you, the one left behind, can live freely without wanting for anything, I'm sure that would make the people who said 'goodbye' happier than anything else... I'm sure of it."

lines.content: 私が眠るまでやさしい怪物はおとぎ話を話して聞かせてくれた。
lines.translated: Until I fell asleep, the kind monster told me fairy tales.

lines.content: やさしい声で。やさしい言葉で。とてもやさしい物語の結末を私にくれた。
lines.translated: In a gentle voice. With gentle words. They gave me the ending to a very gentle story.

lines.content: おやすみ、千和。今夜も君がすてきな夢を見れますように
lines.translated: "Goodnight, Chiwa. May you have wonderful dreams tonight as well."

lines.content: さみしい君が、一日でも早くさみしくなくなりますように。
lines.translated: May your lonely self stop feeling lonely even one day sooner.

lines.content: ……私たちが、君のお父さんとお母さんと一緒に、ずっとそばで見守っているからね
lines.translated: "...Because we, together with your mom and dad, will always be watching over you right by your side."

lines.content: いっぱいのやさしい言葉を残して、やさしい怪物は部屋を出て行った。
lines.translated: Leaving behind so many gentle words, the kind monster left the room.

lines.content: 明かりの落とされた部屋で、ひとり、“おやすみなさい”とつぶやいてみた。
lines.translated: Alone in the darkened room, I tried whispering, "Goodnight."

lines.content: すると風もないのにカーテンが小さく揺れた。
lines.translated: Just then, even though there was no wind, the curtains swayed slightly.

lines.content: それは、目には見えないけれどそばにいてくれる“誰か”の合図のように思え……安心できた。不思議だけれど、ひとつ、ふたつ、涙も流れた。
lines.translated: It felt like a sign from "someone" who couldn't be seen, yet was right there beside me... and I felt relieved. Strange as it was, one, then two teardrops fell as well.

lines.content: 少しずつ眠りに落ちていく中で、考える。
lines.translated: As I slowly drifted off to sleep, I thought to myself.

lines.content: 不思議に思うことはたくさんあったから。
lines.translated: Because there were so many things I wondered about.

lines.content: “夜の怪物”
lines.translated: "Monsters of the Night."

lines.content: “不死のイキモノ”
lines.translated: "Immortal Creatures."

lines.content: 悲しい気持ちに押しつぶされそうになっている子どもを[さら|攫]い、自分たちと同じ不死にする。そんな噂。
lines.translated: Rumors said they kidnapped children who were about to be crushed by sadness and made them immortal, just like themselves.

lines.content: でも、ふたりが私を仲間にしようという気配はないし……。
lines.translated: Even so, there was no sign that the two of them intended to make me one of their own...

lines.content: そして、この部屋の前の住人だ。名前をもらった誰かのことだ。
lines.translated: And then there was the previous resident of this room. Someone who had also been given a name.

lines.content: ……わからないことが多すぎた。
lines.translated: There were just too many things I didn't understand.

lines.content: だけど、その子のことを“夜”の中で探していたふたりの顔が。
lines.translated: However, the looks on their faces when they were searching for that child in the "Night"...

lines.content: そして、もういいんだとあきらめたときのふたりの顔が。
lines.translated: And the looks on their faces when they gave up, saying it didn't matter anymore...

lines.content: とても……とてもさみしそうだったことだけは、小さな私にもわかった。
lines.translated: Even as a little kid, I could tell at least that much--that they looked very, very lonely.

lines.content: きっとその子はふたりにとってとても大切な子だったはずだ。
lines.translated: That child must have been someone very precious to the two of them.

lines.content: やさしい怪物は“別に君をその子の代わりにしようと思ったわけじゃない”と言っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: The kind monster had said, "It's not like we intended to make you a replacement for that child," and yet...
I decided to live from now on *with that exact intention*.

lines.content: どうせ帰る場所もないのだし……。
lines.translated: After all, I didn't have anywhere to go back to anyway...

lines.content: そうすることしか今の私にお返しできるものはなにもないから。
lines.translated: Because right now, doing that was the only way I could possibly repay them.

lines.content: そうすればふたりは、あのふたりの怪物は、少しくらいよろこんでくれるかな。
lines.translated: If I did that, I wondered if the two of them--those two monsters--would be at least a little happy.

lines.content: 私に少し厳しいやさしくない怪物も、私に笑いかけてくれるかな。
lines.translated: I wondered if the unkind monster, who was a bit strict with me, would smile at me too.

lines.content: ……誰かが悲しい顔をしているのはやはり見たくなかった。
lines.translated: Above all, I didn't want to see anyone making a sad face.

lines.content: 『今日から私たちは三人家族だ』
lines.translated: "Starting today, the three of us are a family."

lines.content: そう言って笑ってくれた怪物のことを思った。
lines.translated: I thought of the monster who had said that to me with a smile.

lines.content: 家族……。
lines.translated: A family...

lines.content: 今日から私たちは、三人家族。
lines.translated: Starting today, the three of us are a family.

lines.content: 暖かなベッドの中、私は新しくもらった自分の名前を何度も繰り返し、つぶやいていた。
lines.translated: Inside the warm bed, I whispered the new name I had been given over and over again.

lines.content: ……私も、ふたりにお名前を贈ってもいい？
lines.translated: "...May I give the two of you names as well?"

lines.content: ……ここに来て数週間目の朝のこと。
lines.translated: This happened on a morning several weeks after I came here.

lines.content: 名前のないふたりと暮らすのは少し不便だった。
lines.translated: Living with two nameless people was a little inconvenient.

lines.content: 本人たちは気にしていないようだし、これまで別に不便と感じたこともなさそうだったけれど……。
lines.translated: They didn't seem to mind it themselves, nor did it seem like they had ever found it inconvenient until now, though...

lines.content: 一生懸命考えた名前をふたりに伝えた。
lines.translated: I told the two of them the names I had thought so hard to come up with.

lines.content: やさしいほうに“ソル”
lines.translated: For the kind one, "Sol."

lines.content: やさしくないほうに“ナハト”
lines.translated: For the unkind one, "Nacht."

lines.content: どういう意味かなとやさしい怪物が私に言った。
lines.translated: The kind monster asked me what they meant.

lines.content: “ソル”は太陽。“ナハト”は夜……。正解かな？
lines.translated: "'Sol' is the sun. 'Nacht' is the night... Did I get it right?"

lines.content: 私は『そうだよ』とうなずいた。
lines.translated: I nodded and said, "That's right."

lines.content: どこか遠い国の言葉。
lines.translated: They were words from some faraway country.

lines.content: 遠くにありすぎて本当に存在しているのかも小さな私にとっては怪しい国だ。言葉の意味は絵本で読んだ。だから知ってる。
lines.translated: It was a country so far away that, to my young mind, it seemed doubtful whether it even really existed. I had read the meanings of the words in a picture book. That's how I knew them.

lines.content: ふたりはなんだか正反対に見えたから、言葉の意味も正反対に近いものがいいんじゃないかとそう思えたのだ。
lines.translated: Since the two of them looked like complete opposites somehow, it felt right to choose words with meanings that were nearly opposites as well.

lines.content: そっか。ふぅん。君は賢いんだね。まだまだこんなに小さいのにさ
lines.translated: "I see. Hmm. You're a clever one, aren't you? Even though you're still so little."

lines.content: おいで、と言われて私はうなずく。
lines.translated: Told to come over, I nodded.

lines.content: そしてやさしい怪物の膝の上に座った。
lines.translated: Then, I sat down on the kind monster's lap.

lines.content: 数日前からここが私の指定席。
lines.translated: For the past few days, this had been my reserved seat.

lines.content: ……あの夜。
lines.translated: Ever since that night.

lines.content: ずっと手を握って私の話を聞いてくれた夜。
lines.translated: The night they held my hand the whole time and listened to my story.

lines.content: あれから私はこの怪物のことを怖いと思うことはなくなった。このひとはやさしい怪物。心からそう思うことができた。
lines.translated: Since then, I stopped feeling afraid of this monster. This person was a kind monster. I was able to believe that from the bottom of my heart.

lines.content: そんな私をうしろからぎゅっと抱きしめてくれる。それが私はとてもうれしい。
lines.translated: Sitting like that, they hugged me tightly from behind. That made me very happy.

lines.content: ……だって、今までどんなにお願いしても、してもらえなかったことでもあったから。
lines.translated: Because until now, no matter how much I begged for it, it was something no one had ever done for me.

lines.content: いなくなった子もこんなふうに甘えたのかな。
lines.translated: I wondered if the child who disappeared used to be spoiled like this too.

lines.content: そんなことを心のどこかでふと思ったりもした。
lines.translated: Deep down inside, that thought briefly crossed my mind.

lines.content: なんだよその目は。別にいいだろ？　私たちはすぐにこの子を抱きしめられなくなっちゃうんだ――[・|だ][・|か][・|ら][・|今][・|の][・|う][・|ち][・|な][・|ん][・|だ][・|よ]。ああ、それともうらやましいのかな？
lines.translated: "What's with that look? It's fine, isn't it? Before long, we won't be able to hug this child anymore--*so we have to do it while we can*. Oh, or could it be that you're jealous?"

lines.content: バカを言うな
lines.translated: "Don't be ridiculous."

lines.content: くだらん、とやさしくない怪物は鼻を鳴らして、たばこの火を灰皿に押しつけた。
lines.translated: "How foolish," the unkind monster snorted, stubbing out his cigarette in the ashtray.

lines.content: ……こいつが太陽なら、俺は月なんじゃあないのか。正反対というのならふつうそうなる。たぶんな。それが気になっただけだ
lines.translated: "...If this one is the sun, shouldn't I be the moon? If you're talking about opposites, that's normally how it goes. Probably. That's the only thing that bothered me."

lines.content: 新聞に視線を向けたまま、やさしくない怪物が低い声で言った。
lines.translated: Keeping his eyes on his newspaper, the unkind monster spoke in a low voice.

lines.content: 真っ黒な出で立ちで、低く静かな声。
lines.translated: Dressed in pitch black, with a low, quiet voice.

lines.content: だけど良くよく見れば、鋭く真っ赤な瞳の奥が、お星さまみたいにきらきら光ってる――少しの間、一緒に暮らしてそれに気づいた。
lines.translated: However, if you looked really closely, deep inside his sharp, bright red eyes, there was a twinkling like the stars--after living together for a little while, I had noticed it.

lines.content: だから月よりも夜そのものと呼んだほうがより[・|ら][・|し][・|く]思えたのだ。
lines.translated: That was why calling him the night itself rather than the moon felt much more *fitting*.

lines.content: そう説明すると、やさしくない怪物は『……そうか』とだけ言って、新聞のページをめくった。
lines.translated: When I explained that, the unkind monster only said, "...Is that so," and turned the page of his newspaper.

lines.content: 無愛想でごめんねとやさしい怪物が苦笑いを浮かべた。
lines.translated: "Sorry he's so blunt," the kind monster said with a wry smile.

lines.content: だけどさ、気づいたかな。もう出て行けとは言わなくなっただろ？
lines.translated: "Still, have you noticed? He's stopped telling you to get out, hasn't he?"

lines.content: 確かにそうかも……？
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, maybe...?"

lines.content: ……ふん。何度も言うのが面倒になっただけだ。出て行ってくれるのなら直ぐにでも出て行ってくれて構わない。俺はな、子どもが嫌いなんだよ
lines.translated: "...Hmph. I just got tired of saying it over and over. If you're going to leave, I don't mind if you leave right this instant. You see, I hate children."

lines.content: ……おいおい。子どもを泣かすとは大人げないやつだな
lines.translated: "...Hey now. Making a kid cry isn't very mature of you."

lines.content: ……ふん。大人も子どももあったものか
lines.translated: "...Hmph. Mature or childish has nothing to do with it."

lines.content: やさしくない怪物は……ナハトは、マッチを擦って新しいたばこに火を付けた。一口紫煙を吐き出す。
lines.translated: The unkind monster... Nacht struck a match and lit a new cigarette. He exhaled a puff of smoke.

lines.content: 俺はこの世に生まれ落ちたときからずっとこのままの姿だ。子どもにはなったこともないし、大人にだってなったことはない
lines.translated: "I've been in this exact form ever since I was born into this world. I've never been a child, and I've never become an adult either."

lines.content: 広げた新聞で顔を隠してしまう。
lines.translated: He hid his face behind the unfolded newspaper.

lines.content: その向こうから真っ白なたばこの煙が立ち上るのを私は見つめていた。
lines.translated: I stared at the pure white cigarette smoke rising from behind it.

lines.content: 約束通り朝食は私の担当。
lines.translated: Just as promised, I was in charge of breakfast.

lines.content: いつも簡単なメニューだけど、小さな私にできることをがんばった。
lines.translated: It was always a simple menu, but I did my very best with what little I could do.

lines.content: 毎朝決まって、わあ、すごいなあと、やさしい怪物は手を叩いてくれる。
lines.translated: Without fail, every morning, the kind monster would clap and say, "Wow, this is amazing."

lines.content: やさしくない怪物は何も言わないけれど、新聞を丁寧に折りたたんで置いた。
lines.translated: The unkind monster wouldn't say anything, but he would neatly fold his newspaper and set it aside.

lines.content: そして三人一緒にいただきますと手を合わせる。それが毎朝欠かさず繰り返される。
lines.translated: Then the three of us would put our hands together and say, "Thank you for the food." That routine was repeated every single morning without fail.

lines.content: ソルは私の作った簡単な朝食を、いつも『すごい。美味しい』と何度も繰り返しながら食べていた。
lines.translated: Sol always ate the simple breakfasts I made while repeating, "Amazing. It's delicious," over and over again.

lines.content: ……美味しい？　味覚が殆どないのに美味いのか
lines.translated: "...Delicious? You barely have a sense of taste, and yet it's good?"

lines.content: いやあ。何を言うんだ君。千和が私たちのために作ってくれた。その気持ちがうれしい。だからきっとこれは美味しいよ。そう感じるのが“心”だろ？
lines.translated: "Come on now, what are you saying? Chiwa made this for us. That thought makes me happy. So I'm sure this is delicious. Feeling that way is what having a 'heart' is all about, right?"

lines.content: ……ふん。何が“心”だ。また人間の真似事か。懲りない奴だ
lines.translated: "...Hmph. 'Heart,' my foot. Imitating humans again, are we? You never learn."

lines.content: 鼻で笑いながらナハトも料理に口を付けた。
lines.translated: Snorting with laughter, Nacht also took a bite of the food.

lines.content: どうかな？
lines.translated: "How is it?"

lines.content: ……何がどうかな、だ
lines.translated: "...What do you mean, 'how is it'?"

lines.content: 今朝の食事、実はね、千和が君の口に合うかどうか一生懸命考えて作ってくれたみたいだよ。いわば君のための朝食だ。ほら、どう？　美味しいだろう？
lines.translated: "Actually, for this morning's meal, it seems Chiwa thought really hard about whether it would suit your tastes when she made it. In a manner of speaking, it's a breakfast made just for you. Well, how is it? It's delicious, right?"

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: 鼻を鳴らすだけで何も言わない。
lines.translated: He only snorted and said nothing.

lines.content: 美味しいとも不味いとも。
lines.translated: Neither that it was good, nor that it was bad.

lines.content: だけど残さず食べてくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, he ate it all without leaving a single bite behind.

lines.content: それで、ナハトが私を家族として認めてくれたことにはならないだろうけど……。
lines.translated: That probably didn't mean Nacht had accepted me as family, though...

lines.content: “しばらくはここにいてもいい”と言ってくれたように思えてしまったから、
lines.translated: Because it felt to me as if he had said, "You can stay here for a while," I timidly whispered, "Thank you."

lines.content: あ、ありがとうございます……
lines.translated: "Th-Thank you very much..."

lines.content: 怖々とそう言う私に、ナハトは何も応えず、また新聞を開いていた。
lines.translated: To my timid words, Nacht gave no reply and simply opened his newspaper again.

lines.content: まったく。ありがとうを言うのは逆じゃないかなあ。無愛想なのにも程ってものがあるよ。千和もそう思うだろ？
lines.translated: "Good grief. Shouldn't the 'thank you' be the other way around? There's a limit to how blunt someone can be. Don't you think so too, Chiwa?"

lines.content: ソルはそう言い、肩をすくめていた。
lines.translated: Sol said that and shrugged.

lines.content: 私はふたりの怪物に名前をもらった。
lines.translated: I was given a name by the two monsters.

lines.content: ここに[さら|攫]われてくるまでの私は、誰でもないただの小さな子だったけれど……。
lines.translated: Until I was kidnapped and brought here, I had been nobody, just a little kid...

lines.content: 名前をもらったことで“私”がようやく形を持ったように感じられていたんだろうと思う。
lines.translated: By receiving a name, I think I finally felt as though "I" had been given a shape.

lines.content: この名前はきっと、これから私の大切なもののひとつになるだろう予感がしていた。
lines.translated: I had a feeling that from now on, this name would surely become one of the things most precious to me.

lines.content: だから私もふたりに名前を贈った。
lines.translated: So I gave the two of them names as well.

lines.content: ソルとナハト。
lines.translated: Sol and Nacht.

lines.content: やさしい怪物とやさしくない怪物。
lines.translated: The kind monster and the unkind monster.

lines.content: 何か私が失敗をしてしまい、ナハトに睨まれたりするのは、今でも少しだけ怖いけれど……。
lines.translated: Even now, it was still a little scary when I made a mistake and Nacht glared at me, though...

lines.content: それでも、ここに来てからさみしいと感じることは殆どなくなった。
lines.translated: Even so, ever since I came here, I almost never felt lonely anymore.

lines.content: 毎食後に開かれていた音楽や映画や物語の鑑賞会は、いつの間にか私を含めた三人で楽しめるものに変わっていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the appreciation sessions for music, movies, and stories held after every meal had turned into something all three of us, myself included, could enjoy together.

lines.content: ……[・|こ][・|こ]で生活するようになってからどれくらい経ったのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder how much time had passed since I started living *here*.

lines.content: 窓の外にはらはらとさくらの花びらが舞う季節。
lines.translated: It was the season when cherry blossom petals fluttered gently outside the window.

lines.content: 朝ご飯を食べ終えて、ぽかぽかの日差しにうつらうつらとしていたところで、ソルが私にこう言った。
lines.translated: Just as I had finished eating breakfast and was dozing off in the warm sunlight, Sol spoke to me.

lines.content: 千和。今日は君に大切なお話とプレゼントがあるんだ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Today, I have an important talk and a present for you."

lines.content: お話と、プレゼント……？
lines.translated: "A talk, and a present...?"

lines.content: うん。お話と、プレゼント。どちらのほうがまず気になる？
lines.translated: "Yeah. A talk, and a present. Which one are you more curious about first?"

lines.content: それはもちろんプレゼントだったけど……。
lines.translated: The present, of course, though...

lines.content: 私はきっと慎重な性格だ。
lines.translated: I must have been a cautious kid by nature.

lines.content: まずは大切なお話から聞かせてほしいと、そう言った。
lines.translated: I told him I wanted to hear the important talk first.

lines.content: お勉強をしようか
lines.translated: "How about we do some studying?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 突然の言葉に目が覚めてしまった。
lines.translated: Those sudden words woke me right up.

lines.content: お勉強、って……？
lines.translated: "Studying...?"

lines.content: 来週からこの町の小学校に通えるよう手続きしてきた。それが、大切なお話のほうだよ
lines.translated: "I finished the paperwork so you can attend the local elementary school starting next week. That's the important talk."

lines.content: そしてプレゼントはこれだと言って、ソルは私に紙袋を渡した。その中には新品の服が入っていた。
lines.translated: Saying "And here's your present," Sol handed me a paper bag. Inside were brand-new clothes.

lines.content: これ……なに？
lines.translated: "What... is this?"

lines.content: 入学祝いだよ
lines.translated: "It's a gift to celebrate your enrollment."

lines.content: え？　にゅう……？
lines.translated: "Huh? En... rollment...?"

lines.content: そう。近くの小学校の制服だ。ここのはとってもかわいいんだよ。千和によく似合うと思うな
lines.translated: "That's right. It's the uniform for the elementary school nearby. The ones here are really cute. I think it'll look great on you, Chiwa."

lines.content: お勉強って、学校って……どうして？
lines.translated: "Studying, and school... Why?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: それはね、とソルが言う。
lines.translated: "Well, you see," Sol said.

lines.content: これから私たちは三人家族だ。私はそう言ったけれど……こいつと、ナハトとね、色々と話し合ったんだ
lines.translated: "I said that from now on, the three of us are a family, right? But... I talked things over at length with this guy--with Nacht."

lines.content: ナハトがちらりと、開かれた新聞の向こうからこちらを見た。
lines.translated: Nacht glanced over at us from behind his open newspaper.

lines.content: 千和。勝手なことで申し訳ないんだけれど、君と私たちが家族でいられる時間は限られているんだよ。いつかは、君もここから巣立っていかなきゃならない
lines.translated: "Chiwa. I'm sorry for being so selfish about this, but the time we can spend together as a family is limited. Someday, you're going to have to leave the nest."

lines.content: すだつ？
lines.translated: "Leave the nest?"

lines.content: うん。……いつかはね、私たちと“さよなら”して、外の世界で、自分の力で生きていかなきゃならないときが来るってことだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...It means that someday, the time will come when you have to say goodbye to us and live out in the outside world on your own strength."

lines.content: この“夜”は不思議な場所だ。
lines.translated: This "Night" is a mysterious place.

lines.content: 大人になると人は自由自在に出入りすることができなくなってしまうから……。
lines.translated: Once people grow into adults, they can no longer come and go freely...

lines.content: だからね、千和。君を[さら|攫]ってきた手前、本当に勝手だとは思うんだけど、そのときに備えて君には色々なことを学んでいてほしんだ
lines.translated: "So you see, Chiwa. Since we're the ones who kidnapped you in the first place, I know this is really selfish of us, but I want you to learn all sorts of things to prepare for when that day comes."

lines.content: 君にはあくまでも人間として育っていってもらいたい。それが私とナハトが話し合った末の結論だよ
lines.translated: "Above all, we want you to grow up as a human. That's the conclusion Nacht and I reached after talking it all through."

lines.content: [・|人][・|間][・|の][・|ま][・|ま][・|で][・|は]いつか一緒に暮らせなくなる。人間は誰もが大人になるイキモノだからだ。
lines.translated: *As long as I remain human*, we won't be able to live together someday. Because humans are creatures that all grow up into adults.

lines.content: それはずっとずっと先のことではあるけれど……。
lines.translated: Though that was still a long, long way off...

lines.content: ゆくゆくは外の世界の中に、千和と一緒に生きてくれる誰かを探さなければならないとソルが言った。
lines.translated: Sol said that eventually, I would have to find someone out in the outside world who would live alongside me.

lines.content: 友だちでもいい。または恋人でも。いつか千和の[・|本][・|当][・|の][・|家][・|族]になってくれる人だ。
lines.translated: A friend would be fine. Or a lover. Someone who would someday become my *true family*.

lines.content: まあ、それこそ本当にまだまだ先の話だけれどね
lines.translated: "Well, that's really still a long way down the road, though."

lines.content: 勝手なことばかり言ってごめんね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry for saying nothing but selfish things."

lines.content: ……謝られると悲しい気持ちになってくる。
lines.translated: Being apologized to made me feel sad.

lines.content: でもやっぱり考えてはしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't help thinking about it.

lines.content: どうせ“さよなら”するのなら、どうしてわざわざ私を[さら|攫]ってきたの？
lines.translated: If we're just going to say "goodbye" anyway, why did you go out of your way to kidnap me?

lines.content: あなた達は[さら|攫]った子を仲間にして、ずっとずっと、“夜”の中で面白おかしく暮らしていくんじゃなかったの……？
lines.translated: Weren't you supposed to make the kids you kidnapped one of your own, and live happily ever after together in the "Night"...?

lines.content: やっぱり噂はただの噂だったのかな。
lines.translated: Maybe the rumors really were just rumors after all.

lines.content: そう言いたかったけれど、上手にそんな気持ちを言葉にできない小さな私は、ただただ、ソルの言葉にうなずくばかりだった――
lines.translated: That was what I wanted to say, but too little to put those feelings into words properly, all I could do was nod along to what Sol was telling me--

lines.content: 学校なんて、いや。きっと私は誰とも仲良くなれない。
lines.translated: I don't want to go to school. I'm sure I won't be able to make friends with anyone.

lines.content: だからこのままここにずっといたいのに……。
lines.translated: That's why I just want to stay here like this forever...

lines.content: ……あれ？
そこで、気づいた。
lines.translated: Right then, I noticed something.

lines.content: 袋の中にまだ何か入っていた。
lines.translated: There was still something else inside the bag.

lines.content: ぬいぐるみ……？
lines.translated: "A stuffed animal...?"

lines.content: 小さな私でも充分抱きしめられるくらい小さなサイズのぬいぐるみだった。
lines.translated: It was a stuffed animal small enough that even little old me could easily hug it tight.

lines.content: それも贈り物だよ。入学祝いだ。君がひとりで眠るのがさみしいとき、その子が一緒にいてくれたらなあって思ってね。でも……
lines.translated: "That's a gift, too. Another enrollment present. I thought it would be nice if that little guy kept you company whenever you felt lonely sleeping by yourself. Though..."

lines.content: 私はその子を抱き上げて、まじまじと見つめた。
lines.translated: I picked the little guy up and stared intently at it.

lines.content: アニメだろうか。漫画だろうか。見たことのないキャラクターだった。
lines.translated: Was it from an anime? Or a manga? It was a character I had never seen before.

lines.content: お屋敷にいた頃は絵本以外のものはまったく見なかったので、有名なものなのかどうかもわからないけど……。
lines.translated: Back when I lived at the mansion, I hadn't seen anything other than picture books at all, so I didn't even know if it was something famous or not...

lines.content: あ、ああー……
lines.translated: "A-Aaah..."

lines.content: ソルが苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Sol had a wry smile on his face.

lines.content: ええっと、改めてみると、かなり[・|か][・|わ][・|い][・|く][・|な][・|い]よね、それ。なんて言っていいのか……。いったい何のぬいぐるみなのかもまったく不明だし……
lines.translated: "Um, looking at it again, it's really *not cute at all*, is it? How should I put it... I have no clue what kind of stuffed animal it's even supposed to be..."

lines.content: ふん。だから言っただろう
lines.translated: "Hmph. Didn't I tell you?"

lines.content: ナハトが新聞を広げたまま言った。
lines.translated: Nacht spoke with his newspaper still spread open.

lines.content: そんな不細工な人形なんて、女の子がよろこぶはずが――
lines.translated: "There's no way a girl would be happy with an ugly doll like--"

lines.content: かわいい
lines.translated: "It's cute."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: ……これ、子犬さんだよね？
lines.translated: "...This is a little puppy, right?"

lines.content: う、うん。大正解……みたいだね。一緒に入ってた説明書にそう書いてあったよ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Bingo... it seems. That's what it said on the tag that came with it."

lines.content: ありがとう……
lines.translated: "Thank you..."

lines.content: 私はぬいぐるみをぎゅっとした。もふもふだった。ふわふわだった。
lines.translated: I gave the stuffed animal a tight squeeze. It was so fluffy. So soft.

lines.content: う、ううむ。プレゼントしておいてこう言うのもなんだけれど……かわいい子は、かわいいと感じるもののセンスが微妙だったりするのかなあ
lines.translated: "H-Hmm. I know I'm the one who gave it to you, so it's weird for me to say this, but... do cute girls actually have questionable taste when it comes to what they find cute?"

lines.content: なにそれ、ひどい
lines.translated: "What's that supposed to mean? That's mean."

lines.content: 私は唇を尖らせ、そんなことないよと首を振った。この子、かわいい。とてもとっても、かわいいよ。
lines.translated: I pouted and shook my head to say that wasn't true at all. This little guy is cute. Really, truly cute.

lines.content: こんなかわいいプレゼント、はじめてもらったよ。ありがとう。うれしい。すごく
lines.translated: "This is the first time I've ever gotten such a cute present. Thank you. I'm happy. Really happy."

lines.content: ……外の世界は怖いけど。
lines.translated: The outside world is scary, though.

lines.content: でも、この子と一緒なら平気かも。
lines.translated: But if I'm with this little guy, I might be okay.

lines.content: だってかわいいこの子は、私のことを思って買ってきてくれたものには間違いがないはずだから……。
lines.translated: Because there was no mistaking that this cute little guy had been bought with me in mind...

lines.content: ……お祝い、ありがとう。私ね、学校、行ってみるよ
lines.translated: "...Thank you for the enrollment gift. You know, I'll give school a try."

lines.content: ナハトはまた新聞を大きく開き、『……ふん』といつもみたいに鼻を鳴らしていた。
lines.translated: Nacht spread his newspaper wide open again and let out his usual "...Hmph" through his nose.

lines.content: ――勇気だ。
lines.translated: --It's about courage.

lines.content: 人生には勇気を試されるようなことが幾度となく訪れる。
lines.translated: In life, there will be many times when your courage is put to the test.

lines.content: 眠れない夜。私の手を握ってくれたソルがそう言っていた。
lines.translated: On a sleepless night, Sol had told me that while holding my hand.

lines.content: その意味を幼い私がどこまで理解できていたかはわからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't know how much of that meaning my young self was able to understand, though...

lines.content: 正直なところ、学校に行くのはとても大きな勇気が必要だった。
lines.translated: To be honest, going to school took a whole lot of courage.

lines.content: 学校というのがどういう場所なのかは知っている。絵本の世界にも何度か描かれていた場所だ。
lines.translated: I knew what kind of place a school was. It had been depicted several times in the world of my picture books.

lines.content: たくさんの子ども達が集まりお勉強をする場所で……。
lines.translated: A place where lots of children gathered to study...

lines.content: そこに集められた子たちが全員、やさしい子だという保証はないことも知っていた。
lines.translated: And I also knew there was no guarantee that all the kids gathered there would be nice.

lines.content: 不安だった。
lines.translated: She was anxious.

lines.content: あの[物語|絵本]のように意地悪ないじめっ子がいるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Just like in that picture book, there might be mean bullies.

lines.content: あの[物語|絵本]のように厳しいばかりの先生がいるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Just like in that picture book, there might be teachers who are nothing but strict.

lines.content: あの[物語|絵本]のようにおかしなルールのある学校かもしれない。
lines.translated: Just like in that picture book, it might be a school with strange rules.

lines.content: ずっとずっとお屋敷で暮らしてきた私。
lines.translated: I had lived my whole, entire life inside that mansion.

lines.content: 外の世界など殆ど知らないのだ。
lines.translated: I knew next to nothing about the outside world.

lines.content: 怖い気持ちはふくれるばかりで……。
lines.translated: My fear just kept growing and growing...

lines.content: それでも私はその日を迎えた。
lines.translated: Even so, that day arrived.

lines.content: じゃ、じゃあ……行ってきます
lines.translated: "W-Well then... I'm off."

lines.content: 入学初日。
lines.translated: The first day of school.

lines.content: ソルが用意してくれたぴかぴかの制服とランドセルを背負うと、なんだか少し勇気が湧いてくるようだった。ランドセルの中にはプレゼントのぬいぐるみも一緒だ。
lines.translated: Putting on the brand-new uniform Sol had prepared for me and slinging the school bag over my shoulders seemed to give me a little bit of courage. The stuffed animal I got as a present was inside my bag, too.

lines.content: この子が一緒ならどこへでも行けそうだ。
lines.translated: With this little guy with me, I felt like I could go anywhere.

lines.content: 本当は、やっぱり学校には行きたくなかったけれど、これで証明できるかもしれないとも思っていた。
lines.translated: The truth was, I still didn't want to go to school, but I also thought that doing this might let me prove something.

lines.content: いじわるな子にいじめられたり。怖い先生に毎日しかられてばかり。不思議なルールに気後れしたり。
lines.translated: Getting bullied by mean kids. Getting scolded every day by scary teachers. Feeling intimidated by strange rules.

lines.content: 私が、そんな外の世界で生きるのは不向きだとわかれば、ふたりは私を仲間にしてくれて……。
lines.translated: If they realized that I wasn't cut out to live in an outside world like that, the two of them might make me one of their own...

lines.content: ふたりの世界の中で一緒に生きていくことを許してくれるかもしれない。
lines.translated: They might let me live together with them inside their world.

lines.content: そんなふうにどこかで期待していたけれど、
lines.translated: Somewhere in my heart, I was hoping for that, yet...

lines.content: 大丈夫。そんなに気負ったり、不安に思わなくても平気だよ
lines.translated: "It's okay. You don't have to put so much pressure on yourself or feel so anxious. You'll be fine."

lines.content: 私の考えていることを察したわけではないだろうけれど、緊張に目を伏せてしまっていた私にソルが言った。
lines.translated: He probably hadn't guessed what I was thinking, but seeing me cast my eyes down in nervousness, Sol spoke to me.

lines.content: ずっと、君のことを見ているからね
lines.translated: "Because I'll be watching over you the whole time."

lines.content: 本当……？
lines.translated: "Really...?"

lines.content: ああ、本当だとも
lines.translated: "Yeah, really."

lines.content: ……姿は、見えなくても
lines.translated: "...Even if I can't see you?"

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ……声は、届かなくても
lines.translated: "...Even if my voice can't reach you?"

lines.content: 私はソルを見上げて、
lines.translated: I looked up at Sol.

lines.content: ……いつも、そばにいてくれる？
lines.translated: "...Will you always be by my side?"

lines.content: そして手を、ソルに伸ばした。
lines.translated: And then, I reached my hand out to him.

lines.content: ……私と、手を、握っていてくれる？
lines.translated: "...Will you hold my hand?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろん
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: 君のこと、ずっとそばで見てるよ。君の手を、いつでもぎゅっとしているよ
lines.translated: "I'll always be watching over you from right by your side. I'll always be squeezing your hand tight."

lines.content: ソルは笑顔でそう言って、伸ばした私の手を握ってくれる。
lines.translated: Sol said that with a smile and took the hand I held out to him.

lines.content: 君が何かピンチになったら助けに飛んでいく。いつだって。どんなときにだって。だから、いいかい？
lines.translated: "If you ever get into a pinch, I'll come flying to your rescue. Anytime. No matter what. So, okay?"

lines.content: 君には安心して色々なことに挑戦してほしいなあって思うんだよ。ソルは笑顔で私を見つめる。
lines.translated: "I want you to try out all sorts of things with peace of mind," Sol said, gazing at me with a smile.

lines.content: ……君はこの瞬間も、一秒、一秒、大きくなってる。そんな君の成長を一番近くで見守っていられることで、私たちも君たちの“心”を、いつか知ることができるかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Even at this very moment, second by second, you're growing bigger. By watching over your growth from up close like this, maybe one day we'll be able to understand your 'hearts,' too."

lines.content: そんな未来を夢見ているんだ、とソルは言った。
lines.translated: "I'm dreaming of a future like that," Sol said.

lines.content: 千和。君は自分の未来を、どんなふうに夢見ているのかな
lines.translated: "Chiwa. What kind of future do you dream of for yourself?"

lines.content: 君が思い描くすてきな未来が、いつか、叶えられますようにと祈ってる。そのために、今はたくさんの経験を重ねてほしいよ
lines.translated: "I pray that the wonderful future you envision will come true someday. And for that, I want you to build up lots of experiences right now."

lines.content: 私たちは繋いだままの手を、指切りするみたいに振って……離れた。
lines.translated: We swung our joined hands like we were making a pinky promise... and parted.

lines.content: 何かを失敗して、私は外の世界が不向きだと知ってもらって。
lines.translated: I had thought that if I failed at something, they would realize I wasn't cut out for the outside world.

lines.content: そしてふたりの仲間にしてもらおうと思っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: And then they would make me one of their own, or so I'd hoped...

lines.content: [・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]言われたら仕方がない。がんばってみるしかない。
lines.translated: When he put it *like that*, I couldn't help it. All I could do was try my best.

lines.content: きっとあの頃の私は“期待”されるのがうれしかったのだ。
lines.translated: Back then, I must have been happy to have someone place their "expectations" in me.

lines.content: “期待”されるということは、ここにいてもいいんだよと言ってもらえているみたいで……。
lines.translated: Having "expectations" placed on me felt like being told that it was okay for me to be here...

lines.content: それでもやっぱり、私は学校でひとりぼっちになったし、小さいからといじめられもした。
lines.translated: Even so, I still ended up all alone at school, and I got bullied for being small.

lines.content: だけどさみしくはなかった。
lines.translated: But I wasn't lonely.

lines.content: 参観日にはきれいにおめかししたソルがやって来てくれた。
lines.translated: On parent observation day, Sol came all dressed up and looking nice.

lines.content: 授業中。教室の後ろだ。クラスメイトのお母さんたちの中に“夜の怪物”が混じってる。
lines.translated: In the middle of class, at the back of the room, a "Monster of the Night" was mingling among my classmates' mothers.

lines.content: なんだか不思議だし、おかしかった。振り返るとにこにこと笑い、ソルは私に手を振ってくれた。
lines.translated: It felt kind of strange and funny. When I looked back, Sol beamed and waved at me.

lines.content: するとどうしてだか教室がざわめいて、私はちょっと得意な気持ちにもなったのだ。
lines.translated: For some reason, that sent a murmur through the classroom, and it made me feel a little proud.

lines.content: リレーで私の番が来ると、ソルが大きな旗を振って応援してくれたのは……とっても恥ずかしかったけれど、とてもとても、うれしくもあったのだ。
lines.translated: When my turn came in the relay race, Sol waved a huge flag to cheer me on... It was super embarrassing, yet at the same time, it made me so, so happy.
*Everything was so that I could get used to the outside world*.

lines.content: すべては、私がいつかふたりの元から“巣立つ”ため――私たちは、家族になった。
lines.translated: Everything was so that I could someday "leave the nest" and set out from the two of them--and so, we became a family.

lines.content: 杏藤という名字を三人の合い言葉にした。
lines.translated: We made the surname "Andou" a secret password for the three of us.

lines.content: 私が学校に入学する前に、適当に本棚から選んだ物語。その登場人物から借りようと三人で話し合ったのだった。
lines.translated: Before I started school, we had talked it over among the three of us and decided to borrow the name from a character in a story I picked at random from the bookshelf.

lines.content: “夜”の外に出るときソルは杏藤一磨と名乗った。
lines.translated: Whenever he went outside the "Night," Sol called himself Kazuma Andou.

lines.content: ナハトは、自分は外に出ることなどないので不要だと言って、たばこの煙をもくもくと吐き出してばかりいたけれど……。
lines.translated: Nacht just kept puffing out clouds of cigarette smoke, saying he didn't need a name since he never went outside anyway...

lines.content: それから学校の行事だけでなく、ソルは住処の“夜”から外へと度々出ては、私がごくふつうの生活になじめるようにと色々なことをしてくれた。
lines.translated: After that, not just for school events, Sol frequently stepped out from our home in the "Night" and did all sorts of things to help me adjust to a completely normal life.

lines.content: 休日になればソルと一緒に手を繋いで出かけた。
lines.translated: On days off, Sol and I would hold hands and go out together.

lines.content: 近所の公園にお弁当を持ってピクニック。
lines.translated: We'd bring a boxed lunch to a nearby park for a picnic.

lines.content: 芝生の上にシートを敷いて、ナハトが作ってくれたお弁当を開いた。
lines.translated: We spread a picnic sheet over the grass and opened up the lunch Nacht had made for us.

lines.content: ソルは太陽の光が苦手らしくって、いつも真っ黒なスーツに真っ黒な日傘を差していた。
lines.translated: Sol seemed to be weak to sunlight, so he always wore a pitch-black suit and carried a pitch-black parasol.

lines.content: そして両手には真っ白な手袋だ。
lines.translated: And on both hands, he wore pure white gloves.

lines.content: その手袋はソルだけではなくナハトも付けていた。何か意味があるのかな。
lines.translated: It wasn't just Sol who wore those gloves; Nacht did too. I wondered if there was some meaning behind them.

lines.content: ずっと気にはなっていたけれど……。
lines.translated: I had been curious about it for a long time...

lines.content: だけどその日の私はそのこと以上に、気になることができてしまっていた。
lines.translated: However, on that day, something else was weighing on my mind even more than that.

lines.content: そっか。またいじめられるようになっちゃったのか
lines.translated: "I see. So you've started getting bullied again."

lines.content: その日、ソルが私を連れ出してくれたのは、朝から私に元気がなかったからだ。
lines.translated: The reason Sol had taken me out that day was because I had been feeling down since the morning.

lines.content: なあ、千和
lines.translated: "Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: なあに？
lines.translated: "What is it?"

lines.content: 君に意地悪をするいじめっ子は男の子だろう。女の子たちじゃなくって
lines.translated: "The bullies being mean to you are boys, aren't they? Not the girls."

lines.content: ……そうだけど
lines.translated: "...They are, yeah."

lines.content: どうしてわかるの？　そう問いかける私に、わかるさ。簡単だよ、とソルはにっこりと笑う。
lines.translated: "How can you tell?" When I asked him that, Sol smiled brightly and said, "I just know. It's simple."

lines.content: 男の子はね、幾つになってもどうしようもないイキモノなのさ。大人だろうと。子どもだろうとね
lines.translated: "Boys, you see, are hopeless creatures no matter how old they get. Whether they're adults or kids."

lines.content: どういうことなの？　よく、わからない
lines.translated: "What do you mean? I don't really get it."

lines.content: 男の子っていうのは好きな子に意地悪したくなるものなのさ。そうすることで好きな子に自分のことを気にしてもらおうとするんだよ……千和、気づいてる？
lines.translated: "Boys just naturally want to be mean to the girls they like. By doing that, they try to get the girl they like to pay attention to them... Chiwa, have you noticed?"

lines.content: なにを……？
lines.translated: "Noticed what...?"

lines.content: うん。最近、千和はずっとかわいくなったんだよ。私たちと一緒に暮らし始めた頃も当然かわいかったけど、今はもっともっと、かわいくなってる
lines.translated: "Well, you've gotten a whole lot cuter lately, Chiwa. Of course you were cute when you first started living with us too, but now you've gotten even cuter."

lines.content: だからさ、千和。君にとっては残念なお知らせかもだけど、君はこれからとっても大変かもしれないな。もっともっと君に意地悪してくる男の子が増えちゃうんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "So, Chiwa. This might be unfortunate news for you, but things might get really tough for you from here on out. I bet even more boys are going to start being mean to you."

lines.content: そんな未来を想像してみると、なんだかとっても悲しくなった。今にも泣いてしまいそう。好きなのに意地悪するなんて理解できない。
lines.translated: Imagining a future like that made me feel terribly sad. I felt like I could burst into tears at any moment. I couldn't understand why someone would be mean to a person they liked.

lines.content: そんな私にソルが“おいで”と言って手招きしてくれる。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, Sol beckoned me over with a "Come here."

lines.content: 私はもぞもぞとソルの胸元に収まった。
lines.translated: I wriggled my way into Sol's embrace.

lines.content: 膝の上だ。抱きしめられて、心臓の音もしない胸に耳を押しつけて……私はとても、安心できた。
lines.translated: Right onto his lap. Held tight in his arms, pressing my ear against a chest that didn't even have a heartbeat... I felt completely safe and at peace.

lines.content: “外”の光が苦手なはずのソルの胸の中は、いっぱいの太陽と草の匂いがした。
lines.translated: Even though Sol was supposed to be weak to the light of the "outside," his chest smelled full of sunshine and grass.

lines.content: もしも、いつか君に、大切な人ができてしまって……
lines.translated: "If, someday, you end up finding someone special to you..."

lines.content: 大切な……？
lines.translated: "Someone special...?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: その“誰か”がね、もし千和に意地悪ばっかりするような男の子だったら……うーん。不安だな。私はその子に、千和の代わりにいっぱい意地悪仕返してしまいそうだよ
lines.translated: "If that 'someone' turns out to be a boy who's always being mean to you, Chiwa... Hmm. That makes me anxious. I feel like I'd end up being super mean right back to him on your behalf."

lines.content: 君と一緒に生きてくれる“誰か”を“外の世界”で探すのも、君が学校に通ったりすることを進める理由ではあるけれど……
lines.translated: "Finding 'someone' in the 'outside world' who will live alongside you is one of the reasons we're encouraging you to go to school and all, though..."

lines.content: 難しい。これはとっても難しい問題だなと、ソルは私の頭を撫でながら、うんうんと唸っていた。
lines.translated: "It's difficult. This is a very difficult problem," Sol groaned, going "Hmm, hmm" as he stroked my head.

lines.content: でも、ごめんね、千和。そのいじめっ子に私たちは仕返ししないよ
lines.translated: "But I'm sorry, Chiwa. We won't get back at those bullies for you."

lines.content: 厳しいようだけど、君の困難は、できるだけ君自身の力で乗り越えてほしい。そのための力を困難の中で学んでほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "It might sound harsh, but I want you to overcome your hardships with your own strength as much as possible. I want you to learn the strength to do that in the midst of those struggles."

lines.content: ソルが胸の中の私に、謳うようにして言う。
lines.translated: Sol spoke to me in his embrace, his voice almost like a song.

lines.content: 私たちはいつも千和のことを見守っていたいと願ってるけど、だけどずっと手助けをしてあげられるわけでもないからね。君には強くてやさしい子に育ってほしいんだ
lines.translated: "We wish we could always watch over you, Chiwa, but it's not like we'll be able to help you out forever. I want you to grow up into a strong, kind girl."

lines.content: 私たちはできだけ君の成長を静かに見守っていたいと願ってる。ソルは言う。
lines.translated: "We want to quietly watch over your growth as much as we can," Sol said.

lines.content: でも、どうしてもつらくて、耐えられなくなったら呼んでほしいかな
lines.translated: "Still, if it ever gets too painful and you just can't bear it anymore, I want you to call for me."

lines.content: 君が私にくれた名前だよ。夜の星を見上げて私を呼んでくれたなら……。いつだって、どこにだって、駆けつけるよ
lines.translated: "By the name you gave me. If you look up at the stars in the night sky and call for me... I'll come running, anytime, anywhere."

lines.content: 風が吹く。
lines.translated: The wind blew.

lines.content: ふわふわさくらの花びらが流れていく。
lines.translated: Soft, fluffy cherry blossom petals drifted past.

lines.content: ソルの声は子守歌みたいに私にいっぱいの安心をくれた。
lines.translated: Like a lullaby, Sol's voice filled me with reassurance.

lines.content: ……千和。起きてる？
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. Are you awake?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ちょっとうとうとしてしまってはいたけれど、
lines.translated: I had been dozing off a little, though.

lines.content: 起きてるよ？
lines.translated: "I'm awake."

lines.content: 顔を上げ、ソルを見上げた。
lines.translated: I lifted my head and looked up at Sol.

lines.content: そろそろちょうどいい時間だ。帰ろうか
lines.translated: "It's just about time. Shall we head back?"

lines.content: そろそろ？
lines.translated: "About time?"

lines.content: うん。ナハトが待ってる
lines.translated: "Yeah. Nacht is waiting."

lines.content: そう、なの……？
lines.translated: "He is...?"

lines.content: ふふ。実はね、千和。今日君をこうして連れ出したのは、千和が元気なさそうだったからってだけじゃないんだよ
lines.translated: "Hehe. Actually, Chiwa, the reason I brought you out like this today wasn't just because you looked down."

lines.content: 不思議そうな顔をする私に、ソルはにっこりと満面の笑みを見せ、こう言ってくれた。
lines.translated: As I gave him a puzzled look, Sol beamed with a huge smile and said this to me:

lines.content: お誕生日おめでとう。千和。ナハトが美味しいおいしいケーキを焼いて、待ってくれてるよ
lines.translated: "Happy birthday, Chiwa. Nacht has baked a delicious, delicious cake and is waiting for you."

lines.content: お家に帰り、玄関を開く。
lines.translated: We returned home and opened the front door.

lines.content: すると甘い香りでいっぱいだった。
lines.translated: Instantly, the air was filled with a sweet aroma.

lines.content: お店のテーブルのひとつにきれに飾り付けられたショートケーキが置いてあった。
lines.translated: A beautifully decorated shortcake sat on one of the shop's tables.

lines.content: チョコレートの文字で何か書いてある。
lines.translated: Something was written on it in chocolate lettering.

lines.content: “ハッピーバースデー、千和”だね。そう書いてあるんだよ
lines.translated: "It says, 'Happy Birthday, Chiwa.' That's what's written there."

lines.content: ソルが私に火の付いていないろうそくをいくつか渡してくれた。
lines.translated: Sol handed me several unlit candles.

lines.content: 今日で、一年だ
lines.translated: "Today marks one year."

lines.content: 一年って……？
lines.translated: "One year...?"

lines.content: うん。千和をここに[さら|攫]って来てちょうど一年だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's been ровно one year since we spirited you away here, Chiwa."

lines.content: ソルは悪戯っぽい笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: Sol flashed a mischievous smile.

lines.content: だから今日が千和のお誕生日だと勝手に決めたよ。一番大切な記念日だ。三人でお祝いする日はこれからもっと、いっぱい、増やして行ければいいなあって思うよ
lines.translated: "So we went ahead and decided that today is your birthday, Chiwa. It's our most important anniversary. I hope we can keep adding lots and lots more days for the three of us to celebrate from now on."

lines.content: ソルがケーキを切り分ける。
lines.translated: Sol cut the cake into slices.

lines.content: 一番大きなイチゴがのっているのを私にくれた。
lines.translated: He gave me the piece topped with the biggest strawberry.

lines.content: ケーキもイチゴも、きらきら光っているように見えて、なんだかとってもどきどきしたことを覚えてる。
lines.translated: Both the cake and the strawberry looked like they were sparkling, and I remember my heart fluttering with excitement.

lines.content: これ。このケーキ。ナハトが作ってくれたの……？
lines.translated: "This... This cake. Did Nacht make it for me...?"

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: ナハトはいつもの席に座り、やっぱりいつものように新聞を読んでいた。だけど今日は咥えたたばこに火をつけていなかった。
lines.translated: Nacht was sitting in his usual seat, reading the newspaper just like always. Today, however, the cigarette in his mouth wasn't lit.

lines.content: ケーキを一口、食べてみた。
lines.translated: I took a bite of the cake.

lines.content: ……美味いか
lines.translated: "...Is it good?"

lines.content: うん。美味しい
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's delicious."

lines.content: ……そうか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ありがとう
lines.translated: "Thank you."

lines.content: ほんとに、ほんとに、美味しいよ……。とってもね、甘いの
lines.translated: "It's really, really delicious... And it's so very sweet."

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: ナハトは何も言わず、開いた新聞で顔を隠してしまった。
lines.translated: Without a word, Nacht hid his face behind his open newspaper.

lines.content: 私が千和を連れ出している間に用意しておいてもらったんだよ。だけどさ……。ううん。この頃こいつ、料理の腕前が妙にあがったと思わないかな？
lines.translated: "I had him get it ready while I was taking you out, Chiwa. Though... Hmm. Don't you think this guy's cooking skills have gotten weirdly good lately?"

lines.content: うん。そうかも
lines.translated: "Yeah. Maybe."

lines.content: 今日のお弁当も美味しかった。残さず全部食べたよ？　ごちそうさまでした。あ、あのね、小さなハンバーグがね、とっても美味しかったの
lines.translated: "Today's bento was delicious, too. I ate every last bite, you know! Thank you for the meal. Oh, and um, the little hamburger steak was super yummy."

lines.content: しかしなあ。[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|か][・|ら][・|お][・|願][・|い][・|し][・|て][・|お][・|い][・|て]なんだけど、いつの間にこんなかわいい感じの焼き菓子まで作れるようになったんだ君は……
lines.translated: "Still, though. I know I'm the one who asked you to do it, but when on earth did you learn to bake cute pastries like this...?"

lines.content: そうか。[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|で][・|も]料理は上手に作れるのか。これは発見だな。
lines.translated: "I see. So even we can learn to cook well. That's quite the discovery."

lines.content: ソルはぶつぶつと言いつつケーキを一口食べながら、やっぱり私たちに味は感じられないなあもったいないなあと苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Sol muttered to himself as he took a bite of the cake, offering a wry smile as he lamented what a waste it was that they couldn't taste anything after all.

lines.content: ああ、ひとつ夢ができたよ
lines.translated: "Ah, I've found myself a dream."

lines.content: ソルはパッと花咲くような笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: Sol flashed a smile like a blooming flower.

lines.content: 夢？　どんなの？
lines.translated: "A dream? What kind?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: いつか三人で、本当にここでお店をしながら生きていくのも悪くはないなあって
lines.translated: "I was just thinking it wouldn't be half bad if the three of us could actually run a shop here together someday."

lines.content: ソルは苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: Sol gave a wry smile.

lines.content: まあ、うん。本当に夢のまた夢って感じだけれどね。だけどもしも叶えば、それは……それはとてもすてきなことだなあって思うんだ
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. It really is a pipe dream, though. Still, if it ever came true, I think... I think that would be something truly wonderful."

lines.content: ナハトは新聞から視線を逸らし、天井を見つめていた。
lines.translated: Nacht looked away from his newspaper and stared up at the ceiling.

lines.content: その表情はソルの夢について思っているように見えた。
lines.translated: From the look on his face, he seemed to be mulling over Sol's dream.

lines.content: だから私も、そんな未来を想像してみた――
lines.translated: So I tried imagining a future like that, too--

lines.content: ソルが、ウエイターさん。ナハトの作った美味しいケーキやコーヒーを、いつものすてきな笑顔でお客さん達に届けて回る。
lines.translated: Sol would be the waiter. With his usual wonderful smile, he would go around serving the delicious cakes and coffee Nacht made to all the customers.

lines.content: そして私も一緒に、お客さん達の注文を、厨房のナハトに大きな声で伝えたりして……。
lines.translated: And I would help out right alongside them, calling out the customers' orders in a big, loud voice to Nacht in the kitchen...

lines.content: そんな日々がずっとずっと続けばいい。
lines.translated: I wished days like that could go on forever and ever.

lines.content: ……いつか、そんな日が来ればいい。
lines.translated: I hoped that someday, a day like that would come.

lines.content: 三人で一緒に、夢のような未来を思い描いた。
lines.translated: Together, the three of us pictured a dreamlike future.

lines.content: ……いっぱいに咲いたさくらの花が散り始めるその季節。
lines.translated: It was the season when the cherry blossoms in full bloom were just beginning to scatter.

lines.content: 私の一番最初のお誕生日は大切な怪物たちと過ぎていく。
lines.translated: My very first birthday was spent with the monsters I cherished so much.

lines.content: また、プレゼントをもらってしまった。
lines.translated: Once again, they gave me presents.

lines.content: 新しい洋服に、くまのぬいぐるみ。
lines.translated: New clothes, and a stuffed bear.

lines.content: ごめんね。また、かわいくないぬいぐるみで
lines.translated: "Sorry. It's another stuffed animal that isn't very cute."

lines.content: なんだかここに[さら|攫]われてきてからずっと、毎日がケーキみたいに甘々だなあと私は思った。
lines.translated: Ever since I was spirited away to this place, I felt like every single day had been as sweet as cake.

lines.content: 私もふたりに何か返せたらいいのに。
lines.translated: I wished I could give something back to the two of them.

lines.content: どうしたらふたりは喜んでくれるのかな。
lines.translated: What could I do to make them happy?

lines.content: そればかりを考えていたのに……、
lines.translated: That was all I had been thinking about, and yet...

lines.content: ごめんな、千和
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Chiwa."

lines.content: それなのに、ソルが少しさみしそうな顔で私に言った。
lines.translated: Despite everything, Sol spoke to me with a slightly lonely look on his face.

lines.content: どうして？　ぬいぐるみは、かわいいよ？
lines.translated: "Why? The stuffed bear is cute, you know?"

lines.content: ううん。違うよ
lines.translated: "No. That's not it."

lines.content: 君はさ、千和。他の子たちよりずっとかしこい子だけれど、やっぱり君くらいの子はさ、お母さんとか、お父さんだとかに思いきり甘えていたいものだよね
lines.translated: "Look, Chiwa. You're much smarter than other kids your age, but a girl like you must still want to be spoiled to her heart's content by her mom and dad, right?"

lines.content: 私たちが勝手に作った君の誕生日だけれど、特別な日は、特にそうなのではないかとソルは言う。
lines.translated: Even if this was a birthday they had simply made up for me, Sol said that must be especially true on a special day like today.

lines.content: それなのに、君にはとてもさみしい思いをさせてしまっているんじゃないかって、そう思うと……
lines.translated: "And yet, when I think about how we might be making you feel terribly lonely..."

lines.content: 本当に君を[さら|攫]ってきて良かったのかな。そう思うことも時どきだけどあるんだよ。
lines.translated: "Sometimes, I find myself wondering if it was really okay for us to spirit you away like this."

lines.content: 珍しくソルの笑顔が曇っていた。
lines.translated: Unusually for him, Sol's smile was clouded over.

lines.content: ここにこうして[さら|攫]われてこなければ、君には今頃……全然さみしい思いをする必要のない、まったく別の“今”があったかもしれない
lines.translated: "If you hadn't been spirited away here, you might have had a completely different 'now'... one where you wouldn't have to feel lonely at all."

lines.content: そんなことない。
lines.translated: That's not true.

lines.content: さみしくなんてないよ。
lines.translated: I'm not lonely at all.

lines.content: こうして私のために、お誕生日まで祝ってくれるふたりがいるから……。
lines.translated: Because I have the two of you right here, even celebrating my birthday for me...

lines.content: その気持ちを伝えるにはどんな言葉が一番だろう。
lines.translated: What were the best words I could use to convey these feelings?

lines.content: 考えて。
lines.translated: She thought about it.

lines.content: 考えて。
lines.translated: She thought about it.

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ずっとふたりに言いたかったことがあったんだ。
lines.translated: There was something I had been wanting to say to the two of them for a long time.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 私は、座っていた椅子から立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood up from my chair.

lines.content: そしてふたりを順番に見て、言った。恥ずかしかったけれど、思いきって言ってみた。
lines.translated: Then, looking at each of them in turn, I spoke. It was embarrassing, but I mustered my courage and said it.

lines.content: いつも、ありがとう
lines.translated: "Thank you for everything, always."

lines.content: ぱ、パパ……
lines.translated: "P-Papa..."

lines.content: ソルは目を見開いた。
lines.translated: Sol's eyes flew wide open.

lines.content: ナハトは新聞をばさりと落とした。
lines.translated: Nacht dropped his newspaper with a rustle.

lines.content: ……心配してくれて、ありがとう。でもね、さみしくないよ。ほんとだよ
lines.translated: "...Thank you for worrying about me. But you know, I'm not lonely. Really, I'm not."

lines.content: 私はふたりに笑って見せた。
lines.translated: I gave the two of them a smile.

lines.content: だって、私には、パパがふたりもいるんだもん。全然、さみしくなんてないんだよ
lines.translated: "Because I have two whole Papas! I'm not lonely at all."

lines.content: ふと、気づく。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I noticed something.

lines.content: 少し空気が止まってしまっている――ように感じた。ふたりが私をじっと見ていた。
lines.translated: It felt as though time had frozen for a moment. Both of them were staring intently at me.

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: 変なこと、言ったかな。困らせてしまったかな。
lines.translated: Did I say something weird? Did I trouble them?

lines.content: 少し焦ってしまったけれど、
lines.translated: I started to panic a little, when...

lines.content: ふ
え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ふ、お、おおおおおおおっ
lines.translated: "Pff, w-woooooooah!"

lines.content: 勢いよくソルが立ち上がった。
lines.translated: Sol shot up from his seat.

lines.content: も、もう一回、今のもう一回言ってみてよ千和っ
lines.translated: "O-One more time! Say what you just said one more time, Chiwa!"

lines.content: ……パパ？
lines.translated: "...Papa?"

lines.content: お、おおう……
lines.translated: "O-Oh, right..."

lines.content: ソルは頭を抱えてふらりとした。
lines.translated: Sol clutched his head and staggered.

lines.content: ……まずい。これ、まずいよ。鼻血が出そう
lines.translated: "...This is bad. This is really bad. I think my nose is gonna bleed."

lines.content: ……何をデレデレしているんだ。気色の悪い
lines.translated: "...What are you fawning over? It's disgusting."

lines.content: 新聞をナハトは拾い直し、咳払いをしていた。
lines.translated: Nacht picked his newspaper back up and cleared his throat.

lines.content: まったく。それくらいのことで動転するとはな。見苦しいにも程といういうものがある
lines.translated: "Good grief. Getting that flustered over something so trivial. There is a limit to how unsightly you can be."

lines.content: ……おい
……なんだ
lines.translated: "...What."

lines.content: 新聞が、逆さまだぞ
lines.translated: "Your newspaper is upside down."

lines.content: ……気のせいだ
lines.translated: "...It's your imagination."

lines.content: いや。気のせいって
lines.translated: "No. What do you mean, my imagination?"

lines.content: ……なあ、今日は千和のお誕生日だ。そう決めたろ？　特別な日なんだ。少しくらい素直になれよ。君だって充分動転しちゃってるんじゃないのか？
lines.translated: "...Come on, today is Chiwa's birthday. We decided that, didn't we? It's a special day. Be a little honest with yourself. You're plenty flustered yourself, aren't you?"

lines.content: ふん。ありえん
lines.translated: "Hmph. Impossible."

lines.content: うれしいなら素直に喜べばいいだろうってだけの話なのになあ。そうすれば千和だってうれしいはずだ。そうだよね、千和
lines.translated: "I'm just saying, if you're happy, you should just be honest and show it. That would make Chiwa happy, too. Right, Chiwa?"

lines.content: う、うん……
lines.translated: Y-yeah...

lines.content: ……別に
lines.translated: "...Not really."

lines.content: ふん、と鼻を鳴らしてナハトは言う。
lines.translated: Nacht gave a loud snort and spoke.

lines.content: お前たちはものを知らなさすぎる。どころか文字を読む方法も知らないのか。人間とはありとあらゆるものが逆転しているのが俺たちなんだ。時に文字を逆から読むことだってある
lines.translated: "You two are far too ignorant. Do you not even know how to read letters? Everything about us is the exact opposite of humans. At times, we even read letters upside down."

lines.content: だから、別に、これはごくふつうのことで、おかしなことは何も……
lines.translated: "So there is nothing strange about this at all. It is completely normal..."

lines.content: 逆さまの新聞を読みながら、ナハトが早口でそう言っていた。
lines.translated: Nacht rattled this off in rapid-fire speech while staring at his upside-down newspaper.

lines.content: 千和。こいつの癖をひとつ教えようか？
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Want me to tell you one of this guy's habits?"

lines.content: え？　どんなの……？
lines.translated: "Huh? What is it...?"

lines.content: ああ。隠し事があったりするとね、こいつ、饒舌になるんだよ。普段は[・|あ][・|ん][・|な]なのに……とってもね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Whenever he's hiding something, he gets super talkative. Even though he's usually like that... he really babbles on."

lines.content: いったいどんな気持ちを隠してるのかなあと、ソルは意地悪な笑顔でナハトを見ていた。
lines.translated: Sol looked at Nacht with a teasing grin, wondering aloud just what kind of feelings he was trying to hide.

lines.content: お誕生日をパパたちにお祝いしてもらった夜のこと。
lines.translated: That night, after my Papas celebrated my birthday for me...

lines.content: なんだか、眠れなかった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't fall asleep.

lines.content: 『眠れない夜は暖かなミルクを飲んでみる。身体が温まると心も緩むよ』
lines.translated: "On nights when you can't sleep, try drinking some warm milk. Warming your body helps your heart relax, too."

lines.content: ソルが暖めてくれたミルクを飲み過ぎたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe I had drunk too much of the milk Sol warmed up for me.

lines.content: お手洗いにベッドから起きて一階に降りると、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り][・|の][・|部][・|屋]に明かりが灯っていることに気づいた。
lines.translated: When I got out of bed to use the restroom and went downstairs, I noticed the light was on in their room.

lines.content: まだ、起きてるの……？
lines.translated: "Are you still awake...?"

lines.content: 扉を薄く開いて、声を掛けてみた。
lines.translated: I cracked the door open slightly and called out to them.

lines.content: すると部屋にはソルがひとりで椅子に座っていた。こちらをいつもの笑顔で振り返ってくれる。
lines.translated: Inside, Sol was sitting alone on a chair. He turned back toward me with his usual smile.

lines.content: うん。起きてるよ。私たちは特に毎晩欠かさず眠る必要もないからね
lines.translated: "Yeah, I'm awake. It's not like we need to sleep every single night without fail, after all."

lines.content: そうだった
lines.translated: "That's right."

lines.content: ソルの笑顔に私も笑顔でうなずいた。
lines.translated: I returned Sol's smile and nodded.

lines.content: 眠れないのかな？
lines.translated: "Having trouble sleeping?"

lines.content: ……ちょっとだけ
lines.translated: "...Just a little."

lines.content: 今日という日がとても楽しい日だったから……。
lines.translated: Today had been such a fun day...

lines.content: だからなんだか眠るのがもったいないと、そう感じてしまっていたかもしれない。部屋のベッドに横になると、なんだかさみいし気持ちが膨らんだ。
lines.translated: Maybe that was why I felt like going to sleep would be a waste. When I lay down in my bed, a lonely feeling had swelled up inside me.

lines.content: それに、少しだけ気になることもあったから……。
lines.translated: Besides, there was something that had been bothering me just a little bit...

lines.content: ……おいで
lines.translated: "...Come here."

lines.content: ソルが手招きしてくれる。
lines.translated: Sol beckoned me over.

lines.content: 私は喜んで駆けていく。ソルの膝の上に座った。
lines.translated: I happily ran to him and sat down on his lap.

lines.content: そんな私をいつもみたいに後ろからぎゅっと抱きしめてくれて、私は、とってもうれしいけれど……、
lines.translated: He wrapped his arms tightly around me from behind just like always, which made me really happy, but...

lines.content: ……大丈夫？
lines.translated: "...Are you okay?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 今日……
lines.translated: "Today..."

lines.content: 私は、抱きしめられた膝の上から、ソルの顔を見上げた。
lines.translated: From my seat on his lap, wrapped in his arms, I looked up at Sol's face.

lines.content: 今日、時どき、さみしそうな顔をしてたように……見えたから
lines.translated: "Today, it looked like you were making a lonely face from time to time..."

lines.content: たとえば公園で、こうして私を抱きしめてくれていたとき。
lines.translated: Like at the park, when he was holding me just like this.

lines.content: たとえば、私のことを[さら|攫]ったのは正しかったのかなと、そう言っていたとき。
lines.translated: Or when he was wondering aloud if kidnapping me had really been the right thing to do.

lines.content: ……なんだか[・|い][・|つ][・|も][・|よ][・|り]、さみしそうだった。だから、大丈夫なのかなって
lines.translated: "...Somehow, you looked even lonelier than usual. So I was wondering if you were okay."

lines.content: え？　……いつもより？
lines.translated: "Huh? ...More than usual?"

lines.content: うん。……そう。いつもより、だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...That's right. More than usual."

lines.content: 驚いた顔をしたソルだったけれど、
lines.translated: Sol looked surprised, though.

lines.content: ……ソルも、ナハトも。時どきとっても、さみしそうに……見えるよ？
lines.translated: "...Both you and Nacht. Sometimes you both look... really lonely, you know?"

lines.content: そう続けた私に、千和、君は、すごい子だな、と言って微笑んだ。
lines.translated: When I added that, he smiled and said, "Chiwa, you really are an amazing girl."

lines.content: その小さな笑顔の中に、やっぱり[・|い][・|つ][・|も][・|よ][・|り]少しだけ大きなさみしい気持ちが隠れているように、私には見えた――ずっと、ずっとそうだった。
lines.translated: Hidden inside that small smile, it still looked to me like there was a lonely feeling just a little bigger than usual--it had always, always been that way.

lines.content: ソルはいつも笑顔でいてくれる。
lines.translated: Sol always kept a smile on his face for me.

lines.content: にこにこ笑って、慣れない場所に[さら|攫]われてきた私に、いっぱい安心をくれるけど。
lines.translated: He would grin warmly, giving me so much peace of mind after I had been kidnapped and brought to an unfamiliar place, and yet...

lines.content: そんな笑顔の中に、いつも小さな“さみしい気持ち”が見え隠れしていたように思えたのだ。
lines.translated: It felt like a tiny "lonely feeling" was always peeking through that smile of his.

lines.content: ……私、ふたりの役に立てる？
lines.translated: "...Can I be of help to the two of you?"

lines.content: いつかの夜。眠れない夜。私はソルに自分の“さみしい気持ち”を聞いてもらった。だから……、
lines.translated: On some past night. A sleepless night. Sol had listened to my own "lonely feelings." That's why...

lines.content: いつも、私、ふたりに色々してもらうばっかりで……。だからね、お願い……何かお返ししたいなあって……思って
lines.translated: "You two are always doing so much for me... So please... I was thinking I want to give something back..."

lines.content: そっか。千和にはバレバレだったのか
lines.translated: "I see. So you saw right through me, Chiwa."

lines.content: ソルが私を撫でてくれる。やっぱり君はすごい子だ。やさしい子だ。そう言いながら。
lines.translated: Sol gently stroked my head. "You really are an amazing girl. Such a kind girl," he said as he did.

lines.content: 今日も、とっても楽しかったから……うん。昔のことをいつもより少し強く、思い出してしまったみたいなんだ
lines.translated: "Today was so much fun, too... Yeah. It seems I ended up remembering the old days a little more strongly than usual."
"Today, too...?"

lines.content: うん。そうだよ。君を[さら|攫]って来てからはずっと楽しい日ばかりだからね。そして今日は、もっともっと、楽しかったから……
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. Ever since we kidnapped you and brought you here, every single day has been nothing but fun. And because today was even more fun than usual..."

lines.content: ソルはそこで口を閉ざした。
lines.translated: Sol trailed off and closed his mouth.

lines.content: じっと見ているのは、目の前に置かれたキャンバスの絵だった。そこには知らない子の笑顔が描かれていた。
lines.translated: He was staring fixedly at the painted canvas resting in front of him. Depicted on it was the smiling face of a child I didn't know.

lines.content: ……私のお話、聞いてくれるかな？
lines.translated: "...Would you be willing to listen to my story?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: もちろんだよと私はうなずく。
lines.translated: "Of course," I said, nodding.

lines.content: 今度は私が、お話、聞く番だから
lines.translated: "Because this time, it's my turn to listen to your story."

lines.content: 私はソルの手を握った――[・|あ][・|の][・|夜]、眠れない私の手をソルが握ってくれたみたいに。そうして、私のさみしい気持ちを聞いてくれたみたいに。
lines.translated: I took Sol's hand--just like Sol had held my hand on that sleepless night. And just like he had listened to my lonely feelings.

lines.content: ありがとうと、ソルは微笑む。
lines.translated: "Thank you," Sol said with a smile.

lines.content: そしてまずは一言、私にこう教えてくれた。
lines.translated: Then, to start, he told me one thing.

lines.content: 私はね、元々はごくふつうの人間だったんだよ
lines.translated: "You see, originally, I was a completely ordinary human."

lines.content: ぽつり、ぽつりとソルはお話をはじめた。
lines.translated: Slowly, bit by bit, Sol began to tell his story.

lines.content: ……ずっと昔の話だ。
lines.translated: It was a story from a long, long time ago.

lines.content: 私と同じ人間だったソルにはちゃんと名前があって、家族もいた。
lines.translated: Back when Sol was a human just like me, he had a proper name, and a family, too.

lines.content: この町で産まれて、この町で育った。大好きな[人|妻]と出会い、結婚をして……子どももひとり、授かったんだ
lines.translated: "I was born in this town, and grew up in this town. I met the woman I loved, got married... and we were blessed with a single child."

lines.content: 幸せだったんだと思う。ソルは細く静かな声で言う。
lines.translated: "I think we were happy," Sol said in a thin, quiet voice.

lines.content: だけど……。私たちの子が六つになった日のことだ
lines.translated: "However... It happened on the day our child turned six."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は、事故だった。
lines.translated: It was an accident.

lines.content: お誕生日を三人で祝ったんだ。今日みたいに美味しいケーキを三人で一緒に食べたんだよ……
lines.translated: "The three of us celebrated her birthday. We ate delicious cake together, just like today..."

lines.content: 私たちのかわいい子はこれからどんな人生を送るのかな。幸せになってほしいな。たぶん何もかもが上手くいくようなことはない。一筋縄にはいかないだろうことも多いだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of life would our adorable child lead from here on out? I hoped she would be happy. Things probably wouldn't always go smoothly. There would surely be many times when life wasn't straightforward.

lines.content: それでも、幸せになることを諦めず生きていってほしいな。
lines.translated: Even so, I wanted her to live on without ever giving up on finding happiness.

lines.content: そんなふうに祈ることが、何よりも幸せだったんだ……
lines.translated: "Being able to pray for things like that made me happier than anything..."

lines.content: でも、そんな幸せはちょっとした不注意にあっという間に足下を掬われた。
lines.translated: However, in the blink of an eye, a moment of carelessness swept that happiness right out from under their feet.

lines.content: 火の不始末だった。
lines.translated: It was an accidental fire.

lines.content: 吹き消したはずのろうそくの火。
lines.translated: The flame of a candle they thought they had blown out.

lines.content: ちゃんと消したはずのその火が、捨てたゴミ箱の中で大きくなって……。
lines.translated: That tiny spark, which should have been properly extinguished, grew inside the trash can where it was thrown away...

lines.content: 気づいたとき、ソルは病院のベッドにいた。
lines.translated: When Sol came to, he was in a hospital bed.

lines.content: そこで、自分だけが助かったのだと知らされた。
lines.translated: There, he was told that he was the only one who had survived.

lines.content: 包帯でぐるぐる巻きの状態だ。全身が痛い。重度のやけどを負っていた。生きているのも奇跡のようだとお医者さんたちは口々に言った。
lines.translated: He was wrapped head to toe in bandages. His entire body ached. He had suffered severe burns. The doctors all said it was a miracle he was even alive.

lines.content: だけどそれは本当に奇跡だったのか。たったひとり残されることのどこが幸運だというのだろうか。
lines.translated: Yet was it truly a miracle? What part of being the only one left behind could possibly be called fortunate?

lines.content: ソルは泣いて。泣いて。
lines.translated: Sol cried. And cried.

lines.content: ……ふと、思い出したんだ。学校の生徒たちが話していたことを
lines.translated: "...Suddenly, I remembered something I had heard the students at school talking about."

lines.content: この町にはいくつも不思議な“噂”がある。
lines.translated: There were several mysterious "rumors" in this town.

lines.content: そのひとつに……[・|さ][・|く][・|ら]だ。
lines.translated: One of them... was about the cherry blossom tree.

lines.content: 学園の時計塔に寄り添うようにたつ大きなおおきなさくらの樹。
lines.translated: A huge, massive cherry blossom tree standing nestled against the academy's clock tower.

lines.content: “その根元にはこの町で死んだ者たちの命が埋まってる”
lines.translated: "Beneath its roots lie buried the lives of those who have died in this town."

lines.content: “あのさくらは死者の命を吸い上げ、咲いていて……”
lines.translated: "That cherry tree drinks up the lives of the dead to bloom..."

lines.content: “満月の夜。あのさくらの木の根を、大切な人の名前を途切れることなく呟きながら素手で掘り起こしていく”
lines.translated: "On the night of a full moon, dig up the roots of that cherry tree with your bare hands while whispering the name of your precious person without pause."

lines.content: “すると死んでしまったはずの人が、掘り起こした穴の中に現れる”
lines.translated: "Do that, and the person who died will appear inside the hole you dug."

lines.content: “その人のことを抱きしめて、名前を呼んで、目を、覚ましたら……。手を繋いで一緒にお家に帰れる”
lines.translated: "If you embrace them, call their name, and they open their eyes... you can hold hands and go home together."

lines.content: “ただし取り戻したい人が死去してから一週間以内でしか効果はない”
lines.translated: "However, it only works within one week of the death of the person you wish to bring back."

lines.content: ……最初その話を聞いたときは、子どもたちは面白いことを信じるんだなあって思うばかりで、もちろん、信じてはいなかった
lines.translated: "...When I first heard that story, I just thought kids sure do believe in interesting things. Of course, I didn't believe it myself."

lines.content: そういう話を“大人”は信じちゃだめなんだって、どこかでそう思っていたんだろうけれど……病院でたったひとり目覚めた私は……信じなければと思った
lines.translated: "Deep down, I probably figured 'adults' shouldn't believe in stories like that... Yet when I woke up all alone in that hospital... I felt that I had to believe."

lines.content: そうでなければ心が死んでしまうと、思った。
lines.translated: Otherwise, he felt as though his heart would die.

lines.content: 心が、真っ暗だった。意識していないと呼吸も忘れてしまいそう。
lines.translated: His heart was pitch black. If he didn't consciously focus on it, he felt like he might forget how to breathe.

lines.content: たとえ幻みたいにあり得ないものでも、ひとつ……“希望”がないと、今にも全部が消えてなくなってしまいそうだった。
lines.translated: Even if it was something as impossible as an illusion, if he didn't have just one shred of "hope"... it felt like everything was about to vanish completely right then and there.

lines.content: ソルは真夜中に病院を抜け出した。
lines.translated: Sol snuck out of the hospital in the dead of night.

lines.content: 自分が眠りから目覚めたのは、事故があってから五日後だ。
lines.translated: He had woken from his slumber five days after the accident occurred.

lines.content: 噂話によると効果があるのは一週間。
lines.translated: According to the rumor, it only worked within a week.

lines.content: 病院を抜け出すには医者たちの目を盗まなければならず……。一日をベッドの上で空費した。
lines.translated: To sneak out of the hospital, he had to slip past the doctors' watchful eyes... wasting an entire day lying in bed.

lines.content: 残り時間は病院を抜け出した夜しかなかった。
lines.translated: The only time he had left was the very night he escaped the hospital.

lines.content: 火傷でただれた身体を引きずるようにして、ソルは夜の街を走った。
lines.translated: Dragging his burn-ravaged body along, Sol ran through the streets at night.

lines.content: 見上げれば、さくらだ。
lines.translated: When he looked up, there was the cherry tree.

lines.content: 学園の時計塔に寄り添うさくらは、町を覆い隠すほど大きく枝を伸ばしていて……。
lines.translated: The cherry tree nestled against the academy's clock tower stretched its branches out wide enough to cover the town...

lines.content: そのすべてにいっぱい咲かせた花は、満月の光を受けて、[ひとひら|一片]ひとひらがまばゆく瞬いているようだった。
lines.translated: And the countless blossoms blooming across every branch caught the light of the full moon, each and every petal seeming to twinkle dazzlingly.

lines.content: ソルはさくらの根元を掘り返した。
lines.translated: Sol dug into the earth at the base of the cherry tree.

lines.content: 大切な人。大好きな人。“さよなら”をしてしまった人。……取り戻したい人。
lines.translated: His precious people. The people he loved so much. The people he had been forced to say "goodbye" to. ...The people he wanted to bring back.

lines.content: 何度も何度も名前を叫んだ。
lines.translated: He screamed their names over and over again.

lines.content: 爪は剥がれ、血が噴き出して、肉が裂け、指先に骨がむき出しになった頃……。
lines.translated: By the time his nails were torn off, blood was spurting out, his flesh split open, and the bones of his fingertips were exposed...

lines.content: 涙が、あふれた。
lines.translated: Tears overflowed.

lines.content: わかってた。
lines.translated: He knew.

lines.content: こんなことをしても意味がないことくらい……。
lines.translated: He knew full well that doing something like this was meaningless...

lines.content: こんなことを心から信じていられるほど子どもではなかった。
lines.translated: He wasn't a child anymore, naive enough to truly believe in such a thing from the bottom of his heart.

lines.content: 夢も、希望も、どこか遠い時間の中に置き去りにしてきた。大人になるということはそういうことだ。
lines.translated: He had left both dreams and hope behind somewhere in the distant past. That was what it meant to grow up.

lines.content: どうして……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: どうしてこんなことになってしまったんだろう。
lines.translated: Why had things turned out like this?

lines.content: 幸せだったのに。
lines.translated: They had been so happy.

lines.content: それ以上のことは何も望んでいなかったのに。
lines.translated: He hadn't wished for a single thing more than what he already had.

lines.content: 痛い……。
lines.translated: It hurt...

lines.content: 身体中が軋んだ。
lines.translated: His whole body creaked in agony.

lines.content: 何もかもが、痛い。
lines.translated: Everything hurt.

lines.content: 心がひび割れる音がした。
lines.translated: He heard the sound of his heart cracking.

lines.content: このままここで死んでしまえたらどれだけ楽か。
lines.translated: How much easier would it be if he could just die right here like this?

lines.content: そう、思ったときだ。
lines.translated: It was the exact moment he thought that.

lines.content: ……命を差し出せ
lines.translated: "...Offer up your life."

lines.content: 声がした。
lines.translated: A voice called out.

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: するとそこには“夜”そのものとも思えるほど真っ黒な“[何か|誰か]”が立っていた。
lines.translated: Standing right there was "someone" as pitch-black as the "Night" itself.

lines.content: 鋭い真紅の瞳が、さくらの根元にうずくまる私を見下ろしている。
lines.translated: Sharp crimson eyes looked down at me as I crouched at the base of the cherry tree.

lines.content: お前の命と、お前の大切な誰かの終わってしまった命とを、今、ここで、このさくらの樹の下で……交換するんだ
lines.translated: "Right now, right here, beneath this cherry tree... you shall exchange your life for the ended life of someone precious to you."

lines.content: この世界のすべては時間が支配している。命もそうだ。あらかじめ与えられた時間を一秒一秒、じわじわと消費しながら生き続けていく――
lines.translated: "Everything in this world is ruled by time. Life is no exception. You continue to live by slowly, second by second, consuming the time allotted to you beforehand--"
"It is about how you use your life. The time you are given. The true value of a life lies in how it is used."

lines.content: ……つまり命の残り[寿命|時間]を、[・|“][・|夜][・|”][・|の][・|根][・|源]であるそのさくらの巨木に差し出せるというのなら、大切な人を蘇らせることが叶うのだという。
lines.translated: In other words, if he was willing to offer the remaining time of his lifespan to this giant cherry tree--the very source of the "Night"--his wish to revive someone precious to him would be granted.

lines.content: 差し出した残り時間だけ、蘇った[・|そ][・|の][・|人]は、お前の代わりに生きていくことができる
lines.translated: "The revived person will be able to live on in your stead for the exact amount of remaining time you offer up."

lines.content: ……ああ、下らない。
lines.translated: Ah, how ridiculous.

lines.content: また、噂話か。
lines.translated: Another rumor?

lines.content: バカを言うな。そんなこと、できるわけ……
lines.translated: Don't be absurd. As if something like that could possibly...

lines.content: できる
lines.translated: "It can."

lines.content: “夜”ははっきりと言い切った。
lines.translated: The "Night" stated it flatly.

lines.content: いいか人間。目に見えるものだけが真実だと疑わないのは、お前たちの欠点のひとつだ
lines.translated: "Listen to me, human. Never doubting that only what you can see with your own eyes is the truth is one of your kind's greatest flaws."

lines.content: 空気だって目には見えないがここにある。
lines.translated: "Even the air is invisible to the eye, yet it is right here."

lines.content: 青臭くむずがゆい話だが――お前の中に“大切な人を思う気持ち”だって、目には見えないが、確かに[・|そ][・|こ]にあるだろう。
lines.translated: "It may sound naive and cringeworthy, but--even the 'feelings you hold for your precious people' inside you are invisible to the eye, yet they are undeniably right there, aren't they?"

lines.content: ため息交じりに“[誰か|夜]”がそう言い、ソルの隣を指さした。
lines.translated: Saying this with a sigh, that "someone"--the "Night"--pointed right next to Sol.

lines.content: ……まだ、お前の家族は“夜”の中にいる。感じないのか？　ふたりはお前のそばにいる。ずっと、お前のことを見つめているぞ
lines.translated: "...Your family is still here within the 'Night.' Can't you feel them? The two of them are right beside you. They have been watching over you this entire time."

lines.content: 涙が、止まらなかった。
lines.translated: My tears wouldn't stop.

lines.content: そばに？
lines.translated: Beside me?

lines.content: ずっと……？
lines.translated: This entire time...?

lines.content: こんな姿を、ふたりが……ずっと見ていた？
lines.translated: The two of them... have been watching me in this pathetic state the whole time?

lines.content: さあ、どうするんだ。お前の[時間|寿命]をすべて差し出せば、大切な人をどちらかひとり、蘇らせられる。焼け落ちた身体も元通りにできるだろう
lines.translated: "Now, what will you do? If you offer up all of your remaining time--your lifespan--you can revive one of the people precious to you. Even a burned, ruined body will be restored to how it was."

lines.content: その代わり……。
lines.translated: Instead...

lines.content: お前はもう二度と、その者に会うことはできなくなるぞ。それだけは理解しておくことだ
lines.translated: "However, you will never be able to meet that person again. Make sure you understand that much."

lines.content: ……なぜ
なぜ、会えなくなるのか。
lines.translated: Why wouldn't I be able to meet them again?

lines.content: 命を差し出せばお前の時間は停止する。そして“不死”となる。“夜”の一部になるんだよ
lines.translated: "Once you offer up your life, your time will come to a halt. You will become 'immortal.' You will become a part of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: わかるだろう？　太陽と月は相容れないもの。俺たちは[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|イ][・|キ][・|モ][・|ノ]なのだと理解しろ
lines.translated: "You understand, don't you? The sun and the moon are incompatible. Understand that we are that kind of creature."

lines.content: 迷いなどなかった。
lines.translated: There was no hesitation.

lines.content: 私の不注意だ。すべて私に責任がある。幸せに、足下を掬われたのだ。
lines.translated: It was my own carelessness. All of the responsibility lies with me. I had the rug pulled out from under me by my own happiness.

lines.content: 大切な子の人生を私が奪ってしまった。あの子の幸せを祈っていたはずの私自身が――ごめんな。
lines.translated: I stole away the life of my precious child. I, the very person who was supposed to be praying for that child's happiness--I'm so sorry.

lines.content: 妻の名前を何度も呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called out my wife's name over and over again.

lines.content: 本当は君も蘇らせたい。
lines.translated: In truth, I want to bring you back, too.

lines.content: だけど、可能なのはどちらかひとり……で、あるらしいから。
lines.translated: However, it seems that I can only save one of you...

lines.content: 隣で[・|君]はきっとうなずいていてくれる。
lines.translated: Right beside me, I'm sure you are nodding in agreement.

lines.content: そう、信じて……。
lines.translated: Believing that...

lines.content: その時点で私の残り[寿命|時間]がどれだけ残っていたかわからないけれど……。私は、残されたすべての寿命を差し出すと、うなずいたんだ
lines.translated: "I didn't know how much of my remaining lifespan was left at that point, but... I nodded, agreeing to offer up every last bit of the time I had left."
And just like that, Sol became a fellow "Monster of the Night."

lines.content: ……どうやって命と命を交換したの？
lines.translated: "...How did you exchange your life for theirs?"

lines.content: 子どもの心は好奇心の塊だ。
lines.translated: A child's heart is a bundle of curiosity.

lines.content: こんなことを問いかけてソルが傷ついてしまうかもしれないと――その可能性に、言葉を吐き出してから私は気づいた。
lines.translated: Asking something like this might end up hurting Sol--I only realized that possibility after the words had already left my mouth.

lines.content: だけどソルは微笑んで、私に色々と教えてくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, Sol smiled and taught me all sorts of things.

lines.content: 少し眠れと言われたよ
lines.translated: "I was told to sleep for a little while."

lines.content: 眠る？
lines.translated: "Sleep?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 私が、必死になってさくらの根元を掘り起こしていた穴だよ。そこに入って眠れと言われたんだ。次に目覚めたとき、私は命をなくしてる。そしてそこはもう“夜”の中だって
lines.translated: "In the hole I had been desperately digging at the base of the cherry tree. He told me to get inside it and go to sleep. That the next time I woke up, my life would be gone, and I would already be inside the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 穴の中に横になると、[あいつ|ナハト]が私に土を被せていった。
lines.translated: When I lay down inside the hole, that guy--Nacht--covered me in dirt.

lines.content: 私の中から“何か”が抜け落ちていくような感覚があり――眠った。深く、ふかく私は眠ったんだ
lines.translated: "I felt 'something' slipping away from inside me--and then I fell asleep. Deeply, so deeply, I slept."

lines.content: そして次に目を覚ましたとき、私は確かに、見たことのない“夜”の中にいた。
lines.translated: And the next time I opened my eyes, I was indeed inside a "Night" unlike any I had ever seen.

lines.content: 私は私を“怪物”にした男と共に暮らすことになった。
lines.translated: I ended up living together with the man who had turned me into a "monster."

lines.content: 古いカフェが彼の根城だ。
lines.translated: An old cafe was his hideout.

lines.content: どうしてこんなところに住んでいるのかと問いかけると、“夜の怪物”はコーヒーが好物なんだよと適当なことを言われ、私は笑った。きっとただの趣味だったんだろう。
lines.translated: When I asked him why he lived in a place like this, he gave me some flippant answer about how "Monsters of the Night" love coffee, and I laughed. I'm sure it was just a hobby of his.

lines.content: 彼の根城にはたくさんの音楽や物語が溢れていた。
