lines.translated: His hideout was overflowing with all kinds of music and stories.

lines.content: それもまた彼の趣味だったのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think that was probably just another hobby of his, too.

lines.content: ……“怪物”は人の心を持たないイキモノだ。だから[ゼロ|無]から何かを生み出すことができない――お前も怪物になったのだから俺と同じだ。心を持たない。だから涙ももう流せない
lines.translated: "...'Monsters' are creatures without human hearts. That is why we cannot create anything from nothing--from zero. Since you have become a monster as well, you are the same as me. You have no heart. Which means you can no longer shed tears, either."

lines.content: だがそれでは[・|“][・|役][・|割][・|”]を果たせはしないから、常にこうして人の心が生み出したものに触れている。お前もそうしろ
lines.translated: "However, since we cannot fulfill our 'role' like that, I am constantly exposing myself to things created by the human heart in this way. You should do the same."

lines.content: 彼はいつも同じ席で音楽を聴きながら新聞や本を読んでいた。
lines.translated: He was always sitting in the exact same seat, reading newspapers and books while listening to music.

lines.content: ……胸に手を当てると鼓動がなかった。火傷だらけだった身体もまったく無傷になっていた。
lines.translated: When I placed a hand over my chest, there was no heartbeat. My body, which had been covered in burns, was now completely unscathed.

lines.content: これは、夢だな。改めて私はそう思うことにした。これから私は夢の中で生きていく。
lines.translated: This must be a dream. I decided once again to think of it that way. From now on, I would live on inside a dream.

lines.content: ……“役割”とは？
lines.translated: What do you mean by "role"?

lines.content: ああ……いいか。“夜”の中に産まれる者たちにはすべて“役割”がある。ここに不要な者などひとりもいないんだ
lines.translated: "Ah... listen well. Every single one of those born into the 'Night' has a 'role.' There is not a single unnecessary person here."

lines.content: “夜の怪物”に与えられた[仕事|役割]は少女を[さら|攫]うことだった――
lines.translated: The work--the role--given to the "Monsters of the Night" was to spirit away young girls--

lines.content: “[現実世界|太陽の時間]”でどうしようもない苦しみに涙を流し続けてる女の子を[さら|攫]って来ては、その命を身体から抜き出し、“夜”の一員として受け入れた。
lines.translated: We would spirit away girls who were endlessly shedding tears over inescapable suffering in the "real world"--the time of the sun--extract the lives from their bodies, and welcome them in as members of the "Night."

lines.content: そして取り出した命はあのさくらの樹に捧げる。
lines.translated: And the extracted lives were offered up to that cherry tree.

lines.content: 少女らの命を源に、あのさくらの巨木はいつまでも満開だった。
lines.translated: With the lives of those girls as its source, that giant cherry tree remained in full bloom forever.

lines.content: 冬でも。夏でも。秋でも。いつまでも――雪降る中に満開のさくら。その光景はうつくしい“夜”の中ででも、一際うつくしく感じられるものだった。
lines.translated: Even in winter. Even in summer. Even in autumn. Forever and always--cherry blossoms in full bloom amidst the falling snow. Even within the beautiful "Night," that scenery felt exceptionally breathtaking.

lines.content: ……あのさくらが完全に枯れてしまうと“夜”もまた消滅するといわれてる。この時間を、“夜”を維持することが俺たちの役割なんだ。……きっとな
lines.translated: "...It is said that if that cherry tree withers completely, the 'Night' will also vanish. Maintaining this time, maintaining the 'Night,' is our role. ...Surely."

lines.content: “夜”の中には私たち以外にどんなイキモノが住んでいるんだ？
lines.translated: What other kinds of creatures live inside the "Night" besides us?

lines.content: 色々だとあいつは言った。
lines.translated: All sorts, he said.

lines.content: 色々なイキモノが、色々な“役割”を持って生きている。
lines.translated: All sorts of creatures live here, each holding all sorts of different "roles."

lines.content: その中でも“猫”は自分たちと対局にあるのだとあいつは言った。
lines.translated: Among them, he said, the "Cats" stood at the complete opposite end of the spectrum from us.

lines.content: ……[・|あ][・|い][・|つ][・|ら]は[・|少][・|年][・|少][・|女]らの“悪夢”だけを心から抜き出し、どこか遠いところへ送るようだが……
lines.translated: "...It seems those ones extract only the 'nightmares' from the hearts of boys and girls and send them off to somewhere far away, but..."

lines.content: そんなことをしても子どもらの現実は何も変わらない。“夜”だって維持できない
lines.translated: "Doing something like that changes nothing about the children's reality. It can't maintain the 'Night,' either."

lines.content: 心を傷つける原因をなくさなければまた同じように子どもらは傷つく。あいつらのやっていることは所詮その場しのぎでしかないんだよ
lines.translated: "Unless you eliminate the root cause of what is hurting their hearts, the children will just be hurt in the exact same way all over again. What they are doing is nothing more than a stopgap measure in the end."

lines.content: ……私たち“夜の怪物”が[さら|攫]う[子どもたち|女の子]には共通点があった。
lines.translated: The children--the girls--whom we "Monsters of the Night" spirited away all had something in common.

lines.content: “さみしい思い”をしている少女だ。
lines.translated: They were young girls suffering from "feelings of loneliness."

lines.content: それもどういうわけか、愛されることに飢えている子らばかりを[・|あ][・|の][・|さ][・|く][・|ら][・|は][・|選][・|ん][・|だ]。
lines.translated: And for whatever reason, that cherry tree chose only children who were starved for love.

lines.content: ……満月の夜。
lines.translated: A night of the full moon.

lines.content: 咲き誇るさくらの天井を見上げると、はらはらと舞い落ちる花びらに乗り――今、この町のどこかで涙を流している女の子の映像もまた、頭の中に降りてくる。
lines.translated: Whenever I looked up at the ceiling of cherry blossoms in full bloom, riding upon the petals fluttering gently down--visions of a girl shedding tears somewhere in this town right now would also drift down into my mind.

lines.content: それは、私たち“怪物”だけに？
lines.translated: Does that happen only to us "monsters"?

lines.content: ……そうだ。俺たち“夜の怪物”の頭の中にだけだ
lines.translated: "...That's right. Only inside the minds of us 'Monsters of the Night.'"

lines.content: だからそれが俺たちの“役割”なのだと信じる。あいつはそう言い、次のレコードを選んでいた。
lines.translated: That was why he believed it to be our "role." Saying that, he began picking out the next record.

lines.content: あいつの煎れたコーヒーを一口飲んだ。
lines.translated: I took a sip of the coffee he had brewed.

lines.content: まったく味がしないのは私がもう人間ではないことの証のひとつだった。
lines.translated: The fact that it had no taste whatsoever was one piece of proof that I was no longer human.

lines.content: 少しさみしいなと感じる。そして私たちの子は今ごろどうしているのだろうかと考えた。私が渡した残り時間をどんなふうに使っているのか。
lines.translated: I felt that it was a little lonely. And then I wondered how our child was doing right about now. How they were using the remaining time I had passed on to them.

lines.content: 二度と会うことを許されない大切な人を“夜”の中で繰り返し想い続けた。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," I thought of that precious person I was never allowed to meet again, over and over.

lines.content: ……次の音楽が流れ始める。
lines.translated: The next piece of music began to play.

lines.content: ところで
lines.translated: "By the way."

lines.content: ……なんだ
lines.translated: "...What."

lines.content: いつも思ってたんだが、君の選曲のセンスはあんまりにひどいと思うんだが……そこのところを話し合おうか
lines.translated: "I've been thinking this for a while now, but I find your taste in music to be utterly atrocious... Shall we have a little talk about that?"

lines.content: ……ふん。いいだろう。私たちの命にはあまりあるほど時間がある。なんといっても“不死”だからな。いくらでも話そうじゃないか
lines.translated: "...Hmph. Very well. Our lives have more than enough time to spare. After all, we are 'immortal.' Let us talk as much as you like."

lines.content: いくつもの話し合いの結果、私たちはあまりに正反対だなと言って少し笑った。
lines.translated: As a result of countless discussions, we laughed a little, saying that we really were complete opposites.

lines.content: ……長いながい時間をふたりで過ごした。
lines.translated: The two of us spent a long, long time together.

lines.content: きっと、あいつは、ああ見えて人一倍にさみしがり屋なんじゃないかと思う。
lines.translated: Despite how he looks, I think that guy is surely much lonelier than anyone else.

lines.content: ……そんなさみしがりな気持ちを抱いたまま、ずっとひとりきりで、自分と同じように“さみしい気持ち”を抱えた女の子を[さら|攫]っていたのだ。
lines.translated: Harboring those lonely feelings all by himself the entire time, he had been spiriting away girls who held the exact same "feelings of loneliness" as him.

lines.content: あいつは、女の子を[さら|攫]って来ると必ず私にこう言った。
lines.translated: Whenever he spirited a girl away and brought her back, he would always say this to me:

lines.content: ……子ども達の相手はお前がしてくれ。お前のことを“[仲間|不死]”にした理由をあえてつくるのなら、[・|そ][・|れ]だ
lines.translated: "...You deal with the children. If I had to come up with a reason for why I made you 'immortal'--a companion--that would be it."

lines.content: 俺は顔が怖いからな。目つきも悪い。子どもらを相手にするのは随分と面倒なことが多い。いちいち泣かれるのは面倒だ。……苦手なんだよ。そういうのは
lines.translated: "I have a scary face, after all. And a nasty glare. Dealing with children is often a huge pain in the neck. Having them cry on me every single time is a hassle. ...I'm just no good with that sort of thing."

lines.content: 何人の女の子を[さら|攫]い、“夜”の住人にしただろう。さみしさなんてないはずの“夜の国”で、共に生きていこうとしただろう。
lines.translated: How many girls did we spirit away and turn into residents of the "Night"? How many times did we try to live together in this "Land of Night," where loneliness wasn't supposed to exist?

lines.content: だけど[さら|攫]ってきた誰もが“さみしい気持ち”を忘れられず……。
lines.translated: Yet none of the girls we spirited away could ever forget their "feelings of loneliness"...

lines.content: 少女らは私たちの元を去って行く。
lines.translated: The girls all ended up leaving us behind.

lines.content: その存在そのものを“切符”に変えて、どこか遠くへと旅立つのを見送った。
lines.translated: We saw them off as they turned their very existences into "tickets" and departed on journeys to somewhere far away.

lines.content: いくつもの“さよなら”ばかりを私たちは繰り返した。
lines.translated: We repeated nothing but countless "goodbyes" over and over.

lines.content: いつしか私たちはもう誰も[さら|攫]わないと決めた。
lines.translated: Before long, we decided that we wouldn't spirit anyone away anymore.

lines.content: 私たちのしていることも、“猫”たちと同様、無意味なことだと気づいたからだ。
lines.translated: Because we realized that what we were doing was just as meaningless as what the "Cats" did.

lines.content: ……もう誰も[さら|攫]わない。
lines.translated: We wouldn't spirit anyone away anymore.

lines.content: そう決めた最後の日に、私はもう一度だけ、満月の“夜”に空を見上げた。
lines.translated: On the very last day, when we made that decision, I looked up at the sky on a full-moon "Night" just one more time.

lines.content: はらはらはらり。
lines.translated: Fluttering, drifting down.

lines.content: さくらの降る“夜”
lines.translated: A "Night" of falling cherry blossoms.

lines.content: “お父さんとお母さんに愛されたい。抱きしめられたい……”
lines.translated: "I want to be loved by my mom and dad. I want to be hugged..."

lines.content: ……そんな君の声が聞こえたから、最後の最後にもう一度だけ、“さみしい気持ち”を[さら|攫]おうと私が勝手に決めたんだ
lines.translated: "...Because I heard your voice wishing for that, at the very, very end, I selfishly decided on my own to spirit away those 'feelings of loneliness' just one last time."

lines.content: あいつにはいっぱい怒られたけど、後悔はしてないよとソルは言う。
lines.translated: Sol said that although that guy got really mad at him, he had no regrets.

lines.content: 最初は反対していたあいつも、私がしつこく説得したからね……次第次第に、あいつから反対する言葉も少なくなった。君のことを“最後の女の子”として受け入れてくれたんだと思う
lines.translated: "He was against it at first, too, since I persistently talked him into it... Little by little, his objections grew fewer and fewer. I think he came to accept you as the 'last girl.'"

lines.content: だけど私のことを“[仲間|不死]”にはしない。
lines.translated: Yet they wouldn't make me an "immortal"--one of their companions.

lines.content: これまでの子とは違う方法で、私のさみしさをなくせないかとふたりは考え、こうして一緒にいてくれるのだと私は理解できた――いつか私は、ふたりから“巣立つ”。
lines.translated: I came to understand that the two of them were staying with me like this, thinking of a way to erase my loneliness differently from the children before me--and that someday, I would "leave the nest."

lines.content: そのために、私は“人間”として、ふたりに育てられてる。
lines.translated: For that sake, I was being raised by the two of them as a "human."

lines.content: ……そういったこれまでの色々を、千和。君にパパって呼んでもらえて思い出しちゃったんだ……あの子は。私の子は、今、どうしてるのかなって
lines.translated: "...All of those things from the past, Chiwa... being called 'Papa' by you made me remember them all... I started wondering how that child--my child--is doing right now."

lines.content: ソルがさみしそうにしていた理由がわかった。
lines.translated: Now I understood the reason why Sol had looked so lonely.

lines.content: 見つめていたキャンバスの絵は親子の絵だった。
lines.translated: The painting on the canvas he had been staring at was a picture of a parent and child.

lines.content: そして、[・|あ][・|の][・|人]がさみしそうにしていた理由も、同時に、わかってしまった。
lines.translated: And at the same time, I also came to understand why that person had looked so lonely.

lines.content: [・|俺]は……奏大雅は[まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I... Kanade Taiga, open my eyelids.

lines.content: 心は今現在へと少しの間、戻る。
lines.translated: My mind returns to the present for a brief moment.

lines.content: 目の前には千和がいる。
lines.translated: Right in front of me is Chiwa.

lines.content: 俺と手を繋いだまま、深く[まぶた|瞼]を閉じていた。
lines.translated: With her hand still joined with mine, her eyelids were shut tight.

lines.content: ここから先だと感じていた。
lines.translated: I could feel that it lay beyond this point.

lines.content: ここから先にこそ、千和の“悪夢”が潜んでる。
lines.translated: Right beyond here was where Chiwa's "nightmare" lurked.

lines.content: 再び深く目を閉じたなら、千和のいつかの時間が更に先へと進むだろう。
lines.translated: If I closed my eyes deeply once more, that bygone time of Chiwa's would progress even further ahead.

lines.content: 繋いだこの手が“夜”を通じて、千和の“悪夢”の正体と、その“[魔法|願い]”とを、“魔法少女『使い』”だなんていう“役割”を持つこの俺に……知らせてくれる。
lines.translated: Through the "Night," these joined hands would reveal the true nature of Chiwa's "nightmare" and her "wish"--her magic--to me, the one who holds the "role" of a so-called "Magical Girl 'User'"...

lines.content: だがほんの少しの躊躇いがあった。
lines.translated: However, I felt a slight hesitation.

lines.content: こうして千和の時間を夢見るということは、俺は千和に本当の意味で受け入れてもらったということだ――[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|“][・|関][・|係][・|性][・|”]が、俺たちの間には芽生え始めている。
lines.translated: Dreaming of Chiwa's time like this meant that she had accepted me in the truest sense--that kind of "relationship" was beginning to bud between us.

lines.content: だからこそだ。
lines.translated: And that was precisely why.

lines.content: 俺は、この先を見てしまってもいいのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was it really okay for me to look at what lay ahead?

lines.content: 小さな頃の千和がいったい[・|何][・|に][・|気][・|づ][・|き]、そしてどんな行動を起こし……どんな“[奇跡|魔法]”を、必要としたのか。
lines.translated: Just what had young Chiwa noticed, what actions had she taken... and what kind of "magic"--what miracle--had she needed?

lines.content: 知ってしまえば後戻りはできなくなる。そんな予感が強くある。君の力になれないとは断じて言えなくなる。
lines.translated: Once I knew, there would be no turning back. I had a strong premonition of that. I would categorically no longer be able to tell her that I couldn't help her.
If I were the person I originally was...

lines.content: いっぱい考えて、悩んで、時間をかけて答えを出すべき問題なのではと考えるのだろうが……、
lines.translated: I would probably think this was a problem I should ponder deeply, agonize over, and take my time answering, but...

lines.content: （……勇気だ）
lines.translated: (...Have courage.)

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: （……もう、ぐずぐず悩まないと決めただろう）
lines.translated: (...I already decided I wouldn't dawdle and agonize anymore, didn't I?)

lines.content: 心で、つぶやく。
lines.translated: I whisper inside my heart.

lines.content: 千和の心と向き合うために……。
lines.translated: In order to face Chiwa's heart...

lines.content: 俺は再び、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じたのだった。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids once again.

lines.content: この町は文学や絵画や、そして音楽などに携わる人間たちが多く住む。
lines.translated: Many people involved in literature, painting, music, and the like live in this town.

lines.content: 市が、そういったいわゆる芸術家と呼ばれる人たちを迎え入れるため、プロ活動を行っている表現者に限定した制度を設けているためである。
lines.translated: This is because the city established a system limited to creators working professionally in order to welcome those so-called artists.

lines.content: たとえば、持ち主のいなくなった古民家を、殆どただ同然の家賃で貸し出したり、税金の徴収率を減額してみたり等などだ。
lines.translated: For example, renting out old folk houses whose owners were gone for practically free, or reducing their tax rates, and so on.

lines.content: そんな市を上げた活動が実を結んだのか、次第次第に名の売れた芸術家が育ちはじめ――彼らの作品は、きらびやかに町を飾った。
lines.translated: Perhaps those city-wide efforts bore fruit, as little by little, well-known artists began to emerge--and their works gorgeously decorated the town.

lines.content: そんな作品を目当てに国内外から観光客が少なからず集まってくるようにもなった。
lines.translated: Aiming to see those works, no small number of tourists began gathering from both within the country and abroad.

lines.content: そうして名の知られるようになった表現者たちの中に、[・|そ][・|の][・|名][・|前]があることに、私は気づいたのだった。
lines.translated: And among those creators whose names had become well-known, I noticed that name.

lines.content: ソルがその命を交換してまで延命を望んだ人――ソルの子どもだ。
lines.translated: The person whose life Sol had wished to prolong even at the cost of trading his own--Sol's child.

lines.content: ソルの話の中に出てきたその名前と、町に住むとある芸術家の女の人の名前が同一のものだったのだ。
lines.translated: The name that had come up in Sol's story and the name of a certain female artist living in town were one and the same.

lines.content: その人は私くらいの子どもでも、この町に関係している者なら、一度は名前を聞いたことがあるだろうというくらい、それなりに有名な人だったのだろうはずだ。だからすぐに気づけた。
lines.translated: She must have been famous enough that even a child my age, as long as they had ties to this town, would have heard her name at least once. That was why I noticed right away.

lines.content: だけど、ソルは違う。
lines.translated: However, Sol was different.

lines.content: もう殆ど“外”の世界とは関わらず生きている。私の参観日だとか。運動会だとか。そういう催しがなければ“夜”から出ることはない。
lines.translated: He lived with almost no involvement with the "outside" world anymore. Unless there was an event like my school visitation day or sports festival, he never left the "Night."

lines.content: だから知らなかったんだろうと思う。
lines.translated: That was why I thought he didn't know.

lines.content: ……もしかしたら、あえて知らないように努めていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, he was deliberately trying not to know.

lines.content: 十年後の[・|今]の私ならそう思い至れる。
lines.translated: The me of now, ten years later, can reach that conclusion.
Because if he found out about his daughter, no matter what, he would end up wanting to see her.

lines.content: それを避けるため、ソルは“外”の世界と関係を絶っていたんだろうと、今の私なら思い至れただろうけれど――[・|あ][・|の][・|頃]の私には、無理な話だった。
lines.translated: The me of now could have realized that Sol had severed his ties with the "outside" world to avoid that--but for the me back then, that was impossible.

lines.content: 私は[・|そ][・|の][・|こ][・|と]をソルに話した。
lines.translated: I told Sol about it.

lines.content: ……もう、時間がないこと。
lines.translated: That there was no time left anymore.

lines.content: でも急げばきっと[・|間][・|に][・|合][・|う]はずだと。
lines.translated: But that if he hurried, he would surely make it in time.

lines.content: その人はもうすっかり歳を取り……。
lines.translated: That person had grown completely old...

lines.content: 町の病院に入院し、かなり大変な病気と戦っている。様々な媒体の町のローカルニュースがそう報じていた。
lines.translated: She was hospitalized in the town hospital, battling a very serious illness. The town's local news across various media had been reporting as much.

lines.content: その人の作品は町中に散らばっている。
lines.translated: Her works were scattered all throughout the town.

lines.content: たとえば廃線となった市電。そこに残された列車をカンバス代わりにして描かれた様々な楽しい絵。それが代表作のひとつだ。
lines.translated: For instance, the discontinued streetcar line. The various fun pictures painted using the trains left behind there as canvases. That was one of her masterpieces.

lines.content: 他の芸術家もそれを真似て、いろとりどりの飾られた列車は増えていき……。
lines.translated: Other artists imitated it, and the number of colorfully decorated trains grew and grew...

lines.content: その作品は、町の観光スポットのひとつとして数えられるようになっていた。
lines.translated: That work had come to be counted as one of the town's tourist spots.

lines.content: この町の人たちにとって、その芸術家は、ソルの子どもは、誰もが愛する隣人のような存在だった。
lines.translated: To the people of this town, that artist--Sol's child--was like a neighbor loved by everyone.

lines.content: その人の最期が近いのではないかと、町中の人が悲しみにくれていた。
lines.translated: Fearing that her end might be near, people all over town were overcome with grief.

lines.content: だけどソルは何も応えず、ただ椅子に座り、目の前の絵をじっと見つめているばかりだった。
lines.translated: Yet Sol gave no answer, simply sitting in his chair and staring intently at the painting in front of him.

lines.content: その横顔にはいつもの明るい笑顔は……太陽みたいに暖かな笑顔は、どこにもない。
lines.translated: On his profile, his usual bright smile... that smile as warm as the sun, was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 大丈夫……？
lines.translated: Okay...?

lines.content: 不安になった私はソルにそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: Growing anxious, I asked Sol what was wrong.

lines.content: あ、ああ……。うん。大丈夫。平気だよ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah... Mhm. I'm fine. I'm okay."

lines.content: ソルは思い出したようにパッと笑顔になったけど――だけど、その笑顔には、いつもよりもっともっとさみしそうな気持ちが滲んでいるように、私には見えた。
lines.translated: Sol flashed a sudden smile as if he had just remembered to--but to me, an even deeper loneliness than usual seemed to be bleeding through that smile.

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: 私は何か、間違えた……？
lines.translated: Did I make some kind of mistake...?

lines.content: ありがとう、千和。あの子のことを教えてくれて
lines.translated: "Thank you, Chiwa. For telling me about her."

lines.content: 少しだけ色々と考えたいんだけど……ごめんね。ひとりにさせてもらってもいいかな？
lines.translated: "I'd like to think about a few things for a little bit... Sorry, but could you leave me alone for a while?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 心配だったけれど。
lines.translated: Although I was worried.

lines.content: なんだか不安、だったけれど……。
lines.translated: Although I felt somewhat uneasy...

lines.content: ソルを残して部屋を出た。
lines.translated: I left Sol behind and stepped out of the room.

lines.content: だけどやっぱり、どうしても不安も心配も消えてくれなくて……。
lines.translated: Even so, neither my uneasiness nor my worry would go away no matter what...

lines.content: 私はこっそり、薄く開いた扉からソルの背中を見つめていた。
lines.translated: Through the slightly cracked-open door, I secretly stared at Sol's back.

lines.content: しばらくの間、ソルは目の前の絵をただじっと見つめているばかりだったけれど、
lines.translated: For a while, Sol simply kept staring intently at the painting in front of him,

lines.content: ……あの子は、幸せだっただろうか
lines.translated: "...I wonder if that child was happy."

lines.content: ぽつりと、ひとりぼっちのソルがつぶやいた。
lines.translated: All alone, Sol murmured softly.

lines.content: ……やっぱり、さみしい思いばかりをさせただろうか
lines.translated: "...I wonder if I only ever made her feel lonely, after all."

lines.content: [・|ど][・|ち][・|ら][・|か][・|ひ][・|と][・|り]しか命を交換できなかった。そういう決まりだった。だから、あのときはあの子を……娘を蘇らせる選択以外には、何も考えられなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "Only one of them could have their life traded for. That was the rule. So back then, I couldn't think of any choice other than reviving that child... my daughter, but..."

lines.content: でも、それは、あの子はずっとひとりぼっちで生きていかなきゃならなくなるってことだ
lines.translated: "Even so, that meant she had to go on living all alone forever."

lines.content: あの子は一度、母親と共にこの世を去り……。
lines.translated: That child had once departed this world together with her mother...

lines.content: 父親の身勝手で蘇らせられたうえ、ひとりぼっちの長いながい人生を強要させられた――本当に、あの子は蘇って幸せだったのだろうか。
lines.translated: And on top of being revived out of her father's selfishness, she was forced into a long, long life all by herself--was she truly happy to have been brought back to life?

lines.content: きっと、たくさんつらいことやさみしいことがあったはずなんだ
lines.translated: "I'm sure there must have been so many painful and lonely things."

lines.content: 本当なら親が一緒に考えて、悩んで、解決していくような問題も……。
lines.translated: Even the kinds of problems that a parent would normally think through, worry over, and solve together with her...

lines.content: あの子はひとりで考え、悩み、解決していかなきゃならないこともたくさんあったはずなのだ。
lines.translated: There must have been so many things she had to think through, worry over, and solve all by herself.

lines.content: それはとても、とても……親としては何よりさみしいことのひとつだ。
lines.translated: As a parent, that was truly, truly... one of the loneliest things of all.

lines.content: 親らしいことは何もできなかった。ふと、いきなりひとりぼっちにさせられて、あの子は私を……恨んでいるかもしれない
lines.translated: "I couldn't do a single parent-like thing for her. Being suddenly left all alone out of nowhere, she might... resent me."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 今さら父親と会いたいなんて、あの子に思ってもらえると都合のいいことは考えない……そんなのは図々しい話だってわかってる
lines.translated: "I won't flatter myself into thinking she'd want to see her father after all this time... I know how presumptuous that is."

lines.content: でも……
ああ、だけど……
lines.translated: "Ah, but..."

lines.content: 最後くらい……あの子の手を引いてやれないのなら、私は……いったい、どうして
lines.translated: "If I can't even take her hand at the very end, then... just why did I..."

lines.content: ソルは手のひらをじっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: Sol stared intently at the palm of his hand.

lines.content: 沈黙が降りた。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: じりじりと廊下の蛍光灯が音を立てていた。
lines.translated: Out in the hallway, the fluorescent light was buzzing faintly.

lines.content: ……そうか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: ソルはつぶやき、そしてうなずく。
lines.translated: Sol murmured, and then nodded.

lines.content: ……これが、私の[・|命][・|の][・|使][・|い][・|道]。そういうのもまた、悪くはないよな
lines.translated: "...This is how I will use my life. That wouldn't be so bad, either."

lines.content: ソルはゆるやかに椅子から立ち上がり、出かける支度を淡々とこなし、ひとりで町外れの病院へと向かっていった。
lines.translated: Sol rose slowly from his chair, matter-of-factly got ready to go out, and headed off alone toward the hospital on the outskirts of town.

lines.content: 私は部屋の時計を何度も見ている。
lines.translated: I looked at the clock in the room over and over again.

lines.content: ソルが出かけていって随分と経っていた。
lines.translated: Quite a lot of time had passed since Sol went out.

lines.content: 私は私にずっとやさしくしてくれたソルに、やっと恩返しのようなことができたのではないかと思い、うれしかった。
lines.translated: Thinking that I might have finally been able to do something to repay Sol, who had always been so kind to me, I was happy.

lines.content: ……うれしかった、はずなのに。
lines.translated: I was supposed to be happy, and yet.

lines.content: それなのに、なんだろう。
lines.translated: Despite that, what was this feeling?

lines.content: 胸の中がそわそわする。
lines.translated: My chest felt restless.

lines.content: 私がソルの子どもかもしれない人のことを教えると、ソルは笑ってくれるよりも先にさみしそうな顔をした。
lines.translated: When I told him about the person who might be his child, before Sol even smiled for me, he had made a lonely face.

lines.content: ……よろこんでくれるって思ってた。ソルは病院に飛んでいくんじゃないかって、思ってた。でも
lines.translated: "...I thought he would be glad. I thought Sol would go flying to the hospital. But..."

lines.content: 私はやっぱり、何かを間違えてしまったように思えてならなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't shake the feeling that I had made some kind of mistake after all.

lines.content: ……うう
lines.translated: Ugh.

lines.content: だめだ、眠れない。
lines.translated: It's no use, I can't sleep.

lines.content: ソルを迎えに行こう。
lines.translated: Let's go meet Sol.

lines.content: 早く安心したかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to feel relieved as soon as possible.

lines.content: 私は、ナハトに黙って家を出た。
lines.translated: Without telling Nacht, I left the house.

lines.content: “夜”の中だ。
lines.translated: Out into the "Night."

lines.content: ひとりでは“夜”を出歩かないという約束だったけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though I had promised not to wander around in the "Night" by myself...

lines.content: 今夜もきらきら輝く“夜”の中――私は、走った。
lines.translated: Through the "Night" that sparkled brightly once again tonight--I ran.

lines.content: 探し求めた背中を[・|そ][・|こ]に見つけた。
lines.translated: And right there, I found the back I had been searching for.

lines.content: ……“夜”の大通り。
lines.translated: On the main street of the "Night."

lines.content: たったひとりソルは道の真ん中で立ちすくみ、さくらの“夜”を見上げていた。
lines.translated: All alone in the middle of the road, Sol stood frozen, looking up at the cherry-blossom "Night."

lines.content: はら、はら、はらり――
lines.translated: Gently, softly, fluttering down--

lines.content: さくらが降るきらめく“夜”のその中で、ソルの、あなたの姿が透き通っているように、見えて……、
lines.translated: Amidst that sparkling "Night" of falling cherry blossoms, Sol's figure--your figure--looked almost transparent...

lines.content: ソル……っ！
思わず、叫んだ。
lines.translated: I cried out without thinking.

lines.content: だけどすぐにその口を両手で押さえた。
lines.translated: But right away, I clapped both hands over my mouth.

lines.content: 大きな声を出したら、たちまちソルの姿は消えてなくなる――意味もなく、わけもなく、そんなふうに思ってしまったから。
lines.translated: Because for no reason at all, without any rhyme or logic, I felt as though Sol would vanish into thin air the moment I raised my voice.

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: ソルは私を振り返ってくれた。
lines.translated: Sol turned back to look at me.

lines.content: そこにいつもの笑顔があったから、じわりと目の奥が熱くなるのを感じた。
lines.translated: Seeing his usual smile there, I felt a warm ache welling up deep behind my eyes.

lines.content: 千和？　どうして……
lines.translated: "Chiwa? Why are you..."

lines.content: ……泣いてるの？
lines.translated: "...crying?"

lines.content: ソルの声が“夜”のざわめきに掠れてしまう。
lines.translated: Sol's voice grew raspy, swallowed up by the rustling of the "Night."

lines.content: ううん。何でもないよ。ただ、安心しただけだから
lines.translated: "No, it's nothing. I was just relieved, that's all."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……ソル？
……おいで
lines.translated: "...Come here."

lines.content: 手招きされて、私は恐る恐るソルの隣へ歩いて行った。ソルは私に手を差し出してくれる。その手をそっと握った。
lines.translated: He beckoned to me, and I timidly walked over to his side. Sol held out his hand to me. I gently took hold of it.

lines.content: 迎えに来てくれたのかな
lines.translated: "Did you come to meet me?"

lines.content: 私は、うなずいた。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そっか。ありがとう。……でも、だめじゃないか、千和
lines.translated: "I see. Thank you. ...Still, you shouldn't do that, Chiwa."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: “夜”の中にひとりで出るのは危ないよ？　ナハトに怒られちゃうかもしれないぞ
lines.translated: "Going out into the 'Night' all by yourself is dangerous, you know? Nacht might get mad at you."

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ……ねえ、千和
lines.translated: "...Hey, Chiwa."

lines.content: うん。……なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? ...What is it?"

lines.content: あいつのこと……ナハトのこと、どう思ってる？
lines.translated: "What do you think of him... of Nacht?"

lines.content: どう、って？
lines.translated: "What do you mean?"

lines.content: ……怖いとか。苦手とか。嫌い、だとか
lines.translated: "...Like whether you find him scary. Or hard to be around. Or if you dislike him."

lines.content: 好きだよ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: 突然の質問に少し驚いたけれど……、私は正直にそう言い切れた。
lines.translated: The sudden question surprised me a little... but I was able to answer him with complete honesty.

lines.content: ソルみたいにやさしくはない“怪物”だけど。
lines.translated: Even though he's a "monster" who isn't gentle like Sol.

lines.content: ソルみたいにいつも笑いかけてはくれないけど。
lines.translated: Even though he doesn't always smile at me like Sol does.

lines.content: ソルみたいに、手を繋いだり、ぎゅっと抱きしめてはくれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though he won't hold my hand or hug me tight like Sol...

lines.content: ナハトも、ソルみたいに私のこと大切にしてくれてるパパなんだって、私……思ってる
lines.translated: "I think... Nacht is a papa who treasures me just as much as you do, Sol."

lines.content: だから好きだよ。私は言った。ふたりのこと、私は、大好きだよ……でも。
lines.translated: That's why I like him, I said. I love the two of you so much... But.

lines.content: 子どもが苦手だって、ナハトは言ってたよね。だからナハトは私のこと……あまり得意じゃないのかもしれない
lines.translated: "Nacht said he isn't good with kids, right? So maybe... he doesn't really know how to handle being around me."

lines.content: だから早く“大人”になりたいなと私は言った。
lines.translated: That's why I want to become an "adult" as soon as I can, I told him.

lines.content: 大人になれば、ナハトも私のこと、今よりは苦手に思ったりしなくなるんじゃないかなあって……思って
lines.translated: "I figured that once I grow up, maybe Nacht won't find me as hard to be around as he does now..."

lines.content: ナハトの目はね、きらきらしてるよ
lines.translated: "Nacht's eyes sparkle, you know."

lines.content: ふと見上げたさくらの夜空に星を見つけて……私はその光を指さした。
lines.translated: Looking up on a whim, I spotted stars in the cherry-blossom night sky... and pointed toward their light.

lines.content: ナハトの真っ赤な瞳はね、ほら、お星さまがいっぱいのあの空みたい
lines.translated: "Nacht's bright red eyes are just like that sky full of stars, look."

lines.content: お店のいつもの席で新聞を読んでいるナハトの目をバレないようにじっと見つめていると……。
lines.translated: Whenever I secretly stared at Nacht's eyes while he read the newspaper in his usual seat at the shop, making sure he didn't notice...

lines.content: 不思議だった。
lines.translated: It was strange.

lines.content: ナハトの瞳のひかりが、時どき流れ星みたいにさーっと流れる。
lines.translated: The light in his eyes would sometimes streak across like a shooting star.

lines.content: 最初それに気づいたときはとても驚いたし、なんだか誰も知らない世界の秘密を私だけが見つけてしまったみたいに思えてうれしくなった。
lines.translated: I was so surprised when I first noticed it, and it made me happy, feeling as though I alone had discovered a secret of the world that nobody else knew.

lines.content: その一瞬のひかりをナハトの瞳に見つけたら、私はひとつ、お願い事をすることにしていた。
lines.translated: I had decided that whenever I caught sight of that fleeting light in Nacht's eyes, I would make a single wish.

lines.content: 早く“大人”になって、いつかナハトと笑ってお話がしたい。そうお願いしてる。きっといつか、ナハトが叶えてくれるよね……？
lines.translated: "I wish to become an 'adult' soon, so that someday I can smile and talk with Nacht. That's what I wish for. Someday, Nacht will make it come true for me, right...?"

lines.content: あいつの瞳の中に流れ星、か。知らなかったな。なんだか面白い話だね。……確かに、誰も知らない秘密かもしれないな
lines.translated: "A shooting star in his eyes, huh? I never knew that. What an interesting story. ...That really might be a secret nobody else knows."

lines.content: きっとあいつ本人も知らないんじゃないかな。たぶんね。ソルはおかしそうに笑っていた。
lines.translated: I bet even he doesn't know about it himself. Probably not. Sol laughed in amusement.

lines.content: そして『……安心したよ』と囁くように言った。
lines.translated: And then, almost in a whisper, he said, "...That's a relief."

lines.content: 何を安心したのかは聞けなかった。とっさに言葉が出なかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't ask what he was relieved about. The words wouldn't come out in time.

lines.content: 千和。今夜のことはお互いにあいつには黙ってようね。だけど……これからも、あいつの言うこと、聞くようにしてあげてほしいな
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Let's keep tonight a secret between us and not tell him. Still... from here on out, I want you to keep listening to what he says, okay?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: もう、わかってると思うけどさ。あいつはあんなふうに見えて……まさに怪物って感じだけどさ、とてもいい奴だから
lines.translated: "I'm sure you already know this, though. He might look the way he does... and come across like a total monster, sure, but he's a really good guy."

lines.content: ……うん。わかってる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I know."

lines.content: そうだね。もう、わかってくれてるよね。千和は私たちふたりの子だ。やさしくて、とても賢い……
lines.translated: "Right. You already know that, don't you? You're our child, Chiwa. Kind, and very smart..."

lines.content: ソルは、微笑む。
lines.translated: Sol smiled gently.

lines.content: きらめくさくらの“夜”の中。
lines.translated: Amidst the sparkling cherry-blossom "Night."

lines.content: ソルと手を繋いでお家に帰る。
lines.translated: Holding hands with Sol, going back home.

lines.content: ……はずだった。
lines.translated: Or so I should have been.

lines.content: ……ありがとう、千和
lines.translated: "...Thank you, Chiwa."

lines.content: ソルは私と手を繋いだまま、その場所に立ち続けている。
lines.translated: With his hand still joined with mine, Sol kept standing right there on that spot.

lines.content: 君のおかげであの子と……娘と会えたよ。色々と、話せた
lines.translated: "Thanks to you, I was able to meet that child... my daughter. We talked about all sorts of things."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでさみしくなかったかな。君の人生は、幸せだったのかな……。それをどうしても最後に聞きたかった
lines.translated: "Whether she was lonely being all by herself. Whether she had a happy life... No matter what, I wanted to ask her that at the very end."

lines.content: ……最後？
lines.translated: "...One last thing?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……ありがとう千和。本当に、君のおかげだ
lines.translated: "...Thank you, Chiwa. It really is all thanks to you."

lines.content: 君が背中を押してくれたから、勇気をくれたから……会いに行けたよと、ソルは言う。
lines.translated: Because you gave me that push, because you gave me courage... I was able to go see her, Sol said.

lines.content: 今夜。あの子の時間が終わってしまう最後の瞬間まで、私はあの子のそばで見守ることができた……
lines.translated: "Tonight, right up until the very last moment when her time came to an end, I was able to stay by her side and watch over her..."

lines.content: そして“夜”に産まれ直したあの子の命と手を繋いで、色々話ながら“刻の終着駅”まで一緒に歩いた
lines.translated: "And then, holding hands with her life after she was reborn into the 'Night,' we walked together all the way to the 'Terminal Station of Time' while talking about so many things."

lines.content: それは殆ど一瞬程度の短い時間だったけれど、きっと、幸せだったとソルは言う。
lines.translated: It was such a brief span of time, practically no more than an instant, yet Sol said that he was surely happy.

lines.content: そして辿り着いてしまった“刻の終着駅”
lines.translated: "And then, the 'Terminal Station of Time' we ended up reaching..."

lines.content: そこでソルは自分のことを怒っているか、恨んだりしなかったかと聞いてみたという。
lines.translated: There, Sol said, he asked her if she was angry with him, or if she had resented him.

lines.content: その問いかけには、とても大きな勇気が必要だったはずで――だけどおばあさんは『怒るわけがない』とあっさりと言ったという。
lines.translated: Asking that question must have taken an immense amount of courage--yet the old woman simply replied, "Of course I'm not angry," as if it were nothing.

lines.content: ……あの子はさ、確かに色々なことがあった人生だったけれど、それでもそれなりに幸せな人生だったと笑ってくれた
lines.translated: "...She told me with a smile that while a lot certainly happened in her life, even so, it had been a reasonably happy one."

lines.content: その言葉を聞けて何かすべてが報われたような気がしたとソルは言った。
lines.translated: Hearing those words made him feel as though everything had been rewarded somehow, Sol said.

lines.content: 身勝手だけれど。あらゆるものが一行通行な感情だけれど――最後に……あの子に命をあげたことを、後悔せずにすんだよと。
lines.translated: Even if it was selfish. Even if every part of it was a one-way sentiment--at the very end... it meant he didn't have to regret giving his life to her.

lines.content: ……そんなあの子が列車に乗るのを見送った
lines.translated: "...And so, I saw her off as she boarded the train."

lines.content: あの子がどこへ向かうための“切符”を買ったのかはわからないけれど……。“次”もまた、私が自分のお父さんになってほしいって、そう……言ってくれて
lines.translated: "I don't know where the 'ticket' she bought was bound for, though... She told me... that in the 'next' life, too, she wants me to be her father again."

lines.content: そこでソルは口を閉ざしてしまった。
lines.translated: At that, Sol fell silent.

lines.content: ねえ、帰ろうよ
lines.translated: "Hey, let's go home."

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”が白みはじめている。そろそろ“夜”が眠りにつく時間。
lines.translated: The "Night" I looked up at was beginning to pale into white. Soon, it would be time for the "Night" to go to sleep.

lines.content: 早く帰らないと……本当にナハトに怒られちゃうかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "If we don't hurry back... Nacht really might get mad at us."

lines.content: ぐいぐいと繋いだ手を引っ張った。
lines.translated: I tugged hard, over and over, on the hand joined with mine.

lines.content: でも、ソルはその場から動かない――どうしてか涙がぽろりとこぼれはじめる。
lines.translated: Yet Sol didn't budge from that spot--and for some reason, tears began spilling down my cheeks.

lines.content: そして、気づいた。
lines.translated: And then, I realized.

lines.content: 私と繋いだ手……。
lines.translated: The hand joined with mine...

lines.content: ソルの真っ白な、手のひら。
lines.translated: Sol's pure white palm.

lines.content: その手にいつもしている手袋が、なかった。
lines.translated: The glove he always wore on that hand wasn't there.

lines.content: ソルが唇を噛んでいた。
lines.translated: Sol was biting his lip.

lines.content: 繋いだソルの手が、真っ白なその肌が、[・|ひ][・|び][・|割][・|れ][・|て][・|い][・|た]。
lines.translated: Sol's hand, joined with mine--that pure white skin--was cracked and splitting open.

lines.content: こ、これ……どうしたの？
lines.translated: "W-What... happened to your hand?"

lines.content: ……大丈夫。平気だよ
lines.translated: "...It's all right. I'm fine."

lines.content: うそだ、とすぐにわかった。
lines.translated: I knew right away that it was a lie.

lines.content: どこか、痛いの……っ？
lines.translated: "Does it hurt somewhere...?"

lines.content: 殆どすがりつくように私は言った。
lines.translated: I asked, practically clinging to him.

lines.content: ……これは、私自身が選んだことだから
lines.translated: "...This is something I chose for myself."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……だから、千和。気にしないで。もしも叶うなら、笑顔で見送ってもらいたい……。君たちに出会えて、よかった。ナハトにもそう伝えておいてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "...So don't worry about it, Chiwa. If it's not too much to ask, I'd like you to see me off with a smile... I'm glad I got to meet the two of you. I want you to tell Nacht that for me, too."

lines.content: ……どういう、こと？
lines.translated: "...What does this mean?"

lines.content: 三人一緒の私の[人生|時間]は幸せだった、そういう意味だよとソルは微笑み、
lines.translated: It means that the time I spent living together with the three of us was happy, Sol said with a gentle smile,

lines.content: 千和。ずっとずっと、大好きだよ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. I'll love you forever and ever."

lines.content: いつもみたいに小さな私の頭を撫でて、
lines.translated: Patting my small head just like he always did,

lines.content: 忘れないで
lines.translated: "Don't forget."

lines.content: ソルは、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて……、
lines.translated: Sol closed his eyelids...

lines.content: ……約束するよ
lines.translated: "...I promise you."

lines.content: ……はら、
lines.translated: Flutter,

lines.content: 姿は、見えなくても
lines.translated: "Even if you can't see me,"

lines.content: ……はら、
lines.translated: Flutter,

lines.content: 声は、届かなくても
lines.translated: "Even if my voice can't reach you,"

lines.content: ……はらり、
lines.translated: Fluttering down,

lines.content: 必ず、いつもそばで、君の手を……こうして……ずっと……
lines.translated: "I'll definitely always be by your side, holding your hand... like this... forever..."

lines.content: 最後の声は“夜”に砕けた。
lines.translated: His final words shattered into the "Night."
Sol turned into countless flower petals...

lines.content: 私の手の中からこぼれていった。
lines.translated: And spilled out from inside my hands.

lines.content: ……幸せに足下を掬われた。
lines.translated: Happiness swept my feet out from under me.

lines.content: ソルは私にそう言っていた。
lines.translated: That was what Sol had told me.

lines.content: 最初は、どういう意味なのかよくわからなかった。
lines.translated: At first, I didn't really understand what he meant.

lines.content: だけど[・|今]の私になら、なんとなくわかる。
lines.translated: But the me of right now can somewhat understand it.

lines.content: 今日は私のお誕生日。
lines.translated: Today is my birthday.

lines.content: ふたりがそう決めてくれた日だ。
lines.translated: The day the two of them decided on for me.

lines.content: 甘くて美味しいケーキに、プレゼント。そしておめでとうの言葉と笑顔。
lines.translated: A sweet, delicious cake, and a present. Plus words of congratulations and smiling faces.

lines.content: 『いつか三人で、本当にお店をしながら生きていくのも悪くはないね』
lines.translated: 'Someday, it wouldn't be bad for the three of us to actually run a shop and live together, would it?'

lines.content: そんな夢まで一緒に思い描けた。
lines.translated: We were even able to picture a dream like that together.

lines.content: だから私は、もしかすると望まれてここにいるのかもしれないと、そんなふうに感じることができていて……たぶん、幸せだった。
lines.translated: That was why I could feel that maybe I was wanted here... and why I was probably happy.

lines.content: だから私の足は掬われた。
lines.translated: And that was why my feet were swept out from under me.
What killed Sol was my own hand--
And the ones who killed the "Chiwa" whom the two monsters had cherished so dearly were--

lines.content: ……私のお父さんと、お母さん
lines.translated: "...My father and mother."

lines.content: 私の大切なふたりは人の形をした悪魔――“ヒトデナシ”だったのだと教えられた。
lines.translated: I was told that the two people precious to me were devils in human form--"inhuman monsters."

lines.content: 小さなちいさな花となり、“夜”の中に姿を消した……やさしい怪物。
lines.translated: The gentle monster... who turned into tiny, tiny flowers and vanished into the "Night."

lines.content: その命の花を大切に抱きしめ、ナハトの待っている家に走って帰る私を呼び止める声があったのだ――
lines.translated: As I held those flowers of life tightly to my chest and ran back toward the house where Nacht was waiting, a voice called out to stop me--

lines.content: やっぱりそうなってしまったのか
lines.translated: "So it ended up like that after all."

lines.content: と。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: だからオレらはお前みたいな人間を“夜”の中に住まわせるのは反対だったんだ
lines.translated: "That's why the rest of us were against letting a human like you live inside the 'Night.'"
Wait.

lines.content: それは二本足で立ち上がり、人の言葉を話す猫――“夜”に住まうイキモノだ。今夜のできごと、その一部始終を覗き見ていたようだった。
lines.translated: It was a cat standing on two legs and speaking human words--a Creature living in the "Night." It seemed to have been watching everything that happened tonight from beginning to end.

lines.content: 殺した人間の娘に殺されるだなんて。そこらによくある物語みたいにお粗末な結末じゃあないか
lines.translated: "Being killed by the daughter of the humans they killed. Isn't that a pathetic ending, just like a dime-a-dozen story you'd find anywhere?"

lines.content: 私が、“夜の怪物”たちに[さら|攫]われたのは偶然ではない。私は[・|そ][・|う][・|な][・|る][・|よ][・|う][・|に]と期待された、ただの使い捨ての命だった。
lines.translated: It was no coincidence that I had been spirited away by the "Monsters of the Night." I was nothing more than a disposable life, expected to end up that way.

lines.content: 物心ついたときにはすでに私は[・|そ][・|こ]にいた。
lines.translated: By the time I was old enough to be aware of things, I was already there.

lines.content: ……大きなお屋敷だった。
lines.translated: It was a big mansion.

lines.content: 一日のすべてをそこで過ごした。
lines.translated: I spent every single part of my day there.

lines.content: 産まれてから一度も外へ出たことはない。
lines.translated: Since the day I was born, I had never once gone outside.

lines.content: 私の世界は、買い与えられたたくさんの絵本の中の世界だけ……。
lines.translated: My world was nothing more than the world inside the many picture books that had been bought and given to me...

lines.content: さみしい。悲しい。
lines.translated: Lonely. Sad.

lines.content: そんな私は、私の心が、“夜の怪物”をおびき出すための[・|餌]だったのだ。
lines.translated: That version of me--my heart--was the bait used to lure out the "Monsters of the Night."

lines.content: この町にはたくさんの“噂”があり……。
lines.translated: There were many "rumors" in this town...

lines.content: そのひとつに、“夜の怪物”の“噂”があった。
lines.translated: And among them was the "rumor" of the "Monsters of the Night."

lines.content: それは“悲しい今に閉じ込められた少女を[さら|攫]い、永遠の命を与え、共に不思議なふしぎな“夜”の世界で暮らしていく”というものだった。
lines.translated: It went that they would "spirit away a girl trapped in a sorrowful present, grant her eternal life, and live together with her in a mysterious, wondrous world of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: どこの町にもよくある“噂”でしかないはずの[・|そ][・|れ]は、しかし、実際に起きてしまう出来事で……。
lines.translated: What should have been nothing more than a common "rumor" found in any town was, however, something that actually happened...
I was born into this world for the sole purpose of being spirited away by such a monster.

lines.content: お父さん。お母さん。
lines.translated: Father. Mother.

lines.content: ……私、私は、ふたりに褒められたことがあまりない――
lines.translated: "...I-I was hardly ever praised by the two of them--"

lines.content: 大きなおおきなお屋敷の中で、名前もなく、お友だちもなく、ただ、“それ”とか“あれ”とか、そんなふうに呼ばれ……ただ生きているだけの“何か”だった
lines.translated: "Inside that big, huge mansion, without a name, without any friends, I was just called things like 'it' or 'that'... I was just 'something' that was merely alive."

lines.content: “あなたの世界は、その命の価値は、いつだって相手に何を差し出せるかどうかで決まるのよ――”
lines.translated: "Your world, and the value of your life, is always decided by what you can offer to the other person--"

lines.content: お父さんとお母さんにはそう言われ続け、育った。さみしかった。
lines.translated: I grew up being told that over and over by my father and mother. I was lonely.

lines.content: “――さあ、見せてちょうだい。私たちの子として認めてもらいたいのなら、あなたは、私たちにいったい何を差し出せるのかしら”
lines.translated: "--Now, show us. If you want to be acknowledged as our child, just what on earth can you offer us?"

lines.content: 私はいつもふたりに褒めてもらえる、あるいは認めてもらえる“何か”を探してた。悲しかった。
lines.translated: I was always searching for "something" that would make the two of them praise me, or acknowledge me. I was sad.

lines.content: “わかってるわよね。[・|早][・|く][・|攫][・|わ][・|れ][・|な][・|さ][・|い]。そうでなければ、あなたの命に価値なんてまるでないんだからね”
lines.translated: "You understand, don't you? Hurry up and get spirited away. Otherwise, your life has no value whatsoever."

lines.content: どうしようもなくさみしくて、悲しくて……。
lines.translated: Helplessly lonely, and sad...

lines.content: 際限もなく[はぐく|育]まれ続けたそんな気持ちこそが、“夜の怪物”をおびき寄せる“餌”だった。
lines.translated: Those very feelings, endlessly cultivated within me, were the "bait" to lure in the "Monsters of the Night."

lines.content: そうして怪物どもに[さら|攫]われ、永遠の命を受け取った少女らを、お前の両親は“怪物”の元から更に攫って……どうすると思う？
lines.translated: "And so, the girls who were spirited away by the monsters and received eternal life were then abducted right back from the 'monsters' by your parents... What do you think they did to them?"

lines.content: 意地悪な猫は言った。わからない、と私は首を振るしかない。
lines.translated: The mean cat spoke. All I could do was shake my head and say I didn't know.

lines.content: 私はただ“怪物”に[さら|攫]われるためだけに存在している――それ以上のことは何も教えられてはいなかった。
lines.translated: I existed solely to be spirited away by a "monster"--I hadn't been taught anything beyond that.

lines.content: [さら|攫]い直した少女のことを喰らってしまうんだよ。バラバラにして。骨も残さず。その血を一滴も残さずね
lines.translated: "They devour the girl they abducted back. Tearing her to pieces. Not leaving a single bone behind. Not leaving a single drop of her blood."

lines.content: そうすることで、その子の体内に宿った“永遠の命”を我が物として取り込める――だ、なんてな。愚かにも一部の人間は、そんな迷信に陶酔してしまっているんだよ
lines.translated: "By doing so, they can take the 'eternal life' dwelling within that child's body and make it their own--or so the story goes. Foolishly enough, a certain group of humans has become intoxicated by such a superstition."

lines.content: 大人になってしまえば人間の[・|殆][・|ど]は“夜”に関係することができなくなってしまう。
lines.translated: Once they become adults, almost all humans lose the ability to have any involvement with the "Night."

lines.content: 不死の命を“夜”の中から得ようにもそうできない。故に。少女の悲しい気持ちに引き寄せられる“怪物”を利用するのだ。
lines.translated: Even if they try to obtain immortal life from within the "Night," they cannot do so. Therefore, they make use of the "monsters" that are drawn to a young girl's sorrowful feelings.

lines.content: ……と、そう考えていたのだろう。愚かなおろかな、人間たちは
lines.translated: "...Or so they must have thought. Those foolish, foolish humans."

lines.content: そうして千和は……お前のひとつ前の千和だ。[・|そ][・|の][・|子]は怪物たちの隙をつき、お前の両親に[さら|攫]われて……、喰われてしまったんだよ
lines.translated: "And so Chiwa... the Chiwa right before you. That child was abducted by your parents when the monsters let their guard down... and was devoured."

lines.content: まさに“ヒトデナシ”の所行だよなと意地悪な猫は言い、にやりと、笑う。頬まで裂けた唇を三日月みたいにつり上げて。
lines.translated: Truly the deed of "inhuman monsters," the mean cat said, grinning broadly. Its lips, split all the way to its cheeks, curled up like a crescent moon.

lines.content: そして、それに激怒した怪物が……ナハト、だったか？　お前がそう名付けたんだよな？　あいつが、お前の両親をぶっ殺してしまったのさ
lines.translated: "And the monster who flew into a rage over that... was Nacht, right? You're the one who named her that, aren't you? She slaughtered your parents."

lines.content: あいつはああ見えて、人間の子らを[・|無][・|条][・|件][・|に][・|好][・|い][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|う][・|側]のイキモノだからな
lines.translated: "Despite how she looks, she's a Creature on the side that unconditionally winds up loving human children, after all."

lines.content: 今までかわいがり育ててきた子を[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]して殺されてしまったんだ。そりゃあ逆鱗にくらい触れようというものさ
lines.translated: "The child she had doted on and raised up until then was killed in a way like that. Naturally, that was more than enough to incur her wrath."

lines.content: そしてあいつと共に暮らす元人間の“怪物”が、残された何も知らないお前を“夜”に[さら|攫]った。そして……
lines.translated: "And then the former-human 'monster' living with her spirited you away into the 'Night,' since you had been left behind knowing nothing. And then..."

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...
That former-human monster, Sol, was killed tonight--by the hands of the humans lying in wait.
"The former-human monster went out to the hospital to watch over his daughter's final moments. Isn't that right? You're the one who encouraged him to do so, aren't you?"

lines.content: はは。……まんまとしてやられたな。お前は知らずあいつを“罠”にはめてしまったんだよ。“夜の怪物”の命を狙う人間たちのね
lines.translated: "Haha. ...They played you completely. Without realizing it, you walked him right into a 'trap.' A trap set by the humans after the lives of the 'Monsters of the Night.'"

lines.content: 意地悪な猫は意地悪そうに笑っていた。
lines.translated: The mean cat was laughing maliciously.

lines.content: [あいつ|ソル]の娘は元々死者だ。あいつが、その命を差し出し、時間を交換することで生きながらえた――……しかし
lines.translated: "Sol's daughter was originally dead. She only survived because he offered up his own life and exchanged his time for hers--...However."

lines.content: しかし、だ。孤児となった娘を引き取った相手が悪かった。それは長きにわたり“不死”を追い求めている人間の一族だったのさ。“ヒトデナシ”な連中だったのさ
lines.translated: "However, you see. The people who took in his orphaned daughter were bad news. They were a clan of humans who had been pursuing 'immortality' for a long, long time. A bunch of 'inhuman monsters.'"

lines.content: 奴らは孤児を引き取ってきては使い捨てできる命として利用するんだよ――“夜の怪物”をおびき寄せ、少女を“不死”にさせ……挙げ句ばらばらに解体し、喰らうためにね
lines.translated: "They take in orphans and use them as disposable lives--all to lure in the 'Monsters of the Night,' turn the girls 'immortal'... and ultimately butcher them into pieces and devour them."

lines.content: まあお前はそんな一族内に産まれていてなお、[・|無][・|才][・|が][・|故][・|に]、“ヒトデナシ”な両親に使い捨てられようとしていたわけだがね
lines.translated: "Well, even though you were born into that clan yourself, because you lacked talent, you were about to be used and thrown away by your 'inhuman' parents."

lines.content: ともあれ、[あいつ|ソル]の娘だ
lines.translated: "At any rate, back to Sol's daughter."

lines.content: あの子が“夜の怪物”と関係していることくらいわかった上で、[・|奴][・|ら]は引き取り、育てた――いつかこの子に命を授けた“夜の怪物”が現れる。そのはずだとアタリをつけて
lines.translated: "Knowing full well that the girl was connected to a 'Monster of the Night,' those people took her in and raised her--guessing that someday, the 'Monster of the Night' who had granted the child life would appear."

lines.content: ……今度は“夜の怪物”自体を生け捕り、その[・|命]を喰らうことで“永遠”を得られないかと考えたんだろうさ――[・|そ][・|れ]だよ
lines.translated: "...This time, they must have thought they could obtain 'eternity' by capturing the 'Monster of the Night' itself alive and devouring its life--that right there."

lines.content: 意地悪な猫は私の手の中の小さな花を視線で指す。
lines.translated: The mean cat pointed with its gaze at the small flowers inside my hands.

lines.content: 花だ。“不死の怪物”の根源とも言っても良いだろう“小さな命の花”だ。次に奴らが狙ったのは[・|そ][・|れ]なんだよ
lines.translated: "Flowers. 'Small flowers of life' that could very well be called the root of an 'immortal monster.' That is what they were aiming for next."

lines.content: ……奴らは“夜の怪物”をおびき寄せるため、あらゆる場所に、あらゆる“罠”を仕掛け、心やさしい“怪物”が現れるのを手ぐすね引いて待っている。[・|こ][・|れ]も多くの内のひとつだ
lines.translated: "...In order to lure in the 'Monsters of the Night,' those people set up all kinds of 'traps' in all kinds of places, eagerly waiting for a kindhearted 'monster' to appear. This is just one of many."

lines.content: 奴らは表向きはこの町で芸術家として様々な活動を続けながら、その心を研ぎ澄ませることで、大人になっても“夜”に近しい存在でいられるよう、自身の少年少女性を保とうとする
lines.translated: "On the surface, they continue various activities in this town as artists, honing their hearts so that they can maintain their boyhood and girlhood, remaining beings close to the 'Night' even after becoming adults."

lines.content: ……そんな一族に引き取られたあいつの娘も、例外なく芸術という名の“何か”を学ぶようにと強要され続ける人生だったことだろう
lines.translated: "...Taken in by such a clan, his daughter too must have lived a life where she was without exception constantly forced to study 'something' in the name of art."

lines.content: そうして長いながい、一瞬ほどの長いあの子の命が終わる頃……。奴らの稚拙な想定通り、[あいつ|ソル]は現れた。お前の勧めによってな
lines.translated: "And so, when that child's long, long life--no longer than a single moment--came to an end... just as their crude assumptions predicted, Sol appeared. At your encouragement."

lines.content: またもにやりと笑う意地悪な猫。
lines.translated: The mean cat grinned broadly once again.

lines.content: 罠だよ。すべては“怪物”をおびき寄せるための罠だったんだ。長いながい……あんまりにも気の長い罠のひとつだった
lines.translated: "It was a trap. Everything was a trap to lure out the 'monster.' A long, long... absurdly patient trap among many."

lines.content: そこには“永遠の命”を欲する人間たちが待ち構えていた――人間たちは現れた[あいつ|ソル]を一斉に追い立てた。娘を見送った後にそうしたのは唯一の良心だったのかもしれないが……
lines.translated: "Lying in wait there were the humans who craved 'eternal life'--and when Sol appeared, the humans hounded him all at once. Doing so only after he saw his daughter off might have been their sole shred of conscience, though..."

lines.content: なんとか逃げおおせたのだろうが、あいつの身体はもう限界だった。奴らと触れあうというだけで、そして最期にお前と手を繋ぐというだけで、あいつの時間は終わってしまった
lines.translated: "He managed to escape somehow, it seems, but his body was already at its limit. Just coming into contact with those people, and finally holding hands with you at the very end, was enough to bring his time to a close."

lines.content: つまり……。
lines.translated: In other words...

lines.content: 今となっては正解をくれる者もいないが……
lines.translated: "At this point, there's no one left who can give us the right answer, but..."

lines.content: 奴らが、お前を“夜の怪物”に[さら|攫]われたままにしておいたのも、もしかしたら奴らはこうなることがわかっていて放っておいたのかもしれないな
lines.translated: "The reason those people left you spirited away by the 'Monsters of the Night' might have been because they knew it would turn out like this and left you alone on purpose."

lines.content: つまり、それは……。
lines.translated: Which meant that...

lines.content: お前も奴らのしかけた“罠”のひとつだったんだよ。きっとな
lines.translated: "You were one of the 'traps' those people set, too. Surely."

lines.content: 両親に愛されず、心やさしい“怪物”に育てられ――愛情に飢えている幼いお前は、必ずだ。自分にやさしくしてくれた“怪物”に必ず報いようとするだろう
lines.translated: "Unloved by your parents, raised by kindhearted 'monsters'--a young child starved for affection like you would without fail try to repay the 'monsters' who were kind to her."

lines.content: ああ、そうさ。それが奴らの罠だったのか。奴らの目論見通りだったのか。そんなのはどうだかはどうでもいい。結果、こうなってしまった。だから……お前は
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Whether that was their trap or whether it went according to their scheme doesn't really matter. In the end, this is how it turned out. And so... you..."

lines.content: そこでスッと、意地悪な猫は目を細めた。
lines.translated: Right then, the mean cat narrowed its eyes.

lines.content: ……お前は、ここに来るべきじゃなかったんだよ。千和
lines.translated: "...You never should have come here. Chiwa."

lines.content: 私は、とぼとぼと家に帰る。
lines.translated: I trudged heavily back home.

lines.content: 今日は産まれてはじめてお誕生日を祝ってもらえた日。
lines.translated: Today was the day I had my birthday celebrated for the very first time since I was born.

lines.content: それなのに、この日はソルと“さよなら”した日にもなってしまった。
lines.translated: And yet, this day had also become the day I said "goodbye" to Sol.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 何もかも全部、私のせいだ。
lines.translated: Everything, all of it, was my fault.

lines.content: 物語はハッピーエンドになって、また次の楽しそうな“何か”がはじまるんだって、期待した。
lines.translated: I had hoped that the story would reach a happy ending, and that the next fun "something" would begin again.

lines.content: ……三人一緒にその“何か”を前に、首をかしげたり、渋い顔をしてみたり、最後には笑ってみたりするものだと考えていた。
lines.translated: I had thought that the three of us would face that "something" together, tilting our heads in wonder, making sour faces, and finally laughing about it in the end.
I regretted it.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|こ]にいるはずの誰もがみんな、よろこんでくれると思っていたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I had thought that everyone who was supposed to be there would be happy...

lines.content: ナハトは何も言わない。
lines.translated: Nacht didn't say a word.

lines.content: ただじっと、いつまでも、手のひらの[・|花]を見つめ続けていた――……きらりと、その目元で何かが光った。
lines.translated: He simply stared endlessly at the flower resting on his palm--...and then, something glinted at the corner of his eye.

lines.content: 一瞬。ただ、ひとつだけ。
lines.translated: For just a fleeting moment. Just a single drop.

lines.content: ナハトの赤い瞳に瞬くひかりが、まるで涙みたいにこぼれて落ちて……。
lines.translated: The light twinkling in Nacht's crimson eyes spilled and fell, just like a tear...

lines.content: ……ごめん、なさい
lines.translated: "...I'm... sorry."

lines.content: 私は、泣いた。
lines.translated: I cried.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。ごめんなさい。こんなことに、なるなんて……思わなかったの
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I never thought... it would turn out like this."

lines.content: 涙がぽろぽろこぼれて止まらない。
lines.translated: My tears spilled over and wouldn't stop falling.

lines.content: この世界はいっぱいのおとぎ話でできている――だけど、絵本の中みたいに、そのすべてがハッピーエンドにはなれないのだと私は知った。
lines.translated: This world is made up of countless fairy tales--but I learned then that, unlike in picture books, not all of them can have a happy ending.

lines.content: ナハトは手のひらに乗せた花を見つめ続けている。
lines.translated: Nacht kept staring at the flower resting on his palm.

lines.content: ……いつも鋭く光っていた真っ赤な目。
lines.translated: Those bright red eyes of his that had always gleamed so sharply.

lines.content: 良く見るときらきら小さなひかりが瞬いているきれいな目。
lines.translated: Those beautiful eyes where tiny lights twinkled if you looked closely.

lines.content: そこに流れ星のようなひかりは、今はもう、たったひとつも見つからなかった。
lines.translated: Now, not even a single one of those shooting-star-like lights could be found in them anymore.

lines.content: あのね。あなたのその目が、私は好きなの。
lines.translated: You know... I really love those eyes of yours.

lines.content: そう伝えられられることもなく、私はあなたのことを……傷つけた。
lines.translated: Without ever being able to tell him that, I had... hurt him.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。私、ここに、来なければよかった
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I never should have come here."

lines.content: 私は家を、飛び出した。
lines.translated: I bolted out of the house.

lines.content: “夜の怪物”は決して死なない――“不死なるイキモノ”
lines.translated: "Monsters of the Night" never die--they are "immortal creatures."

lines.content: だけど[おとぎ話|世界]にはいつだって例外がある。
lines.translated: However, there are always exceptions in this fairy-tale world.

lines.content: 彼らはどんな大怪我を負うこともないし。大病を患うこともない。
lines.translated: They never suffer any grave injuries, nor do they ever fall seriously ill.

lines.content: 更には歳を取ることもない。彼らの[時間|命]はどこかの時点で停止してしまっている。
lines.translated: Furthermore, they never grow old. Their time--their lives--have come to a halt at some point along the way.

lines.content: そんな彼らを殺せる“例外”
lines.translated: The "exception" that can kill beings like them...

lines.content: それは、人間だ。
lines.translated: is humans.

lines.content: “人と触れあうこと”
lines.translated: "Coming into contact with humans."

lines.content: それが彼らを唯一“殺せる方法”だ。
lines.translated: That is the one and only way to kill them.

lines.content: 彼らが人間の子どもしか[さら|攫]わないのにはわけがある――この町のさくら云々という話だけではない。
lines.translated: There is a reason why they only spirit away human children--and it isn't just because of the cherry blossoms in this town and all that.

lines.content: もう心も身体もすっかり大人になった人間に、彼らが触れると……その身体は[・|ひ][・|び][・|割][・|れ][・|、][・|崩][・|れ][・|る]。
lines.translated: When they touch a human whose mind and body have already become fully adult... their own bodies crack and crumble away.
The "Monsters of the Night" can only touch us while we are still children.

lines.content: ……“夜”の住人たちは[花|さくら]から産まれた。崩れ落ちた身体は花の姿に戻ってしまう――たくさんの花びらと、一輪のちいさな花に。
lines.translated: The inhabitants of the "Night" were born from cherry blossoms. When their bodies crumble away, they return to the form of flowers--into countless petals, and a single tiny blossom.

lines.content: 私たち人間は大人になると“夜”に立ち入ることが困難になるイキモノだ。
lines.translated: We humans are creatures who find it difficult to set foot into the "Night" once we grow up.

lines.content: ……たとえば。
lines.translated: For example.

lines.content: 大切な誰かと命を交換し“夜の怪物”になったりなどしない限りは、決して存在を知覚することさえ叶わない。
lines.translated: Unless someone exchanges their life with a precious person to become a "Monster of the Night," they can never even perceive its existence.

lines.content: 太陽と月みたいに相容れないモノ同士。ふたつが出会えば[・|ど][・|ち][・|ら][・|も]壊れる。
lines.translated: They are incompatible things, like the sun and the moon. If the two meet, both of them will break.

lines.content: ソルが今まで自分の子どものことを探さず、“夜”の中で生きていたのは……。
lines.translated: The reason Sol had lived in the "Night" without ever searching for his child until now...

lines.content: 命を交換した者同士が出会ってしまうと、取り替えた命は再び元の持ち主の中に戻ろうとする――それはつまり、再び、ソルの大切な人は死んでしまうということだ。
lines.translated: When two people who have exchanged lives meet, the traded life tries to return to its original owner--which meant that Sol's precious person would die all over again.

lines.content: それでも最後に会いに行ったのは、娘の命がそろそろ尽きるのだとわかったから。
lines.translated: Even so, he went to see her at the very end because he knew his daughter's life was about to run out.

lines.content: 『これが、私の命の使い道か』
lines.translated: "Is this how my life is meant to be used?"

lines.content: ソルがひとりぼっちの部屋でそうつぶやいていた――その背中を、私は思い出さずにはいられない。
lines.translated: Sol had muttered that in his lonely room--and I couldn't help but remember the sight of his back from then.

lines.content: そういった“怪物”たちの事情を私に教えてくれたのは、やはり通りすがりの[・|意][・|地][・|悪][・|な][・|猫]だった。
lines.translated: The one who taught me about those circumstances of the "monsters" was, sure enough, that passing mean cat.

lines.content: 彼は他人の事情を覗き見るのが趣味なのだと、自分の悪趣味さを得意がるように、やっぱり意地悪な笑顔を浮かべてばかりいた。
lines.translated: Claiming that prying into other people's business was his hobby, he had worn a malicious grin the entire time, as if proud of his own bad taste.

lines.content: 家を飛び出した私は、“夜”の中にソルの姿を探して走った。
lines.translated: Having fled the house, I ran through the "Night" searching for Sol.

lines.content: 以前、教えてもらったことを思い出したのだ。
lines.translated: I remembered something I had been told before.

lines.content: “[現実世界|太陽の時間]”で命尽きた者は“夜”を通じて“次”へと向かう――
lines.translated: Those whose lives come to an end in the "real world"--the time of the sun--pass through the "Night" to head toward the "next"...

lines.content: ソルとナハトは“千和”を毎夜のごとく探しに出ていた。私が名前をもらった[誰か|千和]をだ……私のお父さんとお母さんが、食べてしまった女の子を、だ。
lines.translated: Sol and Nacht had gone out almost every night to search for "Chiwa." For the girl whose name I was given... the girl my father and mother had eaten.

lines.content: ソルもまだこの町のどこかにいるかもしれない。
lines.translated: Sol might still be somewhere in this town, too.

lines.content: どんな形であれ見つけ出したソルの手を引き、家に連れて帰れれば――ナハトは笑ってくれるかもしれないと期待していた。それが、私の最後の希望だったように思う。
lines.translated: I hoped that if I could find Sol, in whatever form he might be, take his hand, and bring him back home--Nacht might smile again. I think that was my final hope.

lines.content: 涙を流すことなく泣いていたナハト。
lines.translated: Nacht, who had been crying without shedding any tears.

lines.content: 今にもナハトの身体のほうが崩れ落ちてしまいそうなほど……両肩を落とし、小さく縮こまっているように見えた。
lines.translated: His shoulders had slumped, and he looked so small and shrunken... as though his own body might crumble away at any moment.

lines.content: あの人のあんな顔は、あんな姿は、はじめて見た。
lines.translated: It was the first time I had ever seen him make a face like that, or look like that.

lines.content: ……自分のしてしまったことの重大さを、幼いながらも理解するにはそれだけで充分だったのだ。
lines.translated: Even as a young child, that alone was enough for me to understand the gravity of what I had done.

lines.content: 何も知らなかったからといって許されないものがこの世界にはあるのだと、私はそのとき思い知らされた。
lines.translated: I was made to realize then that there are things in this world that cannot be forgiven just because you didn't know anything.

lines.content: ……“夜”の中を走り回った。
lines.translated: I ran all around through the "Night."

lines.content: 名前を呼んだ。何度も呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called her name. I called it over and over again.

lines.content: だけど応えてくれる声はどこにもないし、探し求めた姿もやはり、どこにもなかった。
lines.translated: Yet there was no voice to answer me anywhere, nor was the figure I sought anywhere to be found.

lines.content: 町中を走り、気づけば私は[・|そ][・|こ]に辿り着いた。
lines.translated: I ran all through the town, and before I knew it, I had arrived there.

lines.content: 駅だった。
lines.translated: It was the station.

lines.content: たくさんの“何か”が入り乱れる巨大な駅。
lines.translated: A gigantic station where countless "somethings" mingled together in a chaotic crowd.

lines.content: 行き交う“何か”の中にソルを探した。
lines.translated: I searched for Sol among the passing "somethings."

lines.content: 誰かとぶつかり、もみくちゃにされ……。
lines.translated: I bumped into someone, got jostled around in the crowd...

lines.content: 意地悪な誰かに突き飛ばされて、転がった。
lines.translated: And was shoved aside by someone mean, sending me tumbling to the ground.

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 小さな私はその場にへたり込む――そしてもう、動けない。
lines.translated: Small as I was, I collapsed right there on the spot--unable to move anymore.

lines.content: 涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: 涙が、こぼれた。
lines.translated: A tear spilled over.

lines.content: ぽたぽたとこぼれる自分の涙のあとを見て……。
lines.translated: Looking at the trails left by my own tears as they pattered down...

lines.content: 涙もなく泣いていたナハトの顔を思い出し、また、泣いた。
lines.translated: I remembered the face of Nacht crying without tears, and I cried all over again.

lines.content: 小さな私は泣いてばかりだ。
lines.translated: Little me did nothing but cry.

lines.content: そんな私に“どうしたの、こんなところで”と声を掛けてきたのは、ひとりの小さな女の子だった。
lines.translated: It was a single little girl who called out to me then, asking, "What's wrong, in a place like this?"

lines.content: ……人間の子どもがこんなところに、しかもひとりぼっちでいるなんて、珍しい
lines.translated: "...It's rare to see a human child in a place like this, and all alone at that."

lines.content: 車掌さんのような服を着た子だった。
lines.translated: She was wearing clothes that looked like a train conductor's uniform.

lines.content: へたり込む私の顔を覗き込むようにして、その目を何度もぱちぱちと瞬かせていた。
lines.translated: Peering into my face as I sat collapsed on the ground, she blinked her eyes over and over.

lines.content: ……あなたは
lines.translated: "...Who are..."

lines.content: 誰？　そう聞いた。
lines.translated: "...you?" I asked.

lines.content: さあ。誰なのかな。私も私がわからない――
lines.translated: "Who knows? Who could I be? Even I don't know who I am--"

lines.content: 小首をかしげてその子は言った。
lines.translated: The girl tilted her head slightly and spoke.

lines.content: ――私は、ただここにいるだけの“何か”だよ
lines.translated: "--I'm just a 'something' that happens to be here."

lines.content: ぶかぶかの制服に、目深に被った駅員さんの帽子。肩から下げた大きな鞄を、重たそうに抱えながら歩いていた。
lines.translated: She was walking along in a baggy uniform, a station attendant's cap pulled low over her eyes, carrying a large bag slung over her shoulder that looked quite heavy.

lines.content: もしかして出口がわからなくなったのかな。時どき“夜”の中に迷い込んじゃう子がいるけれど……あなたも、そう？
lines.translated: "Did you lose track of the exit, perhaps? Every now and then, a child wanders into the 'Night' by mistake... Is that what happened to you?"

lines.content: だったら外まで案内しようか？
lines.translated: "If so, shall I guide you outside?"

lines.content: そう言い、ふっと女の子が微笑んだ。
lines.translated: Saying that, the girl offered a gentle smile.

lines.content: 私と同じくらいの小さなちいさな女の子。
lines.translated: A tiny little girl, just about the same size as me.

lines.content: それなのにその微笑みはどこか大人びていて――あのときの私には、その子がソルやナハトを助けてくれる救いの主のように見えたのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, her smile was somehow mature--and to me back then, she looked like a savior who would help Sol and Nacht.

lines.content: 私はその子に泣きながら事情を話した。
lines.translated: Through my tears, I explained the situation to her.

lines.content: ……残念だけど、言いにくいことだけれど……。ごめんね。あなたの探しているひとは、いくら探しても見つからないと思うよ
lines.translated: "...It's unfortunate, and hard for me to say, but... I'm sorry. I don't think you'll find the person you're looking for, no matter how much you search."

lines.content: 女の子は泣いてばかりの私から目を伏せる。
lines.translated: The girl lowered her eyes away from me as I kept crying.

lines.content: そして、私のまだまだ知らない“夜”について教えてくれたのだった。
lines.translated: And then, she told me about aspects of the "Night" I still knew nothing about.

lines.content: ソルは、大切な人と命を交換した。
lines.translated: Sol had exchanged his life with someone precious to him.

lines.content: いわばその命は娘さんと一心同体。
lines.translated: So to speak, that life was one and the same with his daughter's.

lines.content: ソルの時間はとっくに尽きてる。故に。この“夜”に産まれ直すようなことはない――彼との“さよなら”は本当の“終わり”なのだ。
lines.translated: Sol's time had run out long ago. Therefore, he would not be reborn into this "Night"--saying "goodbye" to him meant the true "end."

lines.content: ……一度さよならをしてしまったものとはもう二度と、会えない。それが命に備わった本来のルールなんだよ
lines.translated: "...Once you've said goodbye to something, you can never meet it again. That is the fundamental rule built into life."

lines.content: ……これくらいのことなら、どんなに小さくても、どんなに、子どものように見えていても――
lines.translated: "...Something like this, no matter how small you are, no matter how much like a child you might look--"

lines.content: 人間は思いの外、かしこくて。小さくてもそうでなくても色々と、たくさん、たくさん考えながら、生きているイキモノだから……
lines.translated: "Humans are surprisingly clever. Whether they're small or not, they are creatures that live while thinking about all sorts of things, so, so very much..."

lines.content: だからこれくらいのこと、わざわざ言われなくても――
lines.translated: "So you already know this much without having to be told--"

lines.content: ……うん。わかってる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I know."

lines.content: だけどいやなの。
lines.translated: But I didn't want that.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]が認められないから。
lines.translated: Because I couldn't acknowledge that.

lines.content: それが、受け入れられないから。
lines.translated: Because I couldn't accept it.

lines.content: だから私は泣いてる。誰か助けてと願い続けてる。
lines.translated: That was why I was crying. Why I kept wishing for someone to save us.

lines.content: ……私は、どうしたらいい？
lines.translated: "...What should I do?"

lines.content: 小さな私は、小さな女の子に問いかけた。
lines.translated: Little me asked the little girl.

lines.content: ……ナハトにソルを返したい
lines.translated: "...I want to give Sol back to Nacht."

lines.content: 手のひらに乗せた花を見つめるナハトは、何も言わなかったけれど……とても、とてもさみしそうだった。
lines.translated: Nacht hadn't said anything as he stared at the flower resting on his palm, but... he had looked so, so very lonely.

lines.content: ナハトはソルの前でも、私の前でも、いつも多くを語らない。
lines.translated: Whether in front of Sol or in front of me, Nacht never spoke much.

lines.content: ……そんなナハトが、ソルのことをどう思っていたのか。
lines.translated: Just how had Nacht felt about Sol?

lines.content: その横顔を見るだけで、小さな私にも良くよくわかった。
lines.translated: Just by looking at his profile, even someone as small as me could understand it all too well.

lines.content: 私が、ふたりの家に来たせいで……
lines.translated: "Because I came to their house..."

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: それがそもそもの間違いだった。
lines.translated: That had been the mistake from the very beginning.

lines.content: ……私が、ソルにとっての死神、だったんだ
lines.translated: "...I was the grim reaper for Sol."

lines.content: ナハトは私を家に住まわせることを最初は反対していた。あのとき何も言わずに家を出ていれば良かった。
lines.translated: Nacht had been against letting me live in their house at first. I should have just left without saying a word back then.

lines.content: ふたりのことを追いかけて“夜”を出歩いた最初の日。“夜の王”だとかいう“何か”と私とを勘違いした“夜”の住人たちに、あのまま食べられてしまえば良かった。
lines.translated: On the very first day I wandered out into the "Night" chasing after the two of them, I should have just let myself be eaten by the residents of the "Night" who mistook me for the "King of the Night" or whatever that "something" was.

lines.content: 後悔だ。その数はいくつ数えてもきりがない。
lines.translated: Regrets. No matter how many of them I counted, there was no end to them.

lines.content: お願い。なんだってする。どんなことだってがまんする。私の全部を、あげるから。だから……お願い。お願いします
lines.translated: "Please. I'll do anything. I'll endure whatever it takes. I'll give you everything I have. So... please. I'm begging you."

lines.content: どうか、神さま、ナハトに大切なお友だちを返してあげて……。
lines.translated: Please, God, give Nacht back his precious friend...

lines.content: 沈黙があった。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: ざわざわと騒がしい構内の喧噪ばかりが耳につく中で――“覚悟は、あるのかな”と女の子がそう聞いてきた。
lines.translated: Amidst the noisy bustle of the station echoing in my ears--the girl asked me, "Are you prepared for what it takes?"

lines.content: ……ねえ、小さなちいさな女の子
lines.translated: "...Hey, tiny little girl."

lines.content: 応えてほしいと、その子は言った。
lines.translated: She told me she wanted an answer.

lines.content: あなたは、あなた自身がそのひとにとっての死神だったんだと……そう、言っていたけれど
lines.translated: "You said that you yourself were the grim reaper for that person... You said that, didn't you?"

lines.content: どう、なのかな
lines.translated: "So, I wonder..."

lines.content: こんなにも小さくて、こんなにも泣き虫なあなたに……あなたが殺してしまったという怪物を蘇らせる。それだけの覚悟が、あるのかな
lines.translated: "Someone as small and as much of a crybaby as you... bringing back to life the monster you claim to have killed. Do you really have the resolve it takes to do that?"

lines.content: ……そんなの
lines.translated: "...Of course..."

lines.content: 当然、あると応えた。
lines.translated: Naturally, I answered that I did.

lines.content: どんなにつらくても？
lines.translated: "No matter how painful it gets?"

lines.content: ……もちろんだよ
lines.translated: "...Of course."

lines.content: 構わないと応えた。
lines.translated: I answered that I didn't mind.

lines.content: どんなに、怖くても？
lines.translated: "No matter how scary it gets?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 平気だと、応えた。
lines.translated: I answered that I would be fine.

lines.content: どんなにつらくて、怖くても、私は……
lines.translated: "No matter how painful or scary it is, I..."

lines.content: お願いだよ。安易にうなずいたりしないでほしい
lines.translated: "Please. I don't want you to nod so easily."

lines.content: 女の子は一度、私の言葉を遮った。
lines.translated: The girl interrupted my words for a moment.

lines.content: いい？　ちゃんと、しっかり、想像力を働かせてほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Okay? I want you to really, truly use your imagination."

lines.content: 想像力……
lines.translated: "Imagination..."

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: 良くよく考えて応えてほしい――つらいこと、怖いこと……悲しいこと。この世にはありとあらゆる[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]が溢れてる。それに立ち向かうための勇気が必要だということだよ
lines.translated: "I want you to think it through very carefully before answering--painful things, scary things... sad things. This world is overflowing with all sorts of them. It means you're going to need the courage to stand up to them."

lines.content: 勇気。
lines.translated: Courage.

lines.content: ふたりが、ソルが、これから先、私に立ちはだかるだろう困難を、自分の力で解決するために学んでほしいものがあると、そう言っていた。
lines.translated: The two of them--Sol--had told me there was something he wanted me to learn so that I could overcome the hardships that would stand in my way in the future with my own strength.

lines.content: それは勇気なんだよと私にソルは教えてくれた。いつだって必要なのはそれだけなのだ。だから、私は……。
lines.translated: Sol had taught me that this something was courage. That was the only thing I would ever need. And so, I...

lines.content: もう一度だけ聞くよ。女の子。もう二度と泣かず、強く……あなたの“夢”を叶えられるまで、決して諦めないと、誓える？
lines.translated: "I'll ask you just one more time, little girl. Can you swear that you'll never cry again, that you'll be strong... and that you'll never give up until your 'dream' comes true?"

lines.content: ……私は――私は、うなずく。
lines.translated: I--I nodded.

lines.content: ……誓う。誓います
lines.translated: "...I swear. I swear it."

lines.content: 勇気だ。
lines.translated: Courage.

lines.content: 今、ここで、ソルが学んでほしいと願ってくれた[それ|勇気]を出せなくて、どうする。
lines.translated: If I couldn't muster that courage Sol had wished for me to learn right here and now, what would I do?

lines.content: 強くなる
lines.translated: "I'll become strong."

lines.content: 私はふたりの大切な時間を壊した。
lines.translated: I had destroyed the precious time the two of them shared.

lines.content: ……私は、いないほうがよかった。
lines.translated: It would have been better if I had never existed.

lines.content: だからせめて、私を育ててくれたふたりが、いつか、自慢に思ってくれる子に私はなりたい。ならなければ。
lines.translated: So at the very least, I wanted to become a child that the two who raised me could be proud of someday. I had to become that.

lines.content: もう二度と泣かないし、この願いを叶えるまで……決して諦めない。絶対。絶対。何があっても……私は、平気
lines.translated: "I'll never cry again, and until I make this wish come true... I'll never give up. Never. Never ever. No matter what happens... I'll be fine."

lines.content: 女の子はじっと私の目を見つめた――その視線から私は目をそらさず見つめ返していた。
lines.translated: The girl stared straight into my eyes--and I stared right back without looking away from her gaze.

lines.content: ……そう。わかった
lines.translated: "...I see. Understood."

lines.content: 女の子は、うなずいた。
lines.translated: The girl nodded.

lines.content: そして小さなその手を私に差し出す――さあ、この手を取って、と。
lines.translated: And then, she held out her tiny hand to me--as if to say, "Come on, take this hand."

lines.content: これは、契約だよ
lines.translated: "This is a contract."

lines.content: けい、やく……？
lines.translated: "A con... tract...?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: あなたの願いを叶えてあげる
lines.translated: "I'll grant your wish for you."

lines.content: えっ
lines.translated: "Eh?"

lines.content: 何もかもが上手くいけば、“さよなら”をしてしまったひとを取り戻せる……かも、しれないよ
lines.translated: "If everything goes well, you might... just be able to get back the person you said 'goodbye' to."

lines.content: ほ、本当に……っ？
lines.translated: "R-Really...?!"

lines.content: ナハトのことを思った。
lines.translated: I thought of Nacht.

lines.content: もし私がソルを連れて帰ることが叶えば……。
lines.translated: If my wish to bring Sol back home came true...

lines.content: あのひとは泣き止んでくれるだろうか。笑ってくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Would he stop crying? Would he smile for me?

lines.content: だけど……その代わり、あなたのその願いを、夢を、叶えてあげる代わりに……あなたに救ってほしいものがあるんだよ
lines.translated: "However... in exchange for granting that wish of yours, that dream of yours... there is something I want you to save."

lines.content: ……何を、救うの？　私が？
lines.translated: "...Save what? Me?"

lines.content: あなたが、あなた[・|達]が、救うのは……
lines.translated: "What you--what all of you--will be saving is..."

lines.content: 女の子は小首をかしげ、ぽつりと、言った。
lines.translated: The girl tilted her head slightly and murmured.

lines.content: この世界、そのものだよ
lines.translated: "This very world itself."

lines.content: あまりにもあんまりな回答に、私はぽかんとしてしまう――世界？　世界を、救う？
lines.translated: The answer was so overwhelming that my mind went blank--the world? Save the world?

lines.content: ……すべての命を喰らい尽くすのだと言われてる“夜の王”。[・|そ][・|れ]が出現する場所がわかったんだよ
lines.translated: "...The 'King of the Night,' who is said to devour all life. I've found the place where it is going to appear."

lines.content: あなたがこの手を取るのなら……これからあなたを、私が、“夜の王”が出現すと推測される[ポイント|場所]にまで連れて行く
lines.translated: "If you take this hand... I will take you from here to the point where the 'King of the Night' is predicted to appear."
