lines.content: 同じようにして集められたあなた[・|達]には、そこでそれぞれに適した“魔法”を学び、力を合わせて……[・|そ][・|れ]を倒してほしいんだ
lines.translated: "There, I want all of you who have been gathered in the same way to learn the 'magic' suited to each of you, join forces... and defeat it."

lines.content: ……世界を、救うために？
lines.translated: "...To save the world?"

lines.content: そう、だね。この世界と、あなた達人間の未来を守る、そのために
lines.translated: "That's right. In order to protect this world, and the future of you humans."

lines.content: ……で、でも、倒すなんて……そんなこと、どうやって
lines.translated: "...B-But, defeat it... How could I possibly do something like that?"

lines.content: “夜の王”――私が知っているのは名前だけ。
lines.translated: The "King of the Night"--the only thing I knew about it was its name.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]がいったい何なのか。[・|そ][・|れ]がどんな姿をしたものなのか。
lines.translated: What on earth it was. What kind of form it took.

lines.content: 何もかも、私は、知らないのに……。
lines.translated: I didn't know a single thing about it, and yet...

lines.content: この手を取れば、あなたは、この世界を救うための刃となる
lines.translated: "If you take this hand, you will become a blade to save this world."

lines.content: 女の子は、言った――あなたがそう望もうと望むまいとそういうふうになってしまうのだ、と。
lines.translated: The girl spoke--telling me that whether I wished for it or not, that was how it would turn out.

lines.content: 私はこの世界を救う“心の力”を備えた子たちを探してる。きっと、あなたの願いは世界を救う。そう感じられたよ。あなたの強い思いは私に届いた
lines.translated: "I'm looking for children who possess the 'strength of heart' to save this world. Surely, your wish will save the world. I could feel it. Your strong feelings reached me."

lines.content: 心の力とは願いの力だと女の子は言った――その願いの力が“夜の王”と戦うための武器となる。
lines.translated: The girl said that the strength of heart was the power of a wish--and that the power of that wish would become a weapon to fight the "King of the Night."

lines.content: その願い、あるいは“夢”が、とほうもなく大きなものであればあるだけ……きっと、その願いは、その夢は、やはりとほうもない力となるはずだから
lines.translated: "The more tremendously huge that wish, or 'dream,' is... surely, that wish, that dream, will become an equally tremendous power."

lines.content: 覚えておいて。あなたの救いの主は私なんかじゃない。あなた自身だよ
lines.translated: "Remember this. Your savior isn't someone like me. It's you yourself."

lines.content: あなたが自分自身の願いを信じられるのなら。心の強さを、守り続けられると誓うのなら――
lines.translated: "If you can believe in your own wish. If you swear that you can keep protecting the strength of your heart--"

lines.content: 女の子は、微笑み……。
lines.translated: The girl smiled...

lines.content: ――さあ。出かけよう
lines.translated: "--Now. Let's head out."

lines.content: あなたの願いを叶えるために……大切なひとを取り戻す、そのために
lines.translated: "To make your wish come true... to take back the person precious to you."

lines.content: 私と一緒に、“夜”の先へと……その最果てへと出かけよう。人生に一度だけの大冒険が、待ってるよ
lines.translated: "Let's head out together beyond the 'Night'... to the very ends of it. A once-in-a-lifetime grand adventure is waiting for you."

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: 私は、ほんの僅かに感じた戸惑いを打ち消すように、差し出されたその手を取った。
lines.translated: As if to shake off the slight hesitation I felt, I took the hand she held out to me.

lines.content: 私は、旅に出た。
lines.translated: I set out on a journey.

lines.content: ソルを取り戻すまでは絶対に帰らないと誓い――
lines.translated: Swearing that I would never return until I got Sol back--

lines.content: 私の手を引く小さな女の子。彼女の友だちなのだという列車に乗った。
lines.translated: A tiny little girl pulling me by the hand. We boarded a train that she said was a friend of hers.

lines.content: 行き先は告げられていない。
lines.translated: I hadn't been told our destination.

lines.content: これは世界を救うための旅……。
lines.translated: This was a journey to save the world...

lines.content: これは私が私の願いを叶えるための旅。
lines.translated: This was a journey to make my wish come true.

lines.content: 私が、私のことを信じ続けるための旅。
lines.translated: A journey for me to keep believing in myself.

lines.content: ただそれだけがこの胸の中にある――
lines.translated: That alone was what filled my heart--

lines.content: ここにいても、平気なの？
lines.translated: "Is it really okay for you to be sitting here?"

lines.content: 隣に座る女の子に私は言った。旅立ちのときからずっと、寄り添うようにしてくれている。
lines.translated: I asked the girl sitting next to me. Ever since we set out on our journey, she had been staying close by my side.

lines.content: ……列車には、私とあなた、ふたりしかいないみたいだけど
lines.translated: "...It looks like you and I are the only two on this train, though."

lines.content: 操縦は大丈夫なの？
lines.translated: What about driving it?

lines.content: そう問いかける私に『うん。平気』と女の子はうなずいた。
lines.translated: When I asked her that, the girl nodded and said, "Yeah. It's fine."

lines.content: この子は賢いからね。むしろ私がとやかく指示を出すより、全部をすっかり任せていたほうが何かといいんだよ
lines.translated: "This kid is smart, after all. Rather than me bossing them around with instructions, things actually go much better when I just leave everything completely up to them."

lines.content: そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: うん。そうなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. It's true!"

lines.content: 女の子は顔にズレ落ちてくる大きな帽子を何度も直している。
lines.translated: The girl kept adjusting the large hat that kept slipping down over her face.

lines.content: 餅は餅屋というでしょう。なんだって。どんなことだって。だいたいそういうふうにしておけば上手くいくものなんだよ。きっとね
lines.translated: "Leave it to the experts, as they say. With anything. With everything. Things usually work out best when you do it like that. Probably, anyway."

lines.content: そう言った女の子は、抱えていた鞄の中身をごそごそとしていた。
lines.translated: Saying that, the girl rummaged around inside the bag she was holding.

lines.content: 見れば鞄の中にはいっぱいのお菓子が入ってる。
lines.translated: Looking inside, I saw that the bag was stuffed full of sweets.

lines.content: いくつかあめ玉をもらった。スナック菓子や色とりどりの甘いゼリーも――こんなものばかり食べてるの？
lines.translated: She gave me a few pieces of hard candy. There were also snack foods and colorful sweet jellies--do you eat nothing but stuff like this?

lines.content: そう問いかけると、『うん。そうだよ』と、口の中のあめ玉をころころ舐めながら女の子は応えた。
lines.translated: When I asked her that, the girl rolled the candy around in her mouth as she licked it and replied, "Yep. That's right."

lines.content: でもね、うーん……。そろそろお菓子にも飽きちゃって
lines.translated: "Although, hmmm... I'm starting to get a little tired of sweets lately."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 何か、私のお口に合う美味しいものを探してるところなんだよ。別に私という“何か”はご飯を食べなきゃ死んじゃうようなことはないけれど……
lines.translated: "I'm currently on the lookout for something delicious that suits my tastes. Not that a 'something' like me is going to die if I don't eat meals, mind you..."

lines.content: でも美味しいものを食べたいという気持ちを満たすということは、長いながい暇をつぶすには最適な娯楽であるらしい。
lines.translated: Still, satisfying the desire to eat delicious food was apparently the perfect pastime for killing a long, long stretch of free time.

lines.content: 甘いの好きだし、お菓子も好きだよ
lines.translated: "I do like sweet things, and I like candy too."

lines.content: でも今は、お砂糖の甘さより……なんて言うのかな。どちらかというと身体に悪そうな脂っこいものが食べてみたいなあって、そんな気分
lines.translated: "Right now, though, rather than sugary sweetness... how should I put it? I'm kind of in the mood to try eating something greasy that's probably bad for you."

lines.content: 少しの間その子と話した。
lines.translated: I chatted with the girl for a little while.

lines.content: そしてふと、会話が途切れるような予感があったから……。
lines.translated: Then, suddenly having a hunch that a lull in our conversation was coming...

lines.content: ……旅は、まだまだ続くの？
lines.translated: "...Is our journey going to continue for much longer?"

lines.content: ……私は果てもなく思える旅路について問う。
lines.translated: I asked about this seemingly endless journey of ours.

lines.content: そうだね。もう少しだけ
lines.translated: "Let's see. Just a little longer."

lines.content: そっか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: もう少しだけ、時間はあるんだね。
lines.translated: So we still had a little bit of time left.

lines.content: それなら不思議に思う色々を訪ねてみようか――
lines.translated: In that case, maybe I should try asking her about the various things I was curious about--

lines.content: ……あなた[・|達]って、言ってた
lines.translated: "...Earlier, you said 'children.'"

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ……“夜の王”を倒すのは、そのために集められるのは、私だけじゃない？
lines.translated: "...Does that mean I'm not the only one being gathered to defeat the 'King of the Night'?"

lines.content: ああ、うん
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah."

lines.content: 辿り着いたその先に、あなたと良く似た子たちが集められる――予定だよ
lines.translated: "Once we reach our destination, children very much like you will be gathered there--that's the plan, anyway."

lines.content: 予定、なんだ
lines.translated: "The plan, huh..."

lines.content: ……そう、だね
lines.translated: Yeah, they are.

lines.content: たったひとりで“困難”に立ち向かうのはさみしくて、未知なる“何か”を学ぶには、やっぱりたったひとりだと大変なことが多すぎる
lines.translated: "Standing up to 'hardships' all on your own is lonely, and when it comes to learning about an unknown 'something,' there are just way too many tough things to deal with by yourself."

lines.content: だから共に戦い、共に学べる仲間を私が連れてくるよと女の子。
lines.translated: That was why, the girl said, she would bring companions who could fight and learn alongside me.

lines.content: できうることなら、その子らと……[・|あ][・|の][・|子]と、仲良くしてあげてほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "If at all possible, I'd really like you to get along with those kids... with that girl."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|こ]には何人くらい、集められる予定なの？
lines.translated: "About how many people are supposed to be gathered there?"

lines.content: またいじめられたりしないだろうか。
lines.translated: Would I end up getting bullied again?

lines.content: ……もしも意地悪な子がいたら。
lines.translated: What if there were mean kids there?

lines.content: ……今度こそひとりぼっちで立ち向かわなきゃ行けない。
lines.translated: Then I really would have to face everything all alone this time.

lines.content: あなた達を受け入れる先の主が、もうこれ以上は無理かな、って。そう言い出すくらいは集めようと思ってる
lines.translated: "I'm thinking of gathering enough that the master of the place taking you all in will say, 'I don't think I can handle any more than this.'"

lines.content: たぶん四、五人くらいかな、と女の子は言った。
lines.translated: Probably around four or five people, the girl said.

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: 不安は尽きない。
lines.translated: My anxieties were endless.

lines.content: 未来に対する恐怖だって[・|い][・|つ][・|も][・|以][・|上]につきまとっているけれど……。
lines.translated: Even my fear of the future was clinging to me more than usual, and yet...

lines.content: ……ナハト。今、どうしてるかな。
lines.translated: Nacht. I wonder how he's doing right now.

lines.content: 私がいなくなっていることに気づいたら……ほっとするだろうか。
lines.translated: When he realizes I'm gone... will he feel relieved?

lines.content: ……ねえ
なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: ……あなたに名前は、ないの？
lines.translated: "...Do you not have a name?"

lines.content: 無理矢理微笑みを作り、私はそう問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: Forcing a smile onto my face, I tried asking her that.

lines.content: ないよ
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: 女の子は首を振り、言った。三つ編みの長い髪がふわりと揺れる。
lines.translated: The girl shook her head and spoke, her long braided hair swaying softly.

lines.content: 言ったと思うけど、私は私が何なのかわからない。私はただ、ここにいるだけの“何か”だから……名前なんて。そんなのはないよ。あっても呼んでくれる人もいないしね
lines.translated: "I think I mentioned this before, but I don't know what I am. I'm just a 'something' that happens to be here... so a name? I don't have anything like that. Even if I did, there's no one to call me by it anyway."

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: それは、さみしいねと私は言った。
lines.translated: That sounds lonely, I told her.

lines.content: そうかもしれないと女の子は言った。
lines.translated: Maybe so, the girl replied.

lines.content: だけどそれもそれで慣れてしまえば平気だよとも。
lines.translated: Though she also added that once you get used to it, it's really no big deal.

lines.content: 孤独っていうのはさ、きっと上手に、丁寧に、慎重に付き合えば、最高のお友だちになれる“何か”なんだって私は思うよ
lines.translated: "I think loneliness is a 'something' that can become your absolute best friend, as long as you deal with it skillfully, carefully, and cautiously."

lines.content: ……私はそんなふうに強くなれるだろうか。
lines.translated: Could I ever become as strong as her?

lines.content: そんな願いを込めたつもりで、私は言った。
lines.translated: Hoping to put that wish into my words, I spoke.

lines.content: 私も、あなたと同じだったよ
lines.translated: "I used to be the same as you."

lines.content: 私も私が誰なのか、いったい何者なのかわからず、お屋敷の中にずっと閉じ込められていた。
lines.translated: I didn't know who or what I was either, locked away inside that mansion all that time.

lines.content: そんな私に名前をくれた“夜の怪物”
lines.translated: It was the "monsters of the Night" who gave a name to someone like me.

lines.content: ふたりに“千和”と呼ばれるそれだけで、私は誰でもない私から、ふたりに大切に育ててもらった子になれた。
lines.translated: Just by having the two of them call me "Chiwa," I went from being a nobody to a child they raised with love and care.

lines.content: それはたった一年の間だけだったけれど……。
lines.translated: Even if it was only for a single year...

lines.content: 三人で暮らした時間は、私にとって大切にしたい宝物だった。
lines.translated: The time the three of us spent living together was a treasure I wanted to cherish forever.

lines.content: これからどんな悲しいことがあっても、苦しいことがあったとしても、心の中であの頃のことを思えば、頑張れる――無理矢理にでも頑張らなければとそう思えるはずだから。
lines.translated: No matter what sad or painful things might await me from here on out, as long as I held the memories of those days in my heart, I could keep going--I would surely be able to tell myself that I had to push through, even if I had to force myself.

lines.content: もう泣かないと決めたのに、三人で笑っていた今夜のことを思うと……。
lines.translated: I had already decided I wouldn't cry anymore, and yet, when I thought back to tonight, when the three of us were laughing together...

lines.content: たった数時間前のことを思うと、涙がまた流れそうになり……。
lines.translated: Just thinking about what happened mere hours ago made the tears threaten to spill over all over again...

lines.content: 待っててナハト。
lines.translated: Wait for me, Nacht.

lines.content: 約束するよ。
lines.translated: I promise.

lines.content: 必ず私がソルを連れて帰るから……。
lines.translated: I'll definitely bring Sol back home...

lines.content: 着いたよ
lines.translated: "We're here."

lines.content: ……女の子のそんな言葉にハッとして、私は涙を袖で乱暴に拭った。
lines.translated: Startled by the girl's words, I roughly wiped my tears away with my sleeve.

lines.content: ここが、“夜の王”が現れるとされている[ポイント|場所]だよ
lines.translated: "This is the point where the 'King of the Night' is said to appear."

lines.content: そしてあなたが、あなた自身の願いを叶える――そのための“魔法”を得る場所でもある
lines.translated: "And it's also the place where you'll obtain the 'magic' you need--to make your own wish come true."

lines.content: 大きな汽笛に身体を震わせ――……停車。
lines.translated: A loud whistle made my body tremble--...and the train came to a halt.

lines.content: 私は列車を降りた。
lines.translated: I stepped off the train.

lines.content: ……ここって
lines.translated: "...This place is..."

lines.content: そこは私たちの暮らしていた町、“参禅町”の駅だった。
lines.translated: It was the station of the town where we had been living, "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: しかもさっき出発したばかりの“夜”の中。“刻の終着駅”だ。
lines.translated: Not only that, we were inside the "Night," at the very place we had just departed from: "Time's Terminal Station."

lines.content: 何かの間違えだろうか。
lines.translated: Could this be some kind of mistake?

lines.content: そう思い、構内に降りた私は振り返る。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I turned around where I stood on the platform.

lines.content: 女の子も着いてきてくれていると思ってた。
lines.translated: I had assumed the girl was following right behind me.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。ここから先は一緒に行けない
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I can't go with you any further than this."

lines.content: だけど女の子は開かれた扉の側――列車の中に立っていた。
lines.translated: However, the girl was standing inside the train, right beside the open doors.

lines.content: 私にはあまり自由がないんだよ
lines.translated: "I don't have very much freedom, you see."

lines.content: 女の子はさみしそうに、言う。
lines.translated: The girl spoke with a lonely look on her face.

lines.content: 私は“夜”の中でもごく限られた場所でしか出歩けないようになっている。どういうわけか、そう、なってる
lines.translated: "Even within the 'Night,' I'm only able to walk around in a very limited number of places. For whatever reason, that's just how it is."

lines.content: この列車の中。この駅の中。この町にあるという神社の敷地内。
lines.translated: Inside this train. Inside this station. And on the grounds of a shrine said to be in this town.

lines.content: それが女の子が唯一、出歩ける場所なのだと言う――あなたと私は同じだねと言ったけれど、違う。私よりもずっとずっと、この子のほうが自由はなかった。
lines.translated: She told me those were the only places she could walk around--I had said earlier that she and I were the same, but I was wrong. This girl had far, far less freedom than I ever did.

lines.content: 良くよく聞いて。思いの外早く到着してしまったからあまり多くを説明する暇がなかった。だから、簡単で悪いけれど、必要最低限の情報を今からあなたに手渡すよ
lines.translated: "Listen very carefully. We arrived sooner than I expected, so I didn't have time to explain very much. I feel bad keeping it so brief, but I'm going to pass the bare minimum of information you need on to you right now."

lines.content: 私はうなずき……女の子の声をけして聞き漏らすまいとした。
lines.translated: I nodded... determined not to miss a single word she said.

lines.content: ……突拍子もないことを言うようだけれど……、ごめんね
lines.translated: "...This might sound completely outlandish, so... I'm sorry in advance."

lines.content: ここは
lines.translated: "This place..."

lines.content: この、“参禅町”は
lines.translated: "This 'Sanzen Town'..."

lines.content: あなたが暮らしていた“[町|参禅町]”のように見えて、そうではない――……[・|あ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]長いながい時間を飛び越えた先にある、[・|未][・|来][・|の][・|世][・|界][・|だ]
lines.translated: "It might look like the 'Sanzen Town' you lived in, but it isn't--...This is a world of the future, lying beyond a long, long leap through time from back then."

lines.content: 未来？
lines.translated: The future?

lines.content: 時間を、飛び越えた……？
lines.translated: We leaped... through time...?

lines.content: 『行き先は様々だ。次の人生だったり、夜空の[ほし|惑星]たちだったり。[・|遠][・|い][・|時][・|間][・|の][・|そ][・|の][・|先][・|だ][・|っ][・|た][・|り]にも行ける列車があると聞いたことがあるね』
lines.translated: "Their destinations vary. Sometimes it's the next life, sometimes it's the planets in the night sky. I've even heard there are trains that can take you far beyond into distant time."

lines.content: いつかの“夜”でソルが言っていた言葉を私は思い出していた。
lines.translated: I remembered the words Sol had spoken during some "Night" in the past.

lines.content: いい？　よく聞いて。未来と言ってもそう遠い先のことじゃない
lines.translated: "Okay? Listen closely. Even though I call it the future, it isn't all that far ahead."

lines.content: 車が空を飛んでたり、多くの人たちの殆どが想像もしていなかった発明が、それまでの常識を塗り替えていたり……。そういうことは殆どない
lines.translated: "Cars aren't flying through the sky, and there aren't any unimaginable inventions that have completely rewritten common sense... There's almost nothing like that."

lines.content: 人間が一世代ほど入れ替わる程度の長い時間が過ぎた先なのだ。そして、この[時間|ポイント]の“夜”の中にこそ“夜の王”は現れるんだと……女の子は、言った。
lines.translated: It was a time after a long stretch had passed--roughly enough for a single human generation to turn over. And it was within the "Night" of this specific point in time that the "King of the Night" would appear... or so the girl said.

lines.content: そして伝えるべき大切なものは、もうひとつ。
lines.translated: And there was one more important thing she had to tell me.

lines.content: あなたが契約を交わすのは私じゃない――私の“役割”はただ相応しいだろう子を選び、こうして連れてくるだけなんだよ
lines.translated: "I'm not the one you'll be making a contract with--my 'role' is simply to choose children who seem suitable and bring them here like this."

lines.content: あなたに契約をしようと言い、手を差し出したのはあなたの勇気を試すためだったと女の子は苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: The girl gave a wry smile, confessing that telling me to make a contract with her and holding out her hand had just been a test of my courage.

lines.content: 本当にあなたが取るべき手は、その相手は、この時代の“夜”を管理する女のひとだよ
lines.translated: "The person whose hand you really need to take is a woman who manages the 'Night' of this era."

lines.content: それが今から私が、たったひとりで、訪ねに行かなければならないひとなのだと早口で伝えられた――じりじりとベルの音。
lines.translated: Speaking rapidly, she told me that this was the person I had to go visit all by myself right now--and then, the shrill ringing of a bell echoed out.

lines.content: 時間だ。
lines.translated: It was time.

lines.content: ……もう、行かないと
lines.translated: "...I have to get going now."

lines.content: 次の列車が構内に滑り込んでくる。遠くから汽笛の音が響いていた。
lines.translated: The next train was sliding into the station. The sound of a whistle echoed from afar.

lines.content: ごめんね。私は行くよ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm heading off."

lines.content: 私と一緒に、願いを叶えるためにがんばる人を、探しに行くの……？
lines.translated: "Are you going to look for the others who will work hard with me to make their wishes come true...?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: ……時間を飛び越えられるなら
lines.translated: "...If you can leap through time..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……私が“怪物”たちの家に[さら|攫]われて来る前にまで、連れて行ってくれたらそれでよかったのに
lines.translated: "...I wish you could have just taken me back to before I was kidnapped and brought to the 'monsters'' house."

lines.content: そうだね。そうできたら満点だよね
lines.translated: "Yeah, you're right. If I could do that, it'd be a perfect ten out of ten."

lines.content: 女の子は苦笑いを浮かべ、“ごめんね”と言う。
lines.translated: A wry smile surfaced on the girl's face as she said, "I'm sorry."

lines.content: 私にはあまり自由がないって言ったけど……。列車の行き先も自由には選べないんだよ
lines.translated: "I mentioned that I don't have much freedom, right...? Well, I can't freely choose the train's destination, either."

lines.content: この子が行き着ける先は、このポイントの“夜”と、“夜の王”と戦うのに相応しいだろう“願い”の力を持った子がいる時間。その“夜”の中だけなんだ
lines.translated: "The only places this kid can reach are this point's 'Night,' and the times where children who possess the power of a 'wish' suitable for fighting the 'King of the Night' exist. Only inside those 'Nights.'"

lines.content: その“夜”に引き寄せられるようにして列車は進む――列車の行く先はいつだって決まってる。線路が続く場所にだけしか進めないのだ。
lines.translated: The train moved forward as if drawn to those "Nights"--its destination was always predetermined. It could only travel where the tracks led.

lines.content: できるだけ、あなたにやさしくしてくれる子を選んでくるよ。泣き虫なあなたのことをいじめたり、泣かしたりしないだろうやさしい子をね
lines.translated: "I'll do my best to pick kids who will be kind to you. Kind kids who won't bully a crybaby like you or make you cry."

lines.content: 最後に女の子は私に小さな紙切れを渡してくれた。
lines.translated: At the very end, the girl handed me a small slip of paper.

lines.content: そこには、この時代の――言葉にするとやはり信じがたい気持ちにはなるけれど――ともかく今から私が行くべき場所が記されていた。
lines.translated: Written on it was the place in this era--putting it into words still made it feel hard to believe, though--where I needed to go right now.

lines.content: それは地図だった。
lines.translated: It was a map.

lines.content: ふたりの怪物にとてもやさしく、とても大切に育てられた私だから……簡単な地図くらいならもう読める。
lines.translated: Because the two monsters had raised me with such kindness and care... I already knew how to read a simple map.

lines.content: ……それじゃあ、またね。なんとなくだけれど、あなたとはきっとまた会えるような予感がするよ
lines.translated: "...Well then, see you later. It's just a hunch, but I have a feeling you and I will meet again."

lines.content: 女の子は、かわいい顔をちょっと引き締め――
lines.translated: The girl's cute face grew a little serious--

lines.content: あなたの未来に、いつも、すてきな“魔法”がありますように
lines.translated: "May your future always be filled with wonderful 'magic.'"

lines.content: ピシッと敬礼するみたいにして、少し照れたようにはにかんだ。
lines.translated: She gave a crisp salute, then smiled shyly, looking a little embarrassed.

lines.content: 扉が閉まる。
lines.translated: The door closes.

lines.content: 大きな汽笛と蒸気を吹き出して、列車は走っていった。
lines.translated: With a loud blast of its whistle and a billow of steam, the train pulled away.

lines.content: その姿が見えなくなるまで私は見送り――“刻の終着駅”を出た。
lines.translated: I watched it go until it was completely out of sight--and then I left the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: するとちょうど時間だったみたいだ。
lines.translated: As I did, it seemed it was just about time.

lines.content: りんごんりんごん
lines.translated: Ding-dong, ding-dong.

lines.content: 時計塔のベルが鳴り響き……。
lines.translated: The clock tower's bell rang out...

lines.content: じわりじわりと“夜”が沈んだ。
lines.translated: Slowly, bit by bit, the "Night" sank away.

lines.content: 振り返る。すると“駅”はその姿を学園に変えていて……。
lines.translated: I looked back. The "station" had already changed its form into an academy...

lines.content: ……私も、行かないと
lines.translated: "...I need to get going, too."

lines.content: ……おかしいな。
lines.translated: That's strange.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでいると涙がいきなり溢れてくる。
lines.translated: The moment I was all alone, tears suddenly came spilling out.

lines.content: ひとりでいるのには慣れているはずだった。
lines.translated: I thought I was supposed to be used to being alone.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: “怪物”たちと過ごした時間が、私をすっかり泣き虫にしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: The time I spent with the "monsters" had turned me into a total crybaby.

lines.content: 誰もいない朝の町。
lines.translated: An empty morning town.

lines.content: 静かな時間だ。
lines.translated: A quiet hour.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでとぼとぼ歩いた……。
lines.translated: I trudged along all by myself...

lines.content: 見回せば町は確かに私がいつも見ている光景とは少し……ほんの少しだけどこかが違って見えた。
lines.translated: Looking around, the town really did look a little... just the slightest bit different from the scenery I was used to seeing.

lines.content: たとえば、たばこ屋さんがコンビニになっている。
lines.translated: For example, the tobacco shop had become a convenience store.

lines.content: たとえば、まだ小さかったはずの並木道のさくらが大きくなっている。
lines.translated: For example, the cherry trees lining the street, which should have still been small, had grown large.

lines.content: 未来の世界……。
lines.translated: A world of the future...

lines.content: ここは知っているけど知らない町……。
lines.translated: This was a town I knew, yet didn't know...

lines.content: ……で、あるらしい。
lines.translated: Or so it seemed.

lines.content: そんなところにたったひとり放り出されて……ひとりだ。
lines.translated: Thrown out into a place like this all by myself... I was alone.

lines.content: これから私はたったひとりで生きなきゃ行けない。仲間はいない。助けてくれる味方もいない。
lines.translated: From now on, I would have to survive all on my own. I had no friends. No allies to help me.

lines.content: これから、私、どうなるんだろう。
lines.translated: What was going to happen to me from here on out?

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 涙があふれる。止まらない。ぽろぽろ、こぼれる。
lines.translated: Tears overflowed. They wouldn't stop. They spilled down, drop by drop.

lines.content: 必ずソルを取り戻すんだって決めたのに。
lines.translated: Even though I had decided I would definitely get Sol back.

lines.content: もう泣かないって、決めたのに。
lines.translated: Even though I had decided I wouldn't cry anymore.

lines.content: そうだよ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: ……泣くのはソルが帰ってきてくれてからだ。
lines.translated: I'll save my crying for after Sol comes back to me.

lines.content: 涙をごしごし拭きながら、更に歩いた。
lines.translated: Scrubbing my tears away, I walked on.

lines.content: 地図によると目的地は駅から結構な距離があった。
lines.translated: According to the map, my destination was quite a distance from the station.

lines.content: 二時間くらい歩いただろうか……。
lines.translated: I must have walked for about two hours...

lines.content: 休みやすみ進んでいった先に辿り着いたのは、古びた駄菓子屋さんのような建物だった。
lines.translated: Moving forward while taking little breaks along the way, I finally arrived at a building that looked like an old, worn-down penny candy shop.

lines.content: 扉も窓も閉め切られてしまい、光もなく、中からはまるで人の気配が感じられないのは、今はまだ誰もが寝静まるような早朝だからだろうか。
lines.translated: Its doors and windows were shut tight, there were no lights on, and there wasn't a single sign of life inside--perhaps because it was still early morning, when everyone was fast asleep.

lines.content: 女の子からもらった紙切れを開く。
lines.translated: I unfolded the slip of paper the girl had given me.

lines.content: するとそこにはいくつかの番号が並んでいた。
lines.translated: There, a string of numbers was written out.

lines.content: 電話番号……。
lines.translated: A phone number...

lines.content: 女の子のメッセージがも一緒に添えてある。
lines.translated: A message from the girl was included alongside it.

lines.content: “この番号を店先の公衆電話に入力すること”
lines.translated: "Enter this number into the payphone out front."

lines.content: 公衆電話……
lines.translated: "A payphone..."

lines.content: 確かに、お店の出入り口付近に一台の電話機を見つけた。
lines.translated: Sure enough, I found a single telephone near the shop's entrance.

lines.content: この紙切れはいくつも用意されているのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe she had many of these slips of paper prepared.

lines.content: どこかの世界。どこかの時間。
lines.translated: In some world. In some time.

lines.content: その中で――私みたいな“誰か”と出会えたなら、その子に手渡すためにいくつもあの女の子が用意しているもの。これはそのうちの一枚なのだ。
lines.translated: Something that girl had made plenty of copies of, ready to hand over whenever she met "someone" like me. This was just one of those sheets.

lines.content: 私は受話器を手に取り、番号を公衆電話に打ち込んだ。
lines.translated: I picked up the receiver and punched the number into the payphone.

lines.content: 十円玉も入れていないのに受話器から呼び出し音が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: Even though I hadn't put a ten-yen coin in, I heard a ringing tone from the receiver.

lines.content: 一回。
lines.translated: Once.

lines.content: 二回。
lines.translated: Twice.

lines.content: 三回。
lines.translated: Three times.

lines.content: 四回……。
lines.translated: Four times...

lines.content: 少し、不安になってきたところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was starting to feel a little anxious,

lines.content: ぽつり、ぽつりと……。
lines.translated: One by one...

lines.content: さっきまで真っ暗だった建物の窓に、やわらかな明かりが順番に灯り始めた。
lines.translated: Soft lights began to turn on in sequence behind the windows of the building, which had been pitch black a moment ago.
It was the "Night"...

lines.content: 眠りについていたはずの今夜の“夜”が、もう一度……私のためだけに目覚める気配がした。
lines.translated: I felt the presence of tonight's "Night," which should have already gone to sleep, waking up once more... just for my sake.

lines.content: ……待ってたよ
lines.translated: "...I've been waiting for you."

lines.content: コール音が途切れ、電話口から囁くような声がした。
lines.translated: The ringing stopped, and a whispering voice came from the other end of the line.

lines.content: ようこそ、私たちの“夜”の中へ。話は聞いてるよ。さあ、中へおいで。玄関の鍵は開いている
lines.translated: "Welcome to our 'Night.' I've heard about you. Come on inside. The front door is unlocked."

lines.content: それだけ言うと電話は途切れた。
lines.translated: With just those words, the call disconnected.

lines.content: 少しだ。
lines.translated: Just a little.

lines.content: ほんの少しだけ迷ったけれど、私は明かりの灯った玄関を開いた――
lines.translated: I hesitated for just a moment, then opened the lit front door--

lines.content: 私はこの“夜”を管理する者。陽向井あさひという。正体は、そうだな――我が輩は猫である。なんてな
lines.translated: "I am the one who manages this 'Night.' My name is Hinamukai Asahi. As for my true identity, well--I am a cat. Just kidding."

lines.content: 悪戯っぽい笑顔を浮かべ、『これからどうぞよろしくな』とそのひとは言った。
lines.translated: With a mischievous smile on her face, the person said, "It's nice to meet you."

lines.content: 涙が……。
lines.translated: Tears...

lines.content: ……取り戻したい、ひとが、いるんです
lines.translated: "...There's someone... I want to get back."

lines.content: いっぱい……。
lines.translated: So many of them...

lines.content: ……どうか、お願いします。私の願いを……叶えてください
lines.translated: "...Please, I'm begging you. Please grant... my wish."

lines.content: 次々と……いっぱい。
lines.translated: One after another... so many tears.

lines.content: ……そうか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: 泣きながら[・|こ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で][・|の][・|こ][・|と]を語った私に、そのひとは、ため息をつくようにしてうなずいた。
lines.translated: As I cried and told her about everything that had happened up until now, the person let out a sigh and nodded.

lines.content: ……悪いな
lines.translated: "...Sorry."

lines.content: 話が違うと言われてしまうかもしれないけれど……私はね、安易な“魔法”にはあまり肯定的ではないんだよ
lines.translated: "You might say this isn't what you were promised, but... you see, I'm not really a fan of easy 'magic.'"

lines.content: ……だからまず、私は君に、君たちに、こう問わなければならない――君の願いに、[・|そ][・|の][・|“][・|魔][・|法][・|”][・|は]本当に……必要なのかな
lines.translated: "...So first, I have to ask you--all of you--this question: Is that 'magic' truly... necessary for your wish?"

lines.content: その問いかけと共に、小さな私と“夜の魔法使い”との日々がはじまったのだけれど……。
lines.translated: With that question, my days as a little girl living with the "Magician of the Night" began...

lines.content: ……ここから先は、先輩も知っていると思います。だから多くは語りません
lines.translated: "...I think you already know what happens from here on out, Senpai. So I won't say much."

lines.content: 閉じた闇の向こうから声がして……俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。
lines.translated: A voice called out from beyond the closed darkness... and I opened my eyelids.

lines.content: さっきまで深い眠りについていた千和が[まぶた|瞼]を開き、ベッドの中から俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa, who had been fast asleep until just a moment ago, had opened her eyes and was looking at me from the bed.

lines.content: 私たちがまだ、仲良くなる前に……。幼馴染みになるその前に
lines.translated: "Before we became close friends... Before we became childhood friends."

lines.content: まだまだお互いにお互いのことをよく知らない中で……およそ十年前の“夜”の中で、力を合わせて“夜の王”と戦った。ただそれだけの話があるだけです
lines.translated: "While we still barely knew anything about each other... in the 'Night' roughly ten years ago, we joined forces and fought the 'King of the Night.' That's really all there is to the story."

lines.content: 同じ“夢”を見ていたのだろう千和がそう言い、苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa, who must have been seeing the same "dream," said this with a wry smile on her face.

lines.content: その、左手……
lines.translated: "That left hand..."

lines.content: “元魔法少女”である杏藤千和。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa, a "former magical girl."

lines.content: 彼女は、俺が彼女に触れているその手のひらに、いったいどういった事情が付与されているのか――なんとなくだろうけど理解したようだった。
lines.translated: She seemed to have at least a vague understanding of the circumstances behind the palm of my hand currently touching her.

lines.content: ああ……。そうだね。[・|そ][・|こ][・|か][・|ら][・|先]は、わかってる
lines.translated: "Yeah... That's right. I know what happened from that point on."

lines.content: ここからしばらく先の出来事は俺も重々理解しているつもりだ。
lines.translated: I was all too familiar with the events that followed for a while after that.

lines.content: ここからは“人類の未来を救うための戦争”がはじまった――というだけのことなのだ。
lines.translated: From that point on, the "war to save the future of humanity" began--that was all there was to it.
And then, the war ended.

lines.content: 次々と集められた子ども達。
lines.translated: Children gathered one after another.

lines.content: ……それぞれに叶えがたい“[願い|夢]”を抱えた子ども達。
lines.translated: Children who each carried a "wish"--a dream--that was nearly impossible to grant.

lines.content: 全員が文字通り力を合わせ……結果、俺たちは勝利したのだ。
lines.translated: Everyone literally joined forces... and as a result, we were victorious.

lines.content: “勝利”という結果を得るには一筋縄ではいかなかったのも事実だ。
lines.translated: It was also a fact that achieving that "victory" had been far from straightforward.

lines.content: 最大最悪の“悪夢”である“夜の王”と対峙するのには様々な困難があったはず。
lines.translated: Facing the "King of the Night," the greatest and worst "nightmare" of all, must have come with countless hardships.

lines.content: 仲間の誰かが傷つき。信頼などまだまるで互いにないから喧嘩も尽きず。
lines.translated: One of our comrades would get hurt. Because we didn't have an ounce of trust in each other yet, the fighting amongst ourselves never ended.

lines.content: ときに離ればなれにもなり。もうだめかと思ったことも何度だってあったはず。
lines.translated: Sometimes we were separated. There must have been countless times when we thought it was all over.

lines.content: だけどそれらを乗り越え、俺たちは無事に勝利を得たけれど……。
lines.translated: Yet we overcame all of that and safely claimed our victory, even so...

lines.content: ……“夜の王”をみんなで倒して、契約どおり、事前の約束どおりに……ようやく私たちは、私たちの物語を終わらせられる[魔法|きっかけ]を得られたけれど
lines.translated: "...We all defeated the 'King of the Night' together, and just as contracted, just as promised beforehand... we finally obtained the magic--the catalyst--to bring our own stories to an end, and yet..."

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 他のみんなはどうだったのかは知らない。
lines.translated: I didn't know how it had been for the others.

lines.content: だけど私にとっては、そのときにはもう、何もかもが遅すぎたんです
lines.translated: "But for me, by the time that happened, it was already far too late for everything."

lines.content: もう一度閉じた[まぶた|瞼]の闇に、再びあのときの千和の“夢”が映し出される。
lines.translated: In the darkness behind my closed eyelids once more, Chiwa's "dream" from back then played out again.

lines.content: ……およそ十年前の“夜”の空。
lines.translated: The sky of the "Night," roughly ten years ago.

lines.content: きらきら瞬く“夜”を覆い尽くさんばかりだった巨大な“[それ|夜の王]”は、誰かが撃ち込んだ止めの一撃に力尽き……。
lines.translated: The colossal "King of the Night," which had nearly blotted out the sparkling "Night," finally gave out from the finishing blow someone had struck...

lines.content: たくさん、たくさん、
lines.translated: So many, so many,

lines.content: いっぱい、いっぱい、
lines.translated: Endless, endless,

lines.content: その[・|巨][・|体]は、ひらひらで、ふわふわの花びらとなり、“夜”の街中に降り注いだ。
lines.translated: Its massive body turned into fluttering, fluffy petals that rained down all across the city of the "Night."

lines.content: ひら、ひら、ひらり……。
lines.translated: Fluttering, drifting down...

lines.content: さくらの降る“夜”の空。
lines.translated: The sky of the "Night," with cherry blossoms falling.

lines.content: [・|私]は、私[・|た][・|ち]は、揃って空を見上げていた。
lines.translated: I--no, we--were all looking up at the sky together.
The war was finally over.

lines.content: 花のようにばらばらに砕けて散った“夜の王”
lines.translated: The "King of the Night" had shattered and scattered like flowers.

lines.content: その姿はまるで、私の手の中でひび割れ、崩れてしまった[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]のようで……。
lines.translated: That sight looked just like that person who had cracked and crumbled away in my hands...

lines.content: その一片ひとひらに、世界中から寄せ集められた強い想いが詰まっていて……。
lines.translated: Every single petal was packed with strong feelings gathered from all over the world...

lines.content: “夜”に降り注ぐいっぱいの花の中で、私は、祈った――“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: Amidst the countless flowers raining down into the "Night," I prayed--for "magic."

lines.content: “夜の王”を打ち倒した者にのみ与えられるという権利。外の世界にたったひとつ、“魔法”を持ち出せるという特権。
lines.translated: A right granted only to those who defeated the "King of the Night." The privilege to bring just one piece of "magic" out into the outside world.

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: そのときの私は、いったいどんな“魔法”がほしいと思い描いただろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of "magic" had I envisioned wanting back then?

lines.content: どんな“奇跡”があれば、つらかったことや悲しかったことを帳消しにできるだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of "miracle" could possibly wipe away all the painful and sad things that had happened?

lines.content: 私が殺してしまった大切なひと。
lines.translated: The precious person I had killed.

lines.content: 私が傷つけてしまった、孤独なあのひと。
lines.translated: That lonely person I had hurt.

lines.content: ふたりに捧げる“魔法”は……。
lines.translated: The "magic" I would dedicate to the two of them was...

lines.content: ……“死んでしまったひとを蘇らせること”
lines.translated: "...To bring someone who died back to life."

lines.content: それが私の望んだ“最後の魔法”
lines.translated: That was the "final magic" I wished for.

lines.content: ……そして、その“魔法”を使うための“代償”は――……
lines.translated: "...And the 'price' to use that 'magic' was--..."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]に釣り合うだけの[・|支][・|払][・|い]も“想像”できた。
lines.translated: I could also "imagine" a payment steep enough to balance it out.

lines.content: だけど本当に、そんな“奇跡”以上に困難だろうことが“魔法”なんかで可能にできるのか。[・|た][・|っ][・|た][・|こ][・|れ][・|っ][・|ぽ][・|っ][・|ち][・|の][・|“][・|代][・|償][・|”]で足りるのだろうか……。
lines.translated: But could something even more difficult than a "miracle" really be made possible through "magic"? Would a "price" as small as this really be enough...?

lines.content: “さよなら”が私は嫌い。もう二度と取り戻せないものばかりだから
lines.translated: "I hate 'goodbyes.' Because they're full of things you can never get back again."

lines.content: 疑う気持ちはいくつもあった。
lines.translated: I had plenty of doubts.

lines.content: それでも私は信じた。信じなければと、縋った。
lines.translated: Even so, I believed. Telling myself I had to believe, I clung to it.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じると思い出す――ソルと、ナハト。そして私。三人一緒に暮らした短い時間。
lines.translated: When I closed my eyelids, I remembered--Sol, and Nacht. And me. The brief time the three of us lived together.

lines.content: お誕生日を祝ってくれた最後の日がどうしてだかいつまでも忘れられなかった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I could never forget that final day when they celebrated my birthday.

lines.content: あの日の光景を、時間を、もう一度取り戻すのが私の“夢”だ。
lines.translated: Taking back the scenery of that day, that time, once more was my "dream."

lines.content: でも……
でも、今も、昔も、そのための“魔法”は本当に必要だったのか――
lines.translated: But both now and back then, was the "magic" for that truly necessary--?

lines.content: 最初に“夜の魔法使い”にそう問いかけられたように、私自身もわからなくなってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Just as the "Magician of the Night" had asked me at the very beginning, I myself no longer knew anymore.

lines.content: なぜなら……。
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: 取り戻したいと願ったはずの、そのひとは……。
lines.translated: The person I had wished to get back...

lines.content: ……おかえり、千和
lines.translated: "...Welcome home, Chiwa."

lines.content: 願いを叶えるため、何十年と時間を飛び越えたその先に……。
lines.translated: Waiting at the end of my leap across decades of time to grant my wish...

lines.content: 長いながいお出かけだったね。でも……よかった。元気そうで、本当によかったよ
lines.translated: "That was a long, long outing, wasn't it? But... thank goodness. You look well, and I'm truly glad."

lines.content: そのひとは“[奇跡|魔法]”を持ち帰るまでもなく、変わらない笑顔で、私の帰りを待っていてくれたから……。
lines.translated: Even without me bringing back a "miracle"--"magic"--that person had been waiting for my return with the same unchanging smile...

lines.content: また三人で暮らしていこう。私たちはこれからもずっと、ずっと、三人一緒の家族だからね
lines.translated: "Let's live together as three again. Because from now on, forever and ever, the three of us are a family."

lines.content: あさひさんの“ゆめのねどこ”に辿り着いてから、私は一度もお家には帰っていませんでした
lines.translated: "Ever since I arrived at Asahi-san's 'Bed of Dreams,' I hadn't gone back home even once."

lines.content: “夜の王”との戦争が終わるまで千和は山の上の施設で寝起きしていた。
lines.translated: Until the war with the "King of the Night" ended, Chiwa had lived at the facility atop the mountain.

lines.content: ナハトの顔を見るのが怖かったからだと千和は言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa said it was because she was afraid to look Nacht in the face.

lines.content: ここは、私が産まれた世界より何十年か先の……未来の世界
lines.translated: "This is a world several decades ahead of the one I was born into... a world of the future."

lines.content: 私のことを知ってる人はもう殆ど生きてはいないだろうし、もしも生きていたとしても、相当なお年寄りになっているだろうと思います
lines.translated: "Most of the people who knew me are probably no longer alive, and even if they were, I think they'd be quite elderly by now."

lines.content: だけど“夜の怪物”は“不死のイキモノ”――[・|時][・|間]では彼らを殺すことはできない。
lines.translated: However, the "Monsters of the Night" are "Immortal Creatures"--time cannot kill them.

lines.content: きっと、何十年なんていう長い時間でも、ナハトにとってはあっという間で……
lines.translated: "Surely, even a long span of time like several decades was just the blink of an eye for Nacht..."

lines.content: だからナハトはあの頃と変わらず、ソルと出会う以前のように、あの家で今もひとりぼっちで生きている……かも、しれない
lines.translated: "So Nacht might still be living all alone in that house right now, unchanged from back then, just like before he met Sol... maybe."

lines.content: もしかすると新しい友だちを作って一緒に暮らしている可能性もあったかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Though there was also a possibility that he might have made new friends and was living together with them...

lines.content: ナハトがそうしているような光景を、私にはどうしても上手く想像できなかったから
lines.translated: "Because I just couldn't picture Nacht doing something like that no matter how hard I tried."

lines.content: だからソルを取り戻せる“魔法”を、彼の元に持ち帰れるのだとわかってからでなければ、千和はとても家には帰れないと思った。
lines.translated: That was why Chiwa felt she couldn't possibly go home until she knew for sure she could bring the "magic" to get Sol back home to him.

lines.content: ……この世界は、いっぱいのおとぎ話でできている
lines.translated: "...This world is made up of so many fairy tales."

lines.content: ぽつりと、ため息のように千和が言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa murmured the words like a sigh.

lines.content: “夜の王”をみんなで倒してからが私の本当のお話のはじまりだって、思っていたんです。もう何も間違えられない。[・|そ][・|こ]から先こそが本番だった。だけど……
lines.translated: "I thought my real story would begin after we all defeated the 'King of the Night' together. I couldn't afford to make any more mistakes. Everything from that point on was supposed to be the real thing. And yet..."

lines.content: “大切なひとを取り戻すための魔法”
lines.translated: "Magic to take back someone precious."

lines.content: そんな“奇跡”を握りしめ、何十年ぶりかに帰宅した千和を待っていたのは……。
lines.translated: Clutching that "miracle" tightly, what awaited Chiwa when she returned home for the first time in decades was...

lines.content: 孤独に暮らしていたナハトでも、新しく[・|そ][・|こ]に住み着いたまるで知らない“誰か”でもなく……ソルだった。
lines.translated: Neither Nacht living in solitude, nor some complete "stranger" who had newly settled in there... It was Sol.

lines.content: 死んだはずの……“さよなら”をしたはずのひとが、千和の帰りを待っていた。
lines.translated: The person who was supposed to be dead... the person she had supposedly said "goodbye" to, was waiting for Chiwa's return.

lines.content: 唖然とした。
lines.translated: She was dumbfounded.

lines.content: 呆然とだってした。
lines.translated: She was stunned senseless, too.

lines.content: 彼は“いつか三人で本当にお店をするのもいいね”――そんな夢物語を、たったひとりで叶えるように生きていたのだ。
lines.translated: "It'd be nice if the three of us could run a real shop together someday"--he had been living as if to fulfill that pipe dream all by himself.

lines.content: 確かに、[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]は私の手の中で花に戻って、消えてしまった……そのはずなのに
lines.translated: "That person definitely turned back into a flower in my hands and disappeared... At least, he was supposed to have."

lines.content: もちろん、千和は“どうして？”と問い詰めたという。
lines.translated: Naturally, Chiwa said she pressed him, asking "Why?"

lines.content: ……花です
lines.translated: "...The flower."

lines.content: 千和は目を伏せて、言った。
lines.translated: Lowering her eyes, Chiwa spoke.

lines.content: ソルの身体がばらばらに崩れて……私の手の中に残った一輪の花。ナハトに渡したその花が、“夜の怪物”にとっての心臓で――
lines.translated: "When Sol's body crumbled apart... the single flower that remained in my hands. That flower I handed to Nacht is the heart of a 'Monster of the Night'--"

lines.content: それが枯れさえしなければ“怪物”は死なない。“夜”の中であれば何度でも復活できる――何度でも、何度でも。まさに“不死のイキモノ”だ。
lines.translated: As long as that doesn't wither, the "monster" does not die. As long as they are within the "Night," they can revive as many times as it takes--over and over again. Truly an "Immortal Creature."

lines.content: 問い詰める千和に、ソルはそう説明したのだという。
lines.translated: When Chiwa pressed him, that was how Sol explained it to her.

lines.content: 私が家を飛び出してからすぐ、ナハトがその花をさくらの木の根元に植えたそうです。あの大きなおおきなさくらの木です
lines.translated: "Right after I ran out of the house, Nacht apparently planted that flower at the base of the cherry blossom tree. That big, huge cherry blossom tree."

lines.content: ソルの復活にはおよそ数年ほど掛かったけれど、しかしその身体は完全に元の姿を取り戻し……。
lines.translated: It took roughly several years for Sol to revive, yet his body completely regained its original form...

lines.content: 目を覚ますと私がいない。どこにも、いない……
lines.translated: "When he woke up, I wasn't there. Nowhere to be found..."

lines.content: その[わけ|理由]をナハトから聞いて、ソルはずっと私が帰ってくるのを待っていたと、そう言いました
lines.translated: "Sol told me that after hearing the reason why from Nacht, he spent the whole time waiting for me to come back."

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”から列車に乗った千和の姿を“夜”の住人たちが見ていたという。あの猫だ。他人の人生を覗き見ることが好きな悪趣味な猫。
lines.translated: Apparently, the residents of the "Night" had seen Chiwa boarding the train from the "Terminal Station of Time." It was that cat. That cat in poor taste who loved peeking into other people's lives.

lines.content: “怪物”たちは、[・|そ][・|の][・|言][・|葉]を信じた――意地悪な猫から聞かされた私の行き先は、[・|未][・|来]だ。
lines.translated: The "monsters" believed those words--the destination I had been told about by that mean cat was the future.

lines.content: ソルを取り戻すため、私は、時間を飛び越えるのだという“噂”の列車に飛び乗った。
lines.translated: In order to get Sol back, I had jumped aboard the "rumored" train said to leap across time.

lines.content: ……どれだけ先の未来に私が向かったのかは、さすがにわからなかったみたいですけど……
lines.translated: "...Though it seems they couldn't quite figure out just how far into the future I had gone..."

lines.content: しかし“夜の怪物”は“不死”である。
lines.translated: However, a "Monster of the Night" is "immortal."

lines.content: 未来へと旅立った千和を、滅びることのない長いながい時間の中で待ち続けていた――
lines.translated: Throughout a long, unending stretch of time, he had kept waiting for Chiwa, who had departed for the future--

lines.content: 何十年。何百年。たとえ何千年後の未来であろうと待ち続けるつもりだったとソルは言ったのだという。
lines.translated: Decades. Centuries. Sol told her that even if it were a future thousands of years ahead, he had intended to keep waiting.

lines.content: 『……千和。君が“未来へ旅立つ”なんていう奇跡を手に入れたのも、きっと、私が君のことをたくさん傷つけたからだ』
lines.translated: "'...Chiwa. The reason you ended up obtaining a miracle like "departing for the future" is surely because I hurt you so much.'"

lines.content: 千和を待ち続けていたソルはそう言った。
lines.translated: Sol, who had kept waiting for Chiwa, said that.

lines.content: 『“夜の怪物”は決して死なない。なぜならもう既にこの身体に命はないのだから――その事実をしっかりと説明し切れていなかった。そのせいで……。私は君を、傷つけた』
lines.translated: "'A "Monster of the Night" never dies. Because there is already no life in this body to begin with--I failed to explain that fact to you properly. And because of that... I hurt you.'"

lines.content: 『私を蘇らせるための方法が未来にある。そう、言われたから。それを、信じたから……千和。君は長いながい旅に、たったひとりで、立ち向かってくれたんだよね』
lines.translated: "'Because you were told there was a way to revive me in the future. Because you believed that... Chiwa. You braved that long, long journey all by yourself for me, didn't you?'"

lines.content: ありがとう。そして、ごめんね。
lines.translated: Thank you. And I'm sorry.

lines.content: 『たくさんたくさん、大変な思いをさせてしまったね。だけどもう、平気だよ。何もかもが元通りだ』
lines.translated: "'I put you through so, so much hardship, didn't I? But it's okay now. Everything is back to the way it was.'"

lines.content: そんな言葉に迎え入れられて……。
lines.translated: Welcomed back by those words...

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: 何もかもが悪い夢だったんだ。
lines.translated: Everything had just been a bad dream.

lines.content: またここで、三人一緒に暮らしていける――あの頃の千和は何も疑うことを知らず、その心はあまりにもまっすぐで、あんまりにも少女だったのだ。
lines.translated: The three of us could live here together again--the Chiwa of back then knew nothing of doubt; her heart was far too earnest, and she was far too much of a young girl.

lines.content: ただただ、安堵の涙を流してばかりいたという。
lines.translated: She said she did nothing but shed tears of sheer relief.

lines.content: それから私たちは[・|ふ][・|た][・|り][・|で]暮らし始めました
lines.translated: "After that, the two of us started living together."

lines.content: ふたり？
lines.translated: "The two of you?"

lines.content: ……はい。ソルと、私のふたりです
lines.translated: "...Yes. The two of us--Sol and me."

lines.content: 学校に通わせてもらいました。ソルがあの頃みたいに私のお父さんの代わりをしてくれました
lines.translated: "He let me attend school. Sol stood in as my father for me, just like back then."

lines.content: だからこうして無事にここまで大きくなれましたと、千和は苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: "That's how I was able to grow up safely to where I am now," Chiwa said with a wry smile on her face.

lines.content: だけど、ナハトはどこかへ出かけたままお家に帰ってきませんでした。ナハトとはここに、この未来の時間にやって来てから、一度も会えていなかったんです。今夜までは、一度も
lines.translated: "However, Nacht went out somewhere and never came back home. Ever since I came here, to this time in the future, I hadn't been able to see Nacht even once. Not even once, until tonight."

lines.content: ずっと、ずっと、ふたりだけで暮らしていたんです。どうしてナハトは帰ってこないのとソルに聞くと、ちょっとあいつとは喧嘩中なんだよと、そう、言ってましたけど……
lines.translated: "For the longest, longest time, it was just the two of us living together. Whenever I asked Sol why Nacht wasn't coming home, he would just say, 'I'm having a bit of a fight with him right now,' though..."

lines.content: とにかく千和は元の生活を[・|半][・|分][・|く][・|ら][・|い]取り戻すことができた――“魔法”など介入する隙もなく。
lines.translated: In any case, Chiwa was able to reclaim about half of her original life--without any room for "magic" to intervene.

lines.content: 死んでしまったと思っていたソルは生きていた。だけどナハトがそこにいない。そんな生活。
lines.translated: Sol, whom she had thought was dead, was alive. Yet Nacht wasn't there. That kind of life.

lines.content: ふたりが喧嘩別れをしてしまった理由は、どうしても教えてもらえませんでしたけど……私のせいかもしれない。そんなふうには、何度も思いました
lines.translated: "He wouldn't tell me the reason why the two of them had a falling out no matter how much I asked, though... It might have been my fault. I thought that to myself so many times."

lines.content: ……ふたりの関係を私は壊した。
lines.translated: I destroyed the relationship between the two of them.

lines.content: 千和の心にはやはり、遠いとおい昔に産まれた“後悔”が、強く……爪を立てているように俺には感じられた。
lines.translated: To me, it felt as though a "regret" born in the distant, faraway past was still digging its claws deeply into Chiwa's heart.

lines.content: ……私は、十年前の戦いの結果、ご褒美としてもらった“最後の魔法”の使い道をなくしてしまいました
lines.translated: "...As a result of the battle ten years ago, I lost my use for the 'final magic' I received as a reward."

lines.content: 千和は改めるようにして、言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa composed herself and spoke.

lines.content: ソルが無事に生きていたのなら[・|そ][・|れ][・|以][・|上]に求めることはない――ただ私が早とちりしてしまっただけ。ほんの少し、苦労を無駄に重ねてしまったというだけだ。
lines.translated: As long as Sol was safe and alive, there was nothing more to ask for--she had simply jumped to conclusions. She had just gone through a little bit of needless hardship for nothing.

lines.content: ……どうして
俺は疑問を抱かずにはいられなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help having my doubts.

lines.content: 少なくとも今、ここにはいくつかの謎がある。
lines.translated: At the very least, there were still several mysteries here right now.

lines.content: どうして、なんだろう
lines.translated: "Why is that, I wonder..."

lines.content: 千和が自分の過ちで殺してしまったはずのソルは生きていた。
lines.translated: Sol, whom Chiwa was supposed to have killed through her own mistake, was alive.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: そもそも、ソルの死に対して千和に落ち度はかけらもないと第三者の目には写りはするが、当人にしてみればそうはいかないというのも理解はできるが……。
lines.translated: To begin with, from a third party's perspective, Chiwa wasn't the slightest bit at fault for Sol's death, though I could understand why she couldn't see it that way herself...

lines.content: ここで話し合いたいのは[・|そ][・|れ]ではない。
lines.translated: However, that wasn't what I wanted to talk about right now.

lines.content: 千和を育てた“夜の怪物”……ふたりは何か言い合うようなことはあっても、それは仲がいいことの延長だったように俺も感じたけれど
lines.translated: "The 'Monsters of the Night' who raised you... Even if the two of them bickered over things, it felt to me like that was just an extension of how close they were."

lines.content: 千和の心を通してその光景を覗き見たこの俺は、否応なく、そう感じてしまうのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Having peeked at those scenes through Chiwa's heart, I couldn't help feeling that way, whether I wanted to or not...

lines.content: ……それなのにどうして、ナハトはソルのことを殺害したのかな
lines.translated: "...And yet, why did Nacht murder Sol?"

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 今夜。ここにこうして千和と一緒にいることも、はじまりはそこだった。
lines.translated: Tonight. Even the fact that I was here with Chiwa like this had started from that.

lines.content: 千和のお父さん、杏藤一磨は何者かに殺害された――今やその“何者か”が誰であるのかは論ずるまでもない。彼の友人であるはずの“夜の怪物”ナハトだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa's father, Andou Kazuma, had been murdered by someone--at this point, there was no need to even debate who that "someone" was. It was his supposed friend, the "Monster of the Night," Nacht.

lines.content: 千和の時間を知ってしまっただけに、今夜の[彼|ナハト]の行動があまりに腑に落ちない。
lines.translated: Precisely because I had come to know Chiwa's past, Nacht's actions tonight made far too little sense to me.

lines.content: ソルは、ナハトにばらばらにされてたんだよね
lines.translated: "Sol was torn to pieces by Nacht, wasn't he?"

lines.content: ……はい
その光景は、言葉にするだけで凄惨なものだっただろうと想像できる。
lines.translated: Just putting that scene into words was enough to imagine how gruesome it must have been.

lines.content: だけど俺が千和の家に駆けつけた頃にはその遺体はどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: Yet by the time I rushed over to Chiwa's house, the body was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 消えたのだ。大量の血液だけが部屋を真っ赤に染めているだけだった――ここで浮上する謎は、ふたつだ。
lines.translated: It had vanished. Only a massive amount of blood was left staining the room bright red--which brought two mysteries to the surface here.

lines.content: まず、ひとつ。
lines.translated: First, one.

lines.content: 疑問なんだけど、身体をばらばらに切り刻むということで“不死の怪物”は殺せるのかな。確か、彼らを殺せる唯一の方法は……
lines.translated: "Here's a question, though: can an 'Immortal Monster' even be killed by having their body hacked to pieces? If I remember right, the only way to kill them is..."

lines.content: “人間と触れあうこと”、ですね
lines.translated: "'Coming into contact with a human,' right?"

lines.content: うん。そうだった
lines.translated: "Right. That's what it was."

lines.content: 本当にソルは殺されたのかな。理由はわからないけど、過激だけれど彼らにとってはただの喧嘩というか、仲間割れというか……
lines.translated: "Was Sol really killed, I wonder? I don't know the reason, and it's extreme, but for them, maybe it was just a fight, or a falling-out between friends..."

lines.content: ふたりの間にいったいどんなことがあったのかは、千和も話してもらえていないということだから、もちろん俺にもわからないけれど……
lines.translated: "Since they wouldn't tell you what happened between the two of them either, Chiwa, I obviously have no way of knowing, of course..."

lines.content: ばらばらに相手を切り刻むのも、首を切り落としてしまうのも、“不死”なる者同士が激突すれば、その程度のことくらいならありうる……のかな
lines.translated: "Hacking the other person to pieces, or lopping off their head... if two 'immortal' beings clash, couldn't something on that level just happen?"

lines.content: わかりません
lines.translated: "I don't know."

lines.content: 千和は首を振る。
lines.translated: Chiwa shook her head.

lines.content: ……ふたりがそこまでの喧嘩をする理由もわからないんです。ちょっとしたことを言い合うならまだしも……
lines.translated: "...I don't even know why the two of them would have a fight that extreme. Bickering over little things is one thing, but..."

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: なぜナハトはソルを襲ったのか。
lines.translated: Why did Nacht attack Sol?

lines.content: それについては、ここでこうして考えているだけでは答えを見いだせそうになかった。叶うなら本人から事情を聞き出す以上に的確なものはなさそうだ。
lines.translated: When it came to that, it didn't seem like we would find an answer just by thinking about it here like this. If possible, nothing would be more accurate than hearing the circumstances from the person himself.

lines.content: 千和
lines.translated: Chiwa

lines.content: ……あのさ。俺が疑問に思うことは、謎に感じてしまうことは、もうひとつだけあるんだけど……聞いてもいいかな
lines.translated: "...Hey. There's just one more thing I'm wondering about, one more thing that feels like a mystery to me... Can I ask you?"

lines.content: ……はい
千和は俺の顔を見上げる。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked up at my face.

lines.content: それは……。どんな疑問で、どんな謎、なんでしょうか
lines.translated: "And that is...? What kind of question, and what kind of mystery is it?"

lines.content: ああ、うん……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 実のところ少しばかり問いかけづらいものではあるのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Truth be told, it was a slightly awkward thing to ask, though...

lines.content: それに、少々場違いな質問にもなってしまうだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Plus, it would probably end up being a somewhat out-of-place question right now...

lines.content: 今を逃せば、更にこの問いに勇気が必要になってしまうだろうから、
lines.translated: However, if I let this moment slip by, it would probably take even more courage to ask this question later, so...

lines.content: どうして、なのかな
lines.translated: "Why is it, I wonder?"

lines.content: 俺は首をかしげ、言った。
lines.translated: I tilted my head and spoke.

lines.content: どうして……、千和は、俺のことを好きになってくれたのかな
lines.translated: "Why... did you come to like me, Chiwa?"

lines.content: ここまでの話に、そして覗き見てしまった光景の中に、この疑問に答えをくれるものはひとつもなかった……ように、思える。
lines.translated: In everything she had talked about up to this point, and in all the scenes I had peeked into, it felt... as though there wasn't a single thing that offered an answer to this question.

lines.content: 別に自分を卑下しようというつもりはないんだ。ただ、どうしても不思議には思ってしまう
lines.translated: "I'm not trying to put myself down or anything. I just can't help wondering about it."

lines.content: だってさ、千和。こう言うのもどこか変かもしれないけど、俺は、千和に好きになってもらえるようなことを、何か……何かひとつでもしたような覚えもないんだ
lines.translated: "I mean, Chiwa... it might sound a little strange to put it like this, but I don't remember ever doing anything... not even a single thing that would make you fall in love with me."

lines.content: そもそもこんな問いかけをすること自体がどうかしてしまってはいる。
lines.translated: Asking a question like this in the first place was a bit crazy in itself.

lines.content: 言葉を吐き出してから、その滑稽さとでもいうのだろうか――浮き足立つような羞恥を覚え始めていた。
lines.translated: Once I blurted the words out, I started feeling a restless sort of embarrassment over how ridiculous it sounded.

lines.content: ……えっと
だからつい、言葉を詰まらせてしまう。顔が少し熱かった。
lines.translated: Because of that, I ended up stumbling over my words. My face felt a little hot.

lines.content: 先輩
lines.translated: "Senpai."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: どきっとした。千和の声が意外に思えるほど真っ直ぐだったから。
lines.translated: My heart skipped a beat. Because Chiwa's voice was so unexpectedly direct.

lines.content: 私が、先輩のことを……好きになった理由は
lines.translated: "The reason I... fell in love with you, Senpai, is..."

lines.content: 声や言葉だけではない。俺のことを見上げる千和の視線もまた、同じように真っ直ぐだった。
lines.translated: It wasn't just her voice and her words. Chiwa's gaze as she looked up at me was just as direct.

lines.content: ……千和？
lines.translated: "...Chiwa?"

lines.content: 真っ直ぐだ。ただ真っ直ぐに俺を見つめたまま、少しの間、千和は何も言わなかったけれど……、
lines.translated: Unwavering. For a short while, Chiwa didn't say anything, just staring straight at me, until...

lines.content: きっと
lines.translated: "I'm sure..."

lines.content: ……ぽつりと言い、
lines.translated: she murmured quietly,

lines.content: きっと先輩は、覚えていないと思います
lines.translated: "I'm sure you don't remember it, Senpai."

lines.content: ほんの僅かにさみしそうな顔で、千和は小さく笑っていた。
lines.translated: With the faintest trace of loneliness on her face, Chiwa gave a small smile.

lines.content: そう、なのかな。でも、[・|そ][・|れ][・|く][・|ら][・|い]の大きなことなら、指摘されたらさすがに思い出せるんじゃないかと……
lines.translated: "Is that so? Still, if it was something that big, I feel like I'd at least remember it if you pointed it out to me..."

lines.content: ……え、えっと。違うんです
lines.translated: "...U-Um. That's not it."

lines.content: 別に、そのことに拗ねてたりなんてしていませんし、覚えていない先輩を責めたりするつもりも全然ないんです
lines.translated: "I'm not pouting about it or anything, and I have no intention at all of blaming you for not remembering, Senpai."

lines.content: ……ただ
lines.translated: "...It's just..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ただ……きっと、先輩が考えてるような劇的な何かがあったわけじゃないんです
lines.translated: "It's just... there really wasn't anything dramatic like what you're probably imagining, Senpai."

lines.content: たとえば十年前の戦いほど、忘れたくても忘れられない“何か”があって。だから私は、先輩を……その……好きになったわけじゃなくて。きっかけはただごくごくふつうのことです
lines.translated: "For instance, it's not like there was 'something' so unforgettable I couldn't forget it even if I tried, like the battle ten years ago, and that's why I... um... fell in love with you, Senpai. What started it was something completely, utterly ordinary."

lines.content: あんまりにもふつうのこと過ぎて、口にするのも恥ずかしいくらいなのだと千和は言う。
lines.translated: It was something so ordinary that it was almost embarrassing to even say out loud, Chiwa said.

lines.content: ……だから、先輩が覚えていなくても仕方がないし、だからこそずっと、ずっと、この気持ちは秘密のままでいられると思っていたんですけど……
lines.translated: "...So it can't be helped if you don't remember, Senpai, and that's exactly why I thought I could keep these feelings a secret forever and ever, though..."

lines.content: ……手です
lines.translated: "...My hand."

lines.content: そこで千和は、はじめて俺から視線を逸らし、言った。
lines.translated: At that point, Chiwa averted her gaze from me for the first time and spoke.

lines.content: ……手を、繋いでくれたんです
lines.translated: "...You held my hand."

lines.content: 手を……？
lines.translated: "Your hand...?"

lines.content: ……はい
今みたいに、ただこうして、先輩が私と手を繋いでくれました……それがきっかけです。たったそれだけのことで、私、先輩のことを……好きになりました
lines.translated: "Just like right now, you simply held my hand like this, Senpai... That's how it started. Over something as small as that, I... fell in love with you, Senpai."

lines.content: 俺は、ずっと千和と繋いだままの手と手を見た。
lines.translated: I looked down at our hands, which had remained intertwined this whole time.

lines.content: ここは、私にとって未来の世界です
lines.translated: "To me, this place is a world in the future."

lines.content: ぽつりと。
lines.translated: She murmured softly.

lines.content: 俺から視線を逸らし、うつむいたまま、千和が言う。
lines.translated: Looking away from me and keeping her eyes cast down, Chiwa spoke.

lines.content: 大きなおおきな変化の起きた先の未来というわけではないけれど……。それでも、私にとってここは知らない場所だったんです。知っているけど知らない、不思議な場所です
lines.translated: "It's not as if it's a future after some huge, massive change happened, though... Even so, to me, this was an unfamiliar place. A strange place that I knew, yet didn't know."

lines.content: ……勇気を出してがんばろうと思いました。ナハトにソルを返さなきゃ……。そうできない限り私はふたりの元に帰れない
lines.translated: "...I decided to muster my courage and do my best. I had to give Sol back to Nacht... Until I could do that, I couldn't go back to the two of them."

lines.content: だからいっぱい頑張った。頑張ろうと誓った。
lines.translated: So she tried as hard as she could. She vowed to do her best.

lines.content: ……大人になるともうふたりとは会えない。
lines.translated: Once she grew up into an adult, she wouldn't be able to see the two of them anymore.

lines.content: 少女が大人になるその境界線はいったいどこに存在するものなのだろう――もしかしたらその日は明日にでもやって来るのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Where on earth did that boundary line exist where a young girl became an adult?--Perhaps that day might even arrive as soon as tomorrow.

lines.content: だから一刻も早く“大切な人を取り戻すことのできる魔法”を手に入れなければと、その“魔法”について“夜”の中で“想像”し続けていた。
lines.translated: That was why, thinking she had to obtain the "magic to get her precious person back" as soon as possible, she kept "imagining" that "magic" within the "Night."

lines.content: そして望む未来ばかりを――三人一緒に[カフェ|お店]を開くその光景ばかりを、そんな幸せな未来ばかりを思い描いていた。
lines.translated: And she kept picturing only the future she wished for--only that scene of the three of them opening a cafe together, only that happy future.

lines.content: 私は、ナハトのことを傷つけてしまった……
lines.translated: "I ended up hurting Nacht..."

lines.content: 花に戻ってしまったソルを渡したときの、あのひとの顔が今もずっと忘れられないんです
lines.translated: "Even now, I still can't forget the look on his face when I handed Sol over after he'd turned back into a flower."

lines.content: いつかあのひとが笑っているところを見たいってそう願ったはずなのに……それなのに、私は
lines.translated: "Even though I had wished to see him smile someday... despite that, I..."

lines.content: ナハトに笑ってもらうためにも、やっぱり私はソルを取り戻すしかないんだって、信じて……がんばろう。がんばるんだ。がんばらなきゃ。ずっとそう自分に言い聞かせてました
lines.translated: "Believing that getting Sol back really was the only way for me to make Nacht smile... I'll do my best. I'm going to do my best. I have to do my best. I kept telling myself that the whole time."

lines.content: ……でもやっぱり、怖かったんです
lines.translated: "...But even so, I was scared."

lines.content: 知っているけど知らない場所で、誰ひとり知らない人たちに囲まれて……。時には、命をかけて戦うこともあった
lines.translated: "In a place I knew yet didn't know, surrounded by people where I didn't know a single soul... At times, I even had to risk my life to fight."

lines.content: きっとすごくさみしくもあったんです。まだまだ小さい私だったから
lines.translated: "I'm sure I was really lonely, too. Because I was still so little back then."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 絶対に、負けない。ひとりでも頑張る。諦めたりは、絶対にしない……
lines.translated: "I definitely won't lose. I'll do my best even on my own. I will never, ever give up..."

lines.content: 私をここに連れてきてくれた女の子にも、ナナちゃんにも、そう誓ったから
lines.translated: "Because I swore that to the girl who brought me here, and to Nana-chan, too."

lines.content: だから私は絶対に、泣いたりなんか……
lines.translated: "So I told myself I would never cry or anything..."

lines.content: そんなふうにひとりで張り詰め続けていた幼い千和の手を、同じように小さかったあの頃の俺が、繋いだのだという。
lines.translated: The hand of the young Chiwa, who had kept herself wound so tight all on her own like that, was held by the me of back then, who was just as small, she said.

lines.content: ……それはまだ、みんなと友だちになって、一緒に遊ぶようになる前です。全員がただそこに居合わせただけの他人で……あさひさんから“魔法”を学んでいたときの話です
lines.translated: "...That was before we all became friends and started playing together. Back when everyone was just a stranger who happened to be there... when we were learning 'magic' from Asahi-san."

lines.content: 先輩と、私。どうして手を繋ぐことになったのかは覚えていません。きっと些細なことが理由だったはずです
lines.translated: "You and I, Senpai. I don't remember how we ended up holding hands. I'm sure the reason must have been something trivial."

lines.content: “魔法”についてのあさひさんの授業中に、必要にかられてそうしただけのことだったかもしれないし……。
lines.translated: It might have just been something we did out of necessity during Asahi-san's lessons about "magic"...

lines.content: ひとりぼっちでとぼとぼ歩いていた私を見かねて、先輩が“こっちだよ”って、そう言って……手を、引いてくれただけなのかもしれないし
lines.translated: "Or maybe you just couldn't bear to watch me trudging along all by myself, Senpai, so you said 'This way'... and simply took me by the hand."

lines.content: とにかくきっかけはそれくらいのことだった。
lines.translated: In any case, what started it was something that small.

lines.content: それでもひとつ無理矢理にでも理由を探せば、あの頃の俺もまた千和と同じように、ひとりでさみしそうにしていたからかもしれないと千和が言う。
lines.translated: Even so, if she had to force herself to find a reason, Chiwa said it might have been because the me of back then looked just as lonely all by himself as she did.

lines.content: ……おかしいですよね。先輩のそばには、いつも一緒の[・|あ][・|の][・|子]がいたのに
lines.translated: "...It's strange, isn't it? Even though you had that girl who was always with you right by your side, Senpai."

lines.content: ……あの子
lines.translated: "...That girl."

lines.content: クロのことだろうとすぐに察した。
lines.translated: I immediately guessed she meant Kuro.

lines.content: 俺といつも一緒にいてくれたのは今も、昔も、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]しかいないから。
lines.translated: Because both now and back then, that girl was the only one who had always stayed with me.

lines.content: それなのに、なんだか先輩もずっとひとりぼっちで、さみしそうにしているように見えて……
lines.translated: "And yet, for some reason, it looked like you were always all alone and lonely too, Senpai..."

lines.content: 私と同じ[・|何][・|か]を後悔しているように、見えてしまって……
lines.translated: "It ended up looking to me like you were regretting something, just like I was..."

lines.content: どういうきっかけであったにせよ、そんな俺と手と手を繋ぎ……。
lines.translated: Whatever the catalyst had been, she held hands with that version of me, and...

lines.content: すると、足りないものを互いが互いに埋められているように、感じられもして……。
lines.translated: And when she did, it felt as though we were filling in what the other was missing...

lines.content: なんだかとても、すごく、安心したのだと千和は言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa said that for some reason, it brought her an overwhelming sense of relief.

lines.content: おかしいですよね。先輩のことを好きになったきっかけもあまりよく覚えていないのに。それなのに、気づけば私……先輩のことしか見えない子になってしまってました
lines.translated: "It's funny, isn't it? Even though I don't really remember what made me fall in love with you, Senpai. Despite that, before I knew it... I had become a girl who only had eyes for you."

lines.content: 照れたように千和は微笑む。
lines.translated: Chiwa smiled bashfully.

lines.content: そんな私を、みんなが……幼馴染みになれたみんなが、小さい頃も、そして今も変わらず、ずっと色々と応援してくれてて……
lines.translated: "And everyone... everyone who became my childhood friends, both when we were little and even now, has always supported me in so many ways..."

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。ときに行き過ぎるけどね
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. Though sometimes they go a bit too far."

lines.content: つい、千和の犬耳なコスチュームを思い出してしまった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but remember Chiwa's dog-eared costume.

lines.content: 千和も何か思い出してしまったのだろう。小さく笑顔を浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa must have remembered something too. A small smile floated onto her face.

lines.content: その笑顔を見て……。
lines.translated: Looking at that smile...
"I'm the same way."

lines.content: そう、うなずくと……。
lines.translated: Saying that, I nodded, and...

lines.content: 俺も千和と同じだ
lines.translated: "I'm the same as you, Chiwa."

lines.content: そう、微笑んでしまうと……。
lines.translated: When I let a smile slip out...

lines.content: いつ自分が、千和のことを大切だって思うようになったのか。その瞬間については、正確にここだよと断言はできないし、思い出せないけれど……
lines.translated: "As for when I started thinking of you as someone precious to me, Chiwa... I can't pinpoint the exact moment and say 'this was it,' nor can I remember it, but..."

lines.content: 千和。杏藤千和。俺のかわいい幼馴染み。俺よりも少しだけ早く、大人の世界へと踏み出そうとした女の子。
lines.translated: Chiwa. Andou Chiwa. My cute childhood friend. A girl who tried to step into the adult world just a little bit sooner than I did.

lines.content: そんな彼女の心を間近に感じ、自分の気持ちを理解できた――俺は今、そんな君のことを守りたいと思ってる。
lines.translated: Feeling her heart so close to me, I was able to understand my own feelings--right now, I want to protect her.

lines.content: ああ、うん。そうだな
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: 俺は、君のことをこれからずっと守っていきたい。
lines.translated: I want to keep protecting you from here on out.

lines.content: それはもちろん、君のことを傷つけようとする外的な何かから。
lines.translated: That naturally means from anything on the outside that tries to hurt you.

lines.content: そして、きっと、今もずっと君のことを責め立て続ける――君自身の“後悔”という名の心から。
lines.translated: And surely, from your own heart named "regret"--which continues to torment you even now.

lines.content: 本当は、君のことを育てた“怪物”だって、[・|そ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と][・|で]自分を責めないでほしいと願うはずだから……。
lines.translated: Because in truth, even the "monsters" who raised you would surely wish for you not to blame yourself over something like that...

lines.content: 俺は……
君のことを守ると誓う。
lines.translated: I swear to protect you.

lines.content: “怪物”たちの代わりに君を守る。
lines.translated: I will protect you in place of the "monsters."

lines.content: これから一緒に生きて行ければと、願う。
lines.translated: I wish that we can walk through life together from now on.

lines.content: そのために……。
lines.translated: For that sake...

lines.content: 君に、聞いてほしいことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "There's something I want you to hear."

lines.content: たった今、近くに感じた千和の心に、改めて“勇気”を学んだような気がしたから……。
lines.translated: Because I felt as though I had learned "courage" all over again from Chiwa's heart, which I had felt so close to me just now...

lines.content: 千和。俺は、君のことが好きだよ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. I love you."

lines.content: ようやく言葉できたその気持ちを、俺は、いつまでも大切に大切に育てて行ければと……祈った。
lines.translated: I prayed that I could cherish and nurture those feelings I had finally put into words, forever and ever...

lines.content: 杏藤千和の“悪夢”は“後悔”だ。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa's "Nightmare" is "regret."

lines.content: そんな心が彼女の中に芽生えてから、長いながい時間が経過してはいるけれど……。
lines.translated: A long, long time had passed since that feeling first took root within her, and yet...

lines.content: その夜色は、今も彼女の中にくすぶり続けている。
lines.translated: That night-colored darkness still continued to smolder inside her.

lines.content: そしてその“後悔”の[・|居][・|場][・|所]を、千和の心を垣間見たその中で、俺は見つけた。
lines.translated: And within that glimpse of Chiwa's heart, I found where that "regret" was hiding.

lines.content: ずっとだ。
lines.translated: All this time.

lines.content: ずっと、千和の心はこの場所にうずくまっていた。
lines.translated: All this time, Chiwa's heart had been crouching in this place.

lines.content: 『……私、ここに来なければ良かった』
lines.translated: "'...I shouldn't have come here.'"

lines.content: 大切なひと。
lines.translated: Someone precious to her.

lines.content: 大切に、してくれたひと。
lines.translated: Someone who had cherished her.

lines.content: 一緒に繋いで歩いた手の中で、そのひとは小さなちいさな花になり……。
lines.translated: Within the hands they held as they walked together, that person turned into a tiny, tiny flower, and...

lines.content: そんな[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]の光景が何度も、何度でも、千和の心で……千和の“夜”の中で、繰り返されていた。
lines.translated: That scene from back then was repeated over and over again within Chiwa's heart... within Chiwa's "Night."

lines.content: 俺は千和の手を引き、[・|こ][・|こ]へ来た――少し不思議な“夜”の中。あるいは暗黒の死者の国。あるいは、夢や希望の詰まった夢の国。
lines.translated: I took Chiwa by the hand and came here--into a slightly mysterious "Night." Or perhaps the dark land of the dead. Or perhaps, a dreamland filled with dreams and hopes.

lines.content: 千和は、じっと見つめている。
lines.translated: Chiwa was staring intently.

lines.content: 繰り返し繰り返し、“夜”の中で再現されるその瞬間を。
lines.translated: At that moment being replayed over and over again within the "Night."

lines.content: そして、その度に涙を流す……幼かった自分自身を。
lines.translated: And at her own young self... shedding tears every single time.

lines.content: 『“私が、ふたりの時間を壊してしまった……”』
lines.translated: "'I destroyed their time together...'"

lines.content: “夜”の中。ここは杏藤千和の[夢|心]の中。小さな[千和|悪夢]がそう言って、頭を抱えた――泣いている。
lines.translated: Inside the "Night." This is inside Andou Chiwa's dream--her heart. The little Chiwa--her Nightmare--said that and clutched her head--she was crying.

lines.content: ぽろぽろこぼれる涙のその中に、幼いばかりの後悔が、今も止めどなく溢れていた。
lines.translated: Within the tears spilling down one after another, a childish regret was still overflowing endlessly even now.

lines.content: ……しかしソルは生きていたのだ。
lines.translated: However, Sol was alive.

lines.content: このとき抱えた“後悔”も、どうしようもないほどの罪悪感も、そしてすがりついた希望と“魔法”も……。
lines.translated: The "regret" she harbored at this time, the overwhelming sense of guilt, and the hope and "magic" she clung to...

lines.content: 結果として、彼女のあらゆる苦悩は徒労に終わってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: In the end, all of her anguish had ended up being in vain, yet...

lines.content: 彼女に芽生えた“後悔”は、[・|彼]の生存を確認できたところで消えてなくなるはずだったのだ。ふつうなら、そうなる。そうなるはずだ。
lines.translated: The "regret" that had sprouted within her should have vanished completely the moment she confirmed his survival. Normally, that was how it would go. That was how it should have been.

lines.content: でも……、だめだ。
lines.translated: But... no.

lines.content: ……ナハトの悲しそうな、さみしそうなあの横顔を、私はずっと……忘れられない
lines.translated: "...That sad, lonely profile of Nacht's... I still can't forget it."

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: やはり、後悔だ。後悔している。
lines.translated: Sure enough, it was regret. She was regretting it.

lines.content: 自分が“怪物”たちと出会わなければ、あんな光景に行き着くことはなかった。
lines.translated: If she hadn't met the "monsters," things never would have ended up like that scene.

lines.content: 私が、両親に愛されないからといって、さみしい気持ちに喘いでさえいなければ……
lines.translated: "If only I hadn't been gasping in loneliness just because I wasn't loved by my parents..."

lines.content: やはり“怪物”たちは自分の存在を知ることもなく、あのひとが花となり、壊れて、消える――そんな瞬間に、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]の時間が辿り着くことはなかった。
lines.translated: Then sure enough, the "monsters" never would have known of her existence, and that person turning into a flower, breaking apart, and vanishing--their time never would have arrived at such a moment.

lines.content: 消したくても消えない“後悔”
lines.translated: A "regret" that wouldn't disappear no matter how much she wanted it to.

lines.content: 大切なひとのことを痛烈に傷つけてしまったというその事実。
lines.translated: The fact that she had deeply hurt someone precious to her.

lines.content: ……きっと、この世で一番思い通りにならないものは、自分自身の心の模様だ。
lines.translated: Surely, the thing in this world that least goes the way you want it to is the shape of your own heart.

lines.content: もう苦しまなくてもいいと頭で理解していても、心はそれを許さない。苦しみ続けることを選べと叫ぶ。
lines.translated: Even if your head understands that you don't have to suffer anymore, your heart won't allow it. It screams at you to choose to keep suffering.

lines.content: だから、今から俺は、俺たちは……、
lines.translated: That is why, starting now, I--we...

lines.content: 握りしめた千和の小さな手のひらに、俺は、想像するための意識を集める。
lines.translated: Into Chiwa's small palm, which I held tightly, I gathered my consciousness in order to imagine.

lines.content: するとほんの一瞬、まばゆい光りが“夜”を照らして……。
lines.translated: When I did, for just a split second, a dazzling light illuminated the "Night"...

lines.content: う、うう。……こんな格好、必要なんですか。先輩
lines.translated: "U-Ugh... Is an outfit like this really necessary, Senpai?"

lines.content: 光が晴れると、かわいく飾られた千和が隣に立っていた。
lines.translated: When the light cleared, Chiwa was standing next to me, dressed up cutely.

lines.content: こ、こんなの。子どもの頃に着るのだって、恥ずかしかったのに
lines.translated: "S-Something like this... Even wearing it when I was a kid was embarrassing."

lines.content: 変じゃないですか。あんまり、見ないでください。真っ赤になって千和はそう言い、うつむいてしまってる。
lines.translated: Doesn't it look weird? Please don't stare too much. Turning bright red, Chiwa said that and looked down.

lines.content: それでも手はしっかり繋いだままだ。この手を離すと元に戻ってしまうから。
lines.translated: Even so, our hands remained firmly intertwined. Because if we let go, she would turn back to normal.

lines.content: ああ。……えっと。説明はちょっと難しいけれど、この場所で特別なことをするには――とりわけ、もう“夜”に出入りできない君たちがそうするためには、必要なことらしいんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Um. It's a little hard to explain, but in order to do something special in this place--especially for you girls who can no longer enter and leave the 'Night'--it seems this is necessary."

lines.content: あさひさんがそのように“夜”の中に設定したのだ――否、少女らの中に組み込んだ、と言ったほうがもしかするとより正しいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Asahi-san had set it up that way within the "Night"--no, it might be more accurate to say she had built it into the girls themselves.

lines.content: 故に必要。
lines.translated: Therefore, it was necessary.

lines.content: 別に、俺が千和のかわいい姿を見てみたいと思ったわけでは決してない……。
lines.translated: It definitely wasn't because I personally wanted to see Chiwa looking cute or anything...

lines.content: たぶん。……きっと。
lines.translated: Probably. ...Surely.

lines.content: え、ええっと
lines.translated: "U-Umm."

lines.content: ちょっとした気まずさと、やっぱり目的の半分だった[・|そ][・|れ]を達成できた満足感とを誤魔化すように、俺は咳払いをし、言った。
lines.translated: As if to gloss over a bit of awkwardness and the sense of satisfaction from achieving that--which admittedly had been half of my goal--I cleared my throat and spoke.

lines.content: 千和。今、君は俺の“魔法”だ。……君自身の“夢”や“願い”を叶えたいとそう祈る。そんな俺の想いを叶える。そのための“魔法”、なんだよ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Right now, you are my 'magic.' ...I pray that I want to grant your own 'dreams' and 'wishes.' To make those feelings of mine come true. You are the 'magic' for that purpose."

lines.content: 私の、“願い”……
lines.translated: "My 'wish'..."

lines.content: つぶやいて、千和は目の前の[悪夢|自分]を見つめてる。
lines.translated: Murmuring, Chiwa gazed at her own self--her Nightmare--in front of her.

lines.content: ……ごめんね
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 千和は自身の“夜”のその中で、いつまでも苦しみ続ける心に囁く。
lines.translated: Within her own "Night," Chiwa whispered to her heart that continued to suffer endlessly.

lines.content: 小さなちいさな、あの頃の私。“[あなた|悪夢]”のことを、ここじゃないどこか[・|遠][・|く][・|へ]、送ることにしたよ
