lines.translated: "My tiny, tiny self from back then. I've decided to send 'you'--my Nightmare--somewhere far away from here."

lines.content: 千和とふたりで、千和の心に根付いた“後悔”を、千和の“夜”の中から切り離し……。
lines.translated: Together with Chiwa, the two of us severed the "regret" rooted in her heart from within her "Night"...

lines.content: そして列車に乗せ、見送った。
lines.translated: And then we put it on the train and saw it off.

lines.content: ……なんだか不思議な体験でした
lines.translated: "...That was kind of a mysterious experience."

lines.content: 隣で千和がぽつりと言う。遠ざかる列車をいつまでも見送りながら。繋いだ手を離し、千和はもう俺の“魔法”ではない。
lines.translated: Beside me, Chiwa murmured softly, watching the receding train for a long, long time. Having let go of my hand, Chiwa was no longer my "magic."

lines.content: ……自分の心の一部と対話するなんて、きっと、そう何度もできる体験じゃないですよね
lines.translated: "...Having a conversation with a part of your own heart surely isn't an experience you can have very often, is it?"

lines.content: 千和と千和の“悪夢”は話し合い、向かうべき“次”を一緒に決めた――少女時代の千和と、一歩、大人の世界に足を踏み入れた今現在の千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa and Chiwa's "Nightmare" had talked it over and decided together on the "next" place she should head toward--the Chiwa of her childhood, and the present Chiwa who had taken a step into the adult world.

lines.content: 千和の“悪夢”は、これまでずっとずっと苦しみ続けてきた[こと|時間]を代償として“刻の終着駅”に支払い、切符を買った――行き先は、[・|夜][・|空][・|の][・|星][・|の][・|そ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と][・|つ]。そう決めた。
lines.translated: Using the time she had spent suffering on and on until now as the price paid to the "Terminal Station of Time," Chiwa's "Nightmare" had bought a ticket--her destination was one of the stars in the night sky. That was what they had decided.

lines.content: そんな[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]の様子を見つめながら、俺は自分の胸に手を当ててみた。
lines.translated: As I watched the two of them like that, I placed a hand against my own chest.

lines.content: そこに“心”が詰まっているわけではない。
lines.translated: It isn't as though a "heart" is packed inside there.

lines.content: 心は脳の中に産まれる微量な電気信号の連なりだ――この身体のどこかにあるのだろうと信じる頼りない俺の心の中にも、いつか産まれた“悪夢”がいるのだろうか。
lines.translated: The mind is a series of faint electrical signals born within the brain--within this unreliable heart of mine, which I believe must exist somewhere in this body, is there also a "Nightmare" that was born at some point?

lines.content: ……そんな“[心|誰か]”は、今も何かを“後悔”し続けているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is that "someone" within my heart still continuing to "regret" something even now?

lines.content: だとすれば、俺の“悪夢”は、俺自身にどう語りかけてくるのだろうか。
lines.translated: If so, how would my "Nightmare" speak to me?

lines.content: それを想像するのはあまりに明白なように思え、あまりに、困難なことのようにも思えた。
lines.translated: Imagining that seemed all too obvious, and yet, it also seemed all too difficult.

lines.content: ……帰ろうか
lines.translated: "...Shall we head back?"

lines.content: 列車が見えなくなるまで見送って、俺はため息をつくようにそう言った。
lines.translated: After watching the train until it was out of sight, I said that with a sigh.

lines.content: 別に急ぐ必要もないけれど……そろそろ“夜”が空ける時間だ
lines.translated: "There's no particular need to rush, but... it's almost time for the 'Night' to break."

lines.content: ……そうですね。わかりました。帰りましょう
lines.translated: "...You're right. Understood. Let's go home."

lines.content: 千和と手を繋いだまま“夜”の街を歩いた。
lines.translated: With my hand still joined with Chiwa's, we walked through the city of the "Night."

lines.content: 行き先は千和の部屋。そこで眠りについている千和の身体へ、こうして手と手を繋いでいる千和の心を返すのだ。
lines.translated: Our destination was Chiwa's room. We were going to return Chiwa's heart, which was holding my hand like this, back to her body sleeping there.

lines.content: そうすることで、“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”で千和は目覚める。
lines.translated: By doing so, Chiwa would wake up in the "real world"--the Time of the Sun.

lines.content: どうかな。少しは何か、変わったかな
lines.translated: "What do you think? Did anything change, even a little?"

lines.content: 繰り返し繰り返し、自分自身を責め続けていた“[後悔|悪夢]”という感情。心の一部である[・|そ][・|れ]を切り取った。
lines.translated: The emotion called "regret"--her Nightmare--which had kept blaming itself over and over again. We had cut away that piece of her heart.

lines.content: 俺は自身の左手を見つめる。
lines.translated: I stared at my own left hand.

lines.content: ……これは、俺の“役目”はなんだろうとそう考えた結果だ。
lines.translated: This was the result of wondering what my "role" was.

lines.content: かつて特別だった少女たち。その“夢”を叶えるために“[魔法|希望]”を引き出す。
lines.translated: Drawing out "magic"--hope--in order to grant the "dreams" of the girls who were once special.

lines.content: それがこの俺の左手に付与された“役割”だったけれど……。
lines.translated: That was the "role" granted to this left hand of mine, however...
Ando Chiwa had become a lost child.

lines.content: 一度、“魔法”の使い道を失ったのだ。
lines.translated: For a time, she had lost the purpose for her "magic."

lines.content: そしてまた再び、その“魔法”は必要とされている……のかもしれない。
lines.translated: And now once again, that "magic" was needed... perhaps.

lines.content: 千和の父親、杏藤一磨は本当に殺されたのか。
lines.translated: Was Chiwa's father, Ando Kazuma, really murdered?

lines.content: それをまず確かめなければならない。
lines.translated: We had to confirm that first.

lines.content: そして“魔法”が必要となるのなら、そのために千和が“夜”に支払うべき“代償”もまた、[・|正][・|し][・|て][・|い][・|か][・|な][・|け][・|れ][・|ば]ならない。
lines.translated: And if her "magic" was going to be necessary, then we also had to correct the "price" Chiwa would have to pay to the "Night" for it.

lines.content: やらなければならないことも、考えなければならないこともまだまだ山積みだ。
lines.translated: There was still a mountain of things we had to do and things we had to think about.

lines.content: だから今、せめてこの俺ができることはなんだろうと考え――こうして千和の“[後悔|悪夢]”を切り取ることを提案したのだった。
lines.translated: That's why I thought about what at least I could do right now--and proposed cutting away Chiwa's "regret," her Nightmare, like this.

lines.content: その、結果。
lines.translated: And as a result of that...

lines.content: 心の一部を失った今現在の千和の視界には、この世界は、どう映っているのだろうか――そのことがやはり気になってしまう。
lines.translated: How did this world look in Chiwa's eyes right now, having lost a part of her heart?--I couldn't help but wonder about that.

lines.content: いつもより心が軽くなるような。いつもより、明るい気持ちになっているような。そんな変化が心にあるものなのかな
lines.translated: "Like your heart feels lighter than usual. Like you're in a brighter mood than usual. I wonder if there's a change like that in your heart?"

lines.content: そうですね……
lines.translated: "I suppose so..."

lines.content: 千和は“夜”の空をふと見上げる。
lines.translated: Chiwa suddenly looked up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: 今は正直なところよくわかりません。何かが劇的に変わったという感じは、今は、今のところは、感じないかと思います
lines.translated: "To be honest, I'm not really sure right now. I don't think I feel like anything has changed dramatically right now, at least for the moment."

lines.content: ただ……
lines.translated: "It's just..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……私は、先輩に、好きだよって言ってもらえましたから
lines.translated: "...Because you told me that you love me, Senpai."

lines.content: だ、だから、今日からは……目が、覚めてからは、どんな毎日になるんだろうって。今はそんなふうに考えている自分のことを、どうしても意識してしまうっていうか……
lines.translated: "S-So, starting today... after I wake up, I wonder what every day will be like. Right now, it's more like I can't help being conscious of myself thinking that way..."

lines.content: 少しずつもにょもにょと声がしぼんでしまっていた。見ればその横顔も少しずつ赤く染まっていた。
lines.translated: Little by little, her voice trailed off into a mumble. Looking at her, I saw her profile slowly blushing red as well.

lines.content: でも……こんなの、だめです
lines.translated: "But... this is no good."

lines.content: 空を見上げていた千和がそっと、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Chiwa, who had been looking up at the sky, gently closed her eyelids.

lines.content: だって……、まだまだ考えなきゃいけないこと、確認しなきゃならないこと……いっぱい、いっぱい、あるのに
lines.translated: "Because... there are still so, so many things I have to think about, and things I have to confirm..."

lines.content: それなのに先輩との明日だなんて……。私、何言ってるんだろう。浮かれてなんかいられないのに
lines.translated: "And yet, thinking about tomorrow with you, Senpai... What am I even saying? I can't afford to be getting carried away like this."

lines.content: ……確かにそうだ。きっとこれから解決しなければならないことは山とあるだろう。
lines.translated: That was certainly true. There would surely be a mountain of things we had to resolve from here on out.

lines.content: ……まあ、うん。何はともあれ
lines.translated: "...Well, yeah. Be that as it may."

lines.content: はい……
過去よりも未来を見られるようになったというのなら、それはきっと悪いことじゃないと思うよ。過程がどうであれ、君を育てた“怪物”たちだってそれを喜ばないわけはない
lines.translated: "If it means you're able to look toward the future rather than the past, I think that's surely not a bad thing. Whatever the process, there's no way the 'monsters' who raised you wouldn't be happy about that, too."

lines.content: と、勝手ながらそう思う。そう願う。
lines.translated: Selfishly, that's what I thought. That's what I wished.

lines.content: だから今夜だけはあえて前を、未来を、見つめるというのなら――
lines.translated: So if, just for tonight, we dared to gaze forward, toward the future--

lines.content: 俺たちは、その……正式に恋人同士になったわけだけど
lines.translated: "We've, um... officially become lovers, after all."

lines.content: ――こんなふうに今は、[・|あ][・|え][・|て]、浮かれてしまうのも悪い話じゃないだろうと、思う。
lines.translated: --Then right now, I didn't think it was a bad idea to deliberately let ourselves get carried away like this.

lines.content: は、はい……。そう、ですね
lines.translated: "Y-Yes... That's true."

lines.content: 恋人同士、ですね……。と。
lines.translated: "We're lovers, aren't we..." she added.

lines.content: 千和はもにょもにょとしながら、言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa said this while fidgeting bashfully.

lines.content: その様子がどうしようもなくかわいく思えて、ついいつもみたいに意地悪を――……
lines.translated: The way she acted seemed hopelessly cute, and out of habit, I was about to tease her like I always did--...

lines.content: ……しそうになるが、そこはぐっと堪えなければ
lines.translated: "...I'm about to, anyway, so I really have to hold myself back here."

lines.content: え？　堪えるって……何を、ですか？
lines.translated: "Eh? Hold back... from what?"

lines.content: いや。ごめん。考え事がつい口に出ていた――だからもうひとつ、この流れで聞いてもらいたいことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "No, sorry. I accidentally said my thoughts out loud--so there's one more thing I want you to hear while we're on the subject."

lines.content: もうひとつ……？
lines.translated: "One more thing...?"

lines.content: 千和。俺が、君を一生守っていくから
lines.translated: "Chiwa. I will protect you for the rest of your life."

lines.content: え……っ
“怪物”たちの代わりに俺が千和を守るよ。ずっと、ずっと
lines.translated: "In place of the 'monsters,' I'll protect you, Chiwa. Forever and ever."

lines.content: え、え、ええええ……
lines.translated: "Eh, eh, ehhhhh...?"

lines.content: 目を泳がせながら千和は真っ赤になる。
lines.translated: Chiwa turned bright red, her eyes darting around.

lines.content: 何でだか仲違いなんかして、千和をひとりぼっちにさせるような“怪物”たちの代わりに、俺が……なんて言ったら、千和、あまり気分がよくないかな
lines.translated: "If I say that I'll take the place of the 'monsters' who had a falling out for whatever reason and left you all alone... does that rub you the wrong way, Chiwa?"

lines.content: ……どうでしょう
lines.translated: "...I wonder."

lines.content: わかりませんと千和は首を振り、苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Saying she didn't know, Chiwa shook her head, a wry smile on her face.

lines.content: 今はただ、驚きのほうが大きいです。だって、先輩。ついこの前までは……私の告白、冗談だとか、そう言って……取り合ってもくれなかったのに
lines.translated: "Right now, my surprise is just greater than anything else. Because, Senpai, until just recently... you called my confession a joke and things like that... You wouldn't even take me seriously."

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: ……い、一生って
lines.translated: "...F-For the rest of my life..."

lines.content: ……それはやっぱり、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]、なんでしょうか
lines.translated: "...Does that really mean what I think it means?"

lines.content: 真っ赤な頬で視線を伏せる。
lines.translated: With bright red cheeks, she lowered her gaze.

lines.content: ……一生守ってくれるって、いうのは……その
lines.translated: "...Saying you'll protect me for the rest of my life... um..."

lines.content: そうだね。[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]、だね。千和が許してくれるなら
lines.translated: "Yeah. It means what you think it means. If you'll allow me to, Chiwa."

lines.content: 大人の世界を生きている人たちが、今の俺たちのやりとりを聞けば、きっと、何を青臭いことを言ってるんだ、とか。全然現実を見えてない、だとか……
lines.translated: "If the people living in the adult world heard our exchange just now, they'd surely ask what kind of naive things we're spouting. Or say that we aren't looking at reality at all..."

lines.content: どうせうまくいくはずがない。世界を知らない子どもの思い描く未来予想図なんてそんなもの……。叶うはずがない。
lines.translated: That there's no way it'll work out anyway. That a vision of the future painted by children who don't know the world is just like that... That there's no way it can come true.

lines.content: そんなふうに笑われちゃいそうだけど……
lines.translated: "They'd probably laugh at us like that, though..."

lines.content: 誓うよと俺は言う。
lines.translated: "I swear it," I said.

lines.content: それでも、誓う。誰にどんなふうに思われたって知ったことじゃない。勝手に言ってろって具合だ。そんな奴らに見せつけてやるみたいに、あえて、青臭くしてしまってもいい
lines.translated: "Even so, I swear it. I don't care who thinks what about us. Let them say whatever they want. I'm fine with being deliberately naive, as if to rub it in the faces of people like that."

lines.content: そんな俺の気持ちをどうにか認めてもらうそのためにも……。
lines.translated: And in order to somehow get my feelings acknowledged, too...
"...I want to talk properly with your father one more time, Chiwa. And with your other father, too."

lines.content: そのために、千和の“最後の魔法”を使うなら。千和が、そう望むのなら……
lines.translated: "If we're going to use your 'final magic' for that purpose. If that is what you wish for, Chiwa..."

lines.content: 俺はそう言いながら、千和の小さな手をぎゅっと握りしめていた。
lines.translated: As I said that, I tightly squeezed Chiwa's small hand.

lines.content: そんな俺と繋いだ手を、千和がじっと見つめて、
lines.translated: Chiwa stared intently at our joined hands,

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 私は、この夢のことを覚えていないんですよね。目を覚ましたら全部忘れてしまう
lines.translated: "I won't remember this dream, right? Once I wake up, I'll forget all of it."

lines.content: ……そうだね。そういうことになる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's how it'll be."

lines.content: 先輩が……わ、私に、たくさん、いっぱい、うれしいことを言ってくれるなんて……。信じられないです。本当に夢みたい、です
lines.translated: "For you to tell me... s-so many, lots and lots of things that make me happy, Senpai... I can't believe it. It really is like a dream."

lines.content: でも私は、こんなにうれしい気持ちも全部、忘れてしまうから……
lines.translated: "But I'm going to forget all of these happy feelings, too, so..."

lines.content: ああ、うん。そっか
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. I see."

lines.content: だから先輩は、恥ずかしがり屋なはずの先輩は、“夜”の中では平気な感じで、私にうれしい言葉を一杯くれるんですね。どうせ忘れちゃうからって。だって先輩は、意地悪だから
lines.translated: "That's why you, Senpai, when you're supposed to be so shy, can act totally fine inside the 'Night' and give me tons of words that make me happy. Thinking I'll just forget it anyway. Because you're a meanie, Senpai."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせて――意地悪そうな笑顔でそう言う千和だった。
lines.translated: Pouting her lips--Chiwa said that with a teasing smile.

lines.content: それじゃあまた、今度は“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”でもう一度、千和に同じことを伝えるよ
lines.translated: "Well then, next time I'll tell you the exact same thing again in the 'real world'--the Time of the Sun."

lines.content: これは、プロポーズ……と言ってもいいと思う。
lines.translated: I think you could call this... a proposal.

lines.content: 同じ言葉で、同じ気持ちを伝えるよ。何度だって
lines.translated: "I'll convey the same feelings with the same words. As many times as it takes."

lines.content: 千和を寝床まで連れて行った。
lines.translated: I brought Chiwa to her bed.

lines.content: そしてしばしのお別れを伝え合う。
lines.translated: And then we bade each other a brief farewell.

lines.content: 千和。目を覚ましたら、これからのことを一緒に色々と話し合おう
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Once you wake up, let's talk over all sorts of things about what comes next together."

lines.content: 千和が願い、求め続けてきた“最後の魔法”
lines.translated: "The 'final magic' that you've wished for and kept seeking."

lines.content: ――“大切なひとを蘇らせるための魔法”
lines.translated: --"The magic to revive someone precious to you."

lines.content: それを今こそ使いたいのなら、“代償”だ。そのために支払うものを、千和はどう[想像|設定]したのか……
lines.translated: "If you want to use it now, there's the 'price.' How you imagined--how you set up--what you're going to pay for that purpose..."

lines.content: 目を覚ましたら、改めて教えてもらいたいんだ
lines.translated: "Once you wake up, I want you to tell me properly."

lines.content: 繋いだ手から流れ込んできた千和の時間。その心。だけど[・|そ][・|こ]だけは未だに解き明かされることのないままだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa's time had flowed into me from our joined hands. Her heart. However, that part alone still remained unraveled.

lines.content: そうじゃないと、俺は千和の“魔法”に安心して許可が出せないから……
lines.translated: "Otherwise, I won't be able to give permission for your 'magic' with peace of mind, Chiwa..."

lines.content: 千和？
lines.translated: "Chiwa?"

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: うん。何？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: 私の“最後の魔法”の使い道。そして、“[・|代][・|償]”の話。今すぐには答えを出せないけれど……
lines.translated: "How to use my 'final magic.' And the talk about the 'price.' I can't give you an answer right away, though..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 私、少しだけ怖いです
lines.translated: "I'm a little bit scared."

lines.content: ベッドに横になった千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa lay down on the bed.

lines.content: 俺の手をしっかりと握り、離さない。
lines.translated: She gripped my hand tightly, not letting go.

lines.content: 怖い？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Scared? Why?"

lines.content: なんだかわかりませんけど、少し、ほんの少しだけですが、嫌な予感がするんです
lines.translated: "I don't really know what it is, but I have a little, just a tiny bit of a bad feeling."

lines.content: 嫌な予感……
lines.translated: "A bad feeling..."

lines.content: はい……
俺の目をじっと見つめ、千和は言う。
lines.translated: Staring straight into my eyes, Chiwa spoke.

lines.content: ……ここはまだ“夜”の中ですよね
lines.translated: "...We're still inside the 'Night' right now, aren't we?"

lines.content: ……そうだね
lines.translated: "...That's true."

lines.content: “夜”……。心で想像できるすべてのものを形にしてしまう“夜の国”
lines.translated: "The 'Night'... The 'Country of the Night' that gives form to everything you can imagine in your heart."

lines.content: ……今、私がつい想像してしまったり、感じてしまっている“嫌な予感”まで、どうしようもないくらい形にされてしまうんじゃないかって……怖いです
lines.translated: "...I'm scared that even the 'bad feeling' I'm accidentally imagining and feeling right now might hopelessly be given form..."

lines.content: 千和はふと、俺と視線を僅かに外す。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Chiwa averted her gaze from mine ever so slightly.
"...Because, my father--surely..."

lines.content: そこで千和は何も言わず、黙ってしまった。
lines.translated: At that point, Chiwa said nothing more and fell silent.

lines.content: 千和は今、どんなことを想像してしまったのだろう。それについては問いかけることなく、
lines.translated: What kind of thing had Chiwa just imagined? Without asking her about it,

lines.content: 大丈夫
lines.translated: "It's okay."

lines.content: 俺は、不安そうな顔をしている千和の額をそっと撫でてみた。
lines.translated: I gently stroked Chiwa's forehead as she wore an anxious expression.

lines.content: 大丈夫だよ。千和。やさしい“怪物”が君に語ったあの話が、俺は好きだよ
lines.translated: "It'll be okay, Chiwa. I really like that story the kind 'monster' told you."

lines.content: あの話……？
lines.translated: "That story...?"

lines.content: 目には見えなくても。声は聞こえなくても。悲しいときは。苦しいときには。いつもそばにいてくれる“誰か”が、俺たちの人生が上手くいくようにって力を貸してくれている……
lines.translated: "Even if you can't see them. Even if you can't hear their voice. When you're sad, when you're hurting, 'someone' who is always by your side is lending us their strength so that our lives will go well..."

lines.content: 俺のそばにも[・|誰][・|か]の気配を、心を、感じることができるから……。
lines.translated: Because I can feel "someone's" presence, their heart, right beside me, too...

lines.content: だから大丈夫。
lines.translated: So it'll be okay.

lines.content: きっと何かも上手くいくはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely everything will work out.

lines.content: でも、今は[・|そ][・|れ]を、どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: But right now, I wonder why...

lines.content: 俺はあまり思い出せなくなっている。
lines.translated: I'm having a hard time remembering "it."

lines.content: ……おやすみ、千和。また明日
lines.translated: "...Goodnight, Chiwa. See you tomorrow."

lines.content: ……はい
朝になったら迎えに来るよ
lines.translated: "I'll come pick you up when morning comes."

lines.content: ……はい
千和はうなずく、そして微笑む。
lines.translated: Chiwa nodded, and then smiled.

lines.content: おやすみなさい。先輩
lines.translated: "Goodnight, Senpai."

lines.content: ああ。おやすみ。千和
lines.translated: "Yeah. Goodnight, Chiwa."

lines.content: 君の隣に、いつも、いつでも、すてきな“魔法”がありますようにと……祈ってる
lines.translated: "I'll be praying... that there is always, forever, wonderful 'magic' right beside you."

lines.content: そっと繋いだ手と手を、俺たちは――離した。
lines.translated: Gently, we let go of the hands we had been holding.

lines.content: ……さて
lines.translated: "...Now then."

lines.content: 千和のお店から出、“夜”の大通り――その真ん中で俺は頭を掻いた。
lines.translated: Leaving Chiwa's shop, I stood in the middle of the main street of the "Night" and scratched my head.

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”の空には大きなおおきなさくらの樹が、そこに花のない枝をどこまでも広げているばかり……。
lines.translated: In the sky of the "Night" above me, a massive, towering cherry tree merely spread its flowerless branches out as far as the eye could see...

lines.content: それでも街中のさくらの木々から流れゆく花びらが、漆黒なばかりではない“夜”の空を彩っていた。
lines.translated: Even so, petals drifting from the cherry trees throughout the town colored the sky of the "Night," keeping it from being purely jet-black.

lines.content: さあ……どうしたものか。
lines.translated: Now... what should I do?

lines.content: 俺は、“夜”の空を見上げたまま、しばし[・|最][・|善]を考えたあと、
lines.translated: Still looking up at the sky of the "Night," I pondered the best course of action for a moment, and then,
"You're there, aren't you?"

lines.content: つぶやく。少々、大きめな声で。
lines.translated: I murmured. In a slightly louder voice.

lines.content: ずっとだ。俺たちの後ろを、ずっと、ついてきていましたよね
lines.translated: "This whole time. You've been following behind us this whole time, haven't you?"

lines.content: 振り返らずとも、わかる。気配がする――圧迫感とでもいおうか。背後から視線だけでこの身を焼こうかという鋭い意図を感じた。
lines.translated: I knew without even turning around. There was a presence--a sense of pressure, you could call it. From behind, I felt a sharp intent, as if trying to burn me up with a gaze alone.

lines.content: ……“夜”に、[さと|賢]いんだな。少年
lines.translated: "...Clever in the 'Night,' aren't you, boy?"

lines.content: 声がした。まるで暗闇の底から這い出してくるかのような、低い――低い声だった。
lines.translated: A voice rang out. It was a low--deep voice, as if crawling up from the very bottom of the darkness.

lines.content: むやみに後ろから接近するような真似をせず慎重でいて正解だった
lines.translated: "I made the right call being cautious instead of recklessly approaching you from behind."

lines.content: ……振り返る。
lines.translated: And looked back.

lines.content: するとそこに“怪物”がいた。
lines.translated: And right there stood a "monster."

lines.content: 存在そのものが“夜”そのものでできているかのような――漆黒の“夜の怪物”
lines.translated: A jet-black "Monster of the Night"--as though its very existence were made of the "Night" itself.

lines.content: ……一応、俺も“夜”の中で“役割”を持っている者ですから。ある程度、こちらに向けられている意図の気配くらいなら、感じ取ることができます
lines.translated: "...For the record, I am also someone who holds a 'role' within the 'Night.' So I can at least sense the presence of intent directed at me to some degree."

lines.content: 左手を掲げてみせる――“夜”との繋がりを持つ左の手のひらをだ。
lines.translated: I held up my left hand to show him--the palm of my left hand, which held my connection to the "Night."

lines.content: 多くを説明するだけの仲では無論ないので、それ以上は語らず、ただ目の前の相手を俺は見つめる。
lines.translated: Naturally, we weren't on close enough terms for me to explain much, so I said nothing more and simply stared at the figure before me.

lines.content: ……奏大雅
lines.translated: "...Kanade Taiga."

lines.content: ぽつりと、“怪物”が言う。
lines.translated: The "monster" muttered.

lines.content: あの子が……千和が思いを寄せる少年、か。ずっとお前のことを見ていたよ。[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]でな
lines.translated: "The boy that girl... that Chiwa has feelings for, huh. We've been watching you this whole time. The two of us."

lines.content: 今だ街に覆い被さる“夜”のベールのその中に、真紅の[そうぼう|双眸]がぎらりと鋭く瞬いていた――その光は、[・|み][・|っ][・|つ]ある。
lines.translated: Within the veil of the "Night" that still hung over the town, a pair of crimson eyes glinted sharply--there were three points of light.

lines.content: ふたつの両目。そして、口元に咥えたたばこの火だろう。“怪物”が言葉を吐くその度に、みっつ目の光は、“夜”の中で僅かに震えるように動いた。
lines.translated: Two eyes. And likely the lit tip of a cigarette held in his mouth. Every time the "monster" spat out words, that third light trembled slightly in the "Night."

lines.content: ……ふたりで？
lines.translated: "...The two of you?"

lines.content: ああ。俺と、あいつだ。元人間の怪物だよ。ふたりでお前が本当に千和にとって有益な人間であるのか否か。観察し続けてきた
lines.translated: "Yeah. Me, and him. The monster who used to be human. Together, we kept observing whether or not you were truly a beneficial human for Chiwa."

lines.content: ……まずは問わせてほしい。少年……。奏大雅。君は、千和がどうして自分のことを好いたのか。それを理解できるか？
lines.translated: "...First, let me ask you. Boy... Kanade Taiga. Are you capable of understanding why Chiwa took a liking to you?"

lines.content: 第三者にそれを説くことができうるか。
lines.translated: "Can you explain it to a third party?"

lines.content: そのように“夜の怪物”は俺へと言葉を投げかけ、僅かに首をかしげた――ように、見える。
lines.translated: Throwing those words at me, the "Monster of the Night" tilted his head slightly--or so it seemed.

lines.content: 時折、まるで蜃気楼のようにその姿は暗闇に沈んではっきりしない瞬間があるのだが、闇の中で瞬くみっつの赤い光が傾き、“怪物”の所作をおおよそ察することができる。
lines.translated: At times, his figure sank into the darkness like a mirage, becoming indistinct for a moment, but the three red lights blinking in the dark tilted, allowing me to roughly guess the "monster's" movements.

lines.content: そんな程度の短くもない距離感が、互いの間には横たわっているのだが、しかしその低い声は明瞭にここまで届いていた。
lines.translated: A not-so-short distance lay between us, yet that low voice reached me clearly all the same.

lines.content: お前が、千和に相応しい人間なのか……
lines.translated: "Whether you are a human worthy of Chiwa..."

lines.content: 千和のことを支えて長く短い一生を、共に生きていけるような……それを[・|許][・|せ][・|る]だけの人間であるのか否か
lines.translated: "Whether you are a human who can support Chiwa and live out a long, short life together with her... someone we can allow to do that, or not."

lines.content: 結果――[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は、お前のことを認めたと言っていたが……
lines.translated: "In the end--he said he acknowledged you, but..."

lines.content: “怪物”は、すっと目を細めた――闇に光る双眸の赤色が、細く、瞬く。
lines.translated: The "monster" narrowed his eyes--the red of his twin pupils glowing in the dark narrowed and blinked.

lines.content: 疑問だ。はなはだ首をかしげる結果だ。俺としてはそれ以上の感想をまったく持てない
lines.translated: "I have my doubts. It's an outcome that makes me tilt my head in sheer disbelief. Personally, I have no further impressions beyond that whatsoever."

lines.content: これでも俺は、俺なりに、お前という人間を日々、観察してきたわけだが……
lines.translated: "In my own way, I've spent day after day observing the human you are, and yet..."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|い][・|つ]はいったいお前のどこを認めたというのか……。お前を、どのようにして見初めたのかどうか。まるで、理解に苦しむ
lines.translated: "Just what part of you did he acknowledge...? How on earth did he ever come to see anything in you? I am completely at a loss to understand it."

lines.content: 敵愾心を隠そうともしない声音とせりふだった。
lines.translated: His tone and words made no attempt to hide his hostility.

lines.content: そんな感情や言葉を、初対面の相手に投げかけられては――こちらも相応の対応をせざるを得ない。
lines.translated: Having such emotions and words thrown at me by someone I was meeting for the first time--I had no choice but to respond in kind.

lines.content: そんなのは、人それぞれでしょう。誰かに対する評価や好感の度合いだなんて……そんなもの
lines.translated: "Things like that are different for everyone, aren't they? How you evaluate someone, or how favorably you view them... things like that."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]とはほんの少ししか直接話す機会はありませんでしたけど……
lines.translated: "I only had the chance to speak directly with him for a very brief time, though..."

lines.content: ある程度は打ち解けることができた。俺はそう思っています。でも、あなたとは違う。ただそれだけのことだと思いますけど
lines.translated: "We were able to warm up to each other to some extent. That's what I think. But with you, it's different. I think it's really no more complicated than that."

lines.content: ……ああ、いつだってそうさ。あいつとは何もかもが合わない。真逆なのさ、俺たちは
lines.translated: "...Yeah, it's always like that. He and I don't see eye to eye on anything. We're polar opposites, the two of us."

lines.content: だから……
“殺した？”と、俺は目の前の闇そのものに問いかける。
lines.translated: "Did you kill him?" I asked the very darkness standing before me.

lines.content: あなたの気に入らない俺を、あのひとは認めたから……だからあなたは、あなた達は、口論になった末に……？
lines.translated: "Because he acknowledged me, someone you don't like... is that why you, why the two of you got into an argument, and in the end...?"

lines.content: そんな[・|つ][・|ま][・|ら][・|な][・|い]結論でいいのだろうか。そんな疑問とも呼びがたい感情を抱いたまま、俺はそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: Could it really come down to such a trivial conclusion? Holding onto a feeling that could hardly even be called a question, I asked him that.

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: 鼻で笑うような気配が“夜”の底から感じられた。
lines.translated: From the depths of the "Night," I sensed him snort with laughter.

lines.content: なっていないな、少年。あまりその年齢で自惚れることを覚えないほうが身のためだ。そうでなければ、きっと、これからずっと生きづらくもなるだろう
lines.translated: "That's no good, boy. For your own sake, you'd best not learn to be so conceited at your age. Otherwise, I'm sure you'll find life much harder to live from here on out."

lines.content: いいか。他人は誰もがお前の思っている以上にお前のことになど興味はないんだよ。そんな程度でいがみ合うようなことはない。いかに俺たちが真逆であろうと
lines.translated: "Listen. No matter who it is, other people are nowhere near as interested in you as you think they are. We wouldn't turn on each other over something so petty. No matter how much of polar opposites we might be."

lines.content: それなら、どうして……
lines.translated: "Then why..."

lines.content: あいつが千和のことを“不死”にはしないと言い始めたからだ
lines.translated: "Because he started saying he wouldn't make Chiwa 'immortal.'"

lines.content: 我々がはじめに千和を[さら|攫]った動機は、あの子を“不死”にすることだった
lines.translated: "Our motive for abducting Chiwa in the first place was to make that girl 'immortal.'"

lines.content: ……それをあいつは、今になって、やっぱりやめようと言い出した――何を、今さら。そんなのは許されることじゃない。そんなことを許してしまっては……
lines.translated: "...And yet, after all this time, he suddenly started saying we should call it off--after all this time! Something like that cannot be permitted. If I were to allow that..."

lines.content: “怪物”は、ナハトは、そこで“夜”の空を見上げた。
lines.translated: At that, the "monster"--Nacht--looked up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: ……“夜”が、枯れる
lines.translated: "...The 'Night' will wither."

lines.content: え？　……枯れる？
lines.translated: "Eh? ...Wither?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 俺たちの“夜”の世界が終わってしまう。……そこで生きているモノたちをすべて巻き込んで。もう殆ど、限界なんだよ
lines.translated: "Our world of the 'Night' will come to an end. ...Dragging everything that lives within it down with it. It's already almost at its limit."

lines.content: ナハトが見上げた先には、枯れ枝を街中の頭上に広げたさくらの樹があった。
lines.translated: Where Nacht looked up, the cherry tree spread its withered branches overhead across the entire town.

lines.content: あのさくらは“夜”そのものだ。少女たちの命を源に生きている
lines.translated: "That cherry tree is the 'Night' itself. It lives using the lives of young girls as its source."

lines.content: あの花が完全に枯れ落ちてしまえば“夜”の世界も同時に閉じる――と、言われてる。
lines.translated: "It is said that if those blossoms wither and fall completely, the world of the 'Night' will close at the exact same time."

lines.content: 言われてる？
lines.translated: "It is said?"

lines.content: 俺たちはただここにこうして[・|在][・|る]だけのイキモノだ。[・|そ][・|れ]がなんであれどうであれ、ことの真相など知るよしもない。そういうイキモノなんだよ――
lines.translated: "We are creatures that simply exist here like this. Whatever 'it' may be or how it works, we have no way of knowing the truth of the matter. That is the kind of creatures we are--"

lines.content: ただ与えられた“役割”を淡々とこなす。それだけの存在だ。それだけの存在で、あるべきだったんだ。人の子の人生や幸せになど、首を突っ込むべきじゃあなかった
lines.translated: "We simply carry out the 'role' we were given without question. That is all we exist for. That is all we should have existed for. We never should have meddled in the lives or happiness of human children."

lines.content: ああ、そうさ。さくらに千和の命を捧げ、“夜”を延命させること――それが“夜”の中での俺たちの“役割”だったはずだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Offering Chiwa's life to the cherry tree and extending the life of the 'Night'--that was supposed to be our 'role' within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: だが、しばらく俺たちは少女たちを[さら|攫]わなかった
lines.translated: "However, for a while, we stopped abducting young girls."

lines.content: 千和のひとつ前に[さら|攫]った子が[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に][・|し][・|て]殺された。俺たちが少女に“永遠の命”を与えたから……それを欲する[人間|大人]に喰われた――
lines.translated: "The girl we abducted right before Chiwa was killed in such a horrific way. Because we granted the girl 'eternal life'... she was devoured by adults who lusted after it--"

lines.content: 故にもう少女を[さら|攫]わないと決めていたんだよ。自分たちの“役割”を放棄することにはなるが……。自分たちの“役割”を強欲な者たちに利用されるほうがよほど歯がゆい
lines.translated: "Therefore, we had decided not to abduct young girls anymore. Even though it meant abandoning our own 'role'... Having our 'role' exploited by greedy fools was far more maddening."

lines.content: それなのに[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は千和を[さら|攫]ってきた。もう少女のことを[さら|攫]わない――その誓いはどうしたとあいつを責めても、あいつはのらりくらりと笑うだけ――
lines.translated: "And yet, he abducted Chiwa and brought her here. Even when I confronted him, asking what happened to our vow to never abduct another girl--he just dodged the question and laughed it off--"

lines.content: しかも[さら|攫]ってきただけで、“怪物”としての“役割”を果たすでもない。千和の命をさくらに捧げることはしないと言い張った。この子は人間として育てたいんだと
lines.translated: "What's more, he only abducted her, with no intention of fulfilling his 'role' as a 'monster.' He insisted that he wouldn't offer Chiwa's life to the cherry tree. Said he wanted to raise the girl as a human."

lines.content: ……俺は、そんなものはどうでもいいと何度も言ったんだがな。俺は千和を俺たちの家に住まわせることに最初から反対だった
lines.translated: "...I told him over and over that I didn't care about any of that. I was against letting Chiwa live in our house right from the very beginning."

lines.content: そんな子はさっさと追い出せと何度となくあいつに言ったよ。もう少女を“不死”にはしないと誓いはしたが、[さら|攫]ってきてしまったのなら仕方がない
lines.translated: "I told him countless times to hurry up and kick a girl like that out. We had vowed not to make young girls 'immortal' anymore, but since he had already abducted her, it couldn't be helped."

lines.content: 追い出さないのであればさっさとその子の命をさくらに捧げろと。最後にもう一度だけ“怪物”としての“役割”を果たせと。何度も何度もあいつに言ったさ
lines.translated: "I told him that if he wasn't going to kick her out, he should hurry up and offer the girl's life to the cherry tree. To fulfill his 'role' as a 'monster' just one last time. Over and over, I told him that."

lines.content: それなのに……
lines.translated: "And yet..."

lines.content: [・|あ][・|い][・|つ][・|が]“怪物”の“役割”を果たすことを拒否し続けたそのために、あのさくらは……見てみろ。その花を枯らしてしまっている
lines.translated: "Because he kept refusing to fulfill the 'role' of a 'monster,' that cherry tree... look at it. It has withered away its own blossoms."

lines.content: “夜”の中に不要な者は誰ひとりとして存在しない――だが、与えられた“役割”を果たさない者は消えてなくなるのが行き着く道だろうと、想像する。
lines.translated: Not a single unnecessary person exists within the "Night"--but I imagine that fading away into nothingness is the inevitable end for anyone who fails to fulfill the "role" they were given.

lines.content: ……時間がないのだとナハトは言う。
lines.translated: There is no time left, Nacht said.

lines.content: 千和の命をさくらに捧げる。そして“夜”をこれからも断続させていく。与えられた“役割”を俺は果たす――そう決めた
lines.translated: "I will offer Chiwa's life to the cherry tree. And I will keep the 'Night' going from here on out. I will fulfill the 'role' I was given--that is what I decided."

lines.content: 強欲な人間どもに、俺たちが“永遠”を与えた少女らが喰われてしまおうと、そんなのはもうどうでもいい――“役割だ”。大切なのはただそれだけなんだよ
lines.translated: "Even if the girls we grant 'eternity' to end up devoured by greedy humans, I don't care about that anymore--it is our 'role.' That is the only thing that matters."

lines.content: “役割”こそがこの世界に生まれた理由であり、命の価値なんだとナハトは言う。
lines.translated: A "role" is the very reason one is born into this world, and the very value of one's life, Nacht said.

lines.content: その決行予定はこの春だったはず――千和が大人になってしまうぎりぎりのラインだ。少女から大人へと変わる季節はいつだって春なんだよ
lines.translated: "The plan was supposed to be carried out this spring--the absolute borderline before Chiwa becomes an adult. The season when a girl changes into an adult is always spring."

lines.content: さくらが咲いて。そして散る。すると少女は空を見上げなくなり、いつの間にか、その心は大人になっている
lines.translated: "The cherry blossoms bloom. And then they scatter. When they do, a girl stops looking up at the sky, and before she knows it, her heart has grown into an adult's."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で][・|は]千和と一緒に暮らしていたいというあいつの願いを聞き入れた結果だ。約束の日まで俺は待った。あのふたりから距離を置いて
lines.translated: "That was the result of me granting his wish to live together with Chiwa until then. I waited until the promised day. Keeping my distance from the two of them."

lines.content: 近くにいればどうしたってあいつに小言を言っただろうし、千和にも無駄に厳しく当たってしまうようなこともあっただろう――俺は人間の子どもが嫌いだからな
lines.translated: "If I stayed close by, I inevitably would have nagged at him, and I probably would have been needlessly harsh on Chiwa, too--because I hate human children."

lines.content: あの子の顔を見ていればどうしても思い出してしまうからとナハトは付け加えた。千和の両親がしたことをどうしても考えずにはいられない。
lines.translated: Nacht added that looking at that girl's face inevitably made him remember. He couldn't help but think about what Chiwa's parents had done.

lines.content: ふたりには最後の日まで静かに共に暮らしていける時間を与えたつもりだった。交換条件だよ。[・|そ][・|の][・|日]が来るまで俺はふたりの生活を邪魔しない。そう決めた。それなのに
lines.translated: "I meant to give the two of them time to live quietly together until the very last day. It was a trade-off. I decided I wouldn't interfere with their lives until that day came. And yet..."

lines.content: あいつは、ソルは、予定していた“夜”に千和を連れ出すことを拒否した。
lines.translated: He--Sol--refused to bring Chiwa out on the scheduled "Night."

lines.content: あの“夜”のさくらに命を捧げれば、千和は、“不死のイキモノ”となる。そうなれば正式に俺たちの仲間になるんだ
lines.translated: "Once her life is offered to the cherry tree of the 'Night,' Chiwa will become an 'immortal creature.' If that happens, she will officially become one of us."

lines.content: あいつが、バカみたいに夢見た家族にだって、あるいは……なれたかもしれない。今年の春を過ぎようと、千和と共にこれからもずっと生きて行けただろう
lines.translated: "Perhaps they even could have become... that family he so foolishly dreamed of. Even after this spring passed, he probably could have kept living together with Chiwa forever."

lines.content: だというのに、あいつはあくまでも千和は外の世界で、人間として育っていってほしいと主張した
lines.translated: "And yet, he stubbornly insisted that he wanted Chiwa to grow up as a human in the outside world."

lines.content: ……我々は千和が大人になればそばにいられなくなる。あの子が、大人の世界に慣れれば慣れてしまうほど、俺たちは、あの子に近寄ることさえ難しくなるんだ
lines.translated: "...Once Chiwa becomes an adult, we will no longer be able to stay by her side. The more accustomed that girl grows to the adult world, the harder it will become for us to even approach her."

lines.content: そうなればもし千和に何かあったとしても守ってやれなくなるぞ――
lines.translated: "If that happens, even if something were to happen to Chiwa, we wouldn't be able to protect her--"

lines.content: 大人の世界は厳しければ厳しいほど正義だと思いたがる者たちで溢れてる。そんな場所に千和を放り出さなきゃならない――
lines.translated: "The adult world is overflowing with people who want to believe that the harsher things are, the more righteous they are. We'd have to cast Chiwa out into a place like that--"

lines.content: それでもいいのかとナハトは問いかけた。
lines.translated: Are you really okay with that? Nacht had asked.

lines.content: それでもいいんだとソルは応えた。
lines.translated: I'm okay with that, Sol had answered.

lines.content: 『そのためにも、千和は、自分の困難は自分の力で乗り越えるための術を学んでいってくれていると、信じてる』
lines.translated: "For that very reason, I believe Chiwa is learning how to overcome her own hardships through her own strength."

lines.content: 『それにな、ナハト。千和を“不死”にすれば、千和の両親のように永遠を求める何者かが、千和をその手に掛けてしまう可能性だってあるんだ』
lines.translated: "Besides, Nacht. If we make Chiwa 'immortal,' there's a chance someone seeking eternity--just like her parents--might take her life."

lines.content: だからそれでいいんだと、ソルはうなずいた――千和を“怪物”には、仲間には、しない。
lines.translated: So this is for the best, Sol had nodded--he wouldn't make Chiwa a "monster," one of their own.

lines.content: 『千和はあくまでも人間として生きていくべきだ。私たちのような何者かと暮らすのではなく、同じ時間を生きる人間と共に歩いて行くべきなんだ』
lines.translated: "Chiwa should live her life as a human to the very end. Rather than living with creatures like us, she should walk alongside humans who live in the same flow of time."

lines.content: ……そんなのはよくないと、ナハトは、思った。
lines.translated: That is no good, Nacht had thought.

lines.content: どうしてですか
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: 俺は問いかけずにはいられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but ask.

lines.content: どうして、あなたは“そんなのはよくない”と思ったんですか？
lines.translated: "Why did you think that was 'no good'?"

lines.content: 予感だよ。嫌な予感が、していた
lines.translated: "A premonition. I had a bad premonition."

lines.content: あの子は“ヒトデナシ”の子だ。いつかどうしようもない面倒が降りかかってくるんじゃないかというような……そんな予感がいつもしていた
lines.translated: "That girl is the child of 'inhuman monsters.' I always had this premonition... that someday, some unavoidable trouble would come crashing down on us."

lines.content: さっさと千和を“不死”にして手放してしまえ、喰われてしまうならそれはそれで仕方がない――ナハトは何度も、何度でも、ソルに言ったのだという。
lines.translated: Hurry up, make Chiwa "immortal," and wash your hands of her; if she gets devoured, then so be it--Nacht said he had told Sol that over and over again.

lines.content: ……だが[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は頑なだった。どうしても千和を“不死”にはしないと。そして許されるだけの時間、千和と一緒に過ごしたいと
lines.translated: "...But he was stubborn. He insisted that no matter what, he wouldn't make Chiwa 'immortal.' And that he wanted to spend as much time with Chiwa as he was allowed."

lines.content: だから仕方なく俺は、千和以外の――今を苦しむ少女たちを[さら|攫]い、幾人かの少女たちの命をさくらに捧げてきた
lines.translated: "So, left with no choice, I abducted girls other than Chiwa--girls who were suffering in the present--and offered the lives of several of them to the cherry tree."

lines.content: ……“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”に居場所を失った子らの命をだ。そうして“夜”を延命させようとした。そうしてもう一度、自分の“役割”に従順であろうとした
lines.translated: "...The lives of children who had lost their place in the 'Time of the Sun.' That was how I tried to extend the life of the 'Night.' That was how I tried to be obedient to my 'role' once more."

lines.content: ……だけど、だめだった
lines.translated: "...However, it was no use."

lines.content: ……だめ？　どうしてですか？
lines.translated: "...It didn't work? Why?"

lines.content: 少女たちの命で、ほんの少しだけさくらは花を咲かせるが、[・|予][・|想][・|通][・|り]、すぐにまた枯れてしまうんだ。このままでは“夜”が閉じてしまう
lines.translated: "With the girls' lives, the cherry tree blooms just a tiny bit, but just as I expected, it immediately withers again. At this rate, the 'Night' will close."
"...Just as you expected?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: ……さくらが千和の命を求めてるんだよ。あの子の命で……、いいや、[・|あ][・|の][・|子][・|た][・|ち]の命でなければ、さくらはすぐに枯れてしまう
lines.translated: "...The cherry tree is demanding Chiwa's life. Unless it is that girl's life... no, unless it is the lives of *those girls*, the cherry treewithers away immediately."

lines.content: あの子たちとは……およそ十年前。“夜の王”と戦い、このさくらから報酬として“魔法”を得た少女たちのこと。
lines.translated: By "those girls"... he meant the girls who fought the "King of the Night" roughly ten years ago, and received "magic" from this cherry tree as a reward.

lines.content: さくらが求めるのはあのときの少女らの命だけ――そうでなければさくらは満足しない。そうでなければ、“夜”を延命させられない
lines.translated: "The cherry tree demands only the lives of the girls from back then--otherwise, the cherry tree will not be satisfied. Otherwise, the life of the 'Night' cannot be extended."

lines.content: 枯れゆくさくらを見上げ、[・|そ][・|の][・|わ][・|け]を問うてみた俺の頭の中に、そういった回答が花びらみたいに降ってきたんだよ
lines.translated: "When I looked up at the withering cherry tree and asked the reason why, that answer drifted down into my head like falling petals."

lines.content: 千和以外の命をいくら捧げても意味はないのだと。
lines.translated: That no matter how many lives other than Chiwa's were offered, it would be meaningless.

lines.content: 俺はこのさくらが求めるように命を捧げる。そして“夜”を延命させていく。それだけだ。ただそれだけが俺の“役割”だ。……[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]がやって来るまではずっとそういう生活だった
lines.translated: "I offer lives just as this cherry tree demands. And I extend the life of the 'Night.' That is all. That alone is my 'role.' ...Until he came along, that was always how I lived."

lines.content: ……そういう生活で、満足していたはずだった。それをすっかり忘れてしまっていた
lines.translated: "...I was supposed to be satisfied with that kind of life. I had completely forgotten that."

lines.content: 元人間の“夜の怪物”
lines.translated: A former human turned "monster of the Night."

lines.content: そしてそんな[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]が[さら|攫]ってきた……“ヒトデナシ”の子。
lines.translated: And the child of "inhuman monsters"... whom he had abducted.

lines.content: あいつらと暮らしていく中で、つい……考えるようになってしまっていた
lines.translated: "As I lived alongside them, before I knew it... I had started to think."

lines.content: 考える……
lines.translated: "Think..."

lines.content: ああ。それは俺たち“怪物”にとって危険なことだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. For 'monsters' like us, that is a dangerous thing."

lines.content: 何が危険なのかと問いかける俺に、ナハトは肩を竦め、応えた。
lines.translated: When I asked what was so dangerous about it, Nacht shrugged and answered.

lines.content: 俺たち“怪物”は“考える”ということをしない。ただ与えられた“役割”を淡々とこなし続けるだけのイキモノなんだ。元は花だ。ただの植物。空に向かって成長するだけの考えない葦だ
lines.translated: "We 'monsters' do not 'think.' We are creatures that simply carry out the 'role' given to us without question. Originally, we were flowers. Mere plants. Unthinking reeds that merely grow toward the sky."

lines.content: “我々はどこから来たのか。我々は何者か。我々はどこへ行くのか”――
lines.translated: "'Where do we come from? What are we? Where are we going?'--"

lines.content: そういった思考の迷路をぐるぐると永遠に巡り続けるのはお前たち人間の“役割”だ。特権と言い換えてもいい
lines.translated: "Wandering endlessly in circles through a labyrinth of thoughts like that is the 'role' of you humans. You could even call it a privilege."

lines.content: そうした思考の中で“生きる”ことや、“幸福”について見いだそうとするのが人間というイキモノだろう
lines.translated: "Trying to find the meaning of 'living' and 'happiness' within such thoughts is what makes humans the creatures they are, isn't it?"

lines.content: だが、俺たちはそうはなれない。“想像”することや“考える”ことを知らないからだ
lines.translated: "However, we cannot become like that. Because we do not know how to 'imagine' or 'think.'"

lines.content: だと、いうのに……
lines.translated: "And yet, despite that..."

lines.content: 自分の“役割”は他にあるんじゃないかと。この命の使い道は別にあるんじゃないのかと。いつの間にか人間みたいにそんなことを思いはじめてしまってた
lines.translated: "Wondering if I might have some other 'role.' Wondering if there might be another way to use this life. Before I knew it, I had started thinking about things like that, just like a human."

lines.content: だが、そんなものはないとナハトは言った。
lines.translated: However, there is no such thing, Nacht said.

lines.content: ――俺に別の“役割”が？　命の使い身が別にあるのではないか？　そんなものはないんだよ。それなのに、ふと湧いた疑問を疑問のまま放置できなくなっていた
lines.translated: "--Another 'role' for me? Another way to use my life? There is no such thing. And yet, once a sudden doubt sprang up, I found myself unable to just leave it alone."

lines.content: ……人間のそばで暮らしてしまったことの副作用だ。俺も、考え続けていれば何か“答え”のようなものを見つけられるかもしれないとも感じ始めてた――
lines.translated: "...It is a side effect of having lived alongside humans. I had even started to feel that if I kept thinking, I too might be able to find something like an 'answer'--"

lines.content: 俺に、俺のような“怪物”に、そのようなものの答えなど導き出せるはずもないのに
lines.translated: "Even though there is no way I--a 'monster' like me--could ever arrive at an answer to something like that."

lines.content: それなのに、とナハトは空を見上げたままに言う。
lines.translated: And yet, Nacht said, still looking up at the sky.

lines.content: それなのに、延々と、自分の“生”について考え始めている自分に気づき、戸惑った
lines.translated: "And yet, I realized I had started thinking endlessly about my own 'life,' and I was bewildered."

lines.content: 人間にはなれない“怪物”が人間のふりを始めた――それはとても危険なことなのだと知っていた。
lines.translated: A "monster" that could never become human had begun pretending to be human--he knew that was a very dangerous thing.

lines.content: 俺たちは“考える”ことができない。“想像”することが、できない。そういうイキモノだからだ
lines.translated: "We cannot 'think.' We cannot 'imagine.' Because that is the kind of creatures we are."

lines.content: それなのに、ふとした“疑問”に捕らわれてしまえば……終わりだ
lines.translated: "And yet, if we get caught up in a sudden 'doubt'... it is the end."

lines.content: 考えられもしないのに、人間の真似事をして永遠に考え続け……ついには“考える”こと以外、何もできなくなり……
lines.translated: "Even though we aren't capable of thinking, we imitate humans and keep thinking forever... until finally, we become unable to do anything *but* 'think'..."

lines.content: そうなってしまった“怪物”は花に戻るんだ。つまりそれは我々にとっての死だ
lines.translated: "A 'monster' that ends up like that returns to being a flower. In other words, that is death for us."

lines.content: そういう仲間を何人も見てきたとナハトは言った。そしてついに“怪物”は俺ひとりになったんだ、と。
lines.translated: Nacht said he had seen many of his kind end up that way. And that finally, he had become the only "monster" left.

lines.content: 俺が“考える”ことに取り憑かれ、結果、消えてしまったら……いったい誰が“夜”を維持していくんだ。[・|こ][・|こ]にはたくさんのイキモノたちが暮らしてる――
lines.translated: "If I become obsessed with 'thinking' and end up disappearing as a result... just who is going to maintain the 'Night'? So many creatures live here--"

lines.content: ……その“役割”を一度は放棄したじゃないですか
lines.translated: "...Didn't you abandon that 'role' once before?"

lines.content: そうだな。強欲なる[イキモノ|人間]に、俺たちの“役割”を利用されるのがどうしたってしゃくだったからだ
lines.translated: "That's right. Because having our 'role' exploited by greedy humans was unbearably maddening no matter how I looked at it."

lines.content: だがな、少年。俺や俺たちの勝手だけで、“夜”に生きる全員の未来を断定するかのような真似など、決して許されるはずがない――だから、終わりだ
lines.translated: "However, boy. Acting as if I or my kind have the right to dictate the future of everyone living in the 'Night' out of our own selfishness is something that can never be permitted--so, it is over."

lines.content: ……人間の真似事は、かけらも残さず、終わりにすることにした
lines.translated: "...I decided to put an end to imitating humans, without leaving a single shred behind."

lines.content: 考えることなどもう終わり。
lines.translated: An end to thinking altogether.

lines.content: そしてただただこれまで通り、思考停止の有様で、与えられた“役割”を全うするだけだ。
lines.translated: Simply fulfilling the "role" he was given, just as before, in a state of complete thoughtlessness.

lines.content: ナハトは、ため息をつき――咥えたたばこの長くなっていた灰が足下に落ちた。
lines.translated: Nacht let out a sigh--and the long ash at the tip of the cigarette in his mouth fell to his feet.

lines.content: ……それでもソルは、[・|そ][・|れ]を拒否し続けたから
lines.translated: "...And because Sol kept refusing that anyway..."
"I killed him."

lines.content: 冷たい声が返ってきた。理由なんていつだって単純で、簡単なものなんだと。
lines.translated: A cold voice came back. As if to say that the reason is always something simple and straightforward.

lines.content: あいつを“夜”に立ち入らせたのは間違いだった。あいつは“夜”の存在を脅かす脅威だ
lines.translated: "Allowing him to set foot into the 'Night' was a mistake. He was a threat that endangered the very existence of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 千和を人間として育てたい。故にその命をさくらに捧げることはしない。そんなあいつの主張のために“夜”が消えようとしている
lines.translated: "He wanted to raise Chiwa as a human. Therefore, he wouldn't offer her life to the cherry tree. Because of that insistence of his, the 'Night' is on the verge of vanishing."

lines.content: だから俺は、あいつを殺してでも千和の命をさくらに捧げることにした――“夜”の中で生きているたくさんのイキモノたちのために
lines.translated: "So I decided to offer Chiwa's life to the cherry tree, even if it meant killing him--for the sake of the many creatures living within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: “夜の怪物”の弱点を知ってるか、少年
lines.translated: "Do you know the weakness of a 'monster of the Night,' boy?"

lines.content: ……“人と触れあうこと”
lines.translated: "...'Touching a human.'"

lines.content: ああ、そうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: やはりお前は“夜”に[さと|賢]いなとナハトは言った。
lines.translated: You really are well-versed in the ways of the "Night," Nacht said.

lines.content: “怪物”を殺せるのは人だけだ。そして、同じ“夜の怪物”同士だ。この手ならば仲間のみならず自分自身をも殺せるだろう
lines.translated: "Only a human can kill a 'monster.' And fellow 'monsters of the Night.' With these hands, we can kill not only our own kind, but ourselves as well."

lines.content: ともかく、だ。少年。“想像”してみろよ。……[・|つ][・|ま][・|り]、これからお前に、俺が……何を言いたいのか。わかるだろう
lines.translated: "At any rate, boy. Try to 'imagine' it. ...In other words, what it is... that I am about to say to you right now. You can figure it out, can't you?"

lines.content: ……つまり？
lines.translated: "...Which means?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ナハトは、うなずく――そして濃い煙を一息、吐き出し、
lines.translated: Nacht nodded--then exhaled a single puff of thick smoke,

lines.content: お別れは済ませたか、少年。俺は、今夜、千和の命を[さら|攫]いに来たぞ
lines.translated: "Have you said your goodbyes, boy? I have come tonight to abduct Chiwa's life."

lines.content: 一瞬だった。
lines.translated: It happened in an instant.

lines.content: 瞬きも許されないほどの、一瞬だ。
lines.translated: An instant so brief it didn't even allow for the blink of an eye.

lines.content: 充分に保たれていたはずの距離を一瞬で省略し――ナハトが、その漆黒の巨体が、俺のすぐ目の前に立っていた。そして背中を丸めるようにし、俺の顔を覗き込んでいた。
lines.translated: Closing the ample distance that should have been between us in a flash--Nacht, that pitch-black giant frame of his, was standing right in front of my eyes. Hunching his back, he peered down into my face.

lines.content: ……俺たち“怪物”は、人間に対して、[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]もできる
lines.translated: "...We 'monsters' can also do *this* to humans."

lines.content: ……闇だ。
lines.translated: Darkness.

lines.content: 大きなおおきな闇と真紅の双眸が、俺を見下ろしている。
lines.translated: A vast, immense darkness and a pair of crimson eyes were looking down at me.
"Taiga. Kanade Taiga. Entry is forbidden. I hereby expel you from this 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 目を、覚ました――俺は大通りに倒れていた。
lines.translated: I woke up--I was collapsed on the main street.

lines.content: ずきずきと腹部に鈍痛がある。
lines.translated: There was a dull, throbbing pain in my abdomen.

lines.content: 空はすっかり明けていた。朝だ。そろそろ大通りにも人が行き交い始める時間だろうと察する。
lines.translated: The sky had completely brightened. It was morning. I figured it was about time for people to start walking along the main street.

lines.content: ふらふらと、立ち上がり……。
lines.translated: Unsteadily, I stood up...

lines.content: 『お別れは済ませたか、少年。俺は、今夜、千和の命を[さら|攫]いに来たぞ』
lines.translated: "Have you said your goodbyes, boy? I have come tonight to abduct Chiwa's life."

lines.content: 千和の部屋へ俺は急いだ。
lines.translated: I hurried to Chiwa's room.

lines.content: ……く、そう
lines.translated: "...Dammit."

lines.content: やられた、と唇を噛む。
lines.translated: He got me, I thought, biting my lip.

lines.content: ……連れて行かれた……のか、これは
lines.translated: "...Was she... taken away?"

lines.content: 千和はベッドの中で眠りについたまま――しかし、目を覚まさなかった。
lines.translated: Chiwa remained asleep in her bed--but she wouldn't wake up.

lines.content: 呼びかけてみても、身体を揺すってみても。
lines.translated: No matter how much I called out to her, no matter how much I shook her body.

lines.content: おそらく“夜”の側から心を、あるいは命そのものを、ナハトが連れて行ってしまったのだろう。
lines.translated: Nacht had likely taken her heart, or perhaps her very life itself, away from the side of the "Night."

lines.content: ……取り返さなければ。
lines.translated: I have to get her back.

lines.content: 千和の命をさくらに捧げられてしまうその前に。
lines.translated: Before Chiwa's life is offered up to the cherry tree.

lines.content: 千和を“怪物”にさせられてしまう、その前に。
lines.translated: Before Chiwa is turned into a "monster."

lines.content: うう
腹部の痛みにうめいた。
lines.translated: I groaned from the pain in my abdomen.

lines.content: “夜”の立ち入りを禁ず――
lines.translated: Entry into the "Night" is forbidden--

lines.content: そのような言葉と共に、一撃だ。腹部に重く鋭い衝撃が走った。何をされたのかはわからない。
lines.translated: Along with words to that effect came a single blow. A heavy, sharp impact shot through my abdomen. I don't know what he did to me.

lines.content: ただ、何がしかの打撃を受けたのだろうことは……わかる。
lines.translated: All I know... is that I must have taken some kind of hit.

lines.content: ……俺は、人間は、“怪物”の弱点じゃなかったのか
lines.translated: "...Aren't I--aren't humans supposed to be a 'monster's' weakness?"

lines.content: まるで愚痴でもこぼすかのように言いながら、俺は、重い身体を引きずりながら早朝の大通りを行く。
lines.translated: Grumbling as if I were just venting a complaint, I dragged my heavy body down the early morning main street.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。おかしいじゃないか。人間と触れあうと“怪物”は死に至る――はずだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right. Isn't it strange? Touching a human is supposed to be fatal to a "monster"--or so it should be.

lines.content: それは俺自身がまだ“夜”に出入りできるほど少年だからか。
lines.translated: Is it because I'm still enough of a boy to pass in and out of the "Night"?

lines.content: そんな俺を相手なら、まだ触れてもナハトは無事だと、そういうことなのだろう――そのように“想像”することはできうるが、
lines.translated: Meaning that with someone like me as his opponent, Nacht would still be fine even if he touched me--I could "imagine" it being something like that,

lines.content: 嫌な予感がしていた。
lines.translated: I had a bad feeling about this.

lines.content: いや。これは予感と呼べるような曖昧なものではない。もっと確かなものだ。
lines.translated: No. This wasn't something as vague as a premonition. It was something much more certain.

lines.content: お前をこの“夜”から除外する――
lines.translated: I hereby expel you from this "Night"--

lines.content: 俺は、“ゆめのねどこ”へと急いだ。
lines.translated: I hurried toward the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: ……繋がらない
lines.translated: "...It won't connect."

lines.content: “鍵”を使用しても“ゆめのねどこ”に玄関が通じなかった。何度もためした。しかし、結果は同じ。
lines.translated: Even when I used the "Key," the front door wouldn't connect to the "Bed of Dreams." I tried over and over. However, the result was the same.

lines.content: “鍵”は消えずに、こうしてちゃんとまだあるのに……
lines.translated: "Even though the 'Key' hasn't disappeared, and it's still right here like this..."

lines.content: 店先に置かれた公衆電話。
lines.translated: The payphone sitting out in front of the shop.

lines.content: その受話器を手に取り、番号を押すも……、
lines.translated: I picked up the receiver and pressed the numbers, but...

lines.content: ……こちらもだめか
lines.translated: "...No good on this end either, huh."

lines.content: 耳に押し当てた受話器からは呼び出し音どころか、その向こうから何の気配も感じられはしなかった。
lines.translated: From the receiver pressed against my ear, let alone a dial tone, I couldn't sense any presence from the other side at all.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”を、その建物を、俺は見上げる――唐突だ。あまりに唐突に“夜”からはじき出されてしまった。
lines.translated: I looked up at the "Bed of Dreams," at the building itself--it was so sudden. All too suddenly, I had been cast out of the "Night."

lines.content: 『大雅。奏大雅。立ち入りを、禁ず。お前をこの“夜”から除外する』
lines.translated: "Taiga. Kanade Taiga. Entry is forbidden. I hereby expel you from this 'Night.'"

lines.content: 唖然とする。呆然ともする。
lines.translated: I was stunned. Dumbfounded, even.

lines.content: うそだろ、と思う。
lines.translated: This has to be a lie, I thought.

lines.content: いつかこういう日が来るだろうことは覚悟しているつもりだった。
lines.translated: I thought I had prepared myself for the fact that a day like this would come eventually.

lines.content: だが、こんなにも急にその瞬間が訪れるなんて……覚悟はしていても、想像が足りていなかった。
lines.translated: But for that moment to arrive so suddenly like this... even if I was prepared for it, my imagination had fallen short.

lines.content: あさひさん。十夜。ナナちゃん。……クロ
lines.translated: "Asahi-san. Toya. Nana-chan. ...Kuro."

lines.content: もう俺は、君たちに会えない？　永遠に……？
lines.translated: Will I never be able to see you all again? Forever...?

lines.content: 言葉もなく立ち尽くす――いや。違う。何を言ってる。
lines.translated: Speechless, I stood rooted to the spot--no. That's wrong. What am I saying?

lines.content: 今、思いを巡らせなければならないのは、こんな当たり前のさみしさについてではない。千和。千和だ。早くしないと、千和の命が……。
lines.translated: What I need to be thinking about right now isn't this kind of obvious loneliness. Chiwa. It's Chiwa. If I don't hurry, Chiwa's life will...

lines.content: 見上げたさくらの枝に花はまだない。
lines.translated: There were still no flowers on the cherry tree branches I looked up at.

lines.content: それはつまり、今はまだ、千和の命はさくらへと捧げられてはいない、ということなのだろうか……。
lines.translated: Does that mean that, right now, Chiwa's life still hasn't been offered up to the cherry tree...?

lines.content: 何か。何かないのか。
lines.translated: Something. Isn't there something?

lines.content: 再び“夜”の中に踏みいるための方法は……何か。
lines.translated: Some way to step back into the "Night" again... anything.

lines.content: あ、ああ。そうだ。クロだ
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. That's right. Kuro."

lines.content: 俺は、携帯のことを思い出す。
lines.translated: I remembered the cell phone.

lines.content: クロとだけ繋がれる携帯電話だ。
lines.translated: The cell phone that can only connect to Kuro.

lines.content: 焦っていたからと言って、こんな大切なものを忘れていただなんて……。
lines.translated: Even if I was panicking, to think I'd forget something this important...

lines.content: 取り出す。今やこの端末しか“夜”と、その住人と繋がるための手段はなにもない。
lines.translated: I took it out. Now, this device was the only means left to connect with the "Night" and its residents.

lines.content: 急いで“９６”をプッシュする。
lines.translated: I hurriedly pressed "96."

lines.content: 祈るような思いで耳に押し当てた……。
lines.translated: With a prayer in my heart, I pressed it to my ear...

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ため息を、吐き出す。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh.

lines.content: こっちも、だめなのか
lines.translated: "This one's no good either, huh..."

lines.content: 急いで番号を入力しはしたものの……。
lines.translated: Even though I had hurriedly punched in the number...

lines.content: しかし繋がらないのはわかっていた。
lines.translated: Deep down, I already knew it wouldn't connect.

lines.content: 携帯は電源さえ入らなかったのだ。
lines.translated: The cell phone wouldn't even turn on.

lines.content: さすがに、胸を突き刺すような気持ちがあった。
lines.translated: Even for me, that felt like a stab to the chest.

lines.content: この電話が、繋がらない……
lines.translated: "This phone won't connect..."

lines.content: ここのところ何度電話してもクロは呼び出しに応えてくれなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: Lately, no matter how many times I called, Kuro hadn't answered the ring, though...

lines.content: しかし、この状況で、この結果は――だめだ。
lines.translated: However, in this situation, this result is--no good.

lines.content: 今、この電話が繋がらないということは、どうしようもない何かが決定的になってしまったように、思えてしまって……。
lines.translated: The fact that this phone wouldn't connect right now made it feel as though something irreversible had been set in stone...

lines.content: いや。だめだ。
lines.translated: No. No way.

lines.content: そんなのはだめだ。
lines.translated: I can't accept that.

lines.content: ……お願いだ。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: ……お願いだから、出てくれ。クロ。力を……。俺に力を、貸してくれ
lines.translated: "...Please, pick up. Kuro. Your power... Lend me your power."

lines.content: しかし何度番号を押そうと。
lines.translated: Yet no matter how many times I pressed the numbers.

lines.content: 何度、クロの名前を呼んでみようと。
lines.translated: No matter how many times I tried calling Kuro's name.

lines.content: 俺の現実には何の変化もなかった。古い端末はただのガラクタになってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Nothing changed in my reality. The old device had turned into nothing more than a piece of junk.

lines.content: 力なく俺は端末を耳から離し――うなだれる。行き場をなくした。心も、身体も。すべてが真っ白になっていた。
lines.translated: Powerlessly, I pulled the device away from my ear--and hung my head. I had nowhere left to go. My mind, my body. Everything had gone completely blank.

lines.content: ……新聞配達のバイクの音。
lines.translated: The sound of a newspaper delivery bike.

lines.content: ……どこかの飼い犬が吠える声。
lines.translated: The sound of someone's pet dog barking.

lines.content: ……少しばかり早い“行ってきます”の挨拶。
lines.translated: A slightly early "I'm heading out" greeting.

lines.content: いつもと変わらず、町が目覚める気配がしていた。
lines.translated: Just like always, there were signs of the town waking up.

lines.content: そして……、
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: ひら、ひら、
lines.translated: Flutter, flutter.

lines.content: ……花、びら？
lines.translated: "...Petals?"

lines.content: ……ひらり。
lines.translated: Flutter.

lines.content: 見上げた枝に、春だ。
lines.translated: Upon the branches I looked up at, there was spring.

lines.content: まるで、空っぽの器に命が満たされていくように……。
lines.translated: As if an empty vessel were being filled with life...

lines.content: ひとつ、ふたつ――その枯れ枝に、小さな春が芽吹き始めていた。
lines.translated: One, two--upon those withered branches, a small spring was beginning to bud.

lines.content: ……千和。ごめんな
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 声がする。
lines.translated: Her voice rang out.

lines.content: どうか、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]のことを許してやってほしい
lines.translated: "Please, I want you to forgive *him*."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じると――いつでもあなたの笑顔がそこにある。
lines.translated: Whenever I close my eyelids--your smiling face is always right there.
"...You must know it too, Chiwa. He *really, truly resembles the 'monster'* from that story. Right?"

lines.content: ああ、うん。確かにそうだねとうなずくと、[まぶた|瞼]の裏のあなたはおかしそうに微笑んだ。
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah. That's certainly true," I nodded, and behind my eyelids, you smiled in amusement.

lines.content: ああ、うん。そうなんだよ。あの物語の“怪物”のように、あいつはああ見えて、実は――……
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Just like the 'monster' in that story, despite how he looks, he's actually--..."

lines.content: 目を、覚ます。
lines.translated: I woke up.

lines.content: 短い、短い……ほんの僅かな夢を見ていた。
lines.translated: A short, short... I was having the briefest of dreams.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を、閉じれば――大切なひとはいつもそこで微笑んでいる。だから私は大丈夫。さみしくない。ちゃんと、生きていける。“魔法”はなくても。
lines.translated: If I close my eyelids--the person precious to me is always smiling there. So I'm okay. I'm not lonely. I can live on, properly. Even without "magic."

lines.content: 夢の中で、そうつぶやいたような気がしてる。そしてあなたは微笑んでくれる。そんな夢の続きを、見たかった。
lines.translated: I feel like I whispered that in my dream. And then you smiled for me. I wanted to see the rest of that dream.

lines.content: ここは、どこだろう……。
lines.translated: Where am I...?

lines.content: ああ。私はまだ夢を見ているのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Ah. Maybe I'm still dreaming.

lines.content: 空が見える。きらきらの“夜”の空――おかしいな。ちゃんと部屋のベッドで目を閉じたはずなのにな。
lines.translated: I can see the sky. The sparkling sky of the "Night"--how strange. I'm sure I properly closed my eyes in my bed in my room.

lines.content: 私の小さな身体は誰かに抱えられ、緩やかに、揺られてた。
lines.translated: My small body was being held by someone, gently swaying.

lines.content: ……先輩？
lines.translated: "...Senpai?"

lines.content: きっと、そうだ。
lines.translated: Surely, that's it.

lines.content: そう……だよね。
lines.translated: That's... right, isn't it?

lines.content: 小さな私を抱きかかえて歩いてくれるのはあなたがいいなと思った。
lines.translated: I thought how nice it would be if the one carrying little me and walking along were you.

lines.content: だけど返事はない。ただ“夜”よりも静かな沈黙が降り注ぐばかり。
lines.translated: But there was no reply. Only a silence quieter than the "Night" came pouring down.

lines.content: ナハト……。
lines.translated: Nacht...

lines.content: 見上げた視界にはあなたの顔が見えた。
lines.translated: In my upturned field of vision, I saw your face.

lines.content: 私は今、あなたの腕に抱きかかえられている。
lines.translated: Right now, I am being carried in your arms.

lines.content: ……ここは、どこ？
lines.translated: "...Where is this?"

lines.content: そう聞いた。
lines.translated: That was what I asked.

lines.content: まだ眠いばかりの私にあなたは答える――さくらだ、と。
lines.translated: To me, still so very sleepy, you answered--the cherry tree.

lines.content: 町の中心。学園のすぐ隣。さくらの大木。その根元。
lines.translated: The center of town. Right next to the academy. The great cherry tree. At its base.

lines.content: ……借りたものを返しに来たんだ
lines.translated: "...I came to return what I borrowed."

lines.content: 借りた、もの……
lines.translated: "What you... borrowed..."

lines.content: はらり。
lines.translated: *Flutter.*

lines.content: どこかから風に乗り運ばれてきた[ひとひら|一片]が、私の鼻先を掠めていった。
lines.translated: Carried on the wind from somewhere, a single petal brushed past the tip of my nose.

lines.content: ナハト
lines.translated: Nacht

lines.content: 名前を呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called his name.

lines.content: ……ナハト。やっと、会えた
lines.translated: "...Nacht. I finally got to see you."

lines.content: ここに、この時間の中にやって来てから、あなたのことを傷つけてから……十数年。
lines.translated: Since coming here, into this time, since hurting you... over ten years.

lines.content: ずっと会いたかった。
lines.translated: I have wanted to see you for so long.

lines.content: ずっと、ずっと……ごめんなさいを言いたかった。
lines.translated: For so, so long... I wanted to say I'm sorry.

lines.content: 許してもらえるなんて思っていない。私はあなたの大切なものを壊しすぎたから。
lines.translated: I don't expect you to forgive me. Because I destroyed far too many of the things that were precious to you.

lines.content: それでも、何度でも、何度だって……いつまでも、あなたに謝り続けていたかった――ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: Even so, over and over, as many times as it takes... forever and ever, I wanted to keep apologizing to you--I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。ナハト
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Nacht."

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。ごめんなさい。ずっとずっと、私……あなたに、ナハトに、謝りたかった
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I'm sorry. For so, so long, I... I wanted to apologize to you, to Nacht."

lines.content: 私が壊した。あなたの全部を壊してしまった――私はもう子どもじゃない。だから謝っても何も元には戻らないことくらいわかってる。わかってしまう。
lines.translated: I broke it. I ended up breaking everything you had--I'm not a child anymore. So I know full well that apologizing won't bring anything back to the way it was. I can't help knowing it.

lines.content: だからこそ、思うのだ。
lines.translated: And that is precisely why I think this.

lines.content: 私なんて産まれてこなければ、よかった。
lines.translated: It would have been better if someone like me had never been born.

lines.content: 涙と一緒にぽろぽろ言葉がこぼれて落ちた。
lines.translated: My words spilled and fell in drops along with my tears.

lines.content: あなたは私をさくらの根元にそっと寝かせた。
lines.translated: You gently laid me down at the base of the cherry tree.

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: 私の頬に指先で触れた。その手は真っ白な手袋で覆われている。
lines.translated: You touched my cheek with your fingertips. That hand was covered in a pure white glove.

lines.content: ナハト……
lines.translated: "Nacht..."

lines.content: なんだか懐かしくなって。なんだか、悲しくなって……さみしくなって。私は泣いた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I felt nostalgic. For some reason, I felt sad... and lonely. I cried.

lines.content: ナハトは私に触れた手を引き、空を……さくらの樹を見上げた。
lines.translated: Nacht pulled back the hand that had touched me and looked up at the sky... at the cherry tree.

lines.content: ……あの、少年は
lines.translated: "...That boy is..."

lines.content: 奏大雅だ。お前の友人。お前の幼馴染み。……お前にとって、特別だったのだろう人間だ
lines.translated: "Kanade Taiga. Your friend. Your childhood friend. ...A human who must have been special to you."

lines.content: ナハトはマッチでたばこに火を付けた。ふわりと真っ白な煙が“夜”に溶ける。その様子を、あの頃みたいに私はじっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: Nacht lit a cigarette with a match. Pure white smoke drifted up softly and dissolved into the "Night." Just like back then, I stared fixedly at the sight.

lines.content: なあ、千和。どうしてあいつなんだ
lines.translated: "Hey, Chiwa. Why him?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: どうして、あいつじゃないとだめなんだ。俺にはどうしてもわからない。答えをくれないか、千和
lines.translated: "Why does it have to be him and no one else? I just can't understand it. Won't you give me an answer, Chiwa?"

lines.content: ……答え、を？
lines.translated: "...An answer?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 俺は“夜の怪物”だ。人の心に憧れ続けるばかりの“イキモノ”だ。……いつだってこの世界のことを知りたいと思ってる
lines.translated: "I am a 'Monster of the Night.' A 'creature' that does nothing but endlessly yearn for the human heart. ...I always want to know about this world."

lines.content: だが、世界の謎や不思議を解き明かすために考えたくとも、それらの可能性について“想像”したくとも、お前たちのようにはいかないイキモノだから……
lines.translated: "However, even if I want to think in order to unravel the mysteries and wonders of the world, even if I want to 'imagine' those possibilities, I am a creature that cannot do so the way you all do..."

lines.content: だから教えてほしいんだ。千和。とナハトは言う。
lines.translated: That's why I want you to tell me, Chiwa, Nacht said.

lines.content: ……どうしてお前は、あの少年を恋しく求めるようになったんだ。その心を、俺は……きっと知りたいと思ってる
lines.translated: "...Why did you come to long for and seek out that boy? That heart of yours, I... surely want to understand it."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……私が、先輩のことを好きになったのは
lines.translated: "...The reason I fell in love with Senpai is..."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ……秘密
lines.translated: "...a secret."

lines.content: ナハトが真っ赤な目を細めた。
lines.translated: Nacht narrowed his crimson eyes.

lines.content: 私が先輩を好きになった理由……。
lines.translated: The reason I fell in love with Senpai...

lines.content: そんなの、言えないよ
lines.translated: "I can't tell you something like that."

lines.content: 先輩のことを、あの人のことを好きになったその瞬間については、私も、先輩も、簡単には思い出せなくなってしまったけれど……。
lines.translated: As for the exact moment I fell in love with Senpai, with him, neither I nor Senpai can easily remember it anymore, though...

lines.content: だけどね、ナハト。私は先輩が好きなの。これからもっといっぱい、この気持ちがいろんな形に育っていってほしいって思ってる
lines.translated: "But you know, Nacht. I love Senpai. From here on out, I want these feelings to grow into lots and lots of different shapes."

lines.content: ……もう、会えなくてもか
lines.translated: "...Even if you can never see him again?"

lines.content: ナハトは、言った。目を瞑ったまま――まるで私の言葉はもう聞きたくないとばかりに。
lines.translated: Nacht spoke, keeping his eyes closed--as if to say he didn't want to hear my words anymore.

lines.content: あの少年はもう二度と“夜”の中には這入れない。“夜”との繋がりを切断したからだ
lines.translated: "That boy can never crawl into the 'Night' again. Because I severed his connection to the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……先輩と、会えない？
lines.translated: "...I can't see Senpai?"

lines.content: ……もう二度と、だ。俺がそうした
lines.translated: "...Never again. I made it so."

lines.content: だから俺を恨め――とばかりに冷たい声だった。
lines.translated: His voice was cold, as if telling me to hate him for it.

lines.content: ……今のお前は肉体から魂だけを抜き取った、いわば霊体のような存在だ。命そのものと言ってもいいかもしれない。そんなお前を、このさくらに捧げれば……
lines.translated: "...Right now, you are an existence with only the soul extracted from the body, like a spirit, so to speak. You could even call it life itself. If I offer you as you are now to this cherry tree..."

lines.content: 私の肉体は“夜”の中で再び目覚める――そして私は“夜の住人”になっている。
lines.translated: My physical body will awaken once more within the "Night"--and I will have become a "resident of the Night."

lines.content: 私が“夜”で目覚めればいったいどんなイキモノになっているんだろう。ソルはナハトと同じ“夜の怪物”になった。それは、ほんの少しだけ気にはなるけど……。
lines.translated: If I awaken in the "Night," just what kind of creature will I have become? Sol became a "Monster of the Night" just like Nacht. That does bother me just a tiny bit, though...

lines.content: わかった
lines.translated: "Okay."

lines.content: いいよと私は答える。私はナハトと一緒に“夜”の中で生きる。それが私の犯した罪の償いなんだと言われても納得できる――
lines.translated: It's okay, I answered. I will live in the "Night" together with Nacht. Even if I'm told that is the atonement for the sin I committed, I can accept it--

lines.content: 平気なのか
lines.translated: "Are you fine with that?"

lines.content: ナハトは言う。
lines.translated: Nacht said.

lines.content: もう二度と、大好きな人と会えなくても……千和。お前は大丈夫なのか？
lines.translated: "Even if you can never meet the person you love so much ever again... Chiwa. Are you alright with that?"

lines.content: 平気……じゃないけど、平気だよ
lines.translated: "I'm... not fine with it, but I'll be fine."

lines.content: ……もう二度と会えなくても
lines.translated: "...Even if we can never meet again."

lines.content: それでも私は、ずっと、先輩のことが好きだよ
lines.translated: "Even so, I will always love Senpai."

lines.content: ……どうして
どうしてそう言い切れるのかと、ナハトは私を見ないままに言う。
lines.translated: How can you declare that with such certainty? Nacht asked without looking at me.

lines.content: ……先輩。私のこと好きだって、言ってくれた
lines.translated: "...Senpai. He told me that he loves me."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: こんな、私をだよ？　柊先輩でも夜月先輩でもなくて……小さくて、生意気で、すぐ泣いちゃう……こんなかわいくもない私を、好きだって
lines.translated: "Me, of all people, you know? Not Hiiragi-senpai, and not Yatsuki-senpai... Someone small, and cheeky, and quick to cry... He said he loves someone as un-cute as me."

lines.content: 先輩が私に好きって言ってくれる――そして手を、繋いでくれる。そんな夢みたいな瞬間を、私、小さな頃からずっとずっと思い描いてた
lines.translated: "Senpai telling me he loves me--and holding my hand. Ever since I was little, I've been picturing a dreamlike moment like that, over and over."

lines.content: 聞いてよナハト。私ね、夢がひとつ、叶ったの。もう諦めてた夢だったのに……私なんて、先輩は気にしてもくれないって、思ってたのに
lines.translated: "Listen, Nacht. One of my dreams came true, you know. Even though it was a dream I had already given up on... Even though I thought Senpai wouldn't even spare a thought for someone like me."

lines.content: うれしかった。幸せ、だった。それだけで、私……バカな私はね、もう一生、先輩のこと嫌いになんてなれなくなっちゃったんだよ
lines.translated: "I was happy. So blissful. Just from that alone, I... foolish little me became completely unable to ever hate Senpai for the rest of my life."

lines.content: 単純な子に、考えの足りない子に育ってしまってごめんなさいと言い、私はナハトの真っ赤な瞳を見つめた。
lines.translated: Saying I'm sorry for growing up into such a simple-minded, thoughtless girl, I gazed into Nacht's crimson eyes.

lines.content: だからね、ナハト。たとえもう二度と会えなくなっても。そして先輩の気持ちが私から離れてしまうことがあったとしても……
lines.translated: "That's why, Nacht. Even if we can never meet again. And even if Senpai's feelings ever drift away from me..."

lines.content: それはね、悲しいけど。さみしいけれど。先輩からもらったたった一回の“大好き”の言葉で、きっと、私は何もかも大丈夫な気がするよ
lines.translated: "That would be sad, you know. It would be lonely. But with just that single 'I love you' I received from Senpai, I feel like everything will surely be alright for me."

lines.content: ……幸せ
lines.translated: "...Blissful."

lines.content: ナハトは小さな声で言った。それはいったい、どんな気持ちなんだと。
lines.translated: Nacht spoke in a quiet voice, asking just what kind of feeling that was.

lines.content: うん……。私はね、ひとりぼっちで死んでいくんだと思ってた。お父さんとお母さんに好きになってもらいたかったけど……そうはならなかった。だから、私はひとりだと思った
lines.translated: "Yeah... You know, I thought I was going to die all alone. I wanted my dad and mom to love me, but... it didn't turn out that way. So, I thought I was all alone."

lines.content: そんな私のことをソルが[さら|攫]ってくれて。そんな私に、ナハトが美味しい料理を作ってくれて。三人で、一緒に家族みたいに、生きて……
lines.translated: "And then Sol spirited me away. And Nacht made delicious food for me. The three of us lived together, just like a family..."

lines.content: 幸せだった、と私は言った。
lines.translated: I was blissful, I said.

lines.content: 充分だったの。もうこれ以上はなにも要らない。そう思える瞬間を生きた記憶が、私の“幸せ”……
lines.translated: "It was enough. I didn't need anything more than this. The memory of living through a moment where I could feel that way is my 'happiness'..."

lines.content: だけどね、ナハト
lines.translated: "But you know, Nacht."

lines.content: ……私は、あなた達ふたりにとっての幸せにはなれなかった。ふたりの大切なものを、壊してしまった
lines.translated: "...I couldn't become happiness for the two of you. I ended up destroying what was precious to you both."

lines.content: ……私は、私の家族は、ソルとナハトから大切な子を奪った。……たぶん、ありったけの残酷な方法で。そして私は、ナハトから大切な友だちを、奪った。ありったけの考えのなさで
lines.translated: "...I, my family, stole a precious child away from Sol and Nacht. ...Probably in the most cruel way imaginable. And I stole a precious friend away from Nacht. With the utmost thoughtlessness."

lines.content: だから私は、こんなバカな私は、いつまでもひとりぼっちでいなきゃいけない人間なんだって、気づいて……
lines.translated: "So I realized that I, someone as foolish as me, am a human who has to stay all alone forever..."

lines.content: ひとりでいれば誰も傷つけるようなことはないはずだから……。
lines.translated: Because as long as I'm alone, I shouldn't end up hurting anyone...

lines.content: でも、そんな私の手を先輩が引いてくれて――また、ひとりぼっちじゃなくなって
lines.translated: "But even so, Senpai took my hand--and once again, I wasn't all alone anymore."

lines.content: だけどね。幸せは油断していると足下を掬いにやって来るんだよ。私は、幸せになれた私は、また大切な人の大切な何かを壊してしまうかもしれない。それが、怖いよ。ナハト
lines.translated: "However, you know. If you let your guard down, happiness comes to sweep your feet out from under you. I, having managed to become happy, might end up destroying something precious to someone precious to me again. That scares me. Nacht."

lines.content: ……私のこと、大切に想ってくれる人がいた。一緒に生きようって言ってくれる人がいた
lines.translated: "...There were people who cared about me deeply. There were people who told me to live together with them."

lines.content: どうしようもなく悲しいことが起こる度、すごいよ、ナハト。そういう人たちが増えていく気がするんだよ……。先輩も。お友だちも。ソルも、そしてナハトもそうだよ
lines.translated: "Every time something hopelessly sad happens, it's amazing, Nacht. I feel like the number of people like that keeps growing... Senpai. My friends. Sol, and you too, Nacht."

lines.content: そのことに気づけたことも、きっと私の幸せなんだと思う
lines.translated: "Being able to realize that is surely part of my happiness, I think."

lines.content: そういったものをもう二度と壊したくないって気持ちも、やっぱり、私の幸せなんじゃないかなって……。ごめんね。生意気なこと言って、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "And this feeling of never wanting to destroy those things ever again is, after all, probably my happiness too... I'm sorry. For saying something so cheeky, I'm sorry."

lines.content: だけど本当に私はそう思うんだよとナハトに伝える。
lines.translated: But I really do think so, I conveyed to Nacht.

lines.content: だからね、ナハト。それだけで、私は全部ぜんぶ、大丈夫。先輩と、もう二度と会えなくても……
lines.translated: "That's why, Nacht. With just that, everything, every little thing is alright for me. Even if I can never see Senpai again..."

lines.content: しかし言葉にすると、だめだな。じわりと涙がにじんだ――“夜”の光が淡く揺れるようだった。
lines.translated: Yet when I put it into words, it's no good. Tears slowly welled up--making the light of the "Night" seem to waver faintly.

lines.content: ……祈ってる
lines.translated: "...I'm praying."

lines.content: ここから、“夜”の中から、先輩のこれからの人生を、幸せを祈ってる
lines.translated: "From here, from within the 'Night,' I'll pray for Senpai's life from here on out, for his happiness."

lines.content: それくらいなら大丈夫だよね。私の大切な人の……先輩の、大切な何かを壊したりはしないよね？
lines.translated: "At least that much is alright, isn't it? It won't destroy anything precious to my precious person... to Senpai, right?"

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……お前がどんなに“夜”の中であいつの幸せを祈ろうと、そんなお前のことに、あいつが気づくことはない
lines.translated: "...No matter how much you pray for his happiness within the 'Night,' he will never notice you doing so."

lines.content: そうかな。きっと、わかってくれるよ
lines.translated: "I wonder about that. He'll surely understand."

lines.content: 私は無理矢理に微笑んでみせる。
lines.translated: I forced myself to smile.

lines.content: 先輩は、わかってくれる。声は届かなくても。姿は、見えなくても。私がそばで先輩の全部が上手くいくように、祈ってること……
lines.translated: "Senpai will understand. Even if my voice can't reach him. Even if he can't see my figure. That I'm right by his side, praying for everything to go well for him..."

lines.content: ずっと隣で、先輩の手を繋いでいたいんだって、思ってること。先輩はきっと、気づいてくれるよ
