lines.translated: "That I want to stay right next to him and hold his hand forever. Senpai will surely notice."

lines.content: ……あいつが
lines.translated: "...Even if he..."

lines.content: ナハトは、たばこの煙と一緒に言葉を吐き出す。
lines.translated: Nacht exhaled the words along with the cigarette smoke.

lines.content: ……あいつが、いつか、お前のことを忘れてしまってもか
lines.translated: "...Even if he forgets all about you someday?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……あいつがもしも、千和。お前のことを忘れて、いつか、お前以外の誰かを好きになってもか
lines.translated: "...What if he, Chiwa, forgets about you, and someday falls in love with someone other than you?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……本当か？
lines.translated: "...Is that really true?"

lines.content: “夜”の住人となったお前とあいつはもう相容れることはない。お前の時間は止まったんだ。お前は、ここで子どものまま。あいつは、外で大人になる。忘れるんだ。お前のことを
lines.translated: "You, who have become a resident of the 'Night,' and he can no longer coexist. Your time has stopped. You will remain a child here. He will become an adult on the outside. He will forget. All about you."

lines.content: それでも、千和。お前は……
lines.translated: "Even so, Chiwa. Will you..."

lines.content: それでも私は、先輩の幸せを祈っていたいよ
lines.translated: "Even so, I want to keep praying for Senpai's happiness."

lines.content: きっと、さみしく思うこともあるだろうし、悲しく思って泣くこともあると思う……私は、嫌な子だから、もしかすると先輩が幸せになればなる程、胸がずきずき痛いのかもしれない
lines.translated: "I'm sure there will be times when I feel lonely, and I think there will be times when I feel sad and cry... Because I'm a nasty girl, maybe the happier Senpai becomes, the more my chest will throb with pain."

lines.content: でもね。その悲しい気持ちは、私だけの宝物なんだよ。誰にもあげないし、これだけは切り取って捨てたりもしないよ
lines.translated: "But you know. That sad feeling is a treasure that belongs only to me. I won't give it to anyone, and this is the one thing I won't cut out and throw away."

lines.content: だって、とても悲しくなるのは、とってもさみしくなってしまうのは、私が先輩のことを大好きな証拠だから……。そうだよね？
lines.translated: "Because becoming so very sad, and becoming so very lonely, is proof that I love Senpai so much... Right?"

lines.content: だからね、ナハト。もう私は、先輩と二度と会えない――この悲しい気持ちがいつまでも消えずに、私の中にあるのなら……
lines.translated: "That's why, Nacht. I can never meet Senpai again--so as long as this sad feeling never fades and stays inside me forever..."

lines.content: 私は、“夜”の中から先輩のこれからの人生を応援し続けていけるんだって、思うんだよ
lines.translated: "I think I can keep cheering for Senpai's future life from within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ふたりで空を見上げた――さくら舞う“夜”の空。
lines.translated: The two of us looked up at the sky--the sky of the "Night" where cherry blossoms danced.

lines.content: ……覚悟、か
lines.translated: "...Resolve, huh."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 覚悟は勇気と書き換えることができると何かで読んだな
lines.translated: "I read somewhere that resolve can be rewritten as courage."

lines.content: ナハトはたばこの火を、親指と人差し指の間で挟み、もみ消した。
lines.translated: Nacht pinched the lit tip of his cigarette between his thumb and forefinger, snuffing it out.

lines.content: 覚悟を決めて、勇気を学んだ人間には――世界に、その人生に祝福されるとも何かで読んだ
lines.translated: "I also read somewhere that a person who makes up their mind and learns courage--will have their life blessed by the world."

lines.content: ……なんだか
lines.translated: Somehow,

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: なんだか、きらきらしすぎて眩しい話だね。それ
lines.translated: "Somehow, that sounds like a story so sparkling it's dazzling."

lines.content: ……そうだな
lines.translated: "...Right."

lines.content: ……俺もだ。大げさな話だなと思った。人間は、些細な話や言葉でも、いつも誇張して美談にしたがるイキモノだなと
lines.translated: "...I thought so too. That it was an exaggerated story. That humans are creatures who always like to blow even the most trivial stories and words out of proportion and turn them into heartwarming tales."

lines.content: また少しの間だけ、私たちは同じ“夜”の空を見つめていた。
lines.translated: For just a little while longer, the two of us gazed up at the same "Night" sky.

lines.content: ……ナハト
lines.translated: "...Nacht."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ……はじめてだね
lines.translated: "...This is a first, isn't it?"

lines.content: 私は微笑む。
lines.translated: I smile.

lines.content: ……はじめて、こんなにいっぱい、話したね
lines.translated: "...It's the first time we've talked this much."

lines.content: これからはもっと、いっぱい、私たちは話せるのかな。私なんかじゃソルの代わりにはなれないだろうけど……
lines.translated: "I wonder if we'll be able to talk a lot more from now on. Someone like me probably can't take Sol's place, though..."

lines.content: 物語の話も、音楽の話も、私としていてもきっと楽しくないって、思うけど……。
lines.translated: Even if we talk about stories or music, I'm sure it won't be any fun doing it with me, I think, but...

lines.content: 今夜からは私が、ソルみたいに、あなたの友だちになれたら……
lines.translated: "Starting tonight, if I could become your friend just like Sol..."

lines.content: せめてあなたをひとりぼっちにはさせずに済む。
lines.translated: At the very least, I could keep you from being all alone.

lines.content: 私から視線を逸らすナハトに、私の気持ちは言葉以上に伝わってしまっていたように、なぜか感じられた。
lines.translated: As Nacht averted his gaze from me, I somehow felt as though my feelings had gotten through to him even more than my words had.

lines.content: ……覚悟はいいか
lines.translated: "...Are you resolved?"

lines.content: 覚悟と、勇気だ
lines.translated: "It takes resolve, and courage."

lines.content: 千和。これからお前は“夜”の中で生きていく。あいつとは離ればなれになる。その覚悟と勇気は、充分なんだな
lines.translated: "Chiwa. From now on, you will live within the 'Night.' You will be separated from him. You have enough of that resolve and courage, don't you?"

lines.content: 私は、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: はらはらとさくらが降る“夜”――これまでずっと枯れていたさくらの樹の枝には、たくさん、たくさんの花が芽吹き始めている。
lines.translated: The "Night" where cherry blossoms fluttered down--on the branches of the cherry trees that had been withered for so long, lots and lots of blossoms were beginning to bud.

lines.content: 私の命で咲いた花。
lines.translated: Flowers that bloomed from my life.

lines.content: 私の命で“夜”にも明日がやって来る。
lines.translated: Through my life, tomorrow would come even to the "Night."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 覚悟は、したけれど。
lines.translated: I had made up my mind, though.

lines.content: そのための勇気も出さなきゃって、思うけど。
lines.translated: And I think I have to muster the courage for it, too.

lines.content: それでも、やっぱり。
lines.translated: Even so, after all.

lines.content: この悲しい気持ちも、さみしい気持ちも、先輩を好きだってことの証拠なのだから、絶対になくさず持っていたいけど……。
lines.translated: Both this sad feeling and this lonely feeling are proof that I love Senpai, so I want to hold onto them and never lose them no matter what, and yet...

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 涙だ。また、涙が……。
lines.translated: Tears. Again, tears are...

lines.content: ちがう。これは、違うよ……
lines.translated: "No. This isn't what it looks like..."

lines.content: 流れる涙を必死で拭った――何が違うのかもう自分でもよくわからない。
lines.translated: I frantically wiped away the flowing tears--not even really knowing myself what I was denying anymore.

lines.content: 覚悟を決めても。勇気を出しても。全部一瞬。
lines.translated: Even if I steel my resolve. Even if I muster my courage. It all lasts for just a single moment.

lines.content: どうしよう。私、だめだな。すぐに泣き虫な私に戻ってしまう。
lines.translated: What do I do? I'm no good at all. I go right back to being my crybaby self.

lines.content: ……ごめん。ナハト
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Nacht."

lines.content: 先輩。……先輩。
lines.translated: Senpai. ...Senpai.

lines.content: やっと夢が叶ったのに。やっと先輩が、私を見てくれたのに。
lines.translated: Even though my dream finally came true. Even though Senpai finally looked at me.

lines.content: ナハトに許してもらえるのなら、私は“夜”に閉じ込められたままでもいいと、思ったばかりなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I had just thought that if Nacht would forgive me, I wouldn't mind staying trapped in the "Night" forever...

lines.content: ……ごめん
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ごめんなさい。私には新しい“夢”ができてしまったみたいだ。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. It seems I've found a new "dream."

lines.content: いつも、思い描いていた。
lines.translated: I had always pictured it.

lines.content: ソルとナハト、そして私の三人で、いつかお店を開いて生きていく……。
lines.translated: Sol, Nacht, and me--the three of us opening a shop together someday and living our lives...

lines.content: そこに、もうひとり。
lines.translated: And to that, one more person.

lines.content: 一緒にいてほしい人が増えてしまった。
lines.translated: There's one more person I want to be there with us now.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: 自分勝手な私に育ってしまって……本当に、ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I've grown into such a selfish girl... I'm truly sorry.

lines.content: ナハトが流れる私の涙に手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: Nacht reaches his hand out toward my falling tears.

lines.content: もう一度、ナハトが私に触れれば、私は“夜”に取り込まれてしまう――
lines.translated: If Nacht touches me one more time, I will be absorbed into the "Night"--

lines.content: そんな気配を感じてしまった……だから。
lines.translated: I sensed that sign... and so.

lines.content: だから私は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: And so, I closed my eyes.

lines.content: 銃声が、した。
lines.translated: A gunshot rang out.

lines.content: 本物のピストルの音なんて聞いたことはないけれど……。
lines.translated: I'd never heard the sound of a real pistol before, though...

lines.content: それでも、それは銃声なのだとなぜかわかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I somehow knew that it was a gunshot.

lines.content: たった、一発。
lines.translated: Just a single shot.

lines.content: その悲鳴にも似た音は“夜”の中に反響し続けていた。
lines.translated: That sound, almost like a scream, kept echoing throughout the "Night."

lines.content: そして、私は[・|そ][・|れ]を確かに見た。
lines.translated: And then, I saw it for sure.

lines.content: 空だ。ナハトとふたりで見上げていた空が割れ――
lines.translated: The sky. The sky Nacht and I had been looking up at together split open--

lines.content: 千和……！
lines.translated: "Chiwa...!"

lines.content: 先輩が……。
lines.translated: Senpai is...

lines.content: 千和っ、頼む、どうかこの手を取ってくれ――っ
lines.translated: "Chiwa, please, take my hand--!"

lines.content: 見上げた“夜”の空を割り、先輩が、[・|い][・|っ][・|ぱ][・|い][・|の][・|涙][・|と][・|一][・|緒][・|に]、私へ手をさしのべていた。
lines.translated: Splitting open the sky of the "Night" I looked up at, Senpai was reaching his hand out to me along with a flood of tears.

lines.content: さあ、帰ろう千和。君のことを、“夜”の底から……[さら|攫]いに来たぞ！
lines.translated: "Come on, let's go home, Chiwa. I've come... to spirit you away from the depths of the 'Night'!"

lines.content: ……千和っ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa!"

lines.content: ――[・|俺]は、空を撃ち抜いた。
lines.translated: --I shot right through the sky.

lines.content: 聞こえてるか……千和っ
lines.translated: "Can you hear me... Chiwa?!"

lines.content: ぶち抜いた[頭上|空]には、大きなおおきな穴が開き……。
lines.translated: In the sky overhead that I had blasted through, a huge, gaping hole opened up...

lines.content: その向こうは、“夜”だ。
lines.translated: Beyond it was the "Night."

lines.content: 千和と、千和を[さら|攫]った“怪物”の姿が見えていた。
lines.translated: I could see Chiwa, and the "monster" that had spirited her away.
An entrance gaping open overhead in a distorted shape.

lines.content: まるでこことは違う別の世界を覗き見る窓のよう。
lines.translated: Just like a window peeking into another world different from this one.

lines.content: そこから覗いて見える千和と“怪物”とがいる場所の光景は、地上と空とが逆転し……互いが互いの姿を見上げているような状況だ。
lines.translated: The scene of the place where Chiwa and the "monster" were, visible through that opening, had the ground and the sky inverted... creating a situation where we were both looking up at each other.

lines.content: そんな出入り口に俺は手をさしのべて――
lines.translated: I reached my hand out into that entrance--

lines.content: 頼むっ、手を、この手を取ってくれ……っ
lines.translated: "Please, my hand, take this hand...!"

lines.content: こちらからでは届かない。だから、千和。君が俺をそちらへ引き込んでくれ。
lines.translated: I can't reach from this side. So, Chiwa. Pull me over to your side.

lines.content: すぐに俺の意図を千和は察してくれる。
lines.translated: Chiwa immediately sensed what I was trying to do.

lines.content: さしのべた手を、まるでしがみつくみたいにして取り――千和が[・|そ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側][・|へ]と俺を引き込んだ。
lines.translated: Taking my outstretched hand as if clinging to it--Chiwa pulled me over to that side.

lines.content: ぐるりと上下が逆転し、俺は……気づけば千和のことを抱き留めていた。
lines.translated: Up and down spun around and inverted, and before I knew it... I was holding Chiwa in my arms.

lines.content: 先輩……、どうして
lines.translated: "Senpai... why?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ため息と共に、俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: With a sigh, I nod.

lines.content: 友だちが……
lines.translated: "A friend..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大切な、友だちだ。あの子が最後に力を貸してくれたから……だから俺は、[・|も][・|う]
lines.translated: "A precious friend. Because she lent me her power one last time... that's why I'm already..."

lines.content: ……頭上の出入り口は音もなく閉じていく。
lines.translated: The entrance overhead closes without a sound.

lines.content: その様子に、俺は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて……、
lines.translated: Watching it happen, I closed my eyes...
Ah. Just as I thought.

lines.content: 手のひらが空っぽであることに気づいていた。
lines.translated: I realized that the palm of my hand was empty.

lines.content: さっきまで確かに握りしめていたはずの“魔法”は、もうどこにもなく……。
lines.translated: The "magic" I had definitely been clutching tightly until just a moment ago was nowhere to be found anymore...

lines.content: もう二度と、俺は、あの子に会えない。
lines.translated: Never again will I be able to meet her.

lines.content: 聞き慣れた携帯の着信音が、いつまでも、ずっと……頭に響き続けていた。
lines.translated: The familiar ringtone of the cell phone kept echoing in my head... forever and ever.

lines.content: ……少し、前のこと。
lines.translated: It happened just a little while earlier.

lines.content: 千和を“夜”の中へと連れ去られ。
lines.translated: Chiwa had been taken away into the "Night."

lines.content: だからといって手段など何もなく。
lines.translated: And yet, I had no means to do anything about it.

lines.content: 頭を。
lines.translated: My head.

lines.content: 心を。
lines.translated: My heart.

lines.content: 抱えようかとしていたときだった。
lines.translated: It was right when I was about to clutch them in despair.

lines.content: ……なんだ。
lines.translated: What is that?

lines.content: 音が聞こえる。
lines.translated: I hear a sound.

lines.content: 何の音だろう。
lines.translated: What sound could it be?

lines.content: 聞き慣れた音だ。
lines.translated: It's a familiar sound.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ああ、しかし、だめだ。
lines.translated: Ah, however, it was no use.

lines.content: その正体が何であるかを、俺はすぐに察することができなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't immediately grasp what that sound actually was.

lines.content: ひどく陳腐な言い回しを選ぶなら――俺の心は、絶望に浸ってしまっていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: If I were to choose a terribly cliche phrase--my heart might have been steeped in despair.

lines.content: “夜”に這入るための手段をなくした。唐突だった。慣れ親しんだ場所から唐突に追放された。
lines.translated: I had lost my means of entering the "Night." It was sudden. I was abruptly banished from a place I had grown so familiar with.

lines.content: 千和を救いに行くための手段を――考えて、考えて、何もない。何もないのだ。
lines.translated: A way to go save Chiwa--I thought, and thought, and there was nothing. Nothing at all.

lines.content: 絶え間なくさくらの降る空を、ただ、見上げ続けていた。
lines.translated: I just kept staring up at the sky where cherry blossoms fell without end.

lines.content: そんな俺に、“目を覚ませ”とばかりに手の中の[・|そ][・|れ]は鳴り続けている。
lines.translated: And to me in that state, the thing in my hand kept ringing as if to say, "Wake up."

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 携帯だ。
lines.translated: It was the cell phone.

lines.content: そこでやっと、気づく。
lines.translated: That was when I finally realized.

lines.content: ガラクタに戻ったはずの端末が、手の中で音を立て震え続けている――
lines.translated: The device, which should have gone back to being a piece of junk, kept ringing and vibrating in my hand--

lines.content: も、もしもし……っ
lines.translated: "H-Hello...!"

lines.content: 急ぎ、通話のボタンを押した。
lines.translated: I hurriedly pressed the call button.

lines.content: 沈黙だ。いつもと変わらない反応だ。
lines.translated: Silence. The same response as always.

lines.content: しかし今はそれさえも……ごめん、クロ……それさえも今は、まどろっこしい。
lines.translated: Yet right now, even that... Sorry, Kuro... Even that feels agonizingly slow right now.

lines.content: ……クロ。聞こえてる？
lines.translated: "...Kuro. Can you hear me?"

lines.content: ため息のような沈黙が一呼吸。
lines.translated: A sigh-like silence lasted for a single breath.

lines.content: ……聞こえてる
lines.translated: "...I hear you."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 思わず、ため息。それは言いようのない安堵の証だった。
lines.translated: I let out an involuntary sigh. It was proof of my indescribable relief.

lines.content: よかった……。よかったよ、クロ。ちゃんと繋がれた。もう、どうしていいかわからなかったんだ
lines.translated: "Thank goodness... Thank goodness, Kuro. The call actually went through. I didn't know what to do anymore."

lines.content: 俺はクロに現状を伝えた。
lines.translated: I explained the current situation to Kuro.

lines.content: クロと繋がれてよかった。もう誰とも……あさひさんとも、十夜ともナナちゃんとも、会えないんじゃないかって
lines.translated: "I'm so glad I could reach you, Kuro. I thought I wouldn't be able to see anyone ever again... Not Asahi-san, or Toya, or Nana-chan."

lines.content: なあ、クロ。何か方法はないのかな。千和を助けに行きたい。もう一度“夜”に立ち入る方法は、何か……
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro. Is there any way? I want to go save Chiwa. Is there some way to enter the 'Night' one more time...?"

lines.content: よかったことは、ない
lines.translated: "There's nothing good about this."

lines.content: この電話が[・|も][・|う][・|一][・|度]繋がって……いいことなんて、全然、ひとつもないんだよ。大雅
lines.translated: "This phone connecting one more time... There's nothing good about it at all, not a single thing. Taiga."

lines.content: クロ？　何を、言ってるんだ？
lines.translated: "Kuro? What are you talking about?"

lines.content: ……この電話
lines.translated: "...This phone."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: ずっと、ずっと、繋がらないほうが、よかった……のに
lines.translated: "It would have been better if it had never, ever connected again... and yet."

lines.content: クロ……
lines.translated: "Kuro..."

lines.content: おかしい。どういうことだろう。
lines.translated: That's strange. What does she mean?

lines.content: ……ノイズだ。
lines.translated: It's static.

lines.content: 君の声がなんだか聞き取りづらいんだよ。今、君はなんて言ったんだ。とても大切なことを言おうとしているような気がするのに……。
lines.translated: For some reason, your voice is hard to make out. What did you just say? I feel like you're trying to tell me something very important, and yet...

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……きみは、今、たぶん道を間違えようとしてる。だから、この電話が……
lines.translated: "...Right now, you're probably about to take the wrong path. That's why this phone..."

lines.content: クロ。お願いだ
lines.translated: "Kuro. Please."

lines.content: もう少し大きな声で話してほしい。
lines.translated: I need you to speak a little louder.

lines.content: ノイズがひどいんだ
lines.translated: "The static is terrible."

lines.content: 聞こえないよ。何も。……何も。
lines.translated: I can't hear you. Nothing. ...Nothing at all.

lines.content: クロの声、よく聞こえない。大切なところがびりびり割れて……
lines.translated: "Kuro, I can't hear your voice very well. The important parts are crackling and breaking up..."

lines.content: また、沈黙。
lines.translated: Again, silence.

lines.content: 安堵を得られたはずの心が、再び不安に襲われるけれど……。
lines.translated: My heart, which had supposedly found relief, was once again seized by anxiety, and yet...

lines.content: ……“願い”は、決まった？
lines.translated: "...Have you decided on your 'wish'?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 不思議とその一言は、ノイズも何もなくはっきりと聞こえた。
lines.translated: Strangely enough, those words came through clearly without any static or anything.

lines.content: わたしと、大雅は、ずっと……小さな頃からふたりでずっと、大雅の“夢”と、それを叶えるための“魔法”について、話し合ってきた
lines.translated: "You and I, Taiga, have always... Ever since we were little, the two of us have always talked about your 'dream,' and the 'magic' needed to grant it."

lines.content: うなずく。深く、何度も。
lines.translated: I nod. Deeply, over and over.

lines.content: そんな姿はクロには見えないはずなのに、その意図はしっかりと伝わっているように感じられた。
lines.translated: Even though Kuro shouldn't have been able to see me doing that, I felt as if my intention had reached her clearly.

lines.content: ……大丈夫だよ。大雅
lines.translated: "...It's okay, Taiga."

lines.content: その“願い”がどんなものであっても大丈夫と、クロは囁くように言う。
lines.translated: Whatever that "wish" may be, it's okay, Kuro said in a whisper.

lines.content: ……平気。大丈夫。何も、心配しなくていい
lines.translated: "...It's fine. It's okay. You don't have to worry about anything."

lines.content: だってわたしは、大雅……きみの夢を叶えるために、そばにいた
lines.translated: "Because I, Taiga... I was by your side to make your dream come true."

lines.content: クロは繰り返し、言う――“願い”は決まったか。
lines.translated: Kuro repeated the words--have you decided on your "wish"?

lines.content: そのためにどんな“魔法”を望むのか。必要なものは、“想像”できたか。
lines.translated: What kind of "magic" do you desire for its sake? Have you been able to "imagine" what you need?

lines.content: ……大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: ……聞かせて、大雅。そのすべてを、わたしは全部、叶えてあげられるよ
lines.translated: "...Tell me, Taiga. I can grant all of it, every last bit of it for you."

lines.content: 全部……
lines.translated: "Everything..."

lines.content: そう、全部
lines.translated: "Yes, all of it."

lines.content: ……わたしは、[・|あ][・|の][・|子][・|た][・|ち]と違う。だから大雅の“魔法”にはなれない。そのための心を持たない……そんなイキモノ
lines.translated: "...I'm different from those girls. That's why I can't become your 'magic.' I don't have the heart for it... That's the kind of creature I am."

lines.content: でも、あの子たちにはできないことを……、わたしは、できる。大雅に“魔法”をあげられる。その“魔法”が、本当に必要なものなのなら……
lines.translated: "But I can do... what those girls cannot. I can give you 'magic.' If that 'magic' is something you truly need..."

lines.content: “願い”
lines.translated: A "wish."

lines.content: “魔法”
lines.translated: "Magic."

lines.content: 叶えたい“夢”とその“願い”
lines.translated: A "dream" I want to come true, and that "wish."

lines.content: いつかの俺は消えてなくなることを願ってた――“できるだけ苦しんで死ぬこと”
lines.translated: Once, I had wished to disappear and cease to exist--"to suffer as much as possible and die."

lines.content: それが“夢”で、それが“願い”だった。あるいは“希望”でさえあった。
lines.translated: That was my "dream," and that was my "wish." Or perhaps, it was even my "hope."

lines.content: いつもだ。
lines.translated: Always.

lines.content: いつも、そのための“魔法”を探してた――しかしこの俺に想像できうるそのための“魔法”は、ついに誰にも許可されることはなかった。
lines.translated: I was always searching for the "magic" to do that--however, the "magic" I could imagine for that purpose was never permitted by anyone in the end.

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”のあさひさんにも。俺の“魔法”を許可するための鍵を持つクロにも。
lines.translated: Not by Asahi-san, the "Magician of the Night." Nor by Kuro, who held the key to permitting my "magic."

lines.content: しかし今は違う。“夢”は変わった。“願い”も変わった。
lines.translated: But now, things are different. My "dream" has changed. My "wish" has changed, too.

lines.content: “希望”も未来ではなく、今、ここにこそ求めてる。
lines.translated: Even my "hope" is no longer sought in the future, but right here, right now.

lines.content: 千和……。杏藤千和。俺の大切な女の子。
lines.translated: Chiwa... Andou Chiwa. The girl who is precious to me.

lines.content: 生きたい。
lines.translated: I want to live.

lines.content: 少しでも長く、君の隣で、君の笑顔の数を数えるように……生きていきたい。
lines.translated: For even a little longer, right beside you, as if counting the number of your smiles... I want to keep living.

lines.content: そんなふうに自然と願い始めてる。
lines.translated: I've naturally begun to wish for that.

lines.content: その願いを叶えるための“魔法”とは……。
lines.translated: And as for the "magic" to grant that wish...

lines.content: いったいどういうものが相応しいのだろう――
lines.translated: Just what kind of thing would be fitting--

lines.content: そういうふうに、俺は思い始めてる。
lines.translated: That is how I've begun to think.

lines.content: ……不思議だ。クロ
lines.translated: "...It's strange, Kuro."

lines.content: 言葉にしない思いまでもが、今、君にすべて伝わってしまっているような気がするよ。
lines.translated: I feel as though even my unspoken thoughts are all being conveyed to you right now.

lines.content: なあ、クロ。
lines.translated: Hey, Kuro.

lines.content: 聞いてほしいんだ。
lines.translated: I want you to listen.

lines.content: 俺が千和へと抱いたこの気持ち。
lines.translated: These feelings I hold for Chiwa.

lines.content: その正体に名前を付けることを、未だに若干ながら躊躇してしまっている俺が、どうしてだろう、ここにいるけれど……。
lines.translated: Why is it that there's still a part of me here that hesitates, ever so slightly, to put a name to what they truly are...?

lines.content: クロ。君に、この気持ちを正直に打ち明けることに、どうしてだかさみしさにも似た“何か”を感じてしまっている俺が、いるけれど……。
lines.translated: Kuro. Why is it that there's a part of me that feels "something" akin to loneliness at honestly confessing these feelings to you...?

lines.content: ……聞いてほしい。今、俺が望んでいることは
lines.translated: "...I want you to listen. What I desire right now is..."

lines.content: これからも千和と一緒にいられること。
lines.translated: To be able to stay together with Chiwa from now on.

lines.content: 俺に与えられた残り時間、そのすべてを、千和といられるふたりの時間に使いたい。
lines.translated: I want to spend all of the remaining time given to me on time for the two of us to be together.

lines.content: そのために、今、ここで“必要”な“魔法”とは。
lines.translated: For that purpose, what is the "magic" that is "needed" right here, right now?

lines.content: ……もう一度、“夜”の世界へと立ち入ること
lines.translated: "...To enter the world of the 'Night' one more time."

lines.content: ……そして千和を助け出すこと。
lines.translated: And to rescue Chiwa.

lines.content: かつて“夜”の世界へと“怪物”たちに[さら|攫]われた女の子のことを、今度は俺が、“夜”の中から、こちら側へと[さら|攫]って……連れ出すことだ。
lines.translated: The girl who was oncespirited away into the world of the "Night" by "monsters"--this time, I will spirit her away from inside the "Night" back over to this side... and bring her out.
"Magic"...

lines.content: しかし俺たちの使えるものは[・|た][・|だ][・|そ][・|う][・|呼][・|ん][・|で][・|い][・|る]だけのもので、少し願えば何者をも可能にしてしまう“奇跡”ではない。
lines.translated: However, what we can use is something we merely call by that name, not a "miracle" that makes anything possible with just a little wish.

lines.content: [さら|攫]われた千和のことを一瞬で俺の隣に召喚させる――そんな“想像”を形にできれば、何より、最善なのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Summoning the abducted Chiwa to my side in an instant--if I could give form to such an "imagination," that would surely be for the best above all else, and yet...

lines.content: 俺には、無理だ。
lines.translated: It's impossible for me.

lines.content: かつて“夜”の中で戦った[・|特][・|別][・|な][・|少][・|女][・|た][・|ち]ならばいざ知らず……。
lines.translated: It might be a different story for those special girls who once fought within the "Night"...

lines.content: 彼女らに守られてばかりいたこの俺の脆弱なる“想像力”では、そのようなことは不可能だろう。
lines.translated: With my fragile "imagination," having done nothing but be protected by them, such a thing would be impossible.

lines.content: なぜ、不可能なのか――まず、この俺の“想像力”が邪魔をする。俺たちの使える“魔法”は“想像力”だ。
lines.translated: Why is it impossible?--First of all, my own "imagination" gets in the way. The "magic" we can use is "imagination."

lines.content: そのような都合の良い“奇跡”など存在しないと……どうしても、どうしても、捻くれきったこの俺の心が邪魔をする――
lines.translated: This thoroughly twisted heart of mine insists, no matter what, that such a convenient "miracle" doesn't exist, getting in the way--

lines.content: だから、時間の差し迫っているのだろう今だから、まずはこの俺にでも容易に“想像”できうる[魔法|もの]を選ぶ。
lines.translated: So, because time is likely running out right now, I will first choose a magic that even someone like me can easily "imagine."

lines.content: 俺は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて、思い描いてみる――この悲しみに必要な“魔法”は、きっと、こんな形をしているはずだ。
lines.translated: I close my eyelids and try to picture it--the "magic" needed for this sorrow must surely take a shape like this.

lines.content: 電話の向こうで君が、クロが、静かに[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる気配を心で感じた。
lines.translated: In my heart, I felt the sensation of you, of Kuro, quietly closing your eyelids on the other end of the phone.

lines.content: そして俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: And then, I open my eyelids.

lines.content: すると……。
lines.translated: And when I did...

lines.content: 左手が重いことに、気づく。
lines.translated: I realize that my left hand is heavy.
It's a handgun.

lines.content: そこに拳銃が握られていた。
lines.translated: A handgun was grasped in my hand.

lines.content: 手のひらに、小さな拳銃。そして、弾丸が一発。
lines.translated: In the palm of my hand, a small handgun. And a single bullet.

lines.content: ……大雅。きみが思い描いたこと、ぜんぶ、伝わってきた
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Everything you pictured came through to me."

lines.content: その“魔法”をわたしは許可する――細く静かな声がそう言った。
lines.translated: I permit that "magic"--her thin, quiet voice said so.

lines.content: ……それは、きみのことを、大雅のことを幸せにしてくれる。そのための“魔法”だと、わたしは信じた
lines.translated: "...I believed that it is the 'magic' meant to make you, to make Taiga, happy."

lines.content: ……[・|そ][・|れ]は“現実世界の壁を撃ち抜いて、強制的に夢の世界への扉を開く”。そう願ったきみの“魔法”だ
lines.translated: "...It is your 'magic,' wished for so that you might 'shoot through the wall of the real world and forcibly open a door to the world of dreams.'"

lines.content: ……弾丸は、一発。たった、一回きりの“魔法”だよ
lines.translated: "...There is one bullet. It is 'magic' for one time only."

lines.content: 俺の未来を繋ぐもの――“夢”と“希望”だなんて、そのような陳腐な言葉で飾りたくはないけれど――
lines.translated: Something that connects my future--I don't want to dress it up with such cliche words as "dreams" and "hopes," though--

lines.content: 文字通り、どうにもならない現実を前に、すがりつきたいと願った奇跡が形になったもの。
lines.translated: Literally, in the face of a hopeless reality, it was the manifestation of a miracle I wished to cling to.

lines.content: それがどうして、拳銃だなんて……。
lines.translated: Why on earth would it be a handgun...?

lines.content: そのような破壊を象徴するものの形を模しているのか。
lines.translated: Why does it imitate the shape of something that symbolizes such destruction?

lines.content: 一見、真逆に思える。救いとはまるで逆。
lines.translated: At first glance, it seems like the exact opposite. The complete opposite of salvation.

lines.content: だが俺にとってはこれ以上、しっくり来るものはない。
lines.translated: Yet to me, nothing could feel more fitting than this.

lines.content: これだ。この形だ。これこそが俺の“夢”と“希望”、そして“絶望”なるものの形なのだ――故に。それ故に、だ。これ以上のものは何もないのだ。どこにも、ないのだ。
lines.translated: This is it. This is the shape. This is the very shape of my "dreams," my "hopes," and what I call "despair"--therefore. For that very reason. There is nothing beyond this. Nowhere at all.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……その“魔法”には、大雅
lines.translated: "...On that 'magic,' Taiga..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: まだ、安全装置が働いている。それを外すには、ひとつ……決めなきゃいけないことがある
lines.translated: "The safety is still engaged. To release it, there is one thing... we have to decide."

lines.content: 代償だ、とクロは言う。
lines.translated: A price, Kuro says.

lines.content: 奇跡を味方に付けるには、いつだってそれにふさわしい何かを支払わなきゃならないように……世界は、できてる
lines.translated: "To bring a miracle to your side, you always have to pay something worthy of it... That's how the world is made."

lines.content: 物語はいつだってそういうふうにして成り立っている――
lines.translated: Stories are always built that way--

lines.content: 知ってる、大雅。この世界はね、おとぎ話でできているんだよ。それが“夜”の中での常識なんだよと、クロは言う。
lines.translated: "You know, Taiga. This world is made of fairy tales. That's just common sense inside the 'Night,'" Kuro says.

lines.content: 柔らかな声で。触れたら壊れてしまいそうな、細く、震える声で。
lines.translated: In a soft voice. In a thin, trembling voice that felt as though it might break if touched.

lines.content: きみが“夜”の外に持ち出した“魔法”。その“魔法”を使用したなら、きみは、今度こそおとぎの国からはじき出される。もう二度と君はこちら側へは関係できなくなる
lines.translated: "The 'magic' you brought outside the 'Night.' Once you use that 'magic,' you will be cast out of fairyland for good this time. You will never be able to have anything to do with this side ever again."

lines.content: ……それが、代償？
lines.translated: "...Is that the price?"

lines.content: ううん。違うよ
lines.translated: "No. That's not it."

lines.content: それは基本的なルールに過ぎないとクロは言う。
lines.translated: That is nothing more than a basic rule, Kuro says.

lines.content: ……絵本の中の世界は、空想の物語は、本来なら外の世界のきみたちに干渉できない。そんな世界の約束を、びりびりに破ってまで使うのが……“魔法”だから
lines.translated: "...A world inside a picture book, a story of fantasy, isn't normally able to interfere with all of you in the outside world. Because 'magic' is something you use... by tearing the promises of such a world to shreds."

lines.content: だから世界に弾かれてしまってもそれは仕方のないことだし、同然なことなのだとクロは続けた。
lines.translated: So even if you get rejected by the world, it can't be helped, and it's only natural, Kuro continued.

lines.content: そしてそれとはまた別に、“代償”を明確に決める必要がある。偏屈な[・|外][・|世][・|界]に奇跡の介入を認めさせるには、相応の代償がどうしても、必要。
lines.translated: And entirely separate from that, it is necessary to clearly decide upon a "price." In order to make the stubborn outside world accept the intervention of a miracle, an appropriate price is absolutely necessary.

lines.content: そのようにして“魔法”の安全装置を外したなら――そこではじめて、その奇跡は手のひらに収まる。
lines.translated: Once the safety on the "magic" is released in that way--only then will that miracle rest in the palm of my hand.

lines.content: ……さあ、大雅。一緒に……、最後に一緒に、考えよう
lines.translated: "...Come on, Taiga. Together... for the last time, let's think about it together."

lines.content: 最後に……
lines.translated: "For the last time..."

lines.content: そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: ……きみの願った願いに釣り合うだけの“代償”は、いったい、どんなものなのか。ふたりで決めよう
lines.translated: "...Just what kind of 'price' would be enough to balance out the wish you wished for? Let's decide it between the two of us."

lines.content: “代償”
lines.translated: A "price."

lines.content: 心で、つぶやく。
lines.translated: I whisper inside my heart.

lines.content: ……俺の求めた“魔法”に相応しいだけの、その効果に等価するほどの、支払いは――
lines.translated: A payment worthy of the "magic" I sought, equivalent to its effect--

lines.content: もう二度と、俺は、“夢”を見ることができなくなる
lines.translated: "Never again will I be able to see 'dreams.'"

lines.content: それでは足りない。
lines.translated: That isn't enough.

lines.content: ……俺は、今よりも更に“想像力”を大きく、広く、膨らませることができなくなる
lines.translated: "...I will no longer be able to expand my 'imagination' any larger or wider than it is now."

lines.content: それではまだ、足りない。
lines.translated: Even that still isn't enough.

lines.content: ……俺は
ああ、そうだ。[・|こ][・|れ]だ。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right. This is it.
"...I swear that I will bring Chiwa out to the outside world, even if I have to trade this life of mine for hers."

lines.content: そうだな。それくらいがちょうどいい――そう思えたから、そう、思ってしまったから、
lines.translated: That's right. Something like that is just right--because I felt that way, because I couldn't help feeling that way,

lines.content: 鋼鉄がこすり合わさるような微かな音がした。
lines.translated: there was a faint sound like steel rubbing against steel.

lines.content: ……わかった
lines.translated: "...Okay."

lines.content: 同時に、耳元から君の声。
lines.translated: At the same time, your voice by my ear.

lines.content: ……それが、その“奇跡”が、大雅。奏大雅。きみの人生最後の魔法となる
lines.translated: "...That, that 'miracle,' Taiga. Kanade Taiga. It will become the final magic of your life."

lines.content: ……これから先は、きみの人生には、都合のいい魔法が光ることはない。悲しくて。さみしくて。時にりふじん――
lines.translated: "...From here on out, no convenient magic will ever shine in your life. It will be sad. Lonely. And at times, absurd--"

lines.content: そんな残酷なおとぎ話の中を、やさしいばかりだったおとぎ話の外の世界を、きみは、生きていかなきゃいけない
lines.translated: "Inside such a cruel fairy tale, in the world outside the fairy tale that was nothing but kind, you have to go on living."

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: ……意外だった
lines.translated: "...That was unexpected."

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: ……この“代償”では、クロを納得させることはできないかなと思った。だってこの“代償”はあんまりにも自己犠牲めいているから
lines.translated: "...I wondered if I wouldn't be able to convince you with this 'price,' Kuro. Because this 'price' smacks way too much of self-sacrifice."

lines.content: それなのに許可をくれるんだな。
lines.translated: And yet you're giving me permission.

lines.content: そう言う俺に、クロは『大丈夫』と言った。
lines.translated: When I said that, Kuro told me, "It's okay."

lines.content: ……大雅がどんな“魔法”を想像しようと、大雅がどんな“代償”を選ぼうと、大丈夫だよ
lines.translated: "...No matter what kind of 'magic' you imagine, Taiga, and no matter what kind of 'price' you choose, it's okay."

lines.content: 大雅の“願い”。大雅の“夢”。それが大雅を幸せにしてくれるものなら、どんな“代償”だって……大雅の代わりに、わたしが、きっと……
lines.translated: "Your 'wish,' Taiga. Your 'dream.' If it's something that will make you happy, then no matter what the 'price' is... in your place, Taiga, I'll surely..."

lines.content: そこでクロは黙ってしまった。
lines.translated: Right there, Kuro fell silent.

lines.content: ……クロ？　ごめん。またノイズが走った。今、何を言ったのかな
lines.translated: "...Kuro? Sorry. Static cut through again. What did you just say?"

lines.content: 必死になってそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I frantically asked her that.

lines.content: とにかく、大丈夫。わたしを信じて。だけどこれだけは、覚えておいて
lines.translated: "Anyway, it's okay. Trust me. But just remember this one thing."

lines.content: ここからきみは子どもではいられない。もう誰も君を助けない。誰も、きみに手をさしのべない。それだけは、理解して
lines.translated: "From here on, you cannot remain a child. No one will save you anymore. No one will reach out their hand to you. Just understand that much."

lines.content: 大雅。その覚悟が決まったなら――さあ、引き金を引こう。今、きみの“魔法”をふたりで使おう
lines.translated: "Taiga. If you've steel yourself for that--come on, let's pull the trigger. Now, let's use your 'magic' together."

lines.content: ふたりで……
lines.translated: "Together..."

lines.content: ……考えている時間はないんだよ。大雅。きみの大切な人がピンチなんでしょう？
lines.translated: "...There's no time to think, Taiga. Someone precious to you is in trouble, right?"

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 早く……。
lines.translated: Hurry...

lines.content: 早く行かないと。
lines.translated: I have to hurry and go.

lines.content: 千和を助けに行かないと。
lines.translated: I have to go save Chiwa.

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: 躊躇っている。
lines.translated: I'm hesitating.

lines.content: どうしてもこの“魔法”の引き金を引くことを俺は難しいと感じてしまっている。
lines.translated: No matter what, I find myself feeling that pulling the trigger of this "magic" is difficult.

lines.content: 何か、俺は……
lines.translated: "Something, I'm..."

lines.content: とても、とても、大切なものを……。
lines.translated: Something very, very precious...

lines.content: この命をかけてでも果たさなければならない何かを、忘れてしまっているのではないか。
lines.translated: Haven't I forgotten something that I must fulfill even at the cost of this life?

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: 何かを俺は忘れてる。忘れていたことさえ思い出せないほど――決定的に。
lines.translated: I'm forgetting something. To the point where I can't even remember that I've forgotten it--decisively so.

lines.content: 思い出せない。
lines.translated: I can't remember.

lines.content: なぜだ。
lines.translated: Why did it happen?

lines.content: なぜ……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: 俺はいつも、いつでも、憧れの誰かの所在を、探し続けていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I always, at all times, should have been searching for the whereabouts of someone I longed for...

lines.content: 君はずっと静かに俺の覚悟が整うのを待っている。
lines.translated: You are quietly waiting all the while for my resolve to settle.

lines.content: ……だから、俺は。
lines.translated: And so, I...

lines.content: 俺は……
この正体不明の迷いを、別の迷いで上書きしてしまう。[・|こ][・|れ]は、思い出してはいけないものなのだと、そう誰かに言われているような気がした。
lines.translated: overwrite this unidentified hesitation with a different hesitation. I felt as though someone were telling me that this is something I must not remember.

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: なあ、クロ
lines.translated: "Hey, Kuro."

lines.content: ……なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……もう、会えないのかな
lines.translated: "...Will we never be able to meet again?"

lines.content: 指先が、震えている。
lines.translated: My fingertips are trembling.

lines.content: この“魔法”を使えば、君とは、もう……君や、あさひさんや十夜、ナナちゃんとは、もう二度と……
lines.translated: "If I use this 'magic,' with you, I'll never... With you, Asahi-san, Toya, and Nana-chan, I'll never again..."

lines.content: 沈黙があった。
lines.translated: Silence fell.

lines.content: その静けさは言葉以上に肯定の意思表示であるように思えたけれど、
lines.translated: That silence seemed to be an affirmation more than words ever could, and yet,

lines.content: ……ううん。違う
lines.translated: "...No. That's not true."

lines.content: クロは、言う。
lines.translated: Kuro says.

lines.content: さよならなんて、ないよ。どこにもない
lines.translated: "There's no such thing as goodbye. Nowhere at all."

lines.content: いつでも大雅に、わたしは、わたしたちは、会いに行ける。またこうしてお話だって、できるよ。だから……
lines.translated: "Anytime at all, I, all of us, can go to see you, Taiga. We can even talk like this again. So..."

lines.content: だから安心して引き金を引いてほしいと、クロの声が耳元を撫でている。
lines.translated: So she wants me to pull the trigger with peace of mind; Kuro's voice caresses my ear.

lines.content: うそだ。
lines.translated: That's a lie.

lines.content: そう、言いたかった。
lines.translated: That's what she wanted to say.

lines.content: 君の言葉の中にうそがあることくらい、俺にわからないわけがない。
lines.translated: There's no way I wouldn't realize that there's a lie within your words.

lines.content: 俺たちはずっと、ずっと一緒に生きてきた。ずっとふたりで色々なことを考えてきた。大切な友だちだ。大切な、家族だ。
lines.translated: We've lived together for so, so long. The two of us have always thought about all sorts of things together. You're a precious friend. Precious family.

lines.content: それなのに、そんな君とのお別れが、こんな形だなんて……。
lines.translated: And yet, for my farewell with you to take a shape like this...

lines.content: こんなうそを、互いに、気づかないふりまでしないきゃならないだなんて……。
lines.translated: For us to even have to pretend not to notice such a lie to each other...

lines.content: 拳銃だ。
lines.translated: It's a handgun.

lines.content: 手のひらの“魔法”を、俺はただ静かに見つめる――だめだ。だめだ。考えている暇はない。
lines.translated: I simply stare quietly at the "magic" in the palm of my hand--no good. No good. There's no time to think.

lines.content: 一刻を争う。こうしている間にも、見上げたさくらの花はそのつぼみをいくつも、いくつも、増やしていっているのに……。
lines.translated: Every second counts. Even while I'm doing this, the cherry blossoms I look up at are multiplying their buds by the dozens, and yet...

lines.content: ……う、うううっ
lines.translated: "...Ugh, ughh."

lines.content: どうしてだ。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ……涙が。
lines.translated: Tears.

lines.content: 涙が、溢れる。
lines.translated: Tears overflow.

lines.content: どうして……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: 嫌だよ、クロ。
lines.translated: I don't want this, Kuro.

lines.content: 今、俺が想像している未来に……。
lines.translated: In the future I'm imagining right now...

lines.content: 千和と、そしてみんなと笑い合えているその未来の中に、クロ……、君の姿だけが、やっぱり、どこにも……。
lines.translated: Inside that future where I'm smiling together with Chiwa and everyone else, Kuro... your figure alone is, after all, nowhere to be...

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: 声がする。
lines.translated: Her voice rang out.

lines.content: ……どうして、泣くの
lines.translated: "...Why are you crying?"

lines.content: まるでこちらの姿が見えてるみたいにクロは言う。
lines.translated: Kuro speaks as if she can see me right here.

lines.content: ……笑ってよ、大雅
lines.translated: "...Smile, Taiga."

lines.content: ……わたしはね、うれしいんだよ。すごく
lines.translated: "...You know, I'm happy. Really happy."

lines.content: うれしい……？
lines.translated: Happy...?

lines.content: ……どう、して？
……だって
lines.translated: "...Well, that's because..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: だってわたし……おばかだけど、何の役にも、立てない子だったけど……
lines.translated: "Because I... even though I'm silly, and I was a girl who couldn't be of any use at all..."

lines.content: ……大雅。やっとわたし、大雅の役に、立てるかな
lines.translated: "...Taiga. I wonder if I can finally be of use to you, Taiga."

lines.content: そう思うとうれしいんだとクロは言う。
lines.translated: Thinking that makes her happy, Kuro says.

lines.content: ……だからお願い。大雅。泣かないでよ……大雅
lines.translated: "...So please. Taiga. Don't cry... Taiga."

lines.content: ……何で
歯を、食いしばる。
lines.translated: I gritted my teeth.

lines.content: ……何で。そんなこと言うんだよクロ
lines.translated: "...Why would you say something like that, Kuro?"

lines.content: そばにいてくれるだけで安心だった。時どき笑いかけてくれるだけで、手を繋いでくれるだけで、幸せだった。
lines.translated: Just having you by my side gave me peace of mind. Just having you smile at me from time to time, just holding hands with you, made me happy.

lines.content: 困ったとき。さみしいとき。……悲しいとき。君がいつもそばで話を聞いてくれた。人見知りで、口べたな君が、一生懸命、話しかけてくれた。俺が眠れるまで、ずっと、ずっと……
lines.translated: "When I was troubled. When I was lonely. ...When I was sad. You were always by my side, listening to me. Even though you're shy and bad with words, you tried your hardest to talk to me. Until I could fall asleep, the whole time, always..."

lines.content: それなのに、役に立たないだなんて……
lines.translated: "And yet, to say you're of no use..."

lines.content: そんなこと、言わないでくれよ。お願いだから。
lines.translated: Don't say things like that. Please, I'm begging you.

lines.content: ノイズが一層濃くなった。
lines.translated: The static grew even thicker.

lines.content: ……さあ。引き金を引こう。一緒に引こう
lines.translated: "...Come on. Let's pull the trigger. Let's pull it together."

lines.content: それはたぶん、今まで聞いた中で一番やさしい君の声だった。
lines.translated: That was probably the gentlest your voice had ever sounded.

lines.content: ……わたしはね、きみの未来がわかるんだよ。大雅
lines.translated: "...You know, I can see your future, Taiga."

lines.content: いつまでもそこにあってほしいと願うもののひとつが微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: One of the things I wished would remain there forever was smiling.

lines.content: その“魔法”はきっと、きみの未来に幸せをくれるはず。わたしはそう信じてる
lines.translated: "That 'magic' will surely bring happiness to your future. That's what I believe."

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は、拳銃に弾丸を込めた。
lines.translated: I loaded the bullet into the handgun.

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: そしてその銃口を、空に合わせた。
lines.translated: And then I aimed the muzzle toward the sky.

lines.content: ……それで、いいんだよ
lines.translated: "...That's right. That's good."

lines.content: 考えている暇はもうない。きっと、ない。躊躇っている暇もだ。だから、俺は……、
lines.translated: There's no time left to think. Surely none at all. Nor is there any time to hesitate. And so, I...

lines.content: ……クロ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……クロっ
lines.translated: "...Kuro."

lines.content: ……うん。なに、大雅
lines.translated: "...Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: 俺、君のことが……好きだった
lines.translated: "I... loved you."

lines.content: 大切な、大切な、誰よりも大切な……大好きな………友だち、だった
lines.translated: "You were a precious, precious, more precious than anyone... a beloved... friend."

lines.content: ……うん。知ってるよ。ちゃんと、わかってる
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I know. I understand completely."

lines.content: 俺は、撃鉄を、引き起こし……、
lines.translated: I pulled back the hammer...

lines.content: 大雅。ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Taiga. Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ……わたしも、同じ
lines.translated: "...It's the same for me."

lines.content: ……わたしはきみが、大好きだったよ
lines.translated: "...I loved you so much."

lines.content: 俺は、指先に、力を込めて、
lines.translated: I put strength into my fingertip,

lines.content: ……忘れない。わたしは、大雅の、きみの、一番近くにいられた友だちだった
lines.translated: "...I won't forget. I was the friend who got to be the closest to Taiga, to you."

lines.content: ……それだけで、わたし、この世界に産まれた意味がきっとあったよ
lines.translated: "...Just from that alone, there was surely meaning in my being born into this world."

lines.content: 唇を、噛みしめて、
lines.translated: Biting my lip,

lines.content: ……さよなら
lines.translated: "...Goodbye."

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて、
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids,

lines.content: ……さよなら、クロ
lines.translated: "...Goodbye, Kuro."

lines.content: 引き金を、引いた。
lines.translated: And pulled the trigger.

lines.content: 俺の、一番大切で、一番大好きだった……俺の、友だち
lines.translated: "My most precious, my most beloved... my friend."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: たった一発の銃声が、ノイズが、君の声を飲み込んで……、
lines.translated: A single gunshot, the static, swallowed up your voice...

lines.content: ……さよなら。バイバイ。幸せにね
lines.translated: "...Goodbye. Bye-bye. Be happy, okay?"

lines.content: きみのこれからを、ずっと……ずっとここから、応援してるよ
lines.translated: "I'll be cheering for your future, forever... forever, from right here."

lines.content: 電話が、途切れた。
lines.translated: The call cut out.

lines.content: 空がひび割れ、その破片がばらばらと降り注ぎ――俺は、俺は、どうしても溢れる涙と一緒に、口を開けた頭上の“夜”の中へと、手をさしのべた。
lines.translated: The sky cracked, its fragments raining down in pieces--and along with the tears that just wouldn't stop overflowing, I, I reached my hand out into the gaping "Night" overhead.

lines.content: ……返してくれ
lines.translated: "...Give her back."

lines.content: ふらりと、俺は立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Unsteadily, I stood up.

lines.content: 今夜、あまりにも“さよなら”が多すぎた。だから、もう、
lines.translated: Tonight, there had been far too many "goodbyes." So anymore...

lines.content: ……もう、これ以上、大切なものを失いたくない。何も。何ひとつだ
lines.translated: "...I don't want to lose anything precious anymore. Nothing. Not a single thing."

lines.content: 向かい合う“怪物”は何も言わない。ただ、繰り返し吐き出す白い煙を“夜”の空気に混ぜ合わせていた。
lines.translated: The "monster" facing me said nothing. He simply mixed the white smoke he repeatedly exhaled into the air of the "Night."

lines.content: 一方的なことを言うようで、身勝手なことを言うようで、申し訳ないですけど……千和だけは必ずだ。必ず、返してもらう
lines.translated: "I'm sorry if I sound one-sided, if I sound selfish, but... Chiwa is the one exception. No matter what, I'm taking her back."

lines.content: 気づけば俺は目の前の“怪物”に鋭い視線を投げかけてしまっていた――
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was casting a sharp glare at the "monster" in front of me--

lines.content: このひとが俺のすべてを奪った。そんなふうに、もしかしたら心のどこかで思ってしまっていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: This person stole everything from me. Maybe, somewhere in my heart, I had ended up thinking that way.

lines.content: そんな俺に、いつまでも子どもな俺に、いいや、あまりにも当たり前な反応を示すこの俺に、“怪物”は深いため息をつく。
lines.translated: At me being like that, at me forever being a child--no, at me showing an all too natural reaction, the "monster" let out a deep sigh.

lines.content: ……なあ、少年。外の世界のどこに幸せがある
lines.translated: "...Hey, boy. Where in the outside world is there happiness?"

lines.content: “怪物”は、言った。
lines.translated: The "monster" spoke.

lines.content: ……千和は、“夜”の中で暮らしていたほうが幸せだ。そうは思わないか？
lines.translated: "...Chiwa would be happier living inside the 'Night.' Don't you think so?"

lines.content: かもしれないし。そうじゃないかもしれない。でもそれを決めるのは俺でもあなたでもないはずだ
lines.translated: "Maybe so. Or maybe not. But it shouldn't be up to me or you to decide that."

lines.content: わ、私は……
……ああ、そうだな。その通りだ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right. That's how it is."

lines.content: “怪物”は首を振る。千和の声を遮断するように。そして、言う。
lines.translated: The "monster" shook his head, as if to cut off Chiwa's voice. And then, he spoke.

lines.content: お前たち人間には、不思議なことだが持って生まれた特性のようなものがあり、どうしたって[・|そ][・|れ]からは逃れられない。お前たちの命とはそういうふうにできてしまっているんだ
lines.translated: "Strange as it may be, you humans have something like an innate trait you're born with, and no matter what you do, you cannot escape from *that*. That is simply how your lives are made."

lines.content: 杏藤千和はいつもさみしい状況下に閉じ込められる。それが杏藤千和の[命|人生]に込められた特性だ。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa is always trapped in lonely situations. That is the trait embedded into Andou Chiwa's life.

lines.content: 運命だとか宿命だとか。お前たちは[・|そ][・|れ]のことをそう呼ぶのだろうが……
lines.translated: "Fate or destiny. You lot probably call *that* by such names, though..."

lines.content: ……外の世界を見てみろ
lines.translated: "...Take a look at the outside world."

lines.content: 千和のことをまともにあつかう人間などひとりもいなかった。千和を生け贄にしようだとか。その命を代償にして、自分たちは永遠を得ようだとか……
lines.translated: "There wasn't a single human who treated Chiwa properly. Talking of making Chiwa a sacrifice. Using her life as a price so they themselves could obtain eternity..."

lines.content: 奴らは夢見ることに忙しく、千和のことをなんとも思っていなかった
lines.translated: "Those bastards were too busy dreaming to think anything of Chiwa at all."

lines.content: しかもそれは、こともあろうか千和のことを最も愛さなければならない――そんな“役割”を持つはずの両親だ
lines.translated: "And what's more, of all people, those were the parents meant to hold the 'role' of loving Chiwa the most."

lines.content: こんなことがあっていいのかとナハトは言う――おとぎ話の世界ではそんな残酷なことなどそうそう起きない。それなのに……。
lines.translated: How could something like this be allowed to happen, Nacht said--in a fairytale world, such cruel things don't happen very often. And yet...

lines.content: 外の世界ではそんな程度の残酷さは日常茶飯事だ
lines.translated: "In the outside world, that degree of cruelty is an everyday occurrence."

lines.content: それなのに、なぜ、そんな奴らがごろごろと溢れるような場所でお前たちは生きたがる。[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|は][・|な][・|い][・|場][・|所]がここにあるのに
lines.translated: "And yet, why do you lot want to live in a place overflowing with bastards like that, when *a place that isn't like that* is right here?"

lines.content: なあ、少年。教えてくれないかと“怪物”は言う。
lines.translated: Hey, boy. Won't you tell me, the "monster" said.

lines.content: 外にどんな“宝物”があるというんだ。……そんな残酷めいた世界に、千和をみすみす放り出すような真似をして……そうすることにいったいどれだけの価値があるというんだ
lines.translated: "What kind of 'treasure' could possibly be out there? ...To stand by and throw Chiwa out into such a cruel-looking world... just how much value could there possibly be in doing that?"

lines.content: 宝物……
lines.translated: "Treasure..."

lines.content: そうつぶやき、俺は首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Muttering that, I tilted my head.

lines.content: 確かに一度は……ああ、認めよう……一度くらいは、千和と[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]と暮らすことに楽しさのようなものを覚えてことはあっただろうと思う。それは確かに認めるよ
lines.translated: "Certainly, once... yes, I'll admit it... I think there was probably at least one time when I felt something akin to enjoyment in living with Chiwa and *that guy*. I will certainly admit that."

lines.content: だが、それだけだ。それだけなんだよと“怪物”は真っ赤な目を何度か瞬かせた。
lines.translated: However, that is all. That is all it was, said the "monster," blinking his crimson eyes several times.

lines.content: 俺は、俺の目的は、いつでも単純だ。お前たち人間みたいに心は複雑になれない――故に。“役割”を果たしたい。俺の中にあるものはたったそれだけ。それだけなんだ
lines.translated: "I, my purpose, is always simple. My heart cannot become complicated like you humans--therefore, I want to fulfill my 'role.' That is the only thing inside of me. That is all it is."

lines.content: ただ……、と“怪物”は付け加える。
lines.translated: It's just... the "monster" added.

lines.content: ただ、千和が暮らすべき世界は外ではなくこちらなのではないか。千和を“夜”の中から[さら|攫]おうとしているお前にはそう問いかけずにはいられない――それだけのことに過ぎない
lines.translated: "It's just, isn't the world Chiwa should live in this one, rather than the outside? To you, who is trying to snatch Chiwa away from the 'Night,' I cannot help but ask that--it is nothing more than that."
"...You're the same as *that guy*."

lines.content: 千和がソルと名付けた“怪物”だ。お前はあいつと同じように、千和を外の世界に連れ出そうとする。その真意こそ、俺にはまるで理解できない
lines.translated: "The 'monster' Chiwa named Sol. Just like him, you try to take Chiwa out into the outside world. That true intention is the very thing I cannot understand at all."

lines.content: だから繰り返し問うのだとナハトは言う。
lines.translated: That is why he asks repeatedly, Nacht said.

lines.content: ……少年、お前は、“夢”も“希望”もない残酷めいた外の世界で、千和を……大切な女の子のことを、幸せにできるのか？
lines.translated: "...Boy, in that cruel-looking outside world without 'dreams' or 'hope,' can you make Chiwa... can you make your precious girl happy?"

lines.content: ……きっと千和はまたいつか[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|状][・|況]に追い込まれる。そういう運命を持った命だろうからだ
lines.translated: "...Surely, someday, Chiwa will be cornered into *that kind of situation* again. Because hers is likely a life that holds such a fate."

lines.content: もしもまた千和の人生に残酷なお話が訪れたなら――少年。お前だぞ？　お前ごときが、それを止められるのか。運命に打ち勝てるのか？
lines.translated: "If a cruel story should visit Chiwa's life once more--boy. We're talking about you, here. Can someone like you stop it? Can you overcome fate?"

lines.content: まさか……そのための“魔法”でも知っているとでもいうのか？
lines.translated: "Don't tell me... are you saying you know some 'magic' for that?"

lines.content: 俺は“怪物”を見つめている目を細くする――そんな都合のいい“魔法”はもうない。もう、どこにもないんだ。ただ……。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes as I stared at the "monster"--there is no such convenient "magic" anymore. It's not anywhere anymore. It's just...

lines.content: 宝物、とあなたは言いましたね
lines.translated: "You said 'treasure,' didn't you?"

lines.content: 外の世界のどこに、俺たちがわざわざそこを“生きたい”と願うような“宝物”があるのかと……
lines.translated: "Asking where in the outside world there is a 'treasure' that would make us go out of our way to wish to 'live' there..."

lines.content: 思い起こせば、何もない。
lines.translated: Thinking back on it, there is nothing.

lines.content: 外の世界はただただ残酷。そう言わざるを得ない。そう答えるほかの言葉を持たない。
lines.translated: The outside world is simply, purely cruel. I have no choice but to say so. I have no other words to answer with.

lines.content: なぜなら俺も、常々それを不思議に思っていたからだ。
lines.translated: Because I, too, had always wondered about that.

lines.content: ……あなた達“夜”の住人は、“怪物”であれ、“魔法使い”であれ……俺の大切だった友人であれ……誰もがみんな、この世界をおとぎ話とたとえたがるけれど
lines.translated: "...All of you residents of the 'Night,' whether 'monsters,' or 'magicians'... or my precious friend... every single one of you likes to compare this world to a fairytale, though."

lines.content: あえてその流れに乗るのなら……。
lines.translated: If I were to dare go along with that flow...

lines.content: いつも、不思議に思ってた
lines.translated: "I always wondered about it."

lines.content: ……あさひさんの書斎でいくつもの物語に触れる度、[・|そ][・|の][・|不][・|思][・|議]はどんどんと膨らんでいきました
lines.translated: "...Every time I came into contact with the many stories in Asahi-san's study, *that wonder* swelled bigger and bigger."

lines.content: おとぎ話の主人公たちは、どうしていつも冒険に旅立った先の特別な世界から、元の何でもないふつうの世界に戻りたがるんだろうって
lines.translated: "Why is it that the protagonists of fairytales always want to return from the special world they set off on an adventure to, back to their original, unremarkable, ordinary world?"

lines.content: ……ごく平凡だった主人公も、その特別な世界の中でなら、特別なヒーローになれるのに
lines.translated: "...Even a completely ordinary protagonist can become a special hero if they're inside that special world."

lines.content: それなのに……
lines.translated: "And yet..."

lines.content: 特別な世界で得られた宝物をわざわざ手放してまで、元の世界に戻ろうとする場合まである。理解ができなかった。どこか不満にさえ思ってた。だけど……
lines.translated: "There are even cases where they go out of their way to let go of the treasures they obtained in the special world just to try and return to their original world. I couldn't understand it. Part of me even felt dissatisfied with it. But..."

lines.content: 今、主人公たちの気持ちが理解できる――
lines.translated: Now, I can understand how those protagonists feel--

lines.content: と、そう言ってしまえば多少なりとも格好は付くのだろうが。やっぱり、わからないな。
lines.translated: Or so it might look somewhat cool if I said that, I suppose. But in the end, I don't really know.

lines.content: ……あなたの言うとおりだ。きっと元の世界より“夜”の中のほうが快適だ。もし悲しいことはあっても、俺たちの生きている世界よりはずっとましだろうと想像できる
lines.translated: "...It's just as you say. Surely it's more comfortable inside the 'Night' than in our original world. Even if sad things happen, I can imagine it would be much better than the world we live in."

lines.content: なぜならあなた達はやさしすぎるから。やさしいモノとしか、俺は、触れあってこなかったから――
lines.translated: Because all of you are too kind. Because I have only ever come into contact with kind things--

lines.content: そんな“夜”に慣れすぎてしまうと、とてもじゃないが外で暮らせなくなってしまう
lines.translated: "If I get too used to a 'Night' like that, there's no way I'd be able to live outside anymore."

lines.content: ……ならば尚更だ。尚更ここで暮らしていけばいいだけだろう
lines.translated: "...Then all the more reason. All the more reason you should just keep living here, isn't it?"

lines.content: そう、ですね……でも
lines.translated: "That's... true. But..."

lines.content: 不思議だ。
lines.translated: How strange.

lines.content: ……帰りたいと願ってしまう。こんなにも、外の世界が大切だと――
lines.translated: "...I still end up wishing to go home. That the outside world is this precious--"

lines.content: 愛しいとさえ、俺は……、
lines.translated: Even beloved, I...

lines.content: ――俺は、思ってしまうんです
lines.translated: "--I end up thinking that way."

lines.content: なぜだろう。わからない。どんなに不思議に思われても俺自身理解できない。
lines.translated: Why is that? I don't know. No matter how strange anyone finds it, I can't understand it myself.

lines.content: ハル。姫織。智仁。みんなが、いるから？
lines.translated: Haru. Himeori. Tomohito. Is it because everyone is there?

lines.content: いや、それだけじゃない。
lines.translated: No, that's not all.

lines.content: 大切なひとは“夜”の中にも、“夜”の中にこそ、たくさんいてくれた。
lines.translated: There were plenty of precious people inside the "Night" too--no, especially inside the "Night."

lines.content: それなのにこんなにも帰りたいと願うのは――
lines.translated: And yet, the reason I wish so badly to return is--

lines.content: 千和と一緒に、手を取り合って簡単じゃない外の世界を生きていくのは、きっと……楽しいばかりじゃない何かが得られるんじゃないかと、期待してしまうから
lines.translated: "Because living in the unforgiving outside world together with Chiwa, hand in hand... I end up hoping that we might obtain something that isn't just fun."

lines.content: ……何か、とは
lines.translated: "...And what is that 'something'?"

lines.content: ……永遠に大人になれないこの世界にいても得られないだろう困難ばかりが、きっと、得られる
lines.translated: "...Nothing but the hardships we could never gain in this world where we can never become adults--that's what we'll surely obtain."

lines.content: ……そんなものを得ていったいどうしようと言うんだ
lines.translated: "...And what on earth do you intend to do after obtaining something like that?"

lines.content: さあ。どうしようと思っているのか……俺自身もきっとあまりよくわかっていないです
lines.translated: "Who knows. What I intend to do... I'm sure even I don't really understand it all that well myself."

lines.content: なぜなら俺はまだまだ子どもだからと、苦笑いを浮かべてしまう。
lines.translated: Because I'm still just a kid, I thought, a wry smile rising to my face.

lines.content: 大切な人と。……千和と。暗闇の先にあるかもしれない眩しい光景を一緒に見てみたい。千和とふたりだと[・|そ][・|れ]はどんな景色をしているのか。俺は、知りたいんです
lines.translated: "With someone precious to me. ...With Chiwa. I want us to see the dazzling sight that might lie beyond the darkness together. What kind of scenery *that* will be when it's the two of us. I want to know."

lines.content: だから俺は、千和と帰りたいと願う……のかもしれないです
lines.translated: "Maybe... that's why I wish to go home with Chiwa."

lines.content: ナハトはたばこの火を、手のひらで握りつぶすようにしてもみ消し、『話にならない』と吐き捨てた。
lines.translated: Nacht crushed the lit end of his cigarette in the palm of his hand, snuffing it out, and spat, "Out of the question."

lines.content: ……困難の先にはまた新しい困難しかない
lines.translated: "...Beyond hardship lies nothing more than new hardship."

lines.content: ひとつ難しいことを乗り越えたなら、それを見ていた意地の悪い誰かが、“なるほどお前はこの程度の困難ならクリアできるわけか。
lines.translated: Once you overcome one difficult thing, someone malicious watching over it says, "I see, so you can clear a hardship of this level, can you?

lines.content: ならばもう少しだけ大きな苦労にも耐えて見せろよ”と……。
lines.translated: Then show me you can endure a slightly greater struggle, too..."

lines.content: そうしてお前たちは、いつも同じようなことをぐるぐるぐると……まるで犬のように繰り返すばかりだ
lines.translated: "And so all of you simply repeat the same things over and over, round and round... just like dogs."

lines.content: ……そう、ですね。実のところ俺もそう思っています
lines.translated: "...That's... true. Actually, I think so too."

lines.content: 苦笑いのまま俺は首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Keeping my wry smile, I tilted my head.

lines.content: 困難や苦労の先に光り輝くものがあるはずだ、なんて……そんなのはまさに“夢”ですよね
lines.translated: "Thinking there must be something shining brightly beyond hardships and struggles... something like that truly is a 'dream,' isn't it?"

lines.content: 苦労することは尊いだなんてそう嘯くのは、いつだって誰だって、苦労をさせたい人間の言い分でしかないっていうのも……また、よく見る言葉ですしね
lines.translated: "And the idea that those who boast about how noble it is to struggle are always, without exception, just people making excuses to force others to struggle... well, that's another phrase you see all the time."

lines.content: でも……、と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Even so..." I said.

lines.content: それでも。[・|外]でなら、いつかは全部必ず終わるんです――それはたぶん“希望”でもあるんですよ
lines.translated: "Even so. In the *outside* world, everything will definitely come to an end someday--and that is probably a kind of 'hope,' too."

lines.content: 苦しいことも。さみしいことも。楽しいことも……。いつかは終わると思えば耐えられることも多いはずです
lines.translated: "Painful things. Lonely things. Fun things... There must be plenty of things you can endure if you believe they'll end someday."

lines.content: ……何が、言いたい？
lines.translated: "...What are you trying to say?"

lines.content: 想像するに――永遠はつらいんじゃないかって話です
lines.translated: "Just that, as I imagine it--eternity must be painful."

lines.content: 生き続けるにせよ、楽しみ続けるにせよ。……悲しみ続けることにせよ
lines.translated: "Whether it's continuing to live, or continuing to have fun. ...Or continuing to grieve."

lines.content: 永遠に終わりの来ない世界で、“夜”の中で生きるのは、きっと外とは違うつらさが山のようにあるはずだ
lines.translated: "Living in a world that never ends, living inside the 'Night,' must surely come with a mountain of pain different from the outside."

lines.content: すべては俺の想像でしかないですけれどと、俺は付け加える。
lines.translated: "Though all of this is nothing more than my own imagination," I added.

lines.content: ……永遠を生きるってことは、ただそれだけで“さよなら”がどんどんと底なしに増えていくってことでもあるんじゃないでしょうか
lines.translated: "...Doesn't living for eternity mean that, by that very fact alone, the number of 'goodbyes' will just keep growing endlessly?"

lines.content: そういう物語はよく見かけます。よく見かけすぎて食傷気味なくらいだ。だからといって、よくある話だからといって、そんなの俺は……
lines.translated: "You see stories like that all the time. So often that I'm practically sick of them. Even so, just because it's a common story doesn't mean that I..."

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 俺は、とてもじゃないけど耐えられない
lines.translated: "There's no way I could ever endure something like that."

lines.content: ずきり、と。
lines.translated: *Throb.*

lines.content: 自分の言葉に、こんなに胸が痛むのは……。
lines.translated: The reason my chest hurt so much at my own words was...

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。間違いなく、たった今訪れたばかりの“さよなら”について、考えてしまったからだ。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right. Without a doubt, it was because I had ended up thinking about the "goodbye" that had just arrived moments ago.

lines.content: クロ……。
lines.translated: Kuro...

lines.content: どうしてかな。
lines.translated: How come?

lines.content: もう、君の顔も、思い出しづらくなってしまっているけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though it's already become hard to remember your face...

lines.content: だめだな、俺。
lines.translated: I'm no good at all, am I?

lines.content: 君がいないと……。
lines.translated: Without you here...

lines.content: また、涙がこぼれそうになる。
lines.translated: Tears threatened to spill over again.

lines.content: それを必死に耐えて。耐えて。
lines.translated: I desperately held them back. Held them back.

lines.content: ……前だ。
lines.translated: Look forward.

lines.content: 前だけを見て、進まなければ。
lines.translated: I have to look only forward, and keep moving.

lines.content: ……確かに、そうかもしれない。そういう場合もあるのかもしれない
lines.translated: "...Certainly, that might be so. There may be cases like that."

lines.content: ナハトは、言う。ため息をつくように。
lines.translated: Nacht spoke, almost as if letting out a sigh.

lines.content: ……だがお前もここで暮らせば、少なくとも、千和となら一緒に……ずっと一緒にいられるぞ
lines.translated: "...However, if you live here as well, at the very least, you can be with Chiwa... You can be together forever."

lines.content: よく言うじゃないか。好き合ったお前たち人間は、いつも目を見つめ合い……ずっと一緒にいたいねと
lines.translated: "Don't you humans who have fallen in love say it all the time? Gazing into each other's eyes... saying you want to be together forever."

lines.content: その“夢”はここでこそ叶えられるぞとナハトは言った。
lines.translated: "That 'dream' can be granted right here," Nacht said.

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: それは、確かに、少し魅力的な想像だなあとは思います
lines.translated: "I do think that's a somewhat appealing thought, certainly."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: それならどうして、これまであなたが[さら|攫]って来た子たちはただのひとりも、“夜”の中に残っていないんですか
lines.translated: "Then why is it that not a single one of the children you've spirited away up until now remains inside the 'Night'?"

lines.content: ……誰もがみんな、ここを去って行き……残されたのはあなたひとりだ
lines.translated: "...Every last one of them left this place... leaving only you behind."

lines.content: ここは、この“夜”の世界は、俺たち人間には生きづらい何かがあるからこそ、誰もがみんな、ここを去って行くんじゃないですか
lines.translated: "Isn't it because this place, this world of the 'Night,' has something that makes it hard for us humans to live in, that everyone ends up leaving it behind?"

lines.content: ……根拠はなくともそういうふうに想像してしまいます
lines.translated: "...Even without any basis for it, I can't help imagining it that way."

lines.content: ……それに、人間は欲張りなんですよ。“さよなら”したくないほど大切なものは、千和ひとりきりじゃないから
lines.translated: "...Besides, humans are greedy. Because Chiwa isn't the only one precious enough to me that I don't want to say 'goodbye.'"

lines.content: ……俺は、空を見上げる。長い間、枯れてしまっていたはずのさくらの枝を。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky. At the branches of the cherry tree that had been withered for so long.

lines.content: 千和の命を返してもらいます。そして、特別じゃない世界にふたりで帰ります
lines.translated: "I'm going to have you give Chiwa's life back. And the two of us are going to return to that unremarkable world."

lines.content: 十年前から続いてる俺たちの特別な冒険は、今夜で、終わりです――[・|こ][・|こ]へはもう二度と戻ってくることはない
lines.translated: "Our special adventure that has continued since ten years ago ends tonight--we will never come back *here* again."

lines.content: そして千和と一緒に、ふたりで、永遠じゃない外の世界で、一瞬一瞬を大切に生きていきたい。その夢を叶えます。叶えさせて、ください
lines.translated: "And together with Chiwa, just the two of us, I want to live cherishing every single moment in the outside world that isn't eternal. I will make that dream come true. So please, let me make it come true."

lines.content: 先輩……
lines.translated: "Senpai..."

lines.content: ぎゅっと、千和が俺の背中を握った。
lines.translated: Chiwa squeezed the back of my shirt tightly.

lines.content: ……ふん
lines.translated: "...Hmph."

lines.content: 俺の青臭いばかりの言葉はきっと、誰が聞いても反吐がでるほど薄っぺらいものなのだろうと思う。だからナハトも鼻で笑うように、言うのだ。
lines.translated: I'm sure my utterly naive words must sound sickeningly shallow to anyone listening. That was why Nacht snorted derisively as he spoke.

lines.content: そんな言葉で、千和の命は奪わず返そうと俺が言うとでも思ったのか。そんな程度で、この俺が“役割”を放棄するほど……深くお前に説得させられるとでも期待したのか
lines.translated: "Did you really think I would say I'll return Chiwa's life instead of taking it because of words like that? Did you honestly expect that I would be so deeply persuaded by you... that I would abandon my 'role' over something of that level?"

lines.content: いいえ
lines.translated: "No."

lines.content: 俺は、首を振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: 話してわかり合えるような間柄なら、こんなふうに延々と言葉を交わしたりなんてしていないと思いますよ
lines.translated: "If we were on terms where we could understand each other just by talking, I don't think we would be exchanging words endlessly like this."

lines.content: ただ……。俺は、あなたに話してたんじゃない。ずっと俺の後ろにいてくれる千和に、色々な気持ちを表明するために、恥ずかしげもない言葉をずらずら並べていたんです
lines.translated: "It's just... I wasn't talking to you. I was stringing together all those shameless words to express my feelings to Chiwa, who has been standing behind me this whole time."

lines.content: ナハトは、目を細めた。
lines.translated: Nacht narrowed his eyes.

lines.content: そして新しいたばこにマッチで火を付けながら――ゆっくり、ゆっくり、こちらへと歩いてきた。
lines.translated: And as he lit a new cigarette with a match--slowly, slowly, he walked toward me.

lines.content: あまりにまっすぐ、あまりに堂々とこちらへ向かってくるので、すぐ目の前に立たれるまでどうしていいかわからず、俺は……、
lines.translated: He came at me so directly, with such overwhelming presence, that I didn't know what to do until he was standing right in front of me, and I...

lines.content: ……なるほど。話し合いで解決できないのなら、何をどうすれば、解決できるのか。教えてくれないか、少年
lines.translated: "...I see. If it cannot be resolved through talking, then what must be done, and how, to resolve it? Won't you tell me, boy?"

lines.content: ……俺は、俺のことをまるで覆い被さるように見下ろす、巨大な夜の塊のような身体を、その中で光るふたつの赤色を、ただただ……見上げる。
lines.translated: I could only stare up at the body that looked like a massive clump of night looming over me, and the two points of red glowing within it.

lines.content: ……どうした、少年。互いに手が届く距離だぞ
lines.translated: "...What's wrong, boy? We are within arm's reach of each other."

lines.content: ぺたりと、頬をやさしく撫でられた。冷たい。とても冷たい指先だった。
lines.translated: His hand gently stroked my cheek. Cold. His fingertips were terribly cold.

lines.content: さあ。話し合いで解決できないのなら……次は、どうする？
lines.translated: "Come now. If it cannot be resolved through talking... what will you do next?"

lines.content: お、俺は……
唾を、飲み込む。
lines.translated: I swallowed my saliva.

lines.content: ……俺は、あなたと争うためにここへ来たわけじゃ、な――
lines.translated: "...I didn't come here to fight with you, I--"

lines.content: 衝撃が、あった。
lines.translated: There was an impact.

lines.content: ……首から上がすべて吹き飛ぶかと思った。
lines.translated: I thought everything from my neck up had been blown clean off.

lines.content: 気づけば固い地面に額をこすりつけている。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, my forehead was scraping against the hard ground.

lines.content: およそ数メートルは身体を吹き飛ばされたと思う。
lines.translated: I think my body was sent flying several meters.

lines.content: 視界が、歪んでいた。
lines.translated: My vision was warped.

lines.content: 頬を突き刺すような激痛が残っている。
lines.translated: A piercing, agonizing pain lingered in my cheek.

lines.content: まるで、重量級の何かしらの車両に突き飛ばされてしまったかのようだ。
lines.translated: It felt as though I had been rammed by some kind of heavy vehicle.

lines.content: しかし、それはただの平手打ちだった。
lines.translated: However, it had been nothing more than an open-handed slap.

lines.content: おそらく“怪物”にとっては撫でるに等しいほどのもの――だがそのたったひとつで、正常な感覚が根こそぎ揺らぐ。
lines.translated: To the "monster," it was likely no different from a gentle stroke--yet that single blow alone shook my normal senses to their very roots.

lines.content: 千和が何か叫んでいる。
lines.translated: Chiwa was screaming something.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。耳の中で金属を引き裂くような音が反響し――聞こえない。何も。
lines.translated: But it was no use. A sound like tearing metal echoed inside my ears--I couldn't hear. Nothing at all.

lines.content: だというに、不思議だ。
lines.translated: And yet, how strange.

lines.content: ……少年。ここからは男同士の話だ
lines.translated: "...Boy. From here on, this is a talk between men."

lines.content: “怪物”の地を這うような低い声だけは、はっきりと俺に届いた。
lines.translated: Only the "monster's" low voice, creeping along the ground, reached me clearly.

lines.content: あの子に見られていては本音も口にしづらいだろう。俺たちふたり以外には退場願おうか
lines.translated: "It must be hard to speak your true feelings with that girl watching. Let's ask everyone besides the two of us to exit the stage, shall we?"

lines.content: “怪物”が指を鳴らした。
lines.translated: The "monster" snapped his fingers.

lines.content: その乾いた音を合図に、千和の姿が少しずつ薄くなり――……消えた。
lines.translated: With that dry sound as the signal, Chiwa's figure grew fainter little by little--...and vanished.

lines.content: 同時に、頭上のさくらはもう殆ど満開といっていいほど花を咲かせてしまっていた。
lines.translated: At the same time, the cherry tree overhead had already blossomed so much it could practically be called full bloom.

lines.content: ……これは、もう
lines.translated: "...Does this mean, already..."

lines.content: 千和の命は、すべてこのさくらの花に変わってしまったということなのだろうか……。
lines.translated: Did this mean that all of Chiwa's life had already been turned into these cherry blossoms...?

lines.content: 千和、うそ、だろ……
lines.translated: "Chiwa, no way..."

lines.content: はらはらと降るその[ひとひら|一片]を、手のひらの上に捕まえる。
lines.translated: I caught a single petal fluttering down in the palm of my hand.

lines.content: ……お前に、何ができるんだ
lines.translated: "...What can you possibly do?"

lines.content: “怪物”は言う。
lines.translated: The "monster" spoke.
"*You, who were merely raised by a special cat*--how on earth do you think you can change this current situation? *It took a single stroke.*"

lines.content: 地面をひっかくようにして、俺は立ち上がろうとする。手の中の[ひとひら|一片]だけは握りつぶしてしまわぬように。
lines.translated: Clawing at the ground, I tried to stand up. Careful not to crush the single petal in my hand.

lines.content: たったひとつ、その頬を撫でてみせただけでそのざまだ
lines.translated: "Just stroking that cheek of yours once left you in that pathetic state."

lines.content: ……こんなにも、そんなにも脆弱なお前が……それでもだ。それでもこの俺と戦って千和を奪おうと……そういう覚悟さえもないというのなら、いったいお前は何をしにここへ来た
lines.translated: "...Someone as utterly, terribly fragile as you... And yet. If you don't even have the resolve to fight me and take Chiwa back by force... then what on earth did you come here to do?"

lines.content: 何をしに？
lines.translated: What did I come here to do?

lines.content: そんなのは、決まってる。
lines.translated: Isn't that obvious?

lines.content: ……返して、ください
lines.translated: "...Please, give it back."

lines.content: 何度だって、求めるためだ。
lines.translated: To ask for it, no matter how many times it takes.

lines.content: ……千和の、命を
lines.translated: "...Chiwa's life."

lines.content: 息も、絶え絶えに、
lines.translated: Gasping for breath,

lines.content: ……どうか。お願い、します
lines.translated: "...Please. I'm begging you."

lines.content: ふらり、ふらりと、立ち上がり、
lines.translated: I wobbled unsteadily to my feet,

lines.content: ……千和の命を返してほしい。可能なはずだ。そして、夢を。俺たちの夢を、認めてください
lines.translated: "...I want you to give Chiwa's life back. It should be possible. And our dream. Please accept our dream."

lines.content: ――何度だって、[・|許][・|し][・|を][・|請][・|う]ために、俺はここへやって来た。
lines.translated: --I came here to *beg for your forgiveness*, no matter how many times it takes.

lines.content: あなたに……認めてもらえるまで、あなたに、祝福してもらえるまで、千和の命を返してもらえる、それまでは。何度だって、俺は――っ
lines.translated: "Until you... accept us, until you give us your blessing, until you return Chiwa's life to her. No matter how many times it takes, I'll--!"

lines.content: 更に、一撃。
lines.translated: Another blow.

lines.content: ……顔面だ。
lines.translated: Right to my face.

lines.content: 今度は後方へ吹き飛ばされるほどのものではなかったが、しかし膝からその場に崩れ落ちてしまう――まったく容赦のない拳が鼻頭にめり込んだ。
lines.translated: This time it wasn't hard enough to send me flying backward, but my knees buckled and I crumpled to the ground right there--a completely merciless fist had sunk deep into the bridge of my nose.

lines.content: ……ああ、ああ、う
lines.translated: "...Aah, agh, ugh..."

lines.content: うめく。
lines.translated: I groaned.

lines.content: 顔を両手で覆う。
lines.translated: I covered my face with both hands.

lines.content: 鼻からぬらりと、赤いものが――……しかし、それでも、
lines.translated: Something warm and red trickled down from my nose--...Even so,

lines.content: 俺は、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood back up.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 立ち上がろうと、震える足に力を込める。
lines.translated: I forced strength into my trembling legs, trying to stand back up.

lines.content: ……俺の許しを得ることにどれ程の価値があると思っているのか知らないがな、少年……もう、遅いんだよ。わかるだろ。[・|方][・|法][・|は][・|な][・|い]。さくらは殆ど満開だ
lines.translated: "...I don't know how much value you think there is in earning my forgiveness, boy... but it's already too late. Surely you can see that. *There is no way*. The cherry tree is almost in full bloom."

lines.content: それに、もし“俺と戦え”と言えば、“そうすれば認めてやる”と言えば、お前は俺と、ここで、全力でやり合うのか？
lines.translated: "Besides, if I told you to 'fight me,' if I said 'do that and I'll accept you,' would you actually go all out against me right here?"

lines.content: お前は、猫に育てられた。“夜の魔法使い”を謳う小賢しいばかりのあの猫たちだよ。ずっとだ。千和が見初めたお前のことをずっと観察してきたから、わかる。知っている
lines.translated: "You were raised by a cat. One of those overly clever cats who call themselves 'Magicians of the Night.' All this time. Because Chiwa fell for you, I've been watching you this whole time, so I understand. I know."

lines.content: ならば“夜”の中で戦う術くらいは学んでいるはずだ。そうだろう？
lines.translated: "Which means you must have at least learned how to fight within the 'Night.' Isn't that right?"

lines.content: 戦う……
lines.translated: "Fight..."

lines.content: つぶやき、歯を食いしばる。
lines.translated: I muttered, clenching my teeth.

lines.content: しかしすぐに俺は笑ってみせた――何を勘違いしているんですか、と。
lines.translated: Yet I quickly forced a smile--as if to ask what on earth he was misunderstanding.

lines.content: これはそんな物騒な話なんかじゃなかったんですよ
lines.translated: "This was never meant to be anything that violent."

lines.content: ……あなたは、千和のお父さんだ
lines.translated: "...You are Chiwa's father."

lines.content: これは“娘さんを僕にください”っていう、アレなんですよ。場合によっては土下座も辞さない。それくらいの覚悟で誰もが女の子の父親に会いに行く……
lines.translated: "This is that whole 'please give me your daughter's hand' thing. Depending on how it goes, I wouldn't hesitate to get down on my knees and beg. Every guy goes to meet a girl's father with that kind of resolve..."

lines.content: 人間程度の父親も、溺愛する娘の話となればとんでもなく恐ろしく変貌する場合だってあるだろう。まさに怪物のように。
lines.translated: Even a normal human father can transform into something terrifyingly fierce when it comes to the daughter he dotes on. Just like a monster.

lines.content: それが、どうだ。俺の相手は本物の“怪物”だ。土下座くらいで許してもらえるとは思っていない。
lines.translated: And yet, look at this. The one I'm facing is a genuine "monster." I don't expect to be forgiven just by bowing my head to the ground.

lines.content: だから、いくら殴られようと、蹴り飛ばされようと……殺されてしまおうと。抵抗も反抗もしないと決めていました。それが俺の覚悟です
lines.translated: "That's why, no matter how much you beat me, kick me away... or even if you kill me. I already decided I wouldn't resist or fight back. That is my resolve."

lines.content: それが、千和に報いるための俺の勇気だと、思っていたんです
lines.translated: "I thought that was my courage, my way of answering Chiwa's feelings."

lines.content: ナハトは赤い両目をすがめ、
lines.translated: Nacht narrowed both of his red eyes.

lines.content: ……勇気？　思って、いた？
lines.translated: "...Courage? You... thought?"

lines.content: はい……
うなずき、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Nodding, I spoke.

lines.content: 確かに……あなたの言うとおりだ。ここから先は男同士の話です。千和に見られていたままでは本音を言えなかった
lines.translated: "It's true... just like you said. From here on, this is a talk between men. I couldn't say how I really felt while Chiwa was watching."

lines.content: 俺は一度、どうしようもない弱気で千和のことを傷つけました……だって、俺ですよ？　俺みたいなやつを好きだと、勇気を出して告白してくれました
lines.translated: "Once before, I hurt Chiwa because of my own hopeless cowardice... I mean, look at me. She mustered up her courage and confessed that she liked a guy like me."

lines.content: それなのに……俺、どうしようもないから。本当にバカだから。恐がりだから。その言葉を茶化して、千和の気持ちから逃げようとした
lines.translated: "And yet... because I'm completely hopeless. Because I'm a total idiot. Because I'm a coward. I treated her words like a joke and tried to run away from Chiwa's feelings."

lines.content: 俺は俺がきっと好きではないのだろう。幼少の頃からその実感はあった。
lines.translated: I probably don't like myself. I've felt that way ever since I was a little kid.

lines.content: そんな俺のことを誰かが好きだと思ってくれてる。
lines.translated: And yet someone thought they liked a guy like me.

lines.content: 千和から気持ちを伝えられたときは、どうしても、どうしても、その事実を信じるのが怖かった。
