lines.translated: When Chiwa told me how she felt, I was just so, so terrified of believing that fact.

lines.content: すぐに後悔した。
lines.translated: I regretted it immediately.

lines.content: 自分自身を切り刻んでやりたいほど……とても、とても。
lines.translated: Enough to want to tear myself to pieces... so, so much.

lines.content: ……それから、ずっと、考えていたんです
lines.translated: "...Since then, I've been thinking about it nonstop."

lines.content: これまで色々な人が、色々な言葉で、色々な形で、俺に勇気について教えてくれた。
lines.translated: Up until now, all sorts of people have taught me about courage, in all sorts of words, in all sorts of ways.

lines.content: 『一度格好悪いことをしてしまったのなら、次は必ずそれを自分自身の力で……この場合は勇気で、挽回しなきゃいけないんですよ。それがきっとヒーローの条件です』
lines.translated: "'If you end up doing something uncool once, you definitely have to make up for it next time with your own power... or in this case, with courage. That's surely what it takes to be a hero.'"

lines.content: ……そんな言葉が、今も俺の中に残ってる。
lines.translated: Those words still remain inside me even now.

lines.content: だから考えの足りない向こう見ずなこの俺は、千和から受けた告白への返事で、千和の勇気に応えようとしたけれど――
lines.translated: That's why this thoughtless, reckless me tried to answer Chiwa's courage with my reply to her confession, and yet--

lines.content: その方法だって結局はただのひとりよがりだった。ただ、千和に恥ずかしい思いをさせただけだった。
lines.translated: Even the way I did that ended up being nothing more than self-satisfaction. All I did was embarrass Chiwa.

lines.content: ……ずっと、ずっと、考えていた。千和の勇気に報いれる方法はないのかと――心のどこかにいつもその思いが引っかかっていた
lines.translated: "...I thought about it for so, so long. Wondering if there was some way I could repay Chiwa's courage--that thought was always nagging at the back of my mind."

lines.content: そして、見つけたんです。思いついたんです。その方法を、俺は今夜、見つけたんですよ
lines.translated: "And then, I found it. I came up with it. Tonight, I finally found the way."

lines.content: ……そうか。それは、おめでとう。よかったな。で？　その方法とは？
lines.translated: "...I see. Well, congratulations. Good for you. And? What is this way of yours?"

lines.content: まるで関心などないかのように言う“怪物”に、俺は……、
lines.translated: To the "monster" who spoke as though he couldn't care less, I...

lines.content: 命と命の交換です
lines.translated: "An exchange of life for life."

lines.content: よどみなくそう応えられたと思う。覚悟を決めて。勇気を、出して……。
lines.translated: I think I managed to answer without hesitation. Having made up my mind. Mustering up my courage...

lines.content: ……もしも、一度さくらに捧げてしまった命を再び取り戻すような方法が、本当に、本当に、ないのなら
lines.translated: "...If there truly, truly is no way to take back a life once it has been offered to the cherry blossoms..."

lines.content: ……残念ながら、俺には“あなたと戦い、勝利して、そのうえであなたから無理矢理、千和の命を取り返す”――そのような未来をまるで、かけらも、想像できないから……
lines.translated: "...Unfortunately, 'fighting you, winning, and then forcibly taking Chiwa's life back from you'--I can't imagine a future like that at all, not even a shred of it..."

lines.content: “命と命の交換”です。“俺は、俺の命の残り時間を千和に譲りたい”
lines.translated: "So it's 'an exchange of life for life.' 'I want to give the remaining time of my life to Chiwa.'"
"That is *the 'price' for removing the safety device on my 'magic'*."

lines.content: ソルは自身の命の残り時間と、死んでしまった娘の命とを交換することで“怪物”となった。
lines.translated: Sol became a "monster" by exchanging the remaining time of his own life for the life of his dead daughter.

lines.content: ただあのひとと同じことをするだけだ――大切な人に未来を上げたい。たとえ、共にその未来を歩めなくとも。
lines.translated: I'm just going to do the exact same thing she did--I want to give a future to someone precious to me. Even if I can't walk alongside her in that future.

lines.content: 元々、長く生きたいとは考えない人間でした。むしろ早く死んでしまいたいとさえ思ってた。できるだけ、最低最悪な死に方ができる方法をさえ探していました
lines.translated: "From the start, I was never the kind of person who wanted to live a long life. In fact, I even wished I could just die quickly. I was even looking for a way to die in the absolute worst, most miserable way possible."

lines.content: ――そう思っていた理由は、どうしてかな。[・|今]はもう思い出せもしないけれど……。
lines.translated: --Why did I used to think like that, I wonder? *Now*, I can't even remember anymore, though...

lines.content: でも、そんな俺でも、千和のおかげで……未来に希望めいたものを思い描けた。千和と一緒に生きていたいと思えるようになっていた
lines.translated: "Even so, thanks to Chiwa, even someone like me... was able to picture something resembling hope in the future. I came to think that I wanted to live together with Chiwa."

lines.content: ……充分だ。
lines.translated: That's enough.

lines.content: これ以上、俺という人間の心が報われ、救われるような結果があるだろうか。
lines.translated: Could there be any other outcome that would reward and save the heart of a person like me more than this?

lines.content: それに命を使うとはいえ死ぬわけではない――俺は“夜”の中に産まれ直すのだ。
lines.translated: Besides, even though I'm using up my life, it doesn't mean I'm going to die--I will be reborn into the "Night."

lines.content: ここから千和の人生により多く幸せがありますようにと祈り続けることだってできる。
lines.translated: From here, I can even keep praying that Chiwa's life will be filled with as much happiness as possible.

lines.content: 俺たち人間には特性があると言っていましたね
lines.translated: "You said that we humans have certain predispositions, didn't you?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 千和は孤独になりやすい人間だ
lines.translated: "Chiwa is a human who easily falls into loneliness."

lines.content: そして俺は、何かあるとすぐに“死んでしまいたくなる”人間なんだと思います
lines.translated: "And I think I'm the kind of human who immediately 'wants to die' the moment anything goes wrong."

lines.content: ……この先の未来。何か大変なことが起きて、また、俺が自分の命を放り出してしまいたくなる日が来ないとも限らない
lines.translated: "...In the future ahead. There's no guarantee a day won't come when something terrible happens and I want to throw my life away all over again."

lines.content: それなら、この命を、この命の残り時間を、有意義に使ってくれるだろう女の子に託したほうがいい
lines.translated: "If that's the case, it's better to entrust this life, the remaining time of this life, to a girl who will actually put it to good use."

lines.content: そんな理屈を無理矢理つけて、色々なものを納得させて……俺は、そのための覚悟を決めて、ここへ来たのだ。
lines.translated: Forcing that kind of logic together to convince myself of all sorts of things... I made up my mind to do this, and came here.

lines.content: いつもここから、“夜”の中から、千和の幸せを祈ってるし、もし何か千和に大変なことが起こっても、いつでもここから手助けしたいと思ってる
lines.translated: "I'll always be praying for Chiwa's happiness from here, from within the 'Night,' and if anything terrible ever happens to her, I want to be ready to help her from here at any time."

lines.content: そして、命尽きたすべての者が通過する“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: And within the "Night," through which all whose lives have ended must pass...

lines.content: いつかまた、ここで千和と出会えれば。
lines.translated: If I can meet Chiwa here again someday.

lines.content: そして、共に“夜の鉄道”に乗り、笑顔で“次”へと歩き出せれば。
lines.translated: And if we can ride the "Night Train" together, and step forward into the "next" with smiles on our faces.

lines.content: ……ああ、うん。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: それはそれで、悪くない人生だったなあと思えます。これは決して悲劇的な決断ではないと思えるはずです
lines.translated: "All in all, I think I'll be able to look back and say it wasn't a bad life. I'm sure I'll be able to see this not as a tragic decision at all."

lines.content: ナハトは空を見上げる。同じように、俺も“夜”を仰ぎ見た。
lines.translated: Nacht looked up at the sky. In the same way, I gazed up at the "Night" as well.

lines.content: そこに広がるさくらの枝に、花がぽつりぽつりと芽生え――その数を今も少しずつ増やしていた。その一つひとつが千和の命でできている。
lines.translated: On the cherry branches spreading out overhead, blossoms were budding one by one--still increasing their numbers little by little even now. Every single one of them was made from Chiwa's life.

lines.content: そう思えば、風に舞う一片さえ見失うことなく、かき集めなければと焦らされる。
lines.translated: Thinking of it that way filled me with a frantic urge to gather them all up without losing sight of even a single petal dancing in the wind.

lines.content: そんな光景を見つめながら、ナハトは言う。
lines.translated: Gazing at that sight, Nacht spoke.

lines.content: 結局は……、少年。千和と一緒に生きていくという“夢”を叶えさせてほしいと言いながら、その“夢”を自ら諦めることも同時に考えているということか
lines.translated: "In the end... boy. Even as you ask me to grant your 'dream' of living together with Chiwa, you're simultaneously thinking of giving up on that 'dream' yourself?"

lines.content: ……ひとつ叶わなければ、また次のひとつをなんとか思い描いて、どうにかこうにか生きていくのが俺たち人間ですから。なんて。生意気言ってすみません
lines.translated: "...Because if one wish doesn't come true, we humans somehow picture the next one, and manage to keep on living one way or another. Or something like that. Sorry for sounding so cheeky."

lines.content: たとえ共に生きられないとしても、千和のこれからの人生に、幸せに思えることがひとつでも多くあればいい――それが俺の思い描く次の“夢”だ。
lines.translated: Even if we can't live together, I just want Chiwa's life from here on out to have as many happy moments as possible--that is the next "dream" I'm picturing.

lines.content: ……そうなれば、これから千和の人生はまた孤独だな
lines.translated: "...If that happens, Chiwa's life from here on will be lonely once again."

lines.content: 大切な人をなくしてしまったという後悔と、そして孤独が、あの子の人生には常に隣にあるわけだ。ああ……。結局あの子は、そういう運命だということなのか
lines.translated: "The regret of having lost someone precious, and loneliness, will always be right beside that girl throughout her life. Ah... In the end, does that mean such is her fate?"

lines.content: いえ。“夜”の中の出来事は千和が大人になれば忘れてしまう。俺が“夜”に属せば、千和はきっと、俺のことを忘れてくれる。だからいつかはその孤独も忘れてくれます
lines.translated: "No. When Chiwa grows up, she'll forget the things that happened in the 'Night.' Once I belong to the 'Night,' Chiwa will surely forget about me. So someday, she'll forget that loneliness too."

lines.content: ……色々と、強引だな
lines.translated: "...You're forcing quite a lot of things here."

lines.content: ……そうですね。強引だし乱暴ですよね。自分でもそう思いますよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, you're right. It is forceful and reckless. Even I think so."

lines.content: ひとつ叶わなければ次の“夢”……。こんなふうに小賢しく妥協なんて覚えていくから、きっと、俺たちの心は大人にならなきゃならなくなるんですね
lines.translated: "If one wish doesn't come true, then on to the next 'dream'... It's probably because we learn to make clever little compromises like this that our hearts have no choice but to grow up."

lines.content: 何であれ、どうであれ、選択したこの道に俺は後悔しない。あくまでもこれは俺、奏大雅の戦いであり、杏藤千和は無関係――という体を保ちたい。
lines.translated: Whatever happens, no matter how it turns out, I won't regret this path I've chosen. To the very end, I want to keep up the pretense that this is my fight--Kanade Taiga's fight--and that Andou Chiwa has nothing to do with it.

lines.content: [魔法少女|彼女]の“魔法”には頼らない。頼ってはならない。
lines.translated: I won't rely on her "magic." I must not rely on it.

lines.content: 千和のことをこの問題に関わらせてはならないのだ。
lines.translated: I must not let Chiwa get dragged into this problem.

lines.content: ……なるほど。少年。お前の覚悟は多少なりとも理解はできた。伝わりもした。そう感じてはいる
lines.translated: "...I see. Boy. I've more or less understood your resolve. It got through to me. I can feel that much."

lines.content: ただ……。
lines.translated: It was just...

lines.content: それは、つまり
lines.translated: "Which means, in other words..."

lines.content: 肩を落とし、“怪物”はため息と共に言う。
lines.translated: Dropping his shoulders, the "monster" let out a sigh and spoke.

lines.content: ……お前の要求を受け入れるということは……
lines.translated: "...Accepting your demand means..."

lines.content: 俺はまた、元人間の“怪物”と“夜”の中で長く暮らしていかなきゃならないという現実をもまた、受け入れなきゃならないということなのか
lines.translated: "I'll also have to accept the reality of spending another long stretch of time living in the 'Night' with a former-human 'monster,' doesn't it?"

lines.content: まあ、そういうふうになる可能性もありますよね
lines.translated: "Well, there is a possibility it could turn out that way, yeah."

lines.content: 俺は[・|あ][・|の][・|ひ][・|と]みたいによく話すタイプの人間ではないので、決してその時間は楽しいものにはならないだろうとは思うし……。
lines.translated: Though since I'm not the chatty type like *she* was, I doubt that time would be anything fun at all...

lines.content: 俺とあなたが一緒に暮らそうなんて、どちらかがそんな提案をするのも、なんだかあまり想像できませんけれど
lines.translated: "Though I can't really imagine either of us suggesting that you and I live together."

lines.content: “怪物”は、ナハトは、少し考えた後で、
lines.translated: The "monster"--Nacht--thought about it for a moment.

lines.content: ……いいだろう
lines.translated: "...Very well."

lines.content: お前の命の残り時間を千和に渡そう、と言って、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Saying she would give the remaining time of my life to Chiwa, she nodded.

lines.content: だが、ひとつだ。ひとつだけ条件がある
lines.translated: "However, there is one thing. Just one condition."

lines.content: ……条件、ですか。まあ、そうですよね。そんな気はしてました
lines.translated: "...A condition, huh? Well, that makes sense. I had a feeling there'd be one."

lines.content: 苦笑いをうかべ、言う。
lines.translated: I gave a wry smile and spoke.

lines.content: その、条件というのは……。難しいものでなければありがたいですが
lines.translated: "Um, about that condition... I'd appreciate it if it wasn't anything too difficult."

lines.content: ……ああ。簡単だ。たったひとつ。とてもシンプルなものだ。難しいものではない
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It's easy. Just one thing. It's very simple, nothing difficult at all."

lines.content: ナハトは人差し指を立てて見せ、
lines.translated: Nacht held up his index finger to show me.

lines.content: ただ……俺と戦い、勝つことだ。それが条件。力尽くで俺に[・|そ][・|う][・|さ][・|せ][・|て][・|み][・|ろ][・|よ]というだけの話だ
lines.translated: "All you have to do... is fight me and win. That's the condition. You just have to *make me do it* by force."

lines.content: 簡単だろう、とナハトは肩を竦めてみせた。とてもとても、簡単な話だろう、と。
lines.translated: Simple, right? Nacht shrugged his shoulders. A very, very simple matter indeed, he seemed to say.

lines.content: なるほど。そう来ますか。確かにそれは複雑な話ではないですね。
lines.translated: "I see. So that's how it is. That certainly isn't complicated."

lines.content: 理解力にあまり自信のない俺ですけどその点には不安がない――と、いうか。もうそれ以外にはないって感じですよね
lines.translated: "I'm not all that confident in my reading comprehension, but I have zero doubts on that point--or rather, it feels like that was the only way this could ever go."

lines.content: 俺は苦笑いを浮かべ――ため息。わかりましたとあごを引く。
lines.translated: I offered a wry smile--and sighed. Nodding, I said I understood.

lines.content: ……あなたと争いにここへ来たわけではないですが、そうでなければ、俺の要求を……俺の“夢”を叶えてもらえないのであれば、しかたがありません。今こそ……
lines.translated: "...I didn't come here to fight you, but if there's no other way to get you to grant my demand... to grant my 'dream,' then I don't have a choice. Now is the time..."

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じ、
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: ……今こそ、“夜の魔法使い”から、俺の特別なあのひとたちから学んだ術を、ありったけ、全部――ここにぶつけるときなのだと、理解することにします
lines.translated: "...Now is the time to throw every last bit of the arts I learned from the 'Magician of the Night,' from those people who are so special to me--right here, with everything I've got. I'll make sure I understand that."

lines.content: そして深く、ふかく、意識を集中させ……。
lines.translated: And then, deeply, so deeply, I focused my mind...

lines.content: 次々とあるだけ詰め込み続けた物語たち――心の中でそのページを捲る。
lines.translated: The stories I had packed inside myself, one after another, as many as I could hold--I flipped through their pages in my heart.

lines.content: そこに様々な“[魔法|想像]”を求めた。
lines.translated: Searching through them for all kinds of "magic"--imagination.

lines.content: 対する相手は“不死のイキモノ”
lines.translated: My opponent was an "immortal creature."

lines.content: ……ヒーローだ。
lines.translated: A hero.

lines.content: 今、この現状をぶち破るだけの力を持ったヒーローは……いったい、どこにいる。
lines.translated: Where in the world... was a hero with enough power to smash through this situation right now?

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を再び開いたときには戦うための準備は整っている。
lines.translated: By the time I opened my eyelids again, I was ready to fight.

lines.content: 左手には[・|そ][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|の][・|武][・|器]が握られ。この身体には、この心には、いつか憧れたヒーローの姿を投影させた。
lines.translated: In my left hand, I gripped *the weapon meant for that purpose*. Onto this body, and into this heart, I projected the figure of the hero I had once admired.

lines.content: ……確かにお前は猫たちから色々と学んだようだな。不格好だがそれなりに“夜”を使いこなせてはいるようだと評価もできる
lines.translated: "...It seems you really have learned quite a lot from those cats. It's clumsy, but I can give you credit for handling the 'Night' well enough."

lines.content: ナハトはそう言い、短くなったたばこを吐き捨て、笑った。
lines.translated: Saying that, Nacht spat out his shortened cigarette and laughed.

lines.content: 簡単には死んでくれるなよ、少年。お前の“夢”を叶えるために、ありったけの“魔法”を俺に、[・|俺][・|た][・|ち][・|に]、見せてみろ
lines.translated: "Don't go dying on me too easily, boy. To make your 'dream' come true, show me--show *us*--every last bit of 'magic' you've got."

lines.content: 空を、見上げる。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: そこには満開に咲く花の天井ができあがっていた。
lines.translated: Overhead, a ceiling of flowers in full bloom had taken shape.

lines.content: ……千和。待ってろ。今、君の未来に、幸せを届けに行くぞ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. Wait for me. I'm coming to deliver happiness to your future right now."

lines.content: ……“夜”に、光が弾け。
lines.translated: Light burst within the "Night."

lines.content: たくさんの想いが散って。
lines.translated: Countless feelings scattered.

lines.content: 嵐のようにさくらの花が乱れては……消え去った。
lines.translated: Like a storm, the cherry blossoms swirled wildly... and vanished away.

lines.content: [・|私]は、何かとても大切なものを失った。
lines.translated: *I* lost something very precious to me.

lines.content: だけど何をなくしてしまったのか思い出せない――
lines.translated: But I can't remember what it is that I lost--

lines.content: それが悲しくて、さみしくて、時に悔しくも想い……。
lines.translated: It makes me sad, and lonely, and sometimes even frustrated...

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]やさしく手を差し伸べてくれたひとの手を、いつまでも埋まることのない空っぽの手のひらで、いつまでも、探し続けて……。
lines.translated: With an empty palm that will never be filled, I endlessly search for the hand of the person who gently reached out to me *back then*...

lines.content: 長い、長い道のりを、泣きながらひとりで歩く。
lines.translated: Walking all alone down a long, long road, crying as I go.

lines.content: そんな夢を、私は見ていた。
lines.translated: That was the dream I was having.

lines.content: 朝。たったひとりで目を覚ます。
lines.translated: Morning. I wake up all by myself.

lines.content: この頃はよく眠れない日々が続いてた。
lines.translated: Lately, I've been having trouble sleeping day after day.

lines.content: 夢見が悪いからだろうか。しつこい眠気ばかりがいつも私を手招きしている――そんな日々。
lines.translated: Maybe it's because of the bad dreams. A lingering drowsiness is always beckoning to me--those are the kinds of days I've been having.

lines.content: あくびをひとつ。もうひとつ。
lines.translated: One yawn. Then another.

lines.content: ……あと少し、眠っていたい。
lines.translated: I want to sleep just a little bit longer.

lines.content: このままお布団にもう一度包まれたなら、それはそれでとても幸せだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Wrapping myself back up in my futon like this would probably make me very happy in its own way, but...

lines.content: ……うん。そろそろ、起きなきゃ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I have to get up soon."

lines.content: 今日は特別な日だ。遅れたりはできない。
lines.translated: Today is a special day. I can't be late.

lines.content: ましてや二度寝を理由にズル休みだなんて……。
lines.translated: Let alone play hooky just because I went back to sleep...

lines.content: 枕元に置いたスマートフォンを確認する。
lines.translated: I check the smartphone by my pillow.

lines.content: 誰からもメッセージはなかった。
lines.translated: There weren't any messages from anyone.

lines.content: なんだかそれは空っぽなものの象徴のように思えて……。
lines.translated: Somehow, it felt like a symbol of something empty...

lines.content: 今、世界中には自分ひとりしかいないのではないか――なんて。なんだか不思議なさみしさに襲われもして。
lines.translated: Right now, maybe I'm the only person in the whole wide world--or something like that. A strange sense of loneliness washed over me.

lines.content: それは、まるで、誰とも繋がれない私の手のひらみたい。
lines.translated: It's just like my palm, unable to connect with anyone.

lines.content: ため息と共に私はベッドから起き上がる。
lines.translated: With a sigh, I get out of bed.

lines.content: 制服に着替え、髪を整え……。
lines.translated: I change into my uniform, fix my hair...

lines.content: カーテンを開いて外を見る。
lines.translated: And open the curtains to look outside.

lines.content: 今日はぽかぽかと暖かい良い天気。そろそろやって来る春の予感で町はいっぱい。
lines.translated: The weather is nice and pleasantly warm today. The town is brimming with the promise of spring's imminent arrival.

lines.content: お布団を干していこう。真っ白なシーツにふわふわのお布団。きっと、太陽の匂いでいっぱいになる。
lines.translated: I'll hang my futon out to dry before I leave. Crisp white sheets and a fluffy futon. I'm sure they'll end up filled with the scent of the sun.

lines.content: ベッドも。お布団も。制服も。
lines.translated: My bed. My futon. My uniform, too.

lines.content: 全部お父さんが私のために用意してくれたもの――あなたがいなくなってから、もう、[・|三][・|度][・|目][・|の][・|春][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Every last one of them is something Dad prepared for me--since you went away, it's already *the third spring*.

lines.content: ……いただきます
lines.translated: "...Thank you for the food."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで用意した朝ご飯を、ひとりぼっちで私は食べる。
lines.translated: All by myself, I eat the breakfast I made all by myself.

lines.content: 今日は特別だ。トーストにジャムをいつもよりいっぱい塗ってみた。口いっぱいに広がるイチゴの味とその香り。
lines.translated: Today is special. I tried spreading way more jam on my toast than usual. The flavor and aroma of strawberries fill my mouth.

lines.content: だけどそんな私に、“お砂糖の取り過ぎは身体に悪いよ”と言ってくれるひとはいない。
lines.translated: But there's no one here to tell me, "Eating too much sugar is bad for you."

lines.content: “だって今日は特別な日なんだもん。だからこれくらい、いいよね？”
lines.translated: "But today is a special day! So this much is okay, right?"

lines.content: そんなふうに我がままを言う相手も、ここにはいなかった。
lines.translated: There was no one here for me to act spoiled with like that, either.

lines.content: 私は、大切な人を失った。
lines.translated: I lost someone precious to me.

lines.content: そんな感覚が消えずにいつもこの胸の中にあり続けてる。
lines.translated: That feeling never fades, lingering inside my chest all the time.

lines.content: でも、おかしい。私は誰を失ったのか……。私は、誰と“さよなら”してしまったのか。
lines.translated: Yet it's strange. Who did I lose...? Who did I say "goodbye" to?

lines.content: ……わからない。
lines.translated: I don't know.

lines.content: 私が“さよなら”と言った数は少なくないはずで……。
lines.translated: I know I've said "goodbye" more than a few times...

lines.content: そのうちのひとつを忘れてしまってる。
lines.translated: And I've forgotten one of them.

lines.content: それはとても大切なものであるはずだった。そんな気がしているのに――思い出せない。どうしても。
lines.translated: It must have been something deeply precious. Even though I feel that way--I can't remember. No matter how hard I try.

lines.content: それが悲しい。とても、さみしい。
lines.translated: That makes me sad. So, so lonely.

lines.content: いつまでも消えないひとりぼっちの気持ちと一緒に……、
lines.translated: Along with this feeling of being all alone that never goes away...

lines.content: ……行こう
lines.translated: "...Let's go."
Today is my *graduation ceremony*.

lines.content: 私が子どもでいられる最後の日。
lines.translated: The very last day I get to be a child.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちの卒業式だ。
lines.translated: A graduation ceremony all by myself.

lines.content: お祝いに来てくれるひとは誰もいないけれど……。
lines.translated: There isn't anyone coming to celebrate with me, though...

lines.content: 平気。私はきっと、大丈夫。
lines.translated: I'm fine. I'm sure I'll be okay.

lines.content: ……それじゃあ、行ってきます。お父さん
lines.translated: "...Well then, I'm heading out, Dad."

lines.content: 卒業証書はお父さんに一番に見せに帰ってくるね。
lines.translated: I'll come straight home to show you my diploma first thing, okay?

lines.content: 玄関先に飾った写真立てに私は笑いかける。
lines.translated: I smile at the framed photo displayed by the front door.

lines.content: もしも叶うのなら、あなたには今日の私を見ていてほしかったな。
lines.translated: If my wish could come true, I would have loved for you to see me today.

lines.content: そんな子どもみたいな気持ちを抱いて、お店の扉を私は開いた。
lines.translated: Holding onto such a childish feeling, I opened the shop door.

lines.content: ……ふわあ、すごい
lines.translated: "...Whoa, amazing."

lines.content: 町は春の花で満開だった。
lines.translated: The town was in full bloom with spring flowers.

lines.content: 今はまだ三月上旬。
lines.translated: It's still early March right now.

lines.content: 卒業式とさくら。そのふたつを結びつけて想像してしまう人が多いのはどうしてだろうと思う。[・|有][・|名][・|な][・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|歌]があるからか。
lines.translated: I wonder why so many people associate graduation ceremonies with cherry blossoms in their minds. Maybe it's because there's a *famous song like that*.

lines.content: 多くの場合、さくらは入学式のイメージだ。
lines.translated: In most cases, cherry blossoms are associated with entrance ceremonies.

lines.content: それでもこの町のさくらは少し早めに咲く種類もあって……。
lines.translated: Even so, this town has a variety of cherry trees that bloom a little early...

lines.content: 毎年だ。
lines.translated: It happens every year.

lines.content: 卒業式も、入学式も、きらきらで、ふわふわな春の花が、[・|そ][・|の][・|日]を彩ってくれていた。
lines.translated: For both graduation ceremonies and entrance ceremonies, sparkling, fluffy spring flowers colored *that day* for us.

lines.content: 町はまるでさくらの森の中のよう。
lines.translated: The town looks as if it's inside a forest of cherry blossoms.

lines.content: それでもやっぱり、ずっと枯れているままの一番大きなさくらの樹は、今年も咲きそうな気配もないけれど……。
lines.translated: Even so, the biggest cherry tree, which has remained withered all this time, shows no sign of blooming this year either...

lines.content: まるでこの町そのものが、今日、別々の道へ踏み出す子たちに祝福の言葉でも降らせているみたい――
lines.translated: It's as if the town itself is showering words of blessing upon the children stepping out onto their separate paths today--

lines.content: そんなふうに都合良く考えてしまうのは、やっぱり、私がまだまだ子どもな証だろうか。
lines.translated: Thinking about it so conveniently like that is probably proof that I'm still very much a child after all.

lines.content: 上ばかりを、見ていた。
lines.translated: I kept looking only upward.

lines.content: 何かに躓き、転んでしまいそうになった。
lines.translated: I tripped on something and nearly fell.

lines.content: だけど私はもう大丈夫。小さなときみたいにコケたりしないし、迷子になって泣いたりもしない。
lines.translated: But I'm okay now. I don't trip and fall like I did when I was little, and I don't get lost and cry anymore.

lines.content: そんな私に手を差し伸べてくれるひとも、もう、隣にはいないから……。
lines.translated: Because the person who would reach out a hand to me when I did is no longer by my side...

lines.content: 手のひらを見つめた。
lines.translated: I stared at the palm of my hand.

lines.content: いつもだ。いつも私は、この手を握ってくれる誰かのことを探してる。
lines.translated: It's always like this. I'm always searching for someone to hold this hand.

lines.content: ……今日はバスを使わず歩いて行こう。
lines.translated: I'll walk today instead of taking the bus.

lines.content: 少し遠いけれど制服を着て歩く朝は今日が最後だ。
lines.translated: It's a little far, but today is the last morning I'll ever walk to school in this uniform.

lines.content: ……[・|誰][・|か]と笑って話した大通り。
lines.translated: The main street where I laughed and talked with someone.

lines.content: 何か面白いことないかなとふざけ合った石橋の上。
lines.translated: The stone bridge where we fooled around, wondering if there was anything fun to do.

lines.content: 学校終わったらどこに寄り道して帰ろうかと、無茶な計画をしながら歩いた坂の道。
lines.translated: The sloped road we walked up while making reckless plans about where to stop by on the way home after school.

lines.content: 町の至る所に、今日までの日々が、思い出が、いくつも染みこんでいるように思えて――だけど誰かの思い出だけが足りないようにも、思えて……“おめでとう”
lines.translated: It felt like the days leading up to today, and so many memories, were soaked into every corner of this town--and yet, it also felt like memories of one specific person were missing... "Congratulations."

lines.content: ふと通り過ぎた誰かにそう言われたような気がして……振り返る。
lines.translated: Suddenly feeling as though someone passing by had said that to me... I turned around.

lines.content: いつの間にかたくさんの人たちの中に私はいた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was surrounded by a crowd of people.

lines.content: 今日、卒業する生徒たち。
lines.translated: The students graduating today.

lines.content: ここには、誰もが大切な人たちと学園に向かう光景だけがある――坂の道をゆっくりと歩き、学園へと歩いて行く親子連れ。親戚。姉妹。
lines.translated: All around me were scenes of people heading toward the academy with their loved ones--parents and children walking slowly up the sloped road together. Relatives. Sisters.

lines.content: 誰もが笑顔で[・|こ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]のことを話し合っていた。
lines.translated: Everyone was smiling and talking about the future.

lines.content: ひとりなのは私だけ。私の隣にだけ、誰もいない。
lines.translated: I was the only one alone. Only the space beside me was empty.

lines.content: 坂の途中で立ち止まる。
lines.translated: I stopped halfway up the hill.

lines.content: やっぱりこのままズル休みしてしまおうか。
lines.translated: Maybe I should just play hooky and skip the whole thing after all.

lines.content: 今日は特別な日なのだから、特別なことをしてしまってもいい。
lines.translated: Today is a special day, so it's okay to do something special, right?

lines.content: 私ひとりいなくても、卒業式はつつがなく始まって、つつがなく、終わるだろう。
lines.translated: Even without me there, the graduation ceremony will start without a hitch, and end without a hitch.

lines.content: そして気づけば、私はいつの間にか大人になってる。そういうのも悪くはないかな。そう、思う。
lines.translated: And before I know it, I'll have grown into an adult. Maybe that wouldn't be such a bad way to go about it. That's what I thought.

lines.content: ひとり学園に背を向けた。
lines.translated: Alone, I turned my back on the academy.

lines.content: 坂の途中だ。そこから振り向くと、春に染まった町が見渡せた。
lines.translated: I was halfway up the hill. Looking back from there, I could see the entire town dyed in the colors of spring.

lines.content: 誰とも繋がれない空っぽな手のひらを……私は、その光景に向けて伸ばした。
lines.translated: I reached my empty palm, unable to connect with anyone... out toward that scenery.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]にはたくさんの思い出が詰まっているはずだった。たくさんの人と笑い合えた町のはずだった。
lines.translated: This place was supposed to be filled with so many memories. It was supposed to be a town where I laughed with so many people.

lines.content: だけど、どうして。
lines.translated: So why?

lines.content: 誰かの思い出だけが、いつも、足りない。
lines.translated: Why are the memories of that one person always missing?

lines.content: ……うそつき
lines.translated: "...Liar."

lines.content: ふと、心の中から言葉がこぼれた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, words spilled out from deep within my heart.

lines.content: 私自身、どこから産まれてきた想いなのかもわからないけれど……ただ、言葉が、止まらなかった。
lines.translated: Even I didn't know where these feelings were coming from... I just couldn't stop the words.

lines.content: ……ずっと、ずっと、一緒にいてくれるって……言ったのに
lines.translated: "...You said... you'd stay with me forever and ever..."

lines.content: 私は……。
lines.translated: What about me...?

lines.content: 私は、いつも誰かの背中を追っていた。
lines.translated: I was always chasing after someone's back.

lines.content: だけど“さよなら”をした。その誰かとはもう会えない。
lines.translated: But I said "goodbye." I can never meet that person again.

lines.content: ……“さよなら”は、きらい。大嫌い
lines.translated: "...I hate 'goodbyes.' I hate them so much."

lines.content: そうつぶやくと……。
lines.translated: The moment I whispered that...

lines.content: 涙だ。
lines.translated: A tear.

lines.content: 涙が、こぼれた。
lines.translated: A tear spilled over.

lines.content: ぽろぽろこぼれた。
lines.translated: Tears began to spill down my cheeks.

lines.content: どうしてこんな気持ちになるんだろう。
lines.translated: Why do I feel like this?

lines.content: 自分が何を悲しんでいるのかもわからないのに、涙はいつまでも、止まらなくって。
lines.translated: Even though I don't know what I'm grieving over, the tears just won't stop.

lines.content: 通り過ぎる人たちがそんな私を不思議そうに見ていても……。
lines.translated: Even as the people passing by looked at me curiously...

lines.content: やっぱり私の涙は次々、流れる。
lines.translated: My tears kept flowing, one after another.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: 私の人生は“さよなら”がたくさんだ。
lines.translated: My life is full of "goodbyes."

lines.content: だから私は、ひとりぼっちで……さみしい今ばかりがここにある。
lines.translated: That's why I'm all alone... left with nothing but this lonely present.

lines.content: これからも、私の小さな身体には背負いきれないくらいの“さよなら”が、たくさん、いっぱい、降り注ぐのだろうか――……この、[・|さ][・|く][・|ら][・|み][・|た][・|い][・|に]。
lines.translated: From now on, will even more "goodbyes"--too many for my small body to bear--keep pouring down on me, over and over... just like these cherry blossoms?

lines.content: はらはらと、
lines.translated: Fluttering down,

lines.content: ひらひらと、
lines.translated: drifting softly,

lines.content: この町を覆い尽くす春の花みたいに。
lines.translated: like the spring flowers blanketing this entire town.

lines.content: 私の鼻先に触れた、この、[ひとひら|一片]みたいに……。
lines.translated: Like this single petal that just brushed the tip of my nose...

lines.content: ……声だ。
lines.translated: A voice.

lines.content: 声がした。
lines.translated: A voice called out.

lines.content: 学園のほうからだ。
lines.translated: It's coming from the academy.

lines.content: ……騒がしい。
lines.translated: A commotion.

lines.content: わっと歓声が上がる。
lines.translated: A loud cheer goes up.

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: ……なんだろう
lines.translated: "...What could that be?"

lines.content: つぶやくと、不思議だ。
lines.translated: As I murmured to myself, something strange happened.

lines.content: 私の中にふと蘇る光景があった。
lines.translated: A scene suddenly resurfaced within my mind.
Long ago...

lines.content: 随分と昔のことだ。
lines.translated: A very long time ago.

lines.content: 誰かに。
lines.translated: By someone.

lines.content: 今はもう思い出せない誰かに呼び出され……。
lines.translated: I was called out by someone I can no longer remember...

lines.content: 今と同じように、ひとりでこの坂を上り……。
lines.translated: And just like now, I walked up this hill all alone...

lines.content: そんな私を迎えた騒がしい[・|屋][・|上]を、そこに立つ人を、私は、見上げ……。
lines.translated: I looked up at the noisy rooftop that welcomed me, and at the person standing there...

lines.content: ……何か。
lines.translated: Something.

lines.content: ……何かとても、とても恥ずかしくって、だけどすごくうれしいことが……あったような
lines.translated: "...I feel like something very, very embarrassing, yet wonderfully happy... happened back then."

lines.content: ひとりつぶやいた私は、短い後ろ髪を翻すようにして学園へと振り返り――急いだ。急ぎ足で、進んだ。
lines.translated: Whispering to myself, I spun around toward the academy, my short hair flaring behind me--and hurried. I pressed forward at a brisk pace.

lines.content: 予感がしていた。
lines.translated: I had a premonition.

lines.content: 何かがはじまり。
lines.translated: Something was beginning.

lines.content: 何かが、終わる。
lines.translated: And something was ending.

lines.content: ……そんな予感だ。
lines.translated: That was the premonition I had.

lines.content: だけど急がなければ、目を凝らしていなければ、直ぐにでも簡単に見過ごしてしまう――
lines.translated: But if I didn't hurry, if I didn't look closely, I would easily miss it in the blink of an eye--

lines.content: そんな[ささ|細]やかな恋心のような、一瞬の何かが、この坂道の先で待っているような……。
lines.translated: It felt like something fleeting, like a delicate budding romance, was waiting for me at the top of this hill...

lines.content: 『――……ずっとだ』
lines.translated: "--...For so long."

lines.content: 声が、響いてきた。学園のほうからだ。
lines.translated: A voice echoed out. It was coming from the academy.

lines.content: 『――ずっと、今日までずっと、心のどこかで誰かのことを探してた』
lines.translated: "--For so long, right up until today, somewhere in my heart I've been searching for someone."

lines.content: 拡声器のようなものを通して、大きく、おおきく広げられた声が響いている。
lines.translated: Amplified louder and louder through something like a megaphone, the voice echoed across the area.

lines.content: 『……でも、おかしい。不思議なんだ……わからない。何も、わからないんだよ』
lines.translated: "...But it's strange. It makes no sense... I don't know. I don't know anything at all!"

lines.content: 『昨日までの自分が誰を探してて。そして、今……今日の自分が、いったい、誰のことを[・|忘][・|れ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|る][・|の][・|か]……』
lines.translated: "Who was I searching for up until yesterday? And right now... today, who on earth have I forgotten...?"

lines.content: 私は自然と、急ぎ足から小走りになっている。
lines.translated: Naturally, my brisk walk turned into a light jog.

lines.content: 『俺には大切な人がいた。大切にしたいと祈ったはずの人がいた。いつもそばにいて、俺を、心配してくれていた人がいた。それだけは、思い出せたのに……』
lines.translated: "There was someone precious to me. Someone I know I prayed to cherish. Someone who was always by my side, worrying about me. I managed to remember that much, and yet..."

lines.content: 私は坂道を駆け上がり……。
lines.translated: I dashed up the sloped road...

lines.content: 『[・|君]が誰より、何より、大切な人だったということだけは、思い出せたのに……』
lines.translated: "I managed to remember that you were more precious to me than anyone, or anything else, and yet..."

lines.content: 『それなのに……どうして』
lines.translated: "Even so... why?"

lines.content: 『どうして君の顔だけが、どうしても、どうしても……思い出せないんだ……っ』
lines.translated: "Why is it only your face that I just can't... can't remember no matter what...?!"

lines.content: おかしい。どうして。何がなんだかわからない。こんなバカなことがあるのか――うわごとのような言葉がぼそぼそと漏れる。
lines.translated: This is crazy. Why? I don't know what's going on. How could something so absurd happen?--Words like delirious ramblings leaked out in a quiet mutter over the speaker.

lines.content: 『……ごめん。ごめんな』
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. I'm so sorry."

lines.content: 『何が起きてるのかわからないし、何もかもが唐突で……混乱ばかりで、頭がどうにかってしまいそうだけど……ごめん』
lines.translated: "I don't know what's happening, and everything is so sudden... I'm so confused I feel like I'm losing my mind, but... I'm sorry."

lines.content: ごめんなと、繰り返し響いてくる。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry," echoed over and over again.

lines.content: 『ずっと一緒だって、もうひとりぼっちにはさせないからって、そう、約束をしたはずなのに。それなのに……』
lines.translated: "Even though I promised we'd always be together, that I'd never let you be all alone again. Even so..."

lines.content: 私は、校門をくぐり抜け……。
lines.translated: I slipped through the school gates...

lines.content: 『……[・|ま][・|た]、こんな形で、ごめん』
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry for doing it like this again."

lines.content: 『信じられないけれど。バカ、みたいだけれど』
lines.translated: "I know it's hard to believe. I know I sound like an idiot."

lines.content: 『今日まで、君のことを忘れてしまっていた俺だから……』
lines.translated: "Because up until today, I had completely forgotten about you..."

lines.content: 『でもまだ、まだまだ、どうしても……君のことをすべて思い出せない、俺だから……』
lines.translated: "And even now, no matter how hard I try... I still can't remember everything about you..."

lines.content: 『……そんな俺は、ここにいるかもしれない君へ、こんな形でしか呼びかけられないけれど……』
lines.translated: "...And because I'm like this, this is the only way I can call out to you, hoping you might be here..."

lines.content: 校庭で、空を仰ぎ立ち止まる人たちの間を、かいくぐり……。
lines.translated: I wove my way through the people standing frozen in the schoolyard, looking up at the sky...

lines.content: 『ここに、いますか』
lines.translated: "Are you here?"

lines.content: 『俺の大切な人は、大切にしなきゃならない人は、今、この声が届く限りのどこかに……いますか』
lines.translated: "The person precious to me, the person I must cherish--are you somewhere out there right now, within the reach of my voice...?"

lines.content: 『もしもこの声が届くのなら、聞いてほしい。伝えたいことが、あるんだ』
lines.translated: "If my voice is reaching you, please listen. There's something I want to tell you."

lines.content: 『どうか……』
lines.translated: "Please..."

lines.content: 『どうか、お願いします……っ』
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you...!"

lines.content: 校庭に集まった人たちと同じように、私は[・|そ][・|れ]を、[・|そ][・|の][・|人]を、見上げた……。
lines.translated: Just like the crowd gathered in the schoolyard, I looked up at it--at that person...
"Chiwa..."

lines.content: ぽつりと言葉が、落とされる――最初、それは聞き間違いなのかと思った。
lines.translated: A single word was dropped softly into the air--at first, I thought my ears were playing tricks on me.

lines.content: 小さなちいさな声だったから、私は、私が一番ほしい言葉を、都合良く聞き間違えてしまったのかと、思った……。
lines.translated: Because it was such a tiny, quiet voice, I thought I had conveniently misheard it as the word I wanted to hear most of all...

lines.content: 『……千和っ』
lines.translated: "...Chiwa!"

lines.content: でも、違った。
lines.translated: But I was wrong.

lines.content: 『杏藤千和……っ』
lines.translated: "Ando Chiwa...!"

lines.content: その人は、叫んだ。
lines.translated: That person shouted.

lines.content: 『聞こえてるか……俺の、俺の一番、大切な人……っ』
lines.translated: "Can you hear me...? My, my most precious person...!"

lines.content: どうか、お願いだ、俺と――……っ
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you, with me--...!"

lines.content: そこで扉が勢いよく開かれる音が響いた――きっと、屋上の扉だ。
lines.translated: Just then, the sound of a door flying open echoed out--it had to be the door to the roof.

lines.content: 続いて“お前、何をやってるんだっ”という誰かの怒声が響く。
lines.translated: Next came someone's angry shout: "What the hell do you think you're doing?!"

lines.content: “おいっ、まさか……また、お前かっ”
lines.translated: "Hey, don't tell me... it's you again?!"

lines.content: 拡声器が屋上の出来事を拾い上げ、町中に響かせている。
lines.translated: The megaphone picked up the commotion on the roof and broadcast it across the entire town.

lines.content: “ＯＢになってまで何をしてるんだお前はっ”“今日は何の日かわかってやってるのかっ”
lines.translated: "What are you doing pulling a stunt like this after you've already graduated?!" "Do you have any idea what day it is today?!"

lines.content: 『ああっ、わかってるっ、わかってるさっ、申し訳ないとも思ってる――だけど、だけど……っ、これしか方法がなかったんだっ。急がないと、また、忘れてしまいそうで……』
lines.translated: "Yeah, I know, I know! And I feel terrible about it--but, but...! This was the only way! If I didn't hurry, I felt like I'd forget all over again...!"

lines.content: 『だから頼むよっ、少しだけ黙っててくれよっ、なあ、おいっ、見て、わかるだろ――わかってくれよっ、今、大切なところなんだ！』
lines.translated: "So please, just be quiet for a second! Come on, hey, just look, you can tell, right?--Please understand, I'm right at the most important part!"

lines.content: は、はは……
lines.translated: "H-Haha..."

lines.content: どうしよう。
lines.translated: What should I do?

lines.content: たくさんの人たちが私を見てる。
lines.translated: So many people were looking at me.

lines.content: 恥ずかしくって。
lines.translated: It was embarrassing.

lines.content: ……でもちょっとだけ、うれしい気持ちもあって。
lines.translated: But I also felt a little bit happy.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……不思議。
lines.translated: How strange.

lines.content: 私も、思い出せたよ。
lines.translated: I managed to remember, too.
Welcome back, Senpai.

lines.content: ……私の、大好きだった人。
lines.translated: The person I loved so much.

lines.content: 先輩の、ばか
lines.translated: "You idiot, Senpai."

lines.content: 恥ずかしいから、こういうのはもうやめてって、言ったのに
lines.translated: "I told you to stop doing things like this because it's embarrassing."

lines.content: 私はなんだかとても、とても久しぶりに笑顔になれた……。
lines.translated: For the first time in a very, very long time, I was able to smile...

lines.content: そんな気がした。
lines.translated: Or so it felt.

lines.content: ……この頃よく見る夢がある。
lines.translated: There's a dream I've been having a lot lately.

lines.content: ……春だ
lines.translated: "...It's spring."

lines.content: きらきら光る“夜”の中……。
lines.translated: Inside the glittering "Night"...

lines.content: ……あの子が学園を卒業し、大人になるその日まで……どうか
lines.translated: "...Until the day that girl graduates from the academy and becomes an adult... please."

lines.content: 俺は、誰かと約束をしていた。
lines.translated: I was making a promise with someone.

lines.content: ……どうか俺に、俺たちに、時間をもらえないだろうか
lines.translated: "...Could you please give me--give us--some time?"

lines.content: 俺が大切な人を想うのと同じように――
lines.translated: Just as I cared for the person precious to me--

lines.content: いや、もしかすると、俺なんかよりもずっと千和のことを大切に想っていた――何者か。
lines.translated: No, perhaps this someone cared for Chiwa even more deeply than someone like me ever could.

lines.content: ……これから、どんなにあの子のことを忘れてしまっていても。あの子が卒業し、大人になる日には……どうかお前があの子のそばにいてやってほしい
lines.translated: "...No matter how much you might forget about her from here on out. On the day she graduates and becomes an adult... I want you to be there by her side, no matter what."

lines.content: その誰かと、俺は、ふたりきりで誓い合ったのだ。
lines.translated: Just the two of us, that someone and I, swore an oath to each other.

lines.content: ……その日までは責任を持って、千和のことを――……
lines.translated: "...Until that day comes, I will take responsibility and look after Chiwa--..."

lines.content: 約束を。
lines.translated: A promise.

lines.content: 誓いを。
lines.translated: An oath.

lines.content: そして心を、ほんの少し交換し合えたように思う誰かは……いつも。
lines.translated: And that someone, with whom I felt I had exchanged a tiny piece of my heart... always.

lines.content: いつもだ。
lines.translated: Always.

lines.content: ……俺は、幸せについて知りたかった。この命の価値について、知りたかったんだ。いつも、いつでも。そればかりを願ってた
lines.translated: "...I wanted to know about happiness. I wanted to know the value of this life. Always, at all times. That was all I ever wished for."

lines.content: いつも、どこかさみしそうな顔で、微笑むのだった――……
lines.translated: He would always smile with a somewhat lonely look on his face--...

lines.content: がたんとひとつ、大きく荷台が揺れた。その衝撃で目を覚ます。
lines.translated: The bed of the cart gave a sudden, heavy jolt. The impact woke me up.

lines.content: ……星空だ。
lines.translated: A starry sky.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開けばそこには満天の星空が広がっている。
lines.translated: When I opened my eyelids, a sky full of stars stretched out above me.

lines.content: 小さく身体を震わせた。少し、寒い――[まぶた|瞼]をこすりながら、『ここはどこだ』と問いかける。
lines.translated: I gave a slight shiver. It was a little cold--rubbing my eyelids, I asked myself, "Where am I?"

lines.content: ……今、どれくらい進んだ？
lines.translated: "...How far have we gotten now?"

lines.content: ああ、今日はここまでで四、五キロって具合かな
lines.translated: "Yeah, let's see, we've gone about four or five kilometers so far today."

lines.content: 息の上がった声が返ってくる。
lines.translated: A breathless voice came back in reply.

lines.content: そろそろここら辺で休もうかと思ってたところだ――問題は？
lines.translated: "I was just thinking about taking a break around here--any problems?"

lines.content: ああ。特になしだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Nothing in particular."

lines.content: うなずき、応える。
lines.translated: I nodded and answered.

lines.content: こっちもだ。こっちもそろそろ[・|代][・|わ][・|ろ][・|う][・|か][・|と]思ってたところだよ
lines.translated: "Same here. I was just thinking it was about time we traded places, too."

lines.content: そう言い身体を起こすと、えー、ほんとかよと笑い声が返ってくる。
lines.translated: When I said that and sat up, he laughed and replied, "Wait, seriously?"

lines.content: 横になっていた[・|リ][・|ア][・|カ][・|ー][・|の][・|荷][・|台]から俺は飛び降りる。
lines.translated: I hopped down from the bed of the two-wheeled cart where I had been lying.

lines.content: ……砂漠だ。
lines.translated: It was a desert.

lines.content: 足下をさらさらと乾燥した砂が流れていく。
lines.translated: Dry sand slid smoothly beneath my feet.

lines.content: うう。やっぱ夜になると、寒いな。昼間はあんなに暑かったのに
lines.translated: "Ugh. It really does get cold at night. Even though it was so hot during the day."

lines.content: ああ、そうだなあ。気温の落差がとんでもないな――しかし、大雅も大雅だ。よくこんな寒い中で眠れるなあって思ってた
lines.translated: "Yeah, no kidding. The temperature drop is insane--though you're something else yourself, Taiga. I was wondering how on earth you could sleep in this cold."

lines.content: だから、休憩を？
lines.translated: "Is that why we're taking a break?"

lines.content: そうだな。そんなところだよ。こんな砂漠のど真ん中で風邪を引いたら大変だ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Pretty much. It'd be bad news if we caught a cold right in the middle of a desert like this."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずき、見渡す。
lines.translated: I nodded and looked around.

lines.content: 砂だ。見渡す限り砂の地平。
lines.translated: Sand. A horizon of sand as far as the eye could see.

lines.content: しかし前方の遠目には、大波のように隆起した砂の山が見えている。
lines.translated: However, far off in the distance ahead of us, I could see mountains of sand rising up like giant waves.

lines.content: そのてっぺんに、大きなおおきな三日月が沈みかけていた――……静かだ。
lines.translated: Right at their peak, a huge, massive crescent moon was beginning to set--...It was quiet.

lines.content: 星々はため息をこぼすかのように瞬いていて、大きな月は俺たちなんて知らない顔で、眠りについた地上を照らしている。
lines.translated: The stars twinkled as if letting out sighs, and the giant moon illuminated the sleeping earth below, completely indifferent to our existence.

lines.content: 生き物は、いない。俺たち以外には何者もいない。
lines.translated: There were no living creatures. There was no one here besides us.

lines.content: 少なくとも、ぱっと見渡して気づけるほどのものは、どこにも。
lines.translated: At the very least, nothing we could spot with a quick glance around.

lines.content: 簡単な薬はあっても、病院どころか医者も看護師も何もいない。何もないから……風邪くらいでも命取りかもしれないな
lines.translated: "We might have some basic medicine, but forget a hospital, there aren't any doctors or nurses or anything out here. Since there's nothing around... even a simple cold could be fatal."

lines.content: ぶるりと身体を震わせ、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Shivering, I spoke.

lines.content: こんなところで大怪我でもしたらどうなるのかな。俺たちここにいますよって発信できるものは何も持ってきてないしな
lines.translated: "What would happen if we got seriously injured in a place like this? We didn't bring anything that could broadcast our location, either."

lines.content: うーん。それって遭難と同じだろ？　こんなところで行き場をなくしてしまった俺たちを助けに来てくれる誰かはいるのかなあ
lines.translated: "Hmm. Wouldn't that basically be the same as being stranded? I wonder if anyone would even come to rescue us if we got stuck out here with nowhere to go."

lines.content: ……そういえば昔見た映画でさ、[ソロプレイ|孤独な冒険]好きな探検家が、落石と石壁の間に手を挟まれて動けなくなった――みたいなのがあったなあ
lines.translated: "...Come to think of it, in a movie I saw a long time ago, there was this explorer who liked solo adventures, and he got his hand pinned between a falling rock and a stone wall and couldn't move--something like that."

lines.content: 舞台は砂漠ではないけれど、その映画も人なんて滅多に来ない荒野でのことだった。
lines.translated: It wasn't set in a desert, but that movie also took place in a wilderness where people rarely ever came.

lines.content: うへえ。聞いてるだけで痛くなるな。で？　その人、どうなったんだ？
lines.translated: "Ugh. Just hearing about it makes me ache. So? What happened to the guy?"

lines.content: 紆余曲折あって……数十時間後
lines.translated: "After a lot of twists and turns... dozens of hours later."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 挟まれた腕を小さな……豆みたいにちいさなナイフで、自分の腕を、こうしたんだ
lines.translated: "He took a tiny... a knife as tiny as a bean to his trapped arm, and did this to his own arm."

lines.content: 俺は、左手の手首にチョップするような仕草をして見せた。
lines.translated: I made a chopping motion against my left wrist.

lines.content: おいやめろよ。そんなグロい話。痛々しいし、なんだか……うう、なんだか悲しくもなってくるだろ
lines.translated: "Hey, knock it off with the gory stories. It sounds painful, and kinda... ugh, it kinda makes me feel sad, too."

lines.content: だから直接的な言葉は避けたろ？　切断っていう言葉はさ
lines.translated: "That's why I avoided using the direct word for it, right? The word 'amputation,' I mean."

lines.content: ……結局、言っちゃってるじゃん
lines.translated: "...You ended up saying it anyway."

lines.content: お前ならその場合どうする？　水もない。通信機はない。手は、ずっと抜けないまま。叫んでもわめいても誰も……誰も、自分に気づいてくれない
lines.translated: "What would you do in that situation? No water. No communication device. Your hand is completely stuck. No matter how much you scream and shout, nobody... nobody notices you."

lines.content: そういう場面に窮したら、お前は何を犠牲にするのかな。そう問いかけてみる。
lines.translated: If you were cornered in a situation like that, what would you sacrifice? I tried asking him that.

lines.content: うーん。俺だったらそのまま餓死することを選ぶな
lines.translated: "Hmm. If it were me, I'd choose to just starve to death right there."

lines.content: え。マジかよ
lines.translated: "Wait. Seriously?"

lines.content: だって手がなくなったら楽器の殆どが弾けなくなっちゃうだろ。そんなの……生きてる意味、ねえって
lines.translated: "Well, if I lost my hand, I wouldn't be able to play most instruments anymore, right? At that point... there's no meaning to being alive."

lines.content: 何言ってんだ。お前、もう殆ど音楽やってないじゃないか
lines.translated: "What are you talking about? You barely even play music anymore."

lines.content: ああ、言われてみればそうだった
lines.translated: "Ah, now that you mention it, that's true."

lines.content: ……俺たちが普段通りに交わす会話。
lines.translated: The casual conversation we exchanged as usual.

lines.content: それさえもがひどく大きなものに感じられるほどの静けさだ。
lines.translated: The silence was so deep that even our chatter felt overwhelmingly loud.

lines.content: くしゃみを、ひとつ。
lines.translated: I let out a single sneeze.

lines.content: 静かな空気を引き裂かんばかりにそれは響いた。
lines.translated: It echoed out, practically tearing through the quiet air.

lines.content: ぶるりと身体を震わせる――俺の上着、着るか？　と智仁。やめろよ。やさしくするなよ。今、俺たちふたりしかいないんだぞ。と、俺は目を細める。
lines.translated: I shivered--"Want to wear my jacket?" Tomohito asked. "Stop it. Don't be nice to me. It's just the two of us out here right now, you know," I replied, narrowing my eyes.

lines.content: こんなさみしいところでやさしくされてみろよ。俺、お前に惚れちゃうかもしれないだろ。今夜くらい抱かれてやってもいいかなって、そんな気にもなっちゃうだろ
lines.translated: "Try being nice to me in a lonely place like this. I might just fall for you, you know? It might even put me in the mood to let you hold me just for tonight."

lines.content: はっはっは、と快活に笑う智仁だ。
lines.translated: "Hahaha," Tomohito laughed heartily.

lines.content: そういうのもまた需要があるんじゃあないのかな、と言う。だって互いにご無沙汰だろう、とまで言い出す。やめろ。冗談だから。本当に。マジで。
lines.translated: "There might be a demand for that sort of thing too, don't you think?" he said. He even went so far as to add, "After all, it's been a long dry spell for the both of us." Stop. It was a joke. Really. Seriously.

lines.content: しかしほんと、ものすごい寒暖の差だな。話に聞いたとおりだった
lines.translated: "Still, the temperature difference really is insane. Just like we heard."

lines.content: ああ、そうだな
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really is."

lines.content: 昼間はぎらぎら熱くても、夜になれば凍える寒さ――映画とか漫画とか、小説とかで、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|の]はさ、まったく砂漠地帯の定番だが……
lines.translated: "Even though it's blazing hot during the day, it gets freezing cold at night--in movies and manga and novels, that sort of thing is a total desert cliche, though..."

lines.content: ああ。うそじゃなかった。しっかりとした取材に基づいた描写だったってわけだな
lines.translated: "Yeah. It wasn't a lie. Guess those depictions were based on solid research."

lines.content: なるほどなー。物語はリアルと空想のハイブリットってわけだ。改めて実感した。感服した。痛感もさせられたなあ
lines.translated: "I see, I see. So stories are a hybrid of reality and fantasy. I've really come to realize that all over again. Color me impressed. It really hit home."

lines.content: うむ。そして砂漠は本当に、広い
lines.translated: "Indeed. And the desert really is vast."

lines.content: ああ。それもまた、うそじゃなかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. That wasn't a lie, either."

lines.content: そんな下らないことを言い、俺たちは笑い合った。
lines.translated: Saying such pointless things, the two of us laughed together.

lines.content: ……旅をしている。
lines.translated: I'm on a journey.

lines.content: 智仁と一緒にだ。
lines.translated: Together with Tomohito.

lines.content: 目的はない。目的地だってない。
lines.translated: We have no purpose. We don't even have a destination.

lines.content: 学園を卒業して以来、ただただ俺は、智仁とふたりで世界中を旅して回っている――リアカーを、引いて。
lines.translated: Ever since graduating from the academy, Tomohito and I have just been traveling around the world together--pulling a handcart.

lines.content: そう。リアカーだ。
lines.translated: That's right. A handcart.

lines.content: 要するに徒歩だ。歩きだ。乗り物を使わぬ戦い――肉弾戦だ。
lines.translated: In short, on foot. Walking. A battle without using vehicles--hand-to-hand combat.
It was a journey with the self-imposed rule to "keep doing it that way as much as humanly possible."

lines.content: おんぼろなリアカーをひとつ、延々と引き、世界中のありとあらゆる場所を俺たちは回った。
lines.translated: Endlessly pulling a single, beat-up handcart, we traveled to every imaginable place around the world.

lines.content: 疲れたときはじゃんけんで牽引するほうを決め……。
lines.translated: Whenever we got tired, we'd play rock-paper-scissors to decide who had to pull it...

lines.content: ときに日本人だけを狙った山賊に狙われ、[さら|攫]われ……しかしあまりに何も持っていないからと、逆に小銭をもらってしまったようなこともあった。
lines.translated: Sometimes we were targeted and kidnapped by bandits who only went after Japanese people... only for them to end up giving us pocket change out of pity because we had practically nothing on us.

lines.content: また、ときおり飢えて死にそうになりながら……。
lines.translated: Other times, we nearly starved to death...

lines.content: または原因不明の高熱や腹痛に喘ぎ、“あれ。俺、死んじゃうの？”と本気で走馬燈らしきものを見た夜もありながら……。
lines.translated: And there were nights when I gasped for breath from a high fever or stomachache of unknown origin, genuinely seeing my life flash before my eyes and thinking, "Wait. Am I gonna die?"...

lines.content: 雨の日も、風の日も、ぎらぎら暑い晴れの日も。
lines.translated: On rainy days, on windy days, and on blazing hot, sunny days.

lines.content: 動物園でしか見たことのない猛獣の住む荒野だったり、巨大な虫の蠢く密林地帯だったり、あきらかに歓迎されてないだろうと思えるおしゃれな街も……。
lines.translated: Through wildernesses inhabited by fierce beasts I'd only ever seen in zoos, dense jungles crawling with giant bugs, and even stylish towns where we were obviously far from welcome...

lines.content: あらゆる場所や、あらゆる国でリアカーを引き、回った。
lines.translated: We pulled our handcart around every kind of place, in every kind of country.

lines.content: ……なあ、智仁
lines.translated: "...Hey, Tomohito."

lines.content: ああ、なんだ、親友
lines.translated: "Yeah, what is it, my best friend?"

lines.content: 野営の準備を終え、起こした火で最後の食料――残しておいたマシュマロが焼けていくのを眺めながら、言う。
lines.translated: Having finished setting up camp, I spoke while watching the last of our food--some marshmallows we'd saved--roasting over the fire we'd built.

lines.content: これを食べたら、もう食べる物、何もないんだよなあ、そんなことをのんびりと思いながら。
lines.translated: Once we eat this, we won't have a single thing left to eat, I thought idly to myself.

lines.content: 俺たち、どうしてこんな冒険しようと思ったんだったっけか
lines.translated: "Why did we decide to go on an adventure like this again?"

lines.content: お。弱音ですか
lines.translated: "Oh? Are you whining?"

lines.content: ……む。違うさ
lines.translated: "...Hmph. Of course not."

lines.content: 唇を尖らせる。
lines.translated: I pouted.

lines.content: 確かもうそろそろ一年だろ。俺たちが日本を……あの町を飛び出してから、一年だ。だからちょっとだけ感傷に浸りたくもなったんだ
lines.translated: "It's been almost a year now, right? A year since we flew the coop and left Japan... left that town. So I just felt like getting a little sentimental."

lines.content: ふむ。炎の揺らめきは人の心を癒やしたり、ちょっとおセンチな気分にさせたりもするらしいからな。致し方ない
lines.translated: "Hmm. They say the flickering of flames can soothe a person's heart and make them feel a little sentimental, after all. Can't be helped."

lines.content: 意地悪そうな笑みを浮かべ、智仁は答えた――大雅が行こうぜって俺を誘ったんだろ、と。
lines.translated: With a teasing grin on his face, Tomohito answered--saying that I was the one who invited him, telling him, "Let's go."

lines.content: 忘れたなんて言わせないぞ？　大雅。卒業式のときにさ、学生時代最後のときだっていうのに、お前、説教好きのおじいちゃん先生に説教されてたろ？
lines.translated: "I won't let you say you forgot, okay, Taiga? Back at the graduation ceremony, even though it was the very last moment of our student days, you were getting lectured by that old teacher who loved lecturing people, remember?"

lines.content: ああ……。うん。今やすべてが懐かしい
lines.translated: "Ah... Yeah. It all feels so nostalgic now."

lines.content: 満点の星空を見上げ、俺は思い出している。
lines.translated: Looking up at the sky full of stars, I thought back on it.

lines.content: “おい奏大雅。ぎりぎり卒業はできるがな……お前。進学先ではちゃんと英語を身につけておけよ。英語をしっかり学んでおかなければ、今の時代、生きていけないぞ”
lines.translated: "'Listen up, Kanade Taiga. You're barely scraping by to graduate, you know... Make sure you actually learn English at whatever school you're going to next. If you don't study English properly, you won't be able to survive in this day and age.'"

lines.content: そんなことを言われ……。
lines.translated: Being told something like that...

lines.content: 考え方、古っ。
lines.translated: What an outdated way of thinking.

lines.content: と内心、顔をしかめたり……。
lines.translated: I grimaced inwardly...

lines.content: 卒業式のときくらい素直におめでとうと言えないのかしらこの説教好きの先生はとも思い……。
lines.translated: Wondering if this lecture-happy teacher couldn't just honestly say "congratulations" at least on graduation day...

lines.content: しかし呆れるのを通り越し、むしろ徹底したその姿に好感さえ覚えたのだが……。
lines.translated: Though, past a certain point of exasperation, I actually felt a sort of fondness for how thorough he was about it...

lines.content: ふむ。
lines.translated: Hmm.

lines.content: 疑問が湧いたのだ。
lines.translated: A question had popped into my head.

lines.content: 英語を習得しなければ生きてはいけない。
lines.translated: You can't survive unless you master English.

lines.content: それって、本当？
lines.translated: Is that really true?

lines.content: うそじゃあなくて？
lines.translated: Is that not a lie?

lines.content: じゃあそれを試しに行ってみよう。
lines.translated: Well then, let's go test it out.

lines.content: 英語なんて実は中学生レベルも怪しいが、こんな状態で海外へ放り出されたなら――本当？　本当に、俺、生きていけないの？
lines.translated: My English is honestly questionable even at a middle school level, so if I were thrown overseas in this state--really? Would I really not be able to survive?

lines.content: それを試してみようと、なぜだか急に思い立ったのだ――そもそも誰が進学すると言った。俺の未来は自由だ。ただの未定とも言うがとにかく自由なんだ。
lines.translated: For some reason, I suddenly decided to put that to the test--besides, who ever said I was going on to higher education? My future is free. You could also call it completely undecided, but either way, it's free.

lines.content: しかしただただ海外旅行をしたって味気ない。そんなのは単純に楽しいばかりの思い出作りだ。
lines.translated: However, just going on a normal trip overseas would be boring. That would simply be making fun memories.

lines.content: そう思っていたところに、
lines.translated: Just as I was thinking that,

lines.content: 『おい大雅、近所のゴミ捨て場にこんなすてきな乗り物、見つけちゃったぞ』
lines.translated: "'Hey, Taiga, look at this awesome ride I found at the neighborhood dump!'"

lines.content: 満面の笑みで智仁が引いてきたのが……ぼろぼろのリアカーだった。
lines.translated: What Tomohito came pulling along with a huge grin on his face... was a beat-up old handcart.

lines.content: よっしゃ行くかと俺はそれに飛び乗り――現在に至るのだ。
lines.translated: "Alright, let's do this," I said, jumping right onto it--which brings us to the present.

lines.content: ……あれ。おかしいな。智仁。今の回想の中に、俺がお前を誘ったような描写はまるでなかったが
lines.translated: "...Wait. That's weird, Tomohito. In the flashback I just had, there wasn't a single scene where I invited you."

lines.content: 大雅がどんな回想したのかはしらないけれど……。まあ、いいじゃないか。どっちが誘おうと。きっと自然とどちらともなく言い出してたさ
lines.translated: "I don't know what kind of flashback you just had, but... well, who cares which one of us invited the other? I'm sure we both just naturally brought it up at the same time."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうかもなあ。と俺はうなずく。
lines.translated: "Yeah, maybe," I nodded.

lines.content: 俺たちの旅には、“この目で見てもいないのに、それが世界の常識だと信じてしまってるものは果たして真実であるのか否かを確かめる”――
lines.translated: Before we knew it, our journey had developed a vague sort of guideline, if not quite a purpose:

lines.content: といった、漠然とした目的ともいえない指針がいつの間にかできていた。
lines.translated: "To verify whether the things we believe to be common sense in this world, despite never having seen them with our own eyes, are actually the truth or not."

lines.content: 今まで確かめられたものは数多い。
lines.translated: There were many things we had verified so far.

lines.content: 英語がしゃべれないのは不便ではあったが、生きてはいけた――色々騙され、色々迷い、色々と痛い目に遭ってしまいはしたが。
lines.translated: Not being able to speak English was inconvenient, sure, but we could still survive--even if we got scammed in all sorts of ways, got lost a bunch, and went through a lot of painful experiences.

lines.content: 世界中にそういった真実――のようなものを幾つもいくつも、見つけたれたなら……。
lines.translated: If I could find many, many more truths--or things like them--all over the world...

lines.content: 俺は……。
そうして、俺は。
lines.translated: By doing so, I...

lines.content: 何か、[・|大][・|切][・|な][・|も][・|の]を思い出せるのではないかと、感じてる……。
lines.translated: I feel like I might be able to remember something *important*...

lines.content: ……俺もさ、同じだったんだよ
lines.translated: "...It was the same for me, you know."

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ああ。俺もだ。実は、俺もなんだよ、大雅。俺もちょうど何かを忘れてしまっているような……。そんな気がしてさ。どうにもじっとなんてしてられなかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Me too. The truth is, it's the same for me, Taiga. I also felt like I had just forgotten something... I had that exact feeling. I just couldn't sit still."

lines.content: だから大雅と一緒に旅に出よう。そうしよう。きっとそれがいいはずだ――そう、思い立ったのだと智仁は言った。
lines.translated: "So let's go on a journey together with Taiga. Let's do that. I'm sure that's for the best"--Tomohito said that was how he made up his mind.

lines.content: 忘れてしまったもの……？
lines.translated: "Something you forgot...?"

lines.content: 俺は、目を丸くした。
lines.translated: My eyes went wide.

lines.content: 智仁にそんな話、した覚えは……。
lines.translated: I don't remember ever talking to Tomohito about that...

lines.content: 大雅、言ってたろ。忘れたのか？
lines.translated: "You said it yourself, Taiga. Did you forget?"

lines.content: 何をだ？
lines.translated: "Forget what?"

lines.content: 旅に出ようと思った理由は、別におじいちゃん先生に言われた英語がどうの～とか。それが本当なのかどうかを試してみようと、そう思っただけじゃないってさ
lines.translated: "That the reason you wanted to go on a journey wasn't just because of what that old teacher said about English, or wanting to test whether it was true or not."

lines.content: ――曰く。
lines.translated: --According to him.
I had *apparently said this*.

lines.content: 『なんだか、おかしいんだよ。俺さ、ずっと、ずっと……何か大切なものを忘れているような気がするんだ。だけど、それがなんだったのかさえ思い出せない。どうしても。どうしても』
lines.translated: "'It's kind of strange. For a long, long time... I've felt like I'm forgetting something important. But I can't even remember what it was. No matter what. No matter how hard I try.'"

lines.content: それが悲しくて、さみしくて……悔しくて。
lines.translated: And that made me feel sad, and lonely... and frustrated.

lines.content: 『俺は……その大切だったはずのものを……いいや、何より大切だったひとのことを、いつも、いつでも、俺はさ、今日までずっと探し続けてて――不思議だ』
lines.translated: "'I've... always, at all times, right up until today, been searching for that thing that must have been so important... no, for that person who was more important than anything--it's strange.'"

lines.content: 『不思議なんだよ』
lines.translated: "'It's so strange.'"

lines.content: 『そのひとのことを思うと、胸が、心が、軋むみたいに痛いんだ……』
lines.translated: "'Whenever I think about that person, my chest, my heart, hurts like it's being squeezed...'"

lines.content: そういう話を、旅をはじめてからすぐ、俺は智仁に語ったのだという。
lines.translated: Apparently, I had told Tomohito all of this right after we started our journey.

lines.content: それは、とある深いふかい森林のその奥で出会った少数民族に、進められるがまま、歓迎の盃をいっきに空けさせられて――あ、これは、まずいなあ。
lines.translated: That had happened deep, deep inside a certain forest, after a minority tribe we met kept urging me to drink a welcoming cup, which I downed in one gulp--thinking, "Ah, this is bad,"

lines.content: と、視界が暗転してしまった先の出来事であるらしい。
lines.translated: right before my vision went completely dark. Apparently, it happened after I blacked out.

lines.content: ……その日のこと、まるで、全然、覚えてないんだよな。まさかそんな恥ずかしい絡みかたをしてしまっていただなんて。申し訳ない
lines.translated: "...I don't remember a single thing about that day at all. I can't believe I acted like such an embarrassing drunk toward you. Sorry about that."

lines.content: ああ。でもさ、そこでわかったんだよ。大雅も俺と同じなんだなあって
lines.translated: "Yeah. But you know, that's when I realized it. That you were the same as me, Taiga."

lines.content: 俺と同じで、何かをなくしてしまったような……。何かを、ずっと探し続けているような。そんな違和感をいつも感じてる
lines.translated: "Just like me, you feel like you've lost something... Like you're always searching for something. You're always feeling that same sense of wrongness."

lines.content: だから俺たちは旅に出てるんだよ。智仁は言う。自分探しだ。自分のなくしたものを思い出すための旅だ。
lines.translated: "That's why we're out on this journey," Tomohito said. "It's a journey to find ourselves. A journey to remember what we lost."

lines.content: それが見つかるまでは、俺たちの旅は終わらないんだよ。きっとな
lines.translated: "Until we find it, our journey won't end. I'm sure of it."

lines.content: ……そうだなあ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, you're right."

lines.content: 改めて俺は星空を見上げた――そして、“なあ、どうして”と、ため息の代わりに、言った。
lines.translated: I looked up at the starry sky once more--and in place of a sigh, I said, "Hey, why..."

lines.content: どうして俺たち、こんな冒険しようと思ったんだろうなあ――俺たちが探してるものって、何なんだろうなあ
lines.translated: "Why did we decide to go on an adventure like this, I wonder--what is it that we're searching for, anyway?"

lines.content: はは。言ったろ。そんなの、自分探しのために決まってる。自分が忘れたものの正体を探し出すための旅だ
lines.translated: "Haha. I just told you, didn't I? Obviously, it's to find ourselves. It's a journey to uncover the true identity of what we forgot."

lines.content: はは、そうだったな――
lines.translated: "Haha, right, it was--"

lines.content: だけど、おかしいな。
lines.translated: Still, that's strange.

lines.content: 俺はともかく、智仁。お前は自分なんて探すまでもなくちゃんと理解してる人間だと思ってたんだけどな
lines.translated: "Setting me aside, Tomohito... I always thought you were the type of guy who understood himself completely without needing to go searching."

lines.content: ほら、人生は穴掘りだって言ってたろ。掘り起こすんだよ、足下を。自分のルーツはそこにある、みたいなことを言ってたろ。そう言い、俺はなんとなく笑って見せた。
lines.translated: "Come on, didn't you say that life is like digging a hole? That you dig up the ground beneath your feet, and your roots are right there, or something like that?" Saying that, I gave a vague smile.

lines.content: そして智仁は『さすが俺だ。良いこと言うようなあ』とのんびりとした口調で笑い、言った。
lines.translated: And Tomohito laughed in a laid-back tone, saying, "'Leave it to me. I sure do say some great things.'"

lines.content: まあ。この旅は色々と大変だけど後悔はしてない
lines.translated: "Well, this journey has been tough in a lot of ways, but I don't regret it."

lines.content: 智仁は最後のマシュマロを口に放り込む。そして、自分探しの旅も、一緒に歩ける奴次第で中々どうして悪くはないと言い、笑う。
lines.translated: Tomohito tossed the last marshmallow into his mouth. Then he laughed, saying that a journey to find yourself isn't half bad depending on who you have walking alongside you.

lines.content: いつかこの旅を終えて、帰国して、就職活動とかもしもするなら――君は、卒業してから今日までの空白の数年間に何をしてたんですかって言われるよな。履歴書を見た面接官に
lines.translated: "Someday, when we finish this journey, go back home, and maybe start job hunting--the interviewer looking at my resume is definitely gonna ask, 'What were you doing during this blank period of several years between graduation and today?'"

lines.content: “もちろん、冒険してました”。そんなことを言ったらさ、何言ってるんだこのバカはいつまでも子どもみたいなこと言いやがって――採用！　そう言うに決まってるよな
lines.translated: "If I say something like, 'I was on an adventure, of course,' they're bound to go, 'What is this idiot talking about, spouting childish nonsense at his age--you're hired!' Obviously."

lines.content: 採用なのかよ
lines.translated: "They're hiring you?!"

lines.content: 俺は笑う。
lines.translated: I smiled.

lines.content: ああ。だってさ、いつまでも子ども心を忘れないようなバカはどんな組織にもひとりは必要なんだよ。最後には、ああ、こいつがいて良かったなあってさ、誰もが思うもんなんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because, you know, every organization needs at least one idiot who never loses their inner child. In the end, everyone always thinks, 'Man, I'm really glad we have this guy around.'"

lines.content: 知ってるか、大雅。バカは世界を変えるんだぜ、と智仁は胸を張る。
lines.translated: "Did you know, Taiga? Idiots are the ones who change the world," Tomohito said, puffing out his chest.

lines.content: ああ……。そうだな。お前といると際限もなくバカになれるから楽しいよ。まったくな
lines.translated: "Yeah... You're right. Being around you lets me be an endless idiot, so it's fun. Seriously."

lines.content: いつもみたいにどうでもいい話をして、横になる。
lines.translated: Talking about pointless things just like always, we lay down.

lines.content: 揃って寝袋に包まり、寝転んだ。流れ星がいくつか見えた。
lines.translated: We both wrapped ourselves up in our sleeping bags and stretched out. I could see a few shooting stars.

lines.content: なあ。大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: おう。なんだ智仁
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it, Tomohito?"

lines.content: 好きな人の話でもするか？
lines.translated: "Wanna talk about the people we like?"

lines.content: さっさと寝ろ
lines.translated: "Go to sleep already."

lines.content: えー。つれないじゃないか
lines.translated: "Aww, don't be so cold."

lines.content: 明日は早いぞ。太陽が昇って激暑になるより早く出発するんだ
lines.translated: "We've got an early morning tomorrow. We need to head out before the sun comes up and it gets scorching hot."

lines.content: ああ、了解
lines.translated: "Yeah, roger that."

lines.content: 隣で少しの間ごそごそと音がしていたが、すぐに微かな寝息が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: There was some rustling next to me for a moment, and then I heard his faint, steady breathing.

lines.content: ……また、夢を見るのだろうか。
lines.translated: Will I have that dream again?

lines.content: 瞬く星の数をかぞえ、眠くなるのを待ちながら――思った。
lines.translated: Counting the twinkling stars as I waited to drift off to sleep--I wondered.

lines.content: 誰かと何かを誓い合う夢。
lines.translated: The dream where I'm exchanging a vow with someone.

lines.content: そこに、俺が探し続けているものの答えがあるような気がして……。
lines.translated: I felt like the answer to what I've been searching for was right there inside it...

lines.content: ……寝よう
lines.translated: "...Let's get some sleep."

lines.content: 答えは出ない。いつまでも。
lines.translated: The answer never comes. Never.

lines.content: だからずっと、いつまでも、ずっと……この旅は終わらない。そんな気もしていた。
lines.translated: And because of that, I had a feeling this journey would never end... Not ever, for as long as I lived.

lines.content: 明日はどこまで行けるだろうか。
lines.translated: How far will we be able to go tomorrow?

lines.content: 明日はどんな秘密と出会えるだろうか。
lines.translated: What kind of secrets will we stumble across tomorrow?

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら、[まぶた|瞼]を、閉じる――……
lines.translated: Thinking about those things, I closed my eyelids--...

lines.content: 音がした。
lines.translated: There was a sound.

lines.content: なんだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what she wants.

lines.content: リアカーのほうからだ。
lines.translated: It was coming from the handcart.

lines.content: う、うう……。誰だ。目覚ましだなんて……安眠妨害だ。代わりに美味しいもので腹一杯にしてくれるなら、ううむ、ゆるさんでもない
lines.translated: "U-Ugh... Who is it? Setting an alarm... That's disturbing the peace. Though if you're gonna stuff my belly full of delicious food instead, hmmm, I might forgive you."

lines.content: あ、ああ。ちょっと見てくる
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. I'll go check it out real quick."

lines.content: リアカーの荷台。そこに積んだ荷物のひとつから音は聞こえてきている――鞄だ。俺の鞄。
lines.translated: The bed of the handcart. The sound was coming from one of the pieces of luggage piled up on it--a bag. My bag.

lines.content: ごそごそと探る。
lines.translated: I rummaged through it.

lines.content: すぐに音の原因を探り当てた。
lines.translated: I quickly found the source of the sound.

lines.content: ……携帯電話？
lines.translated: "...A cell phone?"

lines.content: それもひどく古いタイプのものだ。
lines.translated: And an awfully old model, at that.

lines.content: こんなもの、俺、持ってきてたっけな……
lines.translated: "Did I really bring something like this with me...?"

lines.content: それはいわゆるガラケーというやつで、呼び出し音を鳴らす度、液晶部分が光っていた。
lines.translated: It was an old flip phone, its screen lighting up with every ring.

lines.content: 呼び出しの相手は名無し。番号は“９６”……“９６”？　そんな短い桁の電話番号、聞いたことがない。
lines.translated: The caller ID said "Unknown." The number was "96"... "96"? I'd never heard of a phone number with so few digits.

lines.content: 少し戸惑ったものの、俺は通話ボタンを押した。
lines.translated: Though a little bewildered, I pressed the answer button.

lines.content: ……もしもし？
lines.translated: "...Hello?"

lines.content: そう呼びかけた瞬間。
lines.translated: The moment I spoke into it...

lines.content: 俺は、携帯電話を手のひらから落とした。
lines.translated: The cell phone slipped right out of my palm and fell.

lines.content: 大雅？　どうした？　まさか俺俺詐欺か？　だったら今、砂漠のど真ん中だって言ってやれよ――
lines.translated: "Taiga? What's wrong? Don't tell me it's one of those phone scammers? If it is, tell 'em you're smack-dab in the middle of the desert right now--"

lines.content: ＡＴＭなんてねえんだよ。振り込みたくても振り込めねえんだ。ここまで直接取りに来やがれ。ときにはそれくらいの根性見せて詐欺してみろよってな
lines.translated: "Tell 'em there's no freakin' ATMs out here, so you couldn't wire 'em money even if you wanted to. Tell 'em to come out here and get it themselves if they've got the guts to pull a real scam."

lines.content: 背後からの声に、恐る恐る、振り返り……。
lines.translated: Hearing his voice behind me, I timidly turned around...

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: ……思い、出した
lines.translated: "...I remembered."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 思い出した……。俺、思い出したぞ、智仁っ
lines.translated: "I remembered... I remembered, Tomohito!"

lines.content: 俺は、智仁に詰め寄り――頭を抱えた。
lines.translated: I rushed over to Tomohito--and clutched my head.

lines.content: あ、ああ、ああっ、どうして、どうして俺、忘れてしまってたんだっ、こんな、大事なこと……っ
lines.translated: "A-Aaah, aah! Why, why did I forget something so, so important...?!"

lines.content: お、おい。大雅、いったい何を思い出したんだよ
lines.translated: "H-Hey, Taiga, what on earth did you remember?"

lines.content: ……千和っ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa!"

lines.content: 俺は、言う。叫ぶように。
lines.translated: I spoke, practically screaming the words.

lines.content: ……杏藤千和だっ
lines.translated: "...It's Andou Chiwa!"

lines.content: 俺の幼馴染みだ。俺の、大好きな人だ。
lines.translated: My childhood friend. The person I love more than anyone.

lines.content: たった今、頭の中に溢れている君の名前を、叫ぶ――……しかし、どういうことだ。
lines.translated: I shouted your name, which was suddenly overflowing in my mind right this very second--...Wait, what is going on?

lines.content: おかしい、不思議だ。なんだよ、これ……
lines.translated: "That's strange, that's weird. What is this...?"

lines.content: ぎゅっと目を閉じ、歯を、食いしばり……。
lines.translated: I squeezed my eyes shut and gritted my teeth...

lines.content: 千和。千和……っ。うそだろ……っ
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Chiwa...! No way...!"

lines.content: 名前は思い出せるのに、幼い頃から一緒に過ごした長い時間や、その思い出は、じわじわと思い出し始めているのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I could remember her name, and all the long years we spent together since we were little, with those memories slowly starting to trickle back into my mind...

lines.content: 俺、俺は、おかしいんだよ、智仁……俺っ、千和の顔をまるで、思い出せないっ
lines.translated: "Something's... something's wrong with me, Tomohito... I can't remember Chiwa's face at all!"

lines.content: 千和ちゃん……
lines.translated: "Chiwa-chan..."

lines.content: そうつぶやいた智仁も、最初は不思議そうだったが――みるみるその目を丸くし始めた。
lines.translated: Tomohito murmured her name, looking puzzled at first--but then his eyes rapidly went wide.

lines.content: そ、そうだ。千和ちゃんだ……っ
lines.translated: "T-That's right. Chiwa-chan...!"

lines.content: 寝袋から立ち上がる智仁。
lines.translated: Tomohito scrambled up out of his sleeping bag.

lines.content: 俺もだ、大雅っ、俺も思い出せたぞ……っ。俺の、俺たちの、幼馴染みだ……っ
lines.translated: "Me too, Taiga! I remembered too...! She's my--she's our childhood friend...!"

lines.content: あ、ああっ、そして俺の彼女だ……っ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah! And she's my girlfriend...!"

lines.content: え？　俺のじゃなかったか？
lines.translated: "Huh? Wasn't she mine?"

lines.content: うっさい……っ、今はそんなボケなんてかましてる場合じゃないんだよっ
lines.translated: "Shut up...! Now's really not the time to be cracking jokes like that!"

lines.content: 砂漠のど真ん中で、男ふたりであたふたと、する。
lines.translated: Smack-dab in the middle of the desert, the two of us panicked and scrambled around.

lines.content: 何で俺たちこんな大切なこと忘れてたんだ？
lines.translated: "Why the hell did we forget something so important?!"

lines.content: わからない。ただ、携帯に着信があって、それに出てみたら……
lines.translated: "I don't know. I just got a call on a cell phone, and when I answered it..."

lines.content: 携帯？　なんだそれ？
lines.translated: "Cell phone? What's that about?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: いったい誰からの着信だったのかわからない。そんな電話をきっかけにして……だと、思う。
lines.translated: I had no idea who the call was from. But I think... that phone call is what triggered it.

lines.content: しかしその携帯電話はどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: Yet that cell phone was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 確かここに落としたはずだという場所を何度見ても見当たらない。
lines.translated: No matter how many times I checked the spot where I was sure I'd dropped it, it wasn't there.

lines.content: 電話をくれた相手が何か事情を知っているのではないか――根拠なんてまるでないのだがそう思えた。しかしいくら探しても端末は見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: Maybe the person who called me knew something about our situation--I had zero proof of that, of course, but I couldn't shake the feeling. Still, no matter how hard I searched, the device was completely gone.

lines.content: ……なあ、智仁
lines.translated: "...Hey, Tomohito."

lines.content: ひとしきり携帯を探し終わってから、俺は、またひとつ思い出していた。
lines.translated: After I finished searching high and low for the phone, another memory came back to me.

lines.content: 『……これから、どんなにあの子のことを忘れてしまっていても。あの子が卒業し、大人になる日には……どうかお前があの子のそばにいてやってほしい』
lines.translated: "...No matter how much you might forget about her from here on out. On the day she graduates and becomes an adult... please, I want you to be there by her side."

lines.content: 大雅？
lines.translated: "Taiga?"

lines.content: どうした？　大丈夫か？　と俺の顔を覗き込んでくる智仁に、俺は問いかけた。
lines.translated: Tomohito peered into my face, asking, "What's wrong? Are you okay?" I asked him a question in return.

lines.content: 智仁。今日は、正確には何月何日だ、智仁。旅をはじめてからだいたい一年だが……
lines.translated: "Tomohito. What's the exact date today, Tomohito? It's been about a year since we started our journey, right...?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。今は三月で、確か、日本時間で、今は――
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. It's March right now, and if we're going by Japan time, right now is--"

lines.content: ちょうど俺たちの学園が卒業式を開く十数時間前、ということだった。
lines.translated: It turned out our school's graduation ceremony was going to start in just over a dozen hours.

lines.content: ま、マジかよ
lines.translated: "Y-You've gotta be kidding me."

lines.content: 猶予はあと十数時間……。
lines.translated: We only had a little over a dozen hours left...

lines.content: ここはどこだ。海外だ。砂漠だ。そのど真ん中だ――おい、俺、こんなところで何をやってるんだよ。
lines.translated: Where are we? Overseas. In a desert. Smack-dab in the middle of it--Hey, what the hell am I doing in a place like this?!

lines.content: どうしたんだ大雅。顔、真っ青だぞ
lines.translated: "What's wrong, Taiga? Your face is completely pale."

lines.content: ……帰りたい
lines.translated: "...I want to go back."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: いや。帰らないと……
lines.translated: "No. I have to go back..."

lines.content: 俺はリアカーの荷物を急いで整理する。
lines.translated: I frantically started packing up the luggage on the handcart.

lines.content: 急いで帰らないと、約束を、守れなくなる……っ
lines.translated: "If I don't hurry back, I won't be able to keep my promise...!"

lines.content: 約束？　いったい何の話をしてるんだ？　確かに、千和ちゃんのことを忘れてたなんて互いにどうかしてたけど……
lines.translated: "Promise? What on earth are you talking about? Sure, there was definitely something wrong with both of us for forgetting about Chiwa-chan, but..."

lines.content: わからない。何もかもわからないけれど、俺は誰かと約束してたんだ。千和が学園を卒業する日、千和のそばには俺がついてるんだって。それに……
lines.translated: "I don't know. I don't understand any of it, but I made a promise with someone. That on the day Chiwa graduates from school, I'd be right there by her side. And besides..."

lines.content: それに？
lines.translated: "And besides?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……それに、急いで帰って千和に会わないと……このまま眠ってしまったら、朝にはまた千和のことを忘れてしまっていそうで、怖いんだ……っ
lines.translated: "...Besides, if I don't hurry back and see Chiwa... I'm terrified that if I fall asleep like this, I'll have forgotten all about her again by morning...!"

lines.content: 今すぐここから出発したい。
lines.translated: I wanted to leave this place right this second.

lines.content: そしてできることなら、千和の卒業式を見守りたい――その時間に間に合いたい。
lines.translated: And if at all possible, I wanted to watch over Chiwa at her graduation ceremony--I wanted to make it back in time for that.

lines.content: それは、今も思い出せない[・|誰][・|か]と交わした約束を守る、という理由も確かにあるけれど……。
lines.translated: Keeping the promise I made with *someone* I still couldn't remember was definitely part of the reason, sure, but...

lines.content: あの子は、ひとりだ。
lines.translated: She's all alone.

lines.content: “……あの子の命は孤独になりやすい”
