lines.translated: "...That girl's life is prone to loneliness."

lines.content: あの子は、千和は、きっと……たったひとりで、学園の坂道をのぼらなきゃならないはずで……。
lines.translated: She... Chiwa would surely have to walk up that school hill all by herself...

lines.content: そんなのは、そんなさみしい明日なんてものは、千和に迎えてほしくない。
lines.translated: I didn't want Chiwa to have to face a lonely tomorrow like that.

lines.content: とは、言うものの……。
lines.translated: That being said, though...

lines.content: 卒業式まで残り十数時間……
lines.translated: "Only a little over a dozen hours left until the graduation ceremony..."

lines.content: そして今、俺たちがいるのは砂漠のど真ん中――改めて、思う。何やってるんだ俺は。間に合うはずがない。そうだ。本来なら、そうなのだ。
lines.translated: And right now, we were smack-dab in the middle of the desert--It hit me all over again. What the hell am I doing? There's no way I'll make it in time. Right. Normally, that would be impossible.

lines.content: ふふ
lines.translated: "Heh heh."

lines.content: そこで智仁が、のんびりとした動作で寝袋から出て、
lines.translated: Just then, Tomohito leisurely climbed all the way out of his sleeping bag.

lines.content: なあ、大雅。さっきの映画の話、あっただろ
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. Remember that movie we were talking about earlier?"

lines.content: にやにやとしながら、荷台の荷物を探り始めた。
lines.translated: Grinning from ear to ear, he started rummaging through the luggage on the cart.

lines.content: 水も食料もない。通信機もない。岩に挟まれた手は抜けないまま。叫んでもわめいても誰も気づいてくれない……。そんな場合、俺ならどうするかって話だ
lines.translated: "No water, no food. No radio. Your arm's pinned under a boulder and you can't pull it out. You can scream and holler all you want, and nobody's gonna notice... We were talking about what I'd do in a situation like that."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 遭難しても俺なら絶対、その映画の主人公みたいにはならない。ああ、絶対だ。断言してもいい
lines.translated: "Even if I got stranded, I'd never end up like the main character in that movie. Yeah, never. I can guarantee it."

lines.content: なぜなら……、
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: なぜなら俺は、そもそも、どんな場合でも、どんなに周りが見えなくなるくらいテンションあげあげになったって……絶対だ。最後の手段を絶対に忘れない男だからだ――
lines.translated: "Because no matter what the situation is, no matter how hyped up I get to the point where I can't see anything around me... I'm the kind of guy who never, ever forgets to bring a last resort--"

lines.content: 得意げな顔で振り返った智仁の手には、少し大きめの端末が握られていた――それは？　問いかける俺に、智仁が答える。
lines.translated: Tomohito turned back to me with a smug look on his face, clutching a slightly bulky device in his hand--What is that? When I asked, Tomohito answered.

lines.content: プリペイド式の衛星電話だ。いいか大雅。プリペイドの、衛星電話、だぞ？　時代はすごいよな。こんなものまで低価格で手軽に買えるんだ
lines.translated: "It's a prepaid satellite phone. Listen up, Taiga. A prepaid. Satellite. Phone, got that? We really live in an amazing era, huh? You can easily buy something like this for cheap."

lines.content: お、お前、どうして……
lines.translated: "Y-You... how...?"

lines.content: 言ったろ。俺は最後の手段をいつだって用意してるタイプなんだよ
lines.translated: "I told you, didn't I? I'm the kind of guy who always has a last resort ready."

lines.content: そもそもこの旅は始まりかた自体がめちゃくちゃだったからな。絶対、無茶なことを繰り返す旅路になるだろうって予想してた
lines.translated: "Besides, the way this trip started was a total mess to begin with. I figured right from the start that we'd end up doing one reckless thing after another along the way."

lines.content: 密林地帯だったり荒野だったり、砂漠、だったり……そういった危険な場所に侵入するなら危険はつきもの。遭難なんて日常茶飯事。
lines.translated: Jungles, wastelands, deserts... If you're going to trek into hazardous places like that, danger comes with the territory. Getting stranded is practically an everyday occurrence.

lines.content: だからさ、どうしてもってときに使おうと思って、日本を出る前に買ってたんだ
lines.translated: "So, I bought it before we left Japan, thinking I'd use it if we ever ended up in a real pinch."

lines.content: どうして俺に秘密にしてたんだ。こんな、大事なこと
lines.translated: "Why did you keep it a secret from me? Something this important..."

lines.content: だって、大雅に言うと絶対、置いてけって言ったろ？
lines.translated: "Because if I told you, Taiga, you definitely would've told me to leave it behind, right?"

lines.content: まあ、うん。そうだな。確かにそうだ
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. You're right. I definitely would have."

lines.content: ともあれ助かった。ありがとう。そう言い素直に頭を下げた。
lines.translated: Regardless, you saved us. Thank you. Saying that, I honestly bowed my head to him.

lines.content: まあ、千和ちゃんのことがなくても、そろそろこれの使いどきだと思ってた。食料も底をついてたしな。しかも砂漠のど真ん中だ
lines.translated: "Well, even without the whole situation with Chiwa-chan, I was thinking it was about time to use this thing anyway. We were running out of food, too. Plus, we're smack-dab in the middle of a desert."

lines.content: 智仁はその端末でどこかへ連絡を入れた。英語だった。やっぱり英語は生きるために必要なのかな。まあ、場合によりけりだろうけれど。今の状況は特殊すぎるし。
lines.translated: Tomohito used the device to contact someone. He spoke in English. I guess English really is necessary for survival, huh? Well, it probably depends on the situation, though. The one we're in right now is just way too extreme.

lines.content: 数時間後――夜明けよりも早く、遠い空にセスナ機の光が見えてきた。
lines.translated: A few hours later--even before daybreak, the lights of a Cessna plane came into view in the distant sky.

lines.content: ……忘れたものを、大切だったものを探す旅、か
lines.translated: "...A journey to find what we forgot, what was precious to us, huh?"

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: ああ、やっぱり、だな
lines.translated: "Yeah, just as I thought."

lines.content: 智仁は苦笑いで俺を振り返った。
lines.translated: Tomohito looked back at me with a wry smile.

lines.content: 大切なものは探しに出かけても見つからない。良くよく探せば、いつだって身近にあるんもんなんだなあって。またひとつ、真実を見つけちゃったな、俺たち
lines.translated: "You won't find the things that matter most by going out to look for them. If you just look closely enough, they're always right there beside you. Looks like we uncovered another truth, huh?"

lines.content: 朝日と共に日本の空港に到着した。
lines.translated: We arrived at a Japanese airport along with the morning sun.

lines.content: ……学園がはじまるまで後、数時間。
lines.translated: Only a few hours left until school starts.

lines.content: 故郷の町まで戻るには、ここからもうひとつ飛行機に乗り換え、電車をふたつ乗り継いで、最後はバスだ。
lines.translated: To get back to our hometown from here, we had to transfer to another plane, take two connecting trains, and finally catch a bus.

lines.content: 移動時間をすべて合わせて考えてみても……ぎりぎりだ。なんとか卒業式が始まる前くらいには故郷の参禅町に到着するはずだった。
lines.translated: Even adding up all the travel time... we were cutting it close. Still, we should just barely make it back to our hometown of Sanzen-cho right before the graduation ceremony started.

lines.content: おい、大雅。お前、そんなヒゲも髪もぼっさぼさな見た目で、千和ちゃんに会いに行く気か？
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. Are you seriously planning to go see Chiwa-chan looking like that, with your hair and beard all scruffy and unkempt?"

lines.content: 空港の出発ロビーで次の便を待っていと、智仁が言った――お前、すごい、におうぞと。鼻をひくひくさせながら。
lines.translated: While we were waiting for our next flight in the airport's departure lobby, Tomohito spoke up--telling me, while twitching his nose, that I reeked something fierce.

lines.content: ……そんなのお互い様じゃないか。お前だって、ひどいぞ。よくもまあこんなやばい状態で搭乗させてもらえたよな。俺たち
lines.translated: "...Look who's talking. You're in pretty rough shape yourself. It's a miracle they even let us board the plane looking this sketchy."

lines.content: 思えば他のお客が誰も俺たちのそばに寄りつかない。俺たちは明らかに“やばい人”みたいに見えることだろう。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, none of the other passengers were coming anywhere near us. We probably looked like complete weirdos to them.

lines.content: ずっとこんな格好で旅をし続けていたから色々と麻痺してしまっていた。
lines.translated: We'd been traveling dressed like this for so long that we'd gone completely numb to a lot of things.

lines.content: 次の便まで時間はまだあるようだ。
lines.translated: It looked like we still had some time before our next flight.

lines.content: 空港のショップで新しい服を購入し、施設内に温泉まであったので（しかも早朝にもかかわらずちゃんと開いていた）、そこで身体をきれいにし……。
lines.translated: We bought new clothes at an airport shop, and since there was even a hot spring inside the facility (which was thankfully open despite it being early morning), we went there to clean ourselves up...

lines.content: ……俺たちは顔を見合わせる。うそだろ、と。
lines.translated: We looked at each other. You've gotta be kidding me, our eyes said.

lines.content: 砂漠を古いリアカー引いて歩いて、歩いて、身体は疲労困憊だったのだ――つい、温泉内でうたた寝をしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Having walked and walked through the desert pulling that old handcart, our bodies were completely exhausted--so we accidentally dozed off right there in the hot spring.

lines.content: つまり、搭乗予定の便をものの見事に乗り過ごしてしまった。
lines.translated: In other words, we royally missed our scheduled flight.

lines.content: わざとではないミスは互いに怒らない。喧嘩しない。責任のなすりつけあいだけは絶対、しない――俺たちが最初に決めた旅の掟だ。
lines.translated: Never get mad at each other over honest mistakes. Never fight. And above all, never, ever push the blame onto each other--those were the rules of the road we decided on right at the beginning.

lines.content: うん！　夜までぐっすりいかなかっただけ、俺たち、えらい！
lines.translated: "Yep! We did a great job just not sleeping straight through till nightfall!"

lines.content: お、おおう。なんだか色々強引だなあ
lines.translated: "O-Oh, yeah. That's a pretty big stretch in a lot of ways, though."

lines.content: 急いで次の便を予約し直し、電車を乗り継ぎ、バスを利用し――……
lines.translated: We hurriedly rebooked for the next flight, transferred trains, hopped on a bus, and--...

lines.content: なんとか俺たちの故郷、参禅町に辿り着いたのは、もうすでに卒業式が始まろうかという時刻だった。
lines.translated: By the time we somehow made it back to our hometown of Sanzen-cho, it was already just about time for the graduation ceremony to begin.

lines.content: そのバスは石橋の手前の停留所までだ。そこからは道を折り返し、戻っていった。
lines.translated: That bus only went as far as the stop right before the stone bridge. From there, it turned around and headed back the way it came.

lines.content: 学園へと向かうバスは別にある。
lines.translated: There was a different bus that went toward the academy.

lines.content: だが既に出発した後だった。学園前の停留所を経由するバスがここを通過するのは数時間後であると、停留所に張り出されていた時刻表にはあった。
lines.translated: However, it had already left. According to the timetable posted at the stop, the next bus passing through here for the academy wouldn't arrive for another few hours.

lines.content: 当然、そんなものは待っていられない。俺たちは走って学園へと向かう――
lines.translated: Naturally, we couldn't wait around for that. We broke into a run toward the academy--

lines.content: 途中、まだ学園へと向かう途中の生徒たちとたくさん、すれ違った。
lines.translated: Along the way, we passed by tons of students who were still heading to the academy themselves.

lines.content: その誰もが、これから先の未来や、特別な今日の日をどのようにして過ごそうかと、並んで歩く大切な人たちと話ながら歩いている。
lines.translated: Every single one of them was walking side by side with the people precious to them, chatting about the future ahead and how they were going to spend this special day.

lines.content: 時間にはほとんど余裕で間に合うことができたようだけれど……焦る。どうしようもなく。
lines.translated: It looked like we had managed to make it back in plenty of time, and yet... I was panicking. I couldn't help it.

lines.content: しかし、町に帰り着けても、俺の中に千和の笑顔が戻ってくることはなかった。
lines.translated: Because even though we had made it back to town, Chiwa's smiling face still hadn't returned to my mind.

lines.content: 町を走り抜け、制服姿の人たちの間をかいくぐりながら――女子生徒の顔を一つひとつ、確認し――俺は、俺たちは、学園へと急いだ。
lines.translated: Sprinting through the town, weaving between the people in uniforms--checking the face of each and every female student one by one--I, we, hurried toward the academy.

lines.content: ……千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: 杏藤千和。
lines.translated: Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: どうして……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: どうして俺は、君を、君の顔を思い出せないんだ。
lines.translated: Why can't I remember you, or your face?

lines.content: 本当は君の名前をここで叫びたい――俺はここだと、声をあげて、叫びたかった。
lines.translated: The truth was, I wanted to shout your name right here and now--I wanted to raise my voice and scream that I was right here.

lines.content: ……会いたい。
lines.translated: I want to see you.

lines.content: 早く君に会いたいよ。
lines.translated: I want to see you as soon as possible.

lines.content: ……そして今日までのことをまず謝りたい。
lines.translated: And first of all, I want to apologize for everything up until today.

lines.content: ひとりにさせてごめん。千和。君にはもうさみしい思いをさせないと約束したはずなのに……。
lines.translated: I'm sorry for leaving you all alone, Chiwa. Even though I promised I'd never make you feel lonely again...

lines.content: この手は絶対に離さないからと、そう誓ったはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I swore I would never, ever let go of your hand...

lines.content: それなのに、本当に、本当に……、ごめん。
lines.translated: Despite all that, I'm truly, truly... sorry.

lines.content: そしてもしも、今日までのことを君と色々話せたら……。
lines.translated: And if, by some chance, I could talk to you about everything that's happened up until today...

lines.content: そんな時間の中に、小さくとも笑顔があるのなら……。
lines.translated: If there could be even a small smile during the time we spend doing that...

lines.content: それはたぶん、幸せな未来に限りなく近いものだと、そう言えるはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Then I should be able to say that it's something infinitely close to a happy future, and yet...

lines.content: ……ここまで[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら][・|し][・|い]子は見つからなかった。
lines.translated: Up to this point, I hadn't found any girl who *seemed* like her.

lines.content: 信号で立ち止まる。肩で息をしながら、頬に伝う汗を拭った。
lines.translated: I stopped at a traffic light. Breathing heavily, I wiped the sweat trickling down my cheek.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 千和も、俺も、互いに互いを気づけず通り過ぎてしまっている――そういう可能性だって、充分以上にあった。
lines.translated: Chiwa and I might have already passed right by each other without either of us realizing it--that was more than a distinct possibility.

lines.content: しかしその懸念を認めてしまうは未だに躊躇いがある。
lines.translated: Yet I still hesitated to acknowledge that fear.

lines.content: なぜならそれは、今、自分の身に起きている不思議を現実として認めなければならないということだ。
lines.translated: Because doing so meant I would have to accept this strange phenomenon happening to me right now as reality.

lines.content: しかしその不安が、もしも的を得ているようであれば……。
lines.translated: However, if that anxiety of mine really was on the mark...

lines.content: すれ違っても、顔を見合わせても、互いに気づけないような状態で……。
lines.translated: If we were in a state where we wouldn't even notice each other when passing by or looking right at one another's faces...

lines.content: ……どうやって俺は、千和のことを見つければいいんだ
lines.translated: "...How on earth am I supposed to find Chiwa?"

lines.content: ……千和。なあ、千和。教えてくれよ。今、君はここにいるのかな。俺の近くにいてくれるのかな。
lines.translated: Chiwa. Hey, Chiwa. Tell me. Are you here right now? Are you somewhere close to me?

lines.content: それとも、君はもう……。
lines.translated: Or are you already...?

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: うだうだ考えていたところで答えが出るような問題じゃない――とにかく、行かなければ。走らなければ。
lines.translated: It wasn't the kind of problem I'd find an answer to just by standing around overthinking it--anyway, I had to go. I had to run.

lines.content: その先のどこかで必ず、君と会えると信じて……。
lines.translated: Believing that I would definitely meet you somewhere up ahead...

lines.content: 信号が青に変わった。
lines.translated: The light turned green.

lines.content: 俺は再び、走り出す――
lines.translated: I started running again--

lines.content: 大雅っ
lines.translated: "Taiga!"

lines.content: 背後から、声。
lines.translated: A voice from behind.

lines.content: 智仁だ。俺の名前を叫んでいる。
lines.translated: It was Tomohito. He was shouting my name.

lines.content: もしかして見つけてくれたのか。千和のことを。
lines.translated: Could it be that he found her for me? Found Chiwa?

lines.content: そんな期待を込めて、振り返るけれど……。
lines.translated: Filled with that hope, I turned around, only to...

lines.content: 危ない……っ
lines.translated: "Look out...!"

lines.content: だが、そこにあった親友の顔は、真っ青で――俺を守ろうと、手を差し伸べているところだった。
lines.translated: However, my best friend's face was pale as a sheet--and he was right in the middle of reaching out his hand to protect me.

lines.content: 守る。いったい、何から――……
lines.translated: Protect me. From what on earth--...

lines.content: ドン、という衝撃があった。
lines.translated: There was a heavy *thud* of impact.

lines.content: 呼吸が止まり――
lines.translated: My breath caught in my throat--

lines.content: 視界が、反転した。
lines.translated: And my vision flipped upside down.

lines.content: ごろごろと転がる全身に、堅いアスファルトの地面を感じた。
lines.translated: As my whole body tumbled over and over, I felt the hard asphalt ground beneath me.

lines.content: 脳も視界も[・|軽][・|く]ぐにゃりと揺れて――……自分に何が起きたのか、瞬間では理解できなかったけれど、
lines.translated: Both my brain and my vision *lightly* warped and swayed--...I couldn't immediately comprehend what had just happened to me,

lines.content: ……う、ううっ
俺は、轢かれてしまったようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed I had been hit by a vehicle.

lines.content: すぐさま立ち上がろうとした俺は、[・|そ][・|れ]を認める――軽トラだった。
lines.translated: Trying to stand up right away, I caught sight of *it*--a mini-truck.

lines.content: おそらく、信号が青から赤になるぎりぎりを責める形で、交差点へと進入しようとしたところ、俺が横断歩道へと走り出したのだろう。
lines.translated: It had probably tried to push its luck entering the intersection right as the light was turning from green to red, just as I dashed out into the crosswalk.

lines.content: おい大雅っ、大丈夫なのかっ
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga! Are you okay?!"

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 駆け寄ってくる智仁に、俺は、うなずく。
lines.translated: As Tomohito came rushing over to me, I nodded.

lines.content: 車にはね飛ばされたというのに、なぜこうも素早く反応できたのか……それは、
lines.translated: Even though I'd been sent flying by a vehicle, why was I able to react so quickly...? It was because,

lines.content: ……平気だ。全然、大丈夫
lines.translated: "...I'm fine. Totally fine."

lines.content: それは、ほぼ無傷だったからだ。
lines.translated: It was because I was practically unharmed.

lines.content: 俺は、地面を転がった際の擦り傷程度しか負っていなかった。
lines.translated: I had only suffered a few scrapes from rolling across the ground.

lines.content: あれくらい吹っ飛べば、骨のひとつやふたつ……内臓のふたつや、みっつ――破壊されてしまっていても不思議はないはずなのに。
lines.translated: Getting sent flying like that, it wouldn't have been strange at all if a bone or two... or two or three of my internal organs--had been completely crushed.

lines.content: 大雅、お前……何やったんだ？
lines.translated: "Taiga, what... what did you do?"

lines.content: そして、驚きの表情で智仁が見ているのは、むしろ俺をはねた軽トラのほうだ――
lines.translated: And yet, what Tomohito was staring at in utter shock was actually the mini-truck that had hit me--

lines.content: さ、さあ。俺、何やったのかな
lines.translated: "W-Who knows? I wonder what I did."

lines.content: ――軽トラのボンネットは、べっこりとへこんでしまっていた。
lines.translated: --The front of the mini-truck had been caved in with a massive dent.

lines.content: ……いや。特筆すべきはそれだけではない。
lines.translated: No. That wasn't the only thing worth noting.

lines.content: 俺をはねたはずの軽トラのほうが、俺よりもずっと遠くへ……数メートル後方へ、押し戻されるような形で吹き飛び、横転してしまっていたのだ。
lines.translated: The mini-truck that was supposed to have hit me had been blown much further away than I was... sent flying several meters backward as if pushed back, flipping completely onto its side.

lines.content: 軽トラは町の和菓子屋さんのものであったらしい。
lines.translated: The mini-truck apparently belonged to a local Japanese sweets shop.

lines.content: ……卒業生たちの小腹を狙ったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had they been hoping to cater to the hungry graduates?

lines.content: 縁起物の商品を、荷台にこれでもかと積んでいて……。
lines.translated: The truck bed had been packed to the brim with celebratory treats...

lines.content: 今、道路にいっぱい、彩り豊かな和菓子が散乱してしまっていた。
lines.translated: And now, colorful traditional sweets were scattered all across the road.

lines.content: その光景を、俺は唖然として見つめるばかりだったけれど、
lines.translated: All I could do was stare dumbfounded at the scene,

lines.content: 大雅、大丈夫なんだな？
lines.translated: "Taiga, you're really okay, right?"

lines.content: 智仁に肩を揺すられ、『あ、ああ。大丈夫だ』とうなずいた。
lines.translated: When Tomohito shook my shoulders, I nodded and replied, "Y-Yeah. I'm fine."

lines.content: 何がなんだかわからないけど、俺……無事だ
lines.translated: "I have no idea what's going on, but I'm... unhurt."

lines.content: ああ。だったら早く行けよ
lines.translated: "Right. Then hurry up and get going."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ここは俺がなんとか処理しとく
lines.translated: "I'll find a way to take care of things here."

lines.content: 俺も大雅と同じで、何がなんだかよくわからないけど……。俺にはまだ、思い出せないものが他にあるように思えて、ならないんだけど……
lines.translated: "Just like you, Taiga, I don't really get what's happening either... And I can't shake the feeling that there's still something else I'm forgetting, too, though..."

lines.content: そこで智仁は唇を噛み……しかし苦笑いを浮かべ、言った。
lines.translated: Tomohito bit his lip there... before offering a wry smile and speaking up.

lines.content: たぶん、お前は今、目に見えない何かの力に守られてるんだよ。それはさ、お前の目的を果たせってことだろ。“何か”がそう言ってるんだよ
lines.translated: "You're probably being protected by some kind of unseen force right now. And that means you need to see your goal through, right? That 'something' is telling you to."

lines.content: それなのにこのまま目的を達せられなきゃ、千和ちゃんを探し出せなきゃ、大雅、これからずっと、その“何か”に祟られ続けたまま生きていくことになるんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "If you still fail to reach your goal after all that--if you can't find Chiwa-chan--then I get the feeling you'll spend the rest of your life being haunted by that 'something,' Taiga."

lines.content: そんなことを真顔で言うものだから、
lines.translated: Because he said something like that with a completely straight face,

lines.content: ……あ、ああ。わかった
lines.translated: "...Y-Yeah. Got it."

lines.content: 俺は深くうなずき、『任せてごめんな』と言い、走り出そうとした。
lines.translated: I nodded deeply, said, "Sorry for leaving this to you," and moved to start running.

lines.content: しかし、すぐに立ち止まる。足下に半壊した軽トラの残骸が落ちていた。
lines.translated: However, I immediately stopped in my tracks. At my feet lay a piece of wreckage from the half-destroyed mini-truck.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を見た瞬間、俺は――またひとつ、思い出してしまった。それは拡声器だ。
lines.translated: The moment I saw *that*, I--remembered one more thing. It was a megaphone.

lines.content: おそらく、“お団子はいりませんか。お茶もありますよ。お安いですよ”だとかなんとか、宣伝しながら車を走らせるつもりだったのだろう。
lines.translated: They had probably planned to drive around advertising their wares with it, calling out things like, "Would anyone like some dango? We have tea, too! Everything's cheap!"

lines.content: ……すみません、これ、借りますっ
lines.translated: "...Excuse me, I'm borrowing this!"

lines.content: そう叫び、拾い上げ――走った。
lines.translated: Shouting that, I scooped it up--and ran.

lines.content: 智仁に無事だとは言ったが、それは車に轢かれた割りには平気だという意味だ。
lines.translated: I'd told Tomohito I was unhurt, but that only meant I was fine for someone who had just been hit by a vehicle.

lines.content: 追突された衝撃で吹き飛ばされ、固い地面を転がったのだ。まるっきり痛みがないわけもない。
lines.translated: I had been sent flying by the impact of the collision and tumbled across the hard ground. There was no way I'd be completely pain-free.

lines.content: じくじく痛む全身を引きずるようにして、走った。
lines.translated: Dragging my throbbing, aching body along, I ran.

lines.content: ……学園への坂道を駆け上がり。
lines.translated: Charging up the hill toward the academy.

lines.content: 校門を踏み越え、校庭を横切った――……そして、
lines.translated: I bounded past the school gates and cut across the courtyard--...and then,

lines.content: そして戸惑うことなく、俺は校舎の中へと入った。
lines.translated: Without a moment's hesitation, I stepped inside the school building.

lines.content: 階段を駆け上がり、上へ、上へと、急ぎ――屋上だ。
lines.translated: I raced up the stairs, hurrying higher and higher--to the rooftop.

lines.content: ……はぁ、はぁ
lines.translated: "...Haa, haa."

lines.content: 上がった息を、何度か繰り返した深呼吸で整える。
lines.translated: Taking several deep breaths, I steadied my ragged breathing.

lines.content: そして、窓際に立つ。時計塔の管理室だ。
lines.translated: Then, I stood by the window. I was in the clock tower's maintenance room.

lines.content: 校庭の景色を見下ろした。
lines.translated: I looked down over the courtyard below.

lines.content: たくさんの生徒たちがいる。まだ誰も俺に気づいている者はいない。
lines.translated: There were so many students down there. Not a single one of them had noticed me yet.

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: 今、ここに、君はいるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Are you here right now?

lines.content: ――探してる。
lines.translated: --I'm looking for you.

lines.content: ずっと君のことを探し続けてた。
lines.translated: I've been looking for you this whole time.

lines.content: 最初は誰を、何を自分が探しているのかもわからなかった。
lines.translated: At first, I didn't even know who or what I was searching for.

lines.content: でも、いつも、いつでも、何か大切なものをなくしてしまったという、そんなさみしさだけが胸に残っていた。
lines.translated: All that ever remained in my chest was the constant, lingering loneliness of having lost something precious to me.

lines.content: その正体が君なのだとようやくわかったのに。[・|君][・|の][・|は][・|ず][・|な][・|の][・|だ][・|と]、ようやくわかったのに。思い、出せたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I finally figured out that it was you. Even though I finally realized *it had to be you*. Even though I remembered...

lines.content: それなのに。
lines.translated: And yet.

lines.content: 最後に残った、たった一枚の薄い壁が破りきれない。君の顔を思い出せないのだ。
lines.translated: I just can't break through the very last, thin wall standing in my way. I can't remember your face.

lines.content: その壁越しに何度君の名前を叫んでも、決して何も、何ひとつ、届いてはくれない――……諦めた。
lines.translated: No matter how many times I shout your name from behind that wall, nothing--not a single thing--will ever reach you--...So I gave up.

lines.content: 君を探すことはもうしない。
lines.translated: I won't look for you anymore.

lines.content: どうしても探し出せないのなら、君のほうから俺を見つめてもらうしかない。
lines.translated: If I can't find you no matter what I do, then I just have to make you look at me instead.

lines.content: ……千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: 俺は、拡声器のスイッチを入れた。
lines.translated: I flipped the switch on the megaphone.

lines.content: ――……ずっとだ
lines.translated: "--...For the longest time."

lines.content: ――ずっと、今日までずっと、心のどこかで誰かのことを探してた
lines.translated: "--For the longest time, right up until today, deep down inside, I've been searching for someone."

lines.content: 俺は、そこにいてくれると信じる君へ、言葉を、想いを投げかけていった。心を込めたつもりで、一つひとつ。
lines.translated: Believing you were out there, I poured my words and feelings out to you. Putting my whole heart into every single one.

lines.content: もしもこの声が届くのなら、聞いてほしい。伝えたいことが、あるんだ――
lines.translated: "If my voice is reaching you, please listen. There's something I want to tell you--"

lines.content: ……千和っ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa!"

lines.content: 杏藤千和……っ
lines.translated: "Andou Chiwa...!"

lines.content: 聞こえてるか……俺の、俺の一番、大切な人……っ
lines.translated: "Can you hear me...? You're my... my most precious person...!"

lines.content: どうか、お願いだ、俺と――……っ
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you, with me--...!"

lines.content: そこで管理室の扉が勢いよく開いた。
lines.translated: Just then, the door to the maintenance room burst open.

lines.content: “おいっ、まさか……また、お前かっ”
lines.translated: "Hey, don't tell me... it's you again?!"

lines.content: 振り返ると懐かしい教師たちの顔ぶれが揃ってる。
lines.translated: Turning around, I saw a familiar lineup of teachers.

lines.content: “ＯＢになってまで何をしてるんだお前はっ”
lines.translated: "What the hell do you think you're doing after already graduating?!"

lines.content: “今日は何の日かわかってやってるのかっ”
lines.translated: "Do you have any idea what day it is today?!"

lines.content: ああっ、わかってるっ、わかってるさっ、申し訳ないとも思ってる――だけど、だけど……っ、これしか方法がなかったんだっ。急がないと、また、忘れてしまいそうで……
lines.translated: "Yeah! I know, I know! And I'm sorry about it--but, but...! This was the only way! If I don't hurry, I feel like I'm going to forget again..."

lines.content: 俺は、唇を噛み――
lines.translated: I bit my lip--

lines.content: だから頼むよっ、少しだけ黙っててくれよっ、なあ、おいっ、見て、わかるだろ――わかってくれよっ、今、大切なところなんだ！
lines.translated: "So please, just stay quiet for a second! Come on, hey, look at me, you can tell, right?--Please understand! I'm right at the most important part!"

lines.content: しかし、そんなのは当然だめだ。
lines.translated: Naturally, though, that wasn't going to fly.

lines.content: 教師たちは俺を取り押さえようと手を伸ばしてくる――お、おい、こんなところで悶着してたら、危ない。落ちるっ。
lines.translated: The teachers reached out to pin me down--H-Hey, if we get into a scuffle in a place like this, it's dangerous. I'll fall!

lines.content: 伸ばされる手を振り払いながらも、しかし俺は叫び続けた――千和っ。
lines.translated: Even as I shook off their grasping hands, I kept shouting--Chiwa!

lines.content: 千和……っ
lines.translated: "Chiwa...!"

lines.content: 君に、この声が届いているんだって、信じる――っ
lines.translated: "I believe... that my voice is reaching you--!"

lines.content: だからこれだけは伝えたい。叫びたい。
lines.translated: That's why I want to tell you this one thing. I want to shout it out.

lines.content: 千和、俺と……
lines.translated: "Chiwa, will you..."

lines.content: お願いします。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: どうか、俺と……、
lines.translated: Please, will you...

lines.content: 俺と、結婚、してください――……っ
lines.translated: "Will you marry me--...?!"

lines.content: 『俺と、結婚してください……！！』
lines.translated: "Will you marry me...?!!"

lines.content: は、はは……
lines.translated: "H-Haha..."

lines.content: まったく。あいつは何なんだ。相も変わらずめちゃくちゃなことをする奴だ。
lines.translated: Good grief. What is with that guy? He's pulling crazy stunts as usual.

lines.content: 屋上の様子を少し離れた場所から……。
lines.translated: Watching the scene on the rooftop from a short distance away...

lines.content: 校門より外側に立ち、[・|俺]は見上げていた。
lines.translated: Standing just outside the school gates, *I* looked up at him.

lines.content: あんな調子じゃあ千和もこれから大変だ。
lines.translated: At that rate, Chiwa's going to have her hands full from here on out.

lines.content: ……でも、まあ
lines.translated: "...Still, well."

lines.content: その大変さもいつかきっと幸せに変わるのだろう。
lines.translated: Even all that trouble will surely turn into happiness someday.

lines.content: 人間というのはどうにも度しがたいイキモノだ。どんなにつらくとも、悲しくとも、そんな過去はいつか笑い話にだってしてしまう。
lines.translated: Humans truly are incorrigible creatures. No matter how painful or sad their past may be, they'll eventually turn it into something they can laugh about.

lines.content: ふたりのことを最後まで見届けられればと思っていたが――もう、いいか。
lines.translated: I'd hoped to watch over the two of them until the very end, but--this is enough, isn't it?

lines.content: 大丈夫だよな。ここまで来れたのなら、もう平気、だよな。ちゃんとふたりは会えるはず。
lines.translated: They'll be fine, right? Since they've made it this far, they'll be okay now, won't they? The two of them should be able to reunite properly.

lines.content: ……俺の“役割”はここまでだ。
lines.translated: My "role" ends here.

lines.content: 重い身体を引きずるようにして坂を下る。
lines.translated: Dragging my heavy body along, I walked down the hill.

lines.content: 学園へ向い、坂道を駆け上がっていく生徒たち。
lines.translated: Students hurried up the slope, heading toward the academy.

lines.content: その誰にも俺の姿は見つけられない。
lines.translated: Not a single one of them could see me.

lines.content: それはまあ、慣れっこだ。胸にほんの少しの痛みがあるだけだ。
lines.translated: Well, I was used to that. It only left the faintest ache in my chest.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: この[・|腕]の痛みはいつ治るだろう。
lines.translated: When will the pain in this *arm* heal, I wonder?

lines.content: 咄嗟のことだった。
lines.translated: It had happened in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: 故に、あまり力を加減できなかった――車との間に割って入った際に、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]のことを突き飛ばしてしまい――向かってきた車を防いだ左腕は、ボロボロだった。
lines.translated: Because of that, I hadn't been able to hold back my strength very well--when I stepped between him and the vehicle, I ended up shoving *him* away--and my left arm, which had blocked the oncoming truck, was in tatters.

lines.content: ……まったく。世話のかかる少年だ
lines.translated: "...Good grief. What a high-maintenance boy."

lines.content: 突っ込んできた車は中々のスピードだ。それを防いだ左腕。骨は折れ、皮膚を破り外へ飛び出し……とにかく、それなりに、痛い。
lines.translated: The truck that came barreling toward him had been moving at quite a speed. My left arm had taken the brunt of it. The bones were shattered, tearing through the skin and jutting out... Anyway, it hurt a fair bit.

lines.content: ……これくらいの怪我なら、本来、あっという間に治ってくれるだろうものなのに
lines.translated: "...Normally, an injury like this would heal in the blink of an eye."

lines.content: この頃、身体の治癒速度が明らかに低下していた。
lines.translated: Lately, my body's healing speed had clearly been declining.

lines.content: ……“夜の怪物”は人と触れあうことができない。
lines.translated: "Monsters of the Night" cannot come into contact with humans.

lines.content: 人は誰もが七歳までは神の子だという。
lines.translated: They say that until the age of seven, all humans are children of God.

lines.content: そこを過ぎれば、少しずつ、少しずつ、奇跡的な“何か”から遠ざかっていく。
lines.translated: Once they pass that age, little by little, they drift further away from that miraculous "something."

lines.content: そして俺たち“夜の怪物”は、大人になった人間と触れ合えないどころか……。
lines.translated: And for us "Monsters of the Night," let alone touching a grown human...

lines.content: そばに近寄るというだけのことで……崩壊だ。
lines.translated: Simply getting close to them... causes us to crumble.

lines.content: この身体はひび割れ、崩れ、命の残りの時間ががりがりと、削られていく。
lines.translated: This body cracks and falls apart, and the remaining time of my life is steadily scraped away.

lines.content: 千和はもう立派な大人だ。これからどんどん大きくなっていく。
lines.translated: Chiwa is a splendid adult now. She'll only keep growing up more and more from here on out.

lines.content: そんなあの子の成長を、これからもずっと見ていたかったけれど……。
lines.translated: I wanted to keep watching her grow forever, and yet...

lines.content: ……これからどんどん、俺は、あの子のそばにいられなくなっていく
lines.translated: "...From now on, it'll become harder and harder for me to stay by her side."

lines.content: 少し、疲れた。
lines.translated: I'm a little tired.

lines.content: 坂道の下。ガードレールの張られた道ばたに腰を下ろした――どうせ誰にも見えていないのだ。不作法だろうと不審だろうと構わないさ。
lines.translated: At the bottom of the hill, I sat down on the roadside lined with guardrails--nobody could see me anyway. It didn't matter if I looked rude or suspicious.

lines.content: 眠いな。
lines.translated: I'm sleepy.

lines.content: なんだかすごく、眠かった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I felt incredibly sleepy.

lines.content: ああ……、そうか
lines.translated: "Ah... I see."

lines.content: このまま俺は死ぬのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if I'm going to die like this.
*I wonder if I can finally die.*

lines.content: それならそれで、構わないけれど……。
lines.translated: If that's how it goes, I don't really mind, though...

lines.content: でも、神さま。
lines.translated: But, God.

lines.content: 神さまみたいな、誰か――聞いてほしい。
lines.translated: Or someone like God--please, hear me out.

lines.content: ……いや。違う。俺は神なんて信じない。
lines.translated: No. That's not right. I don't believe in any God.

lines.content: だから[・|代][・|わ][・|り][・|に]、ひとつだけ、聞いてくれよ。
lines.translated: So *instead*, just listen to this one thing.

lines.content: もしも願いが叶うなら……。
lines.translated: If my wish could come true...
"Hey, *Sol*. I..."

lines.content: 俺はせめて、心あるヒトとして死にたかったよ。
lines.translated: At the very least, I wanted to die as a human with a heart.

lines.content: 視界がかすみ……。
lines.translated: My vision blurred...

lines.content: あるはずもない鼓動は小さく、ちいさく、なっていき……。
lines.translated: The heartbeat that shouldn't have even been there grew fainter, and fainter...

lines.content: 今日までの出来事が、その記憶が、まるで走馬燈のように流れていくようだった。
lines.translated: Everything that had happened up until today, all of those memories, seemed to flash before my eyes like a revolving lantern.

lines.content: “誰からも愛されることのない人生に、いったいどれほどの価値があるというのか”
lines.translated: "'Just how much value could there possibly be in a life unloved by anyone?'"

lines.content: 偶然開いた本のページにそのような一文を見つけ、ああ、なるほど、確かにそうだと思った。人間はいつも良いことを言う。
lines.translated: Coming across a line like that on a page of a book I'd opened by chance, I thought to myself, "Ah, I see, that certainly rings true." Humans always say such good things.

lines.content: ある種の納得をくれるそういう言葉に出会った“夜”は、いつも人間みたいに何かを考えてみたくなる。
lines.translated: On a "Night" when I encounter words like that, which offer a certain kind of conviction, I always find myself wanting to ponder things just like a human would.

lines.content: ……俺は、どうして産まれてきたんだろう
lines.translated: "...Why was I ever born?"

lines.content: へえ。意外だな
lines.translated: "Oh? That's unexpected."

lines.content: ……つい、今はこいつがそばにいることを忘れてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I had completely forgotten that this one was beside me right now.

lines.content: ほんの数日ほど前、[・|仲][・|間]に引き込んだ元人間の“怪物”だ。
lines.translated: A former human turned "monster" whom I had brought into the *fold* just a few days ago.

lines.content: 永遠を生きるはずの君ら“夜の怪物”も、そんな人間みたいな疑問を抱くものなんだね
lines.translated: "So even 'Monsters of the Night' like you, who are supposed to live for eternity, harbor such human-like doubts."

lines.content: そんな問いは適当にはぐらかしてしまってもよかった。
lines.translated: I could have easily brushed off a question like that.

lines.content: ただ、今夜はこいつの歓迎会を称して不慣れなアルコールに口をつけている。
lines.translated: However, tonight I was sipping on unfamiliar alcohol under the pretense of throwing a welcome party for this newcomer.

lines.content: 少ししゃべりすぎてしまったとしても、すべて[・|そ][・|れ]のせいにしてしまおう。
lines.translated: Even if I ended up talking a little too much, I could just blame it all on *that*.

lines.content: 人間たちのつむぐ物語には……いいや、創作物のその殆どは、よく“愛すること”だなんていうテーマが込められているだろう
lines.translated: "In the stories woven by humans... no, in almost all of their creations, the theme of 'loving' is so often embedded within them, isn't it?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really did."
The *beautiful "monster"* shrugged and spoke.

lines.content: 時に陳腐に
lines.translated: "Sometimes tritely."

lines.content: ……時に、稚拙に
lines.translated: "...And sometimes, clumsily."

lines.content: 歯の浮くような言葉もいっぱいだ。つい肌が粟立ってしまうような展開もそこら中に溢れてる。呆れるくらい
lines.translated: "They're full ofwords that set your teeth on edge, too. Developments that make your skin crawl are overflowing everywhere you look. To an exasperating degree."

lines.content: それでも、そんなたったひとつのテーマが飽くことなく繰り返しつむがれていくのは……、そこに、人間たちが普遍的に求め続ける“何か”があるから……？
lines.translated: "Even so, the reason that single theme is woven over and over again without them ever tiring of it... is it because there's 'something' there that humans universally continue to seek...?"

lines.content: ああ。たぶんそういうことなんだろうね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's probably what it comes down to."

lines.content: 謳われるべきテーマはこの世界に溢れているだろうはずだけど、結局は、人の心はそこに回帰したがるものなのかもしれないね
lines.translated: "This world should be overflowing with themes worthy of being praised, yet in the end, perhaps the human heart simply yearns to return to that one place."

lines.content: ……そういった人間の言葉に触れるその度に、思ってた
lines.translated: "...Every time I came into contact with human words like those, I would think about it."

lines.content: ああ、うん。お前は何を思ってきたんだろう
lines.translated: "Ah, right. And just what is it you've been thinking about?"

lines.content: 命の価値だ。愛されるものの条件だよ
lines.translated: "The value of life. The conditions for being loved."

lines.content: ……この世に産まれた命が意味を成すには、そこにいていいものだと理解してもらうには、まず、愛されることが最低条件なんじゃないかと思えてならないけれど
lines.translated: "...For a life born into this world to have meaning, for it to be understood that it's allowed to be here, I can't help but feel that being loved is the bare minimum requirement."

lines.content: だが、俺は……
lines.translated: "However, I..."

lines.content: 誰からも怖がられ。誰からも疎まれて。誰からも、憎まれた。
lines.translated: I was feared by everyone. Shunned by everyone. Hated by everyone.
*Simply because I happened to be born in a form like this.*

lines.content: 俺は、醜かった。
lines.translated: I was ugly.

lines.content: 身体は無意味に巨大で。
lines.translated: My body was pointlessly massive.

lines.content: 顔は恐ろしいケモノのようで。
lines.translated: My face was like that of a terrifying beast.

lines.content: 両の眼は、真っ赤に鋭く光ってて……。
lines.translated: And both of my eyes gleamed with a sharp, crimson light...
*Every single child I ever met was terrified of me*--...

lines.content: 漠然と考えていた俺の答えに、今、なんとなく開いた本が言葉にしてくれたんだ
lines.translated: "A book I casually opened just now put into words the answer I'd been vaguely mulling over."

lines.content: ほう。なんて？
lines.translated: "Oh? And what did it say?"

lines.content: ……愛されることのない命には、その人生には、価値があるといえるのか
lines.translated: "...Can a life that is never loved, an existence like that, truly be said to have any value?"

lines.content: にべもない言葉だな
lines.translated: "Those are some blunt words."

lines.content: だが俺はこの言葉に深く納得してしまった。共感とさえ呼びたい感覚だ。……だからこそ、だ。愛されることのない[・|こ][・|の][・|命][・|は]、ここに存在してはならないものだと改めて、感じた――
lines.translated: "Yet I was deeply convinced by them. It's a sensation I'd even call empathy. ...And that's precisely why. I felt anew that *this life of mine*, which will never be loved, is something that shouldn't exist here--"
And so, my "dream" is *to die*.

lines.content: これまで出会った[子ら|人たち]は……死後、この[夜|街]の終着駅から更に列車に乗って、遠いどこかへとみな旅立っていく。
lines.translated: The people I've met up until now... after death, they all board a train from the terminal station of this city and set off on a journey to somewhere far away.

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれに望む“次”へと進むための“切符”を買って。
lines.translated: Each of them buying a "ticket" to move on to the "next" place they wish for.

lines.content: だけど死ねない俺はどこへも行けない。切符も買えない。……そのための命を持たない
lines.translated: "But because I cannot die, I can't go anywhere. I can't buy a ticket, either. ...I don't possess the life required for that."

lines.content: これまでも、これからも……愛されもしないのにひとりぼっちで“夜”の中を“永遠”に生きる。罪を犯してもいないのに重い罰だけがここにある。そんな気分だ。
lines.translated: Up until now, and from here on out... even though I'm unloved, I'll live on for "eternity" all alone within the "Night." Even though I've committed no crime, only a heavy punishment awaits me here. That's what it feels like.

lines.content: ……置いていかないでくれ。ひとりはいやだ。
lines.translated: Please don't leave me behind. I don't want to be alone.

lines.content: 旅立つ命を見送りながらいつもそう思ってた。
lines.translated: I always thought that as I saw off the lives departing on their journeys.

lines.content: ……どうか、俺も一緒に連れて行ってくれ。俺の“夢”にも、“[希望|切符]”をくれよ。
lines.translated: Please, take me along with you. Grant my "dream" a "ticket" of hope, too.

lines.content: そんな弱音にも似た心が、ときにこの胸を燻ることもあったのだ。
lines.translated: At times, a faint-hearted wish like that would smolder within my chest.

lines.content: 俺があの子らのように“次”へと進めないのは、きっとこの命を誰にも愛してもらえないからだ――故に価値がないからだ。存在自体が間違いだったからなんだ。
lines.translated: The reason I cannot move on to the "next" place like those children is surely because no one will ever love this life of mine--and therefore, it has no value. Because my very existence was a mistake.

lines.content: そう思えてならないからこそ……。
lines.translated: It is precisely because I cannot help feeling that way...

lines.content: だから俺は、せめて穏やかに死ぬことばかりを願ってた……死ぬことができれば、俺もこことは違う“次”へ行けるのではないかと……思えて
lines.translated: "That's why all I ever wished for was to at least die peacefully... thinking that if I could die, perhaps I, too, could go to a 'next' place different from here..."

lines.content: お前は、どう思う？
lines.translated: "What do you think?"

lines.content: え？　私が、か？
lines.translated: "Huh? Me?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 愛されなければ価値はない――命に対する俺のこの疑問は正しいのか。それとも考えるにも値しないものなのか。俺は心のない“夜の怪物”だ。ひとりで考えても答えは出ない
lines.translated: "Without being loved, there is no value--is this doubt I hold toward life correct? Or is it not even worth considering? I am a heartless 'Monster of the Night.' No matter how much I ponder it alone, I cannot find the answer."

lines.content: だから、人間の立場にも立てるだろうお前から……
lines.translated: "That's why, from you, who can still stand in the shoes of a human..."

lines.content: ……恥ずかしげもなく愛ばかりを謳う人間だったお前から、俺は、色々と教えてもらいたいと願ったから……だから俺は、お前を“夜”に引き入れたんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "...From you, who used to be a human that shamelessly sang the praises of love, I wished to be taught all sorts of things... and I think that's why I drew you into the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……愛する者を失い、今にもどうしようもない悲しみに、その心ごと食いつぶされようとしていたお前だから……。
lines.translated: Because you had lost the one you loved, and your very heart was on the verge of being devoured by an inescapable sorrow...

lines.content: そんなお前とだから、交わし合える言葉の中に、俺の探し求める答えがあるのではないかと、思った。
lines.translated: Because it was you, I thought that perhaps the answer I sought might lie within the words we could exchange with one another.

lines.content: 命の価値はその使い道で決まるんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Doesn't the value of a life depend on how it's used?"

lines.content: 私は、そう思うよって話だ
lines.translated: "That's just how I see it, anyway."

lines.content: 元人間の“怪物”は、言った――室内を満たすやわらかな“夜”の音楽に、その頬を小さく綻ばせながら。
lines.translated: The former-human "monster" spoke--her cheeks softening into a faint smile at the gentle music of the "Night" filling the room.

lines.content: 音楽も、絵画も、小説も。それらは全部、かつてこの世界を生きていた人間たちの残した“魔法”だと私は思ってるんだけど……
lines.translated: "Music, paintings, novels. I believe all of those things are 'magic' left behind by the humans who once lived in this world..."

lines.content: ……どういうことだ？　[・|そ][・|れ]と[・|こ][・|れ]とはどう関係してるんだ？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean? How does *that* have anything to do with *this*?"

lines.content: まあまあ、とりあえず聞けよ
lines.translated: "Now, now, just hear me out for a second."

lines.content: 人の名残を纏ったうつくしい怪物は言う。
lines.translated: The beautiful monster draped in the remnants of humanity spoke.

lines.content: 私が私なりに考える命の価値についての話だ――
lines.translated: "This is about how I personally view the value of life--"

lines.content: まあ、うん。まるで自分語りのようで、愛を語るよりも見方によれば、薄ら寒くもあるけれど……今夜は[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|時][・|間]だ。とりあえず聞いてくれ
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. It sounds almost like I'm just talking about myself, and depending on how you look at it, it might be even more cringe-worthy than talking about love... but tonight is *that kind of time*. Just listen for now."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|“][・|魔][・|法][・|”]は、時を超える手紙でもあるんじゃないかなと私は感じる
lines.translated: "I feel like *that 'magic'* might also be a letter that transcends time."

lines.content: そこに込められた言葉や想いが、遙か未来を生きている――今、自分と同じような悲しみに嘆いているかもしれない誰かを、もしかしたら励ますことができる……
lines.translated: "The words and feelings poured into it might just be able to encourage someone living in the distant future--someone who might be grieving over the exact same kind of sorrow right now..."

lines.content: そんな代えがたい価値あものになるかもしれない。
lines.translated: "It might become something of irreplaceable value like that."

lines.content: 未来に生きる悲しい誰かに、この声は届かなくても。その手を、握ってはやれなくても……
lines.translated: "Even if this voice cannot reach that sad someone living in the future. Even if I cannot hold their hand..."

lines.content: 言葉や旋律や色彩に、想いを込められるのなら――
lines.translated: "If you can pour your feelings into words, melodies, or colors--"

lines.content: その想いだけはどこまでも、どこまでも、消えることは決してなく、遠い未来へと届けることが可能なんじゃないかな――……
lines.translated: "Then perhaps those feelings alone will never, ever fade away, making it possible to deliver them all the way to the distant future--..."

lines.content: そして、いつかどこかでこの“魔法”を受け取ってくれた誰かの、その悲しい気持ちを、さみしい想いを、もしかしたら半分くらいにもできるかもしれない？
lines.translated: "And someday, somewhere, for the person who receives this 'magic,' it might just be able to cut their sad feelings and lonely thoughts in half?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだね。それがこの“魔法”の“希望”だよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. That is the 'hope' of this 'magic.'"

lines.content: 俺は、目を細める。
lines.translated: I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: ……なあ、おい
lines.translated: "...Hey, hold on."

lines.content: ああ、なんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, what is it?"

lines.content: 俺が“どういうことだ”と言ったのは、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|意][・|味]だけじゃない。いいか？　[・|ど][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と][・|だ]。お前、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ][・|ら]と会ったのか？　俺に秘密で？
lines.translated: "When I asked 'what do you mean,' I didn't just mean *in that sense*. Listen to me. *What is the meaning of this?* Did you meet with *them*? Behind my back?"

lines.content: 今、こいつが語ったものは、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ][・|ら]の信仰といってもいいだろう言葉の一部であった。
lines.translated: What this one had just spoken of was part of the very words that could be called *their* creed.

lines.content: ああ、うん。お察しの通りだ
lines.translated: "Ah, yep. Just as you guessed."

lines.content: うつくしい怪物は肩を竦めてみせた。
lines.translated: The beautiful monster gave a shrug.

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”を名乗る猫たちと少し話をした。つい数日前くらいかな。それはそれは話が尽きず、盛り上がりもしたよ。楽しい夜だった
lines.translated: "I had a little chat with the cats who call themselves 'Magicians of the Night.' Just a few days ago, I think. Oh, we never ran out of things to talk about, and we really hit it off, too. It was a fun night."

lines.content: ……帰りが遅い日が確かにあったな
lines.translated: "...There certainly was a day when you came back late."

lines.content: どうして俺に秘密で会いに行ったのか。そう問うと、『いや、だって』という言葉が返ってくる。
lines.translated: When I asked why she had gone to meet them in secret, she replied with a, "Well, I mean..."

lines.content: だってお前、いいや、お前たちはさ、自分以外の“夜の住人”を何でだか毛嫌いしてるだろ？
lines.translated: "I mean, you--no, all of you--for whatever reason, you detest any 'Denizens of the Night' other than yourselves, right?"

lines.content: えっと、“夜の王”、だったか？　誰が一番先に[・|そ][・|れ]を倒してみせるのか――だとかさ。そういう具合に争い合ってる。とても言えないじゃないか
lines.translated: "Um, the 'King of the Night,' was it? Arguing over who's going to be the first to defeat *it*--and all that. You're all at each other's throats like that. How could I possibly bring it up?"

lines.content: まあ、とにかく。彼女らも君と違わず、人間の産み出す品々に胸踊らせる子たちだった
lines.translated: "Well, in any case. Just like you, those girls were kids whose hearts danced at the things created by humans."

lines.content: 君は古風でクラシカルな芸術作品を。そして彼女は現代的で若者が喜びそうな作品を。そんなところまで相容れないんだな君たちは
lines.translated: "You prefer old-fashioned, classical works of art. And she likes modern pieces that appeal to the youth. You two really don't see eye to eye on anything, even down to that."

lines.content: うつくしい怪物は歯を見せ、笑った。
lines.translated: The beautiful monster flashed her teeth in a grin.

lines.content: そしてね、そんな彼女らと話しているうちにすっかり意気投合してしまってね――
lines.translated: "And, well, as I was talking with those girls, we ended up hitting it off completely--"

lines.content: 結果、芸術とは“魔法”であり、時を超えた手紙であり、未来へ託す“[エール|応援]”なのではないかという答えに、[・|こ][・|い][・|つ][・|も]行き着いたのだという。
lines.translated: As a result, *this one, too,* had arrived at the answer that art is "magic," a letter that transcends time, and a "cheer" of encouragement entrusted to the future.

lines.content: だけどな、聞いてくれよ“夜の怪物”。私は思うんだよ
lines.translated: "Still, hear me out, 'Monster of the Night.' Here's what I think."

lines.content: 何を……。お前は何を、思うんだ
lines.translated: "What...? What is it that you think?"

lines.content: ああ。じゃあさ、時を超えるほどとても優れた芸術を産み出す特別な人間以外は、その“魔法”は使えないのかな
lines.translated: "Right. Well, does that mean no one can use that 'magic' except for special humans who produce art extraordinary enough to transcend time?"

lines.content: そしてゼロから何も作り出せないらしい君たち“夜の住人”は……
lines.translated: "And what about you 'Denizens of the Night,' who apparently can't create anything from zero...?"

lines.content: ああ、今は私もそうなのか――まるで今知ったとばかりに驚いた素振りを見せながら、
lines.translated: "Oh, I suppose that applies to me now, too--" Feigning surprise as though she had only just realized it, she continued.

lines.content: やっぱり、[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|も]、そんな“魔法”を使うことはどうしたって不可能なのかなって
lines.translated: "Does that mean it really is completely impossible for *us* to use that kind of 'magic,' no matter what we do?"

lines.content: 思い描けるすべてを“魔法”にできる。こんなはちゃめちゃな世界の中で……特別な時間のただ中で、君たちには使えない“魔法”があるということになるのかなってさ
lines.translated: "You can turn anything you envision into 'magic.' And yet, in the middle of this absurd world... in the midst of this special time, does that mean there's a 'magic' you all can't use?"

lines.content: そんな、どこかさみしさにも似た疑問が残ったんだよ。そう言って、うつくしい怪物は笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: "I was left with a question like that, one that felt almost like loneliness." Saying so, the beautiful monster offered a smile.

lines.content: ……彼女らと会いに行ったのは、私も私なりに、[・|こ][・|う][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|っ][・|た]からこそ、自分というものの存在に、その価値に、疑問を持ってしまったからだ
lines.translated: "...The reason I went to meet them was that, in my own way, precisely because *I ended up like this*, I started having doubts about my own existence and its value."

lines.content: 君だけではなく、彼女たちだけでもなく、“夜”を生きるモノたちの言葉により多く触れてみたかったと、あいつは言った。
lines.translated: She said she had wanted to come into contact with more words spoken by those who live in the "Night"--not just mine, and not just theirs.

lines.content: ……私たちはどこから来てどこへいくのか。そんな誰もが迷うような定番の問題に、今、こうして命を失ってしまってから……私はようやく向き合う気になれたんだ
lines.translated: "...Where do we come from, and where are we going? Only now, after losing my life like this... have I finally felt ready to face that classic question everyone struggles with."

lines.content: ……その問題に答えは出たのか
lines.translated: "...Did you find an answer to that question?"

lines.content: いや。[・|変][・|わ][・|ら][・|ず]答えはないよ。代わりに“理想”と“希望”なら見つけた気になっている。だけど……
lines.translated: "No. There is *still* no answer. Instead, I feel like I've found an 'ideal' and a 'hope.' However..."

lines.content: ……どうした？
lines.translated: "...What's wrong?"

lines.content: 笑うなよ
lines.translated: "Don't laugh, okay?"

lines.content: ……笑わないさ
lines.translated: "...I won't laugh."

lines.content: ワイングラスに一度口を付け、
lines.translated: Touching the wine glass to her lips once,

lines.content: ……人生だよ
lines.translated: "...It's life."

lines.content: ぽつりと、あいつは言った。
lines.translated: she murmured quietly.

lines.content: たとえばだけれど、君は偉人と呼ばれる者たちの自伝や伝記を読んだことがあるか？
lines.translated: "Just as an example, have you ever read the autobiographies or biographies of people called great figures?"

lines.content: ……いくつかは
lines.translated: "...A few."

lines.content: いや。別に[・|そ][・|れ]は偉人でなくたっていいんだけどな。むしろ私たちみたいに何も産み出せない平凡な人間の[・|そ][・|れ]であればあるだけいいんだけれど……
lines.translated: "Well, *they* don't necessarily have to be great figures, though. In fact, the more *they* belong to ordinary humans like us who can't produce anything, the better..."

lines.content: ともあれ、人生だよ。彼らが歩んだ道のりを記した本だ。いやいや。本ではなくとも、言い伝えや噂話程度でも充分なんだ
lines.translated: "In any case, it's about a life. A book chronicling the path they walked. No, wait--even if it's not a book, mere legends or rumors are plenty."

lines.content: ……たとえば今、自分を苦しめる何かがあったとする
lines.translated: "...Suppose, right now, there is something tormenting you."

lines.content: どうしても、どうしても、自分には乗り越えがたいと感じられる困難に、今にも押しつぶされそうになっていたとする
lines.translated: "Suppose you're on the verge of being crushed by a hardship that feels utterly, completely insurmountable."

lines.content: ……そんなとき、偶然にも、あるいは運命的に伝え聞いた[・|い][・|つ][・|か][・|の][・|物][・|語]の中に、今の自分と同じような問題で、同じようにもがき苦しんでいる誰かがそこにいる
lines.translated: "...At a time like that, whether by chance or by fate, inside *a story from sometime* that you happen to hear, there is someone struggling and suffering in the exact same way over the exact same kind of problem you have right now."

lines.content: だけど彼らは、いつもいっぱいの勇気で、持てるあらゆる力を総動員して、その困難を乗り越えて見せてくれる――
lines.translated: "And yet, brimming with courage and mobilizing every ounce of strength they possess, they manage to overcome that hardship right before your eyes--"

lines.content: どんなに困難に見える“夢”も、誰からも不可能だと笑われるばかりの“理想”も、這いつくばりながら、もがき苦しみながら、最後には叶えて見せてくれる――
lines.translated: "No matter how impossible a 'dream' may seem, no matter how much everyone laughs at their 'ideal' as impossible, they crawl on hands and knees, struggling and suffering, until they finally make it come true in the end--"

lines.content: そんな“誰か”の人生にこそ“希望”を、“勇気”を、私たちはもらえるんじゃないかなとあいつは言う。
lines.translated: She said that perhaps it is from the life of a "someone" like that where we can receive "hope" and "courage."

lines.content: 物語じゃない。フィクションではない。現実にそれは起きたことなんだ
lines.translated: "It's not a tale. It's not fiction. It is something that actually happened in reality."

lines.content: ……その揺るぎようのない事実は、苦しいばかりの今を戦う熱量となり――その物語を受け取った者の心を振るわせる。そこにある一つひとつの言葉が勇気を、希望を、くれるんだ
lines.translated: "...That unshakable fact becomes the fuel to fight through an agonizing present--and it shakes the heart of the one who receives that story. Every single word in it gives them courage and hope."

lines.content: そうして生き抜いた誰かの道のりも、また、痛烈な“[テーマ|役割]”を持つひとつの優れた[作品|芸術]だとどうして呼べない
lines.translated: "Why couldn't the journey of someone who survived like that also be called a fine work of art carrying a poignant 'theme'?"

lines.content: ――人生は、その生き方そのものが、人の心を振るわせることだってあるはずなんだ。
lines.translated: "--A life, the very way it is lived, should be able to move a person's heart, too."

lines.content: もがき。苦しみ。悲しみに暮れ。だけどそのすべてを捨てずに歩み続ける。そんな人生こそが、私たちの[作品|芸術]なんだよと、あいつは微笑みと共に言う。
lines.translated: Struggling. Suffering. Drowning in sorrow. And yet continuing to walk forward without abandoning any of it. With a smile, she said that a life like that is *our* work of art.

lines.content: だから、“夜の怪物”
lines.translated: "And so, 'Monster of the Night.'"

lines.content: 私たちは……いかなる“魔法”をも“想像”できない私たちは、与えられた永遠にも等しいこの命をどう使い、どう生きるのか――……これからはさ、それを一緒に探していこう
lines.translated: "How will we... we who cannot 'imagine' any kind of 'magic,' use this near-eternal life we've been given, and how will we live it? ...From now on, let's search for that together."

lines.content: そうして思い描いた人生の中にこそ、君や私の命の価値は、あるんじゃあないのかな
lines.translated: "Don't you think the value of your life and mine might lie right inside the lives we envision that way?"

lines.content: ……お前の“夢”はいつか死ぬこと、だったよな。“夜の怪物”
lines.translated: "...Your 'dream' was to die someday, wasn't it, 'Monster of the Night'?"

lines.content: どうせいつか死ぬのなら、まずは[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]生きてみるのも悪くはないんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "If you're going to die someday anyway, wouldn't it be not so bad to try living *like that* first?"

lines.content: その“夜”はいつまでもふたりで生きることとは何かについて意見を交換し続けていた。
lines.translated: All through that "Night," the two of us continued exchanging opinions on what it meant to live.

lines.content: ……考えることのできない“怪物”が何をしている。人にでもなったつもりか。自分自身、呆れていた。
lines.translated: What is a "monster" incapable of thought doing? Does he think he's become human or something? I was exasperated with myself.

lines.content: “考えるイキモノ”である人間にさえ、完全な答えを導けない問題に取り組んだところで……まったく、この時間はどこまでも無意味だというのに。
lines.translated: Even if I tackled a problem that humans--"thinking creatures"--cannot derive a complete answer to... honestly, this time was utterly meaningless through and through.

lines.content: そういうどこか冷め切った自分がいるのと同時に……。
lines.translated: Yet at the very same time that a cold, detached part of me thought that...

lines.content: 答えなんて出やしないけれど、ただそういうことを話す時間が、きっと俺は楽しいと感じていた。
lines.translated: Even though no answer would ever come of it, I surely felt that simply spending time talking about such things was fun.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 今宵の“夜”が明ける頃、あいつは言った。
lines.translated: Around the time tonight's "Night" was breaking, she spoke.

lines.content: 今日はいつもよりたくさん話してくれたな。思いの外、楽しい“夜”だった
lines.translated: "You talked a lot more than usual today. It was a surprisingly fun 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ぜんぶ酒の力だと俺は言う。
lines.translated: I told her it was all because of the alcohol.

lines.content: いつも合わない趣味の話で言い合いばかりの俺たちだったが、その日、はじめて何かが通じ合えたように錯覚していた。
lines.translated: The two of us were always arguing over our incompatible tastes, yet that day, I was under the illusion that we had understood each other on something for the very first time.

lines.content: 長い時間を生きるのにひとりは時どき窮屈だ。話し相手がほしかった。お前を仲間にしてよかったと思ってる……
lines.translated: "Living through such a long stretch of time alone gets stifling every now and then. I wanted someone to talk to. I'm glad I made you my companion..."

lines.content: その“夜”はまるで“怪物”らしくもなく“夢”を見たような気がした。
lines.translated: That "Night," entirely unbefitting of a "monster," I felt as though I had seen a "dream."

lines.content: だが、同時に、こんなことをこいつと話すのはこれで最後だとも感じていた。
lines.translated: However, at the same time, I also felt that this would be the last time I ever spoke of such things with her.

lines.content: 最後だからこそ、こんなことまであいつに語った――酔いが回って、頭の中がしびれていた。
lines.translated: Precisely because it was the last time, I even told her this much--the alcohol had gone to my head, leaving my mind numb.

lines.content: ……どんなに困難なように見える“夢”をも叶えて見せてくれる――
lines.translated: "...Making even the most seemingly impossible 'dream' come true--"

lines.content: そんな“誰か”の人生にこそ“希望”を、“勇気”をもらえる。そういう生き方こそが作品たり得る、かもしれない。そう言ってたな？
lines.translated: "It is from the life of a 'someone' like that where we can receive 'hope' and 'courage.' A way of life like that might be able to become a work of art in itself. That's what you said, right?"

lines.content: ああ、言ったな
lines.translated: "Yeah, I did."

lines.content: なら俺は人として死んでみたい……“怪物”としてではなく。愛をうたえるような心ある人として
lines.translated: "Then I want to try dying as a human... not as a 'monster.' As a person with a heart, someone who can sing the praises of love."

lines.content: ……そしてもしも叶うなら、一度でいい。“家族”を持ってみたい。そこにはきっと、俺のほしいものがすべて揃ってる――
lines.translated: "...And if it could be granted, just once is enough. I want to try having a 'family.' Everything I want is surely gathered right there--"

lines.content: そんなふうに夢見てしまうのだ。どうしても。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but dream like that. No matter what.

lines.content: もしもだ。もしも俺が、誰かに愛されたいだとかいうバカみないた“夢”を、そしていつか家族がほしいだとかいう下らない理想を、いつか叶えることができたなら……
lines.translated: "What if... What if I were able to fulfill that foolish 'dream' of wanting to be loved by someone, and that pointless ideal of wanting a family someday..."

lines.content: 俺でも……こんな、俺なんかでも。誰かを勇気づけられる――誰かに愛してもらえる。そんな人生を生きていくことが、できるかな
lines.translated: "Could even I... even someone like me, encourage someone--be loved by someone? Would I be able to live a life like that?"

lines.content: ……ああ、きっとな
lines.translated: "...Yeah, I'm sure you could."

lines.content: ここは思い描くすべてが叶う“夜の国”、なんだろう？　思い続けていればきっと叶うさ
lines.translated: "This is the 'Land of Night,' where everything you envision comes true, right? If you keep holding onto that thought, it'll surely come true."

lines.content: されに、その願いが叶う日が来れば、きっと君は誰より魅力的な人間になれるはずだよ。ああ、きっと
lines.translated: "Besides, when the day comes that your wish is granted, I'm sure you'll become a more wonderful human than anyone else. Yeah, I know you will."

lines.content: 話しすぎたことを心のどこかで後悔もし、その“夜”からたばこの本数がぐっと増えた。
lines.translated: Deep down, a part of me regretted having talked too much, and from that "Night" on, the number of cigarettes I smoked went up sharply.

lines.content: そしてそれは、もう二度と酒は飲まないぞと誓った“夜”でもあった。
lines.translated: And it was also the "Night" I swore I would never drink alcohol again.

lines.content: ……なんだ、その子どもは
lines.translated: "...What's with that kid?"

lines.content: ……ある日の“夜”
lines.translated: One "Night."

lines.content: 俺たちは言い合いをしていた。
lines.translated: The two of us were arguing.

lines.content: 噛み合わない音楽や物語の好き嫌いについてではない。
lines.translated: It wasn't about our clashing likes and dislikes in music or stories.

lines.content: またあいつが女の子を[さら|攫]ってきたのだ。
lines.translated: She had abducted a girl again.
Even though so little time had passed *since the last girl ended up like that*, what on earth was she thinking?

lines.content: ……前回の子。
lines.translated: The last girl.

lines.content: それは千和という名の女の子。
lines.translated: That was a girl named Chiwa.

lines.content: “夜”の中での俺の“役割”は、外の世界で悲しい思いをしている子を[さら|攫]い、その命を悲しい心ごと“夜”のさくらに捧げることで……。
lines.translated: My "role" within the "Night" was to abduct girls who were suffering in sorrow in the outside world, and offer their lives along with their sorrowful hearts to the cherry blossoms of the "Night"...

lines.content: 代わりに、少女たちには永遠を贈る。
lines.translated: In exchange, we grant the girls eternity.

lines.content: そのような“役割”に従事することが自分の命の価値だと思おうとしていた。
lines.translated: I had been trying to convince myself that devoting myself to such a "role" was the value of my life.

lines.content: ……だが人間はときに信じられないことをする。信じられないほど、残酷なことをする。
lines.translated: However, humans sometimes do unbelievable things. Unbelievably cruel things.

lines.content: あえて少女を拷問めいた虐待で責め続け――その心を“悲しみ”でどっぷりと満たす。
lines.translated: They deliberately subject a girl to torturous abuse over and over--steeping her heart completely in "sorrow."
*When that happens, we cannot help but become aware of that child.*

lines.content: 俺たち“怪物”はそんな子らの心を敏感に感取ってしまうように出来ていて……しかし。
lines.translated: We "monsters" are built to acutely sense the hearts of such children... and yet.

lines.content: しかし[・|そ][・|の][・|子]は、“怪物”である俺たちをおびき寄せるための餌だった。
lines.translated: Yet *that child* was bait meant to lure us "monsters" out.

lines.content: それが罠だとは想像だにできず――俺たちは少女を“不死”にした。
lines.translated: Unable to even imagine that it was a trap--we made the girl "immortal."

lines.content: 永遠を付与された子の肉を、骨を、血液を、そのすべてを喰らえば“不死”となれる――そのような迷信を信じた人間によって、前回[さら|攫]って来た子は喰われてしまったのだった。
lines.translated: If one devours the flesh, the bones, the blood--every last bit of a child granted eternity, one can become "immortal"--by humans who believed in such a superstition, the girl we had abducted last time was devoured.

lines.content: 俺たちがその子を殺したようなもの。
lines.translated: It was practically as if we had killed that child ourselves.

lines.content: もう二度と女の子を[さら|攫]わない。[・|こ][・|れ]は俺たちの生きる意味なんかじゃなかったんだ。あいつとはそう確認し合えていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: We would never abduct a girl again. *This* was never our reason for living. Even though she and I were supposed to have confirmed that with each other...

lines.content: あいつの背中に隠れるようにして、小さな、本当に小さな女の子がいた。俺を恐る恐る見上げている。
lines.translated: Hiding behind her back was a small, truly tiny girl. She was looking up at me timidly.

lines.content: 目が合う度にびくりと震え、涙をにじませ……ああ、この子も同じだ。今までの子らと[おんな|同]じだ。
lines.translated: Every time our eyes met, she flinched and trembled, tears welling in her eyes... Ah, this child is the same. The same as all the children up until now.

lines.content: そんな目で俺を見ないでくれ。怖がらないでくれ。……お願いだ。
lines.translated: Don't look at me with those eyes. Don't be afraid of me. ...Please.

lines.content: 前回の子もそうだったのだ。俺には決して懐かず、怖がるばかりで……。
lines.translated: The last child had been like that, too. She never warmed up to me, only ever fearing me...

lines.content: 一緒にいることのほうがひとりぼっちであるよりずっとさみしい。
lines.translated: Being together was far lonelier than being all alone.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|い][・|つ]がいてくれてよかった。
lines.translated: Thank goodness *she* was here.

lines.content: あいつは前回の子のことを大切に、大切に扱っていた――まるで自分の子どもみたいに。守れなかった自分の子を、思い出しているみたいに。
lines.translated: She had treated the last child with such care, such precious care--just as if she were her own child. As if she were remembering her own child whom she hadn't been able to protect.

lines.content: そんな子が[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]されてしまえば、それは当然、悲しいし悔しいし、[・|怒][・|り][・|だ][・|っ][・|て][・|湧][・|く]だろうが……。
lines.translated: When a child like that *has something like that done to her*, it's only natural to feel sad, to feel bitter regret, and *for anger to well up*, too, but...

lines.content: だからといって、また同じ過ちを繰り返していい理由にはならない。
lines.translated: Even so, that is no reason to repeat the exact same mistake again.

lines.content: しかも今回あいつが[さら|攫]ってきた子は、前回の子と同様の立場だった。
lines.translated: What's more, the child she had abducted this time was in the exact same position as the last one.

lines.content: 俺たちにあえて[さら|攫]わせ、不死にさせられた後、再び俺たちの元から少女を[さら|攫]い――宴を催す。それがこの子の命の価値だ。そのためだけに、この世に産まれてきた命。
lines.translated: Having us deliberately abduct her and make her immortal, only to abduct the girl from us all over again--and hold a feast. That is the value of this child's life. A life born into this world for that purpose alone.

lines.content: そんな女の子を[さら|攫]ってきてしまっては、奴らの思うつぼではないか。
lines.translated: By abducting a girl like that, aren't we playing right into their hands?

lines.content: ……ああ、だからあの子のことを不死にはしない。君にはそうお願いしたいんだ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's why we won't make her immortal. That's what I'd like to ask of you."

lines.content: [さら|攫]ってきた子を寝かしつけてから、あいつは俺にそう言った。
lines.translated: After putting the girl she had abducted to bed, she said that to me.

lines.content: あの子のことはあくまでも人間として育てよう。私たちふたりで
lines.translated: "Let's raise that child strictly as a human. Just the two of us."

lines.content: ……だがそうなれば、お前が[さら|攫]ってきたあの子はいつか、ここを出て行かなきゃならないぞ
lines.translated: "...But if we do that, the girl you abducted is going to have to leave this place someday."

lines.content: 俺たちは人と触れあえない。あの子の隣にいられるのは、あの子が子どもでいられる時間内だけだ
lines.translated: "We can't interact with humans. The only time we can stay by her side is while she's still a child."

lines.content: ……ああ。だからあの子には、外の世界ででも自分ひとりで生きていけるだけの賢さを学んでいってほしい。そういうふうにして育てていこうと思う
lines.translated: "...Yes. That's why I want her to learn enough wisdom to survive on her own even in the outside world. That's how I intend to raise her."

lines.content: そして願わくば、共に支え合って歩いて行ける、そんな誰かと出会ってほしい。それらが全部揃うまでは、あの子の人生に責任を持ちたい。そう、願ってる
lines.translated: "And if I may wish for it, I want her to meet someone she can walk alongside, supporting each other. Until she has all of that, I want to take responsibility for her life. That's what I wish for."

lines.content: ……いいのか？
lines.translated: "...Are you okay with this?"

lines.content: いい、とは……？
lines.translated: "Okay with what...?"

lines.content: お前の[さら|攫]ってきたあの子は、前回の子を喰らった“ヒトデナシ”の娘だぞ
lines.translated: "That girl you abducted is the daughter of the 'inhuman monsters' who devoured the last child."

lines.content: お前はそれで平気なのかと問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked if she was really fine with that.

lines.content: 前回の子のことを、お前はひどくかわいがっていたじゃないか
lines.translated: "You doted on the last child so terribly much, didn't you?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 平気だ、とあいつは応える――……なぜ。なぜ、平気なんだ。
lines.translated: "I'm fine with it," she replied--...Why? How can she be fine with it?

lines.content: ……だって、そうだろ。責任がある。あの子をひとりにしてしまった責任が、[・|私]にはある。だから……
lines.translated: "...Because it's only natural, right? There is a responsibility. *I* bear the responsibility for having left that child all alone. So..."

lines.content: それ以上あいつは何も語らなかった。
lines.translated: She didn't say anything more than that.

lines.content: お前がいいのならそれでいい。勝手にすればいいだろう。
lines.translated: If you're fine with it, then fine. Do whatever you want.

lines.content: それに……。
lines.translated: Not only that...

lines.content: 『やった。これから私たちは[・|三][・|人][・|家][・|族]だ。よろしくね』
lines.translated: "'Hooray. From now on, the *three of us are a family*. Let's get along.'"

lines.content: [・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]を言われてしまえば、これ以上“だめだ”とは言えなくなる――俺の“夢”を知っているからこそ、あいつはきっとそんなことを言ったのだろうから。
lines.translated: Once she said *something like that*, I couldn't say "no" anymore--because she surely said it knowing full well about my "dream."

lines.content: だが、条件をひとつだけ提示した。
lines.translated: However, I gave her just one condition.

lines.content: 俺はできるだけあの子には関わらない。理由なんてわざわざ聞くなよ。わかるだろ。俺は見ての通り醜いんだ。怖いんだ。“怪物”、なんだ
lines.translated: "I'll stay uninvolved with that kid as much as possible. Don't bother asking why. You know already, right? As you can see, I'm ugly. I'm scary. I'm a 'monster.'"

lines.content: そんな俺が近寄っても無駄に怖がらせてしまうだけだし、泣かれでもしたらいよいよだ。そんな子どもを相手にするのは面倒なんだよ
lines.translated: "If someone like me gets close, it'll just scare her for no reason, and if she starts crying, that'll be the end of it. Dealing with a kid like that is a pain."

lines.content: だからお前がすべて世話をしろ。責任を持ってだ。俺はいっさい、手を貸さない。いいな？
lines.translated: "So you take care of everything. Take full responsibility. I won't lend a hand at all. Got it?"

lines.content: まあ、こんな条件を出すまでもない。俺の命は愛されることのない命。あの子は俺になど近寄ろうともしないはずだ。これまでの子らと同じように。
lines.translated: Well, there was no need to even state a condition like this. My life is one that will never be loved. That child wouldn't even try to come near me anyway. Just like all the children before her.

lines.content: ただ、条件だとか面倒なことを言っておけば、あいつも俺に気を遣うこともなく新しい子を迎え入れられるだろうと、ただ、そう思っての発言に過ぎなかったのだが――……。
lines.translated: Still, it was nothing more than a remark made thinking that if I brought up a troublesome condition like that, she would be able to welcome the new child without worrying about me--...

lines.content: 新しいその子は、これまでの子らとは少し違っていた。
lines.translated: That new child was a little different from the ones before her.

lines.content: まず、俺のことを怖がらない。
lines.translated: First of all, she wasn't afraid of me.

lines.content: 家にやって来た最初の“夜”こそ、その他の子らとまったく同じように、醜いばかりのこの俺のことを怖がっているように見えたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though on the very first "Night" she came to the house, she had looked terrified of this ugly self of mine, just like all the other children...

lines.content: 朝、フロアで新聞を読んでいる俺のことを、物陰からじっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: In the morning, as I read the newspaper on the floor, she stared fixedly at me from behind cover.

lines.content: 鬱陶しいなと、思った。
lines.translated: What a nuisance, I thought.

lines.content: 好奇心ばかりが膨らむ子どもはときとして残酷だ。
lines.translated: Children bursting with nothing but curiosity can sometimes be cruel.

lines.content: この醜い顔が珍しく――遠くからじぃっと俺のことを観察し続けているのだろう。
lines.translated: Finding this ugly face of mine unusual--she must have been staring and observing me from afar.

lines.content: 気づいているぞとばかりに振り向けば、たちまち泣いて、恐がり――[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]の元へ走って行くだろう。
lines.translated: If I turned around as if to say I'd noticed her, she would surely burst into tears in an instant, terrified--and run straight to *her*.

lines.content: はじめは店内と家の中とを繋ぐ出入り口から、顔を半分だけだし、俺のことを見ていた。
lines.translated: At first, she only poked half her face out from the doorway connecting the shop and the house, watching me.

lines.content: 次の日の朝は、少しだけ距離が縮まっている――あの子は俺の座る場所からいくつか離れた机の下に身体を押し込め、そこからじっと俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: The next morning, the distance had shrunk just a little--she had squeezed herself under a desk a few tables away from where I sat, staring fixedly at me from there.

lines.content: 次の日はまた少し、こちらに近づいていた。
lines.translated: The day after that, she had gotten a little closer again.

lines.content: 毎朝、その距離が少しずつ、近くなってきているようだった。
lines.translated: Every morning, it seemed as though that distance was gradually closing, little by little.

lines.content: 更に次の朝には、俺の隣の椅子にでも腰を下ろすのではないかと思えてしまった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking that by the following morning, she might actually sit down in the chair right next to mine.

lines.content: ……おい。あの子の世話はお前が見ると言っただろう。目を離さずちゃんと見ていろ
lines.translated: "...Hey. You said you'd take care of that kid, right? Keep your eyes on her and watch her properly."

lines.content: ……約束が違うぞと、俺は堪らずあいつに言った。
lines.translated: Unable to bear it any longer, I told her that this wasn't what she promised.

lines.content: いいじゃないか、仲良くしてあげるくらい。きっとあの子は君に興味津々なんだよ
lines.translated: "Come on, what's the harm in getting along with her a little? I'm sure that child is just brimming with curiosity about you."

lines.content: 俺の戸惑いなどどこふく風というようにあいつは笑っていた。
lines.translated: She laughed as if my bewilderment were none of her concern.

lines.content: まったく。“人間”はすぐ約束をやぶる――これだから外の世界のイキモノは。
lines.translated: Good grief. "Humans" are so quick to break their promises--this is why creatures from the outside world are such a pain.

lines.content: ……そして、その次の日の朝だ。
lines.translated: And then came the next morning.

lines.content: 案の定、というべきなのか。
lines.translated: Just as I thought, perhaps I should say.

lines.content: あの子は俺の隣の席に座り、じっと、俺のことを見つめていた――う、うう。何なんだ。
lines.translated: The girl sat in the seat next to mine and stared fixedly at me--U-Ugh. What does she want?

lines.content: 堪らず、俺は言った。ため息をつくように。
lines.translated: Unable to take it anymore, I spoke, almost like a sigh.

lines.content: ……何を見ている
lines.translated: "...What are you looking at?"

lines.content: 低い声で。うなるように。目をぎらりと、光らせて。
lines.translated: In a low voice. Like a growl. With my eyes glinting sharply.

lines.content: ……バカ野郎。
lines.translated: You idiot.

lines.content: 何をしているんだ俺は――こんな威嚇するかのような言い方をして。もっとやさしい言い方が、声が、言葉が、あったはずだろうに。
lines.translated: What am I doing--speaking to her in such an intimidating way? Surely there was a kinder way to put it, a kinder voice, kinder words I could have used.

lines.content: 驚いたようにハッとする女の子だ。
lines.translated: The girl gasped as if startled.

lines.content: （……あ、ああ。やっぱりいつもと同じだ。また、嫌われる。怖がられる）
lines.translated: (...A-Ah. Just as I thought, it's the same as always. I'll be hated again. Feared again.)

lines.content: 今回は自分で止めを刺してしまったようなもの。
lines.translated: This time, it was practically as if I had dealt the finishing blow myself.

lines.content: 新聞を閉じ――俺は、鋭い赤色を閉じ込めるみたいに、[まぶた|瞼]を塞いだ。
lines.translated: Closing the newspaper--I shut my eyelids, as if to lock away their sharp red color.

lines.content: ……お星さま
lines.translated: "...The stars."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 小さなちいさなその声に、閉じた[まぶた|瞼]をこじ開けられた。
lines.translated: That tiny, tiny voice pried my closed eyelids back open.

lines.content: 開かれた視界には、あの子の怖がった顔、ではなく――にっこり微笑む笑顔があった。
lines.translated: In my opened field of vision was not her frightened face--but a beaming, smiling one.

lines.content: お星さまを、見ていたの。きらきらしてて、とってもきれい
lines.translated: "I was looking at the stars. They're sparkling and so very pretty."

lines.content: ……それは
どういうこと、だろう。
lines.translated: What could she mean by that?

lines.content: 俺は首をかしげてしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help tilting my head.

lines.content: きっとそのとき、この両目は更にぎらりと光り、恐ろしい“怪物”の[・|そ][・|れ]であったはず。
lines.translated: Surely at that moment, both of my eyes had glinted even more sharply, looking every bit like *those* of a terrifying "monster."

lines.content: しかし女の子はにこにこ顔を絶やすことなく、俺の目をじぃっと見つめているばかりで……。
lines.translated: Yet the girl never stopped smiling brightly, just staring intently into my eyes...

lines.content: 俺は……。
俺は、顔を背けてしまう。恥ずかしかったからだ。……落ち着かなかったからだ。
lines.translated: I ended up looking away. Because I was embarrassed. ...Because I felt restless.

lines.content: “……俺が怖くはないのか”
lines.translated: "...Aren't you afraid of me?"

lines.content: とは、聞けなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't ask her that.

lines.content: その瞬間、この子の気まぐれが解け、『……怖い』と言われてしまったらどうしよう。
lines.translated: What would I do if, at that very moment, this child's whim wore off and she told me, "...I'm scared"?

lines.content: そんな恐怖があったから。
lines.translated: Because I had that fear.

lines.content: そんな未来を、想像してしまったから。
lines.translated: Because I couldn't help imagining a future like that.

lines.content: だけどその日の朝、女の子はずっと、俺のそばにいてくれた。
lines.translated: Even so, that morning, the girl stayed by my side the entire time.

lines.content: 俺が新聞のページを捲る。
lines.translated: I turned a page of the newspaper.

lines.content: すると微かな風が舞い上がり、すぐ隣に座る女の子の短い前髪をふわりと揺らした。
lines.translated: As I did, a faint breeze kicked up, softly fluttering the short bangs of the girl sitting right beside me.

lines.content: それがくすぐったいのか、女の子は俺が新聞のページを捲る度、目を細め、小さな笑顔を綻ばせていた。
lines.translated: Perhaps it tickled, because every time I turned a page of the newspaper, the girl narrowed her eyes and broke into a small smile.

lines.content: そんな女の子の顔を見て、つい……、
lines.translated: Looking at the girl's face like that, I almost...

lines.content: ……心の中に芽生えた言葉を、俺はぐっと堪えるばかりだった。
lines.translated: All I could do was tightly hold back the words that had sprouted within my heart.

lines.content: ……君に名前を贈りたいんだ
lines.translated: "...I'd like to give you a name."

lines.content: いつかの朝、あいつがあの子を千和と名付けた。
lines.translated: One morning, she named the child Chiwa.

lines.content: 前回、俺たちが[さら|攫]い――[・|あ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]になってしまった女の子と同じ名だ。
lines.translated: It was the exact same name as the girl we had abducted last time--the one who had met *that terrible fate*.

lines.content: それはさすがにどうだろう。
lines.translated: Is that really a good idea?

lines.content: そう思いはしたが……。
lines.translated: I did think that, though...

lines.content: ならば代わりに名付けろと言われたなら俺は何も言葉を返せない――新しく名前を考え、贈ることさえ、俺たち“怪物”には困難なことのひとつだったからだ。
lines.translated: If I were told to name her instead, I wouldn't have been able to say a word back--because even thinking up and giving a new name was one of the things that was difficult for us "monsters."

lines.content: 女の子を……千和を寝かしつけたなら、俺たちは“夜”に出かけていく。
lines.translated: Once we put the girl... once we put Chiwa to bed, we would head out into the "Night."

lines.content: 前回、不死を与えた子が“夜”に産まれ直してはいないか。
lines.translated: To see if the child we had granted immortality to last time had been reborn into the "Night."

lines.content: その行方を探すためだ――あの子の“魂”が、“夜”のどこかで迷子になってはいないか。
lines.translated: It was to search for her whereabouts--to see if that child's "soul" was lost somewhere within the "Night."

lines.content: それを、確かめるためだ。
lines.translated: It was to make sure of that.

lines.content: あの子を“夜”の中で探すのはもう何度目になるだろう。
lines.translated: How many times had we searched for her in the "Night" by now?

lines.content: ……しかしどこにも見つからない。
lines.translated: Yet she was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: もしもあの子の命が“夜”の中に産まれ直していてくれれば……。
lines.translated: If only that child's life had been reborn within the "Night"...

lines.content: どんな形にせよ、もう一度、会えたなら――謝りたかった。俺たちの不注意で君は[さら|攫]われてしまった。
lines.translated: In whatever form, if we could just meet her one more time--I wanted to apologize. To tell her that she had been abducted because of our carelessness.

lines.content: だけどそれは叶わないまま……。
lines.translated: Yet that wish remained unfulfilled...

lines.content: 俺たちの見解として――“不死”となったイキモノが死を迎えたならば、その他の命とは違い、“夜”の中に産まれ直すことはない――完全に消滅してしまう。本当の死だ。
lines.translated: In our view--when a creature that has become "immortal" meets its death, unlike other lives, it is never reborn into the "Night"--it vanishes completely. A true death.

lines.content: ……故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: おそらく、無から産まれたのだろう俺と、愛する娘と命を交換した元人間の怪物も、死ねばそのまま――
lines.translated: Most likely, both I, who was probably born from nothingness, and the former human turned monster who traded her life for her beloved daughter's, would simply--

lines.content: “夜”に産まれる魂などどこにもなく、跡形もなく消滅してしまうのだろう。
lines.translated: Have no soul born into the "Night" anywhere, vanishing without a trace if we died.

lines.content: どちらともなく“あの子とはもう会えない”と理解し、そして“不死”なる者の俺たちの死こそ本当の死なのだと理解した“夜”だったけれど――……
lines.translated: Without either of us saying it aloud, it was the "Night" we both understood that we would never be able to meet that child again, and that for "immortals" like us, our death would be a true death--...

lines.content: あいつが立ち止まり、背後を見ていた。
