lines.translated: She stopped in her tracks and looked behind us.

lines.content: どうした？　そう問いかける俺に、『あの子だ』と小さく言った。
lines.translated: "What's wrong?" When I asked her that, she quietly said, "It's her."

lines.content: ……あの子の声がする
lines.translated: "...I hear her voice."

lines.content: それは、毎夜、俺たちが探し求めていた子ではなく……新しい千和のほう。
lines.translated: It wasn't the child we searched for every night... It was the new Chiwa.

lines.content: おそらく毎夜のように出かけていく俺たちの後を追ってきたのだろうとあいつは言った。
lines.translated: She said the girl had probably followed after us since we went out almost every night.

lines.content: “夜”の住人たちに囲まれている。
lines.translated: She was surrounded by the inhabitants of the "Night."

lines.content: その様子が“怪物”の耳には届いていた。
lines.translated: The sound of that situation had reached our "monster" ears.

lines.content: そして……、もうひとつ。邪悪な気配も、俺たちには届いていた。
lines.translated: And... there was one more thing. A sinister presence had also reached us.

lines.content: そっちのほうは君に任せてもいいかな
lines.translated: "Do you mind if I leave that side of things to you?"

lines.content: ……ああ。わかった
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Got it."

lines.content: あいつは千和を助けに、一足で、“夜”の空へと舞い上がり――……俺は、
lines.translated: With a single bound, she soared up into the sky of the "Night" to go save Chiwa--...while I,

lines.content: ……なるほど。この俺よりも怪物めいた姿だな、[・|お][・|前][・|た][・|ち]
lines.translated: "...I see. *You two* look even more like monsters than I do."

lines.content: 俺は、俺たちの家で眠る千和を[さら|攫]いにやって来た――ふたりの[・|化][・|け][・|物]たちの前に立つ。
lines.translated: I stood before the two *monsters* who had come to abduct Chiwa while she slept in our home.

lines.content: ……死しても尚、自分たちの娘を道連れにしようと“夜”を彷徨い続けているのか。まったく、心の底から邪悪だな
lines.translated: "...Even in death, you continue to wander the 'Night' just to drag your own daughter down with you? Good grief, you truly are evil to the very core."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は千和の父親と母親の魂だった――“夜”の中で心の形が、その色が、[・|そ][・|れ][・|に][・|相][・|応][・|し][・|い][・|形]として実体化した姿だった。
lines.translated: *Those things* were the souls of Chiwa's father and mother--the physical manifestations of the shapes and colors of their hearts within the "Night," having taken on *forms befitting them*.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]では心の模様がすべてなのだ。
lines.translated: *Here*, the pattern of one's heart is everything.

lines.content: ケモノのような手。そして爪。耳まで裂けた口。まさに人ではないもの――“ヒトデナシ”
lines.translated: Beast-like hands. And claws. Mouths slit all the way to their ears. Truly things that were no longer human--inhuman monsters.

lines.content: ふたつの“化け物”は、『千和を渡せ』と喚いて騒ぐ――『あの子は私たちのものだ』
lines.translated: The two "monsters" shrieked and thrashed about, demanding, "Hand Chiwa over!"--"That girl belongs to us!"

lines.content: そんなふたつを消し去って……。
lines.translated: After erasing the two of them...

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 千和も同じだと、思った。
lines.translated: I thought to myself that Chiwa was the same.

lines.content: 千和も俺と同じで、愛されたい者に愛してもらえず、いつもさみしいばかり、だったのか。
lines.translated: Just like me, Chiwa hadn't been loved by the ones she wanted to be loved by, leaving her constantly lonely.

lines.content: ……そんなあの子のさみしさは、いったいどうしたら拭ってやれるのだろうか。
lines.translated: How on earth could I wipe away that girl's loneliness?

lines.content: そう思うと、胸のどこかがちくりと痛んだ。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I felt a sharp prick of pain somewhere in my chest.

lines.content: ……ふたりにお名前を贈ってもいい？
lines.translated: "...May I give the two of you names?"

lines.content: ……次の朝。
lines.translated: The next morning.

lines.content: 千和のそんな言葉に俺は驚かされていた――ふたり？　今、ふたりにと言ったのか？　あいつにだけじゃなく？　聞き間違えか？
lines.translated: Chiwa's words caught me completely off guard--the two of us? Did she just say the two of us? Not just her? Did I mishear that?

lines.content: あなたはソルで、あなたは……ナハト
lines.translated: "You are Sol, and you are... Nacht."

lines.content: あいつは太陽という意味で、俺は夜という意味の言葉をくれた。聞き間違いではなかったようだ。都合のいい思い込みでもなかったようだ。
lines.translated: She gave my partner a word meaning sun, and me a word meaning night. It seemed I hadn't misheard. Nor was it just wishful thinking on my part.

lines.content: [・|名][・|前][・|の][・|な][・|か][・|っ][・|た][・|自][・|分]に“千和”と名付けてくれたことへのお礼だという。
lines.translated: She said it was to thank us for naming *her nameless self* "Chiwa."

lines.content: ならば、尚更だ。まさか俺にも“お礼”をくれるとは思わなかった――この子に名前を贈ったのも。この子を助けに向かったのも。俺ではなく、あいつだったのに……。
lines.translated: If that was the case, then all the more reason. I never expected her to give *me* a "thank-you" gift as well--when the one who had given her a name, and the one who had gone to save her, hadn't been me, but my partner...

lines.content: それなのに、俺にも名前を……。
lines.translated: And yet, she gave me a name too...

lines.content: “ありがとう”
lines.translated: "Thank you."

lines.content: 礼を、言わなければ。
lines.translated: I had to thank her.

lines.content: “……大切にする”
lines.translated: "...I'll treasure it."

lines.content: それくらいのことは、伝えなければ……。
lines.translated: I had to tell her at least that much...

lines.content: “……名前なんて、はじめてもらったんだ”
lines.translated: "...This is the first time I've ever been given a name."

lines.content: だけど、俺の醜い口元からこぼれ落ちるのは……、
lines.translated: However, what spilled out from my ugly mouth was...

lines.content: ……こいつが“太陽”なら、俺は“月”じゃないのか
lines.translated: "...If she's the 'sun,' then shouldn't I be the 'moon'?"

lines.content: やはり、醜いばかりの言葉と態度、そればかり……。
lines.translated: Just as always, nothing but ugly words and an ugly attitude...

lines.content: そして顔を開いた新聞で隠し――情けない自分に呆れ、大きなおおきなため息をつく。“もっとマシなことを言えないのか”と。
lines.translated: Then I hid my face behind my open newspaper--disgusted with my own pathetic self, I let out a great, heavy sigh. "Can't you say something decent for once?" I thought.

lines.content: だけど千和はそんなこと、気にする素振りも見せず、あいつと……ソルと名付けた元人間の“怪物”と笑い合っていた。
lines.translated: Yet Chiwa showed no sign of minding it at all, laughing together with her... with the former human "monster" she had named Sol.

lines.content: その日の晩。千和が眠りについた頃、フロアに音楽をかけてみた。
lines.translated: That night. Around the time Chiwa fell asleep, I tried putting some music on down on the main floor.

lines.content: “小さな夜の曲”という意味が贈られた音楽だ。
lines.translated: It was a piece of music gifted with the meaning "a little night music."

lines.content: 静かな眠りの時間に捧げられたものというよりは、飛び跳ねる春の日差しに心弾ませるかのような旋律から幕を開くもの。
lines.translated: Rather than something dedicated to a quiet hour of sleep, the curtain rose on a melody that made the heart leap like bouncing spring sunlight.

lines.content: 騒がしい夜だなと常々思っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: I had always thought of it as a rather noisy night, though...

lines.content: ああ、これはまるで俺の心の中みたいだなと、思った。
lines.translated: Ah, it's just like the inside of my own heart, I thought.

lines.content: 口下手で、それを隠すみたいに毒づくばかり……。
lines.translated: Awkward with words, doing nothing but spitting venom as if to hide it...

lines.content: だからまともな関係も築けやしない。静かに部屋の片隅で座り込み、いつも文字ばかりを追っている。
lines.translated: Unable to build a proper relationship because of it. Sitting quietly in the corner of the room, always doing nothing but chasing letters on a page.

lines.content: そのくせいつも心は“どうしてもっと上手にできないのか”と懊悩ばかりで騒がしく――ああ、本当に、まるで不安定な俺の心みたいだなと思えなくもなかったのだ。
lines.translated: And yet, my heart was always noisy with agonizing thoughts of "why can't I do this better?"--ah, I really couldn't help thinking that it sounded just like my own unstable heart.

lines.content: ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah, that's right.

lines.content: ふと、思う。
lines.translated: Suddenly, a thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: どのような作品にもそれぞれテーマがあり、名を贈られることで[・|そ][・|れ]は明確なものとなる。
lines.translated: Every work of art has its own theme, and by being gifted a name, *that* becomes clear.

lines.content: “……誰からも愛されない自分。そんな俺は、どうして産まれてきたんだろう”
lines.translated: "...Nobody loves me. Why was someone like me ever born?"

lines.content: ナハト。“夜”という意味。
lines.translated: Nacht. Meaning "night."

lines.content: 名をもらえたことで、自分というイキモノを認めてもらえたような気がした。
lines.translated: By receiving a name, I felt as though my existence as a living creature had been acknowledged.

lines.content: この命に、価値のようなものが産まれたような気もしていた――千和が笑い、俺に贈ってくれたもの。
lines.translated: I also felt as though something like value had been born into this life of mine--something Chiwa had smiled and gifted to me.

lines.content: まただ。またふと、心に芽生えた[・|不][・|穏][・|な][・|言][・|葉]をぐっと飲み込み――代わりに『お返しをしたい』と、俺は、思った。
lines.translated: There it was again. Once again, I swallowed hard the *unsettling words* that had suddenly sprouted in my heart--and instead, I thought, "I want to give her something in return."

lines.content: 名前を贈ってくれたことは、あの子にとってそれほどの意味はなかっただろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Giving me a name probably hadn't meant all that much to her, though...

lines.content: どうしたらあの子は喜ぶだろうか。
lines.translated: What could I do to make that girl happy?

lines.content: どうしたら、あの子は笑ってくれるだろうか。
lines.translated: What could I do to make that girl smile?

lines.content: ……ぬいぐるみかな
lines.translated: "...A stuffed animal, maybe?"

lines.content: 俺が持ちかけた相談に、あいつはそう答えてくれた。
lines.translated: When I brought the matter to her for advice, that was how she answered me.

lines.content: あれくらいの子はぬいぐるみとかもらえたら喜ぶんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "A kid her age would probably be happy to get a stuffed animal or something, don't you think?"

lines.content: ぬいぐるみ……
lines.translated: "A stuffed animal..."

lines.content: ああ。私の娘は、いつもくまのぬいぐるみをぎゅっとして離さなかった。私が誕生日に贈ったものだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. My daughter was always hugging her teddy bear tight and never let it go. I gave it to her for her birthday."

lines.content: あれはかわいかったなあと、あいつは……ソルは、少し悲しそうに目を細めていた。
lines.translated: "It was so cute," she... Sol said, narrowing her eyes a little sadly.

lines.content: “夜”の中で購入できるものはあまり[・|ま][・|と][・|も]なものがない。ふつうの玩具として機能はするまい。
lines.translated: There wasn't much you could buy in the "Night" that was *decent*. Nothing that would function as a normal toy.

lines.content: だからといって“外”の世界に買い求めに行くのも……。
lines.translated: Even so, going out to buy one in the "outside" world was also...

lines.content: 故に。手作りすることに、決めた。
lines.translated: Therefore, I decided to make one by hand.

lines.content: 家にあったぬいぐるみを手縫いするための教本と、そこに記された材料とをかき集め――……だが、だめだ。
lines.translated: I gathered up an instruction book for hand-sewing stuffed animals that we had in the house, along with the materials listed in it--...however, it was no good.

lines.content: ただ手順通りに作ろうとしているだけなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I was just trying to follow the steps as written...

lines.content: ……うまく、いかない
lines.translated: "...It's not going well."

lines.content: できあがったぬいぐるみは、まるで俺みたいに醜くて、ぐちゃぐちゃで……。
lines.translated: The finished stuffed animal was ugly and mangled, just like me...

lines.content: こんなのもらっても、あの子がよろこぶはずもない……
lines.translated: "There's no way that girl would be happy getting something like this..."

lines.content: 上手にできたプレゼント渡し、そして笑顔になってくれる千和の姿が……。
lines.translated: The image of me handing her a well-made present, and Chiwa breaking into a smile...

lines.content: そんなふうに夢見てしまった未来の光景が、うすぼんやりとして消えていく……。
lines.translated: That vision of the future I had foolishly dreamed of grew faint and faded away...

lines.content: このときほど、自分が何も作り出せない“怪物”であることを疎ましく思ったことはなかった――
lines.translated: Never had I resented being a "monster" incapable of creating anything as much as I did at that moment--

lines.content: 落ち込んだ。泣きたいとさえ、思った。
lines.translated: I was depressed. I even felt like crying.

lines.content: まさか自分がこんなことでここまで気落ちしようとは……。自分自身、驚き、戸惑うほどだった。
lines.translated: To think that I would get this dejected over something like this... Even I was surprised and bewildered by myself.

lines.content: そんな俺を見かねたのだろう。
lines.translated: Perhaps she couldn't bear to watch me like that.

lines.content: ぬいぐるみ……？
lines.translated: "A stuffed animal...?"

lines.content: ソルが、ゴミ箱に放り込んでいたその出来損ないのぬいぐるみを勝手に拾い上げ、千和への“入学祝い”として手渡してしまっていた。
lines.translated: Sol went and fished that defective stuffed animal out of the trash can where I had tossed it, and handed it to Chiwa as a "school entrance gift."

lines.content: ぴかぴかの制服と一緒に押し込められていたぬいぐるみ――醜くて、ブサイクで、まるでホラーだ。まるで、俺自身だ。
lines.translated: The stuffed animal had been stuffed into the box right alongside a brand-new uniform--ugly, hideous, like something out of a horror movie. Just like me.

lines.content: どういうつもりだ。俺はあいつを睨み付ける。
lines.translated: What is the meaning of this? I glared at her.

lines.content: 千和は手に取ったぬいぐるみをじーっと見つめているばかり。
lines.translated: Chiwa simply stared intently at the stuffed animal she had picked up.

lines.content: あ、ああー……
lines.translated: "A-Aaah..."

lines.content: ソルは申し訳なさそうな苦笑いを浮かべ、
lines.translated: Sol gave an apologetic, wry smile,

lines.content: ええっと、改めてみると、かなり[・|か][・|わ][・|い][・|く][・|な][・|い]よね、それ。いったい何のぬいぐるみなのかもまったく不明だし……
lines.translated: "Um, looking at it again, it's really *not cute* at all, is it? You can't even tell what kind of animal it's supposed to be..."

lines.content: ふん。だから言っただろう
lines.translated: "Hmph. Didn't I tell you?"

lines.content: まるで“俺は反対したのにソルが言うことを聞かず買ってきたんだ”――みたいな言い方を、つい、してしまう。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had phrased it as if to say, "I was against it, but Sol wouldn't listen and bought it anyway."

lines.content: そんな不細工な人形なんて、女の子がよろこぶはずが――
lines.translated: "There's no way a girl would be happy with an ugly doll like--"

lines.content: かわいい
lines.translated: "It's cute."

lines.content: ……これ、子犬さんだよね？
lines.translated: "...This is a little puppy, right?"

lines.content: う、うん。大正解……みたいだね
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Spot on... it seems."

lines.content: 驚いている俺の顔をちらちらと見ながら、あいつは言った。
lines.translated: Glancing repeatedly at my surprised face, she spoke.

lines.content: 一緒に入ってた説明書にそう書いてあったよ
lines.translated: "That's what it said in the instruction manual that came with it."

lines.content: ありがとう……
lines.translated: "Thank you..."

lines.content: 千和は、ぬいぐるみをぎゅっとした。
lines.translated: Chiwa hugged the stuffed animal tight.

lines.content: こんなかわいいプレゼント、はじめてもらったよ。ありがとう。うれしい。すごく
lines.translated: "This is the first time I've ever gotten such a cute present. Thank you. I'm happy. Really happy."

lines.content: ああ、まただ。
lines.translated: Ah, there it is again.

lines.content: 千和が笑うと。
lines.translated: Whenever Chiwa smiles.

lines.content: また、心の中に、[・|言][・|い][・|得][・|ぬ][・|不][・|穏]な言葉が芽生えてしまい……。
lines.translated: Once again, *unspeakably unsettling* words sprouted within my heart...

lines.content: 俺はやはり、ぐっと、堪えるばかりだった。
lines.translated: And just like always, all I could do was hold them back with everything I had.

lines.content: 千和がはじめて学校に行った日は落ち着かなかった。
lines.translated: On the day Chiwa went to school for the first time, I couldn't calm down.

lines.content: 千和を外の世界の学校に通わせようという、ソルの主張もわからないでもなかった――いつか俺たちは離れ行く。
lines.translated: It wasn't that I didn't understand Sol's insistence on sending Chiwa to a school in the outside world--someday, we would be parted from her.

lines.content: そのとき、千和を守ってやれる者はいない。だから自分ひとりで生きていけるだけの力や知恵を学んでほしい。
lines.translated: When that time came, there would be no one to protect Chiwa. That was why she wanted her to learn the strength and wisdom she needed to survive all on her own.

lines.content: それはわかる。きっと、必要なことなのだろう。
lines.translated: I understood that. It was surely something necessary.

lines.content: ……だけど、わざわざつらいことがあるかもしれない“外の世界”に向かわせる必要があるのか俺にはわからなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't understand if there was really a need to go out of our way to send her into the "outside world," where painful things might happen to her.

lines.content: いじめられたりしないだろうか。意地の悪い教師に目を付けられたり、しないだろうか。“ヒトデナシ”の誰かに千和の居場所がバレたりしないだろうか。
lines.translated: What if she got bullied? What if some mean-spirited teacher singled her out? What if some inhuman monster found out where Chiwa was?

lines.content: そわそわとして。
lines.translated: Feeling restless and on edge.

lines.content: 時計ばかりを俺は見ている。
lines.translated: I did nothing but stare at the clock.

lines.content: そんな俺にあいつは苦笑いを浮かべていた。
lines.translated: Watching me like that, she wore a wry smile.

lines.content: まあ、そんな心配するなよ。きっと大丈夫だ
lines.translated: "Come on, don't worry so much. I'm sure she'll be fine."

lines.content: ふたり、店のフロアであの子の帰りを今かいまかと待っている最中だった。
lines.translated: The two of us were down on the shop floor, eagerly awaiting that girl's return any minute now.

lines.content: ……心配などしていない
lines.translated: "...I am not worried."

lines.content: 俺はたばこにマッチで火を付ける。
lines.translated: I struck a match and lit a cigarette.

lines.content: ただ面倒ごとを抱えて帰ってこられても、文字通り面倒だというだけのことだ
lines.translated: "It would simply be a nuisance if she came home bringing trouble with her. Nothing more."

lines.content: そんなふうに毒づきながらも、時計から視線を外すことができなかった。
lines.translated: Even as I spat those words out, I couldn't tear my eyes away from the clock.

lines.content: その日は音楽もかけ忘れ、映画を鑑賞することもなく、ただただふたり、あの子の帰りを待っていた。
lines.translated: That day, we forgot to even put on music, and without watching a movie either, the two of us simply waited and waited for that girl to return.

lines.content: ちくたくちくたく、時は過ぎゆき……。
lines.translated: Tick-tock, tick-tock, the time passed by...

lines.content: ただいまー
lines.translated: "I'm home."

lines.content: 千和が店の扉を開いて顔を出す。
lines.translated: Chiwa opened the shop door and poked her head in.

lines.content: 思わず立ち上がりそうになる。
lines.translated: I nearly stood up on reflex.

lines.content: そんな自分に戸惑い、なんとか腰を下ろす。
lines.translated: Bewildered by my own reaction, I somehow managed to sit back down.

lines.content: ソルは俺の様子にやれやれと肩を竦めていた。
lines.translated: Sol gave an exasperated shrug at the sight of me.

lines.content: ああ、おかえり、千和。待ってたよ。はじめての学校はどうだった？
lines.translated: "Ah, welcome back, Chiwa. We've been waiting for you. How was your first day of school?"

lines.content: ……うん。ちょっと、大変だったけど……、でも、ちょっとだけね、楽しいこともあったかも
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It was a little tough... but maybe there were a few fun things, too. Just a little."

lines.content: そっか。それはよかった。……どうかな。明日から、通えそう？
lines.translated: "I see. I'm glad to hear that. ...What do you think? Do you feel like you can keep going starting tomorrow?"

lines.content: うん。きっと
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'm sure I can."

lines.content: ソルに頭を撫でられると、千和はくすぐったそうに目を細めた。
lines.translated: When Sol patted her head, Chiwa narrowed her eyes as if it tickled.

lines.content: そんな千和を見ていると、やっぱり、俺は……、
lines.translated: Watching Chiwa like that, sure enough, I...

lines.content: ――あれ
ソルが驚いた声を出す。
lines.translated: Sol let out a surprised voice.

lines.content: 膝小僧、どうしたのかな。擦りむいてるじゃないか
lines.translated: "What happened to your knee? You scraped it."

lines.content: ……帰りにね、コケちゃった
lines.translated: "...I tripped on the way home."

lines.content: 血が出てるよ。平気かい？
lines.translated: "It's bleeding. Are you alright?"

lines.content: 平気。痛くないよ
lines.translated: "I'm fine. It doesn't hurt."

lines.content: にっこり笑う千和だ。
lines.translated: Chiwa beamed with a bright smile.

lines.content: これくらい……唾付けておけば、治るよね？
lines.translated: "For something like this... if I just put some spit on it, it'll heal right up, won't it?"

lines.content: いやいや。ちゃんと消毒はしておこう。ばい菌がはいっちゃったらいけないし、傷が残っちゃったりしたらもっと大変だよ
lines.translated: "No, no. Let's make sure we disinfect it properly. We wouldn't want germs getting in there, and it'd be even worse if it left a scar."

lines.content: ソルに手を引かれて行く千和の背中を俺は見送る。
lines.translated: I watched Chiwa's back as Sol took her by the hand and led her away.

lines.content: 新聞を、閉じる。
lines.translated: I closed my newspaper.

lines.content: ……はあ
lines.translated: "...Haah."

lines.content: あの子が無事に帰ってくる度、俺はいつも隠れて安堵のため息ばかりついていた。
lines.translated: Every time that girl came home safely, I always hid away and did nothing but breathe sighs of relief.

lines.content: だけどそんな俺をよそに、殆ど休みなく外の学校へと千和は通った。
lines.translated: Yet completely oblivious to me, Chiwa commuted to the school in the outside world with almost no days off.

lines.content: あんなに小さな身体で、外の世界で毎日色々なことと戦って帰ってくる――あの子はすごい。そう、思った。
lines.translated: With such a tiny body, she went out into the outside world every day, fought through all sorts of things, and came back home--that girl is amazing. That was what I thought.

lines.content: そんな千和に、俺ができることは何かないのか……。
lines.translated: Isn't there anything I can do for Chiwa...?

lines.content: ソルのようにやさしい言葉と表情で、あの子を見送ったり、迎え入れたり。
lines.translated: Seeing her off and welcoming her home with gentle words and expressions like Sol did.

lines.content: そんなこと俺にはできない。それに誰も望んでいないだろう。
lines.translated: I couldn't do things like that. Besides, no one would want that from me anyway.

lines.content: ……ならばせめて、毎日、疲れ切って帰ってくるのだろうあの子のために、美味しいご飯くらい作っておけるようになりたい
lines.translated: "...Then at the very least, I want to be able to cook a delicious meal for that girl, since she must come home exhausted every day."

lines.content: あの子が学校に行っている間。
lines.translated: While she was at school.

lines.content: 俺は、料理の勉強を重ねてた――“夜の怪物”たるこの俺が、料理なんて本当に習得できるのか。
lines.translated: I practiced cooking over and over--could someone like me, a "Monster of the Night," really learn how to cook?

lines.content: そんな不安は尽きなかったが、千和が外でがんばっているのだ。
lines.translated: There was no end to those anxieties, but Chiwa was doing her best out there.

lines.content: 俺もこれくらい、がんばりたい――……がんばれよ、俺。
lines.translated: I wanted to do at least this much myself--... Come on, do your best, me.

lines.content: 失敗をいくつも重ねた。
lines.translated: I made mistake after mistake.

lines.content: その数だけ落ち込みもした。
lines.translated: And I got depressed just as many times.

lines.content: だけど、いつしか料理の腕もマシになってくれた。見た目だけでなく味もいい。
lines.translated: However, before I knew it, my cooking skills had actually become decent. Not only did the food look good, it tasted good, too.

lines.content: ……千和が笑って美味しいと言ってくれるからそのはずだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa smiled and told me it was delicious, so that had to be true.

lines.content: 運動会やハイキングだとか。
lines.translated: For things like sports days or hikes.

lines.content: お弁当が必要なときは精一杯、美味しいものを作り――ソルから千和へ渡してくれるようにと、託けた。
lines.translated: Whenever she needed a boxed lunch, I poured my all into making something delicious--and entrusted it to Sol to hand over to Chiwa.

lines.content: 父兄が参加しなければならない行事には、あいつが積極的に参加した。
lines.translated: Whenever there was an event that required a parent or guardian to attend, she actively participated.

lines.content: 帰宅したあいつから、千和がどんなふうにがんばっていたのかを聞く度に、思った。
lines.translated: Every time she came home and told me all about how hard Chiwa had worked, a thought crossed my mind.

lines.content: ……本当は
lines.translated: "...The truth is..."

lines.content: 本当は、それらに俺も行ってみたかった。
lines.translated: Truthfully, I wanted to go to those events, too.

lines.content: あの子が外の世界でどんなふうに生きているのか。遠くからでもいい、見てみたかった。
lines.translated: How was that girl living in the outside world? Even if it was just from afar, I wanted to see it for myself.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: こんな醜い怪物が、どうして人前に姿を現せるというのか――……
lines.translated: "How could a hideous monster like me ever show itself in front of people--...?"

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: この身に“夜”を纏い、姿を消すことくらいは可能だ。
lines.translated: It was possible enough for me to cloak myself in the "Night" and erase my presence.

lines.content: しかし目立ったイベントごとはいつもあいつに頼んだ。誰だって醜いものより、うつくしいものに見守られていたいはずだから。
lines.translated: Even so, I always left the prominent events to her. Because anyone would rather be watched over by something beautiful than something hideous.

lines.content: 行ってらっしゃいも、おかえりなさいも、すべてあいつに任せる代わりに――……醜い俺は、目立たない部分で、いつもがんばっているあの子のことを応援できたらと、思った。
lines.translated: In exchange for leaving all the "have a nice day"s and "welcome home"s to her--... I hoped that my hideous self could support that hard-working girl from behind the scenes.

lines.content: いっぱい遊んで、どろだらけで帰ってきたなら洗濯を。
lines.translated: If she played to her heart's content and came home covered in mud, I did the laundry.

lines.content: 疲れ切ったあの子がしっかり休めるよう、塵も残さず家中きれいに掃除を重ね。
lines.translated: So that the exhausted girl could get a good rest, I cleaned the entire house spotless over and over, not leaving a single speck of dust behind.

lines.content: 育ち盛りでお腹を空かせたあの子のために、もう随分と上達した暖かい料理を、毎日、欠かさず。
lines.translated: And for that growing girl who always came home hungry, I made warm meals--which I had gotten quite good at--every single day without fail.

lines.content: “あの子の成長のためにすべての時間を使うこと”……。
lines.translated: "Spending all of my time for the sake of that girl's growth"...

lines.content: それが、俺に与えられた命の使い道だと……だったらいいなと、そう思って止まない一年間だった。
lines.translated: For a whole year, I never stopped thinking that this was the purpose of the life I had been given... or rather, wishing that it could be.

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right.

lines.content: 一年なんてあっという間だった。あまりに時の流れは早すぎる。
lines.translated: A year went by in the blink of an eye. The flow of time was far too fast.

lines.content: 千和が家に来てから、時間の流れを意識するようになっている自分たちだからこそ、[・|そ][・|れ]に気づいた。
lines.translated: Precisely because we had started paying attention to the passage of time ever since Chiwa came to our home, we noticed *it*.

lines.content: ……そういえば、人間というイキモノは、一年に一度の周期で、自分の産まれた日を祝うものだよな
lines.translated: "...Come to think of it, creatures called humans celebrate the day they were born on a once-a-year cycle, don't they?"

lines.content: ……そろそろ、あと数日ほどで、あの子がここへ来てちょうど一年になる――そんなことに、気づいた。またさくらが町を飾る季節になっていた。
lines.translated: Before long, in just a few more days, it would beઢ exactly one year since that girl came here--I realized that. It was once again the season when cherry blossoms adorned the town.

lines.content: ああ。誕生日だ。産まれてきてくれてありがとうという気持ちやプレゼントを贈る日だ
lines.translated: "Yeah. A birthday. It's a day to give presents and express your gratitude to someone for being born."

lines.content: ……産まれてきてくれて、ありがとう
lines.translated: "...Thank you for being born."

lines.content: つぶやいてみる。
lines.translated: I tried murmuring the words to myself.

lines.content: すると、それは……それは、何より幸福なことであるように感じられた。
lines.translated: When I did, it... it felt like the most blissful thing in the world.

lines.content: ならば千和がここへやって来た日。その日を千和の誕生日ということにするのはどうだろう。あいつにそう提案した。
lines.translated: In that case, what about the day Chiwa first came here? Why don't we make that day Chiwa's birthday? I proposed the idea to her.

lines.content: それは、うん。良い考えだと思うけれど……。例によって、私がそう決めたんだよと、あの子には伝えておくのか？
lines.translated: "That's, yeah. I think it's a great idea, though... As usual, should I tell her that I was the one who decided on it?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: 気恥ずかしいから――……とは言えず、
lines.translated: Because I was too embarrassed--... Unable to say that out loud,

lines.content: そのほうが色々と都合が良いんだ
lines.translated: "It's just more convenient that way for a number of reasons."

lines.content: 吐き捨てるようにしてそう言った。
lines.translated: I spat the words out bluntly.

lines.content: そして数日後に控えたその日は、千和を朝から外へと連れ出しておいてほしいと、願った。
lines.translated: And then, I asked her to take Chiwa out of the house first thing in the morning when that day arrived a few days later.

lines.content: ……ケーキを作ってみる。ふたりが帰ってくるまでには完成させておくつもりだ。誕生日には甘いケーキが必要なんだろ？
lines.translated: "...I'm going to try making a cake. I plan to have it finished before the two of you get back. You need a sweet cake for a birthday, right?"

lines.content: ああ……。そうだな
lines.translated: "Yeah... That's right."

lines.content: ……練習してたんだ。ずっと。たぶんうまくできると思う。部屋も飾り付けておく。きっと、喜んでくれるよな
lines.translated: "...I've been practicing. For a long time. I think I can pull it off. I'll decorate the room, too. She'll be happy with that, right?"

lines.content: ……駆け足でやって来たその日は、千和のお誕生日と決めた日は、朝から大忙しだった。
lines.translated: That day, the day we had decided would be Chiwa's birthday, arrived at a brisk pace, and I was swamped from the moment the morning began.

lines.content: あいつが千和を連れて散歩に出かけた。
lines.translated: She took Chiwa and headed out for a walk.

lines.content: ふたりに持たせるお弁当も朝から作り……。
lines.translated: I had even woken up early to make boxed lunches for the two of them to take along...

lines.content: 千和とあいつが出かけて行ってから帰ってくるまでおよそ二時間だ。
lines.translated: From the time Chiwa and she left until the time they came back, I had roughly two hours.

lines.content: 短いみじかい制限時間のその中で、練習していたケーキを作る。
lines.translated: Within that short, all-too-brief time limit, I set about making the cake I had practiced.

lines.content: スポンジを焼く合間に、店のフロアを飾り付け、プレゼントの用意にと、こんな巨体がめまぐるしく走り回った。
lines.translated: In between baking the sponge cake, decorating the shop floor, and getting her present ready, this massive body of mine scurried around at a dizzying pace.

lines.content: あの子のためにと手縫いしたぬいぐるみは、やはりどうにもかわいい出来とはほど遠く……。
lines.translated: The stuffed animal I had hand-sewn for her had, as expected, turned out far from anything you could call cute...

lines.content: それでも、大丈夫。平気だ。あの子はきっと、喜んでくれるはず。また新しいぬいぐるみもあの子はぎゅっと抱きしめてくれるはず。
lines.translated: Even so, it was fine. It would be alright. That girl would surely be happy with it. She would surely hug this new stuffed animal tight, too.

lines.content: そんな確信と期待とで準備を急ぎ……。
lines.translated: With that conviction and anticipation in my chest, I hurried through the preparations...

lines.content: ……ふわあ、すごい
lines.translated: "...Whoa, amazing."

lines.content: 約束の時間ぎりぎりで、なんとか完了――……
lines.translated: Just barely in time for our promised hour, I somehow managed to finish--...

lines.content: これ、ナハトが準備してくれたの？
lines.translated: "Did Nacht set all of this up for me?"

lines.content: 俺は何事もなかったように、いつもの椅子に腰掛け、新聞を開いていた。
lines.translated: Acting as if nothing at all had happened, I sat in my usual chair with my newspaper spread open.

lines.content: “ああ、そうだよ。お誕生日おめでとう、千和”それくらいどうして言えない“産まれてきてくれてありがとう”と、そこまでは、言えないまでも――……でも。
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Happy birthday, Chiwa." Why couldn't I even say something as simple as that? Even if I couldn't go so far as to say, "Thank you for being born"--... Still.

lines.content: ……美味しい
lines.translated: "...It's delicious."

lines.content: 急いで作ったケーキは上出来だった。
lines.translated: The cake I had hurriedly thrown together was a resounding success.

lines.content: ほんとに、ほんとに、美味しいよ……。とってもね、甘いの
lines.translated: "It's really, really delicious... And it's so very sweet."

lines.content: 千和がこんなに笑顔でほおばってくれる。うれしそうに笑ってくれる。
lines.translated: Chiwa was stuffing her cheeks with such a huge smile on her face. Laughing so happily.

lines.content: プレゼントの新しいぬいぐるみも、ああ、やっぱり、思った通りだ――ぎゅっと抱きしめ、喜んでくれていた。
lines.translated: And the new stuffed animal I gave her as a present--ah, sure enough, just as I thought--she hugged it tight, overjoyed.

lines.content: これ以上の成功があるはずもない。だから、上出来だ。何もかも。
lines.translated: There couldn't possibly be a greater success than this. So it was a triumph. Everything was.

lines.content: “産まれてきてくれて、ありがとう”
lines.translated: "Thank you for being born."

lines.content: そんな言葉を贈ることはできなかったけれど……。
lines.translated: I couldn't give her those words, though...

lines.content: きっとこれで充分なはずだった。
lines.translated: Surely, this was more than enough.

lines.content: だけど、千和がハッとしたような顔をした。どきりとする。ケーキを食べる手を止めてもいた。
lines.translated: However, a sudden look of realization crossed Chiwa's face. My heart skipped a beat. She had even stopped eating her cake.

lines.content: ケーキ。何か美味しくないところでもあったのだろうか。
lines.translated: The cake. Was there some part of it that didn't taste good?

lines.content: 俺たち“夜の怪物”に味覚はない。故に。ろくに味見もできてはいない。
lines.translated: We "Monsters of the Night" have no sense of taste. Therefore, I hadn't been able to properly taste-test it.

lines.content: もしフルーツのひとつが腐っていたとしても、俺がそれを漏らさず気づける保証はどこにもないのだ。
lines.translated: Even if one of the pieces of fruit had gone bad, there was no guarantee anywhere that I would have noticed it without fail.

lines.content: ……失敗してしまったのか。
lines.translated: Did I mess it up after all?

lines.content: 一瞬で、心に分厚い雲が広がるようだったけれど……。
lines.translated: In an instant, it felt as though thick dark clouds were spreading across my heart, yet...

lines.content: ありがとう
lines.translated: "Thank you."

lines.content: 千和が、言った。腰掛けていた椅子から降り、俺たちに向かい、頭を下げて。
lines.translated: Chiwa spoke. She climbed down from the chair she was sitting on, turned to face us, and bowed her head.

lines.content: いつもありがとう、パパ
lines.translated: "Thank you for everything, Papa."

lines.content: 思わずだ。新聞を、落としてしまった。
lines.translated: It happened before I knew it. I dropped my newspaper.

lines.content: パパ……。
lines.translated: Papa...

lines.content: 今、確かに千和はそう言った。
lines.translated: Just now, Chiwa had definitely said that.

lines.content: それはお父さんという意味で……。
lines.translated: She meant it as "father"...

lines.content: あ、ああ。そんなの、まるで、本当に……。
lines.translated: A-Ah. Something like that makes it feel as though we're truly...

lines.content: ……家族、みたいだ
lines.translated: "...Just like a family."

lines.content: 小さく、本当に本当に小さく、俺はつぶやく。
lines.translated: Quietly, ever so quietly, I muttered to myself.

lines.content: はしゃぐソルの声など殆ど聞こえていなかった。
lines.translated: I could barely even hear the sound of Sol's excited voice.

lines.content: ああ、だめだ、千和。
lines.translated: Ah, no, Chiwa.

lines.content: そんなことを言ったらだめだ。
lines.translated: You mustn't say things like that.

lines.content: また、俺の心に不穏な言葉が芽生えてしまう――
lines.translated: Unsettling words are going to take root in my heart again--

lines.content: 不意打ちだ。こんなのは、ずるい。
lines.translated: That caught me completely off guard. Doing something like this isn't fair.

lines.content: だって、そんな急に、そんな……そんなこと、言われたら……。
lines.translated: Because if you suddenly say something... something like that to me...

lines.content: 俺は、もう、
lines.translated: I won't be able to...

lines.content: ふっと心に芽生える、[・|こ][・|の][・|不][・|穏][・|な][・|気][・|持][・|ち]を、押さえられない――……っ。
lines.translated: I won't be able to hold back this unsettling feeling suddenly taking root in my heart--...!

lines.content: あ、ああっ、
lines.translated: A-Ahh...

lines.content: （何で……千和、お前はこんなに、こんなにっ、かわいいんだ……っ）
lines.translated: (Why... Chiwa, why are you so, so unbearably precious...?!)

lines.content: 心の中に芽生える言葉を、気持ちを、今回こそ飲み込めなかった――……一生だ。一生、俺が、お前を守っていきたい。つらいことになんて遭わせたくない。
lines.translated: This time, I couldn't swallow down the words and feelings sprouting inside my heart--... For the rest of my life. For the rest of my life, I want to protect you. I don't want to let you go through anything painful ever again.

lines.content: もういい。いいじゃないか。これまでこの子はたくさん大変な思いをしてきたんだ。
lines.translated: That's enough, isn't it? This girl has already been through so much hardship up until now.

lines.content: それでもこんないい子に、やさしい子に、育ってくれたんだ。これ以上、この子に何を求める――
lines.translated: And yet, she still grew up into such a good, kindhearted child. What more could anyone possibly ask of her--

lines.content: 強くなくていい。弱くていい。俺たちがそばで守っていけば良いだけの話なのに……それなのに……っ。
lines.translated: She doesn't need to be strong. It's fine if she stays weak. All we have to do is stay by her side and protect her... And yet...!

lines.content: いやだ。どうしてっ。離れたくない。離したくない。ずっと一緒に暮らしていきたい。
lines.translated: No. Why?! I don't want to be separated from her. I don't want to let her go. I want us to keep living together forever.

lines.content: 外の世界でつらいことなんて、もう、これ以上、経験させていかなくっても……いいじゃないかっ。
lines.translated: It's fine if we don't make her experience any more painful things out in the outside world... isn't it?!

lines.content: その夜はいつまでも落ち着かなかった。
lines.translated: That night, I couldn't calm down no matter how much time passed.

lines.content: 千和……。
lines.translated: Chiwa...

lines.content: 俺なんかをパパと呼んでくれた。
lines.translated: She had called someone like me "Papa."

lines.content: 千和からもらった言葉の贈り物。これはきっと、俺の生涯の宝物になるはずだった。
lines.translated: A gift of words given to me by Chiwa. This was surely meant to become a lifelong treasure of mine.

lines.content: ……明日、俺は千和の顔をまっすぐ見られるだろうか
lines.translated: "...Tomorrow, will I be able to look Chiwa straight in the face?"

lines.content: なんだか恥ずかしくて、うれしくて……。
lines.translated: I felt strangely embarrassed, and yet so happy...

lines.content: すっかり浮かれてしまっていた俺は、ただの“怪物”のくせに、夢を見た――繰り返し、繰り返し……、
lines.translated: Completely swept off my feet, despite being nothing more than a "Monster," I dreamed a dream--over and over again...

lines.content: “三人一緒にここでお店を開いて暮らしていく”
lines.translated: "The three of us opening a shop here and living together."

lines.content: ……そんな夢を、俺は、いつまでも見続けてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I kept on dreaming that same dream, endlessly.

lines.content: その夢はいつか、叶う。必ずだ。
lines.translated: Someday, that dream will come true. Without fail.

lines.content: そう思えた。
lines.translated: That was what I believed.

lines.content: そう、思えていたのに――……
lines.translated: I had truly believed that, and yet--...

lines.content: ……夢は、壊れた。
lines.translated: The dream was shattered.

lines.content: はらはらと手のひらからこぼれ落ちて行く。
lines.translated: Fluttering down, spilling from the palm of my hand.

lines.content: 花だ。
lines.translated: A flower.

lines.content: 手のひらに乗せた小さな花が、はらり、はらりと朽ちて行く。
lines.translated: The small flower resting on my palm was fluttering apart, crumbling away petal by petal.

lines.content: ……[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は、死んだ。永遠を失った。
lines.translated: She was dead. She had lost her eternity.

lines.content: 代わりに夢を叶えた。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: In exchange, she fulfilled her dream. Or so she must have.

lines.content: 千和のおかげで、最期に[・|娘]と、たくさんの気持ちや言葉を交換できたのだろうと思う――
lines.translated: Thanks to Chiwa, I think she was able to exchange all sorts of feelings and words with her daughter at the very end--

lines.content: 命の残り時間を手渡す代わりに、外の世界に置いてきぼりにしてしまった娘の手を引き、“夜”を歩いた。
lines.translated: In exchange for handing over the remaining time of her life, she took the hand of the daughter she had left behind in the outside world, and walked through the "Night" with her.

lines.content: たぶんあいつは、娘のその魂を、“次”へと笑顔で見送れたのだろうと思う――“怪物は人と触れあうことができない”それを充分、理解しておきながら。
lines.translated: I think she was probably able to send her daughter's soul off to what came "next" with a smile on her face--even while fully understanding that "a monster cannot touch a human."

lines.content: それが、あいつの選んだ命の使い道。
lines.translated: That was how she chose to use her life.

lines.content: 娘のために――……父親もいない、母親もいない、そんなさみしい人生を生き抜かなければならなかった娘のために、あいつは、その命を使い切ったのだ。
lines.translated: For her daughter's sake--... For the sake of the daughter who had been forced to survive such a lonely life without a father or a mother, she used up every last drop of her life.

lines.content: 『命の物語を知った未来の誰かが、自分の夢を諦めない勇気を見いだしてくれればいい』
lines.translated: "I just hope that someone in the future who learns the story of my life will find the courage not to give up on their own dreams."

lines.content: お前はそう言っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: That was what you said, wasn't it...?

lines.content: どこか遠い未来より、顔も知らない誰かのことを、勇気づけようと願うより……。
lines.translated: Rather than some distant future, rather than wishing to encourage someone whose face you don't even know...

lines.content: 今ここにいる、お前を失ってしまったモノは、こんなにも、こんなにも、悲しい……。
lines.translated: Right here, right now, the one left behind who lost you is just so, so terribly sad...

lines.content: ……私、ここへ来なければよかった
lines.translated: "...I shouldn't have come here."

lines.content: ため息と涙の気配。
lines.translated: A sigh, and the faint trace of tears.

lines.content: 誰かが、走り出す。ドアベルが鳴る。大切な誰かが遠ざかっていく……。
lines.translated: Someone breaks into a run. The doorbell rings. Someone precious to me is moving further and further away...

lines.content: 俺の手の届かない、どこかへと。
lines.translated: Off to somewhere my hands cannot reach.

lines.content: そんな音が重なり合っていくのを、俺はうつむいたまま、朽ち行くあいつの花を見つめながら、聞いていて――……気づく。我に、返る。
lines.translated: With my head hung low, staring at her crumbling flower, I listened to those overlapping sounds--...and then I realized. I came back to my senses.

lines.content: ……千和
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: 千和が、いない。
lines.translated: Chiwa is gone.

lines.content: フロアはしんと静まりかえっていた。ここにはもう俺しかいない。
lines.translated: The shop floor had fallen dead silent. I was the only one left in here now.

lines.content: ドアベルの音がしたのを思い出す。駆け出す足音がしたのを、思い出す。
lines.translated: I remembered hearing the sound of the doorbell. I remembered hearing the sound of footsteps running away.

lines.content: 千和が外へ駆け出していった――……だめだっ。今、外は“夜”のただ中だっ。
lines.translated: Chiwa had run outside--... No! Right now, it's the middle of the "Night" out there!

lines.content: 千和を探しに俺も外へ飛び出した。
lines.translated: I burst outside as well to look for Chiwa.

lines.content: まだまだ小さな女の子なのだ。たったひとりで“夜”を歩くなんて危険すぎる。
lines.translated: She's still just a little girl. Walking through the "Night" all by herself is far too dangerous.

lines.content: あの子の名前を呼んだ。何度も呼んだ。“夜”を駆け回って、叫んだ。何度も。何度でも。
lines.translated: I called out that girl's name. I called out to her again and again. Running all around the "Night," I shouted for her. Over and over. As many times as it took.

lines.content: ……だが、見つからない。どこにも。どうして。
lines.translated: However, I couldn't find her. Nowhere. Why?

lines.content: 耳を、澄ませる。
lines.translated: I strained my ears.

lines.content: あの子の泣き声も、ため息も、何もかも全部、聞き漏らさないように……。
lines.translated: Making sure not to miss her crying voice, her sighs, or anything at all...

lines.content: でも、だめだった。聞こえてくるのは夢のようにひしめく雑踏ばかり。
lines.translated: But it was no use. All that reached my ears was the dreamlike clamor of the bustling crowd.

lines.content: 遠く、とおくから……汽笛。
lines.translated: From far, far away... a train whistle.

lines.content: “夜”の空気を振るわせる。
lines.translated: It made the air of the "Night" tremble.

lines.content: そんな音に走る足を止め、俺は、“夜”の空をただただ見上げた……千和。
lines.translated: Stopping dead in my tracks at that sound, I could only stare blankly up at the sky of the "Night"... Chiwa.

lines.content: ……どこへ、行ってしまったんだ
lines.translated: "...Where have you gone?"

lines.content: どうしてだ。もう、どこにもあの子の気配が感じられない……。
lines.translated: Why? I can't sense any trace of her anywhere anymore...

lines.content: ひとりになった。ひとりになって、しまった。
lines.translated: I was alone. I had ended up all alone.
I stared at my left hand. I stared down at my open palm.

lines.content: ひとりで生きてきた時間のほうが長いはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though the time I'd spent living alone was supposed to be far longer...

lines.content: 千和。お前までどこかへ行ってしまったら、俺は、どうしたらいいんだ。
lines.translated: Chiwa. If even you go off somewhere, what am I supposed to do?

lines.content: とぼとぼと歩く俺に、“おう、お前、こんな所で油売ってて平気なのかよ”と、すれ違った猫が言った。
lines.translated: As I trudged along with heavy steps, a passing cat called out to me, "Hey, you sure you oughta be dawdling around in a place like this?"

lines.content: 正直なところ、今、誰かのちょっかいに構っていられるだけの余裕はなかった。
lines.translated: To be honest, right now, I didn't have the composure to bother with someone meddling in my business.

lines.content: しかし嫌な予感がしたのだ。
lines.translated: However, I had a bad feeling about it.

lines.content: 故に“どういうことだ”と問いかける。
lines.translated: And so, I asked, "What do you mean by that?"

lines.content: すると、猫はあの子が列車に乗ったのを見たと答えた。
lines.translated: In response, the cat answered that it had seen that girl board a train.

lines.content: 曰く。千和は“刻の終着駅”を通じて遠い[・|未][・|来]へ旅立ったのだという――……未来？
lines.translated: According to the cat, Chiwa had departed for the distant future through the "Terminal Station of Time"--... The future?

lines.content: なんだ、それは
lines.translated: "What is that supposed to mean?"

lines.content: あんまりにも突飛な話に俺は目を細めてしまう。
lines.translated: The story was so outlandish that I couldn't help narrowing my eyes.

lines.content: “ここらじゃあまり見ない小さなイキモノと、お前たちのところの子が話しているのを聞いたんだ”
lines.translated: "I overheard that kid of yours talking with a small creature you don't see 'round these parts very often."

lines.content: 列車の行き先は構内の掲示板に表示される。それを見上げて、千和の行き先を猫は知ったと教えてくれた。
lines.translated: The train's destination is displayed on the bulletin board inside the station. The cat told me it had learned where Chiwa was headed by looking up at that board.

lines.content: “夜の王”だ。猫は言う。“あの子は夜の王を倒すため、未来へと旅立った”
lines.translated: "The King of the Night," the cat said. "That girl set off for the future to defeat the King of the Night."

lines.content: どうして……
いや。そんなのは問うだけ時間の無駄だろう。
lines.translated: No. Asking why would only be a waste of time.

lines.content: 噂では“夜の王”を倒した者には何でもひとつ、願いを叶えられる権利を与えられるのだという。
lines.translated: Rumor had it that whoever defeated the "King of the Night" would be granted the right to have any single wish fulfilled.

lines.content: 俺は本来、“夢”を見ることのないイキモノだ。
lines.translated: By nature, I am a creature that does not "dream."

lines.content: だからそんな話はまるで興味もなく、信じることもなく、聞き流しているばかりではあったが……。
lines.translated: Because of that, I had zero interest in such stories, never believed them, and always just let them go in one ear and out the other...

lines.content: しかし“夜”に住まう誰もがみんな、“夜の王”の出現を今かいまかと待ち望んでいた。
lines.translated: However, everyone who dwelled in the "Night" was eagerly awaiting the appearance of the "King of the Night" at any moment.

lines.content: その出現ポイントのようなものを、何者かが、何らかの方法で、掴んだのだろう。
lines.translated: Someone must have gotten hold of its point of appearance, or something like it, by some means or another.

lines.content: いや。そもそも出現するポイントは最初から“予言”に含まれていたのかもしれないが……。
lines.translated: No, perhaps the point of appearance had been included in the "prophecy" from the very beginning...

lines.content: とにかく“夜の王”と戦う決意をしたのだろう何物かが千和を[さら|攫]っていった――
lines.translated: In any case, something that had likely resolved to fight the "King of the Night" hadspirited Chiwa away--

lines.content: “夜”の中で人の“想像力”は何物にも代えがたい“[魔法|武器]”となる。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," a human's "imagination" becomes an irreplaceable "magic"--a weapon.

lines.content: ……故に。
lines.translated: Therefore.

lines.content: 千和の心を利用するため、あの子を“悪夢との戦争”だなんていう殺伐に参加させる、そのために、千和を[さら|攫]った……。
lines.translated: In order to use Chiwa's heart, to make that girl participate in something as brutal as a "war against nightmares," it had spirited Chiwa away for that very purpose...

lines.content: 千和。お前はいったい、“夜の王”を倒して、どんな願いを叶えたいと願ったんだ……
lines.translated: "Chiwa. By defeating the 'King of the Night,' what kind of wish were you hoping to have granted...?"

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: それもまた、問うだけ時間の無駄だろう。
lines.translated: That, too, would only be a waste of time to ask.

lines.content: やさしいあの子のことだ。頑張り屋なあの子のことだ。何を願うのかなんて決まってる。
lines.translated: Knowing that kindhearted girl. Knowing how hard she always tries. What she would wish for was already plain as day.

lines.content: 俺は、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: どうしてだ。どうして、俺はすぐあの子に“違う”と言ってやれなかったんだろう。
lines.translated: Why? Why couldn't I have told her right away that she was wrong?

lines.content: 駈け出していくあの子の手を取り、引き留めてやれなかったんだろう。
lines.translated: Why couldn't I have grabbed her hand as she took off running and held her back?

lines.content: ――違う。千和、違うぞ千和。
lines.translated: --You're wrong. Chiwa, you have it all wrong, Chiwa.

lines.content: お前がソルを殺したわけじゃない。
lines.translated: It wasn't you who killed Sol.

lines.content: すべてはあいつが選択し、決断したことだ。
lines.translated: Everything was his own choice, his own decision.

lines.content: 確かに、“さよなら”は何よりつらい。
lines.translated: True, saying "goodbye" hurts more than anything else.

lines.content: 命を持たない俺たち“怪物”は、他のイキモノのように、所有する時間が尽きても、“夜”の中に産まれ直すようなこともない――
lines.translated: Lifeless "monsters" like us aren't reborn into the "Night" when the time we possess runs out, the way other creatures are--

lines.content: 俺たちに訪れる死は本当の死なのだ。無に返る。永遠のさよならだ。
lines.translated: The death that comes for us is a true death. We return to nothingness. It is an eternal goodbye.

lines.content: それでもそれを充分に理解し、覚悟した上で、あいつ自身が選択した結末なのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, it was an ending he chose for himself, fully understanding and accepting all of that.

lines.content: 誰もあいつを責められないし、誰も自分を責められるはずもない。
lines.translated: No one can blame him, and no one should blame themselves, either.

lines.content: 幼い心にそう言い聞かせたところで、納得してくれるかわからないが……。
lines.translated: Though I don't know if her young heart would have been convinced even if I'd tried to tell her that...

lines.content: それでも今、ここに、引き留めることくらいはできたはず――……だが俺も、千和と同じように、突然のさよならに心を奪われてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Still, I at least should have been able to keep her here right now--... Yet just like Chiwa, my own heart had been completely overwhelmed by that sudden goodbye.

lines.content: きっとあの子は、そんな俺に何度も謝っていたはずだ。
lines.translated: She must have been apologizing to me over and over again while I stood there like that.

lines.content: 『ごめんなさい、ごめんなさい』
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry."

lines.content: 今になって、悲痛なあの子の、叫びにも似た声が蘇ってくる――あの子が繰り返していた“ごめんなさい”を、俺は確かに聞いていたのだ。
lines.translated: Only now does her anguished voice, almost like a scream, come echoing back to me--I had definitely heard her repeating "I'm sorry" over and over.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 何も、答えることができず……。
lines.translated: Unable to give her any answer at all...

lines.content: 突然に友人を亡くしてしまったことが、こんなにも、悲しいことだと知ってしまって……。
lines.translated: Learning for the first time just how heartbreaking it was to suddenly lose a friend...

lines.content: 結果、俺はあの子のことを傷つけた。
lines.translated: As a result, I ended up hurting her.

lines.content: ずっと、一生、あの子を守っていってやりたいと願ったはずのこの俺自身が、あの子のことを傷つけてしまった。
lines.translated: I, the very one who had wished to protect her forever, for her entire life, ended up hurting her myself.

lines.content: そして、たぶん、こんな俺の“許し”を得るために、あの子は、簡単には手の届かない遠いとおい場所へと駆けていってしまった。
lines.translated: And so, probably in order to earn "forgiveness" from someone like me, she ran off to a far, far away place where my hands cannot easily reach.

lines.content: ……千和。だめだぞ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa. You mustn't."

lines.content: あの子の“夢”は、その“魔法”は、[あいつ|ソル]を蘇らせるために使われるのだろう。そこにはどんな“代償”があればいいと、あの子は願ったのだろう。
lines.translated: Her "dream," her "magic," will surely be used to bring Sol back to life. And what kind of "price" did she wish to pay for it?

lines.content: 俺は見上げた“夜”に、ふと、問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: Looking up at the "Night," I suddenly asked that question out loud.

lines.content: あの子の“魔法”は――“大切なひとを蘇らせたい”
lines.translated: Her "magic" will be--"I want to bring back someone precious to me."

lines.content: そうなるはずだ。
lines.translated: That is surely what it will be.

lines.content: そのために支払うだろう“代償”は――“生涯、自分を許さない”
lines.translated: And the "price" she will likely pay for it is--"To never forgive myself for as long as I live."

lines.content: きっと、そうなるはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely, that is how it will turn out.

lines.content: あの子はやさしい。やさしい心は罪を背負えば痛烈に自分を壊す。
lines.translated: That girl is kind. And when a kind heart bears a sin, it fiercely destroys itself.

lines.content: 自分を呪い続ける。決して“夢”も願いも叶わない。そんな人生を千和は歩むと決めるのだろう。
lines.translated: She will continue to curse herself. Neither her "dreams" nor her wishes will ever come true. Chiwa will surely decide to walk that kind of life.

lines.content: ……大切な人を蘇らせる代わりに、自分の[幸せ|未来]を殺すのだ。
lines.translated: In exchange for reviving someone precious to her, she will kill her own future--her own happiness.

lines.content: あの子がそう決断するのはあまりにも想像にやさしいけれど……だめなんだ。
lines.translated: It is all too easy to imagine her making that decision, and yet... she mustn't.

lines.content: お前の夢は、叶わない
lines.translated: "Your dream will not come true."

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだ。
lines.translated: Ah, that's right.

lines.content: そんなのは俺が決して、叶えさせてやらないぞ、千和
lines.translated: "I will never let a wish like that come true for you, Chiwa."

lines.content: 人生が、その生き方こそが、俺たちが未来に残せる唯一の[魔法|作品]なのだと[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]は言った――いつか、どこかで、もしも自分の生きた物語を見聞きする“何者か”がいるとして。
lines.translated: He said that life itself, the way we live, is the only magic--the only work of art--we can leave behind for the future. Assuming that someday, somewhere, there is "someone" who might see and hear the story of how we lived.

lines.content: その誰かに、ほんの少しの勇気を与えられるような生き方をいつも選んでいきたい。
lines.translated: I always want to choose a way of life that can give that someone just a little bit of courage.

lines.content: ……あいつは、実の娘のためにその命を使った。
lines.translated: He used his life for the sake of his biological daughter.
Then I will use this life of mine for the sake of the future of that girl we love--and from here on, I will write the story to make that happen.

lines.content: そう堅く決意したからこそ、俺は……。
lines.translated: It was precisely because I made that firm resolution that I...
"Is that how you thought to save that girl's heart?"

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|声]に、俺は伏せていた顔を上げた。
lines.translated: At that voice, I raised my lowered head.

lines.content: 家だ。店内だ。目の前には数人の人間がいる――
lines.translated: A house. Inside a shop. Before my eyes were several humans--

lines.content: [・|天][・|敵]である“夜の怪物”を前にして、自分たちを[さら|攫]ってきた醜いばかりの“不死の怪物”を、前にして……[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]は震え上がっていた。
lines.translated: Faced with a "monster of the Night," their natural enemy--faced with the hideously ugly "immortal monster" that had abducted them... those creatures were trembling in terror.

lines.content: しかし俺が[・|こ][・|の][・|筋][・|書][・|き]を語り聞かせると、人間たちは震えるのを次第に止め、そう言ったのだった。
lines.translated: However, once I finished telling them this scenario of mine, the humans gradually stopped trembling and spoke those words.
"...Truly?"

lines.content: 恐る恐ると、人間たちが言う。
lines.translated: Timidly, the humans spoke.

lines.content: “あなたの言うとおりに、したならば――……”
lines.translated: "If we do just as you say--..."

lines.content: “これまで私たちがしてきたことを許すというだけでなく……いつか、私たちに、永遠の命を授けていただける……？”
lines.translated: "Not only will you forgive us for everything we have done up until now... but someday, you will grant us eternal life...?"

lines.content: ああ。誓おう
lines.translated: "Yeah. I swear it."
Let us strike a deal with that, I told them--

lines.content: [・|お][・|前][・|た][・|ち][・|の][・|し][・|た][・|こ][・|と]を許すばかりでなく、ゆくゆくは“夜”の眷属とし、その命に永遠を手渡そう――ただし、だ。そのためには条件がふたつほどある
lines.translated: "Not only will I forgive what you have done, I will eventually make you kin of the 'Night' and hand eternity over to your lives--however. There are two conditions for that."

lines.content: “それは、どんな……”
lines.translated: "And what might those be...?"

lines.content: ひとつ
lines.translated: "First."

lines.content: もう二度と、“夜”の影響で“不死”の命を得た子を喰らおうなどと考えないこと
lines.translated: "Never again entertain the thought of devouring a child who has gained 'immortal' life through the influence of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: そもそも[・|そ][・|れ]は迷信なのだ、実在しない噂なのだ、そんなことをしたところでお前たち人間は“不死”にはなれない――そう付け加え、俺は続ける。
lines.translated: To begin with, that is nothing more than a superstition, a rumor with no basis in reality; doing such a thing will never make you humans "immortal"--adding that, I continued on.

lines.content: ふたつ
lines.translated: "Second."

lines.content: お前たちの血族に“不死”を与えるのは俺の願いが叶ってからだ。あの子の[・|心]を、救えてからだ
lines.translated: "I will only grant 'immortality' to your bloodline after my wish has come true. Only after I have managed to save that girl's heart."

lines.content: “それはいったい、どれだけ先の話になるのですか”老年の男が祈るように言う。“おそらく。私はそれまで、生きてはいられない”
lines.translated: "Just how far into the future will that be?" an elderly man asked as if in prayer. "In all likelihood, I will not be able to live until then."

lines.content: ああ……、そうだろうな
lines.translated: "Yeah... probably not."

lines.content: 人間の命とは、まるで刹那の光のように儚いものだ。だからこそうつくしいのだと、何をしてでも守り抜きたいのだと、今の俺は思ってしまう。
lines.translated: A human life is as fleeting as a momentary flash of light. And right now, I cannot help feeling that this is precisely what makes it so beautiful, and why I want to protect it no matter what it takes.

lines.content: それは、一年先かもしれないし、十年先かもしれない。あるいは百年、千年――……
lines.translated: "It might be a year from now, or it might be ten years. Or perhaps a hundred, or a thousand--..."

lines.content: それほど長い、ながい未来の話だ。
lines.translated: It is a story of a future that long, that distant.

lines.content: 千和がどれだけ先の未来へと駆けていってしまったのか……。すべてはそれ次第である。すべては、我々に計り知れない、その事実次第……なのである。
lines.translated: Just how far into the future had Chiwa run off to...? Everything depended on that. Everything depended on that single fact, which was beyond our ability to measure...

lines.content: ……今、ここで、お前たちに永遠を与えてしまって……結果、裏切られでもしたら話がとたんややこしくなる。故に。これは成功報酬ということにしたい
lines.translated: "...If I were to grant you eternity right here and now... and ended up being betrayed as a result, things would immediately become complicated. Therefore, I want to make this a reward for your success."

lines.content: 以上が、条件。
lines.translated: Those were the conditions.

lines.content: それでも、俺のつたないばかりの筋書きに、協力してくれるか
lines.translated: "Even so, will you cooperate with this clumsy scenario of mine?"

lines.content: 俺は、[・|攫][・|っ][・|て][・|き][・|た]数人の人間にそう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I posed that question to the several humans I had abducted.

lines.content: 顔を見合わせる人間たちである。
lines.translated: The humans exchanged glances with one another.

lines.content: “……つまり”代表者であろう老年の男が、言った。
lines.translated: "...In other words," the elderly man, who seemed to be their representative, spoke up.

lines.content: “私たちが、あなたの仲間であった元人間の怪物を蘇らせ、そして再び殺されろということでしょうか。あなたの、その手で”
lines.translated: "You want us to revive the former-human monster who was your companion, only for him to be killed once again. By your own hands."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: “……あなたの言う女の子の、目の前で”
lines.translated: "...Right before the eyes of this girl you speak of."

lines.content: ああ、そういうことだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|瞬][・|間]に……それはこれから産まれるお前たちの祖先の誰か、ということになるだろうが。その者に永遠を手渡そう。そういう形で約束を果たす
lines.translated: "At that very moment... though it will likely be one of your descendants yet to be born. I will hand eternity over to that person. That is the form in which I will fulfill my promise."

lines.content: [さら|攫]ってきた人間たちは、俺たち“夜の怪物”にとっていわば天敵。あるいは互いに憎からず思っていたもの同士――
lines.translated: The humans I had abducted were, so to speak, natural enemies to us "monsters of the Night." Or perhaps parties who harbored a mutual obsession for one another--

lines.content: 俺たち“夜の怪物”が、永遠の命を与えた子の肉を喰らえば、“永遠”を得られると信じていた人間だ。[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|家][・|系]の人間たちだ。
lines.translated: They were humans who believed that if they devoured the flesh of a child granted eternal life by us "monsters of the Night," they themselves would obtain "eternity." Humans of that sort of bloodline.

lines.content: ……そういう噂を自ら流し、信仰していた者たちである。
lines.translated: They were the very ones who had spread such rumors themselves and worshipped them as faith.

lines.content: それは……たくさん、たくさんの子らを悲しい心に閉じ込め続けていた、いわば呪われた人間たちなのだ。
lines.translated: They were... cursed humans, so to speak, who had kept so, so many children trapped within sorrowful hearts.

lines.content: 彼らはこの町を拠点にし、古い芸事を生業とする者たちでもあった――表向きはそのようにして生きていた。
lines.translated: Based in this town, they were also people who made their living through old traditional performing arts--at least, that was how they lived on the surface.

lines.content: それはあらゆる芸事を操る者たちだ。
lines.translated: They were masters of all manner of performing arts.

lines.content: 本家。分家。そこに属する者たちは、それぞれがそれぞれに得意な表現方法を選び、生涯を賭し、追求していくのだという。
lines.translated: The main family. The branch families. It was said that those who belonged to them each chose the form of expression they excelled at, staking their entire lives on pursuing it.

lines.content: そうして磨かれた技能や心は、まるで歌舞伎や能などという伝統芸能のような形で、長いながい間、親から子へと引き継がれ、生き続けていく。
lines.translated: The skills and spirit honed in that way were passed down from parent to child over a long, long time, living on much like traditional performing arts such as kabuki or noh.

lines.content: 音楽や絵画。物語。
lines.translated: Music and painting. Storytelling.

lines.content: あらゆるものを専門として操る彼らだが……。
lines.translated: Though they specialized in and mastered all manner of things...

lines.content: 舞台上でまったくの他人の人生を演じきる者。
lines.translated: There were also those who completely played out the life of an utter stranger upon a stage.

lines.content: いわゆる役者だ。
lines.translated: What you would call actors.

lines.content: その道に持てる命の時間をすべて投げ打つ者も、その一族の中には、いつの時代も存在している。
lines.translated: Within that clan, in every era, there existed those who threw every last bit of the lifespan they possessed into that path.

lines.content: そうして長きにわたり引き継がれてきた技術を駆使し、[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]のことを蘇らせてほしい。
lines.translated: By making full use of the techniques passed down over such a long time, I wanted them to bring him back to life.

lines.content: そして、未来。いつかの未来だ。
lines.translated: And then, in the future. Some future yet to come.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|時][・|代]に行き着き、現れたあの子の父親として、元人間の“やさしい怪物”として、共に暮らしていてほしい――あの子が大人になる、その日まで
lines.translated: "When thatgirl arrives in that era, I want you to be living together with her as her father, as that former-human 'gentle monster'--until the day she grows into an adult."

lines.content: 今夜、ここで交わされる盟約を語り継いでいってほしい。お前たち一族はその日がやって来るまで、子孫へと――そのまた子孫へと、連綿と語り継いでいってほしいのだ。
lines.translated: I want you to pass down the covenant we exchange here tonight. Until that day comes, I want your clan to pass it down unbroken to your descendants--and to their descendants after them.

lines.content: ……そして、来たるべきいつかの未来。あの子と[・|偽][・|物][・|の][・|父][・|親]が幸せの絶頂にある頃に、俺が……この醜いばかりの“怪物”が、あの子の愛する父親を殺す
lines.translated: "...And then, in that future yet to come. When that girl and her fake father are at the very peak of their happiness, I... this hideously ugly 'monster' will kill the father she loves."

lines.content: ――ソルを、あいつを殺してしまったのは千和ではない。俺なのだ……あいつと仲違いばかりを繰り返してきたこの俺だ。
lines.translated: --It wasn't Chiwa who killed Sol, who killed him. It was me... me, the one who did nothing but clash with him over and over.

lines.content: そういうふうにはできないだろうか。
lines.translated: Could it not be done that way?

lines.content: なんとかそういうふうにして、千和の[・|後][・|悔]の矛先を、俺に向けさせることはできないだろうか。
lines.translated: By doing it that way somehow, could I not redirect the brunt of Chiwa's regret toward myself?

lines.content: そう考え、そう、祈り――俺はこうして、人間たちに頭を下げる。
lines.translated: Thinking that, praying for that--I bowed my head to the humans like this.

lines.content: なんとかそういう筋書きが上手くいくよう、人間のお前たちに力を、知恵を……想像力を、借り受けたいんだ
lines.translated: "In order for a scenario like that to somehow succeed, I want to borrow your strength, your wisdom... your imagination, as humans."

lines.content: そうでなければ……。
lines.translated: Because if you don't...

lines.content: 俺の願いを拒否するので、あれば……。
lines.translated: And if they were to refuse my wish...

lines.content: 俺の筋書きに協力しないのであれば、お前たちをここで皆殺しにする。[・|あ][・|の][・|子]の両親を、そうしたように
lines.translated: "If you won't cooperate with my scenario, I will slaughter all of you right here. Just as I did to that girl's parents."

lines.content: そのような脅迫も、同時に押しつけさえもした。
lines.translated: At the same time, I even forced such a threat upon them.

lines.content: “……なぜ”誰かが言った。“なぜそのようなまどろっこしいことをするのですか”
lines.translated: "...Why?" someone said. "Why go about this in such a roundabout way?"

lines.content: ……それは
ソルは生きていたんだと思わせて……。
lines.translated: Making her believe that Sol had been alive all along...

lines.content: 千和に“魔法”を使わせないためだ
lines.translated: "It's so I don't let Chiwa use her 'magic.'"

lines.content: そして“自分を生涯、憎み続ける”――そんな“代償”を背負わせないためだ。
lines.translated: And so I don't let her shoulder the "price" of "hating herself for the rest of her life."

lines.content: “私、ここに来なければ、よかった”
lines.translated: "I wish... I had never come here."

lines.content: 最後にあの子が残した言葉を、俺は何度も何度も、思い返してばかりいる。
lines.translated: I kept playing the final words that girl left behind over and over again in my mind.

lines.content: 大切なひとを殺してしまった。よかれと思ってしたことが、原因で
lines.translated: "She ended up killing someone precious to her. All because of something she did out of the goodness of her heart."

lines.content: ……そんなあの子の気持ちを、その涙を、心のないこの俺には、想像することさえできやしないんだ
lines.translated: "...As a heartless creature, I can't even begin to imagine what that girl is feeling, or the tears she's shedding."

lines.content: 人の[心|気持ち]がわからない――こんな俺なんかが思い描いているよりも、ずっと、ずっとだ。あの子は今、つらい気持ちを抱えてしまったのだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I don't understand human feelings--so I think that girl must be carrying a pain right now that goes far, far beyond anything someone like me could ever picture.

lines.content: きっとそのままでいては[・|壊][・|れ][・|て][・|し][・|ま][・|う]。
lines.translated: If left as she is, I am sure it will break her.

lines.content: “生涯、自分を許さない”――そんな“代償”を支払うよりも前に。
lines.translated: Even before she pays the "price" of "never forgiving herself for the rest of her life."

lines.content: （……だめだ）
そんなのは、だめなんだ。そこに“代償”があろうとなかろうと。
lines.translated: I can't let that happen. Whether there is a "price" or not.

lines.content: （……自分のことを恨んじゃだめだよ、千和。そんな心は、やっぱり、いつか壊れる。ガラスみたいにひび割れて）
lines.translated: (...You mustn't hate yourself, Chiwa. A heart like that will surely break someday. Cracking just like glass.)

lines.content: （壊れたままの心で、いつまでも自分のことを憎んで生きていくなんて。それでは、だめだ。お前は、いつまでも幸せになれない……だから）
lines.translated: (Living on while hating yourself forever with a broken heart... No, I won't allow that. You'll never be able to find happiness that way... So--)

lines.content: だから代わりに、俺を恨め。
lines.translated: So hate me instead.

lines.content: その“代償”は俺が引き受ける。
lines.translated: I will take on that "price" myself.
My life was made to never be loved--so I am more than used to that sort of thing. Surely, that is the very reason I was born.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: ずきりと、胸が痛む。
lines.translated: A sharp throb of pain shot through my chest.

lines.content: だがそれは心ではない――こうして人間と対している“怪物”の身体がひび割れ、砕け……少しずつ崩壊が進んでいるその痛み。
lines.translated: Yet that was not my heart--it was the pain of a "monster's" body cracking, crumbling... slowly beginning to collapse from facing humans like this.

lines.content: 老年の者ともなれば、触れあわずとも、こうして空間を同じにしているというだけで、“怪物”の身体には相当[・|き][・|つ][・|い]。崩壊が始まってしまう。
lines.translated: When dealing with the elderly, merely sharing the same space like this without even touching was quite harsh on a "monster's" body. The collapse was already beginning.

lines.content: そうだ。心なんてない。ないものが痛むはずもない――……故に。ああ、だからこそ、なのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. I have no heart. Something that doesn't exist cannot possibly hurt--...Therefore. Ah, that is precisely why.

lines.content: ……俺は、あの子の人生にはじめて現れる意地の悪い“敵役”で構わない
lines.translated: "...I don't mind being the spiteful 'villain' who appears for the first time in that girl's life."

lines.content: 俺は、そういうふうに生きることで、俺という物語を書いていきたい。
lines.translated: By living that way, I want to write the story of who I am.

lines.content: 物語の中の人物たちは、いつだって、手を取り合い、自分を信じ、勇気を持って“悪者”を退け、成長し――……ハッピーエンドを手に入れる
lines.translated: "The characters in stories always join hands, believe in themselves, muster their courage to drive away the 'bad guy,' grow--...and claim their happy ending."

lines.content: そのような筋書きを、どうか俺と一緒に書いてほしい。
lines.translated: I want you to please write that kind of plot together with me.

lines.content: あの子の人生に責任を持つと、俺たちは誓った――つまるところ、理由なんてそれだけだ。それで、いいだろう。もう、いいじゃないか
lines.translated: "We swore that we would take responsibility for that girl's life--in the end, that is the only reason. Isn't that enough? Surely, that's enough now."

lines.content: これ以上、情けない姿を晒させないでくれ――たったひとり、自分に笑いかけてくれた女の子の幸せに、いつまでも、拘る。こんな格好の悪すぎる男を、醜い俺を、見ないでくれ。
lines.translated: Don't make me expose this pathetic side of myself any further--obsessing forever over the happiness of the one and only girl who ever smiled at me. Don't look at such a painfully uncool man, at this ugly creature that I am.

lines.content: ……俺は、上手くやる。上手くやれるよう、がんばる
lines.translated: "...I will do it well. I will try my hardest to pull it off."

lines.content: お前たちほど与えられた役を華麗に演じられるとは思えないが……それでも、可能な限り、がんばるんだ
lines.translated: "I don't think I can play the role given to me as brilliantly as you all can... Even so, I will try my absolute hardest."

lines.content: 俺は本来、口下手で、誰かと話すのも得意ではなく……無口では、あるけれど
lines.translated: "By nature, I am poor with words, not good at talking with others... and quiet, yes."

lines.content: だけど俺はな、どうやら、何か隠し事をしていると口数が多くなる……らしいから。だからきっと、上手くやれるはずなんだ
lines.translated: "However, it seems... that I tend to get quite talkative when I'm hiding something. So I'm sure I should be able to pull it off well."

lines.content: 集めてきた人間たちは、少しの間、顔を見合わせ、言葉を交わし――全員で俺を見つめた。
lines.translated: The humans I had gathered exchanged glances and whispered to one another for a brief moment--before all of them turned their gazes back to me.

lines.content: “……わかりました”
lines.translated: "...We understand."

lines.content: そして代表者が、うなずく。
lines.translated: Then, their representative nodded.

lines.content: “心やさしい“夜の怪物”。あなたの書こうとしている筋書きに、私たちも、乗らせてください”
lines.translated: "Kind-hearted 'monster of the Night.' Please allow us to take part in this plot you are trying to write."

lines.content: 今夜のことは、あなたの心は、親から子へ、子孫代々、長いながい時間の先へと、いつか訪れる未来へと、語り継いでいきます。
lines.translated: What happened tonight, and your heart, will be passed down from parent to child, generation to generation, far into the long, long stretch of time toward the future that will one day arrive.

lines.content: “……だから、どうか。その日が来るまで、あなたもどうかお元気で”
lines.translated: "...So please. Until that day comes, please take care of yourself as well."

lines.content: “不死”とはいえ、ひとりぼっちで居続けるのはさみしいでしょうから――……そう言うと、人間たちは帰っていった。
lines.translated: Even if you are "immortal," remaining all alone must be lonely--...Leaving those words behind, the humans returned home.

lines.content: ……それから何度、暖かな季節を数えただろう。
lines.translated: How many warm seasons had I counted since then?

lines.content: かつて三人で暮らした家。もう誰もいない家。
lines.translated: The house where the three of us once lived. A house where no one remained anymore.

lines.content: ここはあまりに静かだ。たゆまず流れる音楽さえも、張り詰めた静けさに飲み込まれていくようだった。
lines.translated: It was far too quiet here. Even the music that flowed unceasingly seemed to be swallowed up by the tense silence.

lines.content: 多くの時間を定位置の椅子に座ったまま過ごした。
lines.translated: I spent most of my time sitting in my usual chair.

lines.content: そこから立ち上がるのは殆ど年に一度きり――春。
lines.translated: I rose from it almost only once a year--in the spring.

lines.content: あの子の誕生日と三人で決めた日には欠かさずケーキを焼いた。できるだけ甘そうに。できるだけ、美味しそうに。
lines.translated: Without fail, I baked a cake on the day the three of us had decided would be that girl's birthday. Making it look as sweet as possible. As delicious as possible.

lines.content: 料理と違いまったく上達してくれない不細工なぬいぐるみも、その日を迎える度に一個ずつ縫っては、あの子の部屋に飾っておいた。
lines.translated: Even the clumsy stuffed animals, which unlike my cooking never improved at all, I sewed one by one each time that day arrived, placing them in her room as decorations.

lines.content: ……いつかの未来、帰ってきたあの子がさみしい思いをしないようにと。
lines.translated: So that in some future yet to come, when that girl returned, she wouldn't feel lonely.

lines.content: 毎年欠かすことなく、未来にいるあの子の誕生日を俺は祝った。
lines.translated: Without missing a single year, I celebrated the birthday of that girl who was in the future.

lines.content: こんなことに意味などないとわかっていても、こんなことくらいはしておかないと落ち着かなかった。
lines.translated: Even knowing there was no meaning to doing such a thing, I couldn't settle down unless I did at least this much.

lines.content: 一年。
lines.translated: One year.

lines.content: 二年。
lines.translated: Two years.

lines.content: 三年、四年。
lines.translated: Three years, four years.

lines.content: いつしか町で一番大きなさくらの巨木は花を枯らした。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, the giant cherry blossom tree, the largest in town, had withered its flowers.

lines.content: 俺が、源となる少女の命を運ばなくなったからだ。そんなものは俺たちの生き方ではなかったのだと、知ったからだ。
lines.translated: That was because I had stopped bringing it the lives of young girls that served as its source. Because I had learned that such a thing was not how we were meant to live.

lines.content: ……そして、十年。二十年。三十年。
lines.translated: And then, ten years. Twenty years. Thirty years.

lines.content: あの子は来ない。まだ、来ない。
lines.translated: That girl did not come. Still, she did not come.

lines.content: ひとりで生きているときは、呼吸するほどに、瞬きするほどに、あっという間に過ぎゆく時間だったけれど、長い……それはそれは長い時間に感じられた。
lines.translated: When I lived alone, time used to pass in the blink of an eye, as naturally as breathing, yet now it felt long... so very, very long.

lines.content: ……本当、に？
lines.translated: "...Is it... really true?"

lines.content: ひとり、俺はぶつやく。
lines.translated: Alone, I muttered to myself.

lines.content: あの子は本当に未来へと旅立ったのだろうか……。
lines.translated: Had that girl truly departed for the future...?

lines.content: それを目撃し、千和を連れ去った“何者か”との会話を盗み聞きしたのだと、俺にそう言ったのは“猫”だった。つまり俺たちとは異なる種族だ。
lines.translated: The one who told me they had witnessed it and eavesdropped on the conversation with the "someone" who took Chiwa away was a "cat." In other words, a race different from ours.

lines.content: “夜”の住人たちは仲が良いとは決して言えない。本当に、正確な情報を伝えられたのだろうか……。
lines.translated: The denizens of the "Night" could by no means be called friendly with one another. Had I truly been given accurate information...?

lines.content: それに、あの人間たちだ。
lines.translated: And then there were those humans.

lines.content: 俺の話を直接聞いた者たちは協力してくれると、あの場ではうなずきはしたものの。
lines.translated: Although the ones who heard my story directly had nodded and agreed to cooperate back then...

lines.content: 人間の心はころころと移ろいやすいものだとも言う――
lines.translated: They say the human heart is a fickle, ever-changing thing--

lines.content: なぜ、彼らがそうまで“永遠の命”を欲するのかは、ついぞ知り得ることはなかったが、ある日突然“永遠の命”などやはり不要だと、心が移ろい……。
lines.translated: I never did learn why they desired "eternal life" to such an extent, but what if one day their hearts suddenly changed, deciding they had no need for "eternal life" after all...?

lines.content: 彼らにとって別の“夢”や“希望”を既に見いだしてしまっているかもしれない。
lines.translated: They might have already found a different "dream" or "hope" for themselves.

lines.content: 俺との約束など、長い……彼らにとってとても長い時間の中で忘れ去られているかもしれない。
lines.translated: Their promise to me might have been completely forgotten over the long... for them, unfathomably long stretch of time.

lines.content: そう不安を覚え始めた――五五回目の春だった。
lines.translated: It was during the fifty-fifth spring--just as I was beginning to feel such unease.

lines.content: 俺は、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: I stood back up.

lines.content: あの子の誕生日、だからではない。
lines.translated: Not because it was that girl's birthday.

lines.content: “夜”の中に感じた……ようやくだ。
lines.translated: I felt it within the "Night"... At long last.

lines.content: ようやく、あの子の[・|気][・|配]が現れた。
lines.translated: At long last, that girl's presence appeared.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を確かに感じ取れたのだ――この五十五年。ずっと身じろぎもせず、耳を澄ませ、心を澄ませ、感覚を研ぎ澄まし……。
lines.translated: I distinctly sensed it--for these fifty-five years, I had remained completely still, straining my ears, clearing my mind, sharpening my senses...

lines.content: 時を超えたあの子が町のどこかに現れるのを、その気配が現れ出るのを、待っていた。
lines.translated: Waiting for that girl who had crossed through time to appear somewhere in town, for her presence to manifest.

lines.content: 気配とは、声だ。声が聞こえた。
lines.translated: That presence was a voice. I heard her voice.

lines.content: ……ソルを殺したのは自分なのだと、自分自身を責める声。泣きたくても決して泣かない。そんなふうに心を噛みしめているかのような、あの子の声を。
lines.translated: A voice blaming herself, saying she was the one who had killed Sol. Even if she wanted to cry, she never would. That girl's voice, sounding as though she were biting down on her own heart.

lines.content: そして“夜”に問いかけたとおりだったと、わかった。
lines.translated: And I knew then that it was just as I had asked the "Night."

lines.content: 千和の“魔法”も、千和の“代償”も、想像どおり、だった。
lines.translated: Both Chiwa's "magic" and Chiwa's "price" were just as I had imagined.

lines.content: だめだよ千和。
lines.translated: You mustn't, Chiwa.

lines.content: 自分を呪い続けて、恨み続けて、生きていくなんて。
lines.translated: You mustn't live on while endlessly cursing yourself, endlessly hating yourself.

lines.content: そんな“代償”などお前に背負わせないように……。
lines.translated: I won't let you shoulder a "price" like that...

lines.content: ……お前には絶対、その“魔法”を使わせないからな
lines.translated: "...I will never let you use that 'magic.'"

lines.content: お前が恨むのは、お前が生涯許さないのは、自分自身じゃなくてこの俺だ。
lines.translated: The one you will hate, the one you will never forgive for as long as you live, won't be yourself--it will be me.

lines.content: さあ、はじめようか。
lines.translated: Now, let's begin.

lines.content: 力を貸してくれよ。お前もどこかで見てるだろ
lines.translated: "Lend me your strength. You're watching from somewhere too, aren't you?"

lines.content: このあらすじを無事、成し遂げられるよう、そばで見守っていてくれよ。
lines.translated: Watch over me from close by so that I can see this scenario through safely to the end.

lines.content: ……人間たちは約束を覚えていた。覚えていて、くれた。驚くことに。
lines.translated: The humans had remembered the promise. To my surprise, they had remembered it for me.

lines.content: 協力を求めた遠いあの夜。
lines.translated: That distant night when I had asked for their cooperation.

lines.content: あれから五十五年ほどの時を、俺と交わした誓いを忘れることなく、親から子へと語り継いでいてくれた。
lines.translated: For the roughly fifty-five years since then, they had passed down the oath exchanged with me from parent to child, never forgetting it.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]が来たなら専用の回線へと電話することになっていた。
lines.translated: It had been arranged that when the time came, I would call a dedicated phone line.

lines.content: 恐る恐るとかけた俺の電話に対応し、やって来たのは数人の人間だった。
lines.translated: Answering the call I placed with trepidation, several humans came to meet me.

lines.content: もうそこには五十五年前、ここに集めた者はいなかった。しかしその面影は見ることができた。
lines.translated: None of the people I had gathered here fifty-five years ago were among them anymore. However, I could still see traces of them in their faces.

lines.content: 俺が、この[物語|人生]の脚本を書く。それをお前たちが演じてくれ
lines.translated: "I will write the script for this life. I want you all to act it out."

lines.content: もしそこになんらかの不備があるなら……稚拙な落ち度や、つまらない綻びがあるのなら、すべては物語を書いた俺の責任だ。失敗しようと、成功しようと、報酬は必ず手渡す
lines.translated: "If there are any flaws in it... any clumsy oversights or foolish loose ends, the responsibility lies entirely with me, the one who wrote the story. Whether it fails or succeeds, I will hand over your reward without fail."

lines.content: ……零から壱を産み出すことなど不可能なこの俺だ。きっと、思い描いたこの物語は――……穴だらけ
lines.translated: "...I am a creature incapable of creating one from zero. This story I have envisioned is surely--...full of holes."

lines.content: だからできうる限り、お前たち人間の力を借り受け、少しだけでも完璧なものに近づけていきたい――あの子の夢を、そして心を騙す、この物語を
lines.translated: "So as much as possible, I want to borrow your strength as humans to bring it even just a little closer to perfection--this story meant to deceive that girl's dreams, and her heart."

lines.content: 数日をかけ人間たちと話し合い、あらすじを決めた。
lines.translated: Spending several days discussing it with the humans, we decided on the scenario.

lines.content: 物語の舞台はこの家。古い喫茶店だ――
lines.translated: The stage for the story would be this house. An old coffee shop--

lines.content: いつか三人で夢見たように、あいつが……実は無事生きていたソルが、お店を開き、千和の帰りを待っていた。と、いうのが“はじまり”とする。
lines.translated: Just as the three of us had dreamed of someday, he... Sol, who had actually survived safe and sound, had opened a shop and was waiting for Chiwa's return. That would be the "beginning."

lines.content: あとは配役だ。
lines.translated: After that came the casting.

lines.content: 数人の従業員。
lines.translated: A few employees.

lines.content: そして誰がもっともあいつを上手く演じられるのかを決めた。
lines.translated: And then, we decided on who could play him best of all.

lines.content: 演者として彼らの持ち得る特殊なメイクや、俺が語り伝えたあいつの出で立ち（喋り方や仕草に至るまで）を、数日にわたり、仕込んでいき――
lines.translated: Over the course of several days, we prepared him using the special makeup techniques they possessed as actors, along with the details of his appearance (right down to his way of speaking and mannerisms) that I had passed down to them--

lines.content: ……ひとつだけ、質問があります
lines.translated: "...I have just one question."

lines.content: ――いつか俺に殺される予定の（実際に殺害した後に、永遠を手渡す予定の）青年は、あいつそっくりに造り上げられた顔で、言った。
lines.translated: --With a face crafted to look just like his, the young man who was scheduled to be killed by me someday (and to whom I would hand over eternity after actually murdering him) spoke.

lines.content: ……永遠の命を授かったなら、ぼくは、夜の眷属となり――そこに住まうイキモノたちと交流を持つことも、可能となりますか？
lines.translated: "...Once I am granted eternal life, will I become a kindred of the Night--and will it be possible for me to interact with the creatures who dwell there?"

lines.content: ……おそらくは
lines.translated: "...Most likely."

lines.content: なぜ、そのようなことを気にするのか。
lines.translated: Why did he care about something like that?

lines.content: そう問いかけると、青年は……“遠矢”と名乗った青年は、言った。
lines.translated: When I asked him this, the young man... the young man who had introduced himself as "Tooya," answered.

lines.content: ……母です
lines.translated: "...It's my mother."

lines.content: ……ぼくの母親は、たったひとりで、ぼくを育ててくれました
lines.translated: "...My mother raised me all by herself."
"...Until she returned to that house, her life was an endless string of hardships..."

lines.content: きっと泣きたいこともあったはずです
lines.translated: "I'm sure there were times when she wanted to cry."

lines.content: きっと、弱音に押しつぶされそうになったことも、一度や二度ではないはずなんです
lines.translated: "I'm sure there were more than a few times when she was nearly crushed by her own insecurities and doubts."

lines.content: それでも母は、決して腐らず……
lines.translated: "Even so, my mother never gave in to despair..."

lines.content: ぼくに何も心配させまいと、どんなに疲れ切って仕事から帰ってきても、笑顔さえ、決して絶やさず……ぼくをここまで育ててくれました
