lines.translated: "Not wanting me to worry about a thing, no matter how exhausted she was when she came home from work, she never let her smile fade... and she raised me all the way to where I am today."

lines.content: そんな母には、幼少の頃に知り合った友人がいたようなんです
lines.translated: "It seems my mother had a friend she met when she was very young."

lines.content: ……友人？
lines.translated: "...A friend?"

lines.content: はい。おそらくは、“夜”に属する誰かです
lines.translated: "Yes. Most likely, someone who belongs to the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……母はもう、その出会いが実際に自分にあったことだというふうには覚えていないでしょう
lines.translated: "...My mother probably doesn't remember that encounter as something that actually happened to her anymore."

lines.content: ただ、幼いぼくを寝かしつけてくれる際、子守歌代わりにいつも話してくれていました
lines.translated: "However, whenever she tucked me into bed as a little boy, she would always tell me about it in place of a lullaby."

lines.content: お母さん、時どきね、なんだかとてもすてきな夢を見るんだよ――
lines.translated: "'Sometimes, Mommy has the most wonderful dream--'"

lines.content: ちょっと不思議で、とってもやさしい。そんな小さな女の子が、私たちのことを見守っていてくれる夢。いつも私たちのことを応援してくれている、そんな夢。
lines.translated: "'A dream where a slightly mysterious, very kind little girl is watching over us. A dream where she's always cheering us on.'"

lines.content: ……お母さん、その子のことが大好きで。うん。だから、あなたを“遠矢”と名付けたような、そんな気がするの。
lines.translated: "'...Mommy loves that girl very much. Yes. That's why I feel like I named you "Tooya" after her.'"

lines.content: だけどその子はいつもひとりぼっちで……。
lines.translated: "'But that girl is always all alone...'"

lines.content: きっと今もどこかでさみしそうに笑ってる。
lines.translated: "'I'm sure she's still smiling lonely somewhere even now.'"

lines.content: だから、お母さん。その子のことを迎えに行きたいと思うけど……。
lines.translated: "'So Mommy wants to go and bring her back, but...'"

lines.content: そこでいつも夢は覚めちゃうの。
lines.translated: "'That's where I always wake up from the dream.'"

lines.content: 母はそう言い、懐かしそうに、だけどどこかさみしそうに、ぼくに何度となく[・|そ][・|の][・|夢]について語ってくれました
lines.translated: "Saying that, looking nostalgic yet somewhat lonely, my mother told me about that dream time and time again."

lines.content: ……それはきっと、“夜”の住人と、母が幼い頃に出会っていたという証ではないでしょうか
lines.translated: "...Surely, isn't that proof that my mother met a resident of the 'Night' when she was a child?"

lines.content: 本来なら、人間のぼくらは大人になれば“夜”とは疎遠となります。だけど母は、あまりにその子のことが大切で……。
lines.translated: "Ordinarily, we humans grow distant from the 'Night' once we become adults. But that girl meant so very much to my mother..."

lines.content: 母は、それをはっきりと思い出せないことがあまりにさみしいと……そう、言っていました
lines.translated: "My mother said... that it made her terribly lonely not to be able to remember it clearly."

lines.content: ……ぼくが永遠の命を得、夜の眷属となれたなら。母のことを大切に思ってくれていただろう誰かを探し、母の元に連れて行ってあげたいんです
lines.translated: "...If I can obtain eternal life and become a kindred of the Night, I want to find that someone who must have cared so deeply for my mother, and bring them to her."

lines.content: そのためにぼくは“永遠”を得たいのだと、“遠矢”と名のる青年は言った。
lines.translated: That was why he wanted to obtain "eternity," the young man calling himself "Tooya" said.

lines.content: ……母親を労うために、お前は、その母親に大切に育まれたのだろう命を投げ出し、永遠の命を得るというのか
lines.translated: "...In order to reward your mother's hard work, you intend to throw away the life she must have raised so precious and dear, all to obtain eternal life?"

lines.content: ……ええ。そうですね。確かにそうです。親不孝なこと甚だしいだろうと思います
lines.translated: "...Yes. That's right. It certainly is. I think it must be the height of filial impiety."

lines.content: だけど、あなたとの誓いは、誰かがやらねばならない盟約なのだと……ぼくらは言い聞かせられてきました。それだけのことをぼくらの祖先はしてきたのだと
lines.translated: "However, we have been taught since childhood that the oath with you is a covenant that someone must fulfill. That our ancestors committed deeds grave enough to warrant it."

lines.content: ……その贖罪を果たすためなら、どのようなことでもしなければならないのだ、と
lines.translated: "...And that we must do whatever it takes to fulfill that atonement."

lines.content: そうでなければ、ぼくら一族は、本当の意味で“ヒトデナシ”となってしまうから、と
lines.translated: "Because otherwise, our clan would become truly 'inhuman' in the real sense of the word."

lines.content: それにぼくがやらなくとも、代わりに誰かがこの役割を担うこととなります
lines.translated: "Besides, even if I don't do it, someone else will have to take on this role in my stead."

lines.content: どうせ誰かがやらねばならぬことならば、一番上手にできるだろうぼくがしたほうがいい。
lines.translated: "If someone has to do it anyway, it's better that I do it, since I'm likely the one who can pull it off best."

lines.content: ぼくは結構、演技力には自信があるんですよと、青年は言う。絵を描くことと同じくらい。
lines.translated: He was quite confident in his acting skills, the young man said. Just as much as he was in painting.

lines.content: それに、ぼくは実家に恩があるんです。父亡き後、母を再び家族として受け入れてくれたという恩が。その恩に報いることが出来るのなら、まったくもって、これは安い話なんです
lines.translated: "Furthermore, I owe a debt of gratitude to my family home. The debt of accepting my mother back into the family after my father passed away. If I can repay that kindness, then this is an absolute bargain."

lines.content: 青年はまっすぐ俺を見つめ、そして、笑った。
lines.translated: The young man looked straight at me, and then smiled.

lines.content: ――人生は、その生き方そのものがひとつの優れた[作品|芸術]なのだとどうして呼べない。
lines.translated: --Why couldn't a life, the very way it is lived, be called a fine work of art in itself?

lines.content: あいつの声が蘇る。
lines.translated: His voice echoed in my mind.

lines.content: 今、目の前の青年は、愛する母親のためにその命を使おうとしているのだろう。
lines.translated: Right now, the young man before my eyes was likely trying to use his life for the sake of his beloved mother.

lines.content: ……あの子の人生に、責任を持つ
lines.translated: "...To take responsibility for that girl's life."

lines.content: 俺は、つぶやくように言う。
lines.translated: I spoke in a near whisper.

lines.content: あの子が大人になるまでは。あの子が、共に歩める大切な誰かを見つけられる、それまでは――……どうか
lines.translated: "Until that girl becomes an adult. Until she can find someone precious to walk alongside her--...please."

lines.content: どうか、お願いだ
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you."

lines.content: そのときが来るまで、お前があの子の父親としてそばにいてほしい
lines.translated: "Until that time comes, I want you to stay by her side as her father."

lines.content: 千和の好きなあいつのように、ソルのように……誰よりやさしい父親として、あの子のことをそばで見守り、応援していてやってほしいんだ
lines.translated: "Just like the man Chiwa loved, just like Sol... As a father kinder than anyone else, I want you to watch over her closely and cheer her on."

lines.content: その期間は高校に入学するまでと決めた。義務教育とやらを無事に終えたその後だ。子どもから、大人になる境界線。それはそこにあるように俺には思えた。
lines.translated: I decided that period would last until she entered high school. Right after she safely finished what they call compulsory education. The boundary line where a child becomes an adult. To me, it felt like that line lay right there.

lines.content: ……およそ十年後の春だ。
lines.translated: A spring roughly ten years from now.

lines.content: その春に、千和がそれまで一緒に暮らしてきた父親を、千和の目の前で――……俺が、殺す。
lines.translated: In that spring, right in front of Chiwa's eyes, I would kill--...the father she had lived with all that time.

lines.content: もしもそのとき、千和の隣に大切な誰かがいてくれたなら……。
lines.translated: And if, at that time, there was someone precious standing beside Chiwa...

lines.content: その誰かと千和が、幸せを掴もうかとしたその瞬間にこそ、俺は、行動に移ろう。
lines.translated: At the very moment Chiwa and that someone were about to grasp happiness, I would make my move.

lines.content: そしてあの子にとって邪悪なるものは、打ち倒すべき“悪役”は、自分自身の“後悔”から俺へと移してしまいたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to shift the evil in that girl's eyes, the "villain" she must strike down, away from her own "regret" and onto me.

lines.content: ……そしてあの子の中の[悪夢|後悔]を消し去りたいのだ。
lines.translated: And I wanted to wipe away the nightmare of regret inside her.

lines.content: あまりに稚拙で、あまりに強引で、あんまりに……穴ぼこだらけな筋書きだろうと、こんな俺でもわかるけれど……
lines.translated: "Even someone like me can tell that this plot is far too crude, far too forced, and far too... full of holes, but..."

lines.content: この筋書き以上のものを、俺には用意できそうにない。
lines.translated: It didn't look like I would be able to come up with anything better than this script.

lines.content: その穴ぼこだらけの筋書きを埋めようと、青年たちが最後に一つひとつ、丁寧な質問をしてくれた。
lines.translated: Seeking to fill in that hole-ridden script, the young men asked me careful questions at the end, one by one.

lines.content: その子の“魔法”は、大切な人を蘇らせること――……
lines.translated: "That girl's 'magic' is to bring a precious person back to life--..."

lines.content: 青年が、言う。
lines.translated: The young man spoke.

lines.content: その子に“魔法”を使わせるのではいけなかったんですか？　そうすれば、失われた人物はあなた達の元に戻ってくるし……
lines.translated: "Why couldn't you let her use that 'magic'? If you did, the person you lost would return to you, and..."

lines.content: それに、ぼくが[・|そ][・|の][・|人]のふりをして現れることで、その子の後悔は消えてしまうのではないですか？　殺したと思っていたひとが実は生きていた――
lines.translated: "Besides, won't her regret disappear simply by me showing up pretending to be that person? The person she thought she killed was actually alive--"

lines.content: それを示すだけで、充分ではないのですか？
lines.translated: "Isn't just showing her that enough?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."
"Magic"...

lines.content: まるで絶対的不可能を実現させる“奇跡”のような響きだが、しかし、俺はその点には懐疑的だ。
lines.translated: It sounded like a "miracle" that could make the absolutely impossible a reality, yet I was skeptical on that point.

lines.content: “魔法”と呼ばれこそしているが、この場所で使えるそれは、元々はただの“想像力”を形にしただけのものである――
lines.translated: Though it is called "magic," what can be used in this place is originally nothing more than "imagination" given form--

lines.content: 人の想像がいくら強力なものであったにせよ……。
lines.translated: No matter how powerful human imagination might be...

lines.content: 千和の願いがそれほど強く、切実に願われたものであったにせよ……。
lines.translated: And no matter how strongly and desperately Chiwa wished for it...

lines.content: 失われた命を復元させるというような、まるで神のごとく所行を可能に出来るほど、この世界は簡単ではないはずだ――故に。
lines.translated: This world shouldn't be so simple as to allow an act practically worthy of a god, like restoring a lost life--and therefore.

lines.content: いずれにせよその“魔法”は失敗するだろうと俺は踏んでいる。
lines.translated: In any case, I fully expected that "magic" to fail.

lines.content: そうでなければこの世界の“死”とはあまりに軽々しいものではないか。その“魔法”は、神以外には成功できてはいけない“魔法”なのだ。
lines.translated: Otherwise, wouldn't "death" in this world be far too trivial a thing? That "magic" is a "magic" that no one other than a god should ever be allowed to succeed at.

lines.content: この“夜”の住人として、それは確信にも近い予測ではあった。
lines.translated: As a resident of this "Night," that was a prediction bordering on certainty.

lines.content: そして失敗してしまった千和は、また更に、傷つくのではないか。
lines.translated: And if Chiwa were to fail, wouldn't she only be hurt even deeper?

lines.content: そして、お前がソルを演じることで、千和の後悔はその時点で消えてしまうのではないか、という疑問だが
lines.translated: "And as for your question about whether Chiwa's regret would vanish the moment you started playing the role of Sol..."

lines.content: ……はい
いつか、人間のお前は朽ち行くだろう。俺たちと違い歳を取り。そうなればさすがにすべてバレてしまう。どうしたってお前は千和より先に逝く
lines.translated: "Someday, as a human, you will wither away. Unlike us, you age. When that happens, everything will inevitably be exposed. No matter what, you will pass away before Chiwa does."

lines.content: なら先に、ぼくを不死にしてくれれば……
lines.translated: "Then if you would just make me immortal beforehand..."

lines.content: ……悪いな
lines.translated: "...Sorry."

lines.content: 俺は、お前たち人間を信頼しきれていない。報酬を渡した後、お前たちが姿を消す場合だって大いにある。お前たちの祖先にも言ったが、永遠は成功報酬なんだよ
lines.translated: "I don't fully trust you humans. There is a very real chance you would simply vanish after I handed over your reward. As I told your ancestors, eternity is a reward for success."

lines.content: ……ぼくがあなたの仲間、元人間の怪物を演じるのは納得しています。あまりに魅力的な報酬を得るためです。むしろやらせてほしいとさえ思っています。だけど……
lines.translated: "...I accept playing the role of your companion, a former human turned monster. It's to obtain an overwhelmingly attractive reward. In fact, I even want you to let me do it. However..."

lines.content: だけどぼくは、人間です
lines.translated: "However, I am human."

lines.content: あなたの言うとおりだ。ぼくはあなた達と違い歳を取るし、そうなればこの外見を維持することだって容易ではないです。いくら化粧で飾ろうと。綻びは必ず出るだろうと思います
lines.translated: "It's just as you say. Unlike you, I grow old, and as I do, maintaining this appearance will not be easy. No matter how much makeup I use to cover it up, the seams will inevitably start to show."

lines.content: ああ。俺たち“怪物”は“人と触れあう”ことができない。特に、大人になった人間とは――この通りだ。こうしてお前に姿を晒しているというだけで、身体がひび割れ、壊れてしまう
lines.translated: "Yeah. We 'monsters' cannot 'come into contact with humans.' Especially with humans who have grown into adults--just like this. Merely exposing my form to you like this causes my body to crack and break apart."

lines.content: 手袋を外して見せた。
lines.translated: I took off my glove to show him.

lines.content: ひび割れた肌に冷たい空気が触れ痛みがはしる。
lines.translated: The cold air touched my cracked skin, sending a sharp pain shooting through it.

lines.content: ……千和も、この事情は痛いほど理解しているだろうと思う
lines.translated: "...I think Chiwa understands this circumstance all too painfully well."

lines.content: だからお前の老化は、あの子が成長するのに合わせ、少しずつ“怪物”の身体がひび割れていっているのだということにしたい
lines.translated: "So I want to pass off your aging as the 'monster's' body gradually cracking piece by piece as she grows up."

lines.content: では、その子が大人になったので“怪物”とは“さよなら”しなければならなくなった――という結末ではだめなのですか？
lines.translated: "Then, couldn't the ending simply be that because she has become an adult, she has to say 'goodbye' to the 'monster'?"

lines.content: ……そうすればあなたがわざわざ“悪役”になる必要もない
lines.translated: "...If we do that, there would be no need for you to go out of your way to become the 'villain.'"

lines.content: そうだな。……確かに。別れを描いた物語はとかくうつくしいものが多い。そういう終わりも悪くはないかな
lines.translated: "True. ...You have a point. Stories depicting farewells are often quite beautiful. An ending like that might not be so bad."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: いざ別れのときを迎えたなら、あの子はきっとこう言うはずだ――“さよなら”は、嫌だ。自分もソルと一緒に“夜”の中で暮らしていきたい
lines.translated: "However, when the time for that farewell actually arrived, I know for certain she would say this--'I don't want to say "goodbye." I want to live in the "Night" together with Sol, too.'"

lines.content: もう二度と“さよなら”なんてしたくはないと涙さえ見せて。
lines.translated: Even shedding tears, saying she never wanted to say "goodbye" ever again.

lines.content: そんなあの子の顔だけは、どうしてだかはっきりと想像できてしまい――ちくりとした。心などないはずの胸の奥が。
lines.translated: For some reason, I could picture her making that exact face all too clearly--and it pricked at me. Deep inside a chest that shouldn't even have a heart.

lines.content: だからあの子には強制的な“さよなら”が必要なんだと俺は思う。何者かがあの子と大切なひととの間に割り込んででも
lines.translated: "That's why I believe she needs a forced 'goodbye.' Even if it means someone has to violently force their way between her and the person she holds dear."

lines.content: それに、千和は人間として育てたいんだ。それは[・|あ][・|い][・|つ]の願いのひとつ、だったから……
lines.translated: "Besides, I want to raise Chiwa as a human. Because that was one of his wishes..."

lines.content: ……そうですか。わかりました
lines.translated: "...Is that so? I understand."

lines.content: 青年は、うなずく――あなたの望むとおりにいたしましょう、と。
lines.translated: The young man nodded--as if to say, "Let us do it just as you wish."

lines.content: “怪物”の自分は、大人になりはじめた娘には中々近寄れないという理由で、場合によっては自室に引きこもり、身体の変化をあまり悟らせないようにできればとも思います
lines.translated: "Using the excuse that as a 'monster,' I cannot easily get close to a daughter who is beginning to grow into an adult, I think I can shut myself in my room when necessary so that she doesn't notice the changes in my body too much."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そしてもしあなた達の望み通り、いつかあなた達の子が、共に生きたいと願う大切な“誰か”を選び、連れてくるようなことがあったなら……
lines.translated: "And if, just as you both hope, your child someday chooses a precious 'someone' she wishes to live alongside and brings them home..."

lines.content: そのときは俺たちふたりでその“誰か”を見極めよう。本当に、千和を幸せにしてくれるに足る人物であるのかを
lines.translated: "When that time comes, the two of us will judge that 'someone' together. To see if they truly are a person worthy of making Chiwa happy."

lines.content: そうですね。……わかりました。それがぼくの最後の仕事……最後の“役割”となりそうですね。きっと
lines.translated: "Right. ...I understand. That will likely be my final job... my final 'role.' Surely."

lines.content: ……他に、整理しておくべき不調和はないだろうか。俺には気づけていない何かは、ないだろうか
lines.translated: "...Are there any other discrepancies we should sort out beforehand? Anything I might have overlooked?"

lines.content: ……今のところは。何か気づけばおいおい連絡させてもらえればと思います
lines.translated: "...None for the moment. If I notice anything, I will contact you in due course."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 千和が、あなた達の子が、この家に帰って来るのはいつ頃でしょうか
lines.translated: "Around when will Chiwa, your child, be returning to this house?"

lines.content: ……わからない
lines.translated: "...I don't know."

lines.content: おそらくは“夜の王”とやらを倒した後だろう。きっとあの子は、報酬の“魔法”をその手に抱え、帰ってくるはずだ
lines.translated: "Most likely after she defeats this 'King of the Night.' I'm sure that girl will come back holding the 'magic' she received as her reward in her hands."

lines.content: あなたはその“夜の王”と、その子とが戦わなければならない現場には……
lines.translated: "And as for the place where that girl must fight the 'King of the Night'..."

lines.content: もちろん赴く。何か手助けになるようなことを講じられるのであれば、影ながら、そうしようとも思ってる
lines.translated: "Of course I'll go there. If there's anything I can devise to help her out, I intend to do so from the shadows."

lines.content: なんだか……
lines.translated: "Somehow..."

lines.content: 少年は、微笑む。
lines.translated: The boy smiled.

lines.content: とても、過保護ですね
lines.translated: "You really are overprotective."

lines.content: ……そんなことはない。“夜の王”との戦争だなんて。そんなもの、ふつうに生きていれば誰も経験することのないものだ。助けくらいあって当然だろう
lines.translated: "...That's not true. A war against the 'King of the Night'? That's something no one would ever experience if they lived a normal life. It's only natural for her to have some help."

lines.content: 私たちがここで生活している間、あなたはどこへ？
lines.translated: "While we are living here, where will you go?"

lines.content: ……適当だ。この町には草木が多く、休める場所も多くある。お前たちが気にすることではない――……以上か？
lines.translated: "...Wherever. This town has plenty of trees and greenery, and plenty of places to rest. It's nothing for you to worry about--...Is that all?"

lines.content: はい……。いえ。最後に、もうひとつだけ質問です
lines.translated: "Yes... No, wait. Finally, I have just one more question."

lines.content: ……なんだ
lines.translated: "...What."

lines.content: ……本当に、千和の両親を殺したのはあなただったのですか？
lines.translated: "...Was it truly you who killed Chiwa's parents?"

lines.content: “やさしい怪物”に懐いていたその子のことを傷つけないために、そのときもまた、あなたはあの子の思い込みを訂正しなかったんじゃ――
lines.translated: "In order to avoid hurting that girl who had grown so attached to the 'kind monster,' didn't you once again refrain from correcting her misconception back then--"

lines.content: ……聞きたいことは
lines.translated: "...Is that..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 聞きたいことは、それだけか
lines.translated: "Is that all you wanted to ask?"

lines.content: ……はい
青年は、あいつそっくりな顔で目を細め、俺を見ていた。
lines.translated: With a face identical to his, the young man narrowed his eyes and looked at me.

lines.content: どうか、お身体をお大事に……。“怪物”のあなたには大きなお世話かもしれませんが
lines.translated: "Please, take care of yourself... Though that might be none of my business to say to a 'monster' like you."

lines.content: ……あの子のことを、よろしく頼む
lines.translated: "...Please take good care of her."

lines.content: はい
lines.translated: "Yes."

lines.content: ……お願いだ
lines.translated: "...I'm begging you."

lines.content: ……はい
あの子のことを悲しませないよう、できるだけ、いい父親でいてほしい……
lines.translated: "So that she doesn't have to feel sad, I want you to be as good a father to her as you possibly can..."

lines.content: ……善処いたします
lines.translated: "...I will do my very best."

lines.content: ……申し訳ない。本当に
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry. Truly."

lines.content: この先、誰より、あの子を悲しませる予定の俺が、お前たちに対してこんなことを偉そうに言えるわけもないことは、わかっている……だけど
lines.translated: "I know that someone like me, who plans to make her sadder than anyone else in the future, has no right to say something like this so high and mighty to you... Even so."

lines.content: ……いいえ
lines.translated: "...Not at all."

lines.content: 青年は微笑む。俺の言葉を遮るように。
lines.translated: The young man smiled, as if to cut off my words.

lines.content: あなたの代わりに、大切に、大切に、育てます。……およそ十年間。[・|自][・|分][・|の][・|子][・|と][・|同][・|じ][・|よ][・|う][・|に]愛すると誓います
lines.translated: "In your stead, I will raise her with the utmost care. ...For roughly ten years. I swear to love her as if she were my own child."

lines.content: だから、どうか安心してください。ぼくたちはあなたを決して裏切らない。ぼくの母に誓います――青年はそう言い、うなずいた。
lines.translated: "So please, rest assured. We will never betray you. I swear it upon my mother." Saying that, the young man nodded.

lines.content: ……俺はそれ以上何も言わず、この身に“夜”を纏い、青年たちの前から姿を消した。
lines.translated: Without saying anything further, I wrapped myself in the "Night" and vanished from before the young man and the others.

lines.content: 空を見上げている。
lines.translated: I was looking up at the sky.

lines.content: はらはら、はらり。さくら舞う“夜”の空だ。
lines.translated: Fluttering, drifting down. The sky of the "Night," where cherry blossoms danced.

lines.content: ……どうしてかな。
lines.translated: Why, I wonder.

lines.content: ため息をつく。
lines.translated: He let out a sigh.

lines.content: 人間たちと協力をして書き上げた筋書きは、もちろん、完璧なものであるはずがない――
lines.translated: The script I had written in cooperation with the humans could never have been perfect, of course--

lines.content: 何も創造することの叶わない“夜の怪物”がはじめたことだ。どこもかしこも穴だらけだろう。
lines.translated: It was something started by a "monster of the Night" incapable of creating anything at all. It was bound to be full of holes everywhere.

lines.content: それでも、些細な食い違いはあれど、想定外のトラブルも、まあ、一度や二度はありはしたものの……。
lines.translated: Even so, despite some minor discrepancies and, well, an unexpected trouble or two along the way...

lines.content: （……[・|今][・|日]まではある程度、上手くいっていたというのに）
lines.translated: (...Up until today, things had been going reasonably well, and yet.)

lines.content: それなのに、どうして……。
lines.translated: And yet, why...?

lines.content: ……やっぱり、違う
lines.translated: "...No, that's not it after all."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|い][・|つ]は言った――……その一言に、すべてが壊れる。そんな予感が確かにしたのだ。
lines.translated: He said it--...With that single remark, everything would come crashing down. I had a distinct premonition that it would.

lines.content: ……こんなことは、間違ってる。違うんですよ。俺は、あなたと戦いに来たわけじゃないんだ
lines.translated: "...This is wrong. That's not it at all. I didn't come here to fight you."

lines.content: 今、続けて思い出しているのは――……あの“夜”のこと。三年前の春の“夜”
lines.translated: What I was continuously recalling right now--...was that "Night." Though it was a spring "Night" from three years ago, no... right now.

lines.content: 奏大雅。千和が選んだ男の子。これから共に歩んでいきたいと願う者。
lines.translated: Kanade Taiga. The boy Chiwa had chosen. The one she wished to walk alongside from here on out.

lines.content: そいつは俺の差し出した条件を――俺と戦い、千和の命を取り返してみせろ、という条件を前に、取り出した“魔法”の矛を……。
lines.translated: Faced with the condition I had presented him--to fight me and win back Chiwa's life--he had drawn his spear of "magic"...

lines.content: しかしその鋭い切っ先を俺にぶつけることなく、納めた。
lines.translated: Yet without striking its sharp point against me, he put it away.

lines.content: 俺はあなたと戦いに来たわけじゃない――
lines.translated: "I didn't come here to fight you--"

lines.content: 少年は繰り返しそう言う。
lines.translated: The boy repeated those words.

lines.content: ――俺はあなたと、話し合いをするためにここへ来たんだ
lines.translated: "--I came here to talk things over with you."

lines.content: ふん
lines.translated: "Hmph."

lines.content: 俺は、鼻を鳴らす。
lines.translated: I snorted.

lines.content: そしてできうる限り醜悪な自分自身の顔を思い描きながら、言った。
lines.translated: And while picturing my own face looking as hideous as humanly possible, I spoke.

lines.content: まったく。くどいな少年。話し合いなら、もう充分に――
lines.translated: "Honestly. You're persistent, boy. If it's a talk you want, we've already had more than enough--"

lines.content: ……あのひとは、本物、だったんですか
lines.translated: "...Was that person the real thing?"

lines.content: 発せられた少年の一言に、俺は目をすがめた。
lines.translated: At the words uttered by the boy, I narrowed my eyes.

lines.content: ……千和の、お父さんですよ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa's father, I mean."

lines.content: 少年は、言う。俺と目を合わせないまま。
lines.translated: The boy spoke without meeting my eyes.

lines.content: ……千和がこの春まで一緒に暮らしていたお父さんです
lines.translated: "...The father Chiwa lived together with until this spring."

lines.content: そしてあなたが、その手にかけたひと……あなたの仲間だったはずのひとです
lines.translated: "And the person you struck down with your own hands... the person who was supposed to be your companion."

lines.content: あのひとは、本当に……。
lines.translated: Was that person truly...

lines.content: 本当に。遙か昔の“夜”の中。千和のことを[さら|攫]った……“やさしい怪物”、そのひとだったんですか？
lines.translated: "Was he truly that very same 'kind monster'... who spirited Chiwa away in the 'Night' so long ago?"

lines.content: そこで少年は俺を見た。真っ直ぐに、俺を見つめた。
lines.translated: At that point, the boy looked at me. He stared straight at me.

lines.content: ……あなたはさっき、何をしにここへ来たのかと俺に言いましたよね
lines.translated: "...Earlier, you asked me what I came here to do, didn't you?"

lines.content: 千和の命を取り返すため、“やさしくない怪物”と戦いに来たわけでもないのなら……いったい何をしに来たのか、と
lines.translated: "You asked what on earth I came here for, if not to fight the 'unkind monster' to take back Chiwa's life."

lines.content: 俺の目的は、“千和の命を返してもらうそのために”……という名目の元、“千和と俺の命の残り時間を交換するそのために”……
lines.translated: "Under the pretext of 'getting Chiwa's life back'... my true objective is 'to exchange the remaining time of my life for Chiwa's'..."

lines.content: ――それが俺の“魔法”の“代償”だから。少年が言う。
lines.translated: "--Because that is the 'price' of my 'magic,'" the boy said.

lines.content: そして。[・|あ][・|の][・|お][・|父][・|さ][・|ん]は果たして本物だったのか――そんな疑問を投げかけて、事実を確認する。そんな個人的な好奇心を満たすため
lines.translated: "And also. To pose the question of whether that father was truly the real thing--and confirm the truth. To satisfy that personal curiosity of mine."

lines.content: ……これもまた、千和がそばにいては語れない本音のひとつではありました
lines.translated: "...This, too, was one of the true feelings I couldn't speak of while Chiwa was by my side."

lines.content: ……おかしいと思ったのは、千和の悪夢、その[ありか|在処]を垣間見たときでした。違和感があったんです
lines.translated: "...When I first thought something was strange was when I caught a glimpse of Chiwa's nightmare, of where it lay. Something felt off."

lines.content: “夜の怪物”は人の心を持たない。故に。ゼロから何かを造り上げるための“想像力”に欠いている。だから人の造り上げる“作品”に惹かれてやまない――……そのはずなのに
lines.translated: "'Monsters of the Night' do not possess human hearts. Therefore, they lack the 'imagination' to create something from nothing. That is why they are endlessly drawn to the 'works' created by humans--...That's how it's supposed to be, and yet."

lines.content: 俺と千和は、幼い頃、千和のお父さんに一度だけですが、肖像画を描いてもらったことがありました
lines.translated: "When Chiwa and I were little, just once, we had Chiwa's father paint a portrait for us."

lines.content: ……でも、肖像画くらい
lines.translated: "...Well, just a portrait."

lines.content: ただ目の前の人物をキャンバスに描き起こすことくらいなら――なんて軽薄な言い方をすると、語弊があるのかもしれませんが……とにかく
lines.translated: "If it's just reproducing the people right in front of your eyes onto a canvas--putting it so flippantly might be misleading, I suppose, but... anyway."

lines.content: とにかくそれくらいなら創造とも言えず、“夜の怪物”にも可能なことなのかもしれない。元人間の“怪物”になら、尚更だ……
lines.translated: "Anyway, if it's just that much, maybe you couldn't really call it creation, and it might be something even a 'monster of the Night' could do. Even more so for a 'monster' who used to be human..."

lines.content: ……教えてください。応えてください。千和の、もうひとりのお父さん
lines.translated: "...Please tell me. Please answer me. Chiwa's other father."

lines.content: この疑問は、違和感は、本来なら問いかけることなく放置しておくつもりでした。なぜならそう思った根拠があまりにも乏しいからです。証拠もなにも、ないからです
lines.translated: "Originally, I intended to leave this doubt, this sense of incongruity, alone without ever asking about it. Because the basis for thinking that way was far too thin. Because I had no proof or anything at all."

lines.content: ……だけど。
lines.translated: Even so.

lines.content: この細やかな疑惑を、今さらになってどうしても捨て置けなくなった、その理由は――……
lines.translated: The reason I simply couldn't brush aside this small suspicion at this late hour was--...

lines.content: ……俺には、あなたが憎からず思っている者と同じようなことをするとは、やっぱり、どうしてもて思えなかったからです
lines.translated: "...Because I just couldn't bring myself to believe that you would do the exact same thing as the people you despise."

lines.content: ……どういうことだ？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: 千和の両親ですよ
lines.translated: "Chiwa's parents."

lines.content: 実の娘の命を“怪物”に捧げ、更にその肉体を喰らうことで、望みを叶えようとした――“ヒトデナシ”たちです
lines.translated: "Those 'inhuman monsters'--who offered up their own flesh-and-blood daughter's life to a 'monster,' and even tried to devour its flesh to have their wish granted."

lines.content: 自分の“役割”を達成するそのために、[・|自][・|分][・|の][・|娘]の命を代償とする
lines.translated: "Offering up one's own daughter's life as a price in order to fulfill one's own 'role.'"

lines.content: ……今、あなたがしていることですよ。それはまさにその“ヒトデナシ”と同等なのだと俺には感じられてならない
lines.translated: "...That is what you are doing right now. I cannot help+feeling that it is the exact same thing those 'inhuman monsters' did."

lines.content: ……“あなたは何かを隠してる”
lines.translated: "...'You are hiding something.'"

lines.content: 俺の感じた違和感がそう言って聞かないんですよ。その声は次第次第に、大きくなる。だって、あなたは――あれでしょう？
lines.translated: "The sense of incongruity I felt keeps telling me that, refusing to listen to anything else. And that voice is growing louder and louder. Because you--you're like that, aren't you?"

lines.content: あれ？
lines.translated: "Oh?"

lines.content: ……はい
あなたは隠し事があると口数が多くなる――そういう癖があるのだと、千和の中の[思い出|夢]がそう教えてくれました
lines.translated: "You have a habit of talking a lot whenever you're hiding something--the dreams of Chiwa's memories inside her taught me that."

lines.content: その隠し事が、本来は無口で、自らの心を決して語ろうとはしないだろうあなたのことを――こうまで饒舌にさせているのだとしたら
lines.translated: "If that secret is what's making someone like you--who is naturally taciturn and would never speak of his own heart--this talkative..."

lines.content: その隠し事を、その事情を、図々しいことは承知の上で……お願いします。俺にも話して聞かせてもらえることはできませんか
lines.translated: "Knowing full well how presumptuous I'm being, please... couldn't you tell me about that secret, about those circumstances?"

lines.content: もしかすると俺はあなたの味方に、あなたの仲間に、なれるかもしれない。だから――
lines.translated: "Perhaps I could become your ally, your companion. So--"

lines.content: ……なぜだ
……なぜ、そのようなことをお前は思う
lines.translated: "...Why would you think such a thing?"

lines.content: 俺は、千和の命をさくらに捧げた。お前たちの仲を引き裂こうとしているんだぞ
lines.translated: "I offered Chiwa's life to the cherry tree. I'm trying to tear the two of you apart, you know."

lines.content: それなのに、味方だなどと。
lines.translated: And yet, he speaks of being an ally.

lines.content: ……仲間、だなどと。
lines.translated: Of being a companion.

lines.content: この世界はたくさんのおとぎ話でできている――千和はそう言っていました
lines.translated: "'This world is made up of many fairy tales'--that's what Chiwa told me."

lines.content: 少年は両手を広げ、苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: The boy spread both hands and gave a wry smile.

lines.content: どうしようもなく恐ろしい“悪役”が、実は、誰よりもやさしいひとで……誰よりもさみしい心の、持ち主で……
lines.translated: "If a story where a hopelessly terrifying 'villain' is actually kinder than anyone else... possesses a heart lonelier than anyone else's..."

lines.content: そして、大切にしなきゃならない誰かのことを、誰よりも、誰よりも強く想っている人物だった……そういう物語が、もしも現実にあるとしたなら
lines.translated: "And cares for someone he must cherish more strongly than anyone, anyone else... If a story like that actually existed in reality..."

lines.content: ……もしも、誰にも知られることなく、俺たちのそばにあったのなら
lines.translated: "...If it existed right beside us, without anyone ever knowing about it..."

lines.content: たったひとりだけでも、その物語の味方でいようと思う者がいたっていい――そう思ってしまったんです
lines.translated: "Then I couldn't help thinking--it would be okay for there to be at least one person who wanted to be on the side of that story."

lines.content: そんなふうに思ってしまうのが、人間というイキモノなんですよ。きっと
lines.translated: "To end up thinking that way is just what creatures called humans do. Surely."

lines.content: ああ、そうです。と、少年は言う。
lines.translated: "Yes, that's right," the boy said.

lines.content: そう思ってしまったからこそ……、こうして疑問をぶつけないわけにはいかなくなったんです
lines.translated: "It's precisely because I ended up thinking that way... that I had no choice but to confront you with my doubts like this."

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ため息をつき、俺は……。
lines.translated: Letting out a sigh, I...

lines.content: ……まったく。やれやれだ
lines.translated: "...Good grief. Honestly."

lines.content: 俺は思わず、笑ってしまう。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but laugh.

lines.content: もう、いい。なんだか疲れた
lines.translated: "Forget it. I suddenly feel exhausted."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……まるでいけ好かない探偵に追い詰められる犯人のような心境だ。今、それを充分理解できたよ
lines.translated: "...I feel just like a culprit cornered by an obnoxious detective. I fully understand how that feels now."

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだ。お前の言うとおりだよ少年。お前の知ってるあいつは、本物ではない。偽物だ
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right. It's just as you say, boy. The guy you know isn't the real deal. He's a fake."

lines.content: ……とある人間の青年に協力してもらい、十年間ほど、千和の父親として立ち振る舞ってもらっていたんだ
lines.translated: "...I enlisted the help of a certain human young man and had him act as Chiwa's father for about ten years."

lines.content: 少年にここまでの道のりについて簡単に話した――……十年だ。俺は、あの子の成長を遠くから見守り続けてきた。
lines.translated: I briefly told the boy about the path that had led us here--...Ten years. I had continued watching over that girl's growth from afar.

lines.content: ……いつかはあの子の“[憎まれ役|敵]”となるべきこの俺だ。そばで一緒に笑い合えるはずもない。そういった“役割”は、やさしい父親にすべて任せた
lines.translated: "...I am the one destined to eventually become her 'enemy'--the one she must hate. There was no way we could ever laugh together side by side. I left all of those 'roles' to a kind father."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 運動会や文化祭。小学校の卒業式。
lines.translated: Sports days and cultural festivals. Her elementary school graduation ceremony.

lines.content: あの子が活躍する催しや、人生の節目節目には、こっそりとあの子の姿を探しに出かけた。あの子が危険な目に遭わないか、いつも駆けつけられる距離にいた。
lines.translated: For events where she shined, and at every milestone in her life, I secretly went out to look for her. I always stayed close enough to rush over in case she ever ran into danger.

lines.content: 一度、あの子が友人たちと山に入り込み、迷子になることがあった――
lines.translated: Once, she went into the mountains with her friends and got lost--

lines.content: 元気いっぱいの女の子、柊ハルの提案で、町中の“噂話”を検証してみよう。そんな小さな冒険の結果だった。
lines.translated: At the suggestion of an energetic girl named Hiiragi Haru, they had decided to investigate the "rumors" going around town. It was the result of that little adventure.

lines.content: そういったトラブルの、一度や二度、ありはしたけれど……。
lines.translated: There were one or two troubles like that, though...

lines.content: ……無事だ
lines.translated: "...She's safe."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 千和の命はちゃんと無事だ
lines.translated: "Chiwa's life is completely safe."

lines.content: 朝になればあの子は何ら問題なく、いつもと変わらず、ベッドで目を覚ますだろう
lines.translated: "Come morning, she will wake up in her bed without any problems at all, just like always."

lines.content: あの子の命をさくらに捧げる？　この“夜”を延命させる、そのために？　ばかな。くだらん。そんなこと、今さら俺がするはずもない
lines.translated: "Offer her life to the cherry tree? Just to prolong this 'Night'? Don't be ridiculous. How absurd. There's no way I would do something like that at this point."

lines.content: ……じゃあ、どうして
lines.translated: "...Then, why?"

lines.content: 少年は空を見る。
lines.translated: The boy looks up at the sky.

lines.content: ……どうして、さくらは咲いてるんですか。命を源にして咲く花が、ずっと枯れ続けていたあの樹が、花を咲かせているんですか……
lines.translated: "...Why are the cherry blossoms blooming? Why is that tree, whose flowers bloom using life as their source and which had been withered for so long, blossoming now...?"

lines.content: “魔法”だよ。千和の“魔法”だ
lines.translated: "It's 'magic.' Chiwa's 'magic.'"

lines.content: 少年と共に空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Together with the boy, I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: ……十年前
lines.translated: "...Ten years ago."

lines.content: お前たちが“夜の王”と戦い、その果てに得た“魔法”……最後まで使われることのなかった千和の“魔法”を、さくらに還した
lines.translated: "The 'magic' you all obtained at the end of your battle with the 'King of the Night'... I returned Chiwa's 'magic,' which went unused until the very end, to the cherry tree."

lines.content: 人の命は夢である。そして夢とはきらきら光る“魔法”でできてる。さくらはきっと、満開に咲くだろう。
lines.translated: A human life is a dream. And dreams are made of sparkling "magic." Surely, the cherry blossoms will bloom in full glory.

lines.content: ……そもそも千和を“夜”に[さら|攫]ってきたのはそのためだ。あの子の命を取り上げようなど――そのようなことはかけらも考えてはいなかった
lines.translated: "...In the first place, that's why I abducted Chiwa and brought her into the 'Night.' Taking her life--I never even considered such a thing for a fraction of a second."

lines.content: ……でも。あなたは確かに、千和の命をさくらに捧げ“夜”を延命させるのだと俺に断言していた
lines.translated: "...But. You definitely declared to me that you would offer Chiwa's life to the cherry tree to prolong the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……ああ。そうだな
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I suppose I did."

lines.content: すべてはただの、茶番だよ。あいつは、ソルは……いいや。あの子の新しい父親役である“遠矢”青年は、お前のことを認めたと言っていた
lines.translated: "It was all just a farce. That guy, Sol... no. The young man 'Tooya,' who played the role of her new father, said that he acknowledged you."

lines.content: ……遠矢？
lines.translated: "...Tooya?"

lines.content: ああ。十年間、あの子の父親として立ち回ってくれていた哀しい男だ。彼にはこれ以上ないほど感謝している
lines.translated: "Yeah. A sorrowful man who acted as her father for ten years. I couldn't be more grateful to him."

lines.content: 永遠を与えたあの青年は、しかし、“……間に合わなかった”とだけつぶやき、姿を消した。
lines.translated: However, that young man to whom I had granted eternity merely muttered, "...I didn't make it in time," and vanished.

lines.content: そのつぶやきの真意を問おうにも、彼の居場所は掴めなかった。“夜”にいるのか“外”にいるのかもわからない。
lines.translated: Even if I wanted to ask the true meaning behind his muttering, I couldn't grasp his whereabouts. I don't even know whether he's in the "Night" or on the "outside."

lines.content: とにかく、[・|三][・|人][・|の][・|父][・|親]のうちひとりがお前を認めた。
lines.translated: In any case, one of her three fathers acknowledged you.

lines.content: ……だから、今度は俺だ。俺がお前を試すその番だ。そうだろう？
lines.translated: "...So, next is me. It's my turn to test you. Right?"

lines.content: 呆れてしまったためだろうか。
lines.translated: Perhaps because he was dumbfounded.

lines.content: 開いた口がふさがらないといったような顔の少年に、続けて言った――……お前は、言っていたじゃないかと。
lines.translated: To the boy, whose jaw had practically dropped open, I continued--...Didn't you say it yourself?

lines.content: なあ、少年。今夜のことは、アレなんだろう？　いわゆる“娘さんをぼくにください”という、例のアレだとお前は言っていたじゃないか
lines.translated: "Hey, boy. Tonight's business is that, right? You said it yourself, didn't you? That it was the classic 'Please give me your daughter's hand' situation."

lines.content: だから、父親が。……いいや
lines.translated: "That's why her father... No."

lines.content: あの子の父親でいられたらと夢見るばかりの“怪物”が……
lines.translated: "A 'monster' who can only dream of what it would be like if he could be her father..."

lines.content: あの子の選んだ男は、本当に、あの子に相応しい者であるのか否か……。それを試したにすぎない話だ
lines.translated: "Simply tested whether or not the man she chose is truly worthy of her... That's all there is to this story."

lines.content: 今夜の出来事をつまびらかにすれば、どこまでいってもそれだけのこと――
lines.translated: If you lay bare everything that happened tonight, it really boils down to nothing more than that--

lines.content: ……まさにお前たちふたりが乗り越えるべき最初の“[壁|悪役]”としてここにあれれば、俺は、それでよかった。
lines.translated: If I could just stand here as the first "villain"--the first wall--that the two of you must overcome, that was enough for me.

lines.content: だというのに、台無しだ。何もかもが、台無し――まったく
lines.translated: "And yet, it's ruined. Everything is completely ruined--honestly."

lines.content: 今夜のことも。“遠矢”青年のことも。
lines.translated: Both tonight's plan, and the matter with the young man "Tooya."

lines.content: こんなことが上手くいくと思っていた自分自身が情けなくなる。
lines.translated: I feel pathetic for thinking something like this would actually go well.

lines.content: ……結果は？
lines.translated: "...And the result?"

lines.content: 少年が、言う。恐る恐るという具合に。
lines.translated: The boy speaks, sounding somewhat timid.

lines.content: ……俺を試した結果、どうだったんですか？　千和に相応しいと言えますか？
lines.translated: "...What was the result of testing me? Can you say that I'm worthy of Chiwa?"

lines.content: ……それを俺が決めるのか？
lines.translated: "...Am I the one who decides that?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺がダメだと言えば、お前はそこで引き下がるのか？　千和と共に生きていく――その夢を諦めてしまうのか？
lines.translated: "If I say no, are you going to back down right here? Will you give up on your dream of living together with Chiwa?"

lines.content: 娘に相応しいと感じられる男なんてどこにもいないんだよ――……どんな父親もだいたいそんなものだろう？　絶対、嫁になんて出したくないんだ。きっとな
lines.translated: "There isn't a man anywhere in the world who feels worthy of my daughter--...Isn't every father pretty much like that? I definitely don't want to give her away as a bride. Surely."

lines.content: ……なんだか、千和のお父さん。あなたの言ってることはめちゃくちゃですよ
lines.translated: "...Somehow, Chiwa's father... what you're saying is completely unreasonable."

lines.content: 少年は苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: The boy gives a wry smile.

lines.content: ああ。そうだよな。……だからさ、少年。こういうのでは、どうかな
lines.translated: "Yeah. You're right. ...So listen, boy. How about we do it this way?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: これから長いながい人生の中で、お前があの子とどう生きていくのか。その生き方で俺を納得させてみろ。俺はずっと、そばでそれを見ているぞ
lines.translated: "In the long, long life ahead of you, how are you going to live alongside that girl? Convince me with the way you live. I'll always be watching from nearby."

lines.content: ……さあ。もういい。文字通り茶番は終わりだ。……こんな俺を大いに笑え
lines.translated: "...Now then. That's enough. The farce is literally over. ...Go ahead and have a good laugh at me."

lines.content: 心も、身体も、行動さえも――すべてが醜いばかりのこの俺を。
lines.translated: At me, whose heart, body, and even actions--whose everything is nothing but hideous.

lines.content: そろそろ千和も、お前も、幸せになるときだ――……と、本来ならそう言ってやりたい
lines.translated: "'It's about time for both Chiwa and you to find happiness'--...Ordinarily, that's what I'd like to say to you."

lines.content: 本来、なら？
lines.translated: "Ordinarily?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: そのために、ひとつだ。
lines.translated: For that sake, there is one thing.

lines.content: ……もうひとつだけ、残ってる……やるべきことが残ってる
lines.translated: "...There's just one more thing left... something that must be done."

lines.content: 一歩、一歩、ゆっくりと少年へ向かい、歩を進める――表情を硬くする少年に、そう警戒するなよと俺は苦笑いを浮かべ、
lines.translated: Step by step, I slowly walked toward the boy--and as his expression stiffened, I gave a wry smile, telling him not to be so on guard.

lines.content: 千和とお前との出会いは本来、絶対にあり得ないものだった
lines.translated: "The meeting between Chiwa and you was originally something that could never have happened."

lines.content: ……どういう、ことですか？
lines.translated: "...What do you mean?"

lines.content: 未来と過去とがいびつに交差した結果としてお前たち現在はある。それらは言わずもがな、本来なら決して交わることのない時間だった
lines.translated: "Your present exists as a result of the future and the past intersecting in a distorted way. Needless to say, those were times that originally would never have crossed."

lines.content: ……“夜”だ。“夜の国”だとかいう何かがふたりの間に介入してのみ存在し得る出会いであった。
lines.translated: The "Night." It was an encounter that could only exist through the intervention of that something called the "Land of the Night" between the two of them.

lines.content: あり得てはならないものは、時間の流れの中で、次第次第に調整され――消えていく。……いつかお前たちは互いに互いを忘れるだろう
lines.translated: "Things that should never be are gradually, steadily course-corrected within the flow of time--and fade away. ...Someday, the two of you will forget each other."

lines.content: 人は、大人になれば“夜”に関するすべてを忘れゆくイキモノだ。そこで結んだ出会いもまた同様に。
lines.translated: Humans are creatures who forget everything about the "Night" once they grow into adults. And the encounters forged there are no different.

lines.content: ……じゃあ俺は、千和だけでなく、ハルや姫織、智仁のことも……いつか、忘れてしまう？
lines.translated: "...Then, not just Chiwa, but Haru, Himeori, and Tomohito too... Will I forget about them someday?"

lines.content: ……だろうな
lines.translated: "...Probably."

lines.content: だがもし、今口にした者たちを忘れないようなことがあるのであれば、その者たちとの邂逅は“夜”を介することもなく、必然的にあり得たもの、なのだろうな
lines.translated: "However, if by some chance you don't forget the people you just mentioned, it probably means your encounters with them were inevitable, things that could have happened even without the mediation of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ……だけど、千和は違う
lines.translated: "...Still, Chiwa is different."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: あの子だけは、“夜の国”というエラーがなければ、互いに引き合うことは決してなかっただろう。どうあがいたって。産まれた時代があまりに違う。違いすぎている
lines.translated: "With that girl alone, without the error known as the 'Land of the Night,' the two of you would never have been drawn to each other. No matter how hard you struggled. The eras you were born into are far too different. Way too different."

lines.content: 少年は目を細め、『そもそも』と言う。諦観に満ちた表情で。
lines.translated: The boy narrowed his eyes and said, "In the first place," with a look of resignation on his face.

lines.content: ……そもそも俺は、そんな不安を持つ必要はないんです
lines.translated: "...In the first place, there's no need for me to have such anxieties."

lines.content: “代償”を支払った。“魔法”です。再び“夜”に這入るため“魔法”を、千和と命を交換するという“代償”を、想像し……
lines.translated: "I paid the 'price.' It's 'magic.' In order to crawl back into the 'Night,' I imagined 'magic'--the 'price' of exchanging my life for Chiwa's..."

lines.content: ああ、そうだな
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really is."

lines.content: 与えられた絶望的な状況下で、お前がどう決意し、どう行動するのか――それこそを俺は試した。
lines.translated: Under the desperate circumstances given to you, what resolve would you make, and how would you act--that is precisely what I tested.

lines.content: 千和のことをこれから先、未来永劫、任せてしまって良いものかを見極めたいがため。
lines.translated: Because I wanted to ascertain whether it was truly alright to entrust Chiwa to you from here on out, for all eternity.

lines.content: それについては大丈夫だろう
lines.translated: "You don't need to worry about that."

lines.content: え？　大丈夫？
lines.translated: "Huh? It's okay?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: 既に、“魔法”を使ったにもかかわらず“代償”は支払われていない。お前も千和も変わらず無事だ。命は変わらず、互いの胸の内にある
lines.translated: "Even though you already used 'magic,' the 'price' hasn't been paid. Both you and Chiwa are still safe and sound. Your lives remain unchanged, beating inside each of your chests."

lines.content: 少年は自分の両手を開き、じっと見つめていた――……そうだ。いったい、なぜ。少年は無事なのか。
lines.translated: The boy opened both of his hands and stared intently at them--...That's right. Why on earth is the boy unharmed?

lines.content: そんなのは簡単だ。“夜の住人”たるこの俺になら、簡単に察することができる。
lines.translated: That's simple. For someone like me, a "resident of the Night," it's easy to surmise.
I can feel that this boy is never alone, no matter the time.

lines.content: “猫”だ。お前は“夜の魔法使い”を嘯く“猫”に育てられたのだろう？　きっと、そのうちの誰かが、お前の“代償”を……
lines.translated: "It's the 'cat.' You were raised by a 'cat' who boasts of being a 'magician of the Night,' weren't you? Surely, someone among them took on your 'price'..."

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: よそう。
lines.translated: Let's drop it.

lines.content: 部外者が知ったふうに口を出してはいけない。
lines.translated: An outsider shouldn't stick his nose in as if he knows everything.

lines.content: 俺が千和に自分の“役割”について話していないように、少年を想う何者かも、また、何かしらの事情があるのだろうから――……ともあれ、だ。
lines.translated: Just as I haven't told Chiwa about my own "role," whoever cares for this boy surely has their own circumstances as well--...In any case.

lines.content: ……これから、三年間だ
lines.translated: "...Three years, starting now."

lines.content: え？　三年、ですか……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Three years...?"

lines.content: ああ。そうだ。お前も、千和も、無事に外の世界へ還ったあとの――……明日からの三年を、この俺にくれないか
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right. After both you and Chiwa return safely to the outside world--...Won't you give the three years starting tomorrow to me?"

lines.content: 目の前にひらりと舞ったひとひらを、手のひらで受け、言う。
lines.translated: Catching a single petal that fluttered down in front of my eyes in the palm of my hand, I spoke.

lines.content: その三年を、必要充分のさみしさと、必要充分以上の喪失感で、埋めてやる
lines.translated: "I will fill those three years with a necessary and sufficient amount of loneliness, and more than a necessary and sufficient sense of loss."

lines.content: ……ど、どうして。そんなことを
lines.translated: "...W-Why would you do something like that?"

lines.content: わかるだろう、少年
lines.translated: "You understand, don't you, boy?"

lines.content: “夜の国”で何かを得ようと考えるのなら、何事であれ相応の支払いが必要となる。“魔法”であれ、そうでないものであれ
lines.translated: "If you wish to obtain something in the 'Land of the Night,' an appropriate payment is required, no matter what it is. Whether it's 'magic' or not."

lines.content: ……つまり、どういうことですか？
lines.translated: "...In other words, what does that mean?"

lines.content: 明日からの三年間。その時間をすべて“代償”として支払うのなら、お前たちの“出会い”を本物にしてやれるということだ
lines.translated: "Three years starting tomorrow. It means that if you pay all of that time as a 'price,' I can make your 'encounter' genuine."

lines.content: 本物に……
lines.translated: "Genuine..."

lines.content: ……明日の朝日と共にはじまるお前たちの三年間。お前たちは、互いのことをすっかり忘れてしまうだろう……
lines.translated: "...Your three years will begin with tomorrow's morning sun. The two of you will completely forget about each other..."

lines.content: それからは、いつも、いつも、何か大切なものを忘れてしまっている自分自身に苛まれもするだろう。それでも忘れ得ぬさみしさに、眠れぬ夜もあるだろう
lines.translated: "From then on, you will constantly, constantly be tormented by yourself for having forgotten something precious. And yet, there will surely be sleepless nights born from an unforgettable loneliness."

lines.content: そうして鬱々と過ごす三年間は、おそろしく長い、ながい、永遠にも等しい時間であるはずだ。
lines.translated: Those three years spent in such gloom would surely feel terribly long, so very long--a stretch of time equal to eternity.

lines.content: そのようにして過ごす三年という時間。それがお前たちの“代償”だ。そして、その“代償”を支払い終えた頃……
lines.translated: "Three years spent in that manner. That is your 'price.' And by the time you finish paying that 'price'..."

lines.content: お前たちは互いを思い出しはじめる。少しずつ、少しずつ。そして、大切だった人の面影を探し、互いに互いを見つけ出そうともするはずだ
lines.translated: "You two will begin to remember each other. Little by little, bit by bit. And you will surely search for traces of the person who was precious to you, trying to find one another."

lines.content: いいか、少年。記憶が蘇るきっかけは、どのようなものになるかはわからないが……
lines.translated: "Listen well, boy. I don't know what will trigger the return of your memories, however..."

lines.content: お前のことを想う誰かと、相談できるならそうしておくが……、とにかく、三年後だ
lines.translated: "If there is someone who cares for you whom you can consult, you should do so, but... in any case, it will be in three years."

lines.content: ……全力で千和を探し出してくれ。お前が千和を探し出せたとき、千和の記憶もまた完全に戻るだろう
lines.translated: "...Give everything you have to find Chiwa. When you manage to find her, Chiwa's memories will also return completely."

lines.content: そして、その日。
lines.translated: And on that day.

lines.content: ……記憶が戻ったそのときは、どうか、お前があの子のそばにいてやってほしい
lines.translated: "...When her memories return, please, I want you to be right there by that girl's side."

lines.content: ……どうして、三年なんですか？
lines.translated: "...Why three years?"

lines.content: 青春時代の大切な三年間だ。他の誰もが恋をし、未来に希望を描き、瞬く間に過ぎゆく一秒一秒に置いて行かれまいと懸命になる時間。二度と取り戻せない“特別”だ
lines.translated: "They are three precious years of your youth. A time when everyone else falls in love, paints hopes for the future, and tries desperately not to be left behind by each passing second that flies by in the blink of an eye. It is something 'special' that can never be reclaimed."

lines.content: あの子にとって、そしてお前にとって、大切な青春時代の三年間を孤独に捧げることになるんだ
lines.translated: "Both for that girl, and for you, it means dedicating three precious years of your youth to solitude."

lines.content: ……“夢”を勝ち取るための“代償”としては、きっと、充分だろう？
lines.translated: "...As a 'price' to win your 'dream,' it's surely enough, isn't it?"

lines.content: 俺は、少年にではない――見上げたさくらの樹に、そう問いかけている。
lines.translated: I wasn't asking the boy--I was asking the cherry tree I looked up at.

lines.content: 三年間の孤独と永遠の別れ。どちらか選ぶべくもないはずだ
lines.translated: "Three years of solitude or an eternal farewell. There shouldn't even be a need to choose between the two."

lines.content: ……あなたにそうできるほどの権限が、俺たちのあり得なかった出会いを“本物”にするほどの力が、あるのですか？
lines.translated: "...Do you really have the authority to do that, the power to make our impossible encounter 'genuine'?"

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ……お前から“夜”を出入りする権利を奪えたように。それくらいのことはなんとか叶う……だろうと、そう思う
lines.translated: "...Just as I was able to strip you of the right to enter and leave the 'Night.' I think I can manage to grant at least that much... probably."

lines.content: ……さあ、少年。そろそろ時間だ。朝が来る
lines.translated: "...Now, boy. It's almost time. Morning is coming."

lines.content: 仰ぎ見ている“夜”の空。
lines.translated: The sky of the "Night" I looked up at.

lines.content: そこに朝日の気配がにじみはじめている。
lines.translated: The faint signs of the morning sun were beginning to bleed into it.

lines.content: ……これからはじまる三年間。お前の代わりに、俺があの子をどんな危機からも守ると誓う。遠からず、近からず、あの子を見守り続けると、誓う。だから……
lines.translated: "...For the three years that begin now, in your stead, I swear that I will protect that girl from any crisis. Neither too far nor too close, I swear I will continue watching over her. So..."

lines.content: だから安心して孤独に耐えろ。
lines.translated: So endure the solitude with peace of mind.

lines.content: 少年は、苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: The boy gave a wry smile.

lines.content: ……世界に朝がやって来て、俺たちの人生には、少し長めの夜が来る。そんな感じですね
lines.translated: "...Morning comes to the world, and a slightly longer night comes to our lives. It feels something like that, doesn't it?"

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだな。申し訳ないけれど
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right. Though I'm sorry to put you through it."

lines.content: そして俺もまた、少年へと微笑みを返す。
lines.translated: And I, too, returned a smile to the boy.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……俺たち“夜”の住人は、お前たち人間に愛してもらわなければ存在できない――と、思い込みたがるイキモノばかりだ
lines.translated: "...We residents of the 'Night' are all creatures who like to convince ourselves that we cannot exist unless we are loved by you humans."

lines.content: ……お前と“夜”の中で出会えたイキモノたちは、きっと……幸せだっただろうな。そう思えるよ
lines.translated: "...The creatures who were able to meet you within the 'Night' were surely... happy. I truly think so."

lines.content: だから代わりに、もうお前とは出会うことのできないだろうモノたちの、代わりに……礼を言わせてほしかったんだ
lines.translated: "That's why, in their place--in place of the ones who will likely never be able to meet you again... I wanted you to let me say thank you."

lines.content: ……ありがとう。彼女らのことを愛してくれて
lines.translated: "...Thank you. For loving them."

lines.content: きっと、お前を心から大切に思っていただろう“夜”のイキモノたちは、これからもずっといつもお前のそばにいて……
lines.translated: "Surely, the creatures of the 'Night' who cared for you from the bottom of their hearts will continue to stay by your side, always and forever..."

lines.content: いつかお前が苦しいときは、その“今”を乗り越えるため、惜しむことなく、その力を貸してくれるんだろうとそう思う……
lines.translated: "And someday, when you are in pain, in order to help you overcome that 'present,' I think they will unsparingly lend you their strength..."

lines.content: だからもう大丈夫。
lines.translated: So everything is alright now.

lines.content: “夜”がなくてもお前は平気だ。
lines.translated: You'll be fine even without the "Night."

lines.content: 大人の世界へ旅立ってもきっと幸せになれるはず。
lines.translated: Even when you set off into the world of adults, you'll surely be able to find happiness.

lines.content: ……奏大雅。そして、千和
lines.translated: "...Kanade Taiga. And Chiwa."

lines.content: お前たちの未来に、いつも幸せな“魔法”があることを、いつもここから祈ってる。……心から
lines.translated: "I will always be praying from here that there is always happy 'magic' in your future. ...From the bottom of my heart."

lines.content: そうしてその“夜”はまばゆい明日の光に飲まれ、暗闇の幕を静かに下ろした。
lines.translated: And so, that "Night" was swallowed up by the dazzling light of tomorrow, quietly lowering its curtain of darkness.

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はらり……。
lines.translated: Gently...

lines.content: うららかな日差しのその中で、いくつもの春の花が歌い、こぼれる……ある日のことだ。
lines.translated: Amidst the bright, gentle sunlight, countless spring flowers sang and spilled over... It happened on one such day.

lines.content: 俺は、いつもの席でいつものようにその日の新聞を広げ、落ち着かない気持ちをどうにか押さえ込もうと必死になっている。
lines.translated: Sitting in my usual seat, I spread out the day's newspaper just like always, desperately trying to suppress my restless feelings somehow.

lines.content: もみ消すたばこの数も普段の比ではない。
lines.translated: The number of cigarettes I've stubbed out doesn't even compare to usual.

lines.content: 視線は、ちらりちらりと……活字よりも時計にばかり向けられている。
lines.translated: My gaze keeps darting back and forth... directed far more at the clock than at the printed words.

lines.content: 遅いな。いつ帰ってくるのかな。もしかして帰り道で何かあったんじゃ。
lines.translated: She's late. I wonder when she'll come home. Could something have happened on the way back?

lines.content: そわそわそわそわ。……落ち着かない。
lines.translated: Fidgeting, fidgeting. ...I can't calm down.

lines.content: 今日は店も休みにした。
lines.translated: I even closed the shop today.

lines.content: こんな日にまともに働けるはずもない。
lines.translated: There's no way I could work properly on a day like this.

lines.content: そんな俺の様子に、『少しは落ち着けよ。なあ、おい。新聞、逆さまだぞ？』と元人間のあいつは苦笑い……。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, that former human smiled wryly and said, "Calm down a little. Hey, look. Your newspaper is upside down, you know?"

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違うかな。
lines.translated: Maybe that's not quite right.

lines.content: ここには“怪物”なんてひとりもいなくて。
lines.translated: There wasn't a single "monster" here.

lines.content: ただ、この一瞬一瞬にしか生きられない[・|何][・|か]かしか、存在し得なくて……。
lines.translated: There was only something that could exist solely within each passing moment...

lines.content: ……ドアが、開かれた。
lines.translated: The door opened.

lines.content: そして、待ち望んでいた笑顔がそこにはあって。
lines.translated: And the smile I had been waiting for was right there.

lines.content: ただいま。遅くなって、ごめんなさい。[・|こ][・|の][・|子]が途中でぐずっちゃって……
lines.translated: "I'm home. Sorry I'm late. This little one started fussing on the way..."
Starting today, our family had grown by one more.

lines.content: パパ。この子のこと、だっこしてくれる……？
lines.translated: "Papa. Will you hold this little one...?"

lines.content: お、俺が？　いいのか……？
lines.translated: M-Me? Is it really okay...?

lines.content: どうして？　もちろんだよ。……お願い
lines.translated: "Why wouldn't it be? Of course it is. ...Please."

lines.content: あ、ああ……。ああ。
lines.translated: R-Right... Yeah.

lines.content: 震える手をその子に伸ばす。
lines.translated: I reached my trembling hands out toward the child.

lines.content: 暖かい。
lines.translated: It's warm.

lines.content: ……柔らかい。
lines.translated: So soft.

lines.content: そっと抱き寄せたその子はとても……目も、口元も、頬の柔らかさも――
lines.translated: The child I gently pulled close was so very... The eyes, the mouth, the softness of the cheeks--

lines.content: 醜いばかりな俺を見ても、こうして無邪気に笑いかけてくれる……その笑顔も。
lines.translated: And even that smile... smiling so innocently at me despite looking at someone as utterly ugly as I am.

lines.content: 全部。全部だ。愛しいお前にそっくりだった。
lines.translated: Everything. All of it. Looked just like you, my beloved.

lines.content: ……ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 何度も何度も、愛しいと思った。
lines.translated: Over and over again, I thought how precious she was.

lines.content: きっと幸せなんだろうとも、思った。
lines.translated: I also thought that this must surely be happiness.

lines.content: この気持ちを上手い言葉で飾れないことが歯がゆいけれど……。夢だ。これが俺の夢だった。
lines.translated: It's frustrating that I can't dress these feelings up in clever words, but... It's a dream. This was my dream.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|人]が帰ってきたら、四人で一緒に、この子の名前を考えてもらえたらうれしいんだけど……。いいかな
lines.translated: "When he gets back, I'd be happy if the four of us could think of a name for this child together... Would that be okay?"

lines.content: これから四人で、いいや、五人一緒で暮らしていける。そんな未来を全員で思い描けた。
lines.translated: From now on, the four of us--no, the five of us would be able to live together. We could all picture such a future together.

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: これが俺の夢だったんだ。
lines.translated: This was my dream.

lines.content: 俺の夢はすべて余さず、叶えられた。
lines.translated: Every single one of my dreams had been fulfilled completely.

lines.content: ありがとう。……ありがとう神さま。こんなときだけ、俺はあんたに対して笑顔になれるよ。
lines.translated: Thank you. ...Thank you, God. Only at times like this can I bring myself to smile at you.

lines.content: ……そんな夢を、俺は、見ていた。
lines.translated: That was the dream I was having.

lines.content: ――“どうか俺と、結婚してください！”
lines.translated: --"Please, marry me!"

lines.content: あの子が望んでいただろう、そんな声がまたした気がして目を覚ます。
lines.translated: Feeling as though I heard that voice again--the voice that girl must have wished for--I woke up.

lines.content: ……目を覚ます、だけだ。
lines.translated: All I did was wake up.

lines.content: 道ばたにうずくまり、もう、動けない。
lines.translated: Crouching by the side of the road, I can no longer move.

lines.content: 通り過ぎる誰にもこの姿は映らずに――……きっと、このまま俺は朽ちていく。
lines.translated: Without this figure of mine reflecting in the eyes of anyone passing by--...Surely, I will just rot away like this.
Three years.

lines.content: 今日を迎えるその日まで、千和のことをあらゆる出来事から守ってきたつもりだ。
lines.translated: Until the arrival of this very day, I believe I have protected Chiwa from all manner of things.

lines.content: ……あの子のことを忘れた少年の代わりに。
lines.translated: In place of the boy who forgot about her.

lines.content: ……あの子のそばに、いてやれなくなったソルの代わりに。
lines.translated: In place of Sol, who could no longer stay by her side.

lines.content: どんなにこの身体が朽ちていこうとあの子の人生を守り抜く――……それが、[・|俺][・|の]“[・|代][・|償]”なのだと決めていた。
lines.translated: No matter how much this body rots away, I will protect that girl's life to the very end--...I had decided that would be my "price."

lines.content: いったいなんの？
lines.translated: For what on earth, you ask?

lines.content: あの子たちの出会いを“本物”の“縁”とするために“夜”へと願い、俺が支払う“代償”だ。
lines.translated: It is the "price" I pay for wishing upon the "Night" to make those kids' encounter a "genuine" bond of "fate."

lines.content: ……心ない“怪物”たるこの俺の“願い”を、“夜”が聞き入れてくれるか不安ではあった。
lines.translated: I was anxious about whether the "Night" would grant the "wish" of a heartless "monster" like me.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]を信じて生きるしかなかった。
lines.translated: All I could do was believe in it and keep living.

lines.content: 日々、大人へと成長していく千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa, growing into an adult day by day.

lines.content: そんなあの子を、遠からず近からず見守るというだけのことで、“怪物”のこの身体はひび割れ、朽ち始めていく……。
lines.translated: Just by watching over her from neither too far nor too close, this "monster's" body began to crack and rot away...

lines.content: 『……あなたはどうして、たったひとりの子のためにそこまでするの？』
lines.translated: "...Why do you go so far for the sake of just one girl?"

lines.content: ある“夜”、店に招いた子猫がそう言った。
lines.translated: One "Night," a kitten I invited into the shop said that.

lines.content: それは少年の友人だ。あるいは、家族だ。
lines.translated: She is the boy's friend. Or perhaps, his family.

lines.content: 三年後。千和と少年が“代償”を支払い終えた後、ふたりが互いを思い出すための[・|き][・|っ][・|か][・|け]をどうすべきなのか――
lines.translated: Three years later. After Chiwa and the boy finished paying their "price," what should be done about the trigger for the two of them to remember each other--

lines.content: それは俺だけが勝手に決めるわけにはいかないものだと感じた。
lines.translated: I felt that wasn't something I should just decide on my own.

lines.content: だからこの子猫をここに招いた。
lines.translated: That's why I invited this kitten here.

lines.content: 『大雅への[・|き][・|っ][・|か][・|け]はわたしに任せてほしい。……お願い。大雅のバットエンドのすべてはわたしが全部引き受ける。それが、わたしの“役割”だから……』
lines.translated: "I want you to leave the trigger for Taiga to me. ...Please. I will take on all of Taiga's bad ends myself. Because that is my 'role'..."

lines.content: どこかさみしそうに笑い、そう言った後で、子猫は俺へと問いかけたのだ――“あなたはどうして、千和のためにそこまでするの？”
lines.translated: After smiling somewhat lonelily and saying that, the kitten asked me--"Why do you go so far for Chiwa's sake?"

lines.content: そんなのはお互い様だろう。
lines.translated: Surely we're both the same in that regard.

lines.content: 『少年が“夜”へ再び這入るために“想像”した“魔法”――その“代償”をも、お前はその小さな身体で引き受けた』
lines.translated: "The 'magic' the boy 'imagined' in order to crawl back into the 'Night'--you took on the 'price' for that with your own tiny body."

lines.content: 『だからお前は“外”には出れない。もう二度と。……そうだよな』
lines.translated: "Because of that, you can't go 'outside.' Never again. ...Isn't that right?"

lines.content: 『俺もお前と同じだよ。お前が少年のためにそこまでしようとする理由が、俺にもやっぱり、わからない』
lines.translated: "I'm the same as you. Even I still don't understand the reason why you would try to go that far for the boy's sake."
"...Once."

lines.content: 『……一度やさしくされたら、わたしたちは、それでお終い』
lines.translated: "...Once someone shows us kindness, that's the end for us."

lines.content: 子猫は瞼を閉じ、言った。
lines.translated: The kitten closed her eyelids and spoke.

lines.content: 『わたしたちは、わたしたちに一度でもやさしくしてくれたその人のことを、愛しく想わずにはいられない。二度と忘れることなんて、できない。そういうイキモノ』
lines.translated: "We can't help but hold dear the person who showed us kindness even just once. We can never forget them again. That's the kind of creatures we are."

lines.content: 『[・|理][・|由]なんてそれで充分だし、それ以上はどこにもないんだ』
lines.translated: "That alone is more than enough of a reason, and there's nothing else beyond that."

lines.content: 『……だって、やさしい気持ちは、人間の心の中にしかないものだから。わたしたちの心には、ないものだから。わたしたちの心は、いつも、さみしい』
lines.translated: "...Because gentle feelings only exist inside human hearts. They don't exist in ours. Our hearts are always lonely."

lines.content: 『だから少しでも触れていたいの。少しでも、ほんの少しだけでも、いいから……そばにいたいの』
lines.translated: "That's why I want to touch it, even just a little. Even if it's only a little, just a tiny bit... I want to be by his side."

lines.content: それだけ残し、子猫はひとりぼっちで去って行った。
lines.translated: Leaving only those words behind, the kitten walked away all alone.

lines.content: そして三年後の今日。
lines.translated: And today, three years later.

lines.content: 約束の日。卒業式。あの子が子どもから大人へと変わる……最後の春だ。
lines.translated: The promised day. The graduation ceremony. The final spring... when that girl changes from a child into an adult.

lines.content: 安堵した。“夜”は、人ではない“怪物”の“願い”も受け入れてくれたようだった。
lines.translated: I was relieved. It seemed the "Night" had accepted the "wish" of an inhuman "monster" as well.

lines.content: ……あの子猫は上手くやってくれた、ようだった。
lines.translated: And it seemed that kitten had done her job well.

lines.content: 少年は現れた――予定通り千和を忘れ、予定通り、千和を思い出し始めた少年が――……まったく。どこまで[・|忘][・|れ][・|た][・|も][・|の]を探しに行っていたのか。
lines.translated: The boy appeared--the boy who forgot Chiwa as planned, and began to remember Chiwa as planned--...Honestly. Just how far did he go looking for what he had forgotten?

lines.content: 『……走れ、少年。お前の“夢”が、その道の先で待ってるぞ』
lines.translated: "...Run, boy. Your 'dream' is waiting down that road."

lines.content: ……ここまでだ。
lines.translated: This is as far as I go.

lines.content: もう俺の“役割”も終わりかと、そう、思ったけれど……。
lines.translated: I thought my "role" was finally over too, and yet...

lines.content: ……ああ、まったく。どこまでも世話の掛かる少年だ
lines.translated: "...Ah, honestly. He really is a boy who takes no end of trouble to look after."

lines.content: 手を、見る。
lines.translated: I look at my hand.

lines.content: ぼろぼろに、べきべきに崩れてしまった片腕だ。
lines.translated: One of my arms has crumbled away, battered and snapping apart.

lines.content: 不注意で道路に飛び出した少年を突き飛ばし……、車の突進を、防いだ。
lines.translated: I shoved the boy aside when he carelessly dashed out into the street... and blocked the oncoming car.

lines.content: おそらくはもうこの腕が“怪物”めいた回復を見せることはないだろう。
lines.translated: This arm will likely never show that "monster"-like recovery again.

lines.content: この三年。こういうふうにして、何度も、何度となく、ふたりのことを守ってきたつもりだ。
lines.translated: For these past three years. Just like this, time and time again, I believe I have protected the two of them.

lines.content: 故に。俺は、千和に近づきすぎたのだ。
lines.translated: Therefore, I got too close to Chiwa.

lines.content: ……“怪物”の弱点である人間に、接近しすぎたのだ。
lines.translated: I got too close to humans, the weakness of a "monster."

lines.content: 千和を見守り続けた三年間。いや。およそ十三年間かな。
lines.translated: Three years of continuing to watch over Chiwa. No, about thirteen years, I suppose.

lines.content: そして、少年を突き飛ばした瞬間だ。
lines.translated: And then, the moment I shoved the boy out of the way.

lines.content: その瞬間、何か、決定的なものが俺の中で壊れてしまった――……そんな気がしてる。
lines.translated: At that moment, something decisive broke inside of me--...I have that feeling.

lines.content: ため息。
lines.translated: She sighed.

lines.content: そして、苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: And I give a bitter smile.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 眩しいなあ。
lines.translated: How dazzling.

lines.content: ……俺の夢は、叶わなかった
lines.translated: "...My dream didn't come true."

lines.content: ぼろぼろの腕は空っぽだった。
lines.translated: My tattered arms were empty.

lines.content: もうこの指先が温かく、柔らかな、新しい命に触れられることはない。
lines.translated: Never again will these fingertips touch a warm, soft, new life.

lines.content: ……俺は、どうして産まれてきたのかな
lines.translated: "...Why was I even born?"

lines.content: ……いつかそうしたように、ひとり、つぶやいてみる。
lines.translated: Just like I did once before, I murmur to myself, all alone.

lines.content: だけどもう誰も、『意外だな。“怪物”もそんな人間みたいなことを考えるんだな』と声をかけてくれるものはいないけど――……
lines.translated: Though there is no longer anyone left to call out to me and say, "That's surprising. So even a 'monster' thinks about human-like things like that"--...

lines.content: ……なあ、ソル。お前もそばで、見てただろ。俺ひとりじゃ絶対にやり遂げられなかった
lines.translated: "...Hey, Sol. You were watching from right beside me too, weren't you? I never could have pulled this off on my own."

lines.content: ……きっと、お前が力を貸してくれたんだ。
lines.translated: Surely, you lent me your strength.

lines.content: 姿は見えなくとも、声は、聞こえなくとも。お前がいつもそばにいて……
lines.translated: "Even if I couldn't see your figure, even if I couldn't hear your voice. Because you were always by my side..."

lines.content: あの子に幸せになってほしいと願うばかりなこの俺の、あんなにも稚拙なあらすじを、お前がそばで、応援してくれたから……だからこんな俺でも、やり遂げられた。物語を書き切れた
lines.translated: "Because you stayed by my side and cheered on such a clumsy outline written by someone like me, who only wished for that girl to be happy... even someone like me managed to see it through. I managed to finish writing the story."

lines.content: ……なあ、そうだろう？　そうだよな？　俺、ちゃんとやり遂げられたよな、きっと――……だから
lines.translated: "...Hey, isn't that right? It is, isn't it? I managed to see it through properly, right? Surely--...So..."

lines.content: “誰からも愛されることのない人生に、いったいどれほどの価値があるというのか”
lines.translated: "'Just how much value could there possibly be in a life unloved by anyone?'"

lines.content: いつまでも消えないそんな[問い|言葉]に、そろそろ答えがほしいと思ってたんだ。
lines.translated: I was thinking that I'd like an answer soon to those words--that question--which never fade away.

lines.content: 俺はやっぱり、誰からも愛されることはなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "In the end, I was never loved by anyone, but..."

lines.content: それでも、千和。
lines.translated: Even so, Chiwa.

lines.content: 俺は、お前を心から愛することができたよ
lines.translated: "I was able to love you from the bottom of my heart."

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 愛されたいもの達から愛されなかろうと。
lines.translated: Even if I wasn't loved by those I wanted to be loved by.

lines.content: 夢は、叶わなかろうと……。
lines.translated: Even if my dream didn't come true...

lines.content: そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: それでも俺は、お前を愛せた俺の人生に、結構満足できている。
lines.translated: Even so, I am quite satisfied with my life, having been able to love you.

lines.content: あとはあの子が、これからもずっと、ずっと、大切な人と共に笑って、泣いて……生きていってくれたなら……そうなれば、きっと――
lines.translated: "All that's left is if that girl continues to laugh, cry... and live on with her precious person forever and ever from here on out... If that happens, then surely--"

lines.content: なあ、神さま。
lines.translated: Hey, God.

lines.content: 俺みたいな醜い“怪物”を産んだ、あんただよ。教えてくれ。
lines.translated: You, the one who birthed an ugly "monster" like me. Tell me.

lines.content: ――……きっと、こんな俺の命にも、産まれてきた価値くらいはあったよな
lines.translated: "--...Surely, even a life like mine was at least worth being born into, right?"

lines.content: ……頼む。
lines.translated: Please.

lines.content: 誰か。
lines.translated: Someone.

lines.content: 誰かそうだと、言ってくれ……
lines.translated: "Someone, please tell me it was..."

lines.content: 最後くらい人間みたいに泣けたならいいのに。
lines.translated: I wish I could at least cry like a human at the very end.

lines.content: そう思い……。
lines.translated: Thinking that...

lines.content: 崩れゆくこの命を抱き留めるようにして、瞼を閉じた。
lines.translated: As if embracing this crumbling life to hold it in place, I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: ……ひとつ。
lines.translated: A single drop.

lines.content: 千和の頬に涙が流れた。
lines.translated: A tear rolled down Chiwa's cheek.

lines.content: どうしたの……？
lines.translated: "What's wrong...?"

lines.content: そう言い、俺はすぐに後悔した。
lines.translated: As soon as I said that, I regretted it.

lines.content: どうしたも、何も。
lines.translated: How could I ask what was wrong?

lines.content: 今まで長い、長い間、俺はこの子をひとりにしてきた。
lines.translated: For a long, long time until now, I had left this girl all alone.

lines.content: 大切にしなきゃならないはずの子をひとりぼっちにしてしまっていたのだ――どうして自分がこんなにも大切な子のことを忘れてしまっていたのか。
lines.translated: I had left the girl I should have cherished all by herself--why had I forgotten someone so precious to me?

lines.content: その原因さえ思い出せはしないけれど……。
lines.translated: I can't even remember the reason for that, though...

lines.content: とにかく、この子をさみしくさせていた張本人であるこの俺が、“どうしたの”なんて。
lines.translated: Anyway, for me, the very person responsible for making her lonely, to ask "What's wrong?"

lines.content: そんなのは言えようはずもなく……。
lines.translated: There was no way I had any right to say something like that...
"Just now..."

lines.content: 千和が言う。
lines.translated: Chiwa piped up.

lines.content: 不思議なんです。どうしてか今、大切な誰かが、ひとりぼっちで泣いてるような気がして……
lines.translated: "It's strange. For some reason, I feel like someone precious to me is crying all alone right now..."

lines.content: それを知ることができないことが、とても悲しい。
lines.translated: Not being able to know who it is makes me so very sad.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。急にこんなこと。おかしいですよね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Saying something like this all of a sudden. It's strange, isn't it?"

lines.content: ……大きな目からまたひとつ、涙がこぼれた。
lines.translated: Another tear spilled from her large eyes.

lines.content: 千和の涙を見つめながら、俺は、思っている。
lines.translated: Gazing at Chiwa's tears, I lost myself in thought.

lines.content: ――『俺と、結婚してください……っ』
lines.translated: --"Please, marry me...!"

lines.content: 学園の屋上からそう叫んだあと……。
lines.translated: After shouting that from the school rooftop...

lines.content: 不思議だった。
lines.translated: It was strange.

lines.content: 千和のことを次から次へと思い出したのだ。
lines.translated: Memories of Chiwa came flooding back one after another.

lines.content: 屋上から見下ろしたその風景の中。すぐに千和のことを見つけ出し……駆け下りた。
lines.translated: Within the scenery I looked down upon from the roof, I immediately spotted Chiwa... and ran downstairs.

lines.content: 迫る教師や生徒らの間をかいくぐり、その手を――……今までずっと探し続けてきたその小さな手を取り、俺は、俺たちは、駆けだした。
lines.translated: Weaving my way through the approaching teachers and students, I took that hand--...that small hand I had been searching for all this time, and I--we--started running.

lines.content: そして千和の家まで戻ってきた、俺たちだったけれど……。
lines.translated: And though we had made it all the way back to Chiwa's house...

lines.content: ……返事は
lines.translated: "...My answer."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……返事はいつまで、待っていてくれますか？
lines.translated: "...How long will you wait for my answer?"

lines.content: 涙を拭きながら、千和が言う――思い出せない涙のわけを、どこか惜しむようにしながらも。
lines.translated: Wiping away her tears, Chiwa spoke--even while seeming somewhat reluctant to let go of the reason for the tears she couldn't remember.

lines.content: け、結婚って……先輩。私に、言ってくれましたよね？
lines.translated: "M-Marry you... Senpai. You said that to me, didn't you?"

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: あれって……本気、なんですか？
lines.translated: "Was that... Were you serious?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: 本気だ。これ以上ないくらい。
lines.translated: I'm serious. I couldn't be more serious.

lines.content: 三年もそばにいられなかった。……三年だ。いつも、いつも消えないさみしさだけが、胸の中にあって……。心のどこかで、いつも君のことだけ探してた
lines.translated: "I couldn't be by your side for three years. ...Three years. There was only ever a loneliness that wouldn't fade inside my chest... Somewhere in my heart, I was always searching only for you."

lines.content: だから、そんな気持ちが先走ってしまっただけ……だ、なんて。そんなことはない。本気だ。本気で、千和。俺は君と……
lines.translated: "So to say those feelings just got ahead of me... No, it's nothing like that. I'm serious. Truly serious, Chiwa. I want to be with you..."

lines.content: ずっと握ったままの千和の手に力を込めた。
lines.translated: I squeezed Chiwa's hand, which I had been holding tight this whole time.

lines.content: せ、先輩……
lines.translated: "S-Senpai..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: いきなりすぎて……私も、色々、たくさん、忘れたり思い出したり……うれしかったり……でも、どうしてか……悲しかったりもして
lines.translated: "It's all so sudden... I also forgot and remembered so, so many things... I feel happy... and yet, for some reason... I feel sad, too."

lines.content: 今日はもう色々なことがたくさん、たくさんで……
lines.translated: "So many, many things have happened today already..."

lines.content: ……待ってる
lines.translated: "...I'll wait."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: いつまでだって、千和の返事を待ってるよ。もう絶対にどこへも行かない
lines.translated: "I'll wait for your answer for as long as it takes, Chiwa. I will never go anywhere again."

lines.content: もしも君が、俺の気持ちを受け入れてくれなくても……
lines.translated: "Even if you don't accept my feelings..."

lines.content: 君が“はい”と言ってくれるまで、何度だってプロポーズする。千和。俺と結婚してほしい。俺は、君とこれから先の未来を一緒に歩いて行きたいんだ
lines.translated: "I'll propose as many times as it takes until you say 'yes.' Chiwa, I want you to marry me. I want to walk into the future together with you from here on out."

lines.content: ……たとえ誰に“子どもだ”と笑われようと、誰に誹られてしまおうと、この夢が変わることはない。決してない
lines.translated: "...Even if someone laughs at me and calls me a child, even if someone criticizes me, this dream will never change. Never."

lines.content: だから、千和。お願いだ。君には、そんな俺の夢を叶える手伝いをしてほしい
lines.translated: "So, Chiwa. Please. I want you to help make that dream of mine come true."

lines.content: う、ううー
lines.translated: "U-Uuu..."

lines.content: 真っ赤になる。
lines.translated: She turns bright red.

lines.content: 頭が、心が、パンクしそうです……先輩
lines.translated: "My head and my heart feel like they're about to burst... Senpai."

lines.content: 両目をぎゅっと閉じる。
lines.translated: She squeezed both eyes shut.

lines.content: その奥からまた涙がにじみ、そして、こぼれた。
lines.translated: Fresh tears welled up from behind her lids and spilled over.

lines.content: まずは、今日までのことを話そう。色々だ。千和、君に聞いてもらいたいこと。君に、話して聞かせてもらいたいこと……いっぱい、あるんだ
lines.translated: "First, let's talk about everything that's happened up to today. All sorts of things. Chiwa, there are things I want you to hear. And things I want you to tell me... So, so many of them."

lines.content: ……はい
真っ赤な頬ではにかんで、
lines.translated: She gave a shy smile, her cheeks bright red, and said,

lines.content: ……私もです。先輩。私も先輩に……だ、大好きな、先輩に、話したいこと、教えてもらいたいこと、いっぱい、あるんです
lines.translated: "...Me too, Senpai. I also have... so many things I want to tell you, and things I want to learn from you... my beloved Senpai."

lines.content: ……もう一度、今度はふたりきりで卒業式をしよう
lines.translated: "...Let's have a graduation ceremony one more time, just the two of us."

lines.content: そう言って、俺は千和を連れ出した。
lines.translated: Saying that, I took Chiwa outside.

lines.content: ふたりきり。手を繋ぎ、学園へと続く坂道を行く。
lines.translated: Just the two of us. Hand in hand, we walked up the sloped road leading to the academy.

lines.content: 今日で千和は学園を卒業する。人生の節目だ。
lines.translated: Today, Chiwa graduates from the academy. It's a major milestone in her life.

lines.content: 千和はどんな未来を思い描いているのだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder what kind of future Chiwa is envisioning.

lines.content: 何であれ、どうであれ……。
lines.translated: Whatever it may be, however it may go...

lines.content: おそらく、もうこうしてふたりで一緒に、この坂道を歩くことはないのだろう。
lines.translated: Most likely, the two of us will never walk up this hill together like this again.

lines.content: それが少し、さみしいような。
lines.translated: That feels a little lonely.

lines.content: ……それでもやっぱり、よろこばしいような。
lines.translated: And yet, at the same time, it feels joyful.

lines.content: 複雑な気持ちも一緒に連れて歩いて行く。
lines.translated: Carrying those complicated feelings along with us, we kept walking.

lines.content: 坂の途中で千和が立ち止まった。
lines.translated: Halfway up the hill, Chiwa stopped in her tracks.

lines.content: そして、空を見ていた――……はらはらと舞うさくら。ほんの僅かに季節外れのさくらが咲いた、夕暮れの空。
lines.translated: She was looking up at the sky--...at the gently fluttering cherry blossoms. The twilight sky, where just a few out-of-season cherry blossoms were in bloom.

lines.content: 本当なら
lines.translated: "By all rights..."

lines.content: ぽつりと、千和が言う。空を見つめたまま。
lines.translated: Chiwa murmured softly, her gaze still fixed on the sky.

lines.content: 本当なら、今日まで……いっぱい、先輩と一緒にこの道を、この坂の道を歩けたはずなんですよね
lines.translated: "By all rights, up until today... I should have been able to walk this road, this sloped path, with you so many times, Senpai."

lines.content: ……ああ、そうだね
lines.translated: "...Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: だけどそうはならなかった。
lines.translated: Yet that wasn't how it turned out.

lines.content: 互いが互いを探し続けていて尚、不思議とすれ違い続けた三年間だった。
