lines.translated: For three years, even as we kept searching for each other, we somehow kept passing each other by.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: しかし不思議と、そこに悔しさのようなものは感じない――……
lines.translated: Strangely enough, though, I don't feel any frustration over it--...

lines.content: そうでなければならなかったのだという“納得”が、そしてもっと、もっと言い得ぬ“何か”の気持ちが、繋いだ手と手の間にあるような気がして……。
lines.translated: I feel like there is an "acceptance" that things had to be this way, along with an even deeper, indescribable "something," resting right between our joined hands...

lines.content: ……ごめんな
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: 俺は、目を伏せる。
lines.translated: I lowered my gaze.

lines.content: ……何がですか？
lines.translated: "...What is it?"

lines.content: 千和が、首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Chiwa tilted her head.

lines.content: 卒業式
lines.translated: "The graduation ceremony."

lines.content: 俺がめちゃめちゃにぶちこわし……。
lines.translated: I completely ruined it...

lines.content: そしてそのまま千和の手を引き、逃げ出した。
lines.translated: And then I grabbed Chiwa's hand and ran away.

lines.content: 最悪な卒業式の思い出だよな
lines.translated: "It makes for the worst graduation memory, doesn't it?"

lines.content: と、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: ううん。最高の思い出でしたよ。先輩
lines.translated: "No, not at all. It was the best memory, Senpai."

lines.content: と言って、千和は笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Chiwa smiled for me.

lines.content: ……私のことを探して、呼んでくれて。こうして出会えました
lines.translated: "...You searched for me, and you called out to me. That's how we were able to meet like this."

lines.content: こんな特別な今日のこと、忘れたくても忘れられないって思いますもん。絶対。だから最高の思い出なんですよ。最悪でも最低でもありません
lines.translated: "I don't think I could ever forget a day as special as today, even if I tried. Definitely not. That's why it's the best memory. It's not the worst or the most awful at all."

lines.content: 歩き始める。
lines.translated: We started walking again.

lines.content: 学園へと続く坂道だ。
lines.translated: Up the sloped road leading to the academy.

lines.content: 一歩、一歩、ゆっくりと……。
lines.translated: Step by step, slowly...

lines.content: ……私は、何のために産まれてきたんでしょうか
lines.translated: "...What was I born for, I wonder?"

lines.content: 校門前に辿り着いたとき、千和が言った。
lines.translated: When we reached the front of the school gates, Chiwa spoke up.

lines.content: 坂の上。遠い空。太陽が沈んでいくのを振り返り、見つめながら。
lines.translated: At the top of the hill. The distant sky. She looked back, gazing at the setting sun.

lines.content: たぶん……
lines.translated: "Maybe..."

lines.content: 心のどこかで先輩のことを探してた三年間。私はずっと、そんなことばかり考えて過ごしてたような気がします
lines.translated: "During those three years I spent searching for you somewhere in my heart, I feel like that was all I ever thought about."

lines.content: ……いつも、ひとりぼっちの人は。誰もそばにいてくれなくて、さみしいばかりの毎日をすごす人は……いったい
lines.translated: "...People who are always all alone. People who have no one by their side, spending every single day in sheer loneliness... just what..."

lines.content: いったい何のために、産まれてきたんだろう――どこかでそんな言葉を見つけたからだと思います
lines.translated: "Just what were they born for?--I think it's because I stumbled across words like that somewhere."

lines.content: 偶然開いた本の中だったか。何の気なしに付けたテレビの中からだっただろうか。とにかくそんな言葉にいつも心がざわざわしていた。
lines.translated: Was it in a book she happened to open? Or from a TV she turned on without thinking? Whatever the case, those words had always left her heart feeling restless.

lines.content: お父さん。お母さん。……大好きだった。だからふたりにも私を大好きになってほしかった
lines.translated: "Dad. Mom. ...I loved them so much. That's why I wanted the two of them to love me just as much."

lines.content: でも、だめだった。
lines.translated: But it wasn't meant to be.

lines.content: 私が私を愛してほしい人は、いつだって、私のそばにいてくれない――……
lines.translated: "The people I want to love me are never by my side--..."

lines.content: ……そんな気持ちが一日、一日、一秒一秒、大きくなっていくのを、ずっと感じ続けていた三年間だったんじゃないかと思います
lines.translated: "...I think those three years were spent constantly feeling that sentiment grow bigger, day by day, second by second."

lines.content: でも……
でも、先輩は、帰ってきてくれたから……。ちゃんと私を見つけ出してくれたから
lines.translated: "But, Senpai, because you came back to me... Because you properly found me..."

lines.content: 繋いだ手に力が篭もるのを感じていた。
lines.translated: I felt her grip tighten around my hand.

lines.content: ……先輩。先輩だけです
lines.translated: "...Senpai. Only you."

lines.content: 先輩だけが、最後にこうしてそばにいてくれます
lines.translated: "Only you are staying by my side at the very end like this."

lines.content: たとえ一度は忘れてしまっても。
lines.translated: Even if we forgot once before.

lines.content: ……たとえ、長い時間、互いに思い出せなくなったとしても。
lines.translated: Even if, for a long time, we couldn't remember each other.

lines.content: ……先輩は走って、走って、遠い国からでも、飛んで帰ってきてくれました。そして私を探し出してくれました
lines.translated: "...You ran, and ran, and flew all the way back from a distant country for me, Senpai. And you found me."

lines.content: 先輩が、屋上から私に向かって叫んでくれた、そのときは――……やっぱり恥ずかしかったし……、うん。死んじゃいそうなくらい、恥ずかしかったですけれど……
lines.translated: "When you shouted down to me from the rooftop, Senpai--...it really was embarrassing... yeah. I was so embarrassed I thought I might die, though..."

lines.content: でも、どうしようもなくうれしかった。幸せだった――……私の産まれた意味、みたいなものを、その答えみたいなものを、先輩からもらえたような気がしたんです
lines.translated: "Even so, I was overwhelmingly happy. So full of joy--...I felt like you had given me the meaning of my birth, or something like the answer to it."

lines.content: だけど、私……
lines.translated: "However, I..."

lines.content: 夕日が光り、千和は眩しそうに目を細めた。
lines.translated: The evening sun shone brightly, and Chiwa squinted against the glare.

lines.content: 私。まだ何か、大切なことを思い出せていないような。そんな気もしているんです
lines.translated: "I feel like there's still something precious I haven't been able to remember. I have that sort of feeling, too."

lines.content: なんだかとても大切な“さよなら”を、私、忘れてしまっているような気が……してるんです
lines.translated: "For some reason, I feel like... I've forgotten a very precious 'goodbye.'"

lines.content: それは、昨日までちゃんと、覚えていられたはずのものなのに……
lines.translated: "Even though it's something I should have remembered clearly right up until yesterday..."

lines.content: 見つめた夕日。沈み行くその光。
lines.translated: She gazed at the evening sun. At its sinking light.

lines.content: そこに答えはないのだろうかと、そう問いかけるみたいにして、千和は『……私は』とつぶやいた。
lines.translated: As if asking whether the answer lay out there, Chiwa murmured, "...I..."

lines.content: 私は、まだ、何か大切なものを忘れてる。大切な[・|誰][・|か]のことを、忘れてる
lines.translated: "I'm still forgetting something precious. I'm forgetting *someone* precious."

lines.content: その人にいつか絶対、伝えなきゃいけないことがあった、はずなのに……
lines.translated: "Even though there was supposed to be something I absolutely had to tell that person someday..."

lines.content: だけどもう、私はその人のことを絶対に、思い出せることはない――……
lines.translated: "And yet, I will never be able to remember that person ever again--..."

lines.content: そう言う千和は泣いているのか。微笑んでいるのか。その横顔を見るのが少しだけ、躊躇われた。
lines.translated: Was Chiwa crying as she said that? Or was she smiling? I hesitated, just a little, to look at her profile.

lines.content: 俺も、遠い空を見た。
lines.translated: I looked out at the distant sky, too.

lines.content: 沈み行く夕暮れの太陽だ。
lines.translated: At the sun sinking into the twilight.

lines.content: 俺も同じだ、とは、どうしてだか言えなかった。
lines.translated: For some reason, I couldn't bring myself to say that it was the same for me.

lines.content: 俺も、同じなんだよ。
lines.translated: I feel the exact same way.

lines.content: 誰か大切な人を忘れてる。そんな感覚が今も消えず、すぐ隣にあり続けている。
lines.translated: I'm forgetting someone precious. That sensation still hasn't faded, lingering right beside me even now.

lines.content: （千和と再会できればこの気持ちは完全になくなってしまうのだろうと、そう思っていたのに）
lines.translated: (Even though I thought this feeling would completely disappear once I reunited with Chiwa.)

lines.content: 人は、いくつもいくつも“さよなら”ばかりを重ねて生きるイキモノだ。
lines.translated: Humans are creatures who live by piling up one "goodbye" after another.

lines.content: ……千和。杏藤千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa. Andou Chiwa.

lines.content: 俺の大好きな人。
lines.translated: The girl I love so much.

lines.content: そんな君の隣に、俺はいつまでこうして立っていられるだろうか。
lines.translated: How long will I be able to stand beside you like this?

lines.content: “さよなら”は来る。誰の隣にも。誰の未来にも。
lines.translated: "Goodbye" will come. Beside everyone. In everyone's future.

lines.content: どちらが先か。どちらが後か。
lines.translated: Which of us will be first? Which of us will be second?

lines.content: ……どちらが置いて行かれるのだろうか。どちらが置いて、行くのだろうか。
lines.translated: Which of us will be left behind? And which of us will do the leaving?

lines.content: 永遠なんてない世界で生きる俺たちだから……。
lines.translated: Because we live in a world where nothing lasts forever...

lines.content: 千和。卒業おめでとう
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Congratulations on your graduation."

lines.content: いつか“さよなら”がやって来るその日まで。
lines.translated: Until the day that "goodbye" eventually comes.

lines.content: いつかひとりになっても、“さみしさ”に負けない自分になれる……。
lines.translated: Until I can become someone who won't lose to "loneliness," even if I end up alone someday...

lines.content: ……そんな“大人”になれる、その日まで。
lines.translated: Until the day I can become that kind of "adult."

lines.content: できるだけたくさん、たくさん……。
lines.translated: As much as possible, as many times as possible...

lines.content: こんなふうに、人生の大切な瞬間にはいつも君の隣に立っていて。
lines.translated: I want to always stand beside you during the important moments of life, just like this.

lines.content: 君と一緒に、幸せな瞬間をひとつでも多く見つけていきたい――君のこんなかわいい笑顔だけを数えていける。そんな生き方を、選んでいきたい。
lines.translated: I want to find as many happy moments as we can together--counting only these cute smiles of yours. That's the way of life I want to choose.
That is *my new "dream."*

lines.content: ……だけど、だぶん。
lines.translated: Still, probably.

lines.content: 俺たちが、いつか来る“さよなら”に負けないような――……そんな、さみしい気持ちにも負けないくらいの大人になれる日は、まだまだ、ずっと先のことかもしれないけれどね
lines.translated: "The day we can become adults who won't lose to the 'goodbye' that will eventually come--...who won't lose to those lonely feelings, might still be a long, long way off, though."

lines.content: 首をかしげる千和。
lines.translated: Chiwa tilted her head.

lines.content: 振り返る。そして『出てこいよ』と、俺は言う。
lines.translated: I turned around. And then, I called out, "Come on out."

lines.content: まったく。盗み聞きなんて趣味が悪いぞ
lines.translated: "Honestly. Eavesdropping is in bad taste, you know."

lines.content: い、いや～。なんだか出て行くタイミングがわかんなくなっちゃって
lines.translated: "W-Well~. We kinda lost track of the right timing to come out."

lines.content: 校門の向こうから智仁が顔を出す。
lines.translated: Tomohito poked his head out from beyond the school gates.

lines.content: そーだよ。いきなりまじめモードでなんだかお話はじめるんだもん。むしろ空気の読めるひよりちゃんは気を使ってあげてたのに……。なんだかひどい言われよう
lines.translated: "That's right! You suddenly went into serious mode and started having a deep conversation. If anything, Hiyori-chan here was reading the room and being considerate for you... That's a pretty mean way to put it."

lines.content: 続いて姫織も。
lines.translated: Himeori followed right behind him.

lines.content: あ、あはは。このまま黙って帰ったほうが、今日のところはいいのかなって思ったんだけど……。バレちゃってたんだね
lines.translated: "A-Ahaha. I thought it might be better for today if we just quietly went home, but... Looks like you caught us."

lines.content: ハルも続いて顔を出す。
lines.translated: Haru poked her head out next.

lines.content: あ、あ、ああ……っ
途端、真っ赤になってしまう千和――き、聞かれてた。何か恥ずかしいこと言ったはず。絶対。間違いなく。
lines.translated: Instantly, Chiwa turned bright red-- T-They heard us. I definitely must have said something embarrassing. Absolutely. Without a doubt.

lines.content: そんな思いが、小さな彼女の頬を真っ赤に染める。
lines.translated: Those thoughts dyed her small cheeks a deep crimson.

lines.content: きっとさ、ふたりはここに戻ってくるんじゃないかって思ったんだよ。だからハルちゃんとひよちゃんのこと、ここに呼んだんだ
lines.translated: "I figured the two of you would probably come back here. That's why I called Haru-chan and Hiyo-chan out."

lines.content: そう、なのか。なんだか行動がバレちゃってるってのは悔しいような気がするな。少しだけだけど
lines.translated: "Is... that so? Having our movements read like a book feels a little frustrating, though. Just a little bit."

lines.content: いやあ。ずっと一緒に旅してきた相棒の考えることだ。ずっと、一緒に遊んできた親友の考えることだ。これくらい当然なんだ
lines.translated: "Well, come on. It's what my partner, who I traveled with all that time, would think. What my best friend, who I played with all that time, would think. Figuring out this much is only natural."

lines.content: ま、それはそうと――さあ、どうぞどうぞ
lines.translated: "Well, setting that aside--go on, right this way."

lines.content: 姫織が卒業証書をマイクみたいにして差し出す。
lines.translated: Himeori held out her rolled-up diploma like a microphone.

lines.content: いつかみたいに、お返事を
lines.translated: "Let's hear your answer, just like that one time."

lines.content: え？　いつか、みたいに……？　お返事？
lines.translated: "Eh? Just like... that one time...? My answer?"

lines.content: そうそう、そうだよ――俺と結婚してくださいって、そう言われちゃったでしょう？
lines.translated: "Yeah, yeah, that's right--He asked you to marry him, didn't he?"

lines.content: 俺の声真似をする姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori did an impression of my voice.

lines.content: それってなんだか[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]みたい。だからね。千和もあのときみたいにお返事を
lines.translated: "It feels kind of like *back then*. So, Chiwa, give him your answer just like you did back then."

lines.content: あのとき、みたいに……
lines.translated: "Just like... back then..."

lines.content: うん。……ごめんね、千和ちゃん。私たちも思い出せたよ。色々、たくさん
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...I'm sorry, Chiwa-chan. We remembered, too. A whole lot of things."

lines.content: これまでのこと、色々ごめんねとハルは言う。
lines.translated: Haru apologized for everything that had happened up until now.

lines.content: 仲間はずれにする気なんて全然、まったく、なかったのに……。思い返せば自然とそんなふうになっちゃっていて……
lines.translated: "We never, ever meant to leave you out at all, and yet... looking back on it, things just naturally ended up that way..."

lines.content: ううん。先輩たちが悪いわけじゃ……。だから謝らないでください。お願いします
lines.translated: "No. It wasn't your fault, Senpai... So please don't apologize. Please."

lines.content: ……今日からまた、いっぱい、たくさん、仲良くしてもらえたら……それだけで私、うれしいです
lines.translated: "...Starting today, if we can all get along really, really well again... that alone will make me happy."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: もちろんだよと、ハルは言う。どこかさみしそうな顔で微笑みながら。
lines.translated: "Of course," Haru said, smiling with a somewhat wistful look on her face.

lines.content: ……千和ちゃん。あなただったらきっと大丈夫
lines.translated: "...Chiwa-chan. Since it's you, I'm sure everything will be okay."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……大雅くんの“隣”は、あの子じゃないとって、思ってたけど
lines.translated: "...Though I used to think the spot beside Taiga-kun had to belong to *her*."

lines.content: 柊先輩？　それって、どういう……
lines.translated: "Hiiragi-senpai? What do you mean by..."

lines.content: ううん、何でもないよとハルは言い、笑った。
lines.translated: "No, it's nothing," Haru said with a laugh.

lines.content: 今日までのこと、千和ちゃんと話したいことはいっぱいあるけれど。だけどまずは
lines.translated: "There's so much I want to talk to you about regarding everything leading up to today, Chiwa-chan. But first..."

lines.content: うん。まずは大雅からのプロポーズだよ、千和。そのお返事を私たちの前で……今、ここで……どうぞ？
lines.translated: "Yep. First is Taiga's proposal, Chiwa. Why don't you give him your answer in front of us... right here, right now... Go ahead?"

lines.content: い、いや。ちょっと待って
lines.translated: "N-No, hold on a second."

lines.content: ――返事はいつまでも待ってる。
lines.translated: --I'll wait forever for your answer.

lines.content: そう伝えてあるんだ。
lines.translated: That's what I had told her.

lines.content: 千和のタイミングでいいんだよと。
lines.translated: That she could do it whenever she was ready.

lines.content: い、いいえ。いいんです。……先輩。先輩がせっかく勇気を出してくれたのに。私に、気持ちを伝えてくれたのに
lines.translated: "N-No, it's okay. ...Senpai. You went through all the trouble of mustering your courage for me. You told me how you felt."

lines.content: それなのに、私が先送りになんてしてたらだめです。そんなの、私に意地悪だった先輩みたいで……やっぱり、だめです
lines.translated: "After all that, it wouldn't be right for me to put it off. That would make me just like you when you were being mean to me... So I really can't do that."

lines.content: 悪戯っぽく笑ってみせる千和だった。
lines.translated: Chiwa gave me a mischievous smile.

lines.content: う、あ、ああ
lines.translated: "U-Uh, yeah."

lines.content: 先輩。奏先輩……。私の気持ち。私の、返事。聞いてもらえますか？
lines.translated: "Senpai. Kanade-senpai... My feelings. My... answer. Will you listen to it?"

lines.content: 何も言わず、ただうなずく。
lines.translated: Saying nothing, I simply nodded.

lines.content: そんな俺を前にして、千和は少し長めに深呼吸――……
lines.translated: Standing before me, Chiwa took a slightly long, deep breath--...

lines.content: そして、俺を静かに見上げると、
lines.translated: And then, looking up at me quietly,

lines.content: ……好きです
lines.translated: "...I like you."

lines.content: ぽつりと、言った。
lines.translated: she spoke softly.

lines.content: ……先輩
lines.translated: "...Senpai."

lines.content: ……大雅、さん
lines.translated: "...Taiga-san."

lines.content: ……ずっと、ずっと、あなたのことが大好きでした
lines.translated: "...I have loved you for so, so long."

lines.content: お願いです。……お願い、します
lines.translated: "Please. ...Please."

lines.content: ……どうか私を、あなたのお嫁さんに、してください
lines.translated: "...Please make me your wife."

lines.content: ワッと。
lines.translated: Woohoo!

lines.content: 三人分の歓声が、上がった。
lines.translated: A cheer went up from the three of them.

lines.content: ――杏藤千和の命は孤独になりやすいようできている。
lines.translated: --Andou Chiwa's life is made to easily fall into solitude.

lines.content: 誰かの声が、ふと蘇った。
lines.translated: Someone's voice suddenly echoed in my mind.

lines.content: ……これまではどうだったかわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know how things were up until now.

lines.content: 確かにそうだったのかもしれないし、それはただの偶然以上の何ものでもないのかも、しれない。
lines.translated: Maybe that really was true, or maybe it was nothing more than mere coincidence.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: もしもまた、俺たちの間に、目に見えない何かが働いて……。
lines.translated: Even if something unseen were to work between us once again...

lines.content: いつかまた悲しい出来事があり、俺たちを離ればなれにするような“何か”が起こる――
lines.translated: Even if something sad happens someday, and "something" occurs to tear us apart--

lines.content: そんな未来が俺たちを待ち受けているのだとしても。
lines.translated: Even if a future like that is waiting for us.

lines.content: だけど。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: ……それでも。
lines.translated: Even so.

lines.content: 俺たちは歩き出さなければ。
lines.translated: We have to start walking forward.

lines.content: ふたりで、一緒に。
lines.translated: The two of us, together.

lines.content: ――この世界はいっぱいのおとぎ話でできている。
lines.translated: --This world is made of countless fairy tales.

lines.content: 明日からはふたり一緒の物語を書いていこう。
lines.translated: Starting tomorrow, let's write our story together.

lines.content: おとぎ話のその後みたいに、幸せなことばかりを数えていける――そんな物語を。
lines.translated: A story where we can count only the happy things, just like the "happily ever after" of a fairy tale.

lines.content: ハッピーエンドがいつまでも続いていくみたいに、もう決してひとりぼっちにはなれない――そんな、おとぎ話を。
lines.translated: A fairy tale where we can never become all alone again, as if our happy ending will go on forever.

lines.content: ……さあ。帰ろうか
lines.translated: "...Come on. Shall we head home?"

lines.content: 俺が手を差し伸べる。
lines.translated: I held out my hand.

lines.content: ……はい。帰りましょう
lines.translated: "...Yes. Let's go home."

lines.content: 君が手を、取ってくれる。
lines.translated: You took my hand.

lines.content: ここに、この瞬間に。
lines.translated: Right here, in this moment.

lines.content: ……繋ぎ直したばかりの手と手の中に。
lines.translated: Within our newly reconnected hands.

lines.content: いつか思い描いた“[未来|夢]”があるのだと、俺たちは、信じた。
lines.translated: We believed that the "future"--the dream we had once envisioned--was right there.

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: ……はらり。
lines.translated: Flutter.

lines.content: 今年もまたさくら舞う季節がやって来た。
lines.translated: The season of fluttering cherry blossoms has come again this year.

lines.content: ベッドから起き上がるのに、もうこの頃はすっかり時間が掛かるようになってしまった。
lines.translated: Lately, it has started taking me quite a long time just to get up out of bed.

lines.content: 枕元に置いた付けっぱなしのラジオから声がする。
lines.translated: A voice comes from the radio left on beside my pillow.

lines.content: 遠い、とおい、何万光年も遠い宇宙の先に、この星と良く似た環境の惑星が発見された。お金持ちや偉い政治家、特別な地位の有識者たちから先に移住の計画が立ち上がってる。
lines.translated: Far, far away, tens of thousands of light-years across the universe, a planet with an environment very similar to our own was discovered. Plans for migration are already underway, starting with the wealthy, important politicians, and experts of special status.

lines.content: 彼らはなぜこの星を離れようと諸手を上げるのか。
lines.translated: Why are they all so eager to leave this planet behind?

lines.content: それは年々、月と地球との距離が――……。
lines.translated: Because year by year, the distance between the moon and the Earth is--...

lines.content: そんな夢みたいな話をこの頃はよく耳にする。
lines.translated: Lately, I often hear dreamlike stories like that.

lines.content: 案外と[過去|少女時代]より、[未来|大人の世界]のほうが、現実的な夢にも希望にも溢れているのかもしれません。
lines.translated: Surprisingly, the future--the world of adults--might be much more full of realistic dreams and hopes than the past of my girlhood ever was.

lines.content: 私は、大人になってもいつまでも小さくて、いつまでも、細い。そんな身体の節々を丁寧にさすり、暖めて――……。ようやく私は身体を起こす。
lines.translated: Even after growing up, I remained forever small, forever frail. I carefully rub the joints of this body of mine, warming them up--... Finally, I raise myself up.

lines.content: ……きれい
lines.translated: "...It's beautiful."

lines.content: 窓の外には満開のさくら。
lines.translated: Outside the window, the cherry blossoms are in full bloom.

lines.content: あと何度、この季節を迎えられるだろう。あなたと暖かな陽の光を仰いでいられるだろう。
lines.translated: How many more times will I be able to welcome this season? How many more times will I be able to look up at the warm sunlight with you?

lines.content: あれから……
lines.translated: "Since then..."

lines.content: あれからたくさん、たくさんの時が過ぎていきました。
lines.translated: So, so much time has passed since then.

lines.content: 私たちのお話は。
lines.translated: Our story.

lines.content: 私たちふたりで綴った物語は。
lines.translated: The tale the two of us wove together.

lines.content: あの人と私の、おとぎ話は……。
lines.translated: His and my fairy tale...

lines.content: たくさん、たくさんの幸せと笑顔を見つけていける。そんなお話になれたように感じています。
lines.translated: I feel like it was able to become the kind of story where we could find so much happiness and so many smiles.

lines.content: 学園を卒業した年にカフェを再開させました。あの人とふたりで、これからもこの町で暮らしていくことを決めました。
lines.translated: The year I graduated from the academy, we reopened the cafe. The two of us decided to keep living in this town together from then on.

lines.content: 私が注文を受け付けて、あの人が厨房で美味しいコーヒーや軽食を作ってくれる。
lines.translated: I would take the orders, and he would make delicious coffee and light meals in the kitchen.

lines.content: 夜には親しい人たちと集まってお話ししたり、お店の壁をスクリーン代わりに映画を観たり、穏やかな音楽を聴きながらお夕飯をみんなで食べる。
lines.translated: At night, we would gather with close friends to chat, watch movies using the cafe wall as a screen, and eat dinner together while listening to gentle music.

lines.content: ここがそんな居場所にはならないかと、あの人と一緒に考えました。
lines.translated: Together with him, I thought about how wonderful it would be if we could make this place that kind of home for everyone.

lines.content: ……最初のうちは色々と大変でした。
lines.translated: In the beginning, a lot of things were difficult.

lines.content: 美味しいコーヒーを煎れられたからといって、ふたり一緒に考えた自慢のメニューを用意できたからといって、それだけでお店が立ちゆくことはない。
lines.translated: Just because you can brew delicious coffee, and just because you've prepared a proud menu that the two of you came up with together, doesn't mean a shop will stay afloat on that alone.

lines.content: 大変なことは次々に押し寄せます。思ってもみなかった現実に打ちのめされては、その度に落ち込んで……。
lines.translated: Hardships came one after another. We would be beaten down by realities we had never even imagined, getting discouraged every single time...

lines.content: ふたりで何度も励まし合いました。
lines.translated: The two of us encouraged each other over and over again.

lines.content: たくさんの人たちの想いや力を借りて、この小さな喫茶店を、たくさんの笑顔の集まる場所にできたように思います――……まるで、
lines.translated: Borrowing the feelings and strength of so many people, I think we managed to turn this little coffee shop into a place where countless smiles could gather--... Almost as if...

lines.content: ……まるで、二人三脚みたいな人生でした
lines.translated: "...Almost as if our life was a three-legged race."

lines.content: 小さな私と、大きなあなた――
lines.translated: Little me, and big you--

lines.content: 歩幅はきっと、ちぐはぐで……。
lines.translated: Our strides were surely mismatched...

lines.content: それでもゆっくり、ゆっくり、私たちのペースで歩んで行けた人生でした。
lines.translated: Even so, it was a life where we could walk slowly, ever so slowly, at our own pace.

lines.content: ……でも、生きることって、どうしてこんなに簡単じゃないのかな。どうして……こんなに、思い通りにならないのかな
lines.translated: "...Still, why is living not so simple? Why... do things never go the way we want them to?"

lines.content: あの人とふたり、一緒に生きていける場所を見つけていきたい。いつまでも手と手を繋いで、笑い合って、時どき喧嘩もしたりして……。それが、私の夢でした。
lines.translated: I wanted to find a place where the two of us could live together. Holding hands forever, laughing with each other, and sometimes getting into little fights... That was my dream.

lines.content: たくさんの大変さを乗り越えて、その夢は叶えられたけれど……。
lines.translated: We overcame so many hardships and made that dream come true, and yet...

lines.content: ……ひとつ、悲しいことを乗り越えられても。また、ひとつ。次の悲しいことがやって来る。この世界はそういう場所です
lines.translated: "...Even when you manage to overcome one sad thing, another one comes along. And then the next. That is the kind of place this world is."

lines.content: 私たちの新しい夢は子どもを授かることでした。あの人の子ならそれだけできっとかわいい。そう、思ったんです。
lines.translated: Our new dream was to be blessed with a child. I thought that if it was his child, they would surely be adorable based on that alone.

lines.content: でも……。長い間、随分と長い間、その夢が叶えられることはありませんでした。
lines.translated: However... for a long time, a very long time, that dream never came true.

lines.content: ……それはたぶん、いつまでも小さいままな私のせい
lines.translated: "...That is probably my fault, for staying so small forever."

lines.content: 私の身体はあんまりにも小さくて……。
lines.translated: My body was far too small...

lines.content: 私ひとりぶんの命しか納められないようにできていたんだと思います。
lines.translated: I think it was made so that it could only hold enough life for myself alone.

lines.content: 無理矢理にでも子どもを授かろうとすれば、私の身体は出産に耐えられないだろうとのことでした。
lines.translated: I was told that if I tried to force myself to have a child, my body likely wouldn't be able to withstand childbirth.

lines.content: 大好きなあの人ともっと一緒に、ふたり、一緒に……。これからもずっと生きていくことを選ぶなら、私はその子を私は見放さないと、いけなくて……。
lines.translated: If I chose to keep living from here on out, spending more and more time together with the person I loved so much... I would have to give up on that child...

lines.content: 『――気にしないで』
lines.translated: "--Don't worry about it."

lines.content: 私の大好きなあの人は笑ってくれました。
lines.translated: The person I loved so much smiled for me.

lines.content: 『君のことがあんまりに大切すぎるから、今まで子どものことなんて考えもしなかったんだよ』
lines.translated: "You're far too precious to me, so I haven't even thought about having kids until now."

lines.content: 病院からの帰り道。
lines.translated: On the way home from the hospital.

lines.content: 泣きべそをかく私と手を繋いで歩き……。
lines.translated: Walking hand in hand with me while I fought back tears...

lines.content: あの人は“気にしないで”と、“君と一緒にいられればそれで充分。充分以上に幸せだから”と。
lines.translated: He told me, "Don't worry about it," and, "Just being able to be with you is enough. I'm more than happy enough with that."

lines.content: 自分が責められることも厭わないような言葉を選び、やさしく嘘をついてくれたけど……。
lines.translated: He chose words that showed he didn't mind taking the blame upon himself, telling me a gentle lie...

lines.content: そんなあの人だからこそ……。
lines.translated: And precisely because he was that kind of person...

lines.content: ……私はやっぱり、大好きなあの人との子どもがほしくて
lines.translated: "...Even so, I really wanted to have a child with the person I loved so much."

lines.content: きっとなんとかなるからって、あの人のことを一杯いっぱい、困らせて……あの子を産むことにしたんです
lines.translated: "Telling him that it would surely work out somehow, I caused him so, so much trouble... and decided to give birth to that child."

lines.content: 小さな私が小さな命をこの世に迎えるのには、出産だけではなく、色々なことが本当に大変でした。
lines.translated: For tiny me to welcome a tiny life into this world, it wasn't just the childbirth itself--so many different things were truly difficult.

lines.content: だけどあの子をはじめて抱きしめられたときは、うれしかった。幸せだった。
lines.translated: Even so, when I was able to hold that child in my arms for the very first time, I was glad. I was happy.

lines.content: どんなに苦しい思いをしても、この子だけは無事に、この世界へ送り出してあげたかったから。
lines.translated: Because no matter how much pain I had to endure, I just wanted to send this child safely out into the world.

lines.content: ……でも。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: ……でも、やっぱり、無理なものはむりでした
lines.translated: "...However, in the end, what was impossible was still impossible."

lines.content: 赤ちゃんは平均よりずっと小さかったけれど、無事に産まれてきてくれた……。でも。代わりに、私の小さな身体は、そろそろ……
lines.translated: "The baby was much smaller than average, yet they were born safely... However, in exchange, my tiny body is just about..."

lines.content: ……“さよなら”が、近い。
lines.translated: "Goodbye" is drawing near.

lines.content: 大切な人たちとのお別れがもうお近いのだと感じてしまいます。
lines.translated: I can feel that the time to part from the people precious to me is already close at hand.

lines.content: だから……
そんな私だから。
lines.translated: And because I am in this state...

lines.content: 私は、こうして[・|あ][・|な][・|た]のことを思い出せたし、
lines.translated: I was able to remember you like this,

lines.content: こうしてまた、あなたの姿を見つめることができるんですね
lines.translated: "And like this, I am able to gaze at your figure once again."

lines.content: ベッドの横にあなたがいてくれた。
lines.translated: You were right there beside my bed.

lines.content: すっかり弱く、小さくなった私のことを、じっと静かに見守っていてくれた。
lines.translated: Quietly, steadily watching over me, now that I had grown so completely weak and small.

lines.content: パパ……。
lines.translated: Papa...

lines.content: 小さかったあの頃みたいに、私はあなたのことを呼んでみた。
lines.translated: Just like I did back when I was little, I tried calling out to you.

lines.content: ねえ、パパ。私を、迎えに来てくれたの？
lines.translated: "Hey, Papa. Did you come to take me away?"

lines.content: だけどあなたは何も答えず、ゆっくりと目を瞬かせた。
lines.translated: However, you didn't answer, only blinking your eyes slowly.

lines.content: ……あなたは、ぼろぼろだった。
lines.translated: You were in tatters.

lines.content: あんなに大きかった身体は随分と小さく見えた。
lines.translated: Your body, which had once been so big, looked quite small now.

lines.content: 古い木の幹にコケやツタが絡みつくみたいに、たくさんの緑があなたの身体を包み込んでいて……。
lines.translated: Like moss and ivy tangling around the trunk of an old tree, an abundance of greenery wrapped around your body...

lines.content: 片方の腕は朽ちて落ち、残った腕も、弱った木の枝みたいにひび割れて……。
lines.translated: One of your arms had rotted away and fallen off, and your remaining arm was cracked like the branch of a weakened tree...

lines.content: いったいどれだけ長い間、[・|そ][・|う][・|し][・|て]くれていたのだろう。
lines.translated: Just how long have you been doing that for me?

lines.content: ……私ね、パパ。あなたにどうしても、伝えたいことがあったんだよ
lines.translated: "...You know, Papa. There was something I wanted to tell you, no matter what."

lines.content: だけどごめんね。
lines.translated: But I'm sorry.

lines.content: いつの間にか大人になってしまった私は、日々の忙しさに色々なものが飲み込まれ……。
lines.translated: Having grown into an adult before I knew it, I let so many things get swallowed up by the busyness of everyday life...

lines.content: ごめんなさい。あなたのことを、あなたにどうしても伝えたかったことを、今日まで全部忘れてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. Until today, I had completely forgotten about you, and about what I had wanted so badly to tell you.

lines.content: それを、子どもの頃だけの[不思議|“夜”]の影響だからとか、[・|何][・|か]のせいにはしたくないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't want to blame it on the lingering effects of the "Night"--that wonder from my childhood--or on anything else, though...

lines.content: でもね。最期に[・|そ][・|れ]を思い出せて、よかった。本当に
lines.translated: "But you know... I'm glad I was able to remember it at the very end. Truly."

lines.content: 私は、微笑む。
lines.translated: I smile.

lines.content: ずっと言葉にしたかった[・|そ][・|の][・|気][・|持][・|ち]を、ようやく口にすることができるから。
lines.translated: Because I can finally put into words those feelings I had wanted to voice for so long.

lines.content: ありがとう。パパ。いつもそばにいてくれて……ありがとう
lines.translated: "Thank you, Papa. For always being by my side... thank you."

lines.content: ずっと、ずっと、私のことを見守ってくれていたのは……
lines.translated: "The one who was watching over me all this time, forever and always..."

lines.content: いつも……本当に、心から、私を応援してくれていたのは……助けて、くれていたのは。いつだって、あなただったんだよね
lines.translated: "The one who always... truly, from the bottom of his heart, cheered me on... and helped me out. That was always you, wasn't it?"

lines.content: あなたは、目を細める。
lines.translated: You narrow your eyes.

lines.content: すると、瞳の奥の星空がきらりと光ったように見えて……。
lines.translated: As you do, the starry sky deep within your eyes seems to twinkle brightly...

lines.content: あのね、パパ……
lines.translated: "Say, Papa..."

lines.content: 私、小さな頃……あなた達と出会うまでは、ずっとさみしいばかり、だったけど
lines.translated: "When I was little... until I met all of you, I was nothing but lonely all the time."

lines.content: これまでも、大変なことの少なくない人生だったように、思うけど……
lines.translated: "And looking back, I feel like my life up to now has had no shortage of hardships, either..."

lines.content: でもね。ありがとうパパ。あなたのおかげで……本当に、幸せだったよ
lines.translated: "Even so. Thank you, Papa. Thanks to you... I was truly happy."

lines.content: だって……。
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: だって私には、やさしいパパがふたりもいてくれたし……
lines.translated: "Because I had two kind Papas by my side..."

lines.content: それに。
lines.translated: And besides.

lines.content: それにね……
lines.translated: "And besides..."

lines.content: ここから先を口にすべきかどうか。
lines.translated: Whether or not I should say what comes next.

lines.content: 幼い頃はずっとずっと、迷っていた。
lines.translated: Back when I was little, I hesitated over it forever and ever.
I noticed right away that something was strange.

lines.content: でも、言えなかった。どうしても。
lines.translated: Yet I couldn't say it. No matter what.
Because this was...

lines.content: きっとやさしいあなたが私のために、私だけのために、いっぱい、いっぱい、考えてくれたことなんだろうと思うから……。
lines.translated: Surely something that you, in all your kindness, thought through so, so hard for my sake, and for my sake alone...

lines.content: それでも、わからないふりなんて、知らないふりなんて、もうできなくて。
lines.translated: Even so, I can no longer pretend not to understand, or pretend not to know.

lines.content: パパ……
lines.translated: "Papa..."

lines.content: 私は、あなたに心から“ありがとう”を伝えたいから……。
lines.translated: Because I want to tell you "thank you" from the bottom of my heart...

lines.content: だから、お願い。
lines.translated: So please.

lines.content: 聞いてほしいよ。
lines.translated: I want you to listen.

lines.content: 私には、やさしいふたりのパパと……もうひとり、[・|お][・|父][・|さ][・|ん]がいてくれたんだもん。だから今日までずっと、さみしくなかった。いっぱい、いっぱい、幸せだったよ
lines.translated: "I had two kind Papas... and one more Father, too. That's why, right up until today, I was never lonely. I was so, so happy."

lines.content: 勇気を出してそう伝え――私は、微笑む。微笑めていたと思う。
lines.translated: Gathering my courage, I tell him that--and I smile. I think I managed to smile.

lines.content: するとあなたはそこで目を閉じた。
lines.translated: And with that, you closed your eyes.

lines.content: それでもひとつ、ふたつ、[まぶた|瞼]の奥から小さな光りがこぼれているように、見えた。
lines.translated: Even so, it looked as though one, then two tiny lights were spilling out from behind your eyelids.

lines.content: ……ちわ
lines.translated: "...Chiwa."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: おまえを、むかえに……きた……
lines.translated: "I didn't... come here..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……わけじゃあ、ない、よ
lines.translated: "...to take you away, you know."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: おまえに、つたえたいことは……おれにも、たく、さん……あるけれど……
lines.translated: "There are... so many things... I want to tell you, too, though..."

lines.content: でも、この通りだ。
lines.translated: However, as you can see.

lines.content: もうろくに話せもしないほど……。
lines.translated: To the point where I can barely even speak anymore...

lines.content: どうがんばっても、今度こそはここから一歩も動けそうにないほど、ぼろぼろになってしまった俺だから……。
lines.translated: Because I've become so battered and worn out that no matter how hard I try, I don't think I can take a single step from this spot this time...

lines.content: ちわ……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: だけど最期に、せめてこれだけは伝えたい。
lines.translated: Still, at the very end, I want to tell you at least this much.

lines.content: ……はなたばだ
lines.translated: "...It's a bouquet."
"Huh? Flowers...?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: おまえの、みらいに……
lines.translated: "For your... future..."

lines.content: あなたは、私の頬にそっと触れ、
lines.translated: You gently touched my cheek,

lines.content: いっぱいの、はなたばを、つれて……きたんだよ
lines.translated: "I brought... a whole bunch of bouquets... with me."

lines.content: ふと、やさしく……誰よりもやさしく、微笑んでくれた。
lines.translated: And suddenly, gently... more gently than anyone else, you smiled for me.

lines.content: ちわ……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: いとしい、いとしい、おれたちのちわ
lines.translated: "Our beloved, beloved Chiwa."

lines.content: おまえの、これからの……みらい
lines.translated: "Your future... from here on out."

lines.content: いつでも、なんどでも……
lines.translated: "Always, as many times as it takes..."

lines.content: えがおが……しあわせが……なんどだって、あるように……いのってる
lines.translated: "I'm praying... that there will be smiles... and happiness... over and over again."

lines.content: こころから、ずっとだ
lines.translated: "From the bottom of my heart, forever."

lines.content: ……そうしてあなたの微笑みが、いっぱいの花に包まれて。
lines.translated: And just like that, your smile was enveloped in a sea of flowers.

lines.content: 私は、それから短い夢を見た――……ように思う。
lines.translated: After that, I think--... I had a short dream.

lines.content: 卒業式の後。
lines.translated: After the graduation ceremony.

lines.content: お祝いのケーキを買ってくるからと家から飛び出していった先輩だけど、しばらくしてどこも売り切れだったよと、しょんぼりして帰ってきたけれど……。
lines.translated: Senpai had rushed out of the house saying he would go buy a celebratory cake, only to come back dejectedly a while later saying they were sold out everywhere, and yet...

lines.content: ひとりでに開いた冷蔵庫の中に、美味しそうなショートケーキのホールがひとつあったり。
lines.translated: The fridge door would swing open on its own, revealing a whole, delicious-looking strawberry shortcake sitting inside.

lines.content: 喫茶店を再会させた開店日。
lines.translated: Or on the grand reopening day of our cafe.

lines.content: 何週間も前からチラシを配ったりしてがんばったけど、お客さんはひとりも来てくれなくて……。
lines.translated: We'd worked so hard handing out flyers for weeks beforehand, yet not a single customer showed up...

lines.content: お客さんが殆ど来ないまま終わろうとしていた初日。
lines.translated: That first day was just about to end with almost no one having come by.

lines.content: 閉店ぎりぎりになって……ひとり、ふたり、お客さんがやって来てくれた。瞬く間に満席となり、私たちはちょっと慌てた。
lines.translated: Then, right before closing time... customers started trickling in, one by one. Every seat filled up in the blink of an eye, leaving the two of us in a bit of a fluster.

lines.content: その誰もが手に小さな花を持っていて……。
lines.translated: Every single one of them was holding a small flower in their hand...

lines.content: 何でも、お店の前に落ちていたそれをふと拾い上げると……。
lines.translated: Apparently, they had noticed the flowers lying on the ground in front of the shop, and when they stopped to pick them up...

lines.content: そこで美味しそうな香りに気づいて、お店に寄っていこうかなと思ったんだよと、お客さんの誰もが不思議そうにそう言っていたり……。
lines.translated: They caught a whiff of something delicious and decided to drop in--or so every customer told us, looking thoroughly mystified...

lines.content: ふたりでお金を貯めて、なんとか開けた結婚式。
lines.translated: Or at our wedding, which we finally managed to hold after saving up money together.

lines.content: 先輩と一緒に選んだドレスが、業者の発注ミスとかで当日までにどうしても届かないと、式の前日に突然電話が掛かってきて……。
lines.translated: Right on the day before the ceremony, we got a sudden phone call saying the dress Senpai and I had picked out together wouldn't make it in time due to an ordering mix-up by the vendor...

lines.content: だったら久しぶりに学生服を着てみるのもありかもね。そんなふうに苦笑いを浮かべる私たちだったけど……。
lines.translated: We shared a wry smile, joking that we might as well just wear our old school uniforms for the first time in ages, and yet...

lines.content: 当日。予約していた小さなちいさな式場の着替えの部屋に、どうしても届かないと言われていたドレスが置かれていたり……。
lines.translated: On the day of the wedding, sitting in the dressing room of the tiny little venue we'd booked, was the very dress they said could never be delivered in time...

lines.content: いつも……。
lines.translated: Always...

lines.content: いつもだ。
lines.translated: Always.

lines.content: 大変なとき、もうだめかなと思ったときには、必ず誰かがそばで力を貸してくれているように感じてた。
lines.translated: Whenever times were tough, whenever I felt like we were at our wit's end, it always felt like someone was right there beside us, lending a helping hand.

lines.content: だから、これからどんなに大変なことが起こっても、私たちは絶対に大丈夫。
lines.translated: That's why, no matter what hardships come our way from here on out, we'll definitely be okay.

lines.content: 大切な誰かの想いや応援がそばにあるから、乗り越えられないものはきっとない。全部乗り越えていけるはず。
lines.translated: Because the love and support of someone precious is right beside us, there's surely nothing we can't overcome. We can get through anything.

lines.content: ……そうだよね。
lines.translated: Right?

lines.content: [・|誰][・|も]がきっと、そうだよね。
lines.translated: That's surely true for *everyone*, isn't it?

lines.content: 目には見えなくても。声は、届かなくても。
lines.translated: Even if you can't see them. Even if their voice can't reach you.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た]のことを誰より一番、大切に想う誰かが、いつもあなたのそばにいて……。
lines.translated: Someone who cares about *you* more than anyone else is always right there by your side...

lines.content: あなたがとてもつらいとき。悲しいとき。どうしてもさみしくて、眠れない夜にでも。
lines.translated: When you're in terrible pain. When you're sad. Even on nights when you're so unbearably lonely that you can't sleep.

lines.content: あなたのことを想う誰かは、いつもあなたと一緒に悲しんだり、笑ったり、さみしいあなたと手を繋いでくれていたりして。
lines.translated: That someone who cares about you is always grieving with you, laughing with you, and holding your hand when you're lonely.

lines.content: ……あなたを暗い夜の底から、まばゆい風景の中へと、手を引いていってくれるはず。
lines.translated: Surely, they will take you by the hand and lead you out from the depths of the dark night into a dazzling landscape.

lines.content: そうだよね。パパ……。
lines.translated: Right, Papa...?

lines.content: あなたの姿は見えなくても。あなたの声は、聞こえなくても。私には、ずっとあなたがそばにいてくれた。
lines.translated: Even if I couldn't see your face. Even if I couldn't hear your voice. You were always right there beside me.

lines.content: ねえ、パパ。
lines.translated: Hey, Papa.

lines.content: そうだよね？
lines.translated: That's right, isn't it?

lines.content: これからもきっと、そうだよね？
lines.translated: And it'll surely stay that way from now on, too, right?

lines.content: 私を見守っていて、くれるよね？
lines.translated: You'll keep watching over me, won't you?

lines.content: だから……
私は、遠ざかっていくあなたの背中に手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: I reach my hand out toward your back as you walk further and further away.

lines.content: だから、お願い。……行かないで
lines.translated: "So please. ...Don't go."

lines.content: 千和
lines.translated: Chiwa

lines.content: あなたは振り返りもせず、言った。
lines.translated: Without even looking back, you spoke.

lines.content: お前に呪いを掛けてやる
lines.translated: "I'm going to place a curse on you."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……愚かで、醜い……。ただの“怪物”な俺から。最後に、お前へ
lines.translated: "...A final parting gift to you from me... a foolish, hideous... mere 'monster.'"

lines.content: この花を受け取ったお前は、もう絶対に……。どうがんばってもあがいても、もう絶対、ひとりぼっちには……、不幸にはなれないぞ
lines.translated: "Now that you've accepted these flowers, you will never... No matter how hard you try or struggle, you will never end up all alone... or unhappy ever again."

lines.content: だから覚悟して、幸せに生きろ。……いいな？
lines.translated: "So brace yourself, and live a happy life. ...Got it?"

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: はらり……。
lines.translated: Gently...

lines.content: いっぱいの春の花の中。
lines.translated: Amidst a sea of spring flowers.

lines.content: 薄ぼんやりと、ひとりぼっちで遠ざかっていくあなたの背中……。
lines.translated: Your back grows faint and hazy, walking away all alone into the distance...

lines.content: ああ、そうか。
lines.translated: Oh, I see.

lines.content: もうひとつ、思い出せたよ。
lines.translated: There's one more thing I remembered.

lines.content: 私が先輩を、大雅さんを好きになったのはね……。
lines.translated: The reason I fell in love with Senpai, with Taiga-san, was...

lines.content: いつもさみしそうにしていたあなたの背中と、その横顔と、見えない涙で泣いてるようなきれいな瞳とを、心のどこかで重ねていたから……。
lines.translated: Because somewhere in my heart, I saw you in him--your ever-lonely back, your profile, and those beautiful eyes that looked as though they were crying invisible tears...

lines.content: そう気づいたから。
lines.translated: Because I realized that.

lines.content: そう、思い出せたから……。
lines.translated: Because I was able to remember...

lines.content: 私は、あなたの背中へ伸ばした手を下ろし――……静かに、ゆっくりと、あなたとの夢から覚めたのだった。
lines.translated: I lowered the hand I had reached out toward your back--...and quietly, slowly, awoke from my dream with you.

lines.content: 病院からタクシーを使い急いで帰った。
lines.translated: I took a taxi from the hospital and hurried home.

lines.content: 昨晩、子どもが熱を出した。
lines.translated: Last night, our child came down with a fever.

lines.content: まだ一歳にも満たない小さな子。
lines.translated: A tiny little thing, not even a year old yet.

lines.content: これくらいの子はちょっとした熱でも大事になってしまうのだと、つい最近、色々と子どもに関して教えてくれるお客さんが言っていた。
lines.translated: Just recently, a customer who often gives us parenting advice mentioned that even a slight fever can turn into a big deal for a child this young.

lines.content: ただの風邪だと診察はされたが、念のため一晩だけ入院することになり……。
lines.translated: The doctor diagnosed it as a simple cold, but decided to keep the baby overnight just to be safe...

lines.content: たった一晩だけだが家を留守にしないといけなかった。
lines.translated: It was only for a single night, but I had no choice except to leave the house unattended.

lines.content: 不安だった。
lines.translated: She was anxious.

lines.content: 千和……。
lines.translated: Chiwa...

lines.content: [この子|赤ん坊]を産んでから千和はみるみる細く、小さくなっていき……。
lines.translated: Ever since giving birth to this baby, Chiwa had been growing thinner and smaller before my very eyes...

lines.content: この頃は開け放した自室の窓から、外をぼんやりと見つめる時間が多くなっていっているように見える。
lines.translated: Lately, it feels like she's been spending more and more time gazing absentmindedly out the open window of her room.

lines.content: それは、その横顔は、まるでそろそろ“さよなら”が近いように、思えてしまい……。
lines.translated: That sight, that profile of hers, makes it feel as though the time to say "goodbye" is drawing near...

lines.content: 唇を噛む。
lines.translated: I bite my lip.

lines.content: 千和……。君のことが大切だからと、無理はしないでと、あれほど言ったのに。
lines.translated: Chiwa... Even though I told you so many times not to push yourself, because you're too precious to me.

lines.content: そんな言葉はたとえ殺されてしまおうと口にはできない。ましてやこの子を抱いているときだ。本当は考えることだってしてはいけなかった。
lines.translated: I could never speak those words aloud, even if it killed me. Especially not while holding this child in my arms. Truthfully, I shouldn't even be allowing myself to think them.

lines.content: 言葉は伝わらなくとも、心は伝わる。子どもとはそういうものだと思おうから。
lines.translated: Even if they can't understand words, they can understand what's in your heart. I'd like to believe that's how children are.

lines.content: 大事に抱いて帰ったこの子は、熱も引き、静かに眠っていてくれるけど……。
lines.translated: The fever has broken, and the baby I carried home so carefully is sleeping peacefully in my arms, yet...

lines.content: 嫌な予感が、していた。
lines.translated: I had a bad feeling.

lines.content: だから急いで帰ってきたのだ。
lines.translated: That's why I rushed back home.

lines.content: どんどんと弱っていく千和。ついには自分の足で歩くことさえ困難になり……。一日の大半をベッドの上で過ごしてた。
lines.translated: Chiwa was growing weaker and weaker. Eventually, it became difficult for her to even walk on her own two feet... and she spent most of the day in bed.

lines.content: 入院生活は身体より心に負担が大きくなる。
lines.translated: Being hospitalized takes a heavier toll on the mind than on the body.

lines.content: だから自宅療養に切り替えたばかりで……。しかしそれは医者からの“最期の時間をできるだけふたり一緒に”という、見えない配慮であったように思えてならない。
lines.translated: That's why we had just switched to home care... Yet I couldn't shake the feeling that this was an unspoken gesture of consideration from the doctor, a way of saying, "Spend your final moments together as much as you can."

lines.content: だから、これからは片時も離れることなく千和のそばにいるからと約束をした。
lines.translated: So I promised her that from now on, I would stay by her side and never leave her for even a moment.

lines.content: ベッドに横になったまま、千和は儚く見える微笑みでうなずいてくれたけれど……。
lines.translated: Lying in bed, Chiwa had given me a fleeting, fragile smile and nodded, yet...

lines.content: 一晩。
lines.translated: One night.

lines.content: どうしてもしかたがなかったとはいえ、約束を破ってしまった。千和が病院から家に戻ってきてから、こんなに長い時間、千和をひとりにしたことはなかった。
lines.translated: Even though it couldn't be helped, I had broken my promise. Ever since Chiwa returned home from the hospital, I had never left her alone for such a long stretch of time.

lines.content: 赤ん坊を専用の小さな寝床に寝かしつけるのももどかしく……。
lines.translated: Too impatient to even lay the baby down in the little crib...

lines.content: お、お願いだよ。泣かないで……
lines.translated: "P-Please. Don't cry..."

lines.content: さっきまで大人しく眠っていたはずなのに、急にぐずりはじめ、ついには大きな声で泣き始めてしまう。
lines.translated: Despite sleeping so soundly just moments ago, the baby suddenly started fussing, and before long, burst into loud wails.

lines.content: お腹が空いたのか。それともおしめの交換だろうか。
lines.translated: Hungry, maybe? Or does the diaper need changing?

lines.content: ごめんな。それでもまずは千和の様子を確認したい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, little one. Even so, I need to check on Chiwa first.

lines.content: 赤ん坊を抱いたまま部屋の扉を開いた……。
lines.translated: Still holding the baby in my arms, I opened the door to her room...

lines.content: ……驚いた。
lines.translated: I was surprised.

lines.content: これって、いったい……なにが
lines.translated: "What in the world... is this?"

lines.content: まず、ひとつ。
lines.translated: First, one.

lines.content: 千和の部屋がたくさん、たくさんの花でいっぱいにあふれていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa's room was overflowing with flowers--so, so many flowers.

lines.content: 床も。壁も。天井も。
lines.translated: Across the floor. The walls. Even the ceiling.

lines.content: 色とりどりの花たちに飾られ……。
lines.translated: Adorned with blossoms of every color...

lines.content: まるで暖かな季節そのものが、この部屋を駆け足で通り過ぎていったあとみたいに、春の花がはらはらと舞っていた。
lines.translated: Spring petals were fluttering gently through the air, as if the warm season itself had just dashed right through this room.

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: 千和。寝てなくて大丈夫なのか？
lines.translated: "Chiwa. Should you really be up right now?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 千和が起き上がり、ベッドに腰掛けていた。
lines.translated: Chiwa had sat up and was perched on the edge of the bed.

lines.content: 心なしか顔色がいい。昨晩、子どもを連れて病院に行ってくるからと伝えたとき、その頬は青白く、冷たかったのに。
lines.translated: Maybe it was just my imagination, but the color had returned to her face. When I told her I was taking the baby to the hospital last night, her cheeks had been so pale and cold.

lines.content: もう、大丈夫みたい
lines.translated: "I think I'm okay now."

lines.content: 千和はぼんやりとうなずいて、
lines.translated: Chiwa nodded vaguely.

lines.content: なんだか、夢を見ていた気がして
lines.translated: "I feel like I was having a dream."
"Your dream...?"

lines.content: その夢の中で、とても大切な誰かが……、私に、とても大切なものを交換してくれた。そんな気がして
lines.translated: "And in that dream, someone very precious to me... traded something very precious with me. That's what it felt like."

lines.content: ……だからもう、平気だよ。全部大丈夫。そう、思えるの
lines.translated: "...So I'm fine now. Everything is going to be okay. I can really feel it."

lines.content: ぽつり、ぽつりと言いながら、ベッドのそばに置かれた椅子をじっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: Speaking in a quiet, halting voice, she stared fixedly at the chair placed beside her bed.

lines.content: 千和が、いつまでも泣き止まない子を俺から受け取り、抱っこする。
lines.translated: Chiwa reached out, took our inconsolably crying child from my arms, and held the baby close.

lines.content: すると、さっきまで手の付けられないほど泣いていた子が、少しずつ静かになって……ついには、笑った。
lines.translated: As soon as she did, the baby, who had been crying uncontrollably just seconds ago, gradually quieted down... and finally smiled.

lines.content: そして、誰もいないはずの椅子だ――……そこへ向かい、小さな手を伸ばしにこにこと、笑っている。
lines.translated: Then, toward the chair where no one should have been sitting--...the baby reached out a tiny hand, beaming with a bright, happy smile.

lines.content: 俺は[まぶた|瞼]をこする。
lines.translated: I rub my eyelids.

lines.content: 伸ばした赤ん坊の手に誰かが触れた。その一瞬を、俺は確かに見た気がしたのだ。
lines.translated: Someone had touched the baby's outstretched hand. For a split second, I was certain I'd seen it.

lines.content: 風が吹いた。
lines.translated: The wind blew.

lines.content: 部屋の花が……。
lines.translated: The flowers in the room...

lines.content: たくさんの花束が、開け放された窓から吹き込んできた突然の風に、舞い上がり……。
lines.translated: Countless bouquets were swept up into the air by a sudden gust of wind blowing in through the open window...

lines.content: そんな光景に、なぜだか俺は、
lines.translated: Watching that scene, for some reason, I...

lines.content: 俺は……最後に、誰かの夢が叶ったのだろうか。
lines.translated: I found myself wondering... if someone's wish had finally come true at the very end.

lines.content: ふとそんなことを思う自分がここにいた。
lines.translated: That sudden thought crossed my mind as I stood there.

lines.content: ……いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: どうして自分がそんなことを思ったのか……。
lines.translated: Why I would think something like that...

lines.content: 理由はないけれど。
lines.translated: I had no reason for it.

lines.content: 充分な理屈もまた、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I couldn't really explain the logic behind it, either...

lines.content: どうしてか、柄にもなくそんなことを思いたいと感じていた。
lines.translated: Yet for some reason, uncharacteristic as it was for me, I found myself wanting to believe it.

lines.content: ……よし
lines.translated: "...Alright."

lines.content: 千和が深呼吸をし、ベッドから力強く立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Chiwa took a deep breath and rose firmly from the bed.

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: だめだよ、もっと寝ていないとと慌てる俺に、千和は、ううん、大丈夫、本当にもう平気なんだよと首を振る。そして、赤みの差した頬を緩める。
lines.translated: When I panicked and told her she shouldn't, that she needed to rest more, Chiwa shook her head, insisting she was really, truly fine now. Then, her rosy cheeks softened into a smile.

lines.content: なんだかじっとなんてしていられなくって……お願い
lines.translated: "I just can't seem to sit still right now... Please?"

lines.content: ……わかった。でも、無理はしないで。いい？
lines.translated: "...Okay. Just don't push yourself, alright?"

lines.content: うん。ありがとう……。無理はしない。約束するよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Thank you... I won't push myself. I promise."

lines.content: ふたりで赤ん坊を寝かしつけ……。
lines.translated: Together, the two of us put the baby to sleep...

lines.content: 久しぶりに、お店の制服に着替えた千和の手を引き、今日も変わらずオープンさせたお店にふたりで立った。
lines.translated: Taking Chiwa's hand--now dressed in her shop uniform for the first time in a long while--we stood together in the shop we had opened up just like any other day.

lines.content: 春の暖かな日差しを仰ぎ、目を細める千和だ。少し足下をふらりとさせる。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked up into the warm spring sunlight and squinted. Her footing wavered slightly.

lines.content: その身体を支えようと、俺は慌てて千和と手を繋ぐ。
lines.translated: Trying to support her, I hurriedly took her hand.

lines.content: え、えへへ。ちょっとだけふらっとしちゃった
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe. I got a little dizzy there."

lines.content: ずっとベッドの中だったから
lines.translated: "That's because you've been in bed this whole time."

lines.content: うん……。そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah... You're right."

lines.content: 千和は微笑む。
lines.translated: Chiwa smiled.

lines.content: ずっと寝てばかりだったから。だから、急に動いて、身体がちょっと驚いちゃったのかも
lines.translated: "Since all I've been doing is sleeping, my body was probably just a little surprised when I started moving all of a sudden."

lines.content: 千和……
lines.translated: "Chiwa..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……心配、したんだ
lines.translated: "...I was worried."

lines.content: 視線を落とし、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Dropping my gaze, I spoke.

lines.content: すごく、すごく、心配したんだよ。千和。もう……。もう、だめなんじゃないかって
lines.translated: "I was so, so worried, Chiwa. I thought... I thought I might really lose you."

lines.content: 最後の弱気を残らず全部吐き出すみたいに、俺はぽつりと零した。
lines.translated: The words spilled quietly from my lips, as if I were pouring out every last drop of the weakness left inside me.

lines.content: そんな俺に、千和は言う。
lines.translated: Hearing that, Chiwa replied.

lines.content: ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: これまでたくさん、心配掛けてごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry for making you worry so much until now."

lines.content: いいや、そんな……
lines.translated: "No, don't apologize..."

lines.content: でもね、約束する。もう何もかも大丈夫。ほんとに、ほんとだよ
lines.translated: "But I promise you. Everything is fine now. Really, truly."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 不思議だけど、自分でも少し信じられないけれど、私ね、これから少しずつ……、昔よりもずっと元気になれるんじゃないかって、そんな気もしてるんだよ
lines.translated: "It's strange, and even I have a hard time believing it, but... I have a feeling that little by little, I'm going to become much healthier than I ever was before."

lines.content: 赤ちゃんだってもうひとり産めるんじゃないかって思えるくらい――そんなことを笑顔で言って、繋いだ手にほんの僅かな力を込めてくれた。
lines.translated: So healthy she felt like she could even have another baby--she said with a smile, giving our joined hands the faintest squeeze.

lines.content: ……開店時間がもう近い。常連さんたちがひとりふたりと集まってくる。
lines.translated: It was almost opening time. Our regulars began gathering by ones and twos.

lines.content: 制服姿の千和を見て、驚いたり、もう大丈夫なのかと心配してくれたり、中には驚いたことに、元気な千和を見て泣いて喜んでくれる人までいてくれた。
lines.translated: Seeing Chiwa in her uniform, some were surprised, while others worriedly asked if she was really okay now. Amazingly, a few even cried tears of joy at seeing her well again.

lines.content: そんな人たちを今日も変わらず招き入れ、
lines.translated: Welcoming those people in just as we always did,

lines.content: 次は、どんなことが待ってるのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder what's waiting for us next."

lines.content: 春に色づく静かな空を千和は見上げ、そう言った。
lines.translated: Chiwa looked up at the quiet sky, tinged with the colors of spring, as she spoke.

lines.content: ひとつ、悲しかったり大変なことだったりを乗り越えても、また次の何かが待っている。ここは、そんなふうにして進む時間の中なんだろうと思うけど……でも
lines.translated: "Even when we overcome something sad or difficult, there's always something else waiting ahead. I think that's just the kind of flow of time we're living in here... But..."

lines.content: でも？
lines.translated: "But?"

lines.content: うん。でもきっと、きっとね。何があっても大丈夫だよね
lines.translated: "Yeah. But I'm sure--no, I know that no matter what happens, we'll be okay."

lines.content: あなたと一緒に……、これからも一緒に、この命を大切に、大切に、生きていたい
lines.translated: "With you... from here on out, I want to live alongside you, cherishing this life with everything I have."

lines.content: ――この新しい“夢”を私たちが叶えていけるよう、私たちのことを誰より想ってくれてるひと達が、いつもそばで見守り、応援してくれているはずだから。
lines.translated: --Because the people who care about us more than anyone are surely always right beside us, watching over us and cheering us on so that we can make this new "dream" come true.

lines.content: だからきっと、何事もない“今”が幸せ。そうだよね？
lines.translated: "So I'm sure this peaceful 'now' is true happiness. Right?"

lines.content: どちらともなくそう言って、俺たちは笑う。
lines.translated: Without knowing which of us said it first, we both laughed.

lines.content: そんなふうにして、こういうふうにして。
lines.translated: Just like that, and just like this.

lines.content: これからもずっとこの町で、ふたり一緒に生きていこう。
lines.translated: Let's keep living together in this town forever.

lines.content: そう願い、そう祈り。
lines.translated: Wishing for it, praying for it.

lines.content: 今日も俺たちは手と手を繋ぎ、ゆっくり、ゆっくりと、歩幅の合わない二人三脚みたいに歩いて行こうと……笑顔で、誓った。
lines.translated: Today once again, we joined hands and vowed with a smile... to walk forward slowly, ever so slowly, like we were running a three-legged race with mismatched strides.

lines.content: 朝食の席だ。
lines.translated: We were at the breakfast table.

lines.content: 俺はぼんやりと[・|昨][・|日][・|の][・|出][・|来][・|事]について思っている。
lines.translated: Absentmindedly, I was thinking about what happened yesterday.

lines.content: 『大雅はまだあそこに……。“夜の国”の中に出入りできるんだよね？　私たちと違って』
lines.translated: "Taiga, you can still go there... in and out of the 'Land of Night,' right? Unlike us."

lines.content: 姫織がぽつりとこぼした言葉が、なぜだか気にかかっていた。
lines.translated: The words Himeori had quietly murmured were weighing on my mind for some reason.

lines.content: 『さよなら大雅。……今夜、“夜で会えたらすてきだね”』
lines.translated: "Goodbye, Taiga. ...'Wouldn't it be wonderful if we could meet in the night' tonight?"

lines.content: そのとき浮かべた姫織の表情は、どこか意味深なふうにも取れたから……。
lines.translated: Because the expression on Himeori's face back then had seemed somewhat meaningful...

lines.content: だめだぞ大雅
lines.translated: "None of that, Taiga."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: あさひさんの声に、ぼんやりした靄みたいな心の中から引き戻された。
lines.translated: Asahi-san's voice pulled me back from the hazy fog inside my mind.

lines.content: だ、だめ……？
lines.translated: "N-None of what...?"

lines.content: ああ。我が家のルールを忘れちゃだめだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. You mustn't forget our house rules."

lines.content: あさひさんは俺のお茶碗にほかほかのご飯をよそいでくれながら、言う。
lines.translated: Asahi-san spoke while scooping steaming hot rice into my bowl.

lines.content: 手は洗ったか？　まだだろ？　あまり小うるさく言いたくはないけれど……あと、うがいもしっかり忘れずに
lines.translated: "Did you wash your hands? Not yet, right? I don't want to nag too much, though... And don't forget to gargle properly, either."

lines.content: おはようとただいまのあとは手洗いうがい。それが我が家のルールだ。
lines.translated: Wash your hands and gargle after saying "good morning" and "I'm home." That was the rule in our house.

lines.content: それまでちゃんと待っててあげるからと、そう言われ……。
lines.translated: She told me she'd wait until I was done...

lines.content: あ、ああ。ごめんなさい。ちょっとぼんやりしてて……。忘れてました
lines.translated: "Ah, right. I'm sorry. I was spacing out a bit... I forgot."

lines.content: 急いで洗面所で手を洗う。
lines.translated: I hurried to the washroom to wash my hands.

lines.content: 言われた通りうがいすることも忘れずに。
lines.translated: Making sure not to forget to gargle, just as I was told.

lines.content: ……小さな身体の十夜が風邪をひいたりしたら大変だから。
lines.translated: After all, it would be awful if someone as small as Toya caught a cold.

lines.content: しかしそんな十夜は元気がなかった。
lines.translated: However, Toya herself was looking downhearted.

lines.content: 昨日、一緒に歩いた夕暮れ時の帰り道から、十夜はずっと言葉少なにうつむいてしまっている。
lines.translated: Ever since our walk home together at dusk yesterday, Toya had been quiet, keeping her eyes cast down.

lines.content: テーブルに戻った。
lines.translated: I returned to the table.

lines.content: 三人一緒に“いただきます”と、手を合わせる。
lines.translated: The three of us put our hands together and said, "Thank you for the food."

lines.content: あさひさんの隣でちまちまとご飯を食べている十夜。
lines.translated: Toya sat next to Asahi-san, picking at her food in tiny bites.

lines.content: やっぱり元気がなかった。
lines.translated: She really didn't have any energy.

lines.content: （お友だち、か……）
lines.translated: (Her friend, huh...)

lines.content: 十夜に起きたのだろう、昨日の出来事について思い出している。
lines.translated: I thought back to what had apparently happened to Toya yesterday.

lines.content: まだまだお友だちと“さよなら”をしたさみしさが拭い切れていない。そんな雰囲気。
lines.translated: She still hadn't been able to shake off the loneliness of saying "goodbye" to her friend. That was the impression she gave off.

lines.content: たった一晩では、たった一日程度では、それもまた無理からぬ話だろうけど……。
lines.translated: Though after only a single night, a single day, that was completely understandable...

lines.content: ねえ、大雅
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga."

lines.content: 十夜がぽつりと言った。箸先を咥えた口元をもにょもにょとさせながら。
lines.translated: Toya murmured quietly, her mouth mumbling around the tips of her chopsticks.

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: と、俺は応える。
lines.translated: Hearing her, I answered.

lines.content: なにかな、十夜
lines.translated: "What is it, Toya?"

lines.content: あまり慎重になりすぎず。
lines.translated: Not being overly cautious.

lines.content: だからといって、あまり素っ気なくもならないように……気を付けて。
lines.translated: Yet being careful not to sound too dismissive, either...

lines.content: ……さよなら
lines.translated: "...Goodbye."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 昨日のこと、ずっとね、考えていたんだけど……
lines.translated: "I've been thinking about yesterday this whole time, and..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: [・|ま][・|た]さよならも言えなかったのが……さみしいよ。大雅
lines.translated: "Not being able to say goodbye again... makes me lonely, Taiga."
"The new friend I made. ...The girl who suddenly couldn't see me anymore yesterday."

lines.content: 姫織ちゃんたちのときもいきなりだった。いきなり、突然、私たちのことを見てくれなくなっちゃった。だから今度はちゃんと、お友だちにさよならを言いたかったのに……
lines.translated: "It was so sudden with Himeori-chan and the others, too. Out of nowhere, all of a sudden, they couldn't see us anymore. That's why this time, I wanted to say a proper goodbye to my friend..."

lines.content: ちゃんとさよならを伝えたかった。
lines.translated: She had wanted to say a proper goodbye.

lines.content: そしてちゃんと、これまでありがとうと言いたかった。
lines.translated: And she had wanted to properly thank her for everything up until now.

lines.content: 十夜はそう言い、ほんの少しの涙を見せた。
lines.translated: Saying that, Toya shed just a few tiny tears.

lines.content: えっと……今日は私もお昼、ご一緒してもいいですか？
lines.translated: "Um... May I join you for lunch today, too?"

lines.content: お昼休み。昼食の時間。
lines.translated: Lunch break. Time to eat.

lines.content: チャイムが鳴るのとほぼ同時、俺たちの教室に千和がやって来た。
lines.translated: Almost at the exact moment the bell rang, Chiwa came to our classroom.

lines.content: もちろん。一緒に食べよう
lines.translated: "Of course. Let's eat together."

lines.content: 俺がうなずき、
lines.translated: I nodded, and...

lines.content: 空いてる机、適当に使ってもいいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "We can just pull over an empty desk and use it, right?"

lines.content: 智仁もそう言って、立ち上がる。
lines.translated: Tomohito said, standing up.

lines.content: 姫織と千和とハル。そして智仁と俺。
lines.translated: Himeori, Chiwa, and Haru. Along with Tomohito and me.

lines.content: 幼馴染みでグループを作り、それぞれ持ち寄ったお弁当の蓋を開いた。
lines.translated: Forming a group of childhood friends, we each opened the lids of the lunches we'd brought.

lines.content: ふわー
lines.translated: "Whoa..."

lines.content: すごい。自分のお弁当に思わず目を見張ってしまう。
lines.translated: Amazing. I couldn't help but stare wide-eyed at my own bento.

lines.content: （小さなハンバーグが、三つ。卵焼きでカニカマを巻いたもの、タコの形にカットされたウインナーがひとつ、ふたつ……コロッケまで）
lines.translated: (Three mini hamburger steaks. Crab sticks rolled in sweet omelet, one, two octopus-shaped wieners... and even a croquette.)

lines.content: この歳でタコさんウインナーはちょっと恥ずかしいけれど……。
lines.translated: Having octopus wieners at my age was a little embarrassing, though...

lines.content: あさひさんと十夜がふたりで台所に立ち、一生懸命作ってくれていたことを知っている。だから微笑ましくも思えてしまう。
lines.translated: I knew that Asahi-san and Toya had stood in the kitchen together, working hard to make it for me. So I couldn't help but find it endearing.

lines.content: だけど、ご飯がない。
lines.translated: However, there was no rice.

lines.content: それはあさひさんが入れ忘れてしまった、というわけではなかった。
lines.translated: And it wasn't because Asahi-san had forgotten to pack it.

lines.content: 今日は先輩の分のおにぎりも作ってきました。たくさんあるので、たくさん食べてくれても平気です
lines.translated: "I made rice balls for you today too, Senpai. There's plenty, so feel free to eat as much as you want."

lines.content: 千和が殆ど毎日、こうしておにぎりを作って来てくれるのを知ってるからだ。
lines.translated: That was because she knew Chiwa made rice balls for me like this almost every single day.

lines.content: おお～。これまた、すごいね。今日は一段とたくさんだ
lines.translated: "Whoa~. This is amazing, too. There's even more than usual today."

lines.content: 千和の持ってきたお重にはぎっしりとおにぎりが。
lines.translated: The tiered box Chiwa had brought was packed tight with rice balls.

lines.content: あっ、だったらね、大雅の豪華なお弁当はね、私がたくさん食べてあげるね？
lines.translated: "Oh, in that case, I'll eat lots of your deluxe bento for you, okay, Taiga?"

lines.content: ははっ、食いしん坊のひよりちゃんめ。何が“だったら”なのか意味わかんないぞ？
lines.translated: "Haha, you little glutton, Hiyori-chan. How does 'in that case' even make sense here?"

lines.content: んー。千和ちゃんのおにぎり、本当に美味しいね。具が色々あって……、うん。止まらなくなっちゃう
lines.translated: "Mmm. Chiwa-chan's rice balls really are delicious. There are so many different fillings... yeah. I can't stop eating them."

lines.content: ハルが言う。余ってたらおかわりしても、いいかなと。
lines.translated: Haru said, asking if it would be okay to have seconds if there were any left over.

lines.content: じー……
lines.translated: "Staaare..."

lines.content: そんなハルに姫織は目を細めていた。じっとりと。
lines.translated: Himeori narrowed her eyes at Haru. Staring intently.

lines.content: え、ど、どうしたの……？
lines.translated: "Eh? W-What is it...?"

lines.content: 姫織の視線に気づいたハル。たじろいでいた。
lines.translated: Noticing Himeori's gaze, Haru faltered.

lines.content: 私の顔、何か付いてる？
lines.translated: "Is there something on my face?"

lines.content: うん。ついてる
lines.translated: "Yeah. There is."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: でも、顔にでは、ない
lines.translated: "Not on your face, though."

lines.content: ど、どこに……？　何が付いてるの？
lines.translated: "W-Where, then...? What's on me?"

lines.content: あたふたと真新しい制服を確かめる。
lines.translated: Flustered, she checked her brand-new uniform.

lines.content: そんなハルを、またじっとりと姫織は見据え、
lines.translated: Himeori kept staring intently at Haru, and...

lines.content: おっぱい
lines.translated: "Boobs."

lines.content: ……えっ
お胸に、巨大な邪悪が、ふたつも……ついてる
lines.translated: "There are two... giant evils attached to your chest."

lines.content: 姫織は両手をわきわきとさせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori made a grabbing motion in the air with both hands.

lines.content: えろい……！！
lines.translated: "So lewd...!!"

lines.content: ふむっ
lines.translated: "Hmm!"

lines.content: 確かにっ
lines.translated: "Indeed!"

lines.content: 揺れてる。すごく。
lines.translated: They were bouncing. A lot.

lines.content: だというのにハルちゃんは……そんなにいっぱい食べて……まだまだいっぱい、育つ気ですか？
lines.translated: "And yet, Haru-chan... you're eating so much... Are you planning on growing even more?"

lines.content: 私たちとまた差をつける気なんですねと、更に目を細める姫織だった。
lines.translated: "You're planning on widening the gap between us again, aren't you?" Himeori added, narrowing her eyes even further.

lines.content: えっ、そ、そんな、こと……ない、けど……うう
lines.translated: "Eh? T-That's not... true, though... ugh."

lines.content: ハルは真っ赤になった。
lines.translated: Haru turned bright red.

lines.content: 両手で胸を覆い隠す――ふと、俺と目が合った。
lines.translated: She covered her chest with both hands -- and suddenly, our eyes met.

lines.content: やだ……あんまり、見ちゃ……やだよ
lines.translated: "No... Don't stare... so much."

lines.content: もじもじと、する。
lines.translated: She squirmed bashfully.

lines.content: ……やべい。まじ、えろい
lines.translated: "...Damn. That's seriously lewd."

lines.content: あ、だめっ、男の子は見ちゃだめだよっ
lines.translated: "Ah, no! Boys aren't allowed to look!"

lines.content: ぐっは……っ
――バシッと。
lines.translated: -- Smack!

lines.content: 姫織が俺の背後に素早く回り、勢いよく両手で目を塞いできた。叩きつけるように。
lines.translated: Himeori quickly slipped behind me and forcefully covered my eyes with both hands. Practically slamming them over my face.

lines.content: い、痛いよっ
lines.translated: "O-Ow!"

lines.content: それにどうして、俺だけ。
lines.translated: Besides, why only me?

lines.content: ひよちゃん痛いよ暗いよ離してよ
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan, it hurts, it's dark, let go of me."

lines.content: ――ギリギリと、姫織の両手をはぎ取った。
lines.translated: -- Slowly but surely, I pried Himeori's hands off.

lines.content: すると姫織はそのまま倒れ込むようにして、俺の背中に覆いかぶさって来た。
lines.translated: Whereupon Himeori practically collapsed forward, draping herself over my back.

lines.content: むううううう……こんなの絶対へんですよ
lines.translated: "Muuuuuu... This is definitely weird."

lines.content: 俺の頭に顎を乗せたまま唇を尖らせ、姫織はぶうぶうと言うのだ。
lines.translated: Resting her chin on my head, Himeori pouted and grumbled.

lines.content: ハルちゃんも昔は私たちと一緒でぺったんこだったのに……っ
lines.translated: "Haru-chan used to be completely flat just like the rest of us...!"

lines.content: 後頭部にぎゅーっと胸部を押し付けてくる。
lines.translated: She pressed her chest tightly against the back of my head.

lines.content: 今日のひよちゃんはご機嫌ななめだなあ。元気なのはいいことだけども
lines.translated: "You're in a grumpy mood today, Hiyo-chan. Though I'm glad to see you're energetic."

lines.content: だって……大雅が意地悪だからっ
lines.translated: "Because... you're being mean, Taiga!"

lines.content: ……え？　原因、俺なの？
lines.translated: "...Huh? Wait, it's my fault?"

lines.content: 私だっておっぱいあるもん、大雅もともちゃんも意地悪だけど……まだひよこなサイズだけど、ちゃんとあるもんっ
lines.translated: "I have boobs too, you know! You and Tomo-chan are both so mean... They might still be baby-chick sized, but they're definitely there!"

lines.content: ぐいぐいと。ぐりぐりと。
lines.translated: Squish, squish. Grind, grind.

lines.content: 姫織は俺の後頭部に胸を押し付けてくるけれど……。
lines.translated: Himeori kept pressing her chest against the back of my head, though...

lines.content: 本当は『そんなことしちゃだめだよやめなさい』と慌てて引き離すのが本来、なのだろうけど……。
lines.translated: Normally, I probably should have panicked and pulled her away, saying, "You shouldn't do things like that, stop it," right...?

lines.content: （……あんまり、やわっこくない）
lines.translated: (...They're not very soft.)

lines.content: えっちな感じが全然しない。
lines.translated: It didn't feel lewd at all.

lines.content: むしろちょっと悲しい気持ちになって来た。
lines.translated: If anything, it was starting to make me feel a little sad.

lines.content: 私のひよこなおっぱいだって、がんばれば大雅もえっちな気持ちになってくれるもん……絶対っ
lines.translated: "Even with my baby-chick boobs, if I try hard enough, I can definitely make you feel naughty too, Taiga... Definitely!"

lines.content: 不憫な子
lines.translated: "You poor thing."

lines.content: ……先輩。泣いてますけど
lines.translated: "...Senpai. You're crying."

lines.content: ぎるちぃ！
lines.translated: "Guilty!"

lines.content: ――ぐえっ
がばっと。
lines.translated: Wham.

lines.content: 両腕を首に回された。
lines.translated: She wrapped both arms around my neck.

lines.content: 苦しい……っ。
lines.translated: I can't breathe...!

lines.content: ……おいおいっ
lines.translated: "...Whoa, hey!"

lines.content: 智仁が勢いよく立ち上がる――
lines.translated: Tomohito shot to his feet --

lines.content: あ、ああ、友よっ、助けてくれるのか心の友よっ。
lines.translated: A-Ah, my friend! Have you come to save me, my bosom buddy?!

lines.content: 智仁はバタバタと手を振り回す俺に向かって、
lines.translated: As I flailed my arms around, Tomohito turned toward me and said,

lines.content: やったぜ……っ
lines.translated: "Hell yeah...!"

lines.content: パシャリ。
lines.translated: Click.

lines.content: なぜっ、おまえはっ、写真を、撮るんだ……っ
lines.translated: "Why... are you... taking... pictures...?!"

lines.content: ラッキースケベって本当にあるんだな……っ、すげえっ、こいつは奇跡だっ
lines.translated: "Lucky pervert moments really do exist, huh...! Amazing, this is a miracle!"

lines.content: スマホで連写する智仁だった。
lines.translated: Tomohito snapped a burst of photos with his smartphone.

lines.content: は、ははっ、どこがスケベで、どこが、ラッキーなのか……っ
lines.translated: "H-Haha... what part of this is perverted, and what part is lucky...?!"

lines.content: なにおぅ……っ
lines.translated: "What was that...?!"

lines.content: ちゃんと膨らんでるもんっえっちだもんっ
lines.translated: "They're properly filling out! It's super lewd!"

lines.content: 姫織は更に力いっぱい抱き着いて来る。
lines.translated: Himeori hugged me with even more force.

lines.content: 窒息。
lines.translated: Suffocating.

lines.content: 死にそう。
lines.translated: I'm gonna die.

lines.content: でも、やっぱり……。
lines.translated: Still, even so...

lines.content: ごめんひよちゃん。
lines.translated: Sorry, Hiyo-chan.

lines.content: 全然やわっこい感じがないし、えっちな感じもあんまりなかった。
lines.translated: They didn't feel soft at all, and it really didn't feel all that lewd, either.

lines.content: “ゆめのねどこ”に帰宅した。
lines.translated: I returned home to the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: 特別ではない夜と、特別な“夜”との狭間に存在する猫たちの時間。太陽と月の間の時間だ。
lines.translated: The hour of the cats, existing in the threshold between an ordinary night and a special "Night." The time between the sun and the moon.

lines.content: 手を洗い、着替えを済ませ、テーブルにつく。
lines.translated: I washed my hands, changed my clothes, and sat down at the table.

lines.content: 今夜のご飯は……
lines.translated: "Dinner tonight is..."

lines.content: メインは豚の生姜焼き。
lines.translated: The main dish was ginger pork.

lines.content: 更にタケノコの炊き込みご飯。大根のサラダ。油揚げとお豆腐のお味噌汁。アスパラのハム巻きだ。
lines.translated: Along with bamboo shoot seasoned rice. Daikon radish salad. Miso soup with fried tofu and regular tofu. And ham-wrapped asparagus.

lines.content: 美味しそう。
lines.translated: It looked delicious.

lines.content: どれも好物だった。俺も。十夜も。
lines.translated: Every single dish was a favorite. Both for me, and for Toya.

lines.content: しかも食後にはデザートまであるという。プリンだ。これもまた、十夜の好きなものだった。
lines.translated: On top of that, there was apparently even dessert for after the meal. Pudding. That, too, was something Toya loved.

lines.content: いただきますと俺は手を合わせる。
lines.translated: I clapped my hands together and gave thanks for the meal.

lines.content: 美味しい。
lines.translated: Delicious.

lines.content: 炊き込みご飯、濃くもなく薄すぎもせずちょうどいい味付け具合。すっごく美味しい。
lines.translated: The seasoned rice was neither too strong nor too bland, seasoned just right. It was super delicious.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……だけどやっぱり、今夜も十夜は元気がなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, Toya still had no energy tonight, either.

lines.content: ごめんね、お姉ちゃん。今日もご飯、美味しいよ。でも……もう、お腹いっぱいかも
lines.translated: "Sorry, Onee-chan. The food is delicious today, too. But... I think I'm already full."

lines.content: ……お箸を置いた。
lines.translated: She set down her chopsticks.

lines.content: まだ半分も食べられていなかった。
lines.translated: She hadn't even eaten half of her food yet.

lines.content: デザートのプリンも今夜は食べられないかもと、うつむいた。
lines.translated: Looking down, she murmured that she probably wouldn't be able to eat the pudding for dessert tonight, either.

lines.content: そんな十夜に俺は言う。
lines.translated: Seeing Toya like that, I spoke to her.

lines.content: ねえ、十夜
lines.translated: "Hey, Toya."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 顔を上げてくれる。
lines.translated: She raised her head to look at me.

lines.content: なに、大雅
lines.translated: "What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: 今夜は何か予定ある？
lines.translated: "Do you have any plans for tonight?"

lines.content: ううん。別にないよ。何にも
lines.translated: "No, not really. Nothing at all."

lines.content: ふるふると頭を振った。
lines.translated: I gave my head a little shake.

lines.content: 大雅とお風呂入って。大雅とテレビ見て。大雅とトランプとかして……お着替えして。歯、磨きして。眠るだけ
lines.translated: "Just taking a bath with you, Taiga. Watching TV with you. Playing cards with you... changing into my pajamas, brushing my teeth, and going to sleep."

lines.content: そっか。俺と一緒に、か
lines.translated: "I see. Spending it with me, huh?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: だめ？　と十夜は俺を見上げる。
lines.translated: "Is that bad?" Toya asked, looking up at me.

lines.content: ううん。だめなわけないよと、俺は微笑んで応える。
lines.translated: "No. Of course it's not bad," I replied with a smile.

lines.content: ただあともうひとつ、俺と一緒にしてほしいこと、あるんだよ
lines.translated: "There's just one more thing I'd like you to do with me, though."

lines.content: もう、ひとつ……？
lines.translated: "One more... thing?"

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: 箸を置いて十夜を見た。
lines.translated: I set my chopsticks down and looked at Toya.

lines.content: 十夜。俺と一緒に、十夜のお友だちに“さよなら”、言いに行かないか？
lines.translated: "Toya. How about you and I go say 'goodbye' to your friend together?"

lines.content: 驚いた顔。目を何度かパチパチとさせる。
lines.translated: A surprised look crossed her face. She blinked her eyes several times.

lines.content: ……そんなの
lines.translated: "...Of course..."

lines.content: しかしそのまま目を伏せてしまった。
lines.translated: However, she lowered her gaze right after.

lines.content: ……そんなの、無理だよ。大雅
lines.translated: "...That's impossible, Taiga."

lines.content: だって私と、[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は、もう
lines.translated: "Because she and I can't... anymore..."

lines.content: ああ、うん。わかってる
lines.translated: "Yeah, I know."

lines.content: 十夜の言いたいこと、良くよくわかってるつもりだよ。
lines.translated: I understood what Toya was trying to say all too well.

lines.content: 直接こうしてお友だちと話して、その中で“さよなら”を伝えることはもう難しいんだろうって思う。だけど……
lines.translated: "I figure it's probably hard to talk to your friend directly like this and tell her 'goodbye' now. But..."

lines.content: ……だけど？
うん。だけどね、十夜
lines.translated: "Yeah. Even so, Toya."

lines.content: だけど[・|あ][・|の][・|時][・|間]の中でなら。
lines.translated: If it's during that time.

lines.content: “夜”の……“夜の国”の中でなら
lines.translated: "In the 'Night'... inside the 'Night Realm'..."

lines.content: 十夜の願い。お友だちに“さよなら”を伝えたいっていう、その気持ち
lines.translated: "Your wish, Toya. Your desire to say 'goodbye' to your friend..."

lines.content: 全部とは言わないけれど、半分くらいは叶えられるんじゃないのかなって……俺は、思うよ
lines.translated: "I wouldn't say all of it, but I think we might be able to make at least half of it come true."

lines.content: 十夜と一緒に特別な“夜”を行く。
lines.translated: Walking through the special "Night" together with Toya.

lines.content: “夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Night Realm."

lines.content: つらい、さみしい。現実世界でそんな想いをしている人間に、猫たちが一夜限りの遊び場を造り上げ、提供する……その舞台。
lines.translated: The stage where the cats build and provide a one-night-only playground for people feeling pain and loneliness in the real world.
This place and the outside--reality--are linked, to some extent at least.

lines.content: お友だちの家はどこら辺にあるのかな？
lines.translated: "Whereabouts is your friend's house?"

lines.content: ……もう少し。このまま、真っ直ぐだよ
lines.translated: "...Just a little further. Straight ahead this way."

lines.content: 手を繋いで大通りを進んだ。
lines.translated: Holding hands, we walked down the main street.

lines.content: 思えばこうして十夜と“夜”を歩くのも久しぶりだった。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, it had been a while since I'd walked through the "Night" with Toya like this.
