lines.content: 最近は“夜の国”開演前に、ふたりでこの場所を巡回したりもしていなかった――俺には他にこなすべき“役割”ができてしまい、忙しくなってしまったから。
lines.translated: Lately, the two of us hadn't been patrolling this place before the "Night Realm" opened its curtains, either--because I had taken on another "role" to fulfill, and things had gotten busy.

lines.content: ……“夜の国”は今夜も賑わっていた。
lines.translated: The "Night Realm" was lively again tonight.

lines.content: そこかしこに子どもたち。
lines.translated: There were children here and there.

lines.content: “夜”の寝床から目を覚ました子どもたち。その心。
lines.translated: Children who had awakened from their beds of the "Night." Their hearts.

lines.content: 猫たちの提供する大きな夢に参加する者。しない者。
lines.translated: Some participated in the grand dreams provided by the cats. Others did not.

lines.content: 彼ら彼女らは、それぞれが町の至る所で、思い思いの夢を見ながら過ごしていた。
lines.translated: Each and every one of them was spending their time all over town, dreaming whatever dreams they wished.

lines.content: ……今夜の“夜”は平和だな。騒がしいけれど、騒々しいわけじゃない
lines.translated: "...The 'Night' is peaceful tonight. It's lively, but not rowdy."

lines.content: 夢の持ち主を苦しめるような“悪夢”は、とりあえず、どこにも発生していないようだった。
lines.translated: For the time being, there didn't seem to be any "nightmares" tormenting the dreamers anywhere.

lines.content: いつも。いつまでも。
lines.translated: Always. Forevermore.

lines.content: こんなふうに穏やかな“夜”のように、誰もの心が静かなものであれればいいけれど……。
lines.translated: I wished everyone's hearts could remain as quiet as a gentle "Night" like this, though...

lines.content: まもなく到着。
lines.translated: Before long, we arrived.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だち。そのお家。
lines.translated: Toya's friend. Her house.

lines.content: おそらく、太陽の時間……現実世界にもここに、こうして、[・|姿][・|は][・|違][・|え][・|ど]同じように存在する一軒家。
lines.translated: A detached house that probably existed in the exact same way right here during the time of the sun--in the real world--albeit in a different form.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|子]の心が現実世界で眠りについて、そして“夜”にやって来るための寝室や寝床が、この玄関の向こうにはあって……。
lines.translated: Beyond this front door lay the bedroom and the bed where that girl's heart fell asleep in the real world in order to come to the "Night"...
(...A key.)

lines.content: あと必要なのはたったひとつの鍵だった。
lines.translated: All we needed now was a single key.

lines.content: 閉ざされたこの扉。
lines.translated: This closed door.

lines.content: ここを、開いて。
lines.translated: If we opened it...

lines.content: 今もまだ眠っているのだろう[・|そ][・|の][・|子]を、[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]から起こすことができたなら――きっと、十夜の願いは叶う。
lines.translated: And if we could wake that girl--who was surely still asleep right now--from this side, then Toya's wish would surely come true.

lines.content: 太陽の時間の中ではもう、[・|そ][・|の][・|子]が大人になればなるほどに、これからは互いにすれ違い続けるのだろうふたりだけれど。
lines.translated: During the time of the sun, the more that girl grew into an adult, the more the two of them would likely continue to drift apart from here on out.

lines.content: しかしまだ大丈夫。
lines.translated: Even so, it was still okay.

lines.content: “夜”の中でならまだお互い、お友だちにさよならを言い合えるだろうはずだ。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," they should still be able to say goodbye to each other as friends.

lines.content: たとえそのことを、[・|そ][・|の][・|子]が、十夜のお友だちが、“夜”の中であったことを朝になればすっかり忘れてしまうのだとしても。
lines.translated: Even if that girl--Toya's friend--completely forgot everything that happened in the "Night" once morning came.

lines.content: たった一晩の再会だ。
lines.translated: A reunion for just one night.

lines.content: そのために必要な鍵は。
lines.translated: The key needed for that...

lines.content: 十夜の願い。あるいは“夢”
lines.translated: Toya's wish. Or perhaps, her "dream."

lines.content: それを叶えるための、小さな“希望”は――今、十夜が持ってきているはずだった。
lines.translated: Toya should have brought the small "hope" needed to make it come true with her right now.

lines.content: しかし十夜は閉ざされた扉を前に、何も言わず、ただ佇んでいた。
lines.translated: However, Toya simply stood still in front of the closed door without saying a word.

lines.content: その手にはしっかりと小さな鍵が握りしめられている。
lines.translated: A small key was gripped tightly in her hand.

lines.content: お友だちの心を、“夜”の中で目覚めさせるのに必要な鍵。
lines.translated: The key needed to awaken her friend's heart within the "Night."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|子]とお友だちになれた十夜にしか使えない小さな鍵だ。
lines.translated: A small key that only Toya, who had become friends with that girl, could use.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]について、より単純な言葉を選ぶのなら――
lines.translated: To put it in simpler terms--

lines.content: 十夜はお友だちになることで、[・|そ][・|の][・|子]の心の扉を開いたのだ。
lines.translated: By becoming friends, Toya had opened the door to that girl's heart.

lines.content: だから十夜の手にはこの扉を開くための鍵がある。
lines.translated: That was why Toya held the key to open this door in her hand.

lines.content: お友だちという“関係性”こそが鍵となるということ。
lines.translated: It meant that their "relationship" as friends was the very key itself.

lines.content: ふたりの“関係性”が深いものであればあるほど。
lines.translated: The deeper their "relationship" was...

lines.content: ふたりの“関係性”が、より大切に思い合っているものであれば、あるほど。
lines.translated: The more they cherished one another in their "relationship"...

lines.content: 更に深いふかい場所にまで……この家の中に、寝室に、[・|そ][・|の][・|子]の心の中に、踏みいることが叶うだろう。
lines.translated: The deeper and further inside she would be allowed to step... into this house, into the bedroom, and into that girl's heart.

lines.content: だからこそだ。
lines.translated: And that was precisely why.

lines.content: 言ってみれば大切な人との“関係性”が試される鍵であるからこそ、なのだ……。
lines.translated: In a manner of speaking, it was precisely because this key put one's "relationship" with someone precious to the test...

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。大雅。今夜はね。ちょっと、やめとく
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. Tonight, I think... I'll pass after all."

lines.content: ……十夜は力なく首を振るのだった。
lines.translated: Toya shook her head weakly.

lines.content: この鍵でお友だちの寝室の扉を開けなかったらどうしよう。
lines.translated: What if she couldn't open the door to her friend's bedroom with this key?

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: そもそもこの玄関の扉さえ開いてくれなかったら……。
lines.translated: What if even this front door wouldn't open for her in the first place...?

lines.content: [・|そ][・|の][・|子]とお友だちになれたと思っていたのは[私|十夜]だけかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe Toya was the only one who thought they had become friends.

lines.content: 本当は十夜だって、“夜”の側からなら、もう一度、お友だちと会えるかもしれないとはわかっていただろうと思う。
lines.translated: Truthfully, I think even Toya knew deep down that she might be able to meet her friend one more time if she approached from the side of the "Night."

lines.content: だけど、怖かったのだろう。
lines.translated: However, she was probably scared.

lines.content: 私たちはもしかして、本当のお友だちじゃあ、なかったかもしれない――
lines.translated: Maybe we weren't actually real friends after all--

lines.content: それを知るのが怖い。それを試されるのが、怖い。とても、とても。
lines.translated: She was scared of finding that out. Scared of having that put to the test. So, so scared.

lines.content: そんな不安が、うつむく十夜の顔には銘々と滲んでいるように見えた。
lines.translated: That anxiety seemed to clearly bleed through onto Toya's downcast face.

lines.content: 今夜の十夜にはまだ、握りしめたその鍵を使うための勇気が出せないようだった。
lines.translated: Tonight, it seemed Toya still couldn't muster the courage to use the key gripped tightly in her hand.

lines.content: うん。わかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Okay."

lines.content: 俺はうなずき、十夜の小さな頭を撫でる。
lines.translated: I nodded and stroked Toya's small head.

lines.content: さそっておいてこう言うのも変かもしれないけど、無理することはないよ
lines.translated: "It might sound strange coming from the guy who invited you out here, but there's no need to force yourself."

lines.content: だからまた、十夜に勇気が出せそうなとき、出直そう
lines.translated: "So let's try again some other time, when you feel like you can muster up the courage."

lines.content: 俺はそう言って十夜と一緒に“ゆめのねどこ”に歩いて戻った。
lines.translated: With those words, I walked back to the "Bed of Dreams" together with Toya.

lines.content: 十夜に勇気が出せるまで……。
lines.translated: Until Toya could muster up her courage...

lines.content: それまでお友だちが、その心が、大人になりきってしまわなければ、いいのだけれど。
lines.translated: I just hoped that her friend, and her heart, wouldn't finish growing into an adult before then.

lines.content: そうなってしまえばもう、[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側][・|か][・|ら]でも、会えるかどうか……。
lines.translated: Because if that happened, I didn't know if we'd even be able to meet her from this side anymore...

lines.content: そんな不安や心配を、俺は禁ずることもできないままに。
lines.translated: Unable to suppress those anxieties and worries...

lines.content: “夜の国”から“ゆめのねどこ”に帰宅した。
lines.translated: We returned home to the "Bed of Dreams" from the "Night Realm."

lines.content: 今夜は十夜と一緒にお風呂に入った。
lines.translated: Tonight, I took a bath together with Toya.

lines.content: 大雅。頭、洗って欲しい
lines.translated: "Taiga. I want you to wash my hair."

lines.content: とか。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 背中、流しあいっこしたい
lines.translated: "I want us to wash each other's backs."

lines.content: とか。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。ドライヤー、かけてほしいなあ
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. Could you dry my hair with the hairdryer for me?"

lines.content: とか。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 今夜の十夜は甘えん坊な具合で、それはまあ、かわいくはあったけれど……。
lines.translated: Toya was acting spoiled tonight, and while it was certainly cute...

lines.content: 心配にはなる。
lines.translated: It did make me worry.

lines.content: いつもみたいなほんの少しの生意気さが、早く戻ってきてくれればいい。
lines.translated: I hoped her usual slight cheekiness would come back soon.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら、洗面台に十夜と並んで歯を磨いた。
lines.translated: Thinking about that, I stood side by side with Toya at the sink and brushed my teeth.

lines.content: 放課後。
lines.translated: After school.

lines.content: 俺は、姫織の神社に立ち寄った。
lines.translated: I stopped by Himeori's shrine.

lines.content: 自宅となったばかりの“ゆめのねどこ”からは少し遠い場所にある神社。
lines.translated: The shrine was a fair distance away from the "Bed of Dreams," which had only just become my home.

lines.content: そこにわざわざ回り道してまで立ち寄った。
lines.translated: Even so, I went out of my way to take a detour and visit.

lines.content: おみくじを一枚、購入するためだ。
lines.translated: It was to buy a single fortune slip.

lines.content: ここ、夜月神社のおみくじは少し特殊だ。
lines.translated: The fortune slips here at Yozuki Shrine were a little special.

lines.content: “この神社でおみくじを買うと、神さまにお願いを聞いてもらえる”
lines.translated: "If you buy a fortune slip at this shrine, the god will hear your wish."

lines.content: そういう“噂”だ。
lines.translated: That was the "rumor."

lines.content: 大雅……。何か、神さまにお願いしたいことがあるのかな
lines.translated: "Taiga... Do you have something you want to wish to the god for?"

lines.content: [・|す][・|ぐ][・|後][・|ろ][・|か][・|ら]姫織の声が聞こえてくる。
lines.translated: I heard Himeori's voice from *right behind me*.

lines.content: この前みんなでここに来たときは、おみくじ、買ってなかったんだったっけ
lines.translated: "When we all came here the other day, you didn't buy a fortune slip, did you?"

lines.content: えっと……
その声に俺は振り返る。
lines.translated: At the sound of her voice, I turned around.

lines.content: そこには石段に腰掛け、お団子を美味しそうに食べている巫女服姿の姫織がいた。
lines.translated: Sitting on the stone steps was Himeori in her shrine maiden attire, happily eating sweet dumplings.

lines.content: 違うよ。自分用にじゃなくって、友だち用に一枚買って帰ろうかなって思ったんだ
lines.translated: "No, that's not it. It's not for me--I was thinking of buying one to take back for a friend."

lines.content: 十夜だ。
lines.translated: For Toya.

lines.content: 今、少しつらい状況にある俺の小さなお友だち。あの子の色々が上手くいけばいい。そういう思いをこのおみくじに込めて、渡せないかな。
lines.translated: My little friend was in a bit of a painful situation right now. I wanted things to work out for her, and I wondered if I could put those feelings into this fortune slip and give it to her.

lines.content: 気休めにもならないだろうけれど、そういうふうに思ってた。
lines.translated: It probably wouldn't even serve as much comfort, but that was what I had been thinking.

lines.content: ふ～ん、そうなんだ……？　お友だち？
lines.translated: "Hmm, is that so...? A friend?"

lines.content: ああ、そうなんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah, really."

lines.content: ただ、さ。ちょっと心配な事はあるかもしれない。そこのところを巫女さんなひよちゃんにお聞きしたいかとは思ってた
lines.translated: "It's just, well, there's one thing I'm a little worried about. I was hoping I could ask you about it, Hiyo-chan, since you're a shrine maiden."

lines.content: うん、いいとも。どんとこいだよ
lines.translated: "Yup, sure thing. Bring it on."

lines.content: 得意げに胸を張る。
lines.translated: She puffed out her chest proudly.

lines.content: その頬に甘い蜜が少しついているのが気に掛かったけれど……。とりあえず、質問してみる。
lines.translated: I was a little distracted by the dab of sweet glaze stuck to her cheek, but... for now, I decided to ask my question.

lines.content: おみくじとか、お守りとか。そういうのはさ、こうして本人じゃない者が買って渡しても、ちゃんとそのひとに効果があるものなのかなって
lines.translated: "With things like fortune slips and charms... if someone else buys one and gives it to the person instead of them buying it themselves, does it still properly work for them?"

lines.content: むぅ……
ちょっと難しい顔をする。
lines.translated: She made a slightly troubled face.

lines.content: 考えるような仕草で空を見上げた。
lines.translated: She looked up at the sky as if lost in thought.

lines.content: だけど直ぐ、小首をかしげて、
lines.translated: But right after, she tilted her head slightly.

lines.content: ……どう、なんでしょう
lines.translated: "...I wonder how that works?"

lines.content: 目をぱちぱちとさせていた。
lines.translated: She blinked her eyes repeatedly.

lines.content: あれ。どんどこい、じゃなかったっけ
lines.translated: "Huh? What happened to 'bring it on'?"

lines.content: ……そう、だけども
lines.translated: "...Well, yes, but still."

lines.content: 唇をもにょもにょとさせながら、姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori mumbled, her lips squirming.

lines.content: ……巫女さんだって人間だもの。全部わかってるわけじゃないんだよ
lines.translated: "...Even shrine maidens are human, you know. It's not like we know everything."

lines.content: うん、確かにそうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's true."

lines.content: むしろなんにもわかんない。ひよりちゃんは、特に
lines.translated: "In fact, I don't know anything at all. Especially me."

lines.content: いや。そこはそんな得意そうにしてちゃまずいんじゃない？
lines.translated: "No, wait. Shouldn't you not be looking so proud when you say that?"

lines.content: えへへと姫織は照れたように、笑う。
lines.translated: "Ehehe," Himeori laughed bashfully.

lines.content: ……ここのおみくじは、うーん。別の人に渡しても大丈夫じゃないかなって思うよ。私の予想だけど
lines.translated: "...As for the fortune slips here, hmm. I think it's probably fine to give one to someone else. That's just my guess, though."

lines.content: そう？
lines.translated: "Yeah?"

lines.content: うん。だって、日本の神さまは誰もが寛容なんだって言うよ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because they say the gods in Japan are all very generous, you know?"

lines.content: たとえばね、参拝の方法も神社やお寺によって違うけど、それはどれも私たちが勝手に決めてるだけ。少しやり方を間違ったからって、神さまは怒ったりしないんだよって
lines.translated: "For example, the way you pray differs depending on the shrine or temple, right? But those are all just rules we людям decided on our own. They say the gods won't get angry just because you get the method a little wrong."

lines.content: なるほど。さすが神さまって感じだね
lines.translated: "I see. That really sounds like a god for you."

lines.content: だから、そのお友だちの代わりに大雅がくじを引いたって、効果はあるんじゃないかな。神さまはちゃんとわかってくれるよ
lines.translated: "So even if you draw a fortune slip in your friend's place, Taiga, I think it'll still work. The god will understand."

lines.content: それに、大雅がほしいのはおみくじの内容じゃなくって、“この神社のおみくじを買えば、神さまがお願いを叶えてくれる”――その“噂”のほうでしょう？
lines.translated: "Besides, what you really want isn't the fortune written on the slip, right? It's the 'rumor' that 'if you buy a fortune slip at this shrine, the god will grant your wish,' isn't it?"

lines.content: だからそういうの、気にしなくてもいいんじゃないかなあ。と言い、首をかしげながら、姫織はお団子にかけられている甘い蜜をぺろぺろと舐めていた。
lines.translated: "So I don't think you need to worry about that sort of thing," Himeori said, tilting her head as she licked the sweet glaze off her dumplings.

lines.content: 俺の手にもお団子がある。姫織の食べているのと同じものだ。
lines.translated: There was a skewer of dumplings in my hand, too. The exact same kind Himeori was eating.

lines.content: 食いしん坊な姫織が、[・|家][・|ま][・|で][・|送][・|っ][・|て][・|く][・|れ][・|た]お礼だからと、珍しく（本当に珍しく）自分のおやつを分けてくれたのだった。
lines.translated: Despite being a big foodie, Himeori had uncharacteristically (truly uncharacteristically) shared her snack with me as thanks for *walking her home*.

lines.content: この神社は少し高い位置にある。
lines.translated: This shrine sat up on slightly high ground.

lines.content: せっかくだから石段に座り、夕焼け色に沈む町を眺めながら食べようかと、ここに並んで座っていたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: Figuring we might as well sit on the stone steps and eat while looking out over the town sinking into the colors of sunset, we had sat down side by side here, except...

lines.content: 俺はお団子に口を付けられずにいた。
lines.translated: I hadn't been able to bring myself to take a bite of the dumplings.

lines.content: 姫織がおやつを分けてくれるなんて。
lines.translated: Himeori actually sharing her snack with me...

lines.content: きっとただの気まぐれなんだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: It was surely just a passing whim, though...

lines.content: しかしなんだかもったいない気がして、口を付けられず、手持ちぶさたになっていた。
lines.translated: Still, it felt like such a waste to eat it that I couldn't take a bite, leaving me holding it awkwardly.

lines.content: 大雅のお友だち……かあ
lines.translated: "A friend of yours, Taiga... huh."

lines.content: 姫織がぽつりとつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured softly.

lines.content: ん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: どうかした？　と俺は姫織に問いかける。
lines.translated: "Is something wrong?" I asked her.

lines.content: すると姫織はふるふると首を横に振り、びっくりしたよ、とそう言うのだ。
lines.translated: At that, Himeori gave a little shake of her head and said, "You surprised me."

lines.content: びっくり？　どうして？
lines.translated: "Surprised you? Why?"

lines.content: だってさ。大雅に私たち以外の仲良しがいたなんて……意外。すっごく
lines.translated: "Well, I mean... To think you had a close friend besides us, Taiga... It's unexpected. Really unexpected."

lines.content: しみじみとしながら、姫織は少し意地悪げに笑っていた。
lines.translated: Sounding deeply earnest, Himeori smiled a slightly teasing smile.

lines.content: 大雅はさ、私たちとバイバイした後は、いっつもひとりぼっちでさみしい男の子なんだと思っていました。それなのに、お友だちだなんて……びっくりだよ
lines.translated: "I always thought that after you said bye-bye to us, you were a lonely boy who was all by himself all the time, Taiga. And yet, to hear you have a friend... I'm shocked."

lines.content: ……むう
lines.translated: "...Mmph."

lines.content: ちょっとばかりムッとしてしまった――かも、しれない。
lines.translated: That might have made me sulk--just a little bit.

lines.content: そんなこと言うなら、わかった。決めたよひよちゃん
lines.translated: "If you're going to say that, then fine. I've made up my mind, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 俺、これからはひよちゃんたちより、[・|そ][・|の][・|友][・|だ][・|ち]と仲良くすることにするよ
lines.translated: "From now on, I'm going to get along better with *that friend* than with you guys, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: その子はやさしいんだ。今のひよちゃんみたいに意地悪なことなんて、全然言わないからね。だからもう、ひよちゃんとは遊んだりしないって決めたよ――
lines.translated: "She's a really sweet kid. She never says mean things like you just did, Hiyo-chan. So I've decided I'm not going to hang out with you anymore--"

lines.content: だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: あんまりにも些細な意地悪の仕返しのつもり、だったのに、
lines.translated: I had only meant it as payback for her tiny bit of teasing, and yet...

lines.content: 本気でしゅんとした顔をするのはずるいと思った。
lines.translated: I thought it was unfair how she looked genuinely crestfallen.

lines.content: ……ご、ごめん。うそだよ、ひよちゃん。これからもずっと仲良くしてほしいな。また遊ぼう。いっぱい。みんなと一緒に
lines.translated: "...S-Sorry. I was lying, Hiyo-chan. I want us to stay close friends forever. Let's hang out again. Lots and lots. Together with everyone."

lines.content: 君たちが俺にとって一番の友だちだよ――と、恥ずかしげもなくそんなことを言うと、
lines.translated: When I shamelessly added, "You guys are my best friends,"

lines.content: えへへ～
lines.translated: "Ehehe~"

lines.content: へにゃりとうれしそうに笑うので、ほんとにずるいと思う。
lines.translated: her face melted into a happy smile, which I thought was really unfair of her.

lines.content: ちょっと意地悪したお詫びに、俺のお団子も姫織に渡した。
lines.translated: As an apology for being a little mean, I gave my dumplings to Himeori too.

lines.content: 友だちっていうのは十夜のことだよと、俺は伝える。
lines.translated: I told her that the friend I was talking about was Toya.

lines.content: 十夜に最近あたらしいお友だちができたらしい。
lines.translated: That Toya had apparently made a new friend recently.

lines.content: でも、少しわけありで、ふたりの間にうまくいかないことがあって……。
lines.translated: However, there were some complicated circumstances, and things weren't going well between the two of them...

lines.content: だから十夜が新しいお友だちともっと仲良くなれますように――って。そんな俺のお願いも一緒に込めて、十夜にここのおみくじを渡せたらなって思ったんだ
lines.translated: "So I was hoping Toya could get closer to her new friend--and I thought maybe I could put that wish of mine into one of the fortune slips from here and give it to her."

lines.content: 俺がおみくじを必要とした理由を姫織に伝えた。
lines.translated: I explained to Himeori why I needed the fortune slip.

lines.content: すると、既に食べ終わってしまった追加のお団子の串を、名残惜しそうに眺めながら、
lines.translated: Then, gazing wistfully at the empty skewer of the extra dumplings she had already finished eating,

lines.content: ……大雅は、この町の神さまにまだ会える？
lines.translated: "...Taiga, can you still meet the god of this town?"

lines.content: と、姫織が独り言のようにつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured, as if talking to herself.

lines.content: 神さま？
lines.translated: "The god?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんだよ
lines.translated: "Nana-chan."

lines.content: 姫織は、言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: まだ大雅は“夜”の中に出入りできて……。十夜たちともまだ、お友だちのままならね
lines.translated: "Since you can still go in and out of the 'Night,' Taiga... and since you're still friends with Toya and the others."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: それならきっと、大雅はこの町の神さまに……、ナナちゃんにもまだ会えるってことだよね。私たちとは違って
lines.translated: "Then that must mean you can still meet the god of this town... that you can still meet Nana-chan, right? Unlike us."

lines.content: そうだね。会えるよ――まあ、本人は絶対に自分が神さまだとは認めないけど。でも、会える。“夜”の中で
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. I can meet her--well, she'd never admit to being a god herself, though. But I can see her. Inside the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ならばおみくじを買う必要はないんじゃ？　そういうふうに姫織から言われるのかと思った。
lines.translated: "Then don't you not need to buy a fortune slip?" I thought Himeori might say something like that.

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: 姫織はそううなずくだけだった。
lines.translated: However, Himeori simply nodded.

lines.content: ……うん。ナナちゃんはいつも“夜”の中から俺たちのこと、見ててくれてるよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Nana-chan is always watching over us from inside the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 姫織は石段の上を見上げる。
lines.translated: Himeori looked up toward the top of the stone steps.

lines.content: その先には境内があり、“夜”になると姿を変える古い車両が放置してある。
lines.translated: Beyond them lay the shrine grounds, where the old train car that changed its form when "Night" fell sat abandoned.

lines.content: ……ほんと、なのかな
lines.translated: "...I wonder if it's true."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ぼんやりとした声で、しかしはっきりと発せられた姫織のせりふに、俺はどきりとしてしまう。
lines.translated: Himeori's voice was absentminded, yet the words were spoken so clearly that my heart skipped a beat.

lines.content: この神社でおみくじを買うと、神さまが、ナナちゃんがね、その人のお願いを聞いてくれるって“噂”。それって本当なのかなあって
lines.translated: "The 'rumor' that if you buy a fortune slip at this shrine, the god--Nana-chan--will hear your wish. I wonder if that's really true."

lines.content: ううん……。まさか、巫女さんから神さまのことについて質問されるとは思わなかったなあ
lines.translated: "Well... I never expected to be asked about the god by a shrine maiden."

lines.content: ぶう……。違うよ。神さまのことじゃない。町の“噂”についてだよ
lines.translated: "Mmph... That's not it. I'm not asking about the god. I'm asking about the town's 'rumor.'"

lines.content: ちょっと意地悪だよ大雅と、姫織は口を尖らせていた。そんな姫織に笑顔を見せ、俺は言う。
lines.translated: "You're being a little mean, Taiga," Himeori pouted. Offering her a smile, I spoke.

lines.content: この前の日曜日。みんなでおみくじのことを話したよね
lines.translated: "Last Sunday, we all talked about the fortune slips, didn't we?"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: もしもおみくじを買って、[・|十][・|年][・|前]に叶わなかった私たちの願いを叶えてくださいって。そういうふうに願ったら……。神さまは叶えてくれたのかな
lines.translated: "If we bought a fortune slip and wished for the wishes we couldn't fulfill *ten years ago* to be granted... If we wished for that... I wonder if the god would grant it for us."

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: どうだろうか。わからない。
lines.translated: How would that go? I didn't know.

lines.content: 十年前に叶わなかった願いとは、言わずもがなだ。
lines.translated: It went without saying what the wishes we couldn't fulfill ten years ago were.

lines.content: “魔法少女”たちが“夜の王”と戦ったあの“夜”のこと。
lines.translated: It was about that "Night" when the "Magical Girls" fought the "King of the Night."

lines.content: それぞれがそれぞれの叶えがたい願いを抱え、戦い――その末に勝利した。
lines.translated: Each of them held a wish that was hard to fulfill, fought--and in the end, won.

lines.content: しかし少女らの“願い”も“夢”も叶えられることは、なかった。[・|そ][・|う][・|聞][・|い][・|て][・|い][・|る]。
lines.translated: However, neither the girls' "wishes" nor their "dreams" were ever granted. *That's what I heard*.

lines.content: たぶんだけど、無理なんだろうとは思うよ
lines.translated: "It's just a guess, but I think that's probably impossible."

lines.content: ……そう？
lines.translated: "...Really?"

lines.content: 俺たちの“夢”と“願い”。十年前に叶わなかったそれらは全部、きっと、俺たち自身にしか叶えられないものなんだ。たぶんね……だって
lines.translated: "Our 'dreams' and 'wishes.' All the ones that didn't come true ten years ago can surely only be fulfilled by us ourselves. Probably... because--"

lines.content: だって？
lines.translated: "Because?"

lines.content: うん。だってさ、ひよちゃん。そういうふうにして、ある意味簡単に叶えられてしまえるものなら、最初から誰も“夜の王”とは戦わない
lines.translated: "Yeah. Because think about it, Hiyo-chan. If they could be granted that easily in a sense, no one would have fought the 'King of the Night' in the first place."

lines.content: 誰もがここでおみくじを買って、“願い”が……“夢”が叶うのをただじっと待ってたさ。俺たちの中には誰ひとり、戦いなんて望んでた者はいなかったんだし
lines.translated: "Everyone would've just bought a fortune slip here and waited quietly for their 'wishes'... their 'dreams' to come true. Not a single one of us ever wanted to fight, after all."

lines.content: そうだろう？　と首をかしげる俺だ。
lines.translated: "Don't you think so?" I tilted my head.

lines.content: そうだね、とうなずく姫織だった。
lines.translated: "That's true," Himeori nodded.

lines.content: ひよちゃんは……
lines.translated: "What about you, Hiyo-chan..."

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: えっと、うん。もしもナナちゃんが叶えてくれるなら――叶えようと、力を貸してくれるのなら。ひよちゃん。君はどんな願い事をするのかな
lines.translated: "Um, yeah. If Nana-chan were to grant it for you--if she were to lend you her power to make it come true... Hiyo-chan, what kind of wish would you make?"

lines.content: んー……
姫織はまたふと空を見上げる。今の質問の回答を探しているようだ。
lines.translated: Himeori suddenly looked up at the sky again. She seemed to be searching for an answer to my question.

lines.content: 俺は左手を握りしめる。
lines.translated: I clenched my left hand.

lines.content: そこにある“役割”を意識した。
lines.translated: I was acutely aware of the "role" that rested there.

lines.content: 姫織。夜月姫織。十年前の“夜”の中、特別だった女の子。
lines.translated: Himeori. Yozuki Himeori. The girl who was special inside the "Night" ten years ago.

lines.content: 君の“願い”とか“夢”だとか。
lines.translated: Your "wish," or your "dream."

lines.content: それをまず知ることが叶えばと思い、問いかけた質問だったのだけれど……。
lines.translated: I had asked the question hoping I could at least learn what it was first, however...

lines.content: それはね……
lines.translated: "Well, you see..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ひよちゃん？
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: ……大雅の“夢”も、教えてくれる？
lines.translated: "...Will you tell me your 'dream' too, Taiga?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大雅も、十年前の“夜”の中。どうしても叶えたい“夢”があったから、あそこにいたんだよね？
lines.translated: "Inside the 'Night' ten years ago, you were there because you had a 'dream' you desperately wanted to fulfill too, right, Taiga?"

lines.content: “夜の王”を倒した最後の“夜”の中に、大雅も私たちといたんだよねと、姫織は繰り返した。
lines.translated: Himeori repeated it, asking if I had been there with them on that final "Night" when they defeated the "King of the Night."

lines.content: 十年前。大雅の叶えられなかった“夢”を教えてくれたら……考えるよ。私のお願いとか。私の“夢”とか。大雅に聞いてもらうかどうか
lines.translated: "If you tell me the 'dream' you couldn't fulfill ten years ago, Taiga... I'll think about it. Whether or not to let you hear my wish, or my 'dream.'"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 俺は、思わず言い淀んでしまう――“夢”。叶えたい俺の“夢”
lines.translated: I found myself hesitating--a "dream." The "dream" I wanted to fulfill.

lines.content: それが無理なら
lines.translated: "If you can't do that..."

lines.content: ふと我に返る俺に、
lines.translated: As I suddenly snapped back to reality,

lines.content: 今はね、まだまだ大雅には秘密だよ
lines.translated: "Then for now, it's still a secret from you, Taiga."

lines.content: 姫織はそう言い、いつもの笑顔を見せていた。
lines.translated: Himeori said that, showing me her usual smile.

lines.content: ねえ、大雅。お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. Big Sis."

lines.content: ……その夜の夕飯後。
lines.translated: Later that night, after dinner.

lines.content: 三人揃ってごちそうさまと手を合わせた後だ。
lines.translated: It was just after the three of us had put our hands together to thank each other for the meal.

lines.content: ……聞いて欲しいお話が、あるの
lines.translated: "...There's a story I want you to listen to."

lines.content: 相変わらずの甘えん坊で、俺の膝の上でご飯を一緒に食べていた十夜が、ふと、言った。
lines.translated: Spoiled as ever, Toya, who had eaten her meal sitting on my lap, spoke up suddenly.

lines.content: お友だちの話。[・|ま][・|た]さよならって言えなかった、お友だちのお話。……聞いてくれる？
lines.translated: "A story about my friend. The friend I couldn't say goodbye to *again*. ...Will you listen?"

lines.content: 昨晩、十夜と俺は、お友だちの家の前までふたりで行った。
lines.translated: Last night, Toya and I had gone together right up to the front of her friend's house.

lines.content: そのときは勇気が出なかった十夜だけれど……。
lines.translated: Toya hadn't been able to muster her courage back then, but...

lines.content: 一日考え、悩み、何か結論のようなものを彼女なりに出したのかもしれない。
lines.translated: After thinking and worrying about it all day, she might have come to some kind of conclusion in her own way.

lines.content: だから俺は、ああ、もちろん。と言い、うなずいた。
lines.translated: So I said, "Yeah, of course," and nodded.

lines.content: 十夜の大切なお友だち。
lines.translated: Toya's precious friend.

lines.content: [・|ま][・|た]お別れの言葉を伝えられなかった、大切だったお友だち。
lines.translated: The precious friend she hadn't been able to say her farewells to *again*.

lines.content: その子の話を聞かせて欲しいよ。
lines.translated: We want to hear the story about that girl.

lines.content: あさひさんと俺はそう言い、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Asahi-san and I told her that and nodded.

lines.content: あの子のことを最初に見かけたのは、朝からずっとぱらぱら雨が止まない日だった
lines.translated: "The first time I saw her was on a day when a light rain hadn't stopped falling since morning."

lines.content: 雨の日になると公園に行って、遊具とかで雨宿りするのが、[私|十夜]の中のお約束。
lines.translated: Going to the park on rainy days and taking shelter under the playground equipment was my own little rule.

lines.content: しとしと降り続ける雨雲の合間から、きらきら眩しい太陽が顔を出す瞬間が、私はずっと大好きで……。
lines.translated: I've always loved the moment when the dazzling, sparkling sun peeks out from between the clouds after a steady, quiet rain...

lines.content: 少し高い場所にある公園から雨に濡れる町を見る。
lines.translated: Looking out at the rain-soaked town from the park, which sat on slightly higher ground.

lines.content: たくさんの雨粒が跳ねる町を、太陽がいっぱいに照らす光景をひとりでじっと眺める。
lines.translated: Gazing all alone at the sight of the sun shining brightly over the town where countless raindrops bounced.

lines.content: そうすると、なんだか自分だけの秘密を、この世界の中に見つけられたような気がしてた。
lines.translated: Whenever I did that, I felt like I had found a secret all my own in this world.

lines.content: その日も私は、お姉ちゃんに買ってもらったばかりの新しい傘を差し、公園に歩いて向かった。
lines.translated: That day, too, holding the new umbrella Big Sis had just bought for me, I walked toward the park.

lines.content: ……女の子がひとり、いたの
lines.translated: "...There was a girl there, all alone."

lines.content: 私と同い年くらいの――ううん。同い年くらいに見える、人間の女の子
lines.translated: "A human girl about the same age as me--no. A girl who looked about the same age."

lines.content: 私は小さいけれど、もう何年も、何十年も、生きている。
lines.translated: Even though I'm small, I've lived for many years, for many decades.

lines.content: だから同じように見えてその子はずっと年下の小さな子――……短い時間で老いては消えゆく。
lines.translated: So even if we looked the same, that girl was a much younger, little child--...one who would grow old and fade away in a brief span of time.

lines.content: 屋根のあるベンチ。お気に入りの席に、先客だ。
lines.translated: The covered bench. Someone was already in my favorite seat.

lines.content: いつもぜんぜん人の来ない公園だから、そこで雨宿りするのが好きだったのに……
lines.translated: "No one ever comes to that park, which was why I liked taking shelter from the rain there, and yet..."

lines.content: 女の子。早く帰ってくれないかな。
lines.translated: That girl. I wondered if she would go home soon.

lines.content: そばの茂みに隠れてそれを待ってた。
lines.translated: I hid in the bushes nearby and waited for her to leave.

lines.content: でも、女の子はじっとしたまま動かない……。
lines.translated: But the girl sat completely still and didn't move...

lines.content: 雨が止むまで帰るつもりがないのかも。そう思った。
lines.translated: Maybe she has no intention of going home until the rain stops. That's what I thought.

lines.content: 夕暮れに近づくと、雨脚も次第次第に強くなってきた。
lines.translated: As dusk approached, the rain gradually began to fall harder and harder.

lines.content: 雨宿りの場所、取られちゃった……。
lines.translated: My spot for waiting out the rain got taken...

lines.content: そのときはそう思うだけで、私、そのままお家に帰ったんだけどね
lines.translated: "That was all I thought at the time, and I just went straight home."

lines.content: 次の日も雨だった。
lines.translated: It rained the next day, too.

lines.content: 二日続けて雨降りの空模様。
lines.translated: Rainy skies for two days in a row.

lines.content: お姉ちゃんは、何だか忙しそうで……。
lines.translated: Big Sis seemed kind of busy...

lines.content: 大雅もまだお家に住んでいないとき。
lines.translated: And it was before Taiga had moved into our house.

lines.content: ひとりだった。
lines.translated: I was alone.

lines.content: ちょっとさみしかった日曜日。
lines.translated: A slightly lonely Sunday.

lines.content: だから私は新しい黄色の傘と、同じ色の長靴で、水たまりをぱしゃぱしゃさせて、公園に……。
lines.translated: So with my new yellow umbrella and matching rain boots, I splashed through the puddles and headed to the park...

lines.content: 昨日の子、また私より先にそこにいて
lines.translated: "The girl from yesterday was there before me again."

lines.content: その日が終わるまでずっとベンチに座って、お空を見ていた
lines.translated: "She sat on the bench all the way until the day ended, looking up at the sky."

lines.content: 次も。その次も。
lines.translated: The next time, too. And the time after that.

lines.content: そのまた次の雨の日も。
lines.translated: And on the rainy day after that as well.

lines.content: その子はいつも私より先に公園にいて、ベンチに座って、雨降りの空を見つめていたの
lines.translated: "That girl was always at the park before me, sitting on the bench and gazing at the rainy sky."

lines.content: ……私と一緒、かも。
lines.translated: Maybe she's just like me.

lines.content: そう思った。
lines.translated: That's what I thought to myself.

lines.content: いつもその子はひとりだった。
lines.translated: That girl was always alone.

lines.content: ひとりぼっち。お友だちは誰もいない。
lines.translated: All alone. With no friends at all.

lines.content: だからずっとここにいる。
lines.translated: That's why she's always here.

lines.content: だからずっと、ずっと……さみしそうな顔で、空を見ている。
lines.translated: That's why she's always, always... looking up at the sky with such a lonely expression.

lines.content: ……それでもね。早く飽きてくれないかなあ、そこはあなたより先に私が見つけた秘密基地みたいな場所だったのに……って。そう思ってばかりだったけど
lines.translated: "...Even so, all I kept thinking was, 'I wish she'd get tired of it soon, that was like a secret base I found before you did...'"

lines.content: ある雨の日。
lines.translated: One rainy day.

lines.content: いつものようにひとりぼっちのあの子がいた。
lines.translated: Just like always, that lonely girl was there.

lines.content: だけどいつもと様子が違った。
lines.translated: However, something about her was different from usual.

lines.content: その子はベンチに座ったまま、背中を小さく丸め、顔を伏せていた。
lines.translated: Sitting on the bench, the girl had her back hunched small and her head lowered.

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。何か、あったのかな。
lines.translated: What's wrong? Did something happen?

lines.content: 目を懲らす。
lines.translated: I strained my eyes to look closer.

lines.content: 耳を、澄ませる。
lines.translated: I strained my ears.

lines.content: するとその子がすすり泣く声が聞こえてきた。
lines.translated: Then, I heard the sound of her quiet sobbing.

lines.content: そんなあの子のことを撫でてあげる人はいない。
lines.translated: There was no one there to pat her head.

lines.content: 大丈夫だよってそう言って、背中を撫でてあげる人もどこにもいない。
lines.translated: No one anywhere to tell her "It's okay" and rub her back.

lines.content: だってあの子は、いつも、ずっと、ひとりぼっちだったから。
lines.translated: Because that girl was always, always all alone.

lines.content: ……ね、ねえ。どうしたの？　どこか、痛いの？
lines.translated: "...H-Hey. What's wrong? Does it hurt somewhere?"

lines.content: 気づいたら私は茂みの中から這い出して、その子に話しかけていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had crawled out from the bushes and called out to her.

lines.content: 悲しく、さみしい。そんな[人間|誰か]の涙にどうしたって誘われる。
lines.translated: Sad and lonely. No matter what, I am drawn to someone's tears like that.
That is the kind of creature we are. *That is how we are made*.

lines.content: いきなり現れた私に、その子はとっても驚いた顔をしたけれど……。
lines.translated: The girl looked very surprised when I suddenly appeared, but...

lines.content: “うん。ちょっとだけ”
lines.translated: 'Yeah. Just a little.'

lines.content: 女の子はそう言った。
lines.translated: The girl said.

lines.content: “ちょっとだけ、胸のあたりがずきずきして、痛いだけ”
lines.translated: 'It just throbs and hurts a little bit, right around my chest.'

lines.content: ……小さくちいさく、そう言って。
lines.translated: She said it in a tiny, quiet voice.

lines.content: “でも、もう、大丈夫。平気だよ”
lines.translated: 'But I'm okay now. I'm fine.'

lines.content: “だってあなたが会いに、来てくれたから……”
lines.translated: 'Because you came to see me...'

lines.content: その子は涙を拭いて、私に微笑んでくれたから。
lines.translated: She wiped away her tears and smiled at me.

lines.content: だからね。きっと
lines.translated: "So, I'm sure."

lines.content: きっとね。私とあの子は、少しずつだけど……お友だちになれたんだと思うんだよ
lines.translated: "I'm sure that little by little... that girl and I managed to become friends."

lines.content: 雨の日になるとその公園で待ち合わせ……。私たちはそういう約束をしていたの
lines.translated: "Meeting up at that park whenever it rained... That was the promise we made."

lines.content: 十夜はそう言った。
lines.translated: Toya said this.

lines.content: 俺の膝の上に座ったままで。
lines.translated: All while sitting right on my lap.

lines.content: 雨の日にならないと、どうしてだかその子はやって来なかったけど……
lines.translated: "Though for some reason, that girl wouldn't come unless it was a rainy day..."
Somehow, it felt *nostalgic*.

lines.content: 私はそう感じていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe that was how I felt about it.

lines.content: だから雨が上がるまで。
lines.translated: So until the rain stopped.

lines.content: あるいは夜がやって来るそのときまで。
lines.translated: Or until the moment night arrived.

lines.content: 私たちはお話をした。……好きなこと。嫌いなこと。得意なこと。苦手なこと。色々。たくさん
lines.translated: "We talked. ...About things we liked. Things we hated. Things we were good at. Things we were bad at. All sorts of things. So much."

lines.content: 不思議と話が尽きることはなかった。
lines.translated: Strangely enough, we never ran out of things to talk about.

lines.content: それもまた懐かしい気持ちに私はなれた。
lines.translated: And that, too, made me feel nostalgic.

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: どうしよう。私は自分との[・|約][・|束]を破ってしまった。
lines.translated: What do I do? I broke my *promise* to myself.

lines.content: もう“さよなら”はしたくない。
lines.translated: I didn't want to say "goodbye" anymore.

lines.content: だからもう二度とお友だちは作らないって、決めていたのに。
lines.translated: That was why I had decided never to make friends ever again.

lines.content: 私たちは人間と生きる時間の長さが違う。あまりにも。
lines.translated: The length of time we live is different from humans. Far too different.

lines.content: だから絶対、すぐにでも“さよなら”しなきゃならないときがやって来る。それを充分わかっていた。
lines.translated: So the time when we have to say "goodbye" is guaranteed to come all too soon. I understood that well enough.

lines.content: だけどそんな“いつか”のことなんて見ないふりした。忘れてしまったふりをした。
lines.translated: Yet I pretended not to see that "someday." I pretended I had forgotten all about it.

lines.content: あの子とふたりでいられる時間はとっても楽しかったとそう思う。
lines.translated: I think the time I spent alone with that girl was so much fun.

lines.content: 雨の日になると一緒に公園でお弁当を食べた。
lines.translated: Whenever it rained, we ate boxed lunches together at the park.

lines.content: 持ち寄ったおやつを分け合ったり、ふたりでお気に入りの絵本を読んだりもした。
lines.translated: We shared snacks we brought with us, and read our favorite picture books together.

lines.content: また、私にもお友だちができたんだ。
lines.translated: I had made a friend again.

lines.content: ……そう思うと、うれしくて
lines.translated: "...Thinking that made me so happy."

lines.content: ……だから私は“どうして”って、聞けなかった
lines.translated: "...And that's why I couldn't ask her 'why.'"

lines.content: ねえ、どうして。
lines.translated: Hey, why?

lines.content: どうしてあなたはいつもひとりなの。
lines.translated: Why are you always alone?

lines.content: どうしてあなたは、いつも、さみしそうな顔をしているの。
lines.translated: Why do you always look so lonely?

lines.content: ふたりでお話しするときも。
lines.translated: Even when the two of us are talking.

lines.content: 交換し合った楽しい絵本を読んでいるそのときも。
lines.translated: Even when we're reading the fun picture books we traded with each other.

lines.content: 一緒にひとつの傘に入って、あの子のお家まで送ってあげた、あのときも。
lines.translated: Even that time we shared a single umbrella and I walked her all the way home.

lines.content: あの子が“ありがとう”って、私に笑いかけてくれたその奥に……。
lines.translated: Deep behind the smile she gave me when she said "thank you"...

lines.content: いつだって、あの子の中にはさみしい気持ちが隠れているように、思えて……。
lines.translated: It always felt like there was a lonely feeling hidden inside her...

lines.content: ……ねえ、どうして？
lines.translated: Hey, why?

lines.content: ……どうしてあのとき。最初に会ったあの雨の日に
lines.translated: "...Why, back then? On that rainy day when we first met..."

lines.content: あなたはどうして、ひとりぼっちで、泣いてたの……？
lines.translated: "Why were you crying all by yourself...?"

lines.content: そんなふうには聞けなかった。どうしても。
lines.translated: I just couldn't bring myself to ask her that. No matter what.

lines.content: それを聞いてしまうとたちどころに、この関係が終わってしまいそうで……根拠もなく怖かったから。
lines.translated: Because I had this groundless fear that the moment I asked, our relationship would come to an end right then and there.

lines.content: 私、もしかすると嫌な予感がしていたのかもしれないんだよ……
lines.translated: "Maybe I had a bad feeling about it all along..."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はある雨の日だった。
lines.translated: *It* happened on a rainy day.

lines.content: いつものようにやって来たあの子。
lines.translated: That girl came by, just like usual.

lines.content: でも、ずぶ濡れだった。
lines.translated: However, she was soaked to the bone.

lines.content: いつもより“さみしい”がずっと強く浮かんだ顔で……あの子は、お友だちは、私に言ったの
lines.translated: "With 'loneliness' showing on her face much more strongly than usual... that girl, my friend, said to me:"

lines.content: “ねえ、お願い”
lines.translated: 'Hey, please.'

lines.content: “やさしい、かわいい、私の友だち”
lines.translated: 'My kind, cute friend.'

lines.content: “……どうかお願い”
lines.translated: '...Please, I'm begging you.'

lines.content: “明日はきっと晴れだけど。約束の雨の日じゃ、ないけれど”
lines.translated: 'Tomorrow will surely be sunny. It won't be our promised rainy day, but...'

lines.content: “お願い。明日も私とここで、会ってほしいの”
lines.translated: 'Please. I want you to meet me here tomorrow, too.'

lines.content: そう言ったあの子は、これまでで一番さみしそうな、悲しそうな顔をしていたから……
lines.translated: "When she said that, she had the loneliest, saddest look on her face I had ever seen..."

lines.content: 私たちは明日、雨が降ろうと降らなかろうと、公園で会う約束をしたけれど……。
lines.translated: We promised to meet at the park tomorrow, rain or shine, and yet...

lines.content: 次の日。約束の日
lines.translated: "The next day. The promised day."

lines.content: ……大雅に、公園まで送って行ってもらった日だね
lines.translated: "...That was the day you walked me to the park, Taiga."

lines.content: 私は、雨の日以外ではじめて、あの子に会いに出かけていった
lines.translated: "For the first time on a day it wasn't raining, I went out to meet her."

lines.content: 持たせてもらったお姉ちゃんのお弁当をあの子にあげようって思った
lines.translated: "I thought I would give her the boxed lunch my big sister made for me to bring."

lines.content: お姉ちゃんの美味しいご飯を食べたらね、きっと、あの子は笑顔になってくれるって、思ったから
lines.translated: "Because I thought that if she ate my big sister's delicious food, it would surely put a smile on her face."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: お友だちは中々やって来なかった。
lines.translated: My friend didn't show up for a long time.

lines.content: 朝が終わり。お昼がすぎて。おやつの時間。
lines.translated: Morning ended. Noon passed. Snack time came.

lines.content: ……あの子は来ない。
lines.translated: She didn't come.

lines.content: どうしたんだろう。
lines.translated: What's going on with her?

lines.content: 何か、あったのかな。
lines.translated: Did something happen?

lines.content: 不安になる――事故に遭った。怪我をした。病気になって、しまった。
lines.translated: I grew anxious--maybe she got into an accident. Maybe she got hurt. Maybe she fell sick.

lines.content: そんな不安がふつふつ心に湧いてきた。
lines.translated: Those anxieties came bubbling up inside my heart.

lines.content: あの子のお家は知っていた。
lines.translated: I knew where she lived.

lines.content: 前に傘を持ってきていなかったあの子を送っていったことがあったから。
lines.translated: Because I had walked her home before when she didn't bring an umbrella.

lines.content: 様子を見に行こうか。そんなこと、迷惑かな。嫌われてしまうかな。
lines.translated: Should I go check on her? Would that be a bother? Would she hate me for it?

lines.content: どうしたらいいかわからず考えていたところで――……夕刻。
lines.translated: Just as I was wondering what to do, not knowing the answer--...evening fell.

lines.content: “さよなら”の合図が、その歌が、町に流れ始めたところで。
lines.translated: Right as the signal for "goodbye," that song, began to play across town.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: あの子はやって来てくれた
lines.translated: "She came for me."

lines.content: 怪我をしたのでも、大変な病気になってしまったのでもないみたい。
lines.translated: It didn't look like she was hurt, or that she had come down with a terrible illness.

lines.content: 私は安心、したけれど……。笑顔にもなれたけど。
lines.translated: I was relieved, and yet... I managed to smile, and yet.

lines.content: 早い。すごく
lines.translated: "It's fast. So very fast."

lines.content: 人間の子は成長が本当に早い。
lines.translated: Human children really do grow up fast.

lines.content: とりわけ女の子は、心も身体も、育つのがとっても早いのだ。
lines.translated: Girls especially grow up so very fast, in both mind and body.

lines.content: たった一日。
lines.translated: Just one day.

lines.content: たった一晩。
lines.translated: Just one night.

lines.content: あの子に何があったのかはわからないけど。
lines.translated: I don't know what happened to her, though.

lines.content: たったそれだけの時間で、あの子は……。
lines.translated: In just that short amount of time, she...

lines.content: あの子は、大人になってしまって、いたんだよ
lines.translated: "She had already grown up."

lines.content: （十夜のお友だちは一晩で大人になった）
lines.translated: (Toya's friend grew up in a single night.)

lines.content: だから十夜のことを見えなくなってしまっていた。
lines.translated: And because of that, she could no longer see Toya.

lines.content: （たった、一晩。そんな時間の中に、その心が大人になることを選び始める何かが、あったのかな）
lines.translated: (Just a single night. In that brief span of time, did something happen that made her heart start choosing to grow up?)

lines.content: バス停にやって来た女の子。十夜の大切だったお友だち……。
lines.translated: The girl who came to the bus stop. Toya's precious friend...

lines.content: もう、遅いよ。とんでもない遅刻だよ？　と。
lines.translated: "Jeez, you're late. You're super late, you know?"

lines.content: 最初はお友だちとじゃれ合いたいみたいに、そう言った十夜だったけど……。
lines.translated: At first, Toya said that as if wanting to playfully tease her friend, but...

lines.content: そんな十夜の言葉にお友だちは無反応。
lines.translated: Her friend didn't react to Toya's words at all.

lines.content: ベンチに座る。きょろきょろと辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: She sat down on the bench. She looked around restlessly.

lines.content: だけど一度だって十夜のことを見ようともしなかった。十夜の姿を、その瞳に映すことは、なかった。
lines.translated: Yet not even once did she try to look at Toya. Toya's figure was never reflected in her eyes.

lines.content: “……十夜ちゃん。帰っちゃったのかな”
lines.translated: '...Toya-chan. I wonder if she went home already.'

lines.content: そんなつぶやき。
lines.translated: A murmur like that.

lines.content: “……晴れの日じゃ、だめなのかな”
lines.translated: '...I wonder if a sunny day really is no good.'

lines.content: そんな、ため息。
lines.translated: A sigh like that.

lines.content: “……やっぱり雨が降ってないと、あの子は、やって来てくれないのかな”
lines.translated: '...I guess she really won't come unless it's raining.'

lines.content: 雨の降らない夕暮れ近くの空を見上げて、お友だちはまたさみしそうな顔をした。
lines.translated: Looking up at the rainless sky near dusk, her friend made a lonely face again.

lines.content: 『違う。ここだよ。ここにいるよ……お願い、気づいて』
lines.translated: "No. I'm right here. I'm here... Please, notice me."

lines.content: お友だちの肩を揺すってみた。
lines.translated: She tried shaking her friend's shoulders.

lines.content: 『……私はここに、いるんだよ』
lines.translated: "...I'm right here."

lines.content: だけど十夜の声は届かない。
lines.translated: But Toya's voice didn't reach her.

lines.content: ただそっと触れたその気配だけは伝わったのか……。
lines.translated: Only the faint sensation of her gentle touch seemed to get through...

lines.content: 不思議そうに辺りを見渡す。
lines.translated: She looked around with a puzzled expression.

lines.content: お友だちは悲しい顔をした。さみしい声で、十夜を呼んだ。
lines.translated: Her friend made a sad face. In a lonely voice, she called out for Toya.

lines.content: 『……いや。いやだ。だめだよ。お願い、泣かないで』
lines.translated: "...No. I don't want this. This isn't right. Please, don't cry."

lines.content: あなたに、あなたたちに、悲しい顔なんてしてほしくない。さみしい思いなんて、してほしくない。
lines.translated: I don't want you, or any of you, to make such sad faces. I don't want you to feel lonely.
*Because no matter what, that is how we are made*...

lines.content: 十夜はお友だちと手を繋ごうとした。
lines.translated: Toya tried to hold her friend's hand.

lines.content: 私はここだよと伝えたかった。
lines.translated: She wanted to tell her, "I'm right here."

lines.content: 見えなくなっても。聞こえなくなってしまっても。ずっと、あなたのことを見ているよ。ずっとずっと、私は、さみしそうなあなたの味方で、いたいんだよ、と。
lines.translated: Even if you can't see me anymore. Even if you can't hear me anymore. I'll always be watching over you. Forever and ever, I want to be on your side whenever you look lonely.

lines.content: でも、だめだ。
lines.translated: But I couldn't.

lines.content: 今度は触れられもしなかった。
lines.translated: This time, she couldn't even touch her.

lines.content: 十夜の指先はお友だちの身体を透き通り――……もう、さよならだとわかった。
lines.translated: Toya's fingertips passed right through her friend's body--...and she knew it was already time to say goodbye.

lines.content: お別れ。さよならの時。
lines.translated: A parting. The time for goodbye.

lines.content: [・|私]の役目が終わる時。
lines.translated: The time when *my* role comes to an end.

lines.content: 十夜が何度も何度も繰り返してきたのだろう、お友だちとの、人間の子たちとの、お別れの時だ。
lines.translated: It was the time to part ways with her friend, with human children--something Toya must have repeated over and over again.

lines.content: あの子が私を見えなくなってしまったということは……あの子の心が、大人になれたということだから
lines.translated: "The fact that she can't see me anymore means... her heart has managed to grow up."

lines.content: きっと、もう自分のことをあの子は必要ではなくなったということだ――十夜はそう理解する。
lines.translated: It surely meant that the girl no longer needed her--that was how Toya understood it.

lines.content: 私たちは、ひとりぼっちのさみしい子たちに寄り添うために生きている。
lines.translated: We live to stay close to lonely, solitary children.

lines.content: ただそれだけのために、この世界に命をもらったのだとさえ言っていい。
lines.translated: You could even say we were given life in this world for that purpose alone.

lines.content: だから十夜は悟った。理解したのだ。
lines.translated: That was why Toya realized it. She understood.

lines.content: あの子が[・|こ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で][・|の][・|お][・|友][・|だ][・|ち]と同じように、自分のことを見えなくなって、声が、届かなくなって――
lines.translated: Just like *all her friends up until now*, that girl could no longer see her, and her voice could no longer reach her--

lines.content: ああ。そうか。
lines.translated: Ah. I see.

lines.content: この子はもう大丈夫。自分の役割は終わったんだな、と。
lines.translated: This girl is going to be okay now. My role is finished, she thought.

lines.content: だけどあの子のさみしい気持ちは、終わってないの
lines.translated: "Even so, her lonely feelings haven't ended yet."

lines.content: まだその心に、あの子の“夜”のその中に、さみしがり屋な“[悪夢|誰か]”が涙に暮れて、いるのなら。
lines.translated: If a lonely "Nightmare"--a lonely *someone*--is still drowning in tears inside her heart, inside her "Night."

lines.content: お願い、大雅。あの子の“悪夢”を、切り取ってあげてほしい
lines.translated: "Please, Taiga. I want you to cut away her 'Nightmare' for her."

lines.content: ……そうでなければ、きっと、あの子の心には、これからもっともっと、つらいことが待ち受けている。
lines.translated: Otherwise, much, much more painful things are surely waiting for her heart from here on out.

lines.content: そしてあの子の心にさみしい“悪夢”が消えたなら、十夜は問いたい。
lines.translated: And once the lonely "Nightmare" disappears from the girl's heart, Toya wants to ask her.

lines.content: 大丈夫？　もう平気？　もう、さみしくはない？
lines.translated: "Are you okay? Are you alright now? Are you not lonely anymore?"

lines.content: それを確かめられたなら――あの子が“うん、平気だよ、大丈夫だよ、もうさみしくはないよ”と、あの子が十夜に、そう笑いかけてくれたなら。
lines.translated: If she can make sure of that--if the girl smiles at Toya and says, "Yeah, I'm fine, I'm okay, I'm not lonely anymore."

lines.content: 私は、あの子に、笑ってさよならが言えるよ。そして、おめでとうって、伝えることができる
lines.translated: "Then I'll be able to smile and say goodbye to her. And I'll be able to tell her, 'Congratulations.'"

lines.content: これから続くお友だちの人生に、もう私がお友だちではいられなくなるその先の時間に、できるだけ多くの幸せが降りますようにと、そんな願いを渡すことができる。
lines.translated: I'll be able to pass on a wish that as much happiness as possible will rain down upon her continuing life, in the time ahead when I can no longer be her friend.

lines.content: ……いつだって子どもたちが“大人”になる瞬間は唐突で。前触れだって、全然なくて。
lines.translated: The moment children become "adults" is always sudden. There's never any warning at all.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ][・|ま][・|で][・|の][・|お][・|友][・|だ][・|ち]には、お別れも何も伝えられなかったけれど。
lines.translated: To *all her friends up until now*, she hadn't been able to say goodbye or anything at all.

lines.content: もし、願いを叶えてもらえるのなら……。
lines.translated: But if her wish could be granted...

lines.content: ……これから何があっても、どんなことがあっても、私だけはあなたの味方で、いるからねって。大きなお世話かもしれないけれど……最後にそう、伝えたい
lines.translated: "...'No matter what happens from now on, no matter what comes your way, I alone will always be on your side.' It might be none of my business, though... At the very end, that's what I want to tell her."

lines.content: そのために勇気を出して、もう一度、会いに行こう。
lines.translated: For that sake, let's muster up our courage and go see her one more time.

lines.content: 昨晩はだめだった。扉の前にまで一緒に行けたけど……。
lines.translated: Last night was no good. We managed to go all the way to the front of her door together, and yet...

lines.content: そこから怖くなって。勇気が、足りなくて。引き返してきたけれど……。
lines.translated: From there, she got scared. She didn't have enough courage. So we turned back, and yet...

lines.content: でも十夜は“夢”を叶えたい。
lines.translated: Even so, Toya wants to make her "dream" come true.

lines.content: そう強く願い続けている。
lines.translated: She keeps wishing for that with all her heart.

lines.content: ……あの子にとって自分はどういう存在だったのか。
lines.translated: What kind of existence had she been to that girl?

lines.content: 本当にお友だちになれていたのか。
lines.translated: Had they truly become friends?

lines.content: 少しだけでもあの子のさみしい気持ちを拭えていたのか。
lines.translated: Had she been able to wipe away the girl's lonely feelings, even if only a little?

lines.content: それを知ることは、もしかするととてもかなしい結果に繋がるかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: Finding that out might possibly lead to a very sad result, and yet...

lines.content: あの子にすてきなこの先の人生を贈りたい。笑顔をあげたい
lines.translated: "I want to give her a wonderful life ahead. I want to give her a smile."

lines.content: そのために、大雅。私、明日こそ勇気を出して、あの子に会いに、行きたいよ
lines.translated: "To do that, Taiga... Tomorrow for sure, I want to muster up my courage and go see her."

lines.content: そう言った十夜の横顔は、ずっとずっと、大人びているように俺には見えた。
lines.translated: As she said that, Toya's profile looked much, much more mature to me.

lines.content: “夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Night Realm."

lines.content: 俺は十夜と手を繋ぎ、大通りを歩いていた。
lines.translated: I held hands with Toya as we walked down the main street.

lines.content: ……きらきら眩しい“夜”の時間だ。
lines.translated: It was the glittering, dazzling time of "Night."

lines.content: 十夜とふたり、やり残したことを終わらせるため、“夜の国”をゆく。
lines.translated: Just the two of us, Toya and I made our way through the "Night Realm" to finish what we had left undone.

lines.content: ……今夜の夢はまた壮大だな
lines.translated: "...Tonight's dream is on a grand scale again, huh."

lines.content: “夜”の空を見上げる。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: “今夜の夢”が音もなく頭上を通り過ぎていくところだった。
lines.translated: "Tonight's dream" was just passing overhead without a sound.

lines.content: それはかつて人々の心を破滅させんとばかりに、この[夜|街]を暴れ回っていた最大の悪夢――“夜の王”
lines.translated: It was the greatest nightmare that had once rampaged through this Night--this town--as if trying to destroy people's hearts: the "King of the Night."

lines.content: その姿を模造した巨大な飛行艇。
lines.translated: A gigantic airship modeled after its form.
A *flying whale*.

lines.content: 機械式のなめらかな動作。銀色のぬらりとした表面は、月の明かりを反射させ時折きらりと眩しく光る。
lines.translated: It moved with smooth, mechanical motions. Its slick, silver surface reflected the moonlight, occasionally glinting with a dazzling light.

lines.content: それを、かつての“魔法少女”たちのように、今夜夢見る子どもたちが力を合わせ、その“想像力”を結集し、打ち倒す。
lines.translated: Just like the "magical girls" of the past, the children dreaming tonight would join forces, pool their "imagination," and strike it down.

lines.content: 今夜は“夜”の中にそういった舞台が、猫たちによって用意されていた。
lines.translated: Tonight, that kind of stage had been prepared inside the "Night" by the cats.

lines.content: それなりの一大イベントである。
lines.translated: It was quite a major event.

lines.content: この夢に参加する心たちはしかし、朝に目覚めてもおそらくは夢の内容を覚えてはいないだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: However, the hearts participating in this dream probably wouldn't remember the contents of it when they woke up in the morning...

lines.content: “夜の王”を今夜中に撃破できたなら……。
lines.translated: If they managed to defeat the "King of the Night" before tonight ended...

lines.content: [・|い][・|つ][・|か]“刻の終着駅”で買い物するためのコインを、活躍に応じて、支払ってもらえる。
lines.translated: They would be paid coins according to their contributions, to be used *someday* for shopping at the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: そんなちょっとしたおまけつきでもあるようだ。通りすがりの悪戯好きの[猫|仕掛け人]がそう教えてくれた。
lines.translated: It seemed to come with that little bonus attached. A passing, mischievous cat--the mastermind behind it--had told us so.

lines.content: そして俺たちも今夜の舞台に参加するようにと勧めては、さわがしい夜空を眩しいものでも眺めるように見上げているのだった。
lines.translated: And after encouraging us to participate in tonight's stage as well, it was now looking up at the noisy night sky as if gazing at something dazzling.

lines.content: なんだかさ
lines.translated: "You know..."

lines.content: え？　なんだか……って？
lines.translated: "Huh? You know... what?"

lines.content: うん。なんだかこれって、まるでネットゲームとかによくある自由参加型のクエストみたいだよね
lines.translated: "Yeah. Somehow, this feels just like one of those open-participation quests you often see in online games."

lines.content: そんなふうに言ってしまうと、言葉にしずらい細やかな部分が台無しになってしまいそうではあるけれど――
lines.translated: Though putting it that way felt like it might ruin the delicate nuances that were hard to put into words--

lines.content: くえすと……なあにそれ？　ねっと？　外国の言葉？
lines.translated: "Quest...? What's that? Online? Is it a foreign word?"

lines.content: うん。英語だよ。冒険のこと、かな？
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's English. It means an adventure, I guess?"

lines.content: へー？
lines.translated: "Oh?"

lines.content: 十夜もそろそろ英語の勉強、してもいいかもしれないね
lines.translated: "Maybe it's about time you started studying English too, Toya."

lines.content: えええええー
lines.translated: "Ehhhhh?"

lines.content: 渋い顔。すっごく。
lines.translated: She made a sour face. A really big one.

lines.content: いいよぉそんなの。別にいい。私、いらない
lines.translated: "I'm fine without that. I don't care. I don't need it."

lines.content: そう？　覚えてみたら結構楽しいよ。はろー。えぶりにゃん
lines.translated: "Really? It's actually pretty fun once you learn it. Hello, everynyan."

lines.content: は？　急にどうしたの。意味わかんない。それ、面白いの？
lines.translated: "Huh? What's with you all of a sudden? I don't get it. Is that supposed to be funny?"

lines.content: う、うう。にゃんこな十夜にだから語感から責めようかと……そ、そうだよね。つまんないよね。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "Urk, ugh. Since you're a kitty, Toya, I thought I'd hook you with the way it sounds... Y-Yeah, you're right. It's lame. I'm sorry."

lines.content: 真顔で返されちょっと悲しい気分に。
lines.translated: Getting a deadpan response made me feel a little sad.

lines.content: とにかくいらない。お勉強、しない。不要なんです。私には
lines.translated: "Anyway, I don't want it. I'm not studying. It's unnecessary. For me."

lines.content: ぷりぷりしていた。
lines.translated: She was in a huff.

lines.content: だって大雅とこうしてちゃんとお話できてるんだもん。別に知らない国の知らない言葉なんて話せなくったっていいよ……
lines.translated: "Because I can talk properly with you just like this, Taiga. I don't care if I can't speak some unknown language from some unknown country..."

lines.content: それは……まあ、そうだね
lines.translated: "Well... I suppose that's true."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: 確かに俺たちが仲良く話すのには英語なんて必要ないかもね
lines.translated: "We certainly might not need English just for the two of us to get along and talk."

lines.content: ぷいっとする十夜だ。
lines.translated: Toya turned her head away in a huff.

lines.content: ん？　どうしたの？
lines.translated: "Hm? What's wrong?"

lines.content: ……別に
lines.translated: "...Not really."

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: 別に私と大雅は、仲良しじゃないけどね
lines.translated: "It's not like you and I get along, though."

lines.content: 勘違いしないでね、と。
lines.translated: Don't get the wrong idea, her attitude said.

lines.content: 十夜は――我がまま気まぐれ小生意気……いつまでもそんなお年頃なのだろう幼女さまなのだ。ほんとに自由な子猫のようだ。
lines.translated: Toya is--selfish, capricious, and a little cheeky... a little lady who will probably stay at that age forever. She really is just like a free-spirited kitten.

lines.content: 大雅が
lines.translated: "When you..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私たちのお家にやって来たばっかりの頃の小さな大雅が、なんだか、さみしがりな子に見えたから――
lines.translated: "When you had just come to our house, back when you were little, you looked like a lonely kid somehow--"

lines.content: だから、私。仕方なくお話ししてあげてるだけなんだよ。別に私は、この妹は、大雅のことなんて全然好きじゃないのです
lines.translated: "So I'm just talking to you out of pity. It's not like I--this little sister of yours--like you at all, Taiga."

lines.content: なにぃ……
lines.translated: "Whaaat...?"

lines.content: ふぅん。あ、そう。わかったよ
lines.translated: "Hmph. Oh, really? Got it."

lines.content: 俺はパッと、繋いでいた手を離す。
lines.translated: I quickly let go of the hand I was holding.

lines.content: そんなこと言う子とはもう手を繋いであげないんだからな
lines.translated: "I'm not holding hands with a girl who says things like that anymore."

lines.content: お風呂にだって一緒に入ってあげないし、一緒にご飯を食べたりもしてあげないぞ。膝の上に座らせてあげたりだってしないんだ
lines.translated: "I won't take baths with you, and I won't eat meals with you either. I won't even let you sit on my lap."

lines.content: いいもんいいもん。十夜が意地悪するから、大雅くんはふて腐れてしまうことに決めました
lines.translated: "Fine, fine. Since you're being mean, Toya, Taiga-kun has decided to sulk."

lines.content: ぷんすかとしてみる。
lines.translated: I tried acting all huffy.

lines.content: 十夜が“大雅大好き”って言ってくれるまで、大雅くんはもう二度と、十夜とはお手て繋いで歩かないんだからな
lines.translated: "Until you say 'I love you, Taiga,' Taiga-kun is never holding hands and walking with you ever again, Toya."

lines.content: 冗談めかしてそう言った。
lines.translated: I said it jokingly.

lines.content: しかし十夜は、すっごいさみしそうな顔をして俺を見上げ……。
lines.translated: However, Toya looked up at me with an incredibly lonely expression on her face...

lines.content: しょんぼりしていた。泣きそうでもあった。
lines.translated: She looked crestfallen. She even looked like she was about to cry.

lines.content: う。
lines.translated: Urk.

lines.content: なんだか、罪悪感が。
lines.translated: Somehow, I felt a pang of guilt.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 好き
lines.translated: "I like you."

lines.content: ぽつりと、言う。
lines.translated: Quietly, she spoke.

lines.content: 大雅、大好き
lines.translated: "I love you, Taiga."

lines.content: ……だから、だめ
lines.translated: "...So don't."

lines.content: 手、離さないで
lines.translated: "Don't let go of my hand."

lines.content: 意地悪、しないで
lines.translated: "Don't be mean."

lines.content: まったく。この幼女さまは……まったく。
lines.translated: Honestly. This little lady... honestly.

lines.content: 苦笑いで『嘘だよ泣いちゃだめだよ』ともう一度手を繋ぐ。
lines.translated: With a wry smile, I told her, "I was just kidding, don't cry," and took her hand once more.

lines.content: ぐずぐずと十夜は小さな鼻をすすっていた。
lines.translated: Toya sniffled with her tiny nose.

lines.content: 俺たちは“夜”の中を進んだ。
lines.translated: We walked onward through the "Night."

lines.content: この時間の中で夢見るためにではない。
lines.translated: Not to dream within this time.

lines.content: 悪戯に想像力を働かせ、“夜”の中を誰より早く駆け抜けて、“夜の王”――その模造品を打ち倒す。そのような巨大な夢に参加するためでも、ない。
lines.translated: Nor was it to take part in a grand dream of letting our imaginations run wild, racing through the "Night" faster than anyone else to strike down that counterfeit "King of the Night."

lines.content: お友だち。
lines.translated: A friend.

lines.content: 十夜の大切だった、お友だち。
lines.translated: Toya's precious friend.

lines.content: 今夜こそだ。
lines.translated: Tonight was the night.

lines.content: 十夜の握りしめた鍵を役立てるために……俺たちは、進んだ。
lines.translated: In order to put the key clutched tightly in Toya's hand to use... we pressed onward.

lines.content: 目的地に到着する。
lines.translated: We arrived at our destination.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちの家。その玄関先だ。
lines.translated: The front door of Toya's friend's house.

lines.content: この前やって来たときは、ここで“勇気がないから……”と引き返したけれど。
lines.translated: The last time we came here, she had turned back right at this spot, saying she didn't have the courage...

lines.content: 今夜は、行ける？
lines.translated: "Can you go in tonight?"

lines.content: 俺は問う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: うん。大丈夫そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I think I'll be okay."

lines.content: 十夜は、笑った。
lines.translated: Toya smiled.

lines.content: 大雅とお姉ちゃんに、お友だちのこと聞いてもらったら……なんだかちょっと、ちょっとだけね？　勇気が出せそうだなって思ったから
lines.translated: "Having you and Big Sis listen to me talk about my friend... made me feel like I could muster up a little, just a little bit of courage."

lines.content: 十夜の手には“鍵”がある。小さな“鍵”だ。
lines.translated: There was a "key" in Toya's hand. A small "key."

lines.content: 銀色。その柄には雨降りの空が彫刻されていた。
lines.translated: It was silver, with a rainy sky carved into its bow.

lines.content: ……それは、俺が“夜の国”や“ゆめのねどこ”に立ち入るために、かつてあさひさんから手渡された[・|そ][・|れ]と同じものだと言える。
lines.translated: You could say it was the exact same kind of thing Asahi-san had once handed to me so I could enter the "Country of Night" and the "Dream Bed."

lines.content: 今、十夜の手のひらに握られている鍵は――十夜のお友だちが“夜”と繋がるためのものである。
lines.translated: The key currently clutched in Toya's palm was meant to connect her friend with the "Night."

lines.content: “夜”の住人である十夜が、そのお友だちとの間に築けた“関係性”
lines.translated: The "relationship" Toya, a resident of the "Night," had managed to build with her friend.

lines.content: それが形になったもの。
lines.translated: This was that bond given form.

lines.content: 十夜が扉の鍵穴に“[魔法|鍵]”を差し込む。
lines.translated: Toya inserted the "magic key" into the door's keyhole.

lines.content: ひとつ大きく息をつく。
lines.translated: She took one deep breath.

lines.content: そして“鍵”を回した。そっと、回した。
lines.translated: And then she turned the "key." Gently, she turned it.

lines.content: ……カチャリ。
lines.translated: Click.

lines.content: 開錠。
lines.translated: Unlocked.

lines.content: 閉ざされた扉が開かれる音。
lines.translated: The sound of a closed door opening.

lines.content: 開いた……
lines.translated: "It opened..."

lines.content: 安堵の声色だった。
lines.translated: Her voice was filled with relief.

lines.content: この扉が開いたということは……、
lines.translated: The fact that this door opened meant...

lines.content: “自分だけがあの子のお友だちだと思っていたらどうしよう”
lines.translated: 'What if I'm the only one who thought of her as a friend?'

lines.content: ……そんな十夜の不安は、ひとまず解決されたことになる。
lines.translated: That anxiety of Toya's was resolved for the time being.

lines.content: どちらか片方だけが“お友だち”だと思っているだけではだめだ。
lines.translated: It wouldn't work if only one side thought of the other as a "friend."

lines.content: それでは“関係性”は成立しない。心の扉を開くための“魔法”は成り立たない。
lines.translated: A "relationship" cannot be established that way. The "magic" to open the door to someone's heart wouldn't take hold.

lines.content: もしも扉が開かなければ、また引き返さなければならなかった。
lines.translated: If the door hadn't opened, we would have had to turn back again.

lines.content: ……おそらくはこれまで以上に悲しい気持ちになっていただろう十夜と一緒に。
lines.translated: And I would have been walking back with a Toya who was likely even sadder than before.

lines.content: だが、大丈夫。扉は開く。
lines.translated: But it was okay. The door would open.

lines.content: さあ、行こうか。十夜の“夢”を叶えに行こう
lines.translated: "Come on, let's go. Let's go make your 'dream' come true, Toya."

lines.content: 手を繋ぐ。
lines.translated: We held hands.

lines.content: そしてふたり一緒に扉のノブを握りしめた。
lines.translated: Together, the two of us gripped the doorknob tightly.

lines.content: ……ここから先は十夜の“夢”を叶えるための時間となる。
lines.translated: From here on out, it would be time to fulfill Toya's "dream."

lines.content: 十夜は俺の隣で、小さくぶつぶつとつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: Beside me, Toya was muttering quietly under her breath.

lines.content: “さよなら”“ありがとう”“また、いつか……”
lines.translated: "Goodbye." "Thank you." "See you again, someday..."

lines.content: 扉の向こうのお友だちに伝えたい言葉たち。
lines.translated: The words she wanted to convey to her friend on the other side of the door.

lines.content: お友だちと会えるのはおそらく今夜限りだろう――人間の女の子は成長がとても早いのだ。その心といわず。身体といわず。
lines.translated: Tonight would likely be the very last time she could meet her friend--human girls grow up so fast. Both in heart and in body.

lines.content: だからちゃんと気持ちや言葉を取りこぼすことなく口にできるようにと練習していた。
lines.translated: That was why she was practicing, so she could voice her feelings and words properly without leaving anything out.

lines.content: ……うん。大丈夫。もう行ける
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I'm okay. I'm ready to go."

lines.content: 十夜はうなずく。
lines.translated: Toya nodded.

lines.content: わかったと言って、俺もうなずく。
lines.translated: Saying "Got it," I nodded too.

lines.content: ありがとうも。さよならも。
lines.translated: Both "thank you" and "goodbye."

lines.content: 面と向かって直接伝えるのはとっても勇気が要ることだろうと、俺は想像してしまうから……。
lines.translated: Because I could easily imagine how much courage it must take to say those things directly, face-to-face...

lines.content: がんばれ、十夜
lines.translated: "Do your best, Toya."

lines.content: 十夜の勇気。この扉の向こうにある時間の、その全部。ちゃんとそばで見てるからね
lines.translated: "Your courage. Everything that happens in the time beyond this door. I'll be right there beside you, watching all of it."

lines.content: そう言う俺に、照れくさそうに微笑む十夜だ。
lines.translated: Hearing me say that, Toya gave a shy smile.

lines.content: そして小さくうなずきあって……。
lines.translated: Then we gave each other a small nod...

lines.content: 俺たちは、その扉を一緒に開いた。
lines.translated: And together, we opened the door.

lines.content: 開かれた扉。
lines.translated: The opened door.

lines.content: その先に広がった光景は、見知らぬ誰かの家の中――ではない。
lines.translated: The scene that spread out beyond it was not the inside of some stranger's house.

lines.content: どころか“夜”でさえもなかった。
lines.translated: In fact, it wasn't even the "Night."

lines.content: 太陽の時間。参禅町。その町外れ。
lines.translated: The time of the sun. Sanzen Town. On its outskirts.

lines.content: ……公園だ。隅に建てられた雨よけの小屋のような建物。
lines.translated: A park. A small, shed-like shelter from the rain built in the corner.

lines.content: そこにひとり、女の子。
lines.translated: There stood a single girl.

lines.content: あの子が十夜のお友だちだろうか……。
lines.translated: Was she Toya's friend...?

lines.content: 女の子はひとりぼっちで空を見ていた。
lines.translated: The girl was looking up at the sky all by herself.

lines.content: 雨だ。雨が、降っている。
lines.translated: Rain. It was raining.

lines.content: 雨雲などひとつもない空からしとしとしとしと雨が降るのだ。
lines.translated: Rain was falling gently and steadily from a sky without a single raincloud in sight.

lines.content: 青空は、しかし、その大気がまるで固いガラスのように所々がひび割れていて……。
lines.translated: However, the atmosphere of the blue sky was cracked in places, just like hard glass...

lines.content: その隙間からきらきら光る星空が覗いていた。
lines.translated: And through those gaps, a sparkling starry sky peeked out.

lines.content: 宇宙だ。銀河だ。見たこともない星空と星座たち。
lines.translated: Space. The galaxy. A starry sky and constellations I had never seen before.

lines.content: そんな空の隙間からこぼれ落ちた流れ星。地上にいくつもいくつも降り注ぐ。
lines.translated: Shooting stars spilled out from the gaps in the sky, raining down upon the ground in countless numbers.

lines.content: 雨粒と思ったものは全部、小さなちいさな星の光だ。
lines.translated: Everything I had thought were raindrops were actually tiny, minuscule fragments of starlight.

lines.content: 降り注ぐ固い道路などでパチンと弾けて消えていく。
lines.translated: They rained down, popping and vanishing against the hard road.

lines.content: ここは、夢だ。
lines.translated: This place was a dream.

lines.content: バス停のベンチに座り、雨降りの――星降る空を見上げてる――あの子の夢の、その中だ。
lines.translated: We were inside the dream of that girl sitting on the bus stop bench, looking up at the rainy--the star-falling--sky.

lines.content: 女の子はひとりぼっちで、夢のような空を見ている。
lines.translated: The girl was watching the dreamlike sky all alone.

lines.content: ……さみしそうに。悲しそうに。たった、ひとりで。
lines.translated: Looking so lonely. So sad. All by herself.

lines.content: ぽろりと涙。
lines.translated: A tear spilled over.

lines.content: 頬をすべり、落ちていき……。
lines.translated: It slid down her cheek, falling...

lines.content: 握りしめた手の甲で弾けてしまう。
lines.translated: And burst against the back of her tightly clenched hand.

lines.content: そんな一滴の中には、あの子の“悲しい”“さみしい”そんな気持ちがたくさん詰まっているように見えた。
lines.translated: That single drop looked as though it were packed full of her "sad" and "lonely" feelings.

lines.content: ……やっぱり
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: 十夜は唇を噛む。
lines.translated: Toya bit her lip.

lines.content: 夢の中でさえひとりぼっちで涙を流す女の子。
lines.translated: A girl shedding tears all alone, even within a dream.

lines.content: 十夜の不安は当たったのだ。
lines.translated: Toya's fears had been right.

lines.content: あの子はまだ心にさみしい気持ちを残してる。
lines.translated: That girl still had lonely feelings lingering in her heart.
A "Nightmare."

lines.content: その心のどこかに“悪夢”が住んでる。そしてあの子の心で暴れてる。
lines.translated: A "Nightmare" was living somewhere inside her heart. And it was rampaging within her.

lines.content: だからあんなに悲しそうで、さみしそう。ひとりぼっちで泣いている。
lines.translated: That was why she looked so sad and lonely, crying all by herself.

lines.content: 十夜は女の子のところに駆けていく。
lines.translated: Toya ran over to the girl.

lines.content: そして俺はあの“ぬいぐるみ”のことを思い出していた。
lines.translated: Meanwhile, I was remembering that "stuffed animal."

lines.content: あのときの“悪夢”は、持ち主の心の中を抜け出して――
lines.translated: The "Nightmare" back then had slipped out of its owner's heart--

lines.content: “夜”の中をまるで迷子のようにさ迷っていた。
lines.translated: And was wandering through the "Night" just like a lost child.

lines.content: この夢の世界のどこかに“悪夢”が隠れているかもしれない
lines.translated: "There might be a 'Nightmare' hiding somewhere in this dream world."

lines.content: 覚悟だ。
lines.translated: I braced myself.

lines.content: またあの“ぬいぐるみ”のときのように、自分自身を傷つけ暴れる“悪夢”を相手に、乱暴な手段を取らなければならないのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Just like back then with that "stuffed animal," we might have to resort to rough measures against a rampaging "Nightmare" that was hurting itself.

lines.content: そのための覚悟は決めておこう。
lines.translated: I needed to prepare myself for that.

lines.content: 心に“[魔法|想像力]”は充分だろうか。
lines.translated: Did I have enough "magic"--enough imagination--in my heart?

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら、俺も十夜の後を追う。
lines.translated: Thinking about these things, I followed after Toya.

lines.content: ちょうど十夜がお友だちの女の子に声をかけているところだった。
lines.translated: Toya was just calling out to the girl, her friend.

lines.content: 大丈夫？　……どうしたの？
lines.translated: "Are you okay? ...What's wrong?"

lines.content: 十夜は涙を流す女の子の手を握った。
lines.translated: Toya took the crying girl's hand.

lines.content: ねえ、教えて
lines.translated: "Hey, tell me."

lines.content: どうしてあなたはいつも、ひとりぼっちで泣いてたの？
lines.translated: "Why were you always crying all by yourself?"

lines.content: 十夜は言う。
lines.translated: Toya spoke.

lines.content: ……何かつらいことがあるなら教えて欲しい。
lines.translated: If something is hurting you, I want you to tell me.

lines.content: あなたを悲しくさせてる悪い夢が、まだまだ消えずに、心のどこかにあるのなら――……[・|そ][・|れ][・|を]“[・|夜]”[・|の][・|中][・|に][・|返][・|し][・|た][・|い]。
lines.translated: If a bad dream that's making you sad hasn't gone away yet, and is still somewhere inside your heart--...I want to return it to the "Night."

lines.content: 子どもの頃に抱えたつらい気持ちをそのままに、大人になってしまうと悲しいことが多いから……
lines.translated: "If you grow up while still holding onto the painful feelings you had as a child, there will be so much sadness waiting for you..."

lines.content: だからそんな心をあなたの中から連れ去りたい。
lines.translated: That's why I want to take that heartache away from inside you.

lines.content: あなたがどんなにつらくても。悲しくても。今夜からはきっと、大丈夫になる。私のお友だちが。大雅が。あなたのつらい気持ちを……悪い夢を、きっと倒してくれるから
lines.translated: "No matter how painful it is for you. No matter how sad you are. Starting tonight, you'll definitely be okay. Because my friend. Because Taiga. He'll definitely defeat your painful feelings... your bad dream."

lines.content: そのためには何があったのかを教えてもらわなければならない。
lines.translated: For that to happen, we needed her to tell us what had occurred.

lines.content: そうでなければ、心のどこに、夢の世界のどこに、“悪夢”が隠れているのかを見つけ出すことができないから……。
lines.translated: Otherwise, we wouldn't be able to find out where in her heart, or where in this dream world, the "Nightmare" was hiding...

lines.content: だからお願い。話してほしい
lines.translated: "So please. I want you to talk to me."

lines.content: ごめんね。嫌なことをわざわざ思い出させるなんて。そんなの。お友だち失格だけど
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. Making you remember unpleasant things on purpose like this... It makes me a terrible friend, doesn't it?"

lines.content: 十夜は唇を噛み締める。
lines.translated: Toya bit her lip tightly.

lines.content: ……でも、それでいい。それで嫌われたって構わない
lines.translated: "...Even so, that's fine. I don't care if you hate me for it."

lines.content: それであなたが、明日から、幸せに生きていけるなら……
lines.translated: "If it means that starting tomorrow, you can live happily..."

lines.content: もうあなたが、さみしくなくなるのなら……。私は
lines.translated: "If it means you won't be lonely anymore... Then I..."

lines.content: そう小さくちいさくつぶやいて、
lines.translated: Murmuring ever so faintly,

lines.content: 十夜は、言葉を詰まらせてしまう。
lines.translated: Toya choked on her words.

lines.content: “……十夜ちゃん”
lines.translated: "...Toya-chan."

lines.content: 女の子はぽつりと言う。
lines.translated: The girl murmured softly.

lines.content: うつむく十夜をじっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: She was staring intently at Toya, who was looking down.

lines.content: ふたりのことを背後から見ている俺は……。
lines.translated: Watching the two of them from behind, I...

lines.content: 十夜をじっと見つめる女の子の様子に、警戒してしまっている。
lines.translated: I found myself on guard at the way the girl was staring so fixedly at Toya.

lines.content: この子だ。
lines.translated: It's this girl.

lines.content: 今、目の前に座るこの子自身が、この子の“悪夢”の姿なのではないか――
lines.translated: Could it be that this girl sitting right in front of us is the form of her own "Nightmare"--?

lines.content: そのような感情が頭の中に広がっていたからだ。
lines.translated: Because that sort of feeling was spreading through my mind.

lines.content: “……あのね”
lines.translated: "...You know."

lines.content: 女の子は、首をかしげた。
lines.translated: The girl tilted her head.

lines.content: 十夜のことをじっと見つめたまま――こう、言った。
lines.translated: Still staring intently at Toya--she said this.

lines.content: “大丈夫……なの？”
lines.translated: "Are you... okay?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 十夜は顔を上げる。
lines.translated: Toya raised her head.
"Why have you always looked so lonely?"

lines.content: さみし、そう……？　私が？
lines.translated: "Lonely...? Me?"

lines.content: “うん”
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: そして女の子は小さく笑った。
lines.translated: Then the girl gave a small smile.

lines.content: “……お願い。私の大切なお友だち”
lines.translated: "...Please. My precious friend."

lines.content: 十夜の手を握り返して、女の子は言うのだ。
lines.translated: Squeezing Toya's hand back, the girl spoke.

lines.content: “さみしがり屋の不思議な子。私は、[・|私][・|た][・|ち][・|は]、あなたをひとりにしたくない”
lines.translated: "You lonely, mysterious girl. I--we--don't want to leave you all alone."

lines.content: “本当は、いつまでもずっと一緒にいたいけど……”
lines.translated: "Truthfully, I want to stay together with you forever and ever..."

lines.content: “でも、もう、[・|噂][・|ど][・|お][・|り]、さよならしないといけないのなら……。それが私たちの関係、なのなら。お願い”
lines.translated: "But if, just like the rumors say, we have to say goodbye now... If that is what our relationship is. Then please."

lines.content: お願いします、と女の子はまた涙を見せた。
lines.translated: "Please," the girl said, showing tears once more.

lines.content: “最後に私の夢を、あなたに……魔法のような、奇跡のような、小さなあなたに……聞いて欲しい”
lines.translated: "At the very end, I want you... someone small, like magic, like a miracle... to hear my dream."

lines.content: そう言うと女の子は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Saying that, the girl closed her eyelids.

lines.content: こぼれる涙を閉じ込めるみたいにして。
lines.translated: As if trying to lock away the spilling tears.
"I want to grant the dream of that person who is so precious to me..."

lines.content: “私の悪夢は、そこに、あるんだよ”
lines.translated: "My nightmare is right there, you see."

lines.content: ……ね、ねえ。どうしたの？　どこか、痛いの？
lines.translated: "...H-Hey. What's wrong? Does it hurt somewhere?"
