lines.content: 雨降りの公園でひとり泣いていたらそんな声が聞こえた。
lines.translated: When I was crying all alone in the rainy park, I heard a voice.

lines.content: 顔を上げると、女の子がひとり。
lines.translated: When I looked up, there was a single girl.

lines.content: 知らない子だった。
lines.translated: A girl I didn't know.

lines.content: その子が繰り返し私にこう問いかけた――……大丈夫？　どこか、痛いの？
lines.translated: She asked me this over and over--...Are you okay? Does it hurt somewhere?

lines.content: ……うん。ちょっとだけ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Just a little."

lines.content: 名前も知らない女の子に私はうなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded to the girl whose name I didn't even know.

lines.content: ちょっとだけ、胸のあたりがずきずきして、痛いの
lines.translated: "Right around my chest, it's throbbing and hurting just a little."

lines.content: そんな言葉をこぼすと……だめだ。
lines.translated: When I let those words spill out... it was no good.

lines.content: もう、だめだ。
lines.translated: It's too late.

lines.content: 心に自分の言葉が突き刺さり――小さなちいさな穴があく。
lines.translated: My own words pierced my heart--opening a tiny, tiny hole.

lines.content: そこから次々と“つらかったこと”が涙となってこぼれて落ちた。
lines.translated: From there, all the "painful things" spilled out one after another as tears and fell.

lines.content: 学校で……いやなことがあったの
lines.translated: "Something bad happened... at school."

lines.content: 気づけばその子に話していた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was talking to her.

lines.content: 私は、いじめられている。
lines.translated: I am being bullied.

lines.content: クラスメイトから。先生から。
lines.translated: By my classmates. By my teacher.

lines.content: 誰からも愛されない自分。鈍くさい自分。そんな自分のことを大嫌いな、自分。
lines.translated: A me who isn't loved by anyone. A clumsy me. A me who hates that version of myself.

lines.content: 学校に私の居場所なんてどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: There wasn't a place where I belonged anywhere at school.

lines.content: 自分自身の中にさえ、大嫌いな自分の居場所を認められなかった――
lines.translated: Even within myself, I couldn't accept a place for this me that I hated so much--

lines.content: それが、なに？
lines.translated: And so what?

lines.content: そんなのはもはやよくある話だ。
lines.translated: A story like that is all too common by now.

lines.content: 全国どこの学校にでも必ずひとつやふたつあるだろうし、大人の世界にだってそれはきっとあるはずだ。
lines.translated: There's bound to be one or two cases like it in every school across the country, and surely it exists in the adult world, too.

lines.content: 自分のことを好きだと言い切れる人間だって、さほど多くもないはずだ。
lines.translated: There probably aren't that many people who can say for sure that they like themselves, either.

lines.content: うん。そうだ。
lines.translated: Yeah. That's right.

lines.content: この世界は子どもも大人もつらいことだらけ。
lines.translated: This world is full of painful things for both children and adults.

lines.content: そしてその中でも、いじめなんてものはもう“つらいこと”の常套句のようなものだろう。
lines.translated: And among all of that, something like bullying is practically a cliche when it comes to "painful things."

lines.content: そこには目新しさもなければ、“私だってそれくらい何度も経験しているぞ”と鼻で笑われてしまう程度にはよくある話。
lines.translated: There's nothing new about it; it's such a common story that people would just scoff and say, "Even I've experienced that much plenty of times."

lines.content: だからそれくらいで泣いてるなんて――甘えちゃだめだ。
lines.translated: So crying over something like that--I mustn't be so spoiled.

lines.content: あなた以外の誰もがみんな、毎日懸命に、頑張っている。
lines.translated: Everyone else besides you is trying their absolute hardest every single day.

lines.content: そんなふうに呆れられるのが怖いから。
lines.translated: Because I was afraid of people being disgusted with me like that.

lines.content: そんなふうに怒られてしまうのが悲しいから。
lines.translated: Because it would make me sad to be scolded like that.

lines.content: だからこうして、誰もいない雨降りの公園で泣いていたのに……。
lines.translated: That was why I had been crying in a rainy park with no one around, and yet...

lines.content: お願い。……泣かないで
lines.translated: "Please. ...Don't cry."

lines.content: ……その子は静かにそう言った。
lines.translated: The girl quietly said that.

lines.content: つらそうに。悲しそうに。さみしそうに。
lines.translated: Looking pained. Looking sad. Looking lonely.

lines.content: 私なんかのよくある話を、まるで自分のことのように、聞いていた。
lines.translated: She was listening to a common story from someone like me as if it were happening to her.

lines.content: ねえ、知ってる？　悲しそうな女の子
lines.translated: "Hey, did you know? Sad-looking girl."

lines.content: この世界にはね、たくさんの“魔法”が、あるんだよ
lines.translated: "There is lots and lots of 'magic' in this world, you know."

lines.content: その子は言った。泣いてばかりの私の心を撫でるみたいに。
lines.translated: The girl said that. As if gently stroking my heart, which had done nothing but cry.

lines.content: ……悲しいことがちょっとだけ軽くなる“魔法”を、私、知ってるよ。それを一緒に試してほしいな
lines.translated: "...I know a 'magic' spell that makes sad things just a little bit lighter. I'd like for us to try it together."

lines.content: “魔法”？
lines.translated: "'Magic'?"

lines.content: うん、そうだよと言って、その子はうなずく。
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right," the girl said, nodding.

lines.content: つらいときとか、悲しいときとか。そういうときはね、なんだか身体の内側が重たくなるような……そんな気がしないかな
lines.translated: "When you're hurting, or when you're sad. At times like that, doesn't it kind of feel like the inside of your body gets heavy...?"

lines.content: う、うん。そう、かも……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Maybe, it does..."

lines.content: そんなときはね。つらい、悲しい、とってもさみしい……そんな気持ちが身体とか、心の中とかに、いっぱいいっぱい、詰まっちゃってるの
lines.translated: "At times like that, you see. Painful, sad, and very lonely feelings... they're packed so, so tightly inside your body and inside your heart."

lines.content: だからね。そんなつらい気持ちを言葉にして、身体の外に出してあげられれば……
lines.translated: "So, you see. If you can put those painful feelings into words and let them out of your body..."

lines.content: そしたら少し、ほんの少しだけかもしれないけれど、身体の重さが軽くなって……たくさん“大丈夫”になるんだよ――って、お姉ちゃんが言ってた
lines.translated: "Then a little, even if it's just a tiny bit, the heaviness in your body will get lighter... and you'll become 'okay' a whole lot--that's what my big sister told me."

lines.content: お姉ちゃん、が？
lines.translated: "Your big sister?"

lines.content: そう。それはきっとね、誰もが使える“魔法”のひとつ……なんだよって
lines.translated: "Yes. She said that it's surely one of the kinds of 'magic' that anyone can use..."

lines.content: 私の大好きなお姉ちゃんは“魔法使い”なの。他にもたくさんの“魔法”を知ってるよ
lines.translated: "My beloved big sister is a 'magician.' She knows lots of other 'magic' spells, too."

lines.content: だから、そんなお姉ちゃんに教えてもらった“魔法”のひとつを試してみたいのと、女の子は言う。
lines.translated: That was why she wanted to try out one of the "magic" spells her big sister had taught her, the girl said.

lines.content: この“魔法”はね、聞いてくれる人と話してくれる人が必要で、ひとりぼっちじゃできない“魔法”だから……
lines.translated: "You see, this 'magic' needs someone to listen and someone to talk, so it's a 'magic' spell you can't do all by yourself..."

lines.content: だから、お願い
lines.translated: "So, please."

lines.content: この“魔法”を覚えて、いつかお姉ちゃんみたいな“魔法使い”になりたい私に、協力してくれたら……うれしいな
lines.translated: "I want to learn this 'magic' and become a 'magician' like my big sister someday, so if you'd help me out... it would make me really happy."

lines.content: 笑顔でそう言う女の子。
lines.translated: The girl said that with a smile.

lines.content: だけどその表情はどこか震えているようにも見えたのだ。
lines.translated: However, her expression looked as though it were trembling slightly.

lines.content: たぶんこの子は私と同じだ。
lines.translated: Maybe this girl is the same as me.

lines.content: ……私と同じ、内気な子。
lines.translated: A shy girl, just like me.

lines.content: ほんとはこんなふうに、知らない[私|誰か]に平気で話しかけられるような子ではない。
lines.translated: Truthfully, she wasn't the kind of girl who could casually strike up a conversation with a complete stranger like me.

lines.content: でも、私のために無理をして、がんばって、話してくれてる――
lines.translated: Yet for my sake, she was pushing herself, trying her hardest to talk to me--

lines.content: [わけ|理由]もなくそう感じ取ることができたから。
lines.translated: For no particular reason, I could sense that.

lines.content: だから私も、話すことにした。その子の“魔法”を試してみることにした。
lines.translated: So I decided to talk, too. I decided to try out her "magic."

lines.content: ……クラスのとある子に目を付けられたの。みんなその子の言いなり
lines.translated: "...A certain kid in my class singled me out. Everyone does whatever they say."

lines.content: 皆がみんなその子に嫌われたくないからと、言われるままに私にだけ嫌なことをする。
lines.translated: Because none of them wanted to be disliked by that kid, they did as they were told and did awful things only to me.

lines.content: クラスメイトだけじゃない。先生も一緒になって。
lines.translated: Not just my classmates. My teacher joined in, too.

lines.content: 大人のことを上手に、思うように、操るようにできてしまう――“[・|要][・|領][・|の][・|い][・|い][・|子]”というのが、希にでもなく、いる。
lines.translated: Kids who know how to play the game--who can skillfully manipulate adults into doing whatever they want--aren't all that rare.

lines.content: 地獄だ。毎日がただの地獄の底だった。
lines.translated: It's hell. Every day was nothing short of the depths of hell.

lines.content: 私の口は止めどなく言葉をこぼした。
lines.translated: Words spilled endlessly from my mouth.

lines.content: 心に降り積もっていた“いやだったこと”
lines.translated: All the "awful things" that had piled up in my heart.

lines.content: 思い出すだけで悲しくて、悔しくて、涙がぽろぽろ止まらなくなってしまうこと。
lines.translated: The things that made me so sad and frustrated just by remembering them that the tears would start falling and wouldn't stop.

lines.content: 全部ぜんぶ、名前も知らないその子に話してしまっていた。
lines.translated: I ended up telling all of it, every last bit of it, to that girl whose name I didn't even know.

lines.content: ……そう
lines.translated: Yes.

lines.content: 女の子は目を閉じた。
lines.translated: The girl closed her eyes.

lines.content: ……すごいね
lines.translated: "...You're amazing."

lines.content: え？　……すごい？
lines.translated: "Eh? ...Amazing?"

lines.content: うん。すごいよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. You're amazing."

lines.content: あなたは毎日、すごく、とっても、がんばってるんだね
lines.translated: "You're trying so, so very hard every single day, aren't you?"

lines.content: だからすごいよと、その子は言った。
lines.translated: And that makes you amazing, the girl said.

lines.content: そんな言葉に、私は、泣いた。
lines.translated: Hearing those words, I cried.

lines.content: ずっとやさしくされたかった。
lines.translated: I had wanted someone to be kind to me for so long.

lines.content: 誰か……。ほんの少しだけでいい。誰か、お願い。
lines.translated: Someone... Just a little bit is fine. Someone, please.

lines.content: ……私のことを、気にかけてもらいたかった。
lines.translated: I had wanted someone to care about me.

lines.content: そんな小さなちいさな“夢”が叶ったような気さえして。
lines.translated: It even felt as though that tiny, tiny "dream" of mine had come true.

lines.content: 涙が。涙がぽろぽろ、止まらない。
lines.translated: Tears. The tears kept falling and wouldn't stop.

lines.content: そんな私の気持ちを全部わかっているみたいに、その子は……。
lines.translated: As if she understood all of my feelings, that girl...

lines.content: 突然現れたその女の子は。
lines.translated: That girl who had suddenly appeared.

lines.content: 雨が止むまでずっと、私の言葉が止むまでずっと、ずっと……。
lines.translated: Until the rain stopped, until my words ran dry, the whole time...

lines.content: ただただ静かに、私のそばを離れずにいてくれた。
lines.translated: She simply stayed quietly by my side without leaving.

lines.content: 雨が降る日はまた公園で会おうね
lines.translated: "Let's meet at the park again on rainy days, okay?"

lines.content: 私とその子はそんな約束をした。
lines.translated: The girl and I made that promise.

lines.content: 世界中が泣いてるみたいな雨の日だ。
lines.translated: On rainy days when it feels like the whole world is crying.

lines.content: 涙で大洪水みたいな世界のすみっこでくらい、思い切り泣いてみたっていいじゃない――そんなことを言って、あの子は笑う。私の弱気を許してくれる。
lines.translated: In a corner of a world that looks like it's flooding with tears, it's okay to cry your heart out, isn't it?--saying things like that, she would smile. Forgiving my weakness.

lines.content: 私と同じくらいの歳に見えるけど……だけど時どき、私なんかよりずっと、ずっと、大人びた言葉や横顔を見せる女の子。
lines.translated: She looked to be about the same age as me... yet sometimes, she showed a side of herself in her words and profile that was far, far more mature than someone like me.

lines.content: 不思議な子だった。
lines.translated: She was a mysterious girl.

lines.content: その子はいっつもひとり。
lines.translated: She was always alone.

lines.content: 誰か別のお友だちといるところを一度だって見たことがない。
lines.translated: I had never once seen her with any other friends.

lines.content: 心なしかいつもさみしそうにしているように見えた。
lines.translated: Somehow, she always looked lonely.

lines.content: 私と知り合うまであの子はどうしていたんだろう。
lines.translated: I wondered what she had been doing before she met me.

lines.content: ずっとずっと、ひとりきりだったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had she been all alone the entire time?

lines.content: 私とあの子は似た者同士。ふたりはどこか良くよく似ている。
lines.translated: She and I were two of a kind. The two of us were very much alike in some way.

lines.content: だからあの子といると、安心できた。
lines.translated: That was why being with her made me feel at ease.

lines.content: いくつもの雨の日を一緒に過ごした。
lines.translated: We spent many rainy days together.

lines.content: でも、まだ、名前も知らない私たち。
lines.translated: Yet we still didn't even know each other's names.

lines.content: 暗号みたいに“悲しそうな子”“さみしそうな子”と呼び合っている。
lines.translated: Like a secret code, we called each other "sad-looking girl" and "lonely-looking girl."

lines.content: 何かいやなことがあると、私は雨の日を待ち遠しく思うようになった。
lines.translated: Whenever something awful happened, I came to look forward to rainy days.

lines.content: あのね。今日もお話、聞いてくれる？
lines.translated: "Um, hey. Will you listen to me talk today, too?"

lines.content: ……うん。もちろんだよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Of course."

lines.content: 雨の日になると朝一番で公園に向かう。
lines.translated: Whenever it rained, I would head to the park first thing in the morning.

lines.content: するとあの子はいつも私よりも先にそこにいた。
lines.translated: And she would always be there waiting before I arrived.

lines.content: ……さくらの杜、“参禅町”にただひとつある公園。その隅にある屋根付きの休憩所だ。
lines.translated: The only park in Sanzen-cho, Sakura no Mori. A covered rest area in the corner of it.

lines.content: しとしとしとしと、雨が降る。
lines.translated: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter, the rain fell.

lines.content: ぐずぐずぐずぐず、言葉が止まない。
lines.translated: Sniffling and sobbing, my words wouldn't stop.

lines.content: 私をいじめるクラスの子も、先生も、皆みんな、私が早くいなくなってくれればいいって
lines.translated: "The kids in my class who bully me, and my teacher, too... every single one of them says they wish I would just disappear already."

lines.content: ……この世界に間違って産まれてきたってことを早く気づけば良いのにって
lines.translated: "...They said they wished I would hurry up and realize that I was born into this world by mistake."

lines.content: そのことに早く私が気づけるように、自分たちがそのお手伝いをわざわざしてあげてるのに……って。ひそひそ、ひそひそ、言ってたよ……
lines.translated: "They said they were going out of their way to help me realize that sooner... whispering and whispering..."

lines.content: 給食の時間。
lines.translated: During lunch period.

lines.content: 仲良しの子たちが席をくっつけ合って食べている、そんな時間の中で。
lines.translated: At a time when groups of friends pushed their desks together to eat.

lines.content: いつも教室の隅に追いやられ、ひとりぼっちで、みんなより少し汚い給食を食べている私に……。
lines.translated: To me, who was always forced into the corner of the classroom, eating a school lunch all by myself that had been made a little dirtier than everyone else's...

lines.content: そんな私に、聞こえるように大きな声で、ひそひそひそひそ、笑顔で、言ってたんだよ。
lines.translated: They whispered and whispered with smiles on their faces, loud enough to make sure I could hear them.

lines.content: ……私は、嫌われてる。いなくなればいいのにって、思われてる
lines.translated: "...I'm hated. Everyone wishes I would just disappear."

lines.content: 誰も私のこと好きだと思ってくれないのに。ここにいていいって、言ってくれないのに
lines.translated: "No one likes me. No one tells me that it's okay for me to be here."

lines.content: それなのにどうして、そんな場所で、そんな世界で、生きていかなきゃいけないのかな……
lines.translated: "And yet, why do I have to keep living in a place like that, in a world like that...?"

lines.content: どうしたって身体が、心が、震えてしまう。
lines.translated: No matter what I did, my body and my heart trembled.

lines.content: そんな私の手を取って、
lines.translated: Taking my hand as I shook,

lines.content: あなたは……
lines.translated: "You are..."

lines.content: 女の子は、言った。
lines.translated: The girl spoke.

lines.content: あなたはそんな人たちに嫌われて、正解なのかもしれないよ
lines.translated: "Maybe being hated by people like that is actually the right thing to be."

lines.content: 嫌な人に好かれるってことは、たぶん、それは自分もその人たちと同じ嫌な人だからだよ
lines.translated: "Being liked by awful people probably means that you're an awful person just like them."

lines.content: 嫌な人に嫌われる人は、いい子だからだよ。だからあなたは、誰かをいじめるような嫌な子なんかじゃないって、ことだよね……？
lines.translated: "People who are hated by awful people are good kids. So that means you aren't an awful kid who bullies others, right...?"

lines.content: それだけで、あなたの勝ちだよ
lines.translated: "That alone makes it your win."

lines.content: 今はつらいかもしれないけれど……世界は、物語は、絵本の中ででは、いつだって嫌な人が最後に負けるようにできてる。泣いてた子が最後に笑うの。そうでしょう？
lines.translated: "It might be painful right now... but the world, and stories, and picture books are always made so that the awful people lose in the end. The kid who was crying is the one who smiles last. Right?"

lines.content: さみしそうな女の子はにっこり笑った。笑いかけて、くれた。
lines.translated: The lonely-looking girl gave a bright smile. She smiled right at me.

lines.content: それが“魔法”の合図だと私には思えた。
lines.translated: To me, that felt like the cue for her "magic."

lines.content: その子の笑顔を見つめて、今日はさよなら、また次の雨の日にと手を振りあえたら……私の心はほんの少し、軽くなっているからだ。
lines.translated: Because when I gazed at her smile, said goodbye for the day, and waved to her with a promise to meet on the next rainy day... my heart would feel just a little bit lighter.

lines.content: だけど明けない夜がないように、暮れない青空もまたどこにもないのだ。
lines.translated: However, just as there is no night that never dawns, there is also no blue sky that never fades to dusk.

lines.content: あの子の“魔法”は確かに一時的な効果はあった。でも、それだけだ。
lines.translated: Her "magic" certainly had a temporary effect. But that was all.

lines.content: 悲しいことも。
lines.translated: The sad things.

lines.content: さみしいことも。
lines.translated: The lonely things.

lines.content: ……痛いことも。
lines.translated: And the painful things.

lines.content: 私の[世界|毎日]からなくなるようなことはまったくない。
lines.translated: They never disappeared from my everyday world at all.

lines.content: 次の日もしっかり嫌なことは列を成してまで私の前にやって来た。
lines.translated: The very next day, the awful things would line right up in front of me all over again.

lines.content: だけど、不思議だ。
lines.translated: Still, it was strange.

lines.content: 雨の日を重ねて。
lines.translated: Rainy day after rainy day passed.

lines.content: あの子の“魔法”を、何度も試していくうちに……少し。
lines.translated: As I tried out her "magic" over and over again... a little.

lines.content: ほんの少しだけ。
lines.translated: Just a tiny bit.

lines.content: 私の心は、頭の中の“夜色”から目を逸らすことができるようになっている。そんな自分に気づいた。
lines.translated: My heart became able to look away from the "color of night" inside my head. I realized that about myself.

lines.content: 代わりに些細な“うれしいこと”に目がとまる。
lines.translated: Instead, my eyes began to catch on trivial "happy things."

lines.content: そんな自分にも、気づく――今夜のお夕飯は私の大好物のビーフシチューだった。美味しい。思わずつぶやき、頬が緩んだ。
lines.translated: I noticed that about myself, too--tonight's dinner was my absolute favorite, beef stew. "It's delicious," I murmured without thinking, my cheeks relaxing into a smile.

lines.content: ……驚いた。
lines.translated: I was surprised.

lines.content: そんな私を見て、お母さんが泣いていたから。
lines.translated: Because my mom was crying as she watched me do that.

lines.content: 私は、気づけた。
lines.translated: I was able to realize it.

lines.content: 今までお母さんが毎晩、毎日、私の大好物ばかりを作って、私の帰りを待っていてくれたことに。
lines.translated: That until now, every night, every day, my mom had been making nothing but my favorite foods and waiting for me to come home.

lines.content: それは、私がいじめられるようになってからずっとだった。
lines.translated: It had been that way ever since I started getting bullied.

lines.content: 私がどんなに『放っておいて』と泣いて、叫んで、部屋の扉を乱暴に閉じてしまおうと……ずっと。毎日。毎晩。ずっと、ずっと。
lines.translated: No matter how much I cried and screamed "Leave me alone!" and slammed my bedroom door shut... the whole time. Every day. Every night. Always, always.

lines.content: 心配だったと、お母さん。
lines.translated: My mom told me she had been worried.

lines.content: あなたがこの頃ずっと、元気がないから、と、お母さん。
lines.translated: Because I hadn't had any energy lately, she said.

lines.content: 何があったのかと聞いてしまうと、あなたがもっと、もっと、悲しい思いをしてしまうような、気がして……怖かった。
lines.translated: She was afraid that if she asked what happened, it would only make me feel even sadder...

lines.content: でも、よかった。
lines.translated: "But thank goodness."

lines.content: 笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: "You smiled for me."

lines.content: もう二度と、あなたの笑顔を見られないんじゃないかって、不安で、心配で……どうしたら、いいのか……と、お母さん。
lines.translated: She told me she had been so anxious and worried that she might never see my smile again... and hadn't known what to do.

lines.content: 私が毎日大変だったことに、お母さんはなんとなく気づいていたみたいだった。
lines.translated: It seemed my mom had vaguely noticed how hard every day had been for me.

lines.content: そんな“大変さ”を恥ずかしいからと思い、誰にも相談できずにいた私にも……。
lines.translated: Even when I was too ashamed of those hardships to talk to anyone about them...

lines.content: ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: お母さんは言う。
lines.translated: My mom spoke to me.

lines.content: 何の役にも立てないお母さんで、本当に……ごめんね。
lines.translated: "I'm so sorry... for being such a useless mother."

lines.content: あなたのことが、こんなに、こんなに、大切なのに。
lines.translated: "Even though you're so, so precious to me."

lines.content: お母さんはぽろぽろ涙をこぼして、私をぎゅっと抱きしめた。
lines.translated: Big tears spilled from my mom's eyes as she hugged me tight.

lines.content: ああ。私は、もうひとつ、気づいた。
lines.translated: Ah. I realized one more thing.

lines.content: こんなにも近くにいつも味方でいてくれる人がいる。
lines.translated: There was someone right here beside me who was always on my side.

lines.content: 私はひとりぼっちじゃ全然なかった。
lines.translated: I wasn't all alone at all.

lines.content: ずっとずっと、この世界に産まれたときからずっと、そうだった。
lines.translated: It had always been that way, ever since the day I was born into this world.
"I want a kind person who will take my side more than anyone else to always be by my side."

lines.content: それが私の“夢”だったんだ――
lines.translated: That had been my "dream"--

lines.content: そんなことにも、私はようやく気づけた。
lines.translated: I was finally able to realize that, too.

lines.content: もう、大丈夫なの？
lines.translated: "Are you okay now?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 次の雨の日。さみしそうな女の子は私に言った。
lines.translated: On the next rainy day, the lonely-looking girl spoke to me.

lines.content: もう、悲しいことは、なくなった……？
lines.translated: "Are the sad things all gone now...?"

lines.content: ……どうして？
だって、何かいいことがあったって、顔に書いてあるよ
lines.translated: "Because it's written all over your face that something good happened."

lines.content: 今朝はずっとにこにこ、にこにこ、笑っているから。
lines.translated: Because I had been smiling so brightly all morning long.

lines.content: あの子はそう言い微笑んだ。
lines.translated: She smiled as she said that.

lines.content: ……うん。実はね。こんなことが、あったんだよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Actually, here's what happened."

lines.content: お母さんとのことを話した。
lines.translated: I told her about my mom.

lines.content: 私のことをずっと心配していてくれたお母さん。
lines.translated: About my mom, who had been worrying about me the whole time.

lines.content: 私のためにいっぱい涙を流してくれた、お母さん。
lines.translated: About my mom, who had shed so many tears for my sake.

lines.content: 抱きしめられていっぱい泣いた。これまでのつらかったこと全部をお母さんに私は話した。
lines.translated: I cried my eyes out in her arms. I told my mom about all the painful things I had been through up until now.

lines.content: もう大丈夫だよとお母さんは言った。話してくれてありがとうと、お母さんは、言った。
lines.translated: She told me everything was going to be okay now. She thanked me for telling her.

lines.content: もう二度とあなたに悲しい思いなんてさせないからねと、約束してくれた。
lines.translated: She promised me she would never let me feel sad like that ever again.

lines.content: うれしかった。安心だった。
lines.translated: I was so happy. So relieved.

lines.content: ……ねえ、聞いて。
lines.translated: Hey, listen to this.

lines.content: 私はひとりぼっちじゃなかったんだよ、さみしそうな女の子――お母さんの胸の中。太陽みたい。春の中みたいに暖かい。あのときのことを思い出すと、また、涙が出てきてしまう。
lines.translated: I wasn't alone at all, lonely-looking girl--inside my mom's arms, it was like the sun. As warm as being in the middle of spring. Just remembering that moment makes the tears start to fall all over again.

lines.content: 大きな、おおきな。“魔法”よりも大きな何かを、私は手に入れられた。
lines.translated: I had gained something huge, something even bigger than "magic."

lines.content: そんな夜があったことを、私は話した。
lines.translated: I told her all about that night.

lines.content: ……そう。よかった
lines.translated: "...I see. I'm glad."

lines.content: あの子は私に微笑んでいる。
lines.translated: The girl smiled at me.

lines.content: うれしそうに。安心したように。
lines.translated: Looking happy. Looking relieved.

lines.content: あなたが笑うの、私もはじめて見れて……うれしいな
lines.translated: "This is my first time seeing you smile, too... It makes me happy."

lines.content: 思えば、今日がはじめてだ。
lines.translated: Come to think of it, today was the first time.

lines.content: この子に。さみしそうな女の子に。
lines.translated: For this girl. For this lonely-looking girl.

lines.content: 辛くてつらくて、どうしようもなかったこと以外を聞いてもらうのは……はじめてだった。
lines.translated: It was the very first time I had ever had her listen to anything other than how painful and unbearable my life was.

lines.content: もう、大丈夫なんだね？
lines.translated: "So you're really okay now?"

lines.content: あの子は繰り返しそう言った。
lines.translated: She asked me that again.

lines.content: つらいことはもう、なくなった？
lines.translated: "Are the painful things all gone now?"

lines.content: つらいことだけじゃない。悲しいことも。……さみしいことも。全部ぜんぶ、ここに置いていかないと、だめだよ
lines.translated: "And not just the painful things. The sad things, too. ...And the lonely things. You have to leave all of it, every last bit of it, right here."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……あなた達には、子どもの時間に産まれた“つらい思い”を抱えたまま大人になると、どうしてかつらいことがたくさん、たくさん、起きてしまうことが……多いから
lines.translated: "...Because for all of you, if you grow into adults while still holding onto the painful feelings born during your childhood, for some reason, a lot more painful things... end up happening to you."

lines.content: さみしそうな女の子は唇をぐっと結んだ。
lines.translated: The lonely-looking girl pressed her lips tightly together.

lines.content: そして顔を伏せてしまう。
lines.translated: And then she cast her eyes down.

lines.content: さみしそうだった。
lines.translated: She looked so lonely.

lines.content: 今まで見た中で、一番……。
lines.translated: More than I had ever seen her before...

lines.content: そんな顔は見たくないと思った。
lines.translated: I didn't want to see her make a face like that.

lines.content: これまでたくさん私の心と身体を軽くしてくれたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though she had lightened my heart and body so many times until now...

lines.content: 私は、“魔法”よりも大きな何かを見つけられたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I had managed to find something even bigger than "magic"...

lines.content: それなのにあなたは、今でも変わらず、さみしそう。
lines.translated: Despite all that, you still look just as lonely as ever.

lines.content: ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: そう言いたかった。
lines.translated: That was what she wanted to say.

lines.content: ……本当はね。
lines.translated: To tell the truth.

lines.content: あの日、あなたに会えた最初の日。
lines.translated: That day, the very first day I met you.

lines.content: 私は、その日を、自分の最後の日にしようと思っていたの。
lines.translated: I was planning to make that day my last.

lines.content: あまりに嫌なことが多いから。あまりに悲しいことばかりが起こるから。
lines.translated: Because there were just too many awful things. Because nothing but sad things ever happened to me.

lines.content: ……それはこの世界が、神さまが、私のことを嫌ってる証拠なんだと思っていた。だからもう、最後にしようと。
lines.translated: I thought it was proof that this world, and God, hated me. So I decided to just end it all.

lines.content: そのための最善の方法を、雨降りの公園で考えていた。
lines.translated: I was sitting in the rainy park, thinking about the best way to do it.

lines.content: だけどあなたに声をかけられて……。
lines.translated: But then you called out to me...

lines.content: この世界からさよならするのが……ちょっと、怖くなった。
lines.translated: And saying goodbye to this world became... a little bit scary.

lines.content: そしてあなたがくれた小さな“魔法”で、呼吸をやめた心が、少しずつ色づくようで……だから、私は、
lines.translated: Then, with the little bit of "magic" you gave me, my heart that had stopped breathing slowly began to regain its color... And that's why I...

lines.content: ……今度はあなたの“夢”を、叶えてあげたい
lines.translated: "...This time, I want to make your 'dream' come true."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ありがとう、ひとりぼっちの女の子。私はもう平気。大丈夫だよ
lines.translated: "Thank you, lonely girl. I'm fine now. I'm going to be okay."

lines.content: “誰よりも味方でいてくれるやさしい人がそばにいてほしい”
lines.translated: "I want a kind person who will take my side more than anyone else to be by my side."

lines.content: そんな私の“夢”は、あなたの“魔法”が軽くしてくれた心で、少しずつだけど叶えていける。
lines.translated: With my heart lightened by your "magic," I can make that "dream" of mine come true, little by little.

lines.content: でも、私はね。もうひとつだけ気づいたことがある。
lines.translated: But you know, there's just one more thing I realized.

lines.content: ……きっと、私だけじゃないよね
lines.translated: "...I'm sure I'm not the only one, right?"

lines.content: ねえ、さみしそうな女の子。なんだか不思議な、小さな子
lines.translated: "Hey, lonely-looking girl. Mysterious little girl."

lines.content: あなたはきっと、ここで、雨降りのこの公園で、これまで私みたいな子たちの心を、たくさん、いっぱい、引き受けていてくれたんだよね……？
lines.translated: "Here in this rainy park, you've been taking on the hearts of so, so many kids just like me all this time, haven't you...?"

lines.content: このさくらの杜にはたくさんの“噂話”がある。
lines.translated: There are many rumors in Sakuranomori.

lines.content: その中に、“雨の日になると公園に現れる、子どもたちのさみしい気持ちを受け取る[・|何][・|か]”についての“噂”があることを、最近知ったのだ。
lines.translated: Recently, I learned that among them is a rumor about "something" that appears in the park on rainy days to take away children's lonely feelings.

lines.content: あなたの“魔法”は、きっと、私たちの心を軽くしている代わりに、あなたのことをずっとさみしくさせている。そんな気がしたのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but feel that in exchange for lightening our hearts, your "magic" has been keeping you lonely forever.

lines.content: だから、教えて。女の子。あなたの“夢”を教えて欲しい
lines.translated: "So tell me, girl. I want you to tell me what your 'dream' is."

lines.content: これまであなたが“魔法”をかけた、たくさんの子たちの代わりにお礼がしたいよ
lines.translated: "I want to thank you on behalf of all the kids you've cast your 'magic' on until now."

lines.content: そしてあなたのさみしそうな横顔を少しだけでも消し去りたい――そう願う。そう祈る。
lines.translated: And I want to wipe away even a little bit of that lonely look on your face--that is my wish. My prayer.

lines.content: 私の……“夢”
lines.translated: "My... 'dream'?"

lines.content: そんなの考えてもみなかった。目を丸くしたあの子の顔がそう言っていた。
lines.translated: The wide-eyed look on her face said she had never even thought about such a thing.

lines.content: あの子は[まぶた|瞼]を閉じる。胸にそっと触れてみる。
lines.translated: She closed her eyes and gently touched her chest.

lines.content: そしてほんの少しの時間が過ぎて……。
lines.translated: Then, after a short moment passed...

lines.content: 私の、“夢”は
lines.translated: "My 'dream' is..."

lines.content: あの子は言った。雨降りの空をそっと、見上げて。
lines.translated: She spoke, gazing softly up at the rainy sky.

lines.content: ……お友だちと、遊びたい
lines.translated: "...I want to play with a friend."

lines.content: 一度でいいから、お友だちと遊んでみたかった
lines.translated: "Just once is fine, I wanted to try playing with a friend."

lines.content: 小さな声だった。
lines.translated: Her voice was tiny.

lines.content: 恐る恐る。
lines.translated: Timid.

lines.content: まるで口にするだけで罰せられてしまう――そんな言葉を扱うみたいに。
lines.translated: As if she were handling words that she would be punished for merely speaking aloud.

lines.content: ……ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: 今までここでこうして話すばかりで……話を聞いてもらうばっかりで、この子と一緒に遊んだりして過ごすことはなかった。
lines.translated: Until now, all we ever did here was talk... All I ever did was have her listen to me, without ever spending time playing together with her.

lines.content: それは私だけじゃない。そんな気がした。
lines.translated: And I had a feeling it wasn't just me.

lines.content: きっと誰もがこの子のことを“お友だち”だと思う者はいなかった。
lines.translated: Surely, not a single person had ever thought of this girl as a "friend."

lines.content: いつもひとり。ひとりぼっち。誰にも仲間に入れてもらえない。
lines.translated: Always alone. All by herself. Never let into anyone's circle.

lines.content: そんなあなたの気持ちを、ようやく想像できた私は……涙が、こぼれた。
lines.translated: Now that I could finally imagine how you felt... my tears spilled over.

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: 誰もがみんな、そして私も、やさしいこの子に嫌な言葉ばかりを押しつけて……。
lines.translated: Everyone, myself included, just pushed nothing but awful words onto this kind girl...

lines.content: そして用がなくなれば綺麗さっぱり、この子のことも、ここで過ごした時間もみんな、最初からなかったことみたいに忘れてしまい――もう二度と、ここに訪れることはない。
lines.translated: And once they had no more use for her, they completely forgot about her and the time they spent here, acting as if none of it had ever happened from the start--never to visit this place again.

lines.content: それでもあなたはまた雨の日に、ここで、ひとりぼっちで、私たちを待っいる――
lines.translated: Yet even so, on the next rainy day, you wait here for us, all alone--

lines.content: そんなのは、ひどい。あんまりだ。
lines.translated: That's terrible. It's just too cruel.

lines.content: あなたのさみしい気持ちの正体を、私ははじめて知った気がしたのだ。
lines.translated: For the first time, I felt like I understood the true nature of your loneliness.

lines.content: 約束
lines.translated: "It's a promise."

lines.content: 私は女の子と指切りをする。
lines.translated: I linked pinky fingers with the girl.

lines.content: ……今度は、雨の降っていない晴れの日に会おうね
lines.translated: "...Next time, let's meet on a sunny day when it isn't raining, okay?"

lines.content: そしていっぱい、遊ぼうね――絶対、ぜったいだよ
lines.translated: "And let's play a whole lot--no matter what, okay? I mean it."

lines.content: 戸惑うあの子に、私は強くうなずいた。
lines.translated: Seeing her bewilderment, I nodded firmly.

lines.content: ……あなたの名前は？
lines.translated: What is your name?

lines.content: そう問いかけた。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: ……十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: あの子は答えた。
lines.translated: She answered me.

lines.content: じゅうのよると書いて、十夜。
lines.translated: Toya, written with the characters for "ten" and "night."

lines.content: 綺麗な名前だねと私は笑う。
lines.translated: I smiled and told her it was a beautiful name.

lines.content: あなたの名前もすてきだよと、あの子は言った。
lines.translated: She said my name was lovely, too.

lines.content: ……ありがとう
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 私の名前を聞いてくれたの、あなたがはじめてかも……しれないよ
lines.translated: "You might... actually be the very first person to ever ask me my name."

lines.content: あの子は、笑った。
lines.translated: She smiled.

lines.content: 笑ってくれた。
lines.translated: "You smiled for me."

lines.content: 幸せそうに。安心、したように。
lines.translated: Happily. As if relieved.

lines.content: ありがとうと言ってくれたその頬が、ほんの少しだけ、光って見えた。
lines.translated: As she thanked me, her cheeks seemed to glow just a little bit.

lines.content: 雨、止まないねと一緒に空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Saying that the rain just wouldn't stop, we looked up at the sky together.

lines.content: ……次の晴れの日が楽しみだった。
lines.translated: I couldn't wait for the next sunny day.

lines.content: いっぱい遊んで。
lines.translated: To play together as much as we wanted.

lines.content: いっぱい笑って。
lines.translated: To laugh together as much as we wanted.

lines.content: あの子のさみしかったことも話してもらって。
lines.translated: To have her tell me all about the times she felt lonely, too.

lines.content: そうしてあの子の心も軽くなってくれればいい。
lines.translated: And I hoped that doing so would lighten her heart as well.

lines.content: そしてあの子の“夢”を叶えることができたなら……。
lines.translated: And if I could make her "dream" come true...

lines.content: 私の小さなやさしいお友だちを、いっぱい笑顔にできたなら……。
lines.translated: If I could bring lots of smiles to the face of my kind little friend...

lines.content: 今度は私が、あの子に『もう、大丈夫？』と問いかけたい。
lines.translated: Then next time, I wanted to be the one to ask her, "Are you okay now?"

lines.content: あの子が最初に、私にそう声を掛けてくれたみたいに……。
lines.translated: Just like she had asked me when we first met...

lines.content: もう大丈夫？　もう平気？　もう、さみしくはない……？
lines.translated: Are you okay now? Are you alright now? Are you... not lonely anymore?

lines.content: さよならのときにそう問いかけて……。
lines.translated: If I could ask her that when it was time to say goodbye...

lines.content: あの子が『うん。もう、平気だよ。さみしくないよ』と、そう笑ってくれたなら……。
lines.translated: And if she smiled and told me, "Yeah. I'm alright now. I'm not lonely anymore"...

lines.content: 大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: 私も平気。
lines.translated: Then I would be alright, too.

lines.content: 私は安心して、この町を去って行ける……。
lines.translated: I could leave this town with peace of mind...

lines.content: そう、思えた。
lines.translated: That was how I felt.

lines.content: 私は転校することになった。
lines.translated: I was going to transfer schools.

lines.content: どこか遠い、とおい、別の町にある学校だ。
lines.translated: To a school in another town far, far away from here.

lines.content: そこはお母さんが生まれて育った場所なのだと教えてもらった。
lines.translated: I was told it was the place where my mother had been born and raised.

lines.content: やさしい人がたくさん暮らしているその場所で、私たちは新しい生活をはじめていくのだ。
lines.translated: We were going to start a new life together in that place where lots of kind people lived.

lines.content: 初めての場所は、怖い。
lines.translated: Going somewhere for the first time is scary.

lines.content: やさしい人たちは私にとってもやさしい人だとは限らない――……でも、平気だ。
lines.translated: Even if the people there are kind, there's no guarantee they'll be kind to me--...but I'll be fine.

lines.content: 何か悲しいことがあったとしても、大丈夫。
lines.translated: Even if something sad happens, I'll be okay.

lines.content: これからはお母さんがそばにいてくれる。私の味方でいてくれる――“夢”は、叶った。
lines.translated: Because from now on, Mom will be by my side. She'll be on my side--my "dream" came true.

lines.content: でも、ひとつだけ、この町でやり残したことがある。
lines.translated: However, there was just one thing I had left unfinished in this town.

lines.content: 雨降りのさくらの杜。“参禅町”
lines.translated: Sakuranomori in the rain. "Sanzen-cho."

lines.content: ここにあの子を残して行くのがどうしても気がかりだった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help feeling worried about leaving her behind in this place.

lines.content: 雨の日にしか出会えない私の友だち。
lines.translated: My friend whom I could only meet on rainy days.

lines.content: ……いつもひとりぼっちな、さみしそうな女の子。
lines.translated: That lonely-looking girl who was always all by herself.

lines.content: あの子の教えてくれた“魔法”が、私の“夢”を叶えてくれたんだと信じたい……。
lines.translated: I wanted to believe that the "magic" she taught me was what made my "dream" come true...

lines.content: だから今度は私が、あの子だけではない……誰か、たくさんの誰かの“夢”を叶えられる自分になりたい。
lines.translated: So this time, I wanted to become someone who could grant the "dreams" of not just her... but of someone else, of many other people.

lines.content: そう願い、祈ったが故の約束だった――“晴れた日にふたり一緒で公園を出てお出かけしたら、きっと、楽しい”
lines.translated: Our promise was born from that wish, that prayer--"If the two of us leave the park and go out together on a sunny day, it'll surely be fun."

lines.content: だって、そんな世界はきらきら輝いているように感じられたのだ。
lines.translated: Because a world like that felt as though it would shine and sparkle.

lines.content: そうして思い描いた未来の光景は、まるで大切な“魔法”みたいに、私の中に笑顔によく似た気持ちを連れて来てくれたから。
lines.translated: Because the vision of the future I pictured in my mind brought a feeling much like a smile into my heart, just like precious "magic."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: だけど、雨は止まない。
lines.translated: Yet the rain wouldn't stop.

lines.content: 世界にきらきら光る涙ばかりが降り注ぐ。
lines.translated: Nothing but sparkling tears continued to pour down upon the world.

lines.content: さくらの花は静かに散り行き……。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms quietly scattered away...

lines.content: さよならの日が、迫る。
lines.translated: And the day of our goodbye drew near.

lines.content: あの子と会えない日が続いていた。
lines.translated: Days went by without me being able to see her.

lines.content: 雨の日に公園に行ってみてもあの子はいない。どこにも、いない。
lines.translated: Even when I went to the park on rainy days, she wasn't there. She was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: たぶんあの子も[約束の日|晴れの日]を待っているんだと――私は、信じる。
lines.translated: Maybe she's waiting for the promised sunny day, too--that's what I believed.

lines.content: ねえ。あなたも一緒に町を出ない？　新しい私のお家でずっと暮らそう。
lines.translated: Hey. Why don't you leave town with me? Let's live together forever at my new house.

lines.content: 一緒に遊ぶ“約束”をした日に、そう誘っていた。
lines.translated: I had invited her to do just that on the day we made our "promise" to play together.

lines.content: そうしたらいつでも一緒に遊べるよ。ずっとずっとお友だちでいられるよ、と。
lines.translated: Telling her that if she did, we could play together anytime, and be friends forever and ever.

lines.content: それは私の心が、どこかであの子はふつうの子とは違うと気づいていたからだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think it was because somewhere deep down, my heart had realized she was different from normal kids.

lines.content: それは……。
lines.translated: That...

lines.content: 一度この子と離れ離れになってしまったら、もう二度と私たちは会えなくなると、どこかで予感していたからだと、思う。
lines.translated: I think it was because some part of me had a premonition that once we were separated, we would never be able to see each other again.

lines.content: 『……ありがとう』
lines.translated: "'...Thank you.'"

lines.content: あの子が微笑みながらつぶやいた言葉が蘇る。
lines.translated: The words she had murmured with a smile came back to me.

lines.content: 『あなたの“約束”、すごくうれしい』
lines.translated: "Your 'promise' makes me so happy."

lines.content: 『あたなと一緒にお引越し……そんなお誘いもすてきだなって、思う』
lines.translated: "Moving away together with you... I think an invitation like that is wonderful, too."

lines.content: あの子は微笑んだまま、小首をかしげるようにした。
lines.translated: Still smiling, she gave a slight tilt of her head.

lines.content: 『みんな、私のことを忘れてしまうけど……』
lines.translated: "Everyone ends up forgetting about me, though..."

lines.content: 『私だけが、いつまでもずっと、忘れられないままでいるけれど……』
lines.translated: "While I'm the only one left never being able to forget, forever and ever..."

lines.content: 『そんな私なんかに、こんな“お誘い”や“約束”をしてくれたのは、あなたが……はじめて。それだけで私の“夢”は叶ったような気がするよ。だからすごく、うれしい』
lines.translated: "You're... the very first person to ever give someone like me an 'invitation' or a 'promise' like this. That alone makes me feel like my 'dream' has come true. So I'm really, truly happy."

lines.content: 『でもね。きっと、ね……ごめんね。あなたはやっぱり、全部忘れてしまうよ』
lines.translated: "But you know. I'm sure... I'm sorry. In the end, you're going to forget all of it, too."

lines.content: あの子のさみしい色の微笑みは、ずきりと私の胸に突き刺さる。
lines.translated: Her lonely-looking smile pierced sharply into my chest.

lines.content: 『あなたのことを信じていないわけじゃない。ここで出会えたあなた達全員のことも同じだよ。みんな傷つきやすくて、だからとってもやさしい人だったから。ただ……』
lines.translated: "It's not that I don't believe in you. It's the same for all of you whom I've met here. You were all easily hurt, which made you very kind people. It's just..."

lines.content: 『ただ、ね。あなた達はみんな、大人になるイキモノで。そして私たちは、[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|イ][・|キ][・|モ][・|ノ]だから……だからそれで、いいんだよ』
lines.translated: "It's just, you know. All of you are creatures who grow up into adults. And we are *that* kind of creature... so it's okay this way."

lines.content: あの子は歌うようにそう言って。
lines.translated: She spoke as if singing.

lines.content: 変わらず少しさみしそうな笑顔で私を見つめ――“忘れてしまおうよ”と、そう言った。
lines.translated: Gazing at me with that same slightly lonely smile--she told me, "Let's just forget."

lines.content: 『……今日までのことは全部ぜんぶ、綺麗に、さっぱり、忘れてしまえばそれでいい』
lines.translated: "...It's fine if you just cleanly and completely forget every single thing that happened up until today."

lines.content: 『人はみんな、つらいことを忘れることで生きていけるようになるイキモノなんだって、そんなふうに生きるから、幸せになれるイキモノなんだって、お姉ちゃんが言ってた』
lines.translated: "My big sister told me that all humans are creatures who manage to keep living by forgetting painful things, and that living that way is what allows them to find happiness."

lines.content: 『だからね。悲しそうだった女の子。今はもう、うれしそうな顔の、女の子』
lines.translated: "So, you know. Little girl who used to look so sad. Little girl who now has such a happy look on her face."

lines.content: 『つらかった気持ちも言葉も、そして記憶も……全部ここに、この時間の中に置いて行ければ……それでいいんだよ。私はそのために、ずっとここにこうしているんだから』
lines.translated: "If you can leave all your painful feelings, words, and even memories... right here, inside this time... then that's enough. Because that's the whole reason I'm always here like this."

lines.content: だからお願い、私のことなんて気にしないでね、とあの子は言う。
lines.translated: So please, don't worry about me at all, she said.

lines.content: 『……だけどね。私の大切なお友だち。もしも全部忘れてしまっても、お願いね、悲しい気持ちにだけはならないで』
lines.translated: "...Still, you know. My precious friend. Even if you do end up forgetting everything, please, just don't let yourself feel sad."

lines.content: 『私のことなんてこれっぽっちも気にしないで……お願い。幸せに、生きてね』
lines.translated: "Don't worry about me the tiniest bit... Please. Live a happy life, okay?"

lines.content: 『私は、ここからあなたのことをずっと応援してるから』
lines.translated: "Because I'll always be cheering you on from right here."

lines.content: 『ずっとここで、ずっと、ここから……ねえ、うれしそうな顔の女の子。[・|忘][・|れ][・|な][・|い][・|で][・|ね]。私、いつもあなたのそばに、幸せな“魔法”がありますようにって……祈ってるよ』
lines.translated: "Always right here, always from right here... Hey, happy-looking girl. *Don't forget, okay?* I'll always be praying... that there is happy 'magic' right by your side."

lines.content: そんな大人びたことを口にするあの子は――
lines.translated: After saying something so grown-up, she--

lines.content: 『え、えへへ。お姉ちゃん[・|た][・|ち]の決めぜりふを真似てみたの』
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe. I tried copying my big sisters' catchphrase."

lines.content: どうかな、格好いいかなと、幼い笑顔を見せてくれていた。
lines.translated: She showed me a childish smile, asking if I thought she sounded cool.

lines.content: 私はお姉ちゃんみたいな“魔法使い”になれるかな、と。
lines.translated: Wondering aloud if she could become a "magician" like her big sister.

lines.content: 私は、誓う。
lines.translated: I swear to myself.

lines.content: “約束”をする。
lines.translated: I make a "promise."

lines.content: 忘れない。
lines.translated: I won't forget.

lines.content: 忘れないよ。
lines.translated: I won't forget you.

lines.content: 他の子たちがどうだったのかは知らないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't know how it was for the other kids...

lines.content: この世界が、この時間が、どんな規則に縛られているのかなんて、理解もできないけれど……。
lines.translated: And I can't even begin to understand what kind of rules bind this world, or this time...

lines.content: 私は絶対に、あなたのことを忘れたりしない。
lines.translated: But I will never, ever forget about you.

lines.content: あなたと出会えて私の中の雨は止み……。
lines.translated: Meeting you made the rain inside me stop...

lines.content: 真っ暗闇の“夜”の中に、たくさん、たくさん、きらきら光る星を見つけたような気がしてる。
lines.translated: And I feel like I've found so, so many sparkling stars within the pitch-black "night."
And my "dream" came true. *I was even able to find a new "dream."*

lines.content: こんなすてきな出会いを忘れられるはずがない。
lines.translated: There is no way I could ever forget such a wonderful encounter.

lines.content: だから“約束”をしよう。
lines.translated: So let's make a "promise."

lines.content: 必ずここで……。
lines.translated: Without fail, right here...

lines.content: 今度は晴れた日に、ここで待ち合わせしようねと――約束、したんだ。
lines.translated: We made a promise--that next time, on a sunny day, we would meet up right here.

lines.content: ああ……、早く。
lines.translated: Ah... I can't wait.

lines.content: 早く晴れの日が、来ないかなあ。
lines.translated: I wonder if a sunny day will come soon.

lines.content: ふたりで手と手をつないで、空を見上げる――……
lines.translated: The two of us holding hands, looking up at the sky--...

lines.content: 私たちは“約束”を果たせる日をじっと待っていた。
lines.translated: We waited patiently for the day we could fulfill our "promise."

lines.content: 公園に来ていた。雨降りの公園だ。
lines.translated: I had come to the park. A rainy park.

lines.content: 屋根付きの休憩所で雨宿り。
lines.translated: Taking shelter from the rain under the roofed rest area.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで空を見上げた。
lines.translated: All alone, I looked up at the sky.

lines.content: つらいことがあった。
lines.translated: Something painful had happened.

lines.content: 悲しいことが、あった。
lines.translated: Something sad had happened.

lines.content: 涙がこぼれる。
lines.translated: Tears spilled over.

lines.content: 眠れない夜がずっと続いた。
lines.translated: Sleepless nights dragged on and on.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで過ごす夜の時間がつらかった。
lines.translated: The nighttime hours I spent all alone were painful.

lines.content: すると、足が自然とここに向いたのだ。
lines.translated: And so, my feet naturally led me here.

lines.content: 私の“夢”は学校の先生になることだった。それが私の新しい“夢”
lines.translated: My "dream" was to become a schoolteacher. That was my new "dream."

lines.content: いつかの私みたいに、悲しい思いをしている子をひとりにさせない。絶対に、させない。
lines.translated: I wouldn't let children who were feeling sad end up all alone, like I once was. I would never let that happen.

lines.content: その“夢”を叶えるためにたくさん勉強をした。
lines.translated: I studied hard to make that "dream" come true.

lines.content: いじめられていたことがつらくって、余裕がなくて……。
lines.translated: Being bullied had been so painful, leaving me with no room to breathe...

lines.content: あの頃は遅れ気味だった勉強も、次第次第に得意になった。
lines.translated: Even my studies, which I had fallen behind on back then, gradually became my strong suit.

lines.content: 結婚する前は先生だったお母さんがつきっきりで教えてくれたから――ふたりでがんばるそんな時間が、きっと私は、大好きだった。
lines.translated: Because my mother, who had been a teacher before getting married, stayed right by my side to tutor me--I'm sure I truly loved that time we spent working hard together.

lines.content: いくつかの大変なこと。
lines.translated: A number of hardships.

lines.content: いくつかの、うれしいこと。
lines.translated: A number of happy moments.

lines.content: そんな瞬間がめぐって来る度に、私はお母さんと一緒に泣いて、一緒に笑って、一緒に怒って……。
lines.translated: Every time such moments came around, my mother and I cried together, laughed together, got angry together...

lines.content: そんなたくさんの時間を経て、私は“新しい夢”を叶えられた。
lines.translated: After spending so much time like that, I was able to make my "new dream" come true.

lines.content: 小学校の先生として一生懸命働いた。
lines.translated: I worked as hard as I could as an elementary school teacher.

lines.content: 子どもたちみんなが笑顔になれる方法をいつもいつでも探してた。
lines.translated: I was always, constantly searching for a way to make all the children smile.

lines.content: それでも、頑張ればがんばるほど上手くいかないことが多くなる。
lines.translated: Even so, the harder I tried, the more things seemed to go wrong.

lines.content: その度にお母さんがそばで励ましてくれた。
lines.translated: Every time that happened, my mother was by my side to encourage me.

lines.content: “大丈夫”“無理をしないで”“先生だって完璧じゃない。間違えてもいいのよ”“あなたの決めた道だもの。あなたにとってそれが何より正解よ”
lines.translated: "It's okay." "Don't push yourself too hard." "Even teachers aren't perfect. It's okay to make mistakes." "This is the path you chose. For you, that makes it the right answer above all else."

lines.content: お母さんが私にくれたたくさんの言葉は、今でも私の中で星の瞬きみたいに光ってる。
lines.translated: The many words my mother gave me still shine inside me even now, like twinkling stars.

lines.content: それを思うと。
lines.translated: When I think of that.

lines.content: それを思ってしまうと。
lines.translated: When I let myself think of that.

lines.content: 胸が、痛んだ。
lines.translated: My chest ached.

lines.content: 涙がぽろぽろ止まらない。
lines.translated: My tears wouldn't stop falling.

lines.content: お母さんが遠いところに旅立った。
lines.translated: My mother had departed on a journey to a faraway place.

lines.content: ひとりだ。ひとりぼっちになった。
lines.translated: I am alone. I ended up all alone.

lines.content: いつまでもずっと味方だよと、笑顔をくれる人はもういない。どこにもいない。
lines.translated: The person who gave me a smile and told me she would always, forever be on my side is no longer here. She isn't anywhere.

lines.content: 子ども達を励ましたい。お母さんと同じ教師になる。私の“夢”は叶えられたけど……ひとつ、大きな“夢”を失った。
lines.translated: Wanting to encourage children. Becoming a teacher just like my mother. My "dream" came true, and yet... I lost one great big "dream."

lines.content: それからというもの何もかもが上手くいかなくなった。
lines.translated: Ever since then, everything started going wrong.

lines.content: 孤独だった。
lines.translated: I was lonely.

lines.content: 痛い。
lines.translated: It hurts.

lines.content: さみしい。
lines.translated: I'm lonely.

lines.content: どこかが、寒い。
lines.translated: Somewhere inside, I felt cold.

lines.content: いじめられっ子は子どもの世界だけじゃない、大人の世界にも、いるんだよ
lines.translated: "Bullied kids don't just exist in the world of children. They're in the adult world, too."

lines.content: 雨降りの中。休憩所のベンチに座り、誰にともなく私はつぶやいた。
lines.translated: In the falling rain. Sitting on the bench in the rest area, I murmured to no one in particular.

lines.content: 子どもの頃はまだよかった
lines.translated: "It was still better when I was a child."

lines.content: 気づけば誰かが守ってくれていた――いじめられていれば“かわいそうにね”と憐れんだり、一緒に悲しんでくれたりもした
lines.translated: "Before I knew it, someone would be protecting me--if I was being bullied, they would pity me, saying 'You poor thing,' or even share in my sadness."

lines.content: ……いじめはいけないことだと怒ってくれる人もいた。そういう大人が探せばどこかにひとりはいてくれた
lines.translated: "...There were even people who got angry on my behalf, saying that bullying is wrong. If you looked, there was always at least one adult like that somewhere."

lines.content: “悪”も“善”も、何より理解しやすい世界だった。
lines.translated: Above all else, it was a world where "good" and "evil" were easy to understand.

lines.content: でも、大人になると途端に誰も守ってくれなくなる
lines.translated: "But the moment you become an adult, suddenly no one protects you anymore."

lines.content: “わかるよ”って言って、やさしく手をつないでくれなくなる。弱い者には誰も近寄ろうとさえしなくなる。自分も弱い者だと思われるのがイヤだから
lines.translated: "No one says 'I understand' and gently holds your hand anymore. No one even tries to approach the weak. Because they don't want to be seen as weak themselves."

lines.content: どころか“甘えるな”と叱られる。いけないことをそれはだめだと怒って、味方になってくれる人がいなくなる
lines.translated: "In fact, you get scolded and told to 'stop acting spoiled.' There's no longer anyone to get angry that wrong things are wrong, no one to take your side."

lines.content: つらくても。悲しくても。さみしくても。自分で考えろと突っぱねられるだけでなく、“責任”って言葉を盾にして……子どもがするよりも幼稚なことが平気で許されてしまう
lines.translated: "Even when it's painful. Even when it's sad. Even when you're lonely. Not only are you brushed off and told to figure it out yourself, but people use the word 'responsibility' as a shield... and blatantly get away with things more childish than anything a kid would do."

lines.content: それが大人の世界だ。
lines.translated: That is the world of adults.

lines.content: 子どもな心を抱えたまま大人になると……つらい。
lines.translated: Growing into an adult while still holding onto a child's heart... is painful.

lines.content: そんな心には悲しいことが鈴なりのようにしてやって来る。そんな“誰か”の言葉を思い出してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Sad things come piling upon a heart like that in droves. I ended up remembering the words of that "someone."

lines.content: ねえ、“誰か”
lines.translated: Hey, "someone."

lines.content: まだ私は大人になり切れていないのか。
lines.translated: Have I still not fully grown into an adult yet?

lines.content: 心が甘えん坊な子どものまま、なのか。
lines.translated: Is my heart still that of a spoiled child?

lines.content: 大切な人に大切に護られ続けてきた私の心は、人一倍に大切にされ過ぎたから……いつの間にか打たれ弱くなったのか。
lines.translated: Because my heart, which was constantly and dearly protected by someone precious to me, was cherished far more than most... did it unknowingly become too fragile to take a hit?

lines.content: ……だから、大人になってもつらいことばかりが起こっているように思えて、しまうのか。
lines.translated: Is that why I end up feeling like nothing but painful things happen even after becoming an adult?

lines.content: ……教えて。誰か、教えてよ。私は、ただ……
lines.translated: "...Tell me. Someone, please tell me. I just..."

lines.content: ただ、誰かに、“そうだね、わかるよ、大変だったね”って、そう言ってほしくて……。
lines.translated: I just wanted someone to tell me, "That's right, I understand, you've had a really hard time"...

lines.content: ただそれだけを求めて、私はここへこうして、やって来ただけなのに――……でも、誰に？　いったい、誰に？
lines.translated: Wishing for nothing more than that, I came here just like this--...and yet, from whom? Just who was I hoping to hear it from?

lines.content: それを思い出せないことが何よりずっと悲しくて、私は泣いた。
lines.translated: Not being able to remember that was sadder than anything else, and I cried.

lines.content: 雨降りの雨粒よりもたくさん、たくさんの涙をこぼしてしまいたい。
lines.translated: I wanted to shed more, so many more tears than the raindrops falling from the sky.

lines.content: そう想い、願い、ただただ泣いた。
lines.translated: Thinking that, wishing that, I simply cried and cried.

lines.content: ――大丈夫？
lines.translated: --Are you all right?

lines.content: 声がかけられた。
lines.translated: A voice called out to me.

lines.content: 待ち望んだ“誰か”がやって来た。
lines.translated: The "someone" I had been longing for had arrived.

lines.content: 顔を上げた。
lines.translated: I raised my head.

lines.content: するとそこには[・|男][・|の][・|人]が、立っていた。知らない人だ。
lines.translated: Standing there was a *man*. A stranger.

lines.content: ――何か、あったんですか？　大丈夫ですか？
lines.translated: --Did something happen? Are you all right?

lines.content: その人は心配そうに私の顔を覗き込んでいた。
lines.translated: He was peering into my face with a worried expression.

lines.content: 少し話すと、不思議だった。
lines.translated: After we talked for a little while, I found it strange.

lines.content: その人も子どもの頃、雨の日になるとよくここにやって来ていたのだという。
lines.translated: He said that when he was a child, he used to come here often on rainy days, too.

lines.content: ここでつらかったことをひとりで語る。
lines.translated: He would talk to himself about painful things right here.

lines.content: そうするとなぜだかその夜はぐっすり眠れるようになったのだ、と。
lines.translated: And when he did, for some reason, he would be able to sleep soundly that night, he said.

lines.content: そうだ。ひとりだ。
lines.translated: That's right. Alone.

lines.content: たったひとりで雨降りの時間をここで過ごしていたはずだけど……。
lines.translated: I should have been spending the rainy hours here all by myself, and yet...

lines.content: ――ぼくは、ひとりじゃなかったような気がして。
lines.translated: --I felt like I wasn't alone.

lines.content: ――なんだか大切な友だちが、ここに、いてくれたような……気がして。
lines.translated: --For some reason, I felt like... a precious friend had been right here with me.

lines.content: なぜだろう。その友だちに呼ばれたように思ったのだ。
lines.translated: Why was that? He said he felt as though that friend had called out to him.

lines.content: だからふとした気まぐれみたいに来てみると、ひとりで泣いてる私を見つけたということだった。
lines.translated: So when he came here on what felt like a sudden whim, he found me crying all by myself.

lines.content: 私が待っていたのはこの人だろうか。
lines.translated: Was this the person I had been waiting for?

lines.content: その人の友だちは、私だったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was I that person's friend?

lines.content: わからない。
lines.translated: I had no idea.

lines.content: もう何もかもわからない。
lines.translated: I don't understand anything anymore.

lines.content: 何か大切なことを忘れてる。
lines.translated: I'm forgetting something important.

lines.content: 忘れたくないのに、絶対に、忘れちゃだめだったのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I didn't want to forget, even though I absolutely never should have forgotten...

lines.content: 私は手のひらを見つめる。ふと、“誰か”が手をつないでくれたような気がして……。
lines.translated: I stare at the palm of my hand. Suddenly feeling as though "someone" had held my hand...

lines.content: だけど、空っぽだ。空っぽの手のひらを私は、見つめる。
lines.translated: But it's empty. I stare at my empty palm.

lines.content: どうして……？
教えてよ……“誰か”
lines.translated: Tell me... "someone."

lines.content: どうして“さよなら”は、あるの
lines.translated: "Why do 'goodbyes' exist?"

lines.content: どうして、大切な人と、私たちは“さよなら”をしなくちゃならないの……。
lines.translated: Why do we have to say "goodbye" to the people who are precious to us...?

lines.content: そんなどうしようもない焦りだけがここにある。
lines.translated: Only that helpless sense of urgency remains here.

lines.content: 悲しくなった。
lines.translated: I felt sad.

lines.content: また、涙があふれた。
lines.translated: Tears welled up again.

lines.content: なんだか自分が、とってもひどいことをしてしまっているような気がして……。
lines.translated: For some reason, I felt like I had done something truly terrible...

lines.content: 破ってはいけない大切な“約束”を、平気な顔して破り捨ててしまっているような、気がして……。
lines.translated: I felt as though I had casually broken and thrown away an important "promise" that never should have been broken, without a care in the world...

lines.content: ごめん。ごめんね。ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. Please forgive me.

lines.content: 涙も、雨も、ごめんねも、[や|止]まずに流れ……。
lines.translated: The tears, the rain, and my apologies flowed endlessly without stopping...

lines.content: 風が吹いた。
lines.translated: The wind blew.

lines.content: 足元にくしゃくしゃのチラシが流されてくる。
lines.translated: A crumpled flyer was washed toward my feet.

lines.content: そこに、見つけた。
lines.translated: And there, I found it.

lines.content: “だいじょうぶ”
lines.translated: "It'll be okay."

lines.content: チラシの裏に、マジックで書かれた言葉を……見つけてしまった。
lines.translated: I found... words written in marker on the back of the flyer.

lines.content: “何があっても、どんなことがあっても、だいじょうぶ”
lines.translated: "No matter what happens, no matter what comes your way, it'll be okay."

lines.content: “忘れないで。ずっと、ずっと、あなたのことを応援してる”
lines.translated: "Don't forget. I'll always, always be cheering for you."

lines.content: “だからがんばれ、悲しそうな女の子”
lines.translated: "So do your best, sad-looking girl."

lines.content: “祈ってる”
lines.translated: "I'm praying for you."

lines.content: “あなたの隣に、いつもすてきな魔法がありますように”
lines.translated: "May wonderful magic always be right beside you."

lines.content: “あなたの未来に、たくさん、たくさんの笑顔が、ありますように”
lines.translated: "May your future be filled with lots and lots of smiles."

lines.content: 涙が、あふれた。
lines.translated: Tears overflowed.

lines.content: その日、公園で出会った男の人とは縁が途切れることなく連絡を取り合った。
lines.translated: My bond with the man I met at the park that day never broke, and we kept in touch.

lines.content: なぜだかとても気が合ったのだ。
lines.translated: For some reason, we got along remarkably well.

lines.content: ……やさしい人だった。
lines.translated: He was a kind person.

lines.content: 同時に、心の中に折れない光のような力強い“何か”を持っている人だった。
lines.translated: At the same time, he held "something" powerful inside his heart, like an unyielding light.

lines.content: でも、私と同じくらい、さみしがり屋な人でもあった。
lines.translated: Yet he was also just as prone to loneliness as I was.

lines.content: だからもう私たちは、ひとりぼっちになることだけは決してなかった。
lines.translated: And so, the two of us were never completely alone again.

lines.content: 言葉や心や記憶を重ねるうちに、わかったことがもうひとつある。
lines.translated: As we shared our words, hearts, and memories, there was one more thing I came to understand.

lines.content: どうやらその人の家は少し特殊な事情を抱えているようだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, his family had somewhat unusual circumstances.

lines.content: 端的に言えば芸事を受け継ぐ家系だ。
lines.translated: Simply put, they were a lineage that passed down traditional arts.

lines.content: もう少し言えば、芸術家の一族……で、あるそうだ。
lines.translated: To elaborate a bit, they were a clan of artists... or so I was told.

lines.content: 絵画。演劇。雅楽。等々だ。親戚縁者に至るまで、それぞれがそれぞれの得意分野を持っている。
lines.translated: Painting. Theater. Gagaku court music. And so on. Even down to his extended relatives, each and every one of them had their own specialty.

lines.content: その筋では一角の大家――というほどではないにしろ、先祖代々、古くからこの町に住み着いているようだった。
lines.translated: While they weren't quite renowned masters in those circles, it seemed his ancestors had lived in this town for generations, since ancient times.

lines.content: [・|し][・|き][・|た][・|り]などを重んじる家庭に入るのは中々に勇気のいることではあった。
lines.translated: Marrying into a household that placed such heavy value on *traditions* and the like certainly took a fair bit of courage.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 気持ちを伝えたのはどちらが最初だっただろうか。
lines.translated: I wonder which of us confessed our feelings first?

lines.content: 私たちが[・|一][・|緒]になるのはなぜかとても自然なことのように思えた。
lines.translated: For some reason, the two of us *getting together* felt like the most natural thing in the world.

lines.content: 生涯を誓いあい、私は、あの人の……旦那の家業をサポートしながら教師を続けた。
lines.translated: We vowed to spend our lives together, and I continued working as a teacher while supporting his... my husband's family business.

lines.content: たくさんだ。たくさん、たくさんの子たちを見送った。
lines.translated: There were so many. I saw off so, so many children.

lines.content: 歳を重ねるとなぜだか涙もろくなる。さくらの季節がいつしか私は苦手になった。
lines.translated: Growing older makes you prone to tears for some reason. Before I knew it, the cherry blossom season became difficult for me.

lines.content: 巣立って行く生徒たち一人ひとりに“おめでとう”を言い忘れぬよう、気持ちを強く持つのがやっとだった。そうでなければ私はすぐに泣いてしまっていただろうから。
lines.translated: It took everything I had to steel my heart so I wouldn't forget to say "congratulations" to each and every student leaving the nest. Otherwise, I would have burst into tears right away.

lines.content: 時は、過ぎゆく。
lines.translated: Time passes by.

lines.content: さくらの花が散りゆくよりもずっと早く。足早に。
lines.translated: Much faster than cherry blossoms scatter. Briskly.

lines.content: 私たちの心にも身体にも、少しずつちょうどいい皺や傷も増えていき……。
lines.translated: Little by little, our hearts and bodies gained just the right amount of wrinkles and scars...

lines.content: このままふたりで余生を過ごすのも悪くはないかと、指先で触れ合うみたいに微笑み合っていた頃だった。
lines.translated: It was around the time we were smiling at each other, as gently as fingertips brushing together, thinking it wouldn't be so bad to spend the rest of our lives just the two of us.

lines.content: 私たちはようやく子を成すことが叶った。
lines.translated: We were finally blessed with a child.

lines.content: 授かったのは元気な男の子。長男だ。
lines.translated: We were given a healthy baby boy. Our eldest son.

lines.content: 彼の家の人たちはよろこんだ。盛大に祭りごとを催してくれさえもした。
lines.translated: His family was overjoyed. They even held a grand celebration for us.

lines.content: おじいちゃんも、おばあちゃんも、彼の老齢な姉も……。
lines.translated: His grandfather, his grandmother, and his elderly sister...

lines.content: 内々で盛り上がるだけでなく、町中の人たちに“孫が産まれた”“うちの嫁がやってくれた”“かわいい嫁に似てすっごいかわいいぞ”――そんなふうに自慢して回ってさえもいた。
lines.translated: Not only did they celebrate amongst themselves, they even went around bragging to everyone in town--"Our grandson was born," "Our daughter-in-law did it," "He takes after our cute daughter-in-law, he's so adorable."

lines.content: 少し恥ずかしかったが、だけどもやっぱり、とれもうれしいことだった。
lines.translated: It was a little embarrassing, but even so, it made me truly happy.

lines.content: ああ。どうしよう。
lines.translated: Ah. What should I do?

lines.content: 幸せなことがまたひとつ、増えてしまった。
lines.translated: Yet another happy thing has been added to my life.

lines.content: ……幸せな宴の時間は一晩中続いた。
lines.translated: The joyous banquet lasted all through the night.

lines.content: そんなきらきら眩しい光景を、私とあの人は苦笑いで見つめていたのだった。
lines.translated: He and I watched that dazzling, sparkling scene with wry smiles.

lines.content: さあ。この幸せに名前を付けよう。
lines.translated: Now then. Let's give a name to this happiness.

lines.content: その名は“[とおや|遠矢]”とした。
lines.translated: We named him "Tooya."

lines.content: 私も、あの人も、いい名前だねと笑いあったことは、[・|今]も昨日のことのように思い出せてしまう。
lines.translated: *Even now*, I can remember the two of us laughing together and saying what a good name it was, as clearly as if it were yesterday.

lines.content: そしてまたなんだかちょっとさみしくてなって。悲しく、なって。
lines.translated: And then, somehow, I'd feel a little lonely again. A little sad.

lines.content: [・|思][・|い][・|出][・|せ][・|な][・|い][・|こ][・|と]をふたりで泣いた夜もいくつかあった――忘れてる。私たちは何かとても大切なことを忘れてしまっている。
lines.translated: There were several nights when the two of us cried over *what we couldn't remember*--we're forgetting. We've forgotten something terribly important.

lines.content: それを思い出せないことがとても、とても、悲しかった。いつまでもずっとさみしいままだった。
lines.translated: Not being able to remember it made us so, so sad. That lingering loneliness never went away.

lines.content: だけど私たちはその度に気づくのだ。
lines.translated: Yet every time, we would realize.

lines.content: 誰かがいつも私たちを応援してくれている。
lines.translated: Someone is always cheering for us.

lines.content: いつも、私たちの幸せを祈ってくれている誰かがいてくれる。
lines.translated: There is someone out there who is always praying for our happiness.

lines.content: 何も思い出せないけれど、それは確かなことだと思えるから……。
lines.translated: Even though we couldn't remember a thing, we knew that much for certain...

lines.content: たくさん。たくさん。いっぱい。いっぱい。
lines.translated: So much. So much. Lots and lots.

lines.content: 悲しいことやさみしいことを、大切な人と一緒に乗り越えていくことができた。
lines.translated: Together with the person precious to me, I was able to overcome the sad and lonely times.

lines.content: そしてその度にたくさんの幸せを見つけられる人生だった。
lines.translated: And it was a life where we found so much happiness each time we did.

lines.content: その幸せを一緒にお祝いしてほしい“誰か”のことを、私たちはいつも、探し続けてきたけれど……。
lines.translated: Even though we were always searching for that "someone" we wanted to celebrate that happiness with...

lines.content: ……ああ。やっと、思い出せたよ
lines.translated: "...Ah. I finally remembered."

lines.content: 真っ白な病室だ。
lines.translated: A pure white hospital room.

lines.content: 小さく独り言をこぼすだけでも、もう、つらい。
lines.translated: Just letting out a quiet murmur to myself is already painful now.

lines.content: 私の命はもうすぐ終わる。
lines.translated: My life will end soon.

lines.content: 寿命だ。よく、よく、生きた。
lines.translated: It's the end of my natural lifespan. I lived well, truly well.

lines.content: 手はしわくちゃで、髪は真っ白。
lines.translated: My hands are wrinkled, and my hair is pure white.

lines.content: ご飯もほんのちょっとでよくなって。
lines.translated: Just a tiny bit of food is enough for me now.

lines.content: 居眠りしながら一日の多くを過ごすようになっていた。
lines.translated: I've come to spend most of my days dozing off.

lines.content: そろそろ会えるよ。お母さん。私の、大好きだった人
lines.translated: "I'll be able to see you soon. Mom. And the person I loved so much."

lines.content: 一緒に生きたあの人も、数年前に遠い場所に旅立った。
lines.translated: The man I spent my life with departed for a distant place several years ago, too.

lines.content: でも、ひとりぼっちではなかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I wasn't all alone.

lines.content: 息子の遠矢がかわいい孫を連れ、病室に殆ど毎日やって来てくれる。
lines.translated: My son Tooya brings my cute grandchild to visit my hospital room almost every day.

lines.content: すっかり立派になった遠矢は、あの人の特殊な家系の仕事を引き継いだようだった。
lines.translated: Having grown into a fine man, Tooya seems to have inherited his father's unusual family business.

lines.content: 今は名の知れた芸術家として活動しているらしい。主に絵画や舞台に立つ仕事をこなしているのだという。
lines.translated: Apparently, he works as a well-known artist now. They say he mainly paints and performs on stage.

lines.content: その手の話はからっきしだ。
lines.translated: I'm completely hopeless when it comes to that sort of thing.

lines.content: 息子の作品を発表する場はあまりにも特殊だったことも、私の理解が追い付かない理由に拍車をかけていたのかもしれないけれど……。
lines.translated: The fact that the venues where my son presents his works are so unusual might have made it even harder for me to keep up and understand, though...

lines.content: それでも息子の描く絵も、そして舞台も私は好きだった。
lines.translated: Even so, I loved the paintings my son drew, and I loved his stage performances.

lines.content: そのすべてが“誰か”の幸せを祈る“想い”のようなものに、きらきら、溢れているように感じられたから。
lines.translated: Because all of it felt like it was sparkling and overflowing with "feelings" that prayed for "someone's" happiness.

lines.content: 悲しい。さみしい。少し、痛い。そんな気持ちを抱えた人たちの味方でいてくれる――
lines.translated: Sad. Lonely. A little painful. Standing as an ally to people carrying those kinds of feelings--

lines.content: そのような想いが所々に感じられるものばかり、だったから。
lines.translated: Because his works were all filled with those kinds of sentiments, woven throughout.

lines.content: そんな息子が作り上げる作品の中で、私の一番のお気に入りが、今日もかわいい笑顔で病室にやって来る。
lines.translated: Among all the works my son has created, my absolute favorite comes into my hospital room with a cute smile again today.

lines.content: 可愛いかわいい女の子だ。
lines.translated: A sweet, adorable little girl.

lines.content: 今年で十歳になると言っていたっけ。名前は、なんて……いったっけ。
lines.translated: Did they say she's turning ten this year? What was her name... again?

lines.content: ……思い出せない。
lines.translated: I can't remember.

lines.content: だめだめなおばあちゃんだ。
lines.translated: I'm such a hopeless grandma.

lines.content: 頭も心も、すっかりおばあちゃんになってしまったね。
lines.translated: My mind and my heart have completely turned into an old lady's, haven't they?

lines.content: だけど代わりに子どもの頃の記憶が蘇る。
lines.translated: Yet in exchange, memories of my childhood come flooding back.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]のことだけは……そう、まるで昨日のことのように思い出せたのだ。
lines.translated: My memories of *that girl* alone... yes, I could remember them as clearly as if it were yesterday.

lines.content: 歳をとると心が子どもに返るのだと、いつか誰かが言っていた。
lines.translated: Someone once told me that when you grow old, your heart returns to being a child's.

lines.content: そういった何かが関係しているのかもしれないね。
lines.translated: Maybe something like that has to do with it.

lines.content: ……今日は雨が、降っているのね
lines.translated: "...It's raining today, isn't it?"

lines.content: 病室の窓から外を見る。
lines.translated: I look outside through the hospital room window.

lines.content: さくらの季節。雨降りの日。
lines.translated: The season of cherry blossoms. A rainy day.

lines.content: ……あの子は今日も、あそこで、誰かがやって来るのを待っているのかしら
lines.translated: "...I wonder if that girl is still waiting there today for someone to come."

lines.content: 子どもの頃に出会えた小さなちいさなお友だち。
lines.translated: The tiny, tiny friend I met when I was a child.

lines.content: きっとたくさんの子たちに“元気になって”と祈り続けてきた女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who surely kept praying for so many children to "feel better."

lines.content: そして、きっと、その分だけさみしい気持ちをたくさん抱えたのだろう……小さなちいさな“魔法使い”
lines.translated: And who surely carried just as many lonely feelings in return... a tiny, tiny "magician."

lines.content: 大好きだった。
lines.translated: I loved her so much.

lines.content: あの子に笑ってほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted her to smile.

lines.content: さみしい顔はもう見たくなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't want to see her lonely face anymore.

lines.content: そのために“約束”をしたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though we made a "promise" for that very reason...

lines.content: そんな私に“ありがとう”と言ってくれたのに……。
lines.translated: Even though she said "thank you" to me for that...

lines.content: 忘れていた。
lines.translated: I had forgotten.

lines.content: 私も一緒だ。あの子をひとりにした他の子たちと、変わらない。
lines.translated: I'm the same. I'm no different from the other children who left her all alone.

lines.content: ……ひどい。なんて、ひどい。
lines.translated: It's awful. How truly awful.

lines.content: あの子はきっと今もひとりだ。
lines.translated: That girl must still be alone even now.

lines.content: 雨降りのあの公園で、今でもずっと、ひとりぼっちで……。
lines.translated: Still all alone in that rainy park, even now...

lines.content: 悲しい私を、待っている……？
lines.translated: Waiting for the sad me...?
"Making the same lonely face she did back then, always having *everyone else's painful feelings pushed onto her alone*..."

lines.content: 用が済んだら捨てられるみたいに忘れられ。
lines.translated: Forgotten and cast aside the moment she's no longer needed.

lines.content: それでもずっと、ずっと、いつまでも……ずっと、私たちのことを応援し続けていて、くれるのかな
lines.translated: "And yet, even so, I wonder if she'll keep cheering us on forever and ever, for all time..."

lines.content: 涙がにじんだ。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in my eyes.

lines.content: 私は、私たちは、いつも自分のことばかり。
lines.translated: I--all of us--are always only thinking about ourselves.

lines.content: あなたはいつも、私たちのことばかり。
lines.translated: While you are always only thinking about us.

lines.content: 忘れられても、置いて行かれても、約束を守って、もらえなくっても……。
lines.translated: Even when you're forgotten, even when you're left behind, even when we don't keep our promises to you...

lines.content: 私たちをずっと、ずっと、応援し続けていてくれるばかりで……。
lines.translated: You do nothing but keep cheering us on, forever and ever...

lines.content: そんなのはやっぱり、さみしすぎるよね……。
lines.translated: That really is just too lonely, isn't it...?

lines.content: お願いね。私のかわいい宝物
lines.translated: "Please, my cute little treasure."

lines.content: 私は、私のことを大好きだと言ってくれる小さな孫の小さな手を握る。
lines.translated: I take the small hand of my little granddaughter, who tells me how much she loves me.

lines.content: もしも、あなたにも、あの子と出会えるようなことが、あったなら……
lines.translated: "If you ever happen to meet that girl yourself..."

lines.content: どうか、お願い。私の代わりに、あの子のお友だちになってあげて
lines.translated: "Please, I beg of you. Become her friend in my place."

lines.content: そしてあの子の“夢”を叶えてあげてほしい。私の代わりに。どうしようもない、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]の、代わりに。
lines.translated: And I want you to make her "dream" come true. In my place. In place of all of *us*, who were so hopeless.

lines.content: ……あの子に、ありがとうって、言いたかった
lines.translated: "...I wanted to say thank you to her."

lines.content: でも、もう、さよならだ。
lines.translated: But it's already time to say goodbye.

lines.content: さよならの時間がもうすぐそこだ。
lines.translated: The time for goodbyes is almost here.

lines.content: あの子と一緒に、いっぱい、いっぱい、遊びたかった
lines.translated: "I wanted to play with her so, so much."

lines.content: そして……。
lines.translated: And then...

lines.content: もう、大丈夫？　って
lines.translated: "To ask her, 'Are you okay now?'"

lines.content: もう、さみしくはなくなった？　って……
lines.translated: "To ask her, 'Are you not lonely anymore?'..."

lines.content: 今度は私が、あの子にそう言って……あげたかったな
lines.translated: "This time, I wanted... to be the one to say that to her."

lines.content: そして最後にあの子の笑顔を見つけられたなら……。
lines.translated: And if I could finally see her smile at the very end...

lines.content: 私の人生。私の、時間
lines.translated: "My life. My time."

lines.content: もう、誰にも文句を言わせないくらいの……ハッピーエンドに、なるのになあ
lines.translated: "It would have been a happy ending... so wonderful no one could ever complain."

lines.content: “夢”の中の夢はそこで途切れた。
lines.translated: The dream within a "dream" cut off there.

lines.content: 十夜は表情を固まらせている。まるで呼吸を忘れてしまったかのように。
lines.translated: Toya's expression is frozen stiff, as if she has forgotten how to breathe.

lines.content: “私もあなたのお友だちに、なりたかった”
lines.translated: "I wanted to become your friend, too."

lines.content: 女の子が、言った。
lines.translated: The girl said.

lines.content: 十夜の新しいお友だちが……。
lines.translated: Toya's new friend...

lines.content: 昔々に出会った十夜のお友だち、悲しそうな女の子の……その孫が。
lines.translated: The granddaughter of Toya's friend from long, long ago--that sad-looking girl.

lines.content: “おばあちゃんは病院で、あなたのことをいっぱい、たくさん、私に話してくれた”
lines.translated: "Grandma told me so, so many stories about you at the hospital."

lines.content: “……大好きだった”
lines.translated: "...I loved you."

lines.content: “悲しかったおばあちゃんを笑顔にしてくれた、あなたのお話を聞いてから……私も、あなたが大好きになれたから”
lines.translated: "Ever since I heard the stories of how you made my sad grandma smile... I came to love you, too."

lines.content: “私も、あなたと会いたいって……”
lines.translated: "I wanted to meet you, too..."

lines.content: “おばあちゃんとさよならする日のことを”
lines.translated: "When I thought about the day I'd have to say goodbye to Grandma..."

lines.content: “大切な人たちがいつか自分よりも先に死んでしまうことを、思うと……とても、とても、悲しくて怖くなってしまった私は……”
lines.translated: "When I thought about how the people precious to me would someday die before I do... I got so, so sad and scared..."

lines.content: “あなたに大丈夫だよって。そう、言ってほしくって……雨の日の公園に通い続けた……私だから”
lines.translated: "I wanted you to tell me that it's okay. That's why I kept going to the park on rainy days..."

lines.content: “だからね。私が……おばあちゃんの代わりに、もう大丈夫？　って。もう、さみしくはない？　って”
lines.translated: "So, you see, in Grandma's place, I wanted to ask you, 'Are you okay now?' 'Are you not lonely anymore?'"

lines.content: “そんなふうに言えるくらい、あなたが笑顔になってくれるくらい……いっぱい、たくさん、一緒に遊ぶことができたらなって、思ってた”
lines.translated: "I wished we could play together so, so much... enough that I could say those words to you, and enough to make you smile."

lines.content: “だって私は、あなたも、おばあちゃんも、大好きだったから……”
lines.translated: "Because I loved both you and Grandma so much..."

lines.content: そう言い女の子は涙を流した。
lines.translated: Saying that, the girl shed tears.

lines.content: “おばあちゃんはあなたに会いたがってた”
lines.translated: "Grandma wanted to see you."

lines.content: “あなたのことを思い出してから、ずっと、ずっと……”
lines.translated: "Ever since she remembered you, the whole time, always..."

lines.content: “でも、その頃にはもう、おばあちゃんは病室から出ることもできなくなってしまってて……”
lines.translated: "But by then, Grandma couldn't even leave her hospital room anymore..."

lines.content: 雨降りだろうと晴れの日だろうと、お友だちに会いに行けるだけの力は、もうどこにも、残っていなくて……。
lines.translated: Rain or shine, she no longer had the strength left anywhere in her to go see her friend...

lines.content: “おばあちゃんはね。あなたに会いたい、約束を守れなくてごめんねって、ひどいお友だちでごめんなさいって、言いたい……”
lines.translated: "Grandma told me that she wanted to see you, that she wanted to say she's sorry for breaking her promise, and sorry for being such a terrible friend..."

lines.content: “もしも許してくれたなら、あなたと最後に一緒に、遊びたい”
lines.translated: "She said that if you would forgive her, she wanted to play with you one last time."

lines.content: “そして笑顔でまた明日って、そう、言えたなら……って”
lines.translated: "And she wished she could say 'See you tomorrow' with a smile..."

lines.content: “私にだけ、そう言って”
lines.translated: "She told that only to me."

lines.content: “おばあちゃんは……もう”
lines.translated: "Grandma is... already..."

lines.content: つい先日のことだ。[・|そ][・|の][・|人]は旅立った。
lines.translated: It happened just the other day. *That person* departed.

lines.content: 老衰だった。九十歳を超える大往生。
lines.translated: It was old age. A peaceful passing at over ninety years old.

lines.content: 愛する家族に見守られ、愛しい孫に手を握られて……。
lines.translated: Watched over by her loving family, her hand held by her beloved granddaughter...

lines.content: 静かに、ただ眠るように[まぶた|瞼]を閉じて……。
lines.translated: Quietly closing her eyelids, as if simply falling asleep...
*Her life passed into the "Night."*

lines.content: ……たったひとつの“約束”を果たせなかったことを深く、静かに、悔やみながら。
lines.translated: While deeply, quietly regretting that she couldn't fulfill that single "promise."
Her granddaughter--*her heart*...

lines.content: 大好きなおばあちゃんが亡くなったその瞬間、“大人”への一歩を踏み出したのだろう。
lines.translated: The moment her beloved grandmother passed away, she must have taken a step toward becoming an "adult."

lines.content: “……お父さんも。お母さんも。私以上に悲しいはずだ”
lines.translated: "...Mom and Dad must be even sadder than I am."

lines.content: “だから泣いてはだめだ。絶対に。強く、ならなきゃ”
lines.translated: "So I mustn't cry. No matter what. I have to be strong."

lines.content: だから十夜のことが見えなくなった。
lines.translated: And so, she became unable to see Toya.

lines.content: 十夜のことを、感じられなくなった。十夜もあさひさんも、そしてクロも、俺たちが子どもの頃にだけ出会える友だちだから。
lines.translated: She became unable to sense Toya. Because Toya, Asahi-san, and Kuro are friends we can only meet when we are children.

lines.content: そのような強引ともいえる成長過程を踏んだ心は、果たして、この先の時間を幸福に生きていくことが叶うだろうか。
lines.translated: Having gone through such a forced process of growing up, will her heart truly be able to live happily in the time that lies ahead?

lines.content: ……十夜のお友だち
