lines.translated: "...Toya's friend."

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: ……悲しそうな顔の、女の子
lines.translated: "...The girl with the sad face."

lines.content: 俺は更に、つぶやいてみる。
lines.translated: I murmur once more.

lines.content: そして、女の子に……新しい十夜の友だちに、問いかけた。
lines.translated: And then, I asked the girl... Toya's new friend.

lines.content: 君のおばあちゃんは、いつ頃に亡くなったのかな
lines.translated: "When did your grandmother pass away?"

lines.content: “……今夜でちょうど、一週間”
lines.translated: "...Tonight makes it exactly one week."

lines.content: と、いうと？
lines.translated: "What do you mean by that?"

lines.content: 詳しい日にち、そして時間を教えてほしいと俺は言う。
lines.translated: I ask her to tell me the exact date and time.

lines.content: “おばあちゃんが亡くなったのは朝が来るほんの少し前”
lines.translated: "Grandma passed away just a little before morning came."

lines.content: “一週間前の……明け方前だよ”
lines.translated: "One week ago... right before dawn."

lines.content: “あと数分くらいで、ちょうど一週間になるんじゃないかな”
lines.translated: "In just a few minutes, I think it'll be ровно one week."

lines.content: そう。一週間前、か
lines.translated: "I see. One week ago, huh."

lines.content: ……だけど正確には、今はまだ、一週間前にはなっていないんだね？　あと数分で一週間後になる。そういう理解で、間違いない？
lines.translated: "...But to be precise, it hasn't quite been a full week yet, right? It will be one week in a few minutes. Am I understanding that correctly?"

lines.content: “う、うん？”
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah?"

lines.content: “そう、だけど……？”
lines.translated: "That's right, why...?"

lines.content: それがどうしたの？　と女の子。
lines.translated: "What about it?" the girl asks.

lines.content: 女の子は首をかしげていた。その隣にいる十夜もだ――いやいや。
lines.translated: The girl was tilting her head. And Toya, standing next to her, was doing the same--wait, no, come on.

lines.content: 十夜は俺の言わんとすることを察してはほしかった。
lines.translated: I really wished Toya would catch on to what I was getting at.

lines.content: だって君は“夜”の住人……。
lines.translated: Because you're a resident of the "Night"...

lines.content: 十夜。お友だちに会いに行こう
lines.translated: "Toya. Let's go see your friend."

lines.content: 驚いたように顔を上げた。
lines.translated: She looked up in surprise.

lines.content: 死んだ人間とはもう二度と、出会えない
lines.translated: "You can never meet a dead person again."

lines.content: だけどまだ、間に合う……かもしれないよ。俺たちの時間、“夜の国”の中でなら
lines.translated: "But we might... still be able to make it in time. If it's within our time, inside the 'Country of Night.'"

lines.content: そう言って、俺は夜空から視線を逸らすようにして――……[・|時][・|計][・|塔]だ。
lines.translated: Saying that, I averted my gaze from the night sky--...it's the *clock tower*.

lines.content: その姿を脳裏に思い浮かべた。
lines.translated: I pictured its form in my mind.

lines.content: “夜”にそびえる巨大なそれは終わりの象徴。
lines.translated: That massive structure towering in the "Night" is a symbol of the end.

lines.content: 命も。心も。つらかった気持ちでさえも。
lines.translated: Lives. Hearts. Even painful feelings.

lines.content: 終わってしまったすべての時間が集められる場所。
lines.translated: A place where all the time that has come to an end is gathered.

lines.content: そして彼ら彼女らが“次”へと向かうそれまでに、その準備を整えるための場所でもある。
lines.translated: And it is also a place for them to make their preparations before heading on to the "next."

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”
lines.translated: "The Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: しかしそのような名称は、少々恥ずかしい方向に拗らせてしまっているあさひさんが、勝手にそう呼び始めただけの可能性もないではないが……今、重要なのは。
lines.translated: Though there's a chance that particular name is just something Asahi-san made up on her own due to her slightly embarrassing chuunibyou tendencies... what's important right now is this.
"The soul of any human who has lived out their natural lifespan--whether they're headed for heaven, or hell, *or to become one of the stars in the night sky*--"
*Or to be right "beside" someone precious to them.*

lines.content: ――そういったそれぞれの“次”へと向かうまでに、あの巨大な駅の中で、一週間ほどの猶予が与えられる
lines.translated: "--Before they head off to their respective 'next' place, they are given a grace period of about a week inside that giant station."
Wait.

lines.content: 幼いいつかの日に、あさひさんに教えられた“夜”の知識を、俺は掘り起こそうとする。
lines.translated: I try to dig up the knowledge of the "Night" that Asahi-san taught me on some day back when I was little.

lines.content: その一週間という時間の中で、“次”に役立つ買い物をする者がいれば。
lines.translated: Within that one-week period, while there are those who do some shopping that will be useful for their "next" life...

lines.content: 生前に果たせなかった思い残しや後悔を、なんとか取り戻そうとする者もいる。
lines.translated: There are also those who try to somehow make up for the lingering regrets and unfinished business they couldn't fulfill while alive.

lines.content: 大切な人の人生を守るため、その人の“隣”にずっと寄り添い続ける。そんな“次”もある。
lines.translated: Staying right "beside" someone precious to protect their life forever. There is a "next" like that, too.

lines.content: ……もしも十夜のお友だちが、十夜との“約束”を果たせなかったことを今も、この瞬間も、悔やみ続けているとしたら
lines.translated: "...What if your friend is still regretting not being able to keep her 'promise' to you, even now, at this very moment?"

lines.content: あの巨大な終わりの塔の下。
lines.translated: Beneath that giant tower of the end.

lines.content: 今もずっと、十夜ともう一度だけ出会えることを夢見ている……かもしれない。
lines.translated: Even now, she might still be dreaming of meeting Toya just one more time.

lines.content: 行こう、十夜
lines.translated: "Let's go, Toya."

lines.content: 時間がないよとそう言って、俺は十夜と手をつなごうとする。
lines.translated: Telling her we don't have much time, I reach out to take Toya's hand.

lines.content: その日の[・|最][・|終][・|列][・|車]は午前三時と決まってる。それを逃してしまったら……
lines.translated: "The *last train* of the day is always set for three in the morning. If we miss it..."

lines.content: 本当に、本当に。
lines.translated: Really, truly.

lines.content: もう二度と、ふたりは会えなくなってしまう
lines.translated: "The two of you will never be able to meet again."

lines.content: お別れだ。そこに“また、明日”なんてものはない。どこにもない。
lines.translated: It's farewell. There is no "see you tomorrow" waiting there. Nowhere at all.

lines.content: しかし十夜は差し出した俺の手のひらを握ろうとはしなかった。
lines.translated: Yet Toya made no move to take the hand I offered her.

lines.content: ただじっと、自分の足元に視線を落としている。
lines.translated: She just stared quietly down at her feet.

lines.content: 十夜……
lines.translated: "Toya..."

lines.content: 急がないと。今夜で一週間だ。最終便だ。終わってしまった命を“次”へと運ぶ“夜”の列車が出てしまうよ
lines.translated: "We have to hurry. Tonight makes it one week. It's the final departure. The train of the 'Night' that carries ended lives on to the 'next' is about to leave."

lines.content: きっとその列車に十夜のお友だちは乗るのだろう。
lines.translated: Toya's friend is surely going to board that train.

lines.content: ……一週間。
lines.translated: One week.

lines.content: 与えられた目一杯の時間を使い、十夜と最後に出会える方法を考えていたのではないか――
lines.translated: Hadn't she used every last bit of the time given to her, trying to think of a way to meet Toya one last time--?

lines.content: 俺が勝手にそう信じていたいその人は、今夜の列車には必ず乗らなければならないのだ。
lines.translated: That person, whom I selfishly wanted to believe was doing just that, absolutely had to board tonight's train.

lines.content: 何があっても。どんなことが、あったとしても。
lines.translated: No matter what. Whatever might happen.

lines.content: なぜなら、一週間の猶予を過ぎても“次”を選べなかった魂は、“夜”の中に閉じ込められてしまうからだ。
lines.translated: Because a soul that fails to choose their "next" even after the one-week grace period passes gets trapped inside the "Night."

lines.content: そうなるとあの巨大な駅の構内で、飽くなき永遠を漂うようにただただ生きるか……。
lines.translated: If that happens, they either just keep on living inside that giant station, drifting through an unending eternity...

lines.content: いつしか“夜の国”の中で、つらい、悲しい、そんな気持ちを肥大させた“悪夢”となり替わってしまう。
lines.translated: Or before long, within the "Country of Night," their painful, sad feelings swell until they transform into a "Nightmare."

lines.content: もしそんな結果に至ってしまえば、[・|い][・|つ][・|か]……。
lines.translated: And if it were to come to that, *someday*...

lines.content: いつか俺や十夜自身の手で、“悪夢”と化した女の子を[・|回][・|収]しなければならない――最低な[・|い][・|つ][・|か]が訪れてしまう。そんな未来だってないとは言えなかった。
lines.translated: Someday, Toya and I would have to *collect* the girl who turned into a "Nightmare" with our own hands--that worst possible *someday* would arrive. I couldn't say for sure that such a future wouldn't happen.

lines.content: それは想像できうる限り最低最悪の“バットエンド”だとも言えるだろう。
lines.translated: You could call that the absolute worst "bad end" imaginable.

lines.content: そんな終わりの終わりを避けるためには、せめて[・|思][・|い][・|残][・|し]を解消させて、笑顔で……“次”へと見送ることくらいしか最善を思いつけない。
lines.translated: To avoid such an ultimate end, the best thing I can think of is to at least help her clear away her *lingering regrets*, and send her off to the "next" with a smile...

lines.content: 十夜。もう、お友だちと一緒に遊んだりして、十夜の願いを……ふたりの夢を叶えるだけの時間はない。残念だけど
lines.translated: "Toya. Unfortunately, there's no longer enough time to play together with your friend and fulfill your wish... to make the dream the two of you shared come true."

lines.content: こうして話をしている間にも、一秒、二秒、時間はたゆまず進んでしまっているのだから。
lines.translated: Even as we stand here talking like this, time is steadily marching forward, one second, two seconds at a time.

lines.content: それでも、最後に一言だけでもお友だちに伝えたいこととか、もしも十夜にあるなら……ううん
lines.translated: "Even so, if there's even one last word you want to say to your friend, Toya... no."

lines.content: せめて互いに“お別れ”を言い合えるだけでもいい。いや。最後にひと目、会うことだけでも叶えば……十夜。君のさみしい気持ちが少しは軽くなるかも、しれないよ
lines.translated: "Even if you can just say 'goodbye' to each other, that's enough. No, if you can just catch one last glimpse of her... Toya. The lonely feelings inside you might become a little lighter."

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちは幸せな人生を送ったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Toya's friend might have lived a happy life.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: すっかりおばあちゃんになってしまったあの子もまた、最後は悲しそうな顔で[まぶた|瞼]を閉じたと――あの子の孫は言っていた。
lines.translated: Yet her granddaughter said that the girl, who had grown into an old woman, also closed her eyelids with a sad look on her face at the very end.

lines.content: ふたりはまた、“悲しそう”で、“さみしそう”
lines.translated: The two of them are once again "looking sad" and "looking lonely."

lines.content: だから俺はもう一度、言う。
lines.translated: So I say it once more.

lines.content: 行こう、十夜。お友だちに会いに行こう
lines.translated: "Let's go, Toya. Let's go see your friend."

lines.content: ……お別れを言い合うだけのことに意味はあるだろうか。
lines.translated: Is there any meaning in just saying goodbye to each other?

lines.content: ……最後にひと目だけでも会うことに、価値はあるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is there any value in meeting for just one last glance?

lines.content: そんなのはその瞬間に立ち会うまで何も、何ひとつ、わかるはずもないけれど、
lines.translated: There's no way of knowing anything, not a single thing, until we actually witness that moment for ourselves, but...

lines.content: 十夜と、十夜のお友だち。ふたりの心が少しでも軽くなるのなら――俺たちの今夜はきっと、何より意味や、価値のある時間になるはずだと、俺は思うよ
lines.translated: "You and your friend, Toya. If the hearts of you two can become even a little bit lighter--then I think our night tonight will surely become a time with more meaning and value than anything else."

lines.content: 十夜は俺を見上げた。恐る恐る……そっと。
lines.translated: Toya looked up at me. Timidly... gently.

lines.content: ……私のこと
ぽつりと、言う。
lines.translated: Quietly, she spoke.

lines.content: あの子は、私のこと……待っていてくれるかな
lines.translated: "Do you think... she's waiting for me?"

lines.content: もう何年も。何十年も。私たちは会ってない
lines.translated: "We haven't seen each other in so many years. In so many decades."

lines.content: ……それでもちゃんと、私のこと、わかってくれるかな。私の顔、忘れちゃってたり、しないかな？
lines.translated: "...Even so, do you think she'll still recognize me? What if she's forgotten my face?"

lines.content: 十夜の瞳は不安そうに揺れている。
lines.translated: Toya's eyes were wavering with anxiety.

lines.content: 俺はそんな十夜に、無責任にうなずく代わりに、言った。
lines.translated: Instead of irresponsibly nodding back at her, I spoke.

lines.content: それは、ごめんね。俺にはわからないけど……でも
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I don't know the answer to that... but."

lines.content: ……でも？
うん。でもね。十夜
lines.translated: "Yeah. But listen, Toya."

lines.content: もしも十夜が行かなければ、お友だちが待ちぼうけになっちゃうかもしれない。その可能性は凄く高いんじゃないかなって……感じるよ
lines.translated: "If you don't go, your friend might be left waiting in vain. I feel like... the chances of that are really high."

lines.content: 俺はそう言い、苦笑いを浮かべてしまう。
lines.translated: Saying that, a wry smile slips onto my face.

lines.content: そうだ。苦笑いだ。
lines.translated: That's right. A wry smile.

lines.content: こんなもの。
lines.translated: Something like this.

lines.content: どんなに聞こえのいい言葉で着飾ろうと……。
lines.translated: No matter how much I dress it up with nice-sounding words...

lines.content: こんなものは俺が“そうしてほしい”というエゴの塊でしかなくて……。
lines.translated: Something like this is nothing more than a mass of my own ego, wishing for things to turn out that way...

lines.content: そういった自覚が少なからずあるからこそ、俺はまるで引け目の証のように、苦笑いを浮かべてしまうのだった。
lines.translated: It was precisely because I was more than a little aware of that fact that I ended up smiling wryly, almost as proof of my own guilt.

lines.content: そんな俺のことを少し、ほんの少しの間だけ、じっと見つめていた十夜だったけれど、
lines.translated: Toya stared intently at me for a little while, just a brief moment, before...

lines.content: ……わかった
lines.translated: "...Okay."

lines.content: 小さく、こくりと……うなずいてくれた。
lines.translated: She gave a small, quiet... nod.

lines.content: 行く
lines.translated: "I'll go."

lines.content: 私、会いに、行きたい……お友だちとちゃんと“さよなら”したいよ、大雅
lines.translated: "I want to go see her... I want to properly say 'goodbye' to my friend, Taiga."

lines.content: そして差し出していた俺の手を、十夜は握り――小さく笑った。
lines.translated: Then Toya took the hand I had been holding out to her--and gave a small smile.

lines.content: お友だちと最後の挨拶もできないなんて……そんなの。やっぱり、お友だち失格だよね
lines.translated: "Not even being able to say a final goodbye to my friend... something like that would make me a failure of a friend after all, wouldn't it?"

lines.content: ――時間がない。
lines.translated: --We don't have time.

lines.content: 俺と十夜。そして女の子は急いで家から出た。
lines.translated: Toya, the girl, and I hurried out of the house.

lines.content: 巨大な巨大な時計盤。
lines.translated: The giant, massive clock face.

lines.content: 午前三時前。最終便が出るおよそ五、六分前といったところか。
lines.translated: Just before three in the morning. About five or six minutes before the last train departs, perhaps.

lines.content: “夜”から旅立つ列車の最終便が出発するまで、あと四、五分といったところまで時間は迫っていた。
lines.translated: The time was pressing close, with only about four or five minutes left until the final train departing from the "Night" would leave.

lines.content: “[魔法|想像力]”がすべてを支配する特別な時間――“夜の国”。その大通り。
lines.translated: A special time where "imagination"--magic--rules over everything: the main street of the "Country of Night."

lines.content: ここから見上げた時計塔は、遠い。
lines.translated: Looking up from here, the clock tower is far away.

lines.content: 今、俺たちがいる場所からあそこまでは、全速力で走って向かったとしても二十分以上はかかってしまうだろう。
lines.translated: From where we are right now, even if we ran at full speed, it would probably take over twenty minutes to get there.

lines.content: “太陽の時間”の下ではほぼ毎日、通っている場所である――学園だ。
lines.translated: Under the "time of the sun," it's a place I commute to almost every day--the academy.

lines.content: “夜”の中ではすっかりその姿を変えてしまっている。
lines.translated: Inside the "Night," its appearance has completely changed.

lines.content: それでも、[・|こ][・|こ][・|ら][・|あ][・|た][・|り]から、いつも通っている[・|あ][・|そ][・|こ][・|ま][・|で]、どれほどの時間がかかるかはおおよそわかる。
lines.translated: Even so, I have a rough idea of how long it takes to get from *around here* to *over there*, where I always go.

lines.content: このままでは、だめだ。
lines.translated: At this rate, it's no good.

lines.content: せっかく十夜が俺の手を取ってくれたというのに……間に合わない。間に合うはずがない。
lines.translated: Even though Toya finally took my hand... we won't make it in time. There's no way we can make it.

lines.content: もう既に、諦めるために心の準備をしなければならない時間であった。
lines.translated: It was already time to start preparing our hearts to give up.

lines.content: 走って行ったらとても、到底、間に合わない
lines.translated: "If we run there, we'll never, ever make it in time."

lines.content: 思い描くすべてが叶う“夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Country of Night," where everything you envision comes true.

lines.content: だけど時間には逆らえない。
lines.translated: But you cannot defy time.

lines.content: それを延長することも、短縮することも。
lines.translated: You can neither extend it nor shorten it.

lines.content: ……だけど
lines.translated: "...However."

lines.content: 俺は、十夜とつないだ手に改めて力を込めた――[・|空][・|中]でそれを離してしまうことのないように。
lines.translated: I tightened my grip on Toya's hand once more--so that I wouldn't let go of it *in midair*.

lines.content: 飛ぶぞ、十夜。しっかり掴まっていて
lines.translated: "We're going to fly, Toya. Hold on tight."

lines.content: う、うん。わかった
lines.translated: "O-Okay. Got it."

lines.content: ぎゅっと込められた力が伝わる。
lines.translated: I can feel the tight squeeze of her hand.

lines.content: そして十夜は逆の手で女の子の手を握りしめていた。
lines.translated: And with her other hand, Toya was holding tightly onto the girl's hand.

lines.content: 三人だ。
lines.translated: There are three of us.

lines.content: 俺と、十夜と、お友だちの……可愛いかわいいその孫と。
lines.translated: Me, Toya, and her friend's... sweet, adorable granddaughter.

lines.content: 三人で十夜のお友だちに会いに行こう。
lines.translated: Let's go see Toya's friend together, the three of us.

lines.content: せめて“さよなら”を伝える。そのためだ。
lines.translated: To at least tell her "goodbye." That's what this is for.

lines.content: そうすることが、これから続く誰かの時間にとって、ハッピーエンドに一番近づける方法なのではないかと……信じていたい。
lines.translated: I want to believe... that doing so is the best way to bring the time that continues on for someone from here as close to a happy ending as possible.

lines.content: さあ、行くぞ。“魔法使い”の時間をはじめよう
lines.translated: "All right, let's go. Let's begin the time of the 'magician.'"

lines.content: 俺たちの“魔法”は誰にも負けない“想像力”だ。
lines.translated: Our "magic" is an "imagination" second to none.

lines.content: まるで呪文のように心の中でそうつぶやいて――[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Whispering that in my heart like a spell--I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: 俺は、幼い頃に頭の中へと入力し続けた“物語”の中から、今ここに相応しい力を使っている何者かの映像を思い起こそうとした。
lines.translated: From the "stories" I had continuously fed into my head back when I was little, I tried to recall the mental image of someone using a power suited for this very moment.

lines.content: 心のページを静かにめくる。
lines.translated: I quietly turn the pages of my mind.

lines.content: あの“夜”はハルと一緒に高くたかく一息で駆け上がったのだ。
lines.translated: On that "Night," I had soared high, so high into the sky in a single breath together with Haru.

lines.content: 数日前。[・|あ][・|の]“[・|夜]”はハルと一緒に高くたかく一息で駆け上がった。
lines.translated: A few days ago. On *that "Night,"* I had soared high, so high into the sky in a single breath together with Haru.

lines.content: それは俺にとって、それほど難しい“[魔法|想像]”ではないはずだった。
lines.translated: For me, that shouldn't have been a very difficult piece of "imagination"--of magic.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ……おかしい
lines.translated: "...That's strange."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I open my eyelids.

lines.content: ……上手く、できないぞ
lines.translated: "...I can't do it right."

lines.content: 夜空を掛ける――
lines.translated: Soaring through the night sky--

lines.content: たったそれだけの“魔法”が想像できない。
lines.translated: I can't even imagine a "magic" as simple as that.

lines.content: 両足は地面をぴたりと掴んだまま離れなかった。
lines.translated: Both of my feet remained firmly planted on the ground, refusing to leave it.

lines.content: どうしたんだ、俺。……ついこの前は一瞬でできたことじゃないか
lines.translated: "What's wrong with me? ...I was able to do it in an instant just the other day, wasn't I?"

lines.content: 変だ。おかしい。どういうことだ。
lines.translated: It's strange. It's weird. What is going on?

lines.content: 頭の中でめくったページには白紙が並ぶ。
lines.translated: The pages I flip through in my mind are all completely blank.

lines.content: 幼い頃から懸命に入力し続けてきた“[物語|想像]”がどこにも見当たらないのだ。
lines.translated: The "stories"--the "imagination"--I had worked so hard to feed into my head since I was little were nowhere to be found.

lines.content: どころかほんの一瞬だろうと映像を想起することが叶わない。
lines.translated: Far from it, I couldn't even conjure up a mental image for a split second.

lines.content: 頭の中に濃霧がかかってしまったようだった。
lines.translated: It felt as though a thick fog had settled inside my head.

lines.content: しかし[・|そ][・|の][・|原][・|因]にすぐさま俺は思い至ってしまう。
lines.translated: However, I immediately realized *the cause of it*.

lines.content: ……ああ、そうか
lines.translated: "...Ah, I see."

lines.content: 最近、あさひさんの[部屋|工房]に行っていないな
lines.translated: "I haven't been to Asahi-san's room--her workshop--lately."

lines.content: あの場所は俺自身の中に“魔法”を作り上げる……まさに工房だったというのに。
lines.translated: Even though that place was truly a workshop for building up "magic" within myself...

lines.content: 俺にとって“想像力”とは――ひどく陳腐な言葉で表現するのなら――[マジックポイント|ＭＰ]と同じだ。
lines.translated: To me, "imagination" is--to put it in terribly cliche terms--the same as Magic Points, or MP.

lines.content: “夜の国”で“魔法”を使えば使うだけ、頭の中から、そして心の中から、[・|そ][・|れ]は消費されてしまう。
lines.translated: The more I use "magic" in the "Country of Night," the more *it* is consumed from my mind, and from my heart.

lines.content: “夜空を飛ぶ”……といった“想像”を、先日自分の中から[消費|出力]したばかりだ。
lines.translated: Just the other day, I had output--consumed--the "imagination" of "flying through the night sky" from within myself.

lines.content: 同じようにできないのは当然だった。
lines.translated: It was only natural that I couldn't do the same thing again.

lines.content: 大雅……どうしたの？
lines.translated: "Taiga... what's wrong?"

lines.content: 十夜が不安げに俺を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Toya was looking up at me anxiously.

lines.content: その声で、その眼差しで、我に返る。
lines.translated: Her voice, and her gaze, brought me back to my senses.

lines.content: 今はどうしようもない自分に呆れていられるだけの暇もなかった――現状を打破する[・|何][・|か]を探し出さなければならない状況だ。
lines.translated: Right now, I didn't even have the time to stand around being disgusted with my own helplessness--we were in a situation where I had to find *something* to break through this impasse.

lines.content: そのために必要なものは、いったい、なんだろう。
lines.translated: What on earth do I need in order to do that?

lines.content: ……十夜。
lines.translated: Toya.

lines.content: 彼女の“想像力”をあてにするか……？
lines.translated: Should I rely on her "imagination"...?

lines.content: 俺はつないだ小さな手をふと見つめる。
lines.translated: My gaze suddenly falls upon the small hand I'm holding.

lines.content: それは左手だった。俺の利き手。
lines.translated: It was my left hand. My dominant hand.

lines.content: そしてそこには――“夜”だ。俺の左手には特別な“役割”が付与されている。
lines.translated: And dwelling there is--"Night." My left hand has been granted a special "role."

lines.content: ……いや、だめだ
lines.translated: "...No, that won't work."

lines.content: 俺は、首を振る。
lines.translated: I shook my head.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は不可能なのだと知っていた。
lines.translated: I knew that *that* was impossible.

lines.content: “想像力”は誰にも負けない俺たちの“魔法”
lines.translated: Our "magic" is an "imagination" second to none.

lines.content: 俺たちとは人間を指す。そこに猫たちは含まれていない――彼女らがどんなに特別であろうと。想像するということは人間にのみ許された“特別な時間”なのだ。
lines.translated: "Our" refers to humans. Cats aren't included in that--no matter how special they might be. To imagine is a "special time" granted only to humans.

lines.content: だから――
lines.translated: So--

lines.content: いや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 待て。
lines.translated: Wait.

lines.content: そこでふと、今、自分たちのいる場所に見覚えがあることに、気づいた。
lines.translated: Just then, I suddenly realized that the place we were standing in looked familiar.

lines.content: それなりに広い面積を持つ“参禅町”。その、“夜の国”
lines.translated: "Sanzen Town," which covers a fairly large area. Its "Country of Night."

lines.content: 今俺たちのいるこの裏路地は、あまり通りかかったことのある道ではないけれど……しかし。
lines.translated: This back alley we're in right now isn't a street I've walked down very often, set aside... however.

lines.content: ……この付近には、何度も、何度だって、通った覚えがあるぞ
lines.translated: "...I remember passing through this neighborhood many, many times."

lines.content: 独りつぶやき、走り出す。
lines.translated: Muttering to myself, I break into a run.

lines.content: た、大雅？　どうするの？　どこ、行くの？
lines.translated: "T-Taiga? What are you doing? Where are we going?"

lines.content: ごめん。今は説明している余裕はないけど、急ごう。上手くいけば力を貸してもらえるかもしれない……
lines.translated: "Sorry. I don't have time to explain right now, so let's hurry. If things go well, we might be able to borrow some help..."

lines.content: ふと見出した“希望”に向かって。
lines.translated: Toward the "hope" I had suddenly found.

lines.content: 戸惑う十夜たちの手を引いて……。
lines.translated: Pulling a bewildered Toya and the girl by the hand...

lines.content: 俺は、[・|そ][・|の][・|場][・|所]へと駆けていく。
lines.translated: I dash toward *that place*.

lines.content: お願いだ。どうか力を、貸してほしい
lines.translated: "Please. I need you to lend us your power."

lines.content: “[・|夜]”[・|に][・|目][・|覚][・|め][・|さ][・|せ][・|た][・|そ][・|の][・|人][・|物][・|に]、俺は軽く、本当に簡単にではあるけれど、事情を説明し、頭を下げた。
lines.translated: *To the person I had awakened in the "Night,"* I gave a brief, truly simple explanation of the situation, and bowed my head.

lines.content: ごめん
lines.translated: "Sorry."

lines.content: 急に起こして、ごめんな、[・|ひ][・|よ][・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん]
lines.translated: "Sorry for waking you up so suddenly, *Hiyo-chan*."

lines.content: 俺が懇願するのは、姫織だ。
lines.translated: The one I am pleading with is Himeori.

lines.content: 夜月姫織。俺の幼馴染み。
lines.translated: Yatsuki Himeori. My childhood friend.

lines.content: かつて“夜の中”で“特別”だった女の子。その、“夢見る心”だ。
lines.translated: A girl who used to be "special" inside the "Night." Her "dreaming heart."

lines.content: 詳しい事情は後から話すよ。突然こんなことをお願いして、申し訳ないけれど……今すぐあそこに行かなきゃならないんだ、俺たち
lines.translated: "I'll tell you the details later. I'm really sorry for asking something like this out of nowhere, but... we have to get over there right away."

lines.content: 俺は時計塔を指さしそう言った。
lines.translated: I pointed toward the clock tower as I said that.

lines.content: ……十年前のいつかの日。
lines.translated: Someday, ten years ago.

lines.content: “特別な少女”だった夜月姫織は、この“夜”の中を自在に活動することの叶う[・|ひ][・|と][・|り]だった……柊ハルや杏藤千和、そして兎蛙あず咲と同様にして。
lines.translated: Yatsuki Himeori, who had been a "special girl," was *one of those* who could move about freely within this "Night"... just like Hiiragi Haru, Andou Chiwa, and Towa Azusaki.

lines.content: 間に合う。
lines.translated: We can make it.

lines.content: その“[想像力|心]”を、今、借り受けることが叶えば……間に合う。
lines.translated: If I can borrow that "heart"--that "imagination"--right now... we can make it in time.

lines.content: 最終便を逃すことなく、俺たちはあの塔の下に向かえるはずだ。
lines.translated: Without missing the last train, we should be able to reach the foot of that tower.

lines.content: 十年前に君たちを“魔法”として使っていたのはあさひさんだ。“夜の魔法使い”である陽向井あさひさん
lines.translated: "Ten years ago, the one who used you all as 'magic' was Asahi-san. Hinamukai Asahi-san, the 'Magician of the Night.'"

lines.content: だけど、今、その“魔法使い”の役割を俺が譲ってもらってる
lines.translated: "Right now, though, I've inherited that role of 'magician' from her."

lines.content: いつかのあさひさんみたいにはまだまだ全然、上手にはいかないだろうけど……お願いだ。ひよちゃん。俺たちに力を貸してほしい
lines.translated: "I probably won't be able to do it nearly as well as Asahi-san did back then, not by a long shot, but... please, Hiyo-chan. I want you to lend us your strength."

lines.content: 偶然だった。
lines.translated: It was a coincidence.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちのお家から、都合がいいことに……姫織の神社まではすぐそこであることに、俺は気付いて……走った。彼女の“心”を借り受ける、そのために。
lines.translated: Conveniently enough, from Toya's friend's house... I realized that Himeori's shrine was right nearby... and I ran. In order to borrow her "heart."

lines.content: 姫織はまだ状況を理解しきれていないのだろうか。
lines.translated: Maybe Himeori hasn't fully grasped the situation yet.

lines.content: 俺の指さした時計塔をただぼーっと見つめているだけだった。
lines.translated: She was just staring blankly at the clock tower I had pointed to.

lines.content: 焦りがあった。
lines.translated: I felt impatient.

lines.content: それはひどく一方的で、身勝手な感情であることは重々承知ではあるものの……時間がない。幾度となくそんな思いが俺の、俺たちの内面をきゅっと握りしめるのだ。
lines.translated: Even though I was painfully aware of how terribly one-sided and selfish that feeling was... we were out of time. Over and over again, that thought squeezed tightly at my--at our--insides.

lines.content: そんな中でぽつりと、姫織が言った。
lines.translated: Amidst all that, Himeori murmured quietly.

lines.content: ……何も
lines.translated: "...Nothing."

lines.content: え？　何……も？
lines.translated: "Huh? Noth...ing?"

lines.content: うん。何も、見ていないよね……大雅
lines.translated: "Yeah. You didn't see anything, right... Taiga?"

lines.content: 見る、って？
lines.translated: "See what?"

lines.content: そ、それは……えっと……
lines.translated: "Th-That's... um..."

lines.content: 口元をもにょもにょとさせながら、『ここは夜の国だよね』と姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Mumbling hesitantly, Himeori says, "This is the Country of Night, right?"

lines.content: “夜”の中で……私の心とか。夢だとか。そういうの
lines.translated: "Inside the 'Night'... things like my heart. Or my dreams. Things like that."

lines.content: 覗き見したり、していないよね？
lines.translated: "You didn't peek at them or anything, did you?"

lines.content: 不安そうに言う姫織だった。
lines.translated: Himeori asked anxiously.

lines.content: ……だって。その。起こされたとき、なんだかちょうど恥ずかしい夢、見ていたような気がして
lines.translated: "...Because, um. When you woke me up, I feel like I was right in the middle of having an embarrassing dream."

lines.content: 恥ずかしい？
lines.translated: "Embarrassing?"

lines.content: そう……
lines.translated: I see...

lines.content: 姫織ちゃん。恥ずかしい夢を、見ていたの……？
lines.translated: "Himeori-chan. Were you having an embarrassing dream...?"

lines.content: う、うん。そうだよ……。久しぶりだね、十夜。また会えてうれしいなあ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. That's right... Long time no see, Toya. I'm so glad to see you again."

lines.content: ……でも私は、“特別”じゃなくなってしまった今の私は、“夜”が終われば全部わすれちゃうんだろうけど。
lines.translated: "...Although, now that I'm no longer 'special,' I'll probably forget all of this once the 'Night' ends."

lines.content: 姫織は十夜に、苦笑いでそう言っていた。
lines.translated: Himeori said that to Toya with a wry smile.

lines.content: そして俺は、そんな姫織にふるふると首を振る。
lines.translated: And I shook my head at Himeori.

lines.content: ……いいや。大丈夫。見ていないよ。何も
lines.translated: "...Nope. Don't worry. I didn't see anything."

lines.content: そうだ。見ていない。何も。
lines.translated: That's right. I didn't see anything.

lines.content: いいや。ここは見ることができなかった、と言ったほうがいいのかもしれない。
lines.translated: No. Maybe it would be more accurate to say that I couldn't see anything here.

lines.content: こうして姫織を“夜”の中に、[・|心][・|だ][・|け]でも目覚めさせることが叶ったは、いいけれど……。
lines.translated: Being able to awaken Himeori inside the "Night" like this, even if *only her heart*, was all well and good, but...

lines.content: その際、先ほどの十夜のお友だちのときみたいに、姫織の心の風景を垣間見るようなことはなかった。
lines.translated: When I did, I didn't catch a glimpse of the landscape of Himeori's heart, like I had with Toya's friend just a moment ago.

lines.content: 俺と姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori and I.

lines.content: 奏大雅と夜月姫織の心の間には壁がある……“夢”を語り合うべき“関係性”にはまだないということだ。
lines.translated: There is a wall between the hearts of Kanade Taiga and Yatsuki Himeori... meaning we aren't yet in a "relationship" where we should be sharing our "dreams" with one another.

lines.content: さっきは十夜と一緒にいたからこそ、お友だちの夢を俺も[・|つ][・|い][・|で]に垣間見ただけなのだ――この“夜の左手”で、十夜と手を繋いでいたからだ。
lines.translated: Earlier, it was only because I was with Toya that I happened to catch a glimpse of her friend's dream *along the way*--because I was holding Toya's hand with this "left hand of the Night."

lines.content: それはつまり、まだこの俺が彼女の魔法を解き放つには役不足ということなのだ。
lines.translated: In other words, I'm still not up to the task of unleashing her magic myself.

lines.content: 見ていない。何も見てないよ、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "I didn't see. I didn't see anything, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: だからこそ俺はそう繰り返す。
lines.translated: That's precisely why I repeat those words.

lines.content: 今、この瞬間、解決しなければならないことは別にあるから。
lines.translated: Because right now, at this very moment, there is something else we need to resolve.

lines.content: 突然、起こしてしまってごめん。純粋にひよちゃんに協力してほしくて声をかけたんだ
lines.translated: "I'm sorry for waking you up so suddenly. I called out to you purely because I wanted your help, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: あまりにも突然のお願いだった。
lines.translated: It was an all too sudden request.

lines.content: 加えて理由も何も伝えていられる暇はない。
lines.translated: On top of that, I have no time to explain the reason or anything else.

lines.content: 姫織からしてみれば迷惑極まりないからと、断られてしまっても無理からぬ話だ。そう、覚悟はしていたつもりだったけれど、
lines.translated: From Himeori's perspective, it was an extreme nuisance, so I couldn't blame her at all if she refused. I thought I had prepared myself for that, and yet,

lines.content: うん。わかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Okay."

lines.content: 姫織は、ほんの少しのためらいも見せず、こっくりとうなずいてくれた。
lines.translated: Without showing even the slightest hesitation, Himeori gave a firm nod.

lines.content: そして俺にその小さな手を差し出した。
lines.translated: And then she held out her small hand to me.

lines.content: 大雅たちの事情はよくわかんないけど……とにかく時間がないんだろうなあってことは、なんとなく理解できたよ
lines.translated: "I don't really know what's going on with you guys, Taiga, but... I can kind of tell that you're really pressed for time, at least."

lines.content: 後から事情は教えてくれるんだよね、と姫織。
lines.translated: "You'll tell me the whole story later, right?" Himeori asked.

lines.content: もちろんだ、約束だよ、と俺。
lines.translated: "Of course, I promise," I replied.

lines.content: だったら、大雅。使っていいよ。私のこと
lines.translated: "In that case, Taiga. You can use me."

lines.content: ほんとに？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: 自分で姫織のことを起こしておいて、お願いをしておいて、何を今さら、という具合なのだが……。
lines.translated: I'm the one who woke Himeori up and asked for her help in the first place, so it's a little late to be asking this now, and yet...

lines.content: ひよちゃんのことを。ひよちゃんの心を。俺の“魔法”として使ってしまっても、いいんだね
lines.translated: "Is it really okay for me to use you--to use your heart--as my 'magic,' Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: やはり心ある相手を“魔法”として、その力を借り受けるということに、若干の躊躇を俺は覚えてしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Borrowing the power of someone with a heart of their own and using them as "magic" still makes me feel a slight hesitation.

lines.content: うん。だいじょーぶ、ですよ？
lines.translated: "Yeah. It's totally fine, you know?"

lines.content: 小首を傾げるような仕草で、姫織は言った。
lines.translated: Himeori said, tilting her head slightly.

lines.content: ここは、“夜の国”。つまり夢の中の出来事、なんだよね？
lines.translated: "This is the 'Country of Night.' Which means everything happening here is inside a dream, right?"

lines.content: ああ。うん。その通りだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. Mhm. That's right."

lines.content: さっきも思ったけれど、やっぱり……目が覚めたら今夜の出来事について、私は全部、覚えていない……？
lines.translated: "I was thinking about this earlier too, but... once I wake up, I really won't remember anything at all about what happened tonight...?"

lines.content: きっと、ね。そういう具合になっちゃうはずだ
lines.translated: "Probably not. That's how it should turn out."

lines.content: ここが夢なら。目が覚めたら全部ぜんぶ、忘れてしまっていることなら……
lines.translated: "If this is a dream, and I'm going to forget everything--every single thing--once I wake up..."

lines.content: 姫織はつぶやくように言い、俺を見上げた。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured, looking up at me.

lines.content: 私は、大雅に、どう使われてしまっても大丈夫だよ。えっちなことでも全然平気
lines.translated: "Then it's okay no matter how you end up using me, Taiga. Even naughty things are totally fine."

lines.content: い、いや。えっちなことなんて、しないよ
lines.translated: "N-No. I'm not going to do anything naughty."

lines.content: ほんとーに？
lines.translated: "Reeeally?"

lines.content: ……たぶんね
lines.translated: "...Probably."

lines.content: 十夜と一緒に、えっちな大雅に、私……私たちは、えっちな感じで食べられちゃわない？
lines.translated: "Won't a naughty Taiga gobble me... gobble us up in a naughty way along with Toya?"

lines.content: ないない。ないから
lines.translated: "No way, no way. Definitely not."

lines.content: と、そんなことを話している場合ではないのだ。
lines.translated: Wait, this isn't the time to be talking about stuff like that.

lines.content: 時間、ないんだよね。大雅
lines.translated: "We're out of time, aren't we, Taiga?"

lines.content: ……あ、ああ。その通りだ
lines.translated: "...Y-Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 今夜。私の心は大雅の魔法
lines.translated: "Tonight, my heart is your magic, Taiga."

lines.content: 姫織は、つぶやく。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured.

lines.content: 十年前の夜の中。“魔法使い”のあさひさんに、この心を、自由自在に魔法に変えられていたように……
lines.translated: "Just like inside the Night ten years ago, when Asahi-san the 'magician' freely turned this heart into magic..."

lines.content: 今夜の私は、大雅に命じられればそのように――ううん、大雅の命ずる想像以上に、“[魔法|想像力]”を広げてみせますよ？
lines.translated: "Tonight, if you command me, I'll do the same--no, I'll expand my 'imagination'--my magic--even further than you command me to imagine, okay?"

lines.content: ……ああ。ありがとう
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Thank you."

lines.content: 俺は、姫織と手をつなぐ。
lines.translated: I joined hands with Himeori.

lines.content: そうして触れ合う手と手の間に、誰にも負けない“魔法”がありますようにと祈り、俺は……。
lines.translated: Praying that between our touching hands there would be a "magic" second to none, I...
"*The hammer is cocked.*"

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: そして俺は、今夜、すべての一秒を思うままに支配するための“魔法”へと、彼女の心を作り変えるのだ……。
lines.translated: And so, tonight, I reshaped her heart into "magic" to control every single second at will...

lines.content: あ……あれ？
lines.translated: "H... Huh?"

lines.content: それは、一瞬だった。
lines.translated: It happened in an instant.

lines.content: 俺が[・|そ][・|の][・|想][・|像]を完了させるのとほぼ同時。
lines.translated: Almost at the exact same moment I completed *that imagination*.

lines.content: 俺と手をつないだ姫織の身体が、ほんの一瞬、眩い光に包まれて……
lines.translated: The body of Himeori, who was holding my hand, was wrapped in a dazzling light for just a split second...
And then, *it was just as I imagined*.

lines.content: 眩い光が解けたそこに、想像通りの姿があった。
lines.translated: When the dazzling light faded, standing there was the exact figure I had imagined.

lines.content: お、おお……？
lines.translated: "W-Whoa...?"

lines.content: 姫織は目をパチクリさせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori blinked in surprise.
"*Magical Girl.*"

lines.content: 今の夜月姫織の姿を形容するには、そんな言葉が相応しいはずだ。
lines.translated: Those were surely the most fitting words to describe Yatsuki Himeori's current appearance.

lines.content: かわいい俺の幼馴染みを、もっとかわいくと……“想像”してみたんだけど
lines.translated: "I tried 'imagining'... making my cute childhood friend even cuter."

lines.content: 言いながらも、俺は自身を多少なりとも嫌悪している。
lines.translated: Even as I said it, I felt a certain amount of disgust toward myself.

lines.content: 俺、奏大雅は魔法少女が嫌いだ。
lines.translated: I, Kanade Taiga, hate magical girls.

lines.content: そのきらきら眩しい姿を見ていると。
lines.translated: Because whenever I look at their sparkling, dazzling figures...

lines.content: どうしたって。
lines.translated: No matter what...

lines.content: 救えなかったあのひとのことを思い出してしまうから。
lines.translated: I end up remembering that person I couldn't save.

lines.content: ……無力な自分自身への怒りを、思い出してしまうから。
lines.translated: Because I end up remembering the anger I felt toward my own powerless self.

lines.content: しかし[・|こ][・|う][・|し][・|な][・|け][・|れ][・|ば]夜の中で彼女らを魔法にはできないのだ――それが、あさひさんの作ったルールなのだから。
lines.translated: However, *unless I do this*, I cannot turn them into magic inside the Night--because that is the rule Asahi-san made.

lines.content: これでひよちゃんは俺の“魔法”だ。今夜限りの、だけど……
lines.translated: "With this, you're my 'magic,' Hiyo-chan. Even if it's for tonight only..."

lines.content: 想像通り……。いいや。想像以上にうまく仕上がったように思う
lines.translated: "Just as I imagined... No. I think it turned out even better than I imagined."

lines.content: うーむ。想像、通り……？
lines.translated: "Hmm. Just as you... imagined...?"

lines.content: 首をかしげる姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head.

lines.content: 丈の短いスカートや、肌を隠す面積の少ない布を、ペタペタと触れている。
lines.translated: She patted the short skirt and the fabric that covered very little skin.

lines.content: なんだかすっごいすーすーするよ。大雅
lines.translated: "It feels super breezy, Taiga."

lines.content: その服装のデザインは俺自身が細部に渡り『想像』できたものではない。
lines.translated: The design of that outfit wasn't something I was able to "imagine" down to the finest detail on my own.

lines.content: 俺は想像力が不足してしまってる。故に。十年前はみんなの足を大いに引っ張り続けた。
lines.translated: I am lacking in imagination. Because of that, ten years ago, I constantly held everyone back.

lines.content: だからあくまでその変身は、姫織の想像力を借りた上で成せたものなのである。
lines.translated: So this transformation was strictly something achieved by borrowing Himeori's imagination.

lines.content: それはつまり、姫織が自身に重ねる理想の『魔法少女像』ということにもなる――いや。まあ。
lines.translated: Which also means it's the ideal "magical girl image" that Himeori projects onto herself--well, no.

lines.content: 俺の想像も脆弱ながら混ぜられているのだから、若干俺の願望だって混ざったデザインではあるけれども。
lines.translated: Since my own feeble imagination was mixed in too, it is a design blended with a bit of my own desires, though.

lines.content: ……大雅はえっちなのだねえ
lines.translated: "...You really are naughty, Taiga."

lines.content: しみじみとしながら、姫織はうなずく。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded earnestly.

lines.content: どうして“[想像力|魔法]”がうまく働いてくれないって言っていたのに。[・|こ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|の]はどうしてちゃんと、想像できちゃうの……？
lines.translated: "Why is it that even though you said your 'magic'--your imagination--doesn't work well, you can properly imagine *stuff like this*...?"

lines.content: いや、違うな姫織。これは想像じゃない
lines.translated: "No, you've got it wrong, Himeori. This isn't imagination."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ただの、妄想
lines.translated: "It's just a delusion."

lines.content: やっぱり、えっち……っ
lines.translated: "I knew it, you're naughty...!"

lines.content: いーっと、姫織は白い歯を見せるのだった。
lines.translated: Himeori bared her white teeth with a playful grimace.

lines.content: 姫織
lines.translated: Himeori

lines.content: 俺は、その名を呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called out that name.

lines.content: 今夜、すべての一秒。俺の“魔法”として在り続けてくれる[魔法|彼女]のその名を。
lines.translated: The name of *her*--the magic who would continue to exist as my "magic" for every single second tonight.

lines.content: ……頼む。夜月姫織
lines.translated: "...I'm counting on you, Yatsuki Himeori."

lines.content: 俺たちをあの場所まで……“刻の終着駅”まで、運んでほしい。可能な限り、早く
lines.translated: "I want you to carry us to that place... to the 'Terminal of Time.' As fast as possible."

lines.content: 俺は、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: 心に集中力の針先を静かに落とす。
lines.translated: I quietly dropped the needle of my concentration into my heart.

lines.content: 撃鉄はあげられた。
lines.translated: The hammer was cocked.

lines.content: “魔法”の引き金に、この[心|指]は掛けられている。
lines.translated: This *finger*--my heart--was resting on the trigger of "magic."

lines.content: 命じる。
lines.translated: Give the command.

lines.content: それだけでいい。それだけで“弾丸”は撃ち放たれる。
lines.translated: That's all it takes. With just that, the "bullet" will be fired.

lines.content: まだまだ半端ながらも、この“夜”を支配しうる力を持つ者として……。
lines.translated: Though still half-baked, as one who holds the power to rule this "Night"...

lines.content: 即席の“夜の魔法使い”として……。
lines.translated: As an improvised "Magician of the Night"...

lines.content: ふたりの“想像力”を、ここに重ねて……。
lines.translated: Layering the "imagination" of the two of us right here...
"*Fly through the sky.*"

lines.content: 呪文の代わりにつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured it in place of a spell.

lines.content: 複雑な文言も。
lines.translated: No complex incantations.

lines.content: 見るも鮮やかな映像の美も。
lines.translated: No vividly striking visual beauty.

lines.content: そういったわかりやすさはどこにもない。
lines.translated: None of that easy-to-understand flair was anywhere to be found.

lines.content: ここにあるのは誰にも負けない“想像力”。ただそれだけだ。
lines.translated: All that was here was an "imagination" second to none. Simply that and nothing more.

lines.content: ……それだけで、よかった。
lines.translated: And that alone was enough.

lines.content: 夜月姫織。今夜の一秒。そのすべてを支配しうる“夜の魔法使い”として、命じたい……手と手を繋いだこの俺の、“夜空を駆ける魔法”となってほしい
lines.translated: "Yatsuki Himeori. As the 'Magician of the Night' who can rule every single second of tonight, I command you... Hand in hand with me, I want you to become the 'magic that soars through the night sky.'"

lines.content: もう一度、ささやくようにそう言った。
lines.translated: Once again, I spoke the words in a whisper.

lines.content: 姫織の心に描かれた“[魔法|想像力]”を、“夜”のスクリーンに映し出そうとした。
lines.translated: I tried to project the "imagination"--the magic--painted in Himeori's heart onto the screen of the "Night."

lines.content: しかし。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]の裏の闇色に、何も、かけらも、映像を見いだせなかった。
lines.translated: In the dark hue behind my eyelids, I couldn't find anything--not even a fragment of an image.

lines.content: 故に“魔法”ははじまらない。
lines.translated: Therefore, the "magic" did not begin.

lines.content: 俺たちは未だに目的地から遠いこの場所に縫い付けられているままだ。
lines.translated: We remained pinned to this spot, still far from our destination.

lines.content: それは姫織が、俺の（あえてこう表現するが）命じたように、その“想像力”を広げようとしていないと、そういうことだと俺は思った。
lines.translated: I thought that meant Himeori wasn't trying to expand her "imagination" as I had (if I dare phrase it this way) commanded.

lines.content: 姫織……
lines.translated: "Himeori..."

lines.content: 俺は[まぶた|瞼]を開く。
lines.translated: I opened my eyelids.

lines.content: そして姫織の横顔を見る。
lines.translated: And I looked at Himeori's profile.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。大雅
lines.translated: "I'm sorry, Taiga."

lines.content: 姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: じっと、目的の場所、“刻の終着駅”の象徴である時計塔を見上げながら――ぽつり、と。
lines.translated: While staring intently up at our destination, the clock tower that served as the symbol of the "Terminal of Time"--she murmured softly.

lines.content: 無理、みたい
lines.translated: "I don't think... I can do it."

lines.content: 一言、姫織は、その唇から零した。
lines.translated: Himeori let those few words spill from her lips.

lines.content: 無理……？
lines.translated: "You can't...?"

lines.content: ごめんね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: 姫織はうつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: Himeori lowered her gaze.

lines.content: 私はどうやら“空を飛ぶ”ことを想像するのは苦手、みたい
lines.translated: "It seems I'm... not very good at imagining 'flying through the sky.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?
"I'm sorry. *I had forgotten.*"

lines.content: 思えば昔からそうだった……私は“空を飛ぶ”ことが苦手な“魔法”。こうしてまた、“夜の中”で起こされるまですっかり忘れてしまってた
lines.translated: "Thinking back, it's always been that way... I'm a 'magic' that's bad at 'flying through the sky.' I had completely forgotten all about it until I was woken up 'Inside the Night' like this again."

lines.content: あさひさんからも“空を飛ぶ魔法”を、その想像を上手にできるようになるよう練習しておくようにと言われていて……。そのままだった
lines.translated: "Even Asahi-san told me to practice 'magic for flying through the sky' so I could get better at imagining it... and I just left it at that."

lines.content: そのまま私は、“夜の中”には這入れなくなってしまって
lines.translated: "After that, I became unable to enter 'Inside the Night' anymore."

lines.content: だから、大雅のその命令を形にするのは……その“[魔法|想像]”は、私には……難しい
lines.translated: "So giving form to that command of yours, Taiga... that 'imagination'--that magic--is... difficult for me."

lines.content: それは、つまり。
lines.translated: In other words...

lines.content: 大げさな言い方をあえて選ぶのなら――僅かな希望が潰えた。そういうことになる。
lines.translated: If I were to deliberately put it dramatically--our faint hope had been crushed. That was what it meant.

lines.content: それはこちらが身勝手に抱いた希望ではあったけれど……。
lines.translated: Though it had been a selfish hope on my part to begin with...

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: ふと、姫織が俺を呼んだ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, Himeori called out to me.

lines.content: “空を、飛ぶ”……この“夜空を駆ける”
lines.translated: "'Flying through the sky'... 'soaring through this night sky.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 必ずしもそうしなければならないわけでも、ないんだよね。大雅。[・|あ][・|そ][・|こ]にたどり着けさえすればそれでいい。その方法に拘っているわけではない。そう、だよね？
lines.translated: "It's not as if we absolutely have to do it that way, right, Taiga? As long as we can reach *that place*, it's fine. You aren't particular about the method. Right?"

lines.content: 姫織……？
lines.translated: "Himeori...?"

lines.content: お願い、[・|私]。どうか、大雅の思った以上の“魔法”に、なれますように……
lines.translated: "Please, *me*. Please let me become a 'magic' that surpasses Taiga's expectations..."

lines.content: 姫織がそう言い、俺とつないだ手にぎゅっと力を込めたと、[・|そ][・|れ]は同時だった。
lines.translated: As Himeori said that and squeezed my hand tightly, *it* happened at the exact same moment.

lines.content: あのね、大雅。今度は私のほうから、お願いするよ――どうか私に力を貸してほしい
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. This time, let me be the one to ask--please lend me your strength."

lines.content: 瞬間。
lines.translated: In that instant.

lines.content: 頭の中にとある映像が流れ込んできた。
lines.translated: A certain image flowed into my mind.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は手をつないだ姫織の“[魔法|想像力]”だ。
lines.translated: *It* was the "imagination"--the magic--of Himeori, whose hand was joined with mine.
*It* was...

lines.content: 俺にとってみれば、“夜空を駆ける”だなんていう想像よりも、ずっとずっと難しいものであるように思えたけれど……。
lines.translated: To me, it seemed like something far, far more difficult than an imagination like "soaring through the night sky," and yet...

lines.content: ……あ、ああ、うん
lines.translated: "...A-Ah, yeah."

lines.content: うなずく。
lines.translated: I nodded.

lines.content: 充分だ。いいや、充分以上だよ
lines.translated: "That's enough. No, it's more than enough."

lines.content: その“魔法”はしかし、あまりに鮮やかな色彩を持ち、この俺の心に重なっていた。
lines.translated: However, that "magic" possessed extraordinarily vivid colors, overlapping with my own heart.

lines.content: ここまで確かな輪郭を持ち、想像を共有できているのなら――可能だ。その想像は“魔法”になり得る。[俺|拳銃]は、[姫織|弾丸]の“心”を撃ち放てる。
lines.translated: If it held such a distinct outline and we could share the imagination to this extent--it was possible. That imagination could become "magic." This *pistol*--myself--could fire the "heart" of the *bullet*--Himeori.

lines.content: 俺と姫織は顔を合わせ、小さくうなずきあった。
lines.translated: Himeori and I looked at each other and exchanged a small nod.
*Permission granted.*

lines.content: 心の中で拳銃の引き金を力強く押し込む――そのイメージをはっきりと思い浮かべられた。
lines.translated: Forcefully pulling the trigger of the pistol within my heart--I could clearly picture that image in my mind.

lines.content: ……“空を飛ぶ”ことは難しい。だから
lines.translated: "...'Flying through the sky' is difficult. And so..."

lines.content: そうささやく姫織は、時計塔へと手のひらを伸ばし、
lines.translated: Whispering that, Himeori reached her palm out toward the clock tower,

lines.content: だから……
ぎゅっと、その手のひらを握り込む。
lines.translated: And tightly clenched her hand into a fist.
"*And so, I will have the destination come to us instead.*"

lines.content: そして見えない手綱を引くように、ぐいっと、力強く拳を振りかぶったのだった。
lines.translated: Then, as if pulling on invisible reins, she forcefully yanked her fist back.

lines.content: すると……。
lines.translated: And when I did...

lines.content: グラグラと、揺れ始める。
lines.translated: A violent trembling began.

lines.content: 地面が。
lines.translated: The ground.

lines.content: 街全体が。
lines.translated: The entire city.

lines.content: わ、わあああ……っ
lines.translated: "W-Whaaa...!"

lines.content: 十夜が驚きのため息を漏らしていた。
lines.translated: Toya let out a gasp of astonishment.

lines.content: 俺たちのやり取りを静かに見守っていた十夜と、お友だちの女の子は……見上げている。
lines.translated: Toya and her friend, who had been quietly watching our exchange... were looking up.

lines.content: 空だ。
lines.translated: At the sky.
*However, at the end of their gaze, the night sky was no longer there.*

lines.content: そこには、星空の代わりに[・|街]の灯りがあった――
lines.translated: Instead of a starry sky, there were the lights of the *city*--

lines.content: ずっと先にあったはずの“刻の終着駅”のその光景が、俺たちの頭上へと、メキメキと音を立て迫って来ていたのだった。
lines.translated: The scenery of the "Terminal of Time," which should have been far ahead of us, was looming closer right above our heads with a loud creaking groan.
*The city was bending.*

lines.content: 目的地である駅の敷地を境目に……。
lines.translated: Using the grounds of the station, our destination, as the crease...

lines.content: 姫織の手に引っ張られるようにして、街は、まるで巨大な波のように、俺たちの頭上へと覆いかぶさろうとしていた。
lines.translated: As if being pulled by Himeori's hand, the city was about to arch right over our heads like a gigantic wave.

lines.content: その光景に――少し間抜けだけれど――俺はロールケーキを思い浮かべてしまう。
lines.translated: At that sight--though it was a bit silly--I couldn't help thinking of a Swiss roll.

lines.content: 折れ曲がるというよりは、街が丸まっていくようなイメージだった。
lines.translated: Rather than bending at a sharp angle, it looked more like the city was rolling up.

lines.content: 見上げたその場所を歩く者たちは、誰もがその現象に気づいてもいないようだ。
lines.translated: None of the people walking around in that place we were looking up at seemed to even notice the phenomenon.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側][・|の][・|重][・|力]に引っ張られ、バラバラと雨のように降り注いでくることもなく――平然とそれぞれが今夜の時間を過ごしている。
lines.translated: They weren't pulled by *the gravity on our side* to come raining down in pieces--each of them was calmly spending their time tonight as usual.

lines.content: 折り紙
lines.translated: "Origami."

lines.content: ぽつりと、姫織が言った。拳をしっかりと握りしめたまま。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured softly, keeping her fist tightly clenched.

lines.content: 私、折り紙好きなんだ
lines.translated: "I like origami."

lines.content: だから、切ったり張ったりは、得意。空を飛ぶよりもこうするほうが、私にとっては簡単に思えて……
lines.translated: "So I'm good at cutting and folding things. Doing it this way feels easier to me than flying through the sky..."

lines.content: だからこんな壮大にも思える“魔法”が叶ったのだと、そういうことらしかった。
lines.translated: And that, apparently, was why a "magic" that seemed so grand had been realized.

lines.content: ……頭上。
lines.translated: Right overhead.

lines.content: 街は、目的地は、もうすぐそこまで迫ってきている。
lines.translated: The city, our destination, had closed in until it was right in front of us.

lines.content: 時計塔の避雷針。
lines.translated: The lightning rod of the clock tower.

lines.content: 軽くジャンプすればそれを握れる距離まで接近して来ていた。
lines.translated: It had approached close enough that we could grab it with a light jump.

lines.content: ほら、十夜。掴まって
lines.translated: "Here, Toya. Hold on."

lines.content: 俺は十夜を抱き上げて、先に避雷針を握らせた。
lines.translated: I lifted Toya up and had her grab onto the lightning rod first.

lines.content: 続いて十夜のお友だち。
lines.translated: Next was Toya's friend.

lines.content: そして、姫織も続いた。
lines.translated: And then Himeori followed.

lines.content: 最後に俺だ。
lines.translated: I was last.

lines.content: 全員があちら側に映った途端――
lines.translated: The moment all of us had crossed over to the other side--

lines.content: ……ぐるりと。
lines.translated: With a sudden spin.

lines.content: 風景が逆転した。
lines.translated: The scenery inverted.

lines.content: 今度は路地裏が[空|上]となる。巨大な駅が[地面|下]である。
lines.translated: This time, the back alley became the *sky* above. The gigantic station was the *ground* below.

lines.content: 逆転した勢いで、危うく避雷針を手放してしまうところだった。
lines.translated: The momentum of the inversion nearly made me let go of the lightning rod.

lines.content: う、ううっ、高いよ大雅……っ
lines.translated: "U-Uuu, it's so high, Taiga...!"

lines.content: 十夜が俺にしがみついてくる。
lines.translated: Toya clung tightly to me.

lines.content: その弾みで、十夜の靴が片方、落下した――
lines.translated: In the process, one of Toya's shoes slipped off and fell--

lines.content: 恐る恐る、落された靴を見下ろす。
lines.translated: Timidly, I looked down after the dropped shoe.

lines.content: 豆粒よりも更に小さく見えるだけ。
lines.translated: It looked even smaller than a speck of dust.

lines.content: 確かにゾッとする高さだった。
lines.translated: It really was a spine-chilling height.

lines.content: 下を見ちゃだめだよとそう言って、俺は十夜の身体を引き寄せた。
lines.translated: Telling her not to look down, I pulled Toya's body close to mine.

lines.content: 姫織が握りしめた拳を解くと、路地裏はメキメキと音を立て……ゆっくり元に戻っていった。
lines.translated: When Himeori unclenched her fist, the back alley groaned loudly... and slowly returned to normal.

lines.content: 慎重に、時計塔の最上階に続く非常階段へと、俺たちは移る。
lines.translated: Carefully, we moved onto the emergency staircase leading to the top floor of the clock tower.

lines.content: しかし一息ついている暇はない。
lines.translated: However, there was no time to catch our breath.

lines.content: ……列車が
lines.translated: "...The train."

lines.content: 姫織が指さす。
lines.translated: Himeori pointed.

lines.content: その先には、構内に停車している列車があった。
lines.translated: Ahead of her finger was a train parked inside the station premises.

lines.content: 今夜の最終便である。
lines.translated: It was the final train of the night.

lines.content: 銀河の色よりも漆黒の車体は一度、大きな汽笛を響かせた。
lines.translated: Its body, pitch-blacker than the color of the galaxy, sounded a loud whistle once.

lines.content: 真っ白な蒸気が構内に広がった。
lines.translated: Pure white steam billowed across the platform.

lines.content: 背後にした時計塔の文字盤を振り返る――出発まであと一、二分だ。
lines.translated: I looked back at the clock face on the tower behind us--there were only one or two minutes left until departure.

lines.content: 急がなければ。
lines.translated: We had to hurry.

lines.content: ……間に合うだろうか。
lines.translated: Would we make it in time?

lines.content: 裏路地でじゃれ合うみたいにしてロスした時間を、後も先も考えていなかった自分を、今更になって後悔してしまう――
lines.translated: Only now did I regret the time we had wasted fooling around in the back alley, and my own lack of foresight--

lines.content: “魔法”で距離も時間も省略できれば余裕で間に合うとタカを括っていたのだ。
lines.translated: I had been too optimistic, assuming we'd easily make it in time if we could bypass both distance and time with "magic."

lines.content: もう、時間がない。ここから十夜の友だちの姿を探そう
lines.translated: "We're out of time. Let's look for Toya's friend from up here."

lines.content: 左手でつないだ俺の“[姫織|魔法]”にそう願った。
lines.translated: I made that wish to my "magic"--to Himeori--whose hand I held in my left.

lines.content: ――“ここから往来激しい構内を見下ろして、探し求める誰かの姿を捉えたい”
lines.translated: --"I want to look down from here at the bustling station premises and spot the figure of the person we're searching for."

lines.content: そのための“魔法”になるようにと、俺は、命じた。
lines.translated: I commanded her to become the "magic" for that purpose.

lines.content: ん。了解――
lines.translated: "Mm. Understood--"

lines.content: 姫織はうなずく。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded.
"Because tonight, I am *yours to command*... Taiga."

lines.content: そして、俺と繋いでいないほうの手で――人差し指と親指で、ふたつ、小さな輪を作った。
lines.translated: Then, with the hand not holding mine--she made a small circle with her index finger and thumb.

lines.content: それから十夜の背後に立つと、その輪っかをまるでメガネみたいにして、十夜の目の前に姫織はかざした――
lines.translated: Stepping behind Toya, Himeori held that circle up in front of Toya's eyes just like a pair of glasses--

lines.content: わぁ～……すごい。望遠鏡みたい。下の景色がすぐ近くに見えちゃうよ
lines.translated: "Waaah~... Amazing. It's like a telescope. I can see the view below right up close!"

lines.content: ――十夜は、驚きながらも。
lines.translated: --Though surprised, Toya...

lines.content: 姫織の指の間をまさに望遠鏡のように覗き込み、お友だちの姿を探した。
lines.translated: peered through Himeori's fingers just like a telescope, searching for her friend.

lines.content: ざわざわと。
lines.translated: Hustling and bustling.

lines.content: がやがやと。
lines.translated: Chattering and clamoring.

lines.content: あらゆるイキモノが往来する広い構内。
lines.translated: Countless Creatures of the Night came and went across the vast station premises.

lines.content: その中から特定の人物を炙り出すようにと、俺は姫織と、“[想像|魔法]”と言葉とを、重ねたのだけれど……。
lines.translated: I layered my words with Himeori and my "magic" to single out one specific person from the crowd, and yet...

lines.content: ……いない
lines.translated: "...She's not here."

lines.content: 十夜が、言った。
lines.translated: Toya spoke.

lines.content: あの子。ここには、いないよ
lines.translated: "That girl... she isn't here."

lines.content: ……十夜の求めるその姿はどこにもない。見つからない。
lines.translated: The figure Toya was searching for was nowhere to be seen. We couldn't find her.

lines.content: お友だちの孫――新しい十夜のお友だちにも構内をぐるりと見てもらった。
lines.translated: I had her friend's granddaughter--Toya's new friend--take a look around the station as well.

lines.content: しかし探し出したい人の姿は確かに、どこにも見当たらなかった。
lines.translated: However, the person we wanted to find really wasn't anywhere in sight.

lines.content: もう既に十夜のお友だちはこの“夜”を去ってしまったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had Toya's friend already left this "Night"?

lines.content: 今夜の最終便を待つことなく……。
lines.translated: Without even waiting for tonight's final train...

lines.content: 選んだ“次”へと早々に旅立ってしまったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had she already set off early for the "next" place she had chosen?

lines.content: かつての友だちのことを、また再び、忘却してしまったのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had she once again forgotten all about her old friend?

lines.content: ……やっぱり
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: 十夜が、つぶやく。
lines.translated: Toya murmured.

lines.content: “やっぱり、私のことを待っていてくれる人なんて……”
lines.translated: "I knew it, there's no one who would wait for me..."

lines.content: 肩を落とした小さな背中がそう語っているように見えてしまった。
lines.translated: Her small back, shoulders slumped, seemed to be saying just that.

lines.content: 仕方、ないよね
lines.translated: "It can't be helped, right?"

lines.content: 十夜？
lines.translated: "Toya?"

lines.content: だってさ、私たち。今夜ここで会おうって、そんな約束したわけでもないんだし……
lines.translated: "Because, you know... it's not like we made a promise to meet here tonight or anything..."

lines.content: まるで聞き分けのいい子のようにそう言って、十夜は小さく笑っていた。
lines.translated: Saying that like a well-behaved, understanding child, Toya gave a small smile.

lines.content: そしてもう帰ろうと十夜は言うのだ。
lines.translated: And then, Toya said that we should head back.

lines.content: ありがとう。大雅、姫織ちゃん。そして私の新しい、大切な、お友だち
lines.translated: "Thank you. Taiga, Himeori-chan. And my precious new friend."

lines.content: みんなのおかげで、今夜、少しだけ勇気が出せたような気がするよ……
lines.translated: "Thanks to all of you, I feel like I was able to muster up a little bit of courage tonight..."

lines.content: 十夜は笑顔でそう言った。
lines.translated: Toya said that with a smile.

lines.content: ……しかしその横顔は、さみしそう。
lines.translated: However, her profile looked so lonely.

lines.content: ここ数日、俺が心配を重ねていた顔だった。
lines.translated: It was the same expression I had spent the past few days worrying over.

lines.content: 先ほど覗いてみてしまった心の風景。その中で何度となく見つめた表情だった。
lines.translated: The expression I had stared at time and time again within the landscape of her heart that I had glimpsed earlier.

lines.content: ……約束、か
lines.translated: "...A promise, huh."

lines.content: 俺がため息のようにそうつぶやいたのと、[・|そ][・|れ]は同時だった――……大きな汽笛が鳴り響いたのが。
lines.translated: Just as I muttered that like a sigh, *it* happened at the exact same moment--...a loud whistle echoed out.

lines.content: 今夜の最終便が甲高い汽笛と共に真っ白な蒸気を吐き出し、ゆっくり、ゆっくりと発進し始めたのが。
lines.translated: Tonight's final train spewed pure white steam alongside a shrill whistle, slowly, ever so slowly beginning to pull away.

lines.content: そして、ふっと。
lines.translated: And then, suddenly.

lines.content: 俺の頭にとある可能性が浮かんできたのが――殆どすべて、同時だったのだ。
lines.translated: A certain possibility flashed into my mind--almost all of it happened simultaneously.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: そのすべてを、手をつないだままの姫織には、今夜の俺の“魔法”には。
lines.translated: All of that seemed to be conveyed to Himeori, whose hand I was still holding--to my "magic" for tonight.

lines.content: 今……俺の考えていることが、伝わったようだった。
lines.translated: What I was thinking right now... had reached her.

lines.content: 俺と姫織はうなずき合う。
lines.translated: Himeori and I nodded to each other.

lines.content: そして姫織が片目を瞑り、[・|そ][・|の][・|方][・|向]に向かって、人差し指と親指で作った輪っかを通して覗き見た。
lines.translated: Then Himeori closed one eye and peered through the circle made by her thumb and index finger toward *that direction*.

lines.content: 大雅の予想通りだね
lines.translated: "It's just as you guessed, Taiga."

lines.content: 姫織が言う。俺にうなずきながら。
lines.translated: Himeori said, nodding to me.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だち、たぶん、見つけた
lines.translated: "I think I found Toya's friend."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……ひよちゃん。もう一度、“魔法”をお願いできるかな
lines.translated: "...Hiyo-chan. Could I ask you for 'magic' one more time?"

lines.content: うん。わかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Okay."

lines.content: もう一度姫織とうなずき合った。
lines.translated: Himeori and I nodded to each other once again.

lines.content: そんな俺たちを不思議そうに見上げている十夜に……言った。
lines.translated: And to Toya, who was looking up at us in confusion... I spoke.

lines.content: ねえ、十夜
lines.translated: "Hey, Toya."

lines.content: う、うん。なに、大雅
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. What is it, Taiga?"

lines.content: 十夜はお友だちと“約束”したわけじゃないから、今夜は会うことができなくても仕方がないって、そう言っていたけれど……大丈夫。ちゃんと見つけられたよ。十夜のお友だち
lines.translated: "You said it couldn't be helped if you didn't get to see her tonight because you never made a 'promise' with your friend... but it's okay. We found her. Your friend."

lines.content: 大雅？　それって、どういうこと……？
lines.translated: "Taiga? What do you mean by that...?"

lines.content: ……ああ、うん
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: あそこだ。あそこに十夜を待ってくれている人がいる
lines.translated: "Over there. The person waiting for you is right over there."

lines.content: 俺は夜空の向こうを指さして、言った。
lines.translated: I pointed beyond the night sky and spoke.

lines.content: ……十夜。よく思い出してほしい
lines.translated: "...Toya. I want you to remember carefully."

lines.content: 十夜と、十夜のお友だち。ふたりはちゃんと“約束”、してたじゃないか
lines.translated: "You and your friend. The two of you did make a proper 'promise,' didn't you?"

lines.content: だからあの子は、今もずっと[・|あ][・|そ][・|こ]で、十夜のことを待ってるんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why she's still *there* right now, waiting for you all this time."

lines.content: ……そろそろ“夜”が明ける時間だ
lines.translated: "...It's almost time for the 'Night' to break."

lines.content: 俺は“夜”の空を見上げた。
lines.translated: I looked up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: そこには星が。満月が。眩い“夜”が広がっている。
lines.translated: Up there, the stars, the full moon, and the dazzling "Night" stretched out wide.
--"*My friend fell from the sky.*"

lines.content: ついさっき耳にしたそんな言葉を、俺は忘れられずにいた。
lines.translated: I couldn't forget those words I had heard just moments ago.

lines.content: 今夜は驚いたよ。本当に
lines.translated: "Tonight really surprised me. Truly."

lines.content: 隣を歩く姫織が言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said, walking beside me.

lines.content: その姿は、既に俺の“魔法”ではなくなっている。私服だ。
lines.translated: Her appearance was no longer that of my "magic." She was in her casual clothes.

lines.content: いきなり起こされたかと思ったら、部屋に大雅がいて……
lines.translated: "Just when I thought I was woken up out of nowhere, you were in my room, Taiga..."

lines.content: だけどそこは、“夜”の中で。久しぶりに十夜にも会えて
lines.translated: "But we were inside the 'Night.' And I got to see Toya again after so long."

lines.content: 色々といっぺんに起きた“夜”だから、本当に驚いたんだよ
lines.translated: "So many things happened all at once in this 'Night,' it really took me by surprise."

lines.content: 俺は姫織に今夜の出来事を話ながら歩いていた。
lines.translated: I walked along, telling Himeori about everything that had happened tonight.

lines.content: 十夜とお友だちとの“さよなら”を、その一部始終を、すべて見届けてから……このような今がある。
lines.translated: After watching over Toya and her friend's "goodbye" from beginning to end... here we were now.

lines.content: そういった流れの中で、十夜にお友だちがいたことがわかったんだよ。何人も、何人も……たくさん
lines.translated: "Through the course of all that, I found out that Toya had friends. Many, many of them... so many."

lines.content: “今”がつらくてどうしようもない。
lines.translated: Children whose "present" was so painful they couldn't bear it.

lines.content: そんな小さな子たちの心に芽吹き始めた“[つらい気持ち|悪夢]”を、十夜は、十夜なりの方法で……小さな“魔法”で、少しでも軽くしてあげたいと願ってた。
lines.translated: In her own way... with her own small "magic," Toya had wished to lighten the "nightmares"--the painful feelings--beginning to sprout in the hearts of those little children, even if only a little.

lines.content: 十年間。君たち“特別な女の子たち”が、“夜”の中でしていた仕事を、今は俺たちが引き継いでこなしてるんだよ
lines.translated: "For ten years. The work that you 'special girls' used to do inside the 'Night' is something we've taken over and are handling now."

lines.content: 俺のように半端に乱暴な手段を取るでもなく――もっとやさしく、丁寧に。
lines.translated: Not by taking half-baked, reckless measures like I did--but much more gently and carefully.

lines.content: そうして出会ったお友だちのことを、十夜はずっと、ひとりぼっちで応援していたみたいだけれど……
lines.translated: "It seems Toya was always cheering on the friends she met that way, all by herself..."

lines.content: だけど人間は誰もがみんないつか大人になっていくイキモノだ。お別れのときは必ずやって来る。
lines.translated: But humans are creatures who all grow up into adults someday. The time to say goodbye always comes without fail.

lines.content: ……その[・|と][・|き]はいつだって突然なのだ。
lines.translated: And that *time* is always sudden.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|で][・|い][・|い]と思っていても、忘れられることはやっぱりひどく悲しくて
lines.translated: "Even if she told herself *that was fine*, being forgotten was still terribly sad."

lines.content: せめて最後に“ありがとう”や“さよなら”を言えたなら、そのさみしさは軽くなるかもって、十夜は夢見ていたみたいだけれど……
lines.translated: "Toya dreamed that if she could at least say 'thank you' or 'goodbye' at the very end, that loneliness might become a little lighter..."

lines.content: 結局はずっとずっと、長い間、その“夢”を叶えることはできなくて……
lines.translated: "In the end, for a long, long time, she was never able to make that 'dream' come true..."

lines.content: 十夜のさみしさはそこにあったのだ。
lines.translated: That was where Toya's loneliness lay.

lines.content: 応援したい人たちが、幸せに……いつか笑顔になれたとしても……。
lines.translated: Even if the people she wanted to cheer on found happiness... even if they were able to smile someday...

lines.content: その輪の中に、決して自分は加われない――いつもだ。いつも、いつでも、十夜はひとりぼっちだった。
lines.translated: She could never join that circle herself--always. Always, at every moment, Toya was all alone.

lines.content: 俺は、背中に負ぶった十夜の小さな重さを改めて感じ取る。
lines.translated: I felt anew the small weight of Toya, whom I was carrying on my back.

lines.content: 耳元に小さな寝息を感じた。
lines.translated: I felt her soft, sleeping breaths right by my ear.

lines.content: 色々なことがあった“夜”だから。
lines.translated: Because it had been an eventful "Night."

lines.content: 少し疲れて眠ってしまった、十夜だから……。
lines.translated: And because Toya had gotten a little tired and fallen asleep...

lines.content: その小さな胸に閉じ込め続けた小さな“夢”は、今夜、何を思い残すこともなくすべて叶えられたのだろうか。
lines.translated: Had the small "dream" she kept locked inside her tiny chest finally come true tonight, leaving no regrets behind?

lines.content: 十夜は俺の大切な友だちだから。
lines.translated: Because Toya is my precious friend.

lines.content: だからそれをもう一度確かめようと、俺は数分前の出来事を思い返そうとする――
lines.translated: Wanting to make sure of that once more, I tried to recall the events of just a few minutes ago--

lines.content: ……お友だちが空から落ちてきた
lines.translated: "...My friend fell from the sky."

lines.content: 十夜を抱きしめた[・|そ][・|の][・|人]は、心がこぼれ落ちそうなほどの笑顔でそう言った。
lines.translated: Embracing Toya, *that person* said so with a smile so warm her heart seemed ready to spill over.

lines.content: いつも悲しそうな顔をした女の子。十夜のお友だち。
lines.translated: The girl who always wore a sad face. Toya's friend.

lines.content: ……今は、やさしそうに微笑む、かわいい顔のおばあさん。
lines.translated: Now, an old woman with a cute face, smiling ever so gently.

lines.content: [・|彼][・|女]がいたのは、公園だ。
lines.translated: The place *she* had been was the park.

lines.content: かつて少女時代の一部を十夜と過ごした公園。その“夜”だった。
lines.translated: The park where she had once spent part of her girlhood with Toya. It was the "Night" of that place.

lines.content: 終わった命を“次”へと運ぶ最終便。それに乗車することなど考えもせず……。
lines.translated: Without a single thought of boarding the final train that carried ended lives to the "next" place...

lines.content: ただただじっと、雨の止んだ“夜”の空を見上げては、そのひとは十夜が会いに来てくれるのを待っていた。
lines.translated: She had simply stood still, gazing up at the sky of the "Night" where the rain had stopped, waiting for Toya to come see her.

lines.content: 驚いたよ。十夜ちゃん
lines.translated: "You surprised me, Toya-chan."

lines.content: 十夜を抱きしめたまま、そのひとは言った。
lines.translated: Still holding Toya tight, that person spoke.

lines.content: まさか、雨の代わりにお友だちが空から降って来るなんて……。思いもしなかったよ
lines.translated: "To think my friend would fall from the sky instead of rain... I never would have imagined it."

lines.content: しわくちゃのやさしい顔で微笑んだ。
lines.translated: She smiled with her wrinkled, gentle face.

lines.content: 時計塔から見渡した“夜”の中――
lines.translated: Inside the "Night" we had looked out over from the clock tower--

lines.content: この場所にお友だちの姿を見つけた姫織が、もう一度、その“[魔法|想像力]”で“夜”の街をまるで折り紙細工のように折り曲げて。
lines.translated: Having spotted her friend in this place, Himeori had used her "imagination"--her "magic"--once more to fold the city of the "Night" just like a piece of origami.

lines.content: 早く。
lines.translated: Hurry.

lines.content: ……早く。
lines.translated: Hurry.

lines.content: 一刻でも、早く。
lines.translated: As fast as she could, even a single moment sooner.

lines.content: 自分のことを待っていてくれるお友だちのところへ飛んでいきたい。
lines.translated: She wanted to fly to the friend who was waiting for her.

lines.content: そんな十夜をこの場所に、送り届けてくれた。
lines.translated: Himeori had delivered Toya right to this place.
*Toya fell straight into her friend's chest*.

lines.content: 見上げた[空|公園]で、十夜に向かい、両手を広げたお友だちの腕の中へと……。
lines.translated: In the park sky she looked up at, straight into the arms of her friend, who had spread both hands wide toward Toya...

lines.content: 大切なお友だちが、夜空の向こうから降ってきた
lines.translated: "My precious friend fell from beyond the night sky."

lines.content: その人は十夜を抱きしめて、何か大切なものを確かめるみたいにもう一度、そう言った。
lines.translated: Holding Toya tight, that person said those words once more, as if making sure of something precious.

lines.content: やっと……
lines.translated: "Finally..."

lines.content: やっと会えたね。私の一番の、お友だち
lines.translated: "We finally met again. My very best friend."

lines.content: 抱きしめた十夜に、子猫に頬ずりするみたいに顔を寄せ。
lines.translated: She pressed her face close to the Toya in her embrace, as if nuzzling her cheek against a kitten.

lines.content: ごめんね。約束を守れなくて……。酷いお友だちで、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I couldn't keep our promise... I'm sorry for being a terrible friend."

lines.content: あなたとの約束も、あなたのさみしそうな顔も、何もかも、覚えていられなかったけれど……
lines.translated: "My promise to you, your lonely face, everything... I couldn't remember any of it, and yet..."

lines.content: それでもずっと、ずっとずっと、会いたかったよ……。長い間ひとりぼっちにさせてしまって、ごめんなさいね
lines.translated: "Even so, I always, always, always wanted to see you... I'm so sorry for leaving you all alone for so long."

lines.content: ふたりは雨が上がるのを待っていた。
lines.translated: The two of them had been waiting for the rain to stop.

lines.content: 次に会うのは晴れの日だ。思い切り一緒に遊ぼうねと約束をした。
lines.translated: The next time we meet will be on a sunny day. They had promised to play together to their hearts' content.

lines.content: 私はあなたに笑ってほしかった。十夜を抱きしめた人が、言う。
lines.translated: I wanted you to smile. The person embracing Toya spoke.

lines.content: ……私たちはあなたにとって本当に酷いお友だちだった
lines.translated: "...We were truly terrible friends to you."
*Always pushing nothing but our own painful feelings onto you*...

lines.content: つらいことや悲しいことばっかり、小さなあなたの心を、そのための受け皿みたいに吐き出して……。
lines.translated: Pouring out nothing but painful and sad things, treating your tiny heart like a receptacle for it all...

lines.content: きっと誰も、あなたには楽しいことをたったひとつでも贈ろうとしてこなかった。
lines.translated: Surely no one ever tried to give you even a single fun memory in return.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ][・|で][・|い][・|い]とあなたが笑ってくれるから。
lines.translated: Because you would smile and say *that was fine*.

lines.content: 私たちのつらい気持ちが、少しでも軽くなるなら[・|そ][・|れ][・|で][・|い][・|い]んだよと、甘えさせてくれるから。
lines.translated: Because you let us lean on you, telling us that if our painful feelings grew even a little lighter, *that was fine*.

lines.content: だから私は、私たちは、この子の気持ちなどほんの少しだって考えようともしなかった――……本当は、
lines.translated: And so I--so we--never even tried to give the slightest thought to this girl's feelings... When the truth was,

lines.content: 本当は、わかってた
lines.translated: "The truth was, I knew."
There was no way *that was fine*.

lines.content: ずっと応援してる誰かにすてきなことがあったとしても……。
lines.translated: Even if something wonderful happened to someone she had been cheering on all along...

lines.content: 自分だけ“おめでとう”のひとつも言えないばかりか、側にいることもできないのがさみしくて、つらい――
lines.translated: Being the only one unable to say a single "congratulations," let alone be by their side, had to be so lonely and painful--

lines.content: 本当は、あなたが誰よりさみしくがり屋で……
lines.translated: "The truth is, you get lonelier than anyone else..."

lines.content: たくさんのお別れを繰り返し……。
lines.translated: Repeating so many goodbyes...

lines.content: その度に、忘れられ……。
lines.translated: And being forgotten every single time...

lines.content: その度にひとりぼっちで、止まない雨みたいに泣いていたに違いない
lines.translated: "Every single time, you must have been all alone, crying like an endless rain."

lines.content: 私も、私たちみんなも、心のどこかでわかっていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though both I and all the rest of us must have known it somewhere in our hearts.

lines.content: それなのに私たちはそれを見ないふりして。
lines.translated: And yet, we pretended not to see it.

lines.content: ……知らないふりして。
lines.translated: We pretended not to know.

lines.content: 自分たちの心が少しでも楽になるようにと、あなたの“魔法”を、そのやさしさを利用したのだ。
lines.translated: So that our own hearts might feel even a little lighter, we took advantage of your "magic," of that kindness of yours.

lines.content: やさしいあなたにつらかったことをぶちまけて。悲しかったことを垂れ流し。
lines.translated: We dumped our painful experiences onto gentle you. We let our sadness spill out unchecked.

lines.content: ……時には憎悪にも似た夜色の感情をたたき付けたこともあっただろう。
lines.translated: At times, we must have even lashed out at you with night-colored emotions akin to hatred.

lines.content: それなのに、用が済んだらさようなら……
lines.translated: "And yet, once we were done with you, it was goodbye..."

lines.content: あなたのことなんて誰も思い出すことさえもない。
lines.translated: No one ever even remembered you.

lines.content: それでもあなたは、そんな私たちのことをいつまでも応援してるよと微笑んだ……。
lines.translated: Even so, you smiled and said you would always be cheering for us...
*Without ever speaking of the true effect of your "magic."*

lines.content: そんなのは、ひどい。さみしいだなんて言葉じゃ足りない。
lines.translated: That's just awful. A word like "lonely" doesn't even begin to cover it.

lines.content: だから私はあなたに笑ってほしいと思った。
lines.translated: That's why I wanted you to smile.

lines.content: そんな自分は、あなたを忘れた他の子たちとは違うと、信じていたのに。
lines.translated: Even though I believed I was different from the other kids who forgot you.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: それなのに、私は忘れた。あなたを、忘れた
lines.translated: "And yet, I forgot. I forgot you."

lines.content: あなたのいない遠いとおい別の街で、自分ひとりだけ幸せになった。大切なあなたを、雨降りの公園に置き去りにしたままで
lines.translated: "In a distant, faraway town without you, I became happy all by myself. Leaving precious you behind in that rainy park."

lines.content: ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……言葉がこぼれる。
lines.translated: The words spilled out.

lines.content: あなたをひとりぼっちにして、ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry for leaving you all alone.

lines.content: あなたのこと、忘れたくなかった。いつまでもお友だちでいたかった
lines.translated: "I didn't want to forget you. I wanted us to be friends forever."

lines.content: うれしかったこと。幸せなこと。そういった全部をいつまでも笑顔で報告し合える仲良しでいたかった。それなのに、どうして……。どうして私は、忘れてしまったの
lines.translated: "The happy things. The joyful things. I wanted us to stay close friends who could always share all of those things with a smile. And yet, why...? Why did I forget?"

lines.content: こんなにも、こんなにも、大切にしたいと思っていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though I must have wanted to treasure you so, so very much.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちは繰り返しごめんなさいと言う。酷いお友だちで本当にごめんなさい、と。
lines.translated: Toya's friend apologized over and over. Saying she was truly sorry for being such a terrible friend.

lines.content: ……どうして
お友だちの胸に抱きしめられたまま、十夜は……。
lines.translated: Still held tight against her friend's chest, Toya...

lines.content: ねえ、どうして……。どうして私なんかを待っていてくれたの
lines.translated: "Hey, why...? Why did you wait for someone like me?"

lines.content: ……いつまでもずっと小さいままの十夜は、声を微かに震わせながらそう言った。
lines.translated: Toya, who remained forever small, spoke with her voice faintly trembling.

lines.content: “太陽の時間”の中で、あなたの命が亡くなってから、今夜でちょうど一週間……なんだよね？
lines.translated: "In the 'Time of the Sun,' tonight marks restless days... exactly one week since your life ended, right?"

lines.content: ええ。そうね。きっと、それくらいだと思う
lines.translated: "Yes. That's right. I think it's been just about that long."

lines.content: 八十年？　九十年？　そんなのはあっという間だったけど、ここで、あなたのことを待っていたこの一週間は、とってもとっても、長く感じたわ
lines.translated: "Eighty years? Ninety years? All of that went by in the blink of an eye, but this past week I spent waiting for you here felt so, so very long."

lines.content: ひとりぼっちだったあなたの気持ちが、ほんの少しだけわかった気がするよ――
lines.translated: I feel like I finally understand, even if just a little bit, how you felt being all alone--

lines.content: そう言い、十夜の頬をやさしく撫でた。
lines.translated: Saying that, she gently stroked Toya's cheek.

lines.content: ……違う
lines.translated: "...Wrong."

lines.content: 違うよ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: そんなことが言いたいわけじゃあない。十夜はその人の手を握りしめ、問い返す。
lines.translated: That wasn't what she meant to say. Toya squeezed the woman's hand and asked again.

lines.content: どうして。どうして、なの。私の大切なお友だち。私はあなたのハッピーエンドを願ってた
lines.translated: "Why? Why did you do this, my precious friend? I wished for your happy ending."

lines.content: 今夜で、最後だったんだよ。今夜の最終便に乗らなかったら、“次”の“切符”を買わなかったら、あなたは、もう……
lines.translated: "Tonight was the very last chance. If you don't board tonight's final train, if you don't buy a 'ticket' to the 'next' place, you'll never..."

lines.content: この街の“夜”から二度と離れられなくなってしまうのだ。
lines.translated: She would never be able to leave the "Night" of this town again.
The "Night"...

lines.content: “夜の国”
lines.translated: The "Night Realm."

lines.content: ここは言ってみれば[月|あの世]と[太陽|この世]の中間点でもある。
lines.translated: In a manner of speaking, this place is a midpoint between the Moon--the afterlife--and the Sun--this world.

lines.content: 終わってしまった命あるものは、この“夜”を必ず一度は通過する――
lines.translated: Every living thing whose life has ended passes through this "Night" at least once--

lines.content: この通過点は“次”へと向かうまでの休憩所のようなものでもあった。
lines.translated: This transit point was also like a resting area on the way to the "next" place.

lines.content: 旅の途中、心に背負い込んだ多くの荷物をここに降ろして身軽になることができる。
lines.translated: Here, one can set down the many burdens carried in their heart during their journey and unburden themselves.

lines.content: 誰もが心にひとつやふたつくらい、未練のようなものを抱えて生きているものだけど。
