lines.translated: Everyone lives carrying one or two lingering regrets in their heart, after all.

lines.content: 途中下車したこの“夜”で、与えられた猶予期間の中で、すべての“思い残し”を解消することも――やりようによっては――可能ではあるけれど。
lines.translated: By making a stopover in this "Night," within the grace period granted to them, it is possible--depending on how one goes about it--to resolve all the "lingering regrets" left behind, however.

lines.content: しかしその猶予はたった一週間。
lines.translated: However, that grace period is only one week.

lines.content: その時間を過ぎても尚、まだ“夜”の中を離れられずにいる者は、永遠にこの時間の中をさ迷い歩くことになる。
lines.translated: Those who are still unable to leave the "Night" even after that time has passed will wander through this time for eternity.

lines.content: そうしていつしか[・|そ][・|れ]は“夜”に住み着く闇となり……。
lines.translated: And before long, *that* becomes a darkness that takes up residence in the "Night"...

lines.content: “夜”の牢獄に、文字通り永遠と閉じ込められたまま……。
lines.translated: Locked away in the prison of the "Night," quite literally for eternity...

lines.content: 深いふかい“夜”に滲んで溶けていくように、その心は消えてなくなる――それこそが命にとって本当の意味での“死”であった。
lines.translated: Like seeping and dissolving into the deep, deep "Night," their heart fades away into nothing--and that is what constitutes true "death" for a life.

lines.content: 更に、“夜”を彷徨う闇は、ふとしたきっかけで、手の付けられない“悪夢”に変わることも多くある。
lines.translated: Furthermore, the darkness wandering the "Night" often turns into an uncontrollable "nightmare" at the slightest trigger.

lines.content: あなただって、そんな“夜”のルールがわからなかったはずもないのに……
lines.translated: "There's no way you didn't know those rules of the 'Night'..."

lines.content: “夜”の中で目覚めた命のほとんどすべてが、[・|そ][・|れ]を自然と悟ることになるというのに……。
lines.translated: When almost every single life that awakens inside the "Night" comes to understand *that* naturally...

lines.content: それなのに、どうして
lines.translated: "And yet, why?"

lines.content: ……どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: 自ら消え去ることを選んでまで、私なんかとの“約束”に拘ったのか。
lines.translated: Why did you cling to a "promise" with someone like me, even choosing to fade away yourself?

lines.content: ……私なんか忘れたまま、“次”に進んでいればよかったのに
lines.translated: "...You should have just kept forgetting about me and moved on to the 'next' place."

lines.content: そうすればまた、今回とは違う幸せが、あなたの“次”の時間の中であなたのことを待っていたかもしれないのに
lines.translated: "If you had done that, a different kind of happiness from this time might have been waiting for you in your 'next' time."

lines.content: その幸せを私があなたから奪ってしまった。
lines.translated: I robbed you of that happiness.

lines.content: そんな十夜の心の声を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: I felt as though I heard that voice in Toya's heart.

lines.content: 私は、私たちは、あなた達のハッピーエンドだけをいつも祈っていたいのに――こんなのは、違う。私の求めていい幸せな終わりじゃない。
lines.translated: I--we--always want to pray only for your happy endings--this isn't right. This isn't a happy ending I have any right to ask for.

lines.content: 十夜はお友だちの胸に額を押しつけていた。
lines.translated: Toya pressed her forehead against her friend's chest.

lines.content: 伝えたい
lines.translated: "I wanted to tell you."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……あなたに、伝えたいことがあったの
lines.translated: "...There was something I wanted to tell you."

lines.content: ……伝えたい、こと？
lines.translated: "...Something you wanted to tell me?"

lines.content: ……ええ
それをあなたに直接こうして伝えなければ……私の人生に、私の心に、ハッピーエンドだなんてどこまでもあり得なかった
lines.translated: "Unless I told you this directly, just like this... there never could have been a happy ending for my life, or for my heart."

lines.content: それって……
lines.translated: "Does that mean..."

lines.content: 抱きしめられた胸の中で、十夜は微笑むお友だちを見上げた。
lines.translated: From within the chest embracing her, Toya looked up at her smiling friend.

lines.content: 色々……
lines.translated: "So much..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……思えば、色々なことのあった人生だった
lines.translated: "...Looking back, it was a life where so many things happened."

lines.content: この世に生きるすべての人たちと同じように、何ひとつ容易にはいかず、たくさん涙も流したけれど……。
lines.translated: Just like everyone else living in this world, nothing ever went easily, and I shed so many tears, too, but...

lines.content: 悲しいことも。さみしいことも。眠れないばかりで呼吸が止まるかと思った夜も、たくさん、あったけど
lines.translated: "Sad things. Lonely things. There were so many nights when I couldn't sleep and thought my breathing might just stop, too, but..."

lines.content: 八十年
lines.translated: "Eighty years."

lines.content: ……ううん。ほとんど九十年ちかくの人生だ。本当に良くよく、生きた
lines.translated: "...No, it was a life of nearly ninety years. I truly, truly lived it to the fullest."

lines.content: 涙だけじゃなく幸せなこともたくさんあった。いっぱいの大切な人たちに囲まれた――笑顔の多い、人生だった、けれど
lines.translated: "There wasn't just tears; there was plenty of happiness, too. I was surrounded by so many precious people--it was a life full of smiles, and yet..."

lines.content: その輪の中に、あなただけがいなかった。
lines.translated: You were the only one missing from that circle.

lines.content: あなたの姿をいつも心のどこかで探していたはずの、[・|私][・|た][・|ち]だから――
lines.translated: Because *we* must have always been searching for you somewhere in our hearts--

lines.content: ありがとう。私の大切なお友だち
lines.translated: "Thank you, my precious friend."

lines.content: ――今だから、わかるよ。
lines.translated: --Now, I finally understand.

lines.content: 目には見えなくても、声が届かなくても。言葉を交わすことも、できなくなっても――あなたはいつも、私たちを応援してくれていたんだよね
lines.translated: "Even if we couldn't see you, even if our voices couldn't reach you. Even when we could no longer exchange words--you were always cheering us on, weren't you?"

lines.content: 私たち以外にもお友だち、十夜にはたくさん、いたんだね。きっと、あさひさんにも
lines.translated: "Toya had lots of friends besides us, didn't she? And surely, Asahi-san did, too."

lines.content: ふと姫織に声をかけられて意識を戻す――“夜”の空を見つめながら、俺はつい先ほど目にした出来事を思い出していたのだ。
lines.translated: Himeori's sudden words brought me back to reality--while gazing up at the sky of the "Night," I had been recalling what I had witnessed just moments ago.

lines.content: ……小さかった頃の私たちが、あのふたりと出会うずっと昔から、ふたりは、私たちみたいな子のそばにいたってことなんだね
lines.translated: "...Long before we met the two of them when we were little, they were already staying by the side of kids just like us, weren't they?"

lines.content: まるで今はじめてそれを知ったかのようなせりふだったけれど――しかし。
lines.translated: She spoke as if she had only just learned that for the first time--and yet.

lines.content: もちろんそれを知らないわけじゃなかったけれど、今夜、それをはじめて実感できたような気がして、どうしてか複雑な気持ちがするよ
lines.translated: "Of course, it's not that I didn't know, but tonight, I feel like I've truly grasped what it means for the first time, and for some reason, it leaves me with mixed feelings."

lines.content: 負ぶった十夜の身体を背負い直す。
lines.translated: I shifted Toya's weight on my back to get a better hold of her.

lines.content: 十夜は今、どんな夢を見ているのだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of dream is Toya having right now?

lines.content: ……いい夢だった、と。
lines.translated: That it was a good dream.

lines.content: （目を覚ましたときに笑ってそう教えてくれるようなものだったらいいけれど……）
lines.translated: (It would be nice if it's the kind of dream she can smile and tell me about when she wakes up...)

lines.content: この世界から悲しいことなどなくなってしまえばいいのに。
lines.translated: I wish all the sad things in this world would just disappear.

lines.content: そんなことを、ふと思いながら――
lines.translated: As that thought crossed my mind--

lines.content: この小さな身体を離すまい。
lines.translated: I won't let go of this small body.

lines.content: せめて、俺たちの“さよなら”が訪れるそのときまでは……。
lines.translated: At least, not until the time for our "goodbye" arrives...

lines.content: そう誓うと、不思議だった。
lines.translated: Strangely enough, the moment I swore that...
It was my *left hand*.

lines.content: 十夜の身体に触れる手のひらから……。
lines.translated: Through the palm touching Toya's body...

lines.content: 眠る彼女の心が、あるいは夢が、“夜”の左手を通じ、俺の内側に流れ込んでくるかのようだった。
lines.translated: It felt as though her sleeping heart, or perhaps her dream, was flowing into me through my "Night" left hand.

lines.content: 『つらくなったら、またおいで』
lines.translated: "Whenever things get tough, come back again."

lines.content: 『君の好きなものをいっぱい、温かいご飯をたくさん作って、待ってるからな――……』
lines.translated: "I'll make lots of your favorite dishes, plenty of warm food, and be waiting right here for you--..."

lines.content: 大好きなお姉ちゃんが、“ゆめのねどこ”から旅立つ子たちを、いつもそんな言葉で送り出していた。
lines.translated: Her beloved older sister always sent off the children leaving the "Dream Bed" with those words.

lines.content: つらくなったら、また……
lines.translated: "Whenever things get tough, come back..."

lines.content: 小さくつぶやき、空を見上げた女の子……。
lines.translated: The girl murmured softly, looking up at the sky...

lines.content: 姉のような“魔法使い”になりたいと願う小さな子。
lines.translated: A little girl who wished to become a "magician" like her sister.

lines.content: 彼女は、冬月十夜は、いつまでも[・|そ][・|こ]で待っていた。
lines.translated: She, Fuyutsuki Toya, waited *there* forever.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|の][・|子]と出会うまでの十夜は、雨が降ると公園に足を運んだ。
lines.translated: Until she met *that girl*, Toya would head to the park whenever it rained.

lines.content: いつからそうしていたのかはわからない。
lines.translated: She didn't know when she had started doing so.

lines.content: そのはじまりは随分と昔のことだとしか十夜本人にも記憶にない。
lines.translated: Even Toya herself only remembered that it had begun a very long time ago.

lines.content: だが、その動機は明らかだ。“約束”だったから。
lines.translated: However, her motive was clear. Because it was a "promise."

lines.content: 降り出す雨がその合図。
lines.translated: The falling rain was the signal.

lines.content: 世界中が涙で泣き濡れるかのようなこんな日に、ここで私が、私の思い描いた微かな“魔法”で、あなた達の心の重い部分を引き受けて――
lines.translated: On days like this, when it feels as though the whole world is drenched in tears, I'll be right here to take on the heavy burdens of your hearts with the faint "magic" I've envisioned--

lines.content: そうすることで、少しでも元気になれた子たちはみんな、遅かれ早かれ大人になって。
lines.translated: By doing so, all the children who managed to cheer up even a little bit would, sooner or later, grow into adults.

lines.content: 誰もがみんな、大人になれば公園なんて場所には訪れなくなってしまって。
lines.translated: And once they grew up, everyone stopped visiting places like the park.

lines.content: ……さよならだ。
lines.translated: It was goodbye.

lines.content: あなた達の幸せを、ハッピーエンドを、私はここで祈り続ける――
lines.translated: I will keep praying right here for your happiness, for your happy endings--

lines.content: だけど[・|ま][・|た]何かつらいことがあったとき、悲しいことがあったときは、思い出してほしかった。
lines.translated: However, if you *ever* go through something painful or sad again, I wanted you to remember me.

lines.content: つらくなったら、また、ここにおいで……
lines.translated: "Whenever things get tough, come back here again..."

lines.content: もう一度、姉のやさしい口調を真似するようにつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Once more, she murmured, imitating her sister's gentle tone.

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 忘れてもいいから、心のどこかで覚えておいて。
lines.translated: It's okay if you forget, just keep it somewhere in the back of your mind.

lines.content: 私は、いつまでも変わらずここにいて……。
lines.translated: I will always be right here, unchanging...

lines.content: あなた達の心が、いつか、少しだけでも軽くなりますようにと、祈ってる――
lines.translated: Praying that someday, your hearts may grow even just a little bit lighter--

lines.content: “魔法”だ。
lines.translated: It was "magic."

lines.content: 小さな“魔法”を握りしめ、あなた達とまたここで出会えるときを待っている。
lines.translated: Clutching my small "magic" tight, I am waiting for the time when I can meet you here again.

lines.content: それが、“さよなら”を重ねたたくさんのお友だちとの“約束”だった――
lines.translated: That was the "promise" she made with the many friends she had said "goodbye" to over and over--

lines.content: と、ひとりぼっちの十夜はそう信じていたのだ。
lines.translated: Or so the lonely Toya believed.

lines.content: だから十夜は雨の日になると公園に行く。
lines.translated: That is why Toya goes to the park on rainy days.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た][・|達]のためにと思い描いた“魔法”を、小さな手のひらに握りしめ――……しかし。
lines.translated: Clutching the "magic" she envisioned for *your* sakes tightly in her small palm--...However.

lines.content: しかし、だめだった。
lines.translated: However, it was no use.

lines.content: “さよなら”を幾度もいくども重ねていくには、いつまでも大きくなれないその心と身体は、あまりにも小さすぎたのだ。
lines.translated: Her heart and body, which could never grow up, were far too small to bear piling up "goodbyes" over and over again.

lines.content: さみしい気持ちは、小さな彼女に、明けることのない“夜”を連れてやって来た。
lines.translated: That loneliness brought an unending "Night" to the little girl.

lines.content: もう、さみしいことはいや
lines.translated: "I don't want to be lonely anymore."

lines.content: 雨の中、ひとりぼっちで涙がこぼれた。
lines.translated: All alone in the rain, her tears spilled over.

lines.content: 私はお姉ちゃんのようにやさしくも強くもなれない。きっと、“魔法使い”にも。
lines.translated: I can't become gentle or strong like my sister. And surely, I can't become a "magician" either.

lines.content: だから……、
lines.translated: So...

lines.content: お願い。私も、連れて行ってほしかった。
lines.translated: Please. I wanted you to take me with you, too.

lines.content: 大好きなあなた達と一緒に……。
lines.translated: Together with all of you whom I love so much...

lines.content: 今、ここではない“次”の時間へ……。
lines.translated: To the "next" time, somewhere other than here and now...

lines.content: 笑顔で。
lines.translated: With a smile.

lines.content: 手と手を、つないで……。
lines.translated: Hand in hand...

lines.content: また明日ねって、ふたり一緒に、手を振って……。
lines.translated: Waving together, saying, "See you tomorrow"...

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 私には無理なんだ。
lines.translated: It's impossible for me.

lines.content: 私は人間じゃない。だから神さまが[・|そ][・|れ]を許してくれない――どうして。
lines.translated: I'm not human. That's why God won't allow *that*--why?

lines.content: どうして私は、あなた達と同じじゃないの。人間として、産まれてこれなかったの
lines.translated: "Why am I not the same as all of you? Why couldn't I be born human?"

lines.content: 雨降りの空を見上げていつもそうつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: She always murmured those words, looking up at the rainy sky.

lines.content: ふつうでいい。何か、特別なものをもっていなくてもいい。
lines.translated: Being ordinary is fine. I don't need to have anything special.

lines.content: ただ、小さな、ごくふつうの人間として、あなた達と出会いたかった……。
lines.translated: I just wanted to meet you all as a small, completely ordinary human...

lines.content: たった、それだけなのに。ひとりがさみしい、だけなのに。どうして……私だけ
lines.translated: "That's all I ever wanted. It's just so lonely being by myself. Why... why only me?"

lines.content: そんなふうに心がよどんだ時間も、決して少なくはないけれど……。
lines.translated: There were certainly many times when her heart grew stagnant like that, and yet...

lines.content: だけど、そんな十夜に新しい“約束”が増えたのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, Toya gained a new "promise."
"A 'promise'..."

lines.content: つぶやいて、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: She murmured, looking up at the sky.

lines.content: それは晴れの日だったのだ。
lines.translated: It was a sunny day.

lines.content: 今度は、雨の日じゃない。晴れの日にここで待ち合わせ。
lines.translated: This time, not on a rainy day. We'll meet here on a sunny day.

lines.content: 『そのときは一緒にいっぱい遊ぼうね。あなたの“夢”は、私が全部、叶えてあげるよ――』
lines.translated: "When that time comes, let's play lots together, okay? I'll make all of your 'dreams' come true--"

lines.content: そんな言葉が、十夜には、自分の“夜”の中で明るく瞬く光のように感じられたのだ。
lines.translated: To Toya, those words felt like a light twinkling brightly within her own "Night."

lines.content: 笑顔になる。
lines.translated: A smile graced her face.

lines.content: その言葉を思い出すそれだけで……。
lines.translated: Just by remembering those words...

lines.content: あの子に私の“夢”を、叶えてもらえるのかも……
lines.translated: "Maybe she really will make my 'dream' come true..."

lines.content: そう想うだけで幸せにな気持ちになれたのだ。
lines.translated: Just thinking that was enough to make her feel happy.

lines.content: まるで自分の未来の果てにも“希望”があるかのようにも感じられ、また、笑顔がこぼれた。
lines.translated: It felt as though there was "hope" even at the very end of her own future, and another smile slipped out.

lines.content: だけど……、
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: [・|あ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]どれくらい晴れの日が過ぎただろう。
lines.translated: How many sunny days had passed *since then*?

lines.content: いくつ、暖かな季節が過ぎただろう。今はあれから何番目の春だろう。
lines.translated: How many warm seasons had gone by? How many springs had it been since then?

lines.content: “約束”は、守られなかった。
lines.translated: The "promise" was not kept.

lines.content: 約束は次の晴れの日と[・|あ][・|の][・|子]は確かに言った。
lines.translated: *That girl* had definitely said the promise was for the next sunny day.

lines.content: でも、あの子の姿はいつまでも、見当たらず……。
lines.translated: Yet, she was nowhere to be seen, no matter how much time passed...

lines.content: もうあの子はここに来ないだろう。
lines.translated: She probably won't come here anymore.

lines.content: ようやくそう悟ったのは、あの子とお別れして数年後のことだった。
lines.translated: It was several years after parting ways with her that Toya finally came to that realization.

lines.content: それでも十夜は、晴れの日も雨の日も、待ち合わせの公園に立ち続けて待っていた。
lines.translated: Even so, rain or shine, Toya kept standing in their meeting place at the park, waiting.

lines.content: 信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe in her.

lines.content: あの子はきっと私に会いに来てくれる。
lines.translated: She will definitely come to see me.

lines.content: どんなに遅くなったとしても、いつか、必ず……。
lines.translated: No matter how late it gets, someday, for sure...

lines.content: だって……、
lines.translated: Because...

lines.content: だって私と、“また会おう”“一緒に遊ぼう”――そんな“約束”をしてくれたのは、あの子がはじめてだったから……、
lines.translated: Because she was the very first person to ever make a "promise" like that with me--saying "let's meet again" and "let's play together"...

lines.content: だからきっと、また会えるよね
lines.translated: "So I'm sure we'll meet again, right?"

lines.content: そうつぶやいて、空に微笑む。
lines.translated: Murmuring that, she smiled up at the sky.

lines.content: 信じていた。
lines.translated: She believed in it.

lines.content: 自分の中にある、あの子たちが大好きだよという気持ち。
lines.translated: The love she held deep inside for all of those children.

lines.content: この世に産まれた瞬間から、なぜだか不自然なまでに胸にあり続けるこの想い。“約束”の、意味。
lines.translated: For some reason, that feeling had remained almost unnaturally strong in her chest from the very moment she was born into this world. And the meaning of that "promise."

lines.content: その全部をぜんぶ、十夜は信じていたかった。
lines.translated: Toya wanted to believe in all of it, every last bit.

lines.content: ……そして。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 十夜はお姉ちゃんにたったひとつだけ“魔法”をもらっていたのだ。
lines.translated: Her big sister had given her just a single piece of "magic."

lines.content: それは、一度だけ……。
lines.translated: It could only be used once...

lines.content: たった一度だけだ。
lines.translated: Just one single time.

lines.content: 大人になり十夜のことを忘れてしまい、そうして“さよなら”もなくお別れした子と、もう一度だけお話ができる――そんな“魔法”だった。
lines.translated: It was a kind of "magic" that would let her speak just once more with a child who had grown up, forgotten all about her, and parted ways without even a "goodbye."

lines.content: 懐中時計の形をした“魔法”
lines.translated: A piece of "magic" in the shape of a pocket watch.

lines.content: スイッチを押し、秒針の歩みを止め、それを手渡す。
lines.translated: Press the switch, stop the march of the second hand, and pass it over.

lines.content: その日の午前零時まで“魔法”は続く――
lines.translated: The "magic" would last until midnight of that day--

lines.content: 私のことを思い出してくれる。私のことに気づいてくれる。私の声を、受け止めてくれる。
lines.translated: They will remember me. They will notice me. They will hear my voice.

lines.content: その“魔法”は十夜の“希望”であり、“夢”であり、お守りだったのだ。
lines.translated: That "magic" was Toya's "hope," her "dream," and her good luck charm.

lines.content: ……もしまたあの子がここに、偶然でもいい、やって来てくれることがあったなら
lines.translated: "...If that girl ever comes back here again, even by chance..."

lines.content: そのときにこの“魔法”を使おうと決めていた。
lines.translated: She had already decided to use this "magic" when that moment came.

lines.content: まさしくそれは“希望”であった。
lines.translated: It truly was her "hope."

lines.content: たった一度っきりの大切な“魔法”
lines.translated: A precious piece of "magic" that could only be used once.

lines.content: 自分のことや、自分との“約束”を思い出してくれたなら。
lines.translated: If only she would remember me, and the "promise" we made.

lines.content: ずいぶん遅くなってしまったけれど、短い時間でも一緒に遊んで……まるで“ふつうのお友だち”みたいに、微笑み合えたなら。
lines.translated: It's gotten awfully late, but if we could just play together for a short while... and smile at each other like "normal friends."

lines.content: 一度だけでいい。
lines.translated: Just once is fine.

lines.content: 一瞬だけでも、いい。
lines.translated: Even for a single moment is fine.

lines.content: そんな夢みたいな時間に、巡り会えたなら……。
lines.translated: If only I could experience a dreamlike time like that...

lines.content: 私の時間はきっと、それで、それだけで、誰にも負けないハッピーエンドに、なれるよね
lines.translated: "With that, and that alone, I'm sure my time here will reach a happy ending second to none, right?"

lines.content: 手のひらの“[懐中時計|魔法]”を握りしめ、笑顔で……。
lines.translated: She clutched the "magic" pocket watch in her palm, smiling...

lines.content: さみしい気持ちが外へこぼれないよう、笑って、そうつぶやいたとき。
lines.translated: Right as she smiled and murmured those words to keep her lonely feelings from spilling out...

lines.content: 雨だ。
lines.translated: Rain.

lines.content: 太陽は雲間に隠れ。
lines.translated: The sun hid behind the clouds.

lines.content: 青空は、灰色に塗りつぶされて。
lines.translated: The blue sky was painted over in gray.

lines.content: 雨が、しとしと、降り始めると――誰かが。
lines.translated: And as the rain began to softly fall--someone was there.

lines.content: 誰かが私の隣に、立っていた。
lines.translated: Someone was standing right beside me.

lines.content: あの子だ。
lines.translated: It's her.

lines.content: 私に幸せな“約束”をくれたあの女の子……。
lines.translated: The girl who gave me that happy "promise"...

lines.content: ずいぶん大きくなってしまったけれど、すっかり大人になってしまっていたけれど、その横顔を見れば一瞬で[・|そ][・|う][・|だ]とわかった。
lines.translated: She had grown so much, becoming a full-fledged adult, yet one glance at her profile was all it took to know in an instant that *it was her*.

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: わかって、しまった。
lines.translated: I couldn't help but know.

lines.content: その横顔をただの一瞬見ただけで、その人が、その大人の女の人が、“悲しそうな顔をした女の子”だと、わかったのだ。
lines.translated: Just a single glimpse of her profile was enough to tell me that this person, this grown woman, was the "girl with the sad face."

lines.content: ……どうしたの？
lines.translated: "...What's wrong?"

lines.content: 私は、言う。
lines.translated: I say.
"...Why are you *looking so sad* again?"

lines.content: あの子は、泣いていた。
lines.translated: She was crying.

lines.content: それは[・|あ][・|の][・|頃]に見たどんな顔より、悲しそうだった。
lines.translated: It was a sadder expression than any face I had seen on her *back then*.

lines.content: ねえ、どうして……
lines.translated: "Hey, why...?"

lines.content: 私の声は届かない。届くはずもない。
lines.translated: My voice didn't reach her. There was no way it could.

lines.content: 子どもの声は大人には届かない――この世界はそういうふうに出来ている。
lines.translated: A child's voice cannot reach an adult--that is simply how this world is made.

lines.content: あの子はずぶ濡れのまま泣いていた。
lines.translated: Soaked to the bone, she kept crying.

lines.content: ひとりだ……
lines.translated: "I'm alone..."

lines.content: あの子は苦しそうに、言った。
lines.translated: She spoke, her voice full of pain.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちに、なって、しまった……
lines.translated: "I've ended up... all alone..."

lines.content: 違う……っ。
lines.translated: No, you haven't...!

lines.content: そう叫んだ。
lines.translated: I shouted.

lines.content: 誰も、もう誰も、私のそばに……いてくれない
lines.translated: "No one, there's no one left... who will stay by my side."

lines.content: 私がいるよ、ここにいる……っ。
lines.translated: I'm here, I'm right here...!

lines.content: そう、叫んだ。
lines.translated: I shouted out to her.

lines.content: でも、十夜の声も姿も何も……何も、届かない。
lines.translated: But neither Toya's voice, nor her figure, nor anything at all... reached her.

lines.content: 涙のように、ため息のように、女の子は雨降りの夜空を見上げ、言った。
lines.translated: Like tears, like a sigh, the girl looked up at the rainy night sky and spoke.

lines.content: いやだ
lines.translated: "No more."

lines.content: もうつかれた
lines.translated: "I'm so tired."

lines.content: もう、何も、がんばれないよ
lines.translated: "I can't try hard at anything anymore."

lines.content: でも、大人の世界は、それを許してはくれないから――
lines.translated: Because the adult world wouldn't allow her even that--

lines.content: 誰にも、何にも、ほんの少しだって――休ませてはもらえない
lines.translated: "No one, and nothing, will let me rest--not even for a little bit."

lines.content: いやなことばかり。
lines.translated: Nothing but awful things.

lines.content: つらいこと、ばっかり。
lines.translated: Nothing but painful things.

lines.content: 重い……
lines.translated: "It's heavy..."

lines.content: 楽しいことも、うれしいこともあまりに少なく、悲しいことばかりの人生だった……。
lines.translated: It had been a life with far too few fun or happy moments, filled only with sadness...

lines.content: 重いよ……。心が、とっても、重いんだよ
lines.translated: "It's so heavy... My heart is just so, so heavy."

lines.content: 息をするのも、なんだか疲れた……。
lines.translated: Even breathing feels exhausting somehow...

lines.content: ……もう、いいよ。神さま。私は、ここまででいい。私……生きるのに、飽きちゃったよ……神さま
lines.translated: "...I've had enough, God. This is far enough for me. I'm... tired of living... God."

lines.content: やだ。いやだよ……お願い。そんな悲しいこと、言わないで。お願いだから
lines.translated: "No. Don't... Please. Don't say such sad things. Please, I'm begging you."

lines.content: 視界が滲んだ。雨で滲んだ。涙で、滲んだ。
lines.translated: My vision blurred. Blurred with rain. Blurred with tears.

lines.content: お願い、泣かないで……そんな、顔、しないでよ……
lines.translated: "Please, don't cry... Don't make a face like that..."

lines.content: 笑顔でいてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted her to smile.

lines.content: いつも笑っていてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted her to always be smiling.

lines.content: つらい気持ちも悲しい想いも、私と出会った子どもの[頃|時間]にすべて、全部、置いていってほしかった……。
lines.translated: I wanted her to leave all her painful feelings and sad thoughts behind in her childhood, back in the time when she met me...

lines.content: だって、ねえ、知ってる？
lines.translated: Because, hey, did you know?

lines.content: あなた達の誰にも、涙なんて、似合わないんだよ――そう願い、祈り、私はここであなた達の未来を、思い描き続けてきたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Tears don't suit any of you at all--that was my wish, my prayer, as I stood here constantly picturing your futures, and yet...

lines.content: 背中をまるめて、声を殺してあの子は泣いてる。
lines.translated: Hunched over, stifling her voice, the girl cried.

lines.content: その背中をさすってあげたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to rub her back.

lines.content: 震えるその手を握ってあげたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to hold her trembling hand.

lines.content: 大丈夫だよと言って、あげたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to tell her that everything would be okay.

lines.content: ……お姉ちゃんが悲しそうにしてる子を励ましているように、やさしい“魔法の言葉”をかけて、あげたかった。
lines.translated: Just like my big sister did when cheering up a sad child, I wanted to offer her gentle "magic words."

lines.content: ごめんなさい。きっと全部、ぜんぶ、[・|私][・|の][・|せ][・|い]
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm sure all of this, every bit of it, is *my fault*."

lines.content: だから……、
lines.translated: So...

lines.content: だから、また、あの頃みたいに
lines.translated: "So, once again, just like back then..."

lines.content: 触れられもしない震えるあの子の手を握りしめ……、
lines.translated: Clenching her trembling hand, though I couldn't even touch it...

lines.content: あの頃みたいに、私が、あなたの悲しい気持ちを全部……私が、全部“魔法”で……もらって、あげられたら……
lines.translated: "Just like back then, if only I could take all of your sad feelings... take them all away for you... with my 'magic'..."

lines.content: ……たった一度の“魔法”を、ここで使おう。
lines.translated: I'll use my one-time-only "magic" right here.

lines.content: 十夜は、お姉ちゃんからもらった“魔法”を、あの子に渡そうとした。
lines.translated: Toya tried to hand the "magic" she had received from her big sister over to the girl.

lines.content: そして自分のことを思い出したあの子に、あの頃と同じように、あの子の心の重さを、引き受けてあげられたなら……。
lines.translated: And once the girl remembered her, if she could just take on the weight of the girl's heart, the same way she used to back then...

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: ……一度、だけ
lines.translated: "...Just once."

lines.content: そう。懐中時計の“魔法”はたった、一度だけなのだ。
lines.translated: Yes. The pocket watch's "magic" only worked a single time.

lines.content: それ以上はない。それ以上はなにもない。
lines.translated: There was nothing more than that. Nothing beyond it.

lines.content: この子に私ができるのは、ただの“魔法”を、たった一度だけ贈ること……ああ。だめ。
lines.translated: All I can do for her is give her mere "magic," and only a single time... Ah. No good.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 私じゃ、だめだよ。
lines.translated: I'm not enough.

lines.content: っ
十夜は唇を噛み、そして立ち上がり――飛び出していく。
lines.translated: Toya bit her lip, stood up--and dashed off.

lines.content: ――“大切だったはずの友だちに、呼ばれた気がして……”
lines.translated: --"I felt like a friend who used to be very dear to me was calling out..."

lines.content: 泣き濡れた[・|あ][・|の][・|子]の隣に、そうつぶやいく男の人が立っていた。
lines.translated: Standing beside *the girl* soaked in her own tears was a man, murmuring those words.

lines.content: やさしそうな人。
lines.translated: A gentle-looking man.

lines.content: 線が細くて、少し頼りないけれど――人の悲しい気持ちを、まるで自分のことのように想い、涙を流してくれる人――
lines.translated: He was slender and looked a little unreliable--yet he was someone who would feel another person's sadness as if it were his own, and shed tears for them--

lines.content: 十夜はその人がそういう人であることを、知っている。
lines.translated: Toya knew that was the kind of person he was.

lines.content: 雨の日に出会った“お友だち”のひとりだった。
lines.translated: He was one of the "friends" she had met on a rainy day.

lines.content: その子の心の重たさも、言葉に代えて、十夜はたくさん受け取ってきた。
lines.translated: Toya had taken in a great deal of the heaviness in his heart, too, traded in the form of words.

lines.content: 古くから伝わる芸事を、大事にだいじに引き継いでいく家に産まれたのだというその男の子は……。
lines.translated: As a boy, he had been born into a family that carefully, dutifully passed down an ancient traditional art...

lines.content: 自分には才能がないと。
lines.translated: He had said he had no talent.

lines.content: 自分には上手にできることがなにもないと。
lines.translated: That there was nothing he could do well.

lines.content: 誰も、自分の味方でいてくれる人がいない。さみしい。悲しい。
lines.translated: That there was no one on his side. That he was lonely. That he was sad.

lines.content: だから自分には、この世界を生きていくという、最低限の才能だってないに等しいのだ。
lines.translated: Because of that, he felt he lacked even the barest shred of talent required simply to live in this world.

lines.content: そんな心の重さを抱えては、雨の日、十夜に会いにやって来ていた……。
lines.translated: Carrying that heavy heart, he used to come see Toya on rainy days...

lines.content: 自分の話を聞いてくれる小さな子。
lines.translated: A little girl who would listen to what he had to say.

lines.content: 無条件に自分の味方でいてくれる女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who would be on his side unconditionally.

lines.content: 話をすると、不思議と、つらい想いが軽くなっていく、不思議な子。
lines.translated: A mysterious child who, whenever he talked to her, somehow made his painful feelings grow lighter.

lines.content: 十夜と話した夜は、“また明日がんばろう”と思い直し、ぐっすりと眠ることができたのだ――しかし。
lines.translated: On the nights he spoke with Toya, he was able to tell himself, "I'll do my best again tomorrow," and sleep soundly--however.

lines.content: しかしここ数ヶ月、男の子は……いいや、[・|男][・|の][・|人]は、その子のことを忘れてしまっていた。
lines.translated: However, over the past few months, the boy... no, the *man*, had forgotten all about her.

lines.content: そんな男の人の前に、大切だったはずの[お友だち|十夜]が、突然やって来て言ったのだ……。
lines.translated: And then, right in front of that man, the precious friend he had forgotten--Toya--suddenly appeared and said...

lines.content: どうかお願い。私の代わりに……私の“夢”を、叶えて、ほしいよ
lines.translated: "Please, I'm begging you. In my place... I want you to make my 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ――どうしてそんなにぼろぼろなのか。
lines.translated: --Why was she so battered and worn?

lines.content: ――どうして、そんなに、傷だらけに。
lines.translated: --Why was she covered in so many wounds?

lines.content: 男の人の問いかけに、だけど答えていられる時間はもうないのだと……。
lines.translated: The man asked her, yet she had no time left to answer him...

lines.content: 十夜は、その男の人の手を引き雨の中を走って……。
lines.translated: Toya took the man by the hand and ran through the rain...

lines.content: あの子のいる公園に戻ってきて、ちょうど、深夜十二時。
lines.translated: By the time they made it back to the park where the girl was, it was right at midnight.

lines.content: 十夜が連れてきたその人は、なぜ自分がこうして[ここ|公園]に立っているのかを、思い出せない――“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: The man Toya had brought with her couldn't remember why he was standing here in the park like this--it was "magic."

lines.content: お姉ちゃんからもらったたった一度きりの“魔法”を、十夜は、その男の人に渡していた。
lines.translated: Toya had given the one-time-only "magic" she received from her big sister to that man.

lines.content: 自分のことを思い出してくれる“魔法”
lines.translated: The "magic" that allowed someone to remember her.

lines.content: 深夜十二時までしか効果のない“魔法”
lines.translated: The "magic" that only lasted until midnight.

lines.content: ……[・|そ][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|の]素材が枯渇し、もうこれ以上は生成不可であるこの“魔法”
lines.translated: This "magic," whose *very materials* were now depleted, could never be created again.

lines.content: これでもう二度と、誰も十夜のことを思い出すことはできないけれど……。
lines.translated: With this, no one would ever be able to remember Toya again, and yet...

lines.content: ……それでいい。それで、よかった。
lines.translated: That was fine. It was for the best.

lines.content: ふたりは困惑しながらも、寄り添い合うようにベンチに座り、何かを話している。
lines.translated: Though bewildered, the two of them sat huddled together on the bench, talking about something.

lines.content: そんなふたりの足下に、
lines.translated: At the feet of those two,

lines.content: ぼろぼろで、
lines.translated: battered,

lines.content: 泥だらけで、
lines.translated: covered in mud,

lines.content: 傷だらけな十夜が、倒れ込むようにして丸くなっている。
lines.translated: and covered in wounds, Toya collapsed and curled up into a ball.

lines.content: ……疲れた
lines.translated: "...I'm tired."

lines.content: 本当に、ほんとうに、疲れ果ててしまった――しかし誰にも、その声も、姿も。
lines.translated: She was truly, utterly exhausted--yet no one could hear her voice, or see her form.

lines.content: もちろんすぐ側にいるはずのふたりにも、十夜は、気づいてもらえることもなく……呼吸が、小さくなっていく。
lines.translated: Unnoticed by anyone, including, of course, the two people right beside her... Toya's breathing grew fainter and fainter.

lines.content: もう、このまま、眠りたい
lines.translated: "I just want to sleep, right like this..."

lines.content: ……十夜は、走ったのだ。
lines.translated: Toya had run.
*She had searched for someone other than herself*.

lines.content: 今夜一度っきりしか会えないような私じゃだめだ。
lines.translated: Someone like me, who can only meet her for this one night, isn't good enough.

lines.content: 大切な[お友だち|この子]の悲しい気持ちに、これからも続いていくあの子の人生に、そばでずっと寄り添ってくれる人じゃないと、だめなんだ……
lines.translated: "It has to be someone who can stay by my precious friend's side forever, through her sad feelings and the rest of her life to come, or else it's no good..."

lines.content: 走った。
lines.translated: I ran.

lines.content: 土砂降りの雨の中を……走って。走って。
lines.translated: Through the pouring rain... she ran. And ran.

lines.content: 小さい彼女は時どき転び。怪我をして。それでも、走って。
lines.translated: Small as she was, she occasionally tripped. She got hurt. Even so, she ran.

lines.content: 自分の姿が見えない大きな誰かに、あるいは何かに、小さな身体をはね飛ばされることも何度かあって――泣いた。叫んだ。痛かった。苦しかった。
lines.translated: Several times, her tiny body was knocked flying by someone or something large that couldn't see her--she cried. She screamed. It hurt. It was agonizing.

lines.content: でも、十夜は走る。
lines.translated: But Toya kept running.

lines.content: 泣いてる暇はない。涙なんて、拭く暇もない。
lines.translated: She had no time to cry. No time to even wipe away her tears.

lines.content: 時間がもうない。
lines.translated: There was no time left.

lines.content: 今夜を過ぎれば、あの子はもう二度と公園にやって来ないかもしれない――“魔法”を使えるチャンスは今夜が最後。
lines.translated: Once tonight passed, that girl might never come to the park again--tonight was the very last chance to use the "magic."

lines.content: だから走った。懸命に、走り続けた。
lines.translated: So she ran. Desperately, she kept on running.

lines.content: あの子の隣に“魔法”を、幸せを、どうしてもあげたかった。
lines.translated: No matter what, she wanted to place "magic"--happiness--right beside that girl.

lines.content: ぼろぼろになった。
lines.translated: She became battered and bruised.

lines.content: 血だらけになった。
lines.translated: She became covered in blood.

lines.content: 顔は涙で、いっぱい、だったけど、
lines.translated: Her face was completely drenched in tears, and yet,

lines.content: ……私、間に合った、よね
lines.translated: "...I made it in time, didn't I?"

lines.content: ふたりは公園のベンチで寄り添い合ったまま、雨の中、静かに言葉を重ね続けている。
lines.translated: Huddled together on the park bench in the rain, the two of them quietly continued to exchange words.

lines.content: よかった。
lines.translated: thank goodness.

lines.content: もう、安心、だよね。
lines.translated: Everything's going to be okay now, right?

lines.content: その男の人が、きっとあなたを悲しいことから助けてくれる――きっとあなたの人生に、たったひとつの“魔法”になって、くれるはず。
lines.translated: That man will surely save you from your sadness--he will surely become the one and only "magic" in your life.

lines.content: ……私じゃない
lines.translated: "...Not me."

lines.content: 私じゃ、なかった。
lines.translated: It wasn't me.

lines.content: あなた達に笑顔をあげられるのは……いつだって、私じゃないんだ。
lines.translated: The one who can bring smiles to all of you... is never me.

lines.content: 人間には人間。そうでないモノには、そうでないモノ。単純なことだった。
lines.translated: Humans belong with humans. Those who aren't belong with those who aren't. It was that simple.

lines.content: なのにどうしても、あきらめきれなくて……。
lines.translated: And yet, I just couldn't give up...

lines.content: 私はいつも、あなた達にもう一度、名前を呼んでもらいたくって……
lines.translated: "I always wanted all of you to call my name just one more time..."

lines.content: 誰もが憂鬱な雨降りの日に、ちょっとだけの“希望”を抱いてみたくなる。
lines.translated: On gloomy, rainy days, I find myself wanting to hold onto just a little bit of "hope."

lines.content: ほんとうにバカな私だ。
lines.translated: I really am such a fool.

lines.content: もう動けない。
lines.translated: I can't move anymore.

lines.content: 身体中が痛くて、苦しくて。
lines.translated: My whole body hurts, and it's so agonizing.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を、閉じた。
lines.translated: I closed my eyelids.

lines.content: もうこのまま静かに眠ってしまいたい――……でも、ああ、聞こえた。聞こえてしまった。
lines.translated: I just want to fall asleep quietly like this--...but, ah, I heard it. I couldn't help hearing it.

lines.content: 何か大切なことを忘れてる
lines.translated: "I'm forgetting something important..."

lines.content: ……あの子が、泣いてる。
lines.translated: She's crying.

lines.content: 忘れたくないのに、絶対に、忘れちゃだめだったのに……
lines.translated: "Even though I don't want to forget, even though I絕對 mustn't forget..."

lines.content: ……どうして？
悲しそうな女の子の泣いてる。
lines.translated: The sad-looking girl is crying.

lines.content: なんだか自分が、とってもひどいことをしてしまっているような気がして……
lines.translated: "I feel like I've done something terribly, horribly wrong..."

lines.content: ……そんなの。いいんだよ。私のこと、なんて。そんな……
lines.translated: "...You don't have to feel that way. It's okay. Don't worry about me. Please..."

lines.content: ……私だ。
lines.translated: It's me.

lines.content: あの子は、私を思い出せないことを悲しんでいるのだと、わかったよ。
lines.translated: I realized that she was grieving over not being able to remember me.

lines.content: 何で……。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: それだけで。
lines.translated: Just from that.

lines.content: その気持ちだけで。
lines.translated: Just from those feelings alone.

lines.content: 私ね、なんだか、“夢”が叶った、気がするよ……
lines.translated: "You know, I feel like... my 'dream' has come true..."

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]をゆっくり、開く。
lines.translated: Slowly, I open my eyelids.

lines.content: ……伝えなきゃ。
lines.translated: I have to tell her.

lines.content: 私は、平気。
lines.translated: I'm fine.

lines.content: 大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちにも慣れている。
lines.translated: I'm used to being all alone.

lines.content: だからもう、泣かないでって……伝えなきゃ。
lines.translated: So please, don't cry anymore... I have to tell her.

lines.content: ……がんばれ。私の大好きな、お友だち
lines.translated: "...Hang in there. My dearest, most favorite friend."

lines.content: ふらふらと、立ち上がり、
lines.translated: Unsteadily, I stood up.

lines.content: 負けちゃ、だめだよ
lines.translated: "You mustn't give in."

lines.content: ずきずきと身体のあちこちが、痛いけど、
lines.translated: Every part of my body is throbbing with pain, though.

lines.content: どんなことがあっても、お願い、悲しいことなんかに、負けないで
lines.translated: "No matter what happens, please, don't lose to the sadness."

lines.content: あなたともしも最後に出会えたら、一緒に遊ぼうと思い、用意していた色鉛筆やマジックで――
lines.translated: With the colored pencils and markers I had prepared, thinking we could play together if I ever got to meet you one last time--

lines.content: これからも、あなたには悲しいこと、つらいこと、いっぱいあるかも、しれないけれど……
lines.translated: "There might still be lots of sad and painful things waiting for you from here on out, too, but..."

lines.content: ――風に飛ばされてきたチラシの裏に、私、あなたへの手紙を書きたかったんだよ。
lines.translated: --On the back of a flyer blown in by the wind, I wanted to write a letter to you.

lines.content: ……おうえん、してるよ
lines.translated: "...I'm cheering for you."

lines.content: でも、おかしいな。
lines.translated: But, how strange.

lines.content: いつまでも、ずっと、ずっと、ここからあなたのことを、おうえんしてる
lines.translated: "Forever, always, always, I'll be cheering for you from right here."

lines.content: おかしいよ。
lines.translated: It's so strange.

lines.content: 涙が、溢れて来るよ……前が、見えないよ。
lines.translated: My tears are overflowing... I can't see ahead of me.

lines.content: ごめんね
lines.translated: "I'm sorry."

lines.content: へたくそな字で、ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry my handwriting is so messy.

lines.content: 何の役にも立てなかった私で、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry that I couldn't be of any use at all."

lines.content: 買ってもらったばかりのマジックを握りしめ――
lines.translated: Clutching the marker that had just been bought for me--

lines.content: どうかあなたに、届いて欲しい。
lines.translated: Please, I hope this reaches you.

lines.content: “あなたの隣に、いつもすてきな魔法がありますように”
lines.translated: "May wonderful magic always be right beside you."

lines.content: いつだったか、お姉ちゃんが言葉は“魔法”なんだって、そう言っていたから――
lines.translated: Because my big sister told me once that words are "magic"--

lines.content: “あなたの未来に、たくさん、たくさんの笑顔が、ありますように”
lines.translated: "May your future be filled with lots and lots of smiles."

lines.content: この言葉が、この気持ちが、あなたのハッピーエンドのための“魔法”に、なれますようにと、祈るけど――……ああ、もう、真っ暗だ。
lines.translated: I pray that these words, these feelings, can become the "magic" for your happy ending--...ah, it's already pitch dark.

lines.content: 目の前が真っ黒に途切れた。
lines.translated: Everything before my eyes cut to black.

lines.content: （……ねえ、おねえちゃん）
lines.translated: (...Hey, big sister.)

lines.content: （私の言葉。私の、最後の、“魔法”）
lines.translated: (My words. My very last "magic.")

lines.content: 届くかな。
lines.translated: Will it reach you?

lines.content: 届いたら、いいな。
lines.translated: I hope it does.

lines.content: 笑ってほしい。
lines.translated: I want you to smile.

lines.content: 涙はいらない。
lines.translated: There's no need for tears.

lines.content: あなた達に悲しいことなんて、似合わない。
lines.translated: Sadness doesn't suit the two of you at all.

lines.content: だから、どうか、幸せに……。
lines.translated: So please, be happy...

lines.content: まったく無茶をする妹だな
lines.translated: "You really are a reckless little sister, aren't you?"

lines.content: ……お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "...Big sister."

lines.content: 目を覚ますと大好きなお姉ちゃんの腕の中だった。お姉ちゃんは私を抱き上げたまま夜の道を歩いていた。
lines.translated: When I woke up, I was in the arms of my beloved big sister. She was walking down the nighttime road, holding me up in her embrace.

lines.content: いつまでも帰ってこないから心配して探しに来てみたら……驚いたぞ。本当に
lines.translated: "You weren't coming home no matter how long I waited, so I got worried and came looking for you... I got quite a shock. Really."

lines.content: こんなにぼろぼろになって、公園で、倒れてるんだから
lines.translated: "To find you beaten and tattered like this, collapsed in the park."

lines.content: お姉ちゃんに触れられると傷がたちまち良くなっていく。
lines.translated: At my sister's touch, my wounds rapidly began to heal.

lines.content: それはお姉ちゃんの“魔法”――
lines.translated: That was my big sister's "magic"--

lines.content: ではなくて、私たち“特別な猫”が使える生まれついての能力だ。“夜”の中限定の“魔法”と違い、いつでも、どこでも、使える力。
lines.translated: Or rather, it wasn't magic, but an innate ability that we "special cats" could use. Unlike the "magic" limited strictly to the "Night," it was a power we could use anytime, anywhere.

lines.content: ごめんね。心配かけて、ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "I'm sorry. I'm so sorry for making you worry."

lines.content: なんだか今夜は謝ってばっかりだ……。
lines.translated: For some reason, I feel like all I've been doing tonight is apologizing...

lines.content: そんな自分が嫌いになりそうだった。今までよりもずっと、いっぱい……大嫌いに。
lines.translated: It made me feel like I was going to start hating myself. Much, much more than I ever had before... I'd hate myself completely.

lines.content: ……ねえ、お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "...Hey, big sister."

lines.content: 抱き上げられたまま小さく言った。
lines.translated: Still held up in her arms, I spoke in a small voice.

lines.content: うん。なんだ、十夜
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it, Toya?"

lines.content: 私、お姉ちゃんみたいになりたかった
lines.translated: "I wanted to become like you, big sister."

lines.content: 大切に思いたいお友だちの力に、少しだけでもいいから、なりたかったの
lines.translated: "I wanted to be of help to the friend I cared so much about, even if only just a little bit."

lines.content: でも、だめだった
lines.translated: "But it was no good."

lines.content: 私じゃ届かなかったよ、お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "I couldn't reach her, big sister."

lines.content: どうして？
lines.translated: "Why?"

lines.content: だって……私のせいだもん
lines.translated: "Because... it's my fault."

lines.content: あの子が、大人になっても苦しかったのは、悲しい気持ちが、消えてなくならなかったのは……全部、きっと、私のせいだよ、お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "The reason that girl suffered even after growing up, the reason her sad feelings never faded away... all of it is surely my fault, big sister."

lines.content: どうして十夜はそう思うんだ？
lines.translated: "Why do you think that, Toya?"

lines.content: ……私が、わがままだったから
lines.translated: "...Because I was selfish."

lines.content: 私が、自分の“夢”を叶えたいなんて、さみしいのはもういやだって。そんなことを思ったから。そんな自分勝手なことを、思ってしまったから
lines.translated: "Because I thought about wanting my own 'dream' to come true, about not wanting to be lonely anymore. Because I had such selfish thoughts."

lines.content: 純粋に、心から、あの子の幸せだけを願えていなかったから――
lines.translated: Because I hadn't been able to wish purely, from the bottom of my heart, for her happiness alone--

lines.content: だからきっと、私の思い描いた“魔法”は、効果が薄くなってしまっていたんだよ
lines.translated: "That's why the 'magic' I envisioned must have lost its effect."

lines.content: “つらいことを言葉にして話してほしい。その気持ちの全部を私がもらうよ”
lines.translated: "I want you to put your painful feelings into words and tell me. I'll take all of those feelings for you."

lines.content: そんな“魔法”に効果がなくなってしまっていたんだ。私が自分の“夢”をほんの少しでも優先しようとしたから。
lines.translated: That "magic" had lost its effectiveness. Because I tried to prioritize my own "dream," even if only by a tiny bit.

lines.content: ……人間ではないイキモノが人間とお友だちになろうとした罰なのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe this is my punishment for being a non-human creature who tried to become friends with a human.

lines.content: だってそれは[・|間][・|違][・|い]だから。きっと。そういうことなんだ。
lines.translated: Because doing that is a mistake. Surely. That's what it means.

lines.content: ……もしもどこかに神さまがいるとしたら、そんな間違えてること、絶対に許してくれないもんね。きっと
lines.translated: "...If there's a God out there somewhere, they'd never forgive a mistake like that, right? Surely."

lines.content: ……どうして
抱き上げられた胸に顔を押しつける。
lines.translated: I pressed my face against the chest of my sister as she carried me.

lines.content: わからないよ、お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "I don't understand, big sister."

lines.content: ……ああ、何がだ？
lines.translated: "...Yeah? Understand what?"

lines.content: どうしてなの
lines.translated: "Why is it?"

lines.content: どうして、私は、私たちは……こんなに、こんなに、[あの子|人間]たちのことが大好きに、なってしまうの
lines.translated: "Why do I, why do we... end up loving them--loving humans--so, so much?"

lines.content: さよならはすぐにやって来るのに。
lines.translated: Even though goodbye comes so quickly.

lines.content: またさみしい気持ちに、なってしまうのに。
lines.translated: Even though it only leaves us feeling lonely again.

lines.content: 一緒に同じ時間の中を生きていくことも、できないのに。
lines.translated: Even though we can't live together within the same flow of time.

lines.content: それなのに……、
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: どうして
お姉ちゃん。どうして私はまた、[あの子|人間]たちのことを応援していたいって、そんなこと、思ってしまうの……
lines.translated: "Big sister. Why do I find myself wanting to cheer for those humans all over again...?"

lines.content: 十夜
lines.translated: Toya

lines.content: それはな……と、穏やかな声がする。
lines.translated: "Well, that's..." came her gentle voice.

lines.content: ……それはな、十夜。仕方がないんだ。私たちが、そういうイキモノだから
lines.translated: "...Well, Toya, it can't be helped. Because that's the kind of creatures we are."
"That kind... of creature..."

lines.content: ああ
lines.translated: "Yeah."

lines.content: ……ねえ、どうして
lines.translated: "...Hey, why?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……どうして、私は、人間に産まれてこれなかったの
lines.translated: "...Why couldn't I have been born human?"

lines.content: 私、あの子たちの本当のお友だちに、一度だけでいい、なってみたかっただけなんだよ……お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "I just wanted to become their real friend, even if only once... big sister."

lines.content: でも、[・|そ][・|う][・|で][・|な][・|い][・|イ][・|キ][・|モ][・|ノ]では、あの子たちと本当の友だちになんてなれないことを、何度も、何度となく、こうして思い知らされてしまうから……。
lines.translated: But as a creature that isn't human, I'm forced to realize over, and over, and over again like this that I can never become real friends with them...

lines.content: 教えてよ。どうして私は、あの子たちと同じ人間に、産まれて来れなかったの……お姉ちゃん
lines.translated: "Tell me. Why couldn't I have been born as the same kind of human as them... big sister?"

lines.content: ……仕方がない
lines.translated: "...It can't be helped."

lines.content: どうして……
神さまがそう決めてしまったんだ
lines.translated: "God decided it would be that way."

lines.content: 神さまは、何か間違えてるよ
lines.translated: "God is making some kind of mistake."

lines.content: ああ、そうだな
lines.translated: "Yeah, it really is."

lines.content: 何かはわからないけど、何かを、絶対……私たちと同じくらい、間違ってる
lines.translated: "I don't know what it is, but something is definitely... just as mistaken as we are."

lines.content: そう、かもしれないな
lines.translated: "Maybe... you're right."

lines.content: 一度だけでよかったんだよ
lines.translated: "Just once would have been enough."

lines.content: 私は何度でも繰り返し、言う。
lines.translated: I repeated the words over and over again.

lines.content: 一度だけ、あの子たちとふつうに、笑顔で……遊んでみたかった。それだけなのに
lines.translated: "Just once, I wanted to play with them normally, with a smile... That's all I wanted."

lines.content: しかしそれを望んでしまったから、あの子がいつまでも悲しい想いをしてしまっていたのかも、しれなくて……。
lines.translated: Yet, because I wished for that, maybe I caused that girl to carry her sadness forever...

lines.content: ……いやだよ。お姉ちゃん。もう、疲れた
lines.translated: "...I don't want this anymore, big sister. I'm tired."

lines.content: こんなさみしい想いばかりするのなら。
lines.translated: If it only leads to such lonely feelings.

lines.content: こんな、悲しい気持ちにばかり、なるのなら。
lines.translated: If it only makes me feel this sad.

lines.content: 私は、もう
lines.translated: "From now on, I..."

lines.content: 誰のことも好きにはならないように……、
lines.translated: So that I never fall in love with anyone again...

lines.content: もう二度と、お姉ちゃん。私はお友だちなんて、作らないことにする……
lines.translated: "Never again, big sister. I'm never going to make friends ever again..."

lines.content: ……そう決めていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though I was supposed to have made up my mind.

lines.content: 心に強く誓っていたはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though I had sworn it so firmly in my heart.

lines.content: “大切なお友だちが空から降ってきた”
lines.translated: "My precious friend fell right out of the sky."

lines.content: 私のことをぎゅっと抱きしめてくれる腕の中。
lines.translated: I was inside the arms of someone hugging me tightly.

lines.content: 会いたかったよ十夜ちゃん。……私の大切な、たいせつなお友だち
lines.translated: "I missed you so much, Toya-chan. ...My precious, dearest friend."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]はずっとずっと、夢見続けていたことだった。
lines.translated: This was what I had been dreaming of for so, so long.

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: もう。
lines.translated: Jeez.

lines.content: ……本当に。
lines.translated: It really did.

lines.content: この世界はとっても意地悪な誰かが作ったに違いない。
lines.translated: This world must have been made by someone terribly mean.

lines.content: あるいは、悪戯好きな誰かだろうか。
lines.translated: Or perhaps, someone who loves playing pranks.

lines.content: 諦めかけたその瞬間に――
lines.translated: Because at the very moment you're about to give up--

lines.content: “夢”は、突然、叶えられてしまうこともあるみたい……。
lines.translated: Sometimes, it seems a "dream" is suddenly granted...

lines.content: ねえ、“悲しそうな顔の女の子”。どうして私を、待っていてくれたの？
lines.translated: "Hey, 'girl with the sad-looking face.' Why did you wait for me?"

lines.content: ……抱き留められた胸の中、十夜は言った。
lines.translated: Held safely against her chest, Toya spoke.

lines.content: もしも私が来なかったら……どうするつもりだったの？
lines.translated: "What were you going to do... if I hadn't come?"

lines.content: いいや。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 私がこうしてここにやって来ようと来まいともはや関係ない。
lines.translated: Whether I came here like this or not no longer mattered at all.

lines.content: だって、この子はもう――まだ“次”へと生まれ変われるだけの余地があったはずなのに、もう――どこへも行けなくなってしまったのだから。
lines.translated: Because this girl--even though she still should have had enough room left to be reborn into the "next" life--could no longer go anywhere anymore.

lines.content: 今夜が最後。一週間。時間いっぱい。
lines.translated: Tonight was the last night. One week. Her time was up.

lines.content: その命が所有する時間をすべて使い切り、そうして終わってしまった命が乗車するための最終便。
lines.translated: The final train meant for lives that have used up all the time they possessed and come to an end.

lines.content: ……乗り過ごしてしまった。
lines.translated: She had missed it.

lines.content: 私との“約束”を思い出してしまった、ばっかりに。
lines.translated: All because she remembered her "promise" with me.

lines.content: この子はもう二度と、この街の“夜”から“[外|次]”へは、出られない……。
lines.translated: This girl would never again be able to leave the "Night" of this town for the "outside"--for what comes "next"...

lines.content: あなたは絶対、やって来てくれる。そう信じていたの。だから、こうしてずっと、あなたのことを待っていられたわ
lines.translated: "I knew you would definitely come. I believed you would. That's why I was able to keep waiting for you like this the whole time."

lines.content: それがまさか、見上げた空から落ちて来るだなんて。
lines.translated: "Though I never expected you to fall out of the sky when I looked up."

lines.content: 本当に驚いたよと、十夜のお友だちは、年老いてなおかわいい顔で微笑んでいた。
lines.translated: "You really surprised me," Toya's friend said, smiling with a face that remained cute even in old age.

lines.content: だからって……そんな……
lines.translated: "Even so... how could you..."

lines.content: 今夜を逃したら、もう、あなたは二度と……この世界の時間の中には、戻ってこれないのに
lines.translated: "By missing tonight, you'll never, ever... be able to return to the flow of time in this world again."

lines.content: それをあなたは、ちゃんと……
lines.translated: "And you knew that full well..."

lines.content: うん。わかってる。
lines.translated: "Yeah. I know."

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちはうなずいた。ちゃんと、わかってるよ。
lines.translated: Toya's friend nodded. "I know that full well."

lines.content: それでも私はあなたにもう一度、会いたかった
lines.translated: "Even so, I wanted to see you one more time."

lines.content: ……どうして
だってあなたは、ずっと私のことを待っていてくれたんだよね
lines.translated: "Because you kept waiting for me that whole time, didn't you?"

lines.content: “[ここ|夜]”に産まれ直して、それに気づけた
lines.translated: "Being reborn here into the 'Night' allowed me to realize that."

lines.content: 私との“約束”を信じてくれて……ここで。この、公園で……。雨の日も。晴れの日も。きっと、嵐の日でも雪の日でも
lines.translated: "For believing in your 'promise' with me... right here. In this park... On rainy days. On sunny days. And surely on stormy days and snowy days, too."

lines.content: ごめんねと十夜のお友だちは言う。
lines.translated: "I'm sorry," Toya's friend said.

lines.content: そしてありがとうと、言う。
lines.translated: "And thank you," she added.

lines.content: だから今度は、私があなたのことをずっと、いつまでだって、ずっと、待っていたかった
lines.translated: "That's why this time, I wanted to be the one to wait for you forever, no matter how long it took."

lines.content: そのせいで、この“夜の世界”に永遠に閉じ込められてしまうのでも構わなかった。私の命がそんなふうに締めくくられるとしても……私はきっと、納得できた
lines.translated: "Even if it meant being trapped in this 'World of Night' for all eternity, I didn't mind. Even if my life were to end like that... I knew I could accept it."

lines.content: 私は、あなたに伝えたいことがあった
lines.translated: "There was something I wanted to tell you."

lines.content: 私に……伝えたい、こと？
lines.translated: "Something you... wanted to tell me?"

lines.content: そうだよと、十夜のお友だちはうなずいた。
lines.translated: "That's right," Toya's friend nodded.

lines.content: ……ありがとう。私の小さな“魔法使い”さん
lines.translated: "...Thank you. My little 'magician.'"

lines.content: あなたの“[魔法|言葉]”はちゃんと私に、私たちに、届いたよ
lines.translated: "Your 'magic words' truly reached me--reached us."

lines.content: もうそろそろ朝が近いと、夜空を見上げたふたりは悟る。
lines.translated: Looking up at the night sky, the two of them realized that morning was drawing near.

lines.content: さみしいときも。悲しいときも。……ひとりぼっちで眠れない夜も。[・|あ][・|の][・|と][・|き]届いたあなたの言葉に、勇気をたくさん、もらっていた気がする
lines.translated: "When I was lonely. When I was sad. ...Even on sleepless nights when I was all alone. I feel like the words you gave me back then gave me so much courage."

lines.content: あなたがずっと側にいて、私たちを応援してくれていた気がしてる
lines.translated: "I feel like you were always by our side, cheering us on."

lines.content: 目には見えないけれど。
lines.translated: Even if you can't see her.

lines.content: あなたを忘れてさえいたけれど。
lines.translated: Even though I had forgotten you.

lines.content: 心のどこかで、それをいつも感じていたような気がしてる。
lines.translated: Somewhere in my heart, I feel like I always sensed it.

lines.content: 弱虫で。泣き虫で。すぐに全部を投げ出してしまいそうになる、いつも大人の[世界|時間]に負けてしまいそうになる、私だったけれど――……ありがとう
lines.translated: "I was weak. A crybaby. Someone always on the verge of throwing everything away, always about to lose to the adult world--to adult time... Thank you."

lines.content: あなたのおかげで、私、どうしても強くなれないこんな私でも、ほら、見てよ。最後まで負けずに歩いてこれたよ
lines.translated: "Thanks to you, even someone like me who could never become strong--look. I managed to walk all the way to the end without giving up."

lines.content: だから私は、どうしても――思い出せなくても、覚えていなくても――いつも側に感じてたあなたの気持ちに、どうしても報いたくて……
lines.translated: "That's why, no matter what--even if I couldn't remember, even if I didn't know who you were--I desperately wanted to repay the feelings I always felt beside me..."

lines.content: ……たぶんもう二度と会えない、思い出せない、だけどとても大切なひとに“ありがとう”って気持ちを返すには、いったいどうしたらいいの……、って
lines.translated: "'...How on earth can I return my feelings of gratitude to someone very precious to me, whom I can probably never meet again, and can't even remember...?'"

lines.content: 夫に、そう相談してみたことがあった。
lines.translated: I once asked my husband for advice about that.

lines.content: 女の子がそう言うと、十夜の中に[・|そ][・|の][・|子]の記憶が流れ込んできた。
lines.translated: As the girl spoke, her memories flowed into Toya.

lines.content: 相談した女の子に……[・|私]に、夫はこう言ったのだ。
lines.translated: To the girl who asked him... to me, my husband said this:

lines.content: “それは、うん、とっても難しいことだよね”
lines.translated: "That's, well, a very difficult question, isn't it?"

lines.content: と、困ったように笑ってた。
lines.translated: He smiled with a troubled look.

lines.content: “その答えは、ぼくなりの答えは、今はまだ見つけられない”
lines.translated: "I can't find the answer--my own answer to that--just yet."

lines.content: “でも、いつか必ず答えるよ。だから少しだけ待っててね”と
lines.translated: "But I'll definitely give you an answer someday. So just wait a little while, okay?"

lines.content: 夫は私にやさしくそう言ってくれていた。
lines.translated: My husband kindly told me that.

lines.content: そして懸命に、賢明に、頑張ってがんばって……。
lines.translated: And then, earnestly and wisely, he tried so, so hard...

lines.content: その人生を全力で生き抜いて――
lines.translated: Living his life with everything he had--

lines.content: [・|私][・|よ][・|り][・|も][・|早][・|く]自分の時間を使い切ってしまった愛しい人は、私が相談をした数年後、ベッドの上で、真っ白な病室で、私の手を取り、
lines.translated: My beloved, who used up his own time much faster than I did, took my hand several years after I asked him for advice, lying on a bed in a pure white hospital room.

lines.content: ――“がんばって、生きること”
lines.translated: --"To do your best, and live."

lines.content: 微笑んで、“それがぼくなりの答えだよ”とそう言った。
lines.translated: Smiling, he said, "That is my answer."

lines.content: ――“君のことを応援してるひとが願う以上に、君が誰より、何より、笑顔で……幸せに生きていけること”
lines.translated: --"To live with a smile, happier than anyone or anything else... even more than the person cheering for you could ever wish for."

lines.content: あなたはそっと、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: You gently closed your eyelids.

lines.content: ――“誰もがそれを願ってる。君の幸せを祈ってる。だからきっと、そういうふうに生きることが、一番のありがとうに変わるはず”
lines.translated: --"Everyone wishes for that. They are praying for your happiness. So I'm sure that living that way will become the greatest 'thank you' of all."

lines.content: さよならの前に、あなたがそう答えてくれたから。
lines.translated: Because before saying goodbye, you gave me that answer.
--"...I'm sorry."

lines.content: ――“さみしがり屋で、泣き虫な君を、これからひとりにしてしまうけど”
lines.translated: --"Even though you get lonely easily and are such a crybaby, I'm going to leave you all alone from now on."

lines.content: ――“もう、さよならをしないと、いけないけれど”
lines.translated: --"Even though I have to say goodbye now."

lines.content: あの人が、私の手を最後にしっかり握ってくれたから。
lines.translated: Because at the very end, he held my hand tightly.

lines.content: ――“がんばれ”
lines.translated: --"Do your best."

lines.content: ――“負けるな”
lines.translated: --"Don't give in."

lines.content: ――“……ぼくも君を、応援してる”
lines.translated: --"...I'm cheering for you, too."

lines.content: ――“……だからお願い。もう、泣かないで”
lines.translated: --"...So please. Don't cry anymore."

lines.content: 強くなりたい。
lines.translated: I want to be strong.

lines.content: そう思った。
lines.translated: That's what I thought to myself.

lines.content: あなたが心配しないよう。
lines.translated: So that you won't worry.

lines.content: あなたが安心して、旅立てるよう。
lines.translated: So that you can set off on your journey in peace.

lines.content: 私はもう二度と泣いたりしない。
lines.translated: I will never cry again.

lines.content: そう、決めないと……。
lines.translated: I have to make up my mind...

lines.content: 残された息子の小さな手のひらを握りしめ……、
lines.translated: Squeezing the small palm of the son left behind to me...

lines.content: 私は、涙じゃなくて、微笑んで、あなたのことを見送れただろうか。
lines.translated: Was I able to send you off with a smile instead of tears?

lines.content: そして今度は私が、大切なこの子を“応援”しながら生きていく……。
lines.translated: And now, it's my turn to live on while "cheering" for this precious child...

lines.content: 強く……、
lines.translated: Strong...

lines.content: 強く、なりたい。
lines.translated: I want to become strong.

lines.content: ひとりで子を育てるのは容易ではない。
lines.translated: Raising a child alone is not easy.

lines.content: そんなことは充分わかっているつもりだった。教師だった頃に母子家庭の生徒も少なからずみていたのだ。
lines.translated: I thought I understood that well enough. Back when I was a teacher, I had seen more than a few students from single-mother households.

lines.content: でも、実際に、それを我が身のこととするのはとても大変なことだった――……誰も、誰ひとり、この世界で私を必要としてくれる誰かはいなかった。
lines.translated: However, actually experiencing it for myself was unimaginably difficult--...There was no one, not a single person in this world, who needed me.

lines.content: 教師として復職するためたくさんの学校で頭を下げた。
lines.translated: I bowed my head at countless schools to get reinstated as a teacher.

lines.content: でも、居場所は得られなかった。
lines.translated: But I couldn't find a place for myself.

lines.content: 長いブランクがあること。その間にどこの現場も色々と様変わりしていること。
lines.translated: There was a long gap in my resume. And during that time, the workplaces everywhere had changed in many ways.

lines.content: 悔しいが……女性であること。
lines.translated: Frustratingly... there was also the fact that I was a woman.

lines.content: 様々な理由がそこにはあった。
lines.translated: There were all sorts of reasons.

lines.content: 教師がもう無理ならば何でもいい。私にできることをとにかく探した。
lines.translated: If being a teacher was no longer possible, anything would do. I just searched for whatever I could do.

lines.content: ……遠矢。私の息子。あなたと私の愛しい子。
lines.translated: Tooya. My son. Your and my beloved child.

lines.content: 遠矢とふたり、なんとか微笑みながら生きていける――それだけの力が得られさえすれば、何でもよかった。
lines.translated: As long as I could gain just enough strength for Tooya and me to somehow live on with a smile--anything was fine.

lines.content: 工事現場で男たちにまじり働いた。
lines.translated: I worked alongside men at construction sites.

lines.content: 怖い現場監督に怒鳴り散らされる度に泣きそうになる。
lines.translated: Every time the scary site foreman yelled at me, I felt like crying.

lines.content: 朝になるとラブホテルの清掃員として、お昼前まで汚れたシーツを交換したりして働いた。
lines.translated: When morning came, I worked as a cleaner at a love hotel, changing dirty sheets until just before noon.

lines.content: “あのおばさん使えねえな”と、同僚の若い男の子たちが聞こえよがしに言う度に、涙がにじんだ。
lines.translated: Every time my younger male coworkers said, "That old lady is useless," loud enough for me to hear, tears welled up in my eyes.

lines.content: 泣きそうになるその度に、私は唇をかみしめて――“がんばって、生きること”……夫の言葉をつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Every time I was about to cry, I bit my lip and murmured my husband's words--"To do your best, and live"...

lines.content: 休日は引っ越し業者のお手伝いと、老人介護のデイサービス。また夜になると工事現場に戻って朝まで泥と埃りにまみれた。
lines.translated: On holidays, I helped out movers and worked at an elderly daycare service. Then at night, I returned to the construction site, covered in mud and dust until morning.

lines.content: それでも息子とふたりで生きていくためには充分だと言いがたい。
lines.translated: Even so, it was hard to say it was enough for my son and me to live on.

lines.content: もっとだ。これからもっと、お金が必要になる。
lines.translated: More. I was going to need even more money from here on out.

lines.content: 遠矢がどんな道を選んでも、決して、絶対、不自由な想いをさせないように――遠矢。
lines.translated: So that no matter what path Tooya chose, he would never, ever feel held back--Tooya.

lines.content: ねえ、遠矢。
lines.translated: Hey, Tooya.

lines.content: あなたを心から応援したい。お母さん。あなたのことが、大好きよ。
lines.translated: I want to cheer for you with all my heart. Mom loves you so much.

lines.content: ……でも。
lines.translated: However.

lines.content: 遠矢の進学のためにと貯金しておいたお金が銀行口座とか職員の怠慢だとか――
lines.translated: When the money I had saved up for Tooya's higher education was reduced to almost zero due to bank account issues or staff negligence--

lines.content: どうしてそうなってしまうのか理解できない[ずさん|杜撰]な事情で、ほとんどゼロになってしまったときは、さすがに……もう、だめだ。
lines.translated: --some sloppy circumstances I couldn't even wrap my head around, even I thought... I can't do this anymore.

lines.content: 世界や自分の運命や、人生そのものを恨んでしまいそうに、なった。
lines.translated: I hampir came to resent the world, my fate, and life itself.

lines.content: 『……がんばれ』
lines.translated: "...Do your best."

lines.content: そんなときは声が聞こえる。
lines.translated: At times like that, I hear a voice.

lines.content: 『……おうえんしてるよ。いつまでも』
lines.translated: "...I'm cheering for you. Forever and always."

lines.content: もうだめだと思ったとき、私は“魔法”が使えることを思い出す。
lines.translated: When I think I can't go on anymore, I remember that I can use "magic."

lines.content: 『いつもあなた隣に、すてきな魔法がありますように』
lines.translated: "May there always be wonderful magic right beside you."

lines.content: 大切に、大切にしまってある私のお守り――手紙だ。
lines.translated: My good luck charm, kept safely and preciously tucked away--a letter.

lines.content: それは誰からもらったものなのかはわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know who gave it to me.

lines.content: くしゃくしゃのチラシの裏に色鉛筆で書かれた言葉を手紙と呼ぶのも、それで正しいのかさえわからないけど……。
lines.translated: I don't even know if it's right to call words written in colored pencil on the back of a crumpled flyer a letter, though...

lines.content: その手紙を見つめていると声が聞こえる気がするのだ。
lines.translated: When I stare at that letter, I feel like I can hear a voice.

lines.content: 『あなたの未来に、たくさん、たくさんの笑顔が、ありますように』
lines.translated: "May there be lots and lots of smiles in your future."

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……ありがとう。
lines.translated: Thank you.

lines.content: 大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: あと一歩。もう一歩。歩いて行ける。
lines.translated: One more step. Just one more step. I can keep walking.

lines.content: 私はまだまだがんばれる。
lines.translated: I can still keep going.

lines.content: 疲れ切って小さなアパートの部屋に帰ると、遠矢が“おかえりなさい”と言ってくれる。あなたに良く似た笑顔で、駆け寄ってきてくれる。
lines.translated: When I return to our small apartment room completely exhausted, Tooya says, "Welcome home." He runs up to me with a smile that looks so much like yours.

lines.content: それが私の幸せだったと――つらいとき、悲しいとき、いつか誰かからもらった[言葉|手紙]が、思い出させてくれたから。
lines.translated: Because when times were hard, when I was sad, the letter--the words--I received from someone once upon a time reminded me that this was my happiness.

lines.content: ……大丈夫。平気。まだまだ私、がんばれるよ
lines.translated: "...I'm okay. I'm fine. I can still keep going."

lines.content: やさしかった義祖父と夫が亡くなってからは、夫の実家を頼ることはもうできない。
lines.translated: After my kind grandfather-in-law and my husband passed away, I could no longer rely on my husband's family home.

lines.content: あの家は義兄がすべてを取り仕切ることになった。義兄は習わしに厳しい人だった。
lines.translated: My brother-in-law ended up taking charge of everything in that house. He was a man strict about traditions.

lines.content: 遠矢が伝統ある芸事を将来必ず継承するのなら、私たちふたりの生活は保証しよう――そのように言われた。
lines.translated: I was told that if Tooya were to definitely inherit the traditional family art in the future, they would guarantee a living for the two of us.

lines.content: うなずくのはきっと簡単だった。
lines.translated: Nodding in agreement would surely have been easy.

lines.content: その頃の遠矢はまだまだ小さかったし……。
lines.translated: Tooya was still very small back then, after all...

lines.content: だけど幼いが故の“夢”もこの子にはたくさん、いっぱい、あったのだ。
lines.translated: Yet precisely because he was so young, this child had so, so many "dreams."

lines.content: 消防士になりたい。警察官になりたい。宇宙飛行士にもなってみたい。
lines.translated: He wanted to be a firefighter. He wanted to be a police officer. He wanted to try being an astronaut, too.

lines.content: 義兄の言葉にうなずいたなら、私の勝手で遠矢の“夢”をぜんぶ踏みつぶしてしまうことになる……たとえそれが途方もなく幼い“夢”であったとしても。
lines.translated: If I nodded in agreement to my brother-in-law's words, I would be selfishly trampling over all of Tooya's "dreams"... even if they were absurdly childish "dreams."

lines.content: 遠矢が将来、自分の道を、自分の時間を、どのように選択するかはわからない。
lines.translated: I didn't know how Tooya would choose his own path, his own time, in the future.

lines.content: 私がこの子の未来を守らなきゃ
lines.translated: I have to protect this child's future.

lines.content: 大丈夫。お母さん、あなたのことを応援するよ。だから一緒に、ふたりで一緒に、暮らそうか。
lines.translated: "It's okay. Mom will cheer for you. So let's live together, just the two of us."

lines.content: そうしてふたりで家を出たのだ。
lines.translated: And so, the two of us left the house.

lines.content: 後悔はしていない……きっと。
lines.translated: I have no regrets... I'm sure.

lines.content: 遠矢の“夢”を守るために家を出た。あのときは勢いで飛び出してきたけれど、そのために私はこの子に不自由な思いをさせてしまっているかもしれない。
lines.translated: I left the house to protect Tooya's "dreams." Back then, I ran out on impulse, and because of that, I might have been making this child endure hardships.

lines.content: 仕事があまりに忙しくって、お母さんらしいこと、何も出来ていなかったから……だけど。
lines.translated: Because I was so busy with work, I couldn't do anything motherly for him... However.

lines.content: 小学校の卒業アルバムの文集に“将来の夢は正義の味方”と遠矢が書いていたのを見つけた。“ぼくは正義の味方になって、お母さんを助けたい”
lines.translated: In his elementary school graduation anthology, I found that Tooya had written, "My dream for the future is to be a hero of justice." "I want to become a hero of justice and save my mom."

lines.content: なんだかうれしくって、涙が出たよ。
lines.translated: It made me so happy for some reason, and tears came to my eyes.

lines.content: あなたの“夢”はこれからどんな形に変わっていくのかな。
lines.translated: I wonder what kind of shape your "dreams" will change into from here on out.

lines.content: 私はそれがとっても楽しみで……。
lines.translated: I was looking forward to that so much...

lines.content: 今まで応援してくれたすべての人の気持ちを返すため……お願いね、遠矢。お母さんに、あなたの人生を応援させてね。
lines.translated: In order to repay the feelings of everyone who has cheered for me until now... Please, Tooya. Let Mom cheer for your life.

lines.content: そんなことを思いながら。
lines.translated: Thinking such things.

lines.content: 少ない睡眠時間を削り、遠矢が次の日学校で使う雑巾や、やんちゃで破れてしまった服を繕っている時間が、私はきっと、愛おしかった。
lines.translated: The time I spent cutting into my meager sleeping hours to mend the cleaning rags Tooya would use at school the next day, or the clothes he tore while roughhousing, was surely precious to me.

lines.content: だけど……、
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: そんな遠矢が、
lines.translated: For that same Tooya to say,

lines.content: お父さんの家の仕事を引き継ぐよ
lines.translated: "I'll take over Dad's family business."

lines.content: そう言って、控えていた大学受験を諦めてしまったのは……悲しかった。
lines.translated: And give up on the upcoming college entrance exams... was sad.

lines.content: 何より自分が情けなかった。
lines.translated: Above all, I was ashamed of myself.

lines.content: 長年の無理がたたってしまい、私は倒れてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Years of overexertion had taken their toll, and I had collapsed.

lines.content: どうしてこんな、大事なときに……。
lines.translated: Why at such an important time...?

lines.content: それは遠矢が大学進学を控えた冬のことだった。
lines.translated: That happened in the winter just before Tooya was set to go on to college.

lines.content: そんな私を助けるために、遠矢は厳しい芸事の世界に飛び込むことを決意した。
lines.translated: In order to save me in that state, Tooya resolved to plunge into the strict world of traditional performing arts.

lines.content: 家長の義兄は“何を今さら”と最初は煙たい顔をしたけれど……。
lines.translated: At first, my brother-in-law, the head of the family, made a displeased face, saying, "Why now after all this time?"...

lines.content: 再び夫の家に戻された私たち。
lines.translated: We were brought back to my husband's family home once again.

lines.content: 生活は安定した。生きていくことにとりあえずの不安はなくなった。
lines.translated: Our lives stabilized. For the time being, the anxiety over making a living was gone.

lines.content: だけど、これまでの私のがんばりは、いったいなんだったんだろう
lines.translated: But what on earth was all my hard work up until now even for?

lines.content: 落ち込む私に、
lines.translated: As I felt depressed,

lines.content: 知ってるだろう。母さん。ぼくの夢は母さんを助ける正義の味方になることだ。夢は、叶ったんだよ
lines.translated: "You know, don't you, Mom? My dream is to become a hero of justice who saves you. My dream came true."

lines.content: 遠矢はそう言い、笑いかけてくれていた。
lines.translated: Tooya said that, smiling at me.

lines.content: ……あの子にはどうやら才能があったらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, that child had talent.

lines.content: 義兄は驚き、“もっと早く戻ってくれていれば”と簡単に手のひらを返し――
lines.translated: My brother-in-law was surprised and easily changed his tune, saying, "If only you had come back sooner"--

lines.content: 更にこの子に、一番大きな舞台の一番の大役を任せたいとそう言った。
lines.translated: Furthermore, he said he wanted to entrust this child with the biggest leading role on the grandest stage.
They say it is a "story" that has been passed down for generations.

lines.content: 私は、最後まで……
lines.translated: Right until the very end, I...

lines.content: 最後まで遠矢がいったいどんな舞台に立ち、どのような役を与えられ……頑張っているのかわからなかったけれど。
lines.translated: Right until the very end, I didn't understand what kind of stage Tooya was standing on, or what kind of role he had been given... as he did his best, though.

lines.content: 身体を壊し、夫と同じ病院から外へ出れなくなってしまった私に、遠矢はある日、すてきなお見舞いを持って病室へとやって来てくれた。
lines.translated: Having ruined my health and become unable to leave the same hospital my husband had been in, Tooya came to my hospital room one day bringing a wonderful get-well gift.

lines.content: 孫だ。私に孫ができたのだ。かわいい小さな女の子。
lines.translated: A grandchild. I had a grandchild. A cute little girl.

lines.content: その子の笑顔は、遠矢の人生が幸福なものである確かな証拠のように強く感じられた――
lines.translated: That child's smile felt strongly like sure proof that Tooya's life was a happy one--

lines.content: だけどごめんね、孫はどうやら私に似てしまったみたいだね
lines.translated: However, I'm sorry, it seems my granddaughter ended up taking after me.

lines.content: ある日のことだ。
lines.translated: It happened one day.

lines.content: 朝から体調のひどく優れない日のことだった。
lines.translated: It was a day when I had been feeling terribly unwell since morning.

lines.content: 孫がひとりだけで病室にやって来た。
lines.translated: My granddaughter came to my hospital room all by herself.

lines.content: ……泣いていた。
lines.translated: She was crying.

lines.content: クラスのいやな子にいじめられていると、私にだけ打ち明けてくれた――ああ、あなたは私にそっくりね。
lines.translated: She confided only in me that she was being bullied by a mean kid in her class--ah, you look just like me.

lines.content: 声を殺して涙を流す孫を抱きしめた。
lines.translated: I hugged my granddaughter as she shed tears, stifling her voice.

lines.content: いじらしいくらい。愛おしいくらい。あなたは私に、そっくりよ。
lines.translated: Almost pitifully so. Almost endearingly so. You are just like me.

lines.content: だから、そんなあなたにだから、
lines.translated: That's why, precisely because you are like that,

lines.content: 特別な“魔法”をひとつ、教えてあげる
lines.translated: I'll teach you one special kind of "magic."

lines.content: つらいことや悲しいことは、心の中から言葉にして、外に……あなたを、応援してくれる[誰か|私]、に……
lines.translated: Put the painful and sad things inside your heart into words, and let them out... to someone--to me--who will cheer for you...

lines.content: そんな言葉が、私の唇からぽろりとこぼれて……、
lines.translated: Those words spilled softly from my lips, and...

lines.content: 『……一緒に、遊んで欲しい』
lines.translated: "...I want you to play with me."

lines.content: 突然だった。
lines.translated: It came out of nowhere.

lines.content: 『次にまた会えたときは、私と、一緒に』
lines.translated: "The next time we meet again, together with me."

lines.content: あまりにも、突然。
lines.translated: All too suddenly.

lines.content: すべて思い出してしまった。
lines.translated: I remembered everything.

lines.content: 私にはお友だちがいた。
lines.translated: I had a friend.

lines.content: いつも泣いてばかりいた私に、誰でも使える特別な“魔法”を教えてくれた小さな子。
lines.translated: A little girl who taught me, who was always crying, a special "magic" that anyone could use.

lines.content: 雨の日になると町外れの公園で私のことを待っていてくれた。
lines.translated: Whenever it rained, she would wait for me at the park on the outskirts of town.

lines.content: ……次の晴れの日。
lines.translated: The next sunny day.

lines.content: あの子と一緒に遊ぼうと、“約束”をした。
lines.translated: I made a "promise" to play together with that girl.

lines.content: いつもさみしそうな顔をしてひとりぼっちでいた女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who was always all alone with a lonely look on her face.

lines.content: あの子を笑顔にしたい
lines.translated: I want to make that girl smile.

lines.content: さみしそうな顔はもうしてほしくない
lines.translated: I don't want her to make a lonely face anymore.

lines.content: そう、願っていたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I had wished for that...

lines.content: ああ、なんてこと。
lines.translated: Ah, how terrible.

lines.content: 遅刻だ。
lines.translated: I'm late.

lines.content: 何年も。何十年も。あまりにも長い大遅刻。
lines.translated: By years. By decades. Way, way too late.

lines.content: あの子はまだあの公園にいる気がした。
lines.translated: I felt like that girl was still in that park.

lines.content: どうにも不思議だけれど、あの頃と変わらない姿で、あの子はいつまでも、ずっと……私を、私たちを待っていてくれている気がした。今も変わらず、さみしそうな顔をして。
lines.translated: It was awfully strange, yet I felt like that girl was waiting for me, for us, forever and always... looking no different than she did back then. Still making that same lonely face even now.

lines.content: 雨降りの空を、晴れ渡る青空を、ひとりぼっちで見上げながら……。
lines.translated: Looking up at the rainy sky, at the clear blue sky, all alone...

lines.content: 今すぐ。
lines.translated: Right now.

lines.content: 今すぐ病室を飛び出してあの子に会いに行きたい――……でも。
lines.translated: I want to rush out of this hospital room right now and go see that girl--...but.

lines.content: ……でも、もう、無理だ
lines.translated: But, it's impossible now.

lines.content: 私の身体はまったく細くなってしまった。
lines.translated: My body had grown completely thin.

lines.content: 私はがんばりすぎたのだとお医者さんに言われた。身体の中に大きなおおきな“終わり”を抱えてる。そのせいで病院のベッドにたくさんの管やコードで縛り付けられてしまっていた。
lines.translated: The doctor told me that I had pushed myself too hard. I was carrying a big, huge "end" inside my body. Because of that, I was tied down to the hospital bed by lots of tubes and cords.

lines.content: それらを引きちぎって走って行くだけの力を、私は、私の中の“終わり”に日々、着々と飲み込まれていっていて……。
lines.translated: The strength needed to tear them off and run was steadily being swallowed up day by day by the "end" inside me...

lines.content: ……もう、呼吸をするのも、少しつらいよ
lines.translated: Even just breathing is a little painful now.

lines.content: 医者から告げられた余命はあとわずか。
lines.translated: The remaining time the doctor told me I had left was very short.

lines.content: でも、家族には、遠矢には秘密にしてほしいと義兄と医者には願った。
lines.translated: Even so, I asked my brother-in-law and the doctor to keep it a secret from my family, from Tooya.

lines.content: やさしいあの子のことだから、私がこうなってしまったのも自分のせいだと、自分を責め続けてしまうだろうから……
lines.translated: Because knowing that kind child, he would probably keep blaming himself, thinking it was his fault that I ended up like this...

lines.content: そんな人生はあまりに不幸だ。
lines.translated: A life like that is far too tragic.

lines.content: まるで悪夢の中でいつまでも目覚められずにいるみたい。
lines.translated: It's like being trapped in a nightmare, unable to wake up forever.

lines.content: 遠矢と孫にはただ風邪をこじらせてしまったと説明した。軽く。笑って。微笑んで。
lines.translated: To Tooya and my granddaughter, I explained that my cold had just gotten worse. Lightly. Laughing. Smiling.

lines.content: がんばるよ。
lines.translated: I'll do my best.

lines.content: がんばって治すよ。
lines.translated: "I'll do my best to get better."

lines.content: 街のさくらが満開に咲く頃までに……必ず。
lines.translated: "By the time the cherry blossoms in town are in full bloom... definitely."

lines.content: みんなで、三人で、一緒にお花見しましょうね――まあ、うん。どうしてもっていうのなら、お義兄さんも連れて行ってあげてもいいわ
lines.translated: Let's all go cherry blossom viewing together, the three of us--well, yeah. If he really insists, I suppose we can bring my brother-in-law along too.

lines.content: お見舞いに来てくれていた遠矢と孫と、そして義兄と、四人で笑った。
lines.translated: The four of us laughed together--Tooya, my granddaughter, and my brother-in-law, who had come to visit me.

lines.content: ああ、きっとこれが、私の幸せ。
lines.translated: Ah, surely this is my happiness.

lines.content: もう少し。あと、ちょっとだけ。
lines.translated: Just a little more. Just a tiny bit longer.

lines.content: こんな時間の中に私は生きていたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to live inside a time like this.

lines.content: 『……がんばれ』
lines.translated: "...Do your best."

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 『……負けるな』
lines.translated: "...Don't give up."
