lines.content: 任せてよ。
lines.translated: Leave it to me.

lines.content: 『……おうえん、してるよ』
lines.translated: "...I'm cheering, for you."

lines.content: うん。ありがとう……知ってるよ。
lines.translated: Yeah. Thank you... I know.

lines.content: 必ずだ。こんなの必ず治してみせる
lines.translated: Definitely. I will definitely cure something like this.

lines.content: せめて、遠矢。あなたが、あなたの[舞台|大仕事]をやり遂げるまでは……必ず。
lines.translated: At the very least, Tooya. Until you accomplish your big job--your stage... definitely.

lines.content: 私の中の“終わり”を小さくするための治療はとても苦しいものだった。
lines.translated: The treatment to shrink the "end" inside me was very painful.

lines.content: やせ細り。嘔吐して。髪はすべて抜けてしまった。
lines.translated: I grew emaciated. I vomited. All my hair fell out.

lines.content: 義兄に頼んで本物そっくりのカツラを造ってもらい、なんとか遠矢と孫を騙せてはいたと思うけれど……。
lines.translated: I asked my brother-in-law to make a wig that looked just like the real thing, and I think I managed to fool Tooya and my granddaughter somehow, but...

lines.content: 私、泣かなかったよ。
lines.translated: I didn't cry.

lines.content: たくさん笑って。
lines.translated: I laughed a lot.

lines.content: たくさん、あなた達とのすてきな未来を想像してみたからだろうか。
lines.translated: Perhaps it was because I tried imagining so many wonderful futures with all of you.

lines.content: 最近は少し、体調もよくなりはじめていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Lately, I had started feeling a little better, too, and yet...

lines.content: ……そう。もう、ここまでなのね
lines.translated: "...I see. So this is as far as I go."

lines.content: がくっと体調が悪くなってしまったこの日。
lines.translated: On this day, my condition took a sudden, sharp turn for the worse.

lines.content: 理屈も道理もまるで理解できないけれど――
lines.translated: I couldn't understand the logic or reason behind it at all, and yet--

lines.content: あの子のことを思い出したのは、私にそろそろ“終わり”がやって来ることの前兆なのだろう。そう思えた。
lines.translated: It felt like remembering that girl was an omen that my "end" was finally approaching. That's what I thought.

lines.content: 遠矢が泣いている。
lines.translated: Tooya is crying.

lines.content: 孫も泣いている。
lines.translated: My granddaughter is crying too.

lines.content: ……お義兄さんまで。
lines.translated: Even my brother-in-law.

lines.content: だめよ。
lines.translated: No, don't.

lines.content: だめ。
lines.translated: No good.

lines.content: 泣かないで。
lines.translated: Don't cry.

lines.content: 悲しいことなんて何もない。
lines.translated: There's nothing to be sad about.

lines.content: 笑わなきゃ……。
lines.translated: I have to smile...

lines.content: 私が苦しい顔をしていると、あなた達が、やさしいあなたが、悲しんでしまうから……。
lines.translated: Because if I make a pained face, all of you--kind, gentle you--will be sad...

lines.content: がんばって、がんばって。最後まで幸せに……生きないと
lines.translated: "Do your best, do your best. I have to live... happily until the very end."

lines.content: それが私を“応援”してくれる人たちへの、一番の“ありがとう”に変わるはず――
lines.translated: Because that should turn into the greatest "thank you" to the people who are "cheering" for me--

lines.content: そんな[・|あ][・|な][・|た]の言葉を信じてここまで歩いて来れたけど……。
lines.translated: Believing in those words of yours, I managed to walk this far, and yet...

lines.content: さくらだ。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms.

lines.content: さくらの花が咲いていた。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms were blooming.

lines.content: 大切な人たちが私を車いすに乗せ、病院の中庭に連れ出してくれた日――
lines.translated: The day my precious family put me in a wheelchair and took me out to the hospital courtyard--

lines.content: 四人で見上げた春色の空。
lines.translated: The four of us looked up at the spring-colored sky.

lines.content: こぼれ落ちそうなほど真っ青な空の下、今までの楽しかったことを全員で話した。
lines.translated: Beneath a sky so deeply blue it felt like we might fall right into it, we all talked about the fun times we'd had until now.

lines.content: つらいことは不思議と何も思い出せない。
lines.translated: Strangely enough, I couldn't remember any of the painful things.

lines.content: 幸せなこともいっぱいあった人生だったから。
lines.translated: Because it was a life filled with so many happy moments.

lines.content: でも、いつも、そんな時間の中に、側にいてほしいひとの姿だけが、どこにもなかったことも思い出してしまう……。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't help remembering that within all those times, the one person I wanted by my side was nowhere to be found...

lines.content: ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちにしてしまって、“約束”を守らなくて、本当に、ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm so sorry for leaving you all alone, and for not keeping our "promise."

lines.content: ……私の大切なお友だち
lines.translated: "...My precious friend."

lines.content: 私に小さな“魔法”をくれたひと。私に、小さな勇気をくれたひと
lines.translated: "The person who gave me a little 'magic.' The person who gave me a little courage."

lines.content: 眠い。
lines.translated: I'm sleepy.

lines.content: なんだかとっても、眠たくて……。
lines.translated: I feel so, so sleepy...

lines.content: 病院の中庭から見上げた空は、眩しいくらいに、青空で……、
lines.translated: The sky I looked up at from the hospital courtyard was such a dazzling blue...

lines.content: 会いたい
lines.translated: "I want to see you."

lines.content: あなたに、会いに行きたいよ
lines.translated: "I want to go and see you."

lines.content: ねえ、どうかな。
lines.translated: Hey, what do you think?

lines.content: ……教えて欲しいよ。
lines.translated: I want you to tell me.

lines.content: 私はちゃんと、がんばれたのかな。
lines.translated: Did I manage to do my best?

lines.content: 気づけば私は“夜”の中。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I was inside the "Night."

lines.content: きらきら光る不思議な“夜”の公園にいた。
lines.translated: I was in a mysterious, sparkling park of the "Night."

lines.content: 私はここを知っている。知らないはずなのに知っている。
lines.translated: I know this place. I shouldn't, yet I do.

lines.content: 夜の時間に訪れるもうひとつの“夜”である。
lines.translated: It is another "Night" that visits during the nighttime hours.

lines.content: 誰もが心でここを知っていて、誰もがここをまるで知らない――不思議と懐かしいそんな場所。
lines.translated: Everyone knows this place in their hearts, yet no one knows it at all--a strangely nostalgic place.

lines.content: 命が終われば“夢の時間”も終わるのだ。
lines.translated: When a life ends, the "time of dreams" ends as well.

lines.content: 誰もが最期に一度は“[ここ|夜]”を訪れる。
lines.translated: Everyone visits this "Night" at least once at the very end.

lines.content: それを魂の深い部分で、きっと、生きとし生けるすべての者が知っている。
lines.translated: Deep within their souls, surely every living creature knows this.

lines.content: そうして目覚めた“夜”の中で……ひとり。
lines.translated: And so, in the "Night" where I awoke... I was alone.

lines.content: ひとり、ぼっち。
lines.translated: All, alone.

lines.content: あの子はいない。どこにもいない。
lines.translated: That girl isn't here. She's nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 待っていた。ずっとずっと待っていた。
lines.translated: I waited. I waited forever and ever.

lines.content: そろそろ列車に乗らなきゃ、あなた、“夜”の中に呑まれてしまいますよ
lines.translated: "If you don't board the train soon, you will be swallowed up by the 'Night,' you know."

lines.content: この街の“夜”を支配し、言葉を話す二本足で歩く猫が私にそう言った。
lines.translated: A talking cat walking on two legs, who ruled over the "Night" of this town, said that to me.

lines.content: 列車で“次”に向かって、そこで終わった命に、新しい時間を刻んでもらいなさい。そして“次”の夢見る時間を選べばいい
lines.translated: "Take the train toward the 'Next,' and have new time carved into your ended life there. Then you can simply choose your 'next' time to dream."

lines.content: それはあなた達、人間として産まれた“[命|時間]”の特権なんですから
lines.translated: "Because that is the privilege of the 'time' given to you lives born as humans."

lines.content: 汽笛だ……。
lines.translated: A steam whistle...

lines.content: これは、何度目の汽笛だろうか。
lines.translated: How many times have I heard this whistle now?

lines.content: 乗車しなければ大変なことになる……。
lines.translated: Something terrible will happen if I don't get on...

lines.content: 一週間が、猶予だ……。
lines.translated: The grace period is one week...

lines.content: 私が汽車に乗るには今夜が最後のチャンス。
lines.translated: Tonight is my last chance to board the train.

lines.content: そういうふうに、通りすがりの二足歩行の猫に教えられて知っていた。
lines.translated: I knew this because a bipedal cat passing by had told me so.

lines.content: “夜”の公園では殆ど影と化してしまった（おそらくは子どもだろう）、小さな人の形をした[・|何][・|か]が、楽しそうに遊び回っている――あれはなんだろう。
lines.translated: In the park of the "Night," small, human-shaped somethings that had turned almost entirely into shadows (probably children) were playing around happily--what could they be?

lines.content: きっと、汽車に乗車することができず、あるいは乗車することをせず、“夜”の中に同化してしまった“[終わってしまった時間|命]”
lines.translated: Surely, they are "lives"--"times that have ended"--who either could not or did not board the train, and assimilated into the "Night."

lines.content: 今夜を逃すと私もあの子たちみたいになってしまう。
lines.translated: If I miss it tonight, I'll end up just like those children.

lines.content: 永遠に、いつまでも、“夜”の中を彷徨うことになる――目覚めることのない悪い夢の中を彷徨うみたいに。
lines.translated: I will wander through the "Night" forever and ever--like wandering through a bad dream from which I can never awaken.

lines.content: それでも私は列車には乗らない。そう決めた。
lines.translated: Even so, I won't board the train. I've made up my mind.

lines.content: あの子のことをずっと待つのだ。
lines.translated: I will wait for that girl forever.

lines.content: 伝えたいことがあった。
lines.translated: There was something I wanted to tell her.

lines.content: あの子に教えて欲しいことがあった。
lines.translated: There was something I wanted her to tell me.

lines.content: でも、本当に……
lines.translated: "Even so, really..."

lines.content: ……本当に。
lines.translated: It really did.

lines.content: 私はあの子にもう一度、ここで会えるのかな。“約束”をしたのは“夜”の中ではなく“太陽”の下。
lines.translated: Will I ever be able to meet that girl here again? We made our "promise" not in the "Night," but beneath the "Sun."

lines.content: 今、私は“夜”の中にいて。
lines.translated: Right now, I am in the "Night."

lines.content: あの子は“太陽”の下の公園にいて。
lines.translated: And that girl is in the park beneath the "Sun."

lines.content: 互いに見えていないだけで、もしかすると隣にいるのかも……。
lines.translated: Maybe we're right next to each other, and we just can't see one another...

lines.content: ごめんね……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry..."

lines.content: 隣に。
lines.translated: Beside me.

lines.content: 誰もいない空白の隣に、私は手を伸ばしてみる。
lines.translated: I try reaching my hand out into the empty space beside me where no one is.

lines.content: 約束を守らなくて、ごめんなさい……
lines.translated: "I'm sorry for not keeping our promise..."

lines.content: あの子はずっと[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|気][・|持][・|ち]で、ひとりぼっちで、私のことを待っていてくれていたのかな。
lines.translated: Has that girl been waiting for me all alone, with these exact feelings, this whole time?

lines.content: ……そんな気がする。
lines.translated: I feel like she has.

lines.content: 長い、ながい間、私との“約束”を楽しみにしてくれていたのかな
lines.translated: "For a long, long time, I wonder if she was looking forward to our 'promise.'"

lines.content: ……やさしいあなたのことだから、きっと、そうだよね。
lines.translated: Knowing how kind you are, I'm sure that's true.

lines.content: だからこそ、と私は思う。
lines.translated: And that is precisely why, I think to myself.

lines.content: ……がんばって、がんばって、最後まで生きることが、“応援”してくれる人たちへの“ありがとう”の代わりになるのなら……
lines.translated: "...If doing my best, doing my best, and living until the very end can take the place of a 'thank you' to the people who 'cheered' for me..."

lines.content: いつまでだってここで、あの子のことを待ち続けること。
lines.translated: Then waiting here for that girl, for however long it takes.

lines.content: それがあの子への“ありがとう”と“ごめんなさい”の代わりにはならないだろうか。
lines.translated: Couldn't that take the place of my "thank you" and "I'm sorry" to her?

lines.content: 最終便が出る。
lines.translated: The last train is departing.

lines.content: “夜”の中に、汽笛と車輪と、出発進行の笛の音が響いている。
lines.translated: In the "Night," the sounds of the steam whistle, the wheels, and the departure whistle echo out.

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 時間だ。
lines.translated: It was time.

lines.content: 私の時間は本当に終わりのおわり。
lines.translated: My time has truly reached the very end of the end.

lines.content: ごめんなさい。私の愛しい息子。私たちのかわいい孫。そして、お義兄さん。大好きだよ。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. My beloved son. Our adorable granddaughter. And my brother-in-law. I love you all so much.

lines.content: あなた達がいつか“夜”にやって来ても。
lines.translated: Even if you all come to the "Night" someday.

lines.content: 私は、お母さんは……。
lines.translated: I, your mother...

lines.content: あなた達とはもう二度と、会えない
lines.translated: "I will never be able to meet any of you again."

lines.content: 身体が。
lines.translated: My body.

lines.content: ……心が。
lines.translated: My heart.

lines.content: 私に残された最後の時間が。
lines.translated: The final moments of time left to me.

lines.content: “夜”色に、染まっていくけれど……。
lines.translated: They are being dyed the color of the "Night," and yet...

lines.content: お友だちが、見上げた夜空から、落ちてきたよ
lines.translated: "My friend fell down from the night sky I was looking up at."

lines.content: もしかして“夢”の中で“夢”を見てるのかな。
lines.translated: Could I be dreaming a "dream" inside a "dream"?

lines.content: そう思ってしまうほど、最後に幸せな瞬間が待っていた。
lines.translated: Such a happy moment was waiting for me at the very end that it made me think so.

lines.content: それからふたりは“夜”の公園で話をした。
lines.translated: After that, the two of them talked in the park of the "Night."

lines.content: 十夜のお友だち。“悲しそうな顔をした女の子”
lines.translated: Toya's friend. "The girl with a sad-looking face."

lines.content: 泣かなかったよ
lines.translated: "I didn't cry."

lines.content: 小さく、ちいさく十夜のお友だちは十夜に言った。
lines.translated: Very softly, ever so softly, Toya's friend spoke to her.

lines.content: 叫びたい夜はたくさんあった。
lines.translated: There were so many nights I wanted to scream.

lines.content: 悲しいこともいっぱいあった。
lines.translated: There were so many sad things, too.

lines.content: さみしくつらいことだって、飽きもせずに次々とやって来る……息つく暇もまるでない私の時間、だったけど。
lines.translated: Lonely and painful things kept coming one after another without ever getting tired of it... My time gave me no room to even catch my breath, and yet.

lines.content: でもね。
lines.translated: But, you know.

lines.content: ……私、泣かなかったんだよ
lines.translated: "...I didn't cry."

lines.content: ねえ、どこかで見ていてくれたかな。私の大切なお友だち。
lines.translated: Hey, were you watching over me from somewhere? My precious friend.

lines.content: 本当はいつまでも一緒に、同じ時間を歩いて行きたかった、大好きな、大切な、お友だち。
lines.translated: My beloved, precious friend, who I really wanted to walk alongside through the same time together forever.

lines.content: どうかな。
lines.translated: I wonder.

lines.content: ……教えて。
lines.translated: Tell me.

lines.content: 私のがんばりは、無駄じゃなかった？
lines.translated: "Were my efforts not in vain?"

lines.content: 微笑みながら歩いて行けた、私の時間。
lines.translated: My time, which I managed to walk through with a smile.

lines.content: ……いつも応援してくれて“ありがとう”っていう、あなたへの私の想いは。
lines.translated: My feelings for you, wanting to say "thank you" for always cheering me on.

lines.content: 最後まで負けずにこうして歩いて来れたことで……。
lines.translated: By managing to walk all the way to the very end like this without giving in...

lines.content: あなたに、少しでも届いてくれたかな。
lines.translated: Did they reach you, even just a little bit?

lines.content: それがどうしても知りたかった。伝えたかった。
lines.translated: No matter what, I wanted to know that. I wanted to tell you.

lines.content: あなたにだけは、がんばったことを、どうしても知ってもらいたかったから……。
lines.translated: Because more than anyone else, I desperately wanted you to know that I did my best...

lines.content: ……がんばった
lines.translated: "...I did my best."

lines.content: ……私、がんばったんだよ
lines.translated: "...I did my best, you know."

lines.content: どんなにさみしくても、悲しくても、歩き続けることだけは止めなかったよ――
lines.translated: No matter how lonely or sad it got, the one thing I never stopped doing was walking forward--

lines.content: ……あなたが応援してくれたから、たくさん、いっぱい、がんばってこれたんだよ
lines.translated: "...Because you cheered me on, I was able to try so, so hard to make it this far."

lines.content: ――だから、もう、私。
lines.translated: --So now, I...

lines.content: 私ね。少しくらいなら、泣いてしまっても……いいよね。
lines.translated: Hey. If it's just a little bit, it's okay if I cry... right?

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……がんばったね
lines.translated: "...You did your best."

lines.content: あなたがいっぱいがんばってたこと、知ってるよ。お友だちがそう言ってくれる。
lines.translated: "I know how hard you tried." My friend says that to me.

lines.content: あなたがいっぱい、私の“応援”に応えてくれて……私のために、いっぱい、あなた達がたくさん、がんばってくれたこと……
lines.translated: "The fact that you answered my 'cheering' so much... and that for my sake, all of you tried so, so very hard..."

lines.content: きっと私に、届いてた
lines.translated: "It definitely reached me."

lines.content: 十夜はうなずく。そして、微笑む。
lines.translated: Toya nods. And then, she smiles.

lines.content: ありがとう。大切な、私のお友だち
lines.translated: "Thank you. My precious friend."

lines.content: たくさんたくさん、泣きたいのをがまんして……がんばって生きてくれて。
lines.translated: For holding back your tears so, so many times... and doing your best to live.

lines.content: ……幸せに生きてくれて、本当に、ありがとう
lines.translated: "...Thank you so much for living happily."

lines.content: きっとあなたががんばって生きてくれたから、私の小さな“魔法”は完成したんだね。
lines.translated: Surely it's because you did your best to live that my tiny "magic" was completed.

lines.content: それが私の、私たちの、誰にも負けないハッピーエンド。そうだよね？
lines.translated: "That is my--our--happy ending that loses to no one's. Right?"

lines.content: ……“さよならだけが人生だ”
lines.translated: "...'Farewells are all there is to life.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ぽつり、と。
lines.translated: A quiet murmur.

lines.content: 隣を歩く姫織が言葉をこぼし――我に返った俺は小首をかしげた。
lines.translated: Himeori, walking beside me, let those words slip out--and coming back to my senses, I tilted my head slightly.

lines.content: すると姫織は、何か弁明するみたいな苦笑いで、
lines.translated: Then Himeori gave a wry smile, as if trying to make an excuse for something.

lines.content: 遠いむかしのえらい誰かがそんなこと、言ってたよね。……確か。なんとなく思い出しちゃった
lines.translated: "Someone great from a long, long time ago said something like that, right? ...I think. I just remembered it for some reason."

lines.content: うん。そうだね
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 俺も聞いたことくらいはある。
lines.translated: I've at least heard the phrase before, too.

lines.content: 確か、友人との別れの際に歌われたものだったかな……たぶんね
lines.translated: "If I remember right, it was from a poem recited when parting with a friend... Probably."

lines.content: たぶん？
lines.translated: "Probably?"

lines.content: そう。たぶん
lines.translated: "Yeah. Probably."

lines.content: あまり俺に賢さを求められても困るから、曖昧にただうなずいた。
lines.translated: It'd be trouble if she expected too much intelligence from me, so I just nodded vaguely.

lines.content: 大雅
lines.translated: Taiga

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: さっきのはね。なんとなく頭に浮かんだ言葉だったけど
lines.translated: "What I just said, you know. Those words just popped into my head for some reason, though."

lines.content: ……十夜のこれまでの時間は、その[うた|詩]の通りに、友だちとの“さよなら”ばかりがあったのかな
lines.translated: "...I wonder if Toya's time up until now has been nothing but 'farewells' with her friends, just like that poem says."

lines.content: そうだね……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 人生には否が応でも別れがつきもの。
lines.translated: Partings are an inevitable part of life, whether we like it or not.

lines.content: だから……、
lines.translated: So...

lines.content: だから俺は、もう一度、背中に感じる小さな重さを意識する――……いつか。
lines.translated: That's why I once again become aware of the small weight I feel on my back--...Someday.

lines.content: （……いつか俺も、“夜”の中からいなくなるときが来る）
lines.translated: (...Someday, the time will come when I disappear from the "Night," too.)

lines.content: ずきり、と。
lines.translated: *Throb.*

lines.content: 自分の言葉に胸を刺されるような思いがあった。
lines.translated: It felt as though my own words had pierced my chest.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だち。これからどうなっちゃうのかな
lines.translated: "Toya's friend. What do you think will happen to her from now on?"

lines.content: ……このままだと
lines.translated: "...At this rate,"

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: “夜”の公園に佇むばかりの[影|存在]になってしまう
lines.translated: "She'll become an existence that does nothing but stand still in the park of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: “夜の国”にはそういう[・|存][・|在]が、“次”へと進むことなく“永遠”に住み続けている。
lines.translated: In the "Land of the Night," such existences continue to live on for "eternity" without moving on to the "next."

lines.content: 十夜と一緒に、“夜”に残された“悪夢のかけら”を掃除したときのことを思う。
lines.translated: I think back to the time I cleaned up the "fragments of nightmares" left behind in the "Night" together with Toya.

lines.content: 家々の暖かな明かりの中で、幸せだったのだろうときを、永遠に繰り返すようにして営む[影|存在]たちだ。
lines.translated: They are shadows that go about their lives inside the warm lights of their homes, forever repeating the times when they must have been happy.

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちも、一週間の猶予を過ぎてしまったら、あの[影|存在]と同じようになってしまう。
lines.translated: Once the one-week grace period passes, Toya's friend will end up just like those shadows, too.

lines.content: そういう“次”を選ぶ命のために、この“夜”は――“[・|死][・|者][・|の][・|国]”[・|と][・|も][・|呼][・|ば][・|れ][・|る]この場所は、あるのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Though I suppose it's for the sake of lives that choose that kind of "next" that this "Night"--this place also called the "Land of the Dead"--exists...

lines.content: （“夜”の公園にいつまでもひとり、佇み続けるだけの時間を、永遠に過ごしていくだなんて）
lines.translated: (To spend an eternity doing nothing but standing all alone in the park of the "Night" forever...)

lines.content: そんな彼女の姿は時おり何かの拍子で――光の屈折であったり、“夜”の作用に偶然が重なり、空間がひび割れでもして――“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”の中に、その姿を現すことがある。
lines.translated: Every now and then, by some chance--whether through the refraction of light, or a coincidence overlapping with the workings of the "Night," causing space to crack--her figure might appear within the "Time of the Sun."

lines.content: “半透明”
lines.translated: "Semi-transparent."

lines.content: 意思も思考も定まらない浮遊体。
lines.translated: A floating entity with no fixed will or thought.

lines.content: その姿を偶然に目撃した者はこぞってこう口にするだろう――……“幽霊を見た！”
lines.translated: Anyone who happens to witness that figure by chance would surely say the exact same thing--... "I saw a ghost!"

lines.content: そんな“次”はとても幸せだとは思えない。あくまでも、俺は。
lines.translated: I can't possibly think of that kind of "next" as happy. At least, I don't.

lines.content: 命はいつだって“次”へ向かわなければならないのだ。そういうふうに時間は流れる。
lines.translated: A life must always head toward the "next." That is how time flows.

lines.content: 終わってしまった命は、大切な人の“隣”に寄り添うという“次”も選ぶことはできるけど……。
lines.translated: A life that has ended can also choose a "next" where they stay close "beside" someone precious to them, though...

lines.content: そういう“切符”をあの巨大な駅で、相応の支払いのすえ、購入することも可能だけれど。
lines.translated: And it is possible to purchase that kind of "ticket" at that giant station, after paying the appropriate price.

lines.content: （でも、十夜のような“夜の住人”の“隣”には寄り添えない。そういった“次”は選べない）
lines.translated: (However, you can't stay close "beside" a "resident of the Night" like Toya. You can't choose that kind of "next.")

lines.content: それが“夜”の規則だ。
lines.translated: That is the rule of the "Night."
"So in the end, a life that has ended has no choice but to choose some kind of 'next.'"

lines.content: だからこそ、少し、思いついたことがあるんだ
lines.translated: "Which is precisely why I came up with a little idea."

lines.content: え？　思いついたこと……？
lines.translated: "Huh? An idea...?"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: 思いついたと言うよりは、思い出したことと言うほうが正しいだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Though rather than saying I came up with it, it'd probably be more accurate to say I remembered it...

lines.content: 最終の“夜”の便を乗り過ごしてしまった命は、この街の“夜”の中で永遠に彷徨い続ける――……だけど
lines.translated: "A life that misses the last train of the 'Night' will continue to wander forever within the 'Night' of this town--...However."

lines.content: うん。だけど……？
lines.translated: "Yeah. However...?"

lines.content: “夜”の世界に産まれ直すっていう選択もあるんじゃないかって。そう思ったんだ
lines.translated: "I thought that maybe there's also the choice to be reborn into the world of the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 産まれ直す……
lines.translated: "Be reborn..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: あの子も十夜と同じような“夜の住人”になる、という“次”も、命の選択肢の中にはあるんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Maybe becoming a 'resident of the Night' just like Toya is another 'next' among the choices available to a life."

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”でそれを選ぶことができる。
lines.translated: You can choose that at the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: “夜の怪物”になるのか。
lines.translated: Whether to become a "Monster of the Night."

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”になるのか。
lines.translated: Whether to become a "Magician of the Night."

lines.content: “夜の子猫”に、なるのか。それ以外の[・|何][・|か]になるのか。
lines.translated: Whether to become a "Kitten of the Night." Or whether to become something else.

lines.content: そういったすべてを、[・|支][・|払][・|え][・|る][・|も][・|の][・|に][・|応][・|じ][・|て]、あの駅では選ぶことができる
lines.translated: "At that station, you can choose from all of those things, depending on what you're able to pay."
Wait.

lines.content: 聞いたことがある。確か遠い昔だ。あさひさんから“夜の国”について語り聞かせてもらっていたとき、そういう話もあったはず……。
lines.translated: I've heard about it before. It was a long time ago, if I recall. Back when Asahi-san was telling me stories about the "Land of the Night," she must have mentioned something like that...

lines.content: あの頃はあまり自分の願望以外には興味が持てなかった。だから確かなこととして思い出せないけれど。
lines.translated: Back then, I couldn't really take an interest in anything other than my own desires. So I can't remember it with complete certainty.

lines.content: だけど[・|そ][・|れ]は、誰でもそうなれるというわけではなかったはず。
lines.translated: However, it shouldn't have been the case that just anyone could become that.

lines.content: 支払いだ。
lines.translated: It takes payment.

lines.content: 懸命に生き抜いたひとつの人生。
lines.translated: A single life lived out with everything one had.

lines.content: その過程で、魂に詰め込んだたくさんの感情。
lines.translated: The many emotions packed into the soul during that process.

lines.content: ……それらを元に換金できる金と銀の硬貨だ。
lines.translated: Gold and silver coins that are cashed in from those things.

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”になるという“切符”を購入できる――それだけの硬貨を手にできた命だけが、そうなれる。
lines.translated: Only a life that has managed to obtain enough coins to purchase the "ticket" to become a "Creature of the Night" can become one.

lines.content: ……“夜”に生きるモノたちには、それぞれ与えられる“役割”がある
lines.translated: "...Those who live in the 'Night' each have a 'role' given to them."

lines.content: “夜の住人”とまでは言えないこの俺にしても――“夜の魔法使い”から左手に“役割”を添えられている。
lines.translated: Even someone like me, who can't quite be called a "resident of the Night"--has had a "role" placed upon my left hand by a "Magician of the Night."

lines.content: あの子がどんな“夜のイキモノ”としての“次”を選ぶかどうかはわからない
lines.translated: "I don't know what kind of 'Creature of the Night' she would choose to be as her 'next,' or if she even would."

lines.content: そもそもそんなことを望むかどうかも。
lines.translated: Or whether she would even wish for something like that in the first place.

lines.content: ただ、提案してみるくらいはいいだろうと思う
lines.translated: "Still, I think it's fine to at least try suggesting it."

lines.content: もしも[・|そ][・|う]なれば、十夜とあの人は、ずっとお友だちのままでいられるのかもしれない。この“永遠”に続いていく“夜”の中で
lines.translated: "If that happens, maybe Toya and that person can stay friends forever. Within this 'Night' that continues on for 'eternity.'"

lines.content: 一週間の猶予を過ぎてしまった命にもそれが叶うのかどうかはわからない。だからどうにかならないか、俺たちの小さな神さまに――ナナちゃんにお願いしに行ってみようと思う
lines.translated: "I don't know if that can be granted to a life that has already passed the one-week grace period. So to see if something can be done, I'm thinking of going to ask our little god--Nana-chan."

lines.content: ……ナナちゃんに？
lines.translated: "...Nana-chan?"

lines.content: 姫織は首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head.
"...Can Nana-chan do something like that, too?"

lines.content: どうだろう。わからない
lines.translated: "Who knows. I don't know."

lines.content: ええ～……？　わかんないの？
lines.translated: "Eeeh~...? You don't know?"

lines.content: あ、ああ。ごめん。俺も“夜”についてそう多くを知ってるわけじゃないから……
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Sorry. It's not like I know all that much about the 'Night' myself..."

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: ナナちゃんは、“夜”に溢れる人間たちの“願い”を今も毎晩、集めて回っては、あの“駅”に届けてくれているんだよ
lines.translated: "Even now, Nana-chan goes around every night gathering the 'wishes' of the humans overflowing into the 'Night' and delivering them to that 'station.'"

lines.content: だからさ。俺のこんな“願い”も、“夜”の果てに届けてくれるかもしれないなと思って
lines.translated: "So, you know. I thought maybe she might deliver a 'wish' like mine to the far reaches of the 'Night,' too."

lines.content: それが今、俺の中に芽生えた身勝手な“希望”だよと俺は言った。
lines.translated: I told her that was the selfish "hope" that had sprouted within me just now.

lines.content: 姫織は“夜”の星空を見上げていた。
lines.translated: Himeori was looking up at the starry sky of the "Night."

lines.content: そしてため息をつくように『……大雅』と、言った。
lines.translated: And then, as if letting out a sigh, she said, "...Taiga."

lines.content: ……神さまはきっと、私たちにやさしくしてくれるよね
lines.translated: "...God will surely be kind to us, right?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ナナちゃんが、“ずっと十夜のお友だちでいたい”っていうあの女の人の思いを、叶えてくれるよね……？
lines.translated: "Nana-chan will grant that woman's wish to 'stay Toya's friend forever,' right...?"

lines.content: ……ああ。そうなればいいなって思ってるよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I'm hoping it turns out that way."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ナナちゃんとは今すぐ会いにいくのかな？
lines.translated: "Are you going to go see Nana-chan right away?"

lines.content: そう言う姫織に、俺は一度“ゆめのねどこ”に戻るよと、答える。
lines.translated: When Himeori asked that, I answered that I'd head back to the "Bed of Dreams" first.

lines.content: 神さまにお願いするには供物が――捧げ物が必要だからね。規則というよりはただのご機嫌取りだけど。だから、ありったけ持って行かないと
lines.translated: "To make a wish to a god, you need an offering--a tribute, after all. Though rather than a rule, it's just to butter her up. So I have to bring everything I've got."

lines.content: 捧げ物、とは……？
lines.translated: "What do you mean by a tribute...?"

lines.content: カップ麺
lines.translated: "Cup noodles."

lines.content: おおー。カップ麺
lines.translated: "Ooh. Cup noodles."

lines.content: じゅるりとする。
lines.translated: She slavered.

lines.content: お腹がぎゅるぎゅる鳴っちまうぜー
lines.translated: "That's gonna make my stomach growl like crazy~"

lines.content: それに、十夜もいるしね。今夜は疲れちゃっただろうから……
lines.translated: "Besides, Toya is with me too. She must be worn out tonight, so..."

lines.content: 背中で眠る十夜の身体を背負い直した。
lines.translated: I readjusted Toya's sleeping body on my back.

lines.content: カレー味が、いいよ……？
lines.translated: "Curry flavor is good, you know...?"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: そうなの？　と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Is it?" I replied.

lines.content: ナナちゃん、カレー味が好きだったっけ？
lines.translated: "Did Nana-chan like the curry flavor?"

lines.content: ううん。ひよりちゃんがね、今食べたいのがカレー味
lines.translated: "Nope. What Hiyori-chan wants to eat right now is the curry flavor."

lines.content: 得意そうな顔をしちゃってまあ
lines.translated: "Look at you, making such a smug face."

lines.content: 俺は微笑み、わかったよとうなずく。
lines.translated: I smiled and nodded, telling her I got it.

lines.content: 明日、ひよちゃんのお腹にもカレー味をお腹いっぱい、捧げましょう――
lines.translated: "Tomorrow, I shall offer plenty of curry flavor to fill Hiyo-chan's stomach, too--"

lines.content: わっほい、やった……っ、大雅大好きー
lines.translated: "Wahoo, yay...! I love you, Taiga~"

lines.content: ――ひよちゃんがちゃんと、今の約束覚えていたらね
lines.translated: "--Assuming Hiyo-chan properly remembers this promise, that is."

lines.content: ううううっ、意地悪、大雅の……ケチっ
lines.translated: "Uuuuugh, meanie. Taiga, you... cheapskate!"

lines.content: いーっと白い歯を見せる姫織だった。
lines.translated: Himeori bared her white teeth with a "grrr."

lines.content: 分かれ道にさしかかる。
lines.translated: We approached a fork in the road.

lines.content: 俺は左。
lines.translated: Left for me.

lines.content: 姫織は右。
lines.translated: Right for Himeori.

lines.content: 送っていこうか？
lines.translated: "Should I walk you back?"

lines.content: うーん。別にいいよ。ここまで来たらだいじょーぶ
lines.translated: "Hmm. It's fine, really. Now that we've come this far, I'll be okay."

lines.content: 姫織は首を振る。
lines.translated: Himeori shook her head.

lines.content: それにね、ナナちゃんは私の神社の境内にいるんだよ？　お供え物持ってくる前に会っちゃうよ？
lines.translated: "Besides, Nana-chan is on the grounds of my shrine, you know? You'll run into her before you can bring the offerings, won't you?"

lines.content: む。確かにそうだ
lines.translated: "Mm. That's certainly true."

lines.content: 姫織を起こしに走って行ったとき、境内に列車はなかった。
lines.translated: When I had run over to wake Himeori up, the train wasn't on the shrine grounds.

lines.content: おそらくナナちゃんはナナちゃんの“役割”を――この町の人々の願いを集めて周り、“駅”に届けるという“役割”に向かっていたのだろう。
lines.translated: Most likely, Nana-chan had been heading out to fulfill her own "role"--the "role" of going around collecting the wishes of the people in this town and delivering them to the "station."

lines.content: だけどもうそろそろ“夜”が明けるときが近くなっている。もう、帰ってきていてもおかしくはない。
lines.translated: However, it was getting close to the time when the "Night" would break into dawn. It wouldn't be strange if she had already come back by now.

lines.content: そうそう。だからお見送りは不要ですよ
lines.translated: "Right, right. So there's no need to see me off."

lines.content: 小さくうなずき、
lines.translated: She gave a small nod.

lines.content: ……大雅の“お願い”、上手くいくようにって祈ってるね
lines.translated: "...I'll be praying that your 'wish' goes well, Taiga."

lines.content: 姫織はぴょんと飛びはね、俺の前に立つ。
lines.translated: Himeori hopped up with a bounce and stood in front of me.

lines.content: でわでわ改めて……大雅。私は、こっちですので
lines.translated: "Well then, once again... Taiga. My way is over here, so."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ここまで送ってくれてありがとう。大雅。今夜の私は、大雅の“魔法”としてお役に立てたならすてきだなあって思うよ
lines.translated: "Thank you for walking me this far, Taiga. I think it'd be wonderful if I managed to be of use as your 'magic' tonight."

lines.content: 本当に、ここまでで大丈夫？
lines.translated: "Are you really okay going on from here?"

lines.content: 迷ったりしない？
lines.translated: "You won't get lost or anything?"

lines.content: と俺は問う。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: 大丈夫だよ～
lines.translated: "I'll be fine~"

lines.content: だってほら、もう神社に続く石段が見えている。ただあそこをまっすぐに登り切るだけだ。
lines.translated: Because look, the stone steps leading up to the shrine were already in sight. All she had to do was climb straight up them.

lines.content: 今夜のところはさよならだけども……また、明日。私と大雅は、また明日、会えるよね。“さよなら”なんかじゃまだまだないよね？
lines.translated: "It's goodbye for tonight, though... see you tomorrow. You and I will be able to meet again tomorrow, right, Taiga? It's nowhere near time for a real 'goodbye' yet, right?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろん
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: うなずき、答える。
lines.translated: I nod and answer.

lines.content: おやすみひよちゃん。今夜はほんとにありがとう。助かったよ。心から
lines.translated: "Goodnight, Hiyo-chan. Thank you so much for tonight. You really saved me. From the bottom of my heart."

lines.content: そ、そうですかあ～……。なんか素直にそう言われてしまうと、褒められ慣れていないひよりちゃんは照れてれしてしまいますなあ
lines.translated: "I-Is that so~...? Somehow, when you tell me that so honestly, Hiyori-chan, who isn't used to being praised, gets all embarrassed and bashful."

lines.content: 表情をへんにゃりさせて、姫織は俺に手を振り、駆けていった。
lines.translated: Her expression melting into a bashful grin, Himeori waved at me and ran off.

lines.content: もしも……っ
もしも境内でナナちゃんに会ったら、よろしく言っておいてねっ
lines.translated: "If you run into Nana-chan on the shrine grounds, tell her I said hi!"

lines.content: 振り向いた姫織にそれだけ伝え、俺は手を振り替えした。
lines.translated: Passing on just those words to Himeori as she looked back, I waved back at her.

lines.content: おうともさー
lines.translated: "You got it~!"

lines.content: 笑顔で、元気な声が帰ってきた。
lines.translated: With a smile, her energetic voice came bouncing back.

lines.content: 遠ざかっていく背中を俺は見送る。神社へと続く石段をのぼっていく。その姿を確認し、安心。俺も帰路につく。
lines.translated: I watched her retreating back as she went. She climbed the stone steps leading up to the shrine. Confirming that sight, I felt relieved. I set off on my way home as well.

lines.content: それから後日、俺は、カップ麺をいっぱいに詰め込んだ鞄を背負い、夜月神社の“夜”へと向かった。
lines.translated: Then, on a later day, I slung a bag packed full of cup noodles over my shoulder and headed into the "Night" of Yotsuki Shrine.

lines.content: なんだ。別に、遊びに来てくれたわけじゃないんだ
lines.translated: "Oh. So it's not like you came here to hang out with me."

lines.content: 十夜とお友だちが再会できてから、数日が経過した“夜”のことだった――[・|約][・|束][・|の][・|時][・|間]に夜月神社へやって来た俺を、そんな言葉が迎えてくれた。
lines.translated: It was a "Night" several days after Toya and her friend were able to reunite--when I arrived at Yotsuki Shrine at the promised time, those were the words that greeted me.

lines.content: しかし、自分がちょっと恥ずかしいことを口走ってしまったのに気づいたのか、
lines.translated: However, perhaps realizing that she had blurted out something a little embarrassing,

lines.content: ……カップ麺、美味しいの、持ってきてくれたわけじゃ……ないんだ
lines.translated: "...So it's not like... you brought me some delicious cup noodles, huh."

lines.content: 少し頬を赤くしながら唇を尖らせ、そう言い直す――小さな“夜の神さま”。ナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: With her cheeks flushing slightly, she pouted and rephrased it like that--the little "God of the Night." It was Nana-chan.

lines.content: “夜の国”の夜月神社。
lines.translated: Yotsuki Shrine in the "Land of the Night."

lines.content: その境内に止められた列車の屋根に腰掛けたナナちゃんを見上げ、俺は『おはよう』と言う。
lines.translated: Looking up at Nana-chan sitting on the roof of the train parked on the grounds, I said, "Good morning."

lines.content: この前のことはありがとう。助かったよ
lines.translated: "Thank you for the other day. You really helped me out."

lines.content: この前……
lines.translated: "The other day..."

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちだよ
lines.translated: "Toya's friend."

lines.content: ああ、あの子
lines.translated: "Oh, that girl."

lines.content: うん。あの人の命を“次”へ運んでくれた。十夜に変わってお礼を言うよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. You carried her life on to the 'next.' I'm thanking you on Toya's behalf."

lines.content: 改めてありがとうと伝える俺に、しかしナナちゃんは小さく首を振る。
lines.translated: As I thanked her once again, however, Nana-chan gave a small shake of her head.

lines.content: 違うよ。私は、あの子の命を“次”に送ったわけじゃない。あの子がどんな“次”を選ぶのか――そのための場所に、あの子を運んでいっただけ
lines.translated: "That's not it. I didn't send that girl's life on to the 'next.' What kind of 'next' she'll choose--I just carried her to the place for doing that."

lines.content: ……そこであの子がどういった“[道|次]”を選び、進むのか。すべてあの子次第だから
lines.translated: "...What kind of 'path' she chooses there, and how she moves forward. It's all up to her, after all."

lines.content: だから私は別に何もしてないとナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: "So I didn't really do anything," Nana-chan said.

lines.content: あの人は“夜の国”に産まれ直すという選択をした。
lines.translated: That person had made the choice to be reborn into the "Land of the Night."

lines.content: “[現実世界|太陽の時間]”を生きるための時間を使い切った命は、“夜”の中で、“次”はどういった[命|人生]に生まれ変わるのかを決められる。相応の支払いさえ叶えば。
lines.translated: A life that has used up its time for living in the "real world" can decide within the "Night" what kind of "life" to be reincarnated into "next." As long as they can make the appropriate payment.

lines.content: その選択肢の中には、“夜の国”の住人として――“夜のイキモノ”として産まれ直す、というものもある。
lines.translated: Among those choices, there is also the option to be reborn as a resident of the "Land of the Night"--as a "Creature of the Night."

lines.content: 生まれ変わる、ではなく、産まれ直す。
lines.translated: Not reincarnated, but reborn.

lines.content: 生まれ変わりは生前の記憶はないが、産まれ直しは生前の記憶を引き継ぐ。
lines.translated: Reincarnation leaves no memories of one's previous life, whereas rebirth carries those memories over.

lines.content: そのための支払いが可能なほど、あの人の心には様々な“[心|感情]”が溢れていた。
lines.translated: That person's heart had been overflowing with so many different "emotions" that she was able to make the payment required for it.

lines.content: 今、十夜のお友だちの命は、“刻の終着駅”で、どんな“次”を選ぶのか――[・|十][・|夜][・|と][・|ふ][・|た][・|り]で考えている。
lines.translated: Right now, at the "Terminal Station of Time," the life of Toya's friend was thinking about what kind of "next" to choose--just the two of them, together with Toya.

lines.content: あの子の命は、十夜とお友だちでい続けることを選んだけれど……。その[・|形]をどうするか。まだ選びきれずにいるみたい
lines.translated: "That girl's life chose to keep being friends with Toya, though... What to do about its form. It seems she still hasn't quite been able to choose."
"...Form?"

lines.content: 十夜と同じ“夜の子猫”になるのか。それとも、もっと違う別の“何か”になるか……そういう話
lines.translated: "Whether to become a 'Kitten of the Night' just like Toya. Or whether to become 'something' else entirely different... That sort of thing."

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”として生きるモノたちは、誰もがそれぞれ“役割”を持つ。
lines.translated: Those who live as "Creatures of the Night" each have their own "role."

lines.content: どういう“イキモノ”に産まれ直すかを選ぶということは、その“役割”をもまた選ぶということ。
lines.translated: Choosing what kind of "Creature" to be reborn as also means choosing that "role."

lines.content: 不自由なくやっていけそうな“[イキモノ|役割]”はどんなものだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of "role" would allow her to get by without any trouble?

lines.content: それをあの人は決めかねているから、お友だちの十夜といっぱい話して、選ぼうとしているみたいだった。
lines.translated: Since she was having a hard time deciding on that, it seemed she was talking it over a lot with her friend Toya as she tried to choose.

lines.content: それって、さ
lines.translated: "Say, about that..."

lines.content: うん、なに？
lines.translated: Yeah, what is it?

lines.content: ナナちゃんみたいな“夜の神さま”にもなれてしまうのかな
lines.translated: "Could someone even become a 'God of the Night' like you, Nana-chan?"

lines.content: そのための“切符”を買えてしまうものなのかな。
lines.translated: Is it possible to buy a "ticket" for something like that?

lines.content: どれだけの支払いが必要になるのかは、わからないけど……。俺たちも“神さま”になれちゃうのかな
lines.translated: "I don't know how much payment it would take, though... Could we become 'gods' too?"

lines.content: ……あのね大雅。私は“神さま”じゃないんだよって、もう、何度も言ってるけど
lines.translated: "...Listen, Taiga. I've already told you so many times that I'm not a 'god,' haven't I?"

lines.content: 大雅は何度言ってもわかんない子だなあ、もう……。ナナちゃんはため息を付く。
lines.translated: "You really are a boy who never gets it no matter how many times I tell you, geez..." Nana-chan let out a sigh.

lines.content: まあ、叶うんじゃないかな。きっと
lines.translated: "Well, I suppose it's possible. Surely."

lines.content: そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: ちょっと意外に思えた。
lines.translated: That seemed a little unexpected.

lines.content: 私くらいの“何か”にくらい、誰だって簡単になれちゃうよ――そしてもしも、そうなれば
lines.translated: "Anyone can easily become 'something' on my level--and if that ever happens,"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私は、そのときようやく引退できる。誰かが私の“役割”を引き継いでくれるならね
lines.translated: "I'll finally be able to retire then. Provided someone takes over my 'role,' that is."

lines.content: それで？　とナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: "So?" Nana-chan said.

lines.content: 大雅は今夜、何しにここに来たのかな
lines.translated: "What did you come here for tonight, Taiga?"

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: 今、何気に、ナナちゃんがとても大切なことを言っていたように思えたけれど……、
lines.translated: Just now, it felt like Nana-chan had casually said something very important, but...

lines.content: 姫織だよ
lines.translated: "It's Himeori."

lines.content: とりあえず、俺は答える。
lines.translated: For now, I answer her.

lines.content: 今夜、“夜”の中で迎えに来てほしいって姫織が言うから、来たんだけど……
lines.translated: "Himeori asked me to come pick her up inside the 'Night' tonight, so here I am, but..."

lines.content: 姫織が？　迎えに？
lines.translated: "Himeori did? To pick her up?"

lines.content: うん。そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: 少し前、姫織は俺がまだ“夜”に出入りできることを確認してきていた。
lines.translated: A little while ago, Himeori had checked with me to make sure I could still enter and leave the "Night."

lines.content: 今日の帰り道にもそういう話になり、だったらお願い、と姫織は俺に行ってきたのだ――今夜、私を“夜”の中から迎えに来てね？　この前の“夜”みたいに。
lines.translated: The topic came up again on the way home today, and Himeori asked me for a favor--telling me to come pick her up from inside the "Night" tonight, just like that other "Night."

lines.content: どうして？　って聞いてもさ、“ひみつー”とか言っちゃって。教えてくれなかったけど……
lines.translated: "Even when I asked her why, she just went 'It's a secreeet~' and wouldn't tell me, though..."

lines.content: なんだか俺にお願いするときの姫織の目は、いつもみたいにおどけてはいても、その奥に真剣な何かが見えたというか。
lines.translated: Still, when Himeori asked me for that favor, even though she was acting playful like usual, I felt like I could see something serious deep in her eyes.

lines.content: 本当になんとなくだけれど、[・|そ][・|れ][・|な][・|り][・|の][・|事][・|情]があるのではないかと、思えて……。
lines.translated: It was really just a vague hunch, but it made me think she might have her own *circumstances* for it...

lines.content: ……約束の時間は、お月さまが一番高い位置にのぼった頃に、という話だったんだけど
lines.translated: "...We promised to meet around the time the moon climbs to its highest point, though."

lines.content: 見上げた空はほんわり明るい。
lines.translated: Looking up, the sky is softly lit.

lines.content: 銀色の月だ。
lines.translated: A silver moon.
*So silver that it's practically pure white.*

lines.content: もう少しでお月さまは頭上高くに位置するだろう。約束の時間まではあと少し。
lines.translated: Before long, the moon will reach high overhead. Just a little longer until the promised time.

lines.content: ちょっと早く来過ぎちゃったかな。どうしよう。今からひよちゃん起こしたら、まだ寝てたかったのにー、とか言って怒られないかな
lines.translated: "Maybe I came a little too early. What should I do? If I wake Hiyo-chan up now, I wonder if she'll get mad at me and complain that she wanted to sleep longer."

lines.content: そんなこと私に言われても……わかんないよ
lines.translated: "Even if you ask me that... I wouldn't know."

lines.content: だよねえ
lines.translated: "Right, I guess not."

lines.content: さてどうしよう。ちょっと時間が余っちゃったなあ。
lines.translated: Now then, what should I do? I've got a little time to kill.

lines.content: あ
lines.translated: "Ah."

lines.content: え？　なに？
lines.translated: "Huh? What is it?"

lines.content: だったら時間まで私と色々お話ししてよう。うん。それがいいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Then let's talk about all sorts of things together until it's time. Yeah. I think that's a good idea."

lines.content: 急に目をきらきらさせはじめるナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's eyes suddenly start sparkling.

lines.content: 少し前のめりでさえある。
lines.translated: She's even leaning forward a little.

lines.content: 突然のその反応に、俺はちょっと驚いている。
lines.translated: Her sudden reaction takes me slightly by surprise.

lines.content: う、うーん。そうだね……
lines.translated: "U-Umm. Yeah, I guess..."

lines.content: 姫織がどういうわけで俺を呼んだのかわからないが――しかも、“夜”の側からだ。
lines.translated: I don't know why Himeori called me out here--and from the "Night's" side, at that.

lines.content: 何かそれなりに深刻な事情がありそうだなとは想像できるが、約束の時間が来るまで、ナナちゃんと話をして待っているくらい問題ないはずだ。
lines.translated: I can imagine there's probably a fairly serious reason behind it, but there shouldn't be any harm in chatting with Nana-chan while I wait for the promised time to come.

lines.content: だけどさ、ナナちゃん
lines.translated: "Still, Nana-chan..."

lines.content: なに？
lines.translated: "What?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんとお話ししながら、約束の時間まで待つのは――うん。楽しそうだなって、思う。だけどさ
lines.translated: "Waiting until the promised time while chatting with you--yeah, I think that sounds fun. It's just..."

lines.content: 若干、俺は今から卑屈なことを言おうとしている。
lines.translated: I'm about to say something a little self-deprecating.

lines.content: そんなとき、いつだって胸の辺りがきゅっとする。
lines.translated: Whenever I do that, my chest always tightens up a bit.

lines.content: 俺なんかと話してて、楽しい？
lines.translated: "Is it really fun talking with someone like me?"

lines.content: それがちょっと心配だなあと、おどけたふうにして言ってみる。
lines.translated: I try asking that in a joking tone, adding that I'm a little worried about it.

lines.content: んー……
ナナちゃんは首をかしげる。何か、考えているような仕草だった。
lines.translated: Nana-chan tilts her head. She looks like she's thinking about something.

lines.content: 楽しいよ
lines.translated: "It's fun."

lines.content: きっぱりと言われる。
lines.translated: She declared it flatly.

lines.content: そ、そっか
lines.translated: "I-I see."

lines.content: うん。そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. That's right."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは大きな両目をぱちぱちとさせ、言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan blinks her big eyes and answers.

lines.content: さっきはちょっと、恥ずかしいこと言っちゃったかなあって思ったけど……
lines.translated: "I thought maybe I said something a little embarrassing earlier, though..."

lines.content: さっき？
lines.translated: "Earlier?"

lines.content: ……遊びに来てくれたのか。とか。つい口走ってしまった
lines.translated: "...Asking if you came to hang out with me, and stuff. It just slipped out."

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: だけど……まあ、大雅相手だと平気だ
lines.translated: "Still... well, since it's you, Taiga, I don't mind."

lines.content: ……平気って？
lines.translated: "...Don't mind what?"

lines.content: 大雅とお話しできる“夜”は、私にとって数少ない楽しみのひとつなんだって……そいういうふうに素直に言えるよってことだよ。まあ、恥ずかしいって気持ちがないわけじゃないけど
lines.translated: "It means I can be honest and tell you that the 'Nights' I get to talk with you are one of the few things I look forward to. Well, it's not like I don't feel embarrassed at all, though."

lines.content: 小さなちいさな“夜の神さま”
lines.translated: A tiny, tiny "God of the Night."

lines.content: いつもは無口で無表情。
lines.translated: She's usually quiet and expressionless.

lines.content: あまり感情を表には出さないタイプ――……で、あるように見える。
lines.translated: She seems like the type who doesn't show much emotion on the surface.

lines.content: だけど慣れた人間相手になら、ナナちゃんはこんなふうにとっても素直だ。素直な顔を、見せてくれる。
lines.translated: Yet with people she's comfortable around, Nana-chan is wonderfully honest like this. She shows me her true face.

lines.content: だから、こんなふうにかわいい感じで対応されたら、思わず……思わずだ。抱きしめてしまいたくなるのも仕方がない。
lines.translated: So when she acts this cute with me, I can't help... I really can't help wanting to scoop her up in a hug.

lines.content: 小さな頭をいっぱい、たくさん、なでなでしたり……。
lines.translated: And patting her tiny head lots and lots...

lines.content: 不穏に揺れる俺の心内など察することなく、ナナちゃんはしかし、いつもの無表情の中に、
lines.translated: Completely oblivious to the restless thoughts stirring inside my head, Nana-chan manages the deft feat of letting a hint of apologeticness show through her usual blank expression.

lines.content: でもごめん。大雅
lines.translated: "Sorry, though, Taiga."

lines.content: と、少し申し訳なさそうな気持ちを浮かべるという、なんだか器用なものを見せていた。
lines.translated: She says, looking slightly regretful.

lines.content: ごめんって？
lines.translated: "Sorry for what?"

lines.content: ……この前の“夜”、大雅が持ってきてくれたカップ麺。あれ、もう全部食べちゃって。だから何も一緒に食べれるような物はないんだよ
lines.translated: "...Those cup noodles you brought me the other 'Night,' Taiga. I already ate them all. So I don't have anything for us to eat together."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはいつも話し相手にはお菓子とかお茶とか――カップ麺だとか。そういうものを出してくれる。
lines.translated: Nana-chan always serves snacks, tea, or cup noodles whenever she has company to talk to.

lines.content: 今夜はそういったものがひとつもないのだと、落ち込んだような表情を見せていた。
lines.translated: She looks a little down as she tells me she doesn't have a single thing like that tonight.

lines.content: え。もう、食べちゃったの？　結構な数を持ってきてたように思うんだけど……
lines.translated: "Huh? You ate them all already? I thought I brought a pretty big stash..."

lines.content: カップ麺はあればあるだけ……いくらでも、食べられる……ううん。いくらでも飲めちゃうんだ
lines.translated: "The more cup noodles there are... the more I can eat... No, wait. The more I can drink."

lines.content: ……お、おおー。そこの神社の子も同じようなこと、言ってたなあ。パフェは飲み物だって
lines.translated: "...O-Oh, wow. The girl from the shrine over there said something pretty similar, too. That parfaits are a drink."

lines.content: 肩をすくめて見せ、『でも、大丈夫』と俺は言う。
lines.translated: I gave a little shrug and said, "Don't worry, though."

lines.content: 大丈夫？　何が？
lines.translated: "Don't worry? About what?"

lines.content: ……ああ。今夜の俺は、姫織との約束を果たすため、ここに来たわけだけども
lines.translated: "...Well, I came here tonight to keep my promise with Himeori, you see."

lines.content: うん？
lines.translated: Hm?

lines.content: だけど見たまえ。小さなちいさな“夜の神さま”……。カップ麺もしっかり、いっぱい、持ってきたよ
lines.translated: "However, behold, oh tiny, tiny 'God of the Night'... I made sure to bring plenty of cup noodles along with me."

lines.content: 肩から提げた鞄を開き、ぎゅうぎゅうに詰め込んだ中身を見せた。
lines.translated: I opened the bag slung over my shoulder and showed her the contents packed tightly inside.

lines.content: お、おお～……っ
きらきら光るナナちゃんの大きな瞳。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's big eyes sparkled brightly.

lines.content: それはまるで、流れ星がたくさん流れては消えていく――そんな小さな夜の空を見上げているみたいだった。
lines.translated: Looking into them felt like gazing up at a miniature night sky filled with countless shooting stars streaking past and fading away.

lines.content: 大雅、すてき。大雅、最高。とってもとっても、愛してる……
lines.translated: "Taiga, you're wonderful. Taiga, you're the best. I love you so, so much..."

lines.content: うっとりするナナちゃんだ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan looked completely entranced.

lines.content: 一個数百円で“夜の神さま”の愛は買えてしまえるようだった。
lines.translated: Apparently, the love of the "God of the Night" could be bought for a few hundred yen a pop.

lines.content: まあとにかく中にお入りと言い、ナナちゃんは列車の屋根にすっと立つ。すると同時、客車の扉が音を立て、開いた。
lines.translated: Telling me to come on inside anyway, Nana-chan smoothly rose to her feet atop the train's roof. At that exact moment, the passenger car doors slid open with a clatter.

lines.content: 約束の時間まであと一時間くらいかな。
lines.translated: There's still about an hour left until our promised time, I guess.

lines.content: まっしろな月を見上げ、思う。それまでナナちゃんと過ごしてようか、と。
lines.translated: Looking up at the pure white moon, I figured I might as well hang out with Nana-chan until then.

lines.content: 開かれた扉から、車内へ乗り込もうとしたところで、
lines.translated: Just as I was about to step through the open doors and board the train...

lines.content: うわあ……
背後から、声。
lines.translated: A voice from behind.

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: 大雅がちっさな女の子、ナンパしちゃってる……。美味しそうなカップ麺で懐柔しようとしている。なんだかとってもえっちだよ
lines.translated: "Taiga is hitting on a tiny little girl... And trying to win her over with delicious-looking cup noodles. That's really, super perverted."

lines.content: ジト目の姫織がそこにいた。
lines.translated: Himeori was standing right there, staring at me with half-lidded eyes.

lines.content: ……違う。いや、えっちって。言いたいことはたくさん、いっぱい、いくらでも……あるけれども
lines.translated: "...You've got it wrong. Wait, 'perverted'? There are so, so many things I want to say to that, I don't even know where to start, but..."

lines.content: まあ、とりあえず……。
lines.translated: Well, for now...

lines.content: おはようひよちゃん。夢で会えたね
lines.translated: "Good morning, Hiyo-chan. Looks like we managed to meet in our dreams."

lines.content: だ、なんて。
lines.translated: Or something like that.

lines.content: 翌朝、目を覚ましてから恥ずか死んでしまいそうなせりふを、思わず口にしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Without thinking, I blurted out a line so cheesy I'd probably die of embarrassment upon waking up the next morning.

lines.content: こんばんはじゃなくて、おはようなの？
lines.translated: "Good morning? Not good evening?"

lines.content: 姫織は首をかしげていたりした。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head in confusion.

lines.content: とてとてと俺の隣に駆けてくる。
lines.translated: She came trotting right up to my side.

lines.content: まあ、うん。不思議なふしぎな“夜”の中だ。あいさつくらい、いつもと違う不思議なことになっちゃっても……まあ、不思議じゃないんじゃないかな？
lines.translated: "Well, yeah. We're inside a mysterious, wondrous 'Night.' So if even our greetings end up being a little strange and unusual... well, that's not really all that strange, is it?"

lines.content: へー……？　不思議がいっぱいだね……？
lines.translated: "Huh...? That's an awful lot of 'strange,' isn't it...?"

lines.content: 小首をかしげる姫織であった――……と。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head in puzzlement... Anyway.

lines.content: それはまあ、いいんだ。うん
lines.translated: "Well, never mind that. Yeah."

lines.content: 盛大に目的から脱線しまくってしまったが、姫織と無事にこうして会えた。これでようやく本題に入れるというもの。
lines.translated: We had gotten massively derailed from our purpose, but I had managed to meet up with Himeori safely like this. Now we could finally get down to business.

lines.content: それで？　ひよちゃん。約束通り“夜”の側から会いに来たけれど……
lines.translated: "So, Hiyo-chan? I came to meet you from the 'Night's' side just like I promised, but..."

lines.content: これから、どうするの？
lines.translated: What are we going to do from here?

lines.content: と、俺は問う。
lines.translated: I asked.

lines.content: 俺はさ、まだまだ心も身体もガキっぽいからね。だからこうして今でも“夜”の中に、あさひさんの“ゆめのねどこ”を通じて這入ることが叶うけれど……
lines.translated: "I'm still pretty childish in both mind and body, you know. That's why I'm still able to slip into the 'Night' like this through Asahi-san's 'Bed of Dreams,' but..."

lines.content: 叶うけど？
lines.translated: "You're able to, but?"

lines.content: うん。ひよちゃん。君は、違う
lines.translated: "Yeah. Hiyo-chan, you're different."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: だからさ、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "And so, Hiyo-chan..."

lines.content: 今夜あったこと、俺と違って、君は明日になったら、朝になったら、おそらくは全部忘れてしまうだろうけれど……。それでも、いいの？
lines.translated: "Unlike me, once tomorrow comes, once morning arrives, you're probably going to forget everything that happened tonight... Are you okay with that?"

lines.content: それが少々、気に掛かっていたんだ――そう伝えると、姫織はこっくりと、うなずく。
lines.translated: That had been weighing on my mind a little -- and when I told her so, Himeori gave a firm nod.

lines.content: うん。へーき。別に忘れてしまっても、忘れず覚えてしまっていても、どちらでも……問題ないの。今夜の出来事はね、結果さえあれば……それでいい話
lines.translated: "Yeah, I'm fine. Whether I forget it all or end up remembering, either way... it's not a problem. For what happens tonight, as long as the result stays... that's all that matters."

lines.content: ふーん？
lines.translated: "Hmm?"

lines.content: まだまだ見えてこないなあ。
lines.translated: I still couldn't quite see what she was getting at.

lines.content: それにね？
lines.translated: "And besides?"

lines.content: うん？　なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: 小首をかしげるような仕草で言う姫織に、俺もつい、つられて同じように首をかしげてしまった。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head slightly as she spoke, and I found myself mimicking the gesture without thinking.

lines.content: 今夜。“夜”の中でお願いしたいことがあるのはね……。実は、大雅にじゃないの
lines.translated: "The favor I want to ask inside the 'Night' tonight... isn't actually for you, Taiga."

lines.content: え？　そう、なの？
lines.translated: "Huh? It's not?"

lines.content: そう……。ごめんね？
lines.translated: "Yeah... Sorry about that, okay?"

lines.content: 怒らないでね大雅、と姫織は言う。
lines.translated: "Don't be mad, Taiga," Himeori added.

lines.content: ううん。怒らないよ。と俺は言う。
lines.translated: "Nope, I'm not mad," I replied.

lines.content: そんなことで怒ったりなんてしないさ――……だけど
lines.translated: "I wouldn't get angry over something like that... Though,"

lines.content: だけど？
lines.translated: "It's just?"

lines.content: ただ“どうして？”って気持ちにはなってるかな。用があったのは俺じゃない、か。もしも理由を教えてくれたらうれしいなって思うよ
lines.translated: "It does make me wonder 'why?', I guess. So your business wasn't with me, huh? I'd be happy if you could tell me the reason."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 大雅にはね、私のこと……私の心をね、“夜の国”の中で起こしてもらいたかったの
lines.translated: "What I wanted from you, Taiga, was to wake me... to wake my heart up inside the 'Land of Night'."

lines.content: そうじゃないと、もう自由に“夜の国”の中を出入りできなくなっちゃった私だから……
lines.translated: "Otherwise, since I can no longer freely come and go from the 'Land of Night' anymore..."

lines.content: うん。なるほど
lines.translated: "Right. I see."

lines.content: そこまではわかるよ。
lines.translated: I can follow that much.

lines.content: でも、不思議。ちゃんとひとりで起きられた
lines.translated: "But it's strange. I managed to wake up all by myself."

lines.content: にっこりとする姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori gave a sweet smile.

lines.content: ああ、確かに……。不思議だ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that really is... strange."

lines.content: 今夜は不思議がいっぱいな“夜”だなあ。
lines.translated: Tonight is a "Night" full of strange things.

lines.content: “夜の国”の中に、今も出入りできる大雅に、“今夜、迎えに来てほしい”ってお願いしたからなのかな？　起こしてもらわなくても、ちゃんとひとりで起きられたよ？
lines.translated: "Maybe it's because I asked you--someone who can still come and go from the 'Land of Night'--to come pick me up tonight? I managed to wake up all on my own without you even having to wake me!"

lines.content: ……うん。そういうこともあるかもしれないね
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That might just be it."

lines.content: うなずきながら、俺は左手を握りしめる。そこに付与された“役割”を思う。
lines.translated: Nodding, I clenched my left hand, thinking of the "role" that had been bestowed upon it.

lines.content: “夜”と現実とを繋ぐ手のひらだ。姫織の言うとおり、俺に声を掛けたことで、何かしら“夜”と繋がる理由があったのかもしれない。
lines.translated: A palm that connects the "Night" and reality. Just as Himeori said, reaching out to me might have given her some kind of reason to connect with the "Night".

lines.content: それが偶然であるにせよ、そうでないにせよ――とにかくだ。
lines.translated: Whether it was a coincidence or not--regardless.

lines.content: とにかく姫織は、その魂は、その“[命|夢]”は、“夜の国”で目を覚ました。
lines.translated: Regardless, Himeori--her soul, her "life," her "dream"--had awakened in the "Land of Night."

lines.content: ありがとう大雅。ちゃんと迎えに来てくれて。約束、守ってくれて
lines.translated: "Thank you, Taiga. For coming to pick me up. For keeping your promise."

lines.content: ぺこりとお行儀良く――いつものちょっとかわいい暴れん坊な感じの姫織には珍しく――殊勝な感じで頭を下げ、言った。
lines.translated: She bowed her head politely and earnestly--a rare sight for the usually cute, slightly rowdy Himeori--and spoke.

lines.content: 用があるのはね、あなたなの
lines.translated: "The one I have business with is you."

lines.content: 小さなちいさな“夜の神さま”……
lines.translated: "O tiny, tiny 'God of the Night'..."

lines.content: 姫織は、視線を上げる。
lines.translated: Himeori raised her gaze.

lines.content: あなたにお願いしたいことがあって……。それをあなたにこうして直接伝える、そのために
lines.translated: "There is a favor I want to ask of you... And in order to tell you directly like this,"

lines.content: 今宵の眩しい“夜”の中。大雅に、私の心を起こしてもらえたらって……思ったんだよ
lines.translated: "Inside tonight's dazzling 'Night,' I hoped... that Taiga could wake up my heart."

lines.content: ……[・|私]は旅をすることに決めた。
lines.translated: I decided to go on a journey.

lines.content: どうしてもだ。
lines.translated: No matter what it takes.

lines.content: どうしても、取り戻さなければならないものがある。
lines.translated: There is something I absolutely must take back.
My traveling companion is you.

lines.content: ……不思議なふしぎな“夜の国”
lines.translated: In this mysterious, wondrous "Land of Night."

lines.content: この場所でなら、私の失ったもののすべてを取り戻すことが出来る――
lines.translated: If it's in this place, I can reclaim everything I've lost--

lines.content: 今夜が最後のチャンスだ。
lines.translated: Tonight is my last chance.

lines.content: 大人になってしまう一歩手前な私の心が、この“夜”に目覚められるのは今夜が最後。そう感じる。
lines.translated: For my heart, standing just one step away from becoming an adult, tonight is the last time I'll be able to wake up in this "Night." I can feel it.

lines.content: だけどこの“夜”は、思い描けばただそれだけですべて願いを叶えてくれる、という都合の良い場所では決してない。
lines.translated: However, this "Night" is by no means a convenient place that grants every wish just by picturing it.

lines.content: 何かを得るのなら――取り戻したいと、願うのなら。相応の何かを支払わなければ、ならない。
lines.translated: If you want to gain something--if you wish to take something back--you must pay an equivalent price.

lines.content: それは“[夜|月]”だろうと“[昼|太陽]”だろうと、この世に生きるすべてのものに関する事情のひとつだ。
lines.translated: Whether under the "Night" and the "Moon," or the "Day" and the "Sun," that is a truth that applies to every living thing in this world.

lines.content: だから私は……。
lines.translated: And so I...

lines.content: ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.
In exchange for you.

lines.content: そうするしかもう、何も、方法はなくて……。
lines.translated: There was simply no other way left...

lines.content: 涙を堪え。
lines.translated: Holding back my tears.

lines.content: ずきずき痛むばかりの胸を抱き。
lines.translated: Clutching my endlessly throbbing chest.

lines.content: 誰だって泣きたいのは一緒なのだからと、前だけを見て……。
lines.translated: Telling myself that everyone wants to cry just the same, looking only forward...

lines.content: 進む。
lines.translated: I move forward.

lines.content: 進まなければ。
lines.translated: I must move forward.
Rubbing my empty stomach over and over again...

lines.content: 私は響く汽笛の音にただ耳を澄ませていた。
lines.translated: I simply listened closely to the echoing sound of the steam whistle.

lines.content: ……すごい。身体がなくてもお腹は空くのか
lines.translated: "...Amazing. So you still get hungry even without a physical body?"

lines.content: 走る列車の音にさえ負けないその音に、俺は目を丸くするばかり。
lines.translated: I could only stare in wide-eyed amazement at the sound, which wasn't even drowned out by the noise of the running train.

lines.content: え、えへへ。……みたい
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe... Looks like it."

lines.content: ちょっと恥ずかしそうにもじもじする姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori fidgeted, looking a little embarrassed.

lines.content: すっごい大きな音……しちゃった。ちゃんと寝る前にご飯いっぱい、食べたのに……不思議
lines.translated: "That was... super loud. Even though I ate a whole lot of dinner before going to bed... How strange."

lines.content: 何？　どうしたの、大雅？　私の顔に何かついてるの？
lines.translated: "What? What's wrong, Taiga? Is there something on my face?"

lines.content: ……いや。驚いてる
lines.translated: "...No. I'm just surprised."

lines.content: 驚くって……何を？
lines.translated: "Surprised... by what?"

lines.content: 君は本当に……本当に、俺の知ってる怪獣なのかい？
lines.translated: "Are you really... really the little monster I know?"

lines.content: 大丈夫？　平気なのか？　どこか痛いところとか……。つらいところとか、あるのか？
lines.translated: "Are you okay? Are you feeling alright? Does it hurt anywhere...? Are you in pain?"

lines.content: そう言いながら姫織の身体を（肉体はなく命そのものの形なのだが）――手を取ってまじまじ見たり、前髪を上げ、おでこに手を当て熱を見てみたり。順番に確認していった。
lines.translated: Saying that, I checked Himeori's body in order (though she didn't have a physical body, only the form of her life itself)--taking her hands to stare closely at them, lifting her bangs, and putting a hand to her forehead to check for a fever.

lines.content: そんな俺の手をちょっと鬱陶しそうに避けながら、
lines.translated: Dodging my hands as if she found it a bit annoying,

lines.content: え？　どういうこと……？　怪獣？
lines.translated: "Huh? What do you mean...? A monster?"

lines.content: 等と、姫織は言う。目をぱちぱちとさせながら。
lines.translated: Himeori asked, blinking her eyes rapidly.

lines.content: あ、ああ。だって……。だってさ、おかしいだろ？
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. Because... I mean, it's weird, isn't it?"

lines.content: そうだ。あんまりにも、おかしいんだ、こんなのは――俺はおろおろとしさえしながら、言う。
lines.translated: That's right. This is way too weird--I said, getting all flustered.

lines.content: なんだかいつもよりふつうっていうか。いつもよりずっと、ずっと、しおらしいって……いうか。そんなのひよちゃんらしくないって、いうか……
lines.translated: "Like, you're acting way more normal than usual. Or rather, way, way more modest and meek... It's just not like you at all, Hiyo-chan..."

lines.content: 姫織はむすっと目を細めた。
lines.translated: Himeori narrowed her eyes in a pout.

lines.content: ……私がしおらしかったら、大人しくしていたら、大雅は変に思うの？
lines.translated: "...If I act modest and behave myself, do you think that's weird, Taiga?"

lines.content: いや、まあ、えっと……。うん
lines.translated: "Well, I mean, uh... Yeah."

lines.content: 正直に、うなずいた。
lines.translated: I nodded honestly.

lines.content: だって、そうだろ？
lines.translated: "Because, come on, right?"

lines.content: 食欲の固まりみたいな子が……。いつも俺のご飯もおやつも、隙あらばすべて奪ってやろうと目を光らせてる子が……
lines.translated: "A girl who's practically a walking ball of appetite... A girl whose eyes are always gleaming for a chance to steal all my meals and snacks..."

lines.content: お腹が空いたから何か食べさせてと要求してくるでもなく、ただ、頬を赤くしてもじもじするだけだなんて……。こんな、ひどい話があるかよ
lines.translated: "For her to just blush and fidget instead of demanding I feed her something because she's hungry... How could anything be more tragic than this?"

lines.content: ……むぅ。なんだよ、それ。そんなこと言う大雅のほうがよっぽどひどいんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "...Mmph. What's that supposed to mean? You're the one being way more terrible for saying stuff like that, Taiga."

lines.content: そう不満を唱える姫織だって、おかしい。おかしいんだ。
lines.translated: Even the way Himeori voiced her complaints was weird. Just weird.

lines.content: いつもの言動行動は電波的なまでに壊滅的だ――とまでは言わずとも、元気いっぱいに空腹の奴隷――という具合が、姫織らしいと思ってしまっているこの俺なのだ。
lines.translated: I wouldn't go so far as to say her usual words and actions are catastrophically unhinged, but I've come to think of her being an energetic slave to her stomach as classic Himeori.

lines.content: だというのに、こんなのはごくごくふつうな反応では、ないか――ああ。
lines.translated: And yet, isn't this reaction completely and utterly normal? --Ah.

lines.content: ……なるほど
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: うなずく――ああ、そうかと。
lines.translated: I nodded--ah, I get it now.

lines.content: なるほど。恥じらいか
lines.translated: "I see. It's bashfulness."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ひよちゃんは恥じらいを覚えてしまったのか……、大人の女性として
lines.translated: "You've learned how to feel bashful, Hiyo-chan... as a mature woman."

lines.content: ……大人の？
lines.translated: "...Mature?"

lines.content: そうだ。ここ数日で……。俺の知らない間に、“魔性の女”から“奥ゆかしい大人の女性”にクラスをチェンジしてしまったんだな――ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "That's right. Over the past few days... without me even knowing, you changed classes from a 'femme fatale' to a 'modest, mature woman'--haven't you, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 確かに、大人だ。“夜”の中に這入ることができなくなるくらい――俺なんかよりも、ずっと。
lines.translated: She really is an adult. So much so that she can't even enter the "Night" anymore--way more of an adult than someone like me.

lines.content: う、うう。ひよちゃん。また俺を置いて、更に一歩、大人になってしまったんだな
lines.translated: "B-Boohoo. Hiyo-chan. You've left me behind again and taken another step toward adulthood, haven't you?"

lines.content: めそめそとそんなこと言う俺に、姫織は心底鬱陶しそうな顔をしていた。
lines.translated: As I fake-sobbed and said that, Himeori gave me a look of pure, unadulterated annoyance.

lines.content: だって……。今夜の私は、大雅たちに色々お願いしてるんだから……だからあんまり、いつもみたいに騒いでたら……いけないかなって
lines.translated: "Well, I mean... Tonight, I'm asking you guys for all sorts of favors... so I figured maybe I shouldn't... make a huge fuss like I usually do."

lines.content: もにょもにょとしながら、姫織はそんなことを言うのだ。
lines.translated: Himeori mumbled, fidgeting a bit.

lines.content: そしてそんな姫織に、
lines.translated: And looking at her like that,

lines.content: 何度でも、うそだろ、という顔をする俺でなのある。
lines.translated: I couldn't help pulling a "you've got to be kidding me" face all over again.

lines.content: もう！　だから何なのっ、その目っ、すっごいむかつくんだよ……っ
lines.translated: "Geez! What is with that look?! It's super annoying...!"

lines.content: 両手を振り上げ、いーっと白い歯を見せる。
lines.translated: She threw both hands up and bared her white teeth with a "grrr."

lines.content: これ以上、意地悪なこと言ったら噛みつくぞ！　と。歯をがじがじさせながら。
lines.translated: Champing her teeth together as if to say, "Say one more mean thing and I'll bite you!"

lines.content: ふたりとも……、何を騒いでるの
lines.translated: "You two... what are you making such a racket about?"

lines.content: やれやれとばかりにナナちゃんがやって来た。
lines.translated: Nana-chan walked over, looking exasperated.

lines.content: あなた達ふたりしか他に誰もいないからいいけれど……。もしも誰か乗ってきたら、もうちょっと静かにしておいてほしいな
lines.translated: "It's fine since you two are the only ones here, but... if anyone else gets on, I'd like you to keep it down a little."

lines.content: そう言うナナちゃんの手には、熱湯の詰まっているのだろうヤカンが握られている。
lines.translated: As she said that, Nana-chan was holding a kettle in her hand, presumably filled with boiling water.

lines.content: 大雅からもらったの、早速食べようと思って
lines.translated: "I thought we could go ahead and eat what Taiga gave us right away."

lines.content: そう言い、ヤカンを床に置く。肩に提げた鞄からカップ麺をみっつ、取り出した。
lines.translated: Saying that, she set the kettle on the floor and pulled three cups of instant noodles from the bag slung over her shoulder.

lines.content: ……眠いのも。お腹が空くのも。遊びたいのも。我慢してちゃだめだよ。それは身体だけじゃなくって、心が求めてるから[・|感][・|じ][・|る][・|こ][・|と]なんだからね
lines.translated: "...Whether you're sleepy, hungry, or want to play, you mustn't hold it in. You feel those things because it's not just your body, but your heart asking for them, you know."

lines.content: 食べたいときに食べる。眠りたいときに眠る。遊びたいときに、大いに、遊ぶ。
lines.translated: Eat when you want to eat. Sleep when you want to sleep. And when you want to play, play to your heart's content.

lines.content: そうでなければ健康には生きられないんだよ、きっと……。
lines.translated: Otherwise, you surely can't live a healthy life...

lines.content: そう言いながら、俺の隣の席に腰掛けたナナちゃんは、カップ麺を包んだフィルムをぺりぺりと剥ぐ。
lines.translated: Saying that as she sat down in the seat next to mine, Nana-chan peeled off the plastic film wrapping the cup noodles.

lines.content: ああ。このカップ麺、最近ハマってるんだ。ザ、最近のお気に入りセレクトって感じだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. I've been really into these cup noodles lately. You could call them my ultimate recent favorite pick."

lines.content: そうなの？
lines.translated: "You do?"

lines.content: うん。いわゆる家系ってやつでさ、ちょっと、いや、かなり濃い味なんだけど……それでも全然しつこくなくて。お腹にも全然、もたれないんだ
lines.translated: "Yep. They're what you call Iekei-style, so the flavor is a little--no, pretty rich... but even so, it's not too heavy at all. And it doesn't sit heavy in your stomach, either."

lines.content: 最近あまりにもハマっちゃってて。ひよちゃんほどではないけど、たくさん食べれる育ち盛りな男の子な俺は……いつも二個続けて食べちゃう。それくらい大好きで……
lines.translated: "I've been so hooked on them lately. Not quite as much as Hiyo-chan, of course, but as a growing boy with a big appetite... I always end up eating two in a row. That's how much I love them..."

lines.content: あさひさんの目を盗んではこっそり食べて、それがバレてしまい、
lines.translated: I'd sneak them behind Asahi-san's back, only to get caught,

lines.content: 『……大雅は、私のご飯よりカップ麺のほうが好きなんだな』
lines.translated: "'...So you like cup noodles better than my cooking, Taiga.'"

lines.content: と、あさひさんに本気で悲しそうにされてしまうこと、数度。
lines.translated: Which led to Asahi-san looking genuinely heartbroken on several occasions.

lines.content: ごめんなさい、あさひさん。本当に。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Asahi-san. Truly.

lines.content: 大好きです。あさひさんも、あさひさんの料理も。
lines.translated: I love you. Both you and your cooking, Asahi-san.

lines.content: だけど、やめられないんです。
lines.translated: However, I just can't stop.

lines.content: それほどハマってしまっている――……だから。
lines.translated: That's how hooked I am on them... So...

lines.content: ナナちゃんに絶対、食べてほしくて持ってきたんだけど……
lines.translated: "I brought them because I really wanted Nana-chan to try them, though..."

lines.content: 言いながら、ちらりと見る。
lines.translated: As I spoke, I shot a quick glance over.

lines.content: もちろん向かいの席に座る姫織をである。
lines.translated: At Himeori sitting in the seat across from us, of course.

lines.content: だー……っ
lines.translated: "Drool..."

lines.content: よだれだ。
lines.translated: She was drooling.

lines.content: 洪水である。
lines.translated: A literal flood.

lines.content: 目はしっかりと[獲物|それ]を捕らえていた――うん。
lines.translated: Her eyes were locked firmly onto her prey--yep.

lines.content: そうだ……っ
lines.translated: "That's it...!"

lines.content: グッと、俺は手を握りしめた。
lines.translated: I clenched my fist tightly.

lines.content: いいぞっ、安心した……っ。それでこそひよちゃんだ。大人の女性なんてくそ食らえだよな。色気より、食い気……だよな
lines.translated: "Nice, what a relief...! Now that's the Hiyo-chan I know. Screw being a mature woman, right? Appetite over sex appeal... right?"

lines.content: ……ぬぅ
lines.translated: "...Mmph."

lines.content: なぜか姫織は悔しそうに眉根を寄せていた。
lines.translated: For some reason, Himeori furrowed her brow in frustration.

lines.content: なんだよ大雅……。嫌いだよ、大雅
lines.translated: "What's your problem, Taiga...? I hate you, Taiga."

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: 私だって……何もかもひよこなサイズの私だって……いつか、せくしぃーな感じの、あだるちぃな感じの、大人の女性になるんだから……
lines.translated: "Even I... even someone who's chick-sized in every way like me... will someday grow into a sexy, adult-ish, mature woman..."

lines.content: そのとき泣きついてきても、ひよりちゃんは意地悪な大雅なんて知らんぷりだよ――……と。
lines.translated: And even if you come crying to me then, Hiyori-chan is going to completely ignore mean old Taiga--she added.

lines.content: 頬をぷりぷりさせて、三分後。
lines.translated: Puffing her cheeks out in anger, three minutes passed.

lines.content: 姫織は、用意されたカップ麺を[・|飲][・|み][・|込][・|ん][・|だ]。
lines.translated: Himeori swallowed the prepared cup noodles whole.

lines.content: 一口で、あるように……一瞬だったように、見えた。
lines.translated: As if in a single bite... it looked like it happened in an instant.

lines.content: ……うそだろ
lines.translated: "...You've got to be kidding me."

lines.content: 姫織のカップ麺は空っぽだった。[つゆ|汁]までも。
lines.translated: Himeori's cup of noodles was completely empty. Right down to the broth.

lines.content: 唖然とするばかりの俺である。
lines.translated: All I could do was stare in utter disbelief.

lines.content: いくら[・|こ][・|こ]が“夢”の中だからって……ファンタジーすぎる。あまりにも
lines.translated: "Even if we ARE inside a 'dream' right now... that's way too much of a fantasy. Way too much."

lines.content: カップ麺は……
lines.translated: "Cup noodles..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 飲み物で、ある
lines.translated: "...are a beverage."

lines.content: ……ひどい
lines.translated: "...This is awful."

lines.content: ナナちゃんの分も空になっていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's cup had been emptied, too.

lines.content: もっとちゃんと味わおうよ。ふたりとも
lines.translated: "Come on, savor your food properly. Both of you."

lines.content: まあ、味わい方は人それぞれだろうけれど。
lines.translated: Well, I suppose everyone has their own way of savoring things.

lines.content: さあ、本題に移ろうか
lines.translated: "Now then, let's get to the main topic."

lines.content: とりあえずお腹がふくれたところで、ナナちゃんが言う。
lines.translated: Now that our stomachs were full for the time being, Nana-chan spoke up.

lines.content: 姫織
lines.translated: Himeori

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: あなたにどんな理由があるにせよ、どんな事情が、あるにせよ……だよ。夜月姫織。“夜”の中を旅するのは今夜限り。それでいいのなら、力を貸すよ
lines.translated: "Whatever your reasons may be, and whatever circumstances you might have... Yotsuki Himeori. Traveling through the 'Night' ends tonight. If you're okay with that, I'll lend you my strength."

lines.content: あなたは今夜が最後だと感じるよ。ナナちゃんはそう言った。
lines.translated: I can feel that tonight is your last time. That's what Nana-chan said.

lines.content: 夜月姫織がこうして心だけでも、[・|自][・|由][・|自][・|在][・|に][・|歩][・|き][・|回][・|れ][・|る][・|形][・|で]、“夜”の中には入れるのは今夜が最後。
lines.translated: Tonight would be the last time Yotsuki Himeori could enter the "Night" like this, even just as a heart, in a form that allowed her to walk around freely.

lines.content: 姫織はそろそろ大人へと成長するのだ。
lines.translated: Himeori will soon grow into an adult.

lines.content: 今夜で最後……。
lines.translated: Tonight is the last time...

lines.content: そんな姫織が、ナナちゃんに直接伝えたお願いとは、以下の通りである。
lines.translated: And the favor that Himeori asked of Nana-chan directly was as follows.

lines.content: ……私には、取り戻したいものがある
lines.translated: "...There is something I want to get back."

lines.content: ナナちゃんの列車で出発する前のことだ。
lines.translated: This was before we departed on Nana-chan's train.

lines.content: 俺にではなくナナちゃんにこそお願いしたいことがある。そう言った姫織は、独りごちるようにして、続けた。
lines.translated: Saying she had a favor to ask of Nana-chan specifically, rather than me, Himeori continued as if speaking to herself.

lines.content: どうしても。どうしても……取り戻したい忘れ物が、“夜の国”の中に、あるの
lines.translated: "No matter what. No matter what... there is something I left behind in the 'Land of Night' that I want to get back."

lines.content: だけどその“忘れ物”は、広いひろい“夜の国”中に……その至る所に散らばってしまっている。
lines.translated: However, that "lost item" had been scattered all across the vast, wide "Land of Night"... in every corner of it.

lines.content: それをすべて取り戻すのは、私ひとりの力じゃ無理だから……。そのための方法も、まったく、思いつけない私だから
lines.translated: "Getting it all back is impossible by myself... And I can't think of a single way to do it on my own, either."

lines.content: だから、お願いします。ナナちゃん。小さなちいさな“夜の神さま”
lines.translated: "So please, I'm begging you, Nana-chan. Tiny, little 'God of the Night.'"

lines.content: ……私が“夜の国”に忘れてきてしまった大切な、大切な、“忘れ物”……。それを探し出すために、どうか力を貸してほしいです
lines.translated: "...The precious, precious 'lost item' that I left behind in the 'Land of Night'... Please lend me your strength so I can track it down."

lines.content: 夜月姫織の必ず取り戻したい“忘れ物”……。
lines.translated: The "lost item" that Yotsuki Himeori wanted to get back no matter what...

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はいったい何であるのか。
lines.translated: Just what on earth was it?

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]はいったい、“夜の国”のどこに散らばってしまっているのか。
lines.translated: And where on earth in the "Land of Night" had it been scattered?

lines.content: 不明な点も多いけど。
lines.translated: There were still plenty of unclear points.

lines.content: もっと詳しく聞かなければならないことも、当然、多いのだけれど……。
lines.translated: And naturally, there were plenty of things I needed to ask her about in greater detail, too...

lines.content: 珍しく……と言ってしまうと、また姫織は不服そうに頬を膨らませてしまうのだろうが……とにかく、姫織にしては珍しく、真剣な眼差しをしていたから……。
lines.translated: If I called it unusual... Himeori would probably puff her cheeks out in displeasure again... but anyway, she had a remarkably serious look in her eyes for her...

lines.content: ……なるほど。そっか。“忘れ物”
lines.translated: "...I see. Got it. A 'lost item.'"

lines.content: ……ナナちゃんは姫織のお願いに、深く、うなずくと……、
lines.translated: Nana-chan nodded deeply at Himeori's request...

lines.content: ……だめだよ
lines.translated: "...You mustn't."

lines.content: 囁くように、そう言った。
lines.translated: And spoke in a whisper.

lines.content: ……あまりにも漠然としすぎだよ。姫織
lines.translated: "...That is way too vague, Himeori."

lines.content: あなたの“忘れ物”はいったい何なの？　危険なものじゃない？　どうして、私になら力になれると思ったの？
lines.translated: "Just what is this 'lost item' of yours? Is it something dangerous? And why did you think I'd be able to help you?"

lines.content: ……そういういっぱいをちゃんと説明してくれないと……だめ。力になってあげられないよ
lines.translated: "...If you don't explain all those things properly... then no. I can't help you."

lines.content: ……だけど
lines.translated: "...However."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……だけどね、姫織。あなたがどうしてもそのわけを、事情を、話せないっていうのなら……ひとつだけ、条件があるよ
lines.translated: "...However, Himeori. If you're saying you absolutely cannot tell me the reason or the circumstances... then I have just one condition."

lines.content: え？　ひとつ？　条件……？
lines.translated: "Huh? One? A condition...?"

lines.content: うん。そうだよ
lines.translated: "Yep. That's right."

lines.content: これから私のことを“神さま”とか、そんなふうに呼ばないって約束してくれるなら……。いいよ。今夜限りではあるけれど、あなたに力を貸してあげられるよ
lines.translated: "If you promise not to call me 'God' or anything like that from now on... then okay. It'll only be for tonight, but I can lend you my strength."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは姫織に微笑みかけ、うなずき直してくれた。……この町の“夜の神さま”は、本当に俺たちに甘々だった。
lines.translated: Nana-chan smiled at Himeori and gave her a fresh nod. ...This town's "God of the Night" really was way too soft on us.

lines.content: ……ありがとう。ナナちゃん
lines.translated: "...Thank you, Nana-chan."

lines.content: 姫織もうなずく。眩しそうに目を細めて。
