lines.translated: Himeori nodded back, narrowing her eyes as if looking at something dazzling.

lines.content: だけどね、ナナちゃん。その[ありか|在処]も。その事情も。私、ちゃんと全部話せるよ……列車の中で、全部聞いてね
lines.translated: "Still, Nana-chan. Its whereabouts, and the circumstances behind it. I can tell you all of it properly... Please listen to everything once we're on the train."

lines.content: それから俺たちはすぐに出発した。
lines.translated: After that, we departed right away.

lines.content: 一晩という時間はあまりに短い。
lines.translated: A single night is far too short.

lines.content: 捜し物をするには尚更だろうから。
lines.translated: Especially when you're looking for something lost.

lines.content: ……私が、“夜の国”から取り戻したいものはね
lines.translated: "...What I want to get back from the 'Land of Night'..."

lines.content: 求められた説明を、姫織は走る列車に揺られながら言葉にしていった。
lines.translated: Rocked by the moving train, Himeori put the requested explanation into words.

lines.content: ……私の“忘れ物”はね。私の“夢”と、私の“希望”……だったもの
lines.translated: "...My 'lost item' is... what used to be my 'dream' and my 'hope.'"
"What USED to be?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうだよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's right."

lines.content: うなずき、姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded and spoke.

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]は私にとって、とても大切なものだった――……とても。とっても
lines.translated: "It was something very precious to me--...Very. Very much so."

lines.content: だけど今はもう、“大切だったんだ”って気持ちしか、思い出せないの
lines.translated: "But now, the only thing I can remember is the feeling that it used to be precious to me."

lines.content: 姫織は苦笑いを浮かべた。
lines.translated: Himeori gave a bitter smile.

lines.content: ……私は、私のなくしてしまったものを全部、取り戻したい
lines.translated: "...I want to get back everything I lost."

lines.content: そうでなければ、きっと私はこれから先の人生を、どんなふうに生きていけばいいのかもわからない
lines.translated: "Otherwise, I'm sure I won't even know how I'm supposed to live the rest of my life from here on out."

lines.content: ……“夢”も“希望”も、“夜の国”に忘れてきてしまった私だから。だから私は、迷子なの。人生に、迷子。いつまでも、ずっと
lines.translated: "...Because I left both my 'dream' and my 'hope' behind in the 'Land of Night.' That's why I'm lost. Lost in life. Forever and always."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは、ぽつりぽつりと言う姫織のことを、言葉もなく、ただじっと見つめていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan simply stared intently at Himeori without a word as she spoke haltingly, bit by bit.

lines.content: ……十年前の“夜”の中。
lines.translated: In the "Night" ten years ago.

lines.content: 姫織は叶えたい“夢”を握りしめ、“少女たちの戦い”に参加した。
lines.translated: Clinging tightly to a "dream" she wanted to fulfill, Himeori participated in the "girls' battle."

lines.content: そしてその“戦争”に勝利をすることで、叶えがたいと思われた“夢”を叶えるための“[希望|魔法]”を得たはずだ。
lines.translated: And by winning that "war," she should have obtained the "hope"--the magic--to grant a "dream" thought to be nearly impossible to fulfill.

lines.content: その様子を間近で見つめていたこの俺は……。
lines.translated: Having watched it all unfold up close, I...

lines.content: そこまでの少女たちの物語については、誰よりもしっかり理解できているつもりだ。
lines.translated: I believe I understand the girls' stories up to that point better than anyone else.

lines.content: しかし姫織がどのような困難な“夢”を抱き、そしてそれを叶えるために必要であろう強力な“[希望|魔法]”を得たのかは――わからない。
lines.translated: However, I have no idea what kind of difficult "dream" Himeori held, nor what powerful "hope"--what magic--she obtained to fulfill it.

lines.content: それは姫織だけではなく、ハルや千和、そして智仁[・|た][・|ち]についても同様だ。
lines.translated: And that doesn't just apply to Himeori; it's the same for Haru, Chiwa, and even Tomohito and the others.

lines.content: 俺たち幼馴染みは、確かに代えがたい“仲間”であり、何でもない時間を笑い合えるような“友人”になれたことは、間違いないだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: As childhood friends, there's no doubt we became irreplaceable "companions" and "friends" who could laugh together over nothing at all, but...

lines.content: だからといって、すべてを語り合い、慰め合うような関係でもないこともまた事実なのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, it's also a fact that our relationship isn't one where we share everything and comfort one another.

lines.content: 『忘れちゃだめだぞ。大雅。“関係性”こそが“魔法”の鍵となるんだ』
lines.translated: "Don't forget, Taiga. 'Relationships' are the very key to 'magic.'"

lines.content: 俺は、手のひらを見つめる。“夜”を付与された左手だ。
lines.translated: I stare down at my palm. My left hand, granted the "Night."

lines.content: もし、姫織と今以上の関係に……。
lines.translated: If I could build a deeper relationship with Himeori than what we have now...

lines.content: 互いの“夢”や人生の目標だとか、抱え込んでしまっている事情だとかを語り合えるような。そんな関係になれたなら。
lines.translated: One where we could talk about our "dreams," our goals in life, and the circumstances we're keeping bottled up inside. If we could become like that...

lines.content: 俺は、俺のこの左手は、姫織の忘れてしまった“夢”や“希望”を、その記憶を、取り戻してあげることができるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Would I--would this left hand of mine--be able to recover the "dream" and "hope" Himeori forgot, along with her memories of them?

lines.content: そんなことを考えながら、姫織の言葉に俺は耳を傾けていた。
lines.translated: Pondering such things, I listened closely to Himeori's words.
I told a lie.

lines.content: 本当は“夢”も“希望”もちゃんと、しっかり、私は忘れず覚えていたのだ。
lines.translated: In truth, I hadn't forgotten my "dream" or my "hope" at all. I remembered them clearly,vividly.

lines.content: でもそれを正直に話してしまえば、列車の主は私に力を貸してくれないだろう。
lines.translated: But if I were to speak of them honestly, the master of the train would never lend me her strength.

lines.content: 私の“夢”は誰にも理解されないし、私の“希望”は、きっと、誰にも憎まれてしまうだろうはずのもの。
lines.translated: No one would ever understand my "dream," and my "hope" is surely something that everyone would despise.

lines.content: そんな予感があったから、私は騙してしまった――私のことを信頼してくれた、小さな“夜の神さま”を。
lines.translated: Because I had that premonition, I deceived her--the little "God of the Night" who placed her trust in me.

lines.content: 旅に出ようと思った事情。
lines.translated: My reasons for wanting to set out on this journey.

lines.content: 何でもいいから[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら][・|し][・|い]ことを話しておかなければ、後々からきっと[こじ|拗]れてしまうだろう。そう思ったから[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら][・|し][・|く]でっち上げた。
lines.translated: I figured things would surely get complicated later on if I didn't come up with some plausible-sounding story, whatever it might be. So I concocted a convincing lie.

lines.content: [・|あ][・|な][・|た]も私を信じてくれた。
lines.translated: You trusted me, too.

lines.content: ……私は、そんな[・|あ][・|な][・|た]のことを道連れにしようとしている。
lines.translated: And now, I'm trying to drag you down with me.

lines.content: 自分の“忘れ物”を取り戻すために。
lines.translated: In order to take back my "lost item."

lines.content: ……自分の“夢”を、叶えるために。
lines.translated: In order to make my "dream" come true.

lines.content: 私は、あなたの[・|命]を喰いものにしようと、している。
lines.translated: I am trying to prey upon your very life.

lines.content: ごめん。ごめんね。……ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. ...Forgive me.

lines.content: 大切だったものを取り戻すには……もう、これ以上、何も方法がないの。
lines.translated: To get back what was precious to me... there is no other way left anymore.

lines.content: ――今、逃げ出してしまったなら、私はきっと人生の最期で“後悔”するだろう。
lines.translated: --If I were to run away now, I would surely "regret" it at the very end of my life.

lines.content: 何度となく蘇るそんな思いに、私は唇を噛みしめてばかりいた。
lines.translated: As those thoughts resurfaced time and time again, all I could do was bite my lip.

lines.content: そんな私の気持ちなど何も知らないあなたは、いつものやさしい顔のまま、私の隣で列車に揺られてる。
lines.translated: Completely unaware of how I feel, you sit beside me with your usual gentle expression, swaying with the motion of the train.

lines.content: これから先、どんなことが待ち受けているのかも知らず……。
lines.translated: Not knowing what lies in wait for us ahead...

lines.content: そんなあなたのやさしい気持ちから逃げ出すみたいに、私は、ポケットから取り出した“[・|夜][・|の][・|地][・|図]”を広げ、列車の主に告げた。
lines.translated: As if running away from your gentle feelings, I unfolded the "Map of the Night" I had taken from my pocket and spoke to the master of the train.

lines.content: 次は、ここ。
lines.translated: Next is right here.

lines.content: ここに私の“忘れ物”がひとつ、隠れてるんだよ。
lines.translated: One of my "lost items" is hidden here.

lines.content: ――制限時間は今夜、一晩限りだ。
lines.translated: --The time limit is tonight, and tonight only.

lines.content: それは決してナナちゃんが意地悪してそうなってしまっているわけでは、当然ない。
lines.translated: Of course, that certainly wasn't because Nana-chan was being mean to us.

lines.content: 今夜限り。そう言ってしまうと、ちょっと冷たいようだけど……姫織
lines.translated: "Tonight only. Putting it like that might sound a little cold, Himeori, but..."

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: あなたの心を“夜”の中につなぎ止めておけるのは、もう殆ど限界なんだと私は感じるよ
lines.translated: "I can feel that your ability to keep your heart tethered to the 'Night' is almost at its absolute limit."

lines.content: あなたは、かなりの部分が“夜の国”から遠く離れて……。“大人の世界”へ一歩、踏み出してしまってる
lines.translated: "A huge part of you has already drifted far away from the 'Land of Night'... You've taken a step out into the 'adult world.'"

lines.content: ナナちゃんは俺にふと微笑みかけ、
lines.translated: Nana-chan suddenly smiled at me.

lines.content: 女の子は男の子より、たいていの場合だけれど、成長が早いものだからね。あっという間だよ。大人になってしまうのは
lines.translated: "Girls usually grow up faster than boys, after all. It happens in the blink of an eye--becoming an adult."

lines.content: だから“忘れ物”を探し出すための“夜間鉄道”のその旅は、今夜限りなのだと思っておいたほうがいいだろうとナナちゃんは言うのだ。
lines.translated: That's why Nana-chan said we should consider this journey on the "Night Train" to find her "lost item" to be for tonight only.

lines.content: 姫織。あなたはこうして“夜”に心を持ち込むことさえ、そろそろ限界なんだよ。だからね、今この瞬間に、姫織は“夜”の中から遮断されてしまう――だ、なんて
lines.translated: "Himeori. Even bringing your heart into the 'Night' like this is just about at its limit. So, you see, you could be cut off from the 'Night' at this very moment--"

lines.content: そういう可能性だってあり得てしまうんだよ。残念なことに
lines.translated: "Unfortunately, that's a very real possibility."

lines.content: ……そうだ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 残念なことに、私たちは“さよなら”がもう近い。太陽も月も。本来なら、決して相容れないものだから
lines.translated: "Sadly, the time for us to say 'goodbye' is drawing near. Because the sun and the moon are, by nature, things that can never coexist."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが囁くみたいにしてそう言うと、
lines.translated: When Nana-chan said that in a near-whisper,

lines.content: 姫織は、“夜”の景色が流れ行く車窓を見つめ、
lines.translated: Himeori gazed out the train window at the passing scenery of the "Night,"

lines.content: ……制限時間は、今夜限り
lines.translated: "...The time limit is tonight only."

lines.content: 改めるようにして、そうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: She murmured, as if reaffirming it to herself.

lines.content: がたんと列車が大きく弾む。
lines.translated: With a loud clack, the train bounced heavily.

lines.content: ……突風が吹いたみたいだ。
lines.translated: It felt like a sudden gust of wind had blown against us.

lines.content: 窓が一斉にバタンと揺れた。
lines.translated: All the windows rattled loudly at once.

lines.content: ……私の“忘れ物”がある場所
lines.translated: "...The places where my 'lost items' are."

lines.content: 姫織はそこで、制服のポケットから地図をひとつ取り出し、広げた。
lines.translated: With that, Himeori took a map out of her uniform pocket and unfolded it.

lines.content: ……どうやら眠る前、身につけている服のポケットなどに忍ばせたものは、“夜”の中へ持ち込めるらしい。
lines.translated: Apparently, anything you slip into the pockets of the clothes you're wearing before going to sleep can be brought into the "Night."

lines.content: そんな“夜”の規則を、姫織がまだ覚えていたことがちょっとだけ意外だった。
lines.translated: I was a little surprised that Himeori still remembered that rule of the "Night."

lines.content: これを頼りに進んでもらえれば……、どうかな。ナナちゃん。今夜限りの制限時間内に、すべて見つけられる？
lines.translated: "If we use this as a guide to move forward... what do you think, Nana-chan? Can we find all of them within tonight's time limit?"

lines.content: これって……
lines.translated: "This is..."

lines.content: 覗き込んだ地図には赤いクレヨンのような塗料で、バッテンマークがいくつも記されていた――そして、一言。“惑星のかけらを探しに行こう！”そんな一言が添えられていた。
lines.translated: Peering at the map, I saw several X-marks drawn in something like red crayon--along with a single note. "Let's go look for the fragments of a planet!" was written on it.

lines.content: ナナちゃんがまじまじと、姫織の膝の上に開かれた地図を見つめている。
lines.translated: Nana-chan stared intently at the map spread open on Himeori's lap.

lines.content: ……このマークがしてあるところに、ひよちゃんの忘れ物はある感じ、なのかな？
lines.translated: "...So Hiyo-chan's lost items are at the places with these marks, I take it?"

lines.content: 俺がそう問いかけると、
lines.translated: When I asked that,

lines.content: うん。たぶん
lines.translated: "Yeah. Probably."

lines.content: 姫織は、うなずく。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded.

lines.content: これ、どうしたの？　“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”？
lines.translated: "What's the story behind this? 'Fragments of a star'?"

lines.content: 続いてそう問いかけると、姫織は目をぱちぱちとさせながら、応える。
lines.translated: When I followed up with that question, Himeori blinked several times before answering.

lines.content: ……きっと、いつかの私が印を付けて隠しておいたんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "...I'm sure my past self marked this map and hid it away."

lines.content: 未来の私が“忘れ物”のこと、忘れちゃうんだってわかってたから……。だから、いつかの私が、今の私に、残してくれたんじゃないかって……
lines.translated: "Because she knew the future me would forget all about my 'lost items'... So I think my past self left it behind for the me of today..."

lines.content: 姫織はつい先日、この地図を見つけたばかりなのだと言った。
lines.translated: Himeori said she had only just found this map the other day.

lines.content: 家の神社の巫女服がこの春、新しくなり……。
lines.translated: The shrine maiden outfits at her family's shrine had been replaced with new ones this spring...

lines.content: それと同時に、古い巫女服を押し入れの中に詰め込んでいくその中で、古い日記帳が出てきて……。
lines.translated: And while she was packing the old shrine maiden outfits away into the closet, an old diary had tumbled out...

lines.content: その日記帳にね、しおりを挟むみたいに、この地図が入っていたの……
lines.translated: "This map was tucked inside that diary, almost like a bookmark..."

lines.content: 開いた日記帳は殆ど真っ白だった。
lines.translated: When she opened the diary, the pages were almost entirely blank.
Yes, *almost* entirely.

lines.content: 地図の挟まれていたページに、“私のなくした夢と希望”と書かれていた。
lines.translated: On the page where the map had been wedged, the words "My lost dream and hope" were written.

lines.content: その一文を見た瞬間、姫織は思い出したのだという――私には大切なものがあったはずだ、と。
lines.translated: The moment she saw that single sentence, Himeori said it came back to her--the realization that she used to have something precious.

lines.content: ……私には取り戻さなければいけないものが、あったはず。今まで“夢”も“希望”も、私にはなんにもないって思っていたけど……
lines.translated: "...There must have been something I needed to get back. Until now, I thought I didn't have a 'dream' or 'hope' or anything at all, but..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ううん。そんなことはなかった。私は[・|そ][・|れ]を、今までずっと……忘れてしまっていた
lines.translated: "No. That wasn't true. I had just... completely forgotten about *it* all this time."

lines.content: しかし思い出せたのはたったそれだけ。
lines.translated: However, that was the only thing she could remember.

lines.content: それ以上のことは何も、何も……思い出せないままだと姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said she still couldn't recall anything, anything at all beyond that.

lines.content: だからいても立っても、いられなくなっちゃって……
lines.translated: "That's why I just couldn't sit still anymore..."

lines.content: 予感があったのだと姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said she'd had a premonition.

lines.content: 私、身体を“夜の国”に持ち込めなくなって、もう結構経つから
lines.translated: "It's already been quite a while since I stopped being able to bring my physical body into the 'Land of Night.'"

lines.content: だから急がないと……ナナちゃんが言うみたいに、こうしてなんとか目を覚ました心も、“夜の国”から閉め出されちゃうんじゃないかって
lines.translated: "So I was worried that if I didn't hurry... just like Nana-chan said, even my heart, which I finally managed to wake up like this, would get locked out of the 'Land of Night' too."

lines.content: そうなればもう、なくしたものを取り戻すことなんて不可能だ――不可能だと、思えてしまったから。
lines.translated: Because she felt that if that happened, getting back what she had lost would become impossible--utterly impossible.

lines.content: だから急いで、姫織は自分のことを“夜の国”で起こしてくれないかと、俺に願った。
lines.translated: That was why Himeori had urgently wished for me to wake her up in the "Land of Night."

lines.content: なるほど
lines.translated: "I see."

lines.content: 姫織の事情を一通り聞いた俺は、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Having heard the full story of Himeori's circumstances, I nodded.

lines.content: ひよちゃんのなくしたもの。ひよちゃんの“忘れ物”……。こうして“夜”の中にいても、やっぱり全然、思い出せない？　覚えていない？
lines.translated: "What Hiyo-chan lost. Hiyo-chan's 'lost item'... Even being inside the 'Night' like this, can you still not recall it at all? Do you really not remember?"

lines.content: ……うん。思い出せない。覚えて、いない
lines.translated: "...Yeah. I can't recall it. I don't... remember."

lines.content: ふるふると姫織は首を振る。
lines.translated: Himeori slowly shook her head.

lines.content: 私も期待はしていたよ。たぶん、“忘れ物”は“夜の国”についてのことだから……。だからね、“夜”の中で大雅に起こしてもらったら、私は忘れたものを思い出せるかもって
lines.translated: "I had my hopes up, too. Since my 'lost item' is probably related to the 'Land of Night'... I figured that if I had you wake me up inside the 'Night,' Taiga, I might be able to remember what I forgot."

lines.content: だけどそうはならなかった。
lines.translated: Yet that wasn't how it turned out.

lines.content: ……“夜”の中でも。そうじゃなくても。もう昔々のことは、私、殆ど思い出せないから
lines.translated: "...Whether I'm in the 'Night' or not, I can barely remember anything from a long, long time ago anymore."

lines.content: 十年前。みんなと“戦った”あの“夜”のことも。殆ど全部……思い出せない
lines.translated: "Even that 'Night' ten years ago, when I 'fought' alongside everyone. I can't remember... almost any of it."

lines.content: ……そっか
lines.translated: "...I see."

lines.content: それはとてもさみしいことだなと俺は思ってしまう――人間は記憶を重ねて生きていくからこそ、心が育つ。自身の命の価値を見いだせたような、そんな気持ちにもなれるのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: I couldn't help thinking how terribly lonely that must be--it's precisely because human beings live on while accumulating memories that their hearts grow. Isn't that what allows us to feel like we've found the value in our own lives?

lines.content: だというのに、その[時間|過去]を思い出せないだなんて……。
lines.translated: And yet, to not be able to remember that past...

lines.content: ふと、思ってしまう。
lines.translated: A thought suddenly crossed my mind.

lines.content: 自分の過去を姫織みたいに忘却してしまうのと。
lines.translated: To completely forget your own past like Himeori.

lines.content: 自分の過去を憎み、なかったこととしてしまいたいと願うのと……。
lines.translated: Or to despise your own past, wishing you could erase it as if it never happened...

lines.content: いったいどちらが、[・|不][・|幸]なのだろうかと。
lines.translated: Just which of the two is more *unfortunate*?

lines.content: うん。わかった
lines.translated: "Yeah. Okay."

lines.content: 心にふっと唐突に芽生えた“夜色”を、頭を振り、消し飛ばす。
lines.translated: I shook my head, banishing the "night-colored" gloom that had suddenly sprouted in my heart.

lines.content: とにかく目的地はちゃんとあるわけだ。でたらめに“夜”の中を走って行って……とか、そんなことをする必要もないのなら、よかった
lines.translated: "Anyway, at least we have proper destinations. It's a relief we don't have to go running blindly through the 'Night' or anything like that."

lines.content: 地図上の印を数えてみる。
lines.translated: I tried counting the marks on the map.

lines.content: それほど多いわけでもない。その距離感を把握するのは困難であったが、一晩の内にという制限はどうにかクリアできそうではあった。
lines.translated: There weren't all that many. It was hard to grasp the sense of distance between them, but it looked like we'd somehow be able to clear the condition of doing it all within a single night.

lines.content: さあ、“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を探しに行こうか
lines.translated: "Now then, shall we go look for the 'fragments of a star'?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんが言い。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said.

lines.content: それに合わせるみたいに汽笛が鳴った。
lines.translated: Right on cue, a steam whistle blew.

lines.content: ……一晩限り。姫織。大雅。ふたりにとって最後の冒険の、はじまりだね
lines.translated: "...For one night only. Himeori. Taiga. This is the beginning of your final adventure together."

lines.content: ――さあ、今夜限りの“夜間鉄道”のはじまりだ。
lines.translated: --And so, our one-night-only "Night Train" journey began.

lines.content: がたんがたんと列車は進む。
lines.translated: The train chugged along with a steady clatter.

lines.content: 月明かり。星々の瞬き。ときにまばゆい“夜”の中をだ。
lines.translated: Through the moonlight, the twinkling stars, and the at times dazzling "Night."

lines.content: どうやら地図のバッテンマークの位置にあるのは“駅”であるようだ。
lines.translated: Apparently, the X marks on the map indicated the locations of "stations."

lines.content: まず最初に俺たちを乗せた列車が停車したのは“真冬”の駅だった。
lines.translated: The very first station our train stopped at was "Midwinter."

lines.content: ……まさか
lines.translated: "...Of course not."

lines.content: 俺は車窓の外を見つめ、言う。
lines.translated: I stared out the window and spoke up.

lines.content: まさかここから外へ踏み出して、ひよちゃんの忘れ物を……、ええっと、“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を探さなきゃならないのかな
lines.translated: "Don't tell me we have to step out there to look for Hiyo-chan's lost item... um, the 'fragments of a star'?"

lines.content: 外、寒そうだね……
lines.translated: "It looks cold out there..."

lines.content: 車窓から外を覗けば凍てつく冬の光景だ。
lines.translated: Peering through the window revealed a freezing winter landscape.

lines.content: 真っ白に吹きすさぶ吹雪のために、停車した駅がどのような姿なのか見通すこともままならない。
lines.translated: A blinding white blizzard raged outside, making it impossible to even see what the station looked like.

lines.content: すっごい吹雪。気をつけてないと迷子になりそう
lines.translated: "What an incredible blizzard. We'll get lost if we aren't careful."

lines.content: そうだね。……まあ、うん。探してるものが何であれ、そう簡単には見つからないだろうと思ってたし、多少の大変さは覚悟してたけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Well, I figured whatever we're looking for wouldn't be that easy to find, so I was braced for a bit of trouble, but..."

lines.content: さっそく覚悟していた“大変さ”の想定を越えられてしまいそうだった。
lines.translated: Right off the bat, it looked like things were going to exceed the "trouble" I had prepared myself for.

lines.content: この吹雪の中、春の世界からやって来た軽装のままで[・|乗][・|り][・|切][・|れ][・|る]のだろうか――
lines.translated: Having come straight from a world of spring in light clothing, could we really *survive* in a blizzard like this?

lines.content: たとえ[夜の国|ここ]が現実の埒外にある世界であろうと、凍える“真冬”の現実的な寒さをないことにはできないはずだ。
lines.translated: Even if this "Land of Night" was a world outside the bounds of reality, there was no way we could just ignore the very real, bone-chilling cold of "Midwinter."

lines.content: さあどうするべきか。
lines.translated: Now, what should we do?

lines.content: 戸惑っていると、躊躇いを拭いきれずにいると、猛然と吹き乱れる真っ白な吹雪の中から――ひとり、ふたり、人影が現れる。その人影は次々とナナちゃんの列車に乗車した。
lines.translated: As we stood there bewildered, unable to shake our hesitation, figures began emerging one by one from the fiercely swirling white blizzard. One after another, those shadowy figures boarded Nana-chan's train.

lines.content: そして最後のひとりが乗車し終わると、列車の扉は大量の蒸気を吐き出すと共に、自動的に閉じられ――再び、列車は走り出す。
lines.translated: Once the last person was on board, the doors let out a massive hiss of steam and slid shut automatically--and the train began to move once more.

lines.content: あ、あれ……？
姫織は広げた地図に視線を落とした。
lines.translated: Himeori lowered her gaze to the unfolded map.

lines.content: 走り出しちゃったけど……いいのかな。まだ何も、探し出せていないのに
lines.translated: "It started moving again... Is that okay? We haven't even found anything yet."

lines.content: 列車は次第次第、速度に乗り、“夜”の先へと進み始める。
lines.translated: Gradually picking up speed, the train pressed onward deeper into the "Night."

lines.content: そういえば
lines.translated: "Come to think of it,"

lines.content: いや。大切なことを忘れてた
lines.translated: "Wait. I forgot something important."

lines.content: 大切な？
lines.translated: "Something important?"

lines.content: ああ、うん
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah."

lines.content: それってなあに？
lines.translated: "What's that?"

lines.content: ああ。ひよちゃんの“忘れ物”――その[ありか|在処]は、ひよちゃんが持ってきた地図を見ればなんとかわかるけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Hiyo-chan's 'lost item'--we can more or less figure out *where* it is by looking at the map you brought, but..."

lines.content: うん。昔々の私が、未来の……今の私に残してくれた、“夜の国”の地図
lines.translated: "Right. The map of the 'Land of Night' that the me from a long, long time ago left behind for the future me... the me of today."

lines.content: うん――そうだね。備えあれば憂いなしって感じだ。昔々のひよちゃんに感謝しなきゃだね
lines.translated: "Yeah--that's right. Forewarned is forearmed, as they say. We really have to thank the Hiyo-chan from a long, long time ago."

lines.content: 隣の姫織に微笑みかけて、俺は改めて言う――“そういえば”、と。
lines.translated: Smiling at Himeori beside me, I started over--"Come to think of it."

lines.content: そういえばさ、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Come to think of it, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: うん……？
lines.translated: "Yeah...?"

lines.content: 俺たち、目的の“惑星のかけら”がいったいどんなものなのか、知らないんだ
lines.translated: "We don't actually know what these 'fragments of a star' we're looking for are."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|れ]がどんな姿で、どんな形で、どんなふうに[・|在][・|る]ものなのか……わからないんだよね
lines.translated: "We don't know what *they* look like, what shape they take, or how they *exist*... do we?"

lines.content: だから、探しようがない。
lines.translated: Which meant there was no way to look for them.

lines.content: 場所がわかろうと。
lines.translated: Even if we knew the locations.

lines.content: 今さらそんなことに思い至ってしまったのだけれど……。
lines.translated: It had taken me until now to realize something so basic...

lines.content: まあ、それについては大丈夫なんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "Well, I think you'll be fine on that front."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが小首をかしげるようにして、言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said, tilting her head slightly.

lines.content: 向かい合わせの客席だ。俺の目の前に腰掛けていたナナちゃんは、俺の[・|そ][・|れ]を手渡した。
lines.translated: We were sitting in facing box seats. Nana-chan, who was seated right across from me, handed *it* over to me.

lines.content: これって……？
lines.translated: "What's this...?"

lines.content: 切符を切る道具だ。よく古いアニメや漫画に登場する……ええっと……これの名前ってなんて言うんだろうか。
lines.translated: It was a tool for punching tickets. The kind that often shows up in old anime and manga... Um... What was the name for this thing again?

lines.content: [かいさつきょう|改札鋏]。または、[かいさつばさみ|改札鋏]って言うんだよ
lines.translated: "It's called a ticket punch, or a conductor's punch."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはうなずく。
lines.translated: Nana-chan nodded.

lines.content: それを使って、乗り込んできたお客さんの切符を切って、確かめてみてほしい
lines.translated: "I want you to use that to punch the tickets of the passengers who just boarded and see for yourself."

lines.content: 俺は渡された小さな鋏――改札鋏をじっと見る。そして、言う。
lines.translated: I stared closely at the small pair of clippers--the ticket punch--she had handed me. Then, I spoke.

lines.content: それは、あれかな。もぎりみたいな感じ？
lines.translated: "Is this, like, that thing? Like a 'mogiri' ticket tearer?"

lines.content: んー……。もぎりとはちょっと違うかな。[・|そ][・|れ]は映画とかのチケットを切る人のことだしね
lines.translated: "Hmm... It's a little different from a 'mogiri.' *That* refers to the person who tears stubs at movie theaters and such."

lines.content: へえ、そうなんだ
lines.translated: "Huh, I see."

lines.content: 知らなかったなあと俺は素直に感心し、うなずいた。
lines.translated: I didn't know that. Genuinely impressed, I nodded.

lines.content: “惑星のかけら”とは、今乗車してきた“お客”さんが購入した切符のことだよ
lines.translated: "The 'fragments of a star' are the tickets purchased by the 'passengers' who just boarded the train."

lines.content: ……切符？
lines.translated: "...Tickets?"

lines.content: そう。……ほら、見てみて
lines.translated: "Yes. ...Here, take a look."

lines.content: 言って、ナナちゃんは一枚の切符をポケットから取り出す。
lines.translated: Saying that, Nana-chan pulled a single ticket out of her pocket.

lines.content: そして改札鋏でその切符に、ぱちりと、小さな穴を空けた。
lines.translated: Then, with a little *snip*, she punched a small hole into the ticket using the punch.

lines.content: すると――……
lines.translated: And when she did--...
"...Whoa, it *looks delicious*."

lines.content: 思わず、という具合に姫織が声を上げていた。
lines.translated: Himeori let out an involuntary gasp of admiration.

lines.content: 切符に穴を空けた[・|カ][・|ス]は、ナナちゃんの手のひらの上で[こんぺいとう|金平糖]みたいに小さな星の粒となる。まさに[ほし|惑星]のかけらだ。そう思えた。
lines.translated: The *punching* clipped from the ticket turned into a tiny, star-shaped grain like konpeito candy right on Nana-chan's palm. It truly was a fragment of a star. Or so it seemed to me.

lines.content: この瓶に入れて集めよう。ちゃんと蓋を閉めておかないと逃げちゃうよ。気をつけて
lines.translated: "Let's collect them in this jar. Make sure to close the lid tight, or they'll run away. Be careful."

lines.content: 今度は肩に提げた鞄から、ジャムの空瓶をナナちゃんは取り出す。そしてそれを俺に渡した。
lines.translated: Next, Nana-chan pulled an empty jam jar from the bag slung over her shoulder and handed it to me.

lines.content: ……と、いうことは
lines.translated: "...Which means..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: つまり、地図に印の付けられた駅を回って、そこから乗車して来るお客さんの切符を切っていけば、“惑星のかけら”は貯まっていく？
lines.translated: "In other words, if we go around to the stations marked on the map and punch the tickets of the passengers who board, we'll accumulate 'fragments of a star'?"

lines.content: そうなるかもしれないね
lines.translated: "That might just be how it works."

lines.content: そっか。それなら思ったよりずっと簡単かもしれない……？
lines.translated: "I see. Then this might be way easier than I thought...?"

lines.content: ……うーん。どうかな
lines.translated: "...Hmm. I wonder about that."

lines.content: 切符は[・|手][・|紙][・|と][・|一][・|緒][・|で]、目的地に辿り着くために必要なもので……。つまり[・|そ][・|れ]を買った人の“希望”そのものでもあるはずだから
lines.translated: "Tickets *are just like letters*--they're necessary to reach a destination... Which means they must also be the very 'hope' of the person who bought *them*."

lines.content: ……だからね、そのかけらだけでも貰うには、やっぱりそれなりに覚悟はしておいたほうがいいかもしれないね。何か面倒なことをお願いされるかもしれない
lines.translated: "...So even to get just a tiny fragment of one, you should probably be prepared for a bit of a challenge. They might ask you to do something troublesome in return."
"*Letters*?"

lines.content: 先日一緒に回収して回ったでしょう？　“夜”中に散らばっているポストに投函された“[手紙|願い]”だよ
lines.translated: "We went around collecting them together the other day, remember? The 'wishes' mailed in the postboxes scattered throughout the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ああ。うん。……ハルも十夜も一緒だった
lines.translated: "Ah, right. ...Haru and Toya were with us, too."

lines.content: そうだね。四人で一緒に小さな冒険をした“夜”だったね
lines.translated: "That's right. It was a 'Night' where the four of us went on a little adventure together."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは微笑み、続けた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan smiled and continued.

lines.content: 地図のバッテンは駅だけじゃなく、ポストの位置にも付けられているみたいなんだよね
lines.translated: "It looks like the X marks on the map don't just mark stations, they mark the locations of postboxes, too."

lines.content: そっか。じゃあまた海の中にダイブするようなこともあるのかな……
lines.translated: "I see. Does that mean we might end up diving into the ocean again...?"

lines.content: あるかもしれないね
lines.translated: "We just might."

lines.content: なるほど……。わかった
lines.translated: "Got it... Understood."

lines.content: 何かがあろうとなかろうと――あまり気を抜くことなく取りかかろう。
lines.translated: Whether something happens or not--let's tackle this without letting our guard down too much.

lines.content: じゃ、まずは切符からだ。さっそく“惑星のかけら”を集めに行こうか
lines.translated: "Alright, let's start with the tickets. Shall we go collect some 'fragments of a star' right away?"

lines.content: うん。そうしましょー
lines.translated: "Yeah! Let's do it~"

lines.content: 姫織と俺は、客車にぽつりぽつりと座る人たちの元を順番に回った。
lines.translated: Himeori and I went around in order to the passengers sitting here and there throughout the train car.

lines.content: ……まず、最初は三人家族のようだった。
lines.translated: First up seemed to be a family of three.

lines.content: 小さな男の子がひとり。その両脇に寄り添うようにして、向かい合わせの客席のひとつに座る男の人と女の人。
lines.translated: There was one little boy. Snuggled up on either side of him, sitting in one of the facing box seats, were a man and a woman.

lines.content: 足元にはたくさんの絵本が積み上げられていた。
lines.translated: A large stack of picture books was piled up at their feet.

lines.content: 女の人が男の子に読み聞かせている。
lines.translated: The woman was reading aloud to the boy.

lines.content: ……一冊終わればまた次を。
lines.translated: Whenever one book finished, she moved on to the next.

lines.content: 語りかけられる静かで、しかし伸びやかなその声は、客車全体に染みこむようにして響いていた。
lines.translated: Her quiet yet resonant voice seemed to sink into and echo throughout the entire passenger car as she read to him.

lines.content: そんな三人から切符を預かり、ぱちりぱちりと、穴をあけ――
lines.translated: Taking the tickets from the three of them, I punched holes into them with a *snip, snip*--

lines.content: え、えっと……その。この美味しそうなの、もらってもいいでしょうか……？
lines.translated: "U-Um... Excuse me. Would it be alright if we kept these delicious-looking pieces...?"

lines.content: ――それぞれの切符から[・|こ][・|ぼ][・|れ][・|落][・|ち][・|た]、金平糖みたいな小さなかけらを差し出しながらも、姫織が頭を下げていた。
lines.translated: --Holding out the tiny, konpeito-like fragments that had *spilled* from each of their tickets, Himeori bowed her head.

lines.content: 三人は顔を見合わせ、“別にいいけど”とうなずいた。
lines.translated: The three exchanged glances and nodded, saying, "We don't mind."

lines.content: パッと表情を明るくし、頭を上げる姫織に“その代わり”と男の子は言った。
lines.translated: Himeori's face lit up as she raised her head, only for the little boy to add, "In exchange."

lines.content: “その代わり、何か楽しいお話を聞かせてよ。夢と希望がきらきらしてる。そんなお話がいいな”
lines.translated: "In exchange, tell me a fun story. One that's sparkling with dreams and hopes. That's the kind of story I want to hear."

lines.content: そうすればぼくらの心のかけらを少しだけでもわけてあげる。
lines.translated: If you do that, we'll share a little bit of the fragments of our hearts with you.

lines.content: ……お話
lines.translated: "...A story."

lines.content: 姫織は腕を組み。眉根を寄せ。うんうん唸る……。
lines.translated: Himeori crossed her arms, furrowed her brow, and groaned in thought...

lines.content: どうしようか。いきなり何か話してって言われても難しいよね
lines.translated: "What should we do? It's tough being asked to tell a story out of nowhere like this."

lines.content: 当然、というのも情けない限りだが、俺もすぐには話せるようなものはないし。
lines.translated: Though it was pathetic to admit, I naturally didn't have any stories ready to tell off the top of my head, either.

lines.content: 一度ナナちゃんと一緒に作戦会議する？
lines.translated: "Should we go have a quick strategy meeting with Nana-chan?"

lines.content: ……ううん。大丈夫。お話、できそうだよ
lines.translated: "...No, it's okay. I think I can tell them a story."

lines.content: お、そうなの？
lines.translated: "Oh, really?"

lines.content: うん……。だけど
lines.translated: "Yeah... It's just..."

lines.content: ちらちらと俺のほうを見ていた。
lines.translated: She kept glancing over at me.

lines.content: 何？　どうかしたのかな？
lines.translated: "What is it? Is something wrong?"

lines.content: いやぁ～……え、えへへ。なんだか急に恥ずかしい感じになってしまいまして
lines.translated: "Well~... E-Ehehe. I just got kind of embarrassed all of a sudden."

lines.content: 恥ずかしい……？
lines.translated: "Embarrassed...?"

lines.content: 首をかしげる俺だけど、
lines.translated: I tilted my head in confusion, then...
"Huh? Don't tell me *it's that kind of story?*"

lines.content: ハッとしてみせ、ついとぼけたことを言ってしまった。
lines.translated: Feigning a gasp, I accidentally blurted out something silly.

lines.content: そういうとは……どういう？
lines.translated: "What do you mean by... 'that kind'?"

lines.content: 姫織は小首をかしげていた。純真そうな眼差しで。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head slightly, looking at me with pure, innocent eyes.

lines.content: い、いや。うう。何でもない、です……
lines.translated: "N-No, ugh. It's nothing, ma'am..."

lines.content: もにょもにょとするばかり。
lines.translated: All I could do was mumble awkwardly.

lines.content: ひよちゃんの心は俺よりすでに大人に近づいてるんだろうけど、でも、ひよちゃんよりすでに俺の心は色々と[けが|汚]れてしまってるんだろうなあって……そういう話
lines.translated: "Your heart is probably closer to being an adult's than mine, Hiyo-chan, and yet mine has already gotten way more tainted in all sorts of ways... That's what I meant."

lines.content: んー……。大雅の言うことはいつもよくわっかんないけども……
lines.translated: "Hmm... I never really understand what you're talking about, Taiga, though..."

lines.content: ……そ、そうですよね。ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...R-Right, you wouldn't. I'm sorry."

lines.content: もう少しでちょっとした下ネタに走りそうになっていた。そんな自分を反省した。
lines.translated: I had nearly veered into a slightly dirty joke. I reflected on my own behavior.

lines.content: たとえば、人の前で歌う感じ？　そんな照れ具合に良く似ているってことかも
lines.translated: "Like, how it feels to sing in front of people? It might be really similar to that kind of shyness."

lines.content: 人前で、何か物語を話すことが？
lines.translated: "Telling a story in front of people is?"

lines.content: そう。……大雅は意地悪だからくすくすしそうだし？
lines.translated: "Yeah. ...Besides, you're a meanie, Taiga, so I feel like you'd giggle at me?"

lines.content: そんなことしないよ
lines.translated: "I wouldn't do that."

lines.content: ほんと？
lines.translated: "Really?"

lines.content: ああ。ほんとだとも……。千和相手にならいざ知らず
lines.translated: "Yeah, I really mean it... Though it might be a different story if it were Chiwa."

lines.content: あー……。帰ったら千和に言ってやらなきゃ。そうして千和に怒られてる大雅を見ながら、私はとってもくすくすしなきゃだね
lines.translated: "Ahh... I'll have to tell Chiwa when we get back. And then I'll definitely have to giggle a whole lot while watching you get scolded by her."

lines.content: あーだこーだとだらだら話す俺たちに、客席の三人が不思議そうに見上げていた。
lines.translated: The three passengers looked up in confusion at the two of us rambling on and on about this and that.

lines.content: ……お話だ。男の子がよろこぶ何かを話さなければ。
lines.translated: Right, the story. We had to tell something that would make the boy happy.

lines.content: ええっと……
lines.translated: "Ummm..."

lines.content: 姫織はもう少しだけ悩む素振りを見せたけど、
lines.translated: Himeori looked like she was mulling it over for just a bit longer, before...

lines.content: 昔々、あるお腹の中に、小さなちいさな、だけどとっても食いしん坊な怪獣が住んでいました――
lines.translated: "Once upon a time, inside a certain tummy, there lived a tiny, tiny, yet very gluttonous monster--"

lines.content: 空っぽなのかもしれないお腹を撫で撫でしながら、姫織はそんな話を語っていた。
lines.translated: Rubbing her own possibly empty stomach, Himeori began to tell that story.

lines.content: “切符”や“手紙”を[・|私][・|た][・|ち]は集めて回った。
lines.translated: *We* went around collecting "tickets" and "letters."

lines.content: 列車の主が導いてくれるまま、目的の“駅”やポストを巡る。
lines.translated: Guided by the master of the train, we visited our target "stations" and postboxes.

lines.content: 次の客に切符を確認するため声をかけようとした。
lines.translated: I was about to call out to the next passenger to check their ticket.

lines.content: ……男がひとり、客席に腰掛けている。
lines.translated: A single man was sitting in a passenger seat.

lines.content: 堅くしかめた表情で、きらきら光る“夜”の光景を映し出した車窓を眺めていた。
lines.translated: With a tightly furrowed brow, he gazed out the train window, which reflected the sparkling scenery of the "Night."

lines.content: 男の隣には誰もいない。
lines.translated: No one was sitting next to the man.

lines.content: 向かいの席には写真立てがひとつ置かれている。
lines.translated: A single picture frame was placed on the seat across from him.

lines.content: しかし……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 写真立ての中の写真に映る微笑みと、男の隣にふと現れた微笑みは、まるで同一のものだった。
lines.translated: The smile in the photograph inside the frame, and the smile that suddenly appeared beside the man, were completely identical.

lines.content: ……半透明の女の人だ。
lines.translated: It was a translucent woman.

lines.content: 男が短い眠りに落ちて[まぶた|瞼]を閉じると、その女の人は男の隣に現れた。
lines.translated: When the man closed his eyelids, drifting into a brief sleep, the woman appeared right beside him.

lines.content: そして[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた男の手を、そっと握っているようだった。
lines.translated: Then, she seemed to gently hold the hand of the man whose eyes were closed.

lines.content: 男の人はそれに気づいてはいないのだろう――[まぶた|瞼]を閉じたまま、肩を震わせ泣いていた。
lines.translated: The man probably didn't realize it--with his eyelids still shut, his shoulders trembled as he wept.

lines.content: 女の人が流れるその涙を指先で拭おうとしても……だめだ。触れられない。今度は女の人がつらそうに唇を噛み、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: Even when the woman tried to wipe away his falling tears with her fingertips... it was no use. She couldn't touch him. This time, the woman bit her lip in pain and closed her eyelids.

lines.content: がたん。ごとん。
lines.translated: Clack-clack. Clack-clack.

lines.content: 列車が揺れて男は目覚める。
lines.translated: The train jolted, and the man woke up.

lines.content: すると女の人は姿を消した。
lines.translated: At that moment, the woman vanished.

lines.content: ……男は、またひとりきりになる。
lines.translated: The man was all alone once again.

lines.content: ただ向かいの席に置いた写真を見つめ続けていた。つらそうな表情で。さみしそうな眼差しで。
lines.translated: He simply kept staring at the photograph placed on the opposite seat. With a pained expression. With a lonely gaze.

lines.content: そしてもう一度、男の人が[まぶた|瞼]を閉じると……隣に現れた半透明の女の人。ひとりぼっちの男を心配そうに見つめていた。
lines.translated: And when the man closed his eyelids once more... the translucent woman appeared beside him. She gazed worriedly at the solitary man.
*The translucent woman cannot show herself unless the man closes his eyelids.*

lines.content: ここにいるよと。いつも、あなたのそばにいるんだよと。
lines.translated: "I'm right here. I'm always right by your side."

lines.content: ……そんなふうに、微笑みかけることも叶わない。
lines.translated: She couldn't even smile at him to convey that.

lines.content: 私は、その女の人から男の人への伝言を預かった。
lines.translated: I received a message from the woman to pass on to the man.

lines.content: それを目覚めた男に伝えると、男の人は安心したように微笑んで……。
lines.translated: When I relayed it to the man after he woke up, he smiled with relief and...

lines.content: 私に、ふたり分の“惑星のかけら”を譲ってくれた。男の人の切符と女の人の切符。ふたり分だ。
lines.translated: He gave me two shares of "fragments of a star." The man's ticket and the woman's ticket. Enough for the two of them.

lines.content: ――あなた達はどこへ向かっているの。
lines.translated: --Where are the two of you headed?

lines.content: そう問いかけてみた。
lines.translated: I tried asking them that.
Then, *one of them* answered.

lines.content: ――また、私たちふたりが出会える世界まで。
lines.translated: --To a world where the two of us can meet again.

lines.content: そんなふうにして一つひとつ――あるいは一欠片ひとかけら、私はその光を集めていった。
lines.translated: In that way, one by one--or rather, fragment by fragment, I gathered that light.

lines.content: 金平糖みたいにきらきら光るかけらを詰めた瓶は、少しずつ満たされていく。
lines.translated: The jar packed with fragments sparkling like konpeito was gradually filling up.

lines.content: こうして集める“惑星のかけら”は[・|器]を作り出すためのもの。
lines.translated: The "fragments of a star" gathered like this are meant to create a *vessel*.

lines.content: そしてその[・|器]を満たすためには、あなたの命が必要で……。
lines.translated: And in order to fill that *vessel*, your life is needed...

lines.content: ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ごめん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい。
lines.translated: I'm sorry.

lines.content: 何かを得るなら、同じだけ何かを失う。
lines.translated: To gain something, you must lose something of equal value.

lines.content: それが“夜の国”という時間のお約束。
lines.translated: That is the rule of this time known as the "Land of Night."

lines.content: そのときが来るまでに、私はあなたを犠牲にするだけの覚悟が決まるだろうか。
lines.translated: By the time that moment comes, will I have found the resolve to sacrifice you?

lines.content: 心を震わせる汽笛に耳を澄ませながら、今夜の私は自分にそう問いかけ続けてばかりいる。
lines.translated: Listening closely to the soul-stirring train whistle, I do nothing tonight but ask myself that question over and over.

lines.content: ねえ大雅。もしも人生をやり直せるとしたら、大雅はどうする？
lines.translated: "Hey, Taiga. If you could do your life over again, what would you do?"

lines.content: 次の目的の場所に向かう途中で、姫織がぽつりとそう言った。
lines.translated: On our way to the next destination, Himeori murmured that out of the blue.

lines.content: 少し物憂げにも見える表情で、がたんがたんと流れゆく車窓の風景に視線を向けていた。
lines.translated: With an expression that looked somewhat melancholic, she turned her gaze toward the scenery flowing past the window with a rhythmic clack-clack.

lines.content: ……やり直せたらって？
lines.translated: "...If I could do it over?"

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: こちらを見ないまま、姫織はうなずく。
lines.translated: Without looking at me, Himeori nodded.

lines.content: たとえばの話だよ？　もしもそうできるなら、大雅は何歳の頃に戻ってみたい？　そして何を、どんなふうに変えたい？　そういうお話
lines.translated: "It's just a hypothetical, okay? If you could do that, what age would you want to go back to, Taiga? And what would you want to change, and how? That kind of thing."

lines.content: うん。そうだね。それは、わかってる。……ただ面食らってるだけなんだ
lines.translated: "Yeah, right. I get what you mean. ...It just caught me off guard, that's all."

lines.content: 麺を、食らう……？
lines.translated: "Caught... a guard...?"

lines.content: ふふ、と姫織はひとりで笑った。
lines.translated: "Fufu," Himeori chuckled to herself.

lines.content: 親父ギャグっぽいものがツボな姫織だ。しかし今のはギャグにもなっていなかったような……。
lines.translated: Himeori had a weakness for dad-joke-style puns. Though I didn't think what I just said even counted as a pun...

lines.content: やっぱり何が姫織をくすりとさせるツボなのか俺には謎だ。
lines.translated: What exactly tickled Himeori's funny bone was still a mystery to me.

lines.content: 未だにこの幼馴染みについてはよくわからっていないことだらけだなあと、そんなことを改めて思うけれど……、
lines.translated: It made me realize all over again that there were still so many things I didn't understand about this childhood friend of mine, though...

lines.content: ……“もしも人生をやり直せたら”
lines.translated: "...'If you could do your life over again.'"

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: ……ひよちゃんがまたまじめな話してる。シリアスな顔してる。本当に、今夜はどうしてしまったんだよ――だ、なんて。そういうのはもうしつこいよね
lines.translated: "...You're talking about something serious again, Hiyo-chan. Making a serious face, too. Really, what's gotten into you tonight? --Or so I'd say, but harping on that is getting old, isn't it?"

lines.content: とってもしつこい
lines.translated: "Super old."

lines.content: いーっと白い歯を見せる姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori bared her white teeth with a grin.

lines.content: 思わず大雅を全部美味しくいただき黙らせてしまいたくなるくらいしつこいよ
lines.translated: "So old that it makes me want to just gobble you all up on the spot to shut you up, Taiga."

lines.content: う、それは大変だ。いいかげん俺もまじめに答えないと
lines.translated: "Ugh, that would be bad. I'd better give you a serious answer already."

lines.content: 俺は首をかしげ、考える。
lines.translated: I tilted my head and thought about it.

lines.content: そうだなあ。もしも人生をやり直せたら、か
lines.translated: "Let's see. If I could do my life over again, huh?"

lines.content: やり直したいと願うということは、それは過去に何かしら“後悔”しているものがあるということになるのだろうけれど……。
lines.translated: Wishing for a do-over probably meant having some kind of "regret" in the past, though...

lines.content: 俺はどの段階にまで戻って、どんなふうに、やり直したいって思うのかなあ
lines.translated: "I wonder what stage I'd want to go back to, and how I'd want to do it over..."

lines.content: ちょっとおどけたふうに言ってみるけれど――そんなもの。
lines.translated: I tried saying it in a slightly playful tone--but really.

lines.content: この俺にしてみれば回答を詰まらせてしまう道理はどこにもなかった。
lines.translated: For someone like me, there was no reason at all to be at a loss for an answer.

lines.content: なぜなら俺の人生は“後悔”だらけだ。
lines.translated: Because my life was full of "regrets."

lines.content: もしもやり直せるのなら……。
lines.translated: If I could do it over again...
Both *the time I wanted to go back to* and *what I wanted to redo* were painfully obvious, leaving no room for doubt.

lines.content: （ただ、まあ……）
lines.translated: (Still, well...)

lines.content: 俺が[・|そ][・|の][・|時][・|点]にもしも戻れたところで、やはり何もできないまま……今に至っていただろう。だから俺はふるふると首を振り、
lines.translated: Even if I could go back to *that point in time*, I probably still wouldn't be able to do anything... and would just end up right where I am now. So I gave a little shake of my head and said,

lines.content: そう言うひよちゃんはどうなのかな。戻りたい時間。やり直したいこと。何かあるの？
lines.translated: "What about you, Hiyo-chan, since you brought it up? A time you want to go back to. Something you want to redo. Do you have anything?"

lines.content: えー。質問したのは私なのに
lines.translated: "Ehh? Even though I was the one who asked first?"

lines.content: つんとする姫織だ。
lines.translated: Himeori pouted.

lines.content: 大雅はちょっと失礼なんでないかしら
lines.translated: "Don't you think you're being a little rude, Taiga?"

lines.content: え？　どうして俺はちょっと失礼なのかしら
lines.translated: "Huh? And why might I be a little rude?"

lines.content: だってね。質問を質問で返すのはとっても失礼なことなんだって……誰だっけ。そう言ってた人がいたよ？
lines.translated: "Well, you know. They say answering a question with a question is super rude... Who was it, again? Someone told me that before."

lines.content: む。そうか。なら確かに俺は今、ひよちゃんに大変失敬なことをしてしまっている訳か……
lines.translated: "Mm. Is that so? Then I really am doing something terribly discourteous to you right now, Hiyo-chan..."

lines.content: それはいけない。大問題だ。
lines.translated: That wouldn't do. It was a huge problem.

lines.content: どうしたら許してくれる？
lines.translated: "How can I get you to forgive me?"

lines.content: んー……。あめ玉くれたら？　甘くて美味しいのがいいですけども
lines.translated: "Hmm... Maybe if you give me a piece of hard candy? I'd prefer a sweet and delicious one, though."

lines.content: 残念ながらあめ玉は持ってないなあと俺は言う。
lines.translated: I told her that, unfortunately, I didn't have any candy on me.

lines.content: 今ここに智仁がいればな。あいつのポケットは甘いお菓子のワンダーランドだ
lines.translated: "If only Tomohito were here right now. That guy's pockets are a wonderland of sweet treats."

lines.content: うん。毎朝甘いあめ玉とかクッキーとかくれるから、私の眠気もさっぱり覚めちゃう
lines.translated: "Yeah. He gives me sweet candies and cookies every morning, so it wakes me right up from my drowsiness."

lines.content: するとひよちゃんは迷子じゃなくなる。不思議なことに
lines.translated: "And then you stop getting lost, Hiyo-chan. Mysteriously enough."

lines.content: そうだね。私、お腹が空くと何でだか簡単な道もよくわかんなくなっちゃって……血圧？　とかの問題なのかな。ねむねむしいときはお脳に血が回っていないから？
lines.translated: "That's right. Whenever I get hungry, for some reason I lose track of even the simplest roads... Maybe it's a blood pressure thing? Because blood isn't circulating to my brain when I'm all sleepy-weepy?"

lines.content: なんだか私、おばあちゃんみたいと言い、照れくさそうに姫織は苦笑い。
lines.translated: Saying "I sound kind of like an old lady," Himeori gave a sheepish, wry smile.

lines.content: あいつ……
lines.translated: "That guy..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……いや、あいつさ。智仁だよ。俺にはなぜだかミルク味のあめ玉しかくれないんだ。甘いのはひよちゃん用だって言ってさ。まったく。いったい何なんだ
lines.translated: "...No, I mean, that guy. Tomohito. For some reason, he only ever gives me milk-flavored candies. Says the sweet ones are for you, Hiyo-chan. Honestly. What's his deal?"

lines.content: そこに何か意味でもあるのかと今さらながら疑問が膨らむ。
lines.translated: Belatedly, I found myself wondering more and more if there was some deeper meaning behind that.

lines.content: まあきっと特別意味などないのだろうけれど……そうだよな？
lines.translated: Well, there probably wasn't any special meaning to it, though... Right?

lines.content: 私は……。あるよ
えっ？　やっぱり意味があるのかな？
lines.translated: "Huh? So there really is a meaning behind it?"

lines.content: ええー？　意味ってどういう意味……？
lines.translated: "Ehh? What do you mean by meaning...?"

lines.content: あ。いや……あ、ああ。あめ玉、持ってきてたってこと？
lines.translated: "Ah. No... oh, right. You mean you brought candy with you?"

lines.content: もー、違うよ。そうじゃない
lines.translated: "Geez, no. That's not it."

lines.content: ぷりぷりしながら姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori huffed indignantly as she spoke.

lines.content: やり直したいこと、だよ。私にはあるんだよって話
lines.translated: "Something I want to redo. I'm saying that I have something like that."

lines.content: ……なるほど。そっか
lines.translated: "...I see. Gotcha."

lines.content: ならば、それは……。
lines.translated: In that case, what was it...?

lines.content: ひよちゃんの、やり直したいことは……
lines.translated: "Something you want to redo, Hiyo-chan..."

lines.content: それはいったい、なんだろう。
lines.translated: What on earth could that be?

lines.content: 夜月姫織のやり直したいと思っていること――その“後悔”とはいったいなんだろうか。
lines.translated: What Himeori Yotsuki wanted to do over--what could her "regret" possibly be?

lines.content: 姫織がそのことについて語り始めるまで、口を閉ざした。
lines.translated: I kept my mouth shut until Himeori was ready to start talking about it.

lines.content: じっと姫織を見つめた。今もまた流れゆく車窓の向こうに視線を投げている姫織を。
lines.translated: I stared fixedly at Himeori. At Himeori, who was once again casting her gaze out at the scenery flowing past the train window.

lines.content: 次にその唇が開かれたとき、いったいどんな話を聞かせてくれるのだろう。そう、期待して。
lines.translated: When those lips of hers parted next, what kind of story would she tell me? I waited in anticipation.

lines.content: しかし姫織が続きを語ることはなかった。
lines.translated: However, Himeori never continued her story.

lines.content: がたん。
lines.translated: Clack-clack.

lines.content: 列車が一度大きく揺れ、
lines.translated: The train gave a single, heavy lurch,

lines.content: ここら辺で少し休憩にしようと思うんだけど、いいかな。ふたりとも
lines.translated: "I'm thinking of taking a little break around here, if that's okay with you two?"

lines.content: ひょいっとナナちゃんが顔を出したのだ。
lines.translated: and Nana-chan popped her head in.

lines.content: ……もしかして私、空気読めないことしちゃったのかな
lines.translated: "...Wait, did I just fail to read the room?"

lines.content: 何も答えずただ目を伏せた姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori didn't answer, simply lowering her eyes.

lines.content: その様子を気にしたのだろう。ナナちゃんが俺に耳打ちをした。
lines.translated: Probably concerned by the way she was acting, Nana-chan whispered into my ear.

lines.content: ううん。ただちょっとね、俺たちにすると珍しくまじめな話をしてたから
lines.translated: "No, not at all. It's just that, well, we were having a serious talk for once, which is rare for us."

lines.content: ……むぅ。別に珍しくないもん
lines.translated: "...Muu. It's not rare at all."

lines.content: 姫織が唇を尖らせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori was pouting.

lines.content: 私の心はいっつも大人な女の子らしく色々と大変でもにょもにょしてるんだよ。海よりもふかぁい考え事と、山よりもたかぁい悩み事に、いつもいつでも意地悪されてるの
lines.translated: "My heart is always all tangled up with lots of tough things, just like a mature girl's should be. Thoughts deeper than the ocean and worries higher than the mountains are always, always being mean to me."

lines.content: だからまじめな話もいっぱいするよ。謎めいていて、せくしぃーで、あだるてぃなのがひよりちゃんなんだよっ。……ただ
lines.translated: "So I talk about serious things a lot, too! Mysterious, sexy, and adult-like--that's who Hiyori-chan is! ...It's just..."

lines.content: ただ？
lines.translated: "Just?"

lines.content: ……うん。ただね、ちょみっとだけ、ね。そういう大人な女の子な事情より、お腹が空いたなあって気持ちのほうがね、時どき大きくなるだけで
lines.translated: "...Yeah. It's just, a teensy little bit, you know. Sometimes the feeling of being hungry just gets bigger than all those mature-girl circumstances."

lines.content: だからいつもは仕方ないんだよ。ラーメン食べたいいっぱい食べたい。姫織は身体をふらふら揺らしながらそう主張する。
lines.translated: "So it can't be helped most of the time. I wanna eat ramen, I wanna eat lots of it." Himeori insisted, swaying her body back and forth.

lines.content: ひよちゃん……。悩み事とか考え事があれば大人の証拠になるのかな
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan... Does having worries and things to think about really count as proof that you're an adult?"

lines.content: 海よりも深いし山よりも高いからいいの
lines.translated: "They're deeper than the ocean and higher than the mountains, so it counts."

lines.content: がたがたと姫織は椅子に座ったまま小さく飛び跳ねていた――もうっ、やだっ、ばかっ、大雅の意地悪っ、お腹も空いたよっ、と。
lines.translated: Still sitting in her seat, Himeori bounced up and down with a clatter--"Geez, stop it, dummy, you're a meanie, Taiga, and I'm hungry too!" she protested.

lines.content: いっつも私を子ども扱いばっかりするんだから。大雅はほんとにほんとに失礼なんだよ。私の心のほうがもう大人なのに
lines.translated: "You're always treating me like a kid. You're really, really rude, Taiga. Even though my heart is already more grown-up than yours."

lines.content: ……む。それを言われると立つ瀬なしだな
lines.translated: "...Mm. When you put it like that, I really don't have a leg to stand on."

lines.content: 俺は身体ごと“夜の国”へと這入れる。姫織はもう無理。つまりそういうことだ。
lines.translated: I could still enter the "Land of Night" with my physical body. Himeori couldn't anymore. In short, that was what it meant.

lines.content: ……次第次第に列車の速度が落ちていく。
lines.translated: Little by little, the train's speed began to drop.

lines.content: えっと、ナナちゃん。ここら辺で休憩って言ってたけど……
lines.translated: "Um, Nana-chan. You said we're taking a break around here, right...?"

lines.content: 俺は緩やかになり始めた車窓の景色を見る。
lines.translated: I looked out the window at the scenery, which was starting to slow down.

lines.content: 真っ暗に見えるけど、近くに停まっていられるような駅があるのかな
lines.translated: "It looks pitch black out there, though. Is there a station nearby where we can stop?"

lines.content: ううん。駅はないけど、景色はいいよ。それなりにね
lines.translated: "Nope. There's no station, but the view is nice. Reasonably so, anyway."

lines.content: だから休憩はここら辺にしたいんだとナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: That was why she wanted to take our break around here, Nana-chan said.

lines.content: それに今夜は、この路線を走るのは私たちだけだからね。だから停車してても別の列車の邪魔にはならないよ
lines.translated: "Besides, we're the only ones running on this line tonight. So even if we stop, we won't get in the way of any other trains."

lines.content: ねえ、ナナちゃん
lines.translated: "Hey, Nana-chan."

lines.content: うん。何？　姫織
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it, Himeori?"

lines.content: 休憩……いるの？
lines.translated: "A break... Do we need one?"

lines.content: 今夜限りしか時間はないのに？　姫織は少し不安そうに首をかしげていた。
lines.translated: Even though we only have tonight? Himeori tilted her head, looking a little uneasy.

lines.content: うん。それについては改めて……ごめんね。焦っちゃうのもわかるんだけど、この子を少しだけでもいいから休ませてあげてほしいんだよ
lines.translated: "Yeah. About that... I'm sorry to bring it up again. I understand why you're feeling impatient, but I want you to let this little one rest, even if it's just for a bit."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは客席の縁をやさしく撫でた。それはもちろんこの列車の一部だ。
lines.translated: Nana-chan gently stroked the edge of a passenger seat. Which was, of course, part of this train.

lines.content: この子はがんばり屋さんだから。お願いしたらどこまでも走って行ってくれるけど……
lines.translated: "Because this child is a hard worker. If we ask, she'll keep running as far as we want, but..."

lines.content: でもね。がんばり屋さんってさ、頑張ってがんばって……がんばりすぎて、自分がどこか故障しちゃっても気づけないことが多いから
lines.translated: "You know how hard workers are. They try so hard, and keep trying... and try so hard that they often don't even notice when something inside them breaks down."

lines.content: だからこそこちらが気にしてブレーキかけてあげないといけないんだよ。
lines.translated: "That's why we have to be the ones to pay attention and put on the brakes for her."

lines.content: ナナちゃんがそう言うのと殆ど同時に列車は停まった。
lines.translated: Almost at the exact same moment Nana-chan said that, the train came to a stop.

lines.content: 列車が停車したその場所は、駅どころか微かな光さえもない、本当の暗闇の中だった。
lines.translated: The place where the train stopped was in true darkness, without even the faintest light, let alone a station.

lines.content: 列車のライトにぼんやりと照らされた、半径数メートルの範囲内以外、何も見えない。
lines.translated: Aside from a radius of a few meters dimly illuminated by the train's lights, nothing was visible.

lines.content: 砂利の上に引かれた古く、錆だらけの線路だけがそこにはあった。
lines.translated: All that was there were old, rust-covered tracks laid out over gravel.

lines.content: 耳を澄ませてみても物音ひとつしない。
lines.translated: Even when I strained my ears, there wasn't a single sound.

lines.content: 粘性を帯びたようなどんよりとした無音が、しんしんと重苦しくそこら中に降り積もっているようだ。
lines.translated: A dull, viscous silence seemed to be falling heavily and quietly all around us.

lines.content: まるで海の一番深い場所。
lines.translated: Just like the deepest part of the ocean.

lines.content: 今にも闇の中から、見たこともない姿をした何かがぬらりと姿を現しそうで……。
lines.translated: It felt as if, at any moment, something with a shape we'd never seen before might slither out from the darkness...

lines.content: ただここにいると言うだけで息を呑む。
lines.translated: Just being here was enough to take my breath away.

lines.content: そんな暗闇の中、小さなランタンをひとつだけ持ち、ナナちゃんは列車の屋根に登る。
lines.translated: In the midst of that darkness, holding only a single small lantern, Nana-chan climbed onto the roof of the train.

lines.content: 俺たちもその後に続き、おっかなびっくり屋根へとよじ登った。
lines.translated: We followed after her, timidly scrambling up onto the roof ourselves.

lines.content: ああ……。
lines.translated: Ah...

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: うなずき、[・|そ][・|れ]を仰ぎ見る。
lines.translated: I nodded, looking up at *it*.

lines.content: 確かにナナちゃんの言うとおりだ。景色は、いいね。とても
lines.translated: "It really is just like you said, Nana-chan. The view is nice. Very nice."

lines.content: 何もないと思っていた暗闇だった。
lines.translated: It had been a darkness where I thought nothing existed.

lines.content: しかし列車の屋根に登り、ナナちゃんがランタンの灯りを空に掲げると……。
lines.translated: However, once we climbed onto the roof of the train and Nana-chan held the light of her lantern up toward the sky...

lines.content: そこには、きらきら、きらきら、無数の星々が瞬いているのが、わかった――
lines.translated: We could see countless stars twinkling, sparkling and glittering up there--

lines.content: だがここは“夜の国”
lines.translated: Yet this was the "Land of Night."

lines.content: 三人一緒に見上げた[・|そ][・|れ]は、ふつうの星空とはやはり違う。
lines.translated: *What* the three of us looked up at together was, after all, different from a normal starry sky.

lines.content: 瞬く無数の星は、良くよく見ればせわしなく[・|移][・|動][・|し][・|て][・|い][・|た]。
lines.translated: Looking closely, the countless twinkling stars were restlessly *moving around*.

lines.content: ひとつとして一カ所に留まることはなく、ふわふわと、ふらふらと、“夜”の空を揺らめいている。
lines.translated: Not a single one stayed in the same place; they drifted and swayed, floating aimlessly through the "Night" sky.

lines.content: あ、流れ星……？
lines.translated: "Ah, a shooting star...?"

lines.content: 姫織が指さす。
lines.translated: Himeori pointed.

lines.content: そこには確かに、流れ星に良く似た光の筋が尾を引き、走る。
lines.translated: There was indeed a streak of light resembling a shooting star, trailing a tail as it raced across the sky.

lines.content: けれどその光はいっこうに消えゆくこともない。しかも地上へと向かい落ちてゆくのではなく、上へ、上へとゆるやかに昇っていっていた。
lines.translated: Yet that light showed no sign of fading away. Moreover, rather than falling toward the ground, it was gently rising higher and higher.

lines.content: あれはね、“夜”の中を走る列車の光だよとナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: "That's the light of a train running through the 'Night,'" Nana-chan said.

lines.content: あの列車は、どこに向かっているの？
lines.translated: "Where is that train headed?"

lines.content: そう言い首をかしげている姫織に、
lines.translated: To Himeori, who tilted her head as she asked that,

lines.content: もしも人生、やり直せるなら――
lines.translated: "If you could do your life over again--"

lines.content: と、ナナちゃんは答える。
lines.translated: Nana-chan replied.

lines.content: さっき姫織がそう言っていたよね
lines.translated: "You were saying that earlier, weren't you, Himeori?"

lines.content: う、うん
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: [・|も][・|し][・|も]、だなんてことはないんだよ。あなた達の人生は……命はきっと、幾らでも、何度でも、やり直しがきくものなんじゃないかな
lines.translated: "There's no *'if'* about it, you know. Your lives... life itself is surely something that can be redone as much as you want, as many times as you want, don't you think?"

lines.content: 幾らでも？
lines.translated: "As much as we want?"

lines.content: 何度でも、だよ
lines.translated: "As many times as you want."

lines.content: 夜空に星が瞬く限り……幾らでも。何度でも
lines.translated: "For as long as the stars twinkle in the night sky... as much as you want. As many times as you want."
"...Stars?"

lines.content: どういうこと？　と姫織は首をかしげた。
lines.translated: "What do you mean?" Himeori tilted her head.

lines.content: 夜空の星は……あの星も、この星も、ひとつ残らず……死んだ命の行き着く場所なんだよ。もちろん、私たちが今いるこの星もそのひとつ
lines.translated: "The stars in the night sky... that star, this star, every single one of them... are the places where dead lives end up. Of course, this star we're on right now is one of them, too."

lines.content: 俺と姫織は顔を見合わせる。ナナちゃんの言わんとすることがいまいちよくわからない。
lines.translated: Himeori and I exchanged glances. We didn't quite understand what Nana-chan was trying to get at.

lines.content: そんな俺たちの様子に、ナナちゃんは苦笑いのような表情を見せ、
lines.translated: Seeing our reaction, Nana-chan gave a wry smile.

lines.content: 死んだ人間の命はそこで終わりにはならないんだって話だよ
lines.translated: "I'm saying that when a human dies, their life doesn't just end right there."

lines.content: この世界で命尽きるということは、また別の世界に生まれ直すということなんだ――……ほら、さっきの光。あの列車だよ
lines.translated: "When a life runs out in this world, it means being reborn into another world--... Look, that light from earlier. That train."

lines.content: 今度はナナちゃんが、“夜”の空を走る列車を指さした。
lines.translated: This time, Nana-chan pointed at the train running through the "Night" sky.

lines.content: あの列車はね、この星での[所有時間|寿命]が尽きた命を、別の世界に……別の星へと届けるために、“夜”の空を走ってる。それが、私たちの“役割”なんだ
lines.translated: "That train runs through the 'Night' sky to deliver lives whose allotted time--their lifespan--on this star has run out to another world... to another star. That is our 'role.'"

lines.content: ……“夜”に属するものは誰にも“役割”がある。無駄なものなどいないのだ。無価値なものなどここにはないのだ。ナナちゃんは囁くようにそう言う。
lines.translated: Everyone who belongs to the "Night" has a "role." Nothing is useless. Nothing here is without value. Nana-chan spoke those words almost like a whisper.

lines.content: ……じゃあ、えっと
lines.translated: "...Then, um."

lines.content: 姫織は目をぱちぱちとさせながら、言う。
lines.translated: Blinking rapidly, Himeori spoke up.

lines.content: ……こんなにもたくさん、いっぱいある星の一つひとつに、私たちの星みたいな世界があるってことなのかな
lines.translated: "...Does that mean that on each and every one of these countless stars, there's a world just like ours?"

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: どの星にもそれぞれの風景を持った“夜の国”がある。あなた達が火星とか水星とか冥王星とか。そう名付けている星々の中にも
lines.translated: "Every star has a 'Land of Night' with its own scenery. Even among the stars you call Mars, or Mercury, or Pluto."

lines.content: でも、この星みたいに“夜”以外の[世界|時間]はないんだよ。あなた達が日頃暮らしている表の世界は、どんな星にも存在していない――
lines.translated: "However, none of them have a world--a time--outside of the 'Night' like this star does. The surface world where you live your daily lives doesn't exist on any other star--"

lines.content: ……だからこの星は特別なんだよ
lines.translated: "...That's why this star is special."

lines.content: ここは命という存在が唯一、肉体を持って産まれることができる星。だからね、どんな命も一度はこの星に産まれたいと願うものだけれど
lines.translated: "This is the only star where the existence known as life can be born with a physical body. That's why every life wishes to be born on this star at least once, although..."

lines.content: ……けれど？
lines.translated: "...Although?"

lines.content: どこか言い含めるようなナナちゃんに、姫織が首をかしげる。
lines.translated: Himeori tilted her head at Nana-chan, who sounded almost as if she were trying to impart a lesson.

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: [現実|表]の世界、[夜|裏]の世界と限らず、命とは誰もがみんな、それぞれ“役割”を持って産まれてくるものだけれど
lines.translated: "Not limited to the surface world of reality or the flip-side world of the Night, every single life is born with its own 'role,' although..."

lines.content: でもね。この星にだけある表の世界、つまり現実世界には、つらいことがあんまりに多いから
lines.translated: "Even so. Because in the surface world that exists only on this star--in other words, the real world--there are just far too many painful things."

lines.content: 思い描くだけで殆どすべてが揃ってしまう――そんな“夜”とは、まったく性質を真逆とする世界がここにはあるから。
lines.translated: Because here, there is a world whose nature is the exact opposite of the "Night," where nearly everything falls into place just by imagining it.

lines.content: だから……。誰もが一度はこの星に産まれてみたいと思うけど、同時に、少なくもない命がもう二度とごめんだとも思ってしまう……
lines.translated: "That's why... while everyone wants to try being born on this star at least once, at the same time, no small number of lives end up thinking they never want to go through it ever again..."

lines.content: ここはそういう星で。あなた達は、そういう星の下に産まれちゃったんだよね
lines.translated: "That's the kind of star this is. And you two happened to be born under such a star."

lines.content: 姫織はきらきら眩しい“夜”の空を見上げている。
lines.translated: Himeori looked up at the dazzlingly sparkling "Night" sky.

lines.content: 時おりその眼差しを細めてみたり、ぱちぱちと瞬きを繰り返してみたり……そして、
lines.translated: Occasionally narrowing her eyes, or blinking over and over... and then,

lines.content: 命にはそれぞれ“役割”がある……
lines.translated: "Every life has its own 'role'..."

lines.content: そしてぽつりと、姫織はそうつぶやく。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured softly to herself.

lines.content: 私にも何か“役割”があるのかな？
lines.translated: "I wonder if I have some kind of 'role,' too?"

lines.content: 姫織はナナちゃんにそう問いかけていた。
lines.translated: Himeori asked Nana-chan.

lines.content: そうだね。きっとあるよ……それを見つけるために色々と挑戦したり、工夫しながら生きてみるのも、なんだか宝探しみたいで楽しいんじゃないかな。……たぶんだけれどね
lines.translated: "Let's see. I'm sure you do... Trying out all sorts of things and figuring out how to live in order to find it might be fun, just like a treasure hunt. ...Probably, anyway."

lines.content: そんなふうにして、それぞれの“役割”を見つけるために、あなた達は何度も何度も生きることをやり直すのかもしれないなって私は思ってるよ――……だけどね
lines.translated: "I think that maybe, in order to find your respective 'roles' like that, you all redo the act of living over and over again--... However."

lines.content: え？　……だけど？
lines.translated: "Huh? ...However?"

lines.content: うん。いくら命は不滅なものなのだとしても。すべての命は、終わることなくぐるぐる巡るのだとしても……
lines.translated: "Yeah. Even if life is something immortal. Even if all lives circle around and around without end..."

lines.content: だけど、今の“あなた”という命の形は今回きりなんだよ。あなたが夜月姫織でいられるのは、この星での制限時間が尽きるまでの間しかない
lines.translated: "Even so, the shape of life that is the current 'you' is for this time only. You can only be Yotsuki Himeori until your time limit on this star runs out."

lines.content: 後悔なんてしないように、やりたいことをやりたいだけやって生きていくのも正解のひとつなんじゃないかな。自分の“役割”なんて、誰かに貰ってもつまらないしね
lines.translated: "Living by doing whatever you want as much as you want so you won't have any regrets might be one right answer, don't you think? After all, it's boring to have your 'role' just handed to you by someone else."

lines.content: それは……えっと……自分のやるべきことは、“役割”は、自分で決めろってこと？
lines.translated: "Does that... um... mean that I should decide what I need to do--my 'role'--for myself?"

lines.content: そうだね。そんな感じだね。……きっと
lines.translated: "Yeah. Something like that. ...Surely."

lines.content: 私たちの命は決して、死なない……
lines.translated: "Our lives never truly die..."

lines.content: 姫織が小さくつぶやき、ナナちゃんが『そうだね』と言う。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured softly, and Nana-chan said, "That's right."

lines.content: [・|こ][・|こ]で死んでも……与えられた制限時間を使い切ってしまっても、また“次”に、どこかの星に産まれ直す。行き先は自由に選べる
lines.translated: "Even if you die *here*... even if you use up the time limit you were given, you'll be reborn again 'next' time, on some other star. You can freely choose your destination."

lines.content: ……あの大きな駅で切符を買って？
lines.translated: "...By buying a ticket at that big station?"

lines.content: そうだよと言い、ナナちゃんはうなずく。
lines.translated: "That's right," Nana-chan said with a nod.

lines.content: それぞれの星にはそれぞれの風景や特性を持った“夜の国”がある。その星の“夜”で生きた経験を持ち、また“次”の“夜”に……時間の中へと移動する
lines.translated: "Each star has a 'Land of Night' with its own scenery and characteristics. Carrying the experiences of living in that star's 'Night,' you move on to the 'next' 'Night'... into time."

lines.content: あなた達はよく“占い”をするでしょう？　何々生まれの何々座、みたいにね
lines.translated: "You all do 'fortune-telling' a lot, right? Like, born in such-and-such month under such-and-such constellation."

lines.content: その殆どはあんまりにも適当というか、うさんくさいものばっかりなんだけれど……。でも決して間違いってわけでもないんだよ
lines.translated: "Most of that is way too arbitrary, or rather, full of sketchy stuff... But it's not necessarily wrong, either."

lines.content: たとえば、水色輝くあの星で過ごしたなら、“次”にまたこの星に産まれ直したときは、やさしく穏やかな性格になりやすい
lines.translated: "For example, if you spent time on that star shining light blue, the 'next' time you're reborn on this star, you're more likely to have a gentle and calm personality."

lines.content: ……真っ赤に燃えるあの星の“夜”で過ごした命は、たぶん、諦めることを知らない強い心を持って、この星に産まれ直したりするんだよ
lines.translated: "...A life that spent its time in the 'Night' of that star burning bright red will probably be reborn on this star with a strong heart that doesn't know how to give up."

lines.content: ……ふぅん。そっか。そう、なんだ
lines.translated: "...Hmm. I see. So that's how it is."

lines.content: そして姫織は、また空に瞬くたくさんの星を仰ぎ見ていた。
lines.translated: Then Himeori once again looked up at the countless stars twinkling in the sky.

lines.content: すべの命は不滅なるもの。
lines.translated: All life is immortal.

lines.content: つまり……人の命は決して死なない、か。
lines.translated: In other words... human lives never die, huh.

lines.content: そこに“希望”を見いだせる人は、きっと今回の人生が幸せだからそう感じられるのだろう――では、果たしてこの俺ならばどうだろう。
lines.translated: Those who can find "hope" in that probably feel that way because their current life is happy--so then, what about someone like me?

lines.content: “人は死なない。何度でも産まれ直すし、それはつまり、何度だってやり直しがきくということ”
lines.translated: "People don't die. They are reborn over and over, which means they can start over as many times as it takes."

lines.content: そんな時間の成り立ちに、俺は“希望”を感じられるだろうか。その答えは当然――……
lines.translated: Could I feel "hope" in a structure of time like that? The answer to that was, naturally--...

lines.content: よし。そろそろ次へ行こうか
lines.translated: "Alright. Shall we head to the next place soon?"

lines.content: ナナちゃんが立ち上がる。そして、俺の中に芽生え始めた夜色めいた心もふわりと消えた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan stood up. And with that, the night-colored feelings beginning to sprout within me floated away and vanished.

lines.content: 次はもう少し楽しい場所で休憩できると思うよ。それまでまたもう少しだけ、がんばろう
lines.translated: "I think we'll be able to take a break at a slightly more fun place next. Let's do our best for just a little longer until then."

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: うなずき、立ち上がる姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded and stood up.

lines.content: しかしその横顔は、やはり相変わらずどこか元気がないようにも見えてしまう。
lines.translated: However, her profile still looked somewhat lacking in energy, just as before.

lines.content: 姫織本人は、頼み事している立場で我がまま言えないから、と言ってはいるものの……。
lines.translated: Even though Himeori herself said it was because she was the one asking for a favor and couldn't be selfish...

lines.content: 今夜の旅は。
lines.translated: Tonight's journey.

lines.content: 一晩限りのこの旅は、姫織の“忘れ物”を探し出すためのもの。
lines.translated: This one-night-only journey is to track down Himeori's "lost items."

lines.content: それらをひとつ残らず探し出せたなら、思い出せないすべてをふくめ、姫織のいつもの元気な笑顔も取り戻せるだろうか。
lines.translated: If we manage to find every single one of them, including everything she can't remember, will we be able to get back Himeori's usual cheerful smile, too?

lines.content: そんなことを何気なく思いながらも、俺はふたりと一緒に列車へと戻った。
lines.translated: As those thoughts casually crossed my mind, I returned to the train with the two of them.

lines.content: 列車は進む。
lines.translated: The train moved forward.

lines.content: まばゆいふたつのライトが“夜”を切り裂き、前へ前へと[・|私]たちを運んでくれる。
lines.translated: Two dazzling lights sliced through the "Night," carrying *us* onward and onward.

lines.content: ……この旅は私の“大切なもの”を取り戻すための旅。一晩限りの不思議の旅だ。
lines.translated: This journey is a journey to take back my "precious thing." A wondrous journey for one night only.

lines.content: “夜の国”に点在する駅やポスト。
lines.translated: The stations and mailboxes scattered across the "Land of Night."

lines.content: 列車に乗車してくるモノたちの切符から。投函された手紙に込められた想いから。
lines.translated: From the tickets of the things boarding the train. From the feelings put into the mailed letters.

lines.content: ほんの[ひとかけら|一欠片]ずと想いの力を分けてもらって……。
lines.translated: Having them share just a single fragment of the power of their feelings at a time...

lines.content: それらの欠片を組み上げ[・|器]を作るのだ。
lines.translated: I will piece those fragments together to make a *vessel*.

lines.content: その器は私が取り戻したいと願う“大切なもの”を宿すためのもの――いわゆる依り代。
lines.translated: That vessel is meant to house the "precious thing" I wish to take back--what you might call a medium.

lines.content: 大丈夫かな。平気かな。
lines.translated: Will it be okay? Will it be alright?

lines.content: ……うまく、作れるかな。
lines.translated: Can I make it well?

lines.content: 慎重に頑張らないと。
lines.translated: I have to be careful and do my best.

lines.content: [・|こ][・|れ]はきっと、人生みたいにやり直しのきかないことだから。
lines.translated: Because *this* is surely something that can't be redone like a life.

lines.content: ガラス瓶に閉じ込めた[願い|想い]のかけら、そのひとつを私は取り出す――まずは、そうだな。
lines.translated: A fragment of feelings--of wishes--sealed inside a glass bottle; I take one of them out--first of all, let's see.

lines.content: あの“駅”に到着したら、まずは手始めに[・|左][・|腕]から購入しよう。
lines.translated: Once we arrive at that "station," let's start by purchasing the *left arm* first.

lines.content: そうして[・|器]を作り出すんだ。
lines.translated: And just like that, I will create the *vessel*.

lines.content: “何かひとつ代償を支払うことで願いを叶えてもらう”
lines.translated: "Having a wish granted by paying a single price."

lines.content: そういう“夜の住人”との契約の元、この旅をはじめようと思った。
lines.translated: Under such a contract with a "resident of the Night," I decided to begin this journey.

lines.content: がたん
lines.translated: *Clack...*

lines.content: ごとん
lines.translated: *Clack...*

lines.content: 今、この列車は、私の願いを叶えるため、[・|あ][・|な][・|た]という名の代償を乗せ、“夜”の学園へと――“刻の終着駅”へと向かってる。
lines.translated: Right now, in order to grant my wish, this train carries a price by the name of *you*, heading toward the academy of the "Night"--toward the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: 今夜が終わるそのときが、私とあなたのお別れのとき。
lines.translated: When tonight comes to an end, that will be the time for you and me to say goodbye.

lines.content: そう思っていたのに。
lines.translated: Even though I thought that.

lines.content: そう思い、覚悟してきたはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though I thought that, and was supposed to have steeled my resolve...

lines.content: ああ、
lines.translated: Ah,

lines.content: まったく。
lines.translated: Honestly.

lines.content: どうかしてる。
lines.translated: Something is wrong with me.

lines.content: それなのに、今頃になって私は、少し――……
lines.translated: Despite that, this late in the game, I'm starting to feel a little--...

lines.content: 次の休憩場所は誰もいない寂れた“夜の遊園地”だった。
lines.translated: The next resting spot was a deserted "Night amusement park" with no one around.

lines.content: ここも、“夜の国”
lines.translated: Here, too, is the "Land of Night."

lines.content: ……その一部。
lines.translated: A part of it.

lines.content: 駅の門をくぐれば遊園地にそのまま繋がっていて……。
lines.translated: Passing through the station gates led directly into the amusement park...

lines.content: うわ～……おかしいね。私たちが歩いてるところだけ明るいよ。光りが追いかけて来るみたい
lines.translated: "Whoa~... That's funny. Only the place we're walking is bright. It's like the light is following us."

lines.content: 姫織が指さす“夜”の空。
lines.translated: Himeori pointed at the "Night" sky.

lines.content: そこから俺たちへと一筋の光りが落ちてくる――まるでスポットライトに照らされているみたいだ。
lines.translated: From up there, a single beam of light fell down onto us--almost as if we were being illuminated by a spotlight.

lines.content: 姫織の言うとおり、俺たちが移動すると光が追いかけてくる。
lines.translated: Just as Himeori said, whenever we moved, the light followed after us.

lines.content: 観覧車などの前を通ると、それらの遊具も俺たちが近づけば、ひとりでにぱちりと灯りがともるのだった。
lines.translated: As we walked past the Ferris wheel and other attractions, their lights flickered on by themselves the moment we drew near.

lines.content: 本当にこの遊具とかで遊んでみても平気なのかな――ナナちゃんにそう確認してみたいけれど、でも、ナナちゃんは列車から外へは出られない。
lines.translated: I wonder if it's really okay for us to play on these rides--I wanted to double-check with Nana-chan, but she can't step outside the train.

lines.content: 今、“夜”の遊園地を歩いているのは俺と姫織のふたりだけだ。
lines.translated: Right now, the only ones walking through the amusement park of the "Night" are Himeori and me.

lines.content: ナナちゃんから遊園地のチケットをもらってる。フリーパスみたいだから、時間が許す限りは何でも乗り放題だって言ってたから……
lines.translated: "We got amusement park tickets from Nana-chan. It looks like an all-access pass, and she said we can ride whatever we want as much as we want while time permits, so..."

lines.content: だから改める必要はない。観覧車などで遊ぶのも、自由だ。
lines.translated: So there's no need to double-check. We're free to play on the Ferris wheel or whatever else.

lines.content: でも、俺は警戒してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: Even so, I couldn't help being on my guard.

lines.content: ちゃんと安全に遊べるものなのだろうか。
lines.translated: Are these rides actually safe to play on?

lines.content: 誰が整備しているのかもわからない。これで遊んでしまって本当に大丈夫なんだろうか。改めてナナちゃんに確認したかったのだけど……。
lines.translated: I don't even know who maintains them. Is it really okay for us to just ride them like this? I wanted to double-check with Nana-chan, though...

lines.content: 乗り放題かー
lines.translated: "Ride as much as we want, huh~"

lines.content: 姫織が目をきらきらさせていた。
lines.translated: Himeori's eyes were sparkling.

lines.content: まさか、ひよちゃん。遊具に興味あるのかな
lines.translated: "Don't tell me, Hiyo-chan. Are you interested in the rides?"

lines.content: それはもう、ありありですねえ
lines.translated: "Oh, very much so, indeed."

lines.content: うんうんと姫織はうなずく。
lines.translated: Himeori nodded eagerly.

lines.content: だってね、私ね、遊園地って……あんましね、来たことなくって
lines.translated: "Because, you know, I've... never really been to an amusement park much before."

lines.content: え？　そうなの……？
lines.translated: "Huh? Really...?"

lines.content: そうなのです。だからとってもテンションあげあげなのだ
lines.translated: "Yes, really. That is why I am super hyped up right now."

lines.content: そっか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: それなら話は別だ。
lines.translated: Well, that changes things.

lines.content: せっかく乗り放題の権利を持ってしまってるんだ。一通りは遊んでみようか――何せ俺たちは最強のフリーパスを持つ者だからね
lines.translated: "Since we've got unlimited ride privileges, let's try out a bit of everything--after all, we're the ones holding the ultimate all-access pass."

lines.content: だから、光りが私たちを照らしてくれる？
lines.translated: "Is that why the light is shining on us?"

lines.content: ああ、そうだね。うん。俺たちは[ゲスト|お客さま]だから、なのかもね
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right. Mhm. Maybe it's because we're honored guests."

lines.content: だからナナちゃんはこのチケットを渡してくれたのだろう。“夜”の暗闇を照らすランタンの代わりだ。
lines.translated: That must be why Nana-chan gave us these tickets. They're a substitute for a lantern to light up the darkness of the "Night."

lines.content: ふたりで“夜”の空を見上げてみる。
lines.translated: The two of us looked up at the "Night" sky.

lines.content: 光りの元を辿ってみると、ぽっかり浮かんだまんまるお月さまなのだとわかった。
lines.translated: Tracing the light back to its source, we realized it was a perfectly round moon floating up there.

lines.content: どれから乗ろうかと姫織に問う。だけど返事がない――どうかしたのかな。ひょいっと顔を覗き込む。
lines.translated: I asked Himeori which one we should ride first. However, there was no answer--I wondered if something was wrong. I peeked at her face.

lines.content: ……じゅるり
涎をだらだら垂らしていた。
lines.translated: She was drooling all over the place.

lines.content: ど、どうしたの
lines.translated: "W-What's wrong?"

lines.content: あそこ……
lines.translated: "Over there..."

lines.content: 姫織の指さす先には屋台があった。
lines.translated: At the end of Himeori's pointing finger was a food stall.

lines.content: あそこから……良き香りがほんわりと
lines.translated: "A wonderful aroma is wafting over... from over there."

lines.content: おお。さすがひよちゃん。お鼻がいいね
lines.translated: "Ooh. Leave it to you, Hiyo-chan. You've got a good nose."

lines.content: 見ると、確かに。
lines.translated: Looking over, she was right.

lines.content: 暗がりにいくつも屋台が並んでいるのが見えた。
lines.translated: I could see a number of food stalls lined up in the dimness.

lines.content: 焼きそばフランクフルトかき氷フライドポテト――等々。
lines.translated: Yakisoba, frankfurters, shaved ice, french fries--and so on.

lines.content: まるで夜市のようなラインナップ。
