lines.content: そんな少しの不穏さを、また俺は思い浮かべてしまったから……。
lines.translated: Because that slight sense of unease had crossed my mind again...

lines.content: ねえ、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Hey, Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: 問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked her.

lines.content: 返事はないだろうと予想しながら、それでもいいと、俺は話し続ける。
lines.translated: Expecting there wouldn't be an answer, and deciding that was fine, I kept talking.

lines.content: 列車の中で言ったこと、覚えてる？
lines.translated: "Do you remember what you said on the train?"

lines.content: ひよちゃん、言ってたよね――“これで最後だから”って
lines.translated: "You said it, didn't you, Hiyo-chan? 'Because this is the last time.'"

lines.content: あのときはさ、別のことにどきどきしてしまってて……ひよちゃんが色々、いっぱい、その……えっと。か、かわいいから。だからそのまま置いておいちゃったけど
lines.translated: "Back then, my heart was pounding over something else... because you were being so, well, um... c-cute, Hiyo-chan. So I just left it at that, though."

lines.content: こんなときに至ってまで、かわいいと口にすることを羞恥する自分が情けない。
lines.translated: It's pathetic how embarrassed I get just saying the word "cute," even at a time like this.

lines.content: やれやれと自分に首を振りながらも、続けた。
lines.translated: Shaking my head at myself in exasperation, I continued.

lines.content: ねえ、ひよちゃん。そのままには絶対しないよって、言ったよね。後から必ず、あのときひよちゃんが口にした言葉の意味を教えてねって
lines.translated: "Hey, Hiyo-chan. I told you I definitely wouldn't just leave it at that, didn't I? I told you to be sure to tell me later what you meant by the words you spoke back then."

lines.content: 今がその後からってことにしてほしいな。
lines.translated: I told her I wanted to make "later" right now.

lines.content: そう言う俺に、やはり姫織は何も言わない。
lines.translated: Even when I said that, Himeori still didn't say a word.

lines.content: ただ、さっきまでさくらの樹を仰いでいた視線を、足下に力なく落としてしまっていた。
lines.translated: She simply let her gaze, which had been looking up at the cherry tree until a moment ago, drop weakly to her feet.

lines.content: 姫織が話してくれるまでいつまでだって待つつもりだった。
lines.translated: I intended to wait forever until Himeori was ready to talk to me.

lines.content: 予感があったのだ。
lines.translated: I had a premonition.

lines.content: 決して聞こえなかったふりで終わらせてしまってはならない――姫織がこぼしたあの言葉の中には、そういう大切な“何か”があるはずだと。
lines.translated: That I must never let this end by pretending I hadn't heard--that there had to be "something" important like that hidden within those words Himeori had let slip.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: ぽつりと、姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Quietly, Himeori spoke a few words.

lines.content: うん。なに？
lines.translated: "Yeah? What is it?"

lines.content: ……あのね、大雅。聞いて、くれる？
lines.translated: "...Um, Taiga. Will you listen to me?"

lines.content: ああ、もちろん
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: なんだって聞くよと俺は言う。
lines.translated: I told her I would listen to anything.

lines.content: ひよちゃんの話ならどんなことでも聞くよ――お願いだって、どんなことでも聞く
lines.translated: "If it's you talking, Hiyo-chan, I'll listen to anything--even if it's a favor, I'll grant anything you ask."

lines.content: ……お願いも？
lines.translated: "...Even a favor?"

lines.content: 姫織は顔を上げる。
lines.translated: Himeori raised her head.

lines.content: そして俺の目を、見た。
lines.translated: And she looked me in the eye.

lines.content: お話だけじゃなくって、どんなお願いでも、聞いてくれるの……？
lines.translated: "Not just listening to me talk, you'll grant any favor I ask...?"

lines.content: うん。聞くよ。聞きまくっちゃうよ。ひよちゃんがまた元気に笑ってくれるなら――どんなことでも
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'll grant it. I'll grant as many as you want. As long as it makes you smile cheerfully again, Hiyo-chan--anything at all."

lines.content: じっと、俺を見つめている。
lines.translated: She stared fixedly at me.

lines.content: その瞳の中に、今、姫織が何を考えているのか答えを探した――……けれど。
lines.translated: I searched within those eyes for an answer to what Himeori was thinking right now--...but.

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"

lines.content: ぽろり、と。
lines.translated: Plop.

lines.content: 姫織の瞳から大粒の涙がひとつ、こぼれたのだ。
lines.translated: A single large teardrop spilled from Himeori's eyes.

lines.content: ありがとう。私のお願い。聞いてくれるんだよね、大雅……
lines.translated: "Thank you. My favor. You'll grant it for me, right, Taiga...?"

lines.content: その涙につい、息を呑んでしまった俺に、
lines.translated: As I caught my breath at the sight of those tears, she spoke to me.

lines.content: “さよなら”
lines.translated: "'Goodbye.'"

lines.content: 姫織は、言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: ……“さよなら”、大雅
lines.translated: "...'Goodbye,' Taiga."

lines.content: 瓶の底に残っていたひと粒の“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を手のひらに取り出して、
lines.translated: Taking the single grain of "star fragment" remaining at the bottom of the bottle out into the palm of her hand,

lines.content: ……最後のパーツは、ここにあるよ
lines.translated: "...The final part is right here."

lines.content: そっと胸に手を当てて……。
lines.translated: She gently placed her hand against her chest...

lines.content: ……お願い。不思議な“夜”を作るさくらの樹。どうか……お願い、します……私の大切なものを、全部、あなたに捧げる。だから。だから……っ
lines.translated: "...Please. O cherry tree that creates the wondrous 'Night.' Please... I beg of you... I will offer everything precious to me to you. So. So...!"

lines.content: 涙をいっぱい、たくさん、次々こぼし……。
lines.translated: Spilling tears, so many of them, one after another...

lines.content: ……どうか、私の“夢”を、叶えてください……っ
lines.translated: "...Please, make my 'dream' come true...!"

lines.content: ……姫織は、繋いでいた俺の手を、離した。
lines.translated: Himeori let go of my hand, which had been joined with hers.

lines.content: ……手を、離してしまった。
lines.translated: I let go of his hand.

lines.content: 大切だったのに。
lines.translated: Even though it was so precious to me.

lines.content: 何よりも。
lines.translated: More than anything.

lines.content: 誰よりも。
lines.translated: More than anyone.

lines.content: 大事で、大切で、大好きでいなければ、ならないものであったはずなのに……。
lines.translated: Even though it was supposed to be something I had to hold dear, cherish, and love above all else...

lines.content: 私は走った。
lines.translated: I ran.

lines.content: 手を離したあなたのことは振り返らずに。
lines.translated: Without looking back at you, after letting go of your hand.

lines.content: 夢中だった。
lines.translated: I was frantic.

lines.content: 走って。
lines.translated: Running.

lines.content: 走って……。
lines.translated: And running...

lines.content: きっと、いっぱいの“罪悪感”をも振り払えたらと願ってた。
lines.translated: Surely, I was wishing I could shake off all the overwhelming "guilt" as well.
*I will take back that precious life.*

lines.content: それが私の“夢”だった。
lines.translated: That was my "dream."

lines.content: “夜”の中で何かを得るなら、同様の価値ある“何か”を差し出さなければならない。それが“夜”のルールだ。
lines.translated: If you wish to obtain something within the "Night," you must offer up "something" of equal value. That is the rule of the "Night."

lines.content: だからあなたの“[命|心臓]”を、“夜”に捧げてしまおうと思っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: That's why I had intended to offer your "life"--your heart--to the "Night," and yet...

lines.content: ごめんね……。
lines.translated: I'm sorry...

lines.content: 一度でも、あなたのことを犠牲にしようと考えた自分が恥ずかしい。
lines.translated: I am ashamed of myself for ever considering sacrificing you, even once.
*I couldn't do it.*

lines.content: 結局、私は、あなたの“[命|心臓]”を“夜”に差し出すことはできなかった――あなたから手を離したのは、あなたのことを、たとえば“夜”の底に突き落とそうとしたためではない。
lines.translated: In the end, I couldn't bring myself to offer your "life"--your heart--to the "Night"--I didn't let go of your hand to cast you down to the bottom of the "Night."

lines.content: 胸元に触れる。
lines.translated: I touch my chest.

lines.content: 鼓動がしない。
lines.translated: There is no heartbeat.

lines.content: 私の“[命|心臓]”はもう既に“夜”の底……。
lines.translated: My "life"--my heart--is already at the bottom of the "Night"...

lines.content: “後悔”はない。
lines.translated: I have no "regrets."

lines.content: “命”を無駄にしたわけではない。
lines.translated: I didn't waste my "life."

lines.content: 自分の“夢”を叶えるのだから、自分の“命”をもやさずしてどうするというのか。
lines.translated: Since it's my own "dream" I'm fulfilling, how could I do anything less than burn my own "life" for it?

lines.content: さよなら……。
lines.translated: Goodbye...

lines.content: そう、つぶやこうと思った。
lines.translated: I tried to murmur those words.

lines.content: だけどもう声が出なかった。
lines.translated: But my voice wouldn't come out anymore.

lines.content: 両手を見れば肉体はただの“影”になっていた。
lines.translated: Looking down at my hands, I saw that my body had become nothing more than a "shadow."

lines.content: ……さようなら。今まで、ありがとう。
lines.translated: Goodbye. Thank you for everything up until now.

lines.content: あなたがいたから、私は今日まで生きてこられた。
lines.translated: It's because you were there that I was able to live until today.

lines.content: 心の中で何度もそうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured that in my heart, over and over again.

lines.content: あとは、そうだな。
lines.translated: As for the rest, well...

lines.content: 私がこの“命”をもやし、“夢”を叶えた後の世界が……。
lines.translated: After I burn this "life" of mine and make my "dream" come true...

lines.content: 私のいない外の世界が、これからどういうふうに変わっていくのか。
lines.translated: How will the outside world change from here on out without me in it?

lines.content: それを見届けられないことだけが気がかりだった。
lines.translated: Not being able to witness that for myself was my only lingering concern.

lines.content: ふと、“夜”の空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I looked up at the sky of the "Night."

lines.content: さくらだ。
lines.translated: Cherry blossoms.

lines.content: 咲かないはずのさくらが咲いている。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms that weren't supposed to bloom were in full flower.

lines.content: きっと、私の“命”をもやして咲いているのだ。
lines.translated: Surely, they were blooming by burning my "life."

lines.content: それはもう、“外”の世界との永遠の別れを意味しているのだと、感じ……。
lines.translated: Sensing that it meant an eternal farewell to the "outside" world...

lines.content: そっと、[まぶた|瞼]を閉じた。
lines.translated: I gently closed my eyelids.

lines.content: すると、今日までの様々な瞬間、瞬間が、はらはらと“夜”に降る花びらみたいに、私の心の中に重なり続けていた。
lines.translated: As I did, all the various moments leading up to today kept piling up within my heart, like petals fluttering down into the "Night."

lines.content: ……どうしようナナちゃん。ひよちゃんが
lines.translated: "...What should I do, Nana-chan? Hiyo-chan..."
*She vanished somewhere*--she let go of my hand, which had been joined with hers.

lines.content: 『……さよなら』
lines.translated: "'...Goodbye.'"

lines.content: そう言った姫織の身体は――[・|花][・|だ]。
lines.translated: As she said that, Himeori's body became--*flowers*.

lines.content: いっぱいの花びらが、内側から弾けるようにして溢れ、姫織は消えた。
lines.translated: Countless petals burst forth from within her, overflowing, and Himeori disappeared.

lines.content: 何か、眩しい光りが辺りを照らすわけでもなく。
lines.translated: No dazzling light illuminated the surroundings.

lines.content: 何か、激しい炸裂音が空気を切り裂くわけでなく。
lines.translated: No violent explosion tore through the air.

lines.content: 俺の前から。一瞬で。……消失。
lines.translated: Right before my eyes. In an instant. ...She vanished.

lines.content: 辺りを探した。探し回った。
lines.translated: I searched the area. I searched everywhere.

lines.content: だが、当然と言うべきなのか見つからない――どこにも。どこにもだ。
lines.translated: However, perhaps unsurprisingly, I couldn't find her--nowhere. She was nowhere to be found.

lines.content: 急いで帰ってきた俺の説明を聞き終えたナナちゃんは、目を細め、小さくため息をつくように肩を落とした。
lines.translated: Having listened to my explanation after I hurried back, Nana-chan narrowed her eyes and dropped her shoulders with what looked like a small sigh.

lines.content: ……どうして気づかなかったんだろう
lines.translated: "...How did I not notice?"

lines.content: 独り言のようにナナちゃんは、言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan spoke as if talking to herself.

lines.content: 思えば……今夜の姫織は、いつもとちょっとだけ様子が違った。本当に、ほんとうに、ちょっとだけだけど
lines.translated: "Come to think of it... Himeori seemed just a little bit different than usual tonight. Really, truly, just a tiny bit, though."

lines.content: あの子は何か……“願い”を叶えるために、自分の“命”を“夜”に捧げたんだよ
lines.translated: "That girl... she offered her own 'life' to the 'Night' in order to grant some kind of 'wish.'"

lines.content: 今夜は何か、大雅にお願いしたいことがあるから……だから謙虚にしているんだよって。そう言うあの子の言葉に、何も疑いを抱かなかった
lines.translated: "She told me she had a favor to ask of you tonight, Taiga... and that was why she was acting so modest. I didn't doubt her words for a second."

lines.content: 集めて回った“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”で、十年前の“忘れ物”を取り戻す――そんなあの子の言葉を信じてしまった
lines.translated: "She said she was going to use the 'star fragments' she gathered to take back something she 'left behind' ten years ago--and I believed her."
"*Maybe Himeori intended to do this right from the very beginning*..."
Nana-chan hung her head, saying she should have been able to notice--*no, she had to have noticed*.

lines.content: 俺もだ。
lines.translated: Me too.

lines.content: ナナちゃんの独り言を聞いている俺も、思ってしまう。
lines.translated: Listening to Nana-chan's soliloquy, I couldn't help thinking the same thing.

lines.content: 『今夜で最後だから……』
lines.translated: "'Because tonight is the last time...'"

lines.content: 聞き逃せやしなかった姫織のあのつぶやきだ。
lines.translated: It was that murmur of Himeori's, which hadn't escaped my ears.

lines.content: それを追求しようとしたところで、姫織は消えた。
lines.translated: Just as I was about to press her on it, Himeori vanished.

lines.content: もっと早く、姫織の真意を問うていればよかった。
lines.translated: I should have asked Himeori about her true intentions much sooner.

lines.content: そうすれば姫織が何を考えていたかくらいは――どんな問題を抱えていたかくらいは、わかったかもしれないのに。
lines.translated: If I had, I might have at least understood what Himeori was thinking--what kind of problem she was carrying.

lines.content: ふたりで一緒に、その問題を解決するための方法を、考えてみるくらいのことはできたかも、しれないのに――“後悔”だ。“後悔”してる。
lines.translated: Then the two of us might have at least been able to try thinking of a way to solve that problem together--it's "regret." I'm filled with "regret."

lines.content: 俺たちの生きる時間はいつも、数え切れない“後悔”ばかりで溢れてる。
lines.translated: The time we live through is always overflowing with countless "regrets."

lines.content: 私も、ついて行けば良かった
lines.translated: "I should have gone with you two, as well."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは言う。いっぱいの“後悔”を滲ませた声で。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said, her voice thick with "regret."

lines.content: ……姫織がここで、“刻の終着駅”で購入したらしい人形は、“命の持ち時間”を――
lines.translated: "...The doll Himeori apparently bought here at the 'Terminal Station of Time' is something needed to take 'someone' whose 'allotted lifespan'--"

lines.content: ――つまり寿命のすべてを終えしてしまった“何者”かを、現実世界に産まれ直させるために必要なものなんだ
lines.translated: "--in other words, someone who has lived out the entirety of their natural life, and have them be reborn into the real world."

lines.content: 産まれ直し……
lines.translated: "Reborn..."

lines.content: その言葉には聞き覚えがある。
lines.translated: That word sounded familiar.

lines.content: どころか、つい先日、自身が口にした言葉でさえあった――十夜のお友だちだ。
lines.translated: In fact, it was a word I had spoken myself just the other day--regarding Toya's friends.

lines.content: ふたりの場合は“現実世界”ではなく“夜”の中だ。
lines.translated: In their case, it wasn't into the "real world," but within the "Night."

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”として産まれ直すため、“刻の終着駅”でどういう“[イキモノ|次]”に産まれるのかを、十夜と話し合っていたはずだ。
lines.translated: In order to be reborn as "Creatures of the Night," they had been discussing with Toya at the "Terminal Station of Time" what kind of "next creature" they would be born as.

lines.content: そのために必要なのは、“駅”に並ぶそれぞれの店で、それぞれ人形のパーツを買い……最後に、さくらだよ
lines.translated: "What's required for that is buying each of the doll's parts at the various shops lining the 'Station'... and finally, the cherry tree."

lines.content: ナナちゃんは、車窓の向こうにそびえ立つ姿が、遠目に窺える[・|そ][・|れ]見つる目を細めた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan narrowed her eyes, gazing at *it*--the towering figure visible in the distance beyond the train window.

lines.content: ……あのさくらに“[命|心臓]”を差し出す。そうすると、[・|器]は完成する。一度死んだ何者かを、“現実世界”へ呼び戻すための器が
lines.translated: "...You offer a 'life'--a heart--to that cherry tree. When you do, the *vessel* is completed. A vessel to call someone who once died back into the 'real world.'"

lines.content: ……ただ、“夜”の中から取り戻したいと願う“何者”かと、同等ほど大切に想う“命”でなければならないけれど
lines.translated: "...However, it has to be a 'life' that you cherish just as deeply as the 'someone' you wish to take back from within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: 姫織が作っていたのはまさにそれだろうと、ナナちゃんは言う。姫織が大切に想う“何者”かを“夜”の中から取り戻すための[依り代|器]だ。
lines.translated: What Himeori had been making was surely that very thing, Nana-chan said. A vessel to take back "someone" Himeori cherished deeply from within the "Night."

lines.content: ……姫織がいったい何者のことを失い、何者のことを“夜”の中から取り戻そうとしたのかは、わからないけれど――姫織は自分の“[命|心臓]”を“夜”に捧げたんだ
lines.translated: "...I don't know who on earth Himeori lost, or who she was trying to take back from within the 'Night'--but Himeori offered her own 'life,' her heart, to the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ばかだよ、とナナちゃんは小さくこぼした。そして唇を噛みしめている。
lines.translated: "She's an idiot," Nana-chan let slip softly, biting her lip.

lines.content: ――あなた自身が“[命|心臓]”を捧げてしまったら、自分の“夢”が本当に叶ったのかさえわからないじゃないか
lines.translated: "--If you offer up your own 'life' and heart, you won't even know if your 'dream' really came true or not!"

lines.content: 姫織はいったい、“何者”を取り戻したいと願ったのだろう。
lines.translated: Who on earth had Himeori wished to take back?

lines.content: 人形……。
lines.translated: A doll...

lines.content: 姫織がその“何者”かを取り戻そうと作った例の器は、今、俺が抱きかかえている。
lines.translated: I was currently holding the very vessel Himeori had made in order to take back that "someone."

lines.content: 抱えた腕から、心臓の鼓動が微かに伝わってきた。
lines.translated: Through the arms cradling it, I could faintly feel the beating of a heart.

lines.content: 今、この人形は、姫織が大切に想う“何者”かに産まれ直そうとしているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Right now, was this doll about to be reborn as the "someone" Himeori cherished so deeply?

lines.content: どくり、どくりと、心臓の音がする。
lines.translated: *Ba-dump, ba-dump*, went the sound of the heart.

lines.content: ……正直なところ、気味の良い感触ではない。
lines.translated: To be honest, it wasn't a pleasant sensation.

lines.content: ……朝が来ると、人形も目覚める
lines.translated: "...When morning comes, the doll will wake up, too."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそう言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said.

lines.content: そのとき“何者”かは“夜”の外で、新しい命として産まれ直すだろう。
lines.translated: At that time, "someone" would be reborn outside the "Night" as a new life.

lines.content: その瞬間までに、人形の中に閉じ込められた姫織の“[命|心臓]”を、本人に返すことができなければ――姫織は永遠に“夜”の中を彷徨うことになる。
lines.translated: If we couldn't return Himeori's "life"--her heart--trapped inside the doll back to her before that moment arrived--Himeori would end up wandering through the "Night" for all eternity.

lines.content: 私はてっきり、姫織はさ、“夜”の中で集めて回った“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”で、もっと別の“夢”を叶えようとしてたんだろうと、勝手に決めつけて安心してた
lines.translated: "I just went and assumed on my own that Himeori was trying to grant some other 'dream' using the 'star fragments' she gathered in the 'Night,' and felt relieved."

lines.content: たとえば、金や銀の硬貨よりも価値ある“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”で、生まれついての方向音痴を直したい。
lines.translated: For example, using the "star fragments," which were more valuable than gold or silver coins, to fix her natural-born terrible sense of direction.

lines.content: たとえば、いつも空腹ばっかり感じることをどうにかしたい。
lines.translated: Or for example, wanting to do something about how she always felt hungry all the time.

lines.content: そういった生きていくのに不便なものを書き換えたい――姫織はそう望んでいるのではないか。根拠も何もないのに、思い込んでしまっていた。
lines.translated: Wanting to rewrite those inconvenient parts of daily life--wasn't that what Himeori was wishing for? Even though she had no basis for it whatsoever, she had convinced herself of that.

lines.content: ……あの子が何か、自分を犠牲にしてまで何かを成そうと、そう考えていただなんて――そんな“覚悟”を持って、今夜の“夜”にやって来ていたなんて。信じられない。今でもそうだよ
lines.translated: "...To think that girl was planning to accomplish something even at the cost of sacrificing herself--that she came to the 'Night' tonight carrying that kind of 'resolve.' I can't believe it. Even now, I still can't."

lines.content: 姫織は今、自身の“[命|心臓]”を捧げ、存在そのものが“夜”の一部になってしまっているはずだとナナちゃんは言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said that by offering up her own "life"--her heart--Himeori's very existence must have become a part of the "Night" by now.

lines.content: “影”だ。
lines.translated: A "shadow."

lines.content: 姫織は今、“夜”のそこここに行き交うあの“影”となってしまった。
lines.translated: Himeori had now become one of those "shadows" drifting here and there throughout the "Night."

lines.content: 永遠に“夜”の中を、幸福だった時間を探し求め、さまよい歩くばかり――そんな記憶の結晶体と呼んでもいいかもしれない。
lines.translated: Doing nothing but wandering eternally through the "Night," searching for the times when she was happy--you could perhaps call it a crystallization of memory.

lines.content: 自身の“夢”を叶えるために、そんな“何か”に成りはててしまった姫織――俺の幼馴染み、夜月姫織。
lines.translated: In order to make her own "dream" come true, Himeori hadbeen reduced to "something" like that--my childhood friend, Yotsuki Himeori.

lines.content: 俺は手のひらを見る。
lines.translated: I looked down at the palm of my hand.
It's a "promise"...

lines.content: 必ずだ。
lines.translated: No matter what.

lines.content: ひよちゃん。
lines.translated: Hiyo-chan.

lines.content: もし[・|こ][・|れ]が、君自身がどうしてもと望んだことであったとしても――必ず俺が、君のことを見つけてみせるから。
lines.translated: Even if *this* is what you yourself wished for above all else--I will definitely find you, no matter what.

lines.content: 拳を握り、俺は満開に咲いたさくらの樹を見上げた。
lines.translated: Clenching my fist, I looked up at the cherry tree blooming in full glory.

lines.content: ……おかしいな。
lines.translated: That's strange.

lines.content: 昔のことを少し思い出したくなった。
lines.translated: I felt like remembering the past for a little while.

lines.content: ――[・|そ][・|の][・|少][・|女][・|た][・|ち]の話を聞かされたのはいつ頃のことだっただろう。
lines.translated: --When was it that I had been told the story of *those girls*?

lines.content: そして誰の口から、私はその子たちの運命について話して聞かされたのだろうか。
lines.translated: And from whose lips had I heard tell of those girls' fate?

lines.content: いつも暗闇の中に閉じ込められたまま、息を、そして心を殺すかのようにして生きていた幼いばかりな私にとって、[・|そ][・|れ]を明確なものにするのは困難なことだった。
lines.translated: For a child as young as I was back then, always locked away in the dark and living as if stifling both my breath and my heart, it was difficult to recall *that* clearly.

lines.content: しかしその少女たちの話は、いつまでも忘れられず胸の中に在り続けている。
lines.translated: Yet the story of those girls remained unforgettable, lingering forever inside my chest.

lines.content: 遠いとおい昔。
lines.translated: A long, long time ago.
It was said that *several girls saved this town*.

lines.content: かつてこの町は壊滅的な被害に遭っていた。
lines.translated: Once, this town suffered catastrophic damage.

lines.content: さくらの花が咲いて、咲いて、咲き乱れ……。
lines.translated: The cherry blossoms bloomed, and bloomed, and bloomed in wild profusion...

lines.content: どういうわけだか、春が過ぎても花が枯れることはなく、咲いては散ってを繰り返し……。
lines.translated: For whatever reason, the flowers never withered even after spring had passed, endlessly repeating the cycle of blooming and scattering...

lines.content: その花びらが町を覆った。
lines.translated: Those petals covered the town.

lines.content: まるで溶けない雪のように降り積もったその花は、町のすべてを桃色の底に沈めてしまった。
lines.translated: Piling up like snow that would never melt, the blossoms sank the entire town to the bottom of a pink sea.

lines.content: 作物は育たず。隣町からも隔絶され。町の人々は、生に喘いだ。
lines.translated: Crops wouldn't grow. Cut off from neighboring towns, the townspeople gasped for survival.

lines.content: そんな現象を神の怒りと信じた大昔の人々は、この町で一番大きなさくらの樹に、少女たちの命を捧げることにした――それは津々浦々、よくある人柱についての伝承だった。
lines.translated: The people of that distant past, believing this phenomenon to be the wrath of the gods, decided to offer the lives of young girls to the largest cherry tree in town--a legend of human sacrifice common throughout the land.

lines.content: 怒れる大自然の神々を鎮めるために、うら若くうつくしい少女たちの命を捧げるのだ。
lines.translated: To appease the angry gods of nature, they would offer up the lives of young, beautiful girls.

lines.content: この町に伝わる[・|そ][・|れ]も、少女たちが生け贄にされたことで、いつまでも満開だったさくらの花は枯れていき、町にいつもの風景が戻ったのだとされている。
lines.translated: According to *that* legend passed down in this town, once the girls were sacrificed, the perpetually full-blooming cherry blossoms withered away, and the town's usual scenery returned.

lines.content: たいていの場合、そうした形で歌い継がれる伝承の裏には、聞くに堪えない悲惨な[真実|物語]が存在する。
lines.translated: In most cases, behind legends passed down in song like that lies a tragic truth--a story--too unbearable to hear.

lines.content: さくらが咲いては枯れることなく降り積もる――という、一見うつくしくも思える創作で、その凄惨さをひた隠しにしようという意図があるのだろう。
lines.translated: The seemingly beautiful fabrication of cherry blossoms blooming and piling up without ever withering was likely intended to thoroughly conceal the sheer horror of it all.

lines.content: きっと、この町にも、少女たちが涙を呑まざるを得なかった悲惨な物語があったはず。
lines.translated: Surely, this town too must have had a tragic story where those girls were forced to swallow their tears.

lines.content: 真実を知る術はもはやどこにもないけれど……。
lines.translated: Though there is no longer any way to know the truth...

lines.content: だけど、人生でもっとも光り輝く時間と共に、その命を食い物にされた少女たちの“想い”は、今もなお、私たちのすぐそばに残り続けている――
lines.translated: Even so, the "feelings" of the girls whose lives were preyed upon during the most radiant time of their youth continue to remain right beside us, even now--

lines.content: 少女たちは願った。……思い描いた。
lines.translated: The girls wished. ...They envisioned it.

lines.content: 今度産まれてくるときは、こんなふうにつらく、理不尽なことが許される世界は嫌だ。
lines.translated: The next time we're born, we don't want a world that allows such painful, unreasonable things to happen.

lines.content: [・|想][・|像][・|以][・|上]の楽しいことが溢れている世界であってほしい。
lines.translated: We want it to be a world overflowing with fun things *beyond imagination*.

lines.content: 集められた少女たちは誰もが産まれながら、とても豊かな“想像力”に恵まれていた。[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|血][・|筋][・|に][・|産][・|ま][・|れ][・|た][・|子][・|ら][・|で][・|あ][・|っ][・|た]。
lines.translated: Every single one of the girls gathered there had been blessed from birth with a very rich "imagination." *They were children born into such a bloodline*.

lines.content: 現実世界という[時間|空間]が少女らのキャンバスだった。
lines.translated: The space of the real world--its very time--was their canvas.

lines.content: “想像力”を現実の内に具現化させるなどして、まだまだ歌や絵や、物語といった娯楽に乏しい時代を、様々に彩り、町の人たちを楽しませていた。
lines.translated: By manifesting their "imagination" into reality, they brought all kinds of color to an era still poor in entertainment like songs, paintings, and stories, delighting the people of the town.

lines.content: そんな[力|不思議]を恐れた大人たちは、少女らの家系を根絶やしにしようと考えた。さくらの樹の異常気象はすべて、少女たちの悪魔的な“[魔法|想像力]”のせいなのだとして。
lines.translated: Fearing such wondrous power, the adults plotted to eradicate the girls' bloodline entirely. They claimed the abnormal weather surrounding the cherry tree was all the fault of the girls' demonic "imagination"--their "magic."

lines.content: 少女らは息絶えるとき、願った。……思い描いた。
lines.translated: As the girls breathed their last, they wished. ...They envisioned it.

lines.content: 死後の世界はこう[・|あ][・|っ][・|た][・|ら][・|い][・|い][・|な]と、幸福な光景を“夜”のスクリーンに映し出しながら、最期を迎えていった。
lines.translated: Thinking *how nice it would be* if the afterlife were like this, they projected happy scenes onto the screen of the "Night" as they met their end.

lines.content: その中には、自分たちにだけ不幸を押しつけた大人に、最大の不幸が訪れますようにと願った少女もまた、少なからずいた――
lines.translated: Among them, there were also more than a few girls who wished for the greatest misfortune to befall the adults who had forced misfortune upon them alone--

lines.content: 大人たちが栄華を極め、幸せの絶頂にあるときにこそ、彼ら彼女らに破滅が訪れますようにと。
lines.translated: Praying that ruin would visit those men and women at the very height of their prosperity and the peak of their happiness.

lines.content: 少女たちを生き埋めにしてしまった大人たちは、それぞれ、凄惨な死を遂げたという“噂”だ。
lines.translated: According to "rumor," the adults who buried the girls alive each met a gruesome death.

lines.content: [・|私]はその少女たちの子孫である。
lines.translated: *I* am a descendant of those girls.

lines.content: だからいつか、その少女たちと同じように、この命を“夜”に捧げなければならない――少女たちが思い描いた“次の世界”を[・|未][・|来][・|へ][・|と][・|繋][・|ぐ][・|そ][・|の][・|た][・|め][・|に]。
lines.translated: Therefore, someday, just like those girls, I must offer this life to the "Night"--*in order to connect the "next world" those girls envisioned to the future*.

lines.content: 私は大人たちにそう言い聞かせられ、暗闇の底で、育った。
lines.translated: I was told that over and over by the adults as I grew up at the bottom of the darkness.

lines.content: タイムリミットは朝が来るまで。それで、いいんだね。ナナちゃん
lines.translated: "The time limit is until morning comes. That's right, isn't it, Nana-chan?"

lines.content: いっぱいの“夜のイキモノ”たちが行き交う駅に佇み、俺は隣のナナちゃんへ問いかけた。
lines.translated: Standing in the station where countless "Creatures of the Night" came and went, I asked Nana-chan beside me.

lines.content: それまでにひよちゃんを――姫織を、見つけられなければ。もう二度と、姫織を“夜”の中から救い出すことはできない
lines.translated: "If we can't find Hiyo-chan--Himeori--by then, we'll never be able to rescue her from the 'Night' again."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: そのとおりだとナナちゃんは、言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said that was exactly right.

lines.content: 胸元には姫織が造り上げた[人形|器]を抱いている。
lines.translated: Against my chest, I cradled the vessel--the doll--that Himeori had crafted.

lines.content: そこに閉じ込められた姫織の“[命|心臓]”
lines.translated: Trapped inside it was Himeori's "life"--her "heart."

lines.content: それを姫織に返すには……、
lines.translated: In order to return it to Himeori...

lines.content: ……今、“夜”の中を彷徨ういっぱいの“影”たち。そのひとりになってしまってるだろう姫織を見つけ出すこと
lines.translated: "...Right now, there are lots of 'shadows' wandering through the 'Night.' We have to find Himeori, who has likely become one of them."

lines.content: そして“[命|心臓]”を返す。朝までにそれを行えなければ……大雅の言うとおり、姫織は二度と戻って来れない
lines.translated: "And then return her 'life'--her 'heart.' If we can't do that by morning... just as you said, Taiga, Himeori will never be able to come back."

lines.content: 代わりに……。
lines.translated: Instead...

lines.content: 姫織の代わりに、この人形が、外の世界で姫織の居場所を奪い、産まれ直すことになる
lines.translated: "In Himeori's place, this doll will steal Himeori's place in the outside world and be reborn."

lines.content: 姫織の居場所を、奪う……？
lines.translated: "Steal Himeori's place...?"

lines.content: 夜月神社の長女であり、奏大雅の幼馴染みである少女。そういう存在に、“何者”かが成り代わる。そういうことだよ
lines.translated: "The eldest daughter of Yotsuki Shrine, and the girl who is Kanade Taiga's childhood friend. 'Someone' will take her place and become that existence. That's what it means."

lines.content: この人形が“誰”になるのかはわからない。“何者”が姫織の[・|居][・|場][・|所][・|を][・|生][・|き][・|る]のかも当然、わからない。
lines.translated: I didn't know "who" this doll would become. And naturally, I didn't know "who" would *live in Himeori's place*, either.

lines.content: ……わからないが。
lines.translated: I didn't know, but.

lines.content: 姫織の命を引き替えにしてまで手にしなければならないものなどないはずだ。
lines.translated: There shouldn't be anything in this world that must be obtained at the cost of Himeori's life.

lines.content: ごめん、ひよちゃん。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Hiyo-chan.

lines.content: 君がそうまでした覚悟を、土足で踏みつけるような行為になるかもしれないが――俺は君を取り戻したいと思ってる。たったひとりで“外”へ帰るわけにはいかない。
lines.translated: This might be like trampling all over the resolve you went so far to make--but I want to take you back. There's no way I can return to the "outside" all by myself.

lines.content: 朝が来るまで……
lines.translated: "Until morning comes..."

lines.content: あと二、三時間といったところか。
lines.translated: About two or three hours left, maybe.

lines.content: 時計塔の指し示す数字を見上げていた。
lines.translated: I looked up at the numbers indicated on the clock tower.

lines.content: ナナちゃん。一緒に姫織を探してくれるかな……
lines.translated: "Nana-chan. Will you help me look for Himeori...?"

lines.content: 列車から一歩、外に出て――俺は車内を振り返っていた。
lines.translated: Taking a step out of the train--I looked back inside the car.

lines.content: ナナちゃん……？
lines.translated: "Nana-chan...?"

lines.content: もちろんだよと、そんな返答があるとばかり思ってた。
lines.translated: I had fully expected her to reply with an "Of course."

lines.content: だけど、ナナちゃんは、
lines.translated: However, Nana-chan...

lines.content: ……ううん
ふるふると、小さな頭を横に振っていた。
lines.translated: She was slowly shaking her small head from side to side.
"...I can't go. *Not together with you, Taiga.*"

lines.content: ど、どうして
lines.translated: "W-Why?"

lines.content: ちょっと待って。何か、勘違いしてそうだけど……違う。手分けをしようって話だよ
lines.translated: "Wait a second. You look like you're getting the wrong idea... That's not it. I'm saying we should split up."

lines.content: 大雅は駅の中を探して。私は、その周辺を探すから
lines.translated: "Taiga, you search inside the station. I'll search the surrounding area."

lines.content: あ、ああ
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah."

lines.content: 必ずしも駅の中にいるとは限らない。……“影”となった命は生きていた頃に幸せだった時間を求めてさまよい歩く。もう既に町のほうへ歩いて行ってしまってるかもしれない
lines.translated: "She isn't necessarily inside the station. ...A life that has become a 'shadow' wanders around seeking the times they were happy when they were alive. She might have already started walking toward the town."
"That's why we're splitting up. *The time limit is until morning comes.*"

lines.content: ナナちゃんは[・|い][・|く][・|つ][・|か][・|の][・|注][・|意][・|点]を俺へと言い残し、すぐさま列車を走らせ、去って行った。
lines.translated: Leaving me with *a few points of caution*, Nana-chan immediately started the train and departed.

lines.content: ひよちゃん……。どんなに見つけにくいところに迷い込んでしまったとしても……必ずだ。俺が必ず、迎えに行くから
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan... No matter how hard-to-find a place you've wandered into... I promise. I'll definitely come to get you."

lines.content: 俺は、手のひらをぎゅっと握りしめた。
lines.translated: I clenched my hand tightly into a fist.

lines.content: 物心ついたときにはすでに私は[・|そ][・|こ]にいた。
lines.translated: By the time I was old enough to be aware of things, I was already there.

lines.content: ……大きなお屋敷だった。
lines.translated: It was a big mansion.

lines.content: 一日のすべてをそこで過ごした。
lines.translated: I spent every single part of my day there.

lines.content: 産まれてから一度も外へ出たことはない。
lines.translated: Since the day I was born, I had never once gone outside.

lines.content: お屋敷の外に[・|こ][・|こ]とは違う世界があることも私は知らずに育った。
lines.translated: I grew up without even knowing that a world different from *here* existed outside the mansion.

lines.content: ……この世界のすべてには条件がある
lines.translated: "...Everything in this world has a condition."

lines.content: 誰かが繰り返し小さな私に言った。
lines.translated: Someone repeated that to the tiny me over and over.

lines.content: あなたは私たちの願いを叶えるための条件なんだ
lines.translated: "You are the condition to grant our wish."

lines.content: だから私はこうして、[・|そ][・|の][・|と][・|き]が来るまでこのお屋敷で生かされている――そう何度も、何度となく、囁かれていた。
lines.translated: That was why I was being kept alive in this mansion like this until *that time* came--it was whispered to me so many times, over and over again.

lines.content: だけど幼いばかりのあの頃の私には、“さみしい”以外の感情など理解できるはずもなかった。
lines.translated: But back then, when I was still so young, there was no way I could understand any emotion other than "lonely."

lines.content: ……お父さんとお母さんが私に会いに来てくれるのは一週間に一度ほど。
lines.translated: Father and Mother came to see me about once a week.

lines.content: 最初はふたりのことが誰だかわからなかった。
lines.translated: At first, I didn't know who the two of them were.

lines.content: ふたりが私のお父さんとお母さんであることを教えてくれたのは、いつもそばで私のお世話をしてくれていたおばあさんだった。
lines.translated: It was the old woman who always stayed by my side and took care of me who told me that they were my father and mother.

lines.content: 大きなおおきなお屋敷で、私はそのおばあさんとふたりきりで過ごしていた。
lines.translated: In that big, huge mansion, I spent my days all alone with that old woman.

lines.content: 長いながい一日だ。
lines.translated: It was a long, long day.

lines.content: お屋敷の本棚にあるいっぱいの絵本を読んで過ごすだけの時間。
lines.translated: Time spent doing nothing but reading the many picture books on the mansion's bookshelves.

lines.content: おばあさんは私とは話さない。
lines.translated: The old woman didn't speak to me.

lines.content: ただ時間通りにご飯を作り、着替えを私の部屋の前にきちんと折りたたんで置いていく。
lines.translated: She simply made meals on schedule and left neatly folded changes of clothes in front of my room.

lines.content: それだけだ。
lines.translated: That's all.

lines.content: 話しかけてみても嫌そうな顔をするばかりで、私と目も合わせようとはしなかった。
lines.translated: Even when I tried talking to her, she only made a disgusted face and wouldn't even meet my eyes.

lines.content: 一緒に暮らしていても互いに名前も知らない。そもそも私に名前はなかった。
lines.translated: Even though we lived together, we didn't know each other's names. To begin with, I didn't have a name.

lines.content: ある日、絵本の中に読めない漢字を見つけて、おばあさんになんて読むのと聞いてみた。
lines.translated: One day, I found a kanji character I couldn't read in a picture book, and I asked the old woman how to read it.

lines.content: すると、おばあさんは、
lines.translated: When I did, the old woman...

lines.content: その答えを教える代わりに、あんたは私に何を教えてくれるのか――“何か”を得るなら同様の支払いが必要なんだ。覚えておけ
lines.translated: "In exchange for teaching you the answer, what will you teach me?--If you want to gain 'something,' an equal payment is required. Remember that."

lines.content: と言って、目を細めた。
lines.translated: Saying that, she narrowed her eyes.

lines.content: そしておばあさんは私を置いて、自分の寝室に入ると大きな音を立てて鍵をした。
lines.translated: Then the old woman left me behind, went into her own bedroom, and locked the door with a loud clatter.

lines.content: 夜。
lines.translated: Night.

lines.content: ……眠れない夜。
lines.translated: A sleepless night.

lines.content: 虫の声がする。お屋敷が風に軋む音がする。閉ざされた扉を前に、取り残された私の心臓が、きりきりと、痛んだ。
lines.translated: I could hear the voices of insects. I could hear the mansion creaking in the wind. Left behind in front of the closed door, my heart ached with a sharp, piercing pain.

lines.content: そのとき私は“さみしい”という気持ちを学んだのだ。
lines.translated: That was when I learned the feeling called "lonely."

lines.content: ……週に一度、私に会いにやって来るお父さんとお母さん。
lines.translated: Once a week, Father and Mother came to see me.

lines.content: それは私のことを心配したり、私と話をするためにやって来るわけではない。
lines.translated: They didn't come because they were worried about me, or to talk with me.

lines.content: ふたりは私に目も合わせず、私を“それ”とか“あれ”とか“これ”と呼び、おばあさんと何か話して帰って行くだけだった。
lines.translated: Without even meeting my eyes, the two of them called me "it" or "that" or "this," spoke about something with the old woman, and simply went home.

lines.content: さみしい。
lines.translated: I'm lonely.

lines.content: そんな気持ちは、小さな私の代わりに日に日に大きくおおきく育っていった。
lines.translated: Those feelings grew bigger and bigger day by day, in place of the tiny me.

lines.content: ……姫織！
lines.translated: "...Himeori!"

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.

lines.content: どこにいるんだ……っ
lines.translated: "Where are you...?!"

lines.content: 不思議な駅を走り回り、俺は何度も叫んでいた。
lines.translated: Running around the mysterious station, I shouted out over and over again.

lines.content: しかし、この声が姫織へ届くことはないと知っている。
lines.translated: However, I knew my voice would never reach Himeori.

lines.content: 姫織は今、近くとも何より遠い場所にいる――“影”だ。
lines.translated: Right now, even if she was close by, Himeori was in a place further away than anywhere else--she was a "Shadow."

lines.content: 巨大な駅の構内を行き交い、すぐ近くをすれ違っていくたくさんの“影”
lines.translated: Countless "Shadows" came and went through the massive station concourse, brushing right past me.

lines.content: “[命|心臓]”を失った姫織は、その内のひとりとなってしまってる――彼らは死者だ。
lines.translated: Having lost her "heart"--her life--Himeori had become one of them. They were the dead.

lines.content: 生前、幸せだったほんの短い瞬間をもう一度求め、“夜”を永遠に彷徨い続ける“想い”の残響。
lines.translated: Echoes of "feelings" wandering the "Night" for eternity, seeking just one more taste of a brief, happy moment from when they were alive.

lines.content: それが“[彼ら|影]”だ。
lines.translated: That was what "they"--the "Shadows"--were.

lines.content: 生者の世界に――“夜の外”に未練を残したまま寿命を得てしまった魂なのだ。
lines.translated: Souls that had reached the end of their lifespans while still harboring regrets in the world of the living--"outside the Night."

lines.content: 十夜と一緒に“悪夢のかけら”を集めて回ったとき、家の窓から覗いた“影”たちの家。
lines.translated: When I went around collecting "Nightmare Shards" with Toya, we had peeked through the windows of the "Shadows'" houses.

lines.content: 姫織もどこかであんなふうに、幸せだったのだろういつかの時間を一秒、一秒、繰り返しながら――外の世界を、“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”を忘却し続けているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Was Himeori somewhere out there doing the same thing, repeating some happy moment from her past second by second--all while continuing to forget the outside world, the "time of the sun"?

lines.content: 姫織……
lines.translated: "Himeori..."

lines.content: 今、肩を掠めていった“影”がもしかしたら[・|そ][・|う]かもしれない。
lines.translated: The "Shadow" that just brushed past my shoulder might have *been* her.

lines.content: 振り返り、その背中を追った。
lines.translated: I turned around and chased after that back.

lines.content: だが一見するだけではわからない。
lines.translated: But I couldn't tell just from a glance.

lines.content: 誰もがうつむきがちな顔を覗き込んでも、その表情は真っ黒に染まってしまっている。
lines.translated: Everyone had their heads垂led down, and even when I peered into their faces, their expressions were dyed pitch black.

lines.content: 顔だけではなく身体全体が暗闇だった。そのシルエットだけでは、その人が何者であるかを判断するのは難しい。
lines.translated: Not just their faces, but their entire bodies were darkness. From a silhouette alone, it was difficult to judge who a person was.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: たった、一度だけだなんて……
lines.translated: "Only once... I only get one chance..."

lines.content: 姫織を“夜”の底から引き上げるチャンスはたった一度だ。
lines.translated: I only had a single chance to pull Himeori up from the depths of the "Night."

lines.content: 二手に分かれる前に、ナナちゃんがそう教えてくれていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan had told me so before we split up into two groups.

lines.content: 『姫織だと思う“影”の肩に触れるんだ。大雅。あなたのその手で。……“夜”と現実とを繋ぐ、その“左手”で』
lines.translated: "Touch the shoulder of the 'Shadow' you think is Himeori, Taiga. With that hand of yours... With that 'left hand' that connects the 'Night' and reality."

lines.content: 『そうすれば、人形に閉じ込められた“[命|心臓]”が、その手のひらから姫織の身体に戻り、姫織は“夜”の中から帰ってこられるはずだよ――』
lines.translated: "If you do that, the 'heart'--the life--trapped inside the doll will return to Himeori's body through your palm, and she should be able to come back from within the 'Night'--"

lines.content: ただし、チャンスは一度だけだとナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: However, Nana-chan said I would only get one chance.
"Once..."

lines.content: 『そうだよ』
lines.translated: "'That's right.'"

lines.content: ナナちゃんは、うなずいていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan had nodded.

lines.content: 『もし、間違えてしまったら――姫織とは違うまったくの他人の肩を叩いてしまったら』
lines.translated: "If you make a mistake--if you tap the shoulder of a complete stranger instead of Himeori..."

lines.content: [・|そ][・|こ]に姫織とはまったく無関係の他人の“命”が滑り込んでしまう。
lines.translated: The "life" of a complete stranger having nothing to do with Himeori would slip *in there*.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは俺が腕に抱いた“[人形|器]”を指さした。
lines.translated: Nana-chan pointed at the "vessel"--the doll--I held in my arms.

lines.content: 『[・|一][・|度][・|無][・|関][・|係][・|な]“[・|影]”に呑まれた“[命|心臓]”は、もう二度と、元には戻らない』
lines.translated: "*Once a 'heart' is swallowed up by an unrelated 'Shadow'*, it will never return to normal again."

lines.content: ……命をなくした[影|者]たちにとって、命は何よりも眩しい宝物。
lines.translated: To the Shadows--those who had lost their lives--life was a treasure more dazzling than anything else.

lines.content: 一度手にした[・|そ][・|れ]を、“影”は決して手放そうとはしないだろう。
lines.translated: Once a "Shadow" got its hands on *that*, it would never let it go.

lines.content: だから絶対に、ぜったいに、間違えることのないように。
lines.translated: So I must never, ever make a mistake.

lines.content: ナナちゃんはそう言い残していってくれた。
lines.translated: Those were the parting words Nana-chan had left me with.

lines.content: 一度……。たった、一度
lines.translated: "Once... Only once."

lines.content: 繰り返し、辺りを見回す。
lines.translated: Repeating it to myself, I looked around.

lines.content: ……大勢だ。
lines.translated: There were so many of them.

lines.content: “影”は視界に映るだけでも、数え切れないほど大勢、いた。
lines.translated: Just within my field of vision alone, there were countless "Shadows."

lines.content: 朝が来るまでに、一人ひとり、確認していかなきゃならないのか……。しかも俺の呼びかけは届かないみたいだし、触れて確認することも、できない。間に合うのかな
lines.translated: "Do I have to check every single one of them before morning comes...? On top of that, it doesn't seem like my voice reaches them, and I can't even touch them to check. Will I make it in time?"

lines.content: 弱気がつい口からこぼれた――つい、“絶望”してしまいそうに、なった。
lines.translated: Weak words slipped from my mouth--I was on the verge of falling into "despair."

lines.content: ……いや
首を振り、前を向く。
lines.translated: I shook my head and faced forward.

lines.content: やるしかないんだ
lines.translated: "I just have to do it."

lines.content: 何百、何千、何万と行き交うように見える“影”たちだけれど……。
lines.translated: There looked to be hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands of "Shadows" coming and going, but...

lines.content: 何が何でも朝が来るまでに姫織を見つける。
lines.translated: No matter what it takes, I will find Himeori before morning comes.

lines.content: それが君と俺との“約束”だ。
lines.translated: That is the "promise" between you and me.

lines.content: 姫織……。
lines.translated: Himeori...

lines.content: もしかしたら君はもう、それを望んでいないかもしれないけれど。
lines.translated: Maybe you don't even wish for that anymore, though.

lines.content: まったく。まさかこんなところで、こんな形で、迷子になっちゃうなんてなあ
lines.translated: "Honestly. Who would've thought you'd get lost in a place like this, in a way like this?"

lines.content: この突拍子のなさはまさに君らしいと言うべきなのかな。
lines.translated: Maybe I should say this sheer unpredictability is just like you.

lines.content: そう考えると、ちょっとだけ気持ちが緩むような思いがした――必ずだ。
lines.translated: Thinking about it that way made me feel like the tension in my chest eased up just a little bit--I'll do it, without fail.

lines.content: ……必ず。姫織。いや……、ひよちゃん。俺が君を必ず見つけてみせるから
lines.translated: "...Without fail. Himeori. No... Hiyo-chan. I'll definitely find you."

lines.content: 決意を新たに一歩、踏み出した。
lines.translated: With renewed determination, I took a step forward.

lines.content: すると、
lines.translated: Just then,

lines.content: あれ……？
背後から声がした。聞き慣れた声だった。
lines.translated: A voice called out from behind me. It was a familiar voice.

lines.content: 大雅？　こんなところで、何やってるの？
lines.translated: "Taiga? What are you doing in a place like this?"

lines.content: 振り返ると、そこには首をかしげる小さな子。
lines.translated: When I turned around, a small girl was standing there, tilting her head.

lines.content: ……十夜？
lines.translated: "...Toya?"

lines.content: そしてその隣には、十夜と手を繋ぐ女の子……。
lines.translated: And right next to her was a girl holding Toya's hand...

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: そっか。
lines.translated: I see.

lines.content: ふたりはまだどんな“次”へ産まれ直すかを決めかねているようだ。
lines.translated: It seemed the two of them were still undecided on what kind of "next life" to be reborn into.

lines.content: だからまだこうしてここに、いてくれる。
lines.translated: That was why they were still here like this for me.
*Thank goodness*.

lines.content: 少しだ。
lines.translated: Just a little.

lines.content: ほんの少しだけ、“希望”が見えてきた。
lines.translated: Just a tiny bit of "hope" had come into view.

lines.content: お父さんとお母さんは、誰もが[あなた|子ども]のことが大好きなんだ――
lines.translated: Every father and mother loves their children-- loves *you*--very much.

lines.content: 絵本の中の世界が繰り返し、私にそう教えてくれた。
lines.translated: The world inside my picture books taught me that over and over again.

lines.content: ページを開くと登場するお父さんとお母さんは、いつもやさしい笑顔で自分たちの子どもを抱きしめていた。
lines.translated: Whenever I opened the pages, the fathers and mothers who appeared were always hugging their children with gentle smiles.

lines.content: 私もそうしてもらいたいけど。
lines.translated: I wanted them to do that for me, too.

lines.content: 抱きしめて、もらいたいけど。
lines.translated: I wanted to be hugged, too.

lines.content: この世界で幸せを得たいのなら、相応の“何か”を差し出さなきゃならない。覚えておくんだよ。それがあんたの産まれた世界のルールだ
lines.translated: "If you want to obtain happiness in this world, you must offer up a fitting 'something.' Remember that. That is the rule of the world you were born into."

lines.content: そんな言葉がいつも私の心に渦巻いていた。
lines.translated: Words like those were always swirling around in my heart.

lines.content: どうすればいいんだろう――お父さんと、お母さん。ふたりに愛されるために、私はいったい何を差し出せるのだろうか。
lines.translated: What should I do?--Father and Mother. In order to be loved by the two of them, what on earth could I offer up?

lines.content: いっぱい、考えて、考えて……。
lines.translated: I thought about it hard, thinking and thinking...

lines.content: クレヨンでふたりの似顔絵を描いてみた。
lines.translated: I tried drawing portraits of the two of them with crayons.

lines.content: 絵本の世界では、お母さんのお誕生日に似顔絵を描き、“おめでとう”と微笑めば、その子は大好きなお母さんに思い切り抱きしめてもらえてた。
lines.translated: In the world of picture books, if a child drew a portrait for their mother's birthday and smiled while saying "Happy Birthday," their beloved mother would hug them as tight as could be.

lines.content: 私もそうしてもらえないかな。
lines.translated: I wondered if they might do that for me, too.

lines.content: そう、思ったから……。
lines.translated: Because she thought that...

lines.content: だけどそんなもの、ふたりには見向きもされなかった。
lines.translated: However, the two of them didn't even spare it a glance.

lines.content: 足りない。
lines.translated: It wasn't enough.

lines.content: 私がふたりに愛されるには似顔絵じゃあ足りないのだ。
lines.translated: A portrait wasn't enough for me to be loved by the two of them.

lines.content: 今度は、お屋敷にあった折り紙で鶴を作って見せた。
lines.translated: Next time, I used origami paper I found in the mansion to fold paper cranes and showed them.

lines.content: たくさんだ。千羽折れば願いが叶うと、やっぱり絵本の物語に教えてもらったから――のんきなものだなと言われた。
lines.translated: I made a lot of them. Because a story in a picture book had taught me that if you fold a thousand cranes, your wish will come true--and they told me how carefree I was.

lines.content: 一日中遊んでばかりで、お前は良いな。苦労などかけらも知らなそうで。
lines.translated: Must be nice for you, doing nothing but playing all day long. You look like you don't know a shred of hardship.

lines.content: ……うれしかった。とても。
lines.translated: I was happy. So very happy.

lines.content: はじめて声を掛けてもらえたのだ。
lines.translated: It was the very first time they had spoken to me.

lines.content: ふたりに話しかけてもらうには折り紙の鶴を千羽折って渡せば良い。それが相応の対価なのだ。
lines.translated: To get the two of them to talk to me, all I had to do was fold a thousand origami cranes and hand them over. That was the fitting price.

lines.content: 幼い私はそう思い込み、安心していたかった。
lines.translated: My young self convinced herself of that, wanting to feel relieved.

lines.content: 次に会いに来てくれたときには、もっと難しい折り紙を作って見てもらおう。
lines.translated: The next time they came to see me, I would make even more difficult origami and have them look at it.

lines.content: そう思い、がんばっていたけれど……。
lines.translated: Thinking that, I tried my very best, but...

lines.content: 次にふたりは女の子を連れてきた。
lines.translated: The next time, the two of them brought a girl with them.

lines.content: 女の子は私とそっくりな顔をしていた。
lines.translated: The girl had a face that looked identical to mine.

lines.content: ――その子、誰？
lines.translated: --Who is that girl?

lines.content: お父さんとお母さんに問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked Father and Mother.

lines.content: 私の双子の妹だと、いつも一緒に暮らしてるおばあさんが、ふたりの代わりに答えてくれた。
lines.translated: Instead of the two of them, it was the old woman who always lived with me who answered, telling me she was my twin sister.

lines.content: 知らなかった。私には妹がいたみたい。
lines.translated: I didn't know. It seemed I had a younger sister.

lines.content: その日だけ妹と一緒に折り紙をして遊ばせてもらった。
lines.translated: For that day only, I was allowed to play and fold origami together with my sister.

lines.content: 妹は鶴を作ったけれど、あまり上手ではなかった。
lines.translated: My sister made a crane, though she wasn't very good at it.

lines.content: 私は少し得意になった――見て、お父さんお母さん、私、上手に折れたよ。
lines.translated: I felt a little proud--Look, Father, Mother, I folded mine really well.

lines.content: でも、ふたりは妹のほうにだけ笑顔を見せた。
lines.translated: But the two of them only showed smiles to my sister.

lines.content: 妹は満足そうに微笑むと、私にもにこりと微笑んでくれた。
lines.translated: My sister smiled with satisfaction, and then she beamed a bright smile at me, too.

lines.content: かわいいなあと、思った。
lines.translated: She's so cute, I thought.

lines.content: きれいな服に、つやつやに整えられた髪。
lines.translated: Pretty clothes, and glossy, neatly brushed hair.

lines.content: 私はずっと同じ着物で、髪の毛も伸び放題。
lines.translated: I was always in the same kimono, and my hair was left to grow wild.

lines.content: 同じ顔なのにまるで違う何かのように、私には見えたのだ。
lines.translated: Even though we had the same face, to me, she looked like a completely different creature.

lines.content: “この世界で愛されるには条件がある”
lines.translated: "In this world, there is a condition to being loved."

lines.content: お母さんが妹を抱きしめて、言った。
lines.translated: Mother hugged my younger sister and spoke.

lines.content: “この子は私たちに愛されるためいっぱいの[・|か][・|わ][・|い][・|い]をくれるけど……”
lines.translated: "This girl gives us so much 'cuteness' so that we'll love her, yet..."

lines.content: “ねえ。あなたは私たちに何を与えてくれるのかしら”
lines.translated: "Tell me. What do you have to offer us?"

lines.content: 汚くて、みすぼらしくて。かわいくもない。
lines.translated: Dirty and shabby. Not cute at all.

lines.content: とても私たちに愛されようとして産まれてきたとは思えない。
lines.translated: I couldn't possibly believe I had been born to be loved by them.

lines.content: “私たちは[・|そ][・|れ]を確かめるためここに通っていたけれど……。やっぱりあなたには何もないのね”
lines.translated: "We kept coming here just to make sure of 'that,' and yet... It seems you really have nothing at all."

lines.content: お母さんとお父さん、そして妹が笑った。
lines.translated: Mother, Father, and my sister laughed.
"And so we have decided to offer you up."

lines.content: それからお父さんもお母さんも、二度とお屋敷にやって来ることはなかった。
lines.translated: After that, neither Father nor Mother ever came to the mansion again.

lines.content: “夜のイキモノ”である猫たちには、それぞれ特別な力を持っている。
lines.translated: The cats who are "Creatures of the Night" each possess a special power.

lines.content: 冬月十夜は[・|こ][・|の][・|人]と定めた人間にだけ、最大十秒ほど先の未来を見せることができた。
lines.translated: Fuyutsuki Toya could show the future up to ten seconds ahead, but only to the human she decided was "the one."

lines.content: 姫織を見つけるためにその力を借りれないだろうか。
lines.translated: Could I borrow that power to find Himeori?

lines.content: たとえば、“影”の肩に触れようとする前に、十夜の力を使い――その先の未来を見る。
lines.translated: For instance, right before trying to touch a "shadow's" shoulder, I could use Toya's power--and see the future beyond that moment.

lines.content: 十秒あればその選択が正解であったか否かくらいはわかるはず。
lines.translated: Ten seconds should be enough to at least tell whether that choice was the right one or not.

lines.content: 不正解なら別の“影”を前にそれをまた試す。そういうふうに繰り返していければ、いつか正解に行き当たるのでは、ないか。
lines.translated: If it's wrong, we try again in front of a different "shadow." If we keep repeating that, wouldn't we eventually hit upon the right answer?

lines.content: 俺は十夜に現状を説明し、力を借りれないかどうかと、願った。
lines.translated: I explained our current situation to Toya and asked if she could lend me her power.

lines.content: ……うん。それは、いいよ
lines.translated: "...Yeah. That's... okay with me."

lines.content: 十夜はうなずいてくれるけど、
lines.translated: Toya nodded for me, though...

lines.content: ……またちゅーしなきゃ、だめってことだよね。それも……えっと。お友だちの、前で
lines.translated: "...That means we have to kiss again, right? And... um. In front of our friends."

lines.content: 小さく言って、うつむいてしまう。
lines.translated: She murmured softly and looked down.

lines.content: その頬は真っ赤になっていた。
lines.translated: Her cheeks had turned bright red.

lines.content: それにね、大雅。こんなにいっぱい、命の“影”はいるんだよ。一人ひとり試していたら……それこそ朝になっちゃうよ
lines.translated: "Besides, Taiga. There are so many 'shadows' of life here. If we test them one by one... morning really will come before we're done."

lines.content: ああ……。確かにそうだ
lines.translated: "Yeah... That's true."

lines.content: それでもやらなきゃならないんだ。
lines.translated: Even so, we had to do it.

lines.content: 他に代案は思いつけない。だから……。
lines.translated: I couldn't think of any other alternative. So...

lines.content: だから、ごめん。十夜。とても大変なことだとはわかっているけれど、どうかお願いしたいんだ
lines.translated: "That's why I'm sorry, Toya. I know I'm asking a lot of you, but please do this for me."

lines.content: そう言う俺に、十夜はやはり難しい表情だった。
lines.translated: When I said that, Toya still wore a troubled expression.

lines.content: う、うん。……とってもとっても、恥ずかしいけど、大雅のことお手伝いするのは、いいよ。全然いい。私、大雅や姫織ちゃんの役に立ちたいって思うよ。……でも
lines.translated: "Y-Yeah. ...It's really, really embarrassing, but helping you out is okay, Taiga. Totally okay. I want to be useful to you and Himeori-chan. ...But..."

lines.content: 俺を見上げ、十夜は言う。
lines.translated: Looking up at me, Toya spoke.

lines.content: でもね。大雅。……私の力にも制限があるんだよ。大雅が、姫織の肩に触れられるのが一回だけって決まってるみたいに
lines.translated: "The thing is, Taiga... my power has a limit, too. Just like how it's decided that you can only touch Himeori's shoulder once."

lines.content: 恐る恐ると、十夜は“十回だけ”と言い、うなずいた。
lines.translated: Hesitantly, Toya said "only ten times," and nodded.

lines.content: 私の力はね、一回の“夜”の中で十回きりなの
lines.translated: "My power can only be used ten times within a single 'Night.'"

lines.content: えっと。つまり……？
lines.translated: "Um. In other words...?"

lines.content: ……私が大雅に――す、好きな、人間に、ね。未来を見せてあげられるのは、一晩のうちに十秒だけなの。十回っていうのは、一回一秒ずつ使ったときのことだよ
lines.translated: "...The future I can show you, Taiga--to the human I l-like, I mean--is only ten seconds total in a single night. Saying ten times is only if we use it for one second each time."

lines.content: 今、ここで考えなければならないことは……。
lines.translated: What I had to think about right here and now was...

lines.content: 俺が“影”に触れ、それが正解か不正解かを知るには、一回につき何秒必要になるのだろうということだ。
lines.translated: How many seconds would it take each time for me to touch a "shadow" and find out whether it was the right answer or the wrong one?

lines.content: ――たとえば。
lines.translated: --For instance.

lines.content: “影”の肩に触れる。
lines.translated: I touch a "shadow's" shoulder.

lines.content: “影”が、振り返る。
lines.translated: The "shadow" turns around.

lines.content: そのシルエットがみるみるうちに光りを帯び、それが“何者”か、わかる。
lines.translated: Its silhouette rapidly takes on light, and I find out "who" it is.

lines.content: それまでの行程をたった一秒で済ませられるだろうか。
lines.translated: Could that entire process be finished in just a single second?

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: 無理だ。
lines.translated: Impossible.

lines.content: 一秒ではとても無理。
lines.translated: One second was completely impossible.

lines.content: 一回の未来視で正解か不正解かを知るには、どんなに短く予測してみても四、五秒はかかってしまうのではないだろうか。
lines.translated: To know whether it's right or wrong in a single vision of the future, no matter how short an estimate I made, wouldn't it take four or five seconds?

lines.content: だとすると、十夜の力に頼れるのは二回が限度。そう考えたほうがいい。
lines.translated: If so, relying on Toya's power twice was the absolute limit. It was better to look at it that way.

lines.content: たった二回の猶予で、ごった返す“影”たちを相手に、正解を引き当てなければならないなんて……。
lines.translated: Having to pull the right answer from this jostling crowd of "shadows" with only two chances to spare...

lines.content: 無理だ。
lines.translated: Impossible.

lines.content: 再びその言葉が俺の中にこだました――そんなこと、叶えられるはずもない。
lines.translated: Those words echoed inside me once again--There's no way a wish like that could ever be granted.

lines.content: 見上げた時計塔の針は、朝が刻一刻と近づいてきていることを示していた。
lines.translated: Looking up at the clock tower, the hands showed that morning was drawing nearer with every passing moment.

lines.content: ――私、どうしたらお父さんとお母さんに、大好きって言ってもらえるのかな。
lines.translated: --What can I do to make Father and Mother tell me they love me?

lines.content: ある夜のこと。私は一緒に暮らすおばあさんにそう問いかけていた。
lines.translated: It happened one night. I was asking that question to the old woman who lived with me.

lines.content: ――妹みたいにかわいくなれたら……私も、ふたりに抱きしめてもらえる？
lines.translated: --If I become cute like my sister... will the two of them hug me, too?

lines.content: 広い畳の部屋にいっぱいの鶴を作って並べていた。折り紙で鶴を千羽折ると願いが叶う。絵本の世界に教えてもらったことだ。
lines.translated: I had made lots of paper cranes and lined them up across the wide tatami room. If you fold a thousand origami cranes, your wish will come true. That was something the world of picture books had taught me.

lines.content: おまじないだったり。願掛けだったり。
lines.translated: Good luck charms. Prayers and wishes.

lines.content: お願い事を叶えてくれるらしいものは何でも試してみたと思う――大事にされたい。私が大切に想う人たちに、私も同じくらい大事に想われたい。
lines.translated: I think I tried anything and everything that was supposed to make wishes come true--I wanted to be cherished. I wanted the people I cared about so deeply to care about me just as much.

lines.content: そんな私に、おばあさんはやっぱり嫌そうな顔をしたけれど……。
lines.translated: The old woman made her usual displeased face at me, and yet...

lines.content: その日はいつもと違った。
lines.translated: That day was different from usual.

lines.content: どうしてかおばあさんが私をきれいにしてくれた。
lines.translated: For some reason, the old woman cleaned me up and made me pretty.

lines.content: かわいい洋服。整えたれた髪。
lines.translated: Cute western clothes. Neatly brushed hair.

lines.content: 覗き込んだ鏡の中に、お父さんとお母さんに愛される妹とそっくりな誰かが映っていた。
lines.translated: Peering into the mirror, I saw someone reflected there who looked identical to my sister, the one loved by Father and Mother.

lines.content: 今日からあんたは[・|あ][・|の][・|子]になるんだ
lines.translated: "Starting today, you are going to become 'that girl.'"

lines.content: 妹の名前を口にして、おばあさんは顔をしかめた。
lines.translated: Speaking my sister's name, the old woman frowned.

lines.content: ……本当に、私はバカね。言い伝えどおりにしていれば、少なくともしばらくは安泰だっただろうに
lines.translated: "...I really am a fool. If I had just followed the legend, we would have been safe for a while, at least."

lines.content: 吐き出した言葉が苦くて堪らないのだというように、おばあさんはまた顔をぎゅっとしかめていた。
lines.translated: As if the words she spat out were unbearably bitter, the old woman screwed up her face tightly once again.

lines.content: 行きましょう
lines.translated: "Let's go."

lines.content: どこへ？　と私は問いかける。
lines.translated: Where to? I asked.

lines.content: 幸せと不幸せとを交換するんだ
lines.translated: "We're going to trade happiness and unhappiness."

lines.content: おばあさんに手を引かれ、私は産まれてはじめて、お屋敷の外に出た。
lines.translated: Led by the old woman's hand, I stepped outside the mansion for the very first time since I was born.

lines.content: おばあさんと手を繋ぎ、電車に乗った。
lines.translated: Holding hands with the old woman, I boarded a train.

lines.content: 向かう先はお父さんとお母さんの家だとおばあさんは言った。
lines.translated: She told me that we were headed to Father and Mother's house.

lines.content: ふたりの住んでいる町は、みっつ先の駅を降りた先にあるという。
lines.translated: She said the town where the two of them lived was just past the station three stops ahead.

lines.content: 駅をみっつ越えるのなんて直ぐだった。
lines.translated: Passing three stations took no time at all.

lines.content: 私を目的の駅へと列車が運ぶ、短いみじかい時間の中で、おばあさんは私に色々なことを教えてくれた。
lines.translated: During the short, fleeting time the train carried me toward our destination, the old woman told me all sorts of things.

lines.content: 遠い昔のことだ。この町をさくらの花がいっぱいに覆ったのだという。
lines.translated: It happened a long, long time ago. They say cherry blossoms completely covered this town.

lines.content: どこかうつくしくもある不思議な災害の話。
lines.translated: A tale of a mysterious disaster that was somehow beautiful as well.

lines.content: そんな困難から命を賭し、この町を救った少女たちの話。
lines.translated: A tale of the girls who risked their lives to save this town from that hardship.

lines.content: ……意地悪な大人たちに、そういう運命を押しつけられてしまった、かわいそうな女の子たちの話。
lines.translated: A tale of pitiful girls who had that fate forced upon them by cruel adults.

lines.content: 私は、そんな彼女たちの血を引く子孫なのだと、いう話。
lines.translated: A tale saying that I was a descendant carrying the blood of those very girls.

lines.content: ……そして私らは、遠いとおい昔、少女たちを残酷な方法でさくらの樹の下に産めた大人たちの末裔だ
lines.translated: "...And we are the descendants of the adults who buried those girls beneath the cherry trees in such a cruel way, a long, long time ago."

lines.content: 少女たちの中には、大人たちのことを心から憎む子らも少なからずいて……。
lines.translated: Among the girls, there were more than a few who hated the adults from the bottom of their hearts...

lines.content: 呪いだ。
lines.translated: A curse.

lines.content: おばあさんは、言った――私たちの血筋は今も尚、少女らの呪いに縛られ、生きている。
lines.translated: The old woman said--Even now, our bloodline lives on bound by the girls' curse.

lines.content: その少女たちは特別だったんだよ
lines.translated: "Those girls were special."

lines.content: 命を捧げられた誰もがみんな、思い描いたものをすべて現実化できてしまう――そんな特別な“想像力”を持つものばかりだった
lines.translated: "Every single one of them who had their lives offered up possessed a special 'imagination'--the power to turn anything they pictured in their minds into reality."

lines.content: と、そういう言い伝えだ。
lines.translated: Or so the legend goes.

lines.content: その子らの呪詛を恐れた大人たちは――私らの先祖たちは、誓ったんだ。未来永劫。少女らの家系を影ながら支え続けると。そうすることで少女に許しを請うたんだ
lines.translated: "The adults who feared the girls' curse--our ancestors--swore an oath. For all eternity, they would continue to support the girls' lineage from the shadows. By doing so, they begged the girls for forgiveness."

lines.content: ……だから私らの家は、少女らの血筋であるお前たちの家系には――本家であろうと分家であろうと決して逆らうことができない
lines.translated: "...That is why our family can never defy your lineage, the bloodline of those girls--whether it's the main family or a branch family."

lines.content: と、そういう絶対に家訓が脈々と残されている。
lines.translated: That absolute family precept had been passed down unbroken through the generations.

lines.content: もしも、少しでも誓いを違えようものなら、たちまち少女らの呪いによって私たちの血筋は滅ぼされてしまう。女、子どもも容赦なく、呪いによって惨殺される
lines.translated: "If we were to break that oath even slightly, our bloodline would be instantly wiped out by the girls' curse. Women and children alike would be mercilessly slaughtered by it."

lines.content: ……たとえどのような命令でも決して破らず、逆らわず、人生を賭して少女らの子孫の側に控え続けると。
lines.translated: Never breaking a single command no matter what it may be, never defying them, and staking their lives to remain at the side of the girls' descendants.

lines.content: ……だから私は、好きでもないあんたのことを、今日までこうして世話してきたんだ
lines.translated: "...And that is why I have taken care of you until today, even though I don't even like you."

lines.content: おばあさんは乱暴に吐き捨てた。
lines.translated: The old woman spat the words out roughly.

lines.content: それでも手は繋いだままだった。
lines.translated: Even so, she kept holding my hand.

lines.content: そして最後に、どうして私が、あのお屋敷に閉じ込められて育ってきたのかを知らされた。
lines.translated: And finally, I was told why I had been locked away and raised inside that mansion.

lines.content: 広いこの“参禅町”にはいくつもの“噂”がある。
lines.translated: There are many "rumors" in this vast "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: そのひとつに、少女たちが作った“夜の国”――そこには、“不死のイキモノ”と呼ばれる[・|何][・|か]が住んでいるのだという。
lines.translated: One of them says that in the "Country of Night" created by the girls--there lives "something" called an "Immortal Creature."

lines.content: そんな彼らは、かわいそうな[少女|女の子]を――まるで遠い昔のように理不尽な思いをしている女の子のことを――夜な夜な[さら|攫]い、永遠の命をその子たちに授ける。
lines.translated: Night after night, they spirit away pitiful girls--girls suffering unreasonable treatment, just like in the distant past--and grant them eternal life.

lines.content: 恐らくかつて少女らがそういうふうに願ったのだ。誰でもいい。自分たちにやさしくしてほしいと――“夜のイキモノ”の殆どはそうして産まれた。
lines.translated: Perhaps that was what the girls once wished for. Anyone would do. They just wanted someone to be kind to them--most of the "Creatures of the Night" were born that way.

lines.content: そして[さら|攫]ってきたかわいそうな女の子を、“夜の怪物”は自分たちの仲間に引き入れて、いつまでも面白おかしく暮らしていくのだという。
lines.translated: And they say the "Monsters of the Night" welcome the pitiful girls they spirit away into their ranks, living merrily together forevermore.

lines.content: ……きっとあんたはその“怪物”に[さら|攫]われたほうが幸せだろう
lines.translated: "...You would surely be much happier if you were spirited away by that 'Monster.'"

lines.content: おばあさんは言った。
lines.translated: The old woman said.

lines.content: あんたがどんなに求めても、あのふたりはあんたを愛することなど決してない。その可能性だって微塵もないんだ
lines.translated: "No matter how much you crave it, those two will never love you. There isn't even the slightest chance of it."

lines.content: あのふたりにとって、あんたはただ自分たちの願望を叶える道具、手段でしかないからだ
lines.translated: "Because to them, you're nothing more than a tool, a means to fulfill their own desires."

lines.content: ……ならば、あんたを大切にしてくれるだろう“怪物”と生きたほうがよほどいい
lines.translated: "...If that's the case, you're much better off living with a 'Monster' that will actually cherish you."

lines.content: “夜の怪物”に[さら|攫]われてしまえば、その身体から“[命|心臓]”は抜かれ、少女らの心が今も眠り続けるさくらへと“怪物”は捧げることだろう。
lines.translated: Once spirited away by a "Monster of the Night," one's "heart" is pulled from their body, and the "Monster" offers it up to the cherry tree where the girls' spirits still sleep even now.

lines.content: そうすることで“夜”は永遠に未来へと維持されていく――それが“夜の怪物”の“役割”だ。
lines.translated: By doing so, the "Night" is maintained eternally into the future--that is the "role" of the "Monsters of the Night."

lines.content: でも、[・|そ][・|れ][・|だ][・|け][・|な][・|ら]このまま屋敷に閉じ込められていればよかった
lines.translated: "Still, if that were all, it would've been fine for you to just stay locked up in the mansion."

lines.content: “夜の怪物”が、あんたのさみしい心を嗅ぎつけて……そして攫いに来るまで待てばいい
lines.translated: "You'd only have to wait for the 'Monster of the Night' to catch the scent of your lonely heart... and come spirit you away."

lines.content: だけど事情が少し複雑で、残酷なのだとおばあさんは言った。
lines.translated: However, the circumstances were a bit more complicated and cruel, the old woman said.

lines.content: 人生はまるで残酷なおとぎ話のようだから……。
lines.translated: Because life is just like a cruel fairy tale...
"That's why I decided to swap you and your younger sister."

lines.content: 上手くやりなさい。
lines.translated: Do it well.

lines.content: おばあさんは言う。
lines.translated: The old woman said.
"Your sister is already inside the mansion in your place. ...Right about now, your parents are probably looking for you, completely unaware."

lines.content: ああ、そうさ
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's right."

lines.content: あのふたりが[・|そ][・|れ]に気づくはずもない。その他大勢の大人たちと同じだ。自分たちの目的にしか興味を持てない連中だから
lines.translated: "There's no way those two will notice it. They're the same as all the other adults. That lot can only take an interest in their own goals."

lines.content: お父さん、お母さん。
lines.translated: Father, Mother.

lines.content: 大人たちの目的とは……。
lines.translated: The goal of the adults is...

lines.content: “永遠の命”を得ることだ
lines.translated: "To obtain 'eternal life.'"

lines.content: おばあさんは言った。
lines.translated: The old woman said.

lines.content: 何の“才能”も持たず産まれてきた自身の子を代償に差し出して、“夜の怪物”から“永遠の命”を引き出す――
lines.translated: "Offering up their own child, born without any 'talent,' as a sacrifice in order to draw out 'eternal life' from the 'Monster of the Night'--"

lines.content: そのためにあんたは、産まれてから今までずっと、“夜”よりも暗い場所に閉じ込められていた
lines.translated: "For that reason, ever since you were born, you've been locked away in a place darker than the 'Night.'"

lines.content: あんたが上手くやりさえすればきっと騙せる。おばあさんは私に言った。あいつらに本物と偽物を見抜ける目も、心も、あるはずがない。
lines.translated: As long as you play your part well, you can surely fool them, the old woman told me. They couldn't possibly have the eyes or the heart to tell the real thing from a fake.

lines.content: 忘れるな
lines.translated: "Don't forget."

lines.content: 親と子だからといって、そこに無条件に生まれる愛情だなんて、そんなもの……。愛するための努力なくして、そこに産まれるものはなにもないんだ
lines.translated: "Unconditional love born just from being parent and child... there's no such thing. Without the effort to love, nothing is ever born."

lines.content: おばあさんはそう言うと、私と繋いだ手をぎゅっと力強く握った。
lines.translated: Saying that, the old woman gave my hand a firm, tight squeeze.

lines.content: どうしてこんなことをするのかとおばあさんに問いかけた――私と妹をいれかえる？　どうして、そんなことを。
lines.translated: I asked the old woman why she was doing this--Swapping me and my sister? Why would she do such a thing?

lines.content: するとおばあさんは唇を噛み、うつむいた。
lines.translated: At that, the old woman bit her lip and looked down.

lines.content: あんたの家の者たちは、“夜の怪物”が不死にした子のことを――……
lines.translated: "The people of your family treat the children made immortal by the 'Monster of the Night' as--..."

lines.content: 列車がガタンと揺れた。
lines.translated: The train jolted with a clatter.

lines.content: 目的の駅に着いたのだ。
lines.translated: We had arrived at our destination station.

lines.content: おばあさんは私だけを駅に降ろした。
lines.translated: The old woman let only me off at the platform.

lines.content: 忘れるな
lines.translated: "Don't forget."

lines.content: 列車の中と駅の構内。
lines.translated: Inside the train and on the station platform.

lines.content: 開いた扉を間に挟み、おばあさんは私に言う。
lines.translated: With the open doors between us, the old woman spoke to me.

lines.content: あんたは、バカだ
lines.translated: "You're a fool."

lines.content: ……あんな愛のない両親に愛されたいため、かわいくなりたいと願うだなんて
lines.translated: "...Wishing to become cute just because you want to be loved by such loveless parents."

lines.content: おばあさんが手を伸ばし、私の頬にそっと触れた。
lines.translated: The old woman reached out and gently touched my cheek.

lines.content: ……忘れないで
lines.translated: "...Don't forget."

lines.content: こんな格好しても、しなくても……あんたは充分、かわいいわ
lines.translated: "Whether you're dressed like this or not... you are plenty cute."

lines.content: そうして最後に一度だけ、おばあさんは微笑んでくれた。
lines.translated: And then, just once at the very end, the old woman smiled for me.

lines.content: これで、さようなら
lines.translated: "This is goodbye."

lines.content: あんたのご飯を作るのもの、あんたのほつれた着物を繕うのも。思えば結構、楽しかったわ
lines.translated: "Making your meals, mending your frayed kimono... Looking back, it was actually quite fun."

lines.content: ……ごめんなさい
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry."

lines.content: さみしいあんたに、たった一度も、やさしくしてあげなくて
lines.translated: "Even though I wasn't kind to you even once while you were so lonely."

lines.content: 私は強く首を振った。
lines.translated: I shook my head hard.

lines.content: そんなことはない。やさしさなら今もいっぱい、こうしてたくさん、もらってる。
lines.translated: That wasn't true. I was receiving so much kindness right now, right here.

lines.content: また、会える？
lines.translated: Will I see you again?

lines.content: そう問いかけてみる。
lines.translated: I tried asking her.

lines.content: でも、おばあさんも首を振った。
lines.translated: However, the old woman shook her head as well.

lines.content: ……これがバレたら、私は、きっと
lines.translated: "...When this is found out, I'll surely..."

lines.content: 電車の扉が閉まる。
lines.translated: The train doors closed.

lines.content: おばあさんは、窓越しに[まぶた|瞼]を閉じていた。
lines.translated: Beyond the window, the old woman had closed her eyes.

lines.content: 十夜の唇から“十秒先の未来”を渡された。
lines.translated: From Toya's lips, I was handed the "future ten seconds ahead."

lines.content: お友だちにそっぽを向いていてもらい、目線を合わせた俺の額に少し――ほんの少し、唇が触れる程度の儀式だった。
lines.translated: Having her friend look the other way, it was a ritual where we met each other's gaze and her lips touched my forehead slightly--just barely.

lines.content: う、うううう……っ
lines.translated: "U-Uuuuu...!"

lines.content: 十夜はいつもみたいに真っ赤になった。
lines.translated: Toya turned bright red, just like always.

lines.content: もうっ、もう……っ
lines.translated: "Jeez, jeez...!"

lines.content: 恥ずかしそうにその場で小さく飛び跳ねている。
lines.translated: Embarrassed, she hopped up and down slightly on the spot.

lines.content: そうして手渡された十秒の猶予を、どう使うべきなのか……。
lines.translated: How should I use the ten-second grace period handed to me like that...?

lines.content: 悩んだ。
lines.translated: I agonized over it.

lines.content: 行き交う“影”は更にその数を増やしているように見える。
lines.translated: The "Shadows" passing by seemed to be increasing in number even further.

lines.content: 大きな汽車が出るようだった。
lines.translated: It looked like a large steam train was about to depart.

lines.content: そこに乗り込むため、“影”たちは集まってきている――“夜”を彷徨うことに飽いてしまった“影”たちだ。
lines.translated: The "Shadows" were gathering to board it--"Shadows" that had grown weary of wandering the "Night."

lines.content: 焦る。
lines.translated: She panicked.

lines.content: もしも汽車に乗り込む“影”の中に、姫織がいたとしたら……。
lines.translated: What if Himeori was among the "Shadows" boarding the train...?

lines.content: 一人ひとりの顔を覗き込んでは確認する。
lines.translated: I peered into each and every face to check.

lines.content: だが、見つからない――“影”の表情を確認しようと、それが姫織なのかそうではないのかさえ、判別できない。
lines.translated: However, I couldn't find her--even when I tried to check the expressions of the "Shadows," I couldn't even tell whether it was Himeori or not.

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: このまま呆然と立っているわけにはいかない。
lines.translated: I couldn't just stand here in a daze.

lines.content: 姫織……
lines.translated: "Himeori..."

lines.content: 目の前にいた“影”――その肩を、左手で掴んだ。
lines.translated: I grabbed the shoulder of the "Shadow" right in front of me with my left hand.

lines.content: シルエットが姫織に良くよく似ていた。ように、思えたからだ。
lines.translated: Because its silhouette looked very much like Himeori's. Or so it seemed to me.

lines.content: だけどその“影”は姫織とは違った。
lines.translated: However, that "Shadow" wasn't Himeori.

lines.content: 俺が肩に触れると振り返り、にんまりと、笑ったのだ。
lines.translated: When I touched its shoulder, it turned around and grinned broadly.

lines.content: 俺の抱えている人形から姫織の“[命|心臓]”がするりとこぼれ、目の前の“影”へと吸い込まれていき――……
lines.translated: Himeori's "heart" slipped out from the doll I was holding, getting sucked into the "Shadow" before my eyes--...

lines.content: そこで俺は[まぶた|瞼]を開いた。
lines.translated: At that point, I opened my eyes.

lines.content: 今、俺の前を通り過ぎていく姫織に似た“影”
lines.translated: A "Shadow" resembling Himeori passing right in front of me now.

lines.content: その肩に触れるという“四秒後の未来”だ。
lines.translated: That was the "future four seconds later" where I touched its shoulder.

lines.content: 俺は、選ばなかった。その未来を選択しなかった。
lines.translated: I didn't choose it. I didn't select that future.

lines.content: やはり一度に“四秒”、あるいは“五秒”は要してしまう。
lines.translated: As expected, it takes "four seconds" or "five seconds" at a time.

lines.content: 十夜から得た“十秒”も残りあと六秒……。
lines.translated: There were only six seconds left of the "ten seconds" I got from Toya...

lines.content: 慎重に、そして確実に、“力”を使わなければ。
lines.translated: I have to use the "power" carefully and with certainty.

lines.content: そう自身に言い聞かせはしたけれど、だめだ。
lines.translated: I told myself that, but it was no good.

lines.content: ……だめ、だった
lines.translated: "...It was no good."

lines.content: 二度目も同じだ。
lines.translated: The second time was the same.

lines.content: 肩に触れた“影”はまったくの別人で……。
lines.translated: The "Shadow" whose shoulder I touched was a complete stranger...

lines.content: 今回は、少し早い。使用したのは三秒ほどだった。
lines.translated: This time was a little faster. I had used about three seconds.

lines.content: しかしどうしたって選べやしない――“三秒後の風景”に、俺は唇を噛み、[まぶた|瞼]を開いたのだった。
lines.translated: Even so, there was no way I could choose it--at the "scenery three seconds later," I bit my lip and opened my eyes.

lines.content: ……ごめんね大雅。役に立てなくて
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. That I couldn't be of much help."

lines.content: 隣にはしゅんとした顔の十夜がいた。
lines.translated: Beside me was Toya, looking crestfallen.

lines.content: その手をお友だちが静かに繋ぎ、慰めている。
lines.translated: Her friend quietly held her hand, comforting her.

lines.content: ううん。そんなことない。ありがとう十夜
lines.translated: "No, that's not true. Thank you, Toya."

lines.content: 確かに、結果は得られなかったかもしれないけれど、十夜が示してくれた気持ちがうれしい。そう感じる心は本物だ。
lines.translated: True, I might not have gotten the result I wanted, but the feelings Toya showed me made me happy. The heart that feels that way is genuine.

lines.content: と、俺は思うから――
lines.translated: Because that's what I think--

lines.content: だから、余裕がないからといって不機嫌さを隠そうともしない……そんな大人にはなりたくはないと、思うから。
lines.translated: Because I don't want to become the kind of adult who doesn't even try to hide their foul mood just because they're backed into a corner.

lines.content: だからもう一度、十夜にありがとうと伝える。そうして改めて、考えるのだ。
lines.translated: So I told Toya thank you once more. And then, I thought it over again.

lines.content: （……どうする）
lines.translated: (...What do I do?)

lines.content: もう猶予はない。
lines.translated: There's no time left.

lines.content: 未来視はあと三秒ほど残されている。
lines.translated: Only about three seconds of future sight remain.

lines.content: （ぎりぎりもう一回くらいは試せるかもしれないが……）
lines.translated: (I might just barely be able to try one more time, but...)

lines.content: それで確実に正解を引けるとは思えなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't believe I would definitely pull the right answer with that.

lines.content: 次にこの左手で触れたものが姫織でなければ……。
lines.translated: If the next thing I touch with this left hand isn't Himeori...

lines.content: “さよなら”だ。
lines.translated: It's "goodbye."

lines.content: 姫織と俺は、永遠にさよならしなければならなくなる――今、こんな状況に陥っている理由も、姫織の気持ちも何も、わからないままに。
lines.translated: Himeori and I will have to say goodbye forever--without knowing why we've fallen into this situation, or Himeori's feelings, or anything at all.

lines.content: そんなプレッシャーの中、俺はただただ、自身の左手と、そして姫織の“[命|心臓]”を閉じ込める人形とを、交互に見つめるしかできなくて。
lines.translated: Under that crushing pressure, all I could do was look back and forth between my own left hand and the doll confining Himeori's "heart."

lines.content: だめだ。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: いつまでもじっとはしていられない。
lines.translated: I can't stay still forever.

lines.content: ……覚悟を、決めなくては。
lines.translated: I have to steel my resolve.

lines.content: ふと目の前を通り過ぎた“影”
lines.translated: A "Shadow" suddenly passed right in front of me.

lines.content: 姫織に似ている。似ているように、思う。
lines.translated: It looks like Himeori. At least, I think it does.

lines.content: 左手を伸ばす。
lines.translated: I reach out my left hand.

lines.content: “影”が立ち止まり、振り向いた。
lines.translated: The "Shadow" stopped and turned around.

lines.content: 真っ黒に染められた表情。瞳の色さえ窺えない――正解か、不正解か。
lines.translated: An expression dyed pitch-black. I can't even make out the color of its eyes--is this the right answer, or the wrong one?

lines.content: この数秒先の自分は“後悔”しているだろうか。それとも、涙を流し、大切な人を抱き留めているだろうか。
lines.translated: Will the me a few seconds from now be filled with "regret"? Or will I be shedding tears, holding the person precious to me in my arms?

lines.content: どうしてだ。
lines.translated: Why?
Why is it that in life, you never get a second chance?

lines.content: いったい何者を恨んで良いかもわからず……。
lines.translated: I don't even know who I'm supposed to resent for this...

lines.content: そのまま伸ばした左の指先で、“影”に触れようとした――[・|残][・|り]、[・|三][・|秒]。
lines.translated: With my outstretched left fingertips, I tried to touch the "Shadow"--three seconds left.

lines.content: 最後の未来視を、使おう。
lines.translated: I'll use my last bit of future sight.

lines.content: ……そのときだ。
lines.translated: That was when it happened.

lines.content: ポケットにしまっている端末が、俺のピンチを察したみたいに、鳴り始めた。
