lines.content: だけどね。降ろすことのできない重荷を、心に背負ったままのあなたのお母さんもね、ようやく幸せを得られるかというところまで、来たの
lines.translated: "However, you see. Even your mother, who carried a heavy burden on her heart that she could never set down, finally reached the point where she might be able to attain happiness."
Nana-chan speaks as if she were telling her own story.

lines.content: 結婚したのだ。
lines.translated: She got married.

lines.content: 結婚の相手は、愛する人――というわけでもなかった。
lines.translated: Her marriage partner wasn't necessarily someone she loved, though.

lines.content: 夜月の家は廃れかけていて、経済的に豊かな家の次男を受け入れることで、支援を得、どうにか延命することを計ったのだ。
lines.translated: The Yotsuki family was falling into ruin, and by welcoming the second son of a wealthy family, they sought to gain financial support and somehow prolong their survival.

lines.content: 現代では耳にすることもない、まるでファンタジーな話だけれど……
lines.translated: "It's a story you'd never hear of in modern times, almost like a fantasy, though..."

lines.content: そういう時代だったのだ。
lines.translated: It was that kind of era.

lines.content: 政略結婚とまで大げさな話ではないけれど……。
lines.translated: Though it wasn't anything as grand as a political marriage...

lines.content: 別にそのことに恨み言を抱いたりはしていない。
lines.translated: She didn't particularly hold any resentment over it.

lines.content: 愛のない結婚に納得はしていたけれど、たったひとりを生涯愛し続けるという、ある意味での理想を生きることはできなかった。
lines.translated: She had accepted a loveless marriage, though it meant she couldn't live out the ideal, in a sense, of loving only one person for her entire life.

lines.content: そのことは少しさみしいと思ってた。でも、それだけだ。決して不幸なことではないと納得していたのだ。
lines.translated: She felt a little lonely about that. But that was all. She had accepted it, knowing it was by no means an unhappy thing.

lines.content: 両親から愛されることに後ろめたさを感じていた。早く家を出たかった。
lines.translated: She felt guilty about being loved by her parents. She wanted to leave the house quickly.

lines.content: でも、まだ十代も前半といったところだった。
lines.translated: Even so, she was still only in her early teens.

lines.content: 自分ひとりで生きて行くにはあまりに子どもだ。
lines.translated: She was far too much of a child to live all on her own.

lines.content: だからむしろこの話は渡りに船といった具合でもあったのだ。
lines.translated: So in truth, this arrangement was actually something of a godsend for her.

lines.content: すぐに赤ん坊を授かった。
lines.translated: Before long, she conceived a baby.

lines.content: そのときはじめて、今まで抱いていた罪悪感や、拭いきれないさみしさが、限りなく小さなものになっていくように感じた――
lines.translated: For the very first time, she felt as though the guilt she had carried until now and the loneliness she could never wipe away were shrinking to something infinitely small--

lines.content: それは幸せと名付けられた気持ちなのだということを、知った。
lines.translated: She learned that this was a feeling called happiness.

lines.content: そんなこともわからないほど、まだまだ心は幼いままだったのだ。
lines.translated: Her heart had still been so young that she hadn't even understood something like that.

lines.content: 膨らみはじめたお腹を撫でて、思ってた……
lines.translated: "Stroking her belly as it began to swell, she thought..."

lines.content: この子がどんなふうな道を歩んで、どんなふうな大人になっていくのか。
lines.translated: What kind of path would this child walk, and what kind of adult would they grow up to be?

lines.content: その成長を側で見守れるんだと思うだけで、そんな未来を思い描いてみるだけで、胸がそわそわして堪らなかった。
lines.translated: Just thinking that she would be able to watch over that growth by their side, just picturing such a future, made her chest flutter uncontrollably with excitement.

lines.content: だけど、やっぱり……。
lines.translated: However, sure enough...

lines.content: ……わかってた
lines.translated: "...I knew it."

lines.content: 私は[妹|人]の幸せを奪いすぎた。
lines.translated: I stole too much of someone else's happiness.

lines.content: だから神さまが、私の幸せを奪うのも、特に不思議なことではなかった。
lines.translated: So it wasn't particularly strange for God to steal my happiness away, too.

lines.content: 流産だった。
lines.translated: It was a miscarriage.

lines.content: 私は幸せにはなれなかった。
lines.translated: I couldn't become happy.

lines.content: 母子手帳は妊娠がわかってから六週間ほどでもらえるものだ。
lines.translated: A maternal and child health handbook is something you receive about six weeks after learning of a pregnancy.

lines.content: お守りみたいにいつも握りしめていたそれは、何日も、何週間も、泣いてないて、泣き続けた涙を受けて、くしゃくしゃになっていた。
lines.translated: That handbook, which I had always clutched tightly like a charm, had become completely crumpled from catching the tears I cried, and cried, and kept on crying for days and weeks on end.

lines.content: ひとりで寝床に包まる日々を過ごした。
lines.translated: I spent my days curled up alone in bed.

lines.content: 私たち夫婦は、互いに深く愛し合っていたわけではない。だから夫が、泣いてばかりの私に、どんな言葉をかけて良いのかわからず……。
lines.translated: My husband and I didn't deeply love each other. So my husband didn't know what kind of words he should say to me when I did nothing but cry...

lines.content: ついには家にあまり帰ってこなくなっていた。
lines.translated: Eventually, he stopped coming home very often.

lines.content: それもまた責め立てるつもりはない。
lines.translated: I have no intention of blaming him for that, either.

lines.content: いつか、ずっとずっと小さな頃に、お屋敷から助け出してくれたおばあさん。あの人が渡したくれた小さな袋。そのことを思い出し、ようやく開いた――そして見つけた
lines.translated: "One day, she remembered the old woman who had rescued her from the mansion when she was very, very little. The small pouch that person had given her. Remembering that, she finally opened it--and found it."

lines.content: “大切な人を取り戻す方法”
lines.translated: "A way to take back a precious person."

lines.content: 空っぽになってしまったお腹を撫でて、誓った。あなたの命。あなたが歩むはずだった幸せな時間。……私が全部、取り戻すからって
lines.translated: "Stroking her now-empty belly, she swore an oath. Your life. The happy time you were supposed to walk through. ...She promised that she would take it all back."

lines.content: ……あなたのことを、ちゃんとこの世に産んであげたかった
lines.translated: "...I wanted to properly give birth to you into this world."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが、言う――
lines.translated: Nana-chan says--

lines.content: この世界はつらくさみしいことばかりで溢れているけど、それでも、それに似合うだけの幸せだっていっぱいあるはず
lines.translated: "This world is overflowing with nothing but painful and lonely things, yet even so, there must be plenty of happiness to match it."

lines.content: あなたを身ごもったとき、そういうふうに信じられるようになった。
lines.translated: When she conceived you, she became able to believe that.

lines.content: だからあなたは、さみしい私の心を救ってくれた恩人なんだよ――丸くなったお腹を撫でながらそういうふうに語りかけていた。
lines.translated: "That's why you are my benefactor who saved my lonely heart"--she used to speak to you like that while stroking her rounded belly.

lines.content: ……だから、あなたの命を取りこぼしてしまったからといって、また次の子を……とは、どうしても思えなかった
lines.translated: "...So just because I let your life slip through my fingers, I simply couldn't bring myself to think about just having another child..."

lines.content: そういうふうには切り替えられなかった。どうしても。
lines.translated: She couldn't move on like that. No matter what.

lines.content: あなただ。姫織。あなたじゃないとだめだったんだよ……
lines.translated: "It was you, Himeori. It had to be you..."

lines.content: 私は、あなたに“命”と“未来”をあげたかったんだよ。それが私の“夢”だった
lines.translated: "I wanted to give you 'life' and a 'future.' That was my 'dream.'"

lines.content: その“夢”が叶えば、さみしいことばかりの人生だったけれど、ようやく幸せになれるだろうと信じてた。
lines.translated: She believed that if that "dream" came true, even though her life had been filled with nothing but loneliness, she would finally be able to become happy.

lines.content: この世界に新しい命の居場所を作る。そうすることで、妹の居場所を奪ったことへの贖罪にもなるのかな。そうなれば、いいな。そういうふうにも思ってた
lines.translated: "Creating a place to belong in this world for a new life. I also thought that doing so might serve as atonement for stealing my little sister's place. I hoped it would."

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: “夢”は、叶わなかった……何もかも
lines.translated: "My 'dream' didn't come true... None of it."

lines.content: だから、“大切な命を夜の中から連れ戻す方法”……。それを試してみたいと、願ったの
lines.translated: "That's why I wished to try out 'a way to bring back a precious life from within the Night'..."

lines.content: ナナちゃんはまるで……。
lines.translated: Nana-chan sounds almost as if...

lines.content: まるで、自分の遠い思い出を話すみたいな口調で語り続けてくれる。
lines.translated: She keeps speaking in a tone that sounds almost as if she is recounting her own distant memories.

lines.content: ……“大切な人を夜の中から連れ戻す”には、“夜の国”に散らばっている人々の“想い”や“願い”のかけらを……、“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を、必要な分だけ集める必要があった
lines.translated: "...In order to 'bring back a precious person from within the Night,' it was necessary to gather the required amount of fragments of people's 'feelings' and 'wishes' scattered across the 'Land of Night'... the 'star fragments.'"

lines.content: “[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を求め、[・|ふ][・|た][・|り]で“夜”を旅して回った。
lines.translated: Seeking the "star fragments," the two of them traveled around the "Night."

lines.content: ……そのとき出会った、蒸気機関車を操る“夜の神さま”に案内してもらいながら。
lines.translated: Guided by the "God of the Night" who operated a steam locomotive, whom they met at that time.

lines.content: そうして集めた光の粒は、終わる命が行き着く場所――“刻の終着駅”で、特別な買い物をするために必要となる。
lines.translated: The grains of light gathered that way are needed to make a special purchase at the place where ending lives arrive--the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: “命”が再び“[外の世界|太陽の時間]”で産まれ直すのに必要となる[肉体|器]だ。
lines.translated: A vessel--a physical body--needed for a "life" to be reborn once again in the "outside world," the Time of the Sun.

lines.content: その部位を駅の店々で購入し、あとは[・|命][・|と][・|命][・|の][・|交][・|換]だ。
lines.translated: After purchasing those parts at the shops in the station, all that remains is an exchange of life for life.

lines.content: それらの方法については、おばあさんからもらった日記帳に記されていた。それは渡された袋の中に入ってた。
lines.translated: Those methods were written in the diary she had received from the old woman. It had been inside the pouch handed to her.

lines.content: ナナちゃんから一通り話を聞き終えた。私は漆黒の車窓を見つめている。今、いったいどういう場所を列車は走っているのだろう。
lines.translated: I finished hearing the whole story from Nana-chan. I stare out the pitch-black train window. Just what kind of place is the train running through right now?

lines.content: 暗闇の中に一粒の[希望|光り]を探すように見つめながら、私はつぶやく。
lines.translated: Staring into the darkness as if searching for a single grain of light--of hope--I murmur.

lines.content: ……私の、お母さんは
lines.translated: "...My mother..."

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: 産まれる前に死んでしまった私のことを、お母さんは、“夜”の中から取り戻そうとしてくれた
lines.translated: "Even though I died before I was born, my mother tried to take me back from within the 'Night.'"

lines.content: ちゃんとこの世界に産まれさせようとしてくれた――顔も知らない。まだ一度も抱きしめたこともない。そんな私のことを。
lines.translated: She tried to properly give birth to me into this world--someone whose face she didn't even know. Someone she had never even hugged once. Someone like me.
"For that sake... together with my father, the two of them set off on a journey to the 'Land of Night.'"

lines.content: ナナちゃんから教えられたことを、私は繰り返し自分でもつぶやいてみた――“夜の国”で何かを得るなら、同等の価値あるものを差し出さなければならない。
lines.translated: I tried repeating the things Nana-chan had taught me under my breath--if you want to obtain something in the "Land of Night," you must offer up something of equal value.

lines.content: “[命|心臓]”だ。
lines.translated: A "heart"--a "life."

lines.content: 命と命の交換だ。
lines.translated: It is an exchange of life for life.

lines.content: お母さんは、お父さんの命を支払って、私を“夜”の中から救い出そうとしたけれど……
lines.translated: "My mother tried to pay with my father's life to rescue me from within the 'Night,' but..."
She couldn't do it.

lines.content: 直前になって、自分の考えていたことの怖さに気づいて、逃げ出してしまった。
lines.translated: Right before it happened, she realized the horror of what she had been thinking, and she ran away.

lines.content: そしてそんな恐ろしいことを考えていた自分を罰するみたいにして、自分自身の命を“夜”に差し出し――私の“命”を、“夜”の外へ連れ出した。
lines.translated: And as if to punish herself for thinking such a terrifying thing, she offered her own life to the "Night"--and brought my "life" out of the "Night."

lines.content: 何も知らない人の良いあなたのお父さんは、お母さんの……妻の、“ひとりでは怖い。勇気がない。だから一緒に来てほしい”というお願いに、ただただ純真に、うなずいた――
lines.translated: "Your good-natured father, who knew nothing, simply and purely nodded at your mother's... his wife's plea: 'I'm scared to go alone. I don't have the courage. So I want you to come with me'--"

lines.content: そこにほの暗い意図があるとは、夢にも思わず。
lines.translated: Never dreaming that there was a dark intention behind it.

lines.content: ……お父さんもお母さんも、その頃まだ“夜”に出入りできるほど、[・|あ][・|る][・|意][・|味]で純粋だった。
lines.translated: Back then, both my father and mother were, in a sense, still pure enough to be able to enter and leave the "Night."

lines.content: [・|大][・|人][・|に][・|な][・|る]というのは、人それぞれ個人差がある。
lines.translated: Growing into an adult varies from person to person.

lines.content: 特に私のお母さんは、幼少期の多くを暗い部屋に閉じ込められて、育った。
lines.translated: My mother in particular grew up spending much of her early childhood locked away in a dark room.

lines.content: その分、人より“[大人の世界|現実世界]”に心が染まっていなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: Because of that, her heart probably hadn't been stained by the "adult world"--the real world--as much as others.

lines.content: だからふたりは“夜”に目覚め、一緒に私を取り戻すための旅に出たけれど……。
lines.translated: So the two of them awoke in the "Night" and set out on a journey together to take me back, but...

lines.content: [・|ふ][・|た][・|り]で“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を集めて回り。
lines.translated: The two of them went around gathering "star fragments."

lines.content: “[現実世界|太陽の時間]”に私を産まれ直させるための器を買って、最期に、私の“[命|心臓]”とお父さんの“[命|心臓]”とを“夜”の中で交換しようとしたけれど……。
lines.translated: They bought a vessel for me to be reborn into the "real world"--the Time of the Sun--and at the very end, she tried to exchange my "life"--my heart--with my father's "life"--his heart--within the "Night," but...

lines.content: “わかってる”
lines.translated: "I know."

lines.content: お父さんが、お母さんに言ったのだという。
lines.translated: They say that's what my father said to my mother.

lines.content: “君が何を考えて、ここまで来たのか。全部わかってるよ”
lines.translated: "What you were thinking when you came all this way. I know all of it."

lines.content: 一緒にさくらの樹を見上げていた、お父さんは言ったのだ――
lines.translated: Looking up at the cherry blossom tree together, my father said--

lines.content: “君にぼくの命をあげるよ。ぼくたちの子を取り戻そう……。ごめんね。せめてそうすることしか、ぼくは、君に報いれるものがないんだ”
lines.translated: "I'll give you my life. Let's take back our child... I'm sorry. Doing at least this much is the only way I have to make it up to you."

lines.content: お父さんには、お母さん以外に心から愛する人がいた。本当はその人と一緒になりたかった。でも、厳格なばかりが取り柄の家風がそれを許さなかった。
lines.translated: My father had someone else besides my mother whom he loved from the bottom of his heart. He had truly wanted to be with that person. However, his family's traditions, whose only merit was their strictness, did not allow it.

lines.content: “来世で一緒になろうね。大好きだよ。愛してる……。君に秘密で、その人とは幼い頃からそう誓い合ってたんだ”
lines.translated: "Let's be together in our next life. I adore you. I love you... In secret from you, that person and I promised that to each other ever since we were young."

lines.content: “君のことは愛せない。それなのに、ぼくは君の人生をもてあそんだも同じだ”
lines.translated: "I cannot love you. And yet, it's the same as if I toyed with your life."

lines.content: それはお父さんの中で重い罪の意識となって、お父さんを苦しめた。だからお母さんに今回の命を捧げてもいいと思った。
lines.translated: That became a heavy sense of guilt within my father, tormenting him. That was why he thought it would be fine to dedicate his current life to my mother.

lines.content: ……そういうさみしさの持ち主だったのだ。
lines.translated: He was someone who carried that kind of loneliness.

lines.content: 誰もが傷つき、誰もが苦しみ、それぞれ決して同じではない悲しみの中を生きている。
lines.translated: Everyone gets hurt, everyone suffers, and everyone lives amidst a sadness that is never the same as anyone else's.

lines.content: “互いに次の世界で、次の人生で、幸せになろう。愛する人を見つけよう”
lines.translated: "Let's both become happy in the next world, in our next lives. Let's find the people we love."
Right then, she came back to her senses.

lines.content: ……罪悪感だ。
lines.translated: It was guilt.

lines.content: こんなにもさみしい心の持ち主を、自分は、自分の“夢”を叶えるために食い物にしようとしていた。
lines.translated: She had been about to prey upon someone with such a lonely heart in order to fulfill her own "dream."
No way.

lines.content: 自分が[・|こ][・|ん][・|な][・|こ][・|と]を考えていたなんて――うそだ。
lines.translated: That she had been thinking of doing something like this--no way.

lines.content: [・|正][・|気][・|に][・|戻][・|り]、自分で自分が嫌になった。恐ろしくもさえ思った。
lines.translated: Coming back to her senses, she hated herself. She was even terrified of herself.

lines.content: 駆け出した。
lines.translated: She broke into a run.

lines.content: お父さんの手を離し……。
lines.translated: Letting go of my father's hand...

lines.content: 走った。
lines.translated: I ran.

lines.content: どうして……っ。
lines.translated: Why...?

lines.content: こんなにもやさしい人を、私は……っ。
lines.translated: How could I do that to someone so kind...?

lines.content: どうして自分がこんなことをしようと考えたのかわからない。
lines.translated: She didn't understand why she had thought to do such a thing.
It was almost as if the will of someone other than herself had flowed into her heart...

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.
"'...Take me!'"

lines.content: 私の“命”をあの子にあげて……っ。
lines.translated: Give my "life" to that child...!

lines.content: その願いを瞬く間に“夜”は――“夜”の底に眠る少女たちは、受け入れてくれたのだろう。
lines.translated: In the blink of an eye, the "Night"--the girls sleeping at the bottom of the "Night"--must have accepted that wish.

lines.content: 私のお母さんは“命”をなくした。
lines.translated: My mother lost her "life."

lines.content: “夜”を彷徨う“影”となった。
lines.translated: She became a "shadow" wandering the "Night."

lines.content: そうして私は、お母さんの作ってくれた人形を依り代にし、お母さんの“[命|心臓]”をもらい、存在を得て――“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”の中に産まれ直したのだ。
lines.translated: And so, using the doll my mother made for me as a vessel, I received my mother's "heart"--her "life"--gained an existence, and was reborn into the "real world," the Time of the Sun.

lines.content: ……お父さんもお母さんもいない。ひとりぼっちな女の子として。
lines.translated: With neither a father nor a mother. As a girl all alone.

lines.content: 赤ん坊だった私を、たくさんの[おばあさんたち|大人たち]が入れ替わり、立ち替わり、育ててくれた。
lines.translated: When I was a baby, many old women--many adults--took turns raising me.

lines.content: 私は……
私は、私のお世話をしてくれるおばあさん達から、お母さんのことをよく問いかけていた。
lines.translated: I often asked the old women who took care of me about my mother.

lines.content: 知りたい全部を聞かせてくれる人はいなかったし、大人たちにしたところで、私の問いかけた全部を知っている人もまたいない。
lines.translated: There was no one who would tell me everything I wanted to know, and even among the adults, there was no one who knew the answers to everything I asked.

lines.content: 教えてもられるものは、いつも部分部分を少しずつだ。
lines.translated: What I was told was always just little bits and pieces at a time.

lines.content: それらを自分の中でつなぎ合わせて……。
lines.translated: Piecing them together within myself...

lines.content: 私の“[命|心臓]”はお母さんのものなんだって、知ったんだよ……
lines.translated: "I learned that my 'heart'--my 'life'--belongs to my mother..."

lines.content: 私、夜月姫織という存在は、お母さんの“想い”によって生かされている。
lines.translated: My existence as Yotsuki Himeori is kept alive by my mother's "feelings."

lines.content: ……十年前。
lines.translated: Ten years ago.

lines.content: “夜の王”との戦いに参加したのは、この“[命|心臓]”をお母さんに返したかったからだ。
lines.translated: The reason I participated in the battle against the "King of the Night" was because I wanted to return this "heart"--this "life"--to my mother.
"I thought that if I did that, I might be able to meet my mother at the very end, even if only for a single moment."

lines.content: でも……
でもね。十年前の私が手に入れた“魔法”では、だめだった。誰のことも取り戻せなかった。どんなに願っても。祈っても。想像してみても。“夜”は、私の想いに答えてくれなかった……
lines.translated: "But you know, the 'magic' I obtained ten years ago wasn't enough. I couldn't take anyone back. No matter how much I wished. No matter how much I prayed. No matter how much I tried to imagine it. The 'Night' wouldn't answer my feelings..."

lines.content: あさひさんに“どうして？”って相談してみた。
lines.translated: I consulted Asahi-san, asking her, "Why?"

lines.content: “どうして私の魔法は、私の願いを叶えてくれないの？”
lines.translated: "Why won't my magic grant my wish?"

lines.content: 私の“[想い|想像力]”が弱いからかと、思った。
lines.translated: I wondered if it was because my "feelings"--my imagination--were weak.

lines.content: だから“夜に眠る少女たち”に共感してもらえなかった――同情、してもらえなかった。
lines.translated: That was why the "girls sleeping in the Night" didn't empathize with me--didn't sympathize with me.

lines.content: だから叶えられない？
lines.translated: Is that why it can't be granted?

lines.content: 私の“夢”は、誰の心にも届かない幼稚なもの……なのかな。
lines.translated: Is my "dream" something childish that can't reach anyone's heart...?

lines.content: 『いいや。違うよ』
lines.translated: "'No. That's not it.'"

lines.content: あさひさんは、言った。
lines.translated: Asahi-san said.

lines.content: 『ただ、姫織。君が取り戻したいと願っている人は、その人の魂とか心とか――“存在”そのものは、もう既に“次”の[・|何][・|か]に産まれ直してしまってるんじゃないかな』
lines.translated: "'It's just, Himeori... The person you are wishing to take back--their soul, or their heart, or rather their 'existence' itself--might have already been reborn into their 'next' something.'"

lines.content: 私が“帰ってきてほしい”と願う大切な人の命は、もう既に、“次”の時間を生きているのかもしれない。
lines.translated: The life of the precious person I wish would "come back" might already be living in their "next" time.

lines.content: だから私の“魔法”は、その効果を発揮することができないのではないかということらしい……。
lines.translated: It seems that might be why my "magic" is unable to show its effect...

lines.content: もう“次”の人生を歩んでいるかもしれない“命”
lines.translated: A "life" that might already be walking through its "next" life.

lines.content: それを無理矢理に前回の人生に――つまり前世に引き戻されるだなんて、迷惑だなんていうどころの話じゃなくなる。あんまりにも身勝手だ。
lines.translated: Forcing them to be pulled back to their previous life--in other words, their past life--would be far worse than a mere nuisance. It's way too selfish.

lines.content: だったら私は何のために戦ったのかな。
lines.translated: Then what did I fight for?

lines.content: 私は、ひとりぼっちな私は、いったい誰の笑顔を探して生きていけば、いいのかな。
lines.translated: Whose smile should I--someone who is all alone--search for as I go on living?

lines.content: 迷子になった。
lines.translated: I became lost.

lines.content: 人生に、迷子だ。
lines.translated: Lost in life.

lines.content: これからどういうふうにこのさみしい心と付き合い、生きていけば良いのか……。
lines.translated: How should I deal with this lonely heart and go on living from here on out...?

lines.content: 私は生きるための目標も、“夢”も、“希望”も、産まれる前からなくしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: I had lost my goal to live for, my "dream," and my "hope" before I was even born.

lines.content: 『ありがとう、姫織』
lines.translated: "'Thank you, Himeori.'"

lines.content: そんな私に、あさひさんはやさしく言った。
lines.translated: Seeing me like that, Asahi-san spoke gently.

lines.content: 『君の“願い”。君の“夢”。君の“魔法”……それらを[・|少][・|し]でも、私に教えてくれて』
lines.translated: "'For telling me even a little bit about your "wish," your "dream," your "magic"...'"

lines.content: どうやら他の子たちの[・|そ][・|れ][・|ら]を、あさひさんは知らないようだったけど……。
lines.translated: Apparently, Asahi-san didn't know those things about the other girls, though...

lines.content: 『君の“想い”のすべてが叶うよう、これからもできうる限り、協力していければと思う。……君たち人間の心に憧れてばかりいるこんな私に、どこまでできるのか。わからないけどね』
lines.translated: "'I want to keep helping you as much as I possibly can from here on out so that all of your "feelings" come true. ...Though I don't know just how much someone like me, who does nothing but yearn for your human hearts, can really do.'"

lines.content: それから私はどうしていいかわからないまま、どういうふうに生きて良いのかも、理解できない子どもなまま、だらだらと時間だけは過ぎ……。
lines.translated: After that, still not knowing what I should do, still a child who couldn't understand how I ought to live, time simply dragged on...

lines.content: 十年だ。
lines.translated: Ten years.

lines.content: 十年以上も時は過ぎた。
lines.translated: Over ten years passed.

lines.content: “夢は叶わない”
lines.translated: "Dreams don't come true."

lines.content: そんな思いが、諦めが、いつしか私の心を大人に育てていったのだろう――私の“命”は、“夜の国”から遠ざかってしまっていた。
lines.translated: Those thoughts, that resignation, must have gradually raised my heart into adulthood before I knew it--and my "life" grew distant from the "Land of the Night."

lines.content: だけどつい先日、大雅に“夜”の中で起こされた。そこでたくさんのお話に私は触れた。十夜と、十夜のお友だちの話。
lines.translated: However, just the other day, Taiga woke me up within the "Night." There, I came into contact with many stories. Stories about Toya and Toya's friend.

lines.content: “特別なお友だち。大切なひと”
lines.translated: "A special friend. Someone precious."

lines.content: “また会えると信じてる”
lines.translated: "Believing they will meet again."

lines.content: “……また手と手を繋いで笑い合えるはず”
lines.translated: "...That they'll surely hold hands and laugh together once more."

lines.content: “目に見えないたくさんの想い”
lines.translated: "Countless invisible feelings."

lines.content: “夜の中に産まれ直すということ”
lines.translated: "What it means to be reborn into the Night."

lines.content: もしかしたら、お母さん。
lines.translated: Perhaps, Mother...

lines.content: あなたは“夜のイキモノ”となって、“夜”の中に産まれ直して……そうしていつも私のそばにいて、私のことを、見守ってくれて……いないかな
lines.translated: "Could it be that you became a 'Creature of the Night,' were reborn into the 'Night'... and have always been right beside me, watching over me...?"

lines.content: そんな“希望”を抱いてしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up harboring that kind of "hope."

lines.content: お母さんが選んだ“次”は、いつだって私たちの“隣”に寄り添う“夜”の中にある……。だから私の“魔法”が届かなかったんじゃ、ないのかな
lines.translated: "The 'next' life my mother chose is inside the 'Night' that always stays right 'beside' us... Maybe that's why my 'magic' couldn't reach her."

lines.content: そんな“夢”を、思い描いてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: I ended up picturing that kind of "dream."

lines.content: あるいは“後悔”ばかりの“影”となり、未だ“夜”の中を彷徨っているのかもしれない……。
lines.translated: Or perhaps she became a "shadow" filled with nothing but "regret," and is still wandering through the "Night" even now...

lines.content: だから私の声は、“魔法”は、やはり届くことはなかった。
lines.translated: And that was why my voice, my "magic," never reached her after all.

lines.content: ならば“大切な人を産まれ直させる方法”を、試してみよう――私の部屋はお母さんが使っていた部屋だ。その押し入れに古びた袋を見つけた。その中に日記帳があったのだ。
lines.translated: In that case, I decided to try the "method to make a precious person be reborn"--my room is the room my mother used to use. I found an old bag in its closet, and inside it was a diary.

lines.content: ひとりぼっちで戻って来たお父さんが、“夜”の中から持ち帰った唯一のものだ。
lines.translated: It was the sole thing my father brought back from the "Night" when he returned all alone.

lines.content: “[ほし|惑星]のかけらを探しに行こう！”
lines.translated: "Let's go look for the Star Fragments!"

lines.content: 書き殴られたそんな一文と、失った命を取り戻す方法と、そして希望の光を集めて回るための地図が、その日記帳の中には在った。
lines.translated: That hastily scribbled sentence, the method to reclaim a lost life, and a map for going around collecting the lights of hope were all inside that diary.

lines.content: おばあさん達から聞いたのだ。私の“命”はお母さんからこの方法で譲り受けたもの。
lines.translated: I heard about it from the old women. My "life" was passed down to me from my mother through this method.

lines.content: たった一度、あなたと会うため旅に出よう。
lines.translated: Let's set out on a journey to meet you just once.

lines.content: お母さんと同じ方法を通して、今度は私がこの“命”をあなたに返そう――そのための旅に出るんだ。
lines.translated: Through the same method my mother used, this time I will return this "life" to you--I'll go on a journey for that sake.

lines.content: “夜”の中でならきっと届くと信じてた。私の想いも、お母さんからもらったこの“[命|心臓]”も。全部ぜんぶ届くと信じてたんだよ
lines.translated: "I believed that if it was within the 'Night,' it would surely reach her. Both my feelings and this 'life'--this heart--that I received from my mother. I believed every last bit of it would reach her."
It was guilt.

lines.content: 私もね、いつもそれを感じてた。お母さんと、同じ
lines.translated: "You know, I always felt it too. Just like my mother."

lines.content: 私がもうちょっとがんばって、自分の力で、この世界に生まれて来れていたら――お母さんが自分の“命”を無駄にすることもなかったのにって
lines.translated: "Thinking that if I had just tried a little harder and been born into this world through my own strength--my mother wouldn't have had to waste her own 'life.'"

lines.content: そんなのはどうすることもできないことじゃないか。そう言う人もいるだろう。
lines.translated: Some people would probably say that such a thing couldn't be helped.

lines.content: そういうふうにやさしく私の心を護ってくれようとする人は、きっと少なくないはずだと想像もできる。
lines.translated: I can easily imagine there are plenty of people who would try to gently protect my heart like that.

lines.content: わかってる。理屈はわかるよ。とってもよくわかる。お母さんのお腹の中にいた小さなちいさな私は、自分の自由に考えることもできないくらい……小さかったんだもん
lines.translated: "I know. I understand the logic. I understand it very well. Because the tiny, tiny me inside my mother's womb was so small... I couldn't even think freely for myself."

lines.content: でも、だめだよ。理屈じゃないの。私はきっと、産まれることを諦めた。お母さんのお腹の中で何か小さなトラブルがあったんだろうと思う
lines.translated: "Even so, it's no good. It's not about logic. I'm sure I gave up on being born. I think there must have been some small trouble inside my mother's womb."

lines.content: たったそれだけのことで私は産まれることを簡単に手放したから――後悔だ。後悔してる。どうしてもっとがんばれなかったのかって。
lines.translated: Because I so easily let go of being born over something as small as that--it's regret. I regret it. Why couldn't I have tried harder?

lines.content: だから私は“命”を返す。そう決めた。この胸の中の“罪悪感”を消すためにも。
lines.translated: That is why I will return this "life." I made up my mind to do so, if only to erase the "guilt" inside my chest.

lines.content: もしもお母さんが“次”の人生を生きているのではなく、“夜”の中で“影”となってしまっているのなら[・|そ][・|れ]はきっと叶う。
lines.translated: If my mother isn't living her "next" life, and has instead become a "shadow" within the "Night," then that wish will surely come true.

lines.content: そうして“夜”の中で、何か――新しい“イキモノ”に産まれ直す。
lines.translated: And then, within the "Night," I will be reborn into something--a new "creature."

lines.content: そうだよ。私は別に、死にに行くため旅に出たわけではないのだ。
lines.translated: That's right. It wasn't as if I set out on a journey to go and die.

lines.content: ……でもね。ひとりで“夜”を旅することは怖かった。勇気がなかった。“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を集められる自信もあまりなかった
lines.translated: "...But you know, traveling through the 'Night' all alone was scary. I didn't have the courage. And I didn't have much confidence that I could gather the 'Star Fragments' either."

lines.content: 自信がなかったというのなら、お母さんは“夜”の中で私のことを見守っていてくれるかも――なんていう予感もまた、自信はなかった。
lines.translated: Speaking of lacking confidence, I wasn't confident in my hunch that my mother might be watching over me in the "Night," either.

lines.content: それに、ひとりぼっちで“[命|心臓]”を返すのは――うん。やっぱりね、すっごく怖かったし、さみしくもあったんだよ
lines.translated: "Besides, returning this 'life'--this heart--all by myself... Yeah. After all, it was really scary, and it was lonely, too."

lines.content: だから大雅に付いてきてもらった。
lines.translated: That was why I had Taiga come with me.

lines.content: 一番仲の良いお友だちだと思っていたから。
lines.translated: Because I thought of him as my very best friend.

lines.content: 私の“さよなら”を、見守っていてほしかった。
lines.translated: I wanted him to watch over my "goodbye."

lines.content: でもそれは失敗だった。大失敗。
lines.translated: But that was a mistake. A huge mistake.

lines.content: ……色々なものと“さよなら”するための覚悟を決めて、私は今夜、最後の“夜”に這入ったはずなのに。
lines.translated: Even though I had steeled my resolve to say "goodbye" to all sorts of things and entered my final "Night" tonight.

lines.content: それなのに、大雅があんなこと言い出すんだもん
lines.translated: "And yet, Taiga just had to go and say something like that."

lines.content: “約束”だ。
lines.translated: Our "promise."

lines.content: さみしがりな私との“約束”を、大雅は覚えてくれていた。
lines.translated: Taiga had remembered his "promise" to the lonely girl I was.

lines.content: たったそれだけのことが、私はとてもうれしくて……だから、
lines.translated: Something as simple as that made me so happy... and so,

lines.content: ……だからね。もう大雅と会えなくなっちゃう。それを怖いと、思ったの
lines.translated: "...And so, you know. I wouldn't be able to see Taiga anymore. I realized I was scared of that."

lines.content: それは私の中に色々な気持ちが芽生えたからだと、気づいてた
lines.translated: "I realized it was because all sorts of feelings had sprouted inside me."

lines.content: 大雅なら私をひとりぼっちにはしてくれないのかも。そう思った。
lines.translated: I thought that maybe Taiga wouldn't leave me all alone.

lines.content: いつもさみしいばかりの私の心に、いっぱい、たくさん、やさしくしてくれるのかもしれない。そう、期待してしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up hoping that he might shower my endlessly lonely heart with so, so much kindness.

lines.content: だって私、ここで大雅と……
lines.translated: "Because right here, Taiga and I..."

lines.content: ここで、キスをした。
lines.translated: Right here, we kissed.

lines.content: 最初は殆ど強引だったけど……。
lines.translated: It was almost entirely forceful at first, though...

lines.content: たぶん、とても幸せだったんだろうと思う。
lines.translated: I think I must have been very happy.

lines.content: だから“夜”を彷徨う“影”になった私は、あのときの幸せな記憶を求め――ここにこうしてやって来た。
lines.translated: That's why, after becoming a "shadow" wandering the "Night," I sought out the happy memories of that moment--and came back here like this.

lines.content: そんな私のことをあなたが迎えに来てくれないかなと、自分勝手にまた期待をしていたけれど。
lines.translated: I was selfishly hoping all over again that he might come here to find me, even in this state.

lines.content: あなただ。ナナちゃん。
lines.translated: It was you. Nana-chan.

lines.content: 小さな“夜の神さま”が、さみしい私をこうして見つけてくれた。
lines.translated: The little "God of the Night" found lonely me just like this.

lines.content: すると不思議だ。
lines.translated: And then, something wondrous happened.

lines.content: 今、こうして、“影”だったはずの私は元の姿に戻ってる。ほんの少しの間かもしれないけれど。
lines.translated: Right now, though I should have been a "shadow," I have returned to my original form. Even if it might only be for a fleeting moment.

lines.content: でもね、ナナちゃん。
lines.translated: But you know, Nana-chan...

lines.content: ごめんね、大雅。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, Taiga.

lines.content: 私はここから先へは進めないし――進みたくないと、思ってる。
lines.translated: I cannot move forward from here--and I don't want to.

lines.content: ……私には将来の夢とかなにもない。なりたいものとかやりたいこととか、そういうの、全然ないの
lines.translated: "...I don't have any dreams for the future or anything like that. Things I want to become, things I want to do... I don't have any of that at all."

lines.content: 代わりにいつもいつでも迷ってばかりいた――私はお母さんからもらった命で、いったいどういうふうに生きなきゃいけないんだろう。正しい道はどこにあるのか。
lines.translated: Instead, I was always, endlessly lost--wondering just how on earth I was supposed to live with the life I received from my mother. Wondering where the right path lay.

lines.content: 夢がないと生きていないのと同じって、誰かが言ってたけど……そのとおりだなあって思うよ。夢があったらきっと、誰も人生に迷わないから
lines.translated: "Someone once said that having no dreams is the same as not being alive... and I think that's really true. Because if you have a dream, surely no one would ever get lost in life."

lines.content: でも私にはそういうものがまったくない。
lines.translated: Yet I have nothing of the sort at all.

lines.content: 代わりにいっぱいのさみしさと、罪悪感ばかりが日々、心に重なり続けていくだけだ。
lines.translated: Instead, nothing but overwhelming loneliness and guilt continues to pile up in my heart day after day.

lines.content: ……自分は何の価値もない人間だと、何事も成すことのない毎日を重ねては、思うばかりだ。
lines.translated: As I string together days of accomplishing nothing, all I ever think is that I am a worthless human being.

lines.content: だからね、そろそろもういいかなあって思ったの
lines.translated: "So, you know, I thought maybe it was about time to call it quits."

lines.content: こんなさみしい気持ちをずっと抱えて生きていくのも疲れるし……。何もないこんな私がたったひとりで、これから先、“大人の世界”を生きていける自信はなかった
lines.translated: "It's exhausting to keep living while carrying such lonely feelings all the time... And I didn't have the confidence that someone like me, who has nothing, could survive in the 'adult world' all alone from here on out."

lines.content: 完全に大人になっちゃうその前に……、“夜の国”に完全に関われなくなっちゃうその前にね。旅に出ようと決めたんだよ
lines.translated: "Before I completely become an adult... before I lose the ability to be involved with the 'Land of the Night' altogether, I decided to set out on a journey."

lines.content: そうして夜月姫織という存在を捨て、“夜のイキモノ”に産まれ直そうと思った。
lines.translated: I intended to cast aside my existence as Yotsuki Himeori and be reborn as a "Creature of the Night."

lines.content: 好きなお友だちの隣によりそって、“夜”の中でこれからは生きよう――私は、私の心は、永遠に子どもだ。
lines.translated: To stay close beside a friend I care about and live within the "Night" from now on--I, and my heart, are eternally a child.

lines.content: 十夜とそのお友だちのことを見て、そういう道を私も選ぼうって、思ったの……
lines.translated: "Looking at Toya and her friend, I thought I would choose that kind of path for myself, too..."

lines.content: ……大切に思いたい誰かのそばに、いつも寄り添う。その人が何か困難に立ち止まることがあるのなら、いつでもそばで力を貸したい――そういうふうに“夜”を生きる
lines.translated: "...To always stay close beside someone I want to cherish. If that person ever stops in their tracks before some hardship, I want to always be right there to lend them my strength--to live in the 'Night' like that."

lines.content: ……“夢”も“希望”もなにもない私だから、大切な人の“夢”や“希望”を応援していく生き方も、きっといい
lines.translated: "...Because I have no 'dreams' or 'hopes' of my own, I'm sure a way of life where I support the 'dreams' and 'hopes' of someone precious to me would be nice, too."

lines.content: それなのに覚悟がぶれた。
lines.translated: And yet, my resolve wavered.

lines.content: 大雅ともう少し一緒にいたいなあって、そんなことを思ってしまったんだよ。ばかみたいだけど。おかしな話だけれど。そう、思っちゃったの
lines.translated: "I ended up thinking that I wanted to stay with Taiga just a little longer. It sounds foolish, I know. It's a strange thing to say, I know. But that's what I ended up thinking."

lines.content: そんな想いを振り切るために、大雅と一緒にさくらを見上げた。
lines.translated: To shake off those feelings, I looked up at the cherry blossoms together with Taiga.

lines.content: 繋いだこの手を離す。その瞬間を合図と決めよう。そう決めた。
lines.translated: I would let go of his hand in mine. I decided to make that moment the signal. My mind was made up.

lines.content: さよなら……。
lines.translated: Goodbye...

lines.content: そう言って。
lines.translated: Saying those words.

lines.content: ありがとう。大雅。
lines.translated: Thank you, Taiga.

lines.content: そう、伝え。
lines.translated: Conveying that to him.

lines.content: あの人の手を、私は離した……。
lines.translated: I let go of his hand...

lines.content: ……いつか、あなたの“命”が終わるとき
lines.translated: "'...Someday, when your "life" comes to an end.'"

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 最期のときだよ。そのときに“ああ、あのときああいうふうにしておけば……”そういう“後悔”をするような生き方だけはしちゃだめだよ
lines.translated: "'In your final moments. At that time, you must never have lived in a way that leaves you with "regrets," thinking, "Ah, if only I had done things differently back then..."'"

lines.content: それは日記帳に書かれていた言葉だった。
lines.translated: Those were words written in the diary.

lines.content: ぺらぺらめくった日記帳の中には“[ほし|惑星]のかけらを見つけに行こう！”という一文だけではない。
lines.translated: Flipping through the pages of the diary, that single sentence--"Let's go find the Star Fragments!"--wasn't the only thing written inside.

lines.content: そして“夜”の中で行える様々な[・|不][・|思][・|議]を説明するだけではない。そこにはあらゆる言葉が日々をつづるようにして並んでいた。
lines.translated: Nor did it merely explain the various wonders that could be performed within the "Night." All kinds of words were lined up across the pages, chronicling the passing days.

lines.content: きっと、私のお母さんのことを想う誰かが残した言葉だ。お母さんの心を勇気づけた言葉でもあるはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely, they were words left behind by someone who cared deeply for my mother. Words that must have encouraged my mother's heart, too.

lines.content: そういうふうに想像できたから……。
lines.translated: Because I could imagine it that way...

lines.content: だから私も好きな言葉だった。お守りみたいにいつも心に抱いていた。
lines.translated: I loved those words, too. I always held them close to my heart like a good luck charm.

lines.content: あなたがこれからどんな未来を思い描くのか――あなたがどんな選択をしても。どんなふうに与えられた“[命|心臓]”を選ぼうと。あなたが思い通り以上に生きていけるような世界にしたい
lines.translated: "No matter what kind of future you envision from here on out--no matter what choices you make, or what you choose to do with the 'life' you were given. I want to make this a world where you can live even better than you ever hoped."

lines.content: あなたが人生を終えるとき、何の“後悔”もなく笑っていられますように。そういう世界を、あなたのお母さんは望んでた
lines.translated: "May you be able to smile without a single 'regret' when your life comes to an end. That is the kind of world your mother wished for."

lines.content: 私は目を伏せる。
lines.translated: I cast my eyes downward.

lines.content: でも……。だめだよナナちゃん
lines.translated: "Even so... I can't, Nana-chan."

lines.content: 私は私の“夢”を叶えるだけの資格がない。
lines.translated: I don't have the right to make my own "dreams" come true.

lines.content: 私の胸にあるのはお母さんの“[命|心臓]”なんだよ
lines.translated: "What's beating in my chest is my mother's 'life,' you know."

lines.content: そうだね
lines.translated: "That's true."

lines.content: だからなに、とばかりにナナちゃんは目を瞬いている。
lines.translated: Nana-chan blinked as if to ask, "So what?"

lines.content: ……私。“夢”も“希望”も何もないのに。ただ毎日、仲の良い子とわいわいできてればそれでいいんだって、それだけで……。がんばりたいなって思うようなことも、何もない
lines.translated: "...I don't have any 'dreams' or 'hopes' or anything. I always thought that as long as I could just chat and have fun with close friends every day, that alone would be enough... There's nothing I feel like working hard for, either."

lines.content: 世の中には私なんかよりもっとがんばって生きてる人がたくさんいるし、たくさんいたはずだよ
lines.translated: "Out in the world, there are so many people working much harder to live than someone like me, and there must have been so many in the past, too."

lines.content: それなのに……。こんな私だけが、[・|人][・|生][・|を][・|や][・|り][・|直][・|せ][・|る][・|な][・|ん][・|て]……。こんな私だけが、人の“[命|心臓]”をもらってまで生きる価値が、どこかにあるのかな
lines.translated: "And yet... for someone like me to be the only one who gets to start their life over... Could there really be any worth in someone like me living at the cost of receiving another person's 'life'?"

lines.content: どうしたってあるとは思えなかった。
lines.translated: No matter how I looked at it, I couldn't believe there was.

lines.content: 言ってしまえば私を未来へ繋ぐため、消費されていくたくさんの食料やら酸素さえもが無駄だと思える。
lines.translated: Honestly, even all the food and oxygen consumed just to carry me into the future feels like a complete waste.

lines.content: だから、私は、もう……“夜”の中に帰りたかった
lines.translated: "That's why I just... wanted to return to the 'Night' already."

lines.content: “外の世界”を生きているということだけで重なり続ける、大きなおおきな“罪悪感”に、今にも呑まれそうになっている……。
lines.translated: Just by living in the "outside world," this massive, overwhelming "guilt" keeps piling up, and it feels like it's about to swallow me whole at any moment...

lines.content: ……確かに
lines.translated: "...It's true."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが言う。
lines.translated: Nana-chan says.

lines.content: 確かに母親の命をあなたはもらった。あなたは、人ひとりの命を、そして人生をすべて奪ったとも言えるのかもしれない。罪悪感に負けそうになってしまうのも、わかるよ。理解できる
lines.translated: "It is true that you were given your mother's life. Perhaps you could even say that you stole a person's entire life and future away from them. I know how it feels to almost be crushed by that guilt. I understand."

lines.content: でも、代わりに……って言うのも短絡的だけれど、とにかくあなたは、姫織。あなたがひとり分の命を犠牲にして、この世界に生まれてきたからこそ、“夜の王”は倒された
lines.translated: "Calling it a trade-off might sound overly simplistic, Himeori, but the fact remains: it was precisely because you were born into this world at the sacrifice of a single life that the 'King of the Night' was defeated."

lines.content: あなたは、仲間たちと一緒に、多くの人たちの未来を救ったんだよ。ナナちゃんはそう言って私を見上げた。
lines.translated: "Together with your friends, you saved the futures of so many people." Saying that, Nana-chan looked up at me.

lines.content: だからあなたが罪の意識なんて持つ必要はない。むしろ誇ってさえ良いはずだ
lines.translated: "So there's no need for you to carry any sense of guilt. In fact, you have every right to be proud."

lines.content: この世界中の誰もがみんなそう思うはず。ナナちゃんはそう言い切った。
lines.translated: Everyone in this whole wide world would surely think so, too. Nana-chan declared that with absolute certainty.

lines.content: ……でも
lines.translated: "...Even though..."

lines.content: だからね、姫織――
lines.translated: "And so, Himeori--"

lines.content: ぐずぐずするばかりの私の声を、ナナちゃんは遮断する。
lines.translated: Nana-chan cut off my endless, hesitant whining.

lines.content: 今度はあなた自身の“夢”を叶える番だよ。ようやくその番が回ってきたんだ
lines.translated: "This time, it's your turn to make your own 'dream' come true. Your turn has finally come around."

lines.content: どういうこと……？
lines.translated: "What do you mean...?"

lines.content: 私には“夢”も“希望”もなにもない。そういう話を、ずっとしてきたはずなのに――それなのに、今度は私が“夢”を叶える番？
lines.translated: I don't have any "dreams" or "hopes" or anything. Even though I've been telling her that this whole time--now it's my turn to make a "dream" come true?

lines.content: 姫織。あなたは十年前の“夜”の中で“魔法”を得た。失われた“[命|心臓]”を、夜の中から取り戻すための“魔法”を。同じように集められた子らと力を合わせて
lines.translated: "Himeori. In the 'Night' ten years ago, you obtained 'magic.' The 'magic' to reclaim a lost 'life' from within the Night, by joining forces with the other children who had been gathered the same way."

lines.content: そしてその“魔法”は、まだ使われることのないまま、あなたの胸の中にある――
lines.translated: "And that 'magic' is still inside your chest, without ever having been used--"

lines.content: ナナちゃんは私の胸元を指さした。
lines.translated: Nana-chan pointed at my chest.

lines.content: 十年前には確かにあなたは“夢”を抱いた。そのときの“夢”はもうなくなってしまったのかもしれないけれど……。それでも、あなたの心は夢見ることができないわけじゃない
lines.translated: "Ten years ago, you certainly held a 'dream.' Perhaps the 'dream' you had back then is gone now... Even so, it's not as though your heart is incapable of dreaming."

lines.content: 探せば必ず、あの頃とは違う新しい“夢”が今、その胸の中にあるはずだ。
lines.translated: If you look for it, there is surely a new "dream"--different from the one back then--inside your chest right now.

lines.content: ……今だよ。今こそあなたのその“魔法”を、今日まで重ねてきたいっぱいの“想い”を解き放つときだよ――そのすべてを、あなた自身の“夢”のために使うときだよ
lines.translated: "...Now is the time. Now is the moment to unleash that 'magic' of yours, along with all the 'feelings' you've built up until today--it's time to use all of it for the sake of your very own 'dream.'"
"My... 'dream'..."

lines.content: そうつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I murmured the words.

lines.content: すると大切な人の顔が浮かんだ。
lines.translated: As I did, the face of someone precious to me rose in my mind.

lines.content: ……大切なのだと気づいてしまった、あの人の……大雅の笑顔だ。
lines.translated: The smile of that person I had come to realize was so dear to me... Taiga's smile.

lines.content: 今、あの人の“左手”こそが私の“魔法”を――[・|私][・|自][・|身]の“想い”を使う鍵となっている。大雅はそういう“役割”をあさひさんから譲り受けてる。ナナちゃんは私にそう言った。
lines.translated: Right now, his "left hand" is the key to using my "magic"--to using my very own "feelings." Taiga inherited that "role" from Asahi-san. That's what Nana-chan told me.

lines.content: 私の中に眠る[・|そ][・|の][・|力]を今、自分のために使うべきなのだとナナちゃんは繰り返し、私に言った。
lines.translated: Over and over, Nana-chan told me that I should use that power sleeping inside me for my own sake right now.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: 今夜、“さよなら”するのに思い出がほしいからと、自分の中にそんな理由を作り、唇を合わせた。
lines.translated: Telling myself that I wanted a memory before saying "goodbye" tonight, I made up that excuse in my head and pressed my lips to his.

lines.content: 胸が痛んだ。
lines.translated: My chest ached.

lines.content: 私との“約束”を覚えていてくれた大雅だけど……。
lines.translated: Taiga had remembered his "promise" to me, and yet...

lines.content: 正直なところ、最初はちょっとした好奇心だったのだ。
lines.translated: To be honest, at first it was just a little bit of curiosity.

lines.content: もうこれで最後の夜なら、その……[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|こ][・|と]もしてみたい。それなら大雅がいい。大雅に私の全部をもらってほしい。
lines.translated: If this really was going to be my last night, then, well... I wanted to try doing that sort of thing, too. And if I was going to, I wanted it to be with Taiga. I wanted Taiga to have all of me.

lines.content: そういう思いもどこかにあって、唇を合わせたけれど……。
lines.translated: With those thoughts lingering somewhere in my mind, I pressed my lips to his, but...

lines.content: いやだなと、思ってしまった。
lines.translated: I ended up thinking that I didn't want this to end.

lines.content: このまま“夜”から引き返し、また明日から一緒の時間を過ごせるのなら……。
lines.translated: If I could turn back from the "Night" just like this, and spend time together with him again starting tomorrow...

lines.content: もうひとりぼっちだっていう、さみしい思いをしなくていいかもいい。大雅が一緒だ。
lines.translated: Maybe I wouldn't have to feel so lonely and all alone anymore. Taiga would be with me.

lines.content: 今までと違う色をした時間の中を、これからは生きていけるかもしれない――そういうふうに想像してしまってもいた。
lines.translated: From here on out, I might be able to live through days painted in colors different from anything I've known before--I had even caught myself imagining it that way.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは私の気持ちを全部わかったうえで、“夢を叶えて”と言っているのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is Nana-chan telling me to "make my dream come true" while fully understanding all of my feelings?

lines.content: だとするとなんだかちょっと恥ずかしいような気持ちになる――さすがは“神さま”だ。全部お見通し。大雅へ抱きはじめているこの気持ちも。
lines.translated: If so, it makes me feel a little embarrassed--she really is a "god," after all. She sees right through everything. Even these feelings I've started harbouring for Taiga.

lines.content: だけど今夜、“夜”の中に命を返さなければ、私はきっと“後悔”し続ける――最期のときまで、ずっと。
lines.translated: But if I don't return my life to the "Night" tonight, I will surely keep "regretting" it--all the way until my final moments.

lines.content: ……そんな人生こそ地獄の底にいるようだ。
lines.translated: A life like that would be just like living at the bottom of hell.

lines.content: そう感じたからこそ、私は今、ここにこうしているのだけれど……。
lines.translated: It was precisely because I felt that way that I am here doing this right now, and yet...
"'Regret'..."

lines.content: 私は、このまま“命”を“夜”に返すという選択をして、本当に“後悔”することはないのだろうか。
lines.translated: If I make the choice to return my "life" to the "Night" like this, will I truly have no "regrets"?

lines.content: 大雅とふたりで笑える明日が、心に座り込んでいる。
lines.translated: A tomorrow where Taiga and I can laugh together has settled deep within my heart, refusing to budge.

lines.content: 迷いはじめていた。
lines.translated: I was starting to waver.

lines.content: いつもそうだ。
lines.translated: It's always like this.

lines.content: 私はいつもいつでも迷ってばかりだ……。
lines.translated: I am always, endlessly wavering over everything...

lines.content: ねえ、姫織
lines.translated: "Hey, Himeori."

lines.content: 頭を抱えてしまった私に、ナナちゃんはそっと言った――迷っている暇はないよ、と。
lines.translated: As I clutched my head in my hands, Nana-chan spoke to me gently--telling me that there was no time to hesitate.

lines.content: ……もうそろそろ朝が目覚める
lines.translated: "...Morning is about to wake up."

lines.content: 車窓の外に、そびえる時計塔を見上げた。
lines.translated: Outside the train window, I looked up at the towering clock tower.

lines.content: 急いで、姫織。あなたがどんな“夢”を抱くのかは、わからないけれど……太陽が目覚めるまでに走り出さないと……、大雅が、危ない
lines.translated: "Hurry, Himeori. I don't know what kind of 'dream' you'll embrace, but... if you don't start running before the sun wakes up... Taiga will be in danger."

lines.content: ……朝だ
lines.translated: "...It's morning."

lines.content: “参禅町”の“夜”にもうすぐ朝がやって来る。
lines.translated: Morning will soon arrive in the "Night" of "Sanzen Town."

lines.content: 見上げた時計塔の針がそれを知らせていた。今宵の“夜”に“夢”を求めてやって来たものたちは、ちらほらと“外の世界”へと帰っていく。
lines.translated: The hands of the clock tower I looked up at told me as much. Those who had come seeking "dreams" in tonight's "Night" were gradually returning to the "outside world" one by one.

lines.content: しかし[・|俺]はまだ、“夜”の中から出られずにいた。
lines.translated: However, I was still unable to get out of the "Night."

lines.content: 姫織の“迷子気質”のようなものを、これからは俺が引き継ぐ……
lines.translated: "From now on, I'll be taking over Himeori's tendency to get lost..."

lines.content: つぶやく。
lines.translated: We murmured the words.

lines.content: “魔法”の“代償”だ。
lines.translated: It was the "price" of the "magic."

lines.content: ……“夜”の中に消えてしまった姫織を見つけようと“想像”した“魔法”
lines.translated: The "magic" I "imagined" in order to find Himeori after she vanished into the "Night."

lines.content: しかし、失敗した。
lines.translated: However, I failed.

lines.content: 祈り、“想像”した“[奇跡|魔法]”では、姫織を見つけること叶わず……。
lines.translated: The "miracle" I prayed for and "imagined" was unable to find Himeori...

lines.content: あとにはこの“代償”だけが、残った――“ゆめのねどこ”だ。
lines.translated: And only this "price" was left behind--the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: あそこへ帰り着きたい。
lines.translated: I want to make my way back there.

lines.content: 今、抱え込んでいる諸問題を解決へ導くためには、あさひさんのいるあそこへと、まず戻ることが最善だろうと感じている。
lines.translated: To resolve the various problems we're currently facing, I feel that returning to where Asahi-san is would be the best first step.

lines.content: だけど、だめだ。
lines.translated: But it was no use.

lines.content: 帰り道がわからない。
lines.translated: I don't know the way back.

lines.content: 何度も何度も……“夜”の中でも“夜”の外でも、繰り返し歩いたはずの道なのに。
lines.translated: Even though it's a path I've walked over and over again... both inside the "Night" and outside of it.

lines.content: ……迷子の原因を受け取る
lines.translated: "...To take on the cause of her getting lost."

lines.content: 正直なところそれほど重い“代償”だとは思っていなかった。
lines.translated: To be honest, I hadn't thought it would be that heavy of a "price."

lines.content: 姫織を長く悩ませていただろう[・|そ][・|れ]を、どこか安易に考えていたと指摘されてしまえば、それはその通りなのかもしれないが……。
lines.translated: If someone were to point out that I had taken too lightly the very thing that must have plagued Himeori for so long, I suppose they would be completely right...

lines.content: 失敗してしまったとはいえ“魔法”と対等に並び立つ“代償”だ。軽々しいものであるはずもない。
lines.translated: Even though it ended in failure, it was a "price" that stood on equal footing with "magic." There was no way it would be something trivial.

lines.content: “夜の遊園地”からまっすぐに線路を走り続け、なんとか“刻の終着駅”にまでは戻って来れた。
lines.translated: By running straight along the train tracks from the "Night Amusement Park," I had somehow managed to make it back to the "Terminal Station of Time."

lines.content: だがそこから、どんな道をたどれば良かったのだったか……。
lines.translated: But from there, which path was I supposed to take again...?

lines.content: どういうふうに歩いて行けば、あさひさんが帰りを待っていてくれる“ゆめのねどこ”にたどり着けるのだったか……。
lines.translated: How was I supposed to walk to reach the "Bed of Dreams," where Asahi-san was waiting for my return...?

lines.content: 早く
lines.translated: "Hurry."

lines.content: ……早く帰りたい。
lines.translated: I want to get back quickly.

lines.content: そしてあさひさんに事情を話して、力を借りたい――道になんて迷っているような暇などどこにもないのだ。
lines.translated: I want to explain the situation to Asahi-san and borrow her strength--I have no time at all to be getting lost on the way.

lines.content: こうしている間にも、“夜”に姿を消した姫織のことが気がかりで、ならない。
lines.translated: Even while I'm doing this, I can't stop worrying about Himeori, who vanished into the "Night."

lines.content: “[命|心臓]”をうしない“夜”の中を彷徨う“影”となった姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori, who lost her "life" and became a "shadow" wandering through the "Night."

lines.content: ……朝が来るまでになんとか[・|こ][・|ち][・|ら][・|側]へ引き戻さなければ、手遅れになる。姫織は永遠に闇の中だ――
lines.translated: If I don't somehow pull her back to this side before morning comes, it'll be too late. Himeori will be left in the darkness forever--

lines.content: あ、ああ……
lines.translated: "Ah, yeah..."

lines.content: いつの間にか[・|こ][・|こ]にたどり着いていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had arrived here.

lines.content: 姫織の家……夜月神社へと続く長い石段だ。
lines.translated: Himeori's home... the long stone steps leading up to Yotsuki Shrine.

lines.content: どうして、ここに
lines.translated: "Why am I here...?"

lines.content: 目的の地は“ゆめのねどこ”だった。
lines.translated: My destination was the "Bed of Dreams."

lines.content: だからああでもないこうでもないと、見慣れたはずの風景をさまよい歩いて……。
lines.translated: That's why I had been wandering through scenery that should have been familiar, second-guessing every turn...

lines.content: 結果俺は、あくまでも偶然にここへたどり着いた。
lines.translated: And as a result, I ended up arriving here purely by chance.

lines.content: 時間がない。時間が、ないのだ。もうすぐ朝がやって来る。
lines.translated: There's no time. There is no time left. Morning will be here any moment now.

lines.content: こんな寄り道などしていられないのに……。
lines.translated: I can't afford to be taking a detour like this, and yet...

lines.content: ……行かなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to go."

lines.content: ふと、思うのだ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, the thought struck me.

lines.content: ……ここをのぼった先に、君がいる
lines.translated: "...At the top of these steps, you're there."

lines.content: そんなことを、なぜだろう、俺は当然みたいに思ってしまっていた。
lines.translated: For some reason, I found myself believing that as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

lines.content: 見上げた先には境内がある。
lines.translated: Looking up, the shrine grounds lay ahead.

lines.content: “夜”の空気を淡く照らす行燈の明かりが見える――そこで、姫織。君が俺のことを待っていてくれている。
lines.translated: I could see the light of the paper lanterns faintly illuminating the air of the "Night"--and there, Himeori, you were waiting for me.

lines.content: そんなふうに、根拠なんてまるでないのに強く、思えてしまったから。
lines.translated: Despite having no basis for it whatsoever, I felt that conviction so strongly.

lines.content: だから一歩、階段へと足を踏み出した。
lines.translated: So I took a step forward onto the stairs.

lines.content: 不思議だった。
lines.translated: It was strange.

lines.content: 石段を一歩、一歩……一段一段、ゆっくりとのぼっていく。すると、俺の心にふと芽生えるものがあったのだ。
lines.translated: One step, then another... I climbed the stone steps slowly, one by one. As I did, something suddenly began to bud within my heart.

lines.content: 『“約束”するよ』
lines.translated: "I 'promise' you."

lines.content: 十年前のあの“夜”だ――姫織が“夜の遊園地”で迷子になった“夜”
lines.translated: It was that "Night" ten years ago--the "Night" Himeori got lost in the "Night Amusement Park."
"Hiyo-chan. If you ever... no. If either of us ever gets lost again--"

lines.content: 俺は、“君が迷子になったら必ず俺が迎えに行くから”と、あの“夜”に姫織と交わした“[・|約][・|束]”[・|の]……[・|そ][・|の][・|続][・|き]を、思い出していた。
lines.translated: "If you ever get lost, I'll definitely come find you." I was remembering the continuation of the "promise" I had made with Himeori on that "Night"...

lines.content: 『ねえ、ひよちゃん。もうひとつだけ“約束”をしようよ』
lines.translated: "Hey, Hiyo-chan. Let's make just one more 'promise.'"

lines.content: 手を繋いで歩く小さな姫織に、俺は確かこう言ったのだ――“待ち合わせ場所を決めておこうよ”
lines.translated: Walking hand in hand with little Himeori, I was sure I had said this--"Let's decide on a meeting place."

lines.content: 『もしも俺たちのどちらかが迷ってしまったそのときは、そこを目指して歩いて行こう。そうすれば必ず会える。離ればなれになったとしても、怖い気持ちも半分くらいにはならないかな』
lines.translated: "If either of us ever gets lost, let's walk toward that place. That way, we'll definitely be able to meet. Even if we get separated, won't that cut the scariness in half?"

lines.content: そんなことを言った俺に、姫織はうなずいてくれていた。
lines.translated: When I said that, Himeori nodded in agreement.

lines.content: 『私のことを探してくれてる大雅に、ちゃんと見つけてもらえるようにって。ただ迎えに来てもらえるのを、待ってるばかりじゃなくって。……私も、がんばって歩くよ。[・|そ][・|こ]を目指して』
lines.translated: "So that Taiga can find me when he's looking for me. Instead of just waiting for you to come get me... I'll do my best to walk, too. Aiming for that place."

lines.content: だからお願い、と姫織は不安そうに言った。
lines.translated: "So please," Himeori had said anxiously.

lines.content: 『いつだって迷子な私が、ちゃんと[・|そ][・|こ]にたどり着けるかどうか、わかんないけども……がんばるよ』
lines.translated: "Since I'm always getting lost, I don't know if I'll be able to make it there properly, but... I'll do my best."

lines.content: 『……またこうして、迷子な私と、一緒に手を繋いで歩いてくれるように』
lines.translated: "...So that you'll hold my hand and walk together with a lost child like me again, just like this."

lines.content: そんなあのときの姫織の顔を、思い出してしまうのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't help remembering Himeori's face from back then.

lines.content: そうしてふたりで決めた待ち合わせ。
lines.translated: And so, the meeting place the two of us had decided on.

lines.content: その場所は……。
lines.translated: That place was...
"Right up there."

lines.content: 石段が行き着く先を見上げる。
lines.translated: I looked up at where the stone steps led.

lines.content: 夜月神社の境内。
lines.translated: The grounds of Yotsuki Shrine.

lines.content: あそこが俺たちふたりの待ち合わせ場所だった。遠い昔にそうふたりで決めたのだ。
lines.translated: That was our meeting place. The two of us had decided on it a long, long time ago.

lines.content: ……姫織の家だ。
lines.translated: Himeori's home.

lines.content: ちゃんと家にまでたどり着けるのなら、それはもう迷子でもなんでもないだろう。
lines.translated: If she could make it all the way back home properly, she wouldn't really be lost anymore, would she?

lines.content: 幼い頃の俺たちには、色々と足りていなかった小さなちいさな俺たちには、そんな簡単すぎることにも思い至れなくて……いいや。
lines.translated: Back when we were young, when we were so small and lacking in so many ways, we hadn't even realized something so ridiculously simple... No.

lines.content: そんなことは幼くともちゃんとわかってた。
lines.translated: Even as kids, we understood that much.

lines.content: ただ、ふたりだけの“約束”ができればそれでよかっただけなのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Maybe we were just happy as long as we could make a "promise" that belonged only to the two of us.

lines.content: あのとき、手を繋いで歩いた“夜”の中。
lines.translated: Back then, walking hand in hand through the "Night."

lines.content: 互いに互いをどういうふうに思っていたのかは、わからないけれど……。
lines.translated: I don't know how we really felt about each other, though...

lines.content: しかし、そんな曖昧すぎる“約束”をしてしまえる程度には、どこか心が浮き足立っていた。
lines.translated: Still, our hearts had been fluttering enough to make such an overly vague "promise."

lines.content: ……俺にしか迷うこの子を見つけられないんだと思うとうれしかった。ヒーローを気取ることに忙しかった、あの頃の俺にしてみれば、余計にだ
lines.translated: "...Thinking that I was the only one who could find this girl when she got lost made me happy. Especially for the me back then, who was so busy playing the hero."

lines.content: 姫織もまた、迷子な自分を探してくれた人は俺がはじめてだと言っていた。……と、思う。
lines.translated: Himeori had also said that I was the first person to ever come looking for her when she was lost. ...At least, I think she did.

lines.content: だから浮き足立っていた。舞い上がっていた。
lines.translated: That was why our hearts were fluttering. We were walking on air.

lines.content: そんなふたりが、繋いだその手を離してしまったのはいつだっただろう。
lines.translated: When was it that the two of us let go of the hands we had been holding?

lines.content: “約束”を遠い過去のものとして――あるいはただの戯れ言を交換し合っただけだとして――当然のように忘れてしまっていたのは、どうしてだろう。
lines.translated: Why had we so naturally forgotten that "promise," treating it as a thing of the distant past--or perhaps just an exchange of childish prattle?

lines.content: ……幼馴染み以上の“関係”には、今まで俺たちはなれなかったし、それ以上になろうなんて考えもしなかったからだ
lines.translated: "...Because until now, we could never become anything more than childhood friends, and we never even thought about becoming anything more."

lines.content: 姫織だってそうだろう。
lines.translated: It must have been the same for Himeori.

lines.content: ……朝が来たら忘れてる。
lines.translated: Forgotten once morning comes.

lines.content: それくらいに軽やかなものであったとしても、互いに残念がるくらいの価値だってないはずだった。
lines.translated: Even if it was something that fleeting, it shouldn't have even been worth feeling regretful over for either of us.

lines.content: だから……
だから、今、ここから見上げた淡い光りのその中に、ふたりの待ち合わせ場所と決めたあの境内に、姫織が俺を待っていてくれる――
lines.translated: So, right now, up there in that faint light I was looking at, on those shrine grounds we had chosen as our meeting place, Himeori was waiting for me--

lines.content: そんな可能性はどれだけあるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Just how likely was that, really?

lines.content: 俺は、手のひらをじっと見つめた。
lines.translated: I stared intently at the palm of my hand.

lines.content: 『また一緒に手を繋いであるけることを目指して、がんばって私も[・|あ][・|そ][・|こ]を探すよ』
lines.translated: "Aiming to hold hands and walk together again, I'll do my best to look for that place, too."

lines.content: その言葉を“希望”にするしかなかった。
lines.translated: I had no choice but to make those words my "hope."

lines.content: 姫織に会えたら、それで“魔法”の“代償”が消えてなくなるわけではない。俺は“夜”の中で迷子のままだ。
lines.translated: Even if I could meet Himeori, it wouldn't mean the "price" of the "magic" would disappear. I would still be lost inside the "Night."

lines.content: それでももう、今の俺が目指せる場所はあそこしかなかった――“夜”の中で迷子、か。
lines.translated: Even so, that was the only place I could aim for right now--lost inside the "Night," huh?

lines.content: なんだか立場がいつもと逆だよね。ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Our roles are kind of reversed from usual, aren't they, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: 苦笑いでそんなことを言い、一段、一段、不必要なくらい慎重に、のぼった。
lines.translated: Murmuring that with a wry smile, I climbed the steps one by one, with an unnecessary amount of caution.
I had noticed the change.

lines.content: 階段を一段のぼっていくその度に、姫織との“約束”だけではない――忘れてしまっていた幼い頃の記憶が一つ、またひとつ蘇ってくるのだ……。
lines.translated: With every single step I took up the stairs, it wasn't just the "promise" with Himeori--memories of my childhood that I had completely forgotten were coming back to me, one after another...

lines.content: 『……大丈夫』
lines.translated: "...It's okay."

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: 『絶対、ぜったい。きみをひとりぼっちには、させないよ』
lines.translated: "Never, ever. I'll never let you be all alone."

lines.content: はら、
lines.translated: Gently,

lines.content: 『……だから、信じて。お願い』
lines.translated: "...So believe me. Please."

lines.content: はらり……。
lines.translated: Gently...

lines.content: 蘇る言葉や“想い”が、“夜”に舞う花びらみたいに[・|散][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|く]――“魔法”だ。
lines.translated: The reviving words and "feelings" were scattering like flower petals dancing in the "Night"--it was "magic."

lines.content: 俺は、“最後の魔法”を使った。
lines.translated: I had used the "last magic."

lines.content: 姫織を見つけ出したいと、願い――クロにその“許可”をもらった。
lines.translated: Wishing to find Himeori--I had received "permission" for it from Kuro.
The "last"...

lines.content: それはつまり、“特別”だった少年時代の終わりを意味している……。
lines.translated: In other words, that meant the end of my "special" boyhood...

lines.content: そのことに、今になってようやく気づいた。
lines.translated: Only now did I finally realize that.

lines.content: 一歩踏み出すその度に、大切だったはずの記憶を思い出し――そして、忘れる。[・|大][・|人][・|に][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|く]。
lines.translated: With every step I took forward, I remembered memories that should have been precious to me--and then forgot them. I was becoming an adult.

lines.content: それは、大切だったものに“さよなら”を告げているようにも、思え……。
lines.translated: It felt almost as if I were saying "goodbye" to the things I held dear...

lines.content: ……う、ううっ
……涙だ。
lines.translated: It's tears.

lines.content: 気づけば頬を幾つもの涙が濡らしていた。
lines.translated: Before I knew it, tears were streaming down my cheeks.

lines.content: 忘れたくないもの。忘れてはいけないもの。
lines.translated: Things I didn't want to forget. Things I must never forget.

lines.content: ……この手を繋いでいてくれたもの。
lines.translated: The things that had held my hand.

lines.content: たくさんの見えない“想い”が遠く、なっていく。
lines.translated: So many unseen "feelings" were growing distant.
Right now, I believe this is the right thing to do--there are people I want to save. There is a "dream" I want to fulfill.

lines.content: だからこそ[・|今]は、これでいいのだ。
lines.translated: That is precisely why, right now, this is fine.

lines.content: ……だけど
lines.translated: "...However."

lines.content: さみしい。
lines.translated: I'm lonely.

lines.content: どこか奥のほうがずきずき痛んだ。
lines.translated: Somewhere deep inside, I felt a throbbing pain.

lines.content: それでも立ち止まってはいけない。
lines.translated: Even so, I must not stop.

lines.content: あと少しだ。
lines.translated: Just a little more.

lines.content: あともう少しのぼれば、境内につく。
lines.translated: If I climb just a little further, I'll reach the shrine grounds.

lines.content: たどり着いたその先に、姫織……君の笑顔があるのだと信じ、そんな未来を“想像”しようとし――……
lines.translated: Believing that Himeori... that your smile is waiting for me at the end of this climb, I tried to "imagine" that future--...

lines.content: ……なんだ。
lines.translated: What is that?

lines.content: 急に身体が重くなったのだ。
lines.translated: Suddenly, my body grew heavy.

lines.content: 呼吸も荒くなり、咽も唇も、異様に乾いた――全身がずきずきと痛みさえした。
lines.translated: My breathing turned ragged, and my throat and lips felt abnormally dry--my entire body was even throbbing with pain.

lines.content: なんだ、これは。
lines.translated: What is this?

lines.content: 階段を上がる度、記憶を“夜”の底に散らせていって――成長だ。俺は心だけでなく、身体そのものも[・|大][・|人][・|に][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|い][・|る]。
lines.translated: Every time I climb a step, my memories scatter to the bottom of the "Night"--it's growth. Not just my mind, but my very body itself is becoming an adult.

lines.content: 実際に老化しているかどうか確かめるすべはない。だけどそんな疲労感が、確かにあった。
lines.translated: I had no way to confirm whether I was actually aging. Yet that sense of fatigue was undeniably there.

lines.content: 階段をひとつあがると、ひとつ身体が歳を取る。その度、全身がずしりと重くなっていく。そんな感覚だ。
lines.translated: Climb one step, and my body ages by one increment. Each time, my whole body grows heavier and heavier. That was what it felt like.

lines.content: なんだよ、これ。こんなのまるで……
lines.translated: "What the hell is this? This is almost like..."

lines.content: まるで、“悪夢”だ。
lines.translated: It's almost like a "nightmare."

lines.content: 心がまだ大人になることを拒否しているようにも思えた――まだだ、まだまだ俺は、特別な“[時間|夜]”の中にいたいのだ。
lines.translated: It felt as though my heart was still refusing to become an adult--not yet, I still wanted to stay inside this special "Night" for much longer.

lines.content: 今までずっと、そばで見守ってくれていたたくさんの“想い”と突然、“さよなら”をして……。
lines.translated: To suddenly say "goodbye" to the many "feelings" that had stayed by my side and watched over me all this time...

lines.content: そんなさみしいままの心では、大人の世界を生きていく自信などない。
lines.translated: With my heart left this lonely, I had no confidence that I could live on in the adult world.

lines.content: これは、そんな俺の“恐怖”が“夜”の中で形となった……、まさに、“悪夢”だ。
lines.translated: This was that "fear" of mine taking shape within the "Night"... Truly, a "nightmare."

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: ため息をつき、空を見上げた。
lines.translated: I let out a sigh and looked up at the sky.

lines.content: ここから今すぐ引き返し、階段を降りれば子ども時代に――“特別”だった少年時代にまた、心も身体も、戻れるだろうか。
lines.translated: If I turned back right now and walked down the stairs, would my mind and body be able to return to childhood--back to that "special" boyhood again?

lines.content: 試しに、一段、二段と引き返してみる。身体は少し、若返った。
lines.translated: As a test, I stepped back down one step, then two. My body rejuvenated slightly.

lines.content: 失ったはずの記憶もまたひとつ、ふたつ、蘇ってきた。
lines.translated: The memories I thought I had lost came back to me as well, one, then two.

lines.content: このまま……
lines.translated: "If I just..."

lines.content: このまま[・|最][・|後][・|ま][・|で][・|降][・|り][・|れ][・|ば]、また、あさひさん、十夜……クロ。彼女たちとの少し不思議な毎日がまた明日も待っている。
lines.translated: If I just go all the way back down like this, then tomorrow, those slightly mysterious everyday days with Asahi-san, Toya... and Kuro will be waiting for me once again.

lines.content: それはまだ、大人にはならないという選択だ。
lines.translated: That was the choice to not become an adult just yet.

lines.content: “魔法”の“代償”は消えずに残っているだろうけど、三人に相談すれば、何か解決案をくれるのではないか。そんな期待があった。
lines.translated: The "price" of the "magic" would likely remain without disappearing, but I held onto the hope that if I consulted the three of them, they might give me some kind of solution.

lines.content: だけどそれでは、姫織を“夜”の中に置いてきたままとなる――それでいいのか。
lines.translated: However, doing that would mean leaving Himeori behind in the "Night"--was I really okay with that?

lines.content: いいはずがない。
lines.translated: There was no way that was okay.

lines.content: だから、進まなきゃ。
lines.translated: So, I have to keep going.

lines.content: しかし、この階段をあがりきるまで俺の身体が[・|ち][・|ゃ][・|ん][・|と][・|も][・|つ]のかどうか……。
lines.translated: Even so, would my body actually hold out until I finished climbing these stairs...?

lines.content: 一段あがれば少年時代の記憶をひとつ忘れる。肉体がひとつ歳を取り、衰える。
lines.translated: Climb one step, and I forget one memory of my boyhood. My physical body ages by one step and weakens.

lines.content: 階段は……
lines.translated: "The stairs..."

lines.content: あと数十段もあるように、見える。
lines.translated: It looked like there were still dozens of steps left to go.

lines.content: そこまで俺の寿命は持つのかだろうか。
lines.translated: Would my lifespan even last that far?

lines.content: 階段をのぼりきれたからと言って……
lines.translated: "Even if I manage to climb all the way up these stairs..."
There is no guarantee whatsoever.

lines.content: この歩みが報われるのだという保証は、何も、何ひとつ、ないのだ。
lines.translated: There is no guarantee--none at all--that these steps I take will be rewarded.

lines.content: 姫織……。
lines.translated: Himeori...

lines.content: 君が、俺のことを待っていてくれるとは限らない。
lines.translated: There is no telling if you're actually waiting for me.

lines.content: 姫織から“助けて”と願われたわけでは、ない。
lines.translated: It's not as if Himeori wished for me to "save" her.

lines.content: ならばどうする。
lines.translated: Then what should I do?

lines.content: 進むのか。引き返すのか。
lines.translated: Do I press on? Or do I turn back?

lines.content: 迷う。
lines.translated: I hesitate.

lines.content: 迷ってしまう。
lines.translated: I can't help but hesitate.

lines.content: 大人になるのか。まだまだ少年でいたいのか。
lines.translated: Do I become an adult, or do I want to remain a boy for much longer?

lines.content: どちらの“さよなら”を、取るべきなのか……。
lines.translated: Which "goodbye" should I choose...?

lines.content: ああ。
lines.translated: Ah.

lines.content: 人生に、迷子だ……
lines.translated: "I'm lost in life..."

lines.content: 頭を抱えたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to clutch my head in my hands.

lines.content: 立ち止まり、いつまでもここで悩み続けていたかった。
lines.translated: I wanted to stop right here and keep agonizing over it forever.

lines.content: それでも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori.

lines.content: ここで引き返してしまったら、残りの人生、“後悔”ばかりして終わりそうだ――
lines.translated: If I turn back here, I feel like I'll spend the rest of my life doing nothing but "regretting" it until the very end--

lines.content: やがて迎える最期のときにも、ここで引き返してしまった自分のことを、心から落胆してしまっていることだろう。
lines.translated: Even when my final moments eventually arrive, I would surely be deeply disappointed in myself for having turned back here.

lines.content: だから進もう。
lines.translated: So let's keep moving forward.

lines.content: 姫織。また、君と笑って色々なことを話したいんだ――こんな“さよなら”、俺は、嫌だよ
lines.translated: "Himeori. I want to laugh and talk about all sorts of things with you again--I don't want a 'goodbye' like this."

lines.content: 誰にともなくただつぶやいた。
lines.translated: I simply muttered that to no one in particular.

lines.content: そうすることで、一段、一段、のぼる度、身体が重くなっていくことを誤魔化した。
lines.translated: By doing so, I tried to distract myself from how my body grew heavier with each and every step I climbed.

lines.content: あと、数段で境内にたどり着く……。
lines.translated: Just a few more steps until I reach the shrine grounds...

lines.content: そこまでのぼったときにはもう、震える両足でなんとか立っていることがやっとだった。
lines.translated: By the time I had climbed that far, it was all I could do just to stay standing on my trembling legs.

lines.content: 姫織……
lines.translated: "Himeori..."

lines.content: 名前を呼んだ。
lines.translated: I called his name.

lines.content: 見上げた境内に向け、できる限り、大きく叫んだ――つもりだった。
lines.translated: Looking up toward the shrine grounds, I shouted as loudly as I possibly could--or at least, I meant to.

lines.content: だけど、ひゅうひゅうと、喉の奥から空気がもれるような音でしかそれはなかった。
lines.translated: However, it came out as nothing more than the wheezing sound of air leaking from the back of my throat.

lines.content: そんな声に応えてくれるものはいない。
lines.translated: There was no one to answer a voice like that.

lines.content: 歯を食いしばり、また一段、あがった。
lines.translated: Clenching my teeth, I climbed one more step.

lines.content: 更に身体は重くなる。
lines.translated: My body grew heavier still.

lines.content: あと、何段だ……
lines.translated: "How many steps... are left..."

lines.content: 殆ど失いかけている視力で見上げた――あと、五段もない。そのはずだ。ぼやけているがそう見える。
lines.translated: I looked up with my nearly failing eyesight--not even five steps left. It had to be. Everything was blurry, but that's how it looked.

lines.content: もう少し……
lines.translated: "Just a little more..."

lines.content: つぶやいて、ふらりとする。
lines.translated: I muttered, swaying unsteadily.

lines.content: 不可解な眠気に襲われはじめていた。
lines.translated: An inexplicable drowsiness was beginning to wash over me.

lines.content: まるで、身体の大切な機能がひとつずつ停止し、眠りにつこうとしているような……。
lines.translated: It felt as though my body's vital functions were shutting down one by one, preparing to fall into slumber...

lines.content: このまま[まぶた|瞼]を閉じれば、終わりだ。すべて終わり。
lines.translated: If I close my eyelids like this, it's over. Everything will be over.

lines.content: 衰えきった身体が再び目覚めることはないだろう。
lines.translated: My completely withered body would likely never wake again.

lines.content: 階段に倒れ込む。
lines.translated: I collapsed onto the stairs.

lines.content: ……這ってでも進んだ。
lines.translated: Even if I had to crawl, I moved forward.

lines.content: 残り三段、二段、一段……。
lines.translated: Three steps left, two, one...
Gasping for breath, I climbed--and climbed... and climbed all the way to the top.

lines.content: っ
這い上がった“夜”の境内。
lines.translated: The shrine grounds of the "Night," where I had crawled my way up.

lines.content: そこには……。
lines.translated: And there...

lines.content: ああ……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そうだよな。
lines.translated: Figures.

lines.content: わかってた。
lines.translated: He knew.

lines.content: そこにはやっぱり、誰もいなかった。
lines.translated: Just as I thought, no one was there.

lines.content: 俺はまた、迷った挙げ句の選択に、失敗してしまったのだ。
lines.translated: After all that hesitation, I had failed in my choice once again.

lines.content: それはつまり、俺は俺の“夢”を叶えることができないということで……。
lines.translated: Which meant that I wouldn't be able to fulfill my "dream"...

lines.content: もう……立ち上がれない。
lines.translated: I can't... stand up anymore.

lines.content: どころか、声を発することも、呼吸を続けることさえも難しかった。
lines.translated: Let alone stand, it was hard to even utter a sound, or to keep breathing.

lines.content: ――太陽が目覚めるまでに走り出さないと……、大雅が、危ない
lines.translated: "--If we don't start running before the sun wakes up... Taiga will be in danger."

lines.content: ナナちゃんのその言葉に、私はハッとさせられる。
lines.translated: Nana-chan's words made me gasp in realization.

lines.content: 自分でも驚くくらいの早さで、ナナちゃんに振り向いた。
lines.translated: I spun around to face Nana-chan with a speed that surprised even me.

lines.content: 大雅が……？　危ないって、どういうこと？
lines.translated: "Taiga is...? What do you mean, in danger?"

lines.content: それは……
lines.translated: "Well, that's..."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが教えてくれる――今、大雅がどういうことになってしまっているのか。
lines.translated: Nana-chan told me--about what was happening to Taiga right now.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: どうして。
lines.translated: Why?

lines.content: ……私のことなんて構わなければ、いいのに。
lines.translated: I wish he had just left me alone.

lines.content: 大雅は今、“迷子”になってしまっているのだという。
lines.translated: She said that right now, Taiga had become a "lost child."

lines.content: 姿を消した私のことを探して、“魔法”さえ使い……。
lines.translated: Searching for me after I vanished, even using "magic"...

lines.content: その“魔法”の“代償”を支払い、“夜”の中に迷い込み、外へ出ることが叶わなくなってしまっている。
lines.translated: Having paid the "price" of that "magic," he had wandered deep into the "Night," unable to make it back outside.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは、大雅と一緒にいた十夜に聞いたのだという――大雅は私を探しに“遊園地”へ向かった。
lines.translated: Nana-chan said she heard it from Toya, who had been with him--that Taiga had headed to the "amusement park" to look for me.

lines.content: だけど私は[・|そ][・|こ]にはいない。[・|こ][・|こ]にいる。
lines.translated: But I am not there. I am here.

lines.content: だからそこで“魔法”を使っても、あとに残るのはその“代償”だけで……。
lines.translated: So even if he used "magic" there, all that would remain afterward was its "price"...

lines.content: 朝が来れば、どうなるの……？
lines.translated: "What will happen when morning comes...?"

lines.content: “夜”に迷い込んだままの大雅は、どうなってしまうんだろう――危ないとは、いったい。
lines.translated: What would become of Taiga if he remained lost in the "Night"--what on earth did she mean by "in danger"?

lines.content: 大雅はあなたの代わりに“影”となる。そして、“夜”の中を永遠に彷徨い続ける。いつか幸せだった時間ばかりを追い求めて――それが、あの子の“想像”してしまった“代償”だよ
lines.translated: "Taiga will become a 'shadow' in your place. And he will wander through the 'Night' for all eternity, forever chasing after the times when he was once happy--that is the 'price' he ended up 'imagining.'"

lines.content: 姫織の代わりに“夜”の中で“迷子”になるとはそういうことだ。ナナちゃんは言う。
lines.translated: That was what it meant for him to become a "lost child" in the "Night" in my place, Nana-chan said.

lines.content: ……私の代わり
lines.translated: "...In my place."

lines.content: ふと、自分の身体を見た。
lines.translated: Suddenly, I looked down at my own body.

lines.content: 朝が近づいてくるにつれ、“影”に堕としたはずの身体が少しずつ、色づきはじめていた。[・|大][・|雅][・|が]“[・|魔][・|法]”[・|で]、[・|私][・|の][・|代][・|わ][・|り][・|に][・|な][・|っ][・|た][・|か][・|ら]。
lines.translated: As morning drew closer, my body, which should have fallen into a "shadow," was gradually beginning to regain its color. Because Taiga had used "magic" to take my place.

lines.content: ……私は“[命|心臓]”を本来ある場所に返した。
lines.translated: I had returned my "heart"--my life--to where it originally belonged.

lines.content: しかしその“[命|心臓]”が私の中に戻って来つつある。
lines.translated: Yet that "heart" was slowly coming back into me.

lines.content: このまま朝がくれば、[依り代|人形]が“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”に新しい命となり、[・|ま][・|た][・|一][・|か][・|ら][・|産][・|ま][・|れ][・|直][・|す][・|だ][・|ろ][・|う]はずだった。
lines.translated: If morning had come as things were, the doll--the vessel--would have become a new life in the "time of the sun," the real world, and was supposed to be reborn again from the very beginning.

lines.content: 赤ん坊からのスタートだ。
lines.translated: A fresh start as a baby.

lines.content: 押し入れの中にあった日記帳にはそうなるのだと書かれてた。
lines.translated: The diary inside the closet had written that this was what would happen.

lines.content: それはもう、私のお母さんとは呼べない新しい“誰か”だけれど……。
lines.translated: That person would be a new "someone" whom I could no longer call my mother, though...

lines.content: それでもよかった。
lines.translated: Even so, I was fine with that.

lines.content: きっと私なんかより命を立派に使ってくれる――“夢”とか“希望”とか。そういうものを自由に思い描いて生きていってくれるはず。
lines.translated: She would surely make much better use of that life than someone like me ever could--"dreams" and "hopes." She would surely live on, freely envisioning things like that.

lines.content: そういう思いを建前として、日々この胸に育つ“罪悪感”をぬぐい去ろうと私はしたのだ。
lines.translated: Using those thoughts as a pretext, I had tried to wipe away the "guilt" that grew in my chest with each passing day.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: 大雅……。どうして。
lines.translated: Taiga... Why?

lines.content: ――姫織。今度はあなたの“夢”を叶える番だよ
lines.translated: "--Himeori. This time, it's your turn to make your 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ナナちゃんが繰り返し、私にそう言った。
lines.translated: Nana-chan repeated those words to me.

lines.content: 十年前のあの“夜”から、ずっと……その胸に秘めたままの“魔法”を使って
lines.translated: "Using the 'magic' you've kept hidden in your heart ever since that 'Night' ten years ago..."

lines.content: 私のことをじっと見つめ、小首をかしげるような仕草を見せていた。
lines.translated: She gazed steadily at me, tilting her head slightly.
