lines.content: あなたは、自分には“夢”も“希望”もなにもないって言っていたけれど……
lines.translated: "You said that you don't have any 'dreams' or 'hopes' or anything at all, but..."

lines.content: それらは今、あなたの中で迷子になってしまってるだけだ。良く思い出してみて。良くよく、思い描いてみて。きっと、あなたの心に[・|そ][・|れ]はあるはずだよ
lines.translated: "Right now, they've simply gotten lost inside you. Try hard to remember. Envision it as clearly as you can. It is surely there inside your heart."

lines.content: ねえ、姫織。“夜”の世界に生まれ直す――そういう“次”を選びたいと、あなたは言っていたけれど
lines.translated: "Hey, Himeori. To be reborn into the world of the 'Night'--you said you wanted to choose a 'next time' like that, didn't you?"

lines.content: “夜”の中でまったく別の“イキモノ”となれたなら……。
lines.translated: If I could become a completely different "creature" within the "Night"...

lines.content: 大切に思いたい誰かのそばに、いつも寄り添う。その人が何か困難に立ち止まるなら、いつでもそばで力を貸したい――そういうふうに“夜”を生きる
lines.translated: "To always stay close beside someone you want to cherish. If that person ever stops in the face of hardship, you want to always be there to lend them your strength--to live through the 'Night' like that."

lines.content: ……“夢”も“希望”もなにもない自分だから、大切な人の“夢”や“希望”を応援していく生き方も、きっといい。姫織。あなたはそう言っていたけれど
lines.translated: "...Because you have no 'dreams' or 'hopes' of your own, a way of life where you support the 'dreams' and 'hopes' of someone precious to you would surely be nice. Himeori, that's what you said, wasn't it?"

lines.content: でもね姫織。そうすることは、いつでもできるよ。“外”の世界で精一杯、生き抜いた後でも、そうするには充分に間に合うんだよ
lines.translated: "But you know, Himeori, you can do that anytime. Even after living your absolute fullest in the 'outside' world, there will still be plenty of time to do that."

lines.content: 十夜のお友だちは与えられた“命の時間”を、“外”の世界で精一杯、もやした。
lines.translated: Toya's friend had burned through the "time of life" she was given to the absolute fullest in the "outside" world.

lines.content: だから“夜”に産まれ直すという選択に、躊躇いはなかったのだろう。
lines.translated: That was probably why she had no hesitation in choosing to be reborn into the "Night."

lines.content: あなたはまだ与えられた“命”を全部、使い切ってない。だから今は、誰かのためじゃなく、自分のためにまずは生きてほしいから……
lines.translated: "You still haven't used up all the 'life' you were given. So right now, I want you to live for yourself first, rather than for someone else..."

lines.content: だからどうか、もう少しだけ“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”で生きることを諦めないでほしい。
lines.translated: So please, just for a little longer, don't give up on living in the "time of the sun"--the real world.

lines.content: ナナちゃんは小さな声でそうつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: Nana-chan murmured that in a quiet voice.
A "dream"...

lines.content: 私の“夢”を叶えるための“最後の魔法”
lines.translated: The "final magic" to make my "dream" come true.

lines.content: ……いらない
lines.translated: "...I don't need it."

lines.content: 私は、ふるふると首を振った。
lines.translated: I slowly shook my head.

lines.content: ……私に“魔法”はいらないよ
lines.translated: "...I don't need 'magic.'"

lines.content: そんな私の言葉を前に、ナナちゃんはさみしそうに目を伏せる。
lines.translated: At my words, Nana-chan lowered her eyes, looking lonely.

lines.content: そしてもう何も言えないからと、私の手を握ってくれた。
lines.translated: And as if she had nothing left to say, she took my hand and held it tight.

lines.content: ……ううん
私は首を振る。違うよナナちゃん、お願い。そんなさみしそうな顔、しないでよ。
lines.translated: I shook my head. No, Nana-chan, please. Don't make such a lonely face.

lines.content: [・|今][・|は][・|ま][・|だ]、必要ない。そう言いたかったの
lines.translated: "I don't need it just yet. That's what I meant to say."

lines.content: ……今は？
lines.translated: "...Just yet?"

lines.content: そう。今は、まだ“魔法”に頼るようなときじゃない――それにね、ナナちゃん。私は大雅と一緒じゃないと“魔法”になれない。そうだよね？
lines.translated: "Yes. Now isn't the time to rely on 'magic' yet--besides, Nana-chan, I can't become 'magic' unless I'm with Taiga. Isn't that right?"

lines.content: “魔法”がなくても、きっとたどり着けるはずだから。私はつぶやき、真っ暗な車窓の外をじっつ見た。
lines.translated: Even without "magic," I should surely be able to reach him. Murmuring that, I stared intently out the pitch-black train window.

lines.content: ……ねえ、ナナちゃん。ひとつだけ教えてほしいことが、あるの
lines.translated: "...Hey, Nana-chan. There's just one thing I want you to tell me."

lines.content: うん。なに……？
lines.translated: "Okay. What is it...?"

lines.content: あのね。“夢”は、変わってしまってもいいと思う？
lines.translated: "Well... Do you think it's okay for a 'dream' to change?"

lines.content: 隣に座り、私の手をそっと握ってくれているナナちゃんに――私の小さな“夜の神さま”に、私は問いかける。
lines.translated: I asked Nana-chan, who was sitting next to me and gently holding my hand--my little "God of the Night."

lines.content: ずっと思い描いていた“夢”があったとして……。子どもの頃から[・|こ][・|う][・|な][・|り][・|た][・|い]と思ってた未来があったとして
lines.translated: "Suppose there was a 'dream' you had always envisioned... A future you had wanted for yourself ever since you were a child."

lines.content: ……でも、それはいつしか、大人になっていく中で、どうしても叶えられないものだと知ってしまって
lines.translated: "...But before you knew it, as you grew into an adult, you came to realize that it was something that could never come true no matter what."

lines.content: きっと[・|自][・|分][・|に]“絶望”することだろう。
lines.translated: You would surely fall into "despair" with yourself.

lines.content: 小さな頃の自分が思い描き、憧れた未来の自分になれないとわかると、そんな自分を憎みさえするはずだ――
lines.translated: Realizing you could never become the future self your younger self had envisioned and longed to be, you would surely even come to hate yourself--

lines.content: こんな自分は無価値だと、泣いて、泣いて、自分にため息をついて、命そのものを見捨ててしまいたいとさえ、願うこともあるかもしれない
lines.translated: "Thinking that someone like you is worthless, crying and crying, sighing at yourself... You might even wish to abandon life itself."

lines.content: するとナナちゃんは、唇を噛む――
lines.translated: At that, Nana-chan bit her lip--

lines.content: あなたみたいに、そうやって誰かのために、そばで苦しんでくれる。
lines.translated: Just like you, suffering right beside someone for their sake.

lines.content: そういうやさしい“イキモノ”に私はなりたいと祈ってた。
lines.translated: I had prayed to become that kind of gentle "creature."

lines.content: それもまた“夢”だ。まるで夢見るような生き方だ……。
lines.translated: That, too, was a "dream." A way of life that was almost like dreaming...

lines.content: ねえ、ナナちゃん。教えてよ。……“夢”は、変わってしまってもいいと思う？　それってさ。小さな頃の自分を裏切ることには、ならないかな……
lines.translated: "Hey, Nana-chan. Tell me... Do you think it's okay for a 'dream' to change? Wouldn't that... be betraying the person I was when I was little...?"

lines.content: 首をかしげるナナちゃんに、私は答える。
lines.translated: As Nana-chan tilted her head, I answered my own question.

lines.content: ずっとずっと、[・|こ][・|う][・|な][・|り][・|た][・|い]って思ってた――でも、自分にはそうできない。そのための能力がない……才能が、ない。そう気づいてしまったから、また別の“夢”を見る
lines.translated: "For so, so long, I thought 'this is who I want to become'--but I can't do it. I don't have the ability for it... I don't have the talent. Because I realized that, I started having a different 'dream' instead."

lines.content: ナナちゃん。そういうのって許してもらえるのかな……。
lines.translated: Nana-chan... Do you think something like that can be forgiven...?

lines.content: 許してもらえる……。いったい、誰に？
lines.translated: "Forgiven... By whom on earth?"

lines.content: たとえばね、この世界に“神さま”みたいな“誰か”がいるとして……
lines.translated: "For example, suppose there's 'someone' like a 'God' in this world..."

lines.content: 私たちが“夢”を叶えようと色々、その人なりにがんばってみたりする。そういうのを見ている“誰か”がいるとしてね
lines.translated: "And suppose that 'someone' is watching us as we try our best in all sorts of ways, each in our own way, to make our 'dreams' come true."

lines.content: その“誰か”に好かれた人だけが、“夢”を叶えていいよって言ってもらえるのだとしたら。
lines.translated: What if only the people liked by that "someone" are told that it's okay for their "dreams" to come true?

lines.content: 最初に抱いた“夢”を無理だって決めて、諦めてしまって、またすぐ次の“夢”……
lines.translated: "Deciding that the first 'dream' I held was impossible, giving up on it, and immediately moving on to the next 'dream'..."

lines.content: そんなことをして“誰か”に怒られたりしないかな。なんでもっと“夢”を叶えるために努力ができないんだって
lines.translated: "Wouldn't that 'someone' get angry at me for doing something like that? Asking why I couldn't work harder to make my 'dream' come true."

lines.content: ……そんな怠け者には新しい“夢”なんて叶えられるはずがないし、叶えてなんてあげないよって、そういうふうに言われちゃったりしないかな……
lines.translated: "...Wouldn't they say something like, 'There's no way a lazy person like you could ever make a new "dream" come true, and I won't grant it for you anyway'...?"

lines.content: “夢”が変わってしまっても、“[魔法|希望]”は変わらず、私の“夢”を叶えてくれるかな。
lines.translated: Even if my "dream" has changed, will "magic"--"hope"--remain unchanged and still grant my "dream" for me?

lines.content: そんな怖さみたいなものが、あったけど……。
lines.translated: I had a fear like that inside me, and yet...

lines.content: ナナちゃん。私、新しい“夢”を見つけたよ
lines.translated: "Nana-chan. I found a new 'dream.'"

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を閉じれば大雅と一緒に歩く自分の姿があった。
lines.translated: When I closed my eyelids, I could see myself walking alongside Taiga.

lines.content: 自分でも驚くほど楽しそうに笑ってる。そんな未来を叶えたい。
lines.translated: Laughing so happily that it surprised even me. That is the future I want to make come true.

lines.content: だからお願い……
lines.translated: "So please..."

lines.content: と私は、私の隣にいてくれる小さな“神さま”に祈るのだ。
lines.translated: I prayed to the little "God" beside me.

lines.content: ……お願い。ナナちゃん。どうか私を大雅のところへ、連れて行って。もしもあなたが許してくれるなら……新しい私の“夢”を、叶えさせてください
lines.translated: "...Please, Nana-chan. Please take me to where Taiga is. If you can forgive me... please let me make my new 'dream' come true."

lines.content: 朝が来る前に大雅を見つけられれば何とか間に合う
lines.translated: "If you can find Taiga before morning comes, you'll make it in time somehow."
Nana-chan sent the train running in the direction I had wished for.

lines.content: 大雅が、“魔法”の“代償”で、姫織の中に“[命|心臓]”を戻してくれた――だから、姫織。命あるあなたのその手で、大雅のことをつなぎ止めるんだ
lines.translated: "As the 'price' of his 'magic,' Taiga returned your 'heart'--your 'life'--back inside you, Himeori. So, Himeori, with those living hands of yours, hold tightly onto Taiga."

lines.content: そうすることで大雅を“夜”の底から救い上げられる。
lines.translated: By doing so, I could rescue Taiga from the depths of the "Night."

lines.content: だけどそれが叶うのも今夜限りだ。朝が来れば大雅は“夜”の中に“影”として属してしまう。
lines.translated: However, tonight was the only chance to make that happen. Once morning came, Taiga would belong to the "Night" as a "shadow."

lines.content: “魔法”が成功しても失敗しても、姫織の中に“[命|心臓]”が帰っていくようにと、大雅は“夜”に願ったみたいだけれど……
lines.translated: "It seems Taiga wished upon the 'Night' that whether the 'magic' succeeded or failed, your 'heart'--your 'life'--would return to you, Himeori, though..."

lines.content: いいや……。
lines.translated: No...

lines.content: 違う。
lines.translated: No.

lines.content: 違うよね。きっと。
lines.translated: That's not quite right. Surely not.

lines.content: 意図的に、大雅は[・|そ][・|う][・|い][・|う][・|ふ][・|う][・|に]“魔法”を“想像”したんじゃないだろうか。
lines.translated: Didn't Taiga intentionally "envision" the "magic" that way?

lines.content: それとも無意識に、そういうふうに願ってしまったのか――まるで自分自身を罰するように。
lines.translated: Or did he unconsciously wish for it that way--as if to punish himself?
As if he were trying to let go of his own life.

lines.content: （……大雅にも何か、自分を許せないような思いがあるのかも）
lines.translated: (...Maybe Taiga also has some kind of feeling inside him that makes him unable to forgive himself.)

lines.content: いつも自分の命の価値を探してきた私だ。
lines.translated: I had always been searching for the worth of my own life.

lines.content: だから、なんとなく……。
lines.translated: That was why, somehow...

lines.content: あなたにもあるのかもしれないさみしい“想い”を想像してしまう。
lines.translated: I ended up imagining the lonely "feelings" that might be inside you, too.

lines.content: 大雅……。
lines.translated: Taiga...

lines.content: （逢いたいよ、大雅）
lines.translated: (I want to see you, Taiga.)

lines.content: あなたの想いを私にも話して聞かせてほしい。
lines.translated: I want you to tell me about your feelings and let me hear them, too.

lines.content: 重くて苦しい想いは、ふたりで分け合えば、きっと……なんとか背負って歩いて行けるくらいにはなるずだから。
lines.translated: Because if the two of us share those heavy, painful feelings, they will surely... become light enough for us to somehow carry on our backs and keep walking.

lines.content: 朝はもうすぐそこだよ……だから、姫織。間違いないんだね。本当に[・|そ][・|こ]で、いいんだね
lines.translated: "Morning is almost here... So, Himeori. You're sure about this, right? It's really okay for it to be there, right?"

lines.content: そこに大雅はちゃんといるんだねと、繰り返しナナちゃんは私に念を押すようにして言い――私は、うなずく。間違いない。絶対。
lines.translated: Nana-chan repeated that to make sure, asking if Taiga would really be there--and I nodded. There was no mistake. Definitely.

lines.content: ……大雅はあそこに必ず、いてくれる
lines.translated: "...Taiga will definitely be waiting for me there."

lines.content: 車窓を流れる“夜”の風景。
lines.translated: The scenery of the "Night" flowed past the train window.

lines.content: その先を、私は見つめる――“約束”
lines.translated: I gazed out at what lay beyond it--a "promise."

lines.content: “約束”だよね、大雅。覚えてるよ……私。あなたとした“約束”を、ちゃんと今でも、覚えているから
lines.translated: "It's a 'promise,' right, Taiga? I remember... I still properly remember the 'promise' I made with you, even now."

lines.content: だからお願い。あなたも私とのあの“約束”を覚えていてほしい。忘れてたりしないでほしい。
lines.translated: So please. I want you to remember that "promise" you made with me, too. Please don't forget it.

lines.content: ナナちゃんに送ってもらった先は、夜月神社の境内だ。
lines.translated: The place Nana-chan took me to was the grounds of Yotsuki Shrine.

lines.content: ここが大雅と私の待ち合わせ場所。
lines.translated: This was Taiga's and my meeting place.

lines.content: 列車からは私ひとり飛び降り、辺りを見回す……。
lines.translated: I jumped off the train all by myself and looked around...

lines.content: 真っ暗だ。
lines.translated: It's pitch black.

lines.content: 誰もいない。
lines.translated: No one is there.

lines.content: 人影さえも、見当たらない。
lines.translated: There wasn't even a single soul in sight.

lines.content: ……大雅
lines.translated: "...Taiga."

lines.content: 小さく、そっと、名前を呼んでみた――……返事はない。
lines.translated: Softly, quietly, I tried calling his name--...There was no answer.

lines.content: やっぱりここには、私以外に誰もいないようだった。今は、まだ。
lines.translated: Just as I thought, there seemed to be no one here besides me. Not yet, at least.

lines.content: 大丈夫。きっとここだ。
lines.translated: It's okay. This is surely the place.

lines.content: ……あなたはここに、来てくれる。
lines.translated: You will come here for me.

lines.content: ……だって、“約束”したんだもん
lines.translated: "...Because we made a 'promise.'"

lines.content: そうだよ。
lines.translated: That's right.

lines.content: 大雅も絶対に、ここを目指してくれるはず。
lines.translated: Taiga will definitely head for this place, too.

lines.content: その確信はある。
lines.translated: I had that conviction.

lines.content: 大雅は私との“約束”を思い出してくれている。
lines.translated: Taiga remembers his "promise" with me.

lines.content: そう信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe that.

lines.content: 信じてるけど……。
lines.translated: I believe that, and yet...

lines.content: 迷子……
lines.translated: "A lost child..."

lines.content: 大雅は今、迷子になってる。私の代わりに。
lines.translated: Right now, Taiga is a lost child. In my place.

lines.content: そんな状態で、ちゃんとここにたどり着けるだろうか。
lines.translated: In a state like that, will he really be able to find his way here?

lines.content: それに大雅は、朝までに私と会えないといけないって、知ってるのかな……
lines.translated: "Besides, does Taiga even know that we have to meet before morning comes...?"

lines.content: そうでなければ永遠に“迷子”のままだ。
lines.translated: Otherwise, he will remain a "lost child" forever.

lines.content: それをちゃんと理解できる状況にあるのだろうか。
lines.translated: Is he even in a situation where he can properly understand that?

lines.content: ……不安だ。
lines.translated: I'm anxious.

lines.content: 今すぐ私が、今度は私が、あなたのことを迎えに行きたい。
lines.translated: Right this second, I want to go and meet you--this time, I want to be the one to come for you.

lines.content: だけど大雅は“夜”を彷徨う“影”となっている。
lines.translated: However, Taiga has become a "shadow" wandering through the "Night."

lines.content: そんな大雅の前を、通り過ぎたとしても……、
lines.translated: Even if I were to walk right past Taiga while he's like that...

lines.content: ……ごめん、大雅。そんなあなたのことに、私……ちゃんと気づけるか、怖いよ
lines.translated: "...I'm sorry, Taiga. I'm scared... of whether I'd even be able to notice you like that."

lines.content: ここでじっとして待っているしかない。
lines.translated: All I can do is stay still and wait right here.

lines.content: むやみに探しに出て、すれ違いにでもなってしまったら。
lines.translated: What if I went out looking for him blindly, and we ended up passing right by each other?

lines.content: ――ゾッとする。
lines.translated: --The thought sent a chill down my spine.

lines.content: そのすれ違いは永遠に続くことになるのだ。私たちは、もう、どうしたって出会えることはない――
lines.translated: Passing each other by like that would last for eternity. No matter what we did, we would never be able to meet again--

lines.content: そのとき、何か……声を聞いた気がした。
lines.translated: Just then, I felt as though I heard... a voice.

lines.content: 誰かに呼ばれた気がしたのだ。
lines.translated: I felt as though someone had called out to me.

lines.content: 振り返る。
lines.translated: I turned around.

lines.content: でも、やっぱりそこには誰もいなくて――ただ、夜より暗い“夜”の闇が、あるだけで。
lines.translated: But when I looked, there was still no one there--only the darkness of the "Night," darker than night itself.

lines.content: 境内に続く石段と、その向こうに広がる“夜”の町……。
lines.translated: The stone steps leading up to the shrine grounds, and the town of the "Night" spreading out beyond them...

lines.content: そのきらめきが、目覚めはじめた朝の静けさに沈み込もうとしている。
lines.translated: Its glittering lights were about to sink into the quiet of the awakening morning.

lines.content: あるのはただ、それだけだ。
lines.translated: That was all there was.

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: もう一度、名前を呼んでみた。
lines.translated: Once again, I tried calling his name.

lines.content: 微かな風が通り抜ける。ざわざわとさくらの枝が揺れていた。
lines.translated: A faint breeze blew past. The cherry blossom branches rustled and swayed.

lines.content: そんな囁き声みたいな微かな音を、都合良く“今、何より聞きたい声”と聞き間違えただけだろうか。
lines.translated: Had I simply mistaken a faint sound like a whisper for "the voice I wanted to hear more than anything right now" out of wishful thinking?

lines.content: 違う……
唇を噛み、首を振る。
lines.translated: Biting my lip, I shook my head.

lines.content: 確かに聞いたよ。私は聞いた。
lines.translated: I definitely heard it. I heard it.

lines.content: あなたが私を呼ぶ声を聞いたんだ――
lines.translated: I heard your voice calling out to me--

lines.content: 大雅っ
lines.translated: "Taiga!"

lines.content: 叫んだ。
lines.translated: A cry rang out.

lines.content: ……どこ！
lines.translated: "...Where are you?!"

lines.content: 力一杯、呼びかけた。
lines.translated: I called out with all my might.

lines.content: どこにいるの……大雅！
lines.translated: "Where are you... Taiga?!"

lines.content: 返事は、ない。
lines.translated: There was no answer.

lines.content: 私は暗闇に手を伸ばし、何度も叫んだ。
lines.translated: I reached my hand out into the darkness and shouted over and over again.

lines.content: 十年前の“夜”の中――暗い場所に迷い込んだ私を見つけて、そしてあなたはこの手を繋いで歩いてくれた。
lines.translated: In the "Night" ten years ago--you found me when I had wandered into that dark place, and you took this hand and walked with me.

lines.content: もしも……、と私は思うのだ。
lines.translated: What if... I thought to myself.

lines.content: もしも大雅がこの場所で、あのときの私みたいに真っ暗な闇の中、うずくまっているのだとしたら。
lines.translated: What if Taiga is crouching in the pitch-black darkness right here, just like I was back then?

lines.content: 暗い“夜”に同化みたいにしてしゃがみ込んでいて――ただ、私が、私たちが、互いの姿を見ることができていないだけだったら……。
lines.translated: What if he's huddled down, blending into the dark "Night"--and I'm, we're, simply unable to see each other...?

lines.content: ……見つけなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to find him."

lines.content: 手のひらをぎゅっと、握りしめた。
lines.translated: I clenched my hand tightly into a fist.

lines.content: ……私があなたを、見つけなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to find you."

lines.content: そうだ。あなたが私を呼んでいるんだ。
lines.translated: That's right. You're calling out to me.

lines.content: 伸ばした手を彷徨わせ、探した。この手があなたに触れればいい。
lines.translated: I reached my hand out, sweeping it through the air as I searched. If only this hand could touch you.

lines.content: そうすれば、私たちはまた会えると……信じてる。
lines.translated: If it does, I believe... that we'll be able to meet again.

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: ……だめ
伸ばしたこの手が触れるものはない。何もない。
lines.translated: My outstretched hand touched nothing. Nothing at all.

lines.content: 朝が来る。
lines.translated: Morning comes.

lines.content: ……だめよ。お願い
lines.translated: "...No. Please."

lines.content: “夜”のきらめきもざわめきも、少しずつ、深い沈黙の底に沈みはじめ――
lines.translated: Little by little, both the glittering lights and the rustling of the "Night" began to sink into the depths of a profound silence--

lines.content: ……もう少しだけ、待ってよ……お願い、だから……っ
lines.translated: "...Just wait a little longer... Please, I'm begging you...!"

lines.content: 涙がにじんだ。
lines.translated: Tears welled up in my eyes.

lines.content: それでも“夜”は何も答えてくれない――時間はいつだって、私たちを待っていてはくれない。
lines.translated: Even so, the "Night" gave no answer--time never waits for us.

lines.content: ……朝だ。
lines.translated: It's morning.

lines.content: “[現実世界|太陽の時間]”に朝が来た。
lines.translated: Morning arrived in the "real world"--the time of the sun.

lines.content: もう、だめ……？
lines.translated: "Is it... too late...?"

lines.content: 時間切れ……？
lines.translated: Are we out of time...?

lines.content: 見上げた空につぶやいた。
lines.translated: I muttered at the sky above.

lines.content: 町の暗闇はすべて、朝の光りに照らされ消えて……。
lines.translated: All the darkness in the town was illuminated by the morning light and vanished...

lines.content: あなたの“[心|影]”も、消えていく……？
lines.translated: Will your "shadow"--your heart--vanish too...?

lines.content: ……う、うう
lines.translated: "...Ugh, mmgh."

lines.content: 私も……。
lines.translated: Then I'll...

lines.content: 私もここで、呼吸を止めよう――私、気づいてしまったの。
lines.translated: I'll stop breathing right here, too--because I've realized it.

lines.content: あなたがいないと、私には……“夢”も“希望”も、何も見えない。
lines.translated: Without you, I can't see... "dreams," or "hope," or anything at all.

lines.content: 両手で顔を覆って……。
lines.translated: Covering my face with both hands...

lines.content: 泣き崩れよう。
lines.translated: I was about to collapse in tears.

lines.content: 今まさに、そうしようとした私は……。
lines.translated: Just as I was on the verge of doing so...

lines.content: え
lines.translated: "Huh?"
Someone gave my hand a firm pull.

lines.content: よろめき、つんのめる。
lines.translated: I staggered and pitched forward.

lines.content: その先は階段だった。
lines.translated: Right ahead of me were the stairs.

lines.content: 境内に続く長い、とても長い石段だ。
lines.translated: The long, very long stone steps leading up to the shrine grounds.

lines.content: だめだ――落ちる。
lines.translated: No--I'm going to fall.

lines.content: ……踏ん張れない。
lines.translated: I can't catch my footing.

lines.content: 目を閉じる。
lines.translated: I close my eyes.

lines.content: 私は落ちる。
lines.translated: I'm falling.

lines.content: たくさんの階段を転げ落ち……。
lines.translated: I'm going to tumble down all those stairs...

lines.content: それで、終わりだ。
lines.translated: And then, it'll all be over.

lines.content: そんなことを思うけど……。
lines.translated: That was what I thought, and yet...

lines.content: だけどそんな私を、抱き留めてくれる誰かがそこにいて……。
lines.translated: Yet someone was right there, catching me in their arms...

lines.content: 支えられた身体が、震えていた。
lines.translated: Held in their embrace, my body was trembling.

lines.content: [まぶた|瞼]を開こうとする。
lines.translated: I tried to open my eyelids.

lines.content: でも、できない。
lines.translated: But I couldn't.

lines.content: できないよ。
lines.translated: I just can't.

lines.content: ……どうしよう。
lines.translated: What do I do?

lines.content: 私をしっかり抱きしめてくれた誰かの胸元。そこにしがみついて、私は、震えた。
lines.translated: I clung to the chest of the person holding me tightly, and I trembled.

lines.content: 怖かった。
lines.translated: I was scared.

lines.content: 閉じた両目を開くことが、できない。
lines.translated: I couldn't open my tightly shut eyes.

lines.content: 今、何が起きてるのかわからない。わからない、けれど……。
lines.translated: I didn't know what was happening right now. I didn't know, and yet...

lines.content: もしも[・|こ][・|れ]が悪い夢ならどうしよう。
lines.translated: What if this is just a bad dream?

lines.content: 目の前の現実を見つめるのが、怖い――
lines.translated: I'm scared to look at the reality right in front of me--

lines.content: でも……。
lines.translated: Even so...

lines.content: 姫織……
lines.translated: "Himeori..."

lines.content: うん……。
lines.translated: Yeah...

lines.content: 大丈夫、だよね。
lines.translated: It's okay, isn't it?

lines.content: あなたが私の名前を呼んでくれてる。
lines.translated: You're calling my name.

lines.content: 今度はもう、聞き間違えなんかじゃないはずだから……。
lines.translated: This time, there's no way I'm just hearing things...

lines.content: 信じてる。
lines.translated: I believe in her.

lines.content: ……信じてるよ。
lines.translated: I believe in you.

lines.content: 現実を見つめるのは怖いけど。不安、だけれど。
lines.translated: Facing reality is scary. I'm anxious, and yet.

lines.content: 大丈夫。
lines.translated: It's okay.

lines.content: ……これはきっと、悪い夢なんかじゃないよね。
lines.translated: Surely, this isn't a bad dream, right?

lines.content: 勇気を出して、恐る恐る――[まぶた|瞼]を開いて、
lines.translated: Gathering my courage, timidly--I opened my eyelids.

lines.content: ……ああ
lines.translated: "...Yeah."

lines.content: ため息が、こぼれた。
lines.translated: A sigh escaped my lips.
Thanks to that person pulling me by the hand...

lines.content: そこはもう、“夜”の中ではなくて……。
lines.translated: I was no longer inside the "Night"...

lines.content: 目覚めたばかりの、きらきら眩しい朝の光のその中で、
lines.translated: Bathed in the dazzling, glittering light of the newly awakened morning,

lines.content: ……大雅。みーっけ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. Found you."

lines.content: やさしく微笑むあなたのことを見つめるだけで、私は……私、いっぱい……いっぱい、涙が溢れた。
lines.translated: Just looking at you smiling gently back at me made... made so many... so many tears spill over.

lines.content: “迷子”な[・|俺]は姫織に手を引いてもらい、“ゆめのねどこ”にまで戻って来れた。
lines.translated: Now that I was the "lost child," Himeori led me by the hand, and we managed to make it back to the "Dream Bed."

lines.content: あさひさんたちは、いない。
lines.translated: Asahi-san and the others weren't there.

lines.content: 俺の中に残ったままの“迷子”をどうにかすることは可能だろうか――
lines.translated: Would it be possible to do something about the "lost child" still remaining inside me?

lines.content: そういった[・|こ][・|れ][・|か][・|ら]のことを相談しようと思っていたけれど。
lines.translated: I had been hoping to talk to them about what we were going to do from here on out, but...

lines.content: これからずっと、俺はこうして姫織に手を引いてもらわなければ、どこへも行けなくなってしまったのかな
lines.translated: "I wonder if I won't be able to go anywhere anymore unless I have you lead me by the hand like this, Himeori."

lines.content: 姫織の中の“迷子”を、俺は“魔法”の“代償”で引き受けるのだと“想像”した。
lines.translated: I had "imagined" taking on the "lost child" inside Himeori as the "price" of my "magic."

lines.content: その結果……。
lines.translated: And as a result...

lines.content: ……気をつけてね。大雅
lines.translated: "...Be careful, okay, Taiga?"

lines.content: 姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: お腹が空くとね、どうしてだか頭の中がぼんやりしちゃって……“迷子”が強くなっちゃうよ
lines.translated: "When you get hungry, your head starts to feel all fuzzy for some reason... and the 'lost child' gets stronger."

lines.content: そっか……
lines.translated: "I see..."

lines.content: 今まで姫織が抱えていた不安とか、自分への無力感だとか……。
lines.translated: The anxiety Himeori had carried all this time, the sense of helplessness toward herself...

lines.content: そういうものを、ようやく、本当の意味で理解できたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Perhaps I was finally able to truly understand what those felt like.

lines.content: ……よかった
lines.translated: "...Thank goodness."

lines.content: ぽつりと姫織がつぶやいた。
lines.translated: Himeori murmured softly.

lines.content: ……大雅。また会えて、よかったよ
lines.translated: "...Taiga. I'm so glad I could see you again."

lines.content: これで充分だと姫織は小さく笑う。あなたがそばにいてくれるのならそれでいい。
lines.translated: Himeori gave a small smile, as if to say this was enough. As long as you're by my side, that's all I need.

lines.content: 大雅ら“迷子”にならないよう、私がずっと、こうして大雅と手を繋いでる……。大雅とまたこうしていられるなら……それくらい、何でもないよ
lines.translated: "So that you don't become a 'lost child,' Taiga, I'll hold your hand just like this forever... As long as I can be with you like this again, Taiga... something like that is nothing at all."

lines.content: 姫織と繋いだ手を見つめる。
lines.translated: I gazed down at my hand, intertwined with Himeori's.

lines.content: 進むべき道さえもよくわからない。そんな不安の中にある姫織の手を、これまでの俺は簡単に手放してきた――
lines.translated: Not even knowing which way to go. Until now, I had so easily let go of Himeori's hand, leaving her in the grip of that very anxiety--

lines.content: 学園が終わり、放課後。何気ない“さよなら”の後に、姫織はどれだけの不安や心配を重ねてきたのだろう。
lines.translated: After school ended for the day, following a casual "see you tomorrow," just how much anxiety and worry had Himeori piled up inside herself?

lines.content: それを“想像”してしまうと――今、自分の中に芽生える心細さと重ねて、今日までの姫織の気持ちを、思い描いてしまうと……。
lines.translated: When I "imagined" that--when I overlapped the helplessness now budding inside me with the feelings Himeori must have carried up until today...

lines.content: 涙さえ、滲んだ。
lines.translated: Tears even welled up in my eyes.

lines.content: そんな俺の……情けないばかりなこの俺の手を、姫織はずっと繋いだままでいてくれる。
lines.translated: Even for someone as utterly pathetic as me... Himeori was willing to keep holding my hand forever.

lines.content: 姫織……。
lines.translated: Himeori...

lines.content: 大切な“幼馴染み”の女の子。
lines.translated: My precious "childhood friend."

lines.content: もう二度とこの手を離したくない。……離して、ほしくない。
lines.translated: I never want to let go of this hand again. ...And I don't want her to let go, either.

lines.content: この気持ちの正体を、俺は、“夜”に迷いながら――あの石段を這ってでものぼりながら、考えていた。
lines.translated: While wandering through the "Night"--while crawling my way up those stone steps, I had been thinking about the true nature of these feelings.

lines.content: ……姫織に手を引かれ、“ゆめのねどこ”への帰路を歩きながら、考えていたんだ。
lines.translated: And as Himeori led me by the hand on our walk back to the "Dream Bed," I had been thinking about it, too.

lines.content: それはきっと、こういう言葉に変えられるはずだ。
lines.translated: Surely, they could be put into words like this.

lines.content: ……好きだ
lines.translated: "...I love you."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: ……姫織。俺、君が好きだよ。大好きだ
lines.translated: "...Himeori. I love you. I love you so much."

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: ああ。まったく、自意識過剰だった――姫織はよろこんでくれるとどこかで期待していたのだ。
lines.translated: Ah. I really was being full of myself--some part of me had expected that Himeori would be happy to hear it.

lines.content: ……でも
lines.translated: "...Even though..."

lines.content: 不安そうに、あるいはさみしそうに、姫織は言った。
lines.translated: Looking anxious, or perhaps lonely, Himeori spoke.

lines.content: でもね、大雅。私……なんにもできない。大雅が私の中の“迷子”を持って行ってくれたけど……私の[・|な][・|ん][・|に][・|も][・|で][・|き][・|な][・|さ]は、殆どなんにも変わらないんだよ
lines.translated: "But you know, Taiga. I... can't do anything. You took the 'lost child' inside me away, Taiga, but... the fact that I'm completely useless hasn't really changed at all."

lines.content: 空っぽなの、と姫織は言う。
lines.translated: "I'm empty," Himeori said.

lines.content: いつも空っぽなお腹の中みたいに――私、何にもないんだよ。空っぽで。薄っぺらで。ただのへっぽこ。どうして十年前の“戦争”に選ばれたのか。今になってもよくわかってない
lines.translated: "Just like how my stomach is always empty--there's nothing inside me. I'm empty. Shallow. Just a good-for-nothing. Even now, I still don't really understand why I was chosen for the 'War' ten years ago."

lines.content: それくら私には何にもないの。と姫織は苦笑いを浮かべる。
lines.translated: "That's how little I have inside me," Himeori said with a bitter smile.

lines.content: 私にはね、大雅。たとえば歌とか、踊りとか……そういうふうな、この世界を楽しい場所に変えられるような、“特別”な才能がないどころじ、ゃなくて――
lines.translated: "You see, Taiga, for me... Like singing, or dancing... It's not just that I don't have a 'special' talent that can make this world a fun place--"

lines.content: 勉強もできない。運動だって得意じゃない。親しい人と以外は実はあんまり話せない。
lines.translated: "I'm no good at studying. I'm not good at sports, either. And the truth is, I can barely even talk to anyone unless I'm close to them."

lines.content: そんな私は、きっと――
lines.translated: Someone like me must--

lines.content: ――きっと、ね。“この世界で生きていくというごくごく基本的な才能”でさえも、私は、乏しい
lines.translated: "--Must be lacking, you know. Even in 'the most basic talent for living in this world,' I fall short."

lines.content: 私の手の中にはいつまでも何もなかった。何も、掴めてはいなかった。姫織はそう言った。
lines.translated: There had never been anything in my hands. I had never been able to grasp anything at all. That was what Himeori said.

lines.content: 同い年の誰もがいつの間にか手に入れられているだろうものを、私は、産まれてきてから今日に至るまで、何も……何ひとつ。
lines.translated: All the things that everyone else my age had probably gained without even realizing it--from the day I was born right up until today, I haven't had anything... not a single one.

lines.content: そんな私なんかと一緒にいたら……大雅。絶対、大変だよ
lines.translated: "If you stay with someone like me... Taiga, it'll definitely be hard on you."

lines.content: 繋いだ手の力が弱まった。
lines.translated: Her grip on my hand weakened.

lines.content: ……絶対、大雅……いつか私に呆れちゃう。私に、大変な思いさせられるだけじゃなくて……たぶん、大雅は不幸になるよ
lines.translated: "...You'll definitely get fed up with me someday, Taiga. Not only will I put you through so much trouble... you'll probably end up unhappy."

lines.content: 大雅が“夜”の中で“迷子”になって……。
lines.translated: When you became a "lost child" in the "Night," Taiga...

lines.content: あのときは、絶対大雅を取り戻すんだって思うと、不思議と小さな勇気が湧いた――
lines.translated: Back then, the thought that I absolutely had to get you back strangely filled me with a tiny bit of courage--

lines.content: あなたにもあるのかもしれない不安な思いを、私にも分けてほしい。そんなふうにしてこれからも一緒にいられたら。
lines.translated: I wanted you to share whatever anxious feelings you might have with me, too. If only we could stay together from now on just like that.

lines.content: いつもと違う非日常な“夜”の中……どこか気持ちが高ぶっていたのかもしれない。
lines.translated: Amidst that unusual, extraordinary "Night"... maybe my emotions had just been running high.

lines.content: 私は、そんなふうに思っていたけれど……。
lines.translated: That was how I felt, and yet...

lines.content: ……大切な人が、自分のせいで[ふしあわ|不幸]せな人生を送ってるのなんて、見たくない。そんなのいやだよ――もっともっと、自分のことが許せなくなる。大嫌いに、なる
lines.translated: "...I don't want to watch someone precious to me live an unhappy life because of me. I don't want that--I'd be able to forgive myself even less. I'd come to hate myself."

lines.content: そんな未来に至るのならば、今までと同じようにひとりぼっちなままがいい。
lines.translated: If that is the future waiting for us, I would rather stay all alone just like I have been until now.

lines.content: これからは誰にも関わることなく、真っ暗な部屋の中に閉じこもり――[・|閉][・|じ][・|込][・|め][・|ら][・|れ][・|て]、生きていきたい。そうつぶやく姫織。
lines.translated: From here on out, I want to shut myself away in a pitch-black room without getting involved with anyone--to live my life locked away. So Himeori murmured.

lines.content: 繋いだ手から、更に、力が解けていった。
lines.translated: Even more strength slipped from our joined hands.

lines.content: 俺の伝えた“好き”が、姫織を再び不安にさせてしまってる。だからこそ、と思う。
lines.translated: The "I love you" I conveyed to her was making Himeori anxious all over again. And that was precisely why, I thought.

lines.content: ……いいんだよ。姫織
lines.translated: "...It's okay, Himeori."

lines.content: ――だからこそ俺は、飾ることのない真っ直ぐな言葉で、この気持ちを姫織に伝えたかった。
lines.translated: --Precisely why I wanted to convey these feelings to Himeori in plain, straightforward words.

lines.content: 何ができようとできなからとう構わないんだ。俺は、姫織。そんな君と一緒にいたいんだよ。ありのままの君が好きなんだ……
lines.translated: "I don't care what you can or can't do. I want to be with you just as you are, Himeori. I love you the way you are..."

lines.content: と、こんなのはあんまりにも真っ直ぐで。一直線に過ぎていて。だからこそ、どこででも耳にする。
lines.translated: Putting it like this was almost too straightforward. Too direct. Which is why you hear words like that everywhere.

lines.content: もう既に陳腐だとさえ言っていいだろう単純な言葉ではあるけれど……。
lines.translated: They might be simple words, cliche even, and yet...

lines.content: 姫織……。大好きだよ、姫織
lines.translated: "Himeori... I love you so much, Himeori."

lines.content: でも、本当の気持ちだ。
lines.translated: Even so, it's how I truly feel.

lines.content: 届いてほしい。
lines.translated: I want it to reach her.

lines.content: そう、願う。
lines.translated: That was my wish.

lines.content: 俺たち……たぶん、ひとりじゃ色々足りないんだ。そんな俺たちだから、すぐにいっぱいいっぱいになっちゃう
lines.translated: "We're... probably both lacking in a lot of ways on our own. Because that's how we are, it doesn't take much before we're completely overwhelmed."

lines.content: だからさ……これからは、色々な“重さ”を、ふたりで分け合っていこうよ。俺も……
lines.translated: "So... from now on, let's share all sorts of 'burdens' between the two of us. I'll..."

lines.content: ……俺も、できるかぎり……[・|覚][・|え][・|て][・|い][・|る][・|限][・|り]、姫織に話すから。だから……
lines.translated: "...I'll tell you everything I can, Himeori... for as long as I can remember. So..."

lines.content: ずきりと胸を突き刺す不可解な痛みがあった。
lines.translated: A sudden, inexplicable pain lanced through my chest.

lines.content: その正体を俺は思い出せない。あの石段をのぼる中で、置いてきた――“夜”の底に置いてきてしまったのだ。
lines.translated: I couldn't remember what it was. While climbing those stone steps, I had left it behind--left it at the bottom of the "Night."

lines.content: そうすることが正しいと。
lines.translated: Even knowing that doing so was the right thing.

lines.content: そうすることが、“[・|夢]”[・|を][・|叶][・|え][・|る]ためには必要なのだと、わかっていても……。
lines.translated: Even knowing that doing so was necessary to "make the dream come true"...

lines.content: それが悲しくて。
lines.translated: It made me so sad.

lines.content: それが、さみしくて……。
lines.translated: It made me so lonely...

lines.content: ……だから、姫織
lines.translated: "...So, Himeori."

lines.content: 涙だ……。
lines.translated: Tears...

lines.content: 俺に遠慮なんてしなくて、いい。思い切り甘えてほしいんだ。俺に全力で大変な思いをさせてほしい。……君となら、姫織。不幸になった未来だって、きっと、楽しい……
lines.translated: "You don't have to hold back with me. I want you to lean on me as much as you want. I want you to put me through everything you've got. ...If I'm with you, Himeori, even an unhappy future will surely be fun..."

lines.content: どうしてだ。涙がひとつ、こぼれた。
lines.translated: Why? A single tear spilled down my cheek.

lines.content: 今、この胸を満たす想いはなんだろう。
lines.translated: What are these feelings filling my chest right now?

lines.content: この気持ちにはどういった名前をつけたらいいだろう。
lines.translated: What kind of name should I give to this emotion?

lines.content: 大雅……
lines.translated: "Taiga..."

lines.content: 震える俺の手に、姫織がもう一度力を込めて、繋いでくれた。
lines.translated: Himeori squeezed my trembling hand once more, holding it tight.

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: そして小さく、[・|何][・|か]――自分の中にある[・|何][・|か]の存在を、確かめるようにして、小さく、だけど確かにうなずいた後……。
lines.translated: And then, as if confirming the presence of something--something inside herself, she gave a small, yet unmistakable nod...

lines.content: ありがとう。大雅……
lines.translated: "Thank you, Taiga..."

lines.content: 柔らかく、だけどどこかまだ曇り空みたいな微笑みを、姫織は浮かべ、
lines.translated: Himeori offered a soft smile, though it still looked somewhat like a cloudy sky.

lines.content: まだまだ怖い。不安だ。……いっぱい、心配なことは尽きないけれど
lines.translated: "I'm still scared. I'm anxious. ...There's no end to all the things I'm worried about, but..."

lines.content: 私も、と俺のことを見つめ、答えてくれた。
lines.translated: "Me too," she answered, gazing right at me.

lines.content: 私も好きだよ。大雅のこと……
lines.translated: "I love you too, Taiga..."

lines.content: いつまでも消えない不安とか。怖さとか。……心配な気持ちとか。それ以上に、私は……大雅のことが大好き、なんだよ
lines.translated: "More than the anxiety that never goes away. Or the fear. ...Or the worries. More than all of that, I... I love you so much, Taiga."

lines.content: すげえ、ひよちゃん。さすがだなあ……
lines.translated: "Amazing, Hiyo-chan. I knew I could count on you..."

lines.content: 用意したいっぱいのお夕飯はあっという間になくなった。
lines.translated: The huge dinner I had prepared disappeared in the blink of an eye.

lines.content: ごちそうさまです。美味しかったです
lines.translated: "Thanks for the treat. That was delicious."

lines.content: 空っぽになったお皿を片付けながら、問いかける。
lines.translated: As I cleared away the empty plates, I asked her a question.

lines.content: お腹、いっぱいになったかな
lines.translated: "Are you full now?"

lines.content: そうだなあと首をかしげ、姫織はお腹を撫で撫でとする。
lines.translated: "Let's see," Himeori tilted her head, rubbing her stomach.

lines.content: ……もうちょっとだけ、足りないのかも
lines.translated: "...It might still be just a little bit short."

lines.content: 頬をちょっと赤くして、笑っていた。小さく鳴ったお腹を抱きしめ、身体を丸めた。
lines.translated: She laughed, her cheeks flushing slightly. Hugging her softly growling stomach, she curled up a bit.

lines.content: そして上目遣いで俺を見る。
lines.translated: Then, she looked up at me through her lashes.

lines.content: まだまだお腹、からっぽな感じがしちゃうかも……だね
lines.translated: "My stomach might still feel a little empty... I guess."

lines.content: う。そ、そっか……
lines.translated: "Urk. I-I see..."

lines.content: まだまだ足りない、かあ。
lines.translated: Still not enough, huh.

lines.content: 何かもう少し作れるだけの材料はあっただろうかと、冷蔵庫の中身を思い出してみる。
lines.translated: Wondering if there were enough ingredients left to whip up a little something else, I tried to recall the contents of the fridge.

lines.content: うう～ん。あさひさんがいてくれたら、もっと色々、美味しいものをたくさん作ってくれたんだろうけど……
lines.translated: "Hmm. If Asahi-san were here, she probably could've made you lots more delicious food, though..."

lines.content: 俺の作ったものでごめんねと言う。
lines.translated: I apologized for only being able to offer my own cooking.

lines.content: これ以上はちょっと、俺の知識とか料理の腕とかじゃあ作るの難しい、かも
lines.translated: "With my knowledge and cooking skills, making anything more than this might be a little tough."

lines.content: 今はあさひさんも十夜もいない。帰宅してからというものずっと留守だ。
lines.translated: Right now, neither Asahi-san nor Toya was home. They had been out ever since we got back.

lines.content: ふたり共、今日はどこかへ揃ってお出かけするんだ……、みたいなことを言っていただろうか。
lines.translated: Had they mentioned something about the two of them going out somewhere together today...?

lines.content: ともあれ台所に立てるのは俺しかいなかった。
lines.translated: In any case, I was the only one around to man the kitchen.

lines.content: 姫織は……。
lines.translated: As for Himeori...

lines.content: ううん。ごめんね大雅。私、いっぱい食べるくせして、全然、お料理とかできないの……
lines.translated: "No, I'm sorry, Taiga. For someone who eats so much, I can't cook at all..."

lines.content: 苦笑いで姫織は言う。作れるのはカップ麺とレトルトで簡単なあれとかこれとか。それだけなんだ、と。
lines.translated: Himeori gave a wry smile. The only things she could make were cup noodles and simple, pre-packaged stuff. That was it, she said.

lines.content: でも……。聞いてよ大雅
lines.translated: "But... listen to me, Taiga."

lines.content: うん。何かな、ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Yeah. What is it, Hiyo-chan?"

lines.content: これでもね、私、色々とがんばってはみてるんだよ。でも、全然できない――お料理はその内のひとつで
lines.translated: "Believe it or not, I really do try my best at a lot of things. Yet I can't do any of them at all--and cooking is one of them."

lines.content: 私は空っぽなんだよねと姫織は苦笑いを浮かべる。いっつもぺこぺこなこのお腹と一緒だ、と。
lines.translated: "I'm empty inside," Himeori said with a bitter smile. "Just like this stomach of mine that's always starving."

lines.content: 空っぽで、薄っぺらくて、何にもできない自分のことを、ずっと恥ずかしいと思ってた……
lines.translated: "I always felt so ashamed of myself for being empty, shallow, and completely useless..."

lines.content: だからせめて明るい子じゃないと。
lines.translated: So I figured I at least had to be a cheerful girl.

lines.content: そうじゃないとどこにも“居場所”はないんじゃないか。
lines.translated: Otherwise, wouldn't there be no "place to belong" for me anywhere?

lines.content: そういうふうに怖く思ってた。
lines.translated: That was the fear I always carried.

lines.content: でも今はそんな自分も、好きに……は、まだまだなれていないけど。でもね、今ではもう恥ずかしくはないし、嫌いでもないよ
lines.translated: "Right now, I still haven't... quite come to like this side of myself yet. But you know, I'm not ashamed of it anymore, and I don't hate myself either."

lines.content: 何もできない自分を好きではないけど、だけど大嫌いでもない。
lines.translated: I don't like this useless self of mine, capability-wise, yet I don't despise myself either.

lines.content: だって……
lines.translated: "Because..."

lines.content: うん
lines.translated: Yeah?

lines.content: だって、大雅が、こういう私を好きって言ってくれたんだもん
lines.translated: "Because you told me you loved me just the way I am, Taiga."

lines.content: 大雅が好きって言ってくれた自分のことを嫌いとか恥ずかしいとか思ってたらね、なんだか、私に好きをくれる大雅のことも、嫌いだって言ってるみたいに思えて、いやだから……
lines.translated: "If I hated or felt ashamed of the me that you said you loved, Taiga, it'd feel like I was saying I hated you for giving me that love, too, and I don't want that..."

lines.content: 姫織は照れくさそうに身体を揺すっていた。
lines.translated: Himeori swayed bashfully.

lines.content: ひよちゃん
lines.translated: "Hiyo-chan."

lines.content: んー？
lines.translated: "Hmm?"

lines.content: ……姫織
lines.translated: "...Himeori."

lines.content: え、ええ……う、うん
lines.translated: "Eh, eek... Y-Yes?"

lines.content: なあに？　と首をかしげる。
lines.translated: "What is it?" she asked, tilting her head.

lines.content: そんな姫織を、俺はまっすぐに見る。
lines.translated: I looked straight at Himeori.

lines.content: 好きだよ
lines.translated: "I love you."

lines.content: う
lines.translated: "Urk."

lines.content: 大好きだ……
lines.translated: "I love you so much..."

lines.content: え、えう……
lines.translated: "E-Eek..."

lines.content: 姫織
lines.translated: Himeori

lines.content: もう二度と、離さないから。
lines.translated: I will never let go of you again.

lines.content: そう言って、俺は姫織と手を繋ぐ。
lines.translated: Saying that, I took Himeori's hand.

lines.content: そして、あたふたしている真っ赤な姫織の頬に触れた。
lines.translated: Then, as she got all flustered, I touched her bright red cheek.

lines.content: ……う、うう。大雅はちょっと、こ、こんな……男の子っぽい感じもあるんだなって、私、知らなかったよ
lines.translated: "...U-Uuu. I didn't know you had this kind of... boyish side to you too, Taiga."

lines.content: 嫌いにならないでほしいけど
lines.translated: "I hope it doesn't make you dislike me."

lines.content: ……嫌いなんて。そんなこと、なるわけないよ
lines.translated: "...Dislike you? There's no way I ever could."

lines.content: ぎゅっと両目を閉じた姫織と、軽く触れあうように唇を合わせた。
lines.translated: Himeori squeezed her eyes shut, and I pressed my lips lightly against hers.

lines.content: 唇を離すと、直ぐ近くに顔があり……。
lines.translated: When our lips parted, her face was right there, so close to mine...

lines.content: 目が合い、どちらも驚くくらい真っ赤だと、気づく。
lines.translated: Our eyes met, and we realized we were both blushing a startling shade of red.

lines.content: なんだかおかしくなって、ふたりで少し笑った。
lines.translated: Finding it somewhat funny, the two of us shared a small laugh.

lines.content: 大雅の中には“迷子”があって……
lines.translated: "Inside you, Taiga, there's a 'lost child'..."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 私の中には、まだ、暴れん坊の怪獣がいる……
lines.translated: "And inside me, there's still a rampaging monster..."

lines.content: 私と大雅はこうして会えた。また、笑ったり、時どきけんかとかもできるのかもしれない。一緒にいてできることは、楽しいことだけじゃなくてもすべて幸せ。そう思える。
lines.translated: Taiga and I were finally able to meet like this. We'll probably be able to laugh together again, and maybe even fight from time to time. Even if it's not all fun and games, everything we can do together brings me happiness. That's how I feel.

lines.content: だけど……。
lines.translated: However...

lines.content: 私の中の……ううん。私たちの中の、生きていくのに“大変”なものは、なくなっちゃったわけじゃない
lines.translated: "The things inside me... no, inside the two of us that make living 'hard' haven't just disappeared."

lines.content: きっとこれからも、生きていくのは簡単じゃないよね。姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Living won't be easy from here on out either, will it? Himeori said.

lines.content: だから俺もうなずいて、答える。
lines.translated: So I nodded and answered her.

lines.content: そうだね。姫織の言うとおりだ。[・|こ][・|れ]は結構、大変だね
lines.translated: "Yeah. You're right, Himeori. This is pretty tough."

lines.content: 姫織に手を引いてもらわなければ、俺はまともに“ゆめのねどこ”へも帰って来れない。
lines.translated: Unless Himeori holds my hand and leads me, I can't even make it back to the "Dream Bed" properly.

lines.content: ……姫織は、いつも、お腹が空っぽな感覚が満たされることはない。
lines.translated: And Himeori's constant feeling of an empty stomach will never be satisfied.

lines.content: 確かに色々なことが大変だ。容易ではない。
lines.translated: A lot of things really are tough. None of it is easy.

lines.content: だけどさ。今までは、姫織がふたつとも抱えてたんだ
lines.translated: "Even so, up until now, you were carrying both of those burdens all by yourself, Himeori."

lines.content: ひとりでふたつを抱えるよりも、ふたりでひとつずつ背負って歩いて行けるなら……。
lines.translated: Rather than one person carrying both, if the two of us can shoulder one each and walk forward together...

lines.content: そういう“関係”で、俺たちがずっといられるのなら……。
lines.translated: If we can stay in that kind of "relationship" forever...

lines.content: 姫織。俺はさ、こんな困難くらい、なんでもないって思えるよ
lines.translated: "Himeori. To me, a hardship like this feels like nothing at all."

lines.content: 本当に、本当に、俺はそう思ってるんだよという気持ちが伝わるようにと、微笑んでみせた。
lines.translated: I smiled at her, hoping to convey just how truly, genuinely I meant those words.

lines.content: う、た、大雅……
lines.translated: "U-T-Taiga..."

lines.content: 真っ赤になっている――意外にも、思った以上に恥ずかしがり屋だったらしい姫織に、俺は言う。
lines.translated: Turning bright red--surprisingly, she seemed to be much shyer than I'd thought--Himeori stood before me as I spoke.

lines.content: なに？　姫織
lines.translated: "What is it, Himeori?"

lines.content: そ、そのう……
lines.translated: "U-Umm..."

lines.content: うん。言いたいことあったらちゃんと全部、言ってほしいな。姫織
lines.translated: "Yeah. If there's something you want to say, I want you to tell me all of it, Himeori."

lines.content: う。え、えっと……その……さっきからずっと、そうだったけれども……
lines.translated: "Ugh. U-Umm... well... you've been doing it for a little while now, but..."

lines.content: ひよちゃん、じゃなくて……これからは、その[・|呼][・|び][・|方]になっちゃうのかなあ、って……思って
lines.translated: "Instead of Hiyo-chan... I was just wondering if you're going to call me that from now on..."

lines.content: うん。そうしたいと思うけど……
lines.translated: "Yeah. I'd like to, at least..."

lines.content: だめかなと問う。
lines.translated: Is that no good? I asked.

lines.content: ううん。全然、だめじゃないけど……、と姫織はもにょもにょしている。
lines.translated: "No, it's not bad at all, it's just..." Himeori mumbled, fidgeting.

lines.content: い、いきなりだとなんだか……、ちょっとだけだよ？　照れくさいような感じがして……え、えへへ。ほんとう、照れてしまいますねえ
lines.translated: "W-When it's so sudden, it kind of... just a little bit, okay? It feels a bit embarrassing... E-Ehehe. It really makes me feel shy, doesn't it?"

lines.content: いつもの明るい姫織も好きだ。
lines.translated: I love the usual cheerful Himeori, too.

lines.content: でも、こうして俺の前でだけ、真っ赤になって、もじもじしっぱなしな姫織も好きだ。……大好きだ。すごくかわいいと、思ってしまう。
lines.translated: Yet I also love this Himeori who turns bright red and fidgets endlessly only in front of me. ...I love her so much. I can't help thinking how incredibly cute she is.

lines.content: ……だからそんな姫織を抱き寄せる。
lines.translated: So I pulled her into an embrace.

lines.content: あ……。た、大雅？
lines.translated: "Ah... T-Taiga?"

lines.content: 少し戸惑う姫織と、俺は、もう一度唇を合わせようとしたけれど……、
lines.translated: Himeori looked a little bewildered as I tried to press my lips to hers once more, when...

lines.content: はは。もう、台無しだぞ姫織
lines.translated: "Haha. Jeez, that totally ruined the mood, Himeori."

lines.content: え、えへへ～。……お腹の怪獣は空気読んでくれないからねえ
lines.translated: "E-Ehehe~ ...The monster in my stomach doesn't know how to read the room, you see."

lines.content: 照れくさそうに言いながらも、どこかしゅんとしてしまっていた。
lines.translated: Even as she said it bashfully, she looked somewhat deflated.

lines.content: そういう姫織の表情を、ようやく察することができるようになれた――たぶん、幼馴染みよりももっと近くなれたことの証明のように思え、うれしい。
lines.translated: Being able to finally pick up on those subtle expressions of hers felt like proof that we'd grown even closer than childhood friends, and it made me happy.

lines.content: 姫織
lines.translated: Himeori

lines.content: ……うん
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: いっぱい食べる女の子はかわいいよ
lines.translated: "Girls who eat a lot are cute."

lines.content: う。……そ、そう？
lines.translated: "Ugh. ...R-Really?"

lines.content: そうともさ
lines.translated: "You bet."

lines.content: だけど、食費はいっぱい大変だよね……
lines.translated: "Still, the food bill is going to be a huge pain, isn't it...?"

lines.content: ……うん。そうかも
lines.translated: "...Yeah. Maybe so."

lines.content: 確かにそうだとうなずき、答える。
lines.translated: That's certainly true, I nodded in reply.

lines.content: だったらいっぱい稼げるよう、俺、がんばるよ
lines.translated: "In that case, I'll work hard so I can earn a whole lot."

lines.content: え？
lines.translated: Huh?

lines.content: 大好きなかわいい彼女のお腹を、いっぱいにもできないような彼氏なんて……何か、いやだろ。ああ、うん。そんな自分はほんとにいやだな
lines.translated: "A boyfriend who can't even fill the stomach of his cute, beloved girlfriend... I wouldn't want that at all. Yeah. I'd really hate to be like that."

lines.content: か、彼氏かあ……
lines.translated: "B-Boyfriend, huh..."

lines.content: 真っ赤な頬を更に赤くし、姫織は照れくさそうに身体を揺らしているけれど……、
lines.translated: Her already bright red cheeks flushed even deeper as she swayed bashfully, though...

lines.content: ほんとはお嫁さん、と言いたかった。
lines.translated: The truth is, I wanted to say "wife."

lines.content: でもそんなのはまだ早い。あんまりにも軽率で、それこそうそっぽくなってしまう。
lines.translated: Still, it was too soon for that. It would be way too hasty, and it'd end up sounding fake.

lines.content: だから、今日のところはこれでいい。
lines.translated: So for today, this was enough.

lines.content: じゃ、そういうわけだから……お買い物、行こっか
lines.translated: "Well, since that's settled... shall we go shopping?"

lines.content: お買い物……？
lines.translated: "Shopping...?"

lines.content: そうだよ。デザート何もなかったからね。忘れてた。だから一緒に買いに行こう
lines.translated: "That's right. We didn't have any dessert, after all. I forgot. So let's go buy some together."

lines.content: いいの……？
lines.translated: "Are you sure...?"

lines.content: いいともさ
lines.translated: "Of course."

lines.content: ご飯だけじゃないよ。甘いのもいっぱい、いっぱい……、たくさんたくさん食べたいなあって、お願いしちゃうかも……だよ？
lines.translated: "It won't just be regular food, you know. I might end up asking for lots and lots... a whole ton of sweets to eat, too... okay?"

lines.content: ああ、いいよ。知ってる
lines.translated: "Yeah, that's fine. I know."

lines.content: どんとこいと胸を張った。
lines.translated: Bring it on, I puffed out my chest.

lines.content: まだまだ子どもな俺だから、毎日姫織のお腹をいっぱいにはできないけれど……
lines.translated: "I'm still just a kid, so I can't fill your stomach every single day, Himeori, but..."

lines.content: ごめんねと俺は言う。
lines.translated: I'm sorry, I told her.

lines.content: だけど今日は、特別だから。俺のお財布を容赦なく空っぽにしてくれていいよ。代わりに、姫織のお腹がいっぱいになったらいいな
lines.translated: "Today is special, though. You can mercilessly empty out my wallet. In exchange, I hope it fills your stomach right up, Himeori."

lines.content: だから……。
lines.translated: That was why...

lines.content: 姫織。お願いしてもいいかな
lines.translated: "Himeori. Could I ask you for a favor?"

lines.content: 姫織が手を引いてくれないと俺、お買い物もできないんだ――そう言い、ふたりで一緒に外へ出てから、俺は姫織に手を差し伸べた。
lines.translated: Unless you hold my hand and lead me, I can't even go shopping--saying that, after the two of us stepped outside together, I held my hand out to Himeori.

lines.content: うん……
lines.translated: "Yeah..."

lines.content: 姫織は、ふと夕焼け色の空を見上げた。
lines.translated: Himeori suddenly looked up at the sunset-colored sky.

lines.content: その横顔はどこかさみしそうにも見えたけど……。
lines.translated: Her profile looked somewhat lonely, yet...

lines.content: 私も、がんばるよ
lines.translated: "I'll do my best, too."

lines.content: ぽつりと言った。
lines.translated: She murmured softly.

lines.content: これから色々。いっぱい……私もがんばってみようって思う。何にもできない私でも大好きだって、大雅は言ってくれたけど……
lines.translated: "At a lot of things from now on. So many things... I think I'll try doing my best, too. Even though you told me you love me even when I can't do anything, Taiga..."

lines.content: でもね。いつも大雅にお腹いっぱいにしてもらったりとか……。何かを、してもらうばっかりじゃなくて。私も、大雅に……だ、大好きな、大雅に……何かしてあげられる子になりたい
lines.translated: "Still, you know. Instead of always having you fill my stomach... and just having you do things for me all the time. I want to become a girl who can do something for you, too, Taiga... for the Taiga I-I love so much."

lines.content: 今は、“迷子”な大雅の手を引くことしかできないけれど……。
lines.translated: Right now, all I can do is hold the hand of a "lost child" like you, Taiga, but...

lines.content: 私も、大雅の力になれますように。そんな自分になれますように。……それが私の新しい“夢”だよ
lines.translated: "I hope I can be of help to you too, Taiga. I hope I can become that kind of person. ...That's my new 'dream.'"

lines.content: 叶うかな。
lines.translated: I wonder if it'll come true.

lines.content: 姫織は言う。
lines.translated: Himeori said.

lines.content: 私はこの“夢”[・|も]、叶えることができるかな……
lines.translated: "I wonder if I'll be able to make this 'dream' come true, too..."

lines.content: 俺は……。
ああ、もちろん
lines.translated: "Yeah, of course."

lines.content: とっても期待してるよ。と、俺は答える。
lines.translated: I'm really looking forward to it, I answered.

lines.content: ……姫織
lines.translated: "...Himeori."

lines.content: 君は、自分は何にもできないなんて言うけれど……そんなことない。
lines.translated: You say you can't do anything at all, but... that's not true.

lines.content: 君なら何でも、どんなことでもできるって……叶えられないことはないんだって、信じてるよ
lines.translated: "I believe you can do anything, no matter what it is... that there's nothing you can't make come true."

lines.content: だって、姫織……君は“迷子”になってしまった俺を迎えに来てくれたじゃないか。
lines.translated: Because, Himeori... you came to get me when I had become a "lost child," didn't you?

lines.content: だからもし、そんな君のことを、世界中の誰もが認めなかろうと……。
lines.translated: So even if no one else in the entire world acknowledges you...

lines.content: 君ならきっと何でもできるんだと、俺だけはそばで信じ続けていたいんだ。
lines.translated: I want to stay right by your side as the one person who keeps believing that you can surely do anything.

lines.content: 姫織の不安に微笑んでそう答え、姫織もまた、そんな俺にただ微笑んでくれていた。
lines.translated: Smiling at Himeori's anxieties as I gave her that answer, she simply smiled back at me in return.

lines.content: 姫織……。夜月姫織。
lines.translated: Himeori... Yotsuki Himeori.

lines.content: 今日までずっとひとりぼっちだった女の子。
lines.translated: A girl who had been all alone up until today.

lines.content: 明日からはその心のからっぽを、俺が、いっぱいに満たすことの手伝いができたならと、そう願う。
lines.translated: Starting tomorrow, I hope I can help fill that emptiness in her heart to the brim.

lines.content: だからもう二度と心も身体も、迷子になんてならないように……。
lines.translated: So that neither our hearts nor our bodies ever become lost children again...

lines.content: 今は唇を合わせる代わりに、俺たちはしっかりと、手と手を繋いだ。
lines.translated: Instead of pressing our lips together right now, we held each other's hands tightly.

lines.content: さよなら
lines.translated: "Goodbye."
It was morning.

lines.content: ようやく出会えたふたりのことを……[・|石][・|段]に腰掛け、そんなふたりが歩いて行くその背中を、[・|私]は見つめた。
lines.translated: Sitting on the stone steps, I gazed at the backs of the two who had finally found each other as they walked away.

lines.content: ……姫織。大雅。またいつか、“夜”の中で会えたらいいな
lines.translated: "...Himeori. Taiga. I hope we can meet again inside the 'Night' someday."

lines.content: そうつぶやいてはみても……。
lines.translated: Even as I murmured that to myself...

lines.content: うん。
lines.translated: Yeah.

lines.content: ……[・|そ][・|れ]はたぶん、叶わないんじゃないかなあ
lines.translated: "...That probably won't come true, will it?"

lines.content: “規則”を破った――私は列車の外には出られない。[・|出][・|て][・|は]、[・|い][・|け][・|な][・|い]。
lines.translated: I broke the "rules"--I cannot step outside the train. I must not step outside.

lines.content: それを破れば……。
lines.translated: And if I break that rule...

lines.content: ……こうなることくらい、わかってた
lines.translated: "...I knew it would turn out like this."

lines.content: 朝だ……。
lines.translated: It's morning...

lines.content: 空に掲げた手のひらに、朝日の光りがきらきらと透き通っている。
lines.translated: The morning sunlight shone sparkling and clear right through the palm of the hand I held up to the sky.

lines.content: そうだ。規則を破ればこうなるだろうことはわかっていたんだ。
lines.translated: That's right. I knew this would happen if I broke the rules.

lines.content: それなのに……。
lines.translated: And yet...

lines.content: ……見て、いられなかったんだよ
lines.translated: "...I just couldn't stand by and watch."

lines.content: ふと苦笑いを浮かべてしまう。
lines.translated: A bitter smile slipped onto my face.

lines.content: 大雅が、もうすぐ目の前に……あと一歩のところに、うずくまっているのに
lines.translated: "Taiga was crouching right there in front of you... just a single step away."

lines.content: それなのに、姫織、あなたは太陽が目覚めたところで、もうだめだと頭を抱えて……。
lines.translated: And yet, Himeori, the moment the sun awoke, you held your head in despair, thinking it was all over...

lines.content: “影”に呑まれそうになっていた大雅もまた、深い眠りにつこうとしていた。
lines.translated: Taiga, who was on the verge of being swallowed up by the "Shadow," was also about to fall into a deep sleep.

lines.content: ただ目に見えないだけだなんだ。
lines.translated: They simply couldn't see each other.

lines.content: ただ、それだけで、求め合うふたりはすぐ目の前にいた……それなのに、ふたりは手を伸ばそうともしない。
lines.translated: That was all it was; the two who longed for each other were right before one another's eyes... and yet, neither of them even tried to reach out a hand.

lines.content: そんなふたりのことを見ていたら、つい……たまらなくなった。
lines.translated: Watching the two of them like that, I just... couldn't bear it anymore.

lines.content: 思わず列車を飛び出し、姫織の手を引いてしまったんだ――……だから、
lines.translated: Before I knew it, I had jumped off the train and pulled Himeori's hand--...and so,

lines.content: ……だから私は、もう消える
lines.translated: "...And so, I will disappear now."

lines.content: たぶん、そうなる。
lines.translated: That is probably how it will turn out.

lines.content: ……[存在|命]が消えるというわけではない。
lines.translated: It doesn't mean my life itself will vanish.

lines.content: ただ、私の中の“[記憶|誰か]”が消えるのだ。
lines.translated: Rather, the "memories"--the "someone" inside me--will fade away.

lines.content: そしてまっしろな“命”となり、新しい“イキモノ”あるいは“生き物”に生まれ変わっていく。
lines.translated: And I will become a pure white "life," reborn as a new "Creature" or living being.

lines.content: ……私という“存在”は何者でもない。ただ、ここにいるだけの“何か”だ――私の中にはたくさんの記憶があった。
lines.translated: My "existence" is nobody in particular. I am merely "something" that happens to be here--and inside me, there were many memories.

lines.content: 今現在の私に至るまで、たくさん、たくさん、“小さな夜の神さま”として、“夜”に産まれ直し、去って行った者たちの記憶だ。
lines.translated: Memories of the many, many beings who were reborn into the "Night" as "little gods of the night" and eventually departed, leading all the way up to the current me.

lines.content: 心も想いも命も引き継ぎ、私という存在は“夜”に生き続けている。
lines.translated: Inheriting their hearts, their feelings, and their lives, the entity that is me continues to live on in the "Night."

lines.content: だから、私の中にある――おそらくは姫織のお母さんだったのだろう誰かの記憶は、[・|い][・|つ]“[・|私]”[・|の][・|中][・|に][・|降][・|り][・|重][・|な][・|っ][・|て][・|き][・|た][・|も][・|の]だったのかな。
lines.translated: So I wonder when the memories of that someone inside me--who was likely Himeori's mother--drifted down and piled up within "me."

lines.content: 私は、自分が誰だかわからない……
lines.translated: "I don't even know who I am..."

lines.content: いわば私は記憶の集合体だ。
lines.translated: In a manner of speaking, I am an accumulation of memories.

lines.content: [・|私][・|の][・|中][・|の][・|そ][・|の][・|人]は、産まれる前に死んでしまった子を、ちゃんとこの世界に産まれさせてあげたかった。
lines.translated: That person inside me wanted to let the child who had died before being born come into this world properly.

lines.content: だから“夜”へ自らの“[命|心臓]”を差し出し、人生を終えた。
lines.translated: So she offered up her own "heart"--her life--to the "Night," bringing her own life to an end.

lines.content: ……果たして。
lines.translated: And then.

lines.content: 果たして[・|そ][・|の][・|子]が幸せな人生を歩めるのかどうか。せめてその歩みを一番近くから見守っていたかった。
lines.translated: Would that child truly be able to walk a happy life? At the very least, she wanted to watch over those steps from the closest place possible.

lines.content: そういう“次”を選びたいと“夜”に願ったのだ。
lines.translated: She wished to the "Night" to choose that kind of "next life."

lines.content: だけど、簡単にはそうはできなかった。
lines.translated: However, it couldn't be done so easily.

lines.content: その人の心にはいっぱいの“罪悪感”が巣くっていた――自分の望みを叶えるために、やさしい人の命をもやそうとした。
lines.translated: An overwhelming sense of "guilt" had taken root in that person's heart--in order to grant her own wish, she had tried to burn away the life of a kind person.

lines.content: ……どうしてそんなことをしてしまったのかわからない。
lines.translated: She didn't understand why she had done such a thing.

lines.content: 『……あのとき、私はおかしかったんだよ』
lines.translated: "'...I was out of my mind back then.'"

lines.content: 誰かの記憶が、今でも私の胸の中で頭を抱え、苦しんでいる。
lines.translated: Even now, someone's memory is clutching its head in agony deep within my chest.

lines.content: 『どうしてあんな恐ろしいことを考えてしまったんだろう。考えるだけでなく、躊躇いもなく、実行にまで移すだなんて。あんなのまるで……』
lines.translated: "'Why did I ever think of doing something so terrible? And not just thinking of it, but actually carrying it out without a shred of hesitation. It was almost as if...'"
Almost as if my heart had been hijacked by something. That's what it felt like...

lines.content: そういうふうに弁明するしかないけれど……そんなもの、心に芽生える罪の意識の前には通用しない。あんまりに無力だ。
lines.translated: That is the only excuse she could make, yet... such words mean nothing before the sense of guilt budding within her heart. They are far too powerless.

lines.content: 『私は双子の妹の居場所を奪い、何不自由なくのうのうと生きてきた』
lines.translated: "'I stole my twin sister's place in the world and lived a carefree life without wanting for anything.'"

lines.content: 私の悪性を数え上げれば切りがない。
lines.translated: If I were to count my wicked deeds, there would be no end to them.

lines.content: 『……私みたいなものがふつうに“願い”や“夢”を叶えてはいけないよ』
lines.translated: "'...Someone like me shouldn't be allowed to have their "wishes" or "dreams" come true like a normal person.'"

lines.content: そんなのはあってはならない。平等じゃない。
lines.translated: Such a thing must not be allowed. It wouldn't be fair.

lines.content: 『人に与えた不幸と同じくらいの不幸の中で、もがいて、苦しんで、消えてなくなるくらいがちょうどいい……』
lines.translated: "'To struggle, suffer, and fade away into nothingness amidst misfortune equal to what I inflicted on others would be just right for me...'"

lines.content: 心に渦巻くそういう“想い”と、大切にしたい子をそばで見守りたいという“想い”とが反発し合い……。
lines.translated: Those "feelings" swirling in her heart clashed against her "desire" to stay close and watch over the child she cherished...

lines.content: これからは自分のためではなく、たくさんの人々のために生きるのだ。
lines.translated: From now on, she would live not for herself, but for the sake of many others.

lines.content: 誰かの“祈り”や“想い”、そして“願い”を運ぶ“イキモノ”へと、その心は生まれ直した。
lines.translated: Her heart was reborn into a "Creature" that carries the "prayers," "feelings," and "wishes" of others.

lines.content: ……そういう存在に、その“[心|記憶]”は、統合された。それが“夜のイキモノ”――“小さな夜の神さま”だ。
lines.translated: Her "memories"--her heart--were integrated into such an existence. That is a "Creature of the Night"--a "little god of the night."

lines.content: そうすることで、いっぱいの“罪悪感”から解き放たれよう。
lines.translated: By doing so, she sought to be freed from the overwhelming "guilt" weighing her down.

lines.content: 心は“夜”の中でその“[道|次]”を選び取った。
lines.translated: Within the "Night," her heart chose that "next path."

lines.content: きらきらまぶしい“夜”の中――私は毎晩毎晩、誰かの“夢”や“希望”を、“夜の果て”にある巨大な駅にまで運び続けた。
lines.translated: Inside the sparkling, dazzling "Night"--night after night, I continued to carry people's "dreams" and "hopes" all the way to the giant station at the "End of the Night."

lines.content: 『そういうふうに忙しく、誰かのために生きていたなら……。何もしてあげられないけど、あの子のそばにいることくらいは許してもらえるよね』
lines.translated: "'If I live busily like that for the sake of others... Even if I can't do anything for her, surely I'll at least be forgiven for staying by that child's side, right?'"

lines.content: そんなふうに自分で自分を納得させて……。
lines.translated: Convincing herself like that...

lines.content: 神社の境内に列車を置いた。
lines.translated: She placed the train on the grounds of the shrine.

lines.content: そこからあの子の毎日をいつも見ていた。
lines.translated: From there, I always watched over that child's everyday life.

lines.content: ……姫織は、どうして？　いつもさみしそうだった。
lines.translated: Why was it that Himeori always looked so lonely?

lines.content: お友だちといるときは元気にはしゃぐ。
lines.translated: When she was with her friends, she would frolic about cheerfully.

lines.content: だけど仲のいい子たちと別れると、石段に腰掛け、暮れる空をぼんやりひとりで眺めてた。
lines.translated: Yet once she parted ways with the kids she was close to, she would sit down on the stone steps and gaze absentmindedly at the darkening sky all by herself.

lines.content: 時おり姫織は鼻を啜ってもいた。
lines.translated: From time to time, Himeori would even sniffle.

lines.content: 列車からではその後ろ姿しか見えない。だけどきっと泣いていた。
lines.translated: From the train, I could only see her from behind. Even so, I knew she had to be crying.

lines.content: 夕暮れ空をひとりぼっちで見ていたら、ふとさみしくなることもあるよね。わかるよ。……わかる。あなたの気持ちは、良くよくわかる。
lines.translated: Gazing at the twilight sky all alone makes you feel a sudden wave of loneliness sometimes, doesn't it? I know. ...I know. I understand how you feel all too well.

lines.content: だからね。さみしそうなあなたの隣に座り、せめてその手を握っていたかったけれど……。
lines.translated: That's why I wanted to sit beside you when you looked so lonely, and at least hold your hand, yet...

lines.content: 『……ごめんね』
lines.translated: "'...I'm sorry.'"

lines.content: そんなことも私にはしてあげられない。
lines.translated: I couldn't even do something like that for you.

lines.content: どうして私、こんななのかなあ
lines.translated: "Why am I like this, I wonder..."

lines.content: 姫織はぐうぐう鳴ってるお腹を困った顔で撫でている――[・|ご][・|め][・|ん][・|ね]。食べてもたべても腹ぺこなのは、年頃になればちょっと恥ずかしいよね。
lines.translated: Himeori rubbed her rumbling stomach with a troubled look on her face--I'm sorry. Being starving no matter how much you eat is a little embarrassing for a girl your age, isn't it?

lines.content: 今日も迷子になっちゃった……。いつも通ってる校舎の中なのに。私、ばかみたい……
lines.translated: "I got lost again today... Even though it's the school building I go to every day. I'm such an idiot..."

lines.content: ぼんやり見上げた夕暮れの空に、姫織はぽつりぽつり、ひとりでつぶやいていた。
lines.translated: Looking up absentmindedly at the twilight sky, Himeori murmured to herself, one quiet word after another.

lines.content: 大雅が、ともちゃんが、千和が、そばにいてくれなくなったら……私、ちゃんとひとりで生きていけるのかな
lines.translated: "If Taiga, Tomo-chan, and Chiwa weren't by my side anymore... I wonder if I'd even be able to live properly on my own."

lines.content: ごめん。本当に、ごめんね。
lines.translated: I'm sorry. I'm truly, truly sorry.

lines.content: あなたがいつも腹ぺこなのは、あなたがいつも進むべき道を見失ってしまうのは……。
lines.translated: The reason you're always starving, and the reason you always lose sight of the path you should take...

lines.content: きっと[・|私]が、あなたの身体を不完全に作ってしまったからだ――そういう“後悔”の“記憶”もまた、私の中にある。
lines.translated: Is surely because I made your body imperfectly--that "memory" of "regret" also resides within me.

lines.content: “刻の終着駅”で[器|依り代]のパーツをひとつずつ購入した。
lines.translated: At the "Terminal Station of Time," I purchased the parts for a vessel one by one.

lines.content: 姫織。あなたが“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”で産まれ直すために必要な身体だ。
lines.translated: Himeori. It was the body required for you to be reborn in the "Time of the Sun"--the real world.

lines.content: そのとき支払いのための“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”が充分ではなく――ごめんね姫織。安物だったりあり合わせのものだったりで誤魔化すしかなかったの。
lines.translated: Back then, I didn't have enough "Star Fragments" to pay for it all--I'm sorry, Himeori. I had no choice but to make do with cheap parts and whatever else was on hand.

lines.content: [器|依り代]を作るにはたくさんの“素材”を購入する必要があった。
lines.translated: To create a vessel, it was necessary to purchase a great many "materials."

lines.content: 持って生まれる“個性”や“才能”でさえも、[器|依り代]に組み込む“素材”で決定してしまう。
lines.translated: Even the "individuality" and "talents" a person is born with are determined by the "materials" built into the vessel.

lines.content: それは、あなたの人生を決定づける大切な作業だったのだ。
lines.translated: It was a crucial task that would define your entire life.

lines.content: だけど……
lines.translated: "However..."

lines.content: 人形の頭の中に組み込んだコンパスは安物だった。お腹の中には殆ど何も詰め込めず、空っぽだった。
lines.translated: The compass I built into the doll's head was a cheap one. And I could barely pack anything into the stomach, leaving it empty.

lines.content: ただただ時間がなくって……。
lines.translated: I simply didn't have enough time...

lines.content: あのときの私はたった一晩しか“夜”にいられなかった。それ以降はもう二度と、立ち入ることができなかった――心が大人になるからだ。
lines.translated: Back then, I could only remain in the "Night" for a single evening. After that, I would never be able to set foot in it again--because my heart was becoming that of an adult.

lines.content: だからもう一度、“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を集めに行くだけの余裕も、なくて……。
lines.translated: So I didn't even have the leeway to go gather more "Star Fragments"...

lines.content: そのままあなたの身体を完成としてしまった。
lines.translated: And I ended up completing your body just like that.

lines.content: ……私の中の“[誰か|記憶]”は、そのときのこともずっと“後悔”してる
lines.translated: "...The 'someone' inside me has regretted what happened back then this whole time, too."

lines.content: 本当にだめなお母さん――[・|私]の中の“[記憶|誰か]”がいつも、嘆いてた。
lines.translated: What a truly terrible mother--the "someone" within my "memories" was always lamenting.

lines.content: [・|私]がもっとたくさん“[ほし|惑星]のかけら”を集められていて、もっともっと、あなたにぴったりなパーツを購入できてたら……
lines.translated: "If only I had been able to gather more 'Star Fragments' and buy parts that suited you so much better..."

lines.content: 私のせいだ。
lines.translated: It's my fault.

lines.content: 私がしっかりしていなかったせいで……。
lines.translated: Because I didn't have my act together...

lines.content: 上手に、器用に、生きて行けているとは決して言えない姫織……。
lines.translated: Himeori could never be said to be living her life smoothly or skillfully...

lines.content: ……こんな私じゃあ、いつか誰にも相手にされなくなっちゃうよ
lines.translated: "...If I stay the way I am, someday no one will want anything to do with me anymore."

lines.content: 姫織はいつもさみしそうに空を見ていた。
lines.translated: Himeori was always gazing up at the sky looking so lonely.

lines.content: 心にぽっかり穴がある。自分の力だけでは埋められそうにない小さな、だけどとても鋭く深い穴だった。
lines.translated: There was a gaping hole in her heart. It was a small, yet terribly sharp and deep hole that she couldn't seem to fill through her own power alone.

lines.content: まるで自分の半身を見ているようだ――私の中の“誰か”がそう言っていた。
lines.translated: It's just like looking at my own other half--the "someone" inside me used to say that.

lines.content: 大丈夫だよ。誰にも相手にされなくなったとしても、私がいる。そばにいるよ。あなたはひとりぼっちじゃない。
lines.translated: It's okay. Even if no one else wants anything to do with you, I am here. I'm right by your side. You aren't all alone.

lines.content: だからお願い、もう、泣かないで
lines.translated: "So please, don't cry anymore."

lines.content: そういう想いも言葉も、届かないから……。
lines.translated: Because neither those feelings nor those words could ever reach her...

lines.content: もしもこの先、何かあなたが、その人生の中でつまずいてしまうようなことがあったなら、
lines.translated: If by some chance you were to stumble along the way in your life from here on out,

lines.content: そのときは、私が一番に手を貸したい。力になりたい。
lines.translated: When that time comes, I want to be the very first to lend you a hand. I want to be your strength.

lines.content: そう願い……。
lines.translated: Wishing for that...

lines.content: その瞬間を、夢にまで見て……。
lines.translated: Even dreaming of that moment...

lines.content: ……あなたの生きていく世界を、守らなきゃ
lines.translated: "...I have to protect the world you're going to live in."

lines.content: あなたがまだ、大雅たちと出会う前のことだ……。
lines.translated: That was back before you had met Taiga and the others...

lines.content: “夜の王”と呼ばれる破壊の主が近く現れるのだという“噂”を聞いた。
lines.translated: I heard a "rumor" that a lord of destruction called the "King of the Night" would soon appear.

lines.content: そして“[現実世界|太陽の時間]”までをも暗闇の底に浸食し――人類は、滅びる。
lines.translated: And that he would erode even the "Time of the Sun"--the real world--sinking it to the bottom of the darkness, and humanity would perish.

lines.content: そんな“噂”が、“夜”の中でいつの間にかまことしやかに囁かれるようになっていた。
lines.translated: Before anyone knew it, such "rumors" had begun to be whispered quite plausibly throughout the "Night."

lines.content: そんなこと、させないよ……絶対に
lines.translated: "I won't let that happen... Never."

lines.content: “夜の魔法使い”と話をし、力を合わせようとうなずきあって……。
lines.translated: Speaking with the "Magician of the Night," we nodded to each other in agreement to join forces...

lines.content: 人類の敵“夜の王”を倒せるだろう心の力を持つ子たちを、様々な場所から集めて周り……。
lines.translated: We went around gathering children from various places who possessed the strength of heart needed to defeat humanity's enemy, the "King of the Night"...

lines.content: すべては、姫織。あなたの人生が少しでも生きやすいものになりますようにと祈った結果で……。
lines.translated: All of it, Himeori, was the result of my prayers that your life might become even a little bit easier to live...

lines.content: だけど……“夜の王”との戦いに、まさか姫織も参加しようだなんて。そんなこと、思いもしなかったけど
lines.translated: "Even so... I never would have imagined that you would end up participating in the battle against the 'King of the Night' too, Himeori."

lines.content: でも、その集いの中で、姫織は大切なお友だちと出会えたのだと思ってる。
lines.translated: However, I believe that through that gathering, Himeori was able to meet precious friends.

lines.content: ……少し怖い思いをさせてしまったかもしれない。でも、“後悔”はない。
lines.translated: I may have put her through some frightening experiences. Even so, I have no "regrets."

lines.content: 人生はきっと、どんな人と出会うかで光りにも闇にも変わるものだと思うから――姫織が出会ったもののその中に、かけがえのない宝物が眠ってる。そう思う。
lines.translated: Because I believe a person's life can turn into either light or darkness depending on the people they meet--and among those Himeori met, an irreplaceable treasure lies waiting. That is what I think.

lines.content: お別れしたあとにぼんやり空を見上げて、ちょっとさみしく思えるのは、きっと……その“繋がり”を大切に思えているからだ。
lines.translated: After saying goodbye to them, the reason she looks up absentmindedly at the sky and feels a little lonely is surely... because she cherishes those "connections" so deeply.

lines.content: 少しだけ安心だった。
lines.translated: It was a small relief.

lines.content: きっと、この子たちが姫織のことを決してひとりぼっちにはさせないだろう――姫織は、もしみんなが相手にしてくれなくなったらどうしようと、怖く思っているみたいだけれど。
lines.translated: Surely, these kids will never let Himeori be all alone--even though Himeori herself seems terrified of what she would do if everyone stopped wanting anything to do with her.

lines.content: でも、それは心配することないって感じるよ、姫織
lines.translated: "Still, I get the feeling you don't need to worry about that, Himeori."

lines.content: だから、あとは……。
lines.translated: So, all that's left is...

lines.content: あとは、私は私の“夢”を叶えたいと、思ってた。
lines.translated: All that was left was wanting to make my own "dream" come true.
Over and over, I murmured this within my heart.

lines.content: あなたがもし人生に迷ったり、つまづいてしまうようなことがあったなら、私が必ず一番に駆けつけて、力を貸すよ
lines.translated: "If you ever lose your way in life or end up stumbling, I will definitely be the very first to rush to your side and lend you my strength."

lines.content: そして今夜、私は列車を飛び出し、あなたの背中を押したのだ――私は“夢”を叶えた。そのはずだ。
lines.translated: And tonight, I leapt off the train and gave you that push forward--I made my "dream" come true. At least, I should have.

lines.content: ……ねえ、どうかな。私、少しはあなたの役に立てたかな
lines.translated: "...Hey, what do you think? Was I able to be of some help to you?"

lines.content: だめだめなお母さんだった……かもしれない、だめだめな私。
lines.translated: She might have been a hopeless mother... just like hopeless me.

lines.content: 大人になっても。親になっても。人間ってどうして失敗ばかりするのかな。不思議だな。私の中の“誰か”がそう言っている。
lines.translated: Even when they grow up. Even when they become parents. Why do humans do nothing but make mistakes? How strange. The "someone" inside me is saying that.

lines.content: どれくらい時間が経ってしまっていたのだろう。
lines.translated: I wonder how much time has passed.

lines.content: 既に見上げた空は夕暮れに凪いでいた。
lines.translated: When I looked up, the sky had already settled into a calm dusk.

lines.content: ふたりが去って行ってから半日以上が経っている。つくずく“夜のイキモノ”は時間に鈍感だ。
lines.translated: Over half a day had passed since the two of them left. "Creatures of the Night" really are terribly insensitive to the passage of time.

lines.content: “規則”を破ってしまった私は……。
lines.translated: Having broken the "rules," I...

lines.content: あの太陽が沈めば、私は“夜”の中で、まったく別の私に産まれ直す……。
lines.translated: Once that sun sets, I will be reborn within the "Night" as a completely different me...

lines.content: 私の中の“[記憶|誰か]”たちは、ここですべて消えるだろう。
lines.translated: All the "memories"--the "someones" inside me--will vanish right here.

lines.content: もう今までの私はそこにはいない。
lines.translated: The me who existed until now will no longer be there.

lines.content: ……そういう“[リスク|代償]”を背負わなければ、私は自分の“罪悪感”を押し込めて、姫織のそばに産まれ直すことはできなかった。
lines.translated: Without bearing that kind of "price"--that "risk"--I never could have suppressed my "guilt" and been reborn by Himeori's side.

lines.content: 姫織のことをいつも大切に想い、いつもその未来に幸せが多くありますようにと祈ってた。
lines.translated: I always thought of Himeori so dearly, and always prayed that her future would be filled with happiness.

lines.content: そういう想いのすべてがまっしろになる。
lines.translated: All of those feelings will be wiped completely blank.

lines.content: 別にこの命が終わってしまうと言うわけではないけれど……。
lines.translated: It isn't as though this life of mine is coming to an end, and yet...

lines.content: 積み重ねてきた“記憶”のすべてが消えるということは、死と同じように怖いものだ。
lines.translated: Having every last "memory" you've built up disappear is just as terrifying as death.

lines.content: もう、少しだけ……
lines.translated: "Just a little longer..."

lines.content: 見上げた空につぶやいた。
lines.translated: I muttered at the sky above.

lines.content: もう少しだけ、姫織……。あなたのことをそばで見ていたかったな
lines.translated: "Just a little longer, Himeori... I wanted to watch over you from right by your side."

lines.content: こういう形で“夜”を生きたことも、最後に姫織の力になれたことにも、何も……何ひとつ、“後悔”なんてなかったけれど。
lines.translated: Even though I had no... not a single "regret" about living in the "Night" in this form, or about being able to help Himeori at the very end.

lines.content: ……やっぱりもう少しだけ、あなたの成長をそばで見つめていたい
lines.translated: "...Even so, I want to stay by your side and watch you grow up just a little longer."

lines.content: ねえ、姫織。あなたがこの先、[・|私]とは違い、本当に誰かのことを好きになったりして……あなたもたくさん、いっぱい、誰かに愛されて……
lines.translated: "Hey, Himeori. In the future, unlike me, you might truly fall in love with someone... and be loved so, so very much by someone in return..."

lines.content: 大切な人と手を繋いで笑って歩く。そんな姫織の姿を、いつか、見てみたかったなあ……
lines.translated: "Walking hand in hand with someone precious to you, smiling together. I really wished I could have seen you like that someday, Himeori..."

lines.content: 消えたくない。
lines.translated: I don't want to disappear.

lines.content: そう、思った。
lines.translated: That was what I thought.

lines.content: 姫織が幸せになれたんだとわかるまで……。
lines.translated: Not until I know for sure that Himeori has found happiness...

lines.content: お願い……。
lines.translated: Please...

lines.content: 誰でもいい。何でもいい。……聞こえてますか。
